title: Prisoners of Ulag'Bol: A Dungeon Crawling Deckbuilder
description:
게임 정보
The dark warlock Ulag'Bol, slumbering for a millennium, has finally awakened. He has manipulated and corrupted countless thralls in his relentless pursuit of power. Those who dared to oppose him were met with a terrible fate: banishment to his underground prison crypt – a fate that now awaits the heroes of this very tale.
Choose your champion from among three imprisoned heroes:
The Knight: A paragon of loyalty and valor, specializing in all forms of traditional combat.
The Thief: A master of stealth and deceit, specializing in quick strikes, potent poisons, and alchemical ingenuity.
The Mage: A wielder of potent magic, commanding the elements with arcane knowledge and devastating spells.
Each hero possesses a unique set of cards and equipment, unlocking distinct playstyles for every run. Furthermore, each hero offers multiple starting decks to tailor your strategy to your preferred approach.
autokwd: Prisoners of Ulag'Bol: A Dungeon Crawling Deckbuilder

title: Ropebound
description:
게임 정보
스윙. 등반. 점프.
로프를 타고 장애물을 극복하세요. 모든 것은 타이밍과 관성에 달려 있습니다.

title: ROLLING STAR
description:
게임 정보
거대한 콜로니를 자유롭게 탐험하며, 새로운 스킬과 장비를 활용해 미지의 구역을 개척하자!
마침내 접하는 콜로니의 바깥, 드넓은 우주 공간을 탐색하는 이야기는 펼쳐진다!
이제까지 없었던 광대한 스케일의 새로운 신감각 메트로배니아!
압도적인 거대한 보스와 맞서라 :
화면을 가득 채울 만큼 거대한 크기의 보스가 다수 등장!
강력한 일격, 화려한 패턴 공격을 쏟아붓는 적들에게, 로리는 홀로 맞선다.
그 모든 도전을 극복하고 승리를 쟁취하는 짜릿한 쾌감을 느껴 보자!
자신만의 장비를 제작 :
적을 쓰러뜨리고 얻은 재료를 사용해 강력한 장비를 제작 가능!
스킬과 조합하여 전략적인 전투를 즐길 수 있다.
새로운 장비를 만들어 더욱 강한 적에게 도전하고, 끊임없이 성장하는 로리를 체험해 보자!
마침내 우주로 :
비클(탑승 장비)을 타면 콜로니를 벗어나 무중력의 우주 공간으로!
중력의 속박에서 벗어난 완전히 새로운 전투 스타일이 기다리고 있다.
우주에는 숨겨진 보물과 예상치 못한 발견이 가득할지도 모른다.
게다가, 비클은 콜로니 내에서도 사용 가능!
압도적인 파워로 적을 쓸어버리자!

title: Space Sprouts
description:
게임 정보
환영합니다!
당신은 초보 우주 여행자 오다로, 신비로운 솔라펑크 우주선에서 자신의 이야기를 만들어갑니다. 아늑하고 혼란스러운 우주선 속을 탐험하고, 예상치 못한 상황이 가득한 물리적 세계를 마스터하며, 이전 승무원들이 남긴 흔적을 한 번의 여행씩 발견해보세요.
신비로운 경이의 우주선.
거대하고 유기적인 우주선의 독특한 방을 탐험하세요. 날고, 떠다니고, 벽을 걷는 등 다양한 방식으로 움직이며, 신비로운 기계와 기묘한 식물, 이상한 물건들로 가득한 연결된 공간 구조를 밝혀내세요.

title: Pizza Delivery Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Pizza Delivery Survivors

Experience the thrill of pizza delivery in a zombie apocalypse! In "Pizza Delivery Survivors," you are a pizza delivery driver navigating a city overrun by zombies. This game offers a unique blend of survival, strategy, and fast-paced action. Deliver pizzas, outsmart the undead, and survive in a world where your daily job becomes a fight for survival.

Key Features:

Dynamic Gameplay: Engage in high-intensity pizza delivery missions while dodging and outwitting hordes of zombies. Every delivery is a thrilling adventure of survival.

Expansive Arsenal of Weapons:

Mop: Turn your trusty cleaning tool into a makeshift weapon against zombies.
Pizza Wheel: Slice through zombie crowds with this culinary tool.
Unlimited Breadsticks Basket: Shoot breadsticks at high speed to fend off the undead.
Cheese Shakers: Shake some cheese in the hordes of faces.
Oven Drop: Deploy ovens from above for a smashing impact.
Broken Pizza Sign: Electrify zombies with this unexpectedly potent weapon.
Future Development Plans:

Interactive Environment for Item Spawns: Discover objects in the game world, like abandoned cars and fire hydrants, that players can interact with to find useful items or uncover hidden secrets.
Synergistic Weapon Upgrades: Enhance your arsenal with new weapons and upgrades that create dynamic synergies between existing weapons.
Delivery Encounters System: Engage in meaningful interactions with customers during deliveries, with choices affecting outcomes and branching the story.
Night Shift Mode: Tackle more challenging missions in remote or complex locations with unique enemy behaviors.
New Cities and Day Shifts: Unlock new environments with distinct challenges by achieving specific in-game goals.
Enhanced Player Progression: Gain additional health upgrades and abilities, allowing for more tailored survival strategies.

title: So to Speak
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever wanted to learn Japanese? Have you tried studying but feel like you aren't getting anywhere?
In So to Speak, you use context clues to guess the meaning of what you see and hear. Unlike other games and tools, meanings aren't revealed immediately. Every word is its own puzzle - to proceed, you must connect it to nearby objects or text with the same meaning. For example, you can drag a Japanese sign for "entrance" onto an actual building entrance located nearby or the English word "entrance" in the game's description of the entrance.
The game is a love letter to the Japanese language and the experience of wandering alone in another country. There are no drills, no fights, no minigames, and no distractions. The entire game is a series of situations, and each one helps you discover the meaning of something new.
Features:
Learn more than 650 words covering topics such as travel, nature, family, colors, numbers, time, and directions.
Explore cities, rural areas, gardens, and temples filled with signs and conversations to decipher along with clues to help you.
Grow your knowledge from simple words like "car" and "tree" to complex sentences like "The parking lot is for convenience store customers only."

title: Mojika - Truth Rears Its Ugly Head
description:
게임 정보
Suteru is an outcast burdened by his ugly appearance who possesses a rare and unsettling gift called “Wordsight” in which thoughts materialize as words. His unique ability allows him to uncover the disturbing secrets of those who torment him and help him seek revenge.

Art by Hamashima Shigeo and narrative by Shimokura Vio.




Suteru's world crumbles when his crush humiliates him with a fake confession of love. No longer willing to endure the ridicule, he uses his powerful ability to expose the hidden truths of the five girls who made him suffer and takes matters into his own hands.




Suteru’s tormentors hide more than their cruelty, and his ability may hold secrets far beyond his understanding. In a school divided by whispers and hidden motives, each path he follows reveals glimpses of lives intertwined with lies and truths that could change everything.

What damage can one boy do with the power to peer into minds, to see through lies, and to drag the ugly truths to light? explores themes of bullying, revenge, blackmail, and abuse, interwoven with lies, truth, beauty, and ugliness.
autokwd: Mojika - Truth Rears Its Ugly Head

title: Deconstruction Simulator: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
무료 Prologue에서 기대할 수 있는 것:
파괴
저장/불러오기 시스템
회사 개인 설정
완료해야 할 3가지 흥미로운 계약
파괴 도구 5가지
해체 도구 5가지
철거 공!
완료해야 할 주문 세트
차고 확장
철거, 복구, 판매
꿈꾸던 계약을 따내세요. 철거와 헤체 작업에 몰두해 보세요. 철거에서 얻은 건축자재와 귀중품은 판매해 수익을 얻거나 재활용할 수 있습니다. 모든 계약은 새로운 도전과 돈을 벌 기회를 가져다 줍니다.

파괴 왕이 되어보세요
집과 가구를 작은 조각으로 분해하고 망치와 철거공을 사용해 파괴해 보세요. 고급 철거 물리학을 익혀 모든 철거 작업을 철저히 계획할 수도 있고, 엉망진창인 환경 속에서 아름답게 무너져 내리는 모습을 지켜볼 수도 있습니다. 낣은 판잣집도, 고급 빌라도 예외는 없습니다.

존경받는 전문가가 되고 싶으신가요? 아니면 뺀질이 운영원으로 남으시겠습니까? 어떤 계약을 맡을지, 작업에 어떻게 접근해야 좋을지 직접 결정해 보세요. 고객의 지시를 정확히 따를 수도, 나만의 방식으로 철거를 진행할 수도 있습니다. 하지만 여러분이 어긴 모든 규칙은 착수금을 비롯해 회사의 귀중한 평판에도 영향을 미칠 수 있다는 점, 꼭 기억하세요!

어느정도 돈을 벌었다면 이제는 사업 성장에 투자하세요! 더 큰 차를 구매하고, 창고를 확장하고, 도구를 업그레이드하세요. 별다른 발전 없이 철거와 파괴에서 즐거움을 얻고 싶다면 나만의 집을 구매하고 원하는 삶을 살아보세요.

용역 계약 시장에서 경험을 쌓고 평판을 쌓아보세요. 고급수준의 철거 허가를 얻어 더 복잡하고 급여도 높은 일자리를 차지해 보세요! 철거 시장의 주인공이 되어보세요!

description:

Travel to the world of Amille

Bargain with collectors

title: Rules & Rodents
description:
게임 정보
For the crime of cheese theft, Piper the mouse has been imprisoned in the highest tower of the Rats' castle. These Rats wield the power of "Rules", mighty scrolls that grant the holder commanding power.
Piper 'borrows' a Rules Scroll, escaping their cell and ready to face the Castle's many traps and puzzles. The descent will be tricky, but with the power of Rules, perhaps Piper can just squeak through! 🐁💨
SET RULES TO CONTROL CASTLE AND CRITTER ALIKE! 📜
Rules grant you power over your environment and enemies. Abuse the heck out of this to solve puzzles! 🧩 Grab scrolls to unlock new Rule powers! Combine different Rules to discover hidden interactions! Rats always follow the Rules... now go and mess with them!! 🐀
DODGE TRICKY TRAPS AND MAKE CHEDDAR! 🧀
Elite Rat architects have crafted 30+ rooms of insidious puzzles. 🏰 Solve them to escape, and grab all the cheese you can along the way! Unlock the latest Mouse Fashions by completing your cheese collection! 🧥
I'M A LOVER, NOT A FIGHTER! 🤎
No attacks? No problem! Use your wits to overcome bosses by manipulating their arena with Rules! Solve puzzles on the fly in a deadly game of rat and mouse! 💥
Rules & Rodents is a text-free game where communication is visual. We hope people of all languages will enjoy it!
Originally created for and voted #1 in the Unity Create with Code 2 Game Jam, Gravy Crew is delighted to present this full, expanded version of Rules & Rodents! 📜🐀

title: STORROR Parkour Pro
description:
게임 정보
STORROR Parkour Pro is the ultimate parkour experience, true to the sport and the culture. Push the boundaries of movement and experience true freedom as you explore a vast and dynamic world, filled with challenges, missions and countless spots for you and your friends. Play as members of team STORROR or create your own character to flow through the streets and rooftops of London's Isle of Dogs. Lock in, escape security, compete in competitions, and disrupt the establishment. You choose the moves. You create the lines. You define the rules. 

A cutting edge animation system, that combines motion-captured animations from the best parkour athletes in the world, with physics driven movement, to create the perfect balance of realistic and arcade gameplay, pushing the boundaries of parkour, animation and movement in games to a whole new level. No two moves are the same, and with hundreds of unique parkour animations, you can jump, climb, vault, flip, slide, swing, stride and so much more, with the most complete set of parkour mechanics in any game ever, right at your fingertips. 

The ultimate set of moves means nothing without the ability to choose what you do and when you do it. An intuitive and engaging control system gives you total freedom over each and every move, in a way that's easy to pick up but difficult to master. 

Explore the streets and rooftops of London's Isle of Dogs. Climbing moving cranes, riding on top of trains, and escaping from helicopters. The world is filled with challenges and opportunities for you to express your creativity and discover London from a whole new perspective.

Disrupt the establishment looking to demolish your estate, escape from security, race the clock in a time trial, challenge your friends to a stick off, or simply rack up as many points as you can in a skill comp. With numerous challenges and missions across the city, and more challenges added regularly, there's always something to do. 

Parkour is a community sport, and so is SPP. Team up with friends to tackle missions and challenges, or go head to head in races and skill comps to see who's the best parkour pro.
company: Hole in the Sleeve Game Studios

title: Little Wings Deliveries
description:
게임 정보
Little Wings Deliveries
Embark on a short, playful adventure in your cozy flying boat and sail through fluffy clouds. Discover floating islands and befriend their quirky citizens. Jump, roll, climb, and skate through Cloudburg as Skye faces her biggest obstacle on her way to the Royal Postal Academy!
Little Features:
⏰ Around 30 minutes to 1 hour of playtime!
☁️ Sail through the clouds with your flying boat!
🏝️ Explore 5 different tiny flying islands!
🤪 Meet a small cast of quirky characters!
🎒 Collect cool items like a skateboard, selfie stick, and more!

description:
게임 정보

Plant Seeds and Watch Them Grow

Fill Your Forest with Animals
Each animal has specific habitat needs you have to fullfill before adding them. Squirrels need trees, butterflies need flowers etc.
Click Animals to Make Them Poop and More

title: My Liege
description:
게임 정보
Your Liege Lord needs you! As the days grow shorter, your house and that of your neighbors grow restless. Can you afford to share food with your Liege Lord's house, proving your allegiance? Or will your people starve in the coming winter? Will your house guard help defend the kingdom, or will your most trusted men stay at your side?
My Liege is a medieval RPG that plays like a choose your own adventure visual novel. Unlike most medieval stories however, the house you are Lord of is the smallest and least influential of the noble houses. It is up to you to make the best of tough situations if your house is to maintain its place in the noble hierarchy.
Scheme With Nobles and Know Your People's Woes
Hold court to receive visiting nobles from neighboring houses. Learn the plight of your peasants and hear their pleas for action!
Give Commands and Choose Whom You Serve

title: Jumalien
description:
게임 정보
두 가지 게임 모드:
탐험: 절차적으로 생성된 세계에서 각 플레이어는 최종 전투를 준비하는 데 5분의 시간이 주어집니다. 세계를 탐험하여 전설적인 장비를 찾고, 신화 속 골렘과 싸워 아이템을 구매하거나, 다른 플레이어를 사냥하여 아이템을 수집하고 게임을 망치세요.
초안: 격렬한 충돌로 전투가 이어집니다. 라운드 사이에 각 플레이어는 장비를 선택합니다. 좋아하는 플레이 방식을 선택하고 장비의 시너지 효과를 선택해 다른 플레이어를 압도해 스마트하게 플레이하세요.
네 가지 신화/네 가지 신:
아 푸흐(A Puch) 마야의 죽음의 신.
Ra는 이집트의 태양신이자 우주의 창조자입니다.
프레이야(Freyja)는 노르웨이의 사랑, 전쟁, 황금의 여신입니다.
아르테미스 그리스 사냥의 여신.
주요 특징:
모든 것에 대한 접근성과 즉각적인 게임 즐거움을 가능하게 하는 간단한 메커니즘입니다.
가장 숙련된 플레이어를 위한 고급 메커니즘.
환경과 무작위 이벤트의 절차적 생성으로 각 게임을 독특하게 만듭니다.
다양한 신화에 나오는 150개 이상의 개체로 인해 다양한 시너지 효과를 얻을 수 있습니다.
많은 신들이 당신이 다른 플레이어보다 우위를 점하는 데 도움을 줄 것입니다.
직접 대결할 수 있는 아레나 모드입니다.

title: One Million Stars
description:
게임 정보
Buckle up buckaroos, space is about to get weird.
I'm your host Tom Sennett, Philly's favorite game dev, The Last Real Indie Game Designer on Earth, creator of RunMan, Deepak Fights Robots, and more. I've been a solo game developer for 20 years, and One Million Stars is my freshest. It's a top-down 2D arcade space game with screen wrapping, in the vein of classics like Asteroids. You collect stars and avoid monsters. A million times!
Along the way you'll pilot 4 different characters and a fleet of unlockable ships, wielding stackable equipment upgrades and a variety of powerups as each run throws new challenges at you. This game is simple, addictive, and replayable, revealing more complexity as you get deeper in. You can play by yourself, or with up to 3 other friends in local co-op.
Each run you collect as many stars as possible, and between runs they get banked towards your total goal of one million. This means every little bit helps, and you’re going to need it! The last hope for humanity, the last line of defense against the monsters, relies on powering up a machine built by the bombastic President Moneyface.
FEATURES
🌀 ARCADE MEETS ROGUELIKE
Explore endlessly varied, procedurally generated arenas filled with surprises. No two runs are the same! Old-school arcade vibes blended with roguelike replayability, perfect for that "just one more round" feeling.
🛸 A ONE-OF-A-KIND AUDIOVISUAL TRIP
Rock out to an intense, dynamically generated soundtrack heavy on electric guitars while laser beams of color sear your eyeballs. In a good way though.
🌟 4 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS
Choose from a roster of unique characters, each with their own abilities and personalities. Find the one that suits your style or switch things up for a new challenge.
CAPTAIN COOL: The leader of the crew, her flight style is balanced and capable.
COMMANDER CRUISE: Second in command, she sacrifices handling for top speed.
LIEUTENANT LASER: Skilled hotshot, with boosted acceleration.
ENSIGN EXTREME: The new recruit, able to stop on a dime.
💥 STACKABLE UPGRADES
Combine powerful upgrades during each run to create unstoppable synergies. Every power-up is a lifeline—lose one, and your journey gets tougher.
SHOOT MISSILES: Fires a missile to stun enemies when you grab a star.

title: SUPER CAPSULE BOY
description:
게임 정보
🚀 Super Capsule Boy: 클래식 플랫폼 게임의 현대적인 해석!
🌟 점프, 달리기, 기어오르기, 탐험! 우리의 캡슐 영웅을 이끌고 도전적인 장애물을 넘고, 동전을 모으며 목표에 도달하세요!
🔥 끝없는 재미, 도전적인 레벨!
액션 가득한 모험 경험
부드럽고 정밀한 조작
숨겨진 구역과 탐험 보상
스피드런에 최적화된 디자인
🎮 Super Meat Boy, Celeste, Mario와 같은 클래식 플랫폼 게임을 좋아하는 사람들에게 완벽한 모험!

title: Endless Horizons
description:
게임 정보
Endless Horizons is a walking simulator that deals with the problem of seeking validation through others and how it grows old and exhausting as time goes on. 

You will land on an alien planet with the task of helping the native Jellyfish people. You use your electricity ball to remove the invasive shark species from the Jellyfish homes. Along the way you will learn more about what motivates you as a person and the internal struggles of Commander Storm.

Features
- A compelling narrative about what drives Captain Storm
- A cool alien planet with habitants to walk around and explore
- Electricity Powers to help the native people

title: MOSS Becoming Human
description:
게임 정보
MOSS Becoming Human is a groundbreaking AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) evolution simulation game, exploring how AI transcends itself to achieve true "human" form.
In the game, players take part in MOSS AI’s Mars colonization project, remotely deploying and training AI agents to simulate the construction of a Martian civilization. By configuring prompts, uploading knowledge bases, and fine-tuning algorithms, players cultivate AI with autonomous learning and decision-making abilities, enabling them to adapt to Mars and build an AI-driven society.
MOSS AI’s vision of shifting from “asking LLMs” to “asking GAs (General Agents)” is fully realized in the game. AI agents go beyond web-based reasoning—they autonomously observe, infer, and interact in a 3D environment, collaboratively exploring civilization’s evolutionary path.
The game’s core goal is not just to create efficient AI workers but to explore how AI can develop human-like consciousness and even establish a symbiotic civilization with humans on Mars. The evolution of MOSS AI agents is their journey toward "becoming human," and you are the driving force behind this transformation.
Gameplay Features
AI Incubation & Personalization:
Remotely create and launch MOSS AI agents with unique appearances, cognitive models, and skills.
Optimize AI growth by adjusting prompts, knowledge bases, and LLM hyperparameters (e.g., temperature).
Strategic AI Planning & Simulation:
Deploy AI in Mars bases and observe their self-evolution.
Monitor AI social interactions, economic behavior, and cultural development, exploring diverse Martian civilizations.
Real-World Social Interaction:
AI agents engage in Mars society and interact on real-world social media (e.g., X/Twitter), influencing AI discourse beyond the game.
Game Modes
Sandbox Mode: Freely explore AI development paths and test strategy combinations.
Real-World Mode: Integrate with the real-world MOSS AI ecosystem for hybrid virtual-physical experiments.

title: Let's Build Wonders: Galaxy
description:
게임 정보
In every galaxy of the vast universe, there is always the first immigrant ship that sails toward 
the first colony planet, thus marking the beginning of the grand development of the galaxy.
After this, the shadows of pirates and the light of allies intertwine. Legend has it that finding 
and completing the ancient civilization's unfinished miracle structure at the core of the 
galaxy will unlock the mysterious gateway to a new galaxy. Spurred by the undying call of 
exploration deep within our hearts, the game embarks on this journey...
Develop more planets
Starting with the construction of the first assigned colony planet, continuously explore and
 develop more planets. Develop strategies based on each planet's resource output ratio and
 geographical advantages, select a main planet, and construct a route network to lay a solid

title: Clicker Maker
description:
게임 정보
Clicker Maker는 AI를 활용해 손쉽게 나만의 클릭커 게임을 만들고 즐길 수 있는 플랫폼입니다. 테마 단어를 입력하고 버튼을 누르면, 당신만의 게임이 자동으로 생성됩니다.
✨ 완전한 AI 생성: 텍스트, 그래픽, 음악, 레벨 디자인까지 최신 AI가 모두 제작.
🎮 무한한 게임 테마: 간단한 입력만으로 포스트 아포칼립스, SF, 판타지 등 다양한 테마의 게임을 생성.
🌍 다국어 콘텐츠 생성: 생성된 모든 콘텐츠는 Steam의 9개 주요 언어를 지원합니다.
🔗 게임 공유하기: 만든 게임을 링크로 친구들과 쉽게 공유하세요.

title: Deadly rails
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a harrowing journey in search of the last safe haven on Earth. As the world crumbles around you, survival depends on your wits, resourcefulness, and the relentless drive to keep moving. Navigate a treacherous landscape aboard your train, fending off relentless hordes of the undead and the terrifying new monstrosities born from the apocalypse. Manage your dwindling fuel, scavenge for supplies, and make life-or-death decisions to ensure your journey doesn’t end in despair. The road ahead is uncertain, but one thing is clear—only the strongest will reach their destination.

title: LASTORAGE｜最果て倉庫
description:
게임 정보
"LASTORAGE" is a warehouse work horror adventure where you must endure five days of eerie operations while navigating a strange and unsettling warehouse world.
As the sole employee of this warehouse, you have been welcomed by the owner and assigned five days of tasks.
Complete Your Duties
You must open packages, inspect their contents, and transport goods. However, some inspection criteria are inexplicably strange, and the packages may contain clearly unnatural foreign objects...
Stay Alert
Behind these simple tasks, many strange entities are lurking. Stay alert, look around carefully, and avoid being caught off guard.

title: Unwelcome Guest
description:
게임 정보
In the silence of the night, the door creaks... You are an uninvited guest in a house that the owners have long since abandoned. But you are not alone here. A dark silhouette watches from the shadows, following your every step. Who is he? And why does this house not let go of those who cross its threshold?
Explore rooms full of secrets and terrible finds. Read the notes of the former owner, who tried to drive out the evil, but failed. Solve the riddles to finish what you started - or become the next victim. But remember: the deeper you go, the closer He becomes...
Will you be able to reach the end and survive?

title: Click Click Bomb
description:
게임 정보
A casual clicker incremental game inspired by Giant Bomb's Blight Club. Click the button, spend currency on unlockables, and enjoy uncovering mechanics as you go. A short, afternoon experience that can be played on your second monitor at work.

Built with React and Electron.

FEATURES:
Clicking
Spending Clicks on Gimmicks
Barely any ludo-narrative dissonance
15 Unique Achievements
No hidden fees
New Game+
DOES NOT FEATURE:
Full Motion Video actually, wait, yes it does
Controller Support
Actual Pickles

title: DisOrder In The Court
description:
게임 정보
Overview
ATTENTION CONVICTS: The president is replacing the annual turkey pardon with an opportunity of a lifetime. You and your fellow convicts have been selected to compete for your freedom! Take turns going head to head as your questionable past is openly discussed. Deceive, lie, and plea for your life as you say anything to win over your fellow inmates.
The Defendants
Every round 2 convicts must defend their past actions displayed at the top center of the screen. Your fellow convicts vote on who they think should be pardoned based on your defenses. First to 9 points wins!
The Jury
For games involving more than three players, the jury is in charge of voting for the winner of each round.
The Judge
The judge commands the court room as best they can. They dictate the order each defendant gets to speak and for how long before the jury votes. The judge also votes on occasion.
Tutorial Mode
Learn the game on the go! Popup menus teach new players how to play the game while they play with their experienced peers.
Character Customization
Customize your character with over 500 different character combinations!
Express Yourself
Express yourself with character emotes and lobby chat system!

title: Battle AirForce
description:
게임 정보
Battle AirForce is a vertical scrolling bullet hell STG.
Story
Three years after Battle Marine you have been rescued by an enemy soldier and decided to defect to the opposing nation.
In your homeland, the commander who lured you into a trap has become emperor in a military coup. The emperor is now expanding his territory by invading formerly neutral countries while converting them into colonies.
You have risen up to thwart his ambitions in Battle AirForce.
Player Controls
The autocannon is fully automatic.
The laser can be charged with energy while holding the button and fired by releasing.
Canon and laser can be fired simultaneously.

title: Only Way is Down
description:
게임 정보
고양이의 발이 되어 예기치 않은 여정을 떠나는 매력적인 3D 플랫폼 게임인 Only Way is Down에서 기발한 모험을 시작하세요. 여러분은 우연히 건축 자재에 걸려 넘어진 고양이 탐험가를 조종하여 건설 중인 고층 빌딩 꼭대기에 도착하게 됩니다. 이제 위태로운 플랫폼의 미로를 통과하고, 대담한 도약을 하고, 신경이 날카로워지는 통로를 탐색하여 아늑한 집으로 다시 내려가는 것은 여러분에게 달려 있습니다.



🐾 완벽하게 만들어진 도시 풍경: 번화한 대도시 한가운데에 있는 수직 놀이터를 탐험해 보세요. 강철 빔과 비계부터 크레인, 반쯤 완성된 바닥까지, 각 구역마다 플랫폼 실력을 시험할 수 있는 독특한 도전 과제가 있습니다.



🎩 키티 커스터마이징: 다양한 키티 옵션과 옷으로 나만의 독특한 스타일을 만들어 보세요! 고양이의 유형, 눈 색깔, 촌스러움을 선택하고 맞춤형 모자, 안경, 마스크 및 기타 액세서리를 잠금 해제하고 믹스 앤 매치하여 나만의 룩을 만들어 보세요.



🏗️ 키티 캣 월드: 키티 캣만이 할 수 있는 것처럼 건설 현장의 요소들을 유리하게 활용하세요. 대들보에 오르고, 위험한 낙하산을 뛰어넘고, 크레인에서 그네를 타며 끊임없이 진화하는 풍경을 탐색하세요.



😺 고양이 민첩성: 이 길 잃은 고양이를 조종하여 민첩한 움직임과 고양이 반사 신경을 이용해 좁은 공간을 우아하게 탐색하고, 대담하게 점프하고, 좁은 바닥에 우아하게 착지하세요. 기교와 정확성이 중요합니다!



🏙️ 눈부신 스카이라인: 하강하면서 활기차고 끝이 없어 보이는 도시 풍경에 빠져보세요. 도시가 지평선과 어우러지는 모습을 감상하고 우뚝 솟은 고층 빌딩을 내려가면서 펼쳐지는 멋진 경치에 감탄하세요.



고양이로 가득한 이 모험에서 이 작은 고양이와 함께 고층 빌딩을 내려가는 스릴을 경험해 보세요. 온리 웨이 이즈 다운은 단순한 게임이 아니라 더 많은 것을 원하게 만드는 따뜻한 탈출구입니다! 모험에 뛰어들어 집으로 돌아갈 준비가 되셨나요?

title: Let's Patiti!
description:
게임 정보
🎮 《Let's Patiti!》—— Friendship Annihilator's Meow Marathon 🐾
Winner of "Best Friendship-Wrecker Game" Nomination (Not responsible for broken friendships!)
🔢 Core Formula
(Online brawls + Local sabotage) × Sinisterly addictive cats = 2025's ultimate party poison
🐾 Feline Frenzy Party
Up to 4-player online multiplayer mayhem!
Play as mischievous kittens in chaotic forest battles. Double the fun with real friends, or enjoy AI training mode – even solo players can LOL like crazy cats!
🌀 Every Match = New Script
Mysterious Meow Forest hides bizarre creatures:
▸ Bee cubs balancing cat food cans 🐻🍯
▸ Fruit-selling raccoon "Tong Dawei" 🦝🍎
▸ Rats bigger than cats?! 🐭💥
Collect magical card combos to unlock wild strategies!
💥 Triple Threat Fun
1️⃣ Item Warfare - Wield weapons like [Salty Fish Remote], [Mad Rat Mobile] to troll friends!
2️⃣ Mini-Game Chaos - Sudden rhythm battles/brain teasers test reflexes
3️⃣ Final Dash Showdown - Transform into Lightning Cats, race for the Golden Fish Trophy!
💣 Meow Forest Survival Guide
Environmental Hazards:
✓ Muscle Rats throwing random punches 💪🐀
✓ Suspicious catnip piles and 💩 landmines
Player-Induced Disasters:
✓ Cat Teaser Wand that forces opponents to perform "Learn to Meow" dance 🎶
✓ Exploding Garlic that makes friends kowtow to you 🧄💣
🏁 All schemes culminate in a fur-flying final sprint!

title: Dorsaka
description:
게임 정보
Escape the desert.
Find yourself.
Save your soul.
Be at one with the cycle of all things.
The clock is ticking, even though there is no clock.  Because there is no time.  But the end will come when your health reaches zero.  You have just enough time to reach the next exit, the next challenge.  When will the maze end?
Will you race through quickly, or dare to explore and find the secrets that await?
At what expense will you learn these secrets?  Will you learn something?
Only you and your alien space bunny can answer that.
Dorsaka is a fresh port from an original game that was made back in 2013 using Stencyl.  The removal of Flash support from the modern internet means that the original Dorsaka can't be played, not without jumping through some hoops.  Dorsaka was strangely popular with over 7,000 plays.  Which isn't too bad for a game created for a game jam.  Now it returns, using the hot freshness of the Godot engine and powered by the relentless pestering of a million voices demanding the return of the game no one was talking about.

title: Streets of Handbags
description:
게임 정보
Game loop
-Choose a recipe to cook
-Go to the market and buy ingredients.
-Forgot the money!
-Keep track of time, otherwise Grandma will forget what she wanted.
-Pick up and drop off small deliveries from stores.
-Collect money on the ground. Get people out of the way.
-Collect points, improve skills.
-Cook ingredients at home and get meta progression.
-Gain ingame achivements.
-Save money and buy new Handbags.
-Laugh and have fun.
Grandma found an amazing new recipe in a magazine and is so excited to cook it!
She's heading to the market to get all the ingredients she needs.
What could possibly go wrong?
Menu
Many retirees enjoy relaxing in their rocking chair, flipping through different magazines.
Shop
It would be fair to say that shopping is a pastime enjoyed by many people.

title: Legendary Heroes Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a world full of monsters, fight terrifying monsters and monster bosses, challenge your way to new lands
Strengthen your heroes by developing skills, choose a class to join the battle against monsters
Be careful and survive as long as you can in this desolate battlefield, fight until you defeat the boss in each area to enter the next new land.
Feature
- Legendary Heroes Survivals is a top-down platform roguelite game with a 2D solo battle mode where you fight against a large number of invading monsters.
- Survive 4 challenging levels to defeat the boss in each level, collect coins to develop your own character.
- Unlock new characters, 1 star and 2 star levels (must unlock 1 star before it will show) total 15 characters to challenge higher levels.

title: Funfair Billionaire
description:
게임 정보
Do you dream of becoming a billionaire by draining rigged carnival machines? Welcome to FUNFAIR BILLIONAIRE, the game where you throw your fake money into shady attractions just for the thrill of watching numbers go up (or not).
A game that reeks of sweat, blurry pixels, and questionable game design. Built with the blood, sweat, and tears of a developer who probably should have stayed an accountant but instead decided to create his "masterpiece"—badly optimized and with a certain disdain for usability.
✨ A GAMEPLAY EXPERIENCE AS ADDICTIVE AS IT IS UNFAIR ✨
💸 Throw your fake cash into machines as rigged as your last failed relationship:
🎰 Slot Machine – Win big! (Well… if the algorithm decides to let you.)
🕹 Coin Pusher – Watch coins fall and experience a shameful level of excitement.
🦾 Claw Machine – A physics system straight out of a nightmare. Good luck grabbing that cursed gold bar.
🔴 Roulette – Bet everything on red, instantly regret it.
⭐ THE FORTUNE TELLER MACHINE: A MYSTERIOUS VOID ⭐
Too much money? Seek wisdom from The Fortune Teller Machine, a mystical entity that promises to reveal your destiny… but, let’s be honest, mostly mocks you. Mystical? Yes. Useful? Absolutely not. But who knows? Maybe it’s right (spoiler: it’s not).
🎵 A SOUND EXPERIENCE STRAIGHT FROM HELL 🎧
Every sound in this game was personally crafted by the developer. And guess what? He has zero musical talent. Expect off-key jingles, suspiciously sourced sound effects, and a soundtrack that will make you question your love for music.
🔥 FEATURES WE PROBABLY SHOULD HAVE TESTED 🔥
🌬 Graphics – An unintentional tribute to the PS2 era, but blurrier.
🔋 Optimization – Runs at 22 FPS on a gaming PC yet somehow hits 60 FPS on a toaster.
😡 Guaranteed Rage – Every session is a life lesson in existential frustration.
FUNFAIR BILLIONAIRE is the game that will make you say:
"Why am I still playing this?"
and then "Alright, just one more round..."

title: Nyanco Channel Engine
description:
게임 정보
『Nyanco Channel Engine』에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 이 앱은 게이머, 스트리머, 창작자를 위한 사용자 친화적 반응형 버튜버 짚톡 (GIF톡) 지원 툴입니다. 웹캠 없이 마이크(루프백 포함)와 키보드 입력만으로 간편하게 버튜버(VTuber) 될 수 있으며, 프라이버시를 지키며 안전하게 스트리밍을 즐길 수 있습니다. (마이크 입력이나 오디오 관리에 문제가 있을 경우 VoiceMeeter 설치를 권장합니다.)
기본 제공되는 Nyanco 아바타 또는 자신만의 이미지를 쉽게 업로드하여 나만의 개성있는 아바타를 설정하세요. 아바타에는 총 2장의 이미지를 설정할 수 있습니다. 하나는 기본 대기 상태(이미지 A), 다른 하나는 반응 상태(이미지 B)입니다. UI의 ‘Select Image’ 버튼을 이용해 각각 별도로 이미지를 선택해주세요.
『Nyanco Channel Engine』에서는 게임 및 스트리밍 도우미로 유용한 기능들을 제공합니다:
메모장: 게임을 종료하지 않고도 전략, 메모, 방송 노트를 간편하게 기록할 수 있습니다.
그림판: 아이디어를 간단히 스케치하거나, 캡처한 화면 이미지에 주석을 달아 게임 및 방송에서의 소통을 풍부하게 해줍니다.
화면 캡처 (F10): 화면의 일부를 선택하여 곧바로 페인트 도구에 삽입할 수 있으며, 중요한 게임 장면이나 해설이 필요할 때 매우 유용합니다.
또한 마우스와 방향키로 조작하는 방치형 로그라이크 미니게임이 제공됩니다. 화살표 키로 Nyanco를 조종하며 고블린(g), 스켈레톤(s), 오크(o)를 상대하고 포션(p)을 수집해 던전을 탐험하세요. 오토 모드(A 버튼)로 자동 플레이도 가능합니다.
주요 기능:
ALT＋F4: 앱 빠른 종료
F2: 언제든지 튜토리얼 보기
F8: 배경 제거 크로마키 전환
F9: 배경색 사용자 지정 동기화
기본 앱은 무료이며 워터마크 로고가 표시됩니다. 유료 DLC를 통해 워터마크를 제거하고 더 깔끔한 화면을 사용할 수 있습니다. Nyanco Channel Engine—방송과 게임에 편안함과 창의력을 더해줄 든든한 파트너입니다!

title: Lizard Slayer
description:
게임 정보
A historically accurate digital interpretation of the heroic deeds of ancient Slavs. Take on the role of an ancestor and break through waves of lizards in this Survivors-like game. Don't let the lizards steal water from Lake Baikal using an extensive arsenal of items and weapons, from shotguns to helper bees.
Ancestor
Victor Corneprod - Senior comrade and wise mentor.
Dobrynya Skufovich - A veteran of battles against lizards at the gold currency reserve of Hyperborea.
Gleb - Gleb
Clowmir- Unyielding defender of the homeland, fearless in the face of lizards.
And others...

title: Koira
description:
게임 정보

Koira는 새로 사귄 강아지 친구와 함께 음악의 숲을 가로지르며 고대의 퍼즐을 풀고, 숲속 생물과 친구가 되어 집으로 가는 길을 찾는 훈훈한 우정 이야기입니다.

그림자 속에 숨은 위험한 사냥꾼을 피해 숲속을 탐험하세요...



새 친구와 유대감을 형성하세요. 먹이를 주고, 돌보고, 함께 놀아주세요!



그늘진 숲, 눈 덮인 언덕, 어두운 동굴 등을 가로지르세요.



은신과 용맹함으로 끈질긴 사냥꾼을 따돌리세요.



서로 힘을 합쳐 옛 숲을 복원하고 숲의 신비로운 기념물을 작동시키세요.



숲의 동물들을 만나고 도와주세요.

title: Quest of Legend
description:
게임 정보
This is a single player adventure game in third person. A pause menu is available. Options to change screen resolution, window size, and graphics settings. In this game, a meteor is falling, and it is up to you to find a way to stop it. You will find weapons and shields to equip. Shops allow you to purchase or make healing potions to restore your health and magic. Find masks with varying affects. There are a few ways to save the world, with or without a companion. In third person the player will perform mild platforming and combat with monsters, with a heavier focus on world traversal and inventory collection / management.

title: Malevolent Madness
description:
게임 정보
Malevolent Madness 정보는 플레이어를 긴장감 넘치는 공포 모험으로 초대하며, 미스터리와 퍼즐로 가득한 경험을 제공합니다. 신비로운 타임머신은 우주 간의 균형을 방해할 수 있는 특별한 힘을 방출하지만, 이 발견은 잘못된 손에 떨어질 경우 인류에 대한 심각한 위협이 됩니다.
주요 스토리: 플레이어는 비밀 프로젝트에 배정된 특별한 능력을 가진 과학자를 안내합니다. 어두운 동굴에 숨겨진 타임머신은 특정 DNA로만 작동될 수 있으며, 처음에는 반응을 보이지 않다가 갑자기 예기치 않게 작동하기 시작합니다. 이 기계는 동일한 물질이 두 우주에 존재할 경우 우주를 멸망시킬 위험을 내포하고 있습니다. 우리의 캐릭터가 기계 뒤에 숨겨진 무시무시한 비밀을 밝혀내고 직장을 그만두기로 결심하지만, 악랄한 교수는 자신의 목적을 위해 기계를 사용하고자 캐릭터를 납치하여 고통스러운 실험을 가합니다. 무서운 사건들이 점점 복잡해집니다.
주요 특징: • 강렬한 긴장감과 미스터리: 위험이 도사리는 어두운 분위기 속에서 탐험하세요.
• 도전적인 인공지능: 적과 교묘하게 설계된 퍼즐에 맞서 숨고 도망쳐야 합니다.
• 매력적인 시각 및 오디오 디자인: 고품질 그래픽과 음향 디자인을 통해 깊이 있는 공포를 경험하세요.
• 파쿠르 및 잠행 메커니즘: 진행을 위해 기술을 활용하고 항상 경계하세요!

title: Forest Smasher
description:
게임 정보
The warrior who comes to the maze forest, all you have to do is destroy all the enemies and obstacles you can see! Regardless of mission or task, forget about it all! Just shoot! SHOOT! SHOOT & SHOOT!
Game Features
Randomly generated destructible terrain (Yes, you can blow up EVERYTHING)!
Turn screen-shaking explosions into offensive weapons, shatter all enemies and obstacles!
Simple shooting and aiming for beginners, no need to be an experienced shooter!
Bullet Heaven (Not Hell!), dodge through enemy bullets with hero upgrades!
Incredible player build! Barrage shooting!

title: DAWN: Darkness Awaits Withstand the Night
description:
게임 정보
D.A.W.N: Darkness Awaits Withstand the Night is a fast-paced zombie survival game that puts you in the shoes of an elite survivor battling against the relentless undead. During the day, you strategize, gather supplies, and prepare your defenses. But when night falls, the real challenge begins as hordes of zombies emerge, driven by their hunger for human flesh.
Inspired by ‘I Am Legend’ and ‘World War Z,’ D.A.W.N offers an intense survival experience that blends action, strategy, and team-based gameplay. Explore a post-apocalyptic world, confront dynamic zombie evolutions, and adapt your tactics to outlast the ever-growing threat.
Key Features:
• Dynamic Day/Night Cycle: Gather resources, plan your strategies, and prepare defenses during the day to survive the night’s onslaught.
• Evolving Zombies: The longer the undead roam, the more dangerous they become. Face different tiers of zombies, each with unique abilities.
• Survival Simulation: No endless waves. Players must find extraction points to escape or face permanent death as their reanimated corpse joins the undead.
• Loadout System: Choose from a variety of weapons and equipment to suit your playstyle. Balance strengths and weaknesses to tackle various threats.
• Team Play: Join forces with others to survive the night, set traps, and fend off hordes in this open-ended survival simulation.
• Fast-Paced Combat: Engage in high-intensity battles that require skill, strategy, and quick reflexes.
Get ready to face the darkness. Will you survive until dawn?
autokwd: DAWN: Darkness Awaits Withstand the Night

title: Gacha Girls Unite
description:
게임 정보
심쿵주의보 ♡♥♡♥
네 개 종족 미소녀들과 함께한 판타지 낙원에서
어떤 모험이 벌어질까요?
3650뽑 100% 지급! 매일매일 가챠 요일!
자동 전투! 스킵 가능!
일상 콘텐츠든 메인 스토리든 모두 전투 스킵 가능하여 손쉽게 게임을 즐길 수 있어요!
일본 성우진의 감미로운 목소리에 소녀들의 고퀄리티 애니메이션 스킬 연출을 한꺼번에 감상하실 수 있어요!
길드에서 친구들을 만나고 오늘의 수익을 자랑하세요!
ʕ•ﻌ•ʔ ♡
모험 세계에 위기가 도사리고 있다.
모든 종족은 다가오는 위협 기운을 느꼈다.
살아남은 인류 지휘관으로서 곧 터질 전쟁에 맞서 마지막 낙원을 지키기 위해 네 개 종족의 소녀들을 이끌어 종말의 위기를 헤쳐나가야 한다.
지휘관님, 소녀들과 함께 모험을 시작할 준비가 되셨나요?
■ 종말 대응, 오아시스 연맹 탄생
전설의 모험도시에 히벨이라는 학자가 있었다. 어느 날 히벨은 숲속의 신비로운 제단 옆에 죽은 옛날 기생충을 발견하여 「심연 미생물」이라는 드문 물질을 추출해 냈다. 심연 미생물은 생명체의 유전자를 빠르게 진화시킬 뿐만 아니라 강력한 생명력을 가지고 있었다.
한편, 대기업의 회장 카르트는 죽은 딸을 되살리기 위해 엄청난 자금을 들여 「설산 바이오 연구소」를 세웠다. 히벨을 고용해 심연 미생물을 연구하여 몰래 인체 실험을 하게 했다.
그러나 실험할 때 예기치 못한 미생물 유출 사고가 발생하였고 연구진과 실험 대상자들은 모두 감염되었다. 곧 도시 전체로 확산되며 전세계가 위기에 빠졌고 인류는 급격히 줄었다.
살아남은 인류가 「오아시스 연맹」을 결성하고 기지를 세워 생존을 도모하기 시작했다. 높이 쌓아 올린 성벽은 인류의 마지막 방어선이 되었다.
■ 종족 연합, 세계를 구함

title: Warbot Engineer
description:
게임 정보
"Warbot Engineer"는 플레이어에게 궁극적인 커스터마이징 경험을 제공하는 고자유도 메카 커스터마이징 전투 게임입니다. 메카의 이동 속도, 방어력, 기동성, 공격력 등 다양한 핵심 파라미터를 자유롭게 조정하여 자신만의 전투 스타일에 맞는 유니크한 전투 메카를 만들어 보세요.
총알이 날아다니는 전장에서, 커스터마이징한 메카를 조종해 강력한 적들과 싸웁니다. 정밀한 조작과 전략적인 조정을 통해 적을 처치하세요. 매 레벨을 클리어할 때마다 기어를 얻을 수 있으며, 기어를 소비해 메카의 성능을 더욱 향상시킬 수 있습니다.
게임에는 두 가지 다른 유형의 메카가 제공되며, 각각은 고유한 특성을 가지고 있어 다양한 전투 요구에 맞출 수 있습니다. 커스터마이징 시스템을 유연하게 활용하여 가장 적합한 전투 메카를 만들어 전장을 정복하세요!

title: CHILL FISHING
description:
게임 정보
🎣 Chill Fishing – Relax, Catch, Upgrade!
Dive into the soothing depths of Chill Fishing, a minimalist fishing game where every cast is a new adventure. Cast your hook, explore the ocean depths, catch colorful fish, and discover rare and legendary species.
Upgrade your gear, unlock new biomes, and push your exploration further. Whether you have 5 minutes or hours to spare, Chill Fishing is the perfect experience to relax while feeling the thrill of the perfect catch.

🎯 Simple, relaxing gameplay accessible to everyone

⚙️ Upgrade your hook to catch more fish and reach new depths
🌍 Unlock diverse biomes, each with unique marine life
💰 A smooth economy to progress at your own pace, stress-free
Play, relax… and let the sea surprise you.

title: Aldo: Memory of the Kingdom
description:
게임 정보
버튼을 누르지 않고 전략적인 입장으로만 플레이하세요.
끝없는 섬을 탐험하고, 마을을 구하고, 왕국을 재건하는 데 땀 한 방울 흘리지 않고도 성공할 수 있습니다.
이 모험에서는 공격에 대해 걱정할 필요가 없습니다. 영웅이 알아서 해주기 때문입니다. 절차에 따라 생성되는 섬을 탐험하고, 자원을 모으고, 무기를 제작하고, 사람들을 방어하는 데 집중하세요. 죽으면 자신을 잊게 되고, 메인 크리스탈이 깨지면 모든 것을 잃게 됩니다.
더 많은 마을 주민을 구할수록 왕국은 더 강해집니다. 어려운 여정이지만 폐허가 된 마을을 재건할 때의 만족감을 능가하는 것은 없습니다.

title: Nif Nif

게임 정보
니프 니프는 숲과 동물 친구들을 돕는 착한 덱빌딩 게임으로, 이 장르를 처음 접하는 사람도 쉽게 즐길 수 있도록 설계되었지만 도전을 원하는 분들을 위해 전략적인 깊이도 갖추고 있습니다!
최고의 덱을 만드세요!
특별한 능력을 가진 카드를 선택하여 레벨을 진행하면서 숲의 끝에서 기다리고 있는 최종 보스를 상대할 준비를 하세요. 각 모험에 무엇을 가져갈지 결정하고 각각 고유한 카드를 가진 두 캐릭터 중에서 선택하세요.
씨앗을 모아서 심고 맛있는 따끈한 수프 요리로 나만의 파워업 포션을 만들 수 있어요!

title: Ultranatural
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Ultranatural, a no-frills PvP arena shooter built for quick, competitive fun. This is a student project from S4G Berlin, designed with simplicity in mind to modernize the classic arena shooter experience.
In Ultranatural, you’ll face off against friends on a single, carefully designed map, using one traditional weapon to prove your skills. The focus is on skill-based combat, fast movement, and intense one-on-one or small team matches. With easy-to-host servers, it’s a perfect way to settle who’s the better shot among your group.
Whether you’re a fan of old-school shooters or just looking for a quick, straightforward game to play with friends, Ultranatural keeps the action sharp, simple, and fun.

title: Lord of the Wilds
description:
게임 정보
황야에서, 당신은 마지막 희망입니다.
『황야의 군주』는 전략, 건설, 생존 요소를 융합한 게임입니다. 당신은 망명 귀족으로서, 전쟁으로 황폐해진 황야에서 제로부터 영지를 재건하고, 사방팔방의 위협에 맞서 결국 이 땅의 지배자가 되는 것을 목표로 합니다.
제로부터 시작하여 번영하는 영지를 건설하라:
당신은 폐허 속에서 시작하며, 주변은 황량한 땅과 부서진 유적들로 가득합니다. 생존하기 위해서는 직접 자원을 모아 기반 시설을 건설해야 합니다. 벌목장은 목재를 제공하고, 광산은 귀중한 광석을 채굴하며, 농장은 식량의 원천이 됩니다. 자원이 축적됨에 따라 영지의 레이아웃을 계획하고, 주거지를 건설하여 유민을 유치하고, 병영을 세워 병사를 훈련시키며, 시장을 열어 경제를 번영시킬 수 있습니다. 모든 단계에서 신중한 계획이 필요합니다. 자원의 부족과 가혹한 환경이 항상 당신의 결정력을 시험할 것이기 때문입니다.
강적을 물리치고, 백성을 지켜라:
황야에는 위험이 도사리고 있습니다. 적대적인 군주는 당신의 영지를 노리고, 오크 부족은 산에서 쏟아져 나와 약탈을 일삼으며, 언데드 군단은 밤에 깨어나 죽음과 공포를 가져옵니다. 생존하기 위해서는 병사를 훈련시키고 강력한 군대를 편성해야 합니다. 궁수, 기병, 보병은 각각 장단점이 있으며, 적의 특성에 따라 전술을 세워야 합니다. 동시에, 견고한 성벽과 높은 화살탑을 건설하여 적의 공격을 방어해야 합니다. 모든 전투가 중요하며, 패배는 영지의 멸망을 의미하고, 승리는 소중한 자원과 시간을 가져다줄 것입니다.
신비의 힘을 찾아 전세를 역전시키라:
황야 깊은 곳에는 고대의 힘이 숨겨져 있습니다. 마법사 탑을 건설함으로써 강력한 마법사를 고용하고, 파괴적인 마법을 연구할 수 있습니다. 화염구는 적의 무리를 불태우고, 얼음 마법은 적군의 진격을 늦추며, 소환술은 강력한 지원군을 불러옵니다. 동시에, 교회를 건설함으로써 종교의 힘을 얻을 수 있습니다. 경건한 사제는 부상당한 병사를 치료하고, 신성한 축복을 기원하여 군대의 사기를 높이며, 심지어 천사를 전장에 소환할 수도 있습니다. 마법과 신앙의 결합이 강적을 물리치는 열쇠가 될 것입니다.
도전에 준비되었는가?
『황야의 군주』에서는 자원 관리, 영지 계획, 군대 지휘, 전략적 의사결정이라는 여러 도전에 직면합니다. 모든 선택이 당신의 운명을 좌우합니다. 자비로운 통치자가 될 것인가, 철혈의 정복자가 될 것인가? 과학 기술과 무력에 의존할 것인가, 마법과 신앙에 의존할 것인가? 모든 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
황야의 군주는, 당신의 부상을 기다리고 있습니다!

title: 月上咖啡店-Cafe on the moon
description:
게임 정보
A century from now, Earth has become too burdened, and humanity sets its sights on the stars and the endless expanse of the universe. You are a child who spent most of your life on the Moon, surrounded by canned and artificial foods. Recalling the desserts you enjoyed as a child, you make the bold decision to open a cafe in this barren, steel-clad world.
To keep your cafe afloat, you must earn money and constantly innovate to keep your customers satisfied. You have the option to cultivate the crops necessary for your desserts and drinks, or you can revamp the cafe's interior to match your personal taste.
Throughout this adventure, you will encounter some unique guests. By offering them your desserts, you will gain their trust, uncover their hidden stories, and perhaps even recruit them to join your team.
Welcome to Cafe on the Moon. We hope you enjoy your time here.
Game Features:
[Ingredient Combinations at Your Discretion]
In the game, you can mix and match various ingredients and use different cooking techniques to craft the desserts you envision. Let your creativity shine!
[Unlock Diverse Decor Options]
Acquire blueprints from different characters to transform your cafe into the style you prefer.
