title: PathUp!
description:
게임 정보
**PathUp!**은 도전과 모험이 가득한 게임입니다. 험난한 등반을 극복하고, 다양한 메커니즘을 조합하며, 정상에 도달할 수 있는지 시험해 보세요!
당신은 목표를 달성할 수 있을까요?
**PathUp!**에서는 정상으로 향하는 잊지 못할 여정을 떠나게 됩니다. 길을 따라 좁은 길, 가파른 경사, 날카로운 회전 구간이 등장하며, 빠른 판단력과 뛰어난 조작이 필요합니다.
게임을 진행하면서 다양한 메커니즘을 활용해야 합니다:
🚀 Boost – 어려운 구간을 돌파하기 위한 순간 가속.
🦘 Jump – 장애물을 넘기 위한 높은 점프.
⬅️➡️ Impulse Left / Impulse Right – 정밀한 방향 조정.
🔄 Reset Car – 차량이 뒤집히거나 갇혔을 때 초기화.
하지만 조심하세요! 한 번의 실수로 아래로 추락할 수도 있습니다! 길은 험난하며, 다음 장애물이 무엇인지 알 수 없습니다.
💾 게임에는 여러 개의 체크포인트가 있어 진행 상황을 저장할 수 있습니다. 난관에 부딪히더라도 마지막 안전한 지점에서 다시 시작할 수 있습니다.
🚗💨 아래 GIF를 확인하세요, 다양한 메커니즘이 소개됩니다:
✔️ Jump

✔️

title: The Forgotten Village
description:
게임 정보
The Forgotten Village is a Fantasy Simulation RPG. Help the Villagers by competing various tasks and Quests ranging from clearing the Land to fixing broken objects. Upon Quest completion you will be rewarded with new Equipment and Tools. Equipment will provide passive bonuses, while Tools will allow you to gather resources more quickly. Use your newly acquired Tools to repair Structures, clear the Land and restore The Forgotten Village back to its former glory!
Features
Gather Resources!  Pick up Sticks and chop Trees to gather more Wood. Explore the Cave and begin Mining to acquire Stone and Ore.
Get Fixing! Once you have enough resources. Use your trusty Hammer to fix objects in the Village. Fixing Objects will always provide you with a reward, even if you don't have an active Quest.
Quests & Rewards! Good deeds won't go unnoticed. Fixing Objects & completing Villagers' Quests will reward you with new Tools & Equipment. 
Tools & Equipment! Tools will enable you to gather resources more efficiently, while worn Equipment will grant passive bonuses when worn!
Renown: Fixing Objects & Completing Quests will award renown. Earning Renown will trigger special events such as Mail Rewards or messages from other Villagers.

title: Parkour Challenger
description:
게임 정보
Parkour Challenger is a platform game set in various environments. The goal is to complete each course. 
20 levels, each with a unique environment
Playable by 1 to 4 players
Simple objective
High difficulty
Dodge saws, bullets, and lasers!
Jump over a tank, a knight, or even a rocket!
Ability to shrink to slip through narrow passages.
This is no walk in the park, hurry before the lava catches up with you!

title: Raid Auctus
description:
게임 정보
새벽 3시 신규 레이드에서 탱커를 구하지 못해 초조해한 적 있나요?
단체 채팅에 파티 모집을 올려도 묻히는 당혹스러움에 질렸나요?
『방치형 던전』으로 오세요!
믿음직스럽지 않은 팀원은 없음, 소통 스트레스 제로. 음성 채팅 없이 혼자서도 레이드 개시!
돌격만 하는 전사부터 수다쟁이 마법사까지, 냉정한 사격수부터 계산적인 흑마법사까지.
20여 가지 전통 직업으로 인해 파티 참여 걱정 끝! 방치 상태에서도 자동 파티 참가 할 수 있습니다!
게임 실행 중 지속 강화되는 파티, 배터리 소모만이 유일한 비용! 전원 버튼이 당신의 최고 투자처 되세요!
캐릭터마다 독보적인 스킬 성장 트리를 보유하고, 200레벨 성장 시스템이 직업 특성 조합으로 플레이어만의 전용적인 체계를 완성합니다! 딜러가 될지 서포터가 될지, 파티 내 포지션은 플레이어가 직접 설계합니다!

title: Farming & Supermarket Simulator: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
"이 프롤로그는 '농장과 슈퍼마켓 시뮬레이터'의 제한된 버전을 사용하여 생산 및 거래를 할 수 있습니다. 전체 게임을 위시리스트에 추가하여 이 즐거운 경험을 완성하세요!"
재배, 수확, 활용
수확한 제품을 최대한 활용하세요: 슈퍼마켓 선반을 채우거나 동물 사료로 사용하세요. 선택은 당신의 몫입니다!
먹이 주기 및 수확
동물에게 먹이를 주고 보상을 수확하세요! 닭에게 토마토를 주고 신선한 계란을 수집하며 수고의 결실을 즐기세요.[\/p]
기계에 투자하기
기계를 구매하여 생산을 확장하세요! 수확한 제품을 가공하여 슈퍼마켓용으로 가치 있는 아이템을 만드세요.[\/p]

title: Liar Game
description:
게임 정보
서로를 속고 속이는 치열한 심리전! 당신의 말 한 마디가 승패를 가를 수 있습니다.
친구들과 함께하는 이 게임에서는 누구도 믿을 수 없으며, 오직 날카로운 추리력과 설득력이 승리의 열쇠가 됩니다.
게임이 시작되면 일반 플레이어에게는 주어진 키워드가 공개됩니다. 그러나 라이어는 키워드를 알지 못한 채 게임을 시작합니다.
일반 플레이어들은 키워드를 설명해야 하지만, 중요한 점은 라이어가 눈치채지 못하도록 조심해야 한다는 것입니다.
반면, 라이어는 다른 플레이어들의 발언을 듣고 키워드를 유추해야 합니다. 그러나 너무 뻔하게 행동하면 의심을 살 수 있습니다. 설득력 있게 자신을 변호하면서도 자연스럽게 대화를 이어가야 합니다.
과연 당신은 라이어를 밝혀낼 명탐정일까요? 아니면 모두를 속여 승리하는 천재 라이어일까요?
지금 바로, 최고의 심리전 게임을 경험해보세요!

title: Welcome to Primrose Lake 4
description:
게임 정보
Primrose Lake 4 picks up where the last game left off, with the residents of this picturesque town still reeling from the aftermath of David McGovern's disappearance. Jessica, still shaken from the events of the previous game, is trying to keep herself busy by starting a major renovation of the old Carlyle Manor. But as she delves deeper into the history of the manor, she realizes that the house hides more secrets than she ever imagined.

Meanwhile, Jenny is finally finding her feet in Primrose Lake after her fiancé, Matthew, joined her to start over. She's been working hard in the Carlyle Cafe, building a new life for herself in this quaint town. But as the first snow falls, new problems emerge and old wounds are reopened, threatening to unravel the life she's worked so hard to build.

In Primrose Lake 4, you'll have the chance to continue the captivating story with the characters you've grown to love. Help the townsfolk manage their everyday tasks in both familiar and new locations as you guide them through the winter months. And of course, the game wouldn't be complete without a few twists and turns - solve riddles and look for clues in mystery locations to uncover the truth behind the mysteries of Primrose Lake.

With over 60 levels to conquer on one of three difficulty levels, Primrose Lake 4 promises hours of immersive gameplay. You'll be tasked with managing the everyday tasks of the townsfolk, all while navigating the twists and turns of the town's hidden secrets. Will you be able to solve the mysteries of Primrose Lake before it's too late?

So what are you waiting for? Download Primrose Lake 4 today and join the residents of this charming Rocky Mountain town as they uncover its hidden secrets. With stunning visuals, engaging gameplay, and an enthralling story that will keep you hooked from start to finish, Primrose Lake 4 is a must-play for any fan of Time Management games!

title: Escape Game Sleepless
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to "Escape Game Sleepless"!
"Escape Game Sleepless" includes below.
*** Escape Game Sleepless ***
Mouse put the kids to bed.
When Mouse comes to see them later, There are no kids.
Find them.
*** Escape Game Hinamatsuri ***
It is Hinamatsuri today.
When a cat is decorating, hina dolls has run away.
Find hina dolls.
*** Escape Game Mole House ***
Hen and Chicks are taking a walk.
Then the Chick falls into a pitfall.
Escape from the mole house.
*** Escape Game Teatime ***
Mice are having tea.
Then, Bear fall in front of the house and mice aren’t unable to get out of the house.
Escape from the house and save the fallen bear.
*** Escape Game Flower ***
While Sheep is taking a walk, she finds a nice flower.
Get a flower to give as a present.
*** Escape Game Swim Ring ***
One day a bear goes to the sea.
Other bears are swiming with swim rings.
Find a swim ring.
*** Escape Game Recital ***

title: I'm Truely a Good Guy!
description:
게임 정보
Congrats! As a model employee of Cattlehorse Corp, you've been assigned to an abandoned underground warehouse to recover junk… I mean, valuable assets! But here's the problem—rival companies have planted undercover agents who are double-dipping, slacking off, and trying to sabotage your efforts. Stay alert! Luckily, the company has equipped you with some absurd high-tech gadgets and makeshift tools. They’re not free, but you get them at an employee discount. Use your corporate wisdom to outsmart the troublemakers and complete your mission. And there’s a mysterious middle manager on your team—better stay on their good side, since they’ve got a gun.
Core Game Features
Random Map Generation: Each round, the game generates a random underground facility with all devices placed differently. Players can leave marks to help themselves or their teammates navigate.
Vast Variety of Items: Players have access to a wide range of fun tools, such as tasers, metal detectors, and energy drinks. They can also eat and drink to restore health.
Bank System: Players earn points during each run and can choose to save their earnings or spend them all at once. A bonus is awarded if their side wins.
Vending Machine: Players can purchase items from a vending machine, ranging from inexpensive food and drinks to valuable tools like a tase mine or a teleport beacon.
Proximity Chat: Built-in text and voice chat that can only be heard or seen by players within range. Players can use a power box to broadcast messages across the entire map.
Community: Join the community to share feedback on game features or suggest new items. The developer will continue adding fresh content to enhance the experience.
Essential Game Mechanics
(Early access, rules may change)
There are 3 roles: Good guy, Bad guy and Judge, each with different goals.
You can deposit points earned during the mission in the bank, or withdraw them for latter use, if you fail to make it back alive, you loose all your inventory points, points can be used to buy items before or during the mission.
Retrieve items from locked containers, play a mini-game to open them up.
Feed someone by using a food item while aiming at them.

title: Critical Point
description:
게임 정보
Captain! Please pilot the "Devourer" and lead human civilization towards the other side of the universe!
In the near future, Earth is facing an energy crisis. The "Devourer" is the cosmic ark built by humanity in its final moments. Now, with all the crew aboard, you, as the supreme leader, are about to guide the last ember of humanity on a long voyage.
Before you begin the "Devouring" plan, here's a brief overview of what you need to do next:
Activate the Decomposition Cannon
The target planet will be shattered into particles, and we will collect the dispersed particles into the spaceship's reactor.
Adjust the Reactor

title: Mow Meow
description:
게임 정보
Mow catnip. Unlock furr. Hang out.
Welcome to Mow Meow, where you're a stretchy, slightly broken cat with one job — mow catnip. As you gather more catnip, you'll unlock fresh furr and eventually collars, boots, and hats to style your feline. Work alone or team up with friends in this multiplayer sandbox where the only rule is... keep mowing.
Customize your kitty, embrace the weird, and discover unexpected upgrades as you spiral deeper into this world of fuzzy chaos. The catnip never stops growing — and neither do the surprises. 🤯
Key Features:
• Online multiplayer catnip mowing with friends or strangers
• Chill original music to soundtrack your feline journey
• Unlockable furr [eventually hats, collars, shoes, and other mysterious broken upgrades too]

title: No Time to Build
description:
게임 정보
No Time to Build는 협력적인 재미있는 캐주얼 게임으로, 플레이어는 팀워크를 발휘하여 장애물을 넘고 다리 건설을 해야 합니다. 파트너와 함께 나무를 수집하고, 함정을 피하고, 주어진 시간 안에 임무를 완료해야 합니다.
협동의 혼돈!
이 게임은 두 명의 플레이어가 협력하여 진행하며, 팀워크가 매우 중요합니다. 자원을 빠르게 모으고 장애물을 피하는 동시에, 서로 충돌하지 않도록 주의하세요. 하지만 조심하세요—우연한 충돌로 넘어질 수 있습니다!

물리학과 파쿠르!
동적인 레벨은 다양한 도전을 제공합니다: 움직이는 플랫폼, 사라지는 도로, 계단, 기차, 그리고 심지어 걸어 다니는 폭탄까지! 각 레벨은 민첩성과 전략적 사고를 테스트할 것입니다!

title: Skvears
description:
게임 정보
You find yourself stranded on a small island. Can you find the way out?
Explore, help the locals, and enjoy your little adventure!
Skvears is a single-player game where you take on the role of an explorer, lost on an island. This game features quests, finding and using items, interaction with the island's people and animals. It's entirely casual and can be completed in half an hour. Skvears was originally created in 2014.

title: Hidden Cat Outlaws
description:
게임 정보
보안관이 되어 서부에서 원하는 고양이를 모두 찾으세요!
게임 곳곳에 숨어 있는 600마리 이상의 장난꾸러기 고양이를 찾는 퀘스트를 시작하면서 재미있는 낙서 스타일의 예술 작품을 탐험해보세요!
재미있고 편안한 숨은 그림 찾기 게임을 통해 주의력과 관찰력을 테스트해보세요.
고양이를 모두 잡을 수 있나요?

주요 특징들
손으로 그린 수백 가지의 재미있는 개체
수십 가지의 재미있는 "입으로 만든" 소리
15레벨
600마리 이상의 고양이를 찾을 수 있습니다
45개의 비밀
2시간이 넘는 멋진 엔터테인먼트
열정적이고 경험이 풍부한 인디 게임 제작자가 제작했습니다.
향수, 휴식, 유머가 가득한 멋진 음악
가격 대비 뛰어난 가치

title: 4th Era - The RuneChild
description:
게임 정보
What if You had to fight the DragonBorn, Because he had turned to the dark side.?
Somewhere between a Casual open-world RPG and a wizard/Alchemist wet dream...
I like to play open-world Dnd types games, and I always play magic wielders,,, with alchemy for back-up. So here is my game, build around those things.
As a Fighter: Wield a sword, improve it, and even enhance it with magic. Face off against ten mythological monsters in the first main mission. 
As a Rogue: Master the art of stealth, equip throwing stars or daggers, and sneak into dragon hideouts to deliver a deadly backstab that could even decapitate them—or perhaps just steal some of their precious treasures. This is the second main mission: finding the lost Dragon Orbs that control the dragons.
As a Wizard: Choose your magic school—focus on war, defense, or even the dark art of necromancy. Harness the power within you to fight undead beasts, and in time, you may even gain control over them. This is the final main mission, but its secrets will remain hidden... for now.
Races: There are five races, the classics from 'Lord of the Rings'.
Humans are average, and can be everything. Fighter, Rogue or Wizard.
Dwarfs have good constitution, which makes them able to fighter for a long time.
Elves are tall, and flexible, perfects for range weapons, or magic wielding.
Orc are strong, but stupid, perfect for a fighter.
Half-lings are short, nimble and charming, perfect for Rogues.
Magic in this game is wild...
It has to be because you are fighting against mythical creatures like Minotaurs, Medusa, and the Basilisk, which can paralyze. And deep beneath the dwarf kingdom in the North, there are rumors of something dark waiting to be released.
This game is an open-world, single player RPG game.
You can play it casually, taking your time to do quests and explore the world, or you can play it more hard-core.
I like to play open-world RPGs like Skyrim, Oblivion, and Morrowind, as well as Tolkiens universe. So, I have taken the parts I like from them: the wild magic and alchemy from Morrowind, the bright colors from Oblivion, and Skyrim's weapon improvements.

title: Plenty of Fish in the Sea
description:
게임 정보
In Plenty of Fish in the Sea, you dive into the serene, shimmering waters of a peaceful river, where the salmon are not just fish but charming, chatty companions with unique personalities, dreams, and dating preferences. As a friendly aquatic matchmaker (and potential love interest), you’ll engage in heartwarming conversations with a diverse cast of salmon, from poetic deep-thinkers to adventurous thrill-seekers.
 Swim through winding streams, moonlit waterfalls, and cozy underwater grottos as you take your fishy friends on delightful dates—whether it’s a scenic drift downriver, a romantic algae-tasting picnic, or a playful game of leaping over waterfalls.
 With colorful visuals, a soothing soundtrack of bubbling brooks and gentle chiptune melodies, and branching dialogue choices that shape your relationships, Plenty of Fish in the Sea is a cozy, feel-good experience about connection, companionship, and the simple joys of swimming side by side. Will you find your perfect fishy match?
autokwd: Plenty of Fish in the Sea

title: Jeff The Janitor
description:
게임 정보


Explore a dark, seemingly abandoned mall with a shopping list of items you want to collect.
However, you'll be chased by Jeff, the night-shift janitor.



Find keys and other crucial items to unlock doors and access hidden areas,
allowing you to delve deeper into the mall.



If Jeff catches you, it's game over! Stay alert to avoid getting caught.
Hide, run, and outsmart Jeff to survive and complete your mission.

title: Frogstool
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the swampy, medieval world of Frogstool, a land of murky waters, towering castles, and ancient bubble magic. You play as Gubble, a brave but unlikely hero- a small frog with a tongue as strong as a sword and a quest as big as the bog itself.
The village of Frogstool is under siege by Cocferno, the fearsome Chicken Dragon, who has taken control of Fort Wubblewart, a towering stronghold at the edge of the land. Gubble must battle through overrun villages, navigate the eerie Titanfin Passage inside the belly of an Orca, and scale Fort Wubblewart itself to challenge Cocferno at the tower’s peak.  To save the Frogstool Village, Gubble must venture through dangerous lands, battle monstrous foes, and uncover the secrets of the lost Wart Knights—a forgotten order that once stood against Cocferno. 
Does Gubble have what it takes to reclaim the village, conquer Fort Wubblewart, and take down the dreaded Cocferno?

title: SpaceVenture
description:
게임 정보
BLAST Off into SPACEVENTURE! Become Ace Hardway, a "Life Support Systems technician" (let’s be honest—a space plumber), and his robotic dog, Rooter, on an epic intergalactic misadventure. When a routine repair job spirals into galaxy-spanning chaos, Ace finds himself battling sewer monsters, evading crooked cops, and uncovering a sinister conspiracy involving mind-controlling video game consoles. Along the way, you'll build a new spaceship, tinker with bizarre tech, and navigate quirky worlds filled with alien oddballs, unstable AIs, and absurd puzzles.
Created by the minds behind the beloved Space Quest series, SpaceVenture combines sharp humor, challenging puzzles, and nostalgic charm in a modern point-and-click adventure. Featuring stellar voice acting, a retro-inspired score, and endless nods to sci-fi classics, this crowdfunded game delivers a hilarious and heartwarming romp through the stars. Will Ace and Rooter save the galaxy or just make a cosmic mess? Only one way to find out!
Build your ship – Scavenge for parts, refuel with questionable bio-waste, and piece together your interstellar junker as you forge your path across the stars.
Explore a galaxy of interesting locales – From junk asteroids and sketchy space stations to alien deserts and the Hyperspace Beltway, every stop is packed with puzzles, and that trademark Two Guys from Andromeda humor.
Interact with unforgettable characters – Encounter crooked cops, eccentric inventors, shady CEOs, and a robotic dog with a nose for trouble. Everyone has a story... and some of them want you gone.
Solve challenging puzzles with a comedic twist – Use your wits, tools, and trusty PDA apps to fix leaks, outsmart enemies, and uncover hidden truths about a galaxy-sized conspiracy.

title: Little Library
description:
게임 정보
You have moved to the quaint village of Maplewood, tasked with running a brand-new library to help restore a struggling community. But revitalizing the library isn’t easy, and funding is tight. To make ends meet, you’ll need to carefully manage resources, grow the collection, and host events to bring the villagers together.
Beyond the library, you’ll cultivate a quiet life in the village—tending to a small farm, fishing in the local waters, exploring the Whispering Woods, engaging in community projects, and forming deep connections with the townspeople. From aspiring writers to world travelers, every villager has a role to play in Maplewood’s revival. As you uncover pieces of the village’s forgotten past, you’ll shape its future. Can you transform the library into the heart of the community before the Folk Festival?
Features:
📚 Build and manage the library – Watch it grow from a humble collection to a thriving center of the village.
📖 Expand the library’s collection – There are over 70 books to collect, including rare and collectible titles that enhance your display and boost the library’s reputation.
🏡 Tend to your own farm – Grow crops to supplement your income, trade with villagers, and add a touch of rural charm to your new life in Maplewood.
🎣 Go fishing in the village waters – Cast your line in ponds and lakes to catch fish, earn extra income, and even complete special requests from villagers.
🌲 Explore the Whispering Woods – Venture into the mysterious forest on the village’s outskirts, where secrets await.
🔍 Uncover the village’s history – Expand the Local History section of the library and piece together Maplewood’s past.
🤝 Connect with the villagers – Befriend the townspeople, build relationships, and even find romance as you become a part of their lives.
🎭 Engage in community events – Host book clubs and bring the village together through literary and social activities.
🔄 Replay for new outcomes – Your choices influence friendships, romances, and the village’s future, offering a fresh experience with every playthrough.
Will you build a library that stands the test of time and rekindle the spirit of Maplewood?

title: Jinchou
description:
게임 정보
Customize your character and set off on a journey of self-contained block-pushing puzzles.
Experience a retro-nostalgic atmosphere coupled with hauntingly beautiful lo-fi beats.

A simplistic design of challenging and rewarding bite-sized levels.

title: Last Hit Titan
description:
게임 정보
An endless battle against powerful Titans!
In this massively cooperative tower defense game, terrifying Titans travel from player to player. Every attack you land helps weaken these colossi, and the player who delivers the final blow receives rewards to become even stronger.
Build, Upgrade, Survive
Start with walls and a basic turret.
Place your defenses strategically to maximize damage.
Unlock and equip increasingly powerful towers through Titan loot.
A Unique Economic Ecosystem
Looted towers are Steam items.
Buy turrets and walls with the money earned by attacking the Titans.
Each 3h you can loot a tower.
Each Titan has a special loot table.
The stronger the Titan, the more valuable its rewards.
Merge towers and get upper guality tower ! 
Face Ever-Strong Titans
Massive monsters with tons of health points.
A pathfinding system that makes them either go around or destroy your defenses.
Join the battle and leave your mark on the fall of the Titans!

title: Prismatic: Nox's Gate
description:
게임 정보
Captain Cio Greyfluff and his crew of bunnies, big cats, and possums embark on a journey across the galaxy searching for valuable and powerful Prismatic Gems. Little do they know that they're about to get lured into the fast-moving wars, romance, and politics of the Elk, Fox, and Hyena kingdoms.
🎮 Fight at the speed you like with a turn-based grid combat system. Defeat enemies and bosses with many attacks, character classes, and many combatants at once.
⚔️ Battle to a vibing retro/classical soundtrack
🦊 Fully voiced dialog with character art
🌌 Find books, quests, and easter eggs, and even emulate a CRT screen.

title: Screen Pets
description:
게임 정보
반려동물이 작업 표시줄을 돌아다닙니다
귀여운 반려동물이 당신이 다른 일을 하는 동안 화면 하단에 머물러 있습니다.
반려동물을 쓰다듬기
반려동물을 사랑하는 것을 잊지 마세요.
반려동물 메뉴
반려동물 메뉴에서 모든 반려동물을 확인할 수 있습니다.

title: Devil's Derby
description:
게임 정보
The hordes are rising, only you stand in their way. Shoot, grind, slide, and jump your way around a multi-layered level against endless legions of demons, fiends, and monsters.
Rise, fall, and rise again. Can you survive the Devil's Derby?
Use your weapons to tear through endless demons and fiends. Lay down constant damage with the SMG, whilst blasting enemies away with the handcannon- charge it up to cause even more damage with an energy explosion.
Keep your momentum going by grinding around the many rails in the arena. Use them to your advantage to quickly reach other platforms and escape enemies.

title: EOL: End Of Line
description:
게임 정보
EOL:End of Line is a 4x turn-based strategy game where you fight for control of the System from AI control programs.  Expand your control by sizing System nodes, then exploit those nodes using buildings to extract resources to fuel your expansion and ultimately the extermination of the AI programs.
 How will you claim the System?
Build a number of different structures and units to help grow your control while balancing resource extraction vs consumption.
 How will you grow your control?
Distribute your structures across the system to capture unique resource nodes to give your buildings an output boost?
Utilize the games Synergy system by placing the same extraction building next to each other to boost output and create specialized extraction zones?
 How will you keep your control?
Will you utilize the system topography to create barriers and choke points allowing for your slow heavily armored Tanks to maintain supremacy?
Maybe a system of Portals and Electrical Metallic Tubing to create a network that allows you to quickly deploy units around your territory?
Take the fight to the AI with fast lightly armored Scouts to disrupt the AI’s supply chain starving it of vital resource?
 On to the next System!
Victory or Defeat it is never the same game twice as each System is generated to be a new and distinct experience.

title: Mouse practice  kids
description:
게임 정보
'Mouse Practice For Kids'는 어린 아이들이 화면에 나타나는 다채로운 과일을 클릭하면서 PC 마우스 사용법을 배우는 데 도움을 줍니다.
즐거운 음악과 보상 효과음이 더해진 'Mouse Practice for Kids'는 세밀한 운동 능력을 향상시키면서도 즐거운 경험을 제공합니다. 자녀에게 교육적이고 재미있는 활동을 찾는 부모에게 완벽한 선택입니다.
게임 특징:
교육적 목표: 어린이들이 마우스 사용 능력을 향상시키는 데 도움이 됩니다.
간단한 게임 플레이: 화면에 나타나는 알록달록한 과일과 채소를 클릭하세요.
부모 통제 타이머: 게임 시간 제한을 설정할 수 있으며, 시간이 지나면 게임이 자동으로 종료됩니다.
점진적인 난이도: 레벨이 진행될수록 마우스 커서가 작아지고, 과일은 움직이고 작아지며, 도전 과제가 커집니다.
즐거운 피드백: 즐거운 음악과 사운드 효과로 진행 상황을 보상합니다.
게임의 주요 특징은 심리적 트릭으로, 처음에는 마우스 커서와 과일이 크게 나타나 아이들이 마우스를 움직이고 과일을 클릭하는 데 집중하도록 합니다. 레벨이 진행됨에 따라 커서와 과일이 점점 작아져, 결국 커서는 PC의 일반 크기에 도달하게 됩니다.

title: STEEL HUNTERS
description:
게임 정보
대재앙 이후, 인류는 인류의 운명을 좌우할 우주 자원, 스타폴을 지키기 위해 헌터를 만들어 냈습니다. 이제 다양한 세력이 이 무시무시한 거대 기계들을 앞세워, 버려진 푸른 지구의 얼마 남지 않은 자원을 차지하려고 싸웁니다.
다양한 헌터의 플레이스타일과 강력한 무기, 장비, 개조, 기술을 숙지하세요. 막강한 위력을 발휘하여 경쟁자들을 박살 내세요.

title: House of Lost Souls
description:
게임 정보
스토리: 오래 전 사건 이후 잭은 부모님의 집으로 돌아왔고, 지금은 자신의 집이 되었습니다. 어렸을 때 보았던 기억이 그를 잠 못 이루게 했고, 그는 과거를 다시 돌아보기로 결심했습니다.
눈앞에서 부모님이 살해당한 집이 그를 부르는 것 같았습니다. 그 집은 잭의 고통을 먹어치우고 그를 미치게 만들었습니다. 하지만 시간이 지날수록 고통은 가라앉지 않고 점점 더 심해졌습니다. 잭은 마침내 내면의 고통을 진정시킬 해답을 찾고 싶었습니다.
주요 게임 플레이는 주인공인 잭의 과거를 다루고 있습니다. 잭은 어린 시절에 목격했던 사건들을 재현합니다. 잭이 집에 오래 머무를수록 기억을 더 깊이 파고들어 아버지와 관련된 미스터리를 푸는 데 가까워집니다.

title: ZIRQUITZ
description:
게임 정보
ZIRQUITZ is a unique fusion of logic puzzles, idle strategy, and incremental growth, offering a deeply engaging yet relaxing experience. Build, optimize, and expand your circuits in a dynamic world of interconnected nodes.
Node-Based Circuit Building:
Create intricate networks of Producers, Transformers, and Converters. Each node plays a critical role in generating and processing data (bits, bytes, words...) into "Work", the game’s primary resource.
Pull-Based Logic System:
A challenging yet intuitive system where inputs actively and automatically request data from connected outputs, introducing opportunities for optimization and creative problem-solving to avoid buffer overflows and underflows.
Wide Variety of Nodes:
Experiment with 25+ node types, including logic gates (AND, OR, XOR, etc.), data processors and converters, and specialized nodes implementing your own custom logic, each with unique behaviors and mechanics.
Dynamic Upgrades:
Upgrade your nodes to unlock faster production, more efficient processing, and powerful synergies. Each upgrade path introduces new gameplay possibilities.
Idle and Active Playstyles:
Whether you enjoy actively tweaking your graphs or letting the game progress while you step away, ZIRQUITZ accommodates both styles seamlessly.
Sandbox Mode:
Experiment without limits in the sandbox mode, where you can test complex graphs and explore creative solutions without restrictions.
Achievements and Challenges:
Test your skills with achievements like building perfectly efficient circuits or using every node type in a single graph.

title: Alcyone: The Last City
description:
게임 정보
After the fall of civilisation, the City is the only thing still standing.
Outpost Alcyone : the Nihility spread across the universe at close to the speed of light, unmaking & twisting everything it encountered. We had enough warning to protect ourselves as we saw the distant stars flicker out one by one. Alcyone's old name was forgotten and became simply the City.
Alcyone: The Last City is an interactive sci-fi novel in which the player's choices heavily impact the overall narrative, opening or closing pathways through the story, and greatly affecting the end of the game. From the outset, players will have to weigh difficult options, all of which impact the game and provide different insights into the various organisations, Houses, diverse characters, and deep lore of the City. Players are encouraged to live with their decisions, even if the consequences are dire — there is no true failure in the City, only experience.

title: Mystery Boxes
description:
게임 정보
Help intrepid explorer Maya Robinson investigate a set of ancient cube-like artifacts buried deep in the jungle!
When you send a 4-digit signal to the Mystery Box, it will transform it according to a set of secret rules.
Sending 1234 to the box might give you 8642.
Sending another number, like 2244, gives you a different result like 8844.
Through experimentation and deduction, you can figure out the rules: in this case, double each digit, then flip the number backwards.
Once you figure out the rules, use them to obtain the target. With the rules above, what input would produce 6424?

title: Hogen
description:
게임 정보
What happens after you die?
What is the afterlife, if there even is one? 
You go into the light and... 
find out it's playing cards with a skeleton man. Well, it is for you...
Hogen is a digital card game drawing inspiration from Gwent and Magic: the Gathering. Place weapon, unit, and magical crystal shard cards to activate abilities and overpower your opponent.
Can be played with just a mouse!
Unravel a story of Life and Death as progress through the game
Play against vibrant and animated boards with custom dynamic music

title: Death Kid
description:
게임 정보
Death Kid is an arcade-inspired arena brawler with meta progression where skill and strategy are crucial. Break through eight seals to reach the bottom of a treacherous well with the help of three souls trapped between life and death. Protect them at all costs, take out hordes of relentless enemies and fight your way to put the wheel of life and death back in motion.
Step into the role of the cryptic Death Kid – a protagonist cursed with immortality. Engage in close-quarters combat, master a variety of powerful abilities and grow stronger with each run. Stay agile, think fast and devise the right strategy to annihilate your enemies.
Let the rage fill you up and unleash the fury upon otherworldly creatures that want to see you fail.

title: Liminal Department
description:
게임 정보
Trapped in what seems to be an endless hospital department. Carefully observe your surroundings in each loop to escape the Liminal Department
Phenomenon Experience
Explore an ever-changing hallway filled with unusual occurrences. Each loop could have multiple anomalies or none. Some are easy to spot, others are not.
Submit for Anomalies
After a careful examination submit for anomalies to proceed further. Memory skills are key to breaking the loop.
Trapped In a Loop

title: Flight Catastrophe
description:
게임 정보
what Is Flight Catastrophe?
Not everything goes as planned. You need to be prepared to act and often act fast when an emergency occurs. Especially when you’re onboard the airplane witch passengers and your crew
feel Like on a Real Airline
In Flight Catastrophe you need to know every nook and cranny of it - the decks, the engines, the cargo bay - not a single place can escape your attention, as the danger can happen literally anywhere!
prevent the Catastrophe!
In a time of danger, you are often forced to make choices under the pressure of time - and on a plane every single second matters! Don’t hesitate - everyone is counting on you! But fear not - if you fail, you will have a chance to try again and learn on your mistakes - hopefully for the best!

title: Wild Willy West
description:
게임 정보
Wild Willy West is a western top-down shoot 'em up, featuring action packed levels and instant death combat. Use an arsenal of magical bullets to blast your way through the old west, and take revenge on those who wronged you.
Unlock and upgrade a wide selection of unique magical bullets in order to take down your foes. You can only load six magic bullets into your gun at the start of a level, so use them carefully.

title: Sorting Inc
description:
게임 정보
You got hired at Sorting Inc. the most renown company in town that specialized on one thing: sorting. While most people think it's a boring task that should be automated, the managers at Sorting Inc won't follow that trend. To become a true master at sorting you have to visit the different departments and learn all the techniques of an experienced sorter.

Relaxing Gameplay
No time limits, no high scores, no pressure. Play at your own pace and free your mind while sorting items. It typically gets more fun the less you try to rush. It can however be quite satisfactory to optimize your sorting strategies.

Accessibility
Since some of the items are mainly distinguishable by color, different color palettes were added you can choose in the game options.

title: Bugaboo Pocket
description:
게임 정보

지구상에 사는 벌레들이 등장하는 스토리 위주의 애완동물 육성 게임! 밥과 가구를 주워서 벌레들을 귀여워하자! 미니 게임이나 신변을 돌봐 줘서 똥통화를 벌자! 머리를 쓰다듬이나 밥주는 반응을 관찰하자! 벌레들의 알을 풀어놓아 숲의 거처를 살리자!



벌레를 새로운 시점으로 보자! 벌레를 좋아하는 사람은 물론 싫어하는 사람도 즐길 수 있습니다. 모든 벌레들은 현실 세계의 생물에 영향을 받고 있습니다. 벌레들의 생애주기, 서식지, 먹이원에 대해 배워봅시다.



심한 화재가 있었던 숲의 재생을 돕는 과학 연구자로서 플레이하자. 게임 내 영상, 일기, 아이템을 통해 벌레의 성장을 지겨보자! 벌레도감을 완성해서 비밀을 풀고 상품을 얻자!



벌레는 수명으로만 죽기 때문에 느긋하고 즐겁게 원하는 플레이어에게 딱 맞고 있습니다!

title: Elroy and the Aliens
description:
게임 정보
Play as Elroy and Peggie as you solve intriguing puzzles, uncover archaeological secrets, meet peculiar alien cultures, and enjoy wholesome emotional moments—all wrapped in a humorous tone in this modern point-and-click adventure.
Elroy is an ingenious rocket engineer whose father disappeared 18 years ago under suspicious circumstances. Peggie is a passionate investigative reporter with a knack for languages, history, and research.
Their quest begins with the discovery of a secret crystal and an enigmatic message, launching them from their hometown of Slope City on a journey through the cosmos to find Elroy’s long-lost father, all while unraveling a lurking threat to the very existence of the universe.

title: Fortitude Tower Defense
description:
게임 정보
Strategy without the Sweat
Fortitude Tower Defense is everything that makes the genre so enjoyable; real-time action with wave-based decision making. Build and upgrade towers, manage resource production, and train and deploy units to defend your kingdom.
As you play through three Acts with 10 unique maps, you'll enjoy permanent progression along the way. Improve towers and structures with Requisitions. Buff your forces with Relics (rewards for killing the big baddies). And enhance your Mage Towers through Academy Research.
Feature Spotlight: Territories
Territory takeover through conquest allows you to claim additional land to build your defenses. Heavy siege weapons recommended!

title: LiDAR Exploration Program
description:
게임 정보
LiDAR Exploration Program is an atmospheric adventure game with light horror elements, where you can't see the world around you. Use the lidar scanner to colorize everything around you. The game contains several levels to explore, in each of which you have to scan unknown objects.
EXPLORE AND SCAN
You find yourself in complete darkness, in which you can't see anything, but thanks to the scanner you can find your way.
SCAN UNKNOWN OBJECTS
You will have to look for objects, some of them will be ordinary, and some will seem very strange and creepy. Using the scanner you will be able to explore them.

title: High Spirits
description:
게임 정보
High Spirits is a potion-based RPG that's brewed to perfection. Transform the staff of legend into a mighty arsenal of weapons shaped by the potions you drink. Fight your way through a magical city as you overcome ever-changing encounters. High Spirits can be played solo or co-op.
WELCOME TO THE KICKIN MULE
After a party-gone-wrong, Flanagan awakens with an irate talking staff and no memory of the night before. With help from his friends at the Kickin' Mule Tavern, Flan will need to shake off his hangover and master alchemy to defeat the spirit bosses that have risen from the dead.
BREW POWERFUL SPIRITS
Collect ingredients from across the city to brew new potions with Mason's brewin' book. Potions can unlock new combat forms and elemental powers. Drink too many too quickly, and you'll discover the effects of arcane inebriation.

title: Paradise
description:
게임 정보
무한한 가능성
**PARADISE®**는 무한한 가능성을 가진 생활 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
친구들과 함께 플레이하고, 총격전, 자동차 경주에 참여하며, 일일 미션을 완료하고 인생의 정점을 달성하세요. 돈을 벌고 부동산에서 고급 의류까지 원하는 것을 구매하세요.
끝없는 세계, 끝없는 플레이.
AI 기반 NPC

title: The Bright Path
description:
게임 정보
"The Bright Path" is an educational game, which provides interactive experience to learn more about the topics of drug abuse, drug addiction, dangerous societal phenomena and active citizenship in an interactive, entertaining and immersive way. We recommend to follow-up with a reflection activity to discuss the choices you made during the game with your students or in your mind with yourself. You play as a young man called Rasmus, who is a  volunteer in a fictional city called „Sobercity“, which is plagued by drug abuse, drug addiction and other dangerous societal phenomena. Your goal is to roam through the city and discover local citizens, who are facing various challenges and to help them or not, but remember every choice you make counts towards shaping the fate of the city !
The game offers the following features and content: 
open world/sandbox mechanics 
play time of around 30 minutes 
meeting NPCs, helping them with their quests and challenges 
collecting collectible items such as podcasts, journals and other items 
discover 3 different endings based on the actions you take during the game 
adventure/exploration gameplay 
learning more about the dangers of drug abuse and active citizenship in a fun way

title: Disaster Blaster
description:
게임 정보
Disaster Blaster is a roguelite auto-shooter card game where you're a mad scientist building the ultimate doomsday weapon! Design your blaster by choosing which cards to sequence while testing it against hordes of alien enemies. Evolve your weapon and try to destroy the entire planet!
Build your blaster...
Add and swap cards in your weapon as their effects are applied in sequence to the next shot. Boost the damage, increase shooting speed, turn bullets into incendiary and bouncing projectiles! Make incredible combos and watch your creation evolve and transform into an indomitable force!

...Destroy everything else
Test your weapon in a virtual conquest mission led by an alien who will face endless waves of enemies until the entire planet is destroyed.

title: SPALG
description:
게임 정보
SPALG is a runner in 3-dimensional space, where you jump and turn around the tube, and your goal is to reach the finish without touching any spikes.
Dodge obstacles
Dodge a variety of obstacles including: spikes, chasms, gravity portals, etc.
Jumps on platforms
Jump on the platforms. and fall back on surface
Customize your character
Choose the colors of your cube

title: SHOOPER NOVA
description:
게임 정보
《격렬슈팅 초신성》은 로그라이크/타워 디펜스/서바이벌 장르의 우주 탄막 전투 게임입니다. 인류는 세계의 대통합이라는 위대한 이상을 실현한 후, 전례 없는 기술적 진보를 이루었습니다. 5202년, 모든 것이 연결되고 지구는 완전히 디지털화되었으며, 새로운 초지능체들이 등장했습니다.
하지만 이로 인해 전례 없는 위기가 다가왔고, 수많은 적들이 빠르게 다가오고 있습니다...
당신은 지구의 초지능체로 변신해, 고도의 기술을 이용해 탄막을 쏘며 사방에서 밀려오는 적들의 공격을 막아야 합니다.
적들과 금광을 처치하고, 새로운 부품을 구매해 환형 요새를 강화하세요.
상상력과 창의력을 발휘해 무자비한 탄막 기계로 변신하세요!

title: Bolsheviktion 3D
description:
게임 정보
Story
Russia, May 1918. In the midst of a civil war, the Bolsheviks have recently seized power. Tsar Nicholas II has abdicated the throne, and has been placed under house arrest in Alexander Palace. You're a diplomat sent to negotiate with the new regime, but instead are suspected of being a spy. Thrown into prison, you face a grim fate. But one night, you have a nightmare. A gruesome scene - a dark, dingy basement, covered in blood, with walls covered in bullet holes. Seeing dead bodies of young women and men, you realise it's the Tsar's family. Waking up in a cold sweat, you make a decision. When the morning guard comes in to check on you, you'll kill him, take his gun and make your escape. The Tsar needs you.
Features
Battle your way through nine distinct locations to discover the whereabouts of the Tsar, fighting through the Bolsheviks' most brutal battalions
Four unique enemy types and two bosses to conquer
4 difficulty modes - Give Me a Go, Dad, Don't Be So Tough, Let's Go Boys! -- and for the insane gamer -- BOLSHEVIKTOR! (not even remotely fair)
Collect treasure and even rarer royal treasure
Find secret pushwalls containing exotic and useful items for combat
Custom graphics, music and sound effects
A custom raycasting 3D engine built from the ground up using the same techniques pioneered in the groundbreaking title Wolfenstein 3D by id Software

title: 我就是建-I just build
description:
게임 정보
This is a decent game.
Play as demon king, buy various monsters, traps, and buildings, build mazes and dungeons, and block heroes!
Play as hero, purchase weapons and props, recruit teammates, conquer the demon king's dungeon, defeat the boss, and make them as teammates!
Game elements:
■When playing the role of a demon king, enter the construction mode to purchase various monsters, traps, buildings, etc., and build your own dungeon maze to block the hero's attack!
■When playing as a hero, enter RPG mode to purchase props, weapons and armor, learn skills, recruit teammates, and explore deep dungeons and mazes!
■Multiple NPC teammates available for recruitment, as well as corresponding story lines!
■A multi-layered maze dungeon with unique features, utilizing monsters and traps to plan and construct, and fully utilizing props and skills to conquer the dungeon!
Thank you for your visit!:)

title: Anime Dream Match: Girls
description:
게임 정보
Anime Dream Match: Girls is a delightful and soothing memory game featuring captivating artwork of adorable anime girls. Test and enhance your memory skills by finding matching pairs of images to complete each level. As you progress, the game becomes more challenging and exciting, offering a truly enjoyable experience.
Immerse yourself in a cute and calming world, perfect for relaxing and sharpening your memory!

Features of Anime Dream Match: Girls:
• 50 engaging levels
• Beautifully crafted anime art
• Simple and intuitive controls (mouse)
• Achievements to unlock
• Relaxing and charming music

title: Sephiria
description:
게임 정보
세피리아는 픽셀 그래픽의 탑다운 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다.

플레이어는 탑 꼭대기 마을의 토끼가 되어 멸망이 뿌리내린 탑의 운명을 바꿔야 합니다.

탑을 내려가 다양한 동물들을 만나고, 여러 아티펙트과 석판들을 모아 강해지세요.

그것이 멸망을 막을 수 있는 유일한 길입니다.



[주요 특징]

- 빠르고 직관적인 조작감의 탑다운 액션게임 : 많은 적을 쓸어 담아 공격하고, 적들의 공격을 막기도 하며 빠르게 진행되는 액션 게임에 빠져보세요.

- 아기자기한 픽셀 그래픽 : 아름다운 픽셀 아트로 구성된 세계를 탐험하세요.

- 당신만의 빌드 : 획득하기만 해도 특별한 효과를 얻을 수 있는 아티팩트와, 인접한 아티팩트의 효과를 강화해주는 석판을 모아 강해지세요.

- 상호작용 가능한 다양한 요소들 : 게임 안에서 만나는 동물들과 대화하고, 부탁을 들어주고, 거래하세요. 그들은 동료가 될 수도, 적이 될 수도 있습니다.

title: CyberArena
description:
게임 정보
"Combat Fairy System"(CFS)
A portable AI combat assistance system developed by "Yunding" company.
It can provide shield defense and tactical support for the wearer. In order to promote, the company also held a competition to show the "performance" of its products. In pursuit of high prize money, a large number of "gladiators" flocked to it.

title: Phantom Relics
description:
게임 정보
고대 던전
잊혀진 지하 묘지에서 고대의 힘이 깨어납니다. 다가오는 종말을 막을 수 있는 유물을 찾기 위해 위험한 여정을 시작합니다. 그러나 어둠이 다가오고 있습니다. 그 힘을 다룰 수 있을까요, 아니면 뒤따르는 저주에 굴복할까요?
실시간 전투
Phantom Relics는 빠른 반응과 정확한 움직임이 생존을 좌우하는 등각 2D 액션 슬래셔 게임입니다. 기사, 언데드, 돌연변이의 무자비한 무리와 싸우고, 독특한 공격 패턴을 가진 두려운 보스에 맞서십시오. 기술을 연마하고, 공격 타이밍을 맞추며 어둠을 뚫고 나아가십시오.

title: 3 bullets
description:
게임 정보
Three bullets is a roguelike stealth game with an emphasis on sandbox mechanics and resource management. Save your ammo and weapons; this world will throw everything it can at you. Can you survive this harsh environment?

title: Kitsune
description:
게임 정보
Your life is unremarkable: you have a boring job, only one person you might call a friend, an ailing mother in an expensive hospital, and a single bedroom apartment which no-one else ever sees. The only interesting thing about your daily routine is the mysterious stranger who appears every night in your dreams. That is until you come home to find the dream-stranger in your apartment, injured and seeking your help.
Kitsune is a 300,000-word story about love, lies and foxes, written by Thom Baylay, author of the Evertree Saga and The Grim and I. It’s entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
Many a fox grows grey but few grow good, and this one has taken a shine to you. How will you react when an agent of chaos enters your mundane life? Will you embrace the opportunity to mix things up or try to maintain some semblance of control? Will you let a supernatural spirit aid you in a divine quest for meaning or will you suspect everyone’s motives and seek the truth behind the extraordinary? 
Step into a mundane life and watch it transform into something magical.
Uncover the mystery of the one who’s been haunting your dreams.
Learn the shocking truths amidst the lies.
Romance your best friend, a company royal or your mother’s nurse—or focus on your mysterious dream-stranger.
Discover who you really are or lose yourself along the way.
Play as male, female or nonbinary.
Play as gay, straight, bisexual or asexual.
Only you know how to live your life, but who even are you? Get ready to go on a journey of self-discovery, and try not to lose yourself to the whims of a mischievous fox.

title: Babel of Ystilia
description:
게임 정보
Babel of Ystilia combines tactical, turn-based gameplay of traditional roguelikes with fast-paced, minimalistic and intuitive combat where your movement and turn timings are the key to getting out of fights unscathed. Learn enemy patterns to outsmart them, loot equipment to create powerful synergies and slay the god to save the world of Ystilia from divine lunacy.
Every enemy is a micro puzzle
Every enemy has a predictable behavior that feels like a micro puzzle. Learn their patterns and you will always be able to beat them with any weapon and without taking any damage.
Play at your own pace
This game is completely turn-based, but it can feel quite fast due to the minimalistic nature of the combat system and the absence of turn delays. Speed up in simple rooms and slow down when you are surrounded by a crowd of enemies to carefully think about your plan.

title: Jin & Jan
description:
게임 정보
Jin & Jan: A ghostly souls-like puzzle game with dual inverse control
Jin & Jan, in an act of mischief, splitted the world in two: the Light World and the Dark World. Now, the intrepid ghost brothers will have to bring back the balance to the world in an exciting adventure that combines puzzle and skill.
Jin follows your instructions, but his twin Jan always move to the opposite. You will need to plan every step carefully, since the enemies react to your movements: some of them move in real time and the others move as you take action. 
Jin and Jan will take you through increasingly difficult levels, where you will be defeated and learn. Every challenge surpassed will take you a little closer to mastering this peculiar duo.
Mind-bending puzzles: Test your brain with puzzles that require coordination and strategic thinking.

title: Oddventure
description:
게임 정보


Oddventure is a JRPG about the misadventures of Charlie - a nihilistic and rebellious teenage girl with anger issues and social awkwardness. Charlie searches for her troublesome brother Bonzo and ultimately for a way back home. The setting is the Kingdom of Luxia, a land straight from original Grimm Brothers’ fairy tales with a dark, Nietzschean twist.




Battle Enemies – Classic turn-based combat with a twist: use the MOOD of your characters! Every battle can be ended in different ways.




Explore and Interact – Meet new people (or creatures). In this world, every character can be talked to and has something to say. Don't forget to check the objects around you, either.



– Every decision matters. It’s up to you how the story plays out and which of several endings you recieve.



- Between battles, explore a world filled with cute and weird puzzles full of odd creatures.

title: This is the last time
description:
게임 정보
This is the Last Time
This is a short narrative game with a dark and heavy atmosphere.
Experience Jon’s final day at work—just before heading home… or so he thought.
Music and Sound design
With carefully selected and arranged audio, every detail serves a purpose. Listen closely.
-  Music by NicoTeenLow 
A brief story
This is a simple yet immersive experience, lasting no more than 5–10 minutes. The gameplay is minimal, but the atmosphere lingers.

title: DOOMER SIMULATOR
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of melancholy and loneliness of a doomer, trapped within the grim walls of a post-Soviet Khrushchyovka at the turn of the century. His life is an endless cycle of monotonous factory work, cheap instant noodles, and strong tea. Around him are worn-out Soviet relics mixed with the artifacts of a new era, creating a bleak yet nostalgia-filled ambiance.
In the game, you will experience:
Atmospheric pastimes – strolls through the courtyard, smoking, or even taking a bath in a futile attempt to wash away the bitterness of life.
Work at the local factory – meet the production quota, or you’ll get fired.

title: Fur and Fables
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of Fur & Fables, where action-packed roguelike meets party management RPG. Gather a team of animal heroes, fight endless hordes of enemies, and upgrade your way to victory!
Dive paw-first into a fur-ocious battle system that mixes bullet-heaven mayhem with strategic character synergy. With an array of animal adventurers at your command, each journey into the darkness promises new challenges. Whether you choose to play defensively with a bunch of Fighters, deal high damage to single targets with the Rogue, or blast your enemies with the Pyromancer’s fireballs - Fur and Fables offers a menagerie of ways to conquer the night.
Laugh in the Face of Danger: Immerse yourself in a game that doesn't take itself too seriously, blending playful art with a touch of dark humor.
Are you ready to unleash your inner animal and carve your path through a world of darkness, humor, and endless adventure? Fur & Fables awaits your command. Join us, and let's create a tale worth telling!
Party synergies: Discover unique bonuses based on your party composition!

title: Roman Triumph: Survival City Builder
description:
게임 정보
개요
Roman Triumph는 'Banished'와 'Kingdoms and Castles'와 같은 클래식 게임에서 영감을 받은 생존 도시 건설/식민지 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 로마 시대를 배경으로 당신은 사람들을 이끌고 도시를 처음부터 건설하고 성벽, 노포, 궁수탑, 기타 방어시설들로 요새화하여 포악한 히드라, 미노타우루스, 세르베루스, 야만인 무리, 전능한 로마 신, 기타 신화 속의 짐승들과 맞서 살아남아야 합니다.
제국 건설
도시 주민들이 분투하도록 하려면 그들을 먹이고, 안전과 건강을 보장하고, 가장 중요하게는 행복하게 해주어야 합니다. 무작위로 생겨난 이 세계에서 도시를 전략적으로 설계하면 제국이 새로운 시민들을 끌어들일 수 있는 가능성(도시 전체의 흡인력과 행복도)이 높아지고, 자원과 식량 생산 효율을 높이고, 여러 신들과의 관계를 개선하며, 공격 시 안전을 최대로 높일 수 있습니다.
요새화 및 공격
당신의 정착지는 오래 동안 점점 더 위험한 적들의 공격을 받게 됩니다. 히드라, 세르베루스, 미노타우루스 같은 신화 속의 짐승들과 날아다니는 짐승들은 당신의 분주한 도시가 자기들의 서식지를 침해하는 것만큼 당신의 제국을 파괴하려고 할 것입니다.

title: Three Skies Ascension
description:
게임 정보
Three Skies Ascension is a hero and creature collecting RPG where your party takes on challenging dungeons in turn-based combat.
Your Hero's Journey
Customize your Commander, collect and level over 200 creatures and heroes, and design the perfectly synergized dungeon exploring party. Unravel the mystery of the Calamity and save the land of Baranor from a mysterious villain surfacing out of your past.
Core Features

title: The Cecil: The Journey Begins
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT:
"The Cecil" is a chilling and suspenseful experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Join John and Sarah as they venture to the eerie and mysterious Cecil Hotel for a romantic getaway.
However, their dream vacation turns into a nightmare when they fall asleep, and John wakes up locked in a dark cell. As he struggles to find a way out, he realizes that Sarah is missing, and he must find her before it's too late.
KEY FEATURES:
First-Person Action: Take on the role of John and experience a spine chilling battle of terrifying pursuit through dark hallways from a first-person perspective.
Discover what lurks the halls of The Cecil hotel, and get up close and personal with creepy monsters and tall metal screamers, leaving you terrified around every corner.

title: The Last of Us Part II Remastered
description:
게임 정보
에디션은 다음을 포함합니다:
The Last of Us Part II Remastered
엘리와 애비의 여정을 이제 PC로 만나보세요
300개가 넘는 GOTY 수상작에 다양한 기술적 개선 사항을 적용한 The Last of Us Part II Remastered는 많은 호평을 받은 엘리와 애비의 이야기를 경험할 수 있는 가장 좋은 방법입니다.
autokwd: The Last of Us Part II Remastered

title: Static : The Beginning
description:
게임 정보
공포와 미스터리의 세계에 빠져보세요
STATIC에서 당신은 평범한 젊은 여성인 클라라가 되어 플레이합니다. 그녀의 삶은 평범한 저녁, TV를 시청하는 것으로 시작되었지만, 곧 끔찍한 악몽으로 변하고 맙니다. 조용했던 밤이 순식간에 공포로 뒤바뀌며, 클라라는 자신의 TV 속 뒤틀린 차원에 갇히게 됩니다. 가까스로 현실 세계로 돌아오지만, 그녀는 이것이 단순한 시작에 불과하다는 사실을 깨닫게 됩니다…
주요 특징
🔹 몰입감 넘치는 탐험 : 아름답게 구현된 모로코 리야드(전통 저택)를 탐험하며, 세밀한 디테일 속에서 숨겨진 공포를 발견하세요.

title: Mountain 78
description:
게임 정보
단순한 게임, 어려운 도전
Mountain 78은 단 세 번의 점프만으로 산을 오르는 게임입니다.
모든 움직임이 중요하며, 한 번의 실수로 다시 바닥으로 떨어질 수도 있습니다.
이 게임은 "포디안(Foddian)" 장르와, 진행을 잃는 것이 도전의 일부가 되는 정밀한 게임에서 영감을 받았습니다.
왜 "78"인가요?
이 숫자는 일본 속담을 기억하기 쉽게 하기 위해 사용되었습니다.
"일곱 번 넘어져도, 여덟 번 일어나라." (七転び八起き, Nanakorobi yaoki)
특징:
신중한 조작이 필요한 등반 도전
내러티브 대화 없이
정상에 도달하면 멋진 불꽃놀이 보상
넘어지고 다시 도전하는 것이 게임의 일부
당신은 정상에 도달할 수 있을까요?

title: TankOre Mining
description:
게임 정보
Four Tank Types
Buy new mining tanks for faster mining: Driller for close-range mining; Blaster for mid-range explosive blast; Detonator for long-range explosion; and Ravager for massive, long-range explosion.
Tank Upgrades
Upgrade your mining tank by purchasing enhancements to increase durability, heat levels, reduce incoming damage, and improve ore collection efficiency.
Challenging Hazards and Traps
Avoid deadly environmental traps, such as corrosive gas, explosive rocks, shockwaves, falling boulders, and waves of fire explosions. Adapt your strategy to survive as you delve deeper into dangerous floors.
Strategic Resource Management
Balance heat buildup and durability to extend your mining expeditions. Collect valuable components to boost your tank’s regeneration capabilities.
Dynamic Mining Gameplay
Explore layered floors filled with valuable ores, components, and rare artifacts. Artifacts, which sell for a high price, may spawn on every 5th floor.
Universal Detector
A reliable tool that detects surrounding ores and components. Artifacts, however, are undetectable, inspiring deeper exploration and rewarding keen discovery skills.

title: Meowland: Island Farm
description:
게임 정보
MeowLand: 아일랜드 팜 – 고양이 섬에서 펼쳐지는 따뜻한 농장 어드벤처! 🌊🐾
MeowLand에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 아름다운 섬을 배경으로 한 아기자기하고 힐링되는 농장 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 영리한 고양이 농부가 되어 땅을 가꾸고, 풍성한 작물을 재배하며, 꿈의 섬을 완전히 사들이기 위해 노력하세요!
🌱 심고 & 수확하기
🛳 거래 & 확장하기
🏡 건설 & 꾸미기
📅 시간 & 자원 관리
탐험하고, 농사를 짓고, MeowLand: 아일랜드 팜에서 완벽한 고양이 낙원을 만들어 보세요! 🐱💛

title: Spirit Valor
description:
게임 정보
Spirit Valor에서 당신은 마법과 운명 사이에서 고군분투하는 영혼이 됩니다. 마법 폭발로 인간 전사 리차드의 몸에 갇힌 그는 악마의 세력이 일어나는 것을 막기 위해 위험한 여정을 떠나게 됩니다. 세계의 법칙이 무너지고, 군주가 사라진 지금, 그들은 이 치명적인 적을 추적해야만 합니다. 강력한 마법석과 마법을 갖춘 영혼 전사는 세계의 균형을 회복하고 악마로 변하지 않도록 막기 위한 서사적 여행을 시작합니다.

이 게임은 모험과 전략이 결합된 풍부한 RPG 경험을 제공합니다. 영혼과 계약을 체결하고, 각 영혼은 당신의 모험을 돕는 독특한 마법 능력을 부여합니다. 아름답게 제작된 픽셀 아트 세계를 탐험하며, 영혼을 강화하고 진화시키며 강력한 마법을 잠금 해제하세요. 동적인 전투 시스템은 빈 마법석을 이용해 적의 기술을 흡수하고, 적의 강점을 자신의 무기로 바꿀 수 있게 합니다. 전략적인 전투와 깊이 있는 마법 시스템, 퀘스트와 탐험이 가득한 세계가 펼쳐지는Spirit Valor는 끝까지 빠져들게 하는 매력적인 판타지 경험을 선사합니다.

title: The Golden Tile
description:
게임 정보
Step into a vibrant pixel-art world where strategy and creativity collide! In this city-building deck-building game, every card is a piece of your puzzle. Place buildings on a dynamic hexagonal grid, optimize your resource generation, and manage prices to maximize your profits.
Hexagonal City-Building: Place cards strategically to create a thriving city, balancing resources like Wheat, Meat, Metal, and Products. And upgrade your city with houses, shops, and factories to boost resource production and create powerful combos.
Deck-Building Progression: Buy cards from a shop or select random rewards after each level to customize your deck and refine your strategy.

title: Get a midnight snack without mom knowing
description:
게임 정보
쉿! 조용히 하세요.
당신이 부엌에서 시끄러운 소리를 낸다면
어느새 자고 있던 엄마가 당신의 등 뒤에 서 있을 겁니다.

단, 무슨 일이 있어도 당신이 들고 있는 접시를 놓아서는 안 됩니다.

title: Couple Maker
description:
게임 정보
Overview
This is a puzzle game where you create couples. Place panels with various effects on a 3x3 grid and help two people in love meet. You can freely choose the combination of couples, such as male-female, male-male, or female-female.
Strong Puzzle Elements
We have prepared a total of 76 levels, ranging from easy to difficult. Each level has a specific number of characters, their arrangement, and the number and types of panels. The level is cleared when all the characters on the field are paired up.
Each level has been designed with a focus on making the puzzle-solving experience enjoyable. Instead of simply increasing the number of similar levels to inflate the game's volume, we have adjusted the levels to ensure that each one offers a unique and engaging challenge.
While the time it takes to clear all the levels may vary depending on the player, it is estimated that it will take around 10 hours to complete all levels.
Support for Various Genders
By default, the game pairs boys and girls together, but you can change this setting from the options menu to allow for same-gender pairings, such as boys with boys or girls with girls. Additionally, there are more detailed settings available for further customization.
Story
The protagonist is a woman in pajamas, as seen in the main visual. Her profession is a romance novel writer.
When brainstorming ideas for her stories, she never skips a mental simulation. In her mind, she creates couples, has them converse, go on dates, and be affectionate with each other, using these imagined scenarios to expand her story ideas.
This game, a puzzle about creating couples, is a representation of her daydreams (or rather, her job to earn a living).
autokwd: Couple Maker,カップルメーカー

description:

Grow, feed and care for your colony of adorable isopods in this realistic semi-idle simulator. Watch your isopods multiply and split or sell your colony if they become too numerous. Created by the Kunstaat community, 100% of our proceeds support charity!

Work In Progress:

Realistic isopod behavior
Customizable enclosures
Humidity systems
Idle game style progress mechanics
Unique patterns on each isopod
Cute lads

title: TETRIS THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE
description:
게임 정보
1998년 8월, 게임센터에 등장한 액션 퍼즐 게임 『TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER』는, 다양한 도전 요소로 가득 찬 게이머 지향의 『테트리스』로서 많은 팬들에게 사랑받는 작품이 되었습니다.
그 후, 2000년에 『TETRIS THE ABSOLUTE THE GRAND MASTER 2』, 2005년에 『TETRIS THE GRAND MASTER 3 -Terror Instinct-』가 차례대로 발매되었고, 20년 만에 시리즈 최신작 『TETRIS THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-』가 Steam에 등장합니다.

title: SD Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
"SD 던전즈"는 탑다운 방식의 로그라이크 액션 게임입니다.
다양한 파츠와 액세서리를 조합해 자신만의 캐릭터를 만들고,
여섯 가지 직업 중 원하는 것을 선택하세요.
각 직업과 무기의 고유한 스킬과 액션을 활용해 던전 깊숙이 도전하세요!
무작위로 생성되는 던전 층에서는
몬스터와 함정, 그리고 운명을 결정하는 게이트가 기다리고 있습니다.
게이트를 지나면 천국일까, 지옥일까… 아니면 강력한 보스일까!?
보물 상자나 몬스터, 보스를 처치하여 강력한 무기와 방어구를 얻을 수도 있습니다!
더 강력한 아이템을 찾아 계속 전진할지,
아니면 안전하게 탈출하여 아이템과 경험치를 꾸준히 쌓을지는 당신의 선택에 달려 있습니다!
＜캐릭터 생성＞
헤어스타일, 머리 색상, 눈 모양, 액세서리 등 다양한 요소를 선택하여 자신만의 개성 있는 캐릭터를 만들어 보세요!
귀여운 캐릭터부터 멋진 캐릭터까지, 자유롭게 디자인하세요!

title: Primal Hunger
description:
게임 정보
“우리를 죽이지 못하는 것은 우리를 더 강하게 만든다.” 프리드리히 니체

사냥하지 못하면 사냥 당하게 된다. 먹지 못하면 먹히게 되지. 진화하지 못한다면 죽어라. 당신이 지배할 수 있도록 전투하고 진화하라. 죽여라. 먹어라. 진화하라. 진화의 사슬을 지배하고, 최고 포식자로써의 당신의 아성에 도전하는 자들을 부셔버려라.

진화 촉매를 모으려면 다른 진화체들을 처단해야만 합니다. 당신은 촉매를 모아 더 강력한 생명체로 진화할 수 있고, 결국 다른 플레이어를 완전히 죽이고, 섬에 대한 지배권을 주장할 수 있는 최고 포식자로 변모할 수 있습니다.

title: A Session with Dr. Liebnitz
description:
게임 정보
A Session with Dr. Liebnitz is a single-player exploration game taking place in the mind of the playable character.
You play as The Character. You will be wandering through the Character's mind, trying to cure it from fear, depression, anger and many more deep, troubling conditions. This is only possible due to the extravagant techniques of one Dr. Liebnitz, who will be with you every step of the way.
Discover the dark, hidden secrets of the character's mind and free them from their pain. And who knows, perhaps you shall discover some of your own secrets in this poor Character's mind...
-Developed by Kalempirion Studios 13 -
-Solo-Dev and Music : The DAC-


Disclaimer: This is a game. This game should not be used as a substitute for any medical or psychological treatment. If you do require any assistance, please make sure to contact real, licensed physicians. Dr. Liebnitz is just a fictional character.

title: Ekoh Beach
description:
게임 정보
Ekoh 99 has been isolated for years, but a job posting for the mysterious planet’s new town planner brings you to this quaint tropical paradise. Your work is cut out for you. The town has been devastated by an evil Robot Rebellion, and the brilliant quantum scientist: Dr Terra has disappeared! Fulfil your destiny and rebuild the town, befriend its new citizens, bring the planet back to life, and uncover the lost secrets of Ekoh Beach as you return it to its former glory!
Rebuild the town of Ekoh Beach!  Ekoh Beach has seen better days and the Robot Rebellion left the town in ruins. Restore Ekoh Beach to its high-tech heyday with the help of some weird and wonderful hyper-quantum resources. There's no place like your new home but it sure is a mess! Most of the townspeople are gone and the old houses are either blasted by Rebelling Robots or just plain falling down! Start with a few humble houses then build bustling business like the inter-Dimensional bakery or MegaBrain Library. As the town grows and people return the projects get even more ambitious…how about a Quantum Mechanics or even a Spaceport!?

title: Mythic Battlegrounds: Demonic Siege
description:
게임 정보
Prepare yourself for an epic journey into the heart of a world where strategy, survival, and myth collide. Mythic Battlegrounds: Demonic Siege is a turn–based strategy and defense game that thrusts you into a relentless battle for survival against dark forces. Command one of four unique races – Humans, Elves, Orcs, and Dwarves, each with their own legendary commanders and units. As the world teeters on the brink of destruction, it’s up to you to lead your armies, forge powerful alliances, and turn the tide against the demonic horde.
In Mythic Battlegrounds: Demonic Siege, battles are automatic, but every decision you make before the clash is critical. Each turn, you’ll need to carefully manage your resources, train your units, and place your forces to survive the next wave of enemies. Will you invest in powerful units or save your gold to earn interest? The choice is yours, and it could mean the difference between victory and defeat.

With 8 commanders to choose from, each with unique abilities, your strategy will shift depending on who you lead into battle. Whether you’re rallying troops with Kaela Valtorin, the Master-at-Arms who can transform militias into seasoned soldiers, or unleashing the ancient magic of Archdruid Archeon to summon fierce creatures of nature, your commander’s skills will shape your path to victory.

title: Commander Quest
description:
게임 정보
"적들이 들끓는 판타지 세계에 당신은 작은 불씨 로 되살아 났습니다."
"먼 옛날 영웅들의 힘을 빌려 적들을 물리치세요."
커맨더 퀘스트는 덱 빌딩 카드 게임과 실시간 전략 게임의 장르조합으로 탄생한
세상에 하나뿐인 로그라이크입니다.
귀엽지만 브루탈한 판타지 유닛들의 전투. 유닛간의 상성을 고민하고, 카드 시너지의 결과가 필드에 펼쳐지는 독창적이고 깊이 있는 게임플레이를 경험해보세요.

title: SWAT Commander: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
SWAT Commander: 프롤로그는 곧 출시될 팀 전술 슈팅 게임의 무료 소개 버전이며, 게임의 최종 버전을 반영하지 않습니다. 게임의 특징에 대한 설명은 전체 게임의 페이지에서 확인하세요!
여러분은 프롤로그에서 두 번째 임무인 Hot Reception의 도전을 마주하게 됩니다. SWAT 분대에서 친구들과 함께 팀을 이루거나 라이벌 갱단 간에 벌어지는 격렬한 총격전이 벌어진 자동차 정비소를 홀로 조사하세요. 범죄 활동의 증거를 확보하고, 범인들을 법의 심판대에 세우고, 질서를 회복하세요!
임무 브리핑을 숙지하고 무고한 민간인을 위협하는 위험이 무엇인지 알아내세요. 여러분이 직접 마주하게 될 테니까요. SWAT 요원에게 다양한 소총, 권총, 갑옷, 전술 장비를 갖춰주어 적대적인 갱단에 맞서 싸우세요.
멀티플레이어 로비를 만들어 다른 플레이어를 초대하거나 홀로 임무에 참여 또는 다른 SWAT 지휘관의 로비에 참여하세요. 각자 가져올 장비나 선택할 진입 지점에 대한 임무 계획을 조율하고 논의하세요.

title: Brixby
description:
게임 정보
Join Brixby on a Block-Building Adventure!
Embark on an exciting platforming journey in Brixby, a vibrant and action-packed adventure where every level is built from dynamic building blocks! Inspired by classic platformers, Brixby delivers fast-paced gameplay, thrilling challenges, and a world brimming with creativity and danger.
A Battle to Save the Land
The evil Shadow Block and his army of Grey Blocks have invaded, spreading darkness and destruction across the land. As Brixby, the heroic builder, you must journey through diverse and beautifully crafted environments to stop their reign of terror and restore color and life to your world. From sandy deserts to icy forests, from bustling metropolitan cities to towering royal castles, every level offers fresh challenges and surprises.
Platforming at Its Finest
Leap, run, and build your way through intricately designed levels, dodging pitfalls, spikes, and enemies while collecting precious marbles. Take to the skies in a high-speed plane chase, navigate treacherous cave systems in a thrilling minecart ride, and battle powerful foes, including a fearsome dragon guarding Princess Goldie Bloxx. Each encounter will test your reflexes and skill as you strive to reclaim your homeland.
What to Expect:
Classic side-scrolling platformer action with a modern twist
A variety of stunning environments, including deserts, forests, cities, and giant block landscapes
Exciting gameplay mechanics, including flying, minecart riding, and epic boss battles
Engaging collectibles and secrets hidden throughout the world
A heroic journey filled with danger, adventure, and fun!
Are you ready to take on Shadow Block and save your kingdom? The world of Brixby awaits!

title: Bunny Hurling
description:
게임 정보
숲에서 아기 토끼를 활로 추적하고 사냥하세요. 왕의 명령입니다.
투석기를 장전하고, 아기 토끼를 성 안으로 날려 보내세요. 아무도 감사하지 않을 겁니다.
상황은 점점 더 기묘해지고… 훨씬 더 위험해집니다.


BUNNY HURLING에서 할 수 있는 것들…

게임 정보
You are in a Dark maze WITH MONSTERS, where your only source of light is your flashlight! Try to find and Collect 18 keys to try and Escape that Scary maze and, most importantly,
TRY TO NOT DIE.

title: War of the Old Gods
description:
게임 정보
PRESENTATION
This is a classic 2D old-school RPG in the style of the retro Super NES and Genesis RPGs such as Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest.
Oriana has promised to herself to live by one duty and one duty only, to protect her little brother, Orion.
In the blood of their family, runs the prophecy of the Vessels, those who are capable of channelling the powers of the Old Gods, and use them to banish evil. The prophecy skipped Oriana and landed on Orion, who is now being hunted by those who his powers menace the most.
The country is on the brink of a new war, and Oriana and her brother are caught between that and their own personal safety. Orion will have to learn from his older sister how to properly use his powers, because he knows that ultimately, he won't be able to avoid doing so.
FEATURES
A beautiful and touching storyline about brotherhood
A semi open world experience. Explore the world with freedom
Traverse through dungeons, pyramids, shrines and more
Autosave feature
Mouse Support

title: Scrambler
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Scrambler, where adorable characters and menacing enemies collide in a whirlwind of action! In this rogue-like wave survival game, you’ll control a group of lovable yet fierce cartoon heroes, each with unique abilities and powers. Your mission? Survive endless waves of quirky, unpredictable enemies—ranging from mischievous little critters to giant, menacing bosses—all while unlocking new upgrades and weapons.
Each run is a fresh adventure, with procedurally generated levels ensuring no two experiences are the same. Collect power-ups, discover hidden treasures, and fight to stay alive as the chaos intensifies! With every wave, the challenge grows, but so do your characters, leveling up in delightful and unexpected ways.
Scrambler combines charming visuals with frantic gameplay. Will you be able to outlast the adorable onslaught and become the ultimate wave survivor?
Get ready to fight, dodge, and level up in this action-packed rogue-like survival adventure that’s as cute as it is chaotic!

title: Super Dash
description:
게임 정보
빠르게 진행되는 탄막 슈팅 게임으로, 당신의 함선은 발사하지 않습니다. 적에게 돌진하여 파괴하세요.
게임에는 다양한 파워업, 적 유형, 그리고 보스가 등장하며, 적의 물결 속에서 살아남는 데 필요한 독특하고 흥미로운 도전을 제공합니다.
미니멀한 게임 플레이는 배우기 쉽지만 숙달하기 어렵습니다.

title: The Door
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to The Door, a narrative and psychological game where every choice confronts you with your own thoughts.
"What if every door you opened was a window into your own mind?"
In The Door, you will have to go through a series of trials where each door represents an inner reflection. Between light and darkness, hope and doubt, you will have to solve puzzles and make decisions to move forward. But will you be ready to face what your mind has in store for you?
Gameplay and main mechanics
A narrative game based on choices: each door plunges you into a dilemma to solve.
Symbolic puzzles: play with lighting and interactions to progress.
An immersive atmosphere: an intriguing narration accompanied by a striking sound atmosphere.
An introspective journey: explore themes such as solitude, failure and resilience.
A short but intense experience: designed to leave a lasting mark.

title: Monster Care Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Monster Care Simulator에서 귀여운 몬스터들을 돌보며 나만의 돌봄 센터를 구축하고 발전시키세요! 초보 수의사에서 성공한 센터 소유자로 성장하세요.
작은 시작, 큰 꿈
작은 돌봄 센터에서 시작하여 유명한 시설로 발전시키세요. 몬스터들을 치료하고 돈을 벌어 공간을 확장하고 장비를 업그레이드하며 더 많은 생물을 맞이하세요.
몬스터들을 돌보세요
치료 구역에서 맞춤형 케어를 제공한 후, 몬스터들이 휴식을 취하고 놀 수 있는 정원을 꾸며보세요. 각 생물마다 고유한 요구 사항이 있으며, 여러분의 관심이 필요합니다.

title: College Escape
description:
게임 정보
This is a semi-open-ended pixel RPG in which the player takes on the role of a student in a school, and the player has to find a way for this student to escape from this school after seven days!
[Rich Ending]
The escape plan must not be leaked, but the trust between the students must not be disregarded, a little carelessness, the whole game is lost.
[Interesting Achievement System]
The game contains numerous achievements, and you will surely revel in the excitement when the achievement trophies pop up!
[NPCs with grateful hearts]
All for one, one for all. What kind of unexpected thanks (gifts) will you bring to the students you've helped once again?
Interesting Interaction System]
Pick up garbage, turn in quests, grow vegetables, fish, dress up ...... All these fun can be experienced in these seven short but long days.
autokwd: College Escape,学院逃生 正式版

title: Nitronauts
description:
게임 정보
Nitronauts 2~6명의 플레이어가 오프라인/온라인을 통해 함께 즐길수 있는, 고전적인 Bomberman 스타일과 새로운 폭발적인 스타일을 결합시킨 파티 게임입니다. 개성넘치는 아이템과 파워업 아이템들을 활용해 9개의 독특한 스테이지를 배경으로 전투를 벌이세요. 친구들과 모여 폭탄을 가지고 대화를 나눠보세요.
주요 특징
2~6명의 플레이어가 오프라인/온라인으로 함께 플레이하세요.
플레이어의 전략과 적응력을 시험하는 독특한 디자인으로 가득한 9개의 스테이지
19개의 파워업 아이템들이 존재합니다. 탱크, 클러스터 폭탄, 레이저 울타리 등을 사용해 전투를 지휘하세요.
배틀 로얄, 킹 오브 더 힐, 영토 점령의 3가지 게임 모드. 팀을 이루거나 혹은 혼자서 플레이하세요.
AI 봇과 함께 하거나, 혹은 AI 봇과 경쟁하세요.
죽음은 끝이 아닙니다. 고스트 모드를 통해 복수의 기회를 노리며 계속해서 플레이하세요.

title: Another Game About Digging A Hole
description:
게임 정보
Descend to an unexplored planet. Extract valuable resources, sell them for profit and upgrade your equipment - will you be able to find the last precious item hidden in the mines?
Will you be able to find the entire collection hidden in the depths?
autokwd: Another Game About Digging A Hole

title: Strangers Lurk
description:
게임 정보
Strangers Lurk is a next gen horror experience played from the POV of a bodycam as you try to survive a night of being stalked and taunted by a unknown masked stranger.

Story:

Play as Erica who works as a nanny for insurance purposes she is required to wear a bodycam while sitting for people. Its a friday night and the neighbors down the road had their sitter cancel last minute and asked you if you could come instead. What starts as a normal nights baby sitting becomes a chilling fight for survival as a masked maniac taunts you. Will you survive the night? Or will you become another victim of this deranged masked stranger.

KEY FEATURES:

Multiple areas to explore:
Set across 2 levels with multiple houses to explore with where danger lurks at every turn!

Realistic Environment: 
This game is built with Unreal Engine 5 to create a terrifying realistic home invasion experience.

Jump Scares
A masked maniac on the loose and dark corners everywhere your every move should be considered or it could be your last!

title: Liquor And Wine Shop Simulator - Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Liquor and Wine Shop Simulator takes you on a relaxing journey through the charming streets of France, where you'll run your very own wine and liquor shop! In this chill store management game, you'll start as a humble cashier, scanning items, giving the correct change, and earning your way to the top. But that's just the beginning—design and decorate your store with French-inspired elegance, from rustic wooden wine racks to stylish décor that will attract connoisseurs from far and wide.
This is a fun and relaxing store management game where you run your very own liquor and wine shop! Start small as a cashier, scanning items and giving the correct change to your customers, then work your way up to managing a full-fledged business. You'll need to keep your shelves stocked with the finest wines, spirits, and craft liquors, while finding the best deals from suppliers to maximize your profits.
autokwd: Liquor And Wine Shop Simulator - Store Simulator

title: 见诡录：阴魂街 Haunting Record: Phantom Street
description:
게임 정보
"Haunting Record: Phantom Street" is a horror-themed walking simulator filled with fear and suspense. You step into a street both strange and familiar, where eerie events unfold one after another. The air is thick with lingering spirits and overwhelming resentment, as if something in the shadows is waiting to drag you into the abyss… With terror and the unknown closing in, will you break free from their grasp, or will you slowly lose yourself in the darkness?
Gameplay:
The core mechanic of the game is "spotting anomalies": as you advance down the path, carefully observe your surroundings and determine whether what you see is normal. If everything appears ordinary, turn left; if you notice anything strange or unsettling, turn right.
But this is far from a simple observation game. As your journey deepens, you will face intense and thrilling chases, explore twisted and bizarre "Core of the Pool" scenes, confront your chaotic inner self, or navigate through endless labyrinths in search of a sliver of hope. Each scene intertwines with the protagonist's forgotten and distorted memories.
Game Features:
Four distinct level styles: From eerie anomaly-spotting environments to symbolic and metaphorical spiritual worlds, each level offers a completely unique experience.
Diverse gameplay: Beyond spotting anomalies, you’ll explore the unknown, make crucial decisions, and find your way through intricate mazes.
Four unique endings: The story unfolds in four different directions based on your choices. Will you uncover the entire truth, or will you sink into endless oblivion?
Immersive atmosphere: Combining sound design, lighting, and environmental storytelling to deliver a deeply immersive horror experience.
Important Notes:
Estimated playtime: 1.5 to 2 hours or more.
The game contains unavoidable jump scares and horror imagery. Please proceed with caution if you are sensitive to such elements.
autokwd: 见诡录：阴魂街 Haunting Record: Phantom Street

title: Maisons de repos
description:
게임 정보
Maison's de repos is a survival horror game base on true events where players take on the role of the new night shift worker Karen who is starting her first shift at Briarwood house. Can you handle the night shift!

title: Windows Separate Worlds: Chapter 1
description:
