title: Fallen Worlds
description:
게임 정보
Fallen Worlds는 약탈에 중점을 둔 액션 RPG, 핵 앤 슬래시 및 로그라이트 요소가 독특하게 혼합되어 있습니다. 좋아하는 RPG의 최고의 요소와 환상적인 스타일의 그래픽으로 던전 크롤링을 새로운 차원으로 끌어 올렸습니다!
몰락한 세계를 구하세요!
최후의 방어선으로 , 각 타락한 세계를 구하기 위해 악마 군대와 싸우는 것이 당신의 일입니다! 각 막에서 한 세계에서 다음 세계로 여행하고 악마 군대 장군을 물리쳐 그 세계를 구하세요!
1-4명의 플레이어

당신의 길을 가십시오 악마 군대의 무리를 통해 혼자 또는 최대 4명의 플레이어 그룹으로! 난이도는 파티 규모에 따라 조정되어 계속 도전할 수 있습니다!
능력 색상 사용자 정의

능력 색상이 마음에 들지 않습니까? 각 능력의 모양을 원하는 색상으로 맞춤설정하세요!

다양한 격투 스타일

각 실행이 다릅니다! 모든 캐릭터는 전리품과 선택한 시작 기술을 기반으로 제어할 수 있는 고유한 전투 스타일을 갖도록 설계되었습니다! 유리 대포 Ice mage를 서리가 내린 탱크로 바꾸고 싶습니까? 선택은 당신의 것입니다!

10억 개가 넘는 다양한 룬 조합에서 전리품을 찾아 새로운 패시브 기술과 보너스가 실행에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다! 6개의 희귀도와 룬의 특정 측면을 업그레이드하고 다시 롤링할 수 있는 단조 시스템을 사용하여 선택한 빌드에 대한 완벽한 설정을 만들 수 있습니다.


지도에서 지도로 변경되는 새로운 만남에서 무수히 많은 특수 적 기술을 피하십시오. 게임의 로그라이크 측면에 충실하면 서로 다른 세계의 무작위 이벤트, 실행을 변경할 수 있는 강력한 혜택이 있는 무작위 신전, 이벤트 상점에서 구매할 특정 아이템을 선택할 수 있습니다.


게임에 할애할 시간이 많지 않으세요? 아니면 90분간의 로그라이크 탈출에 질렸을 수도 있습니다. 괜찮아요. 타락한 세계로의 탐험은 평균 25-35분이 걸립니다. 힘을 향상시키는 농장 에센스에 뛰어들거나 특정 기술과 수정자를 신중하게 설정하여 더 어려운 난이도를 푸세요. 활동 중간에 일찍 종료할 수도 있습니다!

title: Tempopo
description:
게임 정보
노래하는 꽃이 피는 하나의 정원이 아름다운 섬으로 가득한 하늘에 흩뿌려졌어요. 이제 하나는 마법의 템포포에게 가서 정원을 되돌리는 걸 도와달라고 부탁해야 해요. 템포포는 타고나길 정신없고 부산스러운 존재지만, 하나의 지휘에 맞추어 올바른 방향으로 나아가며 모든 섬의 퍼즐을 해결한답니다.
사계절을 지나며 퍼즐을 맞춰요
각각의 퍼즐 섬은 계획하고 실행하는 도전으로 가득해요. 다양한 배열과 경로를 실험하고, 모든 템포포가 사계절 내내 퍼즐을 통해 서로 부딪히고, 들어 올리고, 밀면서 각자의 역할을 하도록 지시하세요.
음악을 연주하세요
살아 있는 모든 것이 박자에 맞추어 조화롭게 움직이는, 음악이 가득한 밝고 즐거운 세상이 펼쳐져요. 영국 아카데미 시상식(BAFTA)에서 수상받은 경력이 있는 작곡가이자 오디오 디렉터인 Jeff van Dyck의 사운드트랙 덕분에 모든 음이 기쁨으로 가득하답니다.
가능성의 공간
퍼즐을 해결할 때마다 한 송이 꽃을 구출하고, 그 꽃은 멜로디 정원의 일원이 돼요. 꽃은 종류에 따라 자신만의 선율로 노래를 부르고, 그 선율을 모아 나만의 음악 공연을 즐길 수도 있답니다.

title: Run-Sprint-Parkour!
description:
게임 정보
달려서 결승선까지 달려라! 시간이 다 되기 전에 동전, 다이아몬드, 현금을 모으세요!
배고픔이나 갈증이 건강과 함께 줄어들지 않도록 하세요!
생존을 위한 식량, 더 많은 아이템을 운반할 수 있는 백팩, 새 아파트 열쇠, 운전할 차량, 도끼, 멋지고 재밌는 화장품을 살 수 있습니다! 항공 여행사에서 다른 맵을 탐험하고 여행하여 커리어를 이어가고, 짜릿함을 느끼고 액션을 즐기세요!

title: The Flayed Man
description:
게임 정보
                  The Flayed Man is a short, chilling experience ~30 minutes long, perfect for playing before bed, especially if you’re in the mood for a nightmare.
You are the Flayed Man. Awaking in a decayed, otherworldly house where your every waking moment is agony, you must uncover the sins of the past, pass judgement, and decide your fate in this unsettling, macabre adventure.
                                               A dark horror game with mature, disturbing themes.
Multiple endings depending on your choices.
An atmospheric and moody original soundtrack.
Evocative and chilling pixel-art graphics.
Traditional point and click gameplay with modern mechanics and user interface.
Psychosexual demons that will give any budding psychologist food for thought.

title: Pax Augusta
description:
게임 정보
Pax Augusta - The ultimate ancient city-building simulation
Immerse yourself in the fascinating world of the Roman Empire and build your own ancient metropolis! Pax Augusta is probably the most authentic city-building simulation set in the ancient world and puts you in the role of an ambitious governor who builds new cities along the Roman borders.
While Emperor Augustus expands the borders of the empire, capable governors are sought to found new cities in order to consolidate the Roman claim to the newly conquered land. You build a small settlement along a newly constructed imperial road. You attract new inhabitants to the city by building a harbor and a forum.
As your tax revenue increases, you start to mine raw materials and construct new buildings to meet the needs of the population. Baths, theaters, gladiator schools, slave markets, and more serve not only to keep your inhabitants entertained, but also to provide them with work.
Build impressive city districts, ensure the well-being of your citizens, engage in flourishing trade and erect magnificent monuments that will last for centuries. But the road to the top is full of challenges - fire, corruption, unrest and the whims of the emperor will put your leadership skills to the test time and again.
As a skillful governor, you will quickly attract the attention of the senate or the emperor. Increase your reputation enough and you can found new settlements. As you increase your private fortune, you will eventually be able to afford to apply for new offices. This gives you the opportunity to build monuments and unlock new building sites.
Will you become a skillful administrator and make your city flourish? Or will you fail and be deposed by the Senate?
Your skill will decide your fate in the most powerful empire of the ancient world!
 Authentic urban planning in antiquity
Historically accurate architecture: Numerous buildings are based on real-life models and have been recreated with meticulous accuracy. Many of these buildings can still be seen as ruins today!
Experience the construction of a Roman city: Build residential areas, market squares, temples, forums, thermal baths and much more - each building fulfills an important purpose for city life.
Fluid growth mechanics: Your city grows organically with its challenges. From a small outpost to a vibrant metropolis - every decision counts!

title: Polterguys: Possession Party
description:
게임 정보
Your powers of possession bring inanimate objects to life! Use them to fight, run away or just look darn good whilst you soak up the chaos unfolding around you!
Polterguys is a spooky brawlfest where mischievous ghosts are being stalked by a deadly monster who wants to destroy them all! Chaotic? Yes! Competitive? You betcha!

title: The Night Museum
description:
게임 정보
Step into the shoes of a lowly night clerk at The Night Museum, a mysterious place filled with eerie artefacts, unsettling oddities, and, more recently, something far worse. The job starts simple enough: sell tickets, collect money, and make sure patrons leave in one piece. But as the nights go on, the exhibits become more... lively.
As the night attendant, your job is fairly straightforward. Collect money, issue tickets, and keep the museum presentable. But when things go wrong, and they will, you'll need to clean up the mess before the manager notices. Pools of blood, vomit, and worse. It's all part of the job. Just be careful...

title: Clockwork Rabbit
description:
게임 정보
의류 공장에서 기계공으로 일하는 토끼 테사를 안내하세요. 주인공은 재봉실과 염색 작업장 등 다양한 부서를 돌아다니며 고장난 기계 장치를 수리합니다.


토끼는 일거리가 너무 많아서 로봇을 만들고 프로그래밍하여 일을 돕습니다. 또한 막다른 골목에 빠지면 시간을 되돌릴 수 있습니다.
각 레벨은 비판적 사고가 필요한 작은 퍼즐입니다.



플레이어는 자신만의 공장 위치를 만들 수 있는 에디터에 액세스하여 다른 플레이어와 공유할 수 있습니다.



이 게임은 알폰스 무하와 아르데코의 작품에서 영감을 받은 독특한 그래픽 스타일이 특징입니다. 토끼의 굴을 연상시키는 식물 모티브와 스팀펑크의 증기 동력 기계가 흥미롭게 조화를 이루고 있습니다.



주인공이 이동하는 공장의 여러 구역을 반영하는 악기들로 구성된 독특한 음악이 게임을 위해 준비되었습니다. 보일러실에서는 증기가 떨어지는 소리가 선명하게 들리고, 사무실에서는 회계사의 양피지 위에서 펜이 움직이는 소리가 들립니다.

title: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree
description:
게임 정보
인류는 몬스터에게 굴복했고 그로 인해 세계를 빼앗겼습니다. 펠듀엄 사람들은 지도자가 벽돌로 지은 무지의 성벽과 울타리 뒤에 숨어 버렸습니다. 환희와 기쁨은 평범한 사람이 가질 수 없는 탐나는 보석이 되었습니다. 여긴 당신이 약속했던 세계가 아닙니다. 아무것도 보이지 않는 밤에 여행을 떠나 세계를 되찾으세요.
엔트로피의 사악한 영향 아래 먹이가 되어 천천히 무너져가는 세계를 여행하세요. 사악한 크리처와 싸우고, 악몽 같은 보스에게 도전해 보세요. 새로운 동맹과 적, 그리고 그 사이의 모든 그늘과 마주치며 때로는 가혹한 도덕적 선택을 해야 합니다. 도전할 만한 수많은 길이 있습니다. 원하는 길을 선택해 보세요.
독특한 횡스크롤 소울라이크
형벌과 보상이 동일하게 잔혹한 방식으로 이루어지는 2.5D 횡스크롤 맵과 스킬 중심 전투의 독특한 조합을 즐겨 보세요. 음흉한 경비원에서부터 브레이어 섬의 뱀파이어까지 자비가 없는 적과 당신을 만들어 내거나 망가뜨려 버릴 독특하고 무서운 보스와 맞서 보세요.
다크 판타지 세계 속에 빠져들다
시대를 초월한 아트 디렉션과 크리스토스 안토니우(Christos Antoniou)의 장엄하고 뒤틀린 음악이 깔린 풍부하고 분위기 있는 세계 속에서 길을 잃고 헤매어보세요. 메트로배니아 탐험, 무너져가는 벽 허물기, 그라운드 스트라이크 등 새로운 스킬을 사용하거나 그래플링 훅으로 건물 위까지 기어오르기 등 많은 기술을 활용해 보세요.
autokwd: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree

title: Chasmal Fear
description:
게임 정보
게임 소개

"Chasmal Fear"는 플레이어를 수수께끼로 가득 찬 과학 기반 수중 시설로 이끄는, 첫 번째 시점 전술 슈팅 서바이벌 호러 게임입니다. 어떤 일이 엄청난 잘못이 생긴 곳입니다. 탄약은 부족하고, 승리의 기회는 당신에게 무리하게 쌓여 있습니다. 몬스터들과 싸울지, 아니면 몬스터들을 피해 은밀하게 지나갈지 현명하게 선택하세요. 일단 처치하면 더 나쁜 무언가로 변형될 수도 있는 이 끔찍한 존재들입니다. 숨겨진 지역을 찾고 퍼즐을 해결하여 이 최상급 기밀 시설에서 무슨 일이 일어났는지의 진실을 밝혀내세요. 모든 결정은 게임 플레이 경험에 영향을 미칩니다. 어떤 결정은 끊임없이 몰려오는 몬스터들과의 전투를 의미하고, 다른 결정은 은밀하고 교묘한 방법을 사용하여 생존할 수 있는 기회를 제공할 것입니다.

지금 바로 "Chasmal Fear"를 위시리스트에 추가하여 최신 뉴스를 받아보세요!
주요 기능:

한정된 자원

한정된 플레이어 탄약과 부족한 탄약 상자는 플레이어들에게 버려진 강철 복도를 건너면서 전략적으로 생각하고 신중하게 움직이도록 격려할 것입니다.


몰입형 바디캠

바디카메라 영상의 시점을 활용한 예술적 연출. 가까운 미래가 배경으로, 플레이어들은 Magnus 시설의 어두운 복도를 통과하는 데 도움이 되는 AR 인터페이스를 장착합니다.

title: White Knuckle
description:
게임 정보
White Knuckle is a first person roguelite speed-climbing game.
Use momentum-based movement mechanics with precision, deploy a variety of tools and resources, and ascend as fast as you can. 
Just don't lose your grip, there’s eternity below you.
Manage your inventory or become encumbered and fall to your death. Failure to grab what you need from your bag in time can spell disaster.
Through run-based meta-progression, you’ll discover and unlock varied augmentations. 
Bolster your will to ascend.

title: Flushed
description:
게임 정보
Flushed – Unlock the Doors, Question Reality
You wake up in an abandoned asylum. How did you get here? You don’t know. But one thing is clear: you need to get out. The first key is right next to you, easy to find—but the real challenge begins now. As you step through the door, you find yourself walking towards a dark and unsettling apartment building.
Flushed is a first-person exploration game focused purely on atmosphere and psychological tension, without complex puzzles or direct storytelling. Each apartment hides the key to the next, but as you progress, the world around you begins to change…
Key Features:
🔹 Tension and Atmosphere-Driven Gameplay – No need for direct storytelling; just immerse yourself in the unease of your surroundings.
🔹 Free Exploration – No hints, no guidance—just search for the keys and move forward.
🔹 Shifting Environments – From an abandoned asylum to a disturbing apartment complex, the world evolves as you progress.
🔹 Minimal Mechanics, Maximum Suspense – A gripping experience without relying on traditional horror elements.
🔹 A Cinematic Experience in Unreal Engine 4 – Dark corridors, cold rooms, and an ever-changing world pulling you deeper.
The first key is easy—but what about the rest?

title: STAY ALIVE MY SON : A True Story About A Father's Search For His Son
description:
게임 정보
OVERVIEW
Spanning over 45-years, Stay Alive My Son (SAMS) is a groundbreaking virtual reality odyssey where you are transported into the life of Yathay Pin, a survivor of the Cambodian genocide to witness the world through his eyes, where every decision you make unfolds his poignant story of family separation, survival, and resilience. This narrative is based on the true events described in Yathay Pin's compelling novel Tu Vivras Mon Fils (Stay Alive My Son), making every moment of the game an authentic dive into history.
Made by a small team with purpose, SAMS is more than an experience through the life of one man; it's a bridge to the past, an exploration of the depths of human endurance, and a testament to the indomitable spirit of love and the essence of what it means to persevere, to forgive, and to heal.
Honored with the Producers' Guild Innovation Award and five Telly Awards for breaking new ground in storytelling, SAMS revolutionized cinema history by creating a new genre in filmmaking called “Cineplay.” This genre merges cinematic storytelling with interactivity, allowing you to live the life of a real person with a deeply human and emotive narrative. By pioneering a hyper-realistic digital representation of Yathay and integrating volumetric capture of real actors, SAMS brings Yathay and his family to life inside the game engine, enabling you to relive key moments leading to his family's separation and his quest for atonement.
THE EXPERIENCE
Your journey begins outside Yathay’s home, where you meet an eighty-eight-year-old man, brought to life with a hyper-realistic digital human powered by AI. As light gameplay mechanics guide your path, you delve deeper into the psyche of a father haunted by choices from his past. In a ceremonial rite that intertwines your fate with his, your hands become his; you see the world through his eyes; his memories and dilemmas flood your consciousness. In a surreal twist reminiscent of "Alice in Wonderland," you plunge into the depths of his memories, initiating a quest for redemption and understanding.
Navigate the cavernous labyrinthine symbolizing the recesses of Yathay’s mind to uncover the rich history of Cambodia and confront the moments and decisions that have defined Yathay's life leading to his family's separation and abandonment of his six-year-old son, Nawath. Relive the powerful moments that shaped his existence, feeling decades of sorrow and the relentless anguish of not knowing his son's fate.
autokwd: STAY ALIVE MY SON : A True Story About A Father's Search For His Son

title: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare
description:
게임 정보
“Love thy neighbor”. Or so the saying goes at least. Well. On some days that might just not be what you want to do at all. Prepare, gear up and vandalize your way through your neighbors defenses to get the better of them.
NEIGHBORS: Suburban Warfare is a lighthearted team-based multiplayer game for up to 8 players that features a wide range of items, abilities and base-building. All set in the lovely neighborhoods in the grand city of Heartsville.
In NEIGHBORS: Suburban Warfare you get to meet and play as the unique and always charming neighbors living in the neighborhoods of the beautiful city called Heartsville. From the old cheerful Doreen equipped with her trusty boxing gloves to the little annoying brat that is Kevin, there is sure to be a neighbor you can relate to. Keep your eyes peeled as more neighbors will call Heartsville their home in the near future. 
Play as 8 Unique Neighbors with more to come

title: EarWorm
description:
게임 정보
You are an Earworm.
You are an underworld contractor who hacks memories for a living. 
Dive into the memories of your victims in order to unlock the security questions to their bank account. 
Gameplay:
A first person/walking sim thriller experience with some basic puzzle elements. This is a short game, roughly 30-40 minutes long and designed to be completed in one sitting.
Key Features:
Atmospheric environments
Glitchy Pixel Aesthetic
Solve puzzles to hack your victim's bank account

description:

To survive at any cost is the only goal.
To do this, you will have to overcome difficulties such as cold, thirst and hunger. Make a fire, build a shelter, kill animals and explore abandoned cities. Protect yourself from infected and other players.
Do whatever it takes to survive.

Open World Zombie Survival Game.
Travel through a devastated post apocalyptic world.
Fight zombies, human survivors and more.
Control of various types of cars and other unusual equipment
Find many different firearms, melee weapons, clothing and different types of equipment.
Trade with survivors in shelters or safe zones to get the necessary equipment.

title: Vinebound: Tangled Together
description:
게임 정보

마법의 덩굴 요정이 타락한 가든 랜드를 구하기 위해 당신을 깨우지만, 당신에게 그 힘을 부여하려면 당신과 얽혀야 합니다! 이제 파트너와 너무 멀어지거나 너무 가까워질 수 없습니다.

총알 천국/군대 생존 로그라이트 장르의 새롭고 새로운 트위스트에서 ""베리"" 좋은 친구와 함께 혼란스러운 위험, 적, 보스로 가득 찬 강렬한 10분 경주에서 협력하고 살아남으세요!




마법의 덩굴을 사용하면 덩굴을 따라 앞뒤로 움직이는 ""탁구"" 쿨다운 꽃으로 무기를 공유할 수 있습니다! 꽃이 다가올 때 공격을 정렬하고 위치를 지정하고 시간을 정하여 적을 효과적으로 공격하세요!

바나나 검과 같은 무기를 휘두르며 친구의 반대 방향을 향해 베거나 적을 둘러싸서 공격해 딸기 막대의 마법을 시전하세요! 각 무기에는 서로 다른 전략이 필요하며 모든 공격은 수행자에 맞춰 조정되므로 두 플레이어 모두 선호하는 업그레이드와 맛에 맞게 동일한 무기를 맞춤 설정할 수 있습니다.




여러 개의 부풀린 호박 폭탄을 발사해 엄청난 프로스티 마요네즈 폭발을 일으키거나, 딸기 막대를 매운 소스 불꽃으로 적을 삼키는 치명타 괴물로 진화시키는 등 무한한 콤보와 시너지 효과로 강력하고 독특한 무기고를 만드세요!

황금 씨앗을 수집하여 무기고를 확장하여 새로운 무기, 아이템, 소스 및 캐릭터를 잠금 해제하세요. 이 모든 것들은 순위를 업그레이드하여 실행 사이에 힘을 높일 수 있습니다!




진정한 협력은 Vinebound를 차별화하는 요소입니다. 공격은 파트너의 영향을 받을 뿐만 아니라, 보물을 더 빨리 열고, 전략적으로 드롭을 선택하고, 빌드를 결합하고, 압도적인 확률 속에서 서로를 부활시키기 위해 협력해야 합니다. 혼란스러운 의사소통과 몇 번의 비명이 필요하더라도 시너지 효과를 키우는 것입니다.




혼자 플레이할 때는 덩굴 요정이 덩굴의 반대쪽 끝을 차지하여 기본 동작을 따라가지만 여전히 빠르고 독립적으로 목표로 움직일 수 있습니다. 피해에 면역이고, 방울을 수집할 수 있으며, 자체 업그레이드가 있어 둘 이상의 캐릭터에 대한 콤보 전략을 세울 수 있습니다. 부담을 느끼지 않으면서도 덩굴 게임플레이의 잠재력을 최대한 경험해 보세요.



뒤엉킨 숲, 미끄러운 얼음 바닥, 움직이는 용암 벽과 같은 시나리오에서 각각 얼어붙거나 파트너에게 끌려가는 등 특별한 조건이 있는 시나리오에서 살아남으세요. 동시에 반짝이는 보물과 강력한 보스를 운반하는 곰팡이 핀 엘리트 적과 맞서세요. 처음으로 게임을 완료하여 매운 모드를 잠금 해제하고 향상된 무기고와 기술을 사용하여 더 어려운 설정에 도전하세요!




당신의 기술과 협동심을 테스트하는 강렬한 10분 달리기입니다.
무기 공격을 위한 혁신적인 탁구 쿨다운 시스템.
시너지가 필요한 진정한 협동 게임플레이.
여전히 신선한 느낌을 주는 싱글 플레이어 모드.
무기, 아이템, 캐릭터, 소스가 포함된 강력한 무기고 조합.
위험 요소, 엘리트 적, 보스 등 독특한 메커니즘을 갖춘 도전적인 스테이지입니다.
게임을 플레이하는 사이에 카드와 캐릭터를 잠금 해제하고 개선할 수 있습니다.
게임 후 콘텐츠: 추가 도전을 원하는 사람들을 위해 더 엄격한 설정이 포함된 매운 모드.

title: Spellbound Skirmish
description:

🔥 Fast-Paced Multiplayer Wizard Battles! ❄️
Enter the world of Spellbound Skirmish, an intense 2D multiplayer platformer where wizards duel in fast-paced, high-flying magical combat! Jump, dodge, and unleash powerful spells to defeat your opponents in a battle of skill and strategy.

title: Mirage: Ignis Fatuus
description:
게임 정보
Mirage: Ignis Fatuus is a 3D spatial puzzle game that inherits the principles of the 2017 game Mirage: Illusions. This time, the player controls a cuboid, and its movement allows for more complex and interesting puzzles. RPG elements such as inventory management are added into the game, which enables the player to pick up and set objects to modify the walkable landscape, adding dynamism to the puzzles.

title: Touhou Chouhatsuyou ~ Burgeoning Tresses of Longevity
description:
게임 정보
An experiment in Gensokyo went disastrously wrong for a few individuals. A mysterious scent has caused every woman's hair to grow to the height of their body. Some of the victims who are fine with their old hair now look unpleasant to themselves.
Based on an original screenplay and featuring an original score written by Susumu Takajima, you take control of one of the victims out of a selection of four to find the person who conducted the experiment. You will have to take your super long hair across six stages to find the scent's origin so you can restore it to normal. You can tackle it alone or with a friend.* The weight of your hair will make it challenging to defeat your enemies' danmaku and their spell cards.
*Additional accessories may be required for local multiplayer modes.
Features:
Four playable characters spanning different backgrounds
Four difficulty modes with different spell cards
A six-stage main game plus a post-game extra stage
A series of original characters created by Susumu Takajima to fight against
1990s-style musical score by Susumu Takajima
Controller support

title: Carrot Cake
description:
게임 정보
Carrot Cake is an Easter Horror game following a group of kids in an Easter theme park. Compete in the Easter games, solve puzzles, and escape the facility in this PSX style survival horror.
The Easter Bunny has set up a fun-filled event of games, prizes, and laughter for all kids around! Parents drop off their kids for a day of egg hunting, fun challenges, and competing for a prize! But this vibrant event has a dark secret. Can you escape before becoming the next missing child?
Survive Deadly Games
Usually games like Egg Hunts, Hide and Seek, Chasing Chickens, and Painting Easter Eggs are innocent and fun. But here there's a loser and a winner. Make sure you're not the loser.
Solve Puzzles
Behind the pastel colored walls are the keys to your survival. Search for clues, crack codes, and unlock hidden areas before time runs out.
Escape the Easter Bunny
Don't trust the Easter Bunny mascot or his friends. Kids are going missing and you're running out of time.
Wishlist Now... Before It's Too Late.

title: Evil Lurks Below
description:
게임 정보
이 심리 공포 게임에서 어두운 미스터리를 탐험하세요
초자연 현상 탐정 해리 월터스는 섬뜩한 소문에 이끌려 버려진 길먼 가문의 집을 방문합니다. 가족이 설명할 수 없는 실종을 당한 지 4년 후, 해리는 숨겨진 단서를 발견하기 시작하고 치명적인 비밀 속으로 빠져듭니다.
길먼 가족의 비밀을 풀 수 있겠습니까, 아니면 진실은 영원히 숨겨질까요?
주요 특징
몰입형 심리 공포: 긴장감을 주는 1인칭 공포 경험을 제공합니다.
과거의 삶을 조사: 길먼 가문의 운명을 밝혀내기 위해 묻힌 기억과 섬뜩한 단서를 파헤쳐보세요.
퍼즐 해결: 끊임없는 공포에서 벗어나기 위해 도전 과제를 해결하세요.
레트로 PSX 미학: 공포감을 더해주는 픽셀화된 복고풍 비주얼을 즐기세요.
생존을 위한 싸움 또는 도망: 숨어 있거나 도망치며 위협을 피할지, 싸울지 선택하세요.
게임 시간: 약 120분

title: Echoes of Yi : Samsara
description:
게임 정보
ECHOES of YI: SAMSARA는 중국 전통 문화를 결합한 어두운 무협 액션 게임입니다. 이 게임에서 플레이어는 검 성인의 첫 제자로서 모험을 시작하고, 강력한 적들을 하나씩 물리치며 세계의 재앙을 막아야 합니다. 빠른 속도의 전투에 직면한 플레이어는 공격과 방어의 리듬을 정확하게 파악하여 도전적인 전투 시스템을 경험해야 합니다.
삼성堆의 신목 아래에서 마음을 흔드는 정서적 갈등이 조용히 전개됩니다. 플레이어는 영혼의 세계로 깊이 들어가 구출의 방법을 탐색하고, 비밀의 영역에 숨겨진 음모를 하나씩 밝혀내며, 신목과 이 세계 간의 깊은 연관성을 드러냅니다. 진실로 고난에 맞설 것인지, 아니면 흘러가는 대로 무의미하게 살 것인지? 모든 선택은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다.
정확한 리듬과 강렬한 대결
autokwd: Echoes of Yi : Samsara,义闻录：轮回

title: LUNAR Remastered Collection
description:
게임 정보
「LUNAR: Silver Star Story」와 「LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue」가 Steam®에서 부활한다!
세대를 넘어 사랑받는 두 명작 JRPG의 세계로 떠나자.

「LUNAR: Silver Star Story」
드래곤 마스터를 꿈꾸는 청년 아레스가 동료와 함께 마법 황제에 맞서 세계 정복의 야망을 저지하는 장대한 모험극이 펼쳐진다.

「LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue」
「LUNAR: Silver Star Story」로부터 천 년 후의 세계를 무대로, 히이로와 동료들은 수수께끼의 소녀 루시아와 함께 여신 알테나를 찾기 위한 여행에 나선다. 이후 루시아를 「마왕」이라 부르며 쫓는 보건, 백기사 레오가 그들의 앞길을 막아선다.

그래픽과 음질, 조작성이 개선되어 90년대의 향수를 그대로 간직한 채 새로운 감동을 선사합니다. 한국어, 번체중문, 간체중문, 일본어, 영어, 프랑스어, 독일어 자막이 추가되어 한층 더 진화한 리마스터 버전을 꼭 플레이해 보시기 바랍니다!

title: Try them all!
description:
게임 정보
What you have to do is simple: open the box, which is locked with 3~8 digits, with your hands! Solving riddles? Hints? No such thing. Just try them all and you'll open them.
Video Posting, Distribution, and Monetization
This game may be freely used in video postings and live distribution.
There are no restrictions on monetization or donations!
If you want to ask us for permission directly, please feel free to contact us via X (formerly Twitter) or email.
・About the operation
Click the button above the number to increase the number.
Clicking the button below the number decreases the number.
(You can select a digit with the ←/→ keys and change the number with the ↑/↓ keys.)
(You can also use the number keys to change the number of the currently selected digit.)
Clicking on a treasure chest will attempt to open it.
If the number is right, the treasure chest is opened and the game is cleared.
You will receive many rewards for clearing the game!
(You can also use the Space/Enter key to open the chest.)
・About Skill
Although there are no hints, “coins” and “gems” sometimes fall in the game.
Coins and gems can be consumed for a slightly more efficient matching of numbers.
Coins are always consumed, but the type of gems consumed changes with each skill.
Of course, you don't have to use any of these, just try them all and they will open!
・About the difficulty level
The difficulty level can be set freely between 3~8 digits.
You can save your game by each digit, so you can interrupt the game and start with another digit.
It is not possible to create multiple save data with the same number of digits.
The more digits you have, the bigger the reward for clearing the game.
(+10 times the average points earned for each digit)
autokwd: Try them all!,全部試せば開く！

title: Date Z: Welcome to Massville High
description:
게임 정보
매스빌 고등학교의 최신 시니어로서의 삶에 발을 들여보세요. 금요일이 어떤 기말고사보다도 중요하게 느껴지는 가운데, 데이트 상대가 없으면 어떻게 될지 아무도 잘 모르지만, 그날이 오기 전에 상대를 찾고 싶어질 것입니다. 한편, 학교의 오래된 군사 기지의 기초가 복도에 숨어 있는 다른 무언가를 암시하고 있습니다.
"Date Z: Welcome to Massville High"는 학교 생활의 데이트 시뮬레이션 어드벤처와 오싹한 미스터리를 결합한 게임입니다. 소녀 동급생들과 친해지고, 이 옛 군사 기지의 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀내며, 누구를 믿고 누구를 사랑할지 결정함으로써 자신의 이야기를 만들어가세요.
당신의 첫날
• 예측 불가능한 동급생들과 만나기 – 친근한 얼굴부터 외로운 사람까지, 각 소녀는 각각의 짐과 동기를 가지고 있습니다. 그녀들에게 접근하는 방식이 당신의 한 주를 바꿀 수 있습니다.
• 숨겨진 역사를 파헤치기 – 옛 군사 기지는 단순한 역사적 각주가 아닙니다. 과거에 대한 단서를 주시하고, 그것이 어떻게 다음 날들을 형성할지 알아보세요.
• 이야기를 형성하기 – 사소한 댓글이나 대담한 고백이 중요한 기회를 열거나 닫을 수 있습니다. 모든 대화는 플롯을 당신이 통제할 수 있는 방향으로 움직일 기회입니다.
• 두 번째 기회 – 특별한 장치 덕분에 게임 오버는 없습니다. 타임라인의 중요한 지점으로 돌아가 선택을 재고하고 다른 결과를 확인해보세요.
주요 특징
• 갈라지는 길: 당신의 선택이 미래를 형성합니다. 로맨스를 추구할 것인가, 학교의 비밀을 깊이 파헤칠 것인가?
• 독특한 캐릭터: 개성 있고 숨겨진 목적을 가진 동급생들과 친구가 되고, 경우에 따라 데이트도 할 수 있습니다.
• 캠퍼스 탐험: 잠긴 문 너머를 들여다보고, 암호 같은 단서를 조합하여 학교 지하에 숨겨진 큰 미스터리를 밝혀내세요.
• 여러 타임라인: 호기심을 자극하는 장치를 사용하여 다른 선택이 모든 것을 어떻게 바꾸는지 확인해보세요.
• 몰입감 있는 비주얼: 손으로 그린 아트워크가 고등학교 생활의 따뜻함과 매스빌 고등학교의 표면 아래에 있는 오싹한 톤을 전달합니다.
• 이야기를 확장하기: 첫날을 넘어 발견할 것이 더 있습니다. 스릴 넘치는 콘텐츠에 뛰어들어 새로운 얼굴을 만나며 모험을 계속하세요.
매스빌 고등학교에서의 첫날을 시작하고, 당신의 이야기가 어떻게 전개될지 확인해보세요. 시간 내에 데이트를 찾을 수 있을까요, 아니면 미스터리가 먼저 당신을 찾을까요?
autokwd: Date Z: Welcome to Massville High

title: Short Snow
description:
게임 정보
"솔로 개발자로서, 저는 Short Snow의 모든 세부 사항에 마음을 쏟아 몰입감 있고 도전적인 경험을 창출하기 위해 노력했습니다. 바람의 소리부터 발밑의 눈의 소리까지, 모든 요소는 이 얼어붙은 황야에 생명을 불어넣기 위해 세심하게 제작되었습니다."
자세한 요리 메커니즘으로 진정한 생존 경험에 몰입하십시오. 신선한 고기를 사냥하고 수확한 후, 열린 캠프파이어 위에서 신중하게 식사를 준비하십시오. 고기가 요리되면서 지글지글 소리를 내며 완벽하게 갈색으로 변하는 모습을 지켜보십시오. 현실적인 요리 과정은 가혹하고 추운 환경을 견디기 위해 필수적인 최적의 건강 및 에너지 수준을 유지하도록 보장합니다.
Short Snow에서는 현실적인 오픈 월드 생존 경험 속에서 무시무시한 비행기 추락 사고 후 광활한 눈 덮인 숲에서 길을 잃게 됩니다. 기온이 급락하고 배고픔이 엄습해오는 상황에서 생존을 위해 도구를 제작해야 합니다.

title: Soul Oath
description:
게임 정보
PRESENTATION
This is a classic 2D old-school RPG in the style of the retro Super NES and Genesis RPGs such as Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest.
Zeke comes from a long lineage of Wardens, gifted individuals who are tasked with protecting their hometown with their lives. Proud of his heritage and passionated about his duty, his job is the most importante thing for him, along with his relationship with Samza and Temerius, his childhoold friends.
When Temerius arrives in Eaglemoor Town, Zeke's town, after one of his travels, Zeke's fate as a Warden is finally sealed.
On his quest to protect his hometown and live up to his lineage, he will learn from love, pain, friendship, death and ultimately, life.
FEATURES
A moving storyline about duty and friendship
A varied selection of locations to explore
Freedom to explore at your own pace and order
Three difficulty levels to choose from, at any time
Auto-save function
Mouse Support
10 to 20 hours of gameplay, depending on one's play style

title: Deep Dark Space
description:
게임 정보
You are a member of the exploration and investigation team. Your job is to collect enough evidence about the monster that has attacked the station. Venture across derelict stations and planets. Find a way to survive monster's attacks.
Remember that biomorphs can corrupt one of your team members into working on their side! Beware betrayal! As a corrupted player you are on the quest to disrupt and trick other players into thinking that it's another type of a monster.

title: Taram Baba
description:
게임 정보
공포가 되다
타람 바바는 번개처럼 빠른 전투 메커니즘에 초점을 맞춘 액션 로그라이크 게임입니다.
나만의 방식대로 싸우기
잊혀지지 않는 심연을 헤쳐나가면서 악마에게 가하는 모든 타격을 느껴보세요. 벽이 움직이고 있으니 타람 바바를 더 깊고 깊은 어둠 속으로 쫓아가 빛을 붙잡으세요.
타람 바바는 반응이 빠르고, 빠르고, 만족스러운 전투에 중점을 둡니다.

title: Cozy Desktop Konbini
description:
게임 정보
Cozy Desktop Konbini는 화면 하단에서 운영되는 아늑하고 편안한 방치형 게임으로, 작은 편의점을 관리할 수 있습니다.
모든 것이 자동화되어 있어요
편의점은 스스로 운영됩니다! 진열대를 채우고, 손님을 맞이하며, 수익을 얻으세요. 그동안 다른 일에 집중할 수 있습니다.
멀티태스킹 가능
이 게임은 화면 하단에서 실행되므로 공부하거나 일하면서도 가게를 운영할 수 있어요. 또는 그냥 편하게 쉬면서 즐겨보세요!
편의점을 꾸며보세요
진열대, 디스플레이, 장식품 등으로 작은 편의점을 개성 있게 꾸며 가장 아늑한 쇼핑 공간을 만들어보세요.
새로운 상품과 시설을 잠금 해제하세요
새로운 진열대, 자판기, 독특한 제품을 추가하여 고객을 더 많이 유치하고 가게를 성장시킬 수 있습니다!

title: Tranquil Isle
description:
게임 정보
While away the hours on the sunkissed shores of your own tiny paradise! Tranquil isle is a minimalist townbuilder, set on idyllic, randomly generated islands. The sun will rise and set as you work to grow your town to keep everything humming along nicely.
There’s no combat, no trading, and no micromanagement. Just focus on making your little islands the best they can be.
The game has 2 main modes: Classic Mode, where players must strategically place buildings to build up your high score and unlock new buildings and islands, and sandbox mode for those looking to chill out and build purely for aesthetics and vibes. There's also a Daily challenge, where all players will play for a high score on the same fixed map.

title: The Chess
description:
게임 정보
THE CHESS

Themed Chess: Relaxing Minimalistic Strategy Game
Themed Chess offers a relaxing and minimalist approach to the classic chess game. With multiple gameplay options, beautiful themed boards, and a variety of chess pieces, it's perfect for casual players and strategy lovers alike. Whether you prefer to play against AI or challenge other players, this game offers endless enjoyment with many customization options.
Key Features:
♔ Free to Play – Start playing now, no cost involved!
♕ Relaxing Minimalistic Style – A calm and peaceful design for an immersive chess experience.
♖ Multiple Chess Boards & Piece Sets – Enjoy a variety of beautiful, themed sets and boards with even more coming soon via DLCs.
♗ AI with 3 Difficulty Levels – Challenge yourself with varying AI difficulties, suitable for both beginners and advanced players.
♘ Play Against Other Players – Compete in multiplayer mode with friends or players worldwide.
♙ 3D Gameplay & Clear 2D Mini Board – Switch between a dynamic 3D view or a simplified 2D board for a more focused experience.
♙ Chess History & Rules – Learn the game’s history and rules in the integrated section for both new players and chess enthusiasts.
♙ RPG DLC & More – Enjoy exciting DLC content, including RPG-themed chess sets and more on the way!
Themed Chess is perfect for chess lovers who appreciate a relaxing, customizable experience with lots of options to explore. Download the base game for FREE today and immerse yourself in a calm, strategic world of chess!

⭐ Add to your now to stay updated on future DLCs and releases!
👍 the game for news and updates!
💬 and share your thoughts to help us improve!

title: Laser Battle Cats - travel & destroy!
description:
게임 정보
Wouldn't everyone want to have a giant laser battle cat to overcome life's challenges with a devastating beam?
Collect Kittens!
The game offers 5 kittens, each with different stats and appearances. Unlock them by completing levels and give them names. Feed them radioactive milk to make them bigger and stronger.
Conquer Five Continents!
Your cat is equipped with a vest—build a laser mechanism on it. Generate power, store it in batteries, and fire away. Use rotating and sliding parts to reach all enemies. Defeat European pigeons, African snakes, and Australian spiders.

title: Bonds of Yachiyo
description:
게임 정보
When Chiyo and her best friend Akari were about to go home from university, a massive earthquake suddenly began to shake the entire building.
Moments later, the ground beneath them crumbled, plunging the two friends into bottomless darkness.
As Chiyo wakes up, their university has transformed into another world entirely. Now, she must find Akari and try to solve the mystery enshrouded in the demonic darkness.

title: Drop 4
description:
게임 정보
Cause chaos with bombs to stop your opponents from winning as you plan your next move in this classic game with a twist.
Bombs
There are special bomb chips that have a chance to drop into play, using a bomb wipes a row of tokens! Use them to sneak a win or to stop your opponent.
Freeze Chips
Ice chips do the opposite effect to bombs, they freeze a row of chips. To remove the frozen chips a player must use a turn to unfreeze a chip and remove them the next turn. Ice chips can provide strategic advantage but watch out your opponent may try doing the same!
Plan and Strategize
Drop 4 has color indicators for each column so players can see the next incoming colored chip. This allows you to plan your strategy to win! Don't forget to keep an eye on your opponents incoming chips as they may be planning a win!
Combos

title: Biodacity The Mansion
description:
게임 정보
BIODACITY: THE MANSION keeps its horror tense through atmosphere, inspired by ‘Resident Evil’, ‘Amnesia’, and similar horror titles!
Explore your way through a crooked Mansion in the aftermath of an apocalypse. Biological mutants ravaged the Earth! You are responsible for finding crucial information! Fight horrific creatures that lurk around every corner! Find and upgrade your weapons!
You are tasked with discovering information about the Biomutants, leading you to a strange mansion out in the middle of nowhere.
Sharp Combat
Take charge and fight for your survival! There is a variety of enemies with all types of different attacks! Be aware.
Engaging Difficulty and Unique Playthroughs
Each difficulty comes with different enemy placement, changes in loot, and makes the enemies more aggressive and difficult! This ensures that playing on a harder difficulty will be like playing an entirely different game. In addition to this, some of the loot is randomized to make sure that every playthrough is unique. 
Exploration and Puzzles
Every nook and cranny will need to be searched to upgrade your gear! This Mansion offers many secrets in the form of loot or upgrades. You’ll want to explore it and solve all of its mysteries.

title: QLewds
description:
게임 정보
QLewds is an upcoming Free-to-Play 3 vs 3 online multiplayer clash in a large 2D arena. The game aims to bridge aspects of MOBAs, Metroidvanias, 2D Platformers, and Brawlers into a novel gaming experience.

Victory is achieved for one team by destroying the enemy's throne. Thrones are invulnerable until the opposing team collects enough Ether. Ether is gained in a variety of ways, including destroying enemy team's flowers , killing enemy players, and other unique in game objects.

Gameplay is split between day and night cycles. During daytime players can focus on the lanes, where the flowers are active. At night the game opens up, with the flowers sleeping and neutral enemies spawning throughout the map.

You begin the game weak, slow, and pathetic. Yet by leveling up, earning gold, and buying upgraded skills, passive upgrades, and active items. By the end of a match you should feel like an endgame boss from you favorite games and lead your team to victory.

title: Electro Bop Boxing League
description:
게임 정보
빈티지 아톰펑크/일렉트로 스윙 스타일의 오토 복싱에서 랭크를 올리고 최강의 로봇 파이터들의 자리에 도달하세요!🎵 로봇 복서의 소속 국가와 외형을 선택하고 펀치 카드 어빌리티, 리그 벨트 및 로봇 파츠를 통해 다양한 행동 특성을 부여하거나 속도, 힘, 내구도를 강화할 수 있습니다.
로봇 파이터 뒤에 대기중인 충실한 크루들은 최선을 다해 로봇을 조종해 기초 공격을 수행합니다. 플레이어는 음악의 박자에 맞춰 가벼운 리듬 게임을 통해 명령 입력을 관리하고 시스템 자원을 보충하며 전략적 회피의 적용과 어빌리티 탑재 그리고 작동을 수행합니다.
플레이어의 로봇 부속품은 상대방의 강력한 공격을 받아 부서지게 됩니다. 다행히 라운드 사이에 부서진 부속품을 수리할 수 있습니다. 경기 중 쓰러진 크루원 역시 라운드 사이에 복귀하여 역할 별(캡틴, 드라이버, 무기 또는 시스템) 특수 효과와 능력을 회복할 수 있습니다.

title: Last Stretch
description:
게임 정보
Dive into this short linear action-adventure where you grapple towards enemies to unleash powerful attacks. This 30-minute game is a fast-paced adventure enhanced by colorful effects. Use your grappling ability to zip through the world, dodging lasers and bullets while wreaking havoc on anything in your path. Escape relentless aliens armed with vibrant, deadly, one-hit kill weapons. With a fast-paced die-retry system, you'll make bold, risky moves—chaining attacks between enemies in style.
• Crafted entirely by our dedicated team, including the original music.
• Easy to pick up, quick to play, and an entirely unique adventure.

title: Undefined Game Pack
description:
게임 정보
Every Flash game produced by Undefined
Back in early 2008 as a solo indie developer, I started producing flash games under the name Undefined. Over the subsequent years until the death of flash player I published 21 different free-to-play games, many of which were highly popular. Mostly as an answer to requests but also as a vanity project, I'm happy to present the entire collection.
If you remember any, it's most likely that it's one of the most popular game series, such as Protector or Legends of Arkandia, but, did you ever play the others?
With the advent of Ruffle, a new open-source flash player, I'm now able to bring those old games back to life and provide a standalone version of them.
Lots of work has gone into making sure each game runs at an acceptable level. There will be quirks, and sometimes things won't be exactly as they should be, but I have personally played every game in the pack and am happy with how they look and feel. The gameplay has been left mostly untouched, except where there were obvious bugs, which have been fixed.
I hope you enjoy playing this classic little slice of my brain, I've enjoyed putting the pack together and remember fondly creating each and every one.

title: Slingbot Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Slingbot Survivors is a survivor-like auto-shooter with physics-based platforming. Explore a hostile alien planet, use your grappling hook to zip around, and wield an arsenal of powerful weapons & gadgets to wipe out hordes of alien horrors!
Shoot, swing & pull!
Use your versatile grappling hook to outmaneuver your enemies, find resources scattered throughout the environment, and fly around in supersonic speeds.
Only the best can truly master the art of recklessly throwing yourself at your foes.
Build your own Sling-Bot
Wield a vast array of unique weapons, upgrade their stats to suit your build, and customize them with unique augments that change their behavior & playstyle!
Together with special gadgets that grant unique passive abilities, and a variety of different Sling-Bots to play with, each run you can devise new exciting ways to rain down fire upon your enemies!

title: Thrae
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a heartwarming adventure with a fluffy bunny on their path to become the Legendary Easter Bunny! Deliver enchanted eggs to furry friends to help them survive, and build bonds strong enough to rid the forest of the relentless Thrae hunters.
Features:
🎨 Craft & Decorate Magical Eggs
Craft, customize and deliver enchanted eggs to suit each NPC’s needs.
Deep customization system with plenty of colors and pattern hidden around the world.
Gain access to advanced recipes by building relationships with NPCs, and completing quests.
🌎 Explore a Diverse Landscapes

title: PlanetX
description:
게임 정보
PlanetX is a real-time strategy MMO that redefines large-scale multiplayer warfare. The battle begins on Planet Alpha, where dozens of players start with seven land plots each. Unlike traditional flat maps, the entire game takes place on a fully spherical planet, adding an extra layer of strategy to territorial expansion.
Players must build and expand their empire, constructing various structures and managing resources. The first challenge is achieving a perfect balance between resource extraction and production to fuel economic growth. Once a player amasses enough wealth, it's time to assemble a powerful army, featuring tanks, aircraft, and missiles.

title: EternalQube
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to EternalQube, the game where the grid is ever-changing, the Qubes are relentless, and your goal is simple: survive, adapt, and score as high as you can. With over 100 procedurally generated levels, no two playthroughs are the same. The Qubes shift, the boulders fall, and the chaos never ends.
Features That Will Keep You on the Edge:
Procedurally Generated Madness – Every level is unique, with shifting grids, unpredictable Qube patterns, and endless challenges. No two games are ever the same.
Boulders from Above – Dodge falling boulders that crush Qubes, block your path, and add a layer of chaos to your strategy. One wrong move, and your plans could be flattened.
Special Qubes from the Sky – Look out for rare, glowing Qubes that fall randomly, offering massive score multipliers, grid-clearing explosions, or temporary power-ups. Grab them before they disappear!
Dynamic Movement – Dash, run, and jump to outmaneuver the chaos. Use your agility to avoid boulders, reach special Qubes, and navigate the ever-shifting grid.
Score Attack Mode – Your goal is simple: get the highest score possible. Chain combos, activate special Qubes, and survive as long as you can to climb the global leaderboards.
Over 100 Levels of Mayhem – Each level introduces new challenges, from faster boulders to more complex grid patterns. Can you make it to the end?
Sanity-Warping Visuals – As you progress, the grid becomes more chaotic, the colors more intense, and the soundtrack more unnerving. The game itself seems to fight back.
Global Leaderboards – Compete with players worldwide to see who can endure the chaos and claim the top spot. Will you be the EternalQube champion?
Steam Integration – Track your achievements, share your progress, and let your friends witness your descent into Qube-fueled madness.
How to Play:
Shift and Match – Align Qubes to clear them from the grid and score points. But beware: the Qubes shifts constantly, and boulders will crush your plans.
Grab Special Qubes – Keep an eye out for glowing Qubes that fall from the sky. They can give you massive bonuses, but they won’t last forever.
Move Smart – Use your dash, run, and jump abilities to outmaneuver boulders, reach special Qubes, and stay alive.

title: Somniphobia
description:
게임 정보


Escape the reoccurring nightmare and stop the cycle by fighting through strange enemies and collecting items and information to get out before you wake up, otherwise the dream resets, but changes slightly. Somniphobia combines traditional survival horror elements such as combat, fixed camera angles, and item collection, with rogue-like elements where the item, enemy, and room placement will be different every night.



Tank control movement
Fixed cameras
Procedural item and enemy placement
Resource management
Randomized map layout



This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

title: Guardians Of Gaia
description:
게임 정보

가디언을 선택!
특별한 능력을 가진 여러 캐릭터의 조합을 선택해보세요. 전투에서 얻은 전리품을 교환하여 새로운 스킬과 무기를 획득하세요.


전투력 향상!
Gaia Element의 사용방법을 발견해보세요. 게임 중간에 무기를 바꿔 전투해 보세요.


전술적으로 우위를 점하기 위해 주위환경을 어떻게 이용할지 탐색해보세요. 각각의 아레나에는 여러경로, 초크포인트 및잠금해제가 가능한 지름길이 있습니다. 팀워크와 유동성을 이용하여 아레나를 지배하세요.


혼자 개발한 수작. 게임 엔진 포함.
Steam Deck에 맞게 최적화됨.

title: Remnants Of The Witch
description:
게임 정보
Remnants Of The Witch is a story-heavy RPG game. It takes place in a magic-based 1930s-inspired setting.
The story follows Mari, who joins a witch-hunting organization to save her friend Annie. The main story follows her as she learns more about herself, her companions, and the world of witch-hunting she has entered. Joined by her comrades, she will go on various missions to defeat the witch threat that has suddenly appeared. 
 The game currently features up to around 3 hours of the main story, with various side activities and many more to be added. The main loop of the game is to go on main story missions, and then return to the city to spend time hanging out with teammates or do side content. The city will change based on the progress of the main story. Side quests will become available, some will disappear if missed. It's all supposed to be an immersive, seemingly dynamic city. 
It's a large project for one person, but it's one I'm highly passionate about. I just want to tell a story with engaging gameplay. A classic RPG at the core.

title: Old Timer Transport
description:
게임 정보
Mobility scooters, chaos, and laughs—welcome to the wildest ride of your life!
Ready to unleash some ridiculous scooter-driven mayhem? Take on the role of an old, grumpy driver in a turbocharged mobility scooter as you race through the city of Bompidorm. Your mission? Pick up humans scattered throughout the madness and deliver them to safety—all while outmaneuvering your equally grumpy rivals. PvP? Oh, you bet. Ragdoll physics? Absolutely. Laughs? Guaranteed.
Whether you're blasting rivals off the track with a well-timed explosion or speeding toward the hospital, the only thing standing between you and victory is a city full of chaos. Who will be the ultimate grumpy champion?

title: Designated Driver Simulator
description:
게임 정보
대리운전 시뮬레이터: 거리의 진정한 영웅이 되어라!
대리운전 시뮬레이터는 도시를 배경으로 한 오픈월드 대리운전 게임입니다. 다양한 손님을 만나고, 그들이 원하는 곳까지 안전하게 모셔다 드리며 돈을 벌어가세요! 당신의 목표는 매주 사장님에게 일정량의 돈을 바치는 것. 실패한다면 계약 해지와 함께 게임이 종료됩니다. 하지만 성공한다면 더 많은 업그레이드와 새로운 기회가 기다리고 있습니다!
게임에 대해서
🚗 도시의 밤을 누비는 모험
광활한 오픈월드 도시에서 다양한 손님들을 만나보세요. 성격 급한 직장인부터 술에 취한 예술가까지, 손님마다 각기 다른 요구 사항이 당신의 판단력을 시험합니다. 손님을 만족시켜 더 많은 팁과 보상을 획득하세요.
💰 차량 업그레이드 및 커스터마이징
땀 흘려 번 돈으로 새로운 차량을 구매하거나 기존 차량을 업그레이드하세요. 외관 커스터마이징을 통한 개성있는 차량이 더 빠르고 안전한 운행을 도와줍니다!

title: Screaming Savage Blood Death
description:
게임 정보


Salvador Bolero welcomes you to No-Pi-Ba-Ca! Nestled in the heart of New Jersey's Pine Barrens, we are a camp retreat for troubled youth. Our unique approach involves counseling children with the aid of survival training in the forest. However, we need your help!

The camp is teeming with danger. The Barrens are alive, as animals and insects breed aggressively, posing a threat not just to the children but to the staff as well. That's where you come in, alongside four other camp counselors, to patrol our grounds. Keep the kids safe and maintain order, and we might just make it through the week unscathed...



But animals are not our only concern at No-Pi-Ba-Ca. Mysterious lights glide through the woods at night. Sounds of wings too large to belong to any bat echo among the trees. And let's not forget the bodies that have found their final resting place in New Jersey's marshes.

An unseen force is disrupting the natural—and perhaps even the supernatural—balance. Can you uncover the truth?



Brace yourself for seven days and nights of relentless defense against vicious animals and eerie occurrences. Take control of a team of five counselors, patrolling the paths and ensuring everyone's safety. Be ready to respond to calls for help, equipped to face whatever lurks in the shadows. Unearth hidden clues and tools to battle the nightmares emerging from the depths of New Jersey's lore and history. Delve into the malevolence that stalks The Barrens.



Choose from five unique camp counselors, each boasting distinct strengths and weaknesses. Replay the game with an even larger cast of playable characters.

Arm yourself with a plethora of unique weapons, ranging from Molotov cocktails to Philly snowballs.

Stay vigilant as you navigate through dynamic hazards of an active day and night cycle, adding an extra layer of suspense and strategy to your survival.

Experience multiple endings that further unravel the deep-seated mysteries of the Barrens.

title: SokobotS
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to SokobotS!
SokobotS is a cooperative sokoban game with goofy robots!
Discover Sokobots:
Play solo or in coop with different robots!
Resolve sokoban puzzles with many interactions!
Control different robots with many abilities!
Interact with other rooms to help each others!
Discover the plan of the evil Chokocorp compagny...
Explore a (very) unique story:
In the future, all industries are controled by a chocolate cereal lobby called Chokocorp.
When scientist discover that an asteroid belt with the most sugary chocolate ever is close to earth, Chokocorp send robots to extract as many chocolate as possible. No matter what it cost...

title: Ammo Garden
description:
게임 정보
가능한 한 많은 작물을 재배하고 수확하여 막대한 수익을 올리십시오. 농작물을 업그레이드하여 탄약을 업그레이드하세요. 하루가 끝날 때 무기와 아이템을 구입하십시오. 개, 고양이, 까마귀, 돼지, 소 친구들과 친구가 되어 농사를 자동화하고 농장을 방어하세요 밤마다 농작물을 먹으려는 공격자로부터 농작물을 보호하세요. 최종 수확에 도달할 때까지 매 시즌 도전적인 보스와 싸우십시오. 새로운 생물군계를 잠금 해제하고 탐험하고 오래 전에 사라진 농장의 유용한 유물을 찾으십시오. 강력한 전리품은 농사와 전투 능력을 증가시킵니다.

title: Box #341
description:
게임 정보
Box #341 is trying to return to its spot in the warehouse—by cleverly flipping itself and using liquids with unique abilities!

Flip, Dip, and reach the Goal !
Master the art of strategy and creativity in this delightful puzzle adventure! The challenges revolve around harnessing the unique potential of the Box's sides—dip into various liquids to grant each face special properties. Align these enhanced sides with the right slopes to trigger flips and navigate your way through clever, handcrafted levels!
Combination of Elements!

Immerse yourself in intricately designed levels that encourage creative exploration and experimentation! Each challenge invites you to discover the possibilities of combining various game elements. As you develop your skills and master strategic gameplay, the game raises the fun with increasingly complex levels that test your abilities to the fullest.

title: BOX HUSTLE
description:
게임 정보
Box Hustle is a challenging 3D isometric puzzle game inspired by the classic Sokoban. Test your wits as you push wooden crates onto their target spots in levels designed to challenge your logic and planning skills.
Every move matter, one wrong step can block your path and force you to rethink your strategy. Do you have what it takes to conquer 100 levels spread across three unique worlds?
Success lies in thinking before you move. Can you master Box Hustle and become the best?
Box Hustle was developed by a solo indie dev, your support means the world

title: The Litter: Trigo
description:
게임 정보
Learning, but with a Light Touch !
If math feels as indigestible as a litter box to you, this game might just change that! Dive into a playful and colorful world where trigonometry becomes a true narrative game, filled with humor and lovable characters.
Light Touch , but withlearning!
In La Litière Trigo, trigonometry will no longer be an abstract concept !
The game focuses on explaining not only the essential basics but also the "why" behind the math. Through light dialogue and accessible explanations, the concepts become concrete and easy to understand.
A training tailored to your level will be offered to you during the final phase !
This game is literally a private tutoring session in the form of a video game.
For what levels?
La Litière Trigo is designed for students who are just beginning to learn about trigonometry, like sine and cosine, and continues through to more advanced concepts like the unit circle and radians:

title: Farming & Supermarket Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"농장 및 슈퍼마켓 시뮬레이터"는 농장을 건설하고, 유기농 제품을 재배하고, 동물을 돌보고, 슈퍼마켓에서 제품을 판매하여 사업을 확장하는 매력적인 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.[\/p]
재배, 수확, 사용
수확한 제품을 최대한 활용하세요: 슈퍼마켓 선반을 채우거나 동물 사료로 사용하세요. 선택은 당신에게 달려 있습니다![\/p]
먹이 주기 및 수확
동물에게 먹이를 주고 보상을 거두세요! 닭에게 토마토를 주고, 신선한 계란을 수집하며 노동의 결실을 누리세요.[\/p]
[\/p]
기계에 투자하기
기계를 구매하여 생산을 확장하세요! 수확한 제품을 가공하여 슈퍼마켓에서 필요한 가치 있는 상품을 만드세요.[\/p]
[\/p]

title: Flames in Modern Europe
description:
게임 정보
Flames in Modern Europe is not just a real-time global strategy game; it's also an opportunity to immerse yourself in the interesting and captivating events of modern Europe, such as Euromaidan and the Revolution of Dignity! Build a powerful economy of the Old Continent, or start a war against a neighboring state! Develop your nation, overcome political crises, and become part of the most exciting moments in modern history!
MAIN MECHANICS
Courses: In the country menu, you have several courses, such as political and economic. This is your plan to achieve greatness in Europe.

title: Build For Sale Simulator
description:
게임 정보

매물로 나온 주택을 사서 다양한 인테리어를 하며 리노베이션을 하는 부동산 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 자신의 부동산 사업을 관리 할 때 판매 플랫폼에 광고를 게시하고 부동산 기능을 추가하고 가격을 설정하고 판매를 제공합니다. 그런 다음 잠시 후 판매가 발생하고 번 돈으로 새로운 부동산을 구매하여 비즈니스를 확장합니다. 무료 부동산 판매 시뮬레이터 게임을 사용하면 부동산의 세계로 들어가 창의적인 장식으로 부동산에 활기를 불어넣고 나만의 부동산 제국을 건설할 수 있습니다.

원하는 대로 집을 꾸미고 판매하세요!


100가지 아이템으로 개성 넘치는 집을 꾸미세요!

title: CursedSword
description:
게임 정보
In this turn-based puzzle game, travel to the Haunted Island and reach the Countess's Castle to end the evil curse cast on you! Explore the island, defeat all enemies in your way and solve deadly puzzles that will block your path to the Castle!

an Action-packed Puzzle Game
Solve puzzles by defeating all enemies in a room, opening the sealed gates, and escaping the area but beware of all the traps laying around the Haunted Island!




Due to the evil curse, every time you make a move, your sword becomes more and more powerful but at the same time, every action takes you one step closer to death!

Defeating enemies with your magic sword refreshes your curse, preventing the sword from consuming your soul!

title: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine
description:
게임 정보
Our intrepid, ingenious crafter and explorer Flibbius has always dreamt of taking to the sky!
Can you use your wits, problem solving and creativity to help him find the Mysterious Flying Machine and finally make Flibbius' dreams come true?
This is a short puzzle adventure game where you meet characters, craft items and solve puzzles! The game should take between 2 and 3 hours to complete, depending on your playstyle.
autokwd: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine

title: Dumbot
description:
게임 정보
THE STORY:
DUMBOT NEEDS YOUR HELP. Dumbot is a self-aware Robot used by the military to test exoskeleton robotic suits. Dumbot has endured punishing testing including being shot at and crashed. Even worse he has been set on fire, had grenades thrown at him and had IEDs and other explosive devices used on him. So far he has survived all of these punishing and dangerous tests. But now he has a very serious problem. He overheard that his next test will be his last as he is set to be blown to smithereens in-order to test the max explosive tolerance of the exoskeleton suit. Now he needs to find a way out before it’s too late. CAN YOU HELP SAVE HIM?

ABOUT THE GAME / HOW TO PLAY:
Dumbot is a hyper casual side scrolling platformer game. As Dumbot runs through the different levels of a treacherous maze you direct his movements and make him jump in order to avoid a lethal obstacle.

There are two very long levels that Dumbot must get through before he escapes and just be warned this is a very difficult game so you will need excellent hand eye coordination and quick reflexes to help Dumbot escape.

To help you along these levels there are Flags that serve as checkpoints. Once you reach a checkpoint, the next time you will start at that latest flag so you don’t have to start at the beginning of the level again. However, be aware in order to activate a flag you need to collect 25 coins otherwise the checkpoint will not be activated.

So if you like platforming challenges then embark on this great adventure and save Dumbot from sure destruction.

FEATURES OF THE GAME:
• Fluid and challenging hyper casual platforming gameplay designed to entertain.
• Easy controls, use your keyboard or for some old school retro fun use a Joystick or handheld controller.

INCREDIBLE GRAPHICS AND CHALLENGING LEVELS:
• As your progress through the Dumbot world you can expect to be mesmerized by some incredible and unique graphics.
• Venture through this dangerous yet beautiful world and uncover ever more unique and challenging obstacles and weapons


• Beautiful graphics, fun sounds effects as well as dangerous and challenging obstacles all await you as you help Dumbot escape.
• Expect lots of surprises and twists and turns as you make your way through the checkpoints and levels of this beautiful game.

title: Space Outpost Sigma
description:
게임 정보
Sigma Prime is running out of resources! We have to venture into space and mine as much ore as we can for the home planet. Can you survive the harsh environment of an asteroid field? Use probes to discover the sector. Pilot mining ships or direct mining drones to mine ore from asteroids that fly by. Protect Outpost Sigma from collisions using shields. Buy from trading ships. Transports will come to take the much needed ore back to Sigma Prime. If the situation goes bad, you must escape! Good Luck. This is a single-player 2D top-down pixel game with space physics. Random generation makes every run unique. If you ever want to just mine some asteroids while trying to survive the harshness of space, this is the game for you.

title: Desperate Place
description:
게임 정보
절망의 땅 은 우주 공상 과학 소설 테마의 기지 구축 타워 방어 게임입니다.
EC3040년, 인류는 더 이상 지구에 국한되지 않고, 별을 식민지화하고 새로운 주거 행성들을 탐험하기 시작했습니다. KOI 7711.01 행성으로의 여정 중에, 붉은 초거성이 방출하는 매우 강력한 이온 빔파를 예상 외로 만나 헬륨-3을 저장하고 있는 연료탱크가 유출되었습니다. 그 결과, 알려지지 않은 행성에 강제로 추락하여, 그곳에서 연료 공급을 유지하기 위해 헬륨-3을 찾고 손상된 함선을 수리해야 합니다. 더욱이 헬륨-3 입자를 함선으로 돌려보내면, 해당 행성의 알려지지 않은 생물이 함선을 공격하기 시작합니다. 목적지에 성공적으로 도달하기 위해, 임시로 작은 기지를 세워 모든 침입하는 적을 제거해야 합니다.
기지 구축 - 자원은 생존의 열쇠입니다
지휴관으로서 당신은 현장에 있는 제한된 자원을 사용하여 미션을 완료할 수 있는 작은 기지를 구축해야 합니다. 외딴 행성의 표면에서 기지를 짓는 것은 쉽지 않은 작업이며, 기지 레이아웃을 신중하게 계획하고 자원 추출 시설과 연구 시설을 건설할 최적의 위치를 선택해야 합니다. 알려지지 않은 생물의 공격을 격퇴하기 위해 충분한 방어 시설을 구축해야 하며, 방어탑 외에도 지형을 이용한 덫과 장애물을 설치하여 적의 공격을 늦추어야 합니다.
모든 쪽에서 둘러싸인 상황 - 화력으로 공포를 극복하세요
모든 공포는 화력 부족에서 비롯됩니다. 뛰어난 화력으로 알려지지 않은 생물의 공포를 극복하세요! 게임은 다양한 방어탑을 제공합니다. 포탑, 레이저탑, 미사일 발사기 등, 각각의 특정한 사정거리와 데미지 유형이 있습니다. 적의 특성과 공격 경로에 따라 방어탑을 합리적으로 배치하여 사격망을 형성하고 데미지 출력을 최대화하세요.
적들은 게임이 진행됨에 따라 점점 더 강력해지고 다양해집니다. 지속적으로 방어를 적응하고 업그레이드하여 이 싫은 괴물들에게 총알의 맛을 보여줍니다.

title: Out Of Hands
description:
게임 정보
[‘뒤틀린 그것’이 된 후의 이야기]
하루 밤 사이, 난…… 아웃 오브 핸즈가 되었다.
말로 표현조차 할 수 없는 것이 되어버렸다, 내 몸은 전부 꿈틀거리는 손가락이 되었다.
독특한 시점으로 악몽의 순환을 느껴라, 기괴함과 광기를 고스란히 받아들여라.
[희미해진 허상과 현실의 선]
실사풍 아트 콘셉트로 허상과 현실의 경계가 무너졌다, 익숙한 것들에서 뼛속까지 시린 오싹함을 느껴라.
로그라이크 플레이에서 다양한 “기관”의 선택은 중요하다, 뒤틀린 기관들을 잘 선택하고 조합해 꿈 속에서 빠져나가라.

title: Maliki : Poison Of The Past
description:
게임 정보
In the near future, humanity is teetering on the edge of extinction, subjugated by the fearsome Poison, a plant monster that alters the space-time continuum. Led by the enigmatic Maliki, a handful of temporal survivors have joined forces and are coordinating their efforts from the Domaine, a haven outside of time that is so far safe from the threat.
Play as Sand as you travel through the ages to repair the continuum. Use your Chrono Pack to manipulate time, fight the monsters that have infested past worlds alongside Becky, Fang and Fenimale, a wacky and slightly magical band of characters.

title: Spooky Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Spooky Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite that combines humor, strategy, and supernatural chaos. Play as Van Hobo, an eccentric monster hunter with a knack for survival, as you battle relentless hordes of ghastly foes in a haunted realm.
Features:
All Unlocks from the Start: Begin with every upgrade at your fingertips, but the power is in your choices—level up strategically to adapt to the chaos.
Equip Powerful Gear: Find and equip unique items to boost stats and gain abilities, creating endless build possibilities.
Dynamic Challenges: Face evolving waves of enemies that test your strategy and reflexes.
Procedural Variety: No two runs are the same, with randomized enemies and levels keeping the challenge fresh.
Quirky Humor: Embrace the light-hearted charm of Van Hobo as you flip the script on traditional monster hunting.
Chase Glory: Push yourself run after run, wave after wave, and fight to secure your spot in the top 100 leaderboard!
Survive the night, outsmart the hordes, and prove that even a hobo can be a legendary hero in this supernatural bullet hell adventure!

title: Outworld Station
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the TAU System, Station Commander!
Build, expand and exploit every resource you can to construct a planet-spanning space-based industrial complex the likes of which the galaxy has never seen.
Construct Robot Freighters, Wormholes and even harness the awesome power of Antimatter in your quest for ever-greater industrial mastery.
Atomize asteroids, mine ores, deploy cloud-miners and more to gather raw materials ready to be processed into advanced materials, items and parts.
Set up elaborate supply-chains, automate resource-gathering and optimize your stations to fulfill your objectives as efficiently as possible.
Construct Starships to complete objectives and unlock ever-more-advanced technologies to aid you on your mission to bring this hostile alien star system to heel.
Civilian and Military vessels will need vastly different and more complex construction techniques - some more dangerous to you and your station than others. 
Found multiple stations across numerous planets in order to exploit rare resources and connect them together via wormhole to create interstellar supply chains.
But beware: you are not the only force in this alien star system and you'll need to protect yourself and your station to thrive out here.

title: WAR RATS: The Rat em Up
description:
게임 정보
It's time for the rats... To WAR!
Sidescrolling shooter meets tower defense with a sprinkle of RPG elements. A hand-drawn rat-filled side-scrolling looter-shooter moba-lite 2D gore-fest inspired by that brutal 90s gaming feel of yore.
Set in a world where rats are the only form of life. Lead your troops to battle and retake the land of Ratopia from TechnoRat: A singular consciousness comprising cyborg rats that want nothing more than to consume all flesh and turn it to metal.
autokwd: WAR RATS: The Rat em Up

title: Despondent
description:
게임 정보
In a world where the supernatural and paranormal are known to exist, they are administered by the Department of Supernatural Intelligence, a body of government put in place to protect the balance. After the D.S.I. pulls resources out of solving a mass disappearance, you as Sedgewick must go it alone and seek the truth about the goings-on inside ground zero.
HARGRAVE
Once a beautiful and docile place, has turned into a hellish prison for those who disappeared. Make your way through various locales inside Hargrave, from a derelict farmstead to a god-forsaken factory, do whatever it takes to find answers for all those missing people. Will you clasp on to enough hope to escape? Or stay forever ensnared inside Hargrave's rotten mouth...
THE WREAKS
Sedgewick contracts a deadly sickness in which you must manage with medication throughout the journey. If left too long without temporary treatment, symptoms will begin to slow you down and make it difficult to outrun or fight those who want you dead. Symptoms will worsen while progressing, making it more and more difficult to stay alive without medication. Do what you can to stay off the sickness during your fight through Hargrave.
Sedgewick is an agent of the D.S.I. and has both knowledge and training on how to deal with the supernatural and paranormal accordingly. Use a selection of weapons to defend yourself against the horrors that lurk within. However some enemies you face will be invulnerable to your arsenal, in times like this it is in your best interest to run like hell.
There is an abundance of creatures roaming the darkness. From different types of spirits to sea dwelling cryptids, keep track of them in Sed's compendium, which will update with every new creature you lay eyes on, after all... it is important to know which ones will tear you limb from limb without a moments thought. But be ready to lay witness to heinous life-forms nobody has ever seen, in places so truly void of hope... you will forever be Despondent.
Despondent is heavily inspired by games from the late 2000's/early 2010's. It mixes detailed environments and characters with 2D sprites that are implemented as foliage, draw clutter, food etc. It is also paired with some retro post-processing like heavy film grain, bright colours and an overly sharp image. These elements all lovingly come together to create a nostalgic aesthetic that will bring you right back to the good ol' days!

title: xd1
description:
게임 정보
A game of such roguelike wonderful, yes the best! You play as an animatronic of egypt, fly and tulpa liquids collect.
Adventures, big and strong! Play the game!
But there are many secrets, don't let yourself be fooled, animatronic.
It's like this, you jump in one, you walk in the other. The sun will replace the animatronic, so be it!
But there's the bad news, dubai ruins of long ago falls!!!! What to do? What happened to dubai!?
This is what you'll find out in the second chapters!
📝 Plot and 2 chapters
🤐 A lot of secrets
🎶 Original Soundtrack
🏆 150+ achievements
🕗 2-4 hours to complete
❤️ Rogalikes free
company: Джакке-Куген К, Мархабан Е Мил, Джедун Такар О Азад

title: Territors
description:
게임 정보
The quick card game of atomic energy!
Step into the microscopic world of particles with Protons & Neutrons an exciting card game where atomic power collide!
Players take control of Proton and Neutron factions, competing to unlock all the cards by winning intense matches. With each victory, you'll have a chance to unlock new cards, build stronger factions, and face increasingly challenging enemies in this thrilling race for atomic supremacy.
The game is designed to be quick and easy to pick up, offering a thrilling experience without being time-consuming. Each match is fast-paced, making it perfect for shorter sessions.
The game features a drag-and-drop system, allowing players to combine cards in countless ways, each with unique advantages based on their abilities, unique card powers and bonuses, enemy special traits, and a dynamic inventory size that adjusts based on your performance, enabling players to strategize and customize their decks for maximum impact.
The game itself offers great replayability thanks to:
Multiple dynamic card categories
