title: Days Of Haze
description:
게임 정보
Days Of Haze is a puzzle filled climate simulated action RPG where your actions affect the weather and temperature.
Coated in the exakt NES palette. Every enemy killed, every life tree planted, and every seed sown plus every quest undertaken will dynamically affect how much disease is in the air, how the climate system evolves, and ultimately, the fate of the planet. This will, in turn, influence how fast things grow and have a bearing on the survival of the people living on the planet. You have never played an rpg like this before.


You are a boy shielded from everything by your grandfather. Now he is gone and you have to decide if you dare to enter the big world.
Explore a world in decline. Fight the planet's elements. Get diseases and cure diseases and hopefully make the whole world easier to explore and help the people that are left.
Unravel the mystery of the Red Goo and its effect on the world. Why did the Protectors disappear and is there a conspiracy or not?

Do your best to survive but remember, you have to live too. If some days you feel you don't want to challenge the elements and put your life at risk.
Go play arcade games in the bars in towns and collect capsules or take care of your strong willed animals and DAX.

title: Gassy Getaway
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Gassy Getaway - the hilarious casual game that will put your laughter and time management skills to the test!
Navigate Through Office Chaos

In this frantic office adventure, you take on the role of an employee in a highly urgent situation - a pressing need that just can't be stopped! But beware: Your character unfortunately has limited control over their gases and must navigate through the office without hitting too many colleagues with their unwanted emissions.
Complete Tasks Before the Countdown

Your mission? Complete all the important tasks assigned to you in the office before you just can't hold it anymore and urgently need to visit the restroom! Whether it's quickly printing out an important document or locking the computer - withstand the time pressure and avoid embarrassing encounters on the way to relief.
Key Features:

Unique Gameplay: Navigate through the office and complete important tasks while trying to keep your flatulence under control.
Exciting Challenges: From simple to tricky tasks waiting to be completed before you just can't hold it anymore.
Hilarious Animations: Dive into a world full of funny animations and characters that will tickle your funny bone.
Office Environment: Explore various office areas with different obstacles and hiding spots as you make your way to the restroom.
Rewards and Leaderboards: Unlock achievements and compete for the top spot on leaderboards as you showcase your skills in flatulence management.
Customization Options: Customize your character with different outfits and accessories, getting ready for the wild adventure in the office!

With these features, Gassy Getaway is sure to provide an unforgettable experience for all players looking for a humorous and entertaining pastime!

title: Mirrors of Epiphany
description:
게임 정보
Mirrors of Epiphany is a puzzle game where you guide light beams to their designated goals by placing mirrors on a board.
Core gameplay
Light sources and detectors (paired up by colours) are placed around an empty board. The challenge is to place mirrors in positions and orientations so that each source and detector pair is connected.
Rich in content
There are 100 unique puzzles, ranging from the simplest possible to larger boards with multiple pairs of light sources and detectors.
Choose your own challenge level
Most puzzles have a lot of workable solutions, but each puzzle has only one optimal solution (i.e. using as few mirrors as possible). Explore and play around to find solutions that just get the job done, or satisfy your puzzle solving instincts by reaching for perfection.
Unlimited number of moves
You can place mirrors, change their orientations, and remove them again as many times as you like. The number of moves are not counted. The only scoring measure is the number of mirrors placed on the board when all pairs of light sources and detectors are connected.
Relaxing
There are no time limits. You can enjoy solving all the puzzles at your own pace.

title: Axona
description:
게임 정보
Axona(악소나)에서는 이상한 차원에 갇힌 신비한 큐브를 조작합니다. 당신은 탈출구를 찾을 수 있을까요?
굴리고 해결하세요
큐브를 굴려 열쇠를 얻고, 글리프를 해제하여 다음 레벨로 나아가세요. 진행하면서 새로운 메커니즘을 발견하고 더 복잡한 퍼즐을 해결하게 될 것입니다.
자신만의 속도로 플레이
Axona는 도전적인 퍼즐 게임으로 설계되었지만, 여유롭게 즐길 수도 있습니다.

title: Scarred Mansion
description:
게임 정보
이 독특한 덱 빌더에서 떠나는 정맥이 끊기는 여정에는 로그라이크 탐험, 이소메트릭 그리드 이동 및 혁신적인 카드 제작이 순조롭게 융합되어 턴 기반 퍼즐 전략 게임으로 결합됩니다. 저주받은 집에 갇힌 어린 소년 역할을 맡아 탈출을 필사적으로 찾으십시오. 참으실 수 있습니까?
👻 몰입형 로그라이크 탐험
각 플레이스루가 새로운 도전, 놀람 및 초자연적인 만남을 제시하는 저주받은 집의 변화무쌍한 복도를 탐험하십시오. 그림자에 숨겨진 비밀을 발견하지만, 조심하십시오 - 당신이 내린 모든 결정은 심각한 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다.
🃏 혁신적인 카드 제작 시스템
전통적인 덱 구축 게임과 달리, Scarred Mansion은 혁신적인 카드 제작 시스템을 소개합니다. 덱에서 카드를 추가하거나 제거하는 대신, 다양한 효과를 가진 인벤토리를 사용하여 사용자 지정할 수 있는 고정된 카드 세트를 보유하게 됩니다. 추가 카드 슬롯을 잠금 해제하고 효과의 힘을 향상시켜 사용자 지정 및 강력한 덱을 생성하세요!
🔮 다이나믹한 만남과 퍼즐
다양한 초자연적인 엔터티를 만나고, 복잡한 퍼즐을 해결하고, 위협적인 적에게 맞서 보십시오. 재생되는 각 카드는 여정의 결과에 영향을 줍니다. 예상치 못한 도전에 대비하여 전략을 신속히 조정하십시오. 이를 통해 각 플레이스루가 흥미 진진하고 예측할 수 없는 경험이 되도록 보장하십시오.
🌟 업그레이드 가능한 효과 및 비밀
숨겨진 코너를 탐험하여 놀라운 비밀을 발견하고 강력한 새로운 효과를 잠금 해제하십시오. 이러한 요소들은 게임플레이에 깊이를 더하며, 도전에 대한 새로운 접근 방식을 제공하고, 유령 같은 모험의 흐름을 변경합니다.
👁️ 시각적으로 멋진 분위기
환경의 매혹적인 아름다움에 몰입하세요. 모든 그림자, 깜박이는 양초, 스펙트럴 엔터티가 느껴지는 분위기 있는 경험에 기여합니다.
🎶 기이한 사운드트랙
기가 적당한 시각적 효과를 보완하는 것은 Scarred Mansion의 기이한 분위기를 더욱 강화하는 오리지널 사운드트랙입니다. 기이한 음악과 분위기 있는 사운드는 불길한 감각을 증폭시키며, 잊지 못할 청각적 경험을 제공합니다.
알려지지 않은 곳으로 모험을 떠나 운명을 만들고 초자연적인 손아귀에서 탈출하세요. 어둠에 맞서 과연 속에 숨겨진 미스테리를 발견할 용기가 있습니까? 당신의 으스스한 모험이 문 뒤에 기다립니다.

title: TCL - The Cursed Legacy
description:
게임 정보
The Cursed Legacy is an action/exploration game based on “die and retry” and made with love and passion to pay homage to the games of the 90s. It also offers mini games that give this work an infinite lifespan.
FEATURES
6 action stages
13 bosses
Action platformer run'n gun phases
Metroid-like exploration phases
5 mini-games
Save functionality
STORY
Year 3145. The human race has practically disappeared from the universe. The principality of Dallongeville, the last bastion of humanity, no longer exists. It was the scene of the worst abuses.
In these tormented times, the young mercenary Leif survives by committing the worst misdeeds. Always in search of power, he will try to steal the RB209, in one of the oases of the Cube god.
Will you have the courage to accompany him on this odyssey?

title: Orange You Glad i Didn't Say Banana
description:
게임 정보
Orange You Glad I Didn't Say Banana?!
Get ready for the wackiest, most action-packed roguelike platformer you've ever seen! Orange You Glad I Didn’t Say Banana? throws you into the peel of Banana man, a bipedal banana with a thirst for destruction and a minigun that spits absolute chaos!
This isn’t just any ordinary run-and-gun adventure—this is a fast-paced, high-intensity, endlessly challenging roguelike where every run is different, and every decision can mean the difference between glorious victory and getting turned into a fruit smoothie!
MOD YOUR MINIGUN—UNLEASH MAYHEM!
Why settle for just a minigun when you can slap on some of the wildest mods imaginable? Choose from a selection of ridiculous yet devastating weapon upgrades to turn your gun into something truly overpowered:
🔥 Flamethrower – Turn up the heat and roast your enemies into crispy snacks!
🚀 Rocket Launcher – Blast through waves of foes with explosive firepower!
🪝 Grappling Hook – Swing through levels like a banana-flavored ninja, dodging enemies and pulling off insane aerial stunts!
💥 More to Discover! – Unlock secret upgrades that completely change the way you play!
Each mod completely alters the gameplay, allowing you to mix and match upgrades for maximum destruction. Experiment with different builds and see just how far you can push Banana Joe’s arsenal!
THE FURTHER YOU GO, THE HARDER IT GETS!
Think you’ve mastered the game? Think again. Orange You Glad I Didn’t Say Banana? ramps up the difficulty the longer you survive. Enemies get tougher, levels become deadlier, and only the most skilled players will be able to push past the chaos. Survival is key, but destruction is king!
GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS – COMPETE FOR BANANA SUPREMACY!
What’s the point of all this mayhem if you can’t prove you’re the best? Climb the global leaderboard and show the world that you’re the ultimate Banana! Compete for high scores, perfect your runs, and etch your name in the hall of fruit-based legends!
ARE YOU READY TO GO BANANAS?!
This is not just another platformer. This is an adrenaline-fueled, over-the-top, fruit-flavored explosion of chaos that will keep you coming back for more. So grab your minigun, mod it to the max, and prepare for the
autokwd: Orange You Glad i Didn't Say Banana

title: The Little Shelter
description:
게임 정보
The Little Shelter
The Little Shelter is a narrative-driven 2D platform adventure that follows Lunaaa, a young Asian woman navigating the chaos of New York City in search of solace and self-discovery. Caught between reality and surreal dreamscapes, players will embark on an emotional journey of escape, resilience, and self-reflection.
Key Features:
🎭 Deeply Personal Story – Experience Lunaaa’s emotional struggles, shaped by the highs and lows of city life, as she seeks a place to call home.
🏙️ Surreal NYC-Inspired Environments – Explore hand-crafted 2D levels blending urban realism with dreamlike fantasy, reflecting Lunaaa’s shifting emotions.
🎮 Platforming & Puzzle Mechanics – Solve environmental puzzles, navigate complex platforming challenges, and make narrative-driven choices that impact the journey.
🔥 Anxiety System – A unique game mechanic that represents Lunaaa’s emotional state, affecting her movement, perception, and interactions with the world.
🎶 Atmospheric Soundtrack – A rich, immersive score that evolves with the narrative, heightening the emotional depth of Lunaaa’s journey.
🎨 Hand-Drawn Art & Animation – Vibrant, expressive visuals that bring the world to life, blending modern indie aesthetics with evocative storytelling.
Whether you’ve ever felt lost in a city’s overwhelming presence or sought shelter in your own emotions, The Little Shelter offers a poignant and visually stunning experience about finding strength in uncertainty.

title: Swifty
description:
게임 정보
⚡ Swifty – Precision. Speed. Survival.
Race through challenging levels where speed is everything. Swifty tests your reflexes, timing, and precision in a fast-paced 2D platformer designed for players who love a challenge. Dodge deadly traps, pull off flawless jumps, and perfect your runs. Show that annoying frog who is the real "Swifty" here.
💥 Key Features:
Fast-paced gameplay that rewards precision and speed
Tight, responsive controls for smooth movement
Challenging levels with deadly obstacles
Minimalist art style focused on gameplay clarity

title: Little Spaceman
description:
게임 정보
LITTLE SPACEMAN
In a universe full of secrets, you take on the role of a brave astronaut in search of space relics. Explore this vast universe, traverse territories, and dodge asteroids while uncovering rare artifacts lost in the cosmos.
GAME MODES
Explore the mysteries of the universe in Story Mode or test your reflexes in Infinite Run. Take on three challenging minigames: All Sides tests your reaction time, Planet Hop requires precision, and Zero-Gravity Pool brings strategic challenges in weightlessness.

title: Escape Haunted Mansion
description:
게임 정보
Escape Haunted Mansion is a horrific multiplayer deduction game for 3 to 10 players with voice chat. The Haunteds must complete tasks to escape, while the Cursed seek to eliminate them discreetly.

You and your band of friends find yourselves trapped in the basement of a haunted mansion after an exploration gone wrong. Except one of your friends isn't, and he's the one who brought you all here, knocked you unconscious, and imprisoned and killed you.
Get out of here and try to unmask the culprit who deceived you. Then carry out all the tasks necessary for your release. Cooperate to be more efficient in your quest for freedom. Be careful, unmasking your cursed friend won't set you free - you have to complete all the tasks necessary to win and escape.
If everyone dies except your cursed friend, then it's all over for you and he wins.
Don't trust anyone, be quick and open the portal to get away and save yourself.

title: Bill Wants To Retire
description:
게임 정보
Farm, Craft, and Protect your Chickens! Can you survive the night?
Bill wants to Retire is the cozy shooter you've been looking for, by day farm, gather resources, play minigames, and raise your chickens because when night comes so do the wolves! Face off against hoards of wolves, foxes, and coyotes using an arsenal of weapons and towers. In a pinch? You must decide whether to sell a chicken for a quick coin boost, sacrificing both a vital resource and one of your lives.
-Featuring three challenging maps full of scenic views, secrets, and unique challenges.
-Story and endless mode
-4 Melee weapons, 4 guns, and 4 upgradable towers
-A cozy by day, chaotic by night gameplay loop that's easy to pick up and hard to put down.

title: Pawsky
description:
게임 정보
🐾 A Short & Whisker-Twitching Adventure! 🐾
Step into the paws of a curious cat in this choice-driven, storybook-style game! Explore, interact, and make decisions that shape your journey—whether that means making friends, causing mischief, or discovering something unexpected.
What’s in the Box?
✨ Be a Cat – Nap, explore, knock things over, and do what cats do best!
✨ Make Choices – Your decisions shape the story, leading to different outcomes.
✨ Meet Quirky Characters – Befriend (or bother) a cast of charming animal NPCs.
✨ Explore & Collect – Find hidden surprises and collect fun mementos of your adventure.
It’s a short and delightful game—perfect for a cozy playthrough in a single sitting. Where will your paws take you? 🐱

title: Doorz
description:
게임 정보
Step into a world of mystery and riddles!
You’ve been taken from your reality and thrust into a strange, magical world with only one way forward—through doors guarded by mind-bending riddles. A mischievous, clown-like Riddle Master holds the key, testing your wits at every turn. Solve his riddles, unlock the doors, and uncover the truth behind this world as you journey toward the final showdown with the ultimate boss. Can you outsmart the Riddle Master and escape?

title: Cut it!
description:
게임 정보
Cut It! – Slice Your Way to Victory!
Get ready to wield a blade like never before in Cut It!—a thrilling physics-based game where your cutting skills determine the fate of others! Obstacles are blocking the paths ahead, and it's up to you to clear the way with your sharp instincts and even sharper weapons.
With a special knife that adapts to any situation—whether as a humble kitchen tool or a mighty katana—you’ll slice, chop, and carve through anything standing in your way. Precision and timing are key as you decide how and when to strike. Are you ready to do a good deed with a deadly edge?
🔪 Game Features:
A morphing knife that changes size and form to match the challenge
Dynamic obstacles blocking the way—slice through them to clear paths
Physics-based cutting mechanics that reward skillful slicing
Simple and intuitive controls—just use your mouse to slash through the chaos
Step up, grab your blade, and cut your way to success in Cut It!

title: Path Of Balls
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an intriguing adventure, where you have been summoned by a powerful God, on a mission: to recover the sacred balls that were stolen from this God.
The stolen balls.
Pick up the balls that are scattered across different levels.
There are several balls of different colors to be captured.
Find them, capture them and take them to the boxes.
Store the balls in the boxes, to return the balls to the God who takes care of these balls
Each box has the same color as the ball.
The boxes are a portal for the balls to reach the God.
When you reach certain numbers of stored balls, something will happen.

title: SenpaiSurvivor
description:
게임 정보
Players become a member of the defense force to protect the earth and fight against the approaching extraterrestrial forces. Let's protect the future of the human race together.

Game Structure
It consists of a compact game of about 10 minutes.
- Survival mode with a round-based system to keep fighting the oncoming enemies
- A campaign that also serves as a tutorial
- Other challenge modes, etc.

Features
- Animated characters
- Can be played in a short period of time
- Aiming and shooting feel

title: Dual Combat
description:
게임 정보
Calling All Soldiers!
The Blueberry Army awakens to discover that their beloved Chef Lupe is missing, putting their pancake breakfast in jeopardy. It’s up to you to rescue him from the rival Raspberry Army, but it won’t be easy.
The Raspberries have prepared their troops and are ready to stop you. Navigate through their various barricades and overcome their skills in mimicry. When you run, they run; when you shoot, they shoot. With only weapons and wits at your disposal, manipulate your opponents to gain the advantage on the battlefield and save the day!
Do you have what it takes to outsmart yourself?
Features:
Battle your way through 18 quirky levels
Duel against opponents that copy your every move
Use special weapons and abilities to gain the upper hand
Decorate your soldier with unlockable cosmetics

title: Draguna Matata
description:
게임 정보
Draguna Matata는 드래곤 아기가 되어 점점 더 복잡해지는 미로를 빠져나가야 하는 도전적인 퍼즐 게임입니다. 거대한 열대우림에서 작은 용이 되어 삶의 부조리에 맞서면서 논리력과 탐색 능력을 발휘하세요. 더 크게 성장하고, 힘을 얻고, 상자를 밀고, 환경을 제어하고... 그 과정에서 만난 친구들로부터 원치 않는 조언을 받을 수 있습니다!
게임 플레이
이 멋진 Steam 페이지의 제작자가 만든 이 게임에는 70개 이상의 퍼즐 레벨이 있으며, 탐색 과제와 심리적인 함정으로 가득 차 있어 신뢰에 문제가 생길 수 있습니다. Draguna Matata는 드래곤의 성장기를 직접 경험하면서 좁은 공간에서 길을 찾아야 하는 캐주얼한 사고력 퍼즐입니다.
드래곤이 더 커지고 더 현명해지면 주변 세계를 지배할 수 있는 멋진 힘을 얻게 됩니다. 상자를 밀어 넣는 소코반 퍼즐을 현대적으로 재해석한 이 게임에서, 변화하는 물줄기와 급강하하는 구덩이의 역동적인 환경에 몰입해 보세요(때로는 말 그대로!). 티키 횃불을 따라가야 하고 숲 속 동식물을 찾아야 하는 등, 진정한 퍼즐 애호가라면 탐험할 지역과 수집할 파인애플이 가득합니다.

title: DEATH PIT EXPLORER
description:
게임 정보
ARE YOU SKILLED ENOUGH TO TRAVERSE THE DEATH PIT?
Deep below the surface of The City's endless sprawl, something terrible festers. Six months ago, a gaping hole opened and swallowed an entire city block. Government-contracted drone operators attempted to explore the pit, but the operation was deemed a failure and the program ended. Now, the drone-operating software has leaked online and many are trying to fly into the pit to uncover its secrets. 
Features:
Master a challenging control scheme: Attempt to fly your drone to the bottom of the pit in first person using an unconventional control scheme...
Explore surreal environments: Several distinct, challenging, and hand-crafted environments to see...
Effectively manage your drone's power: Every movement, bump, and action costs energy - don't forget to recharge...
WARNING this game may induce motion sickness

title: Hegzis
description:
게임 정보
육각형 그리드를 지배하세요!
다채로운 색감의 2D 스타일로 구현된 차분한 육각형 그리드 퍼즐 게임, Hegzis의 독특한 도전 과제를 통해 자기 두뇌 능력을 시험하세요! 평화로운 해변, 속삭이는 숲 등에서 스테이지 하나를 선택하고, 각 세계에 펼쳐진 다수의 레벨을 진행하세요. 육각형이 연결되어 만들어진 피스를 배치하여 방향에 상관없이 한 줄을 만들면 됩니다.
피스를 돌리면서 끝까지 줄을 채우면, 채워진 육각형 줄은 사라지고 점수가 올라갑니다. 하지만 막히지 않게 조심하세요! 특수 도구를 사용해서 틈을 메우거나 원치 않는 육각형을 지워 공간을 확보하세요. 몇 수 앞을 보고 효율적으로 육각형을 배치하면 더 큰 보너스를 받게 될 것입니다. 새로운 스테이지를 잠금 해제하거나, 이미 클리어한 스테이지로 돌아가서 더 높은 점수에 도전하세요!

title: Error_Boy.exe
description:
게임 정보
모종의 이유로 에러가 발생하여 게임들이 섞여버렸습니다.
이를 해결하기 위해 적응형 에러 수정 프로그램 "Error_Boy"가 나섭니다.
"Error_Boy"는 적응형 에러 수정 프로그램 답게 게임에서 추출한 아이템이나 무기를 사용합니다.
다양한 아이템, 무기, 업그레이드로 적들을 "디버그" 시키세요!
@Medieval Voyager
Medieval Voyager는 흑백 컬러로 이루어진 중세판타지게임입니다.

title: Task Code Foolish
description:
게임 정보
This is an immersive first-person shooter where players take on the role of the clone soldier, SI, dropped onto a planet teeming with crime and chaos. Every inch of this world is corrupted by endless violence and monstrous threats. Players will need to undertake a series of dangerous and high-stakes missions to uncover the dark secrets lurking beneath the surface. In this desolate and decaying world, you will face alien monsters, corrupt military forces, and other terrifying challenges that defy expectation.
The game's aesthetic blends sci-fi and monster realism, creating a vast and intricately detailed virtual world. Each environment is meticulously crafted, filled with futuristic technology and the menacing presence of horrific creatures, offering a truly immersive experience. The pulsating electronic music is seamlessly integrated throughout, with rapid beats and heavy bass that amplify the high-energy, adrenaline-fueled combat. The soundtrack motivates players to fight harder and push their limits, keeping the action intense and non-stop.
To fully immerse players in this brutal, blood-soaked world, the game features a range of brutal execution animations. Each kill isn't just about defeating an enemy—it’s about showcasing stunning and visceral animations that highlight the savage beauty of combat. Every execution is a spectacle of violence, enhancing the visual impact of every encounter and giving players a visceral sense of the high-stakes, life-or-death battles unfolding. Each victory is a test of not only your combat skills but also your nerve and resilience.
In this never-ending battle, Zen's mission is more than just survival—he must unravel the dark conspiracy at the heart of this corrupted world while fighting off waves of monstrous enemies and traitorous foes. The planet is a desolate wasteland, and every moment is a fight for survival. With each heartbeat syncing to the relentless electronic beats, players race against time to complete seemingly impossible missions, becoming the last hope for a doomed world.

title: Mental Harm
description:
게임 정보
경고: 이 비디오 게임은 이 질병에 취약한 사람들에게 광과민성 간질 발작을 유발할 수 있습니다. 게임 관객을 합리적으로 제한하는 것이 좋습니다.

Mental Harm은 걷기 시뮬레이터 장르의 1인칭 심리적 공포 게임입니다.



사샤라는 이름의 주인공은 조부모님의 오래된 정원을 방문할 예정입니다. 이웃들은 그곳에서 이상한 소리가 난다고 오랫동안 불평해 왔다. 단 하나의 손전등으로 무장한 당신은 이 신비한 장소를 조사하러 갑니다. 이 장소의 비밀은 상상을 초월하는 무언가를 만듭니다. 거기에 무슨 일이 일어나고 있습니까?

게임 특징:
- 게임의 주요 장르는 "워킹 시뮬레이터"입니다.
- 현실에 가까운 3D 그래픽;
- 1인칭 시점

title: Stopping Santa
description:
게임 정보
A top-down arena shooter where you play a mercenary fighting against the legions of Santa. Santa has gone ROGUE. He is not paying the Elves, contributing to global warming, and using sweatshops to produce extra presents to save on costs. You have been hired by the United Nations to fight his legions, because they are afraid of a PR nightmare.    
This is a very classic Arcade game. Simple controls, instant action, short play sessions, and a leaderboard for the global Top 10. Slay Santa's minions while enjoying some smooth Jazz.
There are three types of soldiers in the legions of Santa. Elves, Reindeer, and Mall Santas.

title: Risk the Dark
description:
게임 정보
액션 로그라이트

Risk The Dark는 어둠 속에서 진행되는 실시간 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다.
어려운 난이도와 빛과 어둠, 묵직하고 다양한 생존주의적인 액션을 통해 높은 몰입감을 제공합니다.
어둠 속을 탐험하며 성장하고 눈앞의 위협들을 다양한 방식으로 파훼하며 출구를 찾아내세요.
어둠 속에 고립되다



당신은 '찢김' 후 생겨난 괴물들과 싸우다 던진 수류탄으로 인해 알 수 없는 동굴 속에 고립되었습니다.
일단은 살아남았지만 이곳엔 당신 말고도 많은 것들이 존재하고 있었습니다.
살아남기 위해 어둠을 마주하세요.
빛과 어둠



당연하게도, 어둠 속에선 빛이 없다면 앞이 보이지 않습니다. 안전을 위해 어둠을 걷어내세요.
다양한 종류의 광원들은 당신의 눈이 되어줄 겁니다.



평범한 당신도 무기를 들고 싸울 수 있다는 걸 보여주세요.
근접, 원거리, 투척, 원소 등 조합이 가능한 플레이 방식들이 존재하며, 이를 위한 여러 종류의 장비와 개조, 소모품, 액세서리, 숙련도 등이 준비되어 있습니다.
탐색을 하며 원하는 스타일을 강화하고 보완하세요.



각 구역의 마지막에는 당신을 기다리고 있는 특별한 적이 있습니다.
적의 공격을 피하고 허점을 공격해 당신이 쉬운 상대가 아니라는 걸 알려주세요.

title: Goofy Goober Simulator
description:
게임 정보
NO STYLE
NO SUBSTANCE
JUST PEAK 🗣️🗣️🗣️🗣️🗣️🗣️🗣️
Blast and crash through hordes of Hell's strongest warriors as a (Human? Statue?? Creature???) Goofy Goober fighting through all rings of the iconic down-under for Revengeance of unknown proportion. One thing is certain: There Will be Blood Shed. Grab a weapon, equip an item and slice through Twin Raging Titans, Ghastly Apparitions, Big Tank, and Lil' Scratchy. What lies at the end of these Wacky Hijinks..?
There might also be a Fishing Minigame
I don't really know?
Thrilling roguelike gameplay to the darkest depths of Hell
Collectable skins and costumes to personalize your very own Goober
Interesting challenges to spice up regular gameplay
Wide variety of enemies and bosses bent on stopping your scrummage
20+ Song OST to get your blood PUMPING
Plot

title: Skogdal
description:
게임 정보
Something strange is afoot in the small rustic Norwegian town of Skogdal...
This is a deckbuilding card game where you have to explore a large hand-crafted world across multiple runs. Immerse yourself in this weird but familiar adventure, and uncover an unsettling Carpenter-esque mystery…

title: Silent Fleet
description:
게임 정보
A cooperative role-playing video game for 1-5 players. You are a squad of le Fourrageurs in the service of the Burgomaster and your task is to go to the islands for treasure, to replenish the coffers of the colony, and save Saint-Gabriel from ruin. But this task is not as simple as it sounds.
The fortress city of Saint-Gabriel has barely stayed afloat for the last few years, and the Burgomaster has decided to put an end to this. He thought long and hard and selected the most suitable and reliable individuals for this event—you (never-drying sailors, sitting in the port without leaving). For the adventure to begin, you are forced to leave the warm tavern and go, with friends or alone, into the ocean to dangerous islands. Some of them look like a resort, while others immediately make it clear that nothing good awaits you here.
If you manage to survive, then upon returning to the city, you will find... a sad picture... many trading establishments have closed due to the crisis, and you will have to invest so that artisans return to the city. Learn the recipes for powerful spells that the sage keeps. Learn how to assemble useful tools from scrap materials. Stock up on the necessary weapons, or go with what the Motherland equips you with.
Trust the sea, your survival skills, and friends. You have no other choice...
Unless, of course, you are considering a tribunal for failure to comply with an order!
What to expect:
- Co-op up to 5 players with asymmetrical gameplay.
- Restore the settlement, gradually fill it with merchants.
- Advanced crafting system: create useful potions and scrolls of magic.
- Character customization
- Mysterious dungeons with valuables, unusual enemies, and puzzles.
- If you do not understand anything, then play music for your smarter friends.

title: THE BEST INVESTOR
description:
게임 정보
THE BEST INVESTOR is a board game in which your adventure begins with 5 million dollars, then face your opponents by making investments of all kinds in order to increase this financial wealth as much as possible in order to become the best investor in the game!
Give the best of yourself by developing your own investment strategies and comparing them with the strategies of your opponents, however be careful of bad decisions because these can lead you to elimination and being out of the ranking and that doesn't matter your financial wealth!
This game also aims to reproduce as close to reality as possible many situations that one may encounter when managing a financial portfolio! In addition to improving your geographic knowledge through the discovery of numerous cities, THE BEST INVESTOR is an excellent, fun and entertaining way to approach financial education!
You can play with up to 6 people on the same screen or play alone against the robots.



Choose from a multitude of shares in each city and invest according to your strategy, receive dividends from these shares every minute and generate passive income!
You can resell your stock shares at the stock market price whenever you want!

You will also be able to buy and resell gold, so as to benefit or not depending on your decisions on this market combined with that of stock market shares!

You will be able to recover your profits after passing a TAXES box where you will pay taxes on your profits, the Taxes and start boxes are the only boxes where it is impossible to make an action, you can only recover in your profits. For the other squares on the board you will be entitled to 2 actions per turn.
Your profits may be stored in one or more bank accounts depending on your investment strategy, however be careful because these banks can go bankrupt!
You will be able to transfer money from one bank account to another!

You will also be able to sell the cities you hold and their respective investments to other players and therefore buy the cities held by other players who have put them up for sale!

In short, there are a lot of possibilities available to you, it's up to you to make good use of them in order to build a solid investment strategy capable of challenging and beating your opponents to become THE BEST INVESTOR.

title: Hauntrick
description:
게임 정보
초자연적인 현상이 끔찍할 뿐만 아니라 완전히 우스꽝스럽기도 한 협동 공포 게임입니다. 장난스럽고 예측할 수 없는 유령과 맞서고, 혼란스러운 의식을 수행하고, 점점 커지는 광기 속에서 살아남으세요. 당신은 유령을 능가할 수 있습니까? 아니면 속임수가 당신에게 달려 있습니까?
1-4명의 플레이어 온라인 협동
이 혼란스러운 공포 경험에서 최대 3명의 친구와 팀을 이루세요. 함께 협력하여 저주받은 물건을 찾고, 의식을 준비하고, 길을 가로막는 기괴하고 예측할 수 없는 존재를 처리하세요. 무작위 적의 행동, 초자연적인 디버프, 계속 추측할 수 있는 지도 덕분에 각 게임이 신선하게 느껴집니다.
예측할 수 없고 멍청한 영혼들
Hauntrick의 영혼은 결코 평범하지 않습니다. 각각은 다르게 행동합니다. 일부는 멍청하고 일부는 예측할 수 없으며 다른 일부는 의식을 방해하는 이상한 방법을 가지고 있습니다. 그들이 다음에 무엇을 할지 결코 알 수 없으며, 모든 만남을 예상치 못한 혼란으로 만들 것입니다.
모든 달리기는 다릅니다
Hauntrick의 각 세션은 새로운 놀라움을 선사합니다. 절차적으로 생성된 지도, 무작위로 저주받은 개체, 회전하는 독특한 영혼을 통해 두 번의 실행이 동일하게 느껴지지 않습니다. 빨리 적응하지 않으면 속아 조기 무덤에 빠지게 됩니다.

title: Shinobi Match
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a Japan themed twist on the beloved match 3 genre. Here rather than simply sliding pieces to form groups, you will take on the role of a skilled ninja, wielding an array of weapons to launch attacks against enemies while strategically uniting your allies.
Each weapon you encounter has its own attack pattern, providing you with strategic options to pass the puzzles. This allows for you to find multiple approaches to each challenge.
As you become proficient with all the weapons the difficulty ramps up. Enemies will start to deploy traps, adding an extra layer of complexity that will require you to think several steps ahead in order to beat the puzzles successfully.

title: Kozomo: The Smoldering Ember
description:
게임 정보
Wishlist and Follow the Game to Get Notified When The Game Comes Out
Accompany Kozomo in this pointless life
Kozomo is a young man in his late teens, who has spent most of his youth either asleep or escaping to the woods. Despite his and his family’s wealth and reputation, Kozomo finds no joy in life, often neglecting even the simplest of duties like eating. To those around him, his behavior is not just baffling but unsettling. Some people see his detachment as a sign of madness or moral weakness. And some believe that there is a smoldering ember inside him, one day that will raise him up again.
Solve a variety of puzzles
Kozomo: The Smoldering Ember is a platformer game where you'll have to think so often to solve the puzzles blocking your way. The game usually introduces new elements or expects from you to discover new interactions between already introduced elements in some clever ways. This game is not a hardcore puzzle experience, but it also will not be a piece of cake.
Explore your firepowers
Witness Kozomo's discovery of his sorcery powers. Will this powers be able to grant him the life purpose he's lacking? Will he use those for the good, or will the power poison him? Make use of Kozomo's new firepowers to solve puzzles in different ways and find out the uncertain fate of Kozomo.

title: Raider of Realms
description:
게임 정보
Raider of Realms is a 2D real-time strategy game played on a hexagonal grid. Begin your adventure with a few tiles under your control and gather valuable resources to grow your kingdom. Build units, develop an army, and strategically conquer new tiles to expand your empire.
Players must manually place humans and units on the right tiles to collect resources, defend their land, and fight enemies. Success depends on your ability to manage your resources and territory efficiently while fending off opposing forces. Are you ready to become the raider of realms?
Key features:

title: CubeyCollect
description:
게임 정보
Cubey Collect is a minimalistic singleplayer puzzle game, which was originally made in a GameJam in the span of 3 Days.

Collect Coins and progress futher through the level getting harder and harder

title: Kafkaesque: The Nightmare Trial
description:
게임 정보
Kafkaesque: The Nightmare Trial is a psychological survival horror game that thrusts you into a world of bureaucratic nightmares and existential dread.
Solve twisted puzzles, manage scarce resources, and battle monstrous manifestations of authority. Navigate a nightmarish bureaucracy as you piece together the dark truth behind your arrest.
You'll navigate a maze of early 20th century bureaucratic architecture while confronting corrupted officials like the cryptic Inspector and the ominous Magistrate.
Unravel a conspiracy that reaches far beyond your case, challenging your perception of justice and reality itself. Your investigation leads to one of three distinct endings as you face the brutal truth of your fate and the corruption that plagues this world.

title: Metrogether Train Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Metrogether is a train simulator where you drive, collect passengers, work together with friends and explore the subway network in a fictional city. Embark on your journey as a train driver or ticket inspector in single and multiplayer.
Drive Trains
Take control of a subway train, try to follow the timetable and collect passengers as you travel from station to station in this immersive subway simulation.
Explore the Subway Network
Immerse yourself in this fictional subway network, filled with tunnels, bustling stations, and hidden secrets.
Play as a Ticket Inspector
Step into the shoes of a vigilant ticket inspector, ensuring that passengers have valid tickets and deal with troublemakers during the journey.

title: Kalia
description:
게임 정보
                                               On Kalia, a once-promising planet, devastation is the indelible mark of a tragic past. A global catastrophe, triggered by a mysterious energy, extinguished an advanced civilization, leaving behind colossal ruins and obscure secrets.
In this desolate setting, Shaktini, a solitary and resilient miner, seeks resources to ensure her survival. Equipped with robotic implants, she ventures through the ruins of Maha Yuga Stambha, a place that holds the key to Kalia's past.
Her journey will lead her to unravel the mysteries of the energy that destroyed the ancient civilization and to face the dangers of a hostile world. Shaktini will count on the wisdom of the sage Maharishi, who will guide her in her search for answers.
On Kalia, time is implacable, the challenges are implacable, and the past is revealed in fragments. Shaktini will need to use all her intelligence, strength, and courage to survive and uncover the secrets of the lost civilization.
Game Features:
 Explore the colossal ruins of Maha Yuga Stambha, unraveling their hidden secrets and discovering the history of the lost civilization.

title: Make Your Choice
description:
게임 정보
Pick a theme and craft your own story by making branching choices that shape each unique adventure.
You'll be able to explore distinct themes, each offering a unique scenario:
Embark on a seven-year journey at a magic school, where you'll master your powers and unravel ancient mysteries
Lead a party of heroes on a rescue mission to save a lost prince
Establish and fortify an outpost in newly conquered territory, ensuring the prosperity and security of your ancient empire’s expansion
Features
Including a variety of unique themes and situations to start your journey from
Customize characters looks, abilities and backstories
Guide your story with meaningful choices that mold your characters and their world
Intuitive controls, game-play and interactions
Cute 3D art-style
Discover secret and hidden elements to personalize your creations
Be careful, as you shape your creations, they shape you

title: I Come In Peace
description:
게임 정보

Survive as a pacifist alien in a chaotic bullet hell!
Crash-landing on Earth was not part of the plan, and neither was the hostile welcome from its paranoid inhabitants. As a peaceful UFO pilot, you find yourself under attack from relentless mobs, police forces, the army, helicopters, and even a special boss level. But you're not defenseless—your advanced tech bracelet equips you with:
Shield Redirect: Deflect projectiles back at your enemies with an awesome shield.
Transparency Ability: Become intangible, allowing bullets to pass through you harmlessly.
Agile Maneuvers: Sprint and roll to dodge nonstop attacks.
Your mission is critical: find the 10 scattered screws needed to repair your spaceship and escape before it's too late. Every second counts in this adrenaline-pumping, rogue-like, skill-based game where quick reflexes are your best ally.
Can you survive the mayhem and return home? Survive, little alien... survive!

title: Floodlight
description:
게임 정보
Floodlight is a short horror game where you play as a broke college student who just moved into a crappy apartment, which should have been fine if it weren't for the massively bright light that gets turned on every night, directed straight at your apartment's window...
Featuring an immersive, atmospheric experience with photorealistic graphics, discover the truth about this mysterious apartment by exploring the environment around you. Talk to the neighbors to find out what is going on, but you may just end up with more questions than answers.

title: The Froglings
description:
게임 정보
Grow Your Civilization!
Build Houses for your froglings so that they can grow, Utilize them to help build other structures like tower defenses and simple resource gathering buildings!
Defend with defenses!
Take care though, as in the night a raid of robots will want to come and destroy everything you've built! Use the different tower defenses you unlock along the way and your hero to protect your new home and keep it safe from the evil robots.

Grow and prosper your frogling community!

title: Quodan: Treachery on the Arheid
description:
게임 정보
Captain John Will Smith is tasked with delivering the cargo aboard the spacecraft Arheid III to it's destination, however a spy on board tries to sabotage the mission. Captain Smith must find out who the traitor is before they strike again.
Quodan: Treachery on the Arheid is an interactive visual novel in which you must solve the mystery of who betrayed the crew thorugh interrogations and multiple different minigames.
THIS GAME FEATURES:
Put on your Detective Hat
To get to the bottom of this mystery you'll have to interrogate a variety of different characters in a pixel art style universe.
Minigames, Minigames, Minigames
Complete a variety of minigames that impact your relationship with the rest of the crew. 
Multiple Endings
Different choices you make could lead to a variety of outcomes. Discover all 7.

title: Collapsed Horizon
description:
게임 정보
Travel to planets
Travel the galaxy in search of planets rich in ores.
Explore and dig into the ground for valuable ores
Terraforms the planet and collects ores.
Sell ores
Remember that the company takes 30% of your earnings but that's the price you pay to return to Earth.
Buy new equipment
Jetpack, radar, sand vacuum, icebreaker, etc. Everything needed to optimize ore extraction.

title: Slice & Dice: Pizza Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보

마리오 미트볼은 항상 최고의 피자 가게를 만들고 싶어했고, 이제 예산에 맞는 곳을 찾았고, 그의 꿈이 현실이 되었습니다. 하지만 부동산이 그렇게 싸게 팔린 데에는 이유가 있습니다...
