Multiplayer Space Battle Game

title: Galactic Warship
description:
게임 정보
I always wanted to play an action game where I could take direct control of a capital ship in 3D space. Not fake 3D where you're on the same plane, actual 6-Axis Freedom of Movement. One day, I decided to make that game. As a solo developer, I poured two years into crafting Galactic Warship, letting you pilot massive capital-class warships in full 3D with complete 6-axis freedom. You'll unlock dozens of ships, each armed with powerful, customizable weapons, as you face waves of enemies and insane bosses from outside our reality.
Full Command of Capital-Class Warships: Finally, a game that puts the full weight of commanding these massive ships in your hands. Navigate, dodge, and engage in epic battles, with the freedom to move on all six axes.
A Growing Arsenal to Match the Threat: As you progress, you’ll gain access to an ever-expanding array of ships and weapons to suit your style. Progression is constant, every sector you complete unlocks a permanent upgrade that will help you on your next run.  
   
Infinite Replayability: No two runs will be the same, and I will be adding new missions, ships, and features with the help of player feedback.

title: Little TD
description:
게임 정보
There are several different game modes in this Tower Defense Strategy (TD), which can be completed in one go or with endless enemies - resist countless waves of enemies for as long as possible and complete missions!
Complete the storyline to earn rich rewards, and challenge stronger enemies to earn more rewards.
-Simple, optimized, small in size but fully functional.
-Having dozens of different levels and a large number of tasks - no endless hard work!
-A huge permanent upgrade tree (over 500 different studies).
-Completing hardcore tasks can lead to many achievements
-Detailed statistical data for each run
-Complete the storyline and unlock stronger challenge tasks
-No ads, everything can be unlocked for free!

title: Domino Clicker
description:
게임 정보
About

Domino Clicker is a simple clicker game where you can enjoy the thrill of toppling dominoes. With just a click, you can set up plenty of dominoes and revel in the mesmerizing cascade as they fall. It offers straightforward gameplay that anyone can enjoy, providing a calming experience for the mind.
Description
In Domino Clicker, players are immersed in the addictive world of domino toppling. With just a simple click, you can set up an array of dominoes and watch the mesmerizing chain reaction unfold before your eyes.
The game offers a captivating experience suitable for players of all ages, combining relaxation with engaging gameplay.

I'm a junior indie game developer working independently on this project. Your support by adding the game to your wishlist would be greatly appreciated. Feel free to share any feedback or questions you may have—I'm here to listen and improve the game based on your input.

title: Wonderland on Desktop
description:
게임 정보
The screen is big enough, why don’t we fully use it! Wonderland on Desktop will meet your idea! Doing multiple works while arranging your farmland!
3D experience!
Although it’s a tiny window, but there is full function illumination and day night cycle! 3D experience, use mouse wheel to change camera form 45’ angle to top down view. That’s incredible!
autokwd: Wonderland on Desktop,牧野之歌：桌面逸境

title: My Dear Can't Speak
description:
게임 정보
Main Story
After years of relentless effort, the protagonist finally achieves their lifelong dream. However, upon realizing this dream, they are overcome with a deep sense of emptiness and numbness. One day, while drowning their sorrows in alcohol, they come across a mysterious girl at the train station...
Gameplay
As the president of a software company, the protagonist is responsible for managing and operating the business. From software development plans to various employee affairs, every aspect is personally overseen by the protagonist.
Players are not only responsible for advancing the game's main storyline but can also freely explore various management and interactive gameplay elements to create a unique gaming experience.
Players take on the role of a company founder, responsible for operating and developing a software development company. By researching new software, recruiting and training employees, and optimizing budget management, they can help the company grow and enhance its market competitiveness. Players must allocate resources wisely, formulate development strategies, and ensure the company's steady progress.
The game features a shop where players can purchase various items. Using these items strategically can effectively advance the game.
Additionally, the game incorporates heartwarming interactions between the protagonist and his daughter. Players can arrange time to spend with her and participate in her growth journey. Different choices will influence the depth of their father-daughter relationship and may even alter the course of the story.
Players must find a balance between career and family, managing their company while maintaining a strong bond with their daughter, ultimately leading to different game endings.
Main Characters
autokwd: My Dear Can't Speak,私の娘は話すことができません

title: Impossible Moto Sim
description:
게임 정보
Impossible Moto Sim – Conquer the Sky on Two Wheels!
Welcome to the ultimate challenge for those who live and breathe motorcycles! This is not just a race—it’s a battle against gravity, speed, and fear itself. Imagine tearing through high-altitude tracks suspended 3,000 meters above sea level, with no barriers to save you. Every turn is a test of precision, every jump is a leap of faith, and every second pushes your adrenaline to the max.
Some say it’s impossible. Others wouldn’t dare. But do you have what it takes to master the impossible? One wrong move and it’s game over. Only those with steel nerves and blazing speed will cross the finish line in one piece.
🔥 Game Features:
🏍 3 High-Performance Sports Motorcycles – Choose your beast and take on the challenge.
🎮 A Huge Variety of Levels – Each more extreme than the last.
⚠️ Obstacles Everywhere – Every track is designed to test your skill and courage.
This is not just a race. It’s survival. Are you ready to face the ultimate two-wheel test?

title: Rope Raider
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a challenging adventure with Fredrick Twinkly. After a fateful misstep, Fredrick finds himself tumbling down a massive hole, breaking both legs and leaving him stranded in the depths of an ancient, mysterious world. Armed only with his trusty rope and an unyielding spirit, Fredrick must swing his way through the hazardous environment's to uncover the legendary Lost Treasure of the Twinkly Star, a relic tied to the legacy of his great-grandfather.
Gameplay Mechanics:
The game features a unique and precision-based rope-swinging system that will test your timing, patience, and skill. Each stage presents its own set of challenges and environmental hazards, requiring players to master the art of momentum and precision to progress.

title: Fruitgeddon
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for an intergalactic battle like no other! In this fast-paced space shooter with bullet hell action, you’ll face waves of adorable yet deadly mutant fruits threatening to destroy the universe. Only the most skilled players can dodge the chaos, shoot relentlessly, and uncover the dark truth behind the invasion.
Key Features
🚀 Intense Action – Shoot and dodge at high speed in a challenge where every second matters.
🍉 Unique Boss Battles – Each boss offers a different fight that will test your reflexes and strategy.
🌌 A Story with a Twist – Discover who's behind the chaos and prepare for a shocking revelation.
🎮 Hardcore Difficulty – If you love tough games and bullet hell challenges, this is your ultimate test.
🔫 Tight Controls – Master the art of dodging and shooting with smooth and addictive gameplay.
Are you ready to take on the mutant fruit invasion and save the universe? 🌠🔥

In Fruitgeddon, you don’t just survive the chaos – you shape it! Customize your weapons to match your playstyle: modify your shot type, adjust your firing angle, and create unique combinations to unleash maximum power against your enemies. In this world of fruity destruction, you decide how to fight. Do you prefer a barrage of projectiles or a precise, deadly shot? The choice is yours!

title: Misty's Super Golf Solitaire
description:
게임 정보
A Classical Journey with Misty!
Join Misty on his relaxing adventures across a nostalgic country side in Misty's Super Golf Solitaire. Blend strategy, luck, and breathtaking scenery in this fresh twist of a classic card game - Golf Solitaire.
What kind of game is it?
Misty's Super Golf Solitaire is a Golf Solitaire with deck-building elements.
Combine classic Golf Solitaire rules with special ability cards that you can buy to build a deck and clear more levels. Earn gold coins with each play. Play smart and do combos that will multiply the amount of gold you gain.  At the end of each round buy various cards with unique attributes such as wild cards, revivers, money bonus cards and scrap cards to help balance your deck. Each card has limited uses that shape your strategy. Every decision counts as you try to maintain your winning streak. Aim for the highest rank!
Classical Music and Landscapes:
Immerse yourself in Classical Music and landscapes inspired by the late 19th century and early 20th century that change with each level .

title: Lani's Call: A Tiny Whale Singer Story
description:
게임 정보
Lani's Call: A Tiny Whale Singer Story is a 10 min game experience where you can play with Lani, a playful humpback whale, who dives into action when an earthshaking event threatens her underwater home.



Glide Lani through vibrant coral reefs, dense seaweed jungles, and dark ocean depths.

Call out with Lani's voice to commune with other humpbacks.

Take advantage of Lani's massive size to rescue smaller creatures.
autokwd: Lani's Call: A Tiny Whale Singer Story

title: MERIDIAN
description:
게임 정보
MERIDIAN: 웰니스 VR 여정

MERIDIAN은 1시간 동안 지속되는 VR 체험으로, 여러분의 신체, 그 특성 및 한계를 탐구합니다. 원하는 각도로 가속, 감속 및 비행할 수 있습니다. 이 체험은 여러분의 신체를 뼈, 근육, 근막 사이의 연결망으로 바라보도록 장려하며, 움직임 패턴과 자세 습관을 이해하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 근육과 근막은 근육 체인 또는 근막 경락으로 연결되어 있습니다. 이 경락은 머리부터 발끝까지 뻗어 있어 신체의 다양한 부분을 연결합니다. 이 상호 연결성은 한 영역의 긴장이나 기능 장애가 멀리 떨어진 예기치 못한 영역에 영향을 미칠 수 있음을 의미합니다. 운동할 때, 단순히 고립된 근육만이 작동하는 것이 아니라, 뼈, 근육, 결합 조직이 협력하는 복잡한 시스템이 작동합니다.



VR에서 이 근육 체인을 탐구함으로써, 발광 플래시에 의해 안내를 받아 다양한 근육 그룹이 여러분의 움직임에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지에 대한 감각적이고 시각적인 정보를 얻게 됩니다. 이 체험을 충분히 지속하면, 시각과 감각이 결합되어 뇌에 각인되어 보다 고급스러운 언어로 신체와 소통할 수 있게 됩니다. 꾸준한 연습을 통해 폭풍 속에서도 내면의 평화를 찾게 될 것입니다. 깊게 숨을 들이쉬세요.



호흡은 하루 24시간 지속되는 일상입니다. 코와 횡격막뿐만 아니라, 신체 전체, 척추를 포함합니다. 여러분의 신체가 숨을 들이쉬고 내쉬는 방식을 관찰하고 배우며, 흉곽이 흐르는 방식을 관찰하고 이 과정이 근육 체인에 어떻게 관여하는지 알아보세요. 산소 공급은 폐뿐만 아니라 모든 세포에 영향을 미칩니다. 이 연습을 통해 이점을 얻으세요. 의식적인 산소 공급을 통해 운동 효율성을 높이는 길입니다. 슬라이드하는 방법을 배워보세요!



정적 근력 훈련 또는 등척성 운동은 관절 각도와 거리를 변경하지 않고 저항에 대해 정적 위치를 유지하는 것을 포함합니다. 이러한 운동은 근지구력, 안정성 및 근력을 향상시킵니다. 특히 코어 강화와 안정성, 자세 개선, 그리고 통제감 향상에 유익합니다. 이 연습을 통해 무의미한 노력을 이해하게 될 것입니다. 시간과 반복을 통해 개선과 성장을 보게 될 것입니다. 여러분이 얼마나 연결되어 있는지를 기억하세요.



MERIDIAN은 인간 웰니스에 대한 복잡한 접근 방식에 대한 나의 첫 시도입니다. 근육과 근막이 어떻게 협력하여 작동하는지에 대한 인식을 자극합니다. 상호 연결성. 여러분은 새로운 제어와 감각을 개발하게 될 것입니다. 어쩌면 여러분의 고통이 수수께끼로 변할지도 모릅니다.

출처:
조던 테리 "적응 가능한 극성"
토마스 마이어스 "해부학 트레인"

아름다운 가이드가 포함되어 있습니다.

title: Pungolo - A prickly adventure
description:
게임 정보
Pungolo: An Adventure Game like no other.

Pungolo is a unique adventure game that allows players to control Pungolo roots to move, jump, climb and explore.
The game takes place in a magical world where players must navigate through challenging levels, defeat enemies and discover hidden areas.

Gameplay

The gameplay in Pungolo is unlike any other adventure game.
Players control their roots using analog sticks or the keyboard to move around the levels, jump over obstacles, climb walls and explore their surroundings.
The game is set in a magical world filled with vibrant colors and hidden secrets.



As players progress through the game, they will encounter a variety of challenges that will test their skills and abilities.
From avoiding traps to defeating enemies, players must use their wits and quick reflexes to overcome the obstacles in their path.

Features

Pungolo has several features that make it stand out from other adventure games.
These include:

Unique gameplay: Players control their roots to move, jump, climb and explore
Beautiful graphics: The game is set in a magical world filled with vibrant colors and stunning visuals
Challenging levels: Players must navigate through a variety of challenging levels filled with obstacles and enemies

With its beautiful graphics, challenging levels, and unique gameplay, Pungolo is sure to captivate players of all ages.
So why wait? Grab your roots and explore the magical world of Pungolo today!

title: Harold Rabbit - Finder of Lost Things
description:
게임 정보
As a little rabbit, while reading the books of rabbit detective Flynn, Harold wanted nothing more than to become a rabbit detective himself!

And now, he is!
Together with his faithful sidekick, the bumblebee Maud, Harold will find anything that has been lost and misplaced.
But now, something has been stolen from Harold himself!  Will he be able to find out who did it, and why, and solve the mystery of ... the missing trumpet?

Find out in Harold Rabbit : Finder of Lost Things!
autokwd: Harold Rabbit - Finder of Lost Things

title: Politburo Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Politburo Simulator is a turn-based strategy game that puts you in charge of a fictional Communist country, Savlenko. As the General Secretary, your job is to manage your cabinet of Politburo members, make crucial decisions, and maintain control over your nation.

To stay in power, you'll need to navigate a complex web of political events. Each turn, you'll face new challenges—economic crises, internal power struggles, and international diplomacy. Your decisions will directly impact public unrest, resources, capital, and your favor with Moscow.

Key Features

Appoint and manage your Politburo team, each with their own traits, loyalties and ambitions.
Make decisions that affect the state and your political standing.
Experience a rich tapestry of events inspired by the Cold War era.
Manage resources to keep your regime stable over 50 years.
Balance the interests of the Politburo, the public, and the Soviet Union.
Use your intelligence operatives and the military to give you an extra edge.

Every choice you make will shape the future of Savlenko. Will you defend the Revolution, or will history take its course? The fate of your regime is in your hands.

title: Fungi Fantastico
description:
게임 정보
Fungi Fantastico는 버섯으로 가득한 생동감 넘치는 세계를 배경으로 한 재미있는 1인칭 플랫폼 어드벤처 게임입니다. 평화로운 계곡에서 독성 곰팡이 감염을 처리하는 자연 마법 지팡이를 휘두르는 드루이드가 되어 플레이하세요. 부패를 제거하고 새로운 기술을 배우기 위해 모험을 떠나세요. 버섯을 터뜨리고 세상을 이동하는 방식을 개발하세요. 자연 광선으로 땅에 있는 버섯을 터뜨리면 다양한 버프를 얻을 수 있고, 더 높이 움직이고 점프하여 환경을 더 빠르게 횡단할 수 있는 게임입니다. 이와 함께 움직임, 이중 점프, 대시 및 중력 제어를 향상시키는 기술을 습득하세요. 힘든 하루를 보낸 후 편안하게 휴식을 취할 수 있는 이 모험에서 게임 전용으로 제작된 다채로운 환경과 차분한 lofi/주변 음악이 여러분을 기다립니다. 곰팡이와 함께 탈출하세요, in Fungi Fantastico ~

title: Monday Morning Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Monday Morning Simulator is the much-anticipated sequel to Call Hating, the 2D point-and-click adventure game released in 2023.

In Monday Morning Simulator, you play the part of a worker-from-home who hasn't exactly kept up with modern technology. Your old, outdated, and half-broken home becomes one giant puzzle as you struggle to get your internet working and make it to an important online work meeting.

But fear not, you are accompanied by the benevolent Voice Inside Your Head, or VInYH, who serves as a helpful (and sometimes not-so-helpful) narrator in your quest for bandwidth.

Monday Morning Simulator is stocked with minigames and home maintenance-themed puzzles, including washing dishes, fixing plumbing, troubleshooting errors, remembering passwords and finding the right tools for the job around your home.

Will you overcome these challenges and make it through the automated phone system from hell to get your internet back from A.N.I.T.A. (AllNet InterCorp Technical Assistance) the evil A.I. who is out to thwart you at every turn?!

Coming 2024.

title: Farming Through The End
description:
게임 정보
좀비 아포칼립스가 끝없이 이어지는 세상에서 생존은 단순히 좀비와 싸우는 것만이 아닙니다. Farming Through The End에서 플레이어는 자원을 확보하고, 방어선을 구축하며, 전투를 치르는 일 외에도 죽어가는 세상에서 음식을 재배해야 하는 절박한 필요성을 조화롭게 다루어야 합니다. 문명은 붕괴했고, 도시는 좀비들에 의해 점령되었으며, 생존자들은 흩어졌습니다. 장기적인 생존을 위한 유일한 기회는 인류의 뿌리인 농업으로 돌아가는 것입니다.

당신은 혼자 남은 생존자 또는 혼란 속에서 작은 땅을 지키기 위해 고군분투하는 소규모 그룹으로 게임을 진행합니다. 좀비 무리는 계속해서 이동하고 있으며, 다른 생존자들은 동맹이 될 수도 있고 적이 될 수도 있습니다. 자원은 부족하고, 날씨는 예측할 수 없으며, 끊임없는 좀비의 위협은 당신을 극한으로 몰고 갈 것입니다.

작물을 재배하고, 가축을 돌보며, 임시 방어시설을 만들어 농장을 보호하세요. 밤이 되면 주의하세요: 좀비 무리는 생명 신호에 끌려 농장을 무자비하게 공격합니다. 땅을 요새화하고, 함정을 설치하며, 방어 시설이 밤을 견딜 수 있도록 하세요.

낮 동안에는 트럭을 몰고 황폐해진 세상을 탐험하며 자재와 귀중한 물자를 모을 수 있습니다. 버려진 도시, 숲, 폐품 야적장에서 희귀한 아이템을 찾아 농장을 업그레이드하고, 차량을 수리하고, 강력한 무기를 제작하세요. 그러나 조심해야 합니다. 이 탐험은 위험하며, 좀비나 경쟁 생존자들과 마주칠 수 있습니다.

생존자 그룹 간의 거래 경제도 활성화됩니다. 당신이 키운 작물을 다른 생존자 그룹에게 판매하고 더 나은 장비, 고급 무기 및 필수 자재를 교환할 수 있습니다. 농장을 강화하고, 방어 시설을 진화시키며, 생존을 위한 강력한 도구에 접근하세요. 안전한 자원 수집을 위해 트럭을 업그레이드할 것인지, 더 큰 무리를 막기 위해 농장을 요새화할 것인지 선택은 당신에게 달려 있습니다.

Farming Through The End에서 살아남고, 성장하고, 번영하세요. 좀비의 야간 공격에 맞서 싸우고, 동맹을 구축하며, 붕괴하는 세상에서 농장을 요새로 만드세요.

title: Qurtys
description:
게임 정보
In this world, you face countless opponents and must upgrade your inventory during each shopping phase to keep up with them.
Classes
There are four different types of themes, each played in a unique way. However, they all encourage you to play as many cards as possible. The power of animals helps you upgrade your equipment or generate long-term income.
Characters
Additionally, there are various characters, each with unique abilities to make your life easier.
Leaderboard
Fight your way to the top of the leaderboard and make a name for yourself.
Items
There are many different items, each with unique attributes. Combine them wisely in your inventory to achieve the best synergy.

title: President Coin
description:
게임 정보
Limited to 10,000,000 coins. 1,000,000 Golden coins, 3,000,000 Silver coins. 6,000,000 bronze coins. President Coin is a clicker game where you get a random coin between 2000 and 10000 clicks. Every coin is a valuable coin. Click through!

title: Breaking the Grip
description:
게임 정보
Dive into Terror with Breaking the Grip!
Breaking the Grip is an asymmetrical multiplayer game blending horror and strategy. Survivors and the Spirit engage in a psychological battle: one seeks to escape its grasp, while the other drags them into madness. Only teamwork, cunning, and nerves of steel will lead to victory.
Will you be the one to survive… or the shadow that hunts them to their last breath?
Game Rules
🔹 Roles:
Survivors: Their goal is to perform a ritual to weaken the Spirit and break free. They must collect key items, use their abilities wisely, and avoid succumbing to madness.
The Spirit: Its mission is to terrify and weaken Survivors until they are vulnerable enough to be eliminated. It uses supernatural abilities to manipulate and obstruct them.
🔹 Gameplay Phases:
1️⃣ Candle Collection
Survivors must explore the map and gather 5 candles scattered throughout the area.
2️⃣ Banishment Ritual
Once all candles are collected, Survivors must complete a ritual to weaken the Spirit.
3️⃣ Weapon of Deliverance
After the ritual, Survivors must retrieve the Celestial Dagger, the only weapon capable of killing the Spirit.
4️⃣ Final Confrontation
Survivors must strike the Spirit with the Celestial Dagger before it eliminates them all.
🔹 Abilities & Mechanics:
🟢 Survivors – Special Powers
Each Survivor has a unique ability:
Diversion Decoy: Forcefully teleports the Spirit to a fake point of interest.
Desperate Dash: A temporary sprint to escape danger.
Momentary Immunity: Grants brief resistance to the Spirit’s grasp.
Illuminator: Uses a special light to repel the Spirit.

title: Disclosures
description:
게임 정보
The player takes on the role of a video blogger as Luke harper, who loves to explore abandoned places. This time luke sets off to explore an old abandoned hospital in the midst of a deep forest, to capture exclusive footage for his viewers.
Rumor has it the hospital was somehow connected to a case of disappearances in that area.
Game Features:
realistic graphics!
Extremely immersive sound design - almost every sound was recorded specifically for this project!
Screamers and creepy atmosphere - the game has plenty!
Game genre: Horror, Walking simulator.
Made with Unreal Engine 5

title: Pushmania
description:
게임 정보
Pushmania is a well-crafted puzzle game that is designed as an experience to be played together. You can play the entire game on your own, unlocking all map collections to solve, exploring the story and conquering each logical challenge by yourself. However, you can also play with a friend in local co-op style.
Pushmania also includes a full-featured editor so you can design complex challenges, share them and play together.
The PUSHMANIA is scheduled for release April 2025, until then try the DEMO!
PUSHMANIA FEATURES
explore logical love letter to well crafted gameplay-first games from the past
a heartfelt story about two brothers made by real two brothers
meet familiar characters from other game worlds
has an inbuild editor capable of creating your own maps with the ability to share them with your friends
enjoy the game solo or with a friend playing together at the same machine
a great atmospheric soundtrack reflective of gameplay depth
inspired by our decades old game written in QBasic

title: Sector Unknown - Prologue
description:
게임 정보
Sector Unknown - Prologue is a free introductory version of the full-game Sector Unknown.
Sector Unknown - Prologue is an immersive isometric RPG that draws inspiration from classics like Fallout 2, Knights of the Old Republic, Fallout: New Vegas, as well as more modern titles such as Wasteland 3, Encased, Colony Ship, Trudograd, and Pathfinder: Kingmaker. Every decision, every nuance in character development has tangible consequences. Alongside combat, the game equally emphasizes alternative strategies for progression, inviting players to leverage their character's unique abilities to navigate through the narrative creatively and diplomatically.
Story
In Sector Unknown - Prologue, your saga begins as a prisoner aboard a transport ship from which you escape in a commandeered escape pod, crash-landing on Maku, a forsaken world veiled within a remote and uncharted region of space. This planet becomes the foundation of your odyssey as you convert it into a stronghold and base of operations. From there, you will set forth into space, exploring distinct worlds and locations, each teeming with its own factions and unique stories.
In your quest, you will confront the shadowy dealings of Star Frontier, the powerful trading corporation that once imprisoned you. Operating unchecked in the hidden 'null sector'—now absent from all official star charts—Star Frontier has established a tyrannical reign of terror and destruction. Your mission becomes to unite the sector's backwater and forsaken planets, through either force or diplomacy, and overthrow their oppressive rule once and for all.

title: Aggrolotls
description:
게임 정보
Aggrolotls is an arena roguelite from top-down perspective where you are playing as tiny axolotls and have to evolve into a swarm that can take on powerful creatures from the see. Level up and pick from Upgrades that make each round feel unique.
Killing enemies gives you experience, which you need to level up your swarm. As you defeat bosses, you will gain access to special upgrades that change the gameplay even more drastically. This allows you to discover different builds to overcome the challenges the sea has to offer.

title: Frog Bard
description:
게임 정보
Frog Bard is a short, poetic experience about finding inspiration in the world around you. Explore a simple forest and perform reflective ballads as you travel from inn to inn.
Drive through a procedurally generated forest to find sparks of inspiration. Select thoughtful themes for your songs to perform at an inn. Break even and continue your journey.
Please note that Frog Bard is a short (5-10 minutes) but re-playable experience.
This game features an original song.

title: Glow Journey
description:
게임 정보
Prepare to embark on a new journey, test your reflexes and climb the levels! In this fast-paced survival game, you control a glowing orb, navigating through a mysterious, ever-changing world filled with dangerous obstacles and relentless enemies.
🚀 A Thrilling and Evolving Challenge
Each level is a challenge to the exit portal, but reaching it won’t be easy! Collect XP orbs to level up and choose from three powerful upgrades, including passive boosts and unique spells to enhance your survival.
⚡ No Attacks, Only Pure Evasion
There’s no fighting back—only your skills and instincts will keep you alive! The further you go, the tougher the enemies, the trickier the paths, and the faster your decisions must be.

title: Bounty Off Road
description:
게임 정보
Bounty Off Road is inspired by early 2000s Offroading games. Put some relaxing music in the background, complete trails to earn money, customize and tune your vehicles for better performance, and ride together with people in massive open worlds. 

Immerse yourself in the world
3 Large Maps full of events are sure to give you plenty of open world to explore
 Enjoy your OffRoading by yourself or together

title: Fishing On My Desktop
description:
게임 정보
Feeling a bit bored at work? Come fishing!
Fishing On My Desktop is an idle fishing game that runs as a floating button on your desktop. Whether you’re working, studying, watching movies, or even playing other games, you can enjoy the fun of fishing at the same time!
Interesting Fishing Experience
Just a click to start fishing—no complex controls needed.
Fish in rivers, lakes, and oceans.
Collect over 100 different types of fish.
Unique rods and bait options.
Some unexpected catches: crabs, pearls, jellyfish, message bottles, and even treasure chests…
And
The cutest cat in the world.
3 story-driven NPCs.
Mysterious hidden fishing spots.

title: Underquest
description:
게임 정보
Underquest는 빠른 전투와 깊이 있는 인벤토리 관리가 특징인 판타지 로그라이트 어드벤처 게임입니다. 아이템을 수집하고 특별한 스킬로 합성하세요. 다양한 게임 만남이 있는 무작위 생성 던전을 탐험하세요. 장비와 수정자를 사용하여 영웅을 업그레이드하고 다양한 강력한 빌드를 만드세요.
계속 보충되는 재고 정리
인벤토리는 지속적으로 보충되므로 빠르게 해체하세요. 아이템을 서로 결합하거나, 전투에서 획득한 능력을 사용하거나, 영웅에게 갑옷을 장착하세요.
주점에서 캐릭터를 돕고 자신을 향상시키세요

title: Screaming In The Basement
description:
게임 정보
"We shouldn’t be here."
“Screaming In The Basement” is a psychological thriller from the first person, the game takes place in apartment. inspired by P.T.
Average time to complete the game: 120 minutes
WARNING:
Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

title: Cucu
description:
게임 정보
Unlock various skills and engage in intense battles with other players as you compete for survival. Combine different attributes and abilities to create your own unique combat style, and strategize to face increasingly powerful enemies. As stronger foes continue to appear, you'll need to grow stronger yourself to defeat them. This battle is not just about raw strength, but also about intelligence and strategy, making it a psychological challenge.
As the competition heats up, you'll have access to more skills and items, which will help you refine and perfect your combat style. By overcoming various challenges and battles within the game, you will continuously improve and prepare to face even tougher enemies. Strive to survive until the end and become the strongest player. Seize the opportunity to rise to the top by surviving until the very end, and prove your strength by defeating players from all over the world. In the endless battlefield, unleash your tactics and abilities, fighting with only victory in mind.

title: Moon Carrier
description:
게임 정보
In Moon Carrier, you will be doing cargo missions between bases and cities founded on the future moon. You can drive to anywhere you want, however, you are limited with the capabilities of your vehicle. Your oxygen tanks have limited capacity. Your vehicle has limited electrical capacity. Moreover, when you hit on the rocks which may appear in front of you suddenly, your vehicles condition decreases based on your hit velocity. Drive fast and you take risk of a sudden death, drive slower and you take risk of failing your missions for not delivering on time.

title: Card Artisan
description:
게임 정보
Become a card designer and create cards from scratch! From spells to minions, you can select and bring to life your perfect card including its attack and resistance, the effects, and even activation conditions and timing of their abilities!
Random generation & Roguelike elements
Every card in Card Artisan past your starter deck as well as every card in your enemies' decks is randomly generated. This in addition to a randomly generated map results in no two runs being the same!

title: BitRick's Venture
description:
게임 정보
BitRick's Venture is an action-roguelite with procedurally generated maps.
Can you make it through all the floors?
Content:
3 floors
3 weapons
3 bosses
Various enemies
39 items
Here's a quick summary of what the game is about:

title: Drones vs Tanks
description:
게임 정보
Multiplayer Clash of Tanks and FPV Drones
The clash of tanks and drones symbolizes the evolution of conflict, blending AI, agility, and advanced technology into a high-tech duel for dominance.
Engage in high-stakes multiplayer matches where two players go head-to-head. One controls a tank with a mission to reach its destination. The other pilots an FPV drone, aiming to destroy the tank before it completes its route. The round ends when the tank reaches the target or is eliminated. Players then switch roles. The first to win two rounds claims victory!
Choose Your Side in the Tech War
Join one of two factions:
West  East 
Key Features:
Tactical duels with role-switching mechanics.
Immersive FPV drone controls with a first-person perspective.
Rank progression from Private to Captain, with upgradeable equipment.
Modifications: dynamic armor, electronic countermeasures (ECM), and speed boosters for drones.
Unique strategies for each faction.
Will you lead your tank to victory or destroy it with the cutting-edge tactics of FPV drones? The choice is yours!

title: Arcade Jumper
description:
게임 정보
With simple controls, you try to master all the jumps and complete each level. If you don't manage a jump so well, you'll fall a long way behind, but maybe you'll make it the next time you try. The levels differ in length, difficulty, time pressure and the secrets you can find.
More information will follow.

title: Ferral Quest
description:
게임 정보
2D Pixel MMORPG Game
Playable in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, and French.
Multiplayer (Play solo, with friends, or against everyone). Open world with diverse biomes: forest, jungle, desert, snowy wasteland, and volcanic regions.
Plus, dozens of dungeons to explore and hidden secrets to uncover. Ranking PvP and Top Players. Clan system.
Features:
Open World PVE Quests and Special Dungeons: Embark on missions across the world and challenge unique dungeons.
Raid Bosses and Wanderers to Hunt: Scattered across the world for an epic challenge.
Progression from Tier 0 to Tier 10: Level up and unlock new tiers of power.
Skill Tree Development: Customize your character and make them truly unique.
Buffs and Equipment: Forge your battle strategy with a variety of buffs and gear options.
Defeat Mighty Dungeon Bosses for the Best Gear: Face legendary enemies and earn top-tier rewards.
Storyline:
Embark on a grand narrative adventure to discover who you were before rising as a skeleton and find a way to break your curse. Time is running out, as you risk losing your sanity and becoming part of the enslaved warrior army of the great necromancer, Ferral.
Highlights:
Simple and Intuitive Controls: With an accessible information panel that explains gameplay mechanics in detail.
Achievement Panels: Hunt down all the bosses in the game and complete your achievement panel 100%. You can also complete the mythical items panel. Ferral Quest won’t make it easy for you.
Collaboration with Streamers and Content Creators: Each streamer has chosen a Raid Boss as their champion representative. Hunt them all!
Side Quests Across the Open World: Help a merchant find lost items, mine resources while waves of subterranean creatures attack, or pray to the gods—they might bless you… or punish you by sending their troops to destroy you.

title: Incelthread
description:
게임 정보

guy is planning a meeting with his girlfriend to use their shared photos to prank board visitors with provocative posts.
They are both hikikomori who enjoy hanging out together, but circumstances prevent them from living together.
Having been traumatized by their past, they must go through a difficult journey of adapting to a new, still unfamiliar life.    

I don’t know their names. In general, I don’t know that much... But I’ll try to tell you something!

title: Space Menace 2
description:
게임 정보
Space Menace 2에서 은하는 혼란의 기로에 서 있으며, 당신의 선택이 그 운명을 결정합니다. 우주 함장으로서 작은 함대와 함께 시작하지만, 당신의 여정은 결코 평범하지 않습니다. 자유롭게 항로를 개척하며, 프리랜서 임무를 수행하고, 무역과 전투를 통해 함대를 확장하고 업그레이드하는 데 필요한 크레딧을 획득하세요.

권력으로의 상승
당신이 계급을 오를수록 위험도 함께 증가합니다. 처음에는 몇 척의 함선만 지휘하지만, 곧 강력한 함대를 지휘하며 은하계에서 가장 영향력 있는 세력들의 신뢰와 존경을 얻을 것입니다. 신중하게 세력을 선택하세요. 당신의 평판은 강력한 동맹과 치명적인 충돌의 문을 열어줄 것입니다. 하지만 권력을 쥐고 있는 동안, 정체불명의 세력에 대한 소문이 점점 커지며 모든 것을 뒤흔들 위협을 가하고 있습니다.
커스터마이징
Space Menace 2에서 커스터마이징은 매우 중요합니다. 다양한 무기, 장비, 전투기를 선택하여 당신의 전략에 맞는 완벽한 조합을 만들어 보세요. 또한, 모드 지원 기능을 통해 게임을 더욱 개인화하고, 새로운 콘텐츠와 가능성을 추가할 수 있습니다.

Space Menace 2는 최소한의 반복 작업으로 최대한의 전략적 재미를 제공하도록 설계되었습니다. 게임이 진행될수록 도전과 복잡성이 증가하여 매 순간 전술적 판단과 짜릿한 전투가 이어집니다. 적 함대를 능숙하게 제압하거나 강력한 동맹과 협상을 통해 은하계에서 당신만의 전설을 만들어 가십시오.

전략, 액션, 스토리텔링이 조화를 이루는 여정을 준비하고, 전쟁이 임박한 은하에서 최강자가 되기 위한 길을 개척하세요!

title: Septic
description:
게임 정보
Escape the sewer

Do you have what it takes to reach the top? In Septic, you are thrust into the depths of an underground sewer system. With its responsive controls and demanding jumps, this first-person platformer will test your agility and precision at every turn. Navigate through treacherous environments and aim to escape the murky depths.

Don't fall

A single misstep could lead to a devastating fall, costing you tons of progress. The stakes are high, and the margin for error is slim. Each jump must be perfectly timed and executed. Stay focused and don’t let the pressure get to you, or you might find yourself back at the bottom, starting all over again.


Septic challenges you to master its intricate mechanics. Every movement, from the simplest jump to the most complex maneuver, requires precision and skill. The responsive controls are designed to give you full command over your actions, allowing you to hone your abilities and achieve perfection. Practice makes perfect, and perfection is the key to survival.


Prepare yourself for an intense and unforgiving journey. Septic ramps up the difficulty as you progress, presenting you with relentless obstacles and increasingly complex levels. Your perseverance and determination will be tested like never before. Only the most resilient players will endure the challenge and emerge victorious.

title: Fantasy Gatekeeper
description:
게임 정보
Fantasy Gatekeeper is a fantasy simulation game where you take on the role of a city guard, responsible for inspecting adventurers seeking entry. Analyze their documents, search their belongings, and enforce ever-changing laws. Some will try to bribe you, others will attempt to deceive you, and a few may hold secrets that could alter the fate of the city.
Will you be a loyal enforcer of the law, a corrupt official, or someone who uncovers hidden truths? Every decision shapes your reputation, wealth, and the world around you.
Key Features:
Inspect and Judge: Examine adventurers' papers, belongings, and behavior to determine who enters the city.
Evolving Laws & Restrictions: New decrees and changing policies challenge your judgment each day.
Moral Dilemmas: Take bribes, confiscate items, or follow strict orders—your choices define your fate.
Deep Progression System: Earn gold and spend it to unlock tools, resources, and access to hidden knowledge.
Uncover Secrets: Discover hidden conspiracies, forbidden artifacts, and the true power struggles within the city.
Hold the gates. Make your choice. Shape the city's future.

title: Zombie Town Breakout
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Zombie Town Breakout, an intense top-down survival action game where you must lead survivors through a town overrun by zombies. For survival, for hope—pick up your weapons and break through the hordes!
Once a thriving town, now a playground for the undead. As one of the few survivors, you must take charge and seek hope in this desolate wasteland. The intuitive top-down perspective lets you command the battlefield effortlessly, whether slashing through enemies with cold steel or switching to blazing firearms for ranged combat—all delivering exhilarating action.
Venture into dangerous ruins to scavenge supplies and powerful weapons to boost your survival chances. Most importantly, you’re not alone! Along your journey, you’ll encounter other survivors with unique skills. Recruit them to strengthen your team and gain unexpected advantages. Expand your squad, upgrade gear, and survive the relentless zombie onslaught.
Zombie Town Breakout features meticulously designed levels, including exploration maps full of unknowns and strategic stronghold defense challenges. In exploration missions, delve into zombie territories to rescue survivors and gather resources. In defense missions, withstand waves of frenzied attacks—strategize formations, utilize terrain, and protect your survivors at all costs.
Core Features:
Seamless Weapon Switching: Flexibly alternate between melee weapons and ranged firearms to tackle diverse zombie threats and forge your combat style. Recruit Unique Survivors: Discover skilled survivors in the ruins and build a formidable team.

title: Slippy Bear
description:
게임 정보
Newton said
Things don't move on their own.
I thought
The same applies to bears.
Slippy Bear is a game that shows the physical law of inertia through mouse controls. The cute bear in the game sometimes follows inertia, sometimes fights against it, and moves forward.
Finding
Inertia in the laws of physics.
Newton who found it.
And bear.
Challenge
Get past the tricks and traps set up in each level.
With bear.
And sometimes with frogs too.
Growth
While playing the game, you will notice on your own.
Wait... am I getting better at this game?
It's not a joy that someone gives you. It's a joy that you discover yourself.
There are 45 stages in total.
If everything goes smoothly, you can complete the game in about 3 hours.

title: Pupupu
description:
게임 정보
Pupupu is a relaxing casual puzzle game about collecting mushrooms and filling the basket. Nothing more, nothing less. Take a break from the complications of your everyday life and just collect some mushrooms. There is no plot, no challenges, no DLC or paid content, no RPG elements or leaderboards. Just mushrooms.

This game was made for my girlfriend so she could feel less anxious and have a little bit of fun. Play it yourself, or give it to any sad overwhelmed person in your vicinity. And take care.

title: Pantry Raid
description:
게임 정보
Pantry Raid is a rogue lite dungeon-crawler with cooking elements. Players traverse the pantry, defeating food-themed enemies to make meals to improve your character during the course of the game.
Featuring:
High-energy combat where quick reflexes and sharp strategy are key. With dynamic enemies, fluid movement, and ever-changing buff combinations, every battle is a thrilling test of skill. Dodge, strike, and adapt in the heat of the pantry.
Randomized levels and dynamic buff combinations, ensuring no two playthroughs are ever the same. Adapt to shifting strategies as new buffs reshape your play-style.
Each buff ties to a flavorful element—like Spicy for fire attacks or Salty for ice defenses—leading to unexpected synergies. Adapt, experiment, and master these dynamic power-ups to dominate the pantry!
An adorable crew of cooking critters!

title: Lumberjacked
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to LumberJacked, a 3D incremental clicker game that takes place deep in a mysterious forest.
Chop trees, collect the logs, and toss them into the chipper to earn cash. Use your earnings to upgrade your strength and efficiency, or sharpen your axe allowing you to cut down increasingly tougher and more valuable trees.
Tunnel through trees to uncover the story, discover loot, and meet the locals who’ll trade tools for a price.
Destiny calls, do you embrace it, or defy it?
Features:
Be the Lumberjack: Chop down trees, and harvest them in the chipper to earn money.
Pump Some Iron: Upgrade your core stats to increase your efficiency
Hit the Grindstone: Sharpen your axe to improve its effectiveness against harder and more valuable trees
Treasures - Find various treasures and other discoverables to earn extra loot and tools.
Gnomes - Deal with gnomes who are ready to help you, for a fee.
Uncover the Mystery: Seek out the scattered story of the forest to discover your purpose in it.
Determine Your Destiny: Follow the clues and work with gnomes to uncover your story, and accept or deny your destiny through multiple endings.
Replayability: Play the game a second time to unlock purchasable skins & Golden Maple currency, uncover all secrets, and experience the second ending.
company: Inner Realm Studios, Dumb Duck Games

title: Stack & Sort Pals
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Stack & Sort Pals, a delightful and brain-teasing puzzle game where logic and strategy lead to victory! Your mission is simple yet challenging: sort and stack colorful blocks, each representing a cute animal, into perfectly organized columns. But beware—every move counts!
How to Play:
🐾 Drag & Drop – Move blocks around and stack them by color.
🧠 Plan Your Moves – Think ahead to avoid getting stuck and clear the board efficiently.
🌈 Solve the Puzzle – Organize every column so each one contains a single color.
Key Features:
✔ Hundreds of Puzzles – From easy warm-ups to mind-bending challenges!
✔ Adorable Blocky Friends – Meet charming animals with unique personalities.
✔ Relaxing Yet Addictive – Simple to pick up but hard to master!
✔ No Time Limits – Enjoy stress-free puzzle-solving at your own pace.
✔ Colorful & Engaging Design – A visually appealing world full of fun and charm.
Think you have what it takes to master the art of sorting? Test your skills and become the ultimate stacking champion in Stack & Sort Pals! 🏆🐶🐱

title: 101 Cats Hidden in Shenzhen
description:
게임 정보
✍️ 선전에 숨겨진 101마리의 고양이는 손으로 만든 아름다운 풍경 속에서 숨겨진 고양이를 찾는 데 도전합니다.

🎵 검색하는 동안 평화롭고 몰입도 높은 사운드트랙을 즐겨보세요.

😸 수많은 성과를 달성하세요.

🏆 친구들에게 최단 시간 내에 고양이를 모두 찾아보도록 도전해보세요! ⏱️
게임플레이:
🐾 하나의 풍경에 숨겨진 101마리의 고양이.
👉 찾은 고양이를 클릭하세요.
🙌 눈이 피로해지지 않도록 밝기를 조절해보세요.
🔎 놀라운 줌!

😺🐾🐈 😻

title: Dungellion
description:
게임 정보

Rogue-lite with elements of Battle Royale and Action-RPG, inspired by roguelikes such as The Binding of Isaac, Enter the Gungeon, Nuclear Throne. Fight against other players in randomly generated dungeons and find a lot of unique abilities! Become the only one who survived and go to the next stage with all your loot, where you will battle with the winners of other arenas. The number of stages is not limited, but the farther away - the more deadly you are and your opponents. How long can you survive?
Features:
Every man for himself until the last survivor. Arenas up to 4 players.
A lot of abilities that significantly affect your game and tactics. Find the rarest and create unsurpassed synergy.
Randomly generated dungeons and loot. Each new game is unique.
Rewards for the victory. Unlock new characters, skins, and weapons. The farther you go, the more valuable the reward will be.

title: Progress Racer RPG
description:
게임 정보
이동 거리가 곧 재화입니다
앞으로 자동 운전하고 킬로미터를 쌓아 올린 다음 이를 사용하여 차량을 업그레이드하세요. 더 많이 운전할수록 속도는 더 빨라져 더 먼 곳으로 신속하게 이동할 수 있습니다.
선호하는 빌드를 선택하세요
직접 조작을 통해 앞길에 놓인 장애물을 피하거나 장갑을 사용해 억지로 길을 뚫고 나아가세요. 업그레이드를 선택하여 부스트를 결합하거나 완전히 자동화하세요. 활동적인 플레이 스타일을 선호하든 편안하게 앉아서 휴식을 취하든 즐길 수 있는 빌드가 준비되어 있습니다.
기하급수적인 업그레이드 강화
다양한 업그레이드를 스크롤 한 후 강화할 업그레이드를 결정하여 동력, 지속력, 효율성 등을 개선하세요. 비밀을 더 많이 밝혀낼수록 그 이상으로 업그레이드를 촉진할 수 있습니다.

title: Super Silent Sensei
description:
게임 정보
Master the art of stealth in Super Silent Sensei, a fast-paced, casual stealth game where precision and cunning are key. Step into the role of a legendary ninja on a mission to rescue elusive aliens scattered across the military compound Zone 52 without ever being captured.

Stay hidden, stay silent, and use your environment to outsmart patrolling enemies and traps, you only have one 

Get all aliens and make a run for the escape point!

Only the most disciplined Sensei will succeed.

title: Georgie-Yolkie 64 - The Furry Tale
description:
게임 정보
Let's tell an old tale anew, and go back to the good ol' days of gaming with a new classic, hack and slash adventure. Upgrade Georgie & Yolkie's abilities and travel across 17 lovely lands and save Princess Tabitha from the clutches of the evil King Rattie! Lots of addictive swordplay and fun here!
Embark on a thrilling adventure across 17 immersive 3D levels! Battle scary Lions, Minions, Witches, Dragons, and the wicked King Rattie who has kidnapped Princess Tabitha and using her power for his own! Collect gold and fish, upgrade weapons, and use powerful items to become an unstoppable feline and bird duo!
Key Features
Dynamic Combat: Face clever, strategic enemies with fluid battle mechanics.
10+ Unique Foes: Challenge a variety of fierce opponents.
Character Customization: Personalize Georgie's gear and obtain upgrades
Bonus Challenges: Unlock all new stuff!
Replayability: Replay any level from the World Map and find alternative paths and hidden things!
Retro Style Polygons, effects, charming atmosphere and a return to great music!
Well scripted and dynamic boss fights!
Catch all the sheep that annoy you and force you to find new ways to continue on your way, push objects to make new platforms and avoid their pitfalls!

title: 31 Room
description:
게임 정보
31 Room is a shooter puzzle game that challenges your brain and also your reflexes. Combining physics-based mechanics and strategic mind, the game gives you a fulfilling combination of problem-solving and skill.

Unravel the mystery between the AI (you) and the developers' creators (Nawaf & Mohammed) behind the developers. As you proceed, you get new tools with more complexity in puzzles along with more rewards for solving them.

Designed for two players only, 31 Room is a co-op game—you can't play by alone. Play with a buddy or drop into a random lobby to get through the challenges as a team. (In-game voice chat isn't supported.)

title: Bleeding Deities
description:
게임 정보
Key Features
Classic side-scrolling adventure with modern solutions. Experience the nostalgia of a classic platformer with a modern twist.
Face formidable foes in epic boss battles that test your skill and strategy, offering a rewarding challenge and progression.
Gather blood of your enemies to upgrade your equipment, enhancing strength and resilience.
Equip powers gained from defeated deities, use them in combat and reach previously unreachable areas
Navigate a nonlinear world at your own pace, unlocking areas and secrets that shape the unfolding narrative.
Solve puzzles throughout the adventure, testing your problem-solving skills and unlocking new pathways.

title: GnollHack
description:
게임 정보
About
GnollHack is a remastered and enhanced version of the classic roguelike game NetHack, one of the most iconic games developed in 1980s and 1990s. With GnollHack, you get:
Traditional roguelike with turn-based gameplay
Modern user interface
Legendary strategic depth of NetHack
Endless replayability
Several new features, enhancing your gameplay experience
Story
In GnollHack, you are a hero sent by your deity into the perilous Dungeons of Doom, tasked with recovering the stolen Amulet of Yendor from the clutches of the malevolent god Moloch, who has hidden it in the fiery depths of the underworld. Along your journey, you will encounter formidable enemies, discover great magical artifacts, and strive for glory. You must either triumph or perish in the attempt.
Roguelike Gameplay
Explore procedurally generated dungeons filled with monsters, traps, and treasures.
Rich Class and Race System
13 classes: wizard, barbarian, rogue, etc.
5 races: human, elf, gnoll, etc.
Deep Item and Magic System
Hundreds of items, spells, and artifacts with diverse effects.
Challenging Permadeath
(Classic Mode Only)
Death is permanent, requiring players to adapt, plan, and learn from mistakes to progress further.

title: Threats To Humanity
description:
게임 정보
Threats to Humanity: 
Defend Sacramento from an alien invasion!
In this action-packed arcade-style tower defense demo, you are humanity's last hope against waves of alien invaders, rogue robots, and devastating meteors!
Features:
Intense Levels: Battle through challenging levels set in iconic Sacramento locations.
Powerful Turrets: Deploy a variety of turrets, each with unique strengths and upgrade paths.
Epic Boss Battles: Face off against challenging mini-bosses that will test your skills.
Upgrade System: Upgrade your turrets and unlock new abilities to enhance your defenses.
Arcade Action: Experience fast-paced, addictive gameplay with vibrant visuals and explosive sound effects.

title: I met an Archaeologist
description:
게임 정보
Someone strange has entered your office. They offer you historical objects which can fulfil your darkest desires. However, you must answer their questions first. Three wrong answers and it can cost you more than you bargained for. Do you accept?
Features
Inspect the objects and make deductions

title: KINTSUGI - A Journey Through The Broken Pieces
description:
게임 정보
KINTSUGI는 중세 일본의 도자기 수리 예술에서 영감을 받은 게임으로, 금으로 균열을 장식적인 요소로 변환하여 그 아름다움을 강조합니다.
목표는 3D 퍼즐처럼 조각을 사용하여 깨진 용기를 조립하는 것입니다. 이 과정은 단순히 물건의 완전성을 복원하는 것뿐만 아니라, 불완전함, 무상함, 그리고 과거의 흔적을 아름다움과 가치의 원천으로 여기는 Kintsugi 철학을 반영합니다.

이 철학은 완성된 프로젝트가 재탄생의 상징임을 보여줍니다. 수리된 물체는 새로운 독창성과 이전에는 없었던 이야기를 얻게 됩니다. 이는 우리의 삶의 경험을 되돌아보도록 장려하며, 어려움과 변화가 우리를 약화시키는 대신 우리의 성장을 위한 기반이 될 수 있음을 보여줍니다. 또한 어려운 변화를 겪은 것에서도 아름다움을 발견할 수 있음을 증명합니다.

게임에는 현재 4개의 무작위로 선택된 위치가 있으며, 이곳에 항아리를 조립하기 위한 테이블이 놓여 있습니다(추후 더 추가될 수 있음).
autokwd: KINTSUGI - A Journey Through The Broken Pieces

title: Shadows of Wyrmwood
description:
게임 정보
Shadows of Wyrmwood is a roguelike adventure RPG where every encounter can be life or death. Use spells, swords, and strategy to defeat every cursed foe blocking you from saving Wyrmwood. Adventure across four procedurally generated maps that grow harder and harder with every encounter. With each victory, you obtain new armor, weapons, and spells from defeated enemies. Adapt, survive, and overcome every challenge across the land to save all who have been corrupted.  Do you have what it takes to be the Hero?

title: It Takes a Village
description:
게임 정보
It Takes a Village is a city-building RPG with a procedurally generated world inspired by Legend of Zelda and Animal Crossing. Gather resources, build your village, manage diverse villagers, craft weapons and armor, and explore a dynamic world—from lush forests with temples to mountainous tundras with caves and gems. Shape your village's destiny in this immersive adventure.
Explore a unique and changing world
Embark on an epic journey in It Takes a Village across diverse and procedurally generated biomes like deserts, tundras, and forests. Encounter unique enemies and explore intriguing places like caves, graveyards, bandit camps, and elaborate mazes. Gather resources to build and fortify your village and equip yourself to take on bigger and stronger foes.
Build and customize your village
Unleash your creativity in "It Takes a Village" as you personalize every detail of your village. With an extensive array of buildings, furniture, and cosmetics, transform your village into a living tribute to the countless adventures beyond its walls. Dive into the details by customizing pub atmospheres, workshop layouts, and even your own cozy personal house. Your village is a canvas—craft a unique haven that echoes the tales of your extraordinary adventures.

title: Signal Creek
description:
게임 정보
Held captive by the abandoned Signal Creek Shopping Mall, Nour and her companions must come to terms with their deepest regrets or lose themselves to the Void.
Signal Creek is narrative-driven RPG set in a surreal pixel art world. Playing as Nour, you will guide your companions through a journey of reconciliation as you all search for a way to escape.
Explore an abandoned mall
You, along with your younger brother's best friend and your professional mentor, are trapped in a place that should no longer exist. Search the third floor of the mall to find objects and characters that may hold the keys to your escape.
Reconcile with past mistakes
Help Nick through his growing pains, Ms. Gaw deal with old friends, and you yourself face a friendship gone sour as you reveal elements of your pasts that have somehow manifested.
Find the missing apple prince...?
Discover three old (or new?) stores that house a colorful cast of NPCs, including a glitchy store manager, a troupe of apple royalty, and some guy named Tim who wears shoes on his hands.

title: Forest 6174
description:
게임 정보
Forest 6174
1인칭 심리 공포 단편 경험
스토리
당신은 대니(Danny)입니다. 그는 특별한 존재입니다.
대니는 협조적입니다. 대니는 규칙을 따릅니다.
아무리 힘들어도, 대니는 항상 미소를 짓습니다.
그러나 어느 날, 대니는 호출됩니다.
승진도 아니고, 질책도 아닙니다.
그저 휴가를 받기 위해서입니다. 일상에서 벗어날 시간을 갖기 위해서입니다.
이제 대니는 어둠이 깔린 숲 속에 갇혀 있습니다.
그곳에서 그는 현실을 벗어난 듯한 기이한 사건들을 마주하게 됩니다.
탈출하기 위해서는, 이곳 깊숙이 숨겨진 비밀을 밝혀내야 합니다.
게임 플레이
Forest 6174는 1인칭 심리 공포와 분위기 중심의 공포 요소를 결합한 몰입감 넘치는 경험을 제공합니다.
불길한 환경을 탐험하며, 게임을 진행하면서 이야기를 구성하는 단서를 발견하세요.

title: Really Simple Golf
description:
게임 정보

Really Simple Golf is a climbing platformer golf, that blends chill vibes with precision driven adventure. Embark on an adventure across vibrant courses, mastering tricky shoots, navigating obstacles, and sinking those perfect putts.

⛳ Looking for a relaxing round? Take your time, enjoy the scenery, and perfect your "swing". Every obstacle offers a unique challenge, perfect for unwinding after a long day.

⛳ Feeling the need for speed? The mechanics of the game allows you to speedrun all the levels. I am very curious about that :D

⛳ Please help me by adding the game to your wishlist! The more people add the game to their wishlists, the greater the chance that Steam will show it to more people.

⛳ Your feedback shapes the game! I am constantly working to improve the experience, and your feedback is everything to me. Share your thoughts about the game wherever you want. On Steam, Reddit, Discord, X, call me, send a carrier pigeon... you get my point. 😅

⛳ Join the community and have fun!













⛳



⛳



⛳



It's just .

title: Green Thing From The Planet Jupiter
description:
게임 정보
Green Thing from the Planet Jupiter is a fast-paced two-player competitive chase game where players take on the roles of Cannoli, a crafty housecat, and Green Thing, a stranded alien engineer. Cartoonish chaos meets strategic gameplay as Green Thing scavenges parts from around the house to repair his UFO while avoiding Cannoli and his traps.

title: Dream Shark - Pt. 1
description:
게임 정보
When an escapist child’s VR mask breaks, he begins to have intense nightmares. He must learn presence through his dream characters to face the shadowy beast he runs from.
Play as TAC, a cyborg cyclops child living on the moon in the year 2300. TAC racks up points in virtual reality and explores the futuristic moonscape with a jetpack to avoid the struggles of family life. But when his routine is disrupted, he’s pulled into a journey deep within his subconscious.
Enter TAC’s dreamscape—a lush crystal island inhabited by an advanced society of axolotls. Solve puzzles, challenges, and hidden mysteries to unlock mini-games and extras, helping TAC become lucid and take control of his dream - but beware, the Dream Shark is always lurking.

A Fully Original Chiptune Soundtrack – Immerse yourself in a dynamic score that adapts to TAC’s journey.
Cinematic 8-Bit Pixel Art – A richly detailed retro aesthetic, handcrafted for an authentic Game Boy experience.

title: Void Collector
description:
게임 정보
Void Collector is a speedrunning FPS with a unique weapon-switching system, focusing on tightly designed stages that can be replayed over and over again to get faster and faster.
USE A LARGE ARSENAL OF WEAPONRY
Utilize a variety of powerful weapons with many different effects. From a powerful, knockback-inducing shotgun, to an uppercut that sends you and your opponents soaring, to a middle finger that fires an immensely powerful laser, there's an ideal weapon for any situation.
MASTER THE SYSTEM
Press 1-5 on the keyboard to toggle each finger of your hand on or off. This adds a layer of difficulty that allows for a ton of deep skill expression and clever tactics.
FIGHT A TON OF ENEMIES
Blast through a wide array of enemies. From the projectile-shooting Gunther to the bomb-placing Steve Strike, these guys are sure to keep you on your toes at all times!
MANAGE YOUR RESOURCES
Attacking drains your JUICE meter, but defeating enemies gets some back! There's also a combo system, which rewards skillful play with more Juice to use so that you can pull off impressive skips! But be careful, playing too recklessly will leave you open to attack!
BECOME A VOID MASTER
Each stage has a target time to beat to test the most skilled players in their weapon-swapping and rapid movement abilities! Void Collector focuses on a high skill-ceiling to ensure it's fun to play and replay over and over again!
COLLECT DOODADS
Each main stage has a hidden piece of 'memorabilia' to collect. Find them all to understand the history of the mysterious Void Collector and those who hunt it!
ANYONE CAN PLAY
This demo includes multiple difficulties to give some breathing room to new players and truly challenge seasoned veterans. Also included is an accessibility control scheme, ensuring that anyone can enjoy!
The game sports a loose, wobbly artstyle with a jazzy soundtrack to match.

title: Pioneer Racing
description:
게임 정보
In Pioneer Racing, the goal is simple: be the best driver! You start with a slow car, and as you win races against Bots, you unlock new cars! Your best lap times are saved, for you to beat them. After a race, you can relax by driving around the map, or customize your car.

This game is still in development, and it has a lot of niew things planned:
-multiplayer, to race against each other, or drive in the same car
-New circuits, with better visuals
-New garage, with more customization to all cars
-New cars, designed with every little detail
-UI update, to match a futuristic look and game design direction
-More instinctive controls, and UI accessibility
-Fix of bugs, like looking around with the mouse
... and much more! Feel free to tell me, for example on my youtube channel, anything you would like to be in the game!
As I'm alone on this game and I try to do everything by myself, updates may take time to come. You can expect one thing to be added each month or less.

Inspect the objects and make deductions

title: KINTSUGI - A Journey Through The Broken Pieces
description:
게임 정보
KINTSUGI는 중세 일본의 도자기 수리 예술에서 영감을 받은 게임으로, 금으로 균열을 장식적인 요소로 변환하여 그 아름다움을 강조합니다.
목표는 3D 퍼즐처럼 조각을 사용하여 깨진 용기를 조립하는 것입니다. 이 과정은 단순히 물건의 완전성을 복원하는 것뿐만 아니라, 불완전함, 무상함, 그리고 과거의 흔적을 아름다움과 가치의 원천으로 여기는 Kintsugi 철학을 반영합니다.

이 철학은 완성된 프로젝트가 재탄생의 상징임을 보여줍니다. 수리된 물체는 새로운 독창성과 이전에는 없었던 이야기를 얻게 됩니다. 이는 우리의 삶의 경험을 되돌아보도록 장려하며, 어려움과 변화가 우리를 약화시키는 대신 우리의 성장을 위한 기반이 될 수 있음을 보여줍니다. 또한 어려운 변화를 겪은 것에서도 아름다움을 발견할 수 있음을 증명합니다.

게임에는 현재 4개의 무작위로 선택된 위치가 있으며, 이곳에 항아리를 조립하기 위한 테이블이 놓여 있습니다(추후 더 추가될 수 있음).

PAKO 4 is an atmospheric and violent indie action game where the player causes chaos in a big city by committing various crimes with his accomplice and escaping the police. The game is shot from a third-person view and you can move around the city on foot or by car. Fast paced arcade mechanics from Pako 2 meet more in depth missions varying from escorting people to doing all kinds of hi-jinx around the North Paw area! Come and enjoy the old school feel of doing crimes!

title: Bear vs. Wolf Jigsaw Puzzle
description:
게임 정보
Step into the wild with "Bear vs. Wolf Jigsaw Puzzle"—a captivating puzzle game that lets you piece together stunning images of nature’s most formidable predators. Whether you prefer the raw power of a grizzly bear or the cunning intensity of a wolf, enjoy a relaxing yet engaging puzzle experience set against breathtaking wilderness landscapes.
From simple 30-piece puzzles to intricate 285-piece challenges, tailor your gameplay to your skill level and immerse yourself in vivid depictions of bears and wolves in their natural habitats.
Features:
🐻 Epic Wildlife Scenes – Assemble striking images of bears and wolves in forests, mountains, and snowy tundras.
🧩 Multiple Difficulty Levels – Choose between 30 to 285-piece puzzles for a casual or challenging experience.
🎨 Stunning Realistic Artwork – High-quality visuals bring these majestic animals to life.
🎵 Relaxing & Immersive Gameplay – No timers, no pressure—just pure puzzle-solving enjoyment.
"Bear vs. Wolf Jigsaw Puzzle" is a simple yet mesmerizing game designed for puzzle lovers and wildlife enthusiasts. Whether you want a quick mental escape or a deep, challenging puzzle session, enjoy the thrill of assembling nature’s fiercest rivals, one piece at a time!

title: Pioneer Racing
description:
게임 정보
In Pioneer Racing, the goal is simple: be the best driver! You start with a slow car, and as you win races against Bots, you unlock new cars! Your best lap times are saved, for you to beat them. After a race, you can relax by driving around the map, or customize your car.

This game is still in development, and it has a lot of niew things planned:
-multiplayer, to race against each other, or drive in the same car
-New circuits, with better visuals
-New garage, with more customization to all cars
-New cars, designed with every little detail
-UI update, to match a futuristic look and game design direction
-More instinctive controls, and UI accessibility
-Fix of bugs, like looking around with the mouse
... and much more! Feel free to tell me, for example on my youtube channel, anything you would like to be in the game!
As I'm alone on this game and I try to do everything by myself, updates may take time to come. You can expect one thing to be added each month or less.

title: BlackNoise: Shutdown
description:
게임 정보
In the post-pandemic world of 2020, Mexico faced a harsh reality: the lack of preparation for a global biological crisis. In response to this threat, the government created two pioneering entities: SEGMED (Medical Security Brigade), an elite force designed to contain biological outbreaks, and SIT (Technological Innovation Secretariat), tasked with developing groundbreaking advancements to revolutionize quality of life.
Together, these institutions introduced a radical solution: NervoLink, a revolutionary biomedical implant designed to strengthen the human body against diseases, eradicate disabilities, and optimize health. This device, integrated directly into the nervous system, promised to transform humanity, turning bodies into biological fortresses.
After a decade of research and testing, in 2031, the government of Chihuahua took the first step toward the future, mandating the use of NervoLink throughout Ciudad Juárez. Although skepticism initially ran high, the positive results quickly won over the population. By the end of the year, every resident carried a NervoLink under their skin.
But something went wrong.
Two years later, a massive meteorite crashes into the desert near Ciudad Juárez. The collision unleashes a devastating shockwave, destroying electrical infrastructure and leaving the city in ruins. Fragments of the meteorite are scattered across the region, but the true catastrophe begins when the shockwave impacts the NervoLink implants.
For most inhabitants, the implants suffer catastrophic failures, damaging their vital systems. Thousands are left paralyzed, unconscious, or dead. Yet some experience unpredictable mutations: their bodies react abnormally to the NervoLink’s materials, transforming them into something else... something inhuman.

title: OH？ME
description:
게임 정보
"Wipe the Tomb and Wait – OH?ME" – A journey to find yourself in a maze where memory and reality intertwine.
When familiar streets and alleys fragment, and the past merges with the present, you’ll wander through a space that feels both unreal and real.
This is a pixel-art puzzle game about growth, memories, and farewells. You play as a ghost, suspended between reality and recollection, exploring the houses, streets, and unsaid words from your past. The maze-like map is filled with traces of your childhood, and objects and scenes serve as vessels for time. Hidden clues guide you toward different endings.
You may walk steadily into the future, find warmth in memories, or lose yourself in the cracks of time… but no matter the path, the journey’s end depends on your choices.
"The past is never finished, and the future has yet to begin." – Are you ready to set out?

title: Mazer
description:
게임 정보
Mazer is a puzzle game where you have to find a way through a maze while following rules of every element you encounter. With 150 handcrafted puzzles of varying difficulty, each level will test your logic to its limits!
How to Play?
🧩 Find a path through the maze while obeying the rules of stars, shapes, geometric figures, and other elements.
🌟 Each element has its own unique behavior – find out how they interact to solve the puzzle!
💡Learn the game through a dedicated in-game "How to play?" tutorial and starter puzzles set.
🧠 Levels increase in difficulty, keeping you engaged and challenged.
What to expect?
✔ 150 mind-bending unique puzzles
✔ Simple controls, smooth gameplay, and deep logic-based gameplay
✔ No timers, no stress – play at your own pace
✔ Perfect for puzzle lovers looking for a fresh challenge

Can you solve all of the mazes? Try Mazer now and put your logic to the test!

title: Shoot'n'Shell
description:
게임 정보
NOT EASY, NOT SORRY!
A fully offline, true indie, solo-developed mid-core 2.5D looter-shooter with hand-drawn visuals and fast-paced combat.
It’s hard by design—you WILL get better.
Skill-based gameplay combines decision making and gradual progression.
A challenging yet fair action game where success depends on skill and strategy, not luck alone. Master mechanics, leverage upgrades, and adapt to survive.
Key Features:
A Unique Universe – A beautifully hand-drawn world filled with distinct creatures, enemies, and immersive environments.
3 Distinct Biomes – Each with unique enemies, traps, surroundings, and interactive encounters.
Challenging Boss Fights – Face 9 Mini Bosses, 3 Major Bosses, and a Final Boss, each with unique mechanics.
Wearable Items & Weapons – Customize your loadout with gear that provides unique perks and playstyles.
Upgradeable Village – Unlock 27 permanent upgrades to enhance abilities and refine your strategy.
120+ Perks – A deep perk system with tree-like progression for limitless builds and replayability.
Unique enemies — Every one with it unique style, attacks and skills.
Gameplay Focus:
Skill-Oriented Progression – No artificial difficulty—your own skill and strategy determine success.
Tough Yet Fair – Charming visuals, brutal challenge. You earn every victory.
Final Touches:
Fully offline!

title: Zui's Witch Academy
description:
게임 정보
Zui's Witch Academy is a boss rush roguelike-styled action game. You build a deck of 3 magical cards to take down one of many bosses. Each boss has an arena specifically tailored to them. Can you help Rysa graduate from Zui's Witch Academy with flying colors?
This game was originally made for the Boss Rush 2025 Game Jam!
Features
18 unique cards to collect and build your deck with!
3 difficulties to attempt and conquer, I doubt you can beat impossible mode (no like seriously, give up).
Practice and master against every boss in training mode.
8 bosses each with their own arena specifically designed around them.
An energetic and fun soundtrack! Complemented by a charming modern pixel-art aesthetic.
What are you waiting for?
The game is free! Download it and play it now! Rysa is waitin' for you to wake her up, how else is she going to graduate from Zui's Witch Academy?

title: Cardinal Sequence
description:
게임 정보
Cardinal Sequence is a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by space and sci-fi with a unique twist to how to play your cards. It is all about finding perfect synergies, organizing your cards and reaching scores beyond human readability.
A new way to play cards
Input a pattern of directions to match your card's in order to score as high as you can. Every card comes with unique effects and synergies to allow you to beat an ever increasing challenge. Carefully manage your cards to reach for the stars and beyond.
A relaxing space theme
Lean back as you sit in front of your view into space. Watch the stars pass while listening to relaxing, sci-fi inspired tunes. Take your time as you play your cards at your own pace and watch the stars fly by.
More to come...
The game is in active development and will see more content and new ways to play.

title: Leafing Home
description:
게임 정보
출시 시 저희 게임은 한국어로 번역되지 않지만, 위시리스트의 수를 모니터링하고 수요가 충분하다면 번역해 드리겠습니다. 그러니까 관심이 있다는 것을 알 수 있도록 위시리스트를 꼭 작성해 주세요.
리핑 홈 (Leafing Home)은 탐험과 재미로 가득한 마법의 세계로 여러분을 안내해 줄 아늑한 작은 모험입니다. 작은 다람쥐로서 당신은 세계 나무의 열매를 되찾고 집으로 돌아가는 길을 찾기 위해 탐험을 떠날 것입니다. 차가운 탐험, 플랫폼, 플라잉 챌린지, 미니 게임을 섞어가며 날씨가 조금 나빠진 세상을 치유하고 기발한 크루들의 사랑을 전파합니다. 정말 귀엽고 완전히 이상한 캐릭터들을 만나 퍼즐을 풀고 하루를 구하는 방법을 알아 봅니다. 짧지만 열정과 유머로 가득 찬 모험을 할 준비가 되었습니까?
하늘을 날아다니세요! 저희의 독특한 비행 메커니즘은 여러분이 쉽게 공중을 지나거나 활공할 수 있게 해줍니다. 비행 중 모드를 전환하고 네 개의 다른 영역에서 숨겨진 모서리를 발견하세요. 주요 공중 도전 과제: 종이 비행기를 낚아채거나, 의심하지 않는 낚시꾼을 말리거나, 반딧불이를 잡거나, 동료 날다람쥐를 따라 새로운 땅으로 이동합니다.

title: A Way Home Uzy's Journey
description:
게임 정보
Uzy and his friends Ati, Omy and Epo have become separated in a storm where Uzy's navigation system has failed.
Uzy wakes up in the forest which is also where you find him.
Solve puzzles to complete levels and ultimately find your friends and your way home.

Game Overview - Base Game
Gameplay Style: A mix of open-world exploration and limited interactions.
Learning Curve: Designed to be accessible, with text-based instructions.
Character: You play as a small droid, which opens up a casual gameplay mechanics and storyline.
Environment: The world feels both open (offering exploration) and limited (perhaps in terms of objectives or movement).
Multiplayer: A multiplayer mod will allow you and 3 friends to take on a handfull of puzzles and smaller challenges.

title: Soul Pact
description:
게임 정보
Trapped in the dark and mysterious castle of a Fallen Angel, a powerful wizard finds their body and soul torn apart. To escape this cursed place and reclaim their unity, the wizard must face a gauntlet of cunning puzzles set by the very being who divided them. With only a fragile connection between their body and soul, every step demands careful thought and unwavering resolve.
Soul Pact is a mind-bending cooperative puzzle adventure inspired by the We Were Here franchise. You and a partner must take on the roles of the wizard's body and soul, each navigating distinct parts of the castle. Communication is your only tool to bridge the gap between your divided perspectives and solve the Fallen Angel’s devious challenges.
Are you prepared to prove your wits, communication skills, and teamwork in a race against time to reunite the wizard’s essence?
Atmospheric thriller experience: Traverse the shadowy halls of a castle steeped in dread and ancient magic.
Unique dual perspectives: One player commands the wizard’s body, exploring physical realms, while the other controls the soul, uncovering spiritual dimensions of the castle.
Intricate puzzles to solve: Test your minds and your connection as you uncover clues and solve increasingly complex riddles.
Immersive storytelling: Uncover the dark history of the Fallen Angel and the tragic events that led to your separation.
Inspired by games like We Were Here, Myst, and the thrill of real-life escape rooms.
Gather your courage and choose your partner wisely. Together, you’ll determine if the wizard’s soul and body can forge their Soul Pact once more.

title: Eternal Survival
description:
게임 정보
Venture into the forgotten depths of Navel, the massive underground labyrinth built by the dwarves, now overrun by the horrors of the Great War of Menegroth.
Description
Centuries ago, the dwarves abandoned their ancestral home, sealing entire armies of the undead within the vast caverns of Navel. Deadly traps and labyrinthine corridors were constructed to contain the dark plague. But where there’s danger, there’s also glory and unimaginable wealth.
You are a daring adventurer who dares to enter these cursed catacombs, facing endless waves of the undead while seeking fame, treasures, and the secrets of the dreaded necromancer generals of Menegroth.
Key Features
Survive the impossible – Face ever-growing waves of the undead while leveling up and enhancing your abilities with each run.
Addictive progression – Collect relics, unlock new powers, and create devastating builds to survive longer.
Dark and treacherous environments – Explore abandoned dwarven cities, trap-filled mines, and temples defiled by dark magic.
Terrifying enemies and bosses – Battle horrific creatures and the necromancer generals guarding forbidden secrets.
Multiple characters and playstyles – Choose between warriors, mages, and hunters, each with unique abilities.
Eternity awaits those who dare challenge the darkness… Will you survive?

title: KindFolx

KindFolx is a single player PvE real time deckbuilding card game! Play as 1 of 3 monsterfolk members of the Adventurers Guild in their quest to liberate the city of KindFolx's humans from its corrupt leader!
Face challenges head on as the orphan outcast adventurer, dodge and buy your way out of situations as the affluent noble, or deliver an unrelenting barrage of combos with the feisty pugilist!

title: Crime Scene Technician
description:
게임 정보


When the world awakens to life, it discovers the terrible deeds of the night. As a criminal department technician, you will find yourself a regular visitor to scenes of crime, gathering evidence for analysis and skillfully combining the facts - necessary steps for apprehending a suspect.




While the task at hand might seem overwhelming, do not fret - you’re not alone, accompanied by plenty of companions in the form of various tools.
Thanks to the ultraviolet lamp, you will see what’s hidden in the light of day. Test the collected samples in a well-equipped laboratory and recover damaged files or identify fingerprints with the help of advanced software.




Keep in mind, however, that the specialized equipment will be worthless without the most important tool - you! Be perceptive and inquisitive, spotting clues overlooked by others, finding patterns and similarities. Then, once gathered, connect the dots with a line that will lead you towards the truth.




Finish the job by putting the right person behind bars, but that’s not the end! Each day streets are filled with a sordid cast of characters, just waiting for an opportunity to strike. Clear the city of criminals and become a legend in your trade thanks to Crime Scene Technician!

title: Mine & Slash

강력한 전리품으로 영웅을 맞춤 설정하고 장비를 업그레이드하여 더욱 치명적이고 효과적으로 만드세요.
앞으로의 퀘스트에 도움이 될 강력한 기술을 해제하고 더욱 강력해지세요!

title: MazeSlug
description:
게임 정보
This is an immersive first-person single-player horror game. Players will take on the role of an ordinary person returning home late at night, who inexplicably steps into a special space on a familiar path. You must explore and move forward in this space filled with unknown fears.
The game is divided into four chapters. Players will explore four distinctly different styled areas in sequence. Please be advised that some scenes contain bloody elements, and players should mentally prepare themselves accordingly.

title: Motorcycle Sales Simulator: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
도난 시스템
이제 오토바이 세계의 어두운 면으로 들어가 보세요. 눈에 띄는 오토바이를 훔쳐서 합법적으로 벌 수 있는 것 이상으로 위험하지만 수익성이 높은 수입을 올릴 수 있는 기회를 얻으세요. 다양한 오토바이 브랜드와 모델
클래식한 디자인부터 최첨단 모델까지 다양한 오토바이 중에서 선택하세요. 각각의 고유한 성능, 주행거리, 가격 특성을 살펴보세요.



경찰 및 세금 추적
물론 처벌받지 않는 범죄는 없습니다! 프롤로그에서는 도난당한 오토바이를 처리하는 과정에서 경찰의 순찰과 세무 조사가 여러분을 괴롭힐 것입니다. 계속 주시하고 적절한 타이밍에 범인을 놓쳐서 가게의 평판을 지켜야 합니다.

현실적인 협상 경험
고객과 열심히 협상하고, 제안을 검토하고, 수익성 있는 거래를 체결하세요. 하지만 설득이 항상 쉬운 것은 아니므로 신중할 필요가 있습니다!

스토어 관리
구매한 오토바이를 스토어에 전시하고 매력적인 가격으로 판매하세요. 쇼룸을 올바르게 구성하면 더 많은 구매자를 유치하고 수익을 높일 수 있습니다.

유지보수 및 개조 기회
때때로 오토바이는 특별한 관리가 필요합니다. 작은 손길이나 광범위한 수정을 통해 오토바이의 가치를 높이고 잠재 고객을 유치하세요.



단순한 구매와 판매가 아닌 진정한 열정
오토바이 거래 시뮬레이터를 사용하면 거래뿐만 아니라 오토바이 세계의 복잡성을 탐구할 수도 있습니다. 다양한 모델을 비교하고, 가치를 분석하고, 비즈니스에 가장 매력적인 제안을 준비하세요.

꿈에 그리던 오토바이 사업을 시작할 준비가 되셨다면, 오토바이 판매 시뮬레이터가 특별한 모험을 선사합니다!

title: Prison Escape Simulator
description:

죄수는 처형될 것입니다. 그의 유일한 치료법은 감옥에서 탈출하는 것입니다.

title: We Bowling?!

"We Bowling?!" is what happens when a bowling ball escapes the alley and goes on a wild adventure! Roll, bounce, and yeet your way through obstacle courses packed with ramps, seesaws, moving platforms, and even minigolf-style chaos. The pins are waiting at the end, but can you get there fast enough to top the leaderboards? Speed, precision, and a little bit of luck will decide if you’re a strike or a total gutterball. So, We Bowling!? Or are you gonna split?

title: Snakecremental
description:
게임 정보
Collect fruits colors
Upgrade the Skill Tree

당신은 또한 세계에서 자유롭게 탐험하고, 자신의 애완동물을 체포하거나 배양하여 목장 건설에 참여할 수 있으며, 애완동물을 데리고 바깥의 괴물과 싸워 목장의 안전을 수호할 수 있다.목장을 네가 좋아하는 세계로 만들어라.
