title: Skyline Urban Story
description:
게임 정보
Unconventional Path: This is a city-building game without 3D graphics, but that doesn't stop you from creating a massive city with millions of inhabitants! Different wealth groups, building densities, and industries will all converge in the vast metropolis you build with your own hands!

Hexagonal Grid Map
Each plot will have its influence and commuting range. As the city expands, you, as the mayor, need to plan and place plots to maximize tax revenue, reduce expenses, and ensure the healthy development of the city.



"3D" City
Different wealth groups, building densities, and industries will bring distinct areas to the city, such as industrial zones, commercial districts, and office CBDs. You can plan wherever you want according to your wishes.

Pay Attention to Citizen and Business Feedback
Each residence or business has its own needs. Please try to meet their needs while ensuring the healthy development of the city, otherwise, it may lead to negative impacts such as a halt in population growth and a decline in tax revenue.



Plan Transportation
Although this game doesn't require building roads, each plot will have a certain commuting time. Excessive commuting time can prevent two plots from establishing a connection. For example, if a residential area cannot go to another commercial area for shopping, you can use public transportation or replan the functions of the plots to reestablish connections!

Use Information Layers
Like every city-building game, information layers are a very useful tool that can help you quickly grasp various information in the city, providing important references for the decisions of all mayors.

Day-Night Cycle
Experience the changing times of day, allowing you to admire your city both during daylight and under the night sky. As night falls and the city lights up, you'll feel a deep sense of pride as the mayor, watching over the countless glowing windows.



Various Terrains
In the game, different terrains allow for different buildings or zones, and different maps may bring different challenges.

Finally, I wish all mayors a pleasant gaming experience!

title: Motorcycle Sales Simulator: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
도난 시스템
이제 오토바이 세계의 어두운 면으로 들어가 보세요. 눈에 띄는 오토바이를 훔쳐서 합법적으로 벌 수 있는 것 이상으로 위험하지만 수익성이 높은 수입을 올릴 수 있는 기회를 얻으세요. 다양한 오토바이 브랜드와 모델
클래식한 디자인부터 최첨단 모델까지 다양한 오토바이 중에서 선택하세요. 각각의 고유한 성능, 주행거리, 가격 특성을 살펴보세요.



경찰 및 세금 추적
물론 처벌받지 않는 범죄는 없습니다! 프롤로그에서는 도난당한 오토바이를 처리하는 과정에서 경찰의 순찰과 세무 조사가 여러분을 괴롭힐 것입니다. 계속 주시하고 적절한 타이밍에 범인을 놓쳐서 가게의 평판을 지켜야 합니다.

현실적인 협상 경험
고객과 열심히 협상하고, 제안을 검토하고, 수익성 있는 거래를 체결하세요. 하지만 설득이 항상 쉬운 것은 아니므로 신중할 필요가 있습니다!

스토어 관리
구매한 오토바이를 스토어에 전시하고 매력적인 가격으로 판매하세요. 쇼룸을 올바르게 구성하면 더 많은 구매자를 유치하고 수익을 높일 수 있습니다.

유지보수 및 개조 기회
때때로 오토바이는 특별한 관리가 필요합니다. 작은 손길이나 광범위한 수정을 통해 오토바이의 가치를 높이고 잠재 고객을 유치하세요.



단순한 구매와 판매가 아닌 진정한 열정
오토바이 거래 시뮬레이터를 사용하면 거래뿐만 아니라 오토바이 세계의 복잡성을 탐구할 수도 있습니다. 다양한 모델을 비교하고, 가치를 분석하고, 비즈니스에 가장 매력적인 제안을 준비하세요.

꿈에 그리던 오토바이 사업을 시작할 준비가 되셨다면, 오토바이 판매 시뮬레이터가 특별한 모험을 선사합니다!

title: The Pub Life Simulator
description:
게임 정보
꿈의 펍을 운영해볼 준비 되셨나요?
The Pub Life는 여러분을 처음부터 자신의 펍을 설립하고 운영하는 경험으로 초대합니다! 오래된 가게를 인수하고 꿈꾸던 공간을 만들기 위해 도전하세요. 고객을 만족시키고 사업을 확장하려면 무엇이든 해야 합니다. 하지만 주의하세요: 훌륭한 펍을 운영하려면 철저한 계획과 결단력 있는 관리가 필요합니다.
가게를 청소하고 시작하세요
펍에 들어서자마자 청소부터 시작하세요. 먼지와 어수선함 속에 갇히지 마세요. 깨끗한 펍은 만족스러운 고객을 의미합니다! 플레이어는 초기 예산을 신중하게 사용하여 첫 번째 재료를 구입하고 간단한 메뉴로 시작할 수 있습니다.
성장하고 레시피를 발견하세요
사업을 확장하려면 레벨을 올리고 더 고급 재료의 잠금을 해제하세요. 새로운 레시피를 배우고, 칵테일 제조 기술을 향상시키며 고객을 놀라게 할 특별한 메뉴를 만드세요. 창의력을 발휘해 고객의 사랑을 받는 펍으로 거듭나세요!
균형 유지
훌륭한 펍 운영은 메뉴에만 국한되지 않습니다. 재고를 균형 있게 유지하고 예산을 계획하며 고객의 요구를 충족시키는 것을 잊지 마세요. 수입을 신중하게 관리하고 비싼 투자에 신중히 접근하세요. 그렇지 않으면 부채의 늪에 빠질 수 있습니다!
사실적인 시뮬레이션
The Pub Life는 실제 펍 운영자가 직면하는 모든 도전과 보상을 시뮬레이션합니다. 세밀한 관리 시스템, 다양한 레시피 옵션 및 재미있는 공간 개발 과정은 몰입감 넘치는 경험을 제공합니다.
준비되셨나요? 꿈의 펍을 창조하고, 운영하고, 가장 사랑받는 공간으로 만들어보세요!

게임은 당신에게 풍부한 자유를 준다. 당신은 각종 농작물을 재배하고 귀여운 동물을 사육할 수 있다. 버섯과 각종 꽃을 채집할 수 있다. 고기잡이와 채굴을 할 수 있다. 각종 재료를 수집하고 맛있는 음식을 만들 수 있다. 또한 모든 목장의 인물과 상호작용할 수 있다.목장에 더 많은 사람들이 놀러 오도록 하기 위해서, 당신은 점차 풍차 발전옥, 목장 숙박, 식당, 병원을 지을 수 있고, 목장에 유원지를 지을 수 있으며, 그 안에 각종 놀이시설이 있어 목장을 하나의 놀이공원으로 만들 수 있다.
당신은 또한 세계에서 자유롭게 탐험하고, 자신의 애완동물을 체포하거나 배양하여 목장 건설에 참여할 수 있으며, 애완동물을 데리고 바깥의 괴물과 싸워 목장의 안전을 수호할 수 있다.목장을 네가 좋아하는 세계로 만들어라.

title: Domovoy
description:
게임 정보
In the game "Domovoy" you will have to dive into a seemingly ordinary apartment, but the further you go, the more HE reveals his essence. This horror game is a first-person walking simulator with a tense atmosphere, explore the apartment, find answers and move on. Are you ready to meet HIM?
Domovoy is not only a guardian of the hearth, but also a vengeful spirit. If ignored or disrespected, it can turn against the owners.

title: Market Empire Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Market Empire Simulator puts you in the role of a rising market owner, where your business skills and strategy will determine your success. Build, manage, and optimize your very own supermarket from the ground up.
Run Your Own Supermarket
Start with a modest store and turn it into the go-to shopping destination. Control everything from inventory to pricing, ensuring customers leave satisfied and keep coming back.
Hire and Manage Employees
Find the right staff to keep your store running smoothly. Hire employees and maintain morale to maximize productivity.
Stock Your Shelves Wisely
Choose the right products and arrange them strategically to attract customers. From everyday essentials to specialty items.
Expand and Upgrade
Upgrade your store with better equipment, more shelves, and a bigger layout.
Customize and Optimize
Design your store’s layout for peak efficiency or focus on aesthetics to create a welcoming shopping experience. Every detail matters when it comes to running a thriving supermarket.
Do you have what it takes to build the ultimate shopping empire? The challenge awaits in Market Empire Simulator!

title: Mine & Slash
description:
게임 정보
던전으로 들어가 적을 물리치고 금을 캐세요! 많은 금을!
진정한 채굴자로서, 던전 깊숙이 파고 들어가면서 금과 귀중한 자원을 수집할 수 있는 독특한 기회를 가집니다.
주의하세요! 더 깊이 들어갈수록 도전이 더 어려워지고, 더 강력한 적들이 기다리고 있습니다.
강력한 전리품으로 영웅을 맞춤 설정하고 장비를 업그레이드하여 더욱 치명적이고 효과적으로 만드세요.
앞으로의 퀘스트에 도움이 될 강력한 기술을 해제하고 더욱 강력해지세요!

title: the Shadow of Swallow
description:
게임 정보
Immersive Visuals
Experience ancient China in a visually stunning, realistic side-scrolling 3D action-adventure. Play as a master swordswoman, a deadly assassin fighting for justice.
Engaging Gameplay
Engage in thrilling stealth and combat. Infiltrate heavily guarded palaces to eliminate key targets, using stealth or brute force to overcome obstacles.
Engage in dynamic sword fights, showcasing your mastery of combat.

title: PLATiNA :: LAB
description:
게임 정보
데이터의 세계는 언제나 예측불허
말랑말랑 DB들과 함께하는 리듬 플레이!
'PLATiNA :: LAB'은 전통적인 노트 낙하형(Top-Down) 플레이 방식으로 즐기는 리듬 게임입니다.
다양한 장르의 악곡을 연주하고 개성 넘치는 DB(캐릭터)들과 교감하며
'PLATiNA :: LAB'만의 특별한 매력을 느껴 보세요.
● 누구나 재미있게 즐길 수 있는 플레이 방식
초보자부터 숙련자까지 각자의 실력에 맞는 방식으로 다양하게 즐길 수 있습니다.
4LINES · 6LINES로 구분되는 두 가지 연주 방식은
비슷해 보이지만 각각 색다른 즐거움을 선보입니다.
또한 각 모드에서는 특수 패턴이 등장하는 PLUS 패턴을 통해
더욱 깊이 있는 플레이를 경험할 수 있습니다.
곡의 리듬에 맞춰 패턴을 연주하여 더 좋은 성과로 플레이를 완성해 보세요.
● 다양한 플레이어의 취향을 만족시키는 악곡
국내외에서 잘 알려진 게임과 애니메이션의 수록곡부터
다양한 리듬 게임에서 활발하게 활동 중인 유명 아티스트의 인기 악곡과 함께,
'PLATiNA :: LAB'에서만 즐기실 수 있는 다채로운 오리지널 악곡도 준비되어 있습니다.
여러 리듬 게임을 두루 즐겨본 매니아는 물론, 리듬 게임을 즐겨본 적이 없는 분들도 즐겁게 플레이할 수 있습니다.

title: Laundry Simulator : PowerWash It!
description:
게임 정보
"세탁소 시뮬레이터"는 분주하고 도전적인 세탁 사업의 세계에서 자신의 사업을 운영할 수 있는 경험을 제공합니다. 부티크 세탁소의 주인으로서 일반 옷부터 고급 의류까지 다양한 세탁 요구를 처리하고 세탁 관련 제품도 판매할 수 있습니다. 시간과 자원을 현명하게 관리하고, 장비를 업그레이드하며, 매장 레이아웃을 최적화하고, 우수한 서비스를 제공하여 더 많은 고객을 유치하세요.

고객이 가져온 더러운 빨래를 하나씩 세탁바구니에 넣고 세탁기에 넣어야 합니다. 세탁된 옷은 건조되어야 하며, 이는 품질과 고객 만족도를 보장합니다.




세탁소에서 세탁 서비스뿐만 아니라 세탁 관련 제품도 판매할 수 있습니다. 제품을 신중하게 선택하고, 합리적인 가격을 설정한 후 진열대에 배치하여 고객의 구매를 유도하세요.

title: Caverna
description:
게임 정보
Caverna is the digital adaptation of the board game of the same name created by Uwe Rosenberg. The game has the following game mechanics: Automatic Resource Growth, Tile Placement, Turn Order Claim Action, Worker Placement. The game has a Solomode and Multiplayer option. You can also play against the AI. It is a turnbased game that you can play live but also asynchronously. It can be played with 1-7 players. You have 2 options for the look of the game. The classic board game appearance and our 3D interpretation. 

Caverna makes you the head of a dwarf tribe, living in a small cavern.
You cultivate the forest in front of your cavern and dig deeper into the mountain throughout the game. By furnishing rooms in your caverns you make space to grow your tribe and and create new goods from your resources. Deeper into the mountain you will find fountains as well as ore and gem mines. It’s on you to decide how much ore and gems you want to mine, giving you the opportunity to forge weapons and go on adventures; a new way to do things in the game instead of using actions with your workers. Outside your cavern you can clear the forest, cultivate fields, fence pastures and grow crops or breed animals. All this in order to increase your wealth and become the strongest and best tribe leader of them all!

title: Hexed Time
description:
게임 정보
Hexed Time is a hand-drawn point-and-click puzzle adventure set in a small medieval village. You play as Amelia - she might seem like an ordinary grocer in her town, but don't let her common life deceive you. Amelia is a witch, able of many spells and curses.
One night, a prophecy reveals the terrible fate of her dear friend. To save her, she traps the following day in a time loop, ending only if the friend is still alive when midnight strikes. Unfortunately, Amelia could not foresee an unpleasant visit. On that day, the inquisition arrives in the village with only one goal: To expose and burn the witch.
What will be the correct way out of the repeating day?
Features:
Cast spells and make potions to help you escape the time loop
Explore your village and discover how your actions during the day affect your surroundings and neighbors
Reach 3 different endings and determine, which will be your preferred one

title: Remote Reaper: FPV Drone
description:
게임 정보
“Remote Reaper: FPV Drone" is a simulator that immerses the player in the role of an FPV drone operator in modern warfare. The player operates FPV drones using remote control to strike enemy vehicles.
The game offers realistic controls via a controller and a simplified control mode that allows easy drone operation using a keyboard and mouse.
Each enemy vehicle has weak spots. Your task is to identify these critical points and deliver precise strikes for effective enemy destruction.

title: Fish Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
In Fish Shop Simulator you manage your own aquatic store in a cozy New York neighborhood. Build your dream aquarium business by carefully selecting fish, aquariums, and decorations to create beautiful underwater environments for your customers.
Run your own aquarium shop
Serve a variety of customers
Design and sell custom aquariums

title: 9 Kings
description:
게임 정보
수도를 건설하라



당신의 도시를 가장 강력한 왕국으로 만들어보세요. 건물, 부대, 마법, 배치의 무한한 조합을 통해 게임의 규칙을 깨고 압도적인 힘을 손에 넣는 방법을 찾아보세요. 전략적으로 왕국을 성장시키고 수많은 독특한 이벤트에 대비하여 당신의 왕국이 다른 어떤 왕국보다 오래 지속될 수 있음을 세계에 보여주세요.
왕국을 지켜라



당신의 부대와 방어 시설, 그리고 성의 힘을 활용하여 어떤 침략자도 당신의 도시에 접근하지 못하도록 막아보세요.



특별한 카드를 모으고 독특한 특전을 얻어 게임 플레이 방식을 완전히 바꿔보세요.

카드를 무한한 방법으로 조합해보세요. 다른 왕들과 외교를 펼치고, 상식을 뛰어넘는 구성을 시도하며, 대군이 당신의 왕관을 위해 싸우는 모습을 지켜보세요. 가능한 한 오래 생존하여 게임의 규칙을 깨뜨릴 수 있음을 증명하세요.

title: Vindefiant
description:
게임 정보
Vindefiant is a pixel-art adventure game where players take on the role of Alyx, a corprate employee who unexpectedly grows supernatural powers. Disgruntled having been fired from his job, Alyx unleashes his powers and sparks a path of rage and destruction to get revenge on his former employer. Anyone who happens to cross his path will meet a gruesome end. In Vindefiant, you are the bad guy.
In your journey for vengeance, you will need to traverse through various environments, including an office building, streets, and sewers. Use your villainous powers to quickly cause havoc. Your tendrils can be used to grab objects to hurtle towards enemies, throw enemies through windows, into ventilation fans, smash open doors, tear apart turrets, and much more.

title: Nautical Survival
description:
게임 정보
아호이, 선장님!
광대하고 무자비한 바다에서 벌어지는 긴장감 넘치는 생존형 자동 슈팅 게임, 'NAUTICAL SURVIVAL'에 참여하세요. 무장한 선박을 지휘하며 위험한 물길을 항해하고 끊임없이 몰려오는 해상 몬스터의 무리를 막아내십시오. 빠른 게임 플레이와 광범위한 커스터마이징으로, 모든 교전은 기술과 전략의 시험입니다.
고속 해상 전투
함장이 되어 격렬한 전투에 뛰어들고 바다의 무서운 적들과 싸우십시오. 강력한 무기로 선박을 장비하고, 경험 많은 승무원을 고용하며, 생존을 위한 전술을 조정하세요. 업그레이드가 가능한 전초기지를 찾기 위해 미지의 섬으로 여행하십시오. 바다는 위험하므로 화물을 신중하게 관리하십시오!
모험이 부릅니다
'NAUTICAL SURVIVAL'은 재미있고 액션 가득한 해상 경험을 제공하며, 높은 재플레이성, 잠금 해제 가능한 컨텐츠 및 다양한 가능한 빌드를 제공합니다. 베테랑 해상 사냥꾼이든, 첫 폭풍을 맞이하는 신참이든, 환영합니다!
'Nautical Survival'은 빠른 게임 플레이와 높은 커스터마이징을 자랑하는 고속 아레나 슈터입니다. 얼리 액세스 버전은 출시 시 다음과 같은 컨텐츠를 포함할 것입니다:
~20분 짜리 런
절차적 맵
7가지 잠금 해제 가능한 해상 공예품, 각기 다른 능력과 게임 스타일을 가짐
빌드를 커스터마이즈할 수 있는 10명의 승무원 승진
12종류의 전문 자동 발사 무기
바다에서 발견할 수 있는 5개의 업그레이드 가능한 건물

title: Portal Fantasy
description:
게임 정보
Explore, Capture, Battle
Prepare for an epic adventure collecting Porbles to aid you in turn-based battles in this pixel-art online RPG. Fuse your Porbles to enhance, customize, and evolve them to their higher Majesty levels! 
Portal Fantasy is online, and will have multiplayer features coming after 1.0! Due to the game being online, you will need internet access to play, even if playing solo. 
Collect & Fuse
Collect unique creatures, Porbles, and gather ingredients to fuse and enhance your team. Discover hundreds of combinations, which can augment your creatures, teach them new skills and even change their appearances.
Turn-based Strategic Battles
Master strategic battles with unique passives that trigger based on your team composition. Manage your creatures’ momentum as you unleash their skills to victory. Build a superior squad and enhance your team's synergy and strength with each Porble's unique passive that works together in combat.

title: Magic Inn
description:
게임 정보
Follow this step-by-step guide to craft a 5-star inn, the epitome of fantasy and magic.
5-star Service
Recruit top chefs, or hone your own skills and become one yourself! Forge ties with local farmers for quality ingredients and offer a delectable menu for your guests. A 5-star inn draws royalty and fame, so you must prepare the rarest of items. Build relationships with winemakers, trade with merchants, or search the corners of the world for rare gems. Impress even the King upon his arrival!
Pals with Ghosts?
Under the moonlight, the sight of pale ghosts may send most people running, but not you. Discover the secrets, master the spell to unlock a world of friendly ghosts. Serve and befriend these charming spirits, and in return, you’ll receive whimsical rewards beyond your imagination.

title: Private Military Manager: Tactical Auto Battler
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 1990년대 남미의 코르디비아에 터를 잡은 용병회사의 사장입니다.
autokwd: Private Military Manager: Tactical Auto Battler,민간군사기업 매니저: 택티컬 오토 배틀러

title: Sacre Bleu
description:
게임 정보
맙소사! 누군가 당신, 머스킷티어 대장을 거짓 혐의로 감옥에 가두었습니다! 이제 블런더버스를 잡고 자유를 향해 나아갈 때입니다!

우아하면서도 치명적인
블런더버스를 사용하여 플랫폼에서 플랫폼으로 자신을 발사하며, 우아한 불렛 타임 공중전에서 적을 처치하세요! 기술을 연마하고 더욱 어려운 전투를 해제하세요!
괴물 같은 특권층
프랑스 귀족들은 담즙을 내뿜는 좀비 군대로 변했습니다. 거대한 보스를 물리치고 프랑스를 겨냥한 음모를 밝혀내세요!

바스티유 탐험
넓은 바스티유 감옥 복합 단지를 돌파하여 비행선을 만들기 위한 부품을 모으세요. 어두운 구석에서 비밀을 발견하고 새로운 콘텐츠를 해제하세요.
기초부터 접근성




특징:

title: Icaria
description:
게임 정보
Automate a team of robots to gather resources, reshape terrain, and scale up factories on a procedurally generated alien world.
Explore a procedural world
Every game you are exploring a different planet, with a different set of resources and biomes that present unique challenge. You start able to only see a small area, but as you progress you build out a radio network and unlock more of the world.
Collect resources
Expanding your colony requires ever increasing quantity of resources. Luckily, the planet you're on is ripe with them to find and use.

title: SEDAP! A Culinary Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Two aspiring culinary geniuses open a traveling food truck and venture out to Khaya Island – a long abandoned, dangerous island with no shortage of monsters and mysteries. Together, the duo explore Khaya Island in search of new recipes and tastes while slowly uncovering the veil of secrets that haunts the locale.
Forge your culinary adventure either solo, or with a friend!
Explore each level to obtain ingredients and prepare food orders, facing fearsome beasts and dangerous hazards along the way.

Whip up dishes as Som, the Cooker, or battle fearsome creatures while foraging for ingredients as , the Hunter. It’ll take your combined effort to keep your business up and running!

title: Haunted House Renovator
description:
게임 정보
Become a paranormal renovator!
Set out on a path of a ghost-hunting renovator. Your task - restore haunted houses to a usable state! This is not an easy job, applying a new wallpaper won't be enough to render a house safe. You also need to deal with whatever is haunting it.
Accept requests to renovate haunted houses from various eccentric owners. Scout abandoned mansions and look for signs of any paranormal activity. Make sure you're ready for the job by preparing a set of tools to aid your work.
Chase away ghosts by any means possible. Sometimes your job will be as easy as catching an entity with a net and sometimes you will need to draw elaborate magic circles and perform sinister rituals. And if nothing works, you can always look for an alternative way to solve your issue - regular hauntings have two ways of getting rid of them, nice and mean. Choose your playstyle and earn different rewards based on your choices. You can even adopt certain hauntings!

title: Necrophosis
description:
게임 정보
Necrophosis invites you to immerse yourself in a mystical puzzle adventure set in a surreal universe, the environment itself becomes a nightmarish masterpiece, filled with unsettling shapes and haunting visuals.


A MA·CA·BRE WORLD
Billions of years after the universe met its demise, you awaken in a realm where death reigns supreme but even death may die.
Necrophosis, the curse that plagues this world, inflicts decay upon everything it touches. Here, amidst a landscape crafted with meticulous care, dread and decay permeate every corner. The characters of this world, infected by the curse, embody the very essence of decay.

With every turn you take and every sigh that escapes your lips, you bear witness to the relentless touch of decay. Necrophosis weaves its grim tapestry, enveloping you in a haunting journey through a macabre world where death is not an end, but a pervasive reality.




In Necrophosis, visuals are just the surface of a deep, immersive experience. Delve into a world where every element is steeped in a rich backstory, where each step forward unveils a new layer of mystery. As you progress, you'll encounter mechanics that challenge your wit, each puzzle a piece of a larger, enigmatic narrative.
Prepare for a journey of discovery and introspection, where every event is a unique encounter, and each solution leads to deeper revelations. Whether through haunting narrations or evocative poetry, Necrophosis weaves a slow burn of intrigue, drawing you into its captivating tale with every twist and turn.

title: Caravanners: Co-op Open World Camping
description:
게임 정보
돈을 벌고 꿈의 캐러밴을 처음부터 만들어보세요!
완벽하게 맞춤화된 캐러밴으로 자유롭게 여행하고 캠핑하세요.

title: Castle Craft
description:
게임 정보
한없는 창의력과 혼돈이 지배하는 QubiQuest: Castle Craft에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 뭐든 파괴할 수 있는 복셀 세계에, 거대한 성채를 세울 수 있는 대규모 공성전 시뮬레이션 게임에 빠져드세요.
경제력을 키우세요. 정신없는 난장판에 재밌는 물리 효과를 끼얹은 대격전을 벌이세요. 독특한 적들의 끝없는 물량 공세에서 성을 지켜내세요.
Castle Craft는 복셀 샌드박스의 재미와 박진감 넘치는 게임플레이와 정신 나간 물량 디펜스를 한데 버무린 궁극의 역작입니다.
Castle Craft에서는 성주가 되어서 꿈의 성을 세울 수 있습니다! 아마도요.
당신은 존경받고 공경받는 데비미우스 전하의 오른팔입니다. 국왕 전하께서 친히 이르시길, “일은 경이 하게. 칭송은 짐이 받을 테니."
계속 진화하는 적 떼거리가 끝없이 몰려와서 꿈의 성에 끊임없이 몸을 던질 겁니다. 없는 것 빼고는 다 있는 온갖 함정과 장치를 조합해서 살상력을 극대화할 수 있어서 망정이죠!

title: MATCHO
description:
게임 정보


Start your new epic journey in MATCHO with Max and his friends as he tackles a mysterious alien invasion that could lead to curing his illness and saving the Earth.

MATCHO is bringing puzzles into the combat. It‘s Match-3 FPS - a unique combination of genres that merges frenetic shooting with quick decision-making. Explore story-driven chapters as you choose destiny for Max, his friends, and the rest of the world. Fight in action-packed arenas like never before and explore intricate areas –⁠ all that with breathtaking visuals and an insane arsenal of abilities including the freedom of parkour movement.

This is a full-featured indie videogame developed with love by a small group of friends and developers from the Czech Republic. And it‘s FPS like you've never experienced before.



Navigate through a series of exciting platforming sections, solve ingenious puzzles and talk with many lovable characters you'll encounter as Max. MATCHO is our own take on a modern superhero story, with breathtaking visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5.
Main features:
Intense and clever tactical fighting built around the match-3 shooter concept.
Dazzling visuals powered by Unreal Engine.
A non-linear, humor-packed plot with multiple endings.
An extensive, built-in parkour system lets you wall-run, double-jump, float and dash in any direction.

title: Car Dealer Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Turn your dream of selling used cars into reality! In Car Dealer Simulator, you’ll learn the ins and outs of running a business from its quirky owner, Little Sam. He’s not great at keeping things in order, so your task is to buy low, fix up, and sell high. Over time, as you master your initial challenges, you’ll have the chance to take over the business, and then…


Everything will be in your hands! Build a business that fulfills your customers’ automotive fantasies. From budget-friendly cars to top-tier rides, seize opportunities, hire the best, provide excellent service, and maximize profits. Grow your company day by day.


The key to achieving high profits lies in negotiating when buying old cars. Look for great deals, and during price haggling, stay firm and professional.

title: Synthwave Driver
description:
게임 정보
A nostalgic road trip on an endless highway, driving iconic '80s cars through a neon-filled paradise. Let the synthwave/retrowave soundtrack guide you toward the horizon, leading you into a world of nostalgic vibes.
The road stretches infinitely, taking you back to a simpler time, where palm trees sway gently in the warm breeze. As the rhythm takes over, you enter a state of serene reflection, racing through a universe where time is measured in moments of calm and nostalgia.
As you accelerate, you'll unlock new worlds and over 15 iconic vehicles, each offering customization options and upgrades. For competitive players, each world features an online leaderboard, allowing you to compete globally or with friends for the highest scores.
Over 15 Vehicles : Each with unique characteristics and a first-person view.
Soundtrack : An extensive library of Synthwave/Vaporwave/Retrowave tracks.
Gameplay : 5 different game modes.
Garage : Personalize it your way, by changing the flooring and wallpaper, as well as decorative objects.
Vehicles : Acquire new vehicles and improve your performance, as well as customize them the way you want.
Scenery: Explore over 10 worlds, each offering different atmospheres and feelings.
Leaderboards : Chase high scores on global and friends' leaderboards.
Cool Vibes : Brings back fond memories of simpler times.

title: Backrooms: Hide Together
description:
게임 정보
이 게임에 대하여
이 게임에서는 The Backrooms의 기괴하고 끝없는 복도를 탐험하는 강렬한 멀티플레이어 공포 경험을 제공합니다. 최대 6명의 플레이어가 온라인 협동 모드에서 함께 플레이할 수 있으며, 친구들과 함께 불안한 미로를 헤쳐 나가고, 암호 같은 퍼즐을 해결하며, 내부에 숨어 있는 형언할 수 없는 공포를 피해야 합니다.
주요 특징:
실제와 같은 그래픽 및 환경: 매우 세밀한 비주얼과 몰입감 있는 환경이 The Backrooms의 불안한 세계를 놀라운 현실감으로 생생하게 구현합니다.
멀티플레이어 생존: Backrooms를 탐험하면서 협력하거나 분리하여 탐험합니다. 의사소통과 팀워크는 생존을 위한 가장 중요한 도구입니다.
몰입감 있는 공포 분위기: 실제와 같은 환경과 다이나믹한 조명이 잊혀진 방과 불가능한 공간의 공포 세계로 여러분을 끌어들입니다.
무서운 적들: 무자비한 존재들이 각 레벨을 순찰하며, 각각 독특한 행동을 보입니다. 숨거나, 달리거나, 조용히 해야 합니다. 생존은 본능에 달려 있습니다.
8개의 도전적인 레벨: 숨 막히는 복도, 기괴한 열린 공간, 복잡한 퍼즐을 탐험하며 여러 레벨을 넘어섭니다. 새로운 콘텐츠와 레벨이 정기적으로 추가되어 계속해서 긴장감을 유지합니다.
협력 퍼즐 및 탈출 메커니즘: 함께 열쇠를 찾고, 수수께끼를 풀고, 출구를 열면서 모든 방향에서의 위험을 피합니다.
당신에게 필요한 것은 무엇인가요?
생존에는 전략, 은밀함, 그리고 강철 같은 신경이 필요합니다. 팀과 함께 가까이 있어야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 영원히 길을 잃을 위험이 있습니다. Backrooms는 무자비합니다. 몬스터들은 몇 명의 플레이어가 남아 있는지 신경 쓰지 않습니다.
준비하세요. 탈출은 가능하지만, 협력해야만 가능합니다.

title: Office Simulator
description:
게임 정보
오피스 시뮬레이터 는 기업 세계에 깊이 몰입할 수 있는 현실적인비즈니스 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 인턴으로 시작하여 회사 계층을 단계별로 올라가고, 궁극적으로 자신의 회사를 설립하여 업계 리더가 되세요.

커리어 여정
인턴으로 커리어를 시작하고 점점 더 어려운 업무를 수행하세요. 파일 정리, 회의 일정조율, 문서 전달, 이메일 응답 등 다양한 사무실 업무를 처리하여 경험을 쌓고, 역량을강화하며 승진을 통해 더 높은 직책으로 올라가세요.



사무실 업그레이드
최신 사무실 장비와 가구에 투자하여 생산성과 업무 효율성을 극대화하세요. 더 나은 근무환경을 조성하여 직원들의 성과를 극대화하고 회사의 성장을 가속화하세요.

title: SORRY SURVIVOR
description:
게임 정보
Story
One day, the hero suddenly becomes irresistible!
However, there is only one girl he has his heart set on!
Can he overcome all kinds of love confessions and tell his feelings to that girl?
How to play
Use all your skills to reject the girls in the school who try to confess their love to you!
autokwd: SORRY SURVIVOR,ごめんなサバイバー

title: Grocery Store Tycoon - First Store
description:
게임 정보
Grocery Store Tycoon - First Shop은 플레이어가 첫 번째 가게를 관리하고 확장하여 점주로서 첫 발을 내딛게 해줍니다. 작은 가게로 시작하여 레이아웃을 최적화하고, 선반을 효율적으로 채우고, 고객에게 서비스를 제공하여 사업을 성장시키세요. 신중한 계획과 전략적 결정이 소박한 시작을 번창하는 슈퍼마켓으로 바꾸는 열쇠가 될 것입니다!
]
가장 빠른 캐셔의 속도를 도전하거나 임금을 지불하고 싶지 않다면 직접 계산대를 운영하세요. 긴 대기 시간을 피하고 고객을 만족시키기 위해 가능한 빨리 스와이프하세요.

title: Fuel Harvest Together
description:
게임 정보
형제라면 당연히 기름 캐야지! 최대 5인 멀티 지원, 1명은 공장장, 4명은 합작 파트너! 역할을 나누어 최적의 운영을 하세요. 밤새 정제소 돌리는 노동왕, 숨겨진 보물을 캐는 행운러, 주식 시장을 읽는 전략가, 심지어 손 놓고 구경하는 유저도 가게에서 소소한 성취감을 느낄 수 있습니다. 협력해서 석유 산업을 키워나가세요. 적절한 역할 분배만 있다면 석유 제국도 꿈이 아닙니다!
사이버 탐사 장비 메탈 디텍터를 활용해 랜덤으로 생성되는 맵에서 현실판 황금 캐기 게임을 즐겨보세요. 원유를 채굴하는 동안 숨겨진 ‘미스터리 박스’를 발견하고, 희귀 보석, 화석, 광물을 획득해 컬렉션을 완성하고 추가 수익을 올릴 수 있습니다.

title: Countryside Life
description:
게임 정보
The protagonist, Hiro, visits his relative's house in the countryside by himself.
This is a pixel art simulation game where you live under one roof for a month with three sisters, your childhood friends.
How you spend your time is up to you!
You can fish in the ocean or a river, have your catch cooked, build a secret base...
The village is full of interesting folks, like the fisherman, the candy store owner, and your neighbors.
Complete their requests and they might reward you...!
Make this month full of memories of your own.
Haruka
The older sister who is always nice to you and great at cooking.
Her food is so good, you could never get tired of it. In fact, you always end up overeating...

title: GeoGuessr Steam Edition
description:
게임 정보
GeoGuessr Steam Edition takes you on a journey around the world, challenging you to recognize locations and outsmart your opponents. Each round places you in an unknown location, where you must use landscapes, signs, and landmarks to pinpoint your position. Face off against players worldwide in exciting multiplayer battles. Climb the leaderboard, sharpen your geography skills, and discover famous landmarks or hidden corners of the world. Every guess brings you closer to victory. Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate champion?
In this edition, you’ll compete against players from around the world in competitive Solo Duels. Starting in the Amateur Division, the game mode is structured around a ranking system. With skill and perseverance, you can rise to the prestigious Champion Division, where the best players face off to prove their mastery of the world. On your way to the Champion Division, you’ll access new features and game modes, such as No Move and the legendary NMPZ.

title: Lovely Feet Girls
description: 게임 정보

title: Lobotomy
description:
게임 정보
Survival in a Distorted Reality
This is a horror game with elements of exploration and survival. You will explore a strange world, find ways to move forward, and control your fear. Reality will begin to distort, familiar things will become alien, and disturbing events will escalate.
Gameplay and Features:
Exploration – discover a world full of strange locations, unexpected transitions, and hidden details.
Distorted Reality – the environment shifts, and you never know what awaits around the next corner.
An Atmosphere of Unsettling Calm – nothing is chasing you here... for now.
Ordinary Life
You are an ordinary villager, living a peaceful life among familiar faces and a well-known routine. Day after day, everything follows its usual course—until one day, something happens that changes your world forever…

title: A Game About Cutting A Tree
description:
게임 정보
게임은 간단합니다. 모든 나무를 베어내세요.....
울창한 숲에서 자연의 균형을 되찾거나, 시간에 갇혀 방치된 도시를 되찾는 것을 주제로 한 미니멀리스트 게임입니다. 도끼와 결심만으로 빽빽한 초목 속을 헤치고, 귀중한 나무를 모으며, 뿌리 아래에 숨겨진 비밀을 발견하세요.
게임 특징
나무 베기 – 울창한 식생을 제거하고 주위 환경을 구성하세요.
나무 모으기 및 판매 – 더 나은 도구 및 업그레이드를 위해 자원을 모아 거래하세요.
도끼 업그레이드 – 기본 도구로 시작하여 강력한 장비로 업그레이드하세요.
스태미너 관리 – 과로와 부상을 피하기 위해 자신의 페이스에 맞게 조절하세요.
숨겨진 비밀 발견 – 야생이나 폐허 속을 깊이 탐험하며 지표 아래 숨겨진 신비를 밝혀내세요.
복구 및 되찾기 – 풍경을 변화시켜 잊혀진 장소에 생명을 되돌리세요.
autokwd: A Game About Cutting A Tree

title: Univocity
description:
게임 정보
Univocity is a short, 4K ready, cyberpunk visual novel wrapped in neon aesthetics with a lush atmospheric soundtrack, featuring a deep and emotional conversation between two people about taking down a global tech monopoly and the responsibility that it entails.
Synopsis:
Max, a former engineer who turned fugitive, is headed to the top of tallest tower of Univocity—an urban sprawl owned by Ōṁ, a global tech monopoly—to set off an electromagnetic pulse bomb that will plunge the city into a technological dark age. But their plans are disrupted when they encounter Nina, an Ōṁ employee, which sparks a conversation that makes them question their motives.

title: Supreme War God
description:
게임 정보
In this mmo game, the human empire is in chaos, and demons have broken free from their seals to wreak havoc. but fear not! many heroes have risen to fight the demons and save humanity. by defeating demons, players can grow stronger and eventually become the saviors of the world.
###Game System###
In this immersive game, you can personalize your character's appearance using the Fashion System, experimenting with diverse styles and accessories. the Crafting System lets you unleash your creativity, transforming collected resources into practical or valuable items. with the Enchanting System, you can infuse your gear with magical attributes to gain an edge in battles. the Enhancement System provides a way to boost your equipment's performance through meticulous upgrades. mastering the Skill System allows you to develop a unique combat style and strategy. the Retainer System offers the convenience of having helpful assistants for various in-game tasks. through the Castle System, you can showcase your architectural and managerial talents while defending and expanding your territory. the Mercenary System enables you to lead a group of skilled warriors on exciting missions. lastly, the Quest System presents a variety of thrilling challenges that reward your efforts with precious treasures and well-earned fame.
###Gameplay###
In this action-packed game, players can boost their strength by defeating powerful demon armies and obtaining rare items. here's a closer look at the various gameplay elements:
al Enhancement: fortify your magical barriers by battling demon hordes to acquire enhancement stones.
Elven Kingdom: safeguard the elves' realm from demonic forces within a time limit to claim your rewards.
Kingdom Conquest: engage in strategic battles against other players to achieve dominance and boost your kingdom's power.
Demonic Wilderness: explore this vast, untamed land where dark energies surge beneath the cracked earth, inhabited by terrifying creatures and ancient evils.
Troll's Lair: venture into this foul-smelling underground den, where monstrous trolls with an insatiable hunger for battle stand guard.
Blood Demon Corridor: navigate this maze of blood-stained halls, where the agonized cries of the damned echo and bloodthirsty fiends patrol.
Demon Cave: delve into this cavernous abyss where the air is thick with infernal power, a breeding ground for demons plotting world chaos.

title: Oxide Room 208
description:
게임 정보
After Matt’s tragic disappearance in room 104 of the Night Soul Motel, his business partner Josh is still trapped there at the mercy of a ruthless and cruel scientist. The lives of Kat, Josh and Matt crossed paths in science —a macabre science orchestrated by Doc’s deadly hands.

FEATURES:

- Digitalized real actors and use of advance motion capture technology, that will instantly immerse you in this terrifying experience. Putting yourself in the shoes of the protagonists has never been so easy!
- Dig into the bowels of the Night Soul Motel and sneak into the huge underground lab.
- Experience new restarting mechanics after dying, either accidentally or at the hands of horrific creatures that lurk around the facilities. Your actions have consequences! But in OXIDE, death is just the beginning.
- Realistic use of the inventory. You will have the chance to pick up a large number of weapons and items that will help you get out of there, but you can’t carry them all with you! You’d better use your head.

title: WARRIORS
description:
게임 정보
WARRIORS는 멀티플레이어와 AI 봇이 포함된 싱글플레이어 모두를 위해 설계된 슈팅 게임입니다. 얼리 액세스를 구매한 플레이어는 모든 무기 스킨과 캐릭터를 즉시 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다. 이후에는 경험치를 얻어 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다.
현재 게임에서 제공되는 8가지 모드는 다음과 같습니다:
정복
목표를 점령하여 시간 경과에 따라 점수를 얻으세요. 더 많은 목표를 점령할수록 점수를 더 빨리 얻을 수 있습니다.
러시
목표를 파괴하거나 방어하세요. 공격팀의 병력이 소진되면 방어팀이 승리합니다.
킬 컨펌
적을 처치하고 그들의 인식표를 수집하여 점수를 얻으세요. 팀의 인식표를 수집하여 적의 점수 획득을 방지할 수도 있습니다.
팀 데스매치
적을 처치하여 점수를 얻으세요.
깃발 뺏기
적의 깃발을 탈취하여 기지로 가져와 점수를 얻으세요. 깃발이 탈취되면 먼저 그것을 되찾아야 합니다.
모두의 전쟁
모든 플레이어를 처치하여 점수를 얻으세요.
서치 앤 디스트로이
시간 내에 목표를 파괴하세요. 라운드당 한 명의 플레이어만 생존할 수 있습니다.
좀비 모드
무시무시한 좀비와 싸우세요.
.

title: Cosmobreeder Yiffai
description:
게임 정보
In an age of faster-than-light travel and advanced cyber-robotics, brave explorers known as Cosmobreeders travel to forgotten worlds and study alien creatures.
Play as a lone Cosmobreeder shot down over Planet Tutone, a world fallen to ruin and haunted by ancient betrayal. Your comrades have been captured, your equipment stolen. Armed with only your wits, traverse ancient service tunnels, eerie alien forests, and deep volcanic caverns. Reclaim your gear, uncover alien artifacts, and awaken mysterious ESPer abilities to survive the planet’s numerous dangers.
Navigate hundreds of intricate rooms, in which fragile walls hide secrets and hidden paths reward the curious. Battle dozens of unique foes and conquer epic bosses, each victory granting new abilities and allowing you to delve deeper into Tutone.

title: Coin x Union
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Coin pusher x Watermelon-like game.
This is a game where you can enjoy Coin pusher and Watermelon-like union action.
Enjoy this crossover between the coin pusher element of dropping and collecting coins and the exhilarating Watermelon-like sensation of uniting coins.
Throw a coin and let's union coins!
If you hit the same coins together (union), they will turn into higher-ranked coins.
Aim for the golden coin.
Also, if you union coins, bonus coins will fall.
Try to get the coins without dropping them!
Move the boxes to grab the coins that fall.
If you drop them towards you, black coins that cannot be unionized will fall.
Try to grab them without dropping them if possible.
Aim for a high score!
Collect high-scoring coins through union or get and aim for a high score.
The game will finish when the number of coins falls below the value of the coins you threw, or when they fly off to the left, right, or back of the platform and fall.

title: Anomaly Bus
description:
게임 정보
ANOMALY BUS
A Soviet-Era Psychological Horror Where the Route Never Ends...
The year is 1991. You board a rickety bus in a forgotten Soviet village, heading home after another bleak day. But something’s wrong. The same station keeps appearing—or does it? The signs are familiar, the streets look identical… yet something lurks in the gaps of your memory.
Will you escape the loop? Or become its next passenger?
Inspired by The Exit 8 and I’m On Observation Duty, Anomaly Bus blends memory-based horror with paranormal dread. Observe. Remember. Survive.
GAMEPLAY
RIDE THE BUS HOME… OR... BECOME FOREVER PASSENGER
Board only the normal buses—the ones matching your memory of Station 1.
If something feels off, skip it. Your life depends on attention, not speed.
HIDDEN IN PLAIN SIGHT
Anomalies aren’t subtle… but they’re easy to miss if you’re careless.
A flickering light. A missing poster. A passenger who wasn’t there before. Scratching on the windows. Ghost driver and more...
NO CHEAP SCARES—JUST PURE DREAD
No cheap jumpscares… you have to spot the anomaly...
The horror builds as the loop tightens. What’s waiting at the final stop?
SMALL BUS, ENDLESS TERROR
The bus is cramped, but anomalies shift with every ride.
Randomization ensures no two playthroughs are the same.
IMMERSE YOURSELF
Memory Over Reflexes – Patience is your greatest weapon.
Headphones Highly Recommended – The creaks, whispers, and distant Soviet radio static will haunt you.
Average Single Playtime: 1 – 3 Hours – A tight, chilling experience with high replayability.

title: A Weekend Trip
description:
게임 정보
Play as River as they have a trip over the weekend with their friends. Choose what River does during the trip. Will they hang out with their friends? Will they explore the cabin? Or will they choose to just let the trip pass by as quickly as possible.
Features:
- point-and-click gameplay
- choose how River talks to their friends
- choose how River reacts to their surroundings
- simple puzzles
- hand drawn sprites and backgrounds
- atmospheric and ambient music

title: gogh: Focus with Your Avatar
description:
게임 정보
gogh: Focus with Your Avatar 는 아바타&방 꾸미기, 육성 게임, 작업 집중 뽀모도로 타이머가 합쳐진 작업용 게임입니다. 좋아하는 것에 둘러싸인 방, 로파이 비트와 아름다운 환경 소리, 작업을 함께하는 귀여운 아바타와 성장하는 신기한 캐릭터가 당신의 공부와 작업을 더욱 즐겁게 해줍니다.
나만의 공간
가구와 소품을 자유자재로 배치하여 색상 변경이 가능한 압도적인 자유도의 방 꾸미기 모니터나 포스터, 레코드 등등, 자신이 좋아하는 이미지나 GIF를 붙여서 자신만의 개성을 살려보세요. 열심히 꾸민 여러 방을 저장해서, 기분에 맞추어 작업 환경을 바꿀수 있습니다.
귀여운 애니메이션 스타일의 아바타
다향한 얼굴, 헤어스타일, 패션으로 당신과 작업을 함께하는 아바타를 자유롭게 꾸며보세요. 아바타를 의자, 침대, 바닥 등 원하는 장소로 이동시키고 아바타 애니메이션을 선택해 봅시다. 그리고 뽀모도로 타이머의 연동이나, 아바타 타이핑 소리 등의 기분 좋은 작업음이 함께 공부하는 감각을 높여줍니다.

title: Veloria: The Knot of Candles
description:
게임 정보
벨로리아의 촛꽃
벨로리아의 촛꽃은 퍼즐과 레벨 디자인, 강렬한 비주얼과 음악을 결합한 혁신적인 호러 퍼즐 게임입니다.
인간의 정신 질환이라는 가혹한 현실과 마주하며, 심리적 깊이와 공포 요소가 뒤엉키는 이야기.
어둠과 절망 속에서 살아남기 위한 몸부림, 겉모습과 내면의 진실을 탐색하는 과정.
스토리 개요
플레이어는 심각한 정신 질환을 앓고 있는 소녀 벨로리아가 되어, 어린 시절의 악몽 같은 기억을 통해 진실을 찾고 구원을 구하게 됩니다.
게임은 여섯 개의 장으로 나뉘며, 여섯 명의 인물의 이야기를 통해 암울하고 비극적인 이야기가 전개됩니다.
플레이어는 손수 충격적인 진실을 밝혀내야 합니다.
벨로리아는 으스스한 고아원의 문 앞에서 깨어납니다.
타버린 재가 공기 중을 떠다니며, 잊힌 비밀을 드러냅니다. 실제 고아원은 수년 전 화재로 소실되었습니다.
지금 남아 있는 것은 기억의 조각들로 만들어진 기묘한 세계.
진실을 찾기 위해, 그녀는 그 불길한 세계의 문을 엽니다.
이 건물 안은 기괴한 어둠에 뒤덮여 있으며, 오직 촛불의 희미한 빛만이 발밑의 길을 밝혀줍니다…
등장인물
autokwd: Veloria: The Knot of Candles,비라리아의 촛불꽃

title: TaskTwist
description:
게임 정보
Your to-do list just got electrifying.
Charge devices, water plants, or tidy up—but this house and garden are packed with peril . Sparks, faulty cords, and sneaky traps lurk in every corner. Will you survive?

Pick Your Playstyle:
Adventure Mode: Roam freely, dodge hazards, and enjoy the journey.
Speedrun Mode: Compete on leaderboards for the fastest cleanup!
Why Play?
For Everyone: Tackle chores casually or race for the high score—your choice!
Electrifying Hazards: Dodge rogue appliances, frayed wires, and wet zones—all while keeping your sanity
Hidden Risks in Every Corner: Explore every room and yard in a charming, danger-filled world.
“This isn’t a chore—it’s an obstacle course!”
Dive in and turn mundane tasks into electrifying adventures!

title: Leap by Franklin Burnett
description:
게임 정보
...you Leap...
You stand at the bottom of a pit, a lone figure... Above you, only ledges, cliffs, and the long, punishing climb to the summit.  With a single Leap, you begin your ascent.
...you Leap...
Every Leap is a decision.  Every Leap is a chance at progress.  Every fall… is a lesson in despair.  No mercy.  Just you, gravity, and the relentless pull of failure.  One misplaced Leap, and you plummet—losing minutes, hours, maybe even your sanity.
...you Leap...
Like Sisyphus condemned to roll his boulder, you will climb again and again, knowing the pit owes you nothing.  Yet something within you refuses to quit. Is it hope?  Stubbornness?  Or just madness creeping in?
...you Leap...
Gameplay:
-High Stakes Platforming!
The higher you climb, the closer to victory.  But also the farther you will fall!

-Simple Controls!
Hold Space to charge and then release it to LEAP.

-Think Before you LEAP!
Every LEAP requires much patience and thought, DON'T RUSH IT! Or you will certainly fall back to the bottom...
Features:
LEAP is a simple to control game where you climb to the top only by LEAPing into the air.
The higher you jump, the harder you fall
You can enable checkpoints, which you can teleport back to.
Extremely difficult but addictive gameplay
50 brutal floors.
Built in speed running timer
Practice mode.

title: StarVaders
description:
게임 정보


죽여 첨탑의 융합,위반에,그리고 공간 침략자,스타 베이더는 그리드 기반의 전술 카드 전투의 불량 라이트 캠페인에 외계인 침략자의 떼를 싸울 메카 갑옷을 조종하는 스릴 턴 기반 전략 게임이다.

당신이 당신의 언어로이 게임을보고 싶다면 위시리스트하시기 바랍니다! 우리는 번역 할 언어를 결정하기 위해 위시리스트 통계를 볼 것이다!



복잡한 그리드 기반 전술을 마스터하십시오!

title: Moroi
description:
게임 정보
Moroi is set within the Cosmic Engine, a personalized hellscape designed to distort any semblance of normalcy. Truth is an illusion, paranoia is constant, and your humanity is an oddity.

You awake to find yourself a prisoner within a living nightmare. Your name, your past: gone, but not the record of your misdeeds. Your crimes: beyond comprehension. Your conviction: incontestable. Your sentence: eternal. The need to escape and set things right: undeniable.


Fight your way out of a living, twisting labyrinth. Hone your skills as you take on dynamic combat encounters and absurd puzzles. Meet the Cosmic Engine’s most disturbing and grotesque inhabitants, all with unique and nonsensical personalities, who are just as likely to aid in your quest as they are to deceive you.

Escape means freedom, and in freedom, the truth.
Descend through the surreal, twisting Spire as you recover from amnesia and slowly discover the morbid truth about your past and your hostile surroundings. Cling to your sanity as the very fabric of reality is unraveled before your eyes.

title: Dark Pact
description:
게임 정보
Manipulate enemy positions and make use of clever combos in this tactical turn-based strategy game with a focus on creativity rather than number crunching.
Tactical Carnage Awaits
What if Into the Breach had a full campaign? That question sparked the creation of Dark Pact, a game designed to push your tactical skills to the limit while delivering an emotional, gripping story. Inspired by Fire Emblem, Advance Wars, and Into the Breach, Dark Pact aims to stand alongside these legendary titles. Does it succeed? Play the demo and find out!
Master Devastating Abilities
Victory isn’t just about dealing damage—it’s about control. Abilities in Dark Pact don’t just hit hard; they push, pull, taunt, and disrupt, keeping the battlefield in constant flux. Creativity is key to survival.
Earth Splitter – Deal damage in a line and push adjacent units

title: New Life
description:
게임 정보


Immerse yourself in the dark adventure of a guy who suffers from depression and feels guilty. He never takes off his hood and always keeps his hands in his pockets. Michael became disillusioned with life and decided to try to start his life over. To do this, he left the metropolis and a successful career, sold the house he inherited, and moved to the other side of the country to forget the mistakes made in the past. But is it possible to escape from your past?

Unravel the sinister secrets of your neighbors to find the truth hidden by the veil of darkness, and also help Michael get rid of guilt, overcome depression and start a new, happy life.


Enjoy this exciting and intense story through the eyes of Michael, a young man haunted by nightmares
Help Michael get rid of guilt, overcome depression and start a new happy life
Explore, interact with your surroundings... and come face to face with your fears.

In this adventure game, you will interact with Michael's life. In addition to the obvious plot, you can find many hidden details, secrets and tasks that will reveal the plot more, tell neighborly secrets and help Michael cope with his past, which haunts him. But to reveal the whole plot completely, you will have to be attentive and seriously invoke a bit of head-scratching

title: Cataclysm Wars
description:
게임 정보
The Empire is under attack, and only its mighty armies can save it! Shame you aren't in charge of those, then. Lead an outmatched militia through overwhelming odds in this turn-based strategy game, and save your nation from collapse - and perhaps even an apocalypse. Or, lead the dogged Syrinx foe and crush the Empire thoroughly!

An Empire At War
Caught in the surprise attack of the Syrinx Kingdom, your militia will have to fight desperately to hold its own and give army troops time to fight back. Lead your forces through 9 missions as the Commander of the Carcasier Militia, and hold back the tide.

A Kingdom On The Offense
Alternatively, take the role of the dreaded owl menace and execute a daring assault upon the Empire. Execute your battleplan through 5 missions as leading officer of the forces of the Syrinx Kingdom, and bring the humans to their knees!

A Classic Experience
Upgrade your troops through your campaign, read about the situation at hand through narrative events, and take in the details of the world of Cataclysm Wars through its encyclopedia.

Homebrewed to Completion
Cataclysm Wars is based on a "homemade" tabletop role playing game which has been in constant development for half a decade. It is a world of fading magic and gunpowder, dragons and humanoid owls. It is also a world that has grown over half a decade, with well-explored adventures and fleshed-out characters that now inform the setting of Cataclysm Wars.

title: Skin Deep
description:
게임 정보
Skin Deep은 몰입감 넘치는 1인칭 슈팅 게임입니다. 플레이어는 재채기를 하고 뾰족한 물건을 밟으면 발이 다칩니다. 광대한 비선형 우주선을 잠입하여 파괴 공작을 펼치고, 적들을 방해하여 이 우주의 샌드박스에서 생존해 보세요. 플레이어는 수적으로 열세이며, 화력도 적보다 약하고, 신발도 없습니다.

숨쉬고 살아있는 보험증권
보험회사가 귀중품을 안전하게 보관하고 싶을 때는 플레이어를 얼려서 화물 우주선에 실어 둡니다.

그리고 우주 해적들이 우주선에 탑승해 무음 경보를 발동시키면, 플레이어는 마음을 가다듬고 심호흡을 한 다음, 상황을 처리합니다.

행운을 빕니다, 요원님.

title: Wool at the Gates
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 점점 더 어려워지는 일련의 라운드에 걸쳐 도시를 건설하여 침략하는 양떼로부터 도시를 방어하는 전략 게임입니다. 인간, 오크, 엘프가 함께 양떼가 도시를 점령하는 것을 막기 위해 싸워야 합니다. 각 라운드에서 살아남기 위해 경제와 방어의 균형을 신중하게 유지하세요. 건물 유형과 위치를 최적화하고 직업 유형을 쌓아 강력한 시너지 효과를 낼 수 있도록 여러 전략을 짜보세요. 진영과 병과 유형의 독특한 조합으로 레벨을 플레이하여 새로운 도전을 완료하고 보상을 획득하세요.
게임 플레이
기지 건물: 타워, 벽, 자원 생산 건물과 같은 구조물을 건설하고 업그레이드하여 경제를 성장시키고 양 무리를 방어하세요.
라운드 기반 레벨: 다음 웨이브가 시작되기 전에 각 라운드를 천천히 건설하여 레벨당 점점 더 어려워지는 일련의 라운드를 진행하세요. 
자동 전투에서 영감을 얻은 시너지 효과: 같은 클래스의 타워, 부대, 영웅 능력을 선택하면 영웅과 해당 클래스의 모든 캐릭터가 고유하게 강화됩니다.
진영이 연합합니다: 도시를 건설할 때 휴먼, 오크, 엘프를 조합하여 각 진영의 고유한 특전을 얻으세요.
영웅 또는 신: 영웅 형태로 병력과 함께 싸우거나 하늘을 나는 눈동자로 변신하여 빠르게 전장을 가로지르세요. 레벨을 진행하면서 새로운 영웅 능력을 선택하세요.

title: Conquest Dark
description:
게임 정보
검은 행성이 도착한 지 237년 후, 인류는 멸망 직전에 서 있습니다. 언데드 군대는 인류의 왕국을 황폐화시켰고, 우주의 신들은 무너졌으며, 태고의 존재들은 오랜 잠에서 깨어났습니다. 이제 용사들과 범죄자들 모두 문명을 무릎 꿇린 바로 그 세력에 맞서기 위해 어둠의 의식을 거행합니다.
어둠의 의식을 마스터하세요
우주적 공포와 태초의 흉포함이 만나는 무시무시한 환경으로 모험을 떠나세요. 길들여지지 않은 사자의 야만 전사, 신성한 맹세 수호자, 신비한 쿠의 수행자 등 저마다 어둠에 맞서는 고유 능력을 지닌 전설 클래스 중에서 나아갈 길을 선택하세요.
즉각적인 액션 RPG의 희열을 만끽하세요
치열한 의식 공략을 통해 강력한 판타지를 해제하세요. 미약한 호흡으로 시작해서 성장해 나가며 파괴적인 빌드를 발견하세요. 모든 의식은 보람찬 진척도를 제공하여, 농축된 형태의 ARPG의 성장 곡선을 확인할 수 있습니다. 의식을 공략할 때마다 전설 상태에 가까워집니다.
신을 처단하는 빌드를 구성하세요
기괴한 능력을 발견하고, 전설적인 갑옷을 장착하고, 타락한 용사의 독특한 무기를 휘두르세요. 무기고를 강화하고 신을 죽일 만한 빌드를 제작하세요. 심도 있는 커스터마이징과 끝없는 가능성으로 신성을 갖추는 이론적인 길을 개척하세요.

title: Ranch Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
매력적인 마을로 들어와 당신의 기업가적 여정을 시작하세요! 작물을 키우고 농장 동물들을 돌보며, 신선한 농산물과 귀중한 상품을 수집하여 활기찬 시장에서 판매하세요. 온실, 작업장, 장식 요소로 농장을 확장하고 독특하게 꾸며보세요.
마을 주민들과 강한 관계를 형성하여 새롭고 더 나은 물품에 접근하세요. 친절한 나무꾼의 도움으로 가판대를 업그레이드하고, 작업을 간소화하기 위해 직원들을 고용하세요. 가축을 키우고 원자재를 인기 있는 상품으로 변환하세요.
농업
씨앗을 사고, 작물을 키우고, 시장에서 판매하세요. 사계절 재배가 가능하도록 농장이나 온실을 확장하세요.
작업장
고기를 손질하거나 신선한 제품을 굽고, 음료 기계를 사용해 음료를 발효시키세요. 각 도구에 대한 레시피가 제공되어 시작을 돕습니다.
가축
소, 염소, 닭을 사서 헛간에서 키우세요. 매일 먹이를 주면 우유나 계란과 같은 제품을 제공합니다.

title: KIBORG
description:
게임 정보
핏덩이 맷돌, 피와 살이 뒤엉킨 미래 전장! 반란군을 이끌고 무작위로 생성된 스테이지에서 수많은 돌연변이와 기계 군단에 맞서 싸우며 탈출을 시도하십시오! 자원을 수집하고, 동료를 모집하며, 금지된 기술을 연구하여 치열한 전투에서 살아남기 위해 모든 것을 걸어야 합니다. 이곳은 피비린내 나는 전투와 무자비한 살육만이 존재하는 곳입니다. 과연 당신은 이 도전을 받아들일 준비가 되었습니까?
당신은 지옥에서 기어 나온 무법자이며 반란군의 잔존 지도자입니다. 잊혀진 감옥 행성에서 전례 없는 재난이 모든 것을 파괴했습니다. 나노 바이러스가 행성을 침식하여 죄수들을 피에 굶주린 괴물로 변이시켰습니다.
당신은 동료들을 이끌고 시체와 피바다를 헤쳐 나가야 합니다. 이곳에는 법이 없으며, 오직 생존을 위한 싸움만이 있을 뿐입니다. 돌연변이 괴물들의 광기 어린 공격과 적대 세력의 무자비한 추격 속에서 끊임없이 싸우고 진화해야 합니다. 주먹과 칼, 총으로 이 황폐한 땅을 붉게 물들이십시오!
이 재난의 배후에 숨겨진 음모를 파헤치고, 죽어가는 이 행성을 구하십시오! 이 종말의 혼돈 속에서 당신은 인류의 가장 어두운 면모와 가장 빛나는 순간을 목격하게 될 것입니다.
이제 무기를 들어 전투에 참여하고, 절망 속에서 희망의 불씨를 밝히십시오!

title: Grey Galactic
description:
게임 정보
Grey Galactic is a real time strategy game, where you colonize planets to collect their resources and have a base to build ships. By collecting resources, improving your buildings and ships, and expanding your empire to new planets, you will use your fleet of ships to try to destroy the enemy before they can destroy you.
Strategic Real Time Battling - Build your fleet of upgradeable ships to explore, expand, and conquer! Ranging from simple ships to attack with, scout ships to explore the galaxy, and settler ships to take new planets, you can strategically position your fleet to defend your planets, and take down your enemies!
Heroic Capital Ships - The powerful Capital Ship is your secret weapon in battle, as a free moving ship that can hold other ships as a mobile base. With unique abilities to help in battle, the Capital Ship can be the ultimate force to turn the battle!
Unique Consumable Artifacts - The universe is full of mystery, and powerful artifacts from both ancient civilizations and modern science will aid you in different ways. Want to quickly spawn in an extra few ships? Maybe instantly settle a new planet? With research into these powerful items, you can use them throughout the game to become an even greater captain!
Varied and Numerous Battlefields - With a powerful map generator, Grey Galactic features both randomly generated and hand crafted systems to explore. Including planets, moons, asteroid fields, ship-destroying-voids, pirates, space stations, wormholes, and more, each battle is a unique experience!
Scenario, Campaign, and Survival Modes - In addition to Scenario maps where you'll have to overcome a unique enemy and challenging Survival games where you try to outlast the onslaught of enemies, there will also be a 3 part, story driven campaign that explores the themes and history of this universe. Learn about the tumultuous past between the human factions of the UFMC and The Skeptics, the desperate fighters of the alien faction of The Proditum, and the mysterious and incredibly dangerous Grey.

title: Suspense: Madman's Dreams
description:
게임 정보
It’s time to dive in and feel the pain. Imagination can be more real than our world. Will the doctor help? Immerse yourself in the stories of these characters.
A game that aims to leave its mark on the genre of narrative-driven psychological horrors is ready to tell chilling tales of protagonists suffering from psychiatric disorders.
Suspense: Madman's Dream lets you become, for a while, a creator, an observer, and a madman all at once.
Explore the habitats of the characters: a hospital, a dungeon, an English house from the 1950s—all through the eyes of several mentally ill individuals. Watch as their minds crumble before your eyes, tearing apart like an abandoned mansion. Wander through ever-changing environments, face fears and phobias head-on, and feel like someone is always watching you. Even when you think no one’s there, chances are, someone is still staring at your back.
Your goal is to direct the events and assemble all the pieces into a logical story, giving insight into the character's state of mind. To achieve this, you’ll need to explore the world and piece together narrative and interactive elements in your mind. Everything that happens has a logical connection to reality but appears surreal. This is exactly what can be found in the pages of psychiatry textbooks—what might happen to a person suffering from such conditions. Just remember: what you see isn’t real, but it is real for the one who sees it, as their mind is inflamed and deteriorating.

title: Time Tales
description:
게임 정보
This game is a farming simulation developed by a two-person team, where players take on the role of a 12-year-old boy inheriting a farm from his missing grandfather. The goal is to repay the massive debt owed to the missing village chief within three years while uncovering the conspiracy behind it.
The game follows a traditional farm setting (in terms of atmosphere), but in terms of gameplay, it will completely subvert the usual conventions of other farming games—no character customization, no fishing mini-games, no animal petting, no blacksmith shop for upgrading items, no sword fighting, no collecting items to unlock certain things, no weather-reporting TV, and not even NPC names… Instead, we will introduce fresh and engaging mechanics to replace these conventional tropes, creating a world full of surprises—because if a game has no surprises, then what’s the point, right?

title: Neurosis
description:
게임 정보
Neurosis is an intense horror-thriller where your decisions can save—or cost—lives. Step into the shoes of a young psychiatrist running an online support group with deeply troubled patients. Each session reveals unsettling connections, buried secrets, and the shadow of a manipulative psychopath hiding among them.
Dive into a gripping narrative inspired by real psychological challenges and therapeutic practices. Your choices will define relationships, uncover truths, and determine how many lives can be saved. With themes of trust, betrayal, and survival, Neurosis blends a detective’s sharp mind with the haunting uncertainty of the human psyche.
Will you unmask the hidden predator before it's too late, or become their next victim? In Neurosis, the answers lie in your hands.

title: Stash: A Card Looter
description:
게임 정보

Every decision is a razor-sharp balance between pushing your luck for that perfect chase card and the urgency of locking in a game-changing pick before the next battle begins.
Quick, Intuitive Card Selection
Make quick decisions with intuitive swipe-based card selection that feels just like opening a real pack of cards. Thanks to procedural generation, no two choices are ever the same. But don’t let the smoothness fool you—this is a game of deep strategy

title: I had a Friend
description:
게임 정보
I Had a Friend is a first-person, single-player psychological horror game set in the unsettling atmosphere of an abandoned family house. You play as Richard, a foreign tech university student living in Germany. One night, as you drift off to sleep at your computer, your phone suddenly rings.
A message from your mother, Hannah, lights up the screen. She informs you that your father, Tom, has been in a serious accident and is now hospitalized. With no one else to care for the family cat, Felix, Hannah asks you to return home immediately.
Upon arriving at the empty house, with only Felix as your companion, you begin to feel a growing unease. Strange, unexplained noises echo through the halls, objects shift as if moved by it self, and Felix’s behavior grows increasingly erratic with each passing night.

title: Adulting
description:
게임 정보
Growing older has nothing to do with feeling grown up.

»Adulting« is an interactive visual novel tackling the topic of being an adult. It is a third person side scroller and a single player. It's unique style combines two-dimensional as well as three-dimensional art to reflect the look and feel of comics and graphic novels. Set in different apartments it should give the player a closer look into the lives of the three main characters.The goal is to embed the feeling of insecurity that accompanies the term »being an adult« in the form of a visual, interactive story and to enable the recipients to deal with this topic individually but also socially. The game takes around 20–30 minutes, depends on how much time you invest in mini games and reading the dialoge carefully.




The game is an experience focusing heavily on storytelling and featuring engaging mini-games as well as point-andclick interactions with dialogue. The story focuses on three characters, each with 3 acts of the story whereas the storylines are linear. The setting is a multi-apartment building. All those light interactions and additional dialogue focus on different problematic aspects of our three characters who should represent different age groups who are struggling with different aspects of being an adult. Furthermore it features point-and-click events which trigger short animations or dialogues giving the characters and environments more context.


Throughout the story the player will encounter light mini-games that they must complete to continue progressing. It features 12 mini-games with various styles of gameplay.




Additionally the players can write messages and send them to other players. Here, own thoughts can be written down and decorated with stickers. Writing and sending these messages can take place at any time during the course of the action. With the help of a scrapbook that can be accessed at any time, the player can send messages and read and store collected paper planes.




By combining 2D and 3D art styles Adulting reflects with a hand drawn look and feel comics and graphic novels. It features hand painted assets as well as 2D character animations. This gives it a unique art style which is easily recognizable.




The topic of the perception of being and becoming an adult in society is personified with three main characters and their individual struggle with the theme. In preparation the development team invested in a 3 month long research by interviewing psychologists and collaborating with the Sigmund Freud Private University Linz as well as making an online survey with over 70 participants.


A coherent soundtrack with individual themes per character ensures that players are immersed in a calm but emotional atmosphere. Full Soundtrack is available on Spotify.






This game was created from five students + helping hands in their master's degree at the University of Applied Sciences Salzburg as their final master's project. Since then the team graduated and they tried to improve it as much as was possible for them after their studies in their free time and with their limited programming knowledge. So please keep that in mind while playing the game and don't be too harsh on the loading times or other bugs. A lot of sweat, tears, money and love went into this project, so thank you for your support! <3










Liv is a 23-year-old single student who is pursuing a university education in the creative industry as well as a part-time job. She has financial difficulties, as her parents also have to support her other siblings financially. The pressure to get her adult life together financially in addition to education and work is growing.





Albert is a man in his mid-40s with two children. He has difficulty taking care of his two children and all his other adult responsibilities, such as his own florist store, because his partner‘s job often prevents him from being at home.





Finja is a 70-year-old pensioner who has particular difficulties with loneliness, as it is difficult for her to stay in contact with her friends, as she no longer has the possibility to travel long distances due to her age. Her family through their busy adult life also do not have much time to visit her.

title: Scarlet Enigma
description:
게임 정보
A birthday turns deadly, and the truth is buried beneath layers of secrets.
In Scarlet Enigma, you take on the role of a rookie detective navigating a tangled web of lies, timelines, and unanswered questions. A young woman is murdered during what should have been a joyful celebration, and it’s up to you to uncover what really happened, before time runs out.
Explore a richly detailed world where your decisions drive the investigation. Question dozens of unique characters, piece together clues, solve puzzles, and dive into interactive environments that reward curiosity and intuition.
Whether you're chasing leads, uncovering betrayals, or decoding the past, every step brings you closer to the killer and deeper into a case that may not be as straightforward as it seems.

title: Solar System Experience
description:
게임 정보

You can land your landing module on rocky planets to experience gravity differences and also test landing on gas giants in simulated conditions.
