description:
게임 정보
despelote는 사람들에 관한 축구 게임입니다. 8살 아이 Julián의 눈과 귀로, 키토의 거리와 공원에 빠져보세요. 도시 주위로 당신의 축구공을 드리블하고, 패스하고, 슈팅해 다른 사람의 앞으로 축구공을 차면 어떤 일이 일어나는지 확인하세요. 에콰도르가 월드컵 본선 진출에 어느 때보다도 가까워지면서 도시가 변하는 모습을 느껴보세요.
특징:
달콤씁쓸하고 가끔은 몽환이기도 한 어린 시절의 반자전적 이야기입니다.
활동, 상호작용, 저질러 볼 장난으로 가득 찬 빽빽한 도시 공간을 한가하게 탐험해 보세요.
1인칭 시점으로 차고 돌아다니기 좋은 물리 엔진 기반 축구공입니다.
재미있고 진심 어린 대화를 하는 캐릭터로 가득 찬 활기찬 세계입니다.
에콰도르 지역에서 기록한 사진과 오디오를 이용해 강렬한 느낌을 주는 장소를 만들었습니다.

title: Light The Beacon
description:
게임 정보
About LIGHT THE BEACON
LIGHT THE BEACON is a 2D action-adventure survival game with rogue-like elements, set in the depths of a sci-fi apocalyptic universe. Take on the role of a genetically engineered Ranger, humanity’s last hope, as you navigate the dangers of space, maintain your ship, and battle for survival against hostile AI creations.
Key Features:
Survive in Hostile Space: Pilot your customizable ship through derelict stations and forgotten sectors, scavenging for critical resources to keep your crew alive while defending against relentless AI forces and unknown threats.

title: Empire Builder - Europe
description:
게임 정보
Zombie Possum Games Inc, in collaboration with Darwin's Toys Inc, is excited to bring the Empire Builder series of board games to your PC. As fans of these games, we at Zombie Possum Games Inc sought more time in our busy lives to enjoy them. To our surprise, we couldn't find any playable versions online using the services that we love like Steam and Xbox. That changes now. With the release of Empire Builder - Europe and the license to offer all other installments in the franchise, we are partnering with Darwin's Toys to publish the latest versions on Steam, iOS, Xbox, and other platforms.

If you are an avid train gamer in the physical space, we hope you will enjoy our adaption of the board game to the digital game space.

Features to be included in the initial release include the following:
All of the game's resources, cities, demand cards and event cards, fully implemented in the digital game.
A select number of popular house rules. (TBD)
2-6 player multiplayer between Steam friends and those with a ZPG account.
A user interface that is designed to make the game play of the boardgame faster. Our goal is to get 4 player game play down to under an hour or 45 minutes for experienced players.
Tournament rules.
Current tournament approved map coming soon for the physical board game. (published by Darwin's Toys)

2009 map, cards and rules.

Planned features for after release.
iOS support
Xbox and controller support.
Additional languages.

This is the first in a series of Empire Builder games that we plan to release alongside Darwin's Toys' re-release of the physical board games. As avid players ourselves, this is a passion project; one we hope allows us to be able to play with our friends when getting together in person is less than ideal.

title: Heart Keeper
description:
게임 정보
What is Heart Keeper?
Heart Keeper is a survival tower defense game with action roguelike elements. Protect the Sacred Heart by building and upgrading an arsenal of turrets and various structures. Combine strategy and quick reflexes to survive massive waves of enemies!
Enter the world of HUGE waves of enemies and dynamic battles!
To protect yourself, you will strategically build powerful defenses, including turrets and various structures. These essential tools can be unlocked by leveling up or collecting resources scattered throughout the map. Choose from an arsenal of unique weapons, each designed with special abilities and tailored to different strategies. But be careful: one wrong move can lead to your quick death.
Every death resets your progress, sending you back to the beginning. But don't lose hope! Gold persists between runs, allowing you to purchase permanent upgrades that will significantly ease your future attempts.
Test your strategic skills and quick reflexes by eliminating thousands of enemies to defend the Sacred Heart in Heart Keeper!
Starting Tips
Use the time between the first waves and quickly gather resources.
High damage turrets are worth upgrading their speed.
There is nothing wrong with dying in this game; it allows you to purchase new upgrades in the menu.
Pay attention to the statistics of the turrets.

title: LAN Party
description:
게임 정보
Experience a LAN party like never before! LAN Party is designed to be the perfect compliment to your gaming group. Whether you're playing the latest FPS cooperatively, competing against each other in an RTS, or playing different games entirely, LAN Party makes communicating and sharing gameplay so much easier. Fully customize your unique gaming room and gaming setup, select your avatar, and invite your friends to hang out and play games or have a watch party in your virtual space. Welcome to the next era of online gaming, where the excitement, energy, and camaraderie of a LAN party meets the freedom of the virtual world.
Stream Gameplay
Experience the excitement of the game together through seamless in-room gameplay streaming. Open your friend's gameplay stream to cheer them on and broadcast your stream to a virtual screen so you can all watch together.
Watch Content With Friends
Use a shared video screen and have a watch party with your friends. Our streaming infrastructure ensures that videos are always synced between viewers.

title: Herald: The Interactive Period Drama – Complete Edition
description:
게임 정보
Herald is a choice-driven adventure game set during an alternate 19th century in which the West is united as a colonial superpower: the Protectorate.
Help tell the story of Devan Rensburg, a man of mixed heritage who became steward on board of the HLV Herald, a merchant ship set for his country of birth.
As Devan it is your job to keep the peace among the crew and passengers by resolving their daily squabbles. Set during a time of widespread inequality and injustice, you are challenged to uncover a great mystery that surrounds the Herald's perilous voyage.

The 'Complete Edition' contains all four books that tell the entire story of Herald.
For the episodic version of the game, please go to the store page of Herald: Book I & II.
Key Features

A branching narrative that changes depending on how you decide to play. Do you choose to be bold and stand up for the downtrodden, or would pleasing the elite be the safer and smarter choice?
Uncover all of the secrets aboard the merchant clipper Herald, as you explore its many nooks and crannies.
The Herald is a microcosm of 19th century society. The crew and passengers all have their own dark secrets and often use sly coercion to convince Devan to help them. But who can you trust?
Herald's diverse cast of characters is brought to life by beautifully animated portraits, and the performances of thirteen talented voice actors.
Herald is set during an alternate 1857 in which the West has been united as a single global superpower: the Protectorate. Governed not by kings but by an elected 'Lord Protector’, the Protectorians believe they are morally superior. But are they?
A gripping tale about finding your place in a world divided by race, class and culture.

CONTENT WARNING: Emotional and physical violence, suggestive themes and infrequent use of strong language. Suitable for ages 12 and up.
autokwd: Herald: The Interactive Period Drama – Complete Edition

title: Farm Your Friends
description:
게임 정보


최대 8명의 플레이어가 온라인에서 즐길 수 있는 빠른 속도의 경쟁 농장 게임! 작물과 동물을 방어하면서 소요와 절도를 해 최고의 농부가 되세요! 다른 사람과 팀을 이루거나 혼자서 플레이하세요!
심거나 훔치기, 선택은 당신의 몫!

당신의 농장에 심거나 친구에게서 훔치세요, 중요한 것은 최대한 많이 팔아내는 것입니다.
당신의 농장을 무슨 일이 있어도 지켜라!

다양한 방어 아이템을 활용하여 침입자를 물리치세요! 허수아비부터 전기 울타리까지, 방어 아이템으로 작물과 동물을 도둑 놀이어로부터 지킬 수 있습니다. 때로는 최고의 공격이 바로 방어입니다!
무작위 이벤트에 주의하세요!

각 농장에서는 상어 공격부터 보물 찾기, 심지어 좀비 침공까지 게임의 역학을 바꾸는 다양한 이벤트를 마주치게 됩니다! 당신이 친구의 농작물을 팔고 있는 동안 번개를 조심하세요!

게임이 끝날 때 가장 많은 코인을 모은 팀이 승리합니다, 고의적인 방해가 있던 없던!

당신에게 가장 잘 맞는 캐릭터를 선택하세요!

title: WitchGhost
description:
게임 정보
WitchGhost is an exploration adventure game where you play as Ezme, a mischievous witch with a knack for getting into (and out of) trouble. Delve into a spooky yet whimsical world filled with eerie enemies, tricky traps and hidden secrets. As Ezme, you'll explore haunted landscapes, dodging dangers while piecing together your lost memories to find your way back home. With a blend of spooky atmosphere and lighthearted humour, WitchGhost offers a thrilling journey that's as enchanting as it is entertaining.


Explore a spooky yet enchanting world brimming with playful surprises.


Gather Ezme's forgotten memories to restore colour to the world and, naturally, find your way back home.


Master a variety of spells, but beware - they might just as easily work against you as they do for you.


The forest is trecherous. Rely on your wits and quick reflexes to survive.

title: Bearzerk
description:
게임 정보
Bearzerk is a twisted teddy world where you harness bizarre plush powers, gather an arsenal of wacky weapons, and crush wave after wave of stitched nightmares. Survive 20 grueling round and choose from a whole bunch of teddy heroes, each with their own monstrous quirks and synergy potential. It’s an auto-shooter that focuses on creative builds, combos, and endless plush pandemonium.
Features (Early Access)

title: Tales of Grimace
description:
게임 정보
Let the show begin!

In a far of land called Terra…
Tensions are beginning to rise…
People, everywhere, are dictated by their beliefs and religion, killing pushing away anyone who disagrees with them…
The biggest of them being the Maluum, an evil cult hell-bent on making everyone share their beliefs.
Anyone who resists them faces the same fate: death. Those who oppose them are known as obstainers, people who resist the evil religion.
But for our hero Yi Ping…
It was just another quiet day with his friend Hera…
In a little town called Kelna.

Yi Ping is a teenage boy whose life is forever changed when his small town is attacked by an evil cult known as the Maluum. Who is this strange cult? What mysteries are they hiding? And is Yi Ping more closely connected to them than he thinks?
Join Yi Ping and his friends on an epic quest to free Terra from the Maluum’s evil grip and experience a heart-touching story about a young boy conquering his anxiety and depression.
Tales Of Grimace is a mature, traditional RPG where you:
• Explore the vast region of Terra and its amazing landscapes;
• Meet a cast of interesting characters that are relevant to the story;
• Discover the mysteries behind a main character tormented by his past.

title: Beyond Memories – Tales of the Heart
description:
게임 정보
Step into a magical world as a whimsical Grim Reaper in this enchanting narrative flight simulation.

You’ll fly through fantastical, enchanted realms brimming with wonder and magic, each landscape more breathtaking than the last.

Your mission is to break cages that hold mystical souls, each soul revealing legendary stories of heroism, love, and adventure. As you free these souls, you’ll piece together 11 epic tales that transport you to a realm of fantasy and myth.

The non-violent gameplay is both relaxing and captivating, inviting you to collect energy for your shots, explore stunningly crafted environments, and lose yourself in a world where every soul's story is a doorway to another fantastical adventure.
The game starts with you stepping into the role of a whimsical flying Grim Reaper in a magical, fantastical world.

You begin your journey by exploring enchanted realms filled with wonder, each landscape more breathtaking and surreal than the last.
As you soar through these fantastical skies, you come across cages that imprison mystical souls, their ethereal voices pleading for freedom.

At first, you’re unable to open these cages, but your exploration soon leads you to discover soul energy, shimmering like magical essence scattered throughout the environment. This energy is vital, empowering you to shoot and break open the cages. With this newfound energy, you take aim and shoot the cages, watching as they burst open and release the trapped souls.

Each soul you collect shares a piece of its legendary story, adding a layer of magic and adventure to your journey. These stories are filled with heroism, love, and wonder, each fragment slowly revealing the soul's epic past. As you gather more souls, you start to piece together their full narratives, with each level offering a new, fantastical short story to uncover.
autokwd: Beyond Memories – Tales of the Heart

title: Obscured Stories: The Resentment
description:
게임 정보
Resentment는 리사 파커가 겪은 트라우마적인 사건을 따라가는 심리적 공포 게임입니다.
리사가 지역 경찰에 의해 심문을 받으면서, 당신은 리사가 사건이 일어난 저녁에 무슨 일이 있었는지 설명하는 동안 그 사건들을 되돌아보게 됩니다.
리사 파커는 2000년대 초 일본에서 유학 중인 국제 학생입니다. SpinFuel 주유소에서 아르바이트를 하며, 그녀의 일상은 제품을 스캔하고, 선반을 채우고, 가게를 유지하는 단조로운 일들로 이루어져 있습니다. 하지만 그녀는 자신과 가게를 멀리서 지켜보는 신비한 남자를 보기 시작하면서 조용한 삶이 조금씩 무너지기 시작합니다.
주요 특징:
스토리 기반 게임플레이
고객 돕기
세 가지 공식 엔딩 (그 중 하나는... 강렬할 수 있습니다...)
비밀…?
두 밤: 게임은 두 개의 밤에 걸쳐 진행됩니다.
심리적 공포
Pssst...BLOOP! :)

title: Gabe's Mod
description:
게임 정보
Gabe's Mod offers a physics sandbox experience with no set objectives. We provide the tools for you to unleash your creativity. Build anything from cars to rockets by spawning and welding objects together. Whether you prefer offline play or joining the online community, the choice is yours. Not confident in construction? No problem! Have fun placing characters in amusing poses. And if you're ready for more, we've got you covered.

- Gabe's Mod Features -
*An imaginative creator (that's you)
*A world brimming with tools!

Start creating now!!!

title: Monch!
description:
게임 정보
Monch your way to new abilities as you platform and puzzle your way through a colourful, handcrafted world. Monch all that nasty purple stuff, or take it slow and help out some of the locals. Keep an eye out for trinkets and secrets, the Monchling is hungry for adventure!
Key Features:

Explore the hand crafted world of Monch! at your own pace. Leave no stone unturned as you traverse forest, desert, island, and glacial peak.

Monch a variety of creatures to gain their abilities, use them to jump, glide, roll, and gust your way around the world. Upgrade them as you go!

Meet a bunch of quirky characters just doing their thing. Help some of them out and maybe make new friends along the way!

From basic baubles to monchable mysteries, the world is full of things to collect and discover.

title: Maze Mice
description:
게임 정보
Maze Mice는 레트로 미로 탐험과 탄막 생존 및 느긋한 게임플레이가 혼합된 게임입니다.
주요 기능:
집주인이 너무해를 만든 1인 개발자가 제공하는 게임플레이
집주인이 너무해와 같은 작곡가가 제공하는 환상적인 사운드트랙
해금하여 플레이할 수 있는 다양하고 귀여운 캐릭터들
해금 및 선택할 수 있는 수많은 업그레이드

title: Surviving Ceres
description:
게임 정보
적대적인 환경
당신은 왜소행성 세레스로 혼자 보내졌습니다. 살아남는 데 필요한 기본품을 모으고, 제작하고, 건설하는 동안 혹독한 환경을 견뎌내야 합니다. 이 얼음 세계에서 발판을 마련하면서 기계, 시설, 농장을 건설하세요.
노력하지 말고 자동화만 하세요
같은 재료를 계속해서 지루하게 모으는 일은 없습니다. 재료를 획득하고 깊은 매장지를 찾으면 드릴을 제작하여 수집을 자동화할 수 있습니다.
기지 건설

title: Better Mart
description:
게임 정보
Better Mart – Build and Manage Your Dream Supermarket!
Welcome to Better Mart, a dynamic management game, in 1st and 3rd person, where you create, customize, and grow the ultimate supermarket! Combining fun and strategy, this game gives you complete freedom to design a unique store, attract customers, and maximize your profits.
A Complete and Addictive Management Experience
In Better Mart, you have full control over every aspect of your supermarket. Choose the layout of your aisles, arrange products efficiently, and optimize customer flow to ensure a smooth and enjoyable shopping experience. Keep your shelves stocked, monitor market trends, and adjust your prices to outsmart the competition.
What Awaits You in Better Mart:
🔹 Build and customize your supermarket – Design the aisles, set up different areas, and create a welcoming environment for your customers.
🔹 Manage supply and inventory – Keep track of stock levels, order new products, and adjust prices based on market trends.
🔹 Grow your business – Hire and train staff, improve checkout efficiency, and invest in modern equipment.
🔹 Unlock new sections – Add a bakery, fresh produce section, electronics department, and much more to expand your offerings.
🔹 Enhance customer experience – Study customer behavior, optimize their shopping journey, and ensure their satisfaction.

title: Cat Packs - Bushido Blade
description:
게임 정보
Learn the Way of Bushido

A coming of age action rogue-like RPG that follows four heroes on an epic journey to save their homeland. Fast-paced action, stealth and strategy, changing runs and levels, experiment with different skills and builds!
A Hero's Journey

Battle (or sneak) your way through forests, high mountains, gold mines, and enemy territory. Encounter brainwashed foes, aggressive creatures, and ferocious bosses. Meet your allies at camp to gather your strength. RPG style dialogue tells the story of your rise to seasoned assassins. Music matches your environment. Orchestral, cinematic, and heart-pumping EDM tracks add to the immersive experience.
















With a classic rogue-like RPG style, each run will allow you to purchase permanent upgrades to all of your abilities. By defeating foes, powerful Ancient Insight will augment your abilities and grant you new weapons and skills. More powerful foes reward permanent items. The unique leveling system gives you hundreds of choices and allows you to explore different strategies and discover new areas.



With classic Comic-RPG style visuals, a strange and beautiful world awaits you. The rogue-like progression system will reveal new areas as you attempt new runs.

title: Store Empire
description:
게임 정보
낙원 같은 섬에 위치한 도시에서 상점 제국을 건설하고 비즈니스의 왕이 되세요. Store Empire에서, 당신은 작은 상점을 관리하는 것부터 시작해 다양한 상점을 인수하여 포트폴리오를 확장할 수 있습니다. 도둑으로부터 사업을 보호하고, 고객의 행동을 파악하며, 도시 전역에 광고를 하여 더 많은 소비자를 유치하세요. 도시의 축제나 축구 경기 날과 같은 무작위 이벤트에 대비하고, 고객의 특별한 요구를 충족시키기 위해 상점을 조정하세요. 전략과 계획을 통해 섬에서 가장 큰 상업 제국으로 성장시키세요!
도시는 플레이어에게 완전한 몰입감을 제공하기 위해 설계되었습니다. 상점에 가장 적합한 공급업체를 찾기 위해 다양한 창고와 시설을 탐험하세요. 손님이 없어서 한가한가요? 걱정하지 마세요! 광고 대행사에 들러 광고를 계약해 더 많은 손님을 끌어 모으세요. 재정이 어려워지면 은행에서 대출을 받을 수 있지만, 이자를 잘 관리하세요. 아무도 파산을 원하지 않으니까요.

title: SOLANIS
description:
게임 정보
A thousand years ago, humanity tore the moon from the sky, sealing it within you and chaining you to the earth. But all chains rust. It's time to spread your wings once more.
Soar between the ruins of a scarred world, exploring floating islands, hidden canyons, and breathtaking monuments, each with unique characters, challenges, and secrets to discover. Using powers divined from the the moon, transform into a shooting star and propel yourself through the air. Peer into the realm of darkness to aid your search for the fallen moon shards.
Your choices shape not only your journey, but the fate of those around you. Will you restore the moon to the sky, or forge a new destiny in a world of eternal light?

title: The Unrested
description:
게임 정보
버려진 기숙학교… 조용한 복도를 울리는 발자국 소리… 그리고 과거에서 돌아온 복수의 영혼…
몇 년 전, 기숙학교에서 일어난 비극적인 사건이 당신의 소중한 친구를 앗아갔습니다. 그러나 이 이야기는 죽음으로 끝나지 않았습니다. 이제, 당신은 편지를 통해 그 어두운 과거로 다시 호출되었습니다. 이 버려진 학교의 폐허 속에서, 당신의 친구의 불안한 영혼이 기다리고 있습니다.
버려진 방을 탐험하고, 숨겨진 열쇠를 찾고, 치명적인 위험의 손아귀에서 탈출하려고 노력하세요. 하지만 조심하세요… 그들은 당신의 모든 움직임을 지켜보고 있으며, 이번에는 당신을 무서워하게 만드는 것만으로 끝나지 않을 것입니다.

title: Office Outbreak Savior
description:
게임 정보
사무실이 무자비한 좀비 떼의 포위 공격을 받고 있습니다! 살아남아 동료를 보호할 수 있을까요? 무장하고, 동료들을 규합하고, 언데드 위협을 제거하기 위한 전략을 세우세요. 혼란 속에서 세상을 구하고 질서를 회복하는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 도전에 맞서 사무실에 필요한 영웅이 되시겠습니까?
좀비의 파도를 헤쳐나가세요
무자비한 좀비 무리와 싸우고 감염되지 않은 작업자를 안전한 곳으로 이끌어 구출하세요.
대의를 위해 동료를 모집하세요
군인, 의무병, 엔지니어, 운동선수 등 4개 클래스의 엘리트 동료들로 팀을 구성하여 직장을 지키세요.
레벨 업하고 강력한 무기를 획득하세요
당신과 신병의 기술을 향상시키고 점점 늘어나는 적들에 맞서기 위한 강력한 무기를 발견하세요.

title: Grist
description:
게임 정보
An ASCII-driven Sci-Fi RPG, GRIST takes place on the Shell World Atropos: A megaplanet consisting of multiple kiliometres-deep layers - worlds within worlds within worlds. From the mountainous terrain and scattered settlements of the surface, to the ancient temples and dark megacities of the interior, send your team ever deeper in search of the life-giving nanoparticle GRIST.
GRIST draws on a heritage of table-top RPGs, gamebooks, and classic CRPGs from the 1980s, resynthesizing them into a glowing terminal-wave aesthetic with driving basslines, exploding ASCII particles, and a healthy dose of existential horror.
Hexcrawl your way down into the depths of the Shell World finding lost civilisations and forgotten technologies
Take advantage of positioning in combat to avoid attacks, gain buffs, and out-manouever your enemy
Equip your team with build-defining cards salvaged from the battlefield or obtained on the black markets
Every game is different - it's a whole new Atropos each time, from locations to missions to story
A persistent meta-game that evolves based on your actions in each run

title: Slidezzle
description:
게임 정보
Slidezzle의 각 레벨은 신중한 사고와 전략적인 계획이 필요한 독특한 도전 과제를 제공합니다.
여러분의 목표는 모든 색깔 블록을 지정된 타일로 이동시키는 것입니다. 모든 블록은 동시에 같은 방향으로 움직이므로, 신중하게 계획해야 합니다.
일부 블록은 다른 블록을 돕기 위해 존재하며, 퍼즐을 해결하려면 정밀한 전략과 계획이 필요합니다. 이 블록들을 현명하게 활용하여 각 퍼즐을 해결하세요.

title: The victims of lost sunny days: Eclipse
description:
게임 정보
I was sorting through my old game discs. Among them, there were many games I played when I was a kid. All of them were labeled...
All of them except one.
It immediately caught my attention, and I decided to try playing it.
What bad could it possibly do?
There were game files on it. Nothing unusual, except for the strange name.
I launched it.
What is this? A children’s game?
It's so cute and colorful, but why do I have a feeling like something’s wrong..?
This ominous eclipse…
autokwd: The victims of lost sunny days: Eclipse

title: Princess Ursula
description:
게임 정보
Princess Ursula is a short and funny adventure game set in a folks tale setting of princes and princesses. Through the game you will play three different characters that each have their part in telling this modern re-imagining of the classic [i]Goldilocks and the Three Bears[/i] tale.
What you will find in Princess Ursula:
A wholesome story oriented adventure
An adaptation of a tale by professional story teller Yolaine
A host of fully animated characters
So many humorous hand-drawn animations
Around 1 hour of game time
A game that can be played, with mouse, keyboard or gamepad
French, English and Brazilian Portuguese translations
Some voiced narrations with sub-titles
An original soundtrack by Krale

title: SpreadCheat
description:
게임 정보
Excel과 회계가 이렇게 짜릿했던 적이 있었나요? SpreadCheat는 모든 공식이 중요한 독창적인 수학 퍼즐을 제공합니다.
90년대 금융계의 빠른 흐름 속으로 뛰어들어, 기업 브로 문화를 경험해 보세요. 숫자를 쥐어짜고, 상사의 실수를 덮어주고, 출세 가도를 달려보세요. 어쩌면, 당신도 '브로'가 되어버릴지도?!
MIDI 음악, 256가지 색상, 유쾌한 이메일 첨부 파일, 그리고 추억의 도우미 캐릭터 Corpy와 함께 90년대의 황금기를 다시 경험해 보세요!

title: Drop Duchy
description:
게임 정보
Drop Duchy는 모두가 알고 즐겨하는 기하학적 퍼즐 게임을 새로운 시각으로 재해석한 게임입니다. 단순히 줄을 지우는 대신 다양한 모양과 유형의 조각을 사용해 신중하게 왕국을 건설하고 적의 공격을 이겨내야 합니다.
덱빌딩, 퍼즐, 로그라이트가 혼합된 이 게임은 블록 쌓기 전략가로서의 재능을 연마할 수 있도록 설계된 새로운 게임 플레이를 제공합니다. 귀중한 자원을 모으고, 성을 지키고, 군대를 건설하려면 최적화가 중요합니다.
패배를 한다고 끝을 의미하는 것이 아닙니다. 이전 플레이에서 얻은 경험을 활용해 더 많은 콘텐츠를 해제하세요!
Drop Duchy에서는 매 라운드마다 새롭고 독특한 지형이 등장합니다. 일반적인 블록 떨어뜨리기 게임처럼 타일 조각을 배치하되, 활성 규칙을 최대화하여 자원과 유닛을 최대한 생산하도록 타일을 정렬해야 한다는 전략적 요소가 가미되어 있습니다.

title: Breakout Epilepsia
description:
게임 정보
Breakout Epilepsia


⚠ Epilepsy Warning ⚠
The name Epilepsia is not random. This game contains fast flashing lights, intense patterns, and strong visual effects that may trigger seizures in people with photosensitivity or epilepsy. If you're prone to seizures or feel this game could affect you, we strongly advise against playing it. Play responsibly and prioritize your health.



Dive into a fast-paced retro arcade experience that blends classic Breakout gameplay with boss battles inspired by Space Invaders. Smash blocks, dodge incoming attacks, and take on fierce enemies that will test your skills and reflexes.

Follow the journey of Scarlet, a Russian-Mexican heroine on a mission to recover the three stolen crystals that have drained all color from Earth. To restore balance, she must defeat their guardians: Bella, an unpredictable gamer with borderline personality disorder; Kira, a tentacled alien inspired by Kraken legends; and Luna, a gothic girl who acquired dark powers during her time on Earth.


✅ Striking black-and-white aesthetic with hypnotic effects.
✅ Fast-paced and challenging gameplay, perfect for short sessions.
✅ Three intense boss battles with unique mechanics.
✅ Classic Arkanoid/Breakout mechanics with a fresh twist.
✅ Space Invaders-style shooting sections during boss fights.



🎮 Victoria “Cataxis” Pérez

🎵 LosthinK

🎨 Camila Deloris, Death Voice & Quetzalcoutl

🎤: Camila Deloris, Dafne “Blakes” Muñoz , Ilce S Perez C, Kar “Pinkchocoball” Chávez, Neko Chibioso & Yulisa Viridiana Meza Gonzáles

🛠 Evangelo Ruiz, Celeste “Levalotte” Uribe, JuanGdev, kaydev, Diego A. Gómez, Bryan Hernández Cabrera, Ilce S Pérez C, Lalo Rejón, Eduardo Emmanuel Barba Aldana, Eliana Ricci

title: Green Heights
description:
게임 정보
정상에 도달하세요!
Green Heights는 부드럽고 만족스러운 움직임을 갖춘 1인칭 수직 정밀 플랫폼 게임입니다. 독특한 테라리움 같은 환경에서 설정되어 탑을 올라 정상에 도달하세요.
일어서세요.

title: Swords & Bones 5
description:
게임 정보
Swords & Bones 5 is the ultimate conclusion to the saga. It’s also the most challenging chapter, designed to test the skills of veterans who have played every installment!
Take on the role of Basil, an apprentice archer transformed into a rat-man by a demon. You’ll be able to purchase enchanted arrows and wield a dagger to defeat enemies.
Collect power-ups and tackle new challenges in mouse form, with gameplay designed around hardcore platforming mechanics.
Gather all the Heroes’ Trophies and restore peace to the kingdom!
Features:
A new ability that lets you transform into a tiny mouse!
The final chapter of the saga, with unparalleled difficulty!
A revamped magic system using enchanted arrows!
A new story!
Improved graphics and sound!
Power up your hero collecting coins!
Over 50 action-packed levels!
6 fearsome bosses ready to fight!
Two endings to discover!
Pixel-art graphics in 16-bit style!
An epic and dark chiptune soundtrack!
Achievements!

title: Mr. Blob's Honey-Do List
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
After seeing his neighbor's failing marriage Mr. Blob decides to make a “Honey-Do List” of things he wants to do for his wife to improve their marriage. He’s always been a little klutzy and not very adventurous. Knowing this he goes to the public fountain, tosses some money in, and wishes for help on his list of items to do for his wife. Unbeknownst to him the universe listened. A duo of pixies hearing his wishes decided they were pure in nature and a fair trade for a few coins.
For all three scenarios in this game you will play as pixies in some form or another to help Mr. Blob on his quest to do something special for the wife he loves.
Mr. Blob’s Honey Do List
❖     Go to the moon and get a beautiful moon gem for Mrs. Blob
❖     Collect a bouquet of wild flowers for Mrs. Blob.
❖     Redecorate the house with new furniture for Mrs. Blob
Moon Gem
This is a 2D side scrolling space arcade game. Player 1 will guide Mr. Blob's ship to avoid all incoming asteroids. Player 2 will speed up or slow down asteroids to prevent them from hitting Mr. Blob's passenger ship. The goal is to safely escort Mr. Blob's ship to the moon.
Flower Collection
This is a 2D side view static platformer. Player 1 and 2 must work together to pick up a dozen flowers for Mr. Blob to give to his wife before night sets in. Flowers are placed throughout the level and will re-spawn after being picked up. Avoid the bees as they will sting your pixie and cause the pixie to drop any flowers they are holding. Once 12 flowers have been placed in the basket the level is complete.
House Redecoration
This is a 2D isometric strategic turn based game. Player 1 and 2 must place the new furniture around the room in its designated spots. Mr. Blob will bring in a new piece of furniture after each turn. When picking up the furniture it's optional placement spots will highlight green. If the players run out of turns or the furniture piles up at the entrance the game is lost. Once all furniture has been placed in a valid position the game is won.

title: Savara
description:
게임 정보
In this dynamic and colorful action roguelite, delve into a fascinating universe where each decision matters and where strategy is rewarded. You've been invited to take part in grandiose festivities organized for the pleasure of Iop the warrior god. These aren't your typical celebrations – they were designed to put the most valiant fighters in the dimension to the test.
Get ready for a major challenge by arming yourself with your best weapons and selecting your equipment with care. Each weapon has its own characteristics and advantages, and choosing your arsenal wisely will be vital for your survival and success.

title: Bygone Dreams: Prophecy
description:
게임 정보
Bygone dreams: Prophecy is a prologue version of the full game Bygone Dreams, it features first 2 levels with 2-3 hours of gameplay depending on difficulty settings and your skills.
VANQUISH THE NIGHTMARE, RESTORE THE DREAM
Winner of the Reboot Develop "Visual Excellence" award.
Winner at the 2021 WN Dev Contest as chosen by Epic Games.
Bygone Dreams is a high fantasy action adventure with RPG elements set in a surreal dream world.
The dream land of Lume, under the protection of its matron deity, is being threatened by a terrible Nightmare. Embodying the spirit known as Wa, you are the world's last hope for survival.
To aid you in your quest, you must seek out the world's Guardians - powerful creatures worshiped and revered in times long before the corruption seeped in. However, the task ahead is anything but easy, as the Guardians themselves succumbed to the Nightmare.

title: Captain Blood
description:
게임 정보
There will be BLOOD!



Captain Blood is a pirate-themed action game set on the Spanish Main in the 17th century, where you step into the boots of a fearsome pirate on a quest for gold and glory. Expect wild adventures with cannon firing, pistol shooting, swashbuckling sword fights, and plenty of pirate shenanigans. This action-packed hack'n'slash features fierce hand-to-hand combat, hordes of enemies, and a classic fighting system with flashy combos and epic finishers.

Prepare for intense deck battles where you can fire the ship's cannons and fend off blood-thirsty boarding crews. Collect gold to upgrade your fighting skills, buy new weapons, and become the most feared buccaneer on the high seas. Fight for wealth and glory!

Key features:

Epic Pirate Shenanigans: As Captain Blood, live the life of the bravest and most fearsome pirate on the Spanish Main (or at least fake it convincingly).
Intense Action: Dive into fiery hand-to-hand combat and show enemy pirates and landlubbers alike who's the boss with various slick combat techniques.

title: Soaked
description:
게임 정보
An Online Beach Party For 1-8 Players
How To Play
In the Tower game mode, you can play as a Survivor or as the Soaker.
As a Survivor, you start on the wobbly tower and earn stars by staying dry. Push other players off the tower, or work together to plan against the soaker. Use water balloons, geysers, or the ocean to soak other players. Items are dropped when a player gets soaked, even the Soaker's water cannon will be up for grabs.
As the Soaker, you start on the beach and earn stars by soaking players. Use the water cannon to push objects into the geysers and launch them towards the tower! You can store the water cannon on your back to use other items, but it will still drop if you get soaked.
If any player gets soaked, they can still try to earn a star by spin-drying their character and attempting a bonus challenge. These are things like making nice throws, popping water balloons, reaching flying platforms, and completing jump challenges.

title: METAL EDEN
description:
게임 정보
METAL EDEN은 짜릿함이 가득한 SF FPS 게임입니다.
최신 하이퍼 유닛 아스카가 되어 인류의 희망이 담긴 보금자리에서 치명적인 환경으로 변한 거대 집적 도시 뫼비우스로 침투해 시민들의 코어를 구하는 자살 임무를 수행하세요.
사이버네틱 전장에서 내부 방어 부대를 돌파하고, 엔지니어와 맞서며 에덴 프로젝트에 감춰진 비밀을 밝혀내세요.
사이버네틱 전장에 뛰어들어 인공물로 이루어진 세계의 비밀을 지키는 기계 부대와 맞서세요. 강하고 민첩한 기계 부대 및 원소 병력 등 다양한 적과 싸우세요. 에너지 코어를 추출하고 내부 방어 부대의 보호막을 파괴해 전투 지역에서 우위를 점하세요. 다양한 무기와 전투 능력을 개발해 무적의 하이퍼 유닛으로 거듭나세요.
여러분은 팬텀 코어를 동력으로 움직이는 보호 및 정찰 임무에 특화된
최신 전투형 안드로이드, 하이퍼 유닛입니다. 대시, 그래플, 월 러닝 등 뛰어난 파쿠르 스킬을 사용해 내부 방어 부대를 돌파하세요. 뛰어난 민첩성과 유연한 전투 능력을 활용해 위기 상황을 돌파하세요. 장갑을 두른 램볼로 변신해 적진에 돌격하고 치명적인 신형 기계 부대를 상대하세요. 그래비티 훅과 제트팩으로 하늘을 제압하고, 전장을 장악하세요.

title: Doggos in Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
Doggos in Dungeon is a compact dungeon crawler with high mobility exploration and a heavy emphasis on strategic combat.
You'll explore, fight, collect loot, and solve puzzles to reach the top of the tower and save the floating citadel from crashing to the ground.
Most dungeon crawlers have you glued to the floor, but here you'll be jumping, climbing, and dashing as you collect loot and outmaneuver your opponents.
Features:
Turn-Based Grid Movement
Unique Combat
Metroidvania Style Unlocks
Puzzles

title: 100 hidden Cats : Ninja
description:
게임 정보
100 hidden Cats Ninja is a hidden objects/hidden creatures game. The player's task is to find all hundred cats on the map.
The game is decorated with atmospheric and hand-drawn graphics, the kittens are cozy and cute.
100 Ninja kittens to find
hand-drawn graphics
progress record

title: Hyperborea
description:
게임 정보
Hyperborea is a modern take on the classic First-person shooter game Wolfenstein 3D - the game that kick started the FPS revolution has been re-imagined in modern high definition graphics that is sure to push modern graphics cards to their limits. Fresh and exciting visuals for a hyper-eccentric modern era. This game is not for the low spec'd. 😉
A game, a modern benchmark, a fun and relaxing shooter, will it run Hyperborea?
You play the entire game armed with a very capable shotgun; but missing a shot will double the cool down time for the next shot. Staying in flow is vital.
Always watch your back because it's side swipes from enemies when turning corners that can catch you out.
There is no health in this game, if a monster gets near to you - that's it you die. You will however obtain a crucifix/caduceus for every 4 kills which will give you a short protection if caught by a monster, this protection lasts 3 seconds and protects you from the initial monster that caught you and any further monsters in the next 3 second time period.
Monsters make no noise until you kill them, your only way of detecting them is visually when you see them or when the way-point hand begins to shake, it will shake more aggressively the closer you are and it will only shake when an enemy is somewhere in the direction you are currently facing.
Fight your way through the hordes of enemies and complete the game, there's no story-line, just a mindless shooter with a progression through new and interesting high definition 3D content and world geometry, think of it as a relaxing adventure through a modern take on the classic Wolfenstein 3D game, the game-play is a satisfyingly repetitive shooter set in memorably themed environments where the visuals are ever changing as you progress from environment to environment on your quest to the ultimate final goal - whatever that may be.

title: Eternal Decay Souls
description:
게임 정보
Solve puzzles. Overcome challenges. Explore a world full of mysteries.
In Eternal Decay Souls, you embark on a journey through ancient ruins, forgotten temples and exotic landscapes, solving intriguing puzzles and overcoming platforming challenges to restore balance to a world on the brink of collapse.
📜 The Story
The ancient Crystal of Harmony has been shattered, spreading its energy across different regions and leaving the world in chaos. Now, adventurers can activate mystical portals and prevent darkness from consuming everything. But the journey will not be easy…
Puzzles and challenges. Solve puzzles, discover hidden patterns and manipulate mechanisms, search and activate platforms to advance.
Collect different Relics to evolve – Coins, gems and relics
In the last portal, a Dark Guardian protects the key to restoring balance… but the end of the journey may be just the beginning.
Get ready for a journey! Do you have what it takes to unlock the secrets of Eternal Decay Souls?

title: Funny Volleyball
description:
게임 정보
"Funny Volleyball" is a modern remake of the classic arcade volleyball game from the 90s, giving new emotions and nostalgia. Immerse yourself in bright and picturesque landscapes, enjoying the game, but do not forget about the main goal - victory! Take part in an exciting arcade tournament or play quick matches. Fight with a smart opponent controlled by the computer, or challenge your friend. Get ready for fun battles and unforgettable moments on the court!
Game Features
Character Selection
Each character in the game has unique characteristics that affect the gameplay style. You can choose a character with high stamina, powerful strikes, impressive jump height, or increased movement speed, allowing you to adapt the gameplay to your preferences.
Variety of Court Locations
Each tennis court is set in a unique location, adding diversity to the gameplay. You can play on slippery ice, where characters will face difficulties in control, or on a sandy court that slows down running and requires greater agility and strategy from you.
Difficulty Levels
The game offers various difficulty levels, allowing every player to find the right challenge. You can face an easy opponent for a casual experience or test your skills against an artificial intelligence that will become a true master of the game, requiring maximum concentration and skill from you to win.

title: Cash Cleaner Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Cash Cleaner Simulator welcomes you into the life of low-level criminal with a very specific specialty. When your underworld contacts need dirty money to come back squeaky clean, they call you.
Each delivery is different. Arriving in bags, boxes, or stuffed into mattresses, it's your job to retrieve it all, identify any problems like dirt, blood or counterfeit bills, and get to work. Your clients expect results! Do your job well, or do whatever it takes, and reap the rewards.
In your downtime, order new tools to increase your efficiency or scale up your operation. Or buy useless stuff to cozy up your place!
Take on jobs at your own pace, expand your cleaning services to gold bars, ancient statues, and more. Explore your lab...you may need more than just your eyes to discover its secrets. And maybe ask yourself how you got here...and why can't you leave?
In this demo, you will have access to a variety of equipment and tools normally unlocked over time in the full game. Take on jobs, experiment, and clean some cash!
Good Clean Money
Use washing machines, dryers, counting machines, and other tools to clean dirty cash. After cleaning, don’t forget to count it and send it to your handlers! Maybe not all of it; the money pile doesn’t grow by itself! Progress through the jobs to upgrade your gear and unlock new ways to handle the money!
New Phone, Who Dis?

title: Empyreal
description:
게임 정보
Empyreal은 도전 정신을 불러일으키는 고난도 액션 RPG입니다.
은하계 먼 곳, 지금껏 인간의 발이 닿지 않은 행성에서 사라진 문명이 남긴 거대한 유적에 대한 탐사가 시작됩니다.
하지만 유적 안은 위험으로 가득하고, 유적의 비밀을 밝히기에 탐사의 장비는 턱없이 부족합니다.
거듭되는 실패 속에서 이제 모든 이목은 일말의 가능성을 가진 뛰어난 용병에게 집중되고 있습니다.
유적 안을 탐험하며 이 미지의 구조물을 건설한 고대 문명이 남겨 놓은 로봇들을 상대하세요. 끝까지 생존해 인류에 대한 이해를 완전히 뒤바꿀 비밀을 밝혀내세요.
게임플레이 및 전투:
세 가지 무기 유형인 검, 메이스와 방패, 캐논 중 하나를 선택하세요. 무기별로 핵심 작동 방식이 달라 각각 고유한 플레이 스타일을 경험할 수 있습니다.
Empyreal의 특징은 RPG 시스템과 스킬 기반 전투의 독특한 조합입니다. 완벽한 타이밍에 공격, 회피, 막기를 시전하거나, 완벽한 타이밍에 다양한 능력을 시전해 추가 효과를 얻어 전투의 흐름을 휘어잡으세요.
강력한 새 장비를 찾고, 광범위한 모드 시스템을 통해 능력치를 조정하고, 빌드를 완벽하게 손보세요.

title: Dunk Dunk
description:
게임 정보
Dunk Dunk is a basketball game unlike any other, mixing a unique cartoony aesthetic, the strategy and precision of basketball with the chaotic fun of multiplayer arena platforming action, making for some nail-bitingly tense matches.

Play alone, with a friend or a house full of friends. Dress up your mascots and dunk basketballs, balloons or even anvils in crazy locations from all over the universe like space stations, dinosaur parks and haunted houses. It's dunk or be dunked (on).




Plays like your favourite platformer with familiar and simple controls meaning anyone can take to the court and start dunking.




– Total 360° analogue arm control allows you to AIM, THROW and slam DUNK the ball at the exact angle you want.
– Defend your goal! Extend your whole body for a stretchy block or deflection to keep your opponents from scoring. Or, become a platform to help your teammates reach that hoop.
– Fool your opponent with a fake throw or shield the ball by holding it out of your opponent's reach.




Play solo or co-op with a friend in Quick Match, or against increasingly harder opponents in Galaxy Tour, Challenge or Cup modes. Or take on a friend, or up to 16 friends, in local multiplayer across the Quick Match, Mutator Madness and Tournament modes.




Want to play as a purple-robo-vampire-shark? We got it covered. Customise your characters with hundreds of different body parts and more than 2 and a half million procedural team and player names. Who knows, there might even be cameo appearances.




Play across 8 unique arenas from all over the universe. From an underwater lab to dinosaur times and a marooned space station, each arena has its own special features.

title: LongStory 2
description:
게임 정보
The friendliest dating sim on the planet is back and ready to cuddle! A long-awaited sequel to the award-winning visual novel LongStory, our new season picks up where the first ended — the summer before high school begins.
When Turkeyhawk goes missing from a Welcome Home party for Marcel, it’s up to you to find your feathered friend before the school year begins.
It seems like everyone has a theory to share, is busy birdwatching online, or will happily feed the rumor mill. But does the person who left the turkey suit sitting in your closet even want to be found? And if they aren’t Turkey anymore, are they even your friend?
It’s a mess, socially speaking, but don’t worry, there’s still plenty of time for dates and flirtations, even if your romantic escapades keep colliding with quirky detective adventures.
Dive back into life with the most hilarious and heartwarming group of friends you’ll ever encounter in a game!
Episode 1: Surprise!

title: Creature Keeper
description:
게임 정보
Assemble your dream team by befriending a variety of unique Creatures to fight alongside you in real time. Choose your Creatures wisely to best handle any challenge that stands in your way!
Create powerful, diverse, and stylish playstyles through gameplay-altering skill gems, perks, weapons and more while looking the part with tons of hats to dress your Creatures up in.
Use your Pocket Garden to grow food and create helpful Connection Bonuses for your Creatures in an engaging organization mini-game.

title: The Midnight Walk
description:
게임 정보
로스트 인 랜덤 개발진이 신작 어드벤처 게임, 미드나이트 워크로 돌아왔습니다!
이제 길 잃은 랜턴 괴물의 친구가 되어, 친구의 빛과 함께 기묘하면서도 공포 어린 세계를 탐험해 보세요! 괴물들을 따돌리고, 찰흙 스톱 모션 애니메이션으로 만들어낸 으스스하고 세밀한 세계를 직접 확인해 보세요.

title: Mall Heist
description:
게임 정보
Mall Heist에 오신 것을 환영합니다 - 스텔스 어드벤처!

Mall Heist에서 당신은 단순한 교활한 도둑이 아닙니다. 당신은 쇼핑몰 보안 테스트 기관의 정예 요원입니다. 궁극적인 도전: 완벽한 강도를 수행하여 쇼핑몰의 보안 결함을 폭로합니다. 경비원들과 대면하고, 시스템을 해킹하고, 쇼핑몰 보안의 취약점을 강조하세요. 슈퍼마켓의 당근이나 베이커리의 도넛과 같은 쇼핑몰 환경에서 찾은 물건들만으로 무장하고, 각 임무는 당신의 창의력과 전략적 사고를 시험하는 테스트가 됩니다. 이러한 일상적인 물건들을 창의적으로 사용하여 각 강도를 헤쳐 나가세요. 여기서 적응력과 빠른 사고는 은밀한 능력만큼 중요합니다.

은밀함이 당신의 가장 큰 무기
조용히 움직이며, 그림자 속에 숨고, 탐지를 피하세요. 당신의 은밀한 기술이 성공을 결정할 것입니다. 주변 환경을 이용해 눈에 띄지 않게 완벽한 강도를 실행하고, 당신의 기관의 보안 테스트 방법의 효과를 증명하세요.



다양한 도구들
기발한 즉흥적인 아이디어 없이 어떻게 강도를 할 수 있겠습니까? 식료품 부문의 미끄러운 바나나 껍질에서 신발 가게의 잘 배치된 부츠에 이르기까지, 주변 환경이 바로 당신의 무기고입니다. 발 빠르게 생각하고 이러한 예상치 못한 물건들을 사용하여 경비원들을 제압하고 강도를 진행하세요.




경비원을 피하는 것은 시작에 불과합니다. 발각되면 달리고, 피하고, 환경을 사용하여 탈출해야 합니다. 이에는 밀접한 만남을 위한 신뢰할 수 있는 근접 무기도 포함됩니다. 이 고위험 시나리오는 회피 전술을 시험합니다.




우리의 AI 경비원들은 쉽게 다룰 수 있는 상대가 아닙니다. 그들은 순찰을 돌고, 추적하며, 당신의 행동에 반응합니다. 잘못된 움직임 하나가 당신을 포위하게 할 수 있으니 항상 경계하세요. 그들의 고급 AI 행동은 현실적인 보안 테스트 시나리오를 만듭니다.




Mall Heist는 단순한 게임이 아닙니다. 그것은 당신의 전략, 속도, 은밀함을 테스트하는 것입니다. 예술적 매력과 스텔스 장르에 대한 가벼운 접근 방식으로, 계속해서 돌아오게 만들 강도의 연속에 참여할 준비를 하세요! 최고 수준의 보안 테스트 요원으로서의 실력을 증명하고 가장 안전한 쇼핑몰의 취약점을 폭로하세요!

title: Revenge of the Savage Planet
description:
게임 정보
파이오니어 프로그램(PIONEER PROGRAM)에 가입하신 것을 환영합니다!
회사의 탐욕과 자신의 어리석움으로 혼란에 빠진채 당신은 곧 해고되여 멀리 떨어진 우주 가장자리로 버려집니다. 당신은 거의 아무런 장비, 안전장치도 없는 상황에서 시작합니다. 구석구석을 탐험하고 업그레이드 아이템을 수집하며, 외계의 신비로운 바위를 하나하나 뒤집어 보며 과거 고용주에게 복수하고, 지구로 돌아갈 기회를 찾아야 합니다.

여러 행성에 도착하고 다양한 도전에 직면합합니다. 목표는 이 아름다운 외계 세계를 탐험하고 이해하는 것입니다. 식물을 스캔하고, 괴물을 포획하며, 호수로 잠수하고, 동굴을 탐험하며, 산을 오르고, 업그레이드 아이템을 제작하세요. 그리고 셀 수 없이 많은 비밀들이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다...

재미있는 협력 콘텐츠
친구, 파트너 또는 라이벌과 임의 플랫폼에서 함께 게임을 즐기세요. 심지어 크로스 플랫폼 플레이도 가능합니다! 같은 소파에 앉아 같은 화면을 공유하며 옛날게임 갬성을 즐기실수 있습니다. 마치 예전처럼 단순하고 행복했던 순간으로 돌아가세요.

이 세계에서는 자유롭게 달리고, 점프하고, 사격하고, 부수고, 밟고, 회피하고, 활공하고, 채찍질하고, 포획할 수 있습니다! 3가지 독특한 점액(goo)도 시도해보세요! 올가미(Lasso)로 다양한 외계 생물을 잡아 주거지(Habitat) 근처의 우리(Pen)에 가둬보세요!

거대하고 생명력 넘치는 4개의 행성, 각 행성마다 독특한 식물과 생물이 있습니다. 모든 것을 스캔하고 기록하며, 다양한 실험을 완수하여 과학 레벨(science level)을 올리세요...이러한 것들은 더 많은 멋진 장비를 해제할수 있는 열쇠입니다! 그리고... 행성이 4개뿐만 아닐 수도 있죠! 누가 알겠어요?

외계 식물! 기괴한 생물! 멋진 장비! 기묘한 광석! 각 행성의 구석구석에는 수많은 보상과 비밀들이 숨겨져 있습니다. 다양한 아이템들은 당신의 커스터마이징 우주 트레일러(Space Trailer)에 전시할 수도 있습니다.

title: Chronomon
description:
게임 정보
신비한 생물로 가득한 포스트 아포칼립스 세계를 배경으로 하는 크로노몬은 몬스터 길들이기와 농장 시뮬레이션을 결합하여 하나의 매끄러운 경험을 선사합니다. 그들을 잡아 훈련시키고 진화시킨 다음, 무역과 단일하게 이어지지 않는 퀘스트를 통해 마을을 통합하고 모두를 위협하는 악당을 물리치면서 에포크 신디케이트에 맞서 싸우세요. 자기 자신을 돌보는 것을 잊지 마세요. 활기차고 끊임없이 변화하는 세상에서 풍성한 식사와 충분한 수면은 크로노몬만큼이나 중요한 요소입니다!
경험을 공유하고 싶으신가요? 스마트워치(Android WearOS 2.0 이상)를 포함한 모든 기기에서 교차 저장을 지원하므로 어디서든 플레이할 수 있으며, 친구들과 함께 강력한 무역 네트워크를 구축하거나 크로노몬 배틀에서 서로에게 도전하세요!
백 마리의 몬스터 길들이기
당신을 위해 싸우고, 탐험하고, 농장에서 일할 100 마리 이상의 몬스터 (고유 한 특성을 가진 일반 및 희귀 품종 모두)를 잡으세요!
강력한 RPG 시스템으로 각 몬스터를 훈련시켜 플레이 스타일에 맞게 조정하고 맞춤화할 수 있습니다.: 39개의 스킬 트리와 300개 이상의 고유 스킬, 전투에서 퍼펙트 히트, 몬스터 각인, 특수 지속 효과로 더욱 업그레이드된 스킬을 획득하세요!
크로노몬과 함께 퍼즐을 풀고, 독특한 능력을 사용하여 맵 곳곳에 흩어져 있는 도전을 극복하고 특별한 보물을 잠금 해제하세요!
농장에서 일하게 하여 농장을 처음부터 재건하고 특별한 보상을 얻으세요!
종말 이후의 농장

title: Pixelshire
description:
게임 정보

픽셀샤이어에서 단순한 동료의 관계를 뛰어넘는 우정을 쌓으세요. 이 친구들은 당신과 함께 모험을 떠나 자원 모으는 걸 도와주고 과제 완료하는 걸 도와주는 동료가 되어줄 것입니다. “따라가기” 기능을 통해 픽셀샤이어 속에서의 여정을 더욱 재미있고 흥미롭게 만들어 보세요..


독특한 테라포밍 기능을 이용해서 픽셀샤이어의 땅을 원하는 대로 바꿔 보세요. 취향에 따라 강을 깎거나 아름다운 언덕을 쌓아서 자신의 상상력을 마음껏 펼쳐 보세요.


마을 사람들의 과제를 도와주다 보면 각 NPC의 직업과 연관된 새로운 스킬과 재능을 잠금 해제하여 더욱 힘차고 효율적으로 일할 수 있게 됩니다. 예를 들어, 패럴 선장의 재능을 잠금 해제하면 요리 실력이 향상돼서 추가로 스태미나 회복 효과를 제공하는 더욱 맛있는 요리를 만들 수 있게 됩니다!


마을 주민을 위해 집을 짓고 배치할 수 있는 능력을 이용하면 각 주민의 성격과 취향을 반영하여 픽셀샤이어의 구석구석을 디자인할 수 있습니다. 자유로운 마을 디자인 기능을 통해 각 주민에게 취향에 맞고 개성 넘치는 집을 선사하세요.


스릴 넘치는 모험을 떠나 방대한 아르카디아의 대륙을 탐험하세요. 마법으로 가득한 땅을 여행하고 곳곳에 흩어져 있는 숨겨진 보물을 발견하세요. 위험천만한 던전 속으로 들어가고, 값진 광석을 캐고, 땅 밑에 묻혀 있는 비밀을 파헤치세요.

title: Vendetta Forever
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Cult Action Paradise
Vendetta Forever fuses rapid-fire tactical gunplay with effortless acrobatic style in an unapologetic love letter to classic action cinema.
Powered by Lo-Kill-Motion
Shoot to kill. Kill to move. Dispatch foes and seize their weapon in mid-air to propel yourself forward. Strategically plot your next move with each takedown in a frantic fight to the bitter end.
Live your action-movie power fantasy
Rampage through over 60 snackable slices of ultra-stylish strategic shooting. Every moment is a homage to cult cinematic mayhem, spanning raucous saloon shoot-outs to high-tech hijackings at 30,000 feet. Take center stage and blast, zip and slice through enemies to a pounding synthetic soundtrack.
A million ways to die, choose wisely
At your disposal is an outrageous arsenal – some improvised, some irregular, all iconic. Snatch-up the timeless silenced pistols, lock-in on foes with a high-powered sniper rifle or even orchestrate brutally beautiful takedowns with the humble pencil. We provide the iconic scenarios – you do what the movies taught you.

title: Double Trip
description:
게임 정보
Double Trip 은 두 명의 친절한 캐릭터의 도움을 받아 퍼즐을 해결하는 타일 기반 소코반 게임입니다. 다양한 요소들이 서로 어떻게 상호작용하는지 배우며 아름다운 섬을 탐험하세요.
분기된 경로를 따라 세계를 탐험하고, 아름답고 생동감 있는 아트 스타일을 감상하며, 편안한 오리지널 사운드트랙을 들어보세요.
바위를 구멍에 밀어 넣고 통나무를 사용해 섬들을 연결하며, 모든 플레이어들에게 적합한 다양한 잘 설계된 레벨을 즐기세요.
더 복잡한 추가 스테이지에 도전하며 자신에게 도전해 보세요.
싱글플레이어 경험을 즐기거나, 로컬 2인 협동 모드를 통해 친구들과 문제 해결의 순간을 공유해 보세요.
완전히 커스터마이징 가능한 캐릭터로 자신만의 개성을 표현해 보세요!
단순한 오브젝트 속에서 깊은 메커니즘을 발견하세요.

title: Susan's Potion Workshop
description:
게임 정보
Enter Suzan's magical world — a young witch with big dreams and a bubbling cauldron! She’s just opened her potion shop, but she needs your help to make it a success.
💫 Match, Mix, Brew!
Jump into a fast-paced match-3 adventure!
🧪 Discover Unique Potions
Brew all kinds of magical potions with unique effects and fun designs.
🏰 Upgrade Your Workshop
Turn Suzan’s shop into the coziest potion spot around.
Help Suzan become the most famous witch in the land!

title: Kkokko Industry
description:
게임 정보

안녕하세요, 저는 꼬꼬 인더스트리의 개발자인 Happyone입니다.

title: Rhythm Witch: Beat Death
description:
게임 정보
Rhythm Witch: Beat Death is a game that melds rhythm and survival. Attack to the rhythm of the music while dodging monsters who move and attack to the beat. On your journey to eternal beauty, defeat dancing freaks, ghouls, dragon, and more!
Sibel the Rhythm Witch is a necromancer whose one and only goal is eternal beauty.
Dyeing her hair, bathing in blood, collecting magic and mystical herbs, modifying her body... She'll do anything if it'll make her more beautiful!
Of course, the hard and dirty work is left to the skeletons she summons. On her quest for beauty, she hears tell of the Deathless Tower, which spawns an endless stream of monsters, and—so the rumor goes—holds a treasure that grants immortality.
If she gets her hands on that treasure, she can stay young and beautiful forever!
What's there to wait for?
Skeletons! To the Deathless Tower!
In Rhythm Witch, music is not just background—it’s the heart of battle! Players must follow dynamically generated beats, striking enemies with precision while dodging attacks. Hitting the beat accurately quickly builds weapon energy, allowing for powerful skill releases. Maintaining a combo will trigger Frenzy Mode, significantly increasing attack speed and rhythm tempo, creating a seamless, exhilarating combat experience.

title: Burning House
description:
게임 정보
The development team Autremelon presents you with the first challenge!
In the Burning House, rogue-like unite with your stress, the tasks of space exploration, resource allocation, and house-destroying fire to catch you off guard!
Seek in the darkness
The darkness has hidden the "keys" and "doors" from you—find at least a match and seize a piece of fire’s essence to make out the path.
Look around
The house is falling apart, but find the silver lining—find a way to turn the collapsing floor, falling beams, and fragile walls to your advantage. Discover useful items in the dark basement or shorten your path. Break what’s still standing if it helps you!

title: The Kill Zone
description:
게임 정보
Play as a contestant on the most violent game show of all time, The Kill Zone! In this top-down shooter, you'll murder hundreds of attackers in brutal fashion on your way to epic showdowns against challenging bosses. Dual-stick controls allow you to move and attack in all directions. Crouch behind objects or roll to evade attacks.

Try not to feel too bad for the attackers as you slaughter them in a blood bath. We get to know more about certain attackers in the 'Featured Story' segment, where we take a look into their personal life and motivation for joining The Kill Zone, right before entering the arena and facing certain death. Other segments throughout the show will keep you entertained, as well as a rowdy announcer calling all the action.

Features:
10 Diverse Contestants: Unlock up to 10 characters, each with unique attributes that will help or hurt you in the competition.
5 Arenas: Play in 5 different arenas, each with it's own unique set of weapons. Ten levels in all.
Leaderboard: Track your all time kills and see where you match up with players from around the world.
Co-operative Multiplayer: Support for up to 4 players using Photon Pun.
Gamepad Support: Support for Xbox and PS4 style gamepads.

title: KeyLess
description:
게임 정보
Keyless is a jump and run platformer, with very unique logic puzzles.
By starting the game you get into a dispute between logicians and poets.
As a result you lose access to the keys on your keyboard!
You will have to think differently than usual to regain control!
But don’t be afraid, you will understand. Finally. Just keep playing.
In KeyLess you will:
- have to fix the broken keyboard to continue playing,
- solve logic puzzles. KeyLess is mainly a jump-and-run puzzle adventure,
- look behind the facade of the dispute between poets and logicians,
- understand the strange plan to disable your keys,
- be forced to become part of the dispute,
- stumble across many mathematical peculiarities by the logicians, but also
- discover the corresponding and famous quotes from the poets.
Features:
- Beautiful music
- beautiful low-poly-grafic at the poets areas
- rigorous architecture at the logicians areas
- new to the world puzzles
- 2D as well as 3D movement
Warning: This is an Indie game! Expect the unexpected.

title: Tears of Vanfell
description:
게임 정보

Tears of Vanfell is an action-packed dungeon crawler with roguelike and hack-'n-slash elements. Choose between a wide cast of characters and climb the Mountain as you swap weapons and grow stronger as a team of up to four player in online Co-op.


Explore and climb the procedurally-generated Mountain to find and defeat Bosses, and continue on your journey.

During your adventure, you'll pick up powerful new abilities, weapons and equipment, all of which you'll need to use if you plan on surviving.



Explore the Mountain with a team of up to four players! Or, if you would rather take on the Mountain by yourself, don't worry -- you may also bring another member of your camp to help you out.


Prepare yourself for your next expedition at your campsite. At first, it will be just you and your thoughts... but as you explore, you'll find others willing to help you out -- from other explorers with unique skills, to specialists who can help behind the scenes.



During your adventures, you'll meet many characters and grow to understand them and their motivations. But you may also find yourself caught up in the aftermath of a century-old war...

title: The Beresd family
description:
게임 정보
Robert Beresford lived happily in his family mansion, alongside his daughters Elizabeth, Charlotte, Anne, Matilda, and Victoria, the butler Zachary, and the housekeeper Theresa. His businesses were thriving, and peace and joy filled the house.

However, the night of July 20, 1824, everything changed for the Beresford family.

Robert woke from his sleep, restless and fearful of a looming sense of dread.

In the stillness of the night, beneath the shimmering stars, footsteps echoed through the corridors, voices and whispers in the darkness, followed by bursts of fire and screams of agony. Robert rushed out of his room, determined to discover what had shattered the peace of his tranquil family mansion, but his soul was not prepared for all he would encounter on that tragic night.

But what really happened?

Alongside Sheriff Cooper, Robert Beresford will investigate the events of those cursed hours, tracing the steps of each inhabitant of the mansion and uncovering the terrible truth hidden within the darkness of the night.

The resurgence of an ancient curse whose echoes resonate to this day.



Enjoy a mystery and horror novel in which you'll have to investigate and interrogate all its inhabitants to uncover the truth.

title: RPG Chess
description:
게임 정보
RPG CHESS - A TURN-BASED RPG, EXCEPT IT'S ALSO CHESS!
Step into a world where every move is a potential battle for glory! RPG Chess reimagines the classic game of chess as an epic turn-based RPG adventure, combining strategy, combat, and other beloved RPG elements in a way you've never experienced before.
FEATURES:
Strategic Chess Gameplay with an RPG Twist:
Every attack initiates a battle! Instead of capturing pieces, you’ll enter intense 1v1 combat sequences where your piece must fight for victory. The outcome depends on your strategy, piece level, and skill in battle. While the attacker gets the first move, the targeted piece finally gets to fight back!
Piece Progression and Leveling:
Each time a piece moves, fights, or secures victory in combat, it gains valuable experience points. Level up your heroes to unlock stronger abilities and stat boosts, transforming even a humble pawn into a mighty warrior.
Branching Evolution Paths:
As your pieces level up, you’ll decide how they grow. Choose from multiple ability trees and evolve each piece into a specialized role. Turn a rook into a tanky fortress, a bishop into a master of healing, or a queen into a destructive powerhouse. Your strategy will shape your army.
Immersive Single-Player Roguelike:
Lead your pieces through a grand journey across diverse boards and environments. Face off against rival armies, legendary foes, and challenging bosses, each encounter demanding strategic mastery and adaptability. As you progress, your pieces gain experience and level up, creating unique synergies and powerful builds with every run. With permanent upgrades and unpredictable challenges, every attempt offers a fresh opportunity to uncover the secrets of the chess realm and forge an unstoppable team.
Online Duels:
Test your strategy and combat skills by challenging players from around the world in exciting 1v1 online matches! Team up with a friend in co-op 2v2 mode, combining your strategies to outmaneuver and outfight opposing teams. Whether you prefer going head-to-head or working together, multiplayer offers endless opportunities for competitive and cooperative fun.

title: SuperQuest
description:
게임 정보
SuperQuest is a comedy focused turn-based RPG where you traverse through a series of dungeons filled with treacherous traps, mind-bending puzzles (they’re not that hard) and a variety of monsters that you can dispatch by using the game’s unique “Trick” mechanic!
Every individual enemy has unique actions that can be taken against them: you can steal bananas from the monkeys, or try to crack jokes with the skeletons. However this is never done as a means to diplomacy but to give yourself the upper-hand in combat so you can deliver the final blow!
You also have a TP meter that’ll fill up once you’ve taken or dealt enough damage, allowing you to use that character’s “Special Skill”, to help get you out of a tight spot!
If you haven’t been sold yet then get better taste check some of these other key features!:
Get run over by a minecart!

title: Operius DX
description:
게임 정보
Blast off into Operius DX, the ultimate evolution of the popular, retro-inspired, high-speed arcade shooter, Operius!
Navigate twisting polygonal tunnels, battle endless waves of enemies, and face off against challenging bosses across infinite sectors. Each run in this game offers a fresh, action-packed challenge.
In a world where all computers have suddenly lost their internet connections, it’s up to you to enter the mysterious UFO looming in the sky, explore its depths, and reclaim digital freedom for all!
This enhanced version of the classic brings improved visuals, reworked difficulty, new game modes, new color schemes, and much more!
Features:
Go through endless sectors that become progressively more challenging.
Pass through rings to level up your ship, increase your ship's speed, and unleash even more destruction!
Unlock 64 different color schemes, and 12 unique ship designs to personalize each one of your runs.
Face off against 3 challenging bosses that will test your reflexes.
Switch up the action with 7 unique game modes, each delivering its own twist on the game's high-octane action.
Join forces with up to 4 friends in local co-op, and go against waves of enemies together.
Jam out to a pulsating, techno inspired soundtrack that will will keep your adrenaline pumping all the way through.
Ready for the challenge? Grab your copy, step into the cockpit, and blast off into the unknown!

title: Electronic Market Simulator

"전자 시장 시뮬레이터"는 전자 시장 운영에 대한 모든 세부 사항을 갖춘 냉철한 1인칭 시뮬레이션입니다.

These characters are different in movement, attack power, health, special abilities, movement range, attack range and special ability range, and they are also different in battery consuming for movement, attack, and abilities. So you have to choose your team of characters depending on your playing strategy. You must protect your Philosopher's Stone and destroy the opposing team's Philosopher's Stone to win the game.

title: CUBE

CUBE is a minimalist tower defense Roguelike game.
[Game Background]
You are the only one who can operate the tower! Stay nearby to keep it powered up to destroy the hordes of enemies trying to knock it down.
[Game Features]
By combining the elements of minimalist tower defense + Roguelike, a unique gaming experience is created
1. Upgrade the tower, upgrade yourself!
Leave the comfort of the tower to collect resources to upgrade the tower, weapons, and players.
2. Upgrade enemies! ?
After each wave, you must choose which enemies to face next and how to upgrade them. If you want to succeed, you must choose carefully.
3. Survive? Survive?
You will encounter an indescribable BOSS later, please don't be afraid.

title: Hiroshi
description:
게임 정보
Interactive Visual Novel with anime aesthetics. Romance, adventure, betrayals, employment, social relationships. Choose your own adventure. Many options will lead you to meet many characters. Hiroshi is a rebellious young man who lives in a small town where he always has problems with the police. His parents decide to pay for a trip to the island of Shikoku so he can find a job, meet a girl to fall in love with, and become a responsible person. Once on the island, Hiroshi is at your command to make the best decisions for his life. Each decision is a story, and there are many stories and adventures to discover both on the island and beyond. You decide Hiroshi's future.

title: Galaxy Highways
description:
게임 정보
Take on the challenge as a space pilot in this adrenaline-fueled space shooter. Complete a variety of objectives, from attacking enemy forces to defending friendly ships. Blast your way through unique alien ships, space stations, bosses and defend your allies including miners, probes, and convoys against all odds.
Master various ships
Choose from a variety of unique ships, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. With multiple ships to pilot, you can explore the galaxy and engage in fast-paced combat in a new way each time. Take your battles to the next level by pursuing optional objectives. With each successful mission, boost your ship's weapons and defenses.
Unlock and upgrade weapons
Explore an arsenal of weapons to match your playstyle. With lasers, rockets, mines, and defensive turrets at your disposal, you'll never run out of options. As you make your way through the game, earn credits to unlock more weapons and upgrade your existing ones.

title: Project: Mist
description:
게임 정보
Experience full freedom in this open world survival horror
No forced quest, no hand holding, no telling you what to do. Jump right in and enjoy the freedom of your choices while trying to survive in this new harsh environment!
Explore Enigmatic Island:
Rusted mechs, flying whales and secrets behind the giant wall!
Dive into the haunting depths of an enigmatic island where each place is a new opportunity or threat and every step lets you immerse in this environment.
Encounter Giant Creatures:
Run away, hunt them down or simply experience in awe the giant creatures that roam the island.
Build and Defend Your Base:
Your base is your lifeline in this merciless world. Build, fortify, and defend it against relentless threats. Craft traps, siege weapons, power mines, energy turrets and a whole array of arsenal to give yourself the upper hand in the fight for survival.
Power of Gravity Gun:
Harness the raw power of the Gravity Gun, a game-changer in your desperate struggle to survive. It's your best hope for turning the tide against the horrors that await you.
Survive Against All Odds:
In this unforgiving nightmare, every decision can be a matter of life or death. Your resourcefulness, cunning, and determination are your only allies against the unrelenting terror. Farm, cook, craft special consumables, weapons of war and ammunition.

title: Trasmoz Legends
description:
게임 정보
⚔️ Trasmoz Legends: The Ultimate Retro Arcade Showdown 
Step into the final chapter of the Trasmoz saga, a story that began with critically acclaimed homebrew hits on ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC. Now, in this arcade-style adventure, you will experience the definitive version of the Trasmoz series as it would have been imagined in the golden age of arcades.

👾 Authentic 8-bit Pixel Art & Chiptune Soundtrack 
In Trasmoz Legends, every pixel and sound takes you back to the authentic 8-bit era with a meticulously crafted palette of just 16 colors. Our low-res sprites and various restrictions create a truly faithful retro aesthetic, honoring the 1984 arcade style.

But it’s not just a visual treat. We’ve used the legendary Yamaha YM2203 sound chip to recreate the unmistakable chiptune soundtrack of that era. This iconic sound chip, popular in classic arcade cabinets, produces a distinctive blend of FM synthesis and PSG (Programmable Sound Generator) audio, which provides a depth of sound that was rare in home consoles.

The soundtrack taps into the nostalgia of FM-driven basslines, synths, and crisp retro melodies, wrapping you in a fully immersive arcade experience.

title: The Black Vault
description:
게임 정보
You play as a software engineer who just came back from his job and got a message from his friend that a hacking group called "The Black Vault" is recruiting new members. Throughout the night you'll be given different tasks you'll have to complete in order to get into the group. As the night continues, you gather the attention of some shady people that will try to stop you from getting into The Black Vault. You must crack into servers and devices in order to obtain valuable information while avoiding getting murdered by a bunch of Deep Web killers.
COLLECT
Collect information either by analyzing Deep Web websites or cracking into other computers and webservers in order to get into "The Black Vault".
MANAGE
Throughout the night you'll have to manage your security system, your internet satellite, your lights and more in order to survive and get to your goal.

title: The Precinct
description:
게임 정보
여러분은 갓 사관학교를 졸업한 신출내기 경찰, 닉 코델 주니어 경관이 되어 아베르노 시티 시민들의 삶을 최전선에서 지켜내야 합니다. 손에 땀을 쥐게 하는 자동차 추격전, 끊임없이 벌어지는 사건, 1980년대 누아르풍 분위기로 가득 찬 세계에 뛰어들어 보세요. 시민들을 보호하고 아버지의 죽음과 관련된 수수께끼를 파헤치세요.
현장에서 뛰는 경찰
경찰 시뮬레이션에 액션 샌드박스의 화려함을 결합했습니다. The Precinct는 클래식 경찰 영화에 바치는 헌사와도 같은 게임입니다. 거리를 순찰하며 호출에 응답하세요. 경범죄부터 강력 사건까지, 수많은 사건이 여러분 앞에 놓여 있습니다. 스릴 넘치는 추격전과 총격전에서 나만의 전술을 선택하세요. 주차 위반부터 은행 강도, 길거리 경주, 마약 거래 등 사건은 끊임없이 벌어집니다. 생생하게 살아 숨 쉬는 도시에서 아베르노 시티 갱단의 권력 투쟁은 오늘도 끊이지 않습니다.
화끈한 추격전

title: Hero World 2

Join Tom and Lisa in Hero World 2, a thrilling new adventure! Unlike the story-driven first installment, this sequel focuses on helping the duo collect fruits while introducing numerous upgrades and fresh features.
Key Features:
Expanded Wardrobe for Lisa: Lisa now has 6 outfits—3 more than in the first game—for even more variety and customization.
Level Checkpoints: Say goodbye to restarting entire levels! New checkpoints let you pick up right where you left off after a misstep.
Larger Levels: Explore bigger, more detailed levels packed with new challenges and surprises.

20 well-designed levels that will make you think. Takes around 40 minutes to beat it to the end.

title: Echoes of the Sun
description:
게임 정보
This is a moving puzzle adventure story about a teenage girl, Mia, who witnessed the tragic fall of her homeland and the explosion of the Sun. A heavy burden fell on her fragile shoulders - she must restore light to the land and peace in her heart. Will she succeed?
Echoes of the Sun is a first-person puzzle-platformer adventure game in a fantasy setting where you play as a brave girl with telekinesis, who tries to reach her parents.
Restore the environment
Extinguish fires, rebuild surroundings, and bring nature around you back to life.
Use Telekinesis
Manipulate objects, interact with mechanisms, and overcome obstacles.

title: Timeborn
description:
게임 정보
Timeborn is a JRPG inspired game where you explore a world where time has long since ceased and destroy a variety of powerful foes.
Your goal is to rid this world of the void-beings that have began to grow aggressive ever since the gilded tower arose.
The combat is a classic turn based system where you are given a wide range of options to take down your foes including stopping time to unleash powerful attacks.
Between fights you can explore a variety of environments such as a foggy forest, a noir city, and a clock tower gilded in gold.
The games visuals are 2.5d where both pixel art, 3d models, and voxel models are used to create a variety of detailed environments.

title: DOOM: The Dark Ages
description:
게임 정보
슬레이어가 되어 지옥을 상대로 중세 전쟁을 벌여라
DOOM: The Dark Ages는 비평가들의 찬사를 받은 DOOM(2016)과 DOOM Eternal의 프리퀄로, 둠 슬레이어의 분노가 어떻게 탄생했는지 알 수 있는 이야기가 장대한 시네마틱으로 펼쳐집니다. 이 모던 DOOM 시리즈의 세 번째 작품에서 플레이어들은 둠 슬레이어의 피로 얼룩진 여정을 떠나 지옥을 상대로 이제껏 한 번도 본 적 없는 어둡고 사악한 중세 전쟁을 벌이게 됩니다.


신과 왕들의 결전 병기가 되어 슈퍼 샷건과 같은 가공할 위력의 무기로 적들을 찢고, 다목적 병기인 방패 톱을 포함해 적들을 뼈까지 갈아 마셔 버릴 다양한 신규 무기를 사용해 보세요. 플레이어들은 오리지널 DOOM 시리즈 특유의 지상에서 펼쳐지는 무자비한 전투를 통해 악마로 득실대는 전장을 헤쳐 나가게 됩니다.

맞서 싸워라
시네마틱과 액션으로 가득 찬 이야기를 통해 둠 슬레이어의 분노가 어떻게 탄생했는지 확인해 보세요. 신과 왕들의 결전 병기라는 굴레에 속박된 둠 슬레이어는 악마들의 대장이 슬레이어를 없애고 자신이 유일한 공포의 대상으로 등극하기 위해 보낸 수많은 악마 무리를 상대하게 됩니다. 슬레이어가 지옥의 모든 적과 맞서 싸우고 전쟁의 흐름을 바꿔 전설이 되는 과정을 직접 확인하세요.


슬레이어는 지옥의 군단을 박살 내기 위한 여정을 떠나, 이제껏 보지 못한 영역에서 전투를 치러야만 합니다. 황폐해진 성, 장대한 전장, 어두운 숲, 고대 지옥과 그 너머 다양한 장소에 각종 수수께끼와 챌린지, 그리고 보상이 기다리고 있습니다. 잔인하리만치 강력한 방패 톱으로 무장하고, id Software 역사상 가장 광대하며 위협과 비밀로 가득한 어둠의 세계를 헤쳐 나가세요.

title: There's No Dragons
description:
게임 정보
Dragons are an absolute myth! Nobody has ever seen any!
There's No Dragons is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random dragons to find for each of them.
9 Different Levels
3 Difficulty Settings
customizable background colors
replayable with 20 dragons out of 60 selected for each play
special hidden dragons
hint system
zoom
achievements
