튜토리얼과 챌린지를 플레이하고 새 지역과 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하기 위해 언제든지 홈월드로 돌아갈 수 있습니다.



공격력을 강화하기 위해 곤충 영혼을 수집하세요
적을 사격하고 대시 공격하세요
방패 능력으로 자신을 보호하세요
나이든 현명한 드라게나스의 도움으로 능력을 향상시키세요




곤충 영혼은 당신의 영원한 동반자입니다 - 그들의 에너지를 흡수하여 공격에 필요한 탄약을 얻습니다. 이들은 벌레, 딱정벌레, 그리고 잠자리의 세 가지 종류가 있습니다. 벌레와 딱정벌레는 일반 공격(사격 및 대시 공격)에 필요한 에너지를 제공하며, 드문 잠자리는 모든 적을 쓸어버리는 큰 파도 공격을 제공합니다.



블랙 아이스의 가혹한 세계로 나아가 당신의 임무를 완수하고, 당신의 땅에 평화를 되찾아 줄 감금된 영혼을 해방시키세요.

발음은 또는 입니다.

title: Norah's Song
description:
게임 정보
Ordinary home hides a set of abnormal acts. Adam, trapped within the confines of his own mind.
The weight of Adam's past rests heavily on your shoulders, Guide Adam and help his indomitable will shine as a beacon of hope against the darkness. but the question remains: Can you survive long enough to claim the redemption?

This game offers no motives other than self-torture, designed to excite Adam's sanity and impede his path to freedom.
It also balances mind tricks and logical sequence presenting some sort of an exciting challenge to players.

Gameplay:
You are vulnerable in Norah's Song. Seek clues, interact with hidden objects, and desperately piece together Adam's story,.
Survival hinges on maintaining your composure. Avoid succumbing to the terror lurking within the house... and within Adam's fractured mind.

Disclaimer:
-Norah's song video game explores themes of mental anguish, may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy and may be disturbing for some players. Viewer discretion is advised.

-This game focuses on atmosphere and exploration, building tension for a deeper psychological experience Its story unfolds through unsettling imagery and subtle clues within the environment. Expect unconventional challenges that test your resilience.

title: Premier Servi
description:
게임 정보
Eat the cake before your friends without getting spotted !

Premier Servi (First Arrived, First Served) is a colorful Party Game featuring delicious French Pastry.

Everyone starts on the left, but only the First person Arrived will be served ! Hide among friends and game controller character to arrive first, and select carefully who you want to eliminate

Features :
A main party game mode to play with your friends, featuring Ais and a laser to eliminate your friends
2 main sub-modes to vary gameplay, as well as many other small tweaks improving replayability
A cake collection view to see and collect all the cakes you encounter during your games
A "cake" point system to select the winner after each set of rounds
Up to 4 players locally or online with steam remote play
company: Florent Baris, Gaspard Thirion, Mickaël Scherlen

title: KAI
description:
게임 정보
깊은 바다와 무한한 우주를 가로지르는 발견과 계시의 여정, KAI의 매혹적인 세계로 빠져보세요. 무해해 보이는 우주선 임무 뒤에 숨겨진 진실을 발견하기로 결심한 주인공 아키라 역을 맡아 보세요. 하지만 현실은 상상과는 다른 것으로 밝혀지고, 아키라는 가장 친한 친구를 찾기 위해 복잡한 미스터리에 맞서고 수중 깊숙한 곳에 묻힌 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내야 합니다.


특징
다중 환경 탐험: 아키라가 신비로운 수중 세계와 항성 우주 공간 사이의 오픈 월드를 탐험하며 놀라움으로 가득한 장대한 여정을 시작하세요.

물고기 유인: 아키라의 다양한 미끼를 사용하여 다양한 색상의 물고기와 포식자 무리를 능숙하게 관리하고 안내하여 장애물을 극복하고 퍼즐을 풀면서 고대 메커니즘을 잠금 해제하고 새로운 지역에 접근하거나 매혹적인 수중 안무를 만드는 재미를 느껴보세요.

매력적인 내러티브: 예상치 못한 반전과 반전으로 모든 것이 바뀌는 미스터리로 가득한 매력적인 스토리에 빠져보세요.

몰입형 사운드 디자인: 세심하게 제작된 수중 사운드와 다양한 게임 상황에 맞게 동적으로 조정되는 인터랙티브 사운드 트랙으로 몰입감 넘치는 사운드 경험을 즐기세요.










KAI와 함께 발견과 탐험이 전술적인 물고기 관리와 결합하여 장애물을 극복하고 스토리를 진행하는 독특하고 몰입감 넘치는 경험을 준비하세요. 새로운 물고기를 만나고 퍼즐을 풀 때마다 바다와 우주 사이의 베일 뒤에 숨겨진 진실에 점점 더 가까이 다가갈 수 있는 특별한 여행에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

title: SimPlaE
description:
게임 정보
"플랫포머를 시뮬레이션으로 플레이하다"




"안녕하세요? 여기는 심플래입니다. 당신의 목표는 시뮬레이션의 클리어입니다."

모든 캐릭터는 일정한 조건에 따라 주어진 지형과 상호작용하며 자동으로 움직입니다.
당신은 캐릭터를 직접 조작할 수 없습니다.



관찰을 통해 캐릭터의 행동패턴을 파악하세요.
슬롯 내 주어진 블록을 배치하여 새로운 동선을 설계하세요.

시뮬레이션을 클리어하는 방법은 여러 가지입니다. 그러나 최고의 답은 오로지 하나만 존재합니다.
심플래는 당신이 내린 선택을 평가하고 등급을 부여할 것입니다.



필요하다면 힌트를 적극적으로 활용해주세요. 발상의 전환을 촉진할 수 있습니다.



퍼즐을 풀어나가며 다양한 난이도와 기믹을 마주하세요.
새로운 지형과 캐릭터의 움직임이 당신을 기다립니다.

심플래에는 시뮬레이션되는 다양한 플랫포머 세계가 존재합니다.
새로운 세계에는 새로운 규칙과 또 다른 주인공을 중심으로 이야기가 펼쳐집니다.



시뮬레이션의 목적은 무엇일까요? 시뮬레이션의 끝에 어떤 결말이 우리를 기다리고 있을까요?
당신이 내린 선택을 흥미롭게 관찰할 것입니다. 행운을 빕니다.

title: PhantomZone labyrinthos ファントムゾーン ラビュリントス
description:
게임 정보
"I can't wake up... I can't wake up... I can't wake up..."
The nightmare that never allows waking lasts forever.
You wake up from bed and a girl appears before you.
She calls herself “Entourfe,” a management support android.
The setting is a strange facility, and you will explore the inside of the strange facility with her. ......
The nightmare lingers. It will drag you to hell itself.

The protagonist, plagued by nightmares
He is invited to an underground facility.

It is a nightmarish place filled with monsters, androids, and members of a bizarre organization.

Can he overcome the nightmare and escape from it?
Conundrum: Propositions are presented in sections.

title: MI:ND
description:
게임 정보
State-of-the-art Fully-Voiced AI-Powered Dialogue

Every line of dialogue from every character is completely dynamic, generated with the most sophisticated AI-models and realistic emotion-filled speech. Engage in realistic conversations where you can speak freely and must determine exactly what you need to say to get through immersive scenarios while grappling with the psychological challenges posed by a decaying mind and a lurking subconscious.




Thought Reading: Utilize the power of an artifact to read thoughts, offering a unique insight that aids in navigation and decision-making.

Engaging Scenarios

Complex Interactions: From light-hearted moments in a bar to high-stress situations like evading arrest, use your wit and the power of thought reading to navigate through varied scenarios.
Memory Decay and Anomalies: As time progresses, the increasing decay introduces instabilities in the memory, from fun to horrific. Was that bouncer always three kids in trenchcoat?



As you dive deeper into the subconscious, each interaction, and each decision shapes the path forward. There is no dialogue-tree here, only your intuition guides you through a labyrinth of memories teeming with horrors. Will you uncover the secrets held within before it's too late, or will the fading memories consume you?

We're just a small team of two brothers and a close friend, united by our love for video games and a shared dream to create games that stretch the limits of what's possible. From the sounds and music to the art and everything in between, everything you see and hear in our game is crafted by us. We pour our hearts into every detail, hoping to bring you an experience that resonates and inspires.

title: Smashshot
description:
게임 정보
From a random guy in his parents apartment, comes a local multiplayer twin-stick shooter with a twist, rather than dying by taking too much damage, you die upon getting knocked off screen. This is definitely an original mechanic, yup I'm sure there's absolutely no game with this mechanic /s

Utilize two out of over a dozen abilities to find a synergy that fits your play style. One for defense and utility and the second one to finish off high damaged opponents.

Along with the ability to change the type of weapon in use, swapping between different fire rates and damage to complement your way to battle

Play with friends and see who can come out on top or play it alone in high score based challenges

title: Space Elevator Project
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
The space elevator, using carbon nanotube materials, is constructed at the equator of the Earth to create a strong "kite string" extending tens of thousands of kilometers into near-earth, geostationary, and far-earth orbits. Various space station facilities are built along this structure in different orbits, enabling further human utilization of space.

Player
As the project leader of the Space Elevator Project, you will oversee the construction of the space elevator orbit and gradually achieve phased objectives:
1. Construct orbit facilities, accumulate revenue, and repay loans for early-stage infrastructure construction.
2. Build a large number of photovoltaic power generation facilities in geostationary orbit and transmit a significant amount of power to Earth.
3. Construct Mars colonization spacecraft to accomplish the ultimate goal.

Value System
Finance, sci-tech, payload, and power are the four dimensions constraining the development of this project. Players will break through these constraints one by one.

Station modules
Multiple space facilities, each suitable for near-earth orbit, geostationary orbit, and far-earth orbit, utilize limited construction slots. Players can choose different values of G (gravity) to adjust the profitability of the facilities, with only the ring-shaped gravity ring allowing dynamic adjustment of the G value.

Staff
Constructing living quarters in geostationary orbit can accommodate staff, each with different positions, skills, and knowledge, providing bonuses to the profitability of different compartments. Players must choose between building living quarters or functional areas.

SciTech & Policy
Research various technologies to unlock new compartments and functions or provide higher bonuses to different compartments.

Other About
This is the debut game from VanilliA Studio. We apologize for any imperfections in the game and welcome feedback from players for improvement.

title: Wild in the West
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for a rootin' tootin' robot showdown! Wild in the West delivers thrilling third-person action with a unique Wild West twist.
Follow the journey of a mysterious gunslinger who arrives in the frontier town of Red Creek. Skilled but unwelcome, he faces suspicion and rumours about his past. But when ruthless robots invade, the townspeople must turn to the outsider they rejected.
Blast robots across the dusty town, upgrade your firepower and outsmart the relentless invaders. Uncover their secrets and face a mighty boss as you fight to save Red Creek. Can you earn your redemption in a town that never trusted you?
Experience thrilling shootouts, dynamic movement, and a clash of Wild West grit and sci-fi technology. Master your arsenal, outmanoeuvre your enemies, and unravel the mystery behind the invasion!

title: Egg Chef
description:
게임 정보
Egg Chef challenges you to cook and deliver eggs for points, but try not to drop any! Play by yourself for a high score or online with friends to determine the superior Egg Chef.

Catch eggs with your frying pan as they fall from above. Try to flip them as many times as you can to multiply your egg score, but be careful not to drop them as you will lose points.

Play against your friends in online multiplayer to see who's best. Catch Items as they drop from above to either enhance your cooking or hinder your opponents' cooking.
Key Features:
Move the frying pan to catch and flip eggs
Deliver cooked eggs to score points
Flip eggs to multiply their point value
Online multiplayer
Catch falling Items to use them to your advantage

title: Knight Lolita
description:
게임 정보
A sleepy little machine doll explores a world of whispering trees, worn paths, deep seas, towering cities, scraped and flooded ruins, and whatever else lies under heaven. Meet interesting characters and murder them, or try to avert their deaths. An extremely lethal combat system with manual sword control emphasizes the decision to avoid enemies or slaughter even bosses in an instant in wide levels full of roaming monsters. The finished game will feature flight and more vertical exploration.
The game's levels are generated in pseudorandom chunks, themselves populated randomly with enemies, bosses, friendly npcs, objects, and effects. The enemies have absolute pathfinding ability through these chunks and will roam or pursue the player, while the player's objective is to reach the end by any means be it avoidance or slaughter, betrayal or cooperation.
Game in development, store page will be updated as more assets are completed.

title: Collapse
description:
게임 정보
Dive into intense 5v5 online battles with our modern take on the classic Promod formula. Experience fast-paced first-person shooter action where every match demands strategy and skill. Navigate through destructible environments, adding a dynamic layer to gameplay as you adapt to shifting landscapes. Whether you're a veteran of the genre or a newcomer, this game promises high-octane fun and fierce competition. Gear up, strategize, and dominate the battlefield!

title: Park It!
description:

Park It! offers a sneak peek into the full grid-based puzzle game, where you step into the paws of a clever valet cat tasked with parking cars in tight spots. Whether you're a seasoned driver or someone who's never been behind the wheel, this game is designed for everyone!
Features:
-100 Engaging Levels: Experience a variety of parking challenges across 100 levels, each requiring strategic thinking and precision.
-Story Mode: Watch as a talented mechanic cat discovers its unexpected talent for parking cars in tricky spots.
CAR-INSPIRED MECHANICS
Consider the direction of the vehicle before parking. Optimise your moves with side turns. This highlights the engaging puzzle aspect that encourages players to think about the parking challenge.
Can you park perfectly without running out of gas?

title: Cupig's Key Collectathon
description:
게임 정보
Cupig's Key Collectathon 의 열쇠 수집 대회는 열쇠를 모아 보물 상자를 여는 간단한 게임입니다.
.

title: Stellar Dawn: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
용감한 전사여, 인터스텔라 도전에 준비하세요
"스타라이트: 생존자"는 알려지지 않은 인터스텔라 황야로 떠나는 생존 게임입니다. 여기에서는 최첨단 고급 기술 무기로 무수한 적과 맞서 싸우는 용감한 전사로 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 각 전투는 긴장과 흥분으로 가득차며, 각 적은 전진하는 길에 큰 장애물이 될 수 있습니다. 손에 든 무기와 전략을 활용하여 강력한 적을 물리치고 생존의 기회를 얻어야 합니다.
미지의 탐험과 귀중한 보물 발굴하기
신비로운 인터스텔라 황야를 탐험하고 지표면 아래에 숨겨진 귀중한 보물을 발견하세요. 생존뿐만 아니라 이 미지의 땅에서 가장 귀중한 자원을 발굴하는 것이 여러분의 임무입니다. 이 보물들은 즉각적인 이익을 가져다주는데 그치지 않고 전투 능력과 생존 능력을 향상시키는 강력한 업그레이드를 해제하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 각 발굴은 모험이자 각 발견은 놀라움의 순간입니다. 계속 전진하고, 알려지지 않은 지역을 탐험하며 더 많은 보물을 찾아야 합니다.
인내와 지혜로 진정한 생존자가 되기
위기에 가득한 인터스텔라 황야에서는 인내와 지혜만이 여러분의 생존을 가능하게 합니다. 전례 없는 도전에 직면하고 다양한 어려움을 극복해야 진정한 생존자가 될 수 있습니다. 준비되셨나요? 이 모험 여행을 시작하고 알려지지 않은 도전을 맞이하여 스타라이트에서 가장 용감한 전사가 되어봅시다.

"스타라이트: 생존자"가 여러분의 참여를 기다리고 있습니다. 함께 이 신비로운 인터스텔라 황야를 정복하고 여러분만의 전설을 만들어봅시다!

title: ROPOKO  Steam
description:
게임 정보
ROPOKO is an interactive fiction-style adventure game. Players become the robot Ropoko and must escape from a maze-like laboratory with the help of "Doctor." Learn words through conversations and use the vocabulary you've acquired to solve various puzzles!
The Steam version is an enhanced adaptation of the original MZ-700 version, improving playability with features like word selection, auto-mapping, hint functions, and gamepad support, making it easy to enjoy in any play environment.
Story
Forty years have passed since the MZ-700 conquered the Japanese computer market. Nowadays, every citizen has at least two MZ-700s per person, except for a few oddballs who use obscure computers like Windows or Mac.
One day, the AI managing a laboratory suddenly went out of control, initiating a 700-year long expansion project. To escape the labyrinthine lab, "Doctor" activated a newly created robot equipped with a Z80 processor, named Ropoko.
Gameplay
Though interactive fiction games are generally considered high difficulty, we've designed ROPOKO to be accessible even for those unfamiliar with the genre.
Movement is handled entirely with the cursor keys (D-pad), providing smooth navigation similar to action games or RPGs.
In traditional text adventure games, players input commands as keywords to direct the character's actions. In ROPOKO, only one noun is needed to issue commands. You don't need to input verbs or objects as in conventional games; just type a noun while in contact with the target to ask questions or use items.
Examples: "ropoko," "laboratory," "door," "wire."
Only words encountered in previous conversations can be used, so increasing your vocabulary through repeated dialogue is key to progression. Commands can be entered either by typing directly on the keyboard or selecting words using a cursor.
The game includes various puzzles, mini-games, and complex dungeons to keep players entertained. After completing the game, you can aim for the shortest completion time or the highest vocabulary score. The estimated initial playtime is around 7 hours.

title: Road To Wealth
description:
게임 정보
Dive into an immersive text-based RPG that blends rich storytelling with vivid visual elements and a variety of mini-games. Navigate through a harsh fantasy world filled with mythical creatures and menacing monsters as you make crucial choices that shape your unique adventure.

Begin your quest in a quaint village, then traverse through perilous roads, shadowy forests, and vibrant cities. Climb towering mountains, explore orc encampments, and discover hidden secrets, all while being guided by atmospheric artwork and ambient sounds that enhance the narrative.

Forge your own identity with a flexible character system. Whether you choose to harness the arcane powers of magic, wield a colossal battle axe, or master the art of thievery through ancient texts, your character's fate is in your hands.

Meet a diverse array of beings, including humans, elves, dwarves, and orcs. Engage in intense battles, negotiate with mercenary knights, and make strategic decisions that influence the unfolding story. Your mission is to survive, gather gold for better equipment, and conquer the myriad of foes and obstacles that lie ahead.

Enjoy various mini-games such as drinking duels, dice rolling, lockpicking, coin flipping, and card playing. Each mini-game adds a layer of fun and complexity to your adventure, offering additional rewards and challenges.

For those seeking a hardcore experience, iron mode presents a relentless survival challenge where every choice matters. Alternatively, save often to ensure you don't lose your hard-earned progress in this demanding game. With its expansive, non-linear storyline and engaging gameplay, this text-based RPG delivers an epic adventure unlike any other.

title: Caution Ahead: Part 2
description:
게임 정보
This is the second entry of a three-part horror series that blends exploration and stealth-based survival elements. This part includes three chapters.
You continue the story as John Rand, a search and rescue officer stationed at Richburg National Park. After the events of Part 1, John now faces new threats as he tries to make his way to Richburg Mines to rescue Michelle and Elena before it's too late.
Chapters in Part 2:
Chapter 4: The search.
Chapter 5: Crawl for your life.
Chapter 6: Almost there.

title: Steve's Warehouse
description:
게임 정보
Steve is a busy alien and they must sort out human fruits, animals, storage or even planets. To do so, Steve will combine the same objects to create better objects, make more points, and make more money!
Steve's Warehouse is inspired by the Watermelon game (Suika game) and rogue-like deckbuilding games (such as great games like Peglin, Luck be a Landlord or Balatro).
Steve's warehouse is a melting pot of physics, rogue-like and deckbuiling. Purchase objects and play them all with their weird and unexpected physics behaviours! Score as many points as possible to achieve your objectives! Don't make any object fall from your board maybe you will reach the final BOSS!
How do we play?
Purchase New Objects
Play the Entirety Of Your Deck
Combine objects to get better objects with crazier and better effects
Survive malus when you fail to reach the points requirement
Purchase strong passive effects every 3 rounds
What to expect?
8 objects families, including Fruits, Animals, Celestials, Transportations, Storages or even Sports balls.
70+ objects each with a dedicated physic, effect, and points!

title: Feline Realms - The Ancients' Legacy
description:
게임 정보
Dive into Feline Realms: The Ancients' Legacy, a quirky RPG inspired by the golden era of role-playing games.

The story follows an ancient feline race that once traveled between worlds through portals. While they live peacefully on Felix IV, an invading force from a parallel world awakens the gate leading to Earth. Our heroes are called upon, unwillingly, to defend Earth against this new threat—unaware of their ancient heritage.

Rediscover your heritage as the Seshat Ankh, unlock your Guardian powers... or forge your own path—I'm not judging. The fate of Earth lies in your hands.

Oh, and good luck with the humans... To most of them, you're just a strange cat. To others, you're royalty. The modern world presents dangers that are unique to being a cat, as you'll soon discover.

The combat relies on old-school RPG mechanics, and features three different difficulty levels, making it accessible to both young, impatient heroes and hardcore veterans who like to use their full toolkit to achieve victory.

The game is non-linear, meaning you can accomplish goals in any order you choose. You can try to beat some big bosses right away if you dare, but I recommend finding some gear first, as well as acquiring some levels. The loot system is inspired by MMORPGs, where loot is gained through questing, defeating bosses, clearing dungeons, and of course, opening chests and visiting NPC vendors.

title: Backpack Rogue
description:
게임 정보
Your Inventory
Every decision about which item to put in your backpack and exactly how it synergizes with the rest can be crucial. Your survival depends on your ability to balance risk and reward by strategically planning your actions
Game Features

title: Beefarena

In Beefarena, you take on the role of a survivor in a world overrun with mutant cows genetically engineered by aliens. Find allies, unravel sinister plots, and keep Earth safe for people.
Megga Corps, Enlist Today!
The modern world and its ongoing alien cattle invasion can be difficult to navigate, that's why Megga Corp offers a wide variety of products and security services to help combat the chaos-- or as we like to call it, .

title: Sera Dion: Survivor

title: Bread & Butter
description:
게임 정보
🥪 Bread & Butter: Team Up, Fight Back!
🍞 Dual Heroes, One Fight – You’re a fearless slice of bread, but you’re never alone. Your butter companion battles by your side, upgradable and unstoppable, in this chaotic auto-combat survival fest.

title: Crowley Hotel. The JH Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
A sinister forest houses a dark and unsettling hotel where every locked door holds macabre secrets and a blood-stained past. This history of murders, rituals, and dark magic has left three malevolent Entities trapped within the hotel—three antagonistic identities, each with their own story and fate.
You must choose your path wisely to uncover each Entity. Enter their rooms by following clues correctly and collect the objects tied to each Entity to unravel their secrets.
To progress, you’ll need to search for hidden keys to unlock doors to rooms filled with horrors: torture chambers, satanic rituals, and secret passages the hotel’s owner, the murderous Entity, used to dismember his victims.
You’ll also need to retrieve the lingering objects to free each Entity. Study their profiles to recognize which objects belong to whom.
But beware. Mike, the master of ceremonies, is watching your every move. He won’t allow you to pursue multiple paths at once.
Will you be able to reach the secret basement?

title: Sabotage City
description:
게임 정보
Sabotage city takes the idea of a city builder and flips it on its head, making a city destroyer game. You are an average citizen hired to work for a gigantic demolition company, little to find out the cities are less than abandoned… sweet!
Fast paced money management gameplay with a high skill ceiling, speedrunning tools, and a freeplay mode for replayability.
Different gimmicks that spice up the gameplay experience. like being able to hire workers for extra money, or controlling the press to rile up the people. All with the end goal of making the citizens leave.
A full story mode campaign with 20+ locations to destroy,  and a full plot with multiple characters, locations, and different routes to take the story.
Web 1.0 web page inspired menus and shops. Instead of a normal shop menu the game uses a computer with charming 90s style websites that give advice on how to get better, helps you buy tickets to the cities you destroy, and give backstory to the world of the game.
Multiple endings. 
Codes and ciphers to discover and solve. The game is packed with loads of hidden puzzles and things to solve all across it.

title: Yami Protocol
description:
게임 정보
This game is an action genre from a third-person perspective, Inspired by the classics of survival horror.

title: Dark Symphony
description:
게임 정보
In the dead of night, amidst the ominous whispers of the forest, a nightmare awakens. Welcome to Dark Symphony, a spine-chilling first-person horror experience that plunges you into a haunting tale of obsession, madness, and survival.



Story
You are John, a man who wakes from a restless sleep beside his wife in your secluded cabin deep in the woods. Your peaceful night is shattered by the eerie mumblings of an unnamed man outside, searching desperately for his lost vinyl records. He scattered these six records in his drunken stupor, each containing a movement from Percy Grainger's "Lincolnshire Posy," throughout the forest clearing. The man, driven to the brink of madness by his obsession with this music, will stop at nothing to retrieve them.

The stakes are terrifyingly high. The strange man is temporarily distracted as the records play, giving you precious moments to locate and place the remaining records on one of the six gramophones scattered around the clearing. But beware: if he catches you, he will chase you down and end your life. Should the current gramophone finish playing before you find the next record, the man will storm into your cabin and kill your sleeping wife, ending your desperate quest in horror and failure.











Can you unravel the mystery of the strange man and his cursed records? Will you save your wife and escape the forest alive? The gramophones are waiting, and the night is closing in. Prepare yourself for a journey into darkness, where every decision could be your last.

title: exorSYS
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to exorSYS
After unknowingly upgrading to a cursed operating system, you must follow a breadcrumb of previous victims in order to uncover the truth before you inevitably become a victim yourself. Solve puzzles, dig for secrets, hack computers, and use special programs to help advance from level to level.
exorSYS Report Panel

title: Wireframe Warfare
description:
게임 정보
Wireframe Warfare is a Singleplayer Action/Tower Defense hybrid game created by a solo developer over the course of a year. Blast and strategize your way through various levels, combating waves of viruses attacking Cyber Beacons across the pathways of a digital space.
T.A.N.K (ACTION GAMEPLAY)
Tactical Armored Nexus Keeper, or T.A.N.K for short, is a customizable program with several different offensive weapons and modular attachments. During gameplay, you will be controlling your own version of a T.A.N.K, harnessing its power to defend the Cyber Beacons.
S.T.A.N.D (Tower Defense)
Secure Tower Allocation and Network Defense protocol is the foundation of your defense against Viruses. Deploy offensive towers to deal damage, defensive towers to debuff and utility towers to boost your resources.

title: Qiyb2
description:
게임 정보
Qiyb2 is a mathematics -themed 2D score-attack auto-platformer with many different random-generated cubes, hand-crafted backgrounds and experimental soundtracks.
In this game, the player controls an automatically jumping cube, with other cubes working as platforms, where by jumping on them activates their effect. The different cubes that can be generated form as a collection a so-called probability hierarchy, where the cube's rarity usually defines how powerful its effect on the game can be. Example effects include basic score gain, negation that changes the next effect of many cubes, temporary score gain multiplier increase, and a rare and temporary domain shift.
The game has a dynamic difficulty level that corresponds to how high the player's score is; the higher the score, the higher the difficulty. The main objective is to obtain as high a score as possible, where certain score amounts introduce additional random events, such as an enemy or boss spawning, or a negative hit points cube wall approaching.
The player starts with one skill called height reset. There are four additional skills with corresponding skill paths that can be purchased from the shop with the game currencies obtained by playing the game. Teleportation, for example, can be used to teleport through a negative hit points cube wall, thus avoiding its effect, and time dilation can be used to temporarily slow time to grant the player more time to act to the given situation. Each skill has its own cooldown time.
There are over seven bosses in the game, with varying difficulty levels, and corresponding rewards when defeating them. Mechanics, such as the different cubes' effects, are not explained to the player, akin to mathematics, where one experiments to discover something new and learn the rules of the game.

title: UNDER ROOMS
description:
게임 정보
In Under Rooms you take on the role of a 17-year-old teenager, you find yourself trapped in this mysterious and dangerous environment after an accident. Your mission is to survive, explore and discover your way back home. The gameplay focuses on looting, inventory management and crafting mechanics, allowing you to create and find essential resources for survival.
Throughout your journey, you will encounter various factions, each with their own ideologies and goals, creating a complex web of alliances and rivalries. Some factions refuse to cooperate due to their differences, while others offer the opportunity to make connections and find allies in the midst of chaos. However, danger is ever present: hostile entities lurk in the shadows, ready to destroy anyone who crosses their path. Explore uniquely designed locations, each with its own atmosphere and challenges, and immerse yourself in a narrative that gradually uncovers the story of your protagonist and the dark secrets of Backrooms.
Will you survive and find your way out or will you be trapped in this endless world?
Loot and manufacture: Find and create essential resources to keep you alive.

title: IntelRoach
description:
게임 정보
In a world where information is the most valuable asset, your mission is to obtain data that could change the course of scientific progress and shape the future. By taking control of a miniature cockroach, you’ll infiltrate restricted areas, bypass security systems, and face unexpected challenges.
Key Features:
Unique Gameplay: Take control of a cockroach and experience what it’s like to be the smallest yet most crucial agent.
Stealth and Strategy: Your tiny size is both an advantage and a limitation. Use it wisely.
Engaging Storyline: Immerse yourself in a thrilling narrative where no choice is ever simple.
Puzzles and Secrets: Pay close attention to details and use your wits to overcome traps and uncover hidden truths.
Are you ready for a mission where your eyes, ears, and legs belong to a tiny spy?

title: Macho Harvest ~ Muscular Harvest Puzzle ~
description:
게임 정보
마초 × 농업의 슈퍼 혼돈 퍼즐 게임!
밭에 단백질을 뿌려서 탄생하는 다양한 종류의 마초들을 정중하게 애정을 담아 육성해 출하시키자!

마쵸 농원의 원장은 근육을 너무 사랑했던 겨우 '마초를 키우는 농원'을 열어 버린다.
"마초의 씨앗"이라는 수수께끼의 씨앗을 흙에 묻혀 단백질을 물 대신에 준다.
며칠 후, 작은 아령의 싹이 나오고, 밭 일면에 근육의 향기가 풍긴다.

성장한 마초들은 매일 스쿼트와 벤치 프레스에 힘쓰고,

■출하시키기에는 단 3스텝만!

3 종류의 단백질을 밭에 뿌려 마초가 탄생!
색의 곱셈으로 다양한 색의 마초도···?

탄생한 마초에게 더욱 단백질을 주어 가는 것으로 레벨이 올라간다!
잘 기르고 출하에 대비하자!
③ 정리해 발송한다
많은 마쵸를 한 번에 발송하는 것으로 고득점 겟이다!
단백질의 형상에 맞추어 잘 마초를 키워 가자!

title: Chaotic Cute Ghost
description:
게임 정보
The Mystery of Memory

This place is the haven for forgotten souls, those unable to transcend, wandering here forever unable to be freed. Your memory is fragmented, the only thing you can rely on are the memory fragments scattered throughout this world. These fragments are like guiding beacons, gradually piecing together snippets of your past life.
Battle and Adventure
You vaguely recall having fallen in a fierce battle, destined to enter the cycle of reincarnation, but just before dying, you activated a mysterious reincarnation array. This array carried your soul into the chaotic world, avoiding the fate of reincarnation. You must continuously accumulate strength through adventure and battle in the chaotic world until you can activate the array again to leave this place.

title: We're in the Same Boat
description:
게임 정보
Set sail for a unique puzzle adventure!
In We're in the Same Boat, you'll help a crew of quirky animal characters navigate tricky river crossings. But these aren't your ordinary crossings! Each challenge comes with a riddle that unveils the special rule each animal must follow. Can you crack the code and get everyone safely across?
Features:
Brain-teasing puzzles: Solve for the optimal crossing order using logic and the hidden rule revealed in each riddle.
Adorable animal crew: Meet a cast of charming animals, each with their own personality and unique rule.
Ever-changing challenges: Progress through increasingly difficult levels that will test your wit.
Fun for all ages: The simple yet engaging gameplay is perfect for casual players and puzzle enthusiasts alike.
Work together, even if you're in different boats! Download "We're in the Same Boat" and embark on a delightful journey of riddles and river crossings!

title: Friends With Traitors

게임 정보
1 of 4 friends meets the dark truth of getting betrayed by the others.  That 1 must go on a journey to find and stop them and find who was behind it all.  In this game you chose 1 of 4 characters known as Kai, Ian, Ember and Mason. title: Forgotten Signal: Portal
description:
게임 정보
In the Footsteps of Grandfather is a thrilling first-person (FPS) adventure game that combines science fiction, mystery, horror, and action. This mysterious journey, which begins in a wooden mansion, transforms into an epic rescue mission in the depths of space. Are you ready to use both your wits and courage to save your grandfather?
Talent System
In the game, you start with 3 different talents:
Wall Vision: When this talent is used, the enemy’s location is revealed. You can use this talent when you’re curious about whether an enemy is approaching or where they are.

title: Crazy Robot Ball
description:
게임 정보
Step into the thrilling world of Crazy Robot Ball, the ultimate turn-based football showdown! Take command of a team of high-tech robots, each with unique attributes designed to give you the edge in the battle for robotic football supremacy.
Gameplay Highlights:
Turn-Based Tactics: Plan your moves strategically in this turn-based twist on traditional soccer. Anticipate your opponent’s plays, set up the perfect pass, and unleash unstoppable shots on goal!
Customizable Robots: Assemble your dream team with robots that boast specialized attributes—lightning-fast speedsters to dart past defenders, powerhouse strikers to blast through any blockade, and durable defenders to hold the line.
Four Unique Maps: Play across four distinct maps, each set in a unique location and featuring interesting layouts that add new layers of strategy. Adapt to varying terrain and field shapes to outwit your opponents.
Game Modes for Every Player: 
Freeplay Mode: Explore the game at your own pace. Experiment with lineups, perfect your strategies, and refine your skills without the pressure of competition.
Tournament Mode: Test your mettle in a high-stakes championship. Face off against increasingly formidable opponents to claim the prestigious Golden Trophy and cement your legacy as a Crazy Robot Ball champion.
With vibrant arenas and dynamic play-by-play action, Crazy Robot Ball delivers an electrifying mix of strategy and excitement. Whether you're a casual gamer looking for a fun challenge or a tactical mastermind aiming to dominate the league, this game guarantees hours of thrilling gameplay.

title: Endless Leveling In Mycelium Dungeons: from zero to infinity
description:
게임 정보
Endless Leveling In Mycelium Dungeons: from zero to infinity — is a dark fantasy game with a telling title. This is a hardcore Action RPG in which everyone can make their own interesting and unique build. An endless leveling tree, 50+ different skills, 2000+ skill combinations and an almost complete absence of restrictions will help you cope with this task. Become the new deity of this world, if, of course, you succeed.
One day, a woman died in a terrible magical ceremony in order to give birth to a being with potential similar to a deity. This strengthened her fetus and filled it with all kinds of magic of this world. The being that the woman gave birth to — is You. You will have to surpass the old deity, who was killed by the Devourer of Worlds. And make the most important choice: to continue the endless war, to subjugate the magic of another dimension and become a Devourer of Worlds himself, or to become a new deity protecting this world.

title: Divine Move 神之手
description:
게임 정보
Divine Move
This game is inspired by a significant international Go competition in January 2025, which ended with dramatic and controversial results.
This is not a Go game. The game supports up to 8 players, with players taking turns using the same mouse to play.
Each player's block contains a certain number of gems. The next player will collect these gems. The longer a block stays on the board, the more gems it accumulates. When the last block is placed ,the player who collects more gems than the target amount wins.
Purchase special items: You can buy various cards and items in the shop to enhance the gem's extra rewards. Use your funds wisely.
20 variant shapes,
40 types of cards,
50 items,
Any item may change the course of the game.
Build your best profit combination: Each round requires you to filter your blocks and adjust your deck to maximize your profits.
Beware of robbers: Through various items or cards, other players may steal your gems. Of course, you can steal theirs too.
Level editor and Creative Workshop: You can design scenes yourself and share them in the Creative Workshop for other players to download.
Don't let high-value blocks fall: If a block falls, it will not yield any rewards. Plan your strategy carefully, and think about how to place high-value blocks. If necessary, sacrifice low-value blocks.

title: Deadly Joy
description:
게임 정보
Deadly Joy is a multiplayer horror survival game where each player is a Play Center employee chosen to complete dangerous missions under the watchful eyes of the facility's eerie mascots. Between cooperation and betrayal, every choice matters…
Parkour 🏃‍♂️: A deadly obstacle course where only the smartest and fastest will reach the end. Hugster will be there to "guide" you, but will you help others or eliminate them to be the sole winner?
Basement 🏭: Work together to sort objects, but beware—one mistake punishes everyone. Will you trust your teammates, or sabotage the mission for your own survival?
Tower 🏢: Escape a trap-filled tower crawling with CatBox, adorable yet deadly creatures. Cooperate… or eliminate your rivals before they do. And remember, Hugster might be lurking in the shadows.
In Deadly Joy, every decision matters. Will you be an ally… or a traitor?

title: Dug Out

title: LingTian2: Your Destined Prince
description:
게임 정보

링티안2(LingTian2)는 로맨틱하고 달콤한 오토메 비주얼 노벨 게임입니다. 당신은 방 왕국의 평범한 소녀로, 왕자 링티안과의 운명적인 만남은 당신의 따뜻한 마음 덕분입니다. 이제, 당신의 사랑과 로맨스가 펼쳐질 준비가 되었습니다. 이 멋진 왕실 로맨스를 맞이하세요!

▌로맨스 방 왕국의 왕실은 왕자 링티안이 공주를 찾을 수 있도록 "사랑 찾기 이벤트"를 개최합니다. 이 이벤트는 공공의 관심을 돌리고 사회적 긴장을 완화하는 방법으로 사용됩니다. 왕실 시험 후, 당신과 다른 소녀들이 결승에 진출합니다. 그러나 방 궁전에 들어서자마자 왕자는 특별히 당신에게 관심을 가지며 모든 면에서 당신을 보호합니다. 궁전 안에서, 소녀들은 숨겨진 "방 카드"를 찾아 왕자와 데이트할 기회를 얻습니다. 하지만 왕자 링티안은 몰래 당신이 시간 동안 그와 함께 할 수 있도록 힌트를 제공합니다.
왕자를 실수로 물어보았을 때도, 왕자는 당신을 무조건적으로 방어하며 결코 당신을 탓하지 않습니다. 병사들이 당신을 제압하려 할 때, 왕자는 부상을 입었음에도 불구하고 병사들을 엄하게 꾸짖으며 당신에게 해를 끼치지 않도록 합니다.
눈 내리는 날, 왕자는 직접 소녀들을 궁전에 맞이하며 전화기를 선물로 주었습니다. 곧 다른 소녀들은 자신들의 전화기가 왕자와 연락되지 않음을 깨닫고, 오직 당신만이 전화를 걸고 메시지를 보낼 수 있습니다. 당신이 그에게 이 질문을 던지자, 왕자는 깊은 애정을 담아 이렇게 대답합니다: "나는 오직 너만 좋아해. 다른 소녀들에는 관심 없어. 나는 오직 너만 신경 쓰고, 너만 집중해. 너와 함께 있고 싶을 뿐이야."


▌전체 게임 버전
1,000개 이상의 정교한 3D 장면
전 캐릭터 음성 연기 및 효과음
왕자의 심장 박동, 온기, 호흡과 상호작용, 그의 방과 단서 잠금 해제
왕자가 전화, 메시지, 동행, 잠자리에 들게 하는 10개의 상호작용 구간
다양한 선택이 다른 결말로 이어지는 10개의 사이드 스토리라인
재미와 탐험을 위한 3개의 미니게임
사랑에 빠진 느낌을 들게 해주는 10개의 아름다운 테마곡
Ginyan의 소설을 바탕으로 한 10만 단어 이상의 달콤한 로맨틱 이야기

▌방 왕국 소개 방 왕국은 제3차 세계대전 후 지각 운동으로 형성된 사각형의 땅에서 새롭게 창건된 국가입니다. 이 나라는 자유롭고 평등하며 다양한 민족과 언어가 공존하는 나라입니다. 방 왕국의 사람들은 본래 로맨틱하며 사랑에 대한 열정이 강합니다.


▌왕자와 당신
링티안 — 방 왕국의 왕자이자 왕위 계승 4위, 잘생기고 고결하며 성실하고 충성스러운 성격을 가진 왕자입니다. "사랑 찾기 이벤트" 이전에 이미 당신에게 깊이 빠져 있었습니다. 당신이 방 궁전에 입성할 수 있도록 그는 모든 노력을 기울였으며, 무슨 일이 있어도 당신을 무조건 보호합니다. 왕자에게 실수로 물어보았을 때도, 그는 오직 당신이 처벌받을까 걱정하며 자신의 부상은 아랑곳하지 않습니다.
당신 — 친절하고 성실하며 요리에 능한 소녀, 특히 브레이즈드 포크 라이스가 특기입니다. 요리 학원에 다니며 파트타임으로 일하면서 왕실 시험에서 결승에 진출하고 방 궁전에 입성하게 됩니다. 왕자를 만나게 되어 긴장과 부끄러움을 느끼지만, 다른 소녀들이 왕자의 마음을 얻으려 노력할 때, 실수로 왕자를 물게 되어 자신이 탈락할 것이라고 생각합니다. 그러나 곧, 왕자의 호위병이 된 정훈과 재회하게 되며, 정훈은 왕자가 진심으로 당신을 좋아한다고 전합니다.

▌게임 플레이
스토리 시청/선택하기: 영화 같은 스토리 속에서 왕자와의 로맨스를 진행하고 방과 단서를 열어가세요.
미니게임: 왕자에게 연고를 바르거나 단서로 퍼즐을 푸는 재미있는 게임.
일상 상호작용 및 동행: 왕자와의 전화, 메시지, 일기를 통해 소통합니다.
노래와 비디오 리뷰: 로맨틱한 순간을 되새기며 심장을 느껴보세요.


▌환생 시리즈 "방 왕국 왕자 과거와 현재의 꿈 환생 시리즈" — 링티안, 진팅, 비웨이, 리누오 네 명의 왕자가 함께 시간을 초월한 영원한 사랑을 엮어갑니다. 방 왕국 사람들은 환생을 믿으며, 과거 삶을 되돌아보며 링티안과 당신은 사랑이 이 생에만 존재하는 것이 아니라, 수많은 생을 걸쳐 쌓인 것임을 깨닫게 됩니다.
1-링티안: 이번 생의 운명적인 왕자 | 왕자 링티안은 이번 생에서 첫눈에 당신에게 빠졌습니다. 그의 사랑 추구는 당신을 방 궁전에 데려오는 것에 불과하며, 당신을 온전히 보답하고 아끼고 싶어 합니다.
2-진팅: 전생의 헌신적인 왕자 | 방 왕국의 진팅 왕자는 군사학교에 다녔으며, 주방에서 일하는 당신을 항상 보호하고 지켜주었습니다. 그의 열정적이고 헌신적인 로맨스는 당신에 대한 깊은 사랑이었습니다.
3-비웨이: 전생의 왕자 동급생 | 당신은 왕자를 위해 총알을 막았고, 그 덕분에 왕실 고등학교에 다니게 되었습니다. 왕자 비웨이는 당신을 깊이 보호하고, 달콤한 캠퍼스 로맨스를 되돌려줍니다.
4-리누오: 전생의 불면증 왕자 | 리누오 왕자는 당신이 그의 배고픔을 채우고, 그의 곁에 있어야만 잠을 잘 수 있었습니다. 당신의 달콤한 사랑은 그의 불면증을 치유했습니다.
이 사랑은 환생을 넘어, 수많은 생을 거쳐 계속될 것입니다...

▌1000 Princes 시리즈 "1000 Princes" — 매번 다른 왕자 이름을 가진 3D 비주얼 노벨 로맨스 게임 시리즈, 당신이 좋아하는 왕자를 선택하여 화려하고 달콤한 사랑 이야기를 시작할 수 있습니다! 각 왕자는 당신을 보살피고, 귀여워하며, 보호하고, 지지하며, 품어줍니다. 🍰 "1000 Princes" 오토메 게임: STEAM과 Google Play에서 이용 가능
📕 "1000 Princes" 다국어 학습 전자책: Google Play에서 이용 가능
└ 🅿️ "1000 Princes" 개발자 "Ginyan" 다국어 학습: YouTube에서 확인
🍒 "1000 Princes" 테마 송 음악: YouTube에서 확인
🌸 "1000 Princes" 공식 웹사이트

▌개발자 프로필 Ginyan — 독립적인 오토메 게임 개발자, 전자책 작가, 외국어 학습서 및 로맨틱 소설 전자책 창작자. 판타지에 대한 열정을 가지고 있으며 컴퓨터와 외국어 학습에 대한 강한 욕구를 가지고 있습니다. COVID-19 봉쇄 기간 동안부터 iClone과 CC를 배우기 시작하여 3D 애니메이션을 제작하고, Unity 게임 엔진을 연구하고, AI 기술을 결합하여 소설을 오토메 게임으로 변환시켜 플레이어들이 달콤한 사랑의 세계에 몰입할 수 있도록 했습니다.

title: Peek
description:
게임 정보
**This game features immersive spatial audio as a key gameplay mechanic. Headphones are STRONGLY recommended for the best experience.**
Peek is an atmospheric memory horror puzzle game that relies heavily on spatial audio to uncover clues. An unseen presence moves through the room, waiting. Close your eyes, listen carefully, and use the sounds around you to complete the ritual with careful precision.
You must perform a ritual on a 5x5 grid of blessed salts, cleansing it of a restless spirit. To gather clues, kneel in the center, close your eyes, and listen as the spirit moves around you. Pay close attention to every detail you can, and do your best to remember! Listen to direction, distance, and sound type. Listen to what information the footstep sounds are trying to tell you about the spirit's proximity to yourself...and you might even catch a glimpse as she passes in front of the candle light.
Once she leaves through the attic hatch, use your ritual book to match the sounds to the correct relics. Retrieve the necessary tools from the crate on the bed, and carefully place them in their rightful spots.
Be warned: incorrect placements will anger her, and she'll only put up with so much from trespassers. And most importantly...
DON'T PEEK!

title: Cult of Abaruth
description:
게임 정보
Have you always thought you are meant for greatness? Have you ever wanted to test your skills as a dark cult leader? Or maybe you just like Dark Fantasy with a bit of silly humor? Just now you can test your skills! Became cult leader and lead it to achieve fame and glory. From day to day you wil get more followers and the treasury will be filled with blood and souls. But be careful. World is full of danger. Who you trust depends only on you.

Cult of Abaruth is economic strategy in a turn-based system which is easy to control and play - but full of challenges. This simulator of cult management will allow you to experience the climatic soundtrack and stylish pixel art graphics. Remember to plan your moves - this game is cruel to those who are too reckless.

"It's your story"
Give a name to your character, choose its look and specialization of cult. Every specialization can change your gameplay and make it easier or harder.

"Manage your Cult"
Select an action using the appropriate menu, you don't have to move from your headquarters! Watch new cultists join your ranks, how your army recruit and how priest perform dark rituals! Buy new skills in "the tree" and enjoy the great power that comes with them!

"Create Your Own Headquarters"
Don't you think that one building is not enough for such a huge organization? Thanks to the build system, you can change that. Why not, for example, build tents for training the army? Or build a market? Some buildings can also be upgraded to work even better for the sake of your cult!


"Explore the mysterious world of Primeval"
Immerse yourself in the mysterious world of Primeval with the power of one of the Old Ones! Discover the history of the world and the creatures that live in it. Thanks to the event system you can decide about the fate of your organization as well as the entire region (and even the world)! Remember that it is only up to how you wicked you will be and who you will leave alive.

Feature list:
*Many unique events!
*Atmospheric graphics
*Music to highlight events
*Clear game mechanics

title: Sunflowers and the Goddess of Death
description:
게임 정보
우리 시대, Eithne 28년 겨울 61일, 우리를 인도하는 바람, 우리의 영원한 뿌리, Lucan 숲에 있는 언덕 위 도시의 여사제가 흙으로 돌아왔습니다.

우리 민족은 이제 대지와 바람과 나무의 여신인 버드나무의 여인 Imsha 와 연결될 새로운 지도자를 찾아야 합니다. 농작물이 자랄 수 있도록 땅을 축복하고, 우리 동족이 마실 수 있도록 물을 정화하는 것입니다.

누군가가 나서서 영혼들을 꿈으로 이끌어야 합니다. 누군가는 그녀의 신성한 성소에서 찬송을 불러야 우리가 축복받고 그녀의 진노에서 벗어날 수 있습니다. 자연은 친절한 만큼 잔인한 여주인이기 때문입니다. 그리고 나는 그녀의 불만에 대해 느끼는 두려움에 대해 감히 한마디도 말할 수 없습니다.

-Niamh, 약사이자 Amuniai 의 장로

게임의 특징:

🌻 자신의 백성을 지키겠다는 결심을 한 젊은 여성과 그러한 야망이 불러일으키는 고통에도 불구하고 그들의 의지가 펼쳐지기를 바라는 신과 남자를 중심으로 한 스토리 기반 RPG입니다. 설정은 고전 시대에서 영감을 받았습니다. 헤게모니, 의식, 무자비한 정치의 시대. 붉게 물들이는 것 외에는 아무것도 원하는 것 같지 않은 여신이 지배하는 세계...

🌻 다채로운 2D 배경과 3D 그래픽 효과로 보완된 아름다운 사운드트랙이 포함된 구식 영감을 받은 예술입니다. 이 모든 것이 당신을 깊은 마법의 숲, 덩굴로 뒤덮인 고대 유적, 어두운 비밀이 숨어 있는 조용한 마을의 세계로 안내합니다. 음악, 사운드, 예술 및 그에 수반되는 모든 것은 드라마의 맛과 함께 조용하고 편안한 게임 경험을 제공하기 위해 만들어졌습니다.

🌻 상호 작용 가능한 세계: 덩굴을 키워 접근하기 어려운 지역에 접근하고 물체를 띄워 퍼즐을 풀고 숨겨진 보물을 발견하세요. 정식 출시에서는 세상과 상호 작용할 수 있는 더 많은 방법이 계획되어 있습니다.

🌻무작위 전투는 없습니다. 지도를 돌아다니며 원하는 만큼 많은 적과 싸워보세요. 물론, 핵심 스토리 전투는 제외됩니다. 결국 우리 영웅의 죽음을 노리는 생물과 인간이 있고, 그러한 행동은 여신을 기쁘게 합니다...

🌻 과거의 위대한 RPG에서 영감을 받아 RPG에서 기대할 수 있는 모든 요소를 갖춘 시간이 지남에 따라 진행되는 전투 시스템입니다. 전투에는 다양한 아이템, 장비, 전략이 필요합니다.

🌻 사용자 정의 컨트롤 설정, 몬스터 및 전투 애니메이션/이동 끄기, UI 색상/메뉴 레이아웃 등과 같은 다양한 접근성 기능. 스토리에 집중하는 것을 선호하는 사람들이나 죽음 자체를 극복하기 위해 필사적으로 싸우고 싶은 사람들을 위한 난이도 설정이 있습니다. 키보드와 Xbox 컨트롤러 지원이 모두 포함되어 있어 원하는 방식으로 게임을 플레이할 수 있습니다. 이것은 완전한 목록이 아니며 전체 릴리스에는 더 많은 옵션이 있을 것입니다.


게임의 첫 번째 부분을 다루고, 정식 출시에서 기대할 수 있는 세계, 캐릭터, 핵심 게임플레이를 소개하는 무료 데모가 제공됩니다. 데모에는 이번 정식 릴리스에서 사용할 수 있는 모든 기능이 포함되어 있지 않습니다.

지금까지 우리의 이야기가 흥미를 끌었다면 데모를 한번 시도해 보시기 바랍니다.

🌻 전투원을 전문화하고 전투를 신선하게 유지하는 다양한 캐릭터 클래스. 데모에 포함되지 않은 몇 가지 예는 다음과 같습니다:
마녀 - 체력 포인트를 사용하여 공격 주문에 연료를 공급하고 치명적인 부작용과 함께 아군에게 강력한 혜택을 제공합니다.
안개 위버 - 다양한 원소의 마법을 엮어 연속 시전을 강화합니다. 공격력을 극대화하려면 체인을 계속 유지하세요.
검의 처녀 - 마법을 사용하여 무기에 원소 효과를 주입하고 자연스러운 신체 능력을 강화하여 칼날과 활로 적을 학살합니다.

🌻 마법을 사용하여 세상에 영향을 미치는 방법에는 관목을 태우고, 어두운 동굴을 밝히고, 먼 물체를 조작하고, 맹렬한 불꽃을 끄는 등 여러 가지 방법이 있습니다. 게임의 많은 퍼즐과 숨겨진 영역을 해결하고 접근하려면 마법을 창의적으로 사용해야 합니다.

🌻 부서진 섬의 운명을 결정하는 4막의 이야기. 이 땅은 Diadochi 이와 피에 젖은 Martellus 의 왕관에 의한 또 다른 정복이 될 것인가? 신들의 파괴적인 변덕이 균형을 이룰 수 있을까요?

🌻 전체 경험의 길이는 약 20~30시간으로 계획되어 있지만, 플레이 스타일이 얼마나 철저한지 및/또는 선택한 난이도 설정에 따라 확실히 달라집니다.

title: Ultra Auto Gotchimon
description:
게임 정보
Digital Pets
Ultra Auto Gotchimon is a game with digital pets that sit on top of your screen, enabling you to care for your creatures effortlessly while multitasking. If you crave a more immersive experience, dive into strategic auto-battles, where you strategically select moves, navigate procedurally generated regions, and evolve your creatures.

Designed for Multitasking
Multitasking seamlessly—whether you're engaging in creature battles while watching YouTube or opting to magnify the game for a focused experience. Enjoy the flexibility to resize, move, and click through the game, maintaining its overlay presence. Immerse yourself in a world of synergies, unique typings, and evolving strategies in this auto-battler/virtual pet simulation hybrid.

Craft the perfect combination of moves and types by fusing moves together to create multi-typed moves, and train your Gotchi to adopt new typings.

Embark on a journey through procedurally generated regions with random events and battles, all while leveling up your Gotchi.

Show your Gotchi some love by taking care of it—feed it, play with it, and keep it happy. They'll be your loyal companions while you work, watch TV, or attend to other tasks. Collect all 19 unique Gotchis and create your ultimate team!

title: Paddle Protectors
description:
게임 정보
Build your city by selecting random buildings, establishing farms, factories, and more.
Defend your city from enemies. Build ammo caches, artillery, and missiles.

title: Xenocrystal TD
description:
게임 정보
Your mission is to protect the Xenocrystals as you go through alien territory. Use energy to teleport in your towers to defend the Xenocrystals.
Hundreds Of Upgrades

At the end of each stage, you can select upgrades that will stay with you through your mission. There's no purchasing on the towers - once you research that technology, it's yours.

Orbital Strikes

You can call down Orbital Strikes to target specific areas. Be careful though - as they have to recharge. But you can use energy to use them before they fully recharge on their own.
Different towers and Damage Types

Ten different types of towers - long-range/short-range, AOE or single target, shoot slowly or quickly. You choose your arsenal. There are also five types of damage - physical, fire, frost, poison, and lightning - with different effects.
Energy Management

Energy is used to teleport in your towers, or recharge your orbital abilities quickly. But between waves of enemies, you will gain energy proportional to how much energy you currently have and how quickly you've cleared the wave. Plan well and you may be able to use extra energy at the end of the level to get more upgrades or restore crystals.

No meta-progress. You will have access to all units, abilities, and upgrades from the start. Learning how to use them and what the enemies are doing is another story however.

Bosses aren't just damage sponges and have unique abilities or characteristics that separate them from their underlings.

title: Blankspace
description:
게임 정보
⬆️ Maximize Your Score!
Your mission: make as many points as possible by harnessing the power of emojis, each with its own unique effect. But be warned—fall short of the target, and it's game over. Strategize, optimize, and push your limits to stay ahead in this high-stakes challenge!



Jump into Blankspace now and see how far your strategy can take you. Will you unlock the ultimate synergies and rise to the top, or will the challenge push you to your limits? Start playing and find out!

title: Psychic Ward: Kill The Seven King Dragon
description:
게임 정보
Join the world as an agent of the Psychic Ward. Explore the strange surreal world and capture the immense world restructuring power of the Seven King Dragon. Use your mind as the weapon to take down the various threats through the history of this new world.
Find and learn new psychic techniques to fight through numerous enemies and boss fights. Explore the lore of this world through the numerous characters that you can encounter. Made decisions leading to the ultimate ending of this new story.

Psychic Ward: Kill The Seven King Dragon is a First Person Surreal Action Adventure game with multiple endings and require important decision making. The game is single player and involved combat against numerous types of enemies and features dodging and shooting mechanics.
