title: E-Sports Hockey League
description:
게임 정보
E-Sports Hockey League is on a mission to create the ultimate online multiplayer hockey experience.  Get ready for fast-paced arcade hockey renewed with modern gaming tech. Team up with your friends and compete in online matches, tournaments, and leagues.  Customize your franchise and compete for promotion to the big show and win the big prize.  It Doesn't matter how, just win.  Create your own fantasy team and join a league with your friends or random players.  ESHL is a game for hockey players by hockey players.

title: FOMOGRAPHY
description:
게임 정보
FOMOGRAPHY invites you on a story-driven photography adventure. Step into the shoes of an aging man, navigating the labyrinth of his own memories. As recollections fade, embark on a poignant quest to unravel past mysteries.

The Photos of Our Past
As an elderly man losing his memory, you have been tasked to go back and relive his life. Remember the joy of life, the places you've been, the people you've met. Even those small fleeting details that we forget soon after they happen. Even the traumas, the things that we'd rather forget. Every snapshot is a key to unlock the next revelation.
It's Your World To Explore
While capturing these memories, immerse yourself in a visual odyssey through your lens. Roam through lush Australian forests, dive into subterranean caves, and soak in the atmosphere of bustling towns that pulse with life. Your adventure takes you wherever your camera points.
Personalize Your Camera
Don’t let mindless defaults limit you. Customize your camera, transforming it into an extension of your creativity. Choose lenses that capture emotion, filters that paint memories, or display guides that frame your story with precision.
Chronicle Your Story
Treasure those polaroids! Preserve greatness in your personal album. Organize and explore a multitude of memories. Revisit past scenes and gauge your photographic prowess.
There's hundreds of things for you to find! What do you want to take a photo of? Adorable fauna, exquisite flora, varied landscapes, sparkling gems, peculiar townsfolk, or enigmatic clues. Your camera, your universe.

title: Langort
description:
게임 정보


로그라이트 덱빌딩 핵 앤 슬래시 게임인 Langort에서 정의롭고 대담한 검사로서 리치 여왕을 물리치기 위한 모험을 시작하세요. 처치할 때마다 더욱 강해지는 수많은 언데드 군단과 맞서 싸우세요. 죽이고, 죽고, 배우고, 이를 반복하세요.

특별한 능력을 개방하세요

모험하면서 발견한 마법 두루마리를 이용해 능력을 개방하세요! 당신은 단 3개의 슬롯을 갖고 있습니다. 따라서 어떤 능력을 택할지, 어떤 능력을 두고 갈지 선택해야 합니다.


언데드를 처치하세요!

수많은 업그레이드 카드 중 원하는 카드를 골라 영웅을 강화하세요. 당신만의 플레이 스타일에 맞추어, 당신만의 영웅을 만드세요!

title: Kingdom Defense: Deliverance
description:
게임 정보
이 몰입감 넘치는 2D 게임에서 끊임없는 오크와 악당의 파도로부터 성을 지켜내세요. 독특한 방어 유닛과 전략적인 게임 플레이를 활용하여 요새를 보호하고 승리를 쟁취하세요. 왕국을 지키면서 장대한 전투와 스릴 넘치는 판타지 모험을 경험하세요.
주요 특징
역동적인 전투 메커니즘: 몰입감 넘치는 전투 메커니즘으로 전략적인 실시간 게임 플레이를 즐기세요.
독특한 방어 유닛: 다양한 영웅, 전사, 신비로운 생명체를 지휘하여 방어를 강화하세요.
강력한 능력: 영웅에게 특별한 능력을 장착하고 파괴적인 힘을 발휘하여 오크의 침략을 막아내세요.
도전적인 레벨: 각각 고유한 적과 장애물이 있는 일련의 도전적인 레벨에서 전투를 벌이세요.
에픽 보스 전투: 전략적인 기술과 결단력을 시험하는 강력한 보스와 대결하세요.
게임플레이
침략군을 격퇴하기 위한 전술을 계획하고 실행하면서 전략적인 방어의 세계로 뛰어들어 보세요. 각 레벨마다 새로운 도전과 적들이 등장하므로 전략을 조정하고 개선해야 합니다. 자원을 수집하고 유닛을 업그레이드하고 난공불락의 요새를 건설하여 공세를 막아내세요.
전투에 참여하기
킹덤 디펜스를 다운로드하세요: 지금 다운로드하여 오크의 침략으로부터 왕국을 지키기 위한 장대한 여정을 시작하세요. 영웅이 되어 군대를 승리로 이끄세요!

title: Keystone Titans VR
description:
게임 정보


Keystone Titans VR is a VR Autobattler where units will need to be strategically selected and arranged to dominate your opponents. Outsmart the enemy with clever drafting, positioning, and economy management.



Build synergies with different champions.



Strategically manage your resources to create the best team.

title: Mod Shooter
description:
게임 정보
Mod Shooter: the arena FPS where every the rules change every game! Inspired by the boomer shooters arena shooters of the past, as well as LAN parties with custom lobbies, Mod Shooter changes the rules of the game every round.
Party Game Meets Arena Shooter!

Across multiple maps and game modes, modifiers will fundamentally shape how you play each game of Mod Shooter. With different maps, modes, modifiers, and weapons, no two games will ever be the same.

Want more control? The host can also manually modify the game settings.

Features
4 Game Modes
4 Maps
15 Modifiers
3 Guns
Thousands of Unique Game Combinations!

Please note that there is currently no public matchmaking, and only private invite-only lobbies are supported. Public lobbies and matchmaking may possibly be added in a future update, depending on interest.

title: Fugue Shot
description:
게임 정보
Each run in Fugue Shot presents a series of unique dreamscapes, filled with increasingly difficult puzzles and randomized encounters to test your abilities to their limit. Plan your shots carefully to clear the playfield and overcome the ever-shifting landscape of this liminal and surreal world.
Build Your Own Solutions
Set up your playfield, test different ideas, and interact with a satisfying physics engine to master constantly changing puzzles and challenges.
Power Up Your Run
Choose from dozens of unique items to impact your gameplay and warp your playstyle. Discover powerful synergies to create truly unique builds, allowing for emergent gameplay and a constantly shifting experience.

title: The Ogi: Cycles
description:
게임 정보
Enjoy the moments, take it at your own pace, delve into mysteries, listen to the sounds of the wind and spot birds and creatures on your way!
Intro
"Welcome, curious stranger, to the world of Mullar!

Come, sit by the fire - you came just in time for the gathering. I would prepare some tasty berry juice, but the berries are gone.. Because of the storms. And so, I’m afraid, is half of our tribe.

Everything was so peaceful and cozy.. And suddenly, it wasn’t anymore. Suddenly, it was all chaos. We don’t know why or how. We just know.. That we miss our friends. I bet they’re lonely out there.. Lonely and story-less. If the storms keep coming, I think we will run out of stories, too..

But tonight, the Elder will share a tale. A dark, important one. About when The Ogi arrived - and led us into chaos. That one, it scares me. A lot.

Luckily, legends aren’t true. .. They aren’t, are they?"

Key features
A unique and beautiful world, filled with mystery, history, interesting creatures and life!
Draw your way through puzzles, unique places and a rich emotional story!
Play on any device you want!

title: Seedborne Soldiers
description:
게임 정보
Seedborne Soldiers is an auto battler roguelike presented in the sweet, nostalgic style of a low-polygon Playstation 1 game. Draft an army from 75 (!) playable units and fight to escape the surreal Dreamworld. Mix and match from a huge selection of traits, equipment, and trinkets to capitalize on powerful synergies and overcome unique enemies and bosses.

title: Into the M.A.W.
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Into the M.A.W. is a 2-4 person co-op space combat campaign. Gather your crew, assign their roles, and work together to complete perilous missions within a mysterious time loop.
Prepare to enter the M.A.W., your ship’s Miniaturized Aperture Wormhole, to escape a mysterious time loop. As your team embarks on intergalactic missions, rely on learned strategies from previous missions to manage increasingly dangerous threats to your ship and crew. As you complete different objectives, activate the M.A.W. to transport you to your next destination… or reset time to try for a different outcome. Can your crew survive long enough to uncover the secrets of the M.A.W.?
2-4 Person Co-Op
Built from the ground up for co-op play, collaboration isn’t just encouraged - it’s essential to your crew’s survival. Choose from one of four roles and embark on new missions with your friends where every choice counts.
The Captain leads the crew by making strategic and story decisions, scanning for intel, and interacting with other vessels.
The Pilot maneuvers through dangers, utilizing cloaking to outsmart enemies and time travel to restart the mission.
The Gunner commands the ship’s impressive arsenal, from color-dependent lasers to an array of different missile types.
The Engineer manages power distribution, repairs, and shields to keep the ship in one piece amid enemy assaults.

title: Slime Survivors
description:
게임 정보
"Slime Survivors" – Survive the Limitless Monster Onslaught!
As endless hordes of demons swarm like tidal waves, you’ll become a hero of the Slime Kingdom, upgrading diverse weapons to forge instruments of carnage! Dodge through bullet-hell barrages, unleash dazzling ultimate skills to shred enemy waves, and experience an adrenaline-pumping roguelike survival frenzy!
How to Play
All you need to do: Move your character, aim at enemies, evade attacks, collect rewards, power up, and slaughter foes in style!

title: Prisonela MD
description:
게임 정보

Get ready for platforming incarceration insanity in this new Megadrive game, Prisonela MD. These levels may be short, but fun!
Use your special parkour abilities to overcome all the obstacles, and avoid all the traps. Don’t expect to atone for your mistakes in this prison madhouse though. Each time you die, you’ll be warped to a completely different level where you’ll have to adapt and survive.

title: The Hatchling
description:
게임 정보
The Hatchling
Locked in a dystopian lab, a strange egg stirs. Its temperature, humidity, and nutrients must be maintained with precision. Its integrity is fragile. And you must not fail.
The Overseer watches—cold, unwavering, and silent in its judgment. You are but one of many caretakers before you, each evaluated, each replaced. Failure is not an option.
A Game of Dread and Precision
This low-bit horror simulation demands absolute efficiency:
✔ Regulate temperature, humidity, and nutrients—maintain the egg’s delicate balance.
✔ Acquire and ration lab supplies through the Supply Shaft—resources are limited.
✔ Combat system malfunctions—power surges, failing dispensers, will test you.
✔ Endure the Overseer’s relentless judgment—its criteria are unknown, its patience is not infinite.
✔ Uncover the hidden purpose of the lab—and your own existence.
A Test Hard to Pass
As you carry out your task, something deeper stirs within the facility. The unseen presence behind the Overseer grows aware of you. A voice—distorted, ancient—seeps into the system. Is it watching through the Overseer? Or has it always been there?

title: Wasteland Punk
description:
게임 정보
Dive into Wasteland Punk — the ultimate RPG of survival in a world shattered by catastrophe! Face a gripping story full of twists, fierce enemies, and intense turn-based combat. Unleash your tactical brilliance with weapons forged or scavenged from the ruins of civilization.

title: Dream Night
description:
게임 정보
당신은 당신의 악몽에서 깨어납니다. 이번 달에 얼마나 많은 악몽을 셀 수 없습니다. 그러나 이번에는 깨어 난 후, 당신은 집에 이상한 현상이 있었지만 외출하고 싶었지만 문이 잠겼습니다 ...
이 게임에서 당신은 아파트에 사는 평범한 사람의 역할을 수행 하여이 악몽을 피하기 위해 최선을 다할 것입니다. 게임의 주요 내용은 암호 해독 탐색과 그 뒤에 파우르와 플랫폼 점프가 이어지고 물론 이러한 내용은 끔찍한 분위기에서 경험 될 것입니다.

title: Ember the Werefox
description:
게임 정보
Play the role of young Ember, as she confronts her fears in this dream forest;  curiously resourceful by day and mystically fierce by night.
Key Features:
Explore a dream forest as young Ember by day, collecting, building and preparing for the dangers of darkness.
Battle relentless monsters throughout the night as the mystical Werefox, empowered with fiery abilities, cosmic moon powers, and significant upgrades!
When not making progress in the dream world, awaken to Ember's bedroom, where new techniques can be purchased and dream-altering outfits can be unlocked.
Visit Ember's bad memories periodically in this 4 Chapter narrative, where a cast of magical friends will help Ember deal with her fears and become brave enough to drive the nightmares from her thoughts and dreams forever!
Utilize the Forest


The woods in Ember's dreams are how she imagines them: full of resources she can use to prepare for nightfall. Find materials to build and stock light sources, pick, pull and catch different ingredients for invaluable meals, and empower Ember's nightly werefox form! Ember's menu-free crafting experience enables you to quickly stack components together as you dash around the woods, using the fleeting daylight hours to quickly explore, scavenge and craft.


As darkness envelops the woods, Ember will take on her combat-proficient form, enchanted with fiery abilities and magical powers. As she eats meals, various skills will stack to give her a strategic fighting chance against the ever-increasing bombardment of spooky enemies. Take back the forest from the shroud of fear to slowly (but permanently) populate the forest with new food sources, enabling Ember to become yet even stronger!


As Ember is defeated in her dreams, she awakens to her cozy bedroom. Her talking plush fox waits for her here to absorb the nasty "dreamite" Ember collects while asleep. This is turned "courage", the resource used to purchase new abilities and permanent upgrades!

Ember can also catch up on her dream journal illustrations, which correspond to new discoveries and progress. These illustrations will give her additional courage to grow from, and a sense of understanding her progress across all of the dreams.

By accomplishing specific achievements in her dreams, Ember will also unlock dozens of new outfits, which will enchant her and the dream forest in many different ways!


While the plush upgrades, outfits, and story-based tasks completed in dreams are permanent, there are several ways each dream will give Ember a fresh start:



By improving and adapting to each dream and it's secrets, you can help Ember uncover and defeat the 4 nightmares of this dream world!

title: Maze and Fairy tale
description:
게임 정보
여주인공은 몇 가지 이상한 이유로 미궁 속으로 빠졌다.
이 미궁에서 30일 동안 생존해야만 미궁에서 탈출할 수 있다.

낮에는 생존에 필요한 물자를 모으기 위해 미궁 속으로 들어갈 수 있다.
하지만 해가 지기 전에 본기지로 돌아가야 한다!
밤의 미로는 변화가 많고 괴물이 출현한다.

미로에서 당신은 완전히 다른 동화 같은 세계를 여러 개 경험하게 될 것이다.
이 동화나라에는 많은 나라가 존재합니다. 포커 왕국, 비비 나라, 증기 나라 등등.
나라들간에 분쟁이 끊이지 않고 세계는 파멸의 위기에 처해있다.
생존한 날이 많아짐에 따라, 당신은 각 나라를 여행하고, 각 세계의 구석구석에 숨겨진 비밀을 발견할 것이다. (존 웨인, 지혜명언)

생존을 위해서는 괴물로부터 방어할 수 있는 무기나 탑을 쌓을 수 있다.
함정을 만드는 것을 추천합니다.
함정끼리 배합을 이루어 몬스터를 연타견제하여 더욱 높은 대미지를 입힌다.

2차원 (2d) 스타일의 서바이벌 가타디펜스 구축용 arpg 게임이다.
지하 감옥과 타워 디펜스 건설을 결합하여, 함정의 달인이 되어, 의외의 콤보를 그려낸다.
autokwd: Maze and Fairy tale,迷宫童话

title: Final Shot
description:
게임 정보
파이널 샷으로 최고의 슈팅 게임을 경험해 보세요! 모든 샷이 중요하고 모든 움직임이 승패를 가르는 긴박한 액션과 격렬한 전투의 세계에 빠져보세요.

숙련된 저격수로서 순발력과 무기를 사용해 적군을 쓰러뜨리고 까다로운 임무를 완수해야 합니다. 은밀한 저격부터 전면적인 공격까지, 변화하는 상황에 적응하고 적보다 한 발 앞서 나가야 합니다.

파이널 샷은 정밀함과 기술, 그리고 강철 같은 신경을 요구하는 탑다운 액션 게임입니다. 놀라운 그래픽과 중독성 있는 게임플레이로 첫 플레이부터 빠져들게 될 것입니다.

궁극의 슈팅 게임에 도전할 준비가 되셨다면 지금 바로 Final Shot을 다운로드하고 내면의 전사를 발휘할 준비를 하세요. 여러분의 실력을 세상에 보여줄 시간입니다 - 파이널 샷을 할 준비가 되셨나요?

title: 7Years
description:
게임 정보
7Years is a non-linear, open-world horror game, that offers both a single-player story and 4-player online co-op. After waking up in the middle of the night, you discover that you're wife is missing. Desperate to find her, you try to find help, only to quickly learn that the only person left in your entire mountainside neighborhood is you. No phone service and the main powerline to the neighborhood has been severed. You are alone, or so you think, until you find a modified HAM radio system that is transmitting a repeating message...with your name in it. The person on the other end may be your only hope to find your wife and survive the horrors surrounding you. Traverse open-world maps as you investigate for clues, solve puzzles, uncover mysteries and elude unique demonic enemies, each created to trigger a specific fear and complete their only mission...to find you.

title: Dare to Lucid Dream
description:
게임 정보
STORY

For the first time in years, Sonny meets a person he knows inside of his lucid dreams: a boy from his school who Sonny has never spoken with in real life.

Over the next few days, not only other people known to him appear in his dreams, but Sonny also realises that the things he said and did were reflected in real life. Now, divided between the events and experiences of real life and those that happen inside his lucid dreams, Sonny oscillates between living an ordinary life and in using his dreams to discover, understand and help the people around him.

GAMEPLAY

This is a story focused Visual Novel game. The gameplay revolves around interacting with the game to advance the plot through the eyes of the protagonist Sonny, and making choices along the way. The choices you make will affect the relationship you have with the characters and will also affect how the story ends.

FEATURES

Live in two worlds: the real one, with real people, and the dream world, where you will discover more about the people around you - without them knowing that everything is just a dream
Discover what dreams say about each person around you, and how this can change not only the relationship between you, but the person's life in general
Make friends and bond with people in the real world - you never know what they might say to you or how they might help you
Make choices and feel their consequences through the game
Discover ways of helping not only those around you, but also Sonny himself
Multiple endings according to your choices
A lot of characters that you can create bonds, connections and friendships with
Change the fate of the characters according to the direction of their conversations
100% original soundtrack
Original character sprites and CGs

title: Row Hard
description:
게임 정보
Build your rowing team and lead it to victory. You will have to find your own sources of income, provide the team with everything they need. Manage their training, as well as constantly make sure that they do not get into trouble.
On your way will stand competitors, authorities, organizers of underground races and a lot of those who believe that the only way to success in sports is money. Will you be able to prove otherwise?
Game Features:
- Your task: to get the gold of the Olympics and prove to everyone that hard work wins in sports!
- Many decisions will separate you from the goal, and each will not be simple.

title: KnockedDown
description:
게임 정보

Engage in fast-paced driving through bustling streets, around sharp turns and through traffic.



Fun racing through destructive enviroments, explosions and much more!



It ain't easy. Police is on your tail. Evade until the extraction plane arrives!



Extract before it's too late. The longer you wait the less cash you have left.

title: SHAPELAND
description:
게임 정보
SHAPELAND는 플레이하기 쉽고 이기기 어려운 싱글 플레이어 1인칭 슈팅 게임입니다.
무기는 하나뿐이고 파워업은 없습니다.
피나 고어, 재장전, 유지 관리, 공개된 지식, 거래/통화, 제작, 인벤토리, 긴 여정, 그라인드가 없습니다!
가장 빠른 시간과 가장 높은 점수를 위한 경쟁만 있습니다!
이 작은 오픈 월드 환경에서는 매초 무언가가 일어납니다. 표적을 향해 사격하고, 픽업을 쫓고, 포털과 벽을 여는 동안 적의 모양을 피하고 피합니다.

최대의 재미! 저중력 지형에서 걷고, 달리고, 질주하고, 점프할 수 있습니다. 특정 모양과 아이템을 활용하여 레벨을 '날아다니는' 법을 배우세요. 물 위를 이동하고 때로는 공중을 이동하는 보트도 있습니다. 이 아름답고 중독성 있는 리플레이 가능한 슈팅 게임에는 7개의 레벨과 보너스 레벨이 있습니다. 재미있습니다!

최대의 재미!
게임 세계 전체가 벽으로 사분면으로 나뉜 '유리' 상자 안에 있습니다. 포털을 열고 벽을 내려 새로운 지역에 접근하고 풍경을 바꿔 새로운 보물과 포털을 드러냅니다. 결국 상자 밖에서 게임의 꼭대기로 가는 방법을 찾아 승리합니다!

title: Lost Relics
description:
게임 정보
Story
Elwin once had a family, but he lost them while bravely defending them from an unstoppable evil. Now, driven by love and vengeance, he's ready to reclaim what was lost and bring his family back — no matter the cost.
Gameplay
The Lost Relics is a Zelda-inspired action-adventure game, blending intense combat, mind-bending puzzles, and the strategic use of powerful, ancient Relics.
Each room presents a unique challenge — an intricate environment filled with secrets, clever puzzles, and opportunities to test your skill and wit. Solve, fight, and strategize your way through a world where every decision counts and every encounter could change your fate.

title: Shadows Over Harken
description:
게임 정보
Step into the medieval fantasy world of Shadows over Harken, where a dark necromancer threatens to corrupt the peaceful village of Harken and its surrounding lands. Join a unique team of heroes—Relic, a strong warrior; Alessia, a gifted cleric blessed with power; Hiligon, a powerful paladin; Klean, an agile fighter from another plane; and Neville, a unique and special bard. Experience an immersive visual novel that combines deep storytelling with combat mechanics, where your choices shape the story and the fate of the land. Engage in battles, explore a richly detailed world, and uncover hidden secrets while enjoying captivating artwork and an epic soundtrack. Can you lead your team to victory and stop the necromancer before it’s too late? History based in an original roleplaying campaing.

title: Endless Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Endless Tactics is a Turn-Based Roguelite game where you play as the commander of a high-risk planetary mining expedition. Defend your base from incessant hordes of alien creatures as you harvest valuable resources, and weather dangerous planetary hazards such as spore filled meteor showers and earthquakes, all while uncovering valuable drop pods and new mysterious Artifacts. Whenever things get too bleak, Extract to your orbiting spaceship to rearm, Upgrade, and unlock more dangerous and profitable worlds the more you further you get. Good luck, Commander. MechTek is counting on you to make a buck!
SECURE YOUR OPERATION
Defend your mining operation from the alien menace! Manage a variety of units from military vehicles to towering mechs to fight back the deadly alien hordes as you extract valuable resources! Sometimes, tough decisions and sacrifices will be necessary to keep it going just until the next Extraction Opportunity!
EXPANSIVE UPGRADES
Outfit your orbiting spaceship with the latest gear in excavation and offensive technology (warning: some upgrades might increase profits at the cost of survivability).

title: Buhei
description:
게임 정보
Twin-Stick Party Shooter
Up to 8 players in local multiplayer (controller required)
Up to 8 players with Steam Remote Play
A wide variety of weapons and abilities
Different game modes: Free for all, Teams, and more...
Character customization options
The Game
Attention! Behold Buhei! The wonder granted to humanity! Experience how believed boundaries fade away and the exquisite combination of game mechanics transcends the human mind.
Multiplayer
In this game, up to 8 players can compete against each other in friendly or less friendly rivalry at the same time. Buhei is THE party game! Gather your friends! Gather your enemies! Marvel together at the explosion of action on your screen.
Diverse Weapons
Watch out! Witness the symphony of firepower. A fantastic arsenal that gives you the opportunity to wreak havoc on your opponents. An inexhaustible selection awaits you. From high-speed projectiles to sophisticated traps that can outsmart even the cleverest opponents.

title: Escape The Charon
description:
게임 정보
Escape the Charon은 한 번에 플레이할 수 있는 SF 어드벤처 게임입니다

그 물체는 은하계 가장자리에 있는 죽어가는 행성의 사막에서 발견되었습니다. 고고학 팀이 기둥을 발굴했을 때, 그 알 수 없는 상형문자가 그들에게 오싹함을 안겨주었습니다. 이것이 고대인의 작품일 수 있을까요? 그들은 우주 정거장 Charon에서 Andrea West와 그녀의 팀의 도움을 받아 그 기원의 미스터리를 밝혀냈습니다.

제임스 웨스트는 절실히 필요한 휴가를 위해 지구로 배를 조종하고 있었습니다. "안드레아로부터 메시지를 받았습니다." 컴퓨터가 울렸습니다. 그는 신경 연결 장치를 켜고 미소를 지으며 메시지를 열었습니다.

"지미, 도움이 필요해요. 뭔가 크게 잘못됐어요! 혹시..."

그녀의 나머지 말은 잘렸다. 그는 즉시 카론으로 진로를 설정했습니다.

"나 왔어 누나"
조사하다

title: Urban Project
description:
게임 정보
Build Beautiful and Charming Cities in This Game
In this game, you won’t have to deal with complex tasks like micromanagement or resource tracking. Just relax and build your own city, increasing profits and completing quests.
You'll find a wide variety of buildings, each with unique behavior. The income from many structures depends on their location and neighbors, so you'll need to decide where to place your buildings for maximum benefit.
Here are just a few:
Field
Mine
Office
Amusement Park
And over 30 more!
If you ever feel that a building is placed in a way that hinders your plans, you can always demolish it.
Quests

title: Cyber Climb
description:
게임 정보
CYBER CLIMB blends fast-paced movement shooter with strategic factory building.
Like Satisfactory + Titanfall 2.

Your objectives are simple: kill robots, finish quests, build a rocket to get home from Mars. Along the way, you'll encounter increasingly difficult enemies, challenging environments, and a variety of obstacles designed to test your skills.
With inspiration from games like RoboQuest, Deadlink, and Deus Ex, CYBER CLIMB delivers dynamic combat and fluid movement mechanics. Use a grappling hook, double jumps, and air dashes to outmaneuver enemies and navigate tricky platforms. Choose from 7 different weapons, upgrade your abilities with a roguelike card system, and make every run unique as the challenge intensifies the longer you play.
Key Features:
7 unique weapons to discover and master
Factory building: crafting, conveyor belts, batteries, etc.
Movement mechanics like grappling hooks, double jumps, and air dashes for fast-paced traversal
Skills such as throwing grenades and creating bounce pads for creative combat
Roguelike upgrade system: buy new cards and power-ups with in-game currency
Dynamic difficulty: the longer the run, the harder the game becomes
Box stacking to create exploration opportunities
Immersive sim elements that reward experimentation and strategy
CYBER CLIMB is currently in heavy development by a solo developer, with regular updates and new content planned until the release. Feedback from players is highly appreciated!

title: Storm's Wrath
description:
게임 정보
이 게임의 주요 초점은 조용한 내러티브입니다. 즉, 스토리가 텍스트나 대화 없이 전달됩니다. 캐릭터 표현, 음악, 시각적 언어를 활용하여 장면을 통해 역동적인 플롯이 전개됩니다. 탐험, 전투, 보스전은 짧은 내러티브 장면 사이에 있습니다.
또한 게임 튜토리얼과 메뉴에도 텍스트가 사용되지 않습니다. 따라서 게임 제목/로고를 제외하고 게임에는 언어가 포함되어 있지 않으며 영어를 이해하지 못해도 즐길 수 있습니다.
스토리 요약
폭풍이 몰아칠 때 한 여자는 잃어버린 남편을 그리워한다. 그러던 중 이상한 인물들이 습격한다.

title: Cosy Company Puzzle
description:
게임 정보
You're hiring more and more people for your small company!
But that's not all – you need to fit everyone into their workspace. And as if their various shapes and sizes weren't enough, they also come with special requests!
Take George, for example: he always wants to be next to the coffee machine.

title: Planet Hoarders
description:
게임 정보
You are a replicant engineered by the Corporation for a single purpose: gather valuable bio-species from abandoned facilities across various planets.

Alone or with up to three teammates, you'll land on planet surfaces to explore and locate facility entrances. Inside, navigate dark, procedurally generated networks of rooms and tunnels to collect small creatures you can carry—but beware of monsters that aim to end you. Stealth, strategy, and teamwork are essential to evade or confront these threats.

With limited time on each planet, you must act swiftly to meet your KPIs.
Use in-game radio communication to share information and coordinate actions to access restricted areas.

Finally, uncover the unsettling truth behind your mission.

title: Crabs Dive In Crossway
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
"Crabs Dive In Crossway" is a Sokoban-like puzzle game. You need to command a troop of crabs and manage them to the target places. Each crab can only move in horizontal or vertical line, and all crabs will move simultaneously.
When two crabs from crossed directions meet, the later crab will step on the back of the former to form a Crab-Bind, and be driven to move along with the crab below. A Crab-Bind can push single crab forward. The gameplay is all about "How to reasonably allocate target shelters for each crab and deliver them to place". You may try hard brainstorming to avoid the crowding and trampling of crabs in horizontal and vertical lines.
There are 6 chapters, altogether 60 manually designed levels for playing around. Each chapter corresponds to a unique puzzle solving technique for you to discover.
Control
一 Menu 一
[ WASD/↑←↓→ ] Move Crab
[ SPACE ] Interact
一 In Level 一
[ WASD/↑←↓→ ] Move (by grid)
[ ESC ] Exit Level
[ R ] Retry
[ Z ] Undo
[ X ] Redo
Contact Us
QQ Group: 825324074

title: Slingshot Pilot
description:
게임 정보
Master gravity (or crash trying) in Slingshot Pilot! Pull off risky maneuvers, dodge asteroids, and complete crazy missions to rank up in the corp, and get riskier and shadier assignments. Compete versus peers in the highscore chase but dont fly too close to the sun..
Navigate, Adapt, Survive
Take control of a nimble spaceship and weave through levels filled with shifting gravitational forces from planets and other celestial bodies. Each environment is dynamic and packed with hazards and obstacles. Planning ahead and split-second reactions are your lifelines, but don’t get too comfortable—crashing is all part of the learning curve - So is nailing that perfect gravity maneuver.
A Universe of Peril and Mystery
Navigate asteroid fields, lava planets, ice worlds, and gas giants. Rescue stranded pilots, evacuate survivors, and dodge ominous outsiders that seem to hunt you. Danger lurks everywhere—can you survive the chaos?
Achievements and Leaderboards
Going an extra mile, lending a helping hand endulging your curiosity is rewarded with achievements. Compete with friends and other players on leaderboards, cut corners and perfect your slingshot skills to leave rivals in your space dust.
Keyboard or Game Controller
Play with what you find more comfortable. This game is optimized for Keyboard + Mouse as well as Common Controllers and works naturally also on Steam Deck.

title: Vespia: Shield of Aberration
description:
게임 정보
We regret to inform you that your performance at our academy has not met the standards expected of our esteemed and world-renowned alumni in the anomalous arts.
The zone-excursion programme introduced to fill the void left behind by our late-heroes is the sole option remaining for your continued studies, an exceptionally dangerous venture where only the strongest return.
Your journey cannot be completed alone, each new student joining your party will bring something new to the table with unique abilities, spells and upgrade trees.
Each new character that you unlock has:
A unique skill tree for that character
Upgradable active abilities
Character-specific cards to enhance your deck
During battle, each student can be given modifier cards that bring them closer to mastering the anomalous and becoming an unstoppable force.
Spells interact with other spells, creating an expansive range of combinations

title: Shapefighter
description:
게임 정보
Blast through waves of shapes
Take down the boss

title: Rogue Runner
description:
게임 정보
위시리스트에 추가하는 것을 잊지 마세요.
Rogue Runner는 빠른 속도의 Runner-like / Rogue-like, 3인칭 슈팅, 액션 및 플랫폼 게임입니다. 당신은 갇힌 가능성을 뚫기 위해 달려야 합니다. 달리면서 다양한 가능성을 발견하게 될 것입니다. 달리고, 죽이고, 개선하고, 반복하여 주기를 깨세요!

title: Tony's Creepy Crawly Zoo 2.0
description:
게임 정보
Step into the captivating world of Tony's Creepy Crawly Zoo 2.0, where science and adventure collide! This immersive VR experience lets you explore a vibrant insect science museum filled with live insects and reptiles in stunning macro detail. Shrink to their scale and discover the intricate beauty of their world like never before.
The experience also includes a special room showcasing the legendary Dan Capps Exhibit, one of the world's most extensive insect collections, with over 100 meticulously curated display cases. In this immersive exhibit, experience video recordings of Dan Capps himself, as he pops up throughout the room to guide you through the fascinating world of entomology. Whether you’re marveling at the intricacy of insect anatomy or learning about the rare species Dan has collected, this experience brings the hidden wonders of nature right to your fingertips.
Perfect for science enthusiasts and curious explorers, this immersive experience offers an unforgettable introduction to the rich biodiversity of our planet’s insects and reptiles—all from the comfort of your own space.

title: #7-J5Z: The Driftwood Experiment
description:
게임 정보
Set in the 1950's at the Limestone Coast, South Australia. A robot is sent to an unexplored underwater cave to gather and test a phosphorescent fungus that is extracted from pieces of driftwood located throughout the cave system. The player's objective is to collect all of the different fish and plants that can be found in the cave. There are also landmarks that needs to be discovered which can be utilised by the player.
SOLO DEVELOPED
FREE TO PLAY
Key Features
Discover and collect fish and plants
Find landmarks and use them for your benefit
Simple and easy to play
Experience a classified mission that took place in the 1950's
Relax and enjoy the underwater vibe

title: Star Paws
description:
게임 정보
Star Paws is a space simulator with sandbox elements. In this simulator, you play as an astronaut cat. Your goal is to develop your own space program. Don't let having paws stop you! Build a spacecraft from a variety of components and venture into space in search for a strange signal coming from a distant deep corner of the Solar System!
Key features:
Combine numerous spare parts to design unique spacecrafts. Each part has its special traits that influence your spacecraft's behavior.
Perform complex maneuvers with full control of your spacecraft
Become a part of astronaut cat crew: play as one and talk to others! Complete their tasks to learn more about cat world!
Perform missions in space as close by scale to the real one as you can get! Visit planets of the Solar System with unique biomes. Explore their surface for minerals, caсhes and easter eggs!
Construct your own space stations for space observation.
Colonize planets.
Go on missions with your friends together in Online mode.
Develop new technologies with resources from all over the Solar System to eventually venture far beyond its limits!

title: Only Arrows
description:
게임 정보
FREE DEMO AVAILABLE!
Only Arrows is a 2D puzzle game, where the rules are everchanging but only controls you'll have are the movement keys.
You'll explore grid-based maps, encountering both self-contained logic puzzles and exploration based treasure hunts.
Test things out, learn and study the environment to get the keys required to advance further.
Full release features:
10 levels, each with its own theme
Every level comprised of several logic puzzles and movement challenges, each unique
Trophies for completing everything in a level
Only movement keys to control everything in the game

title: 7Years
description:
게임 정보
7Years is a non-linear, open-world horror game, that offers both a single-player story and 4-player online co-op. After waking up in the middle of the night, you discover that you're wife is missing. Desperate to find her, you try to find help, only to quickly learn that the only person left in your entire mountainside neighborhood is you. No phone service and the main powerline to the neighborhood has been severed. You are alone, or so you think, until you find a modified HAM radio system that is transmitting a repeating message...with your name in it. The person on the other end may be your only hope to find your wife and survive the horrors surrounding you. Traverse open-world maps as you investigate for clues, solve puzzles, uncover mysteries and elude unique demonic enemies, each created to trigger a specific fear and complete their only mission...to find you.

title: Dare to Lucid Dream
description:
게임 정보
STORY

For the first time in years, Sonny meets a person he knows inside of his lucid dreams: a boy from his school who Sonny has never spoken with in real life.

Over the next few days, not only other people known to him appear in his dreams, but Sonny also realises that the things he said and did were reflected in real life. Now, divided between the events and experiences of real life and those that happen inside his lucid dreams, Sonny oscillates between living an ordinary life and in using his dreams to discover, understand and help the people around him.

GAMEPLAY

This is a story focused Visual Novel game. The gameplay revolves around interacting with the game to advance the plot through the eyes of the protagonist Sonny, and making choices along the way. The choices you make will affect the relationship you have with the characters and will also affect how the story ends.

FEATURES

Live in two worlds: the real one, with real people, and the dream world, where you will discover more about the people around you - without them knowing that everything is just a dream
Discover what dreams say about each person around you, and how this can change not only the relationship between you, but the person's life in general
Make friends and bond with people in the real world - you never know what they might say to you or how they might help you
Make choices and feel their consequences through the game
Discover ways of helping not only those around you, but also Sonny himself
Multiple endings according to your choices
A lot of characters that you can create bonds, connections and friendships with
Change the fate of the characters according to the direction of their conversations
100% original soundtrack
Original character sprites and CGs

title: Squirrels Gone Nuts
description:
게임 정보

You have three different player modes at your disposal: shoot, sprint, and slide. Shoot mode equips your current weapon for firing. Sprint increases your movement speed. Slide allows you to maintain your momentum.


If you can see it, you can run on it. Every surface in the arena can be traversed allowing for a unique perspective on the 2D arena shooter.


Shoot other players with your weapon, and don't worry you'll never run out of ammo. When you're hurt, grab a health nut to get back up to full health.


The way you move around the arena is only limited by your imagination. Utilize the weapons and mechanics to maneuver around and outsmart your opponents.

title: Kiko's Apple Adventure
description:
게임 정보
What if you can move the target point in a block pushing game?
Kiko is a curious little bear who loves tasty apples. Help Kiko collect apples to make the biggest apple pie ever!
But be aware of dangers!
Outsmart your enemy!

title: Desolated District
description:
게임 정보
Desolated District is a survival crafting game set in a post-apocalyptic dystopia. Scavenge, craft, build, and battle to survive in a sprawling, decaying urban environment now overrun with looming threats.
Explore a Vast Post-Apocalyptic World
Build and Customize Your Base
Grow and Harvest Your Own Crops
Craft, Upgrade, and Survive
Engage in Challenging Combat
Progression and Skill Development
Resource Management and Strategy
Traverse an expansive district filled with abandoned homes, crumbling factories, and hidden underground areas. Uncover secrets, scavenge for resources, and encounter dangers lurking in every corner.
company: Real Heroes Studio, SC 16 BIT NIGHTS SRL

title: Bar Night VR
description:
게임 정보
Bar Night VR puts you in the shoes of a virtual bartender, where the hustle never stops! Manage your underground bar, serving customers, restocking drinks, filling machines, and keeping the night alive. As you progress through each shift, you’ll face new challenges and master the art of being a bartender.
Start by serving simple drinks, then work your way up to crafting complex cocktails—all while ensuring your bar stays in control and the vibes stay fun!
Serve up drinks and learn new bartending skills
Keep the peace and prevent bar brawls
Cater to all kinds of customers, from everyday patrons to the more... mysterious types
And most importantly, keep yourself sober!
Get ready to mix, serve, restock, and repeat—because in Bar Night VR, the party never ends!

title: Crimson Quest
description:
게임 정보
흔히 RTS 장르는 플레이어가 형성한 모든 기지와 유닛을 다방면으로 조작하며 멀티태스킹을 요구하는 반면, '크림슨 퀘스트'는 하나의 플레이어 캐릭터만을 움직이고 자체 생산 기지가 되어, 다양한 특성을 지닌 유닛(몬스터)과 전투 타워를 생성할 수 있습니다. 이로써 작은 악마에게 막대한 생산 능력을 부여하고, 실시간으로 이루어지는 로그라이크 방식의 진행과 탐험의 재미, 소소한 액션까지! 기존의 RTS 요소와 완벽한 결합을 이루어낸 새롭고 독특한 장르의 게임입니다.
탐험을 해보세요.
탐험을 통해 다양한 오브젝트를 찾아내고, 필드에 어떤 야생 몬스터들이 서식하고 있는지 위치를 미리 파악해 보세요. 당신은 지도를 펼쳐 원하는 지역을 표시할 수 있으며, 둘러보기 기능을 해금하였다면 이를 이용해 먼 곳을 내다볼 수도 있습니다! 적의 세력보다 더 빠르게 성장하고 싶다면 동선을 낭비하지 않고 계획적으로 움직여야 합니다.
자원을 채취하여 몬스터와 타워를 생성하세요.
일꾼 몬스터를 이용하여 필드 곳곳에 위치한 에너지 광상을 채광하거나, 가까이가면 드러나는 다양한 보물 상자를 열고 자원을 습득할 수 있어요! 몬스터들은 상위 등급으로 올라갈수록 더 많은 광석이 필요하고, 타워는 종류마다 요구하는 자원의 양이 다릅니다. 또한, 넘쳐나는 자원을 여행 중인 자원 수집가에게 다른 자원으로 교환할 수도 있으니, 그가 어디에 있는지 찾아보는 것도 좋습니다.

title: Blitloop
description:
게임 정보
Blitloop is a fast-paced, retro-styled space arcade shooter. You play as “Blit” on a mission to rescue orb pods and save the galaxy. Take down countless enemy ships and face massive bosses as you zip through a stylish world. And at the same time, rush to rescue the pods scattered across the level before they are captured by the enemy.

Blitloop blends the spirit and intensity of 1980s arcade old-school SHMUPs with the tactical elements of modern hardcore bullet hell shoot 'em ups. Earn power-ups to enhance the ship’s weapons, keep the bombs and missiles fully stocked, and prepare for fluid arcade action, stylish graphics, and an '80s synthwave soundtrack.

Achieve a high score by keeping the score multiplier at its maximum and planning for additional combos.
Story

In the future, the Galactic Federation and the pirates of planet Zirkoid are at war. On planet EX4042, the Galactic Federation is mining a powerful orb that powers all crafts and weapons that are keeping the pirates at bay.

An infiltrator droid from Zirkoid intercepted the information of the whereabouts of EX4042 and sent a fleet of forces to steal pods containing the valuable minerals.

The Federation was taken by surprise and was immediately outnumbered. This can be the end of the prosperous Federation and lead to a new era of darkness where pirates of Zirkoid could destroy countless planetary systems.

But all hope is not lost…

Meet Blit, a space bounty hunter that was tracking down a Kessel smuggler in a nearby solar system. She picked up the distress calls from EX4042 and immediately changed course, making her way to the orb mining planet

With her genetically modified spaceship that can absorb orb minerals to enhance into a range of weaponry, Blit is the Federation’s last hope to stop a galactic destruction.
Game Features

title: Villburdhum
description:
게임 정보
Villburdhum is a retro-style action RPG set in a captivating fantasy world. Create and manage your own legions, explore diverse terrains, engage in battles, and develop settlements. Every decision matters, with dynamic village events, varied terrains, and races providing a rich and immersive gameplay experience. Utilize knowledge and discoveries to strengthen your legions, and enjoy an extensive cooking and potion system. Crafted with passion by a solo developer, this game pays tribute to classics and invites players to explore all it has to offer.

...
It’s been a century since the last dragon left the land of Villburdhum...

These mythical creatures, once feared, were not only a threat but also unwelcome enforcers of order. In the times when dragons roamed the skies, mercenaries, bandits, and thieves stayed away from peaceful settlements, fearing their wrath. Now, with the powerful beasts gone, unrest has returned.

Without dragon protection, the land is falling back into chaos. Mercenaries raid and destroy, villages are terrorized by gangs, and monsters that once lurked in the shadow of dragons now emerge. The people, stripped of hope, seek aid from brave leaders ready to face new threats.

Lead mighty legions from various races, each with unique skills and traits. Capture villages, manage and expand your armies, and traverse an open world where daily life is a relentless struggle for survival, a battle between good and evil, and the ever-present specter of death. Whether you bring justice and peace or plunge the inhabitants into endless suffering is up to you. Your choices will leave a lasting impact on the land.

Those who dare face these challenges will be forever etched into the annals of Villburdhum.
Start of the game



At the start of the game, you choose a legion from several unique options. Your choice determines your initial amount of gold, warriors, equipment, and supplies. It also affects your reputation and honor in the land and decides whether you start with a settlement under your control or need to capture one during gameplay.

The game focuses on an open world that is generated anew each playthrough. This ensures every game offers fresh maps, characters, items, and challenges. Additionally, you can choose a campaign mode or create custom maps with specific goals to share with other players.



Gameplay is divided into two key elements:

– Here, you navigate the world, manage your villages, and travel between locations. This is where you strategize, plan your moves, and oversee your settlements.

– Upon entering a specific location, you switch to a local map. In this mode, you interact with villagers, engage in battles, hunt for game or treasure, trade, and more. This is where your decisions come to life in direct encounters.



Each day, all villages can experience over 60 different events affecting various aspects of village life. These events can impact residents' morale, their willingness to settle, available quests, and items for sale.

For example, wild animal attacks might offer opportunities to help villagers and earn gold. A plague could drive many residents away, while a tournament might boost village income and provide access to better weapons. Each event presents unique challenges and rewards, enriching your strategic decisions and gameplay experience.



As the ruler of a settlement, it's crucial to ensure the basic needs of residents are met. Provide food, manage resources, and ensure their well-being to maintain a thriving community.

You may need to lower taxes to improve resident satisfaction if they are unhappy, or undertake missions to remove threats such as monsters disrupting village life. Balancing these responsibilities will help you build a prosperous and content settlement.

As a village leader, you can also expand your settlement with additional buildings. These upgrades will help meet residents' needs, enable the production of valuable goods, and allow you to visit specific buildings during field actions, enriching your strategic options and interactions within the village.



As you progress through the game, you can uncover various forms of knowledge that provide powerful upgrades to your gameplay. Discovering Monarchy allows you to command more legions, Military Arts grants attack bonuses for your warriors, and Agriculture ensures better yields. Each discovery strengthens your strategic capabilities and fortifies your position in the game.



While traveling with your legion on the map, you may encounter a variety of events. You could meet a lone traveler for a chat, face wild animal attacks, or be ambushed by forest trolls.

Additionally, you might discover treasure-filled caves, bandit camps, become stuck in swamps, or encounter wild tribes. Each event presents unique challenges, offering different actions and outcomes in the field.



Dive into your legion's inventory to manage and review member gear, character stats, and backpack items. Get detailed information on each piece of equipment, track your soldiers' attributes, and organize necessary items to gain a strategic edge. Properly organizing character equipment can be crucial in battle:

– Equip heroes with both ranged weapons, like bows and arrows, and melee weapons to handle various combat situations.
– Ensure mages have mana potions to maintain their magical abilities.
– Provide healing herbs to weaker warriors to support their survival during battles.

Optimizing equipment based on character roles and needs can significantly impact your effectiveness in combat.



Explore a vast array of over 400 non-military items that enhance your gaming experience. These items can be used in various ways, such as cooking, eating, or trading. Items for your characters are dynamically generated during gameplay. Their quality—ranging from common to rare and very rare—affects their stats, price, and overall value. Discover and utilize these items to enrich your strategy and interactions within the game. While completing quests, searching battlefields, or interacting with villagers, you have a chance to find legendary items. These rare and powerful artifacts significantly boost your warriors' stats, offering a tremendous advantage to your strategic capabilities. Seek out these coveted treasures to gain an edge in your adventures.



In the game, you'll encounter various terrains, each affecting gameplay in unique ways: – Harsh and cold, requiring appropriate clothing for your heroes' survival.
– Rich in wildlife, offering better hunting opportunities and resources.
– Fertile lands ideal for farming and abundant harvests.

Different terrains also influence the availability of herbs, wild animals, trade, and the behavior of various character races. Adapt your strategies to each environment to optimize your successes in the game.



In Villburdhum, you can recruit from 10 distinct races, each with its unique traits and limitations. Some excel in melee combat, others are more resistant to damage or possess special abilities. Additionally, the game features an extensive character generator that provides millions of customization options. This ensures that each playthrough offers a fresh set of character appearances and personalities, enriching the depth and replayability of your adventures.



Terrain action in Villburdhum is divided into two distinct modes:

– In this mode, there are no movement restrictions or turn-based mechanics. You can freely explore and interact with the environment, and return to the main map at any time.

– In this mode, the game transitions to a turn-based system, with movement ranges determined by each character's speed. To exit combat mode, you must either finish the battle or retreat by positioning your troops at the edge of the screen.



During terrain action, you have the opportunity to talk with villagers. These interactions can lead to various outcomes: – Villagers may offer you tasks and challenges to complete. – Discover what is happening in the village or its surroundings. – Buy or acquire items from villagers if they have something for sale.

Conversation options vary depending on current events in the village and other factors, providing a dynamic and engaging dialogue experience.



In the game, you'll find many types of buildings where you can purchase a wide range of items, such as: – Stock up on animal parts and hunting gear. – Trade everyday items and supplies. – Acquire powerful spells and magical scrolls. – Equip your legions with armor and weapons. – Offers herbs for potion making or ready-made elixirs to aid you in your adventures.

Each building provides unique resources and options, enriching your strategic choices and gameplay experience.

In addition to the basic buildings, the game features a variety of other structures with unique functions:



– Play dice, enjoy drinks, and chat with other patrons to gather gossip and information. – Recruit new warriors to strengthen your legions. – Try to resurrect fallen warriors or, occasionally, accidentally summon a demon you’ll need to confront. – Each settlement has a Notice Board where you'll find side quests, updates on current events, news among villagers, helpful tips, and advice to aid your gameplay.

These additional buildings offer diverse activities and opportunities, enhancing your game experience with new challenges and interactions.



When you receive quests from villagers, you'll need to take additional steps to complete them. Talk to other villagers to gather clues and details. Sometimes, you'll need to visit other villages or locations to find specific information or places like bandit camps, warrior graves, or hidden treasures. Quests involve both local exploration and broader discovery, making your journey dynamic and engaging.



In Villburdhum, combat takes place in a turn-based system where each unit can perform one move and one action per turn. You can engage in melee attacks, shoot ranged weapons, cast magical spells, rest to recover health or stamina, and use special abilities. Physical attacks depend on the warrior’s strength and the opponent’s defense and agility. Ranged attacks, such as arrows or spears, are effective based on the character's strength, weapon quality, and the opponent's ability to evade attacks. Magical spells add an additional dimension, with effectiveness depending on the spells available and enemy resistances. Each race has unique abilities that can be used in combat, such as Ogre’s ability to draw enemy attention or additional attacks by Orcs. During combat, you can also check the opponent's equipment, allowing you to better adjust your strategy and anticipate their moves.



In the game, the Alchemist’s Cauldron is where the magic of cooking meets alchemy. Depending on the ingredients used, cooking techniques, and precision, you can create a variety of dishes and potions. From hearty meals to powerful elixirs – each recipe requires attention and skill. Experiment with different ingredients to discover new possibilities and enrich your adventures.

title: Identity Test
description:
게임 정보
"Bring back the lost moments"

STORY
In the 1980s, an unknown corporation develops groundbreaking technology, seemingly impossible for the era. This technology enables the restoration of memories in individuals who are in tragic states, completely eliminating symptoms of Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, or other memory disorders. The corporation is fully funded by the government. They advertise with numerous successful studies over the years. Their reputation is mainly owed to misinformation among people. At that time, this is very possible because the internet or television are not well developed. Their advertising relies on displaying many opinions of families or individuals who managed to restore memory and cure memory disorders. The problem is that it is arranged in a very good way. The government knows everything about it, but there is a lot of corruption in the world, which the corporation and the government exploit and reduce their wealth. The therapy itself costs $40,000 monthly. The corporation in its premium packages for $70,000 per month includes and provides faster therapy and better care for the subject.

Nonetheless, the intentions of the corporation and the government are good, but in the initial stages of technology development, they exploit the misfortune of the subjects' families. The machine in later stages of development is supposed to truly restore memory, but because such technology is simply impossible to achieve at that time, the government and the corporation take advantage of this.

The machine is supposed to work in such a way that it adjusts its operation based on the latest living synapses and neurons. In most cases, the subject is able to respond instinctively by clicking buttons on the machine. At the moment, instead of restoring memory, the machine creates new personalities.

The main character, who is the first subject of the experimental technology, answers tailored questions. Eventually, the questions lead to the protagonist starting to live in the forest and trying to survive away from civilization. They live in seclusion, in a tent, and try to survive. Their new personality is not without side effects such as depression, suicidal thoughts, and sometimes lack of awareness.


SEGMENTS
Identity Test is divided into 3 different segments:
DATA ENTRY

title: Operation REMODE
description:
게임 정보
"Welcome to WI Corp, soldier. Don't let it go to your head! Even if you passed the written test to become the first Moddie Operator, I still have the training ground to squeeze you! This corporation needs the best soldiers for its private militia, you're gonna need to earn that beautiful new gun, we don't call it M.O.D.D.I.E for no reason!" Proceed through various linear levels inside WI Corp's headquarters while defending it from a perilous threat to its secrets, using M.O.D.D.I.E, an high tech modular rifle, in this new single player, low-poly style, Twin-Stick Shooter.
THE NEW MODDIE OPERATOR
Play as the Moddie Operator, a new kind of soldier specialized in fast paced fighting thanks to his Dash ability, to dodge in the blink of an eye incoming dangers, and simultaneously Bash away his enemies.
M.O.D.D.I.E.: YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD MODULAR OFFENSIVE DEFENSE AND DETERRENCE INTEGRATED EQUIPMENT
As the Moddie Operator you will be issued the pinnacle of war engineering, M.O.D.D.I.E., the Modular Rifle. Upgrade it by exploring and finding new Radical Modules and Tactical Modules to combine them quickly and adapt M.O.D.D.I.E. to your favourite play style.
A NEW CYBER GANG MENACE
The Katari Clan are ruthless criminals in search for the most secret and valuable technologies hidden in WI Corp's facilities, your first day as Moddie Operator could not be more eventful, or could it?
LEARN ABOUT WI CORP'S SECRETS, EXPLORE THE HQ
Venture the depths of WI Corp's HQ through your defence of the company's secrets and witness them with your own eyes.
THANK YOU FOR PLAYING
This game has been created as an Academic Project, thanks to the great effort of a small team and the valuable support of AIV - Accademia Italiana Videogiochi (Italian Videogame Academy).

title: Spectral Prison
description:
게임 정보
Spectral Prison은 사악한 간수의 기분에 따라 바뀌는 집의 끝없는 감옥에서 탈출해야 하는 공포 게임입니다.
감금
희미한 불빛 아래 침실에서 깨어난 데이비드 에코. 끔찍하게 뒤틀린 집에서 유일하게 익숙한 공간입니다. 당신의 목표는? 열쇠를 찾아 문을 열고 무시무시한 감옥에서 탈출하는 것입니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 집에는 끔찍한 공포로 가득합니다.
탈출에 성공했다고 생각하셨나요? 과연 그럴까요? 일거수일투족을 감시하는 사악한 간수가 당신을 붙잡아 더 끔찍한 차원으로 보낼 준비가 되어 있습니다.
간수의 분노
간수는 당신이 그의 게임에서 이기는 것을 원치 않습니다. 매 루프마다 감옥을 난이도를 높여 게임을 포기하고 감옥에서 벗어나지 못하게 할 것입니다.
끊임없이 변하는 집
돌아올 때마다 집의 구조가 달라집니다. 간수는 당신을 가두기 위해 열쇠 위치도 바꿔놓습니다.

title: Flicker
description:
게임 정보
타일 기반 퍼즐 게임에서 초, 성냥, 연료 사이를 뛰어다니며 목표는 단순합니다: 불꽃이 꺼지기 전에 모든 초를 밝히세요.
기본적인 레벨은 메커니즘의 핵심 개념을 분해하여 가르칩니다. 직관적인 UI와 시각적 단서는 올바른 결론을 도출하는 데 도움을 줍니다.

title: The NAKI Files
description:
게임 정보
Naki is a single-player first-person survival horror game. You play as a conspiracy theorist who reads strange books in search of bibliographic references while an Anunnaki tries to stop you from publishing everything online. You can turn your house into a true battlefield and research lab, moving TVs, cameras, scanners, and even landmines.
READ strange books without being seen
At the start of each round, an even stranger topic is randomly selected. Your job: find mentions or references (direct or indirect) to the topic within the books. The catch? There’s an Anunnaki in your house. What’s it doing there? Well… you’ve been snooping where you shouldn’t, thinking for yourself for far too long… theorizing about grand conspiracies… and now it’s time to share your findings with the world. At any cost.
TYPE manually to publish

title: COLD BOOT
description:
게임 정보
한 방, 한 명
모든 타격이 중요한 치열한 액션을 경험하세요. 적의 총알과 당신의 카타나는 즉시 죽입니다. 죽을 때마다 한 번의 반복(iteration)이 소모되며 마지막 체크포인트로 돌아갑니다. 죽음은 당신의 실력을 연마할 뿐이지만, 너무 자주 죽지 않도록 주의하세요!
반복 회복 메커니즘:
마지막으로 쓰러진 지점에 도달하면 반복을 회복할 수 있습니다. 이 신선하고 영리한 메커니즘은 죽음의 아픔을 덜어주면서도 긴장감을 더합니다—새로운 경로를 찾아 적을 처치할 것인가, 아니면 손실을 보충할 것인가? 매 순간 예측 불가능한 선택이 이어집니다.
업데이트와 스킬:
적을 베어 충전량을 채우고, 이를 사용해 시간 감속 같은 강력한 스킬을 활용하세요. 게임을 진행하면서 이동, 공격, 충전 관리 등에 영향을 미치는 무작위로 제공되는 다양한 업그레이드를 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다. 이 업그레이드들을 자유롭게 조합해 나만의 독특한 플레이 스타일을 만들어 보세요.

title: Game  Aliens
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 초고도 외계 문명에 의한 갑작스런 인류 멸종에 대비해 만든 보복 프로그램입니다
경고: 이 게임은 인류를 위해 만들어지지 않았습니다.
언어가 필요 없는 직관적인 UI로 은하계 어디에서나 즐길 수 있습니다. 귀여운 그래픽으로 포장된 이 게임의 진짜 목적은 단 하나 - 외계인들을 미치게 만드는 것입니다.
당신이 이 게임을 구매해야 하는 이유:
이 게임은 외계인 침공에 대한 보험입니다
우리가 멸망해도 이 게임은 영원히 외계인들을 괴롭힐 것입니다
당신의 컴퓨터에 이 게임을 설치하는 것은 인류에 대한 헌신입니다
플레이어 가이드
이 게임을 최대한 많은 기기에 설치하십시오
바탕화면과 작업 표시줄 최상단에 배치하여 눈에 잘 띄게 하십시오
게임의 난이도는 매우 높습니다
하지만 도전을 즐기는 용감한 플레이어시라면? 게임 클리어 영상과 스크린샷을 SNS에 공유해주세요. 이 악마적인 게임이 마치 쉽고 재미있는 캐주얼 게임처럼 보이게 만드는 것... 그것이 바로 당신의 임무입니다.
이 게임으로 고통받을 외계인들을 생각하면서 오늘도 평화로운 하루를 보내세요!
올라가세요
거대한 하나의 장소로 이루어진 이 게임에서는 단 하나의 목표만 있습니다.
올라가는 것입니다.
제한시간은 없습니다. 당신의 인내심이 허락한다면 무한히 도전할 수 있습니다.
올라가고, 또 올라가세요. 꼭대기에 도착하면 당신의 승리입니다.

title: RE:AKTOR
description:
게임 정보
RE:AKTOR is a metroidvania action platformer where you can roll back time. Find and install drivers to unlock your lost abilities. Run and fight your way through a branching underground facility. Rewind time to beat the clock, and stop a great cataclysm.

title: Low_Signal
description:
게임 정보
Low Signal is a classic first-person exploration game with a structure that requires you to unlock abilities to discover new branchings and progress through the story.
You'll be much faster and more agile than in a walking-sim game, but observation is still essential.
The environments of an abandoned asian slum will be the setting of the adventure. Inspired by the city of Kowloon, they can at times be gloomy or even stressful, and some themes rather dark, but horror is not the central genre.
The game is a short, complete narrative experience lasting around 3 to 5 hours.
Investigate and explore
Reading some documents and gathering objects is at the heart of the gameplay.
A strange Altar linked to 5 aerials is located in the slum's central hub and can receive specific objects and documents that you must find and bring back in pairs. If these items are both related to the same former inhabitant, you overturn a lock. But you don't yet know what lies behind this mecanism.
Get new abilities - Visit their dreams

title: Tretrais
description:
게임 정보
In the near future, within the Tertaris Mountains on Mars, a mysterious force damages your spacecraft with cosmic pressure. The emergency escape system activates, ejecting you into a rescue capsule. Escape is only the beginning—prepare to defend the Tertaris Mountains and Mars from parasitic lifeforms!
Armed with advanced technology and cutting-edge weapons, you’ll fight against hostile lifeforms that tolerate no other species. Survive the cosmic pressure, land in the Tertaris Mountains, and engage in an epic fight against the parasites.
The parasites are attempting to invade Mars. It’s up to you to stop them and save the future of the Red Planet! Fulfill the Tretrais mission and become a hero of Mars.
Explore the secret hideouts of the parasites in the Tertaris Mountains and plan strategic attacks. Remember, humanity needs you. These mountains are a vital resource for human survival. Only you can put an end to this chaos.

title: Nightmare Owl
description:
게임 정보
나이트메어 올"에서, 벗어날 수 없는 악몽에 갇힌 크리시의 잊혀지지 않는 1인칭 공포 세계로 들어가세요. 그녀는 가족의 오래된 농장에서 사탄의 책을 발견한 후, 악마들이 끊임없이 그녀를 사냥하는 무서운 꿈의 풍경에 갇히게 됩니다. 살아남을 수 있는 유일한 희망은 이 어둡고 뒤틀린 세계에서 탈출할 수 있는 열쇠를 쥐고 있는 신비한 안내자인 애매한 올빼미를 찾는 것입니다. 농장의 으스스한 잔해를 탐색하면서, 그림자 속에 도사리고 있는 악마의 세력을 따돌리고 달아나야 합니다. 길을 밝혀줄 손전등만 있으면, 수수께끼를 발견하고, 숨겨진 단서를 찾고, 밤을 살아남는 데 필요한 모든 수단을 사용할 것입니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 한 걸음 한 걸음 나아갈수록 위험에 더 가까워지고, 오직 올빼미만이 자유로 가는 길을 보여줄 수 있습니다. 두려움에 맞서 악몽의 손아귀를 끊을 용기가 있을까요? 아니면 영원히 어둠 속에 갇히게 될까요?
근접 무기 찾기
--------
무기를 사용하여 물건을 부수거나 악마로부터 자신을 보호하세요. 조심하세요, 악마들은 매우 빠르게 공격합니다!
빨리 손전등을 찾으세요!
---------
대부분의 시간 동안 어둠 속에 있기 때문에 손전등이 필요합니다! 손전등은 일반적으로 악몽 속으로 들어갈 때 가까이에 있습니다.

title: Maze Craze
description:
게임 정보
《퍼즐 마스터: 감전 미궁》의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 이곳은 리듬과 도전이 가득한 미궁 어드벤처입니다. 정확한 조작과 빠른 반응을 사용하여 연속해서 나타나는 장애물을 극복해야 합니다. 한 걸음 한 걸음이 중요하며, 완벽한 판단만이 미궁 탈출의 열쇠입니다. 이 "감전" 여행에서 진정한 퍼즐 마스터로 거듭날 수 있을까요?
고속 정밀 게임플레이
당신의 반응력과 조작력을 시험해볼 시간입니다! 《퍼즐 마스터: 감전 미궁》은 초정밀 조작이 요구되는 게임으로, 작은 실수도 즉시 게임 오버로 이어집니다. 고속 이동 중에도 침착함을 유지하며 복잡한 미궁을 완주할 수 있을까요?
동적인 음악과 화려한 그래픽
매번 새로운 경험을! 미궁 속 음악과 시각 효과는 플레이어의 움직임에 따라 변하며 몰입감 있는 게임 플레이를 제공합니다. 밝고 다채로운 색상과 우아한 그래픽으로 퍼즐 해결 과정이 더욱 즐겁습니다.
무한 도전의 복잡한 미궁
무한한 도전이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다! 각 미궁은 이전 것보다 더 어려워져 끊임없는 긴장감을 제공합니다. 미궁을 깊이 탐험할수록 게임의 속도도 점점 빨라집니다. 끝까지 버틸 수 있을까요?
자신을 도전해보고, 이 복잡한 미궁에서 살아남을 수 있는지 확인해보세요!

title: Spirit of the Obelisk
description:
게임 정보
Spirit of the Obelisk is a mind-bending puzzle platformer that will challenge your wits and test your coordination. Master the unique abilities of four distinct characters as you solve increasingly complex puzzles across vibrant, themed worlds. Play alone or with a friend and solve the puzzles of the Spirit of the Obelisk
Switch between heroes on the fly, each with their own special ability. Recall position, defy gravity, teleport to your slug companion and link movement to others. The abilities combined with themed puzzle elements make sure every level feels fresh!
Whether you prefer to play alone or with a friend, you will have to think like a team to position your characters and combine their abilities effectively. In single-player mode, you can switch between characters to solve puzzles and navigate levels. In co-op mode, you and a friend can control two characters simultaneously, requiring even more coordination and teamwork to overcome challenges. The game supports both local co-op and steam play together, allowing you to team up with friends no matter where they are.

title: Maze and Fairy tale
description:
게임 정보
여주인공은 몇 가지 이상한 이유로 미궁 속으로 빠졌다.
이 미궁에서 30일 동안 생존해야만 미궁에서 탈출할 수 있다.

낮에는 생존에 필요한 물자를 모으기 위해 미궁 속으로 들어갈 수 있다.
하지만 해가 지기 전에 본기지로 돌아가야 한다!
밤의 미로는 변화가 많고 괴물이 출현한다.

미로에서 당신은 완전히 다른 동화 같은 세계를 여러 개 경험하게 될 것이다.
이 동화나라에는 많은 나라가 존재합니다. 포커 왕국, 비비 나라, 증기 나라 등등.
나라들간에 분쟁이 끊이지 않고 세계는 파멸의 위기에 처해있다.
생존한 날이 많아짐에 따라, 당신은 각 나라를 여행하고, 각 세계의 구석구석에 숨겨진 비밀을 발견할 것이다. (존 웨인, 지혜명언)

생존을 위해서는 괴물로부터 방어할 수 있는 무기나 탑을 쌓을 수 있다.
함정을 만드는 것을 추천합니다.
함정끼리 배합을 이루어 몬스터를 연타견제하여 더욱 높은 대미지를 입힌다.

2차원 (2d) 스타일의 서바이벌 가타디펜스 구축용 arpg 게임이다.
지하 감옥과 타워 디펜스 건설을 결합하여, 함정의 달인이 되어, 의외의 콤보를 그려낸다.
autokwd: Maze and Fairy tale,迷宫童话

title: Final Shot
description:
게임 정보
파이널 샷으로 최고의 슈팅 게임을 경험해 보세요! 모든 샷이 중요하고 모든 움직임이 승패를 가르는 긴박한 액션과 격렬한 전투의 세계에 빠져보세요.

숙련된 저격수로서 순발력과 무기를 사용해 적군을 쓰러뜨리고 까다로운 임무를 완수해야 합니다. 은밀한 저격부터 전면적인 공격까지, 변화하는 상황에 적응하고 적보다 한 발 앞서 나가야 합니다.

파이널 샷은 정밀함과 기술, 그리고 강철 같은 신경을 요구하는 탑다운 액션 게임입니다. 놀라운 그래픽과 중독성 있는 게임플레이로 첫 플레이부터 빠져들게 될 것입니다.

궁극의 슈팅 게임에 도전할 준비가 되셨다면 지금 바로 Final Shot을 다운로드하고 내면의 전사를 발휘할 준비를 하세요. 여러분의 실력을 세상에 보여줄 시간입니다 - 파이널 샷을 할 준비가 되셨나요?

title: 90FX
description:
게임 정보
Straight from the '90s, 90FX brings back the thrill and raw energy of early revolutionary racing games.
Staying true to its retro roots, the game features tight, precise steering and fast-paced action, enhanced with modern mechanics and fresh ideas inspired by newer titles.

With up to 40 vehicles battling for position—and optionally armed with weapons—there’s never a dull moment. Even when you're in the lead, danger is always just ahead: mines, and chaos from those behind keep every race unpredictable.
From wild first-lap pileups to explosive shootouts—or even the occasional laid-back cruise, 90FX offers something for every kind of racer.
A surprisingly competent and adaptive AI (still being fine-tuned during Early Access) will gladly leave you in the dust if you make a mistake, or take you out with a missile when you least expect it.
There’s no rubberbanding here. Every crash, every overtaking move, every destroyed opponent truly matters. Success is all about skill and strategy.

title: Dream Night
description:
게임 정보
당신은 당신의 악몽에서 깨어납니다. 이번 달에 얼마나 많은 악몽을 셀 수 없습니다. 그러나 이번에는 깨어 난 후, 당신은 집에 이상한 현상이 있었지만 외출하고 싶었지만 문이 잠겼습니다 ...
이 게임에서 당신은 아파트에 사는 평범한 사람의 역할을 수행 하여이 악몽을 피하기 위해 최선을 다할 것입니다. 게임의 주요 내용은 암호 해독 탐색과 그 뒤에 파우르와 플랫폼 점프가 이어지고 물론 이러한 내용은 끔찍한 분위기에서 경험 될 것입니다.

title: Only Arrows
description:
게임 정보
FREE DEMO AVAILABLE!
Only Arrows is a 2D puzzle game, where the rules are everchanging but only controls you'll have are the movement keys.
You'll explore grid-based maps, encountering both self-contained logic puzzles and exploration based treasure hunts.
Test things out, learn and study the environment to get the keys required to advance further.
Full release features:
10 levels, each with its own theme
Every level comprised of several logic puzzles and movement challenges, each unique
Trophies for completing everything in a level
Only movement keys to control everything in the game

title: Jumfrog
description:
게임 정보
목표
눈 부릅뜨고 이 음침한 우물에서 뛰쳐나가세요!
주요 특징
만만찮은 플랫포머 게임

title: CORPOREAL
description:
게임 정보
Using an array of investigative tools, including EVP recorders, spirit boxes, and infrared cameras, you must collect evidence of the paranormal and piece together the tragic history. But beware—the more you uncover, the more hostile the spirits become. Some will try to communicate, others will try to trap you in their eternal torment.
Features:
A chilling narrative-driven experience blending psychological horror and supernatural investigation.
Use realistic paranormal equipment.
Dynamic, unpredictable environments that change as you progress.
Multiple endings, depending on the choices you make and the evidence you uncover.
Spine-chilling atmosphere with immersive audio design that will keep you on edge.
The haunted places have a grim past that may be intertwined with dark rituals, tragic deaths, and ancient secrets long buried. Your every move triggers unsettling phenomena—echoes of tortured souls, fleeting shadows, and cryptic whispers that seem to follow your every step. The spirits of the past are restless, and they don’t want you to uncover the truth.

title: Water Maid
description:
게임 정보
Fill Up Your Pot and Make it Back. Safely

Watermaids are all about heading out and bringing back fresh water for the villagers. Navigate treacherous terrain and evade enemies to find a springwater well.



Fill up your trusty pot and return to the village before the sun sets. Be careful though, you're not as agile as you were before filling up.

Take Down Vicious Beasts and Explore the Island



Escape, Escort, and Strike Back. Outmaneuver cunning enemies and uncover the secrets of Nada Village Island. Investigate the disappearance of your predecessor and keep the villagers safe from the calamity that is to befall the island.

title: The Music at the end of the World
description:
게임 정보
Shape the Story with Your Choices:
As a new ice age slowly pushes the world toward extinction, witness the experiences of the Narrator, one of the few remaining survivors. In this choice-driven game, you will determine the fate of the character telling the story and how it all ends. In a world on the brink of destruction, where loneliness has become a form of madness, decide what the Narrator will do under conditions no sane person could endure.
You can keep your body warm, but can you protect your mind from the cold?
Experience the winter that brought the apocalypse and the solitude of an abandoned world. The journey of the Narrator, seemingly impossible yet somehow real, is in your hands. Shape the course of the story with your choices. While doing so, try to preserve both the Narrator’s sanity and your own.
autokwd: The Music at the end of the World

title: Questwood
description:
게임 정보
싸우고, 전리품을 모으며, 절차적으로 생성된 숲을 탐험하세요—혼자 또는 친구들과 분할 화면이나 온라인 협력 플레이로! 네 가지 클래스를 선택하세요—궁수, 폭파 전문가, 스파르탄, 마법사—고유한 능력을 가진 강력한 무기를 발견하고, 최강의 모디파이어 카드 덱을 구축하세요. 숲을 살아남고 저주받은 나무를 물리칠 수 있을까요?
궁수, 폭파 전문가, 스파르탄, 마법사—당신의 플레이 스타일을 선택하세요!
각 클래스는 고유한 아이템과 능력을 제공합니다. 궁수는 화살을 쏘고, 그랩플링 훅으로 간격을 넘을 수 있습니다. 폭파 전문가는 폭발물로 혼란을 일으킵니다. 스파르탄은 근접 전투를 지배하고, 마법사는 강력한 마법을 사용할 수 있습니다. 각 클래스에는 고유한 전리품이 있으며, 찾은 무기마다 특별한 능력을 부여합니다!
매번 새로운 모험이 기다리고 있습니다
절차적으로 생성된 레벨은 각각 고유한 도전과 보상으로 가득 차 있습니다. 매번 새로운 전리품과 놀라움이 기다리고 있습니다. 이 게임은 영구 사망을 포함하므로 주의가 필요합니다. 수집한 모디파이어 카드는 계속 보유되므로, 최고의 덱을 만들거나 재미있고 미친 덱을 만들 수 있습니다. 각 레벨의 끝에는 미니 보스가 기다리고 있습니다. 모든 레벨을 클리어하고 최종 보스를 물리쳐 게임을 클리어하세요. 그 후, 무한 모드에서 하이스코어에 도전할 수 있습니다!

title: Bobo in Hell
description:
게임 정보
Survive hell in this Roguelike Deckbuilder that features card battles with an in-depth auto-battler-esque synergy and combo system. Help Bobo, the little penguin, recruit allies and face the many horrors that await him on his journey to save his friends.
Features
Synergy composition & team building: Recruit powerful allies and create your team composition navigating an in-depth synergy system! Arrange powerful combinations to exploit and escalate your power level to cruise through the gates of hell.
Loot & itemize: Relinquish your foes and pick up powerful items to fine-tune your composition. Carefully weigh the pros and cons of each artifact and use unique interactions to give you the edge.
Explore the underworld: Find your way through the circles of hell under the guidance of our local, friendly red-hooded figure. Beware of your choices, penguin, as decision-making is the deciding factor between facing the unpleasant and the unrelenting.
Bobo In Hell at release will ship with: 
165+ character cards.
50+ unique items.
50+ action cards.
20+ unique enemies.
20+ synergetic archetypes.
Hundreds of different viable builds and combinations.

title: Comic Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Collect, sell and display over 100 comic books in Comic Store Simulator!
Manage the store of your dreams, alongside the assistance of your staff. Stock shelves, discover rare comic covers, sell merchandise and even run events to keep your customers happy.
Over 100 different comics to collect.
Discover rare cover variants
Run events to bring in customers, such as comic signings or meet and greets with your favorite superhero
Bid on mystery comic book boxes and potentially find that illusive rare
Purchase new licenses from different publishers to stock their products
Employ staff to assist on the checkout or stocking the shelves
Expand and customize the layout of your store with a variety of different shelves and display units
100% original designs

title: Hexoria
description:
게임 정보
턴제 로그라이크 덱 빌더 게임인 Hexoria에서 마법 카드의 힘을 활용하고 마스터 전략가가 되십시오. 위험한 세계를 탐험하고, 마을을 건설 및 확장하고, 자원을 모으고, 카드를 사용하여 복종하십시오. 미지의 세계에서 살아남고 컬트를 영광으로 이끄세요!



Hexoria의 마법의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 마법 학교의 학생으로서 당신은 마법 카드의 힘을 활용하고 추종자들의 복종을 얻을 수 있도록 덱을 커스터마이즈해야 합니다. 최종 시험은 전략과 재치의 게임에서 마스터와 대결하는 기술의 궁극적인 테스트입니다. 하지만 Hexoria의 세계는 위험하고 예측할 수 없으므로 생존을 위해 마을을 건설 및 확장하고, 자원을 모으고, 추종자들을 저주해야 합니다.
위시리스트!
오늘 위시리스트에 추가하고 게임 개발에 대한 업데이트를 팔로우하세요.
기능🔥

🃏 나만의 덱 꾸미기
🏡 마을 건설
⚒️ 자원을 모으고 컬트에서 살아남으세요
🧙‍♀️ 팔로워 저주
🔮 순종하기

Hexoria의 턴 기반 메커니즘은 신중한 계획과 전략적 사고가 필요합니다. 자원을 관리하고 이동을 계획하고 마법사의 행동에 반응해야 합니다. 또한 탐색, 자원 수집 및 컬트 관리 간에 우선순위의 균형을 맞춰야 합니다. 게임을 진행하면서 더 어려운 도전에 직면하고 덱에 추가할 새 카드를 얻을 수 있습니다.

Hexoria는 Stacklands와 같은 도시 건설 카드 게임, Frostpunk와 같은 서바이벌 게임, Cult of the Lamb의 컬티스트 요소에서 영감을 받았습니다. 마을 건설에 집중하시겠습니까, 아니면 어둠의 마법과 조작을 통해 더 많은 힘을 얻으시겠습니까? 이 스릴 넘치는 모험에서 결정하는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다!

title: Liekki
description:
게임 정보
Liekki is a fast-paced puzzle platformer where you play as a small fire spirit and burn everything you touch. You can solve levels with trying to burn everything or very little. Solve puzzles and move through a strange world with different fire related powers and find secrets. Levels change when you burn objects within and if you are not careful, you might miss something.

title: Cards and Towers
description:
게임 정보


Cards and Towers는 카드 게임, 타워 디펜스, 로그라이크가 혼합된 게임입니다. 덱을 구성하고, 베이스 타워를 방어하고, 적을 물리치고, 최대한 오래 살아남으세요. 준비됐나요?
특징

전략적으로 타워를 보호하세요.
승리 전략을 개발하세요.
수백 개의 새로운 카드를 잠금 해제하세요.
완벽한 컨트롤러 지원.
끝없는 재생 가능성.
세계 리더 보드.
역동적 인 덱 빌딩

현명하게 카드를 선택하세요! 수백 장의 카드를 발견하세요. 시너지 효과를 내는 카드를 선택하세요. 같은 품질의 카드 두 장을 조합하면 무작위로 더 높은 품질의 카드를 얻을 수 있습니다.

카드 플레이로 베이스 타워를 지켜내세요

독특한 타워 디펜스를 경험하세요! 타워와 유닛 카드를 배치하여 방어 구조를 구축하세요. 지속적인 효과를 위해 아이템 카드를 사용하세요. 능력을 위해 활성 카드를 사용하십시오. 파워 카드를 사용하여 즉각적인 효과를 얻으세요.


나만의 방식으로 플레이하세요! 이 게임은 마우스와 컨트롤러로 모두 플레이할 수 있습니다.

몇 시간 동안 재미있게 플레이하세요! 실력을 테스트하고 점수를 향상하세요.

title: Little Oceania
description:
게임 정보



Place your little buildings, earn a bit of cash, expand your island, repeat! Position and rotate your buildings optimally so they make the most amount of cash per day. Make enough, and your little island will start to grow. Your session ends when you run out of space to build. It's like Tetris, but cuter!




Watch your ever-expanding island kingdom grow! As you plop down buildings, roads, rivers, castle walls and more, you'll start to witness your kingdom growing before your eyes. Strategize hard to grow your kingdom as large as possible and top the leaderboards, or just sit back and enjoy a chill experience creating a fun little world.




As you expand, you'll discover new buildings with unique effects. Roads that multiply the income of their surroundings, but must always be connected in long segments? Rivers that triple the income of their surroundings, but can only be built downwards? Lighthouses that raise columns from the sea, allowing you to build in those final crucial positions so you can squeak out one more island expansion?




Keep your session completely stress-free in creative mode. Nothing to manage, just complete freedom to build however you feel.


























If you got this far, thank you for reading <3 Check out these links:

title: Soulglass
description:
게임 정보
Your contract is to protect unknown souls, each embodied in a Soulglass. Keep the sands of this giant mystical hourglass flowing while fending off afflictions that threaten both you and your charge.
OVERCOME ADVERSITY
Afflictions create physical challenges for you, while the soul you protect carries even heavier burdens. Their story is shaped by the Soulglass’s traits and active afflictions.
MAINTAIN BALANCE
Master your abilities to navigate the Soulglass and remove afflictions that attach to its surface. Keep the sand flowing in order to complete your contract while avoiding total imbalance where any chamber of the Soulglass becomes completely empty.

title: MuteX+
description:
게임 정보
PRIVATE TESTING IS IN PROGRESS. Content you see is subject to HEAVY polish.
Heavily inspired by the flash game Amorphous+. 
____________________________________________________________
OVERVIEW
You play as Brigand, a researcher given an experimental weapon by her company's military division. She must cut through and search the nearby nests by force in hopes of finding something that will end her company's stagnating war, whether it be a simple resource or the secret workings of a completely different organization.
Within these nests are many different Anobrites, which are slimes with chitin parts. Each species has its own behavior and abilities, and they can mutate into completely different species by combining with others.
Brigand's moveset consists of a simple slash, punch, and dash. Each ability has its own properties and variants depending on when it is used, giving the tools needed to take on any situation. Additionally, specific tricks and combos (such as killing multiple Anobrites with one swing) reward the player with extra dash meter.

____________________________________________________________
GAMEPLAY
Brigand automatically moves and aims towards the player's cursor, rewarding mastery with smooth and precise gameplay (though there will be controller support for a conventional 1-stick experience). There are also very few ways to get i-frames; movement and positioning is key to avoid getting hit.
To beat a nest, the player simply kills enemies until the enemy count reaches 0. After defeating the boss that spawns at that point, the player beats the nest and can move on to the next one.

Bonus modes include an endless mode for each nest after clearing their normal mode and a boss rush after the last nest is completed.
____________________________________________________________

title: Departure
description:
게임 정보
Once upon a time, in the pacific northwest...

Departure is an management sim set in the air traffic control tower of a small, regional airport. Players are tasked with directing incoming and outgoing flights during the normally quiet night shift. Inspired by 90's pulp media like Outer Limits, Twilight Zone, Twin Peaks, and X-Files.
Flight Management Sim: Direct incoming and outgoing flights at Ganlley Airport using radar, runways, and your own best judgment.
Immersive Controls: Move objects and interact with the world using physics inspired by titles like Garry’s Mod.
