An Evening Dreary: Let narrative events unfold while you engage with your work. See how your actions unfold the evening’s mystery.

title: Electro Havoc
description:
게임 정보
Enter a neon-charged battleground where survival meets explosive energy in this retro, space-themed twin-stick shooter! As you dance through waves of geometric adversaries, each defeated enemy leaves behind a deadly debris field—lure other enemies into these hazard zones to trigger devastating chain reactions and score multipliers.
Snag powerful upgrades that temporarily boost your ship's offensive and defensive capabilities while you craft the perfect storm of destruction, turning enemy movements into opportunities for spectacular combos. Set your own pace in this sleek, modern take on classic arcade action, where minimalist design meets pixel particle effects in a sea of vibrant colors.
Simple Controls
Mastering Electro Havoc is easy: Use the two joysticks (or WASD+LMB) to control your ship and spray bullets in the general direction of your foes.
Your Ship
Take control of the Starfighter X-7, a lightning-fast combat ship that comes equipped with devastating weapon systems, perfect for carving through waves of geometric baddies. Just... don't let them touch you.
Ship Upgrades
As you progress through the levels, you'll spot offensive and defensive power-ups that last for a few seconds in-game. Grab them on the map before they disappear!

title: Zooika
description:
게임 정보
Drop cute animals into a box, pack as many as you can in, but if two of the same collide they'll merge into a larger animal! 
Zooika is a delightful casual game where you'll encounter a parade of adorable animals! But watch out! These critters aren't happy when they meet their twin, match two animals of the same kind and POP! They'll combine to form a brand new, even larger animal! It's your job to strategically contain them all.
With every critter combined, you'll earn points and unlock new challenges. Zooika is easy to pick up and play, but mastering the art of animal combination will take some strategic thinking. So, are you ready to box in some fun? Get ready for Zooika!
Different sets of animals
Time Challenge Mode
Order Challenge Mode

title: Lost Tribe
description:
게임 정보
Aim and throw your spear to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies. Use it to create platforms that give you a boost to reach new areas.
Master the winds with the gliding spear, riding air streams to explore even higher heights.
Explore a vast world filled with mysterious encounters and hidden secrets. Use the environment to your advantage by swinging on liana ropes.

title: Defender's Dynasty
description:
게임 정보
A 2D Strategic Base Defender game set in Medieval times. As relentless Waves of enemy forces threaten your Stronghold, you must gather Resources, Fortify your Defenses, and lead your Rebellion. Prepare to strengthen your Base and manage your Resources. But be aware of the Storms!
Step into the shoes of Elian, a brave young hero on a mission to defend his home village of Regera from relentless waves of enemy soldiers. Fight for peace and restore balance to the land. Find and gather resources, fortify your village with diverse defensive buildings, and strategically place them to outsmart your foes. But beware of the storms—they'll test your defenses and force you to adapt on the fly. Upgrade your buildings and unlock new ones. Show the enemies who is the boss and join Elian in an epic battle for Regera's future!

title: Lunar Descent
description:
게임 정보
개요:
당신은 달의 깊이로 자동 하강하는 서브루나 캡슐 안에 있습니다.
하강하는 동안 다양한 아노말리들을 만나게 되며, 대부분은 무해합니다. 그러나 잠재적으로 위험한 아노말리를 발견하면 즉시 경로를 변경하고 보고서를 제출하십시오.
게임 방법? 다음 질문에 답하십시오:
잠재적으로 위험한 아노말리를 발견하셨나요?
예 --> 즉시 보고서를 제출하고 경로를 변경하십시오.
아니오 --> 하강을 계속하십시오.
특징:
VHS 분위기 [실시간 소음 및 시각적 왜곡]
동적 카메라 [몰입감을 위한 약간의 "흔들리는" 카메라 효과]
숨겨진 엔딩 [당신의 선택에 따른 여러 결말][/*][/list]
참고 사항:
플레이 시간: 1-3 시간

title: Domain of Hallucination
description:
게임 정보
Drink the potion and step into the Domain of Hallucination, where survival is your only goal. Each run is unique: new maps, unpredictable enemies, and a fresh arsenal of weapons await every time you enter. But beware—the Game Master’s relentless challenges will test your limits over and over again.
Grow stronger by engraving yourself with ancient, mystical symbols, unlocking powers to dominate your foes. Escape the hallucination alive, and you’ll be rewarded generously.
This game combines the intensity of the bullet hell genre with the strategic depth and satisfaction of bullet heaven.
During your run you choose your next encounter by placing new map tiles, each with their unique challenges and rewards.

title: Tapeheads
description:
게임 정보
Tapeheads is a retro-futuristic computer simulation game set in an world where technology took a different path. You receive a replica of the 1983 Sonnenlicht Troika computer system from your uncle. Using the Symbolic79 programming language, solve puzzles sent by your uncle and his friends. Take breaks with included mini-games.

Key Features:
Symbolic79 programming language: Custom language with extensive documentation and examples.
Interpreter with debugging and REPL: Debug and test your code seamlessly with an interactive interpreter and REPL.
Editor with file revisioning: Manage your projects with built-in file revisioning.
Mini-games with logic puzzles: Enjoy engaging mini-games.
Atmospheric sound and graphics: Immerse yourself in a detailed retro-futuristic system.

Artwork from the In-Game Magazine

title: Ruby Journey
description:
게임 정보
Note for the demo
1) It's in development, some details may look unpolished or cheap (pausemenu, settings menu)
2) I forgot to delete the save, it'll be removed in a future demo update.
> Click "new game" in the first launch.
3) The settings menu is not yet functioning.
Also don't forget to feedback, it's genuinely helping.
> I have a Discord server dedicated to the game.
Introducing, Ruby Journey
Ruby Journey is an immersive sim taking place in a village.
You arrive with just one gold, and you want their ruby.
Trade, do quests, manage your resources wisely to get richer...
Talk to PNJs and grow friendships, all while discovering their lore...
Befriend...
You've officially come to help the village to recover from its recent hardships.

title: Swingin'!
description:
게임 정보
Swingin’! is a physics-based action game where you stick a pole to your environment to control your character’s movement. Swingin-kun can't generate speed by himself, so be careful not to waste the speed you gain from falling! You can bounce off the floor, stick to walls, alternate between your two arms to attach yourself to the ceiling and move sideways– with some creativity, you can do all kinds of things! Furthermore, Swingin’! includes a level editor so that you can create and share your own custom stages!

title: Tilebound
description:
게임 정보
Tilebound is a captivating blend of strategy, puzzle-solving, and magical combat, where every tile you place shapes your destiny. You are a novice Tile Wizard, bound to an ancient spellbook, seeking freedom by mastering the art of building powerful tile chains and unleashing elemental spells.
Key Features:
Strategic Tile Placement
Begin your journey with a single enchanted tile and unlock new ones as you progress through the levels. Each tile carries unique elemental properties—allowing you to create intricate chains that trigger devastating spells.
Dynamic Spellcasting System
Align your tiles to match rune shapes hidden within each level. The longer your chain and the more precise your patterns, the more powerful your spells become, rewarding you with rare tiles and magical artifacts.
Evolving Challenges
Face an array of progressively complex levels, each introducing new mechanics and environmental hazards. Every level tests your mastery of the spellbook.
Freedom Through Mastery
Every chain you build brings you closer to unlocking the full potential of your spellbook. Can you master the art of tile magic and break free from the book's bindings?
Are you ready to place your first tile and begin the journey to freedom?

title: Lost Flight: Survival
description:
게임 정보
Lost Plane: Survival은 치명적인 비행기 추락 사고 후, 신비롭고 미지의 섬에 홀로 남겨지는 오픈월드 생존 어드벤처 게임입니다. 구조의 희망은 없으며, 오직 살아남는 것이 유일한 목표입니다.

자원을 수집하고 도구를 제작하며, 사나운 늑대, 독거미, 그리고 다른 위험 요소들로부터 자신을 보호할 수 있는 안전한 기지를 구축하세요. 사냥, 채집, 그리고 물 정화를 통해 생존하면서 섬을 탐험해야 합니다.

배고픔과 갈증 - 동물을 사냥하거나, 낚시를 하거나, 열매 및 먹을 수 있는 식물을 채집해야 합니다. 민물은 마시기 전에 끓이거나 정화해야 합니다.
건강과 부상 - 늑대에게 공격당하거나 거미에게 물리면 상처를 입거나 중독될 수 있으며, 붕대나 약초 해독제가 필요합니다.
온도와 날씨 - 추운 밤과 폭풍을 피하기 위해서는 대피소와 불이 필요합니다.
기지 건설 - 나무를 베어 벽, 지붕, 방어 시설을 만들어 야생 동물의 야간 공격을 막으세요.
함정과 방어 - 가시 함정, 올가미, 나무 바리케이드를 설치하여 늑대와 기타 위협을 막을 수 있습니다.
도구와 무기 - 창, 활, 돌도끼를 제작하여 사냥 및 자기 방어에 사용하세요.
늑대 - 무리를 지어 사냥하며 어둠 속에서 숨어 있다가 약한 모습을 보이면 공격합니다.
거미 - 동굴과 덤불 속에 숨어 있으며, 독이 있는 물림으로 질병을 유발합니다.
멧돼지와 곰 - 영역 의식이 강하고 도발하면 공격하며, 약한 구조물을 부술 수도 있습니다.
새와 물고기 - 식량으로 사냥할 수 있지만, 덫이나 인내심이 필요합니다.
동굴과 유적 - 고대 유적과 깊은 동굴을 탐험하여 자원을 찾으세요.
낮과 밤의 주기 - 밤이 되면 포식 동물들이 더욱 활발해지며, 시야가 감소하여 위험해집니다.

title: Space Orcs Brawl
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for chaotic, couch-multiplayer mayhem! Pilot wacky, battle-hardened space ships, each with their own wild abilities, and fight for glory in explosive arena combat. It’s time to brawl—who will rule the arena?
Pick from a lineup of 7 unique brawlers, each with their own look, personality, and special powers. Whether you’re zipping around as Doc Croc or befuddle enemies with the tricky Brain Gang CEO, every ship brings a new way to play!
From asteroid belts to junkyard warzones, no two arenas are the same! Dodge hazards, master the terrain, and use the environment to your advantage as you battle for domination.

title: Embroideryvania
description:
게임 정보
Explore a one-of-a-kind embroidered metroidvania world in split-screen, local couch co-op, with a companion. This gem is perfect for players who’d like to introduce someone who doesn't play video games to the hobby. You play as a snail visiting a plant park, identifying plants you’ve never seen before. Customize your shell by finding unique designs in the world. Uncover mysteries and get safely lost in this peaceful world, as there are no enemies or combat to worry about. Only you, your companion, and the surrounding environment.

title: Hop On It
description:
게임 정보
Your goal is to reach the top.With nothing but a pogo stick, you start climbing. The journey isn’t easy. You’ll bounce across tricky obstacles, fight for control, and maybe lose your cool along the way. Play solo or team up with friends for some chaotic fun. Can you conquer the challenge, or will the forest get the best of you?

title: Gemmy's Adventure
description:
게임 정보
We would appreciate your feedback and suggestions!
  Simple but not easy! Move! Avoid the traps! Reach the goal!
  How to Play:
Use only your mouse to guide Gemmy across the map to the goal.
Do not touch any traps, objects, or even the walls!
As you progress, the game becomes more challenging, testing not only your control skills but also your ability to strategize and find a way through the traps.
  Features:
Over 20 types of traps, each with unique mechanics.
Move through these traps, timing your movements carefully to avoid hazards—some even challenge you to pass within a time limit or as the path rotates.
You may even find yourself in shifting mazes where the walls constantly change position, making every second count!
Traps interact with each other, creating even more diverse and unexpected challenges.
                                                                    📌 Accessible to players of any language, even though the system interface is currently available only in English.
Steady your hands, move with precision, dodge the obstacles, and rush forward at the perfect moment!

title: The Snackdown
description:
게임 정보
It's a rougelike with a little bullethell gameplay on top. In this game you control a character that is fighting against mainly junk foods, in hope it  can escape from the dungeon. While he collect items and mysterious things to increase or decrease his chance of escaping.
Features:
5 weapons
54+ items include 5 unlockable
7 sins and virtues
A SLOT MACHINE
5+ Bosses

title: Con Clicker
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to build the most fraudulent empire the world has ever seen? In Con Clicker, you’ll take on the role of a shady TV infomercial tycoon, scamming unsuspecting viewers into buying absurd products. Click your way to success, automate your operations, and become the ultimate kingpin of deception!
Click, Scam, Repeat
Start small by running your first infomercial and selling hilariously over-the-top products. From miracle mops to immortality insurance, there's no limit to what you can sell to your unsuspecting audience. Watch the cash roll in with every ad run!
Automate and Expand
Hire shady managers, unlock advanced upgrades, and automate your infomercial empire to generate viewers and cash while you sleep. Scale your operations from a single channel to a global media scam network, reaping massive rewards with minimal effort.
Prestige and Replayability
Got caught scamming? No problem! Rebrand your company, start fresh, and gain powerful bonuses to grow faster and scam harder.
Con Clicker is the ultimate blend of satirical humor and idle game fun. Whether you’re clicking manually or letting your empire run on autopilot, the only question is: how far will you go to con your way to the top?

title: One Hard Game Please!
description:
게임 정보
One Hard Game Please
Are you ready to test your limits in one of the most challenging rage games out there? One Hard Game Please takes inspiration from the classic "The World's Hardest Game" but cranks the difficulty up to an entirely new level. With movement that’s as tricky to master as the levels themselves, this game is designed to push even the most skilled players to their breaking point.
Core Gameplay
Precision Movement: Once you start moving, there's no stopping! Navigate tight spaces and deadly obstacles while bouncing off walls in this fast-paced, reflex-intensive experience.
Instant Death: Touch anything dangerous, and it’s game over. Respawn at the start of the level and try again—no checkpoints, no mercy.
Retro Pixel Art: Clean, minimalist visuals that keep the focus on the action.
What to Expect
10 Brutal Levels in the Demo: A taste of the chaos to come. Can you conquer these meticulously crafted levels?
100 Levels Planned for Full Release: Each level more devilishly difficult than the last. Perfect your skills and prove your mastery.
Who Is This Game For?
If you crave a real challenge and thrive on skill-based games that test your patience and precision, One Hard Game Please is for you. Whether you're a fan of rage games, looking to push your limits, or just want to prove that you're the best, this game will give you exactly what you’re asking for—and more.
Can you beat the demo? Prove it.

title: 749档案集：无锡外星人事件
description:
게임 정보
Synopsis:
Bureau 749 is a private and secret department in China responsible for the investigation and disposal of unnatural phenomena, supernatural powers, and paranormal events. Involved in many mysterious events since the founding of the Republic. Such as Peng Jiamu missing case, Kunlun Mountain mantis incident, Sichuan Daba Mountain green Maoist incident, Qinling Mountains Sino-Japanese fighting incident and so on. This game is based on the rumor revealed by the relevant personnel that actually happened in Wuxi alien events.
As a young agent of the 749 Bureau, Jia Hua is ordered to go to an abandoned factory in the outskirts of Wuxi to investigate the truth of the alien incident rumored on the Internet. I thought this was just an urban legend, but things are far from simple.
Game Features:
Exciting shooting experience: carefully designed battle scenes, let you feel the pleasure of fighting.
Immersive story: Explore with Jia Hua the truth about mysterious creatures and the love and hate hidden inside the 749 Bureau through cinematic animation.
Mystery and suspense: Gradually uncover the truth behind the abandoned factory, feel the tension and excitement of the unknown world.
Orbital Shooting: Experience an immersive adventure through traditional arcade-style gameplay with orbital shooting from a first-person perspective.
Description:
The story of this game is pure fiction, does not really map any events in reality, if the same, pure coincidence!

title: The Squirrel & Sea
description:
게임 정보
"다람쥐와 바다" 는 수중 2.5D 마우스 전용 고난이도 게임입니다.
노를 저어 바닷속 세계를 탐험하세요.
카약을 젓는 느낌을 상상해 보세요.
해파리, 물고기, 바다표범 등 다양한 해양 생물을 만나게 될 것입니다.
플레이 시간: 8시간 이상 ~ 무한대.
마지막 승자는 무료 버블 스킨을 받을 수 있습니다.
진행도를 여러 번 잃을 수도 있습니다.
게임의 스토리와 배경은 진행하면서 점차 드러납니다.
절대 포기하지 마세요!

title: Murder Inc
description:
게임 정보
In a grim world of chaos, where reality feels like a thin layer over madness, welcome to Murder Inc — a top-down adrenaline-fueled shooter where time and style are your ultimate weapons.
You are a mysterious operative, an antihero walking the fine line between life and death. Your targets are the criminals who rule the city from the labyrinth of filthy streets. But there’s a catch: every shot, strike, or step you take sets time in motion. The faster you move, the faster the world collapses around you.
Features:
Time dynamics: Time only moves when you do. Use this to dodge bullets, plan your attacks, and craft action scenes worthy of a blockbuster.
Brutal style: Every kill is a mix of speed, fury, and tactical precision.
Adrenaline vibe: Stylish pixel visuals paired with a retro-wave soundtrack that keeps your heart racing.

title: Idle Circles
description:
게임 정보
Release a marble so that it fills circle after circle with glowing light.
Clean the light particles to win points, then use these points to buy more marbles.
Let the marbles do their work, or click a circle to manually fill it. 
Play until space runs out and the level ends.
Make strategic choices in the skill tree
Once a level is over, it’s time to spend your remaining marbles in the skill tree.
Choose for each token color critical skills that will change the way you play : boost, automate, multiply…
Do keep a few marbles for the next level ;)
Create your own neon aesthetic
Choose your own color palette or pick among preselected themes, whether for accessibility or maximum visual satisfaction.

title: Escape from Chancellor's Chambers
description:
게임 정보
Escape from Chancellor's Chambers is a puzzle game with platforming elements where you play as a Wizard trying to escape from the many chambers below the chancellor's castle.

Solve puzzles, avoid traps, and find spells to help aid you in your escape. You may meet some interesting characters along the way!


There are several spells that can help the player progress past challenges that were previously impossible.

There is an in-depth story that will try to pull in the player and teach them about the world and the characters inside it, including what roles they play.

title: Eternal Siege
description:
게임 정보
The king has exiled his brother for treason (or so we are told). You are an army General returning from a long trip, tasked with defending the kings city against his brothers attacks. In this strategical resource management tower defense, you will die...Eventually. There is no end to the eternal waves of attacks, but how long can you survive? Can you outlive the human era and reach the leaderboard?
Manage resources and upgrades
Invent the fastest, most efficient resource management path. Maybe even sacrifice some early towers to get upgrades faster...at your own risk.
Never-ending chaos
There are no wave timers, no breaks - the armies keep on coming, and they will never stop until they take over the city.

title: Sweatshop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Get ready to build and manage your own... "entrepreneurial" venture from the ground up! In Sweatshop Simulator, you will take on the challenge of creating a thriving business, navigating the ups and downs of resource management, and, of course, "motivating" your workers to get the job done.
Build and customize your operation from scratch, optimizing production and resource allocation to maximize profits.
Command your workers, each with their own strengths and weaknesses, to execute tasks and keep your business running smoothly.
Balance risk and reward as you navigate the... "gray areas" of the business world.
Adapt to the dynamically changing stock market
As you progress, unlock new equipment, upgrades, and "specialized" products to expand your operation and increase profits.
But beware: with great power comes great hostility... and unwanted attention. Be prepared to hustle and bargain your way out of police raids.
Will you rise to the top, or get caught in the act?
Sweatshop Simulator is a game of strategy, wit, and a dash of humor. Can you navigate the cutthroat world of underground entrepreneurship and come out on top?
Will you build your empire Alone or with Friends?
Play the original single-player experience, or play with up to three friends in Online co-op!
Build, Box, Adapt!
As your production line increases new legal and not-so-legal opportunities will be made available and with every piece of product sold the market value will change according to demand. Adding an extra layer of business strategy to the production of your goods.
Expand your Empire
As your "business" grows, new items and workers will become available to you. As well as bigger and better locations. Starting from Mom's garage to sketchy basements, all the way to Huge Warehouses!

title: Beauty Salon Simulator VR
description:
게임 정보
✨Features Three Main Sections
💄Makeup Section🖌️
Step into the role of a makeup artist, offering a wide range of cosmetic services. From applying blush, eyeshadow, mascara, glitter and liner to switching up hair styles, brows, lashes and eye lenses
coloring hair lashes and brow, each look is yours to create. Enhance skin with a scrub and steam routine, experiment with artistic markers. Top it off with lipstick classic, glossy, or glitter finishes, and personalize it further with accessories like glasses, lenses, or nose piercings. Every brushstroke offers a chance to explore your creativity.
💅 Nails & Pedicure Section 👣
Offer clients a relaxing manicure and pedicure service by filing and polishing fingernails and toenails, refreshing their feet with a scrub brush. Take it a step further by attaching stylish nail extensions, giving each client a personalized look that truly stands out.
📸 Photography Section 👗
capture your clients' final look by letting them take stunning photos with a virtual camera, change their outfit for a unique style, and use a green screen to switch backgrounds. Adjust poses and facial expressions for the perfect shot, then pin and store your favorite styles on your wall of fame to celebrate your best creations.

title: Guards vs Goats
description:
게임 정보
In a long forgotten kingdom, a hero sent to rescue a princess from an evil lord's castle.
What can go wrong?
Guards vs Goats is a first-person, linear, medieval FPS, with a touch of humor.
Story
Once upon a time, in a forgotten land, in a forgotten era, there was a kingdom.
The kingdom was living in peace and prosperity. A peace and prosperity which made the lords of the realm bored and greedy.
When blood and war against neighboring kingdoms was lacking in their daily lives, the lords decided to fight among themselves.
Times like these called a hero. A different... kind of hero...
You are William but the realm knows you as mercenary called "Goat".
You will be summoned by the lords of the realm to perform their "lordly" tasks in return of  some gold.
Features
First person, linear, action playthrough.
Every chapter consists of one or more of the following modes:
Slower paced dungeon crawler levels, where you explore castles and dungeons.
Fast paced horde-mode levels where you fight your way out.
Boss fights.
Escape scenes.
Selectable sword-fight mechanics:
Timing based combat.
Directional combat.
6 castles.
10 chapters.

title: Lab Escape: Box Puzzle Game
description:
게임 정보
In a lab far, far away, scientists are experimenting with the effects of magnetism on lab rats. One of these rats has had enough and is escaping the lab! That rat is you, and this is your story.
Figure out solutions to puzzling box-based problems in 100 unique levels! Can you escape the lab? Can you find the shortest solution to each level? Will you make friends along the way?

title: Pokettohiro
description:
게임 정보
A group of brave heroes must gather the fragments of the Magic Crystal to face the evil Black Knight and thus prevent the destruction of the kingdom.
Be prepared to discover a huge open world to explore, with secrets and surprises in every corner. Embark on hidden dungeons, forge bonds with villagers and help them solve their problems, discover useful items to progress in your adventure, release imprisoned heroes, and unite them to your cause.
Will these little heroes be able to restore peace to the kingdom?
Features:
Six distinct playable characters, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles.
A vast and diverse world, teeming with challenges and secrets to uncover.
Hidden dungeons featuring epic boss battles that will test your skills.
Engaging side quests to assist the villagers and deepen your adventure.
A multitude of collectibles hidden throughout the map, rewarding keen explorers.

title: SkyTaxi
description:
게임 정보
SkyTaxi is a high-energy 2.5D flying taxi game set in a futuristic, cyberpunk world. Players navigate 2D movement within a fully 3D environment, transporting passengers, meeting daily objectives for their boss, and overcoming increasingly complex challenges as they progress.
Core Gameplay
Players take control of a futuristic taxi, navigating a maze of flying bases, dodging obstacles, and keeping an eye on the fuel gauge while racing against the clock. Using impulse-based flight controls, players must skillfully balance gravity to land smoothly and avoid crashes. The core gameplay challenges players to prioritize picking up passengers while managing fuel for maximum efficiency. Additionally, each level features a special box that can be carried and released by the taxi, helping players by destroying drones, stunning robots, and blocking street cleaners, making it easier to pick up passengers from their bases.

title: Smith & Dungeon: Crafting the Legendary Weapons
description:
게임 정보
"Smith and Dungeon" is a hack-and-slash roguelite game, where you play as a blacksmith exploring dungeons, battling monsters, collecting materials, and crafting powerful weapons!
Story
The Kingdom announced a grand reward for anyone who could craft a powerful weapon worthy of equipping the hero and their companions on their mission to defeat the Demon King. Only weapons approved by the king would be rewarded.
Upon hearing this, a young blacksmith, dreaming of fame and fortune, resolved to create the ultimate weapon.
"I want to craft weapons capable of defeating the Demon King with my own hands!"
To achieve this, he set out to explore dangerous dungeons under the Demon King's control, searching for rare materials to forge a weapon so powerful that it would prove its worth to the king.
Thus, his perilous journey into the dungeons began!
Craft a Variety of Weapons and Armor Using Gathered Materials!
Harness rare materials collected in dungeons to showcase your skills as a blacksmith! Craft weapons like swords, spears, and bows, as well as armor, helmets, shields, and rings. Equip your crafted gear to enhance your character and prepare for epic adventures!
Dynamic Dungeons that Change Every Time You Play!
Experience the thrill of roguelite gameplay with dungeons that generate random layouts, monster spawns, and treasure chest locations every time you enter. No two runs are ever the same!
autokwd: Smith & Dungeon: Crafting the Legendary Weapons

title: WuttWorld
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Wutt World! A competitive multiplayer platform where simply being the fastest, isn't enough!
Collect bonuses, PLACE hazards, SURVIVE hazards, EARN hazards, place MORE hazards, outsmart your competition and impress the gods of this mysterious world and prove yourself.
Tons of hidden secrets to achieve and unlock. Stand out; be unique; showcase yourself and do it in style.

title: Train your slayer
description:
게임 정보
Train your slayer is an auto_attack-linear-idle-survival-clicker game.
Just simply upgrade your slayer, he auto attack and can be forward further in the dungeon to see how far can he go.
Eliminate enemy to gain points for slayer upgrade for your slayer to become stronger.
Donate earned Gold to help maintaining item stock in the shop.
Get your highest score to compete with others.
-Caution for mature scene-

title: Soulglass
description:
게임 정보
Your contract is to protect unknown souls, each embodied in a Soulglass. Keep the sands of this giant mystical hourglass flowing while fending off afflictions that threaten both you and your charge.
OVERCOME ADVERSITY
Afflictions create physical challenges for you, while the soul you protect carries even heavier burdens. Their story is shaped by the Soulglass’s traits and active afflictions.
MAINTAIN BALANCE
Master your abilities to navigate the Soulglass and remove afflictions that attach to its surface. Keep the sand flowing in order to complete your contract while avoiding total imbalance where any chamber of the Soulglass becomes completely empty.

title: MuteX+
description:
게임 정보
PRIVATE TESTING IS IN PROGRESS. Content you see is subject to HEAVY polish.
Heavily inspired by the flash game Amorphous+. 
____________________________________________________________
OVERVIEW
You play as Brigand, a researcher given an experimental weapon by her company's military division. She must cut through and search the nearby nests by force in hopes of finding something that will end her company's stagnating war, whether it be a simple resource or the secret workings of a completely different organization.
Within these nests are many different Anobrites, which are slimes with chitin parts. Each species has its own behavior and abilities, and they can mutate into completely different species by combining with others.
Brigand's moveset consists of a simple slash, punch, and dash. Each ability has its own properties and variants depending on when it is used, giving the tools needed to take on any situation. Additionally, specific tricks and combos (such as killing multiple Anobrites with one swing) reward the player with extra dash meter.

____________________________________________________________
GAMEPLAY
Brigand automatically moves and aims towards the player's cursor, rewarding mastery with smooth and precise gameplay (though there will be controller support for a conventional 1-stick experience). There are also very few ways to get i-frames; movement and positioning is key to avoid getting hit.
To beat a nest, the player simply kills enemies until the enemy count reaches 0. After defeating the boss that spawns at that point, the player beats the nest and can move on to the next one.

Bonus modes include an endless mode for each nest after clearing their normal mode and a boss rush after the last nest is completed.
____________________________________________________________

title: Departure
description:
게임 정보
Once upon a time, in the pacific northwest...

Departure is an management sim set in the air traffic control tower of a small, regional airport. Players are tasked with directing incoming and outgoing flights during the normally quiet night shift. Inspired by 90's pulp media like Outer Limits, Twilight Zone, Twin Peaks, and X-Files.
Flight Management Sim: Direct incoming and outgoing flights at Ganlley Airport using radar, runways, and your own best judgment.
Immersive Controls: Move objects and interact with the world using physics inspired by titles like Garry’s Mod.
An Evening Dreary: Let narrative events unfold while you engage with your work. See how your actions unfold the evening’s mystery.

title: Electro Havoc
description:
게임 정보
Enter a neon-charged battleground where survival meets explosive energy in this retro, space-themed twin-stick shooter! As you dance through waves of geometric adversaries, each defeated enemy leaves behind a deadly debris field—lure other enemies into these hazard zones to trigger devastating chain reactions and score multipliers.
Snag powerful upgrades that temporarily boost your ship's offensive and defensive capabilities while you craft the perfect storm of destruction, turning enemy movements into opportunities for spectacular combos. Set your own pace in this sleek, modern take on classic arcade action, where minimalist design meets pixel particle effects in a sea of vibrant colors.
Simple Controls
Mastering Electro Havoc is easy: Use the two joysticks (or WASD+LMB) to control your ship and spray bullets in the general direction of your foes.
Your Ship
Take control of the Starfighter X-7, a lightning-fast combat ship that comes equipped with devastating weapon systems, perfect for carving through waves of geometric baddies. Just... don't let them touch you.
Ship Upgrades
As you progress through the levels, you'll spot offensive and defensive power-ups that last for a few seconds in-game. Grab them on the map before they disappear!

title: Zooika
description:
게임 정보
Drop cute animals into a box, pack as many as you can in, but if two of the same collide they'll merge into a larger animal! 
Zooika is a delightful casual game where you'll encounter a parade of adorable animals! But watch out! These critters aren't happy when they meet their twin, match two animals of the same kind and POP! They'll combine to form a brand new, even larger animal! It's your job to strategically contain them all.
With every critter combined, you'll earn points and unlock new challenges. Zooika is easy to pick up and play, but mastering the art of animal combination will take some strategic thinking. So, are you ready to box in some fun? Get ready for Zooika!
Different sets of animals
Time Challenge Mode
Order Challenge Mode

title: Lost Tribe
description:
게임 정보
Aim and throw your spear to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies. Use it to create platforms that give you a boost to reach new areas.
Master the winds with the gliding spear, riding air streams to explore even higher heights.
Explore a vast world filled with mysterious encounters and hidden secrets. Use the environment to your advantage by swinging on liana ropes.

title: Tiny Devils
description:
게임 정보
Tiny Devils는 1-4명의 플레이어가 즐길 수 있는 빠른 멀티플레이어 파티 게임입니다. 벌과 자석 같은 특수 능력을 사용해 라이벌을 방해하며 미친 듯한 장애물 코스를 질주하세요. 왕관을 차지하고 결승선까지 달려가세요—가장 먼저 도착하는 사람이 이기지만, 혼돈은 피할 수 없습니다!
재미있는 반전이 가득한 혼돈의 경주
상대를 능가하는 창의적인 파워업:
비 스트라이크
플레이어를 쫓아다니는 벌을 내보내어 맞은 상대가 왕관을 떨어뜨리게 만드세요.
마그넷 매드니스
강력한 자력으로 라이벌의 왕관이나 가까운 아이템을 빼앗으세요.

title: Daahrien's Active and Operational
description:
게임 정보
당신은 버려진 것처럼 보이는 우주선에 갇혀 있습니다. 선택지는 제한적입니다. 통제 불능의 AI와 풀어야 할 미스터리가 있습니다. 생존하려면 주위에서 찾을 수 있는 모든 것을 사용해야 합니다.
숨고, 달리고… 생각해라.
매우 지능적인 적 AI가 플레이어의 행동에서 학습합니다.
많은 독특하고 믿을 수 없을 만큼 지능적인 적들과 맞서 싸워야 합니다. 일부는 잠시 멈출 수 있으며, 일부는 심지어 처치할 수도 있습니다. 그러나 대부분은 쓰러지지 않으므로 잘 계획하고 가능한 한 충돌을 피하십시오.
그들은 당신에게서 배우며, 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞춰 적응합니다. 그들은 심지어 다른 적들과 지식을 공유할 수 있으며, 이는 당신이 또한 적응해야 함을 의미합니다.
영구적인 변화는 그들에게 남아 있습니다. 예를 들어, 그들을 영원히 눈멀게 하면, 그들을 다시 만날 때에도 그들은 계속해서 눈이 멀게 됩니다.
주위에는 유용한 물건들이 많이 있습니다. 그것들을 모으거나 자신만의 도구를 만들어 새로운 지역을 열고, 부상을 치료하고, 적을 위한 함정을 놓거나, 심지어 적과 직접 싸울 수 있습니다.
그들이 당신에게서 배운다는 것을 기억하세요! 당신도 적응하세요.
우주선 안에는 숨겨진 비밀들이 많습니다. 기계, 암호적인 상징, 숨겨진 장소와 예기치 못한 장애물들을 풀기 위해 우주선을 깊이 탐험할 수밖에 없습니다.
그 신비로운 가면을 쓴 사람은 누구인가? 당신이 이 무서운 곳에 얽히기 전에 무슨 일이 있었던 것인가? 답이 있을까요?
갑자기 당신은 이상한 장소들에 있습니다.
아이템 생성, 퍼즐 해결, 여러 갈래로 나뉜 거대한 지도, 당신에게서 배우는 예측할 수 없는 행동을 하는 적들— 같은 플레이어라도 매번 다른 경험이 될 것입니다.

title: Noah's Dilemma
description:
게임 정보
Strategy Roguelike x Noah's Ark
Noah's Dilemma is a crew-building strategy roguelike set in a reinvented mythology of Noah's Ark, featuring unique placement-centric gameplay inspired by sudoku and autochess.
Playtime
A successful run typically takes up to 2 hours to complete, with 3 to 5 attempts expected before beating the game for the first time.
Build Your Animal Crew
Embark on a journey to gather animals who will also serve as your sailors. Harness their abilities, ignite synergies, and turn your ark into a swift vessel.
Explore Wild Islands
Sail through a procedurally generated map, venturing to untamed islands filled with hidden treasures, hot springs, altars, villages, and more.
Battle the Coral-Born
The Coral-Born are hostile creatures that emerged after the Great Flood. Command your animal crew to defend the ark from their relentless assaults.
Conquer the Four Seas
Each of the Four Seas is ruled by a formidable boss. Defeat them all, bring every animal onboard to the promised land, and claim your title as the conqueror of the Four Seas.

title: The Music at the end of the World
description:
게임 정보
Shape the Story with Your Choices:
As a new ice age slowly pushes the world toward extinction, witness the experiences of the Narrator, one of the few remaining survivors. In this choice-driven game, you will determine the fate of the character telling the story and how it all ends. In a world on the brink of destruction, where loneliness has become a form of madness, decide what the Narrator will do under conditions no sane person could endure.
You can keep your body warm, but can you protect your mind from the cold?
Experience the winter that brought the apocalypse and the solitude of an abandoned world. The journey of the Narrator, seemingly impossible yet somehow real, is in your hands. Shape the course of the story with your choices. While doing so, try to preserve both the Narrator’s sanity and your own.
autokwd: The Music at the end of the World

title: Questwood
description:
게임 정보
싸우고, 전리품을 모으며, 절차적으로 생성된 숲을 탐험하세요—혼자 또는 친구들과 분할 화면이나 온라인 협력 플레이로! 네 가지 클래스를 선택하세요—궁수, 폭파 전문가, 스파르탄, 마법사—고유한 능력을 가진 강력한 무기를 발견하고, 최강의 모디파이어 카드 덱을 구축하세요. 숲을 살아남고 저주받은 나무를 물리칠 수 있을까요?
궁수, 폭파 전문가, 스파르탄, 마법사—당신의 플레이 스타일을 선택하세요!
각 클래스는 고유한 아이템과 능력을 제공합니다. 궁수는 화살을 쏘고, 그랩플링 훅으로 간격을 넘을 수 있습니다. 폭파 전문가는 폭발물로 혼란을 일으킵니다. 스파르탄은 근접 전투를 지배하고, 마법사는 강력한 마법을 사용할 수 있습니다. 각 클래스에는 고유한 전리품이 있으며, 찾은 무기마다 특별한 능력을 부여합니다!
매번 새로운 모험이 기다리고 있습니다
절차적으로 생성된 레벨은 각각 고유한 도전과 보상으로 가득 차 있습니다. 매번 새로운 전리품과 놀라움이 기다리고 있습니다. 이 게임은 영구 사망을 포함하므로 주의가 필요합니다. 수집한 모디파이어 카드는 계속 보유되므로, 최고의 덱을 만들거나 재미있고 미친 덱을 만들 수 있습니다. 각 레벨의 끝에는 미니 보스가 기다리고 있습니다. 모든 레벨을 클리어하고 최종 보스를 물리쳐 게임을 클리어하세요. 그 후, 무한 모드에서 하이스코어에 도전할 수 있습니다!

title: Bobo in Hell
description:
게임 정보
Survive hell in this Roguelike Deckbuilder that features card battles with an in-depth auto-battler-esque synergy and combo system. Help Bobo, the little penguin, recruit allies and face the many horrors that await him on his journey to save his friends.
Features
Synergy composition & team building: Recruit powerful allies and create your team composition navigating an in-depth synergy system! Arrange powerful combinations to exploit and escalate your power level to cruise through the gates of hell.
Loot & itemize: Relinquish your foes and pick up powerful items to fine-tune your composition. Carefully weigh the pros and cons of each artifact and use unique interactions to give you the edge.
Explore the underworld: Find your way through the circles of hell under the guidance of our local, friendly red-hooded figure. Beware of your choices, penguin, as decision-making is the deciding factor between facing the unpleasant and the unrelenting.
Bobo In Hell at release will ship with: 
165+ character cards.
50+ unique items.
50+ action cards.
20+ unique enemies.
20+ synergetic archetypes.
Hundreds of different viable builds and combinations.

title: Comic Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Collect, sell and display over 100 comic books in Comic Store Simulator!
Manage the store of your dreams, alongside the assistance of your staff. Stock shelves, discover rare comic covers, sell merchandise and even run events to keep your customers happy.
Over 100 different comics to collect.
Discover rare cover variants
Run events to bring in customers, such as comic signings or meet and greets with your favorite superhero
Bid on mystery comic book boxes and potentially find that illusive rare
Purchase new licenses from different publishers to stock their products
Employ staff to assist on the checkout or stocking the shelves
Expand and customize the layout of your store with a variety of different shelves and display units
100% original designs

title: Defender's Dynasty
description:
게임 정보
A 2D Strategic Base Defender game set in Medieval times. As relentless Waves of enemy forces threaten your Stronghold, you must gather Resources, Fortify your Defenses, and lead your Rebellion. Prepare to strengthen your Base and manage your Resources. But be aware of the Storms!
Step into the shoes of Elian, a brave young hero on a mission to defend his home village of Regera from relentless waves of enemy soldiers. Fight for peace and restore balance to the land. Find and gather resources, fortify your village with diverse defensive buildings, and strategically place them to outsmart your foes. But beware of the storms—they'll test your defenses and force you to adapt on the fly. Upgrade your buildings and unlock new ones. Show the enemies who is the boss and join Elian in an epic battle for Regera's future!

title: Lunar Descent
description:
게임 정보
개요:
당신은 달의 깊이로 자동 하강하는 서브루나 캡슐 안에 있습니다.
하강하는 동안 다양한 아노말리들을 만나게 되며, 대부분은 무해합니다. 그러나 잠재적으로 위험한 아노말리를 발견하면 즉시 경로를 변경하고 보고서를 제출하십시오.
게임 방법? 다음 질문에 답하십시오:
잠재적으로 위험한 아노말리를 발견하셨나요?
예 --> 즉시 보고서를 제출하고 경로를 변경하십시오.
아니오 --> 하강을 계속하십시오.
특징:
VHS 분위기 [실시간 소음 및 시각적 왜곡]
동적 카메라 [몰입감을 위한 약간의 "흔들리는" 카메라 효과]
숨겨진 엔딩 [당신의 선택에 따른 여러 결말][/*][/list]
참고 사항:
플레이 시간: 1-3 시간

title: Domain of Hallucination
description:
게임 정보
Drink the potion and step into the Domain of Hallucination, where survival is your only goal. Each run is unique: new maps, unpredictable enemies, and a fresh arsenal of weapons await every time you enter. But beware—the Game Master’s relentless challenges will test your limits over and over again.
Grow stronger by engraving yourself with ancient, mystical symbols, unlocking powers to dominate your foes. Escape the hallucination alive, and you’ll be rewarded generously.
This game combines the intensity of the bullet hell genre with the strategic depth and satisfaction of bullet heaven.
During your run you choose your next encounter by placing new map tiles, each with their unique challenges and rewards.

title: Tapeheads
description:
게임 정보
Tapeheads is a retro-futuristic computer simulation game set in an world where technology took a different path. You receive a replica of the 1983 Sonnenlicht Troika computer system from your uncle. Using the Symbolic79 programming language, solve puzzles sent by your uncle and his friends. Take breaks with included mini-games.

Key Features:
Symbolic79 programming language: Custom language with extensive documentation and examples.
Interpreter with debugging and REPL: Debug and test your code seamlessly with an interactive interpreter and REPL.
Editor with file revisioning: Manage your projects with built-in file revisioning.
Mini-games with logic puzzles: Enjoy engaging mini-games.
Atmospheric sound and graphics: Immerse yourself in a detailed retro-futuristic system.

Artwork from the In-Game Magazine

title: C.U.B.E. - Clever Uber Bot Extensible
description:
게임 정보
Learn how to interact with different blocks (magnet, portal, gate, rotator, etc.)

title: 7821 Akuji
description:
게임 정보
7821 Akugi is a short, liminal horror experience where you pilot a makeshift submarine inside a liquid filled asteroid, searching for a lost science crew.
Story:
> loading decryption key 77CX223UI2F9
> ………… packet checksum validated 
> ………… decryption successful 
> ………… decompressing data blob.
> ………… complete
> data stream follows:
Emergency Log Entry 00
Something is up, power went off hours ago. Backups didn't kick in. Everything is dark and my o2 allocation is running out. What is going on? 
Door controls are dead and I hear nothing outside. I hope someone gets this door open soon. My head is starting to ache…  . Hope this isn't my last log.
Emergency Log Entry 01
I’m pretty sure I blacked out from the lack of oxygen. Barely awake when some Enforcers dragged me to the bridge and gave me two choices: accept a brain wipe for the last few weeks and return to Galene, or pilot some… submersible they made to find a lost science crew?
I know what those brain wipes did to other people, I ain’t gonna risk it. Plus Riley was assigned to the science crew - and if I succeeded in this task I was promised a 3rd class citizenship. Easy choice. 
Back in my room now. They left an o2 canister. At least I can breathe.
Emergency log entry 02
I can hear them coming for me. If I can't find you Riley. Know that… I might be in love with you. 
Press any key to continue.
Gameplay:
Navigate your submersible that is barely water tight through tight corridors with only a single light to guide your way.The hacked-together submersible only has a tiny porthole for you to navigate.Choose two routes: Be a good corporate employee and get the job done. Or choose an alternative path...Pick up items, keycards and solve puzzles in order to progress and reach the lost submarine!

title: Pirates - Rogue's Fortune
description:
게임 정보

Take on the role of Henry Barrington, a returning pirate captain, in this immersive roguelite. Your quest for wealth and glory has led you to the far reaches of the Caribbean in search of the legendary Mapoya treasure.

title: Razorback
description:
게임 정보
Faithful to the genre-defining Trackmania series, Razorback is a groundbreaking futuristic racing game that takes players on a high-speed journey. Piloting advanced ships with innovative vertical engine systems, players will experience thrilling races filled with dynamic challenges and strategic maneuvers. The game emphasizes not only speed but also creativity, allowing for unique racing styles. Competing against other players in time-attack, Razorback is designed for those who crave adrenaline-fueled action and a fresh take on the racing genre.

This game is under active devlopment, some feature might be uncomplete. See Discord server for more info.

title: Elemental Slime
description:
게임 정보
판타지 플랫폼 퍼즐 게임.
원소의 힘을 사용해 퍼즐을 풀고, 주변 세계와 상호 작용하며, 다양한 미스터리를 밝혀보세요!
‘원소’ 관련 플랫폼 메커니즘
이 게임에서는 여러 가지 원소 슬라임을 활용하여 다양한 원소 필드와 상호 작용하는 것이 핵심 메커니즘입니다.
총 다섯 가지 원소 필드가 있습니다: 물, 공기, 불, 번개, 땅. 각각 슬라임에 고유한 영향을 줍니다.
예시: 물 필드
슬라임 형태마다 물 필드에서의 상호 작용이 다릅니다:
물 슬라임 → 물속을 자유롭게 이동하며 부드러운 움직임이 가능합니다.

title: Adventure Paws
description:
게임 정보
This is a 2D side-scrolling adventure game with a nostalgic pixel art style. You and your friend will play as two cats with different abilities, embarking on an exciting journey across a mysterious and unfamiliar continent.

You must work together, using your unique skills, to traverse majestic snowy mountains, dangerous waterfalls, solve numerous puzzles, and defeat strange and unusual enemies. We hope you enjoy a fun and relaxing time in this magical world, experiencing the joy of cooperation and adventure.

Join the black and white cats and embark on this journey filled with challenges and surprises!

Game Features
Nostalgic 2D pixel art style, immersing players in a beautiful pixelated world.
Cooperative two-player mode, with each cat having different skills and abilities, requiring teamwork to overcome various difficulties and challenges.
More than ten diverse character states, including falling, getting wet, and flying, fully capturing the fun of being a cat.
Unexpected traps that force you to find ways to solve puzzles.
Hidden areas full of surprises, where you can take a moment to enjoy the tranquility.

title: TreasureTails
description:
게임 정보
A curious journey where you play as a cute cat named Mikado. Follow your instincts and solve clues to find and unearth hidden bounties, riches and ancient artifacts. Sell, gift or collect them as you please. Learn more about the world around you and its many mysteries!
An adventure fit for a cat
Explore a land full of wonders and hidden treasures with the help of your trusted shovel and metal detector. Every beep is potentially a great find!
Drive around in a pickup truck or take your time and walk to wherever your curiosity takes you, there's no rush.
Chat with other villagers and treasure hunters, they might just give you clues or hints on where to find treasures. 
Follow the main trails or go off-road in search of forgotten long-lost treasures, the world is your oyster!
Sell your findings to other villagers or add them to your collection.

title: ScaleBox
description:
게임 정보
The core mechanics of this game revolve around size, weight, and portals—along with their many surprising applications. You can push boxes as long as their total size does not exceed your own, meaning that the larger you are, the more and bigger boxes you can push!
However, each time you move, you move a distance equal to your own size, making precise positioning more challenging. So, what’s the solution?
Maybe you can use something to block your movement?

title: Necroflora
description:
게임 정보
Necroflora is a strategy roguelike in which you manage a terrifying hydra plant, select strange mutations to wreck havoc on the land.
Bring the chaos
Create your own plant using an array of flowers with different powers and see how it evolves. Feed on the remains of your foes to grow more branches and seek out mana crystals to unlock powerful mutations. The 4 kings have multiple armies all across the lands, only a potent catastrophe could topple their power. Will your hydra grow enough to fill that role?
Mutate, Adapt, Overcome
Using all the tools at your disposal, bio-engineer your very own plant horror. Make it grow, freeze foes, create toxic clouds or even bring back the dead. Everything required for a good time.
5 Plants, offering different starting points and different strategies
10 Flowers, each with their own abilities
30 Mutations to unlock and pick from to increase your hazardousness
10 Foes aiming to get the honor of dealing the final blow to the mighty hydra
10 Biomes to explore and revitalize
4 Kings to topple
Open new horizons
Jump into the minimalist world of Necroflora and watch your hydra grow, offering laid back and relatively short but satisfying play sessions.
Analyze your run and all you and hydra accomplished with a full stats page at the end of each session
Destructible environments, break the means of production
Restore nature and color to the land with various plants in 64 colors

title: SHOCK
description:
게임 정보
Wake up. Survive. Escape.
In SHOCK, a gripping third-person psychological horror experience, you find yourself trapped in the dark, claustrophobic confines of an abandoned indoor parking lot, with no memory of how you got there. Playing as a disabled war veteran, you’ve lost both legs, and your only means of mobility is a wheelchair. But as you soon discover, you're not alone. A terrifying, man-made cybernetic creature roams the desolate lot, hunting you down. The question is: can you survive long enough to escape?

Key Features:
Psychological Horror: Dive deep into a haunting world where the line between reality and nightmare blurs. Explore dark, atmospheric environments while unraveling a mysterious story of survival, fear, and the human spirit.

title: Astrumis - Survive Together
description:
게임 정보
[아스트루미스 - 서바이브 투게더]는 두 명의 플레이어를 위해 설계된 독점 협동 호러 게임입니다. 한 플레이어는 버려진 우주선에서 생존자를 조종하고 다른 플레이어는 우주선 자체를 조종합니다. 두 플레이어는 함께 협력하여 우주선을 탐색하고 퍼즐과 미니게임을 해결하며 미스터리한 괴물로부터 살아남아야 합니다.

생존자
생존자 - 존 코왈스키[/b]로 플레이하세요. 배를 돌아다니며 보이지 않는 괴물과 마주하세요. 다른 플레이어의 지시에 따라 괴물을 피하고 살아남으세요.

미션 컨트롤
미션 컨트롤 - 양성빈으로 플레이합니다. 괴물은 육안으로는 보이지 않지만 보안 카메라를 통해 위치를 파악할 수 있습니다. 다른 플레이어가 우주선을 안전하게 탐색할 수 있도록 조종하세요.

다양한 협동 미니게임을 해결하세요. 혼자서 완료할 수 있는 게임은 없으며, 모두 다른 플레이어와 협력해야 합니다.

title: Burial of Shortcake
description:
게임 정보
"The Burial of Shortcake" is an unpredictable story.  It is a new visual novel with characters which are created/designed by voice actor Nozomi Sasaki, whose "expressiveness" shines throughout her career as a performer.
You can click on the screen to continue to read the story.
Game Features
Genre: Crime suspense, visual novel
Playing time: 5 to 7 hours
Options: none. One way
Story
"Sweat, dirt, blood. It all goes in my mouth and makes me want to throw up."
One night, the main character, Kisetsu, sneaks into a mountain forest in the middle of the night in order to bury the corpse for a certain reason.
A snow shovel.
A shopping cart from a supermarket.
And then he wrapped something in a blue sheet and hid it - [that].
Surrounded by “them”, he started digging a hole, was covered with all the sweat and swallowing blood and dirt.
And then...
“What is that…?”
He just realized that there is no end beyond the hole and beyond the tragedy.
This is about “the world” beyond the tragedy.
Crime Suspense Visual Novel--"The Burial of Shortcake"

title: With Dream
description:
게임 정보
At the last moment of life, if you could go back in time, would there be any regrets you want to make up for?
Dr. Carl and Dr. Menoria have a special job: they listen to people's wishes, travel back in time, and then turn those wishes into reality.
However, this also brings serious consequences. As determined by time, even the slightest change can cause irreversible disasters to reality.
Yet one proven fact is that if something has already happened, it can no longer be changed.
Provided that the wish is reasonable, this service is only offered to one kind of people - those who are dying.
This newly - developed technology can convert a person's spirit into an optical signal. With the help of the person's memory fragments, it can trace back step by step to the earliest time. Under one mystery and clue after another, it gradually uncovers the truth and realizes the wish... if everything goes smoothly...
This time, they came to the home of Nathaniel, an old man full of mysteries. Obviously, this job will be different from previous ones.
His last wish is... a door.
------------------------------------------------------------------
A combination of puzzle - solving, adventure elements and RPG
Appropriate music and plot arrangement
A non - combat game mode
A touching story
A cinematic gaming experience

title: Pest Control Simulator
description:
게임 정보
현실적인 해충 방제 경험
Pest Control Simulator는 플레이어에게 집안의 해충 문제를 매우 현실적으로 체험할 수 있는 시뮬레이션 경험을 제공합니다. 작은 개미부터 큰 쥐까지 다양한 장비와 화학물질을 사용하여 해충 없는 환경을 유지하세요.
다양한 장비와 전략
다양한 종류의 해충을 처리하기 위해 여러 도구가 제공됩니다. 작은 해충에는 스프레이를, 날아다니는 곤충에는 전기채를, 쥐와 전갈 같은 큰 해충에는 끈끈이 패드를 사용하세요. 상황에 맞는 도구를 선택해 효과적으로 문제를 해결하세요.
화학물질과 업그레이드
다양한 화학물질을 전략적으로 사용해 해충을 처리하세요. 연소, 지연, 산, 바이러스 효과를 가진 스프레이가 해충 제거를 도와주며, 일부는 주변 곤충에게 전파됩니다. 게임을 진행하면서 장비와 화학물질을 업그레이드하여 작업을 더 쉽게 만드세요.
점점 어려워지는 도전
레벨이 올라갈수록 도전 과제가 더 어려워집니다. 새로운 종류의 해충, 더 큰 해충 침입, 복잡한 환경이 여러분을 기다립니다. 도구와 전략을 익혀 커지는 도전에 대비하세요.
재미있고 중독성 있는 게임플레이
빠른 액션과 여유로운 순간이 조화를 이루는 Pest Control Simulator는 모든 연령대의 플레이어에게 재미있고 몰입감 있는 경험을 제공합니다. 전략적 사고와 타이밍을 활용해 각 레벨을 완료하고 해충을 물리치세요!

title: RADIO STALKER
description:
게임 정보
비극으로 삶이 파괴된 후, 주인공은 완전히 고립됩니다. 라디오 스토킹은 고통을 완화할 수 있는 유일한 방법이 됩니다. 그러나 그가 깊이 빠져들수록 현실에서 멀어져 갑니다.

주파수를 맞추고, 신호를 녹음하고, 발견한 것을 공개하세요. 좋아요, 조회수, 돈이 새로운 통화가 됩니다. 그러나 그 대가로 무엇을 희생하고 있습니까?

이것은 괴물에 관한 이야기가 아닙니다. 이것은 자신의 생각에 갇히고 자신을 잃는 것이 얼마나 쉬운지에 대한 이야기입니다.

당신의 행동은 두 가지 결말 중 하나로 이어집니다. 너무 늦기 전에 멈출 수 있습니까?

title: Frogmageddon
description:
게임 정보
The Empire of Froge has fallen, but in your last stand, your comrades suddenly re-grow in numbers! This is Frogmageddon! A Bullet Heaven-style survival game where the more evil snakes you defeat, the larger your frog army grows (to the hundreds!).
Grow your army!
Every defeated snake poses an opportunity to amass more frogs. But watch out: each frog can only take one hit before being lost to the fires of war. Master your positioning to maximize the growth of your pond-dwelling platoon!
Weaponized Frogs!

title: The Great Hunt
description:
게임 정보
Ben Stevenson, a rookie search and rescue service worker, embarks on the most mysterious and dangerous mission of his career. What began as a simple mission to find missing tourists soon evolves into a chilling nightmare filled with paranormal enigmas and secrets.

Immerse yourself in the deep forest thickets where reality merges with the darkness of the unknown. Come face to face with mysterious and frightening phenomena that surround you. The deeper you explore, the stranger the surrounding world becomes. Children's cries echo on the wind from nowhere, and tree branches whisper secrets that would be better left unsolved. Will you dare to venture off the beaten paths to uncover the truth, or will you prefer to stay within familiar boundaries and hope for the best?
Explore, Fight, and Survive


The Great Hunt is a survival horror game with RPG elements and a focus on narrative development. However, this doesn't mean your actions are limited. You'll encounter two expansive locations: the quiet town of Tomsville and the adjacent national park. You're granted the freedom to explore these places, encountering random events and assisting those in need. Your character is a search and rescue service worker, and your decisions will influence the transformation of the town and the fate of its inhabitants.
Key Features:


A large, explorable town that lives its own life
Unique events that allow the player to impact the fate of the townspeople
An atmosphere of doom that affects both the player and characters
Open locations to explore, collectible items, and in-game trading
Various types of enemies, each requiring its own approach

title: CLIMB UP! Battle Royale
description:
게임 정보
-PLAY SINGLE OR MULTIPLAYER MODE!
-Get to the top or stay on top before time runs out in a VERTICALLY TIGHTENING AREA!
-Leave behind those who try to bring you down with guns and traps
-Shoot or Push your opponents, remember this is a battle royale and only one person can win!
Start at one of four bottom towers and navigate obstacles to reach the top. Each floor has harder traps. Race to an area with two towers, facing more challenges. Use grappling hooks or special weapons to advance yourself or hinder opponents!
-PLAY SINGLE or MULTIPLAYER MODE!
-ZOMBIE MODE or SUPERHERO MODE
-ADD BOTS IN ANY MODE
-CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION
-CHECKPOINTS EVERY 30 METERS

title: Ghost Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Short adventure game 
Around 1 hour for 100% completion. This game was made during a game jam (game making competition) in just a few days. I enjoyed this game, so I decided to make a full playable version and share it for free!
Infiltrate a haunted cave with your team of ghosts.
A friendly ghost was reported missing when exploring a deep cave alone. This cave was, in fact, haunted! You assemble a team of ghosts to go inside and get your ally back to the surface!
Escape from cursed specters to stay alive.

title: Titans of Commerce
description:
게임 정보
Titans of Commerce: A game where YOU! become the capitalist behind the shadows at the wake of WW1. Manipulate diplomacy, fund opposition's journals or even a coup! Triple your income via arms sales, profiting from global tension. Design, produce and sell the train, gun or ship of your will! Fund Governments and get hefty tax cuts. Improve your business day by day and open factories all around Europe. Thanks to the fund that were left to you with these tax cuts, improve your factories and even find talented people in their jobs and employ them! Or just live your life as a simple baker... All scenarios are possible with 20 different sectors to play with.

Topple Governments and Fund Politics
Meddle with politics, fund the party you like and help them get to power, in exchange; you can get several benefits and hefty tax cuts.
Profit From Politics, War and Peace
You can maintain relations with +40 different authentic parties throughout the Europe, benefit and thrive your business with your political connections.

title: Arachnoid
description:
게임 정보
Arachnoid is an intense survival horror game where moving into an abandoned home turns into a nightmare. Clean the house by picking up trash, move boxes inside to unpack, and drive your car to complete various tasks. At first, it's just an old house with a few creaks and shadows. But as the days pass, you realize you're not alone - something is watching, crawling, waiting. The house is infested with giant, intelligent spiders, and they are not in a hurry to reveal themselves. Run from the giant spiders, until you find a way to fight them. Finding a shotgun, you are able to find and carry ammo to fight against these monsters.
Uncover the dark mystery behind the infestation while solving puzzles and completing quests to survive. But as the horror escalates, so does the fight. After finding a shotgun with limited ammo, you'll have to decide when to run, when to hide, and when to face the nightmare head-on. The spiders aren't just lurking in the corners - they scale wall crawl across ceilings, and hunt in groups.
With a slow-burning atmosphere that builds into heart-pounding terror, Arachnoid will test your nerves. Will you make it through, or will the spiders claim their next victim?

title: Square Brothers
description:
게임 정보
Two bandit brothers, One epic heist!
 Two sly siblings, one crazy platforming heist- ready to steal everything that shines?
 Team up with two green-skinned burglar brothers on a quest for glittering gold. Switch between the tall, lanky thief to reach elevated platforms, and his short, stocky accomplice to slip under narrow gaps. Only by using their unique shapes together can you collect every shiny treasure, snag the key, and escape to the exit.

title: Paws Against the World
description:
게임 정보
The humans are gone. The world has fallen to the undead, and only the animals remain. In a world overrun by zombies, nature’s fiercest survivors must rise up and fight back! In PAW, you and up to three friends take control of powerful animals, scavenge for upgrades, and battle against relentless zombie hordes in a fight for survival.
Survive, Defend, Evolve!
Choose Your Animal: Play as different animals, each with unique abilities and playstyles.
Scavenge & Upgrade – Collect loot and Essence from fallen zombies to power up your skills and abilities.
How long can you last against an endless zombie onslaught? Protect vital strongholds from being overrun!
Permanent Progression: Leftover Essence can be spent in the Library, unlocking permanent upgrades that make each new run stronger than the last.
Multiplayer: Local Shared Screen Co-Op for up to 4 players
The fate of the world rests on paws, claws, and fangs. Fast, chaotic, and endlessly replayable, PAW is the ultimate test of survival instincts. Are you ready to take back the world?

title: Eko and the Bewitched Lands
description:
게임 정보
Eko and the Bewitched Lands is a single player action rogue-like. Explore and find the castle where the Dark Queen has imprisoned your friend and princess of the realm.
Customize your abilities and enhance your playstyle! Each run offers unique and powerful upgrades, letting you adapt, experiment, and evolve your strategies. Will you harness fire, water, or something entirely different?

title: We Need No Kings
description:
게임 정보
Living World
NPCs lead their own lives, and other villages develop on their own, all based on NPC trading. Prices vary wildly based on supply and demand, which you can shape by helping NPCs build industries, by selling items where they are needed, by changing the ecosystem to give them new opportunities, or turning your citizens to religion or weird new ways of being.
A Nation of Islands
Sail between many villages, to buy up items for trade, or to help build up different communities in turn. If you can give them the help they need they can flourish into productive hubs which can help other islands in turn. Islands can have all manner of magical properties, some useful and some not. Some islands may free citizens of the need to eat or sleep, while others experience constant rotting where food decays rapidly. Others are simply extremely cold or filled with hostile life forms.

title: FESTERED
description:
게임 정보
Set in a decaying research facility, now overrun by a fungal infestation,You wake up alone in a control room and must navigate the corrupted corridors to explore the environment where every step is a risk.
FESTERED delivers a unique take on survival horror game genre by blending retro aesthetics with modern mechanics. Its shifting environments, permadeath, and oppressive atmosphere create a tense experience where every decision matters, and the infection warps both the facility and your perception."

Retro Survival Horror: Experience the tension of PSX/PS1-style graphics and a haunting retro soundtrack.
Dynamic Gameplay: Each playthrough offers unique challenges with randomly generated environments.
Tense Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in an oppressive, fear-filled environment where every shadow hides a new threat.
Unique Tools and Items: Discover and utilize a variety of tools and items strategically placed throughout the facility to aid your escape.
Permadeath Mechanics: With only three lives, every decision is critical.

title: Fixing The Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Fixing The Apocalypse challenges you to define what kind of leader you are, shaping the story based on your ideology. In this mysterious world, every choice you make will come back to you in time, guiding the course of your game. With over 30 different endings, you will experience a truly personalized journey.
Fixing the Apocalypse is a type of political management simulation with a first-person perspective, which is somewhat casual yet deals with serious matters. At times, you will make decisions that leave you in a dilemma, while at other times, you will face different societies and ideologies for the benefit of your city. Some choices will lead you to wars that you need to manage, allowing you to create your own military strategy through turn-based tactical battles. Throughout this journey, your ideology and all context-related decisions will shape your personalized story and determine your ending. You will see world politics through the lens of communities with unique ideologies and religious beliefs, sometimes portrayed with humorous, sometimes with terrifying symbolic narratives.
As the layers of the story unfold, you must balance the needs of your people while proving your tactical genius on the battlefield. Your decisions will not only shape your destiny but also determine the future of the world.

title: Infinite Hole Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"Falling through the endless abyss..."
"Five Munutes... 2 Years? I don't know how long it's been..."
"What if I never stop falling..."
The game to end ALL games!
Infinite Hole Simulator is a ONCE IN A LIFETIME experience, fall down a hole, and keep falling FOREVER!
Features
Fall down hole FOREVER
Jump in and fall forever. You NEVER get to come out!
LORE
Why you may ask? Well because we CAN! Can you all through into the Under-Realm and escape the town stuck out of time? You'll find out!
Other Features
Full RPG-combat system
NPCs to help tell the unique story we want to tell
Ingame achievements system
Multiple ingame locations to explore
A defenitely infinite hole that'll DEFENITELY never end.

title: Hostile Lands
description:
게임 정보
Hostile Lands is a 2D top-down roguelite shooter where a crash landing is mistaken for an act of war. The game moves through 11 environments, where players will encounter many types of enemies, find hundreds of unique weapons and discover the reason behind the crash.
With procedurally generated levels, alternate bosses, random gun spawns, up to 3 different endings, as well as playable lore sections, players will have a unique experience every time.
Collect them All!
6 different gun types for all play styles: Pistols, Revolvers, Shotguns, SMGs, Assault Rifles, Sniper Rifles…and perhaps some secrets you’ll just have to discover for yourself…

title: Steal The Pig
description:
게임 정보
Steal the Pig!
As two sneaky thieves, your mission is to steal the pig. But be careful—this pig isn't a fan of traveling! Try not to damage it or let it escape.
Multiplayer: Team Up to Steal the Pig!
Invite a trusted friend to your lobby and work together to steal the pig and deliver it safely!
Traps & Puzzles
Along the way, you'll encounter tricky traps and brain-teasing puzzles that will test your skills and reflexes. Solve challenges and avoid dangers to successfully deliver the pig!

title: Datbyel's Nebula
description:
게임 정보
소개
닻별의 성운은 가벼운 퍼즐과 전투가 포함된 스토리 위주의 게임입니다.
총 두 개의 챕터로 이루어져 있으며, 2챕터는 1챕터를 출시한 후에 개발할 예정입니다.
시놉시스
1992년 9월의 어느 날...
대기업 코넥 에너지를 퇴사한 엘리는 우연히 신비로운 세계 '닻별'에 떨어집니다.
닻별에서 엘리는 기억을 잃은 안치타와 만나고 그와 동행하며 돌아가기 위한 여정을 시작합니다.
엘리는 이 여정 속에서 진정으로 자신이 원하는 것이 무엇인지 깨달을 수 있을까요?

title: Nia: Jewel Hunter
description:
게임 정보
Begin a thrilling journey through time with Nia, a brave young girl who finds herself transported to an ancient world filled with mysteries and dangers.
In this captivating platformer, you’ll venture into a past where myths and legends intertwine, guiding Nia on her quest to return home.
Trapped in this hostile world, Nia must navigate her way back by overcoming numerous trials, solving ancient puzzles, and dodging dangers at every turn. Explore mysterious ruins, uncover hidden artifacts, and tackle intricate mechanisms that can either be your salvation or doom.
Collect ancient artifacts, activate portals, and find the exit on each level to help Nia return to the modern world. Your wit, agility, and keen observation will be the keys to success in this remarkable adventure.
Key Features:
Atmospheric World: Explore a setting inspired by the ancient civilizations of Egypt and Greece.
Engaging Puzzles: Solve challenges rooted in myths and legends.
Exciting Levels: Conquer unique obstacles and trials.
Vibrant Graphics and Enchanting Music: Immerse yourself in the ancient world.

title: Hunt Grounds
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to Hunt Grounds, a multiplayer horror survival experience where players must navigate the terrifying Hunt Grounds, an abandoned and dangerous location where hunters and survivors face off in a deadly game of cat and mouse.
As a survivor, your mission is simple: stay alive. Scavenge for essential supplies, unlock hidden escape routes, and use powerful supernatural items to turn the tide in your favor. Whether you choose to team up with others or go alone, you’ll need to stay sharp as the hunters relentlessly track your every move.
As a hunter, the thrill of the hunt is your calling. Use your heightened senses to track down survivors, unleash your unique abilities to corner your prey, and eliminate anyone who stands in your way. Each hunter has their own terrifying powers, ensuring that no two hunts are ever the same.
Key Features:

title: Keep It Running: Together
description:
게임 정보
The Boss is back! And he has found a new, and much bigger, factory to repurpose for the production of his cursed products. You and your fellow workers find yourselves in the middle of the fierce competition between the monsters than haunt this new location. How many nights can you last?
Welcome to your new life:
In this high-stress, multitasking challenge, your day begins with fueling the two boilers to get the machinery running. You'll need to assemble robot toys on the three production lines, using a wrench to fix any machines that break down. Fail to keep up with the daily quotas and the ever present Boss will quickly show his displeasure.
Each new day brings new obstacles – from cursed toys coming to life and terrifying Clockwork Demons disrupting the machinery to the monstrous Competitors intending to snatch you away to their mines. Stay alert, stay vigilant and above all always keep the production going.
Succeed as a team, or perish in chaos:
Though you can work alone a team effort can truly make or break a successful business. There is plenty to do in the Factory after all, so everyone will be able to fill an essential role. And the Boss will be there to make sure everyone keeps working hard. No slackers allowed!
Do well and be rewarded with new outfits, new challenges and new Achievements as you unlock them! You may just make Employee of the Month~

title: Geyserlands
description:
게임 정보
Geyserlands is a deck-building game of modern otherworldly mystery. You are a detective just assigned a national park nobody knows exists.  Gain new cards and upgrade your deck as you explore the mystery of Geyserlands. Unlock secret powers and gain special advantages. But delve too deep and Geyserlands will consume you. How will your story end in Geyserlands?
Key Features
Collect a deck from hundreds of cards that tell the story of your character's history, abilities, insights and connections.
Use the cards you draw each turn to solve some of Geyserlands' hundreds of mysteries.
Solve mysteries to earn new and better cards and remove weaker cards from your deck.
Escape despair and death with a variety of upgradable healing cards that prevent Geyserlands from consuming you.
Earn strange powers and supernatural edges that allow you to push your luck and accomplish the impossible.
Unravel the secrets of Geyserlands.
However your story ends, you will gain new cards for your next journey.

title: MEDIX
description:
게임 정보
How much can a person endure, and what is the true value of human life? In this minimalist real-time strategy game about war medics, you fight for your own survival and that of others while the army is under constant pressure, retreating from a superior enemy. A narrative campaign, accompanied by hand-drawn illustrations, takes you through the story of physicians pushed to their breaking point in their fight for a sliver of hope.

In MEDIX, you and the Medical Unit IX of the Imperial Army face a formidable challenge. In a story-driven campaign, you'll embark on a journey that will test your speed, wits, and endurance.

Rescue the wounded from the battlefield, gather supplies to care for them, and build infrastructure. Cleverly distribute your personnel between buildings, and when necessary, pack up your structures and use the recycled materials to build new ones or move the entire camp to a different location. In the heat of battle, you must constantly adapt to the dynamically changing situation.

The people you help, and their loved ones, will gladly support your efforts to upgrade your unit or expand your ranks out of gratitude.

title: Exo Exploits
description:
게임 정보

산업 제국을 구축하고 확장하세요
효율성과 이익을 극대화하기 위해 미래지향적인 공장 단지를 설계하고 관리하세요. 자원 채굴, 생산, 물류를 조화롭게 운영하며 행성 밖 제국을 성장시키세요.
우주 함대를 제작하고 지휘하세요
무역, 연구, 방어를 위한 특화된 우주선을 제작하세요. 함대를 구성하여 수익성 높은 무역로를 확보하고 경쟁자를 물리치며 은하 곳곳에서 새로운 기회를 열어보세요.
계약을 완료하고 연방에 영향을 미치세요

네온과 결합된 레트로-퓨처리스틱 미학을 정복하세요

title: CATACOMB
description:
게임 정보
CATACOMBS - is a single-player first-person indie horror game. The game is set from a unique body camera like perspective and the average play time is 1 hour.
What are the Catacombs?
Under the populous streets of Paris exists kilometers of long lost tunnels and rooms—where millions were buried.
You are one of the many urban explorers who find themselves lost in this underground world. Can you find your way out alive as an undead monster hunts you down?
Gameplay
You will have to explore many different tunnels and regions as you find your way out. Lurking around corners is a monster who chases you with chainsaws or his bare hands.
The map is carefully designed so that you quickly find areas of interest rather than being lost in long tunnels.
The game creates an immersive atmosphere with a unique body cam like perspective, beautiful 3D graphics and high quality 3D sound.
Warning: This game contains gore.

Economic Clicker is an exciting economic simulator-clicker that lets you rise from a budding entrepreneur to the owner of a vast business empire!
