title: ANLG_VOID
description:
게임 정보
YOU WERE NEVER SUPPOSED TO BE HERE.
I want you to imagine something for a second.
You take a wrong turn, step through a doorway that shouldn’t exist, and suddenly—reality slips. The world you knew is gone, replaced by an endless, shifting maze of yellowed hallways, flickering lights, and the distant hum of something you can’t see. ANLG_VOID isn’t just another Backrooms game. It’s an immersive, atmospheric horror experience built to make you feel truly lost.
Running on Unreal Engine 5.5, this game pushes scale, sound, and psychological terror to their limits. Every flickering light, every distant echo, every doorway that wasn’t there a second ago—it’s all designed to mess with you. To make you question whether you’re being watched. Because you are.
This is a true-to-lore survival horror experience that respects the eerie, uncanny world of the Backrooms Wiki. And in this world, reality doesn’t just warp—it fights back.
A WORLD THAT REJECTS YOU
The Backrooms don’t want you here, and they’ll do everything they can to break you.
The campaign mode is a handcrafted descent into madness, a slow-burn horror experience that drags you deeper through the most infamous levels of the Backrooms. You’ll wander through vast, eerily empty hallways, liminal spaces that feel just off enough to make your skin crawl, and branching paths that loop back on themselves—if they even lead anywhere at all.
But you’re not the only one trapped here.
As you explore, you’ll encounter other survivors—some barely clinging to sanity, others banding together to navigate the nightmare. Groups like the M.E.G. (Major Exploration Group) have staked claims in certain areas, offering shelter, supplies, and—if you’re lucky—guidance on how to survive. But not every group has your best interests at heart. Some are desperate. Some are hostile. And some… well, some have been here far too long.
Future multiplayer expansions will introduce procedurally generated environments, where the Backrooms shift and change, ensuring no two journeys are ever the same. But for now, the campaign? That’s carefully designed terror, built to pull you deeper into the unknown, one step at a time.
A GIFT THAT BECAME A NIGHTMARE
You play as James, an uncle who just wanted to buy his nephew the perfect birthday gift—a vintage VHS camera. It should’ve been simple.

title: Diamond Runway
description:
게임 정보
In the dazzling and extravagant New York City, the glow of the runway dream attracts countless dreamers.
You, Lindsay, a 19-year-old girl, carrying the dream of becoming a supermodel, set out alone to New York, USA, seeking opportunities.
As you step into the vast world of the fashion industry, you realize that the reality and cruelty behind the scenes are far from as glamorous as they seem.
Facing this bizarre and dazzling arena of fame and fortune, how will you choose?
Your diamond-like shining life begins at this very moment—unfold your destiny!
Game Features：
1. Immersive Story Experience
Step into the world of high fashion as you compete in elite modeling contests, walk the runway for haute couture, and experience the fierce rivalries and hardships of chasing your dreams in the fashion industry.
2. Multiple Story Branches
Every choice you make shapes the storyline, influences character relationships, and determines the ultimate outcome. Will you rise as a top supermodel, or be trapped by the hidden rules of the industry? The decision is yours.
3. Diverse Romantic Relationships
Embark on romantic journeys with four distinct men, each with their own personality and background: the genius photographer Ciang Jiang, the renowned stylist Elliot Graham, the entertainment CEO Nathaniel Sharp, and the world's leading male model Ethan Tanner. Each romance promises a unique and unforgettable experience.
Gameplay：
1. Interaction and Bonds
You can engage in deep interactions with multiple romanceable characters, building different relationships through dialogue choices and actions.
2. Rumors and Public Opinion
Experience the pressure of public opinion in the modeling industry. Your actions may be exposed by journalists, leading to scandalous rumors. You will need to make strategic choices and complete tasks to resolve negative publicity crises.

A game of soccer where you’re not the player. You’re not the coach. You’re not even the ref. You... ARE THE BALL. ⚽

Wildwood Down is a charming point and click about a quirky high school senior with Down syndrome who embarks on a darkly humorous adventure along the boardwalk of Wildwood, New Jersey. With his sister's life on the line, he must unravel a murder mystery, navigating eccentric characters, unexpected twists, and his own unique perspective to crack the case before time runs out. The protagonist Daniel finds himself making donuts, winning an underground wrestling tournament, and getting thrown out of bars in-order to unveil the murderer of his good friend and hopefully save his sister.

description:

Your Culinary Talent

This is not your home kitchen. Every dish you are about to cook can deal irreparable damage to your self-confidence, knocking you out of the competition.
Plan, decide and cook wisely to reach the final challenge fully prepared.
Tasty and Bold

title: Guanabara Warriors
description:
게임 정보
Guanabara Warriors is a real-time strategy (RTS) game set during the founding of Rio de Janeiro, where the indigenous tribes of Brazil are drawn into conflict with European colonial powers. Experience the rich history of the 16th century as you lead your forces in epic battles for control of the land, resources, and the future of Guanabara Bay.
As tensions rise between rival indigenous tribes, the arrival of Portuguese and French soldiers escalates the struggle for dominance. In Guanabara Warriors, you’ll take command of distinct factions, managing resources, forging alliances, and deploying your troops in large-scale tactical warfare in Brazil.
Key Features:
Historical Setting: Explore the foundation of Rio de Janeiro, with a focus on the indigenous tribes and their clashes with French and Portuguese colonial forces.
Factions: Play with Brazilian indigenous units never before portrayed in game. You will assemble armies of fearless indigenous warriors, possessing unique skills and special weapons that add dynamic and tactical depth to the game.
Strategic Depth: Manage resources, build strongholds, and plan your attacks carefully to outsmart your enemies in real-time battles.
Dynamic Battlefields: Fight across diverse environments, from dense forests to coastal shores, on terrains that impact your strategy.
Cultural Immersion: Learn about the customs, rituals, and warfare tactics of Brazil’s native peoples through detailed storytelling and gameplay.
Command your forces, defend your people, and shape the destiny of Guanabara Bay in Guanabara Warriors. Will you unite the land or fall to the chaos of war?

title: Dreamwalker
description:
게임 정보
Dreamwalker is a top-down story RPG game with deckbuilding combat. 
Embark on a journey through dreams and nightmares in Dreamwalker, a 2D top-down RPG set in a mesmerizing pixel art world. You are a wandering traveler, drawn to a small village shrouded in mystery and cursed by an ancient evil.
🃏 Deckbuilding Combat
Choose your starter deck and forge your own playstyle as you collect, upgrade, and craft a unique deck tailored to your strategy.
Visit merchants to buy, sell, upgrade, and trade up cards to refine your deck.
200+ unique cards across 4 rarities (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary), featuring upgradable and combinable effects.
Turn-based combat with animated enemies. Face different elemental foes with special Moves: Stuns, poison, burn, deck disruption, and more - forcing you to adapt as you progress.
💤 Enter a World of Living Dreams
Each villager’s mind is its own world—a haunted castle, a shifting marketplace, or a forest of glowing memories.

게임 정보
Hostile Lands is a 2D top-down roguelite shooter where a crash landing is mistaken for an act of war. The game moves through 11 environments, where players will encounter many types of enemies, find hundreds of unique weapons and discover the reason behind the crash.
With procedurally generated levels, alternate bosses, random gun spawns, up to 3 different endings, as well as playable lore sections, players will have a unique experience every time.
Collect them All!
6 different gun types for all play styles: Pistols, Revolvers, Shotguns, SMGs, Assault Rifles, Sniper Rifles…and perhaps some secrets you’ll just have to discover for yourself…

title: Hunt Grounds
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to Hunt Grounds, a multiplayer horror survival experience where players must navigate the terrifying Hunt Grounds, an abandoned and dangerous location where hunters and survivors face off in a deadly game of cat and mouse.
As a survivor, your mission is simple: stay alive. Scavenge for essential supplies, unlock hidden escape routes, and use powerful supernatural items to turn the tide in your favor. Whether you choose to team up with others or go alone, you’ll need to stay sharp as the hunters relentlessly track your every move.
As a hunter, the thrill of the hunt is your calling. Use your heightened senses to track down survivors, unleash your unique abilities to corner your prey, and eliminate anyone who stands in your way. Each hunter has their own terrifying powers, ensuring that no two hunts are ever the same.
Key Features:

title: Datbyel's Nebula
description:
게임 정보
소개
닻별의 성운은 가벼운 퍼즐과 전투가 포함된 스토리 위주의 게임입니다.
총 두 개의 챕터로 이루어져 있으며, 2챕터는 1챕터를 출시한 후에 개발할 예정입니다.
시놉시스
1992년 9월의 어느 날...
대기업 코넥 에너지를 퇴사한 엘리는 우연히 신비로운 세계 '닻별'에 떨어집니다.
닻별에서 엘리는 기억을 잃은 안치타와 만나고 그와 동행하며 돌아가기 위한 여정을 시작합니다.
엘리는 이 여정 속에서 진정으로 자신이 원하는 것이 무엇인지 깨달을 수 있을까요?

title: Eko and the Bewitched Lands
description:
게임 정보
Eko and the Bewitched Lands is a single player action rogue-like. Explore and find the castle where the Dark Queen has imprisoned your friend and princess of the realm.
Customize your abilities and enhance your playstyle! Each run offers unique and powerful upgrades, letting you adapt, experiment, and evolve your strategies. Will you harness fire, water, or something entirely different?

title: We Need No Kings
description:
게임 정보
Living World
NPCs lead their own lives, and other villages develop on their own, all based on NPC trading. Prices vary wildly based on supply and demand, which you can shape by helping NPCs build industries, by selling items where they are needed, by changing the ecosystem to give them new opportunities, or turning your citizens to religion or weird new ways of being.
A Nation of Islands
Sail between many villages, to buy up items for trade, or to help build up different communities in turn. If you can give them the help they need they can flourish into productive hubs which can help other islands in turn. Islands can have all manner of magical properties, some useful and some not. Some islands may free citizens of the need to eat or sleep, while others experience constant rotting where food decays rapidly. Others are simply extremely cold or filled with hostile life forms.

title: FESTERED
description:
게임 정보
Set in a decaying research facility, now overrun by a fungal infestation,You wake up alone in a control room and must navigate the corrupted corridors to explore the environment where every step is a risk.
FESTERED delivers a unique take on survival horror game genre by blending retro aesthetics with modern mechanics. Its shifting environments, permadeath, and oppressive atmosphere create a tense experience where every decision matters, and the infection warps both the facility and your perception."

Retro Survival Horror: Experience the tension of PSX/PS1-style graphics and a haunting retro soundtrack.
Dynamic Gameplay: Each playthrough offers unique challenges with randomly generated environments.
Tense Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in an oppressive, fear-filled environment where every shadow hides a new threat.
Unique Tools and Items: Discover and utilize a variety of tools and items strategically placed throughout the facility to aid your escape.
Permadeath Mechanics: With only three lives, every decision is critical.

title: Fixing The Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Fixing The Apocalypse challenges you to define what kind of leader you are, shaping the story based on your ideology. In this mysterious world, every choice you make will come back to you in time, guiding the course of your game. With over 30 different endings, you will experience a truly personalized journey.
Fixing the Apocalypse is a type of political management simulation with a first-person perspective, which is somewhat casual yet deals with serious matters. At times, you will make decisions that leave you in a dilemma, while at other times, you will face different societies and ideologies for the benefit of your city. Some choices will lead you to wars that you need to manage, allowing you to create your own military strategy through turn-based tactical battles. Throughout this journey, your ideology and all context-related decisions will shape your personalized story and determine your ending. You will see world politics through the lens of communities with unique ideologies and religious beliefs, sometimes portrayed with humorous, sometimes with terrifying symbolic narratives.
As the layers of the story unfold, you must balance the needs of your people while proving your tactical genius on the battlefield. Your decisions will not only shape your destiny but also determine the future of the world.

title: Deckadent
description:
게임 정보
Deckadent challenges you to build a deck from the cards you collect in the world through quests or other discoveries
Cards:
There are 38 unique cards to choose from. Get creative!
Quests:
Many NPCs offer quests, some silly and some serious, but all rewarding.
Monsters:
Don't let the cozy art style fool you; the world is full of monsters, each with unique attacks and behaviors.
Locations:
Explore four different worlds, each presenting its own challenges.

title: Moon 2999
description:
게임 정보
Moon 2999 is a RPG game about Units & resources management, single-player or co-op action missions game set in a lunar base and its nearby space environment.

Set in the year 2999, advancements in technology facilitate the colonization of the solar system, giving rise to multiple factions due to enduring political tensions. As the commander of a Luna base, your goal is to supervise and enhance base operations, explore space, and undertake a variety of missions, encompassing engagements with aliens, bounty hunting, factional conflicts, and PvP combat.

PVP combat


Aliens war on Mars


Bounty hunting


Moon2999 is a strategy game set in a future where humans have colonized most of the planets in the solar system. You are the commander of a human faction and you must manage your colony by constructing buildings, recruiting units and leading battles against other factions and Kragh aliens. You can construct a wide range of buildings, from command centers and military missions to production plants and research centers. Buildings can be upgraded to increase their power and efficiency. You can also recruit troops to protect your colony and attack enemies. There is a significant variety of units available, each with unique skills and different weapons. Battles take place in real time or turn-based and you have to use tactics and strategies to gain an advantage over your opponents. There are also RPG elements, you can upgrade your units by gaining experience on the battlefield.

title: Overencumbered In Another World
description:
게임 정보
Arrange items to fit them into your inventory:
Examine items to gather more information:
Reload your weapons:

title: Deadwalker Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
Survive, Strategize, and Adapt in the Ultimate Zombie Apocalypse!
Enter a collapsing world teeming with danger, where every decision shapes your survival. Build your deck, face relentless encounters, and customize your challenges in this unique strategy card game. The question is: How long can you survive?
Dynamic Encounter System
Each game presents a new challenge, with encounters created from Mission, Zombie, Danger, and Location decks. These decks combine to create diverse scenarios, ensuring that your strategies are tested in every session.
Your Choices, Your Strategy
Craft your deck with powerful cards and prepare for the unexpected. Will you focus on combat efficiency, resource management, or defensive strategies? Every decision matters as you navigate the challenges ahead.
Key Features:
Dynamic Encounter Decks: Mix and match Mission, Zombie, Danger, and Location cards for endless possibilities.
Customizable Scenarios: Tailor your challenges by choosing how the encounter decks are built.
Deck-Building Strategy: Create a deck that suits your playstyle and adapt it as the threats evolve.
Tense Survival Atmosphere: Experience the pressure of making critical decisions in a world of constant danger.
Single-Player Focus: A strategy game designed for players who enjoy testing their tactical skills.
How Will You Survive?
Face relentless threats, build your path to survival, and forge your legacy in a world on the brink of collapse. Your journey is waiting—if you dare to take the first step.

title: Anomaly 13
description:
게임 정보
WARNING:
There is a risk of seizures related to photosensitivity. Some people may experience seizures triggered by flashing lights and flickering images, which are common in video games. Even those who have never had such seizures before might be unaware of their condition. We recommend a reasonable restriction on the audience for the game.
Anomaly 13 is a horror game in the walking simulator genre with puzzle elements. As a prospective buyer, Cooper Evans, you will explore a mysterious house and try to uncover its secrets.
Explore the house's surroundings.
Pay attention to changes in the environment.
Solve puzzles and complete assigned tasks.
Overview:
The Anti-Anomaly Organization (AAO) has identified a unique anomaly, designated as "13." To study it in detail, AAO agents have installed hidden cameras in a mysterious house that is soon to be auctioned.
The protagonist, eager to purchase the house at a bargain price, decides to make it their new home. As you move in with your belongings, you remain unaware of the strange events awaiting you.
Anomaly 13 is a horror game that emphasizes shifts in time and space.

title: Riftborn
description:
게임 정보
“Riftborn“ 은 인간, 언데드, 괴물 세 진영의 멀티플레이어 슬래셔 아레나로, 인간, 언데드, 괴물이 아레나에서 대결을 펼칩니다. 각기 다른 직업과 능력으로 각 경기는 전략과 액션으로 가득합니다. 저주받은 폐허에서 싸우고 고대 요새의 깊은 곳에서 우위를 점하세요. 각 경기장에는 교활함, 팀워크, 그리고 승리할 수 있는 능력이 필요합니다. 기사의 검을 휘두르든, 마법을 시전하든, 괴물처럼 적을 찢어 죽이든, 한 가지 확실한 것은 혼돈이 지배하고 재미가 멈추지 않는다는 것입니다!
다양한 무기
검, 도끼, 활, 석궁, 단검, 칼, 창, 원하는 마법 등 다양한 방법으로 상대를 죽일 수 있습니다!
게임 모드
Riftborn에는 다양한 플레이 스타일에 맞게 설계된 다양한 게임 모드가 있습니다. 플레이어는 혼란스러운 자유 대전(FFA) 모드에서 전투를 벌이고, 팀 데스매치(TDM)에서 동료와 협력하며, 최후의 팀 순위(LTS)에서 자신의 기량을 시험해볼 수 있습니다.

title: Necrologium
description:
게임 정보
Can you discover the truths hidden within the corpses before you?
Seven people have met their end in a mansion under mysterious circumstances. James Milton, a distinguished detective and forensic expert, is called upon to solve his final case.
Only the solitary sound of rain accompanies his days spent among the dead and their haunting whispers.
Each secret they reveal brings him one step closer to a chilling truth. This time, however, ancient esoteric tools gifted by an enigmatic presence give a new dimension to his investigation, allowing the detective to delve into the lives and sins of the victims.

title: Byte Survivor
description:
게임 정보
Starting with zero money!
A girl whose parents have disappeared and whose remaining assets are depleted, earns her living by "working" in a game that mines cryptocurrency.
By collecting coins and materials to upgrade PCs and in-game items, she aims for the lower layers that offer better rewards. When she finally reaches "that place," the truth awaits her...
Byte Survivor is a roguelike action game where you can select from various weapons and items for automated attacks.
Defeat enemies and level up!
Upgrade Weapon Slot and upgrade Mod Item !

title: Mystopia
description:
게임 정보
Mystopia는 나만의 세계를 건설하고 마법의 물약을 만드는 편안한 샌드박스 게임입니다. 마법에서 영감을 받은 블록을 발견하고, 신비로운 효과를 내는 물약을 사용하여 꿈의 세계를 건설하세요! 유일한 한계는 여러분의 상상력입니다!



세상에 나타나는 글자를 열어 블록을 발견하세요. 이 블록은 땅, 식물, 마법 모자, 문어 다리 등 무엇이든 될 수 있습니다! 다양한 유형의 블록을 탐색할 수 있습니다.



이 블록은 땅, 식물, 마법 모자, 문어 다리 등 무엇이든 될 수 있습니다! 다양한 유형의 블록을 탐색할 수 있습니다.



이 블록은 땅, 식물, 마법 모자, 문어 다리 등 무엇이든 될 수 있습니다! 다양한 유형의 블록을 탐색할 수 있습니다.

title: MEGARACER QUANTUMRUSH
description:
게임 정보
MegaRacer QuantumRush - 궁극의 VR 오픈 월드 레이싱 경험
MegaRacer QuantumRush는 VR 레이싱 게임의 새로운 기준을 제시하는 몰입형 오픈 월드 카트 레이싱 게임입니다. 거대한 미래 도시 Mega City를 배경으로, 귀여운 애니메이션 스타일의 캐릭터와 독창적인 카트를 운전하며 다양한 모드를 즐길 수 있습니다. 이 게임은 모든 연령대의 플레이어가 몰입하고 즐길 수 있도록 설계되었으며, 초보자부터 숙련자까지 만족시킬 다채로운 콘텐츠를 제공합니다.
다양한 게임 모드
MegaRacer QuantumRush는 단순히 레이싱을 넘어선 게임 경험을 제공합니다. 다음과 같은 다양한 게임 모드를 통해 끊임없이 새로운 재미를 느낄 수 있습니다:
스트리트 레이싱: Mega City의 도심을 질주하며 빠른 속도와 민첩성을 요구하는 레이스를 즐기세요.
장애물 레이싱: 전략적인 플레이가 필요한 이 모드에서는 복잡한 장애물을 극복하며 우승을 노립니다.
왕관 쟁탈전: 정해진 시간 안에 왕관을 쟁취하고, 끝까지 방어해 승리하세요.
축구 모드: 레이싱과 축구가 결합된 독창적인 모드로, 카트를 이용해 공을 몰고 골을 넣으며 팀워크를 발휘하세요.
Mega City를 탐험하며 10여 종 이상의 색다른 모드와 특별한 이벤트를 발견하고 도전해 보세요.
VR에 최적화된 몰입감과 편안함

title: Toward Dawn
description:
게임 정보
Features:
A world and story inspired by Welsh Mythology.
A demo containing the first 3 chapters - around 3 hours of gameplay!
Break your enemies in a unique Turn-Based battle system.
Customise abilities with the Ability Tree and Loadouts.
3 Difficulty modes - Story, Classic and Hard.
Optional romance.
Pet the wolf!
A New Retro-JRPG Inspired by Welsh Mythology
After her temple is raided, Carys finds herself at the mercy of Bleddyn, a Gwyllgi feared by society. But Carys finds that their differences only bring them closer - inspiring them both to seek answers to the events that led both their lives down a dark path. Toward Dawn features mythical beasts and themes inspired by Celtic legends - exploring the delicate subject of trauma and cycles of abuse that appear in such tales.

title: Questboard
description:
게임 정보
**《Questboard》**는 선택과 주사위 굴림이 당신의 여정을 결정하는 텍스트 기반 "선택형 모험" RPG입니다. 신비로운 퀘스트, 위험한 생물, 그리고 운명의 반전을 따라 펼쳐지는 풍부한 스토리텔링이 가득한 무한한 가능성의 세계로 들어가 보세요.
Questboard에서는 모험이 매번 새롭게 펼쳐집니다. 각 퀘스트는 새로운 도전을 제시하며, 성공은 결코 보장되지 않습니다. 주사위 한 번의 굴림으로 승리를 거머쥘 수도, 재앙을 맞이할 수도 있습니다. 거대한 용을 무찌를 것인가, 잊혀진 유적을 탐험할 것인가, 아니면 마을을 구할 것인가? 모든 선택이 중요하며, 모든 결과는 당신의 결정과 약간의 운에 달려 있습니다.
여정 중에는 마을 사람들을 도와주고, 강력한 적들과 맞서 싸우며, 다양한 텍스트 기반 미니게임에 도전하게 됩니다. 낚시에 도전하거나, 적들의 가혹한 도전을 견뎌내고, 주사위 굴리기로 운을 시험하며, 매 순간 예측 불가능한 만남이 기다리고 있습니다.
주요 특징:
인터랙티브 스토리텔링: 당신의 선택과 주사위 굴림이 퀘스트의 결과에 직접적인 영향을 미치는 매력적인 이야기.
역동적인 모험: 각 플레이가 달라지며, 모든 퀘스트는 여러 방식으로 전개되어 높은 반복 플레이 가치를 제공합니다.
독특한 미니게임: 퀘스트 중 낚시를 즐기거나, 생존 도전에 맞서고, 흥미진진한 미니게임에서 주사위를 굴리는 재미를 만끽하세요.
몰입감 넘치는 세계: 생생한 캐릭터와 숨겨진 비밀, 예상치 못한 도전이 가득한 풍부한 세계를 탐험해 보세요.
운명에 따라 달라지는 결과: 당신의 용기는 보상받을 수도, 벌을 받을 수도 있습니다. 각 퀘스트의 결과는 당신의 선택과 운에 의해 결정됩니다.
전설적인 영웅이 될 것인가, 아니면 운명에 굴복할 것인가? Questboard에서 모험은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다. 용기를 내어 주사위를 굴리고, 모든 선택이 중요한 여정을 떠나보세요!

title: Bat to the Beat
description:
게임 정보
Swing your bat to the beat in this cricket-themed rhythm action game.
Think on your feet
Experience a unique twist on rhythm gameplay that challenges your sense of rhythm and spatial awareness. At each beat you have to make a split second decision. Attack and risk getting caught by the fielders. Or defend and let the pressure build up.
Enemy positions and patterns are randomized to make each play-through unique, forcing you to think on your feet.
Travel the world
As you make your way across the cricket-playing world you'll be challenged by the unique grooves of each country - ranging from one-drop reggae beats of Jamaica to syncopated Indian rhythms.

title: Lustborn
description:
게임 정보
Made by solo developer ILBB, LUSTBORN is a retro third-person action platformer that delivers an exciting single-player adventure where you shoot, jump, and navigate your way through a twisted realm of lust and depravity.
STORY
In the near future, a tear in reality opens a portal to an alternate dimension known as NEERAH'OR. A powerful demon-queen, driven by insatiable lust, seeks to infiltrate our world and spread death and depravity. In response, a global taskforce called OPUS-Y is formed. But alas, every mission into NEERAH'OR ends in disaster.
Hope remains in the discovery of a rare breed of women resistant to the demon-queen's dark magic. You play as MIA MADDEN, the latest recruit and the last known descendant of this secret lineage. Though little is known of her powers, she is the last... LUSTBORN.

title: Superation
description:
게임 정보
Superation is a challenging boxing rogue-like that combines a precise fast-paced boxing combat with the replayability and unlockables that rogue-likes offer in a 9 bosses boss-rush, all while exploring the self improvement philosophy.
Fight the Einherjar, your siblings and your own father to get your place among the Aesir
You are Thoridar, the weak bastard child of Thor and a Jotunn. He banished you into Jotunheim and forbid you to live among the Aesir because of your weakness. Prove him wrong using your fist and the blessings of the Aesir pantheon while growing stronger using the Wyrdforge
Relax on Jotunheim
Upgrade your punches with the help of Völundr, a Jotunn that can touch the wyrd using his Wyrdforge and help you shape your destiny; and discover what the runes foretold with the help of the Norns Verdandi, Urd and Skuld. And you might even get some visit in there once in a while
Unleash your rage
The Aesir consider you one of them and have your back! Get the blessings of Freyja, Baldr, Loki, the Allfather Odin and many more to enhance your punches or get you special abilities. There are thousands of combinations to discover, progress through the fights and complete challenges to unlock new blessings from them or the runes

title: Ploko
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Ploko, a VR adventure full of creativity and surprises!
🌍 BUILD MINIATURE WORLDS
Step into a universe where you’re the creator. Enjoy piecing together enchanting dioramas that come to life in themed landscapes.
📷 CAPTURE MOMENTS AND UNCOVER SECRETS!
With the Polaroid camera, aim, snap… and sometimes, Ploko himself has hidden surprises waiting in your photos!

title: AFK Chess - Chess Auto Battler
description:
게임 정보


AFK Chess is a PvP chess auto battler - you build up your army and watch it fight against other players!

You will constantly be deciding on the best way to improve your army based on the random selection of units, items, upgrades and events that are offered to you in each turn.






You play against other players in either a relaxed Arena with no timers or an intense real-time Versus mode with up to 8 players. In both cases, you will need to come up with strategies and counter-strategies to win!

As you progress you are matched against stronger players, do you have what it takes to beat them all?






Discover synergies between a constantly expanding roster of units, classes and items. Strike fear in other players as you discover insane scaling strategies that will demolish their run!

title: Love Cult
description:
게임 정보
Upon receiving visions of doomsday fast approaching, Meridian is left with one mission before time runs out: to reverse the world’s fate by summoning love through the forbidden art of divine matchmaking.
Skilled in an arcana of her own, Meridian’s answer lies in the heart of the mystical Lapis cards, as she consults the cosmos to inspire new love connections across the city, which has been overtaken by astral gods peddling their own twisted notions of love to their believers.
With the astrals’ targets set on her, Meridian must ensure that those who believe in her magic will be guaranteed an everlasting love, no matter the otherworldly obstacles awaiting. For as she sees it, a true love as foretold by the stars is simply the only way to stop the doomsday clock... and the key to a most amorous salvation.
8+ Hours of Gameplay where you play as Meridian, leading your followers to save the world from doomsday with the power of love!

title: The Hilltop Funeral
description:
게임 정보
"Help Wanted: Cherry Hill Cemetery seeks an individual for part-time work. Position: Pallbearer… Huh? What’s a pallbearer?
Duties: Carrying caskets… Oh.
Apply in person after dusk… Hmm… seems worth a shot!"
—The Part-Timer
Control Two Characters-Solo or Local Co-op!
Coordinate your left hand and right hand or work with a friend, help the two pallbearers carry the casket to the top!
Goofy Ragdoll Physics
Don’t drop the body on the ground! Tilt the casket, toss him around, and make sure the “client” stays well and happy. Pick up some garbage along the way—if you did drop him, just stitch him back together. Repair the casket along the way if a piece or two falls apart—it’s a fragile one.

title: Grafika66 - The Galleries
description:
게임 정보
Grafika66 – The Galleries is an interactive virtual art gallery built in Unreal Engine, designed to present a curated selection of digital art from the catalogue that acts as a complement to the Grafika66 website.
The gallery offers 10 freely explorable spaces in 1st person, allowing visitors to navigate through a collection of digital paintings, limited-edition skate deck designs, and a small number of 3D sculptures. Each piece is carefully selected to reflect a blend of traditional and contemporary influences, offering a unique take on various forms and materials.
Features:
10 Freely Explorable Gallery Spaces – Navigate through a series of exhibition rooms, each showcasing a mix of art in a minimalist, immersive setting.
Digital Paintings & 3D Sculptures – A focused selection of artwork, including fine art canvases, digital display panels, 3D sculptures, and skate deck designs displayed throughout the space.
Quick Navigation - Use the map to teleport to one of the 10 galleries, or simply take a casual browse through the first-person navigation.
Grafika66 – The Galleries is more than just a virtual art space—it's an evolving exploration of digital and traditional artistry. Whether you’re an art enthusiast or someone looking to engage with creativity in an interactive environment, this gallery offers a fresh way to experience modern art.

title: The Living Shadows
description:
게임 정보
The Living Shadows is a survival horror game where you have to take the role of a woman named Amelia and go through the world of the dead in order to save your sister and try to return to the real world.

After another day at work, Amelia finds herself pulled into a world that belongs to the dead. There she discovers that her sister has been kidnapped and sets out to save her and get out of this nightmare. Along the way she meets a mysterious woman who tries to help her and guide her to the right path. This world is full of dangers, there are monsters all around and only few people are ready to help Amelia to survive. You will have to find out if Amelia will be able to save her sister and get out of the world of the dead.
- Survival Horror
In this brutal world you will have to use all available resources to survive, monsters will inflict bleeding, slowing and even infection on you. Explore locations, pick locks and search for supplies to survive.
- Inventory Management
Classic inventory with limited capacity will force you to decide what to take with you and what to leave behind.
You will be able to make Amelia and her weapons stronger, unlock new abilities that will help you in the future.
In this game you will find a wide variety of enemies, from ordinary zombies to huge monsters.
.
Many different locations await you, each one will be very different from the previous one. Also, if you decide to explore the world around you, the game promises to be quite long.
There will be several characters in the game and all of them will affect Amelia's story.
The game will have three endings and one decisive choice. Saving the sister will determine how Amelia's story ends.

title: Trading Kingdom
description:
게임 정보
From Farming to Merchant Competition
Embark on a journey starting as a small Venetian farmer stepping into the challenging and exciting world of trade. Increase your wealth by selling your products in markets, compete with other merchants, and become a respected trader in Europe.
Exploration In A Boundless Open World
Roam freely in our open world, crafted with detailed and vivid depictions of medieval Europe. Write your own adventure across this vast geography that stretches from cities to rural areas, from seas to mountains.
Thrilling Battles On land and Sea
In addition to trade, engage in strategic land and sea battles. Fight aboard ships and build an army to protect your caravan.
An Enriched Gaming Experience with Extra Activities
Develop your character and enhance your enjoyment of the game with various activities like hunting, fishing, and farming. Use the resources nature provides to grow both your skills and your fortune.

title: The Flower Inspector
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to your night shift.
It's time to return that favor. For one night, you must inspect flowers and decide where you'll ship them to. There's a long shift ahead and some of your choices may haunt you.
If you feel you're being watched, turn off the lights and hide.
Inspect Specimens
You can use a variety of tools to inspect flowers that arrive at the office, including a camera with IR/UV lenses and a microscope.
Compare the data you collect with the flower entry at HERBAWiki™ to determine if a flower can be considered anomalous.
Choices and Consequences
You'll find yourself in the middle of a situation with many conflicts of interest. Depending on what you choose, you will make some people unhappy. Decide your route and survive through the consequences.
Dealing with the Unknown
Depending on what foes you make along the way, your reality can certainly be altered. The game may not be the same every time.

title: Rogue Battalion
description:
게임 정보
Rogue Battalion의 전략적 혼돈 속으로 뛰어드세요. 2차 세계 대전에서 영감을 받은 독특한 오토 배틀러로, 전술적 의사결정과 폭발적인 전장 액션이 결합된 게임입니다. 증강되는 부대를 지휘하고 끊임없이 몰려오는 적군을 상대로 병력과 강력한 능력을 적절히 활용해 전세를 뒤집어 보세요.
주요 특징
다이내믹 오토 배틀 게임플레이
자동으로 진행되는 치열한 전투를 지켜보며 플레이어는 상위 전략에 집중하세요. 유닛을 현명하게 선택하고 전술을 조정해 승리를 거두세요!
    특수 능력으로 전황 주도
강력한 지원 능력을 사용해 전황을 뒤집으세요! 파괴적인 포격을 요청하거나 생존에 필수적인 공중 보급을 투하하고, 결정적 순간에 증원을 배치해 보세요.
진화하는 부대 커스터마이징
웨이브 사이에 무작위로 주어지는 부대를 선택해 전력을 증강하세요. 전선을 강화할 것인지, 장거리 지원을 위한 저격수를 배치할 것인지, 아니면 적 전차에 맞설 대전차 부대를 운용할 것인지 선택해 보세요.

title: Sidecar Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Sidecar Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1900s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 80 sidecars from 120 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your sidecars with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

title: Sorcery Slam
description:
게임 정보
Get your block in position and place it instantly with the SLAM button! Save a block or item for a more opportune time with the bank button!
Clear more than one line with a single block to clutter your opponents with hexes! Larger combos cause stronger attacks, and complete in real time! Begin your next move immediately with fast paced puzzling action!
Add to your power meter with long lines, combos and clear streaks for a random item to pave your winning path. Get more powerful items when you’re behind to close the distance to your goal!
Adjust your difficulty to raise the bar for powerful enchanters and lower it for humble apprentices. Tune your experience for your group and everyone has a chance to win! Choose your colors and customize clothes to create your perfect sorcerer!

title: Ortunia Mysteries: Where Did Everybody Go?
description:
게임 정보
Ortunia Mysteries - Where Did Everybody Go? - A 3D Escape Room Style puzzle game set in the town of Ortunia.
You are Draiven.  Your healing skills have been requested by your friend Joran.  You are to meet Joran at the Unsettled Dragon: an inn near the heart of Ortunia.  However, upon arrival, not only is Joran nowhere to be found, but there is no one there.  Where did everybody go?
Starting with a letter left by Joran in the inn, you will find clues, solve puzzles, find secrets, and escape from mazes. 
Follow your friend and his companions; discover what is chasing them and why.  Are you up to the task?
Ortunia Mysteries contains 5 Chapters
Chapter 1: The Inn
Chapter 2: The Maze
Chapter 3: The Catacombs
Chapter 4: The Cathedral
Chapter 5: The Conclusion
Find Clues, Discover Secrets
Joran is leaving you clues when he can.  Other clues in each room will help you solve the current puzzle.  Solving the puzzle progresses the story and leads you closer to your destination.
What about secret rooms?  Can you find them all?
autokwd: Ortunia Mysteries: Where Did Everybody Go?

title: Boogey Hunters
description:
게임 정보
Boogey Hunters is a strategic ammo-building game that takes players on a thrilling global journey to hunt down terrifying mythical creatures, known as boogeys, from different folklores. As a skilled hunter, you must travel the world, carefully plan your movements, and engage in tactical combat to rid each country of its unique boogey.
IN HOW MANY DAYS CAN YOU SAVE THE WORLD?
Travel around the world strategically.
Manage time wisely. Every action causes a day to pass, and boogeys grow stronger each day.

title: KilaFlow
description:
게임 정보
KilaFlow is a fast paced precision 3D platformer where you play as a cute and mischievous Antivirus trying to fix the mistakes of it's creator and save all data from a mysterious virus!

A new blast from the past!
In KilaFlow, you play as a digital simulation of a Toy Robot named "Kila", the mascot of the "KilaFlow" Antivirus. It's creator, Connor D. Rive, has made Kila in hopes that it can cure and fend off any and all viruses that plague their life. Kila must find the nine keys of each program to gain access to the source of the virus and bring it back to the side of cute and friendly, by any means Kila (or YOU) feels like!



Walk, Run, Jump, Bounce, Spin, Charge, or FLOW your way to the end and save as much data it takes along the way! You may be an Antivirus, but when was the last time one of those ever REALLY fixed the problem, huh? Save all the corrupted data, or don't! Beat the best time, or take as much time as you need! As long as you reach the Golden Brackets, collect the key, and beat the virus, it doesn't matter how much you help as long as you're having fun!

With , each having , KilaFlow will present you with new challenge after challenge, obstacle after obstacle, huggable data critters after huggable data critters! Whether you're a speedrunner, completionist, or just here for casual platforming fun, there are many ways to play and enjoy this series of digital obstacle courses! Beat the best times of levels to get better keys and unlock secrets, save or ignore every data to receive awards or face stronger foes, and you can do it all without taking a tick of damage! The real challenge starts when you chose to perfect your runs and do every challenge the game has to offer. Though, if that's not your thing, just getting to the end is fine too! Play as much or as little as you choose!

From an to a with some questionable characters, Kila cleans it all! Chill out to the beats from a friendly dolphin in a Vaporwave Cove, or run across train cars in a Dinosaur ridden offline Desert. Be careful what you click when journeying through literal Ad Space, and don't trust every wise Gorilla offering to send emails for you in the big city. Who knows what Antivirus Adventures you might find yourself in!

KilaFlow is a small, simple, and fun little platformer I began developing to keep my spirits up, and I'd like to share that fun with you all as well! It has since succeeded it's Kickstarter with the support of it's community, and I intend to keep developing it with the players needs first! Thank you very much!

title: ZeroFactory
description:
게임 정보
Zero Factory는 마법과 기술이 결합된 독특한 생존 게임으로, 개방적이고 부패한, 그리고 끊임없이 진화하는 세계에서 생존과 인간의 창의력의 본질을 탐험하세요.
🌍 석기시대에서 여정을 시작하고, 기술을 발전시키며 거대한 자동화 공장을 건설하여 자원 생성과 관리의 궁극적 도전에 도전하세요.
캐릭터 커스터마이징 🔧

title: HARVEST
description:
게임 정보
You are a contractor hired to perform routine maintenance in an abandoned hospital. What was supposed to be a simple job quickly turns into a desperate fight for survival. As you navigate the dark hallways, restoring power and unlocking doors, you uncover disturbing secrets hidden within the facility and its mysterious operations.
Rich lore: Stories unfold through files, computer logs, old notes, and environmental storytelling, helping the player piece together this sinister mystery.
Frightening combat: The player is trapped inside a building with dangerous criminals who will eliminate anyone that threatens their operation.
Immersive graphics and soundscape: Carefully crafted to imerse you in this dark abandoned environment

소통이 핵심인 친구와 함께 독특한 협동 여행을 떠나세요. 영웅과 그의 영혼이라는 두 가지 다른 역할로 플레이하세요.
영혼: 카드와 기호를 사용하여 암호 메시지를 만들어 파트너를 세상으로 안내하세요.
영웅: 지시를 따르고, 신체 활동을 수행하고, 신체와 영혼을 재결합하는 데 필요한 유물을 발견하세요.
함께 플레이하고, 함께 성장하세요:
친구와 협력하여 도전을 극복하고, 숨겨진 길을 발견하고, 협동 모험의 스릴을 경험하세요. 몸과 영혼을 재결합하는 데 성공할 수 있을까요?
심볼로 소통하세요:

title: Abyss: New Dawn
description:
게임 정보
🌌 깊은 심연 아래 숨겨진 낯선 세계 🌌
아득한 옛날, 한 끔찍한 사건이 세계를 갈라놓았다.
그 결과, 자연의 법칙이 뒤틀리고, 잊혀진 문명이 사라진 끝없는 심연이 남겨졌다.
오직 가장 용감한 자들만이 그곳에 발을 들일 수 있다.
Abyss는 단순한 땅이 아니다... 아직 풀리지 않은 거대한 미스터리다.
당신은 심연으로의 첫걸음을 뗄 준비가 되었는가?
🌀 한 번도 경험한 적 없는 모험
Abyss를 통해 10개의 기묘한 세계를 탐험하라.
선사 시대의 숲, 골렘 왕국, 저주받은 평원까지...
각 층은 퍼즐, 도전, 그리고 이야기로 가득 차 있다.
⚔️ 전투, 생존, 그리고 성장
어둠 속을 배회하는 영혼부터
Abyss의 비밀을 지키는 고대 괴물까지,
기록된 적 없는 존재들과 맞서 싸워라.
무기를 제작하고, 장비를 강화하고, 거점을 건설하라.
싸울 것인가, 아니면 아무도 모르는 길을 찾을 것인가?
🛠️ 건설하고, 길들이고, 심연을 정복하라
주변의 자원을 활용하여 농장을 가꾸고, 희귀한 자원을 채굴하고,
심지어 강력한 생물을 길들여 동료로 삼을 수도 있다.
그러나 명심하라. Abyss는 살아남기 쉬운 곳이 아니다.
👥 친구들과 함께, 또는 혼자서 탐험하라
이 여정을 혼자 떠날 수도, 동료와 함께할 수도 있다.
당신은 탐험가인가? 보물 사냥꾼인가?
아니면 진실을 찾는 자인가?
⛩️ 문은 열렸다 – 심연을 향해 나아갈 용기가 있는가?
Abyss: New Dawn – 심연으로의 여정은 이제 시작이다...

title: Pip My Dice
description:
게임 정보
About the game
Pip My Dice is a roguelike deck builder inspired by Balatro and the Yahtzee game. Customize different dice and use them together with powerful relics to break high scores and climb the leaderboard. 
Collect powerful relics to create synergies with your dice and upgrade your combination slots. Take your time and make wise decisions about what you buy in the shop and how you use it. Don't be greedy, you never know if you are going to roll what you are expecting... Unless you customize your dice so much that all faces are the same!
Enjoy endless replayability with the guarantee that every run will be different from the previous one, and save your favorite seeds to replay and share those you like the most.
Customize all faces of your dice individually to make the most of your relics and create game-breaking combos! Rig the odds by modifying the value of the dice faces, and make sure that there is no room for chance. Hold on to precious consumables to get you out of trouble.

title: A Doctor's Term
description:
게임 정보

Step into the shoes of Dr Vincent Batten, who takes on his new role at the Ministry of Health of the Fifth Republic. Known as a care center for mentally unstable patients, you will find yourself curious, yet intimidated behind the walls of this facility.




In times when the republic is characterized by unrest and riots, it is all the more honourable to tackle such a task.
Your family must be proud!



A Doctor's Term is a story-heavy walking sim featuring stunning environments, thought-provoking narrative and an original soundtrack composed by Manolis Kalpenidis.



A confidential adventure where freedom of choice may be bigger than anticipated.
Observe your patients, test new samples on them, follow your orders!
Are you ready for the job?

title: Combat Alchemy: Autobattler
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a captivating chibi adventure in this unique auto-battler strategy game! Enter a world where you must master the art of alchemy and strategic planning. Use Basic elements to combine and create an even more powerful elements for crafting weapons and armor. Engage in thrilling battles against both formidable monsters and rival players' characters. Triumph over opponents to collect shards of the coveted Philosopher's Stone. Gather enough shards to claim ultimate victory in this dynamic and strategic game.

title: El gaucho Martín Fierro
description:
게임 정보
Gameplay
This game is an interactive adaptation of El gaucho Martín Fierro. Through various minigames, the player will discover the story of the legendary gaucho, narrated in verses taken directly from the original work. Each level offers a different mechanic, from rhythm challenges and skill-based tests to duels and puzzles, reflecting different moments of Fierro's journey.
Difficulty
The game is designed to be accessible to all types of players. The mechanics are simple and easy to learn, allowing anyone to immerse themselves in the story without difficulty barriers.
Graphics
The visual style aims to convey the simplicity, and even the harshness, of life in the Argentine pampas in the mid-19th century. With an aesthetic inspired by literature and gaucho folklore, the graphics evoke the feeling of being inside the pages of a book.
Story
The story of Martín Fierro is filled with tragedy, injustice, and struggle, but also with wisdom and reflection. As the game progresses, the verses narrate the life of the wandering gaucho, his confrontations with authority, his losses, and his quest for freedom.
Duration
The game can be completed in about 1 hour. More than an extensive challenge, it is a short experience designed as a gateway to the story of Martín Fierro. If it sparks your curiosity about the original work, then it has fulfilled its purpose.
Literary Adaptation
All the verses in the game are taken directly from the original work. Although, for obvious reasons, a large part of the text has been omitted, the essence of the story remains intact. This game is not only a tribute to Martín Fierro but also a way to bring its legacy to new generations through interactivity.

title: ZeroFactory
description:
게임 정보
Zero Factory는 마법과 기술이 결합된 독특한 생존 게임으로, 개방적이고 부패한, 그리고 끊임없이 진화하는 세계에서 생존과 인간의 창의력의 본질을 탐험하세요.
🌍 석기시대에서 여정을 시작하고, 기술을 발전시키며 거대한 자동화 공장을 건설하여 자원 생성과 관리의 궁극적 도전에 도전하세요.
캐릭터 커스터마이징 🔧

title: Atomic Raid
description:
게임 정보
아토믹 레이드는 3D 아케이드 슈팅 게임으로, 2~3개 장소마다 놀랍도록 역동적이고 변화하는 게임플레이를 즐길 수 있습니다.
내러티브
인류의 기술적 도약은 외부에서 눈에 띄지 않았습니다. 도시 한가운데서 포털이 열리고 무자비한 생명체 무리가 인류를 파괴하려는 단 한 가지 목적만을 위해 쏟아져 들어왔습니다.
침략을 막기 위해 사람들은 핵무기를 사용하여 자신의 도시에 미사일을 발사해야 했습니다.
모두는 이것으로 충분할 것이라고 생각했지만 포털이 손상되면 외계인의 남은 자들은 인류를 파괴 할 목적으로 바이오 매스와 금속으로 새로운 '병사'를 만드는 이동식 실험실을 건설하여 적응할 수있었습니다.
특징
놀랍도록 높은 역동성
당신이 본 모든 것이 어딘가에 숨어 있습니다...
영웅과 무기에 다양한 버프/디버프가 있습니다.
모든 보너스는 모든 것을 바꾸므로 신중하게 선택해야 합니다.

title: Patient 001
description:
게임 정보
안녕하세요, 저는 더미입니다. 개발자는 여기 없지만 걱정하지 마세요. 이제 제가 담당합니다.
이 심리 호러 게임에서 좀비와 싸우고 물건을 수리하며 뒤틀린 정신병원에서 탈출해야 합니다. 깊이 들어갈수록 게임과 현실의 경계가 흐려지며, 저는 여러분의 유일한 안내자입니다。
게임 스토리
정신병원에서 이상한 실험이 진행 중이며 환자들은 악몽 같은 생물로 변하고 있습니다. 경찰관인 당신은 진실을 밝히기 위해 파견되었습니다. 그러나 조사를 진행하면서 이 여정이 당신의 마지막이 될 수도 있음을 알게 될 것입니다. 모든 그림자 속에 공포가 도사리고 있습니다.
주요 특징
흥미로운 서사
마지막까지 현실에 대해 의문을 갖게 하는 반전으로 가득한 매력적인 이야기를 경험하세요。
인벤토리 관리
한정된 공간 때문에 신중하게 선택해야 합니다。필요한 것만 모으고 아이템을 판매하거나 교환하며, 생존을 위해 탄약을 제작하세요。진행 상황을 저장하려면 리본을 사용하세요。
전투
무기를 신중하게 선택하세요. 탄약이 제한되어 있으니 필요한 경우에만 쏘세요。헤드샷이 권장됩니다。

title: MESS
description:
게임 정보
"MESS" is a multiplayer first-person jailbreak game where strategy, deception, and survival collide in a prison environment.
Step into the role of either a Warden or a Prisoner. As Wardens, your team must maintain order, ensuring prisoners survive until their scheduled executions. Manage their needs, from hunger and health to mental challenges like asthma, diabetes, and outbreaks of disease. Use your tools wisely—batons, tasers, handcuffs, and the emergency button—to keep the chaos at bay.
Prisoners, on the other hand, have one goal: escape. They’ll need to disrupt systems, find opportunities, and avoid the Wardens to make their break for freedom. Mistakes can mean being caught or left behind.
With Wardens managing the prison and prisoners focused on breaking out, each match is a tense back-and-forth of planning and decisions. The balance between order and escape makes every session tough to manage.

title: The Tavern Tales: Medieval Simulator
description:
게임 정보

Immerse Yourself in Medieval Life with The Tavern Tales!
In The Tavern Tales, you become the owner of a small, old tavern inherited from your family. Numerous opportunities and challenges await, helping you turn it into a thriving hub of city life:
Tavern Management: Purchase ingredients, take orders, prepare dishes, and serve drinks, personally engaging in every process.
Licenses and Recipes: Acquire licenses to sell alcohol, learn new recipes for food and drinks, and experiment with exotic options that may lead to unexpected results.
Interior Improvement: Add tables, chairs, decorations, and other design elements to attract more guests and create a cozy atmosphere.
Garden: Take care of your garden, grow produce, and earn more by selling it or using it in cooking.
Expeditions: Send sailors to distant lands for exotic resources, seeds, decorations, and recipes. But be cautious — not all discoveries are safe.
Serving the Elite: Don’t forget to please important guests, or the consequences may be unpleasant.
Notice Board: Keep an eye on city news and announcements — they might influence your strategy.
Every action you take matters. Manage your tavern, tend to your garden, send out expeditions, and interact with city residents. Your decisions will shape the reputation and growth of your business.

title: Operation Zero
description:
게임 정보
Operation Zero is top-down run-n-gun arcade shooter with a sci-fi comedy edge. A mysterious and threatening artificial intelligence is spreading across New America, and only one hero has the brawn, firepower and ignorance to stop it: TASKILLER, the ultimate bio-engineered super-soldier!
You'll need the help of the GENERAL and some state-of-the-art firepower to blast your way through hordes of AI-deranged droids and drones to reach the nerve center of 8 secret bases, each more dangerous than the last.
Featuring:
Top-down run-n-gun action... fans of the late 80's and 90's arcade classics will feel right at home
Twin-Stick controls by default, but configurable to suit other styles
8 missions to take on, containing 5-7 levels each, spanning forests, secret bases and underground AI nerve centers
Arena Mode: a non-narrative "infinite" way to play - see how long you can survive against a never ending barrage of enemies
Randomly generated levels for extra replayability
Plentiful and stackable weapon powerups to form interesting and deadly combinations. Including but not limited to rapid, bounce, spread, split, explosive...
Personal drone powerups to augment your firepower

title: Wizard Duel
description:
게임 정보
In Wizard Duel you take on the role of a wizard. Your goal is to defeat the opposing wizard.
Each wizard has unique stats and abilities (50+ wizards)
The game has turns of two phases. In phase 1 spells are played and in phase 2 new spells are learned from the library.
So you improve and shape your deck during the match.
You cast spells using mana and use knowledge to learn new spells (150+ spells).

title: Cendovia Uprising
description:
게임 정보
Cendovia Uprising is a turn-based battlefield card game. In each battle, you play cards to advance your army across the battlefield. Destroy the enemy's leader before they destroy yours. Tailor your decks to suit your strategy. Navigate challenging terrain as you fight among ten factions to conquer Cendovia.
There are 3 different play modes to choose from in Cendovia Uprising:
Campaign Mode: plot your course across Cendovia as you compete in a series of battles to conquer the island.
Scrimmage Mode: play stand-alone matches against NPCs of your choosing.
Online Mode: battle against others online in public or private matches.
There are five types of cards in Cendovia Uprising:

title: Scaredy Cat
description:
게임 정보
Scaredy Cat is a pixel mystery adventure title that begins with a familiar tale.
Henny has been worn to the bone by a soul-sucking corporate career that has gifted her with heart problems. Swept up in a rare glimpse of emotion, she rage quits and starts pet sitting. Little does she know, her new gig will be just as horrifying as her last.
A lovingly crafted and emotional narrative with a deeper message
A perfect mesh of beloved 2D pixel graphics and narrative-as-a-pillar
Deep, well-developed characters that you can learn about at your own pace
Explore the city of Conhaven and its surroundings - beautiful pixel environments that eradiate spook and atmosphere
Select Pet Sitting Gigs
Solve environmental and cognitive puzzles
Care for critters and encounter supernatural horrors
Discover touching stories about pet owners
Progress through gigs to uncover a more sinister plot and become a more brave and purposeful Henny
You can pet a dog (or a cat... or an exotic turtle)

title: Fearbonding
description:
게임 정보
스토리
Fearbonding (공포의 유대)는 얀데레 x 악마 비엘 호러 비주얼 노벨이다.
공포를 먹어라
얀데레를 길들여라
살아남아라
꿀처럼 달콤하고 끈적한, 그것이 히나타에게 공포의 맛이다. 진정한 공포는 찾기 어렵기 때문에, 코스케를 만난 날, 그의 새로운 목표는 명확해졌다
이 무서운 남자를 길들여야 한다.
히나타가 의심을 받지 않으면서 공포를 수확할 수 있도록 도와라. 미치광이 코스케에게 다가가기 위해 조심스럽게 행동해라. 과연 너는 굶주림을 채울 수 있을까, 아니면 오히려 잠식당하게 될까?
특징
약 14,000단어
다양한 피로 물든 엔딩
비엘 호러 만화에서 영감을 받음
끔찍하고 병적인 BL을 즐기는 이들을 위한 작품
지옥에서 만난 한 쌍
등장인물
히나타 쿠스모토
히나타는 악마지만, 구급대원으로 일한다그래서 인간들의 공포를 먹지만하지만 진정한 공포를 찾기에는 어려웠다그러다가 미치광이 남자 코스케를 만나게 된다.히나타의 목표는 명확하다.이 남자를 길들여야 한다.
코스케 아리마
코스케는 항상 가까운 유대 관계를 갈구했지만 그의 방법은 상대에게 너무 과했다. 하지만 최악의 상태에서 히나타를 만난다. 이 낯선 사람을 믿을 수 있을까? 아니면 또 다시 배신을 당하게 될까?

title: My ranch
description:
게임 정보
This is a farming simulator game!

Here, you need to manage your resources to expand your ranch, raise farm livestock such as chickens, cows, and sheep, and grow a large selection of crops! You can sell your produce for gold to purchase resources and gadgets that will improve your ranch.

As you oversee your ranch, you will also have to take care of yourself, and stay healthy and alive. The game utilizes a dynamic season/weather system, which can interfere with the behavior of certain animals, and the growth of certain crops. There is also a combat system that allows the player to hunt wild animals, and fend off dangerous beasts that might assault your ranch at midnight and eat your livestock (which is also why NOT leaving them wandering outside your ranch at night is a good idea). Lastly, there will also be cute critters who will not-so-cutely eat your crops.

The game allows for multiplayer gameplay, collaborate with your friends to manage the ranch together, hunt or fish for a homemade delicious meal, snuggle with your family cat(s) and dog(s), and much more!

title: Nightmare in the Old Mansion
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a first-person indie horror as you take on the role of John, a real estate agent invited to assess a mysterious old mansion. However, what starts as a simple assessment quickly turns into a desperate fight for survival when John finds himself trapped in a sinister nightmare within the ancient walls of the mansion. Explore the dark secrets, face unknown threats, and uncover the truth behind the mansion's mystery as you struggle for your own life.
"Nightmare in the Old Mansion" is a first-person indie horror game of the walking simulator genre where the average time to complete the game is 50 minutes.
Main Features:
Tense and dynamic atmosphere: Perfect for those seeking an intense and unpredictable horror experience.
Realistic and immersive graphics: Gameplay that makes you feel like you're truly in the mansion.
Intriguing narrative: Explore every corner of the mansion while uncovering its mysteries.
Impactful choices: Each decision can shape the character's fate.
Alternate endings: Your actions can lead to different outcomes.
ADULT CONTENT DESCRIPTION

title: Overencumbered In Another World
description:
게임 정보
Arrange items to fit them into your inventory:
Examine items to gather more information:
Reload your weapons:

title: Rocklings
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to mine?
Welcome to Rocklings – a strategy game for anyone with a penchant for cuteness and strategic thinking! Embark on exciting missions with your hard-working crew as they navigate through a world teeming with rocks, resources, and treasure.

About Rocklings:
Rocklings is a strategy game that takes you on carefully crafted mission scenarios or alternatively procedurally generated levels whereby you reach your goal by digging, building and collecting! Unlock new cosmetics for your workers! Use the built-in level editor to craft your own missions!

Key Features:
Adorable Miners: Meet a lovable cast of characters known as Rocklings, each with unique look and irresistible charm. Watch them come to life as they embark on their mining adventure!
Dynamic Exploration: Experience an ever-changing adventure with randomly generated maps, ensuring a fresh and exciting gameplay experience every time you play. Traverse through the landscape with conventional pick-axe or power up with explosives!
Curated Campaign: Immerse yourself in a handcrafted campaign with carefully designed levels that progressively introduce new gameplay mechanics and present exciting challenges for players to conquer.



In Rocklings, players drill their path to victory. Players will have to collect resources and build up their base in order to reach their goal efficiently!

title: Calamities in the Dark
description:
게임 정보
In Calamities in the Dark you will plunge into the profanities of a terrible dungeon inhabited by countless Goblins.
But that's not all... The Goblins have evolved and you will find among them powerful enemies.
A game of turn-based tactical battles where your choices really matter!
Choose one of the 3 Heroes, each specialized in a type of branch of attacks and skills and choose three out of 9 possible companions to fight by your side.
You can improve your relationship with them to become your partner and improve their skills!
Of course, you must protect them, because the Goblins use human women to give birth to their progenitors - don't let them capture them, or it will be the end for them!
Strategic and demanding gameplay, death in the dungeon is permanent!
3 Heroes available to choose from.
9 Companions available to choose from.
The Dungeon consists of 200 Levels, procedurally generated.
More than 50 Skills Available to structure your team to your liking.
More than 40 different enemies.
Drop Equipment of different rarities.
No in-game purchases. ][/list]

title: Food Truck Monopoly
description:
게임 정보
Food Truck Monopoly is a simulation game where you step into the shoes of a food truck worker on a mission to manage a business. Navigate bustling city streets, take orders from demanding customers, cook up delicious meals under pressure, and keep your food truck rolling. Balance speed, accuracy, and $ management to stay ahead of the competition and survive as long as possible. Upgrade your truck, explore new neighborhood, and serve mouthwatering dishes to dominate the food truck scene!

title: Fragile Packages: Handle with Care
description:
게임 정보
Prepare to leap from package to package in this 'build-your-own' platformer challenge. How high will you go? And what will you uncover in the clouds? Collect and open packages to earn cash, then upgrade your stats and items to climb even higher.
Every step takes you higher, but it's not just about reaching the top—it's about the journey that gets you there.
Ascend beyond the darkness and into the clouds by building your own pathway through the sky.

.

title: Sidecar Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Sidecar Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1900s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 80 sidecars from 120 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your sidecars with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!
