description:
게임 정보
Get your block in position and place it instantly with the SLAM button! Save a block or item for a more opportune time with the bank button!
Clear more than one line with a single block to clutter your opponents with hexes! Larger combos cause stronger attacks, and complete in real time! Begin your next move immediately with fast paced puzzling action!
Add to your power meter with long lines, combos and clear streaks for a random item to pave your winning path. Get more powerful items when you’re behind to close the distance to your goal!
Adjust your difficulty to raise the bar for powerful enchanters and lower it for humble apprentices. Tune your experience for your group and everyone has a chance to win! Choose your colors and customize clothes to create your perfect sorcerer!

title: Ortunia Mysteries: Where Did Everybody Go?
description:
게임 정보
Ortunia Mysteries - Where Did Everybody Go? - A 3D Escape Room Style puzzle game set in the town of Ortunia.
You are Draiven.  Your healing skills have been requested by your friend Joran.  You are to meet Joran at the Unsettled Dragon: an inn near the heart of Ortunia.  However, upon arrival, not only is Joran nowhere to be found, but there is no one there.  Where did everybody go?
Starting with a letter left by Joran in the inn, you will find clues, solve puzzles, find secrets, and escape from mazes. 
Follow your friend and his companions; discover what is chasing them and why.  Are you up to the task?
Ortunia Mysteries contains 5 Chapters
Chapter 1: The Inn
Chapter 2: The Maze
Chapter 3: The Catacombs
Chapter 4: The Cathedral
Chapter 5: The Conclusion
Find Clues, Discover Secrets
Joran is leaving you clues when he can.  Other clues in each room will help you solve the current puzzle.  Solving the puzzle progresses the story and leads you closer to your destination.
What about secret rooms?  Can you find them all?
autokwd: Ortunia Mysteries: Where Did Everybody Go?

title: Boogey Hunters
description:
게임 정보
Boogey Hunters is a strategic ammo-building game that takes players on a thrilling global journey to hunt down terrifying mythical creatures, known as boogeys, from different folklores. As a skilled hunter, you must travel the world, carefully plan your movements, and engage in tactical combat to rid each country of its unique boogey.
IN HOW MANY DAYS CAN YOU SAVE THE WORLD?
Travel around the world strategically.
Manage time wisely. Every action causes a day to pass, and boogeys grow stronger each day.

title: MEDIX
description:
게임 정보
How much can a person endure, and what is the true value of human life? In this minimalist real-time strategy game about war medics, you fight for your own survival and that of others while the army is under constant pressure, retreating from a superior enemy. A narrative campaign, accompanied by hand-drawn illustrations, takes you through the story of physicians pushed to their breaking point in their fight for a sliver of hope.

In MEDIX, you and the Medical Unit IX of the Imperial Army face a formidable challenge. In a story-driven campaign, you'll embark on a journey that will test your speed, wits, and endurance.

Rescue the wounded from the battlefield, gather supplies to care for them, and build infrastructure. Cleverly distribute your personnel between buildings, and when necessary, pack up your structures and use the recycled materials to build new ones or move the entire camp to a different location. In the heat of battle, you must constantly adapt to the dynamically changing situation.

The people you help, and their loved ones, will gladly support your efforts to upgrade your unit or expand your ranks out of gratitude.

War is both terrible and magnificent, and the characters in our story experience its horrors firsthand. Hand-drawn illustrations accompany an emotional narrative about the effort to save as many lives as possible, while also striving to retain one's humanity and hope.

title: Exo Exploits
description:
게임 정보
은하 무역 연합(GTF)의 운영자로서, 당신은 기업 제국을 확장하기 위해 먼 행성으로 파견됩니다. 당신의 임무는 간단합니다: 공장을 건설하고, 자원을 착취하며, 수익을 창출하는 것. 그러나 탐욕으로 가득 찬 은하에서, 연합의 요구를 충족시키기 위해 어디까지 나아갈 수 있겠습니까?
산업 제국을 구축하고 확장하세요
효율성과 이익을 극대화하기 위해 미래지향적인 공장 단지를 설계하고 관리하세요. 자원 채굴, 생산, 물류를 조화롭게 운영하며 행성 밖 제국을 성장시키세요.
우주 함대를 제작하고 지휘하세요
무역, 연구, 방어를 위한 특화된 우주선을 제작하세요. 함대를 구성하여 수익성 높은 무역로를 확보하고 경쟁자를 물리치며 은하 곳곳에서 새로운 기회를 열어보세요.
계약을 완료하고 연방에 영향을 미치세요
GTF에서 자원 수집부터 함대 구축까지 다양한 계약을 수락하세요. 모든 결정이 냉혹한 연방 관리들과의 평판에 영향을 미칩니다. 성공은 보상을, 실패는 대가를 가져옵니다.
네온과 결합된 레트로-퓨처리스틱 미학을 정복하세요
Exo Exploits의 생생하고 신스웨이브에서 영감을 받은 비주얼에 빠져보세요. 빛나는 공장 바닥부터 박동하는 우주 풍경까지, 레트로-퓨처리스틱한 분위기가 모든 순간을 잊을 수 없게 만듭니다.

title: CATACOMB
description:
게임 정보
CATACOMBS - is a single-player first-person indie horror game. The game is set from a unique body camera like perspective and the average play time is 1 hour.
What are the Catacombs?
Under the populous streets of Paris exists kilometers of long lost tunnels and rooms—where millions were buried.
You are one of the many urban explorers who find themselves lost in this underground world. Can you find your way out alive as an undead monster hunts you down?
Gameplay
You will have to explore many different tunnels and regions as you find your way out. Lurking around corners is a monster who chases you with chainsaws or his bare hands.
The map is carefully designed so that you quickly find areas of interest rather than being lost in long tunnels.
The game creates an immersive atmosphere with a unique body cam like perspective, beautiful 3D graphics and high quality 3D sound.
Warning: This game contains gore.

title: Economic Clicker
description:
게임 정보
Add the game to your wishlist
Economic Clicker is an exciting economic simulator-clicker that lets you rise from a budding entrepreneur to the owner of a vast business empire! Start with simple tasks like collecting bottles or performing on the streets to earn your first coins. Gradually develop your skills, unlock new ways to make money, and invest in upgrades to boost your income.
In the game, you’ll find:
Diverse Upgrades: From "Business Surge" to "Work as a Courier" — each upgrade opens new earning opportunities.
Research and Mechanics: Unlock new features like "Advertising Campaigns" to accelerate your business growth.
Shops and Investments: Buy kiosks, minimarkets, supermarkets, and even shopping malls to expand your influence.
Simple Controls: Tap on the banknote to earn money and use it to grow your empire.
Statistics and Settings: Track your progress, check your stats, and customize the game to your liking.
Dive into the world of business where every decision shapes your success! Can you become a tycoon and build your economic empire? The game is currently a "Work in Progress," so expect regular updates with new features and improvements.

title: ANLG_VOID
description:
게임 정보
YOU WERE NEVER SUPPOSED TO BE HERE.
I want you to imagine something for a second.
You take a wrong turn, step through a doorway that shouldn’t exist, and suddenly—reality slips. The world you knew is gone, replaced by an endless, shifting maze of yellowed hallways, flickering lights, and the distant hum of something you can’t see. ANLG_VOID isn’t just another Backrooms game. It’s an immersive, atmospheric horror experience built to make you feel truly lost.
Running on Unreal Engine 5.5, this game pushes scale, sound, and psychological terror to their limits. Every flickering light, every distant echo, every doorway that wasn’t there a second ago—it’s all designed to mess with you. To make you question whether you’re being watched. Because you are.
This is a true-to-lore survival horror experience that respects the eerie, uncanny world of the Backrooms Wiki. And in this world, reality doesn’t just warp—it fights back.
A WORLD THAT REJECTS YOU
The Backrooms don’t want you here, and they’ll do everything they can to break you.
The campaign mode is a handcrafted descent into madness, a slow-burn horror experience that drags you deeper through the most infamous levels of the Backrooms. You’ll wander through vast, eerily empty hallways, liminal spaces that feel just off enough to make your skin crawl, and branching paths that loop back on themselves—if they even lead anywhere at all.
But you’re not the only one trapped here.
As you explore, you’ll encounter other survivors—some barely clinging to sanity, others banding together to navigate the nightmare. Groups like the M.E.G. (Major Exploration Group) have staked claims in certain areas, offering shelter, supplies, and—if you’re lucky—guidance on how to survive. But not every group has your best interests at heart. Some are desperate. Some are hostile. And some… well, some have been here far too long.
Future multiplayer expansions will introduce procedurally generated environments, where the Backrooms shift and change, ensuring no two journeys are ever the same. But for now, the campaign? That’s carefully designed terror, built to pull you deeper into the unknown, one step at a time.
A GIFT THAT BECAME A NIGHTMARE
You play as James, an uncle who just wanted to buy his nephew the perfect birthday gift—a vintage VHS camera. It should’ve been simple.

title: Diamond Runway
description:
게임 정보
In the dazzling and extravagant New York City, the glow of the runway dream attracts countless dreamers.
You, Lindsay, a 19-year-old girl, carrying the dream of becoming a supermodel, set out alone to New York, USA, seeking opportunities.
As you step into the vast world of the fashion industry, you realize that the reality and cruelty behind the scenes are far from as glamorous as they seem.
Facing this bizarre and dazzling arena of fame and fortune, how will you choose?
Your diamond-like shining life begins at this very moment—unfold your destiny!
Game Features：
1. Immersive Story Experience
Step into the world of high fashion as you compete in elite modeling contests, walk the runway for haute couture, and experience the fierce rivalries and hardships of chasing your dreams in the fashion industry.
2. Multiple Story Branches
Every choice you make shapes the storyline, influences character relationships, and determines the ultimate outcome. Will you rise as a top supermodel, or be trapped by the hidden rules of the industry? The decision is yours.
3. Diverse Romantic Relationships
Embark on romantic journeys with four distinct men, each with their own personality and background: the genius photographer Ciang Jiang, the renowned stylist Elliot Graham, the entertainment CEO Nathaniel Sharp, and the world's leading male model Ethan Tanner. Each romance promises a unique and unforgettable experience.
Gameplay：
1. Interaction and Bonds
You can engage in deep interactions with multiple romanceable characters, building different relationships through dialogue choices and actions.
2. Rumors and Public Opinion
Experience the pressure of public opinion in the modeling industry. Your actions may be exposed by journalists, leading to scandalous rumors. You will need to make strategic choices and complete tasks to resolve negative publicity crises.

title: AFK Chess - Chess Auto Battler
description:
게임 정보


AFK Chess is a PvP chess auto battler - you build up your army and watch it fight against other players!

You will constantly be deciding on the best way to improve your army based on the random selection of units, items, upgrades and events that are offered to you in each turn.






You play against other players in either a relaxed Arena with no timers or an intense real-time Versus mode with up to 8 players. In both cases, you will need to come up with strategies and counter-strategies to win!

As you progress you are matched against stronger players, do you have what it takes to beat them all?






Discover synergies between a constantly expanding roster of units, classes and items. Strike fear in other players as you discover insane scaling strategies that will demolish their run!

title: Atomic Raid
description:
게임 정보
아토믹 레이드는 3D 아케이드 슈팅 게임으로, 2~3개 장소마다 놀랍도록 역동적이고 변화하는 게임플레이를 즐길 수 있습니다.
내러티브
인류의 기술적 도약은 외부에서 눈에 띄지 않았습니다. 도시 한가운데서 포털이 열리고 무자비한 생명체 무리가 인류를 파괴하려는 단 한 가지 목적만을 위해 쏟아져 들어왔습니다.
침략을 막기 위해 사람들은 핵무기를 사용하여 자신의 도시에 미사일을 발사해야 했습니다.
모두는 이것으로 충분할 것이라고 생각했지만 포털이 손상되면 외계인의 남은 자들은 인류를 파괴 할 목적으로 바이오 매스와 금속으로 새로운 '병사'를 만드는 이동식 실험실을 건설하여 적응할 수있었습니다.
특징
놀랍도록 높은 역동성
당신이 본 모든 것이 어딘가에 숨어 있습니다...
영웅과 무기에 다양한 버프/디버프가 있습니다.
모든 보너스는 모든 것을 바꾸므로 신중하게 선택해야 합니다.

title: Patient 001
description:
게임 정보
안녕하세요, 저는 더미입니다. 개발자는 여기 없지만 걱정하지 마세요. 이제 제가 담당합니다.
이 심리 호러 게임에서 좀비와 싸우고 물건을 수리하며 뒤틀린 정신병원에서 탈출해야 합니다. 깊이 들어갈수록 게임과 현실의 경계가 흐려지며, 저는 여러분의 유일한 안내자입니다。
게임 스토리
정신병원에서 이상한 실험이 진행 중이며 환자들은 악몽 같은 생물로 변하고 있습니다. 경찰관인 당신은 진실을 밝히기 위해 파견되었습니다. 그러나 조사를 진행하면서 이 여정이 당신의 마지막이 될 수도 있음을 알게 될 것입니다. 모든 그림자 속에 공포가 도사리고 있습니다.
주요 특징
흥미로운 서사
마지막까지 현실에 대해 의문을 갖게 하는 반전으로 가득한 매력적인 이야기를 경험하세요。
인벤토리 관리
한정된 공간 때문에 신중하게 선택해야 합니다。필요한 것만 모으고 아이템을 판매하거나 교환하며, 생존을 위해 탄약을 제작하세요。진행 상황을 저장하려면 리본을 사용하세요。
전투
무기를 신중하게 선택하세요. 탄약이 제한되어 있으니 필요한 경우에만 쏘세요。헤드샷이 권장됩니다。

title: MESS
description:
게임 정보
"MESS" is a multiplayer first-person jailbreak game where strategy, deception, and survival collide in a prison environment.
Step into the role of either a Warden or a Prisoner. As Wardens, your team must maintain order, ensuring prisoners survive until their scheduled executions. Manage their needs, from hunger and health to mental challenges like asthma, diabetes, and outbreaks of disease. Use your tools wisely—batons, tasers, handcuffs, and the emergency button—to keep the chaos at bay.
Prisoners, on the other hand, have one goal: escape. They’ll need to disrupt systems, find opportunities, and avoid the Wardens to make their break for freedom. Mistakes can mean being caught or left behind.
With Wardens managing the prison and prisoners focused on breaking out, each match is a tense back-and-forth of planning and decisions. The balance between order and escape makes every session tough to manage.

title: The Tavern Tales: Medieval Simulator
description:
게임 정보

Immerse Yourself in Medieval Life with The Tavern Tales!
In The Tavern Tales, you become the owner of a small, old tavern inherited from your family. Numerous opportunities and challenges await, helping you turn it into a thriving hub of city life:
Tavern Management: Purchase ingredients, take orders, prepare dishes, and serve drinks, personally engaging in every process.
Licenses and Recipes: Acquire licenses to sell alcohol, learn new recipes for food and drinks, and experiment with exotic options that may lead to unexpected results.
Interior Improvement: Add tables, chairs, decorations, and other design elements to attract more guests and create a cozy atmosphere.
Garden: Take care of your garden, grow produce, and earn more by selling it or using it in cooking.
Expeditions: Send sailors to distant lands for exotic resources, seeds, decorations, and recipes. But be cautious — not all discoveries are safe.
Serving the Elite: Don’t forget to please important guests, or the consequences may be unpleasant.
Notice Board: Keep an eye on city news and announcements — they might influence your strategy.
Every action you take matters. Manage your tavern, tend to your garden, send out expeditions, and interact with city residents. Your decisions will shape the reputation and growth of your business.

title: Operation Zero
description:
게임 정보
Operation Zero is top-down run-n-gun arcade shooter with a sci-fi comedy edge. A mysterious and threatening artificial intelligence is spreading across New America, and only one hero has the brawn, firepower and ignorance to stop it: TASKILLER, the ultimate bio-engineered super-soldier!
You'll need the help of the GENERAL and some state-of-the-art firepower to blast your way through hordes of AI-deranged droids and drones to reach the nerve center of 8 secret bases, each more dangerous than the last.
Featuring:
Top-down run-n-gun action... fans of the late 80's and 90's arcade classics will feel right at home
Twin-Stick controls by default, but configurable to suit other styles
8 missions to take on, containing 5-7 levels each, spanning forests, secret bases and underground AI nerve centers
Arena Mode: a non-narrative "infinite" way to play - see how long you can survive against a never ending barrage of enemies
Randomly generated levels for extra replayability
Plentiful and stackable weapon powerups to form interesting and deadly combinations. Including but not limited to rapid, bounce, spread, split, explosive...
Personal drone powerups to augment your firepower

title: Wizard Duel
description:
게임 정보
In Wizard Duel you take on the role of a wizard. Your goal is to defeat the opposing wizard.
Each wizard has unique stats and abilities (50+ wizards)
The game has turns of two phases. In phase 1 spells are played and in phase 2 new spells are learned from the library.
So you improve and shape your deck during the match.
You cast spells using mana and use knowledge to learn new spells (150+ spells).

title: Cendovia Uprising
description:
게임 정보
Cendovia Uprising is a turn-based battlefield card game. In each battle, you play cards to advance your army across the battlefield. Destroy the enemy's leader before they destroy yours. Tailor your decks to suit your strategy. Navigate challenging terrain as you fight among ten factions to conquer Cendovia.
There are 3 different play modes to choose from in Cendovia Uprising:
Campaign Mode: plot your course across Cendovia as you compete in a series of battles to conquer the island.
Scrimmage Mode: play stand-alone matches against NPCs of your choosing.
Online Mode: battle against others online in public or private matches.
There are five types of cards in Cendovia Uprising:

title: ZeroFactory
description:
게임 정보
Zero Factory는 마법과 기술이 결합된 독특한 생존 게임으로, 개방적이고 부패한, 그리고 끊임없이 진화하는 세계에서 생존과 인간의 창의력의 본질을 탐험하세요.
🌍 석기시대에서 여정을 시작하고, 기술을 발전시키며 거대한 자동화 공장을 건설하여 자원 생성과 관리의 궁극적 도전에 도전하세요.
캐릭터 커스터마이징 🔧

title: A Corgi's Cozy Hike
description:
게임 정보
Follow our Scalisco Developer Steam Page (click our developer name above) to get notified when we release more games that donate to help animals and other causes
Become a SUPERCORGI!
Don't let stubby legs stop you! Collect Corgi Butt Power to use ancient corgi superpowers to climb and soar and prove you're not too stubby to make it wherever you wish.
Be a Corgi Unleashed!
Choose your own path around the island and explore your way. Relax at cozy spots, grow your collections, or talk to locals. It's all your choice. You can even toggle the pixelized Nostalgia Mode on or off in the settings of the game!

title: Scaredy Cat
description:
게임 정보
Scaredy Cat is a pixel mystery adventure title that begins with a familiar tale.
Henny has been worn to the bone by a soul-sucking corporate career that has gifted her with heart problems. Swept up in a rare glimpse of emotion, she rage quits and starts pet sitting. Little does she know, her new gig will be just as horrifying as her last.
A lovingly crafted and emotional narrative with a deeper message
A perfect mesh of beloved 2D pixel graphics and narrative-as-a-pillar
Deep, well-developed characters that you can learn about at your own pace
Explore the city of Conhaven and its surroundings - beautiful pixel environments that eradiate spook and atmosphere
Select Pet Sitting Gigs
Solve environmental and cognitive puzzles
Care for critters and encounter supernatural horrors
Discover touching stories about pet owners
Progress through gigs to uncover a more sinister plot and become a more brave and purposeful Henny
You can pet a dog (or a cat... or an exotic turtle)

title: Food Truck Monopoly
description:
게임 정보
Food Truck Monopoly is a simulation game where you step into the shoes of a food truck worker on a mission to manage a business. Navigate bustling city streets, take orders from demanding customers, cook up delicious meals under pressure, and keep your food truck rolling. Balance speed, accuracy, and $ management to stay ahead of the competition and survive as long as possible. Upgrade your truck, explore new neighborhood, and serve mouthwatering dishes to dominate the food truck scene!

title: Fragile Packages: Handle with Care
description:
게임 정보
Prepare to leap from package to package in this 'build-your-own' platformer challenge. How high will you go? And what will you uncover in the clouds? Collect and open packages to earn cash, then upgrade your stats and items to climb even higher.
Every step takes you higher, but it's not just about reaching the top—it's about the journey that gets you there.
Ascend beyond the darkness and into the clouds by building your own pathway through the sky.
Explore the city to collect packages and bring them back to the courtyard to continue your ascent.
Encounter the 'Things'—they may hinder your progress in unexpected ways.
Open packages for cash and use Fragile Tape to lock them in place, shaping your pathway.
Upgrade your abilities and items to extend your reach deeper into the city and higher into the sky.
Collect notes that unfold a journey through anxiety and self-discovery.
Your beginning shapes your ending—multiple paths lead to different conclusions.

title: We Might Die
description:
게임 정보
Mech-based roguelike set in deep space, where an alien swarm is quickly approaching your home ship. You and your team of robots will salvage procedurally-generated ships to gain the resources you need to escape the star system intact.
FIND NEW ABILITIES
Create Builds that Synergize
Customize your mech's equipment with mods that work well together to create the ultimate killing machine.
UPGRADE YOUR SHIP

title: Rocklings
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to mine?
Welcome to Rocklings – a strategy game for anyone with a penchant for cuteness and strategic thinking! Embark on exciting missions with your hard-working crew as they navigate through a world teeming with rocks, resources, and treasure.

About Rocklings:
Rocklings is a strategy game that takes you on carefully crafted mission scenarios or alternatively procedurally generated levels whereby you reach your goal by digging, building and collecting! Unlock new cosmetics for your workers! Use the built-in level editor to craft your own missions!

Key Features:
Adorable Miners: Meet a lovable cast of characters known as Rocklings, each with unique look and irresistible charm. Watch them come to life as they embark on their mining adventure!
Dynamic Exploration: Experience an ever-changing adventure with randomly generated maps, ensuring a fresh and exciting gameplay experience every time you play. Traverse through the landscape with conventional pick-axe or power up with explosives!
Curated Campaign: Immerse yourself in a handcrafted campaign with carefully designed levels that progressively introduce new gameplay mechanics and present exciting challenges for players to conquer.



In Rocklings, players drill their path to victory. Players will have to collect resources and build up their base in order to reach their goal efficiently!

title: Calamities in the Dark
description:
게임 정보
In Calamities in the Dark you will plunge into the profanities of a terrible dungeon inhabited by countless Goblins.
But that's not all... The Goblins have evolved and you will find among them powerful enemies.
A game of turn-based tactical battles where your choices really matter!
Choose one of the 3 Heroes, each specialized in a type of branch of attacks and skills and choose three out of 9 possible companions to fight by your side.
You can improve your relationship with them to become your partner and improve their skills!
Of course, you must protect them, because the Goblins use human women to give birth to their progenitors - don't let them capture them, or it will be the end for them!
Strategic and demanding gameplay, death in the dungeon is permanent!
3 Heroes available to choose from.
9 Companions available to choose from.
The Dungeon consists of 200 Levels, procedurally generated.
More than 50 Skills Available to structure your team to your liking.
More than 40 different enemies.
Drop Equipment of different rarities.
No in-game purchases. ][/list]

title: One & Done
description:
게임 정보
다양한 무기를 활용한 전투: 원앤던에서는 4가지의 독특한 무기를 사용해 던전을 탐험하며 몬스터들과 싸워야 합니다.
상황에 맞는 무기 변경: 던전 안에서 무기가 자주 바뀌기 때문에 각 무기의 고유한 특성과 능력을 활용해 전략적으로 전투를 진행해야 합니다.

title: El gaucho Martín Fierro
description:
게임 정보
Gameplay
This game is an interactive adaptation of El gaucho Martín Fierro. Through various minigames, the player will discover the story of the legendary gaucho, narrated in verses taken directly from the original work. Each level offers a different mechanic, from rhythm challenges and skill-based tests to duels and puzzles, reflecting different moments of Fierro's journey.
Difficulty
The game is designed to be accessible to all types of players. The mechanics are simple and easy to learn, allowing anyone to immerse themselves in the story without difficulty barriers.
Graphics
The visual style aims to convey the simplicity, and even the harshness, of life in the Argentine pampas in the mid-19th century. With an aesthetic inspired by literature and gaucho folklore, the graphics evoke the feeling of being inside the pages of a book.
Story
The story of Martín Fierro is filled with tragedy, injustice, and struggle, but also with wisdom and reflection. As the game progresses, the verses narrate the life of the wandering gaucho, his confrontations with authority, his losses, and his quest for freedom.
Duration
The game can be completed in about 1 hour. More than an extensive challenge, it is a short experience designed as a gateway to the story of Martín Fierro. If it sparks your curiosity about the original work, then it has fulfilled its purpose.
Literary Adaptation
All the verses in the game are taken directly from the original work. Although, for obvious reasons, a large part of the text has been omitted, the essence of the story remains intact. This game is not only a tribute to Martín Fierro but also a way to bring its legacy to new generations through interactivity.

title: Quest of the Hero
description:
게임 정보
Quest of the Hero is a fantasy based dungeon crawler with turn based progression, semi-idler combat, skill and item building and short dungeon runs.
Make choices at every step. Will you be lucky? Or peril will be coming your way?
Each turn pick one of the three presented cards, each one giving you unique bonuses or unleashing bad forces upon you. Is it all luck? Or can you strategize?
Play as one of the heroes with unique play styles

title: Lone Soul
description:
게임 정보
Lone Soul is a hack-and-slash action game featuring a combo-based fluid combat. By performing unique abilities, your combo meter gets upgraded, rewarding you with increased damage. 

A roguelite progression puts you on a multiple runs that takes you through a series of randomly generated locations, allowing you to craft a unique build with every playthrough. Killed enemies drop gear and health orbs, similar to top-down ARPGs.
Express Yourself in Combat
During your excursions into the mythical tower, you will acquire dozens of spells and attacks to enhance your combo deck. Whether you favor close-quarters combat, tactical positioning, or commanding arcane forces, the choice is yours.

title: A Deep World
description:
게임 정보
Deep World is a 2D stealth adventure game set in an alien underwater realm. Guide a fragile little creature as it explores, hides, and outmaneuver procedural animated monstrous predators on it quest to rescue a lost friend. Can you navigate the depths and make it back home alive?
Features:
Dynamic Underwater World
Explore a mysterious, alien ocean teeming with life and danger, brought to life with stunning 2D art and procedural animations.
Immersive Stealth Gameplay
Outsmart procedural animated predators by sneaking, hiding, and using your wits to survive.
A cinematic emotional journey
Embark on a heartfelt adventure to reunite with your lost companion and find your way back home.
About the development
Deep World was originally created as project in a game design graduate class at USC Games, in collaboration with students from Berklee School of Music. Later finished and polished for this full release by Jose Striedinger.

title: Emberfall
description:
게임 정보
Emberfall는 첫 번째 Roguevania-Survivor입니다: 롤그라이트, 메트로이드배니아, 서바이벌 요소를 결합한 액션 플랫포머입니다.
위험과 미스터리로 가득 찬 몰락한 성채 'Lemia'의 위험한 지하 미로를 탐험하고 10분 이내에 탈출하거나 영원한 파멸을 맞이하십시오.
Emberfall은 탐욕의 신과 빛의 여신을 물리친 Kali를 조종합니다. 이제 신들은 실패했고, 성채는 붕괴될 것입니다.
강력하고 빠르며, 반응 좋은 조작과 끝없는 도전이 기다립니다.
아이디링 전투 시스템을 즐기며, 적을 피하고 기술을 연마하면서 탈출 방법을 찾으세요.
진행을 위해 특정 기술을 잠금 해제해야 합니다. 메트로이드배니아와 비슷하지만 복잡한 진행이나 월드맵은 없습니다. 짧은 플레이를 즐기세요: 플레이, 죽음, 배우기, 반복.

title: Star Leap
description:
게임 정보
Star Leap is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as posible!
Explore unique and creative mechanics that change the way you move across space.
Get through 8 worlds, each one with different environments, obstacles, and handmade challenges.
Obtain stars by beating levels quickly, and spend them to unlock new characters and color palettes.
Compete for the first place in the leaderboards against friends and the rest of the world.

title: PORADORA vs Monsters of the World
description:
게임 정보
Features
Embark on an adventure across a variety of unique stages set around the world, each reflecting its own distinctive culture and mythology.
Engage in dynamic boss battles that challenge you to utilize the environment to your advantage. Success depends on choosing the right bullets, charging your weapon strategically, and mastering precise timing for jumps and slides.
Discover the fallen heroes of each region as you progress through the stages. By locating their final resting places, you can absorb their powers to aid your journey.
autokwd: PORADORA vs Monsters of the World

title: Station Haven 3
description:
게임 정보
Station Haven 3 is a first-person horror game where you will be playing as the newest crew member aboard the station Haven 3.
As you wake up to the growing sound of an engine, you find yourself aboard a Pod that's about to arrive at Station Haven 3. With no recollection of how you got there in the first place, or even who you are, you unwillingly step onto the Station.
Where is everyone?
Uncover the mystery of the crew's vanishing aboard the station. Find their audio logs and uncover their story, along with their last moments before they disappeared. 
Maintain the ship's usability.
As you uncover the secrets of the Station, you must make sure that it maintains full usability. By using the Terminal aboard the Station, figure out what section of the ship requires your attention and fix the issue before it's too late.
Uncover the secrets of the Station and find out who you are.
Who sent you here? Why were you sent here? Who even are you? Slowly piece together the clues you will find aboard the station and put everything together to figure out what has happened.
Find a way to escape.
Will you be able to find a way to get back home? Is there even a way out?

title: My ranch
description:
게임 정보
This is a farming simulator game!

Here, you need to manage your resources to expand your ranch, raise farm livestock such as chickens, cows, and sheep, and grow a large selection of crops! You can sell your produce for gold to purchase resources and gadgets that will improve your ranch.

As you oversee your ranch, you will also have to take care of yourself, and stay healthy and alive. The game utilizes a dynamic season/weather system, which can interfere with the behavior of certain animals, and the growth of certain crops. There is also a combat system that allows the player to hunt wild animals, and fend off dangerous beasts that might assault your ranch at midnight and eat your livestock (which is also why NOT leaving them wandering outside your ranch at night is a good idea). Lastly, there will also be cute critters who will not-so-cutely eat your crops.

The game allows for multiplayer gameplay, collaborate with your friends to manage the ranch together, hunt or fish for a homemade delicious meal, snuggle with your family cat(s) and dog(s), and much more!

title: Nightmare in the Old Mansion
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a first-person indie horror as you take on the role of John, a real estate agent invited to assess a mysterious old mansion. However, what starts as a simple assessment quickly turns into a desperate fight for survival when John finds himself trapped in a sinister nightmare within the ancient walls of the mansion. Explore the dark secrets, face unknown threats, and uncover the truth behind the mansion's mystery as you struggle for your own life.
"Nightmare in the Old Mansion" is a first-person indie horror game of the walking simulator genre where the average time to complete the game is 50 minutes.
Main Features:
Tense and dynamic atmosphere: Perfect for those seeking an intense and unpredictable horror experience.
Realistic and immersive graphics: Gameplay that makes you feel like you're truly in the mansion.
Intriguing narrative: Explore every corner of the mansion while uncovering its mysteries.
Impactful choices: Each decision can shape the character's fate.
Alternate endings: Your actions can lead to different outcomes.
ADULT CONTENT DESCRIPTION

title: Fearbonding
description:
게임 정보
스토리
Fearbonding (공포의 유대)는 얀데레 x 악마 비엘 호러 비주얼 노벨이다.
공포를 먹어라
얀데레를 길들여라
살아남아라
꿀처럼 달콤하고 끈적한, 그것이 히나타에게 공포의 맛이다. 진정한 공포는 찾기 어렵기 때문에, 코스케를 만난 날, 그의 새로운 목표는 명확해졌다
이 무서운 남자를 길들여야 한다.
히나타가 의심을 받지 않으면서 공포를 수확할 수 있도록 도와라. 미치광이 코스케에게 다가가기 위해 조심스럽게 행동해라. 과연 너는 굶주림을 채울 수 있을까, 아니면 오히려 잠식당하게 될까?
특징
약 14,000단어
다양한 피로 물든 엔딩
비엘 호러 만화에서 영감을 받음
끔찍하고 병적인 BL을 즐기는 이들을 위한 작품
지옥에서 만난 한 쌍
등장인물
히나타 쿠스모토
히나타는 악마지만, 구급대원으로 일한다그래서 인간들의 공포를 먹지만하지만 진정한 공포를 찾기에는 어려웠다그러다가 미치광이 남자 코스케를 만나게 된다.히나타의 목표는 명확하다.이 남자를 길들여야 한다.
코스케 아리마
코스케는 항상 가까운 유대 관계를 갈구했지만 그의 방법은 상대에게 너무 과했다. 하지만 최악의 상태에서 히나타를 만난다. 이 낯선 사람을 믿을 수 있을까? 아니면 또 다시 배신을 당하게 될까?

title: Encounter
description:
게임 정보
As fate would have it, you’ve stumbled upon this game. Might as well give it a try. Who knows what you might encounter… ayyy. Get it? Encounter is the name of the game. When I said, “who knows what you might encounter,” it was a play on words.
So, what’s this Tarot thing about? They represent scenarios where you might have to think on your feet, snack on some magical berries, or even get attacked by a [REDACTED]-eating succubus! Fun! But it's not just fate at play—you’ll need to manage your resources wisely, timing your limited actions perfectly as you navigate a labyrinth of twists and turns, and overcome a host of unpredictable events.
Your adventure kicks off with a single crate. What’s inside? Treasure? Trash? A mildly cursed sandwich? Crack it open and find out! From there, anything goes. You’ll encounter oddballs, outlaws, and outright disasters. Duel the friendly neighborhood postman, accidentally infuriate a small child, or face down ambush after ambush—who’s to say? Will you fight, finesse, or just wing it and pray to the RNG gods? Whatever you do, tread carefully—your journey lasts only as long as you do, and the next tavern might be farther than you expect.

title: Deb
description:
게임 정보
Deforb is a roguelite top-down shooter game where a mad orb defending its tower from endless waves of enemies. Armed with up to 4 melee guns and a long-range gun, the orb uses a combination of close and ranged combat to keep the foes at bay. In addition to powerful weapons, the orb can deploy turrets, strategically placing them to help turn the tide of battle.
As the game progresses, you can upgrade your skills, choosing from a wide range of abilities that enhance your combat effectiveness and defense strategies. The key to survival lies in creating the perfect build, utilizing these upgrades to adapt to the increasingly difficult waves of enemies. Every decision you make — from weapon choice to skill upgrades — will shape your strategy, allowing you to experiment and find the most powerful combinations to protect the tower.

title: Kakurenbo Neko
description:
게임 정보
Kakurenbo Neko는 나무 속에 숨어 있는 장난기 많은 고양이들을 찾아야 하는 귀여운 휴식 게임입니다.



마법 지팡이?
맞아요, 이 마법 지팡이는 근처의 귀여운 고양이들에게 길을 안내해요! 소방서를 부르는 건 잊어버리고, 나뭇잎 사이를 찌르며 그 작은 발랄한 고양이들을 찾아보세요.



이 아늑한 게임은 고양이만의 이야기가 아닙니다!
몇 마리의 치와와가 이 모든 흥분에 휘말렸어요! 그들이 나무 위로 고양이들을 쫓아가고 있을까요?
특징
고양이 수집가
나뭇잎 사이에 숨겨진 50마리의 독특한 고양이들을 구출하세요.
치와와?
게임 내 무작위로 숨겨져 있는 15마리의 귀여운 강아지들을 수집하세요.
레벨
이 게임은 숨바꼭질을 즐길 수 있는 90개의 레벨을 제공합니다.

title: Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story
description:
게임 정보


Sondro Gomez is an aspiring musician trying to make it on his own in Sunova. Unfortunately, his career isn’t going very well, and he’s racked up quite a debt to the mysterious Masked Man. Sondro has little choice but to make a deal with him: If Sondro can find the magic, wish-granting "Mystic Orbs" that have fallen from the stars and landed all across Sunova, the Masked Man won’t continue adding interest to his dues. With little to lose, Sondro turns his guitar strings into "the Barbed-Lasso", and goes out on a quest to acquire treasures and recover the Mystic Orbs!




Guide Sondro through an ancient world of wonder on his journey to overcome his financial woes and discover the dark secrets lurking in the shadows. Sunova is home to many unusual residents who are just as keen to get the Mystic Orbs as he is...




In the action-adventure platformer "Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story", use Sondro's Barbed-Lasso to attack enemies, solve puzzles, even swing and slingshot around obstacles and hazards! Several power-ups appear throughout each level to aid in exploration by providing Sondro with new ways to traverse terrain, defeat enemies, and find hidden treasures:





Is this an unreleased title from 1989, once lost the sands of time and finally dusted off for the world to play? Is it instead a modern labor of love by a young team of developers aiming to authentically re-create the classic feel right down to the pixel? Who knows... (it's probably the latter...)

title: Dewdrop Dynasty
description:
게임 정보
Dewdrop Dynasty is a charming neo-retro Metroidvania that includes cheese mines, power struggles, mecha crabs, and of course lots and lots of combat. And unlike most games in the genre, it features a light-hearted setting filled with strange and wonderful characters. But don't be fooled. There's a much more sinister secret abrew in the world of Underland.
Abilities & Upgrades!
Become stronger and explore deeper with new abilities and weapons.
Exploration!
Navigate your way throughout the interconnecting regions of Underland.
Weird Characters!
Meet a hilarious cast of characters, each with their own unique personalities and quirks.
Drama!
Unlike some Metroidvanias in the genre, Dewdrop Dynasty has a strong focus on dramatic story telling mixed with challenging boss fights.
Boss Battles!
Go head-to-head in intense boss battles, all while unlocking the mysteries behind the alluring Dewdrops.




Dewdrop Dynasty is a fast, charming Metroidvania, but it's not for everyone. In order to know if Dewdrop Dynasty is the right game for you, see if you love any of the points down below. (We wont be offended if you don't)
How Many Of these Points Do You Like?

Platforming
Unlocking Abilities

title: Cell Sword
description:
게임 정보
Cell Sword is a six-degree-of-freedom (6DoF) sci-fi adventure set inside the human body inspired by classic shooters of the 1990s. The full game is an epic single player campaign and story that takes place over 16 unique levels.
Thank you for your interest in our "Cell Sword" medical affiliate program. Here at Mediweapon we value your contributions and we are certainly not a giant evil corporation. After you sign up, we inject a microscopic ship into a patient and rely on you to pilot it around and destroy any virus or disease. It's a great way to save some lives, earn some credits and help build a better future on the ruins of the world we absolutely did not help destroy.
It is the future. Video games are dead. 
War has left the world polluted with microscopic autonomous robots. These drones enter the bloodstream and consume the organs and life-force of their host.
This deadly disease is known as RUST.
Instead of games, players are hired by the rich to remotely pilot fast nanobot crafts to blast the Rust. These guns-for-hire are called Cell Swords.
"It's Descent but inside the human body!" -- Developer
"It's hilarious and dark but also a solid shooter." -- Also the developer
"Have you seen the film Fantastic Voyage? Or Inner Space? No? Yeah, well, I love those too." -- Still the developer
We do original research into the history of games to make interesting projects. Cell Sword is our love letter to the #6DoF subgenre.
Please note: Screenshots and trailer footage are taken from the development version and the final product will look different.
Trailer music is "Spider Pants (with Grace)" by WangleLine.

title: Air Fleet
description:
게임 정보
Airfleet - your own airline is in your hands! Manage every aspect of the business: from thoughtful route planning to precise crew selection, every decision affects the reputation and efficiency of the company.
Create an extensive transportation network, combining major international terminals with cozy provincial airfields. Optimize connections and logistics, turning each airport into a vital hub for your empire.
Choose your strategy: become a leader in mass budget transportation or create an elite service for demanding customers. A variety of classes allows you to customize comfort and pricing, gaining passenger trust and loyalty.

title: Carnival Heroes - Super party minigames
description:
게임 정보
Carnival Heroes is cross-platform online multiplayer board game for 2 to 4 players similar to super mario party.
Inside the game you will enjoy 23 minigames which you play along the main game.
The game can be played in 2 game modes: online (vs real human players or solo (vs AI).
GAMEPLAY
You take turns in an order determined by the biggest dice roll.
On your turn you roll a dice and you use (or not) an item you previously collected.
The goal in the game is to collect as many crowns as possible.
Crowns are bought with gems.  Gems you collect by walking onto the game board, by landing on chests or by winning in minigames.
At the start of the game you choose animal avatar which you will play as.
Each of the 8 avatars comes with a special dice which you can play if you want (you either play the regular 1 to 6 dice or the character special dice).
The game has two main gameplay modes: FREE and FIXED.
In FIXED mode you walk along a fixed routers. But you still choose which direction to go on the intersections.
In FREE mode you draw your exact path on which you player will go. You have to make sure you make most of your path (i.e. it goes through many gems, mates and it lands on a board item.
BOARD ITEMS
Gems. These are diamonds in 3 colors: red = 1 gem, green = 2 gems and blue = 3 gems.
Gems are used to purchase crows or items from the store.
Crowns. This is what you must be aiming to get. Crowns are bought with gems. In the beginning of the game 1 crown costs 10 gems..but as the game progresses they will become more and more expensive (15 or 20 gems).
Mates. Mates are special animal friends which will follow you onto the game board and will give you gems for each player you jump over (i.e. pass through its place). 
Each mate you have, will give you additional big dice that you can roll instead of the regular 1 to 6 dice. Moreover, mates have their own small dice that they will roll with you and it will be added to your dice value.

title: Ogrüuk
description:
게임 정보
Ogrüuk is a 3D platformer stealth game where ogres have captured all your dogs! You must save them before their cooking pot is at the right temperature!
Sneak between monsters and keep away from their lights or you'll also be their dinner!
Key features:
Stealth: sneak between ogres and cursed lamps
Mystical powers: run faster or be invisible for a short period of time!
Hide from the light by crouching down.
Multiple levels with increasing difficulty
Many dogs to save!
Explore a dangerous and mysterious world

title: Superstore Rush
description:
게임 정보
Superstore Rush, the ultimate store management game that lets you build, expand, and thrive in your very own bustling superstore! Developed by Shantek, this engaging game combines strategy, resource management, and fast-paced problem-solving to deliver a fun and rewarding experience.
Whether you’re restocking shelves, upgrading departments, or managing your growing customer base, Superstore Rush offers endless excitement and opportunities to grow your dream store. Are you ready to rise to the challenge and become the ultimate store manager?
Best of all, Superstore Rush is free to play and new content is added regularly!
Start small with basic shelves and work your way up to unlocking an array of departments, including groceries, fridges, freezers, deli cabinets, electronics, clothing, and even a mini-restaurant! Expand your store and serve waves of eager customers to maximize sales and profits.
But running a superstore isn’t just about stocking shelves. You'll face dynamic challenges such as spills, power outages, machine maintenance, unruly customers, and more. Keep your store running smoothly by solving problems quickly and efficiently. Every decision you make shapes your store's success.
Have feedback or suggestions for the game? Jump on the community Discord to share!

title: Lunars
description:
게임 정보
루나스는 별들의 힘으로 생명을 얻은 귀여운 십이지 봉제 인형입니다. 사람들이 보지 않을 때 세상을 탐험하며 신나는 시간을 보내죠. 온라인에서 좋아하는 띠의 루나스가 되어 개성 넘치는 8인 멀티플레이로 다채로운 게임판과 흥미진진한 미니 게임을 즐기며 온갖 장난을 펼쳐보세요. 최신 업데이트 및 출시 정보를 받으려면 찜하기를 눌러주세요.


다양한 플레이 스타일과 자유로운 게임 옵션:
* 블리츠 모드: 게임판이 실시간 전장으로 변합니다. 모두가 동시에 주사위를 굴리고 아이템을 마음껏 사용하며, 다른 플레이어의 턴을 기다릴 필요가 없습니다.
* 일반 모드: 전통적인 파티 보드 게임 스타일로 돌아가며 주사위를 굴리고, 턴이 끝나면 미니 게임에서 경쟁합니다.
* 미니 게임 모드: 끊임없이 이어지는 미니 게임으로 쉴 새 없이 액션을 즐길 수 있습니다.


는 전통적인 파티 보드 게임처럼 차례를 을 없애고 을 선사합니다. 전통적인 턴 기반 모드는 여전히 옛날 방식의 재미를 제공하며, 새로운 블리츠 모드는 빠른 플레이를 가능하게 합니다.

This game is a partially text game where you can wander freely in nature and in the village of Iskelonia.

- Some residents are merchants and buy categories of objects linked to their profession or passion
- A randomly generated terrain system with objects and animals to find

title: Kami: Parade of Senses
description:
게임 정보
Note: The description is not finished and will be edited in the process of development. This also applies to the list of localisations.

A Non-linear Visual Novel with Point & Click elements. Visit 10 main (and ??? secret ) locations, complete tasks and choose your path. Don't forget to keep an eye on your stress level, otherwise you might say something wrong.


The second half of the XX century. The Kami Order, a religious organization with unknown motives, is gaining popularity in many countries. At the same time, rumours about revival of disastrous state experiment are circulating around. You are Subject Number 0 (referred as S-0) and you have been forced to participate in this study. Whether to follow the authors' script or try to break out of it is only up to you. Or perhaps you'd risk to get to the bottom of it?


- The Kami Space is a terrifying and cruel place where losing your mind is especially easy. Keep an eye on your stress level and recover using cigarettes, alcohol or... hugs?
- It's hard to say anything sensible when your hands are shaking, isn't it? As your stress level rises, you are more likely to choose the wrong answer. Watch out, as it can play a bad joke at a crucial moment.
- Protagonist's worldview changes due to the stress level. This can open new dialogue options, quests, or even locations.
- Each task can be completed in 2-3 ways.
- The game has two main endings (and ??? secret ones), which depend on... a lot of things.

title: Mystical Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Mystical Tactics is a turn-based tactical-RPG roguelike in which you control a squad of adventurers in a mystical world. Train your heroes in fast-paced tactical battles, equip them with powerful items and lead them to repel the Dark Lord and his legions.
Key features
Roguelike Gameplay: Every playthrough is a new adventure, with procedurally generated dungeons, encounters, and challenges.
Tactical Combat: Engage in intense turn-based battles where positioning, timing, and resource management are key to survival. Develop unique strategies to overcome formidable foes, from cunning goblins to ancient dragons.
Deep Character Progression: Customize your heroes with a wide variety of classes, abilities, and equipment. Experiment with different builds and synergies to find the perfect combination for your playstyle.
Unlockables and Secrets: Unlock new classes, items, and abilities with every single run. Uncover hidden paths and secret areas to unravel the mysteries of this world.

title: Final Forge
description:
게임 정보
마법 망치로 타워를 방어하고 요새 주변의 자원을 최대한 빨리 찾아내세요. 적의 파도가 절차적으로 생성되는 이 타워 디펜스에서 모든 적을 파괴하거나 죽을 때까지 공격으로부터 자신을 보호하고 무기를 만들고 업그레이드할 수 있는 더 나은 방어를 구축하세요.

타워를 방어하세요:
대포를 제어하고, 힘과 제작 무기를 업그레이드하여 타워를 공격하기 위해 절차적으로 생성되는 적의 파도로부터 자신을 방어하세요. 난쟁이의 보물을 훔치지 마세요!
자원을 수집하세요:
요새 주변에서 귀중한 자원을 수집하여 방어를 업그레이드하거나 공격으로부터 회복하세요.
운반할 수 있는 양과 시간에 주의하세요. 탐사 중에 적들이 공격하거나 무방비 상태에서 타워를 파괴할 수 있습니다.

획득한 자원으로 무기를 만들고 업그레이드하고, 여러 적의 약탈자 명령에 맞서고, 자원 수집을 개선하여 모든 적을 파괴할 때까지 살아남으세요.
자원을 수집하는 동안에는 도망쳐서 요새로 돌아갈 수만 있으며, 적들이 당신을 이기기 위해 쫓아올 수 있으니 조심해서 요새로 도망쳐서 적으로부터 자신을 보호하세요.

모두 파괴하세요!

title: Aureole - Wings of Hope
description:
게임 정보
플랫폼 게임을 천국의 높이로!
최고 속도의 후광이 되어 보세요! Ramila와 Ryleth의 고유한 물리 기반 플랫폼 게임에서 악마의 세력으로부터 고향을 되찾기 위한 여정에 함께하세요.
이 천상의 모험에서 속도와 정확성이 하나가 됩니다!
움직임 기술을 시험하고 초음속 속도로 달릴 수 있도록 설계된 레벨을 질주하며, 만족스럽고 빠른 조작감을 활용해 보세요.
악마 왕으로부터 집을 구하세요
악마들이 지하세계로 추방된 지 수 세기가 지난 후, 천국 왕국에 새로운 위협이 다가옵니다. 악마 군대는 자칭 악마 왕 라젤의 지휘 아래 이전보다 강력한 모습으로 돌아왔으며, 천사들의 왕국을 영원히 정복할 준비가 되어 있습니다.
우리의 천사 주인공들인 Ramila와 Ryleth는 침공 중에 천상의 왕국에서 떨어져 인간 세계에 갇히게 되고, 고향으로 돌아가 악마 왕으로부터 되찾겠다는 한 가지 목표를 품습니다!
배우기 쉬우며, 마스터하는 재미가 있습니다!
다양한 색상의 바이옴을 탐험하며 각각의 게임플레이와 메커니즘을 확장하세요!
직관적인 조작법으로 배우기 쉽고, 마스터하기 재미있습니다!

title: Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu
description:
게임 정보
You could say that Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu is like running a marathon while wearing a lobster onesie, dodging exploding melons thrown by other contestants, avoiding ravenous Shiba inu dogs, and being featured on a bizarre Japanese TV gameshow—all at the same time. If you did say that, you’d be absolutely right!
FEATURES:
VERSUS MODE
Choose from the lobster-man J DARWIN, the horned-hoodie Elizabeth Nishibori, the old-man-sailor Zenbei or everyone’s favourite dog-person Snuguru Maestro or create your own crazy character! Once all four humans or CPU are ready the marathon will begin! 
Get to the finish line by diving, dashing, dodging though the crazy obstacle course. Who will make it through the cup-ramen museum unscathed? Which one will duck though the docks in one piece? Use weapons such as the brand new Whirling Cucumber to slap your opponents silly or take crucial shortcuts using the inflatable Pineapple Balloon to leave them for dust!

title: Dustbound
description:
게임 정보
What once was a thriving world is now lost, shattered and forgotten. Dustbound blends strategic deckbuilding with fast-paced bullet-heaven action, delivering a gameplay loop that will keep you on your toes.
Upgrade your cards to create more powerful versions with better stats and effects
Banish cards to gain temporary stat boosts for your character
Create your own unique upgrade pool in every round

title: Secrets of Blackrock Manor - Escape Room
description:
게임 정보
강력한 거물 아우구스투스 블랙록이 숨긴 재산을 찾기 위해 고용되었지만… 그가 숨긴 것은 그것뿐일까?
퍼즐을 해결하세요
저택을 이루는 8개의 탈출 방을 풀기 위해서는 관찰력과 논리적 사고가 필요합니다. 단서와 힌트는 곳곳에 숨겨져 있으니 주의를 기울이세요!
핵심 아이템을 찾으세요
일부 퍼즐은 특정 아이템이 있어야만 해결할 수 있습니다. 때로는 직접 찾아야 하고, 때로는 또 다른 퍼즐을 풀어야만 얻을 수 있습니다.
가족의 비극을 조사하세요

title: Farkle with Friends
description:
게임 정보
🎲 Real Dice, Real Luck!
Welcome to Farkle with Friends—a thrilling multiplayer dice game where physics-based rolling ensures that every outcome is truly random, not just computer-generated. Compete with friends online in fast-paced rounds where every roll could make or break your chances of victory.
🡆 Key Features:
Physics-Based Dice Rolls – No hidden RNG! Your dice roll is completely determined by physics, so every game is fair.
Multiplayer Fun – Play with friends in online matches.
Unique Scoring System – Earn points through special combinations, like sequences, pairs, and high-value rolls.
Risk vs. Reward – Will you play it safe or go for a big gamble? The choice is yours!
Unlockable Dice Skins – Win games, complete challenges, and customize your dice with unique skins!
Custom Dice Rolls – Doubles, triples, and even full six-dice rolls come with their own twists!
Quick & Engaging Matches – Easy to learn, tough to master, and endlessly replayable.
No rigged numbers, no unfair algorithms—just pure skill, luck, and physics. Are you ready to roll?

description:

Typinc. is a roguelike deckbuilding typing game.
Complete typing jobs presented to you to unlock perks which affects the score you make.

Typing stats such as Best Typing Speed, Average of Last 10 and Accuracy. 
Roguelike Deckbuilding
Unlock different perks for different affects

title: Paw Party
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Paw Party: Your AI-Powered Party Playground!
Paw Party is an AI-powered social party game community. Here, players can enjoy online gatherings and play tabletop games not only with real friends but also with AI companions.
- Unmatched Social Gaming with AI Companions
In Paw Party, you can enjoy a unique experience playing party games and online tabletop games with lively AI companions. These AI friends bring warmth, understanding, and energy, creating a social dynamic like no other.

Our AI NPCs are more than just sidekicks; they’re your pets and companions. Chat with them, deepen your bond, and enjoy a friend who’s there for you anytime, anywhere, making every game feel special!
- Game Features
✨ AI-Generated Challenges and Comments, Surprises at Every Turn!

title: Leo: The Square
description:
게임 정보
Leo: The Square is a minimalist 2D platformer that focuses heavily on atmosphere and level design. As players explore various locations, they will encounter diverse challenges, solve puzzles, and interact with unique characters.
Key Features
Varied levels: Each level offers a diverse range of challenges and mechanics, designed to captivate players with unique interactions between light and shadow. From navigating through intricate shadow puzzles to uncovering hidden pathways illuminated by light, players will encounter a variety of intriguing scenarios that keep them engaged and eager to explore further.
Atmospheric music: The game is complemented by a carefully crafted soundtrack that enhances the overall atmosphere and draws players deeper into Leo's world.
Minimalist design: With its minimalist aesthetic, Leo: The Square offers a visually striking experience that leaves a lasting impression. Every aspect of the game's design is meticulously thought out to provide players with a truly unique visual journey.
Compelling storyline: Leo: The Square tells a captivating story as players accompany Leo on his thrilling adventure through a world filled with mysteries and secrets. Along the way, players will become emotionally invested in Leo's journey as they uncover the truth behind his quest.

title: GraeHart
description:
게임 정보
GraeHart is an immersive medieval fantasy 16-Bit RPG, launching as early access in 2025. Step into the role of Percival, a hunter battling to protect his village and uncover dark forces threatening the realm. Explore vast regions, forge alliances, and face challenging enemies in a rich, story-driven world. 
A multiplayer mode with PvP, PvE, in an Arena mode for epic battles will be introduced post-launch, along with guilds for deeper cooperative gameplay. Your choices will shape the fate of GraeHart!

title: Eternal Glory
description:
게임 정보
내게 걸린 미지의 저주는 나의 모든 것을 앗아갔다.
밝았던 성격, 즐겼던 취미, 유쾌했던 아카데미 생활, 그리고…….
사랑하는 부모님마저, 모두.
그 날의 사건이 있은 후 9년.
나는 처음으로 부모님과 함께 살았던 집의 잔해가 남은 터를 찾아갔다.
그리고 그곳에서 마주친 세 남자.
예사롭지 않은 위험한 분위기에 나는 황급히 자리에서 벗어났다.
하지만 얼마 지나지 않아 알게 된 진실은 가히 충격적이었다.
설마 그 세 남자가 신의 조직들의 수장일 줄이야!
심지어 나를 싫어했던 아카데미의 교수가 갑자기 내게 신의 조직에 입단할 수 있도록 추천서를 써준다 한다.
이해할 수 없는 사건들의 연속에 혼란스러운 것도 잠시.
신의 조직을 이끄는 수장이라면 내게 걸린 저주를 풀어줄 수 있지 않을까?
그래서 나는 결심했다.
무슨 수를 써서라도, 그와 대면해서라도 이 저주를 없애버리리라고.
▶캐릭터 소개

title: Evolution adventure
description:
게임 정보
Breeder Simulator: A Game Where Monsters Go on Adventures Themselves
In this game, the player takes control of a base dedicated to raising and crossbreeding monsters. Roads stretch out in all directions from the base, filled with adventures, treasures, and other monsters.
Ran out of monsters? No problem! Skip a day, and new ones will be born in your basement.
Upgrade your base, explore the map, and create the rarest and most valuable monsters.
Planned for release:
A global map packed with quests.
Over 30 base monsters for evolution.
More than 400 types of evolved monsters.
Over 20 hours of gameplay to complete the main story, with endless possibilities for discovering new evolution combinations.
Embark on this evolution adventure and become the ultimate monster breeder!

title: Blasten!!
description:
게임 정보
Blasten!! is a retro styled action side-scroller, hearkening back to the heyday of early console games. Take control of Blasten, an advanced ultra battle bot with a strong sense of right and wrong. Blast your way through challenging platformer levels and take down the nefarious Dr. Kraven and hordes of evil robots!

Features:
An homage to 80s-era side-scrolling shooters!!
Evolving weapons and perks system!!
Challenging platformer levels!!
Beautiful sprite animations and background art!!
Unique robot bosses and sub-bosses!!
No disappearing/reappearing blocks!!
Cursing!!

Some X number of years in the near-future. The world has enjoyed 100 years of peace due to a benevolent and fair world government known as the Peacekeepers. There is very little conflict, and problems that do arise are quickly, wisely, and efficiently dealt with, and everyone leaves happy! On top of that, wondrous future-type technology makes life easier and enjoyable for all citizens, including the invention of robots with free will by the world’s top scientist: Dr. Grey.

However, there are those who are not happy with this peace. The shifty Dr. Kraven decides to hold the PeaceOut Conference, where the world's greatest minds build robots to benefit mankind. Dr. Grey answers the call and invents Blasten, an ultra battle bot with a strong sense of right and wrong.

The conference goes well until the battle robots start going crazy! Dr. Kraven reveals he has taken control of all robots and plans to take over the world!

It's up to Blasten to fight his way through hazardous levels, crazed battle robots, and defeat the evil Dr. Kraven to restore forever peace!

title: SteamMaze
description:
게임 정보
1、 First Impressions of Wasteland World
（1） Special protagonist appears
In this wasteland world, our protagonist has a unique identity - a cyborg. Its body structure cleverly blends mechanical and organic matter, giving the protagonist extraordinary strength and some stunning special abilities through this unique combination.
And the protagonist's' home 'is a train of wasteland. It is not just a simple place to stay, but also a mobile base for the protagonist to embark on an exploration journey. Every time the train departs, the secrets hidden under the wasteland will be revealed one by one.
（2） Danger and opportunity coexist
The entire wasteland world seems to be shrouded in a mysterious and dangerous layer of steam, making it difficult for people to see the whole picture, but they can always feel the dangerous aura hidden in the shadows.
Every exploration is undoubtedly a thrilling adventure. While taking risks, there will also be unexpected gains, such as discovering precious resources, mastering advanced technology, or meeting reliable allies.

title: You Die Today
description:
게임 정보
YOU DIE TODAY
Step into a dungeon-crawling adventure that combines the strategic depth of deck-building with the thrill of rolling dice. Inspired by the magic of tabletop RPGs, this game brings you a unique rogue-like experience where every roll counts.
Key Features:
Deck-Building with a Twist: Collect powerful cards with unique abilities and build your ultimate deck.

title: Forklift Driving Simulator VR
description:
게임 정보
Forklift is a useful and powerful industrial truck used to lift and move materials over short distances, also called lift truck, fork truck, fork hoist, and forklift truck. Forklifts have become an indispensable piece of equipment in manufacturing and warehousing. Along with forklifts, the game also includes pallet trucks, reach trucks, and VNA, allowing you to experience a wide range of industrial equipment.
Up for a real forklift gaming experience? We worked really hard and thoroughly to bring you great forklift simulator realistic graphics in one of the best forklift games, now including pallet trucks, reach trucks, and VNA for a complete experience.
REAL WAREHOUSE EXPERIENCE Not only do you need to ride the forklift, but you'll also need to manually move boxes like in a real warehouse. Be careful in how you manage the forklift; you can cause different problems in this realistic experience. Plus, there's a free-room where you can choose 'Mission Generate Random,' and a truck will arrive to unload or load pallets, adding an extra layer of excitement.

title: Secret Paws - Cozy Offices
description:
게임 정보
Secret Paws - Cozy Offices는 3D 숨은그림찾기 게임으로, 아늑한 사무실에 숨겨진 고양이를 찾는 것이 당신의 임무입니다.

서랍과 캐비닛을 열고 물건을 움직여 가장 예상치 못한 숨겨진 장소를 발견하세요. 사무실의 모든 구석에는 놀라움과 도전이 가득하며, 세밀하게 설계된 아이소메트릭 3D 환경을 탐험할 수 있습니다.
특징
혁신적인 3D 숨은그림찾기: 클래식 탐험 메커니즘과 아이소메트릭 3D 환경을 결합한 혁신적인 게임. 🚀
거의 500마리의 숨겨진 고양이: 모든 색상, 크기 및 성격의 고양이를 찾아보세요. 😺
비밀 고양이: 독특한 숨겨진 장소에서 특별한 고양이를 발견하세요. 💡
세부적인 상호작용: 가구를 열고, 물건을 움직이고, 환경과 상호작용하세요. 😻
힌트 시스템: 어려울 때는 랜덤 고양이를 강조하는 힌트를 사용하세요. 🔎

Sled Together is just a cozy place to spend some time with your friends

SLED SLED SLED!

Hats

title: 燈吉診療所 Hiyoshi Clinic

The protagonist, journalist Eiji Sakuma, visits the attraction for a report and finds himself immersed in a series of terrifying performances that seem far too real. Guided by a child's voice, he begins to experience strange phenomena.
Explore a haunted mansion set in a 1940s setting in FPS mode.
The eerie interior has been renovated while still retaining some of its original appearance.

title: Hexbound
description:
게임 정보
아늑하고 편안한 경험. 육각형 기반 보드에 도형을 배치하며 만족스러운 퍼즐을 풀고 복잡한 이미지 도전을 해결하세요. 타이머도, 압박도 없습니다—그저 나만의 속도로 퍼즐을 즐길 수 있습니다.
🟡 직관적이고 몰입감 있는 게임플레이
다양한 보드 레이아웃에 도형을 배치하고 패턴을 완성하며 이미지 기반 퍼즐을 해결하세요. 각 보드는 새로운 도전을 제공하여 흥미롭고 보람찬 경험을 선사합니다.
🌟 다양한 보드 & 도전 과제
다양한 보드 형태와 독창적인 퍼즐이 준비되어 있어, 매번 새로운 도전을 경험할 수 있습니다. 조각을 맞추거나 이미지를 완성하는 모든 과정이 편안하면서도 몰입감을 제공합니다.

title: Rope It Two
description:
게임 정보
Rope It Two
여러분과 친구들을 위한 와일드한 협동 파티 플랫폼 게임!
1-8인 플레이 광란
최대 8명의 플레이어와 팀을 이루거나 경쟁하며 혼란스러운 멀티플레이어 재미를 즐기세요!

title: Dice With The Universe
description:
게임 정보
Play dice with the Universe. Wield the fundamental forces of physics to control the Universe... and to shape what the next iteration of reality will be. A strategic rogue-like dice-battler with deckbuilding elements where you balance your skills against your luck.
Take the role of a Universal Concept who shapes the very fabric of reality with the power of one of the fundamental forces of physics-- weak, strong, electromagnetic and gravity. Each power provides a distinct and unique playstyle, moveset and dice with special abilities.
Each run crosses the lifespan of the entire Universe, from the Big Bang up until the Big Crunch when the Universe collapses back in on itself, ready to be born again. Your victory or defeat determines your position during the next iteration of the Universe (the next run); when the rules of physics are written during the first Plank epoch, your performance in the previous run will influence reality itself to be favorable to your chosen force. Earn powerful Universal Laws that give you significant bonuses, unique abilities, and change the very rules of the game itself.
Face off against the other fundamental forces in a series of dice-based battles. Your moveset determines the dice outcomes that earn you points (such as straights, of-a-kinds, specific sums, etc). After each roll a decision must be made: will you stay safe and keep the points you have earned-- or roll your remaining dice for more points, but risk not gaining more, and instead losing everything collected so far.
As the four forces struggle eternally as the Universe itself is born and reborn-- could a fifth, previously unknown force arise, looking to permanently break this cycle for it's own malevolent benefit?

title: Fairy Tale TD 2 童话塔防2
description:
게임 정보
동화탑방어는 3D 만화풍의 탑방어게임으로서 게임에는 많은 관문이 있는데 매 관문마다 게임을 시작할 때 소량의 자원을 주어 몬스터를 처치하면 더욱 많은 자원을 얻을수 있다.
게임에서 각 몬스터의 생명치와 이동 속도가 다릅니다. 몬스터가 에너지 보호막을 가지고 있을 때 생명치가 높아집니다. 호박포탑은 에너지 보호막을 가진 몬스터에게 추가 데미지를 입힙니다.
피쳐:
6 가지 승급 가능한 방어포탑
16종 몬스터(일반 몬스터 8종 + 보호막이 있는 일반 몬스터 8종)
25개 관문
autokwd: Fairy Tale TD 2 童话塔防2

title: Spring Tales
description:
게임 정보
Spring Tales welcomes you to Blossomdale a cozy town where the community is coming together to prepare for a spring festival after a devastating storm. The festival isn’t just a celebration of the new season, it’s a way for the townspeople to heal, rebuild, and lift each other’s spirits.
You’ll follow the lives of five unique characters as they navigate the challenges of recovery and festival preparation. You’ll help them solve puzzles and discover their stories along the way. It’s a game about friendship, teamwork, and the simple joys of coming together after hard times.

title: EYES ON THE EXAM
description:
게임 정보
Keep your eyes on the exam... Study the environment, answer the questions before time runs out, find secrets in the classroom and don't even think about looking directly at that... thing.
Improve your score in every game
Uncover dark secrets hidden in the classroom
Enjoy a 100% diegetic horror experience
You wake up at your desk in a dreary classroom run by a monstrous teacher. Your goal is to correctly answer as many questions as possible on the exam in front of you. How can you know the answers? Look around you, look at your classmates' exams, strain your eyes and study your surroundings...
But be careful, don't let the teacher catch you with your eyes off the exam or failing will be the least of your problems....

title: Alien Market Simulator
description:
게임 정보
은하 경찰에게 보석금을 내고 기회를 얻었습니다. 하지만 조건이 있습니다. 당신은 먼 미지의 행성에 있는 우주 정거장을 관리해야 합니다.
그러나 이것이 당신이 꿈꾸던 자유는 아닙니다. 매일 정거장의 시스템에 접속하여 당신의 가치를 증명해야만 합니다. 주어진 임무를 완수해야만 완전한 자유를 되찾을 수 있습니다.
우주 정거장을 수리하고 운영하며 관리하세요.
외계 여행자들에게 간식과 연료 같은 필수 서비스를 제공하세요.
크레딧을 벌어 정거장을 확장하고 자신만의 스타일로 커스터마이징하세요.
그러나 조심하세요—자유로 가는 길은 도전, 수상한 기회, 그리고 끝없는 외계인 손님들로 가득 차 있습니다.
우주 정거장을 관리하세요:
활기찬 외계 시장을 운영하면서 정거장을 수리하고 업그레이드하세요.
외계 여행자들에게 간식, 연료, 다양한 상품을 제공하는 필수 방문지로 만드세요.
정거장을 청소하고 유지보수하세요:
깨끗하고 제대로 작동하는 정거장을 유지하면 외계인 손님들이 좋은 경험을 하게 됩니다.
정거장이 청결할수록 더 많은 손님들이 다시 방문할 것입니다.

title: Motocross Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Motocross Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1980s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 15 motocross bikes from 40 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your motocross bike with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

title: Spin Forward
description:
게임 정보
잠에서 깨어나자, 당신은 Slot 대륙으로 전송되었습니다. 슬롯머신과 당신의 운에 의지해 Slot 대륙의 모험에서 죽거나 더 부유하고 강해질 것입니다.
저희는 Luck Be a Landlord와 Slay the Spire의 게임 메커니즘을 결합했습니다. 적들은 강력하며, 패배하면 게임이 끝납니다.
게임 중에는 강력한 상징과 신비로운 유물을 얻게 되며, 각 상징은 고유한 속성을 지니고, 유물은 다양한 특이한 효과를 가지고 있습니다.
Spin을 클릭하여 모험을 시작하세요!
특징:
다양한 능력을 가진 심볼과 유물을 모으고 조합하여 모험의 길에서 몬스터와 보스를 처치하세요.
Spin을 클릭하여 슬롯 머신을 시작하고 랜덤으로 심볼 조합을 생성하세요. 다양한 유물과 결합하면 공격력과 방어력이 달라집니다.
특정 심볼을 사용하여 적에게 특별한 효과를 발생시킬 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 양치기 지팡이는 적을 양으로 변하게 만들 수 있습니다.
각각의 플레이는 독특한 경험을 제공합니다. 다양한 심볼과 유물을 발견하고, 다양한 적과 사건을 만나며, 새로운 놀라움을 경험하세요.

title: Carnal Sins: Malum Incarnatum + Carne Vescens
description:
게임 정보
"With the sin of the flesh every man is born, thus does each soul yearn for love.
But should love be won but once and then lost, even the soul of a righteous heart may succumb to sin."
Experience two short but unique psychological horror games in one horrific package. Dive into the twisted perceptions of love from two lost souls:

"Malum Incarnatum"
Descend into human hell and unravel a life torn apart by the desire to love and be loved. Even if this longing for love only leads to evil growing inside one man's heart.
"Carne Vescens"
Trapped in her apartment, a mother finds herself unable to keep her insatiable baby fed. So she decides to feed her baby the only bit of food she has left: Herself.
Both games feature:
Unique surreal horror experiences.
Graphics inspired by late 90s PSX-games.
Full Motion Videos (FMVs) and voice acting.
Full controller support (XInput).
A hidden mystery to uncover.
autokwd: Carnal Sins: Malum Incarnatum + Carne Vescens

title: Crypt Robbery
description:
게임 정보
크립트 로버리(Crypt Robbery)는 1인 개발자가 제작한 슈팅 게임과 호러 요소가 혼합된 게임입니다. 고전 FPS 게임에서 영감을 받은 Crypt Robbery는 잊을 수 없는 저녁이나 으스스한 밤에 완벽한 독특하고 스릴 넘치는 모험을 제공합니다!
당신은 필요에 따라 훔치는 초보 도둑으로 플레이합니다. 이번에는 누군가가 당신을 고용하여 지하실에서 유물을 찾았습니다. 그러나 지하실에 들어가자마자 시간과 피가 필요하다는 것을 깨닫게 됩니다.

title: Bam Bam Boom
description:

Experience the thrill of combat with a unique roster of characters, each with their own technical and thoughtful move sets designed for both casual players and competitive fighters alike. Master your character’s abilities and outplay your opponents in intense platform battles.

Whether you're battling friends locally or challenging players online, Bam Bam Boom offers endless fun and competitive game play.
