title: Sheep Sweep
description:
게임 정보
오래 전 칼라와 에리스는 화목하게 살았어요. 하지만 구피 토네이도의 공격으로 모든 것이 바뀌었죠. 구피 토네이도는 양들을 전 세계로 휩쓸고 갔고, 양들을 구하기 위해 칼라와 에리스 두 목자만 남았죠. 양치기들은 매우 회복력이 뛰어나지만, 누군가를 구하기까지 많은 어려움을 겪어야 합니다. 여러분은 이 모험을 감당할 만큼 용감한가요?






팀워크와 소통이 게임의 장애물을 극복하는 데 핵심이 되는 로컬 2인 협동 게임플레이에 참여하세요.




아름답게 제작된 싱글 플레이어 모드에서 혼자서 칼라 또는 에리스가 되어 독특한 도전과 퍼즐을 해결해 보세요.




영웅이 되어 마을에서 길을 잃고 구조를 기다리는 양들을 찾아 구하는 퀘스트를 수행하세요.




불타는 지형을 전략적으로 탐색하고, 도구와 영리한 사고로 불길을 관리하고 진압하세요.




모든 도전을 즐거운 실수로 바꿔주는 재미있는 물리와 래그돌 효과와 함께 웃어보세요.




예술적으로 풍부한 환경을 가로지르며 각 섬마다 퍼즐만큼이나 독특한 시각적 즐거움을 선사합니다.



- 2인 로컬 협동 플레이
- 솔로 플레이
- 재미있는 물리학과 래그돌
- 퍼즐을 풀고 양을 위험에서 구하세요!
- 가연성 및 소화성 세계
- 리더 보드
- 이스터 에그 수집
- 키보드 및 컨트롤러 지원
- 매우 광범위한 지원

title: Galactic Tavern
description:
게임 정보
우주 술집을 건설하고 관리하며 우주로 떠나는 여정을 떠나보세요! 이국적인 재료를 발견하고, 독특한 칵테일을 만들고, 라이브 음악 공연으로 활기찬 분위기를 조성하세요. 우주의 심연을 탐험하며 이 경영 시뮬레이션 모험에서 궁극의 기업가가 되어보세요!
위시리스트!
오늘 위시리스트에 추가하고 게임 개발에 대한 업데이트를 팔로우하세요.


Galactic Tavern에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 여기서 당신은 당신만의 성간 바를 건설, 관리 및 확장할 수 있는 궁극의 우주 모험을 경험할 수 있습니다. 우주의 생생한 한 구석에 위치한 Galactic Tavern은 은하계에서 가장 유명한 술집 주인이 되기 위한 여정에 당신을 초대합니다.

주요 특징:

🌌 우주 술집 커스터마이징: 우주 술집을 디자인하고 커스터마이징하여 은하계 전체에서 고객을 유치하세요.

🌟 이국적인 믹솔로지: 우주 모험에서 발견한 희귀 재료를 사용하여 다양한 우주 칵테일을 만들어 제공하세요.

👨‍🌾 우주 농업: 신선한 재료를 재배하여 음료와 요리에 사용할 수 있는 우주 농장을 직접 관리하세요. 고객에게 최상의 품질을 제공합니다.

🚀 은하 탐험: 새로운 레시피, 재료 및 보물을 발견하기 위해 용감한 탐험가들을 무모한 임무에 보내세요.

🎵 엔터테인먼트 스펙터클: 재능 있는 밴드의 라이브 음악 공연으로 고객을 즐겁게 하고 전기 같은 분위기를 만드세요.

💫 제국 확장: 시설을 업그레이드하고 시설을 확장하며 은하계 전체에서 새로운 고객을 유치하여 술집 제국을 확장하세요.

모험을 경험하세요:

Galactic Tavern은 경영 시뮬레이션, 탐험 및 우주 모험의 독특한 조합을 제공합니다. 칵테일을 만들거나 외계의 미식을 발견하거나 새로운 영토를 탐험하는 등, 이 우주적 여정에서 당신의 창업 및 발견을 경험할 수 있습니다.

여정을 시작하세요:

궁극의 우주 술집 모험을 시작할 준비가 되었나요? 재료를 모으고, 음악을 준비하고, Galactic Tavern에서 잊지 못할 여정을 떠나보세요!

title: Meat Fest
description:
게임 정보
Meat Fest is a dynamic shooter with soulslike elements, arenas and corridors, secrets, traps and its own story. Built on the foundation of good old shooters, it raises the social problems of society.

To answer questions you will have to use a wide arsenal of weapons, an ax, and a suit to protect and dodge fatal blows and dangerous fauna. Collect the story piece by piece to get to the truth, which, as always, lurks somewhere nearby.
STORY
Humanity was forced to leave their home planet and settle on Radix, where leaders tell new generations that the Earth was destroyed as a result of natural disasters. Combat geneticist Marcus Berger, studying samples from the homeland of people, begins to realize how false such statements about the death of the world are. He becomes increasingly immersed in the search for truth and reaches out to black market dealers, consisting mainly of the opposition. His native corporation begins to see him as a dangerous unit and Marcus escapes from Radix, deciding to find answers on Earth. The player will have to face the current inhabitants of the cradle of humanity and find evidence of the theory of a man-made disaster, because of which the world has turned into hell.
MORE
Combine your attacks

title: T.D.Z. 4 Heart of Pripyat
description:
게임 정보
You have to go through this difficult path from a beginner to a seasoned stalker and uncover the mystery of your own father's disappearance!
T.D.Z. 4 The Heart of Pripyat is a game that will draw you in with its amazing atmosphere from the first seconds! Gray sky, rain, campfire dialogues with loyal stalker friends, mutants, anomalies are just a small part of what awaits you in this 1st-person action-adventure shooter! Explore the abandoned locations of the mysterious Exclusion Zone, shoot back mutants, search caches of ammunition and food, complete tasks of stalker friends and reach the very Pripyat to see the finale of this amazing story!
►Game Features◄
☢️ Freedom of action! You can explore the stunning beauty of the location, as well as complete the tasks of other stalkers, earning new equipment!
☢️ A large selection of items! 7 types of weapons, bolts, grenades, first aid kits, anomaly detectors, food and much more in your arsenal for survival in a dangerous zone!
☢️ A mixture of genres in one bottle! Horror, Survival, Action Shooter in one game and at once!
☢️ Convenient controls will appeal to everyone!
☢️ Stunning graphics!
☢️ Dynamic storyline!

title: VTumbler
description:
게임 정보
VTumbler brings your favorite Oshi to the world of Arcade Puzzle Fighting! Brought to you by FeFe and friends, you can compete for the strategic win with your friends, random strangers, or train with a CPU!

title: Sinned Arena
description:
게임 정보
Sinned Arena is a classic arena shooter inspired by timeless 90s games. You are trapped in Hell with other unfortunate souls, fighting among each other for demons twisted pleasures. Fight for your way out of this dark place but beware, demons aren't there just to watch.
Single player

Engage in Single player in two different ways:
Play Campaign mode where you go through predefined Deathmatch maps with progressively increasing difficulty of your opponents.
Play Skirmish mode where you can tailor the gameplay experience to your liking. You can choose game mode, map, score goal, number of opponents and their skills. You can also spice up your experience with Mutators that are adding various modifiers to the game.

Game modes

The game offers 5 game modes: Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Heartcore, Instagib and Team Instagib

Deathmatch is a classic Free For All mode, where you are winning by being first to get required amount of kills.
Team Deathmatch is a team variant of Deathmatch mode where goal is again reaching required amount of kills but score of your teammates counts as well.

Heartcore is a team mode where goal is to destroy a heart inside of enemy base. First team to destroy enemy heart wins.

Instagib a Team Instagib are similar to Deathmatch or Team Deatchmatch modes but this time, you only have one weapon at your disposal and it turns your opponents into bunch of gibs with a single shot.


Throughout the game, you are collecting all sorts of weapon relics and character relics. Weapon relics serves as a way to make your weapons more powerful or even change their functionality entirely while character relics are giving you unique bonuses to your character or upgrading your base stats. There are several ways to obtain relics such as challenging your opponents to a duel. Winning in a duel will give you opponent's relic but be careful, opponents can challenge you for your own relic as well.

title: The Schism
description:
게임 정보
현실 사이에 균열이 생겼고 그들은 이를 분열"이라고 부릅니다. The Schism은 1~8인용 온라인 협동 공포 게임으로, 여러분과 과학자 팀은 정부의 봉쇄 계획을 지원하기 위해 유용한 정보를 수집해야 합니다. 귀하의 팀은 손상된 위치에 들어가 중요한 정보를 수집하는 작업을 시작합니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 당신은 혼자가 아닙니다.

\r\n\r\n목표[\/b]\r\n\r\n

명망 높은 과학자 팀의 일원으로서 당신은 수많은 목표를 완수해야 하는 임무를 맡게 될 것입니다. 감시 설정부터 샘플 수집까지 매번 독특한 게임플레이 경험을 선사할 것입니다. 당신의 팀은 스텔스와 강철의 신경이라는 중요한 기술을 숙달해야 합니다. 적을 피하고 숨어서 성공하세요.

\r\n\r\n고유한 야수[\/b]\r\n\r\n

고유한 몬스터의 수가 증가함에 따라 The Schism을 플레이할 때마다 새로운 만남과 함께 새로운 두려움에 직면하게 됩니다. 변신부터 지능, 순수한 힘과 힘까지, 게임플레이를 항상 신선하게 보장하는 무한한 잠재적 시나리오가 있습니다.

\r\n\r\n지도[\/b]\r\n\r\n

여기 는 수많은 새로운 위치에 대한 계획과 함께 잠재적인 공포의 놀이터 목록이 점점 늘어나고 있습니다.
\r\n\r\n멀티플레이어[\/b]\r\n\r\n

친구들과 함께 게임을 경험해 보세요! 팀워크가 기회를 높일 뿐만 아니라, 친구의 불행한 죽음으로 인한 히스테리보다 더 우스꽝스러운 것은 없습니다.

\r\n\r\n계획[\/b]\r\n\r\n

엄청난 계획이 있습니다. 분열을 위해. 새로운 몬스터, 지도, 작업. 이름을 정할 수 있다면 우리가 계획한 것입니다. 새로운 콘텐츠가 기본이 될 것이므로 이 게임에 대한 투자는 안심하셔도 됩니다. 새로운 추가 사항에 대한 아이디어가 있으시면 Steam 리뷰 섹션을 통해 문의해 주세요."

title: Lunaria Fantasia
description:
게임 정보
The magic kingdom’s court magician, Lunaria, is tasked with her allies to investigate a certain ruin. But when the party gets ambushed by some mysterious men, Lunaria’s magic gets stolen and she’s left with no powers!

When it’s discovered that Lunaria’s magic won’t recover naturally, she falls to utter despair. But not all hope is lost. Elder magicians speak of five great magicians and their prized treasures. If Lunaria can get her hands on those treasures, then her magic may recover! To help her friends and save herself, Lunaria ventures off on an adventure unlike any other!
Features:
Classic RPG Experience
Turn-based Combat
Leveling System
Skill System
Fantasy Setting

title: Hellfire: Wukong
description:
게임 정보
비범한 웅장함, 무한한 환상
환상적인 풍경, 전례 없는 광경, 현실이자 환상인 이 동양의 마법의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 운명의 사람으로서 당신은 서쪽으로 향하는 이상한 여행을 떠나게 될 것이며, 모든 단계는 새로운 놀라움과 도전을 가져올 것입니다. 아직 밝혀지지 않은 비밀을 탐험하고 장대한 모험 전설을 다시 써보세요.
마족들이 다시 나타나고, 마족들이 격렬하게 춤을 추고 있습니다.
유명한 여행자, 교활하고 변덕스러운 마왕. 서쪽으로 가는 길에는 아름다운 풍경뿐만 아니라, 수많은 강력한 적들이 당신의 도전을 기다리고 있습니다. 운명의 사람은 마지막 순간까지 이 길에서 수많은 몬스터와 몬스터들과 치열한 결투를 벌이게 된다.
땅이 흔들리고 산이 흔들리고 신통한 힘이 나타났습니다.
불멸의 기술을 배우고 무한한 변화를 배웠습니다. 다채로운 주문과 마법의 보물은 중국 신화에서 가장 고전적인 전투 요소를 구성합니다. 데스티니드 원은 다양한 스틱 스킬을 습득할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 다양한 주문, 변화, 재능, 무기, 방어구를 자유롭게 조합하여 자신에게 가장 적합한 전투 스타일을 찾을 수 있습니다.
모든 것은 끊임없이 변화하며 영혼을 감동시킵니다.
6가지 형태, 6가지 무기, 6가지 형태 및 6가지 감정. 적들의 교활함과 사악함은 표면에만 있을 뿐이며, 그들 뒤에 숨겨진 이야기는 종종 더 매력적입니다. 치열한 전투 외에도 데스티니는 다양한 캐릭터의 배경 이야기를 탐색하고 그들의 감정과 동기를 이해하며 그들의 사랑과 증오, 탐욕과 분노, 과거와 현재의 삶을 드러낼 것입니다.

title: DeadWire
description:
게임 정보
네온 빛이 가득한 사이버펑크 도시의 어둠 속으로 뛰어드세요, DeadWire—모든 적은 기회가 되고, 모든 물체는 무기가 됩니다.
빚쟁이지만 능숙한 해커인 당신은 자라온 고아원을 위협하는 강력한 범죄 조직을 무찔러야 합니다. 빠르게 전개되는 탑다운 슈터에서 최첨단 무기와 독특한 리와이어 모드로 전세를 역전시킬 수 있습니다.
DeadWire를 위시리스트하고 여러 소식을 받아보세요 (1인 개발자를 응원해주세요<3).
전장을 "리와이어" 하세요
리와이어 모드를 사용해 적, 차량 및 디바이스를 해킹하고 링크해 강력한 연쇄 반응을 일으키세요:
연쇄 반응: 경비를 근처 차량과 링크하세요—경비를 무력화하면 차량이 시동을 걸고 적을 쓸어버립니다.
디바이스 해킹: 오락기, ATM, 레이저 함정을 해킹해 적들을 상대로 활용하세요.
전략적 게임플레이: 주변의 여러 물체를 이용해 불리한 상황을 뒤짚어 적을 농락하세요.

title: Skyline Savior
description:
게임 정보
Get ready to dive into the high-speed, action-packed world of Skyline Savior!

Take control of Sam’s car and navigate through a series of exciting and challenging environments. With a unique set of abilities at your disposal, you’ll need to overcome difficult obstacles to become the ultimate hero of the skies.

Thrilling Gameplay Mechanics

Arcadey Car Movement: Enjoy smooth, responsive driving with the ability to jump, dash, and perform awesome stunts.


Magnet: Use the car’s magnet to interact with various magnets around the map, overcoming obstacles by attracting or repelling the car.


Slow Motion: Slow down time to navigate through tricky sequences and nail those precise maneuvers. You are falling down? Slow the time down so you can afford waiting for the dash cooldown to end.

title: ADA: Tainted Soil
description:
게임 정보
ADA: Tainted Soil is a story-driven adventure filled with unique characters and their own storylines. In this top-down action RPG with fast-paced combat, you’ll fight your way through hordes of diverse enemies with unique behavior and design. Be prepared to explore a vast, cruel world crafted pixel by pixel with passion and love. You’ll unlock and upgrade skills, equip your favorite ones, and forge your character. On your journey, you’ll brew potions and other powerful consumables, and forage land for ingredients to combine them. Remember always to be prepared, as the world around you constantly changes. You never know what you will run into, be it at night or daytime.



"I could swear I knew that forest, but so many things have changed"

The vast and cruel world of Ada is waiting for you to explore. You can choose whichever path you want as long as you can fight your way through encountered enemies. Find all secrets scattered across the land and water, and use the fast travel option to speed up your journey. Find your own way on your journey through carefully handcrafted and designed zones.


Combat in Ada is based on a combination of a basic attack routine with a secondary skill of your choice and potions/consumables. Every fight could end well with proper movement and dodging. Be prepared, observe, adapt, and survive.

Enemies in Ada are carefully designed to bring the highest amount of fair difficulty to the game. They are unique both visually and mechanically. Some will attack you alone with big combos or swings, and others will be fast, agile, and evade your attack, while others may group up to get you with numbers. Prepare for epic encounters with main and side bosses that fit the zone you are exploring.


You'll meet Ada, and as much as you'd want her to have an everyday, happy life, it's not possible in this land, at this time, in this world. Any job would be better than that, but there's no other one for you...

Immerse yourself in a story brimming with mystery and the pangs of solitude. This land is a place of constant surprises, where nothing is as it seems, and everything is a departure from your memories. Engage with the characters, delve into their storylines, and embark on quests. Each one is a unique tale with its own distinct character and appearance.

Traces of the land's history, rich and diverse, can be discovered strewn along your path. Whether in the form of paintings or vivid flashbacks, they reveal ancient battles, transforming dilapidated ruins into majestic castles, or significant historical events that shaped the world you now explore.


Use alchemy to create valuable potions and heal or boost your abilities. Your mixtures can also be thrown at enemies to harm, confuse, stun, or even turn them against each other. Collect herbs, crystals, vials, and other ingredients to create powerful potions. Each comes in different sizes, and the bigger the size, the stronger the explosion.

Potions can also help interact with the environment, burning things down or freezing the water. Who knows what that might mean for you and your exploration of the world of Ada...

title: Spring Tales
description:
게임 정보
Spring Tales welcomes you to Blossomdale a cozy town where the community is coming together to prepare for a spring festival after a devastating storm. The festival isn’t just a celebration of the new season, it’s a way for the townspeople to heal, rebuild, and lift each other’s spirits.
You’ll follow the lives of five unique characters as they navigate the challenges of recovery and festival preparation. You’ll help them solve puzzles and discover their stories along the way. It’s a game about friendship, teamwork, and the simple joys of coming together after hard times.

title: EYES ON THE EXAM
description:
게임 정보
Keep your eyes on the exam... Study the environment, answer the questions before time runs out, find secrets in the classroom and don't even think about looking directly at that... thing.
Improve your score in every game
Uncover dark secrets hidden in the classroom
Enjoy a 100% diegetic horror experience
You wake up at your desk in a dreary classroom run by a monstrous teacher. Your goal is to correctly answer as many questions as possible on the exam in front of you. How can you know the answers? Look around you, look at your classmates' exams, strain your eyes and study your surroundings...
But be careful, don't let the teacher catch you with your eyes off the exam or failing will be the least of your problems....

title: Alien Market Simulator
description:
게임 정보
은하 경찰에게 보석금을 내고 기회를 얻었습니다. 하지만 조건이 있습니다. 당신은 먼 미지의 행성에 있는 우주 정거장을 관리해야 합니다.
그러나 이것이 당신이 꿈꾸던 자유는 아닙니다. 매일 정거장의 시스템에 접속하여 당신의 가치를 증명해야만 합니다. 주어진 임무를 완수해야만 완전한 자유를 되찾을 수 있습니다.
우주 정거장을 수리하고 운영하며 관리하세요.
외계 여행자들에게 간식과 연료 같은 필수 서비스를 제공하세요.
크레딧을 벌어 정거장을 확장하고 자신만의 스타일로 커스터마이징하세요.
그러나 조심하세요—자유로 가는 길은 도전, 수상한 기회, 그리고 끝없는 외계인 손님들로 가득 차 있습니다.
우주 정거장을 관리하세요:
활기찬 외계 시장을 운영하면서 정거장을 수리하고 업그레이드하세요.
외계 여행자들에게 간식, 연료, 다양한 상품을 제공하는 필수 방문지로 만드세요.
정거장을 청소하고 유지보수하세요:
깨끗하고 제대로 작동하는 정거장을 유지하면 외계인 손님들이 좋은 경험을 하게 됩니다.
정거장이 청결할수록 더 많은 손님들이 다시 방문할 것입니다.

title: Motocross Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Motocross Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1980s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 15 motocross bikes from 40 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your motocross bike with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

title: Decide 4 God
description:
게임 정보
Decide 4 God is the final entry of the Abime Series.
One hour.
The woman and her team of investigators had one hour to infiltrate a prison and cause a breakout. Her dearest hope was that, among the prisoners, there would be her brother who disappeared nearly twenty years ago.
She couldn't shake the feeling that something sinister was waiting for her team.
One hour.
The man had been up for one hour, contemplating his past. Everything changed when, one day, around noon, a box with clothing was slid through the opening in the cell door. He was told to put it on if he wanted to escape.
The prisoner obeyed, though something felt wrong. Why was someone breaking him out?
The final chapter in the Abime Series. Decide 4 God contains the entire truth behind the events of both Head AS Code and Birth ME Code. Familiar faces return and new faces emerge to complete the unfortunate cast suffering through over a dozen endings due to the misdeeds of Empathy Systems.
Two sides of the story. You will be able to follow multiple characters as they live out their terrible tale. Side A and Side B have wildly different events making up opposite parts of a whole story.

title: Automate It: Factory Puzzle
description:
게임 정보
Automate It에서 여러분은 창의력과 전략적 사고가 성공의 핵심인 매력적인 산업 자동화의 세계를 만나게 됩니다. 점점 복잡해지는 다양한 도전을 통해 산업 기반 시설을 설계하고 관리하여 생산을 최적화하세요.
본 게임은 전략, 건설, 자원 관리를 결합한 독특한 퍼즐 해결 경험을 선사합니다. 컨베이어 벨트 및 생산 기계에서 엘리베이터 및 파이프까지, 마음껏 사용할 수 있는 다양한 산업 구조를 통해 다가올 도전에 대한 나만의 해결책을 자유롭게 만들고 강화하세요.
창의력과 혁신을 일으킬 수 있도록 플레이어가 각자의 목표를 달성하기 위해 다양한 전략과 접근법을 사용할 수 있습니다. 액체와 기체 등 다양한 자원을 생산하세요!
복잡한 도전: 문제 해결 능력과 전략적 사고를 시험하고 도전 정신을 자극할 다양한 도전을 만나보세요.
만족스러운 진행: 각 도전을 해결하고 매끄럽게 작동하는 나만의 창작물을 확인하며 성취감을 느껴보세요.
반복 플레이할 만한 가치: 다채로운 레벨과 커스터마이징 기능, 무한한 무작위 레벨을 통해 Automate It는 여러 시간에 걸친 즐겁고 지속적인 엔터테인먼트를 선사합니다.

title: Testament of Power
description:
게임 정보
Testament of Power invites players to embrace the role of a tribal member on the culturally rich island of Ambali. Here, power is earned through time-honored traditions, requiring players to undergo initiation trials and challenge creatures native to the island's diverse biomes. By collecting trophies from these powerful beasts, players enhance their attributes and gain unique abilities, reflecting the island's ancient customs and allowing for a flexible and deeply customizable playstyle.

The game features biomes with escalating challenges, where players can battle increasingly difficult creatures and eventually confront Biome Alphas in cooperative gameplay, rewarding them with a rare and powerful trophy. With an emphasis on character building via trophy collection and raid combat, "Testament of Power" offers a unique and immersive experience in a richly detailed world.
Explore on Ambali
The island Ambali is divided into distinct biomes, each showcasing unique elemental wildlife and fauna. Every biome presents its own set of challenges and requires a different strategy to navigate and reach its central core. Adapt your approach to conquer the varying landscapes and uncover the secrets that lie within each biome.
All about Trophies
In "Testament of Power," character progression deviates from traditional RPG mechanics. Instead of leveling up through experience points, players enhance their characters by hunting for trophies. Each trophy not only boosts your attributes but also grants you new abilities. Every creature you encounter possesses a unique set of abilities that can become yours if you claim their trophy and successfully absorb their spiritual mojo through a traditional ritual.

This trophy system allows for complete flexibility in your playstyle, enabling you to tailor your abilities based on the trophies you've earned. Your journey and your power are defined by the creatures you conquer and the trophies you collect.
Conquer the Biomes for the Symbol of Dominance
At the heart of each biome lies the energy core, a sacred artifact fiercely guarded by a powerful beast known as the biome alpha. To challenge this alpha, players must partake in a specific ritual called Madilka. This prepared event reflects the natural cycle of replacing the old alpha with a new, younger one. During this event, players have the opportunity to defeat the reigning alpha beast and earn the rare and powerful trophy - the Symbol of Dominance.

This special trophy is a crucial component for a legendary trophy ritual that culminates in obtaining the "Testament of Power" trophy.

title: Adhvan Chakra
description:
게임 정보
Command powerful aerial units known as Vaahans, and lead your squadron of airborne warriors to victory with innovative macro-based controls.
Command and manage a wide variety of unique Vaahans, each with distinct abilities and tactics, to outsmart relentless enemy factions.
Turn the tide of battle by strategically altering the attack, defense, and speed of your units and even your opponents. With fully simulated physics, every unit and object react dynamically. Manipulate enemy mass and speed to outmaneuver and overpower them.
The enemy is relentless. Gather every resource you can and extract before it's too late.
Outsmart your foes through in-depth research and analysis. Encounter a vast array of enemies, each with unique traits to study. Challenge powerful bosses at any time; but victory demands matching their firepower.
Discover the Gorger system: a revolutionary RPG elemental interaction mechanic where a unit's composition defines its resistances and vulnerabilities. Study your opponents' physical traits, analyze their constitution, and exploit their weaknesses to gain the upper hand.

title: Dreadveil
description:
게임 정보
SLOW PACED ATMOSPHERIC HORROR
Explore decrepit cities, claustrophobic caves, forests and even the wastelands of Antarctica. Avoid and hide from the unnatural monsters around you. Listen for the footsteps and wheezing through doors, while limping to the next drawer or cabinet, hoping to find anything to help you.
BALANCE RESOURCES FOR THE SHORT- AND LONG-TERM
Manage what little supplies you find to push problems into the future while making tough short-term sacrifices to solve more pressing issues.
Spend time to cook a can of meat into more nutritional value or medicate your terminal illness? Leave behind a vital crafting component for some bandages to patch up a bleeding wound?
There is never enough options to solve everything, be careful and stay hidden from the terrible monstrosities that now skulk this world.
PERMA-DEATH MECHANICS AND RANDOMIZATION
Dreadveil features randomized environments with handmade rooms and assets. The slow-paced horror mixed with the nervousness of losing your progress when dying creates a tense, sometimes panicked experience when things go wrong. Something spots you, doors swing open, gunshots and screaming monsters.

title: GlitchSPANKR
description:
게임 정보
이 서사 중심의 탐험 게임에서 굶주린 바이러스 Spunk으로부터 당신의 게임을 구하세요! 친구를 사귀거나 파괴하고, 도전과 미니게임을 헤쳐나가며, 비밀을 밝혀내고, 커스터마이징을 잠금 해제하며, 다양한 결말을 탐험해 보세요. GlitchSPANKR의 안티바이러스 소프트웨어로 모든 레벨은 다르고 예상치 못한 것이 됩니다!
개요
힘든 하루를 보낸 후 당신은 단지 편안하게 쉬면서 가장 좋아하는 게임, Big Booty Slapper 6을 하고 싶을 뿐입니다! 불행하게도, 당신의 소중한 게임을 먹고 망가뜨리는 악성 바이러스가 있는 것 같습니다! GlitchSPANKR 안티바이러스 소프트웨어를 사용하여 가상 세계로 뛰어들어 그 Glitch를 패배시키세요! 아니면 그와 친구가 되세요. 아니면 그의 가련하고 못생기고 비참한 삶을 용서하세요. 아마도 그에게 키스를... 사랑에 빠지세요... 오, 음. 글쎄요, 선택할 수 있는 많은 옵션이 있습니다. 그냥... 들어가서 알아내세요.



물리 기반의 Spankin'과 Destructin', Spank-fu의 예술을 배우세요! 거의 모든 것이 깨지거나 상호 작용할 수 있습니다. 당신의 Spanking 손이 젖었나요? 공기 블로어로 말리세요! Spanking 손이 불에 탔나요? 글쎄, 그것은 안타깝네요. 그 빛이 싫나요? 젠장, 그것을 부수고 어둠 속에서 살아가세요! 당신의 게임을 먹는 그 말하는 화장실이 싫나요? 그 사악한 짐승을 패세요!



모든 결말을 찾기 위해 자신만의 길을 선택하세요, 모든 레벨은 다릅니다! Spunk가 당신의 소중한 Booty Slapper 6 게임을 파괴했다고 미워하나요? 그렇다면 그를 추적하여 자비를 베풀지 마세요! 그가 구원받을 수 있다고 생각하나요? 그를 용서하는 것을 고려하세요, 어쩌면 당신들은 친구가 될 수도 있습니다. 이 모든 것 뒤에 뭔가... 더 깊은 것이 있다고 생각하나요? 그렇다면 본능을 믿고 그것이 당신을 어디로 이끌지 보세요.



F...사랑에... 빠지다? 농담이에요... 아니면?

- 엉덩이를 때리나요?

실제로 Big Booty Slapper 6를 플레이할 수 있을까요? 시간이 말해줄 것입니다...

title: Paradise Beach Simulator
description:
게임 정보

Paradise Beach Simulator는 천국의 섬에서 사업을 시작하는 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
모든 것을 포기하고 천국의 섬에서 다시 시작하다!
장비와 장식품을 주문하고 특급 배가 배달하길 기다리세요. 첫 번째 수건을 배치하여 고객들을 만족시키세요. 그들의 필요를 확인하면서 환영하세요.
🍹음료와 식사를 준비하세요

title: Apopia: Sugar Coated Tale
description:
게임 정보


APOPIA: SUGAR COATED TALE is a comedic adventure with dark mysteries. Help young girl Mai to find her way home. Progress by solving puzzles and outsmarting enemies in minigames. Make friends and foes with talking animals. Unravel the mystery of Mai’s identity from her dark and blurry memories.

As Mai, you will:

Explore the beautiful fantasy world. Get to know funny characters who are a cat, a mole, a lot of bunnies, and more. Each with unique personality and background story.
Solve creative puzzles along your way home.
Beat enemies... um, lower your fists... You'll beat them by outsmarting them in minigames.
Defeat dark bosses in rhythm games.
Discover the truth about your family and identity.











Catch a glimpse into a world before the events of Apopia Prologue. Learn why Moly was banished from her castle in this animated short. Watch and enhance your demo experience!

title: Secret of Sardinia
description:
게임 정보
Secret of Sardinia is an open-world adventure game full of mystery and mythology. It’s a combat-free fish experience with stealth elements and a focus on narrative. Swim, translate, listen, and explore!
Ancient Mythology
Locate magical bottles that contain the voices of departed souls, who speak their innermost thoughts as they live the last few days of their existence. Collect stone fragments to rebuild the Tablets of Ages – ancient writings which tell the forgotten lore of Sardinia. Closely examine the cryptic Tablets to translate its hieroglyphics and read its legends.
Fish-Fantasy
Control Sam the Sardine using a carefully-crafted swimming mechanic that lets you move with 360 degrees of freedom. Test your skills with races scattered throughout the ocean to attain union with the sea herself and unlock new abilities. Master these techniques to avoid the gaze of the unliving, lest you decay.
Open Seas
The Sotebol Expanse. The Giants’ Graveyard. The Caloksian Wasteland. The Undercurrent. Swim through four connected realms to find the answers you seek – and then travel beyond. Use your knowledge of the ancient Sardinian language to unlock the Cipher Stones, which open secret passageways all throughout the sea.
Features
Fluid and customizable swim controls
Four haunting realms to explore
Hand-drawn hieroglyphic language
Original fish-themed mythology
Philosophical narrative conveyed by compelling voice acting
Hundreds of hidden collectibles to uncover
Beautiful, original soundtrack

Copyright attribution for “Secret of Sardinia” can be found here.

title: Pivot of Hearts
description:
게임 정보
Pivot of Hearts is a non-monogamous romance visual novel with a simple card game built into it. It takes place in the city of São Paulo and tells the story of Wén Xiàn, a taiwanese-brazilian game developer who, after a long period of isolation, starts finding chances to open his heart again: he suddenly reconnects with Etsuko, someone important from his past, and forms an unexpected bond with a new colleague, Cauã. As he navigates through an exciting TTRPG adventure, heavy metal concerts, magical-boy dreams, and the usual young adult suffering, Wén will have to reexamine his old notions of love and play his cards right in order to achieve true happiness.

Features:
♥ 8 hours of gameplay
♥ Tarot-based card game mechanic
♥ 5 different endings
♥ Healthy non-monogamy!
♥ Original soundtrack by Livia Maki Yoshikawa
♥ Original illustrations by Raviolivs
♥ Available in Portuguese and English

title: Ant Guardians
description:
게임 정보
내 맘대로 골라 소환하는 유닛 디펜스 게임!
오염된 크리스탈을 봉인하는 동안, 끊임없이 몰려오는 적들의 침공을 막아야 합니다!
자원을 모아 동료 유닛을 소환하여 점점 강해지는 적들을 물리치세요.
벽을 소환하여 입구를 막거나, 튼튼한 유닛을 앞세워 적들을 막을 수도 있습니다.
아이템을 강화하여 유닛을 더욱 강력하게 만들어보세요.

title: 7 Days
description:
게임 정보
                               Step into a world where dreams and reality mix.
                              Play as a boy trapped between waking life and a dream, exploring his memories each day. Each day uncovers a different part of his life, from school and family to love and loss. Your choices influence his journey: will he find hope and awaken, or remain lost in darkness?

title: Knight of the Lions
description:
게임 정보


A story-driven, single-player platformer
Simple mechanics used to create a challenging gameplay
The insight into the diary of a person who has suffered a loss
Pen-drawn graphics meant to look like doodles in a notebook
Inspired by the story of Don Quixote

title: Switchblade
description:
게임 정보
Master your Switchblade in frantic combat against an endless swarm of enemies! 
Switchblade is a frantic top-down shooter where you use your titular Switchblade to shoot and ram through waves of alien creatures. Pave your way through the endless swarm, and be careful not to overheat! 
6 game modes, including Fury, Surge, and Blaze!
30 intense levels, featuring 3 boss battles and multiple ranks to aim for!
Tons of unlocks including, palettes, backgrounds, maps, game modes, and more!
Online Leaderboards to compete against the world!
With Switchblade I wanted to make a classic arcade-style game with quick runs and tons of replayability, with the classic pick-up and play, easy to learn hard to master gameplay loop, and a ton of extra unlockable content to keep things fresh. I wanted anyone to be able to pick it up and have a good time, without needing to be good at these kinds of games. I hope you enjoy it!

title: Hexbound
description:
게임 정보
아늑하고 편안한 경험. 육각형 기반 보드에 도형을 배치하며 만족스러운 퍼즐을 풀고 복잡한 이미지 도전을 해결하세요. 타이머도, 압박도 없습니다—그저 나만의 속도로 퍼즐을 즐길 수 있습니다.
🟡 직관적이고 몰입감 있는 게임플레이
다양한 보드 레이아웃에 도형을 배치하고 패턴을 완성하며 이미지 기반 퍼즐을 해결하세요. 각 보드는 새로운 도전을 제공하여 흥미롭고 보람찬 경험을 선사합니다.
🌟 다양한 보드 & 도전 과제
다양한 보드 형태와 독창적인 퍼즐이 준비되어 있어, 매번 새로운 도전을 경험할 수 있습니다. 조각을 맞추거나 이미지를 완성하는 모든 과정이 편안하면서도 몰입감을 제공합니다.

title: Rope It Two
description:
게임 정보
Rope It Two
여러분과 친구들을 위한 와일드한 협동 파티 플랫폼 게임!
1-8인 플레이 광란
최대 8명의 플레이어와 팀을 이루거나 경쟁하며 혼란스러운 멀티플레이어 재미를 즐기세요!

title: Dice With The Universe
description:
게임 정보
Play dice with the Universe. Wield the fundamental forces of physics to control the Universe... and to shape what the next iteration of reality will be. A strategic rogue-like dice-battler with deckbuilding elements where you balance your skills against your luck.
Take the role of a Universal Concept who shapes the very fabric of reality with the power of one of the fundamental forces of physics-- weak, strong, electromagnetic and gravity. Each power provides a distinct and unique playstyle, moveset and dice with special abilities.
Each run crosses the lifespan of the entire Universe, from the Big Bang up until the Big Crunch when the Universe collapses back in on itself, ready to be born again. Your victory or defeat determines your position during the next iteration of the Universe (the next run); when the rules of physics are written during the first Plank epoch, your performance in the previous run will influence reality itself to be favorable to your chosen force. Earn powerful Universal Laws that give you significant bonuses, unique abilities, and change the very rules of the game itself.
Face off against the other fundamental forces in a series of dice-based battles. Your moveset determines the dice outcomes that earn you points (such as straights, of-a-kinds, specific sums, etc). After each roll a decision must be made: will you stay safe and keep the points you have earned-- or roll your remaining dice for more points, but risk not gaining more, and instead losing everything collected so far.
As the four forces struggle eternally as the Universe itself is born and reborn-- could a fifth, previously unknown force arise, looking to permanently break this cycle for it's own malevolent benefit?

title: Fairy Tale TD 2 童话塔防2
description:
게임 정보
동화탑방어는 3D 만화풍의 탑방어게임으로서 게임에는 많은 관문이 있는데 매 관문마다 게임을 시작할 때 소량의 자원을 주어 몬스터를 처치하면 더욱 많은 자원을 얻을수 있다.
게임에서 각 몬스터의 생명치와 이동 속도가 다릅니다. 몬스터가 에너지 보호막을 가지고 있을 때 생명치가 높아집니다. 호박포탑은 에너지 보호막을 가진 몬스터에게 추가 데미지를 입힙니다.
피쳐:
6 가지 승급 가능한 방어포탑
16종 몬스터(일반 몬스터 8종 + 보호막이 있는 일반 몬스터 8종)
25개 관문
autokwd: Fairy Tale TD 2 童话塔防2

title: Potatogeddon
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready for a potato revolution? Step into the role of an extraordinary hero – a potato who infiltrates the secret base of potato beetles and other creatures feeding on delicious and magnificent potatoes to stop their sinister plan to destroy the world's potato crops!
Potatogeddon is a dynamic first-person FPS game with roguelike elements that will immerse you in fast-paced action and humorous battles. Explore procedurally generated corridors of the enemy base, collect unique upgrades, and fight hordes of enraged beetles, mutants, and mechanical creatures standing in your way. Each attempt to beat the game is a completely new experience – with randomly generated levels, enemies, and items, no two runs are ever the same!
Game Features:
Fast, crazy FPS action – shoot, dodge, and fight against enemies in intense battles.
Procedurally generated levels – each playthrough offers new challenges, unique level layouts, and items.
Roguelike elements – face new combinations of upgrades, enemies, and challenges with every attempt, making each run a unique experience.
Co-op mode for up to 4 players – join forces with friends to avoid annihilation. Defeat enemies together and become potato heroes.
Humorous tone and stylized graphics – a comedic approach to a serious mission combined with a unique art style makes the game perfect for solo players and teams alike.
Take on the challenge in Potatogeddon and prove that the potato is king! 🥔

title: Spin Forward
description:
게임 정보
잠에서 깨어나자, 당신은 Slot 대륙으로 전송되었습니다. 슬롯머신과 당신의 운에 의지해 Slot 대륙의 모험에서 죽거나 더 부유하고 강해질 것입니다.
저희는 Luck Be a Landlord와 Slay the Spire의 게임 메커니즘을 결합했습니다. 적들은 강력하며, 패배하면 게임이 끝납니다.
게임 중에는 강력한 상징과 신비로운 유물을 얻게 되며, 각 상징은 고유한 속성을 지니고, 유물은 다양한 특이한 효과를 가지고 있습니다.
Spin을 클릭하여 모험을 시작하세요!
특징:
다양한 능력을 가진 심볼과 유물을 모으고 조합하여 모험의 길에서 몬스터와 보스를 처치하세요.
Spin을 클릭하여 슬롯 머신을 시작하고 랜덤으로 심볼 조합을 생성하세요. 다양한 유물과 결합하면 공격력과 방어력이 달라집니다.
특정 심볼을 사용하여 적에게 특별한 효과를 발생시킬 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 양치기 지팡이는 적을 양으로 변하게 만들 수 있습니다.
각각의 플레이는 독특한 경험을 제공합니다. 다양한 심볼과 유물을 발견하고, 다양한 적과 사건을 만나며, 새로운 놀라움을 경험하세요.

title: Carnal Sins: Malum Incarnatum + Carne Vescens
description:
게임 정보
"With the sin of the flesh every man is born, thus does each soul yearn for love.
But should love be won but once and then lost, even the soul of a righteous heart may succumb to sin."
Experience two short but unique psychological horror games in one horrific package. Dive into the twisted perceptions of love from two lost souls:

"Malum Incarnatum"
Descend into human hell and unravel a life torn apart by the desire to love and be loved. Even if this longing for love only leads to evil growing inside one man's heart.
"Carne Vescens"
Trapped in her apartment, a mother finds herself unable to keep her insatiable baby fed. So she decides to feed her baby the only bit of food she has left: Herself.
Both games feature:
Unique surreal horror experiences.
Graphics inspired by late 90s PSX-games.
Full Motion Videos (FMVs) and voice acting.
Full controller support (XInput).
A hidden mystery to uncover.
autokwd: Carnal Sins: Malum Incarnatum + Carne Vescens

title: Crypt Robbery
description:
게임 정보
크립트 로버리(Crypt Robbery)는 1인 개발자가 제작한 슈팅 게임과 호러 요소가 혼합된 게임입니다. 고전 FPS 게임에서 영감을 받은 Crypt Robbery는 잊을 수 없는 저녁이나 으스스한 밤에 완벽한 독특하고 스릴 넘치는 모험을 제공합니다!
당신은 필요에 따라 훔치는 초보 도둑으로 플레이합니다. 이번에는 누군가가 당신을 고용하여 지하실에서 유물을 찾았습니다. 그러나 지하실에 들어가자마자 시간과 피가 필요하다는 것을 깨닫게 됩니다.
주요 특징들

title: Bam Bam Boom
description:
게임 정보
Experience the thrill of combat with a unique roster of characters, each with their own technical and thoughtful move sets designed for both casual players and competitive fighters alike. Master your character’s abilities and outplay your opponents in intense platform battles.

Whether you're battling friends locally or challenging players online, Bam Bam Boom offers endless fun and competitive game play.

Key Features
Unique characters: Choose from a diverse set of characters, each with unique abilities and strategies
Technical Move Sets: Discover deep, thoughtful move sets that reward skill and timing
Online Multiplayer: Battle against friends and players from all over the world in online matches
Local Multiplayer: Gather your friends and engage in local battles for ultimate bragging rights
Custom Games: Create your own rules and settings for a unique fighting experience
Challenges: Test your skills in a variety of exciting challenges against opponents who will push your limits

title: SteamMaze
description:
게임 정보
1、 First Impressions of Wasteland World
（1） Special protagonist appears
In this wasteland world, our protagonist has a unique identity - a cyborg. Its body structure cleverly blends mechanical and organic matter, giving the protagonist extraordinary strength and some stunning special abilities through this unique combination.
And the protagonist's' home 'is a train of wasteland. It is not just a simple place to stay, but also a mobile base for the protagonist to embark on an exploration journey. Every time the train departs, the secrets hidden under the wasteland will be revealed one by one.
（2） Danger and opportunity coexist
The entire wasteland world seems to be shrouded in a mysterious and dangerous layer of steam, making it difficult for people to see the whole picture, but they can always feel the dangerous aura hidden in the shadows.
Every exploration is undoubtedly a thrilling adventure. While taking risks, there will also be unexpected gains, such as discovering precious resources, mastering advanced technology, or meeting reliable allies.

title: You Die Today
description:
게임 정보
YOU DIE TODAY
Step into a dungeon-crawling adventure that combines the strategic depth of deck-building with the thrill of rolling dice. Inspired by the magic of tabletop RPGs, this game brings you a unique rogue-like experience where every roll counts.
Key Features:
Deck-Building with a Twist: Collect powerful cards with unique abilities and build your ultimate deck.

title: Forklift Driving Simulator VR
description:
게임 정보
Forklift is a useful and powerful industrial truck used to lift and move materials over short distances, also called lift truck, fork truck, fork hoist, and forklift truck. Forklifts have become an indispensable piece of equipment in manufacturing and warehousing. Along with forklifts, the game also includes pallet trucks, reach trucks, and VNA, allowing you to experience a wide range of industrial equipment.
Up for a real forklift gaming experience? We worked really hard and thoroughly to bring you great forklift simulator realistic graphics in one of the best forklift games, now including pallet trucks, reach trucks, and VNA for a complete experience.
REAL WAREHOUSE EXPERIENCE Not only do you need to ride the forklift, but you'll also need to manually move boxes like in a real warehouse. Be careful in how you manage the forklift; you can cause different problems in this realistic experience. Plus, there's a free-room where you can choose 'Mission Generate Random,' and a truck will arrive to unload or load pallets, adding an extra layer of excitement.

title: Secret Paws - Cozy Offices
description:
게임 정보
Secret Paws - Cozy Offices는 3D 숨은그림찾기 게임으로, 아늑한 사무실에 숨겨진 고양이를 찾는 것이 당신의 임무입니다.

서랍과 캐비닛을 열고 물건을 움직여 가장 예상치 못한 숨겨진 장소를 발견하세요. 사무실의 모든 구석에는 놀라움과 도전이 가득하며, 세밀하게 설계된 아이소메트릭 3D 환경을 탐험할 수 있습니다.
특징
혁신적인 3D 숨은그림찾기: 클래식 탐험 메커니즘과 아이소메트릭 3D 환경을 결합한 혁신적인 게임. 🚀
거의 500마리의 숨겨진 고양이: 모든 색상, 크기 및 성격의 고양이를 찾아보세요. 😺
비밀 고양이: 독특한 숨겨진 장소에서 특별한 고양이를 발견하세요. 💡
세부적인 상호작용: 가구를 열고, 물건을 움직이고, 환경과 상호작용하세요. 😻

title: 燈吉診療所 Hiyoshi Clinic
description:
게임 정보
The newly renovated haunted house, Hiyoshi Clinic, was quickly becoming the centerpiece of Horizon Amusement Park. The protagonist, journalist Eiji Sakuma, visits the attraction for a report and finds himself immersed in a series of terrifying performances that seem far too real. Guided by a child's voice, he begins to experience strange phenomena.
Explore a haunted mansion set in a 1940s setting in FPS mode.
The eerie interior has been renovated while still retaining some of its original appearance.

title: Galactic Tavern
description:
게임 정보
우주 술집을 건설하고 관리하며 우주로 떠나는 여정을 떠나보세요! 이국적인 재료를 발견하고, 독특한 칵테일을 만들고, 라이브 음악 공연으로 활기찬 분위기를 조성하세요. 우주의 심연을 탐험하며 이 경영 시뮬레이션 모험에서 궁극의 기업가가 되어보세요!
위시리스트!
오늘 위시리스트에 추가하고 게임 개발에 대한 업데이트를 팔로우하세요.


Galactic Tavern에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 여기서 당신은 당신만의 성간 바를 건설, 관리 및 확장할 수 있는 궁극의 우주 모험을 경험할 수 있습니다. 우주의 생생한 한 구석에 위치한 Galactic Tavern은 은하계에서 가장 유명한 술집 주인이 되기 위한 여정에 당신을 초대합니다.

주요 특징:

🌌 우주 술집 커스터마이징: 우주 술집을 디자인하고 커스터마이징하여 은하계 전체에서 고객을 유치하세요.

🌟 이국적인 믹솔로지: 우주 모험에서 발견한 희귀 재료를 사용하여 다양한 우주 칵테일을 만들어 제공하세요.

👨‍🌾 우주 농업: 신선한 재료를 재배하여 음료와 요리에 사용할 수 있는 우주 농장을 직접 관리하세요. 고객에게 최상의 품질을 제공합니다.

🚀 은하 탐험: 새로운 레시피, 재료 및 보물을 발견하기 위해 용감한 탐험가들을 무모한 임무에 보내세요.

🎵 엔터테인먼트 스펙터클: 재능 있는 밴드의 라이브 음악 공연으로 고객을 즐겁게 하고 전기 같은 분위기를 만드세요.

💫 제국 확장: 시설을 업그레이드하고 시설을 확장하며 은하계 전체에서 새로운 고객을 유치하여 술집 제국을 확장하세요.

모험을 경험하세요:

Galactic Tavern은 경영 시뮬레이션, 탐험 및 우주 모험의 독특한 조합을 제공합니다. 칵테일을 만들거나 외계의 미식을 발견하거나 새로운 영토를 탐험하는 등, 이 우주적 여정에서 당신의 창업 및 발견을 경험할 수 있습니다.

여정을 시작하세요:

궁극의 우주 술집 모험을 시작할 준비가 되었나요? 재료를 모으고, 음악을 준비하고, Galactic Tavern에서 잊지 못할 여정을 떠나보세요!

title: Meat Fest
description:
게임 정보
Meat Fest is a dynamic shooter with soulslike elements, arenas and corridors, secrets, traps and its own story. Built on the foundation of good old shooters, it raises the social problems of society.

To answer questions you will have to use a wide arsenal of weapons, an ax, and a suit to protect and dodge fatal blows and dangerous fauna. Collect the story piece by piece to get to the truth, which, as always, lurks somewhere nearby.
STORY
Humanity was forced to leave their home planet and settle on Radix, where leaders tell new generations that the Earth was destroyed as a result of natural disasters. Combat geneticist Marcus Berger, studying samples from the homeland of people, begins to realize how false such statements about the death of the world are. He becomes increasingly immersed in the search for truth and reaches out to black market dealers, consisting mainly of the opposition. His native corporation begins to see him as a dangerous unit and Marcus escapes from Radix, deciding to find answers on Earth. The player will have to face the current inhabitants of the cradle of humanity and find evidence of the theory of a man-made disaster, because of which the world has turned into hell.
MORE
Combine your attacks

title: T.D.Z. 4 Heart of Pripyat
description:
게임 정보
You have to go through this difficult path from a beginner to a seasoned stalker and uncover the mystery of your own father's disappearance!
T.D.Z. 4 The Heart of Pripyat is a game that will draw you in with its amazing atmosphere from the first seconds! Gray sky, rain, campfire dialogues with loyal stalker friends, mutants, anomalies are just a small part of what awaits you in this 1st-person action-adventure shooter! Explore the abandoned locations of the mysterious Exclusion Zone, shoot back mutants, search caches of ammunition and food, complete tasks of stalker friends and reach the very Pripyat to see the finale of this amazing story!
►Game Features◄
☢️ Freedom of action! You can explore the stunning beauty of the location, as well as complete the tasks of other stalkers, earning new equipment!
☢️ A large selection of items! 7 types of weapons, bolts, grenades, first aid kits, anomaly detectors, food and much more in your arsenal for survival in a dangerous zone!
☢️ A mixture of genres in one bottle! Horror, Survival, Action Shooter in one game and at once!
☢️ Convenient controls will appeal to everyone!
☢️ Stunning graphics!
☢️ Dynamic storyline!

title: VTumbler
description:
게임 정보
VTumbler brings your favorite Oshi to the world of Arcade Puzzle Fighting! Brought to you by FeFe and friends, you can compete for the strategic win with your friends, random strangers, or train with a CPU!

title: Sinned Arena
description:
게임 정보
Sinned Arena is a classic arena shooter inspired by timeless 90s games. You are trapped in Hell with other unfortunate souls, fighting among each other for demons twisted pleasures. Fight for your way out of this dark place but beware, demons aren't there just to watch.
Single player

Engage in Single player in two different ways:
Play Campaign mode where you go through predefined Deathmatch maps with progressively increasing difficulty of your opponents.
Play Skirmish mode where you can tailor the gameplay experience to your liking. You can choose game mode, map, score goal, number of opponents and their skills. You can also spice up your experience with Mutators that are adding various modifiers to the game.

Game modes

The game offers 5 game modes: Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Heartcore, Instagib and Team Instagib

Deathmatch is a classic Free For All mode, where you are winning by being first to get required amount of kills.
Team Deathmatch is a team variant of Deathmatch mode where goal is again reaching required amount of kills but score of your teammates counts as well.

Heartcore is a team mode where goal is to destroy a heart inside of enemy base. First team to destroy enemy heart wins.

Instagib a Team Instagib are similar to Deathmatch or Team Deatchmatch modes but this time, you only have one weapon at your disposal and it turns your opponents into bunch of gibs with a single shot.


Throughout the game, you are collecting all sorts of weapon relics and character relics. Weapon relics serves as a way to make your weapons more powerful or even change their functionality entirely while character relics are giving you unique bonuses to your character or upgrading your base stats. There are several ways to obtain relics such as challenging your opponents to a duel. Winning in a duel will give you opponent's relic but be careful, opponents can challenge you for your own relic as well.

title: The Schism
description:
게임 정보
현실 사이에 균열이 생겼고 그들은 이를 분열"이라고 부릅니다. The Schism은 1~8인용 온라인 협동 공포 게임으로, 여러분과 과학자 팀은 정부의 봉쇄 계획을 지원하기 위해 유용한 정보를 수집해야 합니다. 귀하의 팀은 손상된 위치에 들어가 중요한 정보를 수집하는 작업을 시작합니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 당신은 혼자가 아닙니다.

\r\n\r\n목표[\/b]\r\n\r\n

명망 높은 과학자 팀의 일원으로서 당신은 수많은 목표를 완수해야 하는 임무를 맡게 될 것입니다. 감시 설정부터 샘플 수집까지 매번 독특한 게임플레이 경험을 선사할 것입니다. 당신의 팀은 스텔스와 강철의 신경이라는 중요한 기술을 숙달해야 합니다. 적을 피하고 숨어서 성공하세요.

\r\n\r\n고유한 야수[\/b]\r\n\r\n

고유한 몬스터의 수가 증가함에 따라 The Schism을 플레이할 때마다 새로운 만남과 함께 새로운 두려움에 직면하게 됩니다. 변신부터 지능, 순수한 힘과 힘까지, 게임플레이를 항상 신선하게 보장하는 무한한 잠재적 시나리오가 있습니다.

\r\n\r\n지도[\/b]\r\n\r\n

여기 는 수많은 새로운 위치에 대한 계획과 함께 잠재적인 공포의 놀이터 목록이 점점 늘어나고 있습니다.
\r\n\r\n멀티플레이어[\/b]\r\n\r\n

친구들과 함께 게임을 경험해 보세요! 팀워크가 기회를 높일 뿐만 아니라, 친구의 불행한 죽음으로 인한 히스테리보다 더 우스꽝스러운 것은 없습니다.

\r\n\r\n계획[\/b]\r\n\r\n

엄청난 계획이 있습니다. 분열을 위해. 새로운 몬스터, 지도, 작업. 이름을 정할 수 있다면 우리가 계획한 것입니다. 새로운 콘텐츠가 기본이 될 것이므로 이 게임에 대한 투자는 안심하셔도 됩니다. 새로운 추가 사항에 대한 아이디어가 있으시면 Steam 리뷰 섹션을 통해 문의해 주세요."

title: MonoRace
description:
게임 정보
MonoRace is a cheerful monobike racing where you can explore tracks and get points by performing tricks. Try the game in VR and PC versions with unique controls.

Monobikes is an electric, self-balancing unicycles, and you need to lean your body to control them. We have transferred this control mechanism to the game.
In VR game lean forward to accelerate, lean back to brake and lean left or right to turn.
In PC version move a mouse to control your unicycle.

Experience the game:
There will be a lot of tracks available and there will be several race paths on each of them. You can ride the main path or you can take a short cut.
Get benefits by collecting bonuses.
Perform mortal tricks to get points and survive to the end without fail.
Be the quickest, or all your tricks point will be lost.
Lead in Leagues: complete exercises and get points to upgrade the unicycle and unlock new tracks.

Multiplayer mode: it's much more interesting to compete with other players and you will have this opportunity.

In training mode, you can try our unique control system and practice tricks.

title: Sheep Sweep
description:
게임 정보
오래 전 칼라와 에리스는 화목하게 살았어요. 하지만 구피 토네이도의 공격으로 모든 것이 바뀌었죠. 구피 토네이도는 양들을 전 세계로 휩쓸고 갔고, 양들을 구하기 위해 칼라와 에리스 두 목자만 남았죠. 양치기들은 매우 회복력이 뛰어나지만, 누군가를 구하기까지 많은 어려움을 겪어야 합니다. 여러분은 이 모험을 감당할 만큼 용감한가요?






팀워크와 소통이 게임의 장애물을 극복하는 데 핵심이 되는 로컬 2인 협동 게임플레이에 참여하세요.




아름답게 제작된 싱글 플레이어 모드에서 혼자서 칼라 또는 에리스가 되어 독특한 도전과 퍼즐을 해결해 보세요.




영웅이 되어 마을에서 길을 잃고 구조를 기다리는 양들을 찾아 구하는 퀘스트를 수행하세요.




불타는 지형을 전략적으로 탐색하고, 도구와 영리한 사고로 불길을 관리하고 진압하세요.




모든 도전을 즐거운 실수로 바꿔주는 재미있는 물리와 래그돌 효과와 함께 웃어보세요.




예술적으로 풍부한 환경을 가로지르며 각 섬마다 퍼즐만큼이나 독특한 시각적 즐거움을 선사합니다.



- 2인 로컬 협동 플레이
- 솔로 플레이
- 재미있는 물리학과 래그돌
- 퍼즐을 풀고 양을 위험에서 구하세요!
- 가연성 및 소화성 세계
- 리더 보드
- 이스터 에그 수집
- 키보드 및 컨트롤러 지원
- 매우 광범위한 지원

title: Multiverse Designer
description:
게임 정보
UNLOCK THE POWER OF INFINITE STORYTELLING!
Multiverse Designer is an innovative 3D virtual tabletop and map creator, a unique toolbox to empower storytellers and create the most immersive RPG experiences. Save hours of your time creating awe-inspiring setpieces with thousands of 3D assets, effects and features thanks to its procedural generation systems and intuitive drag-and-drop UI; or customize everything to its finest detail, from texture to lights or colors. Put your players or yourself in the heros' boots, exploring your creations with real-time fog of war and dynamic lights and shadows. You can even create epic cutscenes with animated assets, camera angles and dialogues!
Use your creations to play any game, any genre, any setting -- from fantasy to sci-fi, from horror to comedy. Multiverse Designer includes Criteria, an easy-to-learn scripting language that you can use to implement rules and character sheets, automate events, or even include RPG rulesets of your own creation in the game, so Multiverse Designer takes care of all the bookkeeping for you!
Multiverse Designer is more than just a software. It’s a venue for your creativity, expression, and entertainment. It’s a way to unleash your imagination and live your dreams. It’s a path to become a storyteller!
CREATE EPIC CUTSCENES

title: Umami Grove
description:
게임 정보
Umami Grove는 물리 기반 VR 어드벤처 게임으로, 위험에 맞서며 요리 실력을 연마해 최고의 상인 골드를 받는 게임입니다! 도토리 모양으로 말이죠. 어쩌면 마법이 걸렸을지도?
특징
멋진 세계를 여행하고, 매력적인 생물을 만나고, 요리하세요! (보통은 요리를 만들어 줘야 해요.)
손과 주변 환경을 이용해 난관을 극복하세요! 보통은 물고기를 던진다고 문제가 해결되지 않지만, 해보지 않으면 모릅니다.
저 나무를 타고 올라 사과를 딸 수 있고, 테이블 위의 버섯을 마구 자를 수 있습니다! 강력한 물리 엔진과 손을 사용해 요리를 마음껏 체험하세요.
다양한 방법으로 도울 수 있는 캐릭터들을 만나세요! 침대로 돌아갈 수 있게 도와주고, 식사를 만들어 주고, 때로는 실수로 물건을 망가뜨리지 않게 조심하세요!
이 도토리들이 무엇인지 잘 생각해보세요!

title: Vertigo Rush
description:
게임 정보
Vertigo Rush is a virtual reality racing experience that combines speed and parkour in an intense physical challenge. Players control agile robots, propelling them through vast, detailed environments by moving their own arms in a heart-pumping race.
Inspired by the mechanics of classic arcade racing games, each level is crafted to test player’s skill and endurance as they race through Haven's floating cities.
• Competitive Online Multiplayer up to 12 Players in Each Race with Global Ranking System, Time Trial Mode, Character & Robot Customization and Cross-Platform Play.
• Polished full-body physical control for high-speed parkour racing, with fluid and satisfying movement mechanics (jumps, climbing, running) designed for an exhilarating VR experience.
• Immersive and emotionally engaging narrative: In a world divided between floating opulence and terrestrial struggle, two ingenious siblings defy their destiny in robot races to save themselves from oppression and rewrite their future.

title: Deja View - A Spot The Difference Game
description:
게임 정보
Deja View is a relaxing yet challenging spot-the-difference puzzle game, filled with surreal hand-drawn illustrations from Bleeding Moon Studio. Explore dream-like worlds as you uncover subtle differences hidden within beautiful artwork.
16 surrealistic hand-drawn illustrations.
Each illustration split into two intricate halves.
Discover 15-20 unique differences per puzzle.
Earn hints as you progress.
Unlock achievements and captivating artwork descriptions.
Atmospheric soundtrack tailored to each artwork.
Enjoy completed illustrations in full view mode.
Immerse yourself in an artistic puzzle experience, combining observation, relaxation, and creativity.
autokwd: Deja View - A Spot The Difference Game

title: Ternion
description:
게임 정보
A Great Responsibility
In the distant future presented by Ternion, you take control of four members of the titular team of mercenaries working for the galactic organization known as the Defence and Tutelage of Abiogenesis, more commonly referred to as the DTA. Based on your decisions and relationships, the game has multiple endings.
Desert, the captain of Ternion and leader of the DTA, has been accidentally infected by a prototype symbiont designed to provide better performance in battle. The DTA discovered that the prototype's unstable nature results in the destruction and overwriting of brain cells, ultimately driving to madness those who come in direct contact with it.
Desert's state of mad delirium eventually drives him to seek the destruction of every inhabited planet in the existence. Upon discovering this plot, you, Fushiko, and Yuki, rebel against former leader, going to any and every length necessary to stop him and spare all civilizations of the Milky Way a terrible fate.
A Modern Mix of Vintage

title: Steel Aces
description:
게임 정보
Prepare to take command of your own tank and dive deep into the annals of history with Steel Aces, the highly anticipated MMO tactical tank shooter that's set to redefine the gaming landscape. Developed by seasoned veterans of the genre, Steel Aces seamlessly combines strategy, simulation, and historical authenticity to offer gamers an unprecedented and immersive experience. Set to be available on PC Windows in 2024, the game also holds the potential for future expansion onto Mac, Linux, and various gaming consoles.
Unleash Your Inner Tank Commander with Free-To-Play Access
Steel Aces introduces a Free-To-Play model, granting global players access to the heart-pounding world of tank warfare. The game features a balanced monetisation approach, offering a diverse range of cosmetic options, including skins, decals, progression boosters, and exclusive collector's vehicles. With a multitude of customisation choices, players can tailor their gaming experience while supporting the continuous development of the game.

in-Game Screenshot
Embark on a Historical MMO Tank Adventure
Setting itself apart from the competition, Steel Aces delivers massive multiplayer tank battles that traverse various historical eras. From the trenches of WWI to contemporary war machines, players can engage in gripping campaigns inspired by real locations and historical events such as The Battle of Cambrai (1917), The Battle of Khalkhin Gol (1939), The Battle of Arras (1940), The Battle of the Bulge (1944), and The Battle of Chawinda (1965) and more.

in-Game Screenshot
Steel Aces meticulously crafts key environments inspired by actual locations and historical occurrences. While some areas may be fictional, they remain plausible and engaging - ensuring players are not bogged down by excessive travel times during gameplay.

in-Game Recording
Steel Aces is the culmination of extensive player feedback and insights, gathered by the experienced developers behind the game. Leveraging their collective expertise, the team has addressed common genre challenges, promising a more fulfilling and satisfying gaming experience. The game retains the core strengths that made tactical vehicle shooters popular in the 2010s while introducing changes, additions, and revisions to elevate it to new heights.

in-Game Screenshot
Steel Aces offers a plethora of features that will captivate players, with these three mechanics taking centre stage:



in-Game Recording

Steel Aces goes further beyond these, ensuring players embark on an unequaled adventure.
Prepare to make history with Steel Aces, the ultimate MMO tactical battle tank shooter. Engage in epic tank battles, use the environments, and strategise your way to victory!
Register now and become a Beta Tester!

title: Death Row Escape
description:
게임 정보
Death Row Escape에서 당신은 정기적인 수리 작업을 위해 버려진 감옥으로 보내진 작업자를 조종합니다. 하지만 상황은 빠르게 악화되며, 목숨을 건 치열한 싸움이 시작됩니다. 감옥은 강력한 인공지능(AI)에 의해 통제되고 있으며, 용병들과 위험한 실험체들이 곳곳에 도사리고 있습니다. 바디캠을 활용하여 타임 루프를 탐색하고, 퍼즐을 풀며 탈출 방법을 찾아야 합니다.
슈팅 액션
Death Row Escape는 짜릿한 슈팅 경험을 제공합니다. 강력한 무기, 전략적인 사격, 그리고 긴장감 넘치는 액션이 생존의 열쇠입니다. 감옥에는 용병과 치명적인 생물체, 그리고 다양한 위험 요소가 가득합니다. 빠른 반사 신경과 정확한 조준이 필수적이며, 주변 환경을 이용해 최적의 순간을 포착하여 공격해야 합니다.

title: Primal Fray
description:
게임 정보
Primal Fray는 턴제 전략 로그라이트 게임입니다. 전투는 절차적으로 생성된 육각형 기반의 하늘에 떠있는 섬에서 이루어집니다. 당신은 유닛을 사용하여 적군을 기습하고 처치할 수 있습니다.
강력한 보스를 물리치세요
독특한 메커니즘을 가진 여러 보스가 등장합니다. 당신은 그들을 뛰어넘을 수 있을까요? 아니면 완벽한 팀을 구성하여 보스를 물리칠 수 있을까요? 가능성은 무한하지만, 한 가지 확실한 점은… 쉽지 않을 거라는 것입니다.

title: Wizard Hand
description:
게임 정보
Wizard Hand is a magical solitaire roguelike about accumulating the maximum number of magical points by mastering the art of combining enchanted cards, transformations, and a collection of magical items.
The goal of the game is to remove the entire pyramid of cards from the table, while scoring the maximum points. Play a matching card onto the pyramid card to start a combo! The more points you have, the more opportunities you have to expand your magical arsenal and be ready for future challenges!

title: Banker Simulator: Prologue
description:
게임 정보

Banker Simulator – 금융 세계의 도전에 대비되었습니까?
파산한 은행을 인수하고 다시 번영하도록 만들어 보세요. 고객 만족도를 높이고, 전략적 투자를 결정하며, 금융 위기를 극복하기 위한 중요한 결정을 내리세요. 리스크를 관리하고 은행을 성장시키며 업계에서 입지를 확고히 하세요. 이 흥미진진한 시뮬레이션 게임에서 금융 전문가이자 전략 마스터가 되어 보세요!

💰 주요 특징:
현실적인 위조지폐 제작 시스템

title: Diecast Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
멀티플레이어
멀티플레이어 다이캐스트 상점 시뮬레이터를 사용하면 다이캐스트 모델 상점을 관리할 수 있습니다. 세밀하고 사실적인 세계에서 진열대를 구성하고, 고객을 돕고, 상점을 확장하세요. 디스코드에 가입하여 다른 플레이어와 소통하고 다이캐스트 상점 경험을 공유하세요!
나만의 다이캐스트 상점 건설
처음부터 최고의 다이캐스트 제국을 건설하세요. 번화한 도시에서 창의력과 전략으로 꿈의 다이캐스트 상점을 디자인하고, 관리하고, 성장시켜 성공으로 이끄세요.
매니저
진열대에 다이캐스트 모델을 배치하고, 미적 감각과 효율성을 위해 매장 레이아웃을 최적화하고, 매력적인 쇼핑 환경을 조성하세요.
커스터마이징
매장 구석구석을 커스터마이즈하고 장식하여 매력적이고 개인화된 쇼핑 환경을 조성하세요.
새 라이선스 잠금 해제
인기 브랜드의 라이선스를 구매하여 다양한 다이캐스트 모델을 구비하세요. 새로운 브랜드를 도입할 때마다 매장에 다양성을 더하고 더 많은 고객을 유치하세요.
희귀 아이템 찾기
희귀한 자동차를 찾아 컬렉션에 추가하세요. 독점 아이템을 제공하여 다이캐스트 애호가와 수집가를 유치하세요.
고객과 거래
고객과 교류하여 다이캐스트 모델을 거래하세요. 공정하고 흥미로운 거래를 통해 관계를 구축하고 충성도 높은 고객층을 확보하세요.
성장
매장의 물리적 공간을 확장하고 인테리어를 업그레이드하며 고객의 요구에 맞게 지속적으로 적응하세요.
온라인 주문
스쿠터로 온라인 주문을 처리하고 배송하여 적시에 정확한 배송을 보장합니다.
특징
다이캐스트 거래 시스템
청소 기계공
NPC 상호작용
랜덤 이벤트
광고 시스템

title: Brominion
description:
게임 정보
Brominion is an interactive overlay strategy game. Turn your boring, lifeless desktop screen into an exciting warzone!
Build your warband:
Buy minions from the shop, or high-roll them from the slot machine! Train an army of fire-breathing dragons or raise a horde of the undead to destroy your adversaries. Civilly, of course.
Learn spells:
Spells are crucial in turning a battle in your favor. Conjure a fiery Meteor from the heavens, bring down enemy flyers with a deadly Tornado, or melt them down with an Acid Rain!

title: Heroes Unhinged
description:
게임 정보
In a world where justice is no longer blind, superheroes have abandoned their moral restraints and taken the law into their own hands. Welcome to Heroes Unhinged, an action roguelike game where raw power reigns supreme, and the lines between hero and villain blur into chaos.
As one of the world's most powerful beings, you are judge, jury, and executioner. The city is your battlefield, and criminals are your prey. Tear through buildings with explosive energy blasts, hurl vehicles, and crash through entire city blocks as you hunt down the scum that plague society. No prisons. No second chances. Just brutal, unrelenting justice.
Destroy everything on the map to wipe it clean of criminal scum.
20+ Heroes with varying play styles and abilities.
5 different locations to destroy.
Fine tune your stats with power points.
Enhanced enemies have a chance to drop crystals that upgrade stats.
Enemies and structures become stronger with every structure destroyed.
Collect crystal fragments to unlock characters and purchase items.
Eliminate crystal runners for bonus fragments and crystals. 
After destroying everything, face a super villain to complete your mission.

title: Hanako's Flower Shop
description:
게임 정보
Hanako, a young woman at a crossroads in her life, takes on the challenge of running her grandpa’s beloved flower shop. Hanako’s Flower Shop is a heartwarming coming-of-age visual novel with resource management elements, where every flower tells a story and every bouquet has the power to heal.
Guided by her deep admiration for her grandpa, a renowned florist known for his unparalleled skill and compassion, Hanako is determined to uphold his legacy. But as she navigates the pressures of living up to her grandpa’s reputation and the fear of falling short of his greatness, she begins to wonder: can she ever truly fill his shoes?

title: Solaro
description:
게임 정보
A lone traveller wakes up deep in space, their location unknown, and memories erased. Where did they come from? How did they end up in this forgotten sector of the galaxy, with its strange inhabitants and cryptic puzzles? A road of discovery awaits, passing deadly obstacles on its way to the heart of this mysterious world...
Master unique styles of movement by harnessing natural forces of the universe. Gravity, wind, magnetic fields and other features of the environment guide your motion across space and inside the atmosphere. A cryptic puzzle guards the entrance to each new planet, and deadly trials stand between you and the realm's darkest secrets...

title: Explory Story
description:
게임 정보

Our highly detailed worlds involve beautiful hand-drawn pixel scenery and thoughtful stories. The text on the floor can be interacted with, leading to a huge variety of effects and experiences. Reading and engaging with the text are crucial for progressing through the puzzles. Additionally, many secret interactions and hidden locations are spread out throughout the game.


Progressing through each level will involve cleverly interacting with objects and text. In some cases, you will be tasked with restoring context to a sentence; in other cases, you will be crafting entirely new and highly variable phrases.


Explory Story contains a boss at the end of each Act. That means 4+ entirely unique boss fights with unique mechanics and challenges. These can be undertaken alone or together with a friend. Additionally, each boss has variants that you can access by engaging with the story.

title: Stickge
description:
게임 정보
Stickforge – the moddable and funny multiplayer stickman game
Welcome to Stickforge, where the laws of physics are more like guidelines. If you’ve ever wanted to create your own stickman game with custom weapons, items, enemies, or program an army of hostile rubber ducks, this is your moment.
From the creator of BattleStick, Stickforge cranks up the fun with full modding support. Design , , , , and . Host your own server, invite friends (or total strangers), and unleash your creations in ways that would probably be illegal in real life.

title: Morphing Bullets
description:
게임 정보
Morphing Bullets
Immerse yourself in a third-person shooter that redefines classic action.
It's not just about precise aiming – your tactical skills determine the outcome as you turn death into an opportunity to shift the tide of battle.
Gameplay That Redefines Death
Death is not the end – it's the beginning of a tactical shift.
When your character falls, a unique transformation takes place: Morph into alternative combat forms, such as a mechanical spider sweeping enemies off the ground or a fiery barrier securing key pathways.
Some morphs last until the end of the match, providing a lasting strategic advantage. Every defeat becomes a stepping stone for a clever comeback.
Multiplayer
Engage in intense battles with up to 31 other players – on your own dedicated server or via Steam’s peer-to-peer mode. Choose your maps, game modes, and battle duration for a customized experience.
Different Characters
Choose from five unique characters, each with their own playstyle and strengths. Whether you prefer high damage, increased speed, or strong defense, every hero offers tailored advantages to enhance gameplay variety.
Aura Skills
Each character possesses an exclusive Aura Skill that can turn the tide of battle.
These special abilities are not always available – they require collecting Aura Points, earned by completing objectives or morphing enemies.
Strategic management of your Aura Points is key – will you activate a protective team shield or become nearly invisible for a short time?
Aura Weapons

title: Neural Edge
description:
게임 정보
From the developer: Dear friends, this game is not a hate piece against neural networks. Rather, it is a multifaceted reflection on the new reality.
🐙 Simple gameplay keeps the focus on the story. Can you uncover every ending?
🐙 Almost everything here is sculpted from clay. What could be more human than that...?
🐙 A short story filled with big questions. Is a human truly better than a neural network? Find your own answer.

title: Skyline Savior
description:
게임 정보
Get ready to dive into the high-speed, action-packed world of Skyline Savior!

Take control of Sam’s car and navigate through a series of exciting and challenging environments. With a unique set of abilities at your disposal, you’ll need to overcome difficult obstacles to become the ultimate hero of the skies.

Thrilling Gameplay Mechanics

Arcadey Car Movement: Enjoy smooth, responsive driving with the ability to jump, dash, and perform awesome stunts.


Magnet: Use the car’s magnet to interact with various magnets around the map, overcoming obstacles by attracting or repelling the car.


Slow Motion: Slow down time to navigate through tricky sequences and nail those precise maneuvers. You are falling down? Slow the time down so you can afford waiting for the dash cooldown to end.

title: Adhvan Chakra
description:
게임 정보
Command powerful aerial units known as Vaahans, and lead your squadron of airborne warriors to victory with innovative macro-based controls.
Command and manage a wide variety of unique Vaahans, each with distinct abilities and tactics, to outsmart relentless enemy factions.
Turn the tide of battle by strategically altering the attack, defense, and speed of your units and even your opponents. With fully simulated physics, every unit and object react dynamically. Manipulate enemy mass and speed to outmaneuver and overpower them.
The enemy is relentless. Gather every resource you can and extract before it's too late.
Outsmart your foes through in-depth research and analysis. Encounter a vast array of enemies, each with unique traits to study. Challenge powerful bosses at any time; but victory demands matching their firepower.
Discover the Gorger system: a revolutionary RPG elemental interaction mechanic where a unit's composition defines its resistances and vulnerabilities. Study your opponents' physical traits, analyze their constitution, and exploit their weaknesses to gain the upper hand.

title: Dreadveil
description:
게임 정보
SLOW PACED ATMOSPHERIC HORROR
Explore decrepit cities, claustrophobic caves, forests and even the wastelands of Antarctica. Avoid and hide from the unnatural monsters around you. Listen for the footsteps and wheezing through doors, while limping to the next drawer or cabinet, hoping to find anything to help you.
BALANCE RESOURCES FOR THE SHORT- AND LONG-TERM
Manage what little supplies you find to push problems into the future while making tough short-term sacrifices to solve more pressing issues.
Spend time to cook a can of meat into more nutritional value or medicate your terminal illness? Leave behind a vital crafting component for some bandages to patch up a bleeding wound?
There is never enough options to solve everything, be careful and stay hidden from the terrible monstrosities that now skulk this world.
PERMA-DEATH MECHANICS AND RANDOMIZATION
Dreadveil features randomized environments with handmade rooms and assets. The slow-paced horror mixed with the nervousness of losing your progress when dying creates a tense, sometimes panicked experience when things go wrong. Something spots you, doors swing open, gunshots and screaming monsters.

title: Shrink Rooms
description:
게임 정보
The basic gameplay of Shrink Rooms is to solve puzzles by pushing boxes.
Different from other puzzle games, the walls of the level's room will contract inward at the end of each round. You must accurately plan the number of steps for pushing boxes to escape from the secret room, so as to avoid being crushed into a puddle of flesh by the walls.
There are various interesting mechanisms in the shrink rooms. The characteristics of different mechanisms are combined to generate many puzzles with rich variations and high difficulty. Welcome to challenge!
