title: Sheep Sweep
description:
게임 정보
오래 전 칼라와 에리스는 화목하게 살았어요. 하지만 구피 토네이도의 공격으로 모든 것이 바뀌었죠. 구피 토네이도는 양들을 전 세계로 휩쓸고 갔고, 양들을 구하기 위해 칼라와 에리스 두 목자만 남았죠. 양치기들은 매우 회복력이 뛰어나지만, 누군가를 구하기까지 많은 어려움을 겪어야 합니다. 여러분은 이 모험을 감당할 만큼 용감한가요?






팀워크와 소통이 게임의 장애물을 극복하는 데 핵심이 되는 로컬 2인 협동 게임플레이에 참여하세요.




아름답게 제작된 싱글 플레이어 모드에서 혼자서 칼라 또는 에리스가 되어 독특한 도전과 퍼즐을 해결해 보세요.




영웅이 되어 마을에서 길을 잃고 구조를 기다리는 양들을 찾아 구하는 퀘스트를 수행하세요.




불타는 지형을 전략적으로 탐색하고, 도구와 영리한 사고로 불길을 관리하고 진압하세요.




모든 도전을 즐거운 실수로 바꿔주는 재미있는 물리와 래그돌 효과와 함께 웃어보세요.




예술적으로 풍부한 환경을 가로지르며 각 섬마다 퍼즐만큼이나 독특한 시각적 즐거움을 선사합니다.



- 2인 로컬 협동 플레이
- 솔로 플레이
- 재미있는 물리학과 래그돌
- 퍼즐을 풀고 양을 위험에서 구하세요!
- 가연성 및 소화성 세계
- 리더 보드
- 이스터 에그 수집
- 키보드 및 컨트롤러 지원
- 매우 광범위한 지원

title: Galactic Tavern
description:
게임 정보
우주 술집을 건설하고 관리하며 우주로 떠나는 여정을 떠나보세요! 이국적인 재료를 발견하고, 독특한 칵테일을 만들고, 라이브 음악 공연으로 활기찬 분위기를 조성하세요. 우주의 심연을 탐험하며 이 경영 시뮬레이션 모험에서 궁극의 기업가가 되어보세요!
위시리스트!
오늘 위시리스트에 추가하고 게임 개발에 대한 업데이트를 팔로우하세요.


Galactic Tavern에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 여기서 당신은 당신만의 성간 바를 건설, 관리 및 확장할 수 있는 궁극의 우주 모험을 경험할 수 있습니다. 우주의 생생한 한 구석에 위치한 Galactic Tavern은 은하계에서 가장 유명한 술집 주인이 되기 위한 여정에 당신을 초대합니다.

주요 특징:

🌌 우주 술집 커스터마이징: 우주 술집을 디자인하고 커스터마이징하여 은하계 전체에서 고객을 유치하세요.

🌟 이국적인 믹솔로지: 우주 모험에서 발견한 희귀 재료를 사용하여 다양한 우주 칵테일을 만들어 제공하세요.

👨‍🌾 우주 농업: 신선한 재료를 재배하여 음료와 요리에 사용할 수 있는 우주 농장을 직접 관리하세요. 고객에게 최상의 품질을 제공합니다.

🚀 은하 탐험: 새로운 레시피, 재료 및 보물을 발견하기 위해 용감한 탐험가들을 무모한 임무에 보내세요.

🎵 엔터테인먼트 스펙터클: 재능 있는 밴드의 라이브 음악 공연으로 고객을 즐겁게 하고 전기 같은 분위기를 만드세요.

💫 제국 확장: 시설을 업그레이드하고 시설을 확장하며 은하계 전체에서 새로운 고객을 유치하여 술집 제국을 확장하세요.

모험을 경험하세요:

Galactic Tavern은 경영 시뮬레이션, 탐험 및 우주 모험의 독특한 조합을 제공합니다. 칵테일을 만들거나 외계의 미식을 발견하거나 새로운 영토를 탐험하는 등, 이 우주적 여정에서 당신의 창업 및 발견을 경험할 수 있습니다.

여정을 시작하세요:

궁극의 우주 술집 모험을 시작할 준비가 되었나요? 재료를 모으고, 음악을 준비하고, Galactic Tavern에서 잊지 못할 여정을 떠나보세요!

title: Meat Fest
description:
게임 정보
Meat Fest is a dynamic shooter with soulslike elements, arenas and corridors, secrets, traps and its own story. Built on the foundation of good old shooters, it raises the social problems of society.

To answer questions you will have to use a wide arsenal of weapons, an ax, and a suit to protect and dodge fatal blows and dangerous fauna. Collect the story piece by piece to get to the truth, which, as always, lurks somewhere nearby.
STORY
Humanity was forced to leave their home planet and settle on Radix, where leaders tell new generations that the Earth was destroyed as a result of natural disasters. Combat geneticist Marcus Berger, studying samples from the homeland of people, begins to realize how false such statements about the death of the world are. He becomes increasingly immersed in the search for truth and reaches out to black market dealers, consisting mainly of the opposition. His native corporation begins to see him as a dangerous unit and Marcus escapes from Radix, deciding to find answers on Earth. The player will have to face the current inhabitants of the cradle of humanity and find evidence of the theory of a man-made disaster, because of which the world has turned into hell.
MORE
Combine your attacks

title: T.D.Z. 4 Heart of Pripyat
description:
게임 정보
You have to go through this difficult path from a beginner to a seasoned stalker and uncover the mystery of your own father's disappearance!
T.D.Z. 4 The Heart of Pripyat is a game that will draw you in with its amazing atmosphere from the first seconds! Gray sky, rain, campfire dialogues with loyal stalker friends, mutants, anomalies are just a small part of what awaits you in this 1st-person action-adventure shooter! Explore the abandoned locations of the mysterious Exclusion Zone, shoot back mutants, search caches of ammunition and food, complete tasks of stalker friends and reach the very Pripyat to see the finale of this amazing story!
►Game Features◄
☢️ Freedom of action! You can explore the stunning beauty of the location, as well as complete the tasks of other stalkers, earning new equipment!
☢️ A large selection of items! 7 types of weapons, bolts, grenades, first aid kits, anomaly detectors, food and much more in your arsenal for survival in a dangerous zone!
☢️ A mixture of genres in one bottle! Horror, Survival, Action Shooter in one game and at once!
☢️ Convenient controls will appeal to everyone!
☢️ Stunning graphics!
☢️ Dynamic storyline!

title: Potatogeddon
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready for a potato revolution? Step into the role of an extraordinary hero – a potato who infiltrates the secret base of potato beetles and other creatures feeding on delicious and magnificent potatoes to stop their sinister plan to destroy the world's potato crops!
Potatogeddon is a dynamic first-person FPS game with roguelike elements that will immerse you in fast-paced action and humorous battles. Explore procedurally generated corridors of the enemy base, collect unique upgrades, and fight hordes of enraged beetles, mutants, and mechanical creatures standing in your way. Each attempt to beat the game is a completely new experience – with randomly generated levels, enemies, and items, no two runs are ever the same!
Game Features:
Fast, crazy FPS action – shoot, dodge, and fight against enemies in intense battles.
Procedurally generated levels – each playthrough offers new challenges, unique level layouts, and items.
Roguelike elements – face new combinations of upgrades, enemies, and challenges with every attempt, making each run a unique experience.
Co-op mode for up to 4 players – join forces with friends to avoid annihilation. Defeat enemies together and become potato heroes.
Humorous tone and stylized graphics – a comedic approach to a serious mission combined with a unique art style makes the game perfect for solo players and teams alike.
Take on the challenge in Potatogeddon and prove that the potato is king! 🥔

title: ADA: Tainted Soil
description:
게임 정보
ADA: Tainted Soil is a story-driven adventure filled with unique characters and their own storylines. In this top-down action RPG with fast-paced combat, you’ll fight your way through hordes of diverse enemies with unique behavior and design. Be prepared to explore a vast, cruel world crafted pixel by pixel with passion and love. You’ll unlock and upgrade skills, equip your favorite ones, and forge your character. On your journey, you’ll brew potions and other powerful consumables, and forage land for ingredients to combine them. Remember always to be prepared, as the world around you constantly changes. You never know what you will run into, be it at night or daytime.



"I could swear I knew that forest, but so many things have changed"

The vast and cruel world of Ada is waiting for you to explore. You can choose whichever path you want as long as you can fight your way through encountered enemies. Find all secrets scattered across the land and water, and use the fast travel option to speed up your journey. Find your own way on your journey through carefully handcrafted and designed zones.


Combat in Ada is based on a combination of a basic attack routine with a secondary skill of your choice and potions/consumables. Every fight could end well with proper movement and dodging. Be prepared, observe, adapt, and survive.

Enemies in Ada are carefully designed to bring the highest amount of fair difficulty to the game. They are unique both visually and mechanically. Some will attack you alone with big combos or swings, and others will be fast, agile, and evade your attack, while others may group up to get you with numbers. Prepare for epic encounters with main and side bosses that fit the zone you are exploring.


You'll meet Ada, and as much as you'd want her to have an everyday, happy life, it's not possible in this land, at this time, in this world. Any job would be better than that, but there's no other one for you...

Immerse yourself in a story brimming with mystery and the pangs of solitude. This land is a place of constant surprises, where nothing is as it seems, and everything is a departure from your memories. Engage with the characters, delve into their storylines, and embark on quests. Each one is a unique tale with its own distinct character and appearance.

Traces of the land's history, rich and diverse, can be discovered strewn along your path. Whether in the form of paintings or vivid flashbacks, they reveal ancient battles, transforming dilapidated ruins into majestic castles, or significant historical events that shaped the world you now explore.


Use alchemy to create valuable potions and heal or boost your abilities. Your mixtures can also be thrown at enemies to harm, confuse, stun, or even turn them against each other. Collect herbs, crystals, vials, and other ingredients to create powerful potions. Each comes in different sizes, and the bigger the size, the stronger the explosion.

Potions can also help interact with the environment, burning things down or freezing the water. Who knows what that might mean for you and your exploration of the world of Ada...

title: Vertigo Rush
description:
게임 정보
Vertigo Rush is a virtual reality racing experience that combines speed and parkour in an intense physical challenge. Players control agile robots, propelling them through vast, detailed environments by moving their own arms in a heart-pumping race.
Inspired by the mechanics of classic arcade racing games, each level is crafted to test player’s skill and endurance as they race through Haven's floating cities.
• Competitive Online Multiplayer up to 12 Players in Each Race with Global Ranking System, Time Trial Mode, Character & Robot Customization and Cross-Platform Play.
• Polished full-body physical control for high-speed parkour racing, with fluid and satisfying movement mechanics (jumps, climbing, running) designed for an exhilarating VR experience.
• Immersive and emotionally engaging narrative: In a world divided between floating opulence and terrestrial struggle, two ingenious siblings defy their destiny in robot races to save themselves from oppression and rewrite their future.

title: Umami Grove
description:
게임 정보
Umami Grove는 물리 기반 VR 어드벤처 게임으로, 위험에 맞서며 요리 실력을 연마해 최고의 상인 골드를 받는 게임입니다! 도토리 모양으로 말이죠. 어쩌면 마법이 걸렸을지도?
특징
멋진 세계를 여행하고, 매력적인 생물을 만나고, 요리하세요! (보통은 요리를 만들어 줘야 해요.)
손과 주변 환경을 이용해 난관을 극복하세요! 보통은 물고기를 던진다고 문제가 해결되지 않지만, 해보지 않으면 모릅니다.
저 나무를 타고 올라 사과를 딸 수 있고, 테이블 위의 버섯을 마구 자를 수 있습니다! 강력한 물리 엔진과 손을 사용해 요리를 마음껏 체험하세요.
다양한 방법으로 도울 수 있는 캐릭터들을 만나세요! 침대로 돌아갈 수 있게 도와주고, 식사를 만들어 주고, 때로는 실수로 물건을 망가뜨리지 않게 조심하세요!
이 도토리들이 무엇인지 잘 생각해보세요!

title: Touching Grass Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Have you touched grass today?
In Touching Grass Simulator, embark on the ultimate quest to reclaim nature, one blade of grass at a time. This quirky and satisfying incremental game lets you grow, manage, and nurture a sprawling field of grass, transforming a barren plot into a lush paradise.
Whether you're planting seeds, upgrading your tools, or automating the process, there's always something to do. Perfect for fans of relaxing, incremental games—or anyone who could use a virtual break from the chaos of daily life.
Will you master the art of grass cultivation and become the ultimate Grass Tycoon? Or will you simply enjoy the chill vibes of watching grass grow?
Key Features
Grow Grass, Literally: Plant seeds, watch grass grow, and keep expanding your green empire.
Incremental Gameplay: Start small and progress into managing an endless field of grass with upgrades, tools, and automation.
Relax and Unwind: Enjoy a calming and therapeutic gameplay experience with satisfying visuals and sound effects.
Upgrade and Automate: Unlock advanced tools, sprinklers, and other upgrades to maximize your growth potential.
Humor and Charm: Packed with tongue-in-cheek humor and nods to the "Touch Grass" meme.
Dynamic Progression: From a single blade of grass to a sprawling, self-sustaining lawn—it's all up to you!
Why Play Touching Grass Simulator?
Need a break? Touch grass—virtually!
Love incremental games? You’ll enjoy the steady flow of upgrades and satisfying growth loops.
Searching for something funny, yet relaxing? This game offers a perfect mix of humor and chill gameplay.
Get ready to touch grass in the most satisfying way possible.
Touching Grass Simulator—it’s more fun than it has any right to be! 🌱

title: Eden: Discovery
description:
게임 정보
EDEN: Discovery is a post-apocalyptic first-person extraction shooter where 20 players enter a dangerous wasteland, each armed with a primary and secondary weapon. Your goal is simple: loot and reach an extraction point before time runs out—or risk losing everything you carry. Players can scavenge gear from crates, defeat AI threats guarding valuable supplies, or take down rival players to claim their loot. If you’re killed, all your equipment drops, and your killer can pick it up. Multiple players can extract and win if they survive; in some matches, no one makes it out alive.
Key Features:
• High-Stakes Extraction
Gather gear from crates, fallen foes, or AI-guarded areas, then make it to the exfil point to secure your haul. Dying means you lose everything you’ve collected.
• In-Game Currency & Tournaments
Earn and spend in-game currency on gear or enter buy-in matches. Settle your score with 1v1 showdowns where you compete for loot or currency.
• Social Spaces
Between matches, return to a shared hub where you can relax, plan your next raid, and trade with other players. This space is persistent, keeping your prized gear on display.
• Future Creative Mode
Build your own maps and game modes for others to explore. Host custom matches where you control the rules, bringing new challenges and fun to the community.
• Multiple Paths to Victory
Survive the wasteland, escape on time, or challenge rivals 1v1. Whether you’re outsmarting AI threats or battling other players, every decision can lead to glory—or complete loss.
EDEN: Discovery blends tense firefights with meaningful risk and reward. It’s not just about shooting—it’s about planning your loadout, picking your battles, and deciding when to cut your losses. Welcome to a world where every match carries real consequences, and only the savviest competitors come out on top.
• Marketplace & Player Economy
Every item you find or craft holds real worth. Trade gear with others using the in-game currency, fueling a player-driven economy.
• PvPvE Gameplay
Face tense firefights against human players while dealing with AI adversaries guarding high-tier loot and strategic locations.

title: Train Kingdom
description:
게임 정보
Set in the United States of the 19th century.
It is a game that aims to acquire all railway lines by trading.
Get a railroad permit and open a new city.
Make money by trading, research technology, and upgrade your locomotive.
Technological research can evolve steam locomotives.
Let's challenge the quest!
Major features
Set in 19th century America
Get a railroad network that connects cities in the United States during the pioneering era
Use locomotives to carry supplies and passengers
Develop technology and evolve locomotives. The evolved locomotive can carry a lot of supplies at once.
Bring your necessities to the city and increase the satisfaction of your residents.
Clear the request from the mayor and raise your fame!
It costs a lot to get the whole rail network
Make money through trade!

title: Rock Paper Scissors ULTIMATE
description:
게임 정보
Rock Paper Scissors ULTIMATE is a roguelike deckbuilder that features the classic gameplay of the "Rock, Paper, Scissors" but with the ability to enhance the offensive and defensive stats while maintaining the hit points of each tool by using different types of cards.

Rock beats Scissors,
Scissors beats Paper,
Paper beats Rock.

Their offensive and defensive abilities, as well as the gameplay actions and reactions can be modified by placing certain cards in the tools' representative panel slots.

The four type of cards:

Clubs: enhances the damage dealing abilities.
Spades: affects the defensive capabilities.
Hearts: hit points related skills.
Diamonds: magic tricks.

Carefully selecting cards based on SYNERGIES makes the tools significantly more powerful.

You will need to play on the synergies, since opponents must be defeated within a certain number of rounds, and as the game progresses they get tougher with more and more dirty tricks up their sleeves.
The number of rounds that can be played in a set can be selected from the randomly given dices. Got some strong combo in your hand? Pick a high round number. Got unlucky pulls? Go for a lower one.

Make sure you pick the right cards for the right slots and choose an appropriate round number, since the selection of Rock, Paper or Scissors will be random for you and your opponent as well.

Collected some money along the way? Feel free to spend it in the shop where stat boosters, other cards and services can be purchased. Or spin the slot machine for a small fee to win something small or big.

One more thing.

Try not to lose any from the Rock, Paper, Scissors trio, since winning without having all of them is very difficult...






But given the right synergies...

title: Klaus Lee - Thunderballs
description:
게임 정보

Dive deep through the neon-hued brash and bawdy '80s inspired classic 2D action-platformer with your favorite BADASS Kraut, Klaus Lee! Dust off your jetpack, grab your dynamite, and prepare your laser eyes to dive deep into Klaus' first challenging adventure!


You remember Klaus Lee, right?! No? Well, you should! He almost became a cop in Beverly Hills but then applied to be a private investigator in Hawaii and got bored waiting to find out if he got it. Moving back to Cali, he worked as an unknown stuntman while running a squad of troubleshooters that kept getting beaten to the clients by A much more successful Team. One time he barely missed his job interview at a New York startup and some dude named Zeddemore got the job as an exterminator of spirits.
Did you know that Klaus trained Maverick how to both fly his jet and play killer beach volleyball? This is only a glimpse of everything he experienced living life to the max. Klaus was a really busy guy!



This is the first chapter of the famous action hero Klaus Lee. He was the role model for Colt Seavers, he made Chuck Norris walk as a toddler and prepared some water for Bruce Lee. He dated all Charlie's Angels at the same time in the same restaurant at different tables and he taught Steve McQueen how to drive a car. We are honored to work with him.



Strap on your experimental jetpack and fly through caves, dodge nasty insects, temple traps, and other hazards. But beware: fuel is not an infinite resource.



The unknown creators of the secret temples build puzzles to keep intruders out of their sacred caves. Are you smart enough to solve them?



Riddles aren't the only thing keeping unwanted visitors away, you have to prove your skills against cursed walls, chasing spirits, moving stones, and other threads.



Create, play and share your own levels with other players in the Steam Workshop. Jump in the level editor and discover the countless possibilities.


- Classic platforming action with attitude
- Over 100 levels created by our cruel level designers
- Build your own levels with the comfortable level editor
- Share your level creations cross-platform with the world
- Discover a potentially endless number of user-generated levels

title: OVERLOOK
description:
게임 정보
Search for missing people, lost objects, or even help people solve their problems by handing them over their required items. OVERLOOK is hand-drawn, cozy, relaxing, and funny. btw, watch! there might be a cat hidden in bushes.
Let's hang out and talk




OVERLOOK is a zen game about people and other creatures living their lives in different tiny cute places and the game has got Meditative gameplay, perfect for relaxing in nowadays stressful situations.
you could find hidden/ missing objects in the scene by solving mini-puzzles or simply by looking around and finding the object based on the given clues that you have. or you would help people by solving their needs and issues. hand over a cog to the mechanic guy or help to slice an apple using the lumberjack's ax.
or just watching people do their things and just enjoy the relaxing original lo-fi soundtrack of the game.
a satisfying and mysterious world with 50+ delightful hidden surprises to discover with charming hand-drawn animations and unexpected scenarios.
gameplay includes:
Solve puzzles by arranging objects.
unpack the untold stories
FEATURES:
Over 50+ unique characters/ creatures
Simple, joyful, quick-to-solve puzzles, and satisfying game-play
Intuitive drag and drop controls
Original lo-fi Soundtrack
Multiple choices to make and multiple outcomes
Environmental storytelling
Charming all hand-drawn graphics
Cute hand-drawn animations
Atmospheric sound design

title: Multiverse Designer
description:
게임 정보
UNLOCK THE POWER OF INFINITE STORYTELLING!
Multiverse Designer is an innovative 3D virtual tabletop and map creator, a unique toolbox to empower storytellers and create the most immersive RPG experiences. Save hours of your time creating awe-inspiring setpieces with thousands of 3D assets, effects and features thanks to its procedural generation systems and intuitive drag-and-drop UI; or customize everything to its finest detail, from texture to lights or colors. Put your players or yourself in the heros' boots, exploring your creations with real-time fog of war and dynamic lights and shadows. You can even create epic cutscenes with animated assets, camera angles and dialogues!
Use your creations to play any game, any genre, any setting -- from fantasy to sci-fi, from horror to comedy. Multiverse Designer includes Criteria, an easy-to-learn scripting language that you can use to implement rules and character sheets, automate events, or even include RPG rulesets of your own creation in the game, so Multiverse Designer takes care of all the bookkeeping for you!
Multiverse Designer is more than just a software. It’s a venue for your creativity, expression, and entertainment. It’s a way to unleash your imagination and live your dreams. It’s a path to become a storyteller!
CREATE EPIC CUTSCENES

title: VTumbler
description:
게임 정보
VTumbler brings your favorite Oshi to the world of Arcade Puzzle Fighting! Brought to you by FeFe and friends, you can compete for the strategic win with your friends, random strangers, or train with a CPU!

title: Sinned Arena
description:
게임 정보
Sinned Arena is a classic arena shooter inspired by timeless 90s games. You are trapped in Hell with other unfortunate souls, fighting among each other for demons twisted pleasures. Fight for your way out of this dark place but beware, demons aren't there just to watch.
Single player

Engage in Single player in two different ways:
Play Campaign mode where you go through predefined Deathmatch maps with progressively increasing difficulty of your opponents.
Play Skirmish mode where you can tailor the gameplay experience to your liking. You can choose game mode, map, score goal, number of opponents and their skills. You can also spice up your experience with Mutators that are adding various modifiers to the game.

Game modes

The game offers 5 game modes: Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Heartcore, Instagib and Team Instagib

Deathmatch is a classic Free For All mode, where you are winning by being first to get required amount of kills.
Team Deathmatch is a team variant of Deathmatch mode where goal is again reaching required amount of kills but score of your teammates counts as well.

Heartcore is a team mode where goal is to destroy a heart inside of enemy base. First team to destroy enemy heart wins.

Instagib a Team Instagib are similar to Deathmatch or Team Deatchmatch modes but this time, you only have one weapon at your disposal and it turns your opponents into bunch of gibs with a single shot.


Throughout the game, you are collecting all sorts of weapon relics and character relics. Weapon relics serves as a way to make your weapons more powerful or even change their functionality entirely while character relics are giving you unique bonuses to your character or upgrading your base stats. There are several ways to obtain relics such as challenging your opponents to a duel. Winning in a duel will give you opponent's relic but be careful, opponents can challenge you for your own relic as well.

title: The Schism
description:
게임 정보
현실 사이에 균열이 생겼고 그들은 이를 분열"이라고 부릅니다. The Schism은 1~8인용 온라인 협동 공포 게임으로, 여러분과 과학자 팀은 정부의 봉쇄 계획을 지원하기 위해 유용한 정보를 수집해야 합니다. 귀하의 팀은 손상된 위치에 들어가 중요한 정보를 수집하는 작업을 시작합니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 당신은 혼자가 아닙니다.

\r\n\r\n목표[\/b]\r\n\r\n

명망 높은 과학자 팀의 일원으로서 당신은 수많은 목표를 완수해야 하는 임무를 맡게 될 것입니다. 감시 설정부터 샘플 수집까지 매번 독특한 게임플레이 경험을 선사할 것입니다. 당신의 팀은 스텔스와 강철의 신경이라는 중요한 기술을 숙달해야 합니다. 적을 피하고 숨어서 성공하세요.

\r\n\r\n고유한 야수[\/b]\r\n\r\n

고유한 몬스터의 수가 증가함에 따라 The Schism을 플레이할 때마다 새로운 만남과 함께 새로운 두려움에 직면하게 됩니다. 변신부터 지능, 순수한 힘과 힘까지, 게임플레이를 항상 신선하게 보장하는 무한한 잠재적 시나리오가 있습니다.

\r\n\r\n지도[\/b]\r\n\r\n

여기 는 수많은 새로운 위치에 대한 계획과 함께 잠재적인 공포의 놀이터 목록이 점점 늘어나고 있습니다.
\r\n\r\n멀티플레이어[\/b]\r\n\r\n

친구들과 함께 게임을 경험해 보세요! 팀워크가 기회를 높일 뿐만 아니라, 친구의 불행한 죽음으로 인한 히스테리보다 더 우스꽝스러운 것은 없습니다.

\r\n\r\n계획[\/b]\r\n\r\n

엄청난 계획이 있습니다. 분열을 위해. 새로운 몬스터, 지도, 작업. 이름을 정할 수 있다면 우리가 계획한 것입니다. 새로운 콘텐츠가 기본이 될 것이므로 이 게임에 대한 투자는 안심하셔도 됩니다. 새로운 추가 사항에 대한 아이디어가 있으시면 Steam 리뷰 섹션을 통해 문의해 주세요."

title: MonoRace
description:
게임 정보
MonoRace is a cheerful monobike racing where you can explore tracks and get points by performing tricks. Try the game in VR and PC versions with unique controls.

Monobikes is an electric, self-balancing unicycles, and you need to lean your body to control them. We have transferred this control mechanism to the game.
In VR game lean forward to accelerate, lean back to brake and lean left or right to turn.
In PC version move a mouse to control your unicycle.

Experience the game:
There will be a lot of tracks available and there will be several race paths on each of them. You can ride the main path or you can take a short cut.
Get benefits by collecting bonuses.
Perform mortal tricks to get points and survive to the end without fail.
Be the quickest, or all your tricks point will be lost.
Lead in Leagues: complete exercises and get points to upgrade the unicycle and unlock new tracks.

Multiplayer mode: it's much more interesting to compete with other players and you will have this opportunity.

In training mode, you can try our unique control system and practice tricks.

title: Spring Tales
description:
게임 정보
Spring Tales welcomes you to Blossomdale a cozy town where the community is coming together to prepare for a spring festival after a devastating storm. The festival isn’t just a celebration of the new season, it’s a way for the townspeople to heal, rebuild, and lift each other’s spirits.
You’ll follow the lives of five unique characters as they navigate the challenges of recovery and festival preparation. You’ll help them solve puzzles and discover their stories along the way. It’s a game about friendship, teamwork, and the simple joys of coming together after hard times.

title: EYES ON THE EXAM
description:
게임 정보
Keep your eyes on the exam... Study the environment, answer the questions before time runs out, find secrets in the classroom and don't even think about looking directly at that... thing.
Improve your score in every game
Uncover dark secrets hidden in the classroom
Enjoy a 100% diegetic horror experience
You wake up at your desk in a dreary classroom run by a monstrous teacher. Your goal is to correctly answer as many questions as possible on the exam in front of you. How can you know the answers? Look around you, look at your classmates' exams, strain your eyes and study your surroundings...
But be careful, don't let the teacher catch you with your eyes off the exam or failing will be the least of your problems....

title: Alien Market Simulator
description:
게임 정보
은하 경찰에게 보석금을 내고 기회를 얻었습니다. 하지만 조건이 있습니다. 당신은 먼 미지의 행성에 있는 우주 정거장을 관리해야 합니다.
그러나 이것이 당신이 꿈꾸던 자유는 아닙니다. 매일 정거장의 시스템에 접속하여 당신의 가치를 증명해야만 합니다. 주어진 임무를 완수해야만 완전한 자유를 되찾을 수 있습니다.
우주 정거장을 수리하고 운영하며 관리하세요.
외계 여행자들에게 간식과 연료 같은 필수 서비스를 제공하세요.
크레딧을 벌어 정거장을 확장하고 자신만의 스타일로 커스터마이징하세요.
그러나 조심하세요—자유로 가는 길은 도전, 수상한 기회, 그리고 끝없는 외계인 손님들로 가득 차 있습니다.
우주 정거장을 관리하세요:
활기찬 외계 시장을 운영하면서 정거장을 수리하고 업그레이드하세요.
외계 여행자들에게 간식, 연료, 다양한 상품을 제공하는 필수 방문지로 만드세요.
정거장을 청소하고 유지보수하세요:
깨끗하고 제대로 작동하는 정거장을 유지하면 외계인 손님들이 좋은 경험을 하게 됩니다.
정거장이 청결할수록 더 많은 손님들이 다시 방문할 것입니다.

title: Motocross Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Motocross Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1980s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 15 motocross bikes from 40 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your motocross bike with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

title: 挂到1000级-Idle to level 1000
description:
게임 정보
This is a simple idle game. The core gameplay of the game is to rationally allocate attribute points for different classes and equip them with gear suitable for their respective classes. Only in this way can characters deal massive damage and instantly defeat monsters.
The main gameplay features include:
Normal Maps: Explore different areas on the map, ranging from easy to difficult.
Trial Tower: Each floor of the Trial Tower has a monster, and the difficulty increases successively. It drops high - level book fragments, refinement stones, evolution gems, divine equipment fragments, and so on. After defeating one monster, you can automatically challenge the next one until you are defeated.
Equipment: Equipment is divided into ordinary equipment, divine equipment, and evolved equipment.
The attributes of ordinary equipment are randomly generated.
Divine equipment has no level requirement. Its hidden attribute values can increase significantly as the character's level and attributes grow. However, this type of equipment is very rare in map drops and requires good luck. You can also obtain divine equipment fragments in the Trial Tower and use them to synthesize the complete equipment.
Evolved equipment is a special type of equipment that can be evolved. It requires a relatively high level to be worn. It also has hidden attributes, and its attribute values increase significantly with the evolution level and the growth of equipment attribute points.
Mining: Sometimes, when you need to obtain more gems, you can go to the gem mine to mine. Mining is automated. You just need to collect the gems after a certain period.
Smelting: In the smelting system, you can synthesize books, refine equipment, and combine divine equipment fragments into complete divine equipment.
Quests: There is a series of quests in the game. Completing these quests can earn you diamonds, which can be used to purchase special items in the store.
Currency: There are only two types of currency in the game, gold coins and diamonds. Gold coins can be obtained by selling ordinary equipment, while diamonds can be obtained by completing quests or selling purple - grade equipment.

title: Paradise Beach Simulator
description:
게임 정보

Paradise Beach Simulator는 천국의 섬에서 사업을 시작하는 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
모든 것을 포기하고 천국의 섬에서 다시 시작하다!
장비와 장식품을 주문하고 특급 배가 배달하길 기다리세요. 첫 번째 수건을 배치하여 고객들을 만족시키세요. 그들의 필요를 확인하면서 환영하세요.
🍹음료와 식사를 준비하세요

title: Lunaria Fantasia
description:
게임 정보
The magic kingdom’s court magician, Lunaria, is tasked with her allies to investigate a certain ruin. But when the party gets ambushed by some mysterious men, Lunaria’s magic gets stolen and she’s left with no powers!

When it’s discovered that Lunaria’s magic won’t recover naturally, she falls to utter despair. But not all hope is lost. Elder magicians speak of five great magicians and their prized treasures. If Lunaria can get her hands on those treasures, then her magic may recover! To help her friends and save herself, Lunaria ventures off on an adventure unlike any other!
Features:
Classic RPG Experience
Turn-based Combat
Leveling System
Skill System
Fantasy Setting

title: Hellfire: Wukong
description:
게임 정보
비범한 웅장함, 무한한 환상
환상적인 풍경, 전례 없는 광경, 현실이자 환상인 이 동양의 마법의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 운명의 사람으로서 당신은 서쪽으로 향하는 이상한 여행을 떠나게 될 것이며, 모든 단계는 새로운 놀라움과 도전을 가져올 것입니다. 아직 밝혀지지 않은 비밀을 탐험하고 장대한 모험 전설을 다시 써보세요.
마족들이 다시 나타나고, 마족들이 격렬하게 춤을 추고 있습니다.
유명한 여행자, 교활하고 변덕스러운 마왕. 서쪽으로 가는 길에는 아름다운 풍경뿐만 아니라, 수많은 강력한 적들이 당신의 도전을 기다리고 있습니다. 운명의 사람은 마지막 순간까지 이 길에서 수많은 몬스터와 몬스터들과 치열한 결투를 벌이게 된다.
땅이 흔들리고 산이 흔들리고 신통한 힘이 나타났습니다.
불멸의 기술을 배우고 무한한 변화를 배웠습니다. 다채로운 주문과 마법의 보물은 중국 신화에서 가장 고전적인 전투 요소를 구성합니다. 데스티니드 원은 다양한 스틱 스킬을 습득할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 다양한 주문, 변화, 재능, 무기, 방어구를 자유롭게 조합하여 자신에게 가장 적합한 전투 스타일을 찾을 수 있습니다.
모든 것은 끊임없이 변화하며 영혼을 감동시킵니다.
6가지 형태, 6가지 무기, 6가지 형태 및 6가지 감정. 적들의 교활함과 사악함은 표면에만 있을 뿐이며, 그들 뒤에 숨겨진 이야기는 종종 더 매력적입니다. 치열한 전투 외에도 데스티니는 다양한 캐릭터의 배경 이야기를 탐색하고 그들의 감정과 동기를 이해하며 그들의 사랑과 증오, 탐욕과 분노, 과거와 현재의 삶을 드러낼 것입니다.

title: DeadWire
description:
게임 정보
네온 빛이 가득한 사이버펑크 도시의 어둠 속으로 뛰어드세요, DeadWire—모든 적은 기회가 되고, 모든 물체는 무기가 됩니다.
빚쟁이지만 능숙한 해커인 당신은 자라온 고아원을 위협하는 강력한 범죄 조직을 무찔러야 합니다. 빠르게 전개되는 탑다운 슈터에서 최첨단 무기와 독특한 리와이어 모드로 전세를 역전시킬 수 있습니다.
DeadWire를 위시리스트하고 여러 소식을 받아보세요 (1인 개발자를 응원해주세요<3).
전장을 "리와이어" 하세요
리와이어 모드를 사용해 적, 차량 및 디바이스를 해킹하고 링크해 강력한 연쇄 반응을 일으키세요:
연쇄 반응: 경비를 근처 차량과 링크하세요—경비를 무력화하면 차량이 시동을 걸고 적을 쓸어버립니다.
디바이스 해킹: 오락기, ATM, 레이저 함정을 해킹해 적들을 상대로 활용하세요.
전략적 게임플레이: 주변의 여러 물체를 이용해 불리한 상황을 뒤짚어 적을 농락하세요.

title: GlitchSPANKR
description:
게임 정보
이 서사 중심의 탐험 게임에서 굶주린 바이러스 Spunk으로부터 당신의 게임을 구하세요! 친구를 사귀거나 파괴하고, 도전과 미니게임을 헤쳐나가며, 비밀을 밝혀내고, 커스터마이징을 잠금 해제하며, 다양한 결말을 탐험해 보세요. GlitchSPANKR의 안티바이러스 소프트웨어로 모든 레벨은 다르고 예상치 못한 것이 됩니다!
개요
힘든 하루를 보낸 후 당신은 단지 편안하게 쉬면서 가장 좋아하는 게임, Big Booty Slapper 6을 하고 싶을 뿐입니다! 불행하게도, 당신의 소중한 게임을 먹고 망가뜨리는 악성 바이러스가 있는 것 같습니다! GlitchSPANKR 안티바이러스 소프트웨어를 사용하여 가상 세계로 뛰어들어 그 Glitch를 패배시키세요! 아니면 그와 친구가 되세요. 아니면 그의 가련하고 못생기고 비참한 삶을 용서하세요. 아마도 그에게 키스를... 사랑에 빠지세요... 오, 음. 글쎄요, 선택할 수 있는 많은 옵션이 있습니다. 그냥... 들어가서 알아내세요.



물리 기반의 Spankin'과 Destructin', Spank-fu의 예술을 배우세요! 거의 모든 것이 깨지거나 상호 작용할 수 있습니다. 당신의 Spanking 손이 젖었나요? 공기 블로어로 말리세요! Spanking 손이 불에 탔나요? 글쎄, 그것은 안타깝네요. 그 빛이 싫나요? 젠장, 그것을 부수고 어둠 속에서 살아가세요! 당신의 게임을 먹는 그 말하는 화장실이 싫나요? 그 사악한 짐승을 패세요!



모든 결말을 찾기 위해 자신만의 길을 선택하세요, 모든 레벨은 다릅니다! Spunk가 당신의 소중한 Booty Slapper 6 게임을 파괴했다고 미워하나요? 그렇다면 그를 추적하여 자비를 베풀지 마세요! 그가 구원받을 수 있다고 생각하나요? 그를 용서하는 것을 고려하세요, 어쩌면 당신들은 친구가 될 수도 있습니다. 이 모든 것 뒤에 뭔가... 더 깊은 것이 있다고 생각하나요? 그렇다면 본능을 믿고 그것이 당신을 어디로 이끌지 보세요.



F...사랑에... 빠지다? 농담이에요... 아니면?

- 엉덩이를 때리나요?

실제로 Big Booty Slapper 6를 플레이할 수 있을까요? 시간이 말해줄 것입니다...

title: Apopia: Sugar Coated Tale
description:
게임 정보


APOPIA: SUGAR COATED TALE is a comedic adventure with dark mysteries. Help young girl Mai to find her way home. Progress by solving puzzles and outsmarting enemies in minigames. Make friends and foes with talking animals. Unravel the mystery of Mai’s identity from her dark and blurry memories.

As Mai, you will:

Explore the beautiful fantasy world. Get to know funny characters who are a cat, a mole, a lot of bunnies, and more. Each with unique personality and background story.
Solve creative puzzles along your way home.
Beat enemies... um, lower your fists... You'll beat them by outsmarting them in minigames.
Defeat dark bosses in rhythm games.
Discover the truth about your family and identity.











Catch a glimpse into a world before the events of Apopia Prologue. Learn why Moly was banished from her castle in this animated short. Watch and enhance your demo experience!

title: Secret of Sardinia
description:
게임 정보
Secret of Sardinia is an open-world adventure game full of mystery and mythology. It’s a combat-free fish experience with stealth elements and a focus on narrative. Swim, translate, listen, and explore!
Ancient Mythology
Locate magical bottles that contain the voices of departed souls, who speak their innermost thoughts as they live the last few days of their existence. Collect stone fragments to rebuild the Tablets of Ages – ancient writings which tell the forgotten lore of Sardinia. Closely examine the cryptic Tablets to translate its hieroglyphics and read its legends.
Fish-Fantasy
Control Sam the Sardine using a carefully-crafted swimming mechanic that lets you move with 360 degrees of freedom. Test your skills with races scattered throughout the ocean to attain union with the sea herself and unlock new abilities. Master these techniques to avoid the gaze of the unliving, lest you decay.
Open Seas
The Sotebol Expanse. The Giants’ Graveyard. The Caloksian Wasteland. The Undercurrent. Swim through four connected realms to find the answers you seek – and then travel beyond. Use your knowledge of the ancient Sardinian language to unlock the Cipher Stones, which open secret passageways all throughout the sea.
Features
Fluid and customizable swim controls
Four haunting realms to explore
Hand-drawn hieroglyphic language
Original fish-themed mythology
Philosophical narrative conveyed by compelling voice acting
Hundreds of hidden collectibles to uncover
Beautiful, original soundtrack

Copyright attribution for “Secret of Sardinia” can be found here.

title: Sit-Back Attack
description:
게임 정보
특징
음료수와 간식을 들고 편히 앉아 팀이 악의 무리를 처단하는 모습을 지켜보세요! 클래스 커스터마이징과 빌드 다양성에 중점을 둔 반유휴형 RPG입니다.
직면하게 될 과제를 해결하기 위해 수천 가지 빌드 옵션을 마음대로 사용할 수 있습니다!
모두 ZERO MTX로!!!!
60개 이상의 다양한 클래스, 500개 이상의 다양한 스킬, 무제한의 빌드 옵션을 갖추고 있어 4명의 영웅으로 구성된 팀이 300개가 넘는 몬스터, 보스, 울트라 보스를 물리칠 수 있습니다!
독특한 도전과 전략으로 재미있고 빠른 전투를 즐겨보세요.
속도 증가는 최대 20배까지 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다!
캐릭터 및 클래스 커스터마이징
팀을 더욱 강하게 만드는 방법을 결정하는 데 도움이 되는 전투, 통계 등의 모든 측면을 볼 수 있는 매우 심층적인 인터페이스입니다!
모든 클래스에는 고유한 캐릭터 아트와 고유한 기술, 강점 및 약점이 있습니다.
레벨업을 하면 원하는 방식으로 캐릭터를 구축하는 데 사용할 수 있는 능력치 포인트가 제공됩니다!
능력치와 플레이스타일을 크게 바꿀 수 있는 패시브 스킬!
애완동물 및 업적
4마리의 애완동물 중 1마리를 선택하여 팀을 강화하고 특수 공격을 사용할 시기를 제어할 수 있습니다. 기본 스텟도 파티를 강화시켜줍니다!
100개 이상의 성과. 달성할 때마다 애완동물의 레벨이 올라갑니다.
애완동물 레벨은 글로벌입니다. 새 게임을 시작하면 프레스티지 효과를 위해 해당 레벨이 상속됩니다!
펫 스킬은 수동으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 캐릭터의 패시브 스킬을 통해서도 향상될 수 있습니다!
레벨링 및 진행
레벨 상한은 500+입니다!
울트라 보스가 있는 도전적인 맵을 완료하여 모든 새로운 캐릭터 파워 등급(레벨 100, 200, 300 등...)을 잠금 해제해야 합니다!
우리가 찾을 수 있는 최고의 진행 균형을 제공하기 위해 엄격한 테스트를 거쳤습니다!

title: Amarillo's Desktop Pets
description:
게임 정보
데스크톱 애완동물이란 무엇인가요?
고대에는 데스크탑 주위를 움직이는 작은 캐릭터를 보여주는 일종의 컴퓨터 소프트웨어가 있었습니다. 그들은 재미있게 성가신 일이었고 매우 인기가 있었습니다. 이 프로젝트는 현대적인 게임 로직을 캐릭터에 접목하고 뛰어난 시각적 요소와 물리학 기반의 상호작용성을 결합하여 해당 장르를 현대적으로 재해석하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
데모의 기능(곧 제공 예정)
Elly: 판단하는 눈으로 당신을 쳐다보는 괴팍한 펑크/고스 소녀
흔들림 물리학: 머리카락, 옷감, 가슴 및 엉덩이에 대한 풍부한 시뮬레이션
표현력이 뛰어남: 성우, 립싱크 및 다양한 표정
전환 가능한 의류
초기 캐릭터 생성기 포함
정식 릴리스에 계획된 기능
사용자 정의 텍스처를 포함하여 캐릭터 생성기를 위한 추가 옵션
워크숍 지원
더 많은 성우 캐릭터
더 복잡한 동작
더 많은 상호작용 옵션

title: ZPF
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by classic horizontal shooters like Lords of Thunder, Elemental Master, and the Thunderforce series, ZPF is a passion project from the designer and developer of Super XYX and Tänzer.



Players will dodge and weave through intense bullet patterns, unleashing a barrage of firepower upon hordes of unique and challenging enemies.



Choose your hero - from the teleporting trickster to the laser-wielding warrior! Each character boasts a distinct playstyle with unique shots and melee attacks.



Brace yourself for epic encounters with mid and end-stage bosses, each demanding a different strategy to defeat.



Upgrade your arsenal and gain valuable tips between levels at each of the world’s in-game shops.



Finish every stage and discover a treasure trove of hidden secrets.

title: Quantum Witch
description:
게임 정보
It's a straightforwardly lovely day in Hus.



It's always a lovely day in Hus. That's not suspicious at all! The bovey is grazing in the field, the faer are roaming around town causing chaos, the shadies are out preaching (they're not a cult!), and a giant stone portal to another dimension has appeared in the woods.

I hope nothing goes hideously wrong and results in an adventure.

So what is it?

Narrative and choice driven platform adventure. Imagine choose your own adventure meets point and click meets platformer. Yes, you've got it! It's that. Not a platformer: a PLOTformer
Hand crafted retro resolution pixel art in a cute style that definitely doesn't unexpectedly turn creepy.
Not a cult.
Choices matter. Convince a character to wear something? They'll wear it for the rest of the game. Save a character? They'll be there as part of your story.

This is the journey of Ren, a twenty-something shepardess who gets thrown into a multiversal conflict while on a fetch quest to find her lost flock. She'll have the fates of her friends in her hands, and YOU will have to help her make the difficult choices.

Will she prevail? Will anyone survive? Why does everything pseudo-mystic have Quantum in the title? These questions and more, or fewer, may or may not be answered!

Characters and story original creations of NikkiJay, developed with BAFTA nominated writer Paul Rose.

Also you can pet the kitty.

"Instead of laying on the exposition and world building, we as the player are dropped into a world that feels lived in. Especially with a romantic relationship, instead of grabbing us by the throat and telling us that character X & Y care for each other and you should care too! They are just a couple, but get past that and they have layers." - Scott's Game Asylum.

"As a fan of narrative driven games, let me tell you, I am loving this." - Drewlusion, variety streamer.

"A bunch of woke nonsense. It's got women in it!" - Internet Man

title: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era
description:
게임 정보
Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era은 동명의 명작 게임 Heroes of Might & Magic 시리즈의 신작으로, 이전 작에서 언급된 적은 있으나 탐험할 수 없던 엔로스의 제이덤 대륙을 배경으로 합니다. 플레이어는 위험과 신비로 가득한 생동감 넘치는 판타지 세계로 모험을 떠나게 됩니다. 웅장한 수도를 건설하고, 대규모의 군대를 양성하고, 영웅과 신화 속 생물들이 펼치는 고도의 전략전에 참여하세요.
솔로로 신규 캠페인, 싱글 맵, 무작위로 끝없이 생성되는 시나리오를 플레이하거나, 멀티플레이어 모드로 다른 플레이어와 지략과 마법을 이용한 전투를 펼쳐 보세요. 맵 에디터 툴을 통해 자신만의 스토리를 만들어 다른 플레이어와 공유하거나, 직접 홀로 플레이할 수도 있습니다.
Heroes of Might & Magic에 익숙한 베테랑 플레이어, 그리고 해당 시리즈와 턴제 전략 장르를 처음 접하는 플레이어 모두가 즐길 수 있는 도전이 기다리고 있습니다.
비선형적 구조를 지닌 캠페인은 신비로운 대륙 제이덤을 무대로 펼쳐집니다. 세계를 정복하려는 인퍼노 악마 군주에 의해 타락한 곤충 로봇 군단 하이브에 맞서, 여러분은 라이벌 진영과 불안정한 동맹을 구축해야 합니다.
기존 인기 진영과 신규 진영을 아우르는 6가지 진영을 만나 보세요. 각 진영은 고유한 플레이스타일과 생물, 영웅, 개성 있는 능력으로 무장하고 있습니다. 템플(구 나이트), 네크로폴리스(언데드 및 뱀파이어), 실반(자연의 힘 및 페이 종족), 던전(다크 엘프 및 지하 생물), 하이브(사악한 곤충 로봇), 그리고 여기에 아직 감추어져 있는 여섯 번째 진영이 공개될 예정입니다.
autokwd: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era

title: Frontier Governor
description:
게임 정보
"목민새록"은 15세기 무렵의 한국 역사를 배경으로 한 도시 경영 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 이 시기, 한반도를 지배했던 신생 왕조 조선은 북방영토 개척에 한창 열을 올리고 있었습니다. 당시 조선의 북방은 험난한 자연환경과, 여진족의 잦은 습격으로 불안정한 지역이었습니다. 당신은 이 지역의 개척을 위해 파견된 수령으로서, 여러 역경을 극복하고 개척지를 성공적으로 운영해야 합니다.
세분화된 고을 성장
"목민새록"의 고을에는 고증을 기반으로 한 총 7개의 등급이 존재합니다. 조정에서 파견된 관리로서, 인사 평가인 포폄을 성공적으로 수행해 도시를 성장시키십시오. 도시를 성장시킬수록 사용할 수 있는 혜택이 많아집니다.
또한 고을에는 농업, 군사, 상공, 학문이라는 4가지 분야의 성향이 존재합니다. 당신의 플레이 스타일에 따라 각 성향 점수가 쌓일 것이고, 점수에 따라 해당 성향의 독특한 기술과 정책이 해금됩니다.
다채로운 환경
울창한 숲, 굽이치는 강, 우뚝 솟은 산, 낮과 밤, 사계절… "목민새록"의 자연은 계속 변화하고, 주민들도 그에 맞춰 행동합니다. 낮에는 일을 하고, 저녁 무렵엔 쉬고, 밤에는 잠을 잡니다. 계절에 맞춰서 작물을 경작하고, 숲에선 나무를 구하고, 강에선 물고기와 농업용수를 얻습니다. 하지만 자연이 매일 풍요로움을 선물하는 것은 아닙니다. 가뭄, 홍수, 폭설 등 때로는 가혹한 면모를 보일 것입니다. 항상 변덕스러운 자연을 대비하고, 관리하고, 이용하십시오.
정착민 관리
15세기 조선은 신분제 사회였습니다. 주민들은 노비, 양인, 토호, 사족이라는 4가지 신분으로 구별되며, 고유한 역할이 존재합니다. 각 신분의 인구를 필요에 따라 조절하고, 통제하십시오.
주민들은 자신의 재산을 가지고 원하는 물건들을 거래합니다. 경작지를 부여하고, 집을 개량하고, 필요한 시설을 지어주는 등의 활동을 통해 주민들이 거친 변방에서 원만히 살아갈 수 있도록 도와주십시오. 물론 주민들에게서 세금과 노동력을 적절히 징수하는 것도 잊지 마십시오!
군사 활동
북방의 변경 지대는 위험한 지역입니다. 고을을 호시탐탐 노리는 주변의 도적 떼, 여진족, 심지어는 불만 많은 내부 세력까지… 고을을 지키기 위해서는 군사력 또한 신경 써야 합니다. 양인들을 동원해 병사로 배치하고, 기술을 개발해 고급 무기와 갑옷을 보급하고, 적재적소에 군사 건물을 지어 침략자들을 막아내십시오.

title: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT THIS GAME
Murmurs of Fear is an episodic psychological horror game where each episode tells a short story from the perspective of those who managed to retain their sanity.
In the first episode, Murmurs of Fear - A Whisper of Loneliness, you play as Alexey, a 22-year-old young man who recently qualified as an electrician and was sent to assist a group of geologists tasked with opening old, preserved mines on an island with a lighthouse. The island had long shown no signs of life, and upon arriving, you discover that the geologists are missing. Left alone on the eerie island, you must uncover mysteries, solve puzzles, and survive the lurking horrors. Can you survive the night and uncover the truth?
Key features of the first episode:
Lovecraftian aesthetics and the atmosphere of old detective stories.
Realistic environments with a VHS game vibe.
Non-linear storytelling.
Exploring mysteries in foggy settings.
autokwd: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness

title: Solaria
description:
게임 정보
Collect various androids known as "Pvas" on the futuristic colony planet named "Solaria", deploy them for battles, construction, farming, crafting; pilot your own mobile base to explore the vast world. This is a brand-new, single player open-world survival and crafting game.
Background Story
Solaria is a human colony planet that relies heavily on artificial intelligence. It was once one of the most glorious early human colonies. The population was once stably controlled at 20,000 people, and each resident owned thousands or even tens of thousands of square kilometers of territory. The vast territory is managed by tens of thousands of Pvas(Personal Versatile Assistant), and the Solarians live a luxurious life like royal nobles. With the advancement of medical technology, the life expectancy of Solarians is getting longer and longer, reaching hundreds of years. During their long life, Solarians are obsessed with the research of androids and have created countless Pvas with different styles and functions. These Pvas allow Solarians to break through all moral and legal taboos and realize their most private and wildest desires. Solaria is like a shining pearl in the universe, and it was once the dream home of everyone.
However, beneath this seemingly perfect world, seeds of decline were quietly sown. As dependence on Pvas deepened, warmth and connection between humans gradually faded, until socializing became taboo, the birthrate dropped to zero, the population continued to decline, and even in the eyes of the outsiders, this planet has become a cold mechanical world. Today, there is no way to know the number of residents in Solaria. Maybe there are only dozens, maybe only a few, or maybe only you, the last watcher of Solaria. But what does it matter? You are accompanied by hundreds of thousands of Pvas, many of which are your own creations. These Pvas have different shapes and functions. They are not only assistants in life, but also emotional sustenance. The good days seem to continue, until one day you wake up and find that all the Pvas have malfunctioned. Is this a betrayal of technology or a conspiracy of outsiders? You must survive alone in this familiar yet strange land, repair your Pvas, rebuild infrastructure, explore unknown areas, and gradually uncover the truth of the incident.
Survival
As a Solarian who is used to a luxurious life, it is not easy to survive on your own, so capture some Pvas as soon as possible to help you.

독특한 식민시 건설시뮬레이션 애호가들을 위해 만들어진 , Gold Gold Adventure Gold 는 컬트 오브 더 램, 림월드, 마제스티와 블랙 앤 화이트를 합친 다음 어게인스트 더 스톰을 약간 곁들인 작품입니다.

모험가들이 공짜로 일하지 않는건 누구나 다 알고 있습니다. 그들의 충성심은 황금에 따라 움직이죠!

title: Wordatro!
description:
게임 정보
Wordatro! is a roguelite that is both simple and easy-to-get-into, designed by an independent developer. This unique single-player game tests your linguistic skills and strategy, offering you a pool of letters to create words. Each letter has a point value, and the length of the words you form affects a score multiplier, pushing you to optimize every move.
As you accumulate points and reach specific thresholds, you unlock a wide range of bonuses, as well as modifiers on the letters that add variety and depth to each game. Whether you're a word game enthusiast or a roguelite fan, Wordatro! offers a rich and captivating challenge.
The replayability of Wordatro! is exceptional due to the numerous strategies available to achieve victory. Each game presents new combinations of bonuses, encouraging you to explore different approaches to overcome the 10 levels. With an intuitive interface and easy-to-learn controls, Wordatro! is accessible to everyone, while offering a depth of gameplay that will captivate even the most experienced and strategic players.
Created with passion, Wordatro! is an immersive adventure that combines simplicity and strategy. Take on the challenge and test your wordcrafting skills! Can you conquer all 10 levels and claim victory in Wordatro! ?

description:

Batter Up is a rogue-lite arena shooter where you bounce a baseball around the map to kill the undead. The game features 3 biomes and a variety of enemies to battle through. With over 50+ items to choose from for your builds, you can create chaotic and downright overpowered synergies to mow through enemies.

30 minute runs

title: Football Life Simulator
description:

풋볼 라이프 시뮬레이터는 프로 축구 선수의 삶을 직접 체험할 수 있는 독창적인 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 경기장에서의 커리어뿐만 아니라 사생활 관리도 중요합니다.

title: Rebecca and the Sword of Nasty Curses
description:
게임 정보
✤Story✤
The female warrior Rebecca is the strongest warrior in this small border village.
Rebecca is not only powerful with swordsmanship but also very kind-hearted.
She plays a role similar to the village guardian and is deeply trusted by the villagers.
One day, Rebecca's village was attacked by a group of bandits.
Almost all the villagers were kidnapped, including Takezo, the person of her unrequited love.
So Rebecca embarked on a journey, vowing to defeat the bandits and save the villagers.
In a new continent, Rebecca obtained the magic sword "Cursed Sword".
And this magic sword will greatly change her destiny...!?
When the bandits are defeated and Rebecca successfully takes back her sweetheart, what will happen to the strongest female warrior in the village?

title: Haneda Girl
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Data Empira Pilot Haneda!
ALARM! Data Empire is being invaded by the Hackernauts! 
Help Chichi Wakaba (pilot Haneda Girl) to save Data Empire from the frightening (and intense) Hackernauts. Dive into this adventure with an exquisite game feel along with M.O.T.H.E.R., Haneda Girl’s combat tactic mecha. Slashes or bullets, control both characters and play in a creative and frenetic way. Tight controls, an addictive loop and the best techno music you’ll hear this season. Are you in?
Haneda Girl is a stylish 2D action (precise) platformer. Swap between characters and clean up the menace in the faster, smarter and most efficient way. Each encounter can be solved in very different manners. Be creative! From speed runners to casual players, this game is designed for EVERYONE!

title: GrimmKitchen
description:
게임 정보
Revive the restaurant passed down from your grandmother and aim for a three-star rating!
Enter a fairy tale world where you’ll battle enemies and gather ingredients in action-packed,
while also hiring and training staff to manage your restaurant.
This game offers a blend of restaurant management and fairy tale action!
Fairy Tale Action
Gather Ingredients
Step into a fairy tale world and collect all kinds of ingredients!
Defeat creatures, and you might just find rare, high-quality ingredients.
The more you gather, the more delicious dishes you can serve at your restaurant!
Fairy Tale Skills
Unleash powerful abilities inspired by fairy tale characters in battle!
Use them strategically to turn the tide of the fight in your favor!

title: RESIDUAL SOUL
description:
게임 정보
RESIDUAL SOUL is a singleplayer narrative short-story heavily inspired by the creepypasta horror genre.
Gameplay
After being taken to a purgatory-like forest with the promise of speaking to his deceased wife, Matt must survive his time there and bring peace to the souls who still linger. Manage threats like violent souls and fluctuating power levels while unveiling the stories of those who came before you.
Features
• Melancholic atmosphere and stunning visuals
• Thoughtful sound design
• Skilled voice acting
• Dynamic storyline

title: GEX Trilogy
description:
게임 정보
IT'S TAIL TIME, BABY!
Things are about to get weirder than the 4th of July at Rick James' place! Everyone's favorite tail-whipping, channel-surfing gecko is back in a collection that features all of his best-selling adventures!
GEX Trilogy includes the original 2D platformer, GEX, and the two 3D sequels: GEX: Enter the Gecko & GEX 3: Deep Cover Gecko —but these aren't just re-runs! This Carbon Engine powered collection includes extras and numerous improvements like that bring GEX back into prime time!

title: Dungeons of Eternity
description:
게임 정보
Endless fantasy action and adventure await you and your friends in Dungeons of Eternity.
Hack-n-slash takes on a new meaning in VR: swing swords, throw axes, use bows, wield magic staffs, and more to make it out alive.
COOP OR SOLO PLAY
Band together for an unforgettable cooperative experience with up to 4 players, or delve into the dungeons yourself. Teamwork is crucial when facing the hordes of monsters infesting the dungeons: coordinate with your party members to overcome the dangers, or embrace the lone wolf approach, facing your enemies head-on and emerging victorious!
EVER-CHANGING DUNGEONS
Explore randomly-generated dungeons across multiple game modes and realms - no dungeon run is the same. A vast array of chambers await, from combat arenas, puzzle and trap rooms, secret chambers, and more.

title: Northern Ireland '74
description:
게임 정보
The Troubles were an ethno-nationalist conflict in Northern Ireland that lasted for about 30 years from the late 1960s to 1998. Also known internationally as the Northern Ireland conflict, it is sometimes described as an "irregular war" or "low-level war". The conflict began in the late 1960s and is usually deemed to have ended with the Good Friday Agreement of 1998. Although the Troubles mostly took place in Northern Ireland, at times violence spilled over into parts of the Republic of Ireland, England, and mainland Europe.
As the British Armed Forces deployed into Northern Ireland, you will need to win the Hearts and Minds of the local population and balance the aspirations of both the Loyalists and the Nationalists.
Both the IRA and the UVF need to be contained, preventing the insurgency from destabilizing the region.
The Royal Ulster Constabulary (RUC) need to be deployed effectively and fairly to keep the two factions apart as a political solution is sought.
Features
Hearts and Minds Victory conditions
Turn based strategy game, procedurally generated at the start of every new game thereby ensuring extended playability.
Multiple factions for the player to control (UK Army, RUC)
Full and authentic order of battle management
Political support model, stakeholder management of the sentiment back home in England.
Full range of Army/Paramilitary units including transport helicopters, Saracen APC's, Ferret armored Cars, Water Cannons, Engineers etc.
Civilian disobedience (riots and marches)
Special Forces operations (SAS)
Operational intelligence map and tracking
Informants and Military Intelligence model, tracking and capturing Insurgent Leaders
Police actions (raids and roadblocks)
IED's and EOD
Full logistical model, including vehicle repairs and maintenance

title: Road Food Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Road Food Simulator를 솔로 또는 협동 모드로 플레이하세요. 다른 플레이어 게임에 참여하거나 처음부터 새로운 피자 프랜차이즈 매장을 시작하세요.
혼자 또는 친구와 함께 피자 매장에서 고객에게 피자를 배달하세요. 피자 도우로 시작하여 재료를 넣으세요.
최고의 피자는 팀워크로 만들어집니다.
한 사람이 피자를 만드는 동안 다른 사람은 피자를 포장합니다. 다른 사람은 피자를 배달합니다.

title: Neongarten
description:
게임 정보
Neongarten is a captivating turn-based strategy game that blends tactical depth with minimalist design, inspired by the likes of ISLANDERS and Luck be a Landlord. Immerse yourself in a vibrant, neon-soaked world where each turn presents new challenges and opportunities.
As the architect of a growing digital garden, you'll carefully place structures and units to expand your territory, earning resources and unlocking powerful synergies along the way. The balance between risk and reward is key—will you play it safe or gamble on high-stakes upgrades?
With a unique combination of procedural generation and strategic depth, NeonGarten keeps you on your toes. Every game offers a fresh experience, demanding you to adapt, optimize, and evolve your tactics.
Key Features:
Turn-based Strategy: Plan your moves carefully, with each decision shaping the future of your neon garden.
Procedural Generation: No two runs are the same, offering endless replayability and new challenges every time.
Minimalist, Cyberpunk Aesthetic: Dive into a stunning retro-futuristic world, where glowing lights meet strategic depth.
Inspired by Islanders and Luck be a Landlord: Combine the simplicity of city-building with the thrill of roguelike progression.
Whether you're looking for a laid-back yet engaging strategy experience or a deep, ever-changing puzzle to solve, NeonGarten offers a unique blend of both worlds.

title: Nightmare Shift
description:
게임 정보
사람들은 벽에 귀가 있다고 말하지만, 벽에 눈이 있다면 어떨까요? 당신이 하는 모든 일을 지켜보고, 기다리고, 보는 눈이 있다면요.
외딴 모텔에서 야간 근무를 하고, 불안한 손님을 상대하고, 섬뜩한 사건을 해결해 보세요. 엠마의 불안한 아파트 생활을 경험하고, 감시당하고 있다는 불안감을 느끼고, 현실과 악몽의 경계가 흐려지면서 무엇이 진짜인지 의문을 품어보세요.

title: Recharge
description:

Recharge – The Ultimate RC Racing Experience
Feel the thrill of RC racing like never before! With stunningly realistic graphics, physics-driven gameplay, and extensive customization options, Recharge is the definitive RC racing game for arcade enthusiasts and simulation purists alike. Whether you prefer solo adventures or adrenaline-pumping multiplayer races, Recharge delivers an immersive racing experience that bridges the gap between fun and realism.

Dynamic Camera Angles

title: Tower Dominion
description:
게임 정보

제국은 야만적인 아트로니드의 끈질긴 침략에 직면하여 존립 자체를 위협받고 있습니다. 사령관으로서 당신은 치명적인 적의 공격에 맞서는 최후의 방어선입니다. 무한 반복 가능한 이 게임의 체험을 통해서 모든 전투는 당신에게 예측할 수 없는 결과로 새로운 도전을 선사합니다
적들이 진격하는 바로 그 지형을 만들어 전장을 장악하세요. 목진지를 만들기 위해 지형 타일을 확장하고 수정하여 적에게 치명적인 포격을 가하거나 치밀하게 배치한 함정으로 유인하세요. 높이와 경로는 당신의 가장 강력한 무기로, 이를 현명하게 사용해 전투의 흐름을 주도하고 승리를 확보하세요.

title: Deadzone: Rogue
description:
게임 정보
당신은 ISS-X에서 깨어났고, 당신이 누구인지 전혀 기억하지 못합니다. 수많은 불량 기계가 있고, 그들은 빠르게 다가오고 있습니다. 적 무리를 물리치고, 희귀한 장비를 약탈하고, 증강 장치로 무장하여 살아남으세요. 데드존을 정복할 수 있을까요?
안
정적인 조준과 빠른 반사신경을 요구하는 거대하고 생체역학적 보스와 싸우세요. 사냥꾼 드론, 로보 스파이더, 무의미한 자들, 그리고 수십 명의 다른 적들을 섬멸하여 각 런에서 살아남으세요. 엔진실에서 브릭까지 모든 선박 구역에서 전투를 벌이세요.

title: Blasted Dice
description:
게임 정보
Blow up your enemies!
Blasted Dice is roguelike deckbuilder where you have a launcher that shoots explosive dice. As you play through rounds, you acquire different dice and items that aid you in doing more damage to your enemies, or blocking from their attacks.
Acquire powerful dice!
Assemble a deck of 9 different varieties of dice, each one with different effects on your score. Use that score to damage enemies or block from their attacks. Playing various combinations of dice form combos that boost your score even higher.
Discover a variety of items!

title: Ninja Ming
description:
게임 정보
Ninja Ming is a precision platformer with a teleportation twist. Play as Ming the ninja and take on the Path of Trial through 8 chapters and 241 levels. 
Dash? Flash! Teleportation is Key.
Throw a kunai and instantly teleport to its location!
Ninja Ming relies heavily on the move of teleportation. Once mastered, you’ll be commanding the air and dashing through the challenging areas.
Build Your Ninjutsu Skillset
"Flash" is just the beginner skill! As you progress through levels, you'll unlock even more dazzling abilities: use "ExFlash" for long-range teleportation, destroy (or build) terrain with "Fireball" and "Rock," and find creative solutions with "Replacement Dash"

title: Somniora: Chapter 1
description:
게임 정보
Somniora is a horror-puzzle game. Get ready to delve into the adventure of our character, who is trapped amidst strange dreams, while searching for answers to the questions lurking in their subconscious.
Amara
Like everyone else, you are someone trying to earn a living through your talent. While your debts and problems never seem to end, you also have to deal with your past. Psychological support aside, you cannot even sleep without medication. Why are you so afraid?
The big day
When that day comes, you won’t even know where you are because you’re on the other side, and if the ones controlling that place don’t want you to wake up, you won’t. Of course, defeating them might change things. A little blood may be spilled...

title: Barrage
description:
게임 정보



Barrage is a turn-based, strategic worker placement game: Engineers are the key elements of your game plan. Send Engineers to carry out different Actions, such as gathering new Machinery, managing water, building structures, and produce energy, but be careful: Action spaces are limited and shared among all players, so timing is crucial to avoid opponents stealing your next move.

The game unfolds in turns; each turn, players will be able to pick just one Action at a time. Engineers are few, and the more powerful an Action, the more Engineers it needs, so managing your workers carefully is the fundamental aspect of every gameplay.


Every corporation is unique in its own, and unlocks different rewards as the game progresses. Plus, every CEO has a special passive power that can be unlocked to maximize energy production, profits, or resource management.

But that’s not all: CEOs are assisted by Executive Officers, useful helpers which heavily impacts the gameplay rules and results in very different play styles. Experiment with different CEOs and XOs to find the ones that fits you best, or draft them at the beginning of the game for more unpredictability.


Objectives, Energy Contracts, and Technologies are randomly chosen from all available possibilities, ensuring a unique experience every time you play. This element of randomness fosters replayability, making each game a new challenge to overcome and forcing you to adapt your planning and strategy.


Dive into the uchronic world of Barrage, redesigned for a better gaming experience on PC, without waiving the beautiful visual language of the board game. Actions, resources, and the captivating visual elements of the board game have been preserved to charm experienced players and new ones alike.


Whether you want to challenge players worldwide or enjoy a solo game, you won’t be disappointed. The online mode allows you to compete against players from around the world. If you prefer a more personal experience instead, the offline mode lets you enjoy the game at your own pace, customizing factions, XOs, and other options.


We would love to hear from you! Connect with Cranio Creations on our social platforms to stay updated on the latest news, or leave a review either on Steam or on BoardGameGeek. Your feedback and experience help us make Barrage better and better.

title: Fractured Mind
description:
게임 정보
Hi, welcome to the Fractured Mind.
This is a PT inspired psychological horror game, with a bodycam style (shocking, I know, there aren't a lot of those lately...). It's ~25-35 minutes of gameplay. The full game will be over 1 hour, I don't know for sure the full length yet.
It's a fairly simple and straightforward game, with a heavy focus on atmosphere. There are also puzzles and shooting elements (which will be expanded upon in the full build).
The HUD is almost entirely non existent, with the exception of the crosshair which appears only when looking at interactable items.
There is no hand-holding in this game. While not difficult by any means, you do need to pay attention to some things.

title: Midnight Mayhem
description:
게임 정보


Be prepared for anything as the monsters abilities keep evolving and changing!
The monster player has limited control over their next ability so they will also have to think quickly to make the best use of them!



Hide in the shadows and kill your prey one by one!
Stalk your prey from a distance and stay as close as possible without being seen. Then strike before they have time to react!

You're completely invisible in the shadows. Avoid light at all cost!



You have various improvised weapons and gadgets at your disposal to locate and defend from the monster.
Use the right tool at the right time to shift the tides!



Work together to survive and banish the monster once and for all!
Don't forget to check the shadows and keep a light source close by, once it decides to attack it's already too late!


Work with your friends or try to brutally murder them!

title: Yoru ga Kuru! -Square of the Moon- Remastered

Three years later, in the city of Otsuna, Japan...
Ryou Hamura's dull life is interrupted by an invitation from a red-eyed girl named Izumi Kagura.

title: Toni Island Adventure
description:

세 층으로 이루어진 병원 단지를 탐험하고, 퍼즐을 풀고, 적과 싸우세요. 매 순간이 죽음에 가까워져 사이클이 재설정됩니다. 각 새로운 루프는 전략의 변화를 요구하며, 적응력과 창의력이 필요합니다.

title: Stickman Strikes: Conquer Fantasy World
description:
게임 정보
스틱맨 이세계 챌린지
특이한 스틱맨으로서, 당신은 신비한 마법 세계에서 태어났습니다. 다른 생물과는 어울리지 않지만, 이 세계는 이미 다양한 기이한 생물들로 가득합니다. 당신은 자신의 삶의 방식을 자유롭게 선택할 수 있으며, 도시, 마을, 광활한 야외를 탐험하며 이 세계의 다채로움을 경험하게 됩니다!
유려하고 화려한 전투
《스틱맨 이세계 챌린지：단검 하나면 충분해》는 《유성호접검》과 《Sekiro：Shadows Die Twice》의 전투 시스템을 참고했지만, 조작은 좀 더 간단하게 설계되었습니다. 《유성호접검》과 《Sekiro：Shadows Die Twice》의 약화 버전이라고 할 수 있습니다. 부드럽고 화려한 전투 기술을 발휘하거나 동료를 모집하여 팀 전투를 벌일 수 있습니다. 단독으로 싸우든 집단 전투를 벌이든 전투는 항상 스릴과 도전으로 가득합니다!
모집 및 제작
주점에서 새로운 팀원을 모집하고, 그들에게 필요한 무기와 장비를 제공합니다. 이 장비들은 상점에서 구입하거나 자원을 수집하여 직접 제작할 수 있습니다. 야외에서 식량, 과일, 채소, 광물 등의 자원을 채집하며, 각 마을 주변의 자원 분포가 다르므로 전략적인 선택이 필요합니다!
자원 관리 및 생존
모험 팀의 리더로서, 전투를 이끌 뿐만 아니라 팀원들의 생리적 필요도 관리해야 합니다. 음식을 사고, 물을 공급하고, 야외에서 요리를 하며, 마을의 목욕탕에서 목욕하고, 야외에서 위생 문제를 해결하며, 수면을 통해 체력과 사기를 회복시켜야 합니다. 이러한 요소들이 게임에 현실감과 몰입감을 더해줍니다!
다양한 퀘스트와 모험
도시에서 다양한 퀘스트를 받아보세요. 편지 배달, 주정뱅이 응징, 물품 호송 등 다양한 퀘스트를 수행하며 새로운 여정을 시작할 수 있습니다. 여러 도시와 마을을 탐험하며 풍부한 스토리와 다양한 모험을 경험하게 될 것입니다. 여행 중 만나는 강도들과의 전투에서 당신의 전투 기술을 시험해 보세요!
향후 업데이트 예정!
《스틱맨의 이세계 정복: 시작은 한 자루 칼로》의 향후 버전에서는 더 많은 특징들이 추가될 예정입니다:
- 마법 시스템: 전투에서 사용할 수 있는 마법 스킬이 추가되어 더 많은 전투 변수가 생깁니다.
- 던전 시스템: 지도의 무덤, 동굴, 유적을 탐험하여 숨겨진 스토리와 보물을 발견하세요.

Features:
• About 2 hours of content.
• Cute female protogen!
• HD fully original artworks.
• Relaxing atmosphere.
• Some personal drama, as usual.

title: SGS Imjin War
description:
게임 정보
임진왜란은 16세기 말 가장 치열했던 전쟁 중 하나로, 1592년부터 1598년(2차 침략 말기)까지 일본이 조선 왕국을 침략한 이야기를 다루고 있습니다. 일본군은 남쪽의 부산을 거점으로 한반도 전역을 점령해야 합니다. 한국 플레이어는 중국의 도움을 받아 침략을 격퇴해야 합니다...
그랜드 캠페인 시나리오는 최대 105턴까지 진행되며, 각 턴은 1592년 5월부터 1594년 4월까지 1주일을 나타냅니다. 1592-1593년 캠페인의 일부를 다루는 소규모 시나리오와 1598년 2차 침략에 대한 시나리오도 있습니다.
한 플레이어는 일본의 명장 히데요시의 사무라이 군대를 대표하고, 다른 플레이어는 조선인과 명나라 군대가 포함된 조선인을 대표합니다. 이벤트와 카드 플레이에 따라 양쪽 모두 만주 여진족(녹색)의 지상 유닛을 지배할 수 있습니다.

title: I will purify you
description:
게임 정보
자신만의 특별한 방법으로 괴이를 정화 시킬 수 있는 초능력을 가진 주인공 '제임스'가 되어 세계 각지의 초자연적인 현상을 해결해 나가세요.
 
 픽셀 그래픽의 귀여운 괴이들과 세계 각지에서 초자연적인 현상을 일으키는 강력하고 아름다운 그녀들을 만나보세요.
 
 I.P.U는 당신에게 계속해서 몰려오는 부하 괴이들과 일정 시간마다 등장하는 강력한 보스를 물리쳐야 하는 2D 픽셀 그래픽의 횡스크롤 액션 게임입니다.

title: Witch of Eclipse
description:
게임 정보


Traveling the world and doing good to benefit human society as a whole is what makes being a witch so rewarding. They call this the Law of the Witch--the oath that female magic users must abide to in serving humanity and helping those in need.

Witches roam from town to town, saving those who need salvation and then quickly drifting to the next destination. All girls born with magic understand that their fate is to travel the world and abide by the Law.

In a small town called Selene lived a witch-in-training, Liz. In order to become an independent and powerful witch, Liz trains every day under her master and mother, Aretta.

After finally passing her final exam as a witch-in-training, Liz graduates and becomes a full-fledged magic wielder. As promised by her oath, Liz leaves her village and sets off to the vast world outside. Little did she know, she may be the reincarnation of the Witch of Eclipse--the very woman who saved the world from a great threat in the past.
Features:
Classic RPG Experience
Turn-based Combat
Leveling System
Skill System
Fully Voiced

title: Tempus Triad
description:
게임 정보
제발
시놉시스:

외딴 섬 깊숙이 위치한 비밀 연구 시설에서 과학자들은 공간과 시간의 경계를 조작할 수 있는 희귀한 물질, 즉 암흑 물질을 이용한 실험을 진행하고 있다. 목표는 혁신적인 기술 발전을 이루는 것이었으나, 실험 도중 예측할 수 없는 이상 현상이 발생하기 시작한다. 선사 시대의 식물이 출현하고 물체가 사라지는 등, 시간 조작이 초래하는 위험성이 서서히 드러난다.
연구팀의 리더는 아내와 딸을 비극적인 사고로 잃은 물리학자다. 그는 시간을 조작하여 과거를 되돌리고 가족을 되찾을 수 있을 것이라 믿는다. 그러나 자신의 목적을 위해 기술을 사용한 순간, 실험은 실패하고 시간 연속성이 붕괴된다. 그 결과, 그는 시간이 불안정하고 선사 시대의 포식자들이 자유롭게 배회하는 왜곡된 세계로 빨려 들어가게 된다.
이제, 시간선이 붕괴 직전에 놓인 상황에서 그는 자신의 선택과 마주해야 한다. 그림자 속에서 위협하는 거대한 생명체들을 피해, 우주의 균형을 되찾고 자신의 구원을 찾기 위해 필사적으로 탈출 방법을 모색해야 한다.
특징:
현실적이고 최적화된 그래픽으로 완전한 몰입감 제공

title: Cry Pic.
description:

Overview:
This is an action shooter game where the main focus is fighting large enemies (bosses).
Dodge the dizzying amount of enemy bullets while dealing damage to the enemy
Destroy the enemy.
Features:
5 stages, boss battles only
2 difficulty levels
I don't think it's easy to clear, so I've narrowed it down to a low difficulty level.
First try the easier level, and then try the harder level.

Danmaku, multi-jointed

title: HackHub
description:
게임 정보
Hackhub: Journey into the Depths of the Digital World

Step into the dark corners of the cybersecurity and hacking world. Hackhub offers players a realistic and thrilling virtual experience. Explore networks, infiltrate mysterious databases, and test your skills by completing high-profile cyber missions.

Key Features:

Realistic Hacking Experience
Utilize real-world tools and techniques to accomplish complex cyber tasks. Master popular tools like nslookup, nmap, and hydra.

Mission Variety
Engage in a wide range of missions, each with unique challenges and objectives. From network reconnaissance to database infiltration, every mission will test your abilities in new ways.

Dynamic Challenges
As you progress, face increasingly difficult tasks that require strategic thinking and advanced skills. Adapt to evolving threats and stay ahead of security measures.

Immersive Storyline
Dive into a captivating narrative that unfolds through your actions and decisions. Every choice you make can have significant consequences.

Customization and Progression
Personalize your hacking tools and techniques as you advance. Earn rewards and unlock new capabilities to enhance your hacking arsenal.

Stunning Visuals and Interface
Experience a sleek and intuitive interface designed for both novice and experienced hackers. Enjoy detailed environments and immersive graphics.


Embark on your hacking journey and prove your mettle in the ever-evolving digital battlefield. Are you ready to become the ultimate hacker in Hackhub?

title: Arcane Trigger
description:
게임 정보
From the Creators of "Demon King’s End" comes their latest masterpiece! A gunslinger with magic at your fingertips!
After years of hard work, the young mage finally saved up enough to build a beautiful house deep in the woods. But what she didn’t realize was that her new home was right next to a rift between the Shadow Realm and the Mortal Realm…
As night falls, monstrous shadowspawn creatures pour through the rift, destroying everything in their path. Armed with her Arcane Rifle, the mage is ready to pull the trigger and unleash a storm of fury on these rude invaders!
Mix & Match for Max Damage!
Think twice before pulling the trigger! Repositioning your bullets to create the ultimate buff combo!
Craft New Bullets!

title: Looping Art Museum
description:
게임 정보
Reveal the memories through "Spot the Difference."
Escape from the endless loop in a single-path maze.

This is a single-player adventure game drawn with flickering lights and pixel art.

Game Description
This game is a side-scrolling adventure game.
You can move right or left, but you will always end up returning to the same place.

There is only one way to move forward. Carefully observe the paintings.
You will notice there’s a painting that differs slightly from the one you saw before.

If you feel something is off, take a stop and look at the painting.
If it has changed, congratulations! You have taken a step forward, and now you are ready to look for the next change.

As you discover changes one by one, the path forward will open up.
Now, you are ready for your journey in the looping art museum.

The game is controlled using only the keyboard.

The Character can only move to the left or right.
A key or Left Arrow key: Move left
D key or Right Arrow key: Move right

There are also parts where you will be required to enter text.
Please use the keyboard to input the word.
On a cold day, the protagonist visits the art gallery for the first time in a while.
She got attracted to one specific painting.
As time passes while they are fascinated, people around her disappear.
But when trying to leave, she noticed something strange.
Whether she goes back or forth, the same painting appears in front of her again and again and again...

This is a looping art museum.

Clever "Mr.Cat" talks to you and tells you to play "Spot the Difference" in the museum.
You have to observe the paintings closely and start naming them.
Find the paintings which are changing stealthily.
Can you escape from the loop by repeating "Spot the Difference"?
And what secrets lie hidden in the looping art museum?
Name: Nekko
A mechanical engineer turned indie game developer.
For some reason, I am burning through my savings day and night, devoting myself to game development.
Obsessed with the charm of pixel art, they endlessly tweak the positions of pixels if left alone.

title: The Book of Aaru
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey in The Book of Aaru, an action-packed rogue-lite game with RPG elements. Discover a world where ancient Egypt has evolved beyond expectations, merging history, mythology, and advanced sci-fi technology. Play as fictional character Emily Sands, a daring explorer who mysteriously vanished while searching for the temple of Osiris in 1926. Cursed and stripped of humanity, you’ll navigate through intricately hand-crafted trap corridors, each presenting a unique challenge that demands diverse skills, precise timing, and adaptable strategies. Will you choose a dangerous path filled with treasures or a safer route with fewer rewards? The choice is yours!
Key Features:
Isometric Action Rogue-lite: Engage in fast-paced, tactical action gameplay from an isometric perspective.

title: Delivery Driver Service
description:
게임 정보
대형 허리케인이 플로리다 주를 휩쓸면서 구조물과 송전 시설을 포함한 대부분의 물류 지점이 파괴되었습니다.


스토리:
긴급 지역의 인프라 복구를 위한 회사가 최고의 전문가를 파견하여 발생한 작업을 해결하는 데 필요한 모든 것을 제공합니다.

[게임 플레이[/i]:
플레이어의 주요 임무는 허리케인으로 피해를 입은 지역의 상태를 복구하여 모든 것이 이전처럼 또는 더 잘 작동하도록 만드는 것입니다!


극복하기:
여행 중에는 다양한 유형의 지형과 자연 장애물을 만날 수 있습니다. 이를 극복하려면 교통수단의 적합성을 고려하는 것이 중요합니다. 일부 차량은 고유한 장단점으로 인해 다른 차량보다 특정 장애물에 더 적합합니다.

:
날씨 기능 외에도 게임 세계에는 봄부터 겨울 풍경까지 실시간으로 변화하는 계절이 등장합니다. 날씨와 마찬가지로 계절도 게임 월드의 지형에 어느 정도 영향을 미치기 때문에 자동차를 움직이기 어렵습니다.


:
게임 플레이를 통해 차량의 고유한 특성에 따라 차량을 업그레이드할 수 있습니다! 운전자의 레벨을 높여 차량과 운전 기술을 업그레이드할 수 있습니다. 운전 실력을 한 단계 업그레이드할 준비를 하세요!


:
운전자의 레벨이 올라갈수록 게임 캐릭터는 더 많은 기술과 운전에 대한 자신감을 얻게 됩니다. 그러니 계속 레벨을 올려 캐릭터의 능력을 향상시키세요! 또한 정비소가 없을 때 예기치 않은 고장에 대처할 수 있는 능력도 향상됩니다.


:
게임을 시작할 때, 여러분과 차량에 필요한 모든 편의 시설을 추가하기 위해 기술적으로나 시각적으로 업그레이드할 수 있는 기지를 이용할 수 있습니다. 침대를 개선하거나 냉장고를 추가할 수 있으며, 차량에는 차고를 떠나지 않고도 더 많은 차량을 수용하고 정비할 수 있는 두 번째 차고 또는 기술 수납공간을 만들 수 있습니다.
