title: Brány Skeldalu
description:
게임 정보
Step Through the Gates of Skeldal – A Legendary Czech Grid-Based Dungeon Crawler
Gates of Skeldal is a cult-classic Czech grid-based dungeon crawler from 1998 that captivated RPG fans with its unique gameplay, epic story, and challenges that will test your wits and strategic thinking. It was a big deal in Czechia in the ‘90s, but before you download and review it, please keep in mind that this is a very old game (your seller of the year!).
🌍 Explore the Mysterious Island of Rovenland
This mythical island is home to the ruins of ancient civilizations, treacherous dungeons, and forgotten temples brimming with magic. Journey through icy caverns, the heart of a volcano, and the windswept peaks of the Stormy Mountain. The fate of the world hangs by a thread—five rogue mages are trying to open a gate to the forbidden dimension of Zohar. Can you stop them before it's too late?
⚔ Assemble Your Party and Engage in Tactical Turn-Based Combat
Pick up to six heroes, each with unique abilities and skills. Every move matters—thoughtful strategy will be the key to victory.
🔮 Master the Power of Magic
Learn powerful spells, discover ancient scrolls, and combine sorcery with tactical combat to overcome any foe.
🧩 Solve Puzzles and Avoid Deadly Traps
Dungeons aren’t just about combat—cunning traps and mind-bending puzzles will challenge even the most seasoned adventurers.
✨ A Timeless Classic
With its mix of 2D and 3D graphics, a rich story, and an unforgettable atmosphere, Gates of Skeldal stands as a legend of the genre. Join thousands of players who keep returning to Rovenland, time and time again!
👉 Go to Rovenland!
🔥 Save the world!

title: Barrage
description:
게임 정보



Barrage is a turn-based, strategic worker placement game: Engineers are the key elements of your game plan. Send Engineers to carry out different Actions, such as gathering new Machinery, managing water, building structures, and produce energy, but be careful: Action spaces are limited and shared among all players, so timing is crucial to avoid opponents stealing your next move.

The game unfolds in turns; each turn, players will be able to pick just one Action at a time. Engineers are few, and the more powerful an Action, the more Engineers it needs, so managing your workers carefully is the fundamental aspect of every gameplay.


Every corporation is unique in its own, and unlocks different rewards as the game progresses. Plus, every CEO has a special passive power that can be unlocked to maximize energy production, profits, or resource management.

But that’s not all: CEOs are assisted by Executive Officers, useful helpers which heavily impacts the gameplay rules and results in very different play styles. Experiment with different CEOs and XOs to find the ones that fits you best, or draft them at the beginning of the game for more unpredictability.


Objectives, Energy Contracts, and Technologies are randomly chosen from all available possibilities, ensuring a unique experience every time you play. This element of randomness fosters replayability, making each game a new challenge to overcome and forcing you to adapt your planning and strategy.


Dive into the uchronic world of Barrage, redesigned for a better gaming experience on PC, without waiving the beautiful visual language of the board game. Actions, resources, and the captivating visual elements of the board game have been preserved to charm experienced players and new ones alike.


Whether you want to challenge players worldwide or enjoy a solo game, you won’t be disappointed. The online mode allows you to compete against players from around the world. If you prefer a more personal experience instead, the offline mode lets you enjoy the game at your own pace, customizing factions, XOs, and other options.


We would love to hear from you! Connect with Cranio Creations on our social platforms to stay updated on the latest news, or leave a review either on Steam or on BoardGameGeek. Your feedback and experience help us make Barrage better and better.

title: Fractured Mind
description:
게임 정보
Hi, welcome to the Fractured Mind.
This is a PT inspired psychological horror game, with a bodycam style (shocking, I know, there aren't a lot of those lately...). It's ~25-35 minutes of gameplay. The full game will be over 1 hour, I don't know for sure the full length yet.
It's a fairly simple and straightforward game, with a heavy focus on atmosphere. There are also puzzles and shooting elements (which will be expanded upon in the full build).
The HUD is almost entirely non existent, with the exception of the crosshair which appears only when looking at interactable items.
There is no hand-holding in this game. While not difficult by any means, you do need to pay attention to some things.

title: Midnight Mayhem
description:
게임 정보


Be prepared for anything as the monsters abilities keep evolving and changing!
The monster player has limited control over their next ability so they will also have to think quickly to make the best use of them!



Hide in the shadows and kill your prey one by one!
Stalk your prey from a distance and stay as close as possible without being seen. Then strike before they have time to react!

You're completely invisible in the shadows. Avoid light at all cost!



You have various improvised weapons and gadgets at your disposal to locate and defend from the monster.
Use the right tool at the right time to shift the tides!



Work together to survive and banish the monster once and for all!
Don't forget to check the shadows and keep a light source close by, once it decides to attack it's already too late!


Work with your friends or try to brutally murder them!

The game supports proximity chat with other effects like echo in certain locations.


Join the Discord using the button on the right side of the page!

title: Toni Island Adventure

title: ZPF
description:

Inspired by classic horizontal shooters like Lords of Thunder, Elemental Master, and the Thunderforce series, ZPF is a passion project from the designer and developer of Super XYX and Tänzer.



Players will dodge and weave through intense bullet patterns, unleashing a barrage of firepower upon hordes of unique and challenging enemies.



Choose your hero - from the teleporting trickster to the laser-wielding warrior! Each character boasts a distinct playstyle with unique shots and melee attacks.



Brace yourself for epic encounters with mid and end-stage bosses, each demanding a different strategy to defeat.



Upgrade your arsenal and gain valuable tips between levels at each of the world’s in-game shops.



Finish every stage and discover a treasure trove of hidden secrets.

title: Quantum Witch
description:
게임 정보
It's a straightforwardly lovely day in Hus.



It's always a lovely day in Hus. That's not suspicious at all! The bovey is grazing in the field, the faer are roaming around town causing chaos, the shadies are out preaching (they're not a cult!), and a giant stone portal to another dimension has appeared in the woods.

I hope nothing goes hideously wrong and results in an adventure.

So what is it?

Narrative and choice driven platform adventure. Imagine choose your own adventure meets point and click meets platformer. Yes, you've got it! It's that. Not a platformer: a PLOTformer
Hand crafted retro resolution pixel art in a cute style that definitely doesn't unexpectedly turn creepy.
Not a cult.
Choices matter. Convince a character to wear something? They'll wear it for the rest of the game. Save a character? They'll be there as part of your story.

This is the journey of Ren, a twenty-something shepardess who gets thrown into a multiversal conflict while on a fetch quest to find her lost flock. She'll have the fates of her friends in her hands, and YOU will have to help her make the difficult choices.

Will she prevail? Will anyone survive? Why does everything pseudo-mystic have Quantum in the title? These questions and more, or fewer, may or may not be answered!

Characters and story original creations of NikkiJay, developed with BAFTA nominated writer Paul Rose.

Also you can pet the kitty.

"Instead of laying on the exposition and world building, we as the player are dropped into a world that feels lived in. Especially with a romantic relationship, instead of grabbing us by the throat and telling us that character X & Y care for each other and you should care too! They are just a couple, but get past that and they have layers." - Scott's Game Asylum.

"As a fan of narrative driven games, let me tell you, I am loving this." - Drewlusion, variety streamer.

"A bunch of woke nonsense. It's got women in it!" - Internet Man

title: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era
description:
게임 정보
Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era은 동명의 명작 게임 Heroes of Might & Magic 시리즈의 신작으로, 이전 작에서 언급된 적은 있으나 탐험할 수 없던 엔로스의 제이덤 대륙을 배경으로 합니다. 플레이어는 위험과 신비로 가득한 생동감 넘치는 판타지 세계로 모험을 떠나게 됩니다. 웅장한 수도를 건설하고, 대규모의 군대를 양성하고, 영웅과 신화 속 생물들이 펼치는 고도의 전략전에 참여하세요.
솔로로 신규 캠페인, 싱글 맵, 무작위로 끝없이 생성되는 시나리오를 플레이하거나, 멀티플레이어 모드로 다른 플레이어와 지략과 마법을 이용한 전투를 펼쳐 보세요. 맵 에디터 툴을 통해 자신만의 스토리를 만들어 다른 플레이어와 공유하거나, 직접 홀로 플레이할 수도 있습니다.
Heroes of Might & Magic에 익숙한 베테랑 플레이어, 그리고 해당 시리즈와 턴제 전략 장르를 처음 접하는 플레이어 모두가 즐길 수 있는 도전이 기다리고 있습니다.
비선형적 구조를 지닌 캠페인은 신비로운 대륙 제이덤을 무대로 펼쳐집니다. 세계를 정복하려는 인퍼노 악마 군주에 의해 타락한 곤충 로봇 군단 하이브에 맞서, 여러분은 라이벌 진영과 불안정한 동맹을 구축해야 합니다.
기존 인기 진영과 신규 진영을 아우르는 6가지 진영을 만나 보세요. 각 진영은 고유한 플레이스타일과 생물, 영웅, 개성 있는 능력으로 무장하고 있습니다. 템플(구 나이트), 네크로폴리스(언데드 및 뱀파이어), 실반(자연의 힘 및 페이 종족), 던전(다크 엘프 및 지하 생물), 하이브(사악한 곤충 로봇), 그리고 여기에 아직 감추어져 있는 여섯 번째 진영이 공개될 예정입니다.

title: Frontier Governor
description:
게임 정보
"목민새록"은 15세기 무렵의 한국 역사를 배경으로 한 도시 경영 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 이 시기, 한반도를 지배했던 신생 왕조 조선은 북방영토 개척에 한창 열을 올리고 있었습니다. 당시 조선의 북방은 험난한 자연환경과, 여진족의 잦은 습격으로 불안정한 지역이었습니다. 당신은 이 지역의 개척을 위해 파견된 수령으로서, 여러 역경을 극복하고 개척지를 성공적으로 운영해야 합니다.
세분화된 고을 성장
"목민새록"의 고을에는 고증을 기반으로 한 총 7개의 등급이 존재합니다. 조정에서 파견된 관리로서, 인사 평가인 포폄을 성공적으로 수행해 도시를 성장시키십시오. 도시를 성장시킬수록 사용할 수 있는 혜택이 많아집니다.
또한 고을에는 농업, 군사, 상공, 학문이라는 4가지 분야의 성향이 존재합니다. 당신의 플레이 스타일에 따라 각 성향 점수가 쌓일 것이고, 점수에 따라 해당 성향의 독특한 기술과 정책이 해금됩니다.
다채로운 환경
울창한 숲, 굽이치는 강, 우뚝 솟은 산, 낮과 밤, 사계절… "목민새록"의 자연은 계속 변화하고, 주민들도 그에 맞춰 행동합니다. 낮에는 일을 하고, 저녁 무렵엔 쉬고, 밤에는 잠을 잡니다. 계절에 맞춰서 작물을 경작하고, 숲에선 나무를 구하고, 강에선 물고기와 농업용수를 얻습니다. 하지만 자연이 매일 풍요로움을 선물하는 것은 아닙니다. 가뭄, 홍수, 폭설 등 때로는 가혹한 면모를 보일 것입니다. 항상 변덕스러운 자연을 대비하고, 관리하고, 이용하십시오.
정착민 관리
15세기 조선은 신분제 사회였습니다. 주민들은 노비, 양인, 토호, 사족이라는 4가지 신분으로 구별되며, 고유한 역할이 존재합니다. 각 신분의 인구를 필요에 따라 조절하고, 통제하십시오.
주민들은 자신의 재산을 가지고 원하는 물건들을 거래합니다. 경작지를 부여하고, 집을 개량하고, 필요한 시설을 지어주는 등의 활동을 통해 주민들이 거친 변방에서 원만히 살아갈 수 있도록 도와주십시오. 물론 주민들에게서 세금과 노동력을 적절히 징수하는 것도 잊지 마십시오!
군사 활동
북방의 변경 지대는 위험한 지역입니다. 고을을 호시탐탐 노리는 주변의 도적 떼, 여진족, 심지어는 불만 많은 내부 세력까지… 고을을 지키기 위해서는 군사력 또한 신경 써야 합니다. 양인들을 동원해 병사로 배치하고, 기술을 개발해 고급 무기와 갑옷을 보급하고, 적재적소에 군사 건물을 지어 침략자들을 막아내십시오.

title: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT THIS GAME
Murmurs of Fear is an episodic psychological horror game where each episode tells a short story from the perspective of those who managed to retain their sanity.
In the first episode, Murmurs of Fear - A Whisper of Loneliness, you play as Alexey, a 22-year-old young man who recently qualified as an electrician and was sent to assist a group of geologists tasked with opening old, preserved mines on an island with a lighthouse. The island had long shown no signs of life, and upon arriving, you discover that the geologists are missing. Left alone on the eerie island, you must uncover mysteries, solve puzzles, and survive the lurking horrors. Can you survive the night and uncover the truth?
Key features of the first episode:
Lovecraftian aesthetics and the atmosphere of old detective stories.
Realistic environments with a VHS game vibe.
Non-linear storytelling.
Exploring mysteries in foggy settings.
autokwd: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness

title: Solaria
description:
게임 정보
Collect various androids known as "Pvas" on the futuristic colony planet named "Solaria", deploy them for battles, construction, farming, crafting; pilot your own mobile base to explore the vast world. This is a brand-new, single player open-world survival and crafting game.
Background Story
Solaria is a human colony planet that relies heavily on artificial intelligence. It was once one of the most glorious early human colonies. The population was once stably controlled at 20,000 people, and each resident owned thousands or even tens of thousands of square kilometers of territory. The vast territory is managed by tens of thousands of Pvas(Personal Versatile Assistant), and the Solarians live a luxurious life like royal nobles. With the advancement of medical technology, the life expectancy of Solarians is getting longer and longer, reaching hundreds of years. During their long life, Solarians are obsessed with the research of androids and have created countless Pvas with different styles and functions. These Pvas allow Solarians to break through all moral and legal taboos and realize their most private and wildest desires. Solaria is like a shining pearl in the universe, and it was once the dream home of everyone.
However, beneath this seemingly perfect world, seeds of decline were quietly sown. As dependence on Pvas deepened, warmth and connection between humans gradually faded, until socializing became taboo, the birthrate dropped to zero, the population continued to decline, and even in the eyes of the outsiders, this planet has become a cold mechanical world. Today, there is no way to know the number of residents in Solaria. Maybe there are only dozens, maybe only a few, or maybe only you, the last watcher of Solaria. But what does it matter? You are accompanied by hundreds of thousands of Pvas, many of which are your own creations. These Pvas have different shapes and functions. They are not only assistants in life, but also emotional sustenance. The good days seem to continue, until one day you wake up and find that all the Pvas have malfunctioned. Is this a betrayal of technology or a conspiracy of outsiders? You must survive alone in this familiar yet strange land, repair your Pvas, rebuild infrastructure, explore unknown areas, and gradually uncover the truth of the incident.
Survival
As a Solarian who is used to a luxurious life, it is not easy to survive on your own, so capture some Pvas as soon as possible to help you.
Pvas

title: Gold Gold Adventure Gold
description:
게임 정보
돈만 있으면 다 해결할 수 있어, 이 멍청아! 도시를 건설하고, 모험가를 초대하고 모험가들이 문제를 해결해줄 때까지 임무를 맡겨... 황금이 부족한게 바로 문제란 말이야! 요즘 반려동물님을 모시는데 식비가 얼마나 들어가는지 알아? 괴물들에게 둘러싸인 땅에 도시를 건설하는건 말할것도 없지!
독특한 식민시 건설시뮬레이션 애호가들을 위해 만들어진 , Gold Gold Adventure Gold 는 컬트 오브 더 램, 림월드, 마제스티와 블랙 앤 화이트를 합친 다음 어게인스트 더 스톰을 약간 곁들인 작품입니다.
임무를 부여하세요
모험가들이 공짜로 일하지 않는건 누구나 다 알고 있습니다. 그들의 충성심은 황금에 따라 움직이죠!
황금과 명예를 가지고 모험가들을 고용하고, 그들에게 임무를 부여하세요! 죽이고, 방어하고, 탐험하는겁니다!

title: Wordatro!
description:
게임 정보
Wordatro! is a roguelite that is both simple and easy-to-get-into, designed by an independent developer. This unique single-player game tests your linguistic skills and strategy, offering you a pool of letters to create words. Each letter has a point value, and the length of the words you form affects a score multiplier, pushing you to optimize every move.
As you accumulate points and reach specific thresholds, you unlock a wide range of bonuses, as well as modifiers on the letters that add variety and depth to each game. Whether you're a word game enthusiast or a roguelite fan, Wordatro! offers a rich and captivating challenge.
The replayability of Wordatro! is exceptional due to the numerous strategies available to achieve victory. Each game presents new combinations of bonuses, encouraging you to explore different approaches to overcome the 10 levels. With an intuitive interface and easy-to-learn controls, Wordatro! is accessible to everyone, while offering a depth of gameplay that will captivate even the most experienced and strategic players.
Created with passion, Wordatro! is an immersive adventure that combines simplicity and strategy. Take on the challenge and test your wordcrafting skills! Can you conquer all 10 levels and claim victory in Wordatro! ?

title: Batter Up
description:
게임 정보
Batter Up is a rogue-lite arena shooter where you bounce a baseball around the map to kill the undead. The game features 3 biomes and a variety of enemies to battle through. With over 50+ items to choose from for your builds, you can create chaotic and downright overpowered synergies to mow through enemies.

Features
50 unique upgrade items
3 biomes to collect unique items in
3 unique bosses to fight
Multiple map variations
30 minute runs
1-2 minute waves

title: Football Life Simulator
description:
게임 정보
풋볼 라이프 시뮬레이터는 프로 축구 선수의 삶을 직접 체험할 수 있는 독창적인 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 경기장에서의 커리어뿐만 아니라 사생활 관리도 중요합니다.
현실적인 훈련과 미니 게임을 통해 축구 기술을 향상시키고, 경기장에서 빛나는 선수가 되세요.
러닝머신에서 달리고, 웨이트를 들어 올리며, 힘과 지구력을 키워 한계를 극복하세요.
바에서 친구들과 어울리고, 새로운 인연을 만들어가며 풍부한 사회 생활을 즐기세요.

title: Rebecca and the Sword of Nasty Curses
description:
게임 정보
✤Story✤
The female warrior Rebecca is the strongest warrior in this small border village.
Rebecca is not only powerful with swordsmanship but also very kind-hearted.
She plays a role similar to the village guardian and is deeply trusted by the villagers.
One day, Rebecca's village was attacked by a group of bandits.
Almost all the villagers were kidnapped, including Takezo, the person of her unrequited love.
So Rebecca embarked on a journey, vowing to defeat the bandits and save the villagers.
In a new continent, Rebecca obtained the magic sword "Cursed Sword".
And this magic sword will greatly change her destiny...!?
When the bandits are defeated and Rebecca successfully takes back her sweetheart, what will happen to the strongest female warrior in the village?
✤Game Content✤

title: Haneda Girl
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Data Empira Pilot Haneda!
ALARM! Data Empire is being invaded by the Hackernauts! 
Help Chichi Wakaba (pilot Haneda Girl) to save Data Empire from the frightening (and intense) Hackernauts. Dive into this adventure with an exquisite game feel along with M.O.T.H.E.R., Haneda Girl’s combat tactic mecha. Slashes or bullets, control both characters and play in a creative and frenetic way. Tight controls, an addictive loop and the best techno music you’ll hear this season. Are you in?
Haneda Girl is a stylish 2D action (precise) platformer. Swap between characters and clean up the menace in the faster, smarter and most efficient way. Each encounter can be solved in very different manners. Be creative! From speed runners to casual players, this game is designed for EVERYONE!

title: GrimmKitchen
description:
게임 정보
Revive the restaurant passed down from your grandmother and aim for a three-star rating!
Enter a fairy tale world where you’ll battle enemies and gather ingredients in action-packed,
while also hiring and training staff to manage your restaurant.
This game offers a blend of restaurant management and fairy tale action!
Fairy Tale Action
Gather Ingredients
Step into a fairy tale world and collect all kinds of ingredients!
Defeat creatures, and you might just find rare, high-quality ingredients.
The more you gather, the more delicious dishes you can serve at your restaurant!
Fairy Tale Skills
Unleash powerful abilities inspired by fairy tale characters in battle!
Use them strategically to turn the tide of the fight in your favor!

title: RESIDUAL SOUL
description:
게임 정보
RESIDUAL SOUL is a singleplayer narrative short-story heavily inspired by the creepypasta horror genre.
Gameplay
After being taken to a purgatory-like forest with the promise of speaking to his deceased wife, Matt must survive his time there and bring peace to the souls who still linger. Manage threats like violent souls and fluctuating power levels while unveiling the stories of those who came before you.
Features
• Melancholic atmosphere and stunning visuals
• Thoughtful sound design
• Skilled voice acting
• Dynamic storyline

title: GEX Trilogy
description:
게임 정보
IT'S TAIL TIME, BABY!
Things are about to get weirder than the 4th of July at Rick James' place! Everyone's favorite tail-whipping, channel-surfing gecko is back in a collection that features all of his best-selling adventures!
GEX Trilogy includes the original 2D platformer, GEX, and the two 3D sequels: GEX: Enter the Gecko & GEX 3: Deep Cover Gecko —but these aren't just re-runs! This Carbon Engine powered collection includes extras and numerous improvements like that bring GEX back into prime time!

title: Dungeons of Eternity
description:
게임 정보
Endless fantasy action and adventure await you and your friends in Dungeons of Eternity.
Hack-n-slash takes on a new meaning in VR: swing swords, throw axes, use bows, wield magic staffs, and more to make it out alive.
COOP OR SOLO PLAY
Band together for an unforgettable cooperative experience with up to 4 players, or delve into the dungeons yourself. Teamwork is crucial when facing the hordes of monsters infesting the dungeons: coordinate with your party members to overcome the dangers, or embrace the lone wolf approach, facing your enemies head-on and emerging victorious!
EVER-CHANGING DUNGEONS
Explore randomly-generated dungeons across multiple game modes and realms - no dungeon run is the same. A vast array of chambers await, from combat arenas, puzzle and trap rooms, secret chambers, and more.

title: Northern Ireland '74
description:
게임 정보
The Troubles were an ethno-nationalist conflict in Northern Ireland that lasted for about 30 years from the late 1960s to 1998. Also known internationally as the Northern Ireland conflict, it is sometimes described as an "irregular war" or "low-level war". The conflict began in the late 1960s and is usually deemed to have ended with the Good Friday Agreement of 1998. Although the Troubles mostly took place in Northern Ireland, at times violence spilled over into parts of the Republic of Ireland, England, and mainland Europe.
As the British Armed Forces deployed into Northern Ireland, you will need to win the Hearts and Minds of the local population and balance the aspirations of both the Loyalists and the Nationalists.
Both the IRA and the UVF need to be contained, preventing the insurgency from destabilizing the region.
The Royal Ulster Constabulary (RUC) need to be deployed effectively and fairly to keep the two factions apart as a political solution is sought.
Features
Hearts and Minds Victory conditions
Turn based strategy game, procedurally generated at the start of every new game thereby ensuring extended playability.
Multiple factions for the player to control (UK Army, RUC)
Full and authentic order of battle management
Political support model, stakeholder management of the sentiment back home in England.
Full range of Army/Paramilitary units including transport helicopters, Saracen APC's, Ferret armored Cars, Water Cannons, Engineers etc.
Civilian disobedience (riots and marches)
Special Forces operations (SAS)
Operational intelligence map and tracking
Informants and Military Intelligence model, tracking and capturing Insurgent Leaders
Police actions (raids and roadblocks)
IED's and EOD
Full logistical model, including vehicle repairs and maintenance

title: Road Food Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Road Food Simulator를 솔로 또는 협동 모드로 플레이하세요. 다른 플레이어 게임에 참여하거나 처음부터 새로운 피자 프랜차이즈 매장을 시작하세요.
혼자 또는 친구와 함께 피자 매장에서 고객에게 피자를 배달하세요. 피자 도우로 시작하여 재료를 넣으세요.
최고의 피자는 팀워크로 만들어집니다.
한 사람이 피자를 만드는 동안 다른 사람은 피자를 포장합니다. 다른 사람은 피자를 배달합니다.

title: Neongarten
description:
게임 정보
Neongarten is a captivating turn-based strategy game that blends tactical depth with minimalist design, inspired by the likes of ISLANDERS and Luck be a Landlord. Immerse yourself in a vibrant, neon-soaked world where each turn presents new challenges and opportunities.
As the architect of a growing digital garden, you'll carefully place structures and units to expand your territory, earning resources and unlocking powerful synergies along the way. The balance between risk and reward is key—will you play it safe or gamble on high-stakes upgrades?
With a unique combination of procedural generation and strategic depth, NeonGarten keeps you on your toes. Every game offers a fresh experience, demanding you to adapt, optimize, and evolve your tactics.
Key Features:
Turn-based Strategy: Plan your moves carefully, with each decision shaping the future of your neon garden.
Procedural Generation: No two runs are the same, offering endless replayability and new challenges every time.
Minimalist, Cyberpunk Aesthetic: Dive into a stunning retro-futuristic world, where glowing lights meet strategic depth.
Inspired by Islanders and Luck be a Landlord: Combine the simplicity of city-building with the thrill of roguelike progression.
Whether you're looking for a laid-back yet engaging strategy experience or a deep, ever-changing puzzle to solve, NeonGarten offers a unique blend of both worlds.

title: Nightmare Shift
description:
게임 정보
사람들은 벽에 귀가 있다고 말하지만, 벽에 눈이 있다면 어떨까요? 당신이 하는 모든 일을 지켜보고, 기다리고, 보는 눈이 있다면요.
외딴 모텔에서 야간 근무를 하고, 불안한 손님을 상대하고, 섬뜩한 사건을 해결해 보세요. 엠마의 불안한 아파트 생활을 경험하고, 감시당하고 있다는 불안감을 느끼고, 현실과 악몽의 경계가 흐려지면서 무엇이 진짜인지 의문을 품어보세요.
엠마의 세계
평범한 밤이 비범한 미스터리로 밝혀지는 엠마의 삶 속으로 들어가 보세요. 엠마의 두려움과 고군분투, 현실과 악몽 사이의 모호한 경계를 경험해 보세요.
불안한 일상

title: Treasure 'n Trio
description:
게임 정보
트레저 앤 트리오
트레저 앤 트리오는 유명 퍼즐 게임 소코반을 베이스로 한 싱글 플레이어 퍼즐 게임입니다.
타일 단위로 이동하고 오브젝트와 상호작용하며 퍼즐을 풀어나갑니다.
  세 명의 캐릭터
무력으로 해결하는 전사, 기민하고 약삭빠른 도적, 순간이동 마법을 가진 겁쟁이 마법사가 한 팀이 되어 움직입니다.
서로 다른 능력을 가진 세 캐릭터를 적재적소에 사용하여 퍼즐을 풀어보세요.

title: Recharge
description:
게임 정보
Recharge – The Ultimate RC Racing Experience
Feel the thrill of RC racing like never before! With stunningly realistic graphics, physics-driven gameplay, and extensive customization options, Recharge is the definitive RC racing game for arcade enthusiasts and simulation purists alike. Whether you prefer solo adventures or adrenaline-pumping multiplayer races, Recharge delivers an immersive racing experience that bridges the gap between fun and realism.
KEY FEATURES
Singleplayer & Multiplayer
Race alone or compete in thrilling online matches with up to 12 players!
Dynamic Camera Angles
Choose from multiple perspectives to capture every twist and turn, from ground-level action to cinematic drone views.
Advanced Vehicle Customization
Create your dream RC car with a range of customization options, from paint jobs to performance upgrades.

title: Tower Dominion
description:
게임 정보

제국은 야만적인 아트로니드의 끈질긴 침략에 직면하여 존립 자체를 위협받고 있습니다. 사령관으로서 당신은 치명적인 적의 공격에 맞서는 최후의 방어선입니다. 무한 반복 가능한 이 게임의 체험을 통해서 모든 전투는 당신에게 예측할 수 없는 결과로 새로운 도전을 선사합니다
적들이 진격하는 바로 그 지형을 만들어 전장을 장악하세요. 목진지를 만들기 위해 지형 타일을 확장하고 수정하여 적에게 치명적인 포격을 가하거나 치밀하게 배치한 함정으로 유인하세요. 높이와 경로는 당신의 가장 강력한 무기로, 이를 현명하게 사용해 전투의 흐름을 주도하고 승리를 확보하세요.

title: Deadzone: Rogue
description:
게임 정보
당신은 ISS-X에서 깨어났고, 당신이 누구인지 전혀 기억하지 못합니다. 수많은 불량 기계가 있고, 그들은 빠르게 다가오고 있습니다. 적 무리를 물리치고, 희귀한 장비를 약탈하고, 증강 장치로 무장하여 살아남으세요. 데드존을 정복할 수 있을까요?
안
정적인 조준과 빠른 반사신경을 요구하는 거대하고 생체역학적 보스와 싸우세요. 사냥꾼 드론, 로보 스파이더, 무의미한 자들, 그리고 수십 명의 다른 적들을 섬멸하여 각 런에서 살아남으세요. 엔진실에서 브릭까지 모든 선박 구역에서 전투를 벌이세요.

title: Blasted Dice
description:
게임 정보
Blow up your enemies!
Blasted Dice is roguelike deckbuilder where you have a launcher that shoots explosive dice. As you play through rounds, you acquire different dice and items that aid you in doing more damage to your enemies, or blocking from their attacks.
Acquire powerful dice!
Assemble a deck of 9 different varieties of dice, each one with different effects on your score. Use that score to damage enemies or block from their attacks. Playing various combinations of dice form combos that boost your score even higher.
Discover a variety of items!

title: Ninja Ming
description:
게임 정보
Ninja Ming is a precision platformer with a teleportation twist. Play as Ming the ninja and take on the Path of Trial through 8 chapters and 241 levels. 
Dash? Flash! Teleportation is Key.
Throw a kunai and instantly teleport to its location!
Ninja Ming relies heavily on the move of teleportation. Once mastered, you’ll be commanding the air and dashing through the challenging areas.
Build Your Ninjutsu Skillset
"Flash" is just the beginner skill! As you progress through levels, you'll unlock even more dazzling abilities: use "ExFlash" for long-range teleportation, destroy (or build) terrain with "Fireball" and "Rock," and find creative solutions with "Replacement Dash"

title: Somniora: Chapter 1
description:
게임 정보
Somniora is a horror-puzzle game. Get ready to delve into the adventure of our character, who is trapped amidst strange dreams, while searching for answers to the questions lurking in their subconscious.
Amara
Like everyone else, you are someone trying to earn a living through your talent. While your debts and problems never seem to end, you also have to deal with your past. Psychological support aside, you cannot even sleep without medication. Why are you so afraid?
The big day
When that day comes, you won’t even know where you are because you’re on the other side, and if the ones controlling that place don’t want you to wake up, you won’t. Of course, defeating them might change things. A little blood may be spilled...

title: Diner Bros 2
description:
게임 정보
HECTIC KITCHEN ACTION
Are you ready to put your culinary skills to the test?  Serve up delicious dishes in the fast-paced, fun, and frantic Diner Bros 2.  Open a bustling restaurant in this chaotic local co-op experience: Juggle orders, cook tasty meals, and race against the clock to satisfy your hungry customers!
KNOW YOUR CUSTOMERS
In Diner Bros 2, it's not just the orders that get crazy — it’s also the Unique Customers who will keep you on your toes! Each character has their own quirks and demands that will test your multitasking skills:
No loitering! The Teenager thinks she can stay all day!
Always on the move, the Jogger wants their food quickly - and we mean fast!
Watch out for the sneaky Punk looking for an opportunity to dine and dash!
... and many more! It's up to you to keep the orders flowing!
UPGRADE YOUR RESTAURANT
Purchase New Equipment: as your diner grows, you'll need better tools to keep up with the increasing demand.
Optimize Your Kitchen Layout: Efficiency is key when it comes to earning cash, so make sure your kitchen is set up for smooth operation.  Or don't!
Expand Your Restaurant: Can you impress the Food Critic and earn the coveted 3-star award?

title: Custom Goban
description:
게임 정보
커스텀 고반(Custom Goban)은 바둑을 재해석한 것으로, 바둑은 전략적 사고와 계획의 복잡성 면에서 체스에 필적하는 아시아의 고전적인 지적 보드 게임이라고 할 수 있습니다. 고전적인 19x19 바둑판에서 플레이하는 것은 많은 플레이어들에게 여전히 흥미로운 일이겠지만, 커스텀 고반은 자신만의 영역을 만들고 전통적인 바둑 규칙에 따른 플레이를 나누어 할 수 있는 기회를 제공하고 있습니다. 이것은 재미있을 뿐만 아니라 게임에 더 많은 창의성을 가져오고 플레이어들이 새로운 방식으로 생각하게 할 것입니다. 게임 시간을 단축하기 위해 기존의 361점의 게임보다 작은 새로운 보드를 만들어낼 수 있으며, 그렇다고 하여 단지 "또 다른 더 작은 사각 보드"가 되지는 않을 것입니다. 숙련된 바둑 기사이든, 이제 막 시작한 바둑 초보이든, 여러분은 좋아하실 거에요!
특징
여러분만의 바둑판 모양을 만듭니다. 구멍 및 불규칙성 부여 가능
공개적으로 서버의 다른 사용자와 PvP를 플레이 가능
친구와 P2P 또는 동일한 기기에서 플레이 가능
KataGo 인공지능과 바둑판에서 겨뤄보세요
플레이를 위해 OGS(Online Go Server)에 연결하세요
미니멀리즘적이고 잘 설계된 UI를 사용합니다
크로스 플랫폼 플레이: iOS, Android(개발 중)

title: Shroomtopia
description:
게임 정보


귀엽고 알록달록한 Shroomtopia의 세계에 빠져보세요! 평온한 풍경을 탐험하며 다양한 퍼즐을 풀고 편안한 시간을 보내세요. 육각형의 땅을 조작하고 색을 섞어보세요. 자연을 되살릴 수 있는 건 오직 당신뿐입니다!



창의력을 발휘할 수 있는 레벨 에디터 제공
직관적이면서도 강력한 도구로 나만의 스테이지를 디자인해 보세요!



더 많은 즐길 거리:

title: Afterschool Adventurers Club
description:
게임 정보
Rumours are that the AfterSchool Adventurers Club started playing a very strange version of the "Adventurers & Perils" tabletop roleplaying game lately!
Most of the club members have left, too scared of what could happen to them on a bad roll, but, for some reasons, your best friend Billy and his party went in last week, never to be seen again.
Some students have tried to warn the teachers, but none would listen. Adults, right? Always too busy with work and stuff to see the truth!
There is no other choice, only you can do it!
As you open the door to the AfterSchool Adventurers Club, you see the evil grin on the Game Master's face:
"A new player? Roll for initiative!"
Gameplay
AfterSchool Adventurers Club is a rogue-lite dungeon-crawler game set in the 80's, where players prepare for their runs in the high-school's tabletop roleplaying club before entering the fantastic world of Vanderfell to delve into perilous dungeons, fight treacherous monsters, uncover special events and face formidable bosses to solve the mystery of the AfterSchool Adventurers Club!
Features
Randomized dungeons for endless replayabiity.
Multiple quests and events to keep runs fresh.
12 Unique classes, each with their own passive skill and starting gear, to fit your favored playstyle.
Lootable Weapons, Spell books, Accessories and Consumables to help adapt on the go.
Various Table Items to combine in the club to further customize your runs and character.
No power meta progression, your skills as a player is what matters!
Built for the Sega Master System, for an authentic retro feel.

title: Metavoidal
description:
게임 정보
If at first you don’t succeed, the only thing to do is to die again. Use your drumsticks to show that you ARE a good drummer!
PLAY AS A DRUMMER who sees through the façade of an ominous metal band
NAVIGATE THE CHURCH overrun with corrupted fans & unimaginable horrors
LEVEL-UP YOUR DRUMMING SKILLS by proving yourself and unlocking new techniques
BUILD YOUR PLAYLIST, and use it to beat your way through the corrupted hordes
DEFEAT THE MEMBERS of hideous, eldritch band, one-by-one.
And ESCAPE!
You, a drummer, just failed your audition with a metal band. After coming to your senses, you realize that everything around you is being controlled and twisted by them & their music. What's worse, they’ve got an army of countless corrupted fans… and now you must defeat all the band members to end this evil curse for good.

title: Adult Game
description: Adult Game

title: Of Sense and Soul
description:
게임 정보
In 1875 London, an editorialist and a gentleman have an unusual first meeting through a misconstrued personal ad. Their paths intertwine as they struggle against their own regrets and ways, and they must decide which to follow: their hearts, or the status quo.
Of Sense and Soul is a story lost to time, centred on two men navigating the smog-covered streets of Victorian London: Hugo Brooks, a reserved editorialist who never adventures far outside the written word, or Seamus Charkham, a confirmed bachelor who would sooner move forward blindfolded than look to the past.
Both are set in their ways, and both are in desperate need of a change, though loath to admit it. Despite wanting to believe they’re satisfied with continuing on as they have been, they find that sometimes, things can change for the better — and that the marks we leave on the lives of those around us are so much greater than we realise.

title: Dreadtome
description:
게임 정보
Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, as well as the battles within your own mind, in this Action-Adventure first person shooter.
This is a student project.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Use your gun, Repulsor gadget and environmental hazards in strategic ways to dispatch the corrupted creatures that roam the library.
Overcome trials of the mind in order to upgrade your tools.
Explore the labyrinthian library to replenish resources, and uncover the story that unfolded before your arrival.
Battle varying enemy types, each with their own unique dangers.

title: Monster Mash
description:
게임 정보
The evil pharmaceutical mogul Ultrachem has been tampering with a ton of top secret genetic projects lately. Everything seemed to be going as planned until the planet was invaded by the Gorgonaut Empire! With a healthy dose of gamma rays, the laboratory’s test gecko, who has been undergoing less-than-kind experiments lately, decides to exact their revenge!

You're deemed too high of a threat to the city of Metroville and you'll have 2 minutes until the city is completely nuked. The frat alien sect known as the UFBro's are on Lunar Break and they're screwing up the planet just for kicks (and a ton of views on GlikGlok). They'll deliver various mutated weapons like mallets, swords, and ray guns to up the ante, as well as delicious snacks. Destroy buildings, cars, and everything else as you absolutely RAGE!

title: Spirit of the North 2
description:
게임 정보


폐허로 변해버린 고대의 세계 속에서 집을 떠나 고립된 여우의 여정을 함께하세요. 현명한 까마귀 친구의 도움을 받아 잃어버린 전설의 가디언을 찾고 어둠의 주술사인 그림니르의 손아귀로부터 그들을 풀어주세요.





잊혀진 역사를 담고 있는 방대한 고대의 오픈 월드를 자유롭게 탐험하세요. 개성 넘치고 시각적으로 황홀한 생물군계를 탐험하세요. 각 생물군계는 저마다의 어려움과 비밀을 담고 있습니다.





능력을 강화시켜 주는 강력한 룬을 발견하세요. 그리고 밀림, 눈 덮인 산봉우리, 고대의 지하묘지를 여행하면서 사라진 가디언을 구하세요.



여우의 외모와 스킬을 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞게 조정해서 매번 새로운 재미를 느껴 보세요.





강력한 적과 상대하면서, 스릴 넘치는 퍼즐 기반의 만남을 통해 전설의 가디언 야수를 구하세요.

title: Stellar Blade
description:
게임 정보
인류를 위해 지구를 탈환하세요
PC로 찾아오는 평단의 찬사를 받은 액션 어드벤처, 스텔라 블레이드™에서 멸종 위기의 인류를 구원하세요.
지구 몰락의 비밀을 풀며 맹렬한 전투와 뜻밖의 스토리를 경험하세요.
한국 개발사 SHIFT UP이 개발하였으며, PC에 최적화하였습니다.
2025년 6월에 만나볼 수 있습니다.
지금 위시리스트에 추가하세요.
장엄한 포스트 아포칼립스 세계를 탐험하세요

인류의 미래는 칼날 위를 걷는 것처럼 위태롭습니다. 신비하고 강력한 생명체의 공격을 받은 지구는 이제 버려졌고, 적은 수의 인간 생존자는 우주의 콜로니로 퇴각했습니다.

이브는 지구를 파괴한 사악한 존재인 네이티브로부터 지구를 탈환하고, 인류를 구원한다는 중대한 임무를 가지고, 콜로니를 떠나 황폐화된 지구에 도착합니다.

하지만 네이티브를 차례차례 처치하고, 인류 문명의 잔재를 탐험하고 과거의 비밀을 짜맞추면서, 이브는 자신의 임무가 그리 단순하지 않다는 걸 깨닫습니다. 임무뿐 아니라, 자신이 믿는 모든 것에 의문을 품습니다...
스릴 넘치는 날카로운 액션

폐허가 된 지구를 돌파하며 숨 가쁘게 진행되는 전투에 뛰어드세요. 잔혹하지만 우아한 콤보를 해방하고, 새로운 기술과 무기 업그레이드를 해제하고, 두뇌와 실력을 모두 시험하는 극적인 보스전을 즐기세요.

아름다움과 공포를 적절하게 조합하여 최고의 효과를 선보이는, 섬세하게 구현한 포스트 아포칼립스 세계관에 빠지세요. PS5의 그래픽 성능으로 살아 숨 쉬는, 놀라운 SF 느낌의 환경을 탐험하세요.

처음부터 끝까지 심오한 테마와 상상을 자극하는 내러티브, 감성 가득한 깨달음으로 가득한 흥미진진한 인류의 운명에 대한 이야기를 확인하세요.

title: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
description:
게임 정보
Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
Every Scan, Every Choice, Humanity’s Survival Depends on You.
Step into the boots of an army officer in Quarantine Zone: The Last Checkpoint, a gripping survival simulation where every decision is a question of life or death for somebody. In a world ravaged by a zombie outbreak, you oversee a critical checkpoint tasked with separating healthy refugees from the infected—and sometimes, the merely suspicious.
Key Features:
Resource Management: Balance limited supplies of test kits and inspection tools while maintaining order and ensuring your checkpoint remains secure.
Dynamic Threats: Face an evolving queue of refugees—some healthy, some carrying ordinary illnesses, and others harboring deadly zombie pathogens.

title: Knightward
description:
게임 정보
다양한 종류의 탑을 모아 무적의 방어선을 구축하세요. 어떤 탑은 버프를 걸고, 어떤 탑은 치유를 하며, 또 다른 탑은 한 번에 수백 명의 적을 소멸시키는 블랙홀을 발사합니다.

title: Fungiman 2
description:
게임 정보
The mysterious yet strangely alluring sequel to beloved horror game Fungiman.
You are a cook and a cook needs their ingredients. What ingredients might require the help of your old friend Fungiman? What's so important that makes you go on a journey through deserts and snowy mountaintops?
You are making THE donut. The one world has never seen or tasted before, and Fungiman is there to stop you. Will you let it happen?

Features:
• A big interconnected multi-area map
• Multiple different endings
• SECRETS
• Unique retro art style

title: Isle Of Pirates
description:
게임 정보
 Ahoy, Captain! Welcome to Isle of Pirates! 
The waves are calling you, the wind fills your sails! From a deserted island to an epic pirate paradise, will you have the courage and wit to lead the way? If your answer is "Aye, Captain!", then you’re in the right waters!
Gather Resources!
A sailor’s treasure isn’t just gold! Chop down trees, break stones, and collect materials! Remember, a strong pirate base needs a solid foundation.
Build Your Tavern!
Every great captain needs a home! Use your resources to build an epic pirate tavern and spread your name across the oceans with every wave!
Decorate Your Tavern!
Pirates don’t just swing swords; they love a good atmosphere too! Hang lanterns from the ceiling, pin ancient maps to the walls, or maybe make space for a pirate band? Should it be lavish, or more like a dark pirate lair? The choice is yours, Captain!
Set Sail into the Blue Waters!
There are unexplored islands on the horizon, lands that aren’t even on the map! The helm is calling you, are you ready to explore? Remember, great treasures require great adventures!

title: Pawfect Inc.
description:
게임 정보
We aim to liberate every friend trapped in tedious desk jobs!
This is an idle casual game that sits at the bottom of your screen. Simply play by clicking and dragging—or do nothing at all, and the game will keep running on its own. In the game, you’ll recruit adorable animals to work at your startup company. Your job? Be the boss and make sure they don’t slack off! Profits generated by their work or spending can be used to renovate or expand your cozy office—or splurge on cyber-themed indulgences. After all, you’re the boss!
Character Design
The game features a wide variety of adorable animals (only a few designs are shown here). Each has unique personalities, career backgrounds, and quirks—these differences are part of the fun! What will they do once they join your company?
Office Customization
The game offers diverse range of themed scenes and furniture to match. Unleash your creativity and design a one-of-a-kind office!
You can even change the exterior buildings to place your office in any city you like—Tokyo skyscrapers, Parisian alleys, or cyberpunk metropolises!
Furniture & Props
Every piece of furniture you buy for the office unlocks new interactions for your animal employees. The more variety you add, the richer their behaviors become! Plus, you can click on these cute furniture items with your mouse to interact with them yourself!
The translation preserves the playful and motivational tone while adapting idioms like "摸鱼" (slacking off) and (cyber-themed indulgences) for natural English readability. Let me know if you need adjustments!

title: Mini Star Quest
description:
게임 정보
사냥의 시간!
미니 스타 퀘스트는 턴제 액션 게임입니다. 티켓을 모아 퀘스터들을 모집하고 여러개의 강력한 파티들을 편성하여 거대한 적들을 화끈하게 사냥해보세요!
특징
자신만의 파티들을 완성해보세요! 한 퀘스트에 최대 3개의 파티를 동시에 데려갈 수 있습니다
하나의 파티로 단기 퀘스트를 도전하거나, 또는 최대 3개의 파티로 장기전을 도전해보세요!
퀘스트를 완료하고 티켓을 모아 귀여운 퀘스터들을 모집해보세요!
귀엽고 컬러풀하며 화려하기까지한 턴제 액션에 푹 빠져보세요!

title: Dino Tower Arena
description:
게임 정보
Dino Tower Arena is a action roguelite game where you can build your dinosaur with different abilities and put it into fights against waves of enemy dinos, upgrading it with new abilities, boosting its stats and unlocking new dinosaurs while advancing on the floors of the enormous Dino Tower!

title: Space Saga
description:
게임 정보
우주의 광대한 공간은 오래전부터 인류를 매료시켰으며, 그 신비로운 깊이는 우리 모두의 호기심과 탐험에 대한 열망을 불러일으키는 비밀과 수수께끼로 가득 차 있습니다. **SPACE SAGA**에서 당신은 진정한 우주 탐험가가 될 기회를 얻게 되며, 위험과 미스터리로 가득 찬 스릴 넘치는 모험에 뛰어들게 됩니다.

title: Rusty Flesh
description:
게임 정보
Rusty Flesh is a sci-fi horror puzzle platformer for the Game Boy Color where you switch gravity instead of jumping (guess you could call it a VVVVVV-like!). Explore the different areas of a derelict spaceship putting together all the pieces of its lovecraftian mistery, and enjoy its retro-futuristic aesthetics.

In the near future, Earth has become a wasteland, unfit for any kind of life. Nations fell, and big tech corporations seized power. They had been getting ready for this. They built massive spaceships where a few chosen ones would travel for hundreds of years, looking for a new home. The Grampus was one of those ships... but something went wrong.
Features
Explore a derelict spaceship: Something's wrong in this spaceship, and it's up to you to discover what happened. Explore the ship and find clues in a non-linear narrative.
Solve gravity-based puzzles: Combine your gravity switch with other mechanics to progress through Rusty Flesh's series of puzzles.
Fight undead abominations: The former crew members have been turned into undead monsters, and they are after you.
8-bit retro gaming fun: Get back to the glorious days of 8-bit handheld gaming! Rusty Flesh actually runs on a Game Boy Color, with all its limitations.

Note: The description, screenshots and trailer you see depict a game that is still in development. All content is subject to change as development continues.

title: Dark Dungeon Feminized
description:
게임 정보
Story background
[Theta Foundation] is a laboratory with the highest security level deep underground, specially set up to contain and study [weird monsters]. After experiencing a system crash, the laboratory, which was closed according to the emergency protocol, became the darkest dungeon
You will play the role of a special agent who survived the crash and try your best to escape from here
As the exit gets closer, the monster will become more and more crazy
Don't be deceived by the appearance of the monster
In order to protect your sanity from being eroded, you are implanted with a [cognitive filter] - but while it saves you from madness, it also distorts your senses, making the creepy monster look like a gorgeous beauty, but a monster is still a monster...

title: Lighthouse Of The Souls
description:
게임 정보
그는 신비주의에 정통한 추기경이었는데, 그의 수행원들과 함께 외딴 섬으로 파견되었습니다. 임무는 고대 문명의 비밀을 밝히는 것입니다. 당신의 임무는 그 비밀을 찾는 것입니다. 하지만 당신이 발견하는 것은 당신의 신앙과 인간성을 시험할 것입니다.
설명
Lighthouse Of The Souls는 RPG 요소와 사실적인 그래픽을 갖춘 3인칭 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다. 혼자 또는 친구들과 함께 어둠의 세계에서 도전에 맞서세요. 그 도전에서 생존 여부는 여러분의 기술과 전략에 달려 있습니다.

title: RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme
description:
게임 정보
R.A.C.E is an action game set in a post-apocalyptic world of steel monsters and epic battles! Survival racing simulator! Welcome to a unique game where the management, pumping and control of the car at the highest level! Real steel rage in survival races! Get engaged in 3D ultimate race battles, fire rockets and use the protective shield to counter the attack from the enemy. Nitro Boost is mandatory! Collect turbo while you hit that gas pedal and leave all other race cars behind. You decide the rules on the track while you drift, drag, bump, collide, fire and overtake to finish first!

FAST ACTION RACING IN 3D
Monster trucks, roaring engines, smoking tires, damaging collisions, and above all Speed! R.A.C.E. - Rocket Arena Car Extreme - is full of epic explosions, destruction and effects. Press nitro - get even more adrenaline, and let your enemies breathe dust. The change of day and night, the neon signs and tricks will never let you get bored. If you like to play with beautiful graphics and no brakes, then this is your race car game of choice! You can change the graphics settings to improve the gameplay quality and smoothness.

THE ULTIMATE RACE BATTLE EXPERIENCE
Your Monster Truck, your arena, your rules! Participate in Arena battles and get straight in to the real action. Burn out your enemies in the derby arena and race them into fire traps, huge morgensterns, chainsaws and other destructive obstacles. This race game is like a real action movie! Rocket Arena Car Extreme (R.A.C.E.) is a burning cocktail of survival races and battles on wheels.

VARIOUS BATTLE LOCATIONS
Participate in battles of different historical epochs!

THE BEST ENEMY IS THE BEATEN ENEMY
Crazy and dangerous driving is a good thing in this racing game because risks are needed to beat your enemies. Choose a weapon to your liking: missiles, bombs, machine guns, and various electric weapons.

BEST ARENA RACE VEHICLES
Win action-packed races and earn rewards to collect your ultimate off-road race car. Make the most out of the vehicles available to you. You will find American muscle cars, European classics and Japanese drift vehicles! Each car is equipped with everything you may need to inflict the maximal damage to your opponents. Those monsters on wheels will cope with any off-road conditions.


Each vehicle may be leveled up as high as level 30. When a vehicle is leveled up to levels 10, 20 and 30, it gains unique body kits that improve race and battle performance even more.


Have you ever wondered if the tank is half full or half empty? The positive attitude rules in this action game - the tank is always full. No need to wait for several hours to restore energy for your car to start racing. You can always rush at full throttle without any limits!


Get prepared to battle for the rank. Many players fight to become the first one and to grab the main reward - the all-time champion title. Upgrade your cars, unlock new ones, upgrade your super skills and perks, upgrade your weapons and win on the road!


Enjoy the specially designed music to feel the excitement of the spectacular speed and explosive competition during the races.


You can change the graphics settings to improve the gameplay quality and smoothness. Unique car skins, colorful and vibrant styles of drawings and car stickers!


- Battle Arena – battle royale style racing
- Career – Race career campaign
- Battle Racing - Racing vehicles special mode
- Tournaments - Racing for the greatest rewards.

Play our racing game, upgrade your cars, crush your enemies, win prizes and become the king of survival races!

title: SIMP: Super Infection Massive Pathology
description:
게임 정보


"The greatest infection in the world is love."

Gaylord took that phrase very seriously when, during his wedding, a giant syringe interrupted the ceremony and abducted all his friends and his fiancée, Zoe...

"A small infection in a needle" - the doctors said... but they had no idea what a true SIMP could do.



Travel throughout the human body, annihilating hordes of enemies and overcoming normal obstacles and traps. A leg? An eye? The rectum? Of course!

Additionally, the obstacles in some maps are dynamically generated, so each game will be different.



Face numerous enemies, from simple Slimes, macrophages, and proteins to a dangerous tapeworm! Over 20 different enemies, each with their own attack and strategy.



Enjoy over 50 weapons, 30 items, and 10 different buildings to customize your build and destroy the human body!

title: AirShooShoo
description:
게임 정보
A unique platformer, where you have to collect stars and shards flying through challenging levels. Avoiding obstacles, having the most precise movements to squeeze in some more seconds.


In single player mode the level difficulty increases slowly, giving plenty of time to enjoy and learn the challenging mechanics of flying between the platforms.


You can go one step further and aim for speed! This game is especially designed for speedrunning, an homage to the style was deeply my intention. Playing against your own time, or against the Global Leaderboards.


Challenge each other in online TimeTrials. Playing on the same level racing for the best time. Highly inspired by TrackMania Nations. A very fun mode with a high pressure sharp skill challenge.



Let's Kill each other! Online, high speed, fast paced, tactical good old shooting! Head-On: The Ultimate Gravity Shooter is considered the predecessor of this game. Try that online was the ultimate goal! Hope you enjoy that mode, it is my favourite.




Choose the skin of your ship, choose your trail, your weapons! Fine tune the engine, even the nitty-gritty details can be set to your taste. To perform on the highest level, you might need those.

title: Upwards
description:
게임 정보
On the outskirts of a small village stands a massive tree whose canopy disappears far above the clouds. While grandiose on the outside, its interior houses the humble Mortem Post, which receives and delivers letters from those who have passed on. Deciding to break protocol to lend a helping wing, Rain, a flighty little courier takes a skittish girl by the name of Mila on an adventure through the inner workings of the post office. Together, they search for a letter containing the last words of someone who seemingly never existed.
One part visual novel, one part puzzle adventure! Follow Rain and Mila through the mysterious Mortem Post as they meet with various couriers working throughout the tree and make use of Rain's trusty stamp collection to overcome a myriad of obstacles that stand in their way!
Often during your adventure, you'll need to take advantage of stamps to tie words together in intuitive ways to help Rain and Mila out of various sticky situations. No two puzzles are exactly the same -- from choose-your-own-adventure style outcomes to stealth missions, you'll see just how versatile Rain's stamps can really be!
autokwd: Upwards, Rain! The Post Office of Farewells

title: Sinbad
description:
게임 정보
Sinbad is a charming 3D sandbox platfomer inspired by A Thousand and One Arabian Nights and games such as Super Mario and A Hat in Time.

It follows a young Sinbad who stumbles upon a Magic Lamp and gets sucked in and trapped inside! Finding this secret magical land in turmoil Sinbad must help a Genie usurped from his throne to overpower the evil Jinn to restore order in the Lamp in order to escape as well!

During this adventure, Sinbad discovers a magic carpet that becomes his companion. This wonderful and magical carpet allows him to hover and interact with various objects around the world. As the player, you must collect Magic Lanterns to disperse the evil curse that the Jinn has placed upon the land.



You explore many different locations and environments around the mystical island inside the Magic Lamp, each area with a different story to tell.

Collect all Magic Lanterns in order to defeat the Jinn and return to the real world!

title: Find Exit
description:
게임 정보


When you wake up, you find yourself in a surreal world full of amazing things, but have you woken up?

What is a dream?
Memories from past lives?
Projection of pictures from the subconscious?

You don't know who you are.
You don't know where you are.
You don't know what to do.

Maybe it's time to wake up?

Find Exit — is a art work with an open world full of secrets. In the game you have to solve riddles relying solely on your intellect, use: abstract, logical and associative methods of thinking, perhaps then the way out will open to you. The game is based on a silent narrative, and also proceeds from the fact that an intelligent person who values his time interacts with it. Not a single game element exists just for complication, every detail carries a thought. The whole picture is saturated with meaning. Travel, contemplate, analyze the world around you, and discover all its secrets by solving riddles.

The game contains mixed genres such as puzzle, psychological horror, slasher.

title: Porta-Tower
description:
게임 정보
Porta-Tower is a roguelike tower defense game where you can pick up and move your towers to better cover the enemies' path.
Move Your Towers
A tower's placement is important, so when a position becomes suboptimal, pick it up and move it! How much you want to move them will depend on what type of towers you have. Long-ranged towers can be left alone for longer while short-ranged towers will need to be moved more frequently to stay in range of enemies.
Upgrade Your Towers
When you've gathered enough crystals, move your tower to the upgrader and upgrade it. Be careful, though, as moving a tower to the upgrader will take it out of the defense until you put it back in position.
Unlockable Towers
As you play, you'll unlock new towers to be used in future runs. Expand your collection of towers to destroy enemies in whatever way you want.

title: Survivors SymphonYs
description:
게임 정보
Musical Weapons
In Survivors SymphonYs, the tree at the center has to be protected. Its roots weave SymphonY patterns, from the depths of the earth through time and space – the source of your magic. Therefore, your weapons are musical instruments, and your attack patterns based on music. Each combination of instruments creates a musical variation, leading to over 28 million possible scores. The better your instruments harmonize, the more SymphonY you accumulate, the higher the tempo of the music, and the more damage you deal. Dash to the rhythm of the music for additional strength, to break bones, activate special attacks, and reflect bullets.
Explore and Defend
Your goal is to survive for four days, protect the tree at the center of your base, and descend into the well of darkness to confront the evil in the abyss. Explore five hand-crafted levels filled with over 150 unique monsters, and listen for new musicians to aid your cause. But beware: while carving your path through hordes of enemies, your base will also be attacked by the evil lurking in the well. This calls for tough decisions: do you level your weapons or the defenders in your base? Do you keep exploring to gain more experience, or warp back to defend? Do you sacrifice your health to clear the base, or will that lead to an even quicker death?
                                                                            Warp back and clear the base.
Build your Base

title: Scramble Up!
description:
게임 정보
Scramble Up! is a fast-paced word puzzle game set against the backdrop of ancient Egyptian pyramids. Test your vocabulary skills as you ascend through a series of pyramids, rearranging letters to form new words on each level. Your goal? To scramble your way to the top, one word at a time, before time runs out!

Game Overview:

In Scramble Up!, you begin at the base of a pyramid with a word that has each letter occupying a block. As you move up the pyramid, you must rearrange all but one letter on the row above to form a new word, continuing this process until you reach the top. The game starts simple but quickly grows more challenging as the pyramids get larger and the words longer.

With each successfully completed word, you’ll add time to your countdown clock. Speed and word complexity are key as you race against time to complete each pyramid. Think fast, scramble wisely, and ascend to victory!

Key Features:

• Addictive Word Puzzle Gameplay: Rearrange letters to form new words in a unique pyramid format.
• Timer-Based Challenge: Keep the clock ticking by forming valid words and earning time bonuses.
• Progressive Difficulty: Start with simple pyramids and work your way up to more challenging ones with longer starting words.
• Egyptian-Themed Visuals: Enjoy a vibrant and engaging backdrop inspired by ancient Egypt.
• Scoring System: Earn points based on word complexity and how quickly you submit your words.
• Endless Replayability: Each play-through offers new words and pyramid structures, keeping the gameplay fresh and challenging.

Can you master the pyramid and discover the secrets within?

title: Friend of a Slime
description:
게임 정보
Stranded at the shore of mystic woods you will join the troops of slimes to defeat hordes of enemies threatening the kingdom of Holy Slime. But no worries, you won't fight those battles alone. Your cute, little, yet combat ready companion will help you with your mission.
Collect fruits on your journey to transform your companion and make it even stronger!

Play together on a single keyboard or with gamepad controllers!
Player 2 will take over the control of Slime.
Features:
Survivors-like action in short 10 minute sessions
20 weapons
20 wearables
30 artifacts that last through rounds
Slime companion that can be transformed
Lightweight RPG World
Minimalistic Dialogues

title: Shade Silver 2 A Walk In The Darkness
description:
게임 정보
Shade Silver 2 A Walk In The Darkness is a game about a wizard trapped in a nightmare looking for an exit. He must stop his nightmares form becoming real and taking over reality.
Achievements
34 levels
Wider verity of game play
More horror like than the first
New death animations
New looks for Shade Silver
More Puzzles
New Bosses
Harder and more fun mazes
2 Dreams AKA Nightmares Basically 2 Games
Get ready to have nightmares and run for you life in a spellbinding Horror game made just for you. Shade Silver 2 A Walk In The Darkness is a new adventure to help you satisfy your cravings for Nightmares.
autokwd: Shade Silver 2 A Walk In The Darkness

title: The Merry Fairy
description:
게임 정보
Deep in the heart of the Fairyland forest lies a hidden sanctuary of creativity and wonder—The Merry Fairy. As a cherished guest in Fairy’s enchanted cottage, you’ll step into a world where journaling becomes pure magic. Collect whimsical decorations, adorable doodles, and uplifting quotes to create stunning journal spreads that capture your most magical thoughts.

Gather a delightful collection of stickers, doodles, and decorations to bring your journal to life. Arrange them freely to craft beautiful spreads that reflect your dreams, thoughts, and inspirations. Add your own thoughts with customisable freeform entries, or print your journal spread designs so you can add your handwriting offline.  

Let the soft glow of lanterns, the gentle rustling of leaves, and the soothing and carefully curated melodies of Fairyland transport you to a world of tranquillity. Customize your journaling space with warm candlelight, twinkling fairy lights, and the soft hum of nature’s lullaby.

Draw wisdom from ancient quotes, discover thought-provoking prompts, and receive affirmations that spark creativity and self-discovery. Or have an interesting chat with Fairy's friends, who will visit you as regularly as you wish.

title: Sqwrk
description:
게임 정보
Sqwk's tribe have been captured by the evil golem. Help him rescue them in this fast paced 3d platformer with momentum based movement

momentum based platforming with wall running
defeat enemies with a homing dash attack
levels have different side challenges to complete

title: Black Smith Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
이 몰입감 넘치는 시뮬레이션 게임에서 숙련된 대장장이가 되어 나만의 대장간을 운영해 보세요. 동적 일주일 주기 시스템을 통해 고객들은 검, 방패, 전투 망치, 도끼, 심지어 앵커 등 다양한 무기와 방어구를 주문하기 위해 가게에 방문합니다. 당신의 장인 정신과 맞춤화 옵션이 고객의 만족도를 결정합니다.
고품질의 장비를 제작하고 판매하여 돈을 벌고, 그 이익을 사용하여 대장간을 개선하세요. 더 좋은 재료를 구입하고, 작업 공간을 확장하고, 더 인상적인 아이템을 만들기 위해 기술을 향상시키세요. 명성이 높아질수록 더 고급 고객들이 독특한 주문을 가지고 찾아옵니다.
성공은 뛰어난 무기의 품질뿐만 아니라 비즈니스 기술에도 달려 있습니다. 현명하게 가격을 책정하고, 자원을 관리하며, 시장의 트렌드에 맞춰 번영하세요. 대장장이의 기술을 마스터하고 최고의 대장간을 만들어 보세요!

title: PATAPON 1+2 REPLAY
description:
게임 정보
신기하고 귀여운 눈알처럼 생긴 생물 ｢파타퐁｣들에게, “4개의 큰북”으로 리듬을 주어 지시를 내려 모험하는 액션 게임.
「파타퐁」은 자세히 보면 조금씩 차이가 있는데, 무리의 중심에서 깃발을 흔들며 앞장서는 ｢깃발퐁｣이나, 큰 방패로 동료를 지키는 ｢방패퐁｣, 활을 이용해 공격하는 「활퐁」 등, 다양한 클래스가 있습니다. 클래스에 따라 역할과 전술도 달라지므로 각자의 개성에 맞게 부대를 편성하여 스테이지를 공략해 나갑시다!
플레이어인 당신은 파타퐁들의 ｢신｣이 되어 “세상의 끝”을 향한 「파타퐁」들의 대행진을 이끌어야 합니다!!
『PATAPON』『PATAPON2』가 세트가 되어 등장!
2007/8년에 발매된 「PATAPON」/「PATAPON2」 두 작품이 리마스터 된 합본 세트로 돌아왔다!
”딱 4개의 버튼”으로 간단한 조작성과 전략성을 갖춘 이면성!
「파타(←)・퐁(→)・동(↓)・챠카(↑)」의 “딱 4개의 큰북”을 리듬에 맞춰 치면 되는 아주 간단한 조작.
한편으론 전황에 맞춰 커맨드를 넣거나, 스테이지에 적합한 클래스로 「파타퐁」 부대를 편성하는 등, 심도 있는 전력 요소도 있는 “간단함과 전략성의 양면”을 갖추고 있다!
반복 플레이 요소가 가득!
「파타퐁」은 아이템을 조합해 탄생, 강화하는 것이 가능. 스테이지와 미니 게임에서 희귀한 소재를 모아서 더욱 강력한 「파타퐁」을 만들 수 있다. 그 밖에도 합계 “약 400종류”의 무기와 장비 같은 강화 요소도 한가득!
철저하게 준비한 “나만의 파타퐁 부대”를 작성해 다양한 기믹의 스테이지와 버라이어티 요소가 가득한 강적에게 도전해 보자!
원작 요소는 그대로 유지하면서 더욱 쉽게 즐길 수 있도록 보조 기능을 새롭게 추가!
원작의 재미는 유지하면서 이번에는 NORMAL・EASY・HARD 3단계의 ”새로운 기준”으로 난이도를 조정하고, 입력 타이밍의 조정 기능, 큰북 커맨드의 상시 표시 기능 등, 보조 기능을 새롭게 추가했다!
당시와 똑같은 재미를 유지하면서 더욱 쉽게 즐길 수 있어진 파타퐁을 플레이 하자!

title: Steam Veins
description:
게임 정보
베기
신앙의 힘으로 거대한 십자가로 모든 뱀파이어를 처치하세요.
쏘기
은으로 된 총알로 적을 처치하세요.
모두 태워라
전기 스테이션의 에너지로 십자가를 충전해 강력한 빛 공격을 하세요.
마시기
맛있는 스팀펑크 혜택으로 몸을 회복하세요.
보스를 물리쳐라
마스터 로드 킹 뱀파이어에 대한 복수를 방해하는 자는 용납하지 마세요.

title: Ruin
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a world where your people have thrived for millennia, having braved the tumultuous aftermath of a distant crash landing. This alien planet is your ancestral home, a testament to the resilience of your people. Amidst a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, the legacy of your ancestors beckons you to chart your own destiny.
A Sci-Fi Sandbox MMORPG Adventure
Embark on an unparalleled sci-fi sandbox MMORPG journey. Currently in closed beta on Windows, Ruin beckons explorers and adventurers to unearth its secrets. Join the thriving community, shaping the fate of this uncharted world. In Ruin, the universe is your canvas.
Forge Your Destiny: The Power of Guilds and Terraforming
Join forces with fellow adventurers to claim dominion over uncharted territories. Engage in strategic terraforming to fortify your holdings and harvest vital resources. Collaboration within guilds enables the transformation of barren landscapes into bastions of strength.
Dynamic Environments: Witness the Living World of Ruin
Experience the raw force of nature as the weather system dynamically shapes the terrain. From nurturing rains that sustain crops to fierce storms that can undo human progress, the environment of Ruin is in constant flux. Prepare to adapt and thrive amidst the ever-changing landscape, where the elements wield an unpredictable yet captivating influence.
Assemble a formidable team of stalwart allies to conquer formidable bosses and conquer treacherous dungeons. Embrace the classic trinity roles of tank, healer, and DPS, or lead massive 40-player raids to claim glory and untold riches. Unravel the mysteries lurking in the shadows, for only the bold shall emerge victorious.
Harness the power of strategic construction to fortify your territories against rival guilds. Erect impregnable defenses, restricting access to only trusted allies. Dominate the landscape and repel invaders as you vie for supremacy, using your cunning and might to reshape the political landscape of Ruin.
Immerse yourself in a dynamic combat system, blending the nostalgia of old-school MMORPGs with modern flexibility. Tailor your arsenal of abilities and define your own combat style, unhindered by the constraints of traditional classes. Embrace the freedom to forge your legacy, one decisive blow at a time.

title: RnGesus Slayer
description:
게임 정보
《RnGesus Slayer》: 《Slay the Spire》와 슬롯머신이 만났다!
《RnGesus Slayer》는 로그라이크 덱빌딩 게임으로, 3개의 개별 덱을 가지고 있으며, 카드는 슬롯머신을 돌려서 배치됩니다!
같은 유형의 카드가 맞으면 콤보가 발동하여 강화된 카드로 변합니다.

title: Dr Voss’ Escape Room
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Dr. Voss' Escape Room is a fun and relaxing multiplayer puzzle game where you and up to 4 friends work together to solve a variety of challenging puzzles. Set in the mysterious lab of Dr. Alaric Voss, you'll uncover hidden clues, piece together the story, and unlock the secrets behind his quest for the immortality potion.
This is a game for those who enjoy taking their time to think things through and solving clever puzzles with friends in a chill, pressure-free environment.
Key Features
Play Together: Team up with friends to solve puzzles designed for collaboration and communication.
Challenging Puzzles: From balancing scales to deciphering hidden messages, every puzzle will test your problem-solving skills.
Relaxed Gameplay: No rush, no stress, just a fun, shared experience of unraveling the mysteries of Dr. Voss’ lab.
Progression Tracking: Watch your progress unfold as you solve puzzles and get closer to escape the room with the immortality potion.
What to Expect
Explore and Discover: Use tools like UV flashlights to reveal hidden messages and clues.
Solve Together: Work as a team to unlock doors, crack codes, and piece together the story.
Create the Ultimate Potion: Follow the clues to blend potions in the correct order, leading to the lab’s final secret.
Around 1 Hour of Gameplay: Enjoy a focused and engaging escape room experience that can be completed in about an hour, perfect for a fun session with friends.
Why You’ll Love It
Dr. Voss' Escape Room is perfect for groups of friends looking for a relaxed but rewarding experience. It’s not just about solving puzzles, it’s about working together, thinking creatively, and enjoying the journey.
So grab your friends and see if you have what it takes to escape Dr. Voss’ lab!

title: EDENS ZERO
description:
게임 정보
왕도 스페이스 판타지 만화 속 세계로 뛰어들자!
마시마 히로 작가의 작품, 스페이스 판타지 만화/애니메이션 "EDENS ZERO"를 원작으로 만들어진 액션 RPG 등장!
원작을 생생하게 체험할 뿐만 아니라, 광활한 필드를 무대로 펼쳐지는 게임 오리지널 스토리의 수많은 퀘스트까지 즐길 수 있는 풍성한 볼륨의 게임!
박력 넘치는 액션 배틀!
콤보와 필살기를 구사해 배틀에 도전하자!
오의로 끝을 내자!
오의 게이지가 쌓이면 주위의 모든 적에게 큰 피해를 주는 "오의"를 발동할 수 있다!

title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition
description:
게임 정보
수많은 팬을 보유한 스트롱홀드 크루세이더의 확장된 결정판에서 성지 탈환을 위한 전설적인 십자군 원정으로 시간 여행을 떠나보세요! 새로운 게임플레이 콘텐츠와 소스 아트워크, 음악, 다시 돌아온 성우, 작곡가, 오리지널 게임의 베테랑 개발자가 참여하여 충실하게 재구성한 업그레이드된 비주얼로 역사적인 사막 전투를 펼치세요.
사막을 정복하세요
스트롱홀드 크루세이더: 결정판은 플레이 가능한 8개의 새로운 병력, 맞서야 하는 4명의 새로운 AI 영주, 추가 캠페인으로 오리지널 게임을 확장합니다. 홀로 새로운 역사적 캠페인 2개와 '시간의 모래' 전초전 트레일 4개를 플레이하거나, 친구와 팀을 이루어 완전히 새로운 협동 트레일을 나아가세요!
또는 더 넓은 맵, 커스텀 옵션, 편의성 개선과 같은 플레이어 요청 기능을 갖춘 전초전 모드에 뛰어들어 보세요. 처음 보는 캐릭터, 병사, 캠페인 등으로 완성된 이 결정판은 오리지널 프리렌더링 아이소메트릭으로 표현된 새로운 그래픽으로 게임을 리마스터하며, 여러분의 패기를 시험합니다!
힘을 발휘하여 20명의 까다로운 AI 영주에게 맞서든, 친구와 함께 새로운 협동 트레일을 진군하든, 그저 자신이 만들어 낸 장엄한 사막 성채에 감탄하든, 스트롱홀드 크루세이더: 결정판에서는 베테랑 플레이어와 신규 플레이어 모두가 실시간 전략 클래식을 다시 방문하여 원하는 방식대로 플레이할 수 있습니다.

title: Atomic Owl
description:
게임 정보
An avian story of a bird and a chatty blade unfurls its feathers! A feathery roguelite for the SNES era makes its debut!
Take up arms against the evil Crow sorcerer who brainwashed your troupe.
You must save them all.
Hidalgo Bladewing and his companions return to their favorite ramen spot following a perilous mission, only to be confronted by the vengeful void crow, Omega Wing. Two years later, Hidalgo must rescue his fallen companions from the clutches of this ruthless old foe—with the help of a chaotic, brash-talking sword.
