description:
게임 정보
「헌터X헌터」최초의 본격 대전 격투 게임이 등장!
「헌터X헌터」최초의 본격 대전 격투 게임이 등장!

title: Shadow Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
팩맨의 유전자가 섞인 탐색형 2D 액션 게임 『Shadow Labyrinth (쉐도우 라비린스)』.

옛 전쟁의 유물이 남아있는 황폐화된 별에서, 수수께끼의 노란 구체 -PUCK- 에게 8번째 적합자로 소환된 주인공.

가혹한 세계에서 살아남기 위해 적을 먹어 치우며 그 운명을 개척하자.

【탐색】

끝을 알 수 없는 동굴, 울창하게 번식한 밀림, 끝없이 펼쳐진 황야.
심연에 감추어진 기묘한 땅과, 앞을 가로막는 수많은 강적에게 도전하며 어둠의 끝으로 향하자.

【액션】

적을 먹어 치우고 새로운 힘을 손에 넣어라.
강화와 커스터마이즈로 독자적인 전술을 찾아내 미궁을 공략하자.

【스토리】

수수께끼의 노란 구체 -PUCK- 의 인도를 받아, 머나먼 곳에 위치한 거대한 탑을 향하게 된다…
PUCK의 진짜 목적이 무엇인지, 무엇과 싸우고 있는지. 이 세계의 비밀을 풀어라.

title: Astral Wield
description:
게임 정보
Félix receives a mission from a powerful mage to go to the monster kingdom and stop the King from starting a war against humanity. With that, Félix needs to explore an unknown realm and face a series of challenges during his exciting and twist-filled journey. But the kingdom seems to mess with his mind, bringing back memories of his past, and the further Félix progresses, the closer he gets to the truth. His choices could shape the destiny of humanity!
How the game works
Astral Wield offers an exploration experience where the player is free to follow the story or explore in search of better resources to ease their journey. Astral Wield features real-time combat, allowing the use of powers and special armor acquired during the journey or exploration.

title: Twelfth Life
Squeeze
description:
게임 정보
Spin, jet, control bubbles to rescue little animals.
A casual puzzle game - unwind here and relieve your stress!
Silky water flow, bouncy bubbles, exhilarating to play however you want!
Straightforward mechanics: Splitting, Bubble Machines, Gravity, Heating, Water Pipes...
Minimalist yet magical art style.
A one-of-a-kind novel experience.

title: Yamauba
description:
게임 정보
[스토리]
Yui의 오빠가 실종된 지 일주일이 지났습니다.
Yui는 오빠를 찾아갑니다.
하지만 마을은 근처 연구실에서 나온 생물학적 위험 물질로 오염되었습니다.
Yui는 오빠를 만날 수 있을까요...?
[내용]
오픈월드 액션 호러 게임
최신 언리얼 엔진으로 렌더링한 아름다운 시골을 배경으로 한 게임입니다.
스토리 모드에서는 두 명의 주인공으로 플레이합니다.
스토리 모드를 클리어하면 미션 모드가 잠금 해제됩니다.
플레이어는 자유롭게 캐릭터를 커스터마이징할 수 있습니다.
* 이 작품은 허구입니다. 실제 인물이나 조직과 관련이 없습니다.

title: Sealed Gate
description:
게임 정보
Sealed Gate is an exciting pixel 2D MMORPG game with sandbox elements, where players can plunge into a fascinating world of fantasy adventures and unique opportunities. In this game you will be able to explore a huge open world, complete quests, fight monsters and create your own guilds.
Events And Seasonal Events
Seasonal events related to the real calendar, such as Halloween or New Year's Eve.

Dynamic events in the world, such as monster attacks on cities or natural disasters that require players to join forces to defend or rebuild.
Achievements
The introduction of an achievement system with rewards for exploring the world, crafting achievements, combat exploits and social interactions.
Crafting
Specialization in crafting, which allows players to become masters in certain fields, for example, blacksmithing, alchemy, construction.

Rare recipes and materials that can only be found in dangerous locations or received as rewards for tasks and events.
Interactive Environment
The effect of time of day and weather on gameplay: certain creatures can only appear at night or during rain, some plants can only grow in certain seasons.
The Ability To Change The World
Players can build their own houses, guild locations, and influence the ecosystem and economy of the game world.
Deep Social Integration
A mentoring system that allows experienced players to help newcomers, receiving unique rewards for this.

Guild tasks and events that promote cooperation and competition between guilds.
Character Personalization
Advanced customization options for characters, including appearance, equipment, and even fighting style.

A pet system where players can tame and train various creatures to help in battle or as companions.
Interactive and branching quests with multiple solutions and outcomes depending on the player's choices.

Quests with a deep plot involving players in the history of the world and its inhabitants.

title: The Way of Knight
description:
게임 정보
What is it?
The Way of Knight is a chess-like puzzle game about the journey of Esroh the knight. You pilot the heroes through various enemies, boards, hazards, and stories. Think your way through different challenges such as defeating all enemies, obtaining special items, and getting to the exit safely.
Features
6 Story Chapters
70+ Levels
New Enemies
Enviromental hazards
Hand drawn artstyle
Meet The Heroes
Esroh, Ynop, and ???
New Enemies

title: UnderMine 2
description:
게임 정보
호평을 받은 액션 어드벤처 로그라이크 게임, UnderMine의 장점을 기반으로 제작된 UnderMine 2는 던전 크롤링을 완전히 새로운 차원으로 끌어올립니다! 강력한 유물을 발견하고, 결합하고, 제작하고, 변화시켜 보잘것없는 소농을 영웅으로 만들어 보세요. 커다란 음모가 펼쳐지며 하찮은 인간의 정치가 방해를 받습니다. 델브모어가 치르고 있는 전쟁은 하나가 아니죠. 파라암 4세 왕이 왕국의 통치권을 되찾으려 하자 사악한 두 형제의 보이지 않는 전쟁이 현실의 구조를 뒤흔듭니다.

친구와 함께 플레이
친구를 게임에 초대하여 UnderMine 2 전체를 함께 플레이하세요! 2인 플레이어 협동 모드로 게임을 진행하며 역동적인 도전을 제시하고 새로운 전략적 옵션을 이용할 수 있습니다.
플레이 가능한 캐릭터
야심 찬 행운의 보물 사냥꾼, 검은 토끼를 포함한 새로운 캐릭터를 발견하고 잠금 해제하여 게임을 플레이하세요. 각 캐릭터는 고유 능력치, 능력, 업그레이드, 유물을 갖추고 있습니다.
여러 갈래의 경로
공개된 언더마인의 새로운 영역에서 각 경로는 다양한 지역으로 이어집니다. 경로를 따라가 제작, 퀘스트, 다양한 목표를 완료하세요. 최종 도전 과제는 런을 진행하며 내린 결정에 따라 달라집니다.
아르카나
새로운 상호작용형 유물, 아르카나를 사용하세요. 각 유물은 화염구 투척, 해골 하수인 소환, 시공간 재배열과 같은 새로운 능력을 캐릭터에 부여합니다.
완전 모드 및 창작마당 지원
색을 칠할 수 있는 타일 세트, 비주얼 스크립트 편집기와 포함된 개발 도구로 새로운 아이템, 캐릭터, 조우, 퀘스트 등을 손쉽게 제작해 보세요. Steam 창작마당에서 다른 플레이어의 작품을 쉽게 다운로드할 수도 있습니다.

title: Total Reload
description:
게임 정보
모든 것이 너무 비참해서 설정을 재설정하고 다시 시작하고 싶은 상황에 처한 적이 있나요? 이 게임에서 당신은 지금까지 통제할 수 없었던 가장 야심찬 프로젝트를 다시 시작할 수 있는 기회를 갖게 될 것입니다. 어떤 종류의 프로젝트인가요? 우주 그 자체!
당신은 규모가 인상적인 놀라운 단일 메커니즘 안에 있는 자신을 발견하게 될 것입니다. HAWKING이라는 침묵하는 상주 인공지능을 조종하면 다양한 기술 장치로 가득 찬 여러 장소를 방문할 수 있습니다.
공간 퍼즐을 풀고, 물리의 기본 법칙을 변경하여 이 놀라운 메커니즘의 모든 시스템을 활성화하고 TOTAL RELOAD라는 프로세스를 시작하세요!
게임 특징

title: Resurrection of Santiago
description:
게임 정보
Captain Jase is a bounty hunter who keeps Dorai safe and gives planet Caloria hope as the GDI are fighting in a war protecting Caloria for what little they have left.
Your mission is simple, apprehend the dangerous outlaw Santiago:
Go from friendly citizens to corrupt individuals as you blast your way through the GDI officers and marauders that roam the desert or that are pitched up around the city.
Traverse this compact open world by strafing, sliding, jetpack boosting. . .
or maybe just jump in a hover car and drift around with ease, mowing down enemies as they pop up.
Whether you’re packing the laser shotgun, hauling the weapon of MASS DESTRUCTION or just strapping your laser handgun. There is no doubt an enemy is equipped to rush you at any moment.

title: Clutchtime: Basketball Deckbuilder
description:
게임 정보
짜릿한 코트의 대결이 시작됩니다! 농구와 카드 덱 빌딩을 결합한 다양한 재미를 느껴보세요. 전술의 묘미가 선사하는 최상의 전략 경험이 기다립니다.
게임 속 모든 카드는 선수의 독창적인 전술을 표현합니다. 3점 슈터 팀으로 코트를 휩쓸 것인지, 철벽 수비 팀으로 승리를 안정시킬 것인지 선택은 당신의 몫입니다. 자원과 리스크를 정밀하게 계산하며 최고의 팀을 만들어보세요.
autokwd: Clutchtime: Basketball Deckbuilder,골밑 접전: 전술의 대가

title: Gundroid
description:
게임 정보






Enjoy a modern take on a classic genre. Gundroid is more than just a throwback. This is retro gaming revitalized.





Learn enemy attack patterns and react quickly to stay one step ahead of the invading forces. Shoot, dodge, jump, and counter their every advance.





Power up your experience with weapons tailor-made for every situation. Find your favourite playstyle or experiment with them all.





Battle your way through diverse stages as you protect every part of the hand-drawn, pixel art landscapes of New Port City.





Fuel your fight with the bespoke metal soundtrack. Thrashing guitars and pulsing drums propel you forward through enemy forces. This is the genre as it was always meant to be heard.

title: Life of a Cat
description:
게임 정보
"Life of a Cat"은 집을 꾸미고, 귀여운 고양이들을 돌보며, 그들이 쉬고 놀 수 있는 친근한 공간을 만드는 아늑하고 편안한 게임입니다. 이 게임은 스트레스 해소와 휴식에 딱 맞는 선택입니다.
꾸미기와 확장: 고양이들이 놀고 쉴 수 있는 충분한 공간을 확보하세요. 수백 가지의 가구와 장식품 중에서 선택하고, 고양이들이 당신이 만든 모든 것과 상호작용하는 모습을 지켜보세요.
귀여운 고양이들과의 상호작용: 방을 꾸미고 확장하는 데 바쁜 와중에도, 게임의 가장 중요한 부분은 고양이라는 것을 잊지 마세요! 고양이들에게 음식, 장난감, 그리고 적절한 배변 공간을 제공하세요.
도전: 도전은 게임을 하면서 지루하지 않도록 추가된 게임플레이 요소입니다. 고양이가 바닥에 닿지 않고 방을 가로지르도록 하거나, 천장에 닿도록 해보세요.
스트레스 없는 공간: 아늑한 분위기, 차분한 사운드트랙, 그리고 사랑스러운 고양이들이 편안하게 휴식을 취할 수 있는 완벽한 공간을 만들어줍니다. 일상의 스트레스에서 벗어나 평화로운 순간을 즐기고 재충전할 수 있는 작은 탈출구입니다.

title: Fire Boy
description:
게임 정보
The hero is not just a character in the game; he's your companion on this journey, breaking the fourth wall and bringing a new dimension to your gaming experience.
Its comedic personality allows for funny interactions, especially when failing or succeeding in unexpected ways. It has unique lines for different situations, such as losing a life or gaining a new ability, but these dialogues may vary depending on the player's actions.
These lines will make you laugh out loud and moments that will warm your heart, this game promises to be a memorable adventure from start to finish. Put your skills to the test. Join the Fire Boy on his epic mission and "Step into the Heat of Adventure. Destiny Calls!"

title: 觀塘 | Kwun Tong
description:
게임 정보
Made in Hong Kong. By Unreal Engine 5.4.4.
Map data from the Land Dept of the government of the HKSAR.
(Open3Dhk)
Background:
Kwun Tong is a short horror game that take place in an industrial district. People become soulless after economic collapse. Wandering on streets. Looking for money......
Features:
- Game is about 60mins in length
- Challenging boss fights
- Minimal text and no document to read
- Based on actual geometry
Gameplay:
- 1st POV
- Story with several chapters
- Linear gameplay
Settings:
- Supports Full Screen / Windowed Mode
- Supports TSR
- Supports HDR
- No save feature. You can access different chapters freely from main menu
By Unreal Engine 5.4.4.

title: REDCALL
description:
게임 정보

FEATURES
Singleplayer ThirdPersonShooter with HIGH quality graphics made in Unreal Engine 5
Missions and progress with ranks and kills | Unique original repair system
Full Xbox GAMEPAD support with rumble FX's and more
Full display gamepad and audio settings to control
4 weapons to buy with gold. Find chests and open them with 02 tank
4 difficulty Levels to play ( COWARD - SOLDIER - ANGEL - RAGE )
Original inmersive FX audio and music with a rich history
REDCALL is an INDIE single-player third-person shooter game with full Xbox controller gamepad support and constant action gameplay, unique RANK and MISSIONs system, hordes with rounds system of undead, monsters and cyborgs with firepower. Campaign system with 4 difficulty levels and 6 maps to explore, collect gold by extracting tanks and locating them on hidden chests, buy weapons and survive the hordes of hell
DISCLAMER! READ BEFORE BUY




The portal’s opening brought incarnate evil, which soon took control of NASE to control the population, spreading fear and chaos. The cruel plan kept the civilian population in a state of deception, where the AI acted as their benefactor, instructing survivors to stay indoors, avoid social relationships, and not venture outside to avoid being devoured or mutilated by the beings from this dimension of evil. Among the beings that began to inhabit the earth, the most dangerous are called “the Damned.” These were evil men/woman during their time on earth, taken to hell by having their heads cut off while their bodies were tortured for eternity. Now, they walk the streets seeking bodies to infect, as their flesh is rotten and full of lethal diseases, especially in their fingernails. They are part of the army of evil under NASE’s command.

title: END: Awakening
description:
게임 정보
END: Awakening is a narrative-based action-survival game in which you and up to three friends must gather resources, craft weapons and tools, and upgrade your cabin into the ultimate anti-zombie fortress! Venture out into the wilds ruled by brutal Rustler scavengers, or the undead-infested Whitestone City to collect food, water, and medical supplies. Solve puzzles and carefully choose between sneaking and fighting to defeat both human and undead enemies in order to advance the plot and begin to unravel Hecate’s twisted plan.
FEATURES
Deep Storyline Rooted in Greek Mythology: The Witch-Goddess Hecate has imprisoned all of Olympus in order to unleash her undead wrath upon the world! The enigmatic Hexa corporation manipulates the disaster! Strike out and unearth the mystery!
Survive the Apocalypse Side By Side: Join up to three friends on your adventure! Forage together, craft together, explore together, and fight together!
Intense Loot-Driven Gameplay: Explore for food and water, medicine and ammunition, as well as powerful weapons and vehicles! Scavenge for resources and materials to upgrade your survival-tools and improve your shelter, fortifying it against all attackers!
Face the Apocalypse Your Way: Every encounter tests your skills, reflexes, and decision-making. Will you fight your enemies directly? Will you sneak past them? Will you set traps and ambushes to turn things to your favor before making your move? The choice is yours– as are the consequences.

title: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings Game
description:
게임 정보
환영합니다, 호빗 친구! 그림으로 그린 듯 아름답고 평온한 공간! 크리에이티브 스튜디오 Wētā Workshop이 빚어낸 샤이어를 소개합니다! 샤이어에서 아늑하기 그지없는 호빗의 삶을 살아보세요. 가운데땅에서의 전원생활을 발견하고, 처소를 꾸미고, 즐거움을 나누세요. Tales of the Shire: 반지의 제왕™ 게임에서는 친절한 호빗과 익숙한 얼굴들도 만나볼 수 있답니다.

강변마을에 도착하면 나만의 호빗을 구축하게 됩니다. 강변마을은 아직 호빗골에서 정식 독립 마을로 인정받지 못한 상태인데요, 여러분은 이 조용한 마을에 생기가 넘치도록 도와줘야 합니다. 나만의 호빗 집을 꾸미면서 편안함을 만끽하고, 정원을 가꾸고, 맑은 연못에서 생선을 낚고, 야생의 과일과 약초를 채집하고, 마을 주민과 거래를 해보세요. 직접 만든 요리를 동네 호빗과 함께 즐기고 관계를 발전시키는 건 어떨까요?
볼거리는 물론, 먹을 것도 풍부합니다. 아름다운 숲과 호수, 초원에서 환상적인 나날을 영위해 보세요.
주요 특징

환영합니다, 호빗 친구 – 많은 사랑을 받은 J.R.R 톨킨의 책에서 튀어나온 듯한 호빗을 플레이해 보세요! 개성 있는 외형으로 꾸미고 멋들어진 호빗 복장을 입힐 수 있습니다. 샤이어에는 꾸미기 요소 역시 무궁무진합니다. 나만의 호빗 집을 꾸미세요. 자유로운 배치 시스템으로 가구를 원하는 대로 놓아, 취향에 맞게 아늑한 공간을 만들어 나갈 수 있습니다. 강변마을의 평온한 집에 적응하면서 매일매일 새로운 경이를 발견하고, 절실했던 휴식을 누리세요.

호빗의 하루는 음식으로 완성된다고 해도 과언이 아닙니다. 낚시, 원예, 채집을 통해 식량 저장고를 노동의 결실로 가득 채워보세요. 그때그때 계절에 맞는 제철 농작물과 꽃도 수확할 수 있습니다. 식사 시간에는 부엌의 온기를 느끼면서 조리법을 골라 요리 실력을 선보일 수도 있죠. 두 번째 아침 식사를 즐기거나, 동료 호빗과 함께 만찬을 나누세요. 초대 손님과 식사를 즐기면 새로운 관계가 형성됩니다.
autokwd: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings Game,Tales of the Shire: 반지의 제왕 게임

title: hololive Holo's Hanafuda
description:
게임 정보
※개발 중인 화면입니다.
🎴홀로 멤버가 그려진 오리지널 패로 펼치는 화투 배틀!🎴
화투는 2명 또는 3~4명이 즐기는 카드 게임입니다. 받은 패로 족보를 만들어 고득점을 노려 보세요! 혼자서 CPU와 대결할 수도 있고, 온라인으로 친구와 대전하거나 랜덤 매치를 할 수도 있습니다!
이 타이틀의 오리지널 규칙인 '홀로 맞추기'뿐 아니라 '코이코이', '오이초카부', '꽃 맞추기' 등 총 4종류의 화투 규칙으로 플레이 가능!
🎴오리지널 규칙 '홀로 맞추기'🎴
패에 그려진 멤버들을 모아서 발동시키는 '홀로 족보', 각 멤버들이 가진 '멤버 스킬'을 조합해서 상대보다 많은 점수를 획득해 보세요!

title: Sivers
description:
게임 정보


Sivers — A Vector-Style RPG Roguelike
Dive into the unique world of Sivers — a dynamic RPG roguelike where every battle and decision can be crucial for survival! In this game, you’ll fight off waves of monsters using a construction system and powerful spells to hold your ground for as long as possible.
Game Features:
43 Spells: Choose from magical, physical, and passive spells to adapt to various situations and defeat your enemies.
8 Bosses and 20 Types of Enemies: Each wave of monsters gets progressively harder, with unique mechanics. Enemies and bosses require different strategies and spell combinations.

title: Unhandled Exception
description:
게임 정보
Unhandled Exception (working title) is a 2D action/adventure, platformer, sidescrolling shooter, top down adventure, puzzle... well I couldn't choose a genre, so am just throwing everything at the wall to see what sticks. The truth is I wanted to try my hand at multiple 2D genre's for two reasons; to push myself to learn different game types, and to build each level around what's best to push the story along.

This game is heavily story driven and I 'borrowed' a lot from the movies and games I grew up with in the 80's and 90's. I look forward to providing more updates as I develop more of my game.

title: Warriors of Thalyrion
description:
게임 정보
Warriors of Thalyrion is a 2D pixelart action game in which you can fight short and fun battles against your friends. As a classic couch game, you play on the same PC as your friend and you share the same game world.
Choose a hero
Before starting the game, you decide on a hero. You can choose between different archetypes and weapons. Do you prefer the sword or the bow? Every character has a weapon for close combat and one for distance fight.
Choose a game mode
PvP: In PvP mode, your teammate is your opponent. Try to achieve the round objectives and score more points than your opponent. Each arena is set up differently and a round is limited in time. With targeted attacks, you can prevent your opponent from collecting points.
Co-op: In the co-op campaign, you play together with your teammate. Complete the round objectives together to reach the next level. A campaign consists of several levels, which are completed with a boss fight.
Solo: You can also play through the campaigns alone. But be aware that it won’t be easy.

title: 栖云：遗忘之境 Oriental Dreams : The Forgotten Realm
description:
게임 정보
This story is circulating in the world.
When the distant wind blew from the other side of the ocean, the mysterious East brought gorgeous satin, porcelain, and - miracles. A small number of people worshipped it as a god, but more people were afraid of it. People held up sickles and torches, avoiding it as if they saw a medieval wizard, and spurned it.
Many years later, people forgot about it, and the miracle eventually became a distant rumor and disappeared in the world.
The story takes place in the fictional Europe at the end of the 19th century. The player will play the role of a teenager working in a pet store. One day, he accidentally stepped into a mysterious toy store and discovered a strange and unusual thing. From then on, his fate began to turn - miracle? Rumor? Resurrection from the dead? The player gradually explores the truth in his contact with the three shop assistants. Maybe... things are not as simple as you see.
autokwd: 栖云：遗忘之境 Oriental Dreams : The Forgotten Realm

title: Program Penguin
description:
게임 정보
Slash, shoot, and slide through Program Penguin, the minimalist adventure game bursting with birds, bad puns, and enough toilet humor to surely provoke a pity laugh or two. Explore the Antarctic Server and fend off impending doom in the form of the deadly computer virus. Discover items, unearth secrets, and battle baddies in this bold and bubbly bombastic bird-based bash!
** Notice To All Players: This game contains imagery that may harm players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar conditions. **
Features:
Acquire Items: 
Obtain a variety of items that are quirky, questionable and downright morally wrong.
Fight Enemies:
Shoot penguins, robots and anything else unfortunate enough to turn its back to you in this real-time action-adventure game.
Solve Puzzles:
Use abilities and items to solve a number of unusual puzzles in this 2-hour indie game made by a single person.
Battle Bosses:
Face 3 funky, mad and memorable bosses in the only video game that feels like a fart joke met a fever dream and rolled it all up into one penguin themed package.
