title: LATAM Hooligans
description:
게임 정보
LATAM Hooligans is a parody-meme arcade game. You are the leader of your country, and people, as always, are furious and drunk. Escape the people, before the party gets to you!
Features
Select any Latin American leader, from Mexico to Chile
More than 3 cities in different parts of LATAM, more to come!
Get the best score and showoff in our leaderboard
Roadmap 2025
This is a tentative roadmap of the development through early access:

title: Backrooms Blackmarket
description:
게임 정보
You are an underground trader in Backrooms Blackmarket, running an illegal business built on the mysteries of the Backrooms. Your job is simple: dive into these forbidden spaces, collect rare and anomalous objects, and sell them on the dark web for profit. The deeper you go, the greater the risks—and the greater the rewards.
Explore, Loot, and Escape
The government has banned all civilian access to the Backrooms after a wave of disappearances and fatal accidents. But that hasn’t stopped people like you. Armed with a stolen teleporter, you can slip inside—if you're fast enough. Time is your enemy. The longer you stay, the more the Backrooms start to notice you.
Upgrade Your Operation
Use your earnings to expand your inventory, acquire better tools, and unlock access to even more dangerous levels. A bigger haul means bigger profits, but it also means greater risks. Light sources, motion detectors, and faster teleporters could mean the difference between life and death.

title: Operation Octo
description:
게임 정보


Dr. Odin, an octopus scientist, has teamed up with his Dolphin colleague to put a stop to underwater skeletons’ reign of terror!

In this action Tower Defense game, you fend off hoards of skeletons by strategically placing sea creature turrets. Beware that as your line of defense falls, this quickly turns into a game of survival where you dodge around for dear life!

Features
Unlock Turrets: Your arsenal is filled with mechanized sea lives! Those cool inventions (such as Pistol Shrimp, Navy Seal, and Death Ray) will handle the fight. You’ll discover new turret types one after another - Figure out how best to utilize each of ‘em!

Skeleton Enemies: Did you know that most humans who ever lived are dead? Tons of skeletons end up in the ocean, and are terrorizing local ecosystems. Fight sword-swinging pirates, poison-wielding chemists, and even skeletal dragons… Those skeletons are sure to shake up your playstyle at every turn!















- a message from Dr. Finn the Dolphin (who really needs your help because he’s too lazy to do the work himself)

title: Blood Gamble: Hanafuda
description:
게임 정보
가장 가까운 하인인 아키가 신비로운 카드를 가진 여우를 추적했다...
이 카드는 너, 뱀파이어에게 블러드 매직의 새로운 지평을 열어주었다. 숲 요괴의 싸움과 퍼즐에 도전하여 48장의 하나후다 카드를 모두 획득하라. 이 카드들은 다음을 제공할 수 있다:
사냥 동료(예: 백로), 그림자 소환, 식물 자원 추출 등의 독특한 능력, 그리고 더 많은 것들.
분해와 변환 같은 고급 블러드 연금술에서 역할을 한다.
카드의 올바른 조합은 너에게 햇빛에 대한 면역을 줄 것이다.
너는 가능한 한 많은 카드를 찾기 위해 숲에 단단히 자리 잡았다...

title: Systemsfall
description:
게임 정보
In the decaying underground remains of Navar, a once-glorious city sealed away by an authoritarian regime, you are a robot—a Prime Unit—unexpectedly awakened in a facility that was never meant to power on again. With only a flickering flashlight and a corrupted memory core, you must navigate a maze of dark corridors, abandoned machinery, and malfunctioning systems to uncover the truth behind your existence and the collapse of the system that created you.
💎 Key Features:
🔦 Exploration: Light reveals the path—but also draws danger. Navigate pitch-black hallways and vast outdoor areas while avoiding detection by active security turrets.
🏙️ Open-Ended Exploration: Move beyond claustrophobic underground corridors and step into vast open city areas, abandoned plazas, industrial zones, and forgotten rooftops. Explore freely, uncover hidden paths, and revisit areas with newly unlocked abilities.
🧠 Puzzle-Focused Gameplay: Solve environmental puzzles, manipulate circuits, and uncover cryptic logs left behind by long-gone workers.
⚙️ Logical Progression: Unlock new areas using access cards, reroute power in maintenance rooms, and manipulate machinery to forge ahead.
📜 Lore-Driven Discovery: Read fragmented logs, decipher corrupted messages, and piece together the fall of Navar and the truth behind the Systemfall Directive.
🏢 Atmospheric World: Explore industrial zones, archives, maintenance halls, vast courtyards, and sealed-off experimental labs—each telling a silent story of its downfall.
🛡️ Tactical Survival: Some threats can't be destroyed—only avoided. Stealth and resourcefulness are your best tools.
📖 Story Overview:
In the final days of the Navar Authority, the regime initiated Plan Five, a desperate attempt to centralize control through a network of obedient robots. But something went wrong. The Prime Units—robots like you—were locked away, deemed too unpredictable, too... aware.
Now, decades later, you're online.
The power flickers. The corridors groan under the weight of their secrets. And somewhere in the dark, the remnants of the Systemsfall still linger, waiting to be uncovered.
But your journey won’t end underground. Beyond the steel doors and flickering lights lies a city frozen in time, its streets empty, its towers looming like silent sentinels over the decay. The truth isn't confined to walls—it spreads across plazas, rooftops, and forgotten streets.

title: Evolution Survival
description:
게임 정보
Evolution Survival is a game where the universe evolves around you. The plants you saw at the beginning will be different at the end, the rocks will have all eroded, the star will have ended, the atmosphere will have been stripped away and your planet may be gone. The animals may be more aggressive, if there are any left, maybe the animals all died out because you caused them to go extinct. Who knows what will happen when Natural Selection is at the wheel.
Evolution:
The star, plants, animals, and rocks will change as time moves past, the game simulates evolution as if hundreds of generations happen with each new offspring. Animals may sprout 7 legs and 5 mouths, maybe trees will prefer to be upside down. The star, if massive enough may go supernova after expanding as it burns helium, becoming a neutron star or black hole. Perhaps it will just become a white dwarf and fade slowly for trillions of years. Maybe you will not get a star at all, just a failed star called a brown dwarf that glows for a little while before fizzing out. The Rocks will erode away and leave pebbles and stones for you to pick up and use in your crafting.


*The Above image is not to scale


You will start on some land, preferably near the sea. Some sort of glowing object will brighten up the otherwise gloomy cosmos above you. Plants and animals will spring up in possibly great numbers, or perhaps few if you are in a freezing desolate wasteland. Just remember, Life always finds a way. Expand your reaches by building shelters with newly eroded stones that came off of cliff rocks, and tough wood from exotic trees. Maybe you'll get hungry and find some lovely fruit to eat! Maybe you get a pet rock or a pet animal and call him Bob! The possibilities are endless!
Since there are weapons in this game you can of course kill your friends. Imagine taming some sort of alien, evolved creature, that has some very cool quirks, and riding in on your friends base and distributing justice! How about raising that creature from the time he is a baby? Or maybe giving a "gift" to your friends in the form of an angry baby dinosaur looking...thing!
Do they exist? Yes. Do they give you any advantage? No. AND they NEVER will be monetized in any way shape or form. That's a promise. All it is, is a simple loot crate system that gives you points you can spend on cosmetics and can occasionally give you a cosmetic. You just equip them from a cosmetic work bench in-game.

title: Florida Interstate '86
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to FLORIDA INTERSTATE '86, a light-weight driving game where the goal is to cruise into the sunset for as long as possible while earning points by collecting cassette tapes and driving dangerously. A dynamic noon-sunset lighting system, a selection of colorful retro-styled sports cars and a synthwave/chillwave soundtrack ensure that every single one of your trips into this '80s fantasy Sunshine State is a unique one.

title: Dungeon Weiqi
description:
게임 정보
Dungeon Weiqi is a pixel-art roguelike card game primarily inspired by the ancient game of Weiqi.
Weiqi Style Card Combat
Deploy cards using Crystals that regenerate automatically each turn.
Once placed on the chessboard, cards autonomously attack adjacent enemies at round's end.
Try to occupy advantageous positions and surround the enemy to create more advantages!
Your Lord enters battle as a card. Will you use the lord's powerful abilities to charge forward, or protect them in the rear and seek victory? The choice is yours!
Diverse Factions & Card Types
Players can choose from multiple factions. You can collect unique cards, and form the most suitable deck to fight!
There are three types of cards for both the enemy and us: Warrior Cards | Skill Cards | Structure Cards.
Master their synergies to overturn desperate situations!
Enemies also possess unique cards and combat styles. Be careful to deal with them and familiarize yourself with their combat styles and weaknesses. Then victory is yours!
Explore the Map Freely
Avoiding strong enemies or engaging in direct combat? The decision is entirely yours! You can freely plan your path, choose the order of battle with enemies, or even completely ignore them (if you are willing to give up the treasure they are guarding).
Be careful with your supplies. Every step further will cost your food. If the food runs out, you will be at a huge disadvantage and even lose the entire game! Plan your path carefully to avoid the worst-case situation.

title: Protean Fox
description:
게임 정보
이건 액션 슈팅 어드벤처 관문 돌파 고기비둘기 게임입니다.

title: Cyber Seekers: Conquest
description:
게임 정보
You control a Cyber Seeker.
Cyber Seekers are bots used to complete high-risk bounties. You are tasked with destroying a legion of bots who have gone rogue and taken over a city. Start every run with limited resources. Receive credits for each bot you destroy and use them to upgrade your bot.
The city is your playground.
Cyber Seekers are equipped with various abilities and can traverse any terrain. Run on walls, grapple, glide and shoot your way through a city under fire. You will find random weapons, ability cards, and programs in each run, making them unique. Choose whatever combination that suits your playstyle.

title: Hue Hooligans
description:
게임 정보
The goal of this game is to get all Hooligans to reach their spray indicator and tag it.

title: EndSeeker
description:
게임 정보
You play Coal, a little black cat who wait his judgment at the Purgatory. He hears his dad's voice which beg to leave the place with him.
On your way, there are Guardians. Shapeless creatures which monitors this place. If they find you, you restart to your tomb where you wait your judgment.
This is an infiltration game with roguelite mechanic because each time the game launch, the placement of room changed.

title: Another Head
description:
게임 정보
It is with great pleasure that I present to you Another Head! The first game by Looting Dreams, created by Eric Sorrentino (yours truly). You’ll be transported to a small town in Colorado, Havenbrook, where you’ll control Tom as he faces one of the most intriguing events of late: there’s a new neighbor in town.
It’s hard to pin Another Head to a single genre. The story can take wildly different directions and tones depending on your choices.
No missions, live the story as the protagonist
Don’t expect senseless quests or triggers! The story progresses according to your decisions, whether you like it or not.
Feeling lost? Don’t worry—you can always consult the thoughts swirling around in Tom’s mind. Draw inspiration from his needs and ideas to navigate the game and make important decisions.
Meaningful dialogues
Interactions with people are key, so never miss a chance to chat with your neighbors. The choices you make during dialogues will always have weight. Think carefully about what to say, or you might regret it.
Multiple endings
Through different choices and actions, you can unlock up to 10 unique endings. If you manage to find them all, you can participate in the ultimate poll to decide which ending becomes the definitive one—good or bad!
A race against time
Another Head spans one full week in Tom’s life. Each day, you’ll have specific time windows to act freely. Don’t rush—savor the adventure—but remember, time is precious!
A mortgage to be paid by flipping burgers
What indie game would be complete without a burger joint? You might feel a sense of déjà vu as you assemble sandwiches and watch your bank account grow, but I promise it will be a fresh experience in its own way.
Developed in Italy, with love
I’ve always wanted to bring my ideas to life—since I was a kid, playing in the backyard with friends, crafting role-playing games, or sketching countless concepts that never saw the light of day. But here we are! I hope you enjoy this small game born from a part of my mind. I hope you’ll appreciate the care and love I poured into it and remember it fondly in the future. If not, let me know—I still have so much to learn, and I’m sure each of you has something to teach me.

title: BrAInstorm
description:
게임 정보
BrAInstorm is a high-stakes fast pace sci-fi Adventure that takes place in Dr. Kairo Mnemorix’s mind, the brilliant scientist who created Z.E.K.E, a super-intelligent AI destined to reshape the galaxy. 
Take the role of one of Dr. Kairo's daughters as you travel inside his mind to destroy the tumor that plagues him. Can you withstand the images of the mind while trying to save Dr. Kairo Mnemorix?
in this sci-fi shoot-em-up your task besides saving the Doctor is dodging and defeating the enemies that you'll face. with challenging bullet patterns and funky visuals this bullet hell is created to be confusing but fun to play. 
CHARACTERS:

title: Emborne: Lucidem Redemption
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the heart of a broken world in Emborne, a classic shoot-'em-up that blends fast-paced action with a rich story narrative. The Earth lies in ruins, shattered by a catastrophic event that opened a massive crack in its surface, unleashing grotesque creatures and chaos. As humanity grapples with the aftermath, the corrupt government tries to conceal its role in the disaster, all while the planet spirals deeper into despair.
You play as one of three brave pilots, determined to venture into the depths of the Earth and confront the horrors that await. Armed with a variety of different ships you'll battle nightmarish foes and navigate treacherous environments as you journey toward the core. Uncover the truth behind the catastrophe and fight to restore balance to a broken world.
With stunning visuals, attention grabbing gameplay, and an intense soundtrack, Emborne offers a unique blend of relentless action and immersive storytelling. Will you uncover the secrets hidden within the Earth’s core and save what’s left of humanity, or will you succumb to the darkness? The fate of the world is in your hands!

title: Pickscover 2
description:
게임 정보
Plunged into a forgotten world of Darkness and Light, you must make this world your own by using it's resources to return balance to it's inhabitants. Over time, collect stronger weapons and armour by fighting off enemies and looting chests, while also shaping the world to your need using pickaxes and axes. Once you are ready, summon and defeat the many bosses of darkness and light to restore order to the world.
Explore the hundreds of twisting cave systems underground complete with tons of enemies, ores, and loot. Always remember to bring plenty of torches, the darkness can be very dangerous...
Equip tons of Swords, Daggers, Helmets, Chestplates, Rings, and much more during your journey! Gain special bonus stats for every piece of equipment to use when fighting enemies and bosses.

title: Butterfly X
description:
게임 정보
A free Butterfly X game featuring characters from all versions of the Butterfly series of puzzle games. You can choose any level to pass through. But it will be great if you pass them all, helping the caterpillar to fulfill its mission.
As usual, the caterpillar can't jump on its own. It can fly from place to place like a butterfly, bouncing off various game objects in its path. It also moves around the level on pipes.
We hope you will enjoy it and have fun!
Features
- Collect all the flowers to advance to the next level.
- Kill bees and bounce off objects to advance to the end of the level.
- Use pipes along the way to overcome obstacles in the level.
- Moving objects help to pass the level.
- There are several paths, find the right one.
- Beware of the blue bird, it pecks to death.
- The levels are very different, be alert.

title: BrightGunner
description:
게임 정보
Bright Gunner는 단순하고 상쾌한 혁신적인 요소를 갖춘 빠르게 진행되는 1인칭 슈팅 게임입니다.
세 가지 주요 디자인 컨셉은 다양한 게임 플레이, 온화한 고기 비둘기 메커니즘, 인터페이스 스타일 없음입니다.
다양한 플레이 방법
이 게임은 멀티 게임 모드를 제공합니다.
서바이벌 모드에서 플레이어는 무한한 전투의 파도에 직면하게 되며, 각 전투에는 수많은 몬스터와 가벼운 고기 비둘기 역학이 포함됩니다.
표준 모드는 여러 개의 작은 레벨과 여러 개의 게임 플레이 스타일이 혼합되어 있습니다.
또한 인카운터, 스나이퍼 배틀, 보스 배틀, 미로 탐험, 스토리 모드의 5가지 모드가 있습니다. 각 모드에는 고유한 초점이 있습니다.
순한 육 비둘기 역학
몬스터, 카드, 소품이 레벨에 무작위로 나타나고, 많은 몬스터가 주인공에게 돌진하고, 주인공의 능력이 점차 성장합니다.
플레이어는 몬스터와 반격을 피하기 위해 계속 움직이고 생존을 위한 보급품을 찾아야 합니다.
인터페이스 스타일 없음
이 게임은 전통적인 초기 인터페이스를 게임 모드, 레벨, 옵션 설정 변경 및 레벨 업 기술이 모두 수행되는 혁신적인 초기 장면으로 대체합니다.
플레이어는 기존 인터페이스에서 버튼을 클릭하는 대신 총으로 벽돌을 쏘아 상호 작용합니다.

title: Conchiglia
description:
게임 정보
해변에서 조개 찾기
해변에서 휴가를 보내고 조개를 찾으러 갔는데 해변에 물건이 가득합니다.
개체와 상호 작용
해변 파라솔과 갑판 의자를 닫고, 선실 문을 열고, 조개를 가릴 수 있는 물체의 시야를 확보하는 데 필요한 모든 조치를 취하고, 일반적으로 해변의 모든 물건과 상호작용하세요.
조개를 찾아 해변을 탐험하세요

title: BACKFIRE
description:
게임 정보
Nine deadly weapons with one thing in common– they all fire backward. Mastering each weapon's quirks is the key to combat. Jet around with the flamethrower, master the kick of the shotgun, kill at a distance with the sniper rifle. Whatever you choose-  fire with purpose, or die.

title: Saunicle
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic adventure across Finland. Experience unique and detailed saunas that are inspired by real locations, meet locals, and enjoy the authentic tradition of throwing löyly.
This is a solo project by me, now about 9 months in development.
Initially planned to be completed in one month.
Expanded scope due to how fun it ended up becoming.
Demo releasing in January; full game launching in Spring on Steam.
Considering a mobile version launch in the future.

title: Wild Script: Nature
description:
게임 정보
You wake up in a primeval forest where chaos reigns. You remember nothing.
All around you is wild nature and a threat with every step. Are you alone, or were you lucky enough to find allies? Your fate hangs in the balance, and the decisions you make may be the key to survival... or death.
The world is going crazy.
Nature goes berserk under the influence of unknown forces, strange anomalies fill the world. Hungry predators are already on your trail! But the world is full of equally lost and frightened individuals, and it's only up to you to decide whether you'll make a friend or a new enemy. Tame animals, make gifts, trade, and engage in dialogue with the inhabitants, or attack everyone and everything, your choice will change your carma!
Fight, explore, create!
Explore the world and use invaluable artifacts that alter genetic structure. How much will you have to change, and will you still be able to call yourself human? Seek resources, build, and create useful tools. Only a comprehensive approach will allow you to survive and unravel the mystery of what's happening around. But the wild nature is cruel and uncompromising, so try to be careful and not get into trouble, because you only have one life. Be responsible for your actions and learn to accept defeat! Harsh reality with no option to reboot events!
Are you up for the challenge?

title: Sudoku Acres
description:
게임 정보
Features
Customize your Sudoku puzzles. Choose between farming elements or standard numbers for your puzzles!
Solve puzzles, get coins. Each puzzle gets you acorns to use to expand your farm!
Adopt animals. Spend acorns to summon new animals to your farm!
Build your farm. Decorate your farm how you see fit! Choose seasons, time of day, weather, and more!
Original music. Composed exclusively with DX7 patches to give a retro vibe to the soundtrack!

title: Rogue's Realm: The Old God
description:
게임 정보
이 흥미로운 게임에서 'Rogue-like'와 'Auto chess' 장르를 결합하여 독특하고 흥미로운 것을 만들었습니다! 이제 여러분은 네 가지 다른 클래스의 능력을 결합하여 자신만의 전투 전략을 만들 수 있습니다. 각 행동이 중요한 동적이고 아드레날린 넘치는 게임 플레이를 즐기세요. 탈랜트 시스템을 통해 캐릭터를 자유롭게 맞춤 설정할 수 있으며, 강렬한 액션은 각 전투가 예측할 수없는 전환점으로 가득 차 있음을 보장합니다! 전투에 참여하여 당신만의 독특한 세계에 몰입하십시오. 여러분의 기술과 전략적 사고가 전에 없던 시험을 받게 될 것입니다!

title: CrafTAE
description:
게임 정보
Stack cards 🃏 to collect food, craft equipment, build structures and defeat the dungeon ⚔️ in this village builder roguelite. Discover new cards, gather new resources and craft new recipes every run! Combine, survive and thrive!
Features ⭐
• 🃏 300+ cards to discover
• 🌳 10 biomes to unlock & explore
• 👿 9 dungeons & 3 difficulties to defeat
• ⚔️ 50+ enemies to fight
Explore biomes 🌳
Biome cards are the main source of resources each run. To start a new run you need to select which biomes you want to use. Explore them to find unique resources and customize your build the way you want!
Craft new resources 🔨
Use your cards to craft all kinds of new resources, equipment and structures to help you settle your people.

title: Radio Ghosts
description:
게임 정보
Radio Ghosts is a narrative game about geometry tests, vampire baristas, and camping with your mom. It was created for and playable on the original Nintendo Game Boy, but through super-spooky frequencies is brought here to modern gaming machines.
Features:
High-quality pixel graphics that only an original 160 x 144 resolution can provide
Genuine simulated four-way D-pad movement
Highly efficient single-button interaction using the Z key
(Seriously, though, the game also supports common controllers)
Four shades of green
Genuinely awesome original four-channel Game Boy soundtrack
All the snark from a fifteen-year-old girl that you can handle
Gameplay:
Meet interesting people and irritate them, including:
Your mom
A radio ghost
A vampire barista
A haughty wizardess
A touchy goblin
A cold and calculating cat
Paul
Top-down super-fun non-Euclidean cartographic action
Petty theft
Marine biology
Geometry
Crushing reality
The experience:
60-90 minutes of playtime

title: Marty's Funducational Tour!
description:
게임 정보
Hello…
My name is Marty. I am a Robot with a Humanology Doctorate from Robot University. I have created a rural American town as my next research project, and I am ecstatic to show off my town to an actual Human. Be prepared to learn all about Humans, such as why you must be quiet in Libraries (because noise can upset the books and jumble the letters), why streets were invented (because the word "roads" was copyrighted by Ancient Romans), or why every town HAD to have a Bowling Alley in it (I am still looking into this).
 This FUNducational journey has over 20+ buildings to explore and many unique and true facts about human culture that may leave you astonished! Some have claimed that my knowledge is false or that I make incorrect assumptions. While this is most likely not true, I am open to any feedback on my project, and since you are a human, I will accept most corrections you give, although I am the expert here.

Thank you,
Marty
What To Expect From This Game:
Witty-ish repartee with Marty The Robot
A Town the size of 1632x1294 pixels with quite a few inconsistencies
Buildings to investigate and find any deviations from the norm(Marty has misplaced quite a few objects...)
Unique and interesting facts from Marty The Robot
An Original Score made by a poorly trained musician - me :)

title: Mystery Trails
description:
게임 정보


The year 1910, you’re a mountain rescuer and a hiking guide who has just received information about an accident in the area.
Your instinct tells you that this time it’s not going to be a regular one and it might be too late for the victims.
Soon after that you find a body and realize something strange happened out there, and it’s up to you to find out what it was.



In order to get the answers you’re seeking, you’ll also have to use your detective abilities.
You’re not a private investigator, but you’ll have to become one.
Think outside of the box, look for hidden details and interview potential witnesses.
Keep in mind that the weather won’t allow you to take it slow, time pressure is on you!




Gather your equipment and make sure you’re confident in your own skills.
From climbing and skiing, through the proper reading of the map, all the way to tracking, avoiding and fighting animals.
There’s no room for error in this environment, so better keep your focus!
In the end, staying calm, cool and collected might save your life.



It's always further than it looks, always taller than it looks, and always harder than it looks - the 3 rules of mountaineering. This isn’t another walk in the park.
Experience the harshest weather conditions and survive against them. Mother Nature doesn't spoil you, and she surely shows no signs of mercy.



Explore the magnificent world of hiking, looking at it through the eyes of an experienced mountaineer.
Enjoy the breathtaking views and connect yourself with the natural world finding the freedom from worry, towards a true peace of mind!

title: Pale Coins
description:
게임 정보
Explore the open world of Grenmark in Pale Coins, an old-school Fantasy Action-RPG with souls-like elements. Pale Coins features challenging gameplay and unique boss fights, tons of rare loot to find, dungeons to conquer, quests to complete, and stories to uncover.




Explore a gorgeous handcrafted fantasy world, starting with nothing but an old weapon. Journey across forests, ruins, mountains, and caverns as you encounter new characters on your search for the Champion’s Coin.




Prepare for battle as you encounter a variety of monsters while exploring beyond the safe borders of the capital and the villages. Amongst them are formidable boss fights that will require skilled gameplay to combat their unique movesets and abilities.




Unearth a broad arsenal of melee, ranged, and magic weapons with their own stats and skills, as well as a plethora of armor sets allowing you to transform your character.



Uncover powerful skills granted by rare pieces of equipment, and are found throughout the vibrant world of Grenmark. While worn, these rare pieces of equipment allow you to cast special magic spells, utilize new movement abilities, summon minions, and much more. It’s up to you to find, utilize, and master all the many skills available.

title: R:\Block
description:
게임 정보
Part of what R:\Block starts out as a Sokoban style, block pushing game that evolves into something that will push your puzzle-solving skills. The other side of the game is a platformer that involves throwing a ball to complete more complex levels as you progress. In the final game, these parts will combine to make a multi-dimensional puzzle/platformer.

There are currently over 100 Sokoban-style levels, a map that let's you pick your path through the levels, and over 10 platformer stages to complete.

title: Gigabyte Dynamite
description:
게임 정보
Gigabyte Dynamite is a retro-themed Shoot 'Em Up game - As an antivirus software, you fight your way through a virus-infected computer, with various nostalgic digital landscapes to conquer.
The first level is inspired by the little game you play when your internet turns off in a browser.
There are several types of dinosaurs and other related enemies.

title: void future
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a dystopian future where every connection can be your last.
In void future, you take on the role of a skilled hacker operating in a near-future cyberpunk world, where corporations hold more power than governments, and personal freedom is a distant memory. As part of a secret underground hacking collective, you infiltrate corporate systems, steal sensitive data, and uncover dark secrets that could change the course of history.
GAMEPLAY
Engage in intense, tactical hacking missions where every line of code counts. Use your skills to breach firewalls, decrypt encrypted data, and infiltrate heavily-secured corporate networks. But be careful—every action you take leaves a digital footprint, and the more you push, the more you attract attention from powerful forces.
Hack & Explore: Navigate through complex systems, bypassing security protocols, cracking passwords, and discovering hidden vulnerabilities.
Puzzle-Solving: Each mission offers its own unique challenges, from timed puzzles to logic-based tasks that test your hacking acumen.
Upgrade Your Tools: Equip yourself with powerful hacking tools.

title: USB-BOT
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an electrifying 2D platform puzzle adventure in USB-BOT, where a small, disconnected USB sets out on a quest to reunite with the device it was once a part of. With its wire tail torn away, USB-BOT must navigate a world that suddenly feels immense and full of danger. As you traverse 2D environments filled with challenging puzzles and dynamic platforming elements, your mission is to help this determined little USB find its way back home.
Grab, move, and use items in creative ways to conquer puzzles and platforming challenges. Grab metal objects and place them cleverly to complete circuits, power devices, and unlock new paths.

title: Neither dead nor alive
description:
게임 정보
Neither Dead or Alive
Will You Break Free or Succumb to Darkness?
In Neither Dead or Alive, you awaken as a skeleton brought back to life by a young, overzealous necromancer. But something went wrong—you retained your will, your mind, and your burning desire for freedom. Trapped within the ominous castle of your creator, your journey to escape begins.
Along the way, you’ll encounter cryptic puzzles, treacherous traps, and a cast of otherworldly characters. Some, like mischievous demon, may aid your quest—or try to steal your soul. Others might tempt you with the ultimate choice: give up and embrace the dark power of the necromancer. Will you forge your own path to freedom, or let the castle claim you forever?
Key Features:
A Unique Undead Perspective: Play as a skeleton with free will, fighting to break free from a necromancer’s control.
Interactive Puzzles and Riddles Solving: Solve devious puzzles scattered throughout the castle to uncover hidden paths and secrets.
Morally Gray Choices: Will you resist the necromancer's pull, strike a deal with the demons, or surrender to the darkness?
Memorable Characters: Interact with a cast of quirky and sinister characters, each with their own agendas.
Why Play?
Neither Dead or Alive is a darkly charming mix of puzzle-solving, storytelling, humor, and moral dilemmas. With a hauntingly atmospheric setting, unique undead protagonist, and a story where every choice matters, this is a game for players who crave more than just another escape adventure.
Your Fate Awaits
Will you defy the necromancer, outwit the demon, and break free? Or will you succumb to the shadows within the castle walls? The choice is yours in Neither Dead or Alive.

title: Orbi Universo II
description:
게임 정보
Orbi Universo II is a deep management-simulation-strategy game that puts you at the forefront of history itself. Through an innovative node-based system, you'll guide your society from the Neolithic era to the Atomic Age, making impactful decisions that ripple through time.
MASTER THE COMPLEXITY OF CIVILIZATION
Harness a unique node system where every aspect of your civilization interacts in meaningful ways
Watch as your decisions create cascading effects across your society
Balance countless interconnected elements: from agriculture and commerce to religion and warfare
Navigate the delicate dance between stability and progress
FORGE YOUR OWN PATH
Shape your civilization's unique cultural and religious traits
Each region has its own local resources and nodes
Adapt to your environment and create truly distinct societies
Challenge historical assumptions and craft your own alternate history
FACE A LIVING WORLD
Engage with rival civilizations across a dynamic world map
Wage wars through tactical battle choices
Forge diplomatic alliances and trade relationships
Secure crucial resources through commerce or conquest
A UNIQUE EXPERIENCE
Abstract visual style that emphasizes clarity and readability
Multiple victory conditions and play styles
Diverse soundtrack inspired by many different cultures, evolving with you
Rich emergent storytelling through systemic interactions
A NEW EVOLUTION

title: SquareMan-Boy
description:
게임 정보
SquareMan-Boy is a fast paced action platformer with focus on quick and precise movement. You are never standing still, constantly getting pushed around by the colored blocks.
Use your charge ability, world rotators and teleporters to dodge lasers and get to the exit of each level.
Each level has an exit and your goal is to reach it without dying
Press and hold to charge a dash, release the button to charge away with great speed

title: survivor redemption
description:
게임 정보
이것은 어두운 스타일의 생존 게임입니다. 게임에서 당신은 강력한 천사로 변신하여 세상의 모든 악을 제거하는 임무를 수행하게 됩니다. 당신의 임무는 악마와 괴물을 파괴하는 것뿐만 아니라 탐험과 전투를 통해 보석을 수집하는 것입니다. 이 보석을 사용하면 장비와 룬을 강화하여 전투에서 더욱 강력해질 수 있습니다.
게임에는 일반부터 악몽까지 점점 난이도가 높아지는 다양한 레벨이 있습니다. 각 레벨에는 고유한 도전 과제와 강력한 적들이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다. 적을 물리치고 임무를 완수하면 푸짐한 보상과 경험치를 받아 레벨과 스킬을 지속적으로 향상시킬 수 있습니다.
각 레벨의 최종 보스는 고유한 공격 모드와 스킬을 가지고 있으므로, 이들을 물리치기 위해서는 다양한 전술을 유연하게 구사해야 합니다. 보스를 성공적으로 물리친 후에는 더 많은 희귀 보석을 잠금 해제하고 다음 전투를 준비할 수 있습니다.
어둠과 도전으로 가득 찬 이 세계에서 여러분은 흥미진진한 전투, 풍부하고 다양한 임무, 심층적인 캐릭터 개발 시스템을 경험하게 될 것입니다. 도전에 응하고 빛을 지키는 천사가 될 준비를 하세요!

title: Mulligans Golf Game
description:
게임 정보
Mulligans Golf Game is a wacky, arcade golfing game. Gameplay is designed to give the player complete freedom to play how they want in the world of a simplified yet challenging golfing experience. It is not a Sim! But it is designed to provide the scenarios and emotions that come when playing real golf. Players choose from the available pool of legendary characters and hand crafted courses, either playing solo or with friends up to 3 Friends (local split screen or online), attempting to set new Personal Bests, going for Course Records (local and global leaderboards), or challenging friends to see who is the best!
Current List of Features
For a detailed Road map for the game, please visit our website,
15 Legendary Characters
Skins to unlock for each by levelling
Character Personal Best Score tracking per Course
Handicaps tracked for determining World Ranking
Multiple ways to Golf
Tutorial, Single Player, Split Screen (up to 4 player), Online (up to 8 player)
Variety of Golf Match types, modes and settings
More Maps to Play!
8 original demo maps + 20 New Maps (progression to unlock)
Download and play Community Designed Maps!
Local and Global Leaderboards for every Course
In Game Course Designer (Sandbox Style)
Design Courses with the help of up to 3 others locally or online
Play your Custom maps with your friends by hosting games
Upload your Custom Maps to the Community Database for others to play!
1 Map Type with a range of assets to design your courses with
This is the *Simplified* Map Type which uses Low poly objects, flat textures, and toon shading
Golf Carts
Rentable Golf Carts that can be used to traverse the Courses (or run over your friends)

title: Grand Taking Ages
description:
게임 정보
세계 최초의 현실 기반 게임 개발 시뮬레이터에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 다음 게임 걸작을 만들고자 하는 당신의 꿈이 실제 현실과 정면으로 충돌합니다!
엄마의 차고(이제 공식적으로 "기술 인큐베이터")에서 여정을 시작하고... 글쎄요, 조금 더 나은 차고로 올라가세요!
당신의 사명(수락하기로 선택했다면)
별이 빛나는 인디 개발자에서 불가능한 마감일, 신비한 버그, 그리고 "단 하나의 기능만 더" 추가하려는 끊임없는 유혹에 맞서 싸우는 카페인에 취한 코딩 전사로 변신하세요. 다음 게임 센세이션을 만들어낼까요? 아니면 당신의 프로젝트가 "Coming Soon™" 전설의 신성한 전당에 합류할까요?
주요 기능
🎮 ZERO에서 HERO까지
꿈과 에너지 드링크만 가지고 시작하세요
차고에서 거의 회사 사무실까지 제국을 건설하세요
여러 커피 위기를 겪으며 팀의 정신 건강을 관리하세요
🚀 개발의 기술을 마스터하세요
기능 확장과 실제 소름 돋는 기능의 균형을 맞추세요
버그를 기능으로 다시 분류하는 고대 예술을 완벽하게 만드세요
커뮤니티 관리의 위험한 물살을 헤쳐 나가세요
"지연이 아니라 추가 연마입니다" 기술을 마스터하세요
⚔️ 장대한 전투가 기다리고 있습니다
불편한 질문으로 무장한 무자비한 기자들을 피하세요
키보드 워리어의 무서운 군대와 맞서세요
미완성 빌드를 유출하려는 해커를 방어하세요
"결과"와 "진행"을 어리석게 기대하는 투자자와 맞서세요
🏗️ 꿈의 스튜디오를 만드세요
완벽한 작업 공간을 디자인하세요 (또는 적어도 투자자 방문에 좋게 보이도록 하세요)
피자로 살아남을 수 있는 능력을 바탕으로 드림팀을 고용하세요
"빌려온" 자산을 실제로 오리지널 콘텐츠로 업그레이드하세요
사기를 북돋우기 위해 점점 더 정교한 커피 머신을 설치하세요
출시일

title: RSOD
description:
게임 정보
AS REAL AS IT GETS ON A 686



RSOD is as cyberpunk as legally permissible. Everything glows or has a flat videogamey texture. Objects have sharp black outlines, like an anime. All the maps are honest geometry with 1:1 physics on almost every triangle.



Shoot some zombies, or catgirls, rednecks, or cyborgs. Hitscan, projectiles, ranged and melee. Engage in content. Experience graphics.

Development is ongoing and the release date may be pushed back until the base game has sufficient content.

title: The Old Man and His Cat
description:
게임 정보
기이 한 해안 마을에서 음식을 찾는 귀엽고 배고픈 고양이의 역할을하는 마음이 따뜻해지는 게임에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 이 게임은 매력적인 게임 플레이, 아름다운 그래픽, 마음을 따뜻하게 해줄 감동적인 스토리로 가득 차 있습니다.

음식을 찾아 마을을 돌아다니다가 음식을 숨겨둔 심술궂은 노인을 우연히 만납니다. 그러나 당신은 곧 그 노인이 아내를 잃은 후 가족과 친구들과 연락이 끊긴 재능 있는 예술가라는 사실을 알게 됩니다. 당신의 도움으로 그는 사랑하는 사람들과 다시 연결되고 다시 한 번 행복을 찾을 수 있습니다.

이 게임은 탐험을 유도하는 오픈 월드 환경을 특징으로 하며 숨겨진 구석구석을 발견할 수 있습니다. 마을은 퍼즐을 풀고 퀘스트를 완료하는 등 흥미로운 캐릭터와 유쾌한 미니 게임으로 가득 차 있습니다. 캐릭터와의 상호 작용을 통해 노인과 예술과 삶에 대한 열정을 재발견하기 위한 그의 여정에 더 가까이 다가갈 수 있습니다.

또한 게임의 놀라운 그래픽과 몰입형 사운드 디자인은 플레이어를 생명과 디테일로 가득 찬 고요하고 평화로운 해안 마을로 안내합니다. 세상은 형형색색의 동식물로 활기차고 사운드트랙은 게임의 분위기를 완벽하게 포착하여 플레이어를 경험에 몰입시킵니다.

전반적으로 우리 게임은 모든 연령대의 플레이어에게 완벽한 유쾌하고 따뜻한 경험입니다. 털복숭이 영웅과 함께 우정과 자기 발견의 여정에 동참하고 노인이 다시 한 번 삶의 기쁨을 찾도록 도와주세요.
autokwd: The Old Man and His Cat

title: Indoras
description:
게임 정보
Indoras: The Whispering Shards
Enter a world of fantasy and adventure, dungeon-based game set in a realm on the brink of collapse. Once proud protectors of the land, the Templars have fallen under a sinister influence and now siphons the world’s elemental power for their own ambitions. Play one of five distinct classes—Warrior, Guardian, Heretic, Elementalist, or Sorcerer— and battle through seven different zones, each shaped by a corrupted Templar’s domain.
Key Features
Group based or Single player dungeon-based runs
Embark in dungeon runs on your own or either with your friends, up to 4 players
Progress in playing dungeons on various difficulties, and clearing them out faster for better loot
Learn the story of Indoras by progressing through dungeons, various dungeons per zone that unveils the story and the Templar's connection to it.
Customized Characters
Ability to choose different looks for your character to reflect your own identity.|

title: Wacambria Island
description:
게임 정보
Explore Wacambria Island’s vast landscape as a treasure hunter, adventurer all while fighting valiantly for the freedom of the local islanders. Search various biomes, caves, ruins and towns while unlocking treasures and solving puzzles in your quest to liberate the island.
Engage in Exciting Combat

Engage in satisfying combat as you save Wacambria Island. Your enemies will strafe, parry and work together to try and stop your valiant efforts. Utilize the variety of weapons and tactics to bring your foes to their knees.
Customize your adventurer

Unlock new cosmetics and armor all throughout Wacambria and its various ruins and caves.
Explore an Ancient World

Discover the secret of Wacambria Island as you explore various locations including ruins, caves, temples and towns. Wacambria Island is packed with secrets, treasure and danger.

Befriend the locals as you rise to the challenge of securing their freedom. The people of Wacambria Island are a friendly bunch. As you adventure through the Island you have the opportunity to engage and help them help you.

Purchase one of many in game homes and decorate them to your hearts extent. Buy materials or use items you find on your adventure to create your own lavish living quarters.

Wacambria Island is a open-world, action RPG set on an island comprised of diverse biomes. Play as an adventurer whos search for treasure lands him in the middle of a drama between the local islanders and an invading army. With the island mostly controlled by the invading army, you will need to work together with the locals to gain back territory. This journey will take you across numerous biomes, caves, ruins and towns while discovering the secrets of an ancient power and a legendary hero. With the odds stacked against the local people, you will be the deciding factor of freedom in Wacambria Island.

title: Mr. President
description:
게임 정보
GMT Games의 유명 보드게임 Mr. President: The American Presidency 2000-2020을 충실하게 디지털로 재현한 이 게임에서 현대 미국의 지도력에 대한 복잡성과 도전을 경험해 보십시오. 미국과 세계를 변화시킨 20년 동안 대통령 집무실에 들어서십시오.
내각을 구성하고 최근 역사에서 중요한 순간을 헤쳐나가면서 행정부를 이끌어 보십시오. 또한, 실제로는 발생하지 않았지만 충분히 가능했던 사건들도 경험할 수 있습니다. 글로벌 금융 위기가 더 일찍 발생했거나 더 심각했다면? 중남미에서 폭력이 격화되어 카르텔이 지배하는 무법 국가가 탄생했다면? 아웃소싱과 자동화, 혹은 유가 급등이 국내 정치 위기를 초래했다면? 대통령의 유산을 결정짓거나 훼손할 중요한 결정을 내려야 합니다.
2000년부터 2020년까지 각 대통령 임기에 맞춘 다섯 개의 역사적 시나리오 중 하나를 선택하여 실제 대통령보다 더 나은 성과를 낼 수 있는지 확인해 보십시오. 2000년대 초반 사회보장 개혁을 통과시킬 수 있을까요? 핵무장을 시도하는 이란이나 북한을 저지할 수 있을까요? 지속 가능한 이민 개혁을 이끌어낼 수 있을까요? 아니면 두 시대의 일반적인 흐름을 반영한 샌드박스 모드를 플레이할 수도 있습니다. 또는 이 두 세대의 전반적인 흐름을 반영한 샌드박스 시나리오를 진행할 수 있습니다. 외교 및 국내 위기를 처리하는 것 외에도, 연방 대법원 판사를 지명하고 그들의 인준 청문회를 주관하며, 스캔들을 관리하고, 재선 캠페인을 운영하며, 의회와 협력하여 입법 agenda를 추진하고, 유능하고 효과적인 내각을 구성해야 합니다.
원작의 충실한 재현, 더 쉬운 관리
디지털 버전은 원작 보드게임이 가진 매력을 그대로 유지합니다:
역사적 사건과 가상의 사건을 포함한 150개 이상의 위기 상황
미국의 주요 동맹국과 적대국별로 고유한 행동 리스트와 정책 의제 - 단순히 국기만 다른 동일한 게임 플레이가 아닙니다
매 턴마다 다양한 선택지를 제공하며, 제한된 행동 예산 내에서 고민해야 하는 전략적 요소
사이버 전쟁, 우주 개발, 정보 수집 등 미국의 전략적 역량을 강화하며 러시아와 중국 같은 주요 경쟁국을 지속적으로 견제
그러나 이제는 행정적인 번거로움을 줄이고, 전략적 판단에만 집중할 수 있습니다.
디지털 기능으로 향상된 경험
모든 표와 행동 리스트를 클릭 한 번으로 확인 가능
전체적인 전략과 당면한 위기를 자유롭게 넘나들 수 있는 매끄러운 보드뷰
몇 초 만에 완료되는 시나리오 설정
보드게임 원작의 팬이든, 대통령 정치 시뮬레이션이 처음이든, 이 디지털 버전은 접근성과 깊이를 완벽하게 조화시킨 경험을 제공합니다. 어려운 결정을 내리고, 역사를 형성하며, 대통령직을 체험해 보십시오.

title: Re:END
description:
게임 정보
Re:END is a laid-back, top-down, solo mode RPG, like the great MMOs of the good old days. Re:END is easy to operate, and has a deep system, including leveling up, reincarnation, pets, equipment upgrades, arenas, materials, and more.
Experience an RPG with all the elements that made the good old days (late 2000s) MMORPGs.
▼Leveling up and reincarnation
What would an MMO be without leveling up? Nothing beats the feeling of overcoming adversity, discovering new and better ways to earn experience points, and getting stronger with every level.
Allocate status points every time you level up, recalibrate, and reincarnate. Get stronger and develop your character to be who you are.
▼Collecting materials and upgrading weapons
Collect materials by defeating powerful monsters or fishing to improve your equipment. Fight more powerful monsters, face new challenges, and prepare for the next power spike.
▼Pets
All enemies, including bosses, can become your allies (some arena monsters cannot join). When you defeat an enemy, there is a small 0.3% chance that it will become your ally. The probability may be low, but the sense of accomplishment when it happens is exceptional!

title: Last Spartan: Glory Over Madness
description:
게임 정보



King Leonidas and his valiant Spartan warriors return triumphantly from their campaigns, only to face a dark and horrifying fate. Their victory has awakened an ancient, eldritch force that lays waste to their fleet. As the sole survivor, King Leonidas is left alone, tormented by guilt and madness. Driven by a burning resolve, he must conquer his inner demons and embark on an epic quest to liberate his homeland from the clutches of insanity.


Choose your ally god from a pool of 10+ Greek gods, all offering different active and passive abilities, allowing you to try different builds, play styles and strategies.




Build your own dice to create a custom deck for turn-based battles. Customize your dice to your own strategy, bring out new and unique synergies and combos coupled with each God's unique abilities. Dice faces are rewards for winning each battle encounter, add them to your collection to progress on your roguelike run.




Encounter new random events and face new enemies each playthrough. Choices matter with each encounter, leading to either rewards, blessings, or curses.





Collect powerful artifacts during encounters, granting permanent stats and abilities for the rest of your run.





Your path towards the final battle will be filled with encounters and narrative events, keep your mind sharp and try not to lose your sanity as you defeat and face Lovecraftian horrors.

title: Drone Zone
description:
게임 정보
We invite you to play a game with a unique gameplay! Drone Zone is a combination of tactical shooter and moba games with leveling up.
DroneZone is already AVAILABLE IN EARLY ACCESS, click "REQUEST ACCESS" and you can try to play right now, the game will immediately appear in your library!



The world is contaminated with hazardous radiation from fallen meteors, that forced humanity to hide under the ground. Your mission is to send various battle drones to the areas exposed to radiation. Survive among anomalies, mutants and fight with other drones for valuable resources contained inside the meteors.





Every drone has a number of active skills. You will be able to stun the enemy by a burst of energy, turn on the field that blocks enemy attacks, generate your own anomaly to astonish or distract your opponent and use many other abilities.




Use acquired resources to craft engines, guns, batteries and other modules. Assemble your own unique drones using these modules.





Destroy any enemy modules, preventing him from using his strengths. For example, destroy engine to make enemy drone fall down or break his gun to deprive him of the ability to shoot. Don't forget to protect your modules from enemy attacks.

title: MATRESHKA
description:
게임 정보
당신은 신비롭게 고장난 엘리베이터에서 깨어나 갇히고 혼란스러워합니다.
층간을 이동하며 주민들을 피하고 건물에서 살아남아 탈출하세요.
절대 MATRESHKA에게 등을 보이지 마세요.


도전적인 퍼즐
논리, 관찰, 창의력을 요구하는 복잡한 퍼즐을 해결하세요. 각 해결책은 자유에 한 발짝 다가가게 하지만 동시에 건물의 미스터리 속으로 더 깊이 빠져들게 합니다.



정교하게 재현된 소련 시대 건물을 탐험하세요. 진정성 있는 디테일과 역사를 생생하게 느낄 수 있는 오싹한 분위기가 가득합니다.



각 층마다 고유한 도전과 상호작용 요소가 있습니다. 단서를 찾고 유용한 아이템을 수집하며 환경을 조작해 건물의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.



건물의 주민들을 조심하세요. 그들의 행동과 동기는 예측할 수 없습니다. 일부는 도움을 줄 수도 있고, 일부는 방해할 수도 있으며, 일부는 아주 위험할 수도 있습니다.

title: Echoed Realms
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an unforgettable journey through breathtaking fantasy worlds where every corner is a canvas for your wildest adventures. Explore beautifully crafted worlds, rich with diverse landscapes, discovering dungeons, creatures, and loot. Make new friends and companions and then take them on adventures. Kick back and fish or grow something delicious. Discover new recipes and make something unique. Stumble upon endless hidden secrets. Amass a collection, or befriend every creature.

Unleash your imagination and shape the world to your liking. Build awe-inspiring structures, from cozy cottages to towering fortresses, using a robust construction system that offers limitless possibilities. Craft intricate items and gear, using the resources you gather from the many environments.

Customize your home world and your play style. Unlock new features and toggle them on or off as you see fit to customize your gameplay experience. If you don't feel like farming or cooking today, turn it off, and no loop drops or quest rewards will fill up your inventory with any unwanted associated materials until you turn it on again. Your game, your way!

Echoed Realms is a stylized fantasy adventure extraction game where you can explore and gather resources and friends from other realms to design and build your own realm. It can be played solo or in a party of up to 4 player friends, NPC friends, or pets. Invite your player friends to visit your realm, or go and visit theirs.

title: Ascend
description:
게임 정보
진실을 밝히다
Ascend는 3인칭 어드벤처 퍼즐 게임으로, 한 젊은 여성이 신비로운 산 정상에 올라 그 비밀을 알아내고 자신의 민족의 땅을 조화로운 상태로 회복시켜야 합니다. 퍼즐, 자연의 경이로움, 잃어버린 문명의 잔재, 천체와의 연결 등 이전에 시도했던 모든 사람들이 불가능하다고 판명된 여정을 떠나는 오로라를 기다리고 있습니다.

오로라는 산이 자신이 상상했던 것과는 전혀 다르다는 것을 금세 알아차립니다. 대답하기보다는 질문이 더 많을 것입니다. 명확한 방향보다는 흐릿한 판단이 더 많아집니다. 결국 그녀는 산 안팎의 모든 삶에서 균형이 얼마나 중요한 역할을 하는지 깨닫게 됩니다.

그녀가 단 한 가지 확신하는 것은 자신이 추구하는 것은 산 정상에 있다는 것입니다. 그녀는 반드시 등반해야 합니다.

산에 있는 고대 유적을 탐험하고 태양이나 달의 빛과 소리 및 플랫폼을 사용하여 퍼즐을 풀어보세요.

각 레벨의 환경은 주변 환경과 상호작용하는 것만으로도 스토리를 전달합니다.


각 레벨은 각기 다른 정신 상태와 요소에서 영감을 받았으며, 각 영역은 각기 다른 매력으로 가득합니다.

title: Essentures
description:
게임 정보
Essentures is inspired by the great games of the 90s and late 80s, but incorporates the improvements and concepts of modern gaming. You will experience a grand adventure through 4 kingdoms wherein you can use mysterious creatures as both allies or weapons! It's entirely up to you how you will travel through this world, defeating the Ancient Gods and discovering the universe's mysteries as you do.
Action RPG + Turn RPG at same time!



Essentures mixes Action and Turn RPG combat systems in a unique system that encapsulates strategic thinking of RPGs and the thrill of real-time combat! To achieve this, the mechanics of both genres were blended in such a way so as to limit the weaknesses of both while exemplifying their strengths. This, mixed with many new mechanics, the reimagining of existing mechanics, a unique battle system, and an epic story creates a unique experience only Essentures can offer!
Over 250 creatures!



In Essentures each creature has an infant stage and an adult stage. The infant stage is shared among members of the same family, each with its own respective color, while each adult stage is unique. There are a grand total of 320 creatures in the game, composed of 250 adult forms and 70 infant forms. Each creature can be transformed into a weapon form optionally in battles to create lots of strategies!

title: GUG
description:
게임 정보
Transcend
Unique gug creation: Each gug is procedurally generated from a phrase you type. Even the devs don't know what's going to happen each time you transcend!
Fight
Unexpected threats: Battle gugs from other players and previous runs. Innovate to counter your own creations!

title: Watchword
description:
게임 정보
Watchword is a roguelike deck builder about playing words to beat increasingly difficult trials with rule-breaking synergies and combos. 
A good vocabulary will certainly help, but it will mostly take careful planning and strategy to beat each trial.
Invent crazy new words and use special symbols to play a board that scores massively! Fill your bag and customize your collection of pieces.
Purchase books to ramp up your point scoring. 
Each book has a unique power that can help (or potentially hinder) depending on what pieces you use. Some books completely change the rules of the game. Explore, and discover clever combinations!

title: Shuruka Boxing
description:
게임 정보
Shuruka Boxing
Step into the ring and experience the most realistic first-person boxing simulation ever created. Shuruka Boxing puts you in the gloves of a rising champion, fighting your way to the top in brutal, high-stakes matches.
🔹 Hyper-Realistic Combat – Every punch, dodge, and block feels authentic, thanks to advanced physics and motion-captured animations.
🔹 Dynamic AI Opponents – Face off against fighters with unique styles, adaptive strategies, and brutal finishing moves.
🔹 Career Mode – Train, rise through the ranks, and challenge legendary fighters for championship glory.
Do you have what it takes to become the undisputed champion?

title: ERA ONE
description:
게임 정보
Era One is a space-themed game developed by Team Complex LTD.
Combining innovation, customization, and epic space battles, Era One offers a unique gaming experience. Players can customize their own ships using assembly modules, construct stations, warships, bases, and even cities in space. The game seamlessly blends real-time strategy (RTS) and base building elements, providing players with the opportunity to engage in intense battles between space fleets.


From the ashes of a shattered universe, a young woman's quest for salvation sparks a journey of intrigue, danger, and discovery. In a future where Earth's resources were depleted, humanity embarked on The Great Colonization, expanding to other planets. The rise of mining corporations led to conflicts and the emergence of space piracy. A wealthy magnate discovered a powerful energy source, leading to the construction of the Navi Mondo, enormous fortified and self-sustaining cities in space, and the formation of the Free Federation of Worlds. Centuries passed, and the population was pushed to abandon planets, living only on the Navi Mondo. However, genetically engineered biominers mutated and posed a threat. With resources nearing exhaustion, the Free Federation planned to migrate using Hyperspace Leap technology. The colonizing ships Victrix and X Gemina encountered a gravitational anomaly, causing a breach. Chaos ensued as resources depleted, wars resumed, and the political system collapsed. Alya De Shars sought to steal a power source to launch a secret ship and start anew. This sets the stage for a story of humanity's struggle, the rise and fall of an empire, and the hope for a fresh beginning beyond the Solar System.
We asked Alberto Selvaggi to read Era One's lore and compose based solely on his inspiration and years of passion for music and piano. The result is a unique and emotionally touching soundtrack that will accompany us throughout the story, adding depth and making everything deeply engaging.


The player can construct their own base using a set of assembly modules, with no limit to shape or size.
Extensive Base Customization: Era One offers a wide range of options for base construction and customization. Players can design and build their bases from scratch, choosing the layout, structures, and aesthetics that suit their playstyle.
Resource Management: Building and maintaining a base requires effective resource management. Players must gather and manage resources such as raw materials, energy sources, and workforce to construct and upgrade their bases. Proper allocation of resources is essential for the growth and sustainability of the base, ensuring its survival in the game world.
Defensive Structures and Strategies: Bases in Era One must be fortified against external threats. Players can construct defensive structures such as turrets, and traps to protect their bases from enemy attacks. Choosing the right defensive strategy, positioning defenses strategically, and upgrading them over time are crucial aspects of base building in the game.
Research and Technological Advancement: As players progress in Era One, they can unlock and research new technologies to enhance their base-building capabilities. Advancements in areas such as construction techniques, resource extraction, and defensive systems provide players with additional options for base expansion and fortification.


Players can build their starships according to their preferences.
Vast Ship Customization Options: Era One offers a wide array of ship customization options, allowing players to design and personalize their vessels. Players can choose from different ship types, sizes, and aesthetics, customizing various aspects such as hull design, paint schemes, and exterior decorations. This level of customization allows players to create unique and visually distinct ships that reflect their individual style.
Modular Ship Components: Ships in Era One are built using modular components, offering players the flexibility to tailor their ships for specific roles and functions. Players can select and install various modules, such as propulsion systems, weapon systems, cargo holds, and utility modules, based on their playstyle and objectives. The modular nature of ship components enables players to experiment with different configurations and optimize their ships for exploration, combat, trading, or other specialized tasks.
Upgradeable Ship Systems: As players progress in the game, they can acquire new technologies and upgrade ship systems to enhance their performance. Upgradable systems can include engines for increased speed, shields for improved defense, weapons for enhanced firepower, and scanners for better exploration capabilities.

title: MBTI Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Do you believe that tiny creatures dwell in the recesses of your mind? 
In MBTI Survivors, you'll discover that your inner world is teeming with spirited beings—quirky, endearing, and ready for battle. Come get to know these charming inhabitants and bond with them as you stand together against the creeping shadows of doubt and fear.
Embark on an extraordinary journey where every personality unveils its hidden strengths. As you command your elemental sprites—each reflecting a distinct MBTI trait—watch them evolve through unique upgrade branches, transforming into formidable allies. Every encounter becomes a chance to learn more about who you truly are, as you craft dynamic builds that mirror your inner complexity.
So, what is your gaming MBTI? Step into the arena of your mind, forge powerful bonds, and let the adventure reveal the depths of your personality.
Key Features
Personalized Elemental Sprites: Use elemental sprites to embody your personality; each sprite not only reflects its unique individuality but also comes with exclusive skill upgrade branches, offering you a myriad of strategic options.
16 Unique MBTI Skills: Every MBTI personality boasts its one-of-a-kind skill, each of which can evolve further through upgrade branches to create your own distinctive battle style.
Fast-Paced Short Runs: Each run lasts around 15 minutes, featuring meticulously designed, short battles that deliver an exhilarating gameplay experience in a compact timeframe.
Hundreds of Traits and Items: Choose from hundreds of traits and items to enjoy fresh experiences and new combinations every run, ensuring each playthrough is full of surprises.
Innovative Theme Integration: Experience a unique fusion of personality testing and game mechanics, where exploring your inner world is paired with adventure-filled, strategic combat.

title: Tower Networking Inc.
description:
게임 정보
Tower Networking Inc is a blend of simulation and economic-strategy with rogue-like elements. Physically connect your clients to your networks by patching cables into switches, routers and data risers. Run an internet service provider in a tower that keeps building random floors. Each new floor comes with unique residences and/or offices that naturally has a variety of different needs.
As the network operator, you are tasked to provide connectivity and various IT related services to the residents in the tower on a limited budget. Your board of directors have a strict policy where you must never go over-budget or face termination from your role. Additionally, some of your clients have service level agreements (SLA) and you must ensure their internet connection (and the services they need) stays up. If any of them files a complaint, then its game-over!.
Your goal is to ensure your internet service provider runs as long as possible.
Key Features:
RUN AN INTERNET SERVICE PROVIDER: Provide internet services to residences and offices in an ever-expanding randomly generated tower.
CABLE MANAGEMENT SIMULATION: Spaghetti ahoy! Link up switches and routers with various types (and lengths) of network cables.

title: Space Bross
description:
게임 정보
          Space Bross is a thrilling blend of action 2.5D roguelite, and Tower Defense genres. Step into the boots of a retired astronaut whose mission has turned personal, your beloved chicken has been abducted by aliens. Now, driven by vengeance and the hope of reunion, you must traverse strange and hostile planets, survive relentless waves of enemies, and uncover clues in the vast, unforgiving expanse of space.
           Prepare for battle by strategically placing turrets and building a strong base. Plan ahead, use your resources wisely, and fortify your defenses as you gear up to face incoming enemies. The success of your strategy will determine whether you can hold the line or fall to the horde.

title: 180 Seconds: A Firefighter's Call
description:
게임 정보
The alarm blares. Your heart races. In 180 seconds, lives will be changed forever - including yours. 
As a firefighter in this thrilling simulation arcade game, you're thrust into burning buildings with nothing but your wits, your equipment, and a ticking clock. Each environment - from maze-like office complexes to sprawling schools - is a puzzle of flame and smoke, waiting to be solved. But unlike traditional puzzles, the stakes here are life and death.
Your primary tool is a firehose with three tactical modes, each offering a different balance of power and precision. Will you use the focused stream to cut through to a specific hotspot, or switch to the wide spray to control a larger area? Every choice matters when the clock is ticking down from 180.
But "180 Seconds" isn't just about fighting fires. It's about the people caught in them. The game uses advanced AI to generate unique characters for each playthrough, complete with their own voices and backstories. The child you save in one run might be replaced by an elderly couple in the next, ensuring that no two games feel the same.
This unpredictability extends to the fires themselves. Using a proprietary system developed in Unreal Engine 5, the game simulates fires that react realistically to their environment and your actions. Manage oxygen levels carefully, or risk turning a smoldering room into a raging inferno with one wrong move.
Between missions, you'll return to the firehouse. Here, the game slows down, allowing you to explore, interact with fellow firefighters, and even care for the station's pet. But don't get too comfortable - the alarm can sound at any moment, catapulting you back into the action.
As you play, you'll find yourself improving. Response times that once seemed impossible become achievable. Rooms that were death traps become navigable. You'll start climbing the Steam Leaderboards, competing with firefighters around the world. But more importantly, you'll gain a deeper appreciation for the real-life heroes who do this work every day.

title: The Path Home
description:
게임 정보
I need to head home......This must be the place I want to return to.
"The Path Home" is a mysterious puzzle game with a 2D pixel-art style, where you gradually transform a mysterious world.
Players can use panels to "flip" between black and white.
The girl is focused on going home, so she’s always looking for the "shortest route to the goal."
It’s up to you to reshape the puzzle world and guide her to the goal.
But if there are fake goals, she might get fooled.
Block the fake paths or steer her away from them.
company: かくひと, けめる, acrocat08

title: Beyond the Red Door
description:
게임 정보
"Beyond the Red Door" is a gripping first-person horror experience that plunges you into a nightmare where reality and the unknown collide.
Seven years ago, a devastating car accident shattered your life—your wife was lost, and your daughter has remained in a coma ever since. Haunted by guilt and grief, you find yourself trapped in a terrifying dream, standing before a massive crimson door. A voice whispers from beyond—your daughter's soul is trapped inside.
One night, you awaken from a disturbing dream of a massive red door, only to find yourself somewhere else—a dark, twisted world beyond comprehension. You didn’t mean to enter, but now you’re trapped. A voice echoes in the void—your daughter’s soul is here, lost and waiting.
To save her, you must navigate the horrors of this nightmarish realm, unlocking its secrets while avoiding the shadows that lurk within. Armed with only a flashlight and your wits, you must survive and escape the nightmare before it consumes you.

title: DarkBlood -ReVerse
description:
게임 정보
Features of this game
.DarkBlood2 is an RPG with simple controls.
Each of the nearly 20 warriors has their own goals in life, and some of them are emotionally scarred. You can change characters by talking with them, raising their intimacy level, and completing the quests assigned to you.
Some events can only occur with certain characters, so experience each life as you change protagonists.
How to proceed with the game
.The goal is to reclaim the Holy Grail of Souls, which governs life and death in the world.
Gather information and explore the dungeon in search of the whereabouts of the Holy Grail.
Exploring a dungeon is a simple choice of going forward, going back, or choosing a fork in the road, but the structure changes each time due to automatic generation, so you can enjoy conquering it over and over again.
As time passes, the atmosphere of the town changes, and the NPCs that appear also change. By using special abilities, you can rewind time, so even if you fail in negotiation, you can start over.
Elements of the game
.The characters in the game are rich in individuality, including warriors, mages, and martial artist types. By leveling up and allocating stats, players can create unique characters such as an agile two-fisted knight or an armor-clad magic warrior.
There are approximately 800 types of weapons and armor that can be enhanced. The type of attack changes depending on the weapon, so strengthen the weapon that best suits your character.
You can also collect various materials dropped by monsters to smelt weapons and items.
Story
.Once upon a time, there was a man who had the blood of a demon king. The man was immortal due to the power of his dark blood.
The king of time, Batos, locked the man in a cave where demons nested in order to end the demon king's bloodline.
However, the man used his immortality and wisdom to escape the cave and defeated King Batos, who had sold his soul to the devil.

To change his immortal destiny, the man set out on a journey. At the end of his long journey, he met the king of the underworld.
The King of the Underworld, the ruler of life and death, heeded the man's wish, and the man was finally freed from the curse of immortality.

The man, now old and sick in bed, was about to die a peaceful death.
In his fading consciousness, he smiled at the thought of the peace that would finally come.

But then he woke up again.
Reflected in the mirror of a strange room was the image of a man he did not know.

You are ...... Who are you ......

세탁기를 통해 자동 수동 소득을 얻거나 손을 더럽히고 고객의 옷을 청소하여 수입을 극대화하여 세탁 제국을 운영 할 수 있습니다. 더러운 빨래를 할 직원을 고용하고 관리할 수도 있습니다!

title: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions
description:
게임 정보
Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is a fast-paced racing game for the whole family that brings the famous Europa-Park mascots Ed & Edda to life for the first time in a video game to coincide with the worldwide release of the animated feature film ‘GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE’!
You can race with the two heroes or six other colourful characters that fans of the film will recognise! The races take players to various well-known locations across Europe to compete in individual races, points races, time trials or the Grand Prix!
Each character not only has their very own racing car, but also individual strengths and weaknesses, which means that each race can be driven very differently depending on which character you take to the track!
But Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is not just a game that is great fun to play alone: in a race with two, three or even four players, every family and every group of friends can create their very own memories in the world of the Racing Champions - because with Ed & Edda, too, it's true: a shared game is often twice the fun!
 Key features of Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions:
 Race over exciting tracks in many world-famous European locations
Choose between eight well-known characters, including Ed & Edda, the legendary Europa-Park mascots
Unleash unique driving skills, master power-ups and customise your race car to make every race feel unique
Long-term modifications to the racing car and unlockable improvements keep the replay value high
A split-screen mode for local multiplayer races of 2 to 4 players invites families to have fun together and create their very own memories in the world of Ed & Edda.
