title: Firearms Factory
description:
게임 정보

An adventure that will last from the beginning of the 1st World War to the end of the 2nd World War is waiting for you.



You will start to produce weapons in a small workshop, and as the weapons you produce win the wars, you will gain money and experience.



With this experience and money, You can manufacture pistols, SMGs, assault rifles, bolt actions, and more...



Maybe if your government trusts you enough, you'll be well-equipped to produce tanks, what do you think?

title: The Necromancer's Tale
description:
게임 정보
The Necromancer's Tale is a narrative-driven top-down RPG where you play the role of a minor noble in the 18th Century, drawn into the Dark Necromantic Arts as you seek knowledge and revenge. Great power awaits... along with the weird, the morbid, and a gradual descent into madness.
Before you lies a great spellbook, filled with powerful rites of death and reanimation. Can you decipher the pages and master its arcane rituals without losing your mind or being strung up by the townsfolk? Your progress will require great determination, cunning and secrecy.
The Necromancer's Tale is a story-rich game, in which you converse with 180+ NPC characters, each with their own portrait art. You will investigate, negotiate, coerce and flatter in order to progress your aims. The game's Trust system means that your choices - even in conversation - really matter. If the townsfolk's trust drops too low, you will find your choices are affected - if it drops further still, you will surely be tried in court and hanged, or lynched by a frenzied mob.

title: Dyping Escape
description:
게임 정보
"I want you to play this typing game.
Just type the keys as instructed.
There's no need to think at all."
The horror typing game "Dyping", played over 250,000 times, has received a massive upgrade and is now officially released.
Now back with infinitely more despair.
A Dying-Typing Game
The ominous "Eyes" present you with disturbing typing prompts.
The words you type become reality and come back to haunt you.
"Please kill me." If you type this sentence, you die. Game over.
Break the Game From the Outside
The game is filled with unavoidable, unfair deaths.
Once the sinister text appears, it seems like your only choice is to type it and march toward your demise.
...But perhaps, you can still open the "Settings Screen."
Roguelike Typing
As the game progresses, the deaths imposed by the Eyes grow increasingly unreasonable.
However, if you obtain "fragments"—cards that allow you to alter words and letters—you can fight back against its malice.
Use the ever-changing fragments in each playthrough to defeat the Eyes!

title: Analog - Skin off
description:
게임 정보
Analog
Analog is game series that combines a first person horror experience with analog horror.
Skin off
Skin off is the first game in Analog, where you play as a teenager during summer break. You decide to stay at your uncle's house away from the city with your friends. A strange message, however, appears on the TV that changes your plans. Follow the instruction if you want to survive.

title: Brickadia
description:
게임 정보
Brickadia is a physics-based multiplayer brick building game that gives you the tools to create and play, your way or with friends! Build intricate structures, invent cool contraptions, then play in them however you'd like!
Build anything you can imagine.
Using our constantly growing collection of bricks and intuitive, powerful tools, you can build towering skyscrapers, fun vehicles, islands, spaceships, cities, anything you can dream of. The only limit is your imagination.
Battle other players.
With the flexible game rules system and our grand collection of Pew Pews, any build can instantly become a fierce battle arena! Blow your friends to smithereens or host servers with custom game modes for anyone to join.

title: Some Deadly Years
description:
게임 정보
Some Deadly Years is a story based TPS Game set in a fictional war between 3 factions. You play as Ivin as he tries to navigate his way through a seemingly pointless war.
Posk: A booming island nation full of prospects and dreams.
Kyrrlauss: A slowly dying empire trying to regain glory after a crippling civil war.
Kasudala: A former American colony that is now trying to gain land it so lays claim to.

title: Shadows of Chroma Tower
description:
게임 정보
Join our official Discord
Click the link on the right to join DISCORD!
Will you escape with gold and power?
Or fall to the Shadows of Chroma Tower?
Survive by means of steel, wit or magic
Defeat the Archmage's minions, plunder their riches, discover the secrets within the Tower and escape with your life! Do it the way you prefer:
Play by yourself or with friends.
5 classes, each with their own skills, talent tree and specialized subclasses.
6 professions for you to master - from fishing to weapon forging.
Several difficulties for you to challenge yourself and test your gear and skills.
Hordes, mini-bosses, bosses and raids to fight alone or with up to 9 friends.


Whether playing by yourself or with friends, you will always be contributing to the bigger picture.

title: Kungfu2
description:
게임 정보
This is a fast-paced survivor game. Players will play as kungfus with special skills, and challenge 30 levels in a 30-second violent battle. Each character has its own characteristics, and with a variety of kungfus and props, activate the power of bondage and challenge the final BOSS!
Each level is only 30 seconds, and ordinary levels quickly kill enemies to accumulate resources, and boss levels!
Multiple character kungfus characteristics
Sword Immortal, God of Wealth, Scholar... Each character has its own characteristics. Switch characters, explore completely different fighting styles, and find your destiny kungfus!
Bond kungfus system
After each level, choose randomly refreshed kungfus and props, activate dozens of bond effects, and each game is a unique growth path!
Sword system + Kongtong School = Blade of Fire!
Sword system + Fist system = High attack speed + True damage = Meat shield nemesis!
The more you fight, the stronger you become, and the more you grow
Killing monsters will drop gold coins and experience, and strengthen your attack, attack speed, critical strike and other attributes in real time! The difficulty of the levels rises step by step. Can your construction defeat the final boss?
Gameplay highlights
Short, flat and fast game: 15 minutes to complete a single game, and you can complete it in a few minutes when you turn on the double speed!
Strategic depth: The kungfus fetters require delicate calculations. Is it mindless shopping? Or operating the economy? In "Kungfu2", every decision is a gamble to live and die.
—— Today, can you rewrite the limits of kungfus within 30 seconds? ——

title: Third Shift
description:
게임 정보
Third Shift is the first ever hybrid, point-and-click, survival horror video game, to take place in a pharmacy.
You are the new pharmacist...
And the night's not done with you yet...

title: DreamBreaker
description:
게임 정보
DreamBreaker is a turn-based card-based building game with rogue.
The Demon Lord is awakening, and you must find the Demon Lord's hiding place and improve yourself as much as you can within a limited time, sealing it again before it fully regains its challenge after challenge, you collect scattered memories and find the truth of this world!
In each game, you can choose different companions and exploration routes to find different skills and items. Experience the ever-changing world of building through different combinations!
Dual-skill cards
Each card can be equipped with 2 skills, and choose 1 of them to cast when played. Think and make choices based on the battle situation
Time-Order
Planned skills will be resolved sequentially during the action phase. Acting before or after the enemy is also part of the strategy!
Hero Team
Choose 1 main attack and 2 support characters for each game. Different fighting styles, and wonderful combinations create wonderful sparks!
Choose Route
The ultimate goal is to defeat the Demon Lord. There are no prescribed game routes, so you can freely choose the map you want to explore, so that every adventure and every build is different!
Boss Fights
Dozens of well-choreographed boss fights. Test your build to be up to the task! And bosses have their own unique loots to enrich your build!
The awakened Demon Lord
The Demon Lord gradually becomes stronger with time. Spend less time facing weaker demon lords, or spend more time becoming stronger yourself!

title: Spell Slide
description:
게임 정보
Push letters to form words in Spell Slide—a unique word game with two distinct modes. In Creative mode, discover as many words as you can to boost your score and unlock new levels. In Puzzle mode, each world introduces new mechanics: from bespoke single-solution challenges, to puzzles where spelling specific words opens doors, to strategy levels with companion robots, and even cryptic clue-based conundrums. Whether you're into freeform wordplay or structured problem-solving, Spell Slide lets you play your way.

title: AAS Mos Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보


A small accident occurred in the laboratory last month, which lead to an apocalypse. Not just an apocalypse, but a 'mos apocalypse'. What's a mos? A mos is a bigger version of a mosquito which was accidentally made by humans. They are not ten cm tall, not even 30 cm, but over one meter tall! It seems that these creatures want to reproduce, therefore they are looking for blood. That is the reason why there are many reports of people going missing. At first, we thought mos would become extinct in the first week. But we were wrong. Now they are everywhere and the number of missing people keeps rising.

An emergency signal has been broadcasted. The AAS team received the signal and are here to take action. They said that they have found a way to stop this apocalypse and that there is no need to send more troops. It seems that every member of AAS has a mission. They said that once all missions have been completed, the apocalypse will end once and for all.

This game consists of two game modes: single player and co-op.
On single player mode: grab a weapon, exterminate all mos, and complete the mission!
On co-op mode: pick your weapons and perks, think of a strategy, and survive endless waves of mos.

title: Idle Adventurer
description:
게임 정보
Become an adventurer and slay your way through infinite stages of enemies in this idle action RPG. Work your way through the hoards of creatures and beasts in order to bring back the glory to your village.
There's over 50 unique monsters with different variants and appearances to match each and every environment in which you will encounter them in. Paired with 25 different bosses and super bosses, you'll have your favorite monster to slay in no time!
Collect different armor and weapon sets in order to gain stat set bonus effects and other lucrative bonuses to help you along your journey.
Can't play the game all day? Then don't worry! Your progress will continue whilst you are offline, and you will come back to a whole host of loot and items when you make your return to vanquish more foes!

title: Shattered Soul
description:
게임 정보
About the Game
Shattered Soul is a modern game that interprets Beat'em up by adding the fun with a charming narrative based on Metroidvania-styled epic action. Explore a fantastic world that intersects medieval Europe, follow stories of adventure in search of lost soul and bodies.
You become 'Ireth' and venture out looking for her lost memories. She explores the forests, cathedrals, and snowy villages of the border area, and battles enemies by using various techniques against bandits, fanatics, demonized humans and mutant animals. 'Ireth' discovers secrets all over the continent to find her soul with shattered sword 'Bias'.
As you hack-and-slash your way across town - either solo or with a friend in local co-op - you'll gain new skills, chow down on power-ups, wield an assortment of weapons, and unleash an arsenal of combos, throws, and special combat moves for both fighting enemies and platforming challenges
Key Features
Classic side-scrolling action, with all the modern trimmings.
Tightly tuned 2D controls. Dodge, dash, and slash your way through over 24 enemies and 6 epic bosses. Face ferocious beasts and vanquish ancient knights on your quest through the lost kingdom.
Five large city regions to fight through, complete with shops and side quests.
An expansive world filled with unique dungeons, quests, and secrets.
All in classic hand-painted original 2D drawings.

title: Jar Head Cauldron
description:
게임 정보
Defeat enemies with enchanted weapons crafted using your cauldron featuring “in world crafting” to upgrade items, weapons and keys to help you save all 13 members of your coven. As you progress you will unlock the secrets of the other side. Find and harvest required occulted items to complete the necromantic ritual to save your coven.
Completing The Ritual
Find and save your lost covens jared heads from a cult of black magic users
Gather required body parts from fallen enemies to build your covens new bodies 
Collect and craft the skulls required to initiate the ritual
Proform the ritual and protect your coven as they pass back through to our world
Gameplay Features and Modes
"American Magic" Crafting tree will include 17th century to early 20th century gunpowder weapons
"Occult" Crafting tree will only include primitive gunpowder weapons a focus on melee and magic. 
Features
In depth in world crafting with the use of the cauldron
Fight waves of enemies and crawl dungeons
Action is broken up with crafting, collecting and looting, puzzles and exploration at your own risk.
Occulted crafting tree that must be discovered through trial and error
Controls FPS, Drag and drop items, Craft, Loot

title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2
description:
게임 정보
◆내용 설명
"인연"의 칼날로 악귀를 멸하라!
카마도 탄지로의 전투가 가정용 게임으로 다시 막을 올린다―――

【솔로 플레이 모드 -히노카미 혈풍담-: 애니메이션 '귀멸의 칼날' 세 편의 이야기를 체험!】
카마도 탄지로가 걸어온 이야기를 게임으로 체험하자.
TV 애니메이션 '귀멸의 칼날' 에서 '환락의 거리편', '도공 마을편', '합동 강화 훈련편' 의 에피소드를 수록!
탄지로와 동료들의 앞을 가로막는 상현 혈귀들에 맞서 함께 싸우자!

【버서스 모드 -대전-: 주, 집결】
귀살대 최고 계급인 검사 '주' 9명을 포함해 40명 이상의 캐릭터가 참전!
전작에 이어 '합체 오의'와 '장비'라는 신규 요소도 추가!
온라인 대전과 오프라인 대전을 통해 새로운 경지에 도달하자!

title: Slimes & Dusters TO
description:
게임 정보
슬라임의 행성은 더스터가 이곳에 오기 전까지 조용했습니다. 외계에서 온 외계인들이 꽃이 만발한 들판을 사막으로, 잔잔한 바람을 모래 폭풍으로, 식물을 먼지로 만들어 버렸습니다. 슬라임을 모아 침략자들과 전투를 벌이세요. 이 행성을 다시 꽃 피우는 것은 여러분에게 달려 있습니다!
주요 특징

공장을 사용하여 슬라임 분대를 만들어 전투에 투입하세요.
떨어진 슬라임 젤을 모아 재사용하세요
공격 사이에 자신의 공장과 슬라임을 개선하세요
전투 사이에 새로운 업그레이드 연구
각 유형의 슬라임은 특별하며 적을 극복하기위한 현명한 전략을 계획하십시오

title: Phantom Demon Siege
description:
게임 정보
After the Phantom Demon Siege, humanity will not only face hordes of demons, but will also attempt to rebuild devastated areas and reclaim lost territories. To this end, the "Order of the Hunters" has formed special rapid response teams known as Shadow Squads. These teams are tasked with carrying out high-risk missions to ensure humanity's survival and slow the demonic expansion.
You and your commando are part of these forces. Each mission takes you to locations infested with supernatural creatures, where you must complete crucial objectives such as recovering artifacts, rescuing survivors, destroying demonic structures, and securing critical areas.
As you complete these tasks, you discover that more sinister forces are manipulating events in order to keep the portals open. Now, each mission is not only about survival, but also about finding clues that can unravel a conspiracy that threatens humanity's fragile resistance.

title: GRADIUS ORIGINS
description:
게임 정보
가정용 게임기로 처음 이식되는 환상의 '그라디우스 III AM 쇼 버전'을 포함하여, 총 7개 타이틀의 18개 버전 아케이드 타이틀 수록
어디서든 할 수 있는 저장과 되돌리기, 무적 모드 등 알찬 지원 기능과 함께, 부활 지점 및 플레이 회차, 파워 업 상태 등을 설정해 연습할 수 있는 트레이닝 모드, 각종 BGM과 귀중한 자료 이미지가 수록된 라이브러리 기능도 구현

1. 샐러맨더 III

2. 그라디우스
일본 ROM판 / 일본 버블 시스템판 / 북미판 (NEMESIS) / 유럽판 (NEMESIS) / 북미 시제품판 (NEMESIS)

3. 샐러맨더
일본판 / 북미판 (라이프 포스)

4. 라이프 포스
일본판

5. 그라디우스 II -GOFER의 야망-
일본 전기판 / 일본 중기판 / 일본 후기판 / 북미판 (VULCAN VENTURE)

6. 그라디우스 III -전설에서 신화로-
일본 OLD판 / 일본 NEW판 / 아시아판 / 일본 AM 쇼판

7. 샐러맨더2
일본판

■ 알찬 지원 기능, 편의 기능, 신규 모드

빠른 저장 / 빠른 불러오기
게임 플레이 중 언제든지 저장/불러오기 가능

되돌리기
언제 어디서든 되돌리기로 다시 시작할 수 있는 편의 기능

이지 모드
플레이어 전투기의 피격 판정 범위가 작아 한결 편하게 진행할 수 있는 플레이 모드입니다.

무적 모드
적의 공격을 맞아도 플레이어 전투기를 잃지 않으며, 잃은 횟수만 기록되는 플레이 모드입니다.

트레이닝 모드
부활 지점 및 플레이 회차, 파워 업 상태 등을 설정해 게임을 연습할 수 있는 플레이 모드입니다.
※특정 게임 버전에서만 플레이할 수 있습니다.

온라인 랭킹
게임 오버 후, 획득한 스코어를 리더 보드에 등록
상위 랭킹에 들면 스코어 등록과 함께 리플레이 업로드

사운드 갤러리
각 타이틀의 오리지널 사운드트랙 및 기존 발매 CD에 수록된 어레인지 악곡 등 감상 가능

비주얼 갤러리
당시의 사용 설명서, 개발 자료 등 열람 가능

그라디우스 도감
각 오리진 타이틀의 적 캐릭터와 스코어 확인 가능


그 외 각 게임 설정 화면에서 다양한 설정(기판의 DIP 스위치, 화면 필터, 당시의 버그 재현 등) 변경 가능

title: King's Blade
description:
게임 정보


King's Blade - classic Beat'em up, inspired by the Conan the Barbarian universe and games like Golden Axe and Streets of Rage. Take on the role of a warrior of an elite royal squad and defeat the bloodthirsty Barganian Empire.

title: Eclipse : Special Forces
description:
게임 정보
데모 플레이 가능! (한국어/English/繁體中文/日本語)
모든 남자가 사라졌다. 새로운 세상의 시작이었다.
오로지 여성만이 존재하는 포스트 아포칼립스에서 펼쳐지는 광대한 서사.
유일신 La의 축복 아래, 남성이 사라진 후 1500년.
완전한 평화 속에서, 오직 ‘이능력’을 지닌 자들만이 입대할 수 있는 특수부대 ‘이클립스’가 세계의 질서를 지켜왔다.

title: Hellver
description:
게임 정보
Delve into the depths of hell and slay hordes of enemies on your way down through a dark well in this retro inspired rogue-lite FPS
Dynamic fast paced combat with tight movement and satisfying guns
Gun and character skill upgrades, variety of guns, range of challenging hellish enemies
Atmospherically dark levels with aggressive difficulty curve
Rich visual style with captivating enemy design
Contextual music matching hardcore combat and softer recovery sections
Stat and performance reports per run down the well

title: Purrfect Galaxies
description:
게임 정보
Purrfect Galaxies는 빠른 속도의 고양이 모험과 간단한 자원 관리 게임입니다. 고전적인 Hamurabi 스타일로, 행성 미야우 별을 지배하고, 당신의 계속 성장하는 요구가 많은 고양이 집단을 10개의 도전적인 태양 주기를 통해 유지해야 합니다. 당신은 성공적으로 당신의 아늑한 장소로 돌아갈 수 있을까요, 아니면 집어삼키는 굶주림이 당신의 통치를 끝낼까요?

■ 추천 대상:
⇒ 텍스트 기반의 전략 게임과 간단한 자원 관리를 좋아하는 사람
⇒ 짧고 발전하는 스토리가 있는 게임을 즐기는 사람
⇒ 고양이와 과학 소설을 사랑하는 사람 :3

■ “나에게 맞지 않는다”는 것을 피하기 위한 추가 정보: 만약 장기적인 게임 경험을 찾고 있다면, 이 게임은 적합하지 않을 수 있습니다. 이 게임은 기복이 있는 짧은 여정을 제공합니다... ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

■ 게임 컨트롤 및 기술 사양: Purrfect Galaxies는 마우스와 키보드로 쉽게 플레이할 수 있으며, 낮은 사양의 컴퓨터에서도 원활하게 실행됩니다. 이 게임은 Python의 Kivy로 프로그래밍되었으며, AI 생성 예술을 비주얼 요소로 사용합니다.

title: Swim Meet
description:
게임 정보
It's time to train...

Or Fall...
In Love!

Manage your time between work, training and hanging out so you can reach your goal of winning the Swim Meet in three months time and secure your place in the local professional swimming team! But don't forget to have lots of fun along the way...

After returning to Paradise Cove you find that so many things have changed, your old team has a new owner and with it new requirements of their swimmers, leading to you needing to prove yourself once more before you can re-join your old friends. Fortunately the local resort has some amazing facilities for you to train at... And an array of other swimmers to train alongside in whatever way you deem fit.
You will be able to choose what you do each day of the game whether you wish to explore, train, work or shop in town to get items to help your training or gifts for the many women you meet along the way. Allowing you to choose your own path through the game and your own schedule based on what YOU want to achieve!

You gain three months to train your stats and prepare before the big Swim Meet competition occurs and your future will be decided. Will you succeed in rejoining the team or find a new motivation with one of the women you meet along the way?

title: Rescue Heli RH407
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a retro-styled, arcade-inspired 2.5D helicopter game! This isn’t a serious flight simulator—instead, it features simplified physics and easy controls for pure, unfiltered fun. The retro vibe isn’t just about the minimalist visuals; it’s about straightforward, enjoyable gameplay. Remember those classic pick-up-and-play games with no complex storylines, just pure gaming joy? If so, you’ll love Rescue Heli RH407! And if you enjoy a challenge, you’ll also find puzzles to solve along the way—retro with a modern twist.
PICKING UP PEOPLE IS JUST THE BEGINNING
Once you’ve picked up your passengers, the real challenge begins. You’ll need to navigate carefully and deliver them safely to the heliport. Only after successfully landing will your score increase, allowing you to make progress toward your goal.
BEWARE OF OBSTACLES
Test your skills by navigating through increasingly tricky obstacles. With limited fuel, you’ll need to think fast and act even faster to avoid crashing and reach your destination in time!
FLIGHT SAFELY
Air acrobatics might seem fun, but don’t forget your passengers are not strapped in! Too much wild maneuvering could send them flying out of the helicopter. Also, remember that landing softly is just as important as flying—crashing to the ground might not only endanger the passengers but could lead to serious injuries or even death.

title: Crime Simulator
description:
게임 정보
감옥에 갇혔지만, 정체불명의 후원자가 보석금을 대신 내주었습니다. 이제 그들은 돈을 돌려받길 원하며, 그것도 빠르게 말이죠. 당신에게 남은 유일한 선택지는 바로 범죄를 저지르는 것입니다. 집에 침입하고, 귀중품을 훔치고, 위험한 작업을 혼자서 또는 최대 세 명의 친구와 함께 수행하세요. 제한 시간이 끝나기 전에 빚을 갚을 수 있을까요?
장소 & 미션
세 개의 독특한 지역을 탐험하세요. 각 지역에는 다양한 목표, 보안 시스템, 그리고 엄청난 양의 전리품이 가득합니다. 첨단 기술이 가득한 대저택을 몰래 이동하거나, 어두운 뒷골목에서 난투극을 벌이든, 모든 장소가 새로운 도전과 숨겨진 보상을 제공합니다.
싱글 또는 4인 협동 플레이
혼자서 모든 일을 해낼 수도 있고, 4인 협동 모드에서 친구들과 힘을 합칠 수도 있습니다. 침입을 계획하고, 전리품을 나누고, 서로의 뒤를 봐주거나, 배신을 선택할 수도 있습니다. 모든 선택은 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
전문 도구
완벽한 강도는 적절한 장비에서 시작됩니다. 잠금 해제 도구를 사용하면 유령처럼 잠긴 문을 통과할 수 있으며, 석궁은 조용히 경비를 제거하거나 감시 카메라를 비활성화할 수 있습니다. 좀 더 은밀한 접근 방식을 원한다면, 수면 가스를 환기구에 주입해 소리 없이 건물 전체를 마비시킬 수도 있습니다. 하지만 때로는 은밀함이 통하지 않을 때도 있죠. 상황이 꼬이면, 가 문제를 해결해 줄 것입니다.

title: Overcome Your Fears
description:
게임 정보
Overcome Your Fears is a psychological atmospheric horror game that immerses you in a world of the unknown.
In this game you are exploring the story of 19-year-old Steve Jackson, who takes a job house-sitting for friends while they are on vacation. What starts as a simple favor quickly turns into a chilling experience as unsettling events unfold in the quiet town. Little does Steve know, that these days will reveal dark secrets, and he must make choices that will change everything.
The Gameplay
This game primarily features a first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration and interaction mechanics.
                         Key Features
Atmospheric environment and realistic graphics.
Psychological horror elements with unexpected twists.
VHS film aesthetic.
Interactive dialogues with NPCs.
Player voice activity

title: BRISTER
description:
게임 정보
Beat your friends in Brister!
A fast paced combination of the classic Pong and Turf War.

Dominate the field by conquering your opponents squares and gain the upper hand!

Play the classic Pong but with a twist! Hit the opponents squares with your ball to paint them in your own color. But be careful, your opponent will do the same. The player with more squares in the end wins the match!

Play against your friends in local multiplayer or use Steam Remote Play to play across the world!
Unlock new characters with abilities and different maps.

Don't just dominate the field, but bombard your enemy with special attacks, gaining the upper hand and ensuring victory or activate defensive powerups that may help you turn the battle, you thought you already lost, making an epic comeback. Because no round is over until the buzzer rings so make every single second count.

Let the chaos unfold on the battlefield!

title: Gothic Clicker
description:
게임 정보
고딕 클리커는 캐릭터와 전투 스타일을 커스터마이징할 수 있는 다양한 가능성이 있는 ARPG 클리커입니다.
강령술사 조타니아를 도와 혼돈의 뼈를 모아 엘더라스 왕국을 붉은 안개에서 구하세요.
캐릭터
캐릭터 개발에 대한 색다른 접근 방식으로 5개의 전투와 5개의 제작 분야가 있으며, 각 분야마다 유연한 특전 시스템이 여러분을 기다립니다.
차가운 무기든 마법이든, 사냥이든 약초이든, 아니면 이 모든 것을 한꺼번에 할 수도 있습니다 - 여러분에게 달려 있습니다!
인벤토리 및 제작
광물로 무기를 업그레이드하고, 물약을 끓이고, 반지, 갑옷, 부적을 착용하세요. 한 번에 10개의 반지를 착용할 수 있으며, 반지를 합쳐서 힘의 반지가 될 수 있습니다.
환생과 아스트랄
당신의 영혼은 아스트랄 상태에 있습니다. 살아 있지는 않지만 죽은 것도 아닙니다.
다시 태어나면서 영혼을 강화하고 더 강해지세요. 연금술사와 각성한 자의 비밀 인장은 파티의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있으며, 아스트랄로 들어가면 영혼의 강력한 실에 접근하여 광대한 우주의 의도를 드러낼 수 있습니다.
길드
고대 왕국 엘더라스에는 다양한 전투 및 제작 길드가 번성하고 있습니다. 길드에 자신의 가치를 증명하면 최고급 방어구를 장착할 수 있으며, 길드 마스터가 새로운 특전을 훈련시켜 줍니다.
무기
철학자의 돌과 골드의 힘으로 전투 중에 무기, 마법 룬 등을 직접 업그레이드할 수 있습니다.
각 무기에는 고유한 기술 세트가 있으며, 마음대로 펌핑하고 조합할 수도 있습니다.
사운드트랙
스타니슬라프 벨랴예프가 작곡한 우울한 샤머니즘 음악이 고딕 클리커의 암울한 세계의 퇴폐와 깊이를 강조합니다.

title: Gohan Quest
description:
게임 정보
Gohan Quest is a humorous adventure RPG that takes place in modern Eastern Europe.
Key features
Authentic and unique atmosphere of typical russian town.
Anime girls VS harsh reality!
Gotta find them all!
Beat the shit out of criminals, bums, stoners, rabid stray animals, etc.
Equip baseball bats, water pistols, soup ladles, laser pointers, fly swatters, valenoks, gas masks, and stuff.
Heal with kebabs, kefir, kvass, ice cream and sunflower seeds.
Advanced turn-based battle system
Non-linear world exploration
7-10 hours of gameplay

Basically, Gohan Quest is a tribute to Earthbound, Undertale and other JRPG classics, but with its own style, plot and humor.

title: Space Adventure Cobra - The Awakening
description:
게임 정보
전설적인 모험가의 개성 넘치는 능력으로 무장하여 박진감 넘치는 액션 플랫폼 게임 속으로 빠져드세요

우주 해적 코브라가 되어 멋진 액션 플랫폼 세계를 탐험하세요. 영원한 파트너, 레이디 아머로이드와 함께 코브라의 전매특허 무기 사이코건으로 온 우주를 위기에 빠트릴지도 모를 수수께끼를 해결하세요.

행성을 넘나들며 무시무시한 우주 해적 길드가 쫓는 엄청난 보물과 운명이 얽힌 정체불명의 세 자매를 구하세요.

코브라의 다양한 무기와 도구를 영리하게 사용해 적을 물리치고 온갖 방해물과 함정으로 가득한 레벨을 헤쳐나가세요. 날고 긴다 하는 우주 해적에게도 쉽지 않은 도전이 될 것입니다.

액션과 플랫폼 장르의 짜릿한 만남

여러분의 게임 실력을 극한으로 밀어붙이는 함정과 덫으로 가득한 레벨이 잔뜩 준비되어 있습니다. 다양한 행성을 오가며 쉴 새 없이 달리고, 점프하고, 기어오르세요.
코브라의 초인적 능력을 활용해 적들을 무찌르세요. 성공을 위해서는 수단과 방법을 가려서는 안 됩니다.
다양한 장비와 무기
시가, 그래플링 훅 등 애니메이션을 통해 익히 알려진 도구들은 물론, 사이코건, 콜트 파이썬 77 등 코브라의 전매특허 무기를 다채롭게 활용해 적들을 쓰러트리세요. 여러분의 앞을 가로막는 강력한 보스들을 처치하기 위해서는 모든 장비를 활용해야 합니다.

싱글 및 멀티플레이어 모드

세 가지 난이도로 스토리 모드를 플레이하세요. 액션 플랫폼 장르에 익숙한 플레이어는 높은 난이도에서 실력을 시험해 볼 수 있으며, 그렇지 않은 플레이어는 낮은 난이도에서 스토리 위주의 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다. 2인 협동 모드에서 적을 피해 이리저리 도망 다녀 보세요.

짜릿한 SF 세계

카리스마 넘치는 강력한 영웅이 되어 멋진 스페이스 오페라 세계를 탐험하세요. 이 장대한 여정에서, 여러분은 로열 자매를 비롯해 코브라의 무시무시한 숙적인 크리스털 보위와 같은 개성 넘치는 인물들과 마주하게 될 것입니다.


Space Adventure Cobra – The Awakening은 우주 해적 코브라를 최신 플랫폼으로 이식한 최초의 게임입니다. 동명 인기 애니메이션 시리즈의 12편까지의 내용을 다루고 있으며, 게임에서도 패기와 유머가 넘치는 원작의 감성을 고스란히 즐길 수 있습니다.

title: STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar
description:
게임 정보
Zephyr Town’s bazaar was once one of the grandest in the world, drawing customers and peddlers from all four corners of the globe. These days, though, the bazaar has more tumbleweeds than customers. It’s up to you to turn its fortunes around! Raise animals, harvest crops, craft rare delicacies, then sell your wares at your very own stall in the bazaar. As the bazaar business grows, new goods and services will arrive, which you can use to improve your farm. Help return prosperity to the bazaar, and Zephyr Town will thrive once again!
Inspired by the classic handheld title, the new STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar builds up and improves on the original in every conceivable way. The world is bigger and more alive than ever thanks to incredible new visuals, new characters, expanded story, and full character voice work in story events—a series first. Take advantage of Zephyr Town’s unique weather, using the wind to make travel and farm tasks a breeze! The winds of change are coming to deliver your new life in STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar.
Cozy Living Reaches New Heights
The magnificent beauty of Zephyr Town shines with gorgeous graphics while richly voiced story carries the player on a rewarding journey of farming, friendship, and renewal.
Take the Leap
Harness the power of the wind! Use windmills to create new products to sell, and effortlessly travel across the town on your glider. Use new jumping skills on your farm, or when exploring the town. You never know what you’ll find!
Ring the Bell and Sell, Sell, Sell
Your farm's produce and goods take on additional importance as the heart of your business at the lively weekly bazaar. Customize your stall and take charge of your sales to build up buzz and power up profits.
A Beautifully Cozy Life
Enjoy a rich life amongst a colorful community of characters, from friendly townsfolk to magical Nature Sprites. Build yourself a home, grow relationships, and even find love and start a family.

title: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER
description:
게임 정보
원작의 핵심은 그대로, 몰입 체험이 진화를 이룬다.
2004년 발매된 "METAL GEAR SOLID 3: SNAKE EATER"를 원작으로 한 리메이크 작품.
원작의 스토리와 세계관은 그대로 유지되었으며, 최신 그래픽과 입체적인 사운드 표현으로 정글에서 펼쳐지는 궁극의 서바이벌 스텔스 액션을 즐길 수 있다.

모든 것의 발단이 된 냉전 하의 위기
냉전의 시대. Naked Snake, 훗날 "Big Boss"로 알려질 그는 과학자 Sokolov의 망명을 돕기 위해 소련으로 향한다. 하지만 Snake의 스승이자 특수 부대의 어머니로 불리던 군인 "The Boss"의 배신으로 임무는 실패, Sokolov는 GRU의 Volgin 대령의 손에 끌려가고 만다.
1주일 후, Snake는 Sokolov의 구출과 더 보스 암살 명령을 받고 또 다시 소련으로 떠난다.
끊임없이 변화하는 "시대(SENSE)"속에서, 전설의 기점이 되는 임무가 결행된다.

오리지널 매력 그대로 진화
스토리, 캐릭터, 보이스, 게임 플레이, 음악 등 원작이 가진 매력은 그대로, 최신 하드웨어에 맞춘 진화를 이룬 리메이크 작품. 세계 구석구석을 다시 만들어 모든 컷 장면에 새로운 생명이 불어넣어졌다.


미려한 그래픽으로 그려지는 세계
Unreal Engene 5를 채용해 광대한 스테이지를 최첨단 기술로 표현. 그 압권적인 그래픽으로 정글, 숲, 늪지대의 무성한 생태계도 고밀도의 디테일로 그려져 있다. 캐릭터도 주름이나 모공, 안구와 홍채와 같은 미세한 디테일을 포함시켜 리얼리티가 넘치는 표정을 구현하고 있다.



전투 피해 묘사가 진화하면서 옷의 찢김, 멍, 탄흔이 실시간으로 Snake의 몸에 표현된다. 옷은 갈아입어 변경을 할 수 있지만, 몸에 난 상처는 계쏙 남게 된다. 플레이어 개개인의 게임 플레이에 따라 Snake의 모습이 다양하게 변한다.



당시와 같은 플레이 감각으로 즐길 수 있는 오리지널 조작 방법과 더불어 새로운 게임에 익숙해진 세대를 위한 플레이 스타일도 채용. 심플하고 이해하기 쉬운 조작성으로 플레이에 대한 집중력을 높여 극한 환경에서의 짜릿한 서바이벌 체험을 즐길 수 있으며, 당시와 같은 플레이 감각으로 즐길 수 있는 플레이 스타일도 선택이 가능.
・SNAKE VS MONKEY
이 모드에서는 Snake 역할을 하며, 각 단계에서 도망치는 탈출한 유인원들을 모두 모으자!


And more…

※일부 컨텐츠는 인터넷에 접속한 후 소프트웨어 업데이트를 통해 플레이할 수 있습니다.

※본 제품 외에도 「Digital Deluxe Edition」이 따로 있습니다. 중복 구매에 주의하시기 바랍니다.
autokwd: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER

title: The Knightling
description:
게임 정보
Sir Lionstone, the most powerful knight and protector of the great city of Clesseia, hasn’t returned from his latest quest. As Sir Lionstone’s trusted knightling, it is up to you and the legendary shield he left behind to become the hero the people need and find Lionstone before lurking threats endanger the realm. Explore the many regions and secrets of the lands of Clesseia, fend off bandits and monsters, and uncover the truth of the shield’s unparalleled power and the realm’s illustrious past.

All Heroes Start Small
Play as the Knightling, a knight-in-training whose loyalty and determination sets them off on a grand adventure to find their knight. With solely a shield in hand, you’ll utilize and upgrade your training and arsenal of abilities to overcome obstacles, help citizens and prove that you’re worthy of knighthood.



The Best Offense Is a Good Defense
Left with just Sir Lionstone’s shield, which contains a mysterious element called Callyrium, it is up to the Knightling to harness its power and become the next legendary hero. Leverage the shields natural defensive power to block, parry, and create ideal openings, then leverage big attacks and combos to finish off foes.



Slide Into Adventure
Set off on your adventure across multiple regions of Clesseia with the power of your shield to help you along! Traverse and platform to various areas to earn valuable praise used in upgrades, or use the shield’s various movement abilities to make getting around easier. Though probably beneath a legendary shield’s reputation, no one is stopping you from sliding all across the land!

title: Highway Builder
description:
게임 정보


Nowadays, one of the most important tasks in the field of infrastructure planning and construction is to create new highways that will connect people living far away from each other. In Highway Builder you will take control of a construction team that specializes in building highways, freeways or even complex and dangerous mountain roads. Together with your team, you will start your career by repairing local national roads to become popular and take orders all over the world. Your team will experience many adventures while travelling to the four corners of the world.

Highway Builder combines elements of a construction worker simulation and company management. After accepting the tasks, you will decide which machines and tools will be necessary during the construction, select the right professionals to the team and send them to the field. Depending on the mission you will need a completely different set of machines, equipment and specialists! Then, during the construction phase, you will take control over individual members of the construction team to perform specific tasks by yourself. Remember that each client expects high quality from you and allocates a specific budget to complete the work. Prove to him that it is possible to do the job well, fast and to not exceed the budget! After all, you are the professionals.

During the construction phase you will sit at the helm of various construction machines, from excavators and tippers to advanced soil stabilization machines, asphalt milling machines and many others. The Highway Builder offers a huge variety of real machines and tools to work with, and as your business grows, you'll get access to even more equipment to broaden your team's capabilities, allowing you to take on more and more complex tasks. Manage your orders skillfully, take care of your tools and work machines, appreciate your employees, and your company will gain global fame in no time at all!

MAIN FEATURES:
- Manage a construction company, take care of finances and make sure the machines are in good condition
- Choose the right tools and specialists for the job
- Go out into the field and take on the role of the workers
- Use a huge number of real construction machines and tools
- Grow your business to achieve global fame!

title: SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance
description:
게임 정보
【디지털 디럭스 에디션 한정 예약 특전】
・최대 3일(72시간) 얼리 액세스

【예약 특전】
・조 무사시 추가 의상 '오리지널 아케이드 의상' (게임 내 아이템)
・추가 부적 '축복' (게임 내 아이템)
※2025년 8월 29일 12:59(KST)까지 예약 구매 한 경우 본 특전이 동봉됩니다.
■게임 설명
히트작 「베어너클 4」의 개발 스튜디오가 선사하는 새로운 닌자 액션 게임. 복수심에 불타는 한 시노비의 서사가 핸드 드로잉 터치의 아트 스타일로 섬세하고 선명하게 그려진다.
■줄거리
시노비의 정점에 이른 닌자 '조 무사시'는 전소된 마을과 돌로 변한 동료들을 눈앞에서 목격하고 복수의 여정에 나선다. 거대한 악에 맞서 동료들의 원수를 갚기 위해서…
■시노비의 기술을 갈고닦아라
검과 쿠나이, 인술, 인법 그리고 조 무사시의 능력을 확장시키는 부적을 자유롭게 사용하여 적을 쓰러뜨려라. 상황에 따라 다양한 기술을 선택하고 자신만의 배틀 스타일로 콤보를 펼치자. 매끄럽고 약동감 있는 애니메이션과 속도감 넘치는 액션이 융합하여 유일무이한 통쾌함을 맛볼 수 있다.

군사 기지부터 작열하는 사막까지, 길을 떠난 조 무사시 앞에 펼쳐지는 각양각색의 스테이지. 수작업으로 밀도 있게 표현된 세계가 그의 여로를 물들인다.
또한, 도중에는 다양한 인술을 구사하여 눈앞의 난관을 극복하고 숨겨진 신규 루트를 발견하는 등, 만족스러운 플랫폼 액션도 즐길 수 있다.



※내용 및 사양은 예고 없이 변경될 수 있습니다.
autokwd: SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance,SHINOBI 복수의 참격

title: WASTED Bloodline
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to step into the raw and ruthless world of WASTED Bloodline, the new multiplayer video game that redefines the concept of pure adrenaline?
Developed with the incredible power of Unreal Engine 5.5, the most advanced graphics engine of the moment, the game offers an uncompromising experience and delivers a breathtaking visual spectacle where every detail, from the subtlest shadows to the conflict-ravaged landscapes, comes to life on screen.
WASTED Bloodline is a game that combines the best of competitive multiplayer and offline experiences, making it perfect for every type of player.
The game features multiple modes:
FREE FOR ALL
A competitive multiplayer mode where you can challenge your friends or others from around the world in a no-rules battle where every player fights for themselves.
SKIRMISH
Brutal battles and intense tactical skirmishes where every decision can mean the difference between victory and defeat. Cooperation and strategy are key to success. 
DOMINATION
In this game mode, territorial control is everything and will determine your victory or defeat. Every meter gained is a battle, every area lost is an open wound. Challenge your opponents in an epic fight to control the key areas of the map. 
TEAM DEATHMATCH
Face off against the opposing team in a blood-soaked showdown where only one simple rule applies: The team that stays standing wins. 
GUN GAME
Does your opponent have better weapons than you? Take them out and claim their gear. No prisoners are taken here, and every kill allows you to progress in your arsenal. 
ZOMBIE MODE
Is your world overrun by ferocious zombies hungry for fresh flesh? Form a squad, gather your courage, and take on the enemy hordes in a no-holds-barred battle. Every street, building, and corner hides danger, and every zombie defeated brings you closer to freedom.

title: The Tale of Relm
description:
게임 정보
The Tale of Relm is a captivating, story-rich JRPG that combines classic turn-based mechanics with strategic depth, offering players an immersive experience set in a richly detailed, handcrafted world. As you journey through diverse landscapes, you'll uncover hidden secrets and solve intricate puzzles reminiscent of early Zelda games.

At the heart of the game lies a compelling story that unfolds through the experiences of 10 unique playable characters, each with their own backstory, abilities, and strengths. Expressive, hand-drawn character busts bring these characters to life, adding emotional depth and making the dialogue more immersive.

The Tale of Relm's strategic combat system emphasizes careful planning and rewards you for discovering enemy weaknesses and breaking their shields before delivering the final blow. With over 200 unique enemies, each with distinct behaviors and strategies, every fight presents a new challenge. Unlike some traditional JRPGs, there are no random encounters; enemies are visible on the map, allowing you to choose when and how to engage.

As you explore the game’s world, you’ll find yourself drawn into its story through interactions with villagers, exploration of its villages, and the mysteries that lie hidden within its landscapes. Shops offer weapons and armor, each with its own strengths and weaknesses, while random villagers may provide useful tips or hints, further enriching the narrative experience.

The game also offers a flexible skill acquisition system, allowing you to customize your characters by obtaining skills in any order through a job point system. This flexibility enables unique and varied builds, giving you control over how your characters evolve throughout the game.

Strategic boss battles are another highlight, with each boss having a perfect strategy waiting to be uncovered. Success in these battles requires careful observation, tactical thinking, and a deep understanding of the game's mechanics, all within the context of its unfolding story.

Embark on an epic, story-rich journey filled with strategy, exploration, and discovery in The Tale of Relm, where every decision shapes your adventure and the narrative pulls you deeper into its world.

title: The Uncalled
description:
게임 정보
The Uncalled is about a young romantic shepherd who is not called to arms for the war against demons and monsters in the north of the territory, considering that he was unable to fight. However, witless enough, the enemy has already preferred the longer path and flocked around the town in the south, using the caves, lakes, ruins, dungeons under the mountains and swampy areas. Our protagonist is left alone with women, children, and animals to protect against the monsters and with lots of pain of being belittled by men of the locale as well as some young girls including his beloved one.
Game Concept: The Unlikely Hero
Premise:
Our protagonist is a seemingly insignificant character, often overlooked and underestimated. They might be physically frail, socially awkward, or possess a unique weakness that sets them apart from the norm. However, beneath this exterior lies a hidden potential, a spark of courage, and a determination to overcome their limitations.
Gameplay:
Incremental Growth: The character's progression is gradual and satisfying. As they overcome challenges and face adversity, they develop new skills, enhance their abilities, and gradually become a formidable force.
Character Customization: Players can choose from a variety of backstories, weaknesses, and starting attributes, allowing for a personalized experience.
Skill Tree: A deep and engaging skill tree system enables players to tailor their character's growth to their preferred playstyle.
Equipment and Items: A diverse array of equipment and items can be collected and upgraded to enhance the character's abilities and appearance.
Companion System: The protagonist can form bonds with a variety of companions, each with their own unique skills and personalities, providing both emotional support and combat assistance.
Challenging Combat: The combat system should be challenging but rewarding, emphasizing strategic thinking and resource management.
Storyline:
The story can revolve around a quest to save the world from a powerful threat, or a personal journey of self-discovery and redemption. The character's initial weakness can serve as a driving force, motivating them to overcome their limitations and prove themselves worthy of the challenge.

title: Dungeon Dot Ruby
description:
게임 정보
Delve into the Master Dungeon as you explore the unyielding tunnels from a top-down view or hop and bop through expansive caverns in 2d-sidescrolling action! Rest assured, intense battles and big discoveries are to be found wherever you are in this retro-style adventure!

Welcome to Dungeon Dot Ruby! Join Dot or Dotti on a charming quest throughout the Master Dungeon to save their friend Tess; and maybe even more! Battle tons of creepy critters! Embark on rescue missions! Find magical artifacts that can aid you on your expedition! In this big cave adventure, you explore and fight YOUR way!

title: Steal It
description:
게임 정보
Steal It
Steal It is an online multiplayer game 🎮 where it depends on who has the most coins 🪙 at the end of a round.
Coins can either be obtained as rewards by completing tasks ✅ or by stealing them from other players 🕵️‍♂️.
The game has two game modes: a team mode 🤝 and a free-for-all mode 💥.
In team mode, there are two teams. One team tries to get coins by completing tasks 🧩 while the other tries to steal them undetected 😈.
The players have the opportunity to track down thieves 🧐 and lock them up in prison 🚔.
In the free-for-all mode, everyone is on their own 🏃‍♂️. At certain time intervals ⏳, the abilities you can use will change 🔄. You can either steal 🕶️ or perform tasks 🛠️.
Shadow-Heist
Shadow-Heist is a team-based mode where two sides face off—Owners and Thieves.Owners must complete tasks around the map to collect coins 💰, while the Thieves blend in with the crowd, trying to steal without getting caught. 🕵️‍♂️🔓
Each team has 3 unique abilities to give them an edge. Owners can use abilities to move faster or place decoy bodies, while Thieves have tools to remain undetected, like a signal jammer or an ability to temporarily disable another player. 🎯🔧
If Owners suspect someone is a Thief, they can call for a vote to send players to jail. 🚨 But they need to be careful—they only have a limited number of votes! Shadow-Heist is a thrilling mix of strategy, deception, and deduction, where every decision counts. 🧠🎭
All-Steal
All Steal is a chaotic and fast-paced mode where it’s every player for themselves! 🏃‍♂️💨 In this free-for-all mode, your goal is to collect as many coins as possible while outsmarting your opponents.
The twist? Players must complete tasks scattered around the map to earn coins, but they can also steal from others 🕵️‍♀️🔓. Timing is everything—knowing when to complete objectives and when to strike is key to dominating the game.

title: Fallen Echo
description:
게임 정보

Fallen Echo

Step into the shoes of humanity's final defender in an epic battle against an alien race that has taken over Earth.

Overview:
In Fallen Echo, you will experience an intense and thrilling fight for survival. As Earth's last standing hero helping the resistance members, you must reclaim our planet from the clutches of a ruthless alien invasion. The fate of humanity rests on your shoulders.








Watch our hero in action!






The aliens have taken over, but humanity is not defeated yet. Gear up and prepare for the ultimate showdown. Are you ready to be the hero Earth needs?

title: Argillite Tamers
description:
게임 정보
Argillite Tamers invites you to the mystical world of Shoeb, where the art of monster crafting meets the cutting edge of generative AI. Shape your destiny by forging one-of-a-kind creatures from enchanted clay, each ready to battle and level up. Embark on an epic journey through a sprawling open world filled with hundreds of quests, rich lore, and endless adventures. Whether you’re teaming up with friends in co-op, challenging rivals in PvP, or exploring the vast unknown, Shoeb is a land of limitless possibilities. Step into the adventure, unleash your creativity, and become a legend in the world of Argillite Tamers!

title: Blueman
description:
게임 정보
평범한 가족 휴가, 소박한 미국 호텔, 아내와 또 한 번 다툰 후 찾아온 팽팽한 침묵. 괜찮아요, 위스키 한 잔이면 분위기를 누그러뜨릴 수 있을 거예요 — 딱 한 잔만요, 긴장을 풀기 위해. 그런데 어느새 하루가 다 지나갔습니다. 저녁이 되었네요. 이상하네요… 모두 어디 갔죠?
위험한 곳
이건 정말 미친 짓이에요! 모든 것이 당신을 죽이려 합니다… 얼마나 시간이 흘렀는지조차 기억나지 않습니다 — 몇 시간, 며칠… 아니면 몇 주? 당신은 여전히 출구를 찾고 있어요. 하지만 애초에 출구라는 게 없었다면요?
정말로 도망칠 수 있다고 믿으십니까?
«이곳은 당신의 한계를 시험하며, 오직 가장 강한 자만이 탈출구를 찾을 수 있다.» — 싸구려 리얼리티 쇼의 홍보 문구 같지만, 여긴 관객도 없고 박수도 없습니다. 오직 침묵과 삐걱대는 바닥소리, 그리고 누군가가 지켜보고 있다는 느낌이 전부죠. 진실은 훨씬 단순합니다. 당신은 여기 갇혀 있고, 결국 여기서 죽게 될 겁니다. 문제는 그게 언제 일어날지… 그리고 누가 (혹은 무엇이) 당신을 가장 먼저 찾아낼지입니다.

title: Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity
description:
게임 정보
Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity (OMUI) is a game about humankind’s suicidal instincts, interweaving grand geopolitical destruction with personal tragedy. It unfolds as a world-ending nightmare: a playful childhood afternoon quickly descends into the trauma of the Iranian Revolution, transforms into a nuclear apocalypse, and concludes with the sudden death of my Uncle Ramin.
Players should expect a deeply personal and tragic experience designed to place you in the shoes and eyes of a child in my own family as the Islamic revolution came and went, followed by the Iran-Iraq War, scattering us in a hundred different directions and uprooting thousands of people from their ancestral land.
Except, in this reality, the nuclear apocalypse comes in its place - and who but Ramin can stop it? You will take on his impossible quest to save his family as the nightmarish reality collides with hallucinations of his real life.
What features should one expect? 
Explore a 1970s style Tehran apartment in a first-person perspective. 
Play with toys, examine photographs, and understand the relationships of an Iranian family.
Watch the Shah on TV, flip the channels, and try to understand your father and brother's political arguments. 
Listen to the Shah's final speech to the Iranian people.
Run for your life and seek shelter.
Control Ramin as a pilot in his battle against nuclear demons and repressed memories. 
Confront Ramin in his final moments. 
Immerse yourself in the primeval destruction of Iran. 
Find your family in the spirit world and prepare for your journey to the Upper Realm.
Coming to peace with what happened was a long and arduous process. Making this game helped me immensely, but sometimes what was meant to be a way to let go grows into a means to hold on. It is with gratitude to the spirits and to history that I present the complete first edition of Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity in time for the tenth anniversary of a world without Ramin.
It's true that the past is the past, but that doesn't mean we can't change how we feel about it.
For the world to heal, we too must mend.

title: Greed Grid
description:
게임 정보
THE PUZZLES
Greed Grid leads you through numerous hand-crafted puzzles, thoroughly exploring innovative twists of familiar mechanics. Each level presents unique challenges and subverts expectations. Every puzzle is a test of your planing and precision skills.
Calculate every move in advance
The malware you control must frequently charge from the power supply of the corporate servers you're hacking, requiring careful planning.
Find the most efficient solution
Your malware will trip the servers' firewall protection if you stay for too long, asking you to find the optimal solution to each puzzle.
Try the speedrunning mode
Go for both speed and efficiency in Greed Grid's speedrunning ironman mode. You will get a timer on all levels and a score at the end.
THE STORY
In a dystopian world, not too far out in the future, and not too far away from our contemporary reality, the world's leading high-tech manufacturer is set to release a revolutionary new product. One unexpected death, however, shines light on the company's insatiable greed and malevolent practices. Our protagonists will reach their breaking point and attempt to resist their omnipresent overlord.
Greed Grid is a cautionary tale of the dangers of oligarchy, but also of the strength and power each of us possess to fight back.

title: Horrible Dream
description:
게임 정보
Horrible Dream is a psychological thriller from the first person. After walking through the dark alleys of an abandoned city, the main character feels that forgotten horrors are beginning to awaken from the depths. While exploring abandoned buildings, he unexpectedly encounters unexplained events and strange phenomena that make him wonder about the nature of reality. In this world of mysterious past and unexplored mysteries, the main character finds himself caught up in a whirlwind of events that go beyond his understanding. His search for the truth leads to the discovery of amazing facts, but also causes incomprehensible reactions from others. It soon becomes obvious that there is something unimaginable lurking around every corner of the city, and the main character realizes that his life will change forever after this journey in a world of riddles and mysteries

title: Isles & Tiles
description:
게임 정보
Raise an island from the sea and build your colony upon it! Isles & Tiles is a turn-based resource management game where you balance expanding your island, growing your colony, and gathering resources against the needs of your settlers and the draw of your cards.
Start with a core deck and unlock new cards, events, trophies, and modifiers as you explore new paths to victory!
Raise an Island – Use the cards you draw to shape the contours of your coastline and build your colony. No two islands will ever be the same, and you can always adjust the terrain to suit your needs.
Manage Your Resources – Start with a small stockpile of basic resources, and build what you require. Need more wood? Raise a forest and place a timberyard, or turn a tile into a mountain and mine it for stone.
Balance Your Needs – The beginning of every colony is easy, but once time starts to pass you'll have to weigh in on the needs and desires of your settlers. What will you choose?
Unlock Legendary Cards – Start with a core deck and unlock over a hundred new and more powerful cards as you play. Collect victory points to unlock new cards or convert your favourite cards into legendary foil versions!

title: Vampire's Castle
description:
게임 정보
Vampire’s Castle is a 4-player online co-op horror game that plunges you into the heart of a cursed fortress, where unimaginable treasures await—if you can survive long enough to collect them. Enter alone or team up with up to three others to explore the castle's dark corridors, avoiding the wrath of Vlad, the vampire who guards it.
The castle is alive with danger, and every step you take could be your last. Vlad stalks the halls in two terrifying forms: as a bat, he relies on his acute hearing to hunt you down. Move too loudly, and he’ll be drawn to your location. As a man, he sees everything in his path, ready to end your hunt for treasure if you’re caught. Use your surroundings carefully, as your survival depends on both silence and strategy.
To escape with your bounty, you'll need to learn how to outsmart Vlad. Some paths can be blocked by opening windows that cast light into the corridors, forcing the vampire to retreat. But be cautious—these windows are not everywhere, and the light can only protect you for so long.
The castle’s layout is as dangerous as it is vast, with some areas louder than others. Certain rooms have creaky floors or footstep-heavy corridors where the sound of your movements will echo. Be sure to check your surroundings and make sure Vlad isn’t nearby before entering these riskier zones.
Time is of the essence, and your goal is simple: collect as much treasure as you can before you find a way out. But remember—staying quiet, staying hidden, and using the environment to your advantage are the keys to survival. Will you escape with your loot, or will you become a permanent resident of the castle?

title: Eridani Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Branded as traitors for revealing a genocidal plot to eliminate a peaceful species for their resources, your pilots Darius, Lana, Abeni, and Pablo must struggle to survive nearly endless waves of attacking ships from The Empire.

Take out what enemies you can as you upgrade your ship's weaponry and defensive capabilities in the hope of surviving long enough to make your escape.

Choose among different pilots and ships with varying abilities and weaponry in this sci-fi themed survivorslike. Evade a variety of enemy ships with different configurations and attack types, including heavily-armed battleships. With enough skill, you can save our heroes from certain doom.

title: To the Eden 末日行者
description:
게임 정보
In a world overrun by zombies, countless survivors hear a broadcast and set out in search of the legendary sanctuary: Eden.
And you are one of them.
But the journey is always full of challenges and dangers.
Various types of zombies stand in your way, yet beyond these known threats, even more unknown dangers await. A gang of ruthless bandits roams the path you must take, robbing everything in their way.
To survive, you must:
Move forward cautiously, making as little noise as possible. They lurk in the darkness.
autokwd: To the Eden 末日行者

title: After Mankind: TD
description:
게임 정보
After Mankind: TD brings a new level of strategy to the Tower Defense genre. Usually, you build solid towers along the way to impede enemy movement, but what if you assembled towers from individual parts? Research technologies, unlock modules, and assemble unique towers!
Control the battlefield

title: Parkour Skyrun
description:
게임 정보
Step into a vibrant and exciting online world where players can run, jump, and explore a variety of colorful and dynamic platforms. Test your skills, challenge others, and discover countless surprises in a game designed to bring joy and laughter to everyone.
Key Features:
Multiplayer Gameplay: Connect with friends or compete against players from around the world in real-time online sessions.
Dynamic Platform Challenges: Navigate through unique and diverse levels filled with exciting obstacles, puzzles, and hidden secrets.
Global Leaderboards: Track your progress and compare your scores with players across all platforms.
Smooth Controls: Enjoy intuitive and responsive controls designed to ensure a seamless gameplay experience.
Vibrant Graphics: Immerse yourself in colorful and beautifully crafted environments that evolve as you play.
Fun for Everyone: Perfect for players of all ages and skill levels, offering a mix of casual fun and competitive challenges.

title: A Totally Realistic Stealth Game
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever wanted to see enemy soldier bodies fly into the stratosphere? Or jump 100ft high across enemy bases as you find the most creative ways to beat levels without being seen? Well, now you can! Flashbang enemies, shoot them into the horizon, throw enemy bodies virtually as far as you like, almost anything is possible.

This game gives you the freedom to complete levels however you choose. Just want to have fun shooting enemies across the map? Great! Want to try your hardest to finish levels as fast as possible? Go for it! There is no "right" way to play this totally realistic first-person shooter.

THROW/DRAG DEAD ENEMIES OVER THE HORIZON


EARN YOUR HIGHEST SCORES TO UNLOCK ABILITIES, NEW MAPS, AND MORE


EXPERIENCE TOTALLY REALISTIC PHYSICS

title: Floatineer
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 바다 위 여정을 시작하여 광활한 바다를 항해하면서 수상 커뮤니티를 돕습니다. 모듈식 건축 블록을 사용하여 다양한 건축물과 주택을 건설합니다. 건설 과정 중에 플레이어는 토네이도, 지진, 뇌우와 같은 자연 재해에 직면하게 되며, 이러한 재해는 건축물에 실제 물리적 영향을 미칩니다. 플레이어는 안정성과 미적 요소 사이에서 균형을 찾아야 하며, 길 위에서 만나는 사람들이 거주할 수 있는 안전하고 아름다운 집을 만들어야 합니다.

또한, 이 게임에는 '화가 모드'가 있어 플레이어가 획득한 색상 팔레트를 사용하여 이미 지어진 건물을 다시 칠할 수 있습니다. 이 모드는 플레이어가 상상력과 창의력을 최대한 발휘하여 각 건축물에 독특하고 개성 있는 스타일을 부여하도록 격려합니다.

title: Interstellar Sentinel 2
description:
게임 정보
Interstellar Sentinel 2 is an action-packed shoot'em up that takes you on a cyberpunk sci-fi journey to PAL Tech world, an Ecumenopolis where the cosmic balance of power is being consumed by Gressle, a cybernitc Weretech line of mercenaries.
An inspired love letter to some of the best side-scrolling games ever made
I grew up playing games like Salamander/Life Force, Gradius, R-Type, Super Aleste, Einhander, Ikaruga, and more. Interstellar Sentinel features tight controls, digital & analog stick (PlayStation & Xbox controllers verified), stylized beautiful art with light anime inspiration, and a rewarding experience that becomes more challenging as your skills grow.

title: Shifting To The Backrooms
description:
게임 정보
Game Description
"Shifting To The Backrooms" is a mix of psychological horror and drama game where the protagonist, Will, grappling with family tragedies, discovers the method of "shifting" enabling him to enter dream liminal worlds and escape from his grim reality. However, the dream turns into a nightmare from which Will cannot wake up.
The game will feature:
More than 15 liminal spaces
Unique and abstract levels never seen before in Backrooms games
Non-Euclidean spaces, time manipulation, and abstract puzzles
An intriguing story about shifting and parallel universes
About the Game
Unlike most Backrooms co-op adventures, our game focuses on a single-player story campaign.
We understand multiplayer is fun (and we plan to add co-op mode post-launch), but we aim to deliver something fresh:
A deep plot with unexpected twists and complex characters.
No clichéd "yellow corridors" — we’ve reimagined liminal spaces. Their potential is limitless.
Story
The core of the game is Will’s personal journey, not the "spaces." Liminality and Backrooms are just the stage.
Will, a 15-year-old, battles family turmoil tied to his father, mother, sister, and stepfather (all revealed in-game). He seeks peace by "shifting" to safe levels, but dreams morph into an inescapable nightmare. Your task: guide Will to wakefulness. Through dreams, you’ll uncover ways to alter reality and secrets that reshape his family’s fate.
Themes explored:
Shifting, astral projections, transcendental travel
Oneirokinesis (Can thought influence reality through dreams?)
Fear of being trapped in the astral plane, a dream, or an alternate reality
The thin line between sleep and reality

title: Breaching Harkon
description:
게임 정보
**Breaching Harkon**은 부드럽고 선명한 픽셀 아트 그래픽이 특징인 탑다운 전술 로그라이크 슈팅 게임입니다. 고위험 미션에 참여하여 엄폐물 활용, 전략적 위치 선정, 다양한 무기를 사용해 적을 능가하고 제압하는 방식을 신중하게 계획하세요. 당신의 행동에 반응하고 전략에 따라 변화하는 역동적이고 세밀한 환경을 탐험하십시오. 사설 군대를 소유한 부패한 억만장자를 처치하는 스릴 넘치는 스토리에 빠져보세요.
게임 플레이!
도전적이고 다양한 레벨 디자인을 돌파하며 적을 처치하세요. 게임을 진행하면서 30개 이상의 고유한 무기를 잠금 해제하고 수집하며, 각 무기는 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞게 완전히 커스터마이징할 수 있습니다. 드론 터릿 배치부터 사망 후 두 번째 기회까지 강력한 업그레이드로 캐릭터를 강화하세요. 마지막 스테이지에서 헬리콥터로 탈출을 확보하고 다음 미션에 대비하세요.

무기 및 장비!
샷건에서 권총, 돌격 소총에 이르기까지 30개 이상의 고유하고 다양한 무기를 사용할 수 있으며, 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 무기를 찾을 수 있습니다. 개머리판에서 소음기에 이르는 다양한 업그레이드로 무기를 강화하세요!

플레이어의 모든 면을 강화하고 당신을 무적의 존재로 만드는 14가지 이상의 업그레이드를 구입하세요.

할시온의 외딴 변경 지역에서 무자비한 억만장자 빅터 하콘은 사설 군대와 첨단 기술을 이용해 땅과 사람들을 착취하고 있습니다. 당신은 저항 조직 뱅가드의 숙련된 요원으로, 하콘을 전복하고 지역을 해방시키기 위해 다양한 환경을 탐험하며 자원과 동맹을 모아야 합니다.

title: Unknot!
description:
게임 정보
Unknot the knot
Untangle the Intricate Web of Knots with Intuitive Puzzle Gameplay & Realistic Knot Theory Simulation

Untangle with Simple, Intuitive Controls
Dive into a puzzle experience where unraveling complex, intertwined ropes is all about insight and strategy. Enjoy a user-friendly interface that lets you focus on thoughtful problem-solving and exploration at your own pace.
Mesmerizing, Fluid Rope Dynamics
Watch as the ropes come to life with smooth, natural movements. The realistic simulation captures the fluid, almost hypnotic dance of every twist and turn, offering a visually satisfying experience that feels both organic and engaging.

title: Beekeeper Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Beekeeper Simulator lets you step into the peaceful yet rewarding world of beekeeping. Start small with a single hive, tending to your bees by providing food, cleaning the hives, and keeping them healthy. As your colonies grow, gather different types of honey based on the flowers your bees visit, each with unique flavors and values.
Use your earnings to buy better tools, new hives, and advanced equipment to improve honey production. Explore the environment to find rare flowers, attract special bee species, and optimize your apiary. Expand your beekeeping empire, manage multiple hives, and master the art of honey-making while keeping your bees happy and productive.

title: Snow • Fall
description:
게임 정보
▶ "But I'm still not the strongest...!"
 Snow • Fall is a deck builder rogue-like that mixes strategic gameplay with fast-paced and satisfying item synergies.
Play a Cube and watch Droplets face off. The person who rolls the higher number gets to attack.
Watch as your character performs high-damage combos against the enemy at your command. Or have the opposite happen, if you're bad.
Each battle is a test of your game knowledge and ability to adapt to unknown circumstances.
The more you play, the more you'll understand. Make game destroying combinations or be sent back to the main menu, it all depends on you.
⠀
⠀
⠀
▶ "If you can't beat them physically, you'll just have to outsmart them!"

title: Alchemy of the Earth
description:
게임 정보
Alchemy of the Earth is set in an open world dreamscape where herbalism and alchemy are your only tools of survival. Gather ingredients, brew potions and poultices, find loot to survive the harsh nights and uncover the secrets of the island’s creator.
Check out my youtube channel to the right of this description ------------------------->
for more Alchemy of the Earth stuff.
Find your way through the Veil:
Explore a large hand-crafted world with distinct environments and sweeping vistas. Traverse ruined settlements and overgrown wilderness, picking up pieces of history of the island as you go.

title: Dreaminal
description:
게임 정보

Dreaminal is an online co-op liminal space puzzle exploration experience where you and up to 3 other players will navigate through eerie, immersive environments inspired by the Backrooms concept. Together, you'll face intriguing puzzles, interact with shifting spaces, and encounter unexpected anomalies, all while making critical choices that affect your path and the levels you explore.


Solve intriguing puzzles for every level, each one with its unique concept and mechanics. Hack your way through a facility computer, navigate dangerous areas, and manipulate time to your advantage. Oh and don't forget to play with the floaties and waterslides in the poolrooms!




Your choices and actions throughout the game influence the ending you receive. Discover hidden levels, uncover new facets of the story, and reach different outcomes depending on how you interact with the environment and approach each puzzle. The levels themselves will shift and change based on the paths you take and the decisions you make, ensuring a unique experience each time you play.


Explore unique levels and multiple sublevels with distinct aesthetics and challenges. Each level offers fresh experiences, hidden secrets, and engaging puzzles to keep gameplay exciting and unpredictable.



Play Dreaminal the way you want, whether that is without entities, normal or nightmare mode where there are more entities, less items and harder to find puzzle parts.

title: Tomboy Adventure 2
description:
게임 정보
A sequel to the critically acclaimed "Tomboy Adventure!" is finally here!
Living in the middle of nowhere can have its benefits. Just you, the sea and ice cream from the vending machine up-hill. No one to bother you. Well, aside from this one girl that keeps showing up whether you want it or not...
Summer is getting close!

Tomboy Adventure 2 is an interaction driven dating sim where through your choices you unsuccessfully try to romance your companion. Exploring the island unlocks new dialogue options, outfits and interactions, creating new opportunities for getting your feelings across. Perseverance is key!
Features

title: Wall Jump Stuff
description:
게임 정보
**Coming Soon - Don't Forget To Wishlist!**


Hi, I have been learning how to make games for a few years now, here is my first release!

I really appreciate your feedback and plan to update this game, so let me know what you would like to see or if you spot any bugs!

Thank you for your interest, I hope you enjoy playing Wall Jump Stuff as much as I enjoyed making it! - Paul Chettle, Fizzy Vortex Games


Wall Jump Stuff is a physics based arcade wall jumping game, you'll need to think fast when positioning your character to navigate obstacles and catch gems

Your character is in a constant state of falling so jumping to the opposing wall or on to an obstacle is the only way to advance

I designed this game to be challenging at first, once you pick up the wall jumping mechanic you should be able to clear obstacles more easily and anticipate how to position your character to better catch the falling gems that are used to unlock more characters

The control is a simple 1 click of the mouse and your character jumps in a predictable arc - but make no mistake - this is not an easy game

There are currently 20 obstacles!, some with variations, that are selected at random and repeat as you ascend the cliff. If you fail a particular obstacle you get another chance at the beginning of your next run to tackle that obstacle before the sequence switches back to random!


Features
- Challenging wall jumping game mechanic
- 1 click to jump
- 20 Obstacles
- 22 Characters
- 3 Boats/Ships
- 63 Steam Achievements
- Steam Cloud Save

Notes: currently there is only mouse support for interacting with the menu system

Trailer Music: Onwards! by Kevin Mueller find his awesome music on Newgrounds

title: Orcs and Outlaws
description:
게임 정보
A classic action adventure shooter, featuring the blonde bounty hunter Ava Garant versus a horde of super Orcs and their army of the undead:
- A new generation of Orc warriors
- Their army of dragons, demons and the undead
- A badass blonde bounty hunter
- Melee, spell casting and shooting combat
Key Features:
ORCS, VAMPIRES, DEMONS AND MORE
The bounty hunters have been getting reports and rumors of bizarre and fearsome creatures roaming the islands. They include visions of dragons, giants and animals never seen before. Whatever’s there, its worth the risk for an Orc bounty.
Demon spirits - malevolent entities believed to possess supernatural powers

title: Cats in Wonderland
description:
게임 정보
😸 A portion of the profit from this game will be allocated to street cat rescue and support initiatives. 😻
Cats in Wonderland is a hidden object game where you need to find all the hidden cats in Wonderland. Explore the maps, find items to access new areas, and gather the resistance to defeat the Queen of Hearts.
Features:
🎵 Original soundtrack.
🐈 800 cats to find.
🎩 Organize the resistance.
🗝️ Collect items.
👑 Defeat the Queen of Hearts.
🗺️ Explore the world in whatever order you choose.
🐰 Interact with famous and charismatic characters.
🧩 Game experience designed for both think and relax.

title: Streamers Cleaning Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Whether you're a cleaning enthusiast or just looking for a fun way to spend your time, The game offers an engaging and humorous look into the behind-the-scenes lives of your favorite gaming personalities. Get ready to clean up and shine in the world of streaming!
Dynamic Environments
Each streamer's room offers a different level of mess and items to interact with, ranging from pizza boxes and soft drink cans to high-tech gaming gear and collectibles.
Time Challenges
Race against the clock to clean up before the next live stream starts. Earn extra money for speed and efficiency.
Customizable Tools
Unlock and upgrade cleaning tools like turbo vacuums, super sprays, and robotic assistants to tackle tougher messes faster.
Streamer Requests
Meet specific demands from streamers to increase your reputation and unlock new cleaning gigs. Each streamer has unique needs and preferences.

title: Station Master RPG
description:
게임 정보
Play the role of the station master at a railway station in rural Japan! You start off with a tiny old station building in the middle of nowhere, but this is soon about to change. Watch the city grow together with your station, upgrade the infrastructure to cope with the ever-increasing demand and design it to your liking! Take care of your passengers and employ staff to cover the station's workload, all while keeping an eye on the finances.
Features available in this Early Access version of the game
Passenger interaction and satisfaction – Don't let them wait in queues!
Construction system that allows for adding and changing floors, walls, wallpapers and roofs
Laying tracks and building new platforms
Typical Japanese station equipment like ticket gates, vending machines, etc.
Staff management and skill progression
Dynamic city development based on the station's ratings
Additional features planned for future releases
More train types (including electrification of the line!)
More station equipment and construction elements
Steam Workshop support for custom objects and trains
Improvement on the RPG factor of the game (player skilling system)
More interactive gameplay (infrastructure maintenance, cleaning, picking up lost items, etc.)
More language support (Japanese & German)
... and much more!
Players are very welcome to join the community and suggest features for the game! Let's build this game together!

title: Maid of Venia
description:
게임 정보
Maid of Venia is an action RPG adventure where you step into the armor of a red-haired warrior sworn to the Belt’s service, tasked with protecting the land of Venia from encroaching threats. But as you fulfill your sacred duties, you’ll uncover unsettling truths about your mission. Are you truly serving justice, or is there a hidden hand guiding your fate?
Choose Your Path
At the start of your journey, you must decide your combat style. Will you embrace the destructive power of fire as a Fire Mage, raining down flames upon your foes? Or will you take the path of the Summoner, calling forth spectral allies to fight by your side? Each choice alters your abilities, shaping the way you approach combat and the challenges ahead.
A World Steeped in Mystery and Magic
Venture through a beautifully crafted world teeming with both wonder and danger:
Thistledown, a hidden Elven town nestled in the towering silverwood trees, is home to ancient scholars, artisans, and rangers who protect their sacred lands from outsiders. It is a place of both wisdom and caution—where you may find powerful enchantments or wary allies unwilling to meddle in human conflicts.
Havenbay, a bustling coastal city, serves as a gateway to adventure. Here, you can catch a boat to perilous islands overrun by pirates and goblins, uncovering lost relics and forgotten ruins amidst the treacherous waves. But beware—some ships that sail from Havenbay never return.
Six grand kingdoms or towns to explore with unique quests and characters.
The Queen’s Deception & The Witch’s Influence
As you battle goblins, dragons, and the formidable Witch of the Wasteland, an even darker plot begins to unravel. The Queen herself may be behind a sinister scheme, conspiring with the Witch to manipulate your destiny. Through powerful magic, the Witch casts a spell that convinces you that your god is speaking directly to you—guiding your path, commanding your battles, and whispering of divine purpose. But is it truly your god’s voice? Or are you merely a pawn in the Queen’s war?
Dynamic Combat and Growth
Level up and customize your character, unlocking new skills, spells, and combat techniques.

title: Pit of Despair
description:
게임 정보
Pit of Despair is a psychological horror game that places the player in a snowbound cabin, isolated deep within a remote forest. The environment is cold, unwelcoming, and indifferent to your presence. You are stranded, with no immediate means of escape. An unidentified presence resides within the cabin’s walls, or perhaps within your own mind.
Inspired by the atmospheric tension of P.T. Silent Hills and the unsettling monotony of The Exit 8, Pit of Despair delivers a chilling, narrative-driven experience that thrives on psychological tension and environmental storytelling. 
This is a short, intense "walking simulator" designed to be experienced in one sitting, lasting approximately 30 - 45 minutes. 
Pit of Despair is an experience best played with headphones, in the dark, and with no distractions.

title: Squiggle Football
description:
게임 정보
Build an Australian Football team - choose who to recruit, who to show the door, and who to invest in for the future.

Based on statistically accurate AFL modelling from Squiggle - view a player's career trajectory and decide who to build a team around.

Start in the Bush League with a handful of players, and construct a list that can survive State Leagues and ultimately win the National League premiership.

And do it before the board gets restless!
GAME OVERVIEW
Build a list from weekly recruits
Make canny player trades to fill list holes and secure the future
Pick the eyes out of the post-season draft
Delist spuds
Heartlessly cut worn-out veterans, or nurture them through their dotage
STREAMLINED MANAGEMENT
You don't have time for fiddly little details. You're a big-picture person.

Choose who to sign and where they play. No contract negotiations. No cry-baby players. No fiddly match-day tactics or surprise injuries.
STREAMLINED GAMEPLAY
A match is 20 seconds. A season is 10 rounds. That gives you time to focus on list management, which is what really matters.
ONLINE DAILY CHALLENGE
Match your eye for talent against the online leaderboard, where everyone starts with the same random seed.

title: Single Forever
description:
게임 정보
“Single Forever?” is a choice-driven Visual Novel where the player plays as the Cupid to matchmake their client through comparing stats and giving out guidance.
    In this game, you'll step into the shoes of Red, an intern Cupid, tasked with a hellish mission to keep their job: help the love-resistant heroine, Lia, find her first love!
    Lia is a 29-year-old young woman—sweet, cheerful, and always ready for love... but despite her best efforts, she's never been in a relationship. Why is she still single after all this time?
    As Red, you'll need to navigate the chaotic world of modern dating, help Lia break out of her comfort zone, and guide her toward the love she’s been waiting for.
♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡⋯⋯⋯♡
Features:
Divergent Butterfly-Effect Paths: Every decision you make could lead to a totally different outcome—heartwarming romances, wild comedies, and hidden surprises waiting to be uncovered!
Unique Characters & Art Style: Meet a diverse cast, from shy introverts to artsy dreamers, each with their own rich backstories. Their outfits were designed based on real-life research and observations to reflect their unique personalities. The story unfolds in a vibrant, imagined Asian city—a blend of 65% Chengdu, 27% LA, and 8% NYC—where East and West collide!
Real Meets Ridiculous: This isn’t your typical dating game. We’ll explore modern love through a sociological lens, with some educational moments mixed in. Plus, there are plenty of wild, laugh-out-loud moments that will have you questioning everything. It’s a rollercoaster of emotions!
Unexpected Twists: The truth you think you know might not be what it seems, and the ending of one thing could just be the beginning of another!
    It’s an adventure that’s as hilarious as it is heartfelt, with plenty of surprises and plenty of laughs along the way.
    Are you ready to take on the challenge?

title: The Mangust
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by the intense action of Doom Eternal, yet set within colorful and charming 2D landscapes. You'll navigate these scenes as a swift and nimble mongoose, acquiring and upgrading weapons, scavenging various items, uncovering secrets and battling hordes of enemies along the way.



Move quickly and freely with dashes, wall-jumps, and double jumps. Use a variety of ranged weapons which all can be aimed in a full range of 360 degrees. Use Melee weapons to keep enemies at bay and execute low health enemies to regain health and ammo.









All guns have six base stats that can be upgraded in any order. Select special abilities, elemental effects, bullet types, and frameworks that change how the gun fundamentally functions.
The game consists of four different environments. Each environment contains 15 hand made levels. Each level has various treasure chests and other collectables. Between each level the players is returned to a base area where various shops exists.
Outside of the guns. There are three different types of items.
Melee weapons - enhances the players combat and knock back capabilities with melee attacks.
Organs - helps with survivability.
Mantras - Improves how the player interacts with power ups and consumables,

title: Wildaria
description:
게임 정보
TAME RIDABLE PETS
Tame any animal with the lasso mini-game to gain a companion that you can level-up, ride into battle, and fight along-side! They even have elemental pet abilities...
EXPLORE INFINITE BIOMES
Explore an endless procedural fantasy world, discover the depth of biomes filled with living creatures, villagers, and natural features... to find all the hidden secrets.

title: World of Magic: Rise of Magic
description:
게임 정보
주요 특징
일부 NPC를 위한 고급 AI:
일부 NPC는 세계와 상호작용하고, 적은 긴 전투 중에 당신의 전투 스타일과 마법을 기억합니다. 만약 평범한 마을 주민이나 여행자가 죽으면, 그들과의 연결은 영원히 사라집니다.
혁신적인 마법 시스템:
몰입감을 높이는 새로운 인터랙티브 주문 방식.
매력적인 스토리라인:
독특한 캐릭터와 흥미진진한 사건이 가득한 스토리를 따라가세요.
선택의 영향:
당신의 결정이 스토리의 전개와 세계의 변화에 큰 영향을 미쳐, 매번 새로운 경험을 제공합니다.
다양한 주문:
다양한 주문을 발견하고 습득하여 나만의 마법적 정체성을 만들어보세요.
캐릭터 강화:
게임 스타일에 맞춰 캐릭터를 강화하세요.
최적화된 자원:
최상의 성능을 위한 세심하게 최적화된 자원으로 고품질 그래픽을 즐기세요.
도시에서는 통치자 외에도 가장 강력한 마법사들이 존경받습니다. 일부는 주머니를 금으로 채우려 하고 있는 반면, 시골의 가난한 사람들은 약탈하고 여성들을 번식하기 위해 납치하는 고블린과 싸우고 있습니다. 그 사이 성 주변에서는 갑자기 오크와 다른 악한 존재들이 나타나기 시작했습니다. 이 혼란 속에서 당신은 가족을 구해야 합니다. 하지만 사람들은 서로 전쟁을 시작했고, 누군가는 금지된 흑마법을 익혀서 무언가 끔찍한 것을 소환했습니다...
가장 위대한 마법사가 되어, 여러 가지 조합 가능한 마법을 익히고, 성을 방어하거나 포위하며, 가족의 행복을 최우선으로 하는 캐릭터의 매혹적인 이야기를 따라가세요.
autokwd: World of Magic: Rise of Magic

title: Hotel Tales
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to our hotel, where anyone could be a guest. Ghost? Ancient deity? Character from a famous fairy tale? But the staff here is not so ordinary either.
From now on, you are a new employee of this hotel. A friendly team and interesting tasks to keep you waiting for more. Your job description? Be ready to become a jack of all trades!
