title: Retro Relics
description:
게임 정보
Retro Relics is a cozy sandbox and story-driven treasure hunting simulation, where you immerse yourself into nature and search for ancient artifacts with your metal detector. Explore, dig, help other people find lost belongings and complete your coin and relics collection.
You can unearth artifacts from all epochs with the help of your metal detector: coins, buttons, buckles, jewellery, military, religious relics and many more

title: Mechanoid
description:
게임 정보
Blast your way through 18 levels of platform mayhem in a quest to save mankind from the grip of a totalitarian  regime. Every level is a playground of possibilities, where quick thinking and quicker reflexes are the keys to survival.
This fast-paced platformer demands split-second timing and combat precision. Players navigate through meticulously crafted levels that shift from neon-drenched industrial zones to snow-covered mountain outposts, each area presenting unique platforming challenges and enemy types. Rusted worker bots patrol abandoned factories, sleek combat drones sweep across open valleys, and massive mechanical bosses guard crucial chokepoints.
In a world overrun by hostile machines, survival depends on quick reflexes, perfect timing, and knowing when to upgrade your gear. Mechanoid delivers pure platforming action where every jump matters and every improvement counts. Each movement must be calculated, each shot timed perfectly. One wrong step or delayed reaction can end in disaster.
As you progress, you'll find opportunities to enhance your crucial systems. Weapon upgrades pack more punch against tougher enemies. Shield improvements give you better protection when things get hectic. Battery enhancements let you push deeper into hostile territory. And perhaps most crucial of all, life support upgrades keep you alive in increasingly dangerous environments.
Mechanoid strips away unnecessary complexity to focus on what matters: precise platforming, intense combat, split second timing and meaningful progression that rewards a player's skill.

title: Blood Moon Horror
description:
게임 정보
설명: "Blood Moon Horror"와 함께 어둠 속으로 뛰어들어 보세요. 최대 1-8명의 플레이어가 함께하는 온라인 협동 심리 호러 게임입니다. 플레이어는 미스터리한 회사인 NovaTech Biogenics에 의해 파견된 과학자들로, 버려진 우주 정거장을 조사하게 됩니다. 이 정거장은 Echo 프로젝트의 일부로, 이 프로젝트는 시그널이라는 위험할 수 있는 미스터리한 이상현상을 연구하는 것을 목표로 했습니다. 이 현상은 블러드 문과 연관되어 있으며, 이 천체 현상은 환경과 그것에 노출된 사람들의 정신 상태를 급격히 변화시킵니다. 블러드 문이 떠오르면, 정거장은 악몽 같은 미로가 되어 공포로 가득 찬 공간으로 변합니다. 과학자들은 진실을 밝혀내고, 생존하며, 광기에 휩싸이기 전에 탈출해야 합니다. 친구들과 함께 음산한 그림자 속을 헤쳐 나가며, 에일리언 포식자를 피하고, 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내는 잊을 수 없는 달 탐험에 도전하세요.
진화하는 위협:
이미 그림자 속에 숨어 있는 두려운 적과 맞서 싸우세요. 현재 개발 중인 두 명의 새로운 적도 준비되어 있습니다.

title: Play Together: Party Games
description:
게임 정보
Play Together: Party Games는 로컬이나 원격으로 즐길 수 있는 재미있고 매력적인 게임들의 확장 컬렉션입니다. 2-8명의 플레이어를 위해 설계된 다양한 협력 및 경쟁 게임을 즐기세요.
최대 8명의 플레이어를 지원하는 멀티플레이어 모드로, 액션 게임, 턴제 게임, 보드 게임 등 다양한 게임이 준비되어 있습니다 – 모든 사람에게 적합한 게임이 있습니다!



태블릿, PC 또는 TV를 메인 화면으로 설정하고, 모든 손님이 자신의 전화로 무료로 참여할 수 있게 하세요. Play Together 컨트롤러 앱은 iOS 및 Android 스토어에서 무료로 제공됩니다.



현재 두 가지 게임이 제공되며, 더 많은 게임이 계획되어 있습니다:
1. : 기술과 파워업을 사용하여 다른 플레이어를 플랫폼에서 밀어내세요.
2. : 주의력과 반사 신경을 테스트 – 화면에 나타나는 캐릭터와 일치하는 캐릭터를 장치에서 찾으세요.
, Steam Broadcast 또는 원하는 플랫폼을 통해 화면을 공유하고, 친구들이 무료로 당신의 방에 참여할 수 있도록 하세요.
에 가입하여 다른 플레이어를 만나고, 매치에 참여하고, 새로운 게임 제안을 해보세요.
플레이어는 Android 또는 iOS 장치를 사용하여 게임에 참여하고 함께 플레이할 수 있습니다! 원격 플레이어와 함께 플레이할 때는 , Steam Broadcast 또는 Remote Play Together 등 원하는 비디오 스트리밍 플랫폼을 사용하여 다른 사람들과 연결할 수 있습니다! 화면을 공유하고 친구들을 초대하세요!

* 이 게임은 로컬 멀티플레이어 게임이지만, 원격 플레이어와 함께 스트리밍을 통해 즐길 수 있습니다.
영어, 브라질 포르투갈어, 스페인어 (라틴 아메리카). 더 많은 언어가 곧 추가될 예정입니다! 원하는 언어를 알려주세요.
Play Together를 위시리스트에 추가하고 더 많은 플레이어에게 도달할 수 있도록 도와주세요:

title: KILLA
description:
게임 정보
가족과도 같았던 스승님의 갑작스러운 죽음.
그녀가 남긴 마지막 한마디—"라를 죽여라."
당신은 ‘발할라’가 되어, 스승님을 죽인 를 찾아 해야 합니다.

title: Test Cricket Manager
description:
게임 정보
test Cricket Manager Game
A cricket management game where you control the on, and off, decisions of a countries national cricket team.
Starting in 1868 (Year of the first Australian touring team to England, the Australian team was entirely comprised of Aboriginals for this tour) you will take your country on a year long journey to play each other test team once at home, and another time away.
While managing the team you will be responsible for
BEFORE THE GAME
- Player wages, contracts, hiring and firing.
- Training of your players. Which skills do you want them to improve?
- Staffing levels and their wages.
- Upkeep of the ground and the pitch. Have a lot of world class spinners? Make your pitch spin friendly.
DURING THE GAME
- Set the batting line up; change your batters aggression at any time. Declare at any time.
- Choose the on field tactics.
- Choose your bowlers, will you bowl them for a long spell or quick fiery bursts?
- Set your fielding aggression (are you going for a wicket or slow the scoring down?)
AFTER THE GAME
- Sit back and check out all the statistics of the game, and season so far.
- See where you are on the ladder. Do you need to win, or will a draw do, next game?
- Do you need to retire some old stars and look at your youth players?
YOU make the decisions, and YOU take the glory. But you also take the fall for failure.

title: Cedric Darkstride: The Pallid
description:
게임 정보

Devotion, betrayal, vengeance, and redemption.

Uncover the dark secrets of "The Order" to achieve divine redemption.
A Souls-like game with an isometric view.

Help Cedric find redemption. Use your melee or ranged attacks, increase your magical powers, and solve puzzles to access certain areas. Immerse yourself in the underworld and defeat the evil one.

Explore the world of Ironholt, delve into the depths of Sombracave, or face the defenders of the various fortresses condemned by the evil one.

Choose your attack style wisely—melee, ranged, or magic—each enemy has its weaknesses.

Investigate your enemies, seek information about their pacts with the evil one and the curse they bear. Gather all the treatises to gain the power to confront the lord of evil.


Buy, sell, or try your luck at gambling to earn enough money to get potions or magic cards—any help in Ironholt is little enough.

title: THE GIRL FROM GUNMA Kai 　群馬県から来た少女 改
description:
게임 정보
It's a pseudo-retro 2D side-scrolling shooter with a variety of gameplay in 8 stages, with visuals (TMS9918A spec V9938 palette) and sound (PSG+SCC) enhanced to mimic the MSX standard popular in Japan in the 1980s. Formerly released for smartphones in 2014 and then passed through Steam Greenlight, the release was delayed for about 10 years due to the production company's busy schedule (Final Re:Quest The Movie). The overall volume of the game has been increased to compensate for this. The controls are very simple and familiar. The player controls a cute little girl with dots, and defeats various enemies with a series of automatic shots. The game is inspired by good old Japanese culture, Gunma's nature and customs, in the 80's style, and the ending may change some by discovering various hidden items in the stage. We aimed to create a simple and kitschy shooting game before the bullet-hell shooters. We hope you will enjoy this game if you are tired of complicated modern games.
autokwd: THE GIRL FROM GUNMA Kai 　群馬県から来た少女 改
company: 株式会社ヒューガ　HUGA Inc

title: City: Battle Ground
description:
게임 정보
어둡고 활기찬 비스트 시티의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 이곳의 거리에서는 바이커, 경찰, 갱스터, 그리고 미친 과학자가 이끄는 좀비 무리들이 치열하게 싸우고 있습니다. 매 턴이 마지막이 될 수도 있으며, 각 카드는 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있습니다.
다양한 진영의 카드를 조합하여 나만의 독특한 덱을 만드세요. 경찰의 힘과 교활함, 바이커의 분노, 갱스터의 기민함, 좀비의 파괴적인 혼돈을 활용하세요. 카드를 강화하고 새로운 능력을 해제하며 도시를 점차적으로 장악하세요.

title: Red Rust
description:
게임 정보
Red Rust is retro-style side-scrolling game which uniquely combines fighting mechanics with shooting mechanics. The game is heavily inspired by 8bit and 16bit hits of the 90s, but it’s being developed with the modern player in mind. Tons of great animation, hand-drawn backgrounds, variety of in-game situations and powerful soundtrack!



It's the year 1984 and you control Agent Red (or just Red), a soviet KGB officer who has been sent to the West on a secret mission. She is an attractive but brutal and cold-hearted girl! Over the course of the game she learns to understand her own emotions and the unfamiliar world around her.

title: The Shafts of Damnation
description:
게임 정보
Core Gameplay Mechanics:
Exploration: Navigate through claustrophobic tunnels and experiment rooms.
Puzzle Solving: Restore power, decode locks, and piece together evidence.
Stealth and Survival: Avoid monstrous creatures and manage limited resources.
Lore Discovery: Collect a few notes per map to unravel the story.
Cat and Mouse Gameplay: Enemies actively pursue and capture the player, using various paths.
Evolving Threat System: The enemy analyzes the player's behavior and learns from their movements.
Shadow Strategy: The player must use the environment and deception to survive.
Be Smarter and Don't Get Caught.
Genre: Souls-Horror – Hardcore difficulty only and strategic combat.
Key Features:
Atmospheric Environment: Flickering lights, eerie soundscapes, and oppressive darkness.
Dynamic Threats: Monsters with unique behaviors stalk the player.
Immersive Storytelling: Story revealed through environmental clues and collectible notes.
Endgame Encounter: A dramatic showdown with the ultimate experiment deep within the shafts.

title: Legacy of Defense
description:
게임 정보
게임 설명:

판타지 세계의 주인공이 되어 몬스터의 침공을 막아라! 레거시 오브 디펜스
레거시 오브 디펜스는 횡스크롤뷰와 덱빌딩 요소를 결합한 혁신적인 디펜스 게임입니다.

모험을 떠나 동료를 획득하고, 위험한 적으로부터 자신을 방어하세요!
주요 특징:

횡스크롤뷰 액션: 화려한 2D 그래픽과 직관적인 조작으로 눈앞에 펼쳐지는 치열한 전투를 경험하세요. 몰려오는 몬스터를 방어하는 짜릿한 손맛을 느껴보세요.

덱빌딩 전략: 다양한 카드들을 모아 나만의 덱을 구성하세요. 각 카드에는 강력한 스킬이 포함되어 있어 전략적인 플레이가 요구됩니다.

판타지 몬스터: 상상 속에서나 볼 수 있었던 다양한 판타지 몬스터들이 공격해옵니다. 각기 다른 능력을 가진 몬스터들을 상대하세요.


스킬 업그레이드: 전투를 통해 경험치를 획득하고, 주인공의 스킬을 업그레이드하세요. 강력한 스킬을 통해 더욱 효과적으로 몬스터를 소탕할 수 있습니다.

몰려오는 몬스터들을 막아내세요. 카드를 선택해 스킬을 사용하고 적들을 처치하세요. 전략적인 덱빌딩이 승리의 열쇠입니다. 각 스테이지를 클리어하며 점점 강해지는 몬스터들에 맞서 최종 보스를 물리치세요!

당신의 전략과 실력을 시험해보세요. 용감한 영웅이 되어 판타지 세계를 구할 준비가 되셨나요?

title: Hell is Us
description:
게임 정보
Hell is Us는 강렬한 근접 전투와 탐험의 스릴이 결합된 3인칭 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다. 세미 오픈 월드를 탐험해 의문에 대한 답을 찾고 여정 내내, 신비로운 생물들을 만나 보세요.
적대적인 세계
국가를 분열하는 내전뿐 아니라, 이 지역은 현대식 무기로는 물리칠 수 없는 초자연적 생물을 태어나게 만든 기이한 재앙으로부터 고통받고 있습니다. 다른 시대에서 온 드론과 검은 무시무시한 키메라가 들끓는 땅을 뚫고 길을 만들며 이들의 등장의 비밀을 파헤치는 과정에 함께하는 충실한 동료입니다.
독특한 탐험 시스템
지도도, 나침반도, 퀘스트 표식도 없습니다. 본능을 따르는 것 역시 모험의 일부입니다. 탐험을 진행하며 직접 결정을 내리고 본능을 따르게 만들어 주는 획기적인 글쓰기 방식과 레벨 디자인을 활용한 독특한 탐험을 즐겨 보세요. 발견은 오로지 당신의 몫입니다.
독창적인 생물들과의 전투
검, 창과 도끼: 이 초자연적 생물체들과 맞서 싸우기 위해 특별하게 만들어진 다양한 무기를 이용할 수 있습니다. 살아남으려면 이 괴물들과 어떻게 싸우고 드론을 활용해야 할지 배워나가야 할 것입니다.

''Hell is Us의 핵심 테마는 인간의 폭력은 인간의 감정과 격정이 부추기는 반복적인 사이클이라는 겁니다.'' - Jonathan Jacques-Belletête, 크리에이티브 디렉터

title: Terminator 2D: NO FATE
description:
게임 정보
훌륭한 픽셀 아트워크와 액션으로 가득 찬 아케이드 게임플레이의 조합으로 생동감 넘치는 '터미네이터 2: 심판의 날' 세계를 직접 경험해 보세요! 사라 코너와 T-800이 되어 스릴 넘치는 다양한 임무를 해결하며 T-1000과 맞서 싸우고 스카이넷의 계획을 저지하여 인류를 멸망에서 구해내세요. 미래의 존 코너가 되어 저항군을 이끌고 기계와의 전쟁에서 인류의 유일한 희망이 되어 최전선에서 전투하세요. '터미네이터 2: 심판의 날'에 등장하는 상징적인 장면과 오리지널 시나리오, 여러 개의 엔딩으로 이루어진 이 특별한 스토리에서 인류의 운명은 여러분의 결정에 달려 있습니다.
게임 특징
정통 아케이드 게임 플레이, 음악 및 시각적 효과를 처음부터 새롭게 제작하여 터미네이터 세계관에 경의를 바치는 클래식한 아케이드 게임에 흠뻑 빠져 보세요.
고전 터미네이터 2: 심판의 날에 등장하는 장면과 지금까지 공개되지 않았던 터미네이터 이야기가 어우러진 스토리 속에서 사라, 존, 그리고 T-800이 되어 상징적인 순간을 다시 체험하고 새로운 길을 열어 보세요.
사이버다인과 스카이넷의 강력한 무기를 상대로 전투를 치르며 다양한 유형의 적과 아드레날린이 솟구치는 보스전에 도전해 보세요.

title: Congruence
description:
게임 정보
Manipulate pentominoes to create congruent shapes
Some pairs have multiple solutions
There are 513 different congruences to find in total

title: Skippy's Grand Escape
description:
게임 정보
About:
In this minimalistic space themed top down runner you play as Skippy who's racing to reach each maze's exit as fast as possible.
Watch out for enemies, traps, black holes and other dangers.
Use available skills tactically.
Compare your time against the game's times as well as Steam friends and global Steam leaderboards.
Skills:
Frost Nova: Freezes enemies in range for a short duration
Tactical Beacon: Drop a "tac beacon" which you can teleport back to, should it become a better option then proceeding or backtracking your current path
Active Sensor Pulse: Show enemy detection range, enemy paths and more
Create Spacetime Rift: Essentially a dash - but with a cooler name :-P
Extend Presence: Explore the area around you without moving Skippy
More to come
Levels:
Currently there are 6 sectors with 6 levels each
Unlock new sectors by reaching all exits of the previous sector
Levels of each sector can be done in any order you like
Gameplay modes:
The game offers 3 modes for different player types: Default, Relaxed, Hardcore.
In default mode you try to reach the game's top tiers by reaching the exit as fast as possible. Each level shows your time's tier, your best time and your friends' times.
This is the intended experience.
Should you require an additional challenge, hardcore mode will certainly give you one. You'll do the same as in default mode but there is no respawn should you ever die. Are you able to beat the game without dying once? Extra points for reaching S-tier ranks for all levels in HC mode!

title: Fairtravel Battle
description:
게임 정보
Fairtravel Battle is an affordable indie collectible card game with familiar gameplay and unique twists

This game is a labor of love for the collectible card game genre, and is aiming to become a fun game to play with friends or solo, without the stress of spending a ton of money buying card packs and keeping up with a meta.
Features

Unique resource system

Fairtravel Battle features a unique resource system that gives you the most flexibility when building a deck.

Make your own masterpiece by combining any kind of card and discovering new decks, creating your own voice in the game.

Multiple Game Modes

Play each mode in 2-4 player matches, either online, lan, or with CPU players.
Battle with your collection in the Duel mode
Deckbuild your way in Explorer mode
Battle a raid boss in the 4-player Raid mode. Or, be the raid boss yourself!
Draft cards to make a deck in Draft mode
Open packs to make a deck in Sealed mode

This is a sustainable game

Fairtravel Battle is being developed so that if support ends, the game can still be played, and will not otherwise disappear. It is playable offline, in your local network, in Steam lobbies, or in player-hosted dedicated servers.

Make it your own

Fairtravel Battle supports game data mods such as new cards, replacing textures, new effects, and more.



Fairtravel Battle will never have any microtransactions for card packs. Excluding some premium cosmetics and expansions, all game content is obtained from playing the game.

title: Roman Empire Wars
description:
게임 정보
Rise!

As a new emperor of Rome, guide your country through the uncertain times, when the Empire is being constantly surrounded by the enemy nations. Don’t wait for the inevitable, but show them your might and bring the war to their doorstep! For the power of Rome is great and the Emperor’s fury brings death.

Command!

Gather your legions of the fiercest warriors in the whole Empire. Prepare for the bloodshed and create a strategy that will bring to shame the leaders across the Europe. Lead your troops to the victory as a wise and tireless commander. Give swift orders and change your plan accordingly to the situation on the battlefield. Flank, push them back and destroy. Everyone shall kneel before the armies of the Emperor.


Stand face to face with various fractions and bring them a crushing defeat. No Gauls, Huns, Greeks, Spartans or other barbarians will spit in the face of the Emperor. Make them pay for their impertinence. No matter how strong is their army, the Roman Empire will bring them devastation across the whole Europe. On the land and on the sea.


Manifest the glory of Rome, by battling in the distant lands of various countries. Rage war throughout the Greece, Carthage, Persia, Egipt and Great Britain. Let the glory of the Roman Empire be spread in Europe, by the means of sword. Make them fear your anger and marvel at your wisdom.

title: I Want to Believe
description:
게임 정보


미국 북부의 작은 마을에는 지역 주민을 흉내 내는 외계인들이 여러 명 있습니다. 당신의 임무는 누가 누구인지 파악하고 외계인을 제거하는 것입니다. 이 위험한 임무를 돕기 위해 오래된 픽업 트럭과 카메라가 제공됩니다.

I Want to Believe는 1인칭 액션 게임으로, 탐정 요소, 시뮬레이션, 잠입, 자유로운 행동 및 운전 요소를 포함하고 있습니다.

지역 주민들을 알아가고, 그들을 관찰하며, 돈을 벌고, 목표를 제거할 방법을 계획하고, 모든 것을 "깔끔하게" 처리하세요. 특히 외계인의 존재를 믿지 않는 현지 경찰 때문에 게임은 용서가 없습니다.

게임 특징
자유로운 행동
스스로 무엇을 해야 하고 어떻게 해야 할지 발견
사실적인 차량 물리
몰입감과 분위기
다양한 게임플레이 요소의 시뮬레이션
완전한 라디오 시스템

title: Pill Fight
description:
게임 정보
Fight six different enemy types in a fast-paced series of waves that increase in difficulty over time. With six unique maps to explore, forget about storylines, quests, or complex mechanics. This is gaming boiled down to its most basic principle: FUN.
Key Features:
Graphics: Pill Fight features a low-poly, minimalist art style, giving each enemy a truly unique look. The style is easy on the eyes and ensures smooth gameplay on virtually any system.
Map Variety: A total of six maps to keep the action fresh! The demo includes one map: a vibrant cityscape featuring a working bus that you can ride.
Frantic Action: Don’t let the friendly visuals fool you—things escalate quickly. Careless players can easily find themselves overwhelmed by sheer numbers.
Enemy Variety: The game features six distinct enemy types, each with unique behaviors and requiring different strategies to defeat.

title: Who Infected?
description: 게임 정보

title: Overage - Child of Chaos
description:
게임 정보
We know what you’re thinking, the age-old question: what would happen if we put your stereotypical quick witty, gun tot-in, sunglasses-wearing, chain-smoking action hero in the universe of a horror game? The answer lies in Overage - Child of Chaos. This is a game that thrives on adaptability, allowing you to find guns that can do anything from permanently setting demons on fire and electricuting them through walls, to turning you into a furry!

Explore a beautiful, futuristic 2.5D world that encompasses platforming, satire, and shooting lots of guns! Don't get too comfortable though, the world of Morning Town is a dreadful place; overrun by demons and other things that go "bump" in the night. You must exercise caution, for there can be danger lurking on each end of the screen... and there are plenty of creatures lurking in the darkness... some big and some small... but all of them are hungry and ready to sink their teeth into your flesh.

So are you ready to kick some bubblegum and chew A**?

title: Borderlands 4
description:
게임 정보
2025년 9월 23일에 찾아오는 보더랜드 4에서는 무자비한 폭군이 지배하는 새로운 행성에서 화끈한 액션과 배드애스 볼트 헌터, 셀 수 없이 다양한 기상천외하고 치명적인 무기를 만나볼 수 있습니다. 지금 위시리스트에 추가하세요!
부와 명예를 쫓는 네 명의 새로운 볼트 헌터 중 한 명이 되어 카이로스에 온몸으로 부딪혀 보세요. 강력한 액션 스킬을 휘두르고, 무궁무진한 스킬 트리로 빌드를 커스텀하고, 화려한 이동 능력으로 적들을 압도하세요.
고고하게 높은 자리에서 민중을 내려다보며 지배하는 무자비하고 억압적인 독재자 '타임키퍼'에게서 벗어나세요. 이제 세계를 뒤흔들 엄청난 재앙이 그의 완벽한 지배를 위협하고 행성 전체에 메이햄을 불러일으킵니다.

title: Effulgence RPG
description:
게임 정보
텍스트 기호로 생명을 얻은 신비로운 세계를 탐험하세요.
게임 특징:
★ 제작 자원을 모으는 유일한 방법은 생물을 물리치고 개별 입자로 분해하는 것입니다.
★ 이러한 입자를 사용하여 특별한 프린터에서 무기, 장비 및 기계를 인쇄할 수 있습니다.
★ 탐험할 수 있는 수십 개의 위치가 있습니다.
★ 프린터에서 아이템을 만들기 위한 다양한 자원.
★ 인쇄할 수 있는 아이템에 대한 100개 이상의 청사진.
★ 고급 캐릭터 업그레이드 시스템.
줄거리
위성이 닿는 거리라면 비디오 신호를 전송하는 것은 쉽습니다. 태양계를 넘어가면, 일반적인 이미지를 지구로 보내는 데 몇 시간이 걸릴 수 있습니다.
그러나 신호가 백만 광년 떨어진 은하에서 온다면, 우리에게는 기호의 조각들만 도달합니다. 때때로 그것들을 해독하여 텍스트 문자로 만든 애니메이션으로 조합할 수 있습니다.
이것은 이상한 세계의 이야기입니다. 신호가 백만 년을 여행했으므로, 그 세계는 더 이상 존재하지 않을 수도 있습니다. 아니면 그 세계는 여전히 존재하며 공격을 준비하고 있을지도 모릅니다?

title: Mining Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Mining Survivors is an incremental game in which you mine resources whilst fending of swarms of enemies in a bullet-heaven environment.
You mine resources in short bursts, before either dying to enemies or fending them off long enough to escape with extra rewards.
You then return to the shop, where you spend your resources to upgrade your character and unlock new levels and areas to mine.
Gameplay / Features
Bullet Heaven combat against enemy hordes

title: Slime Slayer
description:
게임 정보

Slime Slayer is an action-packed roguelite where you exterminate EVERY LAST SLIME! Craft unique character builds in every run with compounding modifier runes.
Features
Pick Your Element: Every spell can be evolved with every element, and every element is mechanically distinct! Learn the strengths and weaknesses of each element and how to best combo them to craft a slime-killing machine!

title: Rogue Tactics
description:
게임 정보
The end of the universe. Humanity has disappeared, and the stars have gone out. However, humanity was able to leave something behind.
The World of Ideas.
Everything is relative in this world, and in the great void, ideas begin to materialize. As one of the self-aware ideas, you strive for the ultimate materialization of the world of ideas, but the battle for it will not be easy.
Rogue Tactics is a turn-based tactical roguelike inspired by games like Kings Bounty and Into the Breach.
Features:
Collect a unique squad of creatures with their own strengths and weaknesses.
Fight in deep tactical battles with the impact of landscape on combat.
Combine creatures to create stronger ones.
Collect a variety of spells that can turn the tide of battle.
Find "Ideas" with their unique effects.

title: Swordplay～Karakuri～Strange Tale
description:
게임 정보
Game Title: "Swordplay～Karakuri～Strange Tale"

Overview:
"Swordplay～Karakuri～Strange Tale" is a Japanese-style 3D action game set in a world where advanced "karakuri" technology is prevalent. Players can immerse themselves in a world inspired by both "karakuri" mechanisms and the late Edo period, enjoying slapstick theatrics in a rural setting.

Features:

3D Action: Experience the world of "karakuri" by utilizing jumping and evasive maneuvers.

Special Moves: Special moves are implemented through command inputs. Mastering them will provide advantages for progressing through the game.

title: Times Trials
description:
게임 정보
Move fast, think faster!
Times Trials is an intense, anime arcade-style block-dropping puzzle game that will supercharge your math skills.
Your goal is simple: arrange the falling number blocks to form rows or columns that equal the target number. As the blocks keep falling, you’ll need lightning-quick thinking to make it through.
Race against the clock in timed mode or go head-to-head against friends in versus battles. Choose from four operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division.

title: Cloak Hero
description:
게임 정보
Cloak Hero는 클래식 로그라이트 요소가 가득한 액션 어드벤처 던전 크롤러 게임입니다. 어두운 땅을 통과하는 위험한 여정에서 우리의 영웅은 용감하고 강해야 하며 다양한 무기, 유물 및 마법 주문을 사용하여 사악한 괴물 군대와 싸워야 합니다. 구석구석이 위험하기 때문에 경험을 쌓고 새로운 기술을 배우는 것이 생존에 필수적입니다. 운명이 기다리고 있습니다. 망토 영웅은 던전 깊은 곳에 도달할 수 있을까요?

이 게임은 솔로 게임 제작사에서 Godot 게임 엔진을 사용하여 개발 중입니다. 모든 사항은 개발이 진행됨에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다. 게임 위시리스트에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 여러분의 인내심과 지원에 감사드립니다.

특징:
* 무작위로 생성된 레벨
* 다양한 무기와 유물
* 강력한 마법 주문
* 자동 및 수동 전투 시스템 혼합
* 업그레이드 가능한 무기 예술과 전설적인 기술

title: Roll The Bones
description:
게임 정보
Let's roll them bones!
In this high-paced, action-packed roguelite you will need to carefully choose a loadout of spell dice to beat each dungeon floor.
Pave your way through 15 unique dungeon floors filled with bloodthirsty enemies!
What's the deal with dice?
Each die has 6 sides and possibly up to 6 different spells. Some are good, some are terrible and some will straight up annihilate the enemies (or even yourself).
Choosing dice that play well against specific dungeon floors is the key to success.

title: Territorial Hissing
description:
게임 정보
Something smells funny around here...
Niko wakes up after a long night of partying to discovers that something is stinking up his neighborhood. As he investigates he stumbles upon a story of corruption that sends him down a path with more than he bargained for.
Explore the world and discover all the secrets. Fight your way through the mean critters as you learn all the truths. Snag some cool trinkets to enhance your abilities. And laugh along the way.

title: Hellspresso
description:
게임 정보
As a dedicated ghost chef trying to make a living in the afterlife, you decide to open your own restaurant in hell. Day after day and night after night, from one shift to the next, race against the clock to serve more and more hungry customers. Switch to your not-so-secret magic kitchen to prepare more exotic dishes. Start off small, expand your restaurant and your skills, and slowly gain your reputation as the best ghost cooking chief in hell!
Cook dishes and serve hungry customers!
.
.
.
Run, cut meat, fry potatoes, mix delicious smoothies, make coffee, serve customers before they storm out, clean tables, stack dirty plates, wash dishes… You will have a lot on your plate.Different kinds of customers have varying tempers and willingness to give you tips. Serving them is key to the longevity of your restaurant. Every second counts, because if you take too long, your customers will be tired of waiting and they will leave angry and hungry!
.
Encountering strange orders with venomous mushrooms or magic plants that you don’t have in your fridge? Time to enter your clandestine kitchen! Discover the mystical counterparts to your regular ingredients and kitchen tools. Watch as a regular steak transforms into rotten meat, and a mushroom becomes a venomous variant with red spots. Sprinkle glowing eyes on your donuts, chop garlic, brew magic potions, and create infusions with foxglove or deadly nightshade. Your cauldron and your alembic will help you to craft enchanting recipes and satisfy every customer. Master the art of juggling between both kitchens to ensure your dishes never burn!
.
.
Discover more than 50 ingredients to cook, each with its magical counterpart hidden in your secret atelier. From familiar carrots, mushrooms, and donuts to exotic items like garlic, blood, or deadly nightshade, a world of exciting ingredients awaits your culinary creativity! You can create more than 100 different recipes from all around the world and even beyond, to offer new dishes and drinks to your demanding customers.
.
Your daily customers are always different! Design your menu however you like based on the day's forecast. Each day, you can choose which ingredients to put on your fridge and on your cupboard, as well as the counters that will be in your kitchen. With more than 10 different personalities, each customer wants something different, and it’s up to you to optimize your menu accordingly. Discover their favorite recipes to gain their trust and unlock their secrets.
.
Some ingredients and ustensiles have a magical equivalent in your secret kitchen, allowing you to put even more recipes to your menu!
.
When they are done eating, customers take a quick nap. Take advantage of their inattention to absorb a part of their soul! Souls can then be used to improve your restaurant!
.
.
Invest the souls you stole to build up your kitchen with upgrades! These decisions change the way you play and are crucial for unlocking new recipes and increasing your profit. Opt for more storage capacity with a fridge expansion to use more ingredients, or tools like a new blender or more stoves to increase your productivity. You can even invest in an automatic dishwasher! Buy more tables to host more and more hungry customers. Decorate your restaurant with fine taste to increase your customer’s patience… and tips! Take some classes and improve your serving skills to get better tips, or specialize in some recipes and increase your prices. Will you decide to master the art of donuts or to unlock the secrets of smoothies? It’s up to you!

title: Stock the Shelves
description:
게임 정보

You're starting your journey as an entrepreneur! You're opening your own shop! Oh how terrifying the future seems. Thankfully you're not alone, your Uncle Dirk is here to support you. But something doesn't seem quite right with him, he's got dollar bills in his eyes and a bit too big of a grin on his face. Though you're probably overthinking it, he's just here to help, right?

Story
You'll be starting at the bottom with a rundown shop which you'll slowly turn into a thriving establishment. Buy new items, hire a helping hand, or 2, OR 3! Tend to customers, stock shelves. All with a juicy story of betrayal layered on top.



Store Management
Alright it's time to get into the nitty gritty of it all. In Stock the Shelves you have one goal, KEEP CUSTOMERS HAPPY! That means no shelf can be left empty. You'll be spending your days running all around the store grabbing items and putting them on shelves. Each customer has a unique shopping list which MUST be fulfilled or they won't leave happily.



When a customer can't find an item on their shopping list they can get real angry real fast. All hope is not yet lost though. You have one final chance to save this sale. If you manage to give them the remaining items on their shopping list in time before the timer runs out you'll turn an angry customer back into a happy one!



Stocking shelves is a tough task, restocking a shelf requires first completing a Restock Challenge. Each item you sell in your shop has a unique Restock Challenge. These can vary from a simple timed button press, to pressing a series of randomized inputs, or even requiring you pay attention to other elements such as the current time of day to complete the challenge correctly.

title: Quandary
description:
게임 정보

In Quandary, a moral dilemma unfolds. As a doctor facing an unimaginable choice, you must make your emotional and logical self cooperate to find a solution, even when the law offers no answers.

Quandary is an intriguing 2D puzzle platformer where your character's internal struggle is brought to life. Your logic and empathy take form as two separate characters, moving in opposite directions, forcing you to strategically utilize both to navigate challenging puzzles.

Can you find harmony within this chaos and solve puzzles that seem impossible, ultimately deciding the fate of your suffering patient?

You control two bodies that move in opposite directions!
You control two bodies that move in opposite directions and represent your empathy and logic.



Solve puzzles to reach the light.






Duh, he is you, and you are him...

title: Death's Web
description:
게임 정보
"Death's Web" is a challenging "Rogue-lite" platformer where you explore an ever-changing 2D world filled with enemies ready to slay you. Fight, die, learn repeat.
Features:
Collector of Souls: You posess the ability to steal enemies souls after they die. you can secure the souls through soul spheres and use them after death to permanently increase your stats and upgrade spells.
Curses: Numerous curses are waiting to be discovered; they may lead to your demise, but they can be exchanged for blessings to aid your journey. Survive their devastating effects to claim your rewards. Curses can blind you, summon deadly spikes, unleash freezing hail, and much more—each one a unique challenge to overcome!
 Blessings: Some will heal you, others grant powerful new abilities, and some can completely absorb incoming damage. They enhance gameplay with unique effects, making each run more dynamic and engaging!

title: Joninės
description:
게임 정보
Four friends in early 90's go to celebrate Midsummer's day in an island in a middle of a lake.
Little do they know of what awaits them.
In this story rich horror tale you will have to survive and find your friends.
Game is in Lithuanian language with English subtitles.

title: Track Racing: The Holy Rosary
Stop The Slimes
description:
게임 정보
Stop The Slimes is a tower defense card-based game where you need to protect their realm from a relentless invasion of the slimes.

What’s the gameplay like?

You will draw a hand of cards.
Using energy you can places your cards to build towers.
After each level you can pick from three new cards to help build your deck.



Levels can cap your deck to a max number of cards.
The deck builder screen will let you select the cards you want!

title: Two Sides
description:
게임 정보
Two Sides is a unique sandbox where you explore the duality of choices. Play as a savior or a sinner, navigating through complex scenarios that challenge your morality. You create your own story. This isn't a game about good vs evil, your choices have consequences and there's no clear path to achieving your objective without any side effects.

Features:

- Simulated sandbox environment with NPCs that respond to your actions.
- Consequences where any character can become a witness to your action.
- Realistic physics & gunplay.
- Infinite replayability through randomized levels.

Every action you take affects how the level can play out. Are you going to shoot an innocent just because they saw you break the law so you don't get caught? Or are you going to shooting someone accidentally just to get to an objective faster?

Two Sides is a top down tactical shooter where you navigate a detailed sandbox full of interactions.

Are you prepared to make tough choices? Will you risk people's lives to conceal your mistakes, or will you take the difficult path to preserve your morality? In Two Sides you can choose how you want to approach things.

title: Dangerous Galaxy
Circle Defense
description:
게임 정보
I know you have rich experience in defending the Earth!
CIRCLE is a tower defense game with a light card system, where you will play as a commander defending the Earth: by building/upgrading weapons on a rotating device called "CIRCLE" and using cards to deal with the continuously invading aliens.


Origin of the CIRCLE
One day, the moon was hit and destroyed by unknown creatures, and the debris turned into a circle around the Earth. Due to concerns about the unknown creatures, humans transformed the lunar circle into the CIRCLE device and deployed cosmic-level defense weapons on it.



Under the pressure of alien attacks, the human military technology tree continues to evolve, and its functions are summarized into command cards, waiting for the commander to issue orders.
The energy for the cards comes from the CIRCLE: the faster the Ring rotates, the higher the energy generation rate, but it seems to affect the aiming rhythm for deploying weapons.



- Level-based game: each successful defense against alien attacks will greatly enhance Earth's weapon defense technology, continuously unlocking new weapon types, upgrade items, and new technology cards.
- The combination of different weapon upgrade projects and different cards will create a multitude of possibilities.
- Each type of monster has its own behavior patterns and characteristics, so make sure to respond based on your understanding of them!
- Besides monsters, you also have to face the harsh cosmic environment, and some levels will force you to abandon common strategies to try more suitable solutions.
- You can press the space bar at any time to slow down time for more time to think about strategies and operations; or maybe you just want to see the fireworks in slow motion?

title: Phenomena Embattled
description:
게임 정보
From the far reaching void of space, to the very cores of planets. This is where Phenomena Embattled takes place. You are part of an alien confederation sent to earth to find the means of ending an intergalactic conflict. Humanity is caught between alien star-fleets. They must strive to keep their place in the universe. You must find the path to complete your mission.
The game is a physics based shoot 'em up. Interact with squadrons and entire fleets in a story driven world. This single player narrative focuses on action rich, rouge-like, trans-medium combat. Be it air, water, or vacuum. The medium you steer your unexplained vehicle through will determine your capabilities. And the ones of your enemies.
Features:
Physics based interactive environment
Action driven missions and story
Intelligent enemies
Formation flying
Ability leveling
Choose your unexplained phenomenon
60+ base units to fight with and against
Many unique undisclosed encounters
Underground bases

title: Barbarization
description:
게임 정보
Defeat enemies in each room to unlock your next reward. Survive longer for better rewards or escape through the next open door if you have to.
Collect ability cards, weapons, and trinkets to build a unique character each run. Experiment with different combinations of abilities, buffs and stat upgrades to find powerful synergies.

title: AO: Containment Breach
description:
게임 정보
There's been a Containment Breach within the AO facility on Terra. You're being sent in to establish communications with the other teams inside and to Contain what AOs have broken containment.
AO: Containment Breach is a Procedurally Generated, Level Building, Semi-Auto-Battling, Rogue-lite, Horror hybrid. Fight and Contain AOs as you make your way through the Containment Breach of the Terra AO facility. During "Dives" scavenge for Materials to bring back to the hub to Craft unique Weapons, Upgrades, and Gear. Build Craft unique and interesting strategies to combat hostile entities. Answers to the breach lay deep within the facility...

CONTAIN: Assume all AO containments have been breached. Figure out the Containment Procedures by looking for clues and other means to Re-Contain them.

title: I Hate Orcs: In My Garden
description:
게임 정보
Orc Wizards have broken your defenses and invaded your gardens! As a humble gardener, you do not have any tools to attack these Orcs. To remove them, you must find the areas that the Orcs have broken through and fix them.
Avoid the Orcs' projectiles by jumping, dodging, and dashing in this third-person 3D game!
autokwd: I Hate Orcs: In My Garden

title: The Mnemograph
description:
게임 정보
A new evening newspaper is hitting the streets, and it's yours. But The Mnemograph Chronicle isn't just another one of the dozens of flimsy 'rags' that people devour every day. This is a paper written by a machine, the Mnemograph. For a genius inventor, what could be easier than creating a system capable of extracting information from the carefully harvested brains of unclaimed bodies at the municipal morgue? All that remained was to build an automated printing factory, so the power of steam could spread across the city, delivering news that chronicles its own downfall.
The rise of the press attracts entrepreneurs of varying scruples every day, so... why not you?
Your printing factory will need to be upgraded to achieve production speeds that can compete with the best-established publishers and reduce costs; regular repairs will also be necessary. The accuracy of the Mnemograph can be enhanced to improve the quality of the journal. You'll also need to manage stocks of paper, ink, copper, and coal.
But most importantly, you'll need to carve out a place for yourself in a hostile world where anything goes. You'll have to get your hands dirty with the city's underworld, exploit its criminal talents, get involved in its schemes, pay for its services, and wade through the muck of corruption under the cover of night.
Build a Unique Deck by Purchasing Services from the Underworld
At night, you'll need to protect yourself from rival newspaper moguls who will try to sabotage you as you rise to the top. But if you want to own the biggest paper in the city, you'll also have to go on the offensive, enlisting the services of the underworld.
As you progress, you'll encounter new characters. Each one offers different services tailored to a specific style of play. For instance, the crime boss provides basic services like thugs (orange cards), while the politician offers protection services (blue cards).
You get to decide who you want to meet, allowing you to build a unique deck with a personalized play style.
Manage Your Supplies, Upgrade Your Printing Factory, and Make Repairs
Carefully manage your supplies by buying and selling goods based on current prices to maximize profits. Upgrade your printing factory to reduce resource consumption and cautiously increase production speeds. Maintain your machines regularly to minimize the risk of breakdowns.

title: Whispering Age
description:
게임 정보
Command Manager!
In whispering age you command your units by speaking with your managers, who then try... to fulfill your orders!
Assign Tasks!
Tell your managers to gather resources, construct structures, or defend the village. You'll at times need to calm your managers as civil war can break out!

title: Casual Trucking
description:
게임 정보
Casual Trucking is a laid-back delivery simulator without any time pressure.

It's a small game, a sort of experiment with 3d and chill gameplay. Something that you can play while listening to your favorite podcast.

- Choose a delivery mission, head to the location and pick up the truck and cargo
- Buy different trucks for specific delivery missions
- Purchase real estate and gain passive income

title: Enter the Nemesis: Blood Portal
description:
게임 정보
Be prepared to hack, slash, shoot, and torch your way through these bloody levels of platforms. You will be creating part of the platforms yourself by killing your enemies - when an enemy is killed his dead body becomes a platform you can move on. You have to kill enough enemies in order to reveal the hidden blood portals, and pile up the dead bodies of the enemies in order to reach the portal and exit the level and enter the next one. Ultimate goal is to go through all the levels and portals to find your abducted step sister, and try to finish the Nemesis. This game is a bloody action platform adventure.

title: Peerless Destiny 绝世天命
description:
게임 정보
The game includes over 50 different types of growth skills that players can obtain, with over two hundred thousand words of game plot and character dialogues. In addition to over 50 sets of different types of equipment that players can obtain, scattered throughout the universe are several sets of ancient artifacts recording ancient secrets waiting for players to acquire and unlock. One hundred different effects of Fate Seals allow players to gain the blessings of destiny in intense battles...

The story takes place in a remote star domain we call Havendia, where the powers of elements such as gold, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, and thunder are the source of all energy. There are a total of eight major races here, and the peace that has been maintained for nearly a thousand years seems to have come to an end...
Exciting and Unique 3D Combat Visual Experience

We place great importance on depicting the combat process, drawing inspiration from various literary and artistic works to make "Peerless Destiny" stand out!
Featuring an innovative 3D spatial combat system, battles can extend from the ground to the sky, with unique camera effects presenting grand scenes of a fantastical world. Engage in battles as seen in novels and animations, where you can perform extraordinary feats like soaring through the air and unleashing incredible powers!
Fundamental Combat System

Blocking, dodging, parrying—inspired by the core elements of Souls-like games, we have made modifications to these mechanics. We offer various difficulty modes to cater to a broader range of players. Even against formidable bosses, players can engage in intense back-and-forth battles!
Satisfying Combo System

By interacting precisely with the keys, players can trigger combos and lengthen their duration. A well-executed combo can potentially turn the tide of a battle in an instant!
Environment Interaction Enhances Realism in Combat

Your skills not only serve as weapons to damage enemies but also have environmental impacts, capable of causing destruction in various settings—whether small villages or large cities, you have the power to wreak havoc. If you enjoy, hmm, demolition work, this could be a great choice!

Both NPCs and monsters intelligently respond to attacks by dodging, fleeing, blocking, counterattacking, and more. They offer real-time voice responses expressing disdain, fear, and other emotions towards you. In this world, each creature reacts differently based on its unique personality! Voice conversations between you and characters make the game livelier, ensuring you don't feel like a lonely warrior. Additionally, precise collision detection between creatures and the environment allows interactions such as kicking rocks on the ground or sending enemies flying through impact!

In addition to the normal "Story Mode", there are two modes to choose from: "Revisiting Old Dreams" and "Trial of Heaven"
"Revisiting Old Dreams" mode, you are randomly teleported to a previously defeated boss and immediately engage in battle. Hone your combat skills and earn additional rewards.
"Trial of Heaven" mode, also known as the "Heavenly Trial Grounds", you will face several replicated boss entities! This place is unstable. Anomalies can occur at any time! For example, encountering temporal disturbances that cause fluctuations in the flow of time, or facing imbalances in gravity, and even adverse environments that disrupt the minds of creatures.
Sustaining the "Heavenly Trial Grounds" requires a significant amount of energy, with the activity area continuously shrinking to reduce consumption. So, please eliminate your targets quickly; otherwise, you will have to face a siege by all bosses without any escape routes.
Of course, if you perform well in the trial, you can obtain not just more experience, equipment, and treasures but also Destiny Marks with random effects.

Customize your own exclusive skills and character growth path. Both skills and characters are capable of growth. The choice between specialization or a comprehensive development path is entirely up to you. The unique Thunder Tribulation system requires characters to undergo a Thunder Tribulation test with each growth, giving you a greater sense of ceremony, mission, and achievement!

We offer various ways to earn Lucky Points, which can be used to draw Destiny Marks. These marks provide different types of destiny-enhancing effects, such as invincibility aura or time dilation. This system combines elements of metaphysical concepts like the I Ching and Bagua!

Wielding the sacred artifact of heaven and earth, you guide the cycle of destiny! By unlocking celestial artifacts, you empower yourself with mysterious and endless strength, commanding unknown miracles within the cosmos!

The Celestial Stele leaderboard comprises four types of rankings. You can compete with players globally, showcase your achievements among friends, or contribute to regional competitions! The Celestial Stele was originally a heaven-defying divine object, stealing a glimpse of celestial secrets to create these leaderboards!

Embark on an incredible gaming journey with "Peerless Destiny"! Immerse yourself in a whole new gaming experience, merging captivating storytelling with interactive gameplay.

Discover a narrative fusion of novels, anime, and immersive gameplay. Experience the rebirth of a near-fallen protagonist, whose newfound strength uncovers deeper secrets of this world.

Engage in breathtaking 3D combat offering free-flight, earth-shattering battles. Destroy environments, from forests to entire villages, showcasing the true power of your character. Brace yourself for intense battles that surpass conventional limits.

Traverse a fantastical landscape filled with richly detailed environments. Witness the aftermath of destructive battles, leaving shattered vistas and scattered remnants. Indulge in the realism and engage in strategic gameplay.

Ascend to new heights through electrifying trials after accumulating sufficient experience points. Avoid fluxing time, gravitational imbalance, and cognitive disruptions. Triumph over challenges and unlock "Destiny" bonus effects.

Radiant with the light of wisdom, system sprites descend upon the dazzling starry skies of "Peerless Destiny". They are eager to establish a closer bond with you and explore the realms of fantasy together.
The game offers four difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard, and Devil.
Easy and Normal modes provide a satisfying grass-cutting experience where skills automatically target enemies, making gameplay relatively simple.
Hard and Devil modes are somewhat similar to souls-like games, requiring manual targeting of skills and utilizing actions like blocking, dodging, and parrying to avoid damage. Otherwise, death comes easily. The gameplay is slightly more complex.
Believe me, the Devil difficulty level will be the most challenging experience you'd rather not speak about! ^^~

title: Lotus: Lost Memories
description:
게임 정보
Lotus: Lost Memories is a pixel art side-scrolling adventure with a unique take on turn-based combat! Experience a fresh blend of strategy and action, with Quick Time Events that add a dynamic edge to each battle.
Step into the richly woven tale of Atsushi, a young samurai bound by duty to his ailing father. Navigate alliances, rivalries, and dark secrets from a hidden past that threaten to alter his path. Undertake a journey of loyalty, honor, and betrayal as he faces skilled adversaries and uncovers the echoes of a legacy that will shape his destiny.
Experience a fresh take on turn-based combat. Engage in calculated battles where timing and strategy are everything. Master QTE (Quick Time Events) to give yourself an edge in combat. Dodge, block, or unleash a ranged attack to turn the tide of battle.

title: Ignifugo
description:
게임 정보
Ignifugo is a top-down action roguelite with auto battler elements. Choose your own path through five biomes with procedurally generated maps as you control a combat shell with slots for placing units. Units are the primary way of attacking and trigger their abilities automatically while you maneuver the character to avoid incoming hits. Strategically place units in the shell, as each one is damaged individually and can break, leaving it unusable until the next level. Once all units break your shell shatters and reveals the core – a second playable character which does not have access to unit abilities anymore.

Borrowing from the auto-battler genre, each unit has their own abilities, belongs to a set of classes and can be leveled to gain health and additional abilities. Having multiple units of one class in your shell unlocks class bonuses. As you fight through different biomes you earn currency which can be spent on buying/ upgrading units and different kinds of items.





Unique blend of action gameplay and strategic shell modification
Hand drawn vector art style


















Over 120 items can be earned and bought as rewards from elites, bosses and certain map encounters. Passive items apply a permanent modification, consumables trigger unique one-time effects, active items grant abilities/ skills which can be used multiple times per battle and melee weapons provide a secondary way of outputting short range damage actively.

Create millions of interesting builds by choosing the perfect items for the units in your shell. If you want to stand against the flame, smart choices matter a lot!





Each run is different, as maps and levels are randomly generated and vary in complexity per biome. Some stages might be peaceful while others are riddled with biome specific obstacles and hazards. Choose the right path for your current build to move forward in your pursuit of the flame.






Strategy is not only important when buying units and equipping your shell, certain actions and items modify the HEAT LEVEL which dynamically changes the difficulty of the run. Higher heat reaps better rewards, but also makes fights harder. Will you play it save or risk burning yourself?



Do not expect to breeze through every biome, over 60 enemies, elites and bosses with different move sets stand in your way. Defeat bosses and elites for item crystals which contain passive items. Prepare for heated battles if you want to stand against THE FLAME.





If you manage to defeat THE FLAME with a specific shell, you unlock additional difficulty levels for it, called incandescence. Each incandescence level provides permanent modifiers to the run, from enemy health variation to manipulating the map generation.
And who knows what might happen if one manages to beat the highest incandescence...



Hey there, this game was solo developed and is inspired by elements of some of my favourite games. The goal was creating a fun, unique and replayable blend of contrasting genres. If you have any feedback or just want to have a friendly chat, feel free to join our Discord server, we would love to hear from you :) I hope you enjoy the game and have a lot of fun!

Impious is a dark, turn-based roguelite RPG that immerses you in the oppressive depths of an underground indoctrination center set in a time reminiscent of modern days, yet not quite our present. As one of the "Impious," you are captured for your sins and subjected to the brutal attempts of a medieval sect to cleanse your soul through pain and obedience. Will you reclaim your freedom, or will you succumb to the brainwashing horrors within?
Features
Strategic Turn-based Combat
Engage in tactical battles where every decision counts. Utilize a variety of weapons, equipment, and consumables to gain the upper hand. Adapt your strategy by anticipating enemy moves and exploiting critical hits, dodges, and status effects.
Unique Death Mechanics
Death is not the end. When your character falls, they are returned to their cell, stripped of their gear, and subjected to further indoctrination. Manage your character's "Will" to prevent them from becoming permanently brainwashed.
Challenging Environments
Navigate through rooms filled with enemies and diverse challenges. Success relies on your equipment and stats, with varying outcomes that shape your journey. Gain experience, loot valuable items, and restore your Will through these trials.
Interact With other Characters
Meet and interact with characters you have created in previous runs. Trade items, offer motivation, and collaborate to increase your chances of escape, adding depth to the narrative and strategy.
Immersive Atmosphere
Explore the harsh, angular environments of a brutalist indoctrination center, dominated by concrete and metal. The cold, artificial lighting creates a claustrophobic and oppressive ambiance. Characters wear torturous medieval garb, emphasizing the sect's cruel methods.
Engaging Sound and Music
Experience a haunting soundscape and a unique soundtrack that blends medieval tones with 80s-inspired synth, enhancing the dark and foreboding atmosphere.
Impious offers a relentless challenge for fans of roguelites, dark RPGs, and strategy games. As you delve deeper into the center, each step brings you closer to freedom or eternal indoctrination. Are you prepared to face the horrors within and reclaim your will?

게임 정보
Swing Boy는 스윙을 새로운 차원으로 끌어올린 정밀 플랫폼 게임입니다. 그랩훅을 사용해 지하에서 탈출하여 지상으로 돌아가세요. 당신이 떠난 동안 무엇이 변했나요? 무엇이 남았나요?
지상으로 탈출하는 것은 쉽지 않습니다! 유독한 하수도를 가로지르고, 버려진 지하 연구소를 탐험하며, 위험한 적들을 피해야 합니다. Swing Boy는 현대적인 물리학과 레트로 픽셀 아트 스타일을 결합하여, 솔로와 협동 플레이 모두에게 잊을 수 없는 경험을 제공합니다.
스토리 모드 몰입감 있는 이야기
로컬 & 온라인 협동 모드
파티 모드: 감염, 타임 트라이얼 등
20개 이상의 Steam 업적
12개 이상의 잠금 해제 가능한 캐릭터
멋진 보스 전투

title: Kiki's Nightmare
description:
게임 정보
In Kiki's Nightmare, players step into the shoes of a fearless hero tasked with rescuing princess Kiki trapped in her own twisted dreams. As the dream world comes to life around you, you'll traverse unhospitable landscapes, battle nightmarish creatures, and possibly solve intricate puzzles that test both your wits and bravery. Can you free her before the dream consumes her mind forever, or will the evil that haunts her dreams claim victory? Only the bravest can conquer the nightmare!

title: Hogtie
description:
게임 정보

Hogtie는 서부의 영웅 테드의 부츠를 신은 당신을 성공의 열쇠인 믿음직한 라소와 함께하는 수상 경력에 빛나는 여정으로 안내합니다. 이 창고반 (Sokoban) 퍼즐 게임은 각 레벨에서 서로 다른 생물 군계를 가로질러 도망친 돼지들을 모으는 과제를 통해 진정한 목동처럼 생각하도록 도전합니다.

메카닉:

밀기가 불가능
이 돼지들은 밀어서 이동할 수 없습니다. 라소를 사용해 끌어야 하며, 이는 고전적인 창고반 퍼즐 메커닉에 새로운 변화를 가져옵니다.



라소
당신의 라소는 생명선이 됩니다. 라소를 사용해 도망친 돼지들을 다시 우리로 끌어들이며, 위험한 환경을 탐험하게 됩니다. 각 레벨은 치명적인 장애물을 피하는 것부터 환경적 위험을 전략적으로 피하는 것까지, 라소 기술을 시험하는 메커닉으로 도전합니다.



모든 발걸음이 중요합니다
움직임의 효율성에 따라 각 레벨에서 최대 세 개의 별을 얻을 수 있습니다. 퍼즐을 최대한 효율적으로 풀 것인지, 좀 더 느긋하게 접근할 것인지는 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞춰 도전을 결정할 수 있습니다.




농장 스타일이나 서부의 매력을 좋아하시나요? 멋진 정장이나 가죽으로 완전히 꾸민 스타일은 어떤가요? 걱정 마세요. Hogtie에서는 테드와 그의 믿음직한 말을 개인의 취향과 스타일에 맞게 커스터마이즈할 수 있습니다.



부츠의 먼지를 털고, 라소를 잡고, 서부가 본 적 없는 가장 야생적인 퍼즐을 해결할 준비를 하세요. 돼지들을 묶을 준비가 되셨나요?

title: God in a Closet
description:
게임 정보
Enter the mysterious house of a witch in this short adventure game to find the answers behind a hunter's quest. A strange presence looms over you, you cannot turn back.
FEATURES
A unique hand-drawn artstyle inspired by Angel's Egg and old fairytales
Simple puzzles and easy gameplay
Explore the house, read documents and speak to the witch to resolve the dangers inside
An immersive and eerie experience to be finished in one sitting (under an hour)
GAMEPLAY
Pick up useful objects in your inventory, use them alone or combined to get through the levels.

title: The Pale Piper
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a haunting world steeped in mystery and sorrow, where a once vibrant town now stands desolate, its streets silent and its buildings echoing with the ghosts of the past. All that remains are the memories of long vanished children, lured away by the Piper's haunting melody. Now, as the last one remaining in this desolate landscape, the mayor beckons you forth, entrusting you with a perilous quest: to venture into the depths of this twisted reality, rescue the lost children, and unravel the mysteries lurking within the shadows. Prepare to embark on a journey of courage, determination, and discovery in a world where the echoes of the Piper's flute still linger.
Hundreds of Handcrafted and Challenging Rooms: Navigate through meticulously designed levels filled with precision platforming challenges, each crafted to test your skills and reflexes.
Jump, Run, and Roll Mechanics: Master the core gameplay mechanics of jumping, running, and rolling as you traverse the world, utilizing precise timing and skillful maneuvers to overcome obstacles, hazards and enemies.
Seamless World: Immerse yourself in a seamlessly interconnected world. Explore distinct environments, each with its own unique obstacles, enemies, and secrets to uncover.
Boss Battles: Challenge formidable bosses scattered throughout the world, each with their own unique mechanics and patterns to master.

title: God Of This World
description:
게임 정보
God Of This World took a couple of classic RPG ideas and modernized them into a 3D top-down shooter. You'll have to explore a logical world while collecting health, jewels, keys, bullets, shield bombs, unlock doors, destroy enemy portals, all while shooting down non-stop seeker robot enemies with regular and tactical guns, enemies who are all set to fire back. Make your way to the boss of each level, and find secrets, as each level gets progressively harder.

title: Card Clash Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
🌟 Introducing Card Clash Chronicles🌟
Embark on a thrilling journey across a cool little world, mastering the art of the Card Clash card game. As you traverse the cityscapes, you'll face off against six legendary opponents to earn your ticket to the World Card Game Tournament!

🃏 Gameplay: Immerse yourself in strategic card battles reminiscent of old school card games and minigames. Collect over 100 cards for your deck, hone your skills, and outwit opponents in intense duels. The winner takes cards from the loser, take care not to lose your cards!

🌍 World Exploration: Explore various parts of Den Den Town as well as other regions, each brimming with unique challenges and hidden secrets. Uncover the stories behind your rivals as you journey towards the ultimate showdown.

🏆 Epic Tournament: Conquer the six special opponents to secure your entry to the prestigious World Card Game Tournament. Will you emerge as the ultimate duelist and claim victory?

title: Goob
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey into the depths of a mysterious and treacherous underground world. This adventure lets you explore vast caves, battle ferocious monsters, mine for precious minerals, and upgrade your abilities in order to survive.

Underground World: Immerse yourself in an interconnected underground world filled with mysteries waiting to be unveiled. Traverse treacherous terrains brimming with unique challenges, secrets, and opportunities for discovery.

Mining for Riches: Dig deep into the earth to obtain a wide variety of valuable minerals including; gemstones, and rare crystals. The deeper you go, the more valuable the resources will be.

Abilities and Upgrades: As you progress, your character will gather precious materials to unlock new abilities and powers. Upgrade your offensive abilities to enhance your effectiveness in battle or upgrade your soft skills to increase your chances of survival… The choice is yours.

Exploration Awaits: Immerse yourself in a sprawling and visually stunning world. You'll encounter a diverse array of formidable creatures and monsters lurking within the shadows. Engage in thrilling battles by using a variety of skills to protect your loot and unravel the secrets hidden beneath the earth's surface.

GOOB’s world invites players to embark on a captivating journey of discovery, survival, and growth. Will you conquer the depths, confront the darkness, and ultimately find a way out of this dangerous world? Start your Adventure soon!

title: Mumble Pines: The Arrival
description:
게임 정보
What you get:
A Nightmare Beneath the Surface – A remote island, a hidden underground research facility, and horrors that should have never been awakened. Experience an intense 3-4 hour horror journey.
Nowhere is Safe – Something is hunting you—multiple entities lurk in the shadows, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
A Dark and Twisted Mystery – You came here searching for your brother, but what you’ll uncover goes far beyond a simple disappearance.
A World of Fear and Discovery – The island hides disturbing secrets. Dare to explore, and you may find things that will haunt you forever.
A Deeply Unsettling Atmosphere – Oppressive darkness, eerie silence, and spine-chilling jumpscares make this an unforgettable horror experience.
Explore the Island – Venture beyond the main path… but be warned, some discoveries are better left undisturbed.
You will never Leave again!

THE ISLAND AWAITS YOU.....

title: Echoes of Myth
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of Myth is a roguelite soulslike set in a broken, ever-changing fantasy world where gods have fallen silent. Choose your class and path, tactically battling enemies and bosses. Collect unique loot, unlock talents, and permanently enhance your character. Die, learn, and rise stronger.
Soulslike Combat
Engage in challenging combat against formidable enemies and bosses. Utilize a mix of melee attacks and spells, relying on well-timed dodges and parries to survive. Choose from different classes, each offering a unique weapon, spells, and talents that fit your playstyle.
Explore a Fragmented Fantasy World
Navigate through a broken, ever-changing realm where gods have fallen silent. Chart your own course through multiple routes filled with secrets and mysteries to uncover. Each path offers new challenges and discoveries in this dynamic world.

title: Trifoil
description:
게임 정보
Learn about the mysteries of Trifoil by exploring and solving line drawing puzzles. In Trifoil the line always interacts with itself, in this rules discovery open world logic puzzle game.
Trifoil will have over 200 hand-crafted puzzles designed to slowly expose the players to the puzzle rules, flip them on their head then introduce new ones. If you like thinky games, rule-discovery and twists this is for you.

title: Wizard Cats Tank Battle
description:
게임 정보

Choose from seven classes and fight other Wizard Cats in Wizard Cats Tank Battle, a cross-platform multiplayer game!

Wizard Cats Tank Battle puts a fantasy RPG twist on the classic arena shooter genre, with mechanics inspired by MMORPGs, MOBAs, and ARPGs. The gameplay emphasizes teamwork and support while focusing on skill and precision.

As you play, you’ll earn Cat Coins, which you can use to customize your Wizard Cat’s fur patterns, body types, hats, wands, tanks, and meows.
Classes
Choose from 7 Wizard Cat classes designed for damage, tank, and support roles. Every class has unique class abilities, including a buff, debuff, and ultimate, as well as unique stats.

Pyro-Prancer - Fire DPS
Hydro-Dancer - Water Support
Furricane - Air Glass Cannon
Purrth-Quake - Earth Tank
Pawadin - Light Support
Necropouncer - Death Tank
Voidstalker - Void Disruptor

Winning is about choosing classes that synergize well within your team, so you can effectively counter your opponents! Players are free, and encouraged, to swap classes mid-game.

Buffs are applied when projectiles hit allies. Debuffs are applied when projectiles hit enemies.

Customize your Wizard Cat with a variety of fur patterns, body types, hats, wands, tanks, and battle cries. Find your cat’s unique voice by choosing from a community-sourced collection of meows!

Your cat will meow loudly every time you defeat another player, taunting the defeated and announcing your kill to the rest of the arena.

Earn coins as you battle and unlock exciting tanks, hats, and wands!
Collect powerups around the map, including special spells such as Exploding MIssiles and Bouncing Bolt. Collect special buffs such as Zoomies (speed boost), Nipped Up (shoot faster), Storm of Claws (increased melee damage), Reflection Bubble (missiles reflect off the player) and more!
Have you ever been in a situation where you're playing a game with friends and there’s that one person who is either too experienced or too novice to really enjoy it?

The combat system in Wizard Cats Tank Battle was designed to ensure it is fun for everyone!

Novice players will benefit from the simplicity of playing a support roll: the same missiles that damage your enemies buff your allies! So, if you want a less experienced friend to have fun, tell them to stand behind you and shoot you in the back!

Experienced Wizard Cats players can use their knowledge to guide their allies into picking the best classes for the situation.

title: SwingHard VR
description:
게임 정보
A Dark Fantasy Boss Rush VR game inspired by Thrill of The Fight X Dark Souls, that will give you a real workout!
Features
Several bosses each with their own unique fighting style, special moves, and mechanics.
Multiple weapons. Swing with axes or punch and elbow with unique weapon "Claw Shields". More weapons coming soon.
Damage based on how fast you swing. You can't just wiggle the controller to do damage like other VR games.
You have to move your body to dodge! Duck, Sway, Dash, and even Jump to avoid damage.
If space is limited use unique "Squat to move mechanic" where you can use joystick to move but it requires squatting in real life, ensuring a workout!
Multiple difficulty modes. And, customize boss specific variables and player stats to create your own challenges.
Dark story coming soon! What unholy power has corrupted humans into monsters? Can it be harnessed for good?
Better graphics, sound effects, soundtracks, and more coming soon!
WORKOUT GUARANTEED!
Credits
Song in trailer: Mellow Sonic - Gravitational Singularity (Xanomeline Remix)

title: Squad Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Squad Tactics is a Turn-Based Tactical RPG with unique combat mechanics and leveling system designed from scratch.
Complex but intuitive combat system, easy to understand but hard to master. Full control of every aspect of your units allowes multiple ways to handle any given situation. It's not about the units in play, but how do you handle them.
Everything is designed for high customizability and replayability.
Squad Composition
Squads are composed of one Hero plus 1 to 6 minions. Killing the enemy Hero is enough for victory but minions shall do everything possible to prevent this from happening, resulting in ever-changing dynamics never seen in any other game.
Different playing styles and squad compositions allow for tank heroes to soak up damage, high mobility heroes for hit-and-run tactics, heal and support heroes for enhanced minion effectiveness and much more.
Additional settings allow for up to 3 heroes per squad simultaneously, for experienced players who prefer even higher complexity.

title: Deus Proxy
description:
게임 정보
A New Kind of Auto Battler

Deus Proxy is a roguelike that brings together the most exciting aspects of new-school auto battlers and old-school tabletop gaming. Every game is a completely new adventure with 15 factions, human opponents, and hundreds of heroes, items, traits, and spells!
Asynchronous Multiplayer

In Deus Proxy you play through hand-crafted PvE and one-of-a-kind PvP encounters. Any army that wins a PvP encounter becomes an adversary in other player’s games. You see the enemy armies before picking your cards and designing your own army, which rewards drafting a diverse deck to counter the challenges you might face instead of playing the most "meta" cards.
Comprehensive In-Game Information

Tired of "wiki games" that require you to constantly alt-tab to see what a powerup does? Every spell, item, hero, unit, trait, buff, faction and game mechanic is explained in a searchable in-game compendium. When designing your army, an overlay tool is present to quickly view any stat of every unit on the field. Within seconds you can discover ways to counter your opponent.
Endless Theorycrafting

Every game of Deus Proxy is a possibility to try new strategies and find new synergies! There are no implicit faction bonuses, all bonuses come from items and spells related to that faction. Your plant-based army might focus on empowering ranged units to entangle far-away targets, giving army-wide regeneration bonuses to make your treants walking tanks, or just being immune to the acid rain your mage caused. Because you have 1-3 battles per turn, it is vital to keep your armies adaptable for each new challenge!

Heroes can equip any item that you obtain, and can cast any spell they have the slightest proficiency to cast. A huge variety of builds are possible, and the traits and stats a hero has are only a suggestion of what they're capable of when properly equipped.

title: Sauna Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"Sauna Simulator" is a funny business simulator. Buy premises, equip them with a sauna stove and start earning from it!
You inherit a sauna stove and decide to open your own sauna business. You have a large area at your disposal, divided into rooms, which you can buy and put there any stove from the store.
While your business is small, you will do all the work yourself: please customers, clean the room, put firewood in the sauna stove. However, as your sauna expands, you'll be able to hire employees to take care of all the chores you don't want to do.
Customers leave feedback. If your customers don't like your sauna: poor service, dirty facilities, etc., they will definitely leave a bad review. If, on the other hand, you take complete care of your customers, they will leave you a positive rating. Based on these ratings, you will see the average rating of your sauna.
You should not forget about safety. If your stove is cheap, then it will have a high chance of catching fire. In such cases you will need fire extinguishers, which of course you can buy at the store.

title: Break Shot Hero
description:
게임 정보
OVERVIEW
Everyone is balls! Flick your balls to victory in this billiards-like tactical RPG!
FEATURES
Angle your shots off of walls & obstacles to find your path to success! Predictive trajectories help you make tricky shots if you can imagine them.
Collect a cast of miniature characters! There are no micro-transactions, no FOMO - only the old fashioned grind. Every hero and monster can be recruited!

title: Wirelight
description:
게임 정보
A tiny turn-based tactical... soulslike! Explore a twisty, interconnected world, battle enemies using a unique spin on a 'posture' system, and employ various upgrades to your advantage.
Turn-Based Soulslike Combat
Alternate turns with enemies in turn-based combat with a unique posture system. You have the option to attack directly, but can also deal damage by knocking enemies out of position, into walls, or even blocking their movement with your own body.
Countless Combinations of Items
Unlock and discover equippable "toolsets" granting special abilities, "modules" to give various passive boosts, and weapons with unique shapes and hidden qualities.  Customize your build as you explore and fight through the challenging terrain.
A Twisty World
Explore six distinct zones through a sprawling, highly (and unpredictably) interconnected world.  Unlock shortcuts, double back to find secrets of challenge difficult enemies, and uncover the hidden depths of this tiny but intricate world.

title: TritonXR: Reality Warfare LIVE
description:
게임 정보
TritonXR: LIVE turns ANY venue into a dynamic multiplayer combat arena. Scan your venue in, setup in minutes, and run your LBE experinces from anywhere!
NOTE: TritonXR: Reality Warfare LIVE is designed for LBE businesses. If you're a consumer, please check out TritonXR: Reality Warfare (visit our developer page above)!
World-First XR
TritonXR has the latest of XR tech - the "Real Life Mode" utilises the Quest 3/3s's XR features to create a mode where it truly feels like you're battling IRL! This world-first mode captivates consumers every time.
Extremely Easy Setup
We've designed the game to be operated regardless of user skill level, for both players and operators. Setup anywhere in minutes!
Scaled For Your Venue
TritonXR allows you to scan your arena into the game. Turn obstacles in the space into cover, and create your own maps easily. Pre-made maps are also available for you to use.
The world's most advanced XR game is here - turn any venue into the ultimate multiplayer combat arena in TritonXR: LIVE!

title: Hollowge
description:
게임 정보
"Buried alive, one shall rise."
Descend into the depths of Hollowforge, a decaying mining complex overrun by monstrous horrors born of corporate greed. In this adrenaline-pumping first-person stealth/action game, you'll need more than just firepower to survive—you’ll need to outwit and outmaneuver the abominations lurking in every shadow.
Blending the fast-paced chaos of Doom with the stealth mastery of Thief, Hollowforge delivers a heart-pounding experience where every choice matters. Run, sneak, and shoot your way through a labyrinth of tunnels, making split-second decisions as you unravel the dark secrets of a megacorporation’s failed experiment.
Key Features:
Fast-Paced Stealth/Action: Stay sharp. Darkness is your ally, but when the monsters find you, your guns become the final word.
Immersive Underground World: Explore the massive, open-ended complex of Hollowforge—a place steeped in mystery, where every corner hides a secret or a nightmare waiting to strike.
Resource Management: Conserve your scarce ammo and health, or spend your hard-earned credits at vending machines for a fighting chance.
Weapons Arsenal: From pistols to crossbows, take control of a versatile range of weaponry as you adapt to the horrors below.
Dynamic 3D Graphics: Feel the tension build with every flicker of light in this atmospheric world. Every shadow could hide an enemy. Every step could be your last.
Get ready to survive. Will you bring the truth to light—or be swallowed by the darkness?
Are you brave enough to face the horrors of Hollowforge?

title: There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder
description:
게임 정보
Play as secret agents Franklin Benjamin and Virginia West as they attempt to stop a madman with a weather machine in this single-player interactive spy novel. Track down this madman named Zeus and destroy his infernal doomsday device. You may find yourself de-escalating a hostage situation, investigating a crime scene, or even defusing a ticking time bomb. But whatever this mission calls for - it’s time for YOU to bring the thunder, agent!
Your Mission
We have it on good intel that a madman named Zeus is attempting to build a weather device that could wipe entire nations off the face of the Earth. Obviously, we can't let that come to pass!
Track down this madman, unravel his scheme, and destroy his doomsday device. The fate of the world rests on your shoulders and your shoulders alone. This is a single-player game, after all
There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder can be played with just a mouse. Gameplay consists of selecting the action or dialog you wish to take given the situation you’re facing. Although the life of a secret agent is complicated, playing There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder is simple
Lightning Strikes Thrice - Sequel or Standalone
There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder is the third entry in the There's Always a Madman series, but it tells a standalone story. Like a classic James Bond novel or film where you can pick any one up independent of the rest, you can pick this story up without having experienced any prior stories in the There's Always a Madman franchise. However, I would recommend starting with the first game There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight if you care to experience the series in its intended order
Forecast, Then Act
As a secret agent, it's not about who has the fastest trigger finger. Put your mind to good use and make intelligent in-the-moment decisions on how best to handle your current predicament. Only by out-thinking your opponents can you survive to tell the tale
Storm's Brewing
A storm is coming, and only our top pair of secret agents can stop it. Whether you find yourself de-escalating a hostage situation, investigating a crime scene, or defusing a ticking time bomb - it'll take all your spy skills to rain on this madman's parade!
autokwd: There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder

title: Death In Your Dice
description:
게임 정보
A mysterious figure draws you into the game. Price: death. Executioner: you. You have dice in your hand and the consequences of this game on your shoulders. Act, predict, observe, and above all... cheat? How long will you last before your conscience takes your minds away? How long will you last before you throw away your values? Do you think you are capable of making sacrifices in the name of honor? The time of trial has come. Even if the die has been cast, let your decisions determine you.
The die is cast
Your fate has been sealed, hasn't it? Observe your surroundings, look for solutions, develop a strategy, try to change the outcome of the roll to achieve your goals.

title: psy-relic
description:
게임 정보
개요
보물을 찾기 위해 몰래 들어간 곳은 무서운 곳이었습니다.
만지면 눈이 멀게 되는 석고상, 팔이 휘감기는 꽃병.
안전한 생존을 선택하거나 위험을 감수하고 부를 선택하십시오
백만장자가 되는 것은 플레이어의 몫입니다!
gemmy 게임의 새로운 생존 공포
보물 사냥꾼이 되는 플레이어를 위한
최후의 선택이 다가온다!
이 게임에 대하여
최대 4명까지 온라인 멀티 협동 플레이가 가능하며, 싱글 플레이도 가능합니다.
직업 시스템이 있으며, 각 직업마다 심령 유물 탐색에 유리한 스킬이 있습니다.
PERK 시스템이 있으며, 플레이를 많이 할수록 심령 유물을 찾는 데 유리해집니다.
수집 시스템이 있으며, 일단 심령 유물을 수집하면 창고에서 자유롭게 다시 확인할 수 있습니다.
각각의 사이킥 유물에는 디버프 세트가 있으며, 들어올리면 다양한 효과를 가져온다.
작동 방법
W/A/S/D - 이동
E - 사이코 유물 들어올리기/내리기
F - 사이코 유물 로드(차량 앞에서만 유효)
B - 워키토키를 이용한 음성 통화
Shift - 대시
Ctrl - 웅크리기
마우스 휠 - 아이템 전환
콘텐츠 제작/유통 지침
개인, 법인 여부를 불문하고 자유롭게 영상을 게시하고 배포해 주시기 바랍니다.
동영상 및 스트리밍 제목에 게임 이름을 포함해 주세요.
