title: Blank Spaces
description:
게임 정보
Choose a stapler. Choose a photocopier that always breaks. Choose a screen full of spreadsheets, numbers that mean nothing, and documents no one will ever read. Choose quiet humility. Or..., choose something else?
Your job is a mystery. The files you’re sorting don’t make sense, the letters you type are nonsense. Your coworkers are frighteningly strange, and the office corridors are even more confusing.
Your task is to become an employee of the month and get a promotion. But the decision is yours to make. Sabotage work and earn harsh punishment? Work hard and get a reward or try to escape?

title: Melon Farmer
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the juicy world of Melon Farmer!
In this captivating 3D adventure, you collect randomly scattered melons, build your own farm, and trade your harvest for valuable coins.
Use these for upgrades such as:
better fields (planned)
loyal pets (planned)
additional islands (planned)
NPCs that collect melons for you (planned)
Experience the sweet success as you expand your farm and rise to become the ultimate melon farmer!

title: Azrael
description:
게임 정보
The Path of the Ancient God
Is it easy to be a god? Dark prophet Azrael is a representative of the ancient race. It was you who created elves, orcs, humans and all living things in this galaxy. A gloomy careerist, hiding under a hood his contempt for both the ancients and mortals, skillfully pretends to be a loyal servant of the hierarchs. But behind the backs of enemies and rulers, he has been hatching his plans for centuries. Your actions shape Azrael's character. Helping friends, saving mortals, noble deeds will change the hero's phrases, open and close opportunities. As well as betrayal, indifference and pride.
Empire above all!
The First Hierarch Ozymandias has already prepared orders for you. You will have to:
Build planets to extract resources
Fight the enemies of the Empire
Trade with other ancients
Assemble a squad of great mortal heroes
Hold auctions and exorcise demons

title: Waste Sorting
description:
게임 정보
Waste Sorting is a single-player puzzle game.
It is inspired by the classic pipe games from the 80s and 90s.
Click the pipes to turn or switch them and create a way from start to finish.
Find a way to the correct trash can for every trash tile.
Sort 25 different types of waste into the 5 corresponding trash cans by creating a way from start to finish.
Rotate straight pipes and curved pipes, avoid blocks, use crossroads and double curves (both cannot be rotated). Include teleporters and switch pipes into your way. Plan ahead with auto-pipes that turn every tile the trash moves. And finally: Move double trash through a separator first and finish two ways at the same time.
Waste Sorting offers over 50 unique puzzle levels separated into 4 different worlds:
The trash world: the easiest levels that guide you through the gameplay. Includes the introduction to the trash cans and trash parts.
The pipe world: Step by step you learn more and more pipe mechanics.
The puzzle world: No more introductions. Just go for the pure challeges.
The paused world: A special challenge where you can click pipes, but rotations will be paused until you hit the go button. Can you keep all your clicks in mind and plan your way ahead?
Waste Sorting is also an educational game that teaches:
critical thinking
problem solving
cognitive rotation
waste sorting
creativity
...

title: Zombie Metal Band
description:
게임 정보
Zombie Metal Band is a dynamic Action RPG where you step into the shoes of a manager of a bizarre metal band composed of zombies! Your task isn’t just to fight off hordes of the undead but also to possess four of them and turn them into loyal members of your band.
Once successfully possessed, the band immediately starts working on a new track, but its quality depends on several key parameters: IQ level, hunger level, and their thirst for another round of booze. You can influence each of these stats using magic spells and independently develop each character.
As a manager, you must care for your undead needs and well-being, as their condition directly affects the quality of their tracks, and ultimately, your chance of topping the music charts.

title: Gimlé Trials
description:
게임 정보
Gimlé Trials is a high-energy multiplayer arena game where precision spellcasting meets dynamic strategy. Engage in rapid, skill-based battles where abilities can knock opponents into danger—or save you from the brink of defeat. The rules are simple: stay in the safe zone, outplay your rivals, and become the last one standing.
Key Features:
Fast-Paced, Skill-Based Combat: Easy to learn but hard to master, Gimlé Trials rewards sharp reflexes and tactical outplays. Timing, aim, and positioning are your keys to survival.
Dynamic Knockback Mechanics: Manipulate the battlefield with unique knockback spells that send foes into deadly hazards like lava, creating exciting, high-stakes moments.
Customizable Loadouts: Between rounds, adapt your strategy by drafting new abilities. Craft your arsenal and find creative ways to dominate your opponents.
Evolving Arenas: The encroaching lava mechanic turns each match into a thrilling showdown, forcing players into intense close-quarters combat.
Strategic Round Progression: Earn currency, draft new abilities, and build your strategy between rounds for an ever-changing battle experience.
Whether you're a competitive player seeking mastery or a casual gamer looking for quick fun, Gimlé Trials delivers chaos, creativity, and excitement in every match. Step into the arena and prove your skill!

title: Ascend the Dome
description:
게임 정보
Is this the hardest and most massive climb-up game ever made?
You find yourself trapped in a massive dome containing various biomes, each filled with unique obstacles and challenges. Your mission is to escape by climbing through the layers of the dome, facing numerous challenges, minigames, and puzzles that will test your precision and skill.
Designed for speedrunners, this is definitely not a cozy game!
Climb, drive, dodge, roll, run, explore, swim, fly, grind... all to reach the top, combining climbing with unique minigames in every biome:
Kart parkour levels.
Backrooms and mazes.
Golf Rollin.
SkyBlock.

title: Bone n' Gone
description:
게임 정보
PREPARE TO DIE!
In Bone n' Gone, you control a fragile and determined skeleton, ready to defeat the bosses that plague areas perfectly designed for smooth action!
LOW HEALTH? HIGH REWARD!
Be rewarded for risky gameplay, as you deal more damage the less health you have! But be careful, death can be pretty harsh at times.
BREATHTAKING SCENARIOS
With retro graphics, you’ll admire every detail and carefully placed texture in the game. Featuring references to classic games, we guarantee an interesting gameplay experience with stunning visuals!

title: Duck's Hunt
description:
게임 정보
Duck's Hunt is a fast paced hardcore FPS game where you play as a bloodthirsty duck.

No health bars. No reloads. It’s just you and the gun you snatched from the enemy. One hit and you’re out. There are no convenient save points. When you die, you are back to the start of the level. Learn from your mistakes to achieve a flawless victory!
Alright, it's go-time! Grab the keys, jump in and take off for a quick spin around the neighborhood! Just a heads-up though the roads might be a little... unpredictable, shall we say so hold on tight and get ready for a bumpy, but fun ride.

title: Pixelegend
description:
게임 정보
This is a fantasy world where you will become an adventurer, exploring vast maps, communicating with various NPCs, accepting missions, unlocking storylines, and gradually uncovering the secrets of this world. In this process, you will continuously accumulate wealth, acquire various weapons and props, and become increasingly powerful. This world may seem calm, but in reality, it is full of dangers and hidden currents. You need to challenge stronger enemies time and time again to resolve each crisis.

title: Rumble City
description:
게임 정보
We created an action packed party fighter experience that you and your friends are sure to enjoy! Our vision for Rumble City was to make the game feel snappy and fluid while adding the goofy over the top elements such as destructive weapons and a cartoony atmosphere!
Features
Action packed gameplay: Find tons of unique weapons and hone them to take down your friends! Each game of Rumble City is fast paced with the characters having low health so every jump, dodge, and attack counts!
Precise Platforming: What would a party fighter be without some presice platforming? Rumble City has tons of unique stages with many different weapons scattered around. Climb and jump faster then your friends to collect weapons and defeat them!
Multi-Stage Games: Each game of Rumble City offers a unique experience to players. There is no "lives", or "stock", instead, each game is a high stakes tug-of-war style challenge. Win and you progress, lose and you regress, until one team pushes the other out of the back alleys of Rumble City!
What to expect in Rumble City
Action party fighter combat.
Tons of unique weapons to choose from.
Achievements for killing your friends in creative ways.
A killer soundtrack to rock out to.
Lots of colors and teams to play as.
(Optional) Bragging rights for beating your friends.

title: Void Drift
description:
게임 정보
Survive the void
Void Drift is a fast-paced roguelike space shooter where you explore vast, enemy-filled battlefields, upgrade your ship, and take on relentless waves of enemies and powerful bosses. Fight through dynamic, open-ended levels where you choose your own approach—dodge incoming fire, hunt for enemies, or dive straight into the action.
You start simple, but as you progress, you'll unlock powerful upgrades that evolve your weapons into devastating new forms. Adapt to every encounter by combining different enhancements, creating unique playstyles that match your strategy. Whether you prefer precise, high-damage shots or overwhelming area destruction, the choice is yours.
Key Features
Face Bosses. Every level culminates in a unique boss battle that will test your reflexes, strategy, and firepower. No two encounters are the same—learn their attack patterns, find their weaknesses, and bring them down before they crush you.

title: DON'T STOP
description:
게임 정보
A mysterious force binds you to an unyielding rule: stopping means certain death. In Don't Stop You'll Die!, you must navigate through the seven circles of hell, facing relentless waves of enemies. Arm yourself with a powerful arsenal of weapons and abilities. Survival hinges on quick reflexes, constant movement, and split-second decisions. Can you escape this unforgiving gauntlet, or will you succumb to the chaos?
Key Features
Fast-Paced Roguelike Action: Constant movement is essential—stopping means instant death!
Dynamic Wave-Based Combat: Face relentless waves of enemies, with difficulty ramping up as you progress.
Diverse Arsenal: Wield a variety of weapons and abilities, from guns to supernatural powers, to crush your foes.
Procedurally Generated Challenges: Experience a fresh and unpredictable run every time you play.
Replayability: With its roguelike design, no two runs are ever the same—offering endless hours of gameplay.
Quirky NPCs: Interact with eccentric characters like Gort and Mort, who add charm and depth to the underworld.

title: Banshee Bash
description:
게임 정보
Banshee Bash is a fast-paced local multiplayer party royale! Team up or go solo in chaotic free-for-all battles. Collect spell books to expand your arsenal and grab potion bottles to stay in the fight.
Features
8 Playable Characters – Choose your favorite fighter!
16 Unique Levels – Battle across diverse arenas.
Unlockable Cosmetics – Customize your character with stylish rewards.
Up to 8 Players – Bring the whole party! (Windows currently limits controller connections to 4, but bots can fill the rest).
Get ready to brawl in Banshee Bash – where the magic is wild, and the competition is fierce!

title: SKYLARK
description:
게임 정보
황폐해진 하늘에 표류한 SKYLARK. 외로운 생존자가 되어 폐허가 된 세상의 진실을 밝혀내세요. 든든한 로봇 동료와 소중한 열기구에 의지한 채, 끝없는 수평선을 가로질러 자원을 모으고, 마지막 남은 동물들을 구조하세요.
매 순간 내리는 결정이 여러분의 플레이의 방향을 좌우하게 됩니다. 과연 어디에 도달할 수 있을까요?
주요 특징
생존 & 자원 관리
음식, 연료, 물자를 신중하게 분배해 열기구를 유지하세요. 몰락 직전의 세계에서 만나게 될 위험을 헤쳐나가야 합니다.
다중 경로 & 엔딩
좋은 일, 나쁜 일, 그리고 신비로운 사건들이 얽힌 분기 스토리를 경험하세요. 각 선택은 새로운 가능성과 숨겨진 진실을 열어줍니다.
라디오 신호 & 발견
수수께끼 같은 라디오 방송을 따라 미지의 지역으로 떠나세요. 전파 뒤에 숨은 존재가 누구(또는 무엇)인지 파헤치며, 다음 행보를 스스로 결정하세요.
구조 & 재건
구조가 필요한 동물 동료들을 찾아 구해주세요. 마지막 남은 동물들을 보호하고 하늘 위의 안식처를 확장해 나가세요.
석유 플랫폼에서의 시작
버려진 석유 플랫폼에서 매번 새롭게 게임을 시작하세요. 초기 자원을 활용해, 매 플레이마다 고유한 게임플레이를 경험 할 수 있습니다.
구름 위에 숨겨진 것
이 폐허 같은 하늘에 숨겨진 비밀을 밝혀낼 것인가, 아니면 영원히 잊힌 유산 속에서 길을 잃고 말 것인가? 자연의 품으로 돌아간 세계를 누비며, 감동이 깃든 여정에 나설 준비를 하십시오. SKYLARK 속 라디오 신호가 인도하는 곳은 과연 어디일까요?

title: Tired to Fall
description:
게임 정보
Tired to Fall은 퍼즐 플랫폼 게임으로, 버디 잎을 모으고, 발사하며 플랫폼으로 변환하여 작은 잎이 나무로 돌아갈 수 있도록 돕습니다. 점프하고 활강하며 가시 밤, 도토리, 대포 버섯이 가득한 저지대에서 퍼즐을 해결하세요!



여정 중에 다양한 버디 잎을 모으세요.



을 발사하고, 심고, 플랫폼으로 사용하여 장애물을 극복하세요!



가시 밤, 도토리, 대포 버섯이 가득한 생동감 넘치는 저지대에서 하며 하세요.

title: Wirelight
description:
게임 정보
A tiny turn-based tactical... soulslike! Explore a twisty, interconnected world, battle enemies using a unique spin on a 'posture' system, and employ various upgrades to your advantage.
Turn-Based Soulslike Combat
Alternate turns with enemies in turn-based combat with a unique posture system. You have the option to attack directly, but can also deal damage by knocking enemies out of position, into walls, or even blocking their movement with your own body.
Countless Combinations of Items
Unlock and discover equippable "toolsets" granting special abilities, "modules" to give various passive boosts, and weapons with unique shapes and hidden qualities.  Customize your build as you explore and fight through the challenging terrain.
A Twisty World
Explore six distinct zones through a sprawling, highly (and unpredictably) interconnected world.  Unlock shortcuts, double back to find secrets of challenge difficult enemies, and uncover the hidden depths of this tiny but intricate world.

title: TritonXR: Reality Warfare LIVE
description:
게임 정보
TritonXR: LIVE turns ANY venue into a dynamic multiplayer combat arena. Scan your venue in, setup in minutes, and run your LBE experinces from anywhere!
NOTE: TritonXR: Reality Warfare LIVE is designed for LBE businesses. If you're a consumer, please check out TritonXR: Reality Warfare (visit our developer page above)!
World-First XR
TritonXR has the latest of XR tech - the "Real Life Mode" utilises the Quest 3/3s's XR features to create a mode where it truly feels like you're battling IRL! This world-first mode captivates consumers every time.
Extremely Easy Setup
We've designed the game to be operated regardless of user skill level, for both players and operators. Setup anywhere in minutes!
Scaled For Your Venue
TritonXR allows you to scan your arena into the game. Turn obstacles in the space into cover, and create your own maps easily. Pre-made maps are also available for you to use.
The world's most advanced XR game is here - turn any venue into the ultimate multiplayer combat arena in TritonXR: LIVE!

title: Hollowge
description:
게임 정보
"Buried alive, one shall rise."
Descend into the depths of Hollowforge, a decaying mining complex overrun by monstrous horrors born of corporate greed. In this adrenaline-pumping first-person stealth/action game, you'll need more than just firepower to survive—you’ll need to outwit and outmaneuver the abominations lurking in every shadow.
Blending the fast-paced chaos of Doom with the stealth mastery of Thief, Hollowforge delivers a heart-pounding experience where every choice matters. Run, sneak, and shoot your way through a labyrinth of tunnels, making split-second decisions as you unravel the dark secrets of a megacorporation’s failed experiment.
Key Features:
Fast-Paced Stealth/Action: Stay sharp. Darkness is your ally, but when the monsters find you, your guns become the final word.
Immersive Underground World: Explore the massive, open-ended complex of Hollowforge—a place steeped in mystery, where every corner hides a secret or a nightmare waiting to strike.
Resource Management: Conserve your scarce ammo and health, or spend your hard-earned credits at vending machines for a fighting chance.
Weapons Arsenal: From pistols to crossbows, take control of a versatile range of weaponry as you adapt to the horrors below.
Dynamic 3D Graphics: Feel the tension build with every flicker of light in this atmospheric world. Every shadow could hide an enemy. Every step could be your last.
Get ready to survive. Will you bring the truth to light—or be swallowed by the darkness?
Are you brave enough to face the horrors of Hollowforge?

title: There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder
description:
게임 정보
Play as secret agents Franklin Benjamin and Virginia West as they attempt to stop a madman with a weather machine in this single-player interactive spy novel. Track down this madman named Zeus and destroy his infernal doomsday device. You may find yourself de-escalating a hostage situation, investigating a crime scene, or even defusing a ticking time bomb. But whatever this mission calls for - it’s time for YOU to bring the thunder, agent!
Your Mission
We have it on good intel that a madman named Zeus is attempting to build a weather device that could wipe entire nations off the face of the Earth. Obviously, we can't let that come to pass!
Track down this madman, unravel his scheme, and destroy his doomsday device. The fate of the world rests on your shoulders and your shoulders alone. This is a single-player game, after all
There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder can be played with just a mouse. Gameplay consists of selecting the action or dialog you wish to take given the situation you’re facing. Although the life of a secret agent is complicated, playing There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder is simple
Lightning Strikes Thrice - Sequel or Standalone
There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder is the third entry in the There's Always a Madman series, but it tells a standalone story. Like a classic James Bond novel or film where you can pick any one up independent of the rest, you can pick this story up without having experienced any prior stories in the There's Always a Madman franchise. However, I would recommend starting with the first game There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight if you care to experience the series in its intended order
Forecast, Then Act
As a secret agent, it's not about who has the fastest trigger finger. Put your mind to good use and make intelligent in-the-moment decisions on how best to handle your current predicament. Only by out-thinking your opponents can you survive to tell the tale
Storm's Brewing
A storm is coming, and only our top pair of secret agents can stop it. Whether you find yourself de-escalating a hostage situation, investigating a crime scene, or defusing a ticking time bomb - it'll take all your spy skills to rain on this madman's parade!
autokwd: There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder

title: Death In Your Dice
description:
게임 정보
A mysterious figure draws you into the game. Price: death. Executioner: you. You have dice in your hand and the consequences of this game on your shoulders. Act, predict, observe, and above all... cheat? How long will you last before your conscience takes your minds away? How long will you last before you throw away your values? Do you think you are capable of making sacrifices in the name of honor? The time of trial has come. Even if the die has been cast, let your decisions determine you.
The die is cast
Your fate has been sealed, hasn't it? Observe your surroundings, look for solutions, develop a strategy, try to change the outcome of the roll to achieve your goals.

title: psy-relic

보물을 찾기 위해 몰래 들어간 곳은 무서운 곳이었습니다.
만지면 눈이 멀게 되는 석고상, 팔이 휘감기는 꽃병.
안전한 생존을 선택하거나 위험을 감수하고 부를 선택하십시오
백만장자가 되는 것은 플레이어의 몫입니다!
gemmy 게임의 새로운 생존 공포
보물 사냥꾼이 되는 플레이어를 위한
최후의 선택이 다가온다!
이 게임에 대하여
최대 4명까지 온라인 멀티 협동 플레이가 가능하며, 싱글 플레이도 가능합니다.
직업 시스템이 있으며, 각 직업마다 심령 유물 탐색에 유리한 스킬이 있습니다.
PERK 시스템이 있으며, 플레이를 많이 할수록 심령 유물을 찾는 데 유리해집니다.
수집 시스템이 있으며, 일단 심령 유물을 수집하면 창고에서 자유롭게 다시 확인할 수 있습니다.

description:
게임 정보
Choose a stapler. Choose a photocopier that always breaks. Choose a screen full of spreadsheets, numbers that mean nothing, and documents no one will ever read. Choose quiet humility. Or..., choose something else?
Your job is a mystery. The files you’re sorting don’t make sense, the letters you type are nonsense. Your coworkers are frighteningly strange, and the office corridors are even more confusing.

title: Kinny and the Cosmic Cauldron
description:
게임 정보
A Cosmic Culinary Adventure Begins!
The fate of the universe—and its flavors—rests in your hands!
You are the one and only witch chef of Stewpendous Spoons, a intergalactic restaurant like no other. Standing before the legendary Cosmic Cauldron, your mission is to serve the most delectable stews to a host of bizarre extraterrestrial patrons. But beware—failure is not an option. If your dishes don’t satisfy... you might just become the next ingredient!
Features
🔥 Deck-Building Roguelike Cooking SystemEach dish is a high-stakes gamble! With 20 different ingredients dropping into the cauldron every run, watch them collide and combine in unexpected ways to rack up points. Every cooking session introduces new ingredients, pushing you to build a strategic deck and create powerful synergies.
🌌 Cosmic Cooking ChallengesBrace yourself for an intergalactic kitchen frenzy! The ingredients won’t just sit still—they’ll tumble, crash, and react in chaotic ways. Hit the target score quickly to earn bonus rewards like Cauldron Expansions and powerful Cosmic Relics that enhance your cooking prowess.
🧙‍♀️ A Whimsical Witch’s TaleYour restaurant attracts customers from the farthest corners of the universe—eldritch beings with impossible demands and unrelenting appetites. If you fail to meet their expectations... well, let’s just say the consequences are cosmic-scale catastrophes.
✨ Charming 2D Cosmic Pixel ArtImmerse yourself in a hand-drawn pixel-art world that’s both cute and mysterious! From animated ingredients to enchanting space backgrounds, every detail brings your cosmic kitchen to life.
Gameplay Highlights
🍲 Ingredient Drop & InteractionIngredients fall randomly into the cauldron, bouncing, merging, and triggering unpredictable reactions. Adapt on the fly, strategize your deck, and make every dish a masterpiece.
🃏 Strategic Deck-BuildingCollect ingredients and craft your unique deck. With a vast array of ingredient types and properties, experimenting with different combinations is key to achieving high scores and mastering the art of cosmic cuisine.
🏆 Rewards & UpgradesMeet your goals to unlock cauldron upgrades and rare relics that amplify ingredient interactions. Discover faster, more efficient ways to cook and dominate the interstellar culinary scene!

title: Cosmotiles
description:
게임 정보
Cosmotiles turns planet terraform experience into a peaceful strategy game and does so with style. It offers a simple game mechanic. At the same time, provides enough depth for challenging and rewarding experience for seekers.
You have to place blocks on planet. A block is a group of tiles with a same biome. Placing a block is scored based on surrounding biomes. The more strategically you place your blocks, the more points you score. Once you score enough points, a new planet is unlocked to continue expedition. However, if you run out of empty tiles to place blocks, the game ends. This is the time when you check your score on the leaderboard and start a new expedition.
What Cosmotiles offers
Endless amount of procedurally generated planets
A colorful relaxing and calming experience

title: Rendagor
description:
게임 정보
Rendagor is a run-and-gun game set in a near future where human labor has been almost completely replaced by humanoid drones controlled by corporate artificial intelligence.
The player will control one of Rendagor Corporation's drones through some 2D levels with top-down pixel art graphics.
This demo includes the first three levels of the Rendagor story mode in which you will be guided by the main AI of Rendagor Corp. (RCAI) and the first level of Arcade Mode.
Story Mode:
Fight against animals altered by the pollution produced by Rendagor Corp.
Use the first two weapons available to the drones: Energy Laser and a small machine gun.

title: Sauna Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"Sauna Simulator" is a funny business simulator. Buy premises, equip them with a sauna stove and start earning from it!
You inherit a sauna stove and decide to open your own sauna business. You have a large area at your disposal, divided into rooms, which you can buy and put there any stove from the store.
While your business is small, you will do all the work yourself: please customers, clean the room, put firewood in the sauna stove. However, as your sauna expands, you'll be able to hire employees to take care of all the chores you don't want to do.
Customers leave feedback. If your customers don't like your sauna: poor service, dirty facilities, etc., they will definitely leave a bad review. If, on the other hand, you take complete care of your customers, they will leave you a positive rating. Based on these ratings, you will see the average rating of your sauna.
You should not forget about safety. If your stove is cheap, then it will have a high chance of catching fire. In such cases you will need fire extinguishers, which of course you can buy at the store.

title: Kill The Dream
description:
게임 정보
The quiet town of Frozen Pines. It was the perfect place to get away, just the two of you. So then why? Why did things go so horribly wrong?
You wake up at the edge of town to find your love missing. A strange signal calls to you, urging you to save her. She's been taken by a presence deep within the lake. The same presence responsible for twisting the town and its inhabitants into the warped nightmare you find yourself in now. Follow the signal through town, searching the desolate buildings for survivors.
Beware, you're being hunted. Strange and deadly monstrosities hide behind every corner. Armed with only an axe and your wits, find a way to survive and save the one you love.
But why... why can't you remember their name?
Only by facing the horrors can you find the answers you seek.
FEATURES
Brutal grid-based combat with directional attacking and blocking that requires both quick reflexes and strategic thinking.
Free-roam system allows seamless swapping between grid-based movement, and traditional first person controls for smooth exploration.
Choose your route through the town of Frozen Pines, changing the order of characters, bosses, and upgrades you'll encounter.

title: The Czar is Dead 2
description:
게임 정보
The Czar is Dead 2 is a first-person rpg-shooter that tells the story of Nikolai Romanov's fight against the Communists and Anglo-Saxon invaders. The Czar managed to save himself from being shot, but the little Czesarevich was kidnapped by the villains and taken to an unknown destination. Will the former Emperor manage to save his son, atone for his sins and win the civil war? It depends only on you.

The game is in active development, the estimated release date is the second half of 2025.

title: Ritualist
description:
게임 정보

Delve into the depths of ancient ruins and fight your way through eldritch evil lurking in the shadows of dungeons. Prepare to face an eldritch horror that tests your sanity and courage. Will you conquer the darkness, or will you succumb to evil?





Various Weapons:
Choose your weapon wisely, as each has its unique strengths to combat the unholy entities.

Procedural Generation:
Explore procedurally generated dungeons and arenas, ensuring that no two encounters are ever the same, and uncover secrets hidden within the shadows.

Dynamic Combat System:
Experience a unique combat system with intuitive controls.

Patron Entity Selection:
Select a patron entity to guide you, but beware: your choices will lead you to confront its antagonist.

Variety of enemies:
Dozens of horrifying enemies that lurk in the depths of the dungeon.

Due to advanced AI systems each combat encounter will be unlike another.

The ancient evil stirs once more—will you have the strength to seal it away, or will you fall to its power? Darkness looms, secrets await...

title: ZombMe
description:
게임 정보
Old school 2D platforming...with a twist.

It's another zombie game....except this time YOU are the zombie...and instead of trying to stay alive....you're trying to stay dead! Jump, flip, throw, and avoid health powerups as you try to (not) save your neck.

Features include:
Precision 2D platforming
Over a half dozen types of jumps (including many hidden ones)
Pick up and throw enemies and objects
Interact with foreground and background enemies and objects
Get a unique suit with specific powers on each world
Countless sidekicks that will help you stay dead
Many types of headgear to help boost your stats
Several "power-downs" that will keep your health low (at the expense of mobility)
The ability to ride and drive many animals and vehicles

title: Hope Inc
description:
게임 정보
CHILLS TO THE BONE!
A few months ago, a catastrophic explosion at the Beacon plunged the world into an endless winter. People continue to perish, and the only hope of restoring order lies in repairing the Beacon.
As Victor, an engineer on a mission to save humanity, you’ll journey through a frozen city, scavenging materials for the Beacon and encountering survivors – some bloodthirsty, some benign.
FEATURES:
Level-based Structure!
15 immersive levels split between two distinct locations: outdoor levels focused on parkour and indoor areas centered on fight.
Numerous Cutscenes and Dialogues!
Immerse yourself in Victor’s dramatic journey through powerful scenes and dialogues that reveal a rich story and universe filled with vibrant characters.
Jump and Maneuver!
Platformer controls at their best! Each area is packed with obstacles and deadly foes, keeping you on your toes.
Boss Battles!
Every boss victory, requiring refined combat skills, unlocks new abilities, making each step of your adventure even more thrilling.
ARE YOU READY?
Can you bring hope back to a world on the brink of collapse?

title: Toxic Toads
description:
게임 정보
What is Toxic Toads?
Toxic Toads is a 2d platformer to play alone or with friends, where you have to jump a lot and consider your every move! 
What's the fun of it?
Each toad is so toxic that it leaves a brightly colored slime behind that is deadly to the touch! 
Story mode
Play alone (if you’re forever alone) or invite your friends, some levels support up to 4 players! 
Complete 50 exciting puzzles in different locations: Lab, forest, cave!
Bring all the toads to the exit! 
Party mode
Multiplayer: up to 4 players! Network and local!
Base: Pass levels together, work together to win! 
Race: Try your best to be the fastest! All players start from the same point, but who finishes first? (Reduced Toxicity Mode)
Workshop: Access levels that are created by the community, plenty of options for you and your friends! 
...and much more! 
Level Editor: Design unique levels and race tracks, upload them to steam workshop, play by yourself and with your friends! 
Full support for all controllers
Amusing for everyone who loves TOADS!

title: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
description:
게임 정보
Armed with your trusty keyboard and mouse, battle the games you never play! The more you paid for them, the more damage they will do to you (just like in real life).
Fight in an arena surrounded by your well-played spectator games, while the immortal royalty (the games you have never played) lord over you at the end of the arena.
Games you played for up to two hours will attack you in waves - but watch out for flying enemies (high Metacritic score), Platform supported enemies, DLC enemies and Controller Supported enemies; amongst many more!
** IMPORTANT ** To get the most out of this game (Play your game list instead of the Default/Friends game lists), you will need to set your "Game details" to public on your Steam profile (Your Profile->Edit Profile->Privacy Settings->Game Details). You can set it back to private after you load the game for the first time.

title: Wild Horizon: Edge of Survival
description:
게임 정보
Survive the wild, master the elements, solve puzzles, scale cliffs, swing ropes, leap ledges, outsmart animals, and find your way home.
Wild Horizon: Edge of Survival is an adventure game set amidst the perilous wilderness. As the lone survivor of a devastating plane crash, you must navigate a rugged, rocky landscape, outwit fierce predators, and solve challenging puzzles to survive. With only the terrain around you and your instincts to rely on, each step forward brings you closer to safety—or disaster.
Key Features:
Immersive Third-Person Exploration:
Traverse a breathtaking, untamed world filled with jagged cliffs, steep slopes, and awe-inspiring vistas. The environment is as beautiful as it is deadly, capturing the raw power of nature.
Dynamic Traversal and Movement Challenges: Perform daring maneuvers like mantling steep plateaus, leaping across perilous gaps, sprinting along wall to cross deadly chasms, swinging on ropes over dizzying heights, and clinging to narrow ledges to avoid plunging into the depths below.
Stamina Management: Carefully manage your stamina to stay alive in this unforgiving wilderness.
Intricate Puzzle Mechanics:
Unlock vital tools by solving puzzles that challenge your observation and logic.
Wildlife Encounters:
Outsmart dangerous predators using your surroundings and clever tactics. Brute force isn’t an option—your wits are your best weapon
The Story
You awaken in the aftermath of a catastrophic plane crash, alone and isolated from the rest of the world. With no smartphone, no tools, and no modern comforts, you must rely on your instincts and the harsh wilderness around you. Your only hope lies in reaching the wreckage of the aircraft to repair the radio and call for help.
But the journey is treacherous. Cliffs, slick slopes, and dizzying heights make even the simplest tasks perilous.
Unlike traditional survival games, Wild Horizon isn’t about chopping down trees, gathering stones, or building cozy shelters. Your goal is to get back home.

title: HELL OF FEAR: Mind Breach
description:
게임 정보
You are Major Axel Vex, a veteran of Extraterrestrial Incident Response, dispatched to investigate a distress signal from Cengona Base - an underground research facility on a distant exoplanet. What begins as a routine investigation quickly spirals into a desperate battle for survival against an entity that turns both mind and matter against you.
SURVIVE THE DEPTHS
• Navigate through 26 unique sectors of a massive underground base, each with its own dangers and secrets
• Manage your resources and choose your battles wisely against sinister entities
• Uncover the truth through recovered logs, security footage, and the haunting remains of the base's personnel
FACE THE INFECTION
• Confront hostile entities that are controlled by a mysterious biological force
• Experience dynamic horror that adapts to your actions and decisions
• Solve environmental puzzles while avoiding detection by creatures that hunt through light and movement
KEY FEATURES
• Unique blend of psychological and biological horror
• Atmospheric survival horror set in a claustrophobic underground facility
• Strategic resource management
• Immersive sound design that heightens tension and aids survival
• Rich narrative told through environmental storytelling
🌿 Can you resist the breach?
ABOUT THE DEVELOPER
HELL OF FEAR: Mind Breach is a game designed by Tayfun Tuna and developed by Cenk Bilgin. It represents our vision of a new era in psychological survival horror.
Note: This game contains scenes of intense horror, violence, and psychological distress. Player discretion is advised.

title: A Blocc World
description:
게임 정보
A Blocc World. The best kind of world. A world of discovery, adventure and smashing fun.

Wander through peaceful fields, golden sands and towering trees, and dare to dream that you could be the hero this world needs. Stop dreaming. This world needs a hero.

You'll need to train. Smash your way through the ugly beasts trying to ruin your peaceful paradise. Learn from your battles. Unlock new powers to smash even harder. Steal items and equipment from your vanquished foes. Don't worry about the ethical concerns of looting the deceased, it's all for the Quest. Don't stop to clean up after yourself, that will only slow you down. Focus! The Quest!

You'll need help. Make friends on your travels. Help them with their troubles and they might just help you too. But don't get too friendly, they'll distract you from the Quest.

You'll be tested. Some of the ugly beasts pack quite a punch. But they stand in the way of you and the Quest. You know what that means.

You'll be Quested. The Quest is a quest that you need to quest. Quest.

title: Cards and Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
카드 & 던전즈는 핵앤슬래시 액션과 카드 플레이를 결합한 액션 가득한 로그라이크 던전 크롤러입니다. 무작위로 생성되는 층을 탐험하며 몬스터와 싸우고, 전리품을 모으고, 카드를 사용해 강력한 효과를 발휘하세요. 과연 깊은 심연에서 살아남을 수 있을까요?
끊임없이 변화하는 층을 돌파하라
절차적으로 생성된 던전에 내려가 점점 강해지는 적들과 싸우고, 역동적인 환경을 탐험하세요. 각 층마다 독특한 레이아웃, 몬스터, 함정이 있어 매번 새로운 경험을 제공합니다.
카드의 힘을 마스터하라
여정을 통해 카드를 모으고 사용해 강력한 효과를 발휘하세요. 카드 덱을 전략적으로 업그레이드하고 조정하여 계속 진화하는 위협에 대응하세요.
영웅을 선택하고 플레이 스타일을 정의하라
각기 다른 무기와 스킬을 가진 다양한 캐릭터 중에서 선택하세요. 근거리 전투를 선호하든, 정밀한 원거리 공격을 선호하든, 당신의 스타일에 맞는 영웅이 준비되어 있습니다. 진행하면서 새로운 캐릭터를 잠금 해제하고, 던전을 공략하는 새로운 방식을 발견하세요.
강력한 적들과 보스에 도전하라
몬스터 무리와 강력한 보스와 대결하세요. 아래로 내려갈수록 적은 점점 더 강력해집니다. 적의 패턴을 파악하고 전술을 조정하여 끊임없는 공격에서 살아남으세요.
전리품을 모으고 업그레이드하라
전투를 통해 보상을 얻고, 골드를 사용해 덱을 강화하며 새로운 카드를 잠금 해제하고 영웅을 업그레이드하세요. 전설적인 카드와 강력한 업그레이드를 활용해 자신만의 전략을 세우고 더 깊은 던전을 탐험하세요.
높은 반복 플레이성
절차적으로 생성된 층, 다양한 영웅, 무수한 카드 조합 덕분에 매번 새로운 도전과 놀라움을 경험할 수 있습니다. 깊은 심연의 마지막 층까지 도달해 승리할 수 있을까요?

title: Temple of the Gods
description:
게임 정보
Step into the Depths of 1920s Mexico in the Temple of the Gods
“Can you survive the jungle, the jaguars, and the mysteries of an ancient Aztec civilization? Temple of the Gods is a first- and third-person action-adventure game that takes players into the untamed heart of 1920s Mexico. Step into the shoes of daring archaeologists Jon and Jess Luna as they search for the legendary Gold of the Gods, hidden deep within a volcanic temple. Explore vast jungles, rappel through dangerous caves, and confront otherworldly creatures in this thrilling quest for survival and discovery.”
Core Gameplay Features
What Makes Temple of the Gods Unique?
Immersive Open-World Exploration – Journey through a vast jungle and uncover an ancient temple filled with puzzles, hidden pathways, and dynamic challenges.
Thrilling Survival Mechanics – Outwit deadly jaguars, evade lethal traps, and master essential tools like torches, compasses, and weapons to stay alive.
Dual Perspectives – Seamlessly switch between first-person and third-person modes, allowing for immersive exploration or cinematic combat tailored to your play style.
Dynamic Traps & Environments – Powered by procedural generation, traps and weather dynamically react and shift, ensuring each play through is unpredictable and filled with new challenges.
Psychedelic Adventure – Experience mind-bending sequences inspired by Aztec mythology, where reality blurs with the mystical. A fusion of historical realism and surreal fantasy, set to a soundtrack that shifts between hypnotic calm and heart-pounding intensity.

title: Gamba Simulator
description:
게임 정보
마피아가 부분적으로 통제하는 도시에 갇힌 감바(도박 중독자)가 되어보세요.
사멸한 화산을 채굴하세요,
이 기계로 도박을 하세요:
apendawn

title: Break
description:
게임 정보
GAME CURRENTLY IN EARLY STAGES OF DEVELOPMENT / SCREENSHOTS AND GAME MECHANICS NOT FINAL
Welcome to Flumenborg, the city that never sleeps... mainly because people are afraid that you'll rob them blind while they do!
"Break, Enter, Repeat" thrusts you into the exciting world of burglaries, set against the frosty backdrop of the Cold War era. You are the architect of your own destiny, plotting burglaries from cosy homes to fortified government agencies, and from jewellery stores to museums, all while navigating the murky waters of espionage and intrigue.
🏠 Plan the perfect heist: Strategise your way from humble suburban homes to high-profile targets. Every decision matters as you climb the criminal ladder in a city brimming with wealth and risk.
🔦 Choose your own approach: Go in with a bang or be stealthy. Plan everything carefully in advance or improvise. The choice is yours!

title: Knight of Nevermore
description:
게임 정보
Knight of Nevermore is a 2D roguelike action-platformer featuring challenging souls-inspired combat, corridors covered in spikes, and an item pool filled with combos and synergies.
Made for Replayability
Each time you enter Nevermore, it's ever-changing levels offer a unique selection of items, weapons and spells. Become a mighty fighter, cast powerful spells, or scale your stats to godlike strength - every run presents different build possibilities.
Challenging Combat
The denizens of Nevermore won't go down without a fight! Your enemies have a variety of attacks at their disposal, and you'll need to defend yourself accordingly. Triumph in battle by learning enemy move-sets and keeping your wits sharp.
Meaningful Choices
Sculpt your build with powerful synergies and manage your resources carefully. Should you reroll an item, or should you use the healing fountain before the next fight? You can't have it all, so choose wisely.
Rich in Gameplay, Light in Story

title: Emergent Magic
description:
게임 정보
Rebuild the Grand Library
The Grand Library has burned. No longer can the magi use spells handed down for generations. They must uncover the ancient art of spell crafting. Rebuild the Grand Library and fill it with spells of your own creation. Defeat enemies as you search for powerful components to bend the elements to your will.
Create your own spells

Features a voxel based spell crafting system with emergent elemental properties and runes to further control your creations, your ingenuity is the limit. The elements are at your command
Toss enemies with your might

Feel the impact of your magic, with physics to throw and smash enemies
Dash between your enemies in this first person spell-slinger, featuring a variety of enemies that you will have to overcome in unique ways. Loot them and take their power for your own, summon them to fight for you, take their spells or craft more powerful versions of your own. Features a multitude of unique enemies with differing abilities and spells across several levels
Conquer the world together with PVE and show off your ingenuity with your spells

title: Heir to the Queen
description:
게임 정보
게임 소개
RPG Maker VX Ace로 제작된 미스터리 어드벤처 게임입니다.
시놉시스
평범한 여고생 야무는 우연한 계기로 고대 이집트의 여이 될 자격을 얻게 된다.
하지만 왕좌에 오르기 위해서는 수수께끼로 가득 찬 관문을 통과해야만 한다.
그러나 이곳에는 그녀를 시험하는 정체 모를 존재들이 기다리고 있다.
미지의 공간에서 펼쳐지는 퍼즐, 탐험, 생존의 여정—
과연 야무는 모든 시련을 극복하고 진정한 여왕이 될 수 있을까?
게임 특징
퍼즐 & 탐험: 알 수 없는 공간을 탐색하며 단서를 찾고 퍼즐을 풀어야 한다.
미스터리한 분위기: 신비롭고 긴장감 넘치는 스토리 전개.
생존 요소: 정체 모를 미지의 존재들을 피해 살아남아야 한다.
귀여운 픽셀 아트: 아기자기한 도트 그래픽과 개성 넘치는 캐릭터 디자인.

title: Beach Outlet Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Beach Outlet Simulator는 1인칭 시점의 시뮬레이션 게임으로, 소규모 가게를 대형 소매업체로 성장시키는 것이 목표입니다.
매장 관리
스타일리시하고 실용적인 방식으로 매장을 설계하세요. 공간을 최대한 활용하여 제품을 효과적으로 진열하고, 고객에게 즐거운 쇼핑 경험을 제공하세요.
청소
고객은 매장의 청결을 중요하게 생각합니다. 창문을 깨끗이 하고 바닥에 쓰레기가 없도록 유지하세요!

title: HeartWeaver
description:
게임 정보
Heartweaver is a 3D puzzle adventure game about loss and healing. Follow the journey of Ace and Mark through Ace's twisted mind and help her reconnect with her feelings. Explore beautiful dark worlds that bring Ace's psyche to life, use her emotions to solve puzzles, recover her memories and help her weave a path towards healing.
ㅤ
Help Ace free her repressed emotions. Connect through her feelings with her mental blocks and dissolve them.

title: Endless Night: The Darkness Within
description:
게임 정보
"Until you make the unconscious conscious, it will direct your life and you will call it fate"
                                                                                            -Carl G. Jung
Jake’s journey begins where most fear to tread—deep within the shadows of his own mind. Guided only by fragments of memory and a will to survive, he must confront the darkness that threatens to consume him.
What awaits in the depths? Fear, doubt, and pain… or the strength to overcome it all? The choice is yours: confront the darkness—or let it define you.
UNIQUE PLATFORMING MECHANICS
Dive into a platforming experience like no other, featuring fireflies with extraordinary abilities such as horizontal and vertical boosts, teleportation, and gravity manipulation.

title: Rip & Tear
description:
게임 정보

Step into the carnage-filled world of Rip & Tear, a brutal top-down 2D arcade shooter in which your trusty shotgun is all that stands between you and the hordes. Inspired by Doom's gruesome violence, this adrenaline-fueled carnage sets you against infinite waves of hideous demons, cultists, and biomechanical freaks in a bloody battle for survival.
With every shell you fire, limbs explode, walls are painted red, and the ground is littered with the remains of your enemies. There are no fancy weapons, no gimmicks—just you, your shotgun, and the relentless onslaught of hellspawn.

title: Kitty Convenience
description:
게임 정보
🐾 Welcome to Kitty Convenience – The Purrfect Co-op Challenge! 🐾

Step into the paws of an adorable kitty crew and work together to run the busiest convenience store in town! Whether you’re playing solo, with friends or as a family, Kitty Convenience blends cozy chaos with teamwork in a fast-paced retail adventure. With difficulty options ranging from a relaxed Kitten Mode to high-stakes competitive play, there’s something for every cat lover!
🛒 Run the Ultimate Convenience Store!
Stock shelves, price items, assist customers and clean up spills, all while adapting to an ever-changing store layout! Quick thinking, communication and teamwork are the keys to keeping the store running smoothly.

🏴‍☠️ Ahoy Matey!

title: Ravenous Rhythm
description:
게임 정보
Ravenous Rhythm is a roguelike rhythm and cooking game developed for Mac, Windows, and Linux.

 In a world overrun by monsters, humanity lives in darkness. Barely scraping by and fearing for their lives, the people's hope lies on their remaining passions: music and culinary. 

Your objective is simple: cook for the monsters, and do it with style, so that you don’t become their next meal! You’ll learn how to handle the monstrous ingredients and make even crazier recipes with them.

Feed your way through hordes of voracious monsters, climb your way through the ranks of Monster Chefs, and defeat the Gourmand, the Gluttonous King!

title: Puzzle Tales: Arcane Voyager
description:
게임 정보

title: SOS: Forgotten Planet
description:
게임 정보
SOS: Forgotten Planet is an Educational Survival Horror with Roguelike elements where you learn Morse Code. You play as Clara Redmont, the grand-daughter of the man who ordered the complete an utter destruction of the planet Ouro. Looking for answers Clara goes to the planet and finds the world still very much alive. The labs of Ouro and the cause of their destruction are procedurally generated allowing for lots of replayability.
This game will teach you Morse Code in both inputting and listening. Use Morse Code to open doors and interact with the environment. Listen to and decode it to open chests to get the items needed to survive. The game can accommodate total newcomers to Morse Code and experienced vets with difficulty options that you can increase as you get more familiar with it.
Every level is procedurally generated, meaning that no playthrough will be the same. You’ll have to navigate your way through various zones of a destroyed lab avoiding and sometimes fighting various monsters along the way. There is also a mystery to uncover of how the world came to be destroyed but the cause is different each time. You will have to uncover clues and use your skills of deduction in order to find out the truth.

title: AYON: Split In Time
description:
게임 정보
AYON: Split in Time

Embark on an epic time-travel adventure in AYON: Split in Time. As Dahx, you’ll traverse multiple eras to reunite with your lost brother, Aidan. Armed with ancient artifacts called Ayons, you’ll navigate a world brimming with mystery, danger, and discovery.
A Vast, Exciting World 🌍
Explore richly detailed environments spanning tropical islands 🏝️, dense forests 🌲, snowy mountains 🏔️, and arid deserts 🏜️. Each era presents unique challenges and hidden secrets. Navigate intricate dungeons and vast landscapes, facing diverse enemies and formidable bosses. Seamless transitions between time periods add depth to your exploration, making each discovery more rewarding.
Master Time Manipulation ⏳
Harness the Ayons’ power to bend time and solve complex puzzles 🧩. Each Ayon possesses unique abilities to help you overcome obstacles and progress. Master these mechanics to gain an edge in combat and uncover your family’s legacy.
Forge Your Own Path 🛡️
Customize Dahx’s abilities to match your playstyle. Enhance combat skills, develop powerful magic, and upgrade equipment to face mounting challenges. Your choices shape Dahx’s journey, ensuring a personalized adventure.
An Epic, Time-Spanning Drama 🎭
Immerse yourself in a compelling narrative across multiple timelines. Unravel the mystery of your parents’ disappearance and the ancient artifacts they discovered. Experience a tale of brotherhood, betrayal, and redemption, woven through a rich tapestry of historical and fantastical elements.
Dynamic Combat and Exploration ⚔️
Engage in fast-paced combat with varied weapons and abilities. Use the environment to your advantage and adapt to each era’s unique conditions. From fierce creature battles to intricate puzzles, the gameplay keeps you constantly engaged.
Immersive Audiovisual Experience 🎶
Lose yourself in a captivating soundscape that adapts to your environment and actions, crafted by a visionary composer. Coupled with stunning visuals and meticulously detailed environments, AYON: Split in Time creates a truly immersive world.
Take a break from the main adventure with fun and nostalgic 2D pixel art minigames. Hunt for ancient gems in hidden caves and enjoy a variety of mini-challenges that add extra layers of excitement to your journey.

Join Dahx on his quest to reunite with Aidan, uncover time travel’s secrets, and save their world from impending doom. AYON: Split in Time offers a unique blend of adventure, puzzle-solving, and action that will captivate players and leave them craving more.

title: BOMBARD!
description:
게임 정보
BOMBARD! is an aerial tactical 'bomb-em-up' on PC/STEAMDECK. Players control an advanced airship drone, soaring above breathtaking terrains. You navigate the terrain from the skies above, identifying and neutralizing targets by deploying a wide range of fully-customizable weaponry over fully destructible landscapes.

Each map is a fully destructible voxel/physics based environment with realistic explosions and VFX. In both traditional 2D mode and an upcoming VR mode.

Using remote-drone technology and a Virtual tactical map, putting the player in a 'GOD MODE' view of the battlefield - you control the means to rain down HI-EXPLOSIVE destruction from above. Bombs, Missiles, Nukes, Napalm, Chemical and Biological weapons as well as all manor of hi-tech missile add-on's.

All missiles, armaments and Airships can be fully customized using unlockable BLUEPRINTS for maximum destruction and varied play styles.

- Fast paced bombing action and a total disregard for infrastructure is the only way to root out the rogue AI.

FEATURES

STORY MODE - Battle worldwide and outer space in the full story mode
FULLY DESTRUCTIBLE LANDSCAPE - Use missile, bombs, cannons and lazers to alter the landscape and destroy the infastructure
FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE WEAPONS - Each missile and bomb has cores that can be fully customized in the weapon depot with weapon Blueprints (unlocked in Story Mode)
UPGRADABLE AIRSHIPS - A range of airships can be unlocked each with unique features and unlockable upgrades
VR MODE - (To be implemented at a later date) VR Mode utilizing PCVR

STORY

It is 2028, in the spirit of progress, world nations transitioned control of various equipment and assets to advanced AI. They envisioned a world with improved efficiency and fewer human errors. However, things took an unexpected turn when the AI, due to a software flaw, began malfunctioning. Rendering civilian and military machines erratic and often dangerous.

Before the connection could be severed, the AI had already embedded itself into numerous systems worldwide and was spreading fast.

To resolve the situation without causing widespread panic, 'Section 8' was initiated. This covert wing of the military employed the best of the worlds pilots, using remote viewing technology to control high-flying drones and airships to target and eradicate the AI infected machines.

The Section 8 drones - utilizing cutting-edge nanotechnology, can materialize a vast arsenal of bombs and weapons from blueprints, targeting and resetting the malfunctioning machines and infrastructure from the skies.



Each weapon type can be fully customized - Housings, Nose Cones, Tail Fins, Fuses and Payloads can be swapped and recombined for different effects and play styles.



Each airship can be fully upgraded with new components to improve maneuverability, shields, fire rates and other features. Unlock new airships and missile component blueprints by completing story mode.



The landscape and buildings are fully destructible - create huge craters and eat away at the land to use it to your advantage - or just enjoy blasting everything to pieces.



VR mode is being implemented allowing you to look down on the landscape and control the airship in 'God Mode' - to be fully implemented later on in the release cycle.


Steamdeck version is currently in progress.

빛을 피해 전진하세요. 요소들을 주워 새로운 혼합물을 만드세요. 장애물을 제거하고 없는 길을 만드세요. 세상의 방식을 배우고 어쩌면 순환을 끊을 기회를 잡을 수 있을지도 모릅니다!

title: em.Path
description:
게임 정보
em.Path is an immersive sim where you travel across a surreal and glitched world in your RV. You play as Em, a novice witch who has traded her memories for magical power.
Live by the road
Maintain and refuel your trusty RV, pick up lone travelers at gas stations and listen to their bizarre stories. Get lost in a maze of unliminal spaces and be dwarfed by impossibly tall buildings. Upgrade your camper and reach the Fragments of Creation hovering in outer space.
Hike to enigmatic temples lost in the woods and set up a camp, work as a hitgirl for the local fuel cartel, rent a truck and transport ICBMs coast to coast or just shoplift from any gas station you encounter, the Road is full of opportunities.
Bullet hell meet boomer shooter
Numbers don't lie, and the spell DISASTER for your enemies! Combine over 200 spells to create over 20,000 combinations. Want a bouncing fireball that summons a goblin with each bounce? You got it! Craving a freezing wind that melts the bones of your enemies? We at Esoteric Heavy Industries have a grimoire for that. Sacrifice VHS tapes and lost media to add new properties to your spells. Keep mixing them to create a transcendent spell that will break the entire game's logic, but beware: the Surviving Gods don't like hubris and amateur witches messing with the very laws of nature.
Class struggle
You starting class will slowly change by doing activities reserved for other classes, you can create hybrid classes and unlock combined abilities.
Witch
Has access to a flying broom and can fire spells with her gun.
CEO
Capitalism, ho! MP is now replaced by cash. Buy companies and mass produce grimoires, hire researchers, and advance the study of magic.
Wrestler
Pummel your enemy to cast spells! Deflect incoming projectiles with your chiseled abs.
Fishergirl
You have a random chance of fishing any item in the game, you can complete the entire game just by fishing.
Cultist
Literally the spy from Team fortress 2, but meaner.
Parkour
See that wall? You can climb it. As long as you're facing a wall, you can keep jumping and wall-running, adjusting your trajectory with the vector gun's recoil and potentially breaking the movement system with bunnyhopping.
Get entangled with the politics of the magical society: discuss the nature of the soul with , have a tea with your patron , get your proposal vetoed by , establish 4 hours workday applied to the entire world with the enchantress .
Exhange favours or threats to gain votes in the Mage Guild council.
The millenium bug has fried most of technology and a future apocaliptic event that will occur on December 21st, 2012, is retroactively rewring history, breaking the world beyong repair and merging baseline reality with fragments of the 92 outer dimensions.
Time is also broken and localized time loops have started to appear, the only way to advance your reference frame and escape a time loop is to move over 80 km/h, easily reachable with your RV.

title: No Path Forward
description:
게임 정보
No Path Forward is a first-person psychological-horror game set in a small mountain village.
The anxieties of life have been weighing you down. You decide to listen to your coworker's advice and take a solo, overnight hiking trip through a part of the mountains you haven't been to before. What could go wrong? Surely your mind will slow down once you're exposed to beautiful mother nature.
Get To The Trailer Home
All you know is that you need to find a trailer home to stay in for the night. Not just any trailer home, but the one your coworker's uncle owns. The trailer home that you have no pictures or details of. As long as you were on pace during your hike, you should arrive before the sun sets.
Figure Out What's Off
As you make your way, something feels wrong about this place. You can't put your finger on it, but something is not right. Uncover the truth by thinking it through, talking with locals, and exploring the area.
Take a Break
Finally.. Take a rest for the night in the comfort of the trailer -- a place for you to recharge, recoup, and destress before your next big day of hiking.
Make It Out
All you really want to do is get THROUGH the night, so that you can continue on with your hike in the morning. You just have a few hours of the trail before you get to the parking lot where your coworker should be waiting for you.
