게임 정보
JRoguePG takes the turn-based battles of a JRPG and combines it with a true Roguelike. From a seasoned JRPG developer, expect a robust and finely-tuned battle system that you will want to dive into again and again with the new classes you unlock, biomes you discover, and randomized equipment you receive during the run.

Evil plagues the world using fear and suffering to gain power. The world's only hope lies within a rift that opens only every decade. This rift allows four heroes to enter and attempt to battle their way to the source of the evil. Upon failure, a portion of the resources and any knowledge gained are left for the next decade's heroes to try again. How many heroes will you sacrifice to the rift in order to defeat Extol?
Unlock 30 classes including Ninja, Elementalist, Paladin, Thaumaturgist, Samurai, Hexblade, Battlemage, Lancer, and more!
Each class unlocks 3 class abilities any other class can equip
25 different biomes each with different themed monsters to learn how to defeat
Expect to use your brain to win battles. There is no mashing A to attack and win or an overpowered ability that kills everything
Randomized equipment chests, enemies, and biomes
How you build your party matters tremendously with class composition and how you equip them
Use resources you gather in the previous run to unlock upgrades like starting with more weapon experience, more frequent rare chests, manipulate the randomized biomes, start with more gold, and more!
PERFECT for the Steam Deck!

title: Bearly Brave
description:
게임 정보
Bearly Brave is a 2D roguelike deck-building game set in a deceptively charming toy shop, where the cutest teddy bears come to life each night to fight in a no-holds-barred tournament that determines their placement on the shelves—and thus their likeness to be taken to their forever home.
You’ll take on the role of Toby, a gentle bear forced into this brutal competition by the sadistic Boris. Mixing turn-based strategy with fast-paced deck-building, Bearly Brave challenges you to craft unique builds in Toby’s fight to escape the sinister clutches of the toy shop.
Equip Toby with a wide range of tools and abilities to overcome his foes. Utilize Weapon Effects, Skill Cards, Candies, Boss Rewards, and Patches to deal absurd amounts of damage and turn the tide of battle.

title: Rename the History
description:
게임 정보
전후 역사상 가장 어려운 시기에 국가를 이끄세요. 이때 강대국이 될지 강대국이 될지 선택해야 합니다. 서쪽으로 갈지 동쪽으로 갈지? 결정은 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 새로운 역사에서 국가를 잃지 않으려고 노력하고, 많은 갈등을 헤쳐 나가며 영향력을 높이세요.
당신의 목표는 21세기 초에 국가 지도자가 되는 것입니다. 국가를 개선해야 하며, 이는 여러 가지 방법으로 가능합니다. 강력한 국가 기관과 경제의 도움으로 강력한 우월성을 달성할 수 있습니다. 또는 강력한 군사 강대국이 되어 이웃을 정복하고 자신을 강대국이라고 선언할 수 있습니다. 두 가지 방법 모두 장단점이 있지만, 어떤 것을 선택할지는 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
군대
보병과 전차로 구성된 군대를 지휘하세요. 보병은 수비대를 만들고 정복한 국경을 보호하는 데 필요합니다. 전차는 전선을 돌파하는 데 필요합니다. 전선에서 승리하려면 여러 유형의 군대를 결합하세요!
경제와 건설
전장에서만 국가를 개발하는 것이 아닙니다. 돈을 빌리고, 사무실, 막사, 벙커를 건설할 수 있습니다. 귀하의 목표는 귀하의 국가에 최대의 번영을 이루는 것입니다. 다양한 경제 개발 방식을 결합하여 새로운 경제 기적을 위한 레시피를 만드십시오!
동맹과 외교
다른 국가와의 문제는 군사 행동의 형태로만 해결될 수 없습니다. 귀하는 그들과 동맹을 맺고, 군대의 통과를 요청하고, 인도적 지원을 보내는 등의 방법을 사용할 수 있습니다. 다양한 외교적 영향력 방법을 사용하여 국경에 편안한 환경을 조성하십시오.
국가 정책
국가 정책으로 국가 문제를 해결하십시오. 향후 60일 동안 국가 개발에 대한 초점을 선택하십시오. 이는 정치적 초점, 경제적 초점 또는 군사적 초점이 될 수 있습니다. 이 메커니즘은 귀하의 국가뿐만 아니라 전체 지역에도 강력한 영향을 미칩니다. 여기에서 강력한 외교 정책을 찾을 수 있습니다.
다양성의 강점
기억하세요. 선택할 수 있는 국가는 50개국 이상입니다. 그리고 각 메커니즘은 국가에 따라 더 중요하거나 덜 중요할 수 있습니다. 또한, 같은 국가에서 플레이하면 게임의 재미를 충분히 느낄 수 없습니다.

title: The Werewolf
description:
게임 정보
The Werewolf is an intense action-survival game where you become a cursed beast, doomed to transform under the full moon. When night falls, your hunger for blood takes over—eliminate enough victims to stave off the curse, or risk being consumed by it.
But the hunt won’t always be easy. As your reign of terror grows, the villagers may begin to fight back, forming a resistance with torches, traps, and weapons to defend themselves. If your killings draw too much attention, the kingdom may even send skilled knights to hunt you down, forcing you into brutal, high-stakes battles.
Amid the chaos, you may uncover the truth behind your curse. Who did this to you—and why? Will you seek revenge, hunting down the one responsible? Or will you succumb to the monster within, becoming the nightmare the world fears? The choice is yours, but the moon always rises again.

title: Carnival Survivors The Parade
description:
게임 정보
휴일과 카니발 시즌이 다가왔습니다! 모두가 축하하고 있지만, 오늘 지구를 침략하기로 결정한 몇몇 성가신 외계인들이 있습니다!

게임을 위해 독점적으로 작곡된 맞춤형 사운드트랙에 몰입하고, 액션의 비트와 완벽하게 조화를 이루세요.
실제 일러스트레이터들이 손으로 그린 만화 아트로 시각적으로 놀라운 경험을 즐기세요!
다양한 랜덤 파워업을 수집하고 트럭을 위해 새로운 음악가들을 모집하세요.
기타리스트, 드러머, 키보드 연주자 등 다양한 멤버로 밴드를 확장하세요!

몇 개의 적 파도에서 생존할 수 있을까요?

title: Broom Broom Karts
description:
게임 정보
🏁 Broom Broom Karts – Fast, Fun & Furry Racing Mayhem! 🚗💨
Get ready to drift, boost, and BROOM BROOM your way to victory in this fast-paced, cartoonish kart racer! Pick your favorite animal racer and battle it out across four thrilling tracks – from Wild West deserts to frozen winter wonderlands, magical fairytale roads, and tropical island escapes.
🔥 Arcade Racing at Its Best!
✅ Multiplayer Madness – Race against friends or foes in high-speed, action-packed showdowns!
✅ Boost, Drift & Fly – Hit speed boosts, soar over ramps, and master the tracks!
✅ 4 Unique Tracks – Each packed with shortcuts, hazards, and surprises.
✅ Adorable & Fierce Racers – Choose from a lineup of fast and furry characters.
🚀 Coming Soon: Special character abilities, power-ups, and even more wild tracks!
Whether you're racing solo or going wheel-to-wheel with friends, Broom Broom Karts is the ultimate low-poly, high-fun kart racing experience. Buckle up, hit the gas, and let's GO!

title: Rustic Defense
description:
게임 정보
Rustic Defense is a hexagonal fantasy tower defense game with roguelike elements, generated enviroment with option explore your own way.
Turrets
Like in classic tower defense game, you build turrets that fight with incoming enemies.
You can research 15 types of turrets that belong to five categories (archery, natural, guns, throwing, splash). Every turret has physical damage, advanced turrets adds elemental damage bonus (fire, poison, ice) and special attack feature. Elemental damage rise overtime damage or slowing monsters. 
Enemies
Enemies incoming from four bioms. The Valley is nearest and enemies haven't any armor. Mountains, Desert and Swamp monsters has armor with resistances to specific elemental attack.
Map
Map and enviroment is randomly generated. After each wave you can choose way that you want to explore.
Progress
After every game you obtain experiences depends on reached wave. Those experiences you can convert to skills in skill tree, that give you advantage for rest of game.

title: Shadow Eagle
description:
게임 정보
Shadow Eagle is a secret organization for peace. It is said that it dates back to the Seljuk Empire and perhaps even before that. Recently, they have been fighting for justice all around the globe.
In a recent robbery that took place in one of London's museums, only the portrait of Sultan Mehmed the Conqueror was stolen. Deniz sets out to Dublin to meet with the person who was examining and researching the painting before the robbery. While waiting in a pub for the meeting he learns that there will be an attack on the Limon Company data center.
Deniz and his connection Orla make a plan to stop this attack.
However this is just the beginning. What is the purpose of this attack? Why are they going to Türkiye, all of a sudden? Shadow Eagle faces an international criminal organization.

title: 魔法之境 Magic Realm
description:
게임 정보
Synopsis
The story of Magic Realm begins in a small town nestled in a dangerous misty forest, where a series of mysterious events take place that propel the protagonist to the town's hidden truth.........
Character portraits
How to play
In addition to the plot, this game also sets up different levels for players to experience, and the battle is a 2D pinball gameplay, and players can better defeat monsters through different combinations of potions and skills.

title: Balkanija
description:
게임 정보
"Balkanija" is a unique blend of adventure, quests, and economic strategy that immerses you in an exciting world on the edge of Europe. The action takes place in the colorful capital of one of the Balkan countries, where life is bustling in a Romani neighborhood filled with vibrant characters and unexpected twists.

You will take control of the fates of the main characters — Hanko and his wife Zoe. Each new day will bring new opportunities, introduce you to interesting people, and present tasks that will make you think about the true values of life.

In this world, even the most mundane tasks can turn into thrilling adventures, but there will also be serious challenges. You will need to maintain a balance between the everyday lives of your heroes and the challenges posed by economic hardships and criminal threats.

Interact with other characters, manage resources and time, and make important decisions — every action you take will have consequences for the fate of Hanko and Zoe. Will you find a way to survive and find happiness in this complex yet captivating world?
Key Features:
Introduction of New Heroes: As the story progresses, you will encounter new characters who can join your team. Each hero has unique skills and can perform various tasks.
Quests: The gameplay is enriched with a quest system that helps you explore the diverse capabilities of your characters and unlock their potential.
Economy: The economy is an integral part of the game. Earn money through various means and use it to develop your business, support your family, and engage in gambling activities.

title: Destruction Overdrive
description:
게임 정보
FULLY. DESTRUCTIBLE. TRACK.
Use your missiles to carve new paths through any wall.
Use your bombs to blow holes in the track, making it harder for your opponents....and you
MULTI-PLAYER
You and up to 12 friends can race, destroy, and obliterate to place 1st
SINGLE PLAYER
Race against the self-destruct timer, finding and optimizing your own paths of ruin is the only way to win
STRATEGIZE
Discover or destroy the shortcuts created
Are your skills better at racing around the track naturally?
Create even tighter corners to take around the race track, or just blast your way right through the middle

title: Archer Hero
description:
게임 정보
Play as the titular Archer Hero as he sets off to climb the mysterious tower that suddenly appeared one day. Conquer the procedurally genereated floors, defeat the monsters that lurk in the shadows and solve the puzzles of this enigmatic tower. Loot the tower as you climb to strengthen your abilities and take on tougher and tougher monsters. Can you reach the top, and uncover the secret origin of the tower?
Features
Procedurally generated floors, leading to a different experience each playthrough.
Puzzle rooms containing floor tile puzzles, numbered orb puzzles, and more.
Variety of items that can strengthen the Archer Hero in numerous ways.
Large cast of enemies designed to match the theme of each floor.
Multitude of bosses and mini-bosses.
Secret end-game content.

title: Descent
description:
게임 정보
Survive
Descent is a co-op survival horror game centered around an ever-changing environment of levels and enemies, where a party of up to 4 (four) players need to complete objectives and make use of stealth to escape and further progress their story.

title: Submansion
description:
게임 정보
In Submansion, you will travel through ten rooms in search of lost keys and an unvaliable thing. Your guide will be the Keykeeper. At first glance, a helpless lady who could not even cope with her main task - to keep the keys.

Game features:
- Visual novel with choices
- Multiple endings
- Point & click elements

title: Skera VR
description:
게임 정보
Skera is a single-player, puzzle-solving action adventure game designed for VR.
- A Dying World and an Ancient Tower -
In Skera VR, you find yourself imprisoned within an ancient colossal Tower, and a planet slowly decaying around you. Following the stories of your people, you have come here to the Tower to save your people. You will need to face robotic automatons, puzzles and the machinations of an Unpredictable AI. Luckily you have something more than fighting spirit to get you out of this.
- The Guardian Sword, Procedural Cutting!-

title: Stellar Reach
description:
게임 정보
Coming soon!
Some time in our future, humans and their machine work force have reached a distant stellar neighbourhood and multiple factions are competing for dominance. Explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate across the nearby stars in a real-scale, fully-3D environment to overcome your rivals, mastering military power, prosperous governance, booming industry, wealth, resources, and their separate technology trees. Choose your faction and your path to victory, but travel it alone; you’ll find no friends in the hostile and dangerous depths of space.
Military
There are no alliances or treaties - everyone is a threat, all of the time.
Build fleets of ships and armies to defend, attack, colonise, and occupy the many planets in the local stellar neighbourhood. Engage enemies on the surface of planet and in space warfare.
Prosperity

title: Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena
description:
게임 정보
Discover the culture of the Huni Kuin indigenous people, the true people!
A classic 2D platform game
Explore each story in a 2D platform game full of obstacles and animals typical of the Amazon Rainforest.
Different weapons and mechanics
Respect the Yuxibu (Forest Great Spirit), play with bow and arrow, club or spear and discover the strength of Nixi Pae (ayahuasca) and Dume Deshke (rapé)!
Various bosses
Face powerful enemies such as the harpy eagle, the big owl, the scorpion king, the bridge alligator and many other fantastic animals and enchanted beings.
Immerse yourself in the mysteries of the Enchanted Boa, the power of the vine (huni) and the leaf (kawa) and the secrets of the people of the forest!
Follow the stories through original drawings by the Beya Xinã Bena group and listen to the narration in the Huni Kuin language itself, the Hátxa Kuï!


This game was made in partnership with the Beya Xinã Bena collective, from the Kaxinawá Indigenous Lands of Rio Jordão, in the state of Acre, in the Brazilian Amazon region, to provide an immersion in indigenous knowledge such as songs, drawings, stories, myths and rituals of the people.

The collective Beya Xinã Bena (New Time Culture) was formed at the initiative of indigenous participants during the game's first workshop, in 2014, with the aim of gathering, promoting and disseminating audiovisual productions linked to the digital technologies of the Huni Kuĩ of Rio Jordão. It is a collective of indigenous audiovisual productions.

title: Wiseguys: The Commission
description:
게임 정보
Prohibition is over, but the world of organized crime continues to thrive. New York City is controlled by five powerful mafia families, in a fierce struggle for power. In this scenario of intrigue and power, your cunning and determination will be tested as never before.

Manage your Family and build an empire
Take on the role of Don and build your own criminal empire. Manage your family’s resources and affiliates; plan every move, from petty crimes to large-scale operations and earn respect through a combination of diplomacy and violence.

Extortion, robbery or burning of business
Use ruthless methods to raise funds and expand your influence. Extort money from local merchants, rob your rivals or burn their property to show your power and intimidate those who dare to oppose.

Wage war on other families and kill their mademan
Declare war on rival families and eliminate their mademan: plan strategic attacks, assassinations and ambushes to weaken them. Defend your territory and consolidate your power. Violence is inevitable in your ascent; only the most smart and determined will succeed.

Drug trafficking
Infiltrate the lucrative drug market and increase your income. Secure safe supplies, distribute goods to maximize profits and avoid the attention of law enforcement.

Control the Commission
Become the head of the Commission and use your power to influence decisions that govern the criminal world. Negotiate with the other mafia families and make important decisions. Your leadership will be crucial to maintain order among the mafia families and establish your dominance over all criminal activities in the city.

Be Ready for Arrests and Investigations
The law is always on our tail. Protect your organization from arrest and investigation, bribe the police and use informants to stay one step ahead of law enforcement. And "manage" the “infamy” problem.

Launder dirty money
A dirty dollar is worth less than a clean one. Launder your illicit earnings by investing in legitimate assets to avoid suspicion and maintain a constant cash flow. Clean money is the most useful during difficult times.

Wiseguys: The Commission combines deep management strategy with intense action, giving you deep strategic experience in the dark world of the Italian mafia in a charming 2D style. Are you ready to be the next boss of all bosses?

title: SOWA VR
description:
게임 정보
SOWA VR - is a multiplayer virtual reality shooter with a focus on community features. Realistic and simplified recharge features and fast paced combat as part of the core experience.

Features
Community hosted dedicated servers.
Quick-starting lobby system.
Search And Destroy, Deathmatch, King of the arena, and Gun Game game modes.
Bots.
Offline mode.
Practice range.
Proximity voice chat and radio communication.

title: Deadly Trick
description:
게임 정보
'Deadly Trick'은 서브컬처 사회적 추론 생존 게임입니다!
폭탄 목걸이가 터지지 않도록 목걸이의 전력을 공급해서
라스토프 학교에서 벌어지는 데스 게임, '특별 수업'에서 살아남는 것이 게임의 목표입니다.
친구들을 모아 같이 플레이하세요!

title: Light Night Street
description:
게임 정보
A new type of bullet hell action game is born!
Bounce back the barrage of shouts with your shield and witness the moment bullet hell games go from "difficult" to "exciting"!
Unique and diverse mecha (weapons).
Aim 360 degrees with the right stick.
Block the attacks of powerful enemies with your shield and counterattack when you see an opening.
The entire game takes place in beautiful night-time cities.
The battle begins with memorable soundtracks!

title: Adrenaline Overdrive
description:
게임 정보
In an alternate 1980s where North Korea won their war, Brooklyn lies in ruins. The streets are controlled by the Vires syndicate, operating under the facade of Virical Corporations. As a former detective whose brother was murdered while investigating Virical Corporations, you've made a fatal choice: injecting yourself with ISS, a deadly military-grade stimulant that grants superhuman abilities at the cost of your life.
KEY FEATURES:
• MASTER SUPERNATURAL MOVEMENT
Run, jump, and slide as you tear through urban battlegrounds. Your enhanced abilities make you unstoppable - if you can stay alive long enough to use them.
• EXPLORE A FRACTURED CITY
From neon-lit corporate towers to abandoned subway tunnels, every corner of this alternate Brooklyn tells a story of war, corruption, and resistance.

title: Distant Oceanic Getaway
description:
게임 정보



Distant Oceanic Getaway - A visual novel for sapphics!
The cruise ship’s horns blast. You’re going to be spending the next 10 days aboard the Distant Oceanic Cruise, a luxury vacation for sapphics only! Play as Maeve (customizable name), a heartbroken soul determined to move on from a cheating ex. There are only six other single sapphics on board— could one possibly be your soulmate? Only time will tell! After all, ‘tis the SEA-son for love!


You’ll have 10 days aboard the ship to explore, interact with characters, and have fun. Get drunk at the bar and pass out after having three drinks! Contemplate the meaning of life with a stranger you just met! There are endless choices for you to make and infinite opportunities for you to explore! And… perhaps even a secret hidden storyline for you to uncover? 



Your choices will shape your experience aboard the cruise. What kind of person will you be? Who will you fall in love with? Which ship will set sail? And where will you end up after these fateful 10 days…?

title: Star Crew
description:
게임 정보
Star Crew is a 1-8 player co-op sci-fi roguelite. Maintain subsystems, fend off enemies, and stay alive long enough for evac to arrive. Powerful upgrade choices, procedurally-generated ships, and permanent progression. Survive with friends or handle things all by yourself.
1-8 PLAYER CO-OP
Manually maintain your ship's subsystems long enough for evac to arrive. Management has provided you with tools to enhance your maintenance capabilities. Operate machines and dispatch intruders. Repair equipment and break trespassers. Automate your maintenance tasks and install defenses against intruders!
MINIGAME MAINTENANCE
Every subsystem must be maintained by completing minigames. Flush the core, feed the eels, shoot the asteroids, tighten the valves, align the antenna, and prevent intruders from activating the self-destruct sequence. If one subsystem goes down, the entire ship immediately explodes. Who built these ships to work like this?
ROGUELITE CUSTOMIZATION
Choose powerful upgrades between rounds to increase your chances of survival! Become an unstoppable force to be reckoned with in combat. Master the ways of optimized engineering. Carve your own path. Survive increasingly difficult challenges as more and more of your ship's subsystems break down. Complete tasks manually or find ways to automate them. Necessity is the mother of invention!
PROCEDURALLY GENERATED SHIPS

title: Cat Tree
description:
게임 정보
Cat Tree is a relaxing and captivating indie game where you can collect adorable cats that inhabit a mysterious tree. Starting with just a few cats, you'll watch as your tree grows, revealing new sections with fresh spots for your charming pets.
Discover a variety of cats hiding in each container!
You'll find everything from common to the most unique ones. Collect them all to expand your collection.
Your task is to nurture the cats, watch them grow, and decide which ones to keep in your collection and which to sell for profit. Explore the tree and uncover all its secrets while enjoying the peaceful and soothing atmosphere of the game.

title: BEANDEJO
description:
게임 정보
Enter the Old West, where the cattle roam, the lawmen keep the peace, and drunken vegetables terrorize the local saloons! You are a Mexican jumping bean fixing to bring the long arm of the law to the disorderly vegetables of Cactusdale. Armed with your trusty revolver, will you lock up these nutritious varmints and become the town’s next sheriff?
Gameplay
BEANDEJO is an action-packed top-down roguelite shooter stuffed with spaghetti western elements and veggie brutality. Hop through the saloons of Cactusdale, taking down vegetable outlaws to rack up the highest score possible. Each move must be quick and precise as you progress through different saloon rooms, as you are constantly outnumbered by a rogue’s gallery of wicked bandits. Master a unique shooting style where timing is essential for success. Rotate your gun clockwise or counterclockwise to shoot your way to victory!
Key Features
Unique control scheme
Goofy cartoon visuals
Challenging gameplay loop
Dozens of hand-crafted saloon rooms
Classic Old West weapons

title: Bumble Rumble
description:
게임 정보

The peaceful world of bees has suddenly come under attack. Embark with your bee friends on a quest to restore peace using your strategic skills.

BumbleRumble is a fusion of Peglin and TowerDefense and plays like one, creating amazing combinations with different bees and relics, but be careful not to lose all your hit points or else...

title: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
Beyond the jagged seas lies the the land of Dragaea, you arrived on it's shores called by a mysterious force in a dream to discover it's secrets and become a legend in your own right. Legends of Dragaea is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler, where you form parties of heroes and plumb mysterious dungeons in search of glory, wealth, and loot.




Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is inspired by classic JRPGs distilling down the essence to it's roots as an idle dungeon crawler. Discover unique locations, visit the Adventurer's Guild and tear quests from the quest board advancing through the tiered ranking system reaping greater rewards. Encounter dangerous enemies that will test your might, and confront calamitous bosses.



With 18 skills dedicated to combat for a robust free-form skill system including melee, ranged, and magic characters allowing you to specialize your heroes any way you wish. Augment your team with over 25+ abilities each like Bonk, Fissure, and Life Steal, using any 4 abilities in any combination you choose. As you explore Dragaea you will be able to recruit new party members to aid you in your journey forming multiple teams of 3 to explore dungeons and tackle challenges becoming the finest adventuring guild in all the land.



The land of Dragaea is a place filled mystery, intrigue, and precious treasure. Collect and upgrade over 200+ pieces of weapons, armor, accessories, items, and other consumables to augment your party's prowess. No two pieces of equipment are the same with different rarities and stats affecting the possibilities. Found a favorite axe or staff? Upgrade it to it's max potential and give your adventurers the finest tools to do the job. A full featured inventory system and shop system lets you manage your collections effortlessly.

title: Head Chef
description:
게임 정보
Open your restaurant and lead it to success.
Create your menu by selecting what dishes to serve. Supply the kitchen accordingly if you do not want to run out of ingredients during service! You can do it yourself, or you can hire a supply manager.
Open the doors of your restaurant and start cooking! Cut, blend, grill, bake and fry ingredients: elevate them to make fantastic dishes. Plate the food and bring it to the delivery counter, where waiters will pick it up. Be fast! Guests are not willing to wait forever and may walk out of the restaurant. Line cooks are there to help you, but they also make mistakes. Supervise, coordinate and motivate them! It will take the right combination of carrot and stick to get the best out of your team.
Prepare delicious desserts in the pastry laboratory. Don't make too many - you want to serve only fresh and tasty cakes to your guests. A pastry chef may help you discover new recipes and will keep your restaurant well-stocked.

title: Skera VR
description:
게임 정보
Skera is a single-player, puzzle-solving action adventure game designed for VR.
- A Dying World and an Ancient Tower -
In Skera VR, you find yourself imprisoned within an ancient colossal Tower, and a planet slowly decaying around you. Following the stories of your people, you have come here to the Tower to save your people. You will need to face robotic automatons, puzzles and the machinations of an Unpredictable AI. Luckily you have something more than fighting spirit to get you out of this.
- The Guardian Sword, Procedural Cutting!-

title: Distant Oceanic Getaway
description:
게임 정보



Distant Oceanic Getaway - A visual novel for sapphics!
The cruise ship’s horns blast. You’re going to be spending the next 10 days aboard the Distant Oceanic Cruise, a luxury vacation for sapphics only! Play as Maeve (customizable name), a heartbroken soul determined to move on from a cheating ex. There are only six other single sapphics on board— could one possibly be your soulmate? Only time will tell! After all, ‘tis the SEA-son for love!


You’ll have 10 days aboard the ship to explore, interact with characters, and have fun. Get drunk at the bar and pass out after having three drinks! Contemplate the meaning of life with a stranger you just met! There are endless choices for you to make and infinite opportunities for you to explore! And… perhaps even a secret hidden storyline for you to uncover? 



Your choices will shape your experience aboard the cruise. What kind of person will you be? Who will you fall in love with? Which ship will set sail? And where will you end up after these fateful 10 days…?

title: Star Crew
description:
게임 정보
Star Crew is a 1-8 player co-op sci-fi roguelite. Maintain subsystems, fend off enemies, and stay alive long enough for evac to arrive. Powerful upgrade choices, procedurally-generated ships, and permanent progression. Survive with friends or handle things all by yourself.
1-8 PLAYER CO-OP
Manually maintain your ship's subsystems long enough for evac to arrive. Management has provided you with tools to enhance your maintenance capabilities. Operate machines and dispatch intruders. Repair equipment and break trespassers. Automate your maintenance tasks and install defenses against intruders!
MINIGAME MAINTENANCE
Every subsystem must be maintained by completing minigames. Flush the core, feed the eels, shoot the asteroids, tighten the valves, align the antenna, and prevent intruders from activating the self-destruct sequence. If one subsystem goes down, the entire ship immediately explodes. Who built these ships to work like this?
ROGUELITE CUSTOMIZATION
Choose powerful upgrades between rounds to increase your chances of survival! Become an unstoppable force to be reckoned with in combat. Master the ways of optimized engineering. Carve your own path. Survive increasingly difficult challenges as more and more of your ship's subsystems break down. Complete tasks manually or find ways to automate them. Necessity is the mother of invention!
PROCEDURALLY GENERATED SHIPS

title: Fogpiercer
description:
게임 정보
Fogpiercer는 열차를 구축하고 업그레이드하여 덱을 구축하는 덱빌딩 로그라이트 게임입니다. 독특한 객차 카드를 사용해 격자식 필드에서 약탈자들과 맞서 싸우세요. 여러분의 최종 덱은 플레이 중에 내린 선택에 따라 달라집니다.
번뜩이는 순간들
위치 선정이 핵심입니다. 카드를 잘 활용하면 적들이 서로를 공격하게 만들거나, 길에서 밀어내거나, 심지어 적을 열차의 경로에 배치해 바퀴로 깔아 뭉갤 수도 있습니다!
열차를 업그레이드하고, 강력한 덱을 구축하세요
여러분의 열차가 곧 덱입니다. 각 객차는 고유한 카드를 보유하고 있으며, 업그레이드할수록 새로운 카드가 덱에 추가되어 즉시 사용할 수 있습니다. 또한, 객차에는 시너지 카드도 존재하며, 두 객차가 최대 레벨에 도달하면 활성화됩니다.
지도를 보며 최적의 전략을 구상하세요
여정은 결코 쉽지 않습니다. 열차를 최종 목적지까지 이끌려면 올바른 선택들을 내려야 하며, 때로는 잘못된 선택의 위험을 감수해야 할 수도 있습니다. 게임에 대한 이해가 깊어질수록, 다음 이동 경로를 결정할 때 선택할 수 있는 전략도 함께 늘어나게 됩니다.

title: RHYTHMIC
description:
게임 정보
RHYTHMIC combines the fast-paced VR rhythm-game genre with tactical tower defense. Collect magical particles in tune with epic music and skillfully unleash powerful spells upon invading enemies to defend the people whose only hope is your prowess!

title: Sling-A-Thing
description:
게임 정보
"Sling-A-Thing"는 마음을 엉망으로 만드는 코미디 액션 퍼즐 게임입니다. 극도로 다양한 만화 캐릭터와 물건으로 변신하여 출구를 찾아 나가세요.
특징:
특이하고 놀라운, 만족스러운 게임 플레이
각 레벨은 특이한 도전과 만족스러운 해결책으로 당신을 놀라게 할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다. 각 퍼즐에 포함된 유머와 창의성은 모든 순간을 즐겁게 만듭니다.

수작으로 만든 레벨 200개 이상
200개 이상의 독특한 레벨이 준비되어 있어 항상 새로운 도전이 기다리고 있습니다. 각 레벨에는 다양한 장애물과 퍼즐이 있어 당신의 지혜와 반사 신경을 시험합니다.

20가지 이상 다른 것으로 변신
"Sling-A-Thing"의 가장 흥미로운 기능 중 하나는 20가지 이상의 다양한 캐릭터와 물건으로 변신할 수 있다는 것입니다. 기괴한 생물부터 일상적인 물건까지, 각 변신은 퍼즐을 해결하는 데 도움이되는 독특한 능력을 제공합니다. 심장과 유령, 모루와 태양, 거북이와 똥, 조합은 무한합니다!

독특한 변신 메커니즘
변신 메커니즘은 정말로 독창적이며 상상할 수 있습니다. 어떤 변신을 언

description:
게임 정보
SOWA VR - is a multiplayer virtual reality shooter with a focus on community features. Realistic and simplified recharge features and fast paced combat as part of the core experience.

Community hosted dedicated servers.
Quick-starting lobby system.

title: Apple Pie Bueno
description:
게임 정보


Immersive RPG. A narrative-driven role-playing game. Unite the region as a post-nuclear drug-running god... guinea pig for science and scavenge as a peaceful vagrant… or experiment as some third kind of person so indefinable you upset the elderly

Freedom of Exploration. Navigate by landmark as you explore the dilemmas of this rich, open world's factions and inhabitants. Try to help, ignore them outright, or play both sides as you see fit

Unforgettable Encounters. A cast overflowing with unique characters, each with secrets to uncover and problems to solve. Have deep conversations, philosophize on society, investigate, rant, provide therapy, or manipulate

Intricate, Branching Stories. Secrets are devastating in the wrong hands and actions taken at the wrong time can be catastrophic. Numerous endings differ drastically based on player behavior

Imagination Fuel. An ambient, unobtrusive soundtrack provides each location with a unique theme and underscores the lonely spaciousness of the open prairie

New World. Discover dozens of bizarre post-apocalyptic locales as you trek the barren landscape. Piece together the connections that tie this world together

title: NIA
description:
게임 정보
Drill, smash, leap and slide through this 2d puzzle platformer mashing retro graphics & icepunk aesthetics. Explore dozens of hand crafted worlds in well over 100 different levels.

A young icer-nomad must drill, battle, and puzzle her way towards the discovery of a lifetime - the true cause of The Silver Storm and the last warm day on Earth - to save her family from the growing cold.


A young icer-nomad has just been given her first ice drill and joined her place in the community as an icercadet. Everything is going just as it should and everyone is doing their part - except that hasn’t stopped the frost from growing through the farmbeds and the lights from crackle-popping in the frigid night. Every once in a while, spectral glimpses of the cities of old can be admired through the permafrost asbut the elders only mutter ”the past is the past’. The Silver Storm is now nothing but a story told to keep cadets under their electric blankets at night.

With fantasies of canned ham and the magical foods of The Before time drifting through the new cadet’s mind, a glimpse of a factory lost deep in the ice beneath her makeshift bed is all she needs to make her decision - she’s going down. As she drills, a crack forms, a large crack that swallows her up and slides her into the depths of the ice below.

Lost in the Underice, she must now find her family the food they need while navigating the dangers lurking below her world. If that means she has to solve the mystery of The Silver Storm and end the global ice age, then so be it. People have to eat.



NIA is a lighthearted old-school 2D platformer with a few modern twists.


13 worlds hand crafted to offer the best possible experience.


A complex simplicity reminiscent of the classics, handcrafted levels for fans of platformers old and new.


:

title: Deadly Trick
description:
게임 정보
'Deadly Trick'은 서브컬처 사회적 추론 생존 게임입니다!
폭탄 목걸이가 터지지 않도록 목걸이의 전력을 공급해서
라스토프 학교에서 벌어지는 데스 게임, '특별 수업'에서 살아남는 것이 게임의 목표입니다.
친구들을 모아 같이 플레이하세요!

title: Light Night Street
description:
게임 정보
A new type of bullet hell action game is born!
Bounce back the barrage of shouts with your shield and witness the moment bullet hell games go from "difficult" to "exciting"!
Unique and diverse mecha (weapons).
Aim 360 degrees with the right stick.
Block the attacks of powerful enemies with your shield and counterattack when you see an opening.
The entire game takes place in beautiful night-time cities.
The battle begins with memorable soundtracks!

title: Adrenaline Overdrive
description:
게임 정보
In an alternate 1980s where North Korea won their war, Brooklyn lies in ruins. The streets are controlled by the Vires syndicate, operating under the facade of Virical Corporations. As a former detective whose brother was murdered while investigating Virical Corporations, you've made a fatal choice: injecting yourself with ISS, a deadly military-grade stimulant that grants superhuman abilities at the cost of your life.
KEY FEATURES:
• MASTER SUPERNATURAL MOVEMENT
Run, jump, and slide as you tear through urban battlegrounds. Your enhanced abilities make you unstoppable - if you can stay alive long enough to use them.
• EXPLORE A FRACTURED CITY
From neon-lit corporate towers to abandoned subway tunnels, every corner of this alternate Brooklyn tells a story of war, corruption, and resistance.

title: captain midnight
description:
게임 정보
Captain Midnight is a first-person horrific mystery game about what happens after the end of the world. 
It started small. A few sick people here, a few sick people there. Then there was thousands, millions. We called them "the drowned," on account of us not being all that creative back then. They ran for the ocean until the air left their lungs and the squirming masses burst from their eyes like confetti. Real mess, I tell ya. I saw it myself once or twice. Don't recommend it. 
Save The World
Just kidding. The worlds cooked, rotten. You missed the boat on saving it by a few decades- but there's still good to be done. 
A new disease is spreading amongst the survivors, a real doozy. I'll spare ya the details but let's just say somethings eating all of their memories, gobbling them right up. And then replacing them with fake ones. Ive seen em talk for an hour about kids they never raised, that never existed.
And then...well, it gets worse. Rather not write it down, to be honest, so I'll brief you on the way. Not good to dwell.   
Find Patient Zero
Someone started this, Captain. Someone dove too deep, deeper than deep, I reckon, and caught something other than dinner. 
To kill it, youre gonna have to find it. Find where it started. Find the source and snuff it out. 
It won't be easy, no sirree, you'll have to use all your grandfather's tools to track it. I know his body's still warm but the tide doesn't wait.

It never stops and neither do we, my young friend. 
Ill be waiting at the docks for you. Bring a change of clothes.
-- Twilight Kid

title: EggChickenFarm
description:
게임 정보
EggChickenFarm is a casual idle simulation game centered around nurturing baby chickens and collecting different chicken species in your chicken catalog.
Hatching and Growing
Start your journey with an ordinary egg! Care for each little chick, watching them grow from nothing into beautiful chickens. Provide them with delicious food and a comfortable environment to help them thrive.
Breeding and Management
Using the breeding house, you can select the best pairs of chickens to produce new eggs and chicks. Each breeding session has the potential to create unique new species, so come and complete your chicken catalog! Gradually expand your farming scale, manage resources wisely, sell fresh eggs to earn coins, upgrade facilities, and purchase more content and decorations.
Dressing Up Chickens and the Farm
Give your chickens adorable hats and change their styles to showcase their unique personalities! You can also adjust the farm scenery to alter the appearance of your space at any time. Create a warm and unique farm that stands out!

title: Be Honest
description:
게임 정보
Be Honest is a horror personality quiz. It starts out innocent and slowly becomes c̸͕̃o̴̧͎̝͋r̵̻̪̚͠r̶̢͎͠ṷ̶̃̚p̸̛̳͆͘ṱ̵̞̉̇̃e̵̡̞̦̐d̶͎͌̈̈́.
Features:
Introspective questions that will teach you about yourself.
4 Good Endings
4 Bad Endings
1 Secret Ending
Images with the correct number of eyeballs.

title: Viking Breaker
description:
게임 정보
⚔️ Escape from the Underworld!
In Viking Breaker, you play as Olaf, a Viking banished to the depths of Hell. Climb aboard your drakkar, sail across rivers of lava, and smash through infernal walls with your magical shields. Fight your way through hordes of demonic creatures and challenge the guardians of Helheim, Niflheim, and a corrupted Asgard.
🛡️ Build your arsenal as you go!
During your journey, choose from powerful upgrades: shields with unique effects, specialized crew members, and devastating rune powers. Create unique combinations in every run to overcome the growing dangers of the Underworld.

title: Comic Book Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Manage your very own comic book store!
Step into the shoes of a comic book store owner and transform your humble store to a bookworm's haven!
Buy comic licenses, hire staff, and engage in various events such as book signings and collect rare version of comics and sell it at a premium! Use various tools to protect your store from troublemakers and keep your store clean! And explore the surrounding areas inspired by the Japanese backstreets!
Features :
Buy licenses to unlock comics, mangas, and manhwas of various genres!
Unlock and collect over 40+ comics, each with its own parodies & unique art!
Hire staff to help you with your store such as restocking, and security
Explore the surrounding areas with the backdrop of a Japanese backstreet
Decorate your store and make it more appealing to customers!
Upgrade your tools and unlock new rooms for your store!

title: United Heist: Facility Zero
description:
게임 정보
정보
이 게임은 두 명의 플레이어가 필요하며, 소통을 위해 게임 내 음성 채팅을 사용합니다. 추가 소프트웨어는 필요하지 않습니다.
두 장소, 당신으로 연결
각자 다른 장소에서 협력하며, 각 장소에는 오직 파트너만 해결할 수 있는 독특한 퍼즐이 가득합니다. 모든 행동은 게임 내 음성 채팅을 통한 명확한 소통에 달려 있습니다. 제한 시간이 끝나기 전에 코드를 풀고 탈출할 수 있겠습니까?
특징
2인 협동 플레이: 각기 다른 장소에서 협력하며, 아이템과 퍼즐을 사용해 서로 진행을 도와주세요.
몰입감 있는 스토리: 독특하고 완전 음성으로 구성된 강탈 스토리에 빠져보세요.
게임 내 음성 채팅: 해킹할 수 없는 특수 주파수를 사용하는 옛날식 무전기로 전문적으로 소통하세요.
분위기: 평범하지 않은 모든 것을 숨기고 있는 신비한 비밀 벙커를 탐험하세요.

title: Warfactory
description:
게임 정보
멸망 직전의 은하계의 운명을 개척하세요. 고대 인공지능의 사령관으로서 여러분의 임무는 분명합니다: 어떤 대가를 치르더라도 은하계를 구하는 것입니다. 공상 과학 RTS와 산업 자동화 장르의 융합을 만족시키는 워팩토리에서 첨단 산업과 장대한 군대의 힘을 활용하세요. 끊임없는 외계 위협에 맞서 궁극의 전쟁 기계를 설계, 제작 및 지휘하세요.
첨단 군사 생산 체인을 건설하여 플라즈마 검, 로켓 발사기, 거대한 기계 선체 등 군대에 필요한 모든 것을 제작하세요. 모든 행성은 적대적인 환경, 제한된 자원, 끊임없는 적의 공격으로 인해 가장 효율적인 전쟁 공장도 시험대에 오르는 새로운 도전입니다.

title: Let's Freeze Some Penguins
description:
게임 정보
Now you're thinking with penguins!
Northern Bear is crawling with penguins! The Emperor Penguin is moving his minions north of the arctic circle, and it’s up to Walnut the Walrus and Noklas the Narwhal to freeze them in their tracks! Use Walnut’s Walrus Wind to freeze penguins into ice-blocks. Use the ice-blocks to build new paths, stairs, and bridges! This simple concept is the foundation of a whole adventure of puzzling predicaments.
Over 50 puzzle levels
3 worlds and a bonus world
Spike-balls, treadmills, elevators, and many more puzzle elements
Collect 3 Fish Medallions per level to unlock new areas
Collect message-bottles with letters from Walnut’s missing parents
Defeat the dreaded Emperor Penguin and stop his invasion!
Music by Karl Rosqvist

title: GSC - Game Store Chronicle
description:
게임 정보
IT IS NOT JUST A SIMULATOR, IT IS PLAYABLE HISTORY!
Step into the exciting world of gaming history and run your own game store! This simulation lets you experience the highs and lows of managing a video game shop while immersing yourself in the evolution of gaming through the decades.
Design and Manage Your Store
From the very first console launches to the dawn of iconic gaming eras, your store will grow alongside the industry. Organize shelves, create attractive displays, and ensure your shop is the go-to destination for gaming enthusiasts. Make every decision count—your store layout and product selection are key to customer satisfaction.
Stay Ahead of the Timeline
In Game Store Chronicle, the timeline matters. As new gaming generations unfold, iconic consoles, games, and accessories will arrive on the scene. Prepare for these key events, stock the right products at the right time, and ride the wave of excitement to maximize your profits. Anticipating trends and staying ahead of the curve will set you apart from the competition.
Stock, Sell, and Strategize
Start your journey by browsing product catalogs to pick and choose items for your store. Call suppliers to place your orders and receive deliveries. As time progresses, upgrade to more advanced tools like in-game computers to streamline your inventory management. Whether it’s selling the latest console, nostalgic games, or must-have accessories, balancing supply, demand, and customer satisfaction is critical to growing your business.
Expand and Evolve
As your profits grow, so can your store! Expand your space, upgrade your interiors, and cater to the needs of an ever-growing customer base. Keep up with the ever-changing gaming landscape, adapt to new trends, and ensure your store remains the top choice for gamers.
A Dynamic Experience
Every decision you make shapes your business—from product selection to pricing strategies. Will you build a thriving store that becomes a gaming hub, or will you fall behind as trends shift and evolve? The choice is yours in this vibrant simulation.

title: Cat Girl Survivor
description:
게임 정보
"Cat Girl Survivor : Bullet Action“은 뱀서라이크 게임의 단순한 플레이 방식과 다양한 캐릭터, 장비 아이템, 스킬, 플레이모드가 조합된 슈팅 액션 게임입니다. 자신만의 캐릭터를 선택하고 다양한 장비와 스킬을 습득해 악마로부터 위협받는 고양이 소녀 세계를 구하세요!
주요 특징
다채로운 스킬과 캐스팅 시스템 효과적으로 악마들을 공격하기 위해 다채로운 스킬과 함께 "Cat Girl Survivor : Bullet Action“에서만 볼 수 있는 캐스팅 스킬 시스템을 활 용해 보세요. 캐스팅 스킬은 사용 전 파워를 모으기 위해 몸을 움직일 수 없는 치명적 약점이 존재하지만 그만큼 광범위하고 강력한 데미 지를 적에게 줄 수 있습니다. 캐스팅 스킬과 일반 스킬을 적절히 전략적으로 사용해 악마들을 효과적으로 공격해 보세요!
스킬을 전설 등급으로 레벨업 해 화려하고 시원한 타격감을 즐길 수 있습니다.
다양한 캐릭터 기본 캐릭터 뿐 아니라 각자 다른 스킬과 능력을 지니고 있는 캐릭터들이 있습니다. 아카네, 시로, 코로 등 당신에게 매력있고 플레이 스타 일에 맞는 캐릭터를 선택해 게임을 즐겨보세요!

title: ARCH WIZARD
description:
게임 정보
ARCH WIZARD is a fast paced First Person "Hyper Shooter":
Tight battlefields
A few very distinct enemies
Many tricks in your sleeve
A lot mechanics to master
Blend all your moves, skills and abilities into one personalized flow of magic rage. A calculated ever adapting dance between enemies. Using their attacks and even detached body parts to dig into the depths of combat spell craft.
You are a powerful mage. Lost in the ruins of warp portal network, once connecting the outskirts of the multiverse.
You must fight your way through cosmoses.
First — to get back to your Tower.
Second — to establish dominance on the parallel realms.
To go back from THE OTHER SIDE.
To find the source of Chaos.
To face the End of the World
To become the eternal ARCH WIZARD — an architect, a director, a tailor of your own fait.
Knowledge based progression. High scores. Full of secrets.

Trailer music contains tracks: Shadows And Dust by Scott Buckley and Creepy Dark Atmosphere by Universfield

title: Runa Illustra
description:
게임 정보
고대 책의 페이지에 갇힌 신비한 세계에 던져진 당신은 집으로 돌아갈 방법을 찾아야 합니다. 주문서를 마스터하여 주문을 그리고 시전하세요. 그것들을 사용하여 주변을 조작하고 예상치 못한 방식으로 도전적인 퍼즐을 해결하세요.
주문을 그리세요
이 실용적인 기호 기반 마법 시스템을 탐험하세요. 주문서의 페이지에 마법 원을 그려서 언제든지 그것을 시전할 수 있습니다.

title: Conquest of Kings
description:
게임 정보
Conquest of Kings blends deep turn-based strategy with fast-paced, 30-60 minute battles! Compete in 1v1 duels or intense 4 player free-for-alls, capturing the Sacred Sites to claim victory!
Recruit units, command powerful armies, and play devastating cards to turn the tide of battle!
Fast-Paced Strategy - Deep tactical decisions in a 30-60 minute game.
Online PVP - 1v1s, 2v2, 4-Player FFA.
Command Powerful Armies - Recruit from five unit types and seize control of key tiles.
Earn the Favor of the Gods - Pay tribute to the Gods to gain powerful bonuses.
Play Powerful Cards - Play cards from your hand to influence battles

title: Catale
description:
게임 정보
Catale은 CCG와 로그라이크를 결합한 덱 빌딩 게임입니다.

title: Plentiful
description:
게임 정보
Shape the world to channel water.
Nurture animals and plants.
Feed your tribe.
A relaxing god game, shaping the map by stacking stones.
Water flows over the landscape and needs to be caught in ponds and lakes.
Trees placed near water will flourish and produce food.
Fruit, Vegetables and Animals are eaten by your tribe of people.
Seasons
Day/night cycle
Water simulation
Stone stacking
Volcanoes, Lightning, Floods, Locusts, Earthquakes, Plagues, Fire

title: Underboard
description:
게임 정보
활동적이고 수동적인 플레이 스타일이 혼합된 전술적 팀 빌딩 오토 배틀러. 팀을 모집하고, 시너지를 구축하며, 아이템을 장착하고, 마법을 사용하여 몬스터와 싸우고 Underboard에서 탈출하도록 도와주세요.
자동 전투
캐릭터는 위치 및 어그로와 같은 규칙에 따라 스스로 행동합니다.
플레이어 주문은 팀을 지원하는 능동적이고 수동적인 방법을 제공합니다.
팀 구성

title: Axis Football 2026
description:
게임 정보
Axis Football 2026 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.
Axis Football 2026 is currently in development. Please see the development blog posts below for more information!
Full Franchise Mode Features:
Multiple league setup options (NFL-style, Tier style)
All-time record tracking
Player Contracts
Trades
Injuries
Practice Squads
Free Agency
Retiring Players
Weekly and Yearly Awards
Dynamic, tiered league structure with playoffs, promotions, and relegations
Unlimited seasons
Player progressions based on performance, age, potential, and playtime
End of season drafts
Season-long team stats
Individual league leader stats
Franchise stats
Depth chart control
Play, coach, spectate, or simulate matches
League and team schedule viewer
Spectate other matches
Customization:
Complete team creator / editor suite

title: Evolve Lab
description:
게임 정보
EvolveLabOnline is a roguelite autobattler, where each enemy you encounter was created by another player. You are a scientist trying to explore the depths of an unknown aquatic planet. As you descent, on each depth you will fight against enemies created by other players and if you win you can evolve the behaviour of your creature until you are the first player to reach a new record depth.

Whenever a creature loses, it stays at the current depth and becomes a possible encounter for following players. Over time the waters of this planet will be filled with all kinds of different creatures and it will get harder and harder to be the first player to reach a new depth.

To program a creature, players can add different actions to their state machine or improve and modify these actions.
The Game currently features:

4 unique creatures to pick from
27 different actions that can be used by a creature
24 different modules and modifiers to further modify actions
23 different cores that provide the creature with unique special abilities
Millions of possible combinations

title: Wizard's Wrath Legends
description:
게임 정보
Wizard's Wrath combines FPS and RTS elements into VR to build a blend of fast-action and strategic play that best fits the energy of the moment. Wrap that in a deep story-driven world where magic is tearing it apart, and an exciting adventure awaits!

The game includes multiple styles of play and it's really up to you how you approach each situation:
Intelligent monster AI with waves of creatures pouring at you.
Survival - prepare well or you won't last long
Duelling - when your level and courage push your confidence to absurdity you can't help but forget the team and go lone wolf! You rely on fast powerful spell casting, weapon mastery and quick thinking to destroy all in your way
Strategy - when you realise your individual capability is great but there is an army of intelligent, devious creatures out there, you might have to starting thinking too!
Wizard's Wrath combines all the core elements to make a game that switches style to fit the current point in the story or MMO moment.

title: Rise Again
description:
게임 정보

'Rise Again'은 마법, 로그라이크 게임 플레이 및 던전 탐험의 요소를 결합한 액션 RPG입니다. 중세 판타지 우주에서 적들을 베어내고 전진하면서 잊혀진 마법사에서 숙련된 던전 탐험가로 변신하세요.
매혹적인 모험
최후의 일격을 날리기 전, 당신은 리치의 저주에 휘말렸습니다. 저주 이전의 모든 것을 기억할 수 없습니다. 눈을 떴을 때, 당신은 죽은 자를 부활시키는 차원의 신비한 세계에 자신을 발견합니다. 새로운 세계를 탐험하고 부활의 진실을 밝혀내며, 당신과 같은 저주받은 다른 이들과 함께 이 세계의 도전을 극복하세요!

리치의 저주에서 벗어나기 위해 변화무쌍한 던전에 들어가세요. 소환된 생물들을 물리치세요. 여러 가지 주문과 강화품을 발견하고 여행 중에 사용하세요. 독특한 전투를 경험하고.

title: Terrors of War
description:
게임 정보
고오캐인, 맥반석 터지는 RTS 어드벤처에 참여하세요! Terrors of War에서는 거대한 군대를 지휘하고 전장에서 전차가 울림을 퍼뜨리며 전략적인 항공 지원으로 하늘을 지배할 수 있습니다. 그러나 화력만큼이나 전략도 중요합니다. 귀하의 공급 라인은 군대의 생명선이며 모든 결정이 중대합니다.



경제는 부차적인 사항뿐만이 아니라 성공의 중추입니다. 기지를 확장하고 게임을 바꾸는 지원을 소환하며 멈출 수 없는 힘을 쌓아나가는 과정에서 각 자원의 무게를 느낄 것입니다.

당신을 숨막히게 만들 준비가 되어 있습니다! 적의 타격에 대항하고 파괴적인 공격을 계획하며 대지를 뒤흔들만한 호출을 일으킬 것입니다. 그리고 이것은 단지 시작일 뿐입니다! Terrors of War는 지속적으로 진화하며 앞으로 더 많은 화려한 특징과 놀라움이 기다리고 있습니다.



이 야심찬 프로젝트의 미래를 형성할 Early Access 여정에 참여하세요. 당신의 피드백, 버그 보고 및 Discord에서의 제안이 게임 개발에 직접적으로 영향을 미쳐 이를 참으로 협업적인 경험으로 만들어 줍니다. 액션에 참여하고 진화의 일부가 되어 함께 전장을 정복합시다!

title: Dwarf Legacy
description:
게임 정보
깊은 산의 거처로 들어가 잃어버린 유산으로 가는 길을 오를 준비를 하세요. 버려진 드워프 산악 동굴의 깊은 곳에서 여러분의 지혜와 민첩성이 시험대에 오릅니다. 이 매혹적인 퍼즐 플랫폼 게임은 위험이 가득한 수직형 던전을 오르도록 도전합니다.
수직형 던전을 오르세요
정교하게 설계된 레벨을 탐험하며 퍼즐 해결 능력과 플랫폼 조작의 정확성을 시험하세요. 각 레벨은 교묘한 함정부터 영리한 적들까지 독특한 도전 과제를 제공합니다.
자원 수집

title: Hidden Pass
description:
게임 정보
이 턴제 RPG에서 탐험가, 전사, 지도자, 전술가인 방랑자가 되어 엘리리움 대지의 미스터리를 풀어보세요. 지상과 공중에서 턴제 전략 전투를 마스터하여 다양하고 강력한 적들을 물리치세요.



엘리리움은 매우 귀중하지만 여전히 매우 위험한 광물로, 엘리리움의 소유자는 마법의 힘을 전달하고 중력을 변화시켜 현실을 왜곡할 수 있습니다. 위험하고 불안정한 엘리리움 지대에서만 찾을 수 있습니다. 여러분과 같은 숙련된 방랑자만이 이 일을 해낼 수 있습니다.



Hidden Pass의 주요 목표는 필요한 모든 수단을 동원하여 엘리리움 지대의 중심부에 도달하는 것입니다. 이를 위해서는 이 세상의 무시무시한 생물들로 가득한 공중의 섬을 통과해야 합니다. 이를 위해서는 높이 솟은 성채인 방랑자의 탑과 체펠린 비행선이 필요합니다. 건물을 세우고, 방어선을 구축하고, 자원을 추출하는 것이 성공의 비결입니다.


Hidden Pass의 전투는 세 개의 맵 레이어에서 펼쳐지며, 각각 지상 유닛과 비행 유닛에게 전술적 과제를 선사합니다.


마법은 가장 강력한 무기이며 잠재적으로 여러분을 파멸의 길로 이끌 수 있습니다. 능력을 사용할 때마다 여러분은 돌이킬 수 없는 위기에 가까워집니다. 마법에 사용되는 엘리리움의 힘은 영웅을 서서히 미치게 만들지만, 동시에 그들에게 독특한 힘을 불어넣기도 합니다.


전투에서 분대 중 가장 우수한 유닛을 최대 4명까지 사용할 수 있습니다. 하지만 팀원 중 한 명이라도 죽으면 언제든지 지원군을 요청할 수 있다는 것을 기억하세요. 영웅들이 수적 열세에 놓이지 않도록 관리하십시오.


모든 유닛이 피와 살을 가진 존재는 아닙니다. 탑에서는 살아있는 강력한 로봇인 자동 로봇을 만들 수 있습니다. 이들은 엘리리움에서 작동하며 전투에서 승리하는 데 도움이 되는 고유한 능력을 가지고 있습니다.


하늘로 치솟는 강력한 요새이자 집에서 떨어진 은신처입니다. 로봇을 제작하고, 새로운 영웅을 모집하고, 장비를 업그레이드하고, 새로운 기술을 탐구할 수 있는 비행 기지입니다. 탑은 엘리리움 대지에서 여러분과 함께 이동할 수 있으며, 자원 추출과 전체 전략에 중요한 영향을 미칩니다.


여기 귀중한 엘리리움이 있습니다! 여러분을 비롯해 수많은 이들이 가능한 한 많은 엘리리움을 찾고 싶어합니다. 채굴 네트워크를 개발하고 라이벌과 전투를 벌이세요. 경제를 발전시키세요. 엘리리움 지대를 통과하는 데 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.


전투에 승리하면 영웅이 더 강해지고 새로운 능력을 배울 수 있습니다. 유연한 전문성 시스템을 통해 독특하고 강력한 영웅을 만들 수 있습니다.

title: Creep
description:
게임 정보
Creep is a 2D platform game that takes place inside a struggled person's inner world represented as a worm world. You control the worm form of the same person as he shows why this world exists and how it's like to live there.
I have no friends and life is full of obstacles
Yes, it is hard to say the other worms in the world are friendly, and there are lots of other dangers you will encounter. There is no one else other than you to cope with all these. Your only weapon is your wit against this crooked world until you reach the point to hell with it. This won't just go forever like that. Your relationship with other worms will change as you progress.
I once loved too
Throughout the story, you will occasionally visit some memories or analogical mini levels with different gameplay than the main part of the game. These levels will unlock new abilities the worm can use. These abilities are not mere powers. They are part of the actual character progression itself and they will start to change the main gameplay and story.

title: Heart Of Muriet
description:
게임 정보
Heart of Muriet is a voxel fantasy 4X RTS with a unique take. Teaming up with Elves, Dwarfs, and Mages, you’ll need to build and manage settlements while researching powerful magic to overcome the enemy in tense, company-based warfare.
Build and upgrade your bases with up to 40 different buildings and even more upgrades. Choose from 4 magic realms with a great selection of spells and a plethora of research options to boost the might of your heroic wizard and their army. Pick a clever strategy for your army, control your wizard and watch them win epic battles against your enemies.
You can manage troop formations and workers with ease and without any stress. Gone are the days of dragging boxes on the battlefield, instead you control entire formations or all the workers at a specific base with a single click. Give your fighting formations special commands depending on the situation, or use your spellcasters to turn the tide of epic battles.

title: Flow Of War
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by classic RTS games, Flow of War offers a unique Real-Time Strategy (RTS) experience with Auto-Micro mechanics for both Workers and Warriors. This allows you to concentrate on other aspects of a classic RTS without the need to micromanage individual units.


Design a well-constructed base not only for good defense but also to allow workers to operate efficiently and perform their tasks in infinitely unique maps.







Embrace the chaos and excitement of battles where multiple units are in action simultaneously.

Unlike other RTS while you have to micro every single unit, in Flow of War they will fight automatically and you can watch them like it’s Esports!





Besides inter-racial warfare, you'll also battle with neutral factions to secure key locations, gain rewards and special points for upgrading your army.




Play fully procedurally generated maps, each game offering a unique and never-before-seen map for both standard and custom game modes.

title: Prize Denied
description:
게임 정보
당신은 한때 플레이어 친화적인 인형뽑기로 유명한 인심 좋은 인형뽑기방 주인이었습니다. 그러나 그 친절함 때문에 결국 파산에 이르고 말았습니다... 삼촌의 차고에 남겨진 단 하나의 뽑기 기계로, 당신은 교활한 사업가로 변신하기로 결심합니다!
나만의 기계를 만들어보세요
기계 부품을 잠금 해제하고 기계를 커스터마이징하세요. 기계의 설정을 조정하여 플레이어에게 도전적인 기계를 만들거나(혹은 파산의 위험을 감수할 수 있다면 플레이어 친화적인 기계를 만들 수도 있습니다). 현재 유행하는 귀여운 상품을 선택해 플레이어를 끌어들이고, 벽과 장애물을 설치해 어떤 일이 있어도 상품이 빠져나오지 않게 막으세요!
액션 카드를 사용하세요
독특한 효과를 가진 액션 카드를 사용해 상품이 떨어지지 않도록 방해하고, 집게 성공률을 낮추며, 플레이어를 끌어모으고, 평점을 높이는 등 다양한 전략을 구사하세요. 상상력과 관찰력을 활용하면 단 한 장의 카드로 여러 개체에 영향을 미쳐 믿기 힘든 반응을 일으킬 수도 있습니다!

title: Stone Age
description:
게임 정보
원시 세계에서 생존하고 발전하는 서사시적인 여행을 시작하세요! 생존, 탐험, 전략이 결합된 이 독특한 게임에서, 당신은 부족을 인도하여 위험한 포식자들을 사냥하고, 자원을 모으며, 정착지를 건설하고 확장합니다. 인류의 생존을 보장하고 기술을 발전시키세요.
주요 특징:
다이나믹한 생존 도전: 호랑이, 악어, 곰 등 위험한 포식자들과 싸우며, 각기 다른 행동과 전리품을 얻습니다.
자원 관리: 중요한 자원을 수집하고, 식물을 재배하고, 자원을 거래하여 부족을 성장시킵니다.
기술 발전: 기본적인 불 사용에서부터 발전된 대피소와 방어 시스템까지 다양한 기술을 해제하여 부족의 진화를 이끕니다.
정착지 건설: 기능과 미학을 균형 있게 결합하여 번창하는 공동체를 만들 수 있습니다.
놀라운 탐험: 숨겨진 자원, 신비로운 동굴, 고대의 비밀이 가득한 지역을 탐험하세요.
풍부한 경제: 고기, 가죽, 공예품과 같은 자원을 수집하고 거래하여 부족의 성장을 촉진합니다.
전략적 깊이: 부족의 확장을 계획하고, 위협으로부터 보호하며, 현명한 결정을 내려 생존을 확보합니다.
도구를 만들거나, 정착지를 관리하거나, 자연과 싸우는 동안 당신의 선택은 부족의 운명을 결정짓습니다. 당신의 부족을 이끌고, 세상을 창조할 준비가 되셨나요?

title: Iron Convoy
description:
게임 정보
Iron Convoy: 황폐한 땅에서 생존하고, 정복하고, 번영하라
Iron Convoy는 가혹한 포스트 아포칼립스 세계를 배경으로 한 전략 생존 게임입니다. 전투 준비가 된 차량과 절박한 생존자들로 구성된 호송대를 이끌고 자원을 수집하고, 업그레이드를 제작하며, 환경 위협과 경쟁 세력이 가득한 위험한 오픈 월드에서 전략적인 턴제 전투를 진행하세요.
"당신은 이 땅의 구원자가 아닙니다. 당신은 당신의 호송대를 이끄는 주인이며, 황폐한 땅을 지배하기 위해 무엇이든 할 준비가 되어 있는 지도자입니다." -황제 마달
커스터마이즈, 제작, 업그레이드
수집한 자원과 전리품을 강력한 업그레이드로 변환하세요. 차량의 고급 부품을 제작하고 방어력을 강화하며 무기를 업그레이드하여 전투에서 우위를 점하세요. 생존을 위해 필요한 모든 것을 약탈, 거래 또는 강탈하세요.
황폐한 땅 탐험

title: Defracted
description:
게임 정보
Defracted - is an online 3rd person arena shooter. The world is set in a fictional sci-fi realm where 2 teams are at war with each other over prosperity in a virtual reality game created by an alien civilization. In this game, you can come together with friends or random online players to battle each other in various game modes. Customize your player and their loadout to deploy on the battlefield. Level up and become the strongest of the pack.
KEY FEATURES
Online PVP (2-8 players)
Leveling System
Character Selection
Weapon Customization
Multiple Game modes (secure the bag, last man standing, TDM, FFA, demolition)
Multiple Maps with Nighttime mode
Online Shop System
Controller Support
Daily Login Rewards!
Story Plot - It was the year 2150, and the world had become a desolate and dangerous place. The last remaining humans had retreated to a virtual reality game. In this game, there were two factions: the Guardians and the Renegades.
The Guardians were a noble and just team, led by a brave warrior named Aria. They fought to protect the innocent and uphold justice in the virtual world. On the other hand, the Renegades were a ruthless and chaotic team, led by a cunning strategist named Xander. They craved power and were willing to do whatever it took to achieve it.

title: ATAK - Angry Tusslin' Awesome Knights
description:
게임 정보
🔥 전쟁에 오신 것을 환영합니다 🔥
Angry Tusslin' Awesome Knights는 단순한 액션 전략 게임이 아닙니다. 이것은 정복 캠페인, 파괴의 전장, 그리고 당신의 의지력에 대한 시험입니다. 당신은 싸울 것입니다. 고통받을 것입니다. 적응해야 할 것입니다. 그리고 마침내 승리가 당신의 손에 달려있을 때? 진정한 지배의 느낌을 알게 될 것입니다.
도전할 준비가 되셨나요?
⚔️ 캠페인: 여섯 지역. 여섯 군벌. 하나의 불가능한 임무. ⚔️

title: Rogue Night
description:
게임 정보
As one of the last warm bodies in Everreach-a land swarming with undead, you must gather resources, build shelters, and find allies to survive. Explore a world full of ruins and dungeons filled with secrets and treasures.
Rescue survivors, and they’ll join your cause, providing resources and unlocking new structures to expand your base. Equip yourself with an assortment of weapons and magic rings, find powerful tools, and uncover hidden blueprints to tip the odds in your favor. Explore dangerous landscapes, solve puzzles, avoid traps, and collect valuable treasures.
-Fantasy Survival: Gather resources to build and survive, explore many locations, and rescue survivors who will aid you on your journey. Explore dungeons filled with monsters, puzzles, traps, to recover various weapons and find rare rings, blueprints, tools, and of course - gold!
-Rogue-lite Gameplay: Confront hordes of undead, harvesting their heads to unlock permanent upgrades after death. Start each new run stronger than before, gradually working your way to Necrosarian himself! Play the game as designed--with permadeath enabled--or turn on 'easy mode' for a more relaxed gameplay experience.
-Upgrade and Customize: Choose from 3 unique classes, 15 weapons, 15 magical rings, and over 35 upgrades to customize your character's abilities. Adapt and overcome the challenges with a character suited to your strategy.
