title: Axis Football 2026
description:
게임 정보
Axis Football 2026 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.
Axis Football 2026 is currently in development. Please see the development blog posts below for more information!
Full Franchise Mode Features:
Multiple league setup options (NFL-style, Tier style)
All-time record tracking
Player Contracts
Trades
Injuries
Practice Squads
Free Agency
Retiring Players
Weekly and Yearly Awards
Dynamic, tiered league structure with playoffs, promotions, and relegations
Unlimited seasons
Player progressions based on performance, age, potential, and playtime
End of season drafts
Season-long team stats
Individual league leader stats
Franchise stats
Depth chart control
Play, coach, spectate, or simulate matches
League and team schedule viewer
Spectate other matches
Customization:
Complete team creator / editor suite

title: Bootsies
description:
게임 정보
Bootsies is a pure 1D fighting game with a handmade retro aesthetic that emphasizes reading your opponent, precise spacing, and making bold moves to outplay opponents. Play as a colorful cast of cute boot-clad fighters determined to shape their planet's future. Steel-toe yourself and BOOT UP!
Bootsies is designed so that anyone can pick it up and start outplaying any opponent within minutes, but experienced players versed in fundamentals will stay endlessly engaged in intense battles rich with layers of spacing, reads, and adaptation.
Bootsies uses an intuitive button scheme with no directional inputs! That means you can even play this game one-handed!
The core of the gameplay is built around the neutral triangle structure common to all fighting games. Bootsies hones in on this tense dance of rock-paper-scissors at its very heart, and takes it to new depths!

title: Frozen Ship
description:
게임 정보
Frozen Ship is a first-person narrative adventure in the unique blending of survival, build&craft, and economic strategy genres.
Welcome to the snow-covered wastelands of a once-thriving world. You will lead an expedition to find a place suitable for establishing a settlement. At your disposal is a crew of 20 people and a ship ­- a machine capable of covering vast distances while carrying everything necessary for a long journey.

title: Seabed Settlers
description:
게임 정보
A citybuilder inspired by classics such as Ceasar III, Anno, Pharaoh and others which takes place the bottom of the ocean. The surface has become uninhabitable and raybomb radiation has turned many into mutants. It is your job to set up your underwater empire and guide new humanity to greatness!



Goal of the game

Your job is to keep everyone in your colony healthy and alive. Tend to all your people's needs; food, power, shelter, survival, safety, culture and entertainment.

If your people are happy your city grows and they have babies. If your people are deprived of food they die. Houses evolve if needs are met, increasing your population capacity.

The threat of raybomb mutants lurks around every corner and add another layer to the game.





Find resource nodes, plan the layout of your colony, raise prosperity and culture ratings and keep your people safe!

Once your city is thriving and objectives are met, your success means your superiors will entrust you with repeating the process in a more challenging area. Along the way you unlock new buildings, resources and technologies to help with this.

At the end players will get to relive those epic childhood games while newer generation players get eased into this type of game so that they too can build fond memories.





During the campaign you will be trading with other settlements and expanding your empire.

There are rival factions that will attempt the same and might reclaim your other cities if you don’t watch out.

The goal is to move through various campaign scenarios that have various objectives.

title: Heroes of the Seven Islands
description:
게임 정보
FURAX THE INDESTRUCTIBLE, fleshless carcass and soulless body, has arrived through an inter-dimensional rift in the colorful, carefree world of Émeyralia, to spread SADNESS and DESPAIR. Nothing seems to be able to stop him: his influence grows daily, many disciples join him and NIGHTMARE CREATURES appear on every continent.
According to the prophecy, only THE ORACLE could defeat him, but he retired centuries ago. To find him, the 7 keys held by the 7 rulers of the 7 islands of the Emerald Archipelago must be gathered. FOUR HEROES, the bravest of the brave, are chosen for this quest. The future of Emeyralia is in their hands.
Key Features
Inspired by Might and Magic 3-8, but it's point-and-click
Turn-based yet fast combat system
Hundreds of (poorly) hand-drawn unique illustrations
Play the main quest or explore the open world and start side quests
Discover 7 biomes with villages, cities, dungeons, caves, forests and so on
Dungeon Synth Music
A (poorly) hand-drawn tribute to Classic RPG and Comic Albums
HEROES OF THE SEVEN ISLANDS is a comfy yet challenging HAND-DRAWN tribute to classic role-playing video games and COMIC BOOKS. Experience a non-linear heroic adventure with side quests in a vast light fairy tale world, inspired by 90s games.
Choose your fate in this NON-LINEAR HIGH-FANTASY ADVENTURE.

title: Light Dude - A Game Where The Level Darkens When You Move!
description:
게임 정보
"집에서 어둠 속을 걷다가 침대 모서리에 발이 부딪혔고, 그래서 이 게임의 아이디어가 떠올랐어요..."
움직이면 레벨이 어두워진다—간단하지만, 해보면 깊이가 있다!
어둠의 하수인들
autokwd: Light Dude - A Game Where The Level Darkens When You Move!

title: Kombat Hamster
description:
게임 정보
햄스터 메타 농장을 자동화된 햄스터 코인 채굴 기계로 성장시킨 다음, 기술을 개발하고 더 많은 기술 자원을 확보하여 생산량을 늘리고 더 많은 햄스터 코인을 얻으세요! 내려가는 길은 없고 올라가는 길만 있어요!

농장을 개선하고 보상을 받으세요: 더 많은 햄스터! 햄스터가 많을수록 농업 사업이 더 빨리 성장합니다! 그리고 기억하세요: 햄스터는 야행성보다 더 어두컴컴하며, 야생에서는 포식자에게 잡히지 않기 위해 낮 동안 지하에 머물지만 농장에서는 그렇지 않습니다. 그들은 연중무휴 24시간 일하고 있으며 햄스터 동전이 그들이 살아가는 유일한 목적이기 때문에 아무것도 두려워하지 않습니다.

순위를 높이고, 임무를 완수하고, 보상을 받고, 새로운 기술을 잠금 해제하고 광산, 광산, 광산! 올바른 길로 가고 있어요, 햄스터 사령관님!

이것은 단지 시뮬레이션 게임일 뿐이며 플레이하는 동안 실제 암호화폐를 채굴하는 것은 아니라는 점을 명심하세요!

행운을 빌며 달에서 만나요!

title: Chaos Bringer
description:
게임 정보
Chaos Bringer는 실시간 전투에 일시정지 기능을 제공하는 파티 기반의 솔로 플레이 RPG입니다. 전략적인 전투를 위해 타임라인에 스킬을 큐잉하세요. 던전 탐험과 MMORPG 스타일의 레이드 보스를 즐기며, DPS 및 위협 미터를 활용해보세요. 특별한 장비 드롭과 도시 특화 제작 시스템을 통해 영웅들을 성장시키세요.
사회적 스트레스로부터 자유로운, 솔로 플레이어를 위한 MMORPG 스타일의 레이드 보스
다양한 보스 패턴과 전략이 준비되어 있습니다!
전술적인 능력과 파티 관리 능력을 시험하는 에픽한 여러 페이즈의 전투에 참여하세요.
더 전략적이고 역동적인 전투를 경험하세요
멀티라인 타임라인 시스템
tag: 일시 정지 가능한 실시간,파티 기반 RPG,전략 RPG

title: Foederatus
description:
게임 정보
Live the tale of a Romanized chieftain uniting his clan on the fringes of the Roman Empire.  In this story-rich kingdom management RPG, lead through narrative events, consolidate resources, and establish alliances.  Beware of every decision as they will haunt you throughout the story.
In the twilight of the Western Roman Empire, you rise as a Romanized barbarian chieftain amidst the rugged landscape of Dalmatia. Tasked with uniting your tribe, the Sciri, you must  navigate a world of shifting alliances and political intrigue.
As the son of a fallen leader and a veteran of the Eastern Roman Army, your journey confronts a difficult choice: uphold the traditions of your ancestors or embrace the allure of Roman civilization. This pivotal decision not only shapes your identity but also determines the fate of your kingdom.
Will you secure your legacy as a barbarian warrior or Roman noble?
Turn-based decision making
Text-based narrative events
Dialogue-based choices and investment of resources
Management of a late antique kingdom
Navigating politics and factions
Manage Your Life and Legacy - Non-Linear Narrative

title: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
description:
게임 정보
자유로운 건설
당신의 개미굴에서 어떤 블록이든 자유롭게 파내고 건설할 수 있습니다. 개미들의 편리한 이동과 중요한 건물을 적의 습격으로부터 보호하는 것 사이의 균형을 유지하세요!
무제한 유닛 수
개미의 수에는 제한이 없습니다. 유지할 수 있는 최대한 큰 식민지를 건설하세요!
많은 강력한 적들
전 세계에서 온 80가지 이상의 다양한 적들이 기다리고 있습니다.
게임에는 여왕개미, 정찰병, 운반자, 농부, 탱크, 전사 등 다양한 능력을 가진 여러 종류의 개미들이 등장합니다. 이들을 조합하여 현실의 거의 모든 개미 종을 재현할 수 있습니다.

title: Run TavernQuest
description:
게임 정보
Run TavernQuest is a role-reversing twist on old school text adventure games. You're the command parser and game master, overseeing the game's inner workings for a player named STEVE. Can you guide STEVE away from his poor decisions so he can save the princess?
In this game, you won't be typing. Instead, STEVE is the player and he types commands to you, often very bizarre ones. Your job is to interpret his words and choose how the adventure proceeds. The choices you make can lead him down drastically different paths, but it's ultimately up to STEVE to win the game.
Features
Fully narrated by the very talented Jack Dundon
Control the environment and every NPC as they respond to STEVE's stupid commands
Engage in text-based combat where your goal is to lose every time
Customizable font and grayscale mode for enhanced readability

title: Lunar Ascendant
description:
게임 정보
Take on the mantle of leadership and venture into a future where mankind has expanded its frontier to the Moon. Lunar Ascendant is a narrative-driven political simulation and role-playing game that thrusts you into the heart of a burgeoning lunar society as the first democratically elected mayor of the lunar colony megacity, Artemis.

In this immersive text-based simulation, your decisions shape the future of humanity's first lunar city. As mayor, you'll navigate a web of political, economic, and social challenges that reflect the complexities of our own world and beyond. Draft policies to address critical issues such as pollution, wealth inequality, technological advancements, and the controversial use of human brains as CPUs. Forge alliances and manage relationships with various factions, including corporate CEOs, underground criminal syndicates, and activist groups. Be prepared to confront challenging moral dilemmas that will test your principles against the hard realities of governance.

Game Features:

Political Simulation: Experience the intricacies of running a lunar colony, balancing urban development, public order, and the needs of a diverse population.

Policy Crafting: Draft and implement policies that shape the future of Artemis, dealing with issues such as wealth inequality, environmental sustainability, and the ethics of AI development.

Interactive Narrative: Engage in rich text-based interactions with various characters, making decisions that shape the colony's future.

Dynamic World: Navigate a complex political landscape with different factions vying for influence, and make choices that lead to multiple possible outcomes.

Moral Complexity: Face difficult decisions that challenge your moral compass and define your legacy.

Dive into a world shaped by your choices, filled with rich lore and dynamic systems that react to your decisions. Can you steer Artemis towards a future of prosperity and independence, or will your leadership plunge the city into chaos? The fate of Artemis lies in your hands.

title: DUCK DUCK
description:
게임 정보
Gather the flock and fluff your feathers for a fly new chatroom sandbox experience!
Soar and Explore a Vibrant Open-World Sandbox
Welcome to Mourning Duck Island, a land of opportunity where you’ll take flight, dive deep, and waddle your way through a mysterious world full of secrets and treasures.
Gather, Trade, and Build
Around these parts, bread is more than just food; it's money! Acquire bread and materials to expand your very own nest, a fully customizable home. Discover and build unique interactables to improve your gathering, enhance exploration, or just have fun!
Glide, Slide, Dive, and Drive
Mourning Duck Island is your playground! With a range of fluid movement mechanics, explore land, air, and sea in whatever way you desire.
A Multiplayer Sandbox Full of Quacky Adventures
Team up with friends in this open-world multiplayer sandbox! Ride pedal-powered boats together, place interactive objects to help with gathering, and explore cooperatively. Whether you're gliding side by side, diving for treasure, or just goofing around, there’s always fun to be had!
Grow Your Flock
Raise and nurture a flock of loyal ducklings to gather materials and uncover hidden treasures. Customize each one to create the ultimate squad of resourceful little hatchlings.
Your Brood, Your Way
Express yourself with unlockable cosmetics for both your duck and ducklings. From stylish feathers to quirky outfits and hats, make your ducks truly stand out in the flock!

title: Mythara Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey in Mythara Chronicles, a tactical role-playing game that combines strategic combat, immersive exploration, and impactful decision-making. As a Hero dispatched by the esteemed Hero’s Guild, your mission is to restore peace to the beleaguered region of Rena. The city of Luecis is under siege by the formidable Demon-General Varynthaal, and only through uniting the divided factions can hope be rekindled.
EXPLORE A DYNAMIC OVERWORLD
Traverse a beautifully hand-painted, isometric world map. Discover vibrant towns, treacherous dungeons, and hidden campsites. Manage resources wisely and encounter dynamic events that make each journey unique.
MASTER TACTICAL COMBAT
Engage in grid-based battles where your tactical prowess is tested. Utilize class synergies, exploit terrain advantages, and position your party effectively to overcome a variety of adversaries, including demonic hordes and corrupted factions.
BUILD YOUR PARTY YOUR WAY
Assemble a party from a selection of unique classes, each with specialized abilities:
Knight: Serve as the stalwart tank and protector, shielding allies from harm.
Mage: Wield elemental magic to devastate foes and control the battlefield.
Ranger: Employ ranged attacks and set traps to outmaneuver enemies.
Warrior: Deliver high-damage melee attacks to swiftly dispatch opponents.
Cleric: Provide healing and divine support to sustain your party.
Bard: Enhance team morale and capabilities through inspiring songs.
Tamer: Summon and command beasts to aid in combat.
Rogue: Utilize stealth and deliver critical strikes to unsuspecting foes.
SHAPE YOUR REPUTATION
Your choices matter. Influence alliances, resolve political conflicts, and shape the future of Rena. Every decision impacts faction relationships, the morale of the populace, and the ultimate outcome of your quest.
DISCOVER DUNGEONS
Uncover hidden dungeons scattered across the overworld. Brave their dangers to recover powerful artifacts that grant unique abilities and unveil secrets of Mythara’s ancient past.

title: Tackle  Loss
description:
게임 정보
Tackle for Loss is a 2D top-down action game that puts you in the shoes of a former American football pro. Violent combat, a captivating narrative, and dark pixel art combine to create a pumped-up experience, inspired by the likes of "Hotline Miami". The player is haunted by the lingering effects of concussions and driven by a desperate mission to save a loved one. Utilizing his unique set of football skills, players will navigate a gritty underworld, battling enemies and unraveling a conspiracy in the process.
Football Infused Combat
Killstreak Mechanic
Unlockable Skillpath
Gamepad & Keyboard Support
Gritty Backstory
Languages: English, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish

title: Eclipse of Elysium
description:
게임 정보










In Eclipse of Elysium, you step into the shoes of 21-year-old Aria. At first glance, she appears to be a young, unassuming woman who wouldn't harm a fly. But appearances can be deceiving. In reality, Aria is a biological weapon, deployed on the most dangerous missions in Eldora. Will you guide Aria to become a guardian angel, protecting the innocent, or a ruthless assassin fulfilling the orders of the powerful and wealthy?



Aria's emotional landscape is turbulent at best. Impulsive, fierce, and often consumed by rage, she embodies the unpredictability of a storm. However, like the calm after a tempest, she can also exhibit kindness and a willingness to aid those around her. The emotional path Aria treads is yours to shape. Will you navigate her through the darkness with a compassionate heart, or will rage be her guide? The choice is yours.



Serving the "Python Network," one of the most critical intelligence services of the Republic, Aria operates in the shadows. She's the one called upon when danger looms, or when tasks demand a leap outside the boundaries of legality. Her hands are the ones that get dirty, fighting battles unseen and undertaking missions that others dare not whisper about.

At the helm of Aria's assignments is Liaison Officer Krall, a member of the Scalekrin—an ancient race of lizard people long oppressed. Krall has climbed the ranks through sheer determination and now stands as a pivotal figure within the Python Network. His loyalty to the organization is unwavering, and he will do whatever it takes to secure his standing, guiding Aria through the network's dark web of intrigue and espionage.



In this shadowed world, every decision, every alliance, and every battle shapes the destiny not only of Aria but also of Eldora itself. What will your choices reveal?





Charon, was once among the most influential figures in Endora. As the chief advisor to the Merchants' Guild, his knowledge, experience, and wisdom were highly valued, and his counsel was eagerly sought after.



However, those who knew him witnessed Charon's gradual descent into madness, a process that began when he started investigating the origins of the mysterious Conflux. This dangerous organism relentlessly spreads across the world, engulfing villages, cities, and even entire kingdoms in its path.

Charon's intent was to halt this threat, leading him to the ruins of ancient civilizations. Yet, as his investigations deepened, he became increasingly reticent and enveloped in secrets. Five years ago, Charon vanished from the public eye. Now, he has reemerged, leading a mysterious order that is working to accelerate the growth of the Conflux.



To be honest, I'm a newcomer in the video game industry. I've been gaming since I commandeered my sister's Super Nintendo at the age of 10. But the dream of developing my own video game only took hold three years ago when I tried out Unreal Engine for the first time and quickly realized the boundless possibilities it offers.



My dream is to create a game that merges the best of two worlds. I'd like to combine the charm and pathos of a JRPG like Xenoblade with the vast freedom of choice found in Western RPGs like Baldur's Gate. The adventure should be easily accessible. There are no complex mechanics preventing you from quickly getting into the game. I also want to avoid grinding that unnecessarily prolongs playtime.

I aim to create a cinematic work that takes players on an emotional journey, presenting them with tough emotional choices and introducing them to charming and complex characters.

title: RelicWar
description:
게임 정보
Turn Based Gameplay
Starting each match you will have a deck of cards. These will allow you to boost movement, attack or defense. You can set traps to slow your enemies down or use the same cards in your hand during battles to give you that extra edge.
Unique Hunters
Each Hunter has a different background story, principles and weapon for combat. Outside of the dungeons you will need to upgrade them and provide healing for any lasting injuries at the nearby MediCenter. Some Relics you find can be equipped for your next adventure into the dungeons.

title: Secrets of Moon Island
description:
게임 정보
Secrets of Moon Island is an Action Adventure RPG with its own, unique approach to Swordplay.
Discover a mysterious island, fight against vicious monsters, and become stronger during your adventures.
The Secrets of Moon Island is a solo developer project (very indie), programmed from scratch in over 6 years of passionate work. The game tells the story of the last descendants of a once wealthy family who are trying to find out what happened to their long lost ancestor. What will they find?
Key Features
Experience Non Target Based Combat.
The game features its own combat system, the "Fencer Mode".
If your sword connects with an enemies body with sufficient speed, or even if they just run into your sword, they will take damage.
To avoid getting hit and taking damage of your own, simply either move out of the way of the enemies hit or move your weapon in the path you think the opponents weapon will take
In most cases enemies do what is known as telegraphing, they pull their weapon back in the direction they are going to try to hit you from. Use this to parry their weapon. If you have successfully parried an enemy, you will have a small time frame to get in a hit of your own.

title: It's Better Alone
description:
게임 정보


It's Better Alone is a puzzle platformer where you must switch control between two characters in order to solve a variety of platforming puzzles.

A weathered man, haunted by the past.

A burdened robot, living to atone.

Work together, so that they can return home. Journey through a world in ruin, and uncover the events that led to the end of the world.

Solve a variety of puzzles.
Switch control between two characters.
Journey through a world reclaimed by nature.
Uncover the events that led to the end of the world.
Strengthen the bonds between man and machine.

title: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.
description:
게임 정보
Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you explore a character through thoughts and momentos you find in stages of their life. Its an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the developer, had growing up.
 Experience through the eyes of a character as they return to their childhood home, after moving out. What mementos will they find? What thoughts will they go through? Can they be happy? Maybe not. You decide which thoughts to keep or discard. Help them find a better Frame of Mind.
While this game does its best to be accessible and kind, it also portrays burdens a normative society puts on kids, that are different growing up. You probably should not play this if you are looking for escapism. This game can be harsh sometimes, but it is driven by empathy and the desire to share authentic insights. Extensive content notes can be found in game and the manual. (see link list at the bottom right)
autokwd: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.

title: Cyber Rats
description:
게임 정보
Cyber Rats is a brutal rogue-lite survival horror game
You are a rat trapped in a sinister, AI-controlled test facility. In deadly mazes, horrifying experiments are conducted on helpless rats every day. Can you complete the objectives of the maze, and escape with your life intact? Can you stop the evil AI, and save the lives of yourself and your fellow lab rats?
Death is part of the experiment
• You are a lab rat trapped in a nightmarish AI-controlled facility, where every corner hides a gruesome death.

Procedural generated death maze
• A constantly shifting labyrinth. Procedural generation ensures no maze is ever the same, and you never know, what will be hiding in the shadows.

Nowhere to hide
• Find the cheese. Avoid the traps. Outsmart the Cyborg Hunters. Survive the maze… or become another failed experiment.

• Unlock twisted new rat experiments, zombie rats, cyborgs rats, mutants, and more!
• Upgrade, evolve, survive. Give your rats the edge they need to escape the AI’s deadly experiments!

• Every rat matters. Every death counts. Survive the horrors, and break free from the AI’s twisted experiment!

title: The Black Bahr
description:
게임 정보
Prepare to set sail in a sandbox colony simulation blending vast ocean exploration with strategic crew management. Roam uncharted waters, discover islands, and shape your legacy at sea whether as an honorable captain, cunning smuggler, or ambitious faction leader.
Lead your crew as they gain experience, build reputations, and navigate alliances and rivalries. Support local empires, embrace piracy, or forge your own path. Keep your crew fed, content, and united, making critical decisions that shape your shared destiny. Your vessel is your colony, workshop, and fortress. Customize its interior, craft resources, and balance trade, adventure, and survival in a world where every choice matters.
FEATURES
• Open-Ended Exploration – Sail wherever you please in a living ocean filled with diverse island settlements, each governed by its own politics and unique outlook on the world.
• Evolving Captain and Crew – Grow stronger by earning experience through trade, naval battles, or diplomacy. Your skills and those of your crew improve as you tackle new challenges.
• Deep Faction System – Encounter various cultures and powers vying for control. Improve (or sabotage) your standing with them, join their cause, or establish your own faction to command the seas.
• Living Shipboard Community – Manage essential resources and the morale of your crew. Every decision you make, from rationing supplies to dealing with mutinous behavior, can change your crew’s loyalty and performance.
• Customize and Produce – Outfit your vessel with workshops and crafting stations suitable to its size and your leadership style. Create gear, refine materials, and stock provisions for lengthy voyages.
• Dynamic Sandbox Gameplay – No supernatural shortcuts here. This is a world grounded in realism, where your wit, preparation, and alliances chart your path.
• Rich Dialogues and Encounters – Cross paths with an array of characters, each with their own agendas. Forge friendships or spark rivalries through direct conversations and carefully chosen actions.
• Tempting Adventures and Rare Rewards – Venture into mysterious waters, daring islands, and treacherous territories that beckon explorers and risk-takers alike. Face off against fierce enemies guarding valuable treasures, rare loot, and secrets waiting to be uncovered by only the boldest captains.
Chart your course, and unleash your ambitions upon this vast ocean of endless possibilities. Your ship is your domain, your crew is your family, and your dreams are what will steer you through storms to victory or oblivion!

title: Who Is Ethan?
description:
게임 정보
"Who is Ethan?"은 1~4인 온라인 협동 심리 공포 게임입니다. 공포는 모든 그림자 속에 도사리고 있습니다.
당신은 버려진 병원에서 눈을 뜹니다. 혼란스럽고 혼자라고 느끼지만… 무언가가 지켜보고 있습니다.
팀원들과 협력하여 암호 같은 단서를 해독하고, 으스스한 복도를 탐험하며, 이 벽들 속에 숨겨진 왜곡된 진실을 밝혀내세요.
하지만 기억하세요… 어떤 질문은 절대 답하지 않는 것이 좋습니다.
🔪 악몽 속에서 살아남을 수 있을까요? 🔪
주요 특징:
👥 1~4인 협동 플레이: 친구들과 팀을 이루거나 혼자서 공포에 맞서세요.
🕵️ 깊이 있는 미스터리 & 조사: 불안한 퍼즐을 풀고 진실을 조각 맞추세요.
👻 적응형 AI & 예측 불가능한 위협: 매번 다른 경험이 펼쳐집니다.
🔊 몰입형 3D 사운드 디자인: 삐걱이는 소리, 속삭임, 발소리 하나하나가 위험일 수 있습니다.
🕯️ 제한된 자원 & 영구 죽음: 당신의 모든 선택이 마지막일 수 있습니다. 신중하게 결정하세요.
당신은 이 병원을 탈출할 수 있을까요… 아니면 그 전설의 일부가 될까요?

title: Football Career Mode 26
description:
게임 정보
풋볼 커리어 모드 26은 원하는 클럽을 관리할 수 있는 간단한 축구 매니저 게임입니다.
무명 클럽을 국제적인 성공으로 이끌고 싶든, 성공한 클럽의 역사를 이어가고 싶든, 각 클럽은 각기 다른 도전 과제를 제공합니다. 신중한 스쿼드 구성, 인프라 업그레이드, 올바른 결정을 통해 클럽에서 타이틀을 획득할 수 있습니다.
클럽을 선택하고 스폰서를 선택하면 풋볼 매니저 커리어를 시작할 수 있습니다!
특징
25개국 39개 리그 국내 및 국제 컵 대회
클럽 이사회가 설정한 조건에 따라 해고 또는 클럽 인수 위험 없이 클럽 인수를 완료하세요. 여러분이 결정하세요!
각 시즌이 시작될 때 클럽의 재정과 팬들의 기대에 따라 다양한 영향을 미치는 스폰서를 선택하세요.
선수 등급, 선수 체력 및 선수 사기를 기반으로 팀의 포메이션, 라인업 및 전술 방향을 결정합니다.
시각적 시뮬레이션에서 클럽의 경기를 따르거나 빠른 시뮬레이션을 사용하여 시간 낭비를 피하십시오.
다른 클럽의 선수를 내 팀으로 이적하세요
유소년 아카데미에서 인재 영입
스카우트 네트워크를 설정하고 유소년 아카데미에서 선수를 발굴하세요.
클럽의 인프라 업그레이드
선수의 계약을 연장하거나 이적 또는 임대 목록에 올리기
그리고 훨씬 더!

title: Fortune Guy
description:
게임 정보
Fortune Guy is a multiplayer casual strategy game inspired by traditional Monopoly-style gameplay, but with more strategic elements. You’ll need a bit of luck, but also clever strategies to accumulate wealth and ultimately claim victory.
In the game, every decision matters. You’ll not only need to build structures to boost your economy but also cleverly use the tech system to gain powerful advantages. Each player can choose their own development path based on strategy or disrupt their opponents’ plans through random events, gradually expanding their lead.
Game Features:
Multiple Maps: Several maps with different styles and layouts.
Various Buildings: All spaces are empty, allowing you to build different types of buildings with various functions.
Random Events: Over dozens of random events that can provide rewards or cause trouble for your opponents.
Technology System: Multiple levels of technology, with dozens of upgrades that provide permanent buffs and unlock special abilities.
Customization System: Players can personalize their appearance with various outfits and skins to become a unique Fortune Guy.
Game Modes:
Random Matchmaking
Steam Friends Rooms
Single-Player Mode
Local Multiplayer
About Us:
This game is my first solo project, and I handled all aspects of it — planning, programming, and art. While there were many challenges during development, every step was enjoyable. I hope this game brings joy to everyone, and I truly appreciate your attention and support! If you enjoy games like Monopoly, Fortune Street, or other family-friendly dice games, Fortune Guy might be the game for you.

title: Sigils of Slaughter
description:
게임 정보
Hack and slash and magic your way through an otherworldly uprising certain to raze the world to nihility. Navigate chaotic urban environments, bringing to bear supernatural weapons and dark magic. In addition to top-down shooter mechanics, our novel gesture and sketch-based user interface offers a unique gameplay experience that traditional interfaces do not by enabling the player to express their will through drawings.
Blades of Mayhem
Use butcher knives tethered to magical ropes by drawing slashes:

Magical Traps
Sketch sigils that anchor to nearby enemies and drain their life:

Conjurings and More
Conjure and command allies to help you fight, as well as unique weapons and artifacts to gain an advantage. Use a variety of magical means to survive the onslaught, but if all else fails - use your ever ready shotgun.
Experience engaging gameplay through complementary enemy design. Brawl against bare knuckle fighting brutes, fireball flinging fiends, and trigger-happy troglodytes. Confront mages that shoot lightning, wizards that cast spells, and wretches who steal your magic. Some enemies are fast, others slow. Some have shields and others don't need them. All are savage.

title: Luminary
description:
게임 정보
Wishlist/Follow and then Join our Discord and the Army of Luminaries
You are a Luminary, a warrior of light. As your world falls into chaos the more dark magic is harnessed and exploited (warping the world and its inhabitants) "You" and your fellow Luminaries evolved to make use of the world's less prevalent resource, light magic. With that power, as you grow stronger throughout your adventures, you will gain the strength needed to rid your world of darkness, and bring back the light.
MAIN FEATURES of LUMINARY
Aside for the overall graphical fidelity, and ease of access to the Openworld ARPG genre for all, There are 5 main pillars of Luminary, that the gameplay and mechanics focus on:
EXPLORATION AND ADVENTURE
- A dense world to explore with a robust fun locomotion system that allows you to go anywhere. Running, Jumping, Gliding, Swimming, Climbing. Just moving around the world and exploring is truly fun.
BATTLES AND COMBAT
- A real time yet forgiving skill base combat system, where you can dynamically switch between fighting styles with the press of a button. Melee, Ranged, Magic, Blocking, Dodging, Parries. Play what style best suits you with a simple switch of your weapon

title: Dixotomia
description:
게임 정보
뱀파이어 군단과 그 지배자들
끝없는 피에 굶주린 뱀파이어들과 강력한 어둠의 지배자들이 너를 기다린다. 광신적인 교단 신자, 살육을 위한 안드로이드, 무자비한 용병 등 다양한 적들이 길을 막는다.
SF 무기 & 뱀파이어 능력
두 가지 독창적인 전투 스타일을 자유롭게 조합하라! 미래형 강력한 총기와 초자연적인 뱀파이어 능력을 활용해 자신만의 스타일로 적을 압도하라. 심화된 업그레이드 트리로 무장하고, 전장의 지배자가 되어라!
몰입감 넘치는 스토리 & 환경
위기에 처한 외딴 식민지에 갇힌 엘리트 특수부대원. 어두운 교단의 음모를 파헤치고, 행성의 운명을 결정하라.

description:
게임 정보
A top-down with rouge-lite elements featuring a dark story and intense gunplay combat

title: Moondusk Masquerade
description:
게임 정보
Frequently reminded about how she was rescued by faeries despite being a human, Lilika (renamable MC) has lived all her life repaying the faeries with her servitude — to cook, clean, and care for the heirs of an elite faerie family in the realm. When the family receives their annual invitation to an upcoming masquerade held by the High Court, Lilika is surprised to also receive an invitation letter, only to have her dreams crushed by the family’s objections.
Lilika refuses to let go of her dreams of romance and dancing amongst the sparkling high court faeries. Her wishes are soon heard by a mysterious flower spirit in the garden and the spirit helps Eve get to the ball.
Believing in the flower spirit, Lilika finds herself at the masquerade in a beautiful disguise and is able to put aside her human identity for a magical evening. But her night soon begins to unmask a stunning mystery - one that ties a clandestine prince, a grand magician, and a roguish knight to her destiny through passionate secrets and mysterious letters by moondusk.
There are 3 romanceable love interests in the main story of the game - Prince Kalon, Astromeria, and Llyr

title: Capybara Hot Tub
description:
게임 정보
Capybara Hot Tub에서 인터넷 스타가 되어보세요!
귀엽고 푹신한 스트리머가 되어 따뜻한 욕조에서 릴렉스하면서 온라인 명성을 키워보세요! 털을 다듬고, 아늑한 스튜디오를 꾸미며, 여러분의 카피바라를 다음 바이럴 스타로 만들어 보세요.
따뜻한 욕조에서 완벽한 휴식
카피바라를 보살피고 행복하게 해주세요:
거품 목욕 즐기기
부드러운 털 마사지
맛있는 간식 제공
카피바라 – 궁극의 인터넷 스타
바이럴 히트가 될 기회를 놓치지 마세요! 따뜻한 욕조에서 라이브 스트리밍을 하며 시청자들의 마음을 사로잡으세요:
신선한 베리와 트로피컬 음료로 ASMR 방송
우아한 수영 세션
트렌디한 의상 쇼
카피바라의 집 & 스튜디오
개성에 맞게 스트리밍 스튜디오 커스터마이징
욕조를 위한 다이나믹 조명과 특수 효과 해제

title: Figure Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Figuré Shop Simulator는 자신만의 피규어 가게를 운영하는 재미있고 상세한 비즈니스 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 3D 프린터로 피규어를 제작하고, 선반을 채우고, 가격을 설정하며 고객에게 최고의 쇼핑 경험을 제공합니다.
사업을 성장시키기 위해 창고를 효율적으로 관리하고, 가게를 확장하고, 디자인을 커스터마이즈하세요. 컬렉터를 위한 희귀 피규어를 만들고, 트렌드를 따르며 가장 인기 있는 피규어를 제공하여 수익을 늘리세요.
하지만 조심하세요! 재고 관리, 고객 만족도 및 가격 책정은 성공의 열쇠입니다. 올바른 전략적 결정을 내려서 당신의 가게를 업계의 정상으로 이끌 수 있습니까?
주요 특징:
3D 피규어 제작 및 커스터마이즈
선반 관리, 가격 책정 및 고객 만족도
가게 확장 및 디자인 커스터마이즈
컬렉션 세트 만들기 및 희귀 피규어 발견하기
시장 트렌드를 따르고 베스트셀러 제품을 찾기
가게를 처음부터 만들어 피규어 컬렉션 세계의 최고가 되세요!

title: Sunken Engine
description:
게임 정보
러브크래프트 스타일의 트위스트가 가미된 조선소
Sunken Engine은 러브크래프트의 분위기를 지닌 선박 수리 시뮬레이터입니다. 아버지의 비극적인 죽음 후, 당신은 가족의 사업을 이어받아 운영해야 합니다. 이는 고객을 만족시키고 마을의 질서를 유지하는 일을 의미합니다. 그러나 새로운 배가 도착할 때마다 새로운 도전과 미스터리가 기다리고 있습니다.
러브크래프트식 공포
당신이 겪는 사건들은 정신 건강에 위협을 줄 수 있습니다. 이는 당신의 일을 어렵게 만들거나 어두운 존재들을 끌어들일 수 있습니다. 당신은 사업을 계속 운영하면서 정신을 유지할 방법을 찾아야 합니다.

title: THE REVENANTS
description:
게임 정보
                                    The Revenants is not just a survival game, but your story of fighting for life in a ruined world where every step can be deadly. You will have to take control of a group of survivors and lead them through trials and threats, where to survive you need to monitor the main indicators: food, water, health and energy.
Search for resources and items in the world, create the necessary equipment. You will also have to fight hostile mobs, protecting your group. Develop skills, improve survival strategies and prove that you can withstand any threat!
                                                  You will have to face the harsh realities of survival in a dangerous world. Equip your character with gear and clothing, pick up weapons for protection.

title: Nomori
description:
게임 정보


Nomori is a gorgeous and heartfelt adventure puzzle game that puts the power of time and space in your hands. As Kiko, players will venture into a vividly rendered fantasy world full of colorful and eccentric spirits, where she will learn to see the world from exciting new perspectives. As Kiko comes into her own and bonds with the Spirits, she will see beyond the limits of reality and save Nomori.

Change Your Reality
Place, shift, and rotate portals to change the gravity direction of objects and even yourself.
Make clever use of portals to reach new places! Try to challenge your understanding of the world’s physical limits.
Use your spirit powers to influence the world around you. Control the flow of time and rotate the forces of gravity to solve mind-bending environmental puzzles!

title: R.E.A.P.E.R. Corp.
description:
게임 정보
Key Game Features:
Intelligent, terrifying creatures that stalk your team, learn, and evolve.
A changing, mutating world where the environment itself is your enemy. Each game is unique, with the landscape mutating in different ways.
Cooperative gameplay, where you work with your team to get in, collect scrap, and get out before the environment and creatures grow to monstrous levels.
Cannibalize your friends

title: Rob Together
description:
게임 정보
The Ultimate Co-op Heist Experience

PLAN YOUR HEIST Every successful heist starts with a solid plan. In Rob Together, teamwork is the key to success. Gather your friends and take on roles like Hacker, Thief, Lookout, and Saboteur. Identify security vulnerabilities, study guard routines, and choose the best approach. Sneak through silently or create diversions to achieve your goals. Every decision will shape the outcome of your heist.


HACK, HIDE, AND STEAL Show off your skills and perfect your timing. Hack cameras and alarms, pick locks to access hidden areas, and collect valuable items while avoiding guards. Work together as a team to complete your objectives and escape without being caught. Every heist will push your team’s abilities to the limit.


ESCAPE WITH THE LOOT Getting in is one thing; getting out is a whole different adventure. After completing your mission, coordinate a stealthy escape. Find hidden routes, avoid patrolling NPCs, and ensure your team gets out safely with the loot. A flawless escape is the most crucial part of the heist.


COLLABORATE IN EVERY MISSION Rob Together delivers the full co-op heist experience. With dynamic environments, complex security systems, and countless strategies, every heist is unique. Play with up to 4 players and face the ultimate test of coordination, communication, and teamwork.

Rob Together isn’t just a game—it’s a challenge that tests your wit, speed, and teamwork. Can you and your crew pull off the perfect heist?

title: Mirror Throne: Auto Battler
description:
게임 정보
Build Your Team

Build a team of JRPG inspired units with unique abilities. You will need to strategically place and synergize the characters to be successful.

Battle

Battles play turns automatically, where units use their special abilities on specific triggers. There are many unique strategies and powerful synergies to be discovered.


Challenge the Mirrored Legion in a run based rogue lite mode where each run is modified by meta shifting trinkets.


Unlock new characters, items, trinkets, and factions after each run.

title: Simulacro
description:
게임 정보

"Simulacro" is a first-person puzzle game, enriched with a narrative inspired by ancient Greek philosophy.

Poísis, an art student, ventures to a mysterious island, newly emerged due to the receding waters of Greece's majestic Lake Prespa - a change brought on by global warming. Gifted with the ability to encapsulate the essence of landscapes in her paintings, she explores the island seeking artistic inspiration. Confronted with relics of a lost civilization and enigmatic portals, Poísis grapples with a pivotal philosophical query posed by the ancients: what is the true essence of reality?
Explore Ancient Greek Ruins
Engage in Artistic Creation

title: MycoRelic
description:
게임 정보
You are a sentient fungus, reanimating the scrapped robotic body of a long-dead machine.
Journey with your friends to explore a world of mushrooms, blooming through the technological wreckage of a failed human civilization. 
Build Your Combat Style in a Classless System
Dodge, block, parry, and engage the hostile tribes and creatures of the island. Master a variety of weapons, each with their own move sets and statistics. Equip yourself with armor that suits your playstyle and aesthetic.
Scavenge Parts to Enhance Your Robotic Body
Start with a decrepit, moldy frame. Replace it to overcome the dangers of the environment, support your combat style, or enhance elemental effects. Expand your stamina, boost the integrity of your frame, and increase the potency of your fungal magic.
Wield the Elemental Powers of Ancient Fungi

title: SeaDogs Of Nassau
description:
게임 정보


Nassau lies in ruins. Its people look to you to restore it to its former glory. Your only choice? Take to the sea and become the most notorious pirate legend of all time. Will you loot, plunder, and decimate all who stand in your way as a fearsome renegade? Or will you use your strength and charisma to rise through the ranks of the Navy? Both these paths and anywhere in between are there for you to take in Seadogs of Nassau.
Explore Unsettled Seas
As an open-world Pirate RPG, Seadogs of Nassau aims to give you the freedom to live like a true warrior of the sea. In a world inspired by Caribbean and West African civilizations of the 17th century, you’ll come face-to-face with challenges both human and mystical.

Coordinate Brutal Naval Combat
Engage in exhilarating naval battles with a pirate vessel of your own making. Fight dirty or honorably with skills befit of a seafaring corsair.

title: Multi Idle
description:
게임 정보
Multi Idle is an progression based Idle game of which features Modules with individuality that excel when cooperating with each other. With a large focus on customization, enjoy a highly randomized item generation system that has the potential to generate exceedingly strong equipment. An expanding passive tree featuring over 300 nodes in its Beta. All with the purpose of making your fighters super strong, to push even further.
Multi Idle has a large focus on giving the player the power to control how they play. Each rebirth unlocks more content and more ways to change the playstyle of your game. Revisit old strategies reborn anew or focus more on a part of the game that you have been meaning to bring up to speed.
There are a number of races and classes for various benefits. And through advantages and game based evolutions that modify the way the game can be played. As well as the powerful inventory and passive tree. There is a large amount of ways to customize a run to the play style of your choosing. Or even just to focus on parts of the game that may be lacking!
Go on Expeditions and fight for loot! But be ready for the next step in combat!
To go further, fight with a more advanced form of combat with Magic, Skills, and opponents that will hit back hard!

title: Lost in Cheese
description:
게임 정보
사랑스러운 정육면체 모양의 고양이가 치즈에 가로막혔어요. 엄청난 양의 치즈가요.
치즈를 밀어서 길을 열고, 커다란 빨간 버튼까지 나아가세요.
치즈로 가득한 각 스테이지를 클리어할 때마다 치즈의 미스터리에 한 걸음 더 다가가게 됩니다.
귀엽고 아늑한 치즈 가득한 세계에 빠져보세요.
여정을 따라가다 보면, 신비로운 치즈의 기원에 대한 단서를 주는 오랜 친구들을 만날 수 있어요.
특징:
100개 이상의 레벨이 있는 아름다운 섬을 탐험하세요.
퍼즐을 마스터하고 새로운 세계를 해금하세요.
최소한의 이동으로 클리어하여 보상을 받으세요.
몰입감 있는 세계에서 두뇌를 자극하는 도전을 즐기세요.

title: Chef Simulator
description:
게임 정보


The Jury waiting for the dinner, and the clock is ticking. All players must be done their cooks before time run out. Here you have to work against your friends and cook well for the Jury requirements.

Chef Simulator lets you a multiplayer cooking experience with your friends up to 8 players. Be the master about 80 realistic cook recipes and experience realistic physics kitchen environment. Use the realistic kitchen tools. Play it your way - help your friends or even sabotage their plates! The game also gives you a sandbox cooking experience with wide ranged foods. You can play all the experiences with up to 8 friends in multiplayer mode or single player mode. If you want to have a relaxing chef experience, you can cook the most basic recipes, or if you want make some serious job there there are very complicated recipes waiting for you, but it doesn't matter either way the things going will be the crazy and most probably foods are start gonna fly.

One of the players can be Jury. You can share tasks with your friends. While a friend taking care of dishes or cooking meats, others can set the table for the dinner.

There is totally 8 game modes available. Both competitive and co operative modes for all type of gamers or you current mood.



- The multiplayer co-op mode allows you to play in a team of up to 8 people to make play as Chefs. There is no specific role requirement within the team, but you are completely free to choose task sharing if needed.

- You can totally customize your personal avatar, including male and female avatars, using an incredibly detailed customization system even face details.

- There are so many activities available in the kitchen. You can apply different strategies here, steal other player props and throw away them!

- Full detailed kitchen available. The method you choose to make your cook totally depend on your creativity.

- Meats and steaks are valuable. You have to cook and prepare them without wasting them. Environmental conditions are steady but be careful about the other players!

- Blowtorch and fire extinguisher can be used actively.

title: Sweet Slaughter
description:
게임 정보
끝없이 밀려오는 적의 물결을 상대하는 액션 로그라이크의 짜릿한 경험을 느껴보세요! Sweet Slaughter에서 유니ーク한 능력을 가진 영웅을 선택하고 점점 강해지는 괴물들의 무리와 싸워보세요. 레벨업 할 때마다 수정 모듈과 확장 모듈을 선택하여 능력치를 향상시키고 추가적인 특수 효과를 얻을 수 있습니다.
15분이 지나면 강력한 보스가 등장하고, 이를 처치해야만 모험을 성공적으로 완료할 수 있습니다.
[h2>주요 특징:]

title: Warlock's Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
Battle your way through hordes of the Warlock's minions in this dungeon crawler! Find better armor and weapons to help you survive, level up to increase your stats, learn new skills to smite your enemies or heal yourself. In the end, will you be able to defeat the evil Warlock and free your people from his tyranny?
***Please Note IF YOU PLAY THE DEMO***
The game is still in ALPHA phase. You may experience bugs, poor quality animations, sounds, VFX, etc. and other issues. Feel free to point things out in the community hub! 
Things we are currently working on:
Animations
Sounds
Visual Effects
Game Balance
Other game mechanics
Adding items
Adding creatures
Lots of other cool stuff!

title: Deflectorium
description:
게임 정보
Wishlist Deflectorium now. The galaxy needs you.
Gameplay
Actively deflect incoming projectiles back at your enemies or spin them around yourself and throw them back. This can all be done within the deflection zone around your hero. Move freely across the arena in no time. Gravity won't bother you.
Arenas are connected to each other on a hexagonal map where a boss waits patiently at the end, opening the way to other sectors. With a new threat.

Along the way, you find various run upgrades that, to a greater or lesser extent, make the journey easier. And more fun. Resources found are perfect for permanent upgrades.

Features
Bullet perfect game
Instant movement by mouse
Active deflection of enemy bullets
Spin and release
Permanent upgrades
Passive run enhancements
Special skills (curving space and time)
Hexagonal progress map
Boss fights
Classes

title: The Little Clandestine
description:
게임 정보
The Little Clandestine is the continuation of the story narrated in Dirty Wars - September 11 by UglyCat Studios, an emotional 2D top-down adventure that invites you to experience the Cold War in South America during the late '70s and '80s through the eyes of Pipo, a Chilean child from a fractured family who enters a clandestine life in a world of struggle and resistance against the military dictatorship in Chile.
                                                                                                                     Pipo
Main Features:
Unique Graphic Style: The game features a graphic style inspired by posters and art from the '70s, with meticulous details that recreate the atmosphere of the time. From poor neighborhoods to the grand avenues of Santiago de Chile, each scene is designed with a retro touch.
