title: Switcheroo
description:
게임 정보
STORY
Dr. Alexander Chromus was an award-winning painter until an accident in the Outback left him colorblind. Since then, he has sworn revenge on all animals, kidnapping, among others, a kangaroo named Jade. Driven mad by his search for a cure, Dr. Chromus conducted evil experiments which inadvertently gave Jade colorkenetic powers!
After breaking out of captivity with a powerful kick, Jade vowed to not only escape the lab, but to use her new color-switching powers to rescue the others and put an end to Dr. Chromus's tyranny once and for all...
GAMEPLAY
By switching the active color with a button press, contraptions around the lab react in different ways. For example, when the color blue is active, blue blocks become solid, whereas red, green, and yellow blocks become passable. Thus, Switcheroo is its own unique breed of platformer, combining skillful movement with strategic color-swapping!
Other examples of contraptions include Crushers, which will crush any object below when their color is active, Dispensers, which only dispense objects when their color is active, and Potted Plants, which grow tall when their color is active.
Color can have more drastic effects on an entire level as well. In some stages. the water level or even the gravity can be affected by the current active color!
And that's just scratching the surface; the possibilities are endless!

title: MustScream
description:
게임 정보
Mysterious deaths kept happening, and then suddenly, a suburban hospital shut down.
As a journalist, you step into the abandoned hospital to uncover the truth.
Scattered throughout the hospital are 10 medical records. Collect them and find your way out.
But there’s one problem… You’re a total coward.
The only way to run is to scream and force yourself forward.
Shout your way to the finish!
Game Features
🔊 Mic Input
Scream into your mic to run.
Running away from enemies by actually screaming makes the experience even more immersive.
(You can play without a mic, but you won’t be able to run, making the game much harder.)
(Normal movement is done with WASD.)
🌍 Online Multiplayer
Play with up to 4 players!
Scream together with your friends.
🎙 Proximity Voice Chat
Talk to your friends while playing.
If you hear a scream in the distance… run for your life!

title: EMOTIONLESS : The Last Ticket
description:
게임 정보

Your final ride begins here - a place where you'll question your sanity while reality distorts into an endless nightmare. 

But it's not all so bad, it's about having fun too, right? Because you can interact with some of the forgotten attractions in the park. They still work, altough no one knows why...

title: Clayground
description:
게임 정보
Step into vibrant, hand-crafted parks brimming with physics-based toys and endless possibilities. Whether you're looking to goof around with friends, master parkour, or dive into hilarious mini-games, Clayground is the all-in-one social VR playground built from the ground up for fun in VR.
(The footage below is from early alpha testing and not representative of final gameplay)
Seamless Social VR - Play Together, Effortlessly
Forget loading screens and complicated setups. Clayground is designed for instant social connection.
Next-Gen Matchmaking: Get playing faster with friends and new faces thanks to our next-gen matchmaking system, including age-based options for a comfortable social space.
Instant Groups: Create groups effortlessly and stay connected with your favorite playmates across parks.
Crossplay Freedom: Whether your friends are on PCVR (Steam), Quest, or PSVR 2 (date to be determined!), everyone can join the fun.
Effortless Park Hopping: Travel seamlessly between every park with your group of up to 8, keeping the party going without interruption.
A Physics Playground Like No Other

title: Vangaro Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Vangaro Tactics is a colorful turn-based strategy game with pointy nose commanders and Stealth Missions.
You will command a vibrant roster of cartoon units into battle. There's regular "frontal combat" levels and Stealth Missions, where you infiltrate behind enemy lines at night, and should choose your moves carefully to avoid alerting too many foes.



Experience the Vangaro War through a diverse cast of playable commanders from multiple backgrounds and factions. Fresh or hardened, noble or humble, each one has a unique perspective on the conflict they've been entangled in. Use your Commander Power to turn the tide of battle!




Infiltrate behind enemy lines at night on the Stealth Missions. You're outnumbered, so measure your forces, choose your targets, and defeat them before they forward the alarm to the next outpost. Mine, recruit units and outsmart the enemy to overcome each mission.




Manage a vibrant roster of ground, air and sea units. Employ to capture buildings and take resources, while provide greater firepower, transport, and more. No unit is flawless, even the chunky tanks may need a hand!





Discover the world of Vangaro through multiple factions with . There's a common set of troops, but each side has developed special units to gain tactical advantage on different terrains and situations. to each commander and faction to plan the best strategies and reach victory.




resources and factories to produce gold, then head to the barracks to new units. Factories under your control yield each turn but minerals are limited; Take them first to get an edge on the enemy!

title: Carnival Massacre
description:
게임 정보
After countless nightmares about your missing little sister, you embark on a journey with one goal: to bring her home. You play as Harley, a girl who’s going to face horrors worse than anything her nightmares could produce.

title: 150 Floors
description:
게임 정보
Ascend!
150 Floors is a roguelite, tile-based strategy RPG where you can choose to play as 8 different elemental mages. Battle your way through 150 floors filled with many eccentric enemies and meet different characters who may or may not help you on your journey, as you reach and defeat the top floor!
Gameplay
Your adventure takes place in a tower that has 150 floors filled with enemies. Use different magical skills unique to each mage to attack your enemies and defend yourself. Each floor made up of tiles have a durability limit. If you attack an enemy, you're also attacking the tile they occupy as well and it may break, sending the enemy to the previous floor. This same logic applies to your opponents as well. If the tile you occupy breaks, you fall to the previous floor as well. Defeat all monsters on a floor and an elevator appears on the floor, taking you to the next floor.
Story
2 years prior in a distant land, strange creatures spawned from the top of a large tower and began their invasion, killing millions of people and consuming their souls. Each mage, afflicted by the sudden invasion of strange creatures, wants to rid the land of these creatures for their own personal reasons. The only similarities they share are to reach the 150th floor and conquer it, granting them any wish they desire... Or so the saying goes.

title: Four Hundred Catapults
description:
게임 정보
Game World
In a realm teetering on chaos, a disordered human army makes its last stand by the merciless sea, the relentless onslaught of the Half Dead Legions nipping at their heels. These horrific creatures, devoid of will, battle scars shrouded beneath heavy armor, pledge blind obedience to their ruthless commander. The only thing that drives them is a ceaseless hatred for all that live.


Main Features

Strategize for survival: Analyze your battlefield and adopt varied survival strategies. Prioritize technological advancement or population growth, strike early to exploit your enemy’s weaknesses or expand and fortify your territory, and beyond!!




Embark on a monumental mission to fortify human resistance and rekindle hope amidst imminent annihilation. As the underdogs in this struggle, your journey won’t be easy!


The single-player campaign offers a diversified mission roster, featuring:





The game features innovative mechanics, making for a unique RTS experience. For hardcore players, advanced modes provide more unconventional mechanics and challenges for an intensified battlefield scenario.

title: 3 Last Chances
description:
게임 정보
3 Last Chances is an Action RPG game with challenging combat and progression system that allows to create your own unique playstyle. You get 3 chances to replay a year, complete quests and find just the right method of weakening and overcoming the seemingly unbeatable final boss.

Replay the same year (50 weeks) up to 3 times, searching for a method to overcome the game's ultimate Boss. Repeated missions and dialogues can be skipped, with only new content being shown.
Acquire up to 56 abilities, each with 2 different upgrades. Unlock power-ups and equip weapons to become stronger and create your own, unique playstyle.
Challenge 20 Bosses, each with their unique attacks and mechanics.
Choices available to you and the game's ending depends on your decisions.

title: CYBERVOID
description:
게임 정보
Deep underground, the advanced city of Umbral lies in silence. Strange silicon lifeforms stir in the depths, dormant robots await the call of their long-slumbering masters, and a lone scientist remains trapped—waiting for help.
Tasked with a mission to determine Umbral’s fate before time runs out, with limited energy, every decision counts. Will you explore, restore, or destroy?
Hack city storage to scavenge vital materials.
Snipe security drones with your long-range graviton beam.
Absorb lost personality cores to upgrade yourself.
As you navigate the city's 45 districts, each linked to its vast neural network, you’ll encounter strange and sentient beings—Dendrone, Cybersaur, the Twins, and the Dross Bishop—each holding fragments of your past.
Even when your BODY resists, something deep inside remembers who you are… until whispers of a THETA Military presence surface. A hidden faction, reawakening with an unfinished mission of its own.
With only five years before Umbral collapses, will you reach the city's core in time—or be buried with its secrets forever?

title: Milo
description:
게임 정보
         What if the next time you woke up you had no memories,  were holding a gun and hunted by deranged people? 
  Find out what you're made of in this unique blend of RNG and skill-based progression
Survive as long as you can and save the rats that are tormented by Milo and his followers. Leverage the corpses to empower you and survive longer
Compete with others in the Global Leaderboards in the "Basketball" mini-game flaunt your skill
Pop the corpses and use slain cultists against their sadistic leader, Milo
Drink from the Cream Machine to upgrade your character
company: Spencer Sharp, rat cream games LLC

title: GrimGraves
description:
게임 정보
GrimGraves is a running-puzzle solving game where you have to avoid monsters and complete your job. The game does show some darker themes though so please be prepared for that. What you can expect from buying the game is a dark game that doesn't have much handholding as your left to figure out where your supposed to go. The gameplay is all centered around completing objectives but hopefully the boss fights bring a lot of spice to the game.

title: The Rain Spirit : Code Breaker
description:
게임 정보
The Rain Spirit : Code Breaker
비의 정신: 코드 해결사

일인칭, 대기 퍼즐 탐험 게임

여러 지역에서, 캐릭터와 원작 주제가와 혼합된 이야기들을 찾고 코드와 퍼즐을 통해 잠금 해제가 가득차 있는 거대하고 인터렉티브한 세계.

배경


1957년 늦은 가을, 하비에르 카마릴로의 딸인 11살 릴라 카마릴로는 스페인 중부의 먼 친척들을 방문했을 때 폭풍우로 인한 보트 사고의 후유증으로 아주 깊은 잠에 빠진 혼수상태가 되었습니다. 릴라의 몸과 정신은 치유의 시간을 필요로하지만 광활하고 신비로운 대안 현실을 통해 삶을 되찾아야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 다시는 일어날 수 없기 때문입니다.

현실 세계를 인식 할 수 없이, 릴라는 자신의 정신안에서 무의식적으로 남아 있게 됩니다. 그녀는 이 상황을 헤쳐나가려고 하지만 절망에 빠지게 되며, 광대하고 신비로운 원더 랜드를 형성하며 현실로 돌아갈 수 있는 방법에 대한 희미한 실마리만 남아있습니다. 그녀는 많은 장애물, 경로, 포털 및 퍼즐과 맞서야 하며, 이 모든 것들에 대한 결과가 나타날 것 입니다.

릴라는 선량하거나 악한 이상한 생물이나 캐릭터들을 만나게 되며, 릴라의 여행을 돕거나 방해할 것입니다. 릴라의 능력은 공포, 유혹, 착각, 믿음 및 문제 해결로 시험대에 오르게 될 것 입니다. 릴라의 인생을 다시 찾을 수 있을까요? 운이 아주 좋으면, 릴라를 도와주는 문서, 코드, 마술, 손전등, 나침반, 지도 및 기타 여러 아이템을 우연히 발견할 것 입니다. 만약 운이 없으면, 릴라는 죽게 되거나, 물리거나, 위험에 빠지거나, 악날한 생물을 만날 수도 있을 것 입니다. 그러나 조금 더 자세히 살펴보면 숨어있는 비
의 정신을 발견할 수가 있을 것 입니다.

이상한 단서는 어디에서나 찾을 수 있습니다.


특징

• 거대한 열린 세계를 탐험하고, 퍼즐을 잠금해제하여 더 여행할 수 있도록 코드를 풀어보세요.
• 원작 주제가를 통하여 몰입할 수 있고 독특한 환경.
• 적, 포털, 수상한 캐릭터 및 문제 해결 기기에 몰입
• 퍼즐 게임 장르의 실험적인 도입
• 나를 도와줄 캐릭터들을 만나기
• 믿어야 할지 말아야 할지 결정 또는 학습
• 이전 대화를 찾아보기 위하여 플레이어 로그를 참조.
• 지점 A에서 지점 B까지를 포함하는 문제 해결 상황은 때로는 현혹하는 것 일 수 있습니다.
• 아름다운 게임 환경과 시간이 가는 줄 모르게 푹 빠져드는 게임 플레이

title: The Witch's Fairy Tale
description:
게임 정보
About "The Witch's Fairy Tale", QQ group: 1 group 576030061

"The Witch's Fairy Tale" is an action roguelike role-playing game independently developed by "A Little Han Han Duck OVO". In this game, you play as a curious young witch who embarks on a fantastical adventure to discover the mystical magic of the world. Your mission is not only to master powerful magic, but also to face a variety of powerful enemies and puzzles to unravel the secrets hidden behind the world.

Each adventure is unique, filled with randomly generated levels, enemies, and treasures, ensuring that every gaming experience is unique. The combat system emphasizes the combination of strategy and skill, and players can create their own fighting style through different combinations of magic.

As your adventure progresses, your story will unfold and be recorded as a magical fairy tale for generations to come. Every decision and choice can affect the ending of the fairy tale, write your own fairy tale.

Are you ready to embark on this magical journey and become the protagonist of a fairy tale?
autokwd: The Witch's Fairy Tale,魔女的童话

title: Dark Laws
description:
게임 정보
당신의 임무는 간단하지만 위험합니다: 처치하고, 약탈하고, 탈출하십시오.



다크 로즈의 세계에 입장하십시오. 텔로스 섬이 당신을 기다립니다. 심장이 뛰는 모험이 펼쳐지는 오픈 월드 전장에 발을 들여놓고, 생존은 피로 써진 증거이며, 약탈은 용감한 자의 통화이고, 탈출만이 유일한 탈출구입니다.



자신만의 운명을 만들어보세요. 치명적인 근접 무기, 정밀한 원거리 무기, 신비로운 주문, 그리고 능력을 향상시키는 패시브 유물을 선택하십시오. 그러나 무기 목록은 여기서 끝나지 않습니다 – 드래곤혼을 조작하여 당신의 장대한 드래곤을 소환하고, 전투의 흐름을 당신에게 유리하게 돌리십시오.

선택은 끝이 없고, 결과는 치명적입니다.

title: noox
description:
게임 정보
Noox is a 3D first person medieval fantasy ghost investigation game that can be played solo or co-op. Use magically powered tools to collect evidence left behind by ghost hauntings, sort through the clues to decide which type of ghost is haunting the location, and assemble the necessary runes on your trap to capture the ghost and stop the haunting. But beware of draining your mana too fast by using too many tools at once, because the ghost will sense your weakness and use that moment to attack!
You play an alchemist investigating hauntings to extract magical energy (noox) from spirits. Travel to different haunted locations and stop the evil presence. Utilizing some fantasy twists on classic ghost investigation tools like an EMF reader of glowing mushrooms, track the ghost and collect the energy it infuses into objects that it has interacted with. Once enough information has been collected, assemble the necessary runes to capture the ghost on your trap and bring the ghost back to your workshop to complete your collection and unlock new abilities.

title: Beast and Cleaver
description:
게임 정보
Beast and Cleaver is a 2D open-world adventure hack-and-slash where tactical combat and monster hunting define your journey. As the Hanging City's hired hunter, your mission is to track and defeat mythical creatures, uncover the secrets of their unique spawning conditions, and use their materials to strengthen both yourself and the city. Every successful hunt expands the Hanging City, unlocking new merchants, potions, and character customizations to aid your next battle.
A World Shaped by the Hunt
Venture through six distinct biomes—from the frozen peaks of the Snow Mountains to the infernal depths of The Flames—each home to unique creatures with their own behaviors, weaknesses, and environmental triggers. Learning how and where to summon them is just as important as the fight itself.
Fast-Paced Tactical Combat
Combat is quick, skill-based, and unforgiving. Use dashes, rolls, wall slides, and precise strikes to stay alive while taking down formidable foes like wyverns, gorgons, yetis, and other mythological beasts. Every battle requires careful positioning and mastery of movement to outmaneuver deadly attacks.
The Hanging City – Your Home & Arsenal
As you hunt, the Hanging City evolves. Turn in rare materials and slay biome specific bosses to unlock new potions and merchants, making each hunt more efficient. This living, growing hub serves as your base of operations, rewarding your dedication with tons of character customization to look swaged out while battling the deadliest beasts.
Survival Demands Strategy
Manage your grid-based inventory, balancing rare loot with essential quest goods. Sell excess materials, buy powerful potions, and customize your hunter’s appearance by completing challenging in-game achievements.
Key Features
Open-World Hunting: Explore six hand-crafted biomes filled with diverse creatures, hidden lore, and tactical combat encounters.
Tactical Combat System: Every fight is a test of skill and movement, with fast-paced dodging and precise strikes.

title: Directive 8020
description:
게임 정보
UNTIL DAWN과 THE QUARRY의 제작자들이 강렬한 서바이벌 게임플레이에 의미심장한 선택지와 분기하는 스토리라인을 결합해, 완전히 새로운 시네마틱 SF 호러 어드벤처를 선보입니다.
지구는 죽어가고 있고 인류에게는 시간이 없습니다. 고향에서 12광년 떨어진, 타우 세티 f는 실낱같은 희망입니다. 식민지 개척함 카시오페이아 호가 행성에 불시착했을 때, 곧 승무원들은 이 행성에는 그들만 있는 게 아니란 것을 깨닫습니다.
카시오페이아의 승무원들은 먹잇감을 모방할 수 있는 외계 유기체에게 사냥당하고 있습니다. 살아남아 고향으로 돌아가려면 추격자들보다 영리하게 행동해야 합니다. 살아남기 위해 싸우면서, 이들은 가장 어려운 선택을 직면합니다. 자신들을 구하느냐, 지구의 모든 인류의 생명을 위험에 처하게 하는 일을 무릅쓰느냐의 선택 말이죠.
차세대 시네마틱 생존형 공포
할리우드 배우 라샤나 린치(밥 말리: 원 러브, 더 우먼 킹)가 기발한 우주 비행사 '영' 역할로 출연합니다. 인류를 구하기 위한 심우주 임무에 착수해 몰입감 넘치는 시네마틱 스토리텔링과 손에 땀을 쥐게 하는 공포를 경험하세요.
실시간 외계인 위협

title: DIMAWORLD
description:
게임 정보
Misha is searching for Dima. He must scour a fictional world (CHECK 233 / 236 PLACES) whose landscapes vaguely resemble areas around major Eastern European cities in the early 21st century—reimagined in a humorous alternate reality.
DIMAWORLD IS:
Realistic visuals, cutscenes, and immersive sound design
A single-player open-world experience, offering several hours of gameplay packed with diverse elements: large-scale events, occurrences of natural phenomena, and unexpected encounters. You’ll interact with various physical objects and entities, robots, and weapons—purchasing and using them, and pursuing additional tasks along the way.
Control different vehicles, ride trains, and survive in third-person perspective, confronting humans, wild animals, robots, and even mutant monsters.
Immerse yourself in a fictional world with a slightly comical atmosphere of an early 21st-century alternate reality.
An indie open-world explorer with elements of survival, action, object searching, and an intriguing storyline.

title: Burlesque
description:
게임 정보
Starting a burlesque show can be tricky, can you make the right decisions to ensure the show is a success?

title: Love at The Milky Way Diner: Demo
description:
게임 정보



Love at the Milky Way Diner is a game about cultural exchange through food, building community, and finding love in the process.

200 years after first contact, humanity is still trying to find their  place in a galaxy full of far more advanced and established species.
One such human, our protagonist, has recently been laid off from their corporate job on Mars when news reaches them; their distant aunt Cassiopia has passed away suddenly, and she would like one of her relatives to take over her restaurant on the distant deep space station Hesperides.
The protagonist decides to take a leap of faith. They may have never left their home start system of Helios, but surely there must be something (or maybe someone) better out there waiting for them.
When they reach the station they find themselves welcomed by a vibrant, multi-species community of eccentric individuals who are only too happy to welcome the new owner of their favourite place to eat.


Love at the Milky Way Diner will feature 8 love interests, each with their own routes and stories
autokwd: Love at The Milky Way Diner: Demo

title: Dragons Reef
description:
게임 정보
안녕하세요 모험가 여러분!
드래곤 리프 세계로의 매력적인 여정을 시작하세요. 8명의 선장 중 한 명으로 플레이하고 드래곤, 해적, 다양한 바다 생물, 그리고 획득할 골드로 가득한 판타지 세계로 자신의 배를 타고 출발하세요. 각 선장은 특정 상황에서 유리한 고유한 기술을 가지고 있습니다. 기술은 다음 레벨로 개발할 수 있습니다. 플레이 스타일과 선택한 레벨에 맞는 선장을 선택하세요. 이 독특한 게임 플레이에서 플레이 방식과 작업 완료 전략을 바꿀 수 있는 24개의 강력한 마법 유물을 획득할 수 있습니다. 한 번에 4개의 유물만 활성화할 수 있으므로 앞으로의 도전에 캐릭터를 신중하게 적응시켜야 합니다. 완벽한 순간에 완벽한 샷을 찍고 해적을 물리칠 수 있도록 배를 배치하세요. 각 라운드는 여러 번, 다양한 방법으로 완료할 수 있는 흥미진진한 모험입니다. 게임 내 이벤트의 높은 무작위성으로 인해 게임 플레이는 매번 약간씩 다르게 보일 것입니다. 배는 8개의 환상적인 대포알을 사용할 수 있으며, 각각은 특별한 속성과 화려한 애니메이션을 가지고 있습니다. 당신 옆에서 날아주고, 해적과 싸우고, 물 속 장애물을 제거하는 데 도움을 줄 황금빛 용과 함께 분위기 있는 땅을 탐험해보세요.
Dragons Reef는 매력적이고 가족 친화적이며 다채로운 액션 게임으로 다음과 같은 특징이 있습니다.
상품 배달에 관한 레크리에이션 모험
해적으로부터 자신을 방어하는 게임 플레이와 용의 알을 보호해야 하는 추가 과제가 있는 화려한 해상 전투
플레이어가 가능한 한 많은 드래곤 알을 자신의 기지로 가져와야 하는 기술과 집중력이 필요한 게임입니다.
다른 선박과의 흥미진진한 경쟁으로, 장애물과 완료해야 할 선택 과제가 가득하며, 이를 통해 추가 골드를 받습니다.

title: Nameless adventure
description:
게임 정보
        An action RPG with elements of metroidvania, sandbox and platformer. You will find a dangerous dungeon that transforms in real time and hides many secrets. Only by reaching its deepest depths will you uncover the truth about what this "dungeon" really is...
Living dungeon – the world changes in real time, creating new challenges and opportunities
Cartoon style graphics
Full world destruction – almost everything can be broken… if you have a strong enough pickaxe
Building – construct structures, create battle cover, set traps, or carve new paths. It’s all up to your playstyle

title: Glöd
description:
게임 정보
Glöd is a hardcore survival game set in the unforgiving wilderness of Sweden. Struggle against nature’s wrath, scavenge for resources, and battle extreme conditions to survive. In this brutal landscape, every decision matters, and every moment is a test of endurance.
Explore a meticulously crafted environment filled with dark forests, rocky terrains, and harsh winters. Engage in tense gameplay with realistic survival mechanics, resource management, and a deeply atmospheric narrative that immerses you in a fight for survival against both nature and the limits of human resilience.
Key Features:
Dynamic Survival Mechanics: Scavenge, hunt, and craft to stay alive in a relentless world.
Harsh Swedish Wilderness: Experience a detailed and atmospheric setting inspired by Scandinavian landscapes.
Realistic Weather Systems: Adapt to punishing blizzards, freezing nights, and torrential rain.
Permadeath Mode: Challenge yourself with a mode where every mistake is permanent.
Immersive Storytelling: Uncover a compelling narrative as you survive against all odds.

title: AS ABOVE SO BELOW
description:
게임 정보
AS ABOVE SO BELOW is a Survival Horror Open World Action/RPG. You play as a recent college graduate offered a job in a small town, but upon arrival things are not what they seem. Face a series of unexplained events that unravel history, and ultimately change the future. Explore, Fight, Survive.

title: Flow - Syn x Vertue
description:
게임 정보
'Flow - Syn x Vertue' is the very best Synthwave + Darkwave + Art Pop music genred arcade co-op party elimination racing game ever built. By far. For sure. No doubt.
Vertue [Party Time]
A melting pot of unique game mechanics, shaders and peripheral design to create intense, and intensely fun, collaborative and combative party play.

title: Double Dragon Revive
description:
게임 정보
1987년 오락실에 등장하여 "벨트 스크롤 액션"을 확립한 걸작 타이틀 "더블 드래곤" 시리즈.
지금까지도 많은 게이머에게 영감을 주고 있는 작품이 "더블 드래곤 리바이브"로 다시 태어난다!

1. 스타일리시하게 향상된 캐릭터 비주얼!
아케이드 황금기를 빛낸 캐릭터들의 개성을 3D 그래픽으로 재현.
주인공 리 형제뿐만 아니라 여태껏 맞서싸워온 강적들도 등장한다!

플레이어가 화면을 좌우로 이동하면서 적을 쓰러트려가는 벨트 스크롤 액션.
그 심플하면서도 직관적인 게임성을 충실히 재현하면서도 조작감과 난이도를 현세대에 맞게 최적화.
아크시스템웍스의 격투 게임 제작 스태프가 철저히 감수하여 처음 플레이하는 사람도 쉽게 플레이가 가능!

본 게임의 전투 액션은 단순히 버튼을 누르는 것이 아닌 다채로운 움직임이 필요!
적의 행동 패턴을 기억하여 효과적인 공격 타이밍을 노리는 등 전략적 요소가 포함되어 있다.
각 스테이지에 떨어져 있는 무기나 준비된 기믹을 활용하여 전투를 유리하게 이끌어가자!

title: Maguntsche Chapter Two
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Macungie, Pennsylvania!
The Lockridge Shipping Company, a once bustling hub of commerce, now stands as a relic of the prosperity once experienced by a small community. Andrew Allen, the company’s latest hire, seizes this opportunity to weave digital threads through the decaying fabric of tradition, bringing the company into the modern era with his expertise in data security. Unknown to him, the company’s purpose has shifted, veering away from its repetitive logistical operations. His employee orientation, a mundane affair on paper, unfolds like a cryptic ritual with the intention of summoning a cataclysmic merger of worlds. As time runs out, Andrew finds himself entangled in the past, present, and future. Only you will decide how it ends.
Gameplay Features Summary
Maguntsche: Chapter Two is an indie horror game that blends the traditional elements of the survival horror genre with a branching narrative experience. The player is tasks with exploring the Lockridge Shipping Company Industrial Complex and must search for items to enable their progression through the warehouse.
The player will be tasked with completing computer work and will have the ability to collect, store, and craft useful items to help them in direct encounters with the entities of the Realmverse. During these frightening encounters, the player will experience two realms stitched together, where a mirrored reality hides in plain sight and the rules are changed.
When immersed within the Realmverse, the player must collect reality fragments to return to their body and continue their investigation; finding a way to stop these otherworldly forces. The Lockridge Industrial Complex is a vast facility full of hidden secrets. Look carefully and you might find evidence and other documents that provides additional insights into the secrets of your new employer. The further you dig, the closer you become to the truth.

title: Data Drift
description:
게임 정보
빠르게 전개되는 탑다운 액션 게임에서 네온과 위험이 가득한 생동감 넘치는 사이버펑크 도시에 푹 빠져 보세요. 시스템을 해킹하고, 기술을 업그레이드하고, 격렬한 전투에서 치명적인 첨단 기술을 갖춘 적과 맞서세요. 눈길을 끄는 애니메이션 영상 스타일과 신스웨이브 사운드트랙을 즐기며 아드레날린이 가득한 미래 세계에 푹 빠져보세요. 이 혼란스러운 디지털 세계에서 살아남는 데 필요한 자질이 있나요?

title: Turret Baffler
description:
게임 정보
In the seedy underbelly of Bailecittà, under the iron fist of the Borflaw corporation, the line between thief and private investigator is as clear as the fog that blankets the streets and factories.
You play as Sadmuc, a freelance “Baffler”. Few of the electronic surveillance systems and safeguards throughout this city can stand up to your custom EMP railgun. But shooting them from a distance doesn’t get you past them. The entire point is that you help somebody else get past.
And when it comes to sniffing around Borflaw's facilities in the sealed-off Bonglesticks area, the only person you can rely on for that is your old partner, Rania. If she can put up with you long enough, you might just be able to get to the heart of whatever Borflaw is up to.
Key Features
Tense, tactical gameplay where success or failure relies on your aim.
Multiple starting locations, allowing you multiple options from which to provide overwatch.
Guards that will not stop searching when they know an intruder is nearby.

title: Vampire Spin
description:
게임 정보
캡처하고, 싸우고, 수집하세요!
전략과 행운이 얽힌 2D 로그라이크 세계에 빠져보세요! 공격을 선택하고, 스핀을 활성화하고, 뱀파이어 생물을 포획하는 동안 적의 파도를 제거하고 군대를 진화시키세요. 모든 결정은 중요합니다. 생물을 업그레이드하시겠습니까, 아니면 다음 레벨에 도달하기 위해 저축하시겠습니까?
전략과 카지노 사이!
로그라이크, RPG
[/b], 카지노 역학의 독특한 혼합 [/ 비], Vampire Spin은 전략적이고 매혹적인 게임플레이에서 적 무리를 상대하는 데 도전합니다. 초자연적인 생물의 군대를 포획하고, 업그레이드하고 제압하세요. 모든 회전이 당신의 운명을 바꿀 수 있습니다!

title: Comet Angel
description:
게임 정보
Izzy and Nat break out of their boring summer routine when they make the discovery of a lifetime: an alien living at the bottom of a nearby pond. The mysterious creature, which they name Faerie, asks them for help returning to its home on a passing comet in exchange for showing the girls their futures. As they search for scrap metal to feed their new celestial friend, Izzy and Nat suddenly realize Faerie's influence is spreading far beyond what they expected. Lost in the purgatory between adolescence and adulthood, they find themselves staring down the long and perilous road to self-acceptance.
Explore the small town of Cold Lake, Michigan as you search for the raw materials Faerie needs to survive, solving puzzles and facing the emotional consequences of Izzy and Nat's discovery. You'll encounter a wide variety of challenges, from wiring puzzles to cryptograms, as you scour abandoned factories and forgotten sheds for precious metals.
What will Izzy and Nat see when they look forward in time?
Key Features
Unique, multi-layered puzzles to solve
Relatable, charming, fully voice acted characters
Complete original soundtrack that invokes the alt-rock spirit of the 1990s
An emotional, heartfelt story with multiple endings

title: The Structureworld: Myths of Skull Island
description:
게임 정보
*Game IS in development, but due to personal circumstances, it takes longer than expected*
Check the Youtube Channel for most recent updates!

Holum Island, Island of Unspeakable Horrors, the Structureworld...... for centuries, stories have been told about an island in the mist. An island of death and despair, only be found by people stuck in the massive storms that threaten this part of the sea.
But there is one name everybody knows: Skull Island.

Jump into this Single Player Hardcore Survival game that lets you explore a new interpretation of Skull Island like you have never seen before!
With building mechanics that let you set traps, build small shelters, gather food and resources, this survival game gives you the freedom to explore and settle on the Coastal Area of Skull Island filled with prehistoric wild life but evolved, dinosaurs and fantasy creatures based on the location of the island.

The game heavily focusses on a semi-open world filled with creatures from big to really small to make it feel more alive.
Each creature has his own place in the ecosystem, with AI focussed on this aspect.
It is possible to overhunt animals(for a short time) because of the spawning system and animals will react to your way of hunting.
The game also features a dynamic weather system that will not only impact the spawnrates of certain animals, but will also result in respawning of resources given to you by the sea.
Sometimes it is better to start running instead of fighting the many hostile animals on the island.
They will crawl from caves, fall from the basalt cliffs, attack you from above and... from carcasses?

The game will also be released with a gore-censor option for youtube(to prevent demonetization).
autokwd: The Structureworld: Myths of Skull Island

title: Welcome to Doll Town
description:
게임 정보
Doll Town is a psychological horror game where players uncover the haunting mystery of a once-thriving village that has been cursed into a twisted, eternal nightmare. You play as a young Japanese student who, upon arriving for a part-time job in a desolate town, becomes ensnared in a macabre world where tragic events endlessly replay and the residents are lifelike dolls made from flesh and bone.

After a panicked boy leads you to the school rooftop, you witness what seems to be a real suicide—a girl, bullied and broken, jumps to her death. Now, you must explore the eerie town, solve twisted puzzles, and face the reanimated memories of the town’s victims—the seven dolls who represent those responsible for the tragedy.

With each doll you confront, you unravel more of the town's dark history. But as you navigate the town’s sinister secrets, you discover that Doll Town is a place where the line between life, death, and doll is blurred, and the real puppet master behind the scenes has much darker intentions. Can you break the cycle of torment, or will you too become a part of the dollhouse forever?

Key Features:
Deep Psychological Horror: Experience a story-driven horror game that combines atmospheric tension with emotional devastation.
Puzzle-Based Exploration: Solve intricate, Saw-like puzzles and unlock the hidden memories of each doll's tragic story to progress.
Cursed Town: Navigate through a hauntingly beautiful but twisted Japanese town, filled with disturbing secrets, lifelike dolls, and dark memories.
Narrative Driven: Unfold the mystery of Mio's death and the seven dolls through immersive storytelling, haunting flashbacks, and heart-wrenching confrontations.
Reenactments and Illusions: Witness surreal and horrifying reenactments of tragic events, never knowing what is real or a product of Doll Town's curse.
Atmospheric Immersion: With no electricity and an abandoned feel, each area is designed to chill with its eerie silence, ambient sounds, and subtle clues.

Doll Town will pull you into a nightmare where the only way out is to solve the twisted riddle behind Mio’s tragic fate. But beware—the deeper you go, the harder it is to distinguish reality from the dollmaker’s cruel illusions.

title: Try 2 Sleep
description:
게임 정보
Description
Try 2 Sleep은 초자연적 영화에서 영감을 받은 캐주얼 소파 협동 공포 게임입니다. 악령이 당신의 집에 침입했습니다. 파트너와 협력하여 밤의 공포에서 살아남으세요!
당신은 좋은 커플입니까? 함께 일하고 완벽한 조화를 이루어야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 살아남지 못할 것입니다. 당신의 연결이 당신의 운명을 결정합니다.
게임 규칙:
집 문제로 인해 잠이 오지 않습니다. 문제를 해결하세요!

title: Twin Stick Heroes 2
description:
게임 정보
Twin Stick Heroes 2 is a top down arena shooter.  Choose from a diverse cast of heroes, and engage in epic battles across a galaxy of exotic planets. This time with new gameplay options an array of new heroes to master, and balance improvements for fair and thrilling combat. Twin Stick Heroes 2 is the sequel you've been waiting for. Are you ready to prove your skills and conquer the cosmos?
             Join the fight today! 
                                        WELCOME TO TWIN STICK COMBAT
