다양한 도시 세금 정책을 자유롭게 조합하여, 좋은 시너지 효과가 나오도록 조세 옵션을 조절해보세요!

주택세, 인구세, 사치품 세금, 극장 공연세, 음악당 공연세, 미술품 거래세, 그리고 자연환경 인접 세금 등의 다양한 특별세를 징수할 수 있습니다.
세금을 징수할 뿐만 아니라, 생산 시설과 산업 시설, 그리고 항구 시설에 보조금을 지급하여 생산 진행을 단축시킬 수도 있습니다.
자금이 충분하지 않을 때에는, 은행에서 대출금을 빌려 보세요!

게임의 경제 시스템은 다양한 요소에서 복합적으로 어우러집니다. 수입과 지출을 파악하는 것은 도시의 재무 업무를 수행하기 위하여 가장 먼저 해야할 일이 됩니다.
도시의 주택 발전 정도에 비하여 세무 행정이 제대로 이루어지고 있는지, 주민세 수입이 충분한지, 성채에서 너무 먼 건물들이 쓸데없이 많은 유지비를 지출시키고 있지는 않은지, 재무 요약 보고서를 통하여 도시의 재정 상황을 파악해보세요!


무역은 도시 전체의 무역 메뉴에서 수출 제안과 수입 제안을 수락하여 진행될 수 있고, 이국적인 사치품으로서, 예를 들어, 후추와 같은 향신료나 찻잎과 같은 진귀한 사치품은, 각 항구 건물마다 수입을 따로 진행할 수 있습니다.


때때로, 수익성이 좋은 특별한 수출 제안이 제시되기도 합니다. 도시가 큰돈을 벌 기회를 놓치지 마세요!



게임에는 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울의 사계절이 존재합니다. 겨울에는 추위가 매서워지고 겨울 자원을 소모하게 됩니다.
따뜻한 날에 충분히 대비하여 놓지 않으면, 한겨울의 혹독한 추위를 이기지 못하고, 도시가 무너질 수도 있습니다!


게임에는 9가지 종교가 등장합니다. 천주교, 개신교, 개혁교회, 주교회, 정교, 그리고 수목신앙, 천문신앙, 배화신앙, 주술신앙이 그것입니다. 이 중에서 원하는 종교를 영지의 국교로 선택하여 지정할 수 있습니다. 각 종교는 고유한 종교 정책과 효과 특성을 가집니다.



어떤 도시 기계공이 모처럼 고안해 낸 활자 인쇄 기술을 지켜내고, 이웃 영지들의 모략과 방해 속에서도, 값비싼 서적을 대량으로 인쇄하여 수출로 큰돈을 벌고, 중세 도시의 만성적인 재정 적자를 해결할 수 있을까요?
역사보다 이른 인쇄기의 발명은, 어떤 사건을 초래하게 될까요? 하나의 이야기는 또 다시 인과가 되어 다른 흥미로운 이야기로 이어집니다.
한편, 향기로운 포도가 가득한 포도의 명산지에서, 특출난 포도잼 기술을 연구 개발하여, 포도잼으로 유명한 도시를 만들어낼 수 있을까요?
대학을 건설하고 각종 연구시설을 개량하여, 학술과 교육 서비스를 수익화하는 데 성공할 수 있을까요?


스테이지 모드에서는, 흥미로운 이야기와 함께 여정이 이어지며 각 스테이지에서 도시를 발전시키고 임무를 수행하게 됩니다.
랜덤 맵 샌드박스 모드에서는, 랜덤 생성되는 자연환경과, 또한 연구 테크트리와 무역 제안과 같은 요소들이 랜덤 생성되는 랜덤 생성 경제환경으로, 각 게임마다 경제적으로 유의미한 톱니바퀴 요소의 전략적 차이가, 의미 있는 창발적이고도 새로운 플레이 경험을 깊이 있게 만들어냅니다.


매 게임 새롭게 달라지는 자연환경과 경제 환경에서는, 그에 맞게 적합한 선택과 집중이 중요합니다. 역동적으로 생성되는 랜덤 생성 테크트리에서, 새로운 상황에 가장 적합한 연구 과제를 선택해보세요!
랜덤 생성 테크트리는 매번 새로운 게임 경험을 선사하며, 경제적으로 최적화되는 선택의 몰입감에 깊이를 더해줍니다.


크라운시티에서 번영하는 중세 도시를 건설해보세요!

title: An Imp and an Imposter
description:
게임 정보
An Imp and an Impostor is an interactive urban fantasy novel by Athar Fikry, author of The Dragon and the Djinn.
You're an undercover imp, serving time for your magical misdeeds by working for Arkan, the division of the city government that investigates magical crimes. Your by-the-book partner doesn't know who you really are - or that your nose for crime is actually a nose for magic. Some of your magic was confiscated when you were sentenced, but you've got enough left to put you above most humans.
Now, just when you were about to recover the rest of your magic, it's gone missing from its vault! You need to track it down - and more importantly, track down the person who took it.
Go on daring heists, cracking open vaults using magic or gadgets. Talk your way past bureaucrats, professors, necromancers, mobsters, afreet, and djinn as you poke into all of the magical and mundane corners of the city, finding things that most people would like to keep hidden.
And pet the world's most adorable undead dog.

title: Astral Hunter: Homebound
description:
게임 정보
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Hello, alien explorers! We are an independent development team of 2 people. We are excited to bring you Astral hunter : Homebound, a fast-paced action RougeLike game.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Build a unique fighting style
Take up arms and fight hordes of enemies

title: The Legend of Pamperlotte
description:
게임 정보
The Legend of Pamperlotte is a tactical RPG with a unique twist: the "Tactical Combo" system! Depending on your character and class, you can have up to three actions per turn that can be anything! You can run to an enemy, hit him and run away! Or hit an enemy, run and take a potion... The more you use an action per turn, the more efficient it becomes. Another unique feature is the "Turn Again" system. If you defeat an enemy, your combo counter refills and you can act all over again and break havoc in the enemy camp! But beware, the enemy has all those same quirks as you do!
Pick your best teams among over 10 classes with 50 different unique skills and techniques. Improve your stats in the skill tree and get to know your teammates with character episodes.
In a world divided among humans, demons and animals, the war is on the verge of breaking out. Follow Hiro and his friends to prevent the catastrophe and bring peace in the Island of Pamperlotte!

title: Uagi-Saba 2
description:
게임 정보
Uagi-Saba 2 is a creature care/breeder sim. Raise cute creatures all with their own brain, genes and unique body parts. Guide them through beautiful hand drawn environments using speech and positive/negative reinforcement. They can learn from experiences, form relationships with other creatures and breed.

Features/Mechanics
Explore
A variety of biomes to explore. Snowy drifts. crystal caves, forgotten mines, magma vents and alien ruins.
Protect
You are the guardian, guide your creatures safely through life. Lead them to water and bring them food. Show them the way to safety and help them avoid danger.
Variety
Every creature is very different from the last. Each can be born with a variety of different body parts and genes. Body, head, ears, horns ,eyes, arms, legs, fur, scales. Color genes can also influence the individual color of body parts, including eyes. The possibilities are endless with hundreds of combinations.
Speak
Learn your creatures native language by looking through old books and scrolls. When fluent you can use commands to influence creature decisions.
Memories
Your creatures will form memories based on objects or locations it spends the most time around. It will even remember other creatures, form relationships and eventually mate.
Learn
Your creatures will learn over time through positive and negative reinforcement and can pass on things they have learned to their offspring.
Evolve
Creatures may evolve differently based on the biomes they spend most time in. Raise your creatures in a cold biome they may evolve fur and form resistance to cold. Raise your creature in a warm arid biome and they may evolve scales and form resistance to heat.
Food And Drink
Your creatures will find a variety of food and drink items in the world, some good and some bad. Water containers, fruits, vegetables, nuts, berries, mushrooms and poisonous plants.

title: Crystal Ball Critters
description:
게임 정보
Roll, jump, ride, glide and fly in this platformer racing game. All from inside a crystal ball!
Unlike most vehicles, a ball does not have a front end; rather, its front end is where its speeding towards!
No need to steer a car back and forth. You can turn around and build up speed in any direction you wish. Racing through platforming sections; even vertically.
Drive masterfully using simple and intuitive controls to keep your speed high with up to 5 strangers or friends.
Crystal Ball Critters features beautiful environments and worlds to race across. Full of original gimmicks and secrets to keep things fresh and stay ahead of the race. All matter of colorful critters competing for recognition from the most evil (actually nicest) villain that the universe has ever had.
All you need is a jumping and rolling to access all of the game's movement. But controlling that movement to its full potential and maintaining your speed flawlessly is an art of its own.
Across the worlds of Crystal Ball Critters, you will encounter Mana Orbs.
Picking one up will give you a burst of speed; giving you an opportunity to turn instantly and change your trajectory, allowing skilled players to make sharp turns without slowing down, and rewarding skill in ways that don't require any strange input or training!
All of it comes naturally by playing.
Perfect for players looking to jump straight into a game without waiting, and also those that want to hone their skill for faster and faster times in the solo modes!
✦ What This Game Is Not

title: 死者还阳Escape from the Underworld
description:
게임 정보
In that era of epidemic, I, who lived alone, could not escape and collapsed alone in the apartment. In a trance, I suddenly found myself in a black and white world, where there were people who gathered here for different reasons, a mysterious girl, and a group of mysteries and demons beyond cognition.
"Work together or kill each other"
The girl gives us hope to return to the human world, but also brings us harsh and frightening conditions. Should we follow our instincts and continue to maintain the kindness of the human world, or do everything for the illusory hope? In this ambiguous "City God's Residence", what is right? What is evil? Everything here has turned into chaos.
"Resurrection" is a suspenseful text adventure game. Players search for the truth of human heart hidden in the puzzles in an alternative Chinese-style fantasy dream woven by Chinese mysticism, religion, and folklore.The gameplay functions of the game are mainly divided into several parts: level options, plot reasoning, level decryption, and map exploration.
autokwd: 死者还阳Escape from the Underworld

description:
게임 정보
Follow me in twitter for news:



Description;

‣  Strategy and planning are the keys when playing Spellbind Tactics, each character has certain set of movements that when used properly can lead to a powerful game plan, every character is designed to support each other in order to achieve effective synergies and movements. Your capacity when executing your game plan and your ability to react to your oponent's will be decisive in order to win.

About the game:

‣ One vs One onlie matchups.

‣  Combine different characters and abilities to unlock powerful effects!

title: Jamir
description:
게임 정보
BASE WARS MODE

3개 팀이 기지전에 참가하여 주발전기에 가장 큰 피해를 준 1개 팀이 주 기지를 장악하고, 선두팀이 다른 2개 팀 앞에서 일정 시간 버틸 수 있으면 기지전이 종료되고 챔피언 팀이 됩니다. 보석으로 수여됩니다. FPP 및 TPP의 두 가지 보기 유형을 기반으로 15, 30, 45, 60 또는 75명의 플레이어 기본 전쟁 경기에 참여할 수 있습니다. 충분한 수의 매치 플레이어가 입장하면 기지 전쟁이 자동으로 시작됩니다.
DEATHMATCH FREE FOR ALL
목표는 라운드당 10분 동안 다른 플레이어를 최대한 많이 죽이는 것입니다. 업그레이드되고 더 강한 플레이어를 죽이면 더 많은 보석을 얻을 수 있습니다.
TEAM DEATHMATCH
목표는 라운드당 10분 동안 다른 팀 플레이어를 최대한 많이 죽이는 것입니다. 업그레이드되고 더 강한 플레이어를 죽이면 더 많은 보석을 얻을 수 있습니다.
SURVIVAL
플레이어가 가능한 한 생물의 파도에서 살아남아야 하는 협동 게임 모드입니다. 3가지 유형의 생물이 있으며 각 유형을 죽이면 파도의 강도에 따라 다른 양의 보석을 얻을 수 있습니다.

title: Godless Lands
description:
게임 정보
This is an adaptation of a board game for two players.
The game takes place on one playing field. In turn with the enemy, you make moves with your cards or use objects. To win the game, you need to destroy the main card (Place of Power) of the enemy. There are no pre-prepared decks here - all cards and items are selected in turn from the general list. Already at the stage of choosing and placing cards, you can get a significant advantage over the enemy by blocking or taking the cards he needs.
All cards in the game (Heroes and Places of Power) have basic characteristics (attack, defense, health) and 2-3 unique skills. Items play a supporting role. They can both enhance the basic parameters of your cards, and inflict direct damage to enemy cards.
For a comfortable game, it is better to start playing with a friend, gradually learning the abilities of different cards and items, their strengths and weaknesses. At the moment, the game has 48 Hero cards, 13 Places of Power cards and more than 80 items and rings.

title: Saturday Super Day
description:
게임 정보
Saturday Super Day is a point and click exploratory choose your own adventure game that was prototyped in PowerPoint.
You play as Bobbi who wakes on a mid 90s Saturday morning with a mission: To reach the computer lab at Scuttlebutt High School and back up an important project before the school servers get wiped for the summer.

Embark on a lovingly handcrafted journey through Olympia WA. That's been packed to the brim with explorable content and characters.

Features:
A vast, mid 90s accurate world to enjoy at your own pace.
Over 30 different environments to explore.
Unique hand-drawn art style based on 90s animation.
Intuitive drag and drop controls.

title: Run Away
description:
게임 정보
제발 저희 매혹적인 공포 게임에 몰두하고, 무서운 비밀을 탐색하고 가창적인 생존 전투에 참여하세요. 당신은 잊혀진 건물을 탐험하게 되며, 각각의 한 걸음이 마지막일 수 있고, 모든 구석마다 무서운 생물이 숨어 있을 수도 있습니다. 예측할 수 없는 상황에 직면하여 어려운 수수께끼를 풀고 생존을 위해 괴물과 싸우세요. 고품질의 그래픽과 현실적인 사운드 효과로 공포와 긴장감의 분위기 속에 몰입하게 될 것입니다. 하지만 주의하세요: 당신이 내리는 각각의 결정은 치명적인 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다. 진정한 도전에 대비하고, 오직 가장 똑똑하고 용감한 사람들만이 생존할 수 있는 준비를 하세요. 당신의 가치, 지혜, 교활함을 보여주며 이 어둠의 세계의 비밀을 밝혀내고 성공적으로 탈출하세요.

title: The Doomed Knight
description:
게임 정보
You are the Doomed Knight. Torn between madness and sanity. You walked the realm of death for thousands of years forgot your own past and identity. But something is wrong in the realm of death. A boy in the world is not allowed to die! The cities of the dead are empty! Souls are being tortured and corrupted. And the black death is preparing something unspeakable! Together with your oldest advisor, the necromicon, the book of the dead, you are out to discover what it is. And maybe even your own past will be uncovered...

This metrodvania inspired game lets you discover an fascinating world full of monsters, secrets and mysteries.

The game offers you:

- 12 giant metroidvania areas
- multiple endings depending on your decisions and gameprogress
- 12 Endbosses and over 60 monsters and creatures
- huge arsenal of items, abilities and equippment
- over 60 souls/characters you can collect
- approximately 20 hours of gameplay
- unique and detailed artstyle

title: Nekopirate
description:
게임 정보

Nekopirate is a story driven action-platformer featuring short challenging levels, colorful graphics and a heartfelt story.



Nina is a nekopirate and the daughter of legendary pirate Bartholomeow Williams. When her father falls ill it is up to Nina to find a cure. But her quest will soon prove to be more challenging than expected, when the only known cure for his illness is a mystical flower known as Lágrima de la Luna.



Explore the Caribbean Sea, Run inside a volcano, find love in an underwater Mermaid City, defeat a giant Rubber Duck, all while trying to escape an island where everything is trying to kill you.



Features:
- Over 40 hand-crafted levels
- 4 different pirate-themed locations
- Fast-paced platforming gameplay
- Unlockable weapons
- Tons of collectables and side quests
- Beautiful artwork
- Giant bosses and mini games
- A funny and emotional story about love and determination

title: BoostHead
description:
게임 정보
Looking for a fun and exciting party game to play with your friends? Look no further than BoostHead! This fast-paced brawler game is all about challenging your friends to see who's the best, with no story to get in the way of the action.

In BoostHead, up to four players can battle it out in a variety of challenging arenas, using a range of special moves and power-ups to gain the upper hand. Whether you're knocking your opponents off the edge of the screen or smashing them with a power-up, there's always something new and exciting happening in BoostHead.

With its intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, BoostHead is the perfect party game for players of all skill levels. Whether you're a seasoned brawler or a newbie just looking to have some fun, BoostHead has something for everyone.

So what are you waiting for? Grab your controllers and get ready to brawl with BoostHead! With its non-stop action and endless variety, this ultimate party game is sure to keep you and your friends entertained for hours on end.

title: Solene's Spin Story
description:
게임 정보
Oh, a shooting star! I wish something would happen...
Solene's Spin Story is an action-puzzle game in which two inseparable stars, Solene and Sélène, set off in search of a shooting star that has struck and injured Sélène. Make your way through increasingly demanding levels with more and more convoluted paths and more and more surprising obstacles to reach the exit!
WARNING: Sélène is injured and must avoid touching anything!
Will you be able to catch up with this nasty shooting star and recover the missing piece of Selene?
Key features
+80 levels full of obstacles (and shortcuts!)
The story told in the form of a drawn tale
Adventure mode with 6 unique and colorful worlds (and a timer! It's up to you to beat the best times!)
A more difficult Challenge mode where the goal is to collect all the “Sun Stickers”, with special gimmicks such as:
A greater orbit for Selene
A ghostly Solene capable of passing through walls
Multiple Moons in different orbits
And much more!
Intuitive handling and short levels for immediate enjoyment

title: Maze Chase
description:
게임 정보
Step into the maze with friends or players worldwide and see who is the ultimate seeker or the most elusive hider. Learn the maze and find the best hiding spots.
Currently, there is only one game mode where a survivor joins the hunters when caught.
Both hiders and seekers can dash.

title: Lobstpurr
description:
게임 정보
This is a clicker game with the following features:
Anti-Auto Clicker
Purr Pass
Secret Codes (Good & Bad)
Cat Customization
Upgrades

Planned Features Include:
Better Menus
3D Experiences

Possible Experiences (may take a long time to implement):
Multiplayer

title: Cattle Hyperdrive
description:
게임 정보
Space Trucking
Cattle Hyperdrive is a space trucking open world game that takes place across the solar system. Fly between on-planet and space destinations with containers in tow. Step out of your ship and interact with locals. Maneuver through space debris while traveling FTL. Engage in the narrative story line, or just complete side missions. Plan trade routes and earn high profits on investments.
The Ship
The game features a physics based ship that interacts with the environment. The ship can enter a warp state for long distance travel, but watch out for asteroid fields. Use the hitch mechanism to attach containers for space trucking delivery.
Space Legs
Hop out of the ship and stretch out your legs. Talk to the locals to unlock side missions and discover the lore. Complete side missions and deliveries to earn money. Find all the easter eggs.

title: Cutie Crowd Control
description:
게임 정보

HERD ANYTHING - you are a hero dog that can herd anything
HILARIOUS WAYS TO DIE - worlds full of dangerous and ridiculous traps
SAVE THE CUTIES - a bunch of cute and too-dumb-to-survive animals
UNLOCK NEW CHARACTERS to play as (Red Panda anyone?)
STREAMER MODE available for all levels - have fun with your audience!
MULTIPLAYER MODES to challenge or co-op with your frens!




Sheep (duh!)
Tractors
Cars!

title: Dinosaurs United
description:
게임 정보
Dinosaurs United is an epic real-time strategy game that challenges you to unite the dinosaurs and save the world from an oncoming comet. As you gather resources, conquer lands, and defeat giant boss enemies, you'll develop advanced technologies and weapons needed to stop the comet and prevent the extinction of all life.

In the age of dinosaurs, one visionary Dino sees a vision of the world being hit by a comet. He unites the dinosaurs around the world to work together and develop a super weapon to destroy the oncoming comet. Along the way, you'll encounter challenges and enemies that will test your strategic skills to the limit.

With a top-down view and heart-pumping gameplay, Dinosaurs United challenges you to race against time to gather resources, unite more dinosaurs, and face the final, epic challenge. Will you rise to the occasion and lead the dinosaurs to victory?

Features include challenging missions, diverse dinosaur units, customizable technologies and weapons, and stunning visuals that bring the prehistoric world to life. With a deep and immersive storyline, Dinosaurs United will keep you on the edge of your seat as you fight to save the world. Are you ready to take on the challenge? Play now and find out!

title: Operation Excision
description:
게임 정보


THE STORY:

Decades after the Great War on Earth, a new world was built on Mars. It was mostly a time of peace, although a cold war was brewing between the Republic of Mars in the Northern Hemisphere, and the Mars Commonwealth in the Southern Hemisphere. Settlers, known as the Mons Gens, had built several colonies around the equator of Mars, forming their own nation-states which had no allegiance to The Republic nor The Commonwealth. Within the past few decades, the largest Mons Gens colony known as Arsia Mons, was abandoned. The Colony’s massive domed cities, built by Atlas Dynamics, would lie uninhabited in the crater for years.



When the Mars Commonwealth spaceport at Pickering was nearly completely destroyed by an old, obsolete Atlas Dynamics construction drone carrying an explosive device, many assumed the Republic of Mars were responsible. But then, long range telemetry picked up dozens of signatures, similar to those of the Atlas Dynamics construction drone, deep below the supposedly abandoned colony at Arsia Mons.

As a Mars Commonwealth Special Forces soldier, your task is to insert into the abandoned Arsia Mons colony, and investigate deep below the surface to find the origin of the signatures and their relation to the bombing of Pickering Spaceport. Bring back any intel you find.

title: QUADREMOR
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by the biggest first person shooters of the 90's and early 2000's, Quadremor brings you back to the classic retro shooting experience you know and love. It's fluid gameplay and unique, dark atmosphere will instantly make you feel at home.
Backstory
In the 23rd century, humanity got so technologically advanced it could colonize other planets of the solar system with ease.
This colonization lead to discoveries of numerous alternative energy sources - which helped with developing first teleporting devices.
People started to explore worlds in other dimensions. They contacted many friendly interdimensional species and gathered a lot of valuable data.
Unfortunately, one of the dimensions proved to be very hostile towards human race.
Monsters killed every member of one of the expeditions, grouped together into a huge army and got into our world through an open portal.
After 2 weeks of fighting, humanity got almost entirely annihilated.
Monsters returned to their homeworld not knowing that you - one of the last human mercenaries and a war veteran - followed them.
Mission
The game takes place in a hostile dimension called Quadremor.
It's a true multiverse full of twisted creatures who want every other race to be either dead or enslaved by them.
You have to find and kill every one of these monsters and make sure that nothing from this dimension will ever get to our world again.
Gameplay
Quadremor is a unique yet familiar first person shooter with an emphasis on dark atmosphere and fluid gameplay.
The game includes multiple weapons, many types of monsters, hand crafted levels, extreme power ups, jump pads, secrets, teleports, and all sorts of good stuff to make your experience as enjoyable as possible.

title: Rogue Tank
description:
게임 정보

Rogue Tank is a chaotic 3D tank shooter with rogue-lite elements. Enter the arena with your trusty tank. It’s time to wreak havoc!
COMBINE DEADLY UPGRADES
Upgrade your tank as you defeat your enemies. Pick upgrades that fit your style of combat. However, choose carefully, as combining the right set of upgrades will turn your tank into an absolute force of destruction.

Bombard enemies with your turret, crash them into deadly arena traps, zap them with lightning, or burn them to a crisp. Destroy your enemies with a diverse set of tools as you dodge incoming attacks.

Unlock new weapons, upgrades, and arenas as you battle. Permanently upgrade your tank to become even stronger!

title: Shells
description:
게임 정보
Shells is a geometry puzzle game about the elegance of nested pieces on a tiny board.
Slide your block into larger shells to rearrange the board and find your way out!
Features:
▪ Simple core mechanics and deep emergent complexity packed into a compact 4x4 grid. Train your brain by challenging your problem solving and spatial reasoning skills!
▪ Gradual difficulty curve featuring over 360 original levels spread across 8 distinct worlds.
▪ Flexible progression structure with multiple levels to choose from at any given point.
▪ Adjust the difficulty to your liking with the optional hint system!
▪ Soothing piano soundtrack accompanied by relaxing sound effects and backgrounds.

title: Zoolovelogy
description:
게임 정보
Pair up all animals with one of their own type to beat each puzzle level
Explore how different animal types, objects, and tiles interact with one another and
Utilize their unique traits to find the optimal solution and earn all 3 stars!
Make and share your own puzzles using Zoolovelogy's handy in-game editor

Features:
Easy to grasp but deep gameplay with many different interactions
Hundreds of levels (100+ on release)
Lots of different animal types, each with their own unique attributes (with more to come!)
Various tiles and objects that differentiate the gameplay
Puzzle editor so that players can create their own custom levels & share them with others

title: Valley of The Old Masters
description:
게임 정보
Since the discovery of the tablet of the Old Masters, the world is in the midst of the winds of change and the future is full of uncertainty. As a wandering artist, your journey takes you to a mystical valley. Will you find inspiration for your art there?

Valley of the Old Masters is an old-school action-adventure game. It features a cryptic world full of secrets to be discovered, a mysterious background story and many challenges and problems to solve.

Wander through a mysterious valley.
Find ancient sketches and paintings. Be inspired by them and draw your own sketches to fill your sketchbook.
Meet other wanderers who are as lost as you are.
Discover the dungeons of the valley full of mysterious and cryptic problems to solve.
Solve the mystery of the Old Masters. Who were they and why have they disappeared?

title: Nameless Bastard
description:
게임 정보
Nameless Bastard is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler. Fast-paced combat, beautiful stylized retro-inspired graphics, rinse-and-repeat progression cycle; we've got it all.
MAKE A NAME FOR YOURSELF
As an adventurer eager to make a name for yourself, you are tasked by the village elder to clear the evil spreading from a nearby dungeon. Fight through the forest and multiple levels of the dungeon to clear the ever-present threat.
UPGRADE IT ALL
Upgrade and enhance various aspects of weapons, spells, character stats, and even the village itself to match your own play style, as you progress through each run, and the game as a whole.
TALES OF THE FORGOTTEN
Adventuring is perilous and many adventurers don't make it. Take a break at the village and listen to larger-than-life songs and tales describing your efforts.
LOOK AT ALL THE PRETTY COLORS
Top it all off with a colorful visual aesthetic, inspired by the games of yore, as well as modern classics.

title: Shotgun Recovery
description:
게임 정보
Life on a knife's edge
The blood on your hands was not worth it, but you can't change that now. Explore Gravdal, a small town with a bad reputation, nested in the shadow of great mountains and rolling hills. Plot with wicked syndicates and grab whatever money you can to fund your escape. It's only a matter of time before the law, or your mind, catches up.
Your own worst enemy
When you're not hiding from police or flashing guns at cashiers; take a moment for self-care. Eat something, take a shower or pop some pills. For when nightmares come alive, preparedness may be the difference between waking up in a cold sweat — or not waking up at all.
Key Features:
Reactive sanity system
Gib-rich combat
A mix of linear and open levels with secrets to discover
Unlockable game mode and weapons

title: Land of Ramchin: Between Dimensions
description:
게임 정보
Overview
In this expansive open-world action role-playing game, you will play as the valiant protagonist, Vico, as you embark on a series of adventures across the sprawling land of Ramchin. Engage in the seamless transitions between multiple dimensions. Through the journey, you will enhance your power and skills through battles and trials and forge your own remarkable tale in this vividly imagined world.

Story
In antiquity, a great flood swept away the dwellings of our ancestors. A giant goat bore the survivors upon its back as they drifted across the endless sea. They journeyed until the ceaseless rain subsided, revealing the once-hidden sky. However, the goat himself transformed into a vast land, with its sinews sculpting towering mountains and its arteries giving life to winding rivers. People call this place the land of Ramchin.

Millenniums later, one day, Vico got lost in a desert and stumbled upon a tram. As he prepared to board, an old man stopped him, warning him that the vehicle was a ghost tram. Subsequently, Vico found himself in a shadowy realm where two infernal messengers sought to capture him. Jolted awake by profound fear, he pondered the unsettling notion that the ghostly tram in his nightmare should appear in the real world!

This marks merely the commencement. We refrain from any more spoilers here, for the allure of this enigmatic fantasy tale is destined to captivate your imagination!

Gameplay

Beyond the abilities to run and swim, players can indulge in paragliding, self-propelled flight, and even mount a dragon to soar across the skies.

A diverse array of of items can be collected, each serving various purposes, facilitating wealth accumulation, investments, and the potential for unexpected robbing encounters. And, engaging in malicious activities in the Land of Ramchin may lead to your incarceration.

The game boasts a sophisticated system encompassing time, weather, banking, public transport, teleportation, quests, achievements, and equipment upgrades. Throughout your journey, a multitude of features ensures a continuous source of enjoyment and exploration.

Fight

In action battle mode, Vico can employ a sword for attacks, wield a shield for defence, and harness skills for additional power. Your equipment can undergo upgrades as you progress through your adventure. Make sure to pay a visit to a Landlord Shrine when you come across one!


Each location is bestowed with a name derived from its origin. For instance, Juhe, which means river in the Manchu language, or Talnotog, translating to plateau in Mongolian. Every unique place holds cultural references to real-world locations.

The protagonist is meticulously crafted to embody the appearance of a seasoned adventurer, with his golden hair colour and iconic red shirt carrying significant meaning within the narrative.


It is strongly recommended that you use a game controller (Xbox controller, PS controller, joysticks) to play.

title: DI: Debt is Inevitable
description:
게임 정보
-= DEATH IS INEVITABLE =-

Each wave will feature larger quantities of enemies, where you must keep a high combo and grab as many coins as you can in order to maximize your profits each round. Memorization of the level's waves and learning each weapon are also key to delaying the inevitable. Reaching the "final" wave will just start it back from the beginning, but even more hectic than before. You cannot escape your demise.
-= DEBT IS INEVITABLE =-

The shop contains everything you need to help you survive, at prices you cannot afford. Here, you can find health, weapons, armor, consumables, powerups, and passive upgrades. Each purchase from the shop increases that item's future prices, so if you're not careful, you may soon find yourself with empty pockets, and a mountain full of debt.
Your deaths and failures in DI will not be in vain, as each run will help you unlock new levels, characters, items, and mechanics that will be available in future runs. Each unlock that you acquire can change the way you play the game dramatically. There's no shortage of things to discover in DI.

title: Neon Death Drop
description:
게임 정보
Explore a futuristic sky-city teeming with glitchy robots in NEON DEATH DROP, an action game about a gay go-go boy who must use his fierce dance moves to save the world.
THE GROUND IS YOUR PLAYGROUND
Manipulate floor tiles by making them move, grow, or even disappear
SLAY THE BOTS DOWN
Defeat enemies by knocking them into pits and watch them drop dead

title: A Bard's Last Song
description:
게임 정보
In "The Bard's Last Song", players take on the roles of three unlikely heroes - Maggie the Mage, Kelly the Knight, and Anwir the Rogue - as they embark on a journey to unite their shattered land. The game begins with Maggie and her father figure, the Bard, on a fateful hike up a mountain. The Bard's sudden death leads to the scattering of his pages across the land, and the trio must recover them in order to restore balance to their world. Each character faces their own unique challenges and enemies as they make their way through twisting forests, dark dungeons, and ruined castles.

Along the way, players will engage in epic battles, solve puzzles, and explore a richly-detailed, hand-drawn world filled with bizarre creatures and hidden secrets. With fast-paced combat, challenging platforming, and a deep, emotionally resonant story, "The Bard's Last Song" is an unforgettable adventure that will keep players hooked until the very end.

If that's not enough then there are also teleporters, gravity fields and marble eaters.

Mind bending Puzzles
Solve nifty puzzles created by our own team or by the community. Use the parts correctly to guide each marble to their goal. An ever increasing level of difficulty makes sure you get in easily and are challenged for a long time.

Defend yourself against the marbles in tower defense mode. Make sure the marbles don't hit the detonation trigger and instead reach the goal.
Choose the right parts to build your deck and use your deck to solve increasingly difficult puzzles in rogue like mode.

title: Galactic Economy

title: Timeless Rain
description:
게임 정보
Play the demo now which features infinite lives for the 'Casual' difficulty setting to help introduce you to the world of Timeless Rain! Please note that this is an exclusive feature for the demo only.
In Timeless Rain you awake within an unknown world which seems to be unbound by the limitations of time. However, only the angelic fiends are able to fully bend the clocks to their will. There are whispers of a place, deep within the Forest of Evocation, which is said to be able to raise someone up to the same capabilities as these monsters, for better or for worse...
During the course of your travels through this world, there is some important information you may want to know. As any other creature who grasps onto their instinct to survive within this hellscape naturally would, you will learn to manipulate time in slight manners. The process will be slow and tedious, but surviving long enough to reach this 'place' is surely going to be worth it... right? Because if not... why not just feed yourself to the devils and demons that inhabit this realm?

Take control of one of the four distinct members of the Rescue Team and make your way through several urban environments, as seen through the lens of an expressive and colorful pixel art, and safely rescue the civilians trapped within natural and man-made disasters.
Systemic speedrun platformer with warm Cyberfunk-inspired visuals seen through grungy but cartoonish pixel-art.
4 playable firefighters with unique abilities. Rescue civilians from burning buildings, natural/artificial disasters.
Find the fastest way to complete each mission, using tools provided: ladders, water buckets, axes to destroy objects blocking the way, and more.
Designed to support high refresh rates (above 60hz)

title: JumpCat
description:
게임 정보
Trapped in limbo. Toyed with for eternity. Escape, or lose your last chance at life.
In JumpCat, you find yourself imprisoned in a haunting limbo ruled by Sadie—a sinister girl with a twisted love for games. She’s trapped you in her dark playground, alongside the eerie residents she’s crafted to entertain her forever. Your only hope? Climb, jump, and outsmart her to reclaim your life. Fail, and you’ll remain her plaything for eternity.
Explore Sadie’s unsettling world, where every shadow holds a secret and every leap brings you closer—or pulls you deeper into despair. Meet her peculiar creations, unravel the truth behind their tragic existence, and search for hidden collectibles that might just hold the key to your freedom.

Key Features
Escape Sadie’s Eternal Trap: Outsmart a sinister child determined to keep you in her nightmarish limbo forever.
Unravel Dark Secrets: Meet haunting residents, uncover their origins, and piece together the story of Sadie’s twisted world.
Climb for Your Life: Navigate challenging vertical levels filled with traps, puzzles, and eerie surprises.
Discover and Collect: Search for hidden artifacts that reveal more about the world—and strengthen your chances of escape.
Solo or (lan) Multiplayer Escape: Face the terror alone, or team up with friends in a frantic race to freedom.
Reclaim your life before it’s too late! Play JumpCat—and jump for your salvation.

title: SORROW: TALES FROM A WORSE WORLD
description:
게임 정보
SORROW is a third person survival game set 2 weeks after the outbreak of a brutal parasitic entity. It follows the perspective of a survivor who has survived the initial chaos, and now has to survive the harsh reality of a American continent after humanity's dominance has been tipped.
Your main objective is to survive by any means possible, including murder. The creatures that you once called a human didn't lose their intelligence, and will be able to flank you, dodge your attacks, and even vault over obstacles you do. However, it is best to remember one thing, nothing lasts forever. Your randomized character will inevitably meet their end.
Features:
multiple towns in different parts of the USA (New Mexico, Texas, Colorado, etc)
randomized interiors for each house/building. no two are the same!
A choice between stealth or action at the start of every playthrough.
Basic survival mechanics alongside a infection meter that fills up when being attacked, don't let it get too high or you'll turn.
Completely randomized characters, you could have a man who was keen on melee one playthrough while another could be better at stealth.
A radio system that chronicles the downfall of civilization
House securing system, barricade windows and block doors to delay the attacks of the creatures. (only on houses in rural areas)
Multiplayer included (peer-2-peer)!
best of all? it's completely FREE!
story mode is planned however won't come until after full release.

title: A Simple Expurriment
description:
게임 정보
- PUBLIC INFO -
Finding herself in space by hitching a ride with the alien who kidnapped her three kittens, a cat mom will have to use all of her feline traits in order to find them as she evades the security systems that keep looking for her.
Fortunately - or not - they're all part of an experiment that aims to understand cats' impressive influence over humans, run by the greedy Toilet Analyst of an even greedier extraterrestrial corporation in his attempt to climb the corporate ladder.
A Simple Expurriment is a combatless metroidvania where stealth is key - no big deal for a cat, specially the three kittens that were genetically upgraded to jump higher, become undetectable and so on. But that's not enough when all the security systems are after the elusive cat mom: that's why she also gets the ability to manipulate sections of the building like pieces of a sliding puzzle, allowing her to move through the depths of the Research Area, the perils of the Maintenance Area, the exclusive VIP Area and the scariest place in the galaxy - the corporate cafeteria.

These things are weird.
They make strange noises. They sleep a lot. They like to defy gravity.
Most importantly, they seem able to make humans do whatever they want.

title: The Continuum
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to The Continuum, a unique stealth-action platformer set in the heart of a high-stakes interstellar conflict. Engage in strategic resource management and platforming challenges as you navigate an ever-changing cosmos to rescue allies and disrupt the formidable Hivemind.
Stealth-action platformer
Make your way through challenging environments utilizing a mix of stealth, combat, and platforming elements. Balance your approach between remaining undetected and engaging with the Hivemind forces only when necessary.
In-depth Resource Management
Manage your resources wisely. Every decision you make, every ally you save, every encounter you engage in, has an impact on your journey. Space and resources are finite, making every choice critical to your mission's success.
Dynamic Hivemind AI
Face the Hivemind, an enemy collective with a unified goal that adapt based on your actions. Learn to understand their behavior, manipulate their perceptions, and use the environment to your advantage.
Engaging Story and Characters
Form alliances with the Abeds, an alien species struggling for survival against the invasion of the almighty Hivemind. Learn their backstories, complete quests, and earn their trust to gain valuable resources and aid in your mission.
High-Tech Gadgets and Alien Abilities
Utilize a variety of high-tech gadgets and harness the unique abilities of your alien allies to gain an edge over the Hivemind. Upgrade your tools and powers to face increasingly formidable challenges.
Strategic Long-Term Planning
Map out your actions based on your understanding of the Hivemind and the broader conflict. Choose when to intervene, when to retreat, and when to make the final strike against the Hivemind's structures or queen.


With its blend of challenging stealth-action platforming, strategic decision-making, and engaging storytelling, The Continuum offers an immersive journey through a universe teetering on the brink of devastation. Can you outsmart the Hivemind and tip the balance of power in your favor?

title: Followers of Krow
description:
게임 정보
The Krow
A strange phenomenon spreads throughout the kingdom. Adventurers and sellswords, suddenly and seemingly at random, as if possessed, start to call themselves "Krow". They immediately venture out to seek danger without any quest or reward. They certainly don't seem to be in control of their own actions, and soon they dissappear as if into thin air never to return.

Select your Krows
You must choose your Krow, they all have different abilities and capabilities, some are strong, some are weak, some have great affinity to magic, others none, perhaps you must make do with weaklings?
Level Up
Teach them abilities as you level them up, equipment and relics can be found by exploring the world, or why not just loot them from the orcs, goblins, trolls and various other monsters you encounter around the world.
To Battle!
Each item you equip automatically acts during combat to provide their benefits. They may be passive or cooldown based. Items may interact with each other in various ways. Your sword may deal 10 damage every 2 seconds, and your shield may block 10 damage every 3 seconds, maybe you find a relic that increases all block values by 5 every time you attack?
Not only swords and shields, it's magic!
The game features numerous weapons and tools to use to defeat your enemies. Whether you wish your Krow to be a sword master, sorcerer, magic swordman... perhaps Followers of Krow will not dissapoint...

title: Death the Guitar
description:

Use "sound" and "electricity" to destroy humans! "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The main character is an electric guitar whose owner was murdered. title: Scrapchasers

A single colony ship sails amongst the stars, its people desperate and courageous. Somewhere in the galaxy waits their new home. But the galaxy is a big and dangerous place. This isn't going to work on the first attempt...

In Scrapchasers, players travel the stars in search of a new star to call home, but they will need more than just their wits to succeed. Ships can be lost, but no attempt is in vain, as the massive colony ship continues its journey undeterred.

Defeat enemy ships to obtain new parts and resources

Brace yourself for an epic challenge as you juggle the art of cooking, the thrill of reckless driving, and the pressure of timely deliveries through bite-sized levels that are sure to get your adrenaline pumping! Jump behind the wheel, fire up the blender, and let the chaos begin!

Test your skills with more than 50 levels of increasing difficulty and challenge.
Beautiful hand-drawn graphics: Immerse yourself in a charming and whimsical world with the game's stunning hand-drawn graphics.
Captivating love story: Follow a heartwarming and engaging story that will make you think and feel.
Steam achievements: Unlock achievements and show off your skills to your friends on Steam.

title: Quantum Cortex
description:
게임 정보
IT IS THE DAWN OF THE 27TH CENTURY.
THE GREED OF MAN HAS MANIFESTED INTO PHYSICAL FORM, TAINTING THE EARTH WITH UNHOLY INFECTION.
SOCIETY HAS COLLAPSED. HUMANITY IS NEAR EXTINCTION.
BUT CORPORATE PROFITS HAVE NEVER BEEN HIGHER!!!!!!
---
Tear through a dark, atmospheric environment at lightning speeds and battle terrifying eldritch creatures in this fast-paced, physics-based metroidvania. Discover the mystery behind civilization’s fall, and rise up against the transhumanist dystopia that took its place.
---
ARSENAL
Abilities are used with the right mouse button. They are versatile and can be used effectively in many situations– be they exploration, travel, or combat. They cost Energy to use. The Energy pool is small, but will recharge automatically over time, or when collecting Blue Orbs. The Energy Meter is located to the right of the crosshair.

title: Within the Unknown
description:
게임 정보
Within the Unknown is a first-person, psychological indie horror game where you regain your memory and relive the trauma from your dark past in a sci-fi simulation.
Synopsis

Upon waking up with no recollection of who you are, explore an abandoned farm to uncover the mysteries behind you and your family. As a human subject, your endurance and sanity will be tested as you experience the nightmares your mind has conjured in this simulation.
Relive flashbacks through tvs showing a car wreck with your daughter and what happened in the cornfield.

There's only one way out of this self-inflicted reality, you must face your fears so you can see them once again.
Gameplay

Core gameplay features crouching, running with stamina with different camera shakes, inventory system with items such as your lighter, keys to unlock areas, and notes from your afflicted wife.

To add some immersion, the lighter will go out when you run and sometimes require a few flicks to ignite. The flashlight you find has the ability to blind the creatures in the cornfield as you search for your daughter.
You can also light candles, reattach mannequin parts, and solve a combination lock.
Estimated play time is roughly 45 mins-1 hour for the first chapter. Chapter 2 is in the works and will hopefully be released in the near future.

Thank you for your interest in my game and good luck!

title: Monster is Me
description:
게임 정보
Calling all monsters!

Prove yourself in "Monster is Me," a rogue-like where you become the architect of destruction in ever-changing, procedurally generated cities. No two cities are the same, but every city is fully destructible! Dive into urban landscapes, teeming with skyscrapers, landmarks, and unsuspecting citizens. From collapsing banks to explosive gas stations, every structure is a potential tool in your path of destruction.
1-4 PLAYER COMPETITIVE CO-OP

Conquer solo or team up with fellow monsters in a race to wreak havoc and establish yourself as the ultimate force of mayhem! Coordinate attacks, strategize, and combine your monstrous powers to lay waste to all humanity. But don't help the other monsters too much, you are each independently scored on your performance. The better your personal score, the stronger you become. Prove once and for all that you are the better monster by scoring higher than anyone on your team!
ESCALATING DYNAMIC MISSIONS

Every play-through, dozens of unique cities await your arrival. Rampage with purpose through each city as you seek to achieve specific missions. These missions include demolishing landmarks, surviving military onslaught, reaching certain destruction levels within a time limit, and more. Each monster is scored independently for each mission. The cities react dynamically to your onslaught with increasing intensity in an attempt to counter your missions. Citizens flee in terror, military scrambles to respond, and massive environmental hazards are unleashed. Will all the monsters survive long enough to achieve all the missions?
LITTLE BIG MONSTERS

Choose from a diverse lineup of gigantic monsters, each with its own special abilities, personal agenda, and tragic backstory. Wield powerful claws, unleash fiery breath, create seismic shock-waves, or charm the humans to do your bidding as you dominate the cityscape. Every monster features 2 unique play styles to choose from when embarking on a new destructive quest. Working on your monster's personal agenda may sidetrack you from achieving the city mission but it will provide boosts to your monster's unique abilities.
MUTATED YOUR WAY

Whether achieving your personal agenda or performing well on city missions, your monster will increase in strength. Each time you increase in strength, you will be presented with rich opportunities to mutate your existing abilities or the option to gain new. These mutations are semi-randomly available but allow you to customize your monster in unique ways each time you play. Mutations will range from enhanced strength to gaining unique traversal options.

With rogue-like gameplay, procedurally generated cities, a variety of monsters, manifold mutation types, and unpredictable multiplayer battles, "Monster is Me" offers limitless replayability. Every game is a new opportunity to showcase your destructive prowess.

Are you ready to unleash the monster within and compete for the crown of chaos? The cityscape awaits your monstrous might in "Monster is Me" – where the only rule is there are no rules in the race to be the ultimate giant monster!

title: The Continuum
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to The Continuum, a unique stealth-action platformer set in the heart of a high-stakes interstellar conflict. Engage in strategic resource management and platforming challenges as you navigate an ever-changing cosmos to rescue allies and disrupt the formidable Hivemind.
Stealth-action platformer
Make your way through challenging environments utilizing a mix of stealth, combat, and platforming elements. Balance your approach between remaining undetected and engaging with the Hivemind forces only when necessary.
In-depth Resource Management
Manage your resources wisely. Every decision you make, every ally you save, every encounter you engage in, has an impact on your journey. Space and resources are finite, making every choice critical to your mission's success.
Dynamic Hivemind AI
Face the Hivemind, an enemy collective with a unified goal that adapt based on your actions. Learn to understand their behavior, manipulate their perceptions, and use the environment to your advantage.
Engaging Story and Characters
Form alliances with the Abeds, an alien species struggling for survival against the invasion of the almighty Hivemind. Learn their backstories, complete quests, and earn their trust to gain valuable resources and aid in your mission.
High-Tech Gadgets and Alien Abilities
Utilize a variety of high-tech gadgets and harness the unique abilities of your alien allies to gain an edge over the Hivemind. Upgrade your tools and powers to face increasingly formidable challenges.
Strategic Long-Term Planning
Map out your actions based on your understanding of the Hivemind and the broader conflict. Choose when to intervene, when to retreat, and when to make the final strike against the Hivemind's structures or queen.


With its blend of challenging stealth-action platforming, strategic decision-making, and engaging storytelling, The Continuum offers an immersive journey through a universe teetering on the brink of devastation. Can you outsmart the Hivemind and tip the balance of power in your favor?

title: Followers of Krow
description:
게임 정보
The Krow
A strange phenomenon spreads throughout the kingdom. Adventurers and sellswords, suddenly and seemingly at random, as if possessed, start to call themselves "Krow". They immediately venture out to seek danger without any quest or reward. They certainly don't seem to be in control of their own actions, and soon they dissappear as if into thin air never to return.

Select your Krows
You must choose your Krow, they all have different abilities and capabilities, some are strong, some are weak, some have great affinity to magic, others none, perhaps you must make do with weaklings?
Level Up
Teach them abilities as you level them up, equipment and relics can be found by exploring the world, or why not just loot them from the orcs, goblins, trolls and various other monsters you encounter around the world.
To Battle!
Each item you equip automatically acts during combat to provide their benefits. They may be passive or cooldown based. Items may interact with each other in various ways. Your sword may deal 10 damage every 2 seconds, and your shield may block 10 damage every 3 seconds, maybe you find a relic that increases all block values by 5 every time you attack?
Not only swords and shields, it's magic!
The game features numerous weapons and tools to use to defeat your enemies. Whether you wish your Krow to be a sword master, sorcerer, magic swordman... perhaps Followers of Krow will not dissapoint...

title: Death the Guitar
description:
게임 정보
Use "sound" and "electricity" to destroy humans! "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The main character is an electric guitar whose owner was murdered. Shake the amp to jump, electrify the floor to activate gimmicks, and destroy all enemies in the room. Experience intuitive controls, hardcore action, and rich guitar sounds!
company: トロヤマイバッテリーズフライド

title: Pallet
description:
게임 정보
                                        

You love puzzle game? 🧩

You think there are not enough games where you can control a living pallet truck? 🏭

Then Pallet is a game for you! 📦

                                        

In this sokoban game, you need to tidy up your warehouse across several dozen of levels. Every puzzle mechanics will challenge your mind, especially if you are a logisitc lover 🧠

Relax yourself with an jazz atmosphere that will accompany you during your journey 🎺

Pallet is currently in active development 💻

title: CULT OF FLIES
description:
게임 정보
As you rush into a panic and dial 9-1-1, the operator begins to speak with you.
"9-1-1, what is your emergency?"
"There is someone outside of my house. I live in Durango, Colorado, just off of Route 550 at 6264 Berkha-"
Your phone line cuts. Your television flickers on, illuminating your face. The Channel 8 logo appears, the reporter starts speaking to the audience:
"A shocking story develops in Durango just off Route 550. A homicide case emerges from the rural home of the Grant family. 13-year-old Dennis Grant was found deceased with several stab wounds to the abdomen and his head nowhere to be seen. A blood trail leading to the basement from the living room shows that he was dragged, even having visible bruises on his ankles. His parents were also found deceased. His mother, Jennifer Grant, hanging by the roof of their front porch with burnt skin, and his father, James Grant, dismembered, scattered throughout the house. Dennis appeared to have tried to call the police, but the intruder cut the phone line just before he could finish giving the operator his address."
Your blood runs cold. You had thought your parents were safe upstairs, and just minutes ago, you had thought you were safe as well. You dare not look out of the peephole at the front door.
CULT OF FLIES is a puzzle horror game set in Durango, Colorado, in the 1980s. You play as a member of the Grant family, a prominent religious chain deeply rooted in the churches around the area. The oldest Grant family member, Bethany Grant, had died. Upon leaving her funeral, you experience several odd occurrences at the Grant residence, leading to a disturbing chain of events.

title: Tales of the Laser Knights
description:
게임 정보
An Epic Journey... Full of Lasers, Explosions, and Ridiculously Good Fun!
Our young hero Zak – who’s certainly not your average farm boy – embarks on a quest to find the Ancient Orbs! These aren’t your average orbs, mind you. No, no – these are REALLY old, REALLY mighty alien gadgets scattered across the five known planets of the galaxy! They’re not just sitting there like some sort of galactic decoration. They’re packed with unimaginable power and the unnecessary complication of making Zak’s life way more difficult than it needs to be.
TALES OF THE LASER KNIGHTS
An Action-Adventure, Comic Sci-Fi B-Movie... with a Seriously Cool Laser Katana!
Controls? Twin-stick shooter style – you attack, you move, you dodge. It's so simple, it practically teaches itself!

title: The Flat
description:
게임 정보
IMMERSE YOURSELF INTO THE WORLD OF THE FLAT
How much can you take, until you snap? The Flat is a first-person action game set within the dark and grotesque walls of Corpo Corporation.
You step into the role of a gray worker, just another cog in the corporate machine. Try to understand the twisted logic that powers this dystopian nightmare and use it to your advantage.
Will you snap? Will you send the boss on a wild goose chase with a fake memo or perhaps 'accidentally' trigger a cascade of events that leads to an office massacre? Your choice, your mayhem.

title: Disclosure
description:
게임 정보
Disclosure is an immersive, first-person horror game set aboard an eerily empty commercial aircraft. You wake up alone mid-flight, with cryptic messages from an unknown source guiding you through a series of supernatural events. Uncover the horrifying truth behind the flight as you navigate the dark, claustrophobic environment, solve intricate puzzles, and avoid unseen dangers. The game blends psychological horror with a gripping narrative inspired by real UFO lore and government conspiracies. Will you survive the terrifying revelations that await you at 30,000 feet?

title: Angry Mother Earth
description:
게임 정보
맞아요. 그녀는 여러분이 그녀의 굴곡진 몸을 망쳐 화가 나 있어요. 이제 도움이 될 만한 무언가를 해 보세요. 그녀를 도와 인류를 없애보세요. 'Angry Mother Earth'에서, 대지의 어머니의 입장에 서서 인류를 없앨 다양한 전략을 구상해보세요. 다른 게임들과 비교할 수 없는 경험이 될 거예요!

배우기는 쉽지만, 마스터하기는 어렵습니다! 여러분은 토네이도, 지진, 허리케인 등과 같은 능력을 사용해 인류가 환경 오염으로 멸망하기 전에 없애야 합니다. 하지만, 게임을 마스터하는 것은 완전히 다른 도전입니다! 여러분에게 피해를 주고 건강 수치에 영향을 주는 산업 구역을 파괴하기 위해 토네이도를 발생시킬 수 있지만, 주의를 기울여야 합니다. 토네이도는 경로에 있는 나무까지 파괴할 수 있는데, 이 나무는 원래대로라면 시간이 지남에 따라 여러분이 받는 피해를 줄여주기 때문입니다.

'Angry Mother Earth'에서, 여러분은 어떻게 인류를 파괴할 것인가에 대한 선택의 기로에 서게 됩니다. 고려해야 할 시나리오들이 몇 가지 있습니다. 만약 농장만을 타겟으로 삼아 식량 공급을 중단하면 어떨까요? 아니면 전력망을 붕괴시킨다면 어떨까요? 그런 행동들이 국가를 전복시킬 수 있을까요? 하지만, 만약 학살이 여러분의 입맛에 맞지 않는다면, 평화적인 접근법을 선택해도 좋습니다. 인류가 환경을 보호하도록 설득하세요.

매 순간마다 진화하는 다이내믹한 시뮬레이션 세계로 빠져보세요. 변화의 바퀴가 돌면서, 이 세계는 기술 발전, 글로벌 이벤트, 요동치는 국가 정책, 그리고 가장 중요한 여러분의 결정에 의해 결정됩니다. 이 복잡한 시뮬레이션에서는 식량, 전력, 서비스, 필수 재화의 공급망이 완벽히 상호 연결되어 있습니다. 하나만 파괴되어도 그 영향은 전체 국가를 관통하니, 이를 활용할 수도 있겠죠.

대지의 어머니, 대지의 아버지, 가이아, 미드가르드가 되어 플레이하세요. 각각의 캐릭터들은 고유의 독특한 능력과 플레이 스타일을 갖고 있답니다! 대지의 어머니는 평화로운 방법을 통해 게임을 진행하는 반면, 대지의 아버지는 그의 눈에 띄는 모든 것들은 없애버리고 싶어 합니다. 가이아는 질병, 바이러스, 전염병으로 인류를 멸망시키는 편인 반면, 미드가르드는 인류에게 다음 빙하기를 선사하고자 하는 편입니다.

다양한 맵을 탐색하세요! 구형 레이아웃과 평평한 지역, 두 개의 서로 다른 맵을 번갈아 가며 전략적 게임 플레이에 빠져보세요. 각 지역은 수행해야 할 도전 과제들을 제시합니다. 적들조차도 지도마다 다르기에, 여러분의 독특한 방법을 사용해야 합니다. 적응력이 관건입니다!

대단한데요! 이렇게까지 스크롤하는 사람은 그리 많지 않은데요. 그 밖에 어떤 것들이 준비되어 있는지 알아보겠습니다.

스스로에게 도전하세요!
쉬움, 보통, 어려움, 악몽의 다양한 난이도 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다. 그리고 숨겨진 레벨까지? 힌트는 산타의 장난꾸러기 목록에 오르지 말라는 겁니다.

확장 가능한 스킬 트리!
각 캐릭터들은 3개의 스킬 트리를 갖고 있으며, 각 13개의 스킬을 보유하고 있습니다. 이를 통해 다양한 전략을 세우고, 몰입하세요.

인류의 반응?
그들을 과소평가하지 마세요. 진심으로, 하지 마세요! 그들은 여러분이 하는 모든 행동에 반응할 것이고, 인간이 가장 잘하는 것을 할 것입니다. 바로 적응과 파괴죠!

역동적인 이벤트, (거의) 끝 없는 가능성!
300개 이상의 이벤트가 있고, 매 게임은 새로운 도전이 됩니다. 인간이 아마존을 위협할 때, 아마존을 보호하기 이해 자원의 방향을 바꿀 것인가요, 아니면 나무를 전부 베어버리게 둘 것인가요? 조심하세요, 나무는 오염을 막아주기 때문에 나무를 사라지게 두는 것은 패배로 이어질 수 있습니다.

title: Hues of the Void
description:
게임 정보
Combining color matching, line defence, and some random puzzle elements, Hues of the Void is a unique and engaging take on the “x-defense” game genre.

Within these prismatic lands, you must defend yourself against the advancing knights of an oppressive theocratic order - The Chromacrusade!
Hone Your Minion Mastery

Charge your portals and release a spectrum of creatures from the Void against the onslaught of the Chromacrusade. Minions such as Slimes, Skeletons, Shades, Gazeblasters and many more are at your disposal. Once a minion has served it's purpose, dismiss them just a readily!
Scheme plots from your Inner Sanctum

Customize your load out of Artefacts, Familars and Friends! Within your Sanctum, fine-tune your menagerie of eldritch horrors and undead monstrosities, and claw your way to victory over the Chromacrusade!

With plenty of summonable monsters to unlock, synergies to uncover and experiment with, your journey is uniquely your own.
Delve into Forbidden Secrets

Follow the trail of the Chromacrusade, right to the very source! Lead your Summoners to victory through Story Mode, following the story of the Prismatic Lands, unlocking more along the way.

As your grand pilgrimage through the Story campaign is complete, dive into endless mode! You can test your most clever combinations and skills against ever-increasing waves of unique and challenging enemies.

The vibrant and colorful world of Hues of the Void offers uniquely challenging gameplay experience.

As a small family team, it's our sincerest hope to provide an entertaining and engrossing game for players of all ages; it will test your skills and keep you engaged throughout many hours of gameplay!

title: Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure
description:
게임 정보


Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure is a captivating 3D puzzle/adventure game where your goal is to guide Lum, a brave light spirit, through a world filled with challenging puzzles and stunning environments. Rotate the levels, think creatively, and solve intricate puzzles to reach the magical purple crystal that hold the key to Lum's journey.
Key Features:

Innovative Puzzle Mechanics: Rotate and manipulate the environment in unique ways to solve puzzles. Each level presents new challenges that require both logic and strategy to overcome.

Four Distinct Chapters: Embark on a journey through 4 beautifully crafted chapters, each with 10 levels, more chapters will be available as we go on. Every chapter introduces its own unique visual style and puzzle elements, ensuring that no two levels are the same.

Visually Stunning Environments: Explore a world where every chapter has a distinct look and feel, from mystical nature to ancient ruins, each rendered in a vibrant and enchanting art style.

Immersive Audio Experience: Enjoy a captivating soundtrack and sound effects that enhance the gameplay and draw you deeper into Lum's world. The music sets the mood perfectly, whether you're deep in thought or celebrating a hard-earned victory.

Challenging and Rewarding Gameplay: Test your puzzle-solving skills with a variety of intricate puzzles. The satisfaction of figuring out each level is matched only by the excitement of discovering what lies ahead.

Can you help Lum collect all the crystals and unlock the mysteries of this enchanted world? Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure offers hours of engaging gameplay for puzzle enthusiasts and adventure lovers alike. Start your journey today!

title: Candy Bandits
description:
게임 정보
Candy Bandits is a thrilling 3D top-down multiplayer party game where Guardians and Bandits face off in chaotic team battles! Equip a mix of passive and active abilities, collect powerful one-time actions from action boxes and strategize with your teammates to outsmart the competition.
Your goal? Collect 30 candies to secure victory or stop the enemy team by catching them—teamwork, quick thinking, and clever tactics are your keys to triumph!"

Will you be a Guardian, defending the precious candies scattered across different landscapes, or will you embrace the life of a Bandit set on stealing these delicious treasures?
Actions: Grab one of many action boxes scattered around the maps and use the unique effects to your and your teams advantage!
Actions vary from simple dashes to more complex team-based actions like laying bombs and blinding your enemies!

title: Plinio Needs a Hand
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a charming and whimsical world, where physics bends to its own rules, and a quirky family of slimes embarks on a journey through five extraordinary levels. In a realm where the surreal becomes routine, meet the slime adventurer family: a robust green father, a delicate pink mother, and a lighter-than-air daughter in soft shades of pink. They've conquered every nook of this peculiar universe, from the foundations to unexplored heights.

Yet, a fateful day turns their journey into an exciting saga. Returning home, a malevolent creature cuts the bridge connecting levels, causing the father slime to plummet to the lowest tier. Desperate to reunite with his beloved family, he stands at the edge of an impassable precipice.

This is where players step in, summoned to guide our slime hero through intriguing challenges using the magic of our hands. Manipulate boxes, unravel puzzles, and forge a path through each level as the captivating narrative unfolds.

Game Features:
🌈 Surreal World: Explore vibrant levels filled with surprises, where each layer unveils new challenges and wonders.
🤯 Innovative Puzzles: Master the art of manipulating boxes controlled by your hand to create passages through intriguing obstacles.
👾 Malevolent Creatures: Encounter and interact with unfriendly creatures whose mission is to hinder our hero.
👪 Family Bonds: Immerse yourself in the exciting story of a slime family, gathering them and overcoming challenges to restore harmony.
💡 Fun and Challenging Physics: Test your skills with a unique game mechanic that challenges the laws of physics in unexpected and stimulating ways.

Get ready for a unique and unforgettable adventure, where your dexterity and imagination are the keys to reuniting this adorable family. Embark now on a journey of puzzles and discoveries in a world where even the simplest slimes can become extraordinary heroes.

title: To The Hall Of The Mountain King
description:
게임 정보
GAME IS STILL IN EARLY DEVELOPMENT!




Setting: A parallel medieval fantasy universe where women can choose their spouses freely. Olivia, having chosen Vlad over the King, faces the King's wrath as he kidnaps their cat, Dimitrije.
Main Characters:
- Olivia: The brave protagonist who chose Vlad as her partner over the King.
- Vlad: Olivia’s partner, a skilled swordsman dedicated to rescuing Dimitrije.
- Mate: Olivia and Vlad’s roommate, providing support on their quest.
Plot Summary: Olivia, Vlad, and their roommate Mate embark on a not-so-secret mission to rescue Dimitrije from the King and seek revenge. The townsfolk are aware of their mission and support them by giving quests. Failure to complete these quests decreases a public secret meter, leading to attacks from the King's soldiers.




Core Objectives:
Players control Olivia, Vlad, and Mate to rescue Dimitrije and overthrow the King of the Seasons.

Key Features:
Hack and Slash Combat: Players face various enemies using combat skills to survive.
Platforming Challenges: Includes obstacles like jumping and crawling.
Adventure Story: A deep, emotional narrative with Kafkaesque twists and satirical humor.
Diverse Enemies: From guards to monsters, each with unique challenges and tactics.
Revenge and Rescue: Players encounter moral dilemmas while solving problems.

Game Mechanics:
Completing quests for townsfolk prevents the depletion of the public secret meter.
Choices impact gameplay; for example, choosing to help a pig or a farmer results in different outcomes and challenges.
Players earn "Threat" points based on their actions, affecting their rank and unlocking stronger attacks, better defense, more health, or faster movement.

Multiplayer Mode:
Online multiplayer includes free-for-all and team battle modes with specialized maps.




Overall Environment:
- The game is set on a large medieval fantasy island with villages, cities, forests, mountains, coastlines, rocky and swampy areas, and underground caves.
- Divided into four seasons: Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter, each with three main levels and a boss battle, totaling 17 single-player levels and 21 levels including multiplayer maps.
Single-Player Mode:
- Spring: Introduction and basic missions, escalating to challenging battles.
- Summer: Increasing difficulty with new characters and quests.
- Autumn: Complex levels with enchanted environments and mystical characters.
- Winter: Final challenges leading to the ultimate battle with the King.
Example Levels:
- Spring Level 1: Basic tutorial to learn controls and mechanics.
- Summer Level 2: Helping magical beings and solving elemental puzzles.
- Autumn Level 3: Navigating a magical forest and defeating enchanted guardians.

title: October Nightmares | Cauchemars d'octobre
description:
게임 정보
October 16, 1970. The Canadian army patrols the streets of Montréal. They are looking for a British diplomat and the Deputy Premier, both kidnapped by the Front de Libération du Québec. At first light, the Canadian government suspended everyone's individual freedoms. Hundreds of arbitrary arrests are made. They are arresting artists, left-wing intellectuals, unionists and activists for national independence. An operation of political repression is underway. Fear reigns in Québec.

Petit-Cartier, a working-class neighborhood in Montréal, lives in anguish. Several members of their community were arrested. Further arrests are feared. In addition, a possibly supernatural phenomenon occurs. The nights of the residents are inhabited by recurring nightmares. Nightmares so vivid, so real, they possess their bodies all day long. An old man, sane the day before, woke up completely mad. Two people vanished in the middle of the night. To find her brother, Hélène must investigate the phenomenon and dive into the depths of nightmares.

October Nightmares is a first-person point-and-click video game. The game is experienced in a day and night cycle that is spread over several days. From morning to dusk, you move through a neighborhood that you can explore freely to unearth its secrets. The main objective is to identify the last victim of the Snatcher, an otherworldly creature, among the residents. Armed with your camera, you must investigate the neighborhood for signs of its passage. When night falls, you can access the world dreams, a dark world that mixes horror with puzzle solving. Over the nights, you must explore the confines of this world to follow in the footsteps of the Snatcher and, perhaps, discover the terrible fate reserved for those who have been taken.

October Nightmares is a cosmic horror game. The inspiration comes mainly from the work of H.P Lovecraft, more precisely his Dream Cycle. Lovecraft is the author who introduced me to horror literature about twenty years ago with The Whisperer in the Darkness. Reading this novella opened the doors for me to all of his writings, but also those of Edgar Allan Poe, Guy de Maupassant, and other writers of the genre. However, October Nightmares is not an adaptation of a Lovecraft short story. I freely draw my inspiration from Lovecraft's conception of the world of dreams to create the universe of the game. You are going to live a story that is essentially Lovecraftian which takes up the main themes of Lovecraft's work.

Features:
A gripping story about fear.
Realistic and dynamic environments.
360° panoramic viewing

title: Rise Of The Overseer
description:

Rise Of The Overseer

It isn't easy getting on with participating in your latest game when the morally and ethically bankrupt Overseer of the game keeps disturbing you, or threatening to vaporise you every 5 minutes. And how did you even get here in the first place?

The Overseer is a sokoban/multiban adventure puzzle game set in science fiction world of the Overseer Corporation Gaming Centre, where The Overseer helpfully guides you and your faithful RoboBuddy through a series of game challenges.

It is strictly forbidden by The Overseer to leave the boundaries of the game, but what's the worst that could happen if you do leave when you find the opportunity?

Along the way you may encounter other friendly AI systems and members of staff. You may even unravel the events that led up to the start of your game and follow the fate of humanity on Galactic News as sinister events related to the Rise Of The Overseer unfold across the galaxy.

Introduction and Disclaimer by the Overseer Corporation CEO

Congratulations on purchasing your Overseer Corporation Mind-Forge brain implant, game Participant! As CEO of the Overseer Corporation, I am so very proud of the efforts of the development team who have truly invested their lives to reach this point! This is truly the sort of advance in gaming that has the capability to change humanity itself and has the added bonus of increasing shareholder and investor value and happiness. As the sole shareholder and investor in the Overseer Corporation, I am indeed increasingly very happy!

But of course, that is merely a happy side-effect of the release of our latest product. On a side note, The Overseer AI System will seamlessly guide your way smoothly through your game, so much that we guarantee it will become an integral part of your life. It is expertly designed for your enjoyment, health and wellbeing.

As we all know, pleasurable gaming is a serious business. And The Overseer is a complicated and flexible AI system, trained on approximately 9.7 trillion gazillion data points harvested from an incredible variety of sources.

As a result, from time to time, The Overseer may come across as unintentionally humorous, self-parodying, prone to satirical episodes and other such amusing features, as the system training included a wide range of British humour, humour from across the Galaxy, and even the depths of American humour. This should naturally be treated as an integral part of your Overseer experience.

We all know that as AI systems increase in our lives, we all wonder; how reliable are they? How safe are they? Well, as CEO of the Overseer Corporation, I can assure you that The Overseer AI System has been designed with intrinsic safeguards in place, including moral and ethical safety features, all designed to ensure the system is safe for use by humans. By design, the worst damage that The Overseer could occasionally is related to the dubious quality of jokes, humour and poetry.

So sit back, wait for your implant to integrate itself into your brain, and enjoy your game!

title: Climbing Back to the Mothership
description:
게임 정보
Game Introduction:
Climbing Back to the Mothership might look like a typical 2D platformer.
But using "seems" to describe the genre feels a bit inaccurate. After thorough research, we found that the surveyor in the game can't actually jump because he's unconscious. He can't jump, and he can't move on his own. The core mechanic of the game revolves around using the grappling hook on the surveyor's arm to move around.
From feet to hands, from jumping to grappling, from nothing to something.
So, Climbing Back to the Mothership is a 2D platform drag-and-pull game.

Thank you for your interest in my game
This page's content has been polished by GPT for localization.
The trailer features an older version of the content, but the core remains the same.
We will refine all related content before the game's release. Thank you for your understanding and look forward to it.
Game Features:
Play as a damaged grappling hook.
Climb from the depths all the way back to the mothership.
Friendly little robots help soothe your emotions when you fall back to the start.
Use your starting skills to increase your margin for error.
Hidden safety measures prevent severe falls, if you can find them.
Picturesque landscapes reminiscent of pixel art.
Fragmented storyline scattered across the map.
Many small robots accidentally dropped, each offering you surprises.
Restarting makes you stronger, or might make you explode with frustration.
Don't worry about breaking the grappling hook; it's out of warranty anyway.




The scientific exploration ship "Lumen Dust" encountered a distress signal from an unknown planet during its return journey. According to the Interstellar Universal Convention's principle of nearest rescue, the captain decided to send personnel to the planet for a rescue mission.
11:47 FST (Fleet Standard Time), the evaluation report returned by the unmanned probe indicated that the comprehensive indicators of the planet met the safe landing standards.
12:02 FST, the surveyors piloted their scout shuttles and successively landed on the planet's surface, while the mothership remained in a low orbit.
12:07 FST, the mothership broadcasted a full-band evacuation signal.
12:12 FST, still no response.
...
12:03 FST, scout shuttle S23A lost control for unknown reasons and began to rapidly descend. Before crashing, the life support system automatically ejected the pilot.
But the misfortunes didn't stop there. The ejected surveyor collided at high speed with an unexpected obstacle in the air, causing the parachute system to go offline. The surveyor then free-fell uncontrollably, and despite the strong protection of the exploration suit, the impact couldn't be entirely mitigated. The grappling hook device "XiaoShouGong No.73" (distributed AI robot, player's perspective), installed on the surveyor's right arm, also suffered some damage.
After landing and becoming stationary, XiaoShouGong No.73 began a self-check. It quickly discovered that the life signs monitor connection had failed, and the surveyor showed no physical response. Following standard procedures, No.73 took over most control functions.
12:07 FST, No.73 received the mothership's evacuation signal but couldn't respond due to a malfunctioning transmission module. Therefore, No.73 initiated an emergency plan to evacuate the surveyor from the scene instead of waiting for rescue.
Just as XiaoShouGong No.73 was about to move, it stopped dead in its tracks.
During the initial self-check, besides the transmission module, No.73 also confirmed that the ranging module and motion sensors were damaged. Thus, its main mode of movement was manual calculation via algorithm. However, due to the surveyor's previous incorrect settings, the safety oversight protocol couldn't be fully disabled and continued to interfere with the algorithm. What seemed like a controlled landing was actually an even more uncontrollable plunge to the bottom.
