title: Arc Tracker
description:
게임 정보
Arc Tracker
Arc Tracker는 주인공 "A.T."를 원궤도를 따라 움직여 다양한 장애물들을 피하고, 코인을 획득하고, 목표지점에 도달하는 게임입니다.
최소한의 오브젝트와 UI를 적용한 미니멀한 그래픽, 편안한 사운드로 몰입감 있는 플레이 경험을 제공합니다.
다양한 구조의 레벨이 제공되며, 업데이트를 통해 지속적으로 추가할 예정입니다.
주요 목표
Arc Tracker의 주요 목표는 최소한의 조작으로 레벨을 완료하는 것입니다.
따라서 각 레벨마다 퍼펙트 클리어를 위한 기준 조작횟수가 부여되어 있으며, 해당 기준 이하의 조작횟수로 레벨을 완료하면 퍼펙트 클리어 판정을 받습니다.
퍼펙트 클리어 판정을 받지 못하더라도 레벨을 완료하기만 하면 다음 레벨로 진행 가능합니다. 이전 레벨로 언제든 되돌아와 퍼펙트 클리어를 위한 재도전을 할 수 있습니다.
A.T.의 움직임
A.T.는 윈궤도라는 단 하나의 규칙만을 따라 움직입니다. 조이스틱이나 방향키는 사용되지 않습니다.
궤도의 중심과 이동 방향을 지정해주면, A.T.는 정해진 원궤도를 따라 자동으로 이동합니다.
레벨의 난이도에 따라 궤도와 이동방향을 바꿔가며 조금 더 복잡한 플레이를 할 수도 있습니다.
조작법
궤도 중심은 마우스로 지정합니다. 클릭 또는 드래그로 궤도중심의 위치를 조절할 수 있습니다.
경우에 따라 궤도 중심의 위치를 더 정밀하게 조절해야 할 필요가 있습니다. 이를 위해 마우스 포인터 주변을 확대하여 보여주는 돋보기 옵션이 기본적으로 활성화되어 있습니다. 메뉴 화면으로 이동하여 이 옵션을 해제하거나 재설정할 수 있습니다.
이동 방향은 화면에 표시되는 UI버튼을 직접 클릭하거나 키보드의 A/D키를 사용하여 지정합니다.
플레이 모드
Arc Tracker는 BASIC, AUTO, DYNAMIC이라는 세 가지 플레이 모드를 제공합니다.
BASIC: 조작 난이도가 쉬운 모드입니다. 원궤도를 따라 움직이던 A.T.는 다음 궤도와 방향을 지정하는 동안에는 정지한 채 다음 움직임을 기다립니다. 게임을 처음 실행할 때에는 이 모드로 자동 지정되어 있습니다.
AUTO: BASIC모드와 동일한 레벨을 공유하고 조작방식이 유사하나, 유일한 차이점은 한 번 움직이기 시작한 A.T.는 장애물에 부딪히거나 목표지점에 도달하기 전까지 절대 정지하지 않는다는 것입니다. 다음 궤도를 지정하는 동안에도 A.T.는 계속 움직이며, 따라서 레벨을 풀어내는 과정에서 궤도를 옮겨 타는 타이밍을 함께 고려해야 하므로 BASIC모드에 비해 조작 난이도가 높습니다.
DYNAMIC: BASIC 및 AUTO모드와는 조작방식이 근본적으로 다릅니다. 드래그 동작으로 궤도중심을 실시간으로 변경할 수 있으며, A.T.는 계속해서 바뀌는 궤도를 따라가므로 원형이 아닌 다른 궤적을 그릴 수 있습니다. BASIC 및 AUTO 모드와는 별개의 레벨이 제공되고, 조작 난이도가 가장 높습니다.
Arc Tracker는 미니멀한 분위기 속에서 게임의 로직 그 자체에 집중하는 것을 추구합니다. 원궤도라는 단 하나의 규칙을 기반으로 하는 다양한 플레이 모드와 레벨들은 때로는 머리를 쓰는 퍼즐로, 때로는 고난도의 컨트롤 실력이 필요한 도전과제로, 때로는 심심풀이 땅콩이나 멋진 눈요기로 다가올 것입니다.

A.T.의 독특한 조작법은 적응하기는 쉽지만, 마스터하기는 어렵습니다. 올 퍼펙트 클리어에 도전해보는 건 어떨까요?

title: Ashcroft
description:
게임 정보
It's 7 o'clock on a friday night. There's 600,000 zombies between you and the city limits. You've got one hour, before a nuclear bomb hits, turning the city and everything in it to ash.

Ashcroft is a Metroidvania inspired Platform Fighter in which you must fight against both time and zombies in a mad dash through city of Ashcroft, rescuing as many of your friends and family as possible, while punching as many zombies as physically possible.

Play as a variety of different characters, each with their own personality, fighting style and special moves, and fight (or sneak) your way through the diverse locations that make up the city - from Downtown Ashcroft to the Iron Works, then back to Suburban Hell and even the amusement park "Paulie's Pier".

Ashcroft features high intensity combat, acrobatic platforming, and all the zombies you can punch. There's a riveting Story Mode, a deadly and ultra-challenging Survival Mode, a local versus mode to challenge yourself vs computers or other players, it's got, more zombies than you can punch, and a handful of unique and fun characters to survive the apocalypse with. Plus, it's fully co-operative, so you and your friends can escape the city together!

Your goal? Collect 30 candies to secure victory or stop the enemy team by catching them—teamwork, quick thinking, and clever tactics are your keys to triumph!"

Will you be a Guardian, defending the precious candies scattered across different landscapes, or will you embrace the life of a Bandit set on stealing these delicious treasures?

title: Plinio Needs a Hand
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a charming and whimsical world, where physics bends to its own rules, and a quirky family of slimes embarks on a journey through five extraordinary levels. In a realm where the surreal becomes routine, meet the slime adventurer family: a robust green father, a delicate pink mother, and a lighter-than-air daughter in soft shades of pink. They've conquered every nook of this peculiar universe, from the foundations to unexplored heights.

Yet, a fateful day turns their journey into an exciting saga. Returning home, a malevolent creature cuts the bridge connecting levels, causing the father slime to plummet to the lowest tier. Desperate to reunite with his beloved family, he stands at the edge of an impassable precipice.

This is where players step in, summoned to guide our slime hero through intriguing challenges using the magic of our hands. Manipulate boxes, unravel puzzles, and forge a path through each level as the captivating narrative unfolds.

Game Features:
🌈 Surreal World: Explore vibrant levels filled with surprises, where each layer unveils new challenges and wonders.
🤯 Innovative Puzzles: Master the art of manipulating boxes controlled by your hand to create passages through intriguing obstacles.
👾 Malevolent Creatures: Encounter and interact with unfriendly creatures whose mission is to hinder our hero.
👪 Family Bonds: Immerse yourself in the exciting story of a slime family, gathering them and overcoming challenges to restore harmony.
💡 Fun and Challenging Physics: Test your skills with a unique game mechanic that challenges the laws of physics in unexpected and stimulating ways.

Get ready for a unique and unforgettable adventure, where your dexterity and imagination are the keys to reuniting this adorable family. Embark now on a journey of puzzles and discoveries in a world where even the simplest slimes can become extraordinary heroes.

title: To The Hall Of The Mountain King
description:
게임 정보
GAME IS STILL IN EARLY DEVELOPMENT!




Setting: A parallel medieval fantasy universe where women can choose their spouses freely. Olivia, having chosen Vlad over the King, faces the King's wrath as he kidnaps their cat, Dimitrije.
Main Characters:
- Olivia: The brave protagonist who chose Vlad as her partner over the King.
- Vlad: Olivia’s partner, a skilled swordsman dedicated to rescuing Dimitrije.
- Mate: Olivia and Vlad’s roommate, providing support on their quest.
Plot Summary: Olivia, Vlad, and their roommate Mate embark on a not-so-secret mission to rescue Dimitrije from the King and seek revenge. The townsfolk are aware of their mission and support them by giving quests. Failure to complete these quests decreases a public secret meter, leading to attacks from the King's soldiers.




Core Objectives:
Players control Olivia, Vlad, and Mate to rescue Dimitrije and overthrow the King of the Seasons.

Key Features:
Hack and Slash Combat: Players face various enemies using combat skills to survive.
Platforming Challenges: Includes obstacles like jumping and crawling.
Adventure Story: A deep, emotional narrative with Kafkaesque twists and satirical humor.
Diverse Enemies: From guards to monsters, each with unique challenges and tactics.
Revenge and Rescue: Players encounter moral dilemmas while solving problems.

Game Mechanics:
Completing quests for townsfolk prevents the depletion of the public secret meter.
Choices impact gameplay; for example, choosing to help a pig or a farmer results in different outcomes and challenges.
Players earn "Threat" points based on their actions, affecting their rank and unlocking stronger attacks, better defense, more health, or faster movement.

Multiplayer Mode:
Online multiplayer includes free-for-all and team battle modes with specialized maps.




Overall Environment:
- The game is set on a large medieval fantasy island with villages, cities, forests, mountains, coastlines, rocky and swampy areas, and underground caves.
- Divided into four seasons: Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter, each with three main levels and a boss battle, totaling 17 single-player levels and 21 levels including multiplayer maps.
Single-Player Mode:
- Spring: Introduction and basic missions, escalating to challenging battles.
- Summer: Increasing difficulty with new characters and quests.
- Autumn: Complex levels with enchanted environments and mystical characters.
- Winter: Final challenges leading to the ultimate battle with the King.
Example Levels:
- Spring Level 1: Basic tutorial to learn controls and mechanics.
- Summer Level 2: Helping magical beings and solving elemental puzzles.
- Autumn Level 3: Navigating a magical forest and defeating enchanted guardians.
- Winter Level 4: Final confrontation with the King, involving strategic combat and rescue missions.

title: Neon Net
description:
게임 정보
The gameplay follows the rules of the "Minesweeper" game, but does not stop the game when a player opens a "mine", it only imposes a time penalty. Since the goal is to complete a task within a certain time (usually finding "keys"), and not just to open all the cells, it makes the game more dynamic, forcing the player to take risks, and challenges the players' quick decision-making skills.

RPG elements create progression and allow you to customize the game to your style - the player can improve both the effectiveness of certain skills and reduce the penalties for using them.

One of the mechanics is also the search for "targets" and the correct use of their finances - to find higher-ranking criminal AIs, the player needs to improve their systems at the right time and choose the most "profitable" targets.

The game also has a storyline, during which the player will choose certain answers that will affect the outcome of the story.

title: Overthrone
description:
게임 정보
HEXAFLIP is a gripping strategy game that blends the classic sensibilities of tabletop strategy with the vibrant energy of a digital board game. Whether your prefer to outsmart other players in PvP skirmishes, or you like to obsess over optimal strategies in the campaign mode, this is a game for you!
Key Mechanics
Charge and Capacity. Each hexagon has a capacity (think of it as it's health), and charge. The charge represents the damage potential of a hexagon, or the number of nearby enemy hexagons it can zap.
Recharging. Using up charge makes the hexagons potentially less effective in future turns. But every time you use up all the charge on a hexagon, it triggers a recharge of all your hexagons. Plan your attacks wisely and create a satisfying recharge loop.
Special Abilities. Multiple special abilities are available (and more will be added). These abilities can spice up the dynamics in the game and take your plays to the next level! Special abilities require unstable charge to operate.
Unstable Charge. Unstable charge will gather on enemy hexagons. You need to zap the hexagons containing it to pick it up. At the end of each turn, the unstable charges migrate on the board challenging you to adapt on the spot.
Game Modes
Campaign: Single-player mode where you try to clear the map in as few turns as possible.
PVP: Play against other players on symmetrical maps. Choose your special abilities wisely and rank up on the ladder.
Daily Challenge: A single-player mode where a new unique map is released every day and all players compete to solve it as quick and as efficient as possible.
Abilities
ZAP
This is the normal attack. Activate a hexagon you control to zap nearby enemy and neutral hexagons.



This is a single-use ability. It upgrades any hexagon on the map to 6 capacity and 6 charge.



This is a single-use ability. It demotes any hexagon on the map to 1 capacity and 1 charge.



Permanently flip the owner of any hexagon on the map. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Place a retaliation rod on any hexagon. When that hexagon is attacked it will attack back. Up to 6 retaliation rods may be placed on a single hexagon. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Performs a more powerful, frenzied, attack from any hexagon you own. For each charge two attacks will be performed. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Infiltrate an enemy hexagon and perform an attack from it as if it were yours. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.

title: VariVaRevenge
description:
게임 정보
This is new type of game, which is combined bullet-hell and 2D-acton.
Players dodge or parry the bullets, and attack the enemy directly.
The key to victory is to use enemy bullets to earn combos and inflict massive damage on the enemy.
Find your own unique strategy by getting creative with your equipment as well!
Action
By using attack and guard, you can parry the bullets that the enemy fires.
Red bullets can be parried by attack only, and blue bullets can be parried by guard only. White bullets can only be dodged.
When you parry, your combos will increase and your attack power will be buffed.
Gear
Equipping gear gives you special effects. Equip gear according to your play style and attack your enemies.

title: Oathborne
description:
게임 정보
You are an Oathborne, one of the last guardians of the realm, sent to the world to defeat the darkness and restore the light in men. Explore and unlock the overworld by delving deep into dungeons, hacking through hordes of enemies, completing puzzles, and destroying "the monoliths". The monoliths give the enemies in each region their power and keep what would be good men in bondage. Destroying a monolith will open up more of the overworld for you to explore. As you progress through the game, you will unlock new skills that you will be able to use in your adventure. Choose from a greatsword wielding paladin, magic weaving mage, or an agile arrow slinging ranger. Will you traverse a world devastated by the wicked one? Will you survive long enough to destroy the monoliths? The bigger question, will you restore the light in men? For all is already written, it is but your destiny to fortify the vigor once lost in your fellow man.
Features
Use a deep hack and slash combat system to mow down mobs of enemies
Unlock skills and use weapon combos to defeat monolith bosses
Roguelike elements with checkpoints to save your playthrough
Intuitive puzzles and dungeon traps to stagnate your progress
Choose from 3 classes with different weapons and skills

title: Hell's Scream
description:
게임 정보
Hell is waiting for you!

Go back in time with an old school shooter game.

title: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress
description:
게임 정보
Fight back against the powerful wizard who has captured your village under his spell.

Battle your way into his ever-shifting towers and tangle with his minions. Drag treasures from the halls to build your strength. And finally, take the fight to the wizard himself to set your village free.

The castle is always similar but never the same, can you find the way and complete your siege of the shifting fortress?


Optimize your hero for close-quarters combat, long-range assaults, or magical dominance. Do you shoot a Bow, or prefer the balance of a Sword and Shield? How about the raw damage of a Great Sword or the brute force of a Warhammer? Mix and match weapons and abilities to create a combat style tailored to you. Experiment with different builds, each offering distinct advantages and tactical options. Choose your style, master your weapons and select abilities that will allow you to dominate your foes.


Master elemental magic to inflict status effects such as freeze, burn, and poison on your enemies. Ice spells slow and eventually freeze them. Once frozen, focus on other threats as they slowly thaw, or shatter them with a physical attack for bonus damage. Use the raw power of Fire to damage and eventually set your enemies ablaze for high damage over time. Poison spells will weaken your adversaries and slowly drain the life out of them. Each element offers unique strategic advantages and effects that you can use to your benefit.


Reveal Synergy Abilities as you raise specific skills to a threshold, which then unlocks a new, combined ability. For instance, enhance your swordplay by reaching proficiency in both Ice Magic and Enhancement Magic, allowing you to imbue your blade with a chilling freeze effect. Alternatively, level up Fire Magic and Block to gain a burning aura ability that damages nearby adversaries. These synergy abilities reward raising skills thoughtfully to unlock powerful new capabilities.


As you ascend the formidable tower, your mission involves rescuing villagers trapped within its walls. Each villager you free adds a valuable ally to your cause.
Unlock a trainer who can enhance your stats, a blacksmith who upgrades your equipment, or an alchemist to upgrade your potions. These freed villagers' skills become essential to your journey, making you a formidable force against tougher adversaries awaiting on higher floors.
Navigate the tower's mysteries, utilize your expanding network of skilled villagers, and break the chains of oppression. Every rescue sharpens your edge in battle and binds the fate of the tower with your own.


There are combat skills like Sword, Greatsword, and Bow. And, magical ones like Transformation and Summoning.
The choice is yours to develop a character that fits your strategy and preferences.
Master the art of melee with the Warhammer or Spear. Alternatively wield the destructive force of Fire Magic, the freezing power of Ice Magic, or keep you and your friends healthy with Life Magic.
Our skill system is not just limited to combat, it also includes practical abilities like Scouting, which enhances your ability to detect enemies and treasures, and Focus, which intensifies your precision. Each skill can be raised when you level up, unlocking new abilities along the way. Perfect your dodge, to gracefully evade enemy attacks, or research Wind Magic to control the flow of battle. Every skill you choose can dramatically influence your journey and combat effectiveness.
Forge your path to greatness, refine your abilities, and become a legend in a land where skill mastery is the gateway to unrivaled power.


Search every corner of each room to find chests and upgrade your equipment. Find magical items that enhance your stats, skills or grant unique abilities. Equip yourself for glory, and let your gear tell the story of your journey as you rise to become the ultimate hero.

Stand alone against the dark.. just you.. and seven of your friends! Join forces in our online co-op game, supporting up to 8 players. Or navigate the tower alone, mastering the game at your own pace to overcome the toughest dungeons and defeat the most difficult bosses. The amount of loot and the difficulty of monsters are multiplied as more players join. Whether you're a lone wolf or a team player, you can have the experience that you desire. Prepare to forge your path, conquer enemies, and achieve greatness, however you choose to play.

Dive into adventures, tackle challenges, and enjoy seamless gameplay with friends worldwide. Experience teamwork, strategy, and unforgettable moments as you struggle to ascend the tower. The adventure begins now!

*Note: Racing the tower key has no real purpose other than sheer entertainment value, so don't sprain an ankle.

Oh, you mean that fountain of life? That thing is super cool. It not only saves your progress, but it revives your character too. And, it projects itself into the dungeon to create fountain resting and save stations for you. It's like it has a mind of its own. Buy the game and take a sip and see for yourself!

However, when its life-giving properties were discovered that's where all the trouble began. You see... in this story, some people want to live forever but are going about it the wrong way. Take our main villain for example. His dark magic has aged and corrupted his body, so when he heard about the fountain he immediately invaded the village.

The wizard sought to consume the magical village fountain and take its life-giving properties, but the fountain has a magic of its own. With its powerful life magic the fountain has repelled the wizard.

Stunned and angry the wizard has hidden in the castle and begun experiments to break the fountains' protection. His experiments have produced monstrous creatures that roam throughout the halls. He then hid his location by casting a powerful spell of "Shifting". This makes the dungeons change each time they are entered. He has hidden the path to find him and commanded his minions guard his halls.

Fight your way into his ever-shifting towers and battle his minions. Drag treasures from the halls to build your strength. And finally, take the fight to the wizard himself to set your village free.

Using the new dimensional portal, you'll find yourself in worlds small and large, familiar and not. Solve puzzles, log your findings, and steer clear of danger while venturing into this untold story. 게임은 현재 개발 중입니다. Discord에 참여하여 제안과 피드백을 공유해주세요.

title: Spirebound
description:
게임 정보
Your adventure starts now!
Experience a grand and heartfelt adventure through relaxing gameplay and controls.
Jump, Dash, and Swing your way up the great spire of wishes where you will get your innermost wish fulfilled.
Everyone dreams - everyone needs a helping hand
You are not alone on your way to the top. Other climbers also want to see their wishes realized. Meet this cast of quirky characters, help them and let them help you as you make friends and memories.
A tiny world with lots to do
Collectibles and treasures are hidden all over the tiny island. Some require you to solve puzzles and riddles whereas others test your platforming abilities. As a reward, you can trade your riches for hats and outfits.
For new and seasoned gamers alike
Spirebound is designed with young and inexperienced players in mind. The fixed camera views of the game allow young and inexperienced players to simply pick the game up and have fun. The whole adventure can be played and finished this way.
For more experienced players, we created 'Dream Dares', entirely optional bonus levels, wherein you can put your platforming skills to the test.

title: Eldoran
description:
게임 정보
Story
It was an era in which the world was shaken by an unprecedented collision. As our Earth and a parallel universe Earth reached exactly the same position in the universe, shocking anomalies emerged on both worlds. The anomalies selectively fused the Earths together, not only annihilating entire regions but also significantly decimating life on both sides. The few survivors found themselves in a world permeated by mysterious energies and vibrant crystal beings. Eldoran, as the locals of the parallel world named it, became a magical place that evoked both fascination and terror.
Features
Survival
Discover numerous survivors in the open world. Save and recruit them for your camps. Find food, build shelters, and combat diseases to prevent your survivors from succumbing to death.

Base Building
In the open world, you can establish camps anywhere and expand them from a small refuge to a large compound. Build shelters, crafting stations, and defensive measures. Defend your camps against attacks of all kinds.

Farming
With the right tools, you can reforest trees and cultivate various types of plants and food. Care for your growing plants and harvest them when they are ripe.

Crafting
With a variety of workstations, you can craft new armor, weapons, food, and other useful items.

Fishing
Fishing is not just a means of food procurement in Eldoran but also a hobby. Catch fish and bring them to your own waters to breed.

Taming
Many primitive crystal beings from the Earth of Eldoran can be captured and trained to assist you in the struggle for survival.

title: Consult Me Bee Opening A Snack Shop
description:
게임 정보
You plan to do a startup about snack shop consulting.
Take out the camera to shoot short videos to get orders.
Open the computer to provide consulting services for each snack shop consultation order and receive payment.
The revenue will be used to obtain more information to provide more accurate counseling, and to pay for the rising rent.
Try to make more people rich overnight before you go bankrupt!
autokwd: Consult Me Bee Opening A Snack Shop

title: The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity
description:
게임 정보
The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© is a survival horror action-adventure game built in RPG Maker MZ and is a prequel to The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows© (Will contain spoilers for The Clown's Forest, This game is best played after beating the first game)
STORY
Blitzo lost control while hunting down Michael. Jonathan had slipped back into control momentarily. Blitzo taunts Jonathan, vowing to destroy him once and for all. Jonathan, stuck in his own body and his own mind, with no way out, has to figure out how to keep himself safe in what was once his own subconscious. Jonathan's mind is slowly dwindling but he has to become stronger than Blitzo himself.

Forcing himself to relive his worst memories and fabrications created by Blitzo, Jonathan has to survive his nightmares to ensure he continues to exist to aid Michael in any way he can. But Blitzo refuses to make it easy for him.
GAMEPLAY
The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© Is a top-down Survival Horror game set between the events of The Clown's Forest© and The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows©, Jonathan has to survive his own nightmares to come out on top of Blitzo. Explore familiar and not so familiar locations fabricated by Jonathan's shared subconscious with Blitzo as Blitzo tries destroying Jonathan's soul from the inside.

Puzzles return with more terrifying consequences and new characters and lore will be expanded on as Jonathan not only fights against his past, but also the longhurst family's past as a whole. 

Jonathan has to protect himself from Blitzo. No matter the cost.
autokwd: The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity

title: Korga's Arena
description:
게임 정보
We combined a Roguelite Deckbuilder, a Turn-Based RPG, and a bloodthirsty orc battle-mage, to create Korga! Enter her domain and defeat anyone foolish enough to challenge you.
Craft your Deck, enhance your Weapons, and forge your Gladiator Emblem to customize your playstyle.




Meet Korga, Akhvar’s ruthless bounty hunter!
Gold has no sway over her; it's the thrill of the hunt and the heads of her prey she values above all. She drags these trophies back to her Arena, trapping their souls to relive their defeat over and over.
It’s more than just a fight, it’s her pleasure.




might be merciless, but she’s got a twisted sense of hospitality.
She can morph the with a snap of her fingers to give her captured foes a taste of home before their battle begins anew. Whether it’s the icy chill of the tundra or the scorching heat of a volcano, she ensures every fight is both familiar and fearsome.




Embrace the chaos in a land where every encounter is a leap into the unknown. With ever-changing challenges and choices that could spell victory or downfall, is a test of strategy, skill, and adaptability.
Will you remain the , or will you fall prey to your own avarice?




melds with . Add new cards to your deck throughout the game and discover amazing combinations!




The is an endless challenge, with the glory of victory and gloom of defeat lurking behind every corner. To better prepare for the challenges ahead, can progress through the paths and obtain their powers.

title: Chronicles of Fear: The Babysitter's Tale
description:
게임 정보


크로니클 오브 피어는 점프스캐어나 다른 싸구려 트릭이 없는 공포 게임을 만드는 데 중점을 둔 시리즈입니다.

우리의 주요 목표는 공포 매뉴얼이 아닌 실제 이야기를 사용하여 플롯을 구축함으로써 믿을 수 있는 공포 설정을 만드는 것입니다. 플레이어가 찾을 수 있는 숨겨진 디테일로 가득한 인터랙티브한 환경을 제공합니다.

완료하는 데 약 1.5~2시간이 걸리는 짧은 게임입니다.
'워킹 시뮬레이터' 장르이지만 주변 환경과 상호작용하고 캐릭터와 대화할 수 있습니다.
게임플레이에는 점프스케이어가 없으며, 현실에 가깝기 때문에 다음과 같은 트리거가 포함되어 있습니다;
거미 공포증, 가족 트라우마, 밀실 공포증, 고소공포증, 폐쇄공포증, 폐쇄공포증





이웃이 외출하는 동안 아들을 돌봐줄 수 있는지 물어보는데, 몇 달러를 벌 수 있는 좋은 방법입니다. 이런 날 밤에 일어날 수 있는 최악의 일이 뭐겠어요? 한적한 빈집에서 TV 앞에서 간식을 먹으며 쉽게 돈을 버는 것이야말로 가장 재미있는 활동이기 때문입니다. 하지만 만일을 대비해 문을 꼭 잠그는 것은 잊지 마세요.
autokwd: Chronicles of Fear: The Babysitter's Tale

title: Celestial Seekers
description:
게임 정보
Defend the research device against waves of enemies in this unique tower defense game! Team up with your friends or take on the challenge solo. Defeat enemies, collect resources, and use them to purchase powerful items, upgrade your character, or power up your base. The Celestial Seekers action takes place on different planets, each with its own secrets—explore them, but remember, time is limited.
COOPERATION
If you dont like going solo, team up with your friends and beat the game together, its always better to have some backup.
FIGHT
Choose from unique characters, each with their own stats and abilities—find your favorite and take down the waves.

title: Six Orders
description:
게임 정보
Try to save the earth

ClimaSave's Terraforming Environmental Restoration and Revival Androids (TERRAs) went rogue. What once was humanities last hope to life again on planet earth turned out to be the possible end for terrestrial live.
Not all hope is lost

As a Simulation Specialist it is your task to find a way to stop the TERRAs and save the earth from its impending death. Jump into new procedurally generated simulations to find the one way to save the earth.
Control and build your squad of robots

Fight with up to 7 different robots against the TERRAs and try to stop them from destroying the earth even further. Customize your robots with different lasers and metal alloys to improve on their tactical strengths.
Manage your resources

For every simulation you try, there is only a limited amount of resources you can use to repair or extend your squad. During each mission you can to stockpile more metal and survive the tactical battles until the TERRAs are defeated.

Every simulation will be different. So can be your squad that you start with. Show ClimaSave that you are capable of saving the earth to . Each has its own strengths and weaknesses providing a different experience with every playthrough.

title: OMAPELI
description:
게임 정보
OMAPELI is an action RPG setting in a medieval fantasy world.
Features

Explore the vast world
The over-world is made of multiple different biomes that each host their respective wild-life, structures and mobs. Houses and dungeons also have a lot to be found.

Fight for your dear life
Don't be a fool! Gather your weapons - swords, bows and spell books - and pat-pat the wood resin out of those nasty chairs.

Do Quests
You can find NPCs everywhere - in villages, roaming in the vastness and in big trouble. Do the needful and you will be handsomely rewarded.

Be the person
The character editor can shape the very fabric of your skeletal structure. Be the person you want to be.

Share your journey
A server-client based multiplayer system is in the developments that should allow local LAN and hopefully over-internet multiplayer for 2-10 simultaneous player.

title: Invade
description:
게임 정보
INVADE는 최대 4명의 플레이어가 즐길 수 있는 혼돈의 멀티플레이어 파티 게임입니다. 선택한 캐릭터로 다양하고 예측할 수 없는 레벨들을 돌파하고, 상대의 보물 상자를 빼앗아 자신의 기지로 안전하게 가져오세요. 그러는 내내 상대방이 당신에게 사용하는 마구잡이식의(그리고 폭발하는 일이 비일비재한) 파워업을 피해야만 합니다.

로컬 멀티 플레이어 모드 & 온라인 멀티플레이어
INVADE는 친구와 플레이할 수 있는 게임입니다. 최대 4인의 플레이어가 온라인 또는 같은 기기에서 2개 팀으로 나뉘어 플레이할 수 있습니다.

캐릭터
저마다 특색 있는 무기를 갖춘 다양하고 흥미로운 캐릭터들 중에서 신중하게 선택하세요!

레벨
해변, 기차역, 건설 현장 등 다채로운 레벨 중에서 매치 장소를 고르세요!

파워업
상대의 머리 위로 폭탄을 떨어뜨릴 수도 있고, 상대를 용암으로 둘러싸거나 우주로 날려버릴 수도 있습니다! 어떤 게임이든 여러 가지 파워업이 등장하면 더욱 정신없어지기 마련이죠!

title: Neon Rush
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the adrenaline-pumping realm of illegal racing, where every turn is an opportunity to showcase your skills.



In Neon Rush, you begin your story as a struggling mechanic barely making ends meet. You find your opportunity in an illegal street race as a way to earn some money. After buying your first car from a junkyard, you embark on your journey in the underworld street racing community. Will you become the best?



Taking part in illegal races will attract the attention of the Neon City Police Department! If you want to succeed as a racer in Neon City, you must be faster than they are!





You will be able to take part in many different races across Neon City, such as:




You will be able to buy different cars, and for each one, you will have the option to modify it!

title: Streamer Content: a simple mechanic
description:
게임 정보
The "Streamer Guy" is doing his routine live stream while his frustration serves as content and entertainment. In the midst of it, he reaches his limit and, after rage-quitting, decides to embark on a journey of self-discovery to find out who he is and what his position is in the world and the universe. Help Streamer Guy in this difficult journey using only a mouse!
Enjoy:

A simple mechanic! Move the mouse cursor using the center of the screen as the base, and Streamer Guy will move in the same intensity. Anyone can get the hang of it!

Punitive level design? You punish yourself, the level design doesn't react! With that in mind, you'll do very well in this peculiar platform and climbing game :D

Super personalized gameplay time! Your skills and persistence will completely dictate the game's duration. You're in charge!

Curiously random and mysteriously satisfying scenarios! (Wow) Talk to NPCs during the journey!

Microscopic budget! (But 100% effective!) You wouldn't expect anything less from this genre of game, especially coming from an indie group called "rotten post" :)

Have fun at a low cost or give it as a gift to your dear friend ;)
autokwd: Streamer Content: a simple mechanic, a simple game

title: Manludo 2
description:
게임 정보
You wake up on an alien space station. In this expansive sequel, every decision you make shapes your journey. Will you seize control of the station, flee to unknown territories, ignite a galactic conflict, broker peace, aid your newfound companions, or pursue riches? The choice is yours.

Engage in the unique game called 'Manludo'—a hand game of rock, paper, scissors—to challenge and outsmart the station's alien inhabitants. Success in these contests can elevate your status and influence within the station, unlocking new paths and possibilities.

Gameplay:
Experience a richly branching narrative in this game. Replay it many times. Simply press the spacebar or click to progress through the dialog. When faced with a choice, click on the corresponding button to determine your character's fate. Navigate through complex interactions and pivotal decisions to craft your unique story amidst the stars.

--- Esperanto ---
Vi vekiĝas sur ekstertera kosmostacio. En ĉi tiu vasta aventuro, ĉiu decido, kiun vi faras, formigas vian vojaĝon. Ĉu vi prenos kontrolon de la stacio, fuĝos al nekonataj teritorioj, komencos galaksian konflikton, intertraktos pacon, helpos viajn novajn kunulojn, aŭ ĉasos riĉaĵojn? La elekto estas via.

Partoprenu en la unika ludo nomata 'Manludo'— ŝtono, papero, tondilo—por defii kaj superlerti la eksterterajn loĝantojn de la stacio. Sukceso en ĉi tiuj konkuroj povas altigi vian statuson kaj influon en la stacio, malŝlosante novajn vojojn kaj eblecojn.

Spertu riĉe branĉan rakonton en ĉi tiu ludo. Vi povas reludi la ludon multfoje. Simple premu la spacan breton aŭ klaku por antaŭenigi la dialogon. Kiam vi alfrontiĝos kun elekto, klaku la korespondan butonon por determini la sorton de via rolulo. Navigu tra kompleksaj interagoj kaj decidoj, kiuj estas klavaj, por teksi vian unikan rakonton inter la steloj.

title: Sliding Hero
description:
게임 정보
슬라이딩 히어로는 장애물을 만날 때까지 한 방향으로 미끄러져 이동하는 탐험 퍼즐 게임입니다.

저택의 수많은 시련을 이겨내고 저택에 갇힌 상황에 숨겨진 진실의 가면을 벗겨낼 수 있을까요?
이동과 미스터리가 핵심인 메트로배니아 퍼즐 게임
불길한 베네치아 저택에 갇힌 상태에서, 순발력과 지력으로 세레니시마의 군인 루카 시코모로가 탈출하도록 도와주세요. Sliding Hero에서는 이동할 때마다 전략을 시험하게 됩니다. 장애물에 부딪힐 때까지 한 방향으로만 슬라이딩할 수 있어, 이동 그 자체가 퍼즐이 되니까요. 1700년대 베네치아와 카니발 가면 속 신비에 영감을 받은, 복잡하며 어둠에 휩싸인 세계를 탐험하세요. 모든 그림자 속에 위험과 속임수가 숨어 있습니다

title: Greed Forest
description:
게임 정보
A real-time strategy tower defense game set in a dangerous yet resource-rich forest. Build your base, shape your defenses, and fend off relentless enemy swarms in a battle for survival and supremacy.
Gather and Grow:
Harvest gold, wood and stone from the forest to expand your base, unlock upgrades, and build advanced tech structures.
RTS Meets Tower Defense:
Experience the strategy of a classic RTS without unit micro-management. Focus entirely on defending against massive waves of enemies.
Campaign and Creativity:
Dive into a challenging campaign or use the built-in map editor to design and share your own custom scenarios.
Greed Forest is about mastering the balance between resource management, strategic planning, and creative defense.

title: Into The Mine
description:
게임 정보
EVER WISHED FOR... an Indiana Jones style adventure blended with an old-school shooter? Light a torch. Grab your shotgun. Prepare for a cursed adventure -  
Not all that glistens in the darkness is GOLD!

title: CrateMage
description:
게임 정보
CrateMage isn't just a puzzle game, its a game obsessed with having you use your crate infused powers to overcome some truly devious puzzles. If you're like me & have a crippling addiction to moving boxes around then this experience will ignite that visceral lust in your brain's burnt out pleasure centers and satiate your crate cravings!

Features
Crates
Metal Crates
Crates which look slightly different to the aforementioned Crates

title: Incline ～Railway of devil's valley～
description:
게임 정보
The only way to defeat the devils is seal them up!

The hero is an devil slayer who has been robbed of his weapons.
He has no direct means of attack, and the only way he can defeat the devils is lure them into the sacred boundary at top floor of village and seal them!
Put devils on the inclined railway, and transport them to the sacred boundary!

To transport the devils to the sacred boundary, use the inclined railway that through the center of the village. Load up arbitrary number of devils in the cargo bed of an incline railway and off you go! You must keep dodging enemy attacks until you reach the top floor of the village. The more devils you put on the cargo bed, the higher the risk, but the greater the return on a successful seal.
Seal the devils and earn the souls!

Once the cargo bed with the devils on it reaches the top floor, seal them up and round them up! If you seal them up, you can earn a lot of the "souls" they have accumulated.
The amount of souls you can earn depends on the number and color of the devils you sealed at that time.

The souls earned are needed, to restore the villager whose soul has been drained to sanity.
By helping them, you will expand the scope of your activities in the village.
Let's fully explore the romantic Japanese world of the late Meiji era!

This work has a mode selection function.
In addition to the regular Adventure Mode, you can also enjoy Co-op Mode for two players to play at the same time! You can play slowly and carefully by yourself, or you can have a lot of fun with two other people!

title: Voxel Vanguard
description:
게임 정보
Voxel Vanguard is a dynamic strategy game set in a vibrant voxel world where players must strategically expand their territory by placing interconnected towers. Navigate through voxel worlds, strategically deploy towers, and connect them with tethers to fend off threats and conquer new territories.
Features:
Dynamic Voxel Terrain: Navigate through a dynamic voxel world filled with endless possibilities and strategic opportunities.
Immersive Voxel Art Style: Experience the charm and beauty of a vibrant voxel art style, bringing the game world to life with its unique aesthetic.
Strategic Tower Placement: Strategically place towers across the voxel landscape to expand your territory and defend against incoming threats.
Real-time Destruction Mechanics: Witness structures being built and destroyed voxel by voxel, adding a layer of realism and immersion to gameplay.
Resource Management: Manage resources efficiently to build and maintain your tower network, balancing expansion with defense.
Challenging Enemies: Face off against a variety of challenging enemies, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and behaviors.
Engaging Single-Player Campaign: Embark on an epic single-player campaign filled with story-driven missions and challenging objectives.
Community Creation Tools: Utilize in-game creation tools to design and share custom maps, towers, and gameplay experiences with the community.

title: Cabral's Quest
description:
게임 정보
Cabral’s Quest is a pixel art puzzle game set in a hidden world underneath the wetlands, ancient homeland of the capybaras.

Make your way to each fragment of the sacred deed to help Cabral reclaim their land. Use different runes to change the elements of the world around you to solve each puzzle.
GOALS



RESCUE BABY CAPYBARAS
Baby capybaras are hidden across the world, lost after the occupation of their lands.
They're optional collectibles to prove your ability.

OBTAIN EACH FRAGMENT OF THE SACRED DEED
And help Cabral recover the land of his community.
Cross portals, doors or bridges and try to avoid the wildlife around to make your way to each fragment of the sacred deed.

CONCEPT

LOGICAL AND LATERAL THINKING
Set in a calm atmosphere, encouraging deep thinking in both logical and lateral ways.


Based on the combination and switching of game elements’ colors, allowing for an accessible but rich gameplay.


Crafted with specific wildlife and natural elements that expand the original mechanics creating new experiences and puzzles.




Use the to modify the elements of the world, changing their color and disabling them to solve the puzzles.


Each element and enemy has different behaviour, and color is always at the core of each mechanic.

Use portals, doors, bridges and other elements to move around the levels.

Avoid the corrupted wildlife that will make your way to the harder.

title: Inhabitants
description:
게임 정보
Watch the development of this game live on twitch!
Inhabitants is a single-player horror game that has you delve into the mysterious disappearance of your friend.
They left without a trace. Their apartment was left unlocked and seemingly empty. Maybe there is something that can point you in the right direction?
Uncover the mysteries behind their disappearance. 
Your only clue is their computer. But what lies within may not be best if found.

title: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzle Challenge
description:
게임 정보
This game is an ultra-high difficulty jigsaw puzzle where players embark on a challenging journey. Players must fit pieces into the correct positions to complete images generated randomly using colored tiles.

However, this game deviates significantly from traditional jigsaw puzzles. Placing a piece triggers several unexpected events. For example, with each piece placed, the colors gradually fade, increasing the difficulty for players to discern the image. Additionally, the workspace gradually shrinks, forcing players to work within tighter confines.

Moreover, placing a piece in the wrong position triggers an explosion, resetting the game from the beginning. Players must carefully select pieces and place them accurately.

Furthermore, players may encounter falling debris when placing pieces, obscuring their view and adding to the challenge.

This game serves as a test of players' concentration and strategic thinking, offering an extremely challenging puzzle experience. Can players accurately fit all the pieces and complete the puzzle?

title: Shadoblitz
description:
게임 정보
This is a high-freedom hack-and-slash roguelite. As an apprentice reaper, you must undergo the Reaper's trials, fighting strategically in limited spaces, absorbing evil spirits, and using the environment to your advantage!

title: Nuclear Tides
description:
게임 정보
Nuclear Tides is a minimalist tower defense game. After the nuclear apocalypse, the isolated island is filled with radiation. Clear the radiation and build structures and turrets during the day, and defend your base against the onslaught of nuclear tides at night. Game features include：
Procedurally generated initial land plots.
Dozens of different land plots include buildings, turrets, and wonders. Most of the time, two identical plots can be combined to form a higher-level plot.
The synergistic effects of turrets
Be mindful not to let emissions get too high, or it will lead to disaster. Find a balance between economy, defense, and the environment.

title: Side42 the tavern of infinity
description:
게임 정보
About This Game

title: pondlife: discone
description:
게임 정보
there are no goals in this videogame.

discone is an exploration of videogames beyond gameness: beyond designed rules and designer-defined objectives. we, as designers, create a physics, a space, some characters. as players, you create the play.
move your expressive character-bodies around an online world
to explore and pull at the videogame's seams, left there intentionally or unintentionally. we believe that a novel, intuitively explorable, and experientially understood movement system, situated in a space, & connected online has infinite potential, and we are excited to explore this possibility space with you.
open exploration and discovery
the ability to pick a point on the horizon but without any combat or external conflict. the casual socialization and community of online web games in the context of a challenge-oriented, self-directed 3d platformer. the exciting stress of embodying and manipulating an alien avatar along not just a path, but an infinity of player-selected paths. are those mountains even climbable? (they definitely are)
embracing simplicity and childlike wonder
to seek the territory outside the boundaries of traditional art & its received aesthetic norms. we are inspired by paint and are exploring pixel-based art (all screen art is pixel art) as an impressionism, as something beyond chunky, low-resolution pixels. our approach to 3d-rendering accepts & embraces the glitchiness, the inherent flatness of polygons & deformed meshes, the seams & rough edges.
discone
is a game with no bosses and no ladders.

title: Scrollden
description:

Gameplay
Players will portray the role of a shaman wielding spirit power, journeying through an enchanted scroll that unveils the mystical realm of the Shan Hai Jing to awaken the slumbering creatures within. Players will build a home for them on a hidden island, gather precious resources and spirit energy, and fulfill their delightful little wishes, weaving a journey full of wonder and enchantment.
Background
In ancient times, when the pillars of Mount Buzhou shattered and the world was plunged into a calamity of water and flames, Goddess Nuwa mend the sky with colorful stones, saving all living beings. 
Thereafter, all of the creations flourished under her protection. Tme dances with the promise of renewal, and thousands of years have since elapsed.
One day, a shaman named “Wu”, imbued with spiritual power that could communicate with nature, received a divine commission from Nuwa herself.
Long ago, as Nuwa journeyed across the vast earth, she was captivated by the ethereal beauty of creation. To immortalize these moments, she crafted the mystical Mirror Scroll—a wondrous record of mountains and seas. When Mount Buzhou collapsed, many mythical beings tragically perished. Touched with compassion, Nuwa sealed their shattered souls within the scroll, hoping that one day their broken essences might be mended.
Now, as these souls grow near wholeness, they stand on the verge of awakening from  thousand years of slumber. Deep within the Eastern Sea lies an immortal island—a haven untouched by the mortal world and brimming with vibrant spiritual energy. Nuwa entrusts Wu with the task of journeying there to awaken, and guide the reborn creatures from the magical scroll, help restore their memories, and build them a new home, so that amid the ever-changing tides of time, they may again find a place to belong.
Core Elements
Shan Hai Jing (Classic of Mountains and Seas)
Collection
Construction
Exploration

Journey Before Destination - Our vision for Skibi's Castle TD 2 is to reimagine tower defense from the ground up, merging upfront auto-battler planning with puzzle-like levels. SK2 is the first step in the journey for us, just like the original (fun fact: the Blizzard version of the game was actually Skibi Castle TD 1 version 6). To that end, we plan to have the full release before the year is out so you have a cool new game to play, and we can enjoy our holidays ːlunar2019grinningpigː.

After the game is released, our next step in 2025 is to listen to your feedback and expand upon the core gameplay. This could mean borrowing from roguelike and idle game systems, improving on the traditional survival mode, or introducing something new like a bullet hell tower defense RTS mission hybrid.

Creating games has been my lifelong passion, and I believe that how we reach our goals and what we learn along the way is more important than the destination itself. I hope that playing SK2 is as enjoyable and fulfilling for you as it was for us to create it. Let us know what you think, chat!

title: Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Please visit the community hub for additional info regarding the game's release.

Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure is a game set in an ancient structure where light is both your guide and your challenge.

In Lux Leonarii you the player explore an ancient structure by harnessing the power of light in the form of highly focused light beams as you solve intricate puzzles by using rotating mirrors, devices and your wits.

Each level invites you to manipulate the beams of light using the environment, directing them through a series of obstacles and challenges while learning new ways to think about space, reflections and interactions.

It combines the challenge of puzzle solving with a visually appealing experience using dynamic lighting that reacts in real-time to the beam's locations to create captivating Levels.

Perfect for mechanical puzzle lovers who still enjoy some degree of visual appeal, Lux Leonarii challenges you to think with reflections in mind, explore creative solutions and discover the forgotten power of light. Will you unlock the secrets hidden here ?.

–Key features–

- Escalating difficulty, from simple A to B connections with a single colour, up to 7 different colours, ten-fold reflections and utilizing all available tiles, so while the first few levels are easy as they introduce the game mechanics, and as the mechanics interact with each other, levels get challenging.

- It is a mechanical puzzle, meaning your actions are immediately visible in real time so if there is a beam being interrupted by an obstacle you will be able to see it immediately and might even be able to nudge the mirrors slightly to bypass it, or the opening of a door might move said door to interrupt another beam, possibly the very same one that is opening it.

- 4 Directly interactable tiles (Like Mirrors you can rotate)

- 7 Indirectly interactable tiles  (Like Doors)

- If you are here only for the Puzzle aspect of the game, the adventure aspect of the game (collecting, crafting, health) can be fully ignored and is merely there because it makes me feel like I am doing well in the game when the inventory is full of stuff. (This might change in the future, with either the removal/change/expansion of the system, but this is the current state of it.)

-Extensive Options, along with the basics (graphics, audio) there are additional settings for example the light sources in the game like the light beams themselves, the fire bowls along with the background light can be customized so you can customize the experience.
autokwd: Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure

As you doze asleep you are awoken by a powerful being named The Cosmic Entity. If you choose to accept, he promises to take you on an adventure throughout the multiverse and time. title: Tickety Boom
description:
게임 정보


In Tickety Boom, you play as Max, a veteran bomb disposal expert whose world is turned upside down by a ghost from his past. And they’re raining terror on his city. Working with his colleague and best friend, Vic, Max must solve puzzles to defuse bombs before time runs out and the city is turned into piles of rubble.

title: Department of Gravity Management

Change Gravity: Activate gravity panels, cylinders, and spheres to change the gravity around you in different ways.  Use these to move Newtonium to reactors throughout the level.  Once you meet your quota, you can move on to the next level.
Walk on Walls: You can use the gravity panels to push and pull yourself in different directions.  Walk on the walls and ceilings.  Fly through the air.  Navigate the levels in creative ways.  Just be careful not to fly into the Newtonium reactors.
Fun with Physics: Send objects into orbit with fully simulated physical forces.  Anything not nailed down is affected by gravity changes, so have fun experimenting with how the different gravity panels affect objects in the game.  And of course, since you control the gravity, you can pick up and throw anything, no matter how big.
New Abilities: Gain new gravity-based abilities as you progress, creating new ways to navigate the world and solve puzzles.  You can create your own gravity panels, use the gravity hook to pull yourself through the air, and even slow time to consider your next move.  You'll need these abilities to navigate the levels and free the station from the oversight of the Newton Corportation.

Mysterious laughter echoed from the river on that restless summer night. Why the hell did you get out of the tent? You find yourself drawn into the gloomy world of Midnight Swamp, filled with strange inhabitants and thrilling puzzles.

title: Escape From Hell
description:
게임 정보
NOTE: The game is currently under development. All pictures are real, but only a small portion of the content is shown.
BRIEF

Enter the shadowy realm of Escape From Hell, where only those who truly understand life can pass judgment. You find yourself trapped in a series of mysterious rooms, each one concealing a fragment of a soul's darkest secret.

Room by room, puzzle by puzzle, you'll unravel the intricate tapestry of an individual's existence. Piece together their most concealed sins and deepest regrets, and confront the ultimate question: Are they guilty of a grave misdeed, or merely victims of their own remorse?

As you delve deeper, the spectral whispers of the past will guide you through the haunted corridors of memory. Beware, for some secrets are fiercely guarded by the spirits that dwell within. Not everyone desires to be judged, and the most damning truths are often buried in the shadows of forgotten moments.

The game is a first-person adventure simulating an escape room. You start in a briefing room (a small room with a reception area), followed by a training room (to learn the controls). Each subsequent room contains puzzles that reveal the next chapter of a person's life. Each puzzle has at least two solutions (for example, the number 1984 can be referenced through a quote from the book or via the mathematical equation "992*2"), so there aren't any specific expectations from the player.


There are well-known sins in the world. Everyone has sins, but sometimes it's not enough for the world to judge each other's sins. What if something bad happened to prevent even worse things? The world can only know about it by asking others. However, how can a decision be made without knowing the whole story, which ended with this sin? Background is always important and needs to be understood first.

You need to understand the life of the person and the background of the incident. Then, you will decide if they are guilty or not.

I would advise preparing a pen and notebook. In first-person mode, you are plunged into the first puzzle-solving room. You can interact with many things: initially, you can interact only with clues, but in deeper levels, you will encounter misleading actors as well. You must solve exactly three puzzles to move forward (red/green lights will indicate your progress). At the end of each level, you will have a brief explanation of this part of the person's life. At the end of a level sequence for a specific person (please note: the game features multiple characters), the game will explain what happened and ask you to judge the incident.

Do you have the insight and resolve to navigate the labyrinth of another's life? Can you unlock all the secrets and piece together the truth? The answers lie within .

Office: Boss's Mystery is a game for everyone who appreciates humor and classic point-and-click adventures. Are you ready to solve the boss's mystery and find out what’s really behind those paperclips?

title: pondlife: discone
description:
게임 정보
there are no goals in this videogame.

discone is an exploration of videogames beyond gameness: beyond designed rules and designer-defined objectives. we, as designers, create a physics, a space, some characters. as players, you create the play.
move your expressive character-bodies around an online world
to explore and pull at the videogame's seams, left there intentionally or unintentionally. we believe that a novel, intuitively explorable, and experientially understood movement system, situated in a space, & connected online has infinite potential, and we are excited to explore this possibility space with you.
open exploration and discovery
the ability to pick a point on the horizon but without any combat or external conflict. the casual socialization and community of online web games in the context of a challenge-oriented, self-directed 3d platformer. the exciting stress of embodying and manipulating an alien avatar along not just a path, but an infinity of player-selected paths. are those mountains even climbable? (they definitely are)
embracing simplicity and childlike wonder
to seek the territory outside the boundaries of traditional art & its received aesthetic norms. we are inspired by paint and are exploring pixel-based art (all screen art is pixel art) as an impressionism, as something beyond chunky, low-resolution pixels. our approach to 3d-rendering accepts & embraces the glitchiness, the inherent flatness of polygons & deformed meshes, the seams & rough edges.
discone
is a game with no bosses and no ladders.

Gameplay
Players will portray the role of a shaman wielding spirit power, journeying through an enchanted scroll that unveils the mystical realm of the Shan Hai Jing to awaken the slumbering creatures within. Players will build a home for them on a hidden island, gather precious resources and spirit energy, and fulfill their delightful little wishes, weaving a journey full of wonder and enchantment.
Background
In ancient times, when the pillars of Mount Buzhou shattered and the world was plunged into a calamity of water and flames, Goddess Nuwa mend the sky with colorful stones, saving all living beings. 
Thereafter, all of the creations flourished under her protection. Tme dances with the promise of renewal, and thousands of years have since elapsed.
One day, a shaman named “Wu”, imbued with spiritual power that could communicate with nature, received a divine commission from Nuwa herself.
Long ago, as Nuwa journeyed across the vast earth, she was captivated by the ethereal beauty of creation. To immortalize these moments, she crafted the mystical Mirror Scroll—a wondrous record of mountains and seas. When Mount Buzhou collapsed, many mythical beings tragically perished. Touched with compassion, Nuwa sealed their shattered souls within the scroll, hoping that one day their broken essences might be mended.
Now, as these souls grow near wholeness, they stand on the verge of awakening from  thousand years of slumber. Deep within the Eastern Sea lies an immortal island—a haven untouched by the mortal world and brimming with vibrant spiritual energy. Nuwa entrusts Wu with the task of journeying there to awaken, and guide the reborn creatures from the magical scroll, help restore their memories, and build them a new home, so that amid the ever-changing tides of time, they may again find a place to belong.

Collection
Construction
Exploration

Defensive Static Weapons: Fortify your position and defend.

Reach the Portal Home
Your mission is straightforward: find the Portal home. Each run features a single portal—can you locate it? Can you reach it? The locals view you as a virus. They want to eradicate you and will stop at nothing to prevent your escape.

If you do manage to reach the portal, where will it lead you? To another part of this bizarre alien world, or back home to your family and friends?
Unleash Your Inner Warrior with Nanobot Upgrades

title: STREAM STRATOS
