"STREAM STRATOS" is a 3D action game.
Players progress through stages to liberate areas occupied by enemies.


As you progress through the stages, the variety and number of enemies increase, gradually raising the difficulty level. In the latest stages, strong adversaries await the player.

title: Candela: Colorless Dreams
description:
게임 정보
Bring light to a colorless world in Candela, a mysterious and atmospheric puzzle platformer set in a desolate, post-apocalyptic land. Manipulate blue and red flames to solve puzzles, master challenging platforming, and uncover secrets.
Harness the powers of blue and red flames, combining them to unlock new possibilities.
Explore a non-linear world map, collecting keys and finding secrets to access new areas and progress.
Face challenging puzzles and a variety of mechanics that test your skills and creativity.
Discover a land full of mysteries waiting to be unraveled.

title: The Realm
description:
게임 정보
Story
The player lost in a Labyrinthine village in another world is looking for a way out alone.
You explore the village from a first-person perspective and find the exit.
There are many creatures lurking in the village. All of them are terrifying creatures you've never seen before.
Will you be able to leave the village safely?

System
This game is a walking simulation game, and all you have to do is walk in the dark village.
The controls for this game are easy, just grab your flashlight and keep walking and look for exit.
You can have an experience like you're actually in a village of horror.

title: Cabral's Quest
description:
게임 정보
Cabral’s Quest is a pixel art puzzle game set in a hidden world underneath the wetlands, ancient homeland of the capybaras.

Make your way to each fragment of the sacred deed to help Cabral reclaim their land. Use different runes to change the elements of the world around you to solve each puzzle.
GOALS



RESCUE BABY CAPYBARAS
Baby capybaras are hidden across the world, lost after the occupation of their lands.
They're optional collectibles to prove your ability.

OBTAIN EACH FRAGMENT OF THE SACRED DEED
And help Cabral recover the land of his community.
Cross portals, doors or bridges and try to avoid the wildlife around to make your way to each fragment of the sacred deed.

CONCEPT

LOGICAL AND LATERAL THINKING
Set in a calm atmosphere, encouraging deep thinking in both logical and lateral ways.


Based on the combination and switching of game elements’ colors, allowing for an accessible but rich gameplay.


Crafted with specific wildlife and natural elements that expand the original mechanics creating new experiences and puzzles.




Use the to modify the elements of the world, changing their color and disabling them to solve the puzzles.


Each element and enemy has different behaviour, and color is always at the core of each mechanic.

Use portals, doors, bridges and other elements to move around the levels.

Avoid the corrupted wildlife that will make your way to the harder.

title: Inhabitants
description:
게임 정보
Watch the development of this game live on twitch!
Inhabitants is a single-player horror game that has you delve into the mysterious disappearance of your friend.
They left without a trace. Their apartment was left unlocked and seemingly empty. Maybe there is something that can point you in the right direction?
Uncover the mysteries behind their disappearance. 
Your only clue is their computer. But what lies within may not be best if found.

title: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzle Challenge
description:
게임 정보
This game is an ultra-high difficulty jigsaw puzzle where players embark on a challenging journey. Players must fit pieces into the correct positions to complete images generated randomly using colored tiles.

However, this game deviates significantly from traditional jigsaw puzzles. Placing a piece triggers several unexpected events. For example, with each piece placed, the colors gradually fade, increasing the difficulty for players to discern the image. Additionally, the workspace gradually shrinks, forcing players to work within tighter confines.

Moreover, placing a piece in the wrong position triggers an explosion, resetting the game from the beginning. Players must carefully select pieces and place them accurately.

Furthermore, players may encounter falling debris when placing pieces, obscuring their view and adding to the challenge.

This game serves as a test of players' concentration and strategic thinking, offering an extremely challenging puzzle experience. Can players accurately fit all the pieces and complete the puzzle?

title: Uanamon: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
The war continues. The enemies have become stronger. We must become stronger too - now there is a secret weapon in the game...
We immerse ourselves in the world of the Uanamon, learn about their traditions and rules of the world. Kill your enemies and restore the world of the Uanamons!
A roguelike-survivor game.

title: Hack Deep
description:
게임 정보
The game is a cyber-space infiltration game that supports up to 4-player cooperation. In this game, players step into a futuristic cyberspace filled with technological wonders and dangers. Their mission is to infiltrate target locations, steal crucial items, and successfully evacuate, all of which require close cooperation between players.
This game not only provides players with thrilling gaming experiences but also encourages teamwork and communication among players. Each player assumes a different role with unique skills and abilities, making each game a fresh challenge. Some players might excel at hacking security systems, some might be adept combatants, while others could be stealth and theft experts. Only through clever strategies and coordinated actions can missions be successfully completed.
The cyber-space in the game is brimming with high-tech gadgets and challenging enemies. Players need to utilize various tools and skills to evade surveillance systems, bypass security personnel, and complete objectives without raising too much attention. At the same time, players must constantly watch out for the safety of their team members and support each other in times of crisis, ensuring everyone evacuates smoothly.

title: The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity
description:
게임 정보
The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© is a survival horror action-adventure game built in RPG Maker MZ and is a prequel to The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows© (Will contain spoilers for The Clown's Forest, This game is best played after beating the first game)
STORY
Blitzo lost control while hunting down Michael. Jonathan had slipped back into control momentarily. Blitzo taunts Jonathan, vowing to destroy him once and for all. Jonathan, stuck in his own body and his own mind, with no way out, has to figure out how to keep himself safe in what was once his own subconscious. Jonathan's mind is slowly dwindling but he has to become stronger than Blitzo himself.

Forcing himself to relive his worst memories and fabrications created by Blitzo, Jonathan has to survive his nightmares to ensure he continues to exist to aid Michael in any way he can. But Blitzo refuses to make it easy for him.
GAMEPLAY
The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© Is a top-down Survival Horror game set between the events of The Clown's Forest© and The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows©, Jonathan has to survive his own nightmares to come out on top of Blitzo. Explore familiar and not so familiar locations fabricated by Jonathan's shared subconscious with Blitzo as Blitzo tries destroying Jonathan's soul from the inside.

Puzzles return with more terrifying consequences and new characters and lore will be expanded on as Jonathan not only fights against his past, but also the longhurst family's past as a whole. 

Jonathan has to protect himself from Blitzo. No matter the cost.
autokwd: The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity

title: Korga's Arena
description:
게임 정보
We combined a Roguelite Deckbuilder, a Turn-Based RPG, and a bloodthirsty orc battle-mage, to create Korga! Enter her domain and defeat anyone foolish enough to challenge you.
Craft your Deck, enhance your Weapons, and forge your Gladiator Emblem to customize your playstyle.




Meet Korga, Akhvar’s ruthless bounty hunter!
Gold has no sway over her; it's the thrill of the hunt and the heads of her prey she values above all. She drags these trophies back to her Arena, trapping their souls to relive their defeat over and over.
It’s more than just a fight, it’s her pleasure.




might be merciless, but she’s got a twisted sense of hospitality.
She can morph the with a snap of her fingers to give her captured foes a taste of home before their battle begins anew. Whether it’s the icy chill of the tundra or the scorching heat of a volcano, she ensures every fight is both familiar and fearsome.




Embrace the chaos in a land where every encounter is a leap into the unknown. With ever-changing challenges and choices that could spell victory or downfall, is a test of strategy, skill, and adaptability.
Will you remain the , or will you fall prey to your own avarice?




melds with . Add new cards to your deck throughout the game and discover amazing combinations!




The is an endless challenge, with the glory of victory and gloom of defeat lurking behind every corner. To better prepare for the challenges ahead, can progress through the paths and obtain their powers.

title: Warranted Humanity
description:
게임 정보
An unknown virus is turning infected mammals into cannibals and zombies.
In Warranted Humanity choices matter. Name your hero, choose the colour of his car and rush through the tutorial, because the clock is ticking and humanity’s survival is resting on your shoulders.
GAME FEATURES
How you spend your time at night, affects your efficiency during the day and how well you fight and scavenge during day-time excursions, determines your options and progress during the night. Will your read a book to improve your skill in hacking, craft a bigger backpack, upgrade your toolbelt or distill more biodiesel for the generator?
Fighting is action-based, but the body part hit, weapon condition, the presence of armour, as well as the hero’s stats all have an influence on the outcome of hits, parries, damage received and damage dealt.
Morale is just as important as health in Warranted Humanity. Killing healthy and curable humans (instead of incapacitating them) has a large negative impact on morale, especially in the beginning of the game. Develop courage by taking damage and improve humanity’s odds of survival, to improve your maximum morale, or you will flee to your shelter in panic after receiving only a few bites and scratches.
Manage short-term challenges like cuts, hunger and fatigue, or they will turn into long-term problems like infection, starvation and sleep deprivation, affecting maximum health, stamina and morale.
Oversee survivors who joined your shelter. Add survivors to your shelter by helping those you encounter during day-time excursions, or by incapacitating and abducting infected humans you then treat with antibodies you harvested from your own body. More survivors at the shelter translates into more hands to help with the crafting, maintenance and upgrades, but it also means more mouths to feed.
Deal with locks in a number of ways They come in different types and sizes and stand between you and important resources. If you have the right tool in your backpack, you can lockpick, hack or pry open a lock. These actions are implemented as mini-games and the difficulty of the task is affected by the hero’s stats. You can also use a key or enter the right combination, if you found one of these along the way.

title: Into The Deep
description:
게임 정보


A tactical adventure game that plunges you into the shadowy depths of a lost city, now overrun by a malevolent force. Take control of a brave squad of dwarves, led by the valiant former ruler Amos, and venture into uncharted depths to reclaim the city from the grip of darkness, one turn at a time. Ready your pick axes, tighten your boots, and prepare to dive headfirst into the darkness – and don't forget your ale!



Combat in Into The Deep is all about smart decisions and bold tactics. Plan each move carefully, position your squad wisely, and execute strategies that leave your enemies in shambles (and possibly leave your dwarves with a few new scars). It’s a game of brains, brawn, and a lot of beards.



Tactics alone aren’t enough – you’ll need precision and quick thinking to pull off some of the more advanced moves. In this turn-based game, positioning is just half the battle. The other half is how well you can aim that dwarven rifle, set up a perfect chain reaction, or bounce a shot just right to hit enemies where they least expect it.



Descend into a labyrinth of forgotten alleys, haunted ruins, and treacherous tunnels. Every path you choose reveals secrets, challenges, and the occasional nasty surprise that’s been waiting far too long for company. Whether you're uncovering lost lore or looting ancient vaults, there’s always something worth discovering – if you can survive long enough to find it.

title: OMAPELI
description:
게임 정보
OMAPELI is an action RPG setting in a medieval fantasy world.
Features

Explore the vast world
The over-world is made of multiple different biomes that each host their respective wild-life, structures and mobs. Houses and dungeons also have a lot to be found.

Fight for your dear life
Don't be a fool! Gather your weapons - swords, bows and spell books - and pat-pat the wood resin out of those nasty chairs.

Do Quests
You can find NPCs everywhere - in villages, roaming in the vastness and in big trouble. Do the needful and you will be handsomely rewarded.

Be the person
The character editor can shape the very fabric of your skeletal structure. Be the person you want to be.

Share your journey
A server-client based multiplayer system is in the developments that should allow local LAN and hopefully over-internet multiplayer for 2-10 simultaneous player.

title: Consult Me Bee Opening A Snack Shop
description:
게임 정보
You plan to do a startup about snack shop consulting.
Take out the camera to shoot short videos to get orders.
Open the computer to provide consulting services for each snack shop consultation order and receive payment.
The revenue will be used to obtain more information to provide more accurate counseling, and to pay for the rising rent.
Try to make more people rich overnight before you go bankrupt!
autokwd: Consult Me Bee Opening A Snack Shop

title: Incline ～Railway of devil's valley～
description:
게임 정보
The only way to defeat the devils is seal them up!

The hero is an devil slayer who has been robbed of his weapons.
He has no direct means of attack, and the only way he can defeat the devils is lure them into the sacred boundary at top floor of village and seal them!
Put devils on the inclined railway, and transport them to the sacred boundary!

To transport the devils to the sacred boundary, use the inclined railway that through the center of the village. Load up arbitrary number of devils in the cargo bed of an incline railway and off you go! You must keep dodging enemy attacks until you reach the top floor of the village. The more devils you put on the cargo bed, the higher the risk, but the greater the return on a successful seal.
Seal the devils and earn the souls!

Once the cargo bed with the devils on it reaches the top floor, seal them up and round them up! If you seal them up, you can earn a lot of the "souls" they have accumulated.
The amount of souls you can earn depends on the number and color of the devils you sealed at that time.

The souls earned are needed, to restore the villager whose soul has been drained to sanity.
By helping them, you will expand the scope of your activities in the village.
Let's fully explore the romantic Japanese world of the late Meiji era!

This work has a mode selection function.
In addition to the regular Adventure Mode, you can also enjoy Co-op Mode for two players to play at the same time! You can play slowly and carefully by yourself, or you can have a lot of fun with two other people!

title: Voxel Vanguard
description:
게임 정보
Voxel Vanguard is a dynamic strategy game set in a vibrant voxel world where players must strategically expand their territory by placing interconnected towers. Navigate through voxel worlds, strategically deploy towers, and connect them with tethers to fend off threats and conquer new territories.
Features:
Dynamic Voxel Terrain: Navigate through a dynamic voxel world filled with endless possibilities and strategic opportunities.
Immersive Voxel Art Style: Experience the charm and beauty of a vibrant voxel art style, bringing the game world to life with its unique aesthetic.
Strategic Tower Placement: Strategically place towers across the voxel landscape to expand your territory and defend against incoming threats.
Real-time Destruction Mechanics: Witness structures being built and destroyed voxel by voxel, adding a layer of realism and immersion to gameplay.
Resource Management: Manage resources efficiently to build and maintain your tower network, balancing expansion with defense.
Challenging Enemies: Face off against a variety of challenging enemies, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and behaviors.
Engaging Single-Player Campaign: Embark on an epic single-player campaign filled with story-driven missions and challenging objectives.
Community Creation Tools: Utilize in-game creation tools to design and share custom maps, towers, and gameplay experiences with the community.

title: Rigid
description:
게임 정보


With just a dash and a wall climb ability you can speed through worlds! Parkour your way to the end of the level using launch pads, doors & more!

Explore through four worlds and 40+ levels
A both casual yet action-packed experience
Map Editor: Make and play community-made maps using the map editor
Multiplayer: Race against your friends on official or community-made maps
Leaderboards: Climb up the leaderboards by gaining high scores
Unique scoring system that provides infinite replayability
Move at Mach 10 (it's seriously very fun)

title: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress
description:
게임 정보
Fight back against the powerful wizard who has captured your village under his spell.

Battle your way into his ever-shifting towers and tangle with his minions. Drag treasures from the halls to build your strength. And finally, take the fight to the wizard himself to set your village free.

The castle is always similar but never the same, can you find the way and complete your siege of the shifting fortress?


Optimize your hero for close-quarters combat, long-range assaults, or magical dominance. Do you shoot a Bow, or prefer the balance of a Sword and Shield? How about the raw damage of a Great Sword or the brute force of a Warhammer? Mix and match weapons and abilities to create a combat style tailored to you. Experiment with different builds, each offering distinct advantages and tactical options. Choose your style, master your weapons and select abilities that will allow you to dominate your foes.


Master elemental magic to inflict status effects such as freeze, burn, and poison on your enemies. Ice spells slow and eventually freeze them. Once frozen, focus on other threats as they slowly thaw, or shatter them with a physical attack for bonus damage. Use the raw power of Fire to damage and eventually set your enemies ablaze for high damage over time. Poison spells will weaken your adversaries and slowly drain the life out of them. Each element offers unique strategic advantages and effects that you can use to your benefit.


Reveal Synergy Abilities as you raise specific skills to a threshold, which then unlocks a new, combined ability. For instance, enhance your swordplay by reaching proficiency in both Ice Magic and Enhancement Magic, allowing you to imbue your blade with a chilling freeze effect. Alternatively, level up Fire Magic and Block to gain a burning aura ability that damages nearby adversaries. These synergy abilities reward raising skills thoughtfully to unlock powerful new capabilities.


As you ascend the formidable tower, your mission involves rescuing villagers trapped within its walls. Each villager you free adds a valuable ally to your cause.
Unlock a trainer who can enhance your stats, a blacksmith who upgrades your equipment, or an alchemist to upgrade your potions. These freed villagers' skills become essential to your journey, making you a formidable force against tougher adversaries awaiting on higher floors.
Navigate the tower's mysteries, utilize your expanding network of skilled villagers, and break the chains of oppression. Every rescue sharpens your edge in battle and binds the fate of the tower with your own.


There are combat skills like Sword, Greatsword, and Bow. And, magical ones like Transformation and Summoning.
The choice is yours to develop a character that fits your strategy and preferences.
Master the art of melee with the Warhammer or Spear. Alternatively wield the destructive force of Fire Magic, the freezing power of Ice Magic, or keep you and your friends healthy with Life Magic.
Our skill system is not just limited to combat, it also includes practical abilities like Scouting, which enhances your ability to detect enemies and treasures, and Focus, which intensifies your precision. Each skill can be raised when you level up, unlocking new abilities along the way. Perfect your dodge, to gracefully evade enemy attacks, or research Wind Magic to control the flow of battle. Every skill you choose can dramatically influence your journey and combat effectiveness.
Forge your path to greatness, refine your abilities, and become a legend in a land where skill mastery is the gateway to unrivaled power.


Search every corner of each room to find chests and upgrade your equipment. Find magical items that enhance your stats, skills or grant unique abilities. Equip yourself for glory, and let your gear tell the story of your journey as you rise to become the ultimate hero.

Stand alone against the dark.. just you.. and seven of your friends! Join forces in our online co-op game, supporting up to 8 players. Or navigate the tower alone, mastering the game at your own pace to overcome the toughest dungeons and defeat the most difficult bosses. The amount of loot and the difficulty of monsters are multiplied as more players join. Whether you're a lone wolf or a team player, you can have the experience that you desire. Prepare to forge your path, conquer enemies, and achieve greatness, however you choose to play.

Dive into adventures, tackle challenges, and enjoy seamless gameplay with friends worldwide. Experience teamwork, strategy, and unforgettable moments as you struggle to ascend the tower. The adventure begins now!

*Note: Racing the tower key has no real purpose other than sheer entertainment value, so don't sprain an ankle.

Oh, you mean that fountain of life? That thing is super cool. It not only saves your progress, but it revives your character too. And, it projects itself into the dungeon to create fountain resting and save stations for you. It's like it has a mind of its own. Buy the game and take a sip and see for yourself!

However, when its life-giving properties were discovered that's where all the trouble began. You see... in this story, some people want to live forever but are going about it the wrong way. Take our main villain for example. His dark magic has aged and corrupted his body, so when he heard about the fountain he immediately invaded the village.

The wizard sought to consume the magical village fountain and take its life-giving properties, but the fountain has a magic of its own. With its powerful life magic the fountain has repelled the wizard.

Stunned and angry the wizard has hidden in the castle and begun experiments to break the fountains' protection. His experiments have produced monstrous creatures that roam throughout the halls. He then hid his location by casting a powerful spell of "Shifting". This makes the dungeons change each time they are entered. He has hidden the path to find him and commanded his minions guard his halls.

Fight your way into his ever-shifting towers and battle his minions. Drag treasures from the halls to build your strength. And finally, take the fight to the wizard himself to set your village free.
autokwd: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress

title: Pilot Light

When all of the stars in the sky go dark, it becomes your mission to venture to the planet at the center of the universe and re-illuminate the pilot light. Your only guidance to your goal is the light from the engine of your rocket.

Navigate through tight spaces and dodge dangerous obstacles placed by peculiar enemies coming from the darkness. One wrong touch to your rocket will spell certain doom.

8 Worlds
80 Levels
8 Bosses
Challenge Modes
Voice-acted cutscenes

title: Cube Guy

Cube Guy is a relatively simple 2.5d platformer game, that currently takes around 1 hour to fully complete.

Dash!!
Unlock the dash and be able to fly through the levels, destroy walls and discover secrets along the way!

Boss fights!!
Some boss fights mix it up, featuring a turn based battle system, where you have to attack, and dodge the opponents attacks!
Main Features

방어력을 향상시킬 수 있는 독특한 전리품이 무작위로 생성되는 층입니다.



수확
초목, 토양, 인간이 만든 쓰레기에서 자원을 추출하여 강력한 기계를 제작하세요. 채소 분대를 활용하여 방을 발견하고 지형을 파헤치세요.



기계를 제작해 복잡한 미로를 만들고 해충을 몰살시키세요. 바닥에는 방어력을 향상시킬 수 있는 독특한 전리품이 무작위로 생성됩니다.



새로운 기계 등을 잠금 해제하기 위해 탐험 중 발견한 호기심을 가지고 다시 등장하거나 더 깊이 파헤치세요!

title: Rising Sands
description:
게임 정보
Set in a post-apocalyptic world, as ex-military soldier Daku, discover the secrets of the sand and reveal how the world has gotten to this state. Uncover the many groups formed after the war, from the government corporation EcoSurge to the eco-terrorist group Rising Sands, and many more.

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, Rising Sands features grounded third person shooter gameplay mixed with fantasy. Heavily inspired by classic RPG titles alongside modern Shooters, the ever changing environments constantly being tampered by The Gemini's rising sand make for a unique experience for every player. The captivating story along with these elements lead to gripping boss fights that push Daku to his limits.



Rising Sands features complex characters in a world where no one truly knows who is right. See all sides of the story and discover what really happened after the war.

title: Enemy Metal
description:
게임 정보

2.5D ROGUELITE SHOOTER WITH UNIQUE GAMEPLAY AND A KILLER SOUNDTRACK

Easy to play yet difficult to master, Enemy Metal features unique starships and vibrant planets. Destroy enemies to unlock new starships and planets and gather crystals to power up your starships.

Battle for Survival
Begin your campaign on Planet Aureus and fight to survive with unlimited time. Compete against players around the world with a global leaderboard on each planet.
Battle against Time
Progress and discover new game modes on Ignis, the Planet of Fire and Glaceus, the Planet of Ice with limited time and increased damage. Battle the mysterious enemy in a race against time in the final challenge on Arcana, the dark moon.

Reach high levels on each planet to permanently upgrade your starships and unlock exciting new planets and starships as you defend the Sunstar System. Gather crystals to restore health and energy and increase your speed, firepower and shields.
Complete achievements on each planet to earn permanent boosts for all your starships.

title: Spirebound
description:
게임 정보
Your adventure starts now!
Experience a grand and heartfelt adventure through relaxing gameplay and controls.
Jump, Dash, and Swing your way up the great spire of wishes where you will get your innermost wish fulfilled.
Everyone dreams - everyone needs a helping hand
You are not alone on your way to the top. Other climbers also want to see their wishes realized. Meet this cast of quirky characters, help them and let them help you as you make friends and memories.
A tiny world with lots to do
Collectibles and treasures are hidden all over the tiny island. Some require you to solve puzzles and riddles whereas others test your platforming abilities. As a reward, you can trade your riches for hats and outfits.
For new and seasoned gamers alike
Spirebound is designed with young and inexperienced players in mind. The fixed camera views of the game allow young and inexperienced players to simply pick the game up and have fun. The whole adventure can be played and finished this way.
For more experienced players, we created 'Dream Dares', entirely optional bonus levels, wherein you can put your platforming skills to the test.

title: Eldoran
description:
게임 정보
Story
It was an era in which the world was shaken by an unprecedented collision. As our Earth and a parallel universe Earth reached exactly the same position in the universe, shocking anomalies emerged on both worlds. The anomalies selectively fused the Earths together, not only annihilating entire regions but also significantly decimating life on both sides. The few survivors found themselves in a world permeated by mysterious energies and vibrant crystal beings. Eldoran, as the locals of the parallel world named it, became a magical place that evoked both fascination and terror.
Features
Survival
Discover numerous survivors in the open world. Save and recruit them for your camps. Find food, build shelters, and combat diseases to prevent your survivors from succumbing to death.

Base Building
In the open world, you can establish camps anywhere and expand them from a small refuge to a large compound. Build shelters, crafting stations, and defensive measures. Defend your camps against attacks of all kinds.

Farming
With the right tools, you can reforest trees and cultivate various types of plants and food. Care for your growing plants and harvest them when they are ripe.

Crafting
With a variety of workstations, you can craft new armor, weapons, food, and other useful items.

Fishing
Fishing is not just a means of food procurement in Eldoran but also a hobby. Catch fish and bring them to your own waters to breed.

Taming
Many primitive crystal beings from the Earth of Eldoran can be captured and trained to assist you in the struggle for survival.

title: The Raptured
description:
게임 정보
SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT AND JOIN THE DISCORD COMMUNITY



The Raptured is a TPS horror survival video game that follows Fletcher in Still Pines, overrun by apparitions that stalk the player. Find out what happened to the town, and try not to be consumed by the treacherous hordes of the apparitions.

The Raptured is a narrative-driven videogame experience that is fictitiously set in the 1990s after the Cold War and immerses the audience in misconstrued reality. Two novice journalists meet together to investigate a dodgy tip from someone anonymous, but little do they know, they are stumbling into the illegal testing grounds of a dangerous PMC.

title: Brave Glin in Fairyaria
description:
게임 정보
Play as Brave Glin, a little magical creature that getting lost in a forest, nedding face dangers on the way to return home!
- Freatures -
∎ Jump! Use enemies as platforms by jumping over their heads! Each enemy has a different reaction when they are trampled!
∎ Defend Yourself! Use a slingshot, a shield and even a stick to defend yourself from enemies!
∎ Super Star! Collect tiny stars, defeat enemies, increasing the experience bar to can collect the great Shooting Stars!
∎ 4 Thematic Worlds! Meet many charismatic characters, crossing the world of Fairyaria!
∎ Friends! The scarecrow Hans and the crow Crowie will help you on the journey!

title: Symphony Stride
description:
게임 정보
Build powerful combos in this two-character roguelike deckbuilder. Craft a deck as you progress through adventures and follow an immersive storyline told using hand drawn comics!


This game features a unique mana system that elevates your decision-making to the next level. When one character plays a card, the other character gets one mana. However, mana comes in different colors! Play the right cards in order to unlock stronger ones in your hand!


Explore a unique experience every time you embark on a run. Choose any two characters to form a team, unlocking new potentials from each!


Join our heroes in their journey through a story told using fully colored comics.

title: Skate O'Clock
description:
게임 정보
Skate O'Clock is dynamic, action, skateboarding game in retro style.
Win the race against time by collecting coins through multiple levels.

title: Jötunn's Greed
description:
게임 정보
Down with the Jötunn! Take down that giant!

A war-hungry giant has laid siege to your village. Play as a viking village chief and raid nearby villages to build your home back up from the ruins. Risk losing your gathered loot by venturing further into the continent and raiding more difficult villages. If you're strong enough, you'll reach the Jötunn's village and take revenge!
Gather Supplies
Each village is stocked with chests and other containers full of building supplies, currency and equipment to help your village grow. The farther in you go, the more loot you can acquire.
Choose your build
Choose between different sets of weapons and armor, each giving you different stat upgrades and attack abilities.
Fight for your life
Your health is limited. Losing all of your health on a raid will cause you to drop all of your acquired loot and return to your home village.
Upgrade your village
Had some successful raids? Use the supplies you gathered to upgrade buildings in your home village, giving you access to better equipment and new abilities.
Wield God-like powers
Utilize 1 of 5 possible powers of the Norse gods while on your raids, giving you special abilities.
Avoid the Storm
Some Norse deities do not like loot hogs. After spending too much time in a single village, a storm will appear, forcing you to move on or perish.
Navigate Through the Fog
Until the storm arrives, each village you raid is filled with dense fog, making it difficult to find your way around.
No Two Villages are the Same
Each village is procedurally generated. Just because you found your way before does not guarantee you will again.

title: Pote Pote Dream
description:
게임 정보
Pote Pote Dream is an action RPG featuring Pote Pote, a timid teddy bear who cannot fight on his own, summons allies to battle. Set in the dream world of his owner, a girl, Pote Pote fights against her inner troubles to save her.
Summon Allies to Drive Away Negative Emotions
Frightened Pote Pote can't fight on its own, but he can call on friends for help. Summon allies to favorable positions, distract enemies, and move around the map according to the situation.
Vibrant Stages Made of Felt
Each stage is crafted from handmade felt plushies and set to original, pop music. The map is randomly generated each time, offering a unique gameplay experience with every playthrough.
Collect Diverse Allies to Form Your Own Team
Earn points by challenging stages, and use these points to gather strong allies and build your team. Combine unique allies with stamina, long-range attack capabilities, and other special traits to create your ideal team.
Randomly Generated Dungeons
After clearing the story, you can repeatedly play in dungeons that are randomly generated.

title: The Herd
description:
게임 정보
《The Herd》에서 당신의 목표는 가능한 한 많은 동물을 구하고, 그들이 세계 곳곳의 위험을 안전하게 통과하도록 돕는 것입니다.
불꽃：
동물들은 그렇게 똑똑하지 않을 수도 있지만, 불꽃을 피하는 등의 기본적인 생존 본능을 가지고 있습니다. 이 점을 활용하여 동물들을 원하는 방향으로 유도하세요!

title: Kenoma: Action Without Action
description:
게임 정보
Due to the high-contrast between the "two worlds" of the game, switching between them quickly may trigger photosensitive epilepsy. Please exercise caution.
Kenoma: Action Without Action is a 2D-sidescrolling graphic adventure game focused on a peculiar narrative experience, a two-sided game world, and a streamlined version of the classic adventure-game feel.
The world has been in two pieces since time immemorial. One knows death, the other does not. Which would you rather live in?
Moving between the halves of the world is instant, easy, and entirely at your discretion. Any time, anywhere, so long as you won't land inside the floor. A spectral image of the other half is always visible to keep you informed. Some problems can only be solved by going back and forth!
Take the role of a driven wanderer and travel these world-halves, finding and destroying the pillars of one to ensure the continued survival of the other. All you need is your wits, the things you can find on the floor, and the help of a few strangers to complete your task.

title: Fantastic Frolic
description:
게임 정보
Fantastic Frolic is an RPG with survival elements set in the whimsical world of Quirkyland. Players take on the roles of one of three main characters - Lil' J, Esther, and Gorf - as they embark on a quest to save the world from Mount Akma's prophesied volcanic explosion.



The game combines classic RPG mechanics like combat, character progression, and exploration with survival elements such as resource management and crafting. Players must gather evidence to prove the volcanic explosion prophecy is real while battling monsters and overcoming challenges in a quirky land that doesn't believe the prophecy could be true.



Key Features
- Play as beloved Adventure Time inspired characters Lil' J, and Gorf
- Dynamic RPG combat against outlandish monsters
- Survival mechanics like resource gathering and item crafting
- Uncover clues to prove the impending volcanic explosion and save the world
- Stylized visuals and music that capture the game's unique charm




Ancient prophecies say that Mount Akma was the entity responsible for the creation of all of Quirkyland. Priests from ancient tribes tell the story of Akma's fury and kindness when, after millennia in his eternal sleep, he announced his awakening with the blossoming of a beautiful cherry tree on its summit, thus the Prophecy of the Ashen Tree was born. Some say that the birth of the cherry tree represents the kindness of Akma, who warned the gods of its imminent eruption. Others believe that Akma defied the gods, causing destruction and death in his path, in a rage that lasted hundreds of years.



Whether out of kindness or fury, the fact is that Akma, after his awakening, drove away the gods and gave rise to Quirkyland, the rocks, the earth, the rivers, and all the life that lives in it today. The desperate gods even tried to contain Akma's momentum, each one was responsible for manufacturing a small artifact, which should contain the powers of each God to calm the primordial volcano. Thus, Brumal, the goddess of Winter, created the Heart of Eternal Ice. Aureon, the god of Autumn, created the Scepter of Serenity. Flora, the goddess of Spring, created the Orb of Tranquility. However, Helion, the god of Summer, enchanted by the heat of the volcanic flames, did not fulfill his promise, breaking the pact between the gods, and allowing Akma to awaken.

Today, Akma's silhouette reigns supreme, and can be seen from all corners of this world, imposing, and once again asleep. This sleep is as long as your firstborn eruption.



Thanks to Akma, today Quirkyland is a prosperous land. Its soil, rich in nutrients, provided by its progenitor, allows the planting of the most diverse crops. Be it the abundant grape vines on the outskirts of Brightopolis, the abundant fungi in the Swirl Swamp, or the wheat, cultivated for years by goblins on the Peculiar Plateau, the fact is that everything that is planted grows in Quirkyland.

These days, the cherry tree has blossomed again, announcing Akma's imminent reawakening. But time passed, and today Brightopolis looks to other horizons. Its population does not think about gods, fury, kindness and magical artifacts, and does not even believe that a volcano can erupt, even the slightest mention of the idea is a complete delusion for many.

Lady Iris, the ruler of Brightopolis and princess of all Quirkyland, is one of the few people who still believes in the Ashen Tree Prophecy and the scientific evidence that proves that it once occurred. Knowledgeable about all the beings in her prosperous kingdom, she encountered a trio of good-hearted adventurers, and revealed to them, through a dream, the real meaning of the cherry blossom. Summoning them to his court, he imbued them with the task of taking knowledge throughout Quirkyland, and even more importantly, finding these lost artifacts and taking them to the summit of Akma, offering peace and serenity to the primordial entity, to thus guarantee the survival of the beings of Quirkyland.

title: Streamer Content: a simple mechanic
description:
게임 정보
The "Streamer Guy" is doing his routine live stream while his frustration serves as content and entertainment. In the midst of it, he reaches his limit and, after rage-quitting, decides to embark on a journey of self-discovery to find out who he is and what his position is in the world and the universe. Help Streamer Guy in this difficult journey using only a mouse!
Enjoy:

A simple mechanic! Move the mouse cursor using the center of the screen as the base, and Streamer Guy will move in the same intensity. Anyone can get the hang of it!

Punitive level design? You punish yourself, the level design doesn't react! With that in mind, you'll do very well in this peculiar platform and climbing game :D

Super personalized gameplay time! Your skills and persistence will completely dictate the game's duration. You're in charge!

Curiously random and mysteriously satisfying scenarios! (Wow) Talk to NPCs during the journey!

Microscopic budget! (But 100% effective!) You wouldn't expect anything less from this genre of game, especially coming from an indie group called "rotten post" :)

Have fun at a low cost or give it as a gift to your dear friend ;)
autokwd: Streamer Content: a simple mechanic, a simple game

title: Manludo 2
description:
게임 정보
You wake up on an alien space station. In this expansive sequel, every decision you make shapes your journey. Will you seize control of the station, flee to unknown territories, ignite a galactic conflict, broker peace, aid your newfound companions, or pursue riches? The choice is yours.

Engage in the unique game called 'Manludo'—a hand game of rock, paper, scissors—to challenge and outsmart the station's alien inhabitants. Success in these contests can elevate your status and influence within the station, unlocking new paths and possibilities.

Gameplay:
Experience a richly branching narrative in this game. Replay it many times. Simply press the spacebar or click to progress through the dialog. When faced with a choice, click on the corresponding button to determine your character's fate. Navigate through complex interactions and pivotal decisions to craft your unique story amidst the stars.

--- Esperanto ---
Vi vekiĝas sur ekstertera kosmostacio. En ĉi tiu vasta aventuro, ĉiu decido, kiun vi faras, formigas vian vojaĝon. Ĉu vi prenos kontrolon de la stacio, fuĝos al nekonataj teritorioj, komencos galaksian konflikton, intertraktos pacon, helpos viajn novajn kunulojn, aŭ ĉasos riĉaĵojn? La elekto estas via.

Partoprenu en la unika ludo nomata 'Manludo'— ŝtono, papero, tondilo—por defii kaj superlerti la eksterterajn loĝantojn de la stacio. Sukceso en ĉi tiuj konkuroj povas altigi vian statuson kaj influon en la stacio, malŝlosante novajn vojojn kaj eblecojn.

Kiam vi alfrontiĝos kun elekto, klaku la korespondan butonon por determini la sorton de via rolulo. Navigu tra kompleksaj interagoj kaj decidoj, kiuj estas klavaj, por teksi vian unikan rakonton inter la steloj.

title: Sliding Hero
description:
게임 정보
슬라이딩 히어로는 장애물을 만날 때까지 한 방향으로 미끄러져 이동하는 탐험 퍼즐 게임입니다.

저택의 수많은 시련을 이겨내고 저택에 갇힌 상황에 숨겨진 진실의 가면을 벗겨낼 수 있을까요?
이동과 미스터리가 핵심인 메트로배니아 퍼즐 게임
불길한 베네치아 저택에 갇힌 상태에서, 순발력과 지력으로 세레니시마의 군인 루카 시코모로가 탈출하도록 도와주세요. Sliding Hero에서는 이동할 때마다 전략을 시험하게 됩니다. 장애물에 부딪힐 때까지 한 방향으로만 슬라이딩할 수 있어, 이동 그 자체가 퍼즐이 되니까요. 1700년대 베네치아와 카니발 가면 속 신비에 영감을 받은, 복잡하며 어둠에 휩싸인 세계를 탐험하세요. 모든 그림자 속에 위험과 속임수가 숨어 있습니다

title: Greed Forest
description:
게임 정보
A real-time strategy tower defense game set in a dangerous yet resource-rich forest. Build your base, shape your defenses, and fend off relentless enemy swarms in a battle for survival and supremacy.
Gather and Grow:
Harvest gold, wood and stone from the forest to expand your base, unlock upgrades, and build advanced tech structures.
RTS Meets Tower Defense:
Experience the strategy of a classic RTS without unit micro-management. Focus entirely on defending against massive waves of enemies.
Campaign and Creativity:
Dive into a challenging campaign or use the built-in map editor to design and share your own custom scenarios.
Greed Forest is about mastering the balance between resource management, strategic planning, and creative defense.

title: Odyssey Times - A Quest  Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of Odyssey Times, a retro-inspired JRPG that combines the charm of classic SNES-era games with a modern twist. Crafted with love for games like Final Fantasy and Undertale, this game takes you on an epic journey filled with emotion and strategy!
 A Story-Driven Adventure
In Odyssey Times, you’ll embark on a captivating quest filled with rich characters, mysterious lands, and dark forces threatening the world. This game attempts to capture the spirit of the 16-bit JRPGs you know and love - while adding fresh mechanics that push the genre forward. Battle enemies with a dynamic combat system, explore beautifully crafted pixel landscapes, and solve puzzles as you unravel the narrative.
 Stunning Pixel Art and Soundtrack
Immerse yourself in the handcrafted pixel art that calls back to the golden age of RPGs by AAA and PixelBoy.
Complementing the visuals is an epic soundtrack carrying you through the highs and lows of your journey made by Haberchuck.
(Check out their amazing stuff on itch!)

title: Side42 the tavern of infinity
description:
게임 정보
About This Game

Side42 is a retro platformer that challenges your precision and reflexes. Dive into an adventure spanning 5 chapters, with a total of 20 thrilling levels, each designed to test your skills.

Game Features:

Challenging Gameplay :
Master your skills with a controller to overcome complex obstacles. Please note that a controller is required to play this game.

Time Trial Mode :
Replay levels to beat your best time or collect all the gold.

Simple and Humorous Story :
Enjoy a light-hearted and funny narrative that accompanies you throughout your journey.

Get ready for a captivating gaming experience with Side42, where each level tests your dexterity in a charming retro universe.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Play as a hero who wants to return to the tavern after saving the universe, but the return doesn't go as planned. An odd journey beyond the hero's known boundaries begins, much to his chagrin, because, well, he's finished saving the universe, and there's not even a taxi to take him back, no, he has to walk the way back.

Key features of the game:

-Epic storyline, Post-it style.

-No complex quests, just challenging moments to get back home.

-Your goal: achieve the best time to impress your friends.

-Unique blend of hand-drawn art and contemporary 3D graphics, creating a strange yet captivating aesthetic.

-Test your skills and composure in training rooms to master the art of mastery, like a true master.

-Playable only with a controller for an immersive experience.

-The gameplay remains consistent, it's you who evolves to overcome the challenges.

Get ready for an original gaming experience, where humor, action, and challenges await you at every turn, except when they don't.

title: Infernae
description:
게임 정보


A bullet hell game where dodging and cowering for your life will claim it. Fear is not shield, a lesson Asmus learned long ago. Will the lesson pass down onto you?
Play through a boss rush of increasingly challenging foes, and watch your game over count go up with each one. We are not responsible for bouts of frustration and indignation. Control your emotions, or they will control you.



A starwitch has been marked for death, and the duty of a memento mori is to carry out their deliverance. That's Asmus' story. But she has a story of her own too, and Lucine will make sure he listens to her if it's the last thing she does.
Lucine is one of several bosses that will be featured in Infernae. Each one has a story to tell, a secret between them that Asmus doesn't want you to know about.

title: Faith in Despair
description:
게임 정보

독특한 플레이 스타일을 가진 새로운 스타터 덱을 잠금 해제하세요

title: Neon Net
description:
게임 정보
The gameplay follows the rules of the "Minesweeper" game, but does not stop the game when a player opens a "mine", it only imposes a time penalty. Since the goal is to complete a task within a certain time (usually finding "keys"), and not just to open all the cells, it makes the game more dynamic, forcing the player to take risks, and challenges the players' quick decision-making skills.

RPG elements create progression and allow you to customize the game to your style - the player can improve both the effectiveness of certain skills and reduce the penalties for using them.

One of the mechanics is also the search for "targets" and the correct use of their finances - to find higher-ranking criminal AIs, the player needs to improve their systems at the right time and choose the most "profitable" targets.

The game also has a storyline, during which the player will choose certain answers that will affect the outcome of the story.

title: LIMINOUS
description:
게임 정보
LIMINOUS is a first-person survival horror game. An immersive experience meant to flip the book on the genre, with just as many reasons to find danger as there are to avoid it. You'll find yourself in the shoes of resident explorer, Sydney, tasked with exploring unknown gaps in our reality in search of anything worth finding.
WORLDS BEYOND
Venture into the unknown, documenting discoveries and solving the mysteries of worlds we can't quite explain. Using the new dimensional portal, you'll find yourself in worlds small and large, familiar and not. Solve puzzles, log your findings, and steer clear of danger while venturing into this untold story. Make no mistake, this is a largely linear story, and remember, you're an intruder in these domains. Not every new face is a friendly one.
TOOLS OF THE TRADE
While you'll be traveling alone, you aren't without help. The boys in the lab are just a long-distance interdimensional transmitter away, always coming up with new tools to help you on your not-so-optional quest. Your discoveries, and anything you can bring back to the lab, will help fund these new tools to aid you on your journey. Best be cautious, however, as the story will continue to be told, whether you're prepared for it or not.
This is a story and project crafted by a solo developer. A labor of love that I hope you enjoy playing as much as I enjoyed making it.

title: Overthrone
description:
게임 정보
HEXAFLIP is a gripping strategy game that blends the classic sensibilities of tabletop strategy with the vibrant energy of a digital board game. Whether your prefer to outsmart other players in PvP skirmishes, or you like to obsess over optimal strategies in the campaign mode, this is a game for you!
Key Mechanics
Charge and Capacity. Each hexagon has a capacity (think of it as it's health), and charge. The charge represents the damage potential of a hexagon, or the number of nearby enemy hexagons it can zap.
Recharging. Using up charge makes the hexagons potentially less effective in future turns. But every time you use up all the charge on a hexagon, it triggers a recharge of all your hexagons. Plan your attacks wisely and create a satisfying recharge loop.
Special Abilities. Multiple special abilities are available (and more will be added). These abilities can spice up the dynamics in the game and take your plays to the next level! Special abilities require unstable charge to operate.
Unstable Charge. Unstable charge will gather on enemy hexagons. You need to zap the hexagons containing it to pick it up. At the end of each turn, the unstable charges migrate on the board challenging you to adapt on the spot.
Game Modes
Campaign: Single-player mode where you try to clear the map in as few turns as possible.
PVP: Play against other players on symmetrical maps. Choose your special abilities wisely and rank up on the ladder.
Daily Challenge: A single-player mode where a new unique map is released every day and all players compete to solve it as quick and as efficient as possible.
Abilities
ZAP
This is the normal attack. Activate a hexagon you control to zap nearby enemy and neutral hexagons.



This is a single-use ability. It upgrades any hexagon on the map to 6 capacity and 6 charge.



This is a single-use ability. It demotes any hexagon on the map to 1 capacity and 1 charge.



Permanently flip the owner of any hexagon on the map. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Place a retaliation rod on any hexagon. When that hexagon is attacked it will attack back. Up to 6 retaliation rods may be placed on a single hexagon. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Performs a more powerful, frenzied, attack from any hexagon you own. For each charge two attacks will be performed. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Infiltrate an enemy hexagon and perform an attack from it as if it were yours. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.

title: WANKO WANKO ADVENTURE
description:
게임 정보
Setting:
The mutation came suddenly.
A mysterious virus attacked everything, transforming everything into a square shape.
Buildings, creatures, even dogs.

You are a dog that has been transformed into a square.
You must go deep into the resort hotel to find your lost family and solve the mystery.


How to Clear:
The door to the hotel room is sealed and you are locked in,
The door to the hotel room is sealed and you are locked in, but if you clear all the squares scattered around the room, the door will open and you will be able to move on.


Controls:
The strange floating paddle on which the dog rides can be operated in various ways!

It can push a large number of objects like a bull tozer,
or swing it like a tennis racket to send things flying far away,
Sometimes they collect things in one place and sometimes they roll them around.

The objects are moving with physical behavior, so you can control them intuitively as if they were right there, and everyone can enjoy the game with a refreshed and exhilarated feeling.


Hotel:
Scattered objects vary from room to room.
Black pollutants are burned in the incinerator, or the luggage of travelers is taken to the collection station,
mysterious precious metals in a collection device, sometimes bold, sometimes subtle.

This new beautiful world combines the retro architectural tones of the 70's with the poly-poly, shiny CG expressions of the 90's.
What lies behind the facility? Will dogs be able to meet their families?
Operation Doggie Doggie is a fun adventure action game with intuitive controls.
