title: Agama versus Bugs
description:
게임 정보


In the heart of a bustling city, in a quiet corner of a certain apartment, there is a small but full of wonders world - a terrarium. This is where a certain hungry agama lives. Take part in the adventures of a lizard who has an unusual passion for bugs.

A 2.5D platform game offering many different worlds (terrariums) filled to the brim with bugs, but also with traps!
Explore the terrarium
Track down and attack unaware victims by surprise, and if they see you, chase them because they will run away!
Find the lost eggs hidden in all the terrariums.
Travel between terrariums through magical vents.

title: An Unfinished Game
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Unfinished Game™ Testing facility! As our new tester, you will have to make your way through a series of unexpected experiments in this first-person adventure. Small puzzles, platforming, meta gameplay and a group of silly NPC awaits you in this unpredictable factory.

The goal? Succesfully finish all tests so that we'll finally be able to release this "Unfinished Game" of ours!

One thing for sure, expect only the unexpected in here!



What you will find:

Simple puzzles
Platforming
Physics based elements
Other testing bot eager to talk with you
Some bugs (voluntary..?)
Collectables
Easter eggs
Unintentional features
And of course, silliness

title: Degenerates
description:
게임 정보


Degenerates is an action-packed, Virtual Reality superhero game. Take control of 3 different super-heroes each with their own unique set of powers: Earth, Telekinesis, and Electricity. Fight off waves of enemies in large combat arenas featuring destructible environments and epic boss fights.



After being deemed a threat to society, a group of young metahumans are detained in a government research lab for people with superpowers. There they are forced to use their powers to fight for survival.

title: Morgman
description:
게임 정보
MORGMAN is a first-person horror game, a hybrid of classic survival horror and puzzle.
You find yourself deep in the forest, in an abandoned mansion with a dark past. You'll need to explore its dark corridors and rooms while staying alive.
By gathering scattered clues and solving tricky puzzles, you'll come closer to unraveling the dark secrets of this place. And try not to become a victim of the unknown evil lurking within the mansion's walls, waiting for you in the most unexpected places.
Plot:
Your sister is an archaeologist and hasn't been in touch with you for the past few days. You managed to pinpoint her last location, which led you to a remote place deep in the Lapland forests...

title: Pirate Escape
description:
게임 정보
In Pirate Escape, you play as one of several captains and control a pirate ship, trying to survive 15 waves. You can turn your ship left and right, but never stop. Shooting is automatic. When you destroy enemy ships, they drop crates of coins. Between waves, you can buy items in the store or hire crew members.

title: Skyt
description:
게임 정보
This game is a arcade block placing puzzle game added with some Tower Defense mechanics and strategy.
Build and defend your fort, with your minigun and defenses against massive amounts of enemies and survive until the last wave.


Build a fort! Stack physically simulated tetromino blocks on top of eachother to build forts high up in the sky. But don't let the blocks fall down or your fortress will collapse! The more blocks you have the more defenses you can maintain, so keep buying new ones.



Tear them apart! Shoot the incoming airships with a minigun to destroy them, before they explode infront of your tower and ruining your carefully placed blocks. Fight against ranged cannon airships, which shoot at your tower where it is most sensible, or ballons which attack your tower by letting bombs fall from above.



Build Cannons in the sky, to defend your tower against the airships, or boost your economy by building windmills, so you can maintain or expand the defenses you've built.

title: Loki's Revenge
description:
게임 정보
"오랜 세월 아스가르드 신들에게 죄와 속임수로 갇혀 있던 로키가 탈출하여 복수를 시작했습니다! 로키는 충성스러운 괴물 군대를 풀어 왕국을 공포에 떨게 하고, 노르드 신들로부터 통제권을 빼앗으려 합니다. 좋아하는 신으로 싸워 로키와 그의 군대를 물리치세요!
로키의 충성스러운 군대를 물리치세요

드라우그, 오거, 늑대 - 이들은 모두 로키를 위해 싸우며 반드시 막아야 합니다! 거대한 몬스터와 보스의 무리를 물리치세요.
레벨 업하고 강력한 업그레이드를 얻으세요

적을 물리치면 XP가 떨어집니다. 충분히 모아 레벨을 올리면 3개의 강력한 업그레이드 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다! 일부 업그레이드는 통계를 향상시키고, 다른 업그레이드는 새로운 공격 방법을 제공합니다. 궁극의 신을 만들기 위해 최대한 많이 수집하세요!

신들은 죽지 않습니다! 죽거나 미션을 완료한 후, 얻은 XP로 영구 업그레이드를 구매할 기회가 주어집니다. 신들의 통계를 향상시키거나 각 신에게 고유한 업그레이드를 선택하여 선호하는 신을 더욱 강하게 만드세요!

각 지도는 수작업으로 설계되었으며, 절차적 생성이 없습니다! 각각의 지도에는 강력한 업그레이드가 숨겨져 있습니다. 찾으면 향후 진행을 위해 업그레이드 풀에 영구적으로 추가됩니다.
"

title: Panic In Store !
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Panic in Store!

As a supermarket employee, you will be required to go from store to store, carrying out short missions for the store chain that employs you. You will have to put the right cardboards (cereal, game, fruit, etc.) in the right aisles (cereal, games, fruit, etc.) while paying attention to the obstacles that will get in your way in this game casual but nervous.
Be a good employee!

Advance from level to level, obtaining more and more stars in order to show the world your skills as a supermarket employee!
Watch out for customers and random events that are there to get in your way.
Beware of the storm!

Random events may occur during your missions: slippery puddles, inverted movements, increased number of customers in the store, level plunged into darkness. You will need to understand these events and how to defuse them, without losing sight of your main objective.
A unique apartment!

As you complete your missions during the various levels of the game, you will unlock furniture and accessories to personalize your apartment.
A fabulous look!

Become a true fashion victim by unlocking various clothes and outfits as you progress to make your games even more fun!

title: Star Child
description:
게임 정보
Star Child is an explosive new futuristic action-adventure game built by a small and passionate indie team.

Explore a mysterious alien world full of unique environments, populated by dangerous alien foes.



Conquer a variety of bosses, each one designed to have a unique visual and gameplay style.

Discover secret areas, find new weapons, enhance your abilities, and destroy any obstacles in your way!

Feeling a bit overwhelmed by it all? Relax for a moment and catch some fish!

Colorful, hand-crafted pixel art
Powerful original soundtrack composed by Tantrum Tech
Multiple difficulties designed for a wide range of ages and skill levels
Full keyboard and controller support

title: Rise of the Bugs
description:
게임 정보
A colony of Bugs living in the basement of a house is running out of food. The elder sends a search group to retrieve the mystical sauce from the kitchen. There are legends that this sauce allows cockroaches to mutate and become stronger. Can you survive in the kitchen and come back a winner?
Interact with your Bugs-friends and random passerby as you mission! They will give you information that help you, and you can get even closer to kitchen goal!
RISE OF THE BUGS features a branch of improve and mutations of the Bugs. Unlock new playable characters as you progress through the game. Each of them has unique animations and new capabilities.

title: Shadoblitz
description:
게임 정보
This is a high-freedom hack-and-slash roguelite. As an apprentice reaper, you must undergo the Reaper's trials, fighting strategically in limited spaces, absorbing evil spirits, and using the environment to your advantage!

title: Nuclear Tides
description:
게임 정보
Nuclear Tides is a minimalist tower defense game. After the nuclear apocalypse, the isolated island is filled with radiation. Clear the radiation and build structures and turrets during the day, and defend your base against the onslaught of nuclear tides at night. Game features include：
Procedurally generated initial land plots.
Dozens of different land plots include buildings, turrets, and wonders. Most of the time, two identical plots can be combined to form a higher-level plot.
The synergistic effects of turrets
Be mindful not to let emissions get too high, or it will lead to disaster. Find a balance between economy, defense, and the environment.

title: King's Subsidy
description:
게임 정보
King's Subsidy is a turn-based economic strategy game with rogue-lite mechanics.

Plan. Develop. Yield. Trade. Protect.

Over 60 crafting recipes
Complex crafting tree. Plan Your strategy according to the chances game gives You. Each material has its own use. You will have to decide if something is worth crafting with Your supply chain.



Different maps
Adapt to surrounding area and take advantage of it.




Choose wisely which materials to collect and which to buy. Is it worth switching to based on current market trends?




Help the king restore the economy to order. If You don't pay the tribute every few dozen You will lose.




Use the unique skills of the most influential merchants in the world and develop their potential. Each game You can pick a different set of skills to approach next run differently.




Adapt Your research to market trends. You will decide what, when and where You will trade the goods. All of these will vary every run.

title: Zombiehood
description:
게임 정보

절차적으로 생성된 세계를 달리고 총을 쏘세요. Zombiehood는 당신이 무작위 무기, 탄약 및 아티팩트를 관리하면서 점점 더 강력해지는 좀비 무리를 상대하는 도전을 합니다. 죽음과 함께 새로운 시작이 오며, 지도가 재설정됩니다. 그러나 진행 상황은 경험치와 돈의 형태로 계속되어, 이를 사용해 런 간에 캐릭터를 강화할 수 있습니다.
강렬한 전투
Zombiehood의 전투는 속이 깊습니다. 적은 특정 약점, 갑옷 및 저항력을 가지고 있어, 게임에서 긴장감을 유지해야 합니다. 부위별 데미지는 사지와 머리를 쏘면 새로운 적 유형을 유발할 수 있습니다. 움직임은 타이트하고 무게감이 있으며 비커밋형 회피는 빠르게 움직일 수 있게 합니다. 다양한 무기 종류가 게임을 흥미롭게 유지합니다.
에머전트 로그라이트 시스템
Zombiehood의 시스템은 서로 겹쳐집니다. 수십 가지 무기를 수집하고 스탯을 업그레이드하면 아티팩트를 발견하게 됩니다. 아티팩트는 무작위 게임플레이 수정자를 제공하여 플레이 방식을 형성하며, 이들은 쌓입니다. 이러한 수정자와 올바른 무기 간의 시너지를 찾아 강력한 빌드를 만들어 적을 물리치세요.

무한한 맵 다양성
맵은 바이옴으로 구성되며, 이는 다양한 레벨 풀로 구성됩니다. 이러한 레벨은 각 런마다 무작위로 선택되고 생성되어 두 번의 런이 동일하지 않게 됩니다. 전쟁의 안개가 맵을 덮고 있으며, 이를 탐험하여 최종 보스에게 도달해야 합니다. 도중에 보충 및 치유할 수 있는 상점과 도와주거나 해를 끼칠 수 있는 무작위 이벤트를 찾게 될 것입니다.
끝없는 전투
성공적인 런을 완료하면 새로운 '해골 난이도'가 잠금 해제됩니다. 이 난이도는 최대 5번까지 중첩될 수 있으며, 50레벨의 적을 상대할 수 있습니다. 더 큰 적은 더 큰 보상을 의미하며, 이를 통해 최적의 미니멕싱을 추구하면서 캐릭터를 업그레이드할 수 있습니다.
오픈 소스
치트 브랜치에서 개발자 콘솔에 액세스할 수 있습니다. 탐험하고, 실험하고, 게임플레이 시스템을 조작하여 독특한 시나리오와 도전을 만드세요. 또한, 코드는 완전히 오픈 소스이며, 리믹스하고, 적응하고, 새로운 콘텐츠를 제작하여 게임의 커뮤니티 주도 진화를 가능하게 합니다.

title: Legend vs. Legion
description:
게임 정보
THE WORLD'S LAST HOPE...
Kingdom Valia is in ruin. Roads are infested with bandits and ratfolk marauders. Safe havens are safe no longer, having been overtaken by vicious orcs, cunning goblins, enchanted golems, bomb-hurling automata, and ... animated crops?!
Legend... you must clear the land of this evil!
A VAST ARRAY OF SPELLS AT YOUR DISPOSAL...
.
Gather potent spells and mystic artifacts as you conquer mighty foes. Strategically choose among choices of spells and artifacts to develop your own unique playstyle. As you grow stronger, use your new powers to keep enemies from passing!
SLASH, DODGE, AND ROLL YOUR WAY TO VICTORY...
.

title: Sea of Brave: Beast Island
description:
게임 정보
For hundreds of years, the elders have spoken of a unique city, made entirely of gold, hidden from the world for 500 years; according to legend, there is only one map, which was separated into parts and hidden all over the world. This is how hundreds of brave men and women began their search, braving the unknown, in the fantastic world of Sea of Brave.
Sea of Brave Beast Island is a turn-based, tactical deck-building roguelike game for one player. Join Aidan on his perilous adventure on Benryu Island, defeating Captain Kingg's minions to uncover his secrets. Create a unique deck by discovering new cards, allies, or improving your deck through each battle.

title: Blunder The Sea
description:
게임 정보
Dive in head first and enjoy this chaotic underwater experience!

Manage Your Oxygen: You lose oxygen over time! Enemies drop oxygen bubbles to refill your meter. Keep up with it or suffer the consequences...
Enemy Drops: Speaking of enemies, they also have a chance to drop upgrades! These don't last forever, so take advantage of them while they last!
Permanent Upgrades: Before you go into battle you get to choose a permanent upgrade to change how you play the game. Be careful, there are drastic downsides to each upgrade. Read carefully!

title: Dreamcatchers
description:
게임 정보
Gökçe and Ilayda are attacked by Dream Thieves,
They are traveling to prevent the return of their sworn enemies.
You will witness the fantastic battles of the Moon People, Dream Thieves, Kam and Alkarısı.
Don't forget to get clues from your dreams with palm reading while solving the puzzles!

title: Tiny Kingdoms
description:
게임 정보
Tiny Kingdoms is a peaceful building strategy and puzzle game where you transform a whimsical landscape into a thriving, ever-expanding kingdom, one tile at a time. Explore a variety of vibrant biomes, each with unique resources and challenges. As you unlock new tiles, strategically place them on the hexagonal grid to create harmonious settlements, sprawling farms, and bustling trade routes.
Strategic Tile Placement
Carefully plan your kingdom's layout. Each hexagonal tile offers distinct resources and building opportunities. Optimize your placement to forge productive chains, like placing farms near mills to generate flour for bakeries.
Resource Management: Gather and utilize wood, stone, crops, and other resources to construct buildings, expand your settlements, and keep your tiny citizens happy and productive.
Vibrant Biomes
Uncover lush forests, sparkling rivers, rugged mountains, and more! Each biome presents its own advantages and obstacles, requiring you to adapt your building strategies.
Unlockable Tiles: As you progress, discover and unlock new tiles, expanding your construction options and enabling you to create more complex and impressive structures.
Relaxed Quest System
Embark on quests to propel your kingdom's growth. These quests will encourage you to explore different biomes, experiment with resource management, and hone your strategic tile placement skills.
Peaceful Gameplay
Focus on building and creating, not combat. Nurture your kingdom and watch your tiny people thrive in a charming and stress-free environment.

Tiny Kingdoms offers a perfect blend of strategic puzzle solving, resource management, and world-building satisfaction. Dive in and create your own enchanting kingdom, tile by tile!

title: Hiragana Hero
description:
게임 정보

Learn to read, recognize, and use hiragana as you guide Keen Reflex through a 50-floor labyrinth in an addictive and educational dungeon crawler RPG!
Learning to read hiragana is the first step in your Japanese learning journey and it's the first hurdle that learners struggle to get over.
This addictive RPG dungeon crawler will have you reading Japanese in record time and cut out all that boring study.



Keen Reflex, an online streamer who teaches viewers Japanese with his experience as a professional Japanese translator and with his JLPT N1 Japanese fluency, has gotten whisked away to a magical land filled with creatures called hiragana that can only be defeated by shouting their name. Since arriving in this new world, Keen seems to have mysteriously forgotten how to read hiragana and only YOU can help him by guiding him through puzzles and hoards of hiragana , leveling up Keen's stats and your reading comprehension along the way!

title: Phoebe Eridani
description:
게임 정보
Defend the human colony on the planet Phoebe in the Eridani star system against a mysterious alien species. Utilize one of four fighter jets, each with unique abilities and attributes.

Features:
- pixel art
- unique fighters
- unique abilites
- lot of level
- strong bosses

title: Mini Worlds
description:
게임 정보
Do you want to create beautiful tiny cities without spending all of your time into resource management? Mini Worlds is for you!
Welcome to Mini Worlds, a cozy, relaxing sandbox for you to create whatever you want.
Generate beautiful and unique landscapes to play on.
Build and Decorate charming, tiny cities for your townsfolk.
No goals or timers, Mini Worlds is all about relaxing and creating your perfect world.
How does Mini Worlds work?
Choose the world of your dreams
Start creating beautiful cities
Kick back and relax

title: Rush N Crash
description:
게임 정보

Rush N Crash is an exciting kart racing game where humans and zombies engage in fierce competition, featuring both single-player and multiplayer modes. Players experience a unique adventure full of special abilities and strategies. Here are the highlights of our game:
Single and Multiplayer Modes: Hone your skills in the story-driven single-player mode or challenge rivals in the online multiplayer mode.
Fast-Paced and Competitive Gameplay: Race through dynamic tracks, boost your speed, outmaneuver opponents, and utilize defensive strategies to win.
Unique Modes: Offers various modes such as Challenge Mode (time-limited survival), Drag Race (speed-focused short races), Death Race (survival mode), and Classic Race.
Character Selection and Customization: Join either the human or zombie team, showcase your unique style with custom appearances, and get racing!
Strategic Power-Ups: Use rockets, obstacles, and permeability to surprise and outsmart your rivals.
Vivid Visuals and Dynamic Music: Experience the thrill of racing with cartoonish graphics and themed soundtracks that bring the atmosphere to life.

title: 90s MY DEAR
description:
게임 정보
90s MY DEAR is a simulation management game where you will play as a little boy who travels back in time to the 90s. Come on, collect various props from the 90s to help classic NPC characters unlock unique weapons and rescue this twisted world
Key Features:
Collection of classic items from the 1990s

Various daily necessities from the 1990s can be collected and converted into currency for transactions or assembled into props for customs clearance
Classic farm simulation management

You will operate a state-owned farm unique to China in the 1990s
Interacting with classic characters from 1990s movies or TV shows

Classic characters that appeared on TV screens or movies in the 1990s will interact with you in the future, completing the tasks they give you and unlocking various props for clearance. This is a farm simulation management game, where players will play as a little boy who travels back to the 1990s. Characters from classic movies and TV dramas from the 1990s will interact with you, helping them unlock various clearance props and restore our familiar world.

title: Conspiracy Crew
description:
게임 정보
Irving's Legitimate* Salvage Incorporated wants you!

Scavenge space stations for scrip with 3-16 players in this online asymmetric scavenging game. But watch out, some of your crewmates are rival corporate spies tasked with preventing you from meeting quota – by any means necessary!
Your Suit and You

We all know space can be a dangerous place. But not to worry! In partnership with Vacuum Solutions Limited, ILS is proud to provide each employee with a top of the line** All-Purpose Environmental Suit 3000 (APES)! Among its countless features are:

A fully functional*** life support to sustain you on the job
A state of the art Databracer™ that makes computer interfacing as easy as a tap of the wrist!
An integrated radio system that enhances synergy and collaboration with coworkers!

The 3000 model is known to have a few**** issues (mainly due to user error), so in the case of malfunction have a crewmate handy to make some emergency repairs!
Cruising in Style

A crew is nothing without a good vessel! Aboard the USS Behemoth, you’ll never find a need unmet. Keep watch for threats with its cutting-edge CCTV Security System, automatically repair and refill your suit with VSL’s revolutionary Replenishment Chamber, and spend your scrip on useful tools with our advanced Requisitions Hatch!


There are, of course, some hazards aboard the stations you’ll be scavenging. That’s why we’re paying you so much*****, after all! We trust with the training you’ve been given, those pesky critters will do you no harm.



URGENT UPDATE: Recent reports suggest our corporate adversaries have planted agents within our salvaging crews. Be vigilant, keep an eye out for signs of malicious behaviour, and if the need arises, do not hesitate to defend yourself. But above all-



Are you there Agent? Don’t worry, your benefactors have supplied you with a myriad of tools to dispose of these pests. Make sure they are unable to meet quota and we’ll make it worth your while.





-And remember, here at Irving's Legitimate* Salvage Incorporated we aren’t just co-workers. We’re a family!


*: As defined by the Outer Arm Federation, all property taken from residences, installations, or places of business that have been unoccupied for over two months is considered Legitimate Salvage. ILS Ltd. is not liable for any equipment falsely repossessed due to reasonable assumption of vacancy.

**: The APES 3000 was the most advanced and feature complete APES model at time of creation, compared to its counterparts the APES 2500 Lite and APES 2200 Vista.

***: The APES 3000 features a limited life support system that provides oxygen for up to a few minutes. Failure to replenish oxygen supply or repair tank leakages are deemed user errors for which neither Irving's Legitimate Salvage nor Vacuum Solutions Inc are liable.

****: Many.

*****: On average accounting for the unemployed population, your monthly earnings are in the top 80th percentile across the Outer Arm! Consider yourself fortunate.

title: Department of Gravity Management
description:
게임 정보
Control gravity, control the station. In this 3D Puzzle Platformer, you get to change gravity to solve physics-based puzzles. Meet your quotas, gain new abilities, and free the station from the oversight of the Newton Corporation.
Change Gravity: Activate gravity panels, cylinders, and spheres to change the gravity around you in different ways.  Use these to move Newtonium to reactors throughout the level.  Once you meet your quota, you can move on to the next level.
Walk on Walls: You can use the gravity panels to push and pull yourself in different directions.  Walk on the walls and ceilings.  Fly through the air.  Navigate the levels in creative ways.  Just be careful not to fly into the Newtonium reactors.
Fun with Physics: Send objects into orbit with fully simulated physical forces.  Anything not nailed down is affected by gravity changes, so have fun experimenting with how the different gravity panels affect objects in the game.  And of course, since you control the gravity, you can pick up and throw anything, no matter how big.
New Abilities: Gain new gravity-based abilities as you progress, creating new ways to navigate the world and solve puzzles.  You can create your own gravity panels, use the gravity hook to pull yourself through the air, and even slow time to consider your next move.  You'll need these abilities to navigate the levels and free the station from the oversight of the Newton Corportation.

title: Midnight Swamp
description:
게임 정보


Mysterious laughter echoed from the river on that restless summer night. Why the hell did you get out of the tent? You find yourself drawn into the gloomy world of Midnight Swamp, filled with strange inhabitants and thrilling puzzles.

Soon, the Witch from the gingerbread house is teaching you the basics of potion craft, and a talking Cat is convincing you to infiltrate the inhospitable castle towering over the swamp. But can you trust the locals? Do you have the courage to uncover the secrets of this place?
Well, it seems you have no choice...



A variety of puzzles, potion crafting, and location exploration
A dark swamp hiding a sinister secret
Many strange inhabitants to meet
Hand-drawn graphics

title: Come Home: Ghost Stories from Bangladesh
description:
게임 정보
Ghost Stories of Bangladesh is an atmospheric, first-person, horror game series based on the ghost stories of Bangladesh.
Come Home

Young Saif always loved going for walks with his dad in the forest near his home in Sylhet, Bangladesh. One day, everything changed when they became separated and Saif was left alone and frightened. What he encountered that day would impact the course of his life and reveal secrets about his home that, sooner or later, would need to be confronted.
Gameplay

First person, narrative driven with occasional, gentle, problem solving. Opportunities to take different paths which result in a different outcome to the story.
Features

Piece together your own story from the clues you discover.

Based on real ghost stories from Bangladesh.
autokwd: Come Home: Ghost Stories from Bangladesh

title: Alonecats
description:
게임 정보
We are excited to introduce our new puzzle game in the hidden object genre.



Your task is to find all the cats in the location. You can rotate/zoom the scene and interact with the environment to find all the hidden animals.



Key features:

- over 100 hidden cats
- 5 different locations
- simple puzzles

title: Legend of the Corndog
description:
게임 정보
Finding yourself out of food, you decide to venture into the outdoors for the first time in an embarrasingly long time in order to satiate your growing hunger.


Legend of the Corndog(s) is a First-Person, Open World Experience that thrives on not taking itself seriously. Believe us, we're just as shocked as you are.



Features Include:
- Pet the Dog!
- Talk to the Locals!
- Visit Strange Places!
- Make Shop Vendors lives Miserable!
- And More!

title: Influencer Boxing
description:
게임 정보
Step into the ring with "Influencer Boxing," a thrilling game featuring 12 of your favorite social media stars. Each influencer brings their unique style and charisma to intense boxing matches, set in dynamic, visually stunning arenas. Pick your fighter, engage in exciting story modes, and challenge other fighters. Who will emerge as the ultimate influencer champion? Join the fight and find out!

title: Faraway: On Lost Isles
description:
게임 정보
Faraway: On Lost Isles is a relaxing 2D top-down survival crafting game. Set on randomly generated islands, each play-through offers a unique experience filled with exploration, creativity, and survival.

Survive and Thrive:
In Faraway, your primary goal is to survive. Manage your health, comfort, and hunger as you navigate through the island's challenges. Gather resources, craft essential items, and build shelters to protect yourself from the dangers that lurk, especially during the night.

Build Your World:
Unleash your creativity with an extensive build system. Construct walls, floors, and furniture to create a cozy home. Customize your structures with textures and paint to make them truly your own. Whether you're building a functional base or a beautiful haven, the grid-based building mechanics offer endless possibilities.

Farm and Domesticate:
Discover seeds to start your own farm and lure wild animals to create a thriving homestead. Breed animals to produce offspring and establish a reliable source of food. Set up fish traps to catch fish and cook nourishing meals to sustain your survival.

Explore and Progress:
Each island is filled with resources, wild animals, and hidden structures. Repair broken bridges to access new islands, where you'll find advanced materials like gold. These materials unlock new crafting options, including electrical devices, waterwheels, and item transport systems.

Face the Night:
As night falls, prepare to defend yourself against mysterious creatures that emerge in the dark. These enemies drop valuable items that aid in your progression. The night adds a layer of suspense and challenge to your survival journey.

Create and Share:
The robust build system also supports custom map creation. Use special objects and a simple scripting system to design and share unique maps with the community. The in-game tutorial itself is crafted using this powerful tool, showcasing its potential for creative storytelling.

Embark on a adventurous journey in Faraway: On Lost Isles. Can you survive and uncover the mysteries of the lost isles?

title: BUILD SCRAP
description:
게임 정보
BUILD SCRAP is a deck-building roguelike with mass elements and customizability through markings, offering a more diverse and strategic combat experience.


Whether attacking, avoiding, or defending, sometimes you can use your enemies to take advantage of the stage.



You can customize the performance of your cards by synthesizing marks on them, allowing you to fight with your own unique cards and your own unique strategy.

Get through various situations created by unique enemies.

title: Toilet Zone 2
description:
게임 정보
You play as Hiru, a duck from the Exploration Guild. Their purpose is to chart and explore other worlds. Your expeditions are powered by the Power Crystal, an other worldly gem capable of producing portals.
But soon, you'll find that its use has unintended consequences....

Use the power of water-powered flight to navigate past enemies and obstacles. Explore a set of challenging levels and master the controls.

Master the Art Of Water-powered Flight
Navigate through increasingly difficult challenges
Create and share your own levels with the in-game level editor
Gather achievements and compete with your friends on the leaderboards

title: Dual Eclipse
description:
게임 정보

Dual Eclipse is a shortform dungeon crawler meant to be played over a weekend that resolves turn-based combat with trick-taking. Players will parry cards, turn the tide of battle with powerful Eclipse cards, and loot monsters to upgrade their decks.
Play as one of three classes to explore mysterious dungeons, evade dangerous traps, uncover powerful treasure, and discover secrets.
UNIQUE TRICK-TAKING COMBAT

title: Dice
description:
게임 정보

Welcome to a card-based roguelike where you, yes you, must save your village. What an honor, right? Roll the dice, play your cards, and laugh in the face of danger. Or at least try not to cry.


As soon as Koshchei opened his eyes, darkness began to spread throughout the forest. Trees whispered evil tales, rivers began to churn ominously, and cute little animals turned into evil monsters. Choose one of the five losers... I mean, heroes, living in your village, and venture into the forest where every bush hides danger, and every tree has an old story to tell. Get ready to battle the chicken-legged hut, get roasted by the firebird, and encounter other charming characters from Slavic folklore.


In this game, the dice decide your fate. A bad roll? Well, someone got up on the wrong side of the bed! But not all is lost, for your cards can change the course of battle. Play them wisely, and don’t forget a pinch of luck—you'll definitely need it. Dice, Destiny and Death is an adventure where every action can lead to either an epic victory or a colossal failure. The village is counting on you, hero. So go forth, save the world, and try not to become the next meal for some mythical beast! Good luck! We're all watching and laughing... I mean, believing in you.

title: Converse with a Small Person
description:
게임 정보
Converse With a Small Person is a narrative experience that will take around 2 hours to complete. It mainly consists of a conversation between you and an old friend you never really knew. It's your choice to find meaning in it and if you do, it will adapt.
A Story Shaped By Conversations
Every choice you make influences what will happen, think of it as talking to an old friend you haven't seen in a while. If he was flat.
Dialogue, Dialogue, and more Dialogue
This game heavily relies on you, the player, paying attention to what the little guy says. You cannot skip the text, so pay attention!
Talk a little Deeper
Choose choices that you wouldn't otherwise and see what the little guy says. You might be surprised how much it resonates.

title: Age of Enchantment
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Age of Enchantment, a thrilling blend of tower defense strategy and deckbuilding innovation!
In the realm of Alhambria, a once-peaceful land now faces an ancient evil reborn. As ominous shadows spread across the horizon, you must harness the power of arcane enchantments and strategic prowess to defend against hordes of undead and demonic adversaries. The various races of Alhambria must now come together to stand their ground and push back the Darkness.
Class-Inspired Towers: Draw upon archetypes from classic fantasy to build towers that reflect distinct combat roles. Choose from towers specializing in magic and physical damage as well as melee and ranged attacks. Each tower is modeled after iconic fantasy roles like powerful Wizards, swift Rangers, and stalwart Fighters. Create diverse combinations to exploit enemy weaknesses, ensuring no two defenses are ever the same.
Innovative Deckbuilding: Customize your strategy by building a deck of powerful cards, each offering unique abilities and synergies. Expand your arsenal at the Shop using currency earned during intense waves of combat
Dynamic Tower Defense: Experience classic tower defense mechanics with a twist. Place and upgrade towers strategically to fend off waves of enemies, each wave more formidable than the last.
Enchanting Powers: Enhance your towers with mystical enchants that amplify their strengths or unlock new tactical possibilities. Adapt your defenses on-the-fly to counter diverse enemy tactics.

title: Tree Simulator 2.0
description:
게임 정보
Have you always wanted to be a tree? According to studies, one in three people would like to have been a tree at least once in their lives. From birth, people long for freedom and wealth, but before you can put down roots you need a stable foundation of tree bark.
In this simulator you will experience what it is like to be a tree. You decide whether you graduate from the tree nursery and become an adult tree house or whether you prefer to do somersaults and end up as paper instead.
Be a tree outside the city
The more you are a tree, the more you will see. And there is a lot to see.

Be a Tree in the City

title: Chiaroscuro
description:
게임 정보

Chiaroscuro invites you into a world where light and shadow dictate reality. Navigate through mind-bending puzzles, embracing the power of shadows to uncover an ancient myth. The narrative unfolds across an ancient island where the balance of light and shadow has been disrupted by the sun god’s corrupted energy. With stunning visuals, your mastery of chiaroscuro shapes the destiny of a universe on the brink.
Embrace the Shadows for Survival and Exploration
Utilize shadows for exploration and survival, moving objects via their shadows and traversing walls in a 2D shadow dimension. Evade corrupted cult members by smartly stealth through the darkness.
Control light sources and mirrors to transform shadows into tangible objects or reveal hidden paths. Solve dynamic puzzles in an ever-changing world where your manipulation of light dictates the progression.
Collect the fragments of 'the Timepiece' and rewind time itself. Mend the rift between the sun and shadow deities, restoring the world's equilibrium.

Join our official Discord community to participate in playtests, share your ideas, and more!

title: Zen Rogue Monks
description:
게임 정보


검과 도끼는 잊어라. 여기서 전투는 영웅들의 마음속에서 벌어집니다: 귀여운 승려들과 노인들이 오직 하나의 목표를 위해 명상을 합니다!

하지만 쉽지는 않을 것입니다. 스트레스, 청구서, 실연 등의 적들이 우리 영웅들을 방해하려 할 것입니다.
당신의 무기는 음악입니다!
카드 덱을 구성하여 적들이 승려들의 평화를 방해하지 못하게 하세요. 유물을 모아 힘을 강화하세요. 그리고 100% 평온함에 도달하여 모든 정신적 전투에서 승리할 때까지 악기를 연주하세요!


수작업으로 그려진 다양한 시나리오가 있습니다! 그리고 훌륭한 로그라이크 덱빌더 게임처럼, 끝에 도달하려면 적절한 카드와 유물을 조합하고 지도에서 올바른 길을 선택하는 기술이 필요합니다!

title: Ghost Golfing
description:
게임 정보
Explore the graveyards of GHOST GOLFING!
⛳At the start of each level, the hole is there, lonely, on the other side of the field, and you have a series of pieces that form the path to it. There are windmills, pumpkins, gravestones, mirrors, and even portals! Your challenge? Build the perfect path to guide the ball! And believe me, it won't be easy. One misplaced piece, and the ball could end up rolling off the field or flying straight into the lake!

title: Power Line Rider
description:
게임 정보
POWER LINE RIDER


Embark on an action-packed journey in Power Line Rider, diving players into an all new hand-pixeled world. Assume the role of John Glider, veteran member of the Power Line Rider organization. Venture out to Reestablish contact with 3 bases that have recently gone dark in this post-apocalyptic world where the fastest means of travel is riding on old power lines.
STORY MODE / ENDLESS MODE


Beat the 3 Bosses in the concise "Story Mode" to unlock the thrilling and addictive "Endless Mode". Enter the NegaZone and ride through ever increasing difficulty all the way to Infinity! (Or as long as you can survive!)
KEY FEATURES

title: Our War: Firepower Suppression
Alien Boom Boom
description:
게임 정보



The aliens are invading your small town, they seem to be everywhere, but a mysterious transmission is guiding you to fight back!




It's time to take the fight to them! Put a stop to their plans by travelling through their network of interconnected ships, bringing you to new destinations such as moon bases, space stations, the white house, exotic runes, your small town and more!




Your ability to utilize your weapons effectively, control recoil, and place those much needed headshots is great and all, but you're still going to have to master the movement! Dash, jump and time your attacks effectively to ensure you tip the scales in Earth's favor.




The mysterious voice in your head needs your help! There is more here than meets the eye, and some how you are central to stopping this invasion.
The truth is UP there!

Alien Boom Boom is a shooter that embraces exaggerated action over realism.

Master your movement and powerful weapons such as explosive shotguns, powerful plasma rifles, railguns that rip through enemies and more. Visit many locations, while battling the alien threat including: moon bases, space stations, the white house and exotic locales.





Follow the journey of a small-town hero as they are thrust into a world-saving mission
Discover the truth behind the alien invasion and uncover a sinister plot.

title: Incrate
description:
게임 정보
Incrate is a mind-warping 2D/3D puzzle game contained within a crate! You've been mysteriously trapped in a bizarre box-shaped prison. Rotating the prison will twist your notions of perspective. Bend reality to your whim and manipulate your world and the things in it to solve the puzzles and escape!
You find yourself suddenly uplifted from your life and discover you're an inmate in a crate with no recollection of how or why you got there. The crate is an otherworldly prison contained within a boxed world. The local inhabitants that greet and guide you seem to be a despondent guard and mysterious ghost...

title: Black Zen White
description:
게임 정보
Black Zen White is a puzzle platformer where the world alternates every 10 seconds between two slightly different versions: black then white. Use your head, act at the right time and interact wisely with other inhabitants to find your way in this cute hand-drawn 2D game.
Act right at the right time...
...get help from friends...
...go through walls...

title: Dumbest Tourists of Timelines
description:
게임 정보
"Dumbest Tourists of Timelines" 에서 미래의 투어 가이드가 되어 역사상 가장 어리석은 관광객들을 과거와 미래의 상징적인 시대를 여행하게 하세요!
혼자서 또는 친구들과 협력 모드에서 함께 플레이하면서 각 여행에서 독특하고 놀라운 도전에 맞서야 하며, 무모한 관광객들이 스스로 만든 재앙에서 구해내야 합니다!
이 미친 여행에서 중세 시대부터 고대 문명, 미래의 시대까지 다양한 시간대를 방문하게 됩니다. 각 레벨은 웃긴 사고와 피해야 할 역사적 함정으로 가득 차 있습니다. 화산 폭발에서 무모한 관광객을 구하거나 분노한 파라오에게 발각되지 않으려 하거나, 매 순간이 도전입니다!
주요 특징:
시간 여행: 다양한 시대를 탐험하고 독특한 역사적 환경과 상호작용하세요.
협력 플레이: 혼자서 또는 친구들과 함께 로컬 협력 모드로 플레이하세요.
관광객들이 역사를 어지럽히지 않도록 막을 수 있을까요? 배낭을 챙기고 "Dumbest Tourists of Timelines" 의 도전에 맞서세요. 각 시대는 웃음과 멸종의 기회가 될 수 있습니다!

title: Party Management
description:
게임 정보
Party Management exists in a fantasy world of the contemporary age. Mighty warriors and mystical wizards now adorn streetwear and star in movies. Adventuring is a common pass time, but to do it you must be licensed under a party manager. This is where you come in. Select and manage up to 7 unique party members for each puzzle and use their abilities to guide them on a treacherous adventure into the golden city of Opulence in hopes of striking it rich, quitting their 9-5’s, and following their dreams.
Features:
Unique RPG Themed Puzzling Mechanics
Solve 20 trials across 4 areas
Expand your party and take on harder challenges
Chart the world around you through Ava’s Log
Master 7 unique abilities across your party
Discover the secrets of Opulence and Confluence
Replay your favorite trials with an expanded party to find new solutions

title: Last Spirit
description:
게임 정보
 Last Spirit is a fast paced roguelike for up to 4 players. Combine items to fight groups of monsters! Unlock new characters and master unique abilities to save your home planet. Goin our communities to learn more!
 - Coop up to 4 players
 - Bunch of unlockable characters with unique abilities
 - More than 100 items that change you playstyle
 - A handful of unique bosses and locations

title: Liquor Love Lady
description:
게임 정보
할아버지의 유언으로 고향에 있는 작은 칵테일 바 ‘히아신스 바’를 물려받게 된 에블린. 하지만 칵테일 바에 대해 아무것도 모르는 그녀에게 가게 운영은 쉽지가 않다.
그때 그녀의 앞에 나타난 다섯 남자들!
그들의 도움으로 에블린은 점점 술에 큰 흥미를 느끼게 되며, 칵테일을 공부하고, 바 운영에도 능숙해진다. 그런데 이 남자들, 칵테일 메뉴 개발을 도와주는 것치고는 너무 선을 많이 넘어오는 것 같은데...?
매출을 올리기 위한 신메뉴 개발부터 생각지도 않았던 연애까지, 에블린 앞에 펼쳐지는 다사다난한 이야기!
---------
'술도 사랑도 어려운 아가씨'는 미니게임이 있는 비주얼 노벨 기반 게임입니다.
칵테일 대회에 나갈 때까지 가게를 운영하며 신메뉴를 개발하고, 호감도를 가장 많이 쌓은 남성과 칵테일 대회에 나가는 것을 목표로 하는 게임입니다.
바를 열어 칵테일을 제조하고 판매하는 미니게임을 통해 타이쿤 게임의 재미를 느낄 수 있습니다.
바를 운영하여 벌어 들인 돈으로 캐릭터 이벤트 시나리오를 구입하여 호감도를 올리거나, 칵테일 신메뉴를 개발할 수 있습니다. 또는 상점을 업그레이드를 하여 더 많은 재화를 벌어 들일 수도 있습니다.
최종적으로 제일 호감도가 높은 캐릭터와 칵테일 대회에 나갈 수 있습니다.
autokwd: Liquor Love Lady,술도, 사랑도 어려운 아가씨

title: Bass Invaders
description:
게임 정보
Nasty aliens from outer space want to eat your moonbase. This is out of the question! Board your tank, load your cannons, and show the aliens who's boss. Aliens you destroy drop items, which you can collect to upgrade your tank. But beware of falling debris and rivalling players who try to snatch the items from under your nose. Aliens move to the rhythm of the music and this helps you anticipate their movement. Get into the groove in order to blast aliens quicker, and score bonus points! Who can eliminate the most aliens and get the highscore? Hilarious outer space musical mayhem for 1-4 players.

title: Flexible Frosty
description:
게임 정보
Put on your mittens and your beanie to discover an icy world in this retro arcade-style game from the heyday of the GameBoy.
Cool features included:
1 little & cute flexible penguin
GameBoy-like graphics and audio
Wholesome & family friendly
Approximately ~2 hours long
40 short levels filled with unique puzzles
40 ice creams to collect as an additional challenge
15 achievements for completionist lovers
An optional binocular view to help you solve larger levels
Mouse, keyboard, and full gamepad support

title: Wretch
description:
게임 정보
Wretch is a story driven thriller set in an abandoned school from the POV of a security officer working a night shift. What seems like a routine call turns out to be something else entirely.
Why was the school vacated with such a haste? What is Project Luminaire? Who killed Bethany Carlington and who is it that's lurking in these dark corridors?
Exploration and puzzles:
Navigate your way through the abandoned school building searching for clues and answers, dealing with the deteriorating environment. Your job is to investigate the area and search for any intruders, but as the story unfolds the hot question becomes philosophical: "Who's the intruder here?".
Dynamic- and non-linear story progression:
The game has a heavy focus on environmental story telling and does quite little to hold your hand through it all. There are multiple ways to progress and multiple endings to the story, with optional secrets / trivia that'll answer you questions you didn't originally even come around asking.
Hide and seek:
It's quite evident you're not alone, can you find them before they find you? Darkness breeds danger, keep your flashlight on!
-Average completion time ~60 minutes
-For the sake of immersion, no saves
-Requires audio for full interactivity

title: Ace of Space
description:
게임 정보
Select a flagship and embark on a journey across a universe on the brink of annihilation. Construct your deck of ships and science, obtain powerful artifacts to enhance your strategy, and make tough choices for the good of the galaxy. Warp across sectors, battle hostile factions, and face impossible odds as the universe itself collapses around you.
In Ace of Space you take the roll of Flagship Commander on a desperate mission to save the galaxy from an all-consuming cosmic entity. With each sector you enter, you’ll encounter distinct factions, from the ruthless Sovereign Imperium to the elusive Venom Syndicate and the nature-bound Verdant Dominion. The stakes are high, and every choice you make could be your last.
But there’s more than just war—time and space are unraveling, and an ancient, unstoppable force is at the heart of it all. Will you attain the strength and synergies needed to stop the Oblivion Nexus, or will you and your crew be lost to the void?
Wishlist today. Updates are coming at a rapid pace.
Features:
Dynamic Tactical Combat: Engage in strategic, real-time battles with enemies from across the galaxy. Adapt to each faction’s unique strengths and weaknesses.
Factions with Rich Lore: Each sector is controlled by a distinct faction with their own agendas, strengths, and hostilities. Fight, trade, or forge alliances with the Ironclad Cartel, Stormfront Collective, and more.
Cosmic Mystery Unfolding: Explore a universe in chaos, as an entity from beyond space and time slowly consumes everything. Each sector brings new challenges, from navigating frozen wastelands of the Frostspire League to surviving the brutal zealots of the Eternal Pantheon.
High-Stakes Story: Your decisions matter. Protect your crew, manage resources, and make critical choices that will decide the fate of your ship—and the galaxy.
73 Units
116 Cards
8 different Factions to encounter and play as
39 Events
79 Artifacts

title: Sintropia
description:
게임 정보
Defend your home with fruits and towers made of scrap in Sintropia!
Prepare yourself for a strategic battle in Sintropia, a adorable tower defence where you control fruits with special skills to defend your trunk.
Colect resources and build your defences:
During the day, explore the map colecting resources like scrap metal and destroying iron blocks to obtain "scrap" the money of the game. Use the scrap to build and enhance powerfull towers that will defend your trunk from enemy waves.
Control frutis with unique skills:
Lead a army of fruits, each one with their own set of unique skills. Some being faster, other being able to carry more resources, and other ones with special skills like being able to increase the speed of other fruits.
Manage your time wisely:
Time is a precious resource on Sintropia. Use the day time to colect resources, build your defences and prepare for the night. Because when the sun sets, waves of enemies will try to reach your trunk. Utilize your resources strategically to defend your base from the attacks to come.
Download the demo:
The free demo of Sintropia will be avaiable soon! Give us your feedback, revies, and suggestion of interesting game mechanics that you would like to see!
What will come in the final release:
Local Co-Op for up to 2 players.
Minigames for up to 4 players localy.
More than 5 variants for each fruit
More than 20 worlds, with each one containing at least 5 stages, each world will introduce a new gimmick, like rain, mud, wind, storms and more.
More fruits like the grapes, avocados and cocoa. And also a few vegetables and tubers, like potato, carrot and beets.
Better accesibility and difficulty options
And more...

title: Cambrox
description:
게임 정보
In a world filled with creatures known as Cambros. Get ready for a top-down 2D Pixel Art JRPG. Collect various Cambros and make a team to explore your heart's content.
Cambrox is about collecting Cambro's, battling trainers, testing your limits, and making it to the fabled Glizzy Stadium.
Collect over 200 unique Cambro's with 12 unique types in this action-packed adventure. Battle in single battle and trio rotation battles to really test your limits as a master.
After beginning this game go onto a crazy journey filled with action and adventure and see what the world of Cambrox has in store for you.
With multiple save slots feel free to try different modes while keeping your main save safe.
Easy Mode (For a chill and stress-free adventure)
Normal Mode (Intended Experience)
Hard Mode (Scaled Up Battles all Cambros in Encounters Increased, better Enemy AI)
Nuzlocke Mode (Your Cambro's cannot be revived and level caps are set for each part of the game)
Speedrun Mode (For one session playthrough, has some optimizations for speedrunners like segment practice mode)
Super excited for you to start your journey. We are a two-person team and we really hope you enjoy our hard work. We believe love is something that makes you wanna die after it's gone, but we wanna make something you'll love that will make you wanna live forever.

title: ShapeSCALE
description:
게임 정보
A game about scaling shapes

Scale shapes to match the target size
50+ levels

Created for the GMTK Game Jam 2024

title: The Lizard Problem
description:
게임 정보
Have you had enough of building impenetrable defenses and then having to wait at 2x speed until the waves provides a challenge big enough? Then look no further.



The Lizard Problem is a dynamic tower defense with a focus on making every wave a new challenge that has to be reacted to. Mother nature herself will rip your defenses apart with earthquakes that shatter your formations and the level in the beginning of each wave, providing new paths for the lizards to then take and try and steal your eggs. You will have to adapt to the ever changing landscape by moving your towers and replacing those who got destroyed in battle.

You may be just a magpie bird, but you are not defenseless. Apart from bribing the animals of the world to help you (building towers), you can yourself engage in the battle. Smack them with your wings, just like your mom said. Speaking of your mom, she will guide you through the life of a soon to be parent, giving you tips on how to deal with The Lizard Problem.

The natural breaks between waves give you a good time to think about what to do next, but if you already got a plan, the game makes sure you can execute it as fast as possible. There are intuitive hot keys for every interaction, letting you place and move turrets in a fraction of a second, even mid round. The flight mechanic makes sure you can reach all ends of the map quickly, which is especially useful for quickly killing of a stray lizard that escaped with the close range melee combat.

Many more features are to be announced as development continues!

title: Wish Of Hers
description:
게임 정보
개요
Wish of Hers는 주인공의 꿈속 세계에서 벌어지며, 현실이 한 걸음 한 걸음마다 휘어지고 변화합니다. 이러한 초현실적인 풍경을 탐험하면서 누군가가 당신의 꿈을 조작하고, 더 깊은 목적을 향해 인도하고 있음을 알게 됩니다. 전투를 통해 진실에 한 발짝 더 다가가고, 꿈속에 숨어 있는 궁극의 적에 맞서기 위해 힘과 능력을 모읍니다.
능력
파워 카드를 구매하여 독특하고 강력한 능력을 획득하세요. 이 능력들은 전투 전략을 강화하도록 설계되었으며, 파괴적인 공격부터 방어적인 동작까지 다양합니다. 능력들은 창의적인 방식으로 결합하여 꿈속에서 변화하는 도전에 적응할 수 있습니다.

업그레이드
현실 조형기를 사용하여 능력을 업그레이드하고 더욱 강력하게 진화시키세요. 업그레이드할 때마다 능력은 새로운 효과와 강화된 힘을 얻게 되며, 꿈의 신비를 깊이 탐구하기 위한 우위를 제공합니다.

title: Chosen War
description:
게임 정보
"Chosen War" is a strategic roguelike game where you build a troop list for battles. You will take on the role of the Divine Chosen One, assembling and leading your army to explore various islands. Through careful troop deployment, you engage in battles against enemies. By using the skills of the Divine Chosen One and simple operations on the army, you strive to defeat the foes. After passing different islands, you'll receive various rewards. It could be an upgrade to your troops, the liberation and incorporation of imprisoned slaves into your army, or the rich treasures hidden under the Italian divine secrets. Ultimately, you'll battle against the evil High Priest to achieve the final victory.

title: BlastBall: All-Stars
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the ultimate sports showdown with BlastBall: All-Stars! Pick your favorite all-star from our roster of adorable creatures and jump into the fun.
With intuitive controls adapted to each sport, jumping into new games is a breeze! Aim with the left stick and add spin with the right stick to score highlight reel goals.

title: Finares
description:
게임 정보
Who are you?
You are Ares, a shepherd dog without a permanent home. Just as you were about to settle down, you return from a short trip to find yourself alone. All the humans have disappeared. When no one fills your food bowl anymore, you realize the situation is serious. Then, a strange female dog appears in your territory, and your adventure to find the humans begins. Find your way through the chaos of the world and lead your pack forward.
What can you expect on this journey?
Travel through multiple open worlds
Listen to local frequencies for signals from humans
Find diary entries, notes, laptops, smartphones, and anything that gives you clues about the last thoughts of humans
Meet other dogs along the way and exchange information with them
Use your nose to track scents and reach new places
Help pick locks and restore the power
Play tag and hide-and-seek
Take care of your pack
Always have your trailer with you
Search for supplies and shelters for the night
Solve puzzles to get information
Friendship
Painted graphics
How is the game's development going?
You can find the game on youtube, where I regularly upload videos about the game:
You can also play the free demo (please note that the game is in active development)

title: Hounimal
description:
게임 정보
In a world where living disasters have eradicated people’s homes, the protagonist sets out on a journey with Hounimal, the village guardian, to restore homes to the world.
Collect and Place Furniture

Obtain various pieces of furniture during your journey and place them in Hounimal. The actions you can choose in battle will change depending on the furniture. (Of course, you can also enjoy them as interior decorations!)
Simultaneous Turn-Based Command Battles

Command battles progress simultaneously with the enemy! Skillfully coordinate the protagonist and Hounimal, who randomly assist, to control the order of actions and gain an advantage in battle.
Listen to your companions' requests to unlock features that make your journey easier. Draw out more of Hounimal's power.

title: Bleeding Hearts: Althazar Chapter
description:
게임 정보
- Available in Bleeding Hearts: Althazar

Complete Bleeding Hearts: Althazar Game

Complete the Mission and Fight against the Threat to Home Land and the world

After Wasim Khan's defeat in the 2024 General Elections, Pakistan descended into civil war, which raged for two years. Despite requests for international peacekeeping troops, the country fractured into several independent states by 2026. One of these regions declared its independence, forming a new country called Qalbistan. This nation emerged from the merger of the Port Area and Tribal regions, with its capital named Althazar.

Althazar quickly gained notoriety as the city with the highest crime rate. It's said that 25% of the population is involved in criminal activities, 25% pays to escape crime, and the remaining 50% are victims. The lawlessness in Qalbistan is so severe that no other country is willing to accept refugees from the region, not even the peacekeeping forces, who are now trapped within its borders.

As the player, you must lead your team through this chaotic and dangerous landscape. Survival is the ultimate goal, but you also face the challenge of rescuing abducted members and finding a safe haven away from the turmoil of Qalbistan. The decisions you make will determine your team's fate as you fight to navigate the lawless streets of Althazar.

Time to Start

Welcome to the world of Althazar, the first part of Bleeding Hearts Series with great collections of maps and heavy single player action. All the maps are open world 3D with new modes and gameplay features and will be available at launch to get everyone started

High Intensity Action Levels

Find, fight, kill and rescue abducted citizens while surviving and fighting tranches of enemy soldiers, rebels and facing civilian revolt in the largest maps. Massive chases to catch enemies and race against time for completing the critical missions.

Plan for escape from the world top 1 crime city Althazar. You will be provided with different set of weapons at each level and tons of interactions to get the work done and quid pro co with available civilians to get help and conquer.

title: Paragone Bomb
description:
게임 정보
Paragone Bomb is a top-down shooter featuring a variety of enemies, weapons, and abilities for our main character.

A tactical game with a bird's-eye view.
Steam Workshop support for custom maps and community challenges.
Single-player mode: play with enhanced bots on all our maps.
Upgrade all weapons during gameplay.
Upgrade abilities and modules.
A store where you can purchase ammo, weapons, modules, medkits, and much more using resources collected during missions.

title: Forest Time
description:
게임 정보
Play the role of a spirit who guides the forest dwellers and guests through their day, helping them meet their goals in this peaceful, family-friendly turn-based puzzle.
Be one with the invisible yet ever-present soul of the forest that helps everyone to find their path. Feel free to practice your planning skills and think several steps ahead to create a perfect route for every character. Or just try different ways and see which one works. The game doesn’t punish you and encourages the retry by allowing you to undo each action while solving the puzzle.
Carefully crafted world
Enjoy the peaceful setting with simple, non-stressful tasks. Participate in festivities and occasionally find some secrets hidden in the woods. Almost every level introduces a new character or concept—no one knows what awaits you after the next turn.
Variety of Characters
There are many characters in the game, and each one is unique in something, just as we are. Different classes of characters offer different mechanics. Different characters within one class vary in a subtle way. Explore their traits and quirks in different settings and find a perfect path for each and every one of them.
Many levels to solve
There are many tasks to solve, from collecting fruits and berries and chatting with friends to trick-or-treating or playing with spirits during seasonal festive events. Complete them all in the order you choose. All puzzles are grouped into four seasons of the year, and it’s up to you which season to explore first.
Development plans
The game is currently in development, and the plans are to release it for desktop platforms by the end of 2025. Please wishlist and follow us. Your support is much appreciated!

title: Dragons Invade Scotland
description:
게임 정보
Match-3 meets Tower Defense! Your matches become towers. Defend each real castle in Scotland! Learn about real Scottish castles/stories/legends while playing. The game takes place on full map of Scotland made of 5 million tiles, where each tile is 19.5 square meters of the real world.

From the creator of Tower Swap. This game isn't released yet, so here's some reviews of Tower Swap:

"It's a perfect blend between the match-3, merge, and tower defense genre, so if you like any of those genres and you want to venture forth with a twist this is a perfect game with a great gameplay loop and great mechanics. It's super addicting... I enjoyed my time with Tower Swap so much that I lost track of time and got a super long gameplay recording." - MintCity Review

"This is a hidden gem and belongs in the best-of list of indie match 3 mobile games alongside Triple Town, 10000000, and Puzzle Craft." - Loren Hernandez

"Never have I ever played a game for such a long time continuously as this game. It's so simple and sooo good. 10/10 would recommend everyone ever. My grandma would love this game and my grandchildren would someday still love this game. ok I'm done. But seriously, play it."

"One of the most well-designed games I've ever played! Game is easy for beginners to play but it takes quite a bit of skill to attain higher levels, as success requires using both match-3 and tower defense strategies."

100s of castles are planned with real folklore from each:

Did you know that there was a castle ruled by a Viking princess, and it was on an island, and she put up a chain reaching to the mainland to stop ships?

Did you know that there was a castle that was said to have been built by a wizard using an army of goblins?

Did you know that there's a fairy flag that still exists today in Dunvegan castle, and it is said that it can only be used 3 times, and it has already been used twice in medieval times to summon fairies to their defense?

All of these and hundreds more are planned to be added to the game.



Note that the game is priced low because it contains IAPs. If you don't want to pay you can play for free on the web but with banner ads, coming soon. You are essentially paying to remove the banner ads, and to be able to load up the game without internet, and to make sure your progress doesn't get cleared from your browser's storage. The Steam version doesn't have any banner ads. There will also be mobile versions with the same structure.

title: Wildwood: Graveyard Defense
description:
게임 정보
Wildwood: Graveyard Defense is a fast-paced, top-down wave defense game! You are a frog with a magical mushroom hat — defend your graveyard and survive the night.
About Me & The Game
Hi, I'm Alan and I'm so excited for you to play Wildwood! 
I'm a solo indie developer. I originally launched Wildwood on mobile in 2019. Since then the game has continuously evolved through new updates and content drops.
Now, I'm completely re-imagining Wildwood for desktop!
I'm expanding the original gameplay, adding new mechanics, new enemies, and an entirely new progression system. I'm also working on some end-game content for anyone who wants even more challenge.
Please wishlist, and stay tuned for more!
Cool Stuff:
🧙 Brew Potions: Buff your base stats with temporary potions
🔦 Collect Lanterns: Unlock new lanterns each with unique properties and effects
📈 Upgrade Skills: Unlock permanent upgrades and abilities to customize your playstyle
✨ Stylized Art: Explore spooky, whimsical environments and unlock new levels
🎮 Play Your Way: Supports keyboard/mouse and controllers
The Highlights:
Fast-paced active combat with simple controls (not an auto-shooter)
A mix of casual fun, sometimes chaotic situations, and a little bit of strategy
End-game challenges and high-score leaderboards
Magical mushroom hat 🐸🍄🎩

title: Falos Chemistry
description:
게임 정보
🔥 Falos Chemistry - Learn Chemistry the FUN Way! 🔥

Get ready to jump, run, and fly your way to becoming a chemistry pro! 🎮 Falos Chemistry is a super fun game that teaches you the basics of chemistry while you play. No boring lessons here—just awesome games that help you learn!

🚀 4 Amazing Mini-Games:

Jumping Gorilla 🦍: Hop through levels and learn atomic weights!
Running Gorilla 🦍: Run fast and memorize electron configurations!
Dragon Snake 🐍: Slither and master elemental symbols!
Bird 🐦: Flap your way to chemistry victory!

🎓 What You'll Learn: Discover the building blocks of chemistry, like atomic weight, electron configurations, and elemental symbols, all while having a blast!

Whether you’re just starting or need a refresher, Falos Chemistry makes learning easy and exciting. Perfect for anyone who loves games and wants to get better at chemistry. 🧪💥

title: Inventris TD
description:
게임 정보
Inventris TD is a roguelike lite tower defense shooter where the combat happens inside your inventories.
Features:
Acquire cats by hatching eggs.
map tiles are Inventory tiles where you can deploy cats as towers and enemy route blocks
Inventory Tetris centric design
Allocate cats in the other inventory to make them mod your player gun bullets
Unlock more inventory tiles also unlocks more map, which leads to stronger enemies as well as better resources and traps
Turn-based tower defense where each enemy turn starts with your shot

title: The Genetic Dilemma
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 두 인물의 시선을 통해 이 세계를 경험하게 됩니다. 대중교통이 무료로 제공되는 시대, 그러나 그 속에서 살아가는 사람들의 일상은 결코 단순하지 않습니다.
남자의 이야기
반복되는 일상에 지친 그는 가벼운 용돈벌이를 위해 설문 조사에 참여하기로 합니다. 지루한 하루를 보내던 중, 우연히 오래된 친구와 재회하게 됩니다. 친구의 집에 초대받아 방문한 그곳에서, 그는 친구의 여자친구와 마주하게 되는데… 단순한 만남이 예상치 못한 방향으로 흘러가며, 그의 삶은 돌이킬 수 없는 변화를 맞이합니다.
여자의 이야기
자율주행 자동차의 자동 브레이크 시스템을 연구하는 그녀는 최첨단 기술의 중심에서 일하고 있습니다. 그러나 어느 날, 뜻하지 않은 사고로 인해 생사의 기로에 서게 됩니다. 그리고 그녀에게 제안된 것은 기존의 장기 이식과는 차원이 다른 ‘혁신적인 수술’— 오직 뇌만을 새로운 몸으로 옮기는 이식 수술이었습니다.
눈을 떴을 때, 그녀는 완전히 새로운 세상 속에 있었습니다. 하지만 그녀를 기다리는 운명은 과연 축복일까요, 아니면 새로운 딜레마의 시작일까요?
대중교통이 무료로 제공되는 세계. 하지만 이 편리함의 대가는 결코 가볍지 않습니다— 단순히 이동하는 것조차 끝없는 광고를 견뎌야 하는 시대입니다.

title: Digital Legacy of Zero
description:
게임 정보
Explore a Digital World where you can collect and train creatures to build your ultimate team. Defend your upgradeable basement from waves of enemy attacks and strategically manage your resources to achieve evolutions. Travel through time to uncover the secret to prevent the impending Armageddon.
Improve Your Team
Manage resources to unlock new evolutions for your creatures, perform special summoning rituals and create your strongest team.
Collect Creatures
Defeat wild enemies to get their eggs that hatch into allies! Each creature brings unique abilities to your team, adding new evolution lines and endless possibilities. Build your dream squad and defeat evil bosses in the Digital World!

title: Tank vs Orcs
description:
게임 정보
Tank vs Orcs is an action packed twin stick shooter in development where you get to live out the ultimate power fantasy; being a fricken' tank and battling endless hordes or orcs.
You'll have quite the arsenal of weapons at your disposal including chain gun, plasma rifle, chainsaw, rockets, cannons, and much more. Tank vs Orcs will also feature boss battles and some lite rogue like mechanics as well. A playable demo for PC and Mac is coming soon!

title: Lost Resolve
description:
게임 정보
You awaken in the Somber Sepulchre, utterly alone and bereft of purpose. To find your Lost Resolve, you must venture deep within the Forlorn Dream. You will search the very depths of loneliness and sorrow, that you might once again find hope.

Game Features
A variety of movement abilities that flow together seamlessly
Beautiful worlds to run through and lose yourself in
Challenging time trials
An emotive and nostalgic original soundtrack

title: The Blue Cut Hook
description:
게임 정보
Step into the warm glow of your very own tavern, where good food, great company, and grand adventures await! In The Blue Cut Hook, you're not just a business owner—you’re a friend, a mentor, and a cornerstone of the community. Build lasting relationships, craft mouthwatering meals, forge mighty weapons, and embark on thrilling quests to create the ultimate haven for adventurers and townsfolk alike!
🍻 From Stranger to Family
Your tavern is more than just a place to eat—it’s a home. Lend a listening ear, solve problems, and earn the trust of your patrons. With each bond you forge, your reputation grows, and soon enough, you’ll find yourself at the heart of a thriving community.
🍲 Cook Up Something Legendary
A great tavern needs great food! Scour the world for exotic ingredients, unlock secret recipes, and craft a menu that keeps adventurers coming back for more. Will you serve hearty comfort food or daring new flavors from distant lands? The choice is yours!
🔨 Forge, Craft, and Equip
Adventurers need the right gear to survive their quests, and that’s where you come in! Hire a blacksmith, gather rare materials, and create powerful weapons and armor to aid your patrons. A well-equipped adventurer is a happy (and generous!) customer.

title: Surface Tension
description:
게임 정보
Construct a resilient base, strategically defend against relentless hostiles, harness vital resources. Don't forget to unlock technologies to combat a spreading corruption and restore nature in this roguelike base defense.
Venture into a world transformed by a creeping corruption. In Surface Tension, you'll face the challenge of rebuilding and defending a fragile ecosystem against relentless hostile forces.
Resource Management:
Gather and manage a diverse range of resources. Whether through manual collection or automated buildings, you'll need to strategically acquire materials to fuel your technological progress.

title: SkyLeague
description:
게임 정보
Rise up champion, a whole new world and other champions are waiting for you.
Soccer matches
As a skycar, a very fast and acrobatic car, participate in soccer matches in 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3. Cooperate with other player to grind the ladders and become the greatest player.
Explore the world
From large futuristic cities next to the sea, in the sky or even in the bottom of the ocean, explore a vast world, discover new challenges and other players to exchange items or do some games.
Extra games
Enjoy mini-games, races, obstacle courses, dribbling challenges and a 8v8 rumble mode.
Customize your Skycar
You are free to choose among several car bodies, wheels, boost, body colors and trails to create your own skycar.
Gather your friends
Add your friend in the game to play some games with them, explore the city and exchange items. Try to grind the ladder with them with your own team mmr.

title: AutoBlobber
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to AutoBlobber, where your strategic Blob skills will be put to the ultimate test!
In AutoBlobber, strategy is everything. You'll manage your Blob, fighting through countless waves of enemies, and surviving by carefully placing upgrades between each wave. Evolve  your blob with new enchantments and upgrades, and see how many waves you can survive.
Show your skills by climbing the global leaderboard!
Equip Upgrades Between Waves
Unique upgrades with different abilities and target modes
Battle
Battle countless enemies with increasing difficulty per wave.
Combine Upgrades Into Stronger Versions

title: Sword Sanctuary
description:
게임 정보
Sword Sanctuary는 패링 위주의 횡스크롤 하드코어 게임입니다.
플레이어는 한 기사를 조종할 수 있습니다.
기사는 소드마스터가 되기 위해 다양한 무기와 기술을 사용하는 자들이 있는 세계와 연결된 검의 성소에 도착했습니다.
그들에게서 모두 승리하면 검성에게 도전할 수 있습니다.
검성을 이기고 소드마스터가 되세요.
플레이어는 이동, 공격, 회피, 방어를 할 수 있습니다.
방어는 상단, 중단, 하단 3가지 방향을 방어할 수 있습니다.
중단 방어는 모든 상단과 하단도 방어할 수 있지만 공격 방향과 방어 방향이 일치한다면 더 적은 피해를 받게 됩니다.
적의 공격이 닿기 직전 방어를 한다면 적의 공격을 튕겨내고 피해를 주며, 자신은 약간 회복합니다.
공격 방향과 방어 방향이 일치하고 튕겨내기를 성공한다면 적에게 더 많은 피해를 주고, 더 많이 회복할 수 있습니다.
공격은 튕겨내기보다 적은 데미지를 가하지만 적의 방어를 유도해 행동을 제한할 수 있습니다.
조작법
이동- 좌우 방향키
회피 - 이동 중 Shift
공격 - Space
방어 - W, A, S, D
   상단 - W
   중단 - A, D
   하단 - S

title: Zombie House Siege
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 총을 강화하여 좀비를 계속 물리치는 로그라이크 게임입니다.
당신은 혼자 또는 동료와 함께 집으로 몰려드는 좀비들로부터 생존해야 합니다. 좀비는 시간이 지날수록 더 많아지고 강력한 개체도 등장하지만, 당신도 그 이상으로 강해질 수 있습니다. 어떻게 강해질지는 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 가능한 한 오랜 시간 생존하여 탈출하세요!
전투
총을 사용한 공격은 안전하지만, 탄환은 제한되어 있으니 주의하세요. 때로는 배트로 때리는 것도 필요합니다.
게임 흐름
좀비 무리를 전멸시키거나 일정 시간 생존하면 자신을 강화하고 다음 무리와 싸우게 됩니다. 전투가 진행될수록 시간대가 아침, 낮, 밤으로 변하며, 밤에는 강력한 좀비가 나타납니다. 하루를 생존할 때마다 탈출 기회가 주어집니다.
강화
전투가 끝날 때마다 랜덤으로 3가지 선택지 중 하나를 선택하여 신체 능력이나 무기를 강화합니다.
체력이 증가
이동 속도가 증가
근접 무기가 불을 두름
총알이 관통함
총알이 전기를 가함
플레이 인원
혼자 싸울 수도 있고, 최대 4명의 팀을 구성하여 협력할 수도 있습니다.

title: Humanolve: A Human Evolution Card Saga
description:
게임 정보
Humanolve: A Human Evolution Card Saga is the epitome of human survival and evolution. Immerse yourself in a world thousands of years ago, as early humans took the first steps to dominate nature. Can you survive the hostilities of nature and wild life in this roguelite adventure? Or will you succumb to a mere footnote of history?
Core Features
Every choice matters: A simple and intuitive system involving interacting with and combining cards, yet choices have a deep and profound impact on your evolution journey.
Action based research system: Your actions reward you in more ways than one. You can unlock powerful tools and abilities based on your actions.
Deep simulation: Fulfill evolving physical and psychological needs with diverse activities—harvesting, crafting, hunting, nourishing, healing, tracking, communication, and more—yielding surprising outcomes.
Expansive Exploration: Traverse 10+ unique locations brimming with challenges and rewards, each offering distinct hurdles and thrilling discoveries.
Master the nature: Explore your surroundings, make them secure for your people to call home, harvest resources, hunt wild game, heal and nourish your tribe.
Memorable Endings: Encounter diverse end game scenarios, each offering a satisfying conclusion to your epic survival tale. Each scenario presents a meticulously crafted challenge, beckoning replay for maximum enjoyment!

Note: This is pre-alpha footage for reference!
autokwd: Humanolve: A Human Evolution Card Saga

title: Codename Incubus
description:
게임 정보
SUBDUE YOUR NIGHTMARES

Cleave through ethereal enemies with blistering slashes, locked in a bullet-hell frenzy between waves of projectiles. Keep dodging and close in on your foes to swiftly dismantle them, or gracefully parry their bullets with resolute precision.
