게임 정보
Blast, Upgrade, and Adapt in this fast-paced roguelike shooter!
Bodacious Blasteroids is a high octane arcade shooter where firepower is everything. Build an arsenal of devastating weapons and obliterate waves of evolving enemies. But there’s a catch. Your guns overheat, forcing you to rotate between weapons on the fly. Master the art of swapping weapons to unleash devastating combos!
Rotating Firepower – Stay on your toes! Your weapons overheat, so be prepared to switch up tactics constantly. Find the ultimate synergy between your tools of destruction as you swap your way to victory.
Evolving Arsenal – Upgrade your weapons in wild ways! Stack mods to transform your weapons into a screen-clearing powerhouses.

title: Prism Warriors DX
description:
게임 정보
Prism Warriors DX is the sequel to the acclaimed retro bullet hell shooter Prism Indigo DX. When Tokyo comes under attack from a mysterious group of evil magical girls calling themselves "the Twilight Four", the Prism Warriors must band together to stop them in their tracks and uncover their true scheme before time runs out...
Play as the whole spectrum
This time, all seven Prism Warriors are playable, each with their own unique Passive skill and rechargeable Special move. From Prism Amber's resilience, to Prism Saffron's rapid-fire assaults, to Prism Aqua's freezing abilities, you're sure to find a Prism Warrior that suits your playstyle.
The new Rainbow difficulty lets you play as all seven Prism Warriors at once, cycling from one to the next each time you lose a life. Be warned, though: should all seven of them fall, you'll have to start over from the beginning...
Overcome all-new challenges

title: Melodic Mage
description:
게임 정보
Unleash the power of music in Melodic Mage, a 2D pixel art action shooter where every attack and dodge must follow the rhythm! Play as a wizard battling through dynamic levels, casting spells, dashing, and dodging—all in sync with the beat.
Key Features
🎵 Rhythm-Based Combat – Cast spells and dodge enemy attacks in sync with the music.
🧙‍♂️ Magical Arsenal – Unlock and choose between different mages.
⚔️ Challenging Enemies & Bosses – Conquer diverse levels, each with their own final boss.
🎶 Hard mode – For those looking for a challenge, the hard mode will punish you every time you miss a beat.
Master the rhythm. Control the magic. Become the Melodic Mage!

title: Mystic Fishing: A Fantasy Fishing RPG 🎣
description:
게임 정보
Set off on your journey to become a Master Angler by experiencing the unique genre blend of fishing sim and turn-based JRPG combat all wrapped up with fantasy elements!
Traverse over 10 unique and varied biomes, catching rare and exotic fish– both real and fantastical! Play a Timing-based fishing minigame to reel in the fish, before taking it on in a traditional party based RPG battle to weakened the fish for capture! Experience the interesting and lore-rich world of Concordia filled with fun and quirky characters, thought provoking story and dialogue, heart-to-heart character moments, and the ever looming sinister presence behind it all!
Inspired by games like River King: Mystic Valley, Dredge, and Deep Horrors of Fishing!
autokwd: Mystic Fishing: A Fantasy Fishing RPG 🎣

title: Compression
description:
게임 정보
너는 2075년의 평범한 엔지니어다. 밤에 지하 창고로 호출되며, 그곳에서 끔찍한 악몽을 경험하게 된다. 창고를 관리하는 인공지능이 창고에 대한 통제를 잃어버리게 된다. 창고는 거대한 적대적인 유기체로 변해버린다. 벽, 바닥, 천장, 모든 것이 살아 움직이며 너를 쫓기 시작한다. 살아있는 벽 외에도, 너를 기다리고 있는 것은 살인 로봇들, 지뢰, 화학 폭탄, 시간 가속기와 지연기, 독성 안개와 그 밖의 치명적인 함정들이다.
너에게 있는 것은 작업용 엑소슈트, 소총, 그리고 약간의 운뿐이다. 하지만 너의 목표는 단순히 창고에서 벗어나는 것이 아니다. 너는 무엇이 평범한 창고를 적대적인 포식자로 변하게 했는지 알아내야 한다. 그리고 창고는 이를 막으려 할 것이다.
모든 레벨은 수작업으로 제작되었으며, 철저히 계획되었다. 너에게는 완전한 도전이 보장된다. 하지만 항상 생존할 기회는 있다. 우주복에 치명적인 손상이 가해지면, 너는 즉시 마지막 체크포인트로 이동한다.

title: Soul Blossom
description:
게임 정보
Long ago, little souls lived in harmony in the Forest of Eternal Blossom. One day, everything has changed. The evil bug king attacked the forest and kidnapped all the little souls! Cik, the only survivor of the attack, embarks on a difficult mission to rescue his loved ones.
Solve logic puzzles by controlling a little soul. Bloom flowers, gather followers and save your loved one from the Evil Bug King.
Bloom flowers to solve logic puzzles. Fly into the flower to bloom it. It will return to its initial state if you fly away. There are many types of flowers that act differently when blossomed.
Most puzzles require other souls to solve them. Rescue them during your journey, they will follow you around and help you with the puzzles. You can order them to fly in the chosen direction or call them back with a single click.
Some actions require multiple followers to perform. Carefully distribute the followers to solve puzzles.

title: Post-Speed
description:
게임 정보
당신은 속도, 지능, 민첩성, 그리고 결단력을 시험하는 음침한 실험실의 실험 대상입니다.
여기에 어떻게 오게 되었는지 기억나지 않지만, 실험을 감독하는 수수께끼의 AI, V.E.R.A.의 목소리가 끊임없이 당신을 앞으로 몰아갑니다.
당신을 기다리는 것은 단순한 속도 경쟁이 아닙니다.
완벽한 정밀함이 요구되는 퍼즐입니다. 장애물을 극복하고, 메커니즘을 활성화하고, 누구보다 빠르게 결승선에 도달할 완벽한 경로를 찾아야 합니다.
주요 특징:
혁신적인 레이싱 퍼즐:
운전 기술과 논리를 결합하여 고속으로 복잡한 퍼즐을 해결하세요.

다층적인 스토리:
실험실의 비밀을 밝혀내고, 당신이 왜 여기에 있는지, 그리고 V.E.R.A.가 무엇을 숨기고 있는지 알아내세요.

냉소적인 AI 동반자:
V.E.R.A.는 당신의 안내자이자 심판입니다. 그녀는 당신을 조롱하고, 몰아붙이며, 어쩌면… 동정심을 보일지도 모릅니다.

다양한 도전 과제:
고전적인 스네이크, 당구, 그리고 스페이스 인베이더까지 — 각 시험마다 새로운 전략과 완벽한 경로가 필요합니다.

독특한 메커니즘:
차량을 조작하여 공을 포켓에 넣고, 플랫폼을 활성화하고, 함정을 피하는 등 일반적인 레이싱 게임과는 다른 플레이 방식을 경험하세요.


여기서는 실수가 용납되지 않습니다. 하지만 실패할 때마다 완벽한 경로를 찾을 또 다른 기회가 주어집니다.

title: Booty Battler
description:
게임 정보
Booty Battler: An auto-battler pirate adventure in the pursuit of loot!
As the Captain, your role involves recruiting and managing your crew through multiple maps filled with enemies and treasures.
Captain and Helmsman - You steer the ship! Progression is heavily dependent on being able to collect the loot from battle before it sinks beneath the waves! Your crew, relics and ship equipment can improve your ship's mobility, but ultimately it is up to you to prioritize and navigate to the loot necessary for your crew's survival.
Latest updates:
Relics are in! These unique and powerful items will help you throughout the entire run.
10 more friendly units added (90 more to go until full-release worthy)
Unit Traits are in! Each unit has a trait, when your raiding party has at least 2 matching traits, the trait bonus is activated for powerful effects.
Mystery events are in! These can be an opportunity for extra loot, tough battles, unique pirates, and more.
UI and Graphics overhaul - New UI system with tooltips to provide clarity on your ship's status, and upgraded water and battle graphics.
Ship Equipment is in! -  Slotted into slots separate from your raiding party, these cards provide your ship with various mobility options.

title: MMKK
description:
게임 정보
Use the earpick to remove earwax!
*You can use a keyboard and mouse, but the game is optimized for a controller with two analog sticks.

title: ODDLI: A satisfying game
description:
게임 정보
ODDLI(오들리)는 루프(loop)형 플레이에 기반한 캐주얼 퍼즐 게임입니다. 루프형 플레이란, 과거의 자신이 플레이한 패턴을 다시 보아가며 게임을 풀어가는 방식을 뜻합니다. 퍼즐의 장애물은 바로 과거의 나! 플레이어가 선택했던 이전 움직임을 그대로 반복하는 장애물들을 넘어서야만 비로소 목표 지점에 도달할 수 있습니다. 레벨을 클리어해갈 때 마다 과거와 현재가 얽히며 만들어내는 매력적인 루프 플레이를 즐겨보세요.
과거의 자신을 피하며 움직여라!
ODDLI의 규칙은 간단합니다. 캐릭터를 움직여 목표에 도달하기! 하지만 또 하나 더 중요한 규칙이 있으니, 지금 당신의 선택이 곧 다음 퍼즐 장애물로 추가된다는 사실! 과거의 자신과 부딪히지 않으면서 목표지점에 도달할 수 있도록 전략을 짜보세요.

title: Dealicious
description:
게임 정보
Dealicious is a cooking-themed kitchen management deck-builder card game. Discover and stack cards together to cook meals, manage your kitchen space and expand eventually hiring staff as you grow your empire. Discover unique cards which offer special abilities/bonuses! Can you collect them all?
300+ cards to collect
90+ recipes
30+ missions
Many packs to discover and unpack
Kitchen customization & expansion
Management of staff (hire & fire)
Gold system (pay bills on time!)
Stack and move cards freely!

title: Super Monkey: Time Traversal Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
FIND YOUR WAY HOME, MASTER TIME
A monkey, accidentally hurled into the future, now fights to return to the present and undo the chaos caused by the mad scientist, Dr. E. Will. Armed with time-manipulation powers, you'll battle through dystopian slums and sprawling cities, bending reality to outsmart mercenaries and overcome the obstacles in your way.
DEFEAT DR. E. WILL’S CREATIONS
Face off against relentless mercenaries and bizarre lab experiments engineered to stop you in your tracks. Use your time-manipulation powers to outmaneuver and outsmart your enemies. Get ready for speed, precision, and fast-paced combat, all while racing against the clock.
SPEEDRUN YOUR WAY TO VICTORY
For speedrunners and action fans alike, a timer tracks your every move. Set new personal bests, shatter developer-set records, and perfect your runs using the time-manipulation mechanic. The faster and more precise you are, the greater your rewards.

title: Japanese Salaryman
description:
게임 정보
About
You are Issei Ito, a talented but underappreciated security specialist at METTA East, drowning in gambling debt and office politics. When a mysterious offer from the company's enigmatic CSO promises to solve all your problems, you're thrust into a dangerous world of corporate conspiracy and moral ambiguity.
Experience a diverging plot over two weeks in 1992 Japan, where your choices in dialogue and your actions in the top-down 2D world dramatically impact the course of the story.
Whatever your actions, Issei's fate is in your hands.
Work

title: Train to Hong Kong
description:
게임 정보
트레인 투 홍콩은 포스트 아포칼립스 비주얼 노벨로, 고등학생 준의 여정을 따라가는 게임입니다. 친구들과 함께 좀비를 처치하고, 동물들로부터 도망치고, 감염된 아시아 도시를 탐험하며 홍콩에 도착하세요!

title: Skeleton Scramble Deluxe 2
description:
게임 정보
Skeleton Scramble Deluxe 2 is a fast-paced tower defense/strategy hybrid.

Choose a faction and class for a unique combination of creatures and towers.

Race against your opponent to gather resources, build defenses, and defeat the enemy hero.

Each 5-10 minute game is a franic base-building tug-of-war, with lots of viable strategies and counterplay.

Each CPU bot showcases a different preferred playstyle, and defeating them all will prepare you for fierce online multiplayer battles against friends.

title: Smart Jump
description:
게임 정보
Isolated and stranded in the middle of the ocean, Tom takes part in a trivia quiz to try to win a prestigious trophy, the Golden Brain.
General Knowledge Quiz
You need to answer 555 multiple-choice questions on various themes.
If your answer is correct, you move on to the next question.
If your answer is wrong, you fall into the water.
There is a checkpoint for each question.
Interface
The green counter displays your score.
The red counter shows how many times you have fallen into the water.
A timer records your time. Hurry up!
Goal
All players who finish the game win a trophy, the Golden Brain.
Complete the game with a high score, a good time, and few falls into the water.
Day/night cycle
Between sea and mountains, a blue sky during the day.

title: Panchin is Frustrated
description:
게임 정보
This is an Idle game, meant for playing in the background while doing other things. For the optimal experience, put the game on a second monitor while you work or browse. Made for PIGSquad Idle Jam 2023, this new version adds many new dreams and activities for Panchin.

You are the all-seeing observer of a pair of roommates, Panchin and Julem. Panchin is an artist struggling with creative block, and thus spends most of their time pacing around the room, or staying distracted.

Click to collect Panchin's Tears of Frustration. The amount of Tears collected during the day affects Panchin's dreams at night.

Connect with Twitch to suggest things for Panchin to do during the day.

Featuring:
15+ Explorable Dreams
Full original synth soundtrack
A cast of quirky, clay-like characters
A hostile goblin

title: The Whittled Horse
description:
게임 정보
In this 2.5D adventure...
a boy named Thomas and his friend Evey are trusted to deliver a package. Together they must travel through several towns to their goal. Little do they know there is a force stalking them, and what they carry will decide the future.
Each town poses a...
different challenge. You will need to talk to the locals, gather items, and do favours to make your way through.
Biking sections will...
test your skills. You need to dodge obstacles set up by an evil foe to make it to the next town. The Bike Shop Owner will teach you new abilities and give you new gadgets for your bike.
Features:
A wonderful mix of 2D and 3D graphics.
Dramatic, hand drawn cutscenes.
Multiple endings.
Meaningful story, with a variety of characters.
Created by a group of friends, bursting at the seams with personality.
Uncover the mystery of the whittled horse...

title: Forbidden Offering
description:
게임 정보
Step into a world on the brink of collapse in Forbidden Offering, an isometric rogue-lite bullet heaven where dark knowledge is your greatest weapon and the end of the world is a looming threat. Carve your path through relentless hordes of monsters with your daring duo, March and Lenore, as they defy fate and challenge the very fabric of their deteriorating reality.
In this crumbling world, the ritual demands the immolation of the girl named Lenore to prevent it from falling apart completely. Yet, young witch March stands defiant, her heart set against this cruel fate. Thus begins their perilous journey to the Last Horizon Threshold, unaware of the true extent of Lenore's mysterious power.
Features
Traverse through diverse world pieces, each with unique biomes as the world collapses around you.
March gains access to new powers as the story unfolds, evolving her abilities to devastating effect.
Unearth ancient relics that bestow new, deadly abilities to aid your quest.
Confront formidable bosses guarding each pathway to the Last Horizon Threshold.
Wield formidable magic, with a variety of unique spells to master.

title: Baking Bad
description:
게임 정보
In Baking Bad you and your friends are criminals diagnosed with an extreme medical condition. In order to ward its effects, constant doctors visits need to be made but the medical bills aren't cheap.
Cook
Cook baked goods in the back of your RV with a large amount of recipes. Discover new recipes and master the product quality to maximize profits.
Sell
Distribute or sell your baked good either locally or through a dealer, just be careful of a deal going wrong.
Evade
Stay one step ahead of the relentless police force. They are determined to shut you down and will stop at nothing to catch you. Engage in intense combat or use your wits to outsmart and outrun them.

title: Gaula Survival
description:
게임 정보
Gaula 생존은 다음을 수행해야 하는 생존 게임입니다.
[목록]

자원 수집
사냥
적과 싸우다
도구, 무기 등을 찾아보세요
생존에 도움이 되는 각종 아이템을 수집하세요
쉼터를 건설하세요.
마지막으로 루프를 다시 시작합니다.

Gaula Survival에서는 죽음이 결코 멀지 않습니다.

title: Card'em All!
description:
게임 정보
Card'em All! is a rogue-like deck-builder with a twist, incorporating the following rules and features:
When you face a wave of enemies, you can do the following:
Use your natural attack, as permitted
Play cards that represent Units, Abilities, or Effects
Units, once deployed, act on their own and use their own attacks and abilities
If you have no units in front, enemy attacks affect you and your health pool.
Several Waves comprise an Encounter.
Your units persist across waves, until the end of an Encounter.
Enemies drop loot in the form of Booty, the fate of which is decided at the end of an Encounter.
At the end of each Encounter you are offered one or more choices for a reward.
These rewards often include cards for your deck.
Certain cards have upkeep and require special attention.
The Booty is added to your Gold pool.
A series of Encounters comprises a Run. Different Runs, across timelines, bring you closer to waking up from the dream sequence and winning the game.
When you die, your dream sequence starts from the beginning with the following changes:
You retain all your deck
You retain half of your gold

title: Rune Craft
description:
게임 정보
Once a glorious civilization, the Rune World was plunged into chaos by the "Core of Chaos" going berserk. As the last inheritor of the runes, you must survive the relentless tides of monsters that emerge with each passing day and night. Every battle is a new trial of runes—whether it’s extracting ancient runes from the bodies of colossal bosses or assembling the ultimate weapon capable of sealing the Chaos.
Game Features
Diverse Items: Choose from hundreds of unique runes and weapons, each with their own distinct traits.
Freeform Builds: The selection and arrangement of your runes will shape the form and attributes of your weapon’s output.
Treasure Chests & Shops: Elite monsters and bosses drop powerful chests, while shops serve as a vital source for runes.
Dynamic Events & Objectives: Encounter a variety of special events and objectives throughout the game, each offering rich rewards upon completion.
◆ Dynamic Trajectory System ◆
Morph projectiles in real-time with runes, craft signature ballistics by combining trajectory modifiers with effect-enhancing glyphs

title: Dreamland
description:
게임 정보
We see the world through the eyes of Alexey, an ordinary worker at the logistics company "Watcher's Cargo." He has long stopped communicating with his old acquaintances. However, after several unusual incidents, Alexey begins to see symbols. Gathering together, the group decides to uncover the root cause of the events that have occurred to them.
The young people travel through several dimensions, solving puzzles and interpersonal conflicts along the way. But will they be able to overcome themselves and untangle this story? Everything depends entirely on the player and their choices.
This story is just a brief excursion into a vast and mysterious world of dreams. Will it turn into a nightmare?

title: Hyper Mice Rescue
description:
게임 정보
🐭💥 너무 늦기 전에 가족을 구하세요! 💥🐭
🚀 미사일이 다가오고 있습니다! 당신의 아이들이 갇혀 있습니다! 아이들을 구할 시간은 몇 초밖에 없습니다!
당신은 아이들을 구하기 위해 시간과 싸우는 절망적인 쥐 아빠입니다. 40층 건물에서 아이들을 구하려고 불길이 번지기 전에!
⚡ 달리고, 점프하고, 벽을 타고 각 층을 번개처럼 빠르게 넘겨보세요!
💣 미사일을 피하고 퍼즐을 풀어 아이들에게 도달하세요! 너무 늦기 전에!
🏆 치즈를 모으고 가능한 한 빨리 레벨을 완료하여 3개의 별을 받으세요!
🔥 10층마다 특별한 가족 구성원을 구해야 합니다! 새로운 강력한 도전에 맞서세요!
🎭 2개의 다른 결말 – 시간 초과 전에 몇 명을 구할 수 있나요?
⏳ 시간이 다가옵니다! 모두 구할 수 있나요? ⏳

title: Nylos
description:
게임 정보
Nylos is a puzzle platformer that takes players through diverse environments–from lush caves to floating islands and high-tech labs.

The game introduces a variety of unique powers that you can combine in creative ways to solve puzzles and explore every corner of the world.

title: Rainbow Unicorn Dash
description:
게임 정보
Rainbow Unicorn Dash is a fast and fun 2D game with art designed by my 5-year-old 🎨 Play as a unicorn, collect shoes to dash through enemies, and chain together massive combos. After dashing, your shoes fly off and bounce around the stage—dash through them again to extend your combo and climb the leaderboards. Unlock powerful abilities, aim for the highest scores, and enjoy quick, exciting gameplay sessions!
🌈 - Play as a unicorn
🎨 - Cute Art
✨ - Chain together massive combos
📈 - Climb the leaderboards
🔥 - Unlock fun abilities
⏰ - Quick gameplay sessions

title: Prepare The Past
description:
게임 정보
Unravel the Past. Change the Future.
A doomed civilization. A future in ruins. A chance to change everything.
Sent back in time with a single mission—investigate the past and present your findings—your goal is to document history before it’s too late. Using advanced tools, you’ll capture key moments, uncover hidden anomalies, and attempt to warn those who still have time to act. But will they listen?
Blending open-world exploration with photography-driven gameplay, this game invites you to traverse a vast and immersive landscape, analyze events as they unfold, and piece together the mystery of an impending catastrophe. Every discovery matters, and every choice shapes the outcome.
Features
Investigate and Document – Use high-tech photography tools to analyze key moments in history.
Expansive Open World – Explore diverse biomes, uncover lost civilizations, and interact with a world unaware of its fate.
Capture Critical Events – Record anomalies, track pivotal changes, and create a visual archive of history in motion.
Dynamic Storytelling – Your findings influence how the past reacts. Can you convince them to change course?
Collection and Progression – Gather artifacts, upgrade your equipment, and unlock deeper secrets hidden in the timeline.
The future is broken, but the past holds the key. Will you find the answers before time runs out?

title: Cascade
description:
게임 정보
Cascade is a game which has interactive simulated fluids and landscapes you can modify while on a mission or in the level editor. Use aircraft, boats, wheeled vehicles, horses, snowmobiles, Choose a creative mode or an mission driven path with challenges that include drones, turrets, monsters, bases to attack. 
There are single player missions that involve first person characters, horse back, aircraft, driving, boats and more. these involve  challenges of exploration, quests, attack, divert rivers etc, fun ! 
The level editor allows you to :
Modify landscapes and the fluids will update in real-time.
Add simulated fluid sources that will follow the landscape.
Add large volumed of liquids.
Change the landscape auto material.
Paint trees and grass.
Place objects that interact with the fluids - rocks, buildings, bridges, floatable objects.
Place enemies like drones, turrets, monsters etc.
Explore your creation on foot, on horseback, in an aircraft, wheeled vehicles, boats, submarines, snowmobile.
Create rivers, seas, and also  mix different fluids ( water, mud, mercury, lava, honey. goop, and more)
Paint with fluids.
Add drains to control the levels.
Create dams then burst them or divert the fluid anywhere.

title: Collisions: Cosmic Geometry
description:
게임 정보
Test your limits in the most frantic Neon Arcade Survival game in the galaxy! In Collisions, your reflexes will be pushed to the limit as you fight for survival in a fast-paced and intense arena against geometric enemies that move randomly and unpredictably.
Collisions: Cosmic Galaxy is an indie project developed by me, Gabriel Henrique, with dedication to the indie gaming universe and the creation of visually striking and challenging experiences. The game is in its final stages of development—stay tuned for updates!
✅ Wishlist Collisions now and get ready for the ultimate neon challenge!
🎮 Simple Gameplay, Intense Challenge
Move using WASD or arrow keys.
Easy to learn, hard to master!

title: Core Rush ! Dash Arena
description:
게임 정보
Core Rush: Dash Arena is a fast-paced, action-packed party game where players race to the core in wild arenas filled with obstacles, platforms, and chaos! Whether you're driving high-speed customizable cars or controlling quirky characters, your goal is simple but challenging: be the first to reach the core and claim victory!
Compete across a variety of vibrant arenas, each featuring unique themes and dynamic obstacles. Dash, jump, drift, and smash your way through intense races, balancing speed and strategy to outplay your opponents. Every round is a test of skill, reflexes, and adaptability as you navigate ever-changing environments designed to keep you on the edge of your seat.
Key Features:
Single-Player and Multiplayer Modes: Race solo or challenge up to 8 players in chaotic online matches!
Unique Arenas and Platforms: Experience a range of arenas with different layouts, hazards, and surprises.
Switch between characters and vehicles, each with distinct abilities and handling.

title: Filiy Eclipse
description:
게임 정보
When he wakes up, he finds himself in an escape pod.
He has no memory, doesn't know where he is, and can't even remember his own name.
He arrives at a shopping street but there is no one there. Only a robot.
The robot speaks to him.
"You have temporarily lost your memory. If you want to regain your memory quickly,
you should go to the museum and look around at various things."
With nowhere to go, he decides to head to the museum.
● Obtain a secretary hidden somewhere and learn and strengthen command skills.
   It can also be learned at a dojo.

title: Victim Complex
description:
게임 정보
Victim Complex is an eerie, atmospheric survival horror game about exploring a haunted apartment complex, where several people have already died under mysterious and tragic circumstances… and whatever killed them is still lurking, hungry for blood. Put your wits and your ghost-hunting tools to work to solve the mystery of all those deaths– before it’s too late to prevent your own!
FEATURES
Make your way through the deadly darkness, using your flashlight to find the path… and draw attention to yourself. 
Eerie apartment-building full of secrets and stories of the people who died there, and of things yet to come. 
Use your ghost-hunting tools, such as the EMP Meter, to detect supernatural presence, and then gather clues to figure out the best way to react!
Full voice-acting contributes to a tense atmosphere and engaging story!
Avoid the deadly presence stalking the halls of the apartment building as you help the lost spirits find peace.
HOPEFULLY, ALL THOSE YEARS PRETENDING HAVE TAUGHT YOU A THING OR TWO

title: Chromatic Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Command a rising interstellar civilization, expand your influence, and master Type II technology in a dynamic real-time strategy roguelike.
Each decision shapes your odyssey—will you conquer, exploit powerful artifacts, or outmaneuver rivals through strategic mastery?
With roguelike mechanics, every playthrough presents new challenges, randomized upgrades, and evolving threats in a universe that never plays the same.

title: Charlie Spotlight
description:
게임 정보
About
Meet Charlie, the next King of Comedy!
Or at least its' Little Prince.
It's a steady grind to get to the top, until on a night like any other, after one of his sets, Charlie is approached by a couple of rather unusual fans.
Help Charlie along the way in this classics-inspired Point-and-Click Adventure game!
Features
Point-and-Click mechanics
Characters with silly dialogues
Fun Puzzles with moderate moon logic
Dorky Tutorial
Questionable Humor

title: Bodacious Blasteroids
description:
게임 정보
Blast, Upgrade, and Adapt in this fast-paced roguelike shooter!
Bodacious Blasteroids is a high octane arcade shooter where firepower is everything. Build an arsenal of devastating weapons and obliterate waves of evolving enemies. But there’s a catch. Your guns overheat, forcing you to rotate between weapons on the fly. Master the art of swapping weapons to unleash devastating combos!
Rotating Firepower – Stay on your toes! Your weapons overheat, so be prepared to switch up tactics constantly. Find the ultimate synergy between your tools of destruction as you swap your way to victory.
Evolving Arsenal – Upgrade your weapons in wild ways! Stack mods to transform your weapons into a screen-clearing powerhouses.

title: Mystic Fishing: A Fantasy Fishing RPG 🎣
description:
게임 정보
Set off on your journey to become a Master Angler by experiencing the unique genre blend of fishing sim and turn-based JRPG combat all wrapped up with fantasy elements!
Traverse over 10 unique and varied biomes, catching rare and exotic fish– both real and fantastical! Play a Timing-based fishing minigame to reel in the fish, before taking it on in a traditional party based RPG battle to weakened the fish for capture! Experience the interesting and lore-rich world of Concordia filled with fun and quirky characters, thought provoking story and dialogue, heart-to-heart character moments, and the ever looming sinister presence behind it all!
Inspired by games like River King: Mystic Valley, Dredge, and Deep Horrors of Fishing!
autokwd: Mystic Fishing: A Fantasy Fishing RPG 🎣

title: Compression
description:
게임 정보
너는 2075년의 평범한 엔지니어다. 밤에 지하 창고로 호출되며, 그곳에서 끔찍한 악몽을 경험하게 된다. 창고를 관리하는 인공지능이 창고에 대한 통제를 잃어버리게 된다. 창고는 거대한 적대적인 유기체로 변해버린다. 벽, 바닥, 천장, 모든 것이 살아 움직이며 너를 쫓기 시작한다. 살아있는 벽 외에도, 너를 기다리고 있는 것은 살인 로봇들, 지뢰, 화학 폭탄, 시간 가속기와 지연기, 독성 안개와 그 밖의 치명적인 함정들이다.
너에게 있는 것은 작업용 엑소슈트, 소총, 그리고 약간의 운뿐이다. 하지만 너의 목표는 단순히 창고에서 벗어나는 것이 아니다. 너는 무엇이 평범한 창고를 적대적인 포식자로 변하게 했는지 알아내야 한다. 그리고 창고는 이를 막으려 할 것이다.
모든 레벨은 수작업으로 제작되었으며, 철저히 계획되었다. 너에게는 완전한 도전이 보장된다. 하지만 항상 생존할 기회는 있다. 우주복에 치명적인 손상이 가해지면, 너는 즉시 마지막 체크포인트로 이동한다.

title: Prism Warriors DX
description:
게임 정보
Prism Warriors DX is the sequel to the acclaimed retro bullet hell shooter Prism Indigo DX. When Tokyo comes under attack from a mysterious group of evil magical girls calling themselves "the Twilight Four", the Prism Warriors must band together to stop them in their tracks and uncover their true scheme before time runs out...
Play as the whole spectrum
This time, all seven Prism Warriors are playable, each with their own unique Passive skill and rechargeable Special move. From Prism Amber's resilience, to Prism Saffron's rapid-fire assaults, to Prism Aqua's freezing abilities, you're sure to find a Prism Warrior that suits your playstyle.
The new Rainbow difficulty lets you play as all seven Prism Warriors at once, cycling from one to the next each time you lose a life. Be warned, though: should all seven of them fall, you'll have to start over from the beginning...
Overcome all-new challenges

title: Melodic Mage
description:
게임 정보
Unleash the power of music in Melodic Mage, a 2D pixel art action shooter where every attack and dodge must follow the rhythm! Play as a wizard battling through dynamic levels, casting spells, dashing, and dodging—all in sync with the beat.
Key Features
🎵 Rhythm-Based Combat – Cast spells and dodge enemy attacks in sync with the music.
🧙‍♂️ Magical Arsenal – Unlock and choose between different mages.
⚔️ Challenging Enemies & Bosses – Conquer diverse levels, each with their own final boss.
🎶 Hard mode – For those looking for a challenge, the hard mode will punish you every time you miss a beat.
Master the rhythm. Control the magic. Become the Melodic Mage!

title: Rusty Foodies
description:
게임 정보
도시 시궁쥐의 삶은 불행과 고난의 연속입니다. 도시 생태계의 최하위인 시궁쥐에겐 도시의 모든 존재가 위험하기 짝이 없죠. 굶주린 길고양이, 갑작스레 범람하는 하수도, 사각을 노리는 까마귀들까지... 하지만 역시 가장 두려운 존재는 바로 "인간"입니다.
여기, 시궁쥐 "아티" 일가의 삶 또한 불행과 고난의 연속이었습니다. 이번 달은 특히나 더 불행했죠. 먹이 비슷한 것도 입에 대기 힘들었으니 말입니다. 하지만 이 또한 지나가리라. 영원히 불행하란 법은 없는 것일까요? 호화로운 만찬이 그들의 눈 앞에 펼쳐졌습니다.
...사실 영원히 불행한 경우도 있죠. 뒤늦게 돌아온 아티를 기다리고 있던 것은 독이 든 음식을 먹고 싸늘하게 눈을 감은 가족들이었습니다. 절망한 주인공 앞에 나타나서 태연하게 독이 든 음식을 집어 먹는 바퀴벌레. 그 광경을 본 아티의 머릿속은 한 가지 끔찍한 계획만으로 가득 차게 되는데...
아티의 계획은 결코 쉽지 않을 것입니다. 가족들 입에 겨우 풀칠이나 해주던 것이 한계였던 그가 온갖 훼방꾼들을 피해 이 새로운 파트너이자 이름난 미식가인 바퀴벌레 친구들을 만족시킬 만한 질 좋고 많은 양의 음식을 구하는 것은 불가능에 가깝겠죠.

title: JAIL DICE: Roll to Break
description:
게임 정보
제일 다이스: 롤 투 브레이크 ( JAIL DICE: Roll to Break ) 는 실시간 전투와 턴제 진행 방식이 뒤섞인 익스트랙션 퍼즐 액션 게임입니다.
주사위 형태의 전투기 [ 다이스 모빌 ] 을 조작하여, 지하 연구실 내 전투 지역에서 적들을 파괴하고 자원을 수집하세요. 갈수록 더 많은 적들이 생성되기 때문에, 전투 지역에 오래 머무를 수는 없을 겁니다.

title: Dealicious
description:
게임 정보
Dealicious is a cooking-themed kitchen management deck-builder card game. Discover and stack cards together to cook meals, manage your kitchen space and expand eventually hiring staff as you grow your empire. Discover unique cards which offer special abilities/bonuses! Can you collect them all?
300+ cards to collect
90+ recipes
30+ missions
Many packs to discover and unpack
Kitchen customization & expansion
Management of staff (hire & fire)
Gold system (pay bills on time!)
Stack and move cards freely!

title: Forsaken Shadows
description:
게임 정보
Forsaken Shadows – A Mind-Bending Singleplayer Horror Experience
Enter the terrifying world of Forsaken Shadows, a single-player psychological horror game where the unseen lurks in the darkness, manipulating your every move. Trapped in an abandoned underground facility, you must unravel dark secrets and survive the psychological torment inflicted by an invisible, malevolent presence.
With every step, the presence draws closer—manifesting through distorted sounds, hallucinations, and shifts in reality. As your stress level rises, your perception becomes increasingly twisted, blurring the line between reality and nightmare. Will you uncover the truth before losing your sanity?
Key Features
🔹 Psychological Horror: Experience an invisible force that manipulates your reality and stalks your every move.
🔹 Immersive Storytelling: Unravel the mysteries of a forgotten facility and piece together the events that led to its demise.
🔹 Dynamic Environments: The underground world shifts and changes, altering your path and perception.
🔹 Stress Mechanic: The more fear consumes you, the more distorted your vision and control become, intensifying the horror.
🔹 Deep Atmosphere: Haunting hallucinations, eerie sounds, and environmental manipulation keep you on edge at all times.
Do you have the strength to escape the Forsaken Shadows? Or will the unseen presence break your mind before you uncover the truth?

title: Little Droid 2: Escape
description:
게임 정보
"Little Droid 2: Escape" is the second part of the game. New enemies, bosses, traps, secret places are waiting for you. In the game you can improve weapons. As in the first part, the droid will have to be constantly charged to complete the entire game.

title: BBS  Magica
description:
게임 정보
Magical Girl Programming ✖︎ Auto Battle!
This is an auto-battle shooting game in which Kurumi, a former magical girl office worker, manages a bulletin board to support herself and aims for early retirement with the proceeds.
Bulletin boards are under constant threat. From cracker attacks to troll posts, Kurumi, now a magical girl in cyberspace, will eliminate any and all obstacles to the operation of the bulletin board.
Combat part
In cyberspace, Kurumi transforms into the magical girl she was when she was shining and protects the bulletin board. The game is over when the durability of the bulletin board reaches zero. Also, the messengers who operate according to your programming will be an important part of the game.
Daily life part
Before going into battle, you can act in the real world only once. You will use your physical strength efficiently, sometimes working on the side to earn funds, and sometimes sleeping to conserve your strength. It is also essential to hone your skills as a magical girl in cyberspace.
Protect your bulletin board from cyber attacks, which intensify in proportion to the popularity of your board, and increase your earnings.
The old-fashioned world of the Internet
In the past, bulletin boards were a great place to support Kurumi as a magical girl. Kurumi's heyday has passed, and now those bulletin boards are in disrepair. Protect the bulletin board and become popular again in a screen that reminds you of the Internet and CRTs of the Heisei era.
autokwd: BBS  Magica,【掲示板】ワイ魔法少女なんやが？【管理できん】

title: Kioku: Last Summer
description:
게임 정보
Kioku: Last Summer is a heartfelt adventure set on the remote island of Kioku, where you play as Asti, a young girl just settling into her new home. As summer unfolds, so does a journey filled with wonder, nostalgia, and the allure of childhood memories. Kioku invites players of all ages to step into a world where every day is a new adventure, every friend holds a story, and magic is hiding in plain sight
Explore a Unique Island World
The island of Kioku is inspired by Scandinavian landscapes mixed with Japanese aesthetics, blending vibrant colors, rustic charm, and a touch of mysticism. As you explore, immerse yourself in the nostalgic beauty of summer, meeting friends and watching as the island’s story unfolds.
Meet a Cast of Colorful Characters
Kioku’s inhabitants are diverse, friendly, and sometimes mysterious. Each new connection enriches your experience, and your choices shape these relationships, creating memories that echo long after summer ends.

title: Hop'n & Bop'n
description:
게임 정보
With Hop'n n Bop'n, you'll embark on a rhythmic adventure that blends precision platforming with infectious beats in more than 30 energizing levels.



Master the art of hopping, bopping, sliding, and slamming your way around a selection of hazards that activate in sync to the music. Race against time to set a new high-score or try to hunt down tapes for your collection to unlock cool playlists and costumes.



Explore the game's strategically distributed secret areas, each offering unique unlockables and a variety of different gameplay routes.



If you’re ready, then get started Hop’n & Bop’n!

title: Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox
description:
게임 정보
Steel Runner is a VR vehicle crafting sandbox game using physics.
Create your own unique Runner(vehicle) by combining various types of blocks, then ride it to enjoy free exploration, adventure, and combat in an open-world environment.
Game Play
In this vast open-world, you will spawn with a small runner that you are initially given.
Use your runner to chop down trees, gather ores, and fight enemies to collect blocks, modifying and upgrading it to aim for the ultimate runner!
At times, you may want to switch to a different runner, or your runner might get destroyed by enemies.
But don’t worry, as long as you have the materials, you can always summon your runner from the saved blueprint.
Create various amazing runners and make this vast open-world your own!
Design and Construction
Runners can be created by combining 1 x 1 m blocks.
Create a vehicle body, attach tyres and... you're ready to move!

title: DODORI
description:

음악의 박자에 맞춰 변형되는 사각형, 육각형 모양의 노트 라인을 따라가며 소운여고 밴드부와 함께 음악을 연주해봅시다!

title: Amp
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the synesthetic world of Amp, the neon rail shooter set in a polygonal rhythmic universe.
A NEON WORLD LIKE NO OTHER
Inspired by the world of audio, Amp takes your senses through the world where music is everything. Watch as you fly through pulsating environments to the beat
RHYTHMICALLY ENGAGE WITH THE FOES
Clear your path with different chain abilities to suit your play style
SCORE ATTACK OR CASUAL? FOLLOW YOUR PLAY MOOD
Want to be the best? Score Attack gives you the challenge of chaining as often as possible to multiply your score. If you are in it for just the scenery, Casual mode is the way to go

title: Xanthiom 2
description:
게임 정보
Xanthiom 2 is an action-adventure platforming game in which you explore a massive planet and fight its hostile inhabitants!

Play as Captain Grisham as you explore what remains of Earth, after humanity's last war! Combat all manner of deadly enemies, from sentient war machines to biological experiments gone wrong! Discover powerful weapons and abilities to assist you on your journey to avenge humanity!






Also featuring:


Xanthiom Zero ReSimulated is a from-the-ground-up remake of Xanthiom Zero, which is included with Xanthiom 2! After the events of Xanthiom Zero, the Coalition commissioned a team of elite computer scientists to create a perfect simulation of planet 4-514. It is your job to explore the simulation and discover what Captain Grisham is keeping from the Coalition!

title: Appearances
description:
게임 정보

게임은 아직 개발 중이며 따라서 변경될 수 있습니다. 저희 Discord 서버를 팔로우하고 게임을 위시리스트에 추가하십시오!
악몽의 밤
Appearances는 1인용의 1인칭 공포 및 퍼즐 게임으로, 당신은 가족 별장에서 자신을 돌보는 베이비 시터와 함께 어린 수지 역할을 합니다. 밤중에 이상하고 날카로운 소리가 들리는데, 이는 당신을 깨우기 위해 특별히 디자인된 것 같습니다. 첫 번째 본능은 시터를 찾는 것인데, 생생한 상상력을 가진 아이에게 밤은 무서울 수 있습니다. 할머니가 당신을 위해 만든 음악 상자가 최고의 위안입니다. 그러나 곧 옆에 초자연적인 무언가가 숨어 있음을 발견할 것이며, 이 음악 상자는 단순히 음악을 연주하는 것 이상의 목적을 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 가족의 과거를 밝히고 이 악몽 같은 유령을 끝내야 합니다.
평행 세계
현대적인 가족 별장으로 진화하고 이 복도와 방들의 미로를 탐험하십시오. 그러나 신비한 축복을 따라가면 당신이 괴롭히는 존재가 거주하는 평행 세계에 접근할 수 있습니다. 분위기 변화와 새로운 길이 당신에게 열릴 것입니다. 이 기회를 잡아 탈출하고 추가적인 비밀을 발견하세요.
할머니의 음악 상자, 그 음악은 당신을 악몽에서 끌어내는 유일한 방법입니다. 이 음악 상자를 사용하여 이 불온한 밤에 당신을 따라 다니는 존재를 찾고, 걸리지 마십시오.
퍼즐을 풀어 가족의 비밀을 밝혀내고 진실을 드러내십시오. 그러나 항상 기억하십시오. 당신은 이해할 수 없는 존재에게 계속해서 쫓기고 있는 어린이일 뿐입니다.
이 게임은 영화와 비디오 게임의 공포 작품 및 탈출 게임에서 영감을 받았습니다!

title: Hype Me For Your Life!
description:
게임 정보
Show off your rhythm in a musical battle where the music decides your fate! Face the God of Time and capture souls to the beat of the music to survive.
🎵 UNIQUE RHYTHM MECHANICS
Each soul is a note falling on one of the 7 strings of your board. To capture them, you must press buttons with both hands as if you were playing real musical chords.
Left Hand: Selects the range of strings where you can capture souls.
Right Hand: Chooses the exact string within the selected range and plays at the right moment.
Double Challenge: Simultaneous notes and strategic combinations will put your skills to the test.
⚔️ USE MUSIC TO ATTACK
You can’t attack your enemy directly… but you can make them drop their guard!
Capture notes in succession to build up your Hype Combo, and once you reach the max level, unleash a devastating attack.
Master the rhythm to break defenses and overcome obstacles.
Prepare for epic boss fights with unique patterns and surprising mechanics.

title: Ground Seal
description:
게임 정보
Enter Ground Seal, a Lo-fi Retro Sandbox RPG!
Wake up in the future to a world with humanity on the brink of extinction. Discover the source of the radiation threatening the world and save civilization from a mysterious threat. This sandbox RPG features a gigantic world to explore, robust town building mechanics and a wide variety of items to craft!
Explore:
A gigantic world to explore, procedural generation creates overlapping regions and you can even travel to different planets!
Dynamic day/night cycle. Different enemies may come out at night and even the seasons change in some regions!
RPG Leveling System - Level up as you explore, fight mutants and complete quests. Tailor your build by spending skill points and specialize in melee, ranged, energy or minions.
Over a thousand items to craft and find!
4 Person Multiplayer - Have your friends join to build, explore and fight a variety of epic bosses.
NPC Classes:
Rescue NPCs and add them to your towns. They will perform tasks for you based upon their building's role.
Discover different civilizations and build unique settlements on other planets.
Build:
Intricate Electrical Systems. Wire up lights, machines and other gadgets. Control lighting and electrical signals through network controls

title: FPI Bank: Cryptocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Tired of normal games? Then you can have a wonderful time not spending it on this game!
No gameplay and no plot! Only microtransactions and fees for jumps and slides.
Shooter, madness, puzzles, lul, easter eggs YES! ... and when not yes?
Wishlist this non game and receive nothing but the extra fees from FPI bank!
This is an FPS adventure with elements of spatial destruction, platforming, and puzzles. The game features levels with dynamic gameplay shifts and engaging realistic locations but also crazy places.

title: Bloody Shrine
description:
게임 정보
사원의 운명은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다. 의식을 완수하면서 강력한 악마를 해제하고 강력한 무기를 발견하며 전략적으로 주문과 아이템을 선택하며 강렬한 전투에 참여하세요. 지옥을 파괴하는 시너지를 형성하여 구울리, 엘리트 및 위협적인 보스들에게 혼란을 일으키세요. 도전을 이겨내고 암흑의 무자비한 힘에 대항하여 신성한 신사를 지키 수 있을 것인가요?
특징
다양한 플레이 가능한 캐릭터. 각각은 다른 플레이 스타일을 가지고 있습니다.
도전을 완수하여 다양한 무기, 주문 및 아이템을 해제
엘리트 및 보스를 포함한 다양한 유형의 적과 전투
짧은 파동
게임을 클리어한 후 난이도 상승

title: Panchin is Frustrated
description:
게임 정보
This is an Idle game, meant for playing in the background while doing other things. For the optimal experience, put the game on a second monitor while you work or browse. Made for PIGSquad Idle Jam 2023, this new version adds many new dreams and activities for Panchin.

You are the all-seeing observer of a pair of roommates, Panchin and Julem. Panchin is an artist struggling with creative block, and thus spends most of their time pacing around the room, or staying distracted.

Click to collect Panchin's Tears of Frustration. The amount of Tears collected during the day affects Panchin's dreams at night.

Connect with Twitch to suggest things for Panchin to do during the day.

Featuring:
15+ Explorable Dreams
Full original synth soundtrack
A cast of quirky, clay-like characters
A hostile goblin

title: The Clubies
description:
게임 정보
The Clubies is a party platformer where players navigate cute cube characters through the disco to reach the dancefloor! Encounter various hazards, puzzles, and shortcuts in a fun, colorful environment as you master user-built levels together.

Our little Cluby dreams of building the world's most fabulous club! To achieve this, he must conduct market research - which means dancing on every dancefloor across the globe to learn what makes a great club!
Cluby doesn't want to dance alone, so he can clone himself! This creates hilarious chaos with tricky puzzles to solve and physics-based controls that reveal the craziest shortcuts.

Our game is a fun party platformer, perfect for casual gamers and offering a fantastic medium for social interactions and friendly competition. Players can enjoy fascinating levels created by friends, either having a blast together in Co-op mode or competing for the best times.
Our user-friendly level editor allows those who want to create their own levels to bring their creative ideas to life and share them with others. All this takes place in a cheerful and colorful environment, providing hours of fun and shared experiences.

title: Grim Potions
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a magical journey with "Grim Potions," a game that blends alchemy and dice-rolling. As a skilled alchemist, use special dice to brew potent elixirs. But the adventure doesn't stop there - manage your apothecary shop, serving heroes with unique needs.

Gameplay:
Roll dice to match symbols and create various potions. Unlock new dice and recipes as you progress.

Shop Management:
Serve heroes, each with distinct tastes. Build a reputation for your shop's quality.

Features:
Enchanting world with stunning visuals.
Explore alchemical adventures in a unique dice game.

title: Marked - The Quest  Tripura
description:
게임 정보
An epic team up of Indian gods...
An encounter of planetary proportions....
Three levitating cities destroyed by a smile...
An archeological marvel in South India and
One of the oldest games known to mankind - this game reveals the secret that millions of Indians have carried for generations with a mark on their foreheads - a clue to reach the lost cities of Tripura.

Marked - The Quest for Tripura tells the story of the origins of Chess by putting the player through mind bending turn based puzzles as they explore the ruins of Hampi in their quest to find Tripura. In this third person puzzle exploration game you play as Dee, short for Drauni, and must find a way to escape your past and make it to the lost cities of Tripura before the agents catch you.

** Please note that the art is work in progress, this is not how the final game will look**

All the puzzles are built on 1 rule, the Knight's movement


The grid shapes create different puzzles

title: Bite Size Terrors: Reverse Blue
description:
게임 정보
Bite Size Terrors:
Are Short Experimental Horror Experiences each with their own Unique Genres and Styles.
From the Creator of Notebook Entries, this is...
Reverse Blue:
An Atmospheric Mystery.
Use your Pod to fly around & Investigate the events surrounding your fellow Air Mates.
Fear Open Space, the only thing between you & the ground, is a Bright Blue Sky.
Story:
As an engineer, your objective is to make sure your fellow air companions are doing okay mentally & that their Ethers are operational.
Ethers are used to survey Weather Disturbances & Conduct Research.
Today, as you float across the sky, an Ether is unusually floating below the clouds.
HQ encourages you to investigate the matter, as you do, you slowly realize,
This Bright Blue Sky... Is Hiding Something.
Gameplay:
Control a Pod in an open blue sky. Clouds cover your view at a distance, while you try to find each Ether to uncover the truth.
Look through logs, investigate each Ether & the outside air around you.

title: Sheep  the Stars
description:
게임 정보

High stakes rocket-powered-sheep precision platformer. Tackle the single-player story or take your rocket propelled skills into the multiplayer arena. Party-game style antics ensue as you challenge other players to a challenging race to the finish, or be left behind in the dust (and the scoreboard).
Features
Rage / Precision platformer with escalating challenges
Multiple difficulty modes to suit beginners and pros alike
Multiplayer lobbies with friends or take your chances with open lobbies
Highly customizable multiplayer gameplay for everyone
Customizable cosmetics and unlockables
Simple to learn, difficult to master

(This game is under active development, join the Discord Server or the Email List to help shape the future of the title.

title: Skeleton Scramble Deluxe 2
description:
게임 정보
Skeleton Scramble Deluxe 2 is a fast-paced tower defense/strategy hybrid.

Choose a faction and class for a unique combination of creatures and towers.

Race against your opponent to gather resources, build defenses, and defeat the enemy hero.

Each 5-10 minute game is a franic base-building tug-of-war, with lots of viable strategies and counterplay.

Each CPU bot showcases a different preferred playstyle, and defeating them all will prepare you for fierce online multiplayer battles against friends.

title: Japanese Salaryman
description:
게임 정보
About
You are Issei Ito, a talented but underappreciated security specialist at METTA East, drowning in gambling debt and office politics. When a mysterious offer from the company's enigmatic CSO promises to solve all your problems, you're thrust into a dangerous world of corporate conspiracy and moral ambiguity.
Experience a diverging plot over two weeks in 1992 Japan, where your choices in dialogue and your actions in the top-down 2D world dramatically impact the course of the story.
Whatever your actions, Issei's fate is in your hands.
Work

title: Train to Hong Kong
description:
게임 정보
트레인 투 홍콩은 포스트 아포칼립스 비주얼 노벨로, 고등학생 준의 여정을 따라가는 게임입니다. 친구들과 함께 좀비를 처치하고, 동물들로부터 도망치고, 감염된 아시아 도시를 탐험하며 홍콩에 도착하세요!

title: Smart Jump
description:
게임 정보
Isolated and stranded in the middle of the ocean, Tom takes part in a trivia quiz to try to win a prestigious trophy, the Golden Brain.
General Knowledge Quiz
You need to answer 555 multiple-choice questions on various themes.
If your answer is correct, you move on to the next question.
If your answer is wrong, you fall into the water.
There is a checkpoint for each question.
Interface
The green counter displays your score.
The red counter shows how many times you have fallen into the water.
A timer records your time. Hurry up!
Goal
All players who finish the game win a trophy, the Golden Brain.
Complete the game with a high score, a good time, and few falls into the water.
Day/night cycle
Between sea and mountains, a blue sky during the day.

title: Lana: Queen of Ancient Egypt
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey in the mystical world of Lana, where ancient secrets and formidable challenges await.
Key Features:
Explore a Vast and Mysterious World
Traverse diverse landscapes, from sun-drenched deserts to enigmatic temples, each filled with hidden secrets and rich lore.
Engage in Challenging Puzzles
Solve intricate puzzles that blend logic and creativity, unlocking pathways and uncovering the mysteries of ancient civilizations.
Battle Diverse Adversaries
Face a variety of foes, each with unique abilities and strategies, requiring quick reflexes and tactical thinking.

title: Fracctal Monsters
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to Fracctal Monsters, the ultimate monster taming experience that takes pet care and real-time combat to a whole new level!



Embark on an exciting journey filled with online exploration, immersive training, adrenaline-pumping 2D action-based platformer combat, and intense PvP battles where you'll face off against other players for epic loot and bragging rights.



In Fracctal Monsters, every virtual pet is more than just a creature – they're your loyal companions with unique personalities, distinct hobbies, specific diets, and individual preferences. Each monster offers a one-of-a-kind bond and interaction that will keep you coming back for more.



Explore a vibrant, living world where you can discover hidden secrets and participate in thrilling challenges. Obtain new monsters by opening packs or winning them in various in-game challenges. The expansive world of Fracctal Monsters is teeming with adventures that challenge your skills and strategic thinking.



Raise and evolve your monsters by engaging them in training modes, keeping them happy, and feeding them their preferred diets. Watch as they grow stronger, learn new abilities, and transform into even more powerful forms. The evolution system allows for deep customization and personal connection with your monsters.



Prepare for epic boss battles that test the limits of your monster's strength and strategy. Team up with other players or go solo to take down formidable foes and earn exclusive rewards. Each boss encounter is a challenge that requires tactical planning and skillful execution.



With a vast world to explore, countless challenges to overcome, and a thriving community of fellow tamers, Fracctal Monsters promises endless hours of fun, excitement, and adventure. So, are you ready to dive into the captivating world of monster taming and unleash the power of your Fracctal Monsters? Join us now and embark on an unforgettable journey like no other!

title: Bomber Hero
description:
게임 정보
bomber Hero

Bomber Hero is a dynamic bomberman-style game that will provide you with hours of great fun! The game offers various gameplay modes, the ability to create unique characters, and many different maps to explore.
character Creation:
Create your hero by choosing from many customization options. Adjust your character's appearance to perfectly match your playstyle.
equipment:
Bomber Hero offers a wide selection of Steam-exclusive equipment that is purely cosmetic. Change the appearance of your character with unique items that do not affect the game mechanics.
Explore various maps, each with a unique layout, obstacles, and challenges. Besides classic mazes, you will also find arenas with teleporters that add a new dimension to the gameplay.
Play online with friends by creating your own rooms - lobbies where you can compete or cooperate. You can also add bots to diversify the gameplay and increase the challenge.



Join the Bomber Hero community and start your adventure today! Get ready for an explosive fun!

title: Quantum Loop
description:
게임 정보
Zoom and dodge your way about space, exploring the quadrant and solving intertwining objectives however you can. Hit an asteroid and the mission resets - but whatever you learn you can exploit in the next loop! Use your crafty wits and precise piloting in chorus to prevent the asteroid crisis!
Quantum Loop is a short non-linear space exploration game where you play as a galactic agent sent on a mission across time to solve an existential threat to the universe: the Asteroid Crisis.
Every life matters! - Your mission takes place within a time loop!
If you hit an asteroid, it's game over. But your knowledge stays with you! Exploit what you can learn about the world to reach success!

title: Antidote city hall
description:
게임 정보
토마스라는 이름의 형사와 혼돈과 절망의 세계에 빠져. 이 도시는 그의 집이지만 지금은 지뢰밭처럼 보입니다. 마약,부패,살인-이 모든 것이 일반화되었습니다.

토마스는 도시의 수호자였지만,고위급 사건으로 경찰에서 해고당했습니다. 이제 그는 자신의 탐정 기관을 설립하고 자신의 전 영광을 회복하기 위해 노력하고있다. 그러나 시간이 지나고 여전히 고객이 없습니다. 잊혀지고 우울한 토마스는 술 한 병에서 위안을 찾습니다.

하지만 토마스는 좋은 이름을 되찾을 기회가 있습니다. 그는 마약 카르텔과 정치인과 관련된 신비한 살인 연쇄를 해결해야 할 것입니다. 그는 도시가 오랫동안 기다리고있는 영웅이 될 수있을 것인가?

게임의 특징:

-예기치 않은 왜곡이있는 흥미 진진한 이야기.
-많은 이웃과 위치가있는 거대한 도시.
-관심과 논리적 사고가 필요한 복잡한 조사 시스템.
-자신의 비밀과 동기를 가지고 각각의 다른 캐릭터와 상호 작용할 수있는 능력.
-전체 통로를 통해 당신을 동반 할 도시에서 지배적 인 두려움과 절망의 분위기.

title: Vivere Memento
description:
게임 정보


1919, Ukraine. It's the last moments of independence, and fear of the future and despair in the air are mixed with the will to live. A self-proclaimed detective comes to the club, asking about the girl from the photo whom no one remembers. A singer who dreams of writing her own songs finds strange poems of unknown authorship. Together, they try to unravel a tangle of riddles and mysterious disappearances but stumble upon something that the human mind is unable to fathom.



- Join the investigation of the two main characters, which will last 7 in-game days
- Explore the streets of the Ukrainian city of 1919 and see the life of people behind the military front line
- Enjoy the atmosphere of noir, black-and-white silent movies, original songs, and chthonic horrors
- Live through a relationship that blossomed in the face of despair

Description, including general details and list of localizations, can be added to and changed during the development of the game.

title: Frostpoint Toll
description:
게임 정보
Wake up, Pilot. We’ve arrived at Frostpoint
Say hello to your new home—if you can call it that.
Here, we appreciate a good joke. But your situation? Far from amusing. What remains of you is fragile, but one thing persists—your will.
Your Frame is online and ready to harvest
It's dangerous to go alone, and highly inefficient...
Your machine is a marvel—capable of leveling cities. You, my friend, will have a more trivial task: move through rough terrain, dig, smash, and collect for your cause.
Gratitude is expected. After all, you are still here.

title: Time Management
description:
게임 정보
Do you have what it takes to beat all 100+ levels in Time Management? Tight corridors and fast paced, yet sometimes slow, gameplay add together for an enriching experience around obstacles.
Main Features:
Walls/Death Walls
Turrets
Various Tokens (Dash, Pause, Play, and Time Addition/Subtraction
Mud
Controller Compatibility
Limited Character Customization
Custom fonts, art, sound effects, and music built and made from the ground up
Zen Mode for Practicing Levels

title: Foxnox
description:
게임 정보
Foxnox is a platformer where you will explore this strange world as a little fox, it's dangerous but there are some shiny items left. Can you get them?
Features
- Explore: Levels are not defined, it's just a big world.
- Collect items: The items will give you tools to deal with problems you will encounter. Go through walls, walk through walls, jump multiple times...
- Expand the world: You goal is getting new floppy disks to unlock new areas in the world.
- Get a higher punctuation: You can get the same floppy disks multiple times. The better you do the more points you will get!

title: Arrows and Antiquity
description:
게임 정보
The ruins of antiquity are overrun with looting bandits and only you can stop them! Set out on a quest, bow in hand, to quickly and accurately remove these raiders once and for all!
Features:
Use your agility and special arrows to earn medals and new weaponry!
Fine-tune your routes and compete for top times on leaderboards!

title: Deus Mantle
description:
게임 정보
Deus Mantle is a progression-based survival sandbox, where you find yourself exploring infinite procedurely-generated worlds full of danger and mystery.
Get prepared to face dangerous creatures to fulfill the will of the gods, and through these hardships you may just find your way home.
Every biome has unique materials you can gather and unique challenges to overcome!
Find tasty chilli peppers in Sandy Desert, dig up snowballs in Snowy Forest and get lost in Deep Forest looking for those precious berries.
Advance through technology tree, unlocking different items, buildings and game mechanics.

title: The King's Courier
description:
게임 정보
The King's Courier is a medieval delivery simulation game with roguelike elements. The King is a demanding figure - speed, stategy and careful planning will be required to meet his daily delivery demands. venture through a vibrant, open world as you strive for a 5-star courier rating.
Route planning is key. Choose a starting point and map out the most efficient path between shops, fields and delivery boxes to ensure all deliveries are made before sunrise!
Upgrade and optimise. Purchase upgrades and equipment from the store and get rewarded with cards to help optimise your route. Sometimes swapping a mushroom for a carrot can save time and prevent retracing steps!

title: Idles of Madness
description:
게임 정보
Idles of Madness is a Lovecraftian incremental/clicker that allows you to play how you want to! Want a more active playstyle? Choose upgrades that mean there’s never a dull moment! Want to sit back and relax? Choose automation upgrades that do the work for you! The choice of how to build your monstrous army is yours - but, one thing’s for sure: Cthulhu is watching…
FEATURES:

Dozens of eldritch monsters to choose from, each with their own abilities and uses.
Eldritch Laboratory & Research Tree systems, allowing you to upgrade specific monsters and unlock game-changing upgrades respectively.
Choose your playstyle - whether that’s active clicking, or passive automation.
Summon hordes of cultists, monsters and victims to sacrifice to Cthulhu!
Transmute your central horror into 10+ different forms - and, ultimately, the Great Dreamer themself...
BUILD AN ARMY OF LOVECRAFTIAN MONSTERS!



Build up your defences between waves, depending on which types of enemies are coming, and which paths they’ll take. Place and upgrade your turrets, and use special modules to make them even more powerful! Be careful: enemies may be equipped with unique upgrades designed to do extra damage if they manage to get through your defence.



Upgrade specific monsters in the Eldritch Laboratory, or unlock game-changing upgrades in the Research Tree, allowing you to choose your own playstyle - whether you want to be constantly busy, or take a more automated, AFK approach.



Each milestone you hit (and there are 10 of them!) your horror will transmute into a new form! Filled with Lovecraftian references (Aptenodytes Albus anyone?), madness awaits for those brave - or foolish - enough to discover them all…

title: Exodos
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a world of revenge to assume your role as the true king in an adventure full of dark creatures into the heart of hell.

In this epic journey of light against darkness you live in the shoes of the warrior Vergil who seeks revenge against the last skull king.

Be strong and courageous during your journey facing Zombies, wizards, ghosts and many other creatures with your powerful sword!

Avoid traps, destroy enemies with your powerful sword, quickly jump over platforms avoiding falling over the cliff like in classic action and adventure games from the 90s. Experience that nostalgia with Exodos!

Features:
33 levels divided into 7 acts.
Exciting action gameplay - use physical combos
Different obstacles and enemies.
Free imprisoned souls to paradise.
Beautiful animated graphics
2D action platformer

title: Hello
description:
게임 정보
Plot:
Try on the role of a food delivery man from the small town N. You have to live in this small and melancholy town for a whole week, collecting and delivering food to different people who inhabit this town. Eavesdrop on scraps of conversations on the street, interact with characters and be a good delivery boy!
Features:
The streets are filled with details and characters. Some of them have extra quests and stories just for you.
The melancholy atmosphere of the city. A reality filled with sadness and humor.
Take pictures of the city and get achievements.

title: Grimwalker
description:
게임 정보
슈팅 게임 "Grimwalker"에서 지옥의 군대와 대치하십시오. 다양한 무기로 짜릿한 전투를 벌이고 악마의 형상을 사용하여 더욱 강력해지십시오. 생존을 위해 자원을 관리하면서 비밀로 가득한 세계를 탐험하십시오.



클래식한 소총과 권총부터 근접 무기까지 다양한 무기의 아르설을 사용하세요. 적들과의 전투에서 승리하기 위해서는 적마의 생물들과의 싸움에서 적절한 장비 선택이 핵심입니다.



이것은 단순한 슈팅 게임뿐만 아니라, 탐험할 수 있는 수수께끼와 미스터리로 가득한 세계입니다. 장비를 관리하고 생존 기회를 제공하는 자원을 찾으세요.



자신의 악마의 형태로 변신하여 적들에게 혼란을 일으키세요. 모두는 한계를 가지고 있습니다... 악마로서, 당신은 그 한계를 무시할 수 있습니다.



잊혀진 마을을 점령한 악마들의 군대에 맞서 싸우고, 악마들의 미스터리를 풀어내기 위해 일어나세요.

title: Alice - Island Adventure
description:
게임 정보


Embark on an enthralling adventure with Alice as she sets out on her much-awaited vacation, eagerly anticipating a well-deserved break from the monotony of daily life. Excitement courses through her veins as she boards the plane, her mind filled with visions of relaxation and exploration in exotic locales.

However, fate has other plans in store for Alice.

What begins as minor disturbances soon escalates into a series of inexplicable events that plunge Alice into a whirlwind of chaos and uncertainty. The once-promising journey quickly morphs into a harrowing ordeal as Alice grapples with the unsettling realization that something sinister is afoot.

Amidst the chaos, questions swirl in Alice's mind. Are these disruptions mere coincidences, or is there a deeper, darker force at play? With each passing moment, the mystery deepens, drawing Alice deeper into a web of intrigue and danger.

title: Deus Mantle
description:
게임 정보
