Features:
Use your agility and special arrows to earn medals and new weaponry!
Fine-tune your routes and compete for top times on leaderboards!

title: Idles of Madness
description:
게임 정보
Idles of Madness is a Lovecraftian incremental/clicker that allows you to play how you want to! Want a more active playstyle? Choose upgrades that mean there’s never a dull moment! Want to sit back and relax? Choose automation upgrades that do the work for you! The choice of how to build your monstrous army is yours - but, one thing’s for sure: Cthulhu is watching…
FEATURES:

Dozens of eldritch monsters to choose from, each with their own abilities and uses.
Eldritch Laboratory & Research Tree systems, allowing you to upgrade specific monsters and unlock game-changing upgrades respectively.
Choose your playstyle - whether that’s active clicking, or passive automation.
Summon hordes of cultists, monsters and victims to sacrifice to Cthulhu!
Transmute your central horror into 10+ different forms - and, ultimately, the Great Dreamer themself...
BUILD AN ARMY OF LOVECRAFTIAN MONSTERS!



Build up your defences between waves, depending on which types of enemies are coming, and which paths they’ll take. Place and upgrade your turrets, and use special modules to make them even more powerful! Be careful: enemies may be equipped with unique upgrades designed to do extra damage if they manage to get through your defence.



Upgrade specific monsters in the Eldritch Laboratory, or unlock game-changing upgrades in the Research Tree, allowing you to choose your own playstyle - whether you want to be constantly busy, or take a more automated, AFK approach.



Each milestone you hit (and there are 10 of them!) your horror will transmute into a new form! Filled with Lovecraftian references (Aptenodytes Albus anyone?), madness awaits for those brave - or foolish - enough to discover them all…

title: Exodos
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a world of revenge to assume your role as the true king in an adventure full of dark creatures into the heart of hell.

In this epic journey of light against darkness you live in the shoes of the warrior Vergil who seeks revenge against the last skull king.

Be strong and courageous during your journey facing Zombies, wizards, ghosts and many other creatures with your powerful sword!

Avoid traps, destroy enemies with your powerful sword, quickly jump over platforms avoiding falling over the cliff like in classic action and adventure games from the 90s. Experience that nostalgia with Exodos!

Features:
33 levels divided into 7 acts.
Exciting action gameplay - use physical combos
Different obstacles and enemies.
Free imprisoned souls to paradise.
Beautiful animated graphics
2D action platformer

title: Hello
description:
게임 정보
Plot:
Try on the role of a food delivery man from the small town N. You have to live in this small and melancholy town for a whole week, collecting and delivering food to different people who inhabit this town. Eavesdrop on scraps of conversations on the street, interact with characters and be a good delivery boy!
Features:
The streets are filled with details and characters. Some of them have extra quests and stories just for you.
The melancholy atmosphere of the city. A reality filled with sadness and humor.
Take pictures of the city and get achievements.

title: Wesley Smith's Repair Game
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Wesley Smith's Repair Game! Join self-declared blacksmith Wesley on his journey of collecting items and crafting weapons to show off his blacksmith skills. But if you already happen to have the weapons, you can use them for other things too, like getting rid of your annoying friends!
Compete against the merciless bots or up to three friends in this couch co-op adventure of collecting items, crafting weapons and defeating your opponents! Chop off their body parts with a chainsaw, burn them to ash with a flamethrower, vacuum away their remains with a vacuum cleaner, or turn to the dark side with a laser sword! With a selection of 12 characters with unique bonuses, three mind-blowing game modes and 12 diverse arenas, Wesley Smith's Repair Game is guaranteed to be frustratingly fun!
Collecting and crafting
Collect various items and craft them into weapons at one of the shops to defeat your opponents. Search food to replenish your health and collect various tools to increase your chances to become the master blacksmith!
Chests and frenzy drops
Once in a while a chest or a frenzy drop spawns up for grabs for anyone. Be sure to get your hands on those to get rare and precious goodies or to initiate a chain reaction of dropping items, chests, or deadly mines!
Multiple characters and game modes

title: The Dark Cowboy
description:
게임 정보
짜릿한 일인칭 공포 어드벤처에 빠져보세요.
Unreal Engine으로 제작된 SoloDev by Valezart.



당신은 용감한 카우보이 제임스 라이더가 될 것이며, 무자비한 블랙우즈 갱단이 그의 가족을 살해할 때 그의 인생은 파괴됩니다. 복수를 위해 그들이 숨어있는 위험한 산맥으로 모험을 떠날 것입니다. 그러나 탐험하면서 숨어있는 그림자가 범죄자를 넘어서는 공포를 품고 있다는 것을 발견하게 될 것입니다. 치명적인 이세계적인 위협이 현실을 악몽으로 변화시켰습니다.




바람이 부는 매번 어두움에 안내되며 랜턴의 약한 빛만으로 어둠을 탐험하면서 산의 기이한 속삭임을 듣습니다. 폭풍 중에는 번개가 하늘을 가르며 바위와 비틀린 나무의 윤곽에 유령 같은 번쩍임을 드러내는 때에만 길을 힘겨울게 볼 수 있을 것입니다.




모든 모퉁이에서 기다리는 상상할 수 없는 공포에 대비하세요. 당신의 유용하지 않은 리볼버로 이러한 불가사의한 것들을 대적하려는 어떤 시도도 확실한 죽음으로 이어질 것입니다. 당신의 감각을 예민하게 유지하세요, 이 살아있는 악몽에서는 그들이 습격하기 전까지 숨겨진 공포를 분간할 수 없을 것입니다.




시네마틱 스토리텔링이 최상위 제작과 원활하게 어우러지는 곳입니다. 감동적인 목소리 연기, 숨막히는 시각 효과 및 오리지널 사운드트랙을 품은 서사에 몰입하고, 블록버스터 영화의 예술성을 반영하는 진정한 감상적인 게임 어드벤처를 경험하세요.

title: Calm Bee the Storm
description:
게임 정보
매일 15,000명의 사람들이 아침 출근길에 후지노미야역을 통과합니다. 이 작은 역에는 직장인, 학생, 여행자들이 모여듭니다 어떤 사람들은 이것을 인간의 폭풍이라고 부릅니다. 그런데 한 사람도 역에 들어오기도 전에 한 남자가 청소를 하러 온다. 새벽이 밝아오고 세상은 여전히 잠들어 있는 것처럼 당신은 폭풍 전의 고요함입니다
Calm Before the Storm은 복고풍 일본 테마의 청소 시뮬레이터 게임으로, 새벽에 인간의 폭풍이 역에 도착하기 직전에 청소 작업자로 일하게 됩니다.
지도에는 게임을 완벽하게 경험하고 탐색하려는 사람들을 위한 대화형 개체, 추가 기능 및 비밀이 가득합니다. 당신의 실력을 시험할 수 있는 다양한 엔딩과 끝없는 미니 게임이 있습니다.
역학
대걸레
쓰레기 수거

title: Catting Over It
description:
게임 정보
Fluffy Jumping Adventure - Catting Over It: You must fight for your love, never giving up! A dangerous monster has kidnapped the love of your life! This challenging journey to the top will require great skill in calculating trajectories, self-control, and the ability to plan your actions. Just remember, falling is not scary, at the bottom awaits a soft blanket and your beloved basket.



Main features:
Prepare for complex trajectory calculations.



While going up, you can find skill points, build your character, but remember, different skill sets may be needed for each level.

title: Punk Juice
description:
게임 정보


Join a band with two crass, potty-mouthed punks, Ricki and Max. What else do you have going on Tuesday nights? Curate your style, endure the trials and tribulations of public transit, and play dead-end gigs! Go on mediocre dates, thrift with your besties, buy overpriced coffee, and complain about the cost of rent in this Seattle-inspired grungy city. Punk Juice invites you to recreate your life… Only worse!
WHAT KIND OF PUNK ARE YOU?

Fully customize your character from their hair to their socks! Your punk reflects whatever inner rebel lies within you. Stay up to date with the latest fashions, shop for "new" clothes at the thrift store, and befriend new styles from your friends.
PLAY DEAD-END GIGS

Unravel an overarching narrative where every decision you make decides your fate. Play rhythm mini games to make a name for yourself in the music scene, be it rivals, friends, or new connections. Go on adventures with your bandmates to build your friendships and unlock extra pieces of the story.

Check out every nook and cranny that makes up the unique neighborhoods in Punk Juice. You'll find new places, quests, and friends in every hot spot.

Who knows what relationships blossom on your adventure? Will you make new friends, keep it casual, or flirt with the enemy...

title: Specters of the Sun
description:
게임 정보


Play as a Specter - Attack while moving, jumping and dashing, throw your sword and watch it ricochet on the walls, and phase to its position, like a specter!



Action-packed Stages - Cross the fallen lands, through deep woods, abandoned towns and graveyards, on your way up the behemoth structure.

- Face end of stage challenges with emergent gameplay and high replayability.



- Find useful sub weapons along the way and make strategic decisions which to keep or replace throughout the levels.



- Fine tune the difficulty on the fly, save states or even skip sections completely.

title: Tangled Crisis
description:
게임 정보
Search, dodge, find and collect in this minimalist score based maze game with limited vision, before the timer runs out!
Mechanics 
BOOST: Gain a temporarily boost of speed and invulnerability to pass through hazards.
VISION: Enlarge your vision and reveal hidden paths.
BUILD SCORE: Collect coins and try to beat your previous run.
FIND KEYS: Search for keys to reach the exit.

title: The Unseen
description:
게임 정보
House parties aren't supposed to result in your death, right?
Find yourself thrown into the depths of darkness with little chance of making it out alive in The Unseen. What starts as a seemingly normal house party quickly turns into a nightmare as you become trapped in a dark, twisting labyrinth beneath. But beware, you are not alone. To survive, you must understand your hunter...
Being Hunted
As apex predators, humans rarely rely on their senses in everyday life. That is about to change. You will need to sharpen your instincts and use the environment to your advantage to evade terrifying threats and unfavourable outcomes. Every shadow, sound, and hiding spot could mean the difference between life and death.
Resource Management
Scarcity breeds chaos. Can you truly trust another human to help you survive, or would you betray them to ensure your own survival? Resources are limited, and every decision matters. Banding together can help you cover more ground and increase your chances of survival, but always keep an eye on your 'friends'. That torch in their hand looks like it's in good condition... but would it look better in your hands?
Crafting
Crafting can ensure your survival, it could also attract some unwanted attention. One wrong move and all your hard work will count for nothing.
Survival
To survive like an animal, you must think like an animal. Cover your scent. Find food. Find water. Adapt to your environment. Use every resource at your disposal. As always, bring something heavy... just in case.
Secrets
Who would do something like this? Why would they do this? What is this place? Find the the answers in the deepest depths of this terrible place. Uncover the dark secrets that force you to fight for survival.

title: NANOVOID
description:
게임 정보
In NANOVOID it's not just about the shooting - it's about outsmarting your enemies. Customize and command your modular ship where each piece adds a unique function and can be the difference between victory and defeat. But beware, your enemies aren't just a health bar. Their ships also use the same modular system, meaning you'll need to strategically target their ship's components to disable them effectively.



Engage in intense battles where the laws of physics reign supreme. Every movement, every shot fired, every explosion generates forces that can be used to your advantage - or lead to your downfall if mismanaged.

Features:

Modular Ships: Build your own spaceship from various modules, each with its own function and characteristics.
Realistic Physics: All actions have consequences, and the realistic physics engine brings a new level of depth to space combat.
Tactical Combat: Outmaneuver your enemies, target their weak points, and use the environment to your advantage.
Epic Encounters: Face off against a variety of enemies, each with their own unique behaviors, attack patterns, and weaknesses.
Stunning Visuals: Experience the beauty and chaos of space with visually stunning graphics and special effects.

In this 2D tactical space shooter, you'll engage in fast-paced battles against deadly enemies and bosses, using strategy and planning to outmaneuver and outgun your opponents. Utilize your skills and reflexes to take down powerful bosses, and immerse yourself in a beautifully designed universe with stunning visuals and special effects.

Fly and fight using intuitive WSAD controls and mouse aim. The open space offers strategic possibilities, allowing you to retreat and recover your shields before re-engaging.

title: Fateful Bullet
description:
게임 정보
Fateful Bullet is an exhilarating third-person arena shooter set in a futuristic world with a vibrant anime aesthetic. Engage in adrenaline-pumping combat where agility and strategy are key to dominating your opponents. Experience the thrill of performing Matrix-style moves, such as wall jumps and dashes, to outmaneuver your enemies and gain the upper hand.
Key Features:

Dynamic Movement System: Execute impressive wall jumps and dashes to navigate the battlefield with style and precision.

Character Customization: Create and personalize your own unique character with a wide array of customization options.

Three Distinct Play Styles:
Unlimited: Combine firearms and melee weapons for versatile combat.
Only Swords: Engage in intense melee combat using only swords.
Only Guns: Rely solely on your firearms for ranged battles.

Variety Of Game Modes:
Team Deathmatch: Work with your team to outscore the opposition.
Touchdown: Capture and deliver the objective to score points.
Battle Royale: Survive against all odds in a free-for-all showdown.
Arcade: Enjoy various fun and challenging scenarios.

Ranked and Casual Play: Climb the ranks in competitive matches or enjoy casual sessions with friends in private lobbies.

Weapon and Skill Variety: Equip up to three weapons along with skills and items to enhance your combat effectiveness.


Join the battle in Fateful Bullet and rise through the ranks as you showcase your skills and strategic prowess. Whether competing for glory or just having fun with friends, Fateful Bullet offers an engaging and action-packed experience for all players.

title: Wild Mars
description:
게임 정보
WISHLIST NOW BEFORE THE STORM HITS
A Mars survival management simulator in which you must produce fuel from bacteria and algae to leave Mars before an incoming storm destroys your base. Defend your base from the bacteria that infest it. Manage the fuel that also powers your base's elevator. Make crucial decisions to survive.
DEFEND YOUR BASE FROM THE BACTERIA

title: Fantasy Football Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Fantasy Football Tactics는 아메리칸 풋볼과 축구에서 아이디어를 얻은 턴 방식 풋볼 RPG 게임입니다. 판타지 세계를 배경으로 왕국을 횡단하고 라이벌을 물리치며 챔피언 팀을 구성해야 합니다.
게임 플레이
4대4 턴 방식 택티컬 풋볼 경기에서 팀을 위해 결정을 내리고 경쟁에서 앞서가세요.
각 플레이어는 자기 차례에 한 번 이동하고 한 가지 행동을 할 수 있습니다.
볼을 차지해 골 존으로 던지거나 직접 들고 가세요. 방법은 당신에게 달려 있습니다!
두 골을 먼저 넣는 팀이 승리합니다.
상대에게 대미지를 주면 실책을 하거나 경기장에서 완전히 쓰러질 확률이 높아집니다.
멀리서 마법 주문을 쓰거나 가까이에서 강력한 태클을 날리세요.
특수 능력으로 볼을 던지고, 선수를 치유하고, 경기장을 누비고, 팀을 강화하거나 상대 팀을 약하게 만드세요.
자연 속성을 활용해 팀의 잠재력을 최대한 끌어내세요.
왕국의 독특한 경기장에서 16곳에서 퀘스트를 수행하며, 팀원들에게 강력하고 새로운 능력을 가르치세요.
8가지 포지션에 걸쳐 팀에 선수를 발탁하세요.
각 행동에서 경험치를 획득해 레벨을 올리고 능력치를 높이세요.
결과가 좋지 않은 결정을 내렸나요? 걱정 마세요! 되감기 기능으로 쉽게 다시 도전할 수 있습니다.
퀵 매치 모드에서는 경기 규칙을 설정해 CPU 또는 친구와 대결할 수 있습니다.
각 경기장은 1990년대 로우 폴리 스타일로 정성스럽게 만들어졌습니다.
스토리
옛날 옛적, 모든 정치 및 영토 분쟁은 수많은 전투와 암살, 잔인한 전쟁으로 해결되었습니다. 수 세기에 걸쳐 많은 목숨을 잃은 후, 왕국은 문화가 발달하고 평화를 찾았습니다. 무기는 버려지고, 전사와 마법사들은 전투 기술을 풋볼 경기에 새롭게 적용했습니다. 국가들은 더 이상 군사력이 아니라, 스포츠 경기의 승리를 통해 힘을 얻습니다. 본국을 선택하고 이 땅의 챔피언이 되어 보세요!
팀 선발
8가지 포지션에 걸쳐 원하는 선수 조합을 구성하세요. 원한다면 전원 "밸런서"로 맞출 수 있습니다. 밸런서가 뭐냐고요? 좋은 질문입니다!

밸런서: 위대한 치유사의 후예인 밸런서는 팀의 중심을 잡고 공을 점유하는 데 중추적인 역할을 합니다. 전장에서 부상을 치료하는 능력은 팀원의 집중력과 인내력을 향상하는 용도로 바뀌었습니다.
스로워: 한때는 금지되었던 기술이 이제는 스로워의 특기가 되었으니, 그것은 바로 전방 패스입니다. 이제 공격의 중추로 여겨지는 스로워는 팀의 태생적 리더이자 공을 던지는 데 능숙한 전문가입니다.






이 게임은 영어 버전의 출시만 예정되어 있지만, 찜 목록 수를 적극적으로 모니터링하여 가장 관심이 많은 언어로 우선 번역할 예정입니다. 찜 목록에 추가해 관심을 표해주세요. 감사합니다!

title: Operation Crustacean
description:
게임 정보
Ride a hotdog-selling shrimp through a surreal and perilous island in this punishing 3D platformer with a twisted sense of humor.
STORY

Wake up, soldier!
You play as the lone survivor of Operation Crustacean, who got stranded in a secret world. Explore a dark and gloomy island filled with danger and unravel its mysteries to find a way back home.

GAMEPLAY

Challenge yourself with the unique shrimp-riding controls and the game's permadeath mechanics that will require all your skill.
Alternate between 2 control schemes on the fly with the press of a button: "Precision" for accurate controls and direct, vertical movement; "Gallop" to go fast and far - but at a price: The increased momentum requires planning ahead.
Avoid deadly traps, encounter ridiculous enemies and face off against epic bosses that will push you to your limits.
Experience a surreal and twisted sense of humor that will make you laugh and shiver at the same time.
Uncover rare permanent power-ups that will give you the decisive edge when it comes to life and death.

Do you have what it takes to survive and escape this bizarre island? Giddy up!

title: The Left Behind
description:
게임 정보
The Left Behind is a solo and co-op post-apocalyptic survival game. Explore a typical Dutch open-world landscape at daytime and beware of hordes of enemies coming in at night. Loot and hunt to survive. Each night, the game becomes increasingly challenging. Keep track of your highscore and try to survive as many nights as possible.
The world
Explore typical Dutch landscapes in a post apocalyptic setting. Every building you encounter can be entered and looted. Discover the personality of each building, the world and the people that used to live in it.
Objectives
Survive with up to four (4) people as long as you can in this harsh world. Survive together or take on each other to see who survives the longest? It’s up to you to decide! Loot abandoned buildings at daylight and try to survive enemies coming in at night. Keep an eye out for your food, thirst and health bar at all times. Stack up some food while you can, you never know when you need it…

title: Angel
description:
게임 정보
브레이크비트 리듬 레이싱 디지털 기후 변화가 eCho 네트워크의 멸종을 위협하는 PSX 영감을 받은 리듬 레이싱 모험 ANGEL에 몰입하세요. 정체된 네트워크에 새로운 활력을 불어넣기 위해 새로운 브레이크 비트를 제작하면서 디지털 풍경을 통해 추진합니다. ANGEL은 레이싱의 흐름 상태에 브레이크비트 음악의 복잡성을 부여하여 아케이드 및 콤보 기반 게임 플레이를 재정의하며, MyraTV, Superdeath 및 많은 다른 브레이크비트 애호가들의 사운드트랙으로 강화됩니다. eCho가 멸종 위기에 처했을 때 ANGEL 프로토콜 - 탐험, 창조, 성찰 - 이 계속됩니다. 연결된다는 것이 무엇을 의미하는지 묻는 여정을 시작하세요.\r\n\r\n

title: ADRIFT
description:
게임 정보
어느 날 갑자기 ADRIFT의 세상으로 들어와, 운전대를 잡게 된 당신의 목표는 오직 하나. 에너지 코어를 운반하는 것입니다. 이유도 목적지도 방법도 알 수 없는 상황에서, 당신의 머릿속에서는 온갖 의문이 요동칠 뿐이죠.
사막을 질주하는 트럭
오프로드 트럭의 시동을 걸고, 굽이진 계곡을 따라 움직이세요. 모래 언덕에서는 속도를 올리고, 험난한 평원에서 기다리는 난관을 핸드브레이크로 돌파하며, 세월의 풍파에 휩쓸린 세상 속을 질주하세요.
운명이 걸린 화물
분과 초를 다투는 상황에서도 침착하게 주변을 탐색하고 경로를 계획한 뒤, 다음 오아시스로 돌진하세요. 하지만 신비한 에너지 코어가 사막의 열기 속에 방치된 채로 매초가 흐를 때마다, 당신의 운명도 끝을 향해 조금씩 달려간다는 것을 잊어서는 안 됩니다.
끝없는 여정 속으로
오랫동안 잊힌 사막의 고요함 속에서 과거의 사건을 밝혀내세요. 지름길을 개척하고, 나만의 경로를 설계하여, 베이퍼웨이브 스타일로 창조된 탑뷰 세계 속을 자유롭게 누비세요!

title: Crab Attack
description:
게임 정보
Grab and Run
Get as many resources as you can by chaining enemy kills, smashing rocks, and discovering secrets. Once you've got as much as you dare, escape with your loot- just don't die before the timer elapses or you'll drop it all.

Explore
Every stage is packed with secret areas to discover, each one brimming with new resources, blueprints, and enemies. Smart use of your weapon's elemental effects and a sharp eye will be required to uncover them all.
Power Up
Build and equip dozens of different weapons and other upgrades with the resources you find. Taking on all of Crater City's challenges will require strategically picking the right tools for each job.

Using everything you've built up, defeat tough bosses for your ultimate reward: meteor shards. Collect enough to unlock new stages with even greater challenges.

title: Path of the Tank
description:
게임 정보


Path of the Tank is an action-RPG where you can only play as a tank. But why? Why a tank and nothing else? Find out in this linear, story-driven and easy to pick up game that may remind you of a different time.

Gameplay features:

-Modernized old-school fighting in real-time
-Simple yet deep skill tree, with 5 powerful late-game options to freely choose
-Hunger mechanic; scavenge for food to survive!
-Wide variety of enemies from different fronts
-Upgradeable armor, potions and weapons
-Tons of secret areas that may contain more than simple loot
-Basic experience earning system. Defeat enemies and complete missions to gain xp!
-Lots of conversations with differents characters, some with a philosophical questioning.
-Locations to travel like dark crystaline caves, villages, ruins, dungeons, and, mostly, lushful forests!
-Long boss fights (you're a tank, you won't do much damage!)



Story:

Something went terribly wrong. Nature is completely altered; earth itself is coming to life, animals are scared and the spirits are restless. The balance of existance itself, which is key for the stability of life has been altered beyond recognition. It's not the first time that this has happened, and it won't be the last. The price that the rational and even the non-rational beings are paying in this world is heavy. Will you be able to stop this disaster? Of course you can. Otherwise no story would be told. But you're here to discover a lot more than that. Remove the nightmares of the innocent beings in this land, tank. Travel the path. Eat the path.



There's a lot of places to discover while traveling the path. Perhaps you could dig out some information out of your past too...? But most importantly...



Can you challenge oblivion itself?

title: Synthetica: Cyber Club Manager
description:
게임 정보
Step into a neon-lit cyberpunk world as the manager of a club where lonely clients seek to fulfill their desires. Build android girls from scrap, match them to clients’ needs, and ensure every guest leaves satisfied. Earn money, research new technologies, and dive into your clients’ personal stories—help them solve their problems or make things worse. The choice is yours.
Manage every detail of your club: keep track of finances, restock supplies, assign tasks to your android workers, analyze clients’ needs and desires, and stay informed by monitoring news that shapes the world around you.

title: Paranatural
description:
게임 정보

온라인에서 다른 플레이어와 팀을 이루거나 혼자서 계약을 완료하며, 다양한 초자연 사냥 장비를 사용하여 유령을 식별하세요.
식별된 유령의 유형에 따라 독특한 퇴마 의식을 수행하세요.
주의: 퇴마에 실패하면 파괴적인 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다.
현재 16가지의 독특한 퇴마 의식이 있으며, 출시 후 더욱 많은 의식이 추가될 예정입니다.


Paranatural은 이전에 본 적 없는 독창적이고 동적인 유령 시스템을 사용합니다.
50가지 이상의 동적 반응 기반 유령 이벤트로 이루어진 전에 없던 무서운 경험이 언제나 가까이에 있습니다.
유령은 당신의 모든 움직임을 학습하고 적응하여, 자신의 능력과 환경을 활용합니다.
동적 유령 시스템은 모든 기본 게임 위치뿐만 아니라 커뮤니티가 만든 사용자 지정 위치에서도 자동으로 작동합니다!


유령 사냥의 여정 동안 유령 사냥에 특화된 애플리케이션이 장착된 특별한 전화기가 제공됩니다.
이 애플리케이션들은 영구적으로 전화기에 남아 있으며, 레벨 업할수록 게임 내 상점에서 구매할 수 있습니다.


Unreal Engine의 MetaHumans를 사용하여 완전한 기능을 갖춘 캐릭터 커스터마이저로 외모와 의상을 커스터마이즈할 수 있습니다.
또한 계약으로 벌어들인 돈을 사용하여 창고 내부를 커스터마이즈할 수 있습니다.

title: Steam & Stones
description:
게임 정보
Team up with your friends and build a thriving dwarven city. 
Use automation to unlock new technologies and harness the power of water, lava, and steam. Create an intricate network of minecarts and clever contraptions to power your industries. Craft the finest dwarven goods, including the best ales to keep your hardworking dwarves fueled and happy. Watch your dwarven city flourish as you amass a fortune, and build a city of stone and steam!
Steam & Stones is still in active development!
Join our Discord to help playtest and give your feedback, and support us by adding the game to your Wishlist!
Features
A full minecart system to haul quantity of ores and crystals from big distances
A torque-based power system to power machines and contraptions.
Water (and lava) physics
Automation working hand in hands with your residents
A bustling city-builder, where Dwarves have demands. Housing, beer, you name it!
Tech tree to unlock new machines, upgrades, and new processes.
Brewing your own beer, for export or local consumption.
Dwarves
Gold
More dwarves

title: Albert's Ark Idle
description:
게임 정보
Experience Albert’s Ark Idle, an idle/clicker adventure filled with magical minigames and exciting activities! Gather money by clicking your castle, playing minigames, buying and upgrading buildings, and restore magic to the kingdom while you go on fun adventures!


Fishing, Fusions and Food

Use the power of Creature Essence to unlock minigames. Grow vegetables at the farm to gain a variety of buffs, or use the harbor to explore the Seven Seas with Albert and come back with huge treasures.




After acquiring Creature Essence from adventures, from all over the world, who will help you with your tasks. Harness the strength of the Bigfoot, the grace of the Unicorn, and the whimsical magical powers of the Fairy to and boost your clicks.




Through hard work and the help of your mystical friends, return magic to the world, which will bring changes to the island with new visuals and also give a boost to your income.




Upgrade and develop your buildings and watch as they visually change to bigger and more impressive structures!




Jealous and greedy pirates will “visit” you to take your riches. or click away the bombs they throw at you to stop them, keeping your island safe from their pillaging schemes... for a time.




Use this power to for your next playthrough! Choose your path, craft your destiny, and ascend to greatness in the world of Albert’s Ark Idle.

title: Neospace
description:
게임 정보


You wake up in a spaceship. Your memory is blurred and you immediately sense that something is wrong. Strange noises echo through the corridors and strange shadows move along the walls. You quickly realize that you are not alone and that something dangerous is on board. Your top priority is to get back to civilization. But this is easier said than done. The eerie encounters you make on your journey gnaw at your mind and make you doubt your own perception.

Continuous storyline


As you try to unlock the secrets of the universe, you will gradually discover the truth about yourself and your role in the universe. Why are you here? What made you so special that you ended up in this situation? The answers lie hidden somewhere inside this mysterious ship and the universe.



hub world

Your journey always leads you back to a central hub world. This not only serves as a hub to get to the next chapter of your story, but also offers a variety of entertaining mini-games. These mini-games are not only a welcome change of pace, but also offer the opportunity to earn unique rewards. Can you become the best and break all records?




The path back to civilization is peppered with challenges. You will come across numerous tricky puzzles that will put your logical thinking and powers of observation to the test. Collect helpful items, combine them cleverly and find creative solutions to make progress. Every puzzle you solve brings you closer to the truth.



If you get stuck, you can activate the help system. This system highlights important story components and hints in neon blue and helps you to find the next step. But be warned: this function is only available on the “Easy” and “Normal” difficulty levels. In the higher difficulty levels, you are completely on your own.

Immerse yourself in this exciting adventure, solve the mystery of your existence and find out what role you play in the grand scheme of the universe. Prepare yourself for the fact that nothing is as it seems and that every decision you make has consequences. Your destiny is in your hands.

title: We Have To Let You Go
description:
게임 정보
We Have To Let You Go is a puzzle RPG game about getting fired (literally) by your totalitarian dictator boss and going on a journey to stop his new business prospects to take over the world.
Features

6 sprawling chapters with plenty of secrets to uncover.
Classic Dragon Quest inspired battles with puzzle elements.
Over 20 unique abilities that offer constant creativity in battle.
Challenging boss fights that require skill and strategy to overcome.
A vital dodge mechanic that adds a risk and reward factor to combat.
A large cast of delightful characters to meet on your journey.
A cute and colorful pixel art style.
Several collectables and optional side quests.
An ever-changing soundtrack that develops throughout the adventure.

We Have To Let You Go will release in 2025
autokwd: We Have To Let You Go

title: Thor's Wrath
description:
게임 정보
Thor's Wrath is a solo defense and combat game. You embody a formidable and somewhat brute warrior. Armed with Thor's mighty hammer, you must face hordes of enemies alone while protecting the city's treasures. The goal is to climb to the top of the best warrior rankings and prove yourself worthy of Thor's hammer! The real challenge lies in your ability to wield your hammer or cast spells with precision while safeguarding your treasures.

Thor's Wrath offers immediate entertainment, is a highly accessible game with different levels of complexity and features innovative game mechanics.
Warning :this Game Is Virtual Reality Only
Main Gameplay Elements

Environment & Level : closed environment represented by different places of a huge castle in a dark fantasy world and several levels of difficulties.

Game physics : ragdoll animation providing a lot of fun when you throw the enemies around the environment and destructible scenery.

Weapons: powerful hammer to hit, throw, activate attack spells

Enemies : thieves, Attackers and Defenders with each a different fighting behavior

Score : based on multiple skills (enemies killed, duration of the fight, scenery destroyed, accuracy of throws, …)
Other features

Unique gameplay featuring hammer manipulation like a boomerang.

Competition between players from around the world.

Possibility to improve your skills to create replayability.

Hyper casual game accessible to both casual and hardcore gamers.

Learning through experience : the player increases their score through their skills.

title: Onslaught: Rift
description:
게임 정보
Onslaught: Rift is an arcade hack and slash where you rapidly switch between three heroes to decimate waves of enemies! Learn to master each hero's set of abilities as you actively switch between them to efficiently destroy your foes.
Venture through a variety of dangerous areas, each with unique monsters and bosses to vanquish!
As your skill increases, accrue more medals by conquering harder difficulties and achieving higher scores!
Fight solo or take up arms with up to three other friends in local co-op!

title: Wizavior
description:
게임 정보
"Wizavior" is a 3D platformer that will pull you into a whirlwind of adventure! The game offers two modes: Arcade and Story Mode. Arcade Mode will test your skills by constantly increasing the difficulty level as you progress, providing an intense and rewarding challenge. Meanwhile, Story Mode lets you step into the shoes of the titular Wizavior—a retired wizard who, with humor and determination, sets out once again to save the world from evil. The story mode also features an incredible narrative enriched with fully animated cutscenes and a progression system that allows you to follow the unfolding events and fully immerse yourself in the epic tale.

title: Red Van Simulator 極速紅Van傳說
description:
게임 정보
遊戲中玩家扮演亡命紅色小巴 （後稱紅Van）司機，為賺錢養家，不惜超速駕駛。玩家需要上下移動，避開障礙物，以最快速度到達終點！
In the game, players take on the role of a reckless red minibus (hereafter referred to as "Red Van") driver , who drives at high speeds to earn money to support their family. Players need to move up and down to avoid obstacles and reach the finish line as quickly as possible!
遊戲靈感來自網上多張超速照片，加上製作者以往的經歷，紅Van司機永不減速轉彎。網上更有改圖笑稱紅Van司機比起漫畫頭文字D的賽車手更為厲害。
The game is inspired by numerous online photos of speeding violations, combined with the creator's past experiences. The Red Van driver never brakes while turning. There are even online memes joking that Red Van drivers are more skilled than the racers in the comic "Initial D."
不過，隨著香港的夜生活減少，加上鐵路愈起愈多，紅Van已漸趨式微，玩家就可能是最後一代亡命紅Van傳奇。
However, with the decline of nightlife in Hong Kong and the increasing number of railways, the Red Van has gradually faded away. Players may be the last generation of legendary reckless Red Van drivers.
autokwd: Red Van Simulator 極速紅Van傳說

title: Lunar Corps
description:
게임 정보
ENLIST TODAY
Our Galaxy is under threat! In a cataclysmic uprising, the Harbingers have unleashed their wrath, ravaging countless worlds in a relentless bid for supremacy. Stand against the tide of destruction and fight for the fate of the Galaxy.

LEAD
Climb the ranks of 'The Lunar Corps'. Lead your fellow comrades into the face of battle and become the leader the Corps needs.

LIBERATE
Defend our planets and moons from the forces of evil. Bring justice to all those who have fallen.

UPGRADE
Customize your character, choose your weapons and upgrade your abilities.


MATURE CONTENT
This game may contain content that is not suitable for all ages or for viewing in the workplace, including frequent violence, gore, and general mature themes.

title: Zompell
description:
게임 정보
***We are looking for a Publisher for this game, Let us know***

Welcome to the post-apocalyptic world of "Zompell Survival Zombie," a heart-pounding first-person shooter experience now available on Steam. In this adrenaline-fueled game, players find themselves amidst a relentless onslaught of zombies, tasked with defending against waves of the undead using a vast array of weapons at their disposal. From pistols and shotguns to assault rifles and explosives, each weapon offers a unique advantage in the fight for survival.

But the excitement doesn't stop there. As players dispatch zombies, they accumulate experience points (XP) which can be used to unlock and harness powerful magic spells. These spells, ranging from protective barriers to devastating elemental attacks, provide an extra layer of strategy and defense against the ever-encroaching hordes.

With four distinct maps to choose from, each presenting its own challenges and opportunities, players can test their skills in diverse environments. Whether it's navigating through abandoned city streets, fighting for survival in a desolate wilderness, or holding out against the undead onslaught in a fortified compound, there's no shortage of thrilling scenarios to explore.

Competitive players will find added motivation in the game's leaderboard system, which records the highest scores and ranks players based on their performance. Will you rise to the top and claim the title of ultimate survivor?

Furthermore, "Zompell Survival Zombie" is committed to delivering ongoing excitement and fresh content. Regular updates will introduce new maps, weapons, and gameplay features, ensuring that players always have something new to discover and master.

And that's not all—should the game garner sufficient interest and support, plans are in place to introduce multiplayer functionality, allowing players to join forces with friends or compete against each other in intense zombie-slaying action.

With its intense gameplay, diverse features, and commitment to ongoing updates, "Zompell Survival Zombie" offers an immersive and endlessly thrilling experience for fans of the survival zombie genre. Are you prepared to face the apocalypse head-on?

title: Jaderaze Inferno
description:
게임 정보
Jaderaze Inferno
The protagonist of the game is the warrior cat spirit, the guardian who protects his island at the time of need. The hero spirit is always in a jade dream, but if the island and its inhabitants were in danger, then people would awaken the guardian warrior, and he would come to the rescue. It has always been so. But years, hundreds of years passed, disasters didn't occur, generations of people changed, and stories about the jade guardian began to be forgotten until there was not a single person who remembered the spirit. And then horror appeared, people failed, the island was enslaved, poisoned by otherworldly filth and distorted. The filth spread everywhere and even reached the jade dream of the warrior cat spirit. Then the keeper woke up from the corruption penetrating into a dream, not understanding why he was not called on time, why his house was destroyed. The warrior, distraught with grief, embarks on his journey, the purpose of which is to destroy the source of filth.
Cats protect us
Travel around the big island of Catsushina
Explore different biomes and interesting locations
Defeat a wide variety of enemies
Fight and defeat bosses to eradicate corruption
Become the hero of an exciting adventure
Atmospheric hand-drawn pixel art
And all this in your favorite retro spirit
And also other interesting features and many game mechanics are waiting for you, which we will gradually talk about in our communities a little later.

title: Minesweeper Together
description:
게임 정보
Minesweeper is back, but this time it's together! Minesweeper Together is a logical puzzle board game about revealing cells and avoiding mines cooperatively.
As you reveal cells, you will find numbers that indicate how many mines are surrounding those numbers.
Choose from 5 different difficulties:
Easy
Medium
Hard
Insane
Diabolical
The selected difficulty dictates board width, board height, and mine count.
Once you're in the game with up to 3 friends (4 total players), you can all interact with the board and work together to reveal cells and flag mines!
Come play Minesweeper, Together!

title: SIGILLUM
description:
게임 정보
SIGILLUM은 마르베야(Málaga) 도시의 역사와 문화에 기반을 둔 1인칭 서바이벌 호러 게임입니다.
 거리는 어둠에 잠식되었고, 질병은 퍼졌으며, 영혼들은 방황하고 있습니다. 당신은 이 새로운 위협의 갑작스러운 등장 뒤에 숨겨진 비밀들을 밝혀내고, 길에 나타날 적들을 처치하거나 피하며, 대체 경로를 찾아내고 퍼즐을 풀어 신성한 임무를 이어가야 하며, 결국 악몽을 끝내는 것이 목표입니다.
특징
클래식 서바이벌 호러 스타일
클래식한 게임 플레이와 아트 스타일이 세밀한 애니메이션과 결합되어, 플레이어에게 동적인 경험을 제공합니다.
도시의 충실한 재현
마르베야의 거리들을 탐험하세요. 신비롭고 불길한 배경을 가진 도시가 세심하게 묘사되어 있습니다.

title: Bow Course
description:
게임 정보
Nock your arrow and challenge your friends in archery golf!
Master realistic arrow physics and challenge your friends for a round in beautiful and challenging 9 target courses. Gain a competitive edge with skillful usage of different arrows, avoid obstacles and utilize shortcuts. The player with the least amount of shots wins!
Main Features
Play solo or challenge your friends in multiplayer
Realistic bow handling & arrow physics
Versatile courses - Each 9 target course offers several routes and shortcuts that players can tactically use with different arrows
Fun and challenging gameplay — Easy to pick up but offers depth to master
Practice at the shooting range in the main hub area
Customizable difficulty - choose starting point, wind conditions & more
Play comfortably with teleport, smooth locomotion and other settings

title: April '86
description:
게임 정보
구성:
Sergei는 어린 시절을 Pripyat시에서 보냈습니다. 그는 한때 아버지와 여동생 Varya와 함께 그곳에서 살았습니다. 1986년, 체르노빌 원자력 발전소 사고 직전, 도시에서 아이들이 사라지기 시작했습니다. 어느 날 Varya도 사라졌습니다. 자원봉사자들로 구성된 경찰과 수색팀도 흔적을 찾지 못했다.
1986년 4월 26일 - 체르노빌 원자력 발전소에서 사고가 발생했으며 실종 아동 문제에 아무도 관여하지 않았습니다. 세르게이의 아버지는 원자력 발전소 직원이었으며 방사선병으로 사망했습니다. 세르게이는 도시에서 대피하여 벨로루시에 있는 조부모와 함께 살았습니다. 10년 후, 세르게이는 죽은 도시를 배경으로 한 여동생의 사진이 담긴 이상한 봉투를 받습니다. 어떻게 이럴 수있어? 그녀는 정말 살아 있나요? 이러한 질문에 답하기 위해 우리의 영웅은 버려진 도시 프리피야트로 돌아가 1986년에 실종된 아이들에게 일어났던 끔찍한 사건을 하나씩 재구성해야 합니다.

title: CUBEN
description:
게임 정보
―Features―

Unique Puzzle Experience: Dive into an addictive and refreshing cube puzzle game!
Inventory Management: Strategically place items and build your unique setup!
Roguelite Elements: Experience new strategies and encounters with each run!



The game features a 4×4×4 grid of mini-cubes. Swipe in any of the six directions, and all mini-cubes move accordingly. When three or more same-colored cubes align in the direction of movement, they merge and burst, triggering an attack! Combine multiple bursts at once for even greater damage.



Sometimes, small companions called 'Sii' are born from the mini-cubes. These loyal allies automatically attack enemies but have short lifespans. Use items to extend their lifespans and maximize their effectiveness.


Strategically place items and 'Sii' to advance with your unique strategies.



On your journey, you may encounter the mysterious 'Pathway' Here, you will meet various characters. What is their connection to the 'CUBEN'...?

Get ready for an engaging puzzle adventure that combines strategy, excitement, and a bit of mystery!

title: Nivoz Running Canned
description:
게임 정보
The game is mission-completion third-person action.

>Combat is similar to TPS, but different.
Because you can't AIM!
Instead, you can simultaneously fire a shotgun that shoots in front of your character and an automatic tracking missile.
The behavior of the missiles can be controlled by the character's direction.

You can also use powerful special moves such as special shots by consuming EN, which increases when the missile hits the target!

>Nivoz, a fellow character
Nivoz is a mysterious canned robot that follows Juju(player) .
If Nivoz is nearby, it can launch Juju upward.
You can also switch control of Nivoz to let him do reconnaissance or set the attack coordinates for a special shot and launch it.

Use the features to your advantage and win the battle!

Juju" is an alien robot.
The day she met "Nivoz," a robot that looks like a canned food, a series of mishaps ensued.
The town where she lives is pierced by a huge building.
The unfamiliar robots began to run amok.
The two robots begin their journey in search of a safe place.

title: Space Diner Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Space Diner Simulator is a cozy diner management game where you will slowly grow your diner from a humble little place to a place with many workers.
Cook, clean, serve and unlock new recipes as you improve your diner with all kinds of different equipment.
Quality service is of the utmost importance in the hospitality service. Customers will complain if the food isn't on time or if it's not hot enough. So speed is greatly appreciated.
Cooking is a skill and as any skill over time it gets better. The more dishes you prepare, the better quality and price they will have. But don't be afraid to try all the different dishes.

title: Rules of War
description:
게임 정보
            
Test your strategic genius in this fast paced turn-based 4X game. In Rules of War you can:
- Develop your territory
- Command your army
- Expand your borders
- Acquire new technologies
- Spy on your enemies
- Engage in missile warfare

Do you have what it takes to lead your nation to VICTORY?

Disclaimer: The game is currently under development. Visuals and features may change depending on player feedback and comments. If you have a comment please reach out to us through our website or discord.
COMBAT
            
Deploy your infantry, mortar units, tanks, reconnaissance vehicles, and artillery to attack your enemies. Currently planned 10 land units.

The ultimate weapon. The ultimate deterrence.

title: Dino Girls
description:
게임 정보
개요:
Dino Girls에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 독특한 매력의 고생물학 세계로 빠져드는 매력적이고 중독성 있는 방치형 게임입니다. 귀여운 공룡 소녀들—공룡과 인간의 혼혈—을 수집하며 그들을 위한 맞춤형 리조트를 건설하고 관리하세요. 당신의 목표는 이 선사 시대의 귀여운 생물들이 번성할 수 있는 궁극의 낙원을 만드는 것입니다. 리조트를 업그레이드하면 새로운 리소스를 잠금 해제하고 게임을 진행할 수 있습니다.

게임플레이:
Dino Girls에서는 작고 기본적인 리조트와 한 명의 공룡 소녀로 시작합니다. 자원을 수집하고 리조트를 확장함에 따라 더 많은 공룡 소녀들을 끌어들이게 됩니다. 각각의 소녀는 고유한 성격, 능력 및 선사 시대 기원을 가지고 있습니다. 장식, 시설 및 업그레이드로 리조트를 맞춤 설정하여 공룡 소녀들을 행복하고 생산적으로 유지하세요. 그들이 행복할수록 더 많은 자원을 생성하여 게임을 진행하고 희귀한 공룡 소녀 및 강력한 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

주요 특징:
귀여운 공룡 소녀 수집:
사나운 티라노사우루스부터 온화한 아마르가사우루스까지 다양한 공룡 소녀를 발견하고 수집하세요. 각각 고유한 특성과 기술을 가지고 있습니다.

리조트 건설 및 맞춤 설정:
독특한 건물, 장식 및 시설로 리조트를 설계하고 확장하여 공룡 소녀들을 위한 완벽한 집을 만드세요. 리조트를 개선하여 새로운 리소스를 잠금 해제하고 게임을 진행하세요.

방치형 진행:
오프라인 상태에서도 공룡 소녀들은 계속해서 자원을 수집하고, 고생물학 연구, 화물 운송 및 실험실 과학 작업을 수행하므로 쉽게 돌아와 계속 진행할 수 있습니다.

리셋 및 배수 보너스:
게임 진행을 리셋하여 영구적인 배수 보너스를 얻고 더 먼 곳까지 나아가는 데 도움을 받으세요.

왜 이 게임을 좋아할까요:
Dino Girls는 방치형 게임의 편안한 재미와 수집 및 맞춤 설정의 흥미를 결합했습니다. 공룡 팬, 귀여운 캐릭터 애호가 또는 경영 게임 팬이든, Dino Girls는 독특하고 매력적인 경험을 제공하여 계속해서 돌아오게 할 것입니다. 모든 공룡 소녀를 수집하고 이 데스크톱 방치형 게임에서 꿈의 리조트를 건설하세요!

title: We Have To Let You Go
description:
게임 정보
We Have To Let You Go is a puzzle RPG game about getting fired (literally) by your totalitarian dictator boss and going on a journey to stop his new business prospects to take over the world.
Features

6 sprawling chapters with plenty of secrets to uncover.
Classic Dragon Quest inspired battles with puzzle elements.
Over 20 unique abilities that offer constant creativity in battle.
Challenging boss fights that require skill and strategy to overcome.
A vital dodge mechanic that adds a risk and reward factor to combat.
A large cast of delightful characters to meet on your journey.
A cute and colorful pixel art style.
Several collectables and optional side quests.
An ever-changing soundtrack that develops throughout the adventure.

We Have To Let You Go will release in 2025
autokwd: We Have To Let You Go

title: Thor's Wrath
description:
게임 정보
Thor's Wrath is a solo defense and combat game. You embody a formidable and somewhat brute warrior. Armed with Thor's mighty hammer, you must face hordes of enemies alone while protecting the city's treasures. The goal is to climb to the top of the best warrior rankings and prove yourself worthy of Thor's hammer! The real challenge lies in your ability to wield your hammer or cast spells with precision while safeguarding your treasures.

Thor's Wrath offers immediate entertainment, is a highly accessible game with different levels of complexity and features innovative game mechanics.
Warning :this Game Is Virtual Reality Only
Main Gameplay Elements

Environment & Level : closed environment represented by different places of a huge castle in a dark fantasy world and several levels of difficulties.

Game physics : ragdoll animation providing a lot of fun when you throw the enemies around the environment and destructible scenery.

Weapons: powerful hammer to hit, throw, activate attack spells

Enemies : thieves, Attackers and Defenders with each a different fighting behavior

Score : based on multiple skills (enemies killed, duration of the fight, scenery destroyed, accuracy of throws, …)
Other features

Unique gameplay featuring hammer manipulation like a boomerang.

Competition between players from around the world.

Possibility to improve your skills to create replayability.

Hyper casual game accessible to both casual and hardcore gamers.

Learning through experience : the player increases their score through their skills.

title: Onslaught: Rift
description:
게임 정보
Onslaught: Rift is an arcade hack and slash where you rapidly switch between three heroes to decimate waves of enemies! Learn to master each hero's set of abilities as you actively switch between them to efficiently destroy your foes.
Venture through a variety of dangerous areas, each with unique monsters and bosses to vanquish!
As your skill increases, accrue more medals by conquering harder difficulties and achieving higher scores!
Fight solo or take up arms with up to three other friends in local co-op!

title: Wizavior
description:
게임 정보
"Wizavior" is a 3D platformer that will pull you into a whirlwind of adventure! The game offers two modes: Arcade and Story Mode. Arcade Mode will test your skills by constantly increasing the difficulty level as you progress, providing an intense and rewarding challenge. Meanwhile, Story Mode lets you step into the shoes of the titular Wizavior—a retired wizard who, with humor and determination, sets out once again to save the world from evil. The story mode also features an incredible narrative enriched with fully animated cutscenes and a progression system that allows you to follow the unfolding events and fully immerse yourself in the epic tale.

title: Crab Attack
description:
게임 정보
Grab and Run
Get as many resources as you can by chaining enemy kills, smashing rocks, and discovering secrets. Once you've got as much as you dare, escape with your loot- just don't die before the timer elapses or you'll drop it all.

Explore
Every stage is packed with secret areas to discover, each one brimming with new resources, blueprints, and enemies. Smart use of your weapon's elemental effects and a sharp eye will be required to uncover them all.
Power Up
Build and equip dozens of different weapons and other upgrades with the resources you find. Taking on all of Crater City's challenges will require strategically picking the right tools for each job.

Using everything you've built up, defeat tough bosses for your ultimate reward: meteor shards. Collect enough to unlock new stages with even greater challenges.

title: Path of the Tank
description:
게임 정보


Path of the Tank is an action-RPG where you can only play as a tank. But why? Why a tank and nothing else? Find out in this linear, story-driven and easy to pick up game that may remind you of a different time.

Gameplay features:

-Modernized old-school fighting in real-time
-Simple yet deep skill tree, with 5 powerful late-game options to freely choose
-Hunger mechanic; scavenge for food to survive!
-Wide variety of enemies from different fronts
-Upgradeable armor, potions and weapons
-Tons of secret areas that may contain more than simple loot
-Basic experience earning system. Defeat enemies and complete missions to gain xp!
-Lots of conversations with differents characters, some with a philosophical questioning.
-Locations to travel like dark crystaline caves, villages, ruins, dungeons, and, mostly, lushful forests!
-Long boss fights (you're a tank, you won't do much damage!)



Story:

Something went terribly wrong. Nature is completely altered; earth itself is coming to life, animals are scared and the spirits are restless. The balance of existance itself, which is key for the stability of life has been altered beyond recognition. It's not the first time that this has happened, and it won't be the last. The price that the rational and even the non-rational beings are paying in this world is heavy. Will you be able to stop this disaster? Of course you can. Otherwise no story would be told. But you're here to discover a lot more than that. Remove the nightmares of the innocent beings in this land, tank. Travel the path. Eat the path.



There's a lot of places to discover while traveling the path. Perhaps you could dig out some information out of your past too...? But most importantly...



Can you challenge oblivion itself?

title: Synthetica: Cyber Club Manager
description:
게임 정보
Step into a neon-lit cyberpunk world as the manager of a club where lonely clients seek to fulfill their desires. Build android girls from scrap, match them to clients’ needs, and ensure every guest leaves satisfied. Earn money, research new technologies, and dive into your clients’ personal stories—help them solve their problems or make things worse. The choice is yours.
Manage every detail of your club: keep track of finances, restock supplies, assign tasks to your android workers, analyze clients’ needs and desires, and stay informed by monitoring news that shapes the world around you.

title: Paranatural
description:
게임 정보

온라인에서 다른 플레이어와 팀을 이루거나 혼자서 계약을 완료하며, 다양한 초자연 사냥 장비를 사용하여 유령을 식별하세요.
식별된 유령의 유형에 따라 독특한 퇴마 의식을 수행하세요.
주의: 퇴마에 실패하면 파괴적인 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다.
현재 16가지의 독특한 퇴마 의식이 있으며, 출시 후 더욱 많은 의식이 추가될 예정입니다.


Paranatural은 이전에 본 적 없는 독창적이고 동적인 유령 시스템을 사용합니다.
50가지 이상의 동적 반응 기반 유령 이벤트로 이루어진 전에 없던 무서운 경험이 언제나 가까이에 있습니다.
유령은 당신의 모든 움직임을 학습하고 적응하여, 자신의 능력과 환경을 활용합니다.
동적 유령 시스템은 모든 기본 게임 위치뿐만 아니라 커뮤니티가 만든 사용자 지정 위치에서도 자동으로 작동합니다!


유령 사냥의 여정 동안 유령 사냥에 특화된 애플리케이션이 장착된 특별한 전화기가 제공됩니다.
이 애플리케이션들은 영구적으로 전화기에 남아 있으며, 레벨 업할수록 게임 내 상점에서 구매할 수 있습니다.


Unreal Engine의 MetaHumans를 사용하여 완전한 기능을 갖춘 캐릭터 커스터마이저로 외모와 의상을 커스터마이즈할 수 있습니다.
또한 계약으로 벌어들인 돈을 사용하여 창고 내부를 커스터마이즈할 수 있습니다.

Nock your arrow and challenge your friends in archery golf!
Master realistic arrow physics and challenge your friends for a round in beautiful and challenging 9 target courses. Gain a competitive edge with skillful usage of different arrows, avoid obstacles and utilize shortcuts. The player with the least amount of shots wins!

Play solo or challenge your friends in multiplayer
Realistic bow handling & arrow physics
Versatile courses - Each 9 target course offers several routes and shortcuts that players can tactically use with different arrows
Fun and challenging gameplay — Easy to pick up but offers depth to master
Practice at the shooting range in the main hub area
Customizable difficulty - choose starting point, wind conditions & more
Play comfortably with teleport, smooth locomotion and other settings

The game is mission-completion third-person action.

>Combat is similar to TPS, but different.
Because you can't AIM!
Instead, you can simultaneously fire a shotgun that shoots in front of your character and an automatic tracking missile.
The behavior of the missiles can be controlled by the character's direction.

You can also use powerful special moves such as special shots by consuming EN, which increases when the missile hits the target!

title: Cursed Bloodline
description:
게임 정보
Cursed Bloodline
조사가 곧 지옥으로 변한다. 실종자들이 흔적을 남기고 사라진 집에 들어서면, 다음 차례는 바로 당신일지도 모른다.
장르: 심리 공포 / 내러티브 드라마
모드: 싱글 플레이, 스토리 중심
시점: 1인칭 시점
주요 특징: 강렬한 분위기, 모션 캡처 애니메이션, 실제 현장 녹음, 챕터 기반의 선형 진행
스토리
당신은 작은 마을의 형사로, 여러 난제를 해결해온 베테랑이다. 그러나 이번 사건은 다르다. 주인이 누구인지조차 모르는 기묘한 집에서 사람들이 계속 실종되고 있다. 그 집으로 발을 들여놓는 순간, 현실과 환각의 경계가 무너지고, 당신은 깨닫게 된다 — 조사하는 건 당신이 아니라, 집이 당신을 지켜보고 있다는 사실을.
게임 플레이
집 안 곳곳을 탐색하며, 모든 사물과 소리, 빛의 깜빡임이 새로운 단서를 드러낸다.
챕터별로 진행되는 선형 스토리, 시간이 지날수록 공포는 점점 강해진다.
실제 모션 캡처로 구현한 생생한 움직임과 표정.
스크립트와 랜덤 이벤트가 뒤섞여, 예측 불가한 공포 연출.
실제 장소에서 녹음한 사운드로 극강의 몰입감 제공.
차별화 포인트
실제 범죄 수사와 심리 공포를 결합한 독창적인 스토리.
인디 게임에서 보기 힘든 AAA급 모션 캡처 기술.
완전한 UI 없는 경험 — HUD도, 힌트도 없다. 오직 순수한 몰입감만.
각 챕터마다 서로 다른 공포 스타일을 적용해, 익숙해질 틈을 주지 않는다.
분위기
시작부터 끝까지 숨 막히는 긴장감.
너무 현실적이라 실제로 일어날 것 같은 공포.
미니멀한 비주얼로, 모든 디테일이 공포로 연결된다.
‘Visage’, ‘Outlast’, ‘Layers of Fear’를 즐겼다면, 이 게임은 당신의 다음 악몽이 될 것입니다.

title: 星象迷案 The Zodiac Mystery
description:
게임 정보
A case that has been cold for over 20 years is suddenly reopened after an astrology enthusiast returns from abroad and discovers a mysterious diary. Forgotten faces, past events, and lost loves resurface one by one... Amid stacks of intricate, perplexing files, travel through time and space, revisiting the past to uncover the concealed secrets of the case. How do the good and evil of human nature intertwine and clash within this mystery? Does the devil truly exist? Were the zodiac sacrifices a mere guise, or a carefully laid trap? Experience a puzzle full of unpredictable twists and endless challenges.
Unravel the mystery and separate truth from falsehood on this journey of discovery. Does the final answer lie in a purgatory of eternal damnation, or a fiery rebirth and redemption? With multiple endings that exceed all expectations, the story's conclusion is yours to uncover in this unique adventure, available on Steam!
✥ Gameplay: Mind-bending puzzles in an immersive world!
✥ Art Style: Delicate & vivid, with diverse & rich scenes
✥ Story: Full of twists & turns, offering a unique narrative journey
✥ Characters: Complex relationships & focus on human nature
✥ Mechanics: Cleverly designed gameplay to test observation
✥ Puzzles: Innovative multiple endings & fresh puzzle-solving experience
    From an eerie murder scene in a studio to a seaside villa steeped in danger; from police  station archives to the interrogation room, every location is shrouded in mystery, every clue clouded by ambiguity—some may lead you toward the light of truth, while others may drag you deeper into the abyss of uncertainty.The game opens with a mysterious astrological murder case. Though seemingly supernatural and esoteric, it is riddled with traps of human origin... Designed from the player's perspective, experience a thrilling and engaging journey as you unravel the mystery to discover clues. With each new clue, a new piece of the puzzle is revealed, and you inch closer to uncovering a long-buried truth. Every breakthrough brings you one step closer to the shocking secrets behind the Zodiac Murders.
autokwd: 星象迷案 The Zodiac Mystery

title: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe
description:
게임 정보
First-person interactive psychological horror narrative game. Immerse yourself in this one-of-a-kind horror where your real phone connects to the game! Travel into Cara’s memories searching for her missing sister. Uncover dark family secrets, exorcize demons, and solve puzzles in a world of witchcraft. Cara’s phone and yours will unlock unspeakable horrors!
Real-Phone Mechanics In this groundbreaking horror experience, you guide Cara using your real-life phone. As her phone connects to yours, you’ll uncover hidden clues, exorcise demons, and receive chilling warnings. Augmented reality reveals secrets unseen in the game alone. Help Cara solve puzzles, fend off dark threats, and discover terrifying family truths. The best part? While this unique connection enhances your experience, it’s not required, the game can still be fully enjoyed and completed without using your phone. Will you dive deeper into the nightmare?

title: Outsider
description:
게임 정보
Who is the Outsider?
Outsider is a science fiction narrative game with meaningful choices. You'll join my childhood friend Nando in his online encounters with a woman claiming to be an extraterrestrial. This game is a faithful recreation of their conversations based on the detailed records he left me before disappearing over a decade ago.
Outsider is a choice-rich game where you will play as Nando's "inner voice", helping him navigate the experience of meeting someone claiming to be from an advanced civilization.
The game's main play area is a fully-featured simulated chat interface. Your first job will be to help Nando figure out whether "Mara" is who she claims to be. How could an extraterrestrial prove their origin through a chat interface?
Outsider doesn't interrupt conversations with long and indistinguishable options. All choices are labeled with emojis that indicate the answer's tone and likely impact. Consequences flow naturally and won't unexpectedly lock you out of important content.
Some choices enable you to skip parts of the story and make progress while not missing anything important. You will use them to pace the game and focus on topics that interest you without affecting the game's endings. A plethora of reading options, such as multiple fonts (including a special Dyslexia-friendly font), adjustable text speed and fast-forward will help you explore all branches without getting bogged down by what you've already read.

title: Echoes of Exile

Echoes of Exile is a short horror game about exploring space caves. You fly to points of interest and delve into the caves with your drone and flashlight.
Send your drone out for recon

title: Palix Transit
description:

Palix Transit
A turn-based role-playing game in a unique, hand-crafted universe.
Immerse yourself in the mystical world of Hara, a planet inhabited by seven sacred races descended from seven gods. The journey of this world began over a decade ago, and now you can explore it in Palix Transit with a vibe reminiscent of 16-bit RPGs.
The story
In the small village of Loriko, the young Amoran Soken is preparing for the Palix Festival, an event that celebrates the Palix Transit - an astrological term associated with the third and final war of the gods. But just before the festival, Ajila, Soken's girlfriend, has a disturbing dream. When a strange object appears in the sky and two powerful beings threaten Loriko, her worst fears are realized. In the end, Soken will take up the fight against the overpowering opponents, but how will he face this impossible task?
You decide, in the open world you can freely explore parts of South Arluna. Discover secrets, level up and equip yourself, find allies, solve puzzles, face powerful creatures and more.

- Turn-based battles: classic JRPG gameplay
- Telekinesis mechanics: Use Soken's ability to solve puzzles and riddles.
- Comrades-in-arms Collect allies to help you on your journey.
- Diverse equipment: Equip your characters with weapons, headdresses, powerful masks and shields.
- Platformer elements: Jump and explore the world to discover hidden secrets.
- Secrets and Lore: Find secrets or delve into the world.
Find the villagers Loriko to gather them.
Venture towards Inedua, the castle that rose from nothing over twenty years ago, to take on its roaming creatures. But be careful, Inedua did not only attract large animals.
Important notice:
This game was developed by a single developer. Please do not expect AAA quality.
It is a unique, original universe with deep, diverse lore with handcrafted, lovingly created characters penned by the solo developer whose initial models and ideas date back over a decade.

title: Scavengers of Mars

Your Mars Rover is your best friend on the hostile Red Planet. It is both your mobile exploration platform and a mobile inventory. Use your rover capacity to retrieve found resources and gear, then get it safely back to the nearest Outpost to use it for your future improvements or as an occasion to earn some spare funds.

As you'll progress, you'll get access to new gear types, with improved modifiers for the Rover's performance and the opportunity to perform new interaction types, from simple surface mining, performing repairs and performing scans of the nearest environment to getting access to map-wide probe mechanics, ability to pinpoint areas of particular resource richness or the ability to drill into the planet's ground.
Game Features:
Martian Mysteries: Explore the Martian Surface just after a catastrophic disaster happened on the planet's orbit. Help the castaways with their survival as the Earth corporations compete against each other on who will be the one to get the deal and organise the succesful rescue mission. Try to discover the details on what was the reason behind the disaster in order to ensure the safety of the future missions.
Control the Rover: Take control of a small, exploration oriented mobile platform. Collect, repair and craft new module types in order to improve and modify your capabilities. Maintain the energy and resource intake and outtake levels on the Rover's deck. Invest in better Rovers to get access to bigger inventory and module slots.

title: Nanika Game Online
description:
게임 정보
Q: What kind of game is this?
A: It's an online falling-block puzzle game where you drop and merge objects called “Nanika,” each with its own unique skill. The game features real-time matches and cooperative play.
Q: What are the rules?
A: You win by reducing your opponent’s HP to zero, causing their Nanika to exceed its stack limit, or by having more HP than your opponent when the match ends.
Q: What is “Nanika”?
A: “Nanika” refers to the objects you drop and merge within the game. There are 66 types in total, and when you combine identical Nanika, they evolve to the next level and become more powerful. Each type has its own skill, so creating different combinations can greatly expand your strategic options.
Q: What ways are there to play?
A: There are three main modes:
Unranked Mode – Play casually without affecting your rank.
Ranked Mode – Your rank changes with wins and losses.
Mirror Mode – Use the same deck as your opponent for a pure test of skill.
Custom Mode – Compete with friends in your own custom matches.
You can also participate in 1v1 or 2v2 online matches.
Q: How is the class determined?
A: As you earn points in the game, you level up. Upon reaching Level 1, you’re assigned a role, and every time you level up, you gain a new skill.
Q: Who is it recommended for?
A: Beginners can steadily practice and get used to the game in Unranked Mode, while advanced players can enjoy challenging themselves in Ranked Mode. If you like team battles, 2v2 matches allow you to cooperate with friends, making the game fun for a wide range of players.
Q: What’s the biggest appeal?
A: It combines the simple mechanics of a falling-block puzzle with the rich strategic depth of 66 different types of Nanika. Because it’s played in real time, split-second decisions and proper use of skills can determine the outcome of a match. Additionally, building your own deck and choosing your role lets you showcase your unique playstyle, which is a major part of the game’s charm.

title: Remorses
description:
게임 정보
STORY

Remorses is a slowly building, heart-aching journey, with tension that builds gradually, focused on an immersive atmospheric experience.

The year is 1991 in Rivervalley, Lakota Territory. It is infamous for its history and missing people recently. Not long ago, rumors of witchcraft began to spread. Rivervalley has long history of false legends before.

Play as Jake Lepistow, an investigator from Beaver Hills, Minnesota. Chasing legends and supernatural occurrences without ever having to face consequences. When a series of strange disappearances and hints of witchcraft reached him, he got his eyes on his next investigation. A made up story of an abandoned Westbrook’s Inheritance Mansion somewhere in the Rivervalley forest. The townspeople avoid it, terrified of its reputation and the rumors of a vengeful witch.

 The most normal thing, the air that you breathe, becomes your lifeline, open windows to get fresh air, ignoring this normal aspect has serious consequences when a disturbing force messes with your mind. Manage your resources, and use every source of light to your advantage. Search for ingredients to create a potion against the possible lurking evil. Use wolves to your advantage by pitting them against each other

FIGHT AND SURVIVE
Slay everything in your way to becoming the strongest war chief the island has ever known. There are various melee options available as well as using a bows or magical staffs with unique abilities.

Short levels with high replayability, reminiscent of speedrun shooters.

Explore culturally rich environments from historic India, traversing through forts and regions influenced by various sultanates, as well as British and Dutch colonies. Immerse yourself in the historical and vibrant settings that shape this epic adventure.

title: Dataminers

Infiltrate highly secured data centres and grab as much data as you can. Plan your moves and outsmart guards, cameras and drones. Every turn counts: the Security Net is already rising. Valuable equipment is hidden in protected terminals. Steal it and use it for your mission or sell it on the black market.

Upgrade your Dataminer with augments, expand his skills and develop your own strategy. Hire miners with special abilities and use their strengths for future missions. Reach the legendary Everything Centre and hack the holy grail of every Dataminer.

Roguelike campaign. Will you reach the Everything Centre?

title: Saci: The Cursed Hunt
description:
게임 정보
In the heart of the Amazon jungle, myths become deadly reality. You wake up alone, and the only way to survive the night is to capture the elusive Saci by finding five objects scattered across the dense, ever-changing forest. Saci is always hunting you, using tricks to alter the environment and lead you astray. Known for his mischievous nature in Brazilian folklore, Saci warps reality, setting traps and illusions to confuse you. With danger at every turn, can you outwit the jungle's trickster spirit before it’s too late?
Survive the night or become another victim of the jungle’s deadly legend.
Key Features:
Dynamic Environment: Explore the Amazon Jungle with realistic weather and wildlife.
Saci’s Tricks: Face visual pranks and shifting landscapes designed to confuse you.
Stealth and Survival: Avoid wildlife predators while gathering the objects.
Exploration: Discover hidden caves, ancient ruins, and unravel the jungle’s secrets.
Who is Saci?
The game draws from Brazilian folklore, where Saci-Pererê is not only a mischievous trickster but also one of the guardians of the Amazon forest. Known for his one-legged figure, magical red cap, and pipe, Saci controls whirlwinds and alters the jungle to confuse travellers. In this version, Saci’s dark past as a former enslaved child who lost his leg adds a tragic edge to his pranks. He warps the environment with illusions and traps to stop you from capturing him.

You will play as a group of three heroes and fight hordes of monsters in a dynamic hybrid turn-based combat system, where heroes move in turn-based mode, and monsters move simultaneously, which allows you to overcome hordes of monsters in fast-paced, dynamic and spectacular battles!

타락한 신부터 신화 속 생물체까지, 가차 없는 적들과 맞서세요. 전투 기술을 익히고 신성한 힘을 발휘하여 타락한 자를 정화하고 상황을 유리하게 바꾸세요. 무리는 만날 때마다 더욱 강해지므로 도전할 때마다 적응해야 합니다.

Scour each silly scene for clues that point to identities, motives, and misadventures. Then use your deductive skills to fill-in-the-blanks and put your conclusions to the test!

As a nameless protagonist, your journey is driven by the chilling need to uncover the secrets buried deep within "the house." Search for hidden paths, solve cryptic mysteries, and confront the horrors that await. But beware: Not all doors should be opened, and not all who dwell here wish you well.
