Enter an epic head-to-head tournament with worldwide reach, where music is your weapon and fame is your destiny! Face off against all sorts, from established K-pop idol groups and rock-gods to the local cult choir and that one guy who keeps insisting that the keytar will make a comeback.
 Turn-Based Strategic Combat for Dummies
Use your skill and wits to outperform your enemies - chain together attacks, buffs, and bend the soundscape to your will by planning multiple rounds in advance and having it all play out exactly as you wish in a flood of eardrum shattering beats and pyrotechnics mayhem that would definitely violate workplace health and safety standards.
Forget those boring old heath bars – they’re so 2010s – control the momentum and dominate the stage through the “state-of-the-art” and totally original Tug-of-War combat system; Drown out the tunes from those lame-wads across the stage from you and get them booed off stage to advance to the next stage of the tournament.  
 A World of Musical Misfits
Every Paul needs his Ringo, every Bob their Marley – Ash can’t win it all by himself, he’ll need a band! Build your flock as you navigate through a city full of musicians who all think they’re way cooler than they actually are. Each new member brings their own deck of tricks to the table, expanding your options on the battle stage.
Talk to people around the stadium to learn about the world, themselves, and even hints to finding collectibles! Choose dialogue options that present you as the next coming of the King of Rock or embrace your inner chaos goblin – whichever speaks to your heart more! There are no wrong answers, so feel free to flip flop around Ash’s personality so much that his band mates start to consider calling a doctor.
 Orchestrate Your Strategy

title: The Hundredth Hike
description:
게임 정보
The Hundredth Hike
The Hundredth Hike is an Indie Psychological Horror game, living the story of you, as a mountain hiker, reliving your tragic past and finding the calm of the nature under your boots. Unaware of what lies before you, you unleash a powerful and mysterious truth.
Rich Story
The Hundredth Hike is a story rich in lore, that is set in the middle of a devastating apocalypse. Napazarim has taken over the minds of 90% of the population causing hallucinations in the infected people in which became an international pandemic. You are one of the lucky few who survived and after losing your family, over the years you went on hikes all over the world to escape real life. This is YOUR Hundredth Hike how will it be different?
Losing your Mind
Along your Hundredth Hike you question your reality on this enormous hike along a mountain that has been restricted for over a decade. Sneaking into a quarantined country, you delve deep into your own mind and lose touch of reality. Will you bring yourself back from the fold?
Mechanics
Run, Hide and solve deep puzzles to escape your faith. With inventory management for your light sources and many interactive objects you will always feel on edge. With barely any HUD and following the protagonists story you will always be immersed in The Hundredth Hike. There are many mechanics of the game I don't want to give away as more and more mechanics are introduced over the course of the game.
Graphics
With the power of UE5, I have been able as a solo developer to get realistic and eye watering graphics with each chapter giving a different feel. From the amazing weather effects to the fully manually placed assets across all of the chapters, you will get an experience which is hard to forget.

title: Find This Pixel Anomaly
description:
게임 정보
In Find This Pixel Anomaly your task involves monitoring real-time surveillance camera feeds. Identify any irregularities within the monitored areas. These anomalies can vary from missing furniture to cute visitors.
Found an anomaly? File a report and hope it will get fixed in time. Otherwise you will get in trouble, because too many anomalies will end the game.
Activate Night Vision to reveal only the most elusive anomalies lurking in the shadows. But don’t get too comfortable — this mode limits what you can see, making every mistake potentially fatal. Focus on the hidden details and spot the threats before they end your game.
EXTRA OBJECT
Wait, was this chair here before? Who put it there? Well, it doesn't matter because you should hurry up and file a report. These added items can blend in surprisingly well, so stay sharp.

title: Fishing  Numbers
description:
게임 정보
Fishing for Numbers is a vibrant, first-person educational adventure where you step into the shoes of an aspiring wizard on a quest to join the prestigious Arcane Anglers Guild. Master increasingly harder equations and catch magical fish to prove your worth and earn your place among the elite!
A unique way to learn math
Open portals to extraordinary math dimensions and unleash your fishing spells to summon magical fish. Harvest their essence to fuel your journey, upgrading your spells and empowering rune stones as you master the art of arcane mathematics!
Multiple game modes
Pick a game mode that fits the way you want to play. Classic Mode offers a preset challenge designed by the development team. Custom Mode lets you adjust the difficulty and rules to your liking.

title: Simulo
description:
게임 정보
Simulo is a 2D physics sandbox game where you can do Anything*. Users can use a variety of in-game tools to build Whatever they could possibly imagine, from simple contraptions like cars to complex machinery. Or, you can just use it to mess around with ragdolls.
     *not anything but Almost
What can I Do with Simulo game?
Once you open Simulo revolutionary 2D physics sandbox, you will find some of the things you can do include:
Build machinery and contraptions like cars, pistons, elevators
Mess around with 2D ragdolls, such as humanoids or the Simulo Mascot thing (simulon!!)
Play around with things made by the community, such as scenes, objects, or even custom tools they made
Now you see that Simulo can do Anything (almost). Truly, this game is a true delight indeed.
Here is a thing made entirely with Simulo:

title: StarSim: BattleZone
description:
게임 정보
StarSim: BattleZone는 StarSim 우주를 배경으로 한 실시간 전략(RTS) 게임입니다.
게임 플레이는 기지 건설, 자원 수집, 새로운 기술 연구, 방어 건설, 유닛 훈련 등과 같은 클래식 RTS 메커니즘을 포함합니다.
여러분은 Home Ascolate의 부대를 지휘하여 자원이 풍부한 무인 행성의 통제권을 장악하게 됩니다.
캠페인에는 Home Ascolate와 다른 세력 간의 갈등을 보여주는 스토리 중심의 임무가 포함되어 있습니다.

title: Type Rider
description:
게임 정보
"Type Rider" is a typing-based tower defense game where you summon units by typing.
The protagonist, once known as the "Type Rider" for her high-speed typing skills while riding a motorcycle, has been tasked with resolving issues in a world overrun by ink lifeforms. She decides to ride her beloved bike once again.
Build Your Unique Deck: Construct your own deck with over 50 unique ink monsters, each possessing various elements such as attributes, classes, and special skills.
Typing Summons: A system where you summon ink monsters by successfully typing. Counter the approaching ink lifeforms by summoning your own creatures.
Strategic Battles: Use the order of summoning and spell cards strategically to gain an advantage in battle.

title: PARAVOID
description:
게임 정보
Paravoid
Survival horror game set on a twisted space station where reality itself turns against you. Navigate warped, ever-changing corridors, face shapeshifting creatures disguised as friends, and manage your mental and physical health to survive the station's sinister secrets.
Features
Shapeshifting Enemies: Mimic creatures disguise themselves as objects or people, keeping you in constant fear and doubt.
Non-Euclidean Exploration: Navigate environments that warp and shift, forcing you to adapt as the station itself changes around you.
Psychological Impact of Death: Each death adds lasting mental strain, leading to hallucinations, distorted gameplay, and increased difficulty.
Stress and Injury Management: Physical wounds limit your abilities, while high stress levels distort your perception of the world.
Resource Management: With limited inventory and scarce supplies, every decision could mean life or death.

title: The Last Worlds : Crossed Souls
description:
게임 정보
- Welcome to the Planet NESS-444 -
The Planet NESS-444 is a vast world full of Adventure,
enemies to face or to have as allies in battle,
valuable resources to gather, mysteries and secrets to unveil.
Climb the world's highest peaks to discover breathtaking views or
wander into the depths of the planet to reveal ruins of ancient lost civilizations.
Unique biomes scattered across the land waiting for you to explore them,
until you are able to discover the truth...

- Nessky -

title: The Immortal Scripture
description:
게임 정보
About the Game
An ancient emperor accidentally obtained 《The Immortal Scripture》 and embarked on a journey of battles to unlock its secrets, heading towards the path of immortality...
Unique Gameplay
In 《The Immortal Scripture》 players can freely choose which side to battle. What if you choose the left side and lose to the AI-controlled right side? Then just switch to the right side and fight against the AI-controlled left side.
Ridiculously Strong AI
The AI in 《The Immortal Scripture》 uses the latest reinforcement learning algorithms. After long periods of training and fine-tuning, it ensures that every level is a challenge that even the author can easily lose to. The goal is to provide players with a refreshing and engaging gaming experience.
Beyond Balance
Each level in《The Immortal Scripture》 has undergone repeated calculations to ensure the overall strength is evenly matched on both sides. Additionally, it ensures that each character's card abilities are neither overly strong nor overly weak.
The Author is a Good Person
To help players clear the game, at the very beginning, the author offers a sacrifice feature. By sacrificing your subjects, you can directly alter the stats of the characters on the board, making it easier to clear the level. Hopefully, this will help you progress!

title: Null Transit
description:
게임 정보
Adrift in the endless void, the captain and crew cling to survival aboard a failing spaceship. Their only hope? Recover a crucial Astronavigator Core before the ship succumbs to the darkness.
FIVE CREW MEMBERS (and a clone). ONE MISSION.
Meet the crew: Captain, Commander, Recon, Engineer, Disciple. Each crew member brings unique strengths, but all are fragile in the face of death.
To avoid unnecessary losses, the captain can send humanoid clones instead—expendable, but at a cost. Every clone drains Ionite, the rare energy source keeping the ship operational. Run out, and the crew will have no choice but to risk their own lives.
How far will you go to keep your crew alive?
A HIGH-STAKES ACTION PLATFORMER
Choices Matter. Losing a crew member is permanent. Every decision counts.
Master Fluid Movement. Simple controls—jump, dash, and channel energy—that evolve into intricate, parkour-like maneuvers as you improve.
Unique Dash-Attack Combat. There is no attack button. Dash through energy to recharge movement and power up your weapons. Every fight is a test of momentum and precision.
Distinct Combat Styles. Each crew member wields two unique weapons, shaping how they fight.
The Captain strikes from afar with tactical orbital bombardments.
The Commander dominates close-quarters combat with brute force.

title: Definitely Not Addictive
description:
게임 정보
Do you trust the cards? You shouldn't. In Definitely Not Addictive, you'll scheme, shuffle, and struggle through a darkly comedic world. Manipulate your luck with powerful items, craft devious strategies, and face off against colorful characters who don't always have your best interests at heart.
Jack Misery - your enemy (or best friend?)
Challenge Jack Misery's twisted deals, dodge The Travelling Salesman's insults, and decode The Old Woman's cryptic guidance—your salvation or undoing hangs in the balance.
This is not just a game about drawing cards. It’s about the decisions you make, the consequences you face, and the lengths you’ll go to for one more chance at winning Jack in one of his mini-games.
What You Can Do:
Forge powerful deck combinations in this grim satirical roguelike
Exploit cigarettes, charms, and drinks to bend luck in your favor
Unravel a twisted narrative where your choices echo through each run
Master an atmosphere that evolves with your growing addiction

title: Echoes of Nara
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of Nara tells the story of a Dreamknight, Nara, as he journeys through a mysterious and captivating dream world. His goal is to free the inhabitants of this realm from their worst nightmares, facing the deep fears and nightmares that dwell within.
Explore diverse worlds, each with unique mechanics and visual styles. Discover the challenges that await Nara in the dreams and nightmares of the inhabitants of Sognaris.
Each world will be completely different, allowing you to switch between dimensions or use special abilities tailored to each environment to overcome or escape nightmares as you uncover the secrets the world of Sognaris holds.

title: How West Clement Was Kinda Won
description:
게임 정보
A drifter finds themselves in a town that is knee deep in a dire situation. The town is going to be taken over by a big ol' company! And you just so happened to arrive right on time to help out these citizens in need!
Play through 4 chapters of that shows the best of Clement County!
Turn-based combat with up to 3 other NPC companions that you love so very much!
Also those companions I was talking about? There's more than 20 of them you could unlock!
Multiple areas in one of the dumbest parts of the world!
Build your character by leveling up, eating pizza, drinking soda and frickin' fighting!
Fight enemies like feral zombies, construction workers, crocodile dudes and other bad things!
Amazing special attacks like Vomit, Super Kick, Skull Crack and MP3 Player!
Everything, art and code, hand-made with love!!!
autokwd: How West Clement Was Kinda Won

title: Superstellar
description:
게임 정보
Superstellar offers a fresh take on the survivor genre with its advanced stat synergies, extensive build diversity and crucial player choice. Roam endless space and engage in frantic combat with responsive, racing-like movement. Complete missions and milestones to unlock new spaceships, each equipped with new weapons and exclusive upgrade choices. Choose your upgrades wisely and fight to stay alive as long as possible against hordes of pesky enemies! Runs typically last about 20 minutes, but skilled players might endure a bit longer.

How long can you survive?
⚔️ Gameplay & Combat
Endless battles – Survive as long as possible in a randomly generated space environment.
Massive enemy waves – Face over 500 enemies at once!
Three enemy territories – Each with unique enemies, events and challenges.
Dynamic events - Adapt to hazards like solar flares, asteroid belts, darkness, and radiation!
All out war – A randomized brutal mode that combines all enemy territories into one.
🚀 Ships & Classes
🌀 Orion – Energy and electricity-based, specializing in electrocution.
🔥 Phoenix – Fire-based, focused on igniting and burning enemies.
❄️ Titan – Ice and summoner-based, capable of chilling, freezing, and shattering foes.
Each ship boasts a game-changing ultimate ability aswell, and comes in light, medium, and heavy armored variants with different stats and ability enhancements.

title: Gatestodian
description:
게임 정보
Defend the Gates from a demonic invasion and become a hero!
Your mission is to protect the Gates that hold back endless hordes of demons, eager to break through and destroy the peaceful inhabitants of the kingdom. In this epic battle, you will be guided by a wise mentor — an old warrior whose advice will lead you to victory against overwhelming forces.
Choose one of four unique heroes, each with their own style of combat and abilities. Upgrade and enhance your chosen hero's skills to adapt to the ever-growing threats and discover new strategies to combat the terrifying forces of evil.
Key Features:
Four Unique Heroes: Each hero has their own playstyle and skill set. Choose the one that best suits your strategy and master their abilities.
Advice from a Wise Mentor: A seasoned veteran will offer you valuable guidance that may turn the tide of battle… but should you always follow his advice?
Upgrade System: Develop your hero, improve their abilities, and create your own unique build to face the most dangerous enemies.
Epic Battles Against Demons: Prepare for intense battles where every decision, skill, and upgrade can change the course of the fight.
Are you ready to stop the demons and save the kingdom? The fate of the world is in your hands!

title: Curry Princess GOLD
description:
게임 정보
A casual game where you collect falling spices, earn gold, and cook delicious curry.
Enjoy three different game modes:
Classic Mode: An endless score-attack challenge, a remastered version of Curry Princess originally released for iOS/Android in 2018, now reimagined for console with enhanced gameplay.
Story Mode: Unfold an engaging story as you progress through episodes.
2P Mode: Play local two-player content. Compete against each other for victory, or work together to overcome the Curry Master's trials—it's up to you!
These three modes offer a variety of ways to play!

title: Void Protocol
description:
게임 정보
Void Protocol is an immersive first-person exploration game that makes you explore not the past, but the future! As the protagonist, you will stop all the experiments that are turning people into robots and save the world, but they are not only turning people into robots...

title: Dusty Dunes Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
Jump into the world of Dusty Dunes Tycoon!
A VR Dropper-Style Gemstone Tycoon game where you unlock and upgrade different droppers to maximize gem productivity and unlock different locations you can explore. The player is stationed within a Minecart equipped with a UI that allows interaction with and travel across the world that surrounds you. You're able to boost dropper production by upgrading different dropper components, aiding by manually clicking with the dropper, or by using esoteric scrolls you find to buff certain droppers or by applying other effects.

title: Planeturem
description:
게임 정보
Explore a procedurally generated planet filled with resources to harvest - with a variety of biomes and creatures to discover. Encounter structures containing potentially rare items, from materials to craft new items, to a brand new piece of armour, or maybe even something to lure evil towards you?
Build your base to protect yourself and fight off calamitous beasts - if successful, you may have the ingredients to construct a new weapon!

title: Curation
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of museum management! Build, customise, and expand your dream museum into a place of science and history, wonder and mystery in this award-winning casual building/management sim!
As the architect, designer, and curator, it’s your job to transform an empty plot of land into a cultural landmark. Create an unforgettable experience for your NPC visitors by selecting, buying, and placing artefacts throughout your new museum. If they have a great time, they might even donate a little cash before heading out!
Build, expand, customise
Design your museum from the ground up! Drag out walls and create uniquely shaped rooms to give your museum a one-of-a-kind layout. A range of customisation options means you can expand and modify your building, tailoring each room for the ultimate visitor experience.
Collect & Display Unique Artefacts

title: Bearstone Campsite
description:
게임 정보
Bearstone Campsite is a first-person horror game that follows the journey of our character who goes missing during a camping trip.
Maria, Paul, and Nathan should have never gone without you. It’s absurd they thought they could manage without the only sensible person in the group. But could they, really? Your friends are out there, desperate, waiting for you to come back.
Now, witness their story. You left them to this fate.
You’ve always been cautious... or maybe just a coward. But this time, what are you going to do?

title: Emberhold
description:
게임 정보
Explore and defend a fantasy kingdom in the skies!
Emberhold is a bastion of hope for the people of Astria, one that has long been in slumber. With your help, the fires of the guilds and trade will awaken anew to battle the tides of evil lurking at it's borders! Work together with allies to reclaim lost territory and quell the warring factions. Rebuild your bastion to defend against the nightmares that lie beyond the fog and below the mists.
Experiment with varying playstyles
Outfit your party the way you want! Your characters can fight with a sword and shield, wield magic, or use a gun; your party composition is yours to decide how best to take on the challenges that await.
Collect, repair, craft, and expand
Gather resources and find unique items on your adventures to restore the Emberhold to it's former glory! Craft equipment at the forge to outfit your party before you set out so that you're ready to face even the strongest foes.
Face off against challenging enemies
Use strategy and skill to take down enemies in a variety of encounters. Even the simplest of foes can pose a threat in large numbers. Take your party and challenge powerful bosses in uniquely phased fights.

title: Sky Fields
description:
게임 정보
Sky Fields에 오신 것을 환영합니다
드론이 되어 Sky Fields를 탐험하고, 떠 있는 다양한 섬을 여행하며 슬라임 컬렉션을 확장하세요. 다양한 슬라임 속이 가득한 독특한 환경을 탐험하면서 싸우고, 자원과 원시 슬라임을 수집하여 새로운 슬라임을 부화시키고 키우세요. 각 슬라임은 고유한 외모, 강점, 희귀성을 지니고 있습니다!
각 섬의 고도는 만날 수 있는 슬라임을 결정하고, 환경 자체를 변화시켜 나무, 식물, 동물군을 형성합니다. 이는 모든 전투에 전략적 깊이를 더하며, 각 발견을 흥미롭고 예측할 수 없는 경험으로 만듭니다.
특징:
탐험
Sky Fields의 세계로 날아가 다양한 섬과 생태계를 넘나들며 탐험하세요. 그러나 조심하세요 — 폭군 군대가 황량한 땅에 숨어 있습니다! 그들에게 맞설 수 있나요? 강화된 성소를 탐험하고, 위험한 섬을 정복하며, 여행 중에 귀중한 자원을 모으세요.
전투 및 레벨업
턴제 전투에서 전략적으로 공격 순서를 정하세요. 다양한 팀 조합을 시도하고 슬라임 간의 시너지를 활용하세요. 근접 전투 유닛 뒤에 지원 유닛과 마법사를 배치하여 이상적인 배치를 만드세요. 강력한 적을 만나고, 레벨업하여 팀을 강화하세요.
나만의 슬라임 만들기!

title: Consortium's Fall: Echoes of Xo'lara
description:
게임 정보
Consortium’s Fall is a sci-fi roguelite twin-stick shooter about a lone hero’s fight against his people’s oppressor. Infiltrate the three bases of the Stellar Consortium, fight the grunts and bosses that guard them, growing stronger with upgrades and weapons you pick up along the way - all while uncovering knowledge and secrets of long gone past. With every new run, you will master the very elements the enemy seeks to exploit. Bring about the Consortium’s fall, no matter what it takes.

You are Zyx, a Cilian scholar compelled to infiltrate the tyrannical Stellar Consortium in the name of his people and home planet, Zolareus. Zolareus is home to an abundance of Eternum, a powerful component the Consortium uses in their relentless pursuit of galactic dominance. If nothing is done, the Stellar Consortium will suck Zolareus dry and secure your people as one of their pawns.

Will you persevere and fight back, before it’s too late? On your journey throughout the enemy’s territory, you will encounter mysterious pillars with messages from ancient times. Decode their scripture to gain better understanding, and uncover knowledge that will help you in your rebellion!

title: Hallway Shot
description:
게임 정보
Halls that loop forever. You are given tools to break out of the loop but can you truly escape? Hallway shot is what happens when you condense a survival horror game into an extremely long hallway.
Five Halls are randomized with a new hall only replacing an old one when a solution is found. Search through furniture for useful items. Halls will be full of random puzzles, enemies, friends, and a variety of other things. In Hallway Shot you find items, solve puzzles, and escape monsters to solve every hall and eventually leave the hallway. Even if you can't figure out a hall's puzzle, there are numerous alternative solutions that let you remove it from the loop and try to solve it again later.

title: PhiloDeka
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by traditional poker, PhiloDeka is an engaging Roguelite card game that’s easy to learn yet deep in strategy and diverse in play.
Create Winning Combos
Combine cards into multiples of ten to maximize rewards — creativity knows no bounds.
Harness Rune Effects
Master unique rune effects to shape your tactics and reap powerful rewards.
(Start with the first rune and unlock others as you progress.)

title: Decomposition
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Decomposition is a psychological horror game focused on survival, where every choice can mean life or death. You control Lucy, a young woman who, after a traumatic event, finds herself on the run from the Dawnbringers, a shadowy cult willing to do anything to fulfill their apocalyptic prophecy.
Encounter oppressive environments such as the Dandelion Mansion and an abandoned Amusement Park, solving puzzles, traversing mazes and facing masked enemies. With limited resources such as axes, pistols and flashlights, you must carefully manage your tools as you brave the unknown and search for answers.
Key Features:
Intense Exploration: Immerse yourself in dark and detailed environments full of secrets and traps.
Challenging Survival: Manage ammunition and supplies while facing constant dangers.
Immersive Storytelling: Discover the truth behind the cult and Lucy's connection to the apocalyptic events.
Intriguing puzzles: Solve puzzles that require logic and attention to detail.
Claustrophobic atmosphere: Feel the tension of every step in cramped and oppressive environments.
Prepare to fight for survival and uncover dark secrets before the Dawn Gate opens. The fate of Lucy, her father, and the world depends on you.

title: Star Watch
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview
Star Watch is a casual game combining elements of "light-action shooting" and "creature care and management." Players take on the role of the Star Watch commander, leading a squad of unique monsters to fight against the evil alien invaders—the Cows, and reclaim the occupied planets and their precious relics!
Game Features
20 Unique Monsters: Each monster has distinct abilities and appearances, allowing players to freely form their own custom squads.
6 Major Planet Levels: Explore planets with unique environmental challenges, each featuring a powerful BOSS with special abilities.
Easy-to-Learn Controls: All actions are performed by simple clicks, making the game accessible to players of all ages.
Diverse Strategy Choices: Combine turret controls with carefully selected monster abilities to fend off enemies, adapting strategies to different planetary environments.
Planet Relic Collection: Defeat the final BOSS on each planet to reclaim valuable relics, enhancing your monster squad for future battles.
Gameplay
Players will need to raise monsters and manage resources to expand their influence across the galaxy. When enemies attack, players must skillfully operate turrets and unleash special monster abilities to fend off the invading Cows while protecting their squad. After each level, players can earn rewards to upgrade their monsters and technologies, further strengthening their forces for tougher challenges ahead.
company: 鈴夢有限公司, 赤腳蛙工作室

title: BACKROOMS INSIDE THE ESCAPE
description:
게임 정보
Venture through a labyrinth of seemingly endless, creepily familiar corridors based on popular Creepypasta lore. Experience the terror with high-quality graphics that bring the eerie environment to life, and envelop yourself in a soundscape of detailed 3D audio that enhances every haunting whisper and distant footstep. The atmosphere is thick with dread, filled with puzzles that challenge the mind and screamers that test your resolve, ensuring a pulse-pounding journey into the unknown.
High-Quality Graphics – Immerse yourself in an environment where every detail is crafted to enhance the horror.
Detailed 3D Audio – Every sound is designed to amplify the suspense and immerse you deeper into the game.
Creepy Atmosphere – The constant, oppressive dread is carefully maintained to keep you on edge.
Challenging Puzzles – Test your wits with intricate puzzles that integrate seamlessly into the narrative.
Effective Screamers – Prepare for heart-stopping moments that are sure to keep the adrenaline pumping.

title: RedSoul 红色之魂
description:
게임 정보
Red Soul is a high-difficulty action RPG focused on precise combat and hardcore challenges. With weapon switching and firearm counterattack mechanics, you'll face powerful enemies and experience life-or-death battles.
Key Features:
Weapon Switching: Choose between a swift sword or a heavy greatsword based on enemy status. The sword is quick for fast strikes, while the greatsword delivers devastating damage.
Firearm Counterattack: Use precise timing to counter enemy attacks with your firearm, shifting the tide of battle.
Hardcore Combat: Every fight requires precise control; enemies and bosses have varied attack patterns that demand quick adaptation.
Intense Levels: Levels filled with traps and ambushes offer extreme challenges.
In Red Soul, failure is an opportunity for growth, and victory belongs to true warriors. Are you ready to face the challenge?

title: What the Hell I Draw
description:
게임 정보
Draw according to the instructions
Admire your creations
Try to guess as early as possible

title: Adventures of Carson: Fractured Continuum
description:
게임 정보
Step into a shattered solar system in Adventures Of Carson: Fractured Continuum, a 2D rogue-lite action-platformer. Take advantage of an expansive array of weapons and abilities as you fight through constantly changing planets devastated by space and time in the Infractus Tempestas system. Die and face the most dangerous enemy, yourself.
An Ever-changing array of planets with a new adventure awaiting each time you play.
The Infractus Tempestas system is an ever changing solar system where each playthrough begets a new adventure. Each time you fall to an enemy a new 2D world awaits you. But, beware the haunting visage of your fallen self awaits you where you perished.
Caught In a Time-loop, Carson cannot die.
The Adventures of Carson: Fractured Continuum follows Carson. The brave explorer who must discover why time and space has been fractured in the Infractus Tempestas system. Each time Carson fails in his mission he is sent back in time to the moment he entered the solar system. Carson may die, but he keeps his abilities and skills he learns before his death. Making him more and more dangerous with each death he suffers.
Fighting to the death is better with a friend.
Time and space is fractured in the Infractus Tempestas system. Carsons from an infinite amount of universes are there to aid you in your fight to save the system. Invite your friends to help you on your journey where they can fight side-by-side with you. Be careful though, your friends can do just as much damage to you as they can the enemy. Choose your friends wisely.
Take advantage of the environment to defeat foes.
Use the ever-changing landscape to your advantage to defeat enemies using fallen trees, loose boulders, or even shallow pools of water. 
Difficult, but rewarding souls-like combat.
Your enemy is faster and stronger than you, but with enough skill and even more deaths you will become strong enough to vanquish your enemy.

title: Lost Soul
description:
게임 정보
Backstory
On a stormy night, a lightning bolt struck a tree, and electricity quickly spread across the ground. In an instant, scattered bones on the ground came to life. The skeletal figure slowly rose, shaky yet aware, as it became a creature with consciousness. However, it couldn't remember anything about its past.
In search of its lost memories, this nameless skeleton sets out on a journey of exploration and adventure.
Game Features
Exploration
The skeleton awakens on a mysterious island filled with unknown areas, waiting for players to delve in and uncover its secrets. Every corner hides fragments of the story, revealing the mysteries of the island.
Puzzles
Some areas cannot be accessed with the skeleton’s current abilities. Players need to advance through certain levels to acquire key items and solve puzzles. Levels are filled with various clues and hints—perhaps a series of numbers or a special symbol—that may be crucial for progression.
Storyline
Throughout the game, players will gradually recover lost memories, uncovering the skeleton’s mysterious origins. Some choices will influence the story’s direction, leading to different possible endings.
Additional Note
This game is still in development. If you're interested, please add it to your wishlist! This really means a lot to us—thank you!

title: Ghostly Acres
description:
게임 정보
Ghostly Acres is a cozy idle simulation game where you turn an old house into a thriving inn for wayward spirits with the help of your friend, Flip the Ghost. Manage and improve Ghostly Acres to generate more revenue from your ghostly guests.
Mel started the inn when she discovered the old house she inherited from her uncle was haunted! She was frightened at first, but the friendly old ghost Flip wasn't scary, just homeless. Flip convinced Mel to open up her home to ghosts everywhere and create the first inn of its kind: for ghosts! And so, Ghostly Acres was officially in business.
Build
Your guests need beds to sleep in and places to eat, drink, and be entertained. Build beds, vending machines, water coolers, and more!
Decorate
Build walls, change the floors, and paint to design your ideal inn.

title: Wheelchair Racer
description:
게임 정보
Become the Wheelchair! This hilariously challenging physics racer dares you to master the art of wheelchair movement.
Dual-Hand Controls:
Take on the challenge with a unique dual-handed control system that tests your left- and right-hand coordination to the limit. Push, pull, and pivot your way through every obstacle!

title: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero
description:
게임 정보
Ragnar Lothbrok, once a legendary Viking hero, has been summoned back to life by Odin the All-Father. In his previous life, Ragnar fought valiantly, yet his soul was tainted by misdeeds, and his spirit was forced to wander in the cold mists of Hel’s domain, deprived of Valhalla's glory.
But Odin saw something of value in Ragnar’s unyielding spirit.
And now, the All-Father has granted him a second chance - not only to redeem himself but to serve the gods in a quest that spans realms few have ever seen.
Our hero embarks on a mysterious journey to recover powerful artifacts scattered by ancient forces. Ragnar's quest leads him through enchanted lands, filled with magic, illusions, and strange creatures, his path lit only by glimpses of fate and the weight of his own redemption.
autokwd: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero

title: Peagrove Noir
description:
게임 정보
An Open-World to Explore
Discover a quiet island town racked by corruption, conspiracy, and collusion. Alone or with up to 3 of your friends, explore speakeasies, tea houses, dockyards, and more across Peagrove's 8 unique districts.
Meet the Locals
Immerse yourself in a world of colourful characters, risky rogues, and vainglorious villains. Townsfolk will remember you and your actions, so find friends, make enemies, and integrate into the local culture as Peagrove's newest detective.

title: Unbound Drift
description:
게임 정보
Unbound Drift is a high acceleration physics game built around the desire for speed and the grace of elastic motion. Once you've mastered the simplistic controls you'll be soaring through space at nerve inducing speeds!
Physics Driven Mastery
Behind the simple swings and artful arcs lies tons of physics fun. Every obstacle is an opportunity to bounce, every corner an opportunity to wrap yourself around. At high speeds, even your tether is loaded with elasticity, allowing you to slingshot yourself to the stars!

title: The Last Prisoner
description:
게임 정보
"Escape is impossible... or is it possible?"
A space prison, endless corridors, deadly traps and an all-seeing artificial intelligence ready to tear you apart. You are the last prisoner awakened from a corrective cryo-sleep, your task is to escape from this hell and find out where is everyone else? The only way to escape is to manipulate gravity and adapt to the chaos around you.
The Last Prisoner is a hardcore platformer with gravity changing mechanics, an engaging story, and memorable characters.
What's in store for you:
Gravity Changing Mechanics: Bypass traps by changing the direction of gravity, dodge deadly AI tricks and blast through levels.
High difficulty for real hardcore gamers: Each level is a new challenge that requires lightning-fast reactions and precision.
Engaging story and charismatic characters: Uncover the truth about humanity’s fate while facing a devious AI and meeting a mysterious ally.
An AI determined to destroy you: The merciless AI will do everything to stop your escape, activating traps at the most unexpected moments. But don’t think she’s just a regular opponent. She won’t just try to kill you—she’ll mock your failures with sarcasm and playful taunts. Get ready for her sharp and cheeky remarks.

title: Bloodmoon
description:
게임 정보
Survive by mastering intense combat: slash with your sword, dash and teleport to evade, and blast enemies with flames and electricity. Light is your only source of healing. Recharge within its glow, or brave the shadows for greater rewards.
Each wave grows deadlier. Strategize carefully, level up to boost your power, and fight to outlast the darkness.
Key Features:
Survive Horde Combat: Battle waves of creatures and face unique bosses.
Light vs. Dark: Stay in the light to recover or risk the shadows for rewards.
Spell-Powered Action: Dash, teleport, and wield arcane abilities.

title: PolyRealms: The Lost Kingdom
description:
게임 정보
In a vast open world survival RPG, you will have the freedom to explore and thrive in diverse biomes: forests, deserts, mountains, and more, each with unique ecosystems and varied resources. With a robust building system, construct your base from scratch, customizing it with defensive structures, farming areas, and workshops. Utilize the farming system to plant and harvest food, essential for survival, or raise livestock for valuable resources.
Additionally, face creatures and explore dungeons filled with dangers and hidden secrets. The game offers a vast skill and equipment tree that allows you to customize your character to tackle the specific challenges of each environment. Dynamic weather and day-night cycles increase the difficulty, while resource management and strategic planning make each journey unique and challenging.

title: HATMAN
description:
게임 정보
                                                                              HATMAN
                 About this game
Enter the whimsical world of HATMAN, a 2D pixel art adventure where humor meets dark twists.

title: Chicken Craft
description:
게임 정보
                 Start with basic chickens and breed them to discover new appearances, mutations, and hidden DNA traits.

title: E9uations
description:
게임 정보
당신은 등호를 조종하게 됩니다. 목표는 숫자블럭을 모두 부수는 것입니다.
숫자블럭은 같은 숫자를 만나면 사라집니다. 올바른 숫자를 구하기 위해 수식을 만들어야 할 것입니다.
이 게임은 복잡한 계산으로 당신을 괴롭히지 않을 것입니다.
대부분의 문제는 간단한 산수로 풀 수 있으며, 필요한 것은 아이디어입니다.
독특한 테마와 100개 이상의 수제 퍼즐을 즐기세요

title: Aralunis
description:
게임 정보
Aralunis is a charming and personality-filled pixel art adventure where you play as Luna, a young princess determined to rescue her hero. Captured by mistake in her place by the powerful evil sorcerer known as Flames of Calamity, Luna must restore peace to her kingdom. Alongside her, embark on an epic journey through unique and enchanting landscapes, each more beautiful and challenging than the last.
Game Features:
2D Platform Adventure with Casual Elements: Perfect for those who love to explore at their own pace, Aralunis offers an accessible and relaxing experience, while still challenging your platforming skills with precision and creativity.
Nostalgic Pixel Art Graphics: Admire vibrant, retro visuals carefully crafted in pixel art, bringing every detail of the kingdom of Aralunis to life. From lush forests to dark caves, snow-covered mountains, and mystical landscapes filled with giant mushrooms, each environment is designed to fascinate and immerse.
Varied and Unique Environments: Explore fascinating and distinct biomes, each with its own atmosphere, creatures, and challenges. From the serenity of the forests to the icy heights and kingdoms shrouded in darkness, every step reveals something new and surprising.
Relaxing Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in a soothing soundtrack that accompanies Luna on her journey, designed to provide a calming and unforgettable experience.
Inspiring Storyline: More than just a princess, Luna is a determined and brave heroine, willing to push her limits to save her loved ones and restore light to her home.

title: Spritz the Happy Onion
description:
게임 정보
Steven Spielberg once said, "I think the real indicator [that games have become a storytelling art form] will be when somebody confesses that they cried at level 17." Well your move, Steve!

Spritz the Happy Onion is a zesty, delicious throwback to momentum-based platformers of old, complete with run button. Except in this game, you can die as many times as you like. Though dying does lose you an expensive egg, which are important because...

A MONSTER HAS APPEARED IN THE SKY TO DEVOUR THE MOON. And only our little layered lancealot possesses a recipe for a cake that might ruin it's appetite.

Spritz can also hop off of background elements, (a feature so satisfying and natural and fun I'm not sure why I haven't seen it anywhere before,) and don magic hats to give him extra abilities like flight and invincibility.

I'm Googling it right now, and it seems like the moon is important for a lot of things like tides and satellites and night visibility. It's not just pretty! So it would be very prudent for you to help Spritz on his quest!

title: Drakefall
description:
게임 정보
Explore the World of Drakefall in this roguelike deckbuilder. Build your deck, discover powerful items, and journey through swamps and mountain peaks with a familiar playstyle.
Tell us what do you think about Drakefall
Features
Evolving Deck Construction: Make strategic card choices! Explore and acquire hundreds of cards to build your deck with every attempt to conquer the ruptured world of Drakefall. Pick cards that synergize well to effectively defeat foes and challenge theruling dragons.

title: Sepulchron
description:
게임 정보
Sepulchron is a difficult puzzle game set in the seemingly deserted Astor Manor. The puzzles within its walls will challenge your logical deduction, observation skills, perseverance, and real-world knowledge of everyday facts. With a day-and-night cycle, you must balance exploration during both periods: Days of tranquil monotony, and nights of dread and danger, requiring you to use anything you can find to defend yourself from ghastly threats. Discover the secrets that the Manor hides if you wish to survive longer than the 72 hours you have left before you die.


PUZZLES



Using physics as a base, Sepulchron's puzzles go beyond simply finding an item to act as a 'key' to solve them, as many puzzle games do. Found a sword, and there are ropes blocking your path? Don’t just 'interact' with it — swing that sword to cut the rope! Need to press something, but it won’t stay down? Maybe you need to place something heavy to weight it down. Use your logic and common sense to uncover secrets and solve the difficult puzzles scattered throughout Astor Manor.


GAMEPLAY



Ghosts and ethereal beings rise with the moon, and you must defend yourself against the evil that lurks in the dark. Either find and use weapons suited for combat with the best ammunition for each situation, or improvise and use whatever you can get your hands on — a chair, a sword from the wall, or even a teddy bear — to defeat your enemies and survive another night. And a word of warning: These sneaky ghosts change tactics every time you play, so stay on your toes!






Instead of relying on jump scares like most scary games, Sepulchron builds its horror through a suspenseful atmosphere. This is achieved by the day-and-night cycle, where days are tranquil, giving a fleeting sense of safety, while nights are dark and dangerous, making preparations vital. The contrast between light and darkness also plays a crucial role, with nights being truly dark, making the management of your light sources and its fuel essential for survival.






If you enjoy the following:

- Difficult Puzzles

- A Horror-filled, Moody Atmosphere

- Passive Storytelling through Enviroment and Lore Books

- Physics-Based Gameplay

- Unpredictable enemies that change tactics and placement every time you start over.

- A Short, yet Dense and Content-rich Game

- Time Management

- A Game Full of Personality


... Then you will have a great time playing Sepulchron!

title: Tears Apart
description:
게임 정보
Tears Apart는 순수한 고속 액션입니다. 대천사 Raggon이 되어 어둠을 뚫고 은하계에 빛을 가져오는 임무를 수행하세요. 당신은 우주를 가득 메운 그림자 속을 돌진하며 적을 베고 정복할 것입니다.
승리를 향한 돌진
모든 공격은 적과 장애물을 가르는 번개처럼 빠른 돌진입니다. 이 게임은 속도와 정확성에 달려 있습니다. 한 번의 실수로 어둠이 당신을 삼킬 수 있습니다.
별자리 창조
숨겨진 별을 발견하고, 당신이 정화하는 은하계마다 더 강해지는 별자리를 해제하세요. 각 별자리는 새로운 힘과 무한한 플레이 방법을 제공합니다.
에픽 보스 전투
당신의 기술을 그 어느 때보다도 시험할 거대한 심연의 보스들과 대결하세요. 이 전투들은 강렬하고 빠르며, 무자비하게 진행됩니다—바로 당신이 원하는 방식대로.
은하계에 질서를 가져오세요
혼돈의 심장부로 뛰어들어, 모든 돌진으로 어둠을 부수고 별을 다시 밝혀 우주의 질서를 회복하세요. 각 승리는 단순한 승리가 아닌 새로운 별의 탄생, 광대한 우주에서 희망의 등대이며, 영원한 영혼의 안식처입니다.
출시 시 특징:
돌진 기반 전투: 모든 공격이 적을 가르는 고속 액션을 경험하세요.
역동적인 우주: 숨겨진 별과 도전, 적들로 가득한 독특한 은하계를 탐험하고 정복하세요.
별자리 시너지: 무한한 전략적 가능성을 제공하는 강력한 별자리를 해제하고 결합하세요.
에픽 보스 전투: 거대한 보스들과 강렬하고 빠른 속도의 전투에서 맞서 싸우세요.
스타더스트 업그레이드: 스타더스트를 모아 다음 은하계를 위한 영구적인 업그레이드에 투자하세요.
몰입감 있는 분위기: 시작부터 끝까지 우주의 모든 구석에 도달하려는 캐릭터로 플레이하세요. 그녀의 우주 규모의 여정에 뛰어들어 다른 원초적 존재들과 만나보세요.

어둠을 찢고 은하계를 균형 잡을 준비를 하세요. 지금 위시리스트에 추가하고, 우주를 차지할 준비를 하세요!

title: Elemental War Clash
description:
게임 정보
Elemental War Clash combines classic tower defense with roguelite and RPG mechanics as well as different elements to combine and create more powerful towers. As a best of Elemental War 1 and Elemental War 2 it provides the most content, best features and stunning visuals while you defeat your portal, beat other players in PvP or build new maps in the level editor.
The foundation of Elemental War are the different elements. With element crystals you get every five waves you can summon powerful bosses, the so-called elementals. By defeating the elementals you unlock their element to improve your towers and get access to new abilities and upgrades by combining up to three elements.
The heart of the Elemental War series are the quests and items. By solving quests you unlock new items for your item pool that then will drop throughout your runs. Items can be passive bonusses, active abilities or tower equipment to customize your towers.
Elemental War Clash features the cross-platform PvP multiplayer mode "Clash" in which two players will fight each other. You both will have to defend your portal as well as send monsters to your opponent at the same time. Who will be able to survive longest?
Features
Dozens of different towers with different abilities and strengths
3 singleplayer modes: Hero Mode, Classic Mode, Survival Mode
Plenty of passive and active items as well as tower equipment
Monster abilities from Gold Rush to Invincibility to make each run unique
Different and visual stunning environments from desert to ice world
Different skills with multiple upgrades to customize your playing behavior
Plenty of different monsters and elementals
Several quests to unlock new items
Level editor to create and share new maps

title: Hedgehog's Dilemma
description:
게임 정보
...and as a result, there are two states at the same time - symmetric and antisymmetric. The particles become entangled.

Now their fate is linked. Even if both particles are in different parts of the galaxy, by measuring the state of one of them, we will instantly affect the other.

Sometimes a person meets a person - and by the will of the Universe, quantum states, or the irresistible current of existence, their lives become connected. The meeting of Marharyta and Mykhailo was definitely a game of fate; they were two scientists with a clear view of the world, and combined as much as they differed from each other. But is it enough?

- Build relationships between Marharyta and Mykhailo, two university professors with their own baggage
- Navigate choices that define potential ending
- Read story from both perspectives and collect information on what's actually happened in their past and in their future
- Define for yourself the cost of connection and fate

The game consists of two hours of content, two different storylines, lot's of dating scenes, and lots of philosophical dialogue.

title: Deprived
description:
게임 정보
A return to Classic Survival Horror.
35 days since the terrorist attack - after being hospitalized your Nightmares keep getting more vivid, effects in the Nightmare start affecting your real body.
Retracing events is the only way to wake up.
They've been consistent - find out and perform whatever tasks you did that day.
It's never mattered how or when, but you won't wake up until they're all done. 
Collecting your thoughts is difficult here, thinking out loud can help put things in perspective. 
Or maybe just touch it, can you open it? Can you even move it? You won't know unless you try.

description: 게임 정보

title: ZaciSa: Idle Defense!
description:
게임 정보
Tower Defense meets Idle Clicker
This is a Tower Defense x Idle Clicker game set inside the Crayon Empire. Let the game build out your bases, upgrade your colorful forces and attack all oncoming enemy forces. Or take charge and control your destiny and fortify your defenses. As the game levels up and enemies get stronger, you will be rewarded new weapon choices and abilities.

title: Object 17
description:
게임 정보
You are Object 17. Someone unknown is forcing you to undergo mental ability tests. What happened to you? Where are you? Who is testing you? If your number is 17, then what happened to the previous 16 subjects? You will have to answer these and other questions during the game.

Collect puzzles from three-dimensional models of the famous Tetris. Move and rotate the figures as you like. The goal is to fit all the figures into a semi-transparent box in the center of the location. Some figures will be locked. To unlock them, you need to solve a problem.

You will have to use your abstract thinking to the fullest. Go through the tests on the flying islands in the open space of your subconscious. It won't be easy!

title: Attrax
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Attrax technological institute
Opposites attract, and likes repel. Dive into the mysterious Attrax institute, solving intricate logic puzzles based on the principles of attraction and repulsion, with each puzzle bringing you closer to the origins of the institute. In this captivating single-player experience, enjoy hours of gameplay that will challenge your mind and redefine your understanding of physics and logic.

Attraction and Repulsion
Each puzzle room will test your knowledge of attraction and repulsion. Manipulate charged field generators, charged particles, charged cubes, and other activators in different testing environments in order to solve these puzzles.

Take the power of attraction and repulsion into your hands. Use the Charge Gun to directly affect the world around you, flinging objects (yourself included) across rooms to solve intricate puzzles and cross deadly gaps.

The institute is much older than it wants you to think, and why is it you can't remember how you came to this place. Keep your eyes and ears open as you progress through the Attrax technological institute, and you just may uncover its deepest and darkest secrets.

title: Lab 77
description:
게임 정보
The game you will love to make your friends play.

In Lab 77 you play as Specimen S539-77, making your way through the challenges of Lab 77's test chambers under the supervision of the Director. Place versions of yourself to bridge gaps between platforms, collect lab notes to learn about the lore of Lab 77, avoid dangers in the test chambers and complete your training.

Strategically maneuver your way through 77 test chambers to complete your training. Pick up collectible lab notes in each chamber to learn about the lore of Lab 77, the enigmatic Dr. Leitner and the daily issues faced by staff at Lab 77.

title: Shenaniguns
description:
게임 정보
Shenaniguns는 탑다운 방식의 실시간 멀티플레이어 슈팅 게임입니다. 매번 생성될 때마다 게임 모드에 따라 2~3개의 무기를 얻어 친구들과 전투를 벌이세요!
권총, 샷건, 저격총, 수류탄, 터렛, 포털 건, 농축 우라늄, 그래플링 후크, 4인치 텅스텐 큐브, 산업용 대형 물총, 휘발유, 최루액, 도박, 아연도금 각철판, 드론, RPG 등 100가지 이상의 무기가…
특수 능력과 마법 부여 등 훨씬 더 많은 요소들이 기다리고 있습니다!
게임 모드
자유 경쟁 - 최대한 많은 사람을 처치하세요!
팀 데스매치 - 빨강과 파랑, 두 개의 균등한 팀!
3가지 무기 - 이름 그대로입니다
깃발 뺏기 - 상대 팀의 깃발을 획득하여 추가 점수 획득!
점령전 - 지도 곳곳에 있는 점령 지점에 서서 팀 점수를 획득하세요!
보스 전투 - Vectah 등! 곧 더 많은 보스가 추가될 예정입니다
건 게임 - 획득하는 무기는 점수에 따라 결정됩니다
혼돈 - 죽으면 폭발하고, 더 빨리 움직이며, 3가지 무기, 더 가까운 생성 지점, 더 큰 불, 더 큰 전투, 그리고 엄청난 양의 핵폐기물이 있습니다

title: ROBOT RECKONING
description:
게임 정보
You play as a demolition worker, electromagnetically connected to a new kind of wrecking ball named Wreckie. The ROBOT RECKONING has begun, and as robots swarm to kill you, you must use Wreckie to smash them and survive.
A SMARTER ACTION GAME
Developing the skill to move Wreckie to where you want her is a challenge, and it's just the beginning.
The real skill is tactical: Wreckie can only be in one place at once, so you have to constantly identify the best position for her in real time, but she only responds to your movements, so you have to move her into that position without moving yourself into enemy fire.
Unlike a lot of action games, this one relies on planning and prediction more than reaction, so it's learnable even if you're not the twitchiest CoD player in the lobby.
IMPACTFUL ABILITIES
The unlocks are changes that you will feel, and every ability is a new thing you can do, not just tweaks; no "+0.5% to Magic Damage on Tuesdays" here.
Also, each ability is versatile enough that you can get creative to synergise and combo them, which you'll have to do at high levels.
HOURS OF GAMEPLAY

title: Mystery of Gevaudan
description:

title: Trapped In The Omniverse
description:
게임 정보
Trapped In The Omniverse: The Infinite Confluence is a challenging first-person survival game that combines interdimensional exploration with adventure and survival. You find yourself lost in the mysterious Antechambers of Quantum Dynamics, where reality blends and distorts. Your mission is to restore the Cosmoportal, the only means to return home, while facing creatures and overcoming obstacles in a chaotic environment. With exploration mechanics, strategic combat, and resource management, every step brings you closer to uncovering the secrets of the multiverses and finding your way back home. Can you restore balance and find the exit before it’s too late?



Quantum Dynamics was a pioneering company in quantum mechanics and its applications during its peak in the 70s and 80s. Their main focus was the unification of quantum physics with gravitational theory, and it is rumored they made significant advances in detecting multiverses and the possibility of traveling between them.

The most notable discovery attributed to Quantum Dynamics was the existence of a connection between the Multiverses through the so-called Antechambers, also known by various names according to documentation found in their old facilities. These antechambers, such as the Omniverse Chamber, the Cosmoportal Nexus, the Infinite Confluence, the Dimensional Nexus Hub, the Quantum Echo Chamber, or the Transdimensional Sanctum, allowed interaction between different universes.

Within these antechambers, it was found that the atmospheres of both Multiverses mixed, creating an environment conducive to the construction of habitable structures. The cross-contamination between parallel realities made these structures livable and allowed for simultaneous existence in both multiverses.



However, Quantum Dynamics began to face significant problems as the antechambers became increasingly contaminated. The company could not maintain control over the presence of specimens and elements from both Multiverses, leading to the gradual abandonment of the facilities.

Despite its disappearance and the loss of records about Quantum Dynamics' activities, the abandoned remains of the company and the documentation found within them remain silent witnesses to a fascinating period in multiverse exploration and attempts to overcome dimensional barriers.

After the fall of Quantum Dynamics, an independent team of daring researchers embarked on a mission to unravel the hidden mysteries behind the company and its legacy. Through meticulous research and exploration of abandoned facilities, they discovered a wealth of written and video material shedding light on Quantum Dynamics’ work.

Among the most surprising findings were numerous documents and records detailing the antechambers used by the company. These antechambers, commonly known by Roman numerals, were not limited to a few. Instead, it was discovered that Quantum Dynamics had managed to build and catalog dozens of interconnected antechambers, each with its own unique features and properties.



Each antechamber presented a specific configuration, with varying dimensions and distinctive characteristics. Some were expansive, covering vast stretches extending across thousands of square kilometers in both multiverses. Others were more compact, limited to a few hundred acres but with an incredible concentration of quantum energy.

The researchers discovered that these numbered antechambers were not only connection points between multiverses but also key nodes for understanding the structure and very nature of reality. Each antechamber seemed to contain fragments of information and knowledge that transcended the limits of any individual universe, revealing fascinating aspects of quantum physics and existence itself.

As they delved deeper into the recovered files, the research team also found mentions of an even more ambitious expansion project known as "Project Omega." This project, which remained unfinished after Quantum Dynamics' disappearance, aimed to create a definitive antechamber capable of connecting multiple multiverses simultaneously. Speculations and hypotheses about the implications and potential applications of such a project flooded the researchers' minds.



The writings and videos uncovered showed indications of the difficulties Quantum Dynamics faced in maintaining control over existing antechambers. The cross-contamination of multiverse atmospheres appeared to be a constant challenge, affecting the balance and habitability of the structures built within them.

The researchers realized that these findings could have significant implications for the future of interdimensional exploration. The possibility of accessing dozens of antechambers and the incomplete vision of Project Omega sparked new questions and possibilities about the nature of the multiverses and the potential for traveling through them.

As the research team delved into this wealth of information, they understood that their discovery had the potential to change humanity’s understanding of the universe and its place within it. The enigmas and secrets locked within the numbered antechambers offered a glimpse into the limits of reality, challenging conventional physics and opening doors to new horizons of exploration and discovery.

title: Dark Light
description:
게임 정보

Dark Light is a pixel art platformer adventure inspired by NES games of the 80s and 90s. You play as John, who is awakened from a peaceful sleep when a lightning strike shatters the silence of the night. As he looks out the window, he witnesses terrifying monsters emerging from the darkness. Armed with improvised tools and driven by curiosity, John embarks on a perilous journey to uncover the source of this strange anomaly and face the growing threats.
EXPLORE

Explore the island, battle enemies and bosses, and unlock new abilities as you guide John through a world filled with danger and mystery. Solve puzzles, defeat monstrous creatures, and uncover hidden secrets in a story-driven adventure that will challenge both your reflexes and your mind.
UNCOVER

What started as a simple investigation soon spirals into a fight for survival as John delves deeper into the island's mysteries. Along the way, he'll face monstrous foes, discover forgotten lore, and slowly piece together the puzzle of what caused this dark anomaly.

title: Vending Machine Hero
description:
게임 정보
자판기 안에 사람이 있어요!
[게임의 배경 및 스토리]


이세계 존재들이 숨어사는 도시를 배경으로하는 어반 판타지 게임입니다.
이세계 존재들을 감시 & 관리하는 임무를 맡은 주인공 나비와 함께 기이한 도시를 조사해보세요.


도시 어디에나 존재하고, 아무도 신경쓰지 않는 자판기.

오늘은 무엇을 마실까?
[다양한 음료수를 마시며 재미있는 능력을 사용해보세요]


나비는 음료수를 마시고 능력을 사용할 수 있습니다. 어떤 음료수를 좋아하시나요? 취향이 가득한 음료수들을 마시면서 재미있는 능력들을 사용해 조사를 진행해볼까요?


자판기에서 새로운 음료수들을 연구하고, 출시해보세요. 조사원 활동에 많은 도움이 될거에요.


조사원의 서포터 오라클과 함께 음료수를 판매하여 활동비를 벌어보세요.
다양한 연구와 업그레이드에는 항상 돈이 필요하답니다.

title: Beastly Tactics: Rock Paper Scissors
description:
게임 정보
Beastly Tactics: Rock Paper Scissors is a turn-based role-playing game where you embody a cunning animal, facing off against others in strategic battles. Each fight is resolved through intuition and deception using the classic Rock, Paper, Scissors, but with a tactical twist. During combat, you'll have access to three key actions to outsmart your opponent:

Guess: Try to predict which choice your opponent will make.
Bluff: Send false signals about your own choice to influence theirs.
Deal: Attempt to force a tie, negotiating a temporary balance.

After each battle, the experience you gain will help level up these abilities, giving you better chances in future duels. Level up, hone your strategy, and prove you’re the smartest in the animal kingdom!

title: Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey is a roguelite turn-based strategy RPG. Echidna, mother of monsters, has unleashed myriad foes across the Aegean. Olympus calls for aid - recruit armies, cultivate skills, and invoke divine aid to save the realm and become a legendary hero!
Choose Your Path
In Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey, each playthrough brings you new randomly generated enemies, events, and allies. Your decisions will shape the encounters you face and the development of your hero. Your hero will acquire heroic epithets granting permanent unique effects and learn godly prophecies to turn fights in your favor.
Battles will be won and lost by the strategies you employ. Fight from a distance with a force of archers, or send flying units in to disrupt enemy formations. Hinder your enemies by casting powerful prophecies, or turn your hero into a one-person army and wreak havoc. After each crisis, new boons are earned, allowing you to continually adjust your approach to find success.
Choose Your Patron
Each Patron offers distinct prophecies, units, and epithets to your hero. Behold the pantheon:
Athena uses strong, defensive units. Her powers aid allied troops and enable clever strategies.

title: 龙魂无限斗 DragonSpiritsINFight
description:
게임 정보
DragonSpiritsINFight
DragonSpiritsINFight is an idle card-building game, serving as a spin-off to Dragon Spirits: Academy Adventures. It boasts a simple interface resembling a regular program and features practical functions like a Pomodoro timer, making it the perfect way to unwind during work breaks.
Background
The peace of the Dragon Spirits Islands has been shattered! Years later, a mysterious and polluting D.S. Field has swept in, making the Dragon Spirits stronger, but weakening the Pacts between Pact Sealers and the dragons. Even worse, unknown monsters have started appearing!
You, a graduate of the Dragon Spirits Academy, join a local guild and take on the responsibility of investigating the truth. As you explore, you will rediscover how to command Dragon Spirits in battle in this new D.S. Field environment and solve the troubles faced by the people, guarding the peace of the islands.
Game Features:
• Mysterious Polluting D.S. Field: Changes the fate of the Dragon Spirits, and brings new challenges.
• More Powerful Dragon Spirits: Break through the level cap and build your own Dragon Spirits team.
• New Battle System: Pre-build your battle strategies, enjoy automatic combat, and experience a new combat style.
• Unknown Monsters Attack: Full of unknown challenges, testing your strategy and tactics.
• Rediscover the Glory of Battle: Start from scratch, grow amidst the crisis, and become a true Pact Sealer.
Gameplay
Collect Dragon Spirits, combine skills, and become the strongest Pact Sealer!
• A new battle system using cost + deck building, combining strategy and skill!
• Real-time combat against other players, with card activation and strategic decision-making!
• Challenge single-player levels, collect resources, and hone your skills.
• Upload your deck, compete in the ladder, and fight for ranking.
• Explore mysterious maps, collect treasures, skills, and Dragon Spirits, and unlock even more possibilities.
• Integrate with the Pomodoro timer to seamlessly connect the game with your work and life, creating an efficient lifestyle!

title: Nightmare Battler Zozo
description:
게임 정보
Nightmare Battler Zozo is a fun and vibrant 2D platformer that blends playful adventure with dreamlike battles. Join Zozo, a young boy trapped in a surreal dream world, as he navigates through bizarre dreamscapes filled with peculiar enemies, mind-bending puzzles, and exciting surprises at every turn. In a land where dreams and nightmares collide, only Zozo’s wits and courage will help him escape!
Battle Your Nightmares: Fight against charmingly creepy enemies that are manifestations of Zozo’s childhood fears. Use a variety of weapons and abilities to blast through your foes and conquer the nightmares.
Explore Dynamic Dreamscapes: Every level takes you deeper into Zozo’s dreams, with vibrant and interactable environments packed with secrets. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden areas, and traverse fantastical landscapes that reflect Zozo's vivid imagination.
Cartoonish Fun: Inspired by the lightheartedness of Sunday morning cartoons, Nightmare Battler Zozo delivers a humorous and heartwarming narrative. The game’s colorful, animated style is sure to delight younger audiences, while its nostalgic platforming mechanics will appeal to older generations who grew up with classic games.
Versatile Gameplay: Master Zozo’s diverse abilities as you jump, climb, fight, and outsmart your way through enemy-filled dreamscapes. Each level offers new challenges and opportunities to test your skills in combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving.
Face Your Fears: Themed around childhood fears, each stage presents unique challenges based on common childhood anxieties, from creepy crawlies to spooky shadows, providing a mix of humor and lighthearted tension.
Whether you're battling nightmare creatures or uncovering hidden surprises, Nightmare Battler Zozo invites you to experience a thrilling, colorful world of imagination and adventure.

title: That sausage museum game
description:
게임 정보

박물관에 맞서다
인내와 정밀함이 필요한 물리 기반의 도전에 직면하세요. 각 동작은 진행과 전시의 시작으로 되돌아가는 것 사이의 섬세한 균형입니다. 그러나 모든 승리는 맛있는 보상을 가져다줍니다: 진정한 예술 감정가가 되는 것.
소시지가 되다
몰입감을 주도록 설계된 조작으로 진짜 소시지가 된 듯한 기분을 느낄 수 있습니다. 모든 굴림과 공중제비는 자연스러워 보입니다 - 비록 소시지는 그렇지 않지만. 아, 그리고 위험을 감수할 준비가 되어 있다면 던질 수도 있습니다.

현대 예술 세계의 허세를 비웃는 게임을 원하셨다면, 당신은 지금 올바른 곳에 있습니다.

예술은 도전이 될 수 있습니다.

title: Relentless Dark
