Key Features
Creature Collecting
Roguelike style leveling
Meta-progression
and more!

title: Trapped In The Omniverse
description:
게임 정보
Trapped In The Omniverse: The Infinite Confluence is a challenging first-person survival game that combines interdimensional exploration with adventure and survival. You find yourself lost in the mysterious Antechambers of Quantum Dynamics, where reality blends and distorts. Your mission is to restore the Cosmoportal, the only means to return home, while facing creatures and overcoming obstacles in a chaotic environment. With exploration mechanics, strategic combat, and resource management, every step brings you closer to uncovering the secrets of the multiverses and finding your way back home. Can you restore balance and find the exit before it’s too late?



Quantum Dynamics was a pioneering company in quantum mechanics and its applications during its peak in the 70s and 80s. Their main focus was the unification of quantum physics with gravitational theory, and it is rumored they made significant advances in detecting multiverses and the possibility of traveling between them.

The most notable discovery attributed to Quantum Dynamics was the existence of a connection between the Multiverses through the so-called Antechambers, also known by various names according to documentation found in their old facilities. These antechambers, such as the Omniverse Chamber, the Cosmoportal Nexus, the Infinite Confluence, the Dimensional Nexus Hub, the Quantum Echo Chamber, or the Transdimensional Sanctum, allowed interaction between different universes.

Within these antechambers, it was found that the atmospheres of both Multiverses mixed, creating an environment conducive to the construction of habitable structures. The cross-contamination between parallel realities made these structures livable and allowed for simultaneous existence in both multiverses.



However, Quantum Dynamics began to face significant problems as the antechambers became increasingly contaminated. The company could not maintain control over the presence of specimens and elements from both Multiverses, leading to the gradual abandonment of the facilities.

Despite its disappearance and the loss of records about Quantum Dynamics' activities, the abandoned remains of the company and the documentation found within them remain silent witnesses to a fascinating period in multiverse exploration and attempts to overcome dimensional barriers.

After the fall of Quantum Dynamics, an independent team of daring researchers embarked on a mission to unravel the hidden mysteries behind the company and its legacy. Through meticulous research and exploration of abandoned facilities, they discovered a wealth of written and video material shedding light on Quantum Dynamics’ work.

Among the most surprising findings were numerous documents and records detailing the antechambers used by the company. These antechambers, commonly known by Roman numerals, were not limited to a few. Instead, it was discovered that Quantum Dynamics had managed to build and catalog dozens of interconnected antechambers, each with its own unique features and properties.



Each antechamber presented a specific configuration, with varying dimensions and distinctive characteristics. Some were expansive, covering vast stretches extending across thousands of square kilometers in both multiverses. Others were more compact, limited to a few hundred acres but with an incredible concentration of quantum energy.

The researchers discovered that these numbered antechambers were not only connection points between multiverses but also key nodes for understanding the structure and very nature of reality. Each antechamber seemed to contain fragments of information and knowledge that transcended the limits of any individual universe, revealing fascinating aspects of quantum physics and existence itself.

As they delved deeper into the recovered files, the research team also found mentions of an even more ambitious expansion project known as "Project Omega." This project, which remained unfinished after Quantum Dynamics' disappearance, aimed to create a definitive antechamber capable of connecting multiple multiverses simultaneously. Speculations and hypotheses about the implications and potential applications of such a project flooded the researchers' minds.



The writings and videos uncovered showed indications of the difficulties Quantum Dynamics faced in maintaining control over existing antechambers. The cross-contamination of multiverse atmospheres appeared to be a constant challenge, affecting the balance and habitability of the structures built within them.

The researchers realized that these findings could have significant implications for the future of interdimensional exploration. The possibility of accessing dozens of antechambers and the incomplete vision of Project Omega sparked new questions and possibilities about the nature of the multiverses and the potential for traveling through them.

As the research team delved into this wealth of information, they understood that their discovery had the potential to change humanity’s understanding of the universe and its place within it. The enigmas and secrets locked within the numbered antechambers offered a glimpse into the limits of reality, challenging conventional physics and opening doors to new horizons of exploration and discovery.

title: Dark Light
description:
게임 정보

Dark Light is a pixel art platformer adventure inspired by NES games of the 80s and 90s. You play as John, who is awakened from a peaceful sleep when a lightning strike shatters the silence of the night. As he looks out the window, he witnesses terrifying monsters emerging from the darkness. Armed with improvised tools and driven by curiosity, John embarks on a perilous journey to uncover the source of this strange anomaly and face the growing threats.
EXPLORE

Explore the island, battle enemies and bosses, and unlock new abilities as you guide John through a world filled with danger and mystery. Solve puzzles, defeat monstrous creatures, and uncover hidden secrets in a story-driven adventure that will challenge both your reflexes and your mind.
UNCOVER

What started as a simple investigation soon spirals into a fight for survival as John delves deeper into the island's mysteries. Along the way, he'll face monstrous foes, discover forgotten lore, and slowly piece together the puzzle of what caused this dark anomaly.

title: Vending Machine Hero
description:
게임 정보
자판기 안에 사람이 있어요!
[게임의 배경 및 스토리]


이세계 존재들이 숨어사는 도시를 배경으로하는 어반 판타지 게임입니다.
이세계 존재들을 감시 & 관리하는 임무를 맡은 주인공 나비와 함께 기이한 도시를 조사해보세요.


도시 어디에나 존재하고, 아무도 신경쓰지 않는 자판기.
나비는 이 도시의 자판기 안에서 살고 있으며, 일반 사람들에게 이세계 존재들의 존재를 걸리지 않게 관리하는 몬스테라의 조사원입니다. 오늘은 또 어떤 사건을 조사하고 해결해야 할까요?
오늘은 무엇을 마실까?
[다양한 음료수를 마시며 재미있는 능력을 사용해보세요]


나비는 음료수를 마시고 능력을 사용할 수 있습니다. 어떤 음료수를 좋아하시나요? 취향이 가득한 음료수들을 마시면서 재미있는 능력들을 사용해 조사를 진행해볼까요?


자판기에서 새로운 음료수들을 연구하고, 출시해보세요. 조사원 활동에 많은 도움이 될거에요.


조사원의 서포터 오라클과 함께 음료수를 판매하여 활동비를 벌어보세요.
다양한 연구와 업그레이드에는 항상 돈이 필요하답니다.

title: Beastly Tactics: Rock Paper Scissors
description:
게임 정보
Beastly Tactics: Rock Paper Scissors is a turn-based role-playing game where you embody a cunning animal, facing off against others in strategic battles. Each fight is resolved through intuition and deception using the classic Rock, Paper, Scissors, but with a tactical twist. During combat, you'll have access to three key actions to outsmart your opponent:

Guess: Try to predict which choice your opponent will make.
Bluff: Send false signals about your own choice to influence theirs.
Deal: Attempt to force a tie, negotiating a temporary balance.

After each battle, the experience you gain will help level up these abilities, giving you better chances in future duels. Level up, hone your strategy, and prove you’re the smartest in the animal kingdom!

title: Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey is a roguelite turn-based strategy RPG. Echidna, mother of monsters, has unleashed myriad foes across the Aegean. Olympus calls for aid - recruit armies, cultivate skills, and invoke divine aid to save the realm and become a legendary hero!
Choose Your Path
In Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey, each playthrough brings you new randomly generated enemies, events, and allies. Your decisions will shape the encounters you face and the development of your hero. Your hero will acquire heroic epithets granting permanent unique effects and learn godly prophecies to turn fights in your favor.
Battles will be won and lost by the strategies you employ. Fight from a distance with a force of archers, or send flying units in to disrupt enemy formations. Hinder your enemies by casting powerful prophecies, or turn your hero into a one-person army and wreak havoc. After each crisis, new boons are earned, allowing you to continually adjust your approach to find success.
Choose Your Patron
Each Patron offers distinct prophecies, units, and epithets to your hero. Behold the pantheon:
Athena uses strong, defensive units. Her powers aid allied troops and enable clever strategies.

title: 龙魂无限斗 DragonSpiritsINFight
description:
게임 정보
DragonSpiritsINFight
DragonSpiritsINFight is an idle card-building game, serving as a spin-off to Dragon Spirits: Academy Adventures. It boasts a simple interface resembling a regular program and features practical functions like a Pomodoro timer, making it the perfect way to unwind during work breaks.
Background
The peace of the Dragon Spirits Islands has been shattered! Years later, a mysterious and polluting D.S. Field has swept in, making the Dragon Spirits stronger, but weakening the Pacts between Pact Sealers and the dragons. Even worse, unknown monsters have started appearing!
You, a graduate of the Dragon Spirits Academy, join a local guild and take on the responsibility of investigating the truth. As you explore, you will rediscover how to command Dragon Spirits in battle in this new D.S. Field environment and solve the troubles faced by the people, guarding the peace of the islands.
Game Features:
• Mysterious Polluting D.S. Field: Changes the fate of the Dragon Spirits, and brings new challenges.
• More Powerful Dragon Spirits: Break through the level cap and build your own Dragon Spirits team.
• New Battle System: Pre-build your battle strategies, enjoy automatic combat, and experience a new combat style.
• Unknown Monsters Attack: Full of unknown challenges, testing your strategy and tactics.
• Rediscover the Glory of Battle: Start from scratch, grow amidst the crisis, and become a true Pact Sealer.
Gameplay
Collect Dragon Spirits, combine skills, and become the strongest Pact Sealer!
• A new battle system using cost + deck building, combining strategy and skill!
• Real-time combat against other players, with card activation and strategic decision-making!
• Challenge single-player levels, collect resources, and hone your skills.
• Upload your deck, compete in the ladder, and fight for ranking.
• Explore mysterious maps, collect treasures, skills, and Dragon Spirits, and unlock even more possibilities.
• Integrate with the Pomodoro timer to seamlessly connect the game with your work and life, creating an efficient lifestyle!

title: Nightmare Battler Zozo
description:
게임 정보
Nightmare Battler Zozo is a fun and vibrant 2D platformer that blends playful adventure with dreamlike battles. Join Zozo, a young boy trapped in a surreal dream world, as he navigates through bizarre dreamscapes filled with peculiar enemies, mind-bending puzzles, and exciting surprises at every turn. In a land where dreams and nightmares collide, only Zozo’s wits and courage will help him escape!
Battle Your Nightmares: Fight against charmingly creepy enemies that are manifestations of Zozo’s childhood fears. Use a variety of weapons and abilities to blast through your foes and conquer the nightmares.
Explore Dynamic Dreamscapes: Every level takes you deeper into Zozo’s dreams, with vibrant and interactable environments packed with secrets. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden areas, and traverse fantastical landscapes that reflect Zozo's vivid imagination.
Cartoonish Fun: Inspired by the lightheartedness of Sunday morning cartoons, Nightmare Battler Zozo delivers a humorous and heartwarming narrative. The game’s colorful, animated style is sure to delight younger audiences, while its nostalgic platforming mechanics will appeal to older generations who grew up with classic games.
Versatile Gameplay: Master Zozo’s diverse abilities as you jump, climb, fight, and outsmart your way through enemy-filled dreamscapes. Each level offers new challenges and opportunities to test your skills in combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving.
Face Your Fears: Themed around childhood fears, each stage presents unique challenges based on common childhood anxieties, from creepy crawlies to spooky shadows, providing a mix of humor and lighthearted tension.
Whether you're battling nightmare creatures or uncovering hidden surprises, Nightmare Battler Zozo invites you to experience a thrilling, colorful world of imagination and adventure.

title: That sausage museum game
description:
게임 정보
박물관에서 소시지가 된 기분이 어떤지 궁금해 본 적이 있나요? 이제 기회가 생겼습니다! 우리의 길쭉한 영웅을 조종하여 초현실적인 예술 전시회를 여행하세요. 기괴한 도전, 중력을 무시하는 조각들, 그리고 정신을 혼미하게 하는 설치미술에 맞서 싸우는 지적으로 도전적인 모험이 기다리고 있습니다.
박물관에 맞서다
인내와 정밀함이 필요한 물리 기반의 도전에 직면하세요. 각 동작은 진행과 전시의 시작으로 되돌아가는 것 사이의 섬세한 균형입니다. 그러나 모든 승리는 맛있는 보상을 가져다줍니다: 진정한 예술 감정가가 되는 것.
소시지가 되다
몰입감을 주도록 설계된 조작으로 진짜 소시지가 된 듯한 기분을 느낄 수 있습니다. 모든 굴림과 공중제비는 자연스러워 보입니다 - 비록 소시지는 그렇지 않지만. 아, 그리고 위험을 감수할 준비가 되어 있다면 던질 수도 있습니다.

현대 예술 세계의 허세를 비웃는 게임을 원하셨다면, 당신은 지금 올바른 곳에 있습니다.

예술은 도전이 될 수 있습니다.

title: Relentless Dark
description:
게임 정보
As the solo developer behind Relentless Dark, this project has been a labor of love, and I’m so excited to finally share my passion with the world. Your support and feedback mean EVERYTHING to me as I yearn to create the most intense and terrifying zombie horde experience imaginable. Whether you want to follow the development, contribute ideas, or simply be part of the community, I’d love for you to join me as I move forward, one small step at a time.
Relentless Dark is designed to be a pulse-pounding, 4-player cooperative zombie horde game, where teamwork and instinct are pushed to their absolute limits. With a haunting atmosphere, brutal combat, and an unforgiving AI, every moment will feel like a fight for survival. Can you and your friends endure the relentless onslaught, or will the darkness swallow you whole?
Oh also this is my first game, wish me luck!

title: A Strange Mage's Rampage
description:
게임 정보
호드 서바이벌 아레나 + 덱 빌더, 이게 가능할까요? 저는 그렇게 생각하며, 이 게임이 이를 증명한다고 생각합니다.덱을 구성할 카드 풀을 커스터마이징하고 나보다 더 낯선 외계인 무리를 상대로 살아남으세요.
하나의 가능한 콤보는 다음과 같이 표시될 수 있습니다:
진행 상황
새로운 카드를 잠금 해제하여 나만의 런덱 꾸미기
새로운 캐릭터를 잠금 해제하여 다음 실행 시 최고의 빌드 방법을 대폭 변경하세요.
더 많은 에일리언, 더 많은 라운드, 더 많은 재미와 무작위성으로 더 높은 난이도를 잠금 해제하세요(더 큰 카드 풀).
실행 중
다음을 수행합니다.
15-120초의 짧고 액션이 가득한 파도를 즐기세요.
레벨을 올리고 무작위로 선택된 3가지 업그레이드 중에서 기본 캐릭터 능력치를 어디로 가져갈지 선택하세요.
라운드 사이에 상점에서 카드 구매
생존을 위한 투쟁의 시작
멈출 수 없는 존재가 되거나 죽음을 맞이하세요
라운드에서
다음을 수행합니다.

title: Tower Petroleum
description:
게임 정보
For those who want classical tower defense experience Tower Petroleum gives towers, tower upgrades, monsters, economical upgrades and strategic experience like you had before!
Tower Petroleum has a narrative element to it. Every choice you make, shaped by your own moral compass, forges a unique path, not only influencing the story but also defining your entire gameplay experience.
Features:
Unique levels with different strategic possibilities.
Deck-building team assembling mechanic
Different branches of towers upgrades: feed your enemies lead or disintegrate them with deadly plasma, use drones or fire: whatever fits your playstyle.

title: Selenetrope
description:
게임 정보
In Selenetrope, you’ll navigate a vast network of interconnected interiors full of secrets and mysterious ancient structures, all while being pursued by a multitude of creatures from among the living, the dead, and the incomprehensible in between. Discover new items and abilities that grant you unique ways to explore the world. Venture into the dark and brave the horrors that lurk within to return to your lost home.
Decide how to approach each monster encounter in your own way. You can stealthily sneak by to avoid detection, moving swiftly and quietly. Or, uncover and exploit their weaknesses to gain the advantage. Or, if all else fails, run as fast as you can.
Discover and master the enigmatic structures hidden in the labyrinth's forgotten corners. Reveal their secrets and learn what they are and where they might lead you.

title: Iron Roland
description:
게임 정보
After a century of brutal struggle against a mysterious enemy, humanity is finally ready to fight back.
This is the idea that brought many honorable volunteers to take part in this suicidal offensive into enemy territory, the first since those beasts suddenly appeared one hundred years ago and forced us to band together under one banner in order to survive.
But that's not your story; you are a convict, a murderer, and guilt is the only feeling that has brought you here. The past week is only a distorted blur in your mind, but you remember the screams and the blood well enough to know that the offer they made to you is probably too generous for a monster such as yourself.
Maintain the apparatus from deep within the machine.
Make sure the Iron Roland reaches its destination.
Talk with your supervisors through the Internal Communication System.
Explore the cryptic dreams you have been experiencing recently.
And when the time comes...

title: Artillis
description:
게임 정보
Artillis is a 3D Tower Defense, grid-based, Roguelike. Every island is a new puzzle to solve, procedurally generated to offer unrivaled visual and strategic depth.
Tower Customization: All towers have upgrade-slots where you can assign modules to drastically change their behavior.
Roguelike Progression: You bring everything with you from island to island, carried on the back of a giant turtle. Throughout each journey you'll pick up new towers and modules, enlist heroes and acquire ancient relics.
Iterative Procedural Generation: With ordered chaos in three dimensions, no two islands are the same. You have to adapt to the individual challenges and opportunities of each.
Setting Up Camp: Each day you'll fortify your position, placing your tents and towers and exploring the surroundings, in preparation for the nightly attacks.
Enemy Types: Every island will offer different selections and ratios of enemies, and it's up to you to adjust your defenses accordingly.
Draw Enemy Path: The enemies follow in your footsteps, which you can use to your advantage, leading them into range of your towers and creating chokeholds.

title: Bubbles in the Air
description:
게임 정보
Floating, Colliding, Merging, Bursting
No grids, no turns—Bubbles in the Air is a real-time match-and-burst game.
Wander Through a Dog's Dream
The basic rules are simple: aim and shoot bubbles at your desired spot. Bubbles of the same color will merge, grow, and eventually burst—creating new bubbles in the process. Plus, a variety of tools and power-ups can drastically alter the gameplay.

title: Mesoké : An inside journey
description:
게임 정보
A flying journey :

Mesoké offers an aerial, contemplative and poetic journey in which you will be led to discover mysteries and unique places by flying freely in a universe with marked and colorful atmospheres.
Help Mesoké find his peace and memories:
By crossing many singular environments you will discover the resources, memories and objects necessary for the evolution of the world as well as the continuation of the journey towards the inner kingdom of Mesoké.

Features :
Enjoyable, smooth, intuitive and satisfying flight gameplay. Feeling of lightness, freedom and ease.
Original scalable HUB system by exploring and collecting resources.
A singular universe and dreamlike forming a web of tangled worlds. Like a labyrinth of paintings  who tells a story without words.
Risk/Reward System : Challenge, tension, precision and difficulty essentially depend on your choice and taking risk.
Mix of Flying genre, adventure and emotion without known equivalent. Sensation spectrum from calming contemplation to the tension of speed.

title: KUBI ZUKA
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of “KUBI ZUKA (Tomb of Heads)"
A ‘KUBI ZUKA’ is a place where the heads of those who have died in battle or criminals are enshrined.
In this ancient village, shrouded in an eerie silence, you will take on the challenge of unraveling the mystery of the ‘KUBI ZUKA’, where fear and mystery swirl together.

title: Dunes Of Raeth
description:
게임 정보
Dunes Of Raeth is a single-player, sci-fi narrative set in the war-torn desert planet of Raeth.
You play as the King of Raeth. You are on your way to save one of your sons as your transport crashes in the Desert. In the ruthless dunes of your home-planet, you are surprised to discover a whole city...a whole civilization living in the middle of the desert.
As you learn more about the city, you realize that there are mystical forces at play here. The spirit of the planet itself has demanded an audience with you. After centuries of war and drought, you have the power to make a change.
Discover the mysteries behind the mystical energy that sustains your world, and make your way back to your throne. Your family needs you, your planet needs you!
Includes
A beautiful, stylized, immersive world

A story that adapts to your choices and evolves with you

Mysteries to solve

Over 36 different endings to experience
-Developed by Kalempirion Studios 13 -
-Solo-Dev : The DAC-
-Music by : Coraldi-

title: Unfoldink
description:
게임 정보
Unfoldink is a 2D logical puzzle adventure game where you craft unique combinations of cards, to come up with animated stories that explain the tribe's depararature.
UNFOLDINK OFFERS
-> Unique mind boggling puzzles
 -> Total of 10 diffrent cards and...
...over 350 animated combinations
-> Surprising and funny character interactions

title: TritonXR: Reality Warfare
description:
게임 정보
TritonXR turns ANY space into a dynamic combat arena with your friends - duck behind your living room couch to reload, throw a grenade down your hallway or jump over your bed to avoid an attack.
Cutting-Edge XR
Battle as many friends as you can fit in your space, customise your environment, choose your loadout, and experience VR like never before. Play in either our Immersive Mode (full VR), Mixed Reality (hybrid) or the Real Life mode that lets you feel like you’re truly battling IRL.
Your Space, Your Battlefield
TritonXR is as simple to set up as it is fun to play. Our intuitive mixed-reality map editor lets you quickly create combat arenas in your physical space. Add walls, props, weapons and more!
Team Up, Take Down
No friends? No problem. Our brand new Survival Mode lets you battle flying foes that can navigate around your space, and creepy crawlies that can climb any piece of furniture in your room. See how long you can survive in singleplayer or multiplayer mode!
The world's most advanced XR game is here - turn any playspace into the ultimate multiplayer combat arena in TritonXR!

title: Far From The Darkness
description:
게임 정보
Far From The Darkness is a multiplayer strategy and betrayal game for 4 to 12 players.
You are part of a squad of soldiers among whom werewolves are hiding. During the night, the soldiers must complete missions while surviving the werewolves, who can transform once and kill a victim during the night.
If the missions are not completed within the time limit, the squad will have to survive a blood night. During this phase, the werewolves can transform again and continue the massacre.
If the missions are completed within the time limit, the day breaks, and the squad votes to eliminate the most suspicious person.
Of course, the werewolves are not invincible, and the squad is not defenseless. All players (soldiers and wolves) have roles that grant them unique abilities. New roles will be added regularly.
Additional Information:
Gameplay: Unlike the board game, you must move around in a 3D environment. Some roles grant the ability to shoot various projectiles; poor aim can seriously hinder your team.
Communication: The game features a proximity chat system to communicate with other players.
Atmosphere: During the night phases, players move through dark areas, lit only by their flashlights. In this terrifying darkness, danger can come out of nowhere! A word of advice, try to find batteries to stay far from the darkness.
Progression: Every action during a match earns you experience. Each level unlocks in-game cosmetics. Your stats are also saved.

title: Bubble Balance Bonanza
description:
게임 정보
Roll, bump, jump, and crash your way through many unique levels in this fast-paced, marble style, physics-driven platformer. With unpredictable environments, cute characters to meet and interact with and crazy obstacles to overcome, you'll need both skill and strategy to keep your balance and complete the journey.
Are you ready for the bonanza?
Protected by a bubble, you'll embark on a wild adventure through an unknown and treacherous world.
With over 30 levels to explore and complete, you'll meet many other creatures, animals and friends! Bubble Balance Bonanza features a dynamic world map where you’ll roll around to select new levels.

title: Crop Crusaders
description:
게임 정보
Play as a sentient Vegetable who can transform into 6 different veggies with unique abilities. Escape the tormenting lab where you were created and are now being held captive.
CARROT: Dash through the air and see in the dark using the carrot’s abilities.
TOMATO: Fire your stem as a weaponized projectile to take out enemies in a blast.  
BROCCOLI: Swing through the air with the Broccoli’s grappling hook ability.
PEPPER: Traverse dangerous levels covered in acid much more safely with the near acid-proof pepper veggie.
CUCUMBER: When you're as slim as a cucumber, you can fit through tight gaps and get to otherwise inaccessible spots.
EGGPLANT: Break rocks and manipulate the environment through smashing stones and boulders to bits with the physically strongest veggie of them all!
Diverse terrain and environment

title: Your Story: Games with Death
description:
게임 정보
    Your Story: Games with Death는 '선택형 어드벤처' 장르의 인터랙티브 텍스트 퀘스트로, 당신이 이야기의 창작자가 되어 자신의 길을 선택하며, 모든 결정이 위대함으로 이어질 수도 있고 비극으로 끝날 수도 있습니다.
     이 텍스트 퀘스트는 중세 시대를 배경으로 고향 도시를 벗어나 미지의 땅으로 모험을 떠나고자 하는 젊은 모험가의 이야기를 들려줍니다. 그 미지의 땅은 신비와 수수께끼로 가득하며, 치명적인 위험이 도사리고 있습니다.
    운명은 이미 정해져 있고 죽음이 당신을 기다리고 있지만, 이야기를 다시 쓰고 결말을 바꾸어 운명을 바꿀 만한 힘이 당신에게 있을까요? 이곳에서는 모든 것을 바꿀 수 있으며, 어떤 결말이 당신을 기다리고 있는지는 오직 당신만이 알게 될 것입니다. 당신에게는 죽음의 함정을 피하고 자신만의 길을 선택하며, 당신만의 규칙으로 죽음과 한 판 승부를 벌일 기회가 있습니다.
    Your Story: Games with Death는 단순한 어드벤처 게임이 아닙니다. 이는 당신이 그 끝을 결정하는 여정입니다. 이것은 당신이 만들어가는 당신만의 이야기입니다. 당신의 이야기가 영웅적인 서사시가 될지, 아니면 때 이른 죽음으로 끝날지는 전적으로 당신에게 달려있습니다.
    끝없는 발견의 갈증으로 더 나은 삶을 찾아 끝없는 바다를 건너는 모험가의 삶을 살아보세요. 모든 수풀이 치명적인 위험을 숨기고 있을지 모르는 울창한 정글을 탐험하세요. 과거의 그림자들이 살아나고 벽이 잊혀진 비밀을 속삭이는 고대 유적을 헤쳐나가세요. 큰 재산을 모으거나 방랑자의 길을 선택하세요. 이 세계에서 당신의 모든 발걸음은 삶과 죽음의 경계에서 벌이는 게임입니다. 실수를 하면 심연이 당신을 삼켜버릴 것입니다

title: More Life
description:
게임 정보
explore your crumbling city
meet NPCs with main character syndrome
find glitches in the fabric of reality
enter surreal alternate universes
collect stuff you find in the street
scheme against the authorities

title: OGORA
description:
게임 정보

Having caused the Wizard a massive headache, you (and your ill-prepared companion) are temporarily banished from your home to play in the garden.
As an enchanted piece of furniture, you can guide both friends and foes through the twists and turns of the mysterious garden - Ogora!
Discover the magical garden of Ogora and test your mind (and your luck) against your enchanted friends - while the Wizard tries to get a moment of peace!
Uncover secrets within the hedges of the garden (or make a path of your own!). But be careful, not everyone in the garden will aid you!

title: Weeks Till Winter
description:
게임 정보
Weeks Till Winter is a game about strategically placing buildings on grid-like three dimensional terrain to harvest resources from land tiles as-well-as maximize population bonuses through affinities with adjacent buildings. Resource management is minimalistic. You can play casually, placing buildings in aesthetically pleasing formations to build something beautiful, or you can play carefully, perfectly planning your placements to maximize gains while triggering the construction of secret bonus structures.
Each building placement spends a week of time, and as weeks pass so too do seasons. Within a season, building placements can be undone and re-tried to maximize gains. However, with the end of each season (and when using special items) past decisions are locked in place. Secret building formations can be discovered which automatically trigger the creation of new buildings, creating a multitude of options within the randomly generated worlds.

title: Divine Orders
description:
게임 정보
This is exploration-style shooting RPG.
【Game flow】
Each stage is divided into several areas, and players can attack any area they like.
The player can use the experience gained in the process, the materials collected and the money to level up and strengthen their weapons,
The aim is to defeat the stage bosses while using the experience gained in the process, collected materials and money to level up, strengthen weapons and purchase new weapons and skills, etc.
【Game features】
The damage system is based on HP rather than a residual unit system, so it is possible to reduce damage by leveling up and strengthening the system.
Damage can be suppressed by improving your level and strengthening. Because of the earning system that uses enemy bullets, you can enjoy the earning play without worrying about being hit by bullets.
You can enjoy a bold earning play without worrying about being hit by bullets.

title: Pastopia
description:
게임 정보
Pastopia is a third-person, open-world adventure where coding becomes your key in unlocking the mysteries of a forgotten world. 
Explore a beautifully crafted world filled with puzzles and challenges that inspire creative thinking. With your Golem A.I. companion by your side, you'll discover and develop coding skills as you play, using them to revive the lost memories of the past.

title: Forge Together
description:
게임 정보
Forge Together is a blacksmith simulation where you craft and sell weapons for different villagers in the marketplace. 
Craft your masterpiece:
Smelt ore and shape them into the blade of your choosing. Add hilts to complete your weapon and ready them for sale.
Sell your creation:
Negotiate with villagers to maximize profit. Charge a reasonable price, or you’ll risk losing a valuable customer!

title: BrebeMan
description:
게임 정보
Save the world with breakbeats.
ABOUT
On the surface, he is a superhero.
But in his true form, he is an up-and-coming DJ who keeps the clubs lively night after night.
His name is BrebeMan.
Every day, he plays breakbeats from two records and defends the world.
Of course, he never misses to proselytize breakbeat sound.
When you finish this game, you will be hooked on breakbeats.
This is the true music game.
SYSTEM
"BrebeMan" is a 3D SHMUPS & music game.
You control the superhero “BrebeMan” and defeat the enemy “Klangeist”.
FEATURING
The disc manipulated by BrebeMan is an offensive and defensive tool.
At times it is a blade that slices the enemy,
and at other times it is a shield that protects you.
When you accumulate tension, you can "change the beat".
"Change the Beat" attacks all enemies.
A powerful boss awaits you at the end of each stage. Face them with all your might.
The music features a wide variety of club music styles,
from classic to trendy, with drum'n'bass as the mainstay.
Interactive sounds that progress according to the game enhance the game.
Starting with BrebeMan , various characters are represented in the collage.
Vintage, vaporwave, retro-futuristic,
and various other visuals invite you into an unknown world.

title: Snapshot Spirit Live!
description:
게임 정보
In Snapshot Spirit Live! you play as a jetpack-flying photographer named Katie as she hunts ghosts in this educational photography game with minimalist 1-bit-inspired graphics and a Game Boy-inspired soundtrack.
Play as Katie as she flies around a haunted forest to find and photograph a wide variety of cute ghosts and build her photo portfolio. Katie streams her photography and jetpack-flying adventures to viewers, and she comments on what happens each day!

title: Tessera
description:
게임 정보
Tessera is a serene jigsaw puzzle game where the puzzles are made by you.
Take a stroll through various levels and choose a view that suits your puzzling predilection, then transform what you see into a jigsaw puzzle.
Watch hot air balloons, birds and clouds move across the sky and use them as reference to connect pieces together. Sea waves, rustling leaves and shadows cast are more than decoration and can be used to help you piece together the puzzle.

Features:
Unique blend of walking simulator and jigsaw gameplay
Dynamic soundtrack that changes as you get closer to solving a puzzle
Reveal hidden paths by piecing them together, unlocking new areas to explore
Explore 5 fantastical worlds with unique visuals

title: HOMELAND: Last Defense
description:
게임 정보
HOMELAND: Last Defense is a Metroidvania 2.5D shooter involving circuitry and moving the rooms around you.
Play as Fid, the last hope of the country Orotof; an everyday electrician given cybernetic upgrades that can be upgraded and rewired on the go. Your country will be invaded imminently by your neighbors in Camto, and Orotof's army knows they cannot possibly defend against Camto's powerful military.
At the very last minute, your country's army tasked all their remaining scientists and engineers to create YOU, a weapon like the world has never seen, the deciding factor in who will win the war.
Travel throughout your country, and choose how you proceed. Fight off Camto's soldiers, protect civilians, repair infrastructure, upgrade your circuits, go on missions with different factions, and do what you think is best to Defend your HOMELAND

title: Rusty Heights
description:
게임 정보
Rusty Heights is an experimental side-view platform game: It is to be played with the mouse only and is made of a single very high level to be climbed without ever falling down.
You play as the last functional robot of your kind. Equipped only with your grappling hook, you will have to overcome the obstacles of the mountain: electrical platforms, deadly turrets and many other rusty machines will prevent you from reaching the top of this dystopian world.
Be careful, the higher you go, the greater the fall! So Learn to master your trusty grappling hook, and never give up!
Be brave little robot! Every fall will make you stronger!

title: EXON
description:
게임 정보
Fast paced and chaotic, EXON will require you to master the full array of death dealing tools at your disposal. Enemies possess a litany of spells and dark magic which will require precise gameplay in order to overcome the odds.
Formidable adversaries wielding unholy magic aim to overthrow your attempts to rid the realm of their unsanctified presence. Only the strongest of specimens will survive this twisted experiment.

title: Polly's Gone
description:
게임 정보
Polly's Gone은 액션 RTS와 슈팅 요소가 결합된 독특한 게임으로, 충실한 양 팀과 함께 실종된 Polly를 찾기 위한 여정을 떠납니다. 레벨을 진행하며 새로운 도전을 직면하고 위험을 극복하며 Polly의 행방에 다가가세요.
Polly's Gone은 두 가지 흥미로운 게임 모드를 제공합니다:
스토리 모드: 이야기에 몰입하며 다양한 레벨을 탐험하고 팀을 전략적으로 이끌며 적을 물리치세요.
생존 모드: 외딴 섬에서 10분간의 생존 아레나에서 팀의 운명을 책임지고 도전에 맞서보세요.
이 액션 가득한 모험에서 역동적인 전투, 독특한 환경, 스릴 넘치는 도전을 경험할 준비를 하세요!

title: Under Destruction
description:
게임 정보
Spyro: The Elite Drone in the Battle for Erythonite

In a dystopian future dominated by artificial intelligence, humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. Machines, led by the supreme AI “Axis”, fight for control of Erythonite, a revolutionary mineral fueling the war. You are Spyro, an elite combat drone tasked with a critical mission: secure Erythonite deposits, eliminate human defenses, and ensure machine dominance.

Key Features:
Total Destruction: Use fully destructible environments to break through barricades, fortifications, and enemy turrets.
Strategic Open-World: Explore a mountainous terrain, discover Erythonite deposits, and plan your moves to outsmart enemies.
Conquer and Defend: Capture human refineries and fortify your bases to fend off enemy raids.  
Intense Combat: Pilot Spyro and face fighter jets, tanks, turrets, and helicopters in relentless battles. 
Customization and Upgrades: Equip Spyro with devastating weaponry, from Gatling guns to plasma cannons and guided missiles.  
Deadly Support: Collaborate with ”Pyramid”, a massive airborne unit providing logistical aid, and deploy powerful tanks to crush even the toughest defenses.

Game Modes:
Single-Player Campaign: Immerse yourself in a story of war, sacrifice, and strategy as you delve into the conflict between humans and machines.  
Multiplayer: Challenge other players in thrilling battles with **Battle Royale** or Survival-Coop modes, where teamwork is key to victory.  

Prepare for War. 
Every shot leaves a mark, every decision shapes the battlefield. 
Axis has a plan, you are its weapon. 
Take control of Spyro and lead the machine revolution.

title: Block Sprawl
description:
게임 정보
Block Sprawl: A City Planner Deck Builder
Build your dream city from the ground up! Sprawl combines the classic, strategic fun of Tetris with the deep city-building mechanics inspired by Foundations of Rome and Urban Sprawl. Every decision matters, and every choice shapes your bustling metropolis in this single-player, deck-building strategy game.
Key Features:
Card-Driven Strategy: Draw Permit, Plot, and Action Cards to drive your city planning. Use Permits to construct CIVIC, RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, and INDUSTRIAL buildings, each with unique combinations and synergies.
Tetris-Like Building Challenges: Place buildings of varying shapes on a grid-based city map. Master the puzzle-like placement rules to maximize your city’s layout.
Dynamic Scoring System: Every turn matters! Points are calculated based on the adjacency bonuses, and prestige is awarded for completing rows and columns with aligned building types. Find the perfect balance to maximize your city's prestige.
Action Cards for Dynamic Play: Unlock powerful abilities that can trigger throughout your turn—from gaining extra coins to free placements and lingering effects that last multiple rounds.
Deep Choices and Urgent Challenges: You’re racing against an ever-growing list of demands. Every time you end your turn, adversarial effects impact your city, keeping you on your toes and making each choice count.
Plot, build, strategize, and expand in Sprawl, a unique blend of deck-building strategy, puzzle-solving, and city-building. Your city’s success lies in your hands. Will you create the next metropolis or end up sprawled out?
Wishlist now and prepare to reshape the skyline!

title: ZOPHARION
description:
게임 정보
"엘리트 병사인 THORYN의 역할을 맡아, ZOPHARION 바이러스에 대한 연구를 맡고 있는 뛰어난 과학자 DR. ZYPHAR가 숨기고 있는 비밀을 밝혀내기 위한 임무를 시작하십시오."
바이러스는 연구소 승무원들을 괴물로 변하게 만듭니다. 누구도 안전하지 않으며, 바이러스의 확산 속도는 가공할 수준입니다. 괴물들과 자신의 두려움에 맞서 싸워야 하며, 당신의 결정은 연구소와 인류의 운명을 좌우하게 될 것입니다.

title: ThaumSmith
description:
게임 정보
Play as the beloved ThaumSmith, the master crafter behind every hero's success. Paladins, warlocks, rogues, and more depend on your expertise to forge powerful gear and brew life-saving potions. Equip them for epic quests, helping them grow stronger each day. As your crafting skills improve, you'll uncover the secrets of a world plagued by corrupted magic and hidden mysteries. You may not be the story's main character, but the fate of the town—and its heroes—rests in your hands!

title: Uciana
description:
게임 정보
Build a Spacefaring Empire in this 4X turn-based strategy game.

Explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate in Uciana, a turn-based strategy game set in a procedurally generated galaxy. Each playthrough brings fresh challenges with new star systems, events, alien races, and the unknown waiting to be discovered.

Strategically manage your empire's resources to thrive. Balance research, farming, and production to grow your systems while adapting to the ever-changing galaxy. Will you fortify your systems with defenses, or expand aggressively by building fleets to conquer and protect your growing empire?

Engage in tactical, turn-based ship-to-ship combat. Customize each ship with weapons, defenses, and components tailored to your strategy. Victory depends on careful planning and adapting to your role as leader.

Features:
Procedurally generated galaxy maps and systems for unique experience each time.
Ship customization.
Tactical turn-based combat.
Steam Cloud Saves for seamless play across devices.

title: EggRoyale
description:
게임 정보
Birds gather for a heartwarming battle over a giant egg!
Various types of birds engage in real-time combat, waging an intense struggle to claim the egg.
As the player, you’ll command your bird army, defending your base’s egg from incoming enemies.
Strategically position your units based on their strengths and the terrain to maximize your defense.
Protect the egg until the time runs out to secure victory.
Enjoy the adorable yet determined efforts of the birds as you lead your allies to triumph!
The birds’ ambitions take flight over the mysterious “BigEgg”…
One day, a massive egg called “BigEgg” suddenly appeared in the park.
“The bird that hatches this egg will rule over all birds.”
This rumor spread among the birds, sparking an intense scramble to claim the egg—a true bird battle!
Experience authentic real-time strategy with simple controls!
Position your forces, set attack targets, and establish defensive lines—all with easy controls!
All you need is one button!
Master unit synergies and unleash special skills for a dramatic comeback!
With dynamic changes in battle depending on the birds' compatibility and positioning, enjoy deep and strategic gameplay.
Turn the tide of battle with devastating skills and aim for a miraculous comeback!
Endless Defense Mode
Test your endurance in Endless Mode, where you compete to see how long you can defend.
Push your limits and aim for a spot on the global leaderboard!
Battle Mode

In a dystopian future dominated by artificial intelligence, humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. Machines, led by the supreme AI “Axis”, fight for control of Erythonite, a revolutionary mineral fueling the war. You are Spyro, an elite combat drone tasked with a critical mission: secure Erythonite deposits, eliminate human defenses, and ensure machine dominance.

Key Features:
Total Destruction: Use fully destructible environments to break through barricades, fortifications, and enemy turrets.
Strategic Open-World: Explore a mountainous terrain, discover Erythonite deposits, and plan your moves to outsmart enemies.
Conquer and Defend: Capture human refineries and fortify your bases to fend off enemy raids.  
Intense Combat: Pilot Spyro and face fighter jets, tanks, turrets, and helicopters in relentless battles. 
Customization and Upgrades: Equip Spyro with devastating weaponry, from Gatling guns to plasma cannons and guided missiles.  
Deadly Support: Collaborate with ”Pyramid”, a massive airborne unit providing logistical aid, and deploy powerful tanks to crush even the toughest defenses.

Game Modes:
Single-Player Campaign: Immerse yourself in a story of war, sacrifice, and strategy as you delve into the conflict between humans and machines.  
Multiplayer: Challenge other players in thrilling battles with **Battle Royale** or Survival-Coop modes, where teamwork is key to victory.  

Prepare for War. 
Every shot leaves a mark, every decision shapes the battlefield. 
Axis has a plan, you are its weapon. 
Take control of Spyro and lead the machine revolution.

title: Block Sprawl
description:
게임 정보
Block Sprawl: A City Planner Deck Builder
Build your dream city from the ground up! Sprawl combines the classic, strategic fun of Tetris with the deep city-building mechanics inspired by Foundations of Rome and Urban Sprawl. Every decision matters, and every choice shapes your bustling metropolis in this single-player, deck-building strategy game.
Key Features:
Card-Driven Strategy: Draw Permit, Plot, and Action Cards to drive your city planning. Use Permits to construct CIVIC, RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, and INDUSTRIAL buildings, each with unique combinations and synergies.
Tetris-Like Building Challenges: Place buildings of varying shapes on a grid-based city map. Master the puzzle-like placement rules to maximize your city’s layout.
Dynamic Scoring System: Every turn matters! Points are calculated based on the adjacency bonuses, and prestige is awarded for completing rows and columns with aligned building types. Find the perfect balance to maximize your city's prestige.
Action Cards for Dynamic Play: Unlock powerful abilities that can trigger throughout your turn—from gaining extra coins to free placements and lingering effects that last multiple rounds.
Deep Choices and Urgent Challenges: You’re racing against an ever-growing list of demands. Every time you end your turn, adversarial effects impact your city, keeping you on your toes and making each choice count.
Plot, build, strategize, and expand in Sprawl, a unique blend of deck-building strategy, puzzle-solving, and city-building. Your city’s success lies in your hands. Will you create the next metropolis or end up sprawled out?
Wishlist now and prepare to reshape the skyline!

title: Uciana

Strategically manage your empire's resources to thrive. Balance research, farming, and production to grow your systems while adapting to the ever-changing galaxy. Will you fortify your systems with defenses, or expand aggressively by building fleets to conquer and protect your growing empire?

Procedurally generated galaxy maps and systems for unique experience each time.
Ship customization.
Tactical turn-based combat.
Steam Cloud Saves for seamless play across devices.

title: Towers Heritage

Tower defense game revisiting the genre for both gamers nostalgic of the old sweet TD days and newcomers.
Defend your kingdom, customize your towers and play online or offline in this tribute to the Tower Defense genre.

title: Scent of Clouds
description:
게임 정보
You've always known that your keen sense of smell is your greatest talent. However, you're a doe which makes the art of perfumery not exactly the most traditional profession for your kind. Luckily, you've found a mentor who couldn't care less about societal pressures and has taken you under her wing. After two years of working as her assistant, you're now ready to create fragrances on your own. Yet, you don't expect just how deep the waters will be...
The most important sense in the animal kingdom is the sense of smell, particularly here on the Palent planet, where it plays a key role in communication, camouflage, healing, and many other essential functions. Palent is predominantly inhabited by highly intelligent animals, whose level of technological development resembles that of the 18th- to 19th-century Earth. Peace has long prevailed here, but recent rumors speak of unknown species of lizards disrupting the established order. Where have they come from?

title: Five More Minutes

Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos!
Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.
Each genre has its own set of unique cards, keepsakes, and strategies. Level up your character to gain more actions, health, and collect powerful mementos from your gaming adventures.

title: Mystic Resistance

Customize your build with an arsenal of unique weapons and power-ups, and harness the game's unique planetary perspective to outmaneuver your enemies and turn the tide of battle. How long can you last against the cosmic onslaught?
You are a skilled bounty hunter with a powerful tank, hired by planets desperate to reclaim their land from invaders. Your mission: exterminate the monstrous threats and make the planets habitable for settlers.
For every monster you eliminate, you earn a bounty, which can be used to upgrade your weapons, tank, and abilities—allowing you to tackle even greater challenges and amass even greater rewards.

Rotten Forgotten: A Whimsical Farm Revival Adventure.
Gather your friends and embark on a delightful agricultural escapade in Rotten Forgotten, a charming cooperative farming game for 1-4 players. Your once-thriving family barn teeters on the brink of bankruptcy, and it's up to you and your companions to breathe new life into the dilapidated homestead.
Cultivate a variety of quirky crops, tend to your eclectic menagerie of farm animals, and race against time to fulfill orders and save your beloved barn from financial ruin. With a perfect blend of strategy, teamwork, and lighthearted fun, Rotten Forgotten is perfect for playing with friends.
Co-op!
Engaging co-op gameplay for solo farmers or groups of up to four players. Play with keyboard and/or controllers.
Challenging time management as you juggle crop cycles and animal care.
Plant!

title: On Roads Between
description:
게임 정보
On Roads Between is currently in ALPHA and will not be released until complete. Free demos will be available forever but will have limited cross-play with the final game.
Monsters are attacking New Zealand, and the newspaper is paying good money for photos. Grab a camera, a couple mates and your high-school car, to be the first to capitalize on it.
On Roads Between is a co-op horror game set in 1980s New Zealand with a unique papercraft art-style. Drive anywhere from the top of the North Island to the bottom of the South to capture anomalies and Lovecraftian horrors on fresh film.
On Roads Between features a massive map (won't be in demo, still squashing bugs,) where you can drive from town to town. Restock and replenish your items in the small towns before venturing out into the native bush to get paid. Keep your car topped up and repaired, just in case you need a quick getaway.
You can drive almost anywhere, and where you can't, you can hike. Keep in mind that you drop your items when you die, so don't go too far from you camp.
Camps are how you respawn friends, save progress and pass the time. This is the 1980s, so you have to pass time by playing instruments, sports and maybe a few pranks on your friends. Remember, time flies when you're having fun.
Soon enough, night will fall. And with it, monsters and anomalies will be more common. Get your cameras ready, and hope you have enough spare film to catch them all. And don't worry if a Scuttler or a Merchant takes you out. You can still help your friends from beyond the grave.
With your new found dough, put together the slickest outfit you can. Stick stickers all over your character to build a unique look. Yes, I know what you guys will do with this feature, and you can disable seeing other's custom costumes. Please don't make me regret adding this.
Also, I am going to look into making the stickers tradable, with a foil and aging system. Keep an eye out for rare stickers, because you might be the only one in the world to have it.

title: Cryptage

게임 정보

In theory, on top of this geometric minimalist basic graphics style, players can flexibly customize over 500 combinations of graphics styles and choose the most suitable one to play the game, in order to create a unique challenge experience!

title: Esper Agent
description:
게임 정보
Esper Agent is a game about esper secret agents, where a group of girls from an agency receive a mission to infiltrate the cities of a large corporation and stop their evil plans.
Players can choose one of several unique agent girls to take part in the mission. During the game, you'll need to dodge waves of enemy bullets while attacking and using special abilities to defeat enemies and reach the goal.
Shooting Mechanics
Players can choose a weapon for combat. As you progress, you'll collect various parts to modify your weapon, increasing its damage or enhancing its effects. Each weapon has different bullet capacity limits and reload times, so you’ll need to manage reload windows carefully to maximize your damage output.
Mastering Your Abilities
To advance and thwart the corporation's conspiracy, players must grow stronger step by step by leveraging their agent’s abilities and weapons. This includes using genetic chips to enhance your powers, weapon parts to improve your arsenal, and skill rings to adapt to different situations.
Infiltration Missions
The route you choose for each infiltration will affect the journey ahead. By selecting the most relevant paths and exploring for rewards, you’ll increase your chances of successfully reaching the final destination.

title: Spin & Jump
description:

슬롯머신을 중심으로 한 게임으로, 모든 행동이 슬롯머신에 의해 결정됩니다!
캐릭터의 다음 행동, 몬스터에게 입히는 피해, 얻는 전리품!
