title: Camille and Laura
description:
게임 정보
Camille and Laura is a short narrative game about the daily life of a single mother.
It’s Camille’s first week of elementary school, one of the most important weeks in someone's life. Take the role of Laura, Camille’s mother, as she tries her best to be an exemplary mother for her small family. Navigate your work environment, do daily chores, and try as you might to raise your kid the best way you can.
Camille and Laura is an honest look at the realities of life and daily struggles. Solo developed and inspired by children shows, I wanted to make a game that could be both filled with fun, childish excitement, while recognizing the extreme isolation and grind of adult life.
This a short narrative game that will take under an hour and a half to complete.

title: You're a dad
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a text adventure about becoming a father! Get up, take care of your child, buy groceries, prepare dinner. Do nothing else. Repeat every day, because...
... You're a dad!
This is your child. It is your job to make sure he thrives, or at least survives. You can go skating, imaginary monster hunting, or just sleep the day away. The game reacts to your actions, so it really is possible. But should you?
(No, you shouldn't. Make good choices, okay?)
Navigate through all the endings!
Your family is coming for dinner. So not only do you have to be a dad - you also need to make food. You can make food. It's not that hard. Don't get lost in day dreams, going camping or starting a cat café. If your child starts reading philosophy, nip that in the bud before they get a PHD.

title: Permanent: Hope & Vacuum
description:
게임 정보
«Permanent: Hope & Vacuum» is a disturbing first-person psychological horror indie game with adventure, puzzle, platformer, dungeon crawler and action gameplay.

This is a one-person development, so please let me introduce the game to you. Thanks!



Discover a story that will take you through a world that is as terrifying as it is intriguing, where you will encounter numerous obstacles and irrational challenges that will test your skills as a player.



Your main objective is to unravel the mystery behind your memory loss and discover all about the strange world you have woken up in after a long and surreal fall.

To do this, you'll have to defeat creatures called «Reks», solve all sorts of puzzles, overcome dungeons, use platforming mechanics, and face a variety of disturbing situations that will always leave you with more questions than answers.



Fortunately, with the help of the , you will have access to various special abilities to defend yourself, control fire, alter gravity... These skills are acquired throughout the game and will help you fight the and progress on your journey.

"But remember, is the only thing that matters. In , is more than a word. It is the very life of the character, the key to his entire story, and also the currency for obtaining documents from the that will help you better understand the LORE of the world.

Your adventure begins as you fall down a sort of energy cliff until you land in a room straight out of your worst nightmares.



From this point on, you'll be alone and confused, but unfortunately for you, .

.



It's best not to give too much away so that you can discover it for yourself, but the subtly and progressively told story will always keep you guessing, and when it's all over (if it ends) you'll understand why .














"Hi, I'm David Oliver, the only member of DOgames, a new indie studio based in Madrid (Spain) and the developer of . I'd like to introduce you to the amazing 3D fantasy world I'm creating with all my love and passion.



As an old-school gamer, I have always dreamt of creating a game capable of transporting players to another world and etching the experience in their gamer memory.

I'm working on every aspect of the game with care and attention to detail. From the puzzles, to the soundtrack, to every hidden corner, ensuring that every player will have an unforgettable experience.

I am excited to share that the project has been in full development for around a year now, but I need all the help I can get to fully realise the plans I have defined. Any kind of collaboration will be greatly appreciated; together we can make this game even more special!

title: Silicon Wasteland
description:
게임 정보
Following a worldwide catastrophe, a lone android wakes up years later to the wind and rain of the quiet apocalypse. Damaged, low on power, and having limited memories, she sets out into the nearby ruined city in search of answers.

SILICON WASTELAND is a kinetic visual novel set during the twilight years of humanity, and follows the wandering android Silica, as she explores the beautiful and sometimes frightening wonders of the world in a small quest to discover her purpose.

Featuring music from the creators of the Tunic Soundtrack, Lifeformed and Janice Kwan, as well as music from WastedMeerkat and Vidboy.

title: HYPERFATAL
description:
게임 정보
HYPERFATAL is a fast-paced old school FPS that combines the explosive action of movement shooters with unique mechanics similar to Quake and popular Source engine games.

An ancient interdimensional army known as the Goonabites have been disturbed by unknown forces, and are invading countless worlds. In a last ditch attempt against the masses, the last dwellers of the known universe have unleashed Project HYPER, an experimental cyborg soldier with unmatched speed, brutality, and abilities to face those who wish to destroy all of creation. Time is running out... show them that your existence will be FATAL


Use movement mechanics such as Rocket Jumping, Air Strafing, and Surfing to traverse environments quickly and dodge the relentless attacks of enemies.

With an emphasis on Push-Forward combat, kill enemies to gain charges for health and for Hyper Abilities, powerful tools to aid you in combat efficiency.

title: POWER CRISIS
description:
게임 정보
POWER CRISIS is an unnerving puzzle/resource-management game, where you have nothing but your mind, a light, and your superhuman electrical abilities to help you avoid obstacles, ward off enemies, and progress between test chambers.


As you progress, you'll need to interact with special components-- plenty of which need to be powered by your stored electricity.


For some chambers, you're given constant access to a generator, which you can use to charge up. Oftentimes though, your ability to access this generator is limited.


While a misuse of power could mean nothing more than a slight time loss, there is another problem that can arise...


Bee, the player character, is deeply afraid of the dark. And, seeing what lies within it, you won't blame them.
First, being in the dark for too long will cause Bee to panic, giving you a slight setback on time.


But, more pressing, you're not alone-- and you'll wish you were. Your light is your only weapon against the creatures that live within the dark.

Of course, beyond survival, there is one more reason you'll want to be efficient with your power usage...


This mission isn't without consequences. The world depends on you, and as such, you need to prove you're up for the task. Once your test officially begins, your Power Rating score will continuously decrement. Each time you're knocked out, you will also face a penalty to this score.


The higher the score you have by the end, the better grade you will receive. If your score reaches 0, your mission will end. Speaking of which.


You've been tasked with something you've been training for your entire life-- the preparation of a mysterious new power source, which should be powerful enough to save humanity from a new, incoming apocalypse. On your mission, you will have to use your power and your wits to interact with different mechanisms to ultimately allow you to progress. With a handful of different components to work with, you will constantly have to learn how new mechanisms work and interact with one another. In this mission, your quick thinking is your only lifeline.

title: Meowmentum
description:
게임 정보
Meowmentum is a first-person speedrunning platformer in which you must finish speed trials as fast as possible to become a full-fledged catmage! 🐈🧙‍♂️ What are you waiting for? Go get your name on the leaderboards MEOW~!



Use your newly-found powers of Meowmentum and harness the potential of paw-kour! Run on walls, slide down ramps, and dash through magic orbs to keep going faster!





Prove yourself worthy by completing the Elder Catmages' speed trials! Discover secret shortcuts and movement techniques as you paw through each trial!





Collect meow-zmerizing medals and race against Catmages all around the world! Will you dominate the leaderboards and become a master of Meowmentum?





Hello! We are a team of 5 indie developers (+ 4 audio collaborators) aiming to create the best magical cat speedrunner in existence! We sincerely hope you enjoy our game, in whatever capacity it may be. Wanna chat with us? JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER!! Thank you <3

title: Dark & Quispy
description:
게임 정보
다크 앤 퀴스피(Dark and Quispy)는 2.5D 종이 같은 비주얼을 특징으로 한 로그라이크 생존 게임입니다.
어둠과 위험으로 뒤덮인 세상, 불길한 피의 달이 땅을 뒤덮으며 악의적인 빛을 발합니다. 그게 나쁜 일이라는 걸 짐작할 수 있을 겁니다.
네, 맞습니다... 특히 메인 플레임(Main Flame)에게는요.
최근 피의 달이 뜨면서 등장한 수많은 생명체들에 의해 그녀는 끊임없이 공격을 받았고, 그녀의 영혼을 잃었습니다! 그녀의 본질이 벗겨지고 영혼들이 사방으로 흩어지며, 그녀는 존재의 끝자락에 서게 됩니다.
소울 플레임(Soul Flame) 사람들의 수호자로서 당신의 임무가 시작됩니다. 오직 어둠의 심연으로 뛰어들어 치열한 적들과 싸우고 메인 플레임의 잃어버린 영혼들을 되찾아야만 세상의 균형을 회복할 수 있습니다!
무기
적들을 어떻게든 물리쳐야 합니다! 강력한 무기로 무장하여 적들을 물리치고 가능한 오래 생존하세요. 쓰러뜨린 적에게서 소울 플레임을 수집해 무기를 업그레이드하고 무기를 더 강력하게 만드세요!

title: A Byte War
description:
게임 정보

Byte War는 실시간 전략 게임으로 다른 차원에서 온 기계의 위협에 맞서 블록 기반 기계 종족을 이끌게 됩니다.블록으로 기지를 건설하고 패턴을 형성하여 건물을 지어 자원 수확, 유닛 스폰, 영향력 확장 등 필요한 사항을 커버하세요.적을 정복하고, 영향력을 확장하여 지도를 지배하거나 자신의 땅에서 버티며 적이 방어를 뚫고 들어오지 못하게 하는 것까지, 다양한 엔딩이 있는 임무에서 자신만의 길을 찾아보세요.



Byte War에서는 기본적인 건물 블록인 블록을 지을 능력이 있습니다.타일 기반 격자에 여러 패턴으로 지어서 특정한 모양과 기능을 갖춘 건물을 만드세요.특정 모양의 블록을 사용하여 퍼즐 조각처럼 배치하여 상상한 대로 자신만의 기지를 만드세요.

각 건물은 꼭대기의 조종 장치로 제어됩니다.예:
- 본부는 주요 건물로 특정 활성화 스킬 조종 장치를 가지고 있습니다.
- 자원 수확기는 스폰 및 자동 수확 조종 장치를 가지고 있습니다.
- 유닛 스포너는 유닛을 특정 목적지로 보내는 조종 장치를 가지고 있습니다

이 필수 건물을 지으려면 블록을 특정 패턴으로 배열해야 합니다.각각 전략 옵션을 강화하는 고유한 기능을 선보이는 어려운 임무에 걸쳐 진행해 나아가며 새로운 패턴과 건물 기능을 잠금 해제하세요.



영향력을 확장하는 것은 주변 지역을 장악하는 데 있어 중요한 메커니즘 중 하나입니다.여러분의 영향력은 영구적인 영향력 스팟을 생성하는 본부부터 시작되며, 도달 범위를 전략적으로 계속 확장하려면 영향력 확산기를 배치하여 주변 지역에 대한 지배력을 강화하세요.

여러분의 영향력 아래에 있는 지역은 다음과 같은 큰 이점을 제공합니다.
- 기지가 제대로 작동되도록 유지합니다
- 피해를 당한 유닛을 치유합니다.
- 무기화하여 적 건물을 비활성화하고 적 유닛에게 피해를 줄 수 있습니다
- 새로운 자원 매장물을 생성합니다
- 지도의 기존 매장물을 변환합니다

하지만 조심하세요. 적이 자신의 영향력을 사용하여 반격할 수 있으니까요.



모든 임무에서 자신만의 길을 선택하여 고유한 여정과 결과를 만들어 내세요.

본 게임은 다양한 임무 유형을 제공하며 각각 구별되는 도전 과제와 전략 목표를 선사합니다.압도적인 적 부대에게서 달아나거나, 생존하기 위해 무자비한 침략을 물리치거나, 우격다짐으로 적 영토를 정복하거나, 자신의 영향력을 확장하여 지형을 지배하는 자신을 보게 될 것입니다.
각 임무 유형은 여러 후속 임무로 갈라져 나가며 특정 엔딩으로 종결되는 다양한 길로 이끕니다.

title: How West Clement Was Kinda Won
description:
게임 정보
A drifter finds themselves in a town that is knee deep in a dire situation. The town is going to be taken over by a big ol' company! And you just so happened to arrive right on time to help out these citizens in need!
Play through 4 chapters of that shows the best of Clement County!
Turn-based combat with up to 3 other NPC companions that you love so very much!
Also those companions I was talking about? There's more than 20 of them you could unlock!
Multiple areas in one of the dumbest parts of the world!
Build your character by leveling up, eating pizza, drinking soda and frickin' fighting!
Fight enemies like feral zombies, construction workers, crocodile dudes and other bad things!
Amazing special attacks like Vomit, Super Kick, Skull Crack and MP3 Player!
Everything, art and code, hand-made with love!!!
autokwd: How West Clement Was Kinda Won

title: Superstellar
description:
게임 정보
Superstellar offers a fresh take on the survivor genre with its advanced stat synergies, extensive build diversity and crucial player choice. Roam endless space and engage in frantic combat with responsive, racing-like movement. Complete missions and milestones to unlock new spaceships, each equipped with new weapons and exclusive upgrade choices. Choose your upgrades wisely and fight to stay alive as long as possible against hordes of pesky enemies! Runs typically last about 20 minutes, but skilled players might endure a bit longer.

How long can you survive?
⚔️ Gameplay & Combat
Endless battles – Survive as long as possible in a randomly generated space environment.
Massive enemy waves – Face over 500 enemies at once!
Three enemy territories – Each with unique enemies, events and challenges.
Dynamic events - Adapt to hazards like solar flares, asteroid belts, darkness, and radiation!
All out war – A randomized brutal mode that combines all enemy territories into one.
🚀 Ships & Classes
🌀 Orion – Energy and electricity-based, specializing in electrocution.
🔥 Phoenix – Fire-based, focused on igniting and burning enemies.
❄️ Titan – Ice and summoner-based, capable of chilling, freezing, and shattering foes.
Each ship boasts a game-changing ultimate ability aswell, and comes in light, medium, and heavy armored variants with different stats and ability enhancements.

title: Gatestodian
description:
게임 정보
Defend the Gates from a demonic invasion and become a hero!
Your mission is to protect the Gates that hold back endless hordes of demons, eager to break through and destroy the peaceful inhabitants of the kingdom. In this epic battle, you will be guided by a wise mentor — an old warrior whose advice will lead you to victory against overwhelming forces.
Choose one of four unique heroes, each with their own style of combat and abilities. Upgrade and enhance your chosen hero's skills to adapt to the ever-growing threats and discover new strategies to combat the terrifying forces of evil.
Key Features:
Four Unique Heroes: Each hero has their own playstyle and skill set. Choose the one that best suits your strategy and master their abilities.
Advice from a Wise Mentor: A seasoned veteran will offer you valuable guidance that may turn the tide of battle… but should you always follow his advice?
Upgrade System: Develop your hero, improve their abilities, and create your own unique build to face the most dangerous enemies.
Epic Battles Against Demons: Prepare for intense battles where every decision, skill, and upgrade can change the course of the fight.
Are you ready to stop the demons and save the kingdom? The fate of the world is in your hands!

title: Curry Princess GOLD
description:
게임 정보
A casual game where you collect falling spices, earn gold, and cook delicious curry.
Enjoy three different game modes:
Classic Mode: An endless score-attack challenge, a remastered version of Curry Princess originally released for iOS/Android in 2018, now reimagined for console with enhanced gameplay.
Story Mode: Unfold an engaging story as you progress through episodes.
2P Mode: Play local two-player content. Compete against each other for victory, or work together to overcome the Curry Master's trials—it's up to you!
These three modes offer a variety of ways to play!

title: Void Protocol
description:
게임 정보
Void Protocol is an immersive first-person exploration game that makes you explore not the past, but the future! As the protagonist, you will stop all the experiments that are turning people into robots and save the world, but they are not only turning people into robots...

title: Dusty Dunes Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
Jump into the world of Dusty Dunes Tycoon!
A VR Dropper-Style Gemstone Tycoon game where you unlock and upgrade different droppers to maximize gem productivity and unlock different locations you can explore. The player is stationed within a Minecart equipped with a UI that allows interaction with and travel across the world that surrounds you. You're able to boost dropper production by upgrading different dropper components, aiding by manually clicking with the dropper, or by using esoteric scrolls you find to buff certain droppers or by applying other effects.

title: Planeturem
description:
게임 정보
Explore a procedurally generated planet filled with resources to harvest - with a variety of biomes and creatures to discover. Encounter structures containing potentially rare items, from materials to craft new items, to a brand new piece of armour, or maybe even something to lure evil towards you?
Build your base to protect yourself and fight off calamitous beasts - if successful, you may have the ingredients to construct a new weapon!

title: Curation
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of museum management! Build, customise, and expand your dream museum into a place of science and history, wonder and mystery in this award-winning casual building/management sim!
As the architect, designer, and curator, it’s your job to transform an empty plot of land into a cultural landmark. Create an unforgettable experience for your NPC visitors by selecting, buying, and placing artefacts throughout your new museum. If they have a great time, they might even donate a little cash before heading out!
Build, expand, customise
Design your museum from the ground up! Drag out walls and create uniquely shaped rooms to give your museum a one-of-a-kind layout. A range of customisation options means you can expand and modify your building, tailoring each room for the ultimate visitor experience.
Collect & Display Unique Artefacts

title: Bearstone Campsite
description:
게임 정보
Bearstone Campsite is a first-person horror game that follows the journey of our character who goes missing during a camping trip.
Maria, Paul, and Nathan should have never gone without you. It’s absurd they thought they could manage without the only sensible person in the group. But could they, really? Your friends are out there, desperate, waiting for you to come back.
Now, witness their story. You left them to this fate.
You’ve always been cautious... or maybe just a coward. But this time, what are you going to do?

title: Emberhold
description:
게임 정보
Explore and defend a fantasy kingdom in the skies!
Emberhold is a bastion of hope for the people of Astria, one that has long been in slumber. With your help, the fires of the guilds and trade will awaken anew to battle the tides of evil lurking at it's borders! Work together with allies to reclaim lost territory and quell the warring factions. Rebuild your bastion to defend against the nightmares that lie beyond the fog and below the mists.
Experiment with varying playstyles
Outfit your party the way you want! Your characters can fight with a sword and shield, wield magic, or use a gun; your party composition is yours to decide how best to take on the challenges that await.
Collect, repair, craft, and expand
Gather resources and find unique items on your adventures to restore the Emberhold to it's former glory! Craft equipment at the forge to outfit your party before you set out so that you're ready to face even the strongest foes.
Face off against challenging enemies
Use strategy and skill to take down enemies in a variety of encounters. Even the simplest of foes can pose a threat in large numbers. Take your party and challenge powerful bosses in uniquely phased fights.

title: Sky Fields
description:
게임 정보
Sky Fields에 오신 것을 환영합니다
드론이 되어 Sky Fields를 탐험하고, 떠 있는 다양한 섬을 여행하며 슬라임 컬렉션을 확장하세요. 다양한 슬라임 속이 가득한 독특한 환경을 탐험하면서 싸우고, 자원과 원시 슬라임을 수집하여 새로운 슬라임을 부화시키고 키우세요. 각 슬라임은 고유한 외모, 강점, 희귀성을 지니고 있습니다!
각 섬의 고도는 만날 수 있는 슬라임을 결정하고, 환경 자체를 변화시켜 나무, 식물, 동물군을 형성합니다. 이는 모든 전투에 전략적 깊이를 더하며, 각 발견을 흥미롭고 예측할 수 없는 경험으로 만듭니다.
특징:
탐험
Sky Fields의 세계로 날아가 다양한 섬과 생태계를 넘나들며 탐험하세요. 그러나 조심하세요 — 폭군 군대가 황량한 땅에 숨어 있습니다! 그들에게 맞설 수 있나요? 강화된 성소를 탐험하고, 위험한 섬을 정복하며, 여행 중에 귀중한 자원을 모으세요.
전투 및 레벨업
턴제 전투에서 전략적으로 공격 순서를 정하세요. 다양한 팀 조합을 시도하고 슬라임 간의 시너지를 활용하세요. 근접 전투 유닛 뒤에 지원 유닛과 마법사를 배치하여 이상적인 배치를 만드세요. 강력한 적을 만나고, 레벨업하여 팀을 강화하세요.
나만의 슬라임 만들기!

title: Consortium's Fall: Echoes of Xo'lara
description:
게임 정보
Consortium’s Fall is a sci-fi roguelite twin-stick shooter about a lone hero’s fight against his people’s oppressor. Infiltrate the three bases of the Stellar Consortium, fight the grunts and bosses that guard them, growing stronger with upgrades and weapons you pick up along the way - all while uncovering knowledge and secrets of long gone past. With every new run, you will master the very elements the enemy seeks to exploit. Bring about the Consortium’s fall, no matter what it takes.

You are Zyx, a Cilian scholar compelled to infiltrate the tyrannical Stellar Consortium in the name of his people and home planet, Zolareus. Zolareus is home to an abundance of Eternum, a powerful component the Consortium uses in their relentless pursuit of galactic dominance. If nothing is done, the Stellar Consortium will suck Zolareus dry and secure your people as one of their pawns.

Will you persevere and fight back, before it’s too late? On your journey throughout the enemy’s territory, you will encounter mysterious pillars with messages from ancient times. Decode their scripture to gain better understanding, and uncover knowledge that will help you in your rebellion!

title: Hallway Shot
description:
게임 정보
Halls that loop forever. You are given tools to break out of the loop but can you truly escape? Hallway shot is what happens when you condense a survival horror game into an extremely long hallway.
Five Halls are randomized with a new hall only replacing an old one when a solution is found. Search through furniture for useful items. Halls will be full of random puzzles, enemies, friends, and a variety of other things. In Hallway Shot you find items, solve puzzles, and escape monsters to solve every hall and eventually leave the hallway. Even if you can't figure out a hall's puzzle, there are numerous alternative solutions that let you remove it from the loop and try to solve it again later.

title: Shadowbridge - The Genesis
description:
게임 정보
In Shadowbridge: The Genesis, you step into a rich fantasy world in this immersive point-and-click adventure. As Ezra's ally, you'll travel through a series of diverse and intricately designed dimensions, each with its own unique landscapes, challenges, and threats. Your mission; to solve the enigmatic puzzles scattered across these realms and uncover the secrets behind the sudden collapse of the Balance Dimension.
Explore strange, fantastical worlds teeming with hidden clues, ancient mysteries, and treacherous obstacles. With each dimension you traverse, you’ll encounter peculiar inhabitants, cryptic messages, and intricate riddles that will test your wits. Can you decipher the secrets that hold these worlds together and help Ezra bring peace to Shadowbridge once again? Every choice you make and puzzle you solve brings you one step closer to restoring the balance or plunging the dimensions into eternal chaos.
Prepare for an unforgettable journey through mind-bending landscapes, where your puzzle-solving skills and keen observation will be key to saving the dimensions from destruction. Will you rise to the challenge and become a true guardian of balance?"

title: Monad Tachyon
description:
게임 정보
Monad Tachyon is a high-speed Metroidvania game where you can experience action that breaks the sound barrier.
Enter a world teeming with strange insect creatures. Guided by a mysterious silver-haired girl, you embark on an unknown journey into the depths of this realm.
Features
Exciting, fast-paced action with simple controls: Accumulate acceleration to increase your attack power.
Unique story and cutscenes
Classic Metroidvania exploration

title: Decomposition
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Decomposition is a psychological horror game focused on survival, where every choice can mean life or death. You control Lucy, a young woman who, after a traumatic event, finds herself on the run from the Dawnbringers, a shadowy cult willing to do anything to fulfill their apocalyptic prophecy.
Encounter oppressive environments such as the Dandelion Mansion and an abandoned Amusement Park, solving puzzles, traversing mazes and facing masked enemies. With limited resources such as axes, pistols and flashlights, you must carefully manage your tools as you brave the unknown and search for answers.
Key Features:
Intense Exploration: Immerse yourself in dark and detailed environments full of secrets and traps.
Challenging Survival: Manage ammunition and supplies while facing constant dangers.
Immersive Storytelling: Discover the truth behind the cult and Lucy's connection to the apocalyptic events.
Intriguing puzzles: Solve puzzles that require logic and attention to detail.
Claustrophobic atmosphere: Feel the tension of every step in cramped and oppressive environments.
Prepare to fight for survival and uncover dark secrets before the Dawn Gate opens. The fate of Lucy, her father, and the world depends on you.

title: Star Watch
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview
Star Watch is a casual game combining elements of "light-action shooting" and "creature care and management." Players take on the role of the Star Watch commander, leading a squad of unique monsters to fight against the evil alien invaders—the Cows, and reclaim the occupied planets and their precious relics!
Game Features
20 Unique Monsters: Each monster has distinct abilities and appearances, allowing players to freely form their own custom squads.
6 Major Planet Levels: Explore planets with unique environmental challenges, each featuring a powerful BOSS with special abilities.
Easy-to-Learn Controls: All actions are performed by simple clicks, making the game accessible to players of all ages.
Diverse Strategy Choices: Combine turret controls with carefully selected monster abilities to fend off enemies, adapting strategies to different planetary environments.
Planet Relic Collection: Defeat the final BOSS on each planet to reclaim valuable relics, enhancing your monster squad for future battles.
Gameplay
Players will need to raise monsters and manage resources to expand their influence across the galaxy. When enemies attack, players must skillfully operate turrets and unleash special monster abilities to fend off the invading Cows while protecting their squad. After each level, players can earn rewards to upgrade their monsters and technologies, further strengthening their forces for tougher challenges ahead.
company: 鈴夢有限公司, 赤腳蛙工作室

title: BACKROOMS INSIDE THE ESCAPE
description:
게임 정보
Venture through a labyrinth of seemingly endless, creepily familiar corridors based on popular Creepypasta lore. Experience the terror with high-quality graphics that bring the eerie environment to life, and envelop yourself in a soundscape of detailed 3D audio that enhances every haunting whisper and distant footstep. The atmosphere is thick with dread, filled with puzzles that challenge the mind and screamers that test your resolve, ensuring a pulse-pounding journey into the unknown.
High-Quality Graphics – Immerse yourself in an environment where every detail is crafted to enhance the horror.
Detailed 3D Audio – Every sound is designed to amplify the suspense and immerse you deeper into the game.
Creepy Atmosphere – The constant, oppressive dread is carefully maintained to keep you on edge.
Challenging Puzzles – Test your wits with intricate puzzles that integrate seamlessly into the narrative.
Effective Screamers – Prepare for heart-stopping moments that are sure to keep the adrenaline pumping.

title: RedSoul 红色之魂
description:
게임 정보
Red Soul is a high-difficulty action RPG focused on precise combat and hardcore challenges. With weapon switching and firearm counterattack mechanics, you'll face powerful enemies and experience life-or-death battles.
Key Features:
Weapon Switching: Choose between a swift sword or a heavy greatsword based on enemy status. The sword is quick for fast strikes, while the greatsword delivers devastating damage.
Firearm Counterattack: Use precise timing to counter enemy attacks with your firearm, shifting the tide of battle.
Hardcore Combat: Every fight requires precise control; enemies and bosses have varied attack patterns that demand quick adaptation.
Intense Levels: Levels filled with traps and ambushes offer extreme challenges.
In Red Soul, failure is an opportunity for growth, and victory belongs to true warriors. Are you ready to face the challenge?

title: What the Hell I Draw
description:
게임 정보
Draw according to the instructions
Admire your creations
Try to guess as early as possible

title: Adventures of Carson: Fractured Continuum
description:
게임 정보
Step into a shattered solar system in Adventures Of Carson: Fractured Continuum, a 2D rogue-lite action-platformer. Take advantage of an expansive array of weapons and abilities as you fight through constantly changing planets devastated by space and time in the Infractus Tempestas system. Die and face the most dangerous enemy, yourself.
An Ever-changing array of planets with a new adventure awaiting each time you play.
The Infractus Tempestas system is an ever changing solar system where each playthrough begets a new adventure. Each time you fall to an enemy a new 2D world awaits you. But, beware the haunting visage of your fallen self awaits you where you perished.
Caught In a Time-loop, Carson cannot die.
The Adventures of Carson: Fractured Continuum follows Carson. The brave explorer who must discover why time and space has been fractured in the Infractus Tempestas system. Each time Carson fails in his mission he is sent back in time to the moment he entered the solar system. Carson may die, but he keeps his abilities and skills he learns before his death. Making him more and more dangerous with each death he suffers.
Fighting to the death is better with a friend.
Time and space is fractured in the Infractus Tempestas system. Carsons from an infinite amount of universes are there to aid you in your fight to save the system. Invite your friends to help you on your journey where they can fight side-by-side with you. Be careful though, your friends can do just as much damage to you as they can the enemy. Choose your friends wisely.
Take advantage of the environment to defeat foes.
Use the ever-changing landscape to your advantage to defeat enemies using fallen trees, loose boulders, or even shallow pools of water. 
Difficult, but rewarding souls-like combat.
Your enemy is faster and stronger than you, but with enough skill and even more deaths you will become strong enough to vanquish your enemy.

title: Lost Soul
description:
게임 정보
Backstory
On a stormy night, a lightning bolt struck a tree, and electricity quickly spread across the ground. In an instant, scattered bones on the ground came to life. The skeletal figure slowly rose, shaky yet aware, as it became a creature with consciousness. However, it couldn't remember anything about its past.
In search of its lost memories, this nameless skeleton sets out on a journey of exploration and adventure.
Game Features
Exploration
The skeleton awakens on a mysterious island filled with unknown areas, waiting for players to delve in and uncover its secrets. Every corner hides fragments of the story, revealing the mysteries of the island.
Puzzles
Some areas cannot be accessed with the skeleton’s current abilities. Players need to advance through certain levels to acquire key items and solve puzzles. Levels are filled with various clues and hints—perhaps a series of numbers or a special symbol—that may be crucial for progression.
Storyline
Throughout the game, players will gradually recover lost memories, uncovering the skeleton’s mysterious origins. Some choices will influence the story’s direction, leading to different possible endings.
Additional Note
This game is still in development. If you're interested, please add it to your wishlist! This really means a lot to us—thank you!

title: Ghostly Acres
description:
게임 정보
Ghostly Acres is a cozy idle simulation game where you turn an old house into a thriving inn for wayward spirits with the help of your friend, Flip the Ghost. Manage and improve Ghostly Acres to generate more revenue from your ghostly guests.
Mel started the inn when she discovered the old house she inherited from her uncle was haunted! She was frightened at first, but the friendly old ghost Flip wasn't scary, just homeless. Flip convinced Mel to open up her home to ghosts everywhere and create the first inn of its kind: for ghosts! And so, Ghostly Acres was officially in business.
Build
Your guests need beds to sleep in and places to eat, drink, and be entertained. Build beds, vending machines, water coolers, and more!
Decorate
Build walls, change the floors, and paint to design your ideal inn.

title: Wheelchair Racer
description:
게임 정보
Become the Wheelchair! This hilariously challenging physics racer dares you to master the art of wheelchair movement.
Dual-Hand Controls:
Take on the challenge with a unique dual-handed control system that tests your left- and right-hand coordination to the limit. Push, pull, and pivot your way through every obstacle!

title: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero
description:
게임 정보
Ragnar Lothbrok, once a legendary Viking hero, has been summoned back to life by Odin the All-Father. In his previous life, Ragnar fought valiantly, yet his soul was tainted by misdeeds, and his spirit was forced to wander in the cold mists of Hel’s domain, deprived of Valhalla's glory.
But Odin saw something of value in Ragnar’s unyielding spirit.
And now, the All-Father has granted him a second chance - not only to redeem himself but to serve the gods in a quest that spans realms few have ever seen.
Our hero embarks on a mysterious journey to recover powerful artifacts scattered by ancient forces. Ragnar's quest leads him through enchanted lands, filled with magic, illusions, and strange creatures, his path lit only by glimpses of fate and the weight of his own redemption.
autokwd: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero

title: Peagrove Noir
description:
게임 정보
An Open-World to Explore
Discover a quiet island town racked by corruption, conspiracy, and collusion. Alone or with up to 3 of your friends, explore speakeasies, tea houses, dockyards, and more across Peagrove's 8 unique districts.
Meet the Locals
Immerse yourself in a world of colourful characters, risky rogues, and vainglorious villains. Townsfolk will remember you and your actions, so find friends, make enemies, and integrate into the local culture as Peagrove's newest detective.

title: Unbound Drift
description:
게임 정보
Unbound Drift is a high acceleration physics game built around the desire for speed and the grace of elastic motion. Once you've mastered the simplistic controls you'll be soaring through space at nerve inducing speeds!
Physics Driven Mastery
Behind the simple swings and artful arcs lies tons of physics fun. Every obstacle is an opportunity to bounce, every corner an opportunity to wrap yourself around. At high speeds, even your tether is loaded with elasticity, allowing you to slingshot yourself to the stars!

title: The Last Prisoner
description:
게임 정보
"Escape is impossible... or is it possible?"
A space prison, endless corridors, deadly traps and an all-seeing artificial intelligence ready to tear you apart. You are the last prisoner awakened from a corrective cryo-sleep, your task is to escape from this hell and find out where is everyone else? The only way to escape is to manipulate gravity and adapt to the chaos around you.
The Last Prisoner is a hardcore platformer with gravity changing mechanics, an engaging story, and memorable characters.
What's in store for you:
Gravity Changing Mechanics: Bypass traps by changing the direction of gravity, dodge deadly AI tricks and blast through levels.
High difficulty for real hardcore gamers: Each level is a new challenge that requires lightning-fast reactions and precision.
Engaging story and charismatic characters: Uncover the truth about humanity’s fate while facing a devious AI and meeting a mysterious ally.
An AI determined to destroy you: The merciless AI will do everything to stop your escape, activating traps at the most unexpected moments. But don’t think she’s just a regular opponent. She won’t just try to kill you—she’ll mock your failures with sarcasm and playful taunts. Get ready for her sharp and cheeky remarks.

title: Bloodmoon
description:
게임 정보
Survive by mastering intense combat: slash with your sword, dash and teleport to evade, and blast enemies with flames and electricity. Light is your only source of healing. Recharge within its glow, or brave the shadows for greater rewards.
Each wave grows deadlier. Strategize carefully, level up to boost your power, and fight to outlast the darkness.
Key Features:
Survive Horde Combat: Battle waves of creatures and face unique bosses.
Light vs. Dark: Stay in the light to recover or risk the shadows for rewards.
Spell-Powered Action: Dash, teleport, and wield arcane abilities.

title: PolyRealms: The Lost Kingdom
description:
게임 정보
In a vast open world survival RPG, you will have the freedom to explore and thrive in diverse biomes: forests, deserts, mountains, and more, each with unique ecosystems and varied resources. With a robust building system, construct your base from scratch, customizing it with defensive structures, farming areas, and workshops. Utilize the farming system to plant and harvest food, essential for survival, or raise livestock for valuable resources.
Additionally, face creatures and explore dungeons filled with dangers and hidden secrets. The game offers a vast skill and equipment tree that allows you to customize your character to tackle the specific challenges of each environment. Dynamic weather and day-night cycles increase the difficulty, while resource management and strategic planning make each journey unique and challenging.

title: HATMAN
description:
게임 정보
                                                                              HATMAN
                 About this game
Enter the whimsical world of HATMAN, a 2D pixel art adventure where humor meets dark twists.

title: Chicken Craft

                 Start with basic chickens and breed them to discover new appearances, mutations, and hidden DNA traits.

title: E9uations
description:
게임 정보
당신은 등호를 조종하게 됩니다. 목표는 숫자블럭을 모두 부수는 것입니다.
숫자블럭은 같은 숫자를 만나면 사라집니다. 올바른 숫자를 구하기 위해 수식을 만들어야 할 것입니다.

title: Aralunis
description:
게임 정보
Aralunis is a charming and personality-filled pixel art adventure where you play as Luna, a young princess determined to rescue her hero. Captured by mistake in her place by the powerful evil sorcerer known as Flames of Calamity, Luna must restore peace to her kingdom. Alongside her, embark on an epic journey through unique and enchanting landscapes, each more beautiful and challenging than the last.
Game Features:
2D Platform Adventure with Casual Elements: Perfect for those who love to explore at their own pace, Aralunis offers an accessible and relaxing experience, while still challenging your platforming skills with precision and creativity.
Nostalgic Pixel Art Graphics: Admire vibrant, retro visuals carefully crafted in pixel art, bringing every detail of the kingdom of Aralunis to life. From lush forests to dark caves, snow-covered mountains, and mystical landscapes filled with giant mushrooms, each environment is designed to fascinate and immerse.
Varied and Unique Environments: Explore fascinating and distinct biomes, each with its own atmosphere, creatures, and challenges. From the serenity of the forests to the icy heights and kingdoms shrouded in darkness, every step reveals something new and surprising.
Relaxing Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in a soothing soundtrack that accompanies Luna on her journey, designed to provide a calming and unforgettable experience.
Inspiring Storyline: More than just a princess, Luna is a determined and brave heroine, willing to push her limits to save her loved ones and restore light to her home.

title: LastDitch
description:
게임 정보
Click on the image below to join discord!

🌌 Face the invasion of the Void and march forward bravely. In this unknown world, the invasion of Void creatures has brought an unprecedented crisis. As the last line of defense for humanity, you are the guardian of light, and you must bravely resist this force of darkness!
________________________________________

🛠️ Build an invincible lineup, showcase strategic wisdom. Combine with the bonds of other races and leverage the strengths and abilities of your pieces. Thoughtfully design your tactics, as each deployment may alter the course of battle, determining the balance between victory and defeat.

🔥 Dive into a deep Roguelike experience, face ever-escalating challenges. Each battle brings new trials and opportunities. Choose from three technology enhancements, adapt to the ever-changing battlefield, and demonstrate your tactical depth and adaptability.

🎭 The fate of humanity is in your hands. In this life-and-death struggle, you are not only a commander but also a decision-maker. Choose the right strategies, cooperate closely with allies, and collectively resist the invasion of the Void, securing the last living space for humanity!

________________________________________

🌠 The outlook for the future holds infinite possibilities. "LastDitch" is a continually evolving world. With the passage of time, new races, pieces, bonds, technologies, and game modes will constantly be introduced, providing you with a more enriched and immersive gaming experience.

________________________________________

⚔️ Join "LastDitch" now and become the guardian of this strategic world, resisting the invasion of the Void, and writing the final legend of humanity!

title: Permanent: Hope & Vacuum
description:
게임 정보
«Permanent: Hope & Vacuum» is a disturbing first-person psychological horror indie game with adventure, puzzle, platformer, dungeon crawler and action gameplay.

This is a one-person development, so please let me introduce the game to you. Thanks!



Discover a story that will take you through a world that is as terrifying as it is intriguing, where you will encounter numerous obstacles and irrational challenges that will test your skills as a player.



Your main objective is to unravel the mystery behind your memory loss and discover all about the strange world you have woken up in after a long and surreal fall.

To do this, you'll have to defeat creatures called «Reks», solve all sorts of puzzles, overcome dungeons, use platforming mechanics, and face a variety of disturbing situations that will always leave you with more questions than answers.



Fortunately, with the help of the , you will have access to various special abilities to defend yourself, control fire, alter gravity... These skills are acquired throughout the game and will help you fight the and progress on your journey.

"But remember, is the only thing that matters. In , is more than a word. It is the very life of the character, the key to his entire story, and also the currency for obtaining documents from the that will help you better understand the LORE of the world.

Your adventure begins as you fall down a sort of energy cliff until you land in a room straight out of your worst nightmares.



From this point on, you'll be alone and confused, but unfortunately for you, .

.



It's best not to give too much away so that you can discover it for yourself, but the subtly and progressively told story will always keep you guessing, and when it's all over (if it ends) you'll understand why .














"Hi, I'm David Oliver, the only member of DOgames, a new indie studio based in Madrid (Spain) and the developer of . I'd like to introduce you to the amazing 3D fantasy world I'm creating with all my love and passion.



As an old-school gamer, I have always dreamt of creating a game capable of transporting players to another world and etching the experience in their gamer memory.

I'm working on every aspect of the game with care and attention to detail. From the puzzles, to the soundtrack, to every hidden corner, ensuring that every player will have an unforgettable experience.

I am excited to share that the project has been in full development for around a year now, but I need all the help I can get to fully realise the plans I have defined. Any kind of collaboration will be greatly appreciated; together we can make this game even more special!

title: Silicon Wasteland
description:
게임 정보
Following a worldwide catastrophe, a lone android wakes up years later to the wind and rain of the quiet apocalypse. Damaged, low on power, and having limited memories, she sets out into the nearby ruined city in search of answers.

SILICON WASTELAND is a kinetic visual novel set during the twilight years of humanity, and follows the wandering android Silica, as she explores the beautiful and sometimes frightening wonders of the world in a small quest to discover her purpose.

Featuring music from the creators of the Tunic Soundtrack, Lifeformed and Janice Kwan, as well as music from WastedMeerkat and Vidboy.

title: HYPERFATAL
description:
게임 정보
HYPERFATAL is a fast-paced old school FPS that combines the explosive action of movement shooters with unique mechanics similar to Quake and popular Source engine games.

An ancient interdimensional army known as the Goonabites have been disturbed by unknown forces, and are invading countless worlds. In a last ditch attempt against the masses, the last dwellers of the known universe have unleashed Project HYPER, an experimental cyborg soldier with unmatched speed, brutality, and abilities to face those who wish to destroy all of creation. Time is running out... show them that your existence will be FATAL


Use movement mechanics such as Rocket Jumping, Air Strafing, and Surfing to traverse environments quickly and dodge the relentless attacks of enemies.

With an emphasis on Push-Forward combat, kill enemies to gain charges for health and for Hyper Abilities, powerful tools to aid you in combat efficiency.

title: POWER CRISIS
description:
게임 정보
POWER CRISIS is an unnerving puzzle/resource-management game, where you have nothing but your mind, a light, and your superhuman electrical abilities to help you avoid obstacles, ward off enemies, and progress between test chambers.


As you progress, you'll need to interact with special components-- plenty of which need to be powered by your stored electricity.


For some chambers, you're given constant access to a generator, which you can use to charge up. Oftentimes though, your ability to access this generator is limited.


While a misuse of power could mean nothing more than a slight time loss, there is another problem that can arise...


Bee, the player character, is deeply afraid of the dark. And, seeing what lies within it, you won't blame them.
First, being in the dark for too long will cause Bee to panic, giving you a slight setback on time.


But, more pressing, you're not alone-- and you'll wish you were. Your light is your only weapon against the creatures that live within the dark.

Of course, beyond survival, there is one more reason you'll want to be efficient with your power usage...


This mission isn't without consequences. The world depends on you, and as such, you need to prove you're up for the task. Once your test officially begins, your Power Rating score will continuously decrement. Each time you're knocked out, you will also face a penalty to this score.


The higher the score you have by the end, the better grade you will receive. If your score reaches 0, your mission will end. Speaking of which.


You've been tasked with something you've been training for your entire life-- the preparation of a mysterious new power source, which should be powerful enough to save humanity from a new, incoming apocalypse. On your mission, you will have to use your power and your wits to interact with different mechanisms to ultimately allow you to progress. With a handful of different components to work with, you will constantly have to learn how new mechanisms work and interact with one another. In this mission, your quick thinking is your only lifeline.

title: Meowmentum
description:
게임 정보
Meowmentum is a first-person speedrunning platformer in which you must finish speed trials as fast as possible to become a full-fledged catmage! 🐈🧙‍♂️ What are you waiting for? Go get your name on the leaderboards MEOW~!



Use your newly-found powers of Meowmentum and harness the potential of paw-kour! Run on walls, slide down ramps, and dash through magic orbs to keep going faster!





Prove yourself worthy by completing the Elder Catmages' speed trials! Discover secret shortcuts and movement techniques as you paw through each trial!





Collect meow-zmerizing medals and race against Catmages all around the world! Will you dominate the leaderboards and become a master of Meowmentum?





Hello! We are a team of 5 indie developers (+ 4 audio collaborators) aiming to create the best magical cat speedrunner in existence! We sincerely hope you enjoy our game, in whatever capacity it may be. Wanna chat with us? JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER!! Thank you <3

title: Dark & Quispy
description:
게임 정보
다크 앤 퀴스피(Dark and Quispy)는 2.5D 종이 같은 비주얼을 특징으로 한 로그라이크 생존 게임입니다.
어둠과 위험으로 뒤덮인 세상, 불길한 피의 달이 땅을 뒤덮으며 악의적인 빛을 발합니다. 그게 나쁜 일이라는 걸 짐작할 수 있을 겁니다.
네, 맞습니다... 특히 메인 플레임(Main Flame)에게는요.
최근 피의 달이 뜨면서 등장한 수많은 생명체들에 의해 그녀는 끊임없이 공격을 받았고, 그녀의 영혼을 잃었습니다! 그녀의 본질이 벗겨지고 영혼들이 사방으로 흩어지며, 그녀는 존재의 끝자락에 서게 됩니다.
소울 플레임(Soul Flame) 사람들의 수호자로서 당신의 임무가 시작됩니다. 오직 어둠의 심연으로 뛰어들어 치열한 적들과 싸우고 메인 플레임의 잃어버린 영혼들을 되찾아야만 세상의 균형을 회복할 수 있습니다!
무기
적들을 어떻게든 물리쳐야 합니다! 강력한 무기로 무장하여 적들을 물리치고 가능한 오래 생존하세요. 쓰러뜨린 적에게서 소울 플레임을 수집해 무기를 업그레이드하고 무기를 더 강력하게 만드세요!

title: A Byte War
description:
게임 정보

Byte War는 실시간 전략 게임으로 다른 차원에서 온 기계의 위협에 맞서 블록 기반 기계 종족을 이끌게 됩니다.블록으로 기지를 건설하고 패턴을 형성하여 건물을 지어 자원 수확, 유닛 스폰, 영향력 확장 등 필요한 사항을 커버하세요.적을 정복하고, 영향력을 확장하여 지도를 지배하거나 자신의 땅에서 버티며 적이 방어를 뚫고 들어오지 못하게 하는 것까지, 다양한 엔딩이 있는 임무에서 자신만의 길을 찾아보세요.



Byte War에서는 기본적인 건물 블록인 블록을 지을 능력이 있습니다.타일 기반 격자에 여러 패턴으로 지어서 특정한 모양과 기능을 갖춘 건물을 만드세요.특정 모양의 블록을 사용하여 퍼즐 조각처럼 배치하여 상상한 대로 자신만의 기지를 만드세요.

각 건물은 꼭대기의 조종 장치로 제어됩니다.예:
- 본부는 주요 건물로 특정 활성화 스킬 조종 장치를 가지고 있습니다.
- 자원 수확기는 스폰 및 자동 수확 조종 장치를 가지고 있습니다.
- 유닛 스포너는 유닛을 특정 목적지로 보내는 조종 장치를 가지고 있습니다

이 필수 건물을 지으려면 블록을 특정 패턴으로 배열해야 합니다.각각 전략 옵션을 강화하는 고유한 기능을 선보이는 어려운 임무에 걸쳐 진행해 나아가며 새로운 패턴과 건물 기능을 잠금 해제하세요.



영향력을 확장하는 것은 주변 지역을 장악하는 데 있어 중요한 메커니즘 중 하나입니다.여러분의 영향력은 영구적인 영향력 스팟을 생성하는 본부부터 시작되며, 도달 범위를 전략적으로 계속 확장하려면 영향력 확산기를 배치하여 주변 지역에 대한 지배력을 강화하세요.

여러분의 영향력 아래에 있는 지역은 다음과 같은 큰 이점을 제공합니다.
- 기지가 제대로 작동되도록 유지합니다
- 피해를 당한 유닛을 치유합니다.
- 무기화하여 적 건물을 비활성화하고 적 유닛에게 피해를 줄 수 있습니다
- 새로운 자원 매장물을 생성합니다
- 지도의 기존 매장물을 변환합니다

하지만 조심하세요. 적이 자신의 영향력을 사용하여 반격할 수 있으니까요.



모든 임무에서 자신만의 길을 선택하여 고유한 여정과 결과를 만들어 내세요.

본 게임은 다양한 임무 유형을 제공하며 각각 구별되는 도전 과제와 전략 목표를 선사합니다.압도적인 적 부대에게서 달아나거나, 생존하기 위해 무자비한 침략을 물리치거나, 우격다짐으로 적 영토를 정복하거나, 자신의 영향력을 확장하여 지형을 지배하는 자신을 보게 될 것입니다.
각 임무 유형은 여러 후속 임무로 갈라져 나가며 특정 엔딩으로 종결되는 다양한 길로 이끕니다.

title: The Betweenlands
description:
게임 정보
It's time for Mori to find her place in the world, but she's stuck on the dark and wet Core, miles below the beautiful Surface. She must use her trusty grappling hook to traverse the Betweenlands, clusters of floating islands hovering between the Core and the Surface. Explore and climb unique skyscapes on your way to discovering Mori's true desires in this passionately-crafted high-precision platformer.

In a world where the wealthy use massive mechanical wings for vertical travel, help Mori beat the odds and overcome impossible obstacles with nothing but a grappling hook, constantly risking it all for her dream. Meet diverse characters along the way who encourage or challenge Mori's beliefs, forcing her to question why she wants to reach the Surface at all.

Inspired by my own life experiences, The Betweenlands is a painfully personal tale of determination, self-discovery, and the feeling of blazing your own path in a world of deeply ingrained norms and protocols. Created by a single developer, all mechanics, design, sound, and art (pixel and full resolution) form a cohesive unit to tell a story impossible for AAA studios.

title: Chop Shop
description:
게임 정보
이 액션 상점 운영 게임에서 놀라울 정도로 빠른 속도로 사냥하고, 고기를 발라내고, 요리하면서 흐름을 타보세요. 귀여운 몬스터를 사냥하고, 거대한 고깃덩이를 썰고, 신선육을 파워 슬라이스로 잘라 고객에게 더욱 빠르게 대령하세요. 상점이 살아남으려면 빠르게, 예리하게 대처해야 합니다.
정육 - 거대한 내장과 살코기를 발라내어 팔아 수익을 올리세요.
요리 - 각 고객에게 딱 맞는 요리를 만들거나 대중을 위한 매력적인 식품으로 가공하여 파세요.
- 적을 싹둑 썰어 맛있는 고기 부위로 만들어 보세요.

title: Quest Industries
description:
게임 정보
퀘스트 인더스트리는 엄청난 양의 코인을 벌어들이는 판타지 공장을 짓는 것에 대한 점진적인 게임입니다.
리소스 수집
공장을 건설하세요
엄청난 양의 동전을 벌어라

title: Ten Ten
description:
게임 정보
Ten Ten is a unique game that combines shooting, puzzles, and bullet-dodging.

The game is heavily focused on boss battles, and the ease of replaying enhances the challenge even more.

Gameplay is simple, but you need to constantly make the right choices as you solve puzzles, dodge enemy attacks, and strike back at the same time. Each boss has its own unique attack patterns and stage mechanics.

title: Operator Unknown
description:
게임 정보
Otto receives a mysterious phone call that leads him to his family’s killer. To uncover the truth, he must complete a series of trials that distort his perception of reality.
Guided by an entity called the Operator, he navigates strange events, faces threats, and uncovers hidden clues. With each trials, the lines between past and present blur, forcing him to question what is real. His choices shape the outcome—will he find the truth or lose himself in the process?

Warning: Game contains imagery that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar condition.
Two Perspectives, One Nightmare
Switch between first-person gameplay and top-down exploration. Each view presents different challenges, requiring quick thinking and adaptation.
A Distinctive Vision
Explore a world with a unique art style and atmospheric storytelling. Every scene holds a clue, and every shadow hides something unknown.
Nightmares Made Flesh
Encounter supernatural entities lurking in the dark—some recognizable, others impossible to understand… and maybe even a few clowns to make things worse.
Retro-Tech Horror Vibes
A robotic text-to-speech voice, inspired by classic S.A.M. synthesis, adds an eerie and nostalgic feel to every interaction.
A Protagonist Worth Watching
Play as a lead character who isn’t just smart and determined—but also easy on the eyes.

title: Appulse
description:
게임 정보
Discover pinball like never before with Appulse! The game is a roguelite shooter, where you protect a Galactic Federation ship! Upgrade your ball, your weapons and your ship to pushback waves of unwavering robots.
Inspired by the classic pinball Space Cadet we loved during our childhood, Appulse is a reinterpretation of the genre. Bringing newcomers and old timers by mixing the juicy mechanics of the pinball, and the thrilling and fast gameplay of a roguelite shooter, we want to spark a new interest among the gamer community!
We stayed faithful to the pinball legacy and designed a completely unique table for Appulse. In this game you are entirely immersed into a space war. Your goal is to protect the capital
ship while he is cruising through space to escape the grasp of the robot syndicate.

title: Object 17
description:
게임 정보
You are Object 17. Someone unknown is forcing you to undergo mental ability tests. What happened to you? Where are you? Who is testing you? If your number is 17, then what happened to the previous 16 subjects? You will have to answer these and other questions during the game.

Collect puzzles from three-dimensional models of the famous Tetris. Move and rotate the figures as you like. The goal is to fit all the figures into a semi-transparent box in the center of the location. Some figures will be locked. To unlock them, you need to solve a problem.

You will have to use your abstract thinking to the fullest. Go through the tests on the flying islands in the open space of your subconscious. It won't be easy!

title: Attrax
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Attrax technological institute
Opposites attract, and likes repel. Dive into the mysterious Attrax institute, solving intricate logic puzzles based on the principles of attraction and repulsion, with each puzzle bringing you closer to the origins of the institute. In this captivating single-player experience, enjoy hours of gameplay that will challenge your mind and redefine your understanding of physics and logic.

Attraction and Repulsion
Each puzzle room will test your knowledge of attraction and repulsion. Manipulate charged field generators, charged particles, charged cubes, and other activators in different testing environments in order to solve these puzzles.

Take the power of attraction and repulsion into your hands. Use the Charge Gun to directly affect the world around you, flinging objects (yourself included) across rooms to solve intricate puzzles and cross deadly gaps.

The institute is much older than it wants you to think, and why is it you can't remember how you came to this place. Keep your eyes and ears open as you progress through the Attrax technological institute, and you just may uncover its deepest and darkest secrets.

title: xiao wang phone store simulator
description:
게임 정보
Xiao Wang phone store simulator  a mobile phone sales and management simulation game, players through reasonable management, earn money, expand the scale of the store, open the secret room. You will become the owner of Xiao Wang's Repair Shop and expand its scale. By purchasing second-hand mobile phones, refurbishing and repairing them, you can earn gold coins. Then, you can open the mysterious chamber and explore the secrets hidden within.

title: Shoot  the Moon
description:
게임 정보
SHOOT FOR THE MOON은 우스꽝스러운 로그라이트 업그레이드와 사랑스러운 성우진의 부적응 친구들이 등장하는 아케이드 액션 플랫폼 게임입니다!
드루이드가 통제하는 위험한 숲을 통과하면서 비행 생물에게 마법의 창을 던지세요!
이상한 가족의 도움으로 창, 주문, 괴물 친구를 업그레이드하여 점점 더 높이 성장할 수 있으며, 숲에서 하늘 도시, 용의 뱃속을 거쳐 그 너머까지 탐험할 수 있습니다!
창 길이와 속도를 업그레이드하여 멈출 수 없는 작살과 투척 기계가 되세요!
숲의 어두운 면에 숨겨진 끔찍한 비밀을 밝혀내세요!
순간이동 및 마인드 컨트롤과 같은 예상치 못한 기술을 잠금 해제하기 위해 새로운 친구를 데려오세요!
새, 박쥐, 짐승을 삼켜서 달리는 동안 콤보에 불을 붙이고 힘을 키워보세요!
숲을 노예로 삼는 사악한 드루이드에게 복수하세요.
유쾌한 목소리 연기와 중독성 넘치는 게임, 이제 창을 들고 달을 향해 쏠 시간입니다!
놓치면 무기를 업그레이드하고 다시 가세요!

title: Mochi Conquest
description:
게임 정보
✨ WISHLIST NOW & JOIN THE ADVENTURE!
⛩️ MOCHI NEED YOU! WILL YOU SAVE… OR DESTROY THEM ALL?
 The Dread Fog spreads, twisting the land and corrupting the once-sacred Kami. Cursed Shikigami enslave the Mochi, turning them into relentless foes.
 You are their last hope. Lead the Mochi warriors, free the Kami, and reclaim a world drowning in corruption.
 When the time comes, will you save the lost… or erase them forever?
⚔️ MASTER TIMING-BASED COMBAT

title: Live War
description:
게임 정보
Live War is an easy-to-learn, hard-to-master strategy game—a streamlined take on titles like Company of Heroes, Men of War, and Wargame. As a senior commander, you’ll deploy the right units and abilities at the perfect moment to dominate the battlefield. Watch as your army crushes the enemy, or take matters into your own hands by calling in airstrikes, missiles, or directly commanding officers to turn the tide of battle.
Strategy-Driven Gameplay
Focus on tactics—every decision matters.
Clear battlefield intel—what you see is what you get.
Real-time strategic feedback—adapt and react instantly.
Diverse Units & Deep Strategies
Dozens of unit types to deploy.
Unique abilities like airstrikes, cover setups, and resource buildings.
Tactical counters—each unit type has strengths and weaknesses.

title: Snowman Mo
description:
게임 정보
Join this brave little guy!
He's about to embark on a grand journey to find his friends in this heartwarming adventure game.
A narrative, single-player experience made with all the charm you deserve.
Scamper around the snowcapped peaks of Grumble Mountain and discover a world full of possibility.
Battle bullies, wolves, and firebees in frantically fun snowball fights.
Turn into a snowball and tumble down icy slopes.
Meet dozens of unforgettable characters. Like this snowman named Sherbert!

title: DinoSwarm
description:
게임 정보
The Swarm Queen is ready to invade the dimensions and gather as much power as she can. She will grant you incredible powers and enhancements.
Create your own Hybrid and upgrade it to face increasingly difficult challenges. Infinite possibilities! You can hybridize your Dinosaur using DNA from various body parts collected during battle. In addition to changing the physical appearance and movements, its stats also change, so have fun experimenting with different builds!

title: Dungeon Fletcher
description:
게임 정보
Time jumps and avoid obstacle as you collect treasures and find secret passages in the search of the best score!
Dungeon Fletcher is an ode to old school computer platformers of the 90s/80s!
Game modes
Challenge yourself in 4 different difficult modes, explore the dungeon and try to find all secret areas!

title: The Advent: Children of Arla
description:
게임 정보
The Advent: Children of Arla invites you to explore the enigmatic planet of Argus, a world created by the Hydrackians—an ancient and advanced civilization—to serve as humanity’s legacy. This RPG hybrid combines massive multiplayer worlds with engaging single-player dungeon adventures to deliver an unparalleled gaming experience.
Key Features:
Hybrid Gameplay: Seamlessly transition between vast multiplayer worlds and challenging single-player RPG dungeons.
Immersive Lore: Discover the story of Klateqal, the bipedal shapeshifting dragon whose role as humanity’s guardian led to betrayal, banishment, and the fusion of his soul with his enemy, Zo-ar. Unravel mysteries tied to ancient Earth legends and the Hydrackians’ grand plan.
Mesoamerican Mythology: Journey through a sub-world inspired by Aztec and Mayan timelines, including ‘Temple Q,’ a breathtaking dungeon set in ancient Teotihuacan.
Dynamic Quests and Challenges: Solve intricate puzzles, navigate perilous traps, and complete quests that impact the fate of Argus and its inhabitants.
Customization and Progression: Build your character’s skills, unlock unique abilities, and discover rare artifacts to aid in your journey.
Stunning Visuals: Explore richly detailed environments, from lush jungles to the surreal landscapes of Argus and beyond.
The Story Begins:
On the home world of Arla, Klateqal—the legendary dragon believed to be the inspiration for Earth’s Quetzalcoatl—was once beloved by his people and destined for greatness. Framed for murder by the cunning Zo-ar, Klateqal was sentenced to banishment. A tragic accident involving Luminoy, a mysterious mineral, fused Klateqal with his enemy, creating a powerful and vengeful being consumed by hatred.
Centuries later, humanity discovers Argus, a planet imbued with remnants of Hydrackian technology and a dark secret tied to Klateqal’s fate. As one of the Children of Arla, you must navigate this mysterious world, face its challenges, and decide its destiny.
Wishlist Now!
Prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure. Add The Advent: Children of Arla to your wishlist on Steam today and be the first to uncover the secrets of Argus.

title: Sweep City
description:
게임 정보
Jump into your street sweeper and master the satisfying art of cleaning, from fallen leaves to forgotten treasures.
Get behind the wheel of your trusty sweeper and keep the neighborhoods tidy. Every shift brings something new - you never know what you might find hidden beneath the debris.
Relax and unwind in the atmospheric world of Sweep City.
Features:
Satisfying driving and street cleaning mechanics
Endless streets to explore with procedural generation
Discover hidden treasures as you sweep
Turn collected materials and rare finds into sweeper upgrades
Cruise to your own tunes with the built-in media player
Coming Soon:
Interactive Twitch integration
New environments to explore
Dynamic weather system

title: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?
description:
게임 정보
Satan was feeling lonely. The people simply don't care about eternal damnation like they used to. Maybe all hell needed was a promotional event to get people excited again. One day, he heard people arguing about how many toddlers they could beat in a fight and then he got an idea. If anyone could defeat 20 waves of toddlers they would acquire powers beyond their wildest imagination.
A Deal with the Devil 
At the end of each wave, choose between a variety of powerful upgrades, but each one comes at a cost! For example an upgrade might give a boost to damage after a reload, making it powerful if you reload your weapon often. However, the upgrade also reduces the knockback given to enemies. Many Faustian upgrades are able to be taken multiple times, stacking the benefits and drawbacks. So repeating that same upgrade may give you massive damage after you reload, but the knockback it inflicts is so reduced that it pulls enemies closer to you! Depending on the upgrades you choose, this could be a critical weakness in your strategy or an attribute you are able to overcome with the other power you have acquired.
Explore Unique weapons
Explore a variety of powerful weapons that each have two firing modes.
Including a Brella gun that has an automatic rifle component and an alt fire that shoots umbrellas that pushes back enemies and deletes projectiles,
A double barrel shotgun with an alt fire that shoots two barrels at once, increasing knock back and penetration while stunning enemies,
An AK-47 with Molotov launcher alt fire,
And many more!

title: Little Onryo
description:
게임 정보
As a small Onryō, you just can't wait to curse as many chumps as possible - but first you have to power up your Nensha by collecting all the objects in an 8-bit style old school platformer!
Make your nefarious way through ten different worlds, dodging guardians and nasties, negotiating crumbling platforms, cunning level designs and use your telekenesis and Nesha bolt to solve problematic puzzles.
A fond love letter and parody of the classic 48K games of Matthew Smith and all small and gruesome spirits that dwell in wells.
FEATURES:
Hundreds of rooms to explore and solve, including a country house, shopping mall, moon base, furry forest and the most dreaded foe of all - your mother!
Dozens of curious enemies with a massive four frames of animation!
Tricky jumps and physics puzzles!
16 blistering colors! (Except when it isn't)
A chiptune soundtrack!
Explore every nook and cranny and save your sisters!
Old school gameplay - it's a challenge, just like the good old days. You get seven lives to conquer a world and that's it!
