title: SUMO TATAMI
description:
게임 정보
서투른 스모 선수들이 재미있고 경쟁적인 모드에서 경쟁하는 Sumo Tatami의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 친구 및 라이벌과 함께 레이스, 결투, 볼링, 골프 및 기타 스모 모험을 준비하세요.
게임 기능:
🤣 예측할 수 없는 스모 액션: 서투른 레슬러를 조종하며 위험한 경기장에서 혼란을 경험하세요.
💥 코믹 무기: 로켓 발사기부터 작살까지 웃긴 무기를 활용하세요.
🥇 경쟁: 웃음과 흥분이 가득한 다양한 모드에서 스모 챔피언의 자리를 놓고 싸우세요.

title: Endless Descent
description:
게임 정보
Endless Descent is a high-stakes roguelike adventure where every decision matters. Players descend into an ever-changing labyrinth of procedurally generated dungeons, armed with medieval weapons and the resolve to survive. But beware — in Endless Descent, you only have one life. If you fall, everything is lost: your character, your progress, and your hard-earned treasures.
Across multiple dungeon worlds, players search for rare and powerful Soul Stones, mystical artifacts capable of enhancing their abilities or empowering their weapons with unique effects. Each descent presents tougher enemies, unpredictable encounters, and the constant pressure to survive. Victory means growth, but defeat means starting over with nothing but hard-earned knowledge.
With intense, permadeath-driven gameplay, deep customization, and endless replay ability, Endless Descent offers a relentless challenge where only the strongest, smartest, and most adaptable adventurers will endure. How far will you descend before the dungeon takes its toll?

title: Nanima
description:
게임 정보
Fight through a constantly evolving microscopic world to deliver a vital payload. The inhabitants of the microcosm may be small but they can tear you apart, so you'll have to scavenge what's left of previous expeditions from their remains to bolster your arsenal.
Combine dozens of unique weapons and augments to create devastating combos while strategically placing thrusters, weights, and fins to fine-tune your movement and outmaneuver enemies.

title: POUMOSA
description:
게임 정보
= Gameplay =
POUMOSA is a Point And Click adventure game.
It is intended for players who like dialogues, puzzles and wiggling mustaches.
= Story =
In 1503, Europe is captivated by the promise of the New World. Expeditions are being prepared in all the kingdoms, each hoping to obtain their share of the riches and unexplored lands.
You play the role of Balthazar De Rochemort, a nobleman who invests in one of these expeditions and boards a ship. However, caught in a violent storm, your expedition drifts and discovers a small mysterious island, inhabited by an unknown people.
Study their language !

title: Madora
description:
게임 정보
A third-person 3D Roguelite like you've never seen before! Madora raises the challenge level by bringing a different map perspective and character view. Explore dark forests and lands as you challenge enemies and protect the world of Madora.

title: GAME
description:
게임 정보
It's time you learnt how to play.
GAME follows the story of a champion player of a cryptic and bizarre sport set in a vibrant and surreal world. Awoken at dawn one morning by your mother and shown the basics, you are thereafter thrust onto the path towards stardom—whether you like it or not.
Told through a series of scenes and conversations spread throughout your life, equal parts funny and sad, GAME spans several decades and a wide variety of colorful and evocative locations. The dialogue choices you make with the people you meet along the way will impact the path you take, and the ultimate conclusion to your story.
Roughly 1-2 hours for one playthrough, depending on the path you take
Bizarre and beautiful locations rendered in colorful, stylized 3D artwork
Multiple paths and outcomes influenced by your dialogue choices throughout the game

title: Seed Adventure
description:
게임 정보
세계수는 죽어가고 있으며, 이는 시드의 세계를 위협합니다. 시드는 마을의 족장이 후계자로 선택한 귀여운 작은 씨앗입니다! 이 3D 플랫폼 게임에서 다양한 위험한 환경을 가로질러 마을을 구하세요!
당신의 마을이 위험에 처해 있으며, 당신은 마을을 구해야 합니다! 서로 다른 7개의 환경을 지나 궁극적인 목표인 세계수에 도달하고 마을을 구하세요.
고된 모험이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다! 환경에 맞게 조정된 다양한 장애물을 극복하여 당신의 능력을 시험해보세요.
쉬움, 보통, 그리고 가장 용감한 이들을 위한 어려움 중에서 난이도를 선택하세요!

작은 구성 및 제한된 저장 공간에 적합합니다.

title: Just Grow
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the dark world of childhood nightmares, where every room is a challenge, and every fight is a test of courage.
Step into the shoes of Cooper, a young hero trapped in an abandoned orphanage filled with reawakened childhood memories. Plush bears, toys, clowns, and robots—seemingly innocent things have transformed into dark monsters that stand in your way. To survive, you must fight, explore, and develop your skills as you navigate procedurally generated rooms packed with challenges.
Gather essence from defeated enemies and use it to play the mysterious "GrowMachine.” The rewards you earn will unlock new possibilities—granting abilities that allow you to delve deeper into the orphanage and uncover its secrets.
Key Features:
Dynamic melee combat: Intuitive controls and reflex-based gameplay deliver thrilling action.
Procedurally generated levels: Every playthrough is a fresh challenge—you never know what lies behind the next door.
Unique art style: Hand-drawn, frame-by-frame animations give the game a distinctive look.
Dark, magical atmosphere: The abandoned orphanage holds many secrets, balancing fear and wonder.
Embark on an emotional adventure that pushes the limits of courage and perseverance. Will Cooper conquer the nightmares of childhood and find light within the darkness?

title: Soul Roach City
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a harrowing journey of violent paranoia and schizophrenic delusion in Soul Roach City, the worst city in the world—a decaying urban nightmare where gangs rule, and the streets are flooded with drugs, smut, and despair. Thrust into a brutal, action-packed FPS horror experience, confront horrific realities and twisted delusions of guilt and suffering as you struggle to discern what’s real from the nightmares that haunt your mind. Are you ready to face the truth?
Key Features:
Roguelike Perma-Death FPS: Every run is unique, with high stakes and no second chances.
Cigarette-Based Health System: Stay alive by strategically managing your health in a grim, unconventional way.
Projectile-Based Bullet System: Experience satisfying, skill-driven combat where every bullet counts.
Diverse Enemies: Battle brutal gangs and surreal, drug-induced visions in a city gone mad.
Multiple Stages of Descent: Progress deeper into the decaying nightmare of Soul Roach City.
Unique Perks Every Run: Customize your playstyle with perks that make each run a new experience.
Discover Each Characters Harrowing Past: Unravel the tragic journey into madness of each playable character that led to this point.
Explore the Rich Lore: Dive deep into the twisted and haunting history of Soul Roach City.
Classic FPS-Inspired Movement System: Master air-strafing, bunnyhopping, and more for high-speed, skill-based traversal.

title: Space Grunts 3
description:
게임 정보
Space Grunts is a combination of turn-based tactics and fast paced arcade action.
Navigate your way through procedurally generated space stations, taking out enemies or using the shockwave of your rockets, grenades and other explosions to simply move those enemies out of the way on your path to the end goal.
(Planned) Key features
Fast turn-based gameplay (as seen and enjoyed in the original Space Grunts)
Tactical weapon usage with weapons having a "spread pattern"
Explosive weapons generate shock-waves pushing/forcing entities around the map
Procedurally generated
Risk reward mission system: Dangerous missions give bigger rewards than easier missions

title: Pixel Domain
description:
게임 정보
Pixel Domain is a minimalist, medieval 4x game. Play cards to capture territories, play more cards to build in those territories to get access to better cards, play better cards to get a larger army, build castles to get access to powerful hero's, build improvements to pay for your upkeep. Pixel Domain can be played against an AI, online or hotseat multiplayer. Unlock new cards by playing challenges. Conquer the island or build a wonder to win.

title: Just Cube
description:
게임 정보
                                                    "Just Cube" 는 도전적인 장애물, 장대한 보스 전투, 쉴 틈 없는 긴장감으로 가득한 12개의 독특한 장소로 여러분을 안내하는 2D 플랫포머 게임입니다. 각 장소는 여러분의 기술과 반사 신경을 시험하는 새로운 도전이며, 정밀한 움직임과 뛰어난 전략을 요구합니다.
이 게임은 단순히 A 지점에서 B 지점으로 이동하는 것뿐만 아니라, 여러분을 가로막는 수많은 함정과 맞서야 합니다. 그리고 각 장소의 끝에는 여정을 계속하지 못하도록 방해하는 장대한 보스 전투가 기다리고 있습니다.

title: A Father's Tale
description:
게임 정보
A Father's Tale is a story about grief and acceptance. After the loss of your son, you magically get sucked into his drawing book that contains a fantasy world inside. Explore this land with colorful creatures and beautiful landscapes in a Top-Down view of the Father. Jumping, crouching and running your way through obstacles
The book soon becomes a way to reconnect with your loved one. All your memories are written and drawn inside but suddenly it's revealed this kingdom is being taken under control of a powerful and mysterious entity. All it's colors are vanishing and you will need to find a way to save the joy and colors from the book.
In this adventure, you will solve puzzles to open new paths and learn about this world. Evil creatures will, however, try to stop you. Their objective is to fill the land with darkness and sadness by using their dark magic so you will need to sneak around them. Using covers and distractions, they will be no match for you.
During your journey, a magic crystal will become your most powerful ally. It will contain many powers, including coloring what was once lost to the corruption from darkness. Some objects you encounter during your exploration are corrupted by darkness and grief. You will have the power to restore their color and thus, progressing in your quest.

title: Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate
description:
게임 정보
In a medieval world consumed by darkness,
you are the last hope—a lord tasked with saving your people.
As night falls, monsters emerge, threatening your village's survival.
To fight back and thrive, you must rely on a mysterious magic coin pusher.
Push coins to summon heroes, forge weapons, and gather resources.
Strategically combine cards to unleash powerful effects, repel monsters, and unlock greater rewards.
Blending slot-machine randomness with roguelike progression, the game offers a unique experience:
Push coins, collect resources: Trigger rewards and build your stockpile.
Recruit heroes, defend your land: Summon warriors, mages, and builders to fight for survival.
Synergize and upgrade: Chain card effects to unlock massive multipliers and dominate the darkness.
Will you save your resources for the future or risk it all for immediate gain?
Lead your village through the night and into the light!
Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate
a test of survival and fate.
Ready to take the challenge?
autokwd: Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate

title: Mac & Jack: Candy Bashers
description:
게임 정보
As the old saying goes, nothing stands between a Pumpkin and their Cat.
In Mac & Jack: Candy Bashers you'll brave the Halloween night and work to survive against waves of monsters while collecting as much candy as you can! Discover new items by Trick-or-Treating between waves, purchase them from the shopkeeper for permanent use, and build a loadout that customizes the difficulty of every run!
And if the monsters have you feeling a little tense? Take a second to breathe and just spend time with your friend. 
Features:
Wave based runs that are customized by what items you choose to bring. Looking for an easy breezy run? Pack a little less! Thrive on difficulty? Bring all you can carry!
Over a dozen unique items and accessories to unlock!

title: Golden Soul
description:
게임 정보
Who should rule the human's fate–
The human itself or an abstract god?
This is a clash between past and future, tradition and progress, beliefs and ideals.
After a tragic event, you find yourself trapped in a magical time loop. Half a century passes, and your soul withers away, leaving behind an empty shell to aimlessly wander the abyss.
But fate still has plans for you.
A mysterious mage appears, granting you a Golden Soul and saving you from eternal oblivion. Your real soul holds your personality, memories, and emotions. The Golden Soul is a magical imitation that prolongs your existence – but you feel nothing. No blood courses through your veins, no morality guides your actions.

title: OMEXYAN
description:
게임 정보
Test your skills and become the champion of the Universal Games!
The galaxy is watching you in this once-in-a-millennium competition. 
Step into the world of OMEXYAN, where movement, rhythm, and skill rule the arena! Feel the adrenaline in this dynamic VR game that challenges your reflexes and precision.
-Dive into the world of OMEXYAN, where reflexes, precision, and skill dominate in an exciting VR adventure!
Use the color-catching devices in your hands to collect incoming red and green orbs. Then, control two colorful remote devices to aim at and hit the matching-colored cubes accurately. In the third challenge, wield a sporty laser weapon to shoot the correct-colored targets with precision.
Earn points, unlock new levels and arenas, and face increasingly challenging and diverse tasks. With a fast-paced soundtrack accompanying your gameplay, OMEXYAN ensures you’re fully immersed in a dynamic and thrilling experience.
This game focuses on skill-based challenges and dynamic VR gameplay, offering exciting and captivating entertainment.

title: Pizza Super Slice
description:
게임 정보
Pizza Super Slice is a cartoon-exploration-platformer in which you play as an animated pizza slice. Explore a strange, cartoonish town full of little secrets, dark corners and secret passages.

title: Fling your Friends TD - Tower Defense
description:
게임 정보
Dedicated to my daughter. Wherever you are, I hope you know that you are loved.
Fling your Friends TD is the ultimate party game that will have you and your friends laughing, strategizing, and outsmarting each other in the most entertaining showdown ever! In this game, players take on the roles of either the Defender or the Attackers in a wild and whimsical battle of wits and creativity.
Defender:
Build Your Fortress: Carefully place traps and obstacles to create a formidable defense that will challenge the Attackers.
Special Abilities: Use unique abilities to disrupt and thwart the Attackers' progress, adding an extra layer of strategy to your defenses.
Attacker:
Plan and Conquer: Strategically plan your route and collaborate with your friends (or go solo) to navigate through the Defender's traps.
Character Progression: Level up your character's skills and counter the Defender's strategies.
Overcome Challenges: Utilize special abilities to outmaneuver obstacles and reach your goal.
Key Features
Cooperative PvP Multiplayer: Engage in thrilling multiplayer modes, teaming up with and against friends in a battle of cunning.
Creative Trap: Place an array of imaginative traps that will keep the Attackers on their toes.
Hilarious Gameplay: Experience the fun and chaos of a light-hearted game designed to bring joy and laughter to your gaming sessions.
Strategic Depth: Balance creativity and strategy to outwit your opponents and achieve victory.
Vibrant Visuals: Enjoy colorful and cartoony graphics that enhance the game's charm and appeal.
Replayability: Every game offers a unique experience with countless trap combinations and strategies to explore.
autokwd: Fling your Friends TD - Tower Defense

title: Lobsterpunk
description:
게임 정보
Lobsterpunk is a puzzle, walking simulator where you make your way through an abandon city powered solely by the combustion of lobsters. Bring the dead machinery one last breath of life before their steel forms lay cold forever. As you do, see the memories of the last man on earth, the ones he loved, the ones he lost, & the mistakes he made to get to where he is.
Complete lockpicking puzzles to traverse this dead city, explore any house you desire, find the story of those who once lived here through what they left behind & how familiar that might feel, however foreign the setting.
Lockpicking Systems:
Lockpicking uses W,A,S,D to turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find the sweet spot in a lock!
Volt Wave uses W,A,S,D toto turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find a moving sweet spot on a panel!
Gearbox uses W,A,S,D to turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find the sweet spot in a set of 3 layered gears!

title: Filtration
description:
게임 정보
From the developer that brought you Quaternion comes a new ball-rolling platform challenge that's bigger, better, and full of surprises! Jump, bounce, blast, and fly through 12 pocket dimensions in order to harvest the precious power sources within. Find Modules that let your ball do things you've never seen before at the touch of a button. With robotic foes and tricky puzzles in your way, it's gonna take a lot more than Ion Cells to get through this!
Filtration is a single-player puzzle platform game. By rolling a robotic ball, you'll explore and unlock the secrets of the lost Amali civilization, along with hints as to where they might have gone. Along the way, you'll find Modules, expansion units to plug into your ball and increase its capabilities, adding abilities like a protective shield, a rocket engine, and a pair of wings. The game provides a balance of tricky platforming, brain-tickling puzzles, and action combat in order to explore every corner of the ball-rolling genre.
Features include:
12 main levels, along with several small bonus levels
An expansive Split Complex hub
12 Planck Cores for you to collect
12 Modules to power up your ball
30,000 Ion Cells
Unlockable upgrades to your abilities
An awesome soundtrack
And more!

title: Project Louisiana - The BOUNDS VR
description:
게임 정보
Explore and unveil the secrets of an old New Orleans mansion. Investigate your daughter disappearance and unravel the mysteries of a voodoo cult whose interest seems to be revolving around her.
Exploration, puzzles and combat... Will you be strong enough to survive The BOUNDS VR and  face the truth?

title: Leave
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in LEAVE, a narrative-driven platformer and atmospheric adventure that tells a deeply moving story of survival, resilience, and the fight for freedom. Follow the journey of a young child navigating the haunting beauty of a world torn apart by tyranny, experiencing themes of hope, defiance, and the devastating impact of oppression all brought to life through cinematic visuals, emotional storytelling, and seamless gameplay.
Solve intricate puzzles using interactive systems like pushing objects, breaking obstacles with an axe, and crawling under carpets to evade enemies.
Engage with procedural animations and active rag-doll physics for immersive movement and realistic interactions.
Experiment with fun activities like throwing rocks into a lake or playfully interacting with the world around you.

title: Melt Abyss
description:
게임 정보
・Dual protagonists that can be switched at will
You can switch between the two protagonists Kagura Mea and Minato Aqua at will to explore the city freely.
・A variety of VTUBER’s signature skills
There are more than a dozen of VTUBER’s signature skills appearing in the game, such as the famous “Ui Beam”.
・Different bonds with different VTUBERs
In the city, Kagura Mea and Minato Aqua will fight or talk with different VTUBERs, and different VTUBERs will have different attitudes towards the two protagonists.

title: Chaos Ascension
description:
게임 정보
Chaos Ascension은 빠르고 액션 가득한 로그라이트 게임입니다. 각기 독특한 능력, 무기, 플레이 스타일을 가진 다양한 영웅 중 하나를 선택하세요. 적의 무리를 처치하며 강력한 장비를 수집하고 새로운 능력을 해제하며, 여정을 위협하는 보스들과 맞서 싸워야 합니다. 매번 다른 진행이 가능하며, 생존을 위한 나만의 전략을 세울 수 있습니다.
특징:
몬스터 무리를 처치하세요
빠르게 끝나는 20분 러닝
지도를 탐험하며 생존에 도움이 될 다른 주요 지점을 발견하세요
여러 플레이 가능한 클래스 중에서 캐릭터를 선택하세요
경험치 보석을 모으고 레벨을 올리며 다양한 업그레이드 스킬을 선택하세요
장비를 획득하여 캐릭터를 강화하세요
강력한 보스와 대결하세요

title: Forlorn Society
description:
게임 정보
As a supply scout for a struggling survivor colony, your mission is simple: collect supplies, fight off the undead, and bring what you can back to base. But the world is far from simple. The undead aren’t the only danger lurking—other players will stop at nothing to take what you’ve scavenged. In this harsh new world, everyone is a threat.
Key Features:
Top-Down Combat & Survival: Engage in tactical, top-down gameplay where every mission is a fight for survival. Scavenge, shoot, and strategize to make it back to your colony with precious supplies.
Tense PvP and PvE Action: Battle both the relentless undead and hostile players in a constantly shifting, dangerous environment. Your supplies are your lifeline—protect them at all costs.
RPG Progression: Level up your character, improve your skills, and find new gear to help you survive the ever-growing threats in the world.
Persistent Online World: Dive into a living, breathing world where your actions have lasting consequences. Your colony's survival depends on your ability to navigate the dangers of the apocalypse.
Survival at Any Cost: Will you cooperate with other survivors, or will you betray them for your own gain? Every encounter is an opportunity to choose your path—trust is a rare commodity in this new world.
The apocalypse isn’t just a backdrop—it’s your reality. Survive, scavenge, and fight to stay alive in a world where every supply run is a high-stakes gamble. The question isn’t whether you’ll survive—it’s for how long..

title: Transpawt Train
description:
게임 정보
다양한 동물이 함께 살아가는 “발바닥 도시”에 오신 여러분을 환영합니다!
여러분은 “철도 공단”의 직원으로서, 발바닥 도시의 기차 노선들을 설계하고
동물 마을들을 연결하는 임무를 담당합니다.
창의적인 전략과 설계로 동물들의 세상을 이어주세요!
동물 마을을 연결해서 철도를 설계해보세요!
여러분이 설계한 철도를 따라 기차가 운행을 시작해요.
동물 주민들이 편하게 기차를 탑승할 수 있도록 만드세요!

title: COVID-29
description:
게임 정보
Explore inside the human body as a COVID-virus. A single player, action-adventure, indie game created by a doctor.
Gameplay
Single player
Third person
Punching
Kicking
Shooting magic projectiles
Item attacks
Climbing
Style
Action-Adventure
Souls-like elements
Medieval mixed with biology style
Platforming
Character
Play as a customized COVID-virus, choosing your own colors and surface protein shape.

title: Emojis Battle
description:
게임 정보
Emojis Battle에서는 유명한 블루이모지들과 싸워 왕국을 구하세요. 노란 이모지의 역할을 맡고, 한때 하나였던 땅에서 블루이모지들에게 국경일을 주지 않겠다고 한 왕의 결단으로 시작된 1년 간의 갈등에서 승리하세요.
자유로운 선택:
경계가 없습니다! 당신의 전략에 맞는 노란 이모지 군을 구성하세요. 그들의 무기를 선택하고 블루이모지들과의 전투를 이끌어가세요!
블루이모지:

title: Finger Party
description:
게임 정보
Finger Party is a short incremental game about collecting and plopping creatures with your fingers and revealing the mystery about the Finger Party.
Life of a finger:
1. Be a finger
2. Join a party
3. Gain immense power through various finger-related technologies
4. Collect and plop the colorful blobs
5. Gain inside information about the party

Plop the Blobs in this simple and relaxing gameplay loop

title: Roadside Egg Stand
description:
게임 정보
로드사이드 에그 스탠드는 아늑하고 편안한 방치형 게임입니다. 귀여운 길가의 에그 스탠드를 직접 만들고 관리하며 신선한 달걀을 제공하고 작은 마을의 아름다운 도로에 기쁨을 전하세요.
조용한 시골길을 달리다 알록달록한 달걀과 수제 간식, 그리고 "신선한 달걀!"이라는 손글씨 표지가 있는 작은 나무 스탠드를 발견한다고 상상해보세요. 이 따뜻하고 포근한 느낌이 바로 이 게임의 핵심입니다.
행복한 닭 키우기:
닭 떼를 보살피고, 희귀 품종을 발견하며 점박이 달걀부터 황금 달걀까지 수집하세요!
스탠드 꾸미기:
꽃바구니, 랜턴, 꽃 장식과 손으로 그린 표지판을 추가해 스탠드를 더욱 매력적으로 꾸며보세요.
새로운 장소 탐험:
시골길, 숲길, 활기찬 마을 시장 등 아름다운 장소로 사업을 확장하세요.
신선한 달걀, 신선한 수익:
고객을 응대하고, 적절한 가격을 책정하며, 특별한 요청을 처리해 수익을 올리고 닭들이 잘 먹고 행복하도록 돌보세요!
이번 주의 직원:
최고의 닭들에게 재미있는 타이틀과 보상을 제공하며 가족처럼 축하하세요!
여유로운 분위기, 끝없는 재미:

title: Top Check
description:
게임 정보
Collect cards, build decks, and battle fierce opponents in Top Check, a chess inspired rogue-like deck builder and online collectable card game.  Demonstrate your deck building prowess in the rogue-like Challenge Run game mode.  Or clash with adversaries online using your favorite constructed deck.  With a plethora of new pieces and unique abilities, only the best strategists will emerge victorious. Do you have what it takes to reach the top?
Features
Rich tactical combat
Constructed deckbuilding
A tutorial to guide you as a new player
A 1v1 AI Battle mode to test new decks
A dedicated rogue-like game mode with deckbuilding
Online PvP with MMR-based matchmaking
Tons of new pieces and unique abilities
Cosmetic options to personalize your in-game experience

title: Ferro Bellator
description:
게임 정보
Ferro Bellator is an endless foe slaying game about trying to reach the highest floor possible. 
You are a combat robot designed to take part in the fight for multiversal control, for training you are put into an interdimensional elevator, your goal is to prove that you are a worthy soldier. You are given multiple different weapons to combo together to slay your way up the elevator shaft through dimensions

title: SWT: Survivor With Towers
description:
게임 정보
A Unique Fusion of Vampire Survivors and Tower Defense!
Face endless waves of enemies in this thrilling blend of survival action and strategic tower defense! Expand your territory, build powerful towers, and withstand relentless enemy attacks. How long can you survive?
Gameplay
Daytime
Gather resources from the environment to prepare for the night.
Build towers to fortify your defenses.
Strategically expand your territory by creating walls, which generate additional nearby territory.

title: The Indomitable Rocket Dog
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Good Dog Club. Bark fast and bark strong. Rocket jump your way through increasingly difficult levels and don't let anything slow you down.
The Indomitable Rocket Dog is a fast paced, physics-based, 2D platformer time-trial game. Use your rockets to propel yourself through each area as fast as you can and earn a perfect rank on each level.
Inspired by games like N++, Neon White, & Sonic, you'll have to master your physics and momentum to get perfect times.
The game includes a full level editor & leaderboards with the ability to watch world-record runs. It is currently under development and will hopefully release in 2026!

title: Asteroidia
description:
게임 정보
Asteroidia is a simple retro-style arcade shooter. Choose from different ships, each with unique weapons, and blast your way through waves of asteroids and enemies.
Upgrade your weapons, face stronger and numerous enemies, aim for the top! It’s straightforward, fast-paced, and all about chasing high scores.

title: Black Pieces Move First
description:
게임 정보
어느 날, 겸손한 검은 폰이 체스의 첫 번째 규칙에 도전하기로 결심했습니다. 백색 말들은 이에 대해 전혀 만족하지 않았습니다. 결과는? 전쟁이었습니다.
당신은 다양한 체스판에서 검은 폰을 조종하게 됩니다. 클래식 체스의 이동, 방어, 공격 규칙을 따르면서도, 한 가지 변형이 있습니다: 검은 폰은 왕처럼 이동할 수 있는 능력을 가지고 있으며, 검은 말을 밀어내고 명령에 따라 공격하게 할 수 있습니다.
이 퍼즐은 논리적 사고, 민첩성, 창의력을 요구하며, 각 레벨의 목표를 달성하기 위한 해결책을 찾아야 합니다(총 60단계, 점차 난이도가 상승합니다).

title: Push Through Hell
description:
게임 정보
목적
코어를 목적지까지 이동시키세요. 목적지가 어디냐고요? 앞으로... 뒤돌아보지 말고 질문하지 마세요. 단 한 가지만 기억하세요. 당신은 쉽게 대체될 수 있지만, 코어는 그렇지 않습니다. 그러니 당신의 목숨을 걸어서라도 코어를 보호하세요.
장애물
물론, 그렇게 간단하지 않을 겁니다. 당신의 길을 가로막으려는 모든 것이 있을 겁니다. 그들은 당신이 성공하는 것을 원하지 않습니다. 아마도 당신이 성공했을 때 어떤 일이 일어날지 두려워하거나, 아니면 이 세상이 영원히 혼란에 빠져 있기를 바라는 악한 괴물일지도 모릅니다. 상관없습니다, 방아쇠를 당기고 계속 나아가세요.

title: SNOWY MEMORIES
description:
게임 정보
Game Features:
1. A Blend of Metroidvania and Resident Evil Elements: Experience a thrilling survival adventure with deep exploration. Explore vast maps, solve intriguing puzzles, acquire weapons to gain new abilities, unlock new areas, and challenge powerful enemies.
2. Limited Inventory and Ammo Management: Survive with limited ammunition and supplies by carefully managing your inventory. Every bullet counts, and each decision could mean the difference between life and death.
autokwd: SNOWY MEMORIES,寒雪记忆 SNOWY MEMORIES

title: REVENGE CRYSTAL
description:
게임 정보
❝Revenge and Correcting Old Sins Come Together in One Entity❞
Revenge Crystal is an epic top-down action RPG. Awaken as a knight with no memory in a ruined land overrun by mysterious invaders. Battle fierce foes, solve intricate puzzles, and navigate interconnected challenges to reclaim hope.
KEY FEATURES:
Discover a rich, diverse world, bursting with secrets and dangers in every unique environment.
Engage in epic battles with fierce enemies and powerful bosses, testing your combat skills to the max.
Wield magical spells with the option to enhance them with elemental powers for devastating effects.
Embark on intriguing side quests that deepen the lore and add layers to your adventure.
Craft your own journey, making choices that determine your path and the challenges you face.
Customize your character to suit your playstyle, evolving skills and abilities to conquer your foes.

title: Fallen Mankind MMO
description:
게임 정보
Good morning loner, welcome to hell.
Welcome to Fallen Mankind MMO, a world where paradise has turned into a nightmare. The Zone was once a cluster of beautiful islands, the kind you’d see on postcards—lush, vibrant, and full of life. But everything changed after the Event. No one knows exactly what happened, but one day, the skies cracked, the ground was trembling, and strange, unexplainable phenomena began to spread. These anomalies turned the islands into a warped, dangerous wasteland where reality doesn’t always play by the rules.
Governments tried to intervene, but it wasn’t long before they gave up and finished operations, cutting their losses and leaving the islands to rot. That’s when the private military corporations swooped in, hoping to uncover the secrets of the anomalies. The most infamous of these was the Parallax Group. They were well-funded, ruthless, and dead set on figuring out what made The Zone tick. These days, no one knows if they’re still out there. Some say they’re gone for good, while others whisper about shadowy figures and advanced tech still roaming the islands.
Heirloom: A ragtag group of loners and misfits trying to do some good in a place that’s mostly bad. They’re scavengers, researchers, and medics, patching up wounds and digging up answers about The Zone’s mysteries. If you’re looking for people who believe in second chances, you might find a home here.
Outsiders: The kind of people your mom warned you about. These guys live by one rule: take what you want, and don’t leave witnesses. They thrive on chaos and violence, carving a path through The Zone with no regard for anyone but themselves.
Parallax Remnants: They’re less of a faction and more of a legend. Parallax left a big footprint when they were here, high-tech equipment, strange experiments, and a reputation for getting what they wanted, no matter the cost. Some say they’re still out there, pulling the strings, but no one really knows for sure.

The Zone itself is as dangerous as any faction. Anomalies can suck you in, burn you alive, or just straight-up warp reality around you. But they also create artifacts—strange objects that can grant incredible power if you’re brave (or foolish) enough to claim them.
Survival isn’t easy here. Resources are scarce, alliances are fragile, and every decision you make could mean life or death. Will you try to bring people together, uncover the secrets of the anomalies, and maybe make the world a little less horrible? Or will you give in to the chaos, letting The Zone shape you into its next monster?
In Fallen Mankind MMO, the choice is yours. Welcome to The Zone. Try not to die.

title: Cut the Cards
description:
게임 정보
In this roguelike deckbuilder, you cut the cards... literally! With scissors! You can recombine the cut-outs to form new cards, and you can play your custom cards in combat or in text-based dialogue events. The game has a custom language processing engine that will determine the special effects of each new card you make.
(Note: This game does not use generative AI.)

Features:
Hundreds of cards. You can mix-and-match effects from different cards using a unique card-cutting mechanic. There are endless possibilities of what you can make!

title: BUNNY
description:
게임 정보
모험에 뛰어드세요: "BUNNY"를 만나보세요
"BUNNY"는 Bunny와 Smallbird가 친구들을 찾기 위한 모험을 떠나는 횡스크롤 액션 게임입니다. Bunny를 조종하여 스테이지를 탐색하고, 장애물을 극복하고, 벽을 뚫고 지나가세요. 게임 오버는 없으므로 누구나 끝까지 플레이할 수 있습니다.
바쁜 당신을 위해: 단 15분 만에 게임을 즐겨보세요!
이 게임은 단 15분 만에 완료할 수 있으므로 빠른 게임 경험을 즐기고 싶은 사람들에게 적합합니다.
4가지 독특한 코스에서 친구를 만나보세요!
각 코스는 세 가지 매력적인 부분으로 구성되어 있으며, 탐험하고 즐길 수 있는 총 4개의 독특한 코스를 제공합니다.
쉬운 조작: 초보자에게 완벽!
스틱과 버튼 두 개만으로 조작이 간편해 어린 플레이어도 쉽게 즐길 수 있습니다.

title: AREA 8
description:
게임 정보
A science fiction and horror adventure-action game with first-person and third-person gameplay perspectives.
As an operative, you are assigned to a remote research facility known as Area 8, a place so secret that even its name is hidden from the public. What awaits you within this facility are experiments that push the boundaries of science and nature, mind-bending creatures, and fragments of an intricate mystery. But beware—once you step inside, there’s no guarantee of coming back...
If you dare to unveil the mystery, add Area 8 to your wishlist now!

title: Beach Slap
description:
게임 정보
It's time to relax for a vacation, and you finally found your perfect spot. Alas, you're not alone...
There is only one beach and you are a disgruntled, selfish penguin. Dash, stomp and slap your way to vacation supremacy in this chaotic multiplayer brawl.
Control the terrain by changing it to your color. Dash your way across the map, jump and stomp the ground to fling your opponents, or give them the ol' flipper to the head to send them packing to the nearest pit.
Play from 2 to 4 players in local multiplayer, or up to 8 players online (with rollback!) accompanied by a colorful low-poly style and sweet bumpy tunes by Dale North.
Duke it out on hundreds of maps with different gimmicks and items, or create your own with the level editor and play them with your friends locally or online.
Important Note: This is a multiplayer only game! No single player is included

title: Guest Uncovered
description:
게임 정보

Steiner Mansion에서 파티 초대를 받았습니다! 하지만 뭔가 이상한 일이 벌어집니다. 도착한 지 얼마 후에 호스트의 시신이 계단 아래에서 발견됩니다. 퍼즐이 해결되고 범인이 드러날 때까지 집은 잠겨 있습니다. 추리 능력을 시험하는 클래식한 살인 미스터리에 참여하세요.



게임 시작 시, 4-12명의 플레이어가 게스트, 살인자 또는 중립 플레이어로 지원됩니다. 게스트로서 임무는 살인자가 누구인지에 대한 단서를 찾는 것입니다. 살인자로서 임무는 모든 게스트들을 숫자로 앞서서 게임을 이기는 것인데, 적발되지 않아야 합니다이를 위해서는 다른 플레이어들을 속이고 기만하여 그들을 소수로 만들면서 하나씩 제거해야 합니다. 중립 플레이어로서 임무는 살인자로부터 죽지 않고 미팅 중에 추방되지 않으면서 자신의 목표를 달성하는 것입니다. 가끔 특별한 게스트 또는 특별한 살인자로 스폰될 기회가 있을 것입니다. 이러한 역할은 팀이 게임에서 이기도록 도울 특별한 능력을 가질 것입니다.
게스트로서 플레이하세요.
게스트들은 게임에서 승리하려면 지도를 탈출할 수 있는 출구를 여는 데 필요한 일련의 작업을 수행해야 합니다. 또한 시체의 위치를 찾아내고, 살인에 사용된 살인 도구를 발견하고, 살인자가 누구인지에 대한 단서를 찾아 수수께끼를 풀어야 합니다.


살인자들은 다음 희생자를 결정하면서 가짜 작업을 수행할 것입니다. 게스트들에게 보이지 않게 살인 도구를 획득하세요. 희생자를 선택하세요. 은밀하고 살인 모드로 전환하세요. 게스트들과 중립 플레이어를 죽이세요. 적발되지 않고 모든 게스트들을 숫자로 앞서면 게임에서 승리하세요.
중립 플레이어들에게도 가짜 작업이 주어지며 게임에서 승리하기 위해 수행해야 할 목표가 있을 것입니다.

의사가 되어 게스트를 구하거나 혹은 탐정과 함께 숨겨진 단서를 찾아보세요. 특별한 역할을 가진 플레이어들은 게임에서 승리하는 데 도움이 되는 능력을 가질 수 있습니다.







시체를 발견하거나 살인자가 누군지 알게 되면, 회의를 소집하세요. 회의 동안 남은 플레이어들은 가능한 범인에 대해 토론합니다. 상대 플레이어 중 한 명을 투표하여 추방하거나 안전하게 투표를 건너뛰는 선택은 몫입니다.
게스트들과 중립 플레이어들은 지도 주변의 아이템 상자에 접근하여 살인자에게 대항할 방법을 제공받을 것입니다.

title: Cold Salvage
description:
게임 정보
Cold Salvage is a co-operative survival game.

Take on the role of a blue-collar salvage engineer. Take contracts, working in the cold depths of space - in a job full of danger and riches. Claim your own tug from the junkyards, and earn credits to upgrade and repair it's systems. Then work with your team to return abandoned vessels to service... but watch for what lurks in the dark.

Stemming the tide of war depends on you. Return the warships to the docks, or destroy them where they drift. The horrors on board cannot be allowed to reach Earth.

title: A Father's Tale
description:
게임 정보
A Father's Tale is a story about grief and acceptance. After the loss of your son, you magically get sucked into his drawing book that contains a fantasy world inside. Explore this land with colorful creatures and beautiful landscapes in a Top-Down view of the Father. Jumping, crouching and running your way through obstacles
The book soon becomes a way to reconnect with your loved one. All your memories are written and drawn inside but suddenly it's revealed this kingdom is being taken under control of a powerful and mysterious entity. All it's colors are vanishing and you will need to find a way to save the joy and colors from the book.
In this adventure, you will solve puzzles to open new paths and learn about this world. Evil creatures will, however, try to stop you. Their objective is to fill the land with darkness and sadness by using their dark magic so you will need to sneak around them. Using covers and distractions, they will be no match for you.
During your journey, a magic crystal will become your most powerful ally. It will contain many powers, including coloring what was once lost to the corruption from darkness. Some objects you encounter during your exploration are corrupted by darkness and grief. You will have the power to restore their color and thus, progressing in your quest.

title: Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate
description:
게임 정보
In a medieval world consumed by darkness,
you are the last hope—a lord tasked with saving your people.
As night falls, monsters emerge, threatening your village's survival.
To fight back and thrive, you must rely on a mysterious magic coin pusher.
Push coins to summon heroes, forge weapons, and gather resources.
Strategically combine cards to unleash powerful effects, repel monsters, and unlock greater rewards.
Blending slot-machine randomness with roguelike progression, the game offers a unique experience:
Push coins, collect resources: Trigger rewards and build your stockpile.
Recruit heroes, defend your land: Summon warriors, mages, and builders to fight for survival.
Synergize and upgrade: Chain card effects to unlock massive multipliers and dominate the darkness.
Will you save your resources for the future or risk it all for immediate gain?
Lead your village through the night and into the light!
Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate
a test of survival and fate.
Ready to take the challenge?
autokwd: Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate

title: Mac & Jack: Candy Bashers
description:
게임 정보
As the old saying goes, nothing stands between a Pumpkin and their Cat.
In Mac & Jack: Candy Bashers you'll brave the Halloween night and work to survive against waves of monsters while collecting as much candy as you can! Discover new items by Trick-or-Treating between waves, purchase them from the shopkeeper for permanent use, and build a loadout that customizes the difficulty of every run!
And if the monsters have you feeling a little tense? Take a second to breathe and just spend time with your friend. 
Features:
Wave based runs that are customized by what items you choose to bring. Looking for an easy breezy run? Pack a little less! Thrive on difficulty? Bring all you can carry!
Over a dozen unique items and accessories to unlock!

title: Golden Soul
description:
게임 정보
Who should rule the human's fate–
The human itself or an abstract god?
This is a clash between past and future, tradition and progress, beliefs and ideals.
After a tragic event, you find yourself trapped in a magical time loop. Half a century passes, and your soul withers away, leaving behind an empty shell to aimlessly wander the abyss.
But fate still has plans for you.
A mysterious mage appears, granting you a Golden Soul and saving you from eternal oblivion. Your real soul holds your personality, memories, and emotions. The Golden Soul is a magical imitation that prolongs your existence – but you feel nothing. No blood courses through your veins, no morality guides your actions.

title: OMEXYAN
description:
게임 정보
Test your skills and become the champion of the Universal Games!
The galaxy is watching you in this once-in-a-millennium competition. 
Step into the world of OMEXYAN, where movement, rhythm, and skill rule the arena! Feel the adrenaline in this dynamic VR game that challenges your reflexes and precision.
-Dive into the world of OMEXYAN, where reflexes, precision, and skill dominate in an exciting VR adventure!
Use the color-catching devices in your hands to collect incoming red and green orbs. Then, control two colorful remote devices to aim at and hit the matching-colored cubes accurately. In the third challenge, wield a sporty laser weapon to shoot the correct-colored targets with precision.
Earn points, unlock new levels and arenas, and face increasingly challenging and diverse tasks. With a fast-paced soundtrack accompanying your gameplay, OMEXYAN ensures you’re fully immersed in a dynamic and thrilling experience.
This game focuses on skill-based challenges and dynamic VR gameplay, offering exciting and captivating entertainment.

title: Pizza Super Slice
description:
게임 정보
Pizza Super Slice is a cartoon-exploration-platformer in which you play as an animated pizza slice. Explore a strange, cartoonish town full of little secrets, dark corners and secret passages.

title: Fling your Friends TD - Tower Defense
description:
게임 정보
Dedicated to my daughter. Wherever you are, I hope you know that you are loved.
Fling your Friends TD is the ultimate party game that will have you and your friends laughing, strategizing, and outsmarting each other in the most entertaining showdown ever! In this game, players take on the roles of either the Defender or the Attackers in a wild and whimsical battle of wits and creativity.
Defender:
Build Your Fortress: Carefully place traps and obstacles to create a formidable defense that will challenge the Attackers.
Special Abilities: Use unique abilities to disrupt and thwart the Attackers' progress, adding an extra layer of strategy to your defenses.
Attacker:
Plan and Conquer: Strategically plan your route and collaborate with your friends (or go solo) to navigate through the Defender's traps.
Character Progression: Level up your character's skills and counter the Defender's strategies.
Overcome Challenges: Utilize special abilities to outmaneuver obstacles and reach your goal.
Key Features
Cooperative PvP Multiplayer: Engage in thrilling multiplayer modes, teaming up with and against friends in a battle of cunning.
Creative Trap: Place an array of imaginative traps that will keep the Attackers on their toes.
Hilarious Gameplay: Experience the fun and chaos of a light-hearted game designed to bring joy and laughter to your gaming sessions.
Strategic Depth: Balance creativity and strategy to outwit your opponents and achieve victory.
Vibrant Visuals: Enjoy colorful and cartoony graphics that enhance the game's charm and appeal.
Replayability: Every game offers a unique experience with countless trap combinations and strategies to explore.
autokwd: Fling your Friends TD - Tower Defense

title: Lobsterpunk
description:
게임 정보
Lobsterpunk is a puzzle, walking simulator where you make your way through an abandon city powered solely by the combustion of lobsters. Bring the dead machinery one last breath of life before their steel forms lay cold forever. As you do, see the memories of the last man on earth, the ones he loved, the ones he lost, & the mistakes he made to get to where he is.
Complete lockpicking puzzles to traverse this dead city, explore any house you desire, find the story of those who once lived here through what they left behind & how familiar that might feel, however foreign the setting.
Lockpicking Systems:
Lockpicking uses W,A,S,D to turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find the sweet spot in a lock!
Volt Wave uses W,A,S,D toto turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find a moving sweet spot on a panel!
Gearbox uses W,A,S,D to turn parts of a specialized lockpicking tool to find the sweet spot in a set of 3 layered gears!

title: Filtration
description:
게임 정보
From the developer that brought you Quaternion comes a new ball-rolling platform challenge that's bigger, better, and full of surprises! Jump, bounce, blast, and fly through 12 pocket dimensions in order to harvest the precious power sources within. Find Modules that let your ball do things you've never seen before at the touch of a button. With robotic foes and tricky puzzles in your way, it's gonna take a lot more than Ion Cells to get through this!
Filtration is a single-player puzzle platform game. By rolling a robotic ball, you'll explore and unlock the secrets of the lost Amali civilization, along with hints as to where they might have gone. Along the way, you'll find Modules, expansion units to plug into your ball and increase its capabilities, adding abilities like a protective shield, a rocket engine, and a pair of wings. The game provides a balance of tricky platforming, brain-tickling puzzles, and action combat in order to explore every corner of the ball-rolling genre.
Features include:
12 main levels, along with several small bonus levels
An expansive Split Complex hub
12 Planck Cores for you to collect
12 Modules to power up your ball
30,000 Ion Cells
Unlockable upgrades to your abilities
An awesome soundtrack
And more!

title: Project Louisiana - The BOUNDS VR
description:
게임 정보
Explore and unveil the secrets of an old New Orleans mansion. Investigate your daughter disappearance and unravel the mysteries of a voodoo cult whose interest seems to be revolving around her.
Exploration, puzzles and combat... Will you be strong enough to survive The BOUNDS VR and  face the truth?

title: Leave
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in LEAVE, a narrative-driven platformer and atmospheric adventure that tells a deeply moving story of survival, resilience, and the fight for freedom. Follow the journey of a young child navigating the haunting beauty of a world torn apart by tyranny, experiencing themes of hope, defiance, and the devastating impact of oppression all brought to life through cinematic visuals, emotional storytelling, and seamless gameplay.
Solve intricate puzzles using interactive systems like pushing objects, breaking obstacles with an axe, and crawling under carpets to evade enemies.
Engage with procedural animations and active rag-doll physics for immersive movement and realistic interactions.
Experiment with fun activities like throwing rocks into a lake or playfully interacting with the world around you.

title: Melt Abyss
description:
게임 정보
・Dual protagonists that can be switched at will
You can switch between the two protagonists Kagura Mea and Minato Aqua at will to explore the city freely.
・A variety of VTUBER’s signature skills
There are more than a dozen of VTUBER’s signature skills appearing in the game, such as the famous “Ui Beam”.
・Different bonds with different VTUBERs
In the city, Kagura Mea and Minato Aqua will fight or talk with different VTUBERs, and different VTUBERs will have different attitudes towards the two protagonists.

title: Chaos Ascension
description:
게임 정보
Chaos Ascension은 빠르고 액션 가득한 로그라이트 게임입니다. 각기 독특한 능력, 무기, 플레이 스타일을 가진 다양한 영웅 중 하나를 선택하세요. 적의 무리를 처치하며 강력한 장비를 수집하고 새로운 능력을 해제하며, 여정을 위협하는 보스들과 맞서 싸워야 합니다. 매번 다른 진행이 가능하며, 생존을 위한 나만의 전략을 세울 수 있습니다.
특징:
몬스터 무리를 처치하세요
빠르게 끝나는 20분 러닝
지도를 탐험하며 생존에 도움이 될 다른 주요 지점을 발견하세요
여러 플레이 가능한 클래스 중에서 캐릭터를 선택하세요
경험치 보석을 모으고 레벨을 올리며 다양한 업그레이드 스킬을 선택하세요

title: Forlorn Society
description:
게임 정보
As a supply scout for a struggling survivor colony, your mission is simple: collect supplies, fight off the undead, and bring what you can back to base. But the world is far from simple. The undead aren’t the only danger lurking—other players will stop at nothing to take what you’ve scavenged. In this harsh new world, everyone is a threat.
Key Features:
Top-Down Combat & Survival: Engage in tactical, top-down gameplay where every mission is a fight for survival. Scavenge, shoot, and strategize to make it back to your colony with precious supplies.
Tense PvP and PvE Action: Battle both the relentless undead and hostile players in a constantly shifting, dangerous environment. Your supplies are your lifeline—protect them at all costs.
RPG Progression: Level up your character, improve your skills, and find new gear to help you survive the ever-growing threats in the world.
Persistent Online World: Dive into a living, breathing world where your actions have lasting consequences. Your colony's survival depends on your ability to navigate the dangers of the apocalypse.
Survival at Any Cost: Will you cooperate with other survivors, or will you betray them for your own gain? Every encounter is an opportunity to choose your path—trust is a rare commodity in this new world.
The apocalypse isn’t just a backdrop—it’s your reality. Survive, scavenge, and fight to stay alive in a world where every supply run is a high-stakes gamble. The question isn’t whether you’ll survive—it’s for how long..

title: Transpawt Train
description:

다양한 동물이 함께 살아가는 “발바닥 도시”에 오신 여러분을 환영합니다!
여러분은 “철도 공단”의 직원으로서, 발바닥 도시의 기차 노선들을 설계하고
동물 마을들을 연결하는 임무를 담당합니다.
창의적인 전략과 설계로 동물들의 세상을 이어주세요!
동물 마을을 연결해서 철도를 설계해보세요!
여러분이 설계한 철도를 따라 기차가 운행을 시작해요.
동물 주민들이 편하게 기차를 탑승할 수 있도록 만드세요!

title: COVID-29

Action-Adventure

Medieval mixed with biology style

title: Emojis Battle
description:
게임 정보
Emojis Battle에서는 유명한 블루이모지들과 싸워 왕국을 구하세요. 노란 이모지의 역할을 맡고, 한때 하나였던 땅에서 블루이모지들에게 국경일을 주지 않겠다고 한 왕의 결단으로 시작된 1년 간의 갈등에서 승리하세요.

경계가 없습니다! 당신의 전략에 맞는 노란 이모지 군을 구성하세요. 그들의 무기를 선택하고 블루이모지들과의 전투를 이끌어가세요!

Life of a finger:

title: Roadside Egg Stand
description:
게임 정보
로드사이드 에그 스탠드는 아늑하고 편안한 방치형 게임입니다. 귀여운 길가의 에그 스탠드를 직접 만들고 관리하며 신선한 달걀을 제공하고 작은 마을의 아름다운 도로에 기쁨을 전하세요.
조용한 시골길을 달리다 알록달록한 달걀과 수제 간식, 그리고 "신선한 달걀!"이라는 손글씨 표지가 있는 작은 나무 스탠드를 발견한다고 상상해보세요. 이 따뜻하고 포근한 느낌이 바로 이 게임의 핵심입니다.
행복한 닭 키우기:
닭 떼를 보살피고, 희귀 품종을 발견하며 점박이 달걀부터 황금 달걀까지 수집하세요!
스탠드 꾸미기:
꽃바구니, 랜턴, 꽃 장식과 손으로 그린 표지판을 추가해 스탠드를 더욱 매력적으로 꾸며보세요.
새로운 장소 탐험:
시골길, 숲길, 활기찬 마을 시장 등 아름다운 장소로 사업을 확장하세요.
신선한 달걀, 신선한 수익:
고객을 응대하고, 적절한 가격을 책정하며, 특별한 요청을 처리해 수익을 올리고 닭들이 잘 먹고 행복하도록 돌보세요!
이번 주의 직원:
최고의 닭들에게 재미있는 타이틀과 보상을 제공하며 가족처럼 축하하세요!

title: Top Check
description:
게임 정보
Collect cards, build decks, and battle fierce opponents in Top Check, a chess inspired rogue-like deck builder and online collectable card game.  Demonstrate your deck building prowess in the rogue-like Challenge Run game mode.  Or clash with adversaries online using your favorite constructed deck.  With a plethora of new pieces and unique abilities, only the best strategists will emerge victorious. Do you have what it takes to reach the top?
Features
Rich tactical combat
Constructed deckbuilding
A tutorial to guide you as a new player
A 1v1 AI Battle mode to test new decks
A dedicated rogue-like game mode with deckbuilding
Online PvP with MMR-based matchmaking
Tons of new pieces and unique abilities
Cosmetic options to personalize your in-game experience

title: Ferro Bellator
description:
게임 정보
Ferro Bellator is an endless foe slaying game about trying to reach the highest floor possible. 
You are a combat robot designed to take part in the fight for multiversal control, for training you are put into an interdimensional elevator, your goal is to prove that you are a worthy soldier. You are given multiple different weapons to combo together to slay your way up the elevator shaft through dimensions

title: SWT: Survivor With Towers
description:
게임 정보
A Unique Fusion of Vampire Survivors and Tower Defense!
Face endless waves of enemies in this thrilling blend of survival action and strategic tower defense! Expand your territory, build powerful towers, and withstand relentless enemy attacks. How long can you survive?
Gameplay
Daytime
Gather resources from the environment to prepare for the night.
Build towers to fortify your defenses.
Strategically expand your territory by creating walls, which generate additional nearby territory.

title: The Indomitable Rocket Dog
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Good Dog Club. Bark fast and bark strong. Rocket jump your way through increasingly difficult levels and don't let anything slow you down.
The Indomitable Rocket Dog is a fast paced, physics-based, 2D platformer time-trial game. Use your rockets to propel yourself through each area as fast as you can and earn a perfect rank on each level.
Inspired by games like N++, Neon White, & Sonic, you'll have to master your physics and momentum to get perfect times.
The game includes a full level editor & leaderboards with the ability to watch world-record runs. It is currently under development and will hopefully release in 2026!

title: Asteroidia
description:
게임 정보
Asteroidia is a simple retro-style arcade shooter. Choose from different ships, each with unique weapons, and blast your way through waves of asteroids and enemies.
Upgrade your weapons, face stronger and numerous enemies, aim for the top! It’s straightforward, fast-paced, and all about chasing high scores.

title: Black Pieces Move First
description:
게임 정보
어느 날, 겸손한 검은 폰이 체스의 첫 번째 규칙에 도전하기로 결심했습니다. 백색 말들은 이에 대해 전혀 만족하지 않았습니다. 결과는? 전쟁이었습니다.
당신은 다양한 체스판에서 검은 폰을 조종하게 됩니다. 클래식 체스의 이동, 방어, 공격 규칙을 따르면서도, 한 가지 변형이 있습니다: 검은 폰은 왕처럼 이동할 수 있는 능력을 가지고 있으며, 검은 말을 밀어내고 명령에 따라 공격하게 할 수 있습니다.
이 퍼즐은 논리적 사고, 민첩성, 창의력을 요구하며, 각 레벨의 목표를 달성하기 위한 해결책을 찾아야 합니다(총 60단계, 점차 난이도가 상승합니다).

title: Push Through Hell
description:
게임 정보
목적
코어를 목적지까지 이동시키세요. 목적지가 어디냐고요? 앞으로... 뒤돌아보지 말고 질문하지 마세요. 단 한 가지만 기억하세요. 당신은 쉽게 대체될 수 있지만, 코어는 그렇지 않습니다. 그러니 당신의 목숨을 걸어서라도 코어를 보호하세요.
장애물
물론, 그렇게 간단하지 않을 겁니다. 당신의 길을 가로막으려는 모든 것이 있을 겁니다. 그들은 당신이 성공하는 것을 원하지 않습니다. 아마도 당신이 성공했을 때 어떤 일이 일어날지 두려워하거나, 아니면 이 세상이 영원히 혼란에 빠져 있기를 바라는 악한 괴물일지도 모릅니다. 상관없습니다, 방아쇠를 당기고 계속 나아가세요.

title: SNOWY MEMORIES

게임 정보

2. Limited Inventory and Ammo Management: Survive with limited ammunition and supplies by carefully managing your inventory. Every bullet counts, and each decision could mean the difference between life and death.

Embark on an adventure to save your home from a trio of mischievous crows! Tumble through challenging platforming levels as an egg and reach each nest to progress onward. Navigate treacherous cliffs, activate mechanisms, ride quick-moving platforms, and dodge impeding creatures that guard your path.
Reach The Nest

Avoid Enemies

title: A Difficult Game About Letters
description:
게임 정보
When your best friend falls into trouble, it’s up to you to embark on a daring journey through the Land of Letters.

In A Difficult Game About Letters, you take control of a character who can transform into any letter of the alphabet. Each letter's shape provides unique abilities, which you’ll need to solve puzzles, navigate obstacles, and complete challenging platforming levels.
Here’s what you can do in the game:
Transform Into Letters: Instantly switch between 26 different letters to adapt to obstacles. Each letter's shape can help you in unique ways.
Jump Across Platforms: Use letters like J or V to jump higher or leap across wide gaps.
Hook and Grab: Turn into L or T to hook onto ledges, edges, or moving platforms.
                          Roll and Squeeze: Transform into round letters like O or C to roll through tight spaces or under obstacles.

title: Albatross program
description:
게임 정보
You awaken on an unknown island, your mind shrouded in fog and no memory of how you arrived. All you know is that the puzzles around you are the only way to uncover the truth and find a way out.
Albatross Program is an immersive puzzle game that guides you through a world of mysterious locations and intriguing challenges. Each solved puzzle reveals fragments of a greater secret, bringing you closer to the heart of the mystery.
Albatross Program is a single-player, first-person experience where every element is designed to respect your curiosity and the value of your time. There are no fillers: every challenge, choice, and discovery adds depth to the experience, introducing new mechanics and ideas. In short, it’s a journey full of surprises and innovation.
An experience that will test your wits and determination, where every step is a discovery, and every solution unveils a new revelation.

title: Touhou Farming ~ Minoriko's Homestead Harvest
description:
게임 정보
This is an unofficial fan work produced under the Touhou Project fan content guidelines. Touhou Project is the property of Team Shanghai Alice / ZUN.
You are MINORIKO AKI, Symbol of Abundance, one of the eight million gods! The field for harvest gods is particularly competitive, so the amount of faith you've been able to scrape together has been modest at best. However, your time to shine is fast approaching!
Gensokyo is growing! As more gods and youkai take refuge from the outside world in this sealed-off fantasy land, more humans are needed to sustain them; thus, many big-name youkai are taking an extended vacation to give the Human Village some breathing room to grow.
This is a big opportunity to increase your popularity! Conspiring with the Moriya Shrine, you aim to help the village expand by supplying it with as many healthy crops as your divine, dirty little hands can cultivate. Time to get to work!
~
Minoriko's Homestead Harvest is a traditional farm sim set against the colorful backdrop of Touhou Project's Gensokyo. Rather than trying to split the difference between casual players and those that enjoy a time management challenge, it offers two gameplay modes:
In Casual Mode, you have as much time each day as you like, and you can play at your own pace to complete the game by meeting certain story objectives.
In Serious Mode, each day has a time limit, and you have two in-game years to reach your goal of gathering enough faith through Minoriko's farming operation. Some additional hurdles to make resource management more robust are added as well.
There's more to planning out your farm than just aesthetics! You can't walk through your crops after they've sprouted, so you'll need to plan their placement with care, but your tools can upgrade their area of effect in many ways to suit whatever layout you please. You can build terraces to grow rice and other aquatic crops, as well as lay out an irrigation system through hoses and sprinklers with a variety of patterns.  Players that enjoy a light engineering challenge will find themselves at home here.
Various side sources of income such as fishing and mining are available, but if you want some real excitement, head into Youkai Mountain's adventure zones for some shooting action and loot! (Note: In development, no screenshots yet!)
The nearby Yasaka Resort Town and surrounding Youkai Mountain feature a large number of the eccentric (and notoriously combative) characters Touhou is known for, but what's a farm sim without a bit of romance?

title: Auridia
description:
게임 정보
Auridia is a short metroidvania where you explore an interconnected world filled with intricate platforming challenges. Unlock new biomes by chaining together abilities you learn, such as climb, grapple, throw, and parry. Examine dozens of artifacts, commune with forgotten gods, and piece together what happened to Auridia.
Explore an unlocking world
In the ruins of Auridia, you will find obstacles you are not prepared for. Mark them on your map, and return when you've learned more. Or perhaps you'll find another way around...
Overcome platforming challenges
Some areas will require you to string together all the abilities you have learned. Think carefully about when you use which ones, because your stamina is limited.

title: Sketch Magician
description:
게임 정보
Sketch Magician is a 2D action game where players fight using sketches as weapons.
In a world of sketchbooks where you get lost, you control a stick figure wizard and defeat enemies by firing freely drawn pictures as attacks.
Experience a sketch battle like never before, where your strategy and creativity will be tested!
◆ How sketch magic works
When you sketch and decide the direction of the shot, the picture you drew will become an attack!
Arrow-like attacks, shields to block enemy attacks, barriers to trap enemies... it's all up to your sketch.
Unlock new sketch techniques and expand your strategy!
◆ Game progress
As you clear stages, more powerful enemies appear.
Boss battles require unique sketch tactics!
As you progress through the game, new skills will be unlocked and you will be able to draw more magic.
◆ Game modes
Enjoy sketch battles in single player mode.
Play VS mode with your friends in multiplayer mode. (To be added in an update!)

title: 帕斯的餐厅Pas's restaurant
description:
게임 정보
당신의 레스토랑을 운영하십시오.
환상적인 다른 세계에서 유일무이한 레스토랑을 운영하십시오.
사랑스러운 손님들을 만날 수 있으며 그들을 정기 고객으로 만드십시오.
장식하고, 당신의 레스토랑을 개조하십시오.
다양한 스타일의 가구를 사용하여 당신의 레스토랑에 개성을 더하십시오.
더 많은 손님을 끌어들이십시오 그리고 당신만의 스타일을 구축하십시오.

title: Throw A Life!
description:
게임 정보
Throw A Life! is a party survival game for up to four players! Team up with friends to mine, craft, build, and hunt as you work together to survive on a harsh island. Strategize by dividing roles or embrace the chaos and have fun! Show off your teamwork and take on the adventure!
Survive as long as you can!
Teamwork is essential to endure the harsh survival challenge.
Divide tasks like mining, crafting, building, and hunting wisely to make it through!
…But beware of hunger.
Prepare for enemy surprise attack!
Hurry... The enemy attacks at night!
Craft weapons and build your base before night falls to prepare for the enemy's surprise attack!

title: 我在地府打麻将 - Demonic Mahjong
description:
게임 정보
Demonic Mahjong is a Roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by the timeless mechanics of Mahjong. Masterfully use the tiles in your hand to craft powerful combinations, reach staggering high scores, and develop strategies that are uniquely your own!
It’s Mahjong, but not just Mahjong:
Scoring follows basic Mahjong rules, so if you know how to play Mahjong, you’re already halfway there!
Roguelike gameplay is seamlessly integrated into the Mahjong foundation. Find your best strategy to win big!
It’s not just about getting high scores; the key is to find a way to defeat the boss!

title: SherloCAT Nonogram Rio
description:
게임 정보
새로운 모험을 준비하세요! 게임 세계에서 가장 매력적인 탐정 고양이, SherloCat이 이제 리오데자네이로의 중심으로 오셨습니다! SherloCat Nonogram Rio에서는 리오의 랜드마크인 슈가로프, 구세주 그리스도상, 코파카바나 해변 등을 배경으로 한 논리 퍼즐을 해결하는 도전을 하게 될 것입니다.
Picross, 또한 hanjie 또는 nonogram으로 알려진 이 게임은 전 세계적으로 매우 인기 있는 퍼즐 게임으로 문제 해결 능력을 테스트합니다. 여러 개의 칸으로 구성된 그리드가 제공되며, 각 칸은 채우거나 비워 둘 수 있습니다. 목표는 제공된 힌트를 바탕으로 빈 칸을 채워서 숨겨진 이미지를 나타내는 것입니다. 이 게임을 처음 접하시나요? 걱정하지 마세요! 이 게임은 다양한 난이도 레벨을 제공하여 모두가 즐길 수 있는 경험을 제공하며, 여러분이 Picross의 달인이 되도록 도와줍니다!
경험을 선택하세요! 두 가지 게임 모드가 있습니다. 클래식 모드는 여유롭고 편안한 경험을 원하는 사람들을 위한 모드입니다. 반면, 도전 모드는 타이머와 오류 제한이 있어 당신의 사고력을 시험할 수 있는 모드입니다.

title: Grim Pastures
description:
게임 정보
Grim Pastures는 1970년대의 향수를 불러일으키는 농장 환경을 배경으로 한 멀티플레이어 생존 사회 추리 게임입니다. 이 게임에서 각 플레이어는 계절 근로자를 연기하지만, 농장에는 위협이 존재합니다. 연쇄 살인범이 마을 사람들 사이에 숨어 있으며, 생산 과정을 방해하려고 합니다.
각 플레이어는 고유한 능력을 가지고 있습니다. 어떤 플레이어는 민첩하고 빠르며, 어떤 플레이어는 리더십을 발휘하고, 또 다른 플레이어는 농업과 축산에 특화되어 있습니다. 게임이 시작되면 살인범은 비밀리에 선택되고, 플레이어들은 서로를 신뢰해야 합니다. 살인범은 마을 사람들의 일을 방해하려고 하며, 마을 사람들은 생존하고 농장의 임무를 완료하기 위해 서로를 신뢰해야 합니다.
농장에서의 임무에는 채소, 과일, 고기, 유제품, 목재, 건초 등 중요한 자원의 생산이 포함됩니다. 시간이 제한되어 있고, 각 임무는 정해진 시간 내에 완료되어야 합니다. 그러나 이 과정은 살인범의 방해로 위협받고 있습니다. 살인범은 생산 지역을 파괴하거나 작업자를 방해하거나 주의를 분산시켜 마을 사람들이 임무를 완료하는 것을 어렵게 만들 수 있습니다. 마을 사람들의 유일한 목표는 생산을 제때 완료하고 농장의 질서를 유지하면서 살인범으로부터 자신을 보호하는 것입니다.
Grim Pastures에서 생존하는 것은 단지 임무를 완료하는 것만이 아닙니다. 그것은 전략, 팀워크, 그리고 누구도 신뢰하지 않는 것을 의미합니다. 어떤 마을 사람이 동료이고 어떤 마을 사람이 적일까요? 아무도 확신할 수 없습니다. 이것은 매 순간이 긴장감과 흥분으로 가득 차게 만듭니다. 각 플레이어는 자신의 추측과 관찰에 의존해야 합니다.
이 게임에서 당신은 농장에서의 생산을 완료하는 것뿐만 아니라 서로를 보호하며 생존해야 합니다. Grim Pastures는 인내, 집중, 완벽한 타이밍이 필요한 도전입니다. 결국, 누가 살아남을까요? 당신과 당신의 팀을 기다리고 있는 것은 놀라움과 흥분으로 가득 찬 경험입니다!

title: Village Empires
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of tactics in the Village Empires game! Here you have to manage both the entire army and individual units from a third-person perspective. In the game, you will be immersed in a gloomy atmosphere. You are surrounded by various enemies and other difficulties, and you will build an empire.
Main features of the game:
1. Army and unit management: You will be able to control both entire troops and individual fighters, solving complex tasks and extracting unique resources.
2. Item Creation: The extracted resources can be used to create new items, which can then be mass-produced and used to strengthen your army.
3. Battles and tactics: To win, you need to destroy all the enemies on the map. Use your strategic skills and tactical techniques to defeat your opponents.
Are you ready to take on the challenge and survive in this dangerous world? Then go to the dark times and test your survival skills!

title: Multi Deck Hero
description:
게임 정보
Master the Power of Synergy in Multi Deck Hero!
Multi Deck Hero is a roguelike deckbuilder where strategy and synergy determine your survival. With three dynamic decks at your command, you must tactically combine your cards, unlock powerful charms, and defeat an endless wave of evolving enemies.
Every turn, make the most of your cards, create devastating combos, and discover new strategies with each run. Will you master the perfect deck or fall to the growing challenge?
🃏 Key Features:
Unique Multi-Deck System – Draw and play from three different decks, mixing strategies to outsmart your foes.
Powerful Charms – Unlock game-changing passive effects that enhance your deck’s synergy.
Roguelike Progression – Face increasingly powerful enemies and adapt to ever-changing challenges.
Endless Replayability – No two runs are the same, thanks to randomized card offerings and charm combinations.
Can You Build the Ultimate Deck?
Survive, strategize, and prove your skills in Multi Deck Hero! Wishlist now and prepare for the challenge!
👉 Wishlist Now! 🚀

title: Idle Bones Magic
description:
게임 정보
Idle Bones Magic is an idler incremental game you play as a necromancer raising the dead and snowballing them into enormous hosts.
Go from a lowly initiate in the dark arts to a powerful necromancer taking over the world with hordes of countless zombies. You'll manage your resources to raise all sorts of creatures, which you'll put to work gathering more resources and attacking your enemies.
Start from animating bones into skeletal servants. Use them to pick up more bones to make more of themselves, then start exploring, expanding, and exploiting your surroundings. Shortly you'll be amassing thousands of zombies and taking over entire countries, learning how to create even more powerful creatures and indoctrinating more necromancers into your cult.
Unleash a zombie apocalypse on this unsuspecting world and watch your hordes multiply and take over everything.

title: Block King Demands Red Squares
description:
게임 정보
Block King Demands Red Squares!
You play as the advisor of the Block King in the Shapes Kingdom. The king is a bit of a handful and impulsive so you need to do your best to try to fulfil his requests while keeping the citizens happy. If your reputation gets too low, you will get fired.
Construct a robust trading network
You're in change of constructing the necessary industries and infrastructure needed to fulfil the quests given to you. Construct harvesters which harvest shapes, send them to factories which processes them into new shapes. After that you need to make sure that the logistic network can deliver the shapes to the correct town without causing stoppages.
Space is premium
Having to work with limited sites to fit all the necessary buildings means you need to plan accordingly to get them to fit. You cannot simply make one town which creates everything, you need to send them across the country to build larger so making sure that the logistical network works is important.
Multiple scenarios
The game is divided into multiple different scenarios. Each one tasking you with a different set of quests and towns to work with, giving you new challenges. There is also a free play mode which is more open and allows you to decide more freely how you decide to advance your industry.

title: Make Us Whole
description:
게임 정보
Features
Hours of gathering and exploration in a dystopian horror-scape
A unique blend of fps action and survival horror in an endless expanse of brutalist architecture
An oppressive atmosphere of isolation in a treacherous ever-changing environment
Diverse creatures able to stalk, hunt, and devour the unprepared player
A story hidden between the cracks of concrete revealing humanity’s downfall
HARVEST
Scavenge broken machines and twisted horrors for resources rusty and alien. Choose what to scrap and what to collect, praying you find extraction chambers to save your precious loot. Will you take the gambles and boons of the maze, or embrace a slow risk-free grind?
UPGRADE
Return to the nest to upgrade and evolve your weaponry. Fuse artifacts with your tools to unlock new attributes and powers. Grow or perish. But what are you willing to sacrifice for your survival? Take care human, lest you become something else…
DISCOVER
Navigate this maze of horror, discover new environments hidden in the depths, and hunt greater monstrosities… or become the hunted. Watch your step. This place wasn’t built for humans

title: Dark Heart: 50000
description:
게임 정보
한순간에 모든 것을 잃고 미지의 세계로 던져진 소년 「N」과 함께, 『Dark Heart: 50000』에서 공포와 신비로 가득 찬 세계를 경험해보세요. 「N」은 사랑하는 「S」를 구출하기 위해, 초현실적인 차원을 넘나들며 위험천만한 여정을 시작합니다.
「S」가 곳곳에 남겨둔 흔적만이 그의 유일한 희망입니다. 정교한 퍼즐과 숨막히는 위협들이 가득한 이 세계에서, 「N」은 「S」와 재회할 수 있을까요?
『Dark Heart: 50000』에서 그 해답을 직접 확인해 보십시오.

title: FROST: Bursting with Color and Life
description:
게임 정보
Step into a radiant universe where thousands of unique creatures swarm, evolve, and create beauty across your screen. Through puzzles, sandbox experimentation, and creature creation, you'll discover an entire cosmos of unexpected interactions and breathtaking wonders.
Draw paths to guide the flocking spirits to their home planets. Each glowing swarm is a unique being with its own personality. Some will faithfully follow the paths you draw, serving as shepherds for their more capricious companions. Others dance to the cosmic winds in their own way - drawn irresistibly to their companions, floating away from others, or transforming into new forms when crossing paths.
Three Ways to Play
Embark on a Puzzle Adventure
Guide glowing swarm creatures to their home planets across 60+ handcrafted puzzles. Draw pathways for shepherd species, harness natural attractions and repulsions, and discover how different beings transform when they meet. Through careful observation and experimentation, you'll understand each species' unique nature.
Shape a Living Universe
Create your own living ecosystems in an open simulation space. Spawn different species and watch as they form complex, emergent patterns. Some creatures might shepherd others along paths you draw, while different species may attract, avoid, or even consume one another. Every interaction can lead to fascinating chain reactions and the emergence of entirely new forms of life.
autokwd: FROST: Bursting with Color and Life

title: Chainward
description:
게임 정보
Match-3 meets roguelike! In Chainward, embark on a thrilling journey where you'll defeat monsters, face epic bosses, explore diverse locations, and perfect your deck of items and relics to create powerful synergies.
Strategic Match-3 Gameplay
Connect items in chains to unleash powerful effects. But think carefully—your matches are the key to survival.
Roguelike Progression
Start your journey with a simple pack of items and forge your path through randomly picked locations filled with danger and opportunity.
Powerful Relics and Synergies
Collect unique relics that amplify your abilities and open up new strategies. Build devastating combos and create synergies that suit your playstyle.
Dynamic Locations
Each stop on your journey presents choices. Will you risk it all in a monster cave, relax at a tavern, or maybe do a little donation to the church?
Are you ready to forge your destiny, one chain at a time?

title: CatShift
description:
게임 정보
CatShift is a cute platformer game which is suitable for all ages. You can play as a cat, customize you appearance and use different cat emotions at any time.
Turn into the cutest kitty, run, jump and play through different colorful static and randomized levels. Try to get to the top and collect all the fish. Hiss and scratch everything when you are done.
Features:
Singleplayer trials
Race levels
Randomized levels
Annoying enemies
Cat emotions
Leaderboards
Cute and kind, no deaths or violence, suitable for all ages
Co-op (is planned for the future phase)

title: No Rest  Lex
description:
게임 정보
How come when everything seems to be ok something has to happen that brings me back to square one?
The Event
Although the Metavertex was solved, so much fuss ended up overlapping the realities. Now people are aware that there is something else and that Lex is the point around which the events orbit.
The Loop
Meanwhile Lex just wants to live peacefully. He has found his place and love. The future looked bright, until the Narrative did its thing.
All for being who he is when he couldn't choose it.
Lex will take the journey he didn't want to take to discover things he didn't want to discover to have to make the decision he never wanted to make.
In his last adventure.
Features:
Lex strikes again, alongside Gina as a playable character!
Closing the saga – new characters with old themes come together in the last adventure of the charismatic character.
Old-school adventure - Even more simple mechanics (farewell right click), several challengin puzzles and pixel hunting (once again you have been warned).
The funniest point and click - Laugh so hard milk will come out you nose.
Minigames: as part of the plot they will delight the most demanding players.
Developed by one person!
More pixel art, more laughs, more pop-culture references, more of everything you previously enjoyed.

title: RAKKA: WAKE 01 - SOOT
description:
게임 정보
London, 1993. Rakka works as a disillusioned office employee, navigating the monotony of corporate life. When she stumbles upon a mysterious code hidden in a care package from her job, her world begins to quickly unravel. Alongside her roommates—Sascha, Björn, and Kev—Rakka's life takes a sharp turn from mundane to mayhem, facing unsettling phone calls, mysterious black cars, and a break-in. Are they being watched? Entwined in a dangerous conspiracy, the roommates weigh their options, and when Björn reveals he’s figured out the code, a decision is made. As you guide Rakka and her friends through this narrative, you'll uncover not just the answers to the mystery, but also explore the depths of their friendships. How far will they go for each other? And just who’s on the other end of the line? Follow these friends down their dead-end lives as they piece it all together, and they might just make it out the other side, with any luck.
A visual novel paired with point-and-click elements, Rakka distinguishes itself with its breadth of hand-drawn assets, detailed backgrounds, charming character art, and unique paper-cut style. Complimented by the art is the incredible original soundtrack; spearheaded by the minds behind The PMT, it oozes indie charm. Both serve in tandem, dragging the player into the character and dialogue driven world of Rakka. Think you can make it to its thrilling conclusion?

title: Witch Pachi
description:
게임 정보
"Witch Pachi" is a deck-building roguelike that merges strategic card play with physics-driven combat mechanics, taking inspiration from the progression style of Slay the Spire.
In this game, the player takes on the role of a witch who builds a deck using mana elements and skills that harness their power.
The core combat revolves around dropping orbs onto the battlefield to collect elemental resources. Each skill in a witch’s deck has specific elemental requirements, and once these are met by gathering enough of the corresponding elements from dropped orbs, the skill is automatically cast, unleashing its effects.
The gameplay follows a roguelike structure with procedurally generated paths, featuring battles, events, and opportunities to enhance decks. Each run challenges players to adapt their strategies, leveraging the interplay between deck composition and orb physics.
Currently in development, "Witch Pachi" aims to deliver a fresh take on the genre with its innovative casting system.
More details will emerge as development progresses!

title: Genesis
description:
게임 정보
NeoGenesis: A New Frontier Awaits
Step into the immersive world of NeoGenesis, a captivating story-driven sci-fi adventure set in the year 2060. While humanity has achieved interplanetary travel, the limits of its ingenuity still bind its progress. In this expansive and meticulously crafted universe, the survival of civilization lies not in advanced technology but in the resilience and choices of its people.
NeoGenesis offers players the freedom to explore breathtaking, dynamic environments across alien landscapes, each teeming with secrets waiting to be uncovered. But this isn’t just a game about exploration—it's about creation. Players can engage in crafting, forging tools, weapons, and even advanced technology to aid their survival and improve their chances in an unforgiving world. Weapons are fully customizable, allowing for upgrades and modifications that reflect each player’s unique strategy and playstyle.
At the heart of the game is its intelligent and lifelike AI-powered NPCs, each with distinct personalities, histories, and goals. These characters aren’t just part of the scenery—they actively shape the player’s journey. Every interaction, whether through dialogue, collaboration, or conflict, influences the storyline and the game’s outcome. NPCs remember player choices, respond dynamically to decisions, and carry forward the consequences of those actions, creating a truly adaptive and immersive narrative experience.
The story of NeoGenesis unfolds based on the bonds players forge, the alliances they form, and the challenges they overcome. With the ability to craft, fight, and make critical choices, players take control of their destiny in a richly detailed universe where every decision matters. Will you thrive and lead humanity to a brighter future, or will the weight of your choices steer the story toward chaos?
In NeoGenesis, the future isn’t written—it’s crafted. Are you ready to shape it?

title: Warpswap
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the captivating world of Warpswap, a puzzle-platformer where teleportation and swapping blocks are your ultimate tools! Embark on an epic journey across a unique pixel-art planet, featuring 5 distinct locations, each with its own unique atmosphere and challenges.
From frosty mountains to scorching volcanoes, master your swapping abilities to solve over 70 intricately designed levels. Discover hidden secrets, overcome tricky puzzles, and immerse yourself in a story of adventure and mystery.
In 2125, a lone explorer crash-lands on a lost planet, becoming the first human to set foot on its surface. Struggling to survive and find a way home, they discover a mysterious artifact that grants the power to swap places with objects. Using this newfound ability, they must solve the planet’s secrets and overcome its challenges to send a distress signal and escape.

title: Maze Maou
description:
게임 정보
About
Take on the role of a Dungeon Master in this turn-based tactics game. Make clever use of monster encounters, traps and cursed items to keep invading adventurers at bay, all while managing a demanding employer and troublesome subordinates. Experience the thrill of a soul-crushing office job in a medieval fantasy setting!
Features
Turn-based tactical gameplay with multiple solutions
A short, bite-sized experience you can complete in a few hours
Monsters to boss around
Traps
Cursed items with spooky lore and mind-boggling effects
Paperwork
Mandatory unpaid overtime

title: TETRA's Escape 2
description:
게임 정보
Tetras are back, and they need your help again in the sequel to the block-based puzzle game TETRA's Escape.
Move them around and use their special ability to transform into different shapes of tetrominoes to create platforms and save them during the 80 levels of the game.
