Rediscover the mechanics of the first game (transformations, blocks of fire or ice, thin platforms...) and discover new additions such as teleportation, global gravity inversion or ghost blocks.
Don't be afraid to experiment and make mistakes, as you can now undo all your moves and transformations.
Explore 64 completely new levels mixing old and new mechanics, and enjoy 16 of the best levels from the first TETRA's Escape as a bonus.
Features :
New gameplay mechanics (teleportation, ghost blocks, etc.),
Improved gameplay (more intuitive tetras selection...),
Ability to undo moves/transformations,
64 new levels with increasing difficulty,
16 levels from the first TETRA's Escape included.

title: TERASLIDE
description:
게임 정보
Play as Tulock, a snow fox, and help him progress through the different levels of this puzzle game based on movement on a hexagonal grid.
Slide in a straight line to an obstacle or the edge across 100 levels and find the right path to the final hexagon, avoiding the traps.
Discover new mechanics in the various worlds of increasing difficulty without fear of getting stuck, thanks to the help included in the game.
And for those wanting extra difficulty, over 250 optional challenges spread across the levels are present.
Features:
100 levels spread over 12 worlds,
Hexagonal grid requiring different thinking,
10 mechanics added as the game progresses,
Increasing difficulty, with in-game help included (solutions),
Ability to undo moves if you make a mistake,
More than 250 optional challenges spread over 100 levels.

title: Samurai Arena
description:
게임 정보
🗡️ Become a Samurai in the Battle for Survival! 🧟‍♂️
2D fighting game set in cyberpunk Japan! Control samurais in battles for 2 to 4 players, fend off waves of cyber-zombies, and enjoy a dynamic synthwave soundtrack. The battle begins!
⚔️ Key Features:
Survive in the Arena: Challenge a friend or face off against random opponents in short game sessions to prove your skills!
Use the Hordes of Cyber-Zombies: Think you're about to win? Waves of cyber-zombies with different tactics and behaviors will make every battle unpredictable. Use them to your advantage!
Arena Boss: Better not drag the fight out, or you’ll have to battle not only your opponents but also the arena boss! But no one has ever managed to defeat the boss...
Stylish Graphics: Immerse yourself in the futuristic samurai cyberpunk atmosphere with hand-drawn arenas created by an artist from the board game Arkham Horror.
Local Co-op: Gather your friends and engage in intense battles on a single screen.
Each Arena, a Thousand Tactics: Use the environment to gain the upper hand, survive as long as possible, and maybe even claim victory.

title: Lobotrypo
description:
게임 정보
Rumors of a serial killer stalking your local town are all over the news, and you have a meeting with your counselor in an hour. The problem is, the walk there is long and dark.
Endeavor through carefully crafted and atmospheric levels that branch out from your apartment. Solve the mystery of what is truly going on in your head in this psychedelic and surreal horror game set in Norway.
FEATURES
Dark and psychedelic atmosphere
First person controller
Psychological horror
Nostalgic low poly graphics
Fully voice acted cutscenes
Cinematic vistas based on Norwegian nature

title: Retro Killer
description:
게임 정보
현실의 경계를 넘어갈 준비가 되었는가?
겉보기에는 달콤하지만 그 속에는 무언가 섬뜩한 것이 숨어 있다.
이 흑백 카툰 세계… 어딘가 이상하다.
정체불명의 인물이, 마치 오래된 애니메이션에서 튀어나온 듯한 존재가
너의 아내를 납치했다.
망설임 없이 TV 속으로 뛰어들었지만… 이제 돌아갈 길은 없다.
싱글 플레이, 몰입감 넘치는 스토리
너는 혼자다.
이곳은 네가 알던 세계가 아니다.
하지만 반드시 길을 찾아야 한다.
단서를 따라가고, 위험을 헤쳐 나가며,
이 불길한 세계에 숨겨진 비밀을 밝혀라.
영화 같은 연출과 부드러운 스토리 전개
멋진 시네마틱 연출, 부드러운 애니메이션,
그리고 살아 숨 쉬는 듯한 카툰 세계 속에서 펼쳐지는 강렬한 이야기.

title: V2 Cucumber Scam
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a space adventure like you've never seen before! In “V2 Cucumber Scam” you'll play the role of Mac Skin, a former captain of an interplanetary merchant ship who, instead of serving a 20-year sentence for space crimes, agreed to undergo experimental echomutation. He was given sensory abilities, but at the cost of mandatory service on a remote station in the Verdun belt.
Your routine work turns into a real challenge when a mysterious anomaly over the planet V2 forces you into action. V2 is the place where the “Cucumbers” - a strange new species that has caused more trouble than good for Earth - were exiled. Now the planet hides secrets that no one wants to touch. But you must.
After your ship malfunctions, you land on V2. From that moment the real struggle for survival and discovery of the truth begins. The game combines elements of Adventure and Colony Builder - you build colonies, hack devices, explore the planet, collect resources, hunt unknown species and solve puzzles. All this in a unique 2D pixel art, hand-drawn style that comes to life on your screen.
Embark on this humorous, sarcastic and full of surprises adventure. On V2 you'll not only face a battle for survival, but also for sanity. Will you discover what the Cucumbers are hiding before it's too late?

STATEMENT
You are entering a world where the line between truth, conspiracy theory and legend can be dangerously fluid.

What really crashed at Roswell?
What is the role of the base at Area 51?
Where do the circles in the grain come from?
Why are cows found with their organs cut out in fields?One day I was contacted by a person whose identity remains unknown. She claimed to have information that could shed light on UFO-related events. The contact was through a regular e-mail box, which soon ceased to exist. Faced with these puzzles, I decided to put the acquired information in the game “V2 Cucumber Scam”, hiding it in special missions. Players may discover this content, but as the author I declare that I take no responsibility for its authenticity. This is a story for thought, not for resolution. Many of the threads are artistic interpretation and literary fiction, but each is rooted in speculation that has intrigued researchers and mystery enthusiasts for years. Names of institutions, people and places have been changed or distorted to protect privacy and avoid unintended repercussions.

title: Mumbo Shuffle
description:
게임 정보
Mumbo Shuffle is a teletext deckbuilding roguelike with creatures known as Mumbos. Select a deck with a Mumbo, help guide your Mumbo for snacks and surf channels to see where else you might go...
Aiming for the top with your Mumbo, you will need to play poker hands to gain points to defeat the round's sound. This can be done by playing, discarding and jumbling to get the optimal hand to play. Make sure to keep your Mumbo's power and type in mind with how you play each round.
Your Mumbo's power can encourage different playstyles. Your Mumbo's type can be advantageous with doubling your hands score against a boss round or disastrous with it halving your hands score short of beating the boss round.    
90 Channels, each having their own strange quirk
9 Decks that is accompanied by a Mumbo of a type to choose from for each run
9 types that Mumbos and Boss rounds can be
Submerse yourself into the galaxy of this teletext deckbuilder and see where channel surfing will take you...

title: Mystic Tesserae
description:
게임 정보
Mystic Tesserae is a game that combines Falling Sand simulation and a chill experience, where you use elements and spells to mould the world according to your will. Use elements to interact with every pixel you see (and even the ones you don't).
Gameplay 
Use a variety of Elements to discover the interactions between them.
Craft and build according to your imagination 
Features
Falling Sand
Falling sand simulation where all pixels are simulated.
Use your imagination to overcome challenges.
Use your creativity to build beautiful and uniques designs
Sandbox
Create buildings and even whole forests according to your desires.
2.5D
Unique perspective, being able to see what is behind and bellow other elements.
Circuits
Create circuits using different metals and electrons.
With a "third" dimension, this can get as complex as you wish.

title: Flow of Fortune
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Flow Of Fortune!
1. Learning Through Practice
A safe playground to hone financial skills and test risky moves without losing real money.
2. A Unique Blend of Role-Playing and Economic StrategiesYour character grows like in an RPG, yet you manage assets and businesses reminiscent of a classic board game.
3. Solo or Multiplayer GameplayCompete with friends online or go solo, experimenting with various tactics and starting conditions.

title: Infinite Origin
description:
게임 정보
Immersive Solo Gameplay: Dive into a captivating card game designed for solo adventurers.
Strategic Depth: Collect and master a vast array of unique cards with diverse abilities and synergies.
Adapt and Conquer: Tailor your strategy to overcome varied opponents and scenarios.
Accessible to All: Perfect for both casual players and seasoned strategists.
Endless Fun: Experience a thrilling journey where every decision shapes your path to victory.

title: Octane100
description:
게임 정보
Octane100 is a turn-based pixel-action game with simplified roguelike elements. Level up your heroes and discover items you can combine for smarter, more effective gameplay. The main antagonist is the oil corporation Octane100, bent on world domination – and it's up to you to stop them. But above all, the ultimate goal is simple: have fun.
For hardcore players, the game offers various difficulty levels and customizable modifiers, allowing you to tailor the challenge exactly to your liking. While it may look simple, don’t be fooled – it’s far more intricate and engaging than it seems.
Prefer a more relaxed experience? Dive into the map mode, where you’ll gather resources to build your own infrastructure and logistics networks.

title: Arrow & Fang
description:
게임 정보
As each arrowhead pierce the flesh of a Strider, Lena Morwyn ponders...
"What is this place? I bare the scar from one of those creatures and yet I live. Surviving is feasible."

SOLO DEVELOPED
Key Features
Find and gather different resources used for crafting and upgrading equipment
Stay energised and hydrated throughout the journey
Fight different Striders and harvest their bodies for hide, meat and bones
Use stealth tactics in the environment when Strider engagement is unwanted
NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER:
This game is still very early in the development process and has a lot more content to come!

title: Draggin'
description:
게임 정보
Look what the mouse dragged in!
Click and drag to cast area-of-effect spells to fend off waves of draggins, but be careful! While your magic field is a powerful weapon, it's also vulnerable to enemy attacks. Your key to success is dodging, weaving, and swooping in for devastating blows, all while strategizing your ideal build bit-by-bit.
Fight your way through new types of draggins in each locale.
Upgradeable spells and consumable potions to power you up as the challenge intensifies.
It just keeps draggin' on!
Discover new builds and strategies with each run while overcoming challenges to earn spells and cosmetics. Change the way you play as you strive for higher heights and get Margot some fresh fits!
30+ challenges to hunt with each run for some sweet rewards.
Unlock new kinds of spells so spicing up your attacks can be even spicier.
Fill out Margot's wardrobe and customize your magic field.
What a drag!
Get lost-in-the-box as you're dragged into the experience of Draggin'! Enjoy the cutesy pixel aesthetics as you explore each environment, outfit your mouse in some rad regalia, power through challenges 'til you achieve it all, and jump in for just one more run!

title: Card Fable Quest
description:
게임 정보
Card Based Fantasy RPG
Create a character and then go on an adventure by drawing a card from a deck and choosing how to respond to its text. Then draw another and continue exploring the world. Gather items, accept quests, battle monsters, learn spells, level up, and challenge various end-game bosses.

The cards you draw are always changing according to your location so explore hand-crafted dungeon decks, travel between different map zones to cities and villages to stock up on supplies and find quests, or investigate mysterious ruins where unique game mechanics craft a new card deck dynamically.
Steam Workshop
Use in-game editors to build your own decks of exploration cards, items, monsters, quests, and more. Creating new adventures is easy.

title: FLOWorlds
description:
게임 정보
Floworlds is a relaxing single player strategic puzzle game where you carefully drop payloads to convert barren worlds to habitable worlds. Converting each world is a unique puzzle. Puzzles are organized into Systems where each System contains two Worlds:
A Moon (easier)
A Planet (harder)
You have been assigned a sector of 1,000,000 Systems to ensure a lifetime of puzzles.
For each World:
Carefully choose Payload placements to ensure the World is completely covered.
Payload Drops will Flow down paths from higher zones to lower. Longer Flow paths convert more than shorter paths.
Flow changes Barren zones to Bio-zones. The Bio-zones generate Growth needed to convert the World.
It should be possible to complete all worlds (verification of this statement pending the game authors completion of all Systems).
Relaxing Fun
No time limit.
Game state is saved on exit, so stop and resume at any time.
No restrictions or unlocking. Travel to any System at any time. Switch between Planet and Moon at any time.
Each puzzle is fairly short. Expect to convert a Moon during a coffee break, convert a Planet, or two, on a lunch break.

title: Nemesis Galaxy at War
description:
게임 정보
Nemesis Galaxy at War is an adrenaline-pumping sci-fi asteroid space shooter that takes you on an endless journey through the cosmos! Set in a vast and unforgiving galaxy, you'll navigate your ship through asteroid fields, face off against relentless enemies, and battle fierce bosses in a quest for survival.
As you progress through infinite levels, the challenge grows with each passing wave, ensuring no two moments are the same. The deeper you venture into space, the more intense the battles become. Collect powerful upgrades along the way to enhance your weapons, boost your health, and activate shields that can turn the tide of battle in your favor.
With dynamic combat, strategic power-ups, and an ever-increasing difficulty curve, Nemesis Galaxy at War delivers an exhilarating experience for both casual players and hardcore shooters. Can you survive the chaos of space and emerge victorious against the galaxy's fiercest foes? The war is just beginning—brace yourself for the ultimate test!

title: Tree Kingdoms
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the battle of the Tree Kingdoms.
Explore the map, claim territory, upgrade your cities, and expand your empire to survive the winter and lead your kingdom to victory! Tree Kingdoms is a bite-sized 4x strategy game where you control the forest to claim land and secure your domain. How will your touch shape the board this year?

Strategic Turn-based action!


You are a Great Spirit of the forest, the plants and trees your subjects - but you are one of many Great Spirits. In the coming year you must strive to assert your domain before the winter comes and your power is diminished, as even spirits cannot control the seasons.



Expand and develop your territory to unlock new units and strategic advantages!
Eliminating your competition will ensure your survival, giving you space to grow as you please. So too with laying down deep roots to tide you and yours over the winter, as even the frost cannot reach so deep. But for many, sometimes it is just enough to survive the year and face a new spring. How will your touch shape the forest this year?

title: The Panda Who Fell
description:
게임 정보
Story
Everyone has been naive at some point in life. As children, we explored the world with curiosity, not knowing what was safe or dangerous. It was a time of learning, where mistakes were part of the journey. Being naive is a natural step in discovering life’s wonders.
And so was this little panda, who fell into a big, ancient cave, while exploring the wilderness. Guide him through an uncharted underground world, as you race against time to rescue him from the depths of an ancient, forgotten cave.
Gameplay
The Panda Who Fell is a challenging precision platformer with some extra spice:
Get to the top and safe the panda
Master all challenges of the cave
Manage to reach the next Angels monument before time runs out
Discover the cave's mystery

title: Super Magic Book
description:
게임 정보
Lucy is a cheerful and confident girl who excels in star magic. Since childhood, she has dreamed of becoming a world-renowned grand mage. Both in daily life and magical studies, Lucy works diligently, filling her notebooks with magical theories. She prided herself on her magical talents until she encountered Jeruf's Super Magic Book. To her astonishment, the magic she cast differed completely from the book's descriptions!
Is the Super Magic Book flawed? Was it exaggerated? Who exactly is the legendary Grand Mage Jeruf?
What secrets lie behind this magical scripture? Does the demon sealed by Jeruf truly exist?
Join Lucy in uncovering the truth hidden behind the Super Magic Book.
 Game Features:
• 2D side-scrolling action-adventure with simple yet engaging gameplay
• Unique grimoire system: Combine spellbook skills with environmental interactions to create diverse magical effects
• Open-world exploration with hidden levels to unlock
• Rich narrative combined with exhilarating combat
• Strategic magic-puzzle integration: Clever spellcasting is essential for progression

title: CloserLook VR: Oldways
description:
게임 정보
You play as Tessy, a final-year microbiology student who wakes up trapped in a locked university administrative building. In your desperate attempt to escape, you uncover a grand conspiracy and unravel the sinister intentions of a mysterious organization. Designed exclusively for virtual reality, CloserLook VR allows players to fully inhabit its immersive world, piece together its gripping narrative, and solve unique, story-driven puzzles.
From the moment you wake up in the quiet departmental library, every step forward reveals layers of mystery and intrigue. As you transition from the mundane to the mysterious, solving intricate puzzles becomes the key to unlocking the secrets of this place. Each action pulls you deeper into a beautifully rendered West African setting, rich with history and culture. Along the way, you’ll recover stolen artifacts, piece together untold stories, and face challenges that test your wit and perseverance, making every moment an unforgettable part of your journey to freedom.

title: Trucker 2056
description:
게임 정보
Trucker 2056, a narrative trading RPG featuring a point-and-click driven plot and card-based combat. Heavily inspired by late 80s and early 90s classics by Sid Meier and MicroProse.
Set in a dystopian future Finland, you assume the role of a trucker on a desperate journey to find medicine for their dying daughter. What begins as simple errands for a local crime syndicate soon pulls you into a larger conflict between the oppressive Institute and resistance factions fighting to overthrow the authoritarian regime. Ultimately, the game explores profound themes of community, home, environmental collapse, technology, and fascism.
The core gameplay loop revolves around gathering resources through missions, transporting goods between cities, and engaging enemies in card-based combat. Resources can then be used to purchase and upgrade equipment for your truck. Each piece of equipment unlocks a unique set of combat cards, determined by your character's abilities.
Game Features:
30 unique locations to explore in a point-and-click interface, spread across 10 cities
6 factions to interact with and influence
30 NPCs featuring dynamic dialogue trees, with 10 NPCs recruitable to your party
50 missions, including 20 main missions and 30 side quests
40 truck items to buy that unlock up to 120 combat cards
15 enemy types, each with distinct AI and a pool of combat cards
12 trade goods driving a fully implemented in-game economy

title: Bunny Jump Jump
description:
게임 정보
Journey up through the sewers, across lakes and up the tallest tree to catch the fleeting blue butterfly. 
Hop through challenging platforming challenges as a cute bunny and see beautifully handmade and cozy world!
Single-player challenging 2D platforming as a cute bunny.

title: Nova JET
description:
게임 정보
Nova Jet is a Synthwave survivor-like auto-shooter!
Jump into your JET (Juice Extraction Transport) and embark on an intergalactic employment like no other! As a loyal employee of Nova Cola Drinks Company, your task is simple: Slice, Blast, Shoot and Explode enemies, extract their delicious Juice, and fuel the production of the galaxy's most popular (and most sinister) drink—Nova Cola.
But being a "good employee" isn't just about juice:
Upgrade Your JET
Survive relentless alien waves and unlock powerful weapons and upgrades by playing rounds of Plinko. Customize your JET to dominate the juice-field!
Mine for Power-Ups
Enhance your gameplay with hidden items you can mine for. Mines, Air-Raids, Shields and Health.
Collect Juice
Blast enemy hordes to collect their glowing Juice. It’s a messy job, but someone has to do it. Plus it’s your job anyway.
Can you stay alive long enough to keep the juice flowing, or will you become another casualty in Nova Cola’s corporate machine?
Dive into the fast-paced action of Nova JET.

title: Sea of Dreams Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Welcome aboard the Sea of Dreams, can you survive to this nightmare ?
Fend against vast enemy forces, with hundreds of nightmarish foes swarming the screen at any given time.
In this action-packed rogue-lite, you play as one of the survivors trapped aboard the Sea of Dreams.
Slay, adapt, and grow stronger with every wave of enemies—then slay even more!
Upgrade your abilities, and unlock unique perks to adapt to the escalating chaos.
Set in the terrifying universe of Sea of Dreams, this standalone spin-off delivers relentless action in a world steeped in dread and mystery. Will you endure the horrors of The Other World and find your way back, or will you become another lost soul aboard the Sea of Dreams?
The nightmare begins. Will you survive?

title: Tete's Atelier: Patches
description:
게임 정보
Tete’s Atelier is a Cozy Game where you transform shirts, jackets, eco bags, pants, sweaters, and more into personalized pieces. After customizing your clothes with patches, shapes, and colors, a special machine animation visually finalizes the process, highlighting the finishing touch. Then, you can sell your creations in your in-game store. Customers place bids on customizations, and each sale helps expand your creativity and collection in the atelier.
How Does the Gameplay Work?
👕Choose the Clothing/Accessory – Browse the menu and select a clothing or accessory model you want to transform. 🎨Use the color palette to add more style and personality to your clothes and accessories.
📐Apply Shapes – Choose from various decorative shapes and place them 
freely to create a unique and sophisticated design.

title: Xenoquarium
description:
게임 정보
With the possibility of interstellar travel, a new fish-like species spread throughout the galaxy was discovered. These aquatic creatures, which people call "Xenosh", have become a hobby of gene crossing thanks to their very simple genetic map compared to life as we know it. Everyone is in a race to find their new subspecies.
This situation attracted the attention of criminal organizations and the state began to impose harsh sanctions. Finally, a special forces unit affiliated with the United World Government Ministry of Extraterrestrial Life was established. Liberal factions and black markets emerged against this harsh state tyranny.
Constantly monitor the health, disease and hunger values of your Xenosh. When you meet their needs, they make you happy with their valuable production, you can even find a golden lying. A happy Xenosh gives better results in the breeding machine.
Breed two Xeonsh in the GeneFeeder device. Make selections on their genes using various serums, change mutation values and experiment to discover rare features. But be careful, you may not want to push your precious Xenosh too hard.
The most popular gift these days is Xenosh. They are constantly adding new ads to the sales platform. Everyone has different preferences. If you send the Xenosh that meets these demands as soon as possible, you will earn a high tip fee along with a good reputation. We have heard that reputable producers can get special permits from the state and bend the laws "little".

title: Ludocracy
description:
게임 정보
In a world where every conflict is resolved through games, Ludocracy invites you to step into the shoes of a man who has lost everything to the cruel rules of a game-ruled society. Governed by the divine commandments of the Game God, this world forbids murder and theft, but instead forces its inhabitants to gamble their lives, freedom, and fortunes on the outcome of games.
You must navigate this treacherous world, mastering games like Mancala, Nard, and Tafl to survive and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past. Along the way, you’ll encounter a cast of memorable characters, from cunning gamblers to secretive revolutionaries, each with their own stories and stakes in the game.
But beware—every move you make could mean the difference between freedom and slavery, life and death. Will you rise as a master of games, challenge the very foundations of this world, and rewrite its rules? Or will you become another pawn in the Game God’s eternal play?
Key Features:
A Unique Game-Based World: Explore a richly imagined world where games dictate every aspect of life, from personal disputes to the fate of kingdoms.
Master Three Classic Games: Learn and master Mancala, Nard, and Tafl through interactive tutorials that teach you the rules, mechanics, and strategies of each game, ensuring you’re ready for any challenge.
Skill Trees and Artifice: Develop your skills in Virtuosity (strategy and knowledge) and Artifice (deception and manipulation) to gain an edge in high-stakes matches.
Ludic Essence System: Manage your energy as you play, using it to fuel your skills and survive in a world where every game has consequences.
Branching Storylines: Make choices that shape Darius’s journey, from seeking revenge to uncovering the truth about the Game God and the world’s origins.

title: The Last Ride Home
description:
게임 정보
🌲 고요한 숲. 깜빡이는 불빛. 마지막 절박한 집으로의 여정.
The Last Ride Home은 네 인생에서 가장 긴장감 넘치는 여정이자 생존을 위한 필사적인 싸움이다. 숲이 너를 둘러싸고 깜빡이는 불빛이 완전히 꺼질 위기에 처하면서 매초가 소중하다. 위험한 길을 따라 달리고, 치명적인 장애물을 피하고, 바로 뒤를 쫓는 괴물로부터 도망쳐라. 과연 너는 집에 무사히 도착할 수 있을까?
🌟 주요 특징:
🔦 고장 나고 예측 불가능한 자전거 라이트:
네 자전거 라이트는 제멋대로 깜빡이며 약한 빛에서 완전한 어둠으로 바뀐다. 어둠이 너를 집어삼키기 전에 주변 환경을 재빨리 기억해라. 다시 라이트를 켜기 위해 적절한 순간에 터치해야 하지만, 주의해라: 그 과정에서 조종이 더 어려워질 수 있고, 작은 실수가 치명적일 수 있다!
🛑 운전 실수는 치명적이다:
길을 벗어나지 말고 장애물을 피하라: 길에서 벗어나거나 장애물에 부딪히면 게임이 끝난다.
멈추지 말아라: 너무 오래 멈추면 괴물이 너를 잡을 것이다.
돌아갈 수 없다: 숲은 실수를 용서하지 않는다 – 선택한 길은 최종 결정이다.
🦌 황금 뿔을 가진 사슴 괴물:
숲의 전설에서 태어난 그림자 같은 존재가 빛나는 눈과 소름끼치는 미소로 너를 쫓아온다. 이 괴물은 생각보다 훨씬 빠르며, 실수할 때마다 더욱 가까워진다.
🛣️ 갈라지는 길과 소름 끼치는 체크포인트:
모든 경로는 다르며 각 분기점에는 비밀이 숨어 있다: 버려진 오두막, 잊힌 묘지, 경고 표지판, 그리고 이전 희생자들의 흔적 등이 있다. 이러한 시각적 단서는 숲의 비극적인 과거를 은밀히 드러내지만, 머뭇거릴 시간이 없다 – 앞을 보며 나아가라!
⌛ 시간 압박과 증가하는 위험:
네게 주어진 시간은 제한적이다. 잘못된 경로를 선택하거나 라이트 없이 지체하는 순간이 많아지면 너의 운명은 끝난다. 속도, 집중력, 빠른 반응 사이의 완벽한 균형을 찾아라.
📈 진행률 및 위협 표시기:
너의 여정에서 현재 진행 상황을 확인하고 목표 지점까지 얼마나 남았는지, 그리고 괴물이 얼마나 가까이 왔는지 항상 주시해라. 실수할 여지는 없다.
🎮 게임 메커니즘:
🚴 속도 조절과 정확한 조향: 속도를 지속적으로 조정하며, 괴물로부터 도망치기 위해 가속하거나 날카로운 커브와 치명적인 장애물을 피하기 위해 감속해라.
🔦 자전거 라이트 관리: 고장 난 라이트는 빠른 반응을 요구한다. 어둠 속에 완전히 갇히기 전에 적절한 타이밍에 라이트를 켜되 자전거의 조종을 놓치지 않도록 주의해라.

title: Freak Face
description:
게임 정보
Freak Face is a thrilling 2D horror arcade game where survival and skill are your only allies. 
Wishlist now!

title: Red & Blue
description:
게임 정보
Play with a friend locally or online with Steam's Remote Play Together!
Join the community to offer feedback, find someone to play with, or whatever! Come party!
Red & Blue is a co-op puzzle-platformer for 2 players. It features various challenges of increasing difficulty that will require great teamwork and complicity! Jump on each other, get chained to each other, help each other solve color-coded puzzles and much more!

title: Chemical Combat
description:
게임 정보
Deep within an abandoned research facility, a catastrophic experiment has transformed the scientists into zombified monsters, unleashing chaos within the once safe lab. Armed with a supply of highly volatile chemicals, you'll need to fight your way through a sprawling maze of interconnected rooms, splashing enemies with explosive elixirs and collecting various valuables.
Chemical Combat is an action-packed, chemistry-themed roguelike where strategy is key. Craft complex concoctions that trigger crazy chain reactions, battle your way through crowds of deadly monsters, and gather resources to upgrade your equipment. Survive, escape... or delve deeper for even greater rewards.
COMBINE CATALYTIC CHEMICALS 🧪
Combat here isn't just aimless shooting - it's about chaining the right reactions at the right times. Combine elements to ignite, corrode, freeze, and stun your foes, stacking reactions for even greater devastation. Refine and adapt your playstyle in order to conquer any challenge.
ENTER THE COMPLEX 🗺️
Each expedition takes you into a procedurally generated laboratory full of enemies, puzzles and traps - randomized layouts with risks and rewards around every corner. Navigate safely, as there's only one way out... unless you count death as a second.
MINE RARE MINERALS ⛏️
Construct and upgrade automated drills to passively mine materials between floors. Choose which elements to excavate, expand your arsenal, and experiment with an array of up to 16 unique elements. Be warned though: fuel isn't cheap, so you'll have to manage your resources carefully in order to maximize profits.
BATTLE BRUTAL BOSSES ☠️
Encounter deadly guardians at the exits to each floor. Defeat them to claim large bounties, permanent upgrades, and access to deeper levels, but beware - fighting these titans demands strategy, skill, and split-second reflexes, so there's no room for error.
PURCHASE POWERFUL PERKS ✨
Return to safety after each floor, where you'll have the opportunity to spend your hard-earned cash on various upgrades which significantly boost your damage, survivability, or can even enable entire new playstyles. The choice is yours, but invest wisely - difficulty never decreases...

title: Fuzz & Dizzy: Part-Time Heroes
description:
게임 정보
Play as Fuzz and Dizzy, two quirky half-siblings on a mission to save their kingdom in a vibrant turn-based RPG with a nostalgic cartoon aesthetic. Explore a whimsical world filled with hidden surprises, take on mischievous imps in strategic combat, and unlock unique abilities to aid you on your quest. Along the way, uncover a captivating story that unfolds as you progress, immersing you deeper into the adventure. Packed with retro charm, exploration, and heartwarming moments, Fuzz and Dizzy offers a delightful journey for players of all kinds!

title: The Depths of Duskraven Manor
description:
게임 정보
The Depths of Duskraven Manor is a first-person, turn-based horror RPG where you follow the adventure of five unlikely fugitives that have been summoned to do a job by the most powerful family in the world, the Duskravens. Your party has been dispatched to the old Duskraven manor to quietly take care of a problem they have in the dark depths below. In return, the powerful head of the family, Donovan Duskraven, has promised to have their records wiped, their bank accounts full and a new lease on life.
Little do they know just how deep the dangerous darkness has spread underneath them....
Nolan - A former American intelligence operative who disobeyed one too many orders and has been on the run for years after his former agency determined he has too many secrets in his head to be allowed to live.
Selene - The only confirmed wielder of magic alive among the human race. With every major government and military after her, she's tired of running and ready to hear the Duskravens out, in spite of her late mother's mysterious past with the illustrious family.
Yulia - An orphan raised by a Russian spy agency to be the perfect asset. After years of cruel training and heartless missions, she has gone dark from the watchful eye of her handlers and is ready to live a simple life.
Stan - A genius computer engineer who created what he thought was a simple data crawler AI, only to have it grow beyond his control and nearly destroy the entire world network. In a desperate bid to stop it, he gave his creation what it always wanted, a body. Now residing in an advanced chip fused to his brain stem, Stan hopes the Duskravens can free him from the AI, and the AI hopes they can give it a more durable, capable body.

title: All We Fallen
description:
게임 정보
Overview
After the Fall, take control of any of The Fallen and descend to the bottom of the world in search of a way back to the Surface.
All We Fallen is a difficult Roguelike which takes the player through a web of infinite cave systems into the depths of the world. Join a mysterious guide, Bernahrd, with motives unknown in guiding the Fallen toward the abyss.
On the journey, discover new weapons, enemies, bosses, characters and much more. Every run is unique, due to the permadeath and procedural generation.
Visuals
All We Fallen is locked to a fixed screen size to maintain a strong visual theme and to keep the screen size consistent. It is also rendered with a fixed color palette, further backing the visual theme.
Audio
All of the music in this game is made by the solo developer, Lenni Huopaniemi. More music by me can be found under the name Lennihuopa on most platforms.

title: xiao wang phone store simulator
description:
게임 정보
Xiao Wang phone store simulator  a mobile phone sales and management simulation game, players through reasonable management, earn money, expand the scale of the store, open the secret room. You will become the owner of Xiao Wang's Repair Shop and expand its scale. By purchasing second-hand mobile phones, refurbishing and repairing them, you can earn gold coins. Then, you can open the mysterious chamber and explore the secrets hidden within.
autokwd: xiao wang phone store simulator,휴대폰 매장 시뮬레이터

title: Shoot  the Moon
description:
게임 정보
SHOOT FOR THE MOON은 우스꽝스러운 로그라이트 업그레이드와 사랑스러운 성우진의 부적응 친구들이 등장하는 아케이드 액션 플랫폼 게임입니다!
드루이드가 통제하는 위험한 숲을 통과하면서 비행 생물에게 마법의 창을 던지세요!
이상한 가족의 도움으로 창, 주문, 괴물 친구를 업그레이드하여 점점 더 높이 성장할 수 있으며, 숲에서 하늘 도시, 용의 뱃속을 거쳐 그 너머까지 탐험할 수 있습니다!
창 길이와 속도를 업그레이드하여 멈출 수 없는 작살과 투척 기계가 되세요!
숲의 어두운 면에 숨겨진 끔찍한 비밀을 밝혀내세요!
순간이동 및 마인드 컨트롤과 같은 예상치 못한 기술을 잠금 해제하기 위해 새로운 친구를 데려오세요!
새, 박쥐, 짐승을 삼켜서 달리는 동안 콤보에 불을 붙이고 힘을 키워보세요!
숲을 노예로 삼는 사악한 드루이드에게 복수하세요.
유쾌한 목소리 연기와 중독성 넘치는 게임, 이제 창을 들고 달을 향해 쏠 시간입니다!
놓치면 무기를 업그레이드하고 다시 가세요!

title: Mochi Conquest
description:
게임 정보
✨ WISHLIST NOW & JOIN THE ADVENTURE!
⛩️ MOCHI NEED YOU! WILL YOU SAVE… OR DESTROY THEM ALL?
 The Dread Fog spreads, twisting the land and corrupting the once-sacred Kami. Cursed Shikigami enslave the Mochi, turning them into relentless foes.
 You are their last hope. Lead the Mochi warriors, free the Kami, and reclaim a world drowning in corruption.
 When the time comes, will you save the lost… or erase them forever?
⚔️ MASTER TIMING-BASED COMBAT

title: Live War
description:
게임 정보
Live War is an easy-to-learn, hard-to-master strategy game—a streamlined take on titles like Company of Heroes, Men of War, and Wargame. As a senior commander, you’ll deploy the right units and abilities at the perfect moment to dominate the battlefield. Watch as your army crushes the enemy, or take matters into your own hands by calling in airstrikes, missiles, or directly commanding officers to turn the tide of battle.
Strategy-Driven Gameplay
Focus on tactics—every decision matters.
Clear battlefield intel—what you see is what you get.
Real-time strategic feedback—adapt and react instantly.
Diverse Units & Deep Strategies
Dozens of unit types to deploy.
Unique abilities like airstrikes, cover setups, and resource buildings.
Tactical counters—each unit type has strengths and weaknesses.

title: MeowFall
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for an epic journey in search of the ultimate prize: the best hat ever! Think you're up to the challenge?

Embark on a journey inspired by classic gaming challenges, where every victory feels like a triumph.

Take on the role of an adorable kitten on an epic quest to find the hat of dreams. Navigate through vibrant yet perilous worlds, brimming with cunning traps, cleverly hidden secrets, and bonus levels.


Key Features:

🎯 Tough Challenges: This game isn't for the faint-hearted! Every jump and dodge needs to be spot-on to conquer the trials ahead.

🔍 Discover Secrets: Uncover hidden treasures, unlock secret passages, and explore meticulously crafted bonus levels that offer unique challenges and rewards.

🎩 Fabulous Hat Collection: Seek out and collect a variety of fabulous hats scattered throughout the game.

🪤 Crafty Traps: Watch out for the tricky traps lurking around every corner! From sneaky spikes to mind-bending platforms, each level tests your reflexes and smarts.

🎵 Awesome Music: Immerse yourself in the game's world with a charming, energetic soundtrack that sets the perfect mood for your adventure.

title: Airsoft Range
description:
게임 정보
Join an Airsoft free for all with no rules of engagement make friends betray your friends collect loot for an edge and more

title: MechaBladeHero
description:
게임 정보
MechaBlade Hero is an indie action adventure game where you control a robot fighting your way through an army of robots to get out of a giant tower. Face enemies and gain new weapons, solve puzzles and platform challenges in this challenging hack and slash.

title: Golden Ticket Simulator
description:
게임 정보


Immerse yourself in the ultimate cinematic experience with Golden Ticket Simulator – the revolutionary theater simulator that lets you and your friends enjoy unforgettable movie moments in virtual cinemas. Whether you're a movie buff, a social butterfly, or simply someone looking for a new way to spend time with friends, Golden Ticket Simulator provides the perfect platform. 🍿
Features

Virtual Theaters: Experience movies in stunningly realistic theaters that you can share with your friends. Choose from a variety of theaters, ranging from classic Art Deco cinemas to modern IMAX experiences.

Iconic Movie Scenes: Visit famous film locations and enjoy movies right on the set. Watch a classic at the T-Rex enclosure from "Jurassic Park" or experience a screening aboard a spaceship.

Personalized Avatars: Create your own avatar and give it a unique look. Show off your style as you move around the virtual cinema.

Exclusive Content: Get access to special screenings, premieres, and Q&A sessions with filmmakers. Discover exclusive bonus content and behind-the-scenes material.

Easy Invites: Quickly and easily invite your friends to join your screenings. Share your experiences and make every movie night a social event.

Interactive NPC Guests: Encounter our live, Artificial Intelligence-driven cinema NPCs who converse with you in real-time. Enjoy stimulating dialogues, receive bespoke movie recommendations, and enhance the cinematic atmosphere with an exciting buzz.





(The content of this page is currently evolving in tandem with our development efforts and will be subject to ongoing refinement.)

title: Captain Corgi: Planetary Problem Solver
description:
게임 정보
Play as Captain Corgi in this space adventure! Hop on your cosmic sailboat and explore the Milky Way, land on floating worlds, and lend a helping hand to the eccentric inhabitants of this storybook universe.



This is a short, narrative adventure with some light puzzling. Captain Corgi and his brother Lem are on a quest to become Planetary Problem Solvers! Or at least that's Corgi's quest. Lem would probably rather hang back and read, but their mom told him he needs to look after his little brother. But who knows, maybe he'll learn something new along the way as well.
Features:
Chill exploration without combat
Quirky animal characters to chat with
A 'bark' button
Space sailing!

title: Terminal Bore
description:
게임 정보
Deep in debt and desperate for freedom, you've taken a mining contract on a hostile frontier world. The company owns your life, but they don't own your ambition. Every mineral you extract brings you one step closer to buying back your freedom – assuming you survive the dangers that lurk below.
Transform raw resources into vital upgrades and establish outposts in the depths
Build a network of generators and mobile refineries to power your underground empire
Gather valuable resources to craft upgrades and outposts as you dig ever deeper!
Sell ores to unlock new blueprints or hire new crew members.
Death isn't the end! Launch daring rescue missions to save trapped pilots, or salvage valuable equipment from the wreckage.

title: Mazer Laser
description:
게임 정보
빠르고 도전적인 아케이드 게임
피하고, 텔레포트하며 앞으로 나아가세요. 이 아케이드 게임에서 다양한 미로를 광속으로 움직이며 자신에게 도전하세요. 정밀함과 속도가 당신의 가장 좋은 동맹이 될 것입니다.
악마 같은 난이도

title: Interior Tales
description:
게임 정보
Take the role of an interior designer in a world in desperate need of creative touch. Bring your own and your clients' visions to life in this isometric and colorful simulation game.
BUILD YOUR REPUTATION
Start from humble beginnings in Central Point, and work your way up to designing grand mansions in Hillside. The better you perform, the more opportunities will come your way!
PLENTY OF UNLOCKABLES
Each job offers something new to decorate with. Don't forget to explore the cities for hidden items and special decor pieces!
ICONIC ISOMETRIC ARTSTYLE
Experience a 3D world in an isometric point of view, capturing the charm of classic games.
RELAXING, YET REWARDING GAMEPLAY
Interior Tales offers a stress-free and forgiving gameplay experience while maintaining core simulation elements like an economy and progressive career development.

title: Bite Size Terrors: Speechless
description:
게임 정보
Bite Size Terrors:
Are Short Experimental Horror Experiences each with their own Unique Genres and Styles.
From the Creator of Notebook Entries, this is...
Speechless:
A Story Focusing on Show not Tell.
No dialogue. No Voices. Discover the story as you play and explore.
Enrich yourself in a colorful, yet destroyed world.
Soundtrack gets added depth/Sounds with each achievement in-game.
Use limited bullets & your instincts to survive.
Story:
There is another world that connects with ours, the biggest difference is.... It doesn't hide it's monsters,
Not knowing how long you've waited, Today is the day.
Prepared, you venture into the other world, confronting the creatures that await you.
As you get deeper & deeper, you start to understand that sometimes...we don't hide our monsters either.
We embrace them.
Gameplay:
A Survival Horror focusing on limited bullets, guns & ways to defend yourself.
Find your way around this world, finding New Objectives, Key Items & Weapons.
Minimalistic gameplay with an emphasis on atmosphere when arriving in a new environment.

title: Todomiro
description:
게임 정보
Todomiro is a cozy adventure with a magical zooming ability. Change perspective from the cosmos in all of its glory to a tiny world hidden inside the drink of an ant. Explore your inner flâneur through this relaxing world full of charm, goofs, and of course, gags.
Explore A World Full Of Cool Stuff to Do
Befriend the little people of the planets. Help a lady cross the street or a man make a sandwich, but not all problems are equal, some people have become possessed and you'll need some magic to save them.
Multiple planets full of things to do and explore
Talk with the creatures of the planets and make friends
Solve mysterious puzzles
Idle and active minigames - go fishing, farming or hit the mole
Use the environment as musical instruments

title: Scary Stories
description:
게임 정보
This is a text-based, choose-your-own-adventure style game that presents you with multiple spine-chilling stories where you must navigate your way through with nothing but your wits and any items you find along the way.
Each story has multiple choices which can branch into new paths and even new endings... Along the way, you may be fortunate or smart enough to find yourself something that could be of use.
FEATURES
- Out-the-box Custom Story support!
- Text-based Stories
- Multiple choices/branching paths
- Custom audio sound effects
- Items that can be used to unlock paths/choices
- Configurable settings

title: Into The Craft
description:
게임 정보
Into the Craft is an Open World survival game, where you will create your own place.

Whenever you do an activity, you level up a profession. Develop your character, to unlock more crafting recipes and become better at everyday work!

You can engage in a variety of activities such as:

- Gathering

- Farming

- Tame and raise animals

- Cooking

- Build a small village

- Exploration

- Craft at workstations

- Trade with villagers

- Fight and loot the enemy Camps

and much more!

Gain experience points in categories like Mining, Lumber, Weaponsmith, Armorsmith, Alchemy, Building, Fighting and Jewelcraft. Level them up by doing tasks in the game world, to unlock new recipes, be able to gather better resources, or fight more dangeorus foes!

title: Stunt Xpress
description:
게임 정보
Become a delivery van driver. The best in the world.
Take part in internationally renowned delivery van driving championships.
Shoot your parcels (on time) into customer's homes like a marksman while performing gravity-defying stunts and being chased by god knows what.
Key Features


Van Stunts: Lift the wheels off the ground and nail some wild combos



Deliveries: Shoot parcels out of your van like an archer and hit the bullseye



: Explore procedurally generated maps & championships



Unlock new vans & cosmetics



Gain an edge over your rivals with a variety of unlockable tools

title: Roam
description:
게임 정보
지역 땅은 많은 비밀, 자연의 경이, 보물 및 유물을 숨겨있습니다. 그러나 주요한 미스터리는 수세기 동안 호수 바닥에 존재해 온 방대한 터널과 동굴 네트워크입니다. 여러분은 탐험가의 역할을 맡아 이러한 고대 지하 통로의 깊이를 탐험하고 호수와 그 주변의 비밀을 풀어내는 임무를 맡고 있습니다.

오픈 월드와 절차적 생성
«Roam» 의 세계에서는 절차적 생성 덕분에 무작위 이벤트와 적대적인 환경 시스템이 각 플레이에서 독특한 상황을 만들어냅니다. 위험이 매 순간 도사리고 있습니다: 공격적인 생물들의 공격, 함정, 그리고 마법적인 이상 현상은 여러분이 직면할 작은 부분일 뿐입니다.

선택의 자유와 퀘스트
여러분은 자신의 길을 선택할 완전한 자유를 갖고 있습니다. 다양한 무기와 마법을 사용하고 유용한 물약을 준비하며, 장비를 찾고, 만들고, 업그레이드하여 적대적인 환경을 헤쳐 나가세요. 탐험 경로의 선택은 여러분에게 달려 있습니다. 플레이어는 적과 싸우거나 전투를 피하고, 무자비한 힘 대신 교묘함, 민첩성 및 마법을 사용할지 선택할 수 있습니다. 위험을 혼자든지 친구와 함께 극복하고 매료시키는 장소를 탐험하며 새로운 비밀을 발견하세요. 퀘스트는 여러분에게 최대한의 행동 자유를 제공하기 위해 디자인되었습니다. 손잡이로 안내하는 대신 힌트를 제공하여 여러분이 과업을 해결하고 목표를 달성하는 방법을 선택할 수 있게 합니다. 여러분의 결정은 사건의 흐름에 영향을 주며 새로운 기회를 열거나 예상치 못한 결과로 이어질 수 있습니다.

탐험하고, 싸우고, 생존하세요.

title: Guest Uncovered
description:
게임 정보

Steiner Mansion에서 파티 초대를 받았습니다! 하지만 뭔가 이상한 일이 벌어집니다. 도착한 지 얼마 후에 호스트의 시신이 계단 아래에서 발견됩니다. 퍼즐이 해결되고 범인이 드러날 때까지 집은 잠겨 있습니다. 추리 능력을 시험하는 클래식한 살인 미스터리에 참여하세요.



게임 시작 시, 4-12명의 플레이어가 게스트, 살인자 또는 중립 플레이어로 지원됩니다. 게스트로서 임무는 살인자가 누구인지에 대한 단서를 찾는 것입니다. 살인자로서 임무는 모든 게스트들을 숫자로 앞서서 게임을 이기는 것인데, 적발되지 않아야 합니다이를 위해서는 다른 플레이어들을 속이고 기만하여 그들을 소수로 만들면서 하나씩 제거해야 합니다. 중립 플레이어로서 임무는 살인자로부터 죽지 않고 미팅 중에 추방되지 않으면서 자신의 목표를 달성하는 것입니다. 가끔 특별한 게스트 또는 특별한 살인자로 스폰될 기회가 있을 것입니다. 이러한 역할은 팀이 게임에서 이기도록 도울 특별한 능력을 가질 것입니다.
게스트로서 플레이하세요.
게스트들은 게임에서 승리하려면 지도를 탈출할 수 있는 출구를 여는 데 필요한 일련의 작업을 수행해야 합니다. 또한 시체의 위치를 찾아내고, 살인에 사용된 살인 도구를 발견하고, 살인자가 누구인지에 대한 단서를 찾아 수수께끼를 풀어야 합니다.


살인자들은 다음 희생자를 결정하면서 가짜 작업을 수행할 것입니다. 게스트들에게 보이지 않게 살인 도구를 획득하세요. 희생자를 선택하세요. 은밀하고 살인 모드로 전환하세요. 게스트들과 중립 플레이어를 죽이세요. 적발되지 않고 모든 게스트들을 숫자로 앞서면 게임에서 승리하세요.
중립 플레이어들에게도 가짜 작업이 주어지며 게임에서 승리하기 위해 수행해야 할 목표가 있을 것입니다.

의사가 되어 게스트를 구하거나 혹은 탐정과 함께 숨겨진 단서를 찾아보세요. 특별한 역할을 가진 플레이어들은 게임에서 승리하는 데 도움이 되는 능력을 가질 수 있습니다.







시체를 발견하거나 살인자가 누군지 알게 되면, 회의를 소집하세요. 회의 동안 남은 플레이어들은 가능한 범인에 대해 토론합니다. 상대 플레이어 중 한 명을 투표하여 추방하거나 안전하게 투표를 건너뛰는 선택은 몫입니다.
게스트들과 중립 플레이어들은 지도 주변의 아이템 상자에 접근하여 살인자에게 대항할 방법을 제공받을 것입니다.

title: Cold Salvage
description:
게임 정보
Cold Salvage is a co-operative survival game.

Take on the role of a blue-collar salvage engineer. Take contracts, working in the cold depths of space - in a job full of danger and riches. Claim your own tug from the junkyards, and earn credits to upgrade and repair it's systems. Then work with your team to return abandoned vessels to service... but watch for what lurks in the dark.

Stemming the tide of war depends on you. Return the warships to the docks, or destroy them where they drift. The horrors on board cannot be allowed to reach Earth.

title: Chrono Stone
description:
게임 정보
Game Introduction
Chrono Stone is a semi-automatic Roguelike RPG. Assemble a team, create unique skill builds, and craft powerful gear. As the commander, you’ll devise sound battle strategies and give timely commands to help your squad dodge danger, turning the tide to defeat powerful monsters and opponents.
Choose a Different Adventure
Each time you embark, the composition of the world changes. You will encounter different events, face various bosses, acquire a variety of powerful equipment, and learn unique skills. Some rewards come with risks, and may even require a painful cost. Every decision is crucial, and luck is also a part of strength.
Build Different Teams
The game features no fixed classes. Acquire a variety of skills during your adventures, combine them with equipment that has various random attributes, and create completely different team compositions for a unique gaming experience.

title: Beat Tokyo with Jimotoism
description:
게임 정보
Beat Overconfident Tokyo!
Unite the power of local pride and "hometown (jimoto: your local roots)" across the nation in this innovative action game!
Game Overview

Take control of the team led by Saitama Prefecture, joined by allies from across Japan.
Stages are set in carefully selected "hometowns (jimoto)" from Japan's 47 prefectures!
Navigate fields filled with familiar landmarks and local specialties!
Ally System

Clear stages to recruit new prefectures as allies!
They might help you by creating platforms or throw in unexpected challenges...
Harness the power of "hometowns" to pave the way to Tokyo's defeat!
Local Pride is Your Ultimate Weapon

Your attacks are powered by regional specialties! For example, Saitama wields Fukaya leeks, while Osaka throws takoyaki...
Use hometown pride to overcome stage obstacles and gimmicks.
Boss Battles with Local Trivia for Major Damage

During boss battles, answer quizzes about your local area to deal massive damage to Tokyo!
Packed with features that let you rediscover the charm of Japan while you play.
Collaboration with the Apparel Brand "Jimotoism"

The clothing your characters wear is from the apparel brand "Jimotoism."
Playing the game might unlock some exciting surprises...!

Step into the battle with local pride in your heart and defeat Tokyo!
autokwd: Beat Tokyo with Jimotoism,打倒東京にはJimotoism
company: sewohayami, 株式会社カナメクト

title: Shape Warzone
description:
게임 정보
Redefine tower defense in Shape Warzone, a 2D top-down strategy game where every wave is a fresh challenge. Unpredictable and randomized enemy spawns keep you on your toes as you defend your base from relentless, shape-themed attackers.
Start by mining Shape Shards, your currency, to build and upgrade an arsenal of turrets and defenses. Expand your base across a dynamic grid system that evolves into more challenging layouts offering higher XP rewards at greater risks. Customize your defenses with buildings like long-range snipers or lasers, defensive goos or shockers, and fast paced turrets to create a fortress as unique as your playstyle.

title: Most Quietly
description:
게임 정보
 A horror game that at first glance is not a horror game. But when you encounter a fatal error, horror begins. You find yourself in a place you shouldn't be. Now you need to pack your books because you forgot to write your essay.
 The sound scale - no, it does not capture sound in reality. When you do some loud or not so loud things, it grows. When it fills up, something always happens. Be prepared, because when it's full, something will happen!
 Sometimes, you may come across the words [DELETED] or [GLITCH] and others. There should be words in their place, but someone or something doesn't want us to know about this game. It is trying to prevent this by all means. Find out all the secrets of this unfinished game!

title: Mors Memora
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Tophet Hills!
Mors Memora is a first-person, nostalgia-driven adventure game that blends light puzzle-solving with an eerie yet familiar atmosphere. Inspired by childhood memories and the feeling of being lost in places that once felt safe, Mors Memora takes you on a surreal journey through a mysteriously empty suburban neighborhood frozen in the early 2000s.
"The things we get to see here, I know we won't see them anywhere else!"
Developed with Unreal Engine 5, Mors Memora utilizes advanced lighting and rendering technology  to create highly detailed, true-to-life environments that capture the warmth—and occasional unease—of a world that was once familiar to us.

title: Thunder Tiger
description:
게임 정보
Thunder Tiger is a fast-paced, side-scrolling shoot ’em up that blends the timeless charm of 1980s and 1990s arcades with a fresh, futuristic twist. Command your sleek, heavily armed fighter through a series of intense 2D stages teeming with alien threats, mechanized war machines, and heart-pounding boss battles. With its vibrant pixel graphics and nostalgic retro flair, Thunder Tiger offers a thrilling old-school shooter experience tailored for modern players.
Blast your way through linear, action-packed levels, perfect for unleashing your reflexes and competing for new high scores. Each stage is designed for relentless arcade mayhem, complete with rapid-fire power-ups and mesmerizing visual effects. Whether you’re a longtime fan of classic shooters or new to the genre, Thunder Tiger’s tight controls and smooth controller support make it easy to pick up, but challenging to master.
In Thunder Tiger, every second counts—dodge and weave through waves of enemies, collect power-ups to upgrade your firepower, and chain kills to rack up massive combos. Are you ready to relive the golden era of arcade action with modern speed and style? Climb into the cockpit and prepare to save the galaxy—Thunder Tiger is calling your name!

title: Regista: Reign Your Football Club
description:
게임 정보
당신의 축구 클럽의 주인이 되어라!
전략적인 선택을 하고, 아마추어 리그에서 시작해 최고의 리그로 올라가세요. 클럽을 위해 모든 것을 정리하며, 어려운 결정을 내려야 합니다. 모든 선택은 중요하며, 미래의 상황에 영향을 미칠 것입니다. 과연, 당신은 어떻게 결정하시겠습니까?
특징
당신의 지표가 전부입니다!
Regista에는 네 가지 주요 지표가 있습니다: 팬, 자금, 미디어, 그리고 팀입니다.
모든 선택은 중요하며, 각 지표는 끊임없이 무언가를 요구할 것입니다. 모든 지표를 균형 있게 유지하는 것이 중요합니다. 어느 하나라도 0이나 100에 도달하면, 해당 지표에 대한 통제권을 잃게 되고, 게임에서 패배하거나 다른 지표에 심각한 패널티를 받게 됩니다.
따라서, 절대 누구에게도 완전한 통제권을 주지 마세요. 신중하게 플레이하고, 때때로 불편한 결정을 내리더라도 시즌을 살아남아 정상을 차지하세요!
전략적인 선택을 하세요
당신의 선택은 클럽의 최하위부터 최고까지 모든 사람에게 영향을 미칩니다. 균형을 유지하려면, 원치 않더라도 결정을 내려야 할 때가 있습니다. 예를 들어, 재정 팀을 해고하거나, 선수들의 부적절한 행동에 대해 침묵을 지킬 수도 있습니다. 심지어 클럽을 유지하기 위해 자신의 명성을 희생할 수도 있습니다.
더 강해지고, 무적이 되세요!
이적을 진행하고, 팀의 사기를 유지하며, 완벽한 시즌을 목표로 하세요!
시즌 중에는 팀의 전력, 사기, 가치 등을 강화하는 카드를 만나게 됩니다. 그 선택은 항상 위험과 미스터리로 가득합니다. 즉각적인 힘을 얻을지, 아니면 장기적인 이익을 위해 안전하게 플레이할지는 당신의 결정에 달려 있습니다.
아이템을 사용하여 우위를 점하세요
때때로 상황을 당신에게 유리하게 이끌어야 할 때가 있습니다. 그런 상황에서 아이템을 활용해 우위를 차지하세요.
예를 들어, 상대와의 전력을 맞추기 위해 막바지 이적을 진행하거나, 승리 행진을 유지하기 위해 심판을 매수하거나, 결과가 마음에 들지 않는 카드를 건너뛸 수도 있습니다. 마지막으로, 진행 상황을 보호하기 위해 특정 지표를 강화해 다시 균형을 잡을 수 있습니다.
당신의 선택은 무엇입니까?

title: Lost Ground
description:
게임 정보
어느 마법사의 실수로 악마들이 지상에 강림한 이후, 인류는 패배를 거듭하여 마지막 요새까지 후퇴했습니다. 하지만 아직 모든 것이 끝난 게 아닙니다. 영웅들은 성검의 인도 아래 최후의 반격을 준비하고 있습니다. 원정대를 지휘하여 악마들에게 잃어버린 땅을 되찾으십시오. 이제 인류의 희망은 당신의 어깨에 달려있습니다.

3x3 그리드에서 펼쳐지는 턴제 전투

■ 다수의 영웅을 3x3 그리드에 배치하여 적을 물리치세요. 영웅과 적은 다양한 공격 범위를 갖고 있습니다. 효과적인 배치로 아군의 피해를 최소화하고 수많은 적을 일망타진하세요.

■ 영웅들은 불, 물, 바람 등의 속성을 가지고, 개성적인 특징을 가진 카드를 통해 전투를 수행합니다. 속성으로 보스의 약점을 타격하고, 극적인 시너지를 일으켜보세요.

■ 모험에서 획득하는 유물은 게임의 판도를 가를 수 있는 강력한 특수 효과를 제공합니다. 카드와 유물의 조합으로 자신만의 콤보를 완성하세요. 어떤 것을 획득할지는 회차마다 달라집니다!


■ 로스트 그라운드의 세계는 외길이 아닙니다. 탐험은 전진, 후진, 우회 모두 가능합니다. 육각형 타일로 이루어진 세계를 자유롭게 탐험하며 저주받은 땅의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

■ 유적, 광산, 캠프, 상점, 몬스터, 보물상자... 안개로 가려진 땅 너머에는 다양한 기회와 위험이 있습니다. 안전한 방법으로 착실하게 강해질지, 위험을 무릅쓰고 큰 보상을 노릴지, 선택은 당신의 몫입니다.

■ 퀘스트를 수행하고 보상으로 받은 특성 포인트로 영구히 성장하세요. 단순한 파밍 퀘스트부터 도전 과제에 가까운 기묘한 퀘스트까지 다양하게 준비되어 있습니다.

■ 묘하게 움푹 파인 지형이 있나요? 파헤치세요. 몬스터가 길을 막고 있나요? 때려눕히고 파헤치세요. 수상한 지역을 파헤치다보면 생각치도 못한 만남이 있을지도 모릅니다.


■ 몬스터를 찾아 처치하고 경험치를 획득하여 영웅을 레벨업 시키세요. 상위 카드를 획득하려면 충분한 레벨업이 필요합니다.

■ 모험에서 장비를 획득하고 영웅에게 장착시키세요. 머리, 몸통, 손, 발 등... 각각의 부위마다 다른 스탯이 부여되고 장비마다 다른 고유 효과가 발휘됩니다.

■ 장비, 특성 등의 일부 보상은 회차를 거듭해도 소멸하지 않고 이월됩니다. 영구히 성장하면서 강력한 적에게 도전해 보세요.

title: JumpMap
description:
게임 정보
JumpMap 은 흥미진진한 1인칭 3D 플랫폼 게임으로 특별한 메커니즘을 제공합니다: 떨어질 때마다 이전 위치로 되돌아갑니다. 정밀함과 타이밍을 요구하는 20개 이상의 신중하게 설계된 레벨을 탐험하세요. 이제 Speedrun 모드가 추가되었습니다: 모든 레벨을 통과하고 최고의 시간을 기록해 보세요!
당신의 유일한 목표는 각 레벨의 정상에 도달하는 것입니다. 클라이밍에 집중하고 도전을 헤쳐 나가며 각 오르막을 정복하는 능력을 키우세요.
게임 플레이
Speedrun 모드: 시계를 보며 모든 레벨을 한 번에 클리어하세요. 시간을 추적하고 최고 기록을 목표로 도전하세요. 자신과 친구들과 경쟁하여 가장 빠르게 완료하세요!
최고 시간 추적: 각 레벨을 완료하는 속도를 측정하고, 개인 최고 기록을 통해 도전과 성취감을 느껴보세요.
더블 점프: 공중에서 다시 한 번 점프할 수 있는 능력을 통해, 가장 까다로운 플랫폼도 마스터하고 새로운 높이에 도달하세요.
컨트롤러 및 Steam Deck 지원: 컨트롤러 또는 Steam Deck을 사용할 때 원활한 게임 플레이를 즐기세요. 이동 중에도 편안하게 또는 소파에서 편안하게 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.

title: Deck of Destiny: Battlege
description:
게임 정보
🏆 Deck of Destiny: Battleforge 🏆
Deck of Destiny: Battleforge 는 전략, 액션, 로그라이크 덱 구축의 요소를 결합한 현대적인 로그라이크 덱 빌더입니다. 4명의 전설적인 영웅 중 한 명을 선택하여 고대 땅의 마법을 되찾고 끝없는 전쟁에서 나만의 전설을 쓸 준비를 하세요.
이 전략 게임에서 각 레벨에서 살아남기 위해 영리한 카드 사용과 효과적인 전략 개발에 대한 기술을 테스트하세요. 카드는 공격, 방어, 체력, 버프, 속도의 5가지 유형으로 제공되며 각각 고유한 전략적 이점을 제공합니다. 적의 물결을 물리치고 카드, 귀중한 장비, 골드를 수집하여 캐릭터를 개발하세요. 카드를 강화하고 운과 전략 사이의 섬세한 경계에서 살아남아 운명을 형성하고 전설적인 전사가 되세요!
🌟 고대 왕국은 한때 마법과 힘으로 가득했습니다
고대 왕국은 한때 마법과 힘으로 가득했으며, 카드의 힘이 곳곳에 퍼졌습니다. 하지만 어느 날, 어둠의 저주가 모든 왕국을 뒤덮어 세계의 마법을 훔쳐 혼란에 빠뜨렸습니다. 그 결과, 파괴와 절망이 온 땅에 퍼졌고, 많은 사람들이 카드의 힘이 다시는 돌아오지 않을 것이라고 두려워했습니다.
🎯 전략과 기회에 기반한 모험
전략적 로그라이크 게임인 Deck of Destiny: Battleforge에서 각 영역에서 카드를 현명하게 사용하고 몬스터 군대에서 살아남으세요. 다음 라운드에서 기회를 높이기 위해 살아남고, 카드를 수집하세요. 전략, 빠른 생각, 뛰어난 카드 플레이가 중요합니다.
🦸 영웅을 선택하고 힘을 발견하세요
궁수, 마법사, 전사 또는 탱크? 각자 독특하고 치명적입니다! 모든 영웅은 고유한 능력을 가지고 있습니다. 캐릭터를 개발하고, 카드를 업그레이드하고, 맵 키를 수집하여 새로운 영역을 잠금 해제하세요.

title: Simulario
description:
게임 정보
The game features experimental 2D simulated physics based gameplay. The main feature of the game is that every pixel, every object, every particle in the game is a simulated physical entity.

This means, that the game is fair, it doesn't create invisible walls, doesn't impose unpredictable or illogical rules, doesn't script the way objects interact. What you see gives you complete idea what to expect. If you see a wall and want to go through, just shoot it and go.

Everything in the game is destructible. Everything acts accordingly to laws of physics, so if you want to do something, and your real world intuition makes you expect things to act in a certain way, chances are the game objects you interact with will work as you expect.

Therefore, the way you plan to win the level is up to you. You can explore possibilities, be creative, and you ideas will work if physics allow it. You can add matter, build shapes, create mechanical tools to reach the destination, you can destroy things. You can use forces, momentum or inertia. You can use ropes, wheels, jet engines, and so on.

Purely physically based gameplay is not very popular due to high performance requirements of physics simulation. But two years of prototyping and plenty of computer science allowed me to solve all problems and remove all technical obstacles, and now we have a robust physics engine, that works very fast, and allows to build massive sophisticated and fun to play with physical worlds.

The game will consists of many very different levels. You will drive a dirt bike, drive tanks and heavy multi purpose machines, fly in air, serf in water, dive underwater, fly in space, float in zero gravity or fight massive gravity, dig underground, build mechanical machines, attach jet engines and launch rockets, use ropes and forces, use heavy explosives and laser weapons. Simulated physics allow planty of ways to have fun.

But one of the most prominent features will be to control a soft body based character, that has evolved to walk and fight. That's a never before experienced level of realism and immersion.

The game is currently on early stage of implementing gameplay mechincs. The game will not be released in any kind of early access until it is finished and polished. But there will be multiple demos published, that would allow you to enjoy some of the physics based gameplay.

The game will include competitive levels with Steam based leaderboards, as well as casual levels. All levels will be highly replayable due to the fact, that it's hard to win one way, the physical world is chaotic in a certain way, and your actions will turn the world in different configurtations every time, opening new possibilities to beat levels.

The game will also have a tool for the players to create and publish user generated content.

title: Screaming Head
description:
게임 정보
In this 2d platformer you play as a polyamorous head that pushes his enemies away using the power of scream.
Your wives have been kidnapped and your life had been destroyed by none other than your own body.
It's time to prove once and for all that mind rules over body and not the other way around!
This colorful gem of a gaming experience with unbelievably punchy soundtrack and infuriatingly pushy enemies is everything you need! (if everything you need is a game about a head that is screaming)
Now go ahead and SCREAM YOUR HEAD OFF!!!

title: Cybersim: Noetic City
description:
게임 정보
Cybersim: Noetic City is a half cozy, casual room builder, where players have the freedom to relax with a casual room builder in creative mode or play strategically as a Hacker with a custom deck of hacking programs in casual and normal mode.
You are a newly appointed agent of the Special Cyberwarfare Service. You are responsible for taking down networks used by criminals in the city through a collection of various hacking programs. Use credits to furnish your home and buy upgrades for your hardware and software, to further enhance you hacking capabilities. Create a powerful deck and become a top tier hacker.
Join Our Discord
Purchase your decor and have it delivered to you.
Use your personal computer to purchase all your customizable furniture and decor for your apartment. Create the perfect cyberpunk space, just for you.
Functional Decor
Interactable options can be found across many items purchased from your computer. Apartment controls, TV channels, radio stations, lights and monitors. You have control to make your place one of a kind

title: Schematic Void
description:
게임 정보
Imagine a situation where the developer did not finish the game. "Fantastic!" - that's what you will exclaim, and you will be absolutely right.
And it's exactly how fantastic the plot of "Schematic Void" is. A game where you have to finish the work for the developer.
Using simple tools and non-standard solutions, crack the fourth wall and just have fun.

And it's also a game about electrical circuits. "Oh, Horror!" —that's what you will exclaim, and you will be completely wrong.
The schemes here are fundamental. And the fundamental principle is to be like an electrical circuit as little as possible.

And there are some pets, princesses, and even a unicorn in the game. You will exclaim "What a sweet thing!", and we completely agree with you!

Add the game to the wishlist before someone else does it before you!

- Stylish minimalistic graphics. And even stylish minimalistic animation in places.
- 2D graphics, sometimes considering itself to be 3D.
- Scratched forth wall.
- Kinda presence of a plot. A very deep one, but not wide.
- Mysterious gray cells, which you will have to use your own to solve.
- The strange humor of the developers.
- A stunning soundtrack that makes you want to dance and cry at the same time.

title: Portal Guardians
description:
게임 정보
Portal Guardians는 당신을 지루하게 만들지 않을 것입니다!
혼자 또는 친구와 싸우십시오. 다양한 무기와 함정을 사용하여 적의 파도를 막으세요! 포털이 전 세계에 열렸습니다. 곧 닫힙니다!

무기고에 있는 무기의 모든 힘을 사용하고 다양한 장소(벽, 바닥 및 천장)에 다양한 함정을 설치하여 스토리 시나리오를 진행하세요. 무기고를 개선하고 개선 수준마다 무기의 강도가 증가하고 함정의 힘이 증가합니다. 포털이 닫히는 동안 포털을 보호하여 세계 질서를 회복하고 괴물이 거기에 가지 못하게 하십시오!
주요 기능

스토리 캠페인 - 적의 무리와 싸우고 이러한 공격의 원인이 되는 신비한 힘을 발견하십시오.
협동 플레이 - 두 명의 용감한 영웅을 마음대로 사용할 수 있습니다..
치명적인 무기 - 마법, 활, 검 등 고유한 특성을 가진 9가지 유형의 무기
죽음의 함정 - 벽, 바닥, 천장에 설치할 수 있는 다양한 함정입니다. 이 함정은 적 무리를 제거하는 데 도움이 되므로 업그레이드하는 것을 잊지 마세요!
Dangerous Enemies - 고유한 특징과 특징을 지닌 30가지 이상의 상대 유형! 무기와 함정을 현명하게 선택하세요!
개선 사항 - 캠페인을 진행하면서 무기와 함정을 업그레이드하세요.
광범위한 재생성 - 난이도 선택은 몇 번이고 다시 돌아오고 싶은 욕구를 일깨울 것입니다!

title: Perplex
description:
게임 정보
네온 퍼즐 세계로 뛰어들어 보세요!
화려하고 네온으로 가득 찬 세계에서 흥미진진한 퍼즐과 짜릿한 플랫폼 도전에 도전해 보세요! 혼자서 모험을 즐기든 친구와 함께 플레이하든, 이 게임은 창의성, 전략, 그리고 심장이 뛰는 게임 플레이의 독특한 조합을 제공합니다.
🌟 주요 특징:
🎮 275개의 싱글 플레이어 레벨
직접 제작된 방대한 레벨 컬렉션에 몰입하여 여러분의 실력을 한계까지 시험해 보세요. 각 레벨은 새로운 메커니즘을 도입하며, 점점 더 어려워지는 퍼즐을 풀기 위해 창의적인 사고를 요구합니다. 전략과 정밀성을 요구하는 궁극적인 도전에 준비되셨나요?
🤝 40개의 멀티플레이어 레벨
친구와 함께 도전에 나서 보세요! 멀티플레이어 전용 레벨은 플랫폼 실력뿐만 아니라 팀워크와 소통 능력을 시험하기 위해 설계되었습니다. 두 사람이 모두 무사히 포털에 도달할 수 있을까요?
🔥 100개 이상의 흥미진진한 PvP 레벨
100개 이상의 독특한 PvP 레벨에서 경쟁적인 게임의 매력을 경험하세요. 각 레벨은 다양한 맵, 메커니즘, 장애물로 구성되어 게임 플레이를 신선하고 흥미롭게 유지합니다. 자신의 실력을 입증하고, 전술을 조정하며, 이 스릴 넘치는 멀티플레이어 경험에서 정상에 도달하세요!
🎶 몰입감 넘치는 사운드트랙과 멋진 비주얼
몰입감 있는 사운드트랙과 아름답게 디자인된 비주얼로 네온의 꿈속으로 빠져보세요. 모든 비트와 비주얼 요소가 게임 경험을 향상시키며, 매혹적인 세계로 더욱 깊이 빠져들게 만듭니다.
💎 숨겨진 보물 찾기
게임의 신비한 구석구석을 탐험하며 숨겨진 보물을 발견하세요! 레벨을 넘어 비밀과 놀라움이 가득한 세계로 안내하는 흥미진진한 보물 찾기가 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다.
🐣 숨겨진 참조
팝 컬처에 대한 참조와 게임 곳곳에 숨겨진 깜짝 요소들을 찾아보세요. 모두 발견할 수 있을까요?
이 게임은 단순한 퍼즐 플랫폼 게임이 아닙니다. 놀라움과 도전, 그리고 잊을 수 없는 순간들로 가득한 모험입니다. 게임의 메커니즘을 마스터하든, 모든 비밀을 발견하든, 단순히 네온 분위기를 즐기든, 모든 플레이어를 위한 무언가가 있습니다.
네온 도전을 받아들일 준비가 되셨나요? 지금 게임을 위시리스트에 추가하고 오늘 바로 모험을 시작하세요!

title: The First Mine
description:
게임 정보
The First Mine is a relaxed turn based building and puzzle game. You need to run a productive gold mine by placing, grouping and upgrading various resource tiles without being distracted by different game events.
Play as a single player or in multiplayer mode with friends
Place, group and upgrade various tiles to collect resources
Run a productive mine with your population to mine gold
Don't let different game events distract you
Play a calm and relaxed game alone in single player mode or play together with up to 4 friends in multi player mode. Each round you have to place, group and upgrade various tiles to mine gold and collect resources like wood, stone, wheat and fish.
To mine gold, you need people in your villages. To keep them, you must provide enough wheat and fish. More people and a higher level increases the amount of gold produced per round. You need wood and stone to upgrade the level.

title: Convenient: Fiend
description:
게임 정보
Dig up graves to steal from the dead while you escape graveyard security and run from the legendary Oldlake Wendigo.
Gameplay:

Dig up graves!
Low poly PS1 style
Survive terrifying monsters
Discover hidden secrets
The continuation of Convenient


Survive

Quickly before security catches you. You're at the Oldlake Cemetery to loot graves and make some money. Find the gravestones with the names written in your notebook and dig them up while staying out of sight. If you are spotted, make quick decisions while being chased to survive. Find hiding spots and stay out of sight until the coast is clear. Security guards aren't the only thing you'll be running from so keep your eyes peeled.




Find VHS tapes around the graveyard to uncover the mystery hiding in the cemetery. Instead of watching VHS tapes, you live them. Solve puzzles and experience the story yourself. You may be a grave robber, but there's more going on here than just a few missing bodies. Discover the birth of the Oldlake Wendigo and how to stop it.



The origins of , the short horror game made by LunaApps.

title: Duck Norris Tales
description:
게임 정보


Duck Norris Tales is pixel run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Featuring highly stylized pixel art inspired by the arcade games from the '90s.
STORY
Step into the feathers of a brave duck on a mission of revenge after aliens destroy his favorite ice cream shop! Join him on an epic journey through the depths of the Earth as he uncovers secrets, battles monsters, and rallies the Gods to aid in his quest. Can he save humanity along the way?
THE BATTLE
The Gods are divided and at war, and it's up to you to restore peace and earn their respect. Each time you challenge a God, you have the chance to gain their blessing and grow stronger! Learn new abilities and make new allies to unlock powerful super moves as you strive to bring balance.

Uncover secrets about the world and unlock devastating super attacks as you cleanse the land.

title: Shadows of Tuonela
description:
게임 정보
Journey to the Finnish purgatory – Tuonela – and fight the countless other versions of yourself to prove worthy of ascending back onto the Earth.

Explore the open world, gather resources, craft better equipment to prepare for battle.

But choose your fights wisely as the three hit combat can take even a seasoned Shadow by surprise.

Tuonela remembers only the triumphant.

title: Shadows of the Afterland
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a supernatural point-and-click adventure in which you are confronted with the most difficult decision of your life ... and death...

Madrid, 1960. A chilling incident unfolds at the city's old zoo, leading to a mysterious death that propels a soul to the threshold between the world of the living and the afterlife. But when the transition goes awry, the soul arrives with the memories of Carolina, one of the pioneers of the Madrid police force, who has not yet been born.

Step into Carolina’s shoes and delve into a detective mystery to unravel the enigma shrouding these events. Explore the wacky realm of the afterlife, teeming with unique characters and with its own rules.

In your quest for the truth, you join forces with César, an elusive former ghost agent. Persuade this enigmatic ally to accompany you on a transformative journey to confront the sinister forces lurking in the world of the living. As you gain César’s trust, you'll have to solve tricky point-and-click puzzles, harness the power of magic, navigate between worlds and even possess the living.

title: Veiled Whispers
description:
게임 정보
Enter the Abandoned House: A Haunting Horror Puzzle Experience

Welcome to a chilling adventure set within the confines of an abandoned house, where terror lurks in every shadow. Immerse yourself in a spine-chilling journey through darkened corridors and ominous rooms, all captured from a unique bodycam perspective.

Key Features:

Solve Sinister Puzzles: Explore the eerie interiors of the abandoned house and unravel intricate puzzles that test your resolve and intellect.
Perpetual Dread: Navigate through a relentless atmosphere of fear as you encounter unsettling phenomena and unearth the house's dark secrets.
Immersive Bodycam View: Experience the horror firsthand with our distinctive bodycam perspective, intensifying the suspense and realism of every heart-pounding moment.
Fear Awaits: Brace yourself for an atmospheric horror experience where every creaking floorboard and flickering light may spell doom. Can you survive the night within the haunted confines of the abandoned house?

title: Medieval Life
description:
게임 정보
Medieval Life is a fascinating text-based simulation RPG that transports you into the harsh and challenging world of the Middle Ages. This game revolves around careful planning and smart time management to survive in an era marked by hardships and social hierarchies. From securing your basic needs like food and shelter to managing your daily tasks, you must make every decision thoughtfully to not only survive but also rise to the ranks of the wealthy and powerful.

A central element of Medieval Life is starting a family and navigating the strict social classes of the Middle Ages. Your journey may begin as a simple farmer or craftsman, but with hard work, strategic alliances, and savvy management, you can gradually work your way up. Perhaps one day, you will become a ruler yourself, enjoying the respect and power that comes with the title.

Although Medieval Life may not seem like a complex game at first glance, it is full of depth and strategic challenges. Every decision you make has consequences and influences the course of your game. The combination of role-playing elements and planning makes it an engaging experience that requires both skill and foresight. This is a game that can keep you entertained for hours, providing a realistic insight into medieval life as you work to achieve your own medieval dreams.

title: Nav
description:
게임 정보
나브는 슬라브 신화에서 죽은 자의 영혼을 나타내는 말로, 비극적이고 이른 죽음, 살인자, 흑마법사, 살해당한 자, 익사한 자의 영혼에서 생겨나는 악마의 총칭입니다.
줄거리
한 젊은 역사학자가 어린 시절을 보냈던 버려진 마을로 돌아옵니다.
최근 소년은 치명적인 심장병 진단을 받았습니다. 그는 값비싼 수술이 필요합니다. 그는 마을 사람들이 어떤 컬렉션의 진주가 될 수 있는 독특한 고대 이교도 유물을 보관하고 있다는 것을 기억합니다. 그 물건을 찾아서 파는 것이 유일한 생존의 기회입니다.
그러나 버려진 마을은 언뜻보기에 비어 있지 않습니다. 그는 과거의 불친절한 유령과 맞서고 마침내 그 여름에 무슨 일이 있었는지 그토록 오랫동안 잊으려고했던 것을 기억해야 할 것입니다.
Entourage
세계 사이의 경계가 지워지고, 무서운 슬라브 동화가 살아나고, 경계 너머에서 나브가 당신을 데려가고 싶어하는 세계에 빠져들게 될 것입니다.
배경은 동유럽 어딘가의 버려진 마을입니다.

title: Snakes with Fists!
description:
게임 정보
The RPG with a Beat 'em Up Battle System
Snakes with Fists! combines the open-world exploration elements of an RPG—interesting NPCs, side quests, secrets, and a strong narrative—with the fun of fighting in the beat 'em up style! Open areas are explored in a top down 2d RPG world, Beat 'em UP stages are entered and cleared to unlock new areas and to complete quests. 
Also, you can fight anyone!
Yes, you can... but should you?
Instead of 'random encounters' you will enter into a Beat 'em Up style fight scene with anyone you punch in the RPG world.

title: Revengeful Ghost
description:
게임 정보
●Story
The main character “Keiichi Tsujisawa,” a second-year high school student attending a local school, and his twin sister “Akane Tsujisawa.
One day, the younger sister Akane disappears after a line message of “Flip phone, video”.
Soon after, a girl jumps off the roof of the school.
The protagonist heads to the school to find out the truth.
A mysterious video is left behind on her flip phone, and the incident from 25 years ago comes back to life.
She is told that if she doesn't find the location of the video, she will die.
Fear, a curse, and a horrifying truth are gradually revealed...
●System
This title is a first-person horror adventure game.
The story unfolds mainly through line messages on smartphones.
Just like real time, the in-game time is also ticking away, and messages arrive in real time.
And new incidents are triggered.
The player must use mysterious videos and messages as clues to unravel the mystery of the incidents.
●Characters
Keiichi Tsujisawa　the main character　　　　　　　　High school sophomore
Akane Tsujisawa　twin sister　　　　　　　　　　　　High school sophomore
Aya Sawakita　　 the main character's girlfriend　　　High school sophomore
Yuji Akahori　　　Classmate　　　　　　　　　　　　High school sophomore
Kota KAWABE　　Classmate　　　　　　　　　　　　High school sophomore
Reina NARUMI　　Classmate　　　　　　　　　　　　High school sophomore
Shigezo Gonda　　janitor
Chizuko Gion　　　the master of the curse　　　　　a student at the school 25 years ago
Others　　　　　Aya Sawakita's mother, Chizuko Gion's classmate

title: Echos
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in an expansive and captivating world where exploration, survival, and strategy intertwine to create a unique gaming experience.
In this open-world survival adventure, you will embark on a journey through vast and diverse landscapes, each teeming with secrets waiting to be uncovered. From dense forests to barren deserts, icy tundras to mysterious caves, the environments are not only visually stunning but also brimming with hidden challenges.
Key Features:
Exploration and Discovery: Traverse various biomes, each with its own set of challenges and resources. Uncover hidden areas, ancient ruins, and mysterious artifacts that may change the course of your journey.
Crafting and Resource Management: Gather resources from the environment to craft essential tools, weapons, and survival gear. Whether you're building a shelter, crafting advanced weaponry, or preparing potions, careful resource management is crucial to your survival.
Dynamic Combat: Face off against a range of creatures, each with its own attack patterns and weaknesses. Engage in real-time, fast-paced combat where both skill and strategy are needed to survive.
Survival Mechanics: Keep an eye on your character's health, hunger, and stamina levels. Adapt to the environment by learning to craft necessary survival items such as clothing, fire starters, and food, while managing limited resources.
Story and Quests: Experience an engaging narrative filled with side quests and objectives. The world is rich with lore, and every discovery brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind your environment and your place within it.

title: Wadar: a dimension altering reality
description:
게임 정보
Wadar is a 2d platformer designed to make you think and utilizes gameplay elements that are not seen often in platformers.
some examples of this includes the player being able to:
Flip gravity
Pause your existence?
Stop time
Teleport (in a bunch of different ways)
Use portals
Stop gravity 
and a bunch of other abilities with levels made to allow the player to get the most out of them. 
abilities are not the only focus of this game however. there are 9 worlds which includes 
Ability focused worlds
A troll world, 
A world where you have to find out how much you need to do something and 
A world based on colour platforms defining what you can see or collide with (these platforms have symbols to try and help with colour blindness compatability)
there are also a lot of secrets within some levels to be found including both unlockable cosmetics to stylize your character and even secret endings which may let you skip some levels.
there are over 70 levels in this game and plenty of which you will most likely need to play multiple times to find everything.

title: SOLIVAGANT
description:
게임 정보
A found-footage psychological horror experience.
FEATURES
Pure horror of liminal spaces
Camcorder -aesthetic
Interactable environments

title: Rogue Sky
description:
게임 정보
『Rogue Sky』에서는 중력을 무시하는 전투기를 조종하며 외계 적들의 파도를 쓸어버리세요. 전략적 깊이와 강렬한 게임 플레이가 만나는 이 불렛 헬 로그라이트 게임에서 중력을 무시하는 비행 기술과 시간을 구부리는 힘을 마스터하세요. 침략이 일어나지 않도록 시너지스러운 업그레이드와 강화를 풀어내세요. 하늘을 지배할 준비가 되셨나요?

파일럿 선택: 각각 고유한 능력을 자랑합니다. 적을 속이기 위해 시간을 되돌리거나, 시간을 늦추고 적기를 번개처럼 빠르게 피해 달리세요.

전략적 시너지: 업그레이드를 혼합하고 매치하여, 좋아하는 시너지를 찾아보세요.

특징:
8명의 독특한 파일럿들이 각자의 맞춤 능력과 움직임을 가지고 있습니다.
깊은 시너지를 가진 50개 이상의 런 업그레이드.
각 파일럿에게 공격적 혹은 방어적 플레이 스타일을 선호하게 하는 10개 이상의 영구적인 퍼크와 파워업.
통합된 컨트롤러 지원.
당신을 시험하고 보상할 업적들.

title: The Unexpected  Demise of Jacques du Schnozzle
description:
게임 정보
Jacques Du Schnozzle is the worst person in the world. Thankfully though, he’s just been murdered.
In this live-action, interactive movie, you’ll join Alana, Tim, and Lorenzo as they embark on a journey to try and figure out who killed Jacques Du Schnozzle. With no witnesses, little evidence, and zero experience in the field of criminal investigation, can this intrepid threesome solve the case or will they fall to the forces of evil?
