Starring Ashton Matthews (TripleJump), Ben Potter (also TripleJump), Peter Austin (again, TripleJump), and James Jenkins (Holbeach Primary School’s 1997 Production of Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol)
Jaw-dropping stunts and special effects like nothing you’ve ever seen before
Accompany Alana, Lorenzo, and Tim as they embark on a dark, mysterious, and potentially supernatural journey
Make choices that will alter the course of the story and unlock more than 10 different endings
All Alana ever wanted was to be a celebrity chef, but after booking diva movie star Jacques Du Schnozzle to appear on her cooking show, she begins having regrets. Whilst shooting the latest episode on a closed set, the lights suddenly go out, and when the power comes back, Alana, her producer Lorenzo, and Jacques’ assistant Tim find Jacques brutally murdered. Facing a PR disaster, the plucky trio decide to try and solve the crime themselves. After all, how hard can it be to catch a killer?
autokwd: The Unexpected  Demise of Jacques du Schnozzle

title: Killer Depths
description:
게임 정보
Killer Depths is a submarine horror game. Study the monsters that lurk below and adjust the settings on your vessel according to what you think is currently stalking you. 
FEATURES 
Over a dozen different creatures haunt the waters. Many can not be seen or heard, requiring more intuitive investigation.
The brightness, noise and the speed of the vessel will attract or scare off monsters.
Monster attacks can cause flooding, power outages and explosions. Use tools to keep the vessel from imploding.
Vigilant divers may uncover encrypted messages revealing details about the world and their employer.
What you see and hear may not be real.

title: Lonely House
description:
게임 정보
은은한 로파이(Lo-Fi) 음악이 흐르는 아한 분위기에 몸을 맡기고 집 꾸미기에서 창의성을 표현하고 싶으신가요? 시작해보세요!
­
저희 작은 게임에서는 다음과 같은 것을 할 수 있습니다:
­
다양한 식물과 다른 물건들을 이용하여 집을 꾸밀 수 있습니다
벽에 다른 그래피티 꾸미기
스타일리시한 표지판 추가하고 그 조명을 제어하기
벽의 스타일을 바꾸고 건물의 높이 조절하기
심지어 태양과 날씨까지 제어할 수 있습니다!
­
그리고 벚꽃을 감상하는 것을 잊지 마세요 ⌛️

title: Scrapworks Simulator
description:
게임 정보
게임 소개
부품을 모으고, 워크숍을 만들고, 생산을 시작하고, 거래를 시작하세요!
Scrapworks Simulator에서 당신은 폐기물 수집자로 시작하여 큰 생산 워크숍을 구축하는 길로 나아갑니다. 주변을 탐험하며 땅, 공장, 폐허에 숨겨진 부품을 찾아 모은 후, 이를 자신의 워크숍에서 결합하여 제품을 만듭니다. 제품의 금형을 만들고 주조소에서 대량 생산을 시작한 후, 제품을 일괄적으로 판매할 수 있습니다.
Mold Master(금형 장인) 또는 Foundry Worker(주조공)과 같은 전문 분야에서 숙련도를 높여 Steam의 다른 플레이어들에게 서비스를 제공하고, 보상을 얻을 수 있습니다. 필요한 기계를 구입하고, 서비스 광고를 게시하며, 다른 플레이어에게 서비스를 받을 수도 있습니다.
플레이어 간에 활발한 거래 시스템이 있어, 제품을 다른 플레이어에게 판매하거나 파트너십을 맺거나 특별 주문을 받을 수 있습니다.
이 사회적 거래의 세계에서, 다른 플레이어의 워크숍을 방문하여 새로운 아이디어를 얻고, 자신의 워크숍을 발전시키기 위한 영감을 얻을 수 있습니다. 워크숍을 확장하고, 시장에서의 위치를 강화하며, 생산의 대가가 되어보세요!
수집자에서 최고로!: 게임은 간단한 폐기물 수집자로 시작합니다.
부품 모으기: 주변을 탐험하여 땅, 공장 또는 폐허에 숨겨진 부품을 찾으세요.
워크숍 만들기: 차량 조립 워크숍, 철물 워크숍, 주조 워크숍 등을 원하는 지역에 설치하세요.
장인정신: 모은 부품을 자신의 워크숍에서 조합하여 사용할 수 있는 도구와 물건으로 만드세요.
생산 시작: 제품의 금형을 만들고 주조소에서 대량 생산을 시작한 후, 이 제품들을 대량으로 판매하세요.
제품 판매: 전시대에 제품을 전시하고, 온라인으로 광고를 게시하여 판매하세요.
부유함 과시: 작업장에 방문하는 플레이어에게 얻은 희귀 아이템을 특별한 전시대에서 과시하세요!

title: Requiem of Reuinis
description:
게임 정보
"Requiem of Reuinis" is a magictower-style RPG where players take on the role of Tassia and her companions, gradually uncovering the truth of a lost history.
Game Features:
Zonal Exploration: Players can collect resources in different areas and retreat at any time, without worrying about getting stuck due to operational mistakes!
Alchemy and Research: Players can obtain advanced resources through alchemy using exploration materials, or conduct various research to gradually enhance their strength.
Deep Customization: Nearly 300 equipment pieces and 100 skills, with numerous playable builds, allowing players to create their unique completion strategy.
Multi-layered Narrative: The stories of the protagonist group, knight orders, and the church intertwine to reveal the truth of the【Calamity】
Game Controls:
Game supports mouse play
WASD/Arrow Keys: Movement
Spacebar: Trigger event/Confirm
Esc: Cancel
Backspace: Undo
Z/X/C/V: Skills
Alt: Outlook
Ctrl: Skip dialogue
Shift: Run
autokwd: Requiem of Reuinis,列乌尼斯的挽歌 Requiem of Reuinis

title: Tolampis
description:
게임 정보
《Tolampis》is an adventure game in a watercolor hand-painted style independently developed by Yahnart, an illustrator artist. You will play as a firefly to explore a mysterious forest named Tolampis. In a bizarre visual experience, you will unravel the dark mysteries shrouding the forest and re-energize it.
Game Features:
Explore the dark forest of Tolampis. The invasion of dark forces has caused mutations in the plants, making them full of aggression.
Players will conduct exploration while flying and search for rune fragments in every corner.
Different kinds of night elves will endow players with different abilities to solve the problems they face.
Musical elements will become an important part of the gameplay process, helping you find rune fragments.
There will be puzzle-solving parts during the exploration process. You need to use the collected information to figure out solutions to the problems.
Your exploration progress in the game will change the story direction of the game, and the development of the game will be determined by the players.
Enjoy the visual effects that integrate hand-painted animation techniques and bring life to the wonderful game visuals.
In the psychedelic music atmosphere created by the artist, take a deep breath and face various challenges.
You will look for faint lights in the dark forest and explore in the psychedelic music and whimsical ideas.

title: Heir to the Throne
description:
게임 정보
왕좌의 계승자는 무작위 세계에서 매혹적인 협동 액션을 제공합니다! 몬스터 무리에 맞서 싸우고 독특한 기술을 가진 무기를 발견하세요. 기술과 영리한 팀 플레이를 능숙하게 결합해야만 승리할 수 있습니다. 운명에 맞서세요!

로그라이트 싱글 및 멀티플레이어
싱글 플레이어로 게임을 플레이할 수도 있지만, HttT는 협동 멀티플레이어 모드도 제공합니다. 악에 맞서 싸우는 공동 전투에서는 시너지 효과를 내기 위해 기술 사용을 영리하게 조율해야 합니다. 발견한 아이템을 교환하여 그룹의 전투력을 강화하세요. 죽음은 피할 수 없지만 팀 동료와 함께라면 부활할 수 있는 기회가 있습니다.

독특한 캐릭터 개발
미리 정해진 영웅 클래스가 없는 “당신이 입는 옷이 곧 당신이 된다”는 접근 방식 덕분에 캐릭터를 장비하고 플레이하는 방식이 완전히 자유롭습니다. 또한 무기 기반의 무작위 스킬 시스템을 통해 매번 다르게 진화하는 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.

title: Merana and the Cubewalker
description:
게임 정보
메라나와 큐브워커는 스토리 기반의 3인칭 퍼즐 플랫포머 게임입니다.
메라나는 어느 날 정육면체를 발견한 정착촌의 소녀입니다. 이 유물로 인해 세상이 그녀를 중심으로 움직이게 됩니다. 루빅스 큐브처럼 현재 있는 영역을 회전할 수 있습니다.
게임 플레이
주요 핵심 요소는 큐브입니다. 큐브는 모든 방향으로 회전할 수 있는 3x3x3 루빅스 큐브입니다. 큐브를 회전하면 표면이 다양한 방식으로 새로운 위치로 이동합니다.
게임의 목표는 어느 시점에서 모든 영역을 발견하는 것입니다. 먼저 미개척 지역이 지도에 표시된 다음 퍼즐과 마주하게 됩니다. 시간이 지남에 따라 점점 더 많은 지역을 이용할 수 있게 되면서 퍼즐은 더욱 어려워집니다.
퍼즐 네트워크
퍼즐을 푸는 방법에는 여러 가지가 있습니다. 플레이어는 레벨을 하나씩 완료하는 대신 어떤 퍼즐을 풀지 선택할 수 있습니다. 모든 사람이 같은 목표를 가지고 있지만 접근 방식이 다른 일종의 네트워크 시스템입니다.
지식
루빅스 큐브를 이해할 필요는 없지만, 새로운 시도를 통해 새로운 경로를 만들 수 있습니다. 리셋 버튼을 사용하면 큐브를 원래 위치로 되돌릴 수 있으므로 엉망이 될까 걱정할 필요가 없습니다.
그래픽

title: Myrtle Grove: A Clair V. Mystery
description:
게임 정보
This top down 2.5D short story game will take you the rich story of a Louisiana inspired neighborhood haunting, it's land, it's residents, and it's cultural foleys. The short story format allows for both easy accessibility and let's you discover up to 5 endings without the burden of a 30+ hour RPG.
Using Spirit Vision, Clair leaves their body in an astral form to explore the history of the place and dig deeper into the truth of the festering catalyst of its haunting.
autokwd: Myrtle Grove: A Clair V. Mystery

title: SHOJING ショウジング
description:
게임 정보
Shoji, Shocking, SHOJING.
Break through, instinctively.
"SHOJING" is a casual game in which you control a cat and break shoji screens.
Why not try breaking down those shoji screens to your heart's content, something that you're not allowed to break in the real world?
Good children and good cats, please do not copy this game.
Operation
Easy operation with only mouse movement and left click.
Even those who do not usually play games and children can easily play.

title: Beastbound
description:
게임 정보
Beastbound는 카드 기반 던전 크롤러와 다른 몬스터 테이밍 게임의 팬메이드 챌린지에서 영감을 받은 로그라이크/몬스터 테이밍 융합 게임입니다.
각 플레이에서 새로운 비스트, 아이템, 이벤트를 만나게 되며, 매번 독특한 경험을 제공합니다. 다양한 조합을 시도하고, 팀을 확장하며, 제한된 자원을 최대한 활용하세요.
당신의 비스트는 전투 사이에 체력을 유지합니다! 신중하게 행동하고 팀을 잘 관리하세요. 당신의 모든 결정은 비스트의 운명에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.
다양한 플레이 스타일을 보완하도록 설계된 여러 아이템과 아티팩트 중에서 선택해 게임 플레이 경험을 근본적으로 변화시키세요.

title: MOONY:Black_Lotus
description:
게임 정보
Reclaim Your Corrupted Memories
Dive into a captivating world where fragmented memories await discovery! In this side-scroller adventure, navigate the remains of a once thriving civilization and piece together your scattered past. Between classical jump-n-run and puzzle solving, you have to keep a close eye on your surroundings. Explore the depths as you uncover forgotten stories and concealed corruption. On your journey, you must face the truth about your past life while reclaiming the essence of yourself.
You Are Not Alone
Make your way through this hostile world and challenge yourself with uncovering it's secrets. Along the way you'll meet enigmatic strangers - use their powers to navigate the environment on different ways. Learn how to walk through solid steel bars or see in the dark. Can they aid you on your journey? Remember, every light casts a shadow.

title: Bugscraper
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the bugscraper.
🐜 In this roguelike shooter, you play as Mio and his friends, employees of a bug-filled skyscraper, who are fed up with their jobs.
🐛 On your way to your boss's office, you'll have to face waves of enemies on each floor in a tight elevator.
🐝 Using a wide variety of weapons and upgrades, eliminate them and prepare to battle for the next floor!
🐞 Play solo, or with up to 4 friends in local co-op multiplayer.

title: Sugar OVERDRIVE
description:
게임 정보
Sugar OVERDRIVE is a fast-paced melee game that takes elements from Shooters like Doom, and mixes them with the weapons and crazy combos of Character Action Games like Devil May Cry or Bayonetta.
Candy City is now the only place allowed to produce candies and sugar products, and the inhabitants of the city are slowly transforming into sugar creatures.
Something really wrong is going on here, and YOU are the only one strong enough to infiltrate the city and investigate.
...But you don't really care. All you want is to raid the city, get to the candy factory and have all the sugar for yourself. Because why bother with anything else?
COMBO OR DIE: The only way to heal is to combo your enemies into candy. The longer the combo, the more you can heal!
MASTER YOUR ARSENAL: From lightning hammers to scythes, there are many weapons to master and use in combos.
BECOME A MOVEMENT PRO: From sliding, to dashing, to kick-jumping. The movement in Sugar OVERDRIVE is expressive and deep, and you will need it to survive.
CONTROL THE FLOW OF BATTLE: Parry your enemies, throw them into deadly chocolate or explode them all with one grenade. Sugar is food to be toyed with.
CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD: Show everyone that you are the best with the infinite arena mode, where your skills are the only thing that can stop you.
SUGAR OVERDRIVE: Enemies drop sugar when they die, and the more stylish you play, the more sugar they will drop. Use sugar to unleash unique weapon abilities, or your ultimate SUGAR OVERDRIVE ability.

title: Psychotic Bathtub
description:
게임 정보
FEATURES
Argue with Rubber Duck
Drown Jesus
Drink Wine
Drink Poison
Drink Blood
Flood Bathroom
Chat with Death
Find Your Very Own Ending
WHAT’S PSYCHOTIC BATHTUB?
Sit in your bathtub and experience your very own psychotic episode. Interact with the environment and find a way out of the really scary parts of your mind. 
50% OF PSYCHOTIC’S FINAL PROFIT WILL BE DONATED
Psychotic Bathtub shows a fictional disorder that follows psychotic symptoms. Psychotic is intended to destigmatize mental health disorders and to make them accessible. 50% of it’s final profit will be donated to mental health related projects.

title: Starstrike
description:
게임 정보
Starstrike is an action packed space shooter. Take command of powerful ships and battle through sectors of space while you find new weapons and alien technologies. Improve your ship until you can take on entire fleets! Or die, upgrade, repeat.
Gameplay Features
Single-player roguelike action
Detailed ship damage. Every meter of a ship can be destroyed. Shoot off enemy weapons or engines to cripple them. Or overpower them with withering fire and watch their ship shatter.
Choose from multiple ships with different tactical loadouts and playstyles.
Advanced ship systems including teleporters, minelayers, and shield reflectors are available to bolster your offensive and defensive capabilities.

title: FPS Pro Team Manager
description:
게임 정보
Recruit and manage the team of FPS players of your dreams, create your own strategies and rise to the top of the world's elite.
Recruit and train the team of your dreams:
Recruit your favourite players from the hundreds available to create the line-up you've always dreamed of. Create their match and training schedules to keep them improving in the areas you've chosen. Are you going to train your favorite player with a sniper rifle or rather recruit one directly on the market? Why not recruit young talents and take them to the top with you?
Create your own tactics and win tournaments:
Create the tactics of your dreams and train your team on them to become more and more effective.
Master the game's money system to buy your players the most useful weapons at the right time. Force them to buy every round? Save up to buy your best player a sniper rifle? The choice is yours.
Choose the tactics to be used during the rounds from those you have created or from those that already exist. And why not take inspiration from your opponents' tactics?
Register your team for the tournaments that are most interesting to you, from the smallest local LAN to the biggest major tournaments.
Modify your game:
Easily edit game files to change player stats and appearances, teams, tournaments and more to get the career of your dreams. And why not add yourself and your friends to the game?
Manage your sponsors and finances:
Meet your sponsors' targets and deadlines to boost your finances and progress to the highest level. Be careful, though, if you don't achieve your objectives.

title: Escape Alliance
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
Escape Alliance is a fast paced maze runner where you will advance through maps of dangerous enemies, obstacles and projectiles while making sure to not touch the edges of the map. Only one hit will take you out!
Singleplayer/Multiplayer
It's perfectly fine to play the game alone, but if you play with other players, the first player will unlock the next checkpoint for everyone else, making it a collaborative experience.
Some maps will only be available in multiplayer as it will have puzzles requiring multiple players to solve.
The game supports up to 12 players.
Maps
The game will introduce different landscapes and different maps, but as of now only one map and a snow biome has been developed.
Release date

title: TORSO TENNIS
description:
게임 정보
Enter the world of TORSO TENNIS: a sports-like roguelike. DRAFT and GRAFT to perfect your TORSO and win the season.
WISHLIST TO BECOME A TENNIS GOD
FEATURES
High-intensity grid-based multi-ball tennis gameplay.
Upgrade & Win. Level up your LIMBS, get perma-boosts from TATTOOS, and YOINK limbs from your defeated opponents.
Tons of builds. Find new limb + tattoo combinations that absolutely wreck your foes and break the game.

title: Brawl To The West
description:
게임 정보

서쪽에는 신룡이 있고, 그것을 얻으면 영원히 살 수 있고 무적의 존재가 된다고 합니다! 수많은 사람들이 그 용을 차지하기 위해 추격전에 뛰어들고, 약한 자는 처참하게 죽고, 승자가 모든 것을 차지합니다. 가장 멀리 가는 사람이 되시겠습니까? ...... 즐거운 카드 자체 추진 게임. 장비와 마법 보물을 선택하고, 과일 나무와 악마 짐승을 키우고, 분대를 구성하여 사방을 죽이고 용감하게 서쪽으로 여행할 수 있습니다! 다양한 캐릭터를 선택하여 게임을 시작할 수 있으며 비동기 매칭 랭킹 모드와 다른 플레이어와 대결 할 수도 있으며 장르는 최고이며 각 게임은 새로운 경험입니다!



이 게임은 농업 요소를 자주식 체스 모드에 혁신적으로 통합하고 나무 심기, 와인 양조, 식사 및 거래의 논리로 게임 플레이를 패키지화했습니다. 나무를 심어 강해지세요! 돼지를 키우면 더 강해집니다! 육성 장르와 “농사” 프로그램은 분리할 수 없고, 매우 몰입적이며, 매우 근거가 있습니다!



]

title: E-Shop Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
"E-Shop Tycoon" is a game about managing an online shopping site in all aspects;
Create your own online shop
Hire new employees, expand your office, deal with cargo companies, advertise, buy new buildings, get ahead of other companies, increase your popularity and earn more.
Start in the garage and buy products from your computer. Sign a contract with a cargo company, build your own warehouse and sell products through your warehouse. Advertise your company to increase your prestige and increase your sales popularity. Sell in bigger places by reaching your targets.
Customize your office
Buy and place items in the office to keep your employees happy. Make your office more usable by buying new items. Customize your office by arranging it the way you want!
Grow and manage your company
Create new departments, upgrade your servers and warehouses or hire more employees to speed things up. Accept deals from other companies for more income!
New departments, new opportunities
Establish your own cargo company, cut the middle man and keep all the profits to yourself!
Found the Software Department to protect your site from hackers by providing a high level of cybersecurity. Return the favor, form shady deals with hackers to attack rival sites and destroy their prestige!
Deal with characters
Throughout the game, meet new characters and try to get along with them.
Your users are key to your success
Manage customer requests and gain prestige by keeping them happy. See how your company is doing on social media and react to the posts of customers and companies. Give interviews to media companies and increase your popularity.
Increase your sales by organizing campaigns and advertising activities. See the results of your advertisements and campaigns as sales results.

title: Dice Dice Dice: A Roll Playing Game
description:
게임 정보
Explore a world of turn based RPG but every move has been replaced with dice rolls.

Tactical Dice Combat: Engage in strategic battles where every roll matters. With each character wielding their own dice, the outcome of your attacks, defenses, and abilities are in the hands of chance. Adapt, strategize, and roll your way to victory!

Customizable Dice Heroes: Discover fragments scattered throughout the world and unlock new party members to join your quest. Customize each die face with shards found in chests or earned from vanquished foes. Craft the perfect combination of abilities and unleash the full potential of your party!

Chance and Choice: Embrace the unpredictability of the dice as you face enemies and make crucial decisions. With the outcome of battles, the loot you discover, and the fate of your party all determined by the roll of the dice, every moment is a thrilling gamble.

The choice is out of your hands, its in the dice you just threw.
autokwd: Dice Dice Dice: A Roll Playing Game

title: Monolith's Dreamers
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a mysterious world on a quest for a lost civilization. Solve puzzles and try to prevent disaster from unfolding.
Nyria, a young archaeologist and adventurer, is searching for a way to save her world from a dire fate.
To do so, she places her hopes in exploring the ruins of an ancient and mysterious civilization that vanished long ago.
In the Depths of the Ruins, she encounters mysterious entities and follows in the footsteps of explorers who came before her.
She gradually uncovers numerous Secrets of the Forgotten Past and comes to understand that these ruins are, in fact, connected to the very fabric of Space and Time.
As the only one capable of unraveling and solving the threads of destiny, Nyria unexpectedly finds herself carrying a burden far heavier than she ever imagined…
Navigate the traps protecting the ruins and help the inhabitants.

title: INFERIUS
description:
게임 정보
단테의 지옥과 러브크래프트 호러의 독특한 조화. 1인칭 로그라이크 덱빌더로, 메이저 아르카나 타로 카드를 사용해 어둠 속에 도사리고 있는 공포에 맞서 전략을 세웁니다. 완벽한 덱을 구성하고, 지옥 9층의 각 통치자에게 도전하고, 자주 죽기... 그리고 반복합니다.
메이저 아르카나 타로 카드를 사용한 덱 구성
메이저 아르카나는 당신의 가장 위대한 도구이지만, 동시에 가장 큰 장애물이기도 합니다. 여러 차례에 걸쳐 덱을 짜고, 아르카나를 강화하고, 정신이 걸린 전략적인 카드 전투에 참여하세요.
환생할 때마다 더욱 강력해집니다
전투 전에 미리 전략을 세우고 카드를 강화하세요. 인장과 브랜드를 적용하여 곱하기 효과를 적용하고 확률을 자신에게 유리하게 밀어붙이십시오.
랜턴을 사용해 주변 환경에 영향을 주세요
악몽 같은 생물들이 어둠 속에서 당신을 잡을 것입니다. 랜턴을 사용하여 인페르노를 가로지르는 동안 주변 환경을 구부리고 조작하세요. 당신의 정신이 시험대에 오를 것입니다.
1인칭 스텔스: 영혼을 사냥하는 끔찍한 생물을 피하세요.
전략적인 덱 구축: 메이저 아르카나 타로 카드의 힘을 활용하고 더 깊이 내려갈수록 그들의 힘을 키우세요.

title: Body Count
description:
게임 정보
Body Count lets you step into the worn shoes of a dedicated cop whose world is shattered by a personal tragedy. As the line between right and wrong blurs, you'll grapple with the moral cost of justice in the face of unspeakable loss. Dive into a gripping experience where personal consequences are no longer calculated and a once venerable cop decends into the path of vengeance.


Body Count is a bullet hell shooter that challenges you to explore the gritty side of morality as you navigate a city teetering on the edge of chaos.

title: 史莱狗
description:
게임 정보
Slimg chased by space pirates, is forced to land on a mysterious planet. In order to leave this planet, Slimg began his adventure on this planet
Explore
The SR400 planet has a total of four regions with completely different styles.
Sdog village: The creatures in sdog village love pumpkins, and there is a mysterious ability in the village that allows other creatures to freely grow and shrink.

title: Raed
description:
게임 정보
Lost in the aftermath of a black hole incident, you’re left floating in space with fading oxygen and fragmented clues. Explore haunting environments, uncover hidden truths, and piece together the fate of your crew in this emotional sci-fi adventure. Will you survive long enough to face the dark secret that awaits?

title: Crone
description:
게임 정보
Crone is rogue-like dungeon crawler with fast paced combat and high-octane spell casting. Collect scrolls to help you survive the decent. Resources in the depths are limited, so use them wisely. Rescue the residents of Bogtown to unlock new upgrades and grow stronger. The Crone's eyes have been stolen. Recover them to reveal the mysteries that lurk below.

title: Xiwang Ave N 3rd Section
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview
Xiwang Ave N 3rd Section is a story-driven, first-person, single-player exploration game. At his mother’s request, the protagonist takes a break from work to deliver packages for a distant relative in his home city. After many years of drifting, memories now overlap with reality, and those who were once lost or out of contact suddenly reappear, bringing long-buried pasts……The newly built pedestrian bridge, the temple running a car wash business, the never-ending construction site, and the lost packages…the ordinary everyday life might show signs of an approaching storm….
And that so-called ‘helping out a distant relative’ seems to have some embarrassing truths that are hard to speak about.......
Features
Play a first-person, story-driven city exploration game

title: Marble Dash
description:
게임 정보
Marble Dash is the peak rolling experience! Try to complete the large variation of levels and become the best by competing against the world on the leaderboards! Play with or against your friends in the competitive multiplayer modes and choose to send them flying or prove you are the fastest.



Roll Around Each Unique Level From Easy to Impossible in Difficulty!
Compete Against Your Friends or Those Around The World in the Best Times!
Customize Your Marble and Collect All the Easter Eggs in Each Level!
Enjoy the Amazing Environments and Sound Track to Keep You Rolling!
Master Your Rolling Abilities to Become the Greatest Marble to Exist in Marble Dash.

title: Trouble in Cookie Town
description:
게임 정보
COOKIE TOWN UNDER SIEGE! 🍪⚠️
Disaster has struck Cookie Town! The once-sweet and peaceful city is being devoured by dancing, cookie-eating monsters! With the town’s legendary Broccoli Repellent shattered and scattered, nothing is stopping the crazed horde. As the towns last hope, you must grapple, shoot, and puzzle-solve your way through the chaos—recovering lost pieces, fighting monsters, and mastering physics-based challenges to save Cookie Town before it crumbles!
🪝 Grapple, Swing & Solve! – Use your physics-based grappling hook to zip through Cookie Town, dodge monsters, and complete tricky challenges to recover the lost Broccoli Repellent!
💥 High-Score Mayhem! – Blast cookie monsters, chain insane combos, and master physics-driven puzzles as you fight to save the city from becoming a snack.
🎯 Complete Wacky Challenges! – Take on bizarre physics-based puzzles and absurd objectives to recover all the missing repellent pieces. (It’s okay to get angry—we believe in you!)
🍪 Cookie-Chomping Chaos! – Face an army of unpredictable, dancing, and dangerously hungry monsters who won’t stop until every crumb of Cookie Town is devoured!
🤣 Goofy, Over-the-Top Action! – Physics-driven movement, slapstick combat, ridiculous puzzles, and a surprising amount of dance battles—because why take anything seriously?

title: Mirror Soul!
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a mesmerizing journey in Mirror Soul, a unique puzzle platformer where you control two characters bound by an unbreakable mirrored connection. Explore intricately designed levels that challenge your wits and reflexes, utilizing the power of symmetry to overcome obstacles and solve mind-bending puzzles.
In Mirror Soul, you take control of two characters simultaneously, each moving in perfect mirrored harmony. Every step, jump, and action you perform is mirrored across an axis, demanding precise coordination and strategy to navigate the dual worlds. Guide your characters through beautifully crafted environments filled with traps, platforms, and puzzles that require synchronized movements and creative thinking.
Key Features:
Symmetrical Control: Master the art of controlling two characters at once, with every move mirrored along an axis. Perfect your timing and coordination to progress through challenging levels.
Intricate Puzzles: Solve a variety of puzzles that test your logic and spatial awareness. Use the unique mechanics of mirrored movement to unlock new areas and secrets.
Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in a visually captivating world, with each level featuring detailed, hand-crafted environments that enhance the dual-world concept.
Engaging Storyline: Unravel the mystery behind the connection between the two characters. Discover their story through captivating narrative elements woven into the gameplay.
Dynamic Soundtrack: Enjoy an atmospheric and dynamic soundtrack that adapts to the gameplay, enhancing the immersive experience of Mirror Soul.

title: Marble Havoc
description:
게임 정보
Marble Havoc is a 3D-action game. Take your marble in different levels to the goal.

You start with your marble on a way in a waterland. Navigate your marble over the way without falling into the water.



Jump over obstacles and ditches. Find the flag. Your mission is to navigate your marble to the flag and hit the flag pole. Then you mastered the level.

You are not alone! In the waterland there are other marbles on their way:

title: Witchpop
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Souper Star Cafe where the secret ingredient is Magic. Pick your chef and sous chef, pick your soup, and cook with your spells to make the best soup possible.
Features
Physics Based Puzzle Matching, where you'll have to match ingredients in real time! Avoid your ingredients touching the bottom of the pot where they'll end up burning. Too many burned ingredients and your soup will be ruined!
Accumulate Curses over time and survive as long as you can while trying to attain the highest score possible.
Use Spells to either help save your soup or to score even higher
Risk and Reward Gameplay. Make and store up larger clusters of ingredients to score even more, and take extra curse cards for even higher multipliers
Play with Friends, either head to head in different soup pots, or cooperatively sharing the same pot with multiple cursors.
Multiple Characters to change the aesthetics of your chef and sous chef. With all characters sharing the same abilities, all characters are equally viable to be picked.
Mouse/Keyboard and Controller Support. Either use your mouse to fling ingredients, or, use a gamepad to control the cursor or to teleport between ingredients for incredibly fast movement.

title: Pinball Blitz
description:
게임 정보


Pinball Blitz combines arcade pinball with a fast-paced action roguelike. Shape each run with selectable themes, flipper setups, and table upgrades to defeat bosses and achieve high-scores.
Table Select
Select a theme that determines the ramps and playfields of your table.
Choose a flipper setup that best fits your style.
Each theme and flipper setup will have its advantages - find a combo that helps you shoot combos.
Upgrades
After completing a set of ramps, choose a table upgrade to propel your game.
Upgrades range from multiball to guided rockets - new combinations add to a chaotic run.

title: Rolling Bombs
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a thrilling adventure in Rolling Bombs, a 3D platformer set in the enchanting yet perilous land of Boomerland. With an explosive gameplay, vibrant environments, and challenging mechanics, this game will keep you rolling with excitement!
From dodging enemy bombs to navigating molten lava lakes, every moment in Rolling Bombs is packed with challenges that will test your wits and reflexes. Whether you’re planning your level escape or perfecting your skills in time-based challenges, there’s always a reason to jump back in and play again.
Features:
🕹️ Time-Based Levels + Boss Fights
Dive into a variety of detailed levels, full of secrets to unveil and coins to collect, each more thrilling and challenging than the last, with some epic boss battles that will test your mettle.
⏳ Race Against Time
In each level, the clock is ticking since the fuse has been lit. Can you find your way to the magical well before it’s too late?

title: Dunthera - Tower Defense
description:
게임 정보
주요 특징:
30종 이상의 몬스터, 각각 고유한 행동과 능력을 보유.
5개의 서로 다른 생물군계에 걸친 15개의 독특한 맵, 각각 다른 환경과 경로 제공.
6가지 다양한 타워, 각각 독특한 공격 패턴을 가짐.
플레이어가 조종하는 영웅, 강력한 몬스터에 맞서 타워를 돕는다.
스킬 트리 시스템, 영웅과 타워 모두를 강화 가능.
VFX (비주얼 이펙트), 특수 셰이더와 파티클을 활용한 빛나는 요소 포함.

title: SU42: Hired Gun
description:
게임 정보
Indie game made by a husband and wife from Poland
Play Solo or Co-Op with friends
Steam Remote Play. Invite your friends to your virtual couch
Steam Remote Play TV. Play on your TV.
Choose your two heroes and switch them during the fight
Your playstyle depends on the heroes you choose
This isn’t just mindless mayhem—enemies adapt to your tactics
Colorblind-friendly: Protanopia, Deuteranopia, Tritanopia
SU42: HIRED GUN – This is my private project, born out of a love for the classics of the 80s and 90s.
It all started with a sketch of one of the characters.
Over time, more ideas emerged, until my wife and I turned it all into a concrete game project. I’ve been working in game development for years and thought, “What if I made and released a game myself? One that I want to make, not one a client demands.” Something from a gamer, for gamers. That’s how SU42: Hired Gun came to be—a classic side-shooter packed with action and tactics, offering varied gameplay depending on the chosen characters or on-screen situations.

title: Riftseekers
description:
게임 정보
Use abilities and powerups to defeat enemies, avoid traps, collect gems, and score enough points to summon bosses. Defeat these bosses to complete stages and open rifts to randomized biomes. Collect upgrades between stages to make sure you can survive. In this endless arcade-style roguelike, how many points can you get?

title: Paperlands
description:
게임 정보
Paperlands is a 2D puzzle adventure set in a papercraft world where everything can be interacted with only if brought to life with color. A child started to color the world but got quickly distracted and the world was not finished. Help the people of Paperlands to finish what was started and bring Paperlands to life!
Key Features
Color the objects and people to be able to interact with them
Solve puzzles, unlock new colors and reach new locations
Get creative and color the world to your liking

title: Imperium
description:
게임 정보
In Imperium, you play as a Paladin either solo or as a team of 4, pitted against the hordes of a necromantic cult; you are tasked with defending various fortresses in a grand fantasy war. Arm yourself with spells, build wards to repel evil, and fight to the bitter end.
Experience Unrelenting action, with combat inspired by 90's shooters and Dungeon Crawling Classics.
Wield an arsenal of both magic and melee weapons simultaneously. Combine both to discover new combos and strategies.
Access new Potions, Cantrips, Spells and Melee Weapons during play.
Enchant your weapons to deliver even more radiant justice.
Drink potions to unlock bonuses for use during a run.

title: Hydra Coil
description:
게임 정보
Hydra Coil is a Relaxed Turn-based Space Fantasy RPG where you explore a miniature cosmos, assemble a crew of Voyagers, and uncover the mysteries of the Hydra—an ancient force struggling to emerge from a dying universe.
Imagine Heroes of Might and Magic... set in space!

FEATURES
Turn-Based Space Exploration: Traverse miniature Solar Systems with your Spaceship; fly to new worlds, visit space stations, ghost ships, fantastic creatures, and countless other wonders floating in space. 
Orbital Mechanics: Fly around planets, visiting colonies, landmarks, and more points of interest to gather treasures and trigger story events.  
Tactical Spaceship Battles: Simple yet engaging 4v4 battles in space or in a planet's atmosphere.
Simple Colony Building: Construct and maintain colonies on key worlds, with many different colony types to accommodate unique alien races. Place new structures and upgrade existing ones to strengthen the colony and receive rewards.
Grow your Crew: Meet new Voyagers along the way and add them to your crew, each with unique abilities and skills to upgrade.
This game does not have:
Multiplayer
Playable Characters (Spaceships only)
Grand Strategy, this is not an RTS or 4x style game
Microtransactions

title: A Paranormal Story
description:
게임 정보
After days of being held captive, you finally manage to escape from your kidnapper. However, the feeling of freedom you should feel evaporates when you realize you have the cell phone of the man who kidnapped you. The right thing to do would be to just wait for the police, but a strange feeling takes over you. There are dark secrets hidden in this cell phone, and YOU NEED TO UNCOVER THESE SECRETS!
A paranormal story is an investigation and suspense game where you must try to understand the past and secrets of the cell phone owner, through old messages, notes and mysterious apps through a fake smartphone interface.
Think twice before anything
During the game, you will have to solve countless puzzles. With each solved puzzle, a new door opens, and you get closer and closer to the truth. But be careful: in A Paranormal Story, you must choose the path that your character will follow, and each decision can influence the final outcome of your story.

title: Teddy the Tractor
description:
게임 정보
You arrived to help your uncle with crops in the fields. But of a sudden, you've been attacked by a tractor monster. To rescue the village, you must collect crops and defeat Teddy the tractor!
One of the most important parts of Teddy the Tractor is the tractor. You will ride your tractor, upgrade it, unlock new weapons, and fight Teddy.
During the gameplay, you move through the story by committing quests and collecting crops day by day. Time moves forward constantly, and some quests can be missed or failed.

title: Xontainer Meta Space
description:
게임 정보
About Xontainer Meta Space
Xontainer Meta Space offers a unique simulation experience where players can immerse themselves in a world of logistics, strategy, and innovation. With advanced AI-powered NPCs and a wide array of features, this game brings a new level of realism and interactivity.
Key Features:
AI NPCs with Advanced Communication
Interact with NPCs using either voice (microphone) or text. Each NPC supports two different languages, with a total of 20 languages currently available. English, Turkish, and Spanish are supported at launch.
Truck Operations
Take control of trucks for cargo transportation. Buy, customize, and upgrade your vehicles to improve efficiency and performance.
Warehouse Missions
Engage in tasks like loading and unloading cargo, managing inventory, and completing depot assignments.
Forklift and Vehicle Usage
Operate forklifts for precision tasks or drive vehicles to navigate the expansive in-game world.
Energy Production
Harness power from generators, batteries, and wind turbines to fuel your operations and optimize your logistics network.
In-Game Smartphone System
Use your in-game phone to call other players, transfer money, accept missions, and deliver completed tasks. The smartphone feature brings a dynamic layer of interaction and gameplay management.
Xontainer Meta Space combines realism, strategic gameplay, and player-driven interactions to create a truly immersive simulation experience. Wishlist now and join the next evolution in logistics gaming!

title: Mitch
description:
게임 정보
In this story-driven art game, you’ll follow Mitch, who’s just moved to a strange new planet. Join her as she settles in — starting a new job, exploring the city, and meeting all kinds of interesting folk.
Key Features
Explore the city! Jump on the subway and discover each unique neighborhood.
Meet new friends! Develop relationships with a variety of unusual characters. 
Work for a spider chef! Grind away at your new job - serving sandwiches to flies.
Settle in for a heartwarming and introspective story. Watch Mitch as she grows and adapts to her new life. Face challenges, solve problems, and learn lessons as events unfold.
Enjoy open-world freedom grounded by a linear journey. Join Mitch for a week in her life. Each day is full of potential!
100% indie. This is a two-dev project with hand-drawn artwork and an original soundtrack.

title: Sculptor
description:
게임 정보
In Sculptor you create statues of girls: broke stone segments, use special skills and paint color. Improve your skills with the teacher and become more effective in creating sculptures.

Follow the story of a lonely sculptor who created a statue of a girl and fell in love with her. To bring her to life, he makes a deal with the goddess Aphrodite.
Features of the game:
1. Unusual mechanics of three-stage sculpture creation.
2. A strong story inspired by ancient Greek myth of Pygmalion.
3. The setting of Ancient Greece and myths.

title: Squash and Spell : Kids Typing
description:
게임 정보
Squash and Spell is a fun & friendly game designed for children as soon as they show an interest to interact with a computer. 
A fun on screen representation of all the letters in the alphabet.
                     A spelling rainbow with lots of words.
A word processor mode which lets children type and see the result.
                     Fully voice acted, including a toggle for phonics.
A writing mode where, depending on hardware, children can use a stylus, touch or mouse to draw letters.
                    Time of day system with cosy ambient sounds.

title: Miljama horror tale
description:
게임 정보
Miljana는 전쟁 지역에 있는 병사의 관점을 다루는 심리 공포 게임입니다.
Miljana
Miljana에서 당신은 몇 주 동안 적의 요새에 갇혀 있다가 마침내 아군과 연락을 취하게 됩니다. 구조 팀이 파견되지만, 적에 대한 고급 정보를 활용하여 그들을 당신의 위치로 안내하는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 그러나 당신의 임무는 단순한 지시를 내리는 데 그치지 않습니다. 임무의 성공은 당신의 전략적 결정과 도전을 극복할 능력에 달려 있습니다.
게임플레이
Miljana는 구조 팀을 안내하고 관리하는 다양한 메커니즘을 갖춘 1인칭 포토리얼리즘 시뮬레이터입니다.
주요 특징
분위기 있는 환경과 포토리얼리틱 그래픽
좌표 기반 메커니즘

title: The Hidden Library
description:
게임 정보
"The Hidden Library" is a 2D adventure with point-and-click elements, where you will immerse yourself in worlds forbidden by authority, awakening the imagination and guiding you through a forgotten literary past.
Set in Southern Russia in the early 2000s, you play as Elena, a 13-year-old girl who discovers her late grandfather’s hidden library. It is a place of shadows, secrets, and forbidden Soviet-era literature. As Elena uncovers stories that were once censored, she becomes absorbed in their worlds, meeting characters from novels that the Soviet authorities deemed dangerous and subversive. Each new adventure plunges the player into the very heart of one of these stories, offering a rare glimpse into ideas that were hidden from the public eye, questions of freedom, and the power of literature.
Explore a Library Full of Secrets
The hidden library is not just a place of forgotten books. It is a labyrinth of secrets. Every shelf, every corner hides an artefact or a clue, urging you to delve deeper into Elena’s family history. Diaries, letters, and photographs reveal the mystery of Elena’s grandfather and the dangerous truths he sought to protect.
Journey Through Forbidden Books
Each level of the game is inspired by a banned book or genre, recreating the worlds of Soviet political satires, dystopian futures, and subversive classics. Walk in the footsteps of characters from iconic works, experience their conflicts, interact with complex individuals, and understand why these stories were deemed too dangerous to be read by the Soviet government.
Interact with Literary Figures
Meet characters from the banned books you explore. These figures are not just passive elements in the world; they are alive, complex individuals with their own motivations and inner conflicts. Form alliances, face enemies, and learn about their roles in the struggle against oppressive regimes.
Immersive Story-Driven Gameplay
Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and open new areas as you dive deeper into Elena’s journey and the stories hidden within forbidden literature. Each encounter with characters and themes from these novels sheds light on the enduring struggle for truth, memory, and freedom.

title: DEVIL'S WAY 2
description:
게임 정보
조용한 마을에서 평범한 사람으로서 당신은 생활을 시작합니다. 그러나 심해지는 정신분열증 발작으로 인해 당신의 삶은 지옥으로 변해버립니다. 마을은 더 이상 익숙한 곳이 아니라, 끔찍한 악몽으로 변모했습니다. 이제 살아남고 이 악몽에서 벗어나기 위해서는 당신의 지혜와 용기를 사용해야 합니다.
주요 특징
두려움으로 가득 찬 분위기
외진 어둡고 쓸쓸한 마을 길, 섬세하게 디자인된 환경과 소름 돋는 음향 효과가 당신을 소름끼치게 만들 것입니다.
제한된 자원 관리
마을에서는 제한된 수의 총알과 한 개의 무기만이 당신을 도울 수 있습니다. 자원을 신중하게 사용하여 살아남으세요.
심리적 긴장과 공포
정신분열증 발작으로 인해 마을 길가의 표지판에서 여러 질문들을 보게 됩니다. 그러나 이 질문들이 당신을 올바른 길로 인도할지, 아니면 더 큰 위험으로 이끌지 모릅니다.
괴물에 맞서 생존하기
정신분열증 발작의 결과인지 현실인지 구분하기 어려운 무서운 괴물들과 싸워야 합니다.
깊은 이야기와 현실적인 캐릭터
정신 질환과 싸우는 한 인물의 시각에서, 현실과 환상이 뒤섞인 이야기를 체험하세요.
DEVIL'S WAY 2는 끊임없이 경계심을 일깨우는 분위기, 강렬한 이야기, 그리고 도전적인 생존 메커니즘을 통해 플레이어들에게 잊을 수 없는 공포 체험을 선사할 것을 약속합니다.

title: AREA 8
description:
게임 정보
A science fiction and horror adventure-action game with first-person and third-person gameplay perspectives.
As an operative, you are assigned to a remote research facility known as Area 8, a place so secret that even its name is hidden from the public. What awaits you within this facility are experiments that push the boundaries of science and nature, mind-bending creatures, and fragments of an intricate mystery. But beware—once you step inside, there’s no guarantee of coming back...
If you dare to unveil the mystery, add Area 8 to your wishlist now!

title: Archery Pro VR
description:
게임 정보
Archery Pro brings life-like, competitive archery straight to your living room through VR!

There’s no need for archery equipment to experience the fun of Olympics style Archery with Archery Pro. Simply pop on your headset and experience all the thrills of real-life archery.

Be warned, archery is extremely addictive and challenging.

You can compete online with friends or other players and climb the tournament ranks and unlock amazing rewards.

Players can also experience a realistic and challenging single player campaign by tackling specific trick shots and situations. Friends can compare scores and progress with each other on the leaderboard.

title: DisplaceMen
description:
게임 정보
DisplaceMen is a magic realist ADV that depicts a seven-day mystery story with multiple scenarios and endings.

In the coastal town of Huanmen, everyone knows how to 'displace'—to turn any item or even living being they own into another, as long as the two have equivalent psychological value. Displaced things will vanish and be forgotten.

You are a broke painter who wanders around the town, collecting the strangest things to make art. While chatting with your commissioners, with a painter’s eye to observe and imagine, you will unveil the true faces of these people - the motivational speaker, the trace scholar with a day job as a tattoo artist, the hardcore cosplayer teenager, the wanted pseudoscientist, etc. Working to redeem the vanished “mermaid,” you will accumulate properties until you realize you can displace people. Deciding what to let go of is a painter’s practice. Stay sensitive. Stay gold.



This game will provide a unique visual novel experience featuring multiple gameplay mechanics -
Magic-Realist Narrative
Experience the mainstage “mermaid” mystery by making seamless decisions for multiple endings. Enjoy the satellite stories while exploring various locations in a town operating with the rules of displacement.
Imagine the most impossible found objects as art material. Observe your subjects and chat with your clients to uncover their secrets. Make artistic decisions to enable story branching. Balance special personal values for characters to activate unique painting results.
Collect items and tokens of human ownership within the main story and sidequest. *Bonus: Displace your item or token at the right moment for the best value by watching your psychological values change triggered by events.
Solve small drag-and-drop puzzles while immersed in visceral dream sequences of the vanished “mermaid.” Witness the forgotten story emerging from beautifully intangible streams of consciousness.


_

*Love is an investment. This is a story for those who have the deepest love for things that are not present. We miss the things that are not here, and this drives us insane. We have different mechanisms to process this, and this game proposes two of them: 1, Keep talking to people, and 2, Keep making paintings.

*By the way, the game can make you laugh a lot, especially at inappropriate moments.

Play a first-person, story-driven city exploration game

Marble Dash is the peak rolling experience! Try to complete the large variation of levels and become the best by competing against the world on the leaderboards! Play with or against your friends in the competitive multiplayer modes and choose to send them flying or prove you are the fastest.



Roll Around Each Unique Level From Easy to Impossible in Difficulty!
Compete Against Your Friends or Those Around The World in the Best Times!
Customize Your Marble and Collect All the Easter Eggs in Each Level!
Enjoy the Amazing Environments and Sound Track to Keep You Rolling!
Master Your Rolling Abilities to Become the Greatest Marble to Exist in Marble Dash.

title: Trouble in Cookie Town
description:
게임 정보
COOKIE TOWN UNDER SIEGE! 🍪⚠️
Disaster has struck Cookie Town! The once-sweet and peaceful city is being devoured by dancing, cookie-eating monsters! With the town’s legendary Broccoli Repellent shattered and scattered, nothing is stopping the crazed horde. As the towns last hope, you must grapple, shoot, and puzzle-solve your way through the chaos—recovering lost pieces, fighting monsters, and mastering physics-based challenges to save Cookie Town before it crumbles!
🪝 Grapple, Swing & Solve! – Use your physics-based grappling hook to zip through Cookie Town, dodge monsters, and complete tricky challenges to recover the lost Broccoli Repellent!
💥 High-Score Mayhem! – Blast cookie monsters, chain insane combos, and master physics-driven puzzles as you fight to save the city from becoming a snack.
🎯 Complete Wacky Challenges! – Take on bizarre physics-based puzzles and absurd objectives to recover all the missing repellent pieces. (It’s okay to get angry—we believe in you!)
🍪 Cookie-Chomping Chaos! – Face an army of unpredictable, dancing, and dangerously hungry monsters who won’t stop until every crumb of Cookie Town is devoured!
🤣 Goofy, Over-the-Top Action! – Physics-driven movement, slapstick combat, ridiculous puzzles, and a surprising amount of dance battles—because why take anything seriously?

title: Mirror Soul!
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a mesmerizing journey in Mirror Soul, a unique puzzle platformer where you control two characters bound by an unbreakable mirrored connection. Explore intricately designed levels that challenge your wits and reflexes, utilizing the power of symmetry to overcome obstacles and solve mind-bending puzzles.
In Mirror Soul, you take control of two characters simultaneously, each moving in perfect mirrored harmony. Every step, jump, and action you perform is mirrored across an axis, demanding precise coordination and strategy to navigate the dual worlds. Guide your characters through beautifully crafted environments filled with traps, platforms, and puzzles that require synchronized movements and creative thinking.
Key Features:
Symmetrical Control: Master the art of controlling two characters at once, with every move mirrored along an axis. Perfect your timing and coordination to progress through challenging levels.
Intricate Puzzles: Solve a variety of puzzles that test your logic and spatial awareness. Use the unique mechanics of mirrored movement to unlock new areas and secrets.
Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in a visually captivating world, with each level featuring detailed, hand-crafted environments that enhance the dual-world concept.
Engaging Storyline: Unravel the mystery behind the connection between the two characters. Discover their story through captivating narrative elements woven into the gameplay.
Dynamic Soundtrack: Enjoy an atmospheric and dynamic soundtrack that adapts to the gameplay, enhancing the immersive experience of Mirror Soul.

title: Marble Havoc
description:
게임 정보
Marble Havoc is a 3D-action game. Take your marble in different levels to the goal.

You start with your marble on a way in a waterland. Navigate your marble over the way without falling into the water.



Jump over obstacles and ditches. Find the flag. Your mission is to navigate your marble to the flag and hit the flag pole. Then you mastered the level.

You are not alone! In the waterland there are other marbles on their way:

title: Witchpop
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Souper Star Cafe where the secret ingredient is Magic. Pick your chef and sous chef, pick your soup, and cook with your spells to make the best soup possible.
Features
Physics Based Puzzle Matching, where you'll have to match ingredients in real time! Avoid your ingredients touching the bottom of the pot where they'll end up burning. Too many burned ingredients and your soup will be ruined!
Accumulate Curses over time and survive as long as you can while trying to attain the highest score possible.
Use Spells to either help save your soup or to score even higher
Risk and Reward Gameplay. Make and store up larger clusters of ingredients to score even more, and take extra curse cards for even higher multipliers
Play with Friends, either head to head in different soup pots, or cooperatively sharing the same pot with multiple cursors.
Multiple Characters to change the aesthetics of your chef and sous chef. With all characters sharing the same abilities, all characters are equally viable to be picked.
Mouse/Keyboard and Controller Support. Either use your mouse to fling ingredients, or, use a gamepad to control the cursor or to teleport between ingredients for incredibly fast movement.

title: Echos
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in an expansive and captivating world where exploration, survival, and strategy intertwine to create a unique gaming experience.
In this open-world survival adventure, you will embark on a journey through vast and diverse landscapes, each teeming with secrets waiting to be uncovered. From dense forests to barren deserts, icy tundras to mysterious caves, the environments are not only visually stunning but also brimming with hidden challenges.
Key Features:
Exploration and Discovery: Traverse various biomes, each with its own set of challenges and resources. Uncover hidden areas, ancient ruins, and mysterious artifacts that may change the course of your journey.
Crafting and Resource Management: Gather resources from the environment to craft essential tools, weapons, and survival gear. Whether you're building a shelter, crafting advanced weaponry, or preparing potions, careful resource management is crucial to your survival.
Dynamic Combat: Face off against a range of creatures, each with its own attack patterns and weaknesses. Engage in real-time, fast-paced combat where both skill and strategy are needed to survive.
Survival Mechanics: Keep an eye on your character's health, hunger, and stamina levels. Adapt to the environment by learning to craft necessary survival items such as clothing, fire starters, and food, while managing limited resources.
Story and Quests: Experience an engaging narrative filled with side quests and objectives. The world is rich with lore, and every discovery brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind your environment and your place within it.

title: Snakes with Fists!
description:
게임 정보
The RPG with a Beat 'em Up Battle System
Snakes with Fists! combines the open-world exploration elements of an RPG—interesting NPCs, side quests, secrets, and a strong narrative—with the fun of fighting in the beat 'em up style! Open areas are explored in a top down 2d RPG world, Beat 'em UP stages are entered and cleared to unlock new areas and to complete quests. 
Also, you can fight anyone!
Yes, you can... but should you?
Instead of 'random encounters' you will enter into a Beat 'em Up style fight scene with anyone you punch in the RPG world.

title: Revengeful Ghost
description:
게임 정보
●Story
The main character “Keiichi Tsujisawa,” a second-year high school student attending a local school, and his twin sister “Akane Tsujisawa.
One day, the younger sister Akane disappears after a line message of “Flip phone, video”.
Soon after, a girl jumps off the roof of the school.
The protagonist heads to the school to find out the truth.
A mysterious video is left behind on her flip phone, and the incident from 25 years ago comes back to life.
She is told that if she doesn't find the location of the video, she will die.
Fear, a curse, and a horrifying truth are gradually revealed...
●System
This title is a first-person horror adventure game.
The story unfolds mainly through line messages on smartphones.
Just like real time, the in-game time is also ticking away, and messages arrive in real time.
And new incidents are triggered.
The player must use mysterious videos and messages as clues to unravel the mystery of the incidents.
●Characters
Keiichi Tsujisawa　the main character　　　　　　　　High school sophomore
Akane Tsujisawa　twin sister　　　　　　　　　　　　High school sophomore
Aya Sawakita　　 the main character's girlfriend　　　High school sophomore
Yuji Akahori　　　Classmate　　　　　　　　　　　　High school sophomore
Kota KAWABE　　Classmate　　　　　　　　　　　　High school sophomore
Reina NARUMI　　Classmate　　　　　　　　　　　　High school sophomore
Shigezo Gonda　　janitor
Chizuko Gion　　　the master of the curse　　　　　a student at the school 25 years ago
Others　　　　　Aya Sawakita's mother, Chizuko Gion's classmate

title: Schematic Void
description:
게임 정보
Imagine a situation where the developer did not finish the game. "Fantastic!" - that's what you will exclaim, and you will be absolutely right.
And it's exactly how fantastic the plot of "Schematic Void" is. A game where you have to finish the work for the developer.
Using simple tools and non-standard solutions, crack the fourth wall and just have fun.

And it's also a game about electrical circuits. "Oh, Horror!" —that's what you will exclaim, and you will be completely wrong.
The schemes here are fundamental. And the fundamental principle is to be like an electrical circuit as little as possible.

And there are some pets, princesses, and even a unicorn in the game. You will exclaim "What a sweet thing!", and we completely agree with you!

Add the game to the wishlist before someone else does it before you!

- Stylish minimalistic graphics. And even stylish minimalistic animation in places.
- 2D graphics, sometimes considering itself to be 3D.
- Scratched forth wall.
- Kinda presence of a plot. A very deep one, but not wide.
- Mysterious gray cells, which you will have to use your own to solve.
- The strange humor of the developers.
- A stunning soundtrack that makes you want to dance and cry at the same time.

title: Portal Guardians
description:
게임 정보
Portal Guardians는 당신을 지루하게 만들지 않을 것입니다!
혼자 또는 친구와 싸우십시오. 다양한 무기와 함정을 사용하여 적의 파도를 막으세요! 포털이 전 세계에 열렸습니다. 곧 닫힙니다!

무기고에 있는 무기의 모든 힘을 사용하고 다양한 장소(벽, 바닥 및 천장)에 다양한 함정을 설치하여 스토리 시나리오를 진행하세요. 무기고를 개선하고 개선 수준마다 무기의 강도가 증가하고 함정의 힘이 증가합니다. 포털이 닫히는 동안 포털을 보호하여 세계 질서를 회복하고 괴물이 거기에 가지 못하게 하십시오!
주요 기능

스토리 캠페인 - 적의 무리와 싸우고 이러한 공격의 원인이 되는 신비한 힘을 발견하십시오.
협동 플레이 - 두 명의 용감한 영웅을 마음대로 사용할 수 있습니다..
치명적인 무기 - 마법, 활, 검 등 고유한 특성을 가진 9가지 유형의 무기
죽음의 함정 - 벽, 바닥, 천장에 설치할 수 있는 다양한 함정입니다. 이 함정은 적 무리를 제거하는 데 도움이 되므로 업그레이드하는 것을 잊지 마세요!
Dangerous Enemies - 고유한 특징과 특징을 지닌 30가지 이상의 상대 유형! 무기와 함정을 현명하게 선택하세요!
개선 사항 - 캠페인을 진행하면서 무기와 함정을 업그레이드하세요.
광범위한 재생성 - 난이도 선택은 몇 번이고 다시 돌아오고 싶은 욕구를 일깨울 것입니다!

title: Perplex
description:
게임 정보
네온 퍼즐 세계로 뛰어들어 보세요!
화려하고 네온으로 가득 찬 세계에서 흥미진진한 퍼즐과 짜릿한 플랫폼 도전에 도전해 보세요! 혼자서 모험을 즐기든 친구와 함께 플레이하든, 이 게임은 창의성, 전략, 그리고 심장이 뛰는 게임 플레이의 독특한 조합을 제공합니다.
🌟 주요 특징:
🎮 275개의 싱글 플레이어 레벨
직접 제작된 방대한 레벨 컬렉션에 몰입하여 여러분의 실력을 한계까지 시험해 보세요. 각 레벨은 새로운 메커니즘을 도입하며, 점점 더 어려워지는 퍼즐을 풀기 위해 창의적인 사고를 요구합니다. 전략과 정밀성을 요구하는 궁극적인 도전에 준비되셨나요?
🤝 40개의 멀티플레이어 레벨
친구와 함께 도전에 나서 보세요! 멀티플레이어 전용 레벨은 플랫폼 실력뿐만 아니라 팀워크와 소통 능력을 시험하기 위해 설계되었습니다. 두 사람이 모두 무사히 포털에 도달할 수 있을까요?
🔥 100개 이상의 흥미진진한 PvP 레벨
100개 이상의 독특한 PvP 레벨에서 경쟁적인 게임의 매력을 경험하세요. 각 레벨은 다양한 맵, 메커니즘, 장애물로 구성되어 게임 플레이를 신선하고 흥미롭게 유지합니다. 자신의 실력을 입증하고, 전술을 조정하며, 이 스릴 넘치는 멀티플레이어 경험에서 정상에 도달하세요!
🎶 몰입감 넘치는 사운드트랙과 멋진 비주얼
몰입감 있는 사운드트랙과 아름답게 디자인된 비주얼로 네온의 꿈속으로 빠져보세요. 모든 비트와 비주얼 요소가 게임 경험을 향상시키며, 매혹적인 세계로 더욱 깊이 빠져들게 만듭니다.
💎 숨겨진 보물 찾기
게임의 신비한 구석구석을 탐험하며 숨겨진 보물을 발견하세요! 레벨을 넘어 비밀과 놀라움이 가득한 세계로 안내하는 흥미진진한 보물 찾기가 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다.
🐣 숨겨진 참조
팝 컬처에 대한 참조와 게임 곳곳에 숨겨진 깜짝 요소들을 찾아보세요. 모두 발견할 수 있을까요?
이 게임은 단순한 퍼즐 플랫폼 게임이 아닙니다. 놀라움과 도전, 그리고 잊을 수 없는 순간들로 가득한 모험입니다. 게임의 메커니즘을 마스터하든, 모든 비밀을 발견하든, 단순히 네온 분위기를 즐기든, 모든 플레이어를 위한 무언가가 있습니다.
네온 도전을 받아들일 준비가 되셨나요? 지금 게임을 위시리스트에 추가하고 오늘 바로 모험을 시작하세요!

title: The First Mine
description:
게임 정보
The First Mine is a relaxed turn based building and puzzle game. You need to run a productive gold mine by placing, grouping and upgrading various resource tiles without being distracted by different game events.
Play as a single player or in multiplayer mode with friends
Place, group and upgrade various tiles to collect resources
Run a productive mine with your population to mine gold
Don't let different game events distract you
Play a calm and relaxed game alone in single player mode or play together with up to 4 friends in multi player mode. Each round you have to place, group and upgrade various tiles to mine gold and collect resources like wood, stone, wheat and fish.
To mine gold, you need people in your villages. To keep them, you must provide enough wheat and fish. More people and a higher level increases the amount of gold produced per round. You need wood and stone to upgrade the level.

title: JumpMap
description:
게임 정보
JumpMap 은 흥미진진한 1인칭 3D 플랫폼 게임으로 특별한 메커니즘을 제공합니다: 떨어질 때마다 이전 위치로 되돌아갑니다. 정밀함과 타이밍을 요구하는 20개 이상의 신중하게 설계된 레벨을 탐험하세요. 이제 Speedrun 모드가 추가되었습니다: 모든 레벨을 통과하고 최고의 시간을 기록해 보세요!
당신의 유일한 목표는 각 레벨의 정상에 도달하는 것입니다. 클라이밍에 집중하고 도전을 헤쳐 나가며 각 오르막을 정복하는 능력을 키우세요.
게임 플레이
Speedrun 모드: 시계를 보며 모든 레벨을 한 번에 클리어하세요. 시간을 추적하고 최고 기록을 목표로 도전하세요. 자신과 친구들과 경쟁하여 가장 빠르게 완료하세요!
최고 시간 추적: 각 레벨을 완료하는 속도를 측정하고, 개인 최고 기록을 통해 도전과 성취감을 느껴보세요.
더블 점프: 공중에서 다시 한 번 점프할 수 있는 능력을 통해, 가장 까다로운 플랫폼도 마스터하고 새로운 높이에 도달하세요.
컨트롤러 및 Steam Deck 지원: 컨트롤러 또는 Steam Deck을 사용할 때 원활한 게임 플레이를 즐기세요. 이동 중에도 편안하게 또는 소파에서 편안하게 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.

title: Deck of Destiny: Battlege
description:
게임 정보
🏆 Deck of Destiny: Battleforge 🏆
Deck of Destiny: Battleforge 는 전략, 액션, 로그라이크 덱 구축의 요소를 결합한 현대적인 로그라이크 덱 빌더입니다. 4명의 전설적인 영웅 중 한 명을 선택하여 고대 땅의 마법을 되찾고 끝없는 전쟁에서 나만의 전설을 쓸 준비를 하세요.
이 전략 게임에서 각 레벨에서 살아남기 위해 영리한 카드 사용과 효과적인 전략 개발에 대한 기술을 테스트하세요. 카드는 공격, 방어, 체력, 버프, 속도의 5가지 유형으로 제공되며 각각 고유한 전략적 이점을 제공합니다. 적의 물결을 물리치고 카드, 귀중한 장비, 골드를 수집하여 캐릭터를 개발하세요. 카드를 강화하고 운과 전략 사이의 섬세한 경계에서 살아남아 운명을 형성하고 전설적인 전사가 되세요!
🌟 고대 왕국은 한때 마법과 힘으로 가득했습니다
고대 왕국은 한때 마법과 힘으로 가득했으며, 카드의 힘이 곳곳에 퍼졌습니다. 하지만 어느 날, 어둠의 저주가 모든 왕국을 뒤덮어 세계의 마법을 훔쳐 혼란에 빠뜨렸습니다. 그 결과, 파괴와 절망이 온 땅에 퍼졌고, 많은 사람들이 카드의 힘이 다시는 돌아오지 않을 것이라고 두려워했습니다.
🎯 전략과 기회에 기반한 모험
전략적 로그라이크 게임인 Deck of Destiny: Battleforge에서 각 영역에서 카드를 현명하게 사용하고 몬스터 군대에서 살아남으세요. 다음 라운드에서 기회를 높이기 위해 살아남고, 카드를 수집하세요. 전략, 빠른 생각, 뛰어난 카드 플레이가 중요합니다.
🦸 영웅을 선택하고 힘을 발견하세요
궁수, 마법사, 전사 또는 탱크? 각자 독특하고 치명적입니다! 모든 영웅은 고유한 능력을 가지고 있습니다. 캐릭터를 개발하고, 카드를 업그레이드하고, 맵 키를 수집하여 새로운 영역을 잠금 해제하세요.

title: Simulario
description:
게임 정보
The game features experimental 2D simulated physics based gameplay. The main feature of the game is that every pixel, every object, every particle in the game is a simulated physical entity.

This means, that the game is fair, it doesn't create invisible walls, doesn't impose unpredictable or illogical rules, doesn't script the way objects interact. What you see gives you complete idea what to expect. If you see a wall and want to go through, just shoot it and go.

Everything in the game is destructible. Everything acts accordingly to laws of physics, so if you want to do something, and your real world intuition makes you expect things to act in a certain way, chances are the game objects you interact with will work as you expect.

Therefore, the way you plan to win the level is up to you. You can explore possibilities, be creative, and you ideas will work if physics allow it. You can add matter, build shapes, create mechanical tools to reach the destination, you can destroy things. You can use forces, momentum or inertia. You can use ropes, wheels, jet engines, and so on.

Purely physically based gameplay is not very popular due to high performance requirements of physics simulation. But two years of prototyping and plenty of computer science allowed me to solve all problems and remove all technical obstacles, and now we have a robust physics engine, that works very fast, and allows to build massive sophisticated and fun to play with physical worlds.

The game will consists of many very different levels. You will drive a dirt bike, drive tanks and heavy multi purpose machines, fly in air, serf in water, dive underwater, fly in space, float in zero gravity or fight massive gravity, dig underground, build mechanical machines, attach jet engines and launch rockets, use ropes and forces, use heavy explosives and laser weapons. Simulated physics allow planty of ways to have fun.

But one of the most prominent features will be to control a soft body based character, that has evolved to walk and fight. That's a never before experienced level of realism and immersion.

The game is currently on early stage of implementing gameplay mechincs. The game will not be released in any kind of early access until it is finished and polished. But there will be multiple demos published, that would allow you to enjoy some of the physics based gameplay.

The game will include competitive levels with Steam based leaderboards, as well as casual levels. All levels will be highly replayable due to the fact, that it's hard to win one way, the physical world is chaotic in a certain way, and your actions will turn the world in different configurtations every time, opening new possibilities to beat levels.

The game will also have a tool for the players to create and publish user generated content.

title: Convenient: Fiend
description:
게임 정보
Dig up graves to steal from the dead while you escape graveyard security and run from the legendary Oldlake Wendigo.
Gameplay:

Dig up graves!
Low poly PS1 style
Survive terrifying monsters
Discover hidden secrets
The continuation of Convenient


Survive

Quickly before security catches you. You're at the Oldlake Cemetery to loot graves and make some money. Find the gravestones with the names written in your notebook and dig them up while staying out of sight. If you are spotted, make quick decisions while being chased to survive. Find hiding spots and stay out of sight until the coast is clear. Security guards aren't the only thing you'll be running from so keep your eyes peeled.




Find VHS tapes around the graveyard to uncover the mystery hiding in the cemetery. Instead of watching VHS tapes, you live them. Solve puzzles and experience the story yourself. You may be a grave robber, but there's more going on here than just a few missing bodies. Discover the birth of the Oldlake Wendigo and how to stop it.



The origins of , the short horror game made by LunaApps.

title: Duck Norris Tales
description:
게임 정보


Duck Norris Tales is pixel run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Featuring highly stylized pixel art inspired by the arcade games from the '90s.
STORY
Step into the feathers of a brave duck on a mission of revenge after aliens destroy his favorite ice cream shop! Join him on an epic journey through the depths of the Earth as he uncovers secrets, battles monsters, and rallies the Gods to aid in his quest. Can he save humanity along the way?
THE BATTLE
The Gods are divided and at war, and it's up to you to restore peace and earn their respect. Each time you challenge a God, you have the chance to gain their blessing and grow stronger! Learn new abilities and make new allies to unlock powerful super moves as you strive to bring balance.

Uncover secrets about the world and unlock devastating super attacks as you cleanse the land.

title: Screaming Head
description:
게임 정보
In this 2d platformer you play as a polyamorous head that pushes his enemies away using the power of scream.
Your wives have been kidnapped and your life had been destroyed by none other than your own body.
It's time to prove once and for all that mind rules over body and not the other way around!
This colorful gem of a gaming experience with unbelievably punchy soundtrack and infuriatingly pushy enemies is everything you need! (if everything you need is a game about a head that is screaming)
Now go ahead and SCREAM YOUR HEAD OFF!!!

title: Cybersim: Noetic City
description:
게임 정보
Cybersim: Noetic City is a half cozy, casual room builder, where players have the freedom to relax with a casual room builder in creative mode or play strategically as a Hacker with a custom deck of hacking programs in casual and normal mode.
You are a newly appointed agent of the Special Cyberwarfare Service. You are responsible for taking down networks used by criminals in the city through a collection of various hacking programs. Use credits to furnish your home and buy upgrades for your hardware and software, to further enhance you hacking capabilities. Create a powerful deck and become a top tier hacker.
Join Our Discord
Purchase your decor and have it delivered to you.
Use your personal computer to purchase all your customizable furniture and decor for your apartment. Create the perfect cyberpunk space, just for you.
Functional Decor
Interactable options can be found across many items purchased from your computer. Apartment controls, TV channels, radio stations, lights and monitors. You have control to make your place one of a kind

title: Pinball Blitz
description:
게임 정보


Pinball Blitz combines arcade pinball with a fast-paced action roguelike. Shape each run with selectable themes, flipper setups, and table upgrades to defeat bosses and achieve high-scores.
Table Select
Select a theme that determines the ramps and playfields of your table.
Choose a flipper setup that best fits your style.
Each theme and flipper setup will have its advantages - find a combo that helps you shoot combos.
Upgrades
After completing a set of ramps, choose a table upgrade to propel your game.
Upgrades range from multiball to guided rockets - new combinations add to a chaotic run.

title: Regista: Reign Your Football Club
description:
게임 정보
당신의 축구 클럽의 주인이 되어라!
전략적인 선택을 하고, 아마추어 리그에서 시작해 최고의 리그로 올라가세요. 클럽을 위해 모든 것을 정리하며, 어려운 결정을 내려야 합니다. 모든 선택은 중요하며, 미래의 상황에 영향을 미칠 것입니다. 과연, 당신은 어떻게 결정하시겠습니까?
특징
당신의 지표가 전부입니다!
Regista에는 네 가지 주요 지표가 있습니다: 팬, 자금, 미디어, 그리고 팀입니다.
모든 선택은 중요하며, 각 지표는 끊임없이 무언가를 요구할 것입니다. 모든 지표를 균형 있게 유지하는 것이 중요합니다. 어느 하나라도 0이나 100에 도달하면, 해당 지표에 대한 통제권을 잃게 되고, 게임에서 패배하거나 다른 지표에 심각한 패널티를 받게 됩니다.
따라서, 절대 누구에게도 완전한 통제권을 주지 마세요. 신중하게 플레이하고, 때때로 불편한 결정을 내리더라도 시즌을 살아남아 정상을 차지하세요!
전략적인 선택을 하세요
당신의 선택은 클럽의 최하위부터 최고까지 모든 사람에게 영향을 미칩니다. 균형을 유지하려면, 원치 않더라도 결정을 내려야 할 때가 있습니다. 예를 들어, 재정 팀을 해고하거나, 선수들의 부적절한 행동에 대해 침묵을 지킬 수도 있습니다. 심지어 클럽을 유지하기 위해 자신의 명성을 희생할 수도 있습니다.
더 강해지고, 무적이 되세요!
이적을 진행하고, 팀의 사기를 유지하며, 완벽한 시즌을 목표로 하세요!
시즌 중에는 팀의 전력, 사기, 가치 등을 강화하는 카드를 만나게 됩니다. 그 선택은 항상 위험과 미스터리로 가득합니다. 즉각적인 힘을 얻을지, 아니면 장기적인 이익을 위해 안전하게 플레이할지는 당신의 결정에 달려 있습니다.
아이템을 사용하여 우위를 점하세요
때때로 상황을 당신에게 유리하게 이끌어야 할 때가 있습니다. 그런 상황에서 아이템을 활용해 우위를 차지하세요.
예를 들어, 상대와의 전력을 맞추기 위해 막바지 이적을 진행하거나, 승리 행진을 유지하기 위해 심판을 매수하거나, 결과가 마음에 들지 않는 카드를 건너뛸 수도 있습니다. 마지막으로, 진행 상황을 보호하기 위해 특정 지표를 강화해 다시 균형을 잡을 수 있습니다.
당신의 선택은 무엇입니까?

title: Lost Ground
description:
게임 정보
어느 마법사의 실수로 악마들이 지상에 강림한 이후, 인류는 패배를 거듭하여 마지막 요새까지 후퇴했습니다. 하지만 아직 모든 것이 끝난 게 아닙니다. 영웅들은 성검의 인도 아래 최후의 반격을 준비하고 있습니다. 원정대를 지휘하여 악마들에게 잃어버린 땅을 되찾으십시오. 이제 인류의 희망은 당신의 어깨에 달려있습니다.

3x3 그리드에서 펼쳐지는 턴제 전투

■ 다수의 영웅을 3x3 그리드에 배치하여 적을 물리치세요. 영웅과 적은 다양한 공격 범위를 갖고 있습니다. 효과적인 배치로 아군의 피해를 최소화하고 수많은 적을 일망타진하세요.

■ 영웅들은 불, 물, 바람 등의 속성을 가지고, 개성적인 특징을 가진 카드를 통해 전투를 수행합니다. 속성으로 보스의 약점을 타격하고, 극적인 시너지를 일으켜보세요.

■ 모험에서 획득하는 유물은 게임의 판도를 가를 수 있는 강력한 특수 효과를 제공합니다. 카드와 유물의 조합으로 자신만의 콤보를 완성하세요. 어떤 것을 획득할지는 회차마다 달라집니다!


■ 로스트 그라운드의 세계는 외길이 아닙니다. 탐험은 전진, 후진, 우회 모두 가능합니다. 육각형 타일로 이루어진 세계를 자유롭게 탐험하며 저주받은 땅의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

■ 유적, 광산, 캠프, 상점, 몬스터, 보물상자... 안개로 가려진 땅 너머에는 다양한 기회와 위험이 있습니다. 안전한 방법으로 착실하게 강해질지, 위험을 무릅쓰고 큰 보상을 노릴지, 선택은 당신의 몫입니다.

■ 퀘스트를 수행하고 보상으로 받은 특성 포인트로 영구히 성장하세요. 단순한 파밍 퀘스트부터 도전 과제에 가까운 기묘한 퀘스트까지 다양하게 준비되어 있습니다.

■ 묘하게 움푹 파인 지형이 있나요? 파헤치세요. 몬스터가 길을 막고 있나요? 때려눕히고 파헤치세요. 수상한 지역을 파헤치다보면 생각치도 못한 만남이 있을지도 모릅니다.


■ 몬스터를 찾아 처치하고 경험치를 획득하여 영웅을 레벨업 시키세요. 상위 카드를 획득하려면 충분한 레벨업이 필요합니다.

■ 모험에서 장비를 획득하고 영웅에게 장착시키세요. 머리, 몸통, 손, 발 등... 각각의 부위마다 다른 스탯이 부여되고 장비마다 다른 고유 효과가 발휘됩니다.

■ 장비, 특성 등의 일부 보상은 회차를 거듭해도 소멸하지 않고 이월됩니다. 영구히 성장하면서 강력한 적에게 도전해 보세요.

title: Shadows of Tuonela
description:
게임 정보
Journey to the Finnish purgatory – Tuonela – and fight the countless other versions of yourself to prove worthy of ascending back onto the Earth.

Explore the open world, gather resources, craft better equipment to prepare for battle.

But choose your fights wisely as the three hit combat can take even a seasoned Shadow by surprise.

Tuonela remembers only the triumphant.

title: Shadows of the Afterland
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a supernatural point-and-click adventure in which you are confronted with the most difficult decision of your life ... and death...

Madrid, 1960. A chilling incident unfolds at the city's old zoo, leading to a mysterious death that propels a soul to the threshold between the world of the living and the afterlife. But when the transition goes awry, the soul arrives with the memories of Carolina, one of the pioneers of the Madrid police force, who has not yet been born.

Step into Carolina’s shoes and delve into a detective mystery to unravel the enigma shrouding these events. Explore the wacky realm of the afterlife, teeming with unique characters and with its own rules.

In your quest for the truth, you join forces with César, an elusive former ghost agent. Persuade this enigmatic ally to accompany you on a transformative journey to confront the sinister forces lurking in the world of the living. As you gain César’s trust, you'll have to solve tricky point-and-click puzzles, harness the power of magic, navigate between worlds and even possess the living.

title: Veiled Whispers
description:
게임 정보
Enter the Abandoned House: A Haunting Horror Puzzle Experience

Welcome to a chilling adventure set within the confines of an abandoned house, where terror lurks in every shadow. Immerse yourself in a spine-chilling journey through darkened corridors and ominous rooms, all captured from a unique bodycam perspective.

Key Features:

Solve Sinister Puzzles: Explore the eerie interiors of the abandoned house and unravel intricate puzzles that test your resolve and intellect.
Perpetual Dread: Navigate through a relentless atmosphere of fear as you encounter unsettling phenomena and unearth the house's dark secrets.
Immersive Bodycam View: Experience the horror firsthand with our distinctive bodycam perspective, intensifying the suspense and realism of every heart-pounding moment.
Fear Awaits: Brace yourself for an atmospheric horror experience where every creaking floorboard and flickering light may spell doom. Can you survive the night within the haunted confines of the abandoned house?

title: Medieval Life
description:
게임 정보
Medieval Life is a fascinating text-based simulation RPG that transports you into the harsh and challenging world of the Middle Ages. This game revolves around careful planning and smart time management to survive in an era marked by hardships and social hierarchies. From securing your basic needs like food and shelter to managing your daily tasks, you must make every decision thoughtfully to not only survive but also rise to the ranks of the wealthy and powerful.

A central element of Medieval Life is starting a family and navigating the strict social classes of the Middle Ages. Your journey may begin as a simple farmer or craftsman, but with hard work, strategic alliances, and savvy management, you can gradually work your way up. Perhaps one day, you will become a ruler yourself, enjoying the respect and power that comes with the title.

Although Medieval Life may not seem like a complex game at first glance, it is full of depth and strategic challenges. Every decision you make has consequences and influences the course of your game. The combination of role-playing elements and planning makes it an engaging experience that requires both skill and foresight. This is a game that can keep you entertained for hours, providing a realistic insight into medieval life as you work to achieve your own medieval dreams.

title: Nav
description:
게임 정보
나브는 슬라브 신화에서 죽은 자의 영혼을 나타내는 말로, 비극적이고 이른 죽음, 살인자, 흑마법사, 살해당한 자, 익사한 자의 영혼에서 생겨나는 악마의 총칭입니다.
줄거리
한 젊은 역사학자가 어린 시절을 보냈던 버려진 마을로 돌아옵니다.
최근 소년은 치명적인 심장병 진단을 받았습니다. 그는 값비싼 수술이 필요합니다. 그는 마을 사람들이 어떤 컬렉션의 진주가 될 수 있는 독특한 고대 이교도 유물을 보관하고 있다는 것을 기억합니다. 그 물건을 찾아서 파는 것이 유일한 생존의 기회입니다.
그러나 버려진 마을은 언뜻보기에 비어 있지 않습니다. 그는 과거의 불친절한 유령과 맞서고 마침내 그 여름에 무슨 일이 있었는지 그토록 오랫동안 잊으려고했던 것을 기억해야 할 것입니다.
Entourage
세계 사이의 경계가 지워지고, 무서운 슬라브 동화가 살아나고, 경계 너머에서 나브가 당신을 데려가고 싶어하는 세계에 빠져들게 될 것입니다.
배경은 동유럽 어딘가의 버려진 마을입니다.

title: Dunthera - Tower Defense
description:
게임 정보
주요 특징:
30종 이상의 몬스터, 각각 고유한 행동과 능력을 보유.
5개의 서로 다른 생물군계에 걸친 15개의 독특한 맵, 각각 다른 환경과 경로 제공.
6가지 다양한 타워, 각각 독특한 공격 패턴을 가짐.
플레이어가 조종하는 영웅, 강력한 몬스터에 맞서 타워를 돕는다.
스킬 트리 시스템, 영웅과 타워 모두를 강화 가능.
VFX (비주얼 이펙트), 특수 셰이더와 파티클을 활용한 빛나는 요소 포함.

title: SU42: Hired Gun
description:
게임 정보
Indie game made by a husband and wife from Poland
Play Solo or Co-Op with friends
Steam Remote Play. Invite your friends to your virtual couch
Steam Remote Play TV. Play on your TV.
Choose your two heroes and switch them during the fight
Your playstyle depends on the heroes you choose
This isn’t just mindless mayhem—enemies adapt to your tactics
Colorblind-friendly: Protanopia, Deuteranopia, Tritanopia
SU42: HIRED GUN – This is my private project, born out of a love for the classics of the 80s and 90s.
It all started with a sketch of one of the characters.
Over time, more ideas emerged, until my wife and I turned it all into a concrete game project. I’ve been working in game development for years and thought, “What if I made and released a game myself? One that I want to make, not one a client demands.” Something from a gamer, for gamers. That’s how SU42: Hired Gun came to be—a classic side-shooter packed with action and tactics, offering varied gameplay depending on the chosen characters or on-screen situations.

title: Riftseekers
description:
게임 정보
Use abilities and powerups to defeat enemies, avoid traps, collect gems, and score enough points to summon bosses. Defeat these bosses to complete stages and open rifts to randomized biomes. Collect upgrades between stages to make sure you can survive. In this endless arcade-style roguelike, how many points can you get?

title: The LOST Saga
description:
게임 정보
The The Labyrinth Of Sublime Terror Saga, or the LOST Saga, is an ambitious MMORPG game that plunges you deep into the eerie and mysterious realities of the Backrooms. Our game is designed to balance exploration, survival, co-op gameplay, a truly unique storyline, and character customization.
Our Vision
Our goal is to create an immersive multiplayer experience in an online virtual world that captures both the unsettling nature of the Backrooms and horror games while still fostering a dynamic narrative and player-driven cozy experience. Blending horror, survival, solo, and multiplayer elements seamlessly for the purpose of creating an engaging experience.
What Sets The LOST Saga Apart From Other Games
Expansive Backrooms Universe
Featuring meticulously hand-crafted Backrooms Levels, The LOST Saga brings the familiar Backrooms environments with a unique twist that you won't find in any other game!
Player Progression and Customization
Customize your character with unique outfits while you uncover the universe's lore and navigate through levels full of puzzles, entities, and hidden exits around every corner!
Parties and Guilds
Playing alone isn't fun! Use our online servers to play with your friends, or make new ones, and join guilds like The Major Explorer Group (The MEG), or form parties with your friends to complete puzzles and collect materials!
Trophy System And Achievements
Earn trophy rewards on your Steam Profile for completing tasks, finding Levels, and so much more!
Expanding Content
Updates will come as a "Chapter" system. Currently, there are six (6) chapters planned for the mainline story. There are several others planned for after the conclusion of the main story, essentially functioning as a postgame.

title: DOOM SPIRAL
description:
게임 정보
DOOM SPIRAL is a fast-paced retro-inspired first person shooter that takes place inside a dream.  Your health is the coherence of the world around you. 
[STORY]
You are a hacker who's breached the system of a shadowy organization researching shared layers of consciousness. Now you're trapped in their domain - a spiral of INSANITY where the deeper you go the realer it becomes.
Make your way up through the nightmare spiral labyrinth tower, battling VOID GHOSTS and trying to stay SANE. Each death sends you back down into the ((((( O ))))).
[FEATURES]
Super graphics like you've never seen
Cool sounds
((((( O )))))
GAME JUICE
[STATIC NOISES]
This game contains psychotic flashing images and might not be suitable for photosensitive people.

title: Mozi
description:
게임 정보
먼 은하계에, 모자성이라는 신비한 행성이 숨어 있습니다. 이 행성은 광활한 바다를 가지고 있어 인류에게 끝없는 상상력을 불러일으킵니다. 은하 탐험대의 공학사로서, 나는 모자성에서 기지를 확장하는 중대한 책임을 지고 있으며, 인류의 별계열 식민지화를 위한 확고한 한 걸음을 내디뎌지고 있습니다.

title: Sternly Worded Adventures
description:
게임 정보
Sternly Worded Adventures is a roguelite word puzzle RPG inspired by Bookworm Adventures where you travel through a forested peninsula with Yorkshire-sounding place names fighting monsters with the power of words to uncover whatever dark secrets may be lurking beyond.
FEATURES
Master over 8 different classes
