Over 15 different enemies
Unlock over 180 items
Spell words with over 25 different letters

WHAT'S IN THE DEMO?
In the demo you are limited to the starting Adventurer class.
You can play any adventure node up to and including Level 3. Visiting a Level 4 node triggers an event that ends the demo.
You have access to every item the adventurer could normally access except for one, which is restricted because it can trigger the afore mentioned event early.
You have full access both of the Wordle and Minesweeper inspired minigames, without limit.

You can directly continue your save file from the demo in the full version.

title: Tinycraft
description:
게임 정보

Demons from another world are coming, leading the allied forces of the Six Races to resist them. Choose your main race and heroes independently and form your team through a Rogue mechanism. Purchase equipment, runes and talents to continuously enhance the overall combat effectiveness, so that you can win in waves of enemy attacks!
Features
6 races, 24 heroes, 40 units，6 towers
80+ equipment, 150+ runes and talents, in addition to being extracted through Rogue mechanism, it can also be dropped by defeating neutral creatures
Enjoy the joy of controlling multiple units in combat through the traditional RTS operation method
Most of the abilities are passive or can be cast automatically, which reduces the operating pressure while retaining the upper limit of operation
Production and construction have been simplified to focus on fast-paced combat
Plan the construction route, change the main race when conditions are met, and experience endless hero combinations

title: Heroes of Magic and Steel
description:
게임 정보
                                                     독특한 팀을 구성하고 전략적인 덱을 구축하며, 이 도전적인 중세 판타지 로그라이크 게임에서 전술적 전투를 승리로 이끌어 보세요. 모든 결정이 중요합니다. 영웅을 선택하고, 지능적으로 배치하며, 전쟁의 기술을 마스터하여 점점 더 큰 도전을 극복하세요.                                          
                                                                               매번 새로운 경험! 독특한 능력을 가진 영웅들을 선택하고 조합하여 균형 잡힌 팀을 만듭니다. 완벽한 팀은 없으며, 계획적인 전략이 핵심입니다. 도전을 예측하고, 시너지를 만들며, 게임을 유리하게 이끌어 나가는 방법을 찾아보세요.

title: Battle-Lines
description:
게임 정보
NO THEME. JUST LINES. PURE STRATEGY.
Battle-Lines is an easy to learn strategy game for 1-4 players where the challenge comes from choosing the best moves among dozens of possibilities, against human or AI opponents. Will you use your turn to build for the future, optimize what you have, or sabotage your opponents' strategies?
In Battle-Lines, you will need to constantly revise your strategy. The state of the game changes with every move, and even if you're ahead, your position is never secure. Likewise, you can almost always come back from last place. Games take only 20 minutes!
HOW TO PLAY
You use your turn to either place a piece or rotate a tile on the board. Pieces contain both your lines, and neutral lines.
You get points for the lines you make while doing so.
You convert a grey neutral line to your own by connecting it to one of your own lines.

title: Jade Spring
description:
게임 정보
Relax, potter, and build in Jade Spring, a small Guild Wars 2 decorating and homesteading fan game featuring entirely hand-made assets and items. Tend your garden as a Xunlai jade bot, clearing weeds and pests, dispelling Dragonvoid blights, and furnishing your plot with architecture, flora, furniture, and ornaments from across Tyria!
Zen Cleaning
Engage in mini-games to spruce up your plot, clearing out bugs, invasive plants, trash, and leftover strands of Dragonvoid. Collect Karma from each task to spend on permanent improvements to your gardening and decorating abilities!
Granular Decoration
Personalise your space using robust tools which let you easily move, rotate, scale, snap, and clear items. Acquire enough Karma to unlock fancy decorations, as well as utilities which allow you to change the time of day, clear the map to start fresh, and fine-tune your environment to suit your creativity.
A Guild Wars 2 Tribute
Jade Spring is an independent developer’s love letter to Cantha and to Guild Wars 2 in general, featuring hand-made assets, art, models, animations, and music directly inspired by the worlds of Tyria, and filled with small tributes and references.
Notice as specified by ArenaNet’s content terms of use: © ArenaNet LLC. All rights reserved. NCSOFT, ArenaNet, Guild Wars, Guild Wars 2, GW2, Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns, Guild Wars 2: Path of Fire, Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons, and Guild Wars 2: Secrets of the Obscure and all associated logos, designs, and composite marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of NCSOFT Corporation.

title: The President Bodyguard: Sam story
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the world of covert operations, where your mission is to protect the President of the United States from deadly threats and cunning conspiracies. As Sam Marshall, a former special forces officer, you take on a challenging journey from training to protecting the president on the world stage and within the walls of the White House. Six intense missions await, filled with dramatic twists, stealth operations, and quick tactical decisions.
Game Features:
Highly realistic missions: Navigate through meticulously crafted scenarios — from a diplomatic visit to Beirut to an emergency evacuation during an attack on the White House.
Variety of gameplay styles: Operate drones, conduct reconnaissance, use binoculars for long-range surveillance, eliminate enemies stealthily, or engage in combat to protect the president.
Intense decision-making moments: Every action has consequences. Keep the president and yourself safe by managing limited resources, coordinating evacuations, and selecting strategically crucial routes.
Real-time unfolding events: Public spaces with crowds, tense negotiations, night operations in conflict zones, and sudden attacks — each mission demands flexibility, speed, and strategic thinking.
Smart and dynamic NPCs: Interact with allies and local security teams, work in crowded environments, and avoid panic when threats are uncovered.
Atmospheric graphics and detailed settings: Move through beautifully crafted, realistic locations, from luxury hotels to the intense environment of the White House.
Are you ready to risk it all to protect the president? Follow Sam’s journey — from routine patrols to the most dangerous mission of his career — to become the last line of defense.

title: G.M.M
description:
게임 정보
G.M.M (Guerrier Mages and Metamorphes) is a turn-based 2D RPG.
Story
Play Marco, a young boy who wants to become a swordsman and his mage friend Vard.
During one of their mission, they will encounter a metamorph of the wolf clan with serious wound.
But by helping him, they will put themself into a major conflict between several country.
Travel the world to gain new allies.
Level up your allies to learn new techniques.
Fight enemies in turn-based battles

title: Don't Freeze: A Winter Card Survival
description:
게임 정보
여객기 추락 사고 이후, 당신은 혹독한 겨울 황무지에 홀로 남겨진 유일한 생존자가 되었습니다. 당신의 임무는 문명으로 돌아갈 때까지 살아남는 것—그리고 이 치명적인 환경을 헤쳐 나가며 독특한 카드 기반 생존 경험을 펼치는 것입니다.
추락 현장의 잔해에서부터 얼어붙은 강, 버려진 마을, 그리고 광활하고 가차 없는 겨울 지형까지, 10가지 이상의 다양한 환경을 탐험하며 당신의 생존 본능을 시험하세요.
사냥, 낚시, 덫 설치, 그리고 수색을 통해 생존에 필요한 음식과 보급품을 확보하세요—살아남기 위해 사용할 수 있는 모든 것을 찾아야 합니다.
autokwd: Don't Freeze: A Winter Card Survival

title: Misty Garden
description:
게임 정보
Create a peaceful garden. Build a soothing retreat and help the wandering creatures unwind from chaotic lives. Misty Garden is a calm and relaxing base building providing laid-back experience interacting with the Purrlings, a creature living in the Misty forest.
Take care of Purrlings!
They are interested in your garden! Welcome and place them in the facilities for them to relax. There are open-air rock baths, hot-sand spa, and places to take a nap!
Build & Decorate facilities for the Purrlings to relax
Build and upgrade the facilities the Purrling could use during their stay. They might even request a specific service from you! Decorate the place well, so it looks nice and cozy!

title: Door to Somewhere
description:
게임 정보
Door to Somewhere is a 2.5D horror game about an alchemist, a door, and a forest of monsters. You are Winnie, a novice witch skilled at making potions.
Story--
After a mysterious death, and being involved in a violent incident in the past, she is the first culprit in the eyes of the city. She is innocent however, just a humble alchemist selling her wares in a small market. This matters not, and she must flee the city and into the nearby forest. There, she has set up a hut for herself, safe but alone. Unbeknown to her, horrors are leaking into her world through a strange detached door. Their motives unknown, they begin to show their faces to the witch. The woods are not safe, but she cannot return home, not yet. She must prove her innocence and solve the mystery behind where these creatures came from. 
Key Features--
-Experiment with alchemy to create powerful potions. Brew healing tonics, antidotes, and antibiotics to fight the corruption—but beware, resources are limited
-Explore a sprawling forest teeming with hopes and horrors, and discover what lies on the other side of the door
-Use your potions and wits to solve intricate puzzles and unlock new paths
-There are various monsters waiting for you, some are friendly, some are not
-Make important decisions that will decide the fate of the forest's inhabitants, these choices leading to one of a variety of multiple endings
The door is open. The choice is yours.

title: Arcade Management Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Step into the world of arcade nostalgia with Arcade Management Simulator, a detailed simulation where you manage, expand, and transform your arcade into the ultimate entertainment hub.
Manage Your Arcade
Start with a modest arcade and steadily grow your business. Purchase and set up arcade cabinets, gacha machines, and claw machines to create a space your customers will love.
Dynamic Pricing & Gameplay
Set prices for each play session and find the perfect balance between affordability and profit. Test your luck with over 500 collectible gachas and even try your hand at the claw machines.
Sell & Trade
Sell or trade your collected gachas with customers to keep them coming back. List them online for a massive profit.
Host Events
Transform your arcade into the ultimate party destination! Host birthday parties, office gatherings, and other celebrations to bring in waves of excited guests. Enter Fever Mode, where your arcade experiences a surge in activity and doubles your earnings for the duration
Build Your Reputation
Your goal is to make your arcade the most highly-rated spot in town. Clean, repair, and upgrade your facilities to attract more customers and keep them happy.
Expand & Upgrade
Reinvest your profits to expand your arcade, add new attractions, and customize your layout. Unlock advanced machines and create a one-of-a-kind arcade experience.
In Arcade Management Simulator, every choice you make shapes your journey. Can you rise to the challenge and turn your humble arcade into the most legendary entertainment destination?

This is just the beginning we'll have more features added as development progresses.

title: The Gambit Lost to Time
description:
게임 정보
플뢰레타, 윈터브랜드, 베르단디아, 골든송으로 구성된 네 왕국의 통치자들이 모두 같은 날 의문의 사건으로 죽음을 맞이하며 우노니아 대륙이 혼돈에 빠졌습니다. 갑작스러운 왕위 계승으로 새로운 역할을 떠맡게 된 후계자들은 서로를 향해 비난을 쏟아냈고, 수 세기 동안 이어졌던 평화에 종지부를 찍으며 혼란의 시기가 찾아왔습니다.
대륙의 평화만을 바라며 시간을 여행하는 조언가, 미아가 이때 등장합니다. 
Gambit Lost to Time은 로그라이트 요소가 가미된 전술 RPG 게임으로, 미래의 지식을 활용해 과거를 바꾸며 대륙의 평화를 되찾아야 합니다.
여러분의 전략과 지략으로 전쟁 중인 네 왕국 중 하나를 도와주세요. 오늘의 친구가 다른 시간선에서 적이 될 수도 있다는 점을 염두에 두고 왕과 여왕, 그리고 왕국의 신하들을 친구로 삼으세요. 함께하는 동료나 적대하는 인물들의 갈등 및 유혈 사태가 반복적으로 재현되는 와중에도 감정을 억눌러야 합니다... 
그 운명의 날에 실제로 무슨 일이 벌어진 것인지 알아내고, 그토록 아끼는 친구들과 이 대륙을 지키기 위해서라면 무엇이든 희생할 수 있지 않을까요? 그 결정은 여러분의 손에 달려 있습니다.
전략
어느 왕국을 지원하든 전략가로서 왕국군의 생존을 보장하며 승리로 이끄는 책무를 맡아야 합니다.
50가지 이상의 스킬 중 3개를 슬롯에 채우고 영웅을 전장으로 이끌어 보세요.
그리고 그 영웅을 중심으로 전장을 함께 누빌 병사들을 징집하세요.
전투 전에 영웅을 지휘관으로 임명해야 합니다. 각 영웅에는 부대에 적용될 지휘관 고유 보너스가 있습니다. 올바른 지휘관 보너스를 사용해 자신만의 플레이 스타일에 힘을 실어주거나 다양한 상황에 맞게 활용해 보세요!
시간의 책략
시간 여행자의 힘을 활용해 현재를 원하는 대로 재구성해 보세요. 시간선을 거듭할 때마다 이 세계 자체와 다른 사람들... 그리고 자신에 대해 더 자세히 알아갑니다. 이상적인 시간선을 손에 넣을 때까지 더 강력하게 성장하며 힘을 강화하세요.
지난 행동이 만족스럽지 않으면 시간을 되돌려 이전 턴으로 돌아갈 수도 있습니다.
미래의 지식을 "책략"으로 활용하면 또 다른 시간선에서 다시 마주한 전투의 흐름을 완전히 뒤바꿀 수도 있습니다.
미래에서 겪어보고 학습한 덕분에 새로운 가능성을 열고 전투도 완전히 새롭게 전개할 수 있습니다.
전투를 빠르게 완료하는 경우 획득하는 시간의 정수를 이용해서 다음 시간선으로 넘어가기 전에 최대한 많은 지식을 습득하세요. 
독특한 네 왕국
꽃이 무성한 플뢰레타의 평원부터 차가운 윈터브랜드의 산맥과 파릇파릇한 베르단디아의 숲, 그리고 혹독한 골든송의 황무지까지. 서로 평화롭게 지내던 좋은 시절도 있었습니다.

title: The Gas Station
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to The Gas Station, a nerve-wracking survival horror experience set in the desolate heart of nowhere. As the night shift worker at a lonely gas station, your routine starts with mundane tasks—restocking shelves, taking out the trash, keeping the power on. But the deeper into the night you go, the more unsettling the events become. Eerie phone calls. Shadows moving where they shouldn’t. What starts as an ordinary shift spirals into a nightmare you can't escape.
In The Gas Station, every decision matters, with multiple endings that keep you on edge until the very last moment. Will you survive the hostile activity, make it to dawn, and live? Or will your curiosity—or fear— be the cause of your death?
Features:
Dynamic Tasks: Keep the station running while terror builds around you. The more you do, the worse it gets.
Multiple Endings: Drive away, uncover the killer’s hideout, or fight for survival in a basement torture chamber. Your fate is in your hands.
Immersive Atmosphere: Experience the haunting isolation of a lonely gas station, complete with PS1-style visuals and atmospheric sound effects.
You clock in for a quiet night. But will you clock out alive? Welcome to the most terrifying shift of your life.

title: Covert Crew
description:
게임 정보
- 클래식 2D 턴제 전술
전투 파괴 가능한 구조물, 보조 목표, 독특한 보스 전투를 통해 그리드 기반 전투를 벌이세요.
 - 20개 이상의 플레이 가능한 유닛
각기 고유한 힘, 외모, 개성, 공격력을 가진 다양한 캐릭터에서 모집하세요.
 - 팀원과의 시너지
좋아하는 승무원과 함께 일하며 시너지를 높여 새로운 유대감 장면, 장비, 전투 중 보너스를 잠금 해제하세요.
 - 당신의 힘이 무기입니다
 파워 모듈레이터를 장착하여 공격을 수정하고, 파워와 속도를 높이거나, 상태 효과를 부여할 확률을 추가하세요. 게임을 진행하면서 새로운 모듈레이터를 잠금 해제하고 제작하세요.

title: Aksun
description:
게임 정보

'악선'의 세계에서 '드레드'가 되어, 당신을 방해하는 악귀들을 전부 제거하고
과업을 이루기 위해 저승으로 나아가십시오.
무속이 담긴 한국의 신비로운 세계
'악선'은 한국 문화 기반의 액션 게임입니다.
역사와 무속을 배경으로 등장하는 등장인물과 괴물들
그리고 다양한 유산을 직접 경험해 보십시오.

'드레드의 제례'에 등장하는 다양한 무구들은 당신의 과업을 이루는 데 도움이 될 것입니다.
당신의 마음이 이끄는 데로 무기를 고르고 성장하며 나아가세요.

'악선'은 로그라이트 게임입니다.
전투 중 드레드가 사망해도, 혼은 저승의 어딘가로 돌아갈 뿐입니다.
육신을 수복하는 동안, 사망 전 습득한 도구들은
당신의 과업에 도움이 될 것입니다.
'악선'에서의 죽음은, 하나의 수단일 뿐입니다.
육체가 찢기고 부서져도 앞으로 나아가십시오.

title: Okinawa Journal
description:
게임 정보
Okinawa Journal is a captivating point-and-click narrative game set during the summer of 2000 in the serene yet mysterious landscapes of Okinawa. You step into the ethereal role of Kami, a guardian angel tasked with guiding Haruki, a struggling journalist, as he delves into the baffling disappearance of a beloved actress.
Along the way, you’ll meet a diverse cast of characters—both human and spirit—each harboring their own secrets, ambitions, and obligations. As the investigation unfolds, you’ll uncover a web of hidden truths tied to Okinawa’s dark past, with consequences that linger in the present.
With challenging decisions, intriguing locations to explore, and multiple endings to discover, Okinawa Journal invites you to shape a story where every choice carries weight.
With Haruki's Insight, you'll always know what still interests him. Also, Okinawa Journal is a succinctly written text-based game. There are no walls of text or meandering dialogue. The characters in the game summarize all their interactions in thought, which you, as a guardian angel, are able to understand.

title: Duskpunk
description:
게임 정보

Dredgeport is spiralling out of control. Gangs rule the slums, corruption trumps the law, and corpses of the war-dead are burned daily for fuel. You are an ex-soldier, mistaken for dead and shipped back to Dredgeport for processing. After a narrow escape, you find yourself alone in the guts of the city, with only two things to your name: your life and your sanity. Keeping both will prove a challenge.


Inspired by tabletop RPGs and narrative adventure games like Citizen Sleeper, Duskpunk finds a balance between challenge and freedom, tracking your health, energy and stress as you try to survive. Make lasting choices that determine the city’s fate. Develop skills to distinguish yourself in your chosen field of work. Earn a crust, explore the city, make alliances and escape your traumatic past.


Dredgeport plays host to characters with rich backstories and murky motivations. Some care for you or the city; others are in it for themselves, but will pay well. Choose your allies wisely. They will be part of your fate whether you like it or not.

title: Labyrinth of Crystal Princess
description:
게임 정보
*Additional game trailers, demo versions, and official translations will be released as soon as the beta version is completed.
Overview.
Labyrinth of Crystal Princess is a single-player horror adventure.
With a thrilling tale of a top-secret project that uncovers the dark side of the project,
Invisible Puzzles, the game offers a new gaming experience for everyone.
Story.
An explosion in a laboratory causes Hiyo to fall into an underground labyrinth.
Hiyo decides to escape, but something terrifying and “invisible” is stirring in front of her...
autokwd: Labyrinth of Crystal Princess,結晶姫のラビリンス

title: Eletta
description:
게임 정보
낯선 곳에서 강력한 적들, 첨단 기술 및 과학 발전에 맞서 싸우는 엘레타의 이야기를 탐험해보세요. 액션 게임 엘레타에서 한 소녀는 자신의 행동이 세상을 구할 수 있는 상황에 처하게 됩니다.
포로 생활에서 탈출을 시도하며, 그녀는 납치된 이유를 알게 되고, 자신이 가는 길에 발견한 도구만을 사용하여 다른 사람에게 같은 일이 일어나지 않도록 막기로 결심합니다.
영웅이 되어보세요
사람들은 항상 겉모습과 다를 수 있으며, 유명한 영웅이 악의 근원일 수 있고, 악당처럼 보이는 사람들은 단지 잘못된 길을 걷고 있는 영웅일 수도 있습니다. 세상의 비밀을 밝혀내고, 사람들에게 의심의 여지를 남기며, 도울 수 있는 사람은 돕고 막아야 할 사람은 막으세요.

즉석 전투
준비되지 않은 상황에 내몰린 엘레타는 자신을 방어하고 앞으로 나아가기 위해 찾을 수 있는 모든 것을 사용합니다. 렌치를 무기로, 임시 변통으로 만든 새총과 못을 발사체로, 그리고 자신의 독창성을 이용하여 무엇이든 함정으로 만듭니다. 주변의 모든 것을 활용하여 우위를 점하고 모든 역경을 극복하세요.

title: A Snoot's Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Join Snoot in an Epic, Adorable Journey Like No Other!
Prepare for the fluffiest, fastest-paced, and most Snoot-tastic adventure ever! In “A Snoot’s Adventure,” you’ll step into the floppy shoes of Snoot, the lovable creature from Snootville, as you embark on a magical quest to save the Seven Realms. With vibrant 3D platforming, high-speed paintball combat, and heartwarming acts of kindness, this game blends snoot-strategy with non-stop action!
                       A mysterious rift has opened between Snoot’s peaceful realm and our universe. Now, Snoot must race through intergalactic realms, collecting Spirit Leaves from the legendary Tree of Life to restore harmony. Along the way, earn Gratitude Hearts for helping the quirky citizens of these realms, from shy snails to the snootily mischievous JoJo Magnifico.
                        Key Features

title: Trapped: Forced To Kill
description:
게임 정보
Life turns around when you find out that you have woken up in a room that isn't yours.

Suddenly, to make things worse; Ciara Mori finds out that she has been trapped with a crazy, psycho, man who wants nothing but to gain enjoyment out of seeing others in pain. And if that's not enough, shortly after you find out that you are imprisoned with twelve other helpless people who want nothing but to get out and see their family again.

But that won't be happening! Not until he gets his enjoyment.

Or will you possibly find a way to escape this hell-room? It's up to you to learn about this mysterious place and pick up new clues on how you got there. New clues that could possibly lead to your escape... Mingle with other characters, gain relationships, friendships, and enjoy intimate moments with your chosen characters. But be careful, don't get too close to them... they might turn on you.

What To Expect:
- You play as Ciara Mori: a nine-teen year-old girl. Explore the areas you're trapped in, search for clues, mingle with characters and enjoy
the dark, twisted storyline that is bound to get you swept off your feet! Participate in various killing games, torture games and more, brought to you by the
cunning antagonist- Akira! Work on putting together clues from the story in order to find out the true reason on why you were brought here and enjoy the
beautiful, hand drawn art, with special intimate moments!

Gaining Relationships with Characters:
-Throughout the story, get closer to the one and only, Ash Ito. Enjoy intimate moments with him, choose different choices in order to strengthen your
relationship, help him through tough times and solve puzzles together! It may be a tough situation, but there's always time for a bit of romance ;).
With other characters, you get moments where you can speak to your favourite characters, help them, and get them to trust you.

Steam Features:
-Choose certain choices or actions to gain steam achievements!

title: Princess of the Water Lilies
description:
게임 정보
Princess of the Water Lilies is a 2D puzzle-platformer where players step into the paws of an adventurous cat, exploring a world filled with secrets and magic. Raised by a family of frogs in a tranquil pond, she is gifted a magical collar that becomes the key to unlocking her unique powers. By purring, the collar releases magical energy that transforms the environment—causing plants to bloom, bridges to grow, and pathways to emerge—allowing her to solve puzzles and traverse the mysterious world around her.
Use the cat's magical collar to manipulate the world, solving puzzles that range from environmental interactions to complex multi-stage challenges. Explore lush, hand-drawn biomes, each filled with obstacles, hidden pathways, and secrets to uncover.
As players progress, the magical collar unlocks new abilities that not only aid in puzzle-solving but also enhance the platforming experience, introducing mechanics like vine swinging, water traversal, and more.

title: SAVE AMANI
description:
게임 정보
SAVE AMANI is a adventure game about war. Players will help a child named Amani escape from various dangers during the war by solving puzzles. Players can feel the cruelty of war and the devastation and damage to people's lives and souls, thereby arousing people's appreciation for peace and attention to children in war.





Game Features

The city ravaged by war is in ruins and a mess. The once glorious buildings have now turned into ruins, the streets are covered in gravel and scorched earth, the smoke of gunpowder permeates, and the sky is gloomy. The ruthlessness of war deprives cities of vitality and energy, leaving behind endless sadness and painful memories. People are displaced, their homes are shattered, and the shadow of war covers every inch of the land, which is heartbreaking. ‌




The enemy is lurking in all directions, soldiers armed with live ammunition may appear at any time, drones hover continuously in the air, mechanical dogs patrol along the necessary routes, and in addition, one must always be vigilant of collapsed walls, landmines hidden in the soil, and shells that may fall from the air. Every step is full of unknowns and dangers.




Be sure to hide and stay as far away as possible from enemy drones. Once scanned and locked by them, Oman will face the danger of being shot.




He can control his small drone, explore the situation ahead, and effectively lure away enemies, with a wide range of uses.




War rages on, innocent children, and little boy Aman witnesses his home shattered and his loved ones scattered. The warm embrace of the past has become a cold memory, a tender heart that endures endless sorrow.
To commemorate the deceased teacher, light a candle and offer the sincerest wishes and thoughts.




Multiple spaces support switching from a third person perspective to a first person perspective for exploration.




Help Aman find that QR code, just put on VR glasses and scan it, and he can immerse himself in the illusory scene that was not destroyed before the war. The former campus, classrooms, streets, libraries, amusement parks, and central square are all vividly remembered. Every time he puts on his VR glasses, Oman's face blooms with a smile, as he can once again see his former family, classmates, teachers, and those familiar environments.




However, when he took off his glasses and reality came into view again, Oman's heart was filled with endless sadness. ‌




Once upon a time, the little boy Aman was like a ray of sunshine in winter, with a warm and bright smile, and a pure light shining in his eyes. He loves sunshine, warmth, clouds, nature, and small animals. However, now his eyes no longer flicker and he can only hide himself in the darkness. It seems that things that are within everyone's reach have become an unattainable luxury for Oman.




Separated by a wall, the two worlds are completely separated, with no hope of crossing over. However, the boy Aman still needs to gather courage and move forward resolutely in the midst of danger.
autokwd: SAVE AMANI,拯救阿曼 SAVE AMANI

title: Ghosty Paw’s Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Ghosty’s Big Adventure
Step into the paws of Ghosty, brave and curious, half cat & half ghost and on an epic 2D action-adventure! Explore vibrant, hand-drawn worlds filled with exciting quests, quirky characters, and mysterious creatures. Along the way, you’ll chat with NPCs, lend a helping paw, and solve tricky challenges as you uncover secrets and discover what it takes to be a true adventurer!
Features:
• Explore multiple worlds: From spiky forests to underground castles, each realm is packed with new surprises and secrets!
• Interact with NPCs: Meet friendly faces that will guide you, give you quests, and share their stories.
• Physics-based gameplay: Feel the natural flow of the world as objects move and react in fun and unexpected ways!
Can you help Ghosty become an adventurer just like her grandma? Grab your backpack, adventurer book and start your journey!

title: Wadar: a dimension altering reality
description:
게임 정보
Wadar is a 2d platformer designed to make you think and utilizes gameplay elements that are not seen often in platformers.
some examples of this includes the player being able to:
Flip gravity
Pause your existence?
Stop time
Teleport (in a bunch of different ways)
Use portals
Stop gravity 
and a bunch of other abilities with levels made to allow the player to get the most out of them. 
abilities are not the only focus of this game however. there are 9 worlds which includes 
Ability focused worlds
A troll world, 
A world where you have to find out how much you need to do something and 
A world based on colour platforms defining what you can see or collide with (these platforms have symbols to try and help with colour blindness compatability)
there are also a lot of secrets within some levels to be found including both unlockable cosmetics to stylize your character and even secret endings which may let you skip some levels.
there are over 70 levels in this game and plenty of which you will most likely need to play multiple times to find everything.

title: Five Heads
description:
게임 정보
THE GAME
Five prisoners sit around a table, each with a card on their forehead—visible to everyone but themselves. In the first two rounds, they must figure out where they rank from lowest to highest, using logic, deduction, and psychology. In the final round, each player takes a leap of faith, guessing their exact card. Every guess is a clue, every mistake a setback—can you crack the code?
THE RUN
The Run is a high-stakes gauntlet of logic and teamwork. You and your team of five must survive a series of escalating challenges, ending each level in the correct order to advance. Before moving forward, you’ll vote on a power to aid your deduction and a poison that makes the next level even tougher. With each round growing more intense, will your team adapt, or will the increasing chaos break your streak?

title: The Tale of Azu
description:
게임 정보
특징
🌿 신화 세계로의 모험 - 현실과 신화를 넘나드는 신비로운 모험 속에서 색다른 세계를 탐험하세요
🐾 고양이의 액션 - 민첩한 움직임과 다채로운 스킬로 펼쳐지는 귀엽고 역동적인 액션
🐺 성장과 강화 - 아즈를 훈련하고 강화하여, 모험 속의 강력한 적들과 맞서세요
🎭 감동적인 스토리 - 잃어버린 누나 고양이를 향한 아즈의 가슴 따뜻한 여정을 함께하세요
줄거리
대한민국 어딘가, 아직 어린티를 완전히 벗지 못한 소년 고양이, 아즈가 살고 있다.
아즈는 세상에서 가장 행복한 고양이였다.
누나 고양이 모카가 곁을 떠나기 전까지는...
모카는 아즈의 둘도 없는 동료이자, 아즈에게 고양이로서 살아가는 법을 가르쳐준 스승이었다.
그런 모카가 떠난 이후, 아즈는 마음 어딘가가 빈 것만 같아 견딜 수가 없었다.
집사는 모카가 무지개 다리를 건너서 먼 곳으로 떠나버렸다고,
그래서 이제는 아즈가 자기를 지켜줘야 한다고 했다.
집사를 지키는 것 쯤이야 별 문제 없었지만, 아즈는 궁금해서 참을 수가 없었다.
항상 함께였던 모카가, 자신을 두고 가버린 무지개 다리란 곳은 어떤 곳일까.
그렇게 말도 없이 갑작스레 떠나버릴만큼, 신나는 곳일까.
자신도 그 곳에 가면 모카를 다시 만날 수 있을까…
궁금증은 모카와 함께했던 기억들이 옅어져갈수록, 그 자리를 대신하려는 듯이 강렬해졌다.
그래서 어느 날, 아즈는 모카를 찾아, 무지개 다리를 찾아 떠나기로 결심한다.
아즈가 알고 있는 가장 똑똑한 존재인 까마귀 아저씨조차도,
무지개 다리가 어디에 위치한지는 알지 못했다.
그래도 아즈는 무지개 다리를 찾아야만 했다. 내일 해가 뜨면 무작정 밖으로 나가보기로 했다.
어디로 갈까, 그런데 어떻게 밖에 나갈까. 모르겠다. 일단 든든하게 밥을 많이 먹어두자...
이런저런 생각을 하다 보니 어느새 아즈는 잠이 들고 만다.
그리고 눈을 떠보니, 낯선 대지 위였다.
당신은 집사로서 아즈가 이 모험을 완수하고, 모카와 재회할 수 있도록 도와야합니다.

title: NOT TACTICAL VR
description:
게임 정보
NOT TACTICAL VR is the single-player VR extraction game.
Use the special weapons collected across different maps to lighten the load of your missions.
Realistic combat experience
Complete missions on immersive battlefields using a variety of items based on real-world weapons and gear. Hold your gun with both hands, reload magazines, and pull the trigger. Use complex gun physics and injury and healing systems to escape the area.
Adapt and upgrade
Tailor and upgrade your arsenal to suit your playstyle from your home base with our modding system.

title: PaintMan Go！
description:
게임 정보
PaintMan GO! The main gameplay is TPS (Third-Person Shooting), where players control their characters and shoot to defeat other players. The game also incorporates the concept of ink, where players' ammo, health, and victory conditions are all related to ink. Players must consume their ammo to turn it into ink beans, which they can then use to absorb ink from the same colored dye areas to replenish their ammo.
In the same colored shadowed areas, life points will be restored, while in other colored shadowed areas, life points will gradually decrease. In normal mode, the winning and losing conditions are closely related to the shadowed areas. In short, taking many kills does not determine the outcome of the game, the size of the shadowed areas is the main criterion for determining the winner.
There are diverse and varied game maps in the game, each with a different playstyle. There are also various stylish game interface designs, allowing you to experience a cool and exciting battle. You can also choose from a variety of weapons in the changing weapon arsenal, and dress in cool and stylish outfits to stand out in the game!
Game Features
1. Cool and beautiful girls for you to choose and customize in the graffiti world;
2. Innovative Battle Royale, multiplayer real-time combat tournament;
3. A wide variety of weapons at your disposal, with endless strategies to discover!
4. The squid undergoes a colorful transformation, making it a fun and fascinating experience.
5. Shoot to be just, and spray the world at your command.

title: Kumori Village
description:
게임 정보
일본 깊은 산속의 마을에 길을 잃은 주인공.
그곳에는 사람을 공격하는 신비한 괴물 전설이 존재합니다.
주인공은 다양한 사람들과 협력하며 손전등과 테이저건을 들고 마을의 비밀을 풀어갑니다.
게임 특징:
랜덤으로 등장하는 아이템을 사용, 장비, 합성하며 게임을 진행하세요.
괴물에게 들키지 않도록 조심하며, 테이저건으로 공격하는 잠입 액션.
다양한 기믹을 활용한 던전 공략.

title: Hivaneph - The Legend of Elles
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Hivaneph – The Legend of Elles is an action game with RPG elements for Windows, focusing on narrative, layered exploration, and memorable, charismatic characters.

title: Hellaven
description:
게임 정보
Hellaven - This is a comedy visual novel about an angel imprisoned for life in a heavenly prison many years ago for selling drugs, but at one point his life changes and he is forced to go on an adventure to understand his past
Story
70 years ago, under certain circumstances, a white-haired angel appears in a heavenly prison, but in one day everything changes, and a girl comes to him with an offer of cooperation that is impossible to win, because it helps him free himself from life imprisonment and start a new life... The main thing is not to make past mistakes again, or to make sure that no one knows about it... And you will also have to see old acquaintances and meet many new friends in the human world.
Peculiarities
Duration: 3-4 hours
Full voice acting of the novel (so far only in Russian)
Full video scenes between transitions from locations
Several secret characters
Lots of cute, funny and spicy moments
Colorful, scenic art
Black humor
Dynamic action scenes with different outcome
Elements of Fanservice

title: CountDown
description:
게임 정보


Prepare for a thrilling subterranean adventure in CountDown, a casual pixel-art rogue-like that puts you in control of an omnipotent GLOVE GOD! Set in a charming underground village, devoid of light, you are the last bastion between your townsfolk and the encroaching hoards of mutated fauna. As night falls, your duty is to defend your people, by any means necessary. Will you rely on your "trained" soldiers, or will you unleash your god-like strength to turn the buildings, objects, and even citizens into projectiles to hurl at the oncoming threats?

Delve further into the depths of this chasm to gather resources from the flora which can further fortify your defenses. You'll encounter five unique enemy types in the demo, culminating in an epic boss battle! So don't wait, immerse yourself in the brief yet exhilarating experience of CountDown now!



For any issues or further inquiries about the game, please check out the community discord! There's also information posted here frequently about upcoming updates, as well as sneak peaks at future additions.

title: OOLO
description:
게임 정보
Set off into the lush fantasy world of OOLO, a modern take on the classic isometric adventure game! Embark on a non-linear journey across mysterious forests, haunted catacombs, magical factories, and more as you collect keys, solve puzzles, and discover upgrades that allow you to explore the map in new and exciting ways. Collect memories of previous adventurers to piece together the secrets of the Isle of Souls on your quest to rekindle the World Flame.
Explore a vast world with over 400 interconnected rooms!
Venture through dark forests, subterranean crypts, deadly swamps, and more.
Find new artifacts that change the way you move and interact with the world.

title: Edenfall
description:
게임 정보
"You're a glutton in love."

You're Eden, an eldritch thing. You're in love with your angel Ezekiel. But Ezekiel is enamoured by the slum she is damned to and the angels stagnating in it.

She wants the slum angels to fall. You would do anything to help her. But she wants you, eldritch thing you are, to swallow up the slum as she dallies with its angels. She wants you away from her, wants to love something that is not you.

And that just can't do.

You must make Ezekiel love you. You must tell Ezekiel you love her. You may be a mass of vines and branches but you have a confession to make.

Somehow, you must find a way.

(Parchments, radios, songs… something pulsing alive. Ezekiel must hear it.)



Edenfall is a game about Eden and her angel Ezekiel. It's a darker take on the tale of Seraphim Slum: an obsessive and deranged romance between a destructive force of nature and an angel. But now, it's told from the perspective of the eldritch garden that loves her angel… a little too much.

You play as Eden as you...

Find out god's secrets from the slum's nooks and crannies.
Get to know try not to kill the fallen angels of the slum why the fuck does your angel love them.
Gather the pieces you need to confess your love for your angel she deserves you you're her one and only make her fall for you.

Edenfall is the next instalment to the Seraphim Slum universe. Playing the previous game is recommended, but not required to understand Edenfall.



















Please play at your own discretion.

title: Red Squad Reborn
description:
게임 정보
Red Squad Reborn is a third-person and first-person shooter combat game, plunging players into the heart of World War III's relentless conflict between NATO and Russian forces. Set in a near-future battleground torn apart by global tensions, the game immerses players in a gripping narrative-driven experience filled with adrenaline-pumping action and strategic gameplay.
Game Modes:
Team Deathmatch
Free For All
Search and Destroy (TBA)
Last Man Standing (TBA)
Domination (TBA)

title: HARD VOID
description:
게임 정보
HARD VOID is a 4X turn-based strategy game, in a space setting inspired by Lovecraft mythos.
Design your ships!
Highly customizable spaceship designs allow the selection of multiple ship systems: laser cannons, nuclear missiles, fusion reactors and much more :

Each spaceship is unique and procedurally generated by your requirements.
The procedural spaceship generator can produce up to 18 Trillion unique spaceships hulls!
No two spaceship designs will look the same.
Turn based strategic combat, command hundred of spaceships to battle.
Use multiple FTL travel methods to explore expand : Warp, Sub, Wormholes and more.
Colonize planets, asteroids and the space itself, also you can explore multiple dimensions, but beware,
you aren't only dealing with just other species, space travel unlocks horrors beyond comprehension that are waiting in the vast dark void and will trial your empire.

title: Idea Fix
description:
게임 정보
It's just another one of these days. You're stuck inside the Machine: clicking buttons, pushing levers, hoping there is an end to all this.

Explore the Machine, understand what makes it tick, become a gear in its perfect system. Or maybe you want to get out?

Mechanisms

Interact with the modules of the Machine in an intuitive and tactile way. Repair broken mechanisms, upgrade, unlock and buy new ones.

Exponential Growth

What Machine takes, it gives back with interest. Experiment with the opportunities it presents and find lucrative synergies.

Discover secrets

There's more to the Machine that meets the eye. Uncover its secrets, search for the hidden truth that lies beyond the cold exterior.

Relax

Take a break from your Sisyphean task. Tune out the ever present noise of the machinery and fill the silence with some chill music. Play a game or two, unwind but remember:

The Machine is waiting

title: XenoTechArena
description:
게임 정보
Xenotech Arena is a Roguelite arena shooter set in Neo-Japan inspired arena.
A variety of characters such as Geisha Girl, Ninja Head, and Sumo Rider are playable.
Choose and collect over 70 different power-up items to enhance your player!
If you can get class change items, you can evolve and further enhance your players.
Take on screen-filling monsters with your enhanced character and enjoy the exhilarating experience of tackling and blasting them!
Collect items in dungeon mode and see how long you can survive in arena mode!

title: Miner Clicker
description:
게임 정보
Miner Clicker is a single-player clicking game and your primary task involves clicking to demolish mines. Your goal is to break the rocks, earn minerals, and accumulate wealth through investments.

The real-time market feature offers players to engage in dynamic trade of minerals. Face the exciting challenge of fluctuating market conditions: the strategy to buy low and sell high maximizes profits, yet it also bears the risk of potential losses.



Clicking rocks damages them, and once destroyed, you'll earn the associated minerals. With the wealth accumulated, you can invest in hiring miners who will tirelessly work on your behalf. These hired miners, each with specific attributes such as damage and efficiency rates, automatically strike the mines to extract resources for you.



The ultimate goal is to amass a fortune and create your auto mining farm!

title: Gummy Nightmares
description:
게임 정보
Step into the enigmatic world of "Gummy Nightmares" as Player One, a young boy who awakens in a mysterious amusement park with no memory of his past or identity. Guided by a mysterious girl named Jenny, you must use your slingshot, whistle, and backpack to battle evil robots, solve puzzles, and find clues to recover your lost memories.
Welcome to Gummy Park!
Gummy Park was once a lively amusement park filled with joy and laughter, but one day, an accident turned everything sinister. Now, you must explore this eerie park haunted by sinister robots, uncover its secrets, and remember who you are before the nightmares consume you!

The Robots
Beware of the sinister plushie robots that haunt the park, trying to keep you from discovering the truth. Survive by hiding, setting traps, or confronting them. As you progress through the story, these robots will become increasingly aggressive. Fortunately, along your journey, you will also encounter friendly robots who will help you achieve your objectives and fight the evil ones!

Your slingshot is your best friend! Use it to shoot active elements like electric boxes, gumball dispensers, or fire extinguishers to attack your enemies and slow them down. The slingshot isn't just for fighting; it can also be used to interact with your surroundings, solve puzzles, and unlock secrets. Most importantly, remember to regularly fill your backpack with gumballs from the dispensers located throughout the park.

In certain areas of the park, you'll encounter patrolling robots such as Gummy and Scrawny. Fighting them isn't always an option; at times, survival hinges on finding a hiding spot. Seek sanctuary inside lockers, beneath beds, or within the rides situated in the lobby. Additionally, the karts in the lobby provide a means of evading your adversaries.
One of the distinctive features of Gummy Nightmares is the option to set traps for the patrolling robots. To do so, you must first collect specific baits scattered throughout the park, then place them inside traps like the meat fridge in the kitchen or the giant bear slide in the lobby. Next, you'll need to draw the attention of the robots by creating loud noises with your whistle and luring them into the traps.

title: Tales of SclObonia
description:
게임 정보
Ever wonder what it’d be like to get isekai’d with your unserious cousin and have to create new identities to survive in a world of magical and terrifying creatures? Follow the two cousins, Kam and Simon, as they laugh, cry, and stumble through a world they’ve only imagined could be real in games and on TV. 
Tales of SclObonia is a turn-based fantasy RPG featuring dungeons, puzzles, and choice-based questlines. Level grind to your heart’s content to upgrade skills, discover new techniques, and uncover the mysteries of a foreign land.
Squabble up as Simon, a brawler from the Woods of Ingle, as you swing first and ask questions never. 
Analyze the world around you as Kam, as you learn to manipulate the arcane arts of SclObonia and take down your enemies (wits and a wand optional)!

title: Aetherian Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
Follow us on X and go to our website to subscribe to get listed for Alpha Playtest and get a free permanent pet!
Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! After a hard day of grinding monsters or hunting bosses, wind down by chatting other AI or real players, or dance! It's your adventure, do whatever you feel like it!
Key Features:
: Participate in boss runs or kill legendary monsters for your quests!

title: AnimaCircus
description:
게임 정보
Dearest public, welcome to the feline circus!
In AnimaCircus, the player gets into a circus troupe made out exclusively by cats, performing to a human audience excited to see your tricks.
Using the keyboard keys or controller buttons, press the direction shown on-screen at the right time to guarantee the best show possible. But don’t worry if you get it wrong, the spectators are very comprehensive.
Main Features
Play 20 songs composed especially for this show and pick the difficulty that better suits you;
See the set come to life as you get many notes consecutively;
Customize your avatar, picking their skin and eyes color, as well your best clothes.

title: Arcade Management Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Step into the world of arcade nostalgia with Arcade Management Simulator, a detailed simulation where you manage, expand, and transform your arcade into the ultimate entertainment hub.
Manage Your Arcade
Start with a modest arcade and steadily grow your business. Purchase and set up arcade cabinets, gacha machines, and claw machines to create a space your customers will love.
Dynamic Pricing & Gameplay
Set prices for each play session and find the perfect balance between affordability and profit. Test your luck with over 500 collectible gachas and even try your hand at the claw machines.
Sell & Trade
Sell or trade your collected gachas with customers to keep them coming back. List them online for a massive profit.
Host Events
Transform your arcade into the ultimate party destination! Host birthday parties, office gatherings, and other celebrations to bring in waves of excited guests. Enter Fever Mode, where your arcade experiences a surge in activity and doubles your earnings for the duration
Build Your Reputation
Your goal is to make your arcade the most highly-rated spot in town. Clean, repair, and upgrade your facilities to attract more customers and keep them happy.
Expand & Upgrade
Reinvest your profits to expand your arcade, add new attractions, and customize your layout. Unlock advanced machines and create a one-of-a-kind arcade experience.
In Arcade Management Simulator, every choice you make shapes your journey. Can you rise to the challenge and turn your humble arcade into the most legendary entertainment destination?

This is just the beginning we'll have more features added as development progresses.

title: The Gambit Lost to Time
description:
게임 정보
플뢰레타, 윈터브랜드, 베르단디아, 골든송으로 구성된 네 왕국의 통치자들이 모두 같은 날 의문의 사건으로 죽음을 맞이하며 우노니아 대륙이 혼돈에 빠졌습니다. 갑작스러운 왕위 계승으로 새로운 역할을 떠맡게 된 후계자들은 서로를 향해 비난을 쏟아냈고, 수 세기 동안 이어졌던 평화에 종지부를 찍으며 혼란의 시기가 찾아왔습니다.
대륙의 평화만을 바라며 시간을 여행하는 조언가, 미아가 이때 등장합니다. 
Gambit Lost to Time은 로그라이트 요소가 가미된 전술 RPG 게임으로, 미래의 지식을 활용해 과거를 바꾸며 대륙의 평화를 되찾아야 합니다.
여러분의 전략과 지략으로 전쟁 중인 네 왕국 중 하나를 도와주세요. 오늘의 친구가 다른 시간선에서 적이 될 수도 있다는 점을 염두에 두고 왕과 여왕, 그리고 왕국의 신하들을 친구로 삼으세요. 함께하는 동료나 적대하는 인물들의 갈등 및 유혈 사태가 반복적으로 재현되는 와중에도 감정을 억눌러야 합니다... 
그 운명의 날에 실제로 무슨 일이 벌어진 것인지 알아내고, 그토록 아끼는 친구들과 이 대륙을 지키기 위해서라면 무엇이든 희생할 수 있지 않을까요? 그 결정은 여러분의 손에 달려 있습니다.
전략
어느 왕국을 지원하든 전략가로서 왕국군의 생존을 보장하며 승리로 이끄는 책무를 맡아야 합니다.
50가지 이상의 스킬 중 3개를 슬롯에 채우고 영웅을 전장으로 이끌어 보세요.
그리고 그 영웅을 중심으로 전장을 함께 누빌 병사들을 징집하세요.
전투 전에 영웅을 지휘관으로 임명해야 합니다. 각 영웅에는 부대에 적용될 지휘관 고유 보너스가 있습니다. 올바른 지휘관 보너스를 사용해 자신만의 플레이 스타일에 힘을 실어주거나 다양한 상황에 맞게 활용해 보세요!
시간의 책략
시간 여행자의 힘을 활용해 현재를 원하는 대로 재구성해 보세요. 시간선을 거듭할 때마다 이 세계 자체와 다른 사람들... 그리고 자신에 대해 더 자세히 알아갑니다. 이상적인 시간선을 손에 넣을 때까지 더 강력하게 성장하며 힘을 강화하세요.
지난 행동이 만족스럽지 않으면 시간을 되돌려 이전 턴으로 돌아갈 수도 있습니다.
미래의 지식을 "책략"으로 활용하면 또 다른 시간선에서 다시 마주한 전투의 흐름을 완전히 뒤바꿀 수도 있습니다.
미래에서 겪어보고 학습한 덕분에 새로운 가능성을 열고 전투도 완전히 새롭게 전개할 수 있습니다.
전투를 빠르게 완료하는 경우 획득하는 시간의 정수를 이용해서 다음 시간선으로 넘어가기 전에 최대한 많은 지식을 습득하세요. 
독특한 네 왕국
꽃이 무성한 플뢰레타의 평원부터 차가운 윈터브랜드의 산맥과 파릇파릇한 베르단디아의 숲, 그리고 혹독한 골든송의 황무지까지. 서로 평화롭게 지내던 좋은 시절도 있었습니다.

title: The Gas Station
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to The Gas Station, a nerve-wracking survival horror experience set in the desolate heart of nowhere. As the night shift worker at a lonely gas station, your routine starts with mundane tasks—restocking shelves, taking out the trash, keeping the power on. But the deeper into the night you go, the more unsettling the events become. Eerie phone calls. Shadows moving where they shouldn’t. What starts as an ordinary shift spirals into a nightmare you can't escape.
In The Gas Station, every decision matters, with multiple endings that keep you on edge until the very last moment. Will you survive the hostile activity, make it to dawn, and live? Or will your curiosity—or fear— be the cause of your death?
Features:
Dynamic Tasks: Keep the station running while terror builds around you. The more you do, the worse it gets.
Multiple Endings: Drive away, uncover the killer’s hideout, or fight for survival in a basement torture chamber. Your fate is in your hands.
Immersive Atmosphere: Experience the haunting isolation of a lonely gas station, complete with PS1-style visuals and atmospheric sound effects.
You clock in for a quiet night. But will you clock out alive? Welcome to the most terrifying shift of your life.

title: Covert Crew
description:
게임 정보
- 클래식 2D 턴제 전술
전투 파괴 가능한 구조물, 보조 목표, 독특한 보스 전투를 통해 그리드 기반 전투를 벌이세요.
 - 20개 이상의 플레이 가능한 유닛
각기 고유한 힘, 외모, 개성, 공격력을 가진 다양한 캐릭터에서 모집하세요.
 - 팀원과의 시너지
좋아하는 승무원과 함께 일하며 시너지를 높여 새로운 유대감 장면, 장비, 전투 중 보너스를 잠금 해제하세요.
 - 당신의 힘이 무기입니다
 파워 모듈레이터를 장착하여 공격을 수정하고, 파워와 속도를 높이거나, 상태 효과를 부여할 확률을 추가하세요. 게임을 진행하면서 새로운 모듈레이터를 잠금 해제하고 제작하세요.

title: Aksun
description:
게임 정보

'악선'의 세계에서 '드레드'가 되어, 당신을 방해하는 악귀들을 전부 제거하고
과업을 이루기 위해 저승으로 나아가십시오.
무속이 담긴 한국의 신비로운 세계
'악선'은 한국 문화 기반의 액션 게임입니다.
역사와 무속을 배경으로 등장하는 등장인물과 괴물들
그리고 다양한 유산을 직접 경험해 보십시오.

'드레드의 제례'에 등장하는 다양한 무구들은 당신의 과업을 이루는 데 도움이 될 것입니다.
당신의 마음이 이끄는 데로 무기를 고르고 성장하며 나아가세요.

'악선'은 로그라이트 게임입니다.
전투 중 드레드가 사망해도, 혼은 저승의 어딘가로 돌아갈 뿐입니다.
육신을 수복하는 동안, 사망 전 습득한 도구들은
당신의 과업에 도움이 될 것입니다.
'악선'에서의 죽음은, 하나의 수단일 뿐입니다.
육체가 찢기고 부서져도 앞으로 나아가십시오.

title: Battle-Lines
description:
게임 정보
NO THEME. JUST LINES. PURE STRATEGY.
Battle-Lines is an easy to learn strategy game for 1-4 players where the challenge comes from choosing the best moves among dozens of possibilities, against human or AI opponents. Will you use your turn to build for the future, optimize what you have, or sabotage your opponents' strategies?
In Battle-Lines, you will need to constantly revise your strategy. The state of the game changes with every move, and even if you're ahead, your position is never secure. Likewise, you can almost always come back from last place. Games take only 20 minutes!
HOW TO PLAY
You use your turn to either place a piece or rotate a tile on the board. Pieces contain both your lines, and neutral lines.
You get points for the lines you make while doing so.
You convert a grey neutral line to your own by connecting it to one of your own lines.

title: Jade Spring
description:
게임 정보
Relax, potter, and build in Jade Spring, a small Guild Wars 2 decorating and homesteading fan game featuring entirely hand-made assets and items. Tend your garden as a Xunlai jade bot, clearing weeds and pests, dispelling Dragonvoid blights, and furnishing your plot with architecture, flora, furniture, and ornaments from across Tyria!
Zen Cleaning
Engage in mini-games to spruce up your plot, clearing out bugs, invasive plants, trash, and leftover strands of Dragonvoid. Collect Karma from each task to spend on permanent improvements to your gardening and decorating abilities!
Granular Decoration
Personalise your space using robust tools which let you easily move, rotate, scale, snap, and clear items. Acquire enough Karma to unlock fancy decorations, as well as utilities which allow you to change the time of day, clear the map to start fresh, and fine-tune your environment to suit your creativity.
A Guild Wars 2 Tribute
Jade Spring is an independent developer’s love letter to Cantha and to Guild Wars 2 in general, featuring hand-made assets, art, models, animations, and music directly inspired by the worlds of Tyria, and filled with small tributes and references.
Notice as specified by ArenaNet’s content terms of use: © ArenaNet LLC. All rights reserved. NCSOFT, ArenaNet, Guild Wars, Guild Wars 2, GW2, Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns, Guild Wars 2: Path of Fire, Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons, and Guild Wars 2: Secrets of the Obscure and all associated logos, designs, and composite marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of NCSOFT Corporation.

title: Don't Freeze: A Winter Card Survival
description:
게임 정보
여객기 추락 사고 이후, 당신은 혹독한 겨울 황무지에 홀로 남겨진 유일한 생존자가 되었습니다. 당신의 임무는 문명으로 돌아갈 때까지 살아남는 것—그리고 이 치명적인 환경을 헤쳐 나가며 독특한 카드 기반 생존 경험을 펼치는 것입니다.
추락 현장의 잔해에서부터 얼어붙은 강, 버려진 마을, 그리고 광활하고 가차 없는 겨울 지형까지, 10가지 이상의 다양한 환경을 탐험하며 당신의 생존 본능을 시험하세요.
사냥, 낚시, 덫 설치, 그리고 수색을 통해 생존에 필요한 음식과 보급품을 확보하세요—살아남기 위해 사용할 수 있는 모든 것을 찾아야 합니다.
autokwd: Don't Freeze: A Winter Card Survival

title: Misty Garden
description:
게임 정보
Create a peaceful garden. Build a soothing retreat and help the wandering creatures unwind from chaotic lives. Misty Garden is a calm and relaxing base building providing laid-back experience interacting with the Purrlings, a creature living in the Misty forest.
Take care of Purrlings!
They are interested in your garden! Welcome and place them in the facilities for them to relax. There are open-air rock baths, hot-sand spa, and places to take a nap!
Build & Decorate facilities for the Purrlings to relax
Build and upgrade the facilities the Purrling could use during their stay. They might even request a specific service from you! Decorate the place well, so it looks nice and cozy!

title: Door to Somewhere
description:
게임 정보
Door to Somewhere is a 2.5D horror game about an alchemist, a door, and a forest of monsters. You are Winnie, a novice witch skilled at making potions.
Story--
After a mysterious death, and being involved in a violent incident in the past, she is the first culprit in the eyes of the city. She is innocent however, just a humble alchemist selling her wares in a small market. This matters not, and she must flee the city and into the nearby forest. There, she has set up a hut for herself, safe but alone. Unbeknown to her, horrors are leaking into her world through a strange detached door. Their motives unknown, they begin to show their faces to the witch. The woods are not safe, but she cannot return home, not yet. She must prove her innocence and solve the mystery behind where these creatures came from. 
Key Features--
-Experiment with alchemy to create powerful potions. Brew healing tonics, antidotes, and antibiotics to fight the corruption—but beware, resources are limited
-Explore a sprawling forest teeming with hopes and horrors, and discover what lies on the other side of the door
-Use your potions and wits to solve intricate puzzles and unlock new paths
-There are various monsters waiting for you, some are friendly, some are not
-Make important decisions that will decide the fate of the forest's inhabitants, these choices leading to one of a variety of multiple endings
The door is open. The choice is yours.

title: Jewel of Clementia
description:
게임 정보
The protagonist is asked to search for the Jewel of Clementia, which a legend says will be discovered by brave heroes. Selena and Lilly will accompany the protagonist for the journey. Together they will explore the beautiful world, collect information, obtain items, learn spells and search for the Jewel of Clementia.
Jewel of Clementia is an adventure game where players will freely explore the beautiful world. The game will surely give you the true sense of adventure.
Explore the beautiful world
Jewel of Clementia is a text based adventure game. The exploration system will let you explore the world. There are many choices players will make and what to do is up to you.
Relaxing world
The world is very relaxing. You will enjoy exploring the relaxing world. Jewel of Clementia is a peaceful adventure game crafted for exploration, relaxation and immersion. Jewel of Clementia is designed to offer players relaxing experiences.

title: Brick Buddies
description:
게임 정보
Partner up!
Brick Buddies is a turbulent couch co-op construction game for 2 players. Take control of one of the wobbly buddies, who both share a crane, and work together to construct epic buildings - or at least something that doesn’t immediately collapse. The higher you build, the more points you cash in. The shakier the whole thing gets, the more your friendship is put to the test! But beware - the innocent-looking sheep want to turn your building dreams into nightmares.
Co-operation is key!
Both buddies are responsible for different tasks on the job. Rotating the crane, picking up building blocks and honking away aggressive sheep have to be coordinated to finish the job on time and with minimal collateral damage.

Features, aka The Fun Stuff:

BRICK-TACULAR MECHANICS: Partner up and dive into the chaotic co-op construction fun with easy to learn but hard to master duo-crane controls. Communicate, stack building blocks and honk away the sweet but sneaky sheep. Try out different strategies on multiple maps and become pro-builders in career mode or construct the ultimate skyscraper in endless mode!




So, what are you waiting for? Grab your trusty sidekick (preferably human, not sheep), crash on that comfy couch, and let the bricklaying (and sheep-dodging) madness begin!
Ready, set, build!

title: Realms of Riddles: Wizards'Keep
description:
게임 정보
마법의 중세 세계에서 1인칭 시점의 매혹적인 방탈출 게임에 빠져보세요. 인터랙티브한 환경과 상호작용하고, 비밀을 발견하며, 도전적인 수수께끼를 풀어 신비로 가득한 이야기를 풀어보세요. 당신의 지혜를 시험해보세요!
도전적인 퍼즐
다양한 인터랙티브 퍼즐로 당신의 마음을 도전하세요. 각 도전이 당신의 지혜와 능력을 시험할 수 있는 독특한 기회를 제공하는 매혹적인 세계에 빠져보세요.

흥미진진한 이야기
비할 데 없는 긴장감과 감동으로 가득한 세계에 빠져드는 몰입형 내러티브 경험. 매혹적인 이야기 속으로 흥미진진한 여행을 떠날 준비를 하세요.

title: Into the Depths of Despair
description:
게임 정보
Into the Depths of Despair (ItDod)

I woke up in a room, but I was never asleep. The air is heavy, carrying a scent I can’t recognize. I see with eyes that are not my own, feel a body that doesn’t feel like mine.

The walls seem to breathe, the shadows shift when I’m not looking. There’s no sound except my own breathing—I am alone. Or am I?

Something is keeping me here. I don’t remember how I got to this place, but I know there must be a reason. Is there a way out? Or am I sinking deeper into despair?

title: The Void Calls
description:
게임 정보

Welcome to Reprieve, a town floating above a writhing abyss, formed by murder locations and inhabited by killers. Those unfortunate enough to end up here find themselves trapped, and are inevitably consumed by The Void. Can you escape with your wit and courage, or will you be absorbed like all the rest?

Inspired by classic point-and-click adventures and indie masterpieces, The Void Calls is dark, atmospheric, and exploratory.


Point-And-Click Interface - Interact with anything, use items to solve puzzles.
Discover Secrets - Not everything in Reprieve is as it first seems.
Converse - You'll have to get to know the strange townsfolk to get out.
Explore - It's a big town, with plenty to see.


Dozens of hand-drawn pixel art environments

title: The Shadowed Rune
description:
게임 정보
당신은 위험으로 가득한 잊혀진 탑에 도착했으며, 탈출할 방법이 없습니다. 당신의 유일한 기회는 탑 꼭대기에 올라가 룬 유물의 힘을 사용하여 저주를 푸는 것입니다. 마이아와 다른 탐험가들이 저주받은 탑의 비밀을 밝히는 것을 도와주세요!
The Shadowed Rune은 솔로 또는 2인 협동 모드*로 플레이할 수 있는 도전적인 로그라이크 게임입니다. 룬의 힘을 결합하여 새로운 주문을 발견하고 탑을 올라 저주를 푸세요. 친절해 보이지 않는 적들과 마주하게 되고, 원소의 힘을 현명하게 사용해야 하는 퍼즐도 있습니다. 각 층을 지키는 보스들에 대해 언급했나요? 그것들은 시작에 불과합니다...
*로컬 협동 멀티플레이어는 최소한 하나의 연결된 컨트롤러가 필요합니다.
주요 특징:
총알 지옥 액션 요소, 퍼즐, 도전적인 보스가 있는 독특한 로그라이크 모험.

title: Espirito Delusion
Okinawa Journal
description:
게임 정보
Okinawa Journal is a captivating point-and-click narrative game set during the summer of 2000 in the serene yet mysterious landscapes of Okinawa. You step into the ethereal role of Kami, a guardian angel tasked with guiding Haruki, a struggling journalist, as he delves into the baffling disappearance of a beloved actress.
Along the way, you’ll meet a diverse cast of characters—both human and spirit—each harboring their own secrets, ambitions, and obligations. As the investigation unfolds, you’ll uncover a web of hidden truths tied to Okinawa’s dark past, with consequences that linger in the present.
With challenging decisions, intriguing locations to explore, and multiple endings to discover, Okinawa Journal invites you to shape a story where every choice carries weight.
With Haruki's Insight, you'll always know what still interests him. Also, Okinawa Journal is a succinctly written text-based game. There are no walls of text or meandering dialogue. The characters in the game summarize all their interactions in thought, which you, as a guardian angel, are able to understand.

title: Case 42: The Redwood Files
description:
게임 정보
Case 42: The Redwood Files is a Narrative Horror Adventure game where you play as a Detective and unravel the mystery of a seemingly simple murder case that unfolds itself into something much bigger and scarier.
The Redwood Files is a game taking place in a quite secluded small town with a closed society that is partly welcoming to the detective, partly unwelcoming. This game involves the player making deductions about crime scenes, the loop is to investigate places, talk to folks, get leads, solve puzzles in both worlds, progress, get further leads, connect dots, manage time. You traverse through two realms, one being the normal world where Detective does scene and item investigation, talk to folks and get leads on cases while in other world the Detective faces the real horror of the game, where, while encountering inhumane hostile entities, you further learn about something relevant to the case.

title: Duel Champions - Roguelike Trading Card Game
description:
게임 정보
Play fast card duels, open booster packs, discover cards with powerful synergies and build your best deck in this singleplayer Roguelike Trading Card Game.
Key Features:
Trading Card Game Experience: The joy of Trading Card Games without having to spend real-world currency on booster packs.
Booster packs: Open booster packs to obtain exciting new cards.
Deckbuilding: Builds decks with potent synergies or to counter your next opponent.
Card market: Buy and sell cards but make sure it's the right decision for your card collection.
Lustrum Items: Powerful artifacts that give you various advantages and make each playthrough unique.
Flow:
Play quick duels
Go toe-to-toe with your opponent. Let your cards battle it out on the field. The player with the most victory points wins the duel.
Open booster packs
Use your prize money to buy booster packs and gain powerful new cards.
Build your deck
Optimize your deck with synergies and counters before facing your next opponent.
Face the next Champion
Hone your duel skills and grow your card collection before the next champion challenges you to a duel.
Gain mysterious lustrum items
Defeated champions reward you with lustrum items which can grant you various bonusses on and off the duel field.
autokwd: Duel Champions - Roguelike Trading Card Game
company: Alexander Van den Bulck, Harry Lane

title: Apocalypse Express
description:
게임 정보
Apocalypse Express is an action management Roguelike in which the player conducts, upgrades and repairs different parts of the train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. Departing the darkness of their lifelong shelter, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the outside world with their own eyes, charting out a map around the few remaining memories of the past world.
Manage the Chaos
Be prepared for some nail-biting tension as you try to keep your train running while balancing putting out fires, collecting resources and dispatching enemies. You won't always be able to take care of every part of the Train so be ready to think fast and smart as things will not go as planned.

title: Astrosembler
description:
게임 정보
BUILD. FIGHT. EXPLORE 
A distant planet. A relentless alien threat. And only your ingenuity stands between survival and extinction. Astrosembler is a sci-fi sandbox factory building strategic fps game where you build automated factories, reinforce outposts, and battle extraterrestrial forces in a hostile world.
Assemble, optimize, and defend your industrial empire — because every structure, every bullet, and every resource counts. Will you rise to the challenge?
BUILD ADVANCED PRODUCTION CHAINS
Construct and optimize production chains to manufacture weapons, defenses, and resources. Every building consumes computational power, making expansion a strategic challenge.
FIGHT BACK TO DYNAMIC AI
Defend your factory from an ever-adapting alien threat that targets weak points in your defenses.
DEEP WEAPON CRAFTING SYSTEM

title: Tales of Klodan
description:
게임 정보
In this visual novel, you can shape the story through your choices, decide which characters to pursue a romantic relationship with, and reach one of five possible endings.
As the young prince of Fescillia, you arrive in the snowbound land of Klodan—a kingdom veiled in frost and silence. Sent as the king’s envoy to broker peace, you expect diplomacy, tradition, and civility. But Klodan is not what it seems.
Shadows linger in the frozen corridors of its castles. Whispers curl through the wind, speaking of forgotten oaths and buried truths. The people’s smiles never quite reach their eyes.
And then… something impossible happens.
As the cold tightens its grip and reality begins to unravel, you must navigate a treacherous web of secrets, deception, and forces beyond comprehension. Five paths unfold before you—each leading to a different fate. Some lead to peace. Others… to something far darker.
But one truth remains buried in the ice.
Will you uncover it before it consumes you?
GAME FEATURES
• 22+ unique locations across the snowbound kingdom of Klodan
• 5 endings shaped by your choices and actions
• 2 romanceable characters with deep, intertwining stories
• A web of secrets and intrigue waiting to be unraveled
• Original atmospheric soundtrack enhancing the mystery
• A hidden storyline for those who dare to look deeper

title: Herb Seek Slash
description:
게임 정보
Game Story
An ordinary swordsman, Ethan, sets out to find an ordinary herb to save his sister, Elaine, on an extraordinary and perilous journey.
About the Game
This is a 2D top-down scrolling shoot'em up RPG. Take control of Ethan, slashing enemies with powerful sword waves across the main stages. Stay alert—getting pushed off-screen means death! Each stage features interactive challenges to test your skills.
“Advice” from the Witch
Death isn’t the end—the Witch will revive Ethan and give some “advice". Is the advice helpful? Well…It depends.

title: Bonsai '98
description:
게임 정보
Explore a selection of procedural bonsai trees and make them your own by pruning, twisting, and scraping away to craft your perfect little bonsai.
Decorate your pot, landscape, and tree with a vast selection of props, lights, and atmospheric effects. Place a cute statue, move it around, and light it up with a cozy lantern.
Take beautiful and cozy images with an advanced Photo Mode. Set up the picture perfect scene by changing the time of day, season, and weather. Customize the camera settings or choose from a selection of presets. Share your artwork with your friends and the community.

title: Bloodgrounds
description:
게임 정보
Lead your team of Gladiators in turn-based arena battles, recruiting, training, and sometimes sacrificing them for glory. But remember, your Gladiators are mortal - If they fall in battle, they are lost forever... though their legacy will live on.
As a noble heir, you'll manage your city by unlocking, constructing, and upgrading buildings that provide new services and mechanics to aid you on your bloody quest for vengeance.
You fought tooth and nail for survival, driven by a burning hatred and a thirst for justice. Now, as a wealthy patron and a gladiator trainer, you plot your revenge against the tyrannical Emperor who stole your freedom and murdered your father. But the path to redemption is fraught with peril, and you must navigate a treacherous world filled with deception and danger.
Recruit new allies and expand your gladiator team to climb the ranks of the brutal tournaments. Each victory brings you closer to the grand Capitol, where your ultimate target - the Emperor, lost in his madness - awaits on his throne.

title: DRINKRIME
description:
게임 정보
THE PLOT

You meet a talking liquor bottle, Jin, who asks you to help him interrogate and catch criminals.
One after the other, you measure yourself against a series of unique, non-human characters with something to hide.
Where will this strange adventure bring you? And what is Jin's ultimate goal?
THE GAMEPLAY

You will fight and capture the criminals by interrogating them with the help of Jin's powers, in something known as... the Jinterrogation.
You will be hearing their testimonies and looking for keywords that will complete their confessions.

Each criminal, deep inside, feels guilty about what they have done, and your job is to make them face this reality by asking them questions and examining their answers. By the time you're done with them, you probably won't feel much pity for them... But learning more about their psyche is part of the fun.

The four-color palette, low-res art, and chiptune music create the nostalgic look of something out of a retro game from the '90s.
None of the characters in DRINKRIME look like humans. It'll be a lot of fun conversing with animals, bottles, and the like.

title: Duskpunk
description:
게임 정보

Dredgeport is spiralling out of control. Gangs rule the slums, corruption trumps the law, and corpses of the war-dead are burned daily for fuel. You are an ex-soldier, mistaken for dead and shipped back to Dredgeport for processing. After a narrow escape, you find yourself alone in the guts of the city, with only two things to your name: your life and your sanity. Keeping both will prove a challenge.


Inspired by tabletop RPGs and narrative adventure games like Citizen Sleeper, Duskpunk finds a balance between challenge and freedom, tracking your health, energy and stress as you try to survive. Make lasting choices that determine the city’s fate. Develop skills to distinguish yourself in your chosen field of work. Earn a crust, explore the city, make alliances and escape your traumatic past.


Dredgeport plays host to characters with rich backstories and murky motivations. Some care for you or the city; others are in it for themselves, but will pay well. Choose your allies wisely. They will be part of your fate whether you like it or not.

title: Reggie
description:
게임 정보
Control Gravity Like Never Before in an Adventure Across Time in the New 2D Cartoon Platformer "Reggie, His Cousin, Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World"

Get ready to go on a mind-bending adventure in Reggie, His Cousin, Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World, the new 2D cartoon platformer developed by Degoma. Control the direction of gravity as you run, jump and explore in an outrageous time-traveling adventure as Reggie, an unlikely hero from the 16,000th century on a mission to save science and ultimately the entire universe.



Using the new Multi-Gravity Switch mechanic, the player can instantly flip the direction of gravity. This ability can be used freely without limitation to create jumping combos and unique paths through each level.

Players can choose to take on the game’s challenges solo, or team up with a friend in two different multiplayer modes! Play through the entire game with a friend in Dynamic Split-Screen Mode where the game screen will automatically split to give each player their own view of the action, or test your friendship in Synergy Mode where one player controls Reggie and the other player controls gravity.

Reggie travels through time and teams up with some unexpected allies to ensure that the scientific discoveries of the past remain intact to save the universe! The game has an epic story with a hilarious twist that must be seen to be believed and unfolds through nearly an hour of fully animated and voiced cutscenes.
autokwd: Reggie, His Cousin, Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World

title: NOT TACTICAL VR
description:
게임 정보
NOT TACTICAL VR is the single-player VR extraction game.
Use the special weapons collected across different maps to lighten the load of your missions.
Realistic combat experience
Complete missions on immersive battlefields using a variety of items based on real-world weapons and gear. Hold your gun with both hands, reload magazines, and pull the trigger. Use complex gun physics and injury and healing systems to escape the area.
Adapt and upgrade
Tailor and upgrade your arsenal to suit your playstyle from your home base with our modding system.

title: PaintMan Go！
description:
게임 정보
PaintMan GO! The main gameplay is TPS (Third-Person Shooting), where players control their characters and shoot to defeat other players. The game also incorporates the concept of ink, where players' ammo, health, and victory conditions are all related to ink. Players must consume their ammo to turn it into ink beans, which they can then use to absorb ink from the same colored dye areas to replenish their ammo.
In the same colored shadowed areas, life points will be restored, while in other colored shadowed areas, life points will gradually decrease. In normal mode, the winning and losing conditions are closely related to the shadowed areas. In short, taking many kills does not determine the outcome of the game, the size of the shadowed areas is the main criterion for determining the winner.
There are diverse and varied game maps in the game, each with a different playstyle. There are also various stylish game interface designs, allowing you to experience a cool and exciting battle. You can also choose from a variety of weapons in the changing weapon arsenal, and dress in cool and stylish outfits to stand out in the game!
Game Features
1. Cool and beautiful girls for you to choose and customize in the graffiti world;
2. Innovative Battle Royale, multiplayer real-time combat tournament;
3. A wide variety of weapons at your disposal, with endless strategies to discover!
4. The squid undergoes a colorful transformation, making it a fun and fascinating experience.
5. Shoot to be just, and spray the world at your command.

title: Kumori Village
description:
게임 정보
일본 깊은 산속의 마을에 길을 잃은 주인공.
그곳에는 사람을 공격하는 신비한 괴물 전설이 존재합니다.
주인공은 다양한 사람들과 협력하며 손전등과 테이저건을 들고 마을의 비밀을 풀어갑니다.
게임 특징:
랜덤으로 등장하는 아이템을 사용, 장비, 합성하며 게임을 진행하세요.
괴물에게 들키지 않도록 조심하며, 테이저건으로 공격하는 잠입 액션.
다양한 기믹을 활용한 던전 공략.

title: Hivaneph - The Legend of Elles
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Hivaneph – The Legend of Elles is an action game with RPG elements for Windows, focusing on narrative, layered exploration, and memorable, charismatic characters.

title: Hellaven
description:
게임 정보
Hellaven - This is a comedy visual novel about an angel imprisoned for life in a heavenly prison many years ago for selling drugs, but at one point his life changes and he is forced to go on an adventure to understand his past
Story
70 years ago, under certain circumstances, a white-haired angel appears in a heavenly prison, but in one day everything changes, and a girl comes to him with an offer of cooperation that is impossible to win, because it helps him free himself from life imprisonment and start a new life... The main thing is not to make past mistakes again, or to make sure that no one knows about it... And you will also have to see old acquaintances and meet many new friends in the human world.
Peculiarities
Duration: 3-4 hours
Full voice acting of the novel (so far only in Russian)
Full video scenes between transitions from locations
Several secret characters
Lots of cute, funny and spicy moments
Colorful, scenic art
Black humor
Dynamic action scenes with different outcome
Elements of Fanservice

title: Order of Renewal
description:
게임 정보
Chronicles of The Lands
Fog descends, plunging large areas into darkness for years, the sun is shining no brighter than the moon at night. Cold and poor harvest set in, causing starvation, disease, and mass pestilence. Man-eating animals and mythical creatures appear. Robbery and lawlessness reign. The migration of peoples begins, accompanied by many wars for survival.

title: Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop
description:
게임 정보


"Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop" is an adventure pixel art indie game with platformer and puzzle elements. You will play as Ponchee the bunny, who finds herself on an uninhabited planet called FlopHop. She has no memories except for current events, and her teacher and friend becomes her spacesuit Usagi-01, which tells her about the past, the future, and her destiny.


Gameplay
In the world of FlopHop, you will experience an exciting story told through quests and lore, during which you will be engaged in platforming gameplay: Ponchee must protect capsules with plants to eventually green the planet. You will also encounter many puzzles of various kinds that will stand in Ponchee's way as she learns about the history of the world, the universe, and her home planet.


Why is Ponchee alone on this planet? Who created Usagi-01? What happened to her home planet, and how did she end up on FlopHop? Ponchee will uncover all this together with our players! But this journey of discovery might not be so sweet – along the way, there will be many disappointments, moments of loneliness, contemplation, and reflection.

title: Nebelmer
description:
게임 정보
Use your surfing and flying stick to move through this world. As you progress in your journey, you will encounter new ways of moving, depending on your environment: jumping in a water geyser, bouncing off a jellyfish or flying in a bubble, this world will never cease to impress you.

title: CountDown
description:
게임 정보


Prepare for a thrilling subterranean adventure in CountDown, a casual pixel-art rogue-like that puts you in control of an omnipotent GLOVE GOD! Set in a charming underground village, devoid of light, you are the last bastion between your townsfolk and the encroaching hoards of mutated fauna. As night falls, your duty is to defend your people, by any means necessary. Will you rely on your "trained" soldiers, or will you unleash your god-like strength to turn the buildings, objects, and even citizens into projectiles to hurl at the oncoming threats?

Delve further into the depths of this chasm to gather resources from the flora which can further fortify your defenses. You'll encounter five unique enemy types in the demo, culminating in an epic boss battle! So don't wait, immerse yourself in the brief yet exhilarating experience of CountDown now!



For any issues or further inquiries about the game, please check out the community discord! There's also information posted here frequently about upcoming updates, as well as sneak peaks at future additions.

title: OOLO
description:
게임 정보
Set off into the lush fantasy world of OOLO, a modern take on the classic isometric adventure game! Embark on a non-linear journey across mysterious forests, haunted catacombs, magical factories, and more as you collect keys, solve puzzles, and discover upgrades that allow you to explore the map in new and exciting ways. Collect memories of previous adventurers to piece together the secrets of the Isle of Souls on your quest to rekindle the World Flame.
Explore a vast world with over 400 interconnected rooms!
Venture through dark forests, subterranean crypts, deadly swamps, and more.
Find new artifacts that change the way you move and interact with the world.

title: Edenfall
description:
게임 정보
"You're a glutton in love."

You're Eden, an eldritch thing. You're in love with your angel Ezekiel. But Ezekiel is enamoured by the slum she is damned to and the angels stagnating in it.

She wants the slum angels to fall. You would do anything to help her. But she wants you, eldritch thing you are, to swallow up the slum as she dallies with its angels. She wants you away from her, wants to love something that is not you.

And that just can't do.
