You must make Ezekiel love you. You must tell Ezekiel you love her. You may be a mass of vines and branches but you have a confession to make.

Somehow, you must find a way.

(Parchments, radios, songs… something pulsing alive. Ezekiel must hear it.)



Edenfall is a game about Eden and her angel Ezekiel. It's a darker take on the tale of Seraphim Slum: an obsessive and deranged romance between a destructive force of nature and an angel. But now, it's told from the perspective of the eldritch garden that loves her angel… a little too much.

You play as Eden as you...

Find out god's secrets from the slum's nooks and crannies.
Get to know try not to kill the fallen angels of the slum why the fuck does your angel love them.
Gather the pieces you need to confess your love for your angel she deserves you you're her one and only make her fall for you.

Edenfall is the next instalment to the Seraphim Slum universe. Playing the previous game is recommended, but not required to understand Edenfall.



















Please play at your own discretion.

title: Red Squad Reborn
description:
게임 정보
Red Squad Reborn is a third-person and first-person shooter combat game, plunging players into the heart of World War III's relentless conflict between NATO and Russian forces. Set in a near-future battleground torn apart by global tensions, the game immerses players in a gripping narrative-driven experience filled with adrenaline-pumping action and strategic gameplay.
Game Modes:
Team Deathmatch
Free For All
Search and Destroy (TBA)
Last Man Standing (TBA)
Domination (TBA)

title: HARD VOID
description:
게임 정보
HARD VOID is a 4X turn-based strategy game, in a space setting inspired by Lovecraft mythos.
Design your ships!
Highly customizable spaceship designs allow the selection of multiple ship systems: laser cannons, nuclear missiles, fusion reactors and much more :

Each spaceship is unique and procedurally generated by your requirements.
The procedural spaceship generator can produce up to 18 Trillion unique spaceships hulls!
No two spaceship designs will look the same.
Turn based strategic combat, command hundred of spaceships to battle.
Use multiple FTL travel methods to explore expand : Warp, Sub, Wormholes and more.
Colonize planets, asteroids and the space itself, also you can explore multiple dimensions, but beware,
you aren't only dealing with just other species, space travel unlocks horrors beyond comprehension that are waiting in the vast dark void and will trial your empire.

title: Idea Fix
description:
게임 정보
It's just another one of these days. You're stuck inside the Machine: clicking buttons, pushing levers, hoping there is an end to all this.

Explore the Machine, understand what makes it tick, become a gear in its perfect system. Or maybe you want to get out?

Mechanisms

Interact with the modules of the Machine in an intuitive and tactile way. Repair broken mechanisms, upgrade, unlock and buy new ones.

Exponential Growth

What Machine takes, it gives back with interest. Experiment with the opportunities it presents and find lucrative synergies.

Discover secrets

There's more to the Machine that meets the eye. Uncover its secrets, search for the hidden truth that lies beyond the cold exterior.

Relax

Take a break from your Sisyphean task. Tune out the ever present noise of the machinery and fill the silence with some chill music. Play a game or two, unwind but remember:

The Machine is waiting

title: Love's Time Cycle
description:
게임 정보
In a parallel universe, everything seems normal—until that fateful night. Suddenly, the beautiful women around you start falling for you as if you were the main character in a game. It’s a sweet trap that pulls you in, but just as you’re about to indulge in this newfound love, destiny delivers a cruel twist—the one you cherish most abruptly parts ways with you, leaving an endless void of regret.

In this world brimming with fantasy and challenges, you’ll embark on an emotional journey. As you explore diverse scenes and unlock hidden storylines, you’ll seek to rediscover lost love and rebuild the bonds with those who matter. Every choice you make will shape your relationships with the characters, leading to different endings.

Can you withstand the trials of time and find the true meaning of love in an endless cycle of life? In this sci-fi romance, you’ll experience warmth and healing, and witness the growth of the heart as you navigate through the intricacies of emotions.

Are you ready to embrace this emotional adventure? Join us now, explore this wondrous world, and find the love that’s meant for you!

title: Five Heads
description:
게임 정보
THE GAME
Five prisoners sit around a table, each with a card on their forehead—visible to everyone but themselves. In the first two rounds, they must figure out where they rank from lowest to highest, using logic, deduction, and psychology. In the final round, each player takes a leap of faith, guessing their exact card. Every guess is a clue, every mistake a setback—can you crack the code?
THE RUN
The Run is a high-stakes gauntlet of logic and teamwork. You and your team of five must survive a series of escalating challenges, ending each level in the correct order to advance. Before moving forward, you’ll vote on a power to aid your deduction and a poison that makes the next level even tougher. With each round growing more intense, will your team adapt, or will the increasing chaos break your streak?

title: Tungsten Moon
description:
게임 정보
텅스텐 문은 텅스텐 금속으로 만들어진 가상의 작은 달을 배경으로 한 우주선 시뮬레이션입니다. 달의 지름은 600km이며 표면 중력은 지구의 달과 비슷합니다. 여러분은 달의 다른 지점으로 이동할 수 있는 충분한 연료가 있는 작은 우주선을 타고 텅스텐 달의 표면에 놓이게 됩니다. 어떻게 그곳에 도착했나요? 우주선을 조종하는 방법을 모르시나요? 어떻게 집으로 돌아가나요? 백만 평방 킬로미터가 넘는 지형을 탐험하면서 우주선을 관리하고, 자원을 검색하고, 보급품을 찾고, 어떻게 이런 상황에 처하게 되었는지에 대한 본질적인 미스터리를 풀어나가면서 이러한 질문과 다른 질문들이 여러분의 조사를 기다리고 있습니다.
여러분은 외계 태양계의 낯선 달에 있지만, 우주선은 20세기 말 수십 년 전에 만들어진 것으로 보입니다. 온보드 컴퓨터는 몇 가지 정보와 자동화를 제공하지만 바지에 앉아서 비행하는 법을 배워야 합니다. 결국에는 우주선의 소프트웨어를 업그레이드하거나 수정하고 텅스텐 문 지도를 확장하고 그 주변 궤도에 진입 할 수도 있습니다.
우주선과 달의 물리학은 100% 실제와 동일합니다. 우주선 시스템과 센서는 1980년대 기술의 기능에 충실하게 모델링되어 디테일에 세심한 주의를 기울였습니다. 텅스텐 문에서는 안전 마진이 매우 얇으며 부주의한 부주의의 결과가 빠르게 다가옵니다.
특징
이 시뮬레이터는 게임 컨트롤러, 비행 시뮬레이터 조이스틱 및 VR을 염두에 두고 설계되었지만 키보드와 마우스만으로 플레이할 수 있습니다.
진정한 오픈 월드를 통해 텅스텐 문 구석구석을 탐험하세요.
우주선 물리학은 비행 중 우주선의 질량 감소를 충분히 고려하여 치올코프스키 로켓 방정식을 정확하고 정확하게 시뮬레이션합니다.
궤도 물리학은 RK4 런지-쿠타 4차 적분을 사용하여 모델링됩니다.
달의 자전, 행성 주위의 궤도, 행성의 태양 주위의 궤도는 물리적으로 정확한 시간 척도로 모델링됩니다.
게임을 시작하면 매 초마다 세계 시계가 실시간으로 진행됩니다. 시간이 지남에 따라 해가 지고 행성이 떠오르며 하늘의 모습이 계속 변합니다. 게임 시작 시 밝은 햇빛이 비추는 장소가 5시간 후에는 완전히 어둠에 잠길 수도 있습니다.
우주선 온보드 컴퓨터 소프트웨어는 한때 우주선 항공 전자 공학에 널리 사용되던 포스 컴퓨터 언어의 변형을 사용하여 사용자가 확장할 수 있습니다.

title: Ball King Jam
description:
게임 정보
볼 킹 잼은 어리석은 물리학 기반의 농구 게임입니다. 컴퓨터 상대와 대결하거나 다양한 환경과 코트에서 친구들을 이기는 재미를 즐기세요.

로컬 협동 플레이!
솔로로 플레이해보거나 친구들과 팀을 짜보세요. 최대 네 명까지 다양한 모드에서 함께 플레이할 수 있습니다. 기술과 우정을 시험하세요!
캐릭터 맞춤 설정!
캐릭터를 선호에 맞게 조정하고 맞춤 설정하세요! 도전과제를 완료하여 희귀한 의상을 언락하세요.

스탯을 강화할 수 있는 다양한 영구적이고 장비 가능한 아이템을 언락하세요.

title: Escape Velocity
description:
게임 정보
Blow your way out of a collapsing bomb factory in Escape Velocity, an explosive-based First Person Puzzler!

Use sticky bombs, cannons, and modular fuses to fling yourself (and other stuff) across the wreckage of your old workplace
Peek at your coworker's computers to find out more about their lives and the secrets that built the company
Explore an alien industrial park and find hidden collectibles and puzzles to unlock a new ending

title: The Tale of Azu
description:
게임 정보
특징
🌿 신화 세계로의 모험 - 현실과 신화를 넘나드는 신비로운 모험 속에서 색다른 세계를 탐험하세요
🐾 고양이의 액션 - 민첩한 움직임과 다채로운 스킬로 펼쳐지는 귀엽고 역동적인 액션
🐺 성장과 강화 - 아즈를 훈련하고 강화하여, 모험 속의 강력한 적들과 맞서세요
🎭 감동적인 스토리 - 잃어버린 누나 고양이를 향한 아즈의 가슴 따뜻한 여정을 함께하세요
줄거리
대한민국 어딘가, 아직 어린티를 완전히 벗지 못한 소년 고양이, 아즈가 살고 있다.
아즈는 세상에서 가장 행복한 고양이였다.
누나 고양이 모카가 곁을 떠나기 전까지는...
모카는 아즈의 둘도 없는 동료이자, 아즈에게 고양이로서 살아가는 법을 가르쳐준 스승이었다.
그런 모카가 떠난 이후, 아즈는 마음 어딘가가 빈 것만 같아 견딜 수가 없었다.
집사는 모카가 무지개 다리를 건너서 먼 곳으로 떠나버렸다고,
그래서 이제는 아즈가 자기를 지켜줘야 한다고 했다.
집사를 지키는 것 쯤이야 별 문제 없었지만, 아즈는 궁금해서 참을 수가 없었다.
항상 함께였던 모카가, 자신을 두고 가버린 무지개 다리란 곳은 어떤 곳일까.
그렇게 말도 없이 갑작스레 떠나버릴만큼, 신나는 곳일까.
자신도 그 곳에 가면 모카를 다시 만날 수 있을까…
궁금증은 모카와 함께했던 기억들이 옅어져갈수록, 그 자리를 대신하려는 듯이 강렬해졌다.
그래서 어느 날, 아즈는 모카를 찾아, 무지개 다리를 찾아 떠나기로 결심한다.
아즈가 알고 있는 가장 똑똑한 존재인 까마귀 아저씨조차도,
무지개 다리가 어디에 위치한지는 알지 못했다.
그래도 아즈는 무지개 다리를 찾아야만 했다. 내일 해가 뜨면 무작정 밖으로 나가보기로 했다.
어디로 갈까, 그런데 어떻게 밖에 나갈까. 모르겠다. 일단 든든하게 밥을 많이 먹어두자...
이런저런 생각을 하다 보니 어느새 아즈는 잠이 들고 만다.
그리고 눈을 떠보니, 낯선 대지 위였다.
당신은 집사로서 아즈가 이 모험을 완수하고, 모카와 재회할 수 있도록 도와야합니다.

title: 99 Managers Futsal Edition
description:
게임 정보
99 Managers Futsal Edition is an open-source sports management game, where you control every aspect of a Futsal team, from tactics to finances and much more.
Work in progress
The gameplay, user interface, and features will change before the final release.
Main responsibilities
Choose tactics and lineup for every game
Guide and change your players during the matches
Win the league and cups on a national and international level
Stay up to date by reading news and emails
Special features
Open Source under AGPL-3.0-or-later license
Fantasy teams and players that can be shared with the generation seed
Light/dark themes
More about 99 Managers
99 Managers will be a series of sports management games for different team sports. It is open source and also respects your privacy, because it has no trackers or similar privacy-invading software integrated. Being open source means, that you can see the source code of the game and see how it is made. Besides that, you are also able to suggest bug fixes, new features or create your own customized version of the game.
Made with Godot Engine 4 and much love.

title: BORZOI
description:
게임 정보
BORZOI is a first-person survival horror game where you are relentlessly hunted by a giant, demonic Borzoi dog.
You play as a park ranger assigned to Foster Park, a once-peaceful nature reserve turned nightmare. Tasked with locating a missing colleague, you quickly realize the park harbors dark secrets. As you explore its eerie trails and abandoned sites, the horrifying truth behind its cursed history comes to light.
RISING DREAD
Armed with only your wits, a flickering flashlight, and scarce resources, every decision matters as you navigate the dangers of Foster Park. Hunted by the relentless BORZOI and its reanimated minions, every sound and move you make could spell your doom. Survival demands careful strategy and quick thinking—actions have consequences.

title: The Four Money Bears: Berryville
description:
게임 정보
WELCOME TO BERRYVILLE!
OH NO! The town of Berryville is in dire need of help! This town of bears needs a crafty entrepreneur to help get them out of financial hardship and recover from a bad storm! Can you help? You will only have a short amount of time to get to financial success before you lose everything and the town goes to ruin.

Wait! Don’t worry! You have the help of the Four Money Bears! These cute financial partners will help guide you to learn to manage money. With the support of Spender, Saver, Investor and Giver bear you'll be able to make your financial dreams come true and maybe even learn something along the way!
BECOME THE BEST MERCHANT.
Can you become the biggest merchant in the world? You'll have to beat the competition and manage your money wisely.
Use all the town's resources at your disposal and unlock and craft tons of recipes.

title: Portilus - Civitas Sanguinis
description:
게임 정보
Step into the role of a gladiator thrust into a ruthless world where only the strongest endure. You begin as an unknown fighter, forced to prove your worth in the arena where every battle is a chance to rise or fall into oblivion. Your journey takes you from obscurity to legend, with your helm and blade becoming symbols of your legacy.

title: G-Switch 4: Creator
description:
게임 정보
High-speed single-button platformer where precise timing is key. Switch gravity through twisted levels that will put your reflexes to the test. Includes single player story mode and competitive local multiplayer for up to 8 players. Easily create and publish your own levels.
Key Features
Challenging single-player story mode with 8 levels
Competitive local multiplayer mode for up to 8 players
Create and share your own levels in the intuitive level editor
Thousands of single-player and multiplayer user levels to play
Full gamepad, keyboard and mouse support — mix and match in multiplayer
Seamless profile creation with Steam login (Discord merge available)

title: Bushcraft Survival
description:
게임 정보
BUSHCRAFT SURVIVAL
The world of Bushcraft Survival is truly procedural, and infinite. An endless boreal forest is generated each time a new session starts. Although you progress through gaining XP and spending skill tree points, each round of Bushcraft Survival is a new game - see how many days you can survive in spite of snow storms, injuries and unexpected setbacks.
In early development by a Canadian, solo developer.

title: Salary-Mon | Hiro Versus His Demons
description:
게임 정보
In the crowded streets of modern-day Tokyo, Hiro Kaiho is a middle-aged salaryman drowning in the monotony of his own existence. Trapped in a soul-crushing cycle of endless workdays, sleepless nights, and a life devoid of meaning. His office, a sterile, fluorescent-lit prison, is a microcosm of his despair. Each day, he toils under the oppressive shadow of his senior, a man who embodies everything Hiro despises: arrogance, greed, and a relentless need to dominate. Hiro’s hard work is routinely stolen, his ideas claimed as his senior’s own, and his spirit eroded by the constant belittlement and lack of recognition. Hiro hates his life, his job, and, most of all, himself. He is a man on the brink, teetering between resignation and rebellion.
But one fateful night, as Hiro stumbles into his tiny little apartment his life takes an unexpected turn. Exhausted and broken, he encounters his inner voice in the form of a spiritual guardian. Its presence is both comforting and unsettling, with a voice that seems to echo from the depths of his soul. It reveals to Hiro that his suffering is not merely the result of external forces but is deeply intertwined with his own inner demons—manifestations of his worst traits: self-doubt, anger, envy, and despair. These demons have taken root within him, feeding on his misery and perpetuating his cycle of suffering.

The guardian offers Hiro a choice: continue down his current path and succumb to his demons, or embark on a perilous journey of self-discovery and confrontation. It grants him the ability to see and battle these inner demons, warning him that the road ahead will be fraught with danger and emotional turmoil. Victory will empower him, but defeat could shatter what little remains of his spirit. Yet, the guardian assures him, even in failure, there is growth. "Whatever doesn’t kill you," it says, "will only make you stronger."

Thus begins Hiro’s journey, a haunting and atmospheric odyssey through the streets of his hometown and the labyrinthine corridors of his own psyche. The game’s world is presented in beautiful pixel graphics, displaying a melancholic vision of urban Japan, where the line between reality and the supernatural blurs. The soundtrack is a haunting blend of traditional Japanese instruments and ambient electronic tones which immerses the player in Hiro’s world, amplifying the sense of unease and introspection.

As Hiro explores his hometown, he encounters locations that serve as gateways to his inner struggles—a late night bar where his guilt simmers, a convenience store where his gluttony takes form, and a pachinko parlour where his repressed greed festers. Each location is meticulously designed to reflect the demon it houses, with environmental storytelling that deepens the player’s understanding of Hiro’s psyche. The atmosphere is thick with tension, as players never know when or where a demon might emerge, forcing Hiro to confront his fears head-on.

The core of the game lies in its turn-based strategic combat system, in a Poke-like style, but with a darker, more psychological twist. Hiro’s battles are not fought with physical weapons but with the tools of self-improvement: discipline, wisdom, generosity, and courage. Each demon represents a specific trait Hiro must overcome, and the battles are as much about strategy as they are about emotional growth. Players must carefully choose their actions, balancing offensive moves with defensive techniques in order to claim victory.

The combat system is deep and rewarding, with a variety of skills and abilities that can be unlocked as Hiro progresses. For example, Discipline allows Hiro to focus his energy and execute precise, powerful attacks, while Wisdom grants him the ability to predict and counter his opponent’s moves. Generosity enables Hiro to heal and support himself, reflecting his growing empathy and self-care. Each victory strengthens Hiro’s resolve and unlocks new abilities, but defeat is not the end. Losing a battle forces Hiro to retreat and reflect, often revealing new insights that make him stronger in subsequent encounters.

The demons themselves are grotesque yet symbolic, designed to reflect Hiro’s inner turmoil. A slender figure with a sinister face represents his fear, a dark shadowy mass embodies his depression. These battles are not just tests of skill but emotional crescendos, with each victory bringing Hiro closer to understanding and overcoming his flaws.

As Hiro defeats his demons, he begins to change for the better, building his self-esteem, courage and wisdom. The climax of the game sees Hiro finally confronting his senior, not in a physical battle but in a psychological showdown. This final confrontation is a culmination of everything Hiro has learned, a test of his newfound strength and self-worth.

Salary-Mon | Hiro vs His Demons is more than a game; it is an emotional and atmospheric experience that challenges players to reflect on their own struggles and triumphs. With its hauntingly nostalgic visuals, evocative soundtrack, and deeply strategic combat system, it offers a unique blend of introspection and action, inviting players to confront their own demons alongside Hiro. Will you guide Hiro to victory, or will his inner shadows consume him? The choice is yours

title: BannerBound
description:
게임 정보
당신의 군대를 이끌고, 3인칭 실시간 전투에서 제국을 건설하세요.
다양한 난이도의 역동적인 환경에서 전술적 능력을 시험하세요. 전략을 조정하고, 군대를 지휘하며, 승리를 쟁취하세요.
주요 특징:
⚔️ 군대 커스터마이징: 부대를 선택하고 색상을 변경하며, 자신만의 깃발을 디자인하세요.
⚔️ 영웅 커스터마이징: 영웅의 외형과 능력치를 수정하여 플레이 스타일에 맞게 조정하세요.

title: TreeTale
description:
게임 정보
트리테일은 무한한 커스터마이징과 전략적인 전투가 결합된 핵앤슬래시 RPG입니다.
플레이어는 다양한 패시브 트리와 대형 패시브 노드를 활용해 캐릭터를 자유롭게 빌드하고,
스킬 커스터마이징 시스템을 통해 나만의 전투 스타일을 완성할 수 있습니다.
주요특징:
다양한 패시브 노드를 조합해 원하는 방향으로 성장할 수 있습니다.

title: Souls End
description:
게임 정보
Souls End is a tactical auto-battler roguelike with inventory-management elements. You'll build an army from the ground up, combining units, items and relics to form unique synergistic builds as you battle your way through a world called Limbo.
Placement Strategy
Smart placement strategy of items and units is rewarded and can be the difference between a hard loss or an easy victory. Shape your army your way!
Huge Battles
Huge epic and chaotic battles unfold in Souls End. Will you build your army tall with only the strongest of units, or will you swarm your enemies with a horde of stinky goblins?

title: The Stairwell
description:
게임 정보
You are confined in a mysterious tower with the option to go upstairs or downstairs. Choose wisely to escape.
How to Play
If everything is normal, proceed upstairs.
If you notice an anomaly, go downstairs.
Do not miss too many anomalies.
You may access the roof through the emergency exit on floor 13.
Features
Dozens of unique anomalies
Choose a difficulty: normal, hard, or nightmare (must be unlocked by finishing hard difficulty)
Multiple endings based on your performance
Options
You can toggle the camera head bob and enable a reticle if you are prone to motion sickness. There is a FOV slider as well. You can also customize the graphics settings to play on a variety of PC hardware.

title: Swimmer Away
description:
게임 정보
In this dark and realistic ocean setting, you are the last hope. As a Coast Guard rescue swimmer, you'll face the ocean's fury and make the agonizing choices that define who lives and who dies. Search sinking vessels, battle monstrous waves, and endure the chilling grip of hypothermia. Your decisions have consequences, and every rescue is a gamble against the relentless sea.
Race against the chilling grip of hypothermia as you battle to find and rescue survivors from the raging depths. Every second counts in this desperate struggle against the elements!
Defying the elements, one wave at a time.

title: Oaths Against the Darkness
description:
게임 정보
They came from the seas. Long ships, affixed with hideous totems which hurt the eyes to look at. They brought destruction, hedonism, and pain to our sacred Land. At times, ominous whispers spoken from a thousand lips herald their coming. Other times, wails of the forsaken can be heard for miles. They threaten our Kingdom, our God, and our very way of life. They must be defeated.
In this medieval turn-based RPG set in a fantasy world based on 9th century England, lead your warband of honorable warriors to victory against the Nightmare Vikings.
Fight in tactical battles against Thralls, Warriors, Berserkers, and foes darker still.
Swear oaths of honor, which must be upheld in order to succeed in battle.
Upgrade and progress your troops with equipment, stat boosts, and perks.
Oaths Against the Darkness is designed to be a simple tactics game that doesn't take a ton of brain power to pick up and play, but can still offer deep tactical gameplay. 
If you'd like to interact with me and give feedback, there's a link to a discord I'll be using throughout the next few months!

게임 정보
∆ is an atmospheric first-person exploration game that takes you on a journey to the Beyond - a time/space singularity that can only be accessed through a hidden door inside a dream.

[Features]

Modern graphics and immersive sound design, powered by Unreal Engine 5.
Combines exploration, mind-bending puzzle and platforming elements.
A dreamy, ominous atmosphere.
Horror elements without relying on jump scares.
Approximately 2-3 hours of playtime.

[Story]

Declassified documents from a secret research project reveal that the dream realm is physical in nature and consists of multiple layers.
While regular and lucid dreams occur near the surface, deeper layers constitute a shared reality and can only be accessed by specially trained agents and mystics or by the means of deep space travel.
It is hypothesized that at the bottom of the labyrinth lies a passage to the Beyond - a time/space singularity transcendental to human understanding.

title: SANDRAIL RACE
description:
게임 정보
Sandrail Race 의 가장 큰 특징은 정해진 경로의 제한 없이 지형을 자유롭게 이동할 수 있다는 점입니다. 따라서 각 레이스에서 경사, 움푹 파인 곳, 모래 언덕, 점프대 등 장애물을 극복할지 우회하여 피할지 선택할 수 있으므로 어떤 경로가 더 나은 결과를 가져오는지 경험할 수 있습니다. 유일한 의무는 레이스의 웨이포인트 체크포인트를 건너뛰지 않는 것입니다.
SANDRAIL RACE 를 사용하면 더 많은 것을 즐길 수 있으며, 이러한 모든 기능 덕분에 게임에 더 몰입할 수 있습니다:
진동이있는 게임 패드 : 진동이있는 경우 게임 패드는 모든 서스펜션 점프, 히트, 드리프트 및 속도를 반영하여 진동합니다.
관절형 서스펜션: 샤프트, 충격 흡수 장치, 서스펜션 위시본 및 기타 메커니즘이 게임 플레이 중에 현실에서와 같이 점프할 때마다 표시되고 움직입니다.
구성 가능하고 눈에 보이는 메커니즘: 매우 상세한 3D 모델로 실제 배기, 카뷰레터, 쇼크 업소버, 휠, 페인트, 비닐을 구성할 수 있습니다.
매우 사실적인 3D 랜드스케이프: 사막, 모래 언덕, 거대한 모래 언덕, 계곡, 분화구 등...
롤러 : 모든 바퀴는 모래를 통과하는 길에 틀을 남깁니다.
사실적인 행동: 차량은 미끄러지고, 바퀴에서 모래와 먼지가 튀어나오고, 미끄러지고, 점프하고, 전복되는 등 자연스러운 동작을 합니다.
생생하고 사실적인 사운드: 서라운드 사운드 덕분에 힘과 속도, 근처에 다른 차량이 있는 위치를 느낄 수 있습니다.
이 모든 것이 고품질 3D 그래픽, 사운드, 핸들링으로 구현됩니다 !!!!

title: Sunshine Farm
description:
게임 정보
Manage an Abandoned Farm
Start in debt with an abandoned farm
Plant different seasonal crops, harvest, and sell them to customers or directly at the market
Expand and decorate the farm however you like!
Manage Your Shop

title: BRAINDEAD
description:
게임 정보
An arcade, round-based, zombie survival FPS experience playable by yourself or with up to 3 of your friends online! Dive your way through thousands of dead bodies as you kill them to collect money to upgrade yourself by purchasing weapons, perks, upgrades & much more.
A round-based zombie shooter inspired by classics
Play by yourself or up to 4-players online
A Complete Experience without Microtransactions/DLCs
8 Maps at Launch
50+ Weapons to use & Upgrade
Perks & PowerUps
Hidden Secrets (Easter Eggs)
Infinite Replayability
SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS
Designed for up to 4-players online, the difficulty of BRAINDEAD scales automatically to the number of survivors in the lobby. Make sure to join our Official Discord to find teammates with the same goals as you to play with!
CLASSIC ENEMIES
Zombies & hellhounds aren't the only ones haunting the world. Progress into the rounds to awaken powerful elites and defeat them with everything you have!
GUNS & PERKS
Customize your loadout by purchasing guns & perks during the match. You can also unlock the PowerPuncher3000 and upgrade your weapons to blast enemies' heads with special laser-type enhanced bullets.
POWERUPS
Randomly spawning from killing any enemy types, powerups empower every survivor with a major advantage for a limited time or can even grant a permanent reward such as a random perk or money!
LUCKY OR NOT?

title: Xalos: Collectible Card Game
description:
게임 정보
Players take command of aliens, robots and humans using their unique playstyles to destroy the opponent's energy core. Discover synergy between the cards to craft your combos. Players will face off against the enemy AI in singleplayer or other players in multiplayer mode.
Mechanics
There are 3 main races.
Aliens: Balanced offense and defense, excelling in neither. Effects allow for a board control based approach.
Robots: Typically boast higher defense. Effects have a focus on destruction and sustainability.
Humans: Higher attack power but low defense. Their effects boost each other, call for reinforcements and can equip weapons to become even stronger.

title: Carcerem
description:
게임 정보
Carcerem은 현실적인 1인칭 공포 게임입니다. 고대 미로의 음산한 복도로 발을 들여보세요. 미로의 깊은 곳에서 끊임없이 들려오는 죄수들의 비명과 소가 우는 듯한 소리가 전해진다고 합니다. 미로를 탐험하며 그 구조를 파악해 보세요. 점점 더 깊이 들어갈수록 위험은 커집니다.
주인공은 죄를 짓고 처벌로 미로에 갇힌 죄수입니다. 그곳에서 탈출한 사람은 사면을 받을 수 있다는 것을 알고 있으며, 미로 속의 어떤 위험에도 싸워서 자신의 자유를 쟁취하려고 합니다.
미로는 수백 년 전 죄수를 가두기 위해 지어진 돌로 된 감옥입니다. 지금까지 아무도 이곳에서 탈출한 적이 없습니다.
수천, 아니 수만 명의 죄수들이 수세기 동안 이 미로를 지나갔지만, 아무도 그 벽을 넘어 탈출하지 못했습니다.
게임플레이
퍼즐 해결. 미로 내에서 수백 년 전에 만들어진 독특한 퍼즐은 죄수가 그 구조를 세밀하게 분석해야 합니다. 그 어떤 누구도 퍼즐을 풀어 미로 밖으로 해결책을 전달한 적이 없습니다.
아이템과 힌트 탐색. 죄수에게 있어 미로를 탈출할 수 있는 아이템이나 힌트는 그 무엇보다 소중합니다. 미로를 풀 수 있는 아이템을 찾아보세요.
매 걸음이 위험. 미로 내에서 마음 놓을 수 없습니다. 각 구석마다 위험한 돌연변이나 함정이 숨어 있을 수 있습니다.

title: Cosmos point
description:
게임 정보
Control a squad of fighters in turn-based battles.
The game pays great attention to the details of equipment - armor, weapons, backpacks, a lot of grenades and other devices to achieve goals and do not forget the cartridges, without them the weapon will not shoot! Equip each fighter before landing on the mission, find equipment at locations or take it away from enemies. You can change any item of equipment right during the battle, you do not need to wait for a special moment or return to base.
The death of a fighter means the loss of equipment, some of which can be picked up by the rest of the squad if they have a place for it.
Take out as many resources as possible from missions to improve the space station, this will make it possible to store more items on the base, create the necessary items from other items and open new locations.

title: My Monsters
description:
게임 정보
My Monsters is an action-adventure VR game that with a 100% hand-painted art, creating a visually stunning world full of fantasy and surrealism. At the heart of the game is a deep narrative that explores humanity's greatest inner struggles—anxiety, fear, and loneliness. As a player, you are transported to Onirium, a dream-like realm where you meet Moti, a frightened little monster with no memory.
In My Monsters, you’re never alone. Team up with your inner monster, Moti, to face a variety of enemies, solve intricate puzzles, and overcome challenges in a shared journey. This partnership mechanic fosters a powerful connection with Moti, requiring empathy and courage to navigate obstacles and reveal fragments of a meaningful dreamlike tale. Every stage introduces new aspects of this bond, allowing players to experience moments of self-discovery and emotional depth.
Key Features:
⚔️ Combat Enemies: Engage in dynamic battles with your enemies.
🧩 Solve Puzzles: Test your critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
🌙 A Dream-like Tale: Uncover a touching, emotional narrative that delves into themes of self-reflection and growth.
🎨 100% Hand-Painted Art: Every visual element in the game is carefully crafted by hand, creating a beautiful, one-of-a-kind experience.
🤝 Team Up with Your Inner Monster: Build a meaningful relationship with Moti, using teamwork, empathy, and courage to overcome every challenge.
THE GAME IS CURRENTLY IN DEVELOPMENT, AND ITS CONTENT MAY CHANGE.

title: The Stare
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a haunting journey that challenges your sanity, where every level is a riddle waiting to be solved and every moment is filled with unsettling uncertainty.
You find yourself trapped in a dark, twisted dreamscape, an endless maze of dimly lit hallways and desolate rooms that seem to stretch on forever. Each step forward is hesitant, as the very environment feels alive, intent on confusing and disorienting you. The oppressive atmosphere weighs heavily, with shadows that flicker and dance, and every creak and whisper echoing from unseen corners fills you with unease. It's a world where even the air seems to pulse with dread, and the question is not only where you are but whether you can truly escape.
Inspired by the eerie mystery of the classic backrooms, this game turns every door into a gamble and every room into a potential nightmare. There is a constant, unshakable feeling that something is watching, always lurking just out of sight. The silence is broken only by the occasional distant sound—a reminder that you're not alone. The only way to survive is to stay calm, think clearly, and press forward, but each decision feels like a step deeper into the unknown. Beware, because you won’t always know where you're heading, and sometimes, turning back might not be an option.
Can you uncover the hidden secrets of these shifting levels before it’s too late? The dynamics here are elusive, and only those with sharp minds and steady nerves can hope to make it through unscathed.
Prepare yourself to lose your sense of direction, solve cryptic puzzles, and confront your deepest fears as you venture deeper into the unknown. This is more than a game; it is a test of your wits and courage, challenging you to unravel the mystery before you become a part of it forever.

title: Rusty the Rooster
description:
게임 정보
"Rusty the Rooster" is an engaging 2D pixel art platformer that invites players into a vibrant and adventurous world where courage and determination know no bounds. The protagonist, Rusty, is a courageous and spirited rooster on a noble quest to rescue his beloved girlfriend and their unborn chicks from imminent danger. Throughout this thrilling journey, players will navigate Rusty through beautifully crafted pixel art landscapes, each teeming with challenges and surprises.
The game is divided into three distinct worlds, each comprising eight meticulously designed levels. These worlds offer a variety of environments and themes, ensuring that players remain captivated as they progress through Rusty's epic saga. The levels are filled with intricate platforming sections and cunningly placed obstacles that will test players' timing and reflexes.
As Rusty traverses each level, he faces an array of formidable foes, including stealthy wolves, cunning foxes, and bomb-spitting pelicans that add a layer of strategic combat to the gameplay. Each enemy type requires a different approach, encouraging players to adapt and refine their tactics as they advance.
At the end of each world, Rusty must confront a powerful boss, a true test of skill and perseverance. These boss battles are designed to challenge players' mastery of the game's mechanics, requiring them to utilize all the skills and abilities they've honed throughout their journey.
"Rusty the Rooster" is more than just a platformer; it's a tale of bravery, love, and the unyielding spirit of a rooster determined to protect his family. With its charming pixel art graphics, engaging gameplay, and a heartwarming storyline, this game promises to deliver an unforgettable experience that will resonate with players of all ages. Whether you're a seasoned platformer enthusiast or a newcomer to the genre, "Rusty the Rooster" offers a delightful adventure filled with excitement and heart.

title: Abrasion
description:
게임 정보
You've been captured and enslaved by mysterious figures and tasked with retrieving a valuable resource from the depths of an ancient facility, but it may not be as abandoned as it looks... Will you accept your fate, or find a way to escape enslavement?

Abrasion is a first-person horror game set inside a brutal, skyless, megastructure. It's a difficult game that won't hold your hand, and takes around 90 minutes to complete. The world is filled with useful items, environmental storytelling, and many secrets, so exploration is heavily encouraged.
Features

A dynamic, stalking AI monster.
An interconnected world full of hidden passages and secret areas.
Diverse items and tools to help you progress.
Deep worldbuilding enhanced by intricately designed visuals and audio.
An unsettling story told through the game's environments.

title: Dream Runner
description:
게임 정보
Dream Runner is a heartwarming, 2D adventure platformer following Soma's story of self-reflection as he's forced to master newfound abilities in order to save his lost best friend. 
Hand-crafted pixel art world
Smooth, "flow-state", precision platforming focused on comboing abilities
Embark on a journey of self-reflection as you venture deeper into the Dreamscape to rescue a lost friend
Obtain and combine powerful abilities that transform how you navigate the world
Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and venture through hidden paths as you move through each biome
Put your platforming abilities to the test in a flurry of post-game challenge levels in Arcade Mode

title: SCP: Site Director
description:
게임 정보
Overview

Based on the popular SCP mythos, build your own SCP Foundation and protect the world against dangerous anomalies while navigating the administration of your sites and protecting your personnel. Orchestrate multiple sites and manage containment breaches with on-site security staff and specialized MTF (Mobile Task Force) Units.
The Latest And Greatest Technology



From your very own Facility Management System, on your cutting edge CRT monitor control your foundation and issue construction orders, change site procedures, and manage the research (and containment) of your SCPs.


Expand the staffing of your sites and ensure they live long enough to be promoted and improve their skill (increasing the funding you receive from research). Arm your Security Forces with various weapons and improve their armaments through technological progression. Defend against SCP Breaches, Test Subject Riots, and Raids. Create your own Mobile Task Force Units and designations that serve as specialized security that excel in a few activities.

title: L'Artisan Meurtrier
description:
게임 정보
L'Artisan Meurtrier is an old-school action-RPG built around a rich and demanding combat system. Take on fearsome enemies and thwart the most vicious traps in this varied and unforgiving universe.

Help the famous bounty hunter realize his most cherished wish: to return the Crossroads to its former glory! Rehabilitate old stores, unlock new buildings, participate in the reconstruction and evolution of this majestic city by growing your fame.

Technical and brutal combat: Live up to your reputation and use the full range of moves at your disposal to bring down your opponents!

Bloody executions: L'Artisan Meurtrier is a killer with a sense of panache. Revel in the blood of your victims, thanks to the increasingly bloody kill animations!

Memorable bosses: Prepare to take on the worst scoundrels and creatures in epic battles.

Mysteries and secrets to be revealed: The world of the Crossroads is vast, rich and enigmatic - will you take the time to explore every corner ?

Colorful characters and humorous dialogues serve a story full of twists and turns that follows the plot of the original work!

title: Terminal
description:
게임 정보
You wake up with nothing but the green light of a 90s computer. All there is on the screen is an investing program and a quota. You must escape.
Terminal is a hacking game where you are an AI and have to solve puzzles to escape. In the format of a company's file system, you crack passwords, take notes, find out the truth, but most importantly: escape.
Included is a level editor where you can play community made games and share your own.
Game Features
Evolving Investing Simulation
Expansive computer system
Solving puzzles
Cracking passwords
Lots of hacking
Find secret codes
Many minigames (like minesweeper!)
Create and share your own levels
Play community made levels

title: ENTWINE
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a rich narrative, with meticulously detailed environments, horrific monsters, intricate, challenging puzzles and slow-burn psychological horror inspired by the classics. 
GAMEPLAY
Play as Lucas Hale, a retired police officer, as you find yourself picking up a paranormal investigation job. You've been told to explore the house of the missing CEO of PUPPETEERS Playplace, James Anderson. But when you step in to what used to be his house, you realize it is not what you signed up for.
A fresh take on psychological horror. Forget a fetch quest filled P.T. clone. ENTWINE will keep you on the edge of your seat throughout your entire playthrough.
Solve various puzzles, explore through a forest, house, underground complex, police station and more. Slowly uncover the heartwrenching story behind Lucas Hale and dive deeper into the abandoned estate before being hunted down by the puppet himself.

title: Dome RPG
description:
게임 정보

Dome RPG is a role playing game inspired by video games from the 80s and 90s.
Meet lots of new friends and foes while you explore a strange world with unique visuals.
What kind of mysteries will you uncover during your trip?


Play as Taro, a mute boy who once appeared in this world!


Meet lots of new friends during your adventure!


Explore a weird and diverse world with many secrets to uncover!


Battle against a lot of different enemies and bosses during your trip!


Follow a backstory of how this world came to be!


Salvage the world!

title: Zerra's Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Zerra's Adventure is a classic turn-based RPG with no random encounters. Explore diverse areas, collect items and treasures to improve your team and defeat the strangest enemies. Level up, learn new attacks, and meet quirky characters on your adventure!




Explore diverse landscapes, from frog-filled forests to infernal deserts and dark caves infested with spiders. Face dangers like spikes, fireballs, and shots as you search for treasures, weapons, and other items that will aid you in your adventure, even in a gym filled with insane bodybuilders.




, from small turtles and pigs to armed rabbits and final bosses such as giant frogs and penguins. Utilize your skill and strategy to overcome their signature attacks and progress through the game.




during your adventure and find secret bonuses that will challenge you with short minigames that reward your skill with special and unique items.




by gaining experience and leveling up. Discover new attacks and passive abilities that offer different benefits to the team. Customize each character with weapons and accessories found during your adventure, choosing between increasing attack, defense, or special abilities according to your gameplay style. The choice is yours!

title: Mythical Whalers
description:
게임 정보
Assemble your crew and set sail across a perilous procedurally generated world. Traverse eight distinct biomes, each teeming with bizarre creatures and factions locked in a desperate struggle for survival.

Hunt deadly sea beasts for precious resources and barter with nearby factions for vital equipment and supplies.

Command your crew as they evolve, their traits shifting for better or worse as the voyage unfolds. Seek out and recruit new members from the mythical races dwelling upon the myriad islands you explore.

Enhance your crew with potent elixirs brewed from the coveted gem horns of the whales they slay, bestowing upon them formidable abilities.

Forge alliances or wage war with the crews of rival factions. But heed this warning: your choices are remembered, and every decision bears a consequence.

title: Backpacker Guild
description:
게임 정보


Backpacker Guild에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 사악한 몬스터들을 토벌하기 위해 용병을 고용하고 강력한 장비를 제작해서 용병들의 가방을 꾸려주세요. 강한 용병은 여러분들의 손으로 만들어집니다.
주요특징


용병들을 고용하고 그들의 짐을 자유롭게 싸주자
용병들의 가방에 아이템을 배치해주세요. 여러분이 어떻게 아이템을 배치하는지에따라 용병들이 강해지거나, 약해지거나, 이상해질수도 있습니다.



마력지도에는 다양한 보너스와 아이템 제작 레시피가 숨겨져 있습니다.
마나석을 사용하여 레시피와 보너스들을 획득해보세요.



몬스터는 버릴게 없는 훌륭한 자원입니다.
몬스터에게 각종 재료를 얻어 장비를 제작하세요.



길드를 찾아온 손님들은 아이템 제작부터 몬스터 토벌까지 다양한 의뢰를 맡깁니다.
성실하게 의뢰를 수행하여 풍성한 보상을 획득하고 명성을 쌓아보세요.


가방을 싸주었다면 이제 용병들을 믿고 전투를 지켜보세요.
용병들이 전투에서 승리하고 다양한 전리품을 가지고 길드로 복귀할 것입니다.

title: Bots & Mods
description:
게임 정보
“Come down to Bots & Mods. The first stop for all your robotics needs.”

Take over and run a workshop in the city of Danopolis. Build components to craft custom designed robots. Sell them or keep them to help manage your busy workshop. Keep an eye on market fluctuations and don't forget to meet the locals and get to know their stories.
Gather your resources below the city or in the augmented reality around you, to be able to craft what you need.
Join the discord community:
Features:

Design and craft custom robots to meet your or the customers specific needs. Not all robots will be the same. Pick and choose components and assemble unique robots.

title: Bonville Bandit
description:
게임 정보
Break in by night, live by day!
In this pixel-art stealth game, you take the role of a cunning thief—or at least, that's what some might call you. Break into houses, evade the security and steal precious items. Navigate your way around the village until you have collected enough wealth and wisdom, all while unlocking different areas, discovering new houses and meeting new characters along the way!
During the night, loot the neighborhood!
Break into houses, outsmart guards, and stay one step ahead of security at all costs. Use a variety of potions and clever gadgets to navigate traps and slip past even the toughest defenses. Collect valuable items and make your daring escape before you get noticed!
During the day, embrace the village life!
Get to know the villagers, explore the market, join the excitement of the carnival, and much more. Wander through the surrounding wilderness to uncover its hidden beauty and secrets. Trade and sell your loot to earn resources and unlock new areas to explore.
With so much to do, every day is a chance to prepare for the challenges ahead and ensure you're ready for your next daring heist under the cover of night!

title: Watch Out For Goblins!
description:
게임 정보
            WOFG! blends motion capture animations with real time physics. According to top goblin scientists, the simulation is 100% accurate when compared to real-world goblin physics.
Experience a ragdoll controller like no other! Take precise control of your goblin on land and while airborne! Aim your feet at the ground for a clean landing!
There is no feeling more heartwarming than throwing your friends down a mountain, and knowing they would do the same for you. Grab your best bud and experience WOFG! In splitscreen. Double the Goblins? Half the problems.

title: Uncursed
description:
게임 정보
Uncursed is a co-op pirate adventure where you rescue lost souls, loot shiny treasures, items and uncover secrets so dark even your torch might quit. Survive deadly dungeons, face unpredictable weather, and the occasional chaos caused by your crewmates—all while gathering loot to buy a ship, buy cool gear, and maybe splurge on a new hat.
Your crew's goal is to buy and repair a ship to reach more distant waters and shed light on the threatening secret.
Explore the surrounding islands alone or in a team, collect valuable objects and the souls attached to them. Every day you can take part in a new adventure in the procedurally generated dungeon, which rewards you with valuable treasures if you survive its terrifying creatures and cunning traps.
Many mysteries and social experiences await you at sea and on the islands; from uncovering dark secrets to sharing intimate shit taking at sunset.

title: Rune Defender: Dwarven Defense
description:
게임 정보
Use the day to construct powerful towers and walls to fortify your stronghold. But as night falls, you face hordes of enemies hell-bent on breaching your defenses.
Can you withstand the onslaught?
Prepare your Defenses

Build the ultimate fortress, never to be conquered


Upgrade your defenses to emerge victorious
Survive the night
After nightfall, your fortress will be put to the test. Hordes of undead will come at your walls.


You can use various magical abilities to support your towers against the enemy

title: Mad King Redemption
description:
게임 정보
왕국은 미친 왕에게 함락되었고, 왕은 금지된 마법을 사용해 여왕을 소생시키려 했어요. 하지만 삶과 죽음의 힘이 너무 커서 감당할 수 없었고, 그 결과 왕은 이성을 잃었습니다. 신중하게 버튼을 눌러 적 무리를 처치하세요! 싸움꾼의 역할에 충실하면서 도적의 전략적인 요소가 더해져 왕국의 운명이 여러분의 어깨 위에 놓여 있습니다. 전투 기술, 유물 및 영웅을 잠금 해제하려면 매번 실행 후 영웅의 형제단을 업그레이드하세요.
BEAT'EM'UP 게임플레이
사랑받는 고전 게임에서 영감을 얻어, 저희는 구식 컨트롤과 레트로 감성을 혁신적인 3D 메커니즘과 결합한 비뎀업 경험을 만들었습니다. 4명의 플레이 가능한 캐릭터는 각각 고유한 전투 스타일, 게임플레이에 영향을 주는 커스터마이징 가능한 능력치, 자세한 배경 스토리를 가지고 있습니다. 모든 영웅은 죄를 지었습니다. 그들도 구원이 필요합니다.
로그 엘리트 진행
매번 실행할 때마다 새로운 영웅, 공격 기술, 유물을 잠금 해제하고, 금지된 회랑 깊은 곳으로 모험을 떠나 광기의 왕을 찾아 그의 광기에서 벗어날 수 있도록 하세요. 모든 달리기는 무작위 요소로 구성되어 있습니다. 모든 영웅이 죽거나 미친 왕이 쓰러질 때까지 미친 왕에게 가해진 모든 피해는 같은 런에서 지속되며, 단결된 영웅 형제단만이 미친 왕을 물리칠 수 있습니다. 새로 실행할 때마다 모든 영웅이 다시 태어나지만 미친 왕도 완전한 생명력을 회복합니다.
tag: 앞서 해보기,2D 격투,픽셀 그래픽,핵 앤 슬래시,2D

title: Tall Trails
description:
게임 정보
Tall Trails is a chill exploration game. You play as Alp, an indestructible little golem on a quest to find his purpose. With your trusty Rocket Boot strapped to your back, you'll summit towering peaks, scale mysterious megastructures, and meet strange little guys!
Blast off with your Rocket Boot! Load items into your Rocket Boot and blast them out to send yourself flying skywards! Each item has unique powers: jet pack with hot peppers, hover across gaps with whirligigs, swing on webs with spiders, and much more!
Explore a weird & wonderful world! With your Rocket Boot, no peak is too high or valley too low! Explore 5 unique biomes, each full of new and exciting ways to move and explore.
Find your purpose in life! Every golem has a purpose… but not you? What's up with that??
Customize your look & build! Find & upgrade powerful badges to increase your platforming abilities to unreasonable levels! Or just focus on collecting hats!
Meet strange little guys! This game is loaded with little dudes of the highest quality!! You will not find better little dudes anywhere else!!

title: Emblems: Sunless Vow
description:
게임 정보
Help three unlikely friends destroy the void—before they destroy each other!
New allies Weapon, Spirit, and Magic have some big tasks ahead of them. Recover their stolen memories, defeat an ancient demon or two, and escape from the dreaded void between worlds... Assuming they can stop arguing first, that is.
As stakes rise, and memories slowly return, will their once-forgotten feelings break them?
Or bring them closer?

title: The Warrior
description:
게임 정보
The Warrior is a short action/adventure platformer where protagonist, story and mechanics are constantly changing. Control legendary warriors, giant worms, greedy kings and lazy demons, each with their own purpose.
Control multiple characters

Each character wants to be the protagonist of their own adventure. You will be put in the shoes of each one and discover that the distinction between the story's villain and hero is merely a matter of perspective.
Solve puzzles

In addition to different skills, each character faces unique difficulties and challenges. Overcoming them requires thinking outside the box.
Explore

The world is filled with details and secrets. Take the opportunity to explore, encounter new creatures, and decipher ancient runes.

In the depths, unimaginably colossal and terrifying creatures await. Overcoming them is no easy task.

You can piece together the story through dialogue and ancient buildings from the perspective of each character. Can you uncover the truth?

title: Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons
description:
게임 정보
위도 76: 온킬론의 땅 는 1900-1902년의 실제 북극 탐험 이야기에 영감을 받은 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다. 이 게임은 북극 해양에 숨겨진 환상의 섬 전설을 증명하려는 용감한 탐험자들의 이야기를 들려줍니다.


그랩핑 훅을 사용하고, 집라인을 타고, 절벽을 오르며, 북극 해양의 얼어붙은 광야에 숨겨진 환상의 섬을 탐험하고 그 비밀을 밝혀내세요.



이 땅은 보기보다 간단하지 않습니다. 예상치 못한 도전들이 곳곳에 숨어 있습니다.



귀여운 원숭이로 전환하여 퍼즐을 풀고, 숨겨진 경로를 탐색하며, 털복숭이 친구를 꾸밀 수 있는 스타일리시한 모자를 모으세요.



1900년의 신비로운 실제 탐험에서 영감을 받은 이야기 속으로 빠져보세요. 몰입감 있는 컷신, 예상치 못한 반전, 잊을 수 없는 캐릭터들과 함께 비밀을 풀어보세요.


북극 탐험가 바론 마그누스는 존재한다고 믿는 사람이 없는 땅을 찾기 위해 탐험대를 결성합니다. 탐험가들은 맘모스, 코뿔소, 그리고 신화 속 생물들이 사는 세계를 발견하면서 예상보다 더 많은 것을 알게 됩니다.
그 신비로운 땅은 탐험자들을 환영하지만, 그 앞에는 위험이 도사리고 있습니다. 그들의 모든 움직임을 추적하는 사냥꾼들과 그림자 속에 숨어 있는 다른 무서운 괴물들이 있습니다...

게임은 2025년에 출시 예정 – !
최신 정보, 토론, 그리고 더 많은 내용을 위해 커뮤니티에 참여하세요!
autokwd: Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons,위도 76: 온킬론의 땅

title: Rogue Mech
description:
게임 정보
When the rogue planet soared right through our solar system, scientists predicted two possible outcomes - either earth would be destroyed, or turn into a hellhole.
Well, I guess we were lucky.

Rogue Mech is an isometric Mecha game where you'll do a lot more than fight other mechs - You trade, hack, dig, plant, loot, upgrade, sneak, free prisoners, and maybe chuckle about the dark humor. If you like games that don't take themselves and their scenario too serious while still providing a good, deep challenge - hit that wishlist button.


Find, loot, repair and upgrade sweet stuff for your modular, fusion-powered weapons platform called Phoenix.



Of course, you can also strategically remove those extras from enemy Phoenix'...





No one has a clue if the situation outside would be any better. But Tasha knows that her family will be there - if they survived.



Not everyone is an enemy, and you will not get far if you shoot everything on sight. There are defectors just like you roaming the land. While they are not always friendly, they might have advice, something to trade, or even assist you in an assault on a militia outpost.








We will soon run out of canned food and bottled water. Our only chance is to somehow grow something edible in a dead world. But one cannot do it alone. So set up a cozy home base, find allies among the wasteland dwellers, protect them and watch them harvest your crops.



As a nice side effect, they will help you maintaining your Phoenix. If you can find some raw materials. And machinery. And fuel to operate them. There is a lot to do.

title: Heroes Suck
description:
게임 정보
Defend your dungeon against an onslaught of heroes in this physics-enabled tower defense. Build your dungeon tile by tile, placing deadly traps to protect your loot. Upgrade your defenses and powers as you amass wealth and unleash havoc on these cheese wheel-stealing 'heroes'.
Build your dungeon, your way. Place tile by tile, and fill your dungeon with deadly traps to keep the pesky heroes away from your loot. As you level up, you gain the ability to place more and more tiles to further grow your dungeon.
Unleash havoc with your traps. With physics enabled, send heroes flying around - or even play bowling with their bodies! You can even light them on fire or electrocute them. What fun!

title: The Mirror Dimension
description:
게임 정보
The Mirror Dimension is a Co-Op psychological thriller and horror game that can be played with 1 to 4 players. In the game, players will investigate paranormal activities in a visited house, attempting to solve events occurring in different dimensions. By confronting and eliminating the spiritual entities you encounter, you'll strive to identify the problem in your own dimension. Are you ready to explore different dimensions and uncover their mysteries?
Everything around you is filled with surprises that can distract you. As you interact with your environment, you might unknowingly transition to a different dimension. Everything can change at any moment; observe your surroundings carefully and find a way to survive by uncovering the secrets of the dimensions!
Each dimension has its own unique plotlines. Explore the dimensions, uncover their secrets, and use this knowledge to survive! Do you think you can make it through?

title: The Greys: Human Abductions
description:
게임 정보
The Greys: Human Abductions에서 당신은 실종되어 죽은 것으로 추정된 동생의 신비한 집을 물려받은 남자의 입장에 서게 됩니다. 동생의 집을 탐험하면서, 극비 문서, 녹음, 외계인과의 만남에 대한 불안한 증거로 가득 찬 숨겨진 다락방을 발견합니다. 미스터리에 더 깊이 파고들수록 동생과 같은 공포, 이상한 소리, 설명할 수 없는 사건, 심지어 외계인 납치의 무서운 가능성까지 경험하게 됩니다. 동생의 실종 뒤에 숨은 진실을 발견할 것인가, 아니면 알려지지 않은 세력의 다음 희생자가 될 것인가?

특징 및 게임플레이:

- 서랍을 열고, 문서를 집어 들고 검사하고, 녹음을 재생하고, 조명, 문, 숨겨진 수납공간과 상호작용하세요.

- 열쇠를 찾고, 코드를 해독하고, 미스터리한 상자를 여는 복잡한 퍼즐을 풀어보세요.

- 이상한 소음, 발소리, 속삭임, 으스스한 외계인 현상 등 무시무시한 소리를 경험해 보세요. 오디오 디자인은 게임의 핵심 요소로, 환경을 탐험하고 상호작용할 때 공포와 두려움을 증폭시킵니다.

- 설명할 수 없는 이벤트가 발생하고, 불빛이 깜빡이고, 눈가에 그림자가 움직입니다. 이상한 이벤트가 확대되기 시작하면 숨을 곳을 찾아야 합니다.

- 이야기를 더 깊이 파고들수록 공포는 더욱 커집니다. 더 많은 것을 알아낼수록 위험은 더욱 현실적으로 다가옵니다.

- 게임에는 여러 엔딩이 있으며, 게임 내내 여러분의 선택이 엔딩에 영향을 미칩니다.

title: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens
description:
게임 정보
Merge adorable dessert-shaped cats to create larger felines, all the way up to the ultimate cat-ermelon! Collect points to unlock exciting power-ups and customize your gameplay. Play casually for fun or take on challenges as you navigate obstacles and changing weather conditions.
autokwd: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens

title: Pick Me Up
description:
게임 정보
석기 시대 식민지 시뮬레이션
석기 시대의 당신만의 정착지를 세우고 식민지를 건설하세요! 정착민들을 이끌고 새로운 땅을 개척하며 자원을 모으고 건물을 세워 자급자족이 가능한 안전한 마을을 만들어 나가세요. 당신의 전략적 선택이 정착지의 생존과 번영을 결정짓고, 부족을 확장해 가며 점차 강력한 식민지로 키워 갈 것입니다.

title: 朱鴉～AKEGARASU～ Journey to the Underworld
description:
게임 정보
A Fallen Friendship, a Stolen Love—
To rescue his beloved, taken by a trusted friend, a vengeful shadow pierces the darkness in a high-speed, exhilarating running action game.
Cut Through Enemy Lines with "Gale Rush" !
Experience the ultimate thrill with simple controls: just lock on and strike! Become a whirlwind, wielding lightning-fast sword techniques to carve through layers of fearsome foes.
Time is Running Out!
When the moon sinks and the sun rises, the forbidden ritual "Akegarasu" will make it all too late. With only one minute until dawn, every slash with the secret technique "Chronomancy" extends the night. Fight against the clock until the very last second!
autokwd: 朱鴉～AKEGARASU～ Journey to the Underworld

title: Outer Express
description:
게임 정보
What is the game about:
After a cataclysmic event rendered Earth uninhabitable, humanity was forced to flee their home planet in search of a new beginning. After centuries of interstellar travel, they discovered several planets suitable for colonization. However, these new worlds were barren and resource-poor, forcing humanity to resort to scavenging for survival. As a Star Scavenger, you are at the forefront of this struggle, venturing into the unknown to secure the resources necessary for humanity's survival.
Core Gameplay:
Exploration: Discover new planets and uncover hidden resources.
Collection: Gather a variety of scrap to complete your objectives.
Combat: Fight off dangerous alien creatures to protect yourself and your team.
Survival: Adapt to harsh environments and overcome numerous challenges.
Key Features:
Time is of the Essence: Each planet has its own unique time dilation, forcing you to work swiftly and efficiently.

title: Galactic Wargames
description:
게임 정보
GalacticWargames – Ready to Conquer the Galaxy? 🌌🚀
Welcome to GalacticWargames, an epic 4X space strategy game where alliances, advanced technology, and interstellar battles collide in an endless war for galactic supremacy! Build your fleet, expand your bases, explore the universe, and crush your enemies with surgical strikes that will leave them trembling!
Choose Your Civilization 🌍👽
Will you be a mighty Terrakin, a militarized human ready to conquer the galaxy? Or perhaps a Wreck, a terrifying mix of zombie and machine, unleashing destruction with your all-powerful Destroyer? Maybe you’ll rise as an Ascend, a hyper-evolved AI feared for its unmatched technology and indestructible defenses. Each civilization has its strengths, but only one can reign supreme!
Build, Customize, Dominate 🛠️💥
In GalacticWargames, every decision matters! Expand your space base, customize your ships with unique skins and equipment, and form powerful alliances to crush your foes. This won't be an easy ride! Only the best strategies will lead you to victory. Prove you're the ultimate commander!
Face the Community in Galactic PVP 🔥⚔️
Online PVP battles are at the heart of the game. Engage in epic space combat against players from around the world, forge powerful alliances, and participate in galactic wars of unmatched intensity. The survival of your civilization rests on your mastery of interstellar battles!
Tech, Fleet, and Tactics 🧠🔧
Explore a massive tech tree, unlock advanced warships, develop new weapons, and craft your strategies to surprise and dominate your opponents. Super-capital class ships are the ultimate weapon, but they require significant resources and precise tactics to build and deploy.
No Pay-to-Win, Just Fun and Skill ⚖️🎮
Tired of games where you have to pay to win? So are we. In GalacticWargames, victory comes down to your skills and strategy alone. Whether you're playing on mobile or Steam, we want you to feel the pride of crushing your enemies with well-executed tactics. This game is built for true strategists, not wallets.

title: Brawlers of the West: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
Brawlers of the West: Prologue is a western realistic physics-based fighting game. This is the limited version of the game. You can play the first boss of the game. Some game modes like multiplayer is not available in this prologue.
Physics Based Combat
You can throw different punches and kicks or you can grapple your opponent in combat. You can also grab glass bottles and swing or throw them to your enemies. Characters have active physics and ragdoll system all the time so all the characters reacts to hits realistically, you can even hit the pianist or the bartender. Damage is depend on physics as well so timing your punches and positioning your character is very important. You can also block your opponent's attacks but if you can't position your character well a punch can hit you. Use the environment to your advantage is also important since there are lots of bottles chairs and table in the saloon.
Different Characters
Every character has different stats and this will change your gameplay. For example you can pick a character with high stamina and punch your opponents all the time or you can play with a character that can punch hard. In this prologue some characters is not available to play.

title: Train World Driver
description:
게임 정보
Train World Driver에서 운전석에 앉아보세요!
편안하고 신나는 기차 운전 경험을 즐겨보세요! Train World Driver에서 여러분은 기관사가 되어 증기의 황금기부터 최첨단 기관차까지 다양한 기관차를 조종합니다. 번잡한 도시를 가로질러 승객을 태우든, 경치 좋은 풍경을 가로질러 화물을 실어나르든, 모든 여정은 새로운 모험입니다.
특징
🚂 기관차 함대
19세기의 상징적인 증기 기관차부터 오늘날의 고속철도의 경이로움까지 수십 개의 기차를 운전하세요.
📦 다양한 미션
빡빡한 배달 일정부터 경치 좋은 여가 노선까지 다양하고 재미있고 도전적인 미션을 완료하세요.
🌍 동적 미션 생성기
Train World 플레이어와 소통하세요! Train World 플레이어는 저장 파일을 사용하여 철도 네트워크를 기반으로 미션을 생성하고 공유하여 무한한 게임 플레이 가능성을 만들 수 있습니다.
🎮 배우기 쉬운 컨트롤
모든 사람을 위해 설계된 Train World Driver는 간단하게 유지합니다. 속도, 타이밍 및 정밀도를 관리하여 성공하세요.
🗺️ 숨 막힐 듯한 환경
다양하고 몰입감 넘치는 풍경을 여행하며 기차 운전의 기술을 마스터하세요.
Train World Driver는 기차 애호가와 느긋하고 매력적인 경험을 찾는 캐주얼 게이머 모두에게 적합합니다. 오늘 기차 운전사가 되는 즐거움을 발견하세요!

title: Blue
description:
게임 정보
Blue is a 2D puzzle game where you play “Blue”, a little blue cube who wants to change his world.
You accompany him on his journey, guiding him through a series of progressively more difficult levels.
Along the way, you're likely to meet other characters... who knows what links they may have with our little blue cube.
Bleu's progress in this world will perhaps enable it to evolve into something better.
The game takes the form of a series of puzzles, the aim of which is to “slide Bleu” to an objective. However, some of the levels depart completely from the original gameplay.
The difficulty increases progressively, but finishing the game is a real challenge. Hundreds of levels, boss levels and a wide variety of puzzles await you!
Can you rise to the challenge?

title: Purple Tears. Part I: Everybody dies in the end
description:
게임 정보
In the aftermath of the Cataclysm, a small Eastern European town finds itself trapped within the confines of an enigmatic purple cylinder. Its boundaries are impenetrable, leaving the fate of the world beyond a haunting mystery. Also, the laws of physics have been upended — distant planets now linger in the skies.
Yet, life endures. The townspeople, resigned to their isolation, have adapted to a fragile existence, striving to live ordinary lives beneath the ever-present shadow of uncertainty.
But for five schoolmates, the humdrum of everyday life is no longer enough. Driven by a desire to uncover the fragmented rumors from the internet and the "urban legends," they decide to embark on a hike to abandoned research institute RADIOSVET. There, it is said, a signal was received — a transmission from the other side.
autokwd: Purple Tears. Part I: Everybody dies in the end

title: Dark of the Depths
description:
게임 정보
A first-person realistic underwater explorer. Plunge into the real world horror of the ocean's dark depths. As you head down into the trench, the dark of the abyss surrounds you.
Dark of the Depths uses realistic visuals to put you in the pitch-black atmosphere of the deepest oceans. Use your torch to guide you through the darkness, avoiding violent fish and experience our fears of what lies beneath.
Encounter creatures such as Basking sharks and Killer whales. However, larger, more ferocious beasts lurk within the dark.
Traverse a network of rusted oil structures in search of missing items. Recover interactive collectibles from wreckages and find all the items needed to complete the game and leave the ocean floor.

title: DETECTIVE - Rainy night
description:
게임 정보
Detective Rainy Night는 이상한 실종 사건을 조사하는 임무를 맡은 경찰관 이케르 카르모나의 역할을 맡는 게임입니다.
하루 종일 운전한 후, 이케르는 “홀리데이”라는 모텔에서 하룻밤을 묵기로 결정합니다.
다음 날 아침, 그는 방 밖에서 논쟁 소리를 듣습니다. 밖으로 나가 보니 전기가 나가고, 휴대폰과 컴퓨터가 작동하지 않으며, 차량도 움직이지 않고, 강한 비가 내리기 시작한 것을 알게 됩니다.

title: C:aged
description:
게임 정보
C:aged is a short visual novel with multiple endings, hundreds of branching paths and where your choices do matter.
Story
SPOILER: The following text will reveal story information that may spoil the mystery of the game.
Where are you?
What is this place?
Where is the game that you are wanting to play?
All these questions are likely on your mind as you stare at a slow stream of falling symbols, but then...
Who is this girl?
What is her role here?
Why is she so evasive?
Why won't she let you play the game?
The mystery deepens as you get sidetracked in odd conversation after odd conversation, each time getting no closer to the game you are expected to play.

title: ROT
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a dark dense forest in which terrible inexplicable things happen. In recent years, many people have disappeared here, including the brother of the main character. You will have to find the missing people's belongings by following the coordinates left in the notes of the missing brother. Someone or something lives in the forest and changes everyone who goes there.
There is no map. Navigate through the trees using only a compass and coordinates.
Someone buried all the evidence. A metal detector will help you find the right things, and with a shovel you can dig up not only them, but also useful items for survival.

title: Merp in Merpworld
description:
게임 정보
an adventure platformer that will change the universe.



explore fields of warm grass and wildflowers. glide through the sky with your leaf. elude predating fauna, or make mischief instead.

Merp in Merpworld evokes the feeling of classic Gamegirl Color platformers, but includes modern niceties such as widescreen support, high refresh rate support, and a hi-def, heart-pumping soundtrack.



maybell and these collaborators created Merp in Merpworld:
COMPOSER
@simplycyndi
CHARACTER ART
@elliesprites
COVER ART
Lur Noise

title: Conjured Through Death
description:
게임 정보
"Conjured Through Death"는 금지된 마법 실험의 무모한 결과로 재앙에 빠진 마법사의 비극적인 이야기를 전하는 어두운 매력적인 Roguelike 게임입니다. 한때 강력한 마법사였던 당신은 이제 살아있는 시체가 되어, 죽은 자들의 몸에 반복적으로 환생하는 운명에 처해 있습니다. 당신의 은신처는 성의 지하 깊은 곳에 위치하며, 당신의 어두운 마법이 세상에 빠져나가는 것을 막기 위해 결연히 당신을 가두려는 옛 동료들과 성의 경비병들이 둘러싸고 있습니다.
여정은 성의 가장 어두운 구석에서 시작됩니다. 한 걸음 한 걸음, 당신은 자유를 향해 싸우며 점점 더 강력한 적들과 마주하게 됩니다 — 숙련된 전사들, 교활한 마법사들, 그리고 당신을 막기 위해 목숨을 바칠 준비가 된 무자비한 경비병들. 그 길에서, 당신은 고대의 제단들을 발견하게 되며, 이 제단들은 강력한 힘의 원천이 됩니다. 이 제단을 통해 무기를 강화하고, 강력한 마법을 배우고, 속성치를 향상시키는 등, 다가올 도전에 맞춰 능력을 개발할 수 있는 다양한 길을 제공합니다.
게임에는 다섯 가지 강력한 무기와 네 가지 마법서가 존재하며, 각 마법서는 고유한 원소의 힘을 대표합니다. 이들은 처치한 적들의 영혼을 사용하여 잠금 해제할 수 있으며, 전략적인 깊이를 더하고 당신만의 독특한 게임 스타일을 만들 수 있는 더 많은 방법을 제공합니다.
각 플레이는 당신의 기술, 전략 및 결단력을 시험하며, 독특하고 잔인한 보스와의 치열한 전투는 모든 무기와 마법의 마스터리를 요구합니다. 성을 탈출하려 싸우는 동안, 더 깊은 질문이 떠오릅니다: 당신은 자신이 일으킨 혼돈에 대한 구속을 찾고자 하는 영웅인가, 아니면 자신의 어두운 힘을 성벽 너머로 확장하려는 악당인가? 답은 당신의 승리와 그 과정에서 빼앗은 생명들의 메아리 속에 숨어 있습니다.

title: Smokin Potions
description:
게임 정보
Chaos reigns as up to 4 friends battle in a magical, explosive local-multiplayer showdown. Create your wizard, choose your magical affinity, mix elements, and craft explosive potion bombs to dominate the arena. Even in defeat, haunt and sabotage rivals as a ghost, seizing a second chance at glory.
Take advantage of unique stages, power-ups, and sudden-death hazards that change the flow of battle, keeping each match dynamic and full of surprises.
Customize your wizard with a wide variety of robes, hairstyles, and hats, and unlock new cosmetic items to stand out in every battle.
Explosive Competition
Compete with up to 4 friends in chaotic local-multiplayer battles, using potions as devastating bombs to create explosive mayhem.

title: Shadow Codex
description:
게임 정보
Shadow Codex invites you into a mystical world where magic meets mystery. In this cooperative puzzle-horror game, you and your friends take on the roles of a daring explorer and wise researchers, each with your own crucial part to play. Set in an enchanted forest filled with secrets, you’ll need to communicate effectively and strategize together to uncover ancient truths and combat malevolent witches.
As the explorer, navigate through atmospheric, richly detailed environments—from a enervating graveyard to a frozen lake—each haunted by a distinct elemental witch with unique powers and vulnerabilities. Meanwhile, the scholar assists by deciphering a mystical book filled with lore, puzzles, and spells essential for progress and survival.
Asymmetric Co-Op: Engage in a unique cooperative format where one player explores in-game locations while the other consults interactive documents to provide guidance and solve puzzles.
Mystical Environments: Explore three beautifully rendered, eerie locations each themed around natural elements of fire, ice, and blood, with challenges and aesthetics to match.
Interactive Puzzles: Solve a variety of dynamic puzzles that require real-time communication and collaboration, ranging from brewing ancient potions to decoding celestial alignments.
Rich Narrative: Unravel a gripping story woven through interactions and discoveries in the game, revealing the histories and secrets of the witches you face.
Replayability: With multiple solutions to problems and various strategies to defeat the witches, each playthrough offers new challenges and outcomes.
Atmospheric Visuals and Sound: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world complemented by a haunting soundtrack that enhances the mysterious and foreboding atmosphere of the forest.
Accessibility Modes and Customization: Don't want the enemies listening to you? Turn it off. Just want a chill puzzle experience with your friends? Shadow Codex has that. Want jump scares and butt-clenching terror? That's there for you too.
In Shadow Codex, your teamwork will be tested as you delve deeper into the forest’s shadows. Can you and your partner banish the darkness together, or will you be consumed by the secrets that lurk within? Step into the forest, and discover what lies beyond the veil.

title: Roodies Factory - Chapter 1
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Roodies Factory!

This is the first game in the "Roodies Factory" saga.

Roodies Factory is a first-person horror mascot exploration game. In the game you are the ex-founder of "Roodies Factory" who returns to the factory years after it was abandoned in search of his missing brother...

Explore the abandoned factory, solve puzzles and find out what really happened 3 years ago when the factory was abandoned.

Roodie

Roodie is a tall animatronic clown who can think for himself. He is the main animatronic of Roodies Factory, he is also the most loved animatronic by children.

Characteristics

-Photorealistic Enviroment
-Horror Atmosphere
-Receive calls from NPCs
-Solve puzzles
-Explore the abandoned factory

title: Footsy
description:
게임 정보
Footsy는 할머니 댁에서 펼쳐지는 혼란스러운 멀티플레이 축구 파티 게임입니다! 가구를 부수고, 병을 깨고, TV를 뒤집으며 골을 넣는 치열한 경기를 즐기세요. 파티에 완벽한 선택입니다!
할머니 댁에서 1:1로 펼쳐지는 미친 축구 경기에서 친구들보다 더 많은 골을 넣어보세요!
한 소파에서 플레이하거나 Remote Play로 온라인에서 연결해보세요. 우정이 시험대에 오를 겁니다!
테이블을 부수고, 꽃병을 깨뜨리며, TV를 뒤집으세요. 물리 기반의 혼란스러운 액션 덕분에, 모든 샷이 경기의 흐름과 집안의 상태를 바꿀 수 있습니다!

title: speak of my sin
description:
게임 정보
Discord:
With the help of the inspector, you are expected to unravel the mysteries and cases of both recent and old years, and then recall and speak out your sins as you get closer to the truth of the story.
In this game, you have three goals:
The fundamental and most important thing is to extract key information to find the truth of the case through the text description searched by the police department.
Each piece of information can be a key clue to the real killer, including the layout of the room at the scene of the crime, the footage from surveillance cameras, the chat logs of the suspect and so on.
The core task [/u] is to connect the facts of multiple cases and restore the whole story. In this game, figuring out the story behind the case is more important than finding out the real killer.
If you encounter difficulties in a certain chapter and can’t find out the truth, please be patient and move on to the next chapter, the answer may be concealed in it.

title: Carpocalypse RC Racing
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to the BURN league, newbie! The world may have ended, but the fun is just about to begin. Because as they say, "it doesn't matter how bad the situation is... Humans still want to have some fun!". And we will have a lot of it! So what are you waiting for?

Game Modes:
Arcade: choose a car, choose a race track and show them what you can do!
Championship: seven championships are waiting for you. Finish every race in every environment and take part in few more, way longer and challenging championships.
Time Trial: how fast can you go? Which car is the fastest one? Go solo and race against the clock.
Versus: show your friend who's the boss here in this two player local multiplayer mode.
Mayhem mode: now this is where the fun begins! Try to survive on racing tracks full of traps and other dangers*.

Due to AI limitations, some races should only be played in time trial or versus mode. Of course you can try them in Arcade, but the AI won't be able to work properly. Look for the information on map preview.

main Features:
20 old, RC rusty cars to choose from.
18 normal races in many environments like abandoned houses, shops or warehouses.
14 mayhem races. What can you expect? How about a bomb in your car: touch something, and BOOM! Or maybe a race full of traps that can be activated to destroy your opponents? Oh, they can do it as well so be careful.

title: Veins Like Tapeworms
description:
게임 정보
Veins Like Tapeworms is a slow-burn, psychological horror visual novel about disgust, snuffed-out dreams, and the desire to be loved.



When life becomes a monotonous cycle, it's not hard to grasp how someone could be pushed to the brink of violence, all in the name of feeling free. It becomes even more understandable if that person never even began to live, before being shoved out of the nest. With no gentle way out, the only chance to start anew is to snap chains and splatter organs.

Putting it that way, it was only a matter of time until Demian gave in. We can't prevent a tragedy, but we can cause their descent.

An unsettling, heart-pounding atmosphere

Taking place in the fictional city of Kingsfield Beach, Nevada, Veins Like Tapeworms will present a chilling world for readers to immerse themselves in. Kingsfield is a concrete paradise, where dreams die under gaudy casinos and neon signs. Poor little Demian’s already been swallowed whole by the city, but that doesn’t mean they can’t crawl out of its festering underbelly. All they need is a little push.

Even with a slow-burn narrative told in , readers will be begging for more by the time the story is over.

Take control of a 22 year old living on the razor-thin edge between murder and mental break. After moving to Kingsfield Beach in hopes of finding a place to call home, all of their motivation to get out and live a better life has been sapped away. Now, they survive paycheck-to-paycheck, working their miserable job at the Restful Night Motel as a cleaner.

As they become host to an ancient flower god, though, Demian will soon learn that not all is hopeless with their life; they just need to set themself free. Their humanity will slip away from them, in exchange for their freedom.
With six endings for a player to achieve, the story of Veins Like Tapeworms is heavily dependent on choices made through a playthrough. The way Demian perceives the words and actions of those around them are influenced by the thoughts a player has allowed into their head - a heartwarming conversation in one path can become a harrowing monologue of bloodlust in another.

Every choice a reader can make is a thought running through Demian’s mind at that moment. Will you help them pluck the worms of cruelty from their brain, or indulge in their most violent fantasies?

title: Devil's Terminal
description:
게임 정보
Devil’s Terminal is a cozy mystery visual novel about troubled teens, summer camp, and an occult AI. At Camp Guidance, you will take on the role of a socially anxious outcast and stumble upon an ancient computer that foretells a greater purpose for you. The story explores themes of being lost, late-night talks around a campfire, and the strange comfort of discovering who you really are.

title: QuantumPulse 2A
description:
게임 정보
Solve programming puzzles on a fictional computer with radio-based communication and unique limitations. Competitively optimize to compete on leaderboards against friends and the global community.

Note: Though featuring programming and set in a time when quantum physics was the hip new thing, nothing related to modern "quantum computing" is included in this game.


From your friends at QuantumPulse Ltd we are excited to introduce the brand new QuantumPulse 2A Professional Computer and Visualization Interface: The most powerful device releasing in '77! With its novel on-chip radios, hi-tech BBS interface, and exclusive hardware addons, the QP-2A is sure to win your heart and mind. Compete against your friends in programming challenges to earn GOLD STARS! And ACT FAST: The first to complete the certification course will receive a complimentary unopened pack of traditional Kostovian playing cards.

Disclaimers: All of the above statements are classified as Marketing-Truth as per the Truth in Marketing Act of 1973. Friends need not be real. Stars contain no real gold. Manual may have been damaged, lost, or censored during international shipping.

title: Arctis
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an exciting Arctic expedition where survival is just the beginning. Lead your group across a rotating map as you scavenge for food, clothing and tools. As mysterious strangers invade the frozen wasteland, your struggle intensifies. Confront external threats and internal conflicts, uncover the fate of lost characters, and survive the relentless Arctic winter as new dangers emerge!




The map changes dynamically with each turn. Your group will face not only a shortage of resources, but also constantly moving ice floes.

Events on the map continuously appear and disappear.
Changing seasons mean mild summers and harsh winters.




As mysterious strangers appear on the map, uncover their intentions and adapt your strategy. But be prepared — finding the right approach won't always be simple.





Hunting is crucial for gathering resources. Utilize tools and characters to collect essential supplies in a hunting mini-game.





Throughout your journey, you'll meet all kinds of people — some who will stand by you, others who may pose a danger. Build a resilient community to prepare for the arrival of outsiders. Your group is your family and internal conflicts are likely to happen. Immerse yourself in the evolving story of your characters and fight to survive the freezing cold!

title: Deep Sea Arena
description:
게임 정보
Deep Sea Arena
Dive into Deep Sea Arena, an intense underwater arena shooter where deadly creatures emerge from the abyss. Battle relentless waves of deep-sea horrors, dodge ambushes, and fight to stay alive. How long can you survive the depths?

Fast-Paced Arena Shooter:
Ever-Descending Platform: Your battleground continuously sinks into the ocean depths, ramping up tension as you go.
Depth-Based Highscores: The deeper you manage to survive, the higher your score.
Escalating Difficulty: Face increasingly dangerous waves of enemies as pressure, darkness, and limited space intensify.
Constant Action: Quick reflexes and strategic movement are key—there’s no safe corner in this relentless descent.
Diverse Enemies: Encounter a variety of deep-sea creatures, each with unique attack patterns.
company: Marcel van Duijn, Jarno van Duijn

title: Tall Trails
description:
게임 정보
Tall Trails is a chill exploration game. You play as Alp, an indestructible little golem on a quest to find his purpose. With your trusty Rocket Boot strapped to your back, you'll summit towering peaks, scale mysterious megastructures, and meet strange little guys!
Blast off with your Rocket Boot! Load items into your Rocket Boot and blast them out to send yourself flying skywards! Each item has unique powers: jet pack with hot peppers, hover across gaps with whirligigs, swing on webs with spiders, and much more!
Explore a weird & wonderful world! With your Rocket Boot, no peak is too high or valley too low! Explore 5 unique biomes, each full of new and exciting ways to move and explore.
