Find your purpose in life! Every golem has a purpose… but not you? What's up with that??
Customize your look & build! Find & upgrade powerful badges to increase your platforming abilities to unreasonable levels! Or just focus on collecting hats!
Meet strange little guys! This game is loaded with little dudes of the highest quality!! You will not find better little dudes anywhere else!!

title: Emblems: Sunless Vow
description:
게임 정보
Help three unlikely friends destroy the void—before they destroy each other!
New allies Weapon, Spirit, and Magic have some big tasks ahead of them. Recover their stolen memories, defeat an ancient demon or two, and escape from the dreaded void between worlds... Assuming they can stop arguing first, that is.
As stakes rise, and memories slowly return, will their once-forgotten feelings break them?
Or bring them closer?

title: The Warrior
description:
게임 정보
The Warrior is a short action/adventure platformer where protagonist, story and mechanics are constantly changing. Control legendary warriors, giant worms, greedy kings and lazy demons, each with their own purpose.
Control multiple characters

Each character wants to be the protagonist of their own adventure. You will be put in the shoes of each one and discover that the distinction between the story's villain and hero is merely a matter of perspective.
Solve puzzles

In addition to different skills, each character faces unique difficulties and challenges. Overcoming them requires thinking outside the box.
Explore

The world is filled with details and secrets. Take the opportunity to explore, encounter new creatures, and decipher ancient runes.

In the depths, unimaginably colossal and terrifying creatures await. Overcoming them is no easy task.

You can piece together the story through dialogue and ancient buildings from the perspective of each character. Can you uncover the truth?

title: Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons
description:
게임 정보
위도 76: 온킬론의 땅 는 1900-1902년의 실제 북극 탐험 이야기에 영감을 받은 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다. 이 게임은 북극 해양에 숨겨진 환상의 섬 전설을 증명하려는 용감한 탐험자들의 이야기를 들려줍니다.


그랩핑 훅을 사용하고, 집라인을 타고, 절벽을 오르며, 북극 해양의 얼어붙은 광야에 숨겨진 환상의 섬을 탐험하고 그 비밀을 밝혀내세요.



이 땅은 보기보다 간단하지 않습니다. 예상치 못한 도전들이 곳곳에 숨어 있습니다.



귀여운 원숭이로 전환하여 퍼즐을 풀고, 숨겨진 경로를 탐색하며, 털복숭이 친구를 꾸밀 수 있는 스타일리시한 모자를 모으세요.



1900년의 신비로운 실제 탐험에서 영감을 받은 이야기 속으로 빠져보세요. 몰입감 있는 컷신, 예상치 못한 반전, 잊을 수 없는 캐릭터들과 함께 비밀을 풀어보세요.


북극 탐험가 바론 마그누스는 존재한다고 믿는 사람이 없는 땅을 찾기 위해 탐험대를 결성합니다. 탐험가들은 맘모스, 코뿔소, 그리고 신화 속 생물들이 사는 세계를 발견하면서 예상보다 더 많은 것을 알게 됩니다.
그 신비로운 땅은 탐험자들을 환영하지만, 그 앞에는 위험이 도사리고 있습니다. 그들의 모든 움직임을 추적하는 사냥꾼들과 그림자 속에 숨어 있는 다른 무서운 괴물들이 있습니다...

게임은 2025년에 출시 예정 – !
최신 정보, 토론, 그리고 더 많은 내용을 위해 커뮤니티에 참여하세요!
autokwd: Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons,위도 76: 온킬론의 땅

title: Rogue Mech
description:
게임 정보
When the rogue planet soared right through our solar system, scientists predicted two possible outcomes - either earth would be destroyed, or turn into a hellhole.
Well, I guess we were lucky.

Rogue Mech is an isometric Mecha game where you'll do a lot more than fight other mechs - You trade, hack, dig, plant, loot, upgrade, sneak, free prisoners, and maybe chuckle about the dark humor. If you like games that don't take themselves and their scenario too serious while still providing a good, deep challenge - hit that wishlist button.


Find, loot, repair and upgrade sweet stuff for your modular, fusion-powered weapons platform called Phoenix.



Of course, you can also strategically remove those extras from enemy Phoenix'...





No one has a clue if the situation outside would be any better. But Tasha knows that her family will be there - if they survived.



Not everyone is an enemy, and you will not get far if you shoot everything on sight. There are defectors just like you roaming the land. While they are not always friendly, they might have advice, something to trade, or even assist you in an assault on a militia outpost.








We will soon run out of canned food and bottled water. Our only chance is to somehow grow something edible in a dead world. But one cannot do it alone. So set up a cozy home base, find allies among the wasteland dwellers, protect them and watch them harvest your crops.



As a nice side effect, they will help you maintaining your Phoenix. If you can find some raw materials. And machinery. And fuel to operate them. There is a lot to do.

title: Heroes Suck
description:
게임 정보
Defend your dungeon against an onslaught of heroes in this physics-enabled tower defense. Build your dungeon tile by tile, placing deadly traps to protect your loot. Upgrade your defenses and powers as you amass wealth and unleash havoc on these cheese wheel-stealing 'heroes'.
Build your dungeon, your way. Place tile by tile, and fill your dungeon with deadly traps to keep the pesky heroes away from your loot. As you level up, you gain the ability to place more and more tiles to further grow your dungeon.
Unleash havoc with your traps. With physics enabled, send heroes flying around - or even play bowling with their bodies! You can even light them on fire or electrocute them. What fun!

title: The Mirror Dimension
description:
게임 정보
The Mirror Dimension is a Co-Op psychological thriller and horror game that can be played with 1 to 4 players. In the game, players will investigate paranormal activities in a visited house, attempting to solve events occurring in different dimensions. By confronting and eliminating the spiritual entities you encounter, you'll strive to identify the problem in your own dimension. Are you ready to explore different dimensions and uncover their mysteries?
Everything around you is filled with surprises that can distract you. As you interact with your environment, you might unknowingly transition to a different dimension. Everything can change at any moment; observe your surroundings carefully and find a way to survive by uncovering the secrets of the dimensions!
Each dimension has its own unique plotlines. Explore the dimensions, uncover their secrets, and use this knowledge to survive! Do you think you can make it through?

title: Warpflux
description:
게임 정보
In Warpflux you assume the role of the only living officer aboard an autonomous colony ship. The destination? A new birthplace for humanity. Take command and decide the best course of action during the thousand-year long voyage full of perils.

Features
Defend against enemies during an intense, time-limited resource gathering phase
Carefully plan and manage a limited number of actions before entering cryo sleep
Collect research and use it to unlock new upgrades
Encounter crisis events and make tough decisions
Explore procedurally generated solar systems

title: THRASHER
description:
게임 정보
From the artist & composer behind the cult hit THUMPER comes THRASHER, a mind-melting arcade odyssey and audiovisual experience. Guide a magnificent space eel, elegantly swooping and thrashing it through mesmerizing alien worlds. Race to evolve the space eel from a tiny worm into a mega beast, taking on wild bosses through 9 psychedelic realms. Dive into the game's deep combo system to perfect your runs and compete on the leaderboards, or simply vibe out inside the breathtaking but unsettling landscapes.  Experience the award-winning game on PCVR and 2D screens (including Steam Deck) soon!
TRANSCEND SPACETIME
Immerse yourself in a dazzling odyssey where music, visuals, and gameplay mesh into one transcendent experience. Journey from the depths of primordial gloom to the heights of celestial bliss, culminating in a heart pounding reckoning with a cosmic baby god.
YOU V THE UNIVERSE
Swoop, dash and thrash at breakneck speed, busting through obstacles and stacking up combos, leading to nine jaw dropping encounters with mysterious leviathans that will challenge your skills, and your sanity.
SOUND AND FURY
Lose yourself in the enthralling soundtrack created by designer Brian Gibson, bassist for the band Lightning Bolt. THRASHER is a spatial audio and haptics showcase, creating a stunning sensory experience.
CHILL OR CHALLENGE
Vibe out and enjoy the wild journey, or push yourself to the limit by chaining together massive combos to worm your way up the rankings.

title: Hyperspace Deck Command
description:
게임 정보
Command advanced battle fleets!
Protect your fabricator megaship from waves of advancing enemies in tactical, card-based combat.
Deploy and move your space forces across multiple orbital lanes.
Use high-tech ability cards to support your vessels in battle.
Carefully consider your actions: Units operate on individual turn timers and every card you play brings them closer to carrying out their next attack run.
Enhance your tactics with dual-use status effects!
Ability cards in Hyperspace Deck Command give you an extra bit of tactical flexibility. Every effect works differently depending on if you play them against allies or enemies. Do you want to shield your ship, or contain and prevent damage from a specific attacker? Do you deploy defensive mines around your front line unit or trap the approach vector of a specific enemy? Should your carriers deploy fighters to strafe targets, or send them to guard your own vessels?
Build highly customizable decks!
Combine dozens of possible fabricators, deck commanders, randomly generated flagships and auxiliary vessels into thousands of possible starting decks.

title: Twilight Parade: Moonlit Mononoke
description:
게임 정보
트와일라잇 퍼레이드: 문릿 모노노케는 아름다운 요괴 소녀들이 요괴가 가득한 5개 레벨을 날아다니며 백 요괴의 야간 퍼레이드인 백기 야교를 기념하는 횡스크롤 탄막 슈팅 게임입니다. 날고, 쏘고, 피하세요. 파티를 끝내세요!
매년 요괴들은 백 요괴의 야간 퍼레이드인 백기 야교에서 파티를 하기 위해 거리로 나갑니다. 하지만 올해는 너무 시끄러워서 오니 쌍둥이를 초대하지 않았고, 파티를 망칠 겁니다! 이 횡스크롤 슈팅 게임에서 요괴 무리에 맞서고 파티를 끝내자!

픽셀 아트 스타일의 플레이 가능한 캐릭터로 4명의 아름다운 요괴 소녀, 각각 다른 유형의 조수와 해변복 버전!
화난 요괴로 가득한 5개의 레벨, 각각 끝에 거대한 보스가 등장!
레트로 탄막 게임플레이.
향수 같은 픽셀 아트 스타일의 수평 레벨.
총알, 총알이 정말 많아요!
블루 오니 자매
가장 재밌고 귀여운 쌍둥이로, 뿔이 하나뿐이고 과자와 케이크를 좋아해요. 그녀의 조수는 원형으로 총을 쏘는 타누키예요.

title: Vending Dokan!: Kozy Kiosk
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in Vending Dokan!: Kozy Kiosk, a charming idle simulation game for creating and managing your very own vending machine business.
Place your machines in various spots around the city, design each location to match your style, and build a thriving business whether you're playing actively or letting it run passively in the background while you work or play other things.
Transform ordinary streets alleys into bustling hotspots and create destinations that the locals can vibe with. Decorate each vending location with various items, plants, and themes that attract more customers and boost sales.

title: Dungeons and Diners
description:
게임 정보
In the Diner
Take Orders: Manage food orders as they arrive on your plate.
Cook & Serve: Tackle a hectic kitchen, preparing and plating a variety of dishes that bring life to your diner.
In the Dungeon
Adventuring Guild: Form parties with friends, whether playing online or offline, and set off on collaborative quests.
Inventory Management: Keep a close eye on your loot and ingredients, ensuring you’re always ready for the next challenge.
Character Choices: Select from four distinct heroes, each with unique abilities that can turn the tide in battle.
Development Roadmap & Updates
Our current focus is on perfecting the Demo build. We’re busy gathering player feedback, squashing bugs, and refining core systems—especially the dynamic interplay between diner operations and dungeon adventures. Soon, you’ll experience:
Enhanced combat effects (like a slow effect on the Archer’s Rain of Arrows ability)
Polished town mechanics, ensuring every shop and service—from the General Store to the Diner—operates seamlessly
A richer audio experience that brings every location to life
We’re committed to rolling out regular updates as we work towards a polished Early Access release. Check out our visual roadmap below for a closer look at our progress and upcoming milestones.

title: The Creator
description:
게임 정보
디자인 세계에 빠져보세요

더 크리에이터는 디자인 마스터가 되어 세계에서 가장 아름다운 구석구석에 세련되고 아늑한 공간을 만드는 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 제한도, 스트레스도 없이 창의력과 영감만 있으면 됩니다.


디자인 마스터

다양한 장식 요소, 가구, 식물, 조경을 활용해 독특한 인테리어와 외부 디자인을 만들어 보세요.
원하는 스타일, 색상, 소재를 선택해 편안하고 조화로운 분위기로 공간을 채우세요.


다양한 위치

아늑한 도시형 아파트와 모든 종류의 주거용 주택을 맞춤 제작해 보세요.
차고와 다양한 방은 나만의 독특한 아이디어를 위한 공간을 제공합니다.
편안한 휴식 공간과 기능적인 요소로 환경을 개선하세요.
수천 개의 아이템이 디자인 프로젝트의 일부가 되기를 기다리고 있습니다.



리소스 찾기와 제약은 잊고 오로지 아름다움의 창조에만 집중하세요.
자유롭게 실험하고 그 과정을 즐기며 완벽한 솔루션을 찾아보세요.
사실적인 낮과 밤의 주기와 화창한 날부터 번개를 동반한 뇌우까지 다양한 날씨 조건이 작품에 깊이와 표현력을 더합니다.
다양한 필터가 포함된 맞춤형 사진 모드로 프로젝트의 멋진 사진을 캡처하세요.
최고의 사진을 친구 및 게임 커뮤니티와 공유하여 다른 사람의 작품에서 영감을 얻어보세요.

title: LoveSoTea
description:
게임 정보
Love your tea, love your life.

Gameplay:
Become more and more proficient in the art of tea by making a daily brew each day.
Advancing the story unlocks a variety of tea leaves to choose from, with a particular focus on black tea.
Schedule events in your calendar that can boost luck and wellbeing and live a happy, peaceful life.

In the kitchen:
Practise making tea in the kitchen and play with different heat levels, tea leaves, and brewing times.
Then run taste tests until you discover the perfect brew.

Story:
Meet Yoru, who has been told he only has a few months left to live, and Chihiro, a high school student who keeps insisting on treating him to some delicious tea, for reasons unknown.
The two slowly pass his remaining time together, not at a café but at home, sharing some peace and quiet - and a few laughs - at a tea time just for two.

Features:
Many café games have a lot of tasks, such as running the business and serving countless tables. In this game, you only serve one person.
Plus, you should be able to recreate all the teas in the game at home with your own setup.

- Featuring Japanese and Chinese teas
- No need to be a master of tea party etiquette
- Easy controls: just click, drag, and drop!
- No prior knowledge of tea-making required
- Appropriate for all ages (in theory)

NOTE: If you do care about tea-making etiquette, please forgive the blasphemous idea of throwing tea leaves straight in the kettle.

title: A Long Survive
description:
게임 정보
“It was our fault. Our home, Earth, was attacked and devastated. But we prevailed. We managed to drive out the Lerp and acquire their technology. Our mission now is to find resources and seek a new home for humanity. We know they will attack again. But we will be prepared. We will do what we do best: Survive."
A LONG SURVIVE
A Long Survive is a cooperative shooter game focused on survival against waves of varied enemies. It is an intense action game with resource management, real-time strategy and building elements. One of its keys features is its immersive VR experience, which is compatible with all kinds of VR devices, as well as its crossplay connectivity with PC Players.
All the Project is building in Unreal Engine 5.
JOINS THE SPACE CORP
In A Long Survive, you will take on the role of a soldier from Space Corp. You will have to go with your team to one of the extraction bases on the new planets taken by humans.
But obviously, it won't be easy.
These extraction bases are besieged by the Lerp army. You will have to survive their waves as long as you can while protecting the nexus.
Will you be able to complete the mission? Or Will you have to escape?


GAME HIGHLIGHTS

SURVIVE - PROTECT THE NEXUS.
You have to survive different waves filled with many enemies with different mechanics that Will attack you relentlessly. And what's more important; you must protect the Nexus. If the Nexus falls, the game is over.
MANAGE YOUR RESOURCES – FORTIFY YOUR POSITION.
You will have a wide variety of weapons to survive. But not only that. Thanks to the "Forge Gun" and the resources you acquire during the game, you can fortify your position. You will have the possibility to build walls, turrets, and many other constructions that will help you protect the nexus.
Be smart. Use your resources and those of your team strategically.

title: 17.waves TD
description:
게임 정보
온라인 코옵 타워 디펜스
외행성 W4-V35의 17개 콜로니가 공격받고 있습니다! 17.waves에서 전부 살아남을 수 있을까요?
최대 4명의 친구들과 온라인에서 모여 몰려오는 외계인 무리들로부터 기지를 지키십시오.
협력을 통해 코인과 자원을 모으고 타워를 만들어 유지해야 합니다.
콜로니 수호
[b]외계인의 습격[/b] -- 외계인 벌레들이 기지를 습격합니다! 놈들의 습격 경로를 학습하고 방어 계획을 세우십시오.
[b]타워 제작[/b] -- 다양한 유형의 타워 중에 원하는 타워를 선택해 가장 효율적인 방식으로 배치하십시오.
협력이 중요합니다
내 역할 찾기 -- 7가지 특징적인 업그레이드 중 하나를 이용해 각 팀원을 특화시키십시오. 플릿 풋, 로드 로드, 오버클록과 같이 서로 다른 특징이 있습니다!
[b]자원 채굴[/b] -- 타워는 에너지를 소모하므로 계속 충전해줘야 합니다. 자원을 모아 타워에 주입해 계속 가동하도록 해야 합니다.

title: SiliCorp Systems
description:
게임 정보
YOUR JOB
"We NEED someone to fix this computer as soon as possible. Apparently that weird edutainment game was modified by someone. Yeah, the one where you battle those "parent-approved" monsters or whatever. What's it called again? Wasn't it Edumon or something like that?
We can't let students see this.
...
Well, I don't care who did it, I just need it fixed.
...
Hey, you. Could you do me a favor and stay a little longer today?"
KEY FEATURES
Play through Edumon from start to finish to make sure the game is working properly. Do things such as:
EXPLORE

title: TransmuTowers
description:
게임 정보
How To Get Involved Pre-Release
Wishlist, follow, and join our Discord for opportunities to play in early playtests and help craft the game. We would love to get a small core group of players who love the tower defense and bullet heaven genres so we can make a great game that fits your tastes!
Explore the Campaign
Welcome to the world of Valber! In TransmuTowers, you will explore Valber through a variety of maps, each with their own resources, challenges, and monsters to defeat.
Build a New City Each Level
Establish a foothold on these maps, starting with a small camp and building up to a flourishing base where you can generate resources and build up your strength. Always restarting your cities in games? Our 20-30-min stage-based gameplay will allow you to try numerous base layouts and strategies, and reward you for it!
Defend against the Hordes
Each stage will feature new monsters to conquer, requiring the use of different strategies to beat the highest difficulties. Unlock new towers and effects rapidly as you play the game.
Core Features:
Defend multiple scenic locations throughout the campaign
Roguelike Meta-progression for unlocking new strategies
Real-time strategic decision-making, No pre-defined monster paths here
Dozens of towers with hundreds of upgrades
Randomized powerful augments each level to keep each game fresh
Ability to play solo or with friends

title: Academia Z: The beginning of the catastrophe
description:
게임 정보
A third-person action video game set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies in an anime style.
The world has been ravaged by a zombie apocalypse. Emilia, along with her friend and other students, will try to stay alive within the educational center while zombies lurk around every corner.
Waiting for help won't be the best option. The scarcity of medicine, food, and water will force them to venture outside as they seek help, but nothing will be so simple. They will encounter a city looted by other survivors, who, faced with the lack of resources, will opt for more ruthless actions.
Emilia and her companions' mental health will be threatened, facing psychological and emotional problems as they try to find moments of happiness in a desolate world, although happiness is fleeting in this dark and hostile world.
Will they be able to overcome adversity and preserve the remaining humanity, or will they succumb to the bleak fate that seems inevitable in this new post-apocalyptic world?
autokwd: Academia Z: The beginning of the catastrophe

title: Project Forgemaster
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by the classic Ragnarok Online, Project Forgemaster is an aRPG where you are a Forgeborn, evoked by the king to face the shadows of the world. Being born from the forge allows you to grow your abilities compared to the locals of the realm. You were born to fulfill a destiny, and it's your time to Forgemaster on your way.

title: Compass Lost
description:
게임 정보
Explore procedurally generated ruins looking for treasure in Compass Lost, a cooperative multiplayer third person adventure game that will put your skills and your brains to the test to see if you have what it takes to survive the traps and curses on your path to fame and fortune.
DISCOVER NEWLY UNCONVERED RUINS
A new world of forgotten ruins have been discovered from an ancient civilization deep in the jungle.  You're among the first to explore their depths, solve their mysteries, and tempt fate by taking their valuable treasure. Venture into different sites around the region - overgrown, volcanic, catacombs, and more.  There are even rumors of an entire city made of gold!
BECOME AN ADVENTURER
Whether you decide to journey alone or with others, you wont be exploring empty-handed - assuming you can afford it.  Buy supplies to increase your chances of success: a torch and a medkit can take you a long way if you know what you're doing.  Utilize your journal to keep track of where you've been and to translate ancient writing that can offer clues to the dangers ahead. Leverage your spoils from recent adventures to fund your next expedition or customize your character to stand out from the crowd.
FEATURES
Levels procedurally generated so you never explore the same place twice
Dynamic weather effects change how you approach each new dangerous situation
Hunt for treasure how you want with both solo and cooperative expeditions
Persistent player profiles let you build on your past successes (and failures) by unlocking new places to explore, new items to buy, and new ways to increase your ability to get out alive

title: Soulrise
description:
게임 정보
Soulrise is a game about high-risk jumps, inspired by Jump King and other precision platformer.

Trapped beneath a forgotten tower, lost souls await your help. They must ascend to the top of this Structure, overcome challenging obstacles and uncover hidden secrets - you're their only chance of salvation. Every jump must be carefully considered, as there's a lot at stake... One mistake and your progress is set back by an unpleasant fall.




Experience Soulrise alone or with up to three friends
Rotate your sword 360° around your player to determine the direction of each jump
Hold and release at the right moment to give your jumps the necessary power
Explore a tower with 10 different sections and hidden secrets
Try to avoid mistakes... Every fall has serious consequences.




Experience Soulrise alone or with up to three friends. Explore the abandoned tower together to find the best path to the top.
Or compete against each other in a specially designed mode.

title: Sakura Priestess and Shikigami Mountain
description:
게임 정보
『さくらの巫女とシキガミの山』は16ビットレトロスタイル風アクションアドベンチャー。
呪われた村のケガレを祓うため、お守りやバクダンなどを駆使して妖怪を撃退しよう。
里山の各地に仕掛けられた謎や仕掛けを解き明かし、ケガレの正体を突き止めるのだ！
村人たちの声を聞こう：
土地の住人である人々の話を聞くことで妖怪討伐のヒントにしよう
社を訪問して稲荷様の力を借りよう：
各地に建てられた社を訪ねることで、稲荷様の神通力を借りることができます

さくらの巫女による冒険のはじまりはじまり〜！

title: To The Grave: The Battle  Faenora
description:
게임 정보
Experience the Ultimate Strategy RPG

A Modern Take on Classic Strategy RPGs with a Nostalgic Touch
Join the revolution against tyranny in Faenora in our upcoming real-time strategy role-playing game, To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora. Drawing inspiration from timeless classics like Final Fantasy Tactics and Ogre Battle, we're modernizing the elements that made these games unforgettable while staying true to their roots. Our multiplayer approach to this tactical RPG gameplay will provide a gaming experience as deep and engaging as it is unique.

Join the Revolution
In the Kingdom of Faenora, eons of worsening oppression have sparked a revolution against tyranny. The monarchy rules with ruthless self-interest, pillaging his subjects to add to the royalty's immense wealth and that of his nobles. While the people of Faenora scrounge, scratch and claw for their survival, those brave enough are joining the fight for freedom and justice. Will you join the revolution and alter the destiny of Faenora?

Try it Today
Try our Proof of Concept demo, which is a one map single-player experience that showcases the art style and basic gameplay mechanics. In the final game, you will be able to experience the full thrill of building your army and playing with friends. In its final form, you will engage in cinematic battles where your use of skills, items and reinforcements will be critical to your squads' success and failure. Your strategic cunning will be put to the test as you build your squads, develop and equip your soldiers and control your troops in each mission pushing back the Faenoran oppressors.
autokwd: To The Grave: The Battle  Faenora

title: Wink & the Broken Robot
description:
게임 정보
Explore a lush post-apocalyptic world and help a broken robot recover all its pieces. Enjoy 9 worlds filled with secrets and a huge open world to explore.
Shoot enemies with your laser while collecting coins and mysterious ancient treasures like floppy disks and cassette tapes
Wink takes inspiration from Gameboy classics like Super Mario Land 2 and Link’s Awakening, but it's taking that inspiration and running with it. It has been described as a “cross between Megaman and Kirby”. Regardless of the comparisons, Wink has its own personality and a crazy little world to explore all its own
Your purchase includes an executable version of Wink & the Broken Robot which features:
26 levels in 9 worlds from underground caves to factories to waterfalls in the mountains
Hop n Bop/Shoot-Em-Up hybrid gameplay. Jump on most enemies or shoot to defeat them
100% accurate Gameboy Color restrictions in sound and gameplay
Original chiptune soundtrack by Max Oakland
9 bosses to fight
Open world to explore. You can play worlds in whatever order you want and there are many secrets and easter eggs on the overworld map

title: The Doorway Effect
description:
게임 정보
The Doorway Effect is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror roguelike. Venture into the subconscious minds of test subjects, investigating the recesses of their psyche to dissect a lifetime of fears and traumas.
While you can still play and enjoy the game solo, we know there's no better feeling than getting scared half to death alongside other people. The Doorway Effect will primarily be a multiplayer experience.
This game is atmospheric, frightening, and filled with secrets. There's no telling what may be waiting beyond each door. Collect keys, solve puzzles, outsmart the entities, and brace yourself for the worst...
Push forward through 100s of doors in a shapeshifting environment, scrambling to escape the horrors within, and to reach the final Doorway. Run after run, make it a little further each time, and attempt to unravel the larger mysteries at hand as you do.

title: Reflections of the void
description:
게임 정보
너는 결코 나갈 수 없는 집의 수호자이다. 매일 네 태블릿에 나타나는 지시를 따르며 살아간다. 그 지시를 어길 수도 있고, 아마 뭔가 변할지도 모른다. 결정은 네 손에 달려 있다. 하지만 그렇게 하기 전에 잘 생각해 보길 권한다. 네 선택은 너의 삶뿐만 아니라 다른 것들에도 영향을 미친다.
너의 임무는 살아남는 것이다. 그러나 아무도 너를 쫓아오지 않고, 자연적인 원인으로 죽지도 않는다. 믿어라, 너는 이 세상의 수수께끼를 풀기 전까지 수없이 죽을 수 있다.
특징:
이것은 단 두 사람에 의해 만들어진 게임입니다.
완전한 자유로운 행동: 어떤 문을 열지, 어떤 캐릭터와 더 자주 상호작용할지 스스로 선택할 수 있습니다. (당신은 좋아하는 캐릭터를 선택할 수도 있습니다, 그게 무엇을 의미하든지).
선택의 영향: 당신의 모든 선택은 현재의 대화뿐만 아니라 이후의 사건에도 영향을 미칩니다. 또한, 당신의 선택은 당신 자신이나 게임 내 다른 캐릭터의 죽음을 초래할 수 있습니다. 이곳에는 불사의 존재는 없습니다.
세밀하게 구축된 세계: 종말 이후의 우주는 처음 봤을 때보다 훨씬 더 넓고 깊습니다. 가장 세심한 플레이어들은 'Reflections of the Void'라는 어두운, 놀랍고 잔혹한 세계를 발견하게 될 것입니다. 생존하는 것만이 진정으로 사는 것은 아닙니다.
사랑 이야기: 게임 내에 사랑 이야기가 있지만, 모든 사람이 그 복잡하고 다소 이상한 (혹은 미친?) 여자를 사로잡을 수는 없습니다. 우선 그녀의 생각을 이해해야 합니다. 왜 그녀는 특정 방식으로 행동할까요? 아마도 모든 것이 그렇게 명확하지 않을 수도 있습니다.
의미적 깊이: 어떤 이들은 그저 어두운 이야기로 볼 수도 있고, 다른 이들은 그 사건들의 철학적 의미를 발견하고, 삶과 죽음, 사랑의 모든 형태, 생존의 대가에 대해 질문을 던질 수 있습니다. 어떤 이들에게는 이야기의 심리적 측면이 가장 중요할 수도 있습니다. 그리고 모든 사람은 옳습니다. 이 게임은 그 이야기의 배경이 되는 세계처럼 다면적이고 복잡한 경험을 제공합니다.

title: Samurai Conqueror
description:
게임 정보
“Samurai Conqueror” is an epic historical strategy game where you aim to unify Japan across time — from the ancient Kofun period to the transformative Meiji era.
Set against the sweeping backdrop of Japan’s full historical timeline, you’ll choose one legendary figure to lead your faction and strive to bring all of Japan under your rule.
Develop your domain through commerce, agriculture, technology, and military might.
Wage war against rival factions, expand your realm, and reshape the course of Japanese history.
Will you be the one to unify the ages?
Choose one historical figure from Japanese history and start the game.
Strengthen your faction’s commerce, agriculture, technology, and military power with development commands.
Invade other factions and expand your territory. Aim to unify Japanese history!

title: Robot Beekeeper
description:
게임 정보
Restore collapsed ecosystems by raising bees and reintroducing native plants. Use the resources of your bees to clone new plants, breed new bee species and restore the whole planet to its former beauty with automation.
Become the pilot of an experimental drone sent to an alien planet on the brink of ecological collapse. Your drone will have access to a Terminal for communication and research requests. The Terminal has a built-in Matter Assembler for crafting and a Research Lab for unlocking more advanced machines, discovering new species and upgrades for your drone.
Raise Bees
Craft apiaries, clone bees and collect the unique product of each species to help fulfill your duties of restoring the planet. Use transport bees to move items in your production pipelines and automate ecosystem restoration items. Splice new bees by combining different species and unlock unique produce and new recipes.
Restore Ecosystems
Each ecosystem requires new restoration items and saplings to recover. Restoring each ecosystem will give you access to more bee species, new resources and research opportunities.
Clone native plants to balance the ecosystem, craft required nutrients and tools with bee produce, clean toxic areas and undo the damage of ecological collapse.
Automation
As you explore further from your landing site, the tools and nutrients required for ecological recovery will become more complex while also requiring higher quantities. Machinery will need to be researched and constructed as new items and recipes are required. Utilise your network of bees with your advanced machinery to help provide the necessary components for ecological recovery.

title: Emma's Umbrella
description:
게임 정보
Emma's Umbrella is a precision 2D platformer where you help Emma overcome challenges to find her way back home.
🌧️ An Unexpected Journey
On a rainy day, Emma was leaving school when she accidentally fell into the sewers. Now, our little adventurer must face dangerous challenges, master agile movements, and use her umbrella in creative ways to escape this underground labyrinth.
☂️ Master Emma’s Umbrella
Emma’s umbrella isn’t just for the rain—it’s her main survival tool! Use it in unique ways to overcome obstacles:
Dash – A quick burst of speed to cross gaps or avoid hazards.
Float – Glide smoothly with the umbrella to control jumps.
Hang – Grab onto pipes to reach new areas.
Umbrella Platform – Shoot the umbrella into the air and use it as a temporary platform.
Wall Jump – Jump between walls to reach higher places.
Jump – Perform precise jumps to avoid traps and dangers.

title: Art-Therapy: Jigsaw Puzzle
description:
게임 정보
🧩 A Cozy Jigsaw Puzzle Game for Everyone
If you like puzzles, this one’s for you. It has over 100 beautiful pictures in different styles—some colorful and fun, others peaceful and calming. There’s no rush, no timers, just a simple and relaxing way to spend your time.
💡 Easy to play – Just pick a picture and start putting the pieces together. No complicated menus, no pressure.
🎨 Lots of variety – From detailed artwork to soft, cozy scenes, there’s something for every mood.
🎵 Relaxing music & sounds – Different music styles and ambient sounds to help you focus and unwind.
🌿 A stress-free experience – Play at your own pace, take a break whenever you want, and enjoy the moment.
Whether you want a quick puzzle session or something to help you relax after a long day, this game is here for you. Just sit back, put the pieces together, and have a good time. 😊

title: Clawsome
description:
게임 정보
Step into the whimsical world of Clawsome! Help Clawby find new friends in this wholesome claw machine game in which you collect unique and quirky prizes that move, disappear and even fight back! Navigate through ever changing challenges and build the most charming diorama collection with the figurines you grab!

A Claw Machine Like No Other
Clawby isn’t your typical grabber. The world is alive with moving platforms, disappearing prizes, and unexpected twists that will keep you on your toes.
Collect Unique Figurines
Each prize you grab becomes part of your growing collection. View your treasures in beautifully crafted dioramas and examine them from different angles to appreciate every tiny little detail.

title: DION
description:
게임 정보
DION – A Survival Game Inspired by West African Empires
Dive into DION, a multiplayer survival game that transports you to the heart of a brutal world inspired by the great West African empires. Here, only your ingenuity and strength will determine your fate.
🌍 A Persistent and Ruthless World
Explore rich and diverse landscapes, from arid savannas to lush jungles. Every resource matters, and every encounter could be an opportunity… or a threat.
⚒️ Build, Craft, Survive
Manage your base, craft your own tools and weapons, and hunt to ensure your survival.
⚔️ Fight or Cooperate
In DION, diplomacy is just as powerful as the sword. Form alliances, betray your enemies, and dominate the wild lands.
🔮 Unleash Your Power: Transform!
Master the ancient art of shapeshifting and take on the form of mythical or wild animals. Whether hunting your enemies, escaping imminent danger, or harnessing unique abilities, transformation is a formidable weapon.

title: Moto Roader 「モトローダー」
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to be a MOTO ROADER?
                         Imagine a time in the future when evil has been erased. Life’s tasks are handled by machines.
What will kids do to heat things up?
 They’ll all be MOTO ROADERS.
 Man and machine come together in a race of speed, skill, luck, power and strategy. Race up to four other drivers. Eight heats per race.
 Make sure you spend price money on killer part and weapons – not on weird shades and fuzzy dice!
  Features
Classic legacy title
Choose from multiple cars and drivers
Numerous race tracks
Multiple game modes including bumper car challenges
Up to 4 player local coop
Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point
Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)
Gallery: view images from the original game’s manual and box design

title: Infiniclick
description:
게임 정보
Combine, automate and upgrade programs to amass a fortune! Infiniclick is a relaxing incremental game (or not—it's up to you) where your goal is to pay off an unfair debt to the Fun Corp.
Each program comes with upgrades that will allow you to earn more money with them.
Some programs will require resources from others to run.

title: Morphing
description:
게임 정보
The first sound you hear is the soft drip of water from a stalactite, echoing through the shadows.
In this vast subterranean world, you will encounter a mining tribe that has dwelled here for millennia, hear the mechanical footsteps of enigmatic surface-dwelling war machines reverberating through the empty corridors, and glimpse the Abyssal Heart lurking in the depths below—a remnant of an ancient horror stirring in the world's darkened underbelly. Seek the wisdom of the prophet who resides within a primordial tree, and as your journey unfolds, immerse yourself in the ways of the tribe, uncover the long-buried history of the land, piece together fragments of your lost memories, and bear witness to a fate yet to be realized. Pay close attention to every detail around you—for this is a rare second chance at life.
You wield the power of morphing, a unique ability that allows you to transform and acquire the properties of objects and creatures. Use this gift to interact with the environment, solve intricate puzzles, and embark on an extraordinary adventure.

title: Bandeirantes: The Game.
description:
게임 정보
Bandeirantes invites the player to experience the life of one of the bandeirantes who explored Brazil in the 17th century.
The game takes place in the year 1650 and the player's objective is to organize and lead a Bandeira within the state of São Paulo and parts of Minas Gerais, Goiás, Mato Grosso do Sul and Paraná.
Buy carts, animals, food, water, tools, weapons and hire bandeirantes in 10 different classes to fulfill your objective: Expand the map of Brazil and find riches such as Gold, Silver, Precious Stones and other minerals.
Enemies include terrain, disease, animals, hostile indigenous people, and Spaniards who do not respect the Treaty of Tordesihas.
Game Mechanics includes Plantation, Work, Negotiation with Indigenous People, Hunting, Fishing, Village Construction, Karma for your Decisions, among others.
Come be a modern Bandeirante and show what would you do to be the best among them all.

title: Dead Engine
description:
게임 정보
Dead Engine(데드 엔진) 은 지능적인 좀비들로 가득한 포스트 아포칼립스 도시에서 생존해야 하는 액션 로그라이크 게임입니다. 이 좀비들은 단순히 당신을 쫓아오는 것이 아닙니다. 함께 계획을 세우고, 환경에 적응하며, 전략적인 위협이 됩니다. 싸울 것인가, 도망칠 것인가? 거래할 것인가, 약탈할 것인가? 당신의 선택이 생존 확률을 결정합니다. 중요한 아이템을 모으되, 확장 가능한 가방에 신중하게 배치하세요. 하나의 아이템이 생과 사를 가를 수도 있습니다. 모든 전투에서 좀비의 행동을 분석하고, 장비를 최대한 활용하며, 주변 환경을 전장으로 바꿀 수 있는 능력이 시험될 것입니다!

                                                       픽셀 아트로 표현된 포스트 아포칼립스 도시
손으로 그린 픽셀 아트 맵이 도시를 생생하게 구현하며, 모든 구역이 전략적인 가능성을 지니고 있습니다. 탈출 경로를 계획하고, 교묘한 함정을 설치하며, 도시의 폐허를 치명적인 장애물로 바꾸세요. 살아남기 위해서는 탐험이 필수입니다!

title: The Silo 24
description:
게임 정보
STORY
Begin an adventure in a post-apocalyptic world hit by a natural anomaly that emerged through a portal in one of the underground laboratories.
Some of humanity was able to take refuge in bunkers built by several corporations, one of which is "Silos Corp". The rest either became infected or continue to fight for survival in the vast overgrown and dangerous wasteland, where there are no past rules apply.
Take on the role of a special forces fighter named Martin Grylls and infiltrate a certain Silo 24, from which an emergency signal has been received.
Immerse yourself in a deep plot filled with intriguing characters, each with their own stories, and uncover the main secret of Silo 24 that divided Martin's life into before and after.
EXPLORATION
Explore linear abandoned locations of the bunker, laboratory, city, village, roads, forests and other eerily picturesque places, collecting resources and finding safe paths.
QUESTS AND PUZZLES
On your journey, you will encounter various obstacles and challenges, which can always be overcome by using ingenuity or strength to move toward your goal.
INFECTED
Bloodthirsty zombies, monsters and titans roam around, infected with mutated bioluminescent plants that came from another universe through a portal.
SURVIVAL
Always be on guard, because danger lurks around every corner. Armed with a variety of weapons, both firearms and melee, enter the fight for survival.
HORROR
In the dark corridors of the dead bunker you will find fascinating glowing plants, but this does not mean that the situation is safe. This is not your territory, and you are not welcome here.

title: Watch Where You're Going
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever been so distracted by your phone that you walked into a pole?
If you haven't, this game is for you.
If you have, this game is definitely for you!
Watch Where You're Going - a game about not watching where you're going
Stay one step ahead of your inbox
You will constantly receive messages asking you questions. Stay on top of them before your inbox is full.

title: Hogs Rampage
description:
게임 정보
다음은 한글로 번역한 내용입니다:
한 평화로운 아침이 악몽으로 변했습니다. 당신의 농작물, 정원, 강은 거대한, 격렬한 야생 멧돼지 떼의 공격을 받고 있습니다. 이 괴물들은 눈앞에 있는 모든 것을 먹는 것에 그치지 않고, 당신이 소중히 여기는 모든 것을 파괴하고 있습니다. 당신과 친구들은 빠르게 행동해야 합니다: 활을 잡고, 함정을 설치하고, 농작물을 구하기 위한 전면전 준비를 하세요!
고전 및 현대 무기
활, 공기총, 사냥용 산탄총, 심지어 자작 장치까지 사용하여 야생 멧돼지를 당신만의 스타일로 처치하세요.
영리한 함정
야생 멧돼지를 유인할 수 있도록 미끼 함정, 우리 또는 폭발물 함정을 전략적으로 배치해 우위를 점하세요.
팀 기반 전술
팀에 역할을 할당하세요, 예를 들어 기관총수, 저격수, 함정 설치자 등으로 멧돼지 떼를 물리칠 확률을 높이세요.
독특한 차량
가장 능숙한 운전자를 선택하고, 트럭 뒤에 올라타서 모든 멧돼지를 처치하세요.
변화하는 지형
각 사냥은 새로운 경험을 제공합니다. 넓은 들판에서부터 위험이 가득한 울창한 숲까지, 절차적으로 생성된 맵에서 다양한 도전을 겪게 됩니다.
온라인 및 로컬 협동 플레이
온라인 또는 Couch Co-op! Hogs Rampage는 1~4명의 플레이어가 온라인 또는 같은 화면에서 로컬로 팀을 이루어 협동하며 즐길 수 있는 게임입니다.
Hogs Rampage 는 액션 가득한 게임플레이와 팀워크, 전략을 결합하여 가장 재미있는 방법으로 게임을 제공합니다. 친구들과 함께 웃고, 아슬아슬한 순간에 소리치고, 성공적인 사냥을 축하하며 게임 역사상 가장 영리한 멧돼지들을 상대하세요.

title: Tiny Racing
description:
게임 정보
Gear up for a thrilling ride in Tiny Racing! Dive into a vibrant world of pixel art where you control a variety of vehicles across contrasting and challenging tracks. With intuitive arcade controls, master each turn, drift, and boost to outpace your rivals.
From time trials to full tournaments, every race is a test of skill and strategy. Win cash to purchase new vehicles and become the undisputed champion! Get ready for high-speed excitement and a nostalgic gaming experience in Tiny Racing!
Summary
Get behind the wheel of trucks, drift cars and formula cars!
Quick race, time trials and 12-race tournaments await you
18 unique tracks over 3 settings both day and night
Earn money winning races to purchase cool new vehicles
Easy to pick-up controls means you dive right in!
Out-drive computer opponents over 4 difficulty modes

title: Bomb Vehicle Idle Clicker
description:
게임 정보
Bomb Vehicle is an idle-loot-rpg game that blends elements of post-apocalyptic survival, biohazard crisis, vehicle customization, and explosive action. In this game, players drive their meticulously crafted battle vehicles across the wasteland, exploring unknown territories and eliminating hordes of zombies.
The game is set in a world thrown into chaos due to an outbreak of a mysterious virus, where most humans have turned into ferocious zombies, societal structures have collapsed, and resources are extremely scarce. To survive in this new world, players must gather resources, build and upgrade their vehicles and weapons, and use them to explore the world and eliminate zombie swarms.
In Bomb Vehicle, players can:
Collect Vehicles: The game features a wide array of battle vehicles that can be collected through various means. Each vehicle boasts unique designs, performance characteristics, and special abilities that play crucial roles in different combat scenarios.
Customize Vehicles: Craft your own exclusive battle vehicle by equipping it with different engines, chips, armor, and special abilities. You can even outfit your vehicle with various turrets, from conventional machine guns to high-tech energy cannons.
Reinforce Vehicles: Gather materials to enhance your vehicle. In this challenging post-apocalyptic world, a meticulously enhanced vehicle will not only help you better deal with threats from zombies and other hostile forces but also allow you to progress further in the game.
Loot and Grow: Obtain rare equipment and materials by defeating enemies and completing quests, boosting the power of your vehicle. Every success will give you more confidence when facing greater threats.
Strengthen Weapons: Equipment can be enhanced and synthesized to create even more powerful gear. A carefully enhanced and advanced synthesis weapon set is key to maintaining an advantage in combat.
Explore the World: Traverse desolate city ruins, radiation-contaminated zones, forests, and other perilous areas in search of valuable supplies and potential allies. Each region is filled with challenges and opportunities waiting for brave explorers to uncover.
Combat and Survival: Confront hordes of zombies and other adversaries, using your wisdom and tactical advantages to win battles. Properly configure your vehicle setup to ensure combat readiness under any circumstances.
Continuously Unlocked New Combat Enhancement Modules: Such as Brain Slurry Amplifier, Brainwave Disruptor, Z Virus, Support Bomber... These will provide significant boosts to your battles.
autokwd: Bomb Vehicle Idle Clicker,Bomb Vehicle The Idle Clicker

title: Sibling Souls
description:
게임 정보
Step into the dark world of 2147, a dystopian place of vampires, androids, and dangerous secrets
You are Lina, a young woman desperate to find your twin brother, who vanished the night he became a vampire. Leaving behind the safety of your home, you step into a city where danger hides in every shadow. In your search for answers, you’ll uncover secrets that threaten not just your brother—but the fragile balance of the world itself.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The new humans may look like ordinary people, but beneath their polished exterior lies cold machinery. They call themselves the city's protectors, maintaining order through constant surveillance and binding residents with digital communication rings. They know far too much about you—and this knowledge might lead you to your brother… unless they choose to use it against you.

title: Primest Evil
description:
게임 정보


BETRAYAL! As the Prime Evil, you were once the greatest force for bad there was in your slice of the universe...until you got a knife in your back for all your efforts. Risen again as a lich, you're back to claim what's yours in this comedic cartoon adventure -- with a mixture of roguelite character-building, intense action, and a vast array of spells and weapons, there's no shortage of ways to have fun as you blast your way back to power.
CHOOSE YOUR PATH

Choose from an array of starting classes, from the all-around Archarcanist to elemental classes like the Scorcheror and Toxigician and even the melee-focused Bruisomancer. Develop further builds from enhancements traded for souls at the Shrine of B'Gokk. Particularly enterprising players may even unlock additional specialty classes with game events or special rewards.
ALWAYS OUTNUMBERED, NEVER OUTGUNNED

Wield an extensive armory of procedurally generated magical weapons, from magic wands to enchanted sledgehammers. Learn a grimoire's worth of spells, from simple light enchantments and minor curses to arcane tornadoes and globes of invulnerability that set would-be attackers aflame. Master the power of The Most Annoying Bomb In Existence! No explosion is too loud, no hex too humiliating for your enemies as you make your way through the worlds of the Inverse Tower toward your return to the throne.

Interact with a eclectic mix of oddball characters, and navigate the personalities of Councillors whom you recruit for benefits and quests - abuse them too much, though, and you'll have a rebellion on your hands! Recruited Councillors will provide unique benefits and equipment along with quests that can bring needed resources to the Prime Evil's coffers. On the other hand…they hate each other as much as they hate you. Keep them at each other's throats instead of your own, however, and you'll reap the benefit.

Rise, fight, die, and rise again: now a member of the undead, the Prime Evil can never be put down for long. The floors of the Inverse Tower are everchanging, which can only mean new layouts and new benefits as you charge forth. And with the help of the Shrine of B'Gokk and the dread chicken-goddess's hunger for souls, you'll be able to permanently upgrade your character any time you come back successfully from a run with those unfortunate spirits in pocket. Eventually, the Prime Evil return to the great power they have lost -- it's all just a matter of time.

A comedic story and beautiful cartoon aesthetic drives Primest Evil's game experience. Enjoy a combination of hand-painted art and cel-shaded 3D models, as well as a full original soundtrack!

title: Hot Seat
description:
게임 정보
- ARE YOU READY FOR HOT SEAT? -
Welcome to Vulkan Computing Security Systems.
Here at Vulkan, we strive to build better condor systems, to allow the world a smoother trip through the virtual realm.
We are looking to appoint a brand-new IT Technician to join the Vulkan team, to help with maintaining and updating the computing systems at the high security facility ‘QUASAR’©.
We are in need of someone who is confidant in a role that includes but is not limited to:
- Fault finding and resolution
- Has a good understanding of networks, IP addressing and voice infrastructure
- Ability to identify accurately all types of desktop hardware
- good understanding of software applications
As an Vulkan IT technician at ‘QUASAR’; it is your responsibility to adhere to the following company standards:
- promote the company ‘Vulkan’© in a positive light at all times
- be presentable and project a professional appearance at all times
- be stress free in a high stress environment at all times
- be punctual at all times
We look forward to receiving your application and hopefully welcoming you, into the Vulkan fold.
Good luck.
Mr Dirk Assmann
Head of IT
DISCLAIMER: During your shifts you are responsible for the monitoring and documentation of highly dangerous subject and high security assets. We are not liable for any injuries including: mental trauma, loss of limbs, or death.

title: Tarvos Desolation
description:
게임 정보
참혹한 우주 탐사 사고 후, 당신은 타르보스(Tarvos)라는 미지의 탐사되지 않은 달에서 유일한 생존자가 되었습니다.
처음에는 환대하는 환경처럼 보이지만 곧 끔찍한 본질을 드러냅니다.
당신의 목표는 타르보스의 적대적인 표면에서 살아남고 탈출에 도움이 될 비밀을 밝히는 것입니다. 몬스터 무리와 맞서 싸우고, 신비한 장소를 탐험하며, 답을 찾을 수 있는 버려진 실험실로 향하는 길을 찾아야 합니다. 이것이 집으로 돌아갈 유일한 기회일지도 모릅니다.
주요 특징:
잊을 수 없는 공포 분위기:어두운 장소, 신비로운 소리, 예측 불가능한 위협이 미지의 달에서의 밀실 공포 악몽으로 당신을 끌어들입니다.
몬스터 무리와의 역동적인 전투:작은 돌연변이부터 두려운 괴수에 이르기까지 다양한 적과 맞서 싸우며 생존 기술을 시험받으세요.
탐험과 생존 퍼즐:자원을 모으고, 장비를 업그레이드하며, 증가하는 도전에 맞서기 위해 기술을 발전시키세요.
미스터리 발견:승무원의 기록, 이전 임무의 흔적을 찾고 추락의 진짜 원인을 밝혀보세요. 다른 생존자가 있을까요?
스토리와 동기:
왜 당신의 탐사가 추락했나요? 사고였나요, 아니면 누군가가 의도적으로 당신을 죽음에 처하게 했나요? 타르보스에서의 모든 걸음이 진실에 가까워지게 하지만, 당신은 충분히 살아남아 이를 밝힐 시간이 있을까요?

title: Detective of the Dead
description:
게임 정보
Detective of the Dead is a narrative noir adventure game in which you are a dead detective in the colorful Mexican underworld and must solve cases using your wit, your unlockable abilities, puzzles and mini-games to prevent a conspiracy to ruin the famous Día de los Muertos forever. You and your magic companion dog Xolo work together - you can't let that happen!
You are in an 3D semi-open world in top-down view. From the street level to the roofs to the interior of houses or bars - you can explore the underworld. When it comes to mechanics it´s an adventure with some special ingredients: Be prepared to do some classic talking, interrogation & investigation and gladly: no pixel hunting, because for that we have our magic companion dog Xolo and its abilities to track and find things. We also added some Metroidvania and RPG spice. About ingredients, Mexican food is arguably among the best in the world. And doing the best original Mexican food in the afterworld can help you far sometimes...
Things in the underworld are a bit different than in the world of the living. Some things might seem funny, some weird or absurd to you. And some ancient god's powers are mysterious for sure. But it's all under control in the Mexican underworld. Well, actually it is not, that´s why we need you.
Everyone in the underworld is counting on you on the big case - well maybe except the bandits you are after. But even for them the Day of the Dead is special. Because only on that day everyone hopes to be able to visit the world of the living. To meet your friends & relatives, taste your favorite food (spoiler alert: not that easy in the afterworld) and just have a good time. You know these basics from Coco, documentaries or even from James Bond. That´s where we start with our Detective work.
Be prepared for an underworld full of dead people, some of them you actually might know! That´s one of the reasons why our detective wants to stay unseen in the quarter of the Nearly Forgotten - his past is haunting him. Well - over the course of many hours of game play you can change his course back to happiness and glory. Some help of ancient gods might come in handy though at some points...
Apart from that - do you think the Dead in the Mexican underworld just have fun, play music, no need to work - so everything is great when you´re dead? Think again, most people don´t change, even when they are dead. And everyone wants this Marigold, the inofficial currency in the underworld, to travel longer to the world of the living when the Day of the Dead arrives. So there are a lot of cases to solve. Just concentrate on the one that is about saving the day for all, alright? Depending on your decisions the outcome will change for the better or worse. We hope you can solve the big case and make sure the Dead can go to the world of the Living on the Día de los Muertos.

title: The Vanished Soul
description:
게임 정보
Feel free to check out the demo of the game, which is available here on Steam! Share your thoughts and feedback on the Discord server, or in the Steam Community Hub!
The Vanished Soul is an indie, first-person, psychological horror game made by one person. It is set in 2016 in the fictional place called Novazenica, and it has quite a few references to my actual home country, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Step into the shoes of the main protagonist as you solve the mysteries that begin to unfold in Novazenica. In addition to the realistic and atmospheric setting of The Vanished Soul, you will have to solve various puzzles to progress. While exploring, discover various side story elements, interact with many objects in the game, and immerse yourself in the atmosphere with numerous sound elements.
The game doesn't rely heavily on grotesque and gore elements but instead tries to slowly bring discomfort to the players through lighting, sounds, and effects. Combine that with the story elements, and you will have a realistic and atmospheric experience in this horror game. The Vanished Soul is powered by Unreal Engine 5, which brings some of the latest technologies, like real-time global illumination, helping you immerse yourself in the game as much as possible!

title: Merp in Merpworld
description:
게임 정보
an adventure platformer that will change the universe.



explore fields of warm grass and wildflowers. glide through the sky with your leaf. elude predating fauna, or make mischief instead.

Merp in Merpworld evokes the feeling of classic Gamegirl Color platformers, but includes modern niceties such as widescreen support, high refresh rate support, and a hi-def, heart-pumping soundtrack.



maybell and these collaborators created Merp in Merpworld:
COMPOSER
@simplycyndi
CHARACTER ART
@elliesprites
COVER ART
Lur Noise

title: Conjured Through Death
description:
게임 정보
"Conjured Through Death"는 금지된 마법 실험의 무모한 결과로 재앙에 빠진 마법사의 비극적인 이야기를 전하는 어두운 매력적인 Roguelike 게임입니다. 한때 강력한 마법사였던 당신은 이제 살아있는 시체가 되어, 죽은 자들의 몸에 반복적으로 환생하는 운명에 처해 있습니다. 당신의 은신처는 성의 지하 깊은 곳에 위치하며, 당신의 어두운 마법이 세상에 빠져나가는 것을 막기 위해 결연히 당신을 가두려는 옛 동료들과 성의 경비병들이 둘러싸고 있습니다.
여정은 성의 가장 어두운 구석에서 시작됩니다. 한 걸음 한 걸음, 당신은 자유를 향해 싸우며 점점 더 강력한 적들과 마주하게 됩니다 — 숙련된 전사들, 교활한 마법사들, 그리고 당신을 막기 위해 목숨을 바칠 준비가 된 무자비한 경비병들. 그 길에서, 당신은 고대의 제단들을 발견하게 되며, 이 제단들은 강력한 힘의 원천이 됩니다. 이 제단을 통해 무기를 강화하고, 강력한 마법을 배우고, 속성치를 향상시키는 등, 다가올 도전에 맞춰 능력을 개발할 수 있는 다양한 길을 제공합니다.
게임에는 다섯 가지 강력한 무기와 네 가지 마법서가 존재하며, 각 마법서는 고유한 원소의 힘을 대표합니다. 이들은 처치한 적들의 영혼을 사용하여 잠금 해제할 수 있으며, 전략적인 깊이를 더하고 당신만의 독특한 게임 스타일을 만들 수 있는 더 많은 방법을 제공합니다.
각 플레이는 당신의 기술, 전략 및 결단력을 시험하며, 독특하고 잔인한 보스와의 치열한 전투는 모든 무기와 마법의 마스터리를 요구합니다. 성을 탈출하려 싸우는 동안, 더 깊은 질문이 떠오릅니다: 당신은 자신이 일으킨 혼돈에 대한 구속을 찾고자 하는 영웅인가, 아니면 자신의 어두운 힘을 성벽 너머로 확장하려는 악당인가? 답은 당신의 승리와 그 과정에서 빼앗은 생명들의 메아리 속에 숨어 있습니다.

title: Smokin Potions
description:
게임 정보
Chaos reigns as up to 4 friends battle in a magical, explosive local-multiplayer showdown. Create your wizard, choose your magical affinity, mix elements, and craft explosive potion bombs to dominate the arena. Even in defeat, haunt and sabotage rivals as a ghost, seizing a second chance at glory.
Take advantage of unique stages, power-ups, and sudden-death hazards that change the flow of battle, keeping each match dynamic and full of surprises.
Customize your wizard with a wide variety of robes, hairstyles, and hats, and unlock new cosmetic items to stand out in every battle.
Explosive Competition
Compete with up to 4 friends in chaotic local-multiplayer battles, using potions as devastating bombs to create explosive mayhem.

title: Shadow Codex
description:
게임 정보
Shadow Codex invites you into a mystical world where magic meets mystery. In this cooperative puzzle-horror game, you and your friends take on the roles of a daring explorer and wise researchers, each with your own crucial part to play. Set in an enchanted forest filled with secrets, you’ll need to communicate effectively and strategize together to uncover ancient truths and combat malevolent witches.
As the explorer, navigate through atmospheric, richly detailed environments—from a enervating graveyard to a frozen lake—each haunted by a distinct elemental witch with unique powers and vulnerabilities. Meanwhile, the scholar assists by deciphering a mystical book filled with lore, puzzles, and spells essential for progress and survival.
Asymmetric Co-Op: Engage in a unique cooperative format where one player explores in-game locations while the other consults interactive documents to provide guidance and solve puzzles.
Mystical Environments: Explore three beautifully rendered, eerie locations each themed around natural elements of fire, ice, and blood, with challenges and aesthetics to match.
Interactive Puzzles: Solve a variety of dynamic puzzles that require real-time communication and collaboration, ranging from brewing ancient potions to decoding celestial alignments.
Rich Narrative: Unravel a gripping story woven through interactions and discoveries in the game, revealing the histories and secrets of the witches you face.
Replayability: With multiple solutions to problems and various strategies to defeat the witches, each playthrough offers new challenges and outcomes.
Atmospheric Visuals and Sound: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world complemented by a haunting soundtrack that enhances the mysterious and foreboding atmosphere of the forest.
Accessibility Modes and Customization: Don't want the enemies listening to you? Turn it off. Just want a chill puzzle experience with your friends? Shadow Codex has that. Want jump scares and butt-clenching terror? That's there for you too.
In Shadow Codex, your teamwork will be tested as you delve deeper into the forest’s shadows. Can you and your partner banish the darkness together, or will you be consumed by the secrets that lurk within? Step into the forest, and discover what lies beyond the veil.

title: Tavern Legends
description:
게임 정보
Tavern Legends is a medieval tavern simulation game in first-person perspective. You start with a small tavern and can, once enough gold is earned, expand your tavern and acquire new ones.
Immerse yourself in a quaint atmospheric town from the 14th century with cozy village squares, lively streets, and hearty locals. The town is freely explorable, there is much to discover, and you even have your own home!
Work Hard

title: WitchCraft: Spellbound Decks
description:
게임 정보
이 게임에 대하여

Witchcraft: Spellbound Decks는 고대 마법의 예술에 몰입하여 카드를 구성하는 로그라이크 덱빌딩 게임입니다. 마법이 실재하는 신비로운 세계를 배경으로, 플레이어는 젊은 마녀가 되어 강력한 주문과 의식의 힘을 활용하여 점점 더 어려워지는 적들을 물리칩니다.

Witchcraft에서 실험은 필수적입니다. 다양한 카드 조합을 통해 강력한 전략을 창조하세요. 당신은 순수한 힘을 추구하나요, 아니면 교묘한 속임수를 신뢰하나요? 일시적인 이익을 위해 카드를 희생할 것인가, 아니면 장기적으로 무적의 덱을 구성할 것인가요? 선택은 당신의 몫이며, 각 시도는 다를 것이고, 당신의 전술을 적응하고 발전시키도록 도전할 것입니다.
특징

턴제 전투: 각 움직임이 중요한 전략적 전투에 참여하세요. 신중하게 행동을 계획하고, 강력한 주문과 교묘한 전술을 사용하여 적을 압도하세요.

탐험 지도: 가지가 많은 경로와 숨겨진 비밀이 가득한 동적인 지도를 탐험하세요. 다양한 도전과 보상을 만나면서 신중하게 경로를 선택하세요.

카드 제작: 고대 의식을 통해 새로운 카드를 제작하여 덱을 맞춤화하세요. 요소를 결합하여 자신만의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 강력한 주문과 능력을 만드세요.

상점: 신비로운 상점을 방문하여 특정 카드를 구매하세요. 자원을 현명하게 사용하여 덱을 강화하고 생존 확률을 높이세요.

랜덤 이벤트: 여정의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있는 다양한 랜덤 이벤트를 경험하세요. 유용한 동료이거나 위험한 적일 수 있는 이 만남들은 당신을 긴장하게 할 것입니다.

보스 전투: 독특한 능력과 전략을 가진 강력한 보스와 맞서 싸우세요. 가장 숙련된 마녀들만이 그들을 물리치고 여정을 계속할 수 있을 것입니다.

title: Battle Match: Samurai Wars
description:
게임 정보
Battle Match is a tactical battle simulator where you command vast armies in epic, large-scale conflicts. Take control of thousands of soldiers and experience the chaos and strategy of real-time warfare.

At the core of Battle Match is a cutting-edge real-time simulation engine. It intricately models physical aspects like ballistics, armor resistance, terrain effects (such as elevation, vegetation, and line-of-sight), and soldier fatigue. Key psychological elements like morale, experience, and leadership are also simulated to give you an authentic battlefield experience. Every soldier is individually modeled, but you effortlessly command them in units of tens or hundreds, allowing for both micromanagement and grand strategy.

Use the sandbox mode to test your strategies or to experiment and learn about the battle mechanics. Challenge your friends in thrilling online matchups through our robust matchmaking system. Host massive multiplayer battles with several players on each team, or climb the ranks on a competitive leaderboard to prove your tactical prowess.

Battle Match will release several themed modules, each covering different historical periods.
First up: a modern remake of the acclaimed mobile game Samurai Wars.

Samurai Wars is set in Japan’s Sengoku Jidai, the age of the samurai. Be a samurai warlord and command your troops on the battlefield, using tactical skill to defeat the enemy army.

title: Grandpa's Bee Haven
description:
게임 정보
Grandpa’s Bee Haven is an engaging idle-beekeeping simulator designed to sit at the bottom of your screen while you multitask. Your mission? Help Grandpa grow his beekeeping business into a real beekeeping haven. Work together with Grandpa’s helpers to produce unique bee resources and craft amazing bee products!
Set Up Your Apiary
Strategically place beehives in ideal locations and populate them with different bee species. Ensure your bees thrive by adding nearby watering stations, honey extractors for harvesting, and solar wax melters for collecting beeswax. Once you’ve planned the layout, Grandpa and his helpers will get to work building and assembling everything.
Produce and Upgrade
Unlock hive upgrades to generate valuable resources like honey, pollen, beeswax, propolis, and royal jelly. Use these resources to invest in further upgrades or craft unique products.
Craft Unique Products
Transform the fruits of your bees’ labor into delightful and useful items. Make beeswax candles, propolis medicine for example to enhance your income and diversify your offerings.
Hire Helpers
Expand the bee haven team with charming helpers! Recruit Grandma, a Scientist, a Shaman, or even a loyal Dog or Cat. Helpers have different capabilities: Grandma boosts production alongside with Grandpa, while the Scientist unlocks advanced upgrades.
Design Your Bee Paradise
Create a stunning bee-garden that reflects your style. Be a perfectionist or get really creative with flowers, lush bushes, and beautiful trees.

title: LEGION
description:
게임 정보
LEGION is an epic real-time strategy game that brings the thrill of large-scale battles to both mobile devices and desktop platforms. Engage in intense, short skirmishes on diverse maps as you command massive armies, each consisting of hundreds of units.
Key Features
Cross-Platform Play: Experience seamless gameplay across mobile and desktop, allowing you to take the battle wherever you go.
Real-Time Strategy: Strategize in real time as you control every aspect of your squads on the battlefield.
Complete Squad Control: Take charge of your units with full precision—raise shields, adjust formations, and control formation density to outmaneuver your opponent.
Realistic Physics: Watch as cavalry charges tear through formations of archers, creating dynamic and believable battle scenes.
Variety of Maps: Fight across 3 unique battlefields, each offering different tactical challenges and opportunities.
Campaign Mode: Immerse yourself in a gripping campaign, honing your skills and learning the ropes before taking the fight online.
Online Multiplayer Battles: Test your strategic prowess against players worldwide in exciting real-time skirmishes.
Ranked Matches: Climb the ranks in competitive battles, proving your skills as a commander.
Unit Upgrades: Customize and improve your squads to create a fighting force tailored to your style of play.
Command, strategize, and dominate in LEGION—the ultimate RTS experience where every decision counts. Will your tactics bring victory, or will your army fall before a superior foe?

title: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL
description:
게임 정보
CHANGE THE BOARD. CHASE THE WORLD.
The short-and-sweet INDIEPOCALYPSE original from developer circle SKY HOUR WORKS finally releases standalone on Steam as HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL, an upgraded release of our first action title in the PROJECT NATURA series. Rush into an upgraded adventure with revamped story content, new system changes, and updated polish to bring the definitive ENDLESS RUNNER X GEAR-BASED ROGUELITE action out there.
CHANGE THE BOARD - Equip a garage of hoverboards to store between runs and apply to different situations. CHASE THE WORLD - Risk it all and choose when to end your run - either preserving your boards or bailing for a hell of a finish.
FEATURES
- ENDLESS RUNNER X GEAR-BASED RPG: Stat up your boards and store them between runs - the boards you bail with are gone forever, though!
- Teach 'em new tricks: New abilities will join you, alongside a more fleshed-out map progression, letting you choose your path along the ride!
- Take breaks in-between stages by tinkering your boards and learning more about the story of the hero out of time, now revamped with a proper ending and progress trackers.
- Steam Achievements, Leaderboards, and Cloud Support are included!
- Featuring an Original Soundtrack by Rukyyy (SPACE / MECH / PILOT and A NIGHTMARE'S TRIP)
autokwd: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL

title: FlowerCorner: Plant Watering To Vibe To
description:
게임 정보
Flower Corner is a relaxing idle game where you nurture and grow a variety of plants while doing other activities on your computer. The game sits at the bottom of your screen, quietly blooming in the background, allowing you to enjoy a peaceful gardening experience without interrupting your daily routine.
Casual and Customizable: Arrange your garden with different plants, pots, and decorations to create your own mini green space. As you unlock new species and items, you can customize your garden to reflect your personal style.
autokwd: FlowerCorner: Plant Watering To Vibe To

title: Mushroom Hunter World
description:
게임 정보
Take a break from the hustle and bustle of the city by walking through a picturesque forest. Enjoy nature, pick mushrooms and immerse yourself in the atmosphere of tranquility.
Forest paths hide many secrets. Explore every corner, find rare species of mushrooms and become a true connoisseur of mycology!
GAME FEATURES
Explore seven different locations with their unique places and vegetation, varied weather and mushroom picking conditions.

title: Death Trap Mountain
description:
게임 정보
Venture into 8 enormous stages brimming with challenges, rewards, enhancements, and formidable enemies as you assist Mitch in his quest to locate his missing canine companion. Death Trap Mountain presents a timeless adventure in platforming, incorporating numerous novel concepts. The terrain presents increasingly challenging scenarios for Mitch to navigate. Mitch is likely to encounter numerous adversaries and forge a few allies in his journey! A sinister threat looms over the realm as the black dragon Illugir awaits in his domain.
Bellow are some zoomed out images of the first 3 levels. (Work in Progress)

title: Star Life
description:
게임 정보
Forge your destiny in Star Life, a space-based economic & strategic RPG simulation. Begin as a humble newcomer on a vibrant alien planet, scraping by with basic jobs or petty crime. Through skillful planning, strategic resource management, and a healthy (or not) dose of risk-taking, climb the economic ladder, mastering skills in a dynamic learn-by-doing system. Will you rise from obscurity to become a galactic tycoon, having enough power to overcome those who led you there?
Every decision carries weight. Mine asteroids, plunder unsuspecting freighters, and engage in lucrative trade across solar system. Each choice has consequences, and mistakes can be fatal. Command your spaceship, manage your resources, and navigate dangerous space . Too dangerous for you? Live a normal life on any planet, until consequences of peaceful life hit hard like a rock.

title: Hardcore Circus
description:
게임 정보
Hardcore Circus는 『슈퍼 미트 보이』, 『점프 킹』, 『겟 오버 잇』에서 영감을 받은 고난도 정밀 플랫폼 게임입니다. 플레이어는 숙련된 곡예사 Dik가 되어 악마의 손에서 형제를 구출하는 모험을 떠납니다。
게임 특징：
관성 기반 움직임
신체 절단 시스템 - Dik은 다리를 잃어도 구르거나 점프할 수 있지만, 두 손을 모두 잃으면 처음부터 다시 시작해야 합니다
무기가 없지만, 환경을 이용해 보스를 물리치고 적을 피할 수 있습니다
다양한 물리적 특징을 가진 여러 바이옴 탐험 (예: 바다, 우주)
회전 기어, 포탈, 톱날, 대포, 레버, 스파이크, 트램폴린, 공기 및 물 흐름, 떨어지는 천장, 가고일, 상어 등 독특한 장애물에 도전하세요。
중독성 있는 게임플레이 - 포기하지 말고 계속 도전하여 완벽을 이루세요!

title: Exit Together
description:
게임 정보
Enter an unusual 1960s office, trapped in a loop. In this 1-6 player co-op or single-player adventure, you'll explore rooms 0 to 9, where anomalies may appear in some rooms but not all. Objects shift, disappear, or appear where they don’t belong, and it’s up to you to find them. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and find all anomalies to progress. The eerie atmosphere keeps you on edge, with each room bringing you closer to the exit—or sending you back to Room 0.

title: Zorezdra
description:
게임 정보
Zorezdra is a sci-fi platformer/metroidvania set aboard a giant starport. A woman with unusual powers searches for the truth about her origins, and a way to finally free herself from her difficult past.
THE STORY OF ZOREZDRA
In a lonely galaxy, in a universe unlike our own, people speak of a great prophecy. As the age draws to a close, the galaxy will undergo a phenomenal transformation, granting incredible power to those within it. The time of fulfilment is approaching, and everyone looks forward to it with anticipation.
Almost everyone.
On an isolated space station, hidden away at the galaxy's edge, a mysterious woman lives in solitude. She's never known how she got there or why – none of what she can piece together seems to make any sense. All she knows for sure is that some in the galaxy hold a grievance against her, and only by staying out of their way has she maintained a delicate peace.
It cannot last. When the station is attacked without warning by an army of robotic reptiles, she is forced to flee everything she has ever known. What consequences will there be for revealing her existence to the galaxy she has learnt to fear – and what will be the future of Zorezdra...?
FEATURES
Retro-style action: Run, jump, fight and glide your way through a huge starport.
New powers: Enhance your character with an array of superhuman abilities.
Engaging story: Discover the complex truth about your character's backstory, and the galaxy she inhabits.

title: HEARTLODGED
description:
게임 정보

There are many instances in the world where we lack the information to make a confident judgement on what we know to be true.
So the world instead shapes itself around what we observe.
When someone disappears, we can't say for sure if they are alive or dead. And this destroys us.
Is this how the world should be?


Two young women named Olive and Ashley awaken in a mysterious lodge in the dead of winter.
A mysterious being identifying themselves only as "HL" appears on a television screen, and informs them of their situation.
In 6 hours, 28 minutes, and 11 seconds, a disastrous avalanche will crush the lodge and the two girls inside it.
Escape, however, is not impossible. It is hidden in the lodge, but it can be found. Will they find their way to the way out... and to the truth of the past that set everything in motion?


- A mind-bending narrative from the creators of vivid/stasis that approaches topics pseudo-science topics and life/death
- Puzzle escape rooms that stand between you and your timely escape from the lodge
- A story about climbing out of a depressive spiral, starring two girls with a little bit too much experience
- An emotionally complex soundtrack by A-Saph
- Stunning character art and illustrations by Softy Sapphie

title: Deep Cuts
description:
게임 정보
Deep Cuts의 주인공이 될 시간입니다.
영화 제작사 라이트 카메라 팩션(LCF)의 공동 창립자인 엘리스 웨버가 되어 방대한 영화 카탈로그를 탐험하며 가장 친한 친구이자 크리에이티브 파트너를 구하는 블록버스터급 여정을 떠나세요. 초능력을 손에 넣고 인기가 추락한 치명적인 만화 캐릭터들의 광적인 무리, The Learning Lads와 맞서 싸우며 LCF의 상징적이고 영화적인 순간을 전부 재현해 보세요.
물리 액션!
고반응적인 환경에서 다양한 무기 옵션으로 역동적으로 상호작용할 수 있는 운동 기반 근접 전투와 총기 전투를 펼치세요.

title: Project: Autumn
description:
게임 정보
Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands. 
Explore and Discover
Run, climb, and crawl across the islands as you collect and find new items and tools! 
Be a part of the Community!
Why are we always so pressured by efficiency? Work together with many fun and quirky people as you each learn to relax and enjoy the beauty around you.
Unwind in a Recovering Paradise
Although on a top secret mission, the distractions here are plentiful! Surely our bosses won’t mind if we fish for a little while longer.

title: Crop and Claw 2
description:
게임 정보
STORY
Many years after the events of Crop and Claw have passed. Rumors about the Cult of Atmoss have begun spreading throughout Garden, with their remaining members in motion. A withdrawn dragon named Wend and his friends, along with some mercenary help, must follow the trail of chaos in an foreign realm of the world of Garden and attempt to stop the ominous plot unfolding around them.
KEY FEATURES
Build a custom party of dragons and join story characters throughout an adventure.
Dragons, everywhere.
A non-linear adventure allowing for exploration, routing, and replay-ability.
You are a dragon.
Turn-based combat against flora and dragons alike.
Multiple interactions and solutions to puzzles with characters and environments, encouraging exploration and experimentation.
Dragons. It really is a dragon adventure.

title: My Infamous Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
It's time to be evil. Build and master your dungeon, hire despicable monsters, and rise to conquer the overworld. Gaze from below as your dark tendrils creep across the land, snatching treasures from the forces of good and funding an ever growing empire. But beware! Saint Million the Hero King and his table of royal knights are always watching. Leave your dungeon weak, and a single cleave from the hero's sword will end your reign.
My Infamous Dungeon is a roguelite dungeon builder. Take time to carefully plan your dungeon, then protect it against waves of greedy heroes.
Features
An ever-changing dungeon
Build a unique dungeon every time. Combine over 6 monsters clans and 20 professions to uncover devious synergies and menacing strategies. Roguelite elements bring improvisation and variety to each playthrough.
Control the pace
Heroes enter the dungeon when you allow it. Take your time to plan your dungeon and lay devilish traps, then test your work against waves of delightfully foolish heroes.

title: project_Structure_01
description:
게임 정보
In the beginning of the game you wake up in space and an unknown entity sends you to explore mysterious locations.

project_Structure_01 is a first-person exploration game that takes a minimalist approach to storytelling and gameplay, instead focusing on immersing the player within a captivating and introspective environmental experience. Eschewing traditional narrative conventions, the game invites players to navigate a series of surreal liminal spaces imbued with a unique atmosphere and brutalist architectural style.

At the heart of the project_Structure_01 experience is a profound sense of exploration and discovery. Players must traverse the game's meticulously crafted environments, which blend elements of haunting ambience and soothing tranquility. The soundscape, composed of haunting and relaxing ambient tracks, seamlessly enhances the player's sense of presence, complementing the visual and spatial design.

Through its minimalist approach and focus on environmental immersion, project_Structure_01 offers a contemplative and deeply engaging exploration experience. Players are invited to become lost in the game's captivating liminal spaces, allowing the atmosphere and architectural design to guide their journey of discovery.

Features:
ㆍHaunting and relaxing ambient tracks
ㆍLiminal spaces experience from first-person perspective
ㆍOccasional 3D platforming sections
ㆍFun optional collectibles

title: The Ump Show
description:
게임 정보
Take control of the game as a baseball umpire. Make accurate calls but make sure your team wins!

Pitchers will change up the pitch selection to confuse the batters but you have to be better. Track fastballs and breaking pitches to make accurate strike/ball calls. If you make a terrible call, the players will challenge your call! If you make too many wrong calls, it's game over!

Calls you will make as the home plate umpire:
Ball/Strike
Checked swings
Fair/Foul
Tag Plays and Forceouts

Since you want your preferred team to win, remember to cheat! Giving up too many walks or too many balls can give away the game. Pick your moments and redirect the game at the right time.

To help you, you can spend your integrity to purchase powerups!

Block: Stop a player from challenging your call
Balk: Call a balk on the pitcher and immediately reward a walk to the batter
Eject: Replace the batter or pitcher with your preferred player.
Story Mode

You start as an umpire with no credibility in the amateur leagues. Your goal is to build credibility and earn favors to climb your way to umpiring at the highest levels!

title: Soggy Beans
description:
게임 정보
소기 빈스는 물고기가 당신을 찾아오는 편안한 사이드 아이들러 게임입니다. 새 관찰을 생각해보세요, 하지만 물고기로. 장식하고, 사진을 찍고, 사진 퀘스트를 완료하거나, 친구들이 당신과 함께 다른 일을 하면서 시간을 보내도록 하세요.
 모든 모양과 크기의 물고기를 찾아보세요. 물고기는 자유롭게 오가며, 새로운 물고기가 방문할 때마다 발견하고 각 목격을 일지에 기록하세요.

title: Neon Extermination
description:
게임 정보



🩻 Former employees turned archenemies, Alexa and Cyber Corp are at the heart of a high-stakes corporate drama. Cyber Corp, a towering influence in the tech world, harbors sinister plans that threaten the city Alexa loves.


As time ticks away, Alexa delves deeper into the corporation's machinations, only to discover layers of intrigue and deception far more disturbing than she ever imagined. 🩻

Blending reality and virtual realm, the game promises intense action, exploration, and a gritty narrative.

⭐ Enhance your skills by utilizing upgrade coins that can be found during missions.
⭐ Heroic story – Unravel the secrets behind CyberCorp's experiments with your mysterious companion.
⭐ CyberCorp`s thugs & Bugs – Varied enemies, including humanoid adversaries and creatures born of digital corruption.
⭐ Variety of weapons – From the Pistol & Shotgun to the Rocket Launcher and Plasma Cannon (with alternative firing mods).

title: Stick Robot Puzzle
description:
게임 정보
A puzzle game that combines "Slide Puzzle" (you cannot stop until you hit a wall.) and "Sokoban" .

・Simple controls yet deep puzzles.
・40 or more stages.

title: Elevator Down
