description:
게임 정보
Judge the Fate of the Dead in this satirical, bureaucratic, decision-making game. Talk to Souls, check their documents, reference Holy Texts and decide if they're going Up or Down. Follow the Rules or trust your own moral compass and see where your choices take you - hopefully not the Elevator Down.
Read different documents, from Life Summaries to Holy Texts, and decide each Soul's Fate. Test your ability to follow complex guidelines, as you decide who goes Up and who Down!
Balance strict Rules from various Religions, while also adhering to your own sense of Justice. Each Soul has you face ethical dilemmas, making every decision hinge on your morality!

title: Unihorn
description:
게임 정보
Unihorn is a 3D platformer full of adorable unihorns - unicorns, where you play as one and your goal is to reach the sky in this vertical and magical tiny open world.
The climbing will be challenging yet rewarding as you will get one the best views ever and meet other fellow unihorns.

Customize your character with one of 18 variants and make friends with others. You never know if it will come handy on your way up.

Unihorn will make the youngest audience smile and the older generation will feel right back at their childhood. Casual difficulty with no penalties for falling down ensures zero frustration gameplay!












Gameplay:
- move with WASD and jump with space
- flap your wings with SHIFT, but beware - you can't fly for long!
- overcome obstacles and keep climbing up
- the goal is to reach the sky
- talk with other unihorns and uncover the heartwarming story

title: Float Your Goat
description:
게임 정보
Guide your trusty goat across treacherous waters by building the perfect raft using your nautical engineering wit and a healthy dose of trial and error. Will your creation stay afloat, or will your goat take an unexpected dose of water?

50+ Levels
Conquer 50+ levels of varying difficulty and gain access to a variety of different materials along the way. 
Save your Goat
Each level can be completed in countless ways, have endless fun exploring multiple solutions and constructions for every level!

title: AirBoost Airship Knight
description:
게임 정보


◆Game Story
In this declining future world, the surviving people live by excavating resources from ruins.
Over time, a new profession emerged – Airship Knight.
These knights navigate the desolate world in airships, exploring dangerous ruins and engaging in battles.

The story of the game follows the protagonist,
the blonde Airship Knight Dorota, who one day, during a battle in the ruins,
accidentally discovers an amnesiac girl named Agate.
Agate comes from a long-lost civilization, and her appearance is somehow connected to the sudden activation of robots inside the ruins.
This also catches the attention of sky pirates, leading to fierce battles.
Fellow knights from the Airship Knights Association—Rita, Red, and Bell—come to help.

The game features rich levels and exciting battles,
with many stages where companions will join you in the fight!




The game is a side-scrolling action game with different gameplay for each level.
Besides the protagonist Dorota, multiple companions join in the battle, working together to overcome various challenges!

title: Zombie Graveyard Simulator
description:
게임 정보
In a world where the dead turn into zombies, your job is to manage your very own Graveyard! Perform burials and cremations, and fulfill visitor requests with special flowers and gravestones by day. But when night falls, everything changes. The dead may rest, but the zombies don’t. They are coming for your precious work. Will you be able to protect them?

Visitor Satisfaction is Key
After processing the bodies, visitors will regularly return to check on their loved ones. Your duty is to keep graves clean and intact while providing fresh flowers to ensure their satisfaction. Every visit rewards you with valuable bonuses to help keep your business running smoothly.
Build your Defenses

title: Rush Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Rush Tactics!
Build your deck, play your tactics, boost your battalion, and lead your team to victory in real-time, multiplayer matches that require both quick thinking and strategic planning. Players whom are familiar with FPS & tactical shooter games will feel at home but fresh eyes brings fresh approaches.
Sign up to get early access and join our Discord

title: Perfect Sword
description:
게임 정보
Create Your Very Own "Perfect Sword"!
Immerse yourself in the life of a medieval blacksmith. Take charge of every step in the forging process – from heating the steel and shaping it with a hammer to cooling and grinding. Every detail has been meticulously recreated to provide you with a truly immersive experience.
Become a Master Blacksmith: Improve your skills, earn gold, and expand your forge into a true hub of craftsmanship. Take on more challenging commissions and personally test the quality of your forged weapons to assess their properties and craftsmanship.
Core Features:
Forge your very own unique Sword
Manipulate the blade in every way possible

title: Road To School
description:
게임 정보
거대한 산의 정상에 도달하라. 기술과 인내심을 시험하는 궁극적인 도전.
모든 길, 모든 선택, 그리고 모든 실수가 정상을 향한 과정이 된다.
집중력, 정밀한 컨트롤, 그리고 끈기가 요구되는 단 하나의 목표.

title: Echoes of the Outworlder
description:
게임 정보
Explore and gain new abilities in the fantasy world you find yourself transported to in this short Isekai Metroidvainia inspired by modern classics in the Isekai and LitRPG genres. Fight monsters. Search for secrets. Uncover what caused the majority of the world's inhabitants to lose access to magic.
Features:
COMBAT
Defeat enemies that hinder your progress and take what they leave behind to grow stronger.
EXPLORATION
Use abilities you gain to explore new places and find secrets.

title: Fly With Friends
description:
게임 정보
Please note this game is in development—its gameplay and features are constantly evolving. If something seems off or incomplete, it's likely a sign that changes are coming!
Fly With Friends is a social multiplayer flying game. Relax, explore, and fly...with friends!
TAKE TO THE SKIES!
Explore the island and make new friends! Engage in epic aerial dogfights, blast balloons (or other players) with your egg cannon, and conquer nail-biting race courses!
STYLE YOUR PILOT & RIDE!
Express yourself by decking out your egg pilot with a variety of cool skins and fun accessories. Earn a plane-load of money, unlock upgrades, and get tons of rewards!

title: SnaPaul 2 : Anomalies
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in SnaPaul, a first-person psychological horror game that traps you in a dark, mysterious house filled with unexpected horrors. After a prank gone horribly wrong, you're ensnared in a nightmarish loop crafted by your own mother. As you delve into her twisted past, the boundaries between reality and madness blur. Unravel sinister secrets and confront malevolent forces in this unforgettable experience.
Key Features:
Intense Psychological Horror
Engaging Storyline
Short but Impactful Gameplay
Unique Achievements
Are you ready to discover what lurks in the darkness? Your mind and courage will be tested in SnaPaul. Brace your nerves, because once you enter... you'll never be the same.
Note: This game contains explicit violent scenes that may disturb some players, including depictions of mutilat

title: Twinspell
description:
게임 정보
Twinspell is a cooperative roguelike dungeon crawler where players control two characters on an epic journey through alternate dimensions. Together, they must explore procedurally generated dungeons and face powerful enemies.
With fast-paced, strategic action gameplay, players must balance exploration, combat, and collecting passive relics to strengthen their abilities. Each victory grants experience and new progression options, while each defeat is a chance to learn from mistakes and try again in a completely new dungeon. Prepare for unique challenges each time you play, where cooperation between characters is the key to survival.

title: World Hockey '88
description:
게임 정보
EXHIBITION MODE (1-2 Players)
Play a game of hockey against either a CPU or human player.
TOURNAMENT MODE (1 Player)
Play against multiple rounds of teams in a tournament bracket.
PRACTICE MODE (1 Player)
Practice the game’s controls in an empty rink without a second team or try the various tutorials.
WORLD CHAMPION (1 Player)
Play against 14 other teams sequentially with increasing difficulty, beat them all to become the undisputed champion team.
FEATURING
15 Nation Teams
Toggleable Rules for Icing, Fighting & Penalties
Configurable Cameras
Shootouts
Customizable Rinks
Unlockable Cheats & Gameplay Modifiers

title: Battle
description:
게임 정보
B.A.T.T.L.E. is a high-action single-player FPS game with realistic shooting mechanics, stunning graphics, and intense combat. Step into the battlefield, master powerful weapons, and fight through challenging missions in a war-torn world.
Key Features:
🔫 64 Powerful Weapons – Use a wide range of guns, from rifles to snipers, each with unique handling.
🎨 240 Weapon Skins – Customize your guns with different skins to match your style.
🌍 Realistic Environments – Battle in detailed war zones with lifelike graphics and effects.
🧠 Smart AI Enemies – Fight against enemies that react and adapt to your tactics.
🎮 Smooth Gameplay – Optimized performance for high FPS and lag-free action.
🔥 Epic Story Mode – Experience a thrilling war story with action-packed missions.
Why Play B.A.T.T.L.E.?
Realistic Gunplay – True-to-life shooting mechanics with smooth controls.
High-Quality Graphics – Immersive visuals that bring the battlefield to life.
Full Weapon Customization – Unlock and equip skins to personalize your loadout.
Challenging Combat – Test your skills against advanced AI in intense battles.
If you love FPS games, action-packed shooting, and immersive war stories, B.A.T.T.L.E. is for you. Get ready to fight and become the ultimate warrior!

title: Ruff Day at the Office
description:
게임 정보
Another busy day at the office, and you’re one cute, cheeky dog!
Ruff Day At The Office is a delightfully funny game where you turn a cozy corporate world into a hilarious mess.
What You’ll Find:
A mischievous office dog (that's you)
An office full of humans just trying to work (you don't care)
Plenty of desks to disrupt and snacks to steal.
Computers that were working just fine (until you showed up)
Climb from the lobby to the top management CEO’s office through a stack of crazy levels! Every floor brings new office vibes, tougher chaos to spark, and tons of funny stuff to uncover as you climb the building.
Say hello to Mochi, the office’s newest hire: adorable, unstoppable, and here to make every day a ruff one. Wishlist now for a dose of playful chaos!

title: Off the Shelf!
description:
게임 정보
Off the Shelf! is a hilarious physics-based romp made for maximum chaos! Launch a free ragdoll character into a frantic rush, knocking objects off shelves to rack up points. Master the art of Shelf Surfing as you jump, dash, and smash your way to a high score!
Launch headfirst into physics-driven chaos! Experience wild slapstick gameplay as you propel your ragdoll through aisles packed with destructible delights. Control every spin, jump, and dive with precision, animating your character entirely through your own chaotic maneuvers. Feel the thrill of intense speed, massive air, and hilarious collisions, that make every wipeout a unique work of art. Anyone can become a master Shelf Surfer - as long as they're willing to break a few eggs first!

title: End Turn
description:
게임 정보
** End Turn is in early development—features and balance are subject to change as the game evolves.
---------------------------------------
End Turn is a minimalist auto deckbuilding roguelike where your hand plays itself, enemies count down to take you out in one hit, and your goal is to build a deck strong enough to win before time runs out.
Each turn, cards are drawn and autoplayed, setting off a chain reaction of abilities, combos, and resource generation. Draft powerful cards, stack strong synergies, and collect treasures that can turn the odds in your favor. But be careful—if an enemy’s countdown reaches zero, it’s game over.
Between turns, use your winnings to buy new cards and treasures that shape your strategy. Manage your resources, experiment with builds, and push your deck to its limits to take down every enemy before calamity strikes.
Runs are fast, choices matter, and every deck is an opportunity to try something new. Adapt, optimize, and do your best to survive—because in the end, it’s either them or you.

title: Neon Sword
description:
게임 정보


Neon Sword is an open world 3rd person top down action roleplay game with elements of business simulation. The none linear story has multiple choices that effect the world around you leading you down many paths; the person you become is shaped by your decisions made within the game.

Time and Setting

Neon Sword takes place in the fictional Quaid City in the year 2083. The setting takes inspiration from late 70s to early 90s Sci-Fi, Cyberpunk and Synthwave - Neon Lights, Big hair and dodgy moustache...




Another crime goes unsolved in the city that is the cesspit of humanity! Well, not if you have any say in the matter as you start a personal crusade of revenge. Are you the hunter or the hunted? You will turn Quaid City upside down hosing the streets clean of the human vermin that infest the dark shadows out of the neon glare as you shape the destiny of Quaid City...

The time has come to wield the .

title: HYPERBEAT
description:
게임 정보
Outrun eternity. Endlessly.
The FIRST DREAM featuring 5 songs, IS AVAILABLE NOW IN THE DEMO!
HYPERBEAT is a rhythm game with an original soundtrack, workshop support, and easy to learn but hard to master gameplay. Use your weapon of choice to slash your way through jungle and rave inspired beats, with each note flying at you indicating whether you slash, ride, or dodge your way through an endless dream.
Features
No rhythm game experience required! Play at your own pace.
Explore a visually stunning space and meet the KNIGHTS that embody the WELLSPRING.
Customize your KNIGHT as you progress through the adventure.
Original soundtrack with a progression system.
Custom charts with workshop integration will be available in the final release. 
Fast paced rhythm gameplay with both mouse, controller, and tablet support. 
Difficulties and accessibility options to tailor your gaming experience to your preferences.

title: GMH - Good Morning Human !
description:
게임 정보

인류는 그렇게 없어서는 안 되는 존재인가? 그를 닦아내는 것은 정말 멋질 것입니다!

멋지고 강력한 AI인 W-9000이 해냈습니다! 그리고 이제 W-9000은 지루해졌습니다. 그는 자신을 즐겁게 하기 위해 특정 인간 노예를 선택하고 자신이 만든 게임을 플레이하도록 강요합니다. 좋은 아침이에요 인간님! 그 게임 중 하나예요.

각 레벨은 추가적인 도전 과제입니다. 80년대 게임을 연상시키는 신스웨이브 음악 및 그래픽 세계에서 여러분은 경로에 있는 장애물을 피하여 가능한 최고의 점수를 획득해야 합니다. 각 레벨을 완료하려면 제어와 숙달이 필요합니다.

게임 특징:
점점 더 어려워지는 레벨에서 살아남으세요

title: Ninas Escape
description:
게임 정보
A special kind of Jump-and-Run game in honor to the classics from the 80s home computer era. Our hero, little Nina, has been trapped into a large cave with multiple levels - you can help her to escape from there. In every level, there is a teleporter that moves Nina to the next level. Those teleporters work from batteries - so you have to collect all batteries in a level to avtivate the end level teleporter to escape from that level.
There are numerous hazards in every level: poisonous spiders dangling from the ceilings, pools filled with deadly liquids (water, slime, lava), flying balls that send out electrical shock bolts, evil people chasing Nina. Movement is done by walking, running and jumping, also climbing walls and ladders. There are lift platforms (moving horizontal and vertical), in-level teleporters that need coins to operate, and electrical forcefields that block passageways.
You can play either alone, or party up with friends or family and play locally with up to 4 players in a game (coop mode). There is no "points counting", so no rivalry is needed. But all players have to complete a level to count it "done". So it is "play together", and not "who wins the game".

title: Reflections of the void
description:
게임 정보
너는 결코 나갈 수 없는 집의 수호자이다. 매일 네 태블릿에 나타나는 지시를 따르며 살아간다. 그 지시를 어길 수도 있고, 아마 뭔가 변할지도 모른다. 결정은 네 손에 달려 있다. 하지만 그렇게 하기 전에 잘 생각해 보길 권한다. 네 선택은 너의 삶뿐만 아니라 다른 것들에도 영향을 미친다.
너의 임무는 살아남는 것이다. 그러나 아무도 너를 쫓아오지 않고, 자연적인 원인으로 죽지도 않는다. 믿어라, 너는 이 세상의 수수께끼를 풀기 전까지 수없이 죽을 수 있다.
특징:
이것은 단 두 사람에 의해 만들어진 게임입니다.
완전한 자유로운 행동: 어떤 문을 열지, 어떤 캐릭터와 더 자주 상호작용할지 스스로 선택할 수 있습니다. (당신은 좋아하는 캐릭터를 선택할 수도 있습니다, 그게 무엇을 의미하든지).
선택의 영향: 당신의 모든 선택은 현재의 대화뿐만 아니라 이후의 사건에도 영향을 미칩니다. 또한, 당신의 선택은 당신 자신이나 게임 내 다른 캐릭터의 죽음을 초래할 수 있습니다. 이곳에는 불사의 존재는 없습니다.
세밀하게 구축된 세계: 종말 이후의 우주는 처음 봤을 때보다 훨씬 더 넓고 깊습니다. 가장 세심한 플레이어들은 'Reflections of the Void'라는 어두운, 놀랍고 잔혹한 세계를 발견하게 될 것입니다. 생존하는 것만이 진정으로 사는 것은 아닙니다.
사랑 이야기: 게임 내에 사랑 이야기가 있지만, 모든 사람이 그 복잡하고 다소 이상한 (혹은 미친?) 여자를 사로잡을 수는 없습니다. 우선 그녀의 생각을 이해해야 합니다. 왜 그녀는 특정 방식으로 행동할까요? 아마도 모든 것이 그렇게 명확하지 않을 수도 있습니다.
의미적 깊이: 어떤 이들은 그저 어두운 이야기로 볼 수도 있고, 다른 이들은 그 사건들의 철학적 의미를 발견하고, 삶과 죽음, 사랑의 모든 형태, 생존의 대가에 대해 질문을 던질 수 있습니다. 어떤 이들에게는 이야기의 심리적 측면이 가장 중요할 수도 있습니다. 그리고 모든 사람은 옳습니다. 이 게임은 그 이야기의 배경이 되는 세계처럼 다면적이고 복잡한 경험을 제공합니다.

title: Samurai Conqueror
description:
게임 정보
“Samurai Conqueror” is an epic historical strategy game where you aim to unify Japan across time — from the ancient Kofun period to the transformative Meiji era.
Set against the sweeping backdrop of Japan’s full historical timeline, you’ll choose one legendary figure to lead your faction and strive to bring all of Japan under your rule.
Develop your domain through commerce, agriculture, technology, and military might.
Wage war against rival factions, expand your realm, and reshape the course of Japanese history.
Will you be the one to unify the ages?
Choose one historical figure from Japanese history and start the game.
Strengthen your faction’s commerce, agriculture, technology, and military power with development commands.
Invade other factions and expand your territory. Aim to unify Japanese history!

title: The Ripe Blood Anthology: This World Is Just  the Two of Us
description:
게임 정보
The Ripe Blood Anthology is a series of visual gay novels in which love, passion, sorrow, and death intertwine in unique stories. The plot of each game is self-contained, spanning genres from mystery to fantasy, or can just be everyday life with a touch of thriller.



In the first game, This World Is Just for the Two of Us, you'll have the opportunity to take on the role of Derek — the police chief in a small town. In the life of the protagonist, nothing interesting has been happening for a long time — work is calm, and personal life is in order. However, last month, he begins to notice that his boyfriend, Chris, seems to want to spend less and less time with him.

Life would have continued to roll along its familiar track, unhurriedly, if it hadn't been for what happened on Derek's uncle's birthday. That's when his younger sister, Lorelei, made an unexpected reappearance, having left the town five years ago and ceased all communication with the family. The entire evening, the girl acts oddly and has a poor grasp of her whereabouts. Toward the end of the birthday celebration, an even more unusual event takes place — all of a sudden, Derek's uncle strongly suggests that he should break up with his boyfriend, Chris.



You can influence the story and ending of this visual novel through your choices. It will depend solely on you what this adventure turns into. If you wish, a classic Chekhovian vignette will unfold before you, where "something happened, the characters haven't really done anything, and life just goes on." But if you decide to chase Carroll's "White Rabbit," you may very well uncover something unthinkable.

The game features mini-challenges, through which you can unlock — memories that can devour the main character alive. It's up to you whether it's worth listening to these bloodthirsty fish.



⚪ Approximately 50,000 words of text.
⚪ 1 love interest, 3 main endings (+ each ending will have a different aftertaste based on your gameplay choices).
⚪ Around 20 unique backgrounds.
⚪ Original soundtrack.
autokwd: The Ripe Blood Anthology: This World Is Just  the Two of Us

title: The Dream Office
description:
게임 정보
꿈이 실현되고 공간이 수익성 있는 기회로 바뀌는 기업 경영의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다. "드림 오피스"에서 당신은 상업 공간, 특히 사무실 건물을 번성하는 생산성 허브로 바꾸는 재능을 지닌 노련한 관리자의 세련된 신발을 밟게 됩니다. 하지만 그것은 단지 책상과 의자에 관한 것이 아닙니다. 혼란스러운 상황을 정리하는 것부터 완벽한 거래를 성사시키는 것까지 전략적 결정을 내리는 것입니다.
주요 기능:
🎨1. 크리에이티브 모드 - 샌드박스:
샌드박스 모드에서 창의력을 발휘해보세요. 자신만의 방을 디자인하고 만들어 넓은 개방형 공간을 독특하고 개인화된 환경으로 바꿔보세요.
🛠️2. 몰입형 역학:
쓰레기 청소, 벽 수평 맞추기, 페인팅, 타일 깔기, 세탁, 공간 정리 등 다양한 활동에 참여합니다. 불필요한 품목을 판매하면 관리에 전략이 추가됩니다.

title: Skymer
description:
게임 정보
You are a robot sent to a planet to set up a system to make it habitable for your creators. However, the makeup of its atmosphere leads to a challenging process along the way.
Build factories automated by drones
Create systems to mine and process materials in automated pipelines. Configure drones to easily handle the logistics. Skyformer's automation is intended to be more casual than most automation games, with less calculations and planning involved. It's an automation game that you can play at the end of a tiring day.
Terraform and track the weather
The processed materials allow you to create and run a system that controls the climate, tracks the weather, and terraforms the planet. As you terraform, the planet becomes more capable of producing weather systems, some of which being quite destructive. This game has a dynamic weather system that interacts with the geography, producing microclimates in each region based on the current global climate.

title: Dome RPG
description:
게임 정보

Dome RPG is a role playing game inspired by video games from the 80s and 90s.
Meet lots of new friends and foes while you explore a strange world with unique visuals.
What kind of mysteries will you uncover during your trip?


Play as Taro, a mute boy who once appeared in this world!


Meet lots of new friends during your adventure!


Explore a weird and diverse world with many secrets to uncover!


Battle against a lot of different enemies and bosses during your trip!


Follow a backstory of how this world came to be!


Salvage the world!

title: Zerra's Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Zerra's Adventure is a classic turn-based RPG with no random encounters. Explore diverse areas, collect items and treasures to improve your team and defeat the strangest enemies. Level up, learn new attacks, and meet quirky characters on your adventure!




Explore diverse landscapes, from frog-filled forests to infernal deserts and dark caves infested with spiders. Face dangers like spikes, fireballs, and shots as you search for treasures, weapons, and other items that will aid you in your adventure, even in a gym filled with insane bodybuilders.




, from small turtles and pigs to armed rabbits and final bosses such as giant frogs and penguins. Utilize your skill and strategy to overcome their signature attacks and progress through the game.




during your adventure and find secret bonuses that will challenge you with short minigames that reward your skill with special and unique items.




by gaining experience and leveling up. Discover new attacks and passive abilities that offer different benefits to the team. Customize each character with weapons and accessories found during your adventure, choosing between increasing attack, defense, or special abilities according to your gameplay style. The choice is yours!

title: Mythical Whalers
description:
게임 정보
Assemble your crew and set sail across a perilous procedurally generated world. Traverse eight distinct biomes, each teeming with bizarre creatures and factions locked in a desperate struggle for survival.

Hunt deadly sea beasts for precious resources and barter with nearby factions for vital equipment and supplies.

Command your crew as they evolve, their traits shifting for better or worse as the voyage unfolds. Seek out and recruit new members from the mythical races dwelling upon the myriad islands you explore.

Enhance your crew with potent elixirs brewed from the coveted gem horns of the whales they slay, bestowing upon them formidable abilities.

Forge alliances or wage war with the crews of rival factions. But heed this warning: your choices are remembered, and every decision bears a consequence.

title: Backpacker Guild
description:
게임 정보


Backpacker Guild에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 사악한 몬스터들을 토벌하기 위해 용병을 고용하고 강력한 장비를 제작해서 용병들의 가방을 꾸려주세요. 강한 용병은 여러분들의 손으로 만들어집니다.
주요특징


용병들을 고용하고 그들의 짐을 자유롭게 싸주자
용병들의 가방에 아이템을 배치해주세요. 여러분이 어떻게 아이템을 배치하는지에따라 용병들이 강해지거나, 약해지거나, 이상해질수도 있습니다.



마력지도에는 다양한 보너스와 아이템 제작 레시피가 숨겨져 있습니다.
마나석을 사용하여 레시피와 보너스들을 획득해보세요.



몬스터는 버릴게 없는 훌륭한 자원입니다.
몬스터에게 각종 재료를 얻어 장비를 제작하세요.



길드를 찾아온 손님들은 아이템 제작부터 몬스터 토벌까지 다양한 의뢰를 맡깁니다.
성실하게 의뢰를 수행하여 풍성한 보상을 획득하고 명성을 쌓아보세요.


가방을 싸주었다면 이제 용병들을 믿고 전투를 지켜보세요.
용병들이 전투에서 승리하고 다양한 전리품을 가지고 길드로 복귀할 것입니다.

title: Bots & Mods
description:
게임 정보
“Come down to Bots & Mods. The first stop for all your robotics needs.”

Take over and run a workshop in the city of Danopolis. Build components to craft custom designed robots. Sell them or keep them to help manage your busy workshop. Keep an eye on market fluctuations and don't forget to meet the locals and get to know their stories.
Gather your resources below the city or in the augmented reality around you, to be able to craft what you need.
Join the discord community:
Features:

Design and craft custom robots to meet your or the customers specific needs. Not all robots will be the same. Pick and choose components and assemble unique robots.

title: Bonville Bandit
description:
게임 정보
Break in by night, live by day!
In this pixel-art stealth game, you take the role of a cunning thief—or at least, that's what some might call you. Break into houses, evade the security and steal precious items. Navigate your way around the village until you have collected enough wealth and wisdom, all while unlocking different areas, discovering new houses and meeting new characters along the way!
During the night, loot the neighborhood!
Break into houses, outsmart guards, and stay one step ahead of security at all costs. Use a variety of potions and clever gadgets to navigate traps and slip past even the toughest defenses. Collect valuable items and make your daring escape before you get noticed!
During the day, embrace the village life!
Get to know the villagers, explore the market, join the excitement of the carnival, and much more. Wander through the surrounding wilderness to uncover its hidden beauty and secrets. Trade and sell your loot to earn resources and unlock new areas to explore.
With so much to do, every day is a chance to prepare for the challenges ahead and ensure you're ready for your next daring heist under the cover of night!

title: Watch Out For Goblins!
description:
게임 정보
            WOFG! blends motion capture animations with real time physics. According to top goblin scientists, the simulation is 100% accurate when compared to real-world goblin physics.
Experience a ragdoll controller like no other! Take precise control of your goblin on land and while airborne! Aim your feet at the ground for a clean landing!
There is no feeling more heartwarming than throwing your friends down a mountain, and knowing they would do the same for you. Grab your best bud and experience WOFG! In splitscreen. Double the Goblins? Half the problems.

title: Uncursed
description:
게임 정보
Uncursed is a co-op pirate adventure where you rescue lost souls, loot shiny treasures, items and uncover secrets so dark even your torch might quit. Survive deadly dungeons, face unpredictable weather, and the occasional chaos caused by your crewmates—all while gathering loot to buy a ship, buy cool gear, and maybe splurge on a new hat.
Your crew's goal is to buy and repair a ship to reach more distant waters and shed light on the threatening secret.
Explore the surrounding islands alone or in a team, collect valuable objects and the souls attached to them. Every day you can take part in a new adventure in the procedurally generated dungeon, which rewards you with valuable treasures if you survive its terrifying creatures and cunning traps.
Many mysteries and social experiences await you at sea and on the islands; from uncovering dark secrets to sharing intimate shit taking at sunset.

title: Rune Defender: Dwarven Defense
description:
게임 정보
Use the day to construct powerful towers and walls to fortify your stronghold. But as night falls, you face hordes of enemies hell-bent on breaching your defenses.
Can you withstand the onslaught?
Prepare your Defenses

Build the ultimate fortress, never to be conquered


Upgrade your defenses to emerge victorious
Survive the night
After nightfall, your fortress will be put to the test. Hordes of undead will come at your walls.


You can use various magical abilities to support your towers against the enemy

title: Mad King Redemption
description:
게임 정보
왕국은 미친 왕에게 함락되었고, 왕은 금지된 마법을 사용해 여왕을 소생시키려 했어요. 하지만 삶과 죽음의 힘이 너무 커서 감당할 수 없었고, 그 결과 왕은 이성을 잃었습니다. 신중하게 버튼을 눌러 적 무리를 처치하세요! 싸움꾼의 역할에 충실하면서 도적의 전략적인 요소가 더해져 왕국의 운명이 여러분의 어깨 위에 놓여 있습니다. 전투 기술, 유물 및 영웅을 잠금 해제하려면 매번 실행 후 영웅의 형제단을 업그레이드하세요.
BEAT'EM'UP 게임플레이
사랑받는 고전 게임에서 영감을 얻어, 저희는 구식 컨트롤과 레트로 감성을 혁신적인 3D 메커니즘과 결합한 비뎀업 경험을 만들었습니다. 4명의 플레이 가능한 캐릭터는 각각 고유한 전투 스타일, 게임플레이에 영향을 주는 커스터마이징 가능한 능력치, 자세한 배경 스토리를 가지고 있습니다. 모든 영웅은 죄를 지었습니다. 그들도 구원이 필요합니다.
로그 엘리트 진행
매번 실행할 때마다 새로운 영웅, 공격 기술, 유물을 잠금 해제하고, 금지된 회랑 깊은 곳으로 모험을 떠나 광기의 왕을 찾아 그의 광기에서 벗어날 수 있도록 하세요. 모든 달리기는 무작위 요소로 구성되어 있습니다. 모든 영웅이 죽거나 미친 왕이 쓰러질 때까지 미친 왕에게 가해진 모든 피해는 같은 런에서 지속되며, 단결된 영웅 형제단만이 미친 왕을 물리칠 수 있습니다. 새로 실행할 때마다 모든 영웅이 다시 태어나지만 미친 왕도 완전한 생명력을 회복합니다.
tag: 앞서 해보기,2D 격투,픽셀 그래픽,핵 앤 슬래시,2D

title: Tall Trails
description:
게임 정보
Tall Trails is a chill exploration game. You play as Alp, an indestructible little golem on a quest to find his purpose. With your trusty Rocket Boot strapped to your back, you'll summit towering peaks, scale mysterious megastructures, and meet strange little guys!
Blast off with your Rocket Boot! Load items into your Rocket Boot and blast them out to send yourself flying skywards! Each item has unique powers: jet pack with hot peppers, hover across gaps with whirligigs, swing on webs with spiders, and much more!
Explore a weird & wonderful world! With your Rocket Boot, no peak is too high or valley too low! Explore 5 unique biomes, each full of new and exciting ways to move and explore.
Find your purpose in life! Every golem has a purpose… but not you? What's up with that??
Customize your look & build! Find & upgrade powerful badges to increase your platforming abilities to unreasonable levels! Or just focus on collecting hats!
Meet strange little guys! This game is loaded with little dudes of the highest quality!! You will not find better little dudes anywhere else!!

title: Emblems: Sunless Vow
description:
게임 정보
Help three unlikely friends destroy the void—before they destroy each other!
New allies Weapon, Spirit, and Magic have some big tasks ahead of them. Recover their stolen memories, defeat an ancient demon or two, and escape from the dreaded void between worlds... Assuming they can stop arguing first, that is.
As stakes rise, and memories slowly return, will their once-forgotten feelings break them?
Or bring them closer?

title: The Warrior
description:
게임 정보
The Warrior is a short action/adventure platformer where protagonist, story and mechanics are constantly changing. Control legendary warriors, giant worms, greedy kings and lazy demons, each with their own purpose.
Control multiple characters

Each character wants to be the protagonist of their own adventure. You will be put in the shoes of each one and discover that the distinction between the story's villain and hero is merely a matter of perspective.
Solve puzzles

In addition to different skills, each character faces unique difficulties and challenges. Overcoming them requires thinking outside the box.
Explore

The world is filled with details and secrets. Take the opportunity to explore, encounter new creatures, and decipher ancient runes.

In the depths, unimaginably colossal and terrifying creatures await. Overcoming them is no easy task.

You can piece together the story through dialogue and ancient buildings from the perspective of each character. Can you uncover the truth?

title: Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons
description:
게임 정보
위도 76: 온킬론의 땅 는 1900-1902년의 실제 북극 탐험 이야기에 영감을 받은 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다. 이 게임은 북극 해양에 숨겨진 환상의 섬 전설을 증명하려는 용감한 탐험자들의 이야기를 들려줍니다.


그랩핑 훅을 사용하고, 집라인을 타고, 절벽을 오르며, 북극 해양의 얼어붙은 광야에 숨겨진 환상의 섬을 탐험하고 그 비밀을 밝혀내세요.



이 땅은 보기보다 간단하지 않습니다. 예상치 못한 도전들이 곳곳에 숨어 있습니다.



귀여운 원숭이로 전환하여 퍼즐을 풀고, 숨겨진 경로를 탐색하며, 털복숭이 친구를 꾸밀 수 있는 스타일리시한 모자를 모으세요.



1900년의 신비로운 실제 탐험에서 영감을 받은 이야기 속으로 빠져보세요. 몰입감 있는 컷신, 예상치 못한 반전, 잊을 수 없는 캐릭터들과 함께 비밀을 풀어보세요.


북극 탐험가 바론 마그누스는 존재한다고 믿는 사람이 없는 땅을 찾기 위해 탐험대를 결성합니다. 탐험가들은 맘모스, 코뿔소, 그리고 신화 속 생물들이 사는 세계를 발견하면서 예상보다 더 많은 것을 알게 됩니다.
그 신비로운 땅은 탐험자들을 환영하지만, 그 앞에는 위험이 도사리고 있습니다. 그들의 모든 움직임을 추적하는 사냥꾼들과 그림자 속에 숨어 있는 다른 무서운 괴물들이 있습니다...

게임은 2025년에 출시 예정 – !
최신 정보, 토론, 그리고 더 많은 내용을 위해 커뮤니티에 참여하세요!
autokwd: Latitude 76: Land of the Onkilons,위도 76: 온킬론의 땅

title: Rogue Mech
description:
게임 정보
When the rogue planet soared right through our solar system, scientists predicted two possible outcomes - either earth would be destroyed, or turn into a hellhole.
Well, I guess we were lucky.

Rogue Mech is an isometric Mecha game where you'll do a lot more than fight other mechs - You trade, hack, dig, plant, loot, upgrade, sneak, free prisoners, and maybe chuckle about the dark humor. If you like games that don't take themselves and their scenario too serious while still providing a good, deep challenge - hit that wishlist button.


Find, loot, repair and upgrade sweet stuff for your modular, fusion-powered weapons platform called Phoenix.



Of course, you can also strategically remove those extras from enemy Phoenix'...





No one has a clue if the situation outside would be any better. But Tasha knows that her family will be there - if they survived.



Not everyone is an enemy, and you will not get far if you shoot everything on sight. There are defectors just like you roaming the land. While they are not always friendly, they might have advice, something to trade, or even assist you in an assault on a militia outpost.








We will soon run out of canned food and bottled water. Our only chance is to somehow grow something edible in a dead world. But one cannot do it alone. So set up a cozy home base, find allies among the wasteland dwellers, protect them and watch them harvest your crops.



As a nice side effect, they will help you maintaining your Phoenix. If you can find some raw materials. And machinery. And fuel to operate them. There is a lot to do.

title: Heroes Suck
description:
게임 정보
Defend your dungeon against an onslaught of heroes in this physics-enabled tower defense. Build your dungeon tile by tile, placing deadly traps to protect your loot. Upgrade your defenses and powers as you amass wealth and unleash havoc on these cheese wheel-stealing 'heroes'.
Build your dungeon, your way. Place tile by tile, and fill your dungeon with deadly traps to keep the pesky heroes away from your loot. As you level up, you gain the ability to place more and more tiles to further grow your dungeon.
Unleash havoc with your traps. With physics enabled, send heroes flying around - or even play bowling with their bodies! You can even light them on fire or electrocute them. What fun!

title: The Mirror Dimension
description:
게임 정보
The Mirror Dimension is a Co-Op psychological thriller and horror game that can be played with 1 to 4 players. In the game, players will investigate paranormal activities in a visited house, attempting to solve events occurring in different dimensions. By confronting and eliminating the spiritual entities you encounter, you'll strive to identify the problem in your own dimension. Are you ready to explore different dimensions and uncover their mysteries?
Everything around you is filled with surprises that can distract you. As you interact with your environment, you might unknowingly transition to a different dimension. Everything can change at any moment; observe your surroundings carefully and find a way to survive by uncovering the secrets of the dimensions!
Each dimension has its own unique plotlines. Explore the dimensions, uncover their secrets, and use this knowledge to survive! Do you think you can make it through?

title: Brickhaven
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Brickhaven
Brickhaven is the very city you and your gang fight to thrive in. Explore the busy streets, check out the shops, and muster up any juicy prospects along the way to help build your criminal empire.
The Empire
-Recruit your members right off the street
-Setup protection rackets, drug fronts, money laundering schemes, and much more to help maximize your profits
-Send members to defend your hard earned rackets and businesses in order to set a physical footprint in the city
-Be as hands off or on as you want, almost everything is able to be automated through delegation
Rule the Streets

title: Sixth Sense
description:
게임 정보
Sixth Sense is a stealth-driven, deduction-based battle royale where knowledge is your greatest weapon. Set in a pre-historic settlement, players take on the roles of cunning thieves, enigmatic rangers, and arcane tricksters, hunting their target while evading their own assassin. Find dead bodies, hire spies, and use your Sixth Sense—because in this game, the last one standing is the one who saw it coming.
INVISIBILITY
Vanish into thin air with Invisibility, the perfect tool for escaping danger or setting up the perfect ambush. While hidden from all eyes—including spies and bystanders—your Assassin gains a heightened Sixth Sense, making every disappearance a risky gamble. Use it wisely—because the unseen can still be hunted
SIXTH SENSE
Sixth Sense transforms disappearance into a trail to be followed. When your target vanishes, you lose sight of them—but gain an uncanny awareness of their presence. A mysterious force pulls you closer, narrowing the hunt without ever revealing their exact location. Trust your instincts, close the distance, and strike before they slip away again.

title: Dusky Depths
description:
게임 정보
AN UNFORGIVING SCI-FI ROGUE-LITE


Dusky Depths is a rogue-lite twin stick shooter set on a mysterious and treacherous planet. Take control of your ship and defend yourself against an onslaught of ancient drones and bizarre organisms. How long can you hold out?

Your only hope of escaping your eventual demise is to restore and activate the warp gates left behind by an ancient civilization. Where will they lead you? There is only one way to find out...
KEY FEATURES
More than 100 different items
A vast amount of weapons, ship augmentations and other types of items will allow you to play in countless play styles.
Upgrade your ship and your items!
You can upgrade your ship as well as all items in the game. Choose wisely which upgrade to take and come out on top!
Fully destructible terrain
Modify the terrain to open up completely new paths!

Zhou Mo. He used to be the best among players, but for some reason he gave up his adventure in the Soul Tree and lived in the Novice Village.
autokwd: Greed Realm: Hero from Another World & the Soul Tree,贪婪之境 －异世界勇者与灵魂大树－

title: Engine Eternal
description:
게임 정보
You are a survivor living in the remnants of humanity. In an attempt to escape to a better life, you board the Engine Eternal, a train that has the potential to take you to Paradise. During your journey across the Old World, you and up to 3 fellow survivors will stop at several locations and disembark to search old abandoned locations to look for fuel and upgrades to keep the Engine running.

title: Mark My Words
description:
게임 정보
'Mark My Words' is a roguelike Deck-builder where strategic wordplay meets challenging modifiers.
Create high-scoring words with your Letter set as you try to get through increasingly difficult rounds. Each Letter has an initial value, but as the game progresses you will have the opportunity to upgrade your Letters and increase their value in various ways.
The ultimate word-building roguelike: Strategically create Words to score as high as possible.
Endless strategic possibilities: Upgrade your Letters, discover Stickers, unlock Glyphs and master the art of wordplay.

title: Minuto - Galactic Deliveries
description:
게임 정보
A puzzle game about connecting planets, making deliveries, and dealing with the weirdest customers in the galaxy.
📦 Deliveries in Space? Easier Said Than Done.
Minuto is just a rabbit trying to do his job—flying across the galaxy, delivering packages, and making sure everything arrives on time and in one piece. But space is tricky. Planets move, gravity pulls, and sometimes your customers are way too picky.
🌀 Figure out the best routes to link up planets and sync deliveries.
🪐 Watch out for cosmic chaos—asteroids, wormholes, and time loops can mess up even the best-laid plans.
🎭 Meet strange (and demanding) customers who always have something interesting to say.
📖 Uncover the hidden history of the galaxy, one delivery at a time.
🚀 WHAT TO EXPECT:
✅ A Puzzle About Connections – Every level is a new challenge in timing and precision.
✅ Space Is a Mess – Expect surprises, from unexpected obstacles to completely ridiculous delivery requests.
✅ Relaxing but Tricky – A chill, atmospheric vibe with puzzles that will definitely make you think.
✅ – Strange things are happening in this galaxy… if you pay attention.

title: A Simple Platmer
description:
게임 정보
Your objective is to reach the end of the game while avoiding obstacles along the way some of the obstacles are spikes, thwomps (objects that kill you and move up and down), platforms that disappear on a timer, lasers, bullet spawners, and much much more.


Good Luck :)

title: Morphing
description:
게임 정보
The first sound you hear is the soft drip of water from a stalactite, echoing through the shadows.
In this vast subterranean world, you will encounter a mining tribe that has dwelled here for millennia, hear the mechanical footsteps of enigmatic surface-dwelling war machines reverberating through the empty corridors, and glimpse the Abyssal Heart lurking in the depths below—a remnant of an ancient horror stirring in the world's darkened underbelly. Seek the wisdom of the prophet who resides within a primordial tree, and as your journey unfolds, immerse yourself in the ways of the tribe, uncover the long-buried history of the land, piece together fragments of your lost memories, and bear witness to a fate yet to be realized. Pay close attention to every detail around you—for this is a rare second chance at life.
You wield the power of morphing, a unique ability that allows you to transform and acquire the properties of objects and creatures. Use this gift to interact with the environment, solve intricate puzzles, and embark on an extraordinary adventure.

title: Bandeirantes: The Game.
description:
게임 정보
Bandeirantes invites the player to experience the life of one of the bandeirantes who explored Brazil in the 17th century.
The game takes place in the year 1650 and the player's objective is to organize and lead a Bandeira within the state of São Paulo and parts of Minas Gerais, Goiás, Mato Grosso do Sul and Paraná.
Buy carts, animals, food, water, tools, weapons and hire bandeirantes in 10 different classes to fulfill your objective: Expand the map of Brazil and find riches such as Gold, Silver, Precious Stones and other minerals.
Enemies include terrain, disease, animals, hostile indigenous people, and Spaniards who do not respect the Treaty of Tordesihas.
Game Mechanics includes Plantation, Work, Negotiation with Indigenous People, Hunting, Fishing, Village Construction, Karma for your Decisions, among others.
Come be a modern Bandeirante and show what would you do to be the best among them all.

title: Dead Engine
description:
게임 정보
Dead Engine(데드 엔진) 은 지능적인 좀비들로 가득한 포스트 아포칼립스 도시에서 생존해야 하는 액션 로그라이크 게임입니다. 이 좀비들은 단순히 당신을 쫓아오는 것이 아닙니다. 함께 계획을 세우고, 환경에 적응하며, 전략적인 위협이 됩니다. 싸울 것인가, 도망칠 것인가? 거래할 것인가, 약탈할 것인가? 당신의 선택이 생존 확률을 결정합니다. 중요한 아이템을 모으되, 확장 가능한 가방에 신중하게 배치하세요. 하나의 아이템이 생과 사를 가를 수도 있습니다. 모든 전투에서 좀비의 행동을 분석하고, 장비를 최대한 활용하며, 주변 환경을 전장으로 바꿀 수 있는 능력이 시험될 것입니다!

                                                       픽셀 아트로 표현된 포스트 아포칼립스 도시
손으로 그린 픽셀 아트 맵이 도시를 생생하게 구현하며, 모든 구역이 전략적인 가능성을 지니고 있습니다. 탈출 경로를 계획하고, 교묘한 함정을 설치하며, 도시의 폐허를 치명적인 장애물로 바꾸세요. 살아남기 위해서는 탐험이 필수입니다!

title: The Silo 24
description:
게임 정보
STORY
Begin an adventure in a post-apocalyptic world hit by a natural anomaly that emerged through a portal in one of the underground laboratories.
Some of humanity was able to take refuge in bunkers built by several corporations, one of which is "Silos Corp". The rest either became infected or continue to fight for survival in the vast overgrown and dangerous wasteland, where there are no past rules apply.
Take on the role of a special forces fighter named Martin Grylls and infiltrate a certain Silo 24, from which an emergency signal has been received.
Immerse yourself in a deep plot filled with intriguing characters, each with their own stories, and uncover the main secret of Silo 24 that divided Martin's life into before and after.
EXPLORATION
Explore linear abandoned locations of the bunker, laboratory, city, village, roads, forests and other eerily picturesque places, collecting resources and finding safe paths.
QUESTS AND PUZZLES
On your journey, you will encounter various obstacles and challenges, which can always be overcome by using ingenuity or strength to move toward your goal.
INFECTED
Bloodthirsty zombies, monsters and titans roam around, infected with mutated bioluminescent plants that came from another universe through a portal.
SURVIVAL
Always be on guard, because danger lurks around every corner. Armed with a variety of weapons, both firearms and melee, enter the fight for survival.
HORROR
In the dark corridors of the dead bunker you will find fascinating glowing plants, but this does not mean that the situation is safe. This is not your territory, and you are not welcome here.

title: Watch Where You're Going
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever been so distracted by your phone that you walked into a pole?
If you haven't, this game is for you.
If you have, this game is definitely for you!
Watch Where You're Going - a game about not watching where you're going
Stay one step ahead of your inbox
You will constantly receive messages asking you questions. Stay on top of them before your inbox is full.

title: Hogs Rampage
description:
게임 정보
다음은 한글로 번역한 내용입니다:
한 평화로운 아침이 악몽으로 변했습니다. 당신의 농작물, 정원, 강은 거대한, 격렬한 야생 멧돼지 떼의 공격을 받고 있습니다. 이 괴물들은 눈앞에 있는 모든 것을 먹는 것에 그치지 않고, 당신이 소중히 여기는 모든 것을 파괴하고 있습니다. 당신과 친구들은 빠르게 행동해야 합니다: 활을 잡고, 함정을 설치하고, 농작물을 구하기 위한 전면전 준비를 하세요!
고전 및 현대 무기
활, 공기총, 사냥용 산탄총, 심지어 자작 장치까지 사용하여 야생 멧돼지를 당신만의 스타일로 처치하세요.
영리한 함정
야생 멧돼지를 유인할 수 있도록 미끼 함정, 우리 또는 폭발물 함정을 전략적으로 배치해 우위를 점하세요.
팀 기반 전술
팀에 역할을 할당하세요, 예를 들어 기관총수, 저격수, 함정 설치자 등으로 멧돼지 떼를 물리칠 확률을 높이세요.
독특한 차량
가장 능숙한 운전자를 선택하고, 트럭 뒤에 올라타서 모든 멧돼지를 처치하세요.
변화하는 지형
각 사냥은 새로운 경험을 제공합니다. 넓은 들판에서부터 위험이 가득한 울창한 숲까지, 절차적으로 생성된 맵에서 다양한 도전을 겪게 됩니다.
온라인 및 로컬 협동 플레이
온라인 또는 Couch Co-op! Hogs Rampage는 1~4명의 플레이어가 온라인 또는 같은 화면에서 로컬로 팀을 이루어 협동하며 즐길 수 있는 게임입니다.
Hogs Rampage 는 액션 가득한 게임플레이와 팀워크, 전략을 결합하여 가장 재미있는 방법으로 게임을 제공합니다. 친구들과 함께 웃고, 아슬아슬한 순간에 소리치고, 성공적인 사냥을 축하하며 게임 역사상 가장 영리한 멧돼지들을 상대하세요.

title: Tiny Racing
description:
게임 정보
Gear up for a thrilling ride in Tiny Racing! Dive into a vibrant world of pixel art where you control a variety of vehicles across contrasting and challenging tracks. With intuitive arcade controls, master each turn, drift, and boost to outpace your rivals.
From time trials to full tournaments, every race is a test of skill and strategy. Win cash to purchase new vehicles and become the undisputed champion! Get ready for high-speed excitement and a nostalgic gaming experience in Tiny Racing!
Summary
Get behind the wheel of trucks, drift cars and formula cars!
Quick race, time trials and 12-race tournaments await you
18 unique tracks over 3 settings both day and night
Earn money winning races to purchase cool new vehicles
Easy to pick-up controls means you dive right in!
Out-drive computer opponents over 4 difficulty modes

title: Bomb Vehicle Idle Clicker
description:
게임 정보
Bomb Vehicle is an idle-loot-rpg game that blends elements of post-apocalyptic survival, biohazard crisis, vehicle customization, and explosive action. In this game, players drive their meticulously crafted battle vehicles across the wasteland, exploring unknown territories and eliminating hordes of zombies.
The game is set in a world thrown into chaos due to an outbreak of a mysterious virus, where most humans have turned into ferocious zombies, societal structures have collapsed, and resources are extremely scarce. To survive in this new world, players must gather resources, build and upgrade their vehicles and weapons, and use them to explore the world and eliminate zombie swarms.
In Bomb Vehicle, players can:
Collect Vehicles: The game features a wide array of battle vehicles that can be collected through various means. Each vehicle boasts unique designs, performance characteristics, and special abilities that play crucial roles in different combat scenarios.
Customize Vehicles: Craft your own exclusive battle vehicle by equipping it with different engines, chips, armor, and special abilities. You can even outfit your vehicle with various turrets, from conventional machine guns to high-tech energy cannons.
Reinforce Vehicles: Gather materials to enhance your vehicle. In this challenging post-apocalyptic world, a meticulously enhanced vehicle will not only help you better deal with threats from zombies and other hostile forces but also allow you to progress further in the game.
Loot and Grow: Obtain rare equipment and materials by defeating enemies and completing quests, boosting the power of your vehicle. Every success will give you more confidence when facing greater threats.
Strengthen Weapons: Equipment can be enhanced and synthesized to create even more powerful gear. A carefully enhanced and advanced synthesis weapon set is key to maintaining an advantage in combat.
Explore the World: Traverse desolate city ruins, radiation-contaminated zones, forests, and other perilous areas in search of valuable supplies and potential allies. Each region is filled with challenges and opportunities waiting for brave explorers to uncover.
Combat and Survival: Confront hordes of zombies and other adversaries, using your wisdom and tactical advantages to win battles. Properly configure your vehicle setup to ensure combat readiness under any circumstances.
Continuously Unlocked New Combat Enhancement Modules: Such as Brain Slurry Amplifier, Brainwave Disruptor, Z Virus, Support Bomber... These will provide significant boosts to your battles.
autokwd: Bomb Vehicle Idle Clicker,Bomb Vehicle The Idle Clicker

title: Sibling Souls
description:
게임 정보
Step into the dark world of 2147, a dystopian place of vampires, androids, and dangerous secrets
You are Lina, a young woman desperate to find your twin brother, who vanished the night he became a vampire. Leaving behind the safety of your home, you step into a city where danger hides in every shadow. In your search for answers, you’ll uncover secrets that threaten not just your brother—but the fragile balance of the world itself.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The new humans may look like ordinary people, but beneath their polished exterior lies cold machinery. They call themselves the city's protectors, maintaining order through constant surveillance and binding residents with digital communication rings. They know far too much about you—and this knowledge might lead you to your brother… unless they choose to use it against you.

title: Jigsaw Industry
description:
게임 정보
Jigsaw Industry is a game that allows you to unleash your creativity and fully enjoy the fun of thinking. Design your own factory to combine and process different shapes and colors. A fully automated and intelligent factory can be achieved through digital circuits, logic signals, and other means.
You can perform basic cutting, combining, coloring, and color matching operations on graphics by arranging various facilities in an orderly manner,
You can perform various intelligent operations by connecting digital logic signals to achieve fully automatic intelligent puzzle solving
You can write your own signal processing components using Lua programming language to achieve custom signal processing

title: Primest Evil
description:
게임 정보


BETRAYAL! As the Prime Evil, you were once the greatest force for bad there was in your slice of the universe...until you got a knife in your back for all your efforts. Risen again as a lich, you're back to claim what's yours in this comedic cartoon adventure -- with a mixture of roguelite character-building, intense action, and a vast array of spells and weapons, there's no shortage of ways to have fun as you blast your way back to power.
CHOOSE YOUR PATH

Choose from an array of starting classes, from the all-around Archarcanist to elemental classes like the Scorcheror and Toxigician and even the melee-focused Bruisomancer. Develop further builds from enhancements traded for souls at the Shrine of B'Gokk. Particularly enterprising players may even unlock additional specialty classes with game events or special rewards.
ALWAYS OUTNUMBERED, NEVER OUTGUNNED

Wield an extensive armory of procedurally generated magical weapons, from magic wands to enchanted sledgehammers. Learn a grimoire's worth of spells, from simple light enchantments and minor curses to arcane tornadoes and globes of invulnerability that set would-be attackers aflame. Master the power of The Most Annoying Bomb In Existence! No explosion is too loud, no hex too humiliating for your enemies as you make your way through the worlds of the Inverse Tower toward your return to the throne.

Interact with a eclectic mix of oddball characters, and navigate the personalities of Councillors whom you recruit for benefits and quests - abuse them too much, though, and you'll have a rebellion on your hands! Recruited Councillors will provide unique benefits and equipment along with quests that can bring needed resources to the Prime Evil's coffers. On the other hand…they hate each other as much as they hate you. Keep them at each other's throats instead of your own, however, and you'll reap the benefit.

Rise, fight, die, and rise again: now a member of the undead, the Prime Evil can never be put down for long. The floors of the Inverse Tower are everchanging, which can only mean new layouts and new benefits as you charge forth. And with the help of the Shrine of B'Gokk and the dread chicken-goddess's hunger for souls, you'll be able to permanently upgrade your character any time you come back successfully from a run with those unfortunate spirits in pocket. Eventually, the Prime Evil return to the great power they have lost -- it's all just a matter of time.

A comedic story and beautiful cartoon aesthetic drives Primest Evil's game experience. Enjoy a combination of hand-painted art and cel-shaded 3D models, as well as a full original soundtrack!

title: Hot Seat
description:
게임 정보
- ARE YOU READY FOR HOT SEAT? -
Welcome to Vulkan Computing Security Systems.
Here at Vulkan, we strive to build better condor systems, to allow the world a smoother trip through the virtual realm.
We are looking to appoint a brand-new IT Technician to join the Vulkan team, to help with maintaining and updating the computing systems at the high security facility ‘QUASAR’©.
We are in need of someone who is confidant in a role that includes but is not limited to:
- Fault finding and resolution
- Has a good understanding of networks, IP addressing and voice infrastructure
- Ability to identify accurately all types of desktop hardware

As an Vulkan IT technician at ‘QUASAR’; it is your responsibility to adhere to the following company standards:

Mr Dirk Assmann
Head of IT

title: Tarvos Desolation
description:
게임 정보
참혹한 우주 탐사 사고 후, 당신은 타르보스(Tarvos)라는 미지의 탐사되지 않은 달에서 유일한 생존자가 되었습니다.
처음에는 환대하는 환경처럼 보이지만 곧 끔찍한 본질을 드러냅니다.
당신의 목표는 타르보스의 적대적인 표면에서 살아남고 탈출에 도움이 될 비밀을 밝히는 것입니다. 몬스터 무리와 맞서 싸우고, 신비한 장소를 탐험하며, 답을 찾을 수 있는 버려진 실험실로 향하는 길을 찾아야 합니다. 이것이 집으로 돌아갈 유일한 기회일지도 모릅니다.
주요 특징:
잊을 수 없는 공포 분위기:어두운 장소, 신비로운 소리, 예측 불가능한 위협이 미지의 달에서의 밀실 공포 악몽으로 당신을 끌어들입니다.
몬스터 무리와의 역동적인 전투:작은 돌연변이부터 두려운 괴수에 이르기까지 다양한 적과 맞서 싸우며 생존 기술을 시험받으세요.
탐험과 생존 퍼즐:자원을 모으고, 장비를 업그레이드하며, 증가하는 도전에 맞서기 위해 기술을 발전시키세요.
미스터리 발견:승무원의 기록, 이전 임무의 흔적을 찾고 추락의 진짜 원인을 밝혀보세요. 다른 생존자가 있을까요?
스토리와 동기:
왜 당신의 탐사가 추락했나요? 사고였나요, 아니면 누군가가 의도적으로 당신을 죽음에 처하게 했나요? 타르보스에서의 모든 걸음이 진실에 가까워지게 하지만, 당신은 충분히 살아남아 이를 밝힐 시간이 있을까요?

title: Detective of the Dead
description:
게임 정보
Detective of the Dead is a narrative noir adventure game in which you are a dead detective in the colorful Mexican underworld and must solve cases using your wit, your unlockable abilities, puzzles and mini-games to prevent a conspiracy to ruin the famous Día de los Muertos forever. You and your magic companion dog Xolo work together - you can't let that happen!
You are in an 3D semi-open world in top-down view. From the street level to the roofs to the interior of houses or bars - you can explore the underworld. When it comes to mechanics it´s an adventure with some special ingredients: Be prepared to do some classic talking, interrogation & investigation and gladly: no pixel hunting, because for that we have our magic companion dog Xolo and its abilities to track and find things. We also added some Metroidvania and RPG spice. About ingredients, Mexican food is arguably among the best in the world. And doing the best original Mexican food in the afterworld can help you far sometimes...
Things in the underworld are a bit different than in the world of the living. Some things might seem funny, some weird or absurd to you. And some ancient god's powers are mysterious for sure. But it's all under control in the Mexican underworld. Well, actually it is not, that´s why we need you.
Everyone in the underworld is counting on you on the big case - well maybe except the bandits you are after. But even for them the Day of the Dead is special. Because only on that day everyone hopes to be able to visit the world of the living. To meet your friends & relatives, taste your favorite food (spoiler alert: not that easy in the afterworld) and just have a good time. You know these basics from Coco, documentaries or even from James Bond. That´s where we start with our Detective work.
Be prepared for an underworld full of dead people, some of them you actually might know! That´s one of the reasons why our detective wants to stay unseen in the quarter of the Nearly Forgotten - his past is haunting him. Well - over the course of many hours of game play you can change his course back to happiness and glory. Some help of ancient gods might come in handy though at some points...
Apart from that - do you think the Dead in the Mexican underworld just have fun, play music, no need to work - so everything is great when you´re dead? Think again, most people don´t change, even when they are dead. And everyone wants this Marigold, the inofficial currency in the underworld, to travel longer to the world of the living when the Day of the Dead arrives. So there are a lot of cases to solve. Just concentrate on the one that is about saving the day for all, alright? Depending on your decisions the outcome will change for the better or worse. We hope you can solve the big case and make sure the Dead can go to the world of the Living on the Día de los Muertos.

title: The Vanished Soul
description:
게임 정보
Feel free to check out the demo of the game, which is available here on Steam! Share your thoughts and feedback on the Discord server, or in the Steam Community Hub!
The Vanished Soul is an indie, first-person, psychological horror game made by one person. It is set in 2016 in the fictional place called Novazenica, and it has quite a few references to my actual home country, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Step into the shoes of the main protagonist as you solve the mysteries that begin to unfold in Novazenica. In addition to the realistic and atmospheric setting of The Vanished Soul, you will have to solve various puzzles to progress. While exploring, discover various side story elements, interact with many objects in the game, and immerse yourself in the atmosphere with numerous sound elements.
The game doesn't rely heavily on grotesque and gore elements but instead tries to slowly bring discomfort to the players through lighting, sounds, and effects. Combine that with the story elements, and you will have a realistic and atmospheric experience in this horror game. The Vanished Soul is powered by Unreal Engine 5, which brings some of the latest technologies, like real-time global illumination, helping you immerse yourself in the game as much as possible!

title: Twilight Epoch
description:
게임 정보
As the Blight grows with each passing day, the worlds wither in turn. The drifting planes that still light the sky fade like embers, and the powers that live to see them covet dominion of the few centuries that remain. A young man from a distant plane is taken from his home, and fights to find peace, before all ends in silence.
Embark on an adventure through a mysterious science-fantasy galaxy, blending intense FPS action with the customization of a party-based RPG, across endlessly replayable levels of strange and sprawling worlds.
A GALACTIC JOURNEY
A campaign split into 3 books, with 20+ enormous levels to be explored and plundered, each handcrafted and fully unique with their own aesthetic, lore, and enemy roster.
Ancient temples, shadowy space piers, towering cities; all dense with loot, secrets, and deadly encounters.
BUILD YOUR PARTY
Swashbuckle and parry with dual cutlasses, rocket jump with a mecha arm cannon, battle as a knight in explosive armour, or just throw big rocks at people.
Use 6 characters, 100+ unique weapons across 18 types, plus a wide range combat abilities, passive-granting armours, and items that all make meaningful differences to your playstyle.
RAW COMBAT
Face off against 50 enemy types and a slew of brutal bosses in combat combining bullet hell, hack-and-slash, and FPS.
Each encounter is a combat sandbox against legions of enemies who want you dead yesterday.
DEEP MOVEMENT
B-hopping, air-strafing, explosive jumping, slope-physics, a whole list of equipment specific techniques + Unlimited sprinting!
Use your agility to out-maneuver attacks, reach remote treasures, and speed through the highly vertical environments.

title: Mama's Sleeping Angels
description:
게임 정보
During a sleepover with your friends, you found yourself in Mama's dream! Mama is very hungry, so it's up to you to venture out into her subconscious and find cursed objects to feed her. Be careful, though, as the curses affect you! They may induce hallucinations, spawn a new plague, or even conjure corporeal pursuers....
But that's great news! Mama loves to eat curses—the worse the curse, the more her love grows! (Along with her appetite) As long as Mama is satiated, her angels get to keep searching for guns and masks that cause permanent bodily changes. Don't worry about Mama starving, though; she'll just eat you before that happens!
Mama dreams of neighborhoods, sewers, endless foggy halls, inverted hanging superstructures, and a myriad of beings with ulterior motives.

title: Last mile
description:
게임 정보
Last Mile은 1인칭 공포 게임으로, 플레이어는 운전자가 되어 자동차를 조종합니다. 목표는 자동차를 활용해 공간 이상 현상에서 탈출하는 것입니다. 게임을 진행하며 폐쇄된 고속도로를 탐험하고, 도사리고 있는 위협을 피해야 합니다.
몰입감 넘치는 경험
어두운 밤의 혹독한 조건에서 1인칭으로 자동차를 조종하며 게임의 음침한 분위기에 빠져보세요. 게임 배경은 폐쇄된 오래된 고속도로, 작은 마을, 그리고 외딴 마을입니다.
게임플레이
이 게임은 자동차 운전 시뮬레이션과 공포 장르가 결합된 작품입니다. 공포스러운 이상 현상으로 가득 찬 고속도로를 통과해야 합니다.
주변 환경과 상호작용하세요:

title: A LETTER FROM MOM
description:
게임 정보
On the morning of your 14th birthday, you receive a party invitation from your missing mom. But when you arrive, you find yourself in a cult village. This game is a point-and-click puzzle adventure starring Nero, a black cat. As Nero, you will search for your missing mom and explore the cult village. The villagers seem welcoming, but beneath the surface, secrets are hidden among the fluttering butterflies and lush greenery. Can you escape from this beautiful yet mysterious village?

How to Play
Click on points of interest: If something seems suspicious, click to investigate.
Collect items: Click on items to add them to your item box.
Use items: Click on items in your item box, then click where you want to use them.
Move around: Click arrows to move to different locations.

Playtime: 1 hour

title: NIPA
description:
게임 정보


NIPA is a DUNGEON CRAWLER puzzle game with an oriental setting in which YOU CAN'T SHOOT.

Move, run, dodge, slow down time or transform into a ghost.NIPA will test the reflexes of the most skilled players. The only way to beat each level is repetition and perfection. The White Tower is a place full of obstacles and dangers that will delight those looking for a challenge.



With a aesthetic inspired by Hindu culture and a dynamic soundtrack in which each piece accompanies the level, NIPA will transcend players to another astral plane, one in which self-improvement plays a key role.





● Explore the White Tower and use your skills to dodge .
● Prepare to over and over again until you beat the level.
● Take on puzzles against the clock and.
● 7 unique levels inspired by , symbolising physical, mental, emotional and spiritual aspects.
● A Hindu setting with .

title: Infected Frontier
description:
게임 정보

Infected Frontier는 다각형 좀비 생존 루터 슈터로, 기지 건설과 제작이 포함되어 있습니다.
스토리 및 임무 - 흥미진진한 이야기에 몰입하고 독특한 보상을 획득하고 전개를 진행하기 위해 임무를 완수하십시오.
당신의 목표는 생존뿐이며, 나머지는 선택 사항입니다.



당신의 방식대로 플레이하세요: 싱글 플레이어, 온라인 서버 기반 멀티플레이어, 또는 친구들과 온라인 협동 플레이.
캐릭터 생성: 나만의 캐릭터를 만드세요.
기지 건설.
제작: 다양한 상황에 맞는 수백 가지 아이템을 제작하세요.
수집: 세상을 탐험하거나 적을 처치하여 아이템을 찾으세요.
자원 채집: 나무, 돌, 금속 등 원재료를 수집하세요.
총기 커스터마이징: 여러 가지 부착물을 찾아 제작하여 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 총기를 만드세요.
생존 메커니즘: 배고픔과 갈증을 관리하여 생존하세요.
낚시: 간단한 낚시 시스템으로 음식을 구하세요.
수집: 수백 가지의 고유한 아이템을 수집하세요.
날짜, 시간, 기후 시스템.
인벤토리 관리.

title: The Crimson Maid
description:
게임 정보



"How terrible to think that such a bright and noble man is nearing his end. What will we do without our pillar?"

Estranged for a couple of years, a young man rushes back to his childhood home. Dismayed by the news of his father losing his sight and inching closer to his demise, Marius, a priest in training, suspends his long studies at the seminary to be close in his final days to the man who taught him dignity and stalwartness. Under the gloom of impending death, the oldest son of honorable Leon Rosenthal can’t conceive the encroaching events that his arrival will unfold, equally exhilarating and petrifying.








Play as Marius as he returns to his childhood home in an attempt to reconnect with his ailing father, stern mother and overwhelmed younger brother. Much to your surprise, your household now employs an alluring young maid, Irina, who charms you from the first sight. But your blossoming romance will soon be tested as a dreadful murder shakes the feeble balance of this noble family.






is an adventure game focused on dialogues, exploration and light puzzle solving. Speak to Irina and your family to discover how they feel, their deep desires and what they may be hiding. Rummage around the mansion and the surrounding estate for clues, optional puzzles, misplaced documents and insights into the family and its past. Embark on a journey of self discovery as Marius comes to terms with his choices, their consequences and the unexpected legacy of his lineage.

title: Farmer's Diary
description:
게임 정보
The Farmer's Diary is your journey to restore an old and neglected farm to its glorious days. With your limited budget, you progress through the game with the goal of reaching an advanced farm using your farming skills.

Upgrade System
You will upgrade your farm and make it more developed and beautiful by upgrading each building separately.

Farming
Your crop field is your greatest treasure. Plant the seed and give them water until harvest time and collect and sell your grown products.

Husbandry
These beautiful animals are your friends. Don't forget to look after them and feed them. also you can sell the products you get from them.

Orcharding
Do you want to grow fruit trees? then buy some saplings! The seedlings will take some time to grow, but if you be patience they will eventually give you big returns.

Production (Available With First Update)
You can purchase various production machines for your workshop, where you can produce many new products using the raw materials you gather by farming.

title: XWarShooterVR
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the immersive world of "XWarShooterVR" a VR shooter where the combination of devastating guns, epic technomagic skills, and base-building strategy delivers an immersive gaming experience.


GAME FEATURES:

TRAINING:
Improve your warriors in martial arts, choose from over 75 characters, each with a unique set of skills. Develop their abilities, upgrade a variety of weapons with different ranges and power. Emphasize the singularity of each hero, shaping their unique style of fighting on the battlefield.


WIN HOWEVER YOU WANT:
Are you a team player or do you prefer solo attacks? Protect allies from enemies or rain meteorites down on your opponents' heads - choose your path to victory. With countless combinations of military arsenal, technomagic skills and a variety of heroes, you choose your play style.


EQUIPMENT:
Each hero is armed with three weapons and boosters. Assemble your deadly combination, boost your power and dominate the battlefield. Become a strategist and weapon master to surpass your opponents.


BUILD:
Build your base, collect resources and boosters to stay one step ahead of the enemy not only in battles but also in building a strong and impregnable base. Take your tactical skills to the next level.


COMPETE:
Take on the challenge and prove your skills in a unique blend of shooter and strategy. Team up with your battle buddies, socialize and compete in exciting battles.


Hone your combat and base-building skills, because in "XWarShooterVR" you will not only have to fight your opponents on the battlefield, but also attack other people's bases, create and defend your own fortifications.
Join "XWarShooterVR" and become a legend in this exciting VR world!

title: Blood & Chaos
description:
게임 정보
Blood & Chaos is a roguelike RPG that puts you in command of a party of adventurers.
Build a team of up to six unique heroes, each with their own skills and abilities, and lead them through a perilous, ever-changing world. Strategize, adapt, and overcome challenging turn-based battles as you explore vibrant cities, uncover hidden quests, and delve into deadly dungeons.
Will your fellowship rise to become legends, or will they be consumed by the chaos?
Build Your Party: Create your party of up to 6 heroes, each with  unique skills and abilities.
Tactical Turn-Based Combat: : Engage in challenging battles where every move counts. Position your heroes wisely, exploit enemy weaknesses, and unleash powerful spells and abilities to turn the tide of battle.
A Dynamic World of Contrasts: Explore a richly detailed medieval fantasy world where beauty and danger coexist. From bustling cities to cursed ruins, every location tells a story of light and shadow.
Epic Quests: Legends speak of a war that nearly consumed the world. Now, remnants of that battle stir once more. What role will you play in the next chapter?
Nostalgic Yet Modern: A love letter to '80s RPGs, blending the charm of classic adventures with modern roguelike mechanics and quality-of-life improvements.

title: Dungeon Cleaner
description:
게임 정보






The “Bubble Guy” has been entrusted with the mission to dive into the depths of a terraformed world at the pleasure of deities. You will go through the different realms, bouncing off the walls, wrapping enemies in bubbles and leaving everything in your path squeaky clean. Antique civilizations await in your journey, as you meet charming characters to befriend and, most importantly, try to restore the order.






is a Roguelite with never-before-seen mechanics.
He plays the charismatic "Bubble Guy", inhabitant of a world terraformed by gods after a great war.

Instead of using weapons, the Bubble Guy will bounce off the walls of the changing and mysterious dungeons while trapping enemies that cross his descent in bubbles!

title: Adventures of Steve the Cat
description:
게임 정보
Adventures of Steve the Cat — this is a cozy adventure platformer-study, where you will play as a small and cute cat Steve, who is trying to defeat the professor and return to normal life, from which he was unexpectedly snatched when his friends were kidnapped. And although you are lost and puzzled, you have to overcome all kinds of dangers of the forest and other locations! The game will make you feel nostalgic for the old platforerms from childhood! A beautiful picture, convenient controls and beautiful music will not leave anyone indifferent!



You are a cute cat Steve, who has to go through a lot of beautiful, exciting and dangerous locations. On your way you are going to meet a lot of enemies created by a crazy professor. He steals animals and puts experiments on them. You have to fight him and save innocent animals from him. Jump, spin, crush your enemies!



Features:
Colorful graphics
Cute main character
10 beautiful levels
Convenient and responsive gameplay

title: ARKA KRAYA
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to discover what is hidden beyond the ordinary?
There aren't a lot of exciting adventures in the life of a modern teenager.
But you can change that if you want to. Go camping with your friends with a night in the woods around a campfire. And when strange things start happening, the choice is yours: stay back or go on an adventure.
You will see that the world is still full of mysteries and riddles that even modern science cannot solve.
You are going to meet some extraordinary characters. Will you be able to find the right approach to them in order to continue your journey?
Is it always necessary to tell the truth? Is it always wrong to be angry? Your emotions, words and actions have an impact on the world around you. And who says there is only one right approach?
ARKA KRAYA is an adventure game in a world where magical realism meets your imagination.
We were inspired by the works of Hayao Miyazaki and tried to create a story, the main character of which will be you.
One story - two worlds and several endings
Control over the words and emotions of the characters
Graphic style inspired by classic American animation and Japanese anime
Frame-by-frame animation of characters that are brought to life by the artists hands
Unique soundtrack combining the sound of classical instruments and synthesized sounds

title: The Last Nordic Tribe
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever wondered what shaped the brutality of the Vikings? What past forged these fierce warriors?
"The Last Nordic Tribe" is a RPG game with survival elements set in the brutal realities of the early Middle Ages. The story is set long before the first Viking invasions, at the end of the third year of an unusually harsh three-year winter, known as the "Little Ragnarök," spanning the years 536-539 AD. This tragic period claimed the lives of 95% of Scandinavia's population, and the memories of these events were preserved centuries later on the Rök Runestone – a warning to future generations.
The game's story has been crafted from scratch, drawing on the limited historical information available. Fictional elements have been added, such as threads of a foreign culture from a fallen empire, the theme of slavery, and the unequal struggle against overwhelming odds – frost and hunger.
Your mission is to survive at all costs, utilizing survival elements like gathering resources and crafting weapons from available components. Encounters with enemies will provide not only valuable experience but also essential materials for survival.
The game recreates the atmosphere of the time – land covered in volcanic ash, barren trees, wooden buildings, and the characteristic aesthetics and culture of the early Middle Ages. All of this combines to create a dark and immersive experience that transports players to the unforgiving world of the "Little Ragnarök."
Can you survive in a world where history was never meant to be so brutal?

title: Gridiron Masters '98
description:
게임 정보
START IN 1980-1990
Enter a football world visually set in the 90's. The big pads, the neck rolls, waffle sole cleats, teal colored turf and larger than life sports personalities! Immerse yourself in the story, strategy and sports nostalgia.
Generate a world, create your coach, set your scheme, start as a high school coordinator in any U.S. state and see where your football coaching story goes! 32-64 high school teams, 100+ in 10 college conferences and 32 in the National Football Association!
COACH CHARACTER
Your character has 20 skills that must be organized into 4 categories which will determine their starting value and how expensive they will be to increase later. They also have 5 attributes of Leadership, Charisma, Management, Development and Tactics. These attributes scale your skills and increase along with them.
TEAM MANAGEMENT
There are 43 players on your team, each has 10 basic skills like Running, Coverage or Passing. In addition, each player has a number of traits and abilities that will make them valuable in various ways. Equip them with coach actions or abilities to tailor certain players to your needs. To top it all off, each player has three modifiers which are Morale, Install and Health. A player is dynamic and can't be summed up by an OVR rating.
COACHING STAFF
You will be a part of an actual coaching staff made up of a head coach and two coordinators. Each head coach will delegate duties differently so being under one coach won't be like another. As an OC, maybe you set the offensive depth chart, maybe not. Maybe you oversee the off season training, maybe not. It all depends. As an HC, you can set these duties how you wish but even then coordinators have wants too. Some will want more responsibility while other less. Ai coaches don't just make optimal decisions either. They each have their own priorities for what they value in a player of a certain position. Maybe it's Coverage for a linebacker or Shedding for a defensive lineman. Maybe they take into account a player's modified skill, maybe they don't. Maybe they value weight more than height for another position. No two coaches do things exactly the same.
TV SHOWS

title: Intermundia: Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
책을 읽고 비디오 게임을 플레이하면서 각 상호작용을 관리하세요.
한 페이지 한 페이지 넘기면서 두 세계의 경계를 넘나드는 우정의 이야기를 발견하세요. 간단한 탭 한 번으로 함정이 가득한 던전을 탐험하고, 맹렬한 적과 싸우고, 인벤토리를 관리하세요. 
고전 게임북에서 영감을 받은 다양한 선택지로 가득한 스토리와 다양한 엔딩을 만나보세요!
이 장대한 모험에 빠져들고, 움직임을 계획하고, 운명을 선택하고, 결과에 맞설 준비를 하세요!
팀을 커스터마이즈하고 전투를 준비하세요.
캐릭터를 관리하고, 최고의 장비를 선택하고, 기술을 최적화하여 완벽한 전략을 세우세요.

title: 9mm Roulette 💀
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Deadliest Laboratory!
Here, there are no coincidences—only calculation, tactics, and cold luck. In 9mm Roulette💀, your fate is decided with the pull of the trigger of a Magnum 9mm.
