A deadly experiment is underway in a secret laboratory, where you must outplay your opponents using wit, strategy, and psychological pressure.

Make your choice: shoot yourself to gain an extra turn or fire at your opponent to take them out of the game. Keep a close eye on the magazine—it holds both live and blank rounds, and only calculated decisions will help you avoid a fatal mistake.

Face off against up to three real players. Bluff, predict your opponents’ moves, and take control of the situation to be the last one standing in this lethal experiment.
👥 Multiplayer for up to 4 Players
Test your nerve and strategic thinking against friends. Every decision could be your last, and every shot could change the course of the game. Play solo or form fragile alliances—but remember, only one will survive in the end.

🔫 Tactical Russian Roulette
This isn’t just a game of chance—it’s a deadly experiment where calculation outweighs luck. Track the bullets in the magazine, analyze probabilities, bluff, mislead your opponents, and make cold, calculated decisions. One wrong move, and you're out.

💥 Intense Survival Gameplay
Every action must be carefully considered—do you risk shooting yourself for an extra turn, or do you play it safe and wait for the perfect opportunity? Here, victory belongs not just to the lucky, but to those who can strategize, manipulate, and withstand the psychological pressure.

🔥 Test your luck or become another failed experiment!

title: Billionaire in the Oil Boom
description:
게임 정보
The year is 1960, and the world is on the brink of an energy revolution. The discovery of vast oil reserves in the Middle East is changing the global economic landscape, creating unprecedented wealth and opportunity. Nations rise, corporations battle for dominance, and fortunes are made overnight. Will you seize the moment and build a financial empire, or will you be left behind as others strike it rich?
Money is never enough
In this era of rapid transformation, money is more than just a currency: it’s power. Take control of financial markets and wield a variety of investment tools to build your fortune. Trade in:
Stocks – Invest in emerging oil giants before they take over the world.
Bonds & State Bonds – Secure lucrative government contracts and finance infrastructure projects
Commodities – Buy and sell crude oil, gold, wheat and other valuable resources driving the global economy.
Real Estate – Capitalize on booming Middle Eastern cities as wealth floods the region.
Take Over Corporations – Control Industries
Investing isn’t just about buying and selling assets—you can take control of entire companies! Acquire businesses, set corporate strategies, and dictate their future. Will you build a financial empire through innovation, or will you crush your competition through hostile takeovers? Your leadership and decision-making skills will determine your success.
High-Stakes Special Operations – Shape the Market
To dominate the industry, you must play the game at the highest level. Execute powerful financial moves, including:
Mergers & Acquisitions – Absorb competitors and control global supply chains.
Private and Public Stock Offerings – Raise capital without losing control of your empire.
One well-timed move can shift the balance of power—but one mistake can cost you everything.
Exploit Global Tax Systems & Political Instability
The Middle East oil boom isn’t just about business—it’s about navigating the complex political and economic landscape. With multiple nations vying for control, you must .

title: Monster Punk
description:
게임 정보
Steal, smash, and survive in this high-speed vehicular roguelike! You play as Monster Punk, an outlaw behind the wheel of a weaponized monster truck, pulling off insane heists in a lawless wasteland. Raid heavily guarded bases, outrun relentless robotic enforcers and upgrade your ride to take on bigger, deadlier targets. The bigger the heist, the bigger the chaos...
can you escape the madness and make it out alive & rich?

Every heist is a win-or-die gamble. Once you blast your way in, you better be ready, because the moment the alarms go on, there’s no turning back! With No time to breathe, you're constantly on the run, fighting off deadly robotic enforcers who will stop at nothing to take you down. Drift, boost, and jump your way through the chaos, blasting enemies, running them over, and smashing through anything in your path. The bigger the risk, the bigger the reward. use your scores to upgrade your monster truck with better weapons, armor, and speed to take on even riskier heists. Only the boldest outlaws make it out alive. Will you?

Your truck is more than a getaway vehicle, it’s a ! Upgrade its weapons, boost speed, improve armor, and tweak handling to survive longer, steal bigger, and escape faster. Equip devastating , then hit the wasteland in style. Build the and turn your monster truck into a war machine!

title: Chains Of Reality
description:
게임 정보
Come forth and adventure through a journey unlike no other, surviving the depths alone, or with your friends. In Chains Of Reality, the choice is yours, traversing through numerous, strangely liminal environments trying to utilize the limited resources available in each reality, until it is inevitably unsustainable. 
UNIQUE GAMEPLAY UNLIKE ANY OTHER
Chains Of Reality has it all; core survival game mechanics, huge crafting, currency and inventory system, immersive adventures, a beautiful storyline, and base building inside of liminal spaces while trying to survive just another day. Maybe its the environment that's slowly killing you, maybe its the lack of resources, or maybe its what lurks out there..
IMMERSIVE GRAPHICS
Powered by Unreal Engine 5, Chains Of Reality is a stunning visual experience that'll be sure to cause you to feel immersed within the unique environments found throughout the game.
UNIQUE STORYLINE
Trapped here against your will, unbeknownst of what's to come, you play as the main protagonist who is just trying to make it through another day, and put the pieces together to solve the final puzzle; why we are here. Uncover the mysteries that lie throughout, solving problems on your own while experiencing emotion, character development, and more as you drive yourself closer to the end. Will you end up like the rest, the ones who lose themselves? Or will you manage to be the first victor, conqueror of the unknown..
STRANGE, UNIQUE ENVIRONMENTS
Chains Of Reality hosts a plethora of oddly familiar environments popular within The Backrooms fanbase. Explore strange architecture that scratches that liminal feeling deep within your mind, be at ease with calming forest and ocean environments, or feel unsettled within deep, abandoned, and creepy structures and environments. It's ultimately your choice where you choose to reside in this universe, just make sure its sustainable!

title: Dark Adelita
description:
게임 정보
“Dark Adelita” is an action platformer game, you advance in each level to dodge enemies and their attacks, you will have a varied arsenal to make your way through the enemies and reach the face-to-face encounter against the boss of the level, each legend at the end of the levels will have an epic battle to defeat him.

title: Resina Salvation
description:
게임 정보
A strategic incremental clicker set in Roman times. Clicks. Improvements. Resources. But above all, a volcano on the verge of eruption, sending waves of monsters for you to kill.
Wood, Rock, Water, every natural ressource is collectable. Just click on it to create blocks of it. The click on the block to send it on your storage !

title: GIRL.EXE.EXE
description:
게임 정보
GIRL.EXE.EXE는 독창적인 게임플레이와 스토리를 갖춘 심리 호러 퍼즐 게임으로, 현실과 코드가 얽히고 버그가 이야기가 되는 세계를 탐험합니다
과거로 돌아가는 건 힘든 일이죠, 그렇죠?
당신은 버려진 프로젝트로 돌아왔습니다 – 한때 완성하고 싶었지만 끝내지 못한 그 게임으로요
이제 그 게임은 스스로의 의지를 갖게 되었습니다
세상은 무너지고, 방은 뒤틀리며, 안에 갇힌 소녀는 당신을 놓아주지 않으려 합니다

title: Shadows of the Werewolf
description:
게임 정보
Shadows of the Werewolf는 잔혹한 늑대인간과 다른 치명적인 생물들로부터 탈출해야 하는 생존 공포 모험 게임입니다. 기괴한 장소를 탐험하고, 전략적인 결정을 내리며, 공포 뒤에 숨겨진 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내고, 무슨 일이 있어도 생존하세요.
시네마틱 스토리텔링
몰입감 있는 컷신과 드라마틱한 순간들을 통해 생생하게 펼쳐지는 공포, 스릴러, 액션의 강렬한 혼합.

생존 게임플레이와 물리 기반 전투:
숨거나, 싸우거나, 환경을 사용하세요. 캐릭터와 물체가 물리적으로 반응하는 역동적인 전투에 참여하십시오. 제한된 내구성의 아이템을 사용하여 막거나, 공격하거나, 적에게 던져 각 만남마다 선택이 중요합니다.

분위기 있는 환경
교외의 집, 으스스한 숲 속 휴양지, 정원 미로 등 위험한 장소들을 탐험하세요.

제한된 인벤토리를 신중하게 관리하여 치명적인 만남을 견디고 긴장감 넘치는 퍼즐을 풀어 나가세요. 위험한 상황을 탐색하면서 모든 아이템이 중요하며, 긴장감을 유지합니다.

쉬움, 보통, 어려움 모드 중에서 선택하여, 여러분의 플레이 스타일에 맞게 경험을 맞춤 설정하세요. 이야기를 즐기기 위해 여기 계신가요, 아니면 궁극적인 생존 도전을 위해 계신가요? 모든 유형의 플레이어를 위한 모드가 있습니다.

title: Sub Optimal Co.
description:
게임 정보

Invite up to five friends and operate your submarine. Together or alone.

Navigate carefully and consider every move while you progress through one of 20 challenging and unique cave systems in this slow pace, atmospheric diving experience. Reach the target location without crushing your submarine into the walls by operating your cameras, ping and the submarine's movement. Together or alone. While you can operate the submarine all by yourself - It’s way more effective to have a few helping hands on board. So hire your friends who are up for a dive experience.

It’s simple. Maneuver your submarine to collect the target and return to your base while not scratching the cave-walls.

You will be spending 95% in the submarine. You (and your friends) can freely move within it and by operating the submarine's consoles, you can move and navigate your submarine. Dive through challenging cave systems by turning, tilting, rotating and adjusting movement speed, without touching the walls.

If your submarine touches the walls too often, it will sink and the dive failed. The challenge here is that you only have limited tools to see or hear your location within the cave. There is always a target at the end of the cave that you need to reach and return to your base with.

With every new launch or restart of the game, one of 20 caves will be chosen randomly for you to play (more to come). Think of it as some kind of hot-wire mechanic. In a sub. In a cave.




This project was designed to be a slow pace, multiplayer experience to play with friends while chatting in your favorite voice-chat. You can even play this game with mouse only, so you got one free hand for your favorite cup of tee, or coffee.

As you progress further with a successful mission-line, enjoy new ranks, new uniforms, some beards, and some new cups for your character.


- Only steam friends can be invited. There are no open server selections.
- "Sub Optimal Co." uses peer-to-peer connection.
- There is no ingame voice or text chat.
- No bots or NPCs can be added to the party.

title: Ella Stars
description:
게임 정보
[게임 소개]
🎸 엘라 스타즈 – 리듬의 힘으로 스테이지를 정복하라!
박자 감각? 없어도 괜찮아!
엘라 스타즈에서는 ‘엘라’와 ‘버드’가 함께 뮤직 세계를 위협하는 악당들을 물리칩니다!
강렬한 비트와 함께 보스들의 스킬을 피하고, 리듬 액션으로 반격하세요!
애니메이션을 찢고 나온 듯한 생동감 넘치는 뮤직 액션 게임 – 지금 도전하세요!
[게임 특징]
■다채로운 음악 스타일
- 글램 록(Glam Rock)부터 로파이 힙합(Lo-fi HipHop)까지!
- 비트에 몸을 맡기면 귀가 즐거워지는 사운드 트랙!

title: Ninas Escape
description:
게임 정보
A special kind of Jump-and-Run game in honor to the classics from the 80s home computer era. Our hero, little Nina, has been trapped into a large cave with multiple levels - you can help her to escape from there. In every level, there is a teleporter that moves Nina to the next level. Those teleporters work from batteries - so you have to collect all batteries in a level to avtivate the end level teleporter to escape from that level.
There are numerous hazards in every level: poisonous spiders dangling from the ceilings, pools filled with deadly liquids (water, slime, lava), flying balls that send out electrical shock bolts, evil people chasing Nina. Movement is done by walking, running and jumping, also climbing walls and ladders. There are lift platforms (moving horizontal and vertical), in-level teleporters that need coins to operate, and electrical forcefields that block passageways.
You can play either alone, or party up with friends or family and play locally with up to 4 players in a game (coop mode). There is no "points counting", so no rivalry is needed. But all players have to complete a level to count it "done". So it is "play together", and not "who wins the game".

title: Stream or Die!
description:
게임 정보
CONQUER THE CREATORS
You're Cage, an underdog streamer, teetering on the brink of obscurity. Seize a mysterious invitation to stream WISH, an unexplored MMO, and buckle up for the ride of your life.



Tactical auto-battler RPG plus Streamer simulator all in one!
You've never experienced a story like this
Recruit adventurers with the LFG Party System
Unlock powerful combat abilities by creating Formations
Watch in horror as your in-game choices bleed into the real world!
25+ endings
Fully voiced





Inspired by the Persona series and with an innovative RPG auto-battle system, every choice you make shapes your path. Will you be a family-friendly entertainer or a controversial edgelord? Each decision impacts your journey and your audience. Balance is key; keep your energy high, stress low, and sanity in check to dazzle your audience stream after stream.




As Cage, dive into and lead massive raids through a rich, expansive world brimming with quests, mystical artifacts, and treacherous dungeons. Watch your subscriber count soar as you become a streaming legend.




Uncover the enigmatic lore of the Monumentals, gargantuan beings consuming cities, and the Whisperers, mysterious figures holding the balance. Your streaming journey intertwines with these mysteries, leading to unexpected revelations.




Who Influences the Influencers? As you skyrocket to fame and fortune, a lingering question haunts every stream – who really controls the world of , and what's their game?

title: Lea
description:
게임 정보

In this game, you'll take on the role of Lea, an ace pilot who has gone rogue. You'll not only have to deal with the threats of war but also confront inner struggles. Embark on a journey through a series of islands filled with battles and discoveries. In a time of chaos, stand firm with those who have their own beliefs and stories, uncover the conspiracies behind the war, unravel the secrets of the Philosopher's Stone, and bring peace to as many people as possible.
Are you ready to become the hero who will stop the war and bring new hope to these islands?
Game Features

Exciting Aerial Combat
Engage in thrilling side-scrolling shootouts, battling war machines powered by steam technology and unveiling the conspiracies of madmen.



The game boasts breathtaking visual effects, with every environment brimming with details and surprises.




Immerse yourself in an emotionally charged island continent, follow the characters' destinies, and unlock multi-layered storylines.


Relationships and growth among the characters are integral to the game, and your decisions will influence their relationship outcomes.


Explore diverse island environments and unlock hidden story elements and missions.


The game's music and sound effects create a profound atmosphere, enhancing the emotional impact of the story.

title: Cosmorons
description:
게임 정보
COSMORONS
Greetings, cosmic conquerors! We present to you COSMORONS, an old-school futuristic shooter about comedic robot drudges conquering the cosmos with outlandish weapons & hijinks galore.  To achieve ultimate glory, grapple, shoot, and drill your way to galactic domination. New areas bring big rewards, but drastically increase in difficulty.
SINGLE PLAYER / ONLINE CO-OP GAMEPLAY
Take on the universe as a conquest of one or play co-op with your fellow Drudges! Cosmorons offers both single player and co-op gameplay. As a single player, combat alien factions, complete thrilling challenges and collect planetary cores on your own. In co-op play, it's you and a team of fellow Drudges versus the universe! Online co-op means you and your friends can play from the comforts of your own home.

title: The Lab Thing
description:
게임 정보
WARNING: This video game may trigger seizures for some audience with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.



The Lab Thing is a first-person survival horror game.

Explore a mysterious secret lab as the only body survived. Gather all the scientist's notes about the monster, upgrade backpack items, record information and try to escape before you join the body collection of the lab thing!

the game is set in a secret underground lab that is haunted by a monster that likes to collect human bodies. You will explore an atmospheric underground abandoned lab, wander through tight corridors, check out every dead room, and get lost in the endless presence of afterlife.

This lab is cursed with its past. The secret project that turned against its creators. The symbol of human failure walks right behind you and not only protects his murderous victory but listens to potentials for future. As a player, you will relive parts of this dark past, find the memory of its nature and explore the need to survive.

in this game you are a normal defenseless human being; no weapons could save you from the monster finding you from the next corner, behind the door, hidden in the closet or inside a body bag. You’ll be able to pick up key elements, interact with the environment, and search for door keys that may help you escape this nightmare reservoir of human failure.

title: Electric Alps
description:
게임 정보
Electric Alps is a 2D puzzle game based on real-world electrical engineering. Explore how electricity works. Plan your circuitry, install devices and solve logic-based wiring problems.

You take on the role of an electrician, returning to the remote village of St. Ampere, nestled in the breathtaking Austrian Alps. Tasked with wiring up homes and structures, you’ll master the principles of electrical engineering. Install cables, switches, and other electrical devices, strategically wiring them up to create functional circuits. Each building is a puzzle, requiring your skills to power it up. Your journey will ultimately transform the village, awakening it from its unpowered slumber. One circuit at a time.
⚡ Based on Real-World Electricity
Explore the fundamentals of electrical engineering, delving into real-world electricity. Understand the principles of current flow and master the art of wiring in this hands-on and educational experience.
🧠 Solve Puzzle-Based Circuitries
Engage wiring challenges that combine logic, strategic planning and your new-found electrical knowledge to solve a variety of puzzles in the world of electrical installations.
🛠️ Utilize a Vast Toolbox
Explore a vast array of devices and appliances as you advance through St. Ampere. From installing sockets to crafting intricate power consumption systems, you master various electrical activities, adding switches, relays, motion detectors, fuses, RCDs and other tools to your toolbox.
🏡 Electrify Your Village
As you advance, St. Ampere around you evolves. Overcoming challenges not only opens up new areas, introduces fresh devices but also revitalizes the village. Homes become inhabited, structures turn usable, and green, sustainable energy production takes center stage, transforming St. Ampere into a vibrant, electrified haven.
⛰️ Enjoy the Alpine Charm
Enjoy Austrian culture and the breathtaking Alps. The picturesque alpine landscapes aren't merely a background, but an integral part of your exploration, adding our Austrian charm to your journey through St. Ampere.

title: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey
description:
게임 정보
isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey
(원래 제목: isekizima-To-Tabisuru-Nekomata)
isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey는 2D 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다.
두 개의 꼬리(Nekomata)를 가진 고양이 귀 모험가 키지노로 플레이하고, 이세키지마(관광 안내책자에 쓰여진 대로 꿈과 로맨스의 유적지)로 여행을 떠나세요.
민족 악기와 성가의 박자에 맞춰 숲에 묻힌 유적지를 탐험하세요.
게임 특징
횡스크롤 플랫폼 액션 - 숲에 묻힌 광대한 폐허를 질주, 회피, 트리플 점프로 돌파하세요.
몬스터와의 싸움 - 간단한 입력으로 다양한 공격 스킬을 사용할 수 있습니다. 다양한 스킬을 사용하는 데는 전략적 감각이 있고, 한 번에 여러 적을 날려버리는 짜릿함도 있습니다.
캐릭터 개발 - 배울 수 있는 스킬이 10개 이상 있습니다. 최대 HP와 스태미너 외에도 많은 스킬을 업그레이드할 수 있습니다.









저는 다양한 게임의 "Stage1"을 좋아합니다.
대부분은 제가 영원히 거기에 머물고 싶어지는 평화로운 초원이나 숲입니다.
저는 "Stage1"의 분위기가 계속되는 세계를 만들고 싶어서 이 게임을 만들었습니다.

스테이지가 진행되어도 분위기와 난이도는 크게 바뀌지 않습니다.
(하지만 게임의 특성상 초원은 항상 계속되지는 않습니다.)
개발자는 일본어만 할 수 있습니다. 그러나
영어와 간체 중국어 현지화를 돕는 사람이 있습니다.
언어 파일은 게임과 함께 배포되며, 이러한 간단한 텍스트 파일도 플레이어가 자유롭게 편집하고 추가하여 기존 언어를 개선하거나 새로운 언어에 대한 지원을 추가할 수 있습니다.
자원봉사자가 현지화를 도울 수 있다면 기쁠 것입니다!
이 게임은 생성 AI를 사용하지 않습니다.
이 게임은 AI가 생성한 이미지, 사운드 또는 기타 자료를 사용하지 않습니다.
지침을 따르는 한 스트리밍에 제한이 없습니다.
이 게임이 즐거운 시간을 보내는 데 도움이 되기를 바랍니다.














여기까지 읽어주셔서 감사합니다!

title: Spellslayer
description:
게임 정보
In Spellslayers, you control a powerful sorcerer trying to find the lost eyes of the spellslayer, the most powerful sorcerer in history. Travel to different locations and take out anyone who tries to stop you in this puzzle tactics roguelite adventure!


Each turn, you can move your character and spend energy on spells. You can have up to 4 spells equipped at a time, and each spell has its own hit pattern on the board. Once you cast your first spell you can no longer move that turn, so try to maneuvre to utilise your spells to the fullest!


All the foes you face are sorcerers as well! Each of them has their own distinct spell they cast, telegraphing where they will attack. Outmaneveure their spells and strike back with your own.


Void tiles will appear in each battle, which increases the damage you do and amplify each spell in their own way, but increase the damage you take, so weigh up the odds before stepping onto them for the turn. Be careful though, as enemies can also use these to cast their spell instantly, leading you to take damage you weren't prepared for.


Journey to the location of each eye, and fight off hordes of spellcasters. Choose which path to take next, as you discover new spells, empower old ones, enhance your body, return to your quarters to rest, visit the souls market, and eventually come face to face with other High end sorcerers, competing against you to become the Spellslayer themselves.

title: Arcticide
description:
게임 정보


Procedural levels with diverse biomes, weather, and a day/night cycle.
Survive ruthless mercs, inhuman horrors, and deadly hazards.
Random events including snipers, assassins, bombardments, and supply drops.
Wield a variety of weapons, attachments, devices, and consumables.
A tight resource economy - loot, repair, craft, and pick your battles.
Manage hunger, stamina, and other immersive survival systems.
Horizontally-focused meta-progression.

WATCH YOUR STEP
Navigate and survive dangerous procedural regions in this gritty FPS. Set in a near-future Arctic ravaged by a devastating calamity. Arcticide is a challenging permadeath experience full of unpredictable environments and situations. Resources are scarce, so pick your battles, scavenge carefully, and watch your step. Weapons and equipment have limited durability, so be sure to repair them, replace them, or face the consequences.

Random threats and opportunities abound in every run. Elite soldiers, snipers, aerial barrages, and toxic areas could mean certain death if mishandled. On the other hand, supply caches, printing stations, and helpful locals could tip the scales in your favor.


Finding databanks and surviving deep into runs will provide valuable intel to help you progress. The horizontal meta-progression system allows for unlocking new starting loadouts, potential loot, and crafting recipes. These provide fresh tactical options and tools to play with rather than make the game explicitly easier - to improve your chances of survival, there is no substitute for learning and refining your tactics.

Completed runs also give deeper insight into the events that led to the calamity, and provide clues as to where to search next. Each destination offers unique events, biomes, and enemies.

title: A Song Of Sunlight
description:
게임 정보


Arem has lived his life surrounded by ocean waves and fields of dying grass. Upon his small island lies the Settlement, a community of just three thousand- the Children of the Sun. Passing the long years in prayer and simple work, the blessed people of the island use their traditions to survive. Arem, like all young men and women of the Settlement, knows his duty to society: to perform his obligation for the greater good, and never to enter The Well- a passage leading deep into the unknown earth below.

Raised as a Woundbearer, Arem desires to come of age and play his crucial part in improving the lives of his community- none more so than Sachita, the burning girl, shunned by the Settlement but whom he loves dearly.

Yet, when Arem is suddenly given the responsibilities he always dreamed of, he finds his certainty shattered by the truth of the horror held at the Settlement’s close reach. Realizing that he has a much more important duty to fulfill, Arem becomes engrossed in a mystery he can never speak of.

Descending into the Well and desperately searching for an exit, Arem will discover the breaking point of his relationships.



A Song of Sunlight features a novel pseudo-turn-based combat system that challenges players to fight for their lives against horrifying enemies. Make split-second calculated decisions, then attack, block, evade, and look for openings in real-time against multiple targets in thrilling combat encounters.

By day, carry out your duties to the Settlement and interact with its inhabitants to obtain resources and learn more about the world.

By night, explore desolate megastructures filled with mystery and danger, discover weapons and equipment lost to humanity, and customize your build to suit many distinct play styles.

title: Shadows Of Deceit
description:
게임 정보
Explore the spectral city of Havenbrook, now shrouded in darkness and mystery.
Every step you take reveals fragments of a larger story, a tale of tragedy, loss, and dark forces lurking in the shadows.
But beware, you are not alone. Something or someone knows your every move and seeks to obstruct your path to the truth. Will you survive long enough to unravel the mystery and free yourself from this endless trap?
This is an experience that will leave you breathless, a harrowing descent into the darkest recesses of the human psyche. Confront the unknown and discover if you have the strength to overcome the trials that await you.

title: COCOA
description:
게임 정보
COCOA는 대조적인 세계를 독특하고 감동적으로 탐험합니다.
이 게임에서는 아프리카 코트디부아르 남부에서 Issa와 Asante로서 아동 노동의 가혹한 현실을 경험하게 됩니다. 수확, 분쇄, 청소, 건조 등 카카오콩 처리의 힘든 일정을 포인트 앤 클릭 미니게임을 통해 진행하고, 경비원의 눈을 피해 은밀하게 탈출 기회를 찾는 과제를 수행합니다.

반대로, 탐욕스러운 사업가 Mr. Theodore와 그의 매니저 Tom의 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 럭셔리 초콜릿 공장을 관리하고, 운영을 확장하며, 기계를 업그레이드하는 경영 타이쿤 경험을 제공합니다.

이 어두운 RPG는 이러한 대조적인 경험들을 엮어 강렬하고 불안감을 주는 결말로 이끌며, 탐욕과 인간 가치라는 주제를 강조합니다.
특징
90년대 애니메이션 스타일로 손으로 그린 많은 컷씬들
플레이하는 매 순간 긴장감을 유지하는 강렬하고 생생한 스토리

아동 노동자:
많은 비밀 지역이 있는 어두운 미로 같은 정글을 탐험
경비원들이 지도를 스캔하여 당신을 추적하는 것을 피하기 위해 달아나거나 덤불에 숨기
포인트 앤 클릭 미니게임에서 매일 카카오 처리 작업을 완료. 늦지 않도록 하고 오늘의 목표를 달성하세요!
일터 캠프에서 탈출할 수 있도록 도와줄 다양한 NPC와 대화

초콜릿 공장:
가장 효율적인 시스템을 만들기 위해 컨베이어 벨트와 기계를 배치
공장을 업그레이드: 작업자를 기계로 대체하고, 효율성을 개선하며, 공장 공간을 확장

이 게임은 심각한 주제를 다루고 있지만, 궁극적인 목표는 상업 산업에서 아동 노동 착취에 대한 인식과 공감을 증진하는 것입니다. 우리는 이 게임에서 제시된 주제를 촉진하거나 경시할 의도가 없습니다.

title: Onychomp : Lush journey
description:
게임 정보
산을 오르면서 던전을 탐험하세요.
마법의 산을 오르는 동안 프로시저럴 던전을 통해 위험한 여정을 떠나세요. 밤이 끝나기 전에 정상까지 가는 길을 찾으세요.
생물을 물어 먹고 노랑퍼지세요
만나는 모든 생물을 삼키기 위해 탐욕스러운 식욕을 터뜨리세요.
더 높이 올라갈 수 있는 물건을 만드세요

title: Drone Sector
description:
게임 정보
미래의 드론 건쉽
Drone Sector는 건쉽의 근접 공중 지원 역할과 드론의 관찰 및 임무 지휘를 결합한 게임입니다. 실제 AC-130 건쉽과 MQ-9 리퍼 드론에서 영감을 받아, 이러한 강력한 역할을 미래적인 설정 속에서 통합합니다. 첨단 기술과 강력한 화력 덕분에 더 복잡하고 위험한 임무를 수행할 수 있습니다. 순수한 군사 시뮬레이터는 아니지만, 전술 계획과 실행에 중점을 두며, 임무 설계와 무기 사용에서 더 많은 유연성을 제공합니다.
임무 지휘
당신의 부대를 지휘하여 적대적인 환경을 통과하면서 임무 목표를 달성하세요. 정밀한 명령을 통해 함정을 피하고, 압도적인 화력으로 고우선 순위의 적을 제거하세요. 적군에게 수적으로 열세인 상황에서, 기술적 우위를 최대한 활용해 전세를 뒤집어야 합니다.

title: Underground Security Inc
description:
게임 정보
Underground Security Inc is a unique blend of rogue-lite, tower defense and worker-placement elements. As a head manager of the local dungeon, you are responsible for its security and profitability. 
       Beware! you must face against waves of "heroes" bent on liberating your gold. Build traps, hire minions and cast spells to repel the would-be-adventurers.

title: Quirky Forest
description:
게임 정보
Quirky Forest is a fast-paced single player puzzle platformer. Help two inseparable friends to explore this wacky forest. Place the correct item at the right place, plan ahead, think carefully, this game is easy to play, but hard to master. Be prepared to be challenged!
A big inspiration for the design of this game is Nintendo. I believe if you truly enjoyed titles as Toad Treasure Tracker, Super Mario 3D World, this game is totally for you, thank you so much for checking it out.
The full game will contain:
35 Levels
4 Worlds
A cozy story about two inseparable friends 
6 Different mind-boggling mechanics

title: The Walking Trade
description:
게임 정보
워킹 트레이드(Walking Trade)는 혼돈과 상거래가 충돌하는 기발하고 액션으로 가득한 좀비 아포칼립스 상점 경영 게임입니다!
공간, 미학, 기능의 균형을 맞춰 상점을 디자인하세요. 진열대를 정리하고, 가격을 책정하고, 고객이 행복하게 또는 최소한 살아서 돌아갈 수 있도록 하세요.

title: CoreRunner
description:
게임 정보
스케이트. 베기. 사격. 생존.
코어러너는 칼과 총 전투를 빛나는 빛의 궤적과 융합하여 완전히 독특한 플레이 스타일을 만들어내는 고속 3인칭 러너/슈터입니다. 디지털 감옥으로 설계된 구형 세계의 네트워크인 코어의 네온에 젖은 미래를 배경으로, 여러분은 놀라운 신스웨이브 풍경을 가로질러 자유를 향해 싸워 나갈 것입니다.
특징
혁명적인 전투 시스템: 아레나를 스케이트하며 이중 검과 이중 권총을 휘두르며 360° 공격 범위로 뱀과 같은 빛의 궤적을 남깁니다.
청각적 경험: 모든 환경과 게임플레이 시퀀스가 맥동하는 신스웨이브 트랙을 중심으로 제작되었습니다.
놀라운 시각적 디자인: 생동감 있는 네온 조명과 전투를 시각적 예술로 변화시키는 양식화된 효과가 있는 레트로웨이브 미학.
적응형 난이도: 코어 깊숙이 진행할수록 점점 더 적대적인 순찰대와 환경적 위험에 직면합니다.
정밀 조작: 번개처럼 빠른 반응과 유연한 움직임을 위해 설계된 맞춤형 컨트롤러 시스템을 마스터하세요.

title: Fecal Freighter
description:
게임 정보
After a sudden invasion of space aliens hunting for human biological waste, the job of a sewage truck operator has become a perilous craft. Join the elite of the elite and become a transporter of the brown gold — the very substance without which the world wouldn’t be quite so... picturesque. But beware: dark alleys hide sinister surprises, and no matter how hard you try, you’ll never be fully prepared for what lurks there. It’s not just aliens after you — sludge demons spawned from the filth and the fanatical followers of the Brown Cult, whose ominous leader is rumored to have ties to a shadowy global government, are on your tail too.

title: Weeb Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Weeb Store Simulator.
Where your dream of running the ultimate anime and gaming store comes to life! As the manager, you’ll start with a humble selection of items, but with hard work and smart decisions, you’ll unlock new licenses, expand your inventory, and turn your store into a bustling otaku paradise.
Co-op Multiplayer
Team up with friends in co-op multiplayer mode to manage the store together! Assign roles, stock shelves, handle customers, and watch your business grow. From rare collectibles to the latest gaming gear, every item you sell brings you closer to becoming the top weeb store in town.

title: Virtual Hearts
description:
게임 정보
Virtual Hearts is a cozy short romance story where you play as Bella, a young adult who finds a computer in someone's garbage and decides to take it home.
💖 Memory Mini-Game 💖
Engage with cute and fun memory mini-games to earn points that unlock premium choices
💖 Chat Mechanic💖
Chat with the characters and make decisions that determine the outcome of your relationships. Text, flirt, and uncover secrets with each love interest.

title: The Most Dangerous Game
description:
게임 정보
Hunt. Fight. Survive. Kill. Win. The Most Dangerous Game puts a modern spin on the iconic 1924 short story. Dropped onto a stunning tropical island, you have mere hours to prepare—build shelter, craft weapons, and secure food and clean water—before the first wave of hunters arrives. Their mission? Track and kill you for sport.
Survive the elements, outlast increasingly deadly hunters over ten in-game days, and you win. Will you make it?
Explore a Rich, Beautiful, and Deadly Tropical Island
Experience a vast open-world island with dynamic weather, a realistic day-night cycle, and diverse wildlife. But paradise is deceptive—its beauty hides real danger. Some of the island’s natural inhabitants can be just as deadly as the hunters tracking you.

title: Klasztorna: Lost Within
description:
게임 정보
Psychological horror in which you're trapped inside your own school, hunted by a relentless entity. As you navigate through the ever-changing hallways, you must find a way to escape, all while avoiding the creature lurking in the shadows. In Klasztorna, the environment shifts, distorting reality and testing your perception. The line between what's real and what's imagined blurs, and only your wits can help you survive. Can you escape, or will the darkness consume you?

title: Oni Hunters
description:
게임 정보


환영합니다, 전설과 그림자의 땅, 기로니아에 오신 것을.

매 반세기마다, 이 지역에는 다른 어떤 축제와는 다른 축제가 내려옵니다. 하지만 이것은 단순한 축제가 아닙니다 - 이것은 미스터리와 어둠으로 둘러싸인 '몬스터 주빌리' 이벤트입니다.

•거대한 오픈 월드와 그 던전을 탐험하세요•



기로니아의 넓고 열린 지형에 몸을 던져보세요. 번화한 도시부터 가장 어두운 구석, 복잡한 던전까지, 당신이 밟는 모든 걸음마다 새로운 비밀을 밝혀내거나 위험으로 이끌 수 있습니다. 각 던전 내에 숨겨진 보물과 도전을 발굴하면서 그 수많은 미스터리를 통해 길을 찾아 나가세요. 이렇게 넓은 세계에서, 이야기는 정말로 당신이 형성할 것입니다.

•전략적이고 다이나믹한 전투 시스템•



턴 기반 전투이지만 예측하기는 어렵습니다. 새롭게 변화된 전투 시스템은 전략과 선견지명을 요구합니다. 여러 가지 전투 모드로, 모든 만남은 당신의 지혜와 용기를 시험하는 것입니다.

수백 가지의 독특한 몬스터를 발견하고 친구가 되어보세요. 각각은 다른 능력과 희귀성을 자랑합니다. 그들을 훈련시켜 기로니아에서 가장 위대한 몬스터 테이머가 되어보세요. 하지만 몬스터 주빌리의 그림자에서 테이머와 테이밍되는 자 사이의 경계는 종종 흐릿해질 수 있음을 잊지 마세요.

••

몬스터 퓨전의 강력한 비밀을 밝혀내세요!
두 생물을 결합하여 부모의 기술과 능력을 상속받는 새롭고 강력한 엔터티를 창조하세요. 실험하고, 발견하고, 무적의 팀을 구축하세요.



••

최대 20시간의 핵심 스토리 모드로, 음모, 유머, 그리고 어둠의 이야기에 몰입하세요. 모든 선택, 모든 전투, 그리고 잡히거나 합쳐진 모든 몬스터는 당신을 '몬스터 주빌리'의 미스터리 해결에 한 걸음 더 가깝게 만듭니다.

당신의 행동과 결정에는 무게가 있습니다. 결정에 따라 새로운 결말로 이끌 수 있으므로 길을 지혜롭게 선택하세요. 여러 갈래의 경로가 있으므로 플레이할 때마다 독특한 경험을 기대하실 수 있습니다.

몬스터 주빌리에서 모든 것이 보이는 그대로인 것은 아닙니다. 이 오랜 축제의 진실과 속임수를 발견함에 따라, 당신은 몬스터 테이밍의 어둠의 한면과 직면하게 될 것입니다.



••






기로니아로 들어오세요. 그것의 미스터리를 밝혀내세요. 전설이 되세요.

🌟 지금 를 위시리스트에 추가하고 비교할 수 없는 모험을 준비하세요! 🌟

title: WonderLang Korean
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to WonderLang, where mastering Korean transforms into an engaging RPG journey. Immerse yourself in captivating quests, interactive dialogues, and fun puzzles designed to make language learning seamless and enjoyable.
WonderLang weaves language into the core of its adventure and compelling narrative. Get immersed in Wonderlang, as you: Explore, Fight, Converse and Investigate using your target language.
More affordable, more engaging, and way more fun than any subscription-based language learning app!
WonderLang is designed for beginner language learners, A1 level and A2 level learners, allowing you to dive into the game without any prior knowledge of the language. While the game doesn't aim to fully replace traditional language courses, it provides an immersive and enjoyable way to practice a new language gradually.

title: The Last of the Minnows
description:
게임 정보
It's the apocalypse and it's your job to save the last surviving minnows on the planet. To keep them alive for 100 days, you'll need to carefully manage water conditions, breed fish with beneficial traits, and adapt to environmental fluctuations. Each day brings new opportunities and risks. Will your minnows thrive, or will they perish?
Each day, you’ll check water conditions, manage food supplies, and decide which fish to breed. Adjust temperature, oxygen, and filtration manually—while dealing with unexpected malfunctions. A clogged filter might spike contamination, while a power outage could shut down oxygenation and heating completely. Every decision impacts the tank’s fragile ecosystem.
Key Features:
Dynamic Tank Conditions 
Manually adjust machinery to counteract temperature shifts, oxygen depletion, and contamination build-up. Aging equipment, power outages and unexpected events make this more difficult than it sounds.
Genetic Survival 
Breed fish with unique traits, balancing strengths and weaknesses for long-term survival. Discover and experiment with over a dozen mutations. Some fish thrive in low-oxygen conditions, while others grow larger but require more food. Still others produce more offspring or clean the tank of contaminants. Breed traits that help your fish deal with changing conditions, survive longer and pass their genetic advantages to the next generation.
Resource Management 
Carefully manage a limited food supply, unpredictable power source and fluctuating oxygen levels. Choose between growing a larger population or culling weaker fish to ensure long-term survival. Risk keeping a fish alive for breeding, or sacrifice it for food. Power outages may prevent you from improving tank conditions, forcing you to make some tough decisions.
Unpredictable Challenges
Equipment failures, water leaks, or sudden contamination surges keep you on edge. Random traits and events make each play-through challenging and unpredictable. No single strategy is sure to succeed.
Survival isn't guaranteed. Adaptation is key. Will your minnows make it?

title: Gravethorn
description:
게임 정보
고대의 저주가 악성 가시를 모든 살아있는 영혼에 퍼뜨리며, 희망과 절망 사이의 미약한 균형을 깨뜨렸습니다. 심문관으로 깨어나, 뿌리로 표식된 외로운 방랑자가 되어 잊혀진 전설의 메아리가 어둠의 relentless한 손아귀와 결합되는 세계로 발을 들여놓으세요.
비선형적인 세계를 가로지르는 서사시
썩어가는 신전, 유령처럼 떠도는 숲, 무너져가는 유적이 고요한 아름다움과 흔들리지 않는 위험으로 가득 찬 풍경을 형성하는 비선형적인 세계를 가로지르며 여정을 시작하세요. 모든 그림자는 비밀을 숨기고 있으며, 모든 가시는 이 땅을 얽어맨 저주를 상기시키는 잔인한 경고입니다.
잔혹하고 적응 가능한 전투
Gravethorn의 모든 구석에서 숨어있는 기괴한 생물들과 거대한 저주받은 괴물들과 맞서 싸우세요. 파괴적인 콤보를 마스터하고, 치명적인 마무리 공격을 실행하여 정밀함, 전략, 그리고 순수한 결단력이 유일한 동맹이 되는 치열한 전투에서 승리를 거두세요. 전투 스타일을 즉시 적응시켜 고통을 어둠의 힘에 대한 무기로 변환하세요.
굴하지 않는 커스터마이징
잃어버린 영혼들의 힘이 깃든 유물을 찾아 긴 시간 동안 잊혀졌던 전설의 신비에 깊이 잠수하세요. 능력을 강화하고, 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞춘 독특한 경로를 만들어주는 신비로운 장신구, 문장, 금지된 예술을 장착하세요. 회수한 모든 유물은 저주를 풀고, 당신 자신의 신비한 과거를 풀어나가는 발판이 됩니다.
비극적인 만남의 직조
위험한 여행을 떠나는 동안 Gravethorn의 슬픈 운명과 얽힌 신비한 인물들과 만나요. 일부는 암호 같은 안내를 제공하고, 다른 일부는 광기의 베일 아래에 배신의 동기를 숨기고 있습니다. 그들의 이야기와 선택은 당신의 결단력을 시험하며, 구속을 추구할지 복수를 받아들일지를 결정해야 합니다.
서사적인 보스 전투와 속죄의 대가
고대의 저주를 물리친 거대한 적들과 심장을 뛰게 만드는 전투를 준비하세요. 각 전투는 당신의 용기와 기지에 대한 잔인한 시험이 될 것이며, 모든 승리는 죽음과 재탄생의 순환을 깨는 한 걸음이 됩니다.

title: Split Signal
description:
게임 정보
A new puzzle game from LYNE creator Thomas Bowker with visual design by Peter Bentley.

Traverse a vast landscape filled with hundreds of tetromino inspired puzzles and fix something that has broken.

title: Legends of Castile
description:
게임 정보
What is Legends of Castile?

Legends of Castile is a new comic fantasy point-and-click adventure with full HD hand-drawn graphics, and a twist: The protagonist's biggest dream is to become a nun, and she must investigate the region’s folk legends to fulfill it.


What is the game about?

Legends of Castile is a comic fantasy point-and-click adventure set in the historic Castile region of Spain in the 19th century. It tells the story of a village girl who must investigate the myths and legends of Castile to fulfill her dream of becoming a nun. Advance the story by solving puzzles and riddles, meeting all kinds of characters, defeating fantastic creatures with your wit, and exploring places all around Castile.
Who is the protagonist of this story?

The main character of this adventure is María, a young and fearless, though clumsy, Castilian girl. The story begins when, just after a long night with her friends, María has a vision of the Virgin Mary, after which she decides to become a nun. María asks to be ordained at a convent in Burgos, where her future mother superior assigns her a very important mission: To fulfill her dream, María must investigate the mythological creatures that have been appearing around the territory of Castile, and collect an item from each to prove their existence. Only once she has done this will the bishop take action against the creatures, to end their threat to the population of Castile... and Christianity.

title: Wendigo Hunter
description:
게임 정보
If you like the game please don't forget to add it to your wishlist.
Wendigo Hunter is an action roguelite dungeon crawler with mysterious atmosphere and minimalistic visual. As a chosen member of a cult you will try to hunt down a mythological creature hiding deep in dungeons and abandoned ruins. Unleash a captivating journey where fallen enemies' souls become the key to unlocking mesmerizing magical skills.
Fight, collect, upgrade, die, try again...
FEATURES
master your fighting skills in combat with various creatures
explore randomly generated dungeon
upgrade your magical skills by collecting souls of dead enemies
gain permanent upgrades by spending collected gems
Will you succeed or the next hunter from the cult will need to be chosen?
ABOUT DEVELOPER
Peter Jurkovský, solo developer and father of 1, began work on Wendigo Hunter as a hobby in 2022 after releasing his first PC game called Juro Janosik.

title: ChipWits
description:
게임 정보
ChipWits is a robot coding game with no prior programming experience required. In this game, you use an icon-based language to guide your robot to solve open-ended puzzles and rescue the crew of a space station taken over by a rogue AI, Dr. Droog.


Someone, or something, has forced every last crew member to evacuate Droog Station! The fate of the station – and its crew – is left to a humble robot sitting in the corner of a supply closet: a ChipWit Model CW-03.24.


To save the station, you transmit instructions to your ChipWit by placing chips in a grid. No prior programming knowledge is required – you’ll be taught everything you need to know!




Feeling creative? Solve puzzles in unique and clever ways – there's no one right answer! Optional bonus missions have no objective other than to have fun!

Every solution can be optimized to:
• Maximize your score
• Minimize the number of chips used
• Minimize the number of cycles (steps) it takes for your program to run



When you complete your solution, you can compare your performance to players all around the world!


Droog Station isn’t going to save itself! Unravel the mystery of Dr. Droog and uncover his motive while you go face to face with some of his robotic creations.

Navigate the corridors and rooms of the station to get to your next mission. Rescue other robots and make new friends who will help you in your quest!

Finished the game? Check back often for new puzzles and challenges, and see if you can top the leaderboard!


Look familiar? ChipWits was originally released in 1984 as one of the first games for the Macintosh, Commodore 64, and Apple II.




Join our Discord community (link in the sidebar) to learn how to become a beta tester, connect with fellow players, share tips, and stay updated on the latest game news and events.

title: Starship Colony
description:
게임 정보
Starship Colony. 깊은 우주선 식민지 시뮬레이션. 우주선을 만들고, 공기, 물, 음식, 연료, 에너지, 온도 및 심리학을 관리하여 먼 거리에서 승무원이 살아남을 수 있도록 하세요. 우주의 폐쇄 루프 시스템. 채광, 배선, 배관, 선내 공장, (외계인?) 무선 신호 및 번역, 외교, 전투 등.

우주에서의 생존은 어렵다
자원은 풍부하지만 각 오아시스에 도달하려면 광대한 공허를 가로질러 여행해야 합니다. 이를 위해서는 신중한 계획, 효율적인 재활용, 자급 자족 및 충성스러운 승무원이 필요합니다. 인간 식민지 너머에는 도움을 요청할 사람이 없습니다. 인간 식민지조차도 위험으로 가득 차 있으며 외부 지역에는 분쟁과 불법 복제가 만연합니다. 절망적인 사람들은 절망적인 일을 합니다. 그리고 저 너머의 위험을 알리는 비인간 무선 신호가 있습니다.


당신은 최신 워프 드라이브를 갖춘 새로운 우주선의 선장으로 플레이합니다. 인류 역사상 가장 길고 위대한 임무를 위해 배와 승무원을 모아야 합니다. 소규모로 시작하지만 새로운 승무원을 선택하고 이동함에 따라 배를 확장하십시오.

우주선, 선체 디자인, 장비, 승무원 숙소 및 가구를 만드세요.
공기, 물, 음식, 연료, 에너지, 온도 및 심리를 관리하여 승무원의 생존을 유지하세요.
우주의 폐쇄 루프 시스템. 재활용하거나 죽으십시오. 아무것도 낭비하지 마십시오.
얼음을 캐서 물을 만드세요. 공기와 로켓 연료를 위해 O2와 H2로 나눕니다.
무역이나 선박 확장을 위해 광석과 귀금속을 채굴하세요.
선박 내부에 공장을 건설하여 부품을 제조하십시오.
소행성, 위성, 행성에 착륙합니다. 전초 기지를 건설하십시오.






외계인 무선 신호가 인류에게 워프 기술을 선물한 지 30년이 지났고 인류는 별 전체에 산불처럼 퍼졌습니다. 그러나 우리의 부상을 축소해야 할 잠재적 위협으로 보는 다른 강력한 세력도 있습니다. 우리도 그것에 대해 경고를 받았습니다. 이제 워프 기술에 대한 우리의 이해가 성숙해졌으므로 마침내 더 먼 지역으로 여행하고 답을 얻을 수 있습니다. 전송 소스를 찾고 연락을 취하고 위협에 대한 도움을 구하십시오.
게임은 초기 단계에 있으며 이 페이지를 포함하여 현재 모든 것이 매우 '자리 표시자'이지만 진행 속도가 빠릅니다.

림월드 (RimWorld), Save Our Ship 2, Oxygen Not Included, Space Haven, Stardeus, 프리즌 아키텍트 (Prison Architect) 또는 파코토리오 (Factorio)를 즐겼다면 이 게임도 마음에 드실 것이며 여러분을 환영합니다. 그래도 참아주세요! 좋은 일에는 시간이 걸린다.. :)

Check the website at BlackBeltSoftware dot com for , join our , and be sure to not to miss any important announcements. Thanks!

title: On a Summer Night
description:
게임 정보
"Today, I would like to tell you about one night.
One night that changed my life."

Tokyo suburbs. Japan, early 2000's.
You're an overworked employee going home on a wet and hot summer night.
At the station, you discover that your bag is missing after you've been hit by... something unknown.
Lights are dim and weird people are roaming in the empty streets. How the hell are you supposed to get home now?

With anime-esque graphics and a dark sense of humor, On a Summer Night is the first commercial game of Team Wagashi.

Trigger warning: death, school bullying, suicide, arson, alcoholism, car accident

title: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
description:
게임 정보


Zeta Wolf Chronicles is a dating sim with a hyperrealistic focus, that hones in and examines the struggles of adolescent dating. Experience the journey of Rayen as he navigates his senior year in high school. Learn about the nuances of love and its many intricacies along the way.



Dispirited by his lack of progress, Rayen initially seeks out extravagant means to reach his end. One day, he is approached by a mysterious visitor, who quickly alters his fate. Suddenly, he must choose to befriend one of four girls in his rehabilitation process! Meanwhile, he continues his agenda to pursue Siona, his fateful crush. In this tale inspired by real-life events, Rayen is forced to change his life, and commit time and energy toward what his heart desires the most. Will desperation win out, or will knowledge, patience, and logic pave the way to success?
4 Romancable Girls with a Fifth Wheel

title: Spaceman Memories
description:
게임 정보


Set in a futuristic Japan overrun by spirits, Spaceman Memories is a true ode to classic JRPGs of the past. The game's world coupled with its heartwarming narrative, offer players a chance to relive the good old days of 2D gaming. As the spaceman Ichiro 94, whose capsule mysteriously landed back home after a space mission, players embark on a poignant journey of self-discovery, encountering strange creatures, and battling formidable foes, all while uncovering the secrets of his forgotten past and ancient Japanese mysticism. With each step, players must also solve puzzles and use Ichiro's abilities to fight, all of which are vital in the quest to uncover the truth about his past.

Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted retro Japanese game, brought to life in a vibrant 3D world brimming with emotion and nostalgia. This heartwarming adventure, seamlessly blends open-world exploration with puzzles and turn based battles offering a truly unforgettable experience!



Engage in epic, story-driven exploration and masterfully crafted turn-based battles in a classic JRPG experience.

title: Neural Synapse
description:
게임 정보
A distinctive journey awaits you, where you'll delve into the narrative of our protagonist navigating the shadowy alleys of a futuristic metropolis.
Immerse yourself in a realm of technological advancements and criminal mysteries, where the repercussions of your every choice unfold.
Employ your logical reasoning and analytical skills to endure in this tumultuous world.

Key Features:
• Third Person 3D Adventure
• Non-linear Storytelling
• Exciting missions
• Mini Games
• Clean tone story
• Multiple endings

title: Hivefall
description:
게임 정보
Synthesis: Welcome to Hivefall, a post-apocalyptic world devastated by The Hive, a horde of carnivorous mutants that hunt in synchronicity. As one of the last survivors, your mission is simple: stay alive. Drive your caravan, fight for resources and decide whether you will rebuild what is left of humanity or perish in the attempt.
Every decision counts in this fight for survival and hope for a better future.
Main mechanics:
Dynamic Survival: Explore a hostile world by collecting resources, hunting prey and facing mutants. Constant movement is your best ally,
as stopping too long could attract the deadly attention of The Hive.
Your Caravan, Your Strength: Your vehicle is not just a means of transportation; It is your home, your refuge and your best weapon. Customize it and improve its capabilities to resist enemy attacks and travel long distances.
Wave Battles: Stay in one place too long and prepare to face endless hordes of enemies. With your caravan as a mobile combat base, use strategic tactics and resources to survive these brutal confrontations.
Reconstruction and Renaissance: Shows that humanity still has a chance.
If you survive long enough, you can help the villagers build self-sufficient settlements, marking the beginning of the recovery of the lost world.

title: Midline '85
description:
게임 정보


Midline ‘85 is an interactive thriller about working as an emergency service operator in a small town. Face the fears, desires and cruelty of people caught in trouble, as well as calls from your coworkers, friends, or even enemies. You will observe six months of Elena’s work, from her first day on the job to the story’s finale. Only your choices determine how it ends.


Study Midline for the smallest details of its life: local radio broadcasts, the morning paper, or work mail. Find information that will unlock new dialogue options. But remember: there is no knowing where an unexplored path might take you…




Your telephone is your only weapon. Use information you’ve gathered outside of calls, monitor the person on the other end’s mental state. Lie, intimidate, investigate or play by the book — there’s no tactic you shouldn’t try when someone’s life is at stake. Time is working against you, but it’s no reason to despair.




The past casts long shadows. Your actions affect the state of the protagonist, who cannot forget people’s deaths or her own mistakes. See the consequences in her character, available dialogue options and ultimately the ending.

title: No Stone Unturned
description:
게임 정보
It was a dark and stormy morning when the soon-to-be Greatest Detective in the World, Detective Cox, stumbled upon the body of a chicken. (The body was dead, it was a dead body, the chicken was dead and this was his body, found by the Detective who is neither dead or a chicken.) This grisly discovery leaves him with just one question…
What was he running from? Who, or what, stopped him? And did the chicken really come before the egg? Okay, maybe there's more than one question. But Cox needs answers like a walrus needs a vacation (a lot) - He needs your help (even though he’s incredibly smart, a truly world-class detective and could probably manage without your help, okay?!)
Solve A Murder Most... Fowl and 5 more Side Cases!
Learn why The Hare and the Tortoise are at each other throats, what's got the Cat's tongue, and hoo tried to silence the watchful giant owl...? (Ya know... Hoo. Like an owl)

title: Anime Slayer
description:
게임 정보
Anime Slayer is an engaging and immersive first-person shooter (FPS) game that offers an abundance of adversaries, captivating puzzles, thrilling boss battles, and a touch of humor.

As you awaken, you find yourself transported into a partially abandoned dwelling, a place that seems ethereal and detached from reality. The flickering shadows and lingering echoes create an atmosphere of eerie enchantment, casting doubt upon the authenticity of your surroundings. Every creaking floorboard and whispering gust of wind amplifies the surreal nature of this inexplicable journey. It's as if you have entered a realm where the boundaries of existence are blurred, leaving you questioning the very fabric of reality itself.
Immersed in this enigmatic realm, you are entrusted with unraveling the enigma of this place, embarking on an extraordinary quest that demands both exploration of the surrounding territories and the triumph over adversaries encountered along your path. As you navigate through the mysterious landscapes, unearthing hidden secrets, your journey becomes a captivating tapestry of adventure. Armed with resilience and cunning, you must vanquish the foes that cross your path, for within their defeat lies the key to unlocking the ultimate truth of this ethereal domain.

title: Discarded Memories: Mysteries of the Past
description:
게임 정보
In 1995, Andrew Connor's fiance was hit and killed by a car after she frantically ran out into the road from the nearby forest. It was clear that she had been spooked by something, but no one could figure out what. Since no evidence of foul play was found, the case was eventually marked as solved and archived by the police. Andrew was not happy with this though. His home town was full of mysteries, and now he found himself right in the middle of one of them. He knew that there had to be more to the story, so he began to search for answers on his own. However, he might just get more than he bargained for with this investigation.

Collect Evidence
Things like police case files are rarely served on a silver platter to however asks for them. It will be up to you to get the evidence you need to solve this mystery, and that includes doing things that aren't necessarily legal. Lock picking and trespassing are just some of the things you will end up doing on your quest for answers.

Investigate
Existing evidence can only get you so far. In some cases, you will need to go out and find new clues to help make sense of older ones. Once you have collected enough clues, you can use your trusty cork board to link everything together.

Don't Get Caught
Throughout your investigation, you will encounter people who won't be too happy with you poking around where you shouldn't be. You will have to exercise caution to ensure that you don't end up in jail, or worse. Stealth won't always be required, but you should be ready for when it is. There will be times where you will have to balance completing your current task, and creating as little noise as possible.

Solve the Mystery
You are on your own when it comes to solving this mystery, if there even is a mystery to solve. Is it all in your head, or is there something that everyone else missed?
autokwd: Discarded Memories: Mysteries of the Past

title: Mystic Land: The Search  Maphaldo
description:
게임 정보
Mystic Land is a project that started all the way back in 1994 when couple of friends had the idea of creating a fantasy role playing game that would be a mix of best elements from computer FRP games like Wizardry, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder.
The game saw a couple of attempts to be born back then, but it wasn’t to be. Partly because we were just too young and “green” back then, partly because, you know, “life happens”… we drifted apart, started our professional jobs and other ventures. You know, we grew up.

But, after more than 25 years, we found all them early unfinished DOS versions, maps, concept art and documentation lying on old disks collecting dust. We also found a lot of sketches and ideas on paper (that miraculously survived the 25+ years).
And so the decision was made - it’s time to develop this thing.

We are still determined that Mystic Land will be the best old-school computer fantasy role playing game with all the goodies from the 90s like turn based grid movement and combat, lots of (meaningful) skills and attributes and (hard) puzzled to solve.
Saying that, we will also add some quality-of-life improvements like full controller/mouse/keyboard support and easier inventory and battle strategy management.

title: Winnie's Hole
description:
게임 정보
MUTATE AND EVOLVE
Play as a virus in Winnie's body.
Capture cells to grow mutations and build a deck of actions.
Refine his primitive form, adapt for survival, and do not let his friends contain you. They do not understand our gift... We must share it with them.
EXPLORE AND DISCOVER
Explore randomly generated worlds by placing Virus blocks to spread through the body of your host.
Discover new cells and make gut decisions to direct the adventure.
Collect resources and unlock new abilities.
Evolve and modify your virus blocks to accelerate your growth and create more powerful combinations in battle.
COMBO-DRIVEN DECKBUILDING

title: Abaddon
description:
게임 정보
The terror and horrors that lie within Abaddon will give every horror fan a unique and absolutely terrifying new experience. When you find yourself in the worst possible place, surrounded by unimaginable pain and horror with no one to rely on but yourself, hope is all you have left. Immerse yourself in everyone's worst fears and bring your lost brother back home. Stay alert, as you are not alone.

synopsis


In this first-person psychological horror game, you are lost in a maze-like, nightmarish world of terror. You play as 22-year-old Jimmy, who is searching for his younger brother, Georgie, after he disappeared under mysterious circumstances into a twisted world of nightmares and terror. Now, Jimmy must confront his past, his fears, and his regrets in order to find Georgie and escape the living nightmare. Though you are on your own, remember that you are not alone.


Fear: Unimaginable Fear - A New Level of First-Person Psychological Horror Game

Plot: The immersive plot of the game is designed to test the player's sanity and bravery in a unique and terrifying story-driven gameplay experience, right from the first few minutes of gameplay.

Enemies: The video game villains in this horror genre are like none other, guaranteed to give you nightmares.

The Maze: The game takes place in a chaotic and maze-like world filled with everyone's worst nightmares. In order to face what lies within the maze, the player must possess both skill and bravery.


We are an indie games studio called "Nice to Meet Studios LTD" that has been playing horror games for over a decade. Our love for the genre has led us to create "Abaddon", a game that aims to provide the best and scariest horror experience possible. Inspired by classic horror games such as Amnesia: The Dark Descent, P.T., Outlast, Visage, MADiSON, Detention, Resident Evil, and many more, "Abaddon" is designed to terrify players like never before.

Our goal is to make the players suffer and terrify them in a never-before-seen horror experience. If you think you're brave enough, we'd love for you to try to beat it - if you dare. Lose yourself in the world of "Abaddon"

title: MidEvil
description:
게임 정보
MidEvil is a single player, multiplayer or co-op open world survival RPG that takes place in a vast 20km medieval island setting. Players start shipwrecked on the zombie infested island with nothing. The goals are simple, survive, build, defend!

Early Access planned features include:

Large stylized open world with day/night cycle and dynamic weather.
Host a server for your friends (up to 40 players).
Customizable modular characters, clothing and armour.
XP and skill point levelling system.
Hunger and thirst.
Loot economy with rare items.
Crafting, building, fortification and raiding.
Farming and horticulture system.
Animal breeding, taming and riding.
Hunting, fishing, wildlife and predators.
Rewarding combat system with melee, ranged and mounted combat.
PvP and PvE.
NPCs, zombies, bandits and guards.
Companion AI and pets.
Random quest system.
Dismemberment system.
AI guarded, civilized hubs for trading.
Controller support.
Steam Deck compatibility.
Steam achievements.

Future plans include many more additions such as ship building and siege weapons.


Download our to test the current progress of the game. Please be aware that this is a very early preview of the game and everything is subject to change. The main goal is to test multiplayer performance and stability. We had a lot of fun testing so we thought we'd share it. We welcome any feedback or suggestions.



















Have fun!

title: Master of Luna
description:
게임 정보
Master of Luna is a turn-based strategy game where you take the role of a half-forgotten deity seeking to regain their former power and ascend once again.
Multi-Layered Strategy

There's a lot of things happening all around. Cities grow and spread out across the map. Heroes gain levels and change classes. You learn new spells and expand your domain. AI opponents lurk in the dark. In the midst of it all, you must find a path to victory.

Besides the world map, the game has tactical combat, where you have to masterfully outmaneuver the enemy. Or just summon a bunch of creatures, that works as well.
Melancholic Vibe

Luna is a world of eternal twilight, illuminated by the blue light of two moons and shrouded in thick mist. Dreams and memories mean a lot in this place.

The world has gone through many cycles of sleep and awakening. It’s ancient, so there are lot of mysteries, shattered ruins, heroes of old and eldritch artifacts.
Respectful Attitude

Master of Luna respects its players. You make few decisions, but they matter a lot. There is no micromanagement or tedious tasks. Feedback is instantaneous. At no point you supposed to just hit “End Turn” over and over waiting for some bar to fill up. Creatures have few abilities, yet they are tangible. UI is straightforward and uses the same scheme for world and combat. Important information is explained in tooltips.

title: Speed Demons 2
description:
게임 정보
Speed Demons 2는 독특한 관점, 강렬한 액션, 놀라울 정도로 다양한 요소를 갖춘 아케이드 고속도로 레이싱 게임입니다. 혼란스러운 고속도로 레이싱 갱단인 Demons 중 한 명이나 어떤 대가를 치르더라도 Demons를 막기로 결심한 자경단인 Enforcer가 되어 도로를 달리게 됩니다. 러시아워를 뚫고 달리거나, 라이벌을 제치고 달리거나, Enforcer를 피하거나, 교통을 들이받는 난동을 부리든, Speed Demons 2가 여러분을 위해 여기 있습니다.
속도와 스타일, 횡스크롤 에디션
Speed Demons 2는 체이스 카메라 관점 덕분에 액션을 독특한 시각으로 볼 수 있게 해줍니다. 3가지 카메라 각도(직선, 하이앵글 체이스, 로우앵글 체이스)로 다른 관점에서 레이싱을 하게 됩니다. 이처럼 독특한 관점과 풍부한 추가 효과 덕분에 게임의 속도감이 특히 강렬합니다. 액션을 더 직관적으로 만들기 위해 컨트롤은 조향이 아닌 움직임에 초점을 맞춥니다. 가스, 브레이크, 터보(또는 능력) 버튼이 있으며 아날로그 스틱(또는 마우스)을 위아래로 움직여 차량의 방향을 제어합니다.
Speed Demons 2의 비주얼은 다채롭고 사용자 정의가 가능하며 고도로 최적화되어 있습니다. 물리는 항상 120hz에서 실행되지만 비주얼은 60hz 또는 120hz에서 모두 훌륭해 보이며 특히 고해상도 모니터에서 플레이할 때 더욱 그렇습니다. 이 게임은 미세 조정된 사용자 지정 모션 블러와 틸트 시프트 전체 화면 효과를 제공하지만 둘 다 완전히 선택 사항입니다. 차량과 도로 위험 요소는 셀 셰이딩 처리되지만 더 간단한 스타일을 선호하는 경우 윤곽선을 비활성화할 수 있습니다. 어떤 설정을 사용하든 Speed Demons 2 액션은 스타일리시하고 매끄럽습니다.

title: SYNTAXIA
description:
게임 정보
You awake inside a decaying complex, confused and alone. A nearby laptop flickers to life, revealing a fascinating ability - whatever is written in it becomes reality. With this unique tool, you must navigate the enigmatic Sensoria Komplex, using your creativity and intuition to uncover its secrets and find a way out.
Multiple paths await as you explore the sprawling Sensoria Komplex. Its abstract and unpredictable halls have many secrets, some charming, some dangerous. Its haunting soundscape creates a unique, immersive atmosphere. Your choices will affect this living world, and will decide whether you uncover its secrets or stay within its blood-soaked walls.

title: The Long Fall Home
description:
게임 정보
The Long Fall Home
The year is 1969. The world is watching as Apollo 11 prepares to make history. But behind the scenes, NASA launches a secret initiative: four brave blue-collar volunteers are selected to join the mission, not to walk on the Moon, but to be cryogenically frozen in a lunar research hub. The plan? Wake them up in 1975 when the next crew arrives and study the long-term effects of lunar exposure on the human body.
That mission never happens.
NASA loses its funding. The world moves on. The volunteers? Forgotten. Until the hub’s power fails in 2025, and they thaw out naturally, confused, dazed, and completely alone.
But the Moon isn’t the same. And neither is space.
As they leave the surface, they’re met with a cosmic fever dream, massive yellow submarines floating aimlessly, whales soaring through the void, asteroids being mined by unknown forces, alien ships locked in battle, and everyday objects blown up to absurd proportions, like they just drifted out of a deranged thrift store.
Is this the future? A hallucination? Or are they still frozen, trapped in a bizarre dream?
With only each other and their wits, the four survivors must navigate an interstellar obstacle course of gravity-defying puzzles, physics-based platforming, and mind-bending hazards, all while piecing together what really happened during their 56-year sleep.
Will they find a way home? Or will they be lost in the madness of deep space forever?
🌌 1-4 Player Co-op – Play solo or with friends as you stumble through the unknown, working together to solve puzzles and overcome bizarre challenges.
🚀 Surreal Space Exploration – Traverse a world where logic takes a backseat, and the impossible is just another Tuesday.
🧩 Physics-Based Puzzles – Manipulate objects, master momentum, and solve obstacles using teamwork and ingenuity.
🎭 A Mind-Bending Mystery – Unravel the truth behind your fate while questioning what’s real and what’s the ramblings of a cryo-frozen brain.
You went to sleep in 1969.
You woke up in chaos.
Now, you just need to get home.
Will you make The Long Fall Home?

title: Nano Neighbors
description:
게임 정보
Nano Neighbors - An Online Desktop Idle Game!
In the future, NanoCorp revolutionized society with NANOs—advanced androids designed to work, protect, and evolve. But their greatest discovery wasn’t in circuits or code—it was in connection.
As a Handler, your bond with your NANO determines its growth, efficiency, and potential. The stronger your connection, the more your NANO thrives—and so does the world around you.
Customize your NANO
Personalize your NANO’s appearance to match your style. Upgrade and enhance them as they grow alongside you.
Give Your NANO a Purpose
Assign your NANO different tasks and jobs—whether it’s crafting, gathering, assisting with research, or even taking on unique missions. They can earn rewards and income for you to spend on more customisation!
Build & Decorate a Capsule Home
Design a cozy, futuristic capsule where your NANO lives. Decorate with furniture, gadgets, and upgrades to create the perfect space.
Invite Friends & Visit Their NANOs
Interact with your friends’ NANOs, visit their capsules, or invite them over to yours. Watch how their NANOs grow and evolve in different ways.

title: WonderLang Polyglot
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to WonderLang, where mastering a new language transforms into an engaging RPG journey. Immerse yourself in captivating quests, interactive dialogues, and fun puzzles designed to make language learning seamless and enjoyable.
WonderLang weaves language into the core of its adventure and compelling narrative. Get immersed in Wonderlang, as you: Explore, Fight, Converse and Investigate using your target language.
More affordable, more engaging, and way more fun than any subscription-based language learning app!
WonderLang is designed for beginner language learners, allowing you to dive into the game without any prior knowledge of the language. While the game doesn't aim to fully replace traditional language courses, it provides an immersive and enjoyable way to practice a new language gradually.
                Languages available at launch: French, German, Spanish, Italian & Portuguese.

title: The Liquid Jet
description:
게임 정보
The Liquid Jet
is the new dreamy adventure by Sad Mask Party, the twisted brains behind other twisted and brain-melting games such as Mango, The Lotus Holidays and GLITCH DADDY.
The Story
A year after the passing of their dear former friend Laurie, Mae and her group of girlfriends decide to go to a warehouse rave party in the forest, as a way to honor her memory.
At the rave, Mae goes on to experience an intense bad trip, forcing her to abruptly leave the dancefloor, as well as her friends. Then, she is left to explore the warehouse, getting deeper and deeper inside what morphs to be a liminal dreamscape where everybody seems to have disappeared.
Or have they..?
Help her find a way out and wake up, or witness her descent into a dream that lasts forever.
Features
A slimy, grainy PSX-inspired look, evoking atmospheric nostalgia, along with dreamy psychedelia.
An offbeat story that is equally funny, sad, thought-provoking, totally normal and yet weird.
Exploration, high liminality, interactive dialogue, light puzzles, as well as occasional action sequences and/or combat.
Multiple endings based on your choices and potential discovery of extra secrets.

title: Jane Austen Simulator: Pride and Prejudice
description:
게임 정보
Improve your word-guessing skills with this unique twist on Hangman! Guess sentences from Jane Austen’s Pride and Prejudice. Unlock audio clips and images. With no way to lose, you will be immersed in the greatest love story ever written. Who is “a single man of large fortune”? D_r_y
Think like Jane Austen
In this game you'll step into the shoes of Jane Austen and write the book Pride and Prejudice just like she did it more than 200 years ago. This is a perfect opportunity to show off how much you actually remember from the book.
Gameplay similar to Hangman
Ok, maybe not exactly the same way as Jane Austen. You'll not have to come up with the story yourself *phew*. You will go through the book in a way that is very similar to the word game Hangman. One sentence at a time, guessing letters. If the letter you've guessed, is in the sentence, it will be revealed and you can continue guessing. If you guess wrong, some of the revealed letters will be removed. 
A new way to Enjoy a Book
The proses of guessing the words to progress through the book really makes you pay attention to what you are reading. You get to see some clever use of words that may have gone past you when just reading. You will feel much closer to the text because you are taking such an active role.
autokwd: Jane Austen Simulator: Pride and Prejudice

title: Woke Quest
description:
게임 정보
Woke Quest is a satirical turn-based role-playing game that humorously critiques real-life events, personalities, and RPG conventions.
Four unsuspecting individuals from diverse backgrounds are drawn together by a mysterious force that transcends the boundaries of their reality. Suddenly, a surge of energy engulfs them, transporting them from their computer screens into a realm unlike anything they’ve ever imagined.
Emerging from a cosmic rift, they find themselves in a vibrant world brimming with magic, mythical creatures, and breathtaking landscapes straight out of an RPG. It quickly becomes clear that they are far from home.
Unbeknownst to them, their arrival marks the beginning of an epic saga that will shape the destiny of this enchanted realm and challenge their very understanding of reality.

title: Anime Scary Teacher 3D
description:
게임 정보
A day at school has never been this thrilling! Izumi Sensei, your ruthless teacher with a dark side, has been terrorizing the students for far too long. It’s time to teach her a lesson she’ll never forget—by pranking her at every turn!
Will you outsmart Izumi Sensei, or will her sharp instincts catch you in the act? Your mission: cause as much chaos as possible, and maybe even make her regret all those cruel punishments. After all, revenge is sweet!
Features:
Dive into a hilarious 3D anime world full of tricky pranks and surprises!
Outsmart and prank the terrifying Izumi Sensei, but beware—she's always watching!
Explore different parts of the school and unlock hidden areas for the perfect prank.
Customize your character with fun anime-style accessories.
Laugh, plot, and prank your way through this wild adventure as you teach Izumi Sensei that payback can be fun!

title: Blades of Crossed Hearts
description:
게임 정보
What is Blades of Crossed Hearts?
Blades of Crossed Hearts is an angsty anime character action fighting game taking inspiration from Marvel vs Capcom and the Devil May Cry series.

title: I am Reptile
description:
게임 정보
A 2D fast-paced platformer with action elements and cartoon-style graphics. As a Reptilian, you must traverse numerous levels, avoid traps, and battle enemies along the way. Your goal is to rescue your fellow tribesmen and defeat the evil corporation that seeks to enslave your home planet!
Story
On a distant planet at the edge of the galaxy, a friendly reptilian race lived in peace. Everything was perfect until suddenly, humans from Astra Chemical Corp arrived. The corporation began mining an acid-rich mineral used as an energy source for industrial production and interstellar travel. The Reptilians were enslaved and forced to work in the mines.

However, mining soon became difficult and expensive. The corporation then found another solution—extracting acid directly from the Reptilians, as their bodies consist of 95% acid.

title: HEMA. Humetal Era Morphose Arms
description:
게임 정보
a 2D hack n smash with Metroidvania features, mainly focusing on the Stylish Combo combat,
with simple combination of button press to perform difference Assault-Skill,
no complex command-input is needed, but still able to create your own style combo!
build the play style by the choosing the Sub-Gadget , passive Equipment and the level adjustable Assault-Skill.
Game Features
Suffering of too few Teleport point ?? no , we got stage selection
Metroidvania inspired, but with a bit twisted
With the features of metroidvania, instead of interconnected 1 huge map, it separated by 8  Island and each Island got more than 1 area for you to discover,
 Decrease the time for back-tracking in huge map running or the suffer of lack of Teleport point.
Separated some game content which not everyone enjoyed such as "death chasing" / "the precise jumping" to Challenge Mission, which is not blocking to the main mission.
Beating all the Enemy by your Morphose Arms!!
Once you are skilled , preform stylish Combo! Mixing basic Attack and Assault-Skill , do your crazy Combo !
Breaking Enemy`s Armor-Bar and do your Combos!!

title: Soul•Apocalypto
description:
게임 정보
《Soul Apocalypto》는 롤 플레이팅 게임이지만 동시에 팀 전략 선택에도 중점을 두고 있습니다. 여러 가지 다른 캐릭터를 소환해 자신만의 팀을 구성할 수 있으며 캐릭터 스킬을 조정하여 팀 특성을 구현할 수 있습니다. 어떤 동료를 선택할지, 각 동료의 스킬을 어떻게 배치할지가 모든 도전에 승리하는关键입니다.

title: City Garden Harvest
description:
게임 정보
The world changed after a challenging energy transition. You work remotely as a programmer on an important project. The stressful job doesn't help your anxiety, and your salary barely covers the rent. Everything changes the day a small packet of seeds is mistakenly delivered to you. 
Grow flowers, berries, and vegetables right in your home. Sell your harvest profitably to the Cooperative, buy cooking devices, and create dishes from your homegrown produce!
Renovate
Decorate your home with interior items however you like, and turn your apartment into a green utopia. You can relax and grow plants for comfort or dedicate your entire apartment to industrial-scale tomato farming.For designing your apartment, you will have dozens of various designer interior items at your disposal.
Farm
Take care of your plants—water, fertilize, transplant, and, of course, harvest them! The game features soil chemistry simulation, and all plants and fruits go through several distinct growth and ripening phases.
Cook
Learn recipes and prepare healthy, organic meals right at home! Sell them at the market for a hefty profit—such food is worth its weight in gold in the world of the future. At your disposal are a stove, oven, mortar, and food processor, allowing you to create over 50 dishes!
Plan
Use your time wisely—in City Garden Harvest, time flows faster when you're working with plants, and there’s never enough time for everything.
Chill
Learn to balance work and life—earn money by coding and unwind by caring for plants. Spend your earnings to expand your home farm!
Vibe
Enjoy the music—we’ve composed 11 beautiful tracks perfectly suited to various farming activities.

title: Chinese Strange Stories
description:
게임 정보
Enter a world where the lines between the living and the spirit world blur. Immerse yourself in a game that weaves together the mystical, the supernatural, and the struggles of everyday life during the turbulent final years of the Ming dynasty.

Features:

A Deep, Story-Rich World
Explore a vast and intricate narrative based on nearly 500 "marvel tales" from Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio, a collection of classical Chinese stories by the Qing dynasty writer Pu Songling. Encounter spirits and mythical creatures, and live the life of people during the closing days of the Ming dynasty. Witness their struggles, hear their tales, and decide how you will shape their destiny in a world filled with intrigue, war, and mysticism.

Traditional Turn-Based RPG Meets Card Battling
Enjoy a unique blend of classic turn-based RPG mechanics and dynamic card battling. The combination of randomness and strategy provides endless possibilities for combat and decision-making.

Distinctive Art Style
Step into a living Chinese painting and dive into a harmonious blend of history and artistry. Let the beauty of classic Chinese art captivate your senses like never before as you explore and discover.

Party & Deck Building
Assemble a party of characters, each with their own unique decks. Arrange your team strategically to build the perfect deck. Find unique cards through exploration, quests, and crafting. The more you play, the more options you’ll have to customize and strengthen your cards.

title: Laundromat Manager Simulator
description:
게임 정보
세탁소 관리자 시뮬레이터의 세계로 뛰어들어 보세요—여기서 당신의 기업가 정신과 창의력이 결합하여 겸손한 세탁소를 번창하는 비즈니스 제국으로 변화시킬 수 있습니다! 최첨단 장비 업그레이드부터 눈에 띄는 인테리어 디자인까지 모든 세부 사항을 관리하고, 충성 고객을 유치하며 경쟁자를 능가하세요. 전략가이든 창의적인 인테리어 디자이너이든, 이것은 당신이 최고의 동네 세탁소 허브를 만들 기회입니다. 성공은 바로 세탁 주기만큼 가까워요. 준비되셨나요?
매장 업그레이드
필수 업그레이드에 투자하여 더 많은 고객을 유치하고 수익을 극대화하세요. 공간을 확장하는 것부터 운영을 최적화하는 것까지, 모든 선택이 중요합니다.
기계 구매 및 운영
기본 모델에서 프리미엄 고효율 기계까지 다양한 세탁기와 건조기 중에서 선택하세요. 효율적으로 운영하여 고객 만족도와 원활한 운영을 보장하세요.
세탁 용품 보충
고객이 필요로 하는 세탁 세제, 섬유 유연제, 세탁 바구니 등 필수 용품을 제공하세요. 잘 갖춰진 매장은 고객이 다시 방문하도록 만듭니다!
가구 및 장식
세탁소를 세련된 가구, 편안한 좌석 공간, 시선을 끄는 장식으로 환영하는 공간으로 변신시키세요. 비즈니스를 돋보이게 하는 매력적인 환경을 만들기 위해 세부 사항 하나하나가 중요합니다.
레이아웃 사용자 정의
완벽한 레이아웃을 설계하여 창의적인 비전을 실현하세요. 세탁기, 좌석 및 장식을 배치하여 기능성과 미학의 균형을 맞추고, 고객이 방문할 때마다 즐거운 경험을 할 수 있도록 합니다.
실내 디자인
기본을 넘어 독특한 테마, 색상 조합, 눈에 띄는 장식을 활용하여 세탁소를 단순한 필수 공간이 아닌 고객이 사랑하는 지역 명소로 만드세요.
당신이 내리는 모든 결정으로 세탁소는 작은 스타트업에서 마을에서 가장 인기 있는 세탁소로 발전합니다. 도전을 받아들이고 궁극적인 세탁소 대부가 될 준비가 되셨나요?

title: The World Ends in Ohio
description:
게임 정보
An ominous presence hangs in the air across Ohio. Something is coming to Earth, and their sights are set on the Midwest.  You look up into the dark night sky of Cleveland and wonder... what else is out there?
Then, things begin to change...
At work, people begin to act strange, like they are no longer themselves.  Your friends act like they don't even know you and your neighbors look the other way as you walk down the street.  Soon, people begin to disappear, but no one seems to notice.  You wonder if you are going crazy?  Have you just been living in Cleveland for too long? 
You begin to investigate things on your own and find yourself embroiled in a conspiracy that will take you to the ends of Ohio!
Features:
Numerous weapons, skills and equipment to customize your character - play as a brawling fighter who solves problems with their fists, or a focused marksman that prefers to fight from a distance.
An interactive dialogue system that let's you converse with people as you please - you can become a noble champion who listens and solves people's problems, or you can be a huge jerk that everyone hates.
Explore real places around Cleveland, Ohio and meet all sorts of interesting Ohioans - delve deep into the Buckeye State for a story-rich RPG!
Fully playable on a Steam Deck!

title: Solace Inc. 2
description:
게임 정보
Solace Inc. is back and ready to kick some ass! Join the crew, grab some weapons, and travel across spacetime to fight some baddies... or fight each other?
Solace Inc. 2 is an expansion of the first game's universe in a brand new dimension, with new worlds and foes as well as familiar places and faces.
