Play as a wide variety of unique characters with an expansive arsenal of weapons, and fight against a variety of foes ranging from alien insects, to rogue robots, to screaming demons, and more!
Features:
10+ playable characters with unique special abilities and attributes
Dozens of unlockable and craftable weapons
Wide variety of worlds to explore and fight in
Charming dialogue from a vast cast of characters
Challenging foes and bosses who don't like you very much
...and more!
We're still hiring, submit your application to Solace Inc. today!

title: Color Factory: Automation Meets Canvas
description:
게임 정보
《물감 공방》은 전략적 설계와 자동화 운영이 절묘하게 어우러진 공장 건설 게임입니다. 순수한 원색을 추출하는 것에서 시작하여 정교한 색상 조합을 통해 새로운 색을 창조하고, 개성 넘치는 캔버스를 제작하며, 다양한 흥미로운 도전을 해결해 나갑니다.
흑, 백, 적, 녹, 청을 기본 색상으로 삼아, 이를 조화롭게 섞어 나만의 환상적인 색조를 만들어 보세요. 혼합한 색상을 체계적으로 저장하고, 이를 적재적소에 활용하여 다양한 목표를 달성하세요. 세밀한 계획과 창의력을 발휘하여 도전적인 과제를 하나씩 정복해 보세요!
autokwd: Color Factory: Automation Meets Canvas,물감 공방

title: EARTH:3000
description:
게임 정보
Earth: the year 3000…
EARTH:3000 is a survival RPG made with the Unreal 5 engine, set in a post-technological dark age.

Centuries have passed since the apocalypse. History is mostly forgotten, but relics of past eras remain. Swords and muskets exist alongside mutants and cyborgs.

Create a custom character and explore the mysteries and dangers of the wasteland! Will you search the ancient ruins for knowledge, or loot them for treasure? Fight other players and steal their items, or work together to build a new civilization? Rule over a city, or journey to distant lands - and maybe even find a way off of this doomed world?

Planned features (subject to change prior to release)
Survive in a future dark age wasteland
Fast-paced, full-loot PVP
Control towns and hire NPC guards
Loot ancient ruins for rare artifacts
Mix of mostly low-tech melee and ranged weapons
Play as a mutant, cyborg or techno-mage (very rare)
Defend against bandits... or become one
Fly across the deserts in a sandship or airship
Form caravans to trade resources
(or rob merchants and steal their goods!)
Fight for territory against rival factions
Journey to the toxic oceans and acid rainforests
Discover clues to the earth's lost secrets
Travel to SPACE
...and more!

title: This Be Mutiny
description:
게임 정보
This Be Mutiny is a turn-based strategy game about treasure, romance, and betrayal.

You and your crew of swashbuckling pirates are on an epic treasure hunt - until it devolves into mutiny. But if you can survive the backstabbings and betrayals, the treasure will be yours!!!

Treasure - Work through a series of heists to lead you to the long lost treasure.
Romance - Get to know your crew mates along your adventures.
Betrayal - But be ready: at the end of each heist, your pirates will inevitably betray you.

title: Polygun
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of Polygun, an endlessly customizable hero shooter where you battle against an ever increasing hoard of bloodthirsty shapes! With an array of upgrades to choose from, you'll quickly build from humble beginings into a hexa-bustin killing machine. The possibilities are endless! How long can you survive?
Choose your hero!  
Choose from among a variety of eye-catching heroes with unique weapons and ability focuses!  
Gain experience and unlock new upgrades!

title: Calvar - The Darkest Gate
description:
게임 정보
Calvar - The Darkest Gate is a harrowing first-person horror survival game that drags players into a nightmarish and twisted realm. As Leonard Valentin, you are thrust into a malevolent world haunted by otherworldly entities and obscured by the shadows of a cursed piano and a maleficent cult.
Key Features:
Immersive Interaction System: Every choice you make weaves your path through the darkness. Traverse the haunted landscapes, manipulate cursed objects, and unearth the horrific secrets lurking in the gloom. This innovative interaction system ensures your actions cast long shadows over your journey, adding layers of depth and terror.
Dynamic Inventory System: Scavenge for items that are more than mere survival tools; they are keys to unraveling the arcane mysteries. Each artifact harbors tales of sorrow and horror, with hidden functions that could spell the difference between damnation and your fleeting survival.
Combat and Survival: Arm yourself with an arsenal to battle grotesque abominations from the abyss. Survival hinges on ruthless decision-making and judicious use of scarce resources. Fleeing may often be the only option as not all horrors can be slain.
Dialogue and Quest System: Engage in dialogue that weaves through the fabric of the narrative, impacting the story's trajectory toward multiple ghastly endings. Delve into sinister quests tied deeply with the overarching nightmare, shaping the fate of the haunted world around you. Each choice reshapes your harrowing tale, ensuring no two descents into madness are alike.
Atmospheric World: Venture through environments that breathe unease and fear. Dark corridors, whispering voids, and visuals that chill to the bone craft an atmosphere thick with dread. The game’s world is meticulously crafted to immerse you in a relentless state of terror, navigating through oppressive darkness and surreal horrors.
Complete Narrative Experience: Embark on a full narrative journey that stretches from a chilling prologue to a horrifying conclusion. Each chapter of the game is meticulously woven to deliver a cohesive and terrifying story-driven experience that ensnares you from the ominous start to the grim finale.

title: Snake in the Dark
description:
게임 정보
스네이크 게임을 해보셨죠. 하지만 눈을 가리고 할 수 있을까요? Snake in the Dark는 스네이크와 소코반 같은 시대를 초월한 아케이드와 퍼즐 게임을 완전히 새롭게 재해석했습니다. 여러분이 알고 있는 재미있는 게임플레이에 예상보다 더 많은 퍼즐 요소가 추가되었습니다!
𓆙 먹고 빛나라!!
던전은 어둡고, 뱀은 몇 발자국 앞만 볼 수 있습니다. 마법의 빛 큐브를 먹으면 잠시 동안 레벨 전체를 볼 수 있습니다. 벽은 어디에 있을까요? 먹이는 어디에? 꼬리는 어디에? 빛을 비춰 찾아보세요!
𓆙 커져서 승리하라!!
각 레벨의 궁극적인 목표는 모든 압력판 스위치를 동시에 눌러 출구 문을 열고, 문이 열려있는 동안 도달하는 것입니다. 뱀이 너무 짧나요? 걱정 마세요! 더 많은 빛 큐브를 먹어서 커지면 모든 스위치에 한 번에 닿을 수 있습니다.
𓆙 돌을 밀고 퍼즐을 풀어라!!
보세요! 돌 구슬이 있네요! 이걸 밀어서 스위치의 추로 사용해 문을 열어보는 건 어떨까요? 그리고 이건 뭘까요? 바닥의 구멍이 길을 막고 있나요? 다른 돌 구슬로 구멍을 메워 그 위를 지나갈 수 있는 다리를 만드세요. 소코반 스타일로 문제를 해결하세요!

title: Keplerian Space Discovery
description:
게임 정보
Keplerian Space Discovery is a realistic spaceship trajectory simulator game.
Our solar system is built to scale and rendered with lifelike graphics.
Furthermore, the motion of each celestial body is precisely simulated using Kepler's laws.
Players can construct their own rocket by assembling various components.
Fly Me to the Moon
First, let's go to the moon, the moon.
That's one big step for us.
No rabbits.

title: GANGSTALK
description:
게임 정보
Do you ever feel like you're being watched?
GANGSTALK is a psychological horror game from the POV of your stalkers.
Cam, an urban explorer, is past their breaking point. They've been under relentless surveillance by the megacorp PANDO. Desperate for answers, they infiltrate a secret company town — one that doesn’t exist on any map.
Do you ever feel like you're being watched?
Take control of Cam as they explore the tangled streets of Kudzu Vale, piecing together the conspiracy. Watch them through the fragmented perspectives of CCTV Cameras, Devices, Agents, and the enigmatic Datamoshers.
Kudzu Vale — Explore the dreamlike town of Kudzu Vale and reveal its mysteries. Every clue you uncover will draw you deeper into the nightmare.
Datamoshers — Beware the distorted entities that stalk you. Escape or be consumed by their corruption.

title: Color Fear
description:
게임 정보
오늘 컬러 펀 색칠 쇼에서는 시청자들이 집에 침입한 사람을 찾는 데 도움을 주기를 바랍니다. 침입하는 새로운 침입자들은 각기 다른 능력을 가지고 있으며 여러분을 추적할 것입니다! 쇼에서 알고 싶은 것은 그들이 여러분에게 보여주는 색깔이 무엇인지입니다!
이유를 알아보세요 복숭아가 매일 밤 여러분에게 뒤틀린 게임을 하게 만드는 이유를 알아보세요. 컬러 펀 색칠 쇼의 미스터리 스릴러와 그것이 탄생하게 된 이유를 깊이 파헤쳐 보세요.
밤의 상점: 매일 밤이 끝날 때 밤의 상점을 이용하여 컬러 펀 색칠 쇼에 대항할 업그레이드 또는 능력을 구매하세요!
밤의 상점에서 구매할 수 있는 업그레이드:
침입자의 위치를 찾는 데 도움이 되는 장난감 로봇
가장 싫어하는 출연진을 제거하는 킬러
레이저 대포
손전등 및 이동 업그레이드
밤 건너뛰기 카드

title: Randomly Jerk Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Jiang Jun, who is 50 years old and has been unemployed for many years, is about to run out of his savings. He turns his attention to his parents, who were driven away by his outrageous behavior years ago. This game simulates the parasitic behavior of this jerk.
Features
Random Behaviors: Randomly engage in actions such as shopping, cleaning, cooking, asking for money, and more.
Choose Bonuses: Clean to earn coins? Get discounts on shopping? etc.
Based on Real Events: If there are similarities, please reflect on whether you have relatives who could make games.
Educational Meaning: This game has no educational meaning. Please do not learn from the protagonist in the game.
Be a Better Person: Huh? You became a master of relying on your parents? Come on!

title: John Fox
description:
게임 정보
John Fox is an elite warrior and super soldier who saved the leaders of various States. He was a professional mercenary who retired with honor.



But the evil big toad, decided to make an army of John Fox clones.
To lure the protagonist into the lab. The big toad's minions kill Milo, John's pet.
John Fox rushes in pursuit of the harmful toad and encounters an army of clone frogs, which flooded the entire city.

If the big toad manages to defeat John Fox, the world will be doomed to misery and chaos.



Features:

title: The Run: Got Next
description:
게임 정보
The Run: Got Next is a fast-paced, full court, 3v3 basketball game that celebrates all of street hoops culture worldwide. Play solo online or squad up to stack wins and become the G.O.A.T.

Get in the Game
This is not a simulation. The Run is easy to pick up and play, fast, fluid and above all else, fun. Signature dunks, monster blocks, sweet handles, tricks, logo 3s, alley oops and more – we’re bringing our own flavor to gameplay focused on style and substance, while remaining grounded in street hoops.

Bring Your Best Three & Hold Court
Build out your squad from an ever-evolving roster of diverse, larger-than-life, legendary street ballers, each with towering strengths and weaknesses that require you to really think about how you set your lineups.

Multiplayer Meets Roguelike
Staying on the court takes more than just a great jumper -- there's levels to this. With court conditions, strategic modifiers and drops impacting every game and new players coming in to stop your streak, every Run is unique.

A Handcrafted Hoops Experience
Play on some of the most legendary courts across the world with a uniquely stylized look and feel. From our characters to the courts, hand-keyed animations and everything in between, experience a truly handcrafted sports game for the first time ever.

Who’s Next?

title: Redemption
description:
게임 정보
Redemption은 2000년대의 액션 슈터 및 서바이벌 게임을 기반으로 한 일인칭 액션 호러 게임으로, Redemption은 더 느린 페이스의 슈터와 서바이벌 호러 요소를 혼합하려고 노력합니다.
탐험

죽음을 불러올 위험한 생물로 가득한 다층 시설을 탐험하면서 정확히 당신이 어디에 있고 왜 그곳에 있는지 알아보려고 노력하십시오.
생존

제한된 탄약과 자원이 탐험을 장려합니다

title: Alien Rush
description:
게임 정보
갑자기, 라임 외계인들이 나타나서 모든 곳에서 지구인들을 사로잡기 시작했습니다. 선수들이 뛰는 지구방위군 특수작전팀은 이 결정적인 순간에 임무를 맡깁니다. 그들은 라임 외계인의 점령지 깊숙이 침투하여 부상자를 구조하고, 정보를 수집하고, 저항의 전환점을 찾습니다. 로켓 점프와 파워 해머를 사용하여 라임 외계인이 설정한 다양한 함정을 돌파하십시오. 세상을 구하기 위해 아슬아슬하게 앞으로 나아가세요! 이 게임에는 흥미진진한 스토리 애니메이션과 스릴 넘치는 보스 전투도 포함되어 있습니다. 최고의 게임 경험을 달성하기 위해 게임은 여러 브랜드와 유형의 게임 패드
시간은 생명이다. 앞으로 나아가는 것을 멈추지 마세요!
["에이리언 대시"의 게임 기능]
로켓 백팩, 파워 해머, 구조 사다리 등 다양한 실용적이고 효율적인 도구를 통합합니다. 레벨을 통과하는 모든 장을 극복하기 위해 유연하게 전환하고 사용할 수 있습니다.
팀원들은 라임 외계인이 점령한 지역의 함정을 뚫어야 할 뿐만 아니라 제한된 시간 내에 본부에서 요구하는 여러 작업을 완료해야 합니다.
도시, 바다, 기지, 우주, 라임 행성을 포함한 다섯 가지 환경이 있습니다. 레벨은 독특하고 반복되지 않는 방대한 양의 콘텐츠로 설계되었습니다.
[용감한 팀원들이 앞으로 돌격]
이 게임은 1-4명의 사용자를 위해 동시에 로컬/온라인 플레이를 지원합니다. 친구 초대를 통해 온라인 체험에 참여할 수 있습니다.
[미션을 염두에 두고 실패하지 마십시오]

title: Rubedo: The Occult Dawn
description:
게임 정보
당신은 50년 이상 전에 모든 마법을 제거한 무자비한 마녀 사냥의 유일한 생존자입니다. 감옥에서 평생을 보낸 후, 왕실의 협정이 당신을 풀어주고 다가오는 침략에 대비해 왕국의 최후의 수단으로 한때 봉인된 혼돈을 해방시키는 임무를 맡깁니다. 신비한 잠재력을 다시 연결하면서 중요한 선택에 직면하게 됩니다. 고대 영혼, 몬스터, 저주를 통해 혼돈을 일으킬 것인가, 아니면 왕국에 더 부드러운 접근이 필요할 것인가?

문자 시전 기술을 마스터하세요
혁신적인 턴제 전투는 9개의 연금술 기호를 30개의 강력한 상징으로 결합하여 사람이나 더 끔찍한 무언가를 신속하게 무찌를 수 있게 합니다. 모든 기호를 잠금 해제하고 그들의 창의적인 조합을 통해 새로운 전략을 개발하세요.
마법은 결코 완전히 사라지지 않습니다. 올바른 의식은 자비롭거나 혼란스러운 힘을 확실히 되돌려줄 것입니다. 잠자는 기념비를 살아있는 마법의 장소로 바꾸세요.
[/img] [h2]그리고 더 많은...[/h2] [list] [*][b]풍부한 오픈 월드[/b] - [i]규모보다 내용. 루베도의 세계에서는 모든 공간이 목적을 가지고 있습니다.[/i] [*][b]가입 가능한 파벌[/b] - [i]3개의 파벌 중 하나에 가입하여 파벌 특유의 갑옷, 퀘스트 및 스토리 라인을 잠금 해제하세요.[/i] [*][b]선택이 중요한 이야기[/b] - [i]당신은 복수 임무에 있는가, 아니면 왕국을 새로운 마법의 황금 시대로 이끌 것인가?[/i] [*][b]선택 기반 캐릭터 진행[/b] - [i]당신의 속성은 사용자 인터페이스 클릭을 통해 성장하지 않습니다. 대신, 대화 및 퀘스트 선택이 당신의 본성: 혼돈, 자비 또는 진실을 결정합니다.[/i] [*][b]연금술[/b] - [i]연금술은 단순히 물약을 만드는 것이 아닙니다. 그것은 세계와 자신을 변형시키는 것입�
커스터마이즈 가능한 지하 필사실에서 마법의 질서를 재건하고, 과거의 신비로운 영광을 되찾으십시오. 새로운 추종자들을 찾아 전환시키고, 다시 한번 당신의 전당에 찬송이 울려 퍼지게 하십시오.

title: Spellslayer
description:
게임 정보
In Spellslayers, you control a powerful sorcerer trying to find the lost eyes of the spellslayer, the most powerful sorcerer in history. Travel to different locations and take out anyone who tries to stop you in this puzzle tactics roguelite adventure!


Each turn, you can move your character and spend energy on spells. You can have up to 4 spells equipped at a time, and each spell has its own hit pattern on the board. Once you cast your first spell you can no longer move that turn, so try to maneuvre to utilise your spells to the fullest!


All the foes you face are sorcerers as well! Each of them has their own distinct spell they cast, telegraphing where they will attack. Outmaneveure their spells and strike back with your own.


Void tiles will appear in each battle, which increases the damage you do and amplify each spell in their own way, but increase the damage you take, so weigh up the odds before stepping onto them for the turn. Be careful though, as enemies can also use these to cast their spell instantly, leading you to take damage you weren't prepared for.


Journey to the location of each eye, and fight off hordes of spellcasters. Choose which path to take next, as you discover new spells, empower old ones, enhance your body, return to your quarters to rest, visit the souls market, and eventually come face to face with other High end sorcerers, competing against you to become the Spellslayer themselves.

title: Stream or Die!
description:
게임 정보
CONQUER THE CREATORS
You're Cage, an underdog streamer, teetering on the brink of obscurity. Seize a mysterious invitation to stream WISH, an unexplored MMO, and buckle up for the ride of your life.



Tactical auto-battler RPG plus Streamer simulator all in one!
You've never experienced a story like this
Recruit adventurers with the LFG Party System
Unlock powerful combat abilities by creating Formations
Watch in horror as your in-game choices bleed into the real world!
25+ endings
Fully voiced





Inspired by the Persona series and with an innovative RPG auto-battle system, every choice you make shapes your path. Will you be a family-friendly entertainer or a controversial edgelord? Each decision impacts your journey and your audience. Balance is key; keep your energy high, stress low, and sanity in check to dazzle your audience stream after stream.




As Cage, dive into and lead massive raids through a rich, expansive world brimming with quests, mystical artifacts, and treacherous dungeons. Watch your subscriber count soar as you become a streaming legend.




Uncover the enigmatic lore of the Monumentals, gargantuan beings consuming cities, and the Whisperers, mysterious figures holding the balance. Your streaming journey intertwines with these mysteries, leading to unexpected revelations.




Who Influences the Influencers? As you skyrocket to fame and fortune, a lingering question haunts every stream – who really controls the world of , and what's their game?

title: Lea
description:
게임 정보

In this game, you'll take on the role of Lea, an ace pilot who has gone rogue. You'll not only have to deal with the threats of war but also confront inner struggles. Embark on a journey through a series of islands filled with battles and discoveries. In a time of chaos, stand firm with those who have their own beliefs and stories, uncover the conspiracies behind the war, unravel the secrets of the Philosopher's Stone, and bring peace to as many people as possible.
Are you ready to become the hero who will stop the war and bring new hope to these islands?
Game Features

Exciting Aerial Combat
Engage in thrilling side-scrolling shootouts, battling war machines powered by steam technology and unveiling the conspiracies of madmen.



The game boasts breathtaking visual effects, with every environment brimming with details and surprises.




Immerse yourself in an emotionally charged island continent, follow the characters' destinies, and unlock multi-layered storylines.


Relationships and growth among the characters are integral to the game, and your decisions will influence their relationship outcomes.


Explore diverse island environments and unlock hidden story elements and missions.


The game's music and sound effects create a profound atmosphere, enhancing the emotional impact of the story.

title: Cosmorons
description:
게임 정보
COSMORONS
Greetings, cosmic conquerors! We present to you COSMORONS, an old-school futuristic shooter about comedic robot drudges conquering the cosmos with outlandish weapons & hijinks galore.  To achieve ultimate glory, grapple, shoot, and drill your way to galactic domination. New areas bring big rewards, but drastically increase in difficulty.
SINGLE PLAYER / ONLINE CO-OP GAMEPLAY
Take on the universe as a conquest of one or play co-op with your fellow Drudges! Cosmorons offers both single player and co-op gameplay. As a single player, combat alien factions, complete thrilling challenges and collect planetary cores on your own. In co-op play, it's you and a team of fellow Drudges versus the universe! Online co-op means you and your friends can play from the comforts of your own home.

title: The Lab Thing
description:
게임 정보
WARNING: This video game may trigger seizures for some audience with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.



The Lab Thing is a first-person survival horror game.

Explore a mysterious secret lab as the only body survived. Gather all the scientist's notes about the monster, upgrade backpack items, record information and try to escape before you join the body collection of the lab thing!

the game is set in a secret underground lab that is haunted by a monster that likes to collect human bodies. You will explore an atmospheric underground abandoned lab, wander through tight corridors, check out every dead room, and get lost in the endless presence of afterlife.

This lab is cursed with its past. The secret project that turned against its creators. The symbol of human failure walks right behind you and not only protects his murderous victory but listens to potentials for future. As a player, you will relive parts of this dark past, find the memory of its nature and explore the need to survive.

in this game you are a normal defenseless human being; no weapons could save you from the monster finding you from the next corner, behind the door, hidden in the closet or inside a body bag. You’ll be able to pick up key elements, interact with the environment, and search for door keys that may help you escape this nightmare reservoir of human failure.

title: The Golden Light Guardian
description:
게임 정보
Sure, here's the translation to Korean:
광활한 오픈 월드 맵을 탐험하세요!!!
다양한 생물 군계를 발견하고, 독특한 자원, 숨겨진 비밀, 위험한 적들을 찾아보세요. 모든 코너에는 새로운 모험이 기다리고 있습니다!

생존하세요!
재료를 모으고, 음식을 사냥하며, 건강과 스태미나를 관리하여 적대적인 환경에서 살아남으세요.

섬을 탐험하고 생존을 위해 사냥하세요. 당신의 기술을 사용하여 몬스터를 추적하고 처치하며, 자원을 모으고 도구를 제작하고 음식을 요리하여 생존하세요.

섬을 돌아다니는 몬스터들을 조심하세요.

끊임없이 몰려오는 해골 공격자들을 견디기 위해 방어를 전략적으로 구축하고 강화하세요.

title: Strange Block 36
description:
게임 정보
"이상한 블록 36"은 배틀 로얄 장르의 멀티플레이어 온라인 게임입니다. 플레이어는 떨어지는 블록을 제거하고 적에게 공격을 시작해야 합니다. 36명이 같은 화면에서 경쟁하며 우승을 놓고 경쟁한다!
게임 특징:
• 대규모 동일 화면 전투: 동일 화면에서 36명이 함께 대규모 온라인 전투를 경험하며, 각 플레이어의 전략과 행동이 명확하게 표시됩니다.
• 공정한 결투: 우리는 힘만이 승리와 패배를 결정하는 유일한 기준이 되도록 공정한 경쟁 플랫폼을 제공합니다.
• 모험 모드: 수백 개의 레벨이 하나씩 잠금을 해제하고 정복하기를 기다리고 있습니다.
• 맞춤형 키보드: 플레이어는 자신의 조작 습관에 따라 키의 위치와 크기를 자유롭게 조정할 수 있습니다.
• 비디오 재생 기능: 언제든지 검토 및 분석을 위해 최근 100개의 게임 비디오를 자동으로 저장하여 게임 기술을 향상시킵니다.

title: The House In The Hollow
description:
게임 정보
"The House In The Hollow"는 공포와 신비, 마법이 어우러져 진정한 몰입감과 스릴을 선사하는 1인칭 어드벤처 게임입니다.

플레이어는 Aloysius Abadier가 되어 100년 전 사라진 악명 자자한 오컬티스트 Francis Barrett의 미스터리를 풀어야 합니다.

외딴곳에 떨어진 잊혀진 숲으로 모험을 떠나면 신비로운 의식과 고대의 유물, 강력한 마법이 가득한 어둡고 뒤틀린 세계를 발견할 수 있습니다. 버려진 저택을 탐험하면서 숨겨진 비밀과 고대 유물, 강력한 주문을 찾아보세요. 하지만 조심하세요. 어떤 일이 있어도 비밀이 드러나고 여러분이 탈출하는 걸 막으려 하는 어둠의 힘이 기다립니다.

오컬트 지식과 결단력을 발휘하여 미스터리를 풀고 골짜기를 탈출해야 하는 이 게임은 1인칭 탐험과 퍼즐, 발견 요소가 독특하게 어우러진 것이 특징입니다.

이야기 -

프랜시스 바렛은 영국의 마술사이자 오컬티스트로, 구석진한 생활을 살며 외딴 저택에서 대부분의 시간을 보냈습니다.

산중턱에 자리한 숲으로 둘러싸인 이 집은 세상에 알려지지 않은 숨겨진 곳이었습니다.

프랜시스 바렛에 대해 알려진 것은 오컬트와 마법 정보의 천체 지능체와 총합인 The Magus를 저술한 것 이외에는 거의 없습니다.

프랜시스 바렛이 사라진 이후 많은 해가 지나도록, 사람들은 바렛씨의 신비한 집을 찾으려 하지만 성공하지 못했습니다.

프랜시스 바렛이 집에서 수행한 실험, 또는 무엇을 호출했는지에 대해서는 아무도 확신할 수 없습니다.

집을 찾으러 간 사람들 중에는 돌아오지 않은 사람들도 있습니다.


잊을 수 없는 모험을 시작하세요. 현실적인 환경의 세계에 1인칭 시점으로 몰입하여 전에 경험해보지 않은 방식으로 골짜기를 탐험하세요.

하지만 명심하세요. 진행이 쉽지는 않을 겁니다. 골짜기를 둘러싼 깊은 미스터리를 밝히려면 문제를 해결하고 탐험에 참여해야 하거든요.



실감 나는 게임 세계를 창조하려고 의상과 인테리어 피팅 및 비품에 물리학을 적용했기 때문에 플레이어가 정말 환경의 일부가 된 것처럼 느낄 수 있을 것입니다.

플레이어가 게임 속 세계를 돌아다니는 동안 환경 및 애셋 입자 효과는 사실성을 높여 모든 나뭇잎과 가지를 자연스럽고 진짜처럼 보이게 하는 전체 바람 애니메이션 등의 디테일 하나하나를 정확하고 실감 나게 표현합니다.



몰입도를 더 높이기 위해 물리학을 바탕으로 렌더링된 물질로 멀티 텍스처링을 사용하여 현실적으로 보이고 느껴지는 세상을 만들었습니다.

또한 라이트 섀프트, 템포럴 안티앨리어싱, 톤 매핑 등 게임의 고급 시각 요소는 매끄러운 시네마틱 경험을 제공합니다.



The House In The Hollow는 독특한 장소와 아르데코 디자인, 고급 색상 보정, 앰비언트 오클루전, 실시간 레이 트레이싱 기능을 한데 묶어 풍부하고 몰입감 있는 경험을 선사합니다.

title: COCOA
description:
게임 정보
COCOA는 대조적인 세계를 독특하고 감동적으로 탐험합니다.
이 게임에서는 아프리카 코트디부아르 남부에서 Issa와 Asante로서 아동 노동의 가혹한 현실을 경험하게 됩니다. 수확, 분쇄, 청소, 건조 등 카카오콩 처리의 힘든 일정을 포인트 앤 클릭 미니게임을 통해 진행하고, 경비원의 눈을 피해 은밀하게 탈출 기회를 찾는 과제를 수행합니다.

반대로, 탐욕스러운 사업가 Mr. Theodore와 그의 매니저 Tom의 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 럭셔리 초콜릿 공장을 관리하고, 운영을 확장하며, 기계를 업그레이드하는 경영 타이쿤 경험을 제공합니다.

이 어두운 RPG는 이러한 대조적인 경험들을 엮어 강렬하고 불안감을 주는 결말로 이끌며, 탐욕과 인간 가치라는 주제를 강조합니다.
특징
90년대 애니메이션 스타일로 손으로 그린 많은 컷씬들
플레이하는 매 순간 긴장감을 유지하는 강렬하고 생생한 스토리

아동 노동자:
많은 비밀 지역이 있는 어두운 미로 같은 정글을 탐험
경비원들이 지도를 스캔하여 당신을 추적하는 것을 피하기 위해 달아나거나 덤불에 숨기
포인트 앤 클릭 미니게임에서 매일 카카오 처리 작업을 완료. 늦지 않도록 하고 오늘의 목표를 달성하세요!
일터 캠프에서 탈출할 수 있도록 도와줄 다양한 NPC와 대화

초콜릿 공장:
가장 효율적인 시스템을 만들기 위해 컨베이어 벨트와 기계를 배치
공장을 업그레이드: 작업자를 기계로 대체하고, 효율성을 개선하며, 공장 공간을 확장

이 게임은 심각한 주제를 다루고 있지만, 궁극적인 목표는 상업 산업에서 아동 노동 착취에 대한 인식과 공감을 증진하는 것입니다. 우리는 이 게임에서 제시된 주제를 촉진하거나 경시할 의도가 없습니다.

title: Electric Alps
description:
게임 정보
Electric Alps is a 2D puzzle game based on real-world electrical engineering. Explore how electricity works. Plan your circuitry, install devices and solve logic-based wiring problems.

You take on the role of an electrician, returning to the remote village of St. Ampere, nestled in the breathtaking Austrian Alps. Tasked with wiring up homes and structures, you’ll master the principles of electrical engineering. Install cables, switches, and other electrical devices, strategically wiring them up to create functional circuits. Each building is a puzzle, requiring your skills to power it up. Your journey will ultimately transform the village, awakening it from its unpowered slumber. One circuit at a time.
⚡ Based on Real-World Electricity
Explore the fundamentals of electrical engineering, delving into real-world electricity. Understand the principles of current flow and master the art of wiring in this hands-on and educational experience.
🧠 Solve Puzzle-Based Circuitries
Engage wiring challenges that combine logic, strategic planning and your new-found electrical knowledge to solve a variety of puzzles in the world of electrical installations.
🛠️ Utilize a Vast Toolbox
Explore a vast array of devices and appliances as you advance through St. Ampere. From installing sockets to crafting intricate power consumption systems, you master various electrical activities, adding switches, relays, motion detectors, fuses, RCDs and other tools to your toolbox.
🏡 Electrify Your Village
As you advance, St. Ampere around you evolves. Overcoming challenges not only opens up new areas, introduces fresh devices but also revitalizes the village. Homes become inhabited, structures turn usable, and green, sustainable energy production takes center stage, transforming St. Ampere into a vibrant, electrified haven.
⛰️ Enjoy the Alpine Charm
Enjoy Austrian culture and the breathtaking Alps. The picturesque alpine landscapes aren't merely a background, but an integral part of your exploration, adding our Austrian charm to your journey through St. Ampere.

title: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey
description:
게임 정보
isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey
(원래 제목: isekizima-To-Tabisuru-Nekomata)
isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey는 2D 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다.
두 개의 꼬리(Nekomata)를 가진 고양이 귀 모험가 키지노로 플레이하고, 이세키지마(관광 안내책자에 쓰여진 대로 꿈과 로맨스의 유적지)로 여행을 떠나세요.
민족 악기와 성가의 박자에 맞춰 숲에 묻힌 유적지를 탐험하세요.
게임 특징
횡스크롤 플랫폼 액션 - 숲에 묻힌 광대한 폐허를 질주, 회피, 트리플 점프로 돌파하세요.
몬스터와의 싸움 - 간단한 입력으로 다양한 공격 스킬을 사용할 수 있습니다. 다양한 스킬을 사용하는 데는 전략적 감각이 있고, 한 번에 여러 적을 날려버리는 짜릿함도 있습니다.
캐릭터 개발 - 배울 수 있는 스킬이 10개 이상 있습니다. 최대 HP와 스태미너 외에도 많은 스킬을 업그레이드할 수 있습니다.









저는 다양한 게임의 "Stage1"을 좋아합니다.
대부분은 제가 영원히 거기에 머물고 싶어지는 평화로운 초원이나 숲입니다.
저는 "Stage1"의 분위기가 계속되는 세계를 만들고 싶어서 이 게임을 만들었습니다.

스테이지가 진행되어도 분위기와 난이도는 크게 바뀌지 않습니다.
(하지만 게임의 특성상 초원은 항상 계속되지는 않습니다.)
개발자는 일본어만 할 수 있습니다. 그러나
영어와 간체 중국어 현지화를 돕는 사람이 있습니다.
언어 파일은 게임과 함께 배포되며, 이러한 간단한 텍스트 파일도 플레이어가 자유롭게 편집하고 추가하여 기존 언어를 개선하거나 새로운 언어에 대한 지원을 추가할 수 있습니다.
자원봉사자가 현지화를 도울 수 있다면 기쁠 것입니다!
이 게임은 생성 AI를 사용하지 않습니다.
이 게임은 AI가 생성한 이미지, 사운드 또는 기타 자료를 사용하지 않습니다.
지침을 따르는 한 스트리밍에 제한이 없습니다.
이 게임이 즐거운 시간을 보내는 데 도움이 되기를 바랍니다.














여기까지 읽어주셔서 감사합니다!

title: Arcticide
description:
게임 정보


Procedural levels with diverse biomes, weather, and a day/night cycle.
Survive ruthless mercs, inhuman horrors, and deadly hazards.
Random events including snipers, assassins, bombardments, and supply drops.
Wield a variety of weapons, attachments, devices, and consumables.
A tight resource economy - loot, repair, craft, and pick your battles.
Manage hunger, stamina, and other immersive survival systems.
Horizontally-focused meta-progression.

WATCH YOUR STEP
Navigate and survive dangerous procedural regions in this gritty FPS. Set in a near-future Arctic ravaged by a devastating calamity. Arcticide is a challenging permadeath experience full of unpredictable environments and situations. Resources are scarce, so pick your battles, scavenge carefully, and watch your step. Weapons and equipment have limited durability, so be sure to repair them, replace them, or face the consequences.

Random threats and opportunities abound in every run. Elite soldiers, snipers, aerial barrages, and toxic areas could mean certain death if mishandled. On the other hand, supply caches, printing stations, and helpful locals could tip the scales in your favor.


Finding databanks and surviving deep into runs will provide valuable intel to help you progress. The horizontal meta-progression system allows for unlocking new starting loadouts, potential loot, and crafting recipes. These provide fresh tactical options and tools to play with rather than make the game explicitly easier - to improve your chances of survival, there is no substitute for learning and refining your tactics.

Completed runs also give deeper insight into the events that led to the calamity, and provide clues as to where to search next. Each destination offers unique events, biomes, and enemies.

title: A Song Of Sunlight
description:
게임 정보


Arem has lived his life surrounded by ocean waves and fields of dying grass. Upon his small island lies the Settlement, a community of just three thousand- the Children of the Sun. Passing the long years in prayer and simple work, the blessed people of the island use their traditions to survive. Arem, like all young men and women of the Settlement, knows his duty to society: to perform his obligation for the greater good, and never to enter The Well- a passage leading deep into the unknown earth below.

Raised as a Woundbearer, Arem desires to come of age and play his crucial part in improving the lives of his community- none more so than Sachita, the burning girl, shunned by the Settlement but whom he loves dearly.

Yet, when Arem is suddenly given the responsibilities he always dreamed of, he finds his certainty shattered by the truth of the horror held at the Settlement’s close reach. Realizing that he has a much more important duty to fulfill, Arem becomes engrossed in a mystery he can never speak of.

Descending into the Well and desperately searching for an exit, Arem will discover the breaking point of his relationships.



A Song of Sunlight features a novel pseudo-turn-based combat system that challenges players to fight for their lives against horrifying enemies. Make split-second calculated decisions, then attack, block, evade, and look for openings in real-time against multiple targets in thrilling combat encounters.

By day, carry out your duties to the Settlement and interact with its inhabitants to obtain resources and learn more about the world.

By night, explore desolate megastructures filled with mystery and danger, discover weapons and equipment lost to humanity, and customize your build to suit many distinct play styles.

title: Shadows Of Deceit
description:
게임 정보
Explore the spectral city of Havenbrook, now shrouded in darkness and mystery.
Every step you take reveals fragments of a larger story, a tale of tragedy, loss, and dark forces lurking in the shadows.
But beware, you are not alone. Something or someone knows your every move and seeks to obstruct your path to the truth. Will you survive long enough to unravel the mystery and free yourself from this endless trap?
This is an experience that will leave you breathless, a harrowing descent into the darkest recesses of the human psyche. Confront the unknown and discover if you have the strength to overcome the trials that await you.

title: Get Bento!
description:
게임 정보
Get Bento! is a bento box-building puzzle game.

Design sushi and add them to your bento box for today's lunch. Sort and arrange your tasty treats neatly, ensuring they all fit into your lunch box.

Get Bento! follows a young girl during her holiday break as she packs delicious snacks into her bento box to take to her summer job.
FEATURES

Lunch Box
80 cutesy hand drawn sushi and other bento box tasties for you to collect and arrange in your lunch box.
Levels
The games has 100 levels designd to stimulate your puzzling needs.
Arcade Modes
If you can't get enough of organising sushi into your bento box you'll love the extra modes crafted to keep the fun going indefinitely.
Steam Deck
The game is the perfect relaxation game built for the steam deck and controller but works beautifully with a mouse too.

title: Onychomp : Lush journey
description:
게임 정보
산을 오르면서 던전을 탐험하세요.
마법의 산을 오르는 동안 프로시저럴 던전을 통해 위험한 여정을 떠나세요. 밤이 끝나기 전에 정상까지 가는 길을 찾으세요.
생물을 물어 먹고 노랑퍼지세요
만나는 모든 생물을 삼키기 위해 탐욕스러운 식욕을 터뜨리세요.
더 높이 올라갈 수 있는 물건을 만드세요

title: Dice Builder
description:
게임 정보
Dice Builder
Roll the Dice, Build Your Destiny!
Embark on a captivating journey in Dice Builder, a unique city-building game where every decision starts with the roll of a dice. In this innovative blend of strategy and chance, you will manage and expand your city by carefully assigning dice rolls to gather essential resources, upgrade buildings, and unlock new areas of your empire.
---
Key Features:
Dynamic Dice Gameplay:
Each day begins with a dice roll, providing you with opportunities to allocate your resources strategically. Will you invest in upgrading your infrastructure or prioritize resource collection? The power is in your hands, but the dice determine your fate.
Resource Management:
Master the art of resource management by balancing water, food, gold, stone, wood, and population. Each resource plays a crucial role in the growth and sustainability of your city:
Water: Essential for building houses and powering various utilities.
Food: Harvested from farms, fisheries, and hunting lodges, sustaining your growing population.
Gold: Earned through taxation and selling armory, used for purchasing additional dice and upgrading structures.
Wood and Stone: Gathered from lumbermills and mining camps, used for constructing and upgrading buildings.
Specialized Buildings:
Construct and upgrade a variety of buildings to optimize resource collection:
Farms: Thrive on fertile green ground, maximizing food production.
Lumbermills and mining camps: Strategically placed in forests and stony grounds for optimal resource output.
Water Pumps and Fisheries: Located on static or moving water for enhanced water and food production.
Ground Quality Mechanics:
Choose your building locations wisely based on ground types:

title: Cyber Farmer
description:
게임 정보
농사가 훨씬 더 이상해졌습니다!
사이버 돼지, 돌연변이 작물, 그리고 많은 웃음 — 전통과 미래가 만나는 엉뚱하고 종말 이후의 농장 시뮬레이터인 🤖사이버 파머🤖에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 가족 농장을 물려받을 차기 상속자인 카지미에르즈의 손자의 부츠를 신어보세요. 전쟁으로 황폐해진 세상을 배경으로, 사이버 파머는 소박한 마을의 매력과 기이한 사이버 기술을 혼합하여 유머를 최대한으로 끌어올립니다.
사이버 기술🤖, 유전자 변형 작물🌾, 사이버 돼지🐷가 일상 생활의 일부인 종말 이후의 농장☢️에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 웃음, 기이한 놀라움, 기발한 농장의 재미로 가득한 게임을 준비하세요. 나만의 사이버 농장을 건설하세요!
주요 기능:
🤖 첨단 사이버 가젯을 사용하여 농장을 개선하세요: 미래형 가젯의 힘을 활용하여 농장을 다음 단계로 끌어올리세요. 로봇 도구에서 사이버네틱 업그레이드에 이르기까지 기술은 농장 혁명의 핵심입니다.
😂 이상하고 재밌는 순간이 있는 유쾌한 게임플레이: 터무니없는 순간, 예상치 못한 이벤트, 기발한 캐릭터가 가득한 Cyber Farmer는 유머와 재미로 가득합니다. 영어: 이 기이한 농장 생활을 헤쳐나가면서 웃음이 가득할 것으로 기대하세요.

title: Carrotour
description:
게임 정보
"Well, have I been turned into a horse???"
Yes, you have, Leappa. Get used to it, grab carrots, and be ready to turn into more animals that move differently!
Unfamiliar Leaper Movements
In this game, you don't just move up, down, left and right! Instead, you move as "leapers". They move in a specific angle about an axis, a fixed distance each time, and cannot be blocked. Think about the knight in chess, which is a classic leaper! Getting use to the move patterns is the key to victory.
Fun Traps and Items
On the map of each level, all kinds of traps and items are waiting for you. We got spikes, portals, crates, springs and many more! They interact with each other in unique ways. Understand and use them to your advantage!
Intense Boss Fights
Want some different experience? Behold, boss fights! In boss levels, you don't have to carefully come up with a solution to a puzzle. What you have to do is dodge the boss's rapid attacks, and grab carrots to strike back!

title: Merp in Merpworld
description:
게임 정보
an adventure platformer that will change the universe.



explore fields of warm grass and wildflowers. glide through the sky with your leaf. elude predating fauna, or make mischief instead.

title: Conjured Through Death
description:
게임 정보
"Conjured Through Death"는 금지된 마법 실험의 무모한 결과로 재앙에 빠진 마법사의 비극적인 이야기를 전하는 어두운 매력적인 Roguelike 게임입니다. 한때 강력한 마법사였던 당신은 이제 살아있는 시체가 되어, 죽은 자들의 몸에 반복적으로 환생하는 운명에 처해 있습니다. 당신의 은신처는 성의 지하 깊은 곳에 위치하며, 당신의 어두운 마법이 세상에 빠져나가는 것을 막기 위해 결연히 당신을 가두려는 옛 동료들과 성의 경비병들이 둘러싸고 있습니다.
여정은 성의 가장 어두운 구석에서 시작됩니다. 한 걸음 한 걸음, 당신은 자유를 향해 싸우며 점점 더 강력한 적들과 마주하게 됩니다 — 숙련된 전사들, 교활한 마법사들, 그리고 당신을 막기 위해 목숨을 바칠 준비가 된 무자비한 경비병들. 그 길에서, 당신은 고대의 제단들을 발견하게 되며, 이 제단들은 강력한 힘의 원천이 됩니다. 이 제단을 통해 무기를 강화하고, 강력한 마법을 배우고, 속성치를 향상시키는 등, 다가올 도전에 맞춰 능력을 개발할 수 있는 다양한 길을 제공합니다.
게임에는 다섯 가지 강력한 무기와 네 가지 마법서가 존재하며, 각 마법서는 고유한 원소의 힘을 대표합니다. 이들은 처치한 적들의 영혼을 사용하여 잠금 해제할 수 있으며, 전략적인 깊이를 더하고 당신만의 독특한 게임 스타일을 만들 수 있는 더 많은 방법을 제공합니다.
각 플레이는 당신의 기술, 전략 및 결단력을 시험하며, 독특하고 잔인한 보스와의 치열한 전투는 모든 무기와 마법의 마스터리를 요구합니다. 성을 탈출하려 싸우는 동안, 더 깊은 질문이 떠오릅니다: 당신은 자신이 일으킨 혼돈에 대한 구속을 찾고자 하는 영웅인가, 아니면 자신의 어두운 힘을 성벽 너머로 확장하려는 악당인가? 답은 당신의 승리와 그 과정에서 빼앗은 생명들의 메아리 속에 숨어 있습니다.

title: Smokin Potions
description:
게임 정보
Chaos reigns as up to 4 friends battle in a magical, explosive local-multiplayer showdown. Create your wizard, choose your magical affinity, mix elements, and craft explosive potion bombs to dominate the arena. Even in defeat, haunt and sabotage rivals as a ghost, seizing a second chance at glory.
Take advantage of unique stages, power-ups, and sudden-death hazards that change the flow of battle, keeping each match dynamic and full of surprises.
Customize your wizard with a wide variety of robes, hairstyles, and hats, and unlock new cosmetic items to stand out in every battle.
Explosive Competition
Compete with up to 4 friends in chaotic local-multiplayer battles, using potions as devastating bombs to create explosive mayhem.

title: Roodies Factory - Chapter 1
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Roodies Factory!

This is the first game in the "Roodies Factory" saga.

Roodies Factory is a first-person horror mascot exploration game. In the game you are the ex-founder of "Roodies Factory" who returns to the factory years after it was abandoned in search of his missing brother...

Explore the abandoned factory, solve puzzles and find out what really happened 3 years ago when the factory was abandoned.

Roodie

Roodie is a tall animatronic clown who can think for himself. He is the main animatronic of Roodies Factory, he is also the most loved animatronic by children.

Characteristics

-Photorealistic Enviroment
-Horror Atmosphere
-Receive calls from NPCs
-Solve puzzles
-Explore the abandoned factory

title: Footsy
description:
게임 정보
Footsy는 할머니 댁에서 펼쳐지는 혼란스러운 멀티플레이 축구 파티 게임입니다! 가구를 부수고, 병을 깨고, TV를 뒤집으며 골을 넣는 치열한 경기를 즐기세요. 파티에 완벽한 선택입니다!
할머니 댁에서 1:1로 펼쳐지는 미친 축구 경기에서 친구들보다 더 많은 골을 넣어보세요!
한 소파에서 플레이하거나 Remote Play로 온라인에서 연결해보세요. 우정이 시험대에 오를 겁니다!
테이블을 부수고, 꽃병을 깨뜨리며, TV를 뒤집으세요. 물리 기반의 혼란스러운 액션 덕분에, 모든 샷이 경기의 흐름과 집안의 상태를 바꿀 수 있습니다!

title: speak of my sin
description:
게임 정보
Discord:
With the help of the inspector, you are expected to unravel the mysteries and cases of both recent and old years, and then recall and speak out your sins as you get closer to the truth of the story.
In this game, you have three goals:
The fundamental and most important thing is to extract key information to find the truth of the case through the text description searched by the police department.
Each piece of information can be a key clue to the real killer, including the layout of the room at the scene of the crime, the footage from surveillance cameras, the chat logs of the suspect and so on.
The core task [/u] is to connect the facts of multiple cases and restore the whole story. In this game, figuring out the story behind the case is more important than finding out the real killer.
If you encounter difficulties in a certain chapter and can’t find out the truth, please be patient and move on to the next chapter, the answer may be concealed in it.

title: Carpocalypse RC Racing
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to the BURN league, newbie! The world may have ended, but the fun is just about to begin. Because as they say, "it doesn't matter how bad the situation is... Humans still want to have some fun!". And we will have a lot of it! So what are you waiting for?

Game Modes:
Arcade: choose a car, choose a race track and show them what you can do!
Championship: seven championships are waiting for you. Finish every race in every environment and take part in few more, way longer and challenging championships.
Time Trial: how fast can you go? Which car is the fastest one? Go solo and race against the clock.
Versus: show your friend who's the boss here in this two player local multiplayer mode.
Mayhem mode: now this is where the fun begins! Try to survive on racing tracks full of traps and other dangers*.

Due to AI limitations, some races should only be played in time trial or versus mode. Of course you can try them in Arcade, but the AI won't be able to work properly. Look for the information on map preview.

main Features:
20 old, RC rusty cars to choose from.
18 normal races in many environments like abandoned houses, shops or warehouses.
14 mayhem races. What can you expect? How about a bomb in your car: touch something, and BOOM! Or maybe a race full of traps that can be activated to destroy your opponents? Oh, they can do it as well so be careful.

title: Veins Like Tapeworms
description:
게임 정보
Veins Like Tapeworms is a slow-burn, psychological horror visual novel about disgust, snuffed-out dreams, and the desire to be loved.



When life becomes a monotonous cycle, it's not hard to grasp how someone could be pushed to the brink of violence, all in the name of feeling free. It becomes even more understandable if that person never even began to live, before being shoved out of the nest. With no gentle way out, the only chance to start anew is to snap chains and splatter organs.

Putting it that way, it was only a matter of time until Demian gave in. We can't prevent a tragedy, but we can cause their descent.

An unsettling, heart-pounding atmosphere

Taking place in the fictional city of Kingsfield Beach, Nevada, Veins Like Tapeworms will present a chilling world for readers to immerse themselves in. Kingsfield is a concrete paradise, where dreams die under gaudy casinos and neon signs. Poor little Demian’s already been swallowed whole by the city, but that doesn’t mean they can’t crawl out of its festering underbelly. All they need is a little push.

Even with a slow-burn narrative told in , readers will be begging for more by the time the story is over.

Take control of a 22 year old living on the razor-thin edge between murder and mental break. After moving to Kingsfield Beach in hopes of finding a place to call home, all of their motivation to get out and live a better life has been sapped away. Now, they survive paycheck-to-paycheck, working their miserable job at the Restful Night Motel as a cleaner.

As they become host to an ancient flower god, though, Demian will soon learn that not all is hopeless with their life; they just need to set themself free. Their humanity will slip away from them, in exchange for their freedom.
With six endings for a player to achieve, the story of Veins Like Tapeworms is heavily dependent on choices made through a playthrough. The way Demian perceives the words and actions of those around them are influenced by the thoughts a player has allowed into their head - a heartwarming conversation in one path can become a harrowing monologue of bloodlust in another.

Every choice a reader can make is a thought running through Demian’s mind at that moment. Will you help them pluck the worms of cruelty from their brain, or indulge in their most violent fantasies?

title: Devil's Terminal
description:
게임 정보
Devil’s Terminal is a cozy mystery visual novel about troubled teens, summer camp, and an occult AI. At Camp Guidance, you will take on the role of a socially anxious outcast and stumble upon an ancient computer that foretells a greater purpose for you. The story explores themes of being lost, late-night talks around a campfire, and the strange comfort of discovering who you really are.

title: QuantumPulse 2A
description:
게임 정보
Solve programming puzzles on a fictional computer with radio-based communication and unique limitations. Competitively optimize to compete on leaderboards against friends and the global community.

Note: Though featuring programming and set in a time when quantum physics was the hip new thing, nothing related to modern "quantum computing" is included in this game.


From your friends at QuantumPulse Ltd we are excited to introduce the brand new QuantumPulse 2A Professional Computer and Visualization Interface: The most powerful device releasing in '77! With its novel on-chip radios, hi-tech BBS interface, and exclusive hardware addons, the QP-2A is sure to win your heart and mind. Compete against your friends in programming challenges to earn GOLD STARS! And ACT FAST: The first to complete the certification course will receive a complimentary unopened pack of traditional Kostovian playing cards.

Disclaimers: All of the above statements are classified as Marketing-Truth as per the Truth in Marketing Act of 1973. Friends need not be real. Stars contain no real gold. Manual may have been damaged, lost, or censored during international shipping.

title: Arctis
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an exciting Arctic expedition where survival is just the beginning. Lead your group across a rotating map as you scavenge for food, clothing and tools. As mysterious strangers invade the frozen wasteland, your struggle intensifies. Confront external threats and internal conflicts, uncover the fate of lost characters, and survive the relentless Arctic winter as new dangers emerge!




The map changes dynamically with each turn. Your group will face not only a shortage of resources, but also constantly moving ice floes.

Events on the map continuously appear and disappear.
Changing seasons mean mild summers and harsh winters.




As mysterious strangers appear on the map, uncover their intentions and adapt your strategy. But be prepared — finding the right approach won't always be simple.





Hunting is crucial for gathering resources. Utilize tools and characters to collect essential supplies in a hunting mini-game.





Throughout your journey, you'll meet all kinds of people — some who will stand by you, others who may pose a danger. Build a resilient community to prepare for the arrival of outsiders. Your group is your family and internal conflicts are likely to happen. Immerse yourself in the evolving story of your characters and fight to survive the freezing cold!

title: Deep Sea Arena
description:
게임 정보
Deep Sea Arena
Dive into Deep Sea Arena, an intense underwater arena shooter where deadly creatures emerge from the abyss. Battle relentless waves of deep-sea horrors, dodge ambushes, and fight to stay alive. How long can you survive the depths?

Fast-Paced Arena Shooter:
Ever-Descending Platform: Your battleground continuously sinks into the ocean depths, ramping up tension as you go.
Depth-Based Highscores: The deeper you manage to survive, the higher your score.
Escalating Difficulty: Face increasingly dangerous waves of enemies as pressure, darkness, and limited space intensify.
Constant Action: Quick reflexes and strategic movement are key—there’s no safe corner in this relentless descent.
Diverse Enemies: Encounter a variety of deep-sea creatures, each with unique attack patterns.
company: Marcel van Duijn, Jarno van Duijn

title: RitualRX
description:
게임 정보
                                                              The year is 198X,
                                               The powers that be have gone silent,
                                    Humanity is unrestrained, the party will never stop.
                                                 Vice grips every corner of the city,
                                                   Indulgence is at an all-time high,
                                                    A new kind of doctrine festers.
RitualRX is a brutally violent, blisteringly fast, adrenaline-pumping shooter set within a pastel paradise ruled by cults. Control a group of excommunicated sinners as you shoot, slash, and slaughter your way through a city where ritual is prescribed and the only treatment administered is an overdose of lead.
Lightning fast and brutal combat where everything is a weapon. Kick down doors and cave in skulls, throw everything and tackle enemies- ignite, cut, and blast your way through intricate sandbox-like levels as you master increasingly brutal methods of dispatching your foes.

title: Marble Run Maker
description:
게임 정보
마블런 메이커(Marble Run Maker)는 책, 장난감 등 물리적으로 시뮬레이션된 물체를 쌓아서 마블런을 만드는 게임입니다. 더 많이 달리면 점수가 높아집니다.
사물을 이동하고 회전하는 간단한 제어입니다.
작은 실수로 모든 것이 무너졌습니다 ;_;? 걱정하지 마세요. Ctrl + Z를 눌러 실행 취소하세요.
특성:
모든 것이 물리적으로 시뮬레이션됩니다.
사용하기 쉬운 컨트롤;
개방형 퍼즐은 완벽한 해결책이 없다는 것을 의미합니다.

title: Diacritic
description:
게임 정보
Scavengers scrap viciously for their lives in the ship graveyard that spans the beaches of the Eastern English coast, under shadow of smoke from the great volcano Azufre Nuit.
In neighbouring Allford, the Critic tires of his divine, incomprehensible workload, dreaming in secret of the dangerous artistic pleasures of wild nature.
Everywhere, your world has already hurtled into chaos.
It is your job to make sense.

Clocking in for a shift as a Diacritic, you will be expected to solve puzzles based around manipulating 3D shapes in space. You will complete assigned tasks in a timely manner and answer questions about your experience. Allow yourself to be chilled or enchanted by an icy story of selfishness, selflessness, suffering, survival and scant hope that threatens to infringe upon the world outside the screen.
FEATURES:
Satisfying puzzle gameplay based around manipulating 3D shapes
Work-related mail to peruse, and job assignments to complete (or ignore)
Crisp, chunky art style and retrofuturist OS navigation

title: Panic Lane
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready for the most intense driving game you’ve ever played? In Panic Lane, your goal is simple: survive. You'll be on the edge of your seat as you dodge randomly spawned obstacles and fight relentlessly just to stay alive. Will you make it? There’s only one way to find out.

title: The Witch In The Woods
description:
게임 정보
The Witch in The Woods is a light Yuri visual novel set in a fantasy world of magic and mystery. Delve into a captivating narrative filled with monster encounters, hidden secrets, betrayal, love, and tenderness. Your choices will lead to different outcomes.
The dangerous Greywind Forest has long been avoided by all who dare to tread its path. According to legend, the forest is home to beings beyond the norm, more dangerous than wild beasts. Once inside, escape seems impossible.

title: The Ripe Blood Anthology: This World Is Just  the Two of Us
description:
게임 정보
The Ripe Blood Anthology is a series of visual gay novels in which love, passion, sorrow, and death intertwine in unique stories. The plot of each game is self-contained, spanning genres from mystery to fantasy, or can just be everyday life with a touch of thriller.



In the first game, This World Is Just for the Two of Us, you'll have the opportunity to take on the role of Derek — the police chief in a small town. In the life of the protagonist, nothing interesting has been happening for a long time — work is calm, and personal life is in order. However, last month, he begins to notice that his boyfriend, Chris, seems to want to spend less and less time with him.

Life would have continued to roll along its familiar track, unhurriedly, if it hadn't been for what happened on Derek's uncle's birthday. That's when his younger sister, Lorelei, made an unexpected reappearance, having left the town five years ago and ceased all communication with the family. The entire evening, the girl acts oddly and has a poor grasp of her whereabouts. Toward the end of the birthday celebration, an even more unusual event takes place — all of a sudden, Derek's uncle strongly suggests that he should break up with his boyfriend, Chris.



You can influence the story and ending of this visual novel through your choices. It will depend solely on you what this adventure turns into. If you wish, a classic Chekhovian vignette will unfold before you, where "something happened, the characters haven't really done anything, and life just goes on." But if you decide to chase Carroll's "White Rabbit," you may very well uncover something unthinkable.

The game features mini-challenges, through which you can unlock — memories that can devour the main character alive. It's up to you whether it's worth listening to these bloodthirsty fish.



⚪ Approximately 50,000 words of text.
⚪ 1 love interest, 3 main endings (+ each ending will have a different aftertaste based on your gameplay choices).
⚪ Around 20 unique backgrounds.
⚪ Original soundtrack.
autokwd: The Ripe Blood Anthology: This World Is Just  the Two of Us

title: The Dream Office
description:
게임 정보
꿈이 실현되고 공간이 수익성 있는 기회로 바뀌는 기업 경영의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다. "드림 오피스"에서 당신은 상업 공간, 특히 사무실 건물을 번성하는 생산성 허브로 바꾸는 재능을 지닌 노련한 관리자의 세련된 신발을 밟게 됩니다. 하지만 그것은 단지 책상과 의자에 관한 것이 아닙니다. 혼란스러운 상황을 정리하는 것부터 완벽한 거래를 성사시키는 것까지 전략적 결정을 내리는 것입니다.
주요 기능:
🎨1. 크리에이티브 모드 - 샌드박스:
샌드박스 모드에서 창의력을 발휘해보세요. 자신만의 방을 디자인하고 만들어 넓은 개방형 공간을 독특하고 개인화된 환경으로 바꿔보세요.
🛠️2. 몰입형 역학:
쓰레기 청소, 벽 수평 맞추기, 페인팅, 타일 깔기, 세탁, 공간 정리 등 다양한 활동에 참여합니다. 불필요한 품목을 판매하면 관리에 전략이 추가됩니다.

title: Skymer
description:
게임 정보
You are a robot sent to a planet to set up a system to make it habitable for your creators. However, the makeup of its atmosphere leads to a challenging process along the way.
Build factories automated by drones
Create systems to mine and process materials in automated pipelines. Configure drones to easily handle the logistics. Skyformer's automation is intended to be more casual than most automation games, with less calculations and planning involved. It's an automation game that you can play at the end of a tiring day.
Terraform and track the weather
The processed materials allow you to create and run a system that controls the climate, tracks the weather, and terraforms the planet. As you terraform, the planet becomes more capable of producing weather systems, some of which being quite destructive. This game has a dynamic weather system that interacts with the geography, producing microclimates in each region based on the current global climate.

title: Candy Rangers
description:
게임 정보
이 새로운 온레일 슈팅 게임에서 시간과의 경쟁에 참여하세요. 한 번에 4개의 캐릭터를 제어합니다!

캔디, 민트, 레몬, 그리고 프룸을 만나보세요. 이들은 함께 살며 도시의 자연 환경을 망치려고 오는 생물들과 싸우는 레인저로 일합니다.

이 게임에서 적들은 다양한 형태와 배열로 파도처럼 다가올 것입니다. 다행스럽게도 각 캐릭터는 효과적으로 제거하기 위해 자체적인 특별한 총기와 쏘는 패턴을 가지고 있습니다!



캔디는 총알을 옆으로 쏠 수 있습니다.
민트는 수직으로 쏠 수 있습니다.
플럼은 앞뒤로 쏩니다.
레몬의 총알은 대각선 패턴을 지울 수 있습니다.
레벨을 효율적으로 클리어하기 위해 각각을 잘 활용하세요!

title: Sounds of War
description:
게임 정보

Craft your perfect loadout with our innovative Loadout System, allowing you to tailor your gear to your exact specifications for maximum tactical advantage.


Experience an array of exhilarating game modes, from intense Search & Destroy missions to adrenaline-fueled Team Deathmatches and the cutthroat chaos of Free For All battles.


Stand out on the battlefield with personalized Player Banners (Callsigns), showcasing your unique style and identity as you rise through the ranks to become a true legend of war.


Forge alliances with friends and allies, form powerful clans, and coordinate your strategies to dominate every corner of the battlefield, leaving your mark on the annals of warfare.


Embark on epic campaigns across a vast array of breathtaking maps, ranging from claustrophobic urban environments to sprawling, open landscapes, each offering its own unique challenges and opportunities for triumph.


Feel the pulse-pounding adrenaline rush of combat as you dive headfirst into the heart of the conflict, surrounded by the thunderous roar of gunfire and the explosive symphony of war.


Immerse yourself in the and experience thrilling battles that will put your skills to the test. Join the community, compete against players from all over the world, and prove that you are the ultimate warrior. What are you waiting for? The battle awaits – gear up for on Steam!

title: Beyond R: Rule Ripper
description:
게임 정보


Trapped in an Evolving Death Game, he chooses to rebel

You awaken in a mysterious luxury bar, the Golden Jack, alongside nine strangers, and are forced to play a game by The Owner. Each player represents one of the game's rules. You can disobey your own rule, and that rule will disappear if you die. Only three players can survive...unless you find another way.

Beyond R: Rule Ripper is a visual novel with some light gameplay elements, inspired by series such as Zero Escape, Danganronpa, and Ace Attorney, as well as anime like Death Parade and Kaiji. Mixing suspense, drama, and mystery, with a seasoning of comedy.



Defy the death game by gaining the trust of its players and confronting them in the game's Councils, a face-off between all players where anyone can kill through a vote. Can you tame this wild variety of players before it's too late or will the pressure of death drown you?



Make your voice heard and prevent the discussion from falling into chaos through an imagined game of pool. When do you strike and who?

title: The Spiral
description:
게임 정보
The Spiral is a first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Explore the dungeon, find tools for your survival, and try to escape with your life.
Descend into Darkness
Explore an infinite dungeon with randomized layouts, items, and enemies. No two playthroughs are the same.
Find Powerful Equipment
Make use of the dungeon's bounty to survive. Simple farming tools, legendary weapons, curious potions, and enchanted charms are all at your disposal.
Fight for Your Life
You are not alone. Monsters, nightmares, and other desperate wanderers like you all call the dungeon home. Kill them before they kill you.

title: Heavenstrafer
description:
게임 정보
Take control of Berith, a demon priestess ready to shoot her way through an angel infested Hell, in her crusade to hunt three powerful demons that have been corrupted by the angelic forces. Unleash your arsenal of four powerful guns and weave between them in order to string together stylish combos. And remember:
"It's not about size or speed, it's about technique."
Use all the weapons given to you

The disastrous yet beautiful historical figures [Effector Series] by Takahiro Tanaka, one of Japan's leading animation directors.

.

The maze will be challenging to navigate, doors leading further on are locked by mysterious puzzles, & unknown dangers may await. The mouse holds onto hope that, despite its past experiences, this time it will achieve its goal: Escape.
Éalú is a point & click puzzle/adventure game where the player:
Guides the mouse through a maze, starting from the center.
Finds clues & solves puzzles & has dangerous encounters.
Eats cheese!

Lovingly made by a tiny team

Over 450 video clips were painstakingly created by one animator (mostly in a garden shed) & then woven together in the Unity game engine by one developer to create this interactive experience. title: Shadow Codex
description:
게임 정보
Shadow Codex invites you into a mystical world where magic meets mystery. In this cooperative puzzle-horror game, you and your friends take on the roles of a daring explorer and wise researchers, each with your own crucial part to play. Set in an enchanted forest filled with secrets, you’ll need to communicate effectively and strategize together to uncover ancient truths and combat malevolent witches.
As the explorer, navigate through atmospheric, richly detailed environments—from a enervating graveyard to a frozen lake—each haunted by a distinct elemental witch with unique powers and vulnerabilities. Meanwhile, the scholar assists by deciphering a mystical book filled with lore, puzzles, and spells essential for progress and survival.
Asymmetric Co-Op: Engage in a unique cooperative format where one player explores in-game locations while the other consults interactive documents to provide guidance and solve puzzles.
Mystical Environments: Explore three beautifully rendered, eerie locations each themed around natural elements of fire, ice, and blood, with challenges and aesthetics to match.
Interactive Puzzles: Solve a variety of dynamic puzzles that require real-time communication and collaboration, ranging from brewing ancient potions to decoding celestial alignments.
Rich Narrative: Unravel a gripping story woven through interactions and discoveries in the game, revealing the histories and secrets of the witches you face.
Replayability: With multiple solutions to problems and various strategies to defeat the witches, each playthrough offers new challenges and outcomes.
Atmospheric Visuals and Sound: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world complemented by a haunting soundtrack that enhances the mysterious and foreboding atmosphere of the forest.
Accessibility Modes and Customization: Don't want the enemies listening to you? Turn it off. Just want a chill puzzle experience with your friends? Shadow Codex has that. Want jump scares and butt-clenching terror? That's there for you too.
In Shadow Codex, your teamwork will be tested as you delve deeper into the forest’s shadows. Can you and your partner banish the darkness together, or will you be consumed by the secrets that lurk within? Step into the forest, and discover what lies beyond the veil.

title: Sub Optimal Co.
description:
게임 정보

Invite up to five friends and operate your submarine. Together or alone.

Navigate carefully and consider every move while you progress through one of 20 challenging and unique cave systems in this slow pace, atmospheric diving experience. Reach the target location without crushing your submarine into the walls by operating your cameras, ping and the submarine's movement. Together or alone. While you can operate the submarine all by yourself - It’s way more effective to have a few helping hands on board. So hire your friends who are up for a dive experience.

It’s simple. Maneuver your submarine to collect the target and return to your base while not scratching the cave-walls.

You will be spending 95% in the submarine. You (and your friends) can freely move within it and by operating the submarine's consoles, you can move and navigate your submarine. Dive through challenging cave systems by turning, tilting, rotating and adjusting movement speed, without touching the walls.

If your submarine touches the walls too often, it will sink and the dive failed. The challenge here is that you only have limited tools to see or hear your location within the cave. There is always a target at the end of the cave that you need to reach and return to your base with.

With every new launch or restart of the game, one of 20 caves will be chosen randomly for you to play (more to come). Think of it as some kind of hot-wire mechanic. In a sub. In a cave.




This project was designed to be a slow pace, multiplayer experience to play with friends while chatting in your favorite voice-chat. You can even play this game with mouse only, so you got one free hand for your favorite cup of tee, or coffee.

As you progress further with a successful mission-line, enjoy new ranks, new uniforms, some beards, and some new cups for your character.


- Only steam friends can be invited. There are no open server selections.
- "Sub Optimal Co." uses peer-to-peer connection.
- There is no ingame voice or text chat.
- No bots or NPCs can be added to the party.

title: Conjured Through Death
description:
게임 정보
"Conjured Through Death"는 금지된 마법 실험의 무모한 결과로 재앙에 빠진 마법사의 비극적인 이야기를 전하는 어두운 매력적인 Roguelike 게임입니다. 한때 강력한 마법사였던 당신은 이제 살아있는 시체가 되어, 죽은 자들의 몸에 반복적으로 환생하는 운명에 처해 있습니다. 당신의 은신처는 성의 지하 깊은 곳에 위치하며, 당신의 어두운 마법이 세상에 빠져나가는 것을 막기 위해 결연히 당신을 가두려는 옛 동료들과 성의 경비병들이 둘러싸고 있습니다.
여정은 성의 가장 어두운 구석에서 시작됩니다. 한 걸음 한 걸음, 당신은 자유를 향해 싸우며 점점 더 강력한 적들과 마주하게 됩니다 — 숙련된 전사들, 교활한 마법사들, 그리고 당신을 막기 위해 목숨을 바칠 준비가 된 무자비한 경비병들. 그 길에서, 당신은 고대의 제단들을 발견하게 되며, 이 제단들은 강력한 힘의 원천이 됩니다. 이 제단을 통해 무기를 강화하고, 강력한 마법을 배우고, 속성치를 향상시키는 등, 다가올 도전에 맞춰 능력을 개발할 수 있는 다양한 길을 제공합니다.
게임에는 다섯 가지 강력한 무기와 네 가지 마법서가 존재하며, 각 마법서는 고유한 원소의 힘을 대표합니다. 이들은 처치한 적들의 영혼을 사용하여 잠금 해제할 수 있으며, 전략적인 깊이를 더하고 당신만의 독특한 게임 스타일을 만들 수 있는 더 많은 방법을 제공합니다.
각 플레이는 당신의 기술, 전략 및 결단력을 시험하며, 독특하고 잔인한 보스와의 치열한 전투는 모든 무기와 마법의 마스터리를 요구합니다. 성을 탈출하려 싸우는 동안, 더 깊은 질문이 떠오릅니다: 당신은 자신이 일으킨 혼돈에 대한 구속을 찾고자 하는 영웅인가, 아니면 자신의 어두운 힘을 성벽 너머로 확장하려는 악당인가? 답은 당신의 승리와 그 과정에서 빼앗은 생명들의 메아리 속에 숨어 있습니다.
