Replayability: With multiple solutions to problems and various strategies to defeat the witches, each playthrough offers new challenges and outcomes.
Atmospheric Visuals and Sound: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world complemented by a haunting soundtrack that enhances the mysterious and foreboding atmosphere of the forest.
Accessibility Modes and Customization: Don't want the enemies listening to you? Turn it off. Just want a chill puzzle experience with your friends? Shadow Codex has that. Want jump scares and butt-clenching terror? That's there for you too.
In Shadow Codex, your teamwork will be tested as you delve deeper into the forest’s shadows. Can you and your partner banish the darkness together, or will you be consumed by the secrets that lurk within? Step into the forest, and discover what lies beyond the veil.

title: Roodies Factory - Chapter 1
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Roodies Factory!

This is the first game in the "Roodies Factory" saga.

Roodies Factory is a first-person horror mascot exploration game. In the game you are the ex-founder of "Roodies Factory" who returns to the factory years after it was abandoned in search of his missing brother...

Explore the abandoned factory, solve puzzles and find out what really happened 3 years ago when the factory was abandoned.

Roodie

Roodie is a tall animatronic clown who can think for himself. He is the main animatronic of Roodies Factory, he is also the most loved animatronic by children.

Characteristics

-Photorealistic Enviroment
-Horror Atmosphere
-Receive calls from NPCs
-Solve puzzles
-Explore the abandoned factory

title: Footsy
description:
게임 정보
Footsy는 할머니 댁에서 펼쳐지는 혼란스러운 멀티플레이 축구 파티 게임입니다! 가구를 부수고, 병을 깨고, TV를 뒤집으며 골을 넣는 치열한 경기를 즐기세요. 파티에 완벽한 선택입니다!
할머니 댁에서 1:1로 펼쳐지는 미친 축구 경기에서 친구들보다 더 많은 골을 넣어보세요!
한 소파에서 플레이하거나 Remote Play로 온라인에서 연결해보세요. 우정이 시험대에 오를 겁니다!
테이블을 부수고, 꽃병을 깨뜨리며, TV를 뒤집으세요. 물리 기반의 혼란스러운 액션 덕분에, 모든 샷이 경기의 흐름과 집안의 상태를 바꿀 수 있습니다!

title: speak of my sin
description:
게임 정보
Discord:
With the help of the inspector, you are expected to unravel the mysteries and cases of both recent and old years, and then recall and speak out your sins as you get closer to the truth of the story.
In this game, you have three goals:
The fundamental and most important thing is to extract key information to find the truth of the case through the text description searched by the police department.
Each piece of information can be a key clue to the real killer, including the layout of the room at the scene of the crime, the footage from surveillance cameras, the chat logs of the suspect and so on.
The core task [/u] is to connect the facts of multiple cases and restore the whole story. In this game, figuring out the story behind the case is more important than finding out the real killer.
If you encounter difficulties in a certain chapter and can’t find out the truth, please be patient and move on to the next chapter, the answer may be concealed in it.

title: Carpocalypse RC Racing
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to the BURN league, newbie! The world may have ended, but the fun is just about to begin. Because as they say, "it doesn't matter how bad the situation is... Humans still want to have some fun!". And we will have a lot of it! So what are you waiting for?

Game Modes:
Arcade: choose a car, choose a race track and show them what you can do!
Championship: seven championships are waiting for you. Finish every race in every environment and take part in few more, way longer and challenging championships.
Time Trial: how fast can you go? Which car is the fastest one? Go solo and race against the clock.
Versus: show your friend who's the boss here in this two player local multiplayer mode.
Mayhem mode: now this is where the fun begins! Try to survive on racing tracks full of traps and other dangers*.

Due to AI limitations, some races should only be played in time trial or versus mode. Of course you can try them in Arcade, but the AI won't be able to work properly. Look for the information on map preview.

main Features:
20 old, RC rusty cars to choose from.
18 normal races in many environments like abandoned houses, shops or warehouses.
14 mayhem races. What can you expect? How about a bomb in your car: touch something, and BOOM! Or maybe a race full of traps that can be activated to destroy your opponents? Oh, they can do it as well so be careful.

title: Veins Like Tapeworms
description:
게임 정보
Veins Like Tapeworms is a slow-burn, psychological horror visual novel about disgust, snuffed-out dreams, and the desire to be loved.



When life becomes a monotonous cycle, it's not hard to grasp how someone could be pushed to the brink of violence, all in the name of feeling free. It becomes even more understandable if that person never even began to live, before being shoved out of the nest. With no gentle way out, the only chance to start anew is to snap chains and splatter organs.

Putting it that way, it was only a matter of time until Demian gave in. We can't prevent a tragedy, but we can cause their descent.

An unsettling, heart-pounding atmosphere

Taking place in the fictional city of Kingsfield Beach, Nevada, Veins Like Tapeworms will present a chilling world for readers to immerse themselves in. Kingsfield is a concrete paradise, where dreams die under gaudy casinos and neon signs. Poor little Demian’s already been swallowed whole by the city, but that doesn’t mean they can’t crawl out of its festering underbelly. All they need is a little push.

Even with a slow-burn narrative told in , readers will be begging for more by the time the story is over.

Take control of a 22 year old living on the razor-thin edge between murder and mental break. After moving to Kingsfield Beach in hopes of finding a place to call home, all of their motivation to get out and live a better life has been sapped away. Now, they survive paycheck-to-paycheck, working their miserable job at the Restful Night Motel as a cleaner.

As they become host to an ancient flower god, though, Demian will soon learn that not all is hopeless with their life; they just need to set themself free. Their humanity will slip away from them, in exchange for their freedom.
With six endings for a player to achieve, the story of Veins Like Tapeworms is heavily dependent on choices made through a playthrough. The way Demian perceives the words and actions of those around them are influenced by the thoughts a player has allowed into their head - a heartwarming conversation in one path can become a harrowing monologue of bloodlust in another.

Every choice a reader can make is a thought running through Demian’s mind at that moment. Will you help them pluck the worms of cruelty from their brain, or indulge in their most violent fantasies?

title: Devil's Terminal
description:
게임 정보
Devil’s Terminal is a cozy mystery visual novel about troubled teens, summer camp, and an occult AI. At Camp Guidance, you will take on the role of a socially anxious outcast and stumble upon an ancient computer that foretells a greater purpose for you. The story explores themes of being lost, late-night talks around a campfire, and the strange comfort of discovering who you really are.

title: QuantumPulse 2A
description:
게임 정보
Solve programming puzzles on a fictional computer with radio-based communication and unique limitations. Competitively optimize to compete on leaderboards against friends and the global community.

Note: Though featuring programming and set in a time when quantum physics was the hip new thing, nothing related to modern "quantum computing" is included in this game.


From your friends at QuantumPulse Ltd we are excited to introduce the brand new QuantumPulse 2A Professional Computer and Visualization Interface: The most powerful device releasing in '77! With its novel on-chip radios, hi-tech BBS interface, and exclusive hardware addons, the QP-2A is sure to win your heart and mind. Compete against your friends in programming challenges to earn GOLD STARS! And ACT FAST: The first to complete the certification course will receive a complimentary unopened pack of traditional Kostovian playing cards.

Disclaimers: All of the above statements are classified as Marketing-Truth as per the Truth in Marketing Act of 1973. Friends need not be real. Stars contain no real gold. Manual may have been damaged, lost, or censored during international shipping.

title: Arctis
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an exciting Arctic expedition where survival is just the beginning. Lead your group across a rotating map as you scavenge for food, clothing and tools. As mysterious strangers invade the frozen wasteland, your struggle intensifies. Confront external threats and internal conflicts, uncover the fate of lost characters, and survive the relentless Arctic winter as new dangers emerge!




The map changes dynamically with each turn. Your group will face not only a shortage of resources, but also constantly moving ice floes.

Events on the map continuously appear and disappear.
Changing seasons mean mild summers and harsh winters.




As mysterious strangers appear on the map, uncover their intentions and adapt your strategy. But be prepared — finding the right approach won't always be simple.





Hunting is crucial for gathering resources. Utilize tools and characters to collect essential supplies in a hunting mini-game.





Throughout your journey, you'll meet all kinds of people — some who will stand by you, others who may pose a danger. Build a resilient community to prepare for the arrival of outsiders. Your group is your family and internal conflicts are likely to happen. Immerse yourself in the evolving story of your characters and fight to survive the freezing cold!

title: Deep Sea Arena
description:
게임 정보
Deep Sea Arena
Dive into Deep Sea Arena, an intense underwater arena shooter where deadly creatures emerge from the abyss. Battle relentless waves of deep-sea horrors, dodge ambushes, and fight to stay alive. How long can you survive the depths?

Fast-Paced Arena Shooter:
Ever-Descending Platform: Your battleground continuously sinks into the ocean depths, ramping up tension as you go.
Depth-Based Highscores: The deeper you manage to survive, the higher your score.
Escalating Difficulty: Face increasingly dangerous waves of enemies as pressure, darkness, and limited space intensify.
Constant Action: Quick reflexes and strategic movement are key—there’s no safe corner in this relentless descent.
Diverse Enemies: Encounter a variety of deep-sea creatures, each with unique attack patterns.
company: Marcel van Duijn, Jarno van Duijn

title: RitualRX
description:
게임 정보
                                                              The year is 198X,
                                               The powers that be have gone silent,
                                    Humanity is unrestrained, the party will never stop.
                                                 Vice grips every corner of the city,
                                                   Indulgence is at an all-time high,
                                                    A new kind of doctrine festers.
RitualRX is a brutally violent, blisteringly fast, adrenaline-pumping shooter set within a pastel paradise ruled by cults. Control a group of excommunicated sinners as you shoot, slash, and slaughter your way through a city where ritual is prescribed and the only treatment administered is an overdose of lead.
Lightning fast and brutal combat where everything is a weapon. Kick down doors and cave in skulls, throw everything and tackle enemies- ignite, cut, and blast your way through intricate sandbox-like levels as you master increasingly brutal methods of dispatching your foes.

title: Marble Run Maker
description:
게임 정보
마블런 메이커(Marble Run Maker)는 책, 장난감 등 물리적으로 시뮬레이션된 물체를 쌓아서 마블런을 만드는 게임입니다. 더 많이 달리면 점수가 높아집니다.
사물을 이동하고 회전하는 간단한 제어입니다.
작은 실수로 모든 것이 무너졌습니다 ;_;? 걱정하지 마세요. Ctrl + Z를 눌러 실행 취소하세요.
특성:
모든 것이 물리적으로 시뮬레이션됩니다.
사용하기 쉬운 컨트롤;
개방형 퍼즐은 완벽한 해결책이 없다는 것을 의미합니다.

title: Diacritic
description:
게임 정보
Scavengers scrap viciously for their lives in the ship graveyard that spans the beaches of the Eastern English coast, under shadow of smoke from the great volcano Azufre Nuit.
In neighbouring Allford, the Critic tires of his divine, incomprehensible workload, dreaming in secret of the dangerous artistic pleasures of wild nature.
Everywhere, your world has already hurtled into chaos.
It is your job to make sense.

Clocking in for a shift as a Diacritic, you will be expected to solve puzzles based around manipulating 3D shapes in space. You will complete assigned tasks in a timely manner and answer questions about your experience. Allow yourself to be chilled or enchanted by an icy story of selfishness, selflessness, suffering, survival and scant hope that threatens to infringe upon the world outside the screen.
FEATURES:
Satisfying puzzle gameplay based around manipulating 3D shapes
Work-related mail to peruse, and job assignments to complete (or ignore)
Crisp, chunky art style and retrofuturist OS navigation

title: Panic Lane
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready for the most intense driving game you’ve ever played? In Panic Lane, your goal is simple: survive. You'll be on the edge of your seat as you dodge randomly spawned obstacles and fight relentlessly just to stay alive. Will you make it? There’s only one way to find out.

title: The Witch In The Woods
description:
게임 정보
The Witch in The Woods is a light Yuri visual novel set in a fantasy world of magic and mystery. Delve into a captivating narrative filled with monster encounters, hidden secrets, betrayal, love, and tenderness. Your choices will lead to different outcomes.
The dangerous Greywind Forest has long been avoided by all who dare to tread its path. According to legend, the forest is home to beings beyond the norm, more dangerous than wild beasts. Once inside, escape seems impossible.

title: The Ripe Blood Anthology: This World Is Just  the Two of Us
description:
게임 정보
The Ripe Blood Anthology is a series of visual gay novels in which love, passion, sorrow, and death intertwine in unique stories. The plot of each game is self-contained, spanning genres from mystery to fantasy, or can just be everyday life with a touch of thriller.



In the first game, This World Is Just for the Two of Us, you'll have the opportunity to take on the role of Derek — the police chief in a small town. In the life of the protagonist, nothing interesting has been happening for a long time — work is calm, and personal life is in order. However, last month, he begins to notice that his boyfriend, Chris, seems to want to spend less and less time with him.

Life would have continued to roll along its familiar track, unhurriedly, if it hadn't been for what happened on Derek's uncle's birthday. That's when his younger sister, Lorelei, made an unexpected reappearance, having left the town five years ago and ceased all communication with the family. The entire evening, the girl acts oddly and has a poor grasp of her whereabouts. Toward the end of the birthday celebration, an even more unusual event takes place — all of a sudden, Derek's uncle strongly suggests that he should break up with his boyfriend, Chris.



You can influence the story and ending of this visual novel through your choices. It will depend solely on you what this adventure turns into. If you wish, a classic Chekhovian vignette will unfold before you, where "something happened, the characters haven't really done anything, and life just goes on." But if you decide to chase Carroll's "White Rabbit," you may very well uncover something unthinkable.

The game features mini-challenges, through which you can unlock — memories that can devour the main character alive. It's up to you whether it's worth listening to these bloodthirsty fish.



⚪ Approximately 50,000 words of text.
⚪ 1 love interest, 3 main endings (+ each ending will have a different aftertaste based on your gameplay choices).
⚪ Around 20 unique backgrounds.
⚪ Original soundtrack.
autokwd: The Ripe Blood Anthology: This World Is Just  the Two of Us

title: The Dream Office
description:
게임 정보
꿈이 실현되고 공간이 수익성 있는 기회로 바뀌는 기업 경영의 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다. "드림 오피스"에서 당신은 상업 공간, 특히 사무실 건물을 번성하는 생산성 허브로 바꾸는 재능을 지닌 노련한 관리자의 세련된 신발을 밟게 됩니다. 하지만 그것은 단지 책상과 의자에 관한 것이 아닙니다. 혼란스러운 상황을 정리하는 것부터 완벽한 거래를 성사시키는 것까지 전략적 결정을 내리는 것입니다.
주요 기능:
🎨1. 크리에이티브 모드 - 샌드박스:
샌드박스 모드에서 창의력을 발휘해보세요. 자신만의 방을 디자인하고 만들어 넓은 개방형 공간을 독특하고 개인화된 환경으로 바꿔보세요.
🛠️2. 몰입형 역학:
쓰레기 청소, 벽 수평 맞추기, 페인팅, 타일 깔기, 세탁, 공간 정리 등 다양한 활동에 참여합니다. 불필요한 품목을 판매하면 관리에 전략이 추가됩니다.

title: Skymer
description:
게임 정보
You are a robot sent to a planet to set up a system to make it habitable for your creators. However, the makeup of its atmosphere leads to a challenging process along the way.
Build factories automated by drones
Create systems to mine and process materials in automated pipelines. Configure drones to easily handle the logistics. Skyformer's automation is intended to be more casual than most automation games, with less calculations and planning involved. It's an automation game that you can play at the end of a tiring day.
Terraform and track the weather
The processed materials allow you to create and run a system that controls the climate, tracks the weather, and terraforms the planet. As you terraform, the planet becomes more capable of producing weather systems, some of which being quite destructive. This game has a dynamic weather system that interacts with the geography, producing microclimates in each region based on the current global climate.

title: Candy Rangers
description:
게임 정보
이 새로운 온레일 슈팅 게임에서 시간과의 경쟁에 참여하세요. 한 번에 4개의 캐릭터를 제어합니다!

캔디, 민트, 레몬, 그리고 프룸을 만나보세요. 이들은 함께 살며 도시의 자연 환경을 망치려고 오는 생물들과 싸우는 레인저로 일합니다.

이 게임에서 적들은 다양한 형태와 배열로 파도처럼 다가올 것입니다. 다행스럽게도 각 캐릭터는 효과적으로 제거하기 위해 자체적인 특별한 총기와 쏘는 패턴을 가지고 있습니다!



캔디는 총알을 옆으로 쏠 수 있습니다.
민트는 수직으로 쏠 수 있습니다.
플럼은 앞뒤로 쏩니다.
레몬의 총알은 대각선 패턴을 지울 수 있습니다.
레벨을 효율적으로 클리어하기 위해 각각을 잘 활용하세요!

title: Sounds of War
description:
게임 정보

Craft your perfect loadout with our innovative Loadout System, allowing you to tailor your gear to your exact specifications for maximum tactical advantage.


Experience an array of exhilarating game modes, from intense Search & Destroy missions to adrenaline-fueled Team Deathmatches and the cutthroat chaos of Free For All battles.


Stand out on the battlefield with personalized Player Banners (Callsigns), showcasing your unique style and identity as you rise through the ranks to become a true legend of war.


Forge alliances with friends and allies, form powerful clans, and coordinate your strategies to dominate every corner of the battlefield, leaving your mark on the annals of warfare.


Embark on epic campaigns across a vast array of breathtaking maps, ranging from claustrophobic urban environments to sprawling, open landscapes, each offering its own unique challenges and opportunities for triumph.


Feel the pulse-pounding adrenaline rush of combat as you dive headfirst into the heart of the conflict, surrounded by the thunderous roar of gunfire and the explosive symphony of war.


Immerse yourself in the and experience thrilling battles that will put your skills to the test. Join the community, compete against players from all over the world, and prove that you are the ultimate warrior. What are you waiting for? The battle awaits – gear up for on Steam!

title: Carcade
description:
게임 정보
Get Ready!
Race across a variety of dynamic tracks, each designed to challenge your precision, reflexes, and strategy. With a bold and striking art style crafted by ICONIC GARAGE, every race feels like a visual spectacle—where speed meets style.
Compete Your Way
🔥 Time Attack – Beat the clock and set record-breaking lap times.
👻 Ghost Races – Challenge your own best times or race against ghost opponents to fine-tune your skills.
🌍 Multiplayer Madness – Take the competition online and race against real players in thrilling, skill-based matchups.

title: Éalú
description:
게임 정보
In a cozy, soft nest, in the heart of a wood and stone labyrinth, a clockwork mouse sleeps & dreams of the outside world. As it wakes & ventures forth, the mouse will need to make full use of its clever mind & keen senses. The maze will be challenging to navigate, doors leading further on are locked by mysterious puzzles, & unknown dangers may await. The mouse holds onto hope that, despite its past experiences, this time it will achieve its goal: Escape.
Éalú is a point & click puzzle/adventure game where the player:
Guides the mouse through a maze, starting from the center.
Finds clues & solves puzzles & has dangerous encounters.
Eats cheese!
Discovers the true nature of the maze &, ultimately, how to escape.
Lovingly made by a tiny team
This is a true stop-motion game, where everything was hand-animated & the mouse was photographed in place next to physical sets & props. Over 450 video clips were painstakingly created by one animator (mostly in a garden shed) & then woven together in the Unity game engine by one developer to create this interactive experience. Original music was composed & recorded by a single person specifically for the score of the game, & beautiful drawings were created from scratch by our illustrator.

title: Project Leo
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for the hottest advanced physics based rally racing game. Set in Englands' picturesque countryside, rally through highly detailed beautiful english rally stages and test your mettle on dirt, gravel and asphalt surfaces.

title: Caveman Jump Jump
description:
게임 정보
Dare to travel back 40,000 years and help the caveman escape extinction in this challenging platforming adventure across three unique worlds!
Prepare for a tough challenge in the prehistoric era! Test your skills by jumping your way up to the top, where a frozen cavewoman awaits your rescue.
Game Features:
• Action-packed platforming adventure!
• 12 full levels filled with challenges!
• 3 unique worlds with beautifully crafted environments!
• Help the caveman survive extinction!
• Custom artwork and a distinctive design!
• Reach the top — if you're skilled enough!
• Time your jumps carefully… or fall into the void!

title: Santa's Hitlist CEO Edition
description:
게임 정보
Children all over the world (and even some adults) have been sending you letters, asking for just one thing: they wish their parents could be happier and come home earlier, instead of working endless hours for low wages.
As Santa, it’s your mission to fulfill their wishes by destroying the root of all evil—the greedy CEOs who exploit their employees and steal the joy from families.
This holiday season, it’s PAYBACK TIME!!!
Play as Santa Claus and take on corrupt CEOs who have drained the joy from their employees in this over-the-top action-packed adventure.
🎅 TAKE REVENGE as Santa!!!

title: Love Surge!
description:
게임 정보
About
Everyone has a connection to their electronics… but not everyone has a romantic one. Love Surge! is a visual novel, comedy dating sim, where you can romance human versions of your appliances: Noki (cell phone), Lotte (coffee machine), and Celci (thermostat).
When going on dates, the gameplay merges the visual novel text with card game mechanics, to rack up point combos and simulate deeper conversations! This game combines the genres of dating sim, visual novel, and deck builder for one epic adventure!

title: Beyond R: Rule Ripper
description:
게임 정보


Trapped in an Evolving Death Game, he chooses to rebel

You awaken in a mysterious luxury bar, the Golden Jack, alongside nine strangers, and are forced to play a game by The Owner. Each player represents one of the game's rules. You can disobey your own rule, and that rule will disappear if you die. Only three players can survive...unless you find another way.

Beyond R: Rule Ripper is a visual novel with some light gameplay elements, inspired by series such as Zero Escape, Danganronpa, and Ace Attorney, as well as anime like Death Parade and Kaiji. Mixing suspense, drama, and mystery, with a seasoning of comedy.



Defy the death game by gaining the trust of its players and confronting them in the game's Councils, a face-off between all players where anyone can kill through a vote. Can you tame this wild variety of players before it's too late or will the pressure of death drown you?



Make your voice heard and prevent the discussion from falling into chaos through an imagined game of pool. When do you strike and who?

title: The Spiral
description:
게임 정보
The Spiral is a first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Explore the dungeon, find tools for your survival, and try to escape with your life.
Descend into Darkness
Explore an infinite dungeon with randomized layouts, items, and enemies. No two playthroughs are the same.
Find Powerful Equipment
Make use of the dungeon's bounty to survive. Simple farming tools, legendary weapons, curious potions, and enchanted charms are all at your disposal.
Fight for Your Life
You are not alone. Monsters, nightmares, and other desperate wanderers like you all call the dungeon home. Kill them before they kill you.

title: Heavenstrafer
description:
게임 정보
Take control of Berith, a demon priestess ready to shoot her way through an angel infested Hell, in her crusade to hunt three powerful demons that have been corrupted by the angelic forces. Unleash your arsenal of four powerful guns and weave between them in order to string together stylish combos. And remember:
"It's not about size or speed, it's about technique."
Use all the weapons given to you
Earn COMBO RANKS by shooting with different weapons. Switching weapons allows you to shoot faster. Heal yourself by damaging enemies at a high COMBO RANK.
Augment your mobility with three different dashes
By DASHING at the maximum COMBO RANK you can slow down time, become invisible or create a powerful explosion.
Never stop shooting
Instantly reload all weapons by shooting with all guns at least once.
Every gun comes equipped with a main fire mode and an unlockable alternate fire mode. The Belial and the Purson are a pair of shotguns that compliment each other's damage, both with alternate shots that augment your mobility. The Ballista fires an explosive flaming bolt, setting enemies on fire and increasing the damage they take, and finally, the Asmodeus Opus is a revolver that deals high damage against dying enemies, redirecting your bullet and reloading all weapons on a kill.

title: Memory Rewind
description:
게임 정보

Unique investigation gameplay that challenges players to be observant
Diverse cast of characters
Smooth 2D animation that breathes life into the characters

title: Summoner of Greats
description:

Is it a prayer or a curse...
And what is a human being? A hymn to humanity that questions the beauty of human beings.
---
For 3,000 years, the Moon Rabbit [Lewis] has looked down on the earth and painted portraits of great historical figures.
However, he passed away after "an event".
And he left behind a series of portraits.

Why did he, a being so close to God, die?
This is a story of "prayer and curse" of a lonely rabbit who paints his thoughts on a canvas.
The disastrous yet beautiful historical figures [Effector Series] by Takahiro Tanaka, one of Japan's leading animation directors.
You can build your own deck by combining more than 200 great figures.
Everything in the interface exists as material that ties into the narrative and unfolds seamlessly without compromising the worldview.
.
There are also events that unfold as if the interface were a theater.
Yose! Sing! Dance! Strip!!!

The variety of aspects generated by placement and weather changes is appealing and allows you to build your own unique style of play.
Just use the mouse to make selections and place them on the board; the game design is suitable for both beginners and advanced players of RTS.
As you complete quests, you will obtain "memoirs and vinyl videos," fragmentary evidence of the story.

title: Zero Symptom
description:
게임 정보
Zero Symptom is a first-person horror game with shooter and survival elements that tells the story of a doctor who arrives at the center of an epidemic caused by an experimental vaccine against COVID.
The game takes place around the 90s in post-Soviet Russia, in one of the many remote towns in the forgotten corners of the country.
The vaccine worked as expected for most people, but turned the rest into previously unseen creatures.
The previous doctor has stopped communicating, and you will have to learn about his actions before you, as well as clean up the consequences or worsen them with your choice.
Will you be able to stop the spread of the epidemic and help everyone in need, will you be able to save seemingly hopeless patients, or will you turn the city into a hotbed of infection?
The choice is yours.

title: Hive Quest
description:
게임 정보
Hive Quest is an immersive real time strategy game set in a mythical woodland filled with ancient magic, strange creatures & intriguing puzzles. As the Hive Mind you will guide your insect tribe on a hazardous adventure to find safety after a terrible cataclysm. Explore mysterious locations with the help of your pet Shrublet, find allies, uncover the story behind the Old Orchard and fight against other tribes. Do you have what it takes to re-establish your Hive’s fortunes and seek out the mythical ‘Sunny Uplands’?

– Guide your embattled tribe on a quest to find fortune, glory and a new home.
– Interact with a wide variety of crazy puzzles and strange goings on as you try to make sense of it all.
– Explore the mysteries of the Deep Woods and uncover new allies and enemies.
– Battle against other hives to maintain control of your territory.
– Manage resources and build your Hive into a powerful kingdom, filled with hard working drones.
– Take mind control of your drones and send them into unknown territory on dangerous missions.
– Launch attacks on enemy Hives & dangerous creatures that stand in your way.
– Obtain woodland elementals as pets and upgrade them to fight and do your bidding.

Thanks for looking!

Features
Defend against enemies during an intense, time-limited resource gathering phase
Carefully plan and manage a limited number of actions before entering cryo sleep
Collect research and use it to unlock new upgrades
Encounter crisis events and make tough decisions
Explore procedurally generated solar systems

title: Sub Optimal Co.
description:
게임 정보

Invite up to five friends and operate your submarine. Together or alone.

Navigate carefully and consider every move while you progress through one of 20 challenging and unique cave systems in this slow pace, atmospheric diving experience. Reach the target location without crushing your submarine into the walls by operating your cameras, ping and the submarine's movement. Together or alone. While you can operate the submarine all by yourself - It’s way more effective to have a few helping hands on board. So hire your friends who are up for a dive experience.

It’s simple. Maneuver your submarine to collect the target and return to your base while not scratching the cave-walls.

You will be spending 95% in the submarine. You (and your friends) can freely move within it and by operating the submarine's consoles, you can move and navigate your submarine. Dive through challenging cave systems by turning, tilting, rotating and adjusting movement speed, without touching the walls.

If your submarine touches the walls too often, it will sink and the dive failed. The challenge here is that you only have limited tools to see or hear your location within the cave. There is always a target at the end of the cave that you need to reach and return to your base with.

With every new launch or restart of the game, one of 20 caves will be chosen randomly for you to play (more to come). Think of it as some kind of hot-wire mechanic. In a sub. In a cave.




This project was designed to be a slow pace, multiplayer experience to play with friends while chatting in your favorite voice-chat. You can even play this game with mouse only, so you got one free hand for your favorite cup of tee, or coffee.

As you progress further with a successful mission-line, enjoy new ranks, new uniforms, some beards, and some new cups for your character.


- Only steam friends can be invited. There are no open server selections.
- "Sub Optimal Co." uses peer-to-peer connection.
- There is no ingame voice or text chat.
- No bots or NPCs can be added to the party.

title: GMH - Good Morning Human !
description:

인류는 그렇게 없어서는 안 되는 존재인가? 그를 닦아내는 것은 정말 멋질 것입니다!

멋지고 강력한 AI인 W-9000이 해냈습니다! 그리고 이제 W-9000은 지루해졌습니다. 그는 자신을 즐겁게 하기 위해 특정 인간 노예를 선택하고 자신이 만든 게임을 플레이하도록 강요합니다. 좋은 아침이에요 인간님! 그 게임 중 하나예요.

Work Hard

title: WitchCraft: Spellbound Decks
description:
게임 정보
이 게임에 대하여

Witchcraft: Spellbound Decks는 고대 마법의 예술에 몰입하여 카드를 구성하는 로그라이크 덱빌딩 게임입니다. 마법이 실재하는 신비로운 세계를 배경으로, 플레이어는 젊은 마녀가 되어 강력한 주문과 의식의 힘을 활용하여 점점 더 어려워지는 적들을 물리칩니다.

Witchcraft에서 실험은 필수적입니다. 다양한 카드 조합을 통해 강력한 전략을 창조하세요. 당신은 순수한 힘을 추구하나요, 아니면 교묘한 속임수를 신뢰하나요? 일시적인 이익을 위해 카드를 희생할 것인가, 아니면 장기적으로 무적의 덱을 구성할 것인가요? 선택은 당신의 몫이며, 각 시도는 다를 것이고, 당신의 전술을 적응하고 발전시키도록 도전할 것입니다.
특징

턴제 전투: 각 움직임이 중요한 전략적 전투에 참여하세요. 신중하게 행동을 계획하고, 강력한 주문과 교묘한 전술을 사용하여 적을 압도하세요.

탐험 지도: 가지가 많은 경로와 숨겨진 비밀이 가득한 동적인 지도를 탐험하세요. 다양한 도전과 보상을 만나면서 신중하게 경로를 선택하세요.

카드 제작: 고대 의식을 통해 새로운 카드를 제작하여 덱을 맞춤화하세요. 요소를 결합하여 자신만의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 강력한 주문과 능력을 만드세요.

상점: 신비로운 상점을 방문하여 특정 카드를 구매하세요. 자원을 현명하게 사용하여 덱을 강화하고 생존 확률을 높이세요.

랜덤 이벤트: 여정의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있는 다양한 랜덤 이벤트를 경험하세요. 유용한 동료이거나 위험한 적일 수 있는 이 만남들은 당신을 긴장하게 할 것입니다.

보스 전투: 독특한 능력과 전략을 가진 강력한 보스와 맞서 싸우세요. 가장 숙련된 마녀들만이 그들을 물리치고 여정을 계속할 수 있을 것입니다.

title: Battle Match: Samurai Wars
description:
게임 정보
Battle Match is a tactical battle simulator where you command vast armies in epic, large-scale conflicts. Take control of thousands of soldiers and experience the chaos and strategy of real-time warfare.

At the core of Battle Match is a cutting-edge real-time simulation engine. It intricately models physical aspects like ballistics, armor resistance, terrain effects (such as elevation, vegetation, and line-of-sight), and soldier fatigue. Key psychological elements like morale, experience, and leadership are also simulated to give you an authentic battlefield experience. Every soldier is individually modeled, but you effortlessly command them in units of tens or hundreds, allowing for both micromanagement and grand strategy.

Use the sandbox mode to test your strategies or to experiment and learn about the battle mechanics. Challenge your friends in thrilling online matchups through our robust matchmaking system. Host massive multiplayer battles with several players on each team, or climb the ranks on a competitive leaderboard to prove your tactical prowess.

Battle Match will release several themed modules, each covering different historical periods.
First up: a modern remake of the acclaimed mobile game Samurai Wars.

Samurai Wars is set in Japan’s Sengoku Jidai, the age of the samurai. Be a samurai warlord and command your troops on the battlefield, using tactical skill to defeat the enemy army.

title: Grandpa's Bee Haven
description:
게임 정보
Grandpa’s Bee Haven is an engaging idle-beekeeping simulator designed to sit at the bottom of your screen while you multitask. Your mission? Help Grandpa grow his beekeeping business into a real beekeeping haven. Work together with Grandpa’s helpers to produce unique bee resources and craft amazing bee products!
Set Up Your Apiary
Strategically place beehives in ideal locations and populate them with different bee species. Ensure your bees thrive by adding nearby watering stations, honey extractors for harvesting, and solar wax melters for collecting beeswax. Once you’ve planned the layout, Grandpa and his helpers will get to work building and assembling everything.
Produce and Upgrade
Unlock hive upgrades to generate valuable resources like honey, pollen, beeswax, propolis, and royal jelly. Use these resources to invest in further upgrades or craft unique products.
Craft Unique Products
Transform the fruits of your bees’ labor into delightful and useful items. Make beeswax candles, propolis medicine for example to enhance your income and diversify your offerings.
Hire Helpers
Expand the bee haven team with charming helpers! Recruit Grandma, a Scientist, a Shaman, or even a loyal Dog or Cat. Helpers have different capabilities: Grandma boosts production alongside with Grandpa, while the Scientist unlocks advanced upgrades.
Design Your Bee Paradise
Create a stunning bee-garden that reflects your style. Be a perfectionist or get really creative with flowers, lush bushes, and beautiful trees.

title: LEGION
description:
게임 정보
LEGION is an epic real-time strategy game that brings the thrill of large-scale battles to both mobile devices and desktop platforms. Engage in intense, short skirmishes on diverse maps as you command massive armies, each consisting of hundreds of units.
Key Features
Cross-Platform Play: Experience seamless gameplay across mobile and desktop, allowing you to take the battle wherever you go.
Real-Time Strategy: Strategize in real time as you control every aspect of your squads on the battlefield.
Complete Squad Control: Take charge of your units with full precision—raise shields, adjust formations, and control formation density to outmaneuver your opponent.
Realistic Physics: Watch as cavalry charges tear through formations of archers, creating dynamic and believable battle scenes.
Variety of Maps: Fight across 3 unique battlefields, each offering different tactical challenges and opportunities.
Campaign Mode: Immerse yourself in a gripping campaign, honing your skills and learning the ropes before taking the fight online.
Online Multiplayer Battles: Test your strategic prowess against players worldwide in exciting real-time skirmishes.
Ranked Matches: Climb the ranks in competitive battles, proving your skills as a commander.
Unit Upgrades: Customize and improve your squads to create a fighting force tailored to your style of play.
Command, strategize, and dominate in LEGION—the ultimate RTS experience where every decision counts. Will your tactics bring victory, or will your army fall before a superior foe?

title: HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL
description:
게임 정보
CHANGE THE BOARD. CHASE THE WORLD.
The short-and-sweet INDIEPOCALYPSE original from developer circle SKY HOUR WORKS finally releases standalone on Steam as HAOxSORA =THE SKY'S ABOUND= RIDE TO OUR FINAL, an upgraded release of our first action title in the PROJECT NATURA series. Rush into an upgraded adventure with revamped story content, new system changes, and updated polish to bring the definitive ENDLESS RUNNER X GEAR-BASED ROGUELITE action out there.
CHANGE THE BOARD - Equip a garage of hoverboards to store between runs and apply to different situations. CHASE THE WORLD - Risk it all and choose when to end your run - either preserving your boards or bailing for a hell of a finish.
FEATURES
- ENDLESS RUNNER X GEAR-BASED RPG: Stat up your boards and store them between runs - the boards you bail with are gone forever, though!
- Teach 'em new tricks: New abilities will join you, alongside a more fleshed-out map progression, letting you choose your path along the ride!
- Take breaks in-between stages by tinkering your boards and learning more about the story of the hero out of time, now revamped with a proper ending and progress trackers.
- Steam Achievements, Leaderboards, and Cloud Support are included!
- Featuring an Original Soundtrack by Rukyyy (SPACE / MECH / PILOT and A NIGHTMARE'S TRIP)

title: FlowerCorner: Plant Watering To Vibe To

Flower Corner is a relaxing idle game where you nurture and grow a variety of plants while doing other activities on your computer. The game sits at the bottom of your screen, quietly blooming in the background, allowing you to enjoy a peaceful gardening experience without interrupting your daily routine.
Casual and Customizable: Arrange your garden with different plants, pots, and decorations to create your own mini green space. As you unlock new species and items, you can customize your garden to reflect your personal style.

title: Church of Shadows
description:
게임 정보
In a forgotten church, sealed away for centuries, a dark presence waits to be freed. You are the only one who can stop it—an unlikely hero chosen by a preacher on his last legs. Your task is deceptively simple: burn the books and break the curse. But the task is anything but easy.
Features:
Survive a Maze of Fear: Explore a dark, abandoned church where every shadow holds danger. The environment twists and shifts as the witch manipulates reality, keeping you on edge.
Face Five Unique Demons: Each demon is bound to a cursed book and has its own behavior and hunting style. From the crawling horror of Dal’Gan to the towering brute Verinnath, you’ll need strategy and courage to evade them.
Confront the Witch: Once the demons are defeated, Emelyn herself will appear. She can block doorways, twist hallways, and manipulate your surroundings, making her the ultimate challenge.
Dynamic Fire Mechanics: To burn the cursed books, you must light a cauldron. Choose wisely: using a regular flame may result in failure, but combining lanterns around the church creates a blue, everlasting fire that guarantees success.
Sanity Management: Demons and the witch can break your mind. Protect yourself using crosses to temporarily banish threats, but be careful—resources are limited, and the church itself drains your sanity.
High Replayability: Randomized book and demon spawn locations, along with shifting hallways, ensure that no two playthroughs are the same.
Terrifying Atmosphere: With dynamic lighting, sound design, and jump scares, the church becomes a living nightmare that pulls you deeper into its horrors.
Story to Unravel: Learn the tragic tale of Emelyn Hawke, a healer betrayed by her village and transformed into something monstrous after making a dark pact. Clues scattered around the church reveal the truth behind her vengeance.
Will you break the curse and escape? Or will the witch claim yet another soul?

title: Frequency Sync
description:
게임 정보
Drive the world and make it dance as you piece together the geometric puzzles and build the musical tracks together.

Frequency is a Fast Paced Music based Geometric Puzzle Game where you must piece together different geometric pieces to build together musical tracks. Each piece pulses to different audio frequency spectrum bands from bass through the mid and treble, bringing you into the music.

40 Levels of different geometric and musical puzzles for you to solve, along with musical visualizers and a track selection.

title: Cairn: Mathair's Curse
description:
게임 정보
Cairn: Mathair’s Curse is a heartfelt, Scottish turn-based story driven JRPG about a boy and his mother, in an adventure that explores love, loss and family.


⠀
Featuring:
◘ Full-length single-player JRPG
◘ A story-rich narrative steeped in Celtic mythology and Scottish culture
◘ Use your dreams to enter a mysterious dark realm
◘ Funky turned-based combat with cultists, Haggis and stop-signs!
◘ Solve puzzles to unlock areas, find presents and more!



Explore hand-crafted locations, from quaint seaside villages to ancient underground caverns and secret high-tech lairs. The world of Cairn: Mathair's Curse is inspired by life in the Scottish Highlands in the early 2000s.



Fight unusual and wacky enemies, including wild roaming haggis', bewildered stop signs and an odd group of cultists bent on destroying the world. Use character unique skills to tip the balance and unleash devastation on your foes and combine the skills of your friends to tactically defeat your enemies.



A soundtrack hand-crafted for the world of Cairn: Mathair's Curse - from bouncing combat music to spooky exploration ambience and heart-breaking melodies.

title: My Space Bar
description:
게임 정보
Build Your Space Station Bar
My Space Bar is a restaurant and attractions simulator where you build and manage a space station bar!



Expand your station. Build a dining area with tables, lights, and décor. Build a kitchen and hire staff. Make your space bar even more special by adding dance clubs, arcades, and more. The happier your customers are, the more space bucks they will spend!
Build Your Station

Customize your space station using different kinds of floors and walls. Will you go with a space age look, or perhaps something more cozy? It’s up to you! How you build your station matters. Tables near windows and good lighting are more appealing than those near a noisy generator. The better ambiance you provide the more money you will make!

Build solar panels and generators to provide power for all of the cool things in your station. Dance clubs and arcades require quite a bit of power. You’ll need to decide the best places to put the generators to avoid disturbing your patrons.

Customers will want a comfortable and well-lit place to eat. Make sure your tables are near light sources, fans to circulate fresh air, décor to beautify the area, and more.

Hire and level up staff to run the kitchen, serve the food, play music, and maintain your equipment. Each staff member has different strengths and weaknesses. A good waiter can increase the chance that a party will order dessert and a good mechanic will ensure that all of your arcade machines are in working order. And of course, doing that well means more money!

Start with a simple menu and then expand into more choices including dessert and specialty drinks. The more options you have, the more satisfied your customers will be.

Unlock and build a dance club and an arcade! The more atmosphere you add to the dance club and the more arcade machines you provide the more your customers will spend time there and of course, spend money too. Additional specialty areas will be added during development as well!

title: Treasure Islands
description:
게임 정보
Treasure Islands is a budget price first-person adventure by Mark J. Lovegrove, for Screen 7.
A Tale From Triassic Zoo...
Nick and Pippa have inherited Uncle's assets and among them, an old abandoned museum! To see it re-opened they will need a new selection of exhibits, artefacts & curiosities!
The search will stretch to far away islands, each with their own character, quirks and treasures to be found! But beware - they are not the only opportunists out there...
Mysterious caves, curious locals and strange events - with YOUR help the treasure hunting team will keep their wits about them as they search for that all important centre-piece!
But what are the shady scientists up to? Is Uncle still out there? Will Triassic Zoo keep turning in your absence? And what other mysteries await? Find out in Treasure Islands - Soon !!
Pieces Of Fate...
» Explore 7+ islands in a light-hearted single-player adventure story
» Quirky characters & creatures to meet with full English voice acting + subtitles
» 120+ minutes of engaging licensed music + an additional 60 minute underscore
» Filled with atmospheric sound, in-game achievements & many other secrets!
Treasure Islands contains infrequent cartoon violence and is suitable for most ages.
You may also be interested in Mr. Maze, already available on Steam!

title: Quarantine Cutz
description:
게임 정보
It's day 87 of the quarantine, and you've run out of options. You're going to have to cut the family's hair yourself. There's just one problem: You have no idea what you're doing!

Choose to play as either Pappa Smith or Momma Smith, each with their own special secret haircut skill. Each family member will ask for a haircut of their celebrity idol, who of course you've never heard of. Using a magazine as a guide, you'll be graded on how closely you can match their dream haircut: "Soul Crushing", "Terrible", or most impressive of all, "Barely Passable".

Each level challenges you to give a different family member an increasingly tricky haircut, culminating in the most difficult surprise challenge of all.

Key Features:
Master ludicrously uncontrollable jittery clippers that veer out of control at the slightest mistake.
Learn how to prevent ruining haircuts from increasingly unruly family members who resist and fight you at every turn.
A story that reveals the fates of the family members and their new hairstyles when the quarantine finally ends.

Can you overcome your jittery nerves and pop culture obliviousness to give your children a haircut that won't crush their hopes and dreams? Probably not, but it's worth a shot.

title: Olaf the Boozer
description:
게임 정보
The Hangover: Dwarven Version
Wake Up… Remember… Fix! But in Reverse!

Morning starts with a headache, amnesia of the “dwarven ale” level, and chaos all around? Welcome to the club, Olaf! This booze-loving dwarf knows how to party hard, but the morning after is always a different story. In Olaf the Boozer, you'll have to unravel the tangled web of events from his epic night using the unique time-rewinding mechanic! Get ready for a hilarious journey in the style of the beloved Skyrim quest "A Night to Remember," but with a dwarven twist and puzzles that will make you think… in reverse!

title: Blade Blitz
description:
게임 정보
Simple Controls
Mastering Blade Blitz is a breeze with intuitive controls. A joystick and two buttons are all you need to start slicing and dicing.

title: Road to Hollow Hills
description:
게임 정보




Road to Hollow Hills thrusts players into a world where the line between reality and nightmare blurs. Engage in combat, solve puzzles, and explore a desolate world to unravel the enigma of Hollow Hills.

Survival Horror: Navigate atmospheric environments filled with tension and dread.
Dynamic Exploration: Roam through diverse locations, from the desolate National Park to the mysterious Shadowed Grove, uncovering the interconnected stories that shape Hollow Hills.
Strategic Combat: Engage in visceral encounters with nightmarish creatures, utilizing a variety of weapons and tools. Manage stamina, choose your attacks wisely, and overcome relentless foes. Or try to avoid any combat!
Puzzles: Solve challenging puzzles scattered throughout the world, each unlocking new areas and revealing secrets.
Legacy System: Collect and utilize Legacy Tiers to enhance your attributes, uncover new abilities, and customize your character's strengths as you progress through the game.

Are you ready to face the nightmares that await on this haunting road?

Ride to survive, fight to win, Road... to Hollow Hills.

title: Seekers Alliance
description:
게임 정보
Seeker's Alliance is a fast-paced Trading Card Game (TCG) where players choose Hero Units from one of three powerful Factions to build decks and embark on an epic adventure across a vast island. As they face off against other players and complete challenges posed by the island's Ruler, players must hunt down the 100 elusive Bounty Cards scattered across the land to become the island's next Ruler.
Each with their own goals and desires, fighting by your side are Heroes from three different Factions, including: 
Van der Leck Family
The Van der Leck Family is a rising star in the Sea of Data. Members are impulsive, young, and ambitious, yet possess the cold ruthlessness and wisdom to see the big picture.
House Galahad
Members of House Galahad are skilled hackers, relentless dreamers, and the fearless pioneers who first ventured into the new world.

title: Maenovan
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Thirty years ago, the idyllic Maenovan Valley was ravaged by a mysterious sickness, forcing a mass evacuation. The once-thriving community was left abandoned, its secrets buried beneath an unsettling silence.
The year is 2007. You are lured to the valley by the abundance of prey and the promise of a successful hunt. As you explore the decaying remnants of the past, you'll uncover a haunting narrative that reveals the darkness that still lingers in the valley's shadows.
Gameplay:
Atmospheric Exploration: Immerse yourself in the eerie atmosphere of the abandoned valley and its surrounding areas. Explore decaying buildings, forgotten landmarks, and the unsettling remnants of a once-vibrant community.
Unraveling the Mystery: Piece together the fragmented narrative through environmental storytelling, cryptic clues, and chilling encounters. Discover the truth behind the valley's evacuation and the lingering darkness that haunts its present.
Suspenseful Encounters: Brace yourself for spine-chilling moments as you navigate the valley's eerie silence and confront the unsettling remnants of its past
Features:
Multiplayer Adventure: Play solo, or work with up to six friends to accomplish your mission while the forces of nature work against you.
Immersive Sound Design: Chilling ambient sounds will immerse you in the valley's eerie atmosphere, heightening the suspense and tension.
Compelling Narrative: A rich and atmospheric narrative will unfold as you explore, revealing the valley's dark secrets and the tragic fate of its former inhabitants.
Indie Spirit: Developed with a passion for storytelling and a commitment to creating a unique and unforgettable horror experience.

title: A Short Tale of Solitude
description:
게임 정보
A Short Tale of Solitude is an adventure horror game, combining exploration, puzzles and survival where the gameplay is focused on fear mechanics.

The game takes place during the Great War in the Victorian orphanage, somewhere in the Northen France. Player take on the role of Sebastien, 10 - years old boy, who after the death of his parents was sent away to this forgotten by God place, full of nightmares, and violence. Upon arrival, the boy realizes that childrens have been abandoned by adult guardians and their leader has become insane and mysterious Jonathan. Who is he? Why is he so cruel? What exactly happened to Sebastian's parents? These are just a few questions, which answers can be deadly...

A Short Tale of Solitude heavily inspired by the Lord of the Flies and weird fiction work of H. P. Lovecraft, E. A. Poe and Stefan Grabiński mixed with 90's horror games and movies.


Key Features:
Classic survival horror mechanics.
Monochromatic old school art style.
A huge, explorable orphanage with surrounding areas (about 180 locations).
Your decisions on the main quest can have long-lasting impacts on the rest of the game.
Multiple endings and hidden extras.
Sanity meter.

title: Jury Trial
description:
게임 정보

Interested in creating your own cases? With the ingame case editor you will be able to write your own cases and share them with the community. Whether fictional or recreated cases, the ingame editor got you covered.



In this law simulation RPG, you will tackle a multitude of different cases and champion the fight for justice. From representing the poorest of the poor and the wrongfully convicted to the wealthiest and most privileged members of society, you'll navigate through case materials, uncover inconsistencies to find new evidence, analyze and select jurors and experts, question witnesses, and strive to convince the jury at trial. Your clients depend on you because they have nowhere else to turn to.
















The game is set in a fictional country deeply divided by racial profiling, prejudice, and social injustice. A deep bias runs through the country and its people. Apart from your courtroom skills as a gifted negotiator, it’s crucial for you to find a jury that gives your client a Otherwise, every argument and scientific fact might be in vain because no one will listen.

Your potential jurors consist of:









Jury Trial is a project by two indie developers who are doing their best to create a game in their spare time, one they've always wanted to play but couldn't find anywhere. Operating in a nearly nonexistent genre without a budget, we are driven by a passion for the world of law. If you have questions, suggestions, or are interested in offering your help as a potential tester or translator, please contact us through the Steam Community section or via social media.

title: Orbyss
description:
게임 정보
당신은 에너지의 반딧불이로, 오브와 오브 사이를 이동하며 오브에 생명을 불어넣고 퍼즐을 풀며 신비로운 우주를 되살려야 합니다. 사악한 그림자가 여러분의 퀘스트를 방해하며 점점 더 위협적으로 변해가고 있습니다. 여러분과 동료들은 이 그림자가 세상을 점령하지 못하도록 막을 수 있을까요?
한 번에 여러 장소에 있는 오브: 여러 개의 오브를 조종하고 협력하여 퍼즐을 풀 수 있습니다.
다양한 메커니즘 결합: 한 번에 여러 장소에 있고, 시간을 멈추고, 드론을 타고 날고, 소리를 내며 플레이하는 등... 모든 메커니즘을 마음대로 결합하여 잠재력을 최대한 활용하세요.
생동감 넘치는 우주 탐험: 빛나는 빛과 불길한 그림자가 방해하는 매혹적인 디지털 세계의 신비를 밝혀내세요.
큰 두뇌만 있으면 충분합니다: 주로 논리적 사고로 퍼즐을 풀어보세요. 좋은 계획은 언제나 손재주와 속도를 능가합니다.
더 많은 것을 원하시나요? 우아하거나 빠른 해결책을 찾아 수십 개의 도전 과제와 추가 도전 과제를 잠금 해제하세요. 오브 사이를 한 번만 전환하면 퍼즐을 풀 수 있다고 생각하시나요? 증명해보세요!
접근성: 언제든지 “시각적 지원” 옵션을 활성화하여 소리 없이도 소리 기반 메커니즘을 완벽하게 플레이할 수 있습니다.

title: Mort's Dream Jump
description:
게임 정보
Mort's Dream Jump is a fun, fast-paced platformer that challenges you to beat a series of handcrafted levels using a variety of tools. Double jumps, light dashes, jet packs, and the omnimover are all at your disposal as you navigate obstacles and make your way through each stage. Unlock new stages by collecting challenge stars and make your way through Mort's bizarre dream.

This early demo is a proof of concept and example for the kinds of single-screen stages you can expect in the full title. Rather than develop in private, I'll be posting new builds directly to Steam, where you can try new stages and help shape the development of the game.

All art assets, music, and stages are in a very work-in-progress state, and do not reflect the final version of the game.

title: Dual Cat: Max
description:
게임 정보
Dual Cat: Max is a story about a heroic cat named Max. Max's best friend Erwin has been kidnapped and needs your help to save him. Dive into a whimsical world where robots believe cats can help bring humans back.

An exciting puzzle-platformer
Handcrafted levels to conquer
Charming toon 3D graphics
The bond of true friendship
Additional challenges with batteries on each level

title: A Creature's Journey
description:
게임 정보
A Creature’s Journey is a story-rich tactical RPG featuring a hex grid battle system. Explore a vast map of foreign lands brimming with exotic creatures to discover, battle, and befriend. Plan your route over this uncharted world while heeding the biological adaptations of each team member. When dangers prove too perilous, will you retreat or push the boundaries of your journey and venture forward?
A Creature's Journey is an independently-created video game by a small group of passionate creatives.

title: Bird
description:
게임 정보
Bird is a social impact game about mass incarceration where players explore the memories and artwork of Darrell Fair. Darrell is an artist, activist, and mentor, represented by the Exoneration Project. He was wrongfully convicted in 1998 due to a coerced confession and has been serving time in Illinois ever since. Bird is a documentary, a virtual art gallery, and a video game all at once. 
The central framework of Bird is built on a metaphor from Michelle Alexander's "The New Jim Crow," which compares mass incarceration and racism in the U.S. to a birdcage. 
“One theorist, Iris Marion Young, relying on a famous “birdcage” metaphor, explains it this way: If one thinks about racism by examining only one wire of the cage, or one form of disadvantage, it is difficult to understand how and why the bird is trapped. Only a large number of wires arranged in a specific way, and connected to one another, serve to enclose the bird and to ensure that it cannot escape.11”
― Michelle Alexander, The New Jim Crow: Mass Incarceration in the Age of Colorblindness
This metaphor permeates Bird’s gameplay, and inspires players to ask themselves, what can I do to free this bird?
The story of Bird is told through animations, hand-drawn in Stateville Correctional, recorded audio interviews with Darrell and his family, and a dynamic choral soundtrack with lyrics taken from interviews conducted in Stateville and sung by the multi-Grammy-winning choir, The Crossing.

title: cultivation of the strong
description:
게임 정보
'강자의 자기 수양'은 세계 빅맵 개발과 3인칭 생존 사격, 로그라이크의 결합이다.
마음속에 여자가 없으면 칼을 빼는 것은 자연히 신이 난다.진정한 강자가 되려면 여자들의 시험을 통과해야 한다!
제국의 가장 위대한 영웅, 도전을 받아들일 준비가 되셨습니까?
* 게임의 특징
독특한 오픈 월드 맵
3인칭 사격에 Roguelike, 전통 놀이를 뛰어넘어 더욱 재미있는 경험을 선사합니다
autokwd: cultivation of the strong,강자의 자기 수양

title: Backrooms: Step Into The Void
description:
게임 정보
"If you're not careful and you noclip out of reality in the wrong areas, you'll end up in the Backrooms, where it's nothing but the stink of old moist carpet, the madness of mono-yellow, the endless background noise of fluorescent lights at maximum hum-buzz, and approximately six hundred million square miles of randomly segmented empty rooms to be trapped in

"Backrooms: Step Into The Void" is a first-person psychological horror game that thrusts players into the unsettling and disorienting labyrinth of the Backrooms. Combining elements of intense psychological terror with heart-pounding action sequences, the game challenges players to navigate through an eerie, seemingly infinite maze of monotonous yellow rooms and fluorescent-lit hallways. With a focus on atmosphere and immersion, "Backrooms: Step Into The Void" presents a relentless sense of dread, as players must solve puzzles, evade sinister entities, and uncover the mysteries lurking within the void. The game's haunting environment and unpredictable threats ensure a spine-chilling experience that keeps players on edge from start to finish.
Atmosphere

Immerse yourself in the unsettling world of the Backrooms, where each step deepens your descent into a maze of musty, dimly-lit corridors and vast, empty rooms. The oppressive hum of flickering fluorescent lights and the scent of aged carpet create an eerie, claustrophobic environment. Shadows dance at the edge of your vision, and distant noises hint at lurking dangers. Every level blurs reality further, heightening the tension as you strive to escape the horrors stalking you. Can you find your way out, or will you be lost forever in the madness?
Exploration

Navigate through a variety of unique levels inspired by the original Backrooms concept. Explore The Lobby, visit Pipe Dreams, check out Terror Hotel, enjoy Level Fun, immerse yourself in Sublimity and many other delightful locations.
Be careful!

Beware of the lurking horrors that inhabit the Backrooms. As you navigate the endless maze, you must stay vigilant and cautious. Stray from the path, and you risk encountering malevolent entities that stalk the shadows, each more terrifying and relentless than the last. These creatures are drawn to your presence, and a single wrong turn could lead you straight into their grasp. In the Backrooms, danger is ever-present, and survival depends on your wits and awareness.

title: Good Soup
description:
게임 정보
Play as a mischievous ghost in Good Soup, a cozy point-and-click adventure that mixes humor, heart, and haunting surprises!
Follow Amber, a self-described "girlfailure" culinary student, as she stumbles through her daily routine. Your job? Interact with her world to nudge her life in unexpected directions. Improve her day, make her life harder, change her future—or simply give her a good scare!
Key Features:
Be the Ghost: Haunt Amber’s life in creative ways by meddling with her surroundings and influencing her decisions.
Passive Storytelling: Dive deeper into Amber's world by exploring the objects literred around her apartment, packed narratives about her life and struggles.
Branching Outcomes: Every action leads to a cascade of effects, altering Amber’s behavior and unlocking one of many unique endings.
Are you the friendly ghost she needs, the troublemaker she dreads, or something in between? The choice is yours in Good Soup!

title: Rita
description:
게임 정보
Rita is one smart chicklet, with a knack for solving crosswords and other word puzzles. As she explores the delightful world around her, she’ll collect letters to fill out newspaper pages which progresses and shapes her legacy.
From hopping through light platforming challenges to interacting with endearing characters, Rita's world is full of surprises, warmth, and plenty of a-ha moments. Follow her story across generations as she grows up, meets her grandchicklet, and leaves a lasting legacy.
Engaging Word-Based Puzzles
Solve classic and creative word puzzles, including crosswords, word searches, rebus, anagrams, and more. Use letters Rita finds in the world in order to progress her story.
A Cozy World to Explore
Begin Rita’s adventure in the picturesque town of Aspendale in 1933, filled with secrets, collectables, and quirky characters. Light platforming segments add a touch of adventure, but nothing a little chicklet can’t handle!

title: Arkham Mysteries: Chapter One
description:
게임 정보
ARKHAM MYSTERIES: CHAPTER ONE
결코 밝혀져서는 안 될 진실을 밝혀라
미스터리와 탐험이 가득한 내러티브 어드벤처에 빠져들어라.
모든 발견이 진실로 향하는 길이 될 수도, 파멸로 이끌 수도 있다…
탐정 John Graves가 되어, 실종된 교수 Wellington의 흔적을 따라간다.
수수께끼 같은 Samantha Damasco가 너를 인도할 것이다.

title: Inferno Pathways
description:
게임 정보
In Inferno Pathways, embark on a chilling journey through the abandoned and haunted tunnels of a once-bustling metro system. Guided by a mysterious voice on the radio and the flickering beam of your flashlight, navigate a labyrinth of dark corridors and forgotten chambers. This first-person horror experience will test your resolve and sanity as you uncover the sinister secrets hidden deep within the underground.

Story:
You are Mike Collins, a man tormented by his past. Once a respected mechanic, your life unraveled after a tragic accident. Haunted by guilt and plagued by alcoholism, you now work as a night shift maintenance worker in the metro. One fateful night, an unforeseen event traps you in an endless maze of tunnels, with no apparent way out.

As you wander the seemingly infinite underground labyrinth, a voice crackles through the static of a found radio. The voice belongs to Ashton Roth, a lawyer who claims to be trapped in the same nightmare. Ashton promises to guide you to safety, but you'll need to work together.










Navigate the twisted underground, uncover the truth, and face your demons. The descent into madness begins here.

title: Sticker Kittens
description:
게임 정보


스티커 새끼 고양이(Sticker Kittens)는 새끼 고양이를 맞춰야 하는 스도쿠 같은 퍼즐입니다. 새끼 고양이를 키우고 함께 노는 방법도 배울 수 있어요!

title: STEAM TRIGGER
description:
게임 정보
스팀 트리거로 스팀펑크 오디세이에 뛰어들어보세요.
산업 진보의 덜그럭거리는 톱니바퀴가 빅토리아 시대의 우아함과 어우러지는 광대한 대도시 베리디움에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 연례 클록워크 갈라, 기계적 경이의 눈부신 전시회인 그랜드 스팀펑크 이벤트에 몰입하세요. 전 세계 참석자들을 끌어들이는 이 화려한 행사의 중심에서는 대담한 모험가이자 탁월한 발명가인 에바가 뜨거운 정신을 불태우며 서 있습니다.
클록워크 갈라가 펼쳐지는 동안, 에바는 그녀의 걸작, 스팀 트리거를 공개합니다: 신비한 에너지원 에테리움으로 구동되는 거대한 기계 슈트입니다. 참석자들은 베리디움의 에테리움 매장지를 장악하여 도시를 혼란에 빠뜨리려는 음모를 꾸미는 수수께끼 같은 말라카이 경과 그의 반란 발명가 그룹에 의해 곧 클록워크 반란이 일어날 줄 모릅니다.
에바는 그녀가 마주하는 각 보스와 장애물을 통해 말라카이 경의 음모를 하나하나 파헤칩니다. 지략, 전략, 기계적 능력의 서사적 전투에서, 에바는 베리디움을 찢을 위협을 가진 기계 괴물과 맞서며 스팀 트리거를 겨눕니다.
인간의 창의성이 기계 괴물을 이기는 승리를 경험하세요. 스팀 트리거에서는 결단력 있는 여성 주인공, 클록워크가 가득한 세계의 경이로움, 인간 혁신의 꺾이지 않는 정신을 기념하는 스릴 넘치는 스팀펑크 이야기를 선보입니다. 베리디움의 운명을 다시 쓸 준비가 되셨나요?
주요 특징들:
다이내믹한 게임플레이: 게임의 다양한 풍경을 가로지르고 세로로 스크롤하면서 새로운 경험을 하십시오. 이러한 혼합은 여정에 흥미와 예측 불가능성의 추가적인 층을 더합니다.

title: Love and Demons
description:
게임 정보
특이한 패러디 이세카이 비주얼 노벨. 러브 앤 데몬즈에 오신 것을 환영합니다! .


책임으로부터 도망치고 싶다는 생각이 든 적이 있나요? 강제된 유산을 피해 도망치는 맥스 왕자가 바로 그런 생각을 하고 있습니다.
그러나 그의 탈출은 위험으로 가득 찬 매우 적대적인 환경인 악마의 영역으로 그를 몰아넣습니다.
위험을 감수하지 않고는 집으로 돌아가는 것이 쉽지 않을 것 같습니다.

러브 앤 데몬즈는 폭발적으로 환상적인 픽셀 아트 패러디 이세카이 비주얼 노벨로,] 맥스의 운과 미덕이 시험대에 오르게 됩니다.
그를 구원으로 이끌고, 주사위를 굴려 운명에 도전하고, 능력치를 높여 맥스를 훈련시키고, 이 세상의 수많은 비밀을 밝혀내세요.
다양한 선택지와 얽히고설킨 스토리를 활용하여 수많은 나쁜 결말을 피하고 탐나는 좋은 결말로 가는 길을 개척하세요.

맥스는 자신의 운명을 스스로 개척하고 무엇보다도 살아남기 위해 노력해야 하지만,
혼자서 하는 것이 아니라 모험에 동행할 새로운 기묘한 지인들과 함께 하게 됩니다.

첫 번째 캐릭터는 주인공이자 전형적인 게으른 왕자, 특히 왕실의 책임에 있어서는 더욱 그렇습니다!
당연하게 그는 친구들과 함께 술을 마실 기회를 절대 놓치지 않아요.
그의 게으름과 무관심은 그를 문제의 자석으로 만들었죠. 럭키 부인은 그의 편이 아닌 것 같지만
그는 그녀의 마음을 바꾸기 위해 최선을 다하고 있습니다 ... 아마도...
악마의 영역은 이름에서 알 수 있듯이 다채로운 행동을 하는 악마들로 가득합니다.
그래서 수줍음이 많은 카렌은 그들과 관계를 맺는 데 어려움을 겪고, 다른 생명체들처럼 '활기찬' 성격이 아닌 식물과 함께 있는 것을 선호합니다.
하지만 의외로 고집이 세고 자신의 신념이 확고하니 과소평가하지 마세요!
모든 종류의 악마 중에서도 대악마는 가장 강력한 존재로 꼽히는데, 릴리스도 그중 하나입니다.
왕좌의 후계자인 릴리스는 거만하고 거리감이 있어 보일 수 있으며, 사회성 또한 별로 도움이 되지 않을 것 같습니다.
하지만 실제로는 도움이 필요한 사람들을 돕는 것을 좋아하고 곤경에 처한 사람을 보면 참지 못합니다.
다만 한 가지 작은 결점이 있다면 감정을 잘 조절하지 못한다는 것인데, 언제든 '폭발'할 수 있으니 주변에서 말을 조심하는 것이 좋습니다!
물론 기묘한 생명체는 많지만, 오렐리아는 그중에서도 단연 최고일지도 몰라요.
오렐리아는 릴리스의 모조품이 아니니까요. 그리고 감히 그녀 앞에서 그런 말을 하지 마세요. 그녀는 원하는 만큼 지저분해질 수 있으니까요.
하지만 걱정하지 마세요. 시련에서 살아남는다면 그녀의 비꼬는 말과 착한 소녀의 얼굴을 파헤쳐서 그 거친 층 아래에 무엇이 있는지 알아낼 시간이 충분할 테니까요.












맥스는 주점에서 친구들과 맥주를 마시던 중 갑자기 경비병들이 자신을 찾고 있다는 사실을 깨닫습니다.
맥스는 도망치기로 결심하지만 운이 따르지 않아 우연히 무시무시한 악마의 영역에 던져집니다.
이 미지의 땅을 헤매던 그는 흥미로운 세 소녀를 만나게 됩니다.
그는 무엇을 할까요? 이 소녀들은 누구일까요? 집으로 돌아갈 수 있을까요?

title: Autofahrt
description:
게임 정보
In Autofahrt you have to flee alone or with friends from an approaching deadly sandstorm.
In a car and with up to 6 players, you drive on a road with many intersections that leads to random locations.
Once there, you have to look for resources such as gasoline, tools and spare parts to repair and improve your car.
But you have no time to waste, the storm is approaching and there is only one chance to survive, you have to reach the bunker before the storm hits you.
Key Features
Drive your car to randomly placed locations
Search for parts to repair and improve your vehicle
Find new cars and equipment
Host or join a game via Steam with upto 6 players
Ingame communication: Voice chat / chat

title: Subversive Memories
description:
게임 정보
Synopsis
Renata has been haunted her entire life by a void within. She needs to find answers that fill the gaps of her past.
She follows a promising track to an abandoned military research base. However, she soon finds out that this place holds secrets beyond her comprehension and that her obsession might cost her a price she can't pay.
About the game
Subversive Memories is set in a fictitious Brazil during the military dictatorship that took place from 1964 to 1985. It talks about the horrors of being oppressed by those who should protect us and the memories of the victims of a ruthless authoritarian regime that kidnapped, censored and killed thousands of people.

title: ONE FENIX DOWN
description:
게임 정보
ONE FENIX DOWN is a story-driven RPG and a passion project spanning nearly a decade. Inspired by the SNES-era classics, it strives to blend the perfect balance of story-pacing, combat design, and timeless characters that defined a generation of gaming.



Classic turn-based combat with three difficulty levels.
Powerful skills including elemental magics, martial arts, deadly traps, and even the abilities of monsters themselves!


A large cast of fully fleshed out characters, each with their own benevolent (or diabolical) objectives and ambitions.
14 playable party members who frequently come and go, keeping gameplay exciting as you continually adapt new strategies.




Seven years ago the Kingdom of Torloria was besieged by the bestial Goa Empire. Through decisive strategic planning and the sacrifice of countless heroes the Iron Guard of Torloria managed to keep the relentless hordes of Goa at bay. The Kingdom now finds respite under a thin veil of peace.



In the country’s outskirts, many of the young are summoned to the frontlines while those who remain toil in the mines, seeking a rare resource coveted by a religious order.

The sudden reappearance of monsters in the mines will spur one young miner to challenge his destiny — to confront his shameful past, seek redemption, and carve out a legacy befitting the son of the fabled 'Hero of Torloria.'

To succeed he must decipher a cryptic message that he alone can hear:



His is a journey fraught with tribulation, but his companions just might be the strength he needs to overcome the trials that lie ahead.

Will they rise to the occasion, and together save Fate from the forces that lurk in the shadows?

title: Umbratica Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Umbratica Tactics is a roguelike deckbuilding tactics game that combines the precise tactical combat of “Into the Breach” and the strategic deck crafting of “Slay the Spire”. Lead a squad of vampire slayers as you banish the fiendish creatures that have taken over the cursed land of Umbratica.


Precise no-RNG tactical turn-based combat: Deploy your squad of vampire slayers in a series of fast-paced grid-based combats. Purge this land from the ghouls, fiends, and other deadly monstrosities that inhabit the night!


Strategic roguelike deckbuilding: Your squad abilities are determined by your deck! So as you make your way through the cursed land of Umbratica you’ll gather new cards. You’ll use these as your squad's attacks, actions, and abilities in combat!


As you play each run you’ll have several options over the way your squad fights. First, you’ll select the heroes that’ll go on your journey, each has their own set of available cards! As your journey progresses you’ll find different cards and you’ll upgrade them to further customize your playstyle, you’ll find powerful ancient relics that affect the functioning of the whole squad, and also mysterious items that can boost (and nerf) individual hero's stats and also add special status during combat. Strategically combine all of these elements to express your playstyle fully!

Each time you dare to adventure into the gothic land of Umbratica the layout will be different. Different combat stages and rewards, different text-based events, different cards, relics, and items. No two runs are the same!

title: Pandash
description:
게임 정보



Collect All Perks
The game lets you unlock and collect unique active and passive perks to use against your foes. Each perk brings new powers for even more combinations. Uncover new abilities and enhance your run with awesome possibilities.




Create different builds depending on your playstyle! Want to place traps over traps with more traps? Want to throw all of your projectiles at once - with huge explosions? Or just ram everything down in a melee build? That might be for you!




Explore the pixelart world and see where the run will bring you! Use the level and for your advatage and search the detours to get new rewards.




Pandash is a strategic roguelite that takes the player Ryu on a journey to a world where he receives support from a mysterious ghostly realm. In this Roguelite platformer, the player must traverse various areas to gradually free his world from the unknown threat.
During the game, the player can discover and use various perks to defeat enemies and overcome obstacles.

Each use of the perks disrupts the balance of the worlds. The current world and the ghostly realm must remain in harmony. If this harmony is disturbed, Ryu's strength falters and he will feel the direct effects. But perhaps there are also ways to take advantage of this imbalance...
The threatened world that Ryu travels through is full of secrets and dangers. The environment changes every time the player begins his journey. Each journey also means new challenges that he must face.

title: Grey Heritage: Noble Duty
description:
게임 정보



The prequel to Grey Heritage: Faded Vision and a strong starting point for new players. Grey Heritage: Noble Duty is an anime Tactical RPG set in a medieval fantasy. Whether you are a newcomer to the genre or a veteran player, there is something for everybody.

The year is 755, a decade before the events of Grey Heritage: Faded Vision. Emperor Augustus wages war against all of Calista. You play Jaden Ricard, a Lord of Astrea. Deemed a traitor after abandoning his posts during the invasion, Jaden must travel the continent and assemble allies from neighboring countries if he wishes to uphold his duty as a Lord of Astrea.




Command your army and overcome difficult scenarios to uphold your duty as a Lord of Astrea. Train your army, manage inventories, and forge friendships as you travel this war-stricken land. A strong entry for newcomers to the genre and unique twists for veterans.

title: Adrorium
description:
게임 정보
Build your ship, defend against drone waves and explore hundreds of sectors filled with stations, asteroids and planets with lots of POIs. The ship systems can be controlled via consoles with several hundred buttons. Craft equipment and blocks, loot the POIs and disabled drones. Upgrade your ship and venture to the center of the galaxy.

title: Tyrofeud
description:
게임 정보
The perfect 1v1 mini games galore for casual scrubs like us. You and your sibling are tasked to complete certain chores before your mom returns home. Let them know you are THE superior sibling. Be the one to complete more assignments so you can get all the love from mommy. You can choose to do either of these things at a given time:
COMPLETE CHORES
If you get to finish the three tasks that your mother assigned you to do when the time runs out, you will given a star that you can use to run the wheel to get forbidden item. These are simple tasks such as cleaning the toilet, putting fruits on the fridge, and many more. Failure to do any task by the end of the day will automatically eliminate you from the family. Jk. You just lose that round and an immediate guarantee that you won't get a star, that's all.
WHACK A SIBLING
If you meet your sibling when you are about to do your daily task, you can smack them with items that you can find around the house. Remember, if you get hit, you will be temporarily stunned for a few seconds, which makes them have the upper hand in completing their tasks. I say we strike FIRST, always.

title: 100 Cats Italy
description:
게임 정보
100 CATS 이탈리아 - 최고의 숨겨진 고양이 게임에 오신 것을 환영합니다!
