title: Shadows of Midnight - They Watch Me Sleep
description:
게임 정보
"Shadows of Midnight – They Watch Me Sleep" is a narrative-driven horror experience featuring two unique and terrifying stories of ordinary people facing the unknown.
THE HOTEL
A man’s peaceful summer vacation on the Croatian coast takes a sinister turn when he checks into an old, shady hotel. Strange things start happening in his room—objects move on their own, shadows shift in the dim light, and above his bed, a gaping, unnatural hole looms. Something is watching.
THE FOREST CREATURE
In a quiet Eastern European village, a young boy grows up near the woods. Walking home from school one evening, an eerie sensation washes over him—something is wrong. As he looks toward the trees, he realizes he is not alone. Something is there. Something that has always been watching.
Key features:
VHS Aesthetic: Optional VHS shaders for a nostalgic '90s horror feel.
Low-poly graphics: A mix of PS1/PS2-era visuals with modern lighting techniques.
Multiple endings: Each chapter has multiple endings, depending on your choices
autokwd: Shadows of Midnight - They Watch Me Sleep

title: COCOBOY
description:
게임 정보
What is COCOBOY?
In an alternate history 2005, the forgotten 80's platformer COCOBOY has re-entered the public consciousness of a niche few.
Modify, brute force, and restore unused game mechanics using Modcarts, devices hacked together by tech-savvy fans. Discover clever combinations of mods in order to progress and even break level design in unexpected ways.

title: Study Arcade
description:
게임 정보
The Pomodoro Technique (25 minutes of intense focus followed by 5 minutes of rest) is extremely helpful for more productive studying and working, but let's be honest, we all get distracted pretty easily. My attempts to use the technique looked something like this: set a timer, timer goes off, start scrolling social media or playing a game designed to keep me on for as long as possible, get distracted, and never get back to work. The problem is that most entertainment is designed to monetize your time, the most important resource you have! This free tool helps you solve that problem. It's what I wish I had when I was in school (especially during college), and so I'm putting it out there for free.
When you open Study Arcade, you're presented with an extremely simple interface to set a timer and get going. Hit Start, leave it open in the background, and get to work. It'll alert you  automatically when it's time to take a break.
Come back after studying, hit Play, and it'll give you a random arcade minigame for you to play, giving you a break when you need one! I've made 5 minigames so far, from block-breaking to retro shooter. Crucially, though, it only lets you play after you've already been productive, and all of the games are designed to give you a quick brain break and then help you get back to work. Study more to get a chance to play all of them and try to beat the highscore. Escape the doomscrolling, get stuff done, and most importantly, have fun while doing it. Simple as that!

title: Necromancy  Homies
description:
게임 정보
The story is set in Zhitebsk, a city of contrast, where the commonplace, down-to-earth Central Russian town meets the mystical and the metaphysical, and where the ridiculous meets the horrendous.
An unnamed mob in the 1990s is mourning over their boss’ death. They are in great sorrow, not sure what should they do now without him. However, a necromancer for the establishment and an old acquaintance of theirs, Mr.Besolyubov, doesn’t seem to accept that. He offers to do his job and bring the boss back from the dead, but the mob would have to help.
… That’s where the utter nightmare and the incredulous parade of surreal idiocy begin in the funerary train.
▷ Loads of humor of all sorts
▷ That one absurdist 90s dark comedic movie atmosphere
▷ Shocking plot twists
▷ Vivid, expressive grunge visuals
▷ Nostalgic point-n-click gameplay elements
▷ Your choices affect the story
▷ A trap music score

title: Bunker Constructor Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Contracts
Fulfill contracts from the citizens of the city. Each contract is unique and requires careful consideration of all customer requirements. More complex orders bring more money. Make the client satisfied by fulfilling even the smallest wishes to receive all money earned and even a bonus.
 Construction
Build real underground bunkers that will allow to survive in the most terrible apocalypse. Each bunker must be placed at a particular depth to provide its residents with full protection. Show all your imagination and creativity – build multi-level complex bunkers.
 Building Materials
Buy the necessary building materials in various stores – construction, furniture, electronics store, and transport them to the construction site by your own car or pay for the delivery. All remaining materials can be sold or used in the next contract.
 Underground Bunkers
Build real protected underground bunkers. First, dig the shaft to the required depth. Arrange a convenient descent – build a ladder. Dig out a sufficient volume for constructing bunker. Build capital reinforced concrete floors, walls and ceilings to ensure the strength of the bunker. Build interior walls to organize different rooms and start arranging furniture.
 Interior
To be comfortable in the bunker, it must be furnished with comfortable and practical furniture. Each customer has their own preferences and requirements in interior design. Organize bedrooms, kitchens, workrooms, home theaters, gyms and other spaces.
 Licenses

title: Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side
description:
게임 정보
Tsurine is a PsySpec wrapped up in the intensity of her job, and the stress that comes with dissociative amnesia. One night, a mysterious woman offers to help recover her lost memories. All Tsurine must do in exchange is hunt down the missing fragments to an unusual key.
Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side is an intricate choice-heavy psychological medicore thriller about an amnesiac facing both real and mental horrors within a world akin to an endless, liminal hospital. 
The game utilizes a fusion of Visual Novel, RPG, and Point-&-Click mechanics to paint a story about how people choose to cope with trauma, and the way it shapes one's identity. While the main story of Ad Nauseam is firm, it features hundreds of branching paths, choices, and open exploration areas to engage in along the way. Every action you take, and every choice you make, is remembered and seen through to its very end.
Uncover the secrets of this strange world, and the ones lurking within Tsurine's forgotten past. Will you accept your limitations when faced with peril, or will you dive deep into delusion and madness for a chance at hope?
Can you face the world? Can you face yourself?
Are you sure?
The world of Ad Nauseam is heavily inspired by the works and the aesthetics of Yami Kawaii, Liminality, Traumacore, and both Modern & Pastel Goth. It features a long, diverse, and dark soundtrack done by lolratz combining elements of Breakcore, Hyperpop, and Witch House music genres.
Character Artist: @Catfan1000
Background & Soundtrack Artist: @lolratz

title: Project Thea
description:
게임 정보
 A dark turn-based strategy-survival RPG blending retro-futuristic urban fantasy with Slavic folklore. Customise your characters’ gender, class, and race, and recruit NPC allies to explore the wastelands, rebuild your colony, and engage in tactical card-based combat. Featuring branching narratives, character progression, and co-op for 2 players, every choice shapes your survival and the fate of humanity in this story-rich roguelite adventure.

title: Koko's Cafe
description:
게임 정보
게임 소개
이 성장 비주얼 노벨에서 커피를 서빙하고 손님들과 친구가 되어 그들의 이야기를 알아가 보세요.

title: HackOS
description:
게임 정보
HackOS – Dive into the Ultimate Hacking Sandbox
HackOS is the definitive hacking sandbox you've been waiting for. Immerse yourself in a world of virtual espionage, ethical dilemmas, and high-stakes strategy, all from the comfort of your terminal. Inspired by classic hacking games and refined for modern players, HackOS combines the depth of simulation with the excitement of arcade gameplay.
Key Features:
Authentic Hacking Experience: Utilize realistic commands, crack ports, infiltrate networks, and uncover secrets hidden in the shadows of the digital world.
Dynamic Sandbox: Explore an ever-evolving ecosystem influenced by your decisions. From the dark web marketplace to the global stock exchange, your actions shape the virtual landscape.
Story-Driven Campaign: Join factions, complete missions, and unravel the mysteries of Node Zero, a shadowy organization with its own agenda.
Advanced Modding Tools: Create your own missions, events, and scenarios with the intuitive HackOS Editor, inspired by node-based systems like Unreal's Blueprints.
Diverse Gameplay Systems: Manage your reputation, cooperate with factions, invest in the stock market, or trade cryptocurrencies. Every choice has consequences.
No Microtransactions, Ever: Enjoy the full game for a single, fair price.
Whether you’re a seasoned hacker or new to the genre, Hack OS offers an unparalleled hacking experience that will test your skills, your strategies, and your morality.
Are you ready to log in?

title: The Spirit Engine DX
description:
게임 정보
The Spirit Engine DX is a complete remake of the original 2D, sidescrolling real-time (with pausing) RPG from 2003 by Mark Pay. While the game was written as an experimental reaction to 16-bit console RPGs of the late 90s, the gameplay is very desktop-oriented.

title: Gears of Glory
description:
게임 정보
In this Tower Defense game, inspired by classics like Bloons and Kingdom Rush, we introduce a new twist – the ability to move your towers around the map using a van called the "Gear Machine."
The idea is simple: defend your base against an invasion of over 12 different types of robots. This will require some heavy firepower, as these robots are built with advanced materials. To fight back, humanity has developed a series of towers designed to take on this challenge.

And that’s where your mission begins! Choose from over 10 different types of towers to find the best way to destroy all the robots. But it won’t be easy – you'll have limited resources to buy towers, move them, and unlock new areas to place them. Each map also brings its own unique challenges!

title: BroomSweeper
description:
게임 정보
It’s the night shift at your new job as janitor at megacorp TentaTeq, Inc.’s giant headquarters. All alone with hundreds of offices full of dust to sweep… or so you’ve been told. Strange sounds emanate from nearby rooms, dust bunnies spring to life, and suddenly you find yourself fighting to clear the tiles and survive with your newfound employment intact.
Classic Minesweeper With a Twist
Clickable floor tiles can be swept clean, or conceal an angry dust bunny to avoid. Place caution signs and tread carefully using classic Minesweeper strategies—but watch out! Tiles and numbers may not be as they seem as hazardous materials emerge throughout the night! Characters with unique play styles and 20 ascension levels ensure you can customize your experience.
Ludicrous Item Combinations
Stop by a vending machine to restock your janitor cart with items to help you combat the forces lurking in TentaTeq’s maze of cubicles. Defeat bosses to earn powerful keys that grant you new abilities that upend the way you solve puzzles. Discover limitless wacky combinations as you search for the synergy you need to avoid getting fired!

title: Super Citycon
description:
게임 정보
Super Citycon은 건설, 창조, 전략을 사랑하는 플레이어를 위해 설계된 레트로 스타일의 도시 건설 게임입니다. 16비트 시대의 클래식 도시 건설 게임을 연상시키는 친숙하고 향수를 불러일으키는 비주얼 스타일로, 3D 그래픽과 현대적인 조작 방식으로 새롭게 재구성되었습니다. Super Citycon은 모든 도시 건설 게임 팬들에게 매력적이고 몰입감 넘치는 플레이 경험을 제공합니다.
주요 특징:
• 거대한 맵 & 무한한 창의성: 특수 제작된 지형 시스템을 활용하여 넓고 방대한 도시를 건설하세요. 창의적인 플레이어들에게 완벽한 환경을 제공합니다.
• 다양한 게임 모드: 샌드박스 모드에서 자유롭게 창작하고, 맵 크리에이터를 사용하여 맞춤형 맵을 디자인하며, 타이쿤 퍼즐 모드에서 전략적으로 건물을 배치해 보너스를 얻고 인구를 최대화하세요.
• Super Citycon Unlimited: 모바일 버전과 달리, 이 PC 버전은 프리미엄 경험을 제공합니다. 인앱 결제, 광고, 유료 벽 없이, 처음부터 끝까지 순수한 도시 건설의 즐거움을 누리세요.
• 전략적 깊이: 건물 배치 퍼즐을 풀어 보너스를 최적화하고 도시의 잠재력을 최대한 활용하세요.
레트로 도시 건설 게임의 팬이거나, 보컬 아트를 좋아하거나, 도전적인 전략 퍼즐을 즐기는 플레이어라면 Super Citycon이 딱 맞는 게임입니다!
지금 바로 위시리스트에 추가하세요!
꿈의 도시를 처음으로 건설할 기회를 잡고, 이 여정에 함께하세요!
커뮤니티에 참여하세요!
개발 진행 상황을 확인하고, 아이디어를 공유하며, Super Citycon Unlimited의 미래를 직접 만들어 보세요.
지금 팔로우하고 출시와 함께 즐길 준비를 하세요!

description:
게임 정보
Umbratica Tactics is a roguelike deckbuilding tactics game that combines the precise tactical combat of “Into the Breach” and the strategic deck crafting of “Slay the Spire”. Lead a squad of vampire slayers as you banish the fiendish creatures that have taken over the cursed land of Umbratica.


Precise no-RNG tactical turn-based combat: Deploy your squad of vampire slayers in a series of fast-paced grid-based combats. Purge this land from the ghouls, fiends, and other deadly monstrosities that inhabit the night!


Strategic roguelike deckbuilding: Your squad abilities are determined by your deck! So as you make your way through the cursed land of Umbratica you’ll gather new cards. You’ll use these as your squad's attacks, actions, and abilities in combat!


As you play each run you’ll have several options over the way your squad fights. First, you’ll select the heroes that’ll go on your journey, each has their own set of available cards! As your journey progresses you’ll find different cards and you’ll upgrade them to further customize your playstyle, you’ll find powerful ancient relics that affect the functioning of the whole squad, and also mysterious items that can boost (and nerf) individual hero's stats and also add special status during combat. Strategically combine all of these elements to express your playstyle fully!

Each time you dare to adventure into the gothic land of Umbratica the layout will be different. Different combat stages and rewards, different text-based events, different cards, relics, and items. No two runs are the same!

title: Pandash
description:
게임 정보



Collect All Perks
The game lets you unlock and collect unique active and passive perks to use against your foes. Each perk brings new powers for even more combinations. Uncover new abilities and enhance your run with awesome possibilities.




Create different builds depending on your playstyle! Want to place traps over traps with more traps? Want to throw all of your projectiles at once - with huge explosions? Or just ram everything down in a melee build? That might be for you!




Explore the pixelart world and see where the run will bring you! Use the level and for your advatage and search the detours to get new rewards.




Pandash is a strategic roguelite that takes the player Ryu on a journey to a world where he receives support from a mysterious ghostly realm. In this Roguelite platformer, the player must traverse various areas to gradually free his world from the unknown threat.
During the game, the player can discover and use various perks to defeat enemies and overcome obstacles.

Each use of the perks disrupts the balance of the worlds. The current world and the ghostly realm must remain in harmony. If this harmony is disturbed, Ryu's strength falters and he will feel the direct effects. But perhaps there are also ways to take advantage of this imbalance...
The threatened world that Ryu travels through is full of secrets and dangers. The environment changes every time the player begins his journey. Each journey also means new challenges that he must face.

title: Grey Heritage: Noble Duty
description:
게임 정보



The prequel to Grey Heritage: Faded Vision and a strong starting point for new players. Grey Heritage: Noble Duty is an anime Tactical RPG set in a medieval fantasy. Whether you are a newcomer to the genre or a veteran player, there is something for everybody.

The year is 755, a decade before the events of Grey Heritage: Faded Vision. Emperor Augustus wages war against all of Calista. You play Jaden Ricard, a Lord of Astrea. Deemed a traitor after abandoning his posts during the invasion, Jaden must travel the continent and assemble allies from neighboring countries if he wishes to uphold his duty as a Lord of Astrea.




Command your army and overcome difficult scenarios to uphold your duty as a Lord of Astrea. Train your army, manage inventories, and forge friendships as you travel this war-stricken land. A strong entry for newcomers to the genre and unique twists for veterans.

title: Adrorium
description:
게임 정보
Build your ship, defend against drone waves and explore hundreds of sectors filled with stations, asteroids and planets with lots of POIs. The ship systems can be controlled via consoles with several hundred buttons. Craft equipment and blocks, loot the POIs and disabled drones. Upgrade your ship and venture to the center of the galaxy.

title: Road to Hollow Hills
description:
게임 정보




Road to Hollow Hills thrusts players into a world where the line between reality and nightmare blurs. Engage in combat, solve puzzles, and explore a desolate world to unravel the enigma of Hollow Hills.

Survival Horror: Navigate atmospheric environments filled with tension and dread.
Dynamic Exploration: Roam through diverse locations, from the desolate National Park to the mysterious Shadowed Grove, uncovering the interconnected stories that shape Hollow Hills.
Strategic Combat: Engage in visceral encounters with nightmarish creatures, utilizing a variety of weapons and tools. Manage stamina, choose your attacks wisely, and overcome relentless foes. Or try to avoid any combat!
Puzzles: Solve challenging puzzles scattered throughout the world, each unlocking new areas and revealing secrets.
Legacy System: Collect and utilize Legacy Tiers to enhance your attributes, uncover new abilities, and customize your character's strengths as you progress through the game.

Are you ready to face the nightmares that await on this haunting road?

Ride to survive, fight to win, Road... to Hollow Hills.

title: 100 Cats Italy
description:
게임 정보
100 CATS 이탈리아 - 최고의 숨겨진 고양이 게임에 오신 것을 환영합니다!

이곳에는 이탈리아에 숨어있는 100마리의 고양이가 있습니다! 찾아가세요!

title: Shadows of Midnight - They Watch Me Sleep
description:
게임 정보
"Shadows of Midnight – They Watch Me Sleep" is a narrative-driven horror experience featuring two unique and terrifying stories of ordinary people facing the unknown.
THE HOTEL
A man’s peaceful summer vacation on the Croatian coast takes a sinister turn when he checks into an old, shady hotel. Strange things start happening in his room—objects move on their own, shadows shift in the dim light, and above his bed, a gaping, unnatural hole looms. Something is watching.
THE FOREST CREATURE
In a quiet Eastern European village, a young boy grows up near the woods. Walking home from school one evening, an eerie sensation washes over him—something is wrong. As he looks toward the trees, he realizes he is not alone. Something is there. Something that has always been watching.
Key features:
VHS Aesthetic: Optional VHS shaders for a nostalgic '90s horror feel.
Low-poly graphics: A mix of PS1/PS2-era visuals with modern lighting techniques.
Multiple endings: Each chapter has multiple endings, depending on your choices
autokwd: Shadows of Midnight - They Watch Me Sleep

title: COCOBOY
description:
게임 정보
What is COCOBOY?
In an alternate history 2005, the forgotten 80's platformer COCOBOY has re-entered the public consciousness of a niche few.
Modify, brute force, and restore unused game mechanics using Modcarts, devices hacked together by tech-savvy fans. Discover clever combinations of mods in order to progress and even break level design in unexpected ways.

title: Study Arcade
description:
게임 정보
The Pomodoro Technique (25 minutes of intense focus followed by 5 minutes of rest) is extremely helpful for more productive studying and working, but let's be honest, we all get distracted pretty easily. My attempts to use the technique looked something like this: set a timer, timer goes off, start scrolling social media or playing a game designed to keep me on for as long as possible, get distracted, and never get back to work. The problem is that most entertainment is designed to monetize your time, the most important resource you have! This free tool helps you solve that problem. It's what I wish I had when I was in school (especially during college), and so I'm putting it out there for free.
When you open Study Arcade, you're presented with an extremely simple interface to set a timer and get going. Hit Start, leave it open in the background, and get to work. It'll alert you  automatically when it's time to take a break.
Come back after studying, hit Play, and it'll give you a random arcade minigame for you to play, giving you a break when you need one! I've made 5 minigames so far, from block-breaking to retro shooter. Crucially, though, it only lets you play after you've already been productive, and all of the games are designed to give you a quick brain break and then help you get back to work. Study more to get a chance to play all of them and try to beat the highscore. Escape the doomscrolling, get stuff done, and most importantly, have fun while doing it. Simple as that!

title: Necromancy  Homies
description:
게임 정보
The story is set in Zhitebsk, a city of contrast, where the commonplace, down-to-earth Central Russian town meets the mystical and the metaphysical, and where the ridiculous meets the horrendous.
An unnamed mob in the 1990s is mourning over their boss’ death. They are in great sorrow, not sure what should they do now without him. However, a necromancer for the establishment and an old acquaintance of theirs, Mr.Besolyubov, doesn’t seem to accept that. He offers to do his job and bring the boss back from the dead, but the mob would have to help.
… That’s where the utter nightmare and the incredulous parade of surreal idiocy begin in the funerary train.
▷ Loads of humor of all sorts
▷ That one absurdist 90s dark comedic movie atmosphere
▷ Shocking plot twists
▷ Vivid, expressive grunge visuals
▷ Nostalgic point-n-click gameplay elements
▷ Your choices affect the story
▷ A trap music score

title: Bunker Constructor Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Contracts
Fulfill contracts from the citizens of the city. Each contract is unique and requires careful consideration of all customer requirements. More complex orders bring more money. Make the client satisfied by fulfilling even the smallest wishes to receive all money earned and even a bonus.
 Construction
Build real underground bunkers that will allow to survive in the most terrible apocalypse. Each bunker must be placed at a particular depth to provide its residents with full protection. Show all your imagination and creativity – build multi-level complex bunkers.
 Building Materials
Buy the necessary building materials in various stores – construction, furniture, electronics store, and transport them to the construction site by your own car or pay for the delivery. All remaining materials can be sold or used in the next contract.
 Underground Bunkers
Build real protected underground bunkers. First, dig the shaft to the required depth. Arrange a convenient descent – build a ladder. Dig out a sufficient volume for constructing bunker. Build capital reinforced concrete floors, walls and ceilings to ensure the strength of the bunker. Build interior walls to organize different rooms and start arranging furniture.
 Interior
To be comfortable in the bunker, it must be furnished with comfortable and practical furniture. Each customer has their own preferences and requirements in interior design. Organize bedrooms, kitchens, workrooms, home theaters, gyms and other spaces.
 Licenses

title: Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side
description:
게임 정보
Tsurine is a PsySpec wrapped up in the intensity of her job, and the stress that comes with dissociative amnesia. One night, a mysterious woman offers to help recover her lost memories. All Tsurine must do in exchange is hunt down the missing fragments to an unusual key.
Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side is an intricate choice-heavy psychological medicore thriller about an amnesiac facing both real and mental horrors within a world akin to an endless, liminal hospital. 
The game utilizes a fusion of Visual Novel, RPG, and Point-&-Click mechanics to paint a story about how people choose to cope with trauma, and the way it shapes one's identity. While the main story of Ad Nauseam is firm, it features hundreds of branching paths, choices, and open exploration areas to engage in along the way. Every action you take, and every choice you make, is remembered and seen through to its very end.
Uncover the secrets of this strange world, and the ones lurking within Tsurine's forgotten past. Will you accept your limitations when faced with peril, or will you dive deep into delusion and madness for a chance at hope?
Can you face the world? Can you face yourself?
Are you sure?
The world of Ad Nauseam is heavily inspired by the works and the aesthetics of Yami Kawaii, Liminality, Traumacore, and both Modern & Pastel Goth. It features a long, diverse, and dark soundtrack done by lolratz combining elements of Breakcore, Hyperpop, and Witch House music genres.
Character Artist: @Catfan1000
Background & Soundtrack Artist: @lolratz

title: Project Thea
description:
게임 정보
 A dark turn-based strategy-survival RPG blending retro-futuristic urban fantasy with Slavic folklore. Customise your characters’ gender, class, and race, and recruit NPC allies to explore the wastelands, rebuild your colony, and engage in tactical card-based combat. Featuring branching narratives, character progression, and co-op for 2 players, every choice shapes your survival and the fate of humanity in this story-rich roguelite adventure.

title: Koko's Cafe
description:
게임 정보
게임 소개
이 성장 비주얼 노벨에서 커피를 서빙하고 손님들과 친구가 되어 그들의 이야기를 알아가 보세요.

title: HackOS
description:
게임 정보
HackOS – Dive into the Ultimate Hacking Sandbox
HackOS is the definitive hacking sandbox you've been waiting for. Immerse yourself in a world of virtual espionage, ethical dilemmas, and high-stakes strategy, all from the comfort of your terminal. Inspired by classic hacking games and refined for modern players, HackOS combines the depth of simulation with the excitement of arcade gameplay.
Key Features:
Authentic Hacking Experience: Utilize realistic commands, crack ports, infiltrate networks, and uncover secrets hidden in the shadows of the digital world.
Dynamic Sandbox: Explore an ever-evolving ecosystem influenced by your decisions. From the dark web marketplace to the global stock exchange, your actions shape the virtual landscape.
Story-Driven Campaign: Join factions, complete missions, and unravel the mysteries of Node Zero, a shadowy organization with its own agenda.
Advanced Modding Tools: Create your own missions, events, and scenarios with the intuitive HackOS Editor, inspired by node-based systems like Unreal's Blueprints.
Diverse Gameplay Systems: Manage your reputation, cooperate with factions, invest in the stock market, or trade cryptocurrencies. Every choice has consequences.
No Microtransactions, Ever: Enjoy the full game for a single, fair price.
Whether you’re a seasoned hacker or new to the genre, Hack OS offers an unparalleled hacking experience that will test your skills, your strategies, and your morality.
Are you ready to log in?

title: The Spirit Engine DX
description:
게임 정보
The Spirit Engine DX is a complete remake of the original 2D, sidescrolling real-time (with pausing) RPG from 2003 by Mark Pay. While the game was written as an experimental reaction to 16-bit console RPGs of the late 90s, the gameplay is very desktop-oriented.

title: Gears of Glory
description:
게임 정보
In this Tower Defense game, inspired by classics like Bloons and Kingdom Rush, we introduce a new twist – the ability to move your towers around the map using a van called the "Gear Machine."
The idea is simple: defend your base against an invasion of over 12 different types of robots. This will require some heavy firepower, as these robots are built with advanced materials. To fight back, humanity has developed a series of towers designed to take on this challenge.

And that’s where your mission begins! Choose from over 10 different types of towers to find the best way to destroy all the robots. But it won’t be easy – you'll have limited resources to buy towers, move them, and unlock new areas to place them. Each map also brings its own unique challenges!

title: BroomSweeper
description:
게임 정보
It’s the night shift at your new job as janitor at megacorp TentaTeq, Inc.’s giant headquarters. All alone with hundreds of offices full of dust to sweep… or so you’ve been told. Strange sounds emanate from nearby rooms, dust bunnies spring to life, and suddenly you find yourself fighting to clear the tiles and survive with your newfound employment intact.
Classic Minesweeper With a Twist
Clickable floor tiles can be swept clean, or conceal an angry dust bunny to avoid. Place caution signs and tread carefully using classic Minesweeper strategies—but watch out! Tiles and numbers may not be as they seem as hazardous materials emerge throughout the night! Characters with unique play styles and 20 ascension levels ensure you can customize your experience.
Ludicrous Item Combinations
Stop by a vending machine to restock your janitor cart with items to help you combat the forces lurking in TentaTeq’s maze of cubicles. Defeat bosses to earn powerful keys that grant you new abilities that upend the way you solve puzzles. Discover limitless wacky combinations as you search for the synergy you need to avoid getting fired!

title: Super Citycon
description:
게임 정보
Super Citycon은 건설, 창조, 전략을 사랑하는 플레이어를 위해 설계된 레트로 스타일의 도시 건설 게임입니다. 16비트 시대의 클래식 도시 건설 게임을 연상시키는 친숙하고 향수를 불러일으키는 비주얼 스타일로, 3D 그래픽과 현대적인 조작 방식으로 새롭게 재구성되었습니다. Super Citycon은 모든 도시 건설 게임 팬들에게 매력적이고 몰입감 넘치는 플레이 경험을 제공합니다.
주요 특징:
• 거대한 맵 & 무한한 창의성: 특수 제작된 지형 시스템을 활용하여 넓고 방대한 도시를 건설하세요. 창의적인 플레이어들에게 완벽한 환경을 제공합니다.
• 다양한 게임 모드: 샌드박스 모드에서 자유롭게 창작하고, 맵 크리에이터를 사용하여 맞춤형 맵을 디자인하며, 타이쿤 퍼즐 모드에서 전략적으로 건물을 배치해 보너스를 얻고 인구를 최대화하세요.
• Super Citycon Unlimited: 모바일 버전과 달리, 이 PC 버전은 프리미엄 경험을 제공합니다. 인앱 결제, 광고, 유료 벽 없이, 처음부터 끝까지 순수한 도시 건설의 즐거움을 누리세요.
• 전략적 깊이: 건물 배치 퍼즐을 풀어 보너스를 최적화하고 도시의 잠재력을 최대한 활용하세요.
레트로 도시 건설 게임의 팬이거나, 보컬 아트를 좋아하거나, 도전적인 전략 퍼즐을 즐기는 플레이어라면 Super Citycon이 딱 맞는 게임입니다!
지금 바로 위시리스트에 추가하세요!
꿈의 도시를 처음으로 건설할 기회를 잡고, 이 여정에 함께하세요!
커뮤니티에 참여하세요!
개발 진행 상황을 확인하고, 아이디어를 공유하며, Super Citycon Unlimited의 미래를 직접 만들어 보세요.
지금 팔로우하고 출시와 함께 즐길 준비를 하세요!

title: BuildAndExtract
description:
게임 정보
True to its straightforward title, Build & Extract combines two core mechanics:
programming-inspired building   and   loot-driven exfiltration.
Programmable Build, Creative Combat
Use programming logic to assemble weapon combinations. Attach modules to weapons that alter skill effects and dictate activation logic.
Don't be intimidated, it's easier and more fun than you think
Bring your custom builds into battle, defeat enemies, and claim loot and currency.

title: Glory On Pluto
description:
게임 정보
Earth needs you. Well, it needs someone to fly their newest rocket to space and inspire the masses, and you’re next on the hiring list.
Journey from Earth to Pluto and beyond, building wild item synergies and combos to push your rocket to unimaginable speeds. Restock and hire crew to help out, and bring back glory to earth one boost at a time!
The engine of the future
Place fuel items into 18 slots on a novel and chaotic engine board. With 6 segments and 3 rings that will rotate randomly after each boost, stay on your toes to plan your synergies as best you can.
No such thing as a misfuel
With a planned 100+ items across 12+ fuel types, each with its own effects and bonuses, no two journeys will be the same.
Friends along the way
A planned 40+ crew members can be hired and upgraded after each phase of your journey, giving bonuses and increasing your chances of travelling to the edge of the solar system!
Strategy and fate
With an engine prone to reorganising itself and a limited stock from the acquisition counter after each boost, you’ll have to stay on your toes to build the strongest strategy you can against the odds.
Challenges and Rewards
Take it easier in cadet mode, manage an overheating engine in commander mode, or face an array of setbacks in specialist mode. Gain glory equal to your struggles, use it to buy crew and restock your engines, and push ever deeper into the vastness of space.

title: HaoWei1: Your Domineering Warlord
description:
게임 정보
하오웨이1(HaoWei1)은 여성 대상 3D 비주얼 노벨 오토메 게임으로, 달콤한 로맨스와 살인 미스터리를 결합한 게임입니다.

▌"HaoWei 1"의 줄거리:
◆ 로맨스 부분: 군사 지도자 형, HaoWei는 당신을 깊이 사랑하고, 당신이 재능 에이전트로서 힘들게 돌아다니며 지치는 모습을 더 이상 볼 수 없습니다. 그는 당신이 군대에서 군악대를 관리하는 여유로운 직책을 맡게 하려고 하지만, 당신은 친절하게 거절합니다. 남자 아이돌 팬더는 촬영 때문에 지쳐서 호텔에 돌아오자마자 잠에 듭니다. 방이 하나뿐이라 의심을 피하기 위해 호텔 의자에서 잠을 자게 됩니다. 이 소식을 들은 HaoWei는 격분하며 직접 팬더에게 만나서 심하게 꾸짖습니다. 그는 당신이 조금이라도 고통받는 모습을 더 이상 참을 수 없습니다. HaoWei는 당신의 약혼자 백곰을 자동차 대리점에서 만납니다. 두 사람은 모두 재능 에이전트로서 적합한 고급 차를 고르며 우연히 같은 모델을 좋아하게 됩니다…
◆ 살인 미스터리 부분: "HaoWei 1"의 이번 에피소드에서, 당신의 아티스트 팬더가 갈색 테이프에 의해 질식사한 여성을 살해한 사건에 연루됩니다. 피해자는 어린이 모델의 어머니였으며, 그녀는 테이프로 무서운 방식으로 감겨 있었습니다. 현장에 많은 사람들이 있었고, 누가 감히 이런 범죄를 저질렀을까요? 왜 그들은 이렇게 복잡하고 기괴한 방식으로 그녀를 죽였을까요? 범인은 어떻게 범행을 저질렀을까요? 팬더의 이름을 씻고 그의 명예를 지키기 위해, 당신은 그의 에이전트로서 즉시 단서를 찾아 사건을 해결하고 진짜 범인을 밝혀야 합니다!

▌게임 내용
1000개 이상의 정교한 동적 3D 비디오 클립
모든 캐릭터에 풀 보이스 연기와 사운드 효과
그의 심장 박동, 온도, 호흡을 모아 다양한 방을 열고 살인 미스터리의 단서를 찾아 해결
10개의 상호작용 기능 해제: 그가 당신에게 전화하거나 메시지를 보내고, 당신과 함께 시간을 보내며, 심지어 당신을 자러 재우기도 함
주요 스토리 외에도 10개의 사이드 스토리가 있어 각기 다른 선택이 다른 결말을 이끕니다
3개의 재미있는 미니게임 해제
10개의 테마곡 해제

▌곰 왕국에 대하여
곰 왕국은 제3차 세계대전 이후 새로 설립된 국가입니다. 여러 차례의 군벌 분쟁을 거쳐 현재는 갈색곰 군벌 HaoWei가 국가의 남부를 지배하고 있습니다. 그의 권력은 단단하고, 경제는 빠르게 성장하고 있으며, 문화는 포용적이고 다양합니다.

▌갈색곰과 당신

HaoWei: "갈색곰"이라는 별명을 가진 군사 지도자로, 그는 강하고 위엄 있으며 냉철하지만 당신에게는 모든 부드러움을 아껴 둡니다. 어렸을 때, 두 사람은 부모님의 재혼을 통해 형제가 되었고, 시간이 지나면서 서로에 대한 감정을 키워왔습니다. 갈색곰 HaoWei는 당신을 보호하고 애지중지합니다. 하지만 당신의 의붓아버지인 늙은 군벌은 당신이 백곰이라는 부유한 가문의 아들과 결혼하도록 정해 놓았고, 이는 HaoWei를 분노하게 만듭니다. 그는 당신을 아내로 삼고자 하며, 당신을 되찾기 위해 모든 것을 할 것입니다…


당신: 재능 에이전트로서, 당신은 아이돌 팬더의 경력을 돕기 위해 열심히 일합니다. 당신은 그에게 연기 기회를 찾고, 음반을 조직하고, 라이브 이벤트를 주선하며, 사업 협상도 합니다. 당신은 에이전트로서의 일을 사랑하고 그것에 온전히 헌신합니다.

▌다른 세 마리 곰들

QianYi: "백곰"이라는 별명을 가진 그는 곰 왕국의 최대 백화점인 백곰 백화점의 젊은 회장입니다. 그의 가문은 오래된 부유한 집안으로 전통적이며 자만심이 강합니다. 당신은 어린 시절 백곰과 약혼했지만, 현재 당신이 에이전트로 일하면서 그의 가족은 연예 산업을 크게 경멸하며 당신이 이를 포기하길 원합니다. 그들은 당신이 관심 없는 재정 분야로 나아가기를 원합니다. 백곰은 당신의 에너지 넘치고 근면한 성격을 사랑하지만, 당신에게 결혼을 강요합니다… 그는 전통적인 백화점이 젊은 사람들을 끌어들이기 위해 반드시 개혁되어야 한다고 생각하여, 아이돌 팬더를 백화점에서 공연하도록 초대합니다.


HengQi: "팬더"라는 별명을 가진 팬더는 초등학교 시절부터 당신의 가장 친한 친구였으며, 나중에는 그의 에이전트가 되었습니다. 그는 탁월한 공연, 노래, 춤 실력을 가졌지만, 그의 경력은 불안정하고 다양한 살인 사건에 연루되어 형사 용의자가 되곤 합니다. 당신은 그를 돕기 위해 사건의 단서를 찾아 범인을 밝히고 그의 이름을 씻어야 합니다.


MoMo: "블랙곰"이라는 별명을 가진 그는 경찰에서 형사입니다. MoMo는 경찰 아카데미를 우수한 성적으로 졸업하고, 최연소로 살인 사건 부서에 배치되었습니다. 그는 미세한 단서를 통해 용의자를 빠르게 파악하고 사건을 해결할 수 있습니다. 매번 살인 사건이 일어날 때마다 그는 당신과 마주치게 되고, 그로 인해 두 사람은 알게 됩니다…

▌게임플레이
스토리 감상/선택: 영화 같은 스토리를 즐기며, 그와의 로맨스를 진행하고, 그의 웃음, 심장 박동, 따뜻함을 모아 살인 미스터리의 단서를 찾고 퍼즐을 해결합니다.
미니게임: 미니게임을 하며 중요한 퍼즐 조각을 모아 사건을 해결합니다.
일상적인 상호작용: 그와 전화 통화, 문자 메시지, 일기를 읽으며 상호작용합니다.
노래 및 비디오 클립: 노래를 듣고 중요한 비디오 클립을 다시 감상합니다.

▌네 마리 곰 시리즈
이 서브 시리즈는 당신과 네 마리 "곰"—아이돌 팬더, 군사 지도자 HaoWei, 부유한 약혼자 백곰, 형사 MoMo와의 관계에 초점을 맞추고 있으며, "네 마리 곰 시리즈"로 불립니다. 각 에피소드는 하나의 곰을 중심으로 이름이 지어지며, 이번 에피소드는 HaoWei와의 로맨스를 다룹니다. 네 마리 곰 시리즈의 각 에피소드는 달콤한 로맨스와 살인 미스터리를 포함하고 있습니다!

▌1000 Princes 시리즈
"1000 Princes" 오토메 게임 시리즈는 여성 타겟의 로맨스 게임 시리즈로, 영화 같은 3D 비주얼 노벨 스타일로 진행됩니다. 플레이어는 다양한 왕자들 중에서 선택하여 화려하고 달콤한 로맨스를 경험할 수 있습니다. 이 시리즈의 각 게임은 각기 다른 왕자를 주제로 하며, 그 왕자는 당신을 깊이 사랑하고 아껴줍니다.
"1000 Princes"는 여성들을 위한 대규모 로맨틱 시리즈입니다! 이 시리즈는 달콤한 로맨스 오토메 게임 시리즈와 이해하기 쉬운 다국어 학습 전자책을 포함하고 있습니다.
🍰 "1000 Princes" 오토메 게임: STEAM과 Google Play에서 제공
📕 "1000 Princes" 다국어 학습 전자책: Google Play에서 제공
└ 🅿️ "1000 Princes" 개발자 "Ginyan" 다국어 학습: YouTube에서 제공
🍒 "1000 Princes" 테마곡: YouTube에서 제공
🌸 "1000 Princes" 공식 웹사이트

▌개발자 소개
Ginyan: 저는 오토메 게임/비주얼 노벨의 독립 개발자이자 전자책 작가입니다. 저는 외국어 학습 책과 로맨틱 소설 전자책을 만듭니다. 판타지를 좋아하고 컴퓨터와 외국어 학습에 깊은 열정을 가지고 있습니다. 제 소설을 게임의 스크립트로 사용하고, Unity 엔진과 Naninovel을 사용하여 게임을 개발하며, iClone과 CC로 캐릭터 모델링과 애니메이션을 제작하고 다양한 AI 도구를 사용하여 게임을 개발합니다.

title: Tyrofeud
description:
게임 정보
The perfect 1v1 mini games galore for casual scrubs like us. You and your sibling are tasked to complete certain chores before your mom returns home. Let them know you are THE superior sibling. Be the one to complete more assignments so you can get all the love from mommy. You can choose to do either of these things at a given time:
COMPLETE CHORES
If you get to finish the three tasks that your mother assigned you to do when the time runs out, you will given a star that you can use to run the wheel to get forbidden item. These are simple tasks such as cleaning the toilet, putting fruits on the fridge, and many more. Failure to do any task by the end of the day will automatically eliminate you from the family. Jk. You just lose that round and an immediate guarantee that you won't get a star, that's all.
WHACK A SIBLING
If you meet your sibling when you are about to do your daily task, you can smack them with items that you can find around the house. Remember, if you get hit, you will be temporarily stunned for a few seconds, which makes them have the upper hand in completing their tasks. I say we strike FIRST, always.

title: Project Rebearth
description:
게임 정보
Project Rebearth is a game set in a post-apocalyptic utopia. The world has faced a global collapse many generations ago and whoever survived could only do so by hiding underground. Centuries have passed and the surface appears to be habitable again. It is now up to you, and all other players to rebuild society. Play in a massive online multiplayer where everyone plays on the same exact replica of planet Earth. Grow your town, trade with other players for resources you cannot access yourself, face the challenges that come your way and discover the rich and sometimes dark history of the planet.

You start by choosing any spot on our planet Earth to start your settlement.
Build in a variety of Earth's biomes like woods, deserts, mountains and many more.
Gather resources and manage your inventory to make sure inhabitants are happy and your settlement can grow.
As a fishing village, you will need to trade with the players a bit further in the mountains for stone or metals. Or your desert town rich in minerals will need to trade with a coastal town for food.
Study lost knowledge to advance your capabilities.
Make diplomatic, societal and technological decisions that have ripple effects throughout your entire town.
Launch expeditions to discover artifacts of a world that has been lost and uncover the true history of planet Earth.
Travel across the planet to see how other people are rebuilding society.
Project Rebearth plays out on an exact 1-to-1 replica of our beloved planet Earth.
You choose whether you start your settlement in the scorching deserts, arctic polar region or the more temperate forests. Each place on Earth has different fauna and flora, building materials that will reflect in the buildings you place, or resources and production chains to specialize in.
The world literally is your playground.
Feel free to roam around and explore the familiar, or less familiar corners of our globe. Get inspired by other players and see their wonderful creations. On top of that, every place can be exported as a high resolution map. This makes Project Rebearth highly suitable for map making, or to take your creation out of the game for offline (TTRPG) adventures.
Project Rebearth is a casual game, not meant to be 'finished' in a weekend. Your farms will keep growing potatoes, your woodcutters will keep producing wood, even when you are offline. You can play at your pace and when it suits you.
How did the world become how it is, and can you, together with the other players, piece together the story of Project Rebearth?

title: Doodle Deities
description:
게임 정보
Doodle Deities is a roguelike deck builder that is all about creating powerful synergies, discovering new treasures and unlocking bosses to play as. Never run out of content again with a simple editor that requires no programming and full Steam workshop integration. All the content in the game was made with the built in editors, thus anything can be changed!
Do you like moddable games? We do as well, we built two editors into the game. The normal editor for people with no programming knowledge which can add most kinds of content like cards, bosses or factions to the game. We got full steam workshop integration and anything you make can be used in multiplayer with your friends!
Then we got the advanced editor that can add anything to the game! The entire game was written in this editor, even the normal editor was written in this editor. Add new mechanics, add features to the normal editor or do a total conversion. Your imagination is the only limit here!

title: Luminastadt
description:
게임 정보
It is a relaxing building game. Enjoy the joy of creating something with no management, no battles and no wrong answers.
Relax to chill vibes and escape to a world that feels alive. Create a warm, inviting atmosphere with plants and animals.
Use your creativity to place objects and voxels to customise the world.

title: The Watcher's Curse
description:
게임 정보
Play the free demo now!
Distinct art-style that brings the haunting world of Hollow Veil to life.
Immersive narrative-driven gameplay unfolds a grim tale of mystery, ancient gods, and supernatural peril.
Turn-based combat challenges players to destroy their foes in whatever manner they see fit.
Unravel what secrets lie in the land of Hollow Veil as you explore its haunted landscapes and encounter its gently-deranged inhabitants.
Level up to increase your base stats and unlock powerful new spells.
Welcome to the mysterious land of Hollow Veil, where darkness thrives and hopeless souls wander endlessly. In The Watcher's Curse, you step into the shoes of Artem, a duty-burdened watcher tasked with protecting the world from nefarious forces.
As a watcher, Artem's responsibilities are twofold: learn the secrets of the world along with any lost knowledge and remove any threats posed by the aforementioned nefarious forces. Most common amongst said forces are the puritanical technotheists, a fanatical order that believes technology brings them closer to god. Whether stationed in an overlapped hell forest or chasing ancient horrors through an ageless monolith, Artem faces a relentless barrage of esoteric threats.
Our tale begins with Artem in a precarious predicament, unexpectedly transported across the world after a chance encounter with a seemingly innocuous tome. Stranded in the gloomy confines of Grimm's Briar, nestled amidst the foreboding Noctemura mountains, Artem crosses paths with Mayor Barkeep. Eager to return home, Artem finds himself entangled in the mayor's plea for aid in unraveling the enigma shrouding the disappearance of local villagers.

title: Sacred Earth - Reverie
description:
게임 정보
Sacred Earth - Reverie is a fantasy RPG with visual novel elements, inspired by both classic and modern JRPGs. Follow the story of a former knight of the kingdom as they go on a personal journey through the countryside in order to uncover hidden truths and long lost mysteries of the past.
Explore dungeons, interact with your allies and the townsfolk, build your characters with equipment, abilities, and perks, and test your might against foes in fast-paced turn-based combat.

title: Umigame
description:
게임 정보
유령의 늪에 더 깊이 들어갈수록, 마녀 메이브의 영향력을 더 많이 느낄 수 있습니다. 그녀는 이곳의 생물들을 자신의 뜻대로 굴복시켜 저주받은 혐오스러운 것으로 만들었습니다.
자유로워지고 싶다면 먼저 그녀를 물리쳐야 합니다...
마녀를 물리치고 여정에서 살아남으세요
umigame에서 당신은 위험한 임무를 맡은 전투 경험이 풍부한 바다 거북이가 됩니다.마녀 메이브를 물리치고 저주받은 늪을 해방하세요. 이 빠르게 진행되는 로그라이트에서 끊임없이 나타나는 적과 싸우고, 끊임없이 변화하는 도전에 적응하고, 매번 도전할수록 더 강해지세요.
옴니코어의 힘

title: Unbox the Room
description:
게임 정보
풀어서 발견하기
상자를 열어 다양한 물건과 가구를 찾아보세요. 각각의 물건은 새로운 집에서 자신만의 자리를 갖고 있습니다.
자유롭게 꾸미기
소파부터 작은 컵까지 모든 것을 배치하여 편안하고 살아있는 공간을 만드세요.
간단한 이야기

title: Beyond the Curtains
description:
게임 정보


"Beyond the Curtains" is a tranquil and relaxing game of casually gazing out the window, longing to witness interesting events and surprises.
Through the large window, you will have the opportunity to experience the world outside from the perspective of the room's owner.
Before long, even the fleeting shadows left by passers-by will become a glimpse into their evolving, ever-changing lives.
Additionally, the interior of the room will change over time, which may reveal some personal information about the one viewing through the window...?

Features

As you continually cycle between day and night, time actually keeps moving forward. And the things outside the window will change accordingly...






● Pick-me-up for hard times: Maybe your classroom or office doesn't have a window, but it does now, and it's always sunny!
● Progress at your own pace: Use the nap button to change the time of day so you don't have to worry about missing anything.
● Selectable topics: longing and fantasy, sex and curiosity, different windows, different people's rooms.
● Adjust the music to your taste: Use the in-room playback device to choose from original, classical, or even... heavy metal?
● Become one with the window: Minimal buttons and UI for maximum immersion.

title: Runehaven
description:
게임 정보
Runehaven is an atmospheric first-person dungeon crawler with roguelike elements taking place in a destructible voxel world. Combine runes to craft your own unique spells or to enchant weapons, alter the environment, explore procedurally generated dungeons, battle vile creatures, solve puzzles, discover hidden secrets, and dodge deadly traps!
Craft your own spells by combining different runes using a magic system inspired by Ultima and Arx Fatalis! Each rune affects the spell in an unique and emergent way!

title: Hlína
description:
게임 정보
Hlína는 모든 건물과 마을이 점토로 만들어진 독특한 도시를 배경으로 하는 게임입니다. 주인공 올리는 엄마가 실직한 뒤로 엄마를 돌보려 애쓰고 있습니다. 도시의 공장은 사람들에게 점점 더 많은 작업량을 요구하고 있어, 올리와 엄마의 삶은 더욱 힘들어집니다. 이 게임은 일상적인 문제와 오싹한 미스터리를 결합했습니다. 마을을 탐험하면서 비밀을 알아내고 다양한 도전에 직면하게 됩니다. 점토로 만들어진 마을은 게임에 독특하고 매력적인 분위기를 선사합니다. 올리가 현실 세계의 어려움을 어떻게 헤쳐 나가는지 지켜보는 한편, 마을 곳곳에 숨겨진 무서운 놀라움도 마주하게 될 것입니다.

title: God For A Day
description:
게임 정보
당신의 결정이 이 2D 내러티브 기반 시뮬레이션 게임에서 도시의 운명을 형성합니다. 당신은 신의 아들로서 신성한 역할을 수행합니다.



당신의 신성한 미션: 호프우드 시의 주민들을 결정하고, 축복하고, 혹은 저주하세요.



인생을 바꿀 선택을 하기 전에 그들의 아이템과 비밀을 통해 이야기를 밝혀내세요.



당신의 선택은 심판의 날에 대한 당신의 계시에도 영향을 미칠 것입니다.



‘Papers, Please’, ‘Death and Taxes’, 또는 ‘Do Not Feed the Monkeys’와 같은 내러티브 기반 인디 게임을 즐겼다면, ‘God for a Day’에서 시각과 스토리텔링의 독특한 조화를 사랑할 것입니다. 이 게임은 당신이 신성한 선택을 통해 호프우드 시의 운명을 형성하도록 초대합니다. 시도해보고 다른 어떤 것과도 비교할 수 없는 스토리텔링 어드벤처에 나서세요!




















독립 개발자가 만든 ‘God for a Day’는 현재 활발히 개발 중입니다. 데모 버전을 경험한 사람들로부터의 피드백은 이 독특한 게임 어드벤처를 다듬고 풍부하게 만드는 데 중요한 역할을 합니다. 이 솔로 개발 여정에 참여하여 ‘God for a Day’를 정말 특별하게 만드는 데 기여하세요!

Discord에서 당신의 생각과 피드백을 항상 환영합니다. 우리 커뮤니티에 참여하고 ‘God for a Day’의 독특한 내러티브 경험을 형성하는 데 함께하세요.

title: Civilization Builder
description:
게임 정보
Build, Manage, Evolve!
Immerse yourself in a deep city-building strategy game where your settlement embarks on a journey from primitive shelters in the Stone Age to a thriving modern metropolis. Carefully manage resources, research new technologies, and adapt to evolving challenges to build a prosperous civilization.
Key Features:
• Settlement Evolution – Start with a small tribe and guide it through centuries of progress.
• Dynamic Economy – Every resource matters, and production chains evolve as your city grows.
• Logistics & Transportation – Organize resource delivery from carts and caravans to trains and trucks.
• Construction System – Buildings are constructed in stages, requiring materials and workers.
• Territorial Expansion – Compete for land, expand borders, and connect cities through infrastructure.
Will your city stand the test of time?

title: The Last Winter Knight
description:
게임 정보
You wake up as a ghost, with no memory of who you were or how you died. The only clue to your past is the empty suit of armour you now possess.
As you explore an abandoned castle and piece together your memories, you’ll uncover your tale: A tale of broken promises, regret, and bonds that last beyond death.
But your story doesn’t have to die with you.
How will you write its ending?

title: Six Blow: Bullet Rain
description:
게임 정보
Six Blow: Bullet Rain immerses you into an exhilarating world that combines the classic FPS experience with a unique card collection and tactical combat elements. Set in a Wild West-themed universe, this game challenges players to strategically wield their weapons and abilities to survive in a world teeming with dangerous dinosaurs.

Living Bullets with Cards
Your weapons are filled with living beings, personified as bullets, represented by cards in the game. Each card unveils the identities and unique effects of these living bullets, adding depth and excitement to every moment, allowing players to adapt their strategies accordingly.

Deckbuilding Strategy
The cards in your deck influence your weapons' accuracy percentage. Merge and strategically use these cards to increase the accuracy of your weapons, a critical component and key to your survival.

Wild West Adventure
The game successfully captures the atmosphere of the Wild West. From dark caves to desert towns, embark on an unforgettable journey while battling dinosaurs.

Co-op Multiplayer
Team up with friends to combat dinosaurs. Share your strategies and join forces to tackle challenging foes.

Endless Action
Play endlessly and put your skills to the test to see how far you can go in this action roguelike experience!

Six Blow: Bullet Rain offers a unique action roguelike experience with its living bullet-loaded weapons, Wild West ambiance, and card-based mechanics. Customize and use your bullets strategically to survive the relentless onslaught of dinosaurs. Begin your adventure now!

title: Button Man
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Kingsport! Home to the best views, friendliest of neighbors, and base to one of the biggest bootlegging operations on the Atlantic Ocean. Join us as Bruce McKenzie, professional Button Man to the local Kingpin, in his quest to find the killer of his boss and beloved socialite. With his friends and associates that you'll pick along the way discover the truth and seal the fate of the city.
The game combines point & click and beat 'em up to create a blend of narrative driven dialogues and puzzle and a robust combat system. It has the best of both worlds as it is up to you if to choose to fight or find a clever way to resolve the conflict before it explodes!
Hand Drawn Visuals
From the sprites, the animation, the backgrounds, and our full comic book, every line is carefully drawn by our fantastic artists. We pay great attention to detail and draw from multiple inspirations of comic books in the 1920's and 30's. We always look for references and inspirations that will allow us to provide an authentic experience with reverence to the places we're depicting.

title: Selenwald
description:
게임 정보
Prepare to face the unimaginable magnificence of the university of Selenwald!
Enter the halls of Selenwald to learn forbidden knowledge never meant to leave the cursed edifice. Meet madmen and face horrors that cannot be described by mere words. Discover the truth that terrifies scientists and priests alike.



Challenging Combat - Fight for survival having ultimate control over your character's actions. Engage in melee combat or take enemies down from afar using firearms and powerful magic. Aim carefully since every attack can miss if executed blindly. Dodge enemy attacks and adapt to enemies' behaviour. Use stealth and assassinate or sneak past enemies to avoid risky encounters altogether.
Resource Management - Most of your combat and survival capabilities are dictated by what resources you find. Resources are limited and so is the character's inventory. Make choices on what to bring with you every time you descend to a lower level. Every bullet, potion and spell makes a difference.
Character Development - Every class has a different pool of starting traits, predispositions, items and types of inventory slots available. Make choices when being presented with new random traits to gain power and build interesting combinations. Modify your inventory with acquired accessories to further customize your character.
Permanent Death - If your character dies, they die for good. Choose a new, random adventurer and embark on a new adventure. Even if you don't manage to go far, your actions will have consequences that carry over to subsequent playthroughs. Dying is a natural part of the game.
Random Dungeons - Every playthrough brings completely different areas to explore. No shuffled predefined rooms - truly original locations every time.
Unique Setting - Travel to Europe of the late 1700s and enter the gateway to where the afterlife takes place. Discover how scientists eternally isolated from the world of the living crossed boundaries dictated by known science. See how the discovery of selenium's arcane properties enabled humanity to tap into powerful forces reminiscent of magic. Gain answers to mysteries never before found on the pages of written history.
Mature Story - Unravel the dark, rich story of philosophical nature. Witness how a groundbreaking scientific revelation drives even the brightest minds into madness. Meet tragic characters with intriguing past. Discover the very foundations of life and death and see the true, terrifying nature of matters humanity has desperately tried to explain with religion.

title: X-MODE
description:
게임 정보
X-Mode is a free-to-play medium paced multiplayer FPS with a variety of different gamemodes to play. Perfect for quick casual games with friends or if you're more hardcore you can grind for the top of the global leaderboard.
KEY FEATURES
Play a variety of different gamemodes:
- Free For All
- Team Deathmatch
- Capture The Flag
- Infection
- Elimination
- Race
- Point Hold
Choose from a selection of ranged and melee items
Level up your player and rise to the top of the global leaderboard
Customize your items and player character to stand out
Unlock all the Steam achievements
ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

title: Lagoda Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic adventure in this classic, pixel-art, JRPG. Take part in the land's lore, meet new friends, interact with NPCs, and fight different enemies.


On your journey, you will explore a rich variety of forests, mountains, waters, caves, and dungeons. Small villages, and prosperous cities. You will also collect various valuable resources through fishing, mining, and farming.


You will meet many different enemies as you travel through the lands. The game uses a fast-paced, turn-based battle system, where the different enemies have unique elemental weaknesses. Magic and various buffs/debuffs play a big role in battles. Tailor your party members' unique magic abilities, with the help of different elemental orbs.
The game features:

title: CASSETTE BOY
description:
게임 정보
Is the moon still there when I'm not looking at it?
If it isn't...will the people I love disappear if I stop looking at them?



"Do you really believe the moon isn't there when you're not looking at it?" This famous quote attributed to Einstein poses a profound question about quantum mechanics. This game is a puzzle adventure inspired by quantum mechanics, set in a world where things cease to exist when you're not looking at them. Manipulate existence and solve the mysteries of this intriguing world!

About Cassette Boy:
Cassette Boy looks like a 2D game, but its world is actually 3D.
In order to solve its puzzles, you will have to turn and twist the map around, changing the perspective.
Things that you can't see from your perspective, for example because they're hidden behind a wall, stop existing—this is called the "Schrödinger system."
Hide obstacles out of sight and out of mind or reveal secret passages to advance through the game.
Of course, solving puzzles won't be enough. You'll have to pick up weapons and face monsters and bosses as well.
Enemies, puzzles, and more await you in this mysterious world!



The state of matter is only defined once you observe it.
In Cassette Boy's world, what you can't observe doesn't exist. In other words, the only thing that matters is what you can see on the screen.
Yes, even the people you just talked to. They don't exist unless you're observing them.
Flip the world around and bring things in and out of existence.

title: Dream Channel Zero
description:
게임 정보
'Dream Channel Zero'는 게임 세계에 빨려 들어간 청년 아키라가 후드를 쓴 소녀 루미코와 만나 다양한 난관을 함께 극복하며 게임으로부터의 탈출을 목표로 하는 이야기입니다. 웃음과 눈물과 공포가 뒤섞인 이 일그러진 게임 세계는 'Zelle'의 작가 Fuming이 Odencat과 함께 선사하는 완전히 새로운 어드벤처 게임입니다.
~ 특징 ~
무엇이든 가능한 신나는 월드맵!
꼬마 캐릭터들이 다양한 액션을 취하면서 모험합니다, 너무 귀여워요!
빈칸에 멈춰 서면 서브 이벤트가 발생하거나, 캐릭터들의 집 등 다양한 장소로 이동할 수 있지요.
필드에 있는 TV 채널을 조작하면 다른 세계로 워프할 수 있습니다!
모두가 좋아하는 여름의 해변부터 어둡고 어두운 밤의 세계까지,

title: EXELIO
description:
게임 정보
「Exelio」에서는 플레이어가 끊임없이 변화하는 환경과 다양한 위협에 맞서며, 미지의 땅에서 생존하는 데 필요한 지식과 기술을 습득해 나갑니다. 때로는 미지의 생물과 전투를 벌여야 할 때도 있습니다. 아름다운 자연과 혹독한 현실이 교차하는 세계를 배경으로, 탐험을 통해 세계의 미스터리를 파헤치고, 스스로의 운명을 개척해 나가게 됩니다. 게임의 다양한 요소를 다음과 같이 즐길 수 있습니다.
■ 탐험
산지, 설산, 정글, 동굴, 유적 등 다양한 지형에서 여러 액션이 필요한 탐험이 기다리고 있습니다.
■ 생존
식량과 물의 확보는 항상 중요합니다. 게임을 진행하면서 효율적이고 적절하게 자원을 확보하는 것이 생존의 열쇠가 됩니다.
■ 제작
다양한 장소에서 재료를 수집하여 생존에 필요한 도구, 무기, 건물, 식량, 식물 등을 제작하세요. 무수한 조합을 통해 자신만의 거점을 만들어 나가세요.
■ 전투
낮에는 야생동물과의 전투뿐만 아니라, 밤이 되면 불길한 그림자가 다가옵니다. 많은 적과 맞서 싸우기 위한 최선의 전략을 찾아보세요.
■ 이야기
게임에서는 두 주인공의 미스터리를 밝혀내면서 이야기가 전개됩니다. 그들은 왜 이런 장소에 나타나게 되었을까요? 성격이 다른 주인공들을 능숙하게 조작하는 것이 게임을 진행하는 데 중요합니다.
주의: 이 게임은 Steam Deck에서 원활하게 실행되도록 최적화될 예정입니다.

title: Super/Human Identity
description:
게임 정보
Waking up with superpowers and no memory, five strangers find themselves in a struggle for survival and a search for answers. Pursued relentlessly, will their hardships bring them closer together or turn them against each other? And will everyone make it to the end?

Playing as Subject 5, the number designated to you is your only clue to a former life you have no memory of. On the run, fighting for your life, you join up with Subjects 1-4. Together, you must cross a ruined city to get to safety and find answers. Beset by an external threat as well as internal conflict, you have to navigate your way through alarming revelations and difficult choices before finding your freedom.

Superhuman or only human - you must reclaim your identity, or define who you are anew.

FEATURES
Choose your avatar, pronouns and name as you develop your main character into who you want them to be with frequent, nuanced choices.
Influence each of your companions' fates. Will they live or die? Who will they become if they survive?
Experience different group dynamics as a consequence of your choices. Any two characters can be friends or bitter enemies.
Romance one of 6 different characters – 3 male and 3 female – available for all genders.
Think fast and use your telekinetic powers on the environment to defeat enemies. Choose between 4 difficulty settings ranging from Narrative to Superhuman.
7+ hours long, highly interactive, narrative gameplay. One story with vast variability.
Stylized, cel-shaded characters and backgrounds, with painted CG artworks illustrating key story moments.
Epic, emotional, original soundtrack from composer Edwin Montgomery (Warhammer 40,000: Regicide, Wasteland Remastered, Ghost In The Shell, Neverwinter).
Accessibility features: Opendyslexic font, large UI, self-voicing support with additional descriptive text, captions.

title: Abyss Delvers
description:
게임 정보
Abyss Delvers is an Online Hack'n'Slash Action RPG. Adventure out alone or party up with your friends on an epic journey and fight the monstrous hordes of the Abyss.
GAME FEATURES
Campaign
Venture out and unveil the secrets of the Abyss in an epic 4 act journey.
Abyss Charts
Randomly generated campaigns. Each Abyss Chart layout is different, choose your path to modify the rewards, monsters, area layout and more...
Online co-op with up to 6 players
Crush monsters together with friends, or befriend new ones you may find along the way in the safe zones.
Procedural Generation
Explore new areas, discover secrets and avoid deadly traps in a randomly generated world.
4 unique classes - 12 unique skill trees
Play as the Warrior, Hunter, Warlock or Sorcerer. Each class have 3 unique skill trees to combine and specialize in. (More classes in development)
Ability Augmentation
Augment your abilities with Ability Runes. Increase the damage and area-of-effect, reduce the cooldown and resource cost, or make your ability spawn forth an abyssal monster to fight for you - endless possibilities!
Abyssal Soul Passive Tree
Slay the Lords of the Abyss, consume their soul and spend it in the massive Abyssal Soul Passive Tree to gain their powers.
Contracts
Randomly generated quests found throughout the world. Sell the contracts for a small price, or fulfill its goals and receive rewards! The harder the contract, the greater the loot.
Hardcore mode
Your deeds will be remembered.

title: Diamond Sun
description:
게임 정보
An Evocative Hand-Crafted World
The world of Diamond Sun is brought to life in vivid, moody detail, its caverns alive with bizarre and terrifying creatures, each animatedin a unique 3D style. Every new area you’ll discover is beautifully unique and strange, teeming with new creatures and characters. Take in the sights and uncover new wonders hidden off of the beaten path. If you like classic gameplay, cute but creepy characters, epic adventure and beautiful, gothic worlds, then Diamond Sun awaits!

Brave the Depths of a Forsaken World
Beneath the surface of a flooded planet lies a ruined kingdom shrouded in mystery. Many venture into its depths, chasing after treasure, glory, or long-buried secrets. Diamond Sun is a classically inspired rogue-like adventure set in a sprawling, interconnected world. Traverse winding tunnels, explore lost cities, and navigate perilous landscapes; face off against fearsome foes, encounter eccentric allies, and unravel the enigmatic truths hidden at the heart of this forgotten realm.

title: Sketchy Fables
description:
게임 정보
You wake up in your bedroom, at home, with a mysterious card in hand—a heartfelt invitation to visit your grandmother, who resides in the tallest skyscraper of the bustling city. The world is open before you, but will you set out to see her, or will unexpected events lead you down a completely different path? The choice is yours.
🎨 Fully Hand-Drawn World
Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted game world featuring over 10,000 unique, hand-drawn and animated artworks.
🗺️ Epic Exploration
Embark on a journey through diverse environments, from charming villages to vast, rural landscapes, each brimming with life and mystery.
🔍 Uncover the Unknown
Dive into engaging questlines, discover hidden collectibles, unravel deep secrets, and challenge your mind with intricate puzzles.
✨ Personalized Adventure
Experience a game focused on personal exploration, filled with countless random encounters and surprises waiting to be found.
🎵 Play the Handpan
Discover the soothing tones of the handpan—a unique musical instrument you can play within the game to create immersive soundscapes. Your music can solve puzzles, lift spirits, and shape the world around you.
Let your curiosity guide you—this game is a celebration of creativity, wonder, and discovery.

title: Build Fight Game
description:
게임 정보
Build Fight Game is a class-based shooter set across a collection of fully interactable voxel environments. Create, destroy, and shoot your way to victory with your team in procedurally-generated multiplayer maps!
Choose your fighter
Pick from one of three classes that best suits your gameplay style:
Recon: Low health, but fast and agile with a high powered shotgun and rapid tunnel-digging shovel. A good Recon can leverage their movement and firepower to make up for their low HP and come out on top even against the toughest opponents, all while digging strategic routes with their shovel to assist their team.
Construction: Able to build complex schematics, Construction players massively enhance their team's defences. They are equipped with a special hybrid sniper/assault rifle: the sniper mode can be devastating at long range to players that let their guard down, while the assault rifle mode is vital to staying alive in a pinch.
Destruction: High HP and low mobility, Destruction players are an explosive powerhouse with a grenade launcher and throwable dynamite. No defence is strong enough to stop their wrath, and any player caught off guard will be quickly turned to gibs.
Prepare your defences
Create key strategic pathways and hidden tunnels as Recon, build bases for your team as Construction, and ready yourself for the battle...
Battle
Engage in tense matchups against your enemies. The best players must use every tool at their disposal to come out on top in fights, even if the odds are stacked against them.
Win.
Collect gold from foes that you defeat and take it to your vault! The team with the most gold in their vault at the end of the match wins - but be careful not to let the enemies in, lest they take your gold from right under your nose!
Features
Proximity-based voice chat.

title: Kosmos Connections
description:
게임 정보
"In this story, the choices you make only matter as much as you want them to.

Your perception of these events will determine your outlook on what transpires.

'There is no such thing as a subjective truth…

only interpretations of an incomplete picture.'”

✧*:・ﾟ✧*:・ﾟ✧*:・ﾟ✧*:・ﾟ✧ *:・ﾟ✧

“Kazuhira Hatanaka is the man behind the Soul Uplink, a machine that uploads people’s souls to a digital world called the Datascape. However, when his assistant Nona runs the first test, it all goes wrong. She finds something in the Datascape that shouldn’t be there; something that gave her a sense of loss…” …At least, that’s the story of Uplink Alethia, the visual novel that Tau, your childhood friend, has created.


Welcome (back) to Kosmos, Adelfos! After being away for a long time, you return with your sister Runia for the final week of your winter vacation. With no hesitation, Tau asks you and Jennavieve, the mysterious café owner, to bug-test her game. Kosmos Connections contains two visuals novels in one – the short story of Uplink Alethia, and the fuller narrative that is Kosmos Connections. You must choose to spend your time wisely in order to build up your connections or even rekindle some. At the same time, you are helping out Tau by giving feedback on her game, experiencing a new chapter each day to analyze and discuss. Will you find out the truth of Kosmos, or forever be complacent where you stand?

title: The Realm of Order: Arisen
description:
게임 정보
Enter the kingdom of Mythuras: a proud and mighty human kingdom, and face the greatest threat that the land has yet to see. The dead themselves have arisen.
EXPLORE AND EXPERIENCE THE KINGDOM
Every area of Mythuras is open for exploration. Speak with citizens, inspect items and explore hidden areas to learn the story of the kingdom that you fight for.
There are no right path to saving Mythuras - you must pick the one you deem the safest, fastest or most empowering.
CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF COMBAT
Whether you are a vicious warrior wielding a sword and plate armour, a swift archer who excels in ranged combat or even a great sorcerer with great intellect, you can always get stronger. Buy new weapons and protection from the merchants scattered across the land, or search for them yourself in the darkest corners of the forests.
WORK TOWARD YOUR GOAL
With so many paths to take and so many ways to improve, play through the undead crisis over again, and find the best possible way to save Mythuras. Whether it makes you stronger, faster or perhaps most knowledgable.
MADE TO FEEL LIKE A CLASSIC GAME
The Realm of Order: Arisen is specifically designed to look, sound and feel like a game from years ago. With many old technologies researched and simulated, experience nostalgia without replaying a game from the past.

title: Forgotten Fragments
description:
게임 정보
The Spheres Are the Key
Use the spheres power to light the torches and complete the level. But it won't always be easy: you'll need to aim your throws well and launch them before the time limit runs out...
Two Campaigns, Two stories
Uncover Enid's story as you recover the forgotten fragments, or team up with a friend to unravel all the secrets of the two-player campaign. Each campaign has its own levels!
Over 120 Levels to Conquer
Each campaign features 4 worlds to explore, with over 60 levels each. But the challenge doesn't end there, as you can replay each level to improve your time and become the best!
At the end of each world, you'll face a powerful boss, each with their own unique mechanics. Get ready to apply everything you've learned during your adventure to emerge victorious in these battles.
Find the hidden collectibles in some levels to unlock skins and customize your characters. Make sure to explore every corner: to play the secret levels, you'll need to light special torches...

title: Desert Pirates
description:
게임 정보



GAME DESIGN documents will soon be released to the community. If you're curious or interested, you'll get to know EXACTLY what we're building!
Features:
Cars convoy
Primary weapon variety
Secondary weapon (missiles)
Dynamic Zoom
RAM damage
Speed boost
Command Orders
Upgrade cars and weapons
Collect Cars
Find skins
Expand your convoy
World
2 fighting tribes w/ several cars and features each
1 trading tribe w/ several shops
Environment destruction
4 resources to obtain + credit coin + tech
Strategic levels
Eternal Ride
Experience:
You lead a Convoy through the Desert.

The game involves driving and battling through zones to gather enough resources to sustain your journey as far as possible, all while having a BLAST of fun. Creating a game that can be played "" forever might seem like a foolish idea, but somehow, it's working! (If not us, then who?)

This game is the result of collaboration among three industry colleagues, each with a background in different studios across various eras, some of which we share. We're devoting our spare time to this endeavor. Though it's a gradual process, it's unfolding beautifully.

Our goal is to create a genuinely enjoyable and scalable game that players can engage with over the long term. By continuously adding new content along the journey, we're crafting an experience that players can wholeheartedly immerse themselves in.

title: Dead Static Drive
description:
게임 정보
Grand Theft Cthulhu

Dead Static Drive is Grand Theft Cthulhu. An indie survival-horror game following a nightmarish road trip across a 1980s Americana. Playing as prodigal-child Hearst, you need to scavenge, fight, sneak, and explore in order to figure out what’s happened to your parents, and the rest of the world. Evade police. Equip yourself and those close to you, and follow your own moral code.  Learn how—and who—to trust. And learn it fast, the monsters are gaining on you.

Dead Static Drive blends weird fiction and uncanny Eldritch themes with a spooky unease underlying this small-town life.
Heavily influenced by the work of weird fiction authors T. E. D. Klein, Gene Wolfe, & Ramsey Campbell, filmmaker David Lynch, and photographer William Eggleston, Dead Static Drive hopes to invoke images of an America now lost, where with the right car and enough gas, anything felt possible.

title: Kiosk Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Kiosk Simulator is an action-packed comedic take on the hustles of running a big city kiosk and the nostalgia of reaching that lone open kiosk on a rainy late night.
Roleplay
Take on the role of a kiosk’s owner in Cologne, Germany.
Restock, serve customers, maintain and protect your kiosk against robbery and vandalism!
Vibrant Cast and Dynamic Gameplay
Each customer could be a loyal customer, a potential shoplifter or even a troublemaker!
Difficulty Curve
Tougher antagonists/bosses might take away your hard-earned cash - so be prepared for a challenge!

title: Infinity Knights: Xross
description:
게임 정보
Whether you’re looking for a solo experience or to team up with friends and family, an unforgettable adventure awaits in Infinity Knights: Xross! Lovingly developed by three brothers, this multiplayer RPG immerses players in a lush fantasy world filled with rich lore and challenges. Form strong bonds and band together with allies to take on epic quests, craft powerful items, and challenge colossal bosses, where teamwork is your greatest weapon!
company: Timesea Studio, Saxon, Michael, and Tyrone Goodrick

title: Sealed Bite: Extended
description:
게임 정보


Emilia's family members start mysteriously vanishing, whisked away one-by-one as if by magic. Setting off to search the world for any traces of them, she is unceremoniously forced to do bidding of an ancient wolf spirit. Is the power Emilia gains from it free to be made her own? Are the spirits her allies, or is she being led astray? And is she even looking in the right place?

Embark on a fairytale metroidvania-style platforming adventure in pursuit of power, memories and truth!



Explore the beautifully handcrafted pixel-art world, from autumn forests to frigid mountain tops, caves, castles and more!
Hone your abilities as the memories of your lost family members come back, one by one - or prove you don't need "medicine" to persevere!



Features:




This, and more awaits you in the world both ethereal and unforgiving!

title: KILLDOZER SIMULATOR
description:
게임 정보
KILLDOZER SIMULATOR에서는 방탕한 노력을 펼치며 도시를 납작하게 만들고 권력과 대립하는 과정을 통해 갑옷 입은 불도저를 운전합니다. 차량을 업그레이드하고 파괴의 경로를 계획하고 전설적인 민중 영웅이 되어보세요.

파괴 가능한 환경: 완전히 파괴 가능한 환경에 당신의 흔적을 남기세요.

강렬한 탑다운 전투: 고위험 전투에서 정부 당국과 맞서 싸우는 스릴을 경험하세요. 전략과 화력을 이용하여 상대를 앞서가고 불리한 상황에서 살아남으세요.

차량 사용자 정의 및 업그레이드: 다양한 업그레이드와 사용자 정의로 당신의 킬도저를 멈출 수 없는 힘으로 변신시키세요. 방어력을 강화하고 무기를 강화하고 게임이 진행됨에 따라 차량을 새로운 도전을 이기기 위해 조정하세요.

title: Free Stars: Children of Infinity
description:
게임 정보
An Epic Space Adventure
Free Stars: Children of Infinity is an action-adventure game inspired by the golden age of science fiction, defined by its hopeful future, wondrous technology, and a grandiose galaxy filled with eclectic stories.

You are the captain of a mission to the farthest reaches of space, where you'll discover thousands of exotic worlds and dozens of alien denizens. Some are friendly, some are terrifying, and some are just plain weird.

It’s up to you to decide how to acquire allies, confront threats, and ultimately protect a universe still recovering from the onslaught of the terrible Ur-Quan overlords in this long-awaited sequel to The Ur-Quan Masters.

Be the Captain
As the sequel to The Ur-Quan Masters and adding modern touches, here’s what you can expect:
Experience a player-centered space saga. Reveal powerful truths about the universe, and an existential threat that can only be stopped by you.
Command your starship and navigate a living universe packed with story, danger, and mystery.





In Children of Infinity, humanity and its allies will voyage to an uncharted region of space, with hundreds of undiscovered stars. With an incomplete Star Map and fragmented clues, you will undertake a vital mission to discover the source of intergalactic tremors that are threatening the fabric of HyperSpace.

The universe is big, but you won’t be alone. You will meet a cast of colorful alien characters with their own unique personalities and motives.



Some will be willing to help you and will need your help in return. Other species may be less friendly. The choice of how to interact with them is always yours, and every alien is different from another. Get ready to be amazed, alarmed, and amused.

Every star on the map contains a procedurally generated planetary system. Many of them are uncharted, and several are quite strange. Your planet scanner will show you what to expect, and you will need to learn which planets have the resources you need.



Many planets deserve a closer look. You and your crew will navigate these untamed worlds in the planet lander, avoiding hazards, collecting resources, and investigating new mysteries.


Your story starts with a discovery from the far reaches of space, three years after you and your allies have overthrown the terrible Ur-Quan masters.

The New Alliance of Free Stars has detected an unnatural breach in HyperSpace, and it is only getting worse. This revelation throws you and your allies into a new adventure, towards an uncharted region of the galaxy filled with mystery.



Space isn’t all discovery and diplomacy. Alien encounters can easily start with a bang. The fast-paced, inertia-driven combat will feature more than 30 different starships, building upon the classic Super Melee action from The Ur-Quan Masters. Each starship has unique powers and characteristics, reflecting one of many distinct alien captains. This new game will feature all new ships and aliens, along with every ship from The Ur-Quan Masters (except the Slylandro Probe, for your safety).



No starships are created equal. Should you invest everything into a single, powerful battleship? Or do you want to spread your resources across a fleet of scrappy specialists? Every starship has its strengths and weaknesses, and you can get an edge by picking the right match-up, or by mastering your weapon of choice.



The standalone combat mode – Super Melee – returns for you to practice your combat skills, playing the game against a friend or AI combatant. Super Melee now supports more than just one-on-one play, with combat between multiple players, and unique modes where you battle against onslaughts of enemies.



Combat is challenging. You can avoid a battle by trying to flee, negotiate, or even delegate. Whether you're unsure of your combat skill or simply prefer to advance the story quickly, Cyborg Mode allows you to cede control to an AI and help you win.

The adventure is more fun with friends! Seamless drop-in multiplayer allows other players to join you and be part of the story.

For players who want competitive action, play online Super Melee matches in classic one-on-one battles. Or try special modes made for multiple players, with plenty of new twists.
Our technology supports game modding out of the box. Players will be able to create new ships, new critters, even whole new stories. Heck, you can even make an entirely different game with our tools.

We love modding, and we want players to try fun ideas we never thought of!

This game is a unique combination of strategy and simulation game with some economic elements. Do your best to run a hardware store while making enough money to keep your shop open. Manage every aspect of your shop and use your skills to make your shop the best in the town!!

Complete control over YOUR shop! Buy product and set their price.
