title: Mad Chess
description:
게임 정보
What is it?
Mad Chess is a game that maintains standard chess rules while adding 19 more unique factions to the game. Factions have the same pawns and king as classic chess, but the 4 other pieces, while having the same movement patterns, trade their reduced range for RPG abilities that break specific chess rules.
This makes Mad Chess easy to learn but hard to master. With 190 match-ups instead of 1, chess just got its biggest expansion pack in centuries. Madness? No. Mad Chess.
Twenty Factions, including:
Humans: Use the classic chess army that you all know with long-ranged units.
Mermaids: Bring the ocean with you by covering the chessboard with water.
Angels: Wield the Divine Light which grants protection & situational invincibility.
Dragons: Gain necrotic bonuses upon having your units captured.
Vampires: Consume your own troops to gain momentum & disturb enemy units.
Fairies: Protect your archers to capture enemies without moving from afar.
Key Features:
Adventure: 70+ missions campaign to help Princess Madeline vanquish the Silver Demons.
Versus: Play local games against a decent AI opponent (up to 1300 ELO) or another player.
Multiplayer: Play public or private games online against other players with custom rules.
Shop: Earn gold by playing to unlock factions and boards. (no microtransactions)

title: SYNCO PATH: 17 Days in Seclusion
description:
게임 정보
You’ve screwed up and are now sentenced to death in 17 days unless you can answer a single question. Dive into your dreams and endure isolation in a quest to uncover the truth hidden within your own insecurities. What could be more terrifying than being alone?
SYNCO PATH: The Seclusion System is a first-person narrative experience through the surreal mind of an isolated person who has forgotten a fundamental truth. Through dreams and nightmares, you will realize that reality is far more than the mind perceives.

title: NULLPTR
description:
게임 정보
nullptr is an action puzzle game that requires careful planning and precise execution. Once you're connected to one of the servers ports, you have 20 seconds to hack security systems, reprogram the server, evade sentinel programs and download data. Your goal is to find or create safe routes to download all databases in each server without being traced.
Hacking servers



You start each level disconnected from the server and must choose an open port to start your run. Ports are color coded and give you access to different parts of the server and also to different systems. Once connected to the server, you have the option to open more ports by installing backdoors that will give you additional entry points to attack the server.
Connection route



In order to download the server data, you must build a connection from an entry point to the database. The connection length determines the download time so it is wise to choose short routes. You will also need to evade security systems in your route, like firewalls that will block downloads. The route you take is also important to open gates in some servers. Data nodes included in a route contribute with their color to the connection profile that is used to match and open the gates.



Each server in the game is owned by one of the four megacorporations in the world of nullptr. In order to protect their data, each megacorporation has installed their own sentinel programs whose goal is to trace invaders and eliminate them. Fortunately, you are a hacker and once you understand how each program works, you can manipulate them by choosing specific routes or reprogramming the server using the stack memory.

title: Wicked Lands
description:
게임 정보
Kaboom! The Nexus? Shattered. Time? Cracked like a bad egg yolk. Your purpose? A cosmic mystery. Embark on a thrilling journey into a wicked fantasy realm that's as unpredictable as a caffeinated cat on a trampoline!
MASTER HYBRID WARFARE
Lead your motley crew of minions into fast-paced, tactical combat that will make your enemies question their life choices. Outmaneuver them, exploit their weaknesses and use your arcane powers to turn your minions’ strikes into critical hits - or at least keep them alive till tomorrow!


Get creative with a wide arsenal of magical mayhem. Make two units swap positions, raise a skeletal sidekick, persuade an enemy to switch sides or turn them into a walking bonfire with a sizzling fireball!

Thought you were done? Not so fast! A killing blow grants your minions an extra jab. Skillfully string together their attacks and your own spell-slinging to unleash gloriously orchestrated kill-streaks!
LOOT & PLUNDER
Equip your minions with dazzling items, expand your arcane arsenal with fresh spells, and get your hands on artifacts that rewrite the rules of the game! Every faction hoards their own unique loot, but be warned - you’ll have to pry it from their cold, dead hands!
EMBRACE FATE
Embrace the double-edged sword of fate! As dawn cracks and dusk falls, it's time to draw a Fate Card. Each one introduces new, deadly foes or other challenges to your run. But don’t despair! Finish the quests they come with and get rewarded with new minions, bonus mana or other powerful upgrades. Only with these will you stand a chance to survive the escalating chaos and make it to the final Fate Card draw - giving you a shot at defeating one of the legendary bosses!
Barter for arcane knickknacks with the Bog Witch, hit the jackpot at the Pixie Casino or lay an offering before the monument of Sparkles - the infamous Catmancer, whose loyalties change faster than you can say "hairball.” Discover unique landmarks and denizens ranging from grudgingly civil to suspiciously friendly, offering boons such as spell-cloning, eldritch insurance or some mushrooms to give your minions a psychedelic edge in battle!
Discover why the Nexus went kaboom, find out who you really are, and maybe - just maybe - break the time loop that grips the Wicked Lands!
New combinations of minions, items, artefacts, spells and factions and a randomly generated map offer a fresh experience as well as new challenges every time you play. Daily runs and leaderboards make sure that you’ll have plenty of reasons to come back for more!

title: Bittersweet Birthday
description:
게임 정보


You wake up...dazed, and with no memories. As you ask yourself where you are and how you got there, a strange voice breaks through the speaker system offering you a way out. Unstable individuals are hunting you down and it looks like your only chance of escape...is to listen...



Bittersweet Birthday is an action game where every combat encounter is a challenging and unique experience. Learn your enemy's patterns, plan your movements and tear down your opponent in fierce battles that combine Soulslike dodge roll mechanics with bullet hell mayhem.





Outside of battle, uncover the mysteries surrounding your past through exploration and a colorful cast of characters. Complete side quests and discover secret items to unlock Memories that affect your style of combat. Good or bad, use these mementos to lighten the load or add extra challenge to your encounters.

Among the traumas and the broken memories, gather up the pieces of your past and get ready... You've got a birthday party to attend!

title: Rhythm Towers
description:
게임 정보
음악은 Planet Rhapsody의 고동입니다. 그루비한 곡들이 지속적으로 블루그래스 꽃밭을 통해 울리고, 유령 같은 황무지를 가로질러 메아리치며, 험준한 산맥 위로 울려 퍼집니다. 이러한 음악적인 곡들은 신비로운 AlgoRhythm을 보호하고 유지시키는데, 이것 없이는 Planet Rhapsody는 조용한 심연으로 붕괴될 것입니다.
이제 AlgoRhythm은 초자연적인 힘에 의해 분노에 휩쓸린 생명체들의 위협에 노출되어 있고, 당신의 도움이 필요합니다.
그래, 당신은 큰 성공을 이루지 못한 외계인 팝 그룹일지라도, 이런, 아이야, 당신에게는 용기가 있어. 그리고 비트를 유지할 수 있어. 음악이 당신의 세계니까 - 그래서 당신이 그것을 구해야 해.
음악으로 구축됨
다른 순서와 위치에 타워를 설치하여 독특한 교향곡을 만듭니다. 당신이 건설하는 각 Rhythm Tower는 사운드트랙에 새로운 음악 레이어를 동적으로 추가하여, 각 레벨의 음악적 풍경을 극적으로 변경합니다. 새로운 환경을 탐험하면서, 편안한 Lo-Fi 힙합부터 강렬하고 박진감 넘치는 드럼 앤 베이스까지 다양한 템포와 독특한 스타일의 새로운 음악 장르에 맞춰 춤추세요.

title: Rusty Rangers
description:
게임 정보
[용감한 레인저 팀을 제외하고는 아무도 이전의 세상이 어땠는지 기억하지 못합니다. 이제 혼돈과 예측 불가능성이 모든 곳을 지배하고 있으며, 과거에는 무해했던 생명체가 파괴를 가져오고, 주변 세계는 끊임없이 변화하며 익숙한 환경을 무력화시키고 있습니다.
고전적인 게임플레이와 현대적인 메커니즘의 결합

여러분은 세상을 구하기 위해 달리고, 점프하고, 쏘는 등 바쁘게 지낼 수 있는 많은 독특한 적들을 만나게 될 것입니다! 레인저마다 전투 스타일과 특수 기술이 다르므로 자신에게 가장 적합한 영웅을 선택할 수 있습니다!
아름다운 픽셀 그래픽
러스티 레인저의 세계는 상세한 세계, 독창적이고 다채로운 캐릭터, 유용한 아이템 및 기괴한 생물로 가득합니다. 각 픽셀은 큰 사랑으로 만들어졌습니다. 러스티 레인저의 아름답고 놀라운 세계를 즐겨보세요!

title: Cursed Night
description:
게임 정보
저주받은 밤은 1-5명의 플레이어를 위한 멀티플레이어 호러 게임입니다. 마법 능력을 사용하여 악마를 물리치거나 악마가 되어 복수를 추구하세요. 고양이의 도움을 받아 부적을 찾고 힘을 모으며 영혼을 해방하거나 어둠의 힘을 선택하여 모두를 죽일 수 있습니다.
한 때 너희 중 하나였던 적
당신이 어둠의 마법 연구를 함께 시작한 친구가 어둠의 힘에 빠져 악의 영향을 받게 되었습니다. 이 악마는 그가 인간이었을 때 처량하던 학교와 같은 장소들을 저주하고 그 안에 거주하는 영혼들을 포획하고 있습니다.
고양이와 함께
각 플레이어는 마법의 고양이를 가지고 있으며, 이 고양이는 플레이어가 부적을 찾는 데 도움을 줍니다. 고양이들은 색깔을 변경하고 울음소리로 부적을 찾는 데 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.
당신은 더 이상 무방비 상태가 아닙니다
당신은 어둠의 마법과 관련된 젊은이들의 그룹 중 한 명입니다. 지도상의 임의의 장소에서 찾을 수 있는 부적들 덕분에 당신은 마법 능력을 얻게 되며 이를 이용하여 악마와 생물들에 맞설 수 있습니다.
마법 능력은 강도에 따라 두 가지 단계로 구성되어 있으며, 이를 통해 당신은 적에 대해 더욱 강력해질 수 있습니다.

title: Rules of Alchemy
description:
게임 정보

Rules of Alchemy is a spell combo roguelike with thousands of items, deep rpg systems, fast-paced strategic combat, and a procedurally generated world full of secrets. Mix your spells with each other, the environment, and your weapon, as you master thousands of combinations to decimate your foes!
MASTER THE ELEMENTS
Unlock over 100 spells on the Runegate and discover even more hidden spells as you play the game. In Rules of Alchemy spells are cast by combining other spells in real time. This unique system will have you experimenting with tons of different loadouts. Learn to counter enemy spells and turn them into your own. You can even use the environment or items as part of your combo.
Find your perfect playstyle among the 9 classes and their weapon types. From sword and shield, to dual lances, each weapon class provides a unique combat system that evolves the further you progress in the game. Experience the unique combo system and master every weapon’s perks and techniques. Discover legendary weapons and use them to augment your spells, reach hidden areas, and defeat secret bosses.
Craft, transmute, trade, equip and level up thousands of procedural items. Combined with a deep rpg stat system, a massive spell tree, and 7 procedural biomes, Rules of Alchemy will have every run feeling fresh and exciting. Meet a wide range of NPCs and access different rare items, epic quests, boss fights and climatic endings, all based on the dialog, items, and stats you choose.
A dark force has corrupted the land and the torn have begun to invade. It is said only the Philosopher's Stone can repair this broken world and drive out the dark forces. Discover the mysteries of an ancient people and seek out answers to your immortality. Unlock the power of the runegate and find the traitorous alchemist within your ranks.

title: Immune Simulator Type Z
description:

The story describes a world in which humans are fighting against zombies and losing. The female protagonist accidentally finds an old computer with software that records the process of human-zombie conflicts, much like historical documents.

The protagonist attempts to operate the computer and view these historical records but discovers that the historical data can be changed. After leaving the machine, the balance of power between humans and zombies in the real world also changes. Just as she thinks she can use this machine to turn the tide against the zombies, her companions begin to change one by one.

Is this machine a salvation from God or a trap from the devil? What secrets are hidden in this machine? It's up to the player to discover.

title: BRUTALIST

게임 정보
There is a world among you, a world that consists of abandoned concrete jungles, full of mysteries, dangers and secret passages. Your main enemy is polluted air, so along the way you will have to look for oxygen cylinders, this will add to the challenge!
Somewhere far away, there is a green paradise, but can you reach it?
The main feature and idea of the BRUTALIST is to enjoy the environment, especially for fans of post-apocalypse and minimalist concrete architecture. Narration through the environment, that's what awaits you.
Main features of the Game:
No mini map or flashing pointers on the whole screen, just environment and the goal of going to the green oasis while exploring the mystery of the dead concrete world.
The element of survival is the need for oxygen, collect cylinders with this source of life along your path, go in the wrong direction - most likely you will lose...
For greater immersion in the world, game does not have a classic interface, the only indicator is the oxygen level on the cylinder behind the player.
The world is also dangerous with many sources of radiation, the main character has a counter, it will show with a sound signal how close you are to death.
Collect bits of the history of the world from the environment, and you will find out what happened.

title: Cupid Island
description:
게임 정보



큐피드 아일랜드에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 커플을 만나게 하고 그들의 관계를 육성하는 귀여운 생활 시뮬레이터입니다. 큐피드로서 여러 다른 커플을 발견하고 그들의 사랑 이야기를 돕게 될 것입니다. 사랑, 기쁨 및 열정이 사랑스러운 주민들에 의해 생산되어 섬을 만들고 사용자 정의하고 확장할 수 있습니다.

큐피드 화살로 다양한 커플을 만들기 위해 인간 세계를 탐험합니다. 그들을 큐피드 아일랜드에 살게 할 수 있습니다!

사랑스러운 주민들과 이야기하고 그들의 성격을 알아보고 선물을 줍니다. 더 행복한 사람들은 더 많은 사랑을 만들고 그들의 관계를 개선할 것입니다.
섬에서 사람들이 생산하는 사랑, 기쁨, 열정 및 기타 좋은 감정을 수집하여 확장하고 데이트 및 다양한 재미있는 활동을 위한 멋진 장소를 만듭니다.
섬, 집 및 사람들의 외모를 사용자 정의할 수 있습니다. 꿈의 커플은 누구인가요? 여기서 만들 수 있습니다!
게임에 고유한 시각적 요소를 추가할 수 있습니다. 캐릭터 외모 및 재생 목록에서의 모드 지원은 이 경험을 진정으로 자신만의 것으로 만듭니다! 플레이하면서 좋아하는 노래를 들을 수 있습니다!
아침에는 편안하게 농사를 지을 수 있고 낚시하고 요리할 수 있습니다. 하지만 흥미로운 밤에는 춤을 춰, 노래를 부르거나 축구를 할 수도 있습니다!
열심히 일하는 큐피드 아일라의 이야기를 따라가면서 그녀가 스스로에게 포함되기 위해 편안하고 환영받는 공동체를 구축하는 과정을 지켜보세요. 아마도 그녀는 이곳에서 진정한 사랑을 찾을 수 있을까요?

이 게임은 Ancine (브라질 영화 기관), BRDE 및 FSA와의 협력을 통해 자금을 지원 받았습니다. 이는 브라질 정부의 투자입니다.

title: Duil
description:
게임 정보
스토리:
Targat 왕국은 Vezruvil이 이끄는 언데드 침략군에 의해 파괴되었습니다. 여러분의 가족은 처형되어 개에게 던져졌습니다. Duil은 구금되어 고통을 받을 운명이었습니다. 하지만 아무것도 영원히 지속되지 않습니다. 영웅은 족쇄에서 풀려납니다. 여러분은 Vezruvil 성으로 가서 어둠의 왕을 파괴해야 합니다.
게임플레이:
Duil은 불멸입니다. 패배하면 미로로 들어가 탈출구를 찾아 이전 위치로 돌아가야 합니다. 모든 게임 진행 상황은 저장되지만 인벤토리에서 아이템 하나를 잃게 됩니다.
 게임이 진행됨에 따라 스토리가 전개됩니다.
지도를 탐색하고 NPC와 대화하고 비밀과 숨겨진 방을 찾으세요.
정보를 찾고 게임의 신비한 세계의 역사를 알아보세요.

title: Bike Baron 2: The Art of Riding
description:
게임 정보



Bike Baron 2 is a wild motorbike racer built for time attack. It blends physics-based gameplay, pixel-perfect controls, and mad level design into a game that lives from all the faceplants, uncountable retries, and relentless breaking of records.

The path to the new record is simple. You hit a section, and try to improve it.

Land too far.
Crash.
A little out of balance.

Forty attempts later, you're consistently two tenths faster. Do the same for the last loop in the level, then string it all together for a time that—by some small miracle—ends up just under 37 seconds. That's #4 overall. And there's still that early section to work on!

This game is perfect for those who just know they can squeeze one tiny fraction more out of their run.

Dozens of extraordinary tracks. Varying in difficulty, style, and pacing, each 30-120 seconds in length, some of them quite outrageous.
Ghost runs. Not only to know how fast you're going in comparison, but also to get a look at how others are making their records.
Leaderboards. See where you stand in a competition between friends or—if you're that good—among the world elite at the very top of the standings.

Grab your helmet and let's start breaking records!
autokwd: Bike Baron 2: The Art of Riding

title: Folk Emerging
description:
게임 정보




Lead nomadic families through the dawn of time in this turn-based 4X strategy game with deeply simulated characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the vast wilderness, gather and trade scarce resources, and stand your ground in risky tactical combat. Discover fire, medicine, language—and survive to tell the tale.

Experience what prehistoric life was like by diving into this exploration of ecology, paleolithic societies, and the origins of culture.





Before agriculture and settlements, we spent hundreds of thousands of years as nomadic hunter-gatherers. Guide your people as you migrate through harsh climates, each posing unique challenges.





Manage the relationships between individuals, families, and tribes. Watch your collective adapt over countless generations. Beware the unintended consequences current choices can have on your great-great-great-grandchildren.





Take calculated risks on the battlefield, because a warrior is not just a warrior. When one falls in combat, the tribe loses not only a fighter but also a skilled hunter, family member, and carrier of hard-won wisdom passed down through the ages.





Hunt, gather, and extract resources from the ecosystems around you, but tread carefully: nature is ruthless and you are at its mercy. Maintain the natural equilibrium or face sudden and unexpected challenges.

title: VRSO: Bare Knuckle Fighting
description:
게임 정보
VRSO stands for Virtual Reality Sport Organization. Our vision is to create highest quality sports game based on the physics simulation for the virtual reality.

Locations
The game is set in a world of existing abandoned locations thanks to photogrammetry technology.

Singleplayer
It is based on the concept of a tournament with a backstory, where the player will have to beat 16 players to become the champion of the VRSO league. Each opponent has different skills and fighting style, and thus poses a different level of difficulty.

Cutting edge movement technology
All animations have been created using motion capture technology – in cooperation with professional fighters. As a result, our in-game opponents have all the necessary fighting skills – such as offensive and defensive movement, distraction, dodging, blocks, pivots, fades, attacks, combos.

Traning mode
A lot of emphasis is placed on the training mode, where the player is able to configure their opponent. This is an extremely useful option also for professionals, who will be able to decide how offensive or defensive the opponent is and set all the parameters of the opponent’s other features and behaviors – reflexes, speed, stamina, character and other.

Multiplayer
In addition to the single player campaign, the game features an advanced multiplayer

title: Little Cheese Works
description:
게임 정보
Get the cheese back to the goal within the time limit!
Work together with 2 to 4 people to clear the game.
This game includes voice chat function!
Cat will wake up if it hears footsteps or voice chat!
If a cat found me, it would be terrible...

title: Grimrain MMORPG
description:
게임 정보
Awakening in a forest clearing rescued by a passing Ranger, you begin your journey to discover what happened to your friends and family, and what stirs under the villages and cities of Grimrain. Explore the lore of the world through a variety of story quests, follow treasure maps across mountains and tundra to unearth loot, powerful foes and mysterious dungeons.
CLASSES
Barbarian - With sword and shield! Smash your enemies and defend your party members.
Wizard - Build your selection of ranged magical spells to inflict damage.
Corsair - Arrr! Play as a bloodthirsty pirate adept in the ways of guns, cutlasses, and loot.
Sage- Heal your friends and use crowd controlling abilities to fight on your terms.
Templar - Link together melee abilities to heal your party and deal incredible damage.
Cultist - Harness the powers of the occult to overpower, confuse and incapacitate your enemies.
ALT FRIENDLY
Progress towards reputations and exploration is shared across all your characters on the server, and with a combined item stash and bank, it's even easier to create multiple characters and try every class.
CRAFTING AND GATHERING
Gather materials from around the game world and craft them into potions, weapons, armour, enchants, trinkets, and more.

Current professions:
Mining - Gather stone, ores, and gems.
Botany - Collect and identity herbs and roots for cooking or brewing.
Brewing - Boil up potions, remedies and tinctures.
Smelting - Turn ores into metals and magical alloys.
Armour smithing - Create combat clothing out of metal or leather.
Cooking - Create delicious stews, hearty meals, and rejuvenating drinks for yourself and your party.
Create a party of friends and fight through caverns, caves, and forests, guarded by dungeon bosses and their underlings. Instance scaling allows flexible party sizes and compositions
Located around the game world, these dungeons provide a challenge that can tackled solo, with friends, or with other adventurers you meet along the way.

title: Operation Terra
description:
게임 정보
Operation Terra는 절차적으로 생성된 레벨과 맵이 있는 공상과학 1인칭 슈팅/롤플레잉 게임입니다.
당신을 막으려는 끈질긴 기계들과 싸우는 동안 새로운 지구인 테라에 인류가 정착할 길을 닦으세요.
싸움

무엇이든 불가능하게 만드는 것이 유일한 목표인 드론, 드로이드, 로봇, 탱크, 포탑과 싸우세요. 보너스와 파워업을 수집하세요.
탐험

거의 무한한 절차적으로 생성된 맵과 레벨 레이아웃을 탐험하세요.
모든 플레이가 똑같지는 않습니다.
업그레이드

미션에서 약탈한 크레딧으로 무기와 장비를 업그레이드하세요. 기지에서 영구 업그레이드를 구매하세요. 기지의 새로운 부분에 접근할 수 있는 허가를 받으세요.

최종 게임은 30개의 고유한 적, 6개의 서로 다른 환경, 전체적으로 30개의 고유한 타일 세트를 특징으로 하며, 각각은 2~4개의 서로 다른 텍스처 세트와 절차적으로 매치되어 다양성과 재생성을 더했습니다.

title: Slyders
description:
게임 정보

In order to survive 15 minutes of merciless attacking waves of demons, you must become an unstoppable force of destruction. Choose from a variety of active and passive abilities, summon powerful allies, place deadly turrets, collect special weapons, fight mighty Bosses and more. Switch between different characters and equip them with unique items to create a build that fits your playstyle.
Story

Sky World is an endless heaven with hundreds of inhabited floating islands, each with its own people and culture. But now, an evil overlord with his demon army has attacked the once peaceful realm and is spreading chaos and corruption.
Fortunately, a group of brave resistance fighters from all over Sky World has combined their forces to liberate each island from the evil influence.

You play as Aryx, a fearless fox fighter who is accompanied by his supersonic turtle mount and Brian, a tiny but wise bear with a jetpack. Together, the heroic trio steps up to face the entire demonic war machine.

title: Highreach
description:
게임 정보
고대의 위험한 마법이 현실의 틀을 뒤흔드는, 한때 위대했으나 이제는 산산이 조각나 떠다니는 대륙 하이리치의 잃어버린 세계로 발을 들여보세요.
생존과 전략이 만나는 이 잊혀진 세계를 탐험하세요. 전투와 제작을 통해 캠프를 번영하는 정착지로 발전시키며, 개성 있는 동료들을 만나고, 공동체를 관리하며, 당신의 여정을 형성하는 개인 퀘스트를 수행할 수 있습니다. 건설하고, 생존하며, 하이리치의 비밀을 밝혀낼 준비가 되셨나요?
나만의 비공정을 건설하고 잊혀진 공중 섬들로 이루어진 대륙을 탐험하세요. 다양한 기술로 비공정을 확장하고 업그레이드하여 공중 기지로 활용할 수 있습니다. 친구 및 정착민들과 함께 하늘을 탐험하세요.
다양한 액티브 스킬과 마법을 활용한 독특한 전투 스타일을 경험하세요. 공유 가능한 아이템을 통해 다양한 전투 방식을 자유롭게 전환할 수 있습니다. 진행도는 그룹 내에서 공유되므로, 늦게 합류한 플레이어도 아이템을 장착하여 즉시 따라잡고 전투에 뛰어들 수 있습니다.

title: Dead Meat
description:
게임 정보
Unleash your inner detective in Dead Meat - a murder mystery interrogation game where you can ask the suspects literally anything, using voice or keyboard!
Dive into a macabre conspiracy of burgers and billionaires, getting up-close and personal with an eccentric cast of cold-blooded killers.
Want to discuss their alibi? Probe them on the meaning of life? Confess your love? Or just troll them mercilessly? Your words hold power, and anything goes. Persuade them, manipulate them, threaten them, or even charm them into spilling their secrets.
The Interrogation room is your sandbox, and your imagination is the only limit. What will you ask to get to the truth?

title: Follow The Rules
description:
게임 정보
In Follow the Rules you step into the role of a night shift guard entrusted with the protection of different sites, each with its own mysteries and hauntings. The game delivers a truly immersive and suspenseful horror experience where the core focus is on adherence to a straightforward but critical set of rules.

Diverse Locations: Each night brings a new place to safeguard, from the hushed library filled with ancient books to the grand theater and the museum housing captivating relics.

Realistic Night Shift: Experience the eerie, quiet, and haunting ambiance of the night shift with graphics and sounds that plunge you into the role of a night guard.

The Vital Rules: Your lifeline rests on following a precise set of rules. Violate them, and you'll face the sinister and enigmatic entities lurking in the darkness.

Supernatural Challenge: Encounters with the paranormal, unexplained events, and unsettling encounters will keep you on edge.

Survival at Stake: Follow the Rules challenges you to remain obedient to the rules and endure through each night shift.

title: Building Relationships
description:
게임 정보


As the new arrival to the island, you're here to meet eligible bachelorx pads and find the love of your life! Enjoy a one-of-a-kind story as you navigate a bizarre dating adventure amongst a unique set of structures.
Uncover hidden secrets!
A variety of biomes across an island, jam-packed with goodies! Search through a somber forest, climb up a snowy mountain, or just lay in a flowery field.

Realistic building movement!
We always thought "the one thing missing from dating sims is the ability to wave-dash". So we added it!

Looking to shack up? Meet structures like Millie (a windmill who might step on you if you ask nicely) or Tenet (who's just a himbo tent).

They say there’s plenty of fish in the sea… but you won’t find any around here. We replaced all the fish with cars because it just made more sense.

Wishlist the game and join our discord to stay up-to-date!

title: RX10-40
description:
게임 정보
『RX10-40』(RX ten forty)은 3인칭 슈팅 게임입니다.

『RX10-40』의 특징
간단하고 선형적이며 정통적인 TPS입니다.
총으로 쏘고, 방패로 방어하고, 곤봉 스턴건으로 근거리 공격을 하고, 슈퍼 어택으로 마무리합니다.
사격 시 위아래를 조준하는 동작을 금지함으로써 점프와 웅크리고 있는 동작을 장려하여 더욱 역동적인 플레이가 가능합니다.
레벨업 같은 건 없으므로, 오로지 플레이어의 실력에 달렸습니다.











친구 및 가족과 함께 강렬한 로컬 대전 모드를 즐기세요. 좌우 화면이 분할된 단일 화면에서 진행되는 전투는 향수 어린 광란을 만들어냅니다.



적들이 끝없이 나타나는 서바이벌. 최고 기록을 달성하면 라이벌에게 스크린샷을 보여주세요.






게임 스트리밍과 영상 배포와 관련하여서는 수익 창출 여부와 관계없이 자유롭게 하셔도 됩니다.

title: Deepy
description:
게임 정보
Deepy is an underwater complex built to host a maximum-security prison, where the most dangerous inmates on earth are forced to work extracting gold from the seabed.
No one cares about their condition, or what else is done inside the prison, as they are all sentenced to life imprisonment without appeal.
The shock will come in the second room, straight after opening the door, when you face the first corpse and a messy room. You' ll also have your first confrontation with the prisoners, and from them you will be aware an uprising occurred: the prison has been taken down. They are taking over many rooms looking for a way to escape and rise to the surface.

Your task? Fight, help survivors, search for objects and solve puzzles all in order to survive, escape and reach the surface.

title: Artemis VR
description:
게임 정보
Artemis VR is your ticket to becoming an astronaut in virtual reality! Step into the shoes of a member of the prestigious Artemis space program and put your skills to the test in the most realistic simulation of modern space travel. Do you have what it takes to lead your mission to success?
Experience thrilling moments, from managing day-to-day operations on board to handling critical situations—extinguishing fires, managing decompression, and even caring for sick crew members. Execute precise spacecraft maneuvers, dock at a space station, and embark on an unforgettable spacewalk (EVA). Artemis VR takes simulation to a whole new level with full immersion and realistic spacesuit experiences.
NASA resources and consultation - The game is under development i.e. thanks to NASA resources and consultation in terms of Artemis MIssions
Dynamic mission scenarios – each playthrough presents new challenges inspired by real-life emergency procedures in actual space missions.

title: Observe
description:
게임 정보

Forgotten in ominous rooms, you wander, you look and you solve. Collaborate with yourself to change the past, future and present by replaying your mistakes and creating new ones in this single-player puzzle game. Help your future self to push through, crack puzzles and explore the ethereal. Without yourself, you are left behind.

The game world consists of multiple worlds, each of which is made up of several interlinked rooms of which each contains a puzzle. As you solve, actions from previously completed rooms are replayed. Playthroughs of multiple rooms come together to overcome complex challenges. Thinking ahead to create valuable replays is crucial towards progress.

Solve puzzles using only your eyes. With your vision as the only tool at your disposal, watch as the world around you reacts to being observed.
Multiple worlds with distinctive puzzle mechanics such as lasers, mirrors, conveyor belts and duplicators.
Collaborate with many parallel versions of yourself from the past.
A captivating story about learning from regret.
By traversing through time, you are forced to witness your past mistakes. You confront your own regrets, along with learning about the mistakes of others throughout your journey. The rich environment you travel through is riddled with memories of regret, left behind for someone to listen to. Engage your mind not only through solving puzzles, but by listening to authentic real life stories.
company: Robin van der Horst, Eryk Kiepuszewski,

title: Eternity Guards
description:
게임 정보
The main idea of the game is a fantasy alternative to Valhalla. Scandinavian mythology is a thematic focus - the same style, ornaments and atmosphere where heroes fight for a place in eternity, there will be only one.

This is a world of magic and tactics.

Style - handpaint.

Battle Royale PVP fighting game with strategy elements.

On a small one map, from 2 to 6 players fight at the same time, who are divided into equal teams. Fast matches have a maximum duration of 10 minutes, so the maps are not big, but well designed for energetic battles with fun running around the map in the heat of magical effects.

Each map has all 4 times of year, all are available on the same map to increase variability.

At the end of each match, there will be a unique anti-cheat system based on feedback and ratings of players for the subsequent successful formation of the effective teams.

Before the battle, players appear in a room where they have 30 seconds to equip and buy clothes, weapons, bottles and recharge abilities.

There is an interaction with the environment in the form of teleports and places of interest (landslides, lava, waterfalls, lightning, tornado) that block the way and can inflict damage on the opponent.

The tactic is to activate the character selection circle (menu wheel) via a hotkey for the interaction: for enemies - magic, weapon strikes or debuffs; for allied characters - useful buffs, damage resistance, acceleration, healing etc.

There is a teleport on the map with an 5 sec activation delay, the next character can only be passed with the same delay. There is always some kind of artifact there, which you can use in this or in the next game only once.

There will be several characters in the game, including:
Viking - tank, human shield;



After the end of the fight, in addition to experience, which unlocks many different abilities, and in addition to game currency to unlock new weapons and elements of armor, there is also the opportunity to upgrade a room with weapons (fireplace, sparring partner, sofa, bar etc).

title: ARTIFICIAL
description:
게임 정보
ARTIFICIAL은 물리학에 기반한 1인칭 퍼즐 플랫폼 게임으로 Portal과 Half-Life 시리즈에서 영감을 얻었습니다. 본 게임의 배경은 포획되어 지구 궤도로 이송 중이던 소행성 2031XT의 지하 식민지로, 오염체의 출현으로 인해 이 운송 작업은 갑작스러운 방해를 받습니다. 이 오염체는 식민지 주민들을 공격하고 모든 생존자를 사냥하기 시작한 외계인 군체의식 개체입니다. 본 게임은 이 사건을 기점으로 몇 개월이 지난 시점에서 시작하며 고철 수집 임무를 마치고 돌아가던 플레이어가 숨겨진 최후의 생존자 기지로 돌아가는 과정을 담고 있습니다.
주변 환경과 상호 작용하면서 물체를 집어 던지고 적 주위에서 은밀히 행동하세요. 또한 물리학을 기반으로 하는 복잡한 메커니즘을 제어하고, 소행성 2031 XT의 지하 식민지에서의 생존법을 익히세요.
두말할 것도 없이 이 식민지 내의 무언가가 잘못된 게 틀림없습니다. 여러분은 사건의 한가운데로 던져지게 되는 플레이어로서 서서히 주변 세계에 관해 점점 더 많은 사실을 드러낼 것입니다.
지하 수천 미터 깊이를 여행하는 동안 많은 장애물과 함정을 마주하게 될 것입니다. 개중에는 다른 장애물이나 함정보다 더 치열한 두뇌 싸움을 요구합니다.

title: Ash & Adam's Existential Treads
description:
게임 정보
Part city builder, part retro vehicle shooter. Tear down the ruins of the old world and use what you find to build a settlement. Rescue survivors from the wastes. Defend your people against waves of attacks from the rogue AI that ruined the old world. Procedural levels and random build order make every run unique.
Carve your way through the post-post-apocalyptic sprawl to find valuable resources and rescue settlers.
Every building you construct and how you position it affects your settlement's chance of survival.
The dark remnants of humanity’s past are not friendly.
Work together with your community to restore each wasteland to its natural glory.

title: Gunjutsu
description:
게임 정보
GUNJUTSU
💥 TRICKSHOTTING IS BACK. This is for the ones who never stopped spinning.
GUNJUTSU is a tribute to the golden age of Trickshotting—built for those who lived through the OG console era and designed to feel just like the good old days.
🎯 Master the Art of Trickshotting
Work your way down the 'Trickshot Iceberg', a fully-fledged tutorial system that will teach you every skill.
⚡ A Perfect Balance of Skill & Creativity
For the OG Trickshotters: A game with depth, challenge, and variety.
For newcomers: A step-by-step system that helps you grow into a Trickshot master.
HOW IT PLAYS:
🔥 Stay Airborne – Earn points only while in the air—land, and your score resets!
💀 Trick & Shoot – You only bank points if you hit the target.
🧩 A Puzzle-Shooter Like No Other – Every level is an open-ended Trickshot puzzle.
🎮 Compete Worldwide with quantitative skills – Climb the global Leaderboards and prove you're the best Trickshotter alive.
🚀 Wishlist GUNJUTSU now.

title: Rules of Alchemy
description:
게임 정보

Rules of Alchemy is a spell combo roguelike with thousands of items, deep rpg systems, fast-paced strategic combat, and a procedurally generated world full of secrets. Mix your spells with each other, the environment, and your weapon, as you master thousands of combinations to decimate your foes!
MASTER THE ELEMENTS
Unlock over 100 spells on the Runegate and discover even more hidden spells as you play the game. In Rules of Alchemy spells are cast by combining other spells in real time. This unique system will have you experimenting with tons of different loadouts. Learn to counter enemy spells and turn them into your own. You can even use the environment or items as part of your combo.
Find your perfect playstyle among the 9 classes and their weapon types. From sword and shield, to dual lances, each weapon class provides a unique combat system that evolves the further you progress in the game. Experience the unique combo system and master every weapon’s perks and techniques. Discover legendary weapons and use them to augment your spells, reach hidden areas, and defeat secret bosses.
Craft, transmute, trade, equip and level up thousands of procedural items. Combined with a deep rpg stat system, a massive spell tree, and 7 procedural biomes, Rules of Alchemy will have every run feeling fresh and exciting. Meet a wide range of NPCs and access different rare items, epic quests, boss fights and climatic endings, all based on the dialog, items, and stats you choose.
A dark force has corrupted the land and the torn have begun to invade. It is said only the Philosopher's Stone can repair this broken world and drive out the dark forces. Discover the mysteries of an ancient people and seek out answers to your immortality. Unlock the power of the runegate and find the traitorous alchemist within your ranks.









***Many features listed are not available in the demo

title: Prophecy of Ashen
description:
게임 정보
Prophecy of Ashen is a medieval fantasy role-playing game (CRPG) set against a backdrop of magic, deep social conflicts, religious beliefs, and power struggles. Players will enter a world consumed by flames and ash, exploring the kingdom’s borders, the mysterious Ashen-descendant tribes, the corrupt church, and an impending disaster that threatens to engulf the entire continent.
In Prophecy of Ashen, you will play as a key messenger, navigating the kingdom’s political whirlpool and religious conflicts. By interacting with different factions and uncovering the secrets behind the Sacred Flame, you will face unavoidable choices: remain loyal to the kingdom and church’s orders, or side with the fanatical Ashen-descendants and challenge the societal status quo?
Key Features:
Rich Roleplaying and Choices: In a world filled with hostility and division, your decisions will shape the fate of the kingdom. Every choice you make will impact both your personal story and the larger world around you.
Unique Religious and Political Setting: Explore a kingdom deeply influenced by the faith of the Three Sacred Flames, experiencing conflicts born from racial and religious differences. By learning about the Ashen-descendant tribes and the Sacred Law Tribunal, players will be confronted with moral and spiritual challenges.
Tactical Turn-based Combat System: Engage in intense battles and strategic confrontations, using magic, weapons, and terrain advantages to defeat your enemies. Whether it’s quelling Ashen-descendant uprisings, defending against monster invasions, or resisting foreign expansions, you’ll need to make strategic decisions based on the changing tides of war.
Diverse Character Development: Shape your character's skills, magic, and gear based on your choices. You can choose to work with the church, becoming a warrior imbued with divine powers, or delve into independent magic to uncover the secrets of the Ashen-descendants, becoming a mysterious sorcerer.
Immersive World and Storytelling: Every piece of land in the game has its own unique story, and all events and characters are tightly connected to the kingdom’s past and future. Explore ancient ruins, mysterious villages, and cities ravaged by war and strife.
Game Background:
In the kingdom of Latalan, the fate of the Ashen-descendants is intertwined with that of the entire realm. Once tainted by the molten magma of the Demon Lord’s infernal volcano, seeking power at all costs, their descendants now bear the unclean flame, relegated to the fringes of society. However, during the war with the Frost Giants, the Ashen-descendants’ valorous efforts earned them the church’s forgiveness— allowed them to reenter society. Yet even with this, they have been driven to madness by continued discrimination and rejection.

title: Dark Farts: Parody Smell Edition
description:
게임 정보
EMOTIONAL DAMAGE INCOMING! The most ridiculously epic Souls-like parody ever created meets outrageous humor in this absolutely insane action-RPG! You're no chosen one – just a blacksmith with questionable bean-eating habits who accidentally gained ancient dragon powers. Now, you're humanity's last hope, and it's time to show these evil corporations what REAL power smells like!
UNLEASH THE POWER OF MAXIMUM GASITUDE!
🔥 Master the revolutionary "Gas-Souls" combat system – FART-DASH YOUR WAY TO VICTORY!
💥 Demolish epic bosses with over-the-top attacks and absurd finishers!
🌮 Feast on magical bean burritos for power-ups (now with 100% more dramatic zoom-ins!)
🕺 Strike fabulous poses while delivering devastating attacks!
💀 BECOME THE LEGEND that everyone talks about (but nobody wants to stand near).
FEATURING:
⚔️ Intense battles with tech billionaires and absurd villains!
🎭 A protagonist who won’t stop breaking the fourth wall!
💨 Weapons-grade dad jokes and ridiculous RPG mechanics!
🌟 Multiple endings based on your playstyle and gas-meter management!
READY TO BECOME THE HERO NOBODY ASKED FOR BUT EVERYONE CAN SMELL?
⚠️ Disclaimer: This game does not condone or promote negative stereotypes based on race, ethnicity, or nationality. Dark Farts: Parody Smell Edition is created purely for fun and humor—because we listen, we play, and we don’t judge.

title: !mrak
description:
게임 정보
!mrak is a first-person shooter with immersive sim elements set in an alternate 2003 Hokkaido, which became part of Russia in the mid-20th century. A techno-hub hidden behind neon signs and dark facades. Here, power is divided between corporations, intelligence agencies, and those who remain in the shadows.
You are a tool in someone’s game. Your goal is to find the target, eliminate them, and disappear. How? That’s your choice. Sneak across rooftops, hide in the shadows, disable cameras… or leave a bloody trail behind.
Freedom of approach and an interactive world: Hide in the dark, hack systems, or charge in headfirst. Guards, cameras, hidden pathways—use the environment to your advantage.
Tools:From makeshift implants to Soviet weaponry. Branching levels: Industrial complexes, skyscraper rooftops, underground clubs—find your own path.
A world caught between eras and cultures: Vintage electronics, the hum of CRTs, worn-out cassette tapes, and the cold lights of the metropolis. Soviet legacy, Japanese traditions, and Western influences create a unique atmosphere.

title: Kanji Grinder
description:
게임 정보
Kanji Grinder is a spaced repetition flashcard system, purpose-built for Steam Deck. Designed for immersion learners who want a no-nonsense way to drill Kanji vocabulary recognition, it provides a brisk, pleasant way to get through your daily reviews so you can get back to your media immersion ASAP. Additionally, for those who enjoy quiz games or flexing their knowledge, plenty of challenges await!
Features:
- Over 20,000 hand-curated flashcards, covering over 2,000 kanji in all their major readings. Words are taught based on frequency order - but you're always taught the kanji version first, even if it's less common than the kana version! Every card in the deck teaches at least one kanji. There's enough vocabulary here to take you all the way to JLPT N1, and beyond!
- A novel spaced repetition algorithm that improves upon the usual methods by dynamically adapting to your success or struggles. No more fiddling with interval rates or ease factors - it all adjusts automatically over time to suit your skill level. 
- Over ten hours of hand-picked, hand-mastered music by Japanese indie composers, in a wide range of styles: Lo-fi, Jazz, Bossa, Metal, JRPG OST, Shibuya-kei, J-core, Lounge and more! No matter the day's vibe, there is plenty to listen to as you grind. 
- Fully voiced flashcards and interface: Listening to spoken Japanese is crucial to effective memory formation and language acquisition - so every single flashcard in Kanji Grinder has a sound clip of correct pronunciation. Plus, a native voice actress will cheer you on in the menus!
- A custom monolingual-style dictionary: Unlike the usual Japanese-English dictionaries that just give you a few English words with similar meanings, these dictionary entries will actually explain what the word truly means, and provide example sentences. Each entry is available in both Japanese and English, so you can use it as a "J-J" style monolingual dictionary when you're ready!
- A deep ranking and achievement system: Work your way up from 10th-Kyu to Shodan, and from there, Ichidan and even Kaiden, with increasingly difficult certification exams that grow with your knowledge. There's always a next achievement right around the corner to work towards.
- Purpose-built for Steam Deck: Everything from the user interface to the control scheme and workflow were designed from the ground up to be played on Steam Deck, and the driving purpose of Kanji Grinder is to make SRS study feel like a video game. Developed on Linux, tested on Deck. Windows users welcome.
- Built-in immersion tracking: Keep track of all your immersion time - Anime, Manga, YouTube and whatever else you wish via the comprehensive time-tracking system. A pre-loaded, self-updating database of Anime and Manga titles makes tracking your watch-time and immersion level a breeze.

title: Beach Bar Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Beach Bar Simulator에 오신 것을 환영합니다!
아름다운 마이애미 해변에서 펼쳐지는 편안하면서도 도전적인 경영 시뮬레이션 게임! 당신만의 해변 바를 운영하며 손님을 맞이하고, 자원을 관리하며 작은 가게를 인기 명소로 성장시켜 보세요!
특징:
🛠️ 싱글 & 협력 모드 – 혼자서 즐기거나 친구와 함께 온라인 협력 플레이!
🍹 리얼한 바 운영 – 칵테일을 만들고, 손님을 맞이하며 만족도를 유지하세요.
🏝️ 커스터마이징 & 확장 – 바를 디자인하고, 장비를 업그레이드하여 완벽한 해변 분위기를 조성하세요.
💰 경제 & 전략 – 예산을 관리하고, 가격을 설정하며, 현명한 비즈니스 결정을 내리세요.
🎯 고객 반응 – 적절한 음료를 제공하고 최상의 서비스로 고객을 만족시키세요.
작은 해변 바를 세계적인 명소로 성장시킬 수 있을까요? 지금 바로 칵테일을 만들고, 서빙하며 성공을 향해 나아가세요! 🍹🏝️

title: Mikota
description:
게임 정보
The Dead Town
You wake up in a junkyard in a town frozen in time. The only survivors are people with mechanical parts, each trying to stay alive. As you explore the destroyed buildings - school, hospital, church - you slowly uncover what happened to this place, and discover who you really are.
Your choices shape what happens next. Face your past.
Key Features:
Atmospheric Retro Horror: Experience a psychological horror adventure with haunting visuals and a compelling narrative
Meaningful Choices: Your actions and decisions shape the story, leading to multiple endings that reflect your journey
Environmental Storytelling: Piece together the town's dark history through notes, photographs, and scattered memories
Complex Puzzles: Challenge yourself with puzzles that blend seamlessly with the narrative
Rich Character Development: Interact with survivors in a dead town, each carrying their own secrets and mechanical modifications

title: Pinball Hero
description:
게임 정보
An ensemble of heroes stumble into a creaky room, seemingly unguarded. They notice a silhouette in the dark room; linen cloth draped over a large object. They remove the cloth revealing a strange device of metal gizmos and gadgets. Upon the press of the button & the flick of a switch, the heroes are drawn into the device, emerging as shorter...stubbier versions of themselves.
Welcome to Pinball Hero.
This game is a reimagining of the Pinball genre, mixed with rogue-lite elements. Bump, hack & slash enemy bumpers with your Pinball Hero. Acquire new items and explore mysterious dungeons. Though a hero may fall in battle many times; determination, skill and powerful artifacts will ensure that future attempts to reclaim your hero spirit are successful.
Bump, bop and bash a multitude of enemies and bosses, inspired by retro and contemporary fantasy.
Fill your backpack to the brim with over 100 unique items that automatically trigger to augment your pinball battle experience.

title: Savage Gears
description:
게임 정보
Savage Gears는 2000년대 초반의 목표 지향적인 액션 게임에서 영감을 받은 폭력적인 싱글 플레이 FPS입니다.아이언 피스트와 파괴적인 무기 무기고 을 갖춘 당신은 두려움 없는 군인 Ero Lei'Bourne로 플레이하며, 대륙을 멸망의 위기에서 구하기 위한 위험한 임무를 수행합니다.
스토리
대체 역사인 동아프리카를 배경으로, 당신은 Ero Lei'Bourne의 여정을 따라가며 군비 경쟁 음모를 저지하기 위한 특수부대 작전에 참여하게 됩니다... 아니면 죽음을 맞이할 수도 있습니다.
특징
싱글 플레이 캠페인에서 강렬한 액션을 경험하세요.
다양한 허구의 공상 과학 영감을 받은 무기를 사용하세요.
아이언 피스트의 힘을 활용하여 적들을 물리치며 강렬한 1인칭 전투를 펼치세요.
끊임없이 몰려오는 용병, 드론, 실험적 돌연변이 병사들과의 역동적인 전투를 벌이세요.
포트 스페크에서 기차 레벨, 숲 환경 등 다양한 환경을 탐험하세요.

title: Tech Hustle
description:
게임 정보
Tech Hustle is a wild, fast-paced management sim where you turn a small tech shop into a booming empire! Juggle deliveries, haggle with customers, hire quirky employees, and upgrade to robots that handle it all—while you take a coffee break. But watch out! The black market offers juicy deals on rare tech… if you’re willing to bend a few rules. Will you play it safe or hustle your way to the top?
Run Online and Physical Store
Customize Store: Make your store look fabulous or hilariously awful—it’s your choice! Just be ready for customer reviews like, “Great prices, but what’s up with the neon toilets?”

title: Codename TCT
description:
게임 정보
The battle for the free city of Crimson Tide has begun.



Following the Crimson Reapers path of destruction lead to a state-wide revolution. You are a citizen from the lower levels of the mega city and you will do your part. Will you gather funds to escape the city amidst chaos, or grab the opportunity to scratch some leftovers...or possibly much more. Be warned though: the NRF forces have entered the city to bring back order, but the left over gangs, along with the C.T.P.D. and Kyoncha Security will have their own plans and agendas.



Codename TCT is a FPS with parkour and roguelite elements, where you will forge your own tale through the streets and underbelly of the crumbling mega city of Crimson Tide.

title: 千里山河录
description:
게임 정보
这是一款六边形拼图游戏，站在了同类型优秀作品巨人肩膀上的同时，也努力打造了一个拥有自己特色、能够为玩家游玩体验带来更多惊喜的作品。
透过时光的缝隙，用着900年前古朴的画卷风格，玩家通过自由创造，徐徐展开一幅幅水墨丹青风格的壮丽山水人间长卷。
玩家将与小千一同启程拜访中华美景与诗词古典，重新获得灵感再绘一幅当代的千里江山图。
以全自由拼图玩法为核心，融入剧情冒险与Roguelike挑战，让玩家在休闲放松的同时再次遇见百年前的山水人间之美

title: The Family
description:
게임 정보
The Family
– A Gritty Journey into the Dark World of 1950s Mafia Life

Step into the underworld of 1950s Bayford, Italy, where violence, betrayal, and power define the streets. In The Family, you assume the role of Tyler Jones, a down-and-out boxer struggling to make ends meet. Desperation leads him into the clutches of the notorious Cappello crime family, where the allure of easy money pulls him deeper into a world he never imagined.

As Tyler, you’ll navigate a dangerous path between two warring Mafia families—the Capellos and their bitter rivals, the Costellos. Will you rise through the ranks, gaining wealth and power beyond your wildest dreams, or will you fall victim to the greed and bloodshed that define this ruthless world?

Featuring 13 intense chapters filled with dramatic twists, brutal combat, and morally complex decisions, “The Family” challenges you to prove your loyalty, outmaneuver your enemies, and survive in a world where trust is scarce, and the stakes are deadly.

Do you have what it takes to thrive in this violent underworld, or will you be consumed by the very life you sought to escape?
The choice is yours—but remember, in the Mafia, every decision has consequences.

Key Features:
- Immersive 1950s Mafia setting in the heart of Bayford, Italy.
- Play as Tyler Jones, a struggling boxer turned Mafia enforcer.
- Experience a gripping narrative with 13 action-packed chapters.
- Explore a large open world filled with hidden secrets, dangerous opportunities, and vibrant characters.
- Navigate the complex web of alliances and rivalries between two powerful crime families.

title: Sunken Veins
description:
게임 정보
Sunken Veins is a management horror game set on a flooding underwater coal mine. Your job is to mine for coal whilst dealing with overwhelming floods of water and adaptive aquatic creatures that learn from the way you play.
MINING
Operate a deep-sea mining drill to extract coal and scraps. Whilst mining, the facility builds stress, which increases the chances of causing a flood. Find the balance between gathering resources and maintaining stress levels.
DRAIN
Floods in the facility will disrupt electronics and extend the length of your shift until they are dealt with. Large industrial drains will help you remove water and keep the water levels down.
MAINTAIN
A proactive approach can help you stay alive. Repair and reinforce ceiling vents. Fortify doors to stop water spreading. Whatever it takes to stop you from being overwhelmed.
ADAPTIVE CREATURES
You aren't alone. Predatory creatures have found their way into the mine after the company disrupted their home. They are smart, adaptive and very dangerous. How you play will influence the behaviours they use to hide, deceive and try to kill you.
TWITCH CHAT INTEGRATION
Connect your Twitch account to allow chat to influence the game. You can control which commands are available for chat to use, set cooldowns for them, and also set custom text prompts that triggers the commands. Some commands are helpful and some are disruptive. You can fully control which ones are available for your chat to use.

title: SPORTAL
description:
게임 정보
Bat, Strike, Kick and Smack balls into monstrous menagerie in this retro sport themed fps roguelike, where you are sucked into a portal and emerge with a plethora of sport equipment repurposed into an arsenal of lethal weapons.

- Use a variety of sporting equipment to defeat hordes of monsters straight from 50's era creature features by launching spiked baseballs, lightning infused hockey pucks, exploding golf balls, bladed bowling balls and more



- Find clues as to what happened when you went to your favourite cinema in your favourite mall just to wake up in the magical land frequented by nasties that you only believed existed on celluloid



- Pick up and upgrade the numerous clubs, bats, sticks and balls, outfits and perks to find the winning combinations of hardware and gear to have the best shot at getting rid of all the monstrosities thrown your way and maybe, just maybe, you will have a chance to make it back home

title: SOVIET SPOOKY TALES: Green Eyes
description:
게임 정보
"Eeny, meeny, miney, moe
Creepy GREEN EYES are on the wall.
Don't you think all this is joke,
Little girl is gonna choke!"
Have you ever heard of the cursed Green Vinyl? Or perhaps the Black Blanket is trying to kill you at night? Have you ever encountered a Blue Finger in a bun? The visual novel "SOVIET SPOOKY TALES: Green Eyes" is the first of five planned games set in the lore of Soviet children's spooky stories, where everything is real. The story follows a girl named Dasha from class 4th "B," who disobeyed her mother and listened to the green record. Along with her, you will confront a mysterious and terrifying evil, and it is up to you to decide what awaits her in the end. ^___^
