title: Spook-A-Boo
description:
게임 정보
Welcome cadets!
It’s time to team up with fellow ghost hunters and take a stand against the mischievous ghosts hiding across the galaxy. Travel through wacky worlds and dizzying dimensions in search of these troublemakers before they cause even more havoc.
Spook-A-Boo is a couch co-op game for one to four players and can be played online or offline. Coordinate with your friends and family to outsmart your spooky foes, and capture them before they escape. Race against time in 30 unique levels to complete your mission and uncover the truth behind the ghosts.
Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for a fun family activity, Spook-A-Boo promises laughter, cooperation, and a whole lot of ghostly good times.
Use Cutting-edge Tech
Equip yourselves with the latest ghost-hunting gear to catch those pesky specters.

title: Queendom
description:
게임 정보
It is a turn-based strategy game similar to a board game.
The goal of the game is to capture 12 regions. For each captured region, the player gets one point. The one who reaches the goal first wins.
The game consists of turns. Each turn consists of three phases. The first phase is the orders phase. Only three orders can be given per turn. When all players press “next move”, the second phase begins. In this phase, each player takes turns executing the orders he chose in the previous phase.
Among the orders are march, defense, muster troops, hold a tournament and capture territory.
When all orders have been completed, the game enters the game world phase. A random world event card is played. Then a new round begins.
Features:
Give orders on your lands by thinking through your strategy and tactics
Manage your deck - your victory depends on the correct use of cards.
Lead your troops - can you reach your goal with minimal casualties?
Single and multiplayer games - play against artificial intelligence or friends

title: METACRAFT: Arena
description:
게임 정보
Step into an alternate-reality USSR where the past collides with alien technology: monolithic concrete structures tower over glowing extraterrestrial machinery, all brought to life with nostalgic pixel-art flair. Battle across wildly unique maps — from secret lunar bases to underground bunkers codenamed “Volga-12”.
Choose from a roster of eccentric fighters: Baba Yaga, the engineer-inventor piloting a robotic hut-mech, or Kot Uchyony (The Scientist Cat) — yes, he’s literally a cat and a genius! Each hero boasts a game-changing ultimate ability, like summoning a swarm of cybernetic crows or deploying a reality-warping “Communism Wave” that turns foes into collectivist zealots.

title: Gorecam
description:
게임 정보
GORECAM is a hardcore 4-player, online co-op, demonic horror survival game.
You are part of a desperate crew—one exorcist and three paranormal investigators—haunted by an ancient evil. By night, explore haunted locations to gather evidence, banish demons, and drag cultists into the light for blood money. By day, scrounge for holy water, ration dwindling supplies, and pray you have enough gas to live another day. Stay on the move. Sleep by the campfire, if you can. The darkness is relentless, and every mile traveled brings you closer to something you’re not ready to face. Confront your friends and your sanity on the path to redemption.
Investigate
Immersive Experience: Hyper-realistic graphics and sounds. Demons spread corruption, bending the environment to their will, and perform horrifying acts on their victims and worshippers alike.
Full Voice Recognition: Speak ancient rituals into your microphone to exorcise demons, and perform protective prayers with your fellow exorcists and investigators. Speak to cultists and victims of the paranormal
Malignant Demons: Demons are unique and intelligent. Each has their own personality and weaknesses. Learn their names. Learn their sins. Exploit them to survive.
Equipment: Bibles, holy water, and shotguns. The tools of every exorcist. Camcorders, ghost boxes, cursed possessions, and more allow investigators to gain the upper hand.
Locations: Detailed, procedurally generated haunted houses and ruined complexes mixed with hand-placed horror elements ensure that every day is unique.
Survive
Your Home on the Road: Your RV serves as your investigative home away from home. Upgrade it with furnishing, cameras, and protective runes.
Stay stocked up: Running out of holy water makes any would-be investigator or exorcist easy prey for demons and ghosts. Manage it carefully, and buy it often from the Church. Fuel and food are equally valuable, and the end of either will spell the end of all.
Teamwork: Meet death at its doorstep. Face down the paranormal with shotgun in hand, or support your team with motion sensors and CCTV monitoring.
Multiplayer
Survive with friends. Demons will target those who walk alone in the dark.

title: Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics is a turn-based strategic tennis game. Zero in on your opponent’s pattern of play to predict their shots and gain the upper hand. Line up the perfect shot and simulate the outcome before committing to your next play. Sometimes the court is wide open, and sometimes you have to aim for the lines.
Create Your Own Playstyle:
Fine tune your strategy with custom playstyles that make it easy to construct points just the way you want.

title: Stellar Raven
description:
게임 정보
The near future. The Great Arion Empire, led by the wise and just Empress Rovena, protects peace and order on Earth and hundreds of other planets. But one of the commanders of the elite Space Marine squad, known for his unpredictability and propensity for violence, disobeyed orders, defied the Empire and went over to the rebels. That commander is you. Now, as a rebel, you find yourself in a deadly game against the full might of the Empire, and your chances of survival are close to zero.
Stellar Raven is a single-player first-person shooter in the tank simulator genre. The game is a futuristic action experience where you control a high-tech flying tank and engage in intense battles against enemy forces on different planets.
Gameplay:
You control the flying tank from a first-person perspective, battling enemies on various planets.
The main objective is to destroy all enemy forces on each level and ultimately defeat the final boss, Empress Rovena.
You will need to travel through and conquer several distinct planets, each with its own unique challenges, enemies, and environmental hazards, making every level a different tactical experience.

title: Benny Bash
description:
게임 정보
About
Survive this horror/puzzle adventure. Uncover the secrets of a cursed video game from the '80s while a malevolent entity hunts you. Solve escape room-style puzzles, navigate eerie labyrinths, and see how your actions in the game shape the real world. Stay sharp... and stay alive.
In Benny Bash you will...
Face puzzles in the escape room style.
Uncover a horror story as you progress.
Play cursed 80s games.
Explore eerie environments.
Discover how your actions in the game shape the real world and vice versa.

title: No Way Home
description:
게임 정보
[Note: the games has nothing to do with a certain superhero movie. We had the name first!]
No Way Home is a twin-stick shooter adventure, set in a hostile far flung part of the universe filled with danger at every turn. Outgun ships many times your size in tense skirmishes, complete missions for the many aliens that may offer help, loot bigger and better weapons, and explore countless areas in search of answers and a way home.
Fast-paced topdown-style twin stick combat
Engage in tense skirmishes that require the use of cover, timing and thoughtful positioning moreso than reading predictable bullet patterns
A regenerating shield allows a tactical and front-foot approach to combat, with a buffer to trade hits and move around the environment strategically
Loot new weapons and ship components as random drops from encounters, creating your own build and play-style over time
Procedural world generation with hand-crafted encounters throughout
No permadeath, classic adventure format with zone respawning
Quick-loop arcade modes to unlock
From the team that brought you Moving Out 1 & 2, Death Squared, Thumb Drift and One More Line and many others.
Features
A rich story mode set across a huge universe
Stunning hand-drawn artwork
50+ weapons to loot, craft and upgrade
Over 60 unique enemies to battle
Complete missions or explore freely and forge your own path
Fight huge bosses for rare loot drops (updated for this release)
Procedural universe creates unique layouts per game
Outfit your ship with the gear that suits your playstyle
Full controller support
Ship skins to unlock via arcade minigames
Daily Challenge - run and gun for daily glory with a new mega weapon every day

title: Inspiring ballads
description:
게임 정보
Inspiring ballads is an RPG set in an open fantasy world. Get reliable equipment, create powerful magic, pick up a sword and decide your fate and the fate of the inhabitants of the entire island! Become the new ballad hero!
A classless system. Choose who you want to be: a brutal warrior, a destructive magician, a mobile fighter, a master of poisoning - or find an even more effective way.
Several schools of magic, including hidden ones.
Create equipment from trophies from enemies.
Dozens of types of opponents.
The inhabitants of the island, who were just waiting for you to solve their problems.
The opportunity to win over representatives of the opposite sex.
There are several endings - from the most obvious to the hidden and very hidden.

title: Hermes Library
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Hermes Library. It is the main library of the Hephaestus University, the most famous university in the United Nation of Europa. As a junior named Rainn Echo, you will become the new librarian working at the front desk. While performing your daily duties, you will also witness several mysterious incidents there.
【How to Become a Capable Librarian】
You will help students, faculty members, and alumni to check out and return books. Using the workbook provided, you will check if every reader has complied with the library's rule: if they have checked out more than they should, if they have returned everything on time, if they have used their own ID card... Pay attention to details, and you will become an outstanding librarian!
Work time is divided into two parts: the morning and the afternoon. You will need to help about 12 readers every day with their return and check-out. During their conversations, you will get a glimpse into the lives of these students, professors, and alumni and piece together a rich campus environment.
Check-out: the reader needs to provide their ID and the book they want to borrow. If they have a reservation, they will tell you the title of the book so that you can take it out of the reservation area on the left. The first step of check-out is to use the scanner on the ID card. The information of the reader will appear on the screen on the right. You need to check the information and make sure that they are using their own ID and they have the authorization to borrow. Then you can press the "receipt" button on the bottom of the screen, type in the title of the checked-out book and the return date, and press "print." Then you can give the printed receipt along with the ID card and the now-checked-out book to the reader.

title: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
description:
게임 정보
《의체 궤도강하 타격대: 첫 번째 강하》에서는 유례없는 아이템 조합의 자유도를 경험할 수 있습니다! 데모 버전에서는 50종 이상의 독특한 기능을 가진 의체를 제공하며, 각각의 의체는 새로운 전투 전략과 즐거움을 선사합니다.
총알이 분열 후 폭발하도록 만들고 싶으신가요? 아니면 유도 탄환에 관통 효과를 더하고 싶으신가요? 이러한 자유로운 조합은 모든 전투를 색다르고 짜릿하게 만들어줍니다. 끊임없이 실험하고 조합하여 자신에게 딱 맞는 전투 방식을 찾아내고, 매번 도전에 1+1>2 이상의 즐거움을 느껴보세요!
autokwd: Exo Helljumper: Descent X,의체 궤도강하 타격대: 첫 번째 강하

title: SOG: Vietnam
description:
게임 정보
베트남에 오신 것을 환영합니다, 아들!
2차 인도차이나 전쟁 중 MACV-SOG 전문가의 역할을 맡아, 턴제 전술적 올드스쿨 2D 로그라이트에 뛰어드세요!
각 미션은 잔인한 새로운 도전입니다! 각 공격은 적응력과 기지가 요구되며, 매번 처음부터 캐릭터를 개발하고 무적의 전술을 구축해야 합니다. 모든 도구를 사용하여 목표를 완수하세요: 주변 환경에 녹아들고, 현지인과 연락을 맺고, 정글의 그림자 속에서 위험한 세계를 탐험하거나, 가는 길에 있는 모든 수단을 동원하여 적을 박살내며 혼란을 일으키세요! 궁극적인 목표는 살아남아 기지로 돌아가는 것입니다. 왜냐하면 죽음은 공격 중에 이루어진 모든 진행을 지우기 때문입니다!
베트남에서 미군의 “특유의 스타일”로 적을 섬멸하세요
미군이 제공하는 모든 자원을 최대한 활용하세요! 공중 기병 지원, 포병, 타오르는 네이팜이 당신과 적들을 지루하게 하지 않을 것입니다! 당신의 무기고에는 표준 장비, 네이팜, 포병, C4, 전투 수류탄, 트립와이어 등이 포함됩니다.
적대적인 정글을 탐험하세요
베트남 정글은 위험과 미스터리로 가득 차 있습니다. 헬리콥터가 울창한 숲으로 덮인 절차적으로 생성된 지도에 당신을 내려놓을 것입니다. 매 순간이 마지막일 수 있으니, 지형의 모든 구역을 신중하게 조사하세요. 앞에 무엇이 있을지 모릅니다: 배신적인 함정, 매복한 적, 또는 공격 준비를 마친 야생 동물. 임무는 정찰과 탐험을 요구하므로, 이 예측할 수 없는 세계를 철저히 조사할 준비를 하세요.

title: Sticky Mayhem
description:
게임 정보
Sticky Mayhem is a rogue-like action game where you can build human towers & can battle with each other.
Craft your human tower by understanding the physics & balance of human tower building. Pick the right soldiers, armor, weapon, engines, etc. for combat.
In battle, use speed, shape of the tower and your weapons to attack and destroy your opponent.
After every round use the earnings to upgrade your soldiers, armor, weapon, engines, etc. for the next forthcoming rounds.
Use Sandbox mode to experiment on pyramid structure, combination of soldiers & weapons.

title: This Party Is Killer
description:
게임 정보
You, Ripley, have been worked to the bone in an effort to stay on the straight and narrow. Cooking, plating, rinsing, repeating. On your one day off, you decide to take your partner Iris and their camera to a planning party for your friend Erik’s future thesis film. But the footage Erik wants to capture is more than you or Iris bargained for.
Will you be able to protect your partner from what lies before you?
This Party is Killer is a horror visual novel inspired by classic American slasher films. Playing as Ripley, you make choices throughout the night of the party to determine both Iris's fate and your own. You can also search your surroundings "point-and-click" style for key insights into the world you are exploring.
A visual novel with choices throughout to determine your ending
Choose how you take care of Iris; decide your combined fates
Watch the wheel of cyclical violence spin in a short but sweet format
Over 120+ lovingly painted pieces of key art
LGBT+ cast of characters
Splattershot gore and uncomfortable encounters that will leave you squirming

title: Shinjuku Anomaly
description:
게임 정보
You have a part-time job taking photos of anomalies in the night in Shinjuku.
There are four rules for your part-time job.
If you see a anomaly, take a picture of it.
When taking a picture, get close to a anomaly to an appropriate distance.
However, don't get too close.
If you run out of film, come back.
Game Overview
This is a short horror visual novel game. It has multiple endings.
Scheduled release
Within 2025
Warning
This game is fictional and has no connection to any real people, incidents, or organizations.

title: Don't Forget the Phone
description:
게임 정보
Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Use the computer and other gadgets around the tower to complete your nightly checklist.
But watch out! The research subjects from the lab below tend to wander a bit at night. Use all methods at your disposal to dissuade them.
Complete all of your tasks before sunrise or YOU'RE FIRED!
Congratulations on your new position as a watchtower attendant!
On behalf of the Eclipse Research Foundation, welcome to our family!
Your role is vital in securing, and protecting, our state-of-the-art research facility. Nightly duties will consist of stimulating, and engaging, tasks such as:
Answering phone calls!
Checking your email!

title: Tap Monster Saga
description:
게임 정보
Easy to Play, Stress-Free Fun!
Monster Clicker is a casual game that combines clicking, idle gameplay, and monster training. The controls are incredibly simple—just click to attack, heal, or upgrade your monsters!
If you’re a speed demon, focus on upgrading your "Fingertip" skill to make every click count!
Prefer a more relaxed pace? Train your monsters to fight automatically while you sit back and relax!
Diverse Monsters, Build Your Ultimate Team!
With 20+ unique heroes, each featuring multiple skins to unlock, the possibilities are endless!
Different skins not only look awesome but also come with unique stats and skills!
Your team consists of front, middle, and back rows. Strategically position your heroes to dominate the battlefield!
Assemble your dream team and create an unstoppable monster squad!

title: Touhou Volleyball Danmaku
description:
게임 정보
The latest sensation to hit Gensokyo, Volleyball! But this isn't an ordinary game of volleyball.
Taking place in the skies, you will pick a team of 2 of your favorite Touhou characters as they not only attempt to keep the ball from falling on your side, but also avoid the bullets coming your way! Score a point by dropping the ball on the other side or hitting an opponent with your bullets. Reach the point match or have the most points at time out to win.
The upcoming demo will contain the following features:
Play as a team of 2 and choose from Reimu, Marisa, Sakuya, and Remilia.
Each character will have their own special abilities and bullet patterns.
Powerful bombs and spell card attacks.
Local versus against a human opponent or the CPU.
Gamepad is recommended.

title: Paper War
description:
게임 정보
Paper War is a thrilling rogue-lite adventure that combines creativity and chaos. You take on the role of "Little Blue," a character born from the dreams of a passionate artist. After countless trials, the artist creates the perfect sketch and finally rests, but as the night falls, his creations come to life.
Fueled by envy and resentment, the rejected sketches rise against "Little Blue," determined to destroy the masterpiece and reclaim the canvas for themselves. Amid the chaos, the living paper sheet becomes a battlefield where creativity clashes with destruction. And so, the Paper War begins, with "Little Blue" fighting to survive and prove their worth against relentless foes.

title: Sprunki Town
description:
게임 정보
Sprunki Town is a visual novel where you play as Grey, a gloomy Sprunki with a kind heart, who wants to uncover the mystery behind the strange events and phenomena shaking the town. Meet other Sprunki, dive into the investigation of Mard's disappearance, and discover the truth about the mysterious black Sprunki.

title: Sword of Mejor
description:
게임 정보
Follow the Sword Of Mejor as it travels from kingdom to kingdom. It all starts with an adventurer finding it buried in the ruins, and it's up to your choices to decide what happens next.
The usual "multiple endings" gameplay style brought to the entire game! Keep the initial adventurer alive, equip him with the Sword Of Mejor, and follow his adventure. Or sacrifice him in a fight against the Goblins to embark on a new journey with your Goblin party!
A unique upgrade system where you upgrade the Sword of Mejor based on the character who is currently equipped with it, as well as a normal character leveling system.
Key Features
Turn based combat
Countless characters to play as
Too many endings, middles, and beginnings
Upgrade system
Some of the journeys the Sword Of Mejor will follow...
The Adventurer
Unknowingly the first to find the Sword of Mejor. Help him survive and continue on his quest of discovering Rex's Emerald, a mythical stone with magical powers. Discover vast lands and recruit Humans, Goblins, Orcs, Shades, and more to help him fight. Once news spreads that the Sword Of Mejor has been found, everyone will be trying to get their hands on it!
The Goblin King
Help The Goblin King defend the goblin village from the Orcs in the Great Goblin & Orc War. The Sword of Mejor will decide the fate of each battle!
The Goblin Shopkeeper
While everyone else wants the Sword Of Mejor for themselves, the only thing the Gobin Shopkeeper is interested in is finding the highest bidder. Join him on his quest to get rich!
The Orc Raiders
The other side of the Great Goblin & Orc War, once the Orc Raiders get their hands on the Sword Of Mejor, nothing will stop them from letting go of it... besides death.
The Village Of Paz
A small remote Human village, not far from where the Adventurer found the Sword Of Mejor in the ruins. Some say it was originally forged by a master smith centuries ago by members of the Village Of Paz. Discover the Sword Of Mejor's rich past and why it must be kept away from everyone, including its creator...

title: Diabolika
description:
게임 정보
- STORY:
You have woken up amongst the corpses in the old deprecated and depraved temple - the air stench of rot and the once prosperous village turned into ruin while you have been unconscious.
You don't quite remember what brought you to these lands - nonetheless it is least important thing to worry about right now.
Facing with this strange and horrifying reality you must gather your last strength and escape the overwhelming darkness.
- CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER
Choose one of three classes each with its own unique gameplay style and mechanics.
Lordsworn:
- As the retainer of the crown, slash and bash your foes with pure brutal force or smite them with holy light.
Take upon an knight oath and complete deeds to raise in power.
Shine as beacon of hope for the righteous and innocent in this gods-forsaken land.
Sorceress:
- As a highly qualified scholar and mage - transform your knowledge into a deadly weapon.
Harness the power of the stars and elements and cast powerful spells capable of eradicating your foes.
As the owner of the Grimoire learn its secrets becoming even more powerful or perish under the power of forces beyond your comprehension.

title: Rock Crusher
description:
게임 정보
Rock Crusher is an incremental game with a huge skill tree where you start crushing rocks with a saw blade, collect valuable resources that come out, and then use them to buy upgrades. Slowly, you'll get to discover the secret of the galaxy!
Crush rocks
Blow valuable materials to collect
FEATURES

title: Neebota: Zeebo's Nightmare
description:
게임 정보
ENTER ZEEBO'S NIGHTMARE
Zeebo wakes up multiple times at night after the most bizarre dream where his body painfully morphs. Home alone, he mourns his parents' recent death with only his best friends and pet Hekke by his side. But no one knows just why his nightmares are this intense. As he receives a dream helmet and dream controller through his best friend Laurencia, Zeebo now has the tools to take control of his dream...and find out what's happening to him.
INTO THE FRAY
A dungeon-crawling action-RPG in a surreal nightmare with mind-bending levels and surreal events. Rich in lore, it's set in an entirely original fantasy world called Neebota. Face bizarre creatures as well yourself in different forms, as you transform yourself to gain new abilities and defeat the worst demons haunting Zeebo's mind in a quest to overcome the self.

title: Unoffensible
description:
게임 정보
VR RTS
A classic RTS in VR. Featuring a completely new way of interacting with a RTS game. While keeping the basics like base building, resource gathering and crushing your enemy with overwhelming firepower. As the commander you stand in a futuristic war room. You can move around on the vast battlefield, or scale it down for a better overview.
Interaction
Your hands will be very powerful, but you can only use two of them. Making them the most valuable resource in your arsenal.
There are two movement systems. With the first you can use both hands, to scale, rotate or move the battlefield. With the second you can use one hand, to slide along the terrain.
Scale is important. On a scaled up terrain, you can stack structures accurately to improve their abilities. On a scaled down terrain, you can get an overview of the battlefield.
Physically grab objects to interact with them. Throw your units to move them to the right area. Grab missiles out of the air and throw them at the enemy. Construct a unit by dragging its icon onto the battlefield.

title: Robot Unlock
description:
게임 정보
After years of trying you finally manage to dial into other-space. You find that the dweller of other-space has challenging questions about computability and is asking for your help.
75+ levels
Solve puzzles in constrained spaces using a handful of instructions
Solve open-ended problems and design your own solutions
Optimize your solutions for speed, instructions or space
Use multithreading - carefully time and synchronize your execution threads to halve the execution time
Set breakpoints - step backward, or even step forward!
Compare with other players - see how your solutions rank with fun histograms
Create your own levels, share them and solve community made levels
Trailer music: "Home Dimension" by Joey Freeze / CC BY 3.0

title: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
description:
게임 정보
KISS 는 K-pop의 신나는 세계에 보내는 러브레터입니다.

이 인생 시뮬레이션에서 당신은 인재를 찾고, 일정을 관리하고, 예산을 편성하고, 소셜 미디어를 계획하고, 음악과 패션을 선택하는 강력한 관리자입니다!

차기 K팝 아이돌 그룹 데뷔!


연습생을 선택하세요.


각 연습생은 고유한 특성과 배경 이야기를 가지고 있습니다.
팬들을 열광하게 만들지만 그룹을 망칠 수도 있는 건방진 나쁜 여자를 선택하시겠습니까?
아니면 그녀가 무대에 설 준비가 되기 전에 조금 더 격려가 필요한 수줍은 노래 새와 함께 갈까요?
이 게임에서 당신은 그들의 노래를 듣고, 그들의 성격을 이해하고, 그들의 강점을 찾아 힘을 실어줍니다!
다양한 아이돌 그룹을 모으는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다!
autokwd: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut

title: Poison Noir: Desire
description:
게임 정보
Poison Noir: Desire, Time & Gangsters is an animated visual novel with a captivating fantasy theme. Immerse yourself in a rich, multilayered narrative where desire, time, and danger intertwine in a world of gangsters, secrets, and uncertain fates.
In the 90s, for the shy Jake—a gamer and noir novel enthusiast—and his brave friend Lucy, their small hometown holds no future. Seeking new opportunities in the city, Jake begins a romance with Nina, a wealthy and fascinating girl, but one who is also unsettling and full of secrets.
Their relationship becomes complicated when Jake suffers from a strange illness—poison, madness, or something even darker? With each episode, he is thrust between two different eras, stripped of his memories, unable to distinguish reality, and feeling as if a faceless destiny is pulling the strings of his fate.
Trapped between the seemingly harmless modern world and the violent, ruthless gangster underworld of Prohibition, Jake must confront not only a powerful and merciless enemy but also a painful journey of self-transformation. Surrounded by danger and horror, he becomes entangled in brutal mafia wars as well as sinister mysteries beyond his comprehension.
To protect those he loves, he will fight against his hallucinations and fears, struggle with the terrifying suspicion that nothing is as it seems, and be tormented by the collapse of the sacred values he once held dear. But his greatest challenge in this web of time and fate will be to find, among countless paths, the one that leads him back to sanity, love, and the Light. But… how can he be sure he's making the right choice?

title: DoubleWe
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 출시 시점부터 한글로 번역되어 있지는 않을 것입니다. 대신, 찜하기 수치를 확인하면서 가장 많은 관심을 보이는 언어부터 순서대로 번역을 진행할 예정입니다. 관심이 있으시다면 저희가 알 수 있게 찜 목록에 추가해 주세요!
진정한 편집증을 경험하세요
당신이 가장 취약할 때를 노려 당신을 죽이려는 클론들이 군중 속에 숨어 있습니다. 탄약이 한정적인 무기와 함께 수백 명의 얼굴을 신중하게 살펴가며 당신의 클론을 찾아내세요. 언제나 뒤를 조심하세요. 사방에 위험이 도사리고 있습니다!
생물학적 공포에 맞서세요
로그라이트 게임을 진행해 나가면서 주변의 세상이 변하는 것을 경험하게 됩니다. 이야기가 진행됨에 따라 새로운 클론, 새로운 적, 새로운 위험이 생겨나며, 이 위협을 극복할 새로운 전술을 개발하지 못한다면 생명을 위협받게 될 것입니다.

title: Scottside
description:
게임 정보
You are new to our town, right? You seem to attract trouble to yourself. Strange things started to happen with your arrival: Some kids told me about seeing a monster in the forest, and my best friend noticed a girl crying every evening in the neighbor's house. And it's said a creepy circus is going to come to our town. Our home robots are acting strangely. But what's the most mysterious, is that children started missing one by one, and no one seem to notice, as if they have never even existed. Let's try to find them together? But don't tell the adults! They won't believe us anyway, they'll say we're imagining things. So, what do you think, are you in?

«Scottside» – is a thriller nonlinear visual novel. The story takes place in the alternative version of 1980-s, where technological development is faster than you can imagine. A small provincial town surrounded by mountains and a dense pine forest appears to be quite a boring place. However, things change when you find a strange object in the forest. Inexplicable events start to happen in the town and you find yourself involved in an adventure. The adventure where every decision you make has consequences, defining your destiny.

5 episodes are planned to be released, all of which are connected, although they differ by a unique atmosphere.

title: DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're In Love
description:
게임 정보
DokiToki is a first-person puzzle game about manipulating time to solve escape-the-room style puzzles. Players need to freeze, unfreeze, and manipulate objects in time to reach each level's exit and progress through school.
Stopping time......with the power of love!
Play as Ai, a girl who's so hopelessly in love, it feels like everything around her is stopped in time. Traverse Ai's school, hopping from hallway to hallway and clearing each classroom in search of the boy Ai wants to confess to.
Toy with time
Use a collection of various tools each affecting time in different way. Some let you manipulate frozen objects, others will send items flying when unfrozen. Put each time-manipulating tool to use to solve each puzzle!
autokwd: DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're In Love

title: Operation Terra
description:
게임 정보
Operation Terra는 절차적으로 생성된 레벨과 맵이 있는 공상과학 1인칭 슈팅/롤플레잉 게임입니다.
당신을 막으려는 끈질긴 기계들과 싸우는 동안 새로운 지구인 테라에 인류가 정착할 길을 닦으세요.
싸움

무엇이든 불가능하게 만드는 것이 유일한 목표인 드론, 드로이드, 로봇, 탱크, 포탑과 싸우세요. 보너스와 파워업을 수집하세요.
탐험

거의 무한한 절차적으로 생성된 맵과 레벨 레이아웃을 탐험하세요.
모든 플레이가 똑같지는 않습니다.
업그레이드

미션에서 약탈한 크레딧으로 무기와 장비를 업그레이드하세요. 기지에서 영구 업그레이드를 구매하세요. 기지의 새로운 부분에 접근할 수 있는 허가를 받으세요.

최종 게임은 30개의 고유한 적, 6개의 서로 다른 환경, 전체적으로 30개의 고유한 타일 세트를 특징으로 하며, 각각은 2~4개의 서로 다른 텍스처 세트와 절차적으로 매치되어 다양성과 재생성을 더했습니다.

title: Slyders
description:
게임 정보

In order to survive 15 minutes of merciless attacking waves of demons, you must become an unstoppable force of destruction. Choose from a variety of active and passive abilities, summon powerful allies, place deadly turrets, collect special weapons, fight mighty Bosses and more. Switch between different characters and equip them with unique items to create a build that fits your playstyle.
Story

Sky World is an endless heaven with hundreds of inhabited floating islands, each with its own people and culture. But now, an evil overlord with his demon army has attacked the once peaceful realm and is spreading chaos and corruption.
Fortunately, a group of brave resistance fighters from all over Sky World has combined their forces to liberate each island from the evil influence.

You play as Aryx, a fearless fox fighter who is accompanied by his supersonic turtle mount and Brian, a tiny but wise bear with a jetpack. Together, the heroic trio steps up to face the entire demonic war machine.

title: DoubleWe
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 출시 시점부터 한글로 번역되어 있지는 않을 것입니다. 대신, 찜하기 수치를 확인하면서 가장 많은 관심을 보이는 언어부터 순서대로 번역을 진행할 예정입니다. 관심이 있으시다면 저희가 알 수 있게 찜 목록에 추가해 주세요!
진정한 편집증을 경험하세요
당신이 가장 취약할 때를 노려 당신을 죽이려는 클론들이 군중 속에 숨어 있습니다. 탄약이 한정적인 무기와 함께 수백 명의 얼굴을 신중하게 살펴가며 당신의 클론을 찾아내세요. 언제나 뒤를 조심하세요. 사방에 위험이 도사리고 있습니다!

로그라이트 게임을 진행해 나가면서 주변의 세상이 변하는 것을 경험하게 됩니다. 이야기가 진행됨에 따라 새로운 클론, 새로운 적, 새로운 위험이 생겨나며, 이 위협을 극복할 새로운 전술을 개발하지 못한다면 생명을 위협받게 될 것입니다.

title: Age Of Blocks
description:
게임 정보
In Age of Blocks, gathering resources and mining blocks are at the heart of your kingdom’s survival and expansion. Send your workers to chop down towering trees for wood, harvest bushes and catch fish to keep your army fed, and mine precious gold to fund your growing empire. Every resource plays a vital role, fueling construction, recruitment, and technological advances. As you collect blocks from the voxel-based world, you'll unlock the power to shape the land itself—place blocks to build walls, raise towers, and design your perfect stronghold. Whether you're fortifying defenses or expanding your city, mastering resource collection and block placement is key to defending Azuria!
Building your civilization is a journey of strategy and creativity. With 13 unique types of buildings at your disposal—from humble houses and bustling farms to powerful barracks and advanced research centers—you'll shape a thriving kingdom tailored to your playstyle. As your city grows, unlock a wide range of technologies that boost your economy, strengthen your armies, and unlock new tactical possibilities. Advance through different ages of civilization to gain access to more powerful structures, elite units, and game-changing upgrades. Every decision you make brings you one step closer to turning your fledgling settlement into the most formidable empire in all of Azuria!
Leading your army into battle is where your strategy truly comes to life. Train and command a diverse roster of units such as fearless Footmen, swift Lancers, and devastating Warhounds on the front lines. Rain arrows from afar with Longbowmen and Crossbowmen, or unleash heavy siege power with Catapults, Rams, and the deadly Scorpio. Dominate the seas with powerful Galleons and Scorpio Ships, transport your troops across the map with Transport Ships. Monks can provide crucial support on the battlefield, turning the tide with healing. As you research new technologies, your units become stronger, faster, and deadlier, giving you the edge you need to crush your enemy.

title: Furcifer's Fungeon
description:
게임 정보
Choose from hundreds of unique talents and many spells and items.
Shape your talent tree with your choices.
Be a necromancer, a knight, an electro wizard, or just a pyromaniac!
Highly customizable loadout (over 1 million starting configurations)
Characters with unique abilities and talents can freely switch between different spell sets!

title: Elemental Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
Elemental Labyrinth는 픽셀 아트 타워 디펜스 게임으로, 전장을 직접 구성하고 전투의 흐름을 조종할 수 있습니다. 적들의 경로를 결정하는 미로를 만들고, 무작위 원소 정령을 소환한 뒤 강력한 형태로 융합하여 끊임없이 몰려오는 적의 파도를 막아내세요.
각 정령은 고유한 능력을 지니고 있으며, 전략적으로 조합하여 강력한 시너지를 만들어야 합니다. 다양한 배치와 정령 조합을 실험하며 최적의 방어 전략을 찾아보세요!
레트로 감성의 픽셀 아트, 깊이 있는 전술적 게임 플레이, 그리고 무한한 전략적 가능성을 갖춘 Elemental Labyrinth는 타워 디펜스 장르에 신선한 변화를 가져옵니다. 당신의 미궁이 시간의 시험을 견뎌낼 수 있을까요?
🏗️ 나만의 미로를 건설하세요

title: Demon Source
description:
게임 정보
Jump to the pit, die - repeat!
Demon Source is a roguelike adventure about one of the last Source Hunters.
Explore the vast procedurally generated dungeons. They are generated with pre-made prefabs with 3 variations of enemy spawn. So you will always have the pleasure of being scared entering each location.

Find skills and items and be killed by various enemies. Then hunt them in your run of revenge. Try new builds and strategies every new run and be bamboozled by unexpected enemy hiding by the corner. Collect the Source energy from dead enemies to unlock new weapons and abilities. 30+ unique weapons, 20+ skills, 40+ armors and rings are waiting for you.

Seek for story and lore? I have some!
Deep down the Ulm rock dwarves found the relic of great power. Demonic power. Very soon hordes of demons and possessed undeads were marching through the Lavert Kingdom.
Heroes of the past had stopped them, but they couldn’t destroy the Source. Inside the Ulm mountain this power was able to reshape dungeons to an endless labyrinth full of creatures of the dark. It also was able to revive demons countless times so they can’t be really killed.
Some heroes drink demon blood in order to receive same power. Those who did not died, went deeply to the old dwarf kingdom in order to find and destroy Demon Source.

You don’t remember how have you got to that dungeon. But it is clear that you are immortal such as those demons. Every time you die, the dungeon reshapes and all demons revive. Source doesn’t want to be found and doesn’t want you to go back. People of the past were optimistic about that - saying that now they have countless attempts. But now they are all mad and became corrupted guardians of the Source. So I wish you don't get crazy.

Try this game made with all passion just by single person. And let me to tell you the story of redemption which you will probably experience on yourself in the future. Try the Demon Source

title: Robot Unlock
description:
게임 정보
After years of trying you finally manage to dial into other-space. You find that the dweller of other-space has challenging questions about computability and is asking for your help.
75+ levels
Solve puzzles in constrained spaces using a handful of instructions
Solve open-ended problems and design your own solutions
Optimize your solutions for speed, instructions or space
Use multithreading - carefully time and synchronize your execution threads to halve the execution time
Set breakpoints - step backward, or even step forward!
Compare with other players - see how your solutions rank with fun histograms
Create your own levels, share them and solve community made levels
Trailer music: "Home Dimension" by Joey Freeze / CC BY 3.0

title: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
description:
게임 정보
KISS 는 K-pop의 신나는 세계에 보내는 러브레터입니다.

이 인생 시뮬레이션에서 당신은 인재를 찾고, 일정을 관리하고, 예산을 편성하고, 소셜 미디어를 계획하고, 음악과 패션을 선택하는 강력한 관리자입니다!

차기 K팝 아이돌 그룹 데뷔!


연습생을 선택하세요.


각 연습생은 고유한 특성과 배경 이야기를 가지고 있습니다.
팬들을 열광하게 만들지만 그룹을 망칠 수도 있는 건방진 나쁜 여자를 선택하시겠습니까?
아니면 그녀가 무대에 설 준비가 되기 전에 조금 더 격려가 필요한 수줍은 노래 새와 함께 갈까요?
이 게임에서 당신은 그들의 노래를 듣고, 그들의 성격을 이해하고, 그들의 강점을 찾아 힘을 실어줍니다!
다양한 아이돌 그룹을 모으는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다!
autokwd: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut

title: Poison Noir: Desire
description:
게임 정보
Poison Noir: Desire, Time & Gangsters is an animated visual novel with a captivating fantasy theme. Immerse yourself in a rich, multilayered narrative where desire, time, and danger intertwine in a world of gangsters, secrets, and uncertain fates.
In the 90s, for the shy Jake—a gamer and noir novel enthusiast—and his brave friend Lucy, their small hometown holds no future. Seeking new opportunities in the city, Jake begins a romance with Nina, a wealthy and fascinating girl, but one who is also unsettling and full of secrets.
Their relationship becomes complicated when Jake suffers from a strange illness—poison, madness, or something even darker? With each episode, he is thrust between two different eras, stripped of his memories, unable to distinguish reality, and feeling as if a faceless destiny is pulling the strings of his fate.
Trapped between the seemingly harmless modern world and the violent, ruthless gangster underworld of Prohibition, Jake must confront not only a powerful and merciless enemy but also a painful journey of self-transformation. Surrounded by danger and horror, he becomes entangled in brutal mafia wars as well as sinister mysteries beyond his comprehension.
To protect those he loves, he will fight against his hallucinations and fears, struggle with the terrifying suspicion that nothing is as it seems, and be tormented by the collapse of the sacred values he once held dear. But his greatest challenge in this web of time and fate will be to find, among countless paths, the one that leads him back to sanity, love, and the Light. But… how can he be sure he's making the right choice?

title: Worldwide Rush
description:
게임 정보
월드와이드 러시를 통해 전 세계 규모의 여객 운송과 관리를 체험해 보세요. 거대한 운송 네트워크를 운영하며 겪는 도전과 승리를 경험하고 글로벌 재벌이 되어 보세요.
본사를 건설하고 강력한 차량들을 모아 승객 수요에 따라 수익성 높은 노선을 전략적으로 연결하세요. 급증하는 시장과 새롭게 떠오르는 목적지를 활용하여 최대 수익을 위해 네트워크를 최적화하고 조정하세요. 호텔과 마케팅에 투자해 승객 증가를 노리되, 방심은 금물입니다! 경쟁 업체들도 주도권을 잡으려 합니다. 협력을 택하시겠어요, 아니면 적대적 인수를 시도하시겠어요?
월드와이드 러시를 새로 시작할 때마다 서로 다른 도전 과제가 주어집니다. 절차적이면서도 유기적인 목적지 생성, 다양한 지역 지형, 이벤트, 현지 차량, 그리고 다른 경쟁자들이 무한한 재플레이 가치를 보장합니다. 세계 최대 규모의 항공기로 하늘을 제패하고, 초고속 열차로 전 세계의 주요 도시를 연결하거나, 분주한 여객선과 호화 크루즈로 바다를 지배해 보세요. 당신의 야망만큼이나 끝없는 가능성이 펼쳐지는 역동적이고 정교한 글로벌 샌드박스에서 실험하고 성장해 보세요.

title: Pingbert's Snow Ride
description:
게임 정보
Slide down in Pingbert’s Snow Ride, an endless high-speed platformer where you take control of Pingbert, the cheerful penguin mail carrier. Glide above snowy hills, dodge obstacles, avoid falling off the edge, and deliver mail faster than ever while pulling off slick moves like drifting, spinning, and diving! Earn coins as you play to improve Pingbert's cozy cabin, which doubles as a humble mail postal service, and unlock a variety of useful upgrades and stylish customizations!
Slide, drift, spin, and glide your way through Bubble Mountain. Nail these moves to fullfill your duty as a mail carrier penguin and rack up high scores!

title: ITRP _ Vacuum Bless
description:
게임 정보
ITRP _ Vacuum Bless – research puzzle game about research and puzzles under the nul-gravity conditions.
Welcome to the space program!
In the frameworks of this program, you could’ve navigate through endless space, but instead, have to focus on the way to get out of the spaceship which got stuck in space.
Alone within million kilometers
You have to rely only on yourself. Fortunately, it is enough to manage all the systems of the spaceship. Just study it. Find hidden tunnels and other ways of opening new compartments. Obtain the tackle – it will help you to reveal your performance limitations.
Please, remind me what mission was it…
Wait, why there are no two-factor security systems on this spaceship? No captain’s cabin? Who has placed so many mysteries here and why? Why does this spaceship completely consist of puzzles? Is this a kind of trick?
Does the rescue shuttle indeed exist?
There is only one way to find it out. Tighten the straps of your overall to navigate in the gravity-free vacuum – and go ahead to reveal mysteries!
Estimated game duration: 4-7 hours.

title: Tangles 2 تشابك
description:
게임 정보
في جزيرة سيرين النائية، يتحول السعي وراء الطموح إلى كابوس مظلم.
ماجد، متدرب شاب في مجال البيولوجيا، يتلقى دعوة للتدرب في مركز البيان للأبحاث على جزيرة سيرين، تلك المنشأة الحديثة التي كان ينتظر أن تحقق إنجازات علمية. لكن ما كان يبدو فرصةً لفتح آفاق جديدة في عالم المعرفة، سرعان ما يتحول إلى رحلة مليئة بالغموض والرعب.
وأثناء استكشافه للمركز الذي يبدو مهجورًا بشكل غريب، يكتشف أن الحقيقة تبدو أكثر رعبًا مما هي عليه، لكن الحقيقة تتشابك مع الأوهام، وكل خطوة تكشف سرًا وتنسج آخر.
On the remote island of Scirine, the pursuit of ambition takes a dark turn.
Majed, a young biology trainee, arrives at the state-of-the-art Al-Bayan Research Center on Scirine Island to start his internship. But what was meant to be an opportunity to make scientific breakthroughs becomes a descent into a haunting mystery.
As he explores the eerily abandoned center, Majed discovers that the truth is far more terrifying than it seems. Yet, the truth intertwines with illusions, and every step uncovers a secret while weaving another.

title: theBOLL
description:
게임 정보
theBOLL은 현실적인 물리학과 세심하게 설계된 조작 메커니즘을 갖춘 아케이드 플랫폼 게임입니다. 당신의 임무는 환경과 능숙하게 상호작용하며 다양한 장애물을 극복하는 것입니다. 이 게임은 두 가지 게임 플레이 스타일을 제공합니다: 스피드런을 통해 리더보드에 오르거나, 레벨을 탐험하며 과정을 즐기고 이스터 에그를 찾는 것입니다.
주요 특징
• 공들.
• 단순한 조작의 현실적인 물리학.
• 이스터 에그를 찾는 편안한 플레이.
• 스피드런에 최적화된 레벨.
• 국제 리더보드.
지원하기
theBOLL이 마음에 들고 게임 개발을 도와주고 싶다면 — 스킨을 구매하세요!
Rogue Thunder는 인디 팀이며, 우리는 아케이드 게임에 대한 사랑으로 theBOLL을 만들었습니다. 우리는 게임을 더 좋게 만들고 커뮤니티의 의견을 경청할 것입니다.
로드맵
다가오는 업데이트 계획:
1. 출시
2. 더 많은 우스꽝스러운 업적
3. 더 많은 매우 비밀스러운 비밀
4. 새로운 레벨 + 파괴
5. 향상된 리더보드
6. 스킨이 물리를 변경
7. 새로운 레벨 + 새로운 게임플레이 메커니즘
BIG BOLL ENERGY!

title: GOVNOVOZ
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to GOVNOVOZ—a game where the world of waste management turns into an epic action-packed adventure filled with crazy mini-games, racing, and a hilarious story!
Story:
Grisha arrives in town to claim his father's inheritance, expecting riches or at least a nice apartment… but instead, he gets an old vacuum truck! To make matters worse, his father owed money to the entire local utility service, and the key bosses—Granny Zina, Uncle Vitya the Gasman, and Klava the Janitor—won't let him leave until he pays off the debts.
Now, Grisha has to hustle hard: driving passengers around in his sewage truck, maneuvering through tight parking lots, competing in chaotic obstacle races, outrunning pursuers, and even surviving in a rogue-like action brawl
Game Features:
✅ A hilarious story filled with satire about bureaucracy, government services, and city life.
✅ Dynamic mini-games inspired by classic arcade racers, Crazy Taxi, Vampire Survivors, and more.
✅ Racing, parking challenges, drifting, runner chases, survival modes, and many other wacky trials.
✅ Tons of pop culture references to movies, games, and internet memes.
✅ Memorable characters! Uncle Kolya, the wise trucker; Granny Zina, the witch of the utility office; and even Vin Drosel with his love for family and racing.

title: WildRoot
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to WildRoot, a tranquil colony-building adventure!
Step into a wild and untamed world where you'll guide your colony to prosperity. Build homes, grow resources, and create a harmonious community as you explore diverse biomes. Whether you're farming, hunting, or trading, every decision shapes the future of your settlement.
Key Features
Dynamic Biomes: Expand your colony across varied landscapes, each with unique resources, wildlife, and challenges.
Colony Management: Balance colonists’ needs, manage their moods, and assign jobs to keep everyone productive and happy.
Resource Gathering: Farm, mine, and hunt to sustain your colony, then trade for rare and valuable resources.
Strategic Growth: Unlock new resources, upgrade your colony, and adapt to the evolving environment.
Relaxing Gameplay: With no combat, focus on creativity, strategy, and nurturing your colony in a peaceful setting.
Embark on a journey of growth, exploration, and community in WildRoot. Perfect for players who enjoy nature-inspired, resource management games with a chill vibe.

title: Death Drive
description:
게임 정보
There isn’t much you need for a road trip, just a car, the road, and enough snacks to get you through. Whether it takes days or weeks, as long as you keep going, you’ll reach your final destination.
You just have to keep driving.
You aren’t running away from something, but you might be running towards something.
People say road trips are better with company; you’ve never really agreed.
Still, you ended up with company—it seems like Helia, a strange woman you picked up along the way, means to stay with you for the entire trip.
                               At least you’ll have someone to talk to.
                        Death Drive is a visual novel that takes place entirely inside your trusty jalopy as you make the trip across the country from your hometown to the ocean's shore. With only your dark thoughts and a mysterious hitchhiker you met along the way for company, you must navigate the interstate highways to your final destination, making decisions, defining your character in dialogue, and encountering increasingly strange and haunting events.
Features:
Tale inspired by classic American Gothic fiction and authors such as Poe, Lovecraft, and King.
Branching Narrative
Multiple Endings
Complex Characters

title: Death Fortress
description:
게임 정보
"Death Fortress"는 가벼운 액션 로그 게임입니다. 비밀 실험이 당신을 만들었습니다. 제국의 끔찍한 생물학적 무기로서, 당신은 고통에서 다시 태어났습니다. 모든 적을 죽이는 것인가요, 아니면 완전한 복수인가요?
1. 적을 일격에 물리치고 전투를 즐기자
민첩하고 무자비한 살인자로 변신하세요. 모든 움직임이 단 한 번의 공격으로 적을 처치하는 즐거움을 선사하며, 전투 경험이 상쾌합니다.
2. 풍부한 콘텐츠로 지루할 틈이 없습니다
400개 이상의 능력 강화, 50개 이상의 기술 업그레이드, 그리고 강력한 유대감과 슈트를 잠금 해제할 수 있는 여러 가지 능력 조합이 제공됩니다. 무작위로 생성된 지도는 매번 새로운 도전을 제공합니다.

title: Dragon Realms
description:
게임 정보
용이 되어라. 세계를 지배하라.
Dragon Realms에서 당신은 강력한 용을 제어하여 방대한 판타지 세계를 지배하는 임무를 수행합니다. 광활한 땅을 날아다니며 마을, 성, 농장을 파괴하고, 더 강해지기 위해 보물을 모으세요.
x특징:
용 맞춤화: 용의 색상, 뿔, 액세서리를 선택하고, 불꽃 유형을 선택하여 강력한 공격을 펼쳐보세요.
스킬 업그레이드: 더 빠르게 날고, 체력을 회복하며, 먼 곳의 적을 감지하고, 엄청난 피해를 줄 수 있는 능력을 향상시킬 수 있습니다.
둥지 구축 및 방어: 집을 요새로 변형시키고, 기사와 적대적인 생물들로부터 보호할 수 있는 방어를 추가하세요.
서사적 전투: 기사와 싸우고, 투석기를 피하며, 강력한 용 보스와 싸워 지배권을 확보하세요.
보물 모으기: 마을과 성을 공격하여 음식, 금, 보석을 모아 진화의 힘을 얻으세요.
하늘을 나는 용이 되어 적을 처치하고, Dragon Realms의 지배자로서 정당한 자리를 차지하세요!

title: Stick Figure Combat
description:
게임 정보
Stick Figure Combat is an action-packed, fast-paced battle experience where you fight hordes of relentless grey enemies to achieve the highest score possible. Test your survival skills as you face off against endless waves of foes, each more challenging than the last. Hone your abilities, unlock new weapons, and fight for dominance in an ever-intensifying combat arena.
Feeling creative? Build and share your own custom maps to challenge your friends or the community! Whether you’re aiming to survive as long as possible or simply having fun with your own designs, the choice is yours.
Key Features:
Endless Waves of Combat: Fight through increasingly difficult enemies in a test of skill and endurance.
Unlockable Upgrades: Discover powerful tools to help you survive longer and defeat tougher enemies.
Competitive Leaderboards: See how you rank against other players and strive to reach the top of the leaderboard.
Survive. Fight. Create. The battle never ends in Stick Figure Combat!
This version adds more excitement, clarity, and a focus on the game’s key features, helping it stand out more to potential players on Steam!

title: AstroScaper
description:
게임 정보

AstroScaper is a minimalist puzzle city-builder where every placement counts. Build colonies on asteroids using strategic proximity-based mechanics and minimal resource management. Relax in freebuild mode or chase high scores in challenge mode – all against a serene cosmic backdrop.

AstroScaper is being crafted by a two-person team in early development. Heavily inspired by Islanders, the game will share a similar scope and vibe while introducing fresh ideas in a sci-fi setting.

We’re pouring our hearts into this little universe and welcome you along for the journey. Feel free to share feedback and ideas!
CHALLENGE MODE - CORE GAMEPLAY
In Challenge Mode, you'll progress through a series of asteroids, each demanding thoughtful placement of your structures. Buildings earn points based on proximity bonuses, encouraging clever arrangements and strategic thinking. There’s no rush – take your time to plan and refine your layout to maximize your score. Future seasonal leaderboards and events will offer fresh challenges and friendly competition.
FREEBUILD MODE - CASUAL CREATIVITY
Prefer to relax and just build? Freebuild Mode lets you pick any asteroid seed and create without limits or pressure. Construct a peaceful space town for the fun of it – no scores, no game-overs. Simply enjoy the meditative experience of building among the stars and grab some screenshots.
ROBUST CAMERA CONTROLS

title: Ash & Adam's Existential Treads
description:
게임 정보
Part city builder, part retro vehicle shooter. Tear down the ruins of the old world and use what you find to build a settlement. Rescue survivors from the wastes. Defend your people against waves of attacks from the rogue AI that ruined the old world. Procedural levels and random build order make every run unique.
Carve your way through the post-post-apocalyptic sprawl to find valuable resources and rescue settlers.
Every building you construct and how you position it affects your settlement's chance of survival.
The dark remnants of humanity’s past are not friendly.
Work together with your community to restore each wasteland to its natural glory.

title: Gunjutsu
description:
게임 정보
GUNJUTSU
💥 TRICKSHOTTING IS BACK. This is for the ones who never stopped spinning.
GUNJUTSU is a tribute to the golden age of Trickshotting—built for those who lived through the OG console era and designed to feel just like the good old days.
🎯 Master the Art of Trickshotting
Work your way down the 'Trickshot Iceberg', a fully-fledged tutorial system that will teach you every skill.
⚡ A Perfect Balance of Skill & Creativity
For the OG Trickshotters: A game with depth, challenge, and variety.
For newcomers: A step-by-step system that helps you grow into a Trickshot master.
HOW IT PLAYS:
🔥 Stay Airborne – Earn points only while in the air—land, and your score resets!
💀 Trick & Shoot – You only bank points if you hit the target.
🧩 A Puzzle-Shooter Like No Other – Every level is an open-ended Trickshot puzzle.
🎮 Compete Worldwide with quantitative skills – Climb the global Leaderboards and prove you're the best Trickshotter alive.
🚀 Wishlist GUNJUTSU now.

title: The Maker Way
description:
게임 정보
샌드박스 에디터에서 기계 설계
오픈 월드에서 완전 재미있게 운영하세요

올드 애리조나에서 작은 로버를 제어할 수 있습니다.
세계에서 가장 잘 보호되는 서버 팜에 침투하는 여러분의 목표는 불가능해 보입니다.
내부에서, 수백 테라바이트의 잃어버린 로봇 공학과 제작 지식이 담긴 "금지된 기술 보관소"를 검색하게 될 것입니다.
AI 혁명 이후 정부가 압수한 지식.
기계를 만들고 작동하여 재료와 부품을 수집하고 제작 능력을 확장하며 적과 싸우세요.
충분히 강력한 기계를 사용하면 서버 팜을 지키는 고급 기계를 물리치고 들어갈 수 있습니다.
기계 설계 및 작동
블록, 기계 부품 및 전자 요소를 사용하여 운전, 비행, 전투, 해킹 등이 가능한 기계를 만드세요.
다양한 부품, 물리적 사양 및 에너지 용량을 사용하여 다양한 디자인을 실험하고 제작품을 개선하세요.
새로운 부품 및 재료 찾기
오픈 월드를 탐험하여 새로운 부품 사양을 찾고 이를 사용하여 더 나은 기계를 만드세요.
기계 및 고급 메이커 베이스 구성 요소의 3D 프린팅에 필요한 재료를 찾으세요.

메이커 베이스 구축 및 확장
메이커 베이스의 용량과 성능을 높이세요.
더 크고 보다 정교한 기계를 인쇄할 수 있도록 더 많은 도구와 구성 요소를 추가하세요.
특징

title: MegaBattle
description:
게임 정보




Get ready for Megabattle, a roguelike card game that combines strategic deckbuilding elements with the thrill of epic robot battles. Build a custom deck and embark on a procedurally generated journey, facing increasingly challenging trials.



In Megabattle, each victory brings valuable rewards in the form of parts and upgrade cards. Utilize these resources to enhance your deck, making your robot more powerful and resilient. During battles, strategically play cards to improve your parts, attack opponents, and defend against enemy assaults.



Explore various robot classes, each with their own unique characteristics and obtainable parts. Discover new attack cards and exclusive power-ups to strengthen your arsenal and adapt to different battle strategies.



With an immersive sci-fi/futuristic atmosphere, Megabattle transports you to a universe filled with robots, advanced technology, and thrilling action.

Prepare for battle and claim victory in Megabattle!

title: Beware of Dog
description:
게임 정보
Beware Of Dog immerses players in an exciting third-person action-adventure/slasher game. Our heroes, Grandpa Jackhammer and his faithful Dog, found themselves face to face with the problem of meat shortages in stores. With fire and an 85-inch wrench, they carved their way to the goal, not even thinking about where they would end up in the end. The world had split and gone mad, but no one noticed. Life goes on, saleswomen are rude to customers, bears deliver pizza, elves engage in robbing late pedestrians. Everything is out of place here, and chaos reigns.
You will take on the role of a retired steel mill worker, nicknamed Jackhammer for his inhuman strength, accompanied by his dog, named Dog. What started as a simple mission to buy meat at the grocery store will turn into an epic adventure in which our heroes will battle with criminal authorities, dragons, and other GIANT creatures, and discover that things, creatures, and substances are not always what they seem.
Features:
• Fast-paced combat using a diverse arsenal of melee and ranged weapons.
• Combo system.
• Variety of unlockable skills and techniques.
• Uninterrupted gameplay without loading screens.
• Allies who assist in battle and lift your spirits with their witty remarks.
• A hero who can JUMP.
• Platforming sections and puzzles.
• Captivating storyline.

title: SurfsUp
description:
게임 정보
Master the art of speed, precision, and acrobatic platforming in this high-octane, movement-focused game.
Overview:
Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled adventure where gravity-defying speed and precision platforming take center stage. Inspired by the legendary surf maps of Counter-Strike, this game offers players a fun and thrilling experience.
Glide through the air and tackle gravity-defying ramps in beautifully crafted environments. Every moment in SurfsUp is about mastering momentum and navigating challenging levels with perfect timing and control.
Gameplay Features:
Surfing Mechanics: Master the art of high-speed air-surfing! Use ramps to slide through levels with precision and style. Timing, control, and momentum are crucial as you navigate ramps, tight turns, and massive jumps. The faster you go, the more agile you become, but misjudge your landing, and you'll pay the price.
Fluid Movement: Experience the thrill of fluid, acrobatic movement across unique maps. Perfect your surfing technique to gain speed, jump further, and reach impossible heights, all while maintaining control.

title: March March!
description:
게임 정보
전술적 전투
유닛을 간접적으로 조종해서 턴 기반 전투에 참여하세요. 가장 중요한 건 유닛이 전장에 진입하는 공격로를 선택하고, 유닛의 대형을 전략적으로 배치하는 겁니다. 몇 수 먼저 계획을 세워서 전투의 잠재력을 극대화하세요. 다양한 기술을 사용해서 아군을 지원하거나 적을 혼란에 빠뜨릴 수도 있습니다.

영웅을 선택하세요!
영웅마다 각기 독특한 기술 세트가 있습니다.

다양한 상황을 헤쳐 나갈 수 있게 도와주는 수십 가지 주문을 찾아낼 수 있습니다.
9가지 직업으로 구분되는 백여 가지 이상의 유닛들을 이용해서 나만의 전략을 개발하고 숨겨진 시너지 효과를 찾아내 보세요.

태양의 사원부터 도둑의 길드까지 다양한 장소로 가득 찬 다채로운 지도를 탐험하세요. 각각의 장소에서는 독특한 보너스를 얻을 수 있지만 모든 장소를 방문할 수는 없으므로 이동 경로에 대해 적절히 계획을 세워 보세요.
도둑이나 해골과 싸우는 데 지쳤다면, 더 강한 적들을 상대로 실력을 시험해 보세요.

취향과 플레이 방식에 맞춰 사용할 수 있는 다양한 유물을 찾아내 보세요. 그 외에도 다양한 콘텐츠가 마련되어 있습니다!

title: Morgenstern
description:
게임 정보

모르겐슈테른은 'Manhunt 2'의 리드 애니메이터, 'No Rest For The Wicked'의 프로듀서, 'Split Second'의 파괴 아티스트로 활동했던 팀이 만든 싱글 및 멀티플레이어 로그라이트 핵 앤 슬래시 어드벤처입니다.

게임플레이
"모르겐슈테른"에서 당신은 수작업으로 제작된 레벨과 절차적으로 생성된 던전에 뛰어들어 위험한 적을 물리치고 귀중한 보물을 찾게 됩니다. 추출 메커니즘은 언제 앞으로 나아가고 언제 후퇴할지를 전략적으로 결정해야 하며, 이는 로그라이크 경험에 전술적 깊이를 더해줍니다.

완전히 파괴 가능한 세계는 자원을 모으고 함정을 설치하며 새로운 길을 개척할 수 있게 하여 각 플레이를 독특한 모험으로 만듭니다.

계약을 완료하고 명성을 얻어 레벨을 올리세요. 새로운 무기, 주문 및 능력을 잠금 해제하여 캐릭터를 강화하세요. 무기와 주문을 제작하여 강력한 마법사, 빠른 도적, 또는 강인한 전사 등 당신의 선호하는 플레이 스타일에 맞게 빌드를 커스터마이징하세요.

협동 모드에서 친구들과 힘을 합치거나, 치열한 PvP 전투에서 다른 플레이어와 실력을 겨뤄보세요. 게임의 PvE 모드는 AI 적과의 도전적인 전투를 제공하여 기술을 연마하고 자원을 모으기에 적합합니다.

패배가 임박했을 때, 치명적인 돼지로 다시 태어나 적을 물리치고 전리품을 가지고 탈출할 마지막 기회를 얻을 수 있습니다. 이 독특한 메커니즘은 게임플레이에 흥미로운 반전을 더해주며, 마지막 순간까지 어떤 플레이도 진정으로 끝나지 않도록 합니다.
당신의 전설을 연대기에 새길 준비가 되셨나요? 지금 "모르겐슈테른"을 다운로드하고 다른 어떤 것과도 비교할 수 없는 서사적인 중세 모험을 시작하세요.

title: Final District
description:
게임 정보
Landing on planet Kepler-11e, You and up to 3 other players are tasked with preventing the planet from complete destruction as a nuclear meltdown is in progress. Upgrade weapons and abilities, Eliminate any aliens in your way and enjoy the beautiful sights in this realistic, first-person, sci-fi experience.

title: DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're In Love
description:
게임 정보
DokiToki is a first-person puzzle game about manipulating time to solve escape-the-room style puzzles. Players need to freeze, unfreeze, and manipulate objects in time to reach each level's exit and progress through school.
Stopping time......with the power of love!
Play as Ai, a girl who's so hopelessly in love, it feels like everything around her is stopped in time. Traverse Ai's school, hopping from hallway to hallway and clearing each classroom in search of the boy Ai wants to confess to.
Toy with time
Use a collection of various tools each affecting time in different way. Some let you manipulate frozen objects, others will send items flying when unfrozen. Put each time-manipulating tool to use to solve each puzzle!
autokwd: DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're In Love

title: Kanji Grinder
description:
게임 정보
Kanji Grinder is a spaced repetition flashcard system, purpose-built for Steam Deck. Designed for immersion learners who want a no-nonsense way to drill Kanji vocabulary recognition, it provides a brisk, pleasant way to get through your daily reviews so you can get back to your media immersion ASAP. Additionally, for those who enjoy quiz games or flexing their knowledge, plenty of challenges await!
Features:
- Over 20,000 hand-curated flashcards, covering over 2,000 kanji in all their major readings. Words are taught based on frequency order - but you're always taught the kanji version first, even if it's less common than the kana version! Every card in the deck teaches at least one kanji. There's enough vocabulary here to take you all the way to JLPT N1, and beyond!
- A novel spaced repetition algorithm that improves upon the usual methods by dynamically adapting to your success or struggles. No more fiddling with interval rates or ease factors - it all adjusts automatically over time to suit your skill level. 
- Over ten hours of hand-picked, hand-mastered music by Japanese indie composers, in a wide range of styles: Lo-fi, Jazz, Bossa, Metal, JRPG OST, Shibuya-kei, J-core, Lounge and more! No matter the day's vibe, there is plenty to listen to as you grind. 
- Fully voiced flashcards and interface: Listening to spoken Japanese is crucial to effective memory formation and language acquisition - so every single flashcard in Kanji Grinder has a sound clip of correct pronunciation. Plus, a native voice actress will cheer you on in the menus!
- A custom monolingual-style dictionary: Unlike the usual Japanese-English dictionaries that just give you a few English words with similar meanings, these dictionary entries will actually explain what the word truly means, and provide example sentences. Each entry is available in both Japanese and English, so you can use it as a "J-J" style monolingual dictionary when you're ready!
- A deep ranking and achievement system: Work your way up from 10th-Kyu to Shodan, and from there, Ichidan and even Kaiden, with increasingly difficult certification exams that grow with your knowledge. There's always a next achievement right around the corner to work towards.
- Purpose-built for Steam Deck: Everything from the user interface to the control scheme and workflow were designed from the ground up to be played on Steam Deck, and the driving purpose of Kanji Grinder is to make SRS study feel like a video game. Developed on Linux, tested on Deck. Windows users welcome.
- Built-in immersion tracking: Keep track of all your immersion time - Anime, Manga, YouTube and whatever else you wish via the comprehensive time-tracking system. A pre-loaded, self-updating database of Anime and Manga titles makes tracking your watch-time and immersion level a breeze.

title: Beach Bar Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Beach Bar Simulator에 오신 것을 환영합니다!
아름다운 마이애미 해변에서 펼쳐지는 편안하면서도 도전적인 경영 시뮬레이션 게임! 당신만의 해변 바를 운영하며 손님을 맞이하고, 자원을 관리하며 작은 가게를 인기 명소로 성장시켜 보세요!
특징:
🛠️ 싱글 & 협력 모드 – 혼자서 즐기거나 친구와 함께 온라인 협력 플레이!
🍹 리얼한 바 운영 – 칵테일을 만들고, 손님을 맞이하며 만족도를 유지하세요.
🏝️ 커스터마이징 & 확장 – 바를 디자인하고, 장비를 업그레이드하여 완벽한 해변 분위기를 조성하세요.
💰 경제 & 전략 – 예산을 관리하고, 가격을 설정하며, 현명한 비즈니스 결정을 내리세요.
🎯 고객 반응 – 적절한 음료를 제공하고 최상의 서비스로 고객을 만족시키세요.
작은 해변 바를 세계적인 명소로 성장시킬 수 있을까요? 지금 바로 칵테일을 만들고, 서빙하며 성공을 향해 나아가세요! 🍹🏝️

title: Blood Punk
description:
게임 정보


Blood Punk is a hyper violent fast-paced retro FPS where you must exchange your health for bullets.

Eviscerate giant abominations with the blood of an angel using deadly weapons in a dark fantasy comic book world.



The world was in balance, but the greed of a monarch led him down a treacherous path.
He ensnared an angel and exchanged it's divine ichor with his own mortal blood.

The balance was broken and the world fell into desolation.

Now it is up to Numa, scion of the deluded monarch, with celestial blood coursing through her veins, to restore the balance.

title: The Sky Left Us
description:
게임 정보
A sci-fi visual novel about climate, class, and the relationships that shape our worldview.
From the deepest miasma to the shimmering veil, everything is in its place. The Peakborn rule, the Sunken toil, and the Unmoored trade. But Clear Skies Technology could rewrite the atmosphere, and with it the culture of planet Zé.
It all depends on how you use it.
Play as Spire Risan, an off-worlder scientist who becomes entangled in the drama of a mountain they came here to save. Fall in with the denizens of the three castes, and find that things are more complicated than they seem: be it love, family, or the systems that shape us.
Features
Six routes and one unlockable true route exploring Spire's relationships with the denizens of Zé.
A rich sci-fi world where the toxic atmosphere is intertwined with the culture and class system.
Beautiful art and an original synth-pop-trip-hop soundtrack.
80,000 words of adventure, intrigue and relationships with difficult choices and deeply flawed characters.
Diverse characters and relationship types.
The Route Characters
THE SPYMASTER — A two-faced Peakborn noble trapped in a web of his own design.
THE PAINTER — An ambitious Unmoored artist, kept like a bauble by her Peakborn patrons.
THE WINDY KID — A quiet Unmoored child who has fallen in with pirates.
THE REVOLUTIONARY — A fiery Sunken leader who wants the peaks to burn.
THE DIVER — A Sunken fogdiver who explores the planet's depths.
THE PIRATES — Two Unmoored pirates who search for freedom through their crimes.
THE IDOL (True Route) — A Sunken Idol with a strange connection to the poisonous miasma.

title: Refugees: Shelter
description:
게임 정보
Game Play
Collect all the materials that can be used for survival, and build a workbench that can produce sustainable materials. You can choose to help other refugees to tide over the difficulties, or keep the materials for yourself to ensure your own safety.
You can use different equipment, such as bulletproof vests and helmets to enhance your character's defense capabilities.
Get through times of material scarcity by producing and manufacturing daily necessities.
On rainy days, the hearing of hostile NPCs will decrease, but the player's physical strength will decrease faster when outdoors, which usually happens in summer.
When there is snow on the ground, the footsteps of the player outdoors will increase (which means that hostile NPCs can hear your footsteps more easily), and the player's physical strength will decrease faster, which is a more difficult weather situation.
In general, the player has only one goal, which is to survive until the day when peace (truce) comes. The player can choose to help other refugees or not.
The player can even fight other refugees to get supplies.
In the first version, there will only be one character for players to choose from. But I did consider adding different characters, for example, a character with a doctor background will recover from injuries faster, a security guard will have longer lasting stamina, etc.
If new characters are added in subsequent versions, my plan is to update them for free.
Story Background
A premeditated war broke out overnight, accompanied by deafening explosions and raging fires. The once bustling city was instantly plunged into panic and chaos, its former tranquility shattered and replaced by cries of terror and the wreckage of buildings.
Before this war, no one believed that this political struggle would ultimately lead to armed conflict. People's confidence in peace caught them off guard, and many had no time to escape, hurriedly taking refuge in bomb shelters, praying to survive this disaster. These bomb shelters, built 80 years ago, have witnessed the changes of history and now once again serve as sanctuaries for people.
About me
Hello, everyone. This game is a Solo-Indie Game. It has not yet entered the promotion stage because I have too much work to complete.

title: Blackfield
description:
게임 정보


In a shadowed parallel universe, where the remnants of humanity cling to existence amidst mechanical overlords and nightmarish creatures, a relentless battle for dwindling food and energy supplies rages. In this bleak and unforgiving world, a young girl named Marta embarks on a harrowing journey through desolate landscapes and haunted ruins, driven by the desperate hope of finding her lost family. Each step she takes is fraught with peril, as the line between ally and enemy blurs, and survival becomes a test of both wits and willpower.
Key Feature

Survival-driven Narrative: Navigate a parallel universe where robots, bizarre creatures, and humans vie for scarce resources essential for survival. Marta’s quest to find her lost family unfolds against this backdrop of intense competition and evolving alliances.

Resource Management and Strategy: Strategically manage limited food and energy sources crucial for Marta’s survival and progression. Make tough decisions that impact alliances and resource allocation, shaping the course of Marta’s journey and the fate of those she encounters.

Dynamic Faction Relationships: Forge alliances or navigate rivalries with robots, creatures, and human factions, each with distinct goals and ideologies. Influence faction dynamics through actions and choices, affecting Marta’s path and the overarching narrative.

Innovative Survival Mechanics: Engage in survival mechanics that go beyond traditional gameplay, requiring adaptation to fluctuating environments and strategic planning to overcome challenges. Explore diverse landscapes and adapt to their unique challenges to uncover clues about Marta’s family.

Delve into Marta’s emotional journey as she confronts loss, courage, and hope amidst a visually rich and atmospheric world. Explore diverse regions that reflect the struggles and resilience of its inhabitants, offering both narrative depth and immersive exploration.

title: Social Warfare
description:
게임 정보
Be a troll-for-hire on social media! 
You have been mandated to serve in the Social Warfare Battalion. Endorsing multiple identities, you will shape public opinion through comments on social media. You will promote loyalty in the Great Kingdom of Eternia while disrupting society in its arch-enemy, the Federation of the Free.
Each mission is a news item where, using a terminal that enables you to take multiple online identities, you select comments/replies that fit your objectives. A mood meter gives you real-time feedback on the public’s reaction: you win when it goes totally to the right side, and lose when it goes totally to the wrong side.
The game will then switch sides and put you in the Federation of the Free's Social Intelligence Task Force, where you will fight against what you were promoting. Through a list of news items that covers a range of political and social matters, you will alternately promote two opposing viewpoints.

Social Media is your weapon, public opinion your battelfield!

title: VOIDFACE
description:
게임 정보
Every enemy is a boss.
From ground-shaking robots to monsters and demons, each of them are uniquely brutal.
And so are you.
In VOIDFACE, you face off in a challenging bullet-hell arena shooter to try and clear bite-sized boss rush challenges. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast spells to gain an upper hand, and kill everything that gets in your way.
FEATURES
36 unique bosses, across 12 stages
Easy and hard mode
One hit, and you're dead (2 hp on Easy)
Various defensive and offensive spells
Stylized, smooth-rendered pixel graphics
Distinctive soundtrack for each stage

title: Kitty Loves Birds
description:
게임 정보
호기심 많은 고양이의 발걸음을 따라 자연에서 영감을 받은 이 매력적인 모험을 시작하세요!
각기 다른 세 가지 다채로운 세계를 탐험하세요.
당신의 고양이 영웅은 점프하고, 새를 잡고, 환경을 민첩하게 탐색하는 것을 좋아하며, 장애물과 동물들을 피하고 간단한 퍼즐을 풀어가면서 모험을 이어갑니다.
이 게임은 매력과 놀라움이 가득한 편안하고 재미있는 게임입니다!

특징:
간단하고 직관적인 게임 플레이
귀여운 새들과 동물들
다채롭고 매력적인 그래픽
각 10단계의 3개의 다른 세계
캐릭터를 커스터마이징할 수 있는 고양이 스킨
스팀 업적
아름다운 음악

title: Deserter
description:
게임 정보
In a world of total control and endless wars, you are John Holden, an AWOL soldier trapped in a grim, war-torn town. Use every available trick to survive and escape this damned city: break into houses, steal food and medicine, hone your thieving skills, and influence the fate of its citizens.
You'll have access to a rich arsenal of tools and devices: from lock picks and crowbars to grappling hooks and dynamite. Additionally, take advantage of your surroundings: find or create alternate routes, stick to the shadows, stay quiet, or use loud noises to cause distraction.

title: Ryder
description:
게임 정보
In Ryder, you’ll embark on a journey through a vibrant, low-poly world filled with puzzles and creatures waiting to be restored. As a Ryder, you can bond with over 60 creatures, each with unique traits that help you solve more than 100 puzzles. Explore four colorful regions, use creature abilities to overcome puzzles, complete your bestiary, and climb the Sanguine Mountain to fulfill your destiny.
Step into the role of a Ryder—an ethereal being with the ability to inhabit living creatures through a process known as bonding. You are tasked with restoring the souls of creatures hidden away long ago and must journey to the summit of the mystical Sanguine Mountain.
Each creature’s soul is stored behind a Sacred Site puzzle. Puzzles are solved by retrieving and intermediately using orbs from within the puzzle area. Strategically switch between your party of creatures in the right sequence to get the orbs to the Sacred Site. Completing a Sacred Site brings the creature back into the wild.

title: BATTLERCORE: TEAM BLAZER
description:
게임 정보
You are the chosen one, the heir to the Emperor's legacy. On the desolate planet of Sphera, a war for power has ravaged the continent of Centradia for decades. As the wielder of imperial power, you've joined the BLAZE HOUND, a peacekeeping force intervening in battles across the globe through Liberators, mercenary soldiers with unwavering determination.

title: LootMage
description:
게임 정보
LootMage(루트메이지)는 중세 판타지 세계를 배경으로 한 마법 탄막 슈팅 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다.
플레이어는 이 세계의 모험가로서 끊임없이 변하는 던전에서 적들과 맞서 싸우며
보물을 수집하고 생존해야 합니다.
끊임없이 쏟아지는 적들의 공격을 회피하며 마법을 활용해 스릴있는 전투를 경험하세요.
패배한다면 모든 아이템을 잃지만, 지금까지 쌓아온 기술과 경험은 새로운 도전에 큰 힘이 됩니다.
과연 당신은 던전의 끝에 다다를 수 있을까요?

title: Sealed Bite: Extended
description:
게임 정보


Emilia's family members start mysteriously vanishing, whisked away one-by-one as if by magic. Setting off to search the world for any traces of them, she is unceremoniously forced to do bidding of an ancient wolf spirit. Is the power Emilia gains from it free to be made her own? Are the spirits her allies, or is she being led astray? And is she even looking in the right place?

Embark on a fairytale metroidvania-style platforming adventure in pursuit of power, memories and truth!



Explore the beautifully handcrafted pixel-art world, from autumn forests to frigid mountain tops, caves, castles and more!
Hone your abilities as the memories of your lost family members come back, one by one - or prove you don't need "medicine" to persevere!



Features:




This, and more awaits you in the world both ethereal and unforgiving!

title: KILLDOZER SIMULATOR
description:
게임 정보
KILLDOZER SIMULATOR에서는 방탕한 노력을 펼치며 도시를 납작하게 만들고 권력과 대립하는 과정을 통해 갑옷 입은 불도저를 운전합니다. 차량을 업그레이드하고 파괴의 경로를 계획하고 전설적인 민중 영웅이 되어보세요.

파괴 가능한 환경: 완전히 파괴 가능한 환경에 당신의 흔적을 남기세요.

강렬한 탑다운 전투: 고위험 전투에서 정부 당국과 맞서 싸우는 스릴을 경험하세요. 전략과 화력을 이용하여 상대를 앞서가고 불리한 상황에서 살아남으세요.

차량 사용자 정의 및 업그레이드: 다양한 업그레이드와 사용자 정의로 당신의 킬도저를 멈출 수 없는 힘으로 변신시키세요. 방어력을 강화하고 무기를 강화하고 게임이 진행됨에 따라 차량을 새로운 도전을 이기기 위해 조정하세요.

title: Free Stars: Children of Infinity
description:
게임 정보
An Epic Space Adventure
Free Stars: Children of Infinity is an action-adventure game inspired by the golden age of science fiction, defined by its hopeful future, wondrous technology, and a grandiose galaxy filled with eclectic stories.

You are the captain of a mission to the farthest reaches of space, where you'll discover thousands of exotic worlds and dozens of alien denizens. Some are friendly, some are terrifying, and some are just plain weird.

It’s up to you to decide how to acquire allies, confront threats, and ultimately protect a universe still recovering from the onslaught of the terrible Ur-Quan overlords in this long-awaited sequel to The Ur-Quan Masters.

Be the Captain
As the sequel to The Ur-Quan Masters and adding modern touches, here’s what you can expect:
Experience a player-centered space saga. Reveal powerful truths about the universe, and an existential threat that can only be stopped by you.
Command your starship and navigate a living universe packed with story, danger, and mystery.





In Children of Infinity, humanity and its allies will voyage to an uncharted region of space, with hundreds of undiscovered stars. With an incomplete Star Map and fragmented clues, you will undertake a vital mission to discover the source of intergalactic tremors that are threatening the fabric of HyperSpace.

The universe is big, but you won’t be alone. You will meet a cast of colorful alien characters with their own unique personalities and motives.



Some will be willing to help you and will need your help in return. Other species may be less friendly. The choice of how to interact with them is always yours, and every alien is different from another. Get ready to be amazed, alarmed, and amused.

Every star on the map contains a procedurally generated planetary system. Many of them are uncharted, and several are quite strange. Your planet scanner will show you what to expect, and you will need to learn which planets have the resources you need.



Many planets deserve a closer look. You and your crew will navigate these untamed worlds in the planet lander, avoiding hazards, collecting resources, and investigating new mysteries.


Your story starts with a discovery from the far reaches of space, three years after you and your allies have overthrown the terrible Ur-Quan masters.

The New Alliance of Free Stars has detected an unnatural breach in HyperSpace, and it is only getting worse. This revelation throws you and your allies into a new adventure, towards an uncharted region of the galaxy filled with mystery.



Space isn’t all discovery and diplomacy. Alien encounters can easily start with a bang. The fast-paced, inertia-driven combat will feature more than 30 different starships, building upon the classic Super Melee action from The Ur-Quan Masters. Each starship has unique powers and characteristics, reflecting one of many distinct alien captains. This new game will feature all new ships and aliens, along with every ship from The Ur-Quan Masters (except the Slylandro Probe, for your safety).



No starships are created equal. Should you invest everything into a single, powerful battleship? Or do you want to spread your resources across a fleet of scrappy specialists? Every starship has its strengths and weaknesses, and you can get an edge by picking the right match-up, or by mastering your weapon of choice.



The standalone combat mode – Super Melee – returns for you to practice your combat skills, playing the game against a friend or AI combatant. Super Melee now supports more than just one-on-one play, with combat between multiple players, and unique modes where you battle against onslaughts of enemies.



Combat is challenging. You can avoid a battle by trying to flee, negotiate, or even delegate. Whether you're unsure of your combat skill or simply prefer to advance the story quickly, Cyborg Mode allows you to cede control to an AI and help you win.

The adventure is more fun with friends! Seamless drop-in multiplayer allows other players to join you and be part of the story.

For players who want competitive action, play online Super Melee matches in classic one-on-one battles. Or try special modes made for multiple players, with plenty of new twists.
Our technology supports game modding out of the box. Players will be able to create new ships, new critters, even whole new stories. Heck, you can even make an entirely different game with our tools.

We love modding, and we want players to try fun ideas we never thought of!

title: Effective Immediately
description:
게임 정보
Congratulations,
You have been appointed the position of repair technician on-board the deep space relay station. Pack your belongings, your family can not join you at this time.
Effective Immediately.

Effective Immediately is a gritty, sci-fi future on the verge of political change. As the sole position of travel in the galaxy you must decide who to accept or decline passage to.
