Encounter alien denizens and walk the line of survival or upholding morality. Make a choice and deal with the consequences.

Compare documents for inconsistencies, repair ship systems and ultimately allow or disallow travel. All the while the OCA is piling on more and more bureaucratic red tape in this puzzle, management life-sim.
Make choices that impact the story
Meet many different characters with unique motivations and inner conflicts. Are they lying or telling the truth?
Pass judgment and determine not only their fates but also the trajectory of your own journey.

Verify ID discrepancies
Ensure they have the correct details; name, race, expiry date all match?
What is their destination? Does their story match up? Are they allowed to travel to that sector since the new OCA regulations came in?

Use schematic rules to repair many alien ship systems; navigation, shields, medical and more.
Learn the rules and become an efficient engineer.

title: GAME HOVER
description:
게임 정보
디스코드 클럽에 가입하세요
당신이 승자가 될 수 있을까요?
급커브, 아찔한 루프, 가파른 하강... 1등으로 결승선을 통과할 준비가 되셨나요? 다양한 무기로 적을 제압하고, 신중하게 선별된 음악에 맞춰 공중을 날아보세요. 혼자서 훈련하든 온라인 레이스에서 승리를 차지하든, 이 빠른 페이스의 미래 세계에서 즐거운 시간을 보낼 수 있습니다.
파워업
승리의 열쇠입니다. 각 경주에서 다양한 곳에 흩어져 있는 아이템 박스를 통과하여 무작위로 얻을 수 있습니다.
레벨

title: UZG
description:
게임 정보
Fast paced, wave based zombie shooter.
the current features include:
19 weapons
5 equipment items
Weapon customization (skins/colours)
Ability to import custom weapon skins (only avaliable for some guns)
Dual wielding (only works on 2 weapons)
2 main maps + 1 seasonal map + 3 extra maps
7 normal enemy types + 1 seasonal one
Player upgrades
Online leaderboards

title: Guns are Funs
description:
게임 정보
Guns are Funs is an arcade game that combines elements of a shooter, runner, and tower destruction. Immerse yourself in the world of toy soldiers who wage fierce battles for power and influence in the room. Bright dynamic battles, unique missions, and a variety of game modes await you.
The story campaign is divided into chapters, each offering distinct missions that challenge your skills across different aspects of the game. And if you're looking for some non-stop fun without the narrative, dive into the sandbox mode — where you can explore all game elements and compete for the highest score.

title: Sloppy Forgeries
description:
게임 정보
Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced competitive painting game. Each round players race to copy a famous painting from art history as quickly and accurately as possible using their mouse and a few simple paint tools.
Accuracy is calculated by a pixel-by-pixel comparison of your painted reproduction and the original. Incorrect pixels are visualized upon completion.
Strategically use your assist tools to refine your masterpiece while you paint. These tools include a time-limited grid overlay:
...and three time-limited reference pins, which you can drag on to your canvas or the masterpiece. When placed, a second pin appears on the other painting in the same location, making it easier to see what goes where.

title: Prison of Lies
description:
게임 정보


Four prisoners on death row are cleared of all charges. But the prison has a quota to meet. The four are put in a room and asked to decide among themselves over the course of an hour... who will be the one to die?

Prison of Lies is a psychological linear visual novel about lies, trust, and empathy. There are four chapters, each of which get progressively shorter.

While playing the game, you uncover more about each prisoner.

It takes approximately half an hour to play.
Features

Original soundtrack
Bios and other extras
Non-linear storytelling

title: CHERNOGRAD
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to "CHERNOGRAD"!
You are an officer of the Citizen Tranquility Agency's surveillance department, tasked with investigating potential crimes in District 15 using cutting-edge technology to monitor citizen activity. Your job is to review cases, identify violators, record evidence, and file reports — all for the good of your country!
Core Gameplay
In your office, you will operate a control panel, receiving alerts about potential violations. You will connect to apartments and use buttons, levers, sliders, and dials to determine whether an incident has truly occurred. Pay close attention to the details — violations can be hidden in small things, and sometimes the real culprit isn't the one you're watching. Remember, the responsibility is heavy — your next report could decide not only someone else's fate but also your own.

title: Calamity
description:
게임 정보
You are our very best in these chaotic times. Your job is to help out the locals during these devastating disasters. Can you survive the calamities?
Chaotic Events: Experience meteors smashing into buildings, physics driven tornadoes ripping through towns and tossing you and the locals around, and exploding everything near by, survive the blistering cold inflicted by blizzards, and find cover while dust storms are hitting and huge tumbleweeds hit the town.

Destruction: Experience buildings getting ripped apart by tornadoes or meteors smashing into buildings flying debris.


Player Choices: Play with your friends or find others to help out the locals while trying to survive natural disasters. Adapt and alter your surroundings to gain advantages and create new paths to safety.

title: THREAT ACTOR
description:
게임 정보
Threat Actor is a cybercrime-themed RTS game featuring a series of campaign maps with increasingly complex mechanics and objectives.
THE DARK HUB
As a fresh member of an infamous cybercrime organization called The Dark Hub, your life depends on whether you can prove your worth to the faction's leaders by successfully completing your assignments.
As you slowly climb the leadership ladder, it is only a matter of time before some of the senior staff members start to see you as a threat.
THE DARK WEB
Your criminal enterprise resides on the Dark Web, a 3D topdown map filled with various resources, factions and hostile malware entities.
Occupied by all kinds of people - from simple scammers to hackers, creeps and dangerous members of the occult, you will encounter a variety of quests and other interactions designed around given campaign map's theme.
THE CRIME ECONOMY
Participate in the dark web economy by building out your marketplace. Create workers to gather resources and manage your organization's income, population and amenity level. Produce units to defend your base or attack hostile organizations. Hire moderators to work at the marketplace's facilities and leverage your faction's economy to accomplish the map's objective.

title: Surviving Deponia
description:
게임 정보
SURVIVING DEPONIA
"새로운 시대 - 같은 쓰레기"

"굿바이, 데포니아!"로부터 7년 후, 한때 사랑스러웠던 작은 쓰레기 행성이 매드맥스 같은 악몽으로 변했습니다. 공중에 떠 있는 상류층의 성채 엘리시움이 데포니아의 지표면으로 추락하면서, 전례 없는 물 부족은 물론 새로운 구조와 새로운 질서를 가져왔기 때문입니다.
험난한 데포니아에서 새 친구와 옛 친구들을 만나고, 쓰레기 더미에서부터 모험을 시작하세요!

사랑스러운 쓰레기 행성 위에 지어지는 집
자원을 모아 데포니아에 집을 만드세요. 쓰레기일진 모르지만, 그래도 당신의 쓰레기입니다!
험난한 데포니아에서 살아남기
데포니아는 예전과 달라졌습니다. 위험한 생활 환경은 물론, 괴물과 인간들이 당신의 삶을 피폐하게 만들 것입니다!
새롭게 열리는 장
Surviving Deponia는 독립적으로 즐길 수 있지만, 이 게임은 포인트 앤 클릭 어드벤처 게임인 "데포니아" 시리즈에서 엘리시움의 운명과 데포니아의 주민들의 정식적인 결말을 팬들에게 선사합니다.

title: Beneath the Bleeding Moon
description:
게임 정보
Adashima Haru was born in the lap luxury. He lives with his mother in the heart of Kyoto, in a spacious home with servants to tend to his every need. Haru has everything a young man could ever want…
At a glance, at least.
In actuality, however, Haru’s life isn’t so perfect.
Haru’s mother is stern and controlling, and she dictates every facet of Haru’s life. She is adamant that Haru should dress like a woman, and she constantly berates him for not behaving like a young lady.
Haru's life is dull and uninteresting... until he runs into a thief, Kishou, during a rare shopping excursion.
After discovering that Haru is a young man, not a young woman, Kishou breaks into Haru’s home in the dead of night in an attempt to blackmail him – and, in so doing, Kishou’s destiny becomes irrevocably entwined with Haru’s.
On that fateful night, Haru and Kishou are set a task: to travel the country slaying monsters, so that they might break a centuries-old curse that has plagued Haru’s family for generations.
100k worth of text (approx 4-8 hours of reading)
A linear story with no choices/branches

title: Disco Samurai
description:
게임 정보
개요
디스코 사무라이는 펜실베이니아의 사이버펑크 도시 디스코를 배경으로 한 독특한 리듬 전투 게임입니다. 공격, 방어, 대시 및 기타 능력을 음악의 비트에 맞춰 부드럽게 결합하여 당신의 기술을 시험해보세요. 법과 규칙이 없는 세상에서, 검을 마스터한 자만이 영광과 번영을 누릴 자격이 있습니다. 상상 이상의 음모에 휘말린 반항적인 학생 폭스가 되어, 볼륨을 높이고 신스웨이브와 록의 전율적인 사운드스케이프의 리듬을 잡고, 미니멀리스트 디오라마 아레나를 통해 싸워 나가세요!
상세 정보
전투
디스코 사무라이에서는 당신과 적의 행동이 음악의 비트에 맞춰 동기화됩니다. 사무라이로서 적을 존중해야 합니다 – 적의 공격 지표에 주의를 기울이고, 패리, 블록, 회피를 번갈아 사용하여 적을 지치게 해야 합니다. 주저하지 말고 주도권을 잡아 공격하거나, 적을 환경적 위험 요소로 차서 추가 피해를 입히는 등의 특수 능력을 사용하세요. 비트를 놓치면 당신은 죽은 목숨입니다 – 하지만 레벨은 짧으니 다시 시도하는 데 몇 초밖에 걸리지 않습니다.

보스 전투
복잡한 공격 패턴을 가진 매우 위험한 보스들과 맞서 싸우세요. 각 보스는 자신만의 독특한 노래에 맞춰 공격 패턴이 동기화되어 있어, 각 싸움에 개인적인 터치를 더합니다.

맞춤 음악
레벨을 완료한 후, 게임에 로드한 맞춤 음악으로 다시 플레이할 수 있습니다.
스토리
세상은 디스코 사무라이에 미쳐 있습니다 – 사이버펑크 메타버스인 디스코를 배경으로 한 게임입니다. 모든 사람이 이 게임을 하고 있습니다 – 당신의 이웃, 당신의 상사, 아마도 당신이 가장 싫어하는 정치인까지도요. 사람들은 가상 부동산, 자동차, 디자이너 옷을 구매할 뿐만 아니라 심지어 보험까지 가입하고 있습니다! 미친 소리 같나요? 저에게 말해보세요 – 게임이 출시된 이후로 세계 범죄율이 77% 이상 감소했습니다! 사소한 범죄로 감옥에 썩느니, 디스코에서 악명 높은 현상금 사냥꾼이 되어 아무런 결과 없이 활동하는 게 낫지 않겠어요?

이 이야기는 건축과 미술 분야에서 이름을 날리고 싶은 반항적인 학생 폭스를 따라갑니다. 가상 반달리즘과 픽셀 피를 흘리는 것이 강의를 듣는 것보다 그녀의 스타일에 더 맞기 때문에, 디스코 세계는 ""브루탈리즘""의 새로운 정의를 배우게 될 것입니다.

title: Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness
description:
게임 정보

Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness – 메트로배니아 탐험의 메커니즘과 현대 슬래셔의 역동성을 결합한 액션 RPG 장르의 등각 투영 스토리 중심 게임입니다.

게임의 줄거리는 외계 침략의 중심에 자신을 발견한 중세 남자의 이야기를 담고 있습니다. 주인공과 그의 가족, 지역 주민들은 외계인에게 납치된다. 엄청난 행운, 전투 기술, 신비한 목소리의 개입 덕분에 우리의 주인공은 외계 기술을 가지고 우주선에서 지구로 탈출하는 데 성공합니다. 나중에 그의 가족이 다른 배에 타고 있고 지구에서 본격적인 침략이 벌어지고 있다는 사실을 알게 된 영웅은 행동하기 시작합니다.

- 전투 시스템: 게임플레이의 핵심 요소는 단순히 아이템, 무기, 방어구의 능력치가 아닌 플레이어의 액티브 스킬과 획득한 고유 능력을 효과적으로 사용하는 것입니다. 각 유형의 적을 섬멸하는 독특한 접근 방법을 찾거나, 위치와 주변 물체의 특징을 활용하여 적을 물리치세요!

- 게임 세계는 세미 오픈 원칙으로 구성되어 있습니다. 플레이어에게는 탐험과 상호작용을 위한 광범위한 영역이 제공됩니다. 모든 위치는 서로 연결되어 있으며 스토리가 진행되거나 새로운 기술을 습득하면 사용할 수 있게 됩니다.

- 게임 세계는 역사적 사실에 기초한 것이 아닌 완전히 허구적인 세계입니다. 지역 주민들은 그들만의 문화, 예술, 삶의 방식을 가지고 있습니다. 중세 시대는 Eclipse 세계에서 인간 발달의 현재 단계를 조건부로 지정하는 것입니다. 때때로 플레이어는 중세 시대의 전형적인 기술과 아이템을 접할 수 있지만 나중에 줄거리는 그 모습에 대한 설명을 제공합니다.

지구에 대한 외계인 침공에 맞서 중세 저항군을 이끄세요!

title: AMNYAM
description:
게임 정보
“마우스 조준 기술로 정상에 도전하세요!”
“AMNYAM”은 당신이 “마우스 조준 기술”을 사용하여 올라가고 정상에 도전하는 플랫폼 게임입니다.
주변에 떠 있는 “목표”를 정확히 조준하고 클릭하여 고양이 소녀가 높이 점프하게 하세요.
하지만 아무것도 하지 않으면 캐릭터는 원래 높이로 떨어집니다.
따라서 공중에서 다음 목표를 클릭해야 합니다.

title: Kiosk Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Kiosk Simulator is an action-packed comedic take on the hustles of running a big city kiosk and the nostalgia of reaching that lone open kiosk on a rainy late night.
Roleplay
Take on the role of a kiosk’s owner in Cologne, Germany.
Restock, serve customers, maintain and protect your kiosk against robbery and vandalism!
Vibrant Cast and Dynamic Gameplay
Each customer could be a loyal customer, a potential shoplifter or even a troublemaker!
Difficulty Curve
Tougher antagonists/bosses might take away your hard-earned cash - so be prepared for a challenge!

title: Infinity Knights: Xross
description:
게임 정보
Whether you’re looking for a solo experience or to team up with friends and family, an unforgettable adventure awaits in Infinity Knights: Xross! Lovingly developed by three brothers, this multiplayer RPG immerses players in a lush fantasy world filled with rich lore and challenges. Form strong bonds and band together with allies to take on epic quests, craft powerful items, and challenge colossal bosses, where teamwork is your greatest weapon!
company: Timesea Studio, Saxon, Michael, and Tyrone Goodrick

title: Dead Static Drive
description:
게임 정보
Grand Theft Cthulhu

Dead Static Drive is Grand Theft Cthulhu. An indie survival-horror game following a nightmarish road trip across a 1980s Americana. Playing as prodigal-child Hearst, you need to scavenge, fight, sneak, and explore in order to figure out what’s happened to your parents, and the rest of the world. Evade police. Equip yourself and those close to you, and follow your own moral code.  Learn how—and who—to trust. And learn it fast, the monsters are gaining on you.

Dead Static Drive blends weird fiction and uncanny Eldritch themes with a spooky unease underlying this small-town life.
Heavily influenced by the work of weird fiction authors T. E. D. Klein, Gene Wolfe, & Ramsey Campbell, filmmaker David Lynch, and photographer William Eggleston, Dead Static Drive hopes to invoke images of an America now lost, where with the right car and enough gas, anything felt possible.

title: Desert Pirates
description:
게임 정보



GAME DESIGN documents will soon be released to the community. If you're curious or interested, you'll get to know EXACTLY what we're building!
Features:
Cars convoy
Primary weapon variety
Secondary weapon (missiles)
Dynamic Zoom
RAM damage
Speed boost
Command Orders
Upgrade cars and weapons
Collect Cars
Find skins
Expand your convoy
World
2 fighting tribes w/ several cars and features each
1 trading tribe w/ several shops
Environment destruction
4 resources to obtain + credit coin + tech
Strategic levels
Eternal Ride
Experience:
You lead a Convoy through the Desert.

The game involves driving and battling through zones to gather enough resources to sustain your journey as far as possible, all while having a BLAST of fun. Creating a game that can be played "" forever might seem like a foolish idea, but somehow, it's working! (If not us, then who?)

This game is the result of collaboration among three industry colleagues, each with a background in different studios across various eras, some of which we share. We're devoting our spare time to this endeavor. Though it's a gradual process, it's unfolding beautifully.

Our goal is to create a genuinely enjoyable and scalable game that players can engage with over the long term. By continuously adding new content along the journey, we're crafting an experience that players can wholeheartedly immerse themselves in.

title: no brake no gain
description:
게임 정보
BUILD. CUSTOMIZE. DRIVE.
no brake no gain is an arcade precision-driving game where skill outshines speed. Navigate intense, obstacle-packed tracks where every dodge, drift, and turn demands ultimate control.
Take on a series of high-stakes driving challenges designed to push your reflexes and creativity to the limit. Complete tricky objectives, from speed-based sprints to navigating trap-laden courses. Whether you're dodging hazards or chasing perfection, every level demands mastery!
KEY FEATURES
ARCADE PRECISION DRIVING
Feel the thrill of tight, responsive controls that reward skill and creativity. Master each challenge with pinpoint accuracy as you weave through traps, perform daring maneuvers, and reach the mysterious idol in style.
GARAGE CUSTOMIZATION
Upgrade your cars to handle tougher challenges with confidence. Fine-tune speed and handling, and paint your vehicle to match your personal style as you prepare to conquer every challenge.
VERSUS MINIGAMES
Gather your friends for local multiplayer chaos! Compete in exciting game modes like Capture the Flag, Pass the Bomb, and Survival. May the best driver win!
DYNAMIC LEVELS
Conquer wild, unpredictable tracks filled with lasers, moving platforms, explosive barrels, and other inventive obstacles. Adapt, react, and push your skills to the limit!

title: Perikoto
description:
게임 정보
The lighthouse's bright rays pierce through the foggy sea and the dense woods, beckoning you. Restless crows peck on the roots of the trees, disturbing what's within. As you land on the frozen beach, you realize how far from home you are.
Features
Experience an immersive, tension-filled trek through deep snow and multiple locations.
Plan your route carefully, or accidentally lure the thing of the woods.
Explore abandoned buildings to solve the secret of the lighthouse.
Use various tools to make your way through challenging terrain.
Remember, do not scare the birds.
If you feel it approaching, hide.

This cold land is calling for you…

title: Miyu's Cursed Store
description:
게임 정보
Intro
In a new alternate universe set in the early 20th century, follow Miyu, a young student, as she tries to live everyday life with her teddy bear and guide, 'Cotton'.


When Miyu's parents' reckless lifestyle causes financial harm and attracts dangerous attention, she and her loyal companion embark on a journey into the infernal realms to begin a new business venture.
Characteristics

Write Your Story: Make impactful choices to your journey as shopkeeper.

Profitable Dungeon Crawler: Explore fast-paced dungeon challenges to gain access to new useful resources for your shop.

Potion Crafting: Discover a new and exciting way to make potions.

Master the Art of Pricing: Strategically price your products to attract new customers and maximize profits.

title: Immune Simulator Type Z
description:
게임 정보
Immune Simulator is a strategy-adventure game.

The story describes a world in which humans are fighting against zombies and losing. The female protagonist accidentally finds an old computer with software that records the process of human-zombie conflicts, much like historical documents.

The protagonist attempts to operate the computer and view these historical records but discovers that the historical data can be changed. After leaving the machine, the balance of power between humans and zombies in the real world also changes. Just as she thinks she can use this machine to turn the tide against the zombies, her companions begin to change one by one.

Is this machine a salvation from God or a trap from the devil? What secrets are hidden in this machine? It's up to the player to discover.

title: dev_hell
description:
게임 정보
We are searching for a software developer who is able to start work in our metro office location as soon as possible. This is an exclusive opportunity meant only for big thinkers who truly want to make an impact on the world. The ideal candidate for this position must be committed to unconditional motivation and positivity every day.
Employees at our company recognize that blending work and life is nothing to shy away from. Our current contract with [REDACTED] involves three upcoming projects with tight timelines. The right person for this role will be willing to do whatever it takes.
QUALIFICATIONS:
Able to launch software in a high pressure environment.
5+ years experience in software development.
(Recruiter’s note) Client doesn’t really care about experience.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Complete features before the end of each sprint.
Ensure quality through code reviews and paired programming.
Work with QA to identify and resolve bugs proactively.
Maintain positive relationships with your coworkers.
Play your cards right to balance multiple priorities. (Over 400 cards!)
WHAT WE OFFER:
Career development opportunities. (Lots of unlocks!)
Kudos loyalty rewards to spend at the company store.
Freedom to follow your own path (within reason).
Unlimited coffee.

title: BRUTALIST
description:
게임 정보
There is a world among you, a world that consists of abandoned concrete jungles, full of mysteries, dangers and secret passages. Your main enemy is polluted air, so along the way you will have to look for oxygen cylinders, this will add to the challenge!
Somewhere far away, there is a green paradise, but can you reach it?
The main feature and idea of the BRUTALIST is to enjoy the environment, especially for fans of post-apocalypse and minimalist concrete architecture. Narration through the environment, that's what awaits you.
Main features of the Game:
No mini map or flashing pointers on the whole screen, just environment and the goal of going to the green oasis while exploring the mystery of the dead concrete world.
The element of survival is the need for oxygen, collect cylinders with this source of life along your path, go in the wrong direction - most likely you will lose...
For greater immersion in the world, game does not have a classic interface, the only indicator is the oxygen level on the cylinder behind the player.
The world is also dangerous with many sources of radiation, the main character has a counter, it will show with a sound signal how close you are to death.
Collect bits of the history of the world from the environment, and you will find out what happened.

title: Brobot
description:
게임 정보


Brobot is a single player platform game. Each stage will be released episodically. Its main character; Brobot, is a small robot. He must traverse a myriad of worlds and ultimately reach the mythical Dynamo Core to restore order to his home world.

Brobot allows the player to manipulate the direction of gravity to traverse various worlds and overcome obstacles, creating interesting and unique challenges that encourage fast-paced play while the player uncovers the truth of their purpose in the multiverse.

title: Crescent Overload
description:
게임 정보
CRESCENT OVERLOAD is an Action 3D platformer with major neo-Y2K inspirations, set inside a virtual cyberscape. You play as AL.exe, the newest programmed proto, as she explores YSB2aXJ0dWFsIChyZWFsPykgd29ybGQ with her Gear Scythe.
Fast, fluid movement that combines AL.exe's moveset, her Gear Scythe, and the world around you.
An intertwined world with enemies, secrets, and shortcuts.
Combat which combines movement with bullethell design.
A story YWJvdXQgbm9zdGFsZ2lh set in a fictional game.
YSBsb3ZlbGV0dGVyIHRvIG91ciBwYXN0

title: Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse는 섬뜩한 생물과 페이스가 빠른 근접 전투, 강력한 능력과 함께하는 도전적인 핵 앤 슬래시 로그라이트 게임입니다. 초자연적 현상을 조사하고 인류의 생존을 위해 싸우는 비밀 조직의 일원이 되세요.
진실을 밝히세요!
손으로 그린 코믹 패널이 게임플레이에 자연스럽게 뒤섞이며 수수께끼와 음모가 가득한 어두운 이야기 속으로 플레이어를 끌어들입니다. 게임을 시작하고 죽을 때마다 늑대 섬의 위험과 그 안에 도사린 비밀이 조금씩 드러납니다.
강렬하고 빠른 페이스의 전투에서 실력을 시험하세요!
쉬지 않고 공격을 계속하다 보면 결국 때이른 죽음을 맞을 뿐입니다. 나만의 스타일에 맞춰 고유한 능력과 유물, 강화를 조합해서 강력한 시너지를 발휘하세요. 까다로운 보스들과 맞서 싸우며 우월한 실력을 증명하세요. 적에게 지옥을 맛보여주세요!
autokwd: Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse

title: Cradle-18
description:
게임 정보
I wake disoriented. Where am I? Looking out a window, I see the light reflected off the planet below. Clearly, I’m in orbit, but over a planet I don’t recognize. How did I get here? Why can’t I remember anything? Where is everyone?

Cradle-18 is a 3D walking simulator aboard an orbital space station. Explore from one compartment to the next to unravel the mystery of this deserted craft. What was the mission? And what has become of the crew? Am I truly alone?

Search for clues and collect information to piece together the answers. But space is a harsh environment, and the systems on this craft are showing signs of stress. Survival is not guaranteed.

Notes of horror. It feels uncomfortable on the uninhabited station in space.

Space ambient music. Enjoy space views to the beautiful space music. While you can.

title: Lo-Fi Life
description:
게임 정보
Lo-fi Life is a FPP game about time management in hard conditions of morning time before going to work.
Every decision you make costs you time, every decision is important.
Create your own life path using procedural story and face the consequences, decide to get up or lie "only 5 minutes more".
There are many player stories and paths to the ending

Taste the life in Lo-fi music style!

title: Rules of Alchemy
description:
게임 정보

Rules of Alchemy is a spell combo roguelike with thousands of items, deep rpg systems, fast-paced strategic combat, and a procedurally generated world full of secrets. Mix your spells with each other, the environment, and your weapon, as you master thousands of combinations to decimate your foes!
MASTER THE ELEMENTS
Unlock over 100 spells on the Runegate and discover even more hidden spells as you play the game. In Rules of Alchemy spells are cast by combining other spells in real time. This unique system will have you experimenting with tons of different loadouts. Learn to counter enemy spells and turn them into your own. You can even use the environment or items as part of your combo.
Find your perfect playstyle among the 9 classes and their weapon types. From sword and shield, to dual lances, each weapon class provides a unique combat system that evolves the further you progress in the game. Experience the unique combo system and master every weapon’s perks and techniques. Discover legendary weapons and use them to augment your spells, reach hidden areas, and defeat secret bosses.
Craft, transmute, trade, equip and level up thousands of procedural items. Combined with a deep rpg stat system, a massive spell tree, and 7 procedural biomes, Rules of Alchemy will have every run feeling fresh and exciting. Meet a wide range of NPCs and access different rare items, epic quests, boss fights and climatic endings, all based on the dialog, items, and stats you choose.
A dark force has corrupted the land and the torn have begun to invade. It is said only the Philosopher's Stone can repair this broken world and drive out the dark forces. Discover the mysteries of an ancient people and seek out answers to your immortality. Unlock the power of the runegate and find the traitorous alchemist within your ranks.









***Many features listed are not available in the demo

title: Wandering Wolf
description:
게임 정보
S T R I B O G is a first person shooter with a strong focus on immersion and survival.
You will take part in unpredictable events and stories created by the game itself.
You will meet only that which exists within the framework of the game universe and its laws.
The main story follows the split in society during the Civil War in the Hard Fantasy setting.

- First person shooter

- Thoughtful levels, with Metroidvania elements

- The atmosphere of the civil war and hopelessness

- Immersion, alternative reality effect

- Workshop Support

title: Rusty Rangers
description:
게임 정보
[용감한 레인저 팀을 제외하고는 아무도 이전의 세상이 어땠는지 기억하지 못합니다. 이제 혼돈과 예측 불가능성이 모든 곳을 지배하고 있으며, 과거에는 무해했던 생명체가 파괴를 가져오고, 주변 세계는 끊임없이 변화하며 익숙한 환경을 무력화시키고 있습니다.
고전적인 게임플레이와 현대적인 메커니즘의 결합
용감한 레인저 중 한 명을 조종하여 책임감 있는 임무를 수행하세요 - 악당을 찾아 널리 퍼진 광기를 막고 세상에 평화와 정의를 되찾으세요!
여러분은 세상을 구하기 위해 달리고, 점프하고, 쏘는 등 바쁘게 지낼 수 있는 많은 독특한 적들을 만나게 될 것입니다! 레인저마다 전투 스타일과 특수 기술이 다르므로 자신에게 가장 적합한 영웅을 선택할 수 있습니다!
아름다운 픽셀 그래픽
러스티 레인저의 세계는 상세한 세계, 독창적이고 다채로운 캐릭터, 유용한 아이템 및 기괴한 생물로 가득합니다. 각 픽셀은 큰 사랑으로 만들어졌습니다. 러스티 레인저의 아름답고 놀라운 세계를 즐겨보세요!

title: LIMYN
description:
게임 정보


In the colorful soundscapes of LIMYN, you rotate with the rhythm, guiding a delicate thread through a geometric maze. Each rotation, a tick in time; each transition, a note in an ever-evolving melody. Obstacles dance, enemies lurk, but you are in command.

LIMYN evokes the simple gameplay of turn-based puzzlers like Hitman GO, but with skill-based obstacles that will challenge your musical timing.

Find the flow.

title: Enlightened
description:
게임 정보
You find yourself in the basement if the hotel, not knowing how you get there. The place seems empty, but only at the first glance...
Will you be able to overcome all obstacles on your way and solve the mystery of the hotel?

Solve multiple puzzles created by the fan of the escape rooms,
Find the clues about what happened and why are you here,
Explore multi floor hotel with variety of rooms,
Survive the horrors that exists there,
Experience disturbing scenes from nightmares created in pixel art,

title: Tech Hustle
description:
게임 정보
Tech Hustle is a wild, fast-paced management sim where you turn a small tech shop into a booming empire! Juggle deliveries, haggle with customers, hire quirky employees, and upgrade to robots that handle it all—while you take a coffee break. But watch out! The black market offers juicy deals on rare tech… if you’re willing to bend a few rules. Will you play it safe or hustle your way to the top?
Run Online and Physical Store
Customize Store: Make your store look fabulous or hilariously awful—it’s your choice! Just be ready for customer reviews like, “Great prices, but what’s up with the neon toilets?”

title: Codename TCT
description:
게임 정보
The battle for the free city of Crimson Tide has begun.



Following the Crimson Reapers path of destruction lead to a state-wide revolution. You are a citizen from the lower levels of the mega city and you will do your part. Will you gather funds to escape the city amidst chaos, or grab the opportunity to scratch some leftovers...or possibly much more. Be warned though: the NRF forces have entered the city to bring back order, but the left over gangs, along with the C.T.P.D. and Kyoncha Security will have their own plans and agendas.



Codename TCT is a FPS with parkour and roguelite elements, where you will forge your own tale through the streets and underbelly of the crumbling mega city of Crimson Tide.

title: 千里山河录
description:
게임 정보
这是一款六边形拼图游戏，站在了同类型优秀作品巨人肩膀上的同时，也努力打造了一个拥有自己特色、能够为玩家游玩体验带来更多惊喜的作品。
透过时光的缝隙，用着900年前古朴的画卷风格，玩家通过自由创造，徐徐展开一幅幅水墨丹青风格的壮丽山水人间长卷。
玩家将与小千一同启程拜访中华美景与诗词古典，重新获得灵感再绘一幅当代的千里江山图。
以全自由拼图玩法为核心，融入剧情冒险与Roguelike挑战，让玩家在休闲放松的同时再次遇见百年前的山水人间之美

title: The Family
description:
게임 정보
The Family
– A Gritty Journey into the Dark World of 1950s Mafia Life

Step into the underworld of 1950s Bayford, Italy, where violence, betrayal, and power define the streets. In The Family, you assume the role of Tyler Jones, a down-and-out boxer struggling to make ends meet. Desperation leads him into the clutches of the notorious Cappello crime family, where the allure of easy money pulls him deeper into a world he never imagined.

As Tyler, you’ll navigate a dangerous path between two warring Mafia families—the Capellos and their bitter rivals, the Costellos. Will you rise through the ranks, gaining wealth and power beyond your wildest dreams, or will you fall victim to the greed and bloodshed that define this ruthless world?

Featuring 13 intense chapters filled with dramatic twists, brutal combat, and morally complex decisions, “The Family” challenges you to prove your loyalty, outmaneuver your enemies, and survive in a world where trust is scarce, and the stakes are deadly.

Do you have what it takes to thrive in this violent underworld, or will you be consumed by the very life you sought to escape?
The choice is yours—but remember, in the Mafia, every decision has consequences.

Key Features:
- Immersive 1950s Mafia setting in the heart of Bayford, Italy.
- Play as Tyler Jones, a struggling boxer turned Mafia enforcer.
- Experience a gripping narrative with 13 action-packed chapters.
- Explore a large open world filled with hidden secrets, dangerous opportunities, and vibrant characters.
- Navigate the complex web of alliances and rivalries between two powerful crime families.

title: Sunken Veins
description:
게임 정보
Sunken Veins is a management horror game set on a flooding underwater coal mine. Your job is to mine for coal whilst dealing with overwhelming floods of water and adaptive aquatic creatures that learn from the way you play.
MINING
Operate a deep-sea mining drill to extract coal and scraps. Whilst mining, the facility builds stress, which increases the chances of causing a flood. Find the balance between gathering resources and maintaining stress levels.
DRAIN
Floods in the facility will disrupt electronics and extend the length of your shift until they are dealt with. Large industrial drains will help you remove water and keep the water levels down.
MAINTAIN
A proactive approach can help you stay alive. Repair and reinforce ceiling vents. Fortify doors to stop water spreading. Whatever it takes to stop you from being overwhelmed.
ADAPTIVE CREATURES
You aren't alone. Predatory creatures have found their way into the mine after the company disrupted their home. They are smart, adaptive and very dangerous. How you play will influence the behaviours they use to hide, deceive and try to kill you.
TWITCH CHAT INTEGRATION
Connect your Twitch account to allow chat to influence the game. You can control which commands are available for chat to use, set cooldowns for them, and also set custom text prompts that triggers the commands. Some commands are helpful and some are disruptive. You can fully control which ones are available for your chat to use.

title: SPORTAL
description:
게임 정보
Bat, Strike, Kick and Smack balls into monstrous menagerie in this retro sport themed fps roguelike, where you are sucked into a portal and emerge with a plethora of sport equipment repurposed into an arsenal of lethal weapons.

- Use a variety of sporting equipment to defeat hordes of monsters straight from 50's era creature features by launching spiked baseballs, lightning infused hockey pucks, exploding golf balls, bladed bowling balls and more



- Find clues as to what happened when you went to your favourite cinema in your favourite mall just to wake up in the magical land frequented by nasties that you only believed existed on celluloid



- Pick up and upgrade the numerous clubs, bats, sticks and balls, outfits and perks to find the winning combinations of hardware and gear to have the best shot at getting rid of all the monstrosities thrown your way and maybe, just maybe, you will have a chance to make it back home

title: SOVIET SPOOKY TALES: Green Eyes
description:
게임 정보
"Eeny, meeny, miney, moe
Creepy GREEN EYES are on the wall.
Don't you think all this is joke,
Little girl is gonna choke!"
Have you ever heard of the cursed Green Vinyl? Or perhaps the Black Blanket is trying to kill you at night? Have you ever encountered a Blue Finger in a bun? The visual novel "SOVIET SPOOKY TALES: Green Eyes" is the first of five planned games set in the lore of Soviet children's spooky stories, where everything is real. The story follows a girl named Dasha from class 4th "B," who disobeyed her mother and listened to the green record. Along with her, you will confront a mysterious and terrifying evil, and it is up to you to decide what awaits her in the end. ^___^

title: Spook-A-Boo
description:
게임 정보
Welcome cadets!
It’s time to team up with fellow ghost hunters and take a stand against the mischievous ghosts hiding across the galaxy. Travel through wacky worlds and dizzying dimensions in search of these troublemakers before they cause even more havoc.
Spook-A-Boo is a couch co-op game for one to four players and can be played online or offline. Coordinate with your friends and family to outsmart your spooky foes, and capture them before they escape. Race against time in 30 unique levels to complete your mission and uncover the truth behind the ghosts.
Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for a fun family activity, Spook-A-Boo promises laughter, cooperation, and a whole lot of ghostly good times.
Use Cutting-edge Tech
Equip yourselves with the latest ghost-hunting gear to catch those pesky specters.

title: Queendom
description:
게임 정보
It is a turn-based strategy game similar to a board game.
The goal of the game is to capture 12 regions. For each captured region, the player gets one point. The one who reaches the goal first wins.
The game consists of turns. Each turn consists of three phases. The first phase is the orders phase. Only three orders can be given per turn. When all players press “next move”, the second phase begins. In this phase, each player takes turns executing the orders he chose in the previous phase.
Among the orders are march, defense, muster troops, hold a tournament and capture territory.
When all orders have been completed, the game enters the game world phase. A random world event card is played. Then a new round begins.
Features:
Give orders on your lands by thinking through your strategy and tactics
Manage your deck - your victory depends on the correct use of cards.
Lead your troops - can you reach your goal with minimal casualties?
Single and multiplayer games - play against artificial intelligence or friends

title: METACRAFT: Arena
description:
게임 정보
Step into an alternate-reality USSR where the past collides with alien technology: monolithic concrete structures tower over glowing extraterrestrial machinery, all brought to life with nostalgic pixel-art flair. Battle across wildly unique maps — from secret lunar bases to underground bunkers codenamed “Volga-12”.
Choose from a roster of eccentric fighters: Baba Yaga, the engineer-inventor piloting a robotic hut-mech, or Kot Uchyony (The Scientist Cat) — yes, he’s literally a cat and a genius! Each hero boasts a game-changing ultimate ability, like summoning a swarm of cybernetic crows or deploying a reality-warping “Communism Wave” that turns foes into collectivist zealots.

title: Gorecam
description:
게임 정보
GORECAM is a hardcore 4-player, online co-op, demonic horror survival game.
You are part of a desperate crew—one exorcist and three paranormal investigators—haunted by an ancient evil. By night, explore haunted locations to gather evidence, banish demons, and drag cultists into the light for blood money. By day, scrounge for holy water, ration dwindling supplies, and pray you have enough gas to live another day. Stay on the move. Sleep by the campfire, if you can. The darkness is relentless, and every mile traveled brings you closer to something you’re not ready to face. Confront your friends and your sanity on the path to redemption.
Investigate
Immersive Experience: Hyper-realistic graphics and sounds. Demons spread corruption, bending the environment to their will, and perform horrifying acts on their victims and worshippers alike.
Full Voice Recognition: Speak ancient rituals into your microphone to exorcise demons, and perform protective prayers with your fellow exorcists and investigators. Speak to cultists and victims of the paranormal
Malignant Demons: Demons are unique and intelligent. Each has their own personality and weaknesses. Learn their names. Learn their sins. Exploit them to survive.
Equipment: Bibles, holy water, and shotguns. The tools of every exorcist. Camcorders, ghost boxes, cursed possessions, and more allow investigators to gain the upper hand.
Locations: Detailed, procedurally generated haunted houses and ruined complexes mixed with hand-placed horror elements ensure that every day is unique.
Survive
Your Home on the Road: Your RV serves as your investigative home away from home. Upgrade it with furnishing, cameras, and protective runes.
Stay stocked up: Running out of holy water makes any would-be investigator or exorcist easy prey for demons and ghosts. Manage it carefully, and buy it often from the Church. Fuel and food are equally valuable, and the end of either will spell the end of all.
Teamwork: Meet death at its doorstep. Face down the paranormal with shotgun in hand, or support your team with motion sensors and CCTV monitoring.
Multiplayer
Survive with friends. Demons will target those who walk alone in the dark.

title: Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics is a turn-based strategic tennis game. Zero in on your opponent’s pattern of play to predict their shots and gain the upper hand. Line up the perfect shot and simulate the outcome before committing to your next play. Sometimes the court is wide open, and sometimes you have to aim for the lines.
Create Your Own Playstyle:
Fine tune your strategy with custom playstyles that make it easy to construct points just the way you want.

title: Stellar Raven
description:
게임 정보
The near future. The Great Arion Empire, led by the wise and just Empress Rovena, protects peace and order on Earth and hundreds of other planets. But one of the commanders of the elite Space Marine squad, known for his unpredictability and propensity for violence, disobeyed orders, defied the Empire and went over to the rebels. That commander is you. Now, as a rebel, you find yourself in a deadly game against the full might of the Empire, and your chances of survival are close to zero.
Stellar Raven is a single-player first-person shooter in the tank simulator genre. The game is a futuristic action experience where you control a high-tech flying tank and engage in intense battles against enemy forces on different planets.
Gameplay:
You control the flying tank from a first-person perspective, battling enemies on various planets.
The main objective is to destroy all enemy forces on each level and ultimately defeat the final boss, Empress Rovena.
You will need to travel through and conquer several distinct planets, each with its own unique challenges, enemies, and environmental hazards, making every level a different tactical experience.

title: Benny Bash
description:
게임 정보
About
Survive this horror/puzzle adventure. Uncover the secrets of a cursed video game from the '80s while a malevolent entity hunts you. Solve escape room-style puzzles, navigate eerie labyrinths, and see how your actions in the game shape the real world. Stay sharp... and stay alive.
In Benny Bash you will...
Face puzzles in the escape room style.
Uncover a horror story as you progress.
Play cursed 80s games.
Explore eerie environments.
Discover how your actions in the game shape the real world and vice versa.

title: No Way Home
description:
게임 정보
[Note: the games has nothing to do with a certain superhero movie. We had the name first!]
No Way Home is a twin-stick shooter adventure, set in a hostile far flung part of the universe filled with danger at every turn. Outgun ships many times your size in tense skirmishes, complete missions for the many aliens that may offer help, loot bigger and better weapons, and explore countless areas in search of answers and a way home.
Fast-paced topdown-style twin stick combat
Engage in tense skirmishes that require the use of cover, timing and thoughtful positioning moreso than reading predictable bullet patterns
A regenerating shield allows a tactical and front-foot approach to combat, with a buffer to trade hits and move around the environment strategically
Loot new weapons and ship components as random drops from encounters, creating your own build and play-style over time
Procedural world generation with hand-crafted encounters throughout
No permadeath, classic adventure format with zone respawning
Quick-loop arcade modes to unlock
From the team that brought you Moving Out 1 & 2, Death Squared, Thumb Drift and One More Line and many others.
Features
A rich story mode set across a huge universe
Stunning hand-drawn artwork
50+ weapons to loot, craft and upgrade
Over 60 unique enemies to battle
Complete missions or explore freely and forge your own path
Fight huge bosses for rare loot drops (updated for this release)
Procedural universe creates unique layouts per game
Outfit your ship with the gear that suits your playstyle
Full controller support
Ship skins to unlock via arcade minigames
Daily Challenge - run and gun for daily glory with a new mega weapon every day

title: Inspiring ballads
description:
게임 정보
Inspiring ballads is an RPG set in an open fantasy world. Get reliable equipment, create powerful magic, pick up a sword and decide your fate and the fate of the inhabitants of the entire island! Become the new ballad hero!
A classless system. Choose who you want to be: a brutal warrior, a destructive magician, a mobile fighter, a master of poisoning - or find an even more effective way.
Several schools of magic, including hidden ones.
Create equipment from trophies from enemies.
Dozens of types of opponents.
The inhabitants of the island, who were just waiting for you to solve their problems.
The opportunity to win over representatives of the opposite sex.
There are several endings - from the most obvious to the hidden and very hidden.

title: Hermes Library
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Hermes Library. It is the main library of the Hephaestus University, the most famous university in the United Nation of Europa. As a junior named Rainn Echo, you will become the new librarian working at the front desk. While performing your daily duties, you will also witness several mysterious incidents there.
【How to Become a Capable Librarian】
You will help students, faculty members, and alumni to check out and return books. Using the workbook provided, you will check if every reader has complied with the library's rule: if they have checked out more than they should, if they have returned everything on time, if they have used their own ID card... Pay attention to details, and you will become an outstanding librarian!
Work time is divided into two parts: the morning and the afternoon. You will need to help about 12 readers every day with their return and check-out. During their conversations, you will get a glimpse into the lives of these students, professors, and alumni and piece together a rich campus environment.
Check-out: the reader needs to provide their ID and the book they want to borrow. If they have a reservation, they will tell you the title of the book so that you can take it out of the reservation area on the left. The first step of check-out is to use the scanner on the ID card. The information of the reader will appear on the screen on the right. You need to check the information and make sure that they are using their own ID and they have the authorization to borrow. Then you can press the "receipt" button on the bottom of the screen, type in the title of the checked-out book and the return date, and press "print." Then you can give the printed receipt along with the ID card and the now-checked-out book to the reader.

Momentum Based Movement

title: RoadOut
description:
게임 정보



RoadOut is a story-driven adventure that combines top down action-RPG elements with rubber-burning driving mechanics. Explore a vast post-apocalyptic world in your car, then battle your way through puzzle-filled dungeons on foot. With inspirations from The Legend of Zelda, GTA and Rock'n Roll Racing, RoadOut has a rich story full of surprises, missions and rip-roaring races.


After a great cataclysm, what's left is a post-post-apocalyptic world dominated by an A.I. with rebel groups that take refuge in a desert area known as The Dead Zone.

Claire survives in this world by executing black market contracts for local leaders involving delivery, sabotage and murder. The Dead Zone, now not so dead, is occupied by three rival factions: The Wasteheads, The SaibaKuran, and Order of the New Code.

While investigating her past, Claire uncovers strange evidence that links her existence to the origin of the A.I…

The world is no longer the same. All that remains is The Dead Zone, a large artificial biome created to sustain a new era of humanity. Drive through The Dead Zone doing jobs, getting paid and running roughshod over the scum guarding the secrets of the world. Join factions, fight rival gangs, barter items and take up quests to earn clout while progressing Claire’s story.
Exit your ride and explore locations in the world of RoadOut on foot. Crush bandits with short and long range attacks, block with your shield, and recover using drugs that you’ve crafted on the way. Solve puzzles using fully rotatable stack sprite perspectives that look 2D, but are actually 3D.
Craft new moves, weapons and drugs to survive. You can customize Claire with body mods, cybernetics and an intricate skill tree system. Upgrade her car to traverse different terrain and withstand the effects of weather, night and day.
Equipped with weapons and other tech, Claire’s car is your best friend against dangers in The Dead Zone. Hungry animals are ready to rip you apart. Murderous bandits will rob your lifeless corpse. Prepare for the worst with your car and its arsenal of weapons.
The world may have come to an end, but who said we can't have fun? Ride or die in red-hot races to be the best on the post apocalyptic circuit. 10 tracks in multiple biomes, innumerable races, all of them equal measures deadly and glorious. Indulge in extra game modes such as destruction derby-style racing and twisted battle arena, all while roading out to a thumping synthwave soundtrack.

title: Halberd Black
description:
게임 정보
Halberd Black is an action-adventure JRPG set thousands of years into the future of our galaxy, where you play as a Stark, a genetically engineered human being caught in a struggle to survive and protect those he holds most dear from those who'd wish him harm. Explore the rich story of the Halberd Black universe and explore the beautiful landscapes, and dense city streets and enjoy combat reminiscent of the JRPGs of old ( With a Modern Twist ). Fight a wide variety of enemies using a dynamic turn-based combat system. Explore new environments as you seek strength to fight back against the powerful megacorporation that is after you and your friends. Only through grit and determination will you be able to fight against the threats that are coming your way. The only question is, do you have what it takes?

title: RECURSOR
description:
게임 정보
Take control of the RECURSOR robot and traverse through a randomly generated labyrinth of trials. Enhance your build by installing a wide variety of upgrades. How far can you go?

RECURSOR's mechanics that take inspiration from the platform fighter genre for both movement and combat. This combined with randomized levels and upgrades of the rogue-lite genre multiplies the depth and replayability.



RECURSOR has an extensive moveset allowing you complete freedom of movement! For the speedrunners and labbers, RECURSOR comes with a debug mode to move frame by frame, view your current state, see hitboxes and more!

RECURSOR's artstyle takes the classic pixel art charm and makes use of modern graphics technology to give it a fresh look. Most evidently is the lighting system that casts soft shadows and uses normal maps to create the illusion of 3d.

Inspired by the scifi films and anime of the 80s and 90s, RECURSOR frames the game within a computer terminal / CCTV station that grants the user the ability to monitor and control the RECURSOR robot.

title: Pedro and Sofia's Nuclear Winter
description:
게임 정보
Earth in 2240 had survived war, ecological threats, alien invasions and more, but after all countries exhausted their nuclear stockpiles during the last war, the world was sent back into the Dark Ages. The United States was broken into kingdoms and the lands outside of their reach were populated with mutated orcs, evil mages and entire rogue armies.



Pedro and Sofia, siblings who were questing through the open lands, are called into service to a kingdom in need, where a strange new cult has been converting the local populace and building their own radiated army. Soon, they uncover a mystery across America that must be stopped before Earth is led to its final, nuclear annihilation.

Features:
Over 60 unique skills and more than 500 different types of weapons and equipment to find or build
Fully immersive 3D environments, including a massive, open-world with dungeons, towns and mysterious locations
A unique crafting system to build and upgrade a variety of weapons, armor and more
Real-time, action-RPG combat and a story-rich quest that takes place across America
Three different characters with original stories to play as and build with unique job classes
Hours and hours of quests and surprising adventures, plus fully playable on Steam Deck

title: One More Encounter
description:
게임 정보
One More Encounter: The Game That Never Was
On November 17, 1992, a small group of three developers released a video game like no other. Only available for the NEC PC-9801 computer, this was the most ambitious game the industry had ever conceived. Unfortunately, it was a sales failure and was lost in the abyss of time.
More than 30 years later, One More Encounter (a.k.a OME) has been partially revived. One More Encounter was a dungeon crawler where the important thing was not the motif, but the journey itself and the characters we encountered along the way. Unfortunately, only 0.35% of the total game could be saved. That is, of the more than two thousand possible encounters in the game, this version only contains seven.
Be that as it may, this is a look at a world that could have been, an industry that never really took hold, and a type of videogame that, so many years later, we are still struggling to make.
Over 6 different characters (there are 8 characters)
More than 20 minutes of gameplay (if you're a slow reader)
Two or more endings (but you can only get one)
Dynamic narrative text (because one letter appears after another)
Disclaimer
Due to problems with the game executable itself, it may have to be restarted several times to complete the game fully. We have tried our best not to do this, but something has prevented us from doing so. We have not been able to find the reason. We hope that, with your help, we can solve this mystery together.
Content Warning
The game has graphic depictions of violence, self-mutilation, and blood. Please, be very careful.
Created by Diego Freire
Art and UI by Fran Segura
SFX and Music by Javier Calderón

title: You Are NOT Bunnygirl
description:
게임 정보
Protect Bunnygirl from her foes

In You Are NOT Bunnygirl, you control a robot who wakes up deep underground. You must protect her from her malfunctioning siblings, the dangers of the Lab, and even her own emotions.
Features:
Manage Physical and Emotional Health in a story about self-care
Explore an atmospheric world with a minimalistic color aesthetic
Synth-based soundtrack with lots of reverb
Emotionally scarred NPCs
The save point is a couch
The save point is also a lesbian
The save point will yell at you if you're bad at the game

title: Spirit Vendor
description:
게임 정보


Design your home and your shop exactly to your liking. Place furniture, decorate walls and ceilings,
or simply change the wallpaper and flooring.
Create a unique atmosphere that delights both you and your customers.





In Aeonica, there are many interesting potential partners.
Go on dates, deepen your relationships, and experience a romantic story that can lead to marriage and beyond.





Whether it's fresh produce, handcrafted creations, or rare fish – decide what to sell and how your shop looks.
Take care of your spirit customers and make sure they keep coming back.





Plant crops, raise animals, build pathways, and decorate your farm.
Create your own little paradise and supply your shop with fresh products.

title: Superstar Strategy
description:
게임 정보
Lead Your Troops into Battle

Engage in a battle of wits and strategy in this turn-based tactical RPG. Employ the distinctive abilities of each unit and leverage the battlefield's terrain to outsmart your adversaries and assert your dominance!

Exploit the Battlefield Terrain

Manipulate the environment to your advantage – push, pull, teleport, and displace your foes onto traps, inflicting additional damage and status effects between turns. Escape traps before the next round begins to defy fate and evade harm.

Solo Adventures, Cooperative Play, or Versus Challenges

Embark on a solitary journey through the Campaign and Solo Skirmishes, join forces with a friend in Cooperative play to combat menacing monsters, or engage in competitive scenarios and arenas in Versus mode!


Select from 14 distinct unit roles to forge your own army with unique combinations. Each unit class boasts individual skills, playstyles, and synergies. Experiment with diverse combinations to uncover potent combos and force multipliers, enhancing your chances of triumph.


Unleash the power of each player-controlled unit's unique abilities, shaping their playstyle. Launch formidable attacks, rescue allies, intimidate enemies, and set the battlefield ablaze with awe-inspiring powers. Free actions can be seamlessly combined with other abilities for added potency and trickery.

Navigate diverse maps with distinct primary objectives and multiple win conditions. Adapt your strategy on the fly – if defeat seems imminent, shift tactics and aim for an alternative victory to turn the tide of battle!

Order your units' movements strategically, sequencing actions until all have been exhausted for the round. Time your attacks between your opponent's turns to strike precisely when the moment is just right!

title: Wintertwined
description:
게임 정보
When an endless snowstorm traps a parent and child in a remote cabin, they discover its horrific history.
Wintertwined will be a narrative focussed, puzzle horror game.
You take control of Winter, a shy but snarky young adult, who’s trying to get back “home” safely.
With the aid of Giles, Winter's parental guardian, the two of them must work together to survive the snowy apocalypse.
Wintertwined is currently in development and planned for a commercial release in 2025
Features
• A slow burn mystery with multiple endings
• Original soundtrack by Harumi Makoto
• Puzzles with 3 difficulty levels
• Original spritework

title: Sky Dreamer
description:
게임 정보
「Sky Dreamer」를 만나보세요 – 집중력과 생산성을 극대화해 주는 게이미피케이션의 열쇠!
부유하는 도시와 은하수를 배경으로, 입증된 포모도로(Pomodoro) 기법을 활용해 집중력을 한층 높일 수 있습니다. 「Sky Dreamer」는 작업 성과를 매혹적인 SF 환경에 반영하고 보상함으로써, 재미와 효율성을 동시에 만족시켜 줍니다. 작업 도중이든 인터넷 서핑 중이든, 화면 하단에 「Sky Dreamer」를 두고 진행 상황을 언제나 확인하며 동기부여를 지속할 수 있습니다.
주요 특징
집중 세션에 따라 성장하는 부유 도시
집중 모드에 돌입할 때마다 도시가 확장되며, 눈에 띄는 성취감을 제공합니다. 도시의 테마를 자유롭게 설정해, 목표에 맞춘 나만의 공중 도시를 만들어 보세요.
내장 포모도로 타이머
작업 시간과 휴식 시간을 미리 설정해 집중도를 높이고, 필요에 따라 유연하게 커스터마이징할 수 있습니다.
개인화된 진행도와 보상
포인트를 모아 새로운 건물, 하늘 색상, 우주선과 행성 등 다양한 미래형 요소를 잠금 해제하세요. 도시를 발전시키는 과정 자체가 또 다른 동기가 됩니다.
일일 및 월간 챌린지
매일매일 혹은 매달 새로운 도전에 참여해 보상과 성취감을 얻고, 꾸준히 동기부여를 받을 수 있습니다.
커스터마이징 가능한 할 일 목록
앱 내에서 작업을 체계적으로 관리하고 우선순위를 설정할 수 있습니다. 도시가 성장함에 따라 할 일을 완료하는 재미가 배가됩니다.
편안함을 선사하는 SF 분위기
시간대에 따라 달라지는 하늘 풍경, 확장되는 도시, 우주를 누비는 비행선 등을 감상하며 차분하면서도 몰입도 높은 분위기에서 작업에 몰두할 수 있습니다.
왜 「Sky Dreamer」인가?
독특한 SF 디자인
지루한 작업 환경을 미래지향적인 우주 세계로 바꿔 주어, 창의력과 집중력을 동시에 자극합니다.
게이미피케이션과 효율성의 결합
업무나 학습을 진행하면, 도시가 시각적으로 성장해 나가는 모습을 보며 성취감을 느낄 수 있습니다. 효율성을 높이면서도 재미를 잃지 않습니다.
올인원 기능 제공
타이머, 할 일 목록, 시각적 진행도, 다양한 챌린지까지 하나의 앱에서 모두 해결 가능하며, 화면 하단에 띠 형태로 표시해 언제든 진척 상황을 확인할 수 있습니다.

title: Pub Toilet Simulator 25
description:
게임 정보
In Pub Toilet Simulator 25, players race through the randomly generated layout of "Spetherwoons", a traditional English pub, in a fast-paced, first-person scramble to reach the toilet before their piss-meter fills up. The pub features winding corridors, multiple floors, and dead ends, with each level growing larger and more complicated.
Players must also keep their beer-meter full by picking up beers scattered throughout the pub. Delicious pub food can be collected for extra points, but wasting time on food increases the risk of failure.
As the levels progress, the layout of Spetherwoons becomes more complex, demanding quick decision-making, efficient beer management, and fast navigation. The goal is to reach the toilet as quickly as possible while maximizing your score and surviving the increasingly confusing environment.

Choose your character, grab a beer, and get ready for the piss-fueled adventure of a lifetime!

title: Catacombs Of The Yokai
description:
게임 정보
After finishing a late shift at work you find a mysterious amulet that was dropped on the ground.





As you go to return it to the woman that dropped it, you encounter a strange doorway that you haven't seen before. Entering the door leads you into an unnerving nightmare realm.



On your way through the depths you will encounter various enemies (many inspired from Japanese/Taiwanese urban legends and myths) that must be tricked, conversed with or eluded in sometimes unconventional ways.



Can you survive and return the amulet banishing this portal forever?

title: Hypnotix
description:
게임 정보
What is Hypnotix?
Hypnotix is a guided meditation mindfulness app which will take you on a different journey every time you click 'Start'.

This app is not for the faint of heart, as you will need to completely let go and prepare to be taken to unknown places within your mind . . .

Featuring:

* Algorithms that put together a different meditation journey each time, by chaining different sound files into varying combinations.
* Hundreds of meditation sound files.
* Mystery lockboxes and other awards to unlock, as a reward for time spent in meditation.
What is the aim of this app?
The focus is on you 100%. My aim is to help you unwind, relax, and take you on many exotic, unpredictable, mysterious and fun journeys.
How is this app different to most other meditation apps?
The guided meditations are put together using algorithms which build a different relaxing experience every time, using hundreds of different sound files. The guided meditations are almost hypnotic. Hypnotix is a sister app to 'Boot Camp Fitness' but focusing on mindfulness and relaxation rather than physical health and exercise.

This is not your standard, hit the spacebar and time your mediations app.
Can I control the journey in any way?
No, you will have no control whatsoever, which gives Hypnotix its appeal. There are some player settings where you can turn on or off suggestions for healthy eating, regular exercise, stress management, confidence building etc, but beyond that you will have no control. However, despite being unorthodox and unpredictable Hypnotix only takes you to positive places.
The development road map
The aim is to add more and more mystery journey meditation sound files to expand the game further and further. With many journeys shaped and influenced by players.
When using Hypnotix, please find a safe space where you can close your eyes, either by lying down or sitting comfortably. Do not use this app when driving, using heavy machinery or any other activity that requires waking attention.

title: journey of reincarnation
description:
게임 정보
The game will also be available in English,
but will be translated after the Japanese version is released and released at a later date.

realm and chooses a new life.

title: Rabbit's Tale
description:
게임 정보
A calm peaceful village, burned and destroyed by an oppressive force.

Rabbit was born and raised in Carrot’s Village, a small, sunny town surrounded by forest, where habitants lived in harmony. Small town, great rabbits!

However, a threat grew each day, as a dark entity lurked closer and closer to Carrot’s Village. The Steam Order discovered the power of steam machines, propelling them to power and conquest.



They threatened and took by force all the land they could, expanding their dominion thanks to their terrifying steam machines and cold-hearted minions.

One afternoon, they arrived at Carrot’s Village. A warning they gave, but a short one.



By dawn everything was sacked, burning and destroyed. Families were torn apart by kidnappers with no soul.

Now, our Hero finds himself alone with a mission on his hands.

title: Thawed Waters
description:
게임 정보
Thawed Waters is a mature emotional story experienced through hardcore boat-poling gameplay when every wrong move leads to losses and each stamina point counts!

Thawed Waters is not another farming sim, nor rogue-like, but pure classic isometric action with a problematic topic that needs to be raised in video games.

It's time to look into the ugliest corner of human life - animal testing.

"Pandemic of the second decade was nothing compared to what global warming melted in the Arctic later, freeing bacteria buried by nature millions of years ago. One of the thawed viruses ruthlessly attacked not only people but also animals of all kinds. Multiple attempts to develop a vaccine before the world plunged into chaos were unsuccessful, and a few remnants scattered across the globe lost all hope of surviving."
Stepan, head of Pukhovka village, 2047



NAVIGATE THE BOAT

Survive the planetary flood in the rusty boat with the pole in your hands! Choose directions wisely and apply force carefully to minimise rocking and tilting and avoid capsizing. Go around obstacles with the surgeon’s precision to keep the boat in one piece. Mistakes cost precious live cargo and materials, and the old man's stamina is a finite resource. Every decision is critical.

RESCUE AND SIT RABBITS

Finding the perfect time to pick rabbits is one side of the problem. How about sitting jumpy animals around the boat to achieve balance? The boat's behaviour depends on it, and therefore your life! Don’t miss a safe zone to release your fellow travellers or drown together and be forgotten.

FIGHT FATIGUE

Mental and physical fatigue are your eternal silent companions, that you have to deal with to survive. Collect and identify Siberian herbs and berries, mix them and brew a cosy cup of tea in safe zones to ease physical fatigue. Or not too cosy and get some unexpected side effects. Live through events of your past as mini-games to reduce or increase mental fatigue when dreaming next to the bonfire.

UPGRADE AND MODIFY

Your only ally, a mysterious prosthetic arm, holds the key to survival. Upgrade it with unique mods, and unleash its potential to travel further, push stronger, and save more lives. The boat barely stays afloat, but natural wit and a bit of luck will get you some cool artefacts increasing the boat’s stability or strength when it is needed the most.

LIVE THROUGH APOCALYPTICAL EVENTS

Fight the forces of nature to save it and give humanity another chance. Find a new meaning in life and watch how the broken old man transforms physically and mentally. Discover all the endings of this unusual story of personal salvation through rescuing the tiniest creatures. Explore the dark and submerged corners of the dying Siberian hinterland with a touch of cyberpunk.

title: Moonwakers : Episode 01
description:
게임 정보
Discover the rogue survival-lite 
Dive into a survival roguelite by taking control of a S.E.E.D, an advanced reconnaissance android! To accomplish your mission, explore exoplanets to determine if they are suitable for humanity.
Thus, you'll need to search for vital elements necessary for life: Carbon, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, Oxygen, Phosphorus, and Sulfur. But beware, danger lurks on this unknown land, and your survival will depend on your ingenuity and skills.
Traps abound, and you'll need to strategize to make it through. Regularly, you'll have to shelter your character to escape ionic storms.
Exploration will allow you to acquire new skills and enjoy more autonomy, speed, and gliding. Your biggest challenge? Managing your energy to avoid extinction.
Movement is survival, movement is fun
What could be cooler than exploring an unknown planet on a snowboard?
This mode of movement, fast and fluid, offers you gliding sensations for greater freedom and intensity. Speed, adrenaline, and exploration intertwine in this unique roguelite, where moments of absolute calm collide with the unpredictable challenges of a vibrant, ever-changing world.
Energy consumption as core mechanic

title: DoBad Inc
description:
게임 정보
In this open world, stealth game you play as Garett the Ferret the newest badguyer around, work your way up the corporate ladder to become one of the worst people to ever live, but acquiring this won't be easy, sneak through warehouses, murder Dogooders, steal from civilians, shoplift and more, all just for the sake of your psychotic individuality.
Features:
Traverse the city and interact with civilians
Take jobs from your bosses and commit them out in the world
Use your DoBad Promotional Credits to climb higher on this hellish corporate ladder
Decorate and expand your very own hideout
WARNING ALL ACTS OF MURDER, THEIVERY, WAR CRIME, AND DEVIOUS BEHAVIORS ARE PURELY ENTERTAINMENT!

title: Lokko
description:
게임 정보

LOKKO 는 즐거움과 창의성이 만나는 독창적인 3D 플랫폼 게임입니다. PS5®, PC, iOS에서 실시간으로 원활하게 도전적인 레벨을 만들고 공유하세요. 자신만의 아바타를 만들고, 적과 보스를 디자인하세요. DualSense™의 강력한 기능을 세 가지 플랫폼에서 모두 활용하세요. 플레이어들은 창작물을 교환하고 서로 경쟁할 수 있습니다. 가장 재미있고 독창적인 레벨을 만들어 보세요.
LOKKO 는 India Hero Project 2기 멤버입니다.


레벨 에디터플랫폼 게임과 레이싱 게임을 위한 내장형 레벨 에디터를 통해 플레이어는 직접 레벨을 제작하고 배포할 수 있습니다. 타이머, 가속기, 스위치를 연결하고 NPC와 보스를 배치하여 친구들과 함께 즐길 수 있는 재미있는 레벨을 만드세요. 게임 컨트롤러 및 키보드/마우스를 지원하는 직관적인 조작 방식을 제공합니다.

title: Rebirth of Arcadia
description:
게임 정보
전략적인 턴제 전투
최대 5명의 캐릭터를 조작하며, 전략적인 포지셔닝과 이동, 그리고 통제 지역(ZOC)을 활용해 적을 혼란에 빠뜨리세요. 액션 포인트(AP)를 현명하게 사용하고, 상황에 따라 강력한 콤보를 만들어 여러 적을 공격하거나 방어를 강화하세요.
스킬 변환 시스템
전장에서 원소 에너지를 활용하여 스킬의 잠재력을 끌어내고, 전투 중 일시적으로 더 강력한 능력으로 변환할 수 있습니다.
캐릭터 커스터마이징
쓰러뜨린 적에게서 유전자를 모아 패시브 스킬을 획득하고, 룬스톤 시스템을 통해 캐릭터의 스킬을 강화하며 전략에 맞춰 추가 효과를 부여하세요.
심연 탐험
스토리 전투를 통해 심연의 미스터리를 풀고, 무작위로 생성된 스테이지에서 싸워 캐릭터를 강화하세요.



심연이라 불리는 깊은 구덩이에 떨어져 목숨을 잃은 소년 솔로몬. 그러던 중, 용의 팔을 가진 미스터리한 인물 루비누스와 그의 파트너 에스메랄다가 솔로몬의 비참한 시신을 발견합니다. 그들은 고향 아르카디아의 룬스톤 기술을 이용해 심연에 대해 더 많이 알기 위해 솔로몬을 되살리기로 합니다.

자신들이 있는 장소에 대한 지식이 부족하다는 것을 깨달은 두 사람은 위험한 생물과 거대한 육식 동물이 배회하는 미지의 영역으로 발을 들여놓습니다. 두 사람은 이 위험한 환경에서 목숨을 걸고 싸워 지상으로 돌아가는 방법을 찾아야 합니다.

title: From The Bunker
description:
게임 정보
Story
A group of scientists hired by a powerful military corporation in order to create a serum that improves the physical and regenerative abilities of soldiers. As a result of a fatal mistake, a new and dangerous virus was created. The virus affects the human mind, depriving it of its ability to think and awakens incredible aggression. In addition, due to its regenerative abilities, the pathogen keeps the host alive even with fatal wounds... Due to the favorable conditions, the virus has multiplied extremely fast within the walls of the laboratory and soon got out. Humanity was faced with a new threat that could end civilization.
About the game
In «From The Bunker», you play as a small group of survivors who are lucky enough to find shelter. But this is not enough, because soon you will be visited by the infected, marauders and other enemies who want to take away your shelter. You will have to wisely mange resources, upgrade and defend your bunker, explore the map, look for items necessary for survival, build relationships with other survivors, and much more.

The game will constantly create situations in which you will have to make a choice. Help or harm? Kill or be killed? Save yourself or help a comrade? Only your decision determines whether you will see the next day, or whether the world will be missing another group of survivors.

The world around you has a life of its own. The weather conditions may differ, the sunny day can be changed to a rainy one, or even a thunderstorm. Survivors around you expand their territories, form alliances or fight each other. Hordes of zombies swarm into neighborhoods, threatening people. Take your place in the world.

title: SpaceDominator
description:
게임 정보
Join World of SpaceDominator!
Start on your own planet from which you can go into universe!
expand your civilization, colonize planets, communicate, make enemies or friends, explore universe and experience adventures!
Explore universe!
Universe is unique for every player and that grants you great and unique experience! There can be big amount of stars, planets, comets and others you can explore. You can find resources, valuables, other ciilizations or other stuffs!
Expand your civilization!
Claim, buy or occupy planets. It depends on you how you will get colonies. Expanding is really important in order to advance in game and unlock new technologies. Colonies can be also used as spawnpoints!
Meet new civilizations!
You are not alone in universe. There is lot of other civilizations. Some may be friendly, some neutral and some agressive. Be carefull while communicating with them, you can make them angry or even hostile! Some can be smarter than you, some more stupid. Use them to your advantage. Connect with them or declare wars on them and expand yourself, unlock new technologies and increase your own intelligence!
Complete missions!
Other civilizations can give you missions to complete. You will receive rewards - money, valuables, unique items or even rocketships for completing missions!
Participate in events!
Events are a great way to get unique items, extra money or valuables. Participate in them regularly so you don't lose anything!
Choose your way
Do you want to be aggressive? Adapting to the situation? It's up to you. Any path can be used to your advantage and to complete the game. But remember, your every decision affects gameplay!
Pay to Win is loved by the rich and hated by the poor. That's why you will never find any P2W techniques in our games. You can't buy anything that affects gameplay with real money. You only get items that can be obtained without paying - such as skins.
Boosters, chat, trading, rewards, events. These are just some of the benefits you get from joining a team!
BeyondPlanet is Indie studio. the only developer working on the game is "Lupe" and the only graphic designer is Tarox, who joined few weeks ago. So it is practically the work of two people! We would like to create more games in the future. We are from the northwest of Czech Republic. Lupe has been developing for 7 years and tried lot of languages - PHP, Javascript, C ++, Java and now C#.
Don't forget to wishlist, you will not be disappointed!

Thank you for your support!

title: The Swordfish: Knight of the Deep
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic adventure as a sword-wielding fish and restore order to the kingdom's depths. Explore an ocean world full of adorable characters, menacing foes, and hidden wonders.
Lore
After an unprecedented storm, you find yourself trapped inside an underwater cave full of predators. While you anxiously try to find your way out, you discover a mysterious sword. As you pick it up, you feel its power flow through your veins, filling you with courage that sends you venturing deeper into the abyss. There you find a hidden world with wary creatures. They speak of an oppression that looms, which threaten their once blossoming kingdom.
Key Features
Explore a massive interconnected ocean world.
Face enemies and bosses that threaten the kingdom.
Acquire new weapons, items, and abilities as you progress.
Help friendly sea critters by completing tasks.
Overcome puzzling challenges along the way.
Fun mini-games and extras.
Cute pixel art and original soundtrack.
Compatible with most major console controllers.

Explore The World Of Razgovor

Razgovor Online provides many places for you to explore.

Whether you are exploring to enjoy the view or looking for new people to meet, There are different locations and different ways to enjoy the open world of Razgovor Online.
