title: The Wolf Is Dead
description:
게임 정보
Detective work is never easy. When the body of Alexander Wolff is found floating down in the pool at a party for the film about his life, there's only one man (well, Fox) for the job. You were cleared for that whole thing with the gingerbread man, anyway.



You’re going to need an edge and that cool tie isn’t enough.



Thank God they partnered you with Maxwell. His manners are questionable, but he can see all of space and time so it’s easy to forgive the little things.

With the right information and some light encouragement, Max will take you back to the exact moment you’re looking for.



You can’t just walk into a mob boss’ house. But the murder got you some breathing room and the Chief has made a deal. You've got one night to investigate the house.

It’s a gorgeous mansion. Eighteen rooms. A three-storey fish tank. A garage larger than your entire apartment and a pool overlooking the coast.

And they say crime doesn’t pay.



9 suspects, one evening. What did they do? What secrets are they hiding?

They’re not just gonna tell you, that’s for sure.

Interrogate, cross reference, or just wildly accuse them with no proof. You’re the detective, after all.

title: Cats Are Money
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the farm you inherited from your grandmother—a devoted cat lover. Once a true haven for cats, the farm has fallen into decline over time. Now it’s your chance to restore its former glory
This idle game in the "Tamagotchi" genre offers you more than just farm management—you'll need to take care of each cat as if it were your beloved pet. Clean up the farm, repair damages, upgrade the cat house, and purchase rare breeds that produce more fur.
Every cat needs daily feeding and affection—neglect them, and they may grow sad, stop producing fur, or even fall ill. Expand your farm by unlocking new lands and gaining access to new types of cats. Make sure every pet finds a loving home and proper care!
Discover over 150 unique cats, each with its own appearance and personality. You can collect the rarest and most charming pets from all over the world.

title: Carrier Deck 2
description:
게임 정보
Anyone can hold the helm when the sea is calm...
But can you manage the deck of the Forrestal class steam powered aircraft carrier, the USS Forrestal (CV-59)?
Carrier Deck is a fast paced time management game where you will play as the Air Officer on board a CV-59 in the midst of active war. You, alone, are responsible for all aspects of operations involving aircraft on the ship and you'll need to work fast to ensure everything happens in time for the highest chances of warfare success.
Load the right planes and helicopters up and ready them for the required military missions. Manage both launching and landing the planes, avoiding crashes that could spread throughout the deck wrecking multiple planes and damaging the ship.
In Carrier Deck, you'll manage a staggering array of aircrafts including the F14 Tomcat, A7 Corsair, A6 Intruder, S3 Viking and CH46 Sea Knight, through a campaign that covers the oceans all over the globe. Test your skills in a full spectrum of operations across the globe in extensive campaign mode, or just try the Skirmish mode for a quick challenge.
NEW FEATURES
- Completely new code and UI (Radar)
- Flex Deck settings (options to change deck layouts in game)
- New landing queue management (pattern)
- New range of Aircraft
- Control of supply inventory and resupply
- Control of aircraft rotations
- Editor: custom build your own enemy waves
- Sandbox endless version
- Upgraded Deck movement and automation
- Expanded warnings panel
- Smoother handling of the maintenance deck
- Scenario Win/Lose independent of Carrier Damage
- Losing aircraft and pilot rescue

title: WonderLang Japanese
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to WonderLang, where mastering Japanese transforms into an engaging RPG journey. Immerse yourself in captivating quests, interactive dialogues, and fun puzzles designed to make language learning seamless and enjoyable.
WonderLang weaves language into the core of its adventure and compelling narrative. Get immersed in Wonderlang, as you: Explore, Fight, Converse and Investigate using your target language.
More affordable, more engaging, and way more fun than any subscription-based language learning app!
WonderLang is designed for beginner language learners, allowing you to dive into the game without any prior knowledge of the language. While the game doesn't aim to fully replace traditional language courses, it provides an immersive and enjoyable way to practice a new language gradually.
Key Features
Immersive Japanese Learning
Learn practical Japanese through every conversation, quest, and puzzle.
Progress through beginner level A1 with 40 to 50 hours of combined learning and gameplay.
                                                               Engaging Storyline
Follow the journey of a young hero who must learn Japanese to lift a magical curse from their brother.
Explore vibrant villages, uncover secrets, and build friendships interracting with over 60 unique NPCs.
Learning as a Gameplay Mechanic
Solve puzzles, and complete quests by forming sentences and understanding dialogues.
Practice building sentences and pronunciation thanks to speech recognition challenges.
Utilize in-game tools like a dictionary and contextual help to aid your learning.

title: Minerva Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
Minerva Labyrinth is a turn-based, party-based, first-person dungeon crawler set in the near future of Earth.  Take command of five warriors with incredible powers and defend humanity from an ancient enemy known as the Hate.
Hate is Forever
In the 1990s, humanity finally comes together on an unprecedented scale to confront the  global climate and energy crises that threaten its future.  Over fifty years later, civilization thrives worldwide in a new era of cooperation and humanism, and the recent rediscovery of ancient magic promises miraculous new advancements.  Yet as human strife recedes, something dark and forgotten returns from deep in the earth...
Minerva Squad
Create your own party from ten classes, ten passive skills, and customizable stats, or jump in right away with the balanced quick-start party.
You're not alone in your fight.  Return to your allies to recover from your wounds and upgrade your equipment, from bows and swords to skirts and tiaras.
Enter the Labyrinth
Conquer 16 fully hand-crafted dungeon levels, spanning multiple locations and biomes.
The labyrinth itself is your enemy, but beyond traps, riddles, mazes, and grisly monsters lie valuable hidden treasures.
Battle the Hate in fast-paced interleaved turn-based combat. Each enemy type has its own powers and tactics to counter your own, and each labyrinth has a powerful overlord waiting to crush you.
Fully-annotated automap tracks your progress as you explore the labyrinth.
Optional tutorial mode for players new to dungeon crawling.

title: Five Nights with Froggy
GAL BOCCHI
description:
게임 정보
ゼロから〝神絵師〟を目指す、インターネット絵師体験型シミュレーションＡＤＶ
恋人に振られて落ち込んでいる底辺女絵師（＝あいみすU）を操作して、ゼロからXXフォロワー10万超えの〝神絵師〟を目指そう！
あいみすUはまあまあ絵が上手いけど、そろそろ現実を見ないといけないお年頃……！
自由に絵を描ける最後の1年を最大限有効活用して、元恋人を見返せるぐらいのつよつよ絵師に導いてあげよう！
・あいみすU（あなたが操作する女絵師の主人公）
絵師活動が全く上手くいかずに嘆いてばかりいたら、最後の心のよりどころだった恋人にまで捨てられてぼっちになってしまった、残念な女の子。
company: 幸せ永遠？, ROUND ZERO, Inc

title: Dreamscape Legends
description:
게임 정보
Every Decision You Make Shapes Your Own Unique Story…
In Dreamscape Legends, as you navigate the intricate realms of the Dreamscape, you are not merely engaging in battles; you are at the heart of a dynamic, ever-evolving narrative. Each card you play, every battle you engage in, and every decision you make are pivotal chapters in your unique story, shaped by your decisions and the outcomes of your confrontations. Your journey is intertwined with a grander tale of ideological clashes, the mysteries of the Nightmares, and the collective struggle for survival in this enigmatic realm.
What sets Dreamscape Legends apart is its groundbreaking use of advanced AI to generate unique dialogue, storylines, and quests for every player, ensuring that no two playthroughs are ever the same (in campaign mode).
Every interaction, every choice you make is reflected in a narrative uniquely tailored to your journey, making each game a new chapter in the vast, unfolding saga of the Dreamscape. The cards in your hand are more than just game pieces; they are the tools with which you carve your path through the Dreamscape, influencing not just the outcome of battles but the unfolding lore of this world. Your actions, strategies, and victories contribute to a larger, player-driven saga where every choice can lead to new quests, challenges, and chapters in the game's rich narrative tapestry.
Dreamscape Legends offers not just a game, but a world that grows with you, a canvas for your imagination, where every move is a stroke in the grand painting of the Dreamscape.
Key Features:
Dynamic Content: Quests, campaign events, and dialogue are generated dynamically by generative AI, based on your interactions, gameplay, and more.
Realistic NPC Chat: Open chat with in-game AI opponents and campaign NPCs.
Unique gameplay mechanics not found in any other TCG: Dreamscape cards change the in-game mechanics. Nightmare cards show up randomly in both players' decks at the beginning of the game, introducing an element of Suprise and "chaos" caused by the.

title: Backrooms: Liminal Nightmare
description:

title: From The Top
description:
게임 정보
Fusing Battling tops and Roguelike Deckbuilding together to create an endless  decent source of battling tops fun! Collect new tops, combine them together, pair 'em up with synergistic relic and go on a short adventure, From the Top!
Features
Realistic simulation-:  Ready, Launch, and Battle! Use your spinning top to knock your opponents out or simply out last them in a battle of attrition.
But these aren't your regular old battling tops, these ones have Smash at them with full force, build a wall between to defend yourself, Fly high to the sky and strike and many more abilities to choose from!

title: Enchanter - 附魔师
description:
게임 정보
Enchanter is a roguelike dungeon crawler blending bullet hell combat with sandbox survival elements. Explore mysterious fragmented realms where you'll mine ores, unlock treasure chests, gather resources, cook meals, trade with merchants, enchant gear, and battle magical creatures. Journey through ever-changing environments - from mystical forests to treacherous caverns - to unravel the secrets and claim the ultimate treasures of these dynamic dungeons.
Key Features:
Streamlined Sandbox Systems: Intuitive mining, cooking, trading, and enchantment mechanics
Universal Enchantment: Almost everything you can obtain - from weapons to apples - can be enhanced with various common and unique enchantments
Massive Collection: Over 500 diverse weapons, gear, tools, food items, and artifacts to discover
Reimagined Bullet Hell: Our reworked projectile combat system makes the game accessible to newcomers while offering fresh challenges for bullet hell veterans through innovative dodging mechanics
And much more...?

title: Touhou Crawl
description:
게임 정보
던전화된 환상향을 돌파하자!

이 게임은 던전 크롤 -스톤수프-의 큰 영향을 받은 동방 2차 창작 팬게임 로그라이크입니다.
이 게임은 제가 아주 오래전에 만들어졌던 프로젝트로 로컬라이징 지원, 편의성 추가, 추가 컨텐츠, 밸런싱등의 개선을 통해 스팀 무료 게임으로 제공될 예정입니다.

(상점 페이지에 보이는 스크린샷, 영상은 과거 버전의 영상으로 차후 수정될 예정입니다.)
게임 특징
12개의 종족, 20개의 직업, 혹은 9명의 유니크한 동방 캐릭터 스타팅

200종이 넘는 몬스터 (그 중 약 80명의 동방 캐릭터 네임드)

title: orbs orbs orbs
description:
게임 정보
Orbs Orbs Orbs is a vibrant 2D puzzle platformer where precision meets chaos! Your goal is simple: clear the board of colourful orbs by clicking the screen to create a white ring that destroys them. But with six distinct orb types—each with its own physics and behaviour—every level becomes a dynamic challenge.
Meet the Orbs:
Green – The balanced all-rounder
Blue – Large and slow-moving
Orange – Floats with almost no gravity
Teal – Small, light, and nimble
Red – Unpredictable and chaotic
Pink – Clones itself on impact
Puzzle Elements & Mechanics:
 Seesaws, rotating and moving platforms add an extra layer of strategy
 Red zones destroy your white ring, and certain areas can't be clicked
 Destructible green blocks can alter your approach
 Attraction and repelling zones manipulate movement
 A gravity-flipping button shakes things up!
Relaxing & Chaotic
With soothing ASMR-inspired sound effects and colourful, physics-based interactions, Orbs Orbs Orbs delivers a unique mix of relaxation and energetic puzzle-solving. Levels can be calming or wildly unpredictable depending on how many orbs are in play.
Play Again:
Your score is based on the number of attempts needed to clear the board.
You must secure at least two orbs to progress—but aiming for three is the ultimate challenge!
Track your personal best time and score for endless replayability
Whether you're looking for a casual, meditative experience or a high-score chase, Orbs Orbs Orbs will keep you clicking, strategizing, and coming back for more!

title: Iris Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Note: The English version of the game is currently in preparation. Please stay tuned for updates!
What is Iris Odyssey?
Iris Odyssey is a classic text-based adventure game set in modern-day Shibuya. The story follows Fuka, a "girl searching for her brother," and Iris, a "crime investigator with magical powers," as they embark on an adventure filled with heartfelt encounters. The game features choices that players can make, which will unlock new story elements as the narrative progresses.
Story
Fuka, an orphaned girl living in Shibuya, is searching for her only family member, her missing brother Mitsuba. Along her journey, she awakens to her hidden magical powers. Meanwhile, Iris, a seasoned magic investigator, is pursuing a criminal organization of rogue sorcerers known as the Skyseekers. Her investigation leads her to take an interest in this brother and sister duo, who appear to be connected to the group.
As Fuka and Iris grow closer, they come to share a bond like family. Will this bond be enough to shatter the conspiracy that awaits them? Join Fuka and Iris in a modern fantasy adventure filled with destiny, intrigue, and magic in the opening chapter of Iris Odyssey!

title: Sweets'Devil
description:
게임 정보
For sweets, What Are Humans?
To sweets, humans are like legendary, towering villains—invincible monsters! They're terrifying devils that eat sweets!
In "Sweets' Devil", our heroine Renée faces off against hostile desserts in epic, explosive battles. But she's not the powerless kid who can't resist! Renée can transform into powerful combat forms, able to suppress the whole battlefield . Make the journey through the fantasy world into a joyous sweets-beating adventure.
After meet and make friends with those magic hats which Renée called them hattie as nickname, more powerful unique outfit transformations 'ATTIRE' will become available, each offering fresh ways to dominate the battlefield.
Beyond battles, Renée can roam the conquered regions, taking on fun challenges and side adventures, diving deeper into the stories with an array of interesting characters.
【Martial Magical Girl————Enemies Who Can't Beat Me Are Made To Be My Friends!】
Transformation! Magic! Battle!
Let the girl who's overflowing the cuteness charges forward with ultimate power and speed!
Combine a vast array of dazzling attacks to obliterate any resistance that stands in your way!
Unleash powerful burst skills to handle the most dangerous situations , turn the tide of battle!

title: STRAND
description:
게임 정보
SUMMARY
Strand takes place in a future where humanity expands beyond its system, driven by a shared vision of growth. VESTA, a paradise covered with vast oceans and thriving plankton, has been discovered by exploration probes. To assess its colonization potential, the A.R.E.S. Station has been sent into its orbit.
When a powerful magnetic field hits A.R.E.S., the station is warped by mysterious phenomena, distorting time, space, and physics. Solving these puzzles is your only way to escape.
A PREVIEW OF THE FUTURE
Step into life in the 25th century, where humanity unites in pursuit of a brighter future. This is a speculative vision of ideal technological advancement, filled with both inspiration and unease. As you explore this world, you’ll confront the double-edged nature of progress, offering incredible potential, but at what cost?
RICH ARRAY OF PUZZLES AND RIDDLES

title: Cafe DReAMLAND
description:
게임 정보
This is Cafe "DReAMLAND".
Cafe clerk Yatsume has one job: To make drinks for the strange "customers" that stop by the cafe. 
Not just any drinks, though: have a wish? With just a hint of blasphemy, these drinks can help make it "come true".
Strange? Maybe. For Yatsume, though, that's just business as usual.
However, after a certain someone drops by for a special visit, Yatsume comes to learn about the secret behind the shop, and the truth behind the whole world...
A strange, blasphemous ADV game paying respects to Cthulhu mythos.
Cafe simulation x Exploration x Multiple endings Let your choices decide the final outcome.
Disclaimers:
- This game is an "ADV game meant to pay respects to Cthulhu mythos", meaning that the characters, places, and events are meant to grab inspiration from the world of Cthulhu.
We do not guarantee that any entities or creatures from Cthulhu mythos are featured within this game.
All characters, places, and events are unique to this work, and have no direct relation to the original books, the original characters or the tabletop game.
It can still be played without any prior knowledge of Cthulhu lore.
- This game contains mature themes including, but not limited to, death, bullying, abuse, mental disorders, and fictitious religions; as well as visuals that may be disturbing to some players such as grotesque imagery, blood, and glitching effects.
Original Soundtrack:ruha
English Translation:Meika

title: Past Mistakes - Act I
description:

🏆 선명하고 생생한 4K 해상도로 구현된 아름다운 3D CG 콘텐츠로 이야기를 표현했습니다.
🏆 초당 60프레임의 화려한 애니메이션으로 전투, 액션, 드라마를 유연하고 부드럽게 보여줍니다.

🏆 세 가지 주요 루트, 각각 독특한 캐릭터, 스토리 전개, 그리고 엔딩!
🏆 다양한 분기점과 대체 엔딩이 스토리 경로에 따라 펼쳐집니다.

title: Cosmic Fear
description:
게임 정보
Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension  have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one, big picture. The solution is near; the next expedition will be the crucial one. You turn your gaze to the stars: what lies hidden in the unfathomable depths of the cosmos?
Night falls as the horn's haunting call echoes through the woods. The Great Ceremony is about to begin.

title: Star Ash Fleet
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
"Star Ash Fleet" is a real-time strategy game with unique gameplay mechanics. The game simulates interstellar battlefield environments on a 2D plane, creating a holographic battlefield projection for the player. Players will take on the role of a newly appointed fleet commander, using various gameplay strategies to tackle meticulously designed mission levels and experience thrilling battles.
The interstellar war between the Earth Human Federation and the Pleiades Star Cluster Empire has already spread across the entire galaxy, and the war, which has lasted for centuries, is about to reach a critical turning point. The Federation fleet, commanded by the player, accidentally uncovers the Empire’s conspiracy during a battle. After countless efforts and sacrifices, a significant historical event will pull both the entire war and the player into an uncontrollable situation.
Core Gameplay
Unique Control Experience
We have designed a proprietary fleet control system that combines elements from traditional RTS games while further simplifying and innovating the gameplay. This allows players to easily control a fleet with multiple warships. At the same time, players can execute precise micro-management of individual ships within the fleet through simple controls.

title: Honu
description:
게임 정보
You awaken in a stunning world, seeking to unravel mysteries through puzzles that reveal hidden details of your surroundings. Along the way, meet unique, animal-like characters, each with their own story.
Features
Solve puzzles using magitech
Explore breathtaking environments
Interact with intriguing NPCs
Discover the secret of Honu

title: The House of Toys
description:
게임 정보
The House of Toys is a game developed by Old School Bros, a duo of video game and horror genre enthusiasts.
The game's mission is to free the soul of the cursed toy, day after day, game after game. But be careful—each game can be different. You will earn rewards that make your work more satisfying, allow you to improve your room, and help you discover secrets.
The House of Toys is divided into several phases in each game.
Phase 1:
Investigate – Explore the mansion, searching for clues to help you identify the toy.
Phase 2:
Puzzles and Action – While avoiding the cursed toy, you’ll need to solve puzzles that grant you the power to free its soul.
Phase 3:
Stealth – You’ll need to be cautious and stealthy to use your new power and release the toy’s soul.
Do you dare to discover the true origin of the curse?

title: EVERDARK: Undead Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Embark on Everdark, an action-packed shooter that blends classics like Unreal or Doom with influences from survival horror games such as Resident Evil. Filled with references to 1980s horror movies, you'll be transported to a city swarming with vampires, where you'll face these creatures in diverse and bloody ways.
Survive in a devastated city
Upon returning from a visit to your cousin in Milwaukee, you're forced to take a detour that leads you to Everdark. Then, you suffer a terrible car accident that leaves you stranded with no way to call for help or continue your journey.
The only way out is on foot. However, the streets have descended into chaos… The city is infested with vampires that have wiped out most of its inhabitants! Can you help the survivors, uncover the cause of this catastrophe, and escape alive?

title: Knightfall Showdown
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Knightfall Showdown, where strategy meets chaos on the ultimate chess battlefield!
In this thrilling battle royale experience, 100 players are dropped onto a vast chessboard, each starting as a Knight with one goal: to outwit, outmaneuver, and outlast your opponents. As the clock ticks down, you'll have 30 seconds to collect as many pawns as possible, positioning yourself for supremacy when the action begins.
Gameplay Features:
Dynamic Pawn Collection: Use the initial 30 seconds wisely to gather pawns scattered across the board. Every pawn counts, giving you the edge in combat and upgrades.
Tactical Movement: Every 3 seconds, players can choose their next move strategically. Navigate the board, avoid conflicts, or set up ambushes while the storm gradually shrinks the battlefield, forcing players closer together.
Combat Mechanics: Engage in thrilling battles when your piece collides with another. If two pieces of the same rank meet, the player with more collected pawns upgrades to a higher hierarchy. But beware—higher-ranking pieces like Bishops, Rooks, and Queens can eliminate lower ranks with ease, stealing their pawns in the process.
ELO Ranking System: Show off your skills as you earn or lose ELO points based on your performance. Rise through the ranks, earn prestigious titles like CM, FM, IM, and GM, and compete against the best in the live leaderboard.
Endless Strategies: Whether you prefer stealth, aggression, or calculated moves, each match presents a unique opportunity to refine your strategy. Form alliances, betray friends, and adapt to an ever-changing battlefield.
Are you ready to step into the arena of Knightfall Showdown? Gather your wits, collect your pawns, and prepare for the most exhilarating chess experience of your life. Can you rise to the top and become the last piece standing? The chessboard awaits!

title: Bakso Simulator 2
description:
게임 정보
Bakso Simulator is back! Get ready to rebuild your Bakso Empire with new gameplay mechanics! Encounter both familiar and new faces, explore larger areas, and more!
Follow the footsteps of the legendary bakso seller, Rabas, as he ventures back to his peaceful hometown in the Indonesian countryside. Inheriting a substantial fortune from his late father, Rabas embarks on a new chapter, filled with both challenges and opportunities.
Features :
Discover new areas set in a beautiful Indonesian village
A much improved decorating system where players are more free on where to place objects!
Make your bakso cart cooler and more efficient by customizing and upgrading it!
Manage your shop and buy supplies by utilizing your new laptop and smartphone!
Hire staffs to help you sell bakso and keep customers happy!
Use various tools to keep your shop safe and clean!
A brand new house for Rabas to relax and plan his day!

title: Do You even Forklift?
description:
게임 정보
When all you have is a Forklift, everything looks like palete.
Take a flight to Ghibli stylized JAPAN!
Let your forklift loose on a peacefull prefecture.
Travel through whole island and solve more than 30 puzzles to learn your story.
Some truck takes your parking place? No problem, you can forklift them!
Place Kei Cars on the right parking spots,
They can have alarms,
And might be Wired,
Be smart about parking gates,
Use illegal moves when no one sees, 

But sometimes you can Help others.
Maybe they will show you how to cook Ramen?  Of course using a forklift!
Featuring:
An elegant forklift straight from Japan (that's you)
A lot of kei cars to stick on the fork,
A dedicated beep button (!!!)

title: Kill All Lice
description:
게임 정보
Feeling the urge to scratch your head? Discover KAL, Guild Studio's miracle product to help you get rid of lice!
With its joystick-powered formula, control Captain Soepp or Lieutenant Xam'Pu and face off against the hordes of Lous the First, king of lice, in an epic solo or co-op adventure.
Dive into a captivating universe where frantic action meets zany humor. "Kill All Lice" takes you to the scalps of Eloise and her family in an epic battle to eradicate an epidemic of fearsome critters. Take the helm as Captain Soepp and Lieutenant Xam'Pu, two heroes determined to fight the invasion. Whether you choose to play solo or team up with a friend, prepare for an experience that will be... completely wacky!

title: Eternal Summer
description:
게임 정보
The release of a new mixed reality implant device, dubbed Eternal Summer, promises its users will experience just that.
When a solar storm hits earth the devices are catastrophically damaged, trapping users in their simulations.
Those who are still 'free' must now find their own ways to survive, as they band together into factions.

In this hex-tile turn based strategy game, you control your faction as you try to expand your control against opposing factions.
Some factions may be friendly, others are definitely not, but all have a story to tell about their version of the day the of great aurora.

title: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
description:
게임 정보

On a cold, barren isle somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago, a man wakes up without any memories of where he is, what happened to him, or who he is.
A cellphone gives off a flashing green light, revealing itself in the snow close to him. It will become vital when gathering his past memories, figuring out what is going on, and making decisions on what he must do.
Gameplay
The M/S Cornelia II incident is a mystery point-and-click adventure game in a contemporary setting.
The gameplay consists of regular elements of adventure gaming, such as exploring surroundings and using/combining items.
An original aspect of the game is collecting memory fragments and clues in your surroundings to help puzzle together your past in a room set in your mind.

title: Horse Racing Manager
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of horse racing and construct a remarkable rags-to-riches narrative. Start as a humble stablehand and ascend the industry by establishing your very own horse racing stable. This dynamic game offers freedom and deep simulation.
Diverse Career Paths
Start your journey by honing your skills in established stables, mastering the intricacies of the sport. As you accumulate the necessary resources, seize the opportunity to establish your very own stable.
Breed the Next Champion with the Pseudo-DNA Feature
Delve into the complexities of horse genetics and breeding, aiming to produce the ultimate racing superstar with our life mimicking Pseudo-DNA feature.
Tailor Your Horse's Training and Nutrition
Fine-tune your horse's journey to greatness with personalized training and dietary choices. Decide whether to amplify its natural speed or develop its stamina for endurance races. Every decision impacts its performance, sculpting a unique path to the winner's circle.
Step into the saddle and either watch your horse's performance from the sidelines or take direct control during the race, making split-second decisions that could lead to victory. Embark on a journey, progressing from racing on obscure back alley tracks to competing on the global stage for substantial prize money.
Hire team of professionals, including jockeys, head trainers, trainers, veterinarians, farriers, stablehands, and even landscapers.
Invest in your stable's facilities to provide top-notch training and care for your horses.
Keep a vigilant eye on your financial resources, managing your budget to ensure the sustainability and growth of your stable.
Remain up-to-date with a comprehensive news system that delivers the latest updates on races, competitors, and industry developments.

Forge your destiny in the heart-pounding realm of horse racing, where your choices and strategies will determine your path to glory. Can you lead your stable to victory and become a true legend in the world of equestrian sports? The journey begins now.

title: GROWTH EXPERIMENT
description:
게임 정보
Story

"In an apartment, "I" begin a life with "Chloe" who has lost her intelligence and memory.

The player begins living with a woman named "Chloe" in a dimly lit apartment.
Chloe" does not seem to know who you are.
Chloe's intelligence is regressed and her memory is hazy.
The player begins an attempt to grow Chloe's intelligence by giving her an intellectual education (command training).
Game System


The objective is to give "Chloe" intellectual training (command training) to activate her brain and restore her intelligence.
As "Chloe's" intelligence develops, the novel ADV part will be released.



In the novel ADV part, one young girl's growth is depicted.

By switching back and forth between the nurturing SLG and the novel ADV, what happened to the decadent "Chloe" is revealed.
It is up to you to decide whether you consider the ED to be a happy ending.
This game contains representations of character killings, suicides, and regression of intelligence due to external factors.
There may be realistic triggering effects on susceptible players.
Please use caution when purchasing and playing this game.

title: LlamaRPG: Farm to Fable
description:
게임 정보
Your journey takes you from your birthplace of Sorrelfield to the mysterious Za of the desert and through the fast-paced lives of The Uprooted, to name a few.

Discover all 10 factions and choose your place among them. Llamas always look for greener pastures - it's time to find yours!

Battle through the singleplayer campaign or craft items and trade them with your friends after PvPing.

Master the turn-based combat system and find new ways of playing your character, all while doing it in a game that combines the best parts of your favorite old-school RPGs mixed together into its own unique style.

Key Features
2D 16 Bit Style Graphics
Turn-Based Combat
Complex Crafting System & Professions
Endless Itemization Options
Talent Trees & Specializations
Unique Puzzles & Fight Mechanics
Buy Once - Enjoy Forever: No Monetization or DLCs
Planned Mobile & Console Support

The entire world is meant to have a purpose and often be revisited for various quests, grinds, or simply for fun. No gimmicks, no LlamaPass, no PayToWin mechanics; just pure reward for putting in the work and becoming better at the game.

title: 100 Cats Pakistan
description:
게임 정보
100 CATS 파키스탄 - 최고의 숨겨진 고양이 게임에 오신 것을 환영합니다!

이곳에는 파키스탄에 숨어있는 100마리의 고양이가 있습니다! 찾아가세요!
특징
🎮 1 레벨
😻 100 마리의 숨은 고양이
😸 진짜 고양이 소리
⌛️ 타이머 모드
⚙️ 설정

title: Sanguine
description:
게임 정보

Sanguine offers a classic survival horror experience set in a mysterious rural town in the 1990s. Something terrifying has been unleashed, and your mission is to survive long enough to unravel the mystery, recover your identity, and escape the nightmare.
Gameplay Overview:
Sanguine features intense survival horror gameplay with fixed camera angles that heighten the sense of fear and claustrophobia. Players will need to manage their resources carefully, scavenging for weapons, ammo, and health items while avoiding or confronting the terrifying Bloods. The game also includes intricate puzzles that will challenge your wits and unravel the deeper mysteries of the town.










You play as Kris, who finds herself on the verge of death after a car collision. Seeking help and answers at the local diner, Kris must navigate through the chaos and fear that has overtaken the town. As you uncover the truth, you'll fight through the abominations known as Bloods, determined to become one with you.

Kris is a character shrouded in mystery, suffering from amnesia caused by the car crash. Despite the disorientation and fear that come with memory loss, Kris is strong, smart, and determined to uncover her past. Her journey through the town of Craven Oaks is not just a fight for survival, but also a quest for self-discovery.

As players progress, they will uncover fragments of Kris's memory, gradually piecing together her mysterious past and the dark history of Craven Oaks. She will cross paths with other survivors, each with their own stories and motives. Some will offer help, becoming allies in her quest to survive and uncover the truth. Others may have their own agendas, potentially hindering her progress or putting her in greater danger. These interactions will test Kris's judgment and resilience, adding layers of complexity to her journey.

The town of Craven Oaks is a character in its own right, brimming with intriguing buildings, eerie landmarks, and hidden secrets. Once a peaceful and industrious community, it’s now shrouded in an unsettling atmosphere following the catastrophic events that have left it in turmoil.

In the heart of the town is the imposing AltRan Corporation building, a towering structure symbolizing both innovation and mystery. AltRan Corporation, known for pioneering new ways of travel, has funded nearly everything in Craven Oaks, weaving itself into the very fabric of the town. The company is run by the enigmatic Dr. Gabriel Altran, whose influence permeates every corner of the community.

Central to this terror are the Bloods, hive-minded parasites with a singular, terrifying goal: to find hosts to transform and take over. Once a Blood infects a host, the transformation is irreversible. The host becomes a part of the Blood hive, losing all sense of individuality and humanity. These transformed hosts are no longer capable of reason and become relentless, dangerous creatures driven by the hive's collective will.

Our game captures the nostalgic essence of classic PS1 graphics with meticulously crafted low-poly models and textures.

title: Gemporium: A Cute Mining Sim
description:
게임 정보
Grow your small gem business in this short casual simulation miner, Gemporium! Manage your time wisely between mining up gemstones, refining them for more profit and selling them to awaiting customers. After you inherit a small shop and prospecting license from your grandmother, you quickly realize it also came with a price of generational debt. Now on top of building your business you must appease the Loan Shark and break even before you go broke!
Gemporium features a day cycle similar to Stardew Valley, where there is only so much time in the day for you to complete tasks and run the gem store. Each day consists of:
Explore deeper and deeper in the local mines to stock up on all sorts of Gems. Utilize different mining tools in order to prevent cracks and maintain the highest quality product for your shop!

title: Food Devils
description:
게임 정보
Food Devils combines the narrative & strategic depth of classic SRPGs with the replayability of roguelite elements. You can also build and run your own restaurant to attract new adventurers and power up Devils and humans alike with monstrous food! Master every move in grid-based tactical combat, inspired by classics like Fire Emblem and Final Fantasy Tactics. With stunning 2.5D graphics, each battle offers a visually fresh and strategically engaging experience!
Customize your restaurant with all sorts of whimsical furniture, prepare monstrous food and attract human adventurers! Unlock new tools and facilities to help you gear up for the perfect expedition into the deadly biomes.

title: Kinsfolk
description:
게임 정보
Kinsfolk는 상실 이후 인생을 살아가는 아버지와 자녀에 대한 진심 어린 싱글 플레이어 모험입니다. 아름다운 세상을 탐험하고, 잊혀진 추억을 발견하고, 대화형 탐색을 통해 그들의 이야기를 하나로 엮어보세요. 사랑, 회복력, 시간의 흐름에 대한 깊은 감동의 여정입니다.
세계를 플레이하는 동안 과거에 대해 배울 수 있는 단편 소설을 만나고 재현하게 됩니다. 이 이야기는 탐험할 수 있는 다양한 세계와 시간을 제공합니다.

title: Apomo District
description:
게임 정보
Bosses
Track down and hunt over 50 bosses called ‘Apomo,’ in order to free them from their madness. Fallen knights, spore-covered beasts, hammer-swinging moss balls, sweaty bath demons and more. Each encounter can be bizarre, terrifying, but strangely appealing.

Daily Life
The world changes every day in real time! Each day slaps you with new Apomo to fight, quests to explore, characters to meet, and events to partake in.

Combat
Use weapons such as bells, lanterns and umbrellas to fit your combat style.

Collecting
When you’re tired of smushing Apomo, fish for your next delicious meal. Catch bugs and turn them into magical attacks. Maybe mine some rocks to get to their gooey sentient core.

Movement
Don’t just walk around like a dingus. Utilize all the movement in the world like slime boards, slime gliders, jump pads, wave dashes and more.

title: Homeworld: Vast Reaches
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in a bold new story in the beloved Homeworld saga that brings real-time strategic space battles to VR. In Homeworld: Vast Reaches you play as Fleet Command, controlling your ships in vicious combat against a mysterious new enemy. Through a dramatic single-player campaign, direct your fleet to attack, defend, or capture strategic resources to build up your arsenal of ships and achieve victory.



Experience this strategy space game through a new perspective — get up close and personal to epic space battles, commanding your ships in real-time all around you. Your fleet is at your fingertips in this new Homeworld story where you can execute strategic attacks on your enemies from any direction or angle. This new perspective in VR allows you to build units, shape fleet formations, and orchestrate combat tactics while you're in the middle of the action.



Set between the events of Homeworld 1 and Homeworld 2, you take on the role of Tyrra Soban, a new Fleet Command. Guiding you is Karan S’jet, the legendary hero of Homeworld War, as the original Kushan Mothership is pulled from retirement to serve as the flagship of a new fleet. Together Tyrra and Karan face a new threat, the Radaa, duplicitous interstellar traders who want to obtain your hyperspace core and don’t care if they destroy your Homeworld to get it.

title: Whimsical Heroes
description:
게임 정보


In a land once flowing with milk and honey, resources suddenly began to run out. Sensing the impending end of the world as they knew it, the three heroes embark on a journey through unknown lands to uncover the mystery behind this life-sustaining energy crisis.

Conquer all in tactical, turn-based battles set on a hexagonal grid. Lead a team of cartoon heroes - the brave bean explorer, the fluffy cat defender, and the onion musician from distant realms - through a series of adventures in Whimsical Heroes!

title: RunMan Turbo
description:
게임 정보



The world's fastest returns in RunMan Turbo, a high speed 2D platformer continuing the energetic flair of beloved predecessor RunMan: Race Around the World. Combining the essence of old school classics with tight, modern mechanics, RunMan’s return brings wild enthusiasm and unhinged energy matched with a vibrant aesthetic and groovy soundtrack.




A new challenger wielding a mysterious power has scrambled RunMan's world! Each time you run through a level, it will look and play different, requiring you to master your instincts and reaction in order to get the fastest time.

Bounce, slide and run fast as heck through high speed levels across five unique zones. Beat record times to earn medals and unlock secret characters, levels, and more.




Cool stuff can you do in this game:





Other stuff you will be jazzed about:







RunMan Turbo is soundtracked by a bunch of awesome artists and bands from Philadelphia. With an eclectic mix of rock, folk, funk, and more, I promise you have never heard a game that sounds like this!

Confirmed artists:
Catbite
SNACKTIME

More music to come soon...


Created by Tom Sennett in 2003 and debuting in the Game Maker Community, the RunMan series has spanned more than half a dozen titles, including 2009's beloved RunMan: Race Around the World - a collaboration with Maddy Thorson (, ). RunMan is also featured as a playable character in indie classic . After a few false starts on mobile, RunMan returns to PC for the triumphant sequel RunMan Turbo.


Yo! I'm Tom Sennett, I'm from Philadelphia, and for two decades I've created video games which have brought joy to millions of people around the world. I'm an IndieCade award winner, and have been featured in Kotaku, VICE, Rock Paper Shotgun and more. When it comes to making games, I do everything including design, art, and programming - I even sometimes create my own sound effects and music. My work focuses on taking classic gameplay constructs and tearing them down to be rebuilt in a lean and modern way. I'm pumped to share it with you!

title: Alliance of the Sacred Suns
description:
게임 정보
먼 미래, 인류의 마지막 위대한 제국이 무너지기 직전입니다. 유력 귀족 가문은 부귀영화를 위해 서로 싸우는 반면 제국 시민들은 입에 풀칠하기 위해 분투합니다. 정치적인 긴장 사이에서 선대 황제가 승하하고 플레이어가 황위를 이어받게 됩니다.
황제가 승하하셨다, 황제 폐하 만세
Alliance of the Sacred Suns에서 플레이어는 사회, 정치, 경제적으로 문제가 산적한 성간 제국의 젊은 황제 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 대전략 게임과 RPG 게임을 조합한 이 게임에서 플레이어는 제국의 미래에 영향을 주는 결정을 내리는 동시에 궁정과 제국 귀족 가문을 관리하고 자신의 안위를 담보해야 합니다.


평생을 황제로
황위를 물려받은 젊은 황제는 평생에 걸쳐 제국의 영광을 되찾아야 합니다. 제국의 기반을 무너트리려는 분리주의자들과 황제의 권위를 인정하지 않는 무리를 조심하세요. 제국에는 자신의 목적을 달성하기 위해 수단과 방법을 가리지 않고 황제의 통치를 끝장내려는 이들이 많습니다.

플레이어는 성격, 성장 과정, 장점 등 황제의 배경을 원하는 대로 설정할 수 있습니다. 황제의 출신 가문, 문화, 능력에 따라 제국을 통치하는 동안 겪는 문제를 헤쳐 나가는 방법이 달라집니다.
Alliance of the Sacred Suns에서 플레이어 캐릭터는 나이를 먹으며 시간이 지남에 따라 발생하는 이벤트와 통치 참여도에 따라 건강이 나빠지거나 좋아질 수 있습니다. 턴마다 제한된 행동력이 주어지는데 보통은 행동력을 모두 사용해 다양한 활동을 하기 원하겠지만 턴이 끝날 때 행동력을 일부 남기면 캐릭터가 스트레스를 덜 받으므로 건강 상태가 호전됩니다.


플레이어가 황위에 오르기 몇 세대 전부터 제국은 쇠퇴하고 있었습니다. 강력한 귀족 가문이 등장하고 그들의 힘이 커지면서 중앙 집중적인 황권이 약해졌습니다. 귀족들은 자신이 제국의 위계 질서에서 어느 위치에 있는지 잘 알고 있습니다. 이들은 어느 정도 황제에게 복종하지만 자신이 가진 수단을 동원해 영향력을 발휘하려 할 것입니다.





유력 가문의 수장과 상호작용하든, 자기 가문 사람들과 상호작용하든, 제국 시민들과 상호작용하든 어떤 군주가 될지를 결정할 기회가 많이 주어집니다.




제국이 안에서부터 부패하더라도 정체된 것은 아닙니다. 플레이어는 공중을 맴도는 독수리들에게 보여주기 위해 다양한 방법으로 권위를 투사해야 합니다.



Alliance of the Sacred Suns는 모드를 지원하도록 설계되었습니다. 플레이어는 텍스트와 XML 편집을 통해 게임의 많은 메카닉과 콘텐츠에 액세스할 수 있습니다. 저희는 전 세계 모더들이 저희가 제공하는 우주-정치 프레임워크를 사용해 제작할 콘텐츠를 기대하고 있습니다.

title: Cats Are Money
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the farm you inherited from your grandmother—a devoted cat lover. Once a true haven for cats, the farm has fallen into decline over time. Now it’s your chance to restore its former glory
This idle game in the "Tamagotchi" genre offers you more than just farm management—you'll need to take care of each cat as if it were your beloved pet. Clean up the farm, repair damages, upgrade the cat house, and purchase rare breeds that produce more fur.
Every cat needs daily feeding and affection—neglect them, and they may grow sad, stop producing fur, or even fall ill. Expand your farm by unlocking new lands and gaining access to new types of cats. Make sure every pet finds a loving home and proper care!
Discover over 150 unique cats, each with its own appearance and personality. You can collect the rarest and most charming pets from all over the world.

title: Carrier Deck 2
description:
게임 정보
Anyone can hold the helm when the sea is calm...
But can you manage the deck of the Forrestal class steam powered aircraft carrier, the USS Forrestal (CV-59)?
Carrier Deck is a fast paced time management game where you will play as the Air Officer on board a CV-59 in the midst of active war. You, alone, are responsible for all aspects of operations involving aircraft on the ship and you'll need to work fast to ensure everything happens in time for the highest chances of warfare success.
Load the right planes and helicopters up and ready them for the required military missions. Manage both launching and landing the planes, avoiding crashes that could spread throughout the deck wrecking multiple planes and damaging the ship.
In Carrier Deck, you'll manage a staggering array of aircrafts including the F14 Tomcat, A7 Corsair, A6 Intruder, S3 Viking and CH46 Sea Knight, through a campaign that covers the oceans all over the globe. Test your skills in a full spectrum of operations across the globe in extensive campaign mode, or just try the Skirmish mode for a quick challenge.
NEW FEATURES
- Completely new code and UI (Radar)
- Flex Deck settings (options to change deck layouts in game)
- New landing queue management (pattern)
- New range of Aircraft
- Control of supply inventory and resupply
- Control of aircraft rotations
- Editor: custom build your own enemy waves
- Sandbox endless version
- Upgraded Deck movement and automation
- Expanded warnings panel
- Smoother handling of the maintenance deck
- Scenario Win/Lose independent of Carrier Damage
- Losing aircraft and pilot rescue

title: WonderLang Japanese
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to WonderLang, where mastering Japanese transforms into an engaging RPG journey. Immerse yourself in captivating quests, interactive dialogues, and fun puzzles designed to make language learning seamless and enjoyable.
WonderLang weaves language into the core of its adventure and compelling narrative. Get immersed in Wonderlang, as you: Explore, Fight, Converse and Investigate using your target language.
More affordable, more engaging, and way more fun than any subscription-based language learning app!
WonderLang is designed for beginner language learners, allowing you to dive into the game without any prior knowledge of the language. While the game doesn't aim to fully replace traditional language courses, it provides an immersive and enjoyable way to practice a new language gradually.
Key Features
Immersive Japanese Learning
Learn practical Japanese through every conversation, quest, and puzzle.
Progress through beginner level A1 with 40 to 50 hours of combined learning and gameplay.
                                                               Engaging Storyline
Follow the journey of a young hero who must learn Japanese to lift a magical curse from their brother.
Explore vibrant villages, uncover secrets, and build friendships interracting with over 60 unique NPCs.
Learning as a Gameplay Mechanic
Solve puzzles, and complete quests by forming sentences and understanding dialogues.
Practice building sentences and pronunciation thanks to speech recognition challenges.
Utilize in-game tools like a dictionary and contextual help to aid your learning.

title: Minerva Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
Minerva Labyrinth is a turn-based, party-based, first-person dungeon crawler set in the near future of Earth.  Take command of five warriors with incredible powers and defend humanity from an ancient enemy known as the Hate.
Hate is Forever
In the 1990s, humanity finally comes together on an unprecedented scale to confront the  global climate and energy crises that threaten its future.  Over fifty years later, civilization thrives worldwide in a new era of cooperation and humanism, and the recent rediscovery of ancient magic promises miraculous new advancements.  Yet as human strife recedes, something dark and forgotten returns from deep in the earth...
Minerva Squad
Create your own party from ten classes, ten passive skills, and customizable stats, or jump in right away with the balanced quick-start party.
You're not alone in your fight.  Return to your allies to recover from your wounds and upgrade your equipment, from bows and swords to skirts and tiaras.
Enter the Labyrinth
Conquer 16 fully hand-crafted dungeon levels, spanning multiple locations and biomes.
The labyrinth itself is your enemy, but beyond traps, riddles, mazes, and grisly monsters lie valuable hidden treasures.
Battle the Hate in fast-paced interleaved turn-based combat. Each enemy type has its own powers and tactics to counter your own, and each labyrinth has a powerful overlord waiting to crush you.
Fully-annotated automap tracks your progress as you explore the labyrinth.
Optional tutorial mode for players new to dungeon crawling.

title: Five Nights with Froggy
GAL BOCCHI
description:
게임 정보
ゼロから〝神絵師〟を目指す、インターネット絵師体験型シミュレーションＡＤＶ
恋人に振られて落ち込んでいる底辺女絵師（＝あいみすU）を操作して、ゼロからXXフォロワー10万超えの〝神絵師〟を目指そう！
あいみすUはまあまあ絵が上手いけど、そろそろ現実を見ないといけないお年頃……！
自由に絵を描ける最後の1年を最大限有効活用して、元恋人を見返せるぐらいのつよつよ絵師に導いてあげよう！
・あいみすU（あなたが操作する女絵師の主人公）
絵師活動が全く上手くいかずに嘆いてばかりいたら、最後の心のよりどころだった恋人にまで捨てられてぼっちになってしまった、残念な女の子。
company: 幸せ永遠？, ROUND ZERO, Inc

title: Dreamscape Legends
description:
게임 정보
Every Decision You Make Shapes Your Own Unique Story…
In Dreamscape Legends, as you navigate the intricate realms of the Dreamscape, you are not merely engaging in battles; you are at the heart of a dynamic, ever-evolving narrative. Each card you play, every battle you engage in, and every decision you make are pivotal chapters in your unique story, shaped by your decisions and the outcomes of your confrontations. Your journey is intertwined with a grander tale of ideological clashes, the mysteries of the Nightmares, and the collective struggle for survival in this enigmatic realm.
What sets Dreamscape Legends apart is its groundbreaking use of advanced AI to generate unique dialogue, storylines, and quests for every player, ensuring that no two playthroughs are ever the same (in campaign mode).
Every interaction, every choice you make is reflected in a narrative uniquely tailored to your journey, making each game a new chapter in the vast, unfolding saga of the Dreamscape. The cards in your hand are more than just game pieces; they are the tools with which you carve your path through the Dreamscape, influencing not just the outcome of battles but the unfolding lore of this world. Your actions, strategies, and victories contribute to a larger, player-driven saga where every choice can lead to new quests, challenges, and chapters in the game's rich narrative tapestry.
Dreamscape Legends offers not just a game, but a world that grows with you, a canvas for your imagination, where every move is a stroke in the grand painting of the Dreamscape.
Key Features:
Dynamic Content: Quests, campaign events, and dialogue are generated dynamically by generative AI, based on your interactions, gameplay, and more.
Realistic NPC Chat: Open chat with in-game AI opponents and campaign NPCs.
Unique gameplay mechanics not found in any other TCG: Dreamscape cards change the in-game mechanics. Nightmare cards show up randomly in both players' decks at the beginning of the game, introducing an element of Suprise and "chaos" caused by the.

title: Backrooms: Liminal Nightmare
description:
게임 정보
                                                 다듬어진 몰입감 넘치는 레벨
• Backrooms의 세계관에 충실한 불길하고 신비로운 분위기를 완벽하게 재현한 레벨을 탐험하며 다양한 퍼즐을 풀어보세요.
(앞으로도 앞서 해보기 기간 동안 새로운 레벨이 추가될 예정입니다.)

                                                        최대 6인 협동 플레이
• 혼자서든 친구들과 함께든, 진정한 Backrooms 경험에 몰입하세요.
• 거리 기반 음성 채팅이 환경에 맞게 조정되어 최상의 몰입감을 제공합니다.

                                                          현실감 넘치는 경험
가장 진정한 Backrooms 경험을 즐기세요:
• 현실적인 그래픽
• 최대한의 몰입감을 위한 최소한의 UI
• 어둡고 불길한 분위기

title: From The Top
description:
게임 정보
Fusing Battling tops and Roguelike Deckbuilding together to create an endless  decent source of battling tops fun! Collect new tops, combine them together, pair 'em up with synergistic relic and go on a short adventure, From the Top!
Features
Realistic simulation-:  Ready, Launch, and Battle! Use your spinning top to knock your opponents out or simply out last them in a battle of attrition.
But these aren't your regular old battling tops, these ones have Smash at them with full force, build a wall between to defend yourself, Fly high to the sky and strike and many more abilities to choose from!

title: Enchanter - 附魔师
description:
게임 정보
Enchanter is a roguelike dungeon crawler blending bullet hell combat with sandbox survival elements. Explore mysterious fragmented realms where you'll mine ores, unlock treasure chests, gather resources, cook meals, trade with merchants, enchant gear, and battle magical creatures. Journey through ever-changing environments - from mystical forests to treacherous caverns - to unravel the secrets and claim the ultimate treasures of these dynamic dungeons.
Key Features:
Streamlined Sandbox Systems: Intuitive mining, cooking, trading, and enchantment mechanics
Universal Enchantment: Almost everything you can obtain - from weapons to apples - can be enhanced with various common and unique enchantments
Massive Collection: Over 500 diverse weapons, gear, tools, food items, and artifacts to discover
Reimagined Bullet Hell: Our reworked projectile combat system makes the game accessible to newcomers while offering fresh challenges for bullet hell veterans through innovative dodging mechanics
And much more...?

title: Touhou Crawl
description:
게임 정보
던전화된 환상향을 돌파하자!

이 게임은 던전 크롤 -스톤수프-의 큰 영향을 받은 동방 2차 창작 팬게임 로그라이크입니다.
이 게임은 제가 아주 오래전에 만들어졌던 프로젝트로 로컬라이징 지원, 편의성 추가, 추가 컨텐츠, 밸런싱등의 개선을 통해 스팀 무료 게임으로 제공될 예정입니다.

(상점 페이지에 보이는 스크린샷, 영상은 과거 버전의 영상으로 차후 수정될 예정입니다.)
게임 특징
12개의 종족, 20개의 직업, 혹은 9명의 유니크한 동방 캐릭터 스타팅
17개의 작고 큰 던전과 10개의 룬
200종이 넘는 몬스터 (그 중 약 80명의 동방 캐릭터 네임드)

title: orbs orbs orbs
description:
게임 정보
Orbs Orbs Orbs is a vibrant 2D puzzle platformer where precision meets chaos! Your goal is simple: clear the board of colourful orbs by clicking the screen to create a white ring that destroys them. But with six distinct orb types—each with its own physics and behaviour—every level becomes a dynamic challenge.
Meet the Orbs:
Green – The balanced all-rounder
Blue – Large and slow-moving
Orange – Floats with almost no gravity
Teal – Small, light, and nimble
Red – Unpredictable and chaotic
Pink – Clones itself on impact
Puzzle Elements & Mechanics:
 Seesaws, rotating and moving platforms add an extra layer of strategy
 Red zones destroy your white ring, and certain areas can't be clicked
 Destructible green blocks can alter your approach
 Attraction and repelling zones manipulate movement
 A gravity-flipping button shakes things up!
Relaxing & Chaotic
With soothing ASMR-inspired sound effects and colourful, physics-based interactions, Orbs Orbs Orbs delivers a unique mix of relaxation and energetic puzzle-solving. Levels can be calming or wildly unpredictable depending on how many orbs are in play.
Play Again:
Your score is based on the number of attempts needed to clear the board.
You must secure at least two orbs to progress—but aiming for three is the ultimate challenge!
Track your personal best time and score for endless replayability
Whether you're looking for a casual, meditative experience or a high-score chase, Orbs Orbs Orbs will keep you clicking, strategizing, and coming back for more!

title: Iris Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Note: The English version of the game is currently in preparation. Please stay tuned for updates!
What is Iris Odyssey?
Iris Odyssey is a classic text-based adventure game set in modern-day Shibuya. The story follows Fuka, a "girl searching for her brother," and Iris, a "crime investigator with magical powers," as they embark on an adventure filled with heartfelt encounters. The game features choices that players can make, which will unlock new story elements as the narrative progresses.
Story
Fuka, an orphaned girl living in Shibuya, is searching for her only family member, her missing brother Mitsuba. Along her journey, she awakens to her hidden magical powers. Meanwhile, Iris, a seasoned magic investigator, is pursuing a criminal organization of rogue sorcerers known as the Skyseekers. Her investigation leads her to take an interest in this brother and sister duo, who appear to be connected to the group.
As Fuka and Iris grow closer, they come to share a bond like family. Will this bond be enough to shatter the conspiracy that awaits them? Join Fuka and Iris in a modern fantasy adventure filled with destiny, intrigue, and magic in the opening chapter of Iris Odyssey!

title: Sweets'Devil
description:
게임 정보
For sweets, What Are Humans?
To sweets, humans are like legendary, towering villains—invincible monsters! They're terrifying devils that eat sweets!
In "Sweets' Devil", our heroine Renée faces off against hostile desserts in epic, explosive battles. But she's not the powerless kid who can't resist! Renée can transform into powerful combat forms, able to suppress the whole battlefield . Make the journey through the fantasy world into a joyous sweets-beating adventure.
After meet and make friends with those magic hats which Renée called them hattie as nickname, more powerful unique outfit transformations 'ATTIRE' will become available, each offering fresh ways to dominate the battlefield.
Beyond battles, Renée can roam the conquered regions, taking on fun challenges and side adventures, diving deeper into the stories with an array of interesting characters.
【Martial Magical Girl————Enemies Who Can't Beat Me Are Made To Be My Friends!】
Transformation! Magic! Battle!
Let the girl who's overflowing the cuteness charges forward with ultimate power and speed!
Combine a vast array of dazzling attacks to obliterate any resistance that stands in your way!
Unleash powerful burst skills to handle the most dangerous situations , turn the tide of battle!

title: STRAND
description:
게임 정보
SUMMARY
Strand takes place in a future where humanity expands beyond its system, driven by a shared vision of growth. VESTA, a paradise covered with vast oceans and thriving plankton, has been discovered by exploration probes. To assess its colonization potential, the A.R.E.S. Station has been sent into its orbit.
When a powerful magnetic field hits A.R.E.S., the station is warped by mysterious phenomena, distorting time, space, and physics. Solving these puzzles is your only way to escape.
A PREVIEW OF THE FUTURE
Step into life in the 25th century, where humanity unites in pursuit of a brighter future. This is a speculative vision of ideal technological advancement, filled with both inspiration and unease. As you explore this world, you’ll confront the double-edged nature of progress, offering incredible potential, but at what cost?
RICH ARRAY OF PUZZLES AND RIDDLES

title: Cafe DReAMLAND
description:
게임 정보
This is Cafe "DReAMLAND".
Cafe clerk Yatsume has one job: To make drinks for the strange "customers" that stop by the cafe. 
Not just any drinks, though: have a wish? With just a hint of blasphemy, these drinks can help make it "come true".
Strange? Maybe. For Yatsume, though, that's just business as usual.
However, after a certain someone drops by for a special visit, Yatsume comes to learn about the secret behind the shop, and the truth behind the whole world...
A strange, blasphemous ADV game paying respects to Cthulhu mythos.
Cafe simulation x Exploration x Multiple endings Let your choices decide the final outcome.
Disclaimers:
- This game is an "ADV game meant to pay respects to Cthulhu mythos", meaning that the characters, places, and events are meant to grab inspiration from the world of Cthulhu.
We do not guarantee that any entities or creatures from Cthulhu mythos are featured within this game.
All characters, places, and events are unique to this work, and have no direct relation to the original books, the original characters or the tabletop game.
It can still be played without any prior knowledge of Cthulhu lore.
- This game contains mature themes including, but not limited to, death, bullying, abuse, mental disorders, and fictitious religions; as well as visuals that may be disturbing to some players such as grotesque imagery, blood, and glitching effects.
Original Soundtrack:ruha
English Translation:Meika

title: Past Mistakes - Act I
description:
게임 정보
두 개의 세계! 두 개의 운명! 모든 것을 바꿀 수 있는 한 남자!
특징:
🏆 선명하고 생생한 4K 해상도로 구현된 아름다운 3D CG 콘텐츠로 이야기를 표현했습니다.
🏆 초당 60프레임의 화려한 애니메이션으로 전투, 액션, 드라마를 유연하고 부드럽게 보여줍니다.
🏆 트라우마와 과거의 실수와 같은 매력적인 주제를 담은 광활한 세계를 넘나드는 이야기.
🏆 세 가지 주요 루트, 각각 독특한 캐릭터, 스토리 전개, 그리고 엔딩!
🏆 다양한 분기점과 대체 엔딩이 스토리 경로에 따라 펼쳐집니다.

title: Cosmic Fear
description:
게임 정보
Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension  have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one, big picture. The solution is near; the next expedition will be the crucial one. You turn your gaze to the stars: what lies hidden in the unfathomable depths of the cosmos?
Night falls as the horn's haunting call echoes through the woods. The Great Ceremony is about to begin.

title: Star Ash Fleet
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
"Star Ash Fleet" is a real-time strategy game with unique gameplay mechanics. The game simulates interstellar battlefield environments on a 2D plane, creating a holographic battlefield projection for the player. Players will take on the role of a newly appointed fleet commander, using various gameplay strategies to tackle meticulously designed mission levels and experience thrilling battles.
The interstellar war between the Earth Human Federation and the Pleiades Star Cluster Empire has already spread across the entire galaxy, and the war, which has lasted for centuries, is about to reach a critical turning point. The Federation fleet, commanded by the player, accidentally uncovers the Empire’s conspiracy during a battle. After countless efforts and sacrifices, a significant historical event will pull both the entire war and the player into an uncontrollable situation.
Core Gameplay
Unique Control Experience
We have designed a proprietary fleet control system that combines elements from traditional RTS games while further simplifying and innovating the gameplay. This allows players to easily control a fleet with multiple warships. At the same time, players can execute precise micro-management of individual ships within the fleet through simple controls.

title: Honu
description:
게임 정보
You awaken in a stunning world, seeking to unravel mysteries through puzzles that reveal hidden details of your surroundings. Along the way, meet unique, animal-like characters, each with their own story.
Features
Solve puzzles using magitech
Explore breathtaking environments
Interact with intriguing NPCs
Discover the secret of Honu

title: The House of Toys
description:
게임 정보
The House of Toys is a game developed by Old School Bros, a duo of video game and horror genre enthusiasts.
The game's mission is to free the soul of the cursed toy, day after day, game after game. But be careful—each game can be different. You will earn rewards that make your work more satisfying, allow you to improve your room, and help you discover secrets.
The House of Toys is divided into several phases in each game.
Phase 1:
Investigate – Explore the mansion, searching for clues to help you identify the toy.
Phase 2:
Puzzles and Action – While avoiding the cursed toy, you’ll need to solve puzzles that grant you the power to free its soul.
Phase 3:
Stealth – You’ll need to be cautious and stealthy to use your new power and release the toy’s soul.
Do you dare to discover the true origin of the curse?

title: EVERDARK: Undead Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Embark on Everdark, an action-packed shooter that blends classics like Unreal or Doom with influences from survival horror games such as Resident Evil. Filled with references to 1980s horror movies, you'll be transported to a city swarming with vampires, where you'll face these creatures in diverse and bloody ways.
Survive in a devastated city
Upon returning from a visit to your cousin in Milwaukee, you're forced to take a detour that leads you to Everdark. Then, you suffer a terrible car accident that leaves you stranded with no way to call for help or continue your journey.
The only way out is on foot. However, the streets have descended into chaos… The city is infested with vampires that have wiped out most of its inhabitants! Can you help the survivors, uncover the cause of this catastrophe, and escape alive?

title: Knightfall Showdown
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Knightfall Showdown, where strategy meets chaos on the ultimate chess battlefield!
In this thrilling battle royale experience, 100 players are dropped onto a vast chessboard, each starting as a Knight with one goal: to outwit, outmaneuver, and outlast your opponents. As the clock ticks down, you'll have 30 seconds to collect as many pawns as possible, positioning yourself for supremacy when the action begins.
Gameplay Features:
Dynamic Pawn Collection: Use the initial 30 seconds wisely to gather pawns scattered across the board. Every pawn counts, giving you the edge in combat and upgrades.
Tactical Movement: Every 3 seconds, players can choose their next move strategically. Navigate the board, avoid conflicts, or set up ambushes while the storm gradually shrinks the battlefield, forcing players closer together.
Combat Mechanics: Engage in thrilling battles when your piece collides with another. If two pieces of the same rank meet, the player with more collected pawns upgrades to a higher hierarchy. But beware—higher-ranking pieces like Bishops, Rooks, and Queens can eliminate lower ranks with ease, stealing their pawns in the process.
ELO Ranking System: Show off your skills as you earn or lose ELO points based on your performance. Rise through the ranks, earn prestigious titles like CM, FM, IM, and GM, and compete against the best in the live leaderboard.
Endless Strategies: Whether you prefer stealth, aggression, or calculated moves, each match presents a unique opportunity to refine your strategy. Form alliances, betray friends, and adapt to an ever-changing battlefield.
Are you ready to step into the arena of Knightfall Showdown? Gather your wits, collect your pawns, and prepare for the most exhilarating chess experience of your life. Can you rise to the top and become the last piece standing? The chessboard awaits!

title: Bakso Simulator 2
description:
게임 정보
Bakso Simulator is back! Get ready to rebuild your Bakso Empire with new gameplay mechanics! Encounter both familiar and new faces, explore larger areas, and more!
Follow the footsteps of the legendary bakso seller, Rabas, as he ventures back to his peaceful hometown in the Indonesian countryside. Inheriting a substantial fortune from his late father, Rabas embarks on a new chapter, filled with both challenges and opportunities.
Features :
Discover new areas set in a beautiful Indonesian village
A much improved decorating system where players are more free on where to place objects!
Make your bakso cart cooler and more efficient by customizing and upgrading it!
Manage your shop and buy supplies by utilizing your new laptop and smartphone!
Hire staffs to help you sell bakso and keep customers happy!
Use various tools to keep your shop safe and clean!
A brand new house for Rabas to relax and plan his day!

title: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges
description:
게임 정보
어때, 들려?
‘들린다’는 표현이 적절한지 잘 모르겠어.
내 말이 너에게 전달되고 있는 거야?
……….
아쉽지만, 네가 반응하고 있는지 알 수가 없네.
아마 교신기가 고장났을지도 몰라.
하지만 전달되고 있다고 믿고, 너에게 전하겠어.
이것은 너와 나의 공동 실험이야.
어떤 실험인지 모른다면, 너도 불안하겠지.
그래서 실험의 요점을 정리해봤어. 참고해 줘.
게임의 특징
너와 내가 연속으로 교신할 수 있는 시간은 약 3분
내 목소리는 풀 보이스로 너에게 전달돼
너와의 교신 내용에 따라 실험 결과가 달라져
기본적으로 ‘선택지’라고 불리는 인터페이스로 교류를 진행해
하지만 네가 다른 차원의 존재임을 증명해달라고 할지도 몰라
그럴 땐, 선택지를 초월한 인터페이스로 응답해줘
설령 내가 죽더라도, 너는 실험을 계속 이어가 줘
마지막 항목이 신경 쓰이려나?
내가 실험을 완수하기엔 시간이 부족해.
하지만 네가 협력해준다면, 실험은 완수될 수 있어.
왜냐하면 너는――
이제 시간이――
실험에 참여를――
――여기서 기다릴게.
autokwd: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges,프롤레고메나 약 3분간의 교신으로 발생할 수 있는 극히 초자원적인 인터페이스에 대한 서설

title: OrePlant
description:
게임 정보
🌱 오어플랜트: 마법 같은 판타지 세계관이 기다립니다! ✨
호기심 많은 '핀'과 '마루'는 알 수 없는 신비한 힘에 의해 이세계로 빨려 들어갑니다! 🌀
그곳에는 전설적인 세계수가 우뚝 서 있으며, 당신의 손길로 이 신비로운 땅을 다시 되살릴 수 있습니다. 🌳
귀여운 동료 '아리아'와 함께 이 마법 같은 세계를 탐험하고 가꾸어 보세요!

title: Psynostic
description:
게임 정보
Psynostic is a game that let you incarn a psychologist. Find the words to make your patient speak and make the good diagnostic. You have a full liberty of questions available thanks to the LLM (Large Language Model).
Use your diagnostic book to have guideline about potential questions and to keep track of your suspected diagnostic.

title: Shoestrings Story
description:
게임 정보
A point-and-click visual novel
Approximately 300,000 characters of narrative
A wide variety of mini-games
Retro pixel graphics
A smoking girl dragging around a TV
Sudden quantum mechanics
No "just parry" mechanic
The protagonist is a freelance writer named Love Catch. Due to childhood trauma, they are unable to speak and have no combat experience. However, after saving a wounded, mysterious creature known as a Mamono, they are unexpectedly chosen to become a "Hero." Love Catch’s mission is to "persuade" an entity called the "Demon King," who is said to command the Mamono, and bring an end to the 900-year-long war against these creatures.

title: Beatdown City Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Beatdown City Survivors is an immersive sandbox bullet heaven beat-em-up that knocks the genre on its head. The city is a nightmarish playground filled with gas to ignite, puddles to electrify, and cars to blow up--and you'll need to manipulate every element possible to wipe out the gruesome zombies, mutants and blood- thirsty creatures lurking in the streets.

title: Moon River
description:
게임 정보
Moon River is a short RPG adventure featuring a classic top-down perspective and light RPG / puzzle elements
You are someone called the Mariner, a sailor who's been out at sea for an incredibly long time. You are headed to Elapse Island, one of the last known places of the world. There, it is said the people only exist in the moonlight, as well as the river that runs through the island: "Moon River." For whatever reason, the Mariner desperately seeks something at the end of the river.
As the Mariner, your objective is to travel to the river's end before dawn. Deep shadows obstruct each area of the island, so you must find any sources of pure light to dispel them and proceed down the river.
Along the way you'll find new people to meet, sights & sounds to experience, and secrets to uncover.
Atmospheric RPG Experience
Moon River forgoes combat and heavy narrative, instead primarily consisting of exploration and puzzle solving with optional secret events scattered throughout.
Interactive Events
Occasionally, there are special interactive events and actions to perform, such as operating a machine. These events briefly break up the regular gameplay for a more varied experience.
Hidden Narrative
Beneath the main story, there is a hidden history of events from the past which can only be uncovered within the world's secret spaces and unchecked corners. Only the highly dedicated can piece the entire story together.

title: ApocaShift
description:
게임 정보
Establish Your Stronghold
 Start with an empty plot of land, and gradually expand your base by deploying into raids and gathering essential resources. As you venture out, you'll scavenge items from abandoned towns, ruins, and other hazardous locations, carefully extracting valuable materials like guns, ammo, and food. Every raid brings its own set of dangers, from radioactive zones to swarming mutant creatures. Some regions are heavily contaminated, requiring special gear and caution to loot safely. These zones might hide rare resources, but also host terrifying, radiation-mutated monsters that could easily overwhelm an unprepared survivor.
Build and Fortify Your Base 
Back at your base, use the resources you gather to construct new structures, fortify walls, and develop areas that support your growing community. The more you build, the more survivors you'll attract. These survivors come with unique skills and specialties—some may be engineers, able to repair or improve your armory; others might be skilled medics, offering healing services. As you expand, you’ll also attract traders who bring exotic goods from far-off places, but their supplies come at a steep price. Negotiating with them and exchanging loot for crucial supplies could turn the tide in your survival.
Survive in a Dangerous World 
Along with the growing base, you’ll face ever-present threats. The world around you is constantly shifting, and you must adapt. Dangerous mutants—twisted by the apocalypse’s radioactive fallout—roam the wilderness, and become more common as time continues and some may even infiltrate your base. Your best defense might be well-equipped guards, fortified outposts, and traps designed to ward off these horrific invaders. The wasteland is unpredictable, and with the constant looming threat of radiation storms and mutant hordes, staying one step ahead is vital.
Make Strategic Decisions 
Your decisions will be key to surviving. As you deploy into new areas for exploration, gathering crucial resources and completing quests, you may stumble upon new factions, rogue survivors, or hostile creatures. Completing missions for these groups might offer unique rewards, such as new weapons, armor, or blueprints for advanced technology. But be careful—alliances are fragile, and sometimes helping one group means making enemies with another.

title: Oscuro Blossom's Glow
description:
게임 정보
이 플랫폼 퍼즐 게임은 셀레네의 이야기를 따라갑니다. 그녀는 특별한 꽃의 빛을 흡수하고 방출하여 기계를 작동시키고, 길을 밝히며, 주변 환경의 일부 요소를 미세하게 조정할 수 있는 능력을 지니고 있습니다. 다양한 종류의 꽃빛을 사용하면 물체를 충전하고 플랫폼을 상승시킬 수 있으며, 빛을 활용하는 방식에 따라 변화하는 환경을 탐험할 수 있습니다. 각 도전은 창의력을 요구하며, 우호적이거나 적대적인 생명체와의 만남은 행성계 전체의 운명을 결정짓는 중요한 선택으로 이어집니다.
특징
✨ 빛의 힘을 활용하여 퍼즐을 풀고 장애물을 극복하세요.신비로운 꽃의 빛을 흡수하고 방출하여 길을 밝히고 숨겨진 기계를 작동시킬 수 있습니다. 빛을 사용할 때마다 환경이 변화하며, 어둠과 희망 사이의 섬세한 균형을 형성합니다.
🌿 다양한 존재들과 함께하는 살아있는 세계.여정을 도와줄 수도, 방해할 수도 있는 생명체들을 만나면서, 한 걸음 한 걸음이 새로운 도전이 됩니다. 자연 속 존재들이 퍼즐이자 길잡이가 됩니다.

title: Glowkeeper
description:
게임 정보
Glowkeeper is a puzzle game about manipulating elements. By the light of fireflies, link and dissolve elemental forces to construct bridges, break through obstacles, and traverse a glowing, interconnected world.

title: Beacon Patrol
description:
게임 정보
Beacon Patrol is a cooperative and relaxing tile laying exploration game.

You play as captain of the Coast Guard, navigating the coast of the North Sea to secure its beacon buoys, lighthouses and waterways.

Work together with your friends and score points by creating the most complete map.

Enjoy the full board game experience, including the Ships & Shores expansion, as well as the digitally exclusive Endless Mode.




Start at the Coast Guard HQ and build your own coastal map from there.

Each turn you place up to three tiles, connecting to your ship‘s current location. Your ship immediately moves onto the newly placed tiles and you can spend tokens for additonal movement.



Exchange a tile with another player or hold onto it for the next turn when playing solo.

The game ends when all tiles have been played. Explore tiles to score points and receive new tiles to keep on playing beyond the horizon.














Explore to receive additional tiles and play as long as you can keep scoring. Unlock new tiles and ships for even longer and more adventurous journeys.
Experience a faithful adaptation of the Beacon Patrol board game including the Ships & Shores expansion.
Navigate the coastline at your own pace with unlimited tiles and movement.



Each ship comes with unique abilities that can aid you in navigating the waters ahead. But beware, they require expert hands to operate.

New tiles allow you to create even bigger more varied maps with synergies and scoring opportunities to figure out.

Raise your flag and select a cute seagull companion to accompany you on your chosen map.

title: Neuroshima Hex
description:
게임 정보


-Experience a post-apocalyptic world of Neuroshima - a tabletop hit on your own PC !



-Face each other head on, commanding armies of different factions with different strategies and battling for the control of cities and factories.



-Many different units, technologies and special abilities that can be used for an effective strategy.



-Lead army through a hexagonal landscape and attempt to outmaneuver opponents!



-Lot to do in just one turn! - Move units, activate technologies, attack enemy units and deploy new forces!



-Enjoyable mix of strategy and chance as players struggle to outwit each other on their way to victory!

title: Cats Are Money
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the farm you inherited from your grandmother—a devoted cat lover. Once a true haven for cats, the farm has fallen into decline over time. Now it’s your chance to restore its former glory
This idle game in the "Tamagotchi" genre offers you more than just farm management—you'll need to take care of each cat as if it were your beloved pet. Clean up the farm, repair damages, upgrade the cat house, and purchase rare breeds that produce more fur.
Every cat needs daily feeding and affection—neglect them, and they may grow sad, stop producing fur, or even fall ill. Expand your farm by unlocking new lands and gaining access to new types of cats. Make sure every pet finds a loving home and proper care!
Discover over 150 unique cats, each with its own appearance and personality. You can collect the rarest and most charming pets from all over the world.

title: Carrier Deck 2
description:
게임 정보
Anyone can hold the helm when the sea is calm...
But can you manage the deck of the Forrestal class steam powered aircraft carrier, the USS Forrestal (CV-59)?
Carrier Deck is a fast paced time management game where you will play as the Air Officer on board a CV-59 in the midst of active war. You, alone, are responsible for all aspects of operations involving aircraft on the ship and you'll need to work fast to ensure everything happens in time for the highest chances of warfare success.
Load the right planes and helicopters up and ready them for the required military missions. Manage both launching and landing the planes, avoiding crashes that could spread throughout the deck wrecking multiple planes and damaging the ship.
In Carrier Deck, you'll manage a staggering array of aircrafts including the F14 Tomcat, A7 Corsair, A6 Intruder, S3 Viking and CH46 Sea Knight, through a campaign that covers the oceans all over the globe. Test your skills in a full spectrum of operations across the globe in extensive campaign mode, or just try the Skirmish mode for a quick challenge.
NEW FEATURES
- Completely new code and UI (Radar)
- Flex Deck settings (options to change deck layouts in game)
