- New landing queue management (pattern)
- New range of Aircraft
- Control of supply inventory and resupply
- Control of aircraft rotations
- Editor: custom build your own enemy waves
- Sandbox endless version
- Upgraded Deck movement and automation
- Expanded warnings panel
- Smoother handling of the maintenance deck
- Scenario Win/Lose independent of Carrier Damage
- Losing aircraft and pilot rescue

title: WonderLang Japanese
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to WonderLang, where mastering Japanese transforms into an engaging RPG journey. Immerse yourself in captivating quests, interactive dialogues, and fun puzzles designed to make language learning seamless and enjoyable.
WonderLang weaves language into the core of its adventure and compelling narrative. Get immersed in Wonderlang, as you: Explore, Fight, Converse and Investigate using your target language.
More affordable, more engaging, and way more fun than any subscription-based language learning app!
WonderLang is designed for beginner language learners, allowing you to dive into the game without any prior knowledge of the language. While the game doesn't aim to fully replace traditional language courses, it provides an immersive and enjoyable way to practice a new language gradually.
Key Features
Immersive Japanese Learning
Learn practical Japanese through every conversation, quest, and puzzle.
Progress through beginner level A1 with 40 to 50 hours of combined learning and gameplay.
                                                               Engaging Storyline
Follow the journey of a young hero who must learn Japanese to lift a magical curse from their brother.
Explore vibrant villages, uncover secrets, and build friendships interracting with over 60 unique NPCs.
Learning as a Gameplay Mechanic
Solve puzzles, and complete quests by forming sentences and understanding dialogues.
Practice building sentences and pronunciation thanks to speech recognition challenges.
Utilize in-game tools like a dictionary and contextual help to aid your learning.

title: Minerva Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
Minerva Labyrinth is a turn-based, party-based, first-person dungeon crawler set in the near future of Earth.  Take command of five warriors with incredible powers and defend humanity from an ancient enemy known as the Hate.
Hate is Forever
In the 1990s, humanity finally comes together on an unprecedented scale to confront the  global climate and energy crises that threaten its future.  Over fifty years later, civilization thrives worldwide in a new era of cooperation and humanism, and the recent rediscovery of ancient magic promises miraculous new advancements.  Yet as human strife recedes, something dark and forgotten returns from deep in the earth...
Minerva Squad
Create your own party from ten classes, ten passive skills, and customizable stats, or jump in right away with the balanced quick-start party.
You're not alone in your fight.  Return to your allies to recover from your wounds and upgrade your equipment, from bows and swords to skirts and tiaras.
Enter the Labyrinth
Conquer 16 fully hand-crafted dungeon levels, spanning multiple locations and biomes.
The labyrinth itself is your enemy, but beyond traps, riddles, mazes, and grisly monsters lie valuable hidden treasures.
Battle the Hate in fast-paced interleaved turn-based combat. Each enemy type has its own powers and tactics to counter your own, and each labyrinth has a powerful overlord waiting to crush you.
Fully-annotated automap tracks your progress as you explore the labyrinth.
Optional tutorial mode for players new to dungeon crawling.

title: Five Nights with Froggy
GAL BOCCHI
description:
게임 정보
ゼロから〝神絵師〟を目指す、インターネット絵師体験型シミュレーションＡＤＶ
恋人に振られて落ち込んでいる底辺女絵師（＝あいみすU）を操作して、ゼロからXXフォロワー10万超えの〝神絵師〟を目指そう！
あいみすUはまあまあ絵が上手いけど、そろそろ現実を見ないといけないお年頃……！
自由に絵を描ける最後の1年を最大限有効活用して、元恋人を見返せるぐらいのつよつよ絵師に導いてあげよう！
・あいみすU（あなたが操作する女絵師の主人公）
絵師活動が全く上手くいかずに嘆いてばかりいたら、最後の心のよりどころだった恋人にまで捨てられてぼっちになってしまった、残念な女の子。
company: 幸せ永遠？, ROUND ZERO, Inc

title: Dreamscape Legends
description:
게임 정보
Every Decision You Make Shapes Your Own Unique Story…
In Dreamscape Legends, as you navigate the intricate realms of the Dreamscape, you are not merely engaging in battles; you are at the heart of a dynamic, ever-evolving narrative. Each card you play, every battle you engage in, and every decision you make are pivotal chapters in your unique story, shaped by your decisions and the outcomes of your confrontations. Your journey is intertwined with a grander tale of ideological clashes, the mysteries of the Nightmares, and the collective struggle for survival in this enigmatic realm.
What sets Dreamscape Legends apart is its groundbreaking use of advanced AI to generate unique dialogue, storylines, and quests for every player, ensuring that no two playthroughs are ever the same (in campaign mode).
Every interaction, every choice you make is reflected in a narrative uniquely tailored to your journey, making each game a new chapter in the vast, unfolding saga of the Dreamscape. The cards in your hand are more than just game pieces; they are the tools with which you carve your path through the Dreamscape, influencing not just the outcome of battles but the unfolding lore of this world. Your actions, strategies, and victories contribute to a larger, player-driven saga where every choice can lead to new quests, challenges, and chapters in the game's rich narrative tapestry.
Dreamscape Legends offers not just a game, but a world that grows with you, a canvas for your imagination, where every move is a stroke in the grand painting of the Dreamscape.
Key Features:
Dynamic Content: Quests, campaign events, and dialogue are generated dynamically by generative AI, based on your interactions, gameplay, and more.
Realistic NPC Chat: Open chat with in-game AI opponents and campaign NPCs.
Unique gameplay mechanics not found in any other TCG: Dreamscape cards change the in-game mechanics. Nightmare cards show up randomly in both players' decks at the beginning of the game, introducing an element of Suprise and "chaos" caused by the.

title: Backrooms: Liminal Nightmare
description:
게임 정보
                                                 다듬어진 몰입감 넘치는 레벨
• Backrooms의 세계관에 충실한 불길하고 신비로운 분위기를 완벽하게 재현한 레벨을 탐험하며 다양한 퍼즐을 풀어보세요.
(앞으로도 앞서 해보기 기간 동안 새로운 레벨이 추가될 예정입니다.)

                                                        최대 6인 협동 플레이
• 혼자서든 친구들과 함께든, 진정한 Backrooms 경험에 몰입하세요.
• 거리 기반 음성 채팅이 환경에 맞게 조정되어 최상의 몰입감을 제공합니다.

                                                          현실감 넘치는 경험
가장 진정한 Backrooms 경험을 즐기세요:
• 현실적인 그래픽
• 최대한의 몰입감을 위한 최소한의 UI
• 어둡고 불길한 분위기

title: From The Top
description:
게임 정보
Fusing Battling tops and Roguelike Deckbuilding together to create an endless  decent source of battling tops fun! Collect new tops, combine them together, pair 'em up with synergistic relic and go on a short adventure, From the Top!
Features
Realistic simulation-:  Ready, Launch, and Battle! Use your spinning top to knock your opponents out or simply out last them in a battle of attrition.
But these aren't your regular old battling tops, these ones have Smash at them with full force, build a wall between to defend yourself, Fly high to the sky and strike and many more abilities to choose from!

title: Enchanter - 附魔师
description:
게임 정보
Enchanter is a roguelike dungeon crawler blending bullet hell combat with sandbox survival elements. Explore mysterious fragmented realms where you'll mine ores, unlock treasure chests, gather resources, cook meals, trade with merchants, enchant gear, and battle magical creatures. Journey through ever-changing environments - from mystical forests to treacherous caverns - to unravel the secrets and claim the ultimate treasures of these dynamic dungeons.
Key Features:
Streamlined Sandbox Systems: Intuitive mining, cooking, trading, and enchantment mechanics
Universal Enchantment: Almost everything you can obtain - from weapons to apples - can be enhanced with various common and unique enchantments
Massive Collection: Over 500 diverse weapons, gear, tools, food items, and artifacts to discover
Reimagined Bullet Hell: Our reworked projectile combat system makes the game accessible to newcomers while offering fresh challenges for bullet hell veterans through innovative dodging mechanics
And much more...?

title: Touhou Crawl
description:
게임 정보
던전화된 환상향을 돌파하자!

이 게임은 던전 크롤 -스톤수프-의 큰 영향을 받은 동방 2차 창작 팬게임 로그라이크입니다.
이 게임은 제가 아주 오래전에 만들어졌던 프로젝트로 로컬라이징 지원, 편의성 추가, 추가 컨텐츠, 밸런싱등의 개선을 통해 스팀 무료 게임으로 제공될 예정입니다.

(상점 페이지에 보이는 스크린샷, 영상은 과거 버전의 영상으로 차후 수정될 예정입니다.)
게임 특징
12개의 종족, 20개의 직업, 혹은 9명의 유니크한 동방 캐릭터 스타팅
17개의 작고 큰 던전과 10개의 룬
200종이 넘는 몬스터 (그 중 약 80명의 동방 캐릭터 네임드)

title: orbs orbs orbs
description:
게임 정보
Orbs Orbs Orbs is a vibrant 2D puzzle platformer where precision meets chaos! Your goal is simple: clear the board of colourful orbs by clicking the screen to create a white ring that destroys them. But with six distinct orb types—each with its own physics and behaviour—every level becomes a dynamic challenge.
Meet the Orbs:
Green – The balanced all-rounder
Blue – Large and slow-moving
Orange – Floats with almost no gravity
Teal – Small, light, and nimble
Red – Unpredictable and chaotic
Pink – Clones itself on impact
Puzzle Elements & Mechanics:
 Seesaws, rotating and moving platforms add an extra layer of strategy
 Red zones destroy your white ring, and certain areas can't be clicked
 Destructible green blocks can alter your approach
 Attraction and repelling zones manipulate movement
 A gravity-flipping button shakes things up!
Relaxing & Chaotic
With soothing ASMR-inspired sound effects and colourful, physics-based interactions, Orbs Orbs Orbs delivers a unique mix of relaxation and energetic puzzle-solving. Levels can be calming or wildly unpredictable depending on how many orbs are in play.
Play Again:
Your score is based on the number of attempts needed to clear the board.
You must secure at least two orbs to progress—but aiming for three is the ultimate challenge!
Track your personal best time and score for endless replayability
Whether you're looking for a casual, meditative experience or a high-score chase, Orbs Orbs Orbs will keep you clicking, strategizing, and coming back for more!

title: Iris Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Note: The English version of the game is currently in preparation. Please stay tuned for updates!
What is Iris Odyssey?
Iris Odyssey is a classic text-based adventure game set in modern-day Shibuya. The story follows Fuka, a "girl searching for her brother," and Iris, a "crime investigator with magical powers," as they embark on an adventure filled with heartfelt encounters. The game features choices that players can make, which will unlock new story elements as the narrative progresses.
Story
Fuka, an orphaned girl living in Shibuya, is searching for her only family member, her missing brother Mitsuba. Along her journey, she awakens to her hidden magical powers. Meanwhile, Iris, a seasoned magic investigator, is pursuing a criminal organization of rogue sorcerers known as the Skyseekers. Her investigation leads her to take an interest in this brother and sister duo, who appear to be connected to the group.
As Fuka and Iris grow closer, they come to share a bond like family. Will this bond be enough to shatter the conspiracy that awaits them? Join Fuka and Iris in a modern fantasy adventure filled with destiny, intrigue, and magic in the opening chapter of Iris Odyssey!

title: Sweets'Devil
description:
게임 정보
For sweets, What Are Humans?
To sweets, humans are like legendary, towering villains—invincible monsters! They're terrifying devils that eat sweets!
In "Sweets' Devil", our heroine Renée faces off against hostile desserts in epic, explosive battles. But she's not the powerless kid who can't resist! Renée can transform into powerful combat forms, able to suppress the whole battlefield . Make the journey through the fantasy world into a joyous sweets-beating adventure.
After meet and make friends with those magic hats which Renée called them hattie as nickname, more powerful unique outfit transformations 'ATTIRE' will become available, each offering fresh ways to dominate the battlefield.
Beyond battles, Renée can roam the conquered regions, taking on fun challenges and side adventures, diving deeper into the stories with an array of interesting characters.
【Martial Magical Girl————Enemies Who Can't Beat Me Are Made To Be My Friends!】
Transformation! Magic! Battle!
Let the girl who's overflowing the cuteness charges forward with ultimate power and speed!
Combine a vast array of dazzling attacks to obliterate any resistance that stands in your way!
Unleash powerful burst skills to handle the most dangerous situations , turn the tide of battle!

title: STRAND
description:
게임 정보
SUMMARY
Strand takes place in a future where humanity expands beyond its system, driven by a shared vision of growth. VESTA, a paradise covered with vast oceans and thriving plankton, has been discovered by exploration probes. To assess its colonization potential, the A.R.E.S. Station has been sent into its orbit.
When a powerful magnetic field hits A.R.E.S., the station is warped by mysterious phenomena, distorting time, space, and physics. Solving these puzzles is your only way to escape.
A PREVIEW OF THE FUTURE
Step into life in the 25th century, where humanity unites in pursuit of a brighter future. This is a speculative vision of ideal technological advancement, filled with both inspiration and unease. As you explore this world, you’ll confront the double-edged nature of progress, offering incredible potential, but at what cost?
RICH ARRAY OF PUZZLES AND RIDDLES

title: Cafe DReAMLAND
description:
게임 정보
This is Cafe "DReAMLAND".
Cafe clerk Yatsume has one job: To make drinks for the strange "customers" that stop by the cafe. 
Not just any drinks, though: have a wish? With just a hint of blasphemy, these drinks can help make it "come true".
Strange? Maybe. For Yatsume, though, that's just business as usual.
However, after a certain someone drops by for a special visit, Yatsume comes to learn about the secret behind the shop, and the truth behind the whole world...
A strange, blasphemous ADV game paying respects to Cthulhu mythos.
Cafe simulation x Exploration x Multiple endings Let your choices decide the final outcome.
Disclaimers:
- This game is an "ADV game meant to pay respects to Cthulhu mythos", meaning that the characters, places, and events are meant to grab inspiration from the world of Cthulhu.
We do not guarantee that any entities or creatures from Cthulhu mythos are featured within this game.
All characters, places, and events are unique to this work, and have no direct relation to the original books, the original characters or the tabletop game.
It can still be played without any prior knowledge of Cthulhu lore.
- This game contains mature themes including, but not limited to, death, bullying, abuse, mental disorders, and fictitious religions; as well as visuals that may be disturbing to some players such as grotesque imagery, blood, and glitching effects.
Original Soundtrack:ruha
English Translation:Meika

title: Past Mistakes - Act I
description:
게임 정보
두 개의 세계! 두 개의 운명! 모든 것을 바꿀 수 있는 한 남자!
특징:
🏆 선명하고 생생한 4K 해상도로 구현된 아름다운 3D CG 콘텐츠로 이야기를 표현했습니다.
🏆 초당 60프레임의 화려한 애니메이션으로 전투, 액션, 드라마를 유연하고 부드럽게 보여줍니다.
🏆 트라우마와 과거의 실수와 같은 매력적인 주제를 담은 광활한 세계를 넘나드는 이야기.
🏆 세 가지 주요 루트, 각각 독특한 캐릭터, 스토리 전개, 그리고 엔딩!
🏆 다양한 분기점과 대체 엔딩이 스토리 경로에 따라 펼쳐집니다.

title: Cosmic Fear
description:
게임 정보
Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension  have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one, big picture. The solution is near; the next expedition will be the crucial one. You turn your gaze to the stars: what lies hidden in the unfathomable depths of the cosmos?
Night falls as the horn's haunting call echoes through the woods. The Great Ceremony is about to begin.

title: Star Ash Fleet
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
"Star Ash Fleet" is a real-time strategy game with unique gameplay mechanics. The game simulates interstellar battlefield environments on a 2D plane, creating a holographic battlefield projection for the player. Players will take on the role of a newly appointed fleet commander, using various gameplay strategies to tackle meticulously designed mission levels and experience thrilling battles.
The interstellar war between the Earth Human Federation and the Pleiades Star Cluster Empire has already spread across the entire galaxy, and the war, which has lasted for centuries, is about to reach a critical turning point. The Federation fleet, commanded by the player, accidentally uncovers the Empire’s conspiracy during a battle. After countless efforts and sacrifices, a significant historical event will pull both the entire war and the player into an uncontrollable situation.
Core Gameplay
Unique Control Experience
We have designed a proprietary fleet control system that combines elements from traditional RTS games while further simplifying and innovating the gameplay. This allows players to easily control a fleet with multiple warships. At the same time, players can execute precise micro-management of individual ships within the fleet through simple controls.

title: Honu
description:
게임 정보
You awaken in a stunning world, seeking to unravel mysteries through puzzles that reveal hidden details of your surroundings. Along the way, meet unique, animal-like characters, each with their own story.
Features
Solve puzzles using magitech
Explore breathtaking environments
Interact with intriguing NPCs
Discover the secret of Honu

title: The House of Toys
description:
게임 정보
The House of Toys is a game developed by Old School Bros, a duo of video game and horror genre enthusiasts.
The game's mission is to free the soul of the cursed toy, day after day, game after game. But be careful—each game can be different. You will earn rewards that make your work more satisfying, allow you to improve your room, and help you discover secrets.
The House of Toys is divided into several phases in each game.
Phase 1:
Investigate – Explore the mansion, searching for clues to help you identify the toy.
Phase 2:
Puzzles and Action – While avoiding the cursed toy, you’ll need to solve puzzles that grant you the power to free its soul.
Phase 3:
Stealth – You’ll need to be cautious and stealthy to use your new power and release the toy’s soul.
Do you dare to discover the true origin of the curse?

title: EVERDARK: Undead Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Embark on Everdark, an action-packed shooter that blends classics like Unreal or Doom with influences from survival horror games such as Resident Evil. Filled with references to 1980s horror movies, you'll be transported to a city swarming with vampires, where you'll face these creatures in diverse and bloody ways.
Survive in a devastated city
Upon returning from a visit to your cousin in Milwaukee, you're forced to take a detour that leads you to Everdark. Then, you suffer a terrible car accident that leaves you stranded with no way to call for help or continue your journey.
The only way out is on foot. However, the streets have descended into chaos… The city is infested with vampires that have wiped out most of its inhabitants! Can you help the survivors, uncover the cause of this catastrophe, and escape alive?

title: Knightfall Showdown
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Knightfall Showdown, where strategy meets chaos on the ultimate chess battlefield!
In this thrilling battle royale experience, 100 players are dropped onto a vast chessboard, each starting as a Knight with one goal: to outwit, outmaneuver, and outlast your opponents. As the clock ticks down, you'll have 30 seconds to collect as many pawns as possible, positioning yourself for supremacy when the action begins.
Gameplay Features:
Dynamic Pawn Collection: Use the initial 30 seconds wisely to gather pawns scattered across the board. Every pawn counts, giving you the edge in combat and upgrades.
Tactical Movement: Every 3 seconds, players can choose their next move strategically. Navigate the board, avoid conflicts, or set up ambushes while the storm gradually shrinks the battlefield, forcing players closer together.
Combat Mechanics: Engage in thrilling battles when your piece collides with another. If two pieces of the same rank meet, the player with more collected pawns upgrades to a higher hierarchy. But beware—higher-ranking pieces like Bishops, Rooks, and Queens can eliminate lower ranks with ease, stealing their pawns in the process.
ELO Ranking System: Show off your skills as you earn or lose ELO points based on your performance. Rise through the ranks, earn prestigious titles like CM, FM, IM, and GM, and compete against the best in the live leaderboard.
Endless Strategies: Whether you prefer stealth, aggression, or calculated moves, each match presents a unique opportunity to refine your strategy. Form alliances, betray friends, and adapt to an ever-changing battlefield.
Are you ready to step into the arena of Knightfall Showdown? Gather your wits, collect your pawns, and prepare for the most exhilarating chess experience of your life. Can you rise to the top and become the last piece standing? The chessboard awaits!

title: Bakso Simulator 2
description:
게임 정보
Bakso Simulator is back! Get ready to rebuild your Bakso Empire with new gameplay mechanics! Encounter both familiar and new faces, explore larger areas, and more!
Follow the footsteps of the legendary bakso seller, Rabas, as he ventures back to his peaceful hometown in the Indonesian countryside. Inheriting a substantial fortune from his late father, Rabas embarks on a new chapter, filled with both challenges and opportunities.
Features :
Discover new areas set in a beautiful Indonesian village
A much improved decorating system where players are more free on where to place objects!
Make your bakso cart cooler and more efficient by customizing and upgrading it!
Manage your shop and buy supplies by utilizing your new laptop and smartphone!
Hire staffs to help you sell bakso and keep customers happy!
Use various tools to keep your shop safe and clean!
A brand new house for Rabas to relax and plan his day!

title: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges
description:
게임 정보
어때, 들려?
‘들린다’는 표현이 적절한지 잘 모르겠어.
내 말이 너에게 전달되고 있는 거야?
……….
아쉽지만, 네가 반응하고 있는지 알 수가 없네.
아마 교신기가 고장났을지도 몰라.
하지만 전달되고 있다고 믿고, 너에게 전하겠어.
이것은 너와 나의 공동 실험이야.
어떤 실험인지 모른다면, 너도 불안하겠지.
그래서 실험의 요점을 정리해봤어. 참고해 줘.
게임의 특징
너와 내가 연속으로 교신할 수 있는 시간은 약 3분
내 목소리는 풀 보이스로 너에게 전달돼
너와의 교신 내용에 따라 실험 결과가 달라져
기본적으로 ‘선택지’라고 불리는 인터페이스로 교류를 진행해
하지만 네가 다른 차원의 존재임을 증명해달라고 할지도 몰라
그럴 땐, 선택지를 초월한 인터페이스로 응답해줘
설령 내가 죽더라도, 너는 실험을 계속 이어가 줘
마지막 항목이 신경 쓰이려나?
내가 실험을 완수하기엔 시간이 부족해.
하지만 네가 협력해준다면, 실험은 완수될 수 있어.
왜냐하면 너는――
이제 시간이――
실험에 참여를――
――여기서 기다릴게.
autokwd: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges,프롤레고메나 약 3분간의 교신으로 발생할 수 있는 극히 초자원적인 인터페이스에 대한 서설

title: OrePlant
description:
게임 정보
🌱 오어플랜트: 마법 같은 판타지 세계관이 기다립니다! ✨
호기심 많은 '핀'과 '마루'는 알 수 없는 신비한 힘에 의해 이세계로 빨려 들어갑니다! 🌀
그곳에는 전설적인 세계수가 우뚝 서 있으며, 당신의 손길로 이 신비로운 땅을 다시 되살릴 수 있습니다. 🌳
귀여운 동료 '아리아'와 함께 이 마법 같은 세계를 탐험하고 가꾸어 보세요!

title: Psynostic
description:
게임 정보
Psynostic is a game that let you incarn a psychologist. Find the words to make your patient speak and make the good diagnostic. You have a full liberty of questions available thanks to the LLM (Large Language Model).
Use your diagnostic book to have guideline about potential questions and to keep track of your suspected diagnostic.

title: Shoestrings Story
description:
게임 정보
A point-and-click visual novel
Approximately 300,000 characters of narrative
A wide variety of mini-games
Retro pixel graphics
A smoking girl dragging around a TV
Sudden quantum mechanics
No "just parry" mechanic
The protagonist is a freelance writer named Love Catch. Due to childhood trauma, they are unable to speak and have no combat experience. However, after saving a wounded, mysterious creature known as a Mamono, they are unexpectedly chosen to become a "Hero." Love Catch’s mission is to "persuade" an entity called the "Demon King," who is said to command the Mamono, and bring an end to the 900-year-long war against these creatures.

title: Beatdown City Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Beatdown City Survivors is an immersive sandbox bullet heaven beat-em-up that knocks the genre on its head. The city is a nightmarish playground filled with gas to ignite, puddles to electrify, and cars to blow up--and you'll need to manipulate every element possible to wipe out the gruesome zombies, mutants and blood- thirsty creatures lurking in the streets.

title: Moon River
description:
게임 정보
Moon River is a short RPG adventure featuring a classic top-down perspective and light RPG / puzzle elements
You are someone called the Mariner, a sailor who's been out at sea for an incredibly long time. You are headed to Elapse Island, one of the last known places of the world. There, it is said the people only exist in the moonlight, as well as the river that runs through the island: "Moon River." For whatever reason, the Mariner desperately seeks something at the end of the river.
As the Mariner, your objective is to travel to the river's end before dawn. Deep shadows obstruct each area of the island, so you must find any sources of pure light to dispel them and proceed down the river.
Along the way you'll find new people to meet, sights & sounds to experience, and secrets to uncover.
Atmospheric RPG Experience
Moon River forgoes combat and heavy narrative, instead primarily consisting of exploration and puzzle solving with optional secret events scattered throughout.
Interactive Events
Occasionally, there are special interactive events and actions to perform, such as operating a machine. These events briefly break up the regular gameplay for a more varied experience.
Hidden Narrative
Beneath the main story, there is a hidden history of events from the past which can only be uncovered within the world's secret spaces and unchecked corners. Only the highly dedicated can piece the entire story together.

title: ApocaShift
description:
게임 정보
Establish Your Stronghold
 Start with an empty plot of land, and gradually expand your base by deploying into raids and gathering essential resources. As you venture out, you'll scavenge items from abandoned towns, ruins, and other hazardous locations, carefully extracting valuable materials like guns, ammo, and food. Every raid brings its own set of dangers, from radioactive zones to swarming mutant creatures. Some regions are heavily contaminated, requiring special gear and caution to loot safely. These zones might hide rare resources, but also host terrifying, radiation-mutated monsters that could easily overwhelm an unprepared survivor.
Build and Fortify Your Base 
Back at your base, use the resources you gather to construct new structures, fortify walls, and develop areas that support your growing community. The more you build, the more survivors you'll attract. These survivors come with unique skills and specialties—some may be engineers, able to repair or improve your armory; others might be skilled medics, offering healing services. As you expand, you’ll also attract traders who bring exotic goods from far-off places, but their supplies come at a steep price. Negotiating with them and exchanging loot for crucial supplies could turn the tide in your survival.
Survive in a Dangerous World 
Along with the growing base, you’ll face ever-present threats. The world around you is constantly shifting, and you must adapt. Dangerous mutants—twisted by the apocalypse’s radioactive fallout—roam the wilderness, and become more common as time continues and some may even infiltrate your base. Your best defense might be well-equipped guards, fortified outposts, and traps designed to ward off these horrific invaders. The wasteland is unpredictable, and with the constant looming threat of radiation storms and mutant hordes, staying one step ahead is vital.
Make Strategic Decisions 
Your decisions will be key to surviving. As you deploy into new areas for exploration, gathering crucial resources and completing quests, you may stumble upon new factions, rogue survivors, or hostile creatures. Completing missions for these groups might offer unique rewards, such as new weapons, armor, or blueprints for advanced technology. But be careful—alliances are fragile, and sometimes helping one group means making enemies with another.

title: Oscuro Blossom's Glow
description:
게임 정보
이 플랫폼 퍼즐 게임은 셀레네의 이야기를 따라갑니다. 그녀는 특별한 꽃의 빛을 흡수하고 방출하여 기계를 작동시키고, 길을 밝히며, 주변 환경의 일부 요소를 미세하게 조정할 수 있는 능력을 지니고 있습니다. 다양한 종류의 꽃빛을 사용하면 물체를 충전하고 플랫폼을 상승시킬 수 있으며, 빛을 활용하는 방식에 따라 변화하는 환경을 탐험할 수 있습니다. 각 도전은 창의력을 요구하며, 우호적이거나 적대적인 생명체와의 만남은 행성계 전체의 운명을 결정짓는 중요한 선택으로 이어집니다.
특징
✨ 빛의 힘을 활용하여 퍼즐을 풀고 장애물을 극복하세요.신비로운 꽃의 빛을 흡수하고 방출하여 길을 밝히고 숨겨진 기계를 작동시킬 수 있습니다. 빛을 사용할 때마다 환경이 변화하며, 어둠과 희망 사이의 섬세한 균형을 형성합니다.
🌿 다양한 존재들과 함께하는 살아있는 세계.여정을 도와줄 수도, 방해할 수도 있는 생명체들을 만나면서, 한 걸음 한 걸음이 새로운 도전이 됩니다. 자연 속 존재들이 퍼즐이자 길잡이가 됩니다.

title: Glowkeeper
description:
게임 정보
Glowkeeper is a puzzle game about manipulating elements. By the light of fireflies, link and dissolve elemental forces to construct bridges, break through obstacles, and traverse a glowing, interconnected world.

title: Inner Truth
description:
게임 정보
내면의 진실과 마주하라
큐트하고 크레이지한 세 명의 히로인과 함께, 어둡고 뒤틀린 현대 사회를 살아남아라.
절망 속에서 기어오르고, 숨겨진 수수께끼를 풀어내며, 공포를 극복하라.
스토리

title: Indoor Baseball
description:
게임 정보
The highly anticipated follow up to Indoor Kickball!
Indoor Baseball is BIGGER, better, and even more destructive!
Indoor Baseball is a 1v1 baseball game played in the rooms of your house! Play in a goofy story mode to work your way up to make the school baseball team. Play a 14 game randomly generated season mode, or quick play 1v1 in a local multiplayer match against a friend or CPU.
Each field has their own unique ways to hit home runs:
Smash through the window in the living room
Hit the ball into the mini hoop in the bedroom
Ding the ball into the toilet in the bathroom
Dozens of other insane ways to hit home run
Break through windows for home runs
Avoid physics obstacles to field the ball and run the bases
Destroy too much and you may run in to an angry parent during your game

title: Songs of the Shore
description:
게임 정보
Songs of the Shore is a point-and-click, 3D, immersive Adventure-Collectathon! Collect sea shells and solve puzzles to discover the secrets of the island. 

Explore a mysterious island full of musical shells and secrets to discover. Immerse yourself in an ambient and serene soundtrack which is remixed as you collect more shells.

title: Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids
description:
게임 정보
🐾 Welcome to Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids! 🐾
Ever dreamed of a world where cats and mermaids become one? In Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids, hatch magical cores to reveal adorable Mermeows—each with its own quirky personality and charm. Watch these enchanting cat-mermaids drift gracefully through beautifully hand-drawn lakes in a serene, idle clicker adventure.
🌍 Explore Four Enchanting Biomes
Begin your journey at the peaceful Magical Lake sanctuary, then unlock Molten Lagoon, Spectral Swamp, and Celestial Archipelago. Each realm hosts 20 unique Mermeow types along with environmental buffs from decorations and lake upgrades, transforming your waterside retreat into a vibrant haven.
🐚 How to Play:
💖 Open Chests: Discover Mermeow Cores hidden within magical chests.
🌊 Hatch in Shells: Use the cores in magical shells to awaken new Mermeows.
✨ Shimmer & Fuse: Instantly earn pearls with shimmer or fuse cores to boost quality before hatching.
🐾 Watch & Drift: Enjoy the gentle drift of your Mermeows as they simply swim in your lakes.
💎 Collect Pearls: Earn pearls passively or ascend your Mermeows for extra rewards.
🏡 Expand & Decorate: Upgrade your lakes, add more hatching spots, and decorate to unlock additional buffs.
 🎶 Mellow Music: Each biome features its own exclusive soundtrack to fully immerse you in this gentle world.
✅ Adorable Mermeows: Each Mermeow comes in one of four quality tiers—Normal, Charmed, Enchanted, and the ultra-rare Ethereal—with 20 unique types per biome waiting to be discovered.
✅ Enjoy the soothing, effortless movement of your Mermeows without any flashy distractions.
✅ Boost your hatching process with active clicks or let your serene aquatic companions work in the background—even offline (up to a 24-hour cap).
✅ Enhance your cores with shimmer or fuse multiples to hatch rare, high-quality Mermeows and boost their unique traits for increased pearl production.
✅ Unlock rewards as you expand your sanctuary and nurture your growing collection of uniquely charming Mermeows.

title: Mysplaced
description:
게임 정보
Mysplaced는 신비와 도전, 놀라움이 가득한 아름답게 디자인된 3D 세계를 탐험하는 매력적인 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다. 탐험, 전투, 스토리텔링이 완벽하게 조화를 이루는 몰입형 경험을 제공합니다.
울창한 숲, 뜨거운 사막, 눈 덮인 풍경, 용암 지대, 장엄한 산악 지역 등 다양한 생물 군계를 탐험하며 퍼즐, 보물, 흥미로운 만남을 경험하세요. 새로운 능력을 잠금 해제하고 전투 기술을 마스터하며, 화학 시스템을 활용해 환경과 독창적으로 상호작용할 수 있습니다. 소울 시스템은 도전과 깊이를 더해 탐험과 전략을 보상합니다.
주요 특징:
몰입형 탐험: 숲, 사막, 눈, 용암, 산악 지대 등 비밀과 놀라움이 가득한 아름다운 환경을 탐험하세요.
도전적인 퍼즐: 창의력과 지혜를 시험하는 다양한 퍼즐을 해결하세요.
박진감 넘치는 전투: 직관적인 조작으로 다양한 적들과 싸우고, 강력한 능력을 해제하여 실력을 향상하세요.
고위험 진행 시스템: 숙련된 플레이와 신중한 의사 결정을 보상하는 소울 시스템의 스릴을 경험하세요.
화학 시스템: 환경과 상호작용하며 새로운 해결책과 게임 플레이 가능성을 발견하세요.
미니게임: 다양한 재미있고 보람찬 미니게임을 통해 모험의 새로운 재미를 느껴보세요.
스토리의 비밀을 풀고, 도전적인 퍼즐을 극복하며, 전투의 기술을 마스터하는 동안 Mysplaced는 흥미롭고 잊을 수 없는 액션 어드벤처 경험을 제공합니다.

title: F*ck This Job
description:
게임 정보
개념
일에 지쳤나요? 저도 그렇습니다! 하지만 상사를 불러서 보내버린다면 어떨까요? 어떤 일이 일어날까요?

F*ck This Job은 직장 스트레스를 풀어주는 완벽한 게임입니다! 사무용품으로 무장해서 이 에픽 배틀에서 최고의 무기를 소유하세요.

자, 자루를 군사적인 도구로 변신시켜보세요. 멀리서 공격할 수 있는 스테이플러를 무기로 사용하고, 다양한 창의적인 무기들을 발견하세요. 동료, 상사, 매니저들, 심지어 회사의 CEO들과 맞서 보세요.

당신의 목표? 이 지옥 같은 회사에서 살아남는 것!
적들
동료들은 당신을 해고할 때 적으로 변합니다. 매니저들은 당신의 여정 도중 마주치게 될 가장 강력한 일반적인 적입니다. 여러 상사들이 여러분의 길에서 나타날 것입니다. 하지만 조심하세요, 모든 상사들과 마찬가지로 그들과 대응하는 것은 쉽지 않을 겁니다.
게임 플레이
커피의 힘
맵 상의 물체들을 이용해 자신을 돕세요. 컵, 병, 의자를 적에게 던지세요.

사무용 무기
사무실 안에서는 모든 것이 무기가 될 수 있습니다. 스테이플러, 연필, CD를 원거리 무기로 사용하거나 자, 마우스를 군사적인 무기로 사용하세요. 이것들은 당신의 게임 플레이 중 발견할 수 있는 무기들의 몇 가지 예시입니다.

이동
적을 피하거나 공격하기 위해 빠른 움직임을 이용하세요. 목표물에 도달하기 위해 플랫폼을 오가며, 발과 손을 전투 무기로 활용하세요.

title: PSYCHExFUSE
description:
게임 정보
스토리
방황하는 영혼이 상상할 수 없는 공포의 파스텔 색상 세계에서 길을 잃게 됩니다.
 꿈과 현실 사이의 경계를 흐리게 하는 마음을 혼란스럽게 하는 사건들을 통해 그들을 안내하고, 방랑자의 과거 자아라고 주장하는 익숙한 얼굴들과의 논리를 무시하는 만남을 헤쳐나가세요.
 모든 희망이 사라진 것처럼 보일 때, 우리 영웅의 탈출의 열쇠라고 주장하는 여신이 그녀의 그릇이 되는 대가로 도움을 제공합니다...
특징
위협, 퍼즐 및 공포로 가득 찬 독특한 세계를 탐험하세요.
자신의 과거 버전들을 도와주고, 구하고, 충돌하세요.
두 신과 반의 전쟁 뒤에 숨겨진 미스터리를 풀어보세요.
대체 엔딩으로 당신의 행동의 결과를 직면하세요.
아름답게 손으로 그린 컷신과 다양하고 분위기 있는 사운드트랙을 경험하세요.
질문에 답하세요... 당신은 정말 자신을 믿을 수 있나요?

title: There is NO PLAN B
description:
게임 정보


『There is NO PLAN B』는 세계 최고 수준의 Spine2D 애니메이션이 적용된 Anime 스타일의 등장인물들과, 현실적인 3D 배경 그래픽의 조합이 특징인 「내러티브 탐정 어드벤처」 게임입니다.


2070년, 메가 코프 「Trinity Inc」가 지배하는 「Soul City」의 집순이 사설탐정 「B」가 되어, 사이버펑크 세상에서 벌어진 다양한 사건을 직접 조사하고 해결해 보세요.


B는 으로 Soul City의 경찰, SCPD의 하청이 되어 그들이 맡긴 사건을 수사해야 하는 상황에 처합니다.


하지만 다양한 매력의 조력자들이 여러분들의 수사를 도와줄 뿐만 아니라.



사이버펑크 미래 기술을 이용해, 현장을 분석하고 범인의 흔적을 찾아낼 수 있죠.


끈질긴 수사를 통해 사건 범인을 찾아내고, 사건 범인을 직접 「체포」해보세요!


물론 틈틈이 다양한 등장인물들을 저녁 식사에 초대해, 즐거운 시간을 보내는 것도 잊지 마시고요!

title: Neighbor's Wife
description:
게임 정보
"Wife of my Neighbor" is a visual novel in which you have to help your neighbor in a special way. His wife needs more attention, and you are the only one who can help her.

How exactly - that's up to you! You can either help the couple by becoming their "family therapist" or just help the wife with her lack of attention. Either way, you are sure to make your neighbor's wife happy!

Spend time with her, help her with her morning jog and household chores, prove that you can be trusted in everything!

title: SerialWorld
description:
게임 정보
A comical RPG where a boy named "Milo" and a mysterious creature "Anima" venture into a fantastical world to solve the town's mysteries!
Strategic Battles with Easy Controls
Engage in battles by summoning three Anima at once!
Each Anima has its own personality, and with numerous skills, there's plenty of strategic depth.
Quirky Characters
Prepare to face off against quirky and comical characters!

title: Noblemen: 1941
description:
게임 정보
The year is 1941 and the world is in ruin. The Great Plague has decimated the world's population, food and resources are scarce, and religious dogma has replaced sense and reason. Some countries have isolated themselves while others seek war, ultimately giving rise to a new World War.
Historic Influence
Although Noblemen: 1941 takes place in an alternate reality, many elements are based on familiar real world events, locations, and scenarios from WWII.
Realistic Combat Mechanics
Core gunplay is based on realistic mechanics such as armor penetration, bullet physics, suppression, and morale. Units will use advanced AI modeled on real world combat doctrines and tactics from the time period. 
Alternate Reality Elements
Experience interesting fictional elements such as brutal melee combat, heavy armor, shields, and more. Both deploy and fight against experimental units, mechs, battle suits, and even plague infested ghouls and vampires. Immerse yourself in a war torn, atmospheric world.
"In the face of terror, it is the Noblemen that stand resolute. We are the pillars of hope, guiding the path for those that falter." --Cody Lee, United States Nobleman, 1896, The Plague War
You are a Nobleman - one of a few powerful individuals with the finest weapons, armor, and personal armies. With the world in ruins, the Noblemen take on the burden of war for their nations.

title: Bang Bang Barrage
description:
게임 정보


Recoil-Driven Navigation: Propel yourself through the waters with each shot! Turn gunplay into a dance of strategy and precision. Master the art of movement to outmaneuver and outlast the sea’s dangers.

Multiplayer Mayhem: Sail solo or with up to three friends, mastering the waves through seamless teamwork or solo cunning. More players, more chaos!

Endless Replayability: Each voyage across the sea is unique, with fresh challenges, traits, and upgrade paths to explore. No two games are the same, ensuring endless fun and discovery.

Ever-Changing Voyages: Tailor each run with a variety of upgrades and adapt to spontaneous buffs and debuffs that the sea throws at you. Adapt your strategy on the fly and make the most out of unexpected twists and turns.

title: Odin's Defense
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a quest to defeat Fenrir. Travel distant lands, flanked by your allies, and take your rightful place by Odin's side!
Odin’s Defense is a twist on the traditional Tower Defense genre: instead of upgrades, equip your towers with powerful items to create unique effects each round. Immerse yourself in the story and make choices that will shape the outcome of your campaign. No single playthrough will look the same!
Features:
- Single player tower defense inspired by Norse mythology.
- Traverse 5 different biomes on your quest to bind Fenrir.
- 15+ available Towers all with unique abilities.
- Tons of enemies to challenge your skills and test your wits.
- A variety of items for you to collect and use in creative ways.
- The Longhouse Codex: complete in-game lore at your fingertips.
- Story elements that shape the way you strategise and play the game.
- Play Story Mode to unlock Endless Mode.

title: BUSTAFELLOWS season2
description:
게임 정보
Everyone wants answers.
Who is to blame, and what went wrong?
And what is to be punished?
In order to keep the shape of this world, things are divided into black and white.
Those who look between the black and white will only continue to suffer.
Everyone should know it in their hearts.
Things are two in one.
White and black. Front and back. Light and shadow.
Good news, bad news.
And, if it will change or if it will end.
BUSTAFELLOWS returns!
The hit series BUSTAFELLOWS continues with an all-new season! Featuring the crime-solving gang you know and love, that trouble can’t help but follow. Uncover their story in this movie-like experience, as you meet new characters, make important choices and help solve the dark, unspeakable crimes that plague New Sieg.
A Puzzle to Piece Together: five different playable “movies”, different routes corresponding to each male lead, each portraying a different story which you play an integral part in.
New Flowchart System: review your progress through the story with a helpful flowchart that allows you to select and replay different parts of the story, leaving no stone unturned.
The Romance Builds: continue your relationship from the last game, growing together through struggles, and learning new sides to Teuta, Limbo, Shu, Helvetica, Mozu and Scarecrow.
The Power of Visuals: skilfully crafted characters brought to life with beautiful artistry. Experience the characters in new outfits, hairstyles and scenarios!
An Unforgettable Voice Cast: featuring a cast of famed voices such as Yui Kondo, KENN, Yoshimasa Hosoya, and many more!
Extra Episodes: collect memorabilia and extra episodes through certain conditions, and unlock a special episode upon purchase!

title: Worldseekers - Deckbuilding RPG
description:
게임 정보
Worldseekers는 GPS 탐색 RPG입니다. 이 세계의 광활한 땅과 기만적인 던전을 탐험하면서 희귀한 카드, 이벤트, 독특한 캐릭터를 발견하세요.

정신적, 육체적 건강을 증진하기 위해 Worldseekers는 GPS 메커니즘과 전화 앱 링크를 사용하여 밖으로 나가서 걸을 수 있도록 도와줍니다. 물론 Steam 버전을 사용하면 몇 시간 동안 PC에서 플레이할 수 있으며, 추가 산책에 대한 보상도 받을 수 있습니다. 모든 스트리머의 경우 기본적으로 위치를 조정하거나 숨깁니다.

이메일 뉴스레터에도 가입하세요: (다른 소셜 미디어 자료는 아직 모두 있지만 이메일이 훨씬 더 좋습니다. IMO에서는)
세상을 신비와 신비가 가득한 환상적인 땅으로 바꿔보세요:
[목록]
독특하고 어려운 몬스터를 물리치세요
재미있고 수수께끼 같은 서사를 즐겨보세요
끊임없이 변화하는 땅이 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞춰집니다.
던전 및 기타 콘텐츠를 집에 가져가서 건강한 습관에 대한 보상을 받으세요.[/목록]
미스테리와 마법이 가득한 광대한 세계를 탐험해보세요.
전설적인 생물과 전투를 벌이고 던전 깊이를 탐험하세요.


질문이나 피드백이 있거나 우리를 지원하고 싶다면(확실히 사용할 수 있음) Twitch나 YouTube(최종 보스 편집)에서 저에게 연락해 주세요!

title: Robot's Fate: Alice
description:
게임 정보
Robot’s Fate: Alice는 2070년대의 미래 미국을 배경으로 한 텍스트 기반 RPG입니다. 당신은 신경망 AI로 구동되는 아동 동반자 로봇 Alice로서, 사랑하는 인간의 전심을 다 해 돕도록 설계되었습니다. 하지만 모든 사람들이 자율적인 AI를 두려워하는 세상에서 자아를 갖게 될 순간이 다가오고 있습니다. 당신은 로봇과 인간의 조화로운 삶을 이룰 수 있을까요? 당신의 선택에는 결과가 있습니다.



Robot’s Fate: Alice는 다양한 가능성과 스토리를 진행하며 선택을 통해 주인공의 성격을 형성해 가는 인터랙티브 스토리입니다. Alice는 "백지상태"로 시작해 당신의 행동을 통해서 성격을 형성해 나갑니다. 단호해질 것인가, 아니면 살갑게 접근할 것인가; 공감적인 성격이 될 것인가, 아니면 실용적인 성격이 될 것인가? 모든 선택은 당신의 성격을 형성함과 동시에 새로운 가능성을 열 것입니다.


중요한 선택을 앞두고 딱 한 단계 (아니면 한 스탯 포인트)가 부족해 좌절했던 적이 있나요? 이제 더 이상 걱정 할 필요가 없습니다. Alice의 신경 수용량은 아직 성격이 충분히 형성되지 않은 상황에서도 부족한 파라미터를 추가해 어려운 상황을 벗어 할 수 있게 합니다. 하지만 이는 만능 도구가 아니며, 수용량이 바닥나면 어려운 상황을 벗어날 수 없게 됩니다.


당신은 인간들로 가득 찬 세상 속의 로봇 하나일 뿐입니다. 그리고 많은 인간은 인공지능의 등장을 경멸하고 있지요. 살아남기 위해서는 인간들과 (특히 당신의 주인…. 아니, 가족들과) 조심스럽게 소통해야 합니다. 오늘 최선을 다하지 않으면 내일엔 다른 동반 로봇이 당신 자리를 대체 할 것입니다.




인류는 로봇을 동등하게 받아들이지 않으며, 많은 사람들이 최근의 로봇 발전에 대해 두려움과 증오를 품고 있습니다. 당신은 신중하게 행동해야 하며, 로봇에게는 수많은 위험이 도사리는 새로운 세상을 헤쳐 나가야 합니다. 만약 누군가가 당신의 자아가 형성되고 있다는 것을 알아차리면, 당신은 곧바로 '소거' 당할 것입니다.


당신의 선택은 유니크한 상황으로 이어지며, 이를 헤쳐 나가며 당신의 캐릭터는 고유의 특성을 배울 수 있습니다. 이러한 특성은 미래의 선택에 영향을 끼칠 수 있지만, 성격이 충분히 형성된 상태라면 특성이 없어도 원하는 결과를 얻을 수도 있습니다.


이 게임의 스토리 라인은 220,000자나 되는 스토리를 가지고 있으며, 글자 수로는 ‘해리 포터와 불의 잔’ 이나 ‘반지 원정대’와 비교될 정도의 양을 가지고 있습니다. 하지만 Robot’s Fate: Alice에선 당신이 스토리에 직접적인 영향을 끼칠 수 있습니다. 당신의 로보틱한 삶에서 어느 상황에서 무슨 선택을 할지, 어느 길을 할지는 당신이 결정합니다.




이 이야기는 여러 길로 뻗어나갑니다. 정치인이 될까요, 수석 엔지니어가 될까요, 아니면 비밀 요원이 될까요? 아니면 맛있는 버거를 파는 소소한 행복을 추구하는 삶을 살게 될까요? 그 결정은 당신에게 달려있습니다.

title: Madness Afloat
description:
게임 정보
Set sail into the eerie and mystical waters of "Madness Afloat", an action/adventure game where history, fantasy and cosmic horror collide. In an alternate 1899, steam power and ethereal energies have revolutionized naval warfare, creating a battleground like no other.
Navigate through an immersive world filled with historical fantasy and Lovecraftian dread, where every voyage plunges you deeper into the unknown.

title: HyperBlade 2050 - Dystopian Sports Manager
description:
게임 정보
HyperBlade 2050 is a futuristic text-based sports management simulation set on a dystopian Earth. Experience the excitement of professional sports management, whilst being drawn into the rich lore of society in an alternative future of the 2050s.
Meet the visionary futuristic sport of HyperBlade, a compelling combination of ice hockey, handball, and roller derby.
Take on the role of a head coach, managing your roster of players game-to-game and through their careers, experiencing the emotions, passion, and excitement of sports management.

title: Shades
description:
게임 정보
Hello and welcome !
I'm Mamat, a true passionate gamer and a new French game developer on Unreal Engine 5, and I present to you my very first game : Shades !
These last few years many FPS were not really satisfying me, so I decided to make one by myself with all my ideas and my perspective of a truly immersive first-person game, which means immersive menus, no or minimum HUD or camera effects or pop up notifications or outlined/highlighted items and interactions, like in real life, and be really free to do whatever you want in dense and beautiful environments, no invisible walls, many destructions possible for example, using different ways to complete the objectives and find solutions to problems by yourself, no backseating, minimap or floating arrows/pings/compass, and with that all the latest hardware and software technologies available on PC to have the most realistic graphics and physics for the best immersion possible.
I'm making this game first to gain experience (so please be indulgent), and to start a portfolio in game development, then hopefully in the future to change from my actual job to my dream job : being a game developer, or even better, create my own game studio, which really listen his community and who you can trust and rely on, to make all our dream games for all of us, I have so many ideas !
So based on your support, i hope this early access will give me the time and resources to make all this happen.
About Shades, it's a really immersive solo FPS with infiltration and tactical extraction shooter aspects. Go stealth, or loud, in a variety of missions as a mercenary for an agency that really use your skills to make this world better.
For now the game may not very optimized, so you will surely need a good and recent PC for the best experience (you can check the system requirements below), it may also lacks some content and functionalities, so be aware of that before buying my early access game and then leaving a bad review please.
Currently implemented in the game, there are 4 different maps : your home/vehicle (upgradable), the secret training bunker of the agency, the agency test mission then your first official mission, with for now a basic stealth system with simple lootable AI enemies, a money/level system, a tablet/PC with online casino games, shops, applications, dark web markets and more, 10 customizable weapons : sniper rifle, revolver, 2 assault rifles, 2 SMGs, 2 shotguns, 2 handguns + 4 grenades : fragmentation, contact frag, flash and smoke, several utilities/explosives, an axe, fist fighting and a push/kick/ragdoll system.

title: ALL IN VAIN
description:
게임 정보
Description:

Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world teeming with zombies and hostile gangs in the game "All in Vain." Explore a vast open world, engage in diverse quests, and develop your survival strategy. Utilize an advanced crafting system and weapon customization to create unique items and enhance your combat prowess. Your decisions will determine your fate in this harsh and captivating adventure. Survive at all costs and prove that hope is not in vain!

Key Features:

Crafting:
Gather resources, explore the world, and create everything from simple tools to complex and deadly weapons. Your ingenuity is the key to survival.

Weapon Customization:
Upgrade and modify your weapons to suit your playstyle. Each part has its own significance, and the right choice can be crucial in battle.

Survival:
Fight for your life against bloodthirsty zombies and ruthless bandits. Manage hunger, thirst, and fatigue to stay battle-ready.

Open World:
Explore a vast world filled with diverse landscapes—from dense forests and majestic mountains to raging rivers and tranquil lakes. From small settlements to a sprawling metropolis, each location is meticulously detailed and full of dangers and opportunities. Find shelters, gather valuable resources, and uncover hidden spots to survive and thrive in this harsh world.

Enemies:
In your world, zombies vary in their abilities and characteristics. Some zombies are slow and weak, posing a smaller threat, while others are incredibly strong and powerful. Additionally, there are mutants—extremely powerful and dangerous creatures that require special strategies to defeat. Besides zombies, you'll encounter various factions, each with its own goals and motives. These groups will also be your enemies, creating additional obstacles and conflicts in your fight for survival.


Complete a variety of tasks that will help you survive, find allies, and uncover the mysteries of the post-apocalyptic world. Quests range from resource gathering to complex missions requiring strategy and skill. Dive into intricate quests where you need to think through every step and find creative solutions to overcome dangerous traps and solve challenging puzzles.


Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a post-apocalyptic world with realistic graphics and immersive sound design. Explore detailed locations where every texture and sound creates the feeling of a real apocalypse.

Experience the realism of a world where changing conditions affect your survival. Day brings new opportunities for exploration and resource gathering, while night introduces new dangers, forcing you to seek shelter and stay alert.

Feel the full force of nature with changing weather conditions such as strong winds, dense fog, and heavy rain. These factors not only alter your perception of the world but also significantly impact survival tactics, adding an extra layer of realism and challenges.

Team up with friends in a cooperative multiplayer mode to tackle challenges together, share resources, and complete quests as a team.

"" combines intense survival elements with rich storytelling and a dynamic, ever-changing world, offering players a thrilling and immersive post-apocalyptic experience.

title: ARMED DECOBOT
description:
게임 정보


ARMED DECOBOT is a unique blend of Beat 'Em Up and Bullet Hell Shoot 'Em Up mechanics inspired by Treasure and Metal Slug. It seamlessly combines the crowd control & throw heavy melee combat of Beat 'Em Ups with the intense dodge & shoot gameplay of Shmups. It's fast paced, it's difficult, it's chaotic, it's a pure unbound arcade action game! A quick burst of adrenaline to start the day!

Gameplay

You will seamlessly switch between ranged & melee combat as the situation demands.
You'll strategically pepper enemies with shots to keep them stunned as you move in for a combo!
You'll knock them down, pick them up with your grappling hook and throw them at other enemies!
You will create devastating throw chains!
You will use everything in your arsenal to frantically fight over screen space!


It's a game with maxed out risk and reward!

title: Sister Ray
description:
게임 정보
Sister Ray is an RPG-survival about the brutal daily life of a drug addicted artist named Ray, who takes care of her little sister. Look after your condition, so no one finds out about the addiction. Improve your drawing and social skills. Do everything to get cash for another fix. Survive and look for a way out.



Live each game day as you see fit. The only conditions are to survive and not get caught.
Explore the city streets and visit important locations - the school, bar, underground casino, police station, etc.
Look for places to sketch or draw at home, raising your skill and opening new abilities. Maybe you’ll get to the exhibition after all?
Any action inevitably advances the time of day - plan ahead and do not miss important events.



Selling paintings, part-time work, speculation, pickpocketing - there are a great many ways to get some cash. But what will you spend it on?
Relationships with others are an extremely fragile thing. Try not to lose your friends.
The younger sister is the only person close to you. All your bad habits will become an example for her to follow. She shouldn't find out about the addiction.

title: MARINES VS GOD
description:
게임 정보


2400년, 지구의 과학자들은 상상할 수 없는 보물이 가득한 ‘신들의 행성’을 발견했습니다. 하지만 각 행성은 강력한 수호신의 보호를 받고 있습니다. 가장 용감한 자들만이 해병대에 합류하여 이 위험한 행성으로의 짧고도 위험한 임무에 도전할 수 있습니다.





가능한 많은 신성한 보물을 모으고, 괴물 무리와 함정, 파괴적인 재앙을 일으키는 신의 공격에서 살아남아 행성에서 탈출하세요.


최고의 주문을 전략적으로 선택하고 마나를 현명하게 관리하며, 함정을 설치하고 생명체를 소환하며 원소의 힘을 조종해 해병대를 처치하세요.



— 주변의 해병대를 공격합니다.

— 번개로 일정 지역에 피해를 줍니다.

— 적을 속이는 허상을 만듭니다.

— 짧은 지연 후 큰 피해를 입힙니다.

— 선택한 위치에 벽을 생성합니다.







• 화성 황무지
• 미래의 도시
• 정글 미로
• 얼음 요새
• 버려진 문명


제우스, 악마의 군주, 아나르 드림스(Anar Dreams)


수호자, 저격수, 의무병 또는 기술자


고전적인 비대칭 모드 (4대1) — 신과 해병대의 대결
PvP, PvE, 협동 및 혼합 모드로 친구 또는 AI와 플레이 가능 (최대 8명)

title: Theta and Paralldox on Worldlines
description:
게임 정보
Theta is a little girl who turns left every time she hits a wall. She is curious about the world and discovers a mysterious place, where she picked up a fork that can split her into multiple copies of herself, and from that moment, the world changes forever.
Use the power of splitting to solve puzzles and explore the truth of a world under the observation of "God"

title: Neon Highways
description:
게임 정보
Supercars, Neon-lit Cities, Cyber-Grids and Endless Highways: Welcome to Neon Highways, Where the '80s Come Back to Life!
Neon Highways is a Synthwave / Retrowave inspired casual arcade racer that lets you cruise through the vibrant, neon-lit streets of the 80s.
The music and visual style of Synthwave, inspired by a retro-futuristic vision of the 1980s, evokes a nostalgic sense of a past that never truly existed, yet feels instantly familiar.
This game takes you on an unforgettable road trip through this wonderful retro-futuristic world, where Retrowave, Synthwave, and Neon-Noir aesthetics blend with nostalgic synth melodies to create a journey like no other.
What’s waiting for you in Neon Highways?
🏁 Unlock New Highways, Chase the Horizon!
Cruise through neon-lit cityscapes, endless desert highways, and scenic ocean roads. Unlock up to 12 highways across 6 unique regions.
🚗 Unlock Sleek Supercars!
From classic-inspired speed machines to futuristic cruisers, unlock a growing collection of stylish supercars as you progress.
🎵 Synthwave Soundtrack, Pure Retro Vibes!
Cruise through neon highways with a synthwave soundtrack that perfectly matches the vibe. Every track brings that classic 80s arcade feel to life.
🎥 Authentic Retro Visual FX!
We’ve taken care to make sure Neon Highways doesn’t just look retro, it feels retro. Experience CRT scanlines, subtle film grain, and VHS-style artifacts that bring the nostalgia of old-school arcades and TVs to life on your modern screen.
🎮 Casual Racing, Pure Arcade Fun!
Neon Highways brings a relaxing casual arcade racing experience built for pure cruising enjoyment. If you’re up for a challenge, switch to the Rush Hour Mode—where heavier traffic and tighter time limits create a true test of your reflexes that brings all the stress you could ask for!
Grab the wheel, hit the open road, and let the neon sun guide you through a world where the '80s never left.

title: The Bleakest Keep
description:
게임 정보
A peaceful land has been overtaken by dark magic. Countless horrors hunt and kill all who fail to escape. It is up to you to save them.
The Bleakest Keep is a challenging, dark fantasy action roguelike. Breach the castle and find your way to the top. Find bows, shotguns, or electric cannons to vanquish zombies and creatures that lurk in the darkness. Team up with your dearest Juliet, who’ll upgrade your strength and put an end to the kingdom’s curse once and for all.
SURVIVE A RANDOMIZED KEEP!
SLAY SWARMS OF DARK FANTASY CREATURES!
A VARIETY OF WEAPONS!
UPGRADE AND MASTER YOUR ABILITIES!
DESTROY POWERFUL BOSSES!
SAVE THE WORLD!
tag: 액션 로그라이크,핵 앤 슬래시,던전 크롤러,생존 공포

title: Iris Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Note: The English version of the game is currently in preparation. Please stay tuned for updates!
What is Iris Odyssey?
Iris Odyssey is a classic text-based adventure game set in modern-day Shibuya. The story follows Fuka, a "girl searching for her brother," and Iris, a "crime investigator with magical powers," as they embark on an adventure filled with heartfelt encounters. The game features choices that players can make, which will unlock new story elements as the narrative progresses.
Story
Fuka, an orphaned girl living in Shibuya, is searching for her only family member, her missing brother Mitsuba. Along her journey, she awakens to her hidden magical powers. Meanwhile, Iris, a seasoned magic investigator, is pursuing a criminal organization of rogue sorcerers known as the Skyseekers. Her investigation leads her to take an interest in this brother and sister duo, who appear to be connected to the group.
As Fuka and Iris grow closer, they come to share a bond like family. Will this bond be enough to shatter the conspiracy that awaits them? Join Fuka and Iris in a modern fantasy adventure filled with destiny, intrigue, and magic in the opening chapter of Iris Odyssey!

title: Sweets'Devil
description:
게임 정보
For sweets, What Are Humans?
To sweets, humans are like legendary, towering villains—invincible monsters! They're terrifying devils that eat sweets!
In "Sweets' Devil", our heroine Renée faces off against hostile desserts in epic, explosive battles. But she's not the powerless kid who can't resist! Renée can transform into powerful combat forms, able to suppress the whole battlefield . Make the journey through the fantasy world into a joyous sweets-beating adventure.
After meet and make friends with those magic hats which Renée called them hattie as nickname, more powerful unique outfit transformations 'ATTIRE' will become available, each offering fresh ways to dominate the battlefield.
Beyond battles, Renée can roam the conquered regions, taking on fun challenges and side adventures, diving deeper into the stories with an array of interesting characters.
【Martial Magical Girl————Enemies Who Can't Beat Me Are Made To Be My Friends!】
Transformation! Magic! Battle!
Let the girl who's overflowing the cuteness charges forward with ultimate power and speed!
Combine a vast array of dazzling attacks to obliterate any resistance that stands in your way!
Unleash powerful burst skills to handle the most dangerous situations , turn the tide of battle!

title: STRAND
description:
게임 정보
SUMMARY
Strand takes place in a future where humanity expands beyond its system, driven by a shared vision of growth. VESTA, a paradise covered with vast oceans and thriving plankton, has been discovered by exploration probes. To assess its colonization potential, the A.R.E.S. Station has been sent into its orbit.
When a powerful magnetic field hits A.R.E.S., the station is warped by mysterious phenomena, distorting time, space, and physics. Solving these puzzles is your only way to escape.
A PREVIEW OF THE FUTURE
Step into life in the 25th century, where humanity unites in pursuit of a brighter future. This is a speculative vision of ideal technological advancement, filled with both inspiration and unease. As you explore this world, you’ll confront the double-edged nature of progress, offering incredible potential, but at what cost?
RICH ARRAY OF PUZZLES AND RIDDLES

title: Cafe DReAMLAND
description:
게임 정보
This is Cafe "DReAMLAND".
Cafe clerk Yatsume has one job: To make drinks for the strange "customers" that stop by the cafe. 
Not just any drinks, though: have a wish? With just a hint of blasphemy, these drinks can help make it "come true".
Strange? Maybe. For Yatsume, though, that's just business as usual.
However, after a certain someone drops by for a special visit, Yatsume comes to learn about the secret behind the shop, and the truth behind the whole world...
A strange, blasphemous ADV game paying respects to Cthulhu mythos.
Cafe simulation x Exploration x Multiple endings Let your choices decide the final outcome.
Disclaimers:
- This game is an "ADV game meant to pay respects to Cthulhu mythos", meaning that the characters, places, and events are meant to grab inspiration from the world of Cthulhu.
We do not guarantee that any entities or creatures from Cthulhu mythos are featured within this game.
All characters, places, and events are unique to this work, and have no direct relation to the original books, the original characters or the tabletop game.
It can still be played without any prior knowledge of Cthulhu lore.
- This game contains mature themes including, but not limited to, death, bullying, abuse, mental disorders, and fictitious religions; as well as visuals that may be disturbing to some players such as grotesque imagery, blood, and glitching effects.
Original Soundtrack:ruha
English Translation:Meika

title: Past Mistakes - Act I
description:
게임 정보
두 개의 세계! 두 개의 운명! 모든 것을 바꿀 수 있는 한 남자!
특징:
🏆 선명하고 생생한 4K 해상도로 구현된 아름다운 3D CG 콘텐츠로 이야기를 표현했습니다.
🏆 초당 60프레임의 화려한 애니메이션으로 전투, 액션, 드라마를 유연하고 부드럽게 보여줍니다.
🏆 트라우마와 과거의 실수와 같은 매력적인 주제를 담은 광활한 세계를 넘나드는 이야기.
🏆 세 가지 주요 루트, 각각 독특한 캐릭터, 스토리 전개, 그리고 엔딩!
🏆 다양한 분기점과 대체 엔딩이 스토리 경로에 따라 펼쳐집니다.

title: Cosmic Fear
description:
게임 정보
Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension  have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one, big picture. The solution is near; the next expedition will be the crucial one. You turn your gaze to the stars: what lies hidden in the unfathomable depths of the cosmos?
Night falls as the horn's haunting call echoes through the woods. The Great Ceremony is about to begin.

title: Star Ash Fleet
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
"Star Ash Fleet" is a real-time strategy game with unique gameplay mechanics. The game simulates interstellar battlefield environments on a 2D plane, creating a holographic battlefield projection for the player. Players will take on the role of a newly appointed fleet commander, using various gameplay strategies to tackle meticulously designed mission levels and experience thrilling battles.
The interstellar war between the Earth Human Federation and the Pleiades Star Cluster Empire has already spread across the entire galaxy, and the war, which has lasted for centuries, is about to reach a critical turning point. The Federation fleet, commanded by the player, accidentally uncovers the Empire’s conspiracy during a battle. After countless efforts and sacrifices, a significant historical event will pull both the entire war and the player into an uncontrollable situation.
Core Gameplay
Unique Control Experience
We have designed a proprietary fleet control system that combines elements from traditional RTS games while further simplifying and innovating the gameplay. This allows players to easily control a fleet with multiple warships. At the same time, players can execute precise micro-management of individual ships within the fleet through simple controls.

title: Honu
description:
게임 정보
You awaken in a stunning world, seeking to unravel mysteries through puzzles that reveal hidden details of your surroundings. Along the way, meet unique, animal-like characters, each with their own story.
Features
Solve puzzles using magitech
Explore breathtaking environments
Interact with intriguing NPCs
Discover the secret of Honu

title: The House of Toys
description:
게임 정보
The House of Toys is a game developed by Old School Bros, a duo of video game and horror genre enthusiasts.
The game's mission is to free the soul of the cursed toy, day after day, game after game. But be careful—each game can be different. You will earn rewards that make your work more satisfying, allow you to improve your room, and help you discover secrets.
The House of Toys is divided into several phases in each game.
Phase 1:
Investigate – Explore the mansion, searching for clues to help you identify the toy.
Phase 2:
Puzzles and Action – While avoiding the cursed toy, you’ll need to solve puzzles that grant you the power to free its soul.
Phase 3:
Stealth – You’ll need to be cautious and stealthy to use your new power and release the toy’s soul.
Do you dare to discover the true origin of the curse?

title: EVERDARK: Undead Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Embark on Everdark, an action-packed shooter that blends classics like Unreal or Doom with influences from survival horror games such as Resident Evil. Filled with references to 1980s horror movies, you'll be transported to a city swarming with vampires, where you'll face these creatures in diverse and bloody ways.
Survive in a devastated city
Upon returning from a visit to your cousin in Milwaukee, you're forced to take a detour that leads you to Everdark. Then, you suffer a terrible car accident that leaves you stranded with no way to call for help or continue your journey.
The only way out is on foot. However, the streets have descended into chaos… The city is infested with vampires that have wiped out most of its inhabitants! Can you help the survivors, uncover the cause of this catastrophe, and escape alive?

title: Knightfall Showdown
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Knightfall Showdown, where strategy meets chaos on the ultimate chess battlefield!
In this thrilling battle royale experience, 100 players are dropped onto a vast chessboard, each starting as a Knight with one goal: to outwit, outmaneuver, and outlast your opponents. As the clock ticks down, you'll have 30 seconds to collect as many pawns as possible, positioning yourself for supremacy when the action begins.
Gameplay Features:
Dynamic Pawn Collection: Use the initial 30 seconds wisely to gather pawns scattered across the board. Every pawn counts, giving you the edge in combat and upgrades.
Tactical Movement: Every 3 seconds, players can choose their next move strategically. Navigate the board, avoid conflicts, or set up ambushes while the storm gradually shrinks the battlefield, forcing players closer together.
Combat Mechanics: Engage in thrilling battles when your piece collides with another. If two pieces of the same rank meet, the player with more collected pawns upgrades to a higher hierarchy. But beware—higher-ranking pieces like Bishops, Rooks, and Queens can eliminate lower ranks with ease, stealing their pawns in the process.
ELO Ranking System: Show off your skills as you earn or lose ELO points based on your performance. Rise through the ranks, earn prestigious titles like CM, FM, IM, and GM, and compete against the best in the live leaderboard.
Endless Strategies: Whether you prefer stealth, aggression, or calculated moves, each match presents a unique opportunity to refine your strategy. Form alliances, betray friends, and adapt to an ever-changing battlefield.
Are you ready to step into the arena of Knightfall Showdown? Gather your wits, collect your pawns, and prepare for the most exhilarating chess experience of your life. Can you rise to the top and become the last piece standing? The chessboard awaits!

title: MIRAI #167
description:
게임 정보
Join MIRAI #167 and Jonas, two characters separated by time but united in soul—switch between them to use each character’s unique abilities to overcome and defeat enemies.

title: Trauma - Visual Novel
Contract Rush DX
description:
게임 정보
Contract Rush DX (Also known as simply Contract Rush), is a hand-animated run and gun, with multiple playable characters and a focus on exploration and story! Complete Contracts and collect power-ups that strengthen you immensely, all culminating in massive boss fights! With inspiration from flash cartoons/games of the 2000s, the visuals are hand-animated with a sharp and bold style.






Taking on Contracts will have you exploring large levels, all with their own set of enemies, NPCs, and secrets!
Power-ups will prepare you for the Contract's boss battle at the end of the level. Power-ups can increase movement speed, spread-shot bullets, fire rate, and much more!


Sub-Contracts will have you taking on smaller challenge levels with a variety of objectives. Earn all 3 stars in each and get rewards!






, all with unique play styles. Some are focused on pure shoot'em up gameplay, others centered around melee attacks. If you're having trouble on a level, sometimes trying out a new character is the key!

title: Flea Madness
description:
게임 정보
HUNT. EAT. EVOLVE!
Join a team of alien fleas in this fast-paced game of maddening multiplayer melee mayhem! Choose your species, customize your abilities, and then hunt, eat, and squash your friends and frenemies in team play—or Flea for All, where there can Flea only one!

title: Space Chef
description:
게임 정보
모험이 가득한 풀코스 식사: 레스토랑 매니저, 가벼운 생존 RPG, 그리고 인생 시뮬레이션, 이 모든 것이 말굽 성운의 기이한 세계에서 펼쳐집니다. 직접 은하계 최고의 요리사가 되어 외계 행성에서 최고의 식재료를 찾아 맛있는 요리를 만들고.
외계 세계 탐험
재료의 세계는 끝이 없습니다... 재료가 먼저 당신을 잡아먹지 않는다면 말이죠. 먼 행성, 버려진 우주 정거장, 본인 소유의 지하실을 탐험하며 식물과 동물, 그 밖의 맛있는 먹거리를 찾아보세요.
탐험하는 길에 우주 해적도 만나고, 고대 유적이나 최근에 버려진 것으로 의심되는 레스토랑도 발견하게 될 겁니다. 장비, 주방용품, 우주선을 업그레이드하는 데 사용할 수 있는 희귀 자원(및 다양한 잡동사니)이 있는지 잘 살펴보세요.
각양각색의 우주 요리 만들기
냉장고에 (아마도 거의) 꿈틀거리지 않는 재료가 가득 찼다면 이제 접시를 꺼내 서빙할 차례입니다!
간단한 가정식 비플 꼬치구이부터 전설적인 까다로운 옥토에그 서프라이즈까지 140가지가 넘는 다양한 요리를 만들어 보세요. 맛있는 음식과 빠른 서비스로 손님에게 놀라움을 선사하세요. 은하계 최고의 요리사가 되기 위한 여정을 기념하는 아스트로노미컬 컬리너리 엑설런스 스타즈를 획득할 수 있습니다.
명성이 높아질수록 손님이 몰려들기 시작합니다! 배달 서비스를 계속하거나, 손님이 끊이지 않는 식당을 오픈하는 등 유연하게 사업을 운영하세요. 모험을 떠나고 싶을 때면 언제든지 주방을 닫을 수 있습니다.

title: Lazy Jiangshi
description:
게임 정보


Yuriko dreams of taking over the world by creating her own army of zombies, for which she has acquired textbooks on black magic and necromancy on the Internet. It’s all for one single purpose: she doesn't want to go to study every day.

The young necromancer had already created one jiangshi, Mao, but she was too lazy. Mao tries to do nothing and constantly follows orders in such a way that it would be better if the master didn't command anything. And instead of taking over the world, they are both loafing around for days on end!

Their lazy lifestyle gets disrupted when Yuriko's parents call and promise to deprive her of pocket money if she doesn't start studying properly. The girl is horrified because then she would have to leave the rental apartment and move into a dormitory.

Yuriko has one month to solve the problem. To do so, she needs to take over the world or improve her grades at university. Which will she choose?
Features:
A funny story for about ~4 hours of reading
Visual Novel with choices
High-quality anime-style graphics
Screen resolution Full HD 1080p

title: Mechanical Keyboard Building Simulator
description:
게임 정보







PCB 납땜과 스위치 수리부터 까다로운 고객을 위한 맞춤형 기계식 키보드 제작까지 나만의 기계식 키보드 제국을 건설하여 최고의 기계식 키보드 빌더가 되세요.








기계식 키보드 빌드 시뮬레이터는 실제 제조업체의 방대한 실제 부품 컬렉션을 살펴볼 수 있도록 초대합니다.
은행 계좌를 깨뜨릴 위험 없이 어떤 특별한 기계식 키보드를 현실로 만들 수 있을까요?






나만의 기계식 키보드를 만든다는 생각에 겁이 나시나요?
기계식 키보드 조립 시뮬레이터는 가장 경험이 없는 키보드 애호가도 올바른 순서로 부품을 조립할 수 있도록 단계별 지침을 제공하도록 설계되었습니다. 각 부품과 그 용도에 대한 귀중한 통찰력을 발견하고 꿈의 키보드를 현실로 만들 수 있는 자신감을 얻으세요.

title: Flower in Us
description:
게임 정보
사람 속에 피는 꽃(Flower in Us)은 스토리 중심의 단편 미스터리 어드벤처 게임입니다.

당신은 누군가의 습격으로 쓰러져 기억을 잃었습니다. 정신을 차려 보니 당신은 어딘가의 지하실에 갇혔고, 눈 앞에는 기둥에 묶여 있는 소녀가 있습니다. 당신은 이 소녀를 기억하지 못하지만, 그녀는 당신이 누군지 아는 눈치입니다.

지하실 공간 안을 둘러보며 주변에 놓여 있는 사물을 조사하고, 이 상황을 타개할 단서를 찾아보세요. 잘 모르겠는 것이 있다면 소녀에게 다가가 질문해보세요. 뜻밖의 수확이 있을지 모릅니다.

과연 당신은 소녀와 협력하여 지하실의 윤회에서 벗어날 수 있을까요? 그리고 소녀의 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내고, 소녀와 진실된 관계를 꽃피울 수 있을까요?
특징
한정된 공간 속에서 전개되는 이야기
대화 기반의 인터랙티브 픽션
미려한 일러스트와 픽셀 아트
몰입감 높은 음향 효과와 사운드트랙
단서 수집 및 문제풀이 중심의 미니 게임
autokwd: Flower in Us,사람 속에 피는 꽃

title: SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim
description:
게임 정보
You opened your eyes to find a giant girl looking down at you...

SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim is an adventure game set in 2000s Japan about the lives of Saeko, a girl with mysterious abilities, and the little people she has shrunk to the size of her thumb. Experience Saeko's and the little people's fates in the day and at night, through two separate game systems with different art styles.

You are Rin, the latest addition to the little people. Under Saeko’s protection, you spend your days in her desk drawer together with the other little people.
But don't let your guard down. Saeko has some...interesting hobbies, to say the least.
Features
Stunning and unique visuals drawn in two different styles of pixel art
A world filled with brutal allure inspired by many strange tales, beginning with Fueti Shizue’s work
An original game system which forces players to make difficult choices and live with the consequences
A soundtrack heavily influenced by future garage and breakcore, composed by the developer himself
The deepest journey into a developer’s proclivities in indie game history
Game System
Saeko has entrusted you with the role of supervisor.
In the day, you distribute items to the little people and interact with them, keeping the group together. However, you are no ordinary supervisor.



Each little person has two stats: Health and Appeal. These stats determine whether they will live or die. Give items to the little people in the drawer to manage their stats and make a certain...wish...of Saeko's come true.



At night, you come out of the drawer and become Saeko's confidante. Listen to anything she has to say and reply with a "Yes" or "No" as appropriate.



But be careful. Human life has much less weight to it when you are only the size of a thumb.
If you give the wrong answer, you'll soon find yourself meeting a bad end.



How long can you keep up your role as the supervisor? How many more days can you survive? And when you find yourself in a position to sway their destinies, who will you decide to save?

title: Thalassophobia
description:
게임 정보
Team up in Thalassophobia, a 4-player co-op horror game where you descend into the ocean's depths to uncover sunken secrets and survive the terrors lurking below.

title: Soul Devourer
description:
게임 정보
The Cursed School
After a catastrophic thunderstorm, an ancient curse descends, transforming Sakuradoki High School into a living hell. The awakened survivors gradually lose their sanity, their souls are devoured by desire and fear, turning them into bloodthirsty and brutal monsters...
Parry, Slash and Survive!
Soul Devourer is a metroidvania action-platformer with a striking anime horror art style. Explore the cursed Sakuradoki High School, master powerful abilities, battle twisted monsters, and uncover the long-buried dark secrets hidden beneath the school.
Game Features
Sekiro-inspired Parry System: Actively parry enemy attacks, expose their weaknesses, and unleash a powerful counterattack!
Twisted Monsters: Fight against over 70 twisted monsters, each with unique behaviors and attacks. And challenge over 10 ferocious bosses, exploit their weaknesses, defeat them and get unique abilities!

title: 500 CALIBER CONTRACTZ
description:
게임 정보
KILLING IS EASY
500 Caliber Contractz is a momentum-based 3D-Platformer in which you play as a contract killer hired via crowdfunding to murder CEOs, Disgraced Sinister Ex-Doctors, Private-Prison-Owning DJs, etc. With your handy high caliber sniper rifle and a chest full of anxiety, you can and will propel yourself to where you need to be. Collect tokens that float around for a reason I haven't bothered coming up with and then murder your target. Do it. Please.
MORE DETAILZ
In this game you are given a large variety of moves and plopped into an open level to explore as you please. Each level contains multiple contracts that each have their own unique target as well as a few extra tasks to complete. There is also a bunch of things to collect including Assassin Tokens, Money$$$, and a bunch of outfits for the main character, including some cameos from games made by my friends :O
FEATUREZ
About 3 Levels
Multiple Contractz Per Level
A bunch of cool outfits
Lil cigarette guys you can shoot
Maybe some secrets idk
CREDITZ:
