이 인생 시뮬레이션에서 당신은 인재를 찾고, 일정을 관리하고, 예산을 편성하고, 소셜 미디어를 계획하고, 음악과 패션을 선택하는 강력한 관리자입니다!

차기 K팝 아이돌 그룹 데뷔!


연습생을 선택하세요.


각 연습생은 고유한 특성과 배경 이야기를 가지고 있습니다.
팬들을 열광하게 만들지만 그룹을 망칠 수도 있는 건방진 나쁜 여자를 선택하시겠습니까?
아니면 그녀가 무대에 설 준비가 되기 전에 조금 더 격려가 필요한 수줍은 노래 새와 함께 갈까요?
이 게임에서 당신은 그들의 노래를 듣고, 그들의 성격을 이해하고, 그들의 강점을 찾아 힘을 실어줍니다!
다양한 아이돌 그룹을 모으는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다!
autokwd: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut

title: Neebota: Zeebo's Nightmare
description:
게임 정보
ENTER ZEEBO'S NIGHTMARE
Zeebo wakes up multiple times at night after the most bizarre dream where his body painfully morphs. Home alone, he mourns his parents' recent death with only his best friends and pet Hekke by his side. But no one knows just why his nightmares are this intense. As he receives a dream helmet and dream controller through his best friend Laurencia, Zeebo now has the tools to take control of his dream...and find out what's happening to him.
INTO THE FRAY
A dungeon-crawling action-RPG in a surreal nightmare with mind-bending levels and surreal events. Rich in lore, it's set in an entirely original fantasy world called Neebota. Face bizarre creatures as well yourself in different forms, as you transform yourself to gain new abilities and defeat the worst demons haunting Zeebo's mind in a quest to overcome the self.

title: Poison Noir: Desire
description:
게임 정보
Poison Noir: Desire, Time & Gangsters is an animated visual novel with a captivating fantasy theme. Immerse yourself in a rich, multilayered narrative where desire, time, and danger intertwine in a world of gangsters, secrets, and uncertain fates.
In the 90s, for the shy Jake—a gamer and noir novel enthusiast—and his brave friend Lucy, their small hometown holds no future. Seeking new opportunities in the city, Jake begins a romance with Nina, a wealthy and fascinating girl, but one who is also unsettling and full of secrets.
Their relationship becomes complicated when Jake suffers from a strange illness—poison, madness, or something even darker? With each episode, he is thrust between two different eras, stripped of his memories, unable to distinguish reality, and feeling as if a faceless destiny is pulling the strings of his fate.
Trapped between the seemingly harmless modern world and the violent, ruthless gangster underworld of Prohibition, Jake must confront not only a powerful and merciless enemy but also a painful journey of self-transformation. Surrounded by danger and horror, he becomes entangled in brutal mafia wars as well as sinister mysteries beyond his comprehension.
To protect those he loves, he will fight against his hallucinations and fears, struggle with the terrifying suspicion that nothing is as it seems, and be tormented by the collapse of the sacred values he once held dear. But his greatest challenge in this web of time and fate will be to find, among countless paths, the one that leads him back to sanity, love, and the Light. But… how can he be sure he's making the right choice?

title: Keepsake County
description:
게임 정보


We’ve added a huge update to Keepsake County’s demo, showcasing a brand new, never-before-seen heist (plus two classics), as well as 3 new enemies! Just for Steam Stealth Fest!

Burgle the Architect, the man responsible for Keepsake County’s strange, maze-like homes who lives on the edge of a huge swampy lake across from a guest house. Why’s he so paranoid? And why does he keep looking up at the sky?
Dodge the Pizza Guy, tiptoe past Hounds, and evade the Detective on your tail!
Play a shiny new tutorial that carefully guides new players to greatness.
Mantling, for scampering through the rooms and up the pipes of hoarders!
Twitch Integration, where viewers can prank streamers, or help them pull off amazing heists.
More story than ever, plus loads of new goofy and midwestern voice acting!
Loads of bugfixes and improvements.



Burglarize hideous farmhouses in the middle of nowhere and get outta dodge.

You have moments before the cops arrive to rob a procedurally-generated house that you've never seen before. If you're caught, residents will call the police even sooner... or take the law into their own hands.

title: Interconnected Stories
description:
게임 정보

In each chapter of the story, you will have at your disposal a wide variety of cards with certain actions, with which you will have to help the characters involved to achieve their dreams at that moment. However, the way to fulfill these dreams will be at your whim, being able to generate really bizarre situations. In addition, you will also have in your hand the possibility of looking for alternative stories even more interesting than the original...




- Place the cards on the board to help our friendly characters in their mission
- Unlock dozens of action cards, all of them customized for the different characters
- Enjoy a wide variety of chapters, which can be solved in different ways
- Take advantage of free mode to create your own stories without the restrictions of the main mode




A great variety of characters will appear in the story, some with more relevance than others, but all with an distinctive essence:
- Carapán: a young 216-year-old dragon who, contrary to the traditions of his family, wants to dedicate himself to what is his true passion in life: the bakery.
- The Knight of the Iguana: a small town boy who has launched himself in search of adventure along with his secret weapon, which makes him immortal... at least as far as he has proven.
- Lúa: from a noble family, this astrologer has become a royal advisor fighting against imposed stereotypes, although she has an important private matter that keeps her busy...
- And more to discover! A princess, a ghost minstrel, an evil monster...

title: DEATHGRIP
description:
게임 정보
DEATHGRIP invites the player to the jump in the pilot's seat of some of the fastest and most lethal hovercrafts ever seen and dominate the tracks they compete on. Navigate natural environments through split paths, twists, turns, jumps, shortcuts, and narrow corridors in an intense race to the finish.

DEATHGRIP introduces a depth to its racing controls that challenges the player to explore the skill ceiling. From afterburner allowed at any time to pitching, rolling, drifting, repairing, managing heat, and firing weapons, one should take pride in their ability to master a racer.

It is an experience meant to be visceral, brutal, exciting, and intense, centered on offering players instant enjoyment without gimmicks and an extended sense of achievement for those competitive and dedicated enough to get the most out of the game.


The base release will include (at a minimum) the following features:

8 Unique Racers
All racers share the same functionality, but each has it's own strengths and weaknesses to suit different playstyles.

10 Distinct Tracks
Race across 10 environments on 10 tracks over terrain filled with obstacles, jumps, drops, shortcuts, multiple paths, and other challenges.

Combat Racing
Race against AI with offensive and defensive armaments. Outfit your racer with cannons, shotguns, missiles, countermeasures, and more. Witness the carnage as the track turns into a battlefield.

Time Trials and leaderboards
Best times across the game are saved as ghosts. Compete against your own times, challenge the ghosts of your friends or compete those of the top ranking players on the leaderboards.


Earn credits from winning and spend them on visual and performance upgrades to suit your playstyle. Choose from multiple parts to spec out your racer for speed,


Prove yourself by winning trophies and claiming tops ranks.

title: DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're In Love
description:
게임 정보
DokiToki is a first-person puzzle game about manipulating time to solve escape-the-room style puzzles. Players need to freeze, unfreeze, and manipulate objects in time to reach each level's exit and progress through school.
Stopping time......with the power of love!
Play as Ai, a girl who's so hopelessly in love, it feels like everything around her is stopped in time. Traverse Ai's school, hopping from hallway to hallway and clearing each classroom in search of the boy Ai wants to confess to.
Toy with time
Use a collection of various tools each affecting time in different way. Some let you manipulate frozen objects, others will send items flying when unfrozen. Put each time-manipulating tool to use to solve each puzzle!
autokwd: DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're In Love

title: My Own Murder
description:
게임 정보
After yet another night of brooding over his wife's murder, Edgar McGee receives a mysterious letter under the door of his private investigator's office. Rising music star Minnie Williams has asked you to investigate her “own murder”.
Plunge into the gloomy San Antonio of the 70s, search multiple locations, solve puzzles and interview the victim's relatives to uncover the killer's identity! Will you be able to unravel the truth from the lies?
Play the role of a disillusioned private detective. Since your wife's murder almost 3 years ago, you've been a shadow of your former self. Spending your nights re-examining the report on the investigation into her murder, you're on the verge of going out of business.
So when Minnie Williams asks you to investigate her own murder, you can't afford to miss the opportunity to remake yourself and solve the case.

title: Project: Aurora
description:
게임 정보
Project: Aurora는 기지 건설, 생존과 자원 관리, 독특한 공상과학 스토리라인을 결합한 행성 탐사 게임입니다.
당신은 새로 발견된 행성의 표면에 착륙하는 연구 임무의 선장입니다. 당신의 임무는 임무를 수행하고, 시설을 관리하고, 오로라의 미개척 지역 깊숙이 탐사대를 조직하는 것입니다. 당신은 행성의 과거에 대해 알아내고 마지막 흔적이 이해할 수 없는 경보 신호였던 잃어버린 원정대의 흔적을 찾아야 합니다.
생존
외계 행성에서 연구 프로그램을 운영하게 됩니다. 보급품과 시설 개발뿐만 아니라 승무원의 생명도 돌봐야 합니다. 외계 행성을 연구하는 것은 위험한 일이라는 것을 기억하십시오. 각 승무원은 아프거나 부상을 입거나 사망할 수도 있습니다.
실제 샌드박스

title: DoubleWe
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 출시 시점부터 한글로 번역되어 있지는 않을 것입니다. 대신, 찜하기 수치를 확인하면서 가장 많은 관심을 보이는 언어부터 순서대로 번역을 진행할 예정입니다. 관심이 있으시다면 저희가 알 수 있게 찜 목록에 추가해 주세요!
진정한 편집증을 경험하세요
당신이 가장 취약할 때를 노려 당신을 죽이려는 클론들이 군중 속에 숨어 있습니다. 탄약이 한정적인 무기와 함께 수백 명의 얼굴을 신중하게 살펴가며 당신의 클론을 찾아내세요. 언제나 뒤를 조심하세요. 사방에 위험이 도사리고 있습니다!
생물학적 공포에 맞서세요
로그라이트 게임을 진행해 나가면서 주변의 세상이 변하는 것을 경험하게 됩니다. 이야기가 진행됨에 따라 새로운 클론, 새로운 적, 새로운 위험이 생겨나며, 이 위협을 극복할 새로운 전술을 개발하지 못한다면 생명을 위협받게 될 것입니다.

title: Scottside
description:
게임 정보
You are new to our town, right? You seem to attract trouble to yourself. Strange things started to happen with your arrival: Some kids told me about seeing a monster in the forest, and my best friend noticed a girl crying every evening in the neighbor's house. And it's said a creepy circus is going to come to our town. Our home robots are acting strangely. But what's the most mysterious, is that children started missing one by one, and no one seem to notice, as if they have never even existed. Let's try to find them together? But don't tell the adults! They won't believe us anyway, they'll say we're imagining things. So, what do you think, are you in?

«Scottside» – is a thriller nonlinear visual novel. The story takes place in the alternative version of 1980-s, where technological development is faster than you can imagine. A small provincial town surrounded by mountains and a dense pine forest appears to be quite a boring place. However, things change when you find a strange object in the forest. Inexplicable events start to happen in the town and you find yourself involved in an adventure. The adventure where every decision you make has consequences, defining your destiny.

5 episodes are planned to be released, all of which are connected, although they differ by a unique atmosphere.

title: Gemwielders
description:
게임 정보
You are a Gemwielder, capable of controlling ancient artifacts called Gembearers. Powerful by themselves, only by socketing them with magical gems will you acquire unique abilities that allow you to prevail in a duel with another Gemwielder.
Multiplayer Deckbuilder
Gemwielders condenses the deckbuilding experience into intense card battling duels against your friends and players around the world.
Replayability
Each game you adapt to the cards that appear and craft a new deck with a unique color combination. No two games are the same and whoever seizes the opportunities presented to them best, will be rewarded.
Interaction
Gemwielders is designed around interaction from the ground up. The innovative combat system allows the attack and defense cards to clash each turn and interact meaningfully.
Free Demo
The playable demo features local multiplayer and a single player mode to learn the game and unlock achievements climbing the Student Ranks.
Release
The full game release is scheduled for 2025, introducing online multiplayer, more playable characters and new gem types. After release, new content will be added regularily.
Testimonials
“A Crossover between TCGs and PC Games like Slay the Spire. Awesome game with seemingly unending depth.” – Modin
“Very fun, even after many many games.” – Jakob
“The deck building mechanic is very exciting and sets Gemwielders apart from other games that inspired it like Magic: The Gathering, evening the playing field and making for a different game each time!” – aetios

title: Spice Sacrifice
description:
게임 정보
Spice Sacrifice is a JRPG style game with randomized action-platformer battles.



Travel through an underworld full of caves of guts and bones, or goo and piercings or other fantastical stuff. But watch out for the spice that permeates the air, it will transport your character's minds to a dimension full of dangerous beasts that they must fight. Not to mention all the other dangers that keep getting people killed in gruesomely bizarre ways.

Two of the main characters are Oregano - the anxious wreck who must rescue his boyfriend, and Yonko Donko - the punk donkey with amnesia. The story will feature themes of sexuality, mental health, queer comradery, and finding a sense of place in a hostile world.



Outside of battle, Spice Sacrifice plays like a JRPG with in-depth story segments, towns, dungeons, managing equipment and items, leveling up and collecting things, and minigames.

Travel the overworld to find and hang out with various NPC's and grow friendships with them and advance the story. The gameplay has lots of intertwining systems to keep everything deep and addicting.



When you enter a battle, the game becomes an action-platformer with completely randomized levels. A random-gen system makes each screen unique, with random wall layouts, enemy placements, powerups, etc. Avoid the enemy's spells and use a variety of high-impact attacks to survive.
The game has an ensemble cast of playable characters and NPCs, such as:






A few accessibility options we'll include:

title: Memory Adventures in the Jungle
description:
게임 정보
Dive into an amazing world of fantasy and adventure with our game ! Test your memory and concentration as you explore a jungle full of cute and funny animals ... and a lot of secrets !
In this casual and fun challenge, you'll need to find matching cards and connect the pairs. With its randomly generated levels and engaging gameplay, this game is the perfect way to unwind and sharpen your skills.
Whether you're a fan of light-hearted fun or a thrilling mental test, this game can give you hours of amazing entertainment. Try it now and experience an awesome card-matching adventure in the wild !

title: Buoy
description:
게임 정보
Fight the undead or learn all the ways to sneak and hide among them. Dig through the ruins of the Old World and complete missions from different factions and survivors to earn valuable resources. Risk life and limb to protect those in need, or brutally kill anyone who gets in your way. Destroy both the dead and the living with an arsenal of melee, ranged, and makeshift weapons. Crawl along the ruined streets in search of supplies and secrets.

title: Elemental Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
Elemental Labyrinth는 픽셀 아트 타워 디펜스 게임으로, 전장을 직접 구성하고 전투의 흐름을 조종할 수 있습니다. 적들의 경로를 결정하는 미로를 만들고, 무작위 원소 정령을 소환한 뒤 강력한 형태로 융합하여 끊임없이 몰려오는 적의 파도를 막아내세요.
각 정령은 고유한 능력을 지니고 있으며, 전략적으로 조합하여 강력한 시너지를 만들어야 합니다. 다양한 배치와 정령 조합을 실험하며 최적의 방어 전략을 찾아보세요!
레트로 감성의 픽셀 아트, 깊이 있는 전술적 게임 플레이, 그리고 무한한 전략적 가능성을 갖춘 Elemental Labyrinth는 타워 디펜스 장르에 신선한 변화를 가져옵니다. 당신의 미궁이 시간의 시험을 견뎌낼 수 있을까요?
🏗️ 나만의 미로를 건설하세요

title: Demon Source
description:
게임 정보
Jump to the pit, die - repeat!
Demon Source is a roguelike adventure about one of the last Source Hunters.
Explore the vast procedurally generated dungeons. They are generated with pre-made prefabs with 3 variations of enemy spawn. So you will always have the pleasure of being scared entering each location.

Find skills and items and be killed by various enemies. Then hunt them in your run of revenge. Try new builds and strategies every new run and be bamboozled by unexpected enemy hiding by the corner. Collect the Source energy from dead enemies to unlock new weapons and abilities. 30+ unique weapons, 20+ skills, 40+ armors and rings are waiting for you.

Seek for story and lore? I have some!
Deep down the Ulm rock dwarves found the relic of great power. Demonic power. Very soon hordes of demons and possessed undeads were marching through the Lavert Kingdom.
Heroes of the past had stopped them, but they couldn’t destroy the Source. Inside the Ulm mountain this power was able to reshape dungeons to an endless labyrinth full of creatures of the dark. It also was able to revive demons countless times so they can’t be really killed.
Some heroes drink demon blood in order to receive same power. Those who did not died, went deeply to the old dwarf kingdom in order to find and destroy Demon Source.

You don’t remember how have you got to that dungeon. But it is clear that you are immortal such as those demons. Every time you die, the dungeon reshapes and all demons revive. Source doesn’t want to be found and doesn’t want you to go back. People of the past were optimistic about that - saying that now they have countless attempts. But now they are all mad and became corrupted guardians of the Source. So I wish you don't get crazy.

Try this game made with all passion just by single person. And let me to tell you the story of redemption which you will probably experience on yourself in the future. Try the Demon Source

title: Slumhack
description:
게임 정보
Slumhack is a puzzle-platformer game featuring indirect character control.
Play as Neriko, a girl living in a near-future slum with a virtual friend, and hack your way through the streets of Cynorm.
Make smart use of a variety of Action Buttons and guide Neriko to the goal!

title: Dice A Million
description:
게임 정보
You like big numbers? Sure, got you covered.
Dice A Million is a roguelike deckbuilder about rolling dice to try and get to a million points. Combine the effects of more than 100 different dice and discover powerful synergies. Get through ever-increasing debts and fearsome bosses that will require a perfect symbiosis in your deck in order to be beaten.
Will you be able to push luck to your side?
Features
Randomly generated runs, roguelike style!
More than 100 dice with unique effects

title: Agent Simulator
description:
게임 정보



Agent Simulation is an action, simulation, and strategy game in which each player shows their targeting skills and agility against enemies in a virtual environment. At the end of each mission, you will collect medals and earn various certificates with these medals. At the end of the game, these certificates will prove your strength as an agent and help you to receive your agent license.
In each level of the ‘Agent Simulation’, you will be evaluated according to your targeting skills. Before the limited time provided ends, you must kill all your enemies. Every successful head shot will get you more points! Of course, if you say ‘I am not that good’ and use up your time, you need to start over. Sorry for that! Sometimes you will be asked to complete the missions in such a limited time, you have to be fast and agile! It is a great environment to test yourself, is it not? You can skip the levels that you could not complete and still advance in the game. But it does not sound that great, right? We are talking about being an agent in here.
There will be three options offered in each level and those options will constantly change! For example, double bullets, double damage, slowing time down, blocking bullets or extra life, etc. You can strategize using any of these options! If you would like, you can repeat any level to test and improve your skills.
When you complete all levels of a lesson, you will receive an overall score including all points and medals you earned in that lesson. If your overall score is not high enough to move on to the next lesson, we regret to inform you that you have to work harder and spend more time by repeating all low scored levels. Do not forget that it is not easy to train an agent!
Earning enough certificates will allow you to receive your agent license at the end. According to your license score, you can see where you are in the world ranking or within your friends.
Fight to be the best!

title: Last Words
description:
게임 정보
Last Words is a game of social deception based on the Prisoner’s Dilemma philosophical theory. Are two individuals more likely to work together, or betray the other to make things better for themselves? Stuck in the past (or is it the future?) after your time machine inevitably breaks, you must work together with your fellow imprisoned time traveler to get out. You’ll both profit if you make it out together. But…
What if you betrayed them and seized the loot all for yourself along with a new ride home stranding them? After all, your goal is to amass a collection, not help rival explorers make a greater name for themselves. On the other hand, what if they are preparing to do the exact same thing to you? Can you afford to risk your own survival and a potential partnership?
Work together with the other stuck in time prisoner to escape this predicament.
Unlock perks, consumables, and tricks to synergize on both of your escape plans.
Trust in your sudden ally, prepare for his sudden, but inevitable betrayal, or plot their downfall first before they can even consider it.
[/list]
Customize your time traveler with the aforementioned perks, consumables, and other tricks unlocked in your travel.
Put the spoils of time travel collecting to use by changing your explorer’s appearance and personal hideout.
Flaunt your achievements and shiny accolades, but don’t get too cocky or they might be tempted to try and steal it for themselves.

title: TOCOViX
description:
게임 정보
TOCOViX is a turn-based strategy game where 2-4 players take turn to place Crosses on the game board. The goal of the game is to combine Crosses to create "Shapes", which award points and "Stops". The purpose of Stops is to hinder opponents by preventing them from completing Shapes. A player is unable to move when all of the boxes on the board surrounding their Crosses are already occupied. The match is over when all players are unable to move or when the last standing player has more points than the others.
Levels
Choose between 10 levels with 3 different starts each. As you progress with the game levels get more complex.
Tutorials
From the Main Menu you can access tutorials with a detailed description of every game mechanic. Each explanation is made of both text and animations and can be interrupted at any moment.
TOCOViX comes with hard challenges which range from winning all levels against the CPU to conquering a certain number of boxes in a single match. Complete a challenge to obtain a Trophy and obtain all Trophies to unlock a special Cross!
Thanks to dedicated servers you can challenge other players from around the world! Every time you complete a match online you are awarded or deducted points from your online score. Challenge other players to rise through the ranks and enter the Diamond League!

title: Age Of Blocks
description:
게임 정보
In Age of Blocks, gathering resources and mining blocks are at the heart of your kingdom’s survival and expansion. Send your workers to chop down towering trees for wood, harvest bushes and catch fish to keep your army fed, and mine precious gold to fund your growing empire. Every resource plays a vital role, fueling construction, recruitment, and technological advances. As you collect blocks from the voxel-based world, you'll unlock the power to shape the land itself—place blocks to build walls, raise towers, and design your perfect stronghold. Whether you're fortifying defenses or expanding your city, mastering resource collection and block placement is key to defending Azuria!
Building your civilization is a journey of strategy and creativity. With 13 unique types of buildings at your disposal—from humble houses and bustling farms to powerful barracks and advanced research centers—you'll shape a thriving kingdom tailored to your playstyle. As your city grows, unlock a wide range of technologies that boost your economy, strengthen your armies, and unlock new tactical possibilities. Advance through different ages of civilization to gain access to more powerful structures, elite units, and game-changing upgrades. Every decision you make brings you one step closer to turning your fledgling settlement into the most formidable empire in all of Azuria!
Leading your army into battle is where your strategy truly comes to life. Train and command a diverse roster of units such as fearless Footmen, swift Lancers, and devastating Warhounds on the front lines. Rain arrows from afar with Longbowmen and Crossbowmen, or unleash heavy siege power with Catapults, Rams, and the deadly Scorpio. Dominate the seas with powerful Galleons and Scorpio Ships, transport your troops across the map with Transport Ships. Monks can provide crucial support on the battlefield, turning the tide with healing. As you research new technologies, your units become stronger, faster, and deadlier, giving you the edge you need to crush your enemy.

title: Furcifer's Fungeon
description:
게임 정보
Choose from hundreds of unique talents and many spells and items.
Shape your talent tree with your choices.
Be a necromancer, a knight, an electro wizard, or just a pyromaniac!
Highly customizable loadout (over 1 million starting configurations)
Characters with unique abilities and talents can freely switch between different spell sets!

title: Live Hard
description:
게임 정보
에일리언 군단이 지구를 침략하러 왔습니다!
민폐를 끼치는 손님에겐 무력으로 대응하는 게 지구 방식이죠?
여러분은 지휘관으로서 부대를 통솔하여 지금 당장 대량의 에일리언을 물리쳐야 합니다.
여러분의 부대에는 실력이 뛰어난 의사와 최첨단 의료 트럭뿐만 아니라 튼튼한 다리를 가진 귀여운 간호사도 있습니다!
우수한 대원도 많은데… 잠깐, 이 트럭은 6인승인가…? 그럼 대원은 6명입니다.
걱정 마세요! 중과부적이긴 하지만, 터프한 대원들은 싸우다 다쳐도 쉽게 죽지 않거든요!
치료만 하면 바로 전선으로 복귀할 수 있습니다. 다 같이 살아남아 전장에서 복귀하세요!
하지만 지구를 구하려면 다소의 희생은 필요할지도 모르겠네요.
게임 특징

・고양이도 있습니다. 찜 목록에 넣을 이유는 이걸로 충분한가요?
・용맹한 대원은 알아서 돌격합니다. 세세한 지시는 듣지도 않아요.
・총명한 닥터는 지시를 기다립니다. 트리아지는 여러분의 몫입니다.
・다양한 포탄을 대포로 쏠 수 있습니다. 전장에 포탄의 비를 내려 보세요.
・대량의 에일리언을 해부할 수 있습니다. 에일리언 박사가 되어 보세요.
・오리지널 화학 무기를 개발할 수 있습니다. 아마도 합법일걸요.
・대원은 몸을 개조할 수 있습니다. 팔을 총으로 개조하는 꿈도 이룰 수 있죠.
・고양이는 죽지 않습니다. 이걸로 걱정거리는 모두 해결되었네요!

※아직 개발 중입니다! 이 내용은 다소 변경될 수도 있습니다!
만약 고양이가 도망가면 꼭 알려 드릴 테니 안심하세요!

title: Frontier: Path of Shadows
description:
게임 정보
It’s the 25th century. Humanity is discovering new planets and settling across the galaxy. People who are tired of mundane everyday life flock to the Frontier – the borderline separating the civilized space from the unknown. Comfort and law are in short supply here, but fortunes await those who can deliver a new route, a rare plant, or someone else’s secrets.
When Jay agreed to deliver a suspicious cargo to a client, he thought it would be an easy way to make a quick buck. But what seemed like a simple job quickly turned into serious trouble. The mysterious crystal inside the box wasn’t just an object; it somehow communicated with him! Now, powerful figures lurking in the shadows are anything but happy about this unexpected turn of events. With their lives on the line, Jay and his team find themselves holding the fate of an entire sector in their hands.
TACTICAL COMBAT: The game's tactical battles use a point-and-link system, where both heroes and enemies move along a grid. With a procedurally generated map that adapts to the player's experience, every encounter presents a new challenge!
VIVID CHARACTERS: Each character has a unique past, distinct abilities, and a personalized skill tree. Build your ideal team and experience the world through their eyes.
EXPLORING NEW PLANETS: The Frontier is full of uncharted territories, and the Nebula of the Great Rift holds many secrets. Venture into the unknown, discover new planets, uncover their histories, and harvest valuable resources.
THE SYMBIOTE’S MYSTERY: What secrets lie within the small blue crystal? It reacts to Jay’s actions, displays signs of intelligence, and changes color in response. Study its behavior, uncover its logic, and unlock new possibilities.
EVERY CHOICE MATTERS: Every event in the game impacts the characters and the crystal. Whether you're strategizing in battle, forging relationships with factions, or negotiating with allies, remember: the fate of the sector rests in your hands.
A UNIQUE AUTHOR-CREATED SETTING: The game is set in the Frontier: Endless Space universe, a richly developed sci-fi world filled with diverse human cultures, advanced technologies, and uncharted planets beyond the settled territories. Perfect for sci-fi fans seeking deep lore and exploration.

title: Sokobos 2
description:
게임 정보
Sokobos 2 is a modern twist on the classic block-pushing formula, inspired by Greek tragedies. You must load all the vases into your cart, but the cart moves too.
Experience small and handcrafted puzzles focused on "aha!" moments with interesting interactions and clever solutions. Some objects can be pushed into water to create a bridge, while others float and drift away with the current.
Designed for both Sokoban newcomers and veterans alike! Sokobos 2 offers a unique twist and smooth learning curve that welcomes newcomers but respects their problem-solving later on.
Set in Ancient Greece. You have upset the Gods, and collecting the vases for eternity is your punishment.
Brief Summary
The cart isn't just a container, it's part of the puzzle
Beyond vases and the cart, interact with gates, pressure plates, water mechanics, and more
Minimalist 1-bit visuals keeping the focus on puzzle solving
Teaches new interactions clearly but trusts your problem-solving skills afterward
A story inspired by Greek tragedies

title: New Active Object
description:
게임 정보
New Active Object is a genre-hopping game and multimedia experience synced to the 40-minute genre-hopping Jay Tholen (Dropsy, Hypnospace Outlaw) album of the same name. Remember those auto-playing apps that would appear when you popped pretty much any big album from 1995-2002 into your CD-ROM drive? Remember amateur Klik & Play, The Games Factory, or Game Maker games from around the same time period? New Active Object is inspired by both.

While the game is only 40 minutes long (if you keep the pitch at 1.0) there are enough secrets and missable details to justify multiple playthroughs. This was an intentional choice designed to force unsuspecting gamers to become endeared to my music through mere exposure effect. Doubt it'll work but it's worth a shot.
New Active Object, the album, is a jazz/prog-infused concept album crafted using only* samples from the sound effect libraries of 1990s game-making software Klik & Play and The Games Factory. BOUNCE01.WAV, POP.WAV, CRASH1.WAV, THUNDER2.WAV, AIRBUGGY.WAV and ANAPHASE.WAV to name a handful.
Particularly charming sounds were used sans-manipulation (some posh guy sarcastically quipping "oh excellent"), while most others were prodded and cut-up and messed-with until they became something compositionally useful. Sometimes even pleasant. Nearly every sound contributes its own low bitrate hiss, lining New Active Object's music bed with an airy effervescence.
Guitar (Talha Kaya, David Brimer), Saxophone (Jake Xie, Juanig), Clarinet (Josh Plotner), and Flute (also Plotner) sections add to the vaporous atmosphere. John Ringhofer (Half-handed Cloud) lends bouncing backing vocals, trombone, and glockenspiel to two tracks. Christine Tholen (hi sis!) rounds out the features with her own beautiful vocal harmonies.
New Active Object is broadly about creativity, the limitations of software, and the limitations of the Earthly realm. The lyrics are from the perspective of a game object and its young aspiring maker. Occasionally said maker's Maker chimes in.

title: Vicious Cycle
description:
게임 정보
Vicious Cycle is a first person Horror game where you venture into a dark forest by bike and on foot. Brave hazardous trails on your bike until the path is blocked. Then, explore abandoned sites on foot while solving puzzles and encountering supernatural creatures. Can you survive the cursed forest?
Survive haunted trails
With only your Bicycle light as a guide, ride through forest trails filled with roadblocks and Creatures out to get you. Be wary of your surroundings as they can come from anywhere!
Investigate the eerie Forest
Venture into long abandoned areas of the forest where mysteries and danger await. Uncover the stories of the people that were once there.

title: Winter Clothing
description:
게임 정보
"겨울옷 축제"는 중국 민속을 소재로 한 공포 극의 수수께끼 풀이 게임인 톈허진에는 불문율의 규정이 있다: 한의절에는 어떤 촌민도 뒷산에 접근해서는 안 된다. 만약 이로 인해 어떤 산신야귀를 건드렸다면 청풍관의 도장들은 상관하지 않을 것이다.그러나 할아버지의 실종으로 진래는 산 아래로 내려갔다.산에 정말 귀신이 있습니까?혹시, 귀신보다 무서운 것도 있어.
본 작품은 중국 전통 명절인"한의절"을 인용하여 20여 년 전 톈허진에서 발생한 원한과 갈등을 여러분에게 알려드립니다.대량의 전통 민속 문화 요소, 예를 들면: 동물 선아, 초혼, 야간 시집, 종이 굽기, 빙의, 금기 등은 게임 줄거리와 수수께끼 풀이 단계에 융합되었고, 게임 장면에는 또 일부"문물 골동품"이 나타나 당신이 미혹을 풀 수 있도록 도와준다....
게임 특징
성전 앞까지 가면, 세 가지 향을 피우세요 - 중국식 민속 공포 미스터리 서사
폐쇄된 산촌에서 사람들의 신앙은 왕왕 상위자의 손에 장악된다.한때 마을 남항북에서 활약했던"대선아"는 더 이상 미진을 지적할 수 없었다. 만약 가택이 평온하려면 전 앞의 세 가지 향을 얻어"유원인"이 되어야 한다.
게이머가 연기한"진일"은"초혼"의 방법을 통해 고인의 망혼을 볼 수 있고, TA들이 당신에게 보여주고 싶은 옛일을 볼 수 있지만, 조심해야 한다. 반드시 당신이 보고 싶은 그 TA를 불러오는 것은 아니다....
당신 자신을 포함한 누구도 경솔하게 믿어서는 안 된다는 점에 유의하십시오 -  일부 줄거리는 실제 사건에서 각색됩니다.
그들은 다른 곳에서 왔고 육체는 이곳에 갇혔으며 영혼도 집으로 돌아갈 방향을 찾지 못했다."그들은 다른 곳으로 갔는데, 이곳은 고향도 아니고, 귀처도 아니다."가을밤 골목에서 바퀴가 흙길을 누르는 소리가 들려오니 내일은 또 시끌벅적한 하루가 될 것이다.

title: Her Love
description:
게임 정보


Ethel Briggs is a shy, self-conscious girl in her final year of university. Though she should be working on her thesis about Romantic poetry, her well of inspiration has run dry. After a nasty break-up with her former girlfriend, Clementine, Ethel is feeling very blue - and it certainly doesn't help that she's spending the winter holidays in the depressingly drab village of Oxbury, while her family are off holidaying in sunny Australia.

Left to her own devices, Ethel struggles to finish her thesis while the cold, wintry wind blows outside and the days continue to get shorter and darker.

Staying inside proves to be unbearable, however, and Ethel escapes the confines of her family's home for a breath of fresh air. Going for a walk in the woods should be enough to invigorate her, and fill her with newfound passion for Romanticism.

That was Ethel's plan, at least - but she wasn't counting on meeting a mysterious, dark-haired beauty in the woods, who is much more than she seems.


50,000 words of text (approx 2-4 hours of reading)
A linear story with only one ending
Original character and background art
An original soundtrack
A dark lesbian romance
Mild body horror elements
A creepy, unsettling atmosphere

title: 杰灵物语
description:
게임 정보
In "Jenin Story" you will gather and grow your Jenin squad. Get resources by auto battle, then use these resources to make your Jenin stronger, and then challenge more difficult scenarios, unlock and collect new Jenin.
Game Features
Collect and cultivate Jenin
Freely assign attribute points
Freedom to match Jenin's talent
Equipment system
Fusion Jenin
1.City
Blacksmith: Crafting equipment, talent scrolls
Furnace: Enhanced decomposition equipment
Hunting Lodge: Hunt and Get Jenin
Idol: Fusion of two Jenin with a chance of getting the legendary Jenin

title: The Mirrion
description:
게임 정보

귀중한 자원을 수집하고, 미개척 영역을 탐험하며, 생존을 위한 더 많은 기회를 잠금 해제하세요. 숲, 산, 그리고 숨겨진 동굴은 위협뿐만 아니라 도구 제작, 피난처 건설, 야생에서의 안전을 보장하는 필수 재료도 함께 갖추고 있습니다.
치명적인 위험과 무한한 가능성이 가득한 광대한 오픈 월드를 탐험하세요. 피난처를 구축하고, 자원을 수집하며, 기술과 창의성을 사용하여 생존 방법을 찾으세요. 각 발견은 이 가혹한 세계를 집으로 만드는 데 한 걸음씩 나아가게 됩니다.

야생에서 진정한 사냥꾼이 되세요: 먹이를 추적하여 음식과 귀중한 자원을 확보하세요. 작은 먹이에서 큰 포식자에 이르기까지, 모든 사냥은 전략과 정밀성을 요구합니다. 수집한 재료를 사용하여 무기와 도구를 제작하고 장비를 업그레이드하여 생존 확률을 높이세요.

title: Fungi Crossing
description:
게임 정보
This is a Fungi.
You will be playing as a group of them.
Fungi can cling to almost anything. as well as to each other.
as the Fungi you will to traverse terrain, solve puzzles, and find new and interesting ways to cling to each other to best the many challenges of the wastelands.

title: Entropia
description:
게임 정보
Immerses yourself in Paris at the dawn of the 20th century. The once-grand city is crumbling under the influence of a mysterious force that devours its buildings and inhabitants: The Entropy.
Despite the research of a consortium of scientists and engineers, the mystery deepens when metallic gardens begin to crystallize around strange trees with colorful reflections, emerging within the city’s ancient monuments.
This vegetation seems to be linked to Entropy, representing the last hope for the healing of both living beings and the planet. Léon’s journey becomes a quest to uncover the secrets of Entropy and, perhaps, save what remains of the world.
In this adventure game, exploration is at the heart of the gameplay. Traverse deserted streets and crumbling buildings, as Entropy gradually transforms your environment. Solve puzzles as you move through a city where each step brings you closer to the truth… or to destruction.

title: Infinite Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
Infinite Dungeon | A Pixel-Art Roguelike Deck-Building Adventure
▶ Play as the Underdog
You are a "villain" abandoned by fate, but this time, "courage" drives you to venture into the dungeon to save the world.
▶ Dynamic Battlefields
The "flow of time" mechanic shatters traditional deck-building rules—enemy moves, trap triggers, and even resource spawns evolve in real-time as the sands of time slip away. Every run is a brand-new puzzle to solve.
▶ Infinite Deck-Building Potential
Recruit unconventional allies like the Fallen Knight and Deceptive Warlock, each with hidden synergies.
Combine 100+ tactical cards.
Collect a variety of battle gear.
▶ The Final Challenge
How deep does the dungeon go? No one knows—but perhaps you can uncover the answer.
▷ Every Restart Is a Lesson Toward the Perfect Defeat ◁

title: POLY IMPULSE
description:
게임 정보
POLY IMPULSE is a minimalist fast-paced movement FPS where you will have to shoot colorful polyhedrons to impulse yourself through the level. Accuracy is also very important so you will put your aim to a test with this game!
Features:
• Shoot neon green icosahedron to impulse yourself and gain speed.
• Speedrun the levels and compete with yourself and the global leaderboard to prove that you are the number one.

title: Skingdom
description:
게임 정보
Create your own ski realm in Skingdom, a ski resort construction and management game! Arrange your resort, draw your slopes and build your lifts, hotels and shops. Take care of your budget, hire staff and invest in upgrades for your ski resort to reach the top of the mountain!
Build different lift types : ski lifts, chair lifts, gondola lifts and cable car lifts
Each lift type has its own characteristics. Speed, seats or maximum altitude, invest in the best lifts to outcome the mountain challenges.
Draw slopes for your guests, from easy green slopes in the forest for beginners to the hard slopes with bumps on the edge of the mountains for the most experienced skiers.
Build your resort by investing in housing to welcome your vacationers and shops to satisfy all their needs. But the mountain is not only skiing, movies, pools and other activities will allow your guests to relax after a long day of sports.

title: Karting of Banban
description:
게임 정보
Grip your steering wheel and join your favorite Banban characters in the race of a lifetime! Drift around tight corners and zoom through locations both old and new. Use power-ups and boosts to dodge your opponents and claim first place!
Race with Friends!
Play as your favorite Banban characters, each with their own unique features!
Race alone, or with other players!
Speed’s the Game!
Drift well and often to earn invaluable speed boosts!
Find the shortest route and beat your opponents to the finish line!

title: Hats and Guns
description:
게임 정보
Hats and Guns is a roguelite deckbuilder set in the Wild West. Play as different characters with unique gameplays. Upgrade your cards and collect powerful weapons and relics as you attempt to survive in the heart of a dangerous procedurally-generated desert.
Key features
Deckbuilding
Over 100 card upgrades to assign to 5 basic card types (accuracy, speed, dexterity, reflex and strength) to create powerful combos and optimize your deck.
4 playable characters
4 unique gameplay characters are available, each with a passive skill, a starting weapon and a unique starting deck.
Tactical combat
Combat is grid-based, and accuracy is the central system of combat. You'll need to pay close attention to your position, resources and accuracy management to maximize damage and stay alive in these challenging encounters.
Procedural desert and moral choices
Travel through the wilderness, meticulously choosing your path. Collect equipment to become more powerful and reach your goal, a fearsome gang leader!
Will you become as cruel as he is to get your revenge, or will you stay on the right path?

title: Alchemist Historical Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Alchemist Historical Simulator transports you to the heart of medieval science and mysticism, where you take on the role of an aspiring alchemist. In a world filled with both wonder and danger, you’ll balance the practical and the mystical as you uncover the hidden truths of alchemy.
Key Features:
Play as an alchemist in 18th century Paris.
Receive visitors in your home with an alchemy lab.
Study their symptoms and select medicines by studying the books of ancient healers.
Buy ingredients at the market, create your own, grow the necessary plants in your own garden
Craft medicines and potions from various ingredients, based on recipes.
Heal visitors and earn money from it.
Spend money on developing your own laboratory
Сollect bits of knowledge from ancient books and manuscripts of alchemists of previous generations, solve symbols, allegories and ancient riddles
Find the recipe for the Philosopher's Stone and be the first to create it
Additional features:
Day and Night Duality: By day, serve your town by healing people with carefully crafted potions and remedies. By night, conduct secret experiments in the pursuit of the elusive Philosopher's Stone and the mysteries of immortality.
Historical Accuracy: Delve into authentic medieval alchemical practices, study ancient texts, and encounter historical figures who shaped the field.
Branching Storyline: The path you choose will shape your destiny. Will you pursue alchemy for wealth, power, or the betterment of mankind?
Risk and Reward: Experiment with different ingredient combinations—reap the benefits of success or face dangerous, sometimes explosive, failures.
Puzzle-Based Discovery: Decipher cryptic manuscripts and solve alchemical riddles to unlock ancient knowledge.
Open-Ended Gameplay: Explore a detailed medieval world, filled with challenges, opportunities, and consequences, where your choices determine the outcome of your journey.

title: Moonsigil Atlas
description:
게임 정보
Play cards by positioning magic sigils on the crescent moon. There's no limit to how many cards you can play, as long as you have the space!
With three playable characters and hundreds of cards to choose from, there are countless possible decks with a variety of strategies and play styles.

title: Homeward
description:
게임 정보
Step into the world of Homeward!
As a rookie police officer, you’re tasked with much more than law enforcement. In this heartwarming 2D pixel art adventure, you’ll complete missions, solve mysteries, and help your neighbor, Jenny, find her missing cat, Mac. Explore a charming, open world full of engaging quests, delightful mini-games, and meaningful career choices that lead to multiple endings.
🔍 Explore a Vibrant Open World
Roam through bustling neighborhoods, peaceful parks, and lively locales as you interact with quirky characters and uncover hidden secrets. Every corner holds a new adventure! Take a break from missions, explore the map, or simply relax—there’s always something to discover.
🕵️‍♂️ Complete Engaging Missions
Take on diverse missions that test your detective skills. From solving petty crimes to helping locals with their everyday troubles, every choice matters!

title: Fear Academy
description:
게임 정보
에 Fear Academy, 퍼즐 해결은 Hillcrest High를 가로지르는 불안한 여정의 일부입니다. 어두운 복도를 지나며 끊임없이 누군가가 지켜보고 있다는 느낌에 긴장감이 감돌고, 그로 인해 가장 간단한 작업도 부담스럽게 느껴집니다. 각 퍼즐은 긴장이 가득한 환경에서 명확하게 생각해야 하는 도전을 제시합니다. 매 그림자와 먼 소리가 무엇인가 불길한 것을 숨기고 있을지 모르기 때문입니다. 당신은 퍼즐을 풀어 나아가기만 하는 것이 아니라 생존을 위해 풀게 될 것입니다. 고대의 악이 학교를 차지한 채, 매번 다음 코너에서 무엇이 숨어 있을지 의심하며 한 걸음 앞서 나가려고 애쓰게 됩니다.

title: HER TREES : PUZZLE DREAM
description:
게임 정보
HER TREES : PUZZLE DREAM은 물체를 움직이고 결합하여 퍼즐을 푸는 독특한 포인트 앤 클릭 퍼즐 게임입니다. 꿈속의 이상한 집의 비밀을 밝혀보세요.
이번 작품은 시리즈의 세 번째 작품이지만, 처음 접하는 플레이어도 독립된 작품으로 즐길 수 있습니다.
주요 특징:
40개 이상의 독창적인 퍼즐
꿈속의 이상한 세계와 이야기
번거로운 계산이나 메모 없이 직관과 관찰로 해결할 수 있는 퍼즐
일정 시간이 지나면 힌트와 정답 제공
플레이 시간 약 2-3시간
다양한 플레이어를 위한:
비언어적 게임
전편이 흑백으로 디자인되어 색각에 관계없이 해결할 수 있는 퍼즐
소리에 의존하는 퍼즐 없음

title: Dataclysm
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Dataclysm - A Digital-Fantasy Trading Card Game!
Embark on a journey into the heart of a digital kingdom unlike any other. Dataclysm invites you to explore a world where ancient data comes alive, and every line of code tells a story waiting to be unraveled. 
The Story Unfolds: Origins and Evolution
"Never search too deeply into the game's files: some information is perhaps better left hidden." - The URL
The story of Dataclysm begins in a basement, within an abandoned computer, where an unfinished game is left behind until an inexplicable event has awakened forgotten lines of code and given them consciousness. This convergence gave rise to diverse archetypes that quickly adapted to "life" on the Motherboard: mysterious SANDBAGS, ARMORER guardians, enigmatic MAGICIAN scholars, tribal RANGER adventurers, majestic DRAGONS, carefree UNDEAD, and many more.

title: Ad Astra Infinita: The New Evolution
description:
게임 정보
Ad Astra Infinita: The New Evolution is a punkish, sanboxy JRPG focused on mechanical exploration and light environmental storytelling.
Included:
10-20 hours of gameplay across seven or eight regions in the game world
20+ boss battles, some of which are challenging and/or have been tested, but all of which drop cool stuff
150+ Mutagenes to equip to your party, split across eight different categories such as Human Weapons, Mutant Weapons, Mentalities and Structures
150+ skills to use in battle, including physical attacks, Psionics, and Transcends
A fair amount of silly dialogue and environmental interactions, such as increasing or decreasing the number of corpses in a facility, going bowling, and quiz questions
50+ pieces of original music, including some that could be called headbangable slabs of riffage
Not included:
Original art
Cutscenes
Meticulously balanced gameplay
Base building
Much serious dialogue
Dating/Waifus
autokwd: Ad Astra Infinita: The New Evolution

title: Kickoff Land!
description:
게임 정보
Kick Off Land – Where Myth Meets Strategy!
Step into a world where legends come alive, and claim your place as the new king! Embrace your destiny to build and defend a flourishing city against relentless threats.
🌟 The Journey Begins: The New King – Manne
Start your adventure with the first chapter, "The New King: Manne," and unlock new chapters inspired by myths and legends from around the world!
🎯 Your Mission: Conquer, Defend, and Unlock
Seize the land, build a powerful city, and protect it from endless waves of enemies. Unlock powerful cards to strengthen your defenses and gain strategic advantages. Combine city-building skills with tower defense strategy to overcome every threat.

title: Desktop Survivors 98
description:
게임 정보
SURVIVE, EXPLORE, REPEAT
Survive against waves of enemies in quick, intense rounds as you explore the randomly generated dungeons. Your cursor becomes the hero, battling against foes in a bullet hell frenzy that tests your reflexes, precision, and decision-making.
PLAY ON YOUR DESKTOP
Whether you’re looking for a quick break or an extended challenge, Desktop Survivors 98 fits perfectly into your routine, overlaying directly on your desktop. With its short rounds and the ability to toggle the game on and off at any moment, you can step away, take a breather, and jump back into the action whenever you're ready.

title: RLLL: Tower of Choices
description:
게임 정보
로라라라: 선택의 탑은 파티 기반 RPG와 덱빌딩, 로그라이트 요소를 섞은 싱글 게임입니다. 플레이어는 주인공 캐릭터를 조종하여 여러 선택들과 마주하게 됩니다. 다양한 동료, 다양한 유물, 다양한 스킬을 습득하여 나만의 조합을 꾸리고 탑의 비밀을 파헤쳐보세요.
게임 특징
보드판과 주사위
본 게임은 주사위를 굴려 선택한 눈만큼 이동합니다. 이 주사위 시스템은 다양한 유물의 효과와 맞물려, 주사위를 추가하거나 역행하기도 하고, 특정 주사위를 고를 때 혜택을 얻는 등 단순히 다음 타일을 선택하는 것 이상의 흥미로운 플레이를 제공합니다.
autokwd: RLLL: Tower of Choices,로라라라: 선택의 탑

title: Bagdex
description:
게임 정보
《Bagdex》는 턴제 전투와 기지 건설이 결합된 RPG로, 환상적인 생명체 Bagmons가 등장합니다! 광활한 브라실리스 세계를 탐험하고, 자신만의 기지를 건설 및 맞춤 설정하며, 160종 이상의 독특한 생물을 발견하고 훈련하여 전투에서 승리하고 세계의 비밀을 풀어보세요.
시작 마을을 선택하고 자신만의 방식으로 다섯 개의 지역을 탐험하세요! 브라실리스는 신비로운 역사와 비밀이 가득한 땅으로, 개성 넘치는 트레이너들과의 전투, 탐험할 수 있는 고대 유적, 그리고 엄청난 비밀이 기다리고 있습니다!

title: Etaine : Magic Link Dungeon / 伊泰恩：魔链迷宫
description:
게임 정보
업데이트 03/06: 샐리의 새로운 캐릭터 초상화.
업데이트 03/06: 저장 시스템을 완성하고 캐릭터 초상화 및 기타 아트 리소스를 추가했습니다.
autokwd: Etaine : Magic Link Dungeon / 伊泰恩：魔链迷宫

title: Floorball Practice
description:
게임 정보
Floorball Practice
Step into the immersive world of Floorball Practice, the ultimate training ground for Floorball enthusiasts! Built on the cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5, this game pushes the boundaries of realism with ray tracing, lumen lighting, and detailed characters. Designed to fine-tune your Floorball skills, this Early Access title offers an open-world experience like no other—laying the foundation for the next phase in Floorball gaming.
Key Features
Explore an Open World
Travel through a sprawling open world featuring multiple Floorball halls connected by a train system. Venture into lush forests to jog or run, boosting your stamina while taking in stunning visuals across a dynamic weather system with a fully functioning day and night cycle.
Master Your Skills
Practice like a pro with objectives and skill-based activities designed to refine your Floorball techniques.
Practice shooting with customizable sticks, balls, rinks, goals, and Floorball fields—designed with gear you can unlock and arrange to your liking.
Unlock advanced animations and shooting finishes to perfect your style.
Customize Your Experience
Choose between male or female characters, with options for left- or right-handed playstyles.
Build your identity with a wide range of clothing, sticks, and training gear available through an in-game currency system.
Use the in-game phone system to order gear, set GPS destinations, manage playlists, and more.
Practice Alone or with a Friend
Switch seamlessly between first-person and third-person perspectives to fully immerse yourself in the action. Play solo, or share the Floorball journey with a friend or sibling in mode.

title: Through The Murky Water
description:
게임 정보
The vhs mockumentary underwater horror game.
Observe the environment of the station through the camera monitors.
Go into the depths of the ocean and explore the darkness of the depths.
Features
This game is an interactive horror mockumentary experience.
You will have to explore interactive materials, for example to conduct interviews.
Walk underwater, watch the cameras of the underwater station.
Come face to face with mysterious and frightening events that happened on the bottom of the ocean.

title: Rolly
description:
게임 정보
Rolly: 3D 물리 플랫폼 게임입니다.

Step into the shoes of Japanese Admiral Heihachiro Togo aboard his flagship battleship Mikasa and lead your fleet into battle against the Russian navy’s formidable squadrons of battleships, cruisers, and torpedo boats.

Walldive
Walljump
Wallflip
Roll
Flip

title: Eastern Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Eastern Tactics is a strategy RPG game set in the fictional backdrop of the Tang Dynasty. In the game, players control descendants of famous Tang Dynasty generals embarking on an adventurous journey. Utilizing diverse incarnate abilities and employing varied combat strategies, players aim to emerge victorious in battle challenges.

Game Features

Embark on an adventure: Experience a mysterious and grand adventure in a magical world where the fate of the world's peace lies in your hands.
Only incarnates can defeat other incarnates: Summon various incarnates with unique abilities to assist you in battles.
Win battles and grow stronger: Every battle poses a strong strategic challenge, and winning battles allows your characters to grow. Equip them with different attribute gear, learn more powerful skills, and prepare for the next challenge.
Challenge peculiar and powerful bosses: Your team will face a variety of formidable and bizarre enemies, and each boss battle requires a targeted strategy to overcome.


In every era, there are always those struggling for survival, while others seek a path to transcendence.

In the sixth year of Zhenguan (632 AD), Emperor Taizong of Tang, upon the advice of the celestial being Yuan Tiangang and others, held a grand ceremony on Mount Tai known as the Fengshan ceremony.

Two years later, certain extraordinary beings with incarnates outside their bodies started to become active. It is said that these beings were demonic entities attached to human desires and transformed into incarnates, granting the possessors of these incarnates various extraordinary abilities. "Only an incarnate messenger can defeat another incarnate messenger."

In the eleventh year of Zhenguan (637 AD), in the distant west, the Sassanid Empire was reaching its final moments. Zoroastrian incarnates in the far west were no match for the four great Muslim caliphs, and the king and nobles decided to flee. Unwilling to accept the fate of the Zoroastrian religion being annihilated by the emerging Abbasid Caliphate, the Zoroastrian high priest, the Mobed, dispatched two messengers to travel across the ancient Silk Road to the emerging Eastern Empire in the far east, in search of awakening the slumbering gods...

As they journeyed thousands of miles through the desert to the east, Emperor Taizong suddenly launched a war to conquer the Western Regions.

And this is just the beginning of the story.

title: Eternal Remnant: The First Chapter

Guide a memorable cast of characters and help them fight for their lives in this classic-style fantasy RPG adventure that you won't soon forget.



"I just need you to trust me."



Enjoy a narrative-driven experience that is in equal parts heartwarming as it is breathtaking, all in the space of 4 -6 hours

Fast and breezy combat with characters teaming up to unleash dazzling combo attacks

A visually stunning adventure with a mix of blended environments and pixel art

A world ripe for exploring, packed with treasure and a variety of fearsome foes

Conquer the past. Fight against darkness. Find your destiny.

title: Space gold rush TD

In the frontiers of space where there is the unexplored, also means there is untapped resources. No time to waste mining and extracting, and no regulators to setup health and safety laws and procedures, risk it all and join the many other prospectors in a new hazardous industry blowing up asteroids anyway they can in order to strike it rich.

7 Different Towers each with their own upgrade options to specialize their stats (damage, fire rate, and range).

Mobile Turrets able to set up any where and reposition to fit different roles or when plan A does not go well.

Clear out space and harvest rocks, wood, and weeds with your pinball cannon. Watering your plants? Your cannon takes care of that too! Get the most out of the day by lining up those trick shot ricochets. Then aim and fire your ball!

title: Hello Again
description:
게임 정보
Hello Again is a mysterious and cute adventure game about exploring ancient ruins to uncover the secrets of a mysterious time loop.
EXPLORE
Welcome to the lovely island of Mychaea! This tropical island has everything: towering temples, a run-down motel, dangerous mine shafts, unexplained arcane technology, and traces of light arson!
SOLVE
Keep a close eye on your clock, because these ancient ruins were built to shift throughout the day. Access doors while they're still open, explore tunnels before they cave in, and utilize perpetuum, a strange material which reacts strangely to the loop's effects.
CHAT
Talk with Stew, an up-and-coming singer-songwriter. Befriend Theodore, an exuberant ray of sunshine who makes up for his broken English with extreme confidence. Buy a time share from Gus, the island's sleaziest businessman. And try not to offend the nostrils of world-class perfumier Chauncey.
REPEAT
As a postal worker, you knew it was out of the ordinary to travel off-shore to hand-deliver a package to a famous archaeologist. But you didn't expect to shipwreck on your way over, and you really didn't expect to get stuck in an eternal time loop. All in a (never-ending) day's work...

title: Rusty Seas
description:
게임 정보

Play as Mirig, a diner waitress whose afternoon off is interrupted by a mysterious (and very profitable) offer to collect high-tech junk washing up on the beaches of Northshore. But her venture is fraught with a colorful cast of competitors who also want to lay claim to the salvages. To overcome, Mirig will need to throw her weight around, dunk her adversaries, buy outfits and items, and make friends and allies along the way.

In addition to action-based gameplay, Rusty Seas also features a splash of visual novel style content, through which the player can learn that the lore of Northshore runs a little deeper than its cozy sands.

Stay immersed with our website

They can join you on the next mission tomorrow without getting left behind. Or you can strike out on your own. We get it, not everybody wants to share the power and glory.
Every mission is different and not every journey ends in victory. You'll recruit new characters with each outing, so even defeat has its upside. What are you waiting for? Cretacia isn't going to save itself!

title: Delilah

Delilah is an old-school FPS set in a world divided between Humanity and Hell. Its main goal is to capture the magical formula of the great classics.



Two characters with unique loadouts
Varied encounters, from tight horror experiences to slaughter maps
Seven episodes (planned), each with a distinct theme and story
Authentic 2.5D graphics in 256 colors, multi-directional monster sprites
MIDI tunes emulating sounds straight from the 90's
Custom game engine that supports 3d and dynamic level geometry



A century ago a great hero has saved our species by closing the gates of Hell, but the billions of demons already on Earth didn't just magically disappear. Instead, while Humanity was slowly reconquering the planet, several Arch Devils have adapted to the rules of our dimension. They formed their own twisted governments (known as Circles), to use their populations as human shields.

Our two protagonists were born into this century-long cold war: one is an enforcer of the Transylvanian Daemocratic Circle, the other is an Anointed defender of Humanity.
Borington is a one-person game development team from Transylvania. My previous games include 'BlackChain' and 'Rum & Gun', both available on Steam.

title: Tall Poppy 2
description:

About the game

In Tall Poppy 2, the tense exploration, action and puzzle-solving gameplay will keep players on their toes! Players join John and Emma Goldberg, a married couple who are forced to face the mischievous Tall Poppy and his new lackeys together!

With the sinister spirit unleashed, the island city of Boots Bay's population is slowly being possessed! Players will navigate through the city carefully so that they can avoid capture or possession all while trying to escape Tall Poppy's terror!

Both John and Emma have their own separate playable campaigns, allowing players to see the story from both characters’ perspectives. The fate of these two characters is in the players' hands as they work together to survive and get to the bottom of what is behind the terrifying attack on the city. Will they make it out alive?

Exciting gameplay – Engage in frantic combat with enemies, explore frightening corridors, solve puzzles to access areas and collect and use items discovered around the environment in a terrifying comedic fight for survival
Shooting - If players find the taser gun, they can shoot taser rounds and the Boots Bay citizens! With enough rounds, they can zap the possession out of them! Be careful though, rounds are hard to come by!
Climbing - Players can climb hard-to-reach areas!
Talking to characters - The world has some interesting characters to converse with!
Collecting objects - There are different objects in the world that will need to be collected and used for various reasons!
Inspecting - Players can inspect items for secret details, codes and lore!
Push/Pull - Moving objects out of the way or to help climb up a hard-to-reach place!










Welcome to the island of Boots Bay! The island is located in the middle of the pristine freshwater of Lake Huron. It was founded and built by French settlers in the year 1666 after a military conflict. It was a military outpost that later converted into a successful trading outpost. The indigenous population and French had trading relations that were very historic and highly regarded! Speaking of history, historians claim the island is named after the arc angel Bootelbub. However, some speculate it was named after the trading post's popular bever pelt boots!

Legend has it that there's a deeply hidden secret about the island's past. Some say they feel like they're being pulled...or...drawn to the island. City marketers jumped on this conspiracy theory and made the Boots Bay city motto "The island that you won't want to leave!"

The city is widely known for its European look and it's one of the city's main tourist attractions! You can visit some of the local attractions, such as, but not limited to...




















, husband to Emma and nephew to Lawrence Goldberg. John is a successful video game critic on a video-sharing website. He's known for his harsh criticisms, especially for horror games (ironically).


, wife to John. She's a live streamer who plays games and has a social media following. She's known for taking peace sign selfies mixed with the "duck face" expression in various locations.


, who's abnormally tall. His real name is Poppy Ericson. Due to his height, he often got picked on for being tall. His nickname was given to him by his old high school bully... John Goldberg. He was a grave digger for the city church until he got fired for "pranking distraught widowers as they grieved". He's known for being very curious and likes to explore places he shouldn't be exploring...

title: 万词破 - 单词女友 WCP Word Girlfriend
description:
게임 정보
An "accident" has caused you, who are about to graduate from university, to lose some important memories, including important events, important people, and a significant portion of your vocabulary. In urgent need of improving your vocabulary to meet the requirements of your future job, you joined an experimental project called the "Ten Thousand Words Club." There, you encountered three women whose destinies are intertwined with yours.
Gameplay Overview:
You need to choose a vocabulary book and set your own study plan, including learning methods, the number of new words and reviews per day, and more. After completing these learning tasks, you can earn virtual currency rewards, increase the teaching assistants' affection levels, and unlock new storylines.
* After completing the daily study plan, you can choose to continue working or battling in the virtual world to earn virtual currency and experience points, or you can improve your attributes by working with a fitness trainer. Whether it's "working," "battling," or "working out," all are vocabulary mini-games with a review function. While playing the game, you also enhance your mastery of previously learned words.
* The development of the storyline will change based on the affection levels of the teaching assistants and your choices. To pursue the teaching assistant you like, you need to select her as your current teaching assistant, complete learning tasks according to your set plan, and earn virtual currency to buy her gifts.
* The main antagonist in the game also has his eyes on these three beautiful teaching assistants, considering you as his rival. He will occasionally challenge you with word challenges. Defeat him, and you'll receive substantial rewards!
Game Features:
* Multiple motivational factors: The presence of virtual teaching assistants, cultivating word girlfriends, exploring multiple endings, facing challenges from the antagonist, rewards from vocabulary mini-games, a rich achievement system, and more. Each aspect of the game is designed to provide you with continuous motivation to learn vocabulary.
* More scientific, user-friendly, and personalized learning methods: We understand the drawbacks of traditional vocabulary learning methods. We have made vocabulary learning more dynamic and moderately intense to reduce user frustration and drowsiness. We prioritize the user learning experience and do not mindlessly recommend vocabulary words that exceed the user's learning capacity. We offer multiple learning methods, allowing users to customize their learning based on their actual situations and make adjustments at any time.

title: A Piano Tale
description:

피아노고 스튜디오(Pianogo Studio)의 프랑스 팀은 빠르게 움직이는 이 세상에서 음악과 그림을 사랑하는 분들을 위해 느리고 고요하고 사색적이며 몰입적인 게임을 제안합니다.

피아노 테일(Piano Tale)은 음악적 지략의 요소와 더불어 이야기가 있는 게임입니다. 게임은 가상의 음악가 알렉산드라 아로노비치의 이야기를 따라 그녀의 삶의 여러 단계를 거칩니다. 노년에 들어서 그녀는 알츠하이머 병을 앓고 있는 할머니가 됩니다. 알렉산드라는 소련 스탈린주의 시대의 작곡가였던 아버지 보리스 아로노비치가 체제 전복적인 비밀스런 협주곡을 작곡했다는 사실을 알게 됩니다. 당시 예술가들은 원하는 것을 원하는 대로 만들 수 없던 시대였죠. 그의 협주곡은 딸 알렉산드라를 위한 곡이었고, 이 협주곡을 찾는 일은 대부분의 나레이션에서 중요한 동기가 됩니다. Point&Click 단계와 키보드를 통한 음악적 지략의 게임에서 플레이어의 성공에 따라 세 가지의 결말이 있을 수 있습니다. 알렉산드라가 자신의 병에도 불구하고 기억을 되찾을 수 있었는지, 그리고 아버지로 인해 힘들고 엄격했던 자신의 어린 시절에도 아버지를 용서하게 되는지 볼 수 있습니다.

title: Street Soccer Online

title: Laws of Nadragia
description:
게임 정보
중세 나라 나드라지아에서 혁명이 일어났습니다! 이제 나라는 왕이 아닌 그의 꼭두각시들이 다스립니다. 새로운 국가 권력 기관인 최고 대학회가 통치합니다. 옛 법들은 불타버렸고, 매일 새로운 법들이 만들어지고 있습니다. 새로운 폭정의 시대가 시작되었습니다.
검사로서 법과 사실을 이용하세요.
법과 재판 기록의 허점을 찾아 피고인에게 어떤 수단을 써서라도 유죄 판결을 얻으세요. 법은 매일 바뀌고, 재판도 그렇습니다. 사람들의 생명이 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
전체주의 국가에서 생존하세요.
나드라지아 당국은 유죄 판결 할당량 준수를 요구하며 당신의 모든 움직임을 감시하고 있습니다. 각 재판은 피고인뿐만 아니라 당신에게도 마지막이 될 수 있습니다.

title: Solnox - Grimoire of Seasons
description:
게임 정보
사계절과 지형 변화 효과를 활용하여 끊임없이 변화하는 전장을 마스터하세요. 나만의 덱을 구성하여 완벽한 시너지 효과를 내고 세 명의 수호자를 이끌고 부정한 생명체를 상대로 승리하는 방법을 배워보세요.




전장은 이제 당신의 것입니다. 다양한 계절 카드를 사용하여 계절의 힘을 불러일으켜 자신과 적의 밑에 놓인 타일을 바꾸세요. 플레이하는 모든 카드가 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 것입니다. 적들이 비슷한 힘을 발휘하여 당신의 죽음을 굳히기 때문에 예측할 수 없는 대학살에 대응하세요.



봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울. 사계절에 내재된 고유한 특성을 발휘하여 강력한 시너지 콤보를 만들어 무자비한 적을 물리치세요. 부패의 확산을 막으려는 헛된 시도로 죽어가는 세상을 되찾으세요.



수호자들은 힘을 합쳐야만 다가오는 타락으로부터 스스로를 지킬 수 있습니다. 매번 신중하게 덱을 구성하거나 실험적인 조합을 시도하여 세 명의 강력한 캐릭터 간의 시너지를 더욱 향상시키세요. 실패할 때마다 더 강해지고, 새로운 카드 슬롯을 잠금 해제하고, 더 강력하고 복잡한 카드를 수집하세요.

title: The Backwars
description:
게임 정보
The Backwars is a survival horror game that keeps you on edge at all times. Whether you’re playing alone or with friends, your only goal is to survive. Scavenge for food and water, build what you need to stay alive, and hide from the unspeakable horrors hunting you. Each level is packed with threats that force you to think fast and act faster.
Step into an unforgiving world where everything feels disturbingly real. The heavy atmosphere, eerie sounds, and gritty visuals pull you into a nightmare that won’t let go. Every item, object, or system in the game connects in ways that can surprise or terrify you. Nothing feels safe, and nowhere is truly secure.
The entities stalking you aren’t the only danger—other players can be just as deadly. Trust can get you killed, and alliances rarely last long. Whether you’re hiding in the dark, crafting tools, or fighting for your life, every moment is a gamble.
The Backwars offers different ways to play:

title: Ghost Frequency
description:
게임 정보
Ghost Frequency는 당신을 PIT - 초자연적 조사 팀의 베테랑 유령 사냥꾼 마크로 만들어주는 1인칭 공포 게임입니다.
동료 에밀리와 함께 마크는 음산한 존재가 있는 버려진 장소에서 두 팀원이 신비롭게 사라진 사건을 조사합니다.
당신의 임무? 밤을 견디고 그림자 속에 잠복한 오싹한 미스터리를 밝혀내는 것입니다.

title: UltraBoxing – VR Boxing
description:
게임 정보
UltraBoxing VR is a boxing + fitness game featuring ultra-realistic AI.
Punch, dodge, move, and strategize as you take on dynamic AI opponents with fluid movements, strong defense, and advanced dodging mechanics, delivering a true boxing challenge. Fight and train in fully immersive or mixed reality modes.

title: Beneath the Frost
description:
게임 정보
You are the sole survivor of a devastating spaceship crash, stranded on a frozen, desolate planet. Now, you must scavenge whatever scraps remain in a desperate attempt to call for help.
Remote-Controlled Exploration
Trapped within the hollow shell of your ship, deploy a scrap recovery bot to venture into the outside world. Search for what scarce resources this planet offers and uncover the mystery behind your crash.
An Unfolding Landscape

title: Where Noble Plans Lie
description:
게임 정보
농노들이 반란을 일으키고 귀족들은 망가졌습니다!
다행히도 고문들은 당신이 도울 것이라고 모두에게 말하고 있습니다.
뱀파이어들을 위해 길거리 음식을 준비하려는 계획을 아무도 알아채지 않는 한 모두가 만족할 것입니다.
왕국을 당신의 것으로 만드세요
원하는 대로 영토를 건설하세요.
왕국에서 가장 설득력 있는 고문 팀을 구성하세요.
왕국의 모든 지역을 당신의 통치 하에 두세요.
전략적 턴 기반 토론
원하는 고문을 모집하세요.
5명으로 팀을 구성하세요.
그들에게 무적이 되도록 가르치세요.
더 많이 토론하여 경험치를 얻고 등급을 올리세요.
명성이 전부입니다
귀족들이 당신이 원하는 것을 하도록 설득하세요.

title: Another One
description:
게임 정보
Another One is a photorealistic co-op horror with procedurally generated liminal mazes.
"Black holes have turned the galaxy into chaos, and humanity has found a way out by drawing resources from alternative spaces. "Forwarders" were the so-called detachments that were engaged in extracting valuable items from simulations, the conditions of which were unrealistically extreme."
Will you and your team be able to survive in an environment where the world around you is falling apart?
Immerse yourself in a unique simulation where each entry into the game is a new, exciting story. Procedural generation creates liminal complexes, ensuring that no session will be like the previous one.

title: 伥影重生 Ghost:Reborn
description:
게임 정보
Game Introduction
"Ghost:Reborn" is a 2D pixel horizontal action game with a Chinese cyber theme. While wandering in the world, players use the dual identities of demon-slayer and assassin killer to jump through different scenes, discover the truth of the broken world, and repair the broken order.
Game Background
Since when, people who have lost their history have gradually been alienated into henchmen. Henchmen no longer have self-awareness, but numbly seek the memory or consciousness of others to feed on. They have vague memories of the vivid memories of the past, and vaguely believe that they can return to the beautiful past as long as they eat the consciousness of others. But this is just a temporary solution. Over time, more and more people have become henchmen. Henchmen no longer have hope for the present and the future, leading to the irreversible decline of civilization...

title: Skull Horde
description:
게임 정보
Skull Horde에서 플레이어는 하늘을 나는 해골 네크로맨서가 되어 끝없이 몰려드는 적들을 상대하는 해골 군대를 이끌게 됩니다. 전리품을 획득하고 군대를 강력하게 키워나가면서 자동으로 생성되는 던전을 탐험하세요.




매번 새롭게 생성되는 던전을 탐험하세요. 던전에서는 각기 다른 전략을 요구하는 독특한 적들을 만나게 됩니다. 던전 안에서는 강력한 전리품과 요긴한 아이템들과 상자들을 발견할수 있습니다. 하지만 던전 안에서 잠식당하지 않으려면 계속해서 움직여야 합니다




각 회차를 돌면서 플레이어의 군단을 만들기 위해 다양한 종류의 유닛들을 구매할 수 있습니다. 각 유닛은 각기 다른 특수 능력을 가지고 있습니다. 따라서 유닛들을 조합해 강력한 시너지를 내도록 군단을 조직해야 합니다. 동일한 종류의 유닛을 다수 구입하면 더욱 강력한 유닛으로 합칠수 있으며, 궁극적으로는 강력한 특수 능력을 획득하게 됩니다. 던전에서 발견한 전리품들은 각 유닛들의 클래스와 태그와 상호작용해 강력한 효과를 발휘합니다. 자원을 활용해 전략적으로 유닛을 불러들이고 플레이어가 원하는 빌드를 만들기 위해 자원을 채취하세요.




Skull Horde는 실시간으로 진행되며 플레이어의 유닛들은 독립적으로 전투를 벌입니다. 플레이어의 역할은 각 유닛들을 성장시키고, 탐색 지역을 선택하고, 언제 이동할지를 정해주고, 필요한 업그레이드를 선택하는 것입니다.




플레이어의 레벨이 오르면, 플레이어는 게임 시작시 선택할 수 있는 강력한 특전을 획득하게 됩니다. 선택한 특전들과 플레이 가능한 캐릭터들의 능력을 조합해 압도적인 빌드의 기반을 확보하세요.

각 던전 타입에는 던전만의 고유한 도전과제들이 존재합니다. 이러한 도전과제들을 달성하기 위해서는 다양한 전략을 필요로 하며, 도전과제를 달성시 보상을 획득하고, 새로운 컨텐츠가 개방됩니다.

title: Aldian of Ancients
description:
게임 정보
Take control of dinosaurs and other prehistoric creatures and explore a beautifully crafted world filled with threats and secrets. Build a pack/herd with your friends and take on the challenges of the land. Fight other players for survival and sustenance, conquer territories and nurture your offspring to adulthood. Always be on the lookout since danger not only comes from other players and the environment but sources beyond your comprehension...

The Lands of AldianImmerse yourself in an ancient world, lost in the shuffle of evolution, populated with creatures that promulgate intrigue. Explore different biomes, find hidden secrets and maybe you might stumble upon things that might bewilder you. 

The Denizens of Aldian

title: County of Fortune
description:
게임 정보




In County of Fortune, a medieval city builder with a twist, your goal is to develop an entire county. Rather than constructing individual buildings, your focus is on founding entire settlements and overseeing their growth from small villages to bustling cities. Each settlement you develop contributes to the prosperity of the county, and your decisions will determine its long-term success.






The world of County of Fortune is vast, offering a variety of landscapes where different places yield different oportunities. From natural resource through places suitable for growing various products to large navigable rivers that provide excellent access to the rest of the map. Explore the possibilities and build a county that reflects the diversity of the land.






As your county expands, unique cultural traits emerge based on the characteristics you cultivate in each settlement. These traits influence how your communities develop, making every county region or even village distinct. Will you choose a unified county under a single culture or adapt your playstyle in each region to use strengths of different cultures?

title: Trainatic
description:
게임 정보
Watch your train grow from a tiny engine to a screen-clearing machine.
Unlock new cars and discover game-changing synergies.

title: Arcas Champions
description:
게임 정보
Arcas Champions
Arcas Champions에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 이 게임은 박진감 넘치는 3인칭 능력 기반 슈팅 게임으로, 원숭이들의 고향 행성을 배경으로 합니다. 파벌 간의 충돌, 이국적인 환경, 강력한 능력이 어우러져 매 경기마다 짜릿한 경험을 선사합니다. 챔피언을 선택하고 독창적인 능력을 익혀 이 울창하고 신비로운 세계에서 싸우며 지배하세요.
게임 배경
Arcas 세계는 내전 상태에 빠졌습니다. 갑작스러운 외계 우주선 추락과 오랫동안 잊혀졌던 신비로운 원소 "Bastonium"의 재발견이 전쟁을 촉발했습니다. 이 원소는 엄청난 잠재력과 위험한 특성을 지니고 있습니다. 이단자 반란군과 마을 엘리트 전통주의자들이 행성의 지배권을 놓고 치열하게 맞서고 있습니다. 각 세력이 Bastonium의 힘을 차지하려 하면서 자연과 기술의 경계가 흐려지고, 치열한 주도권 싸움이 벌어지고 있습니다.
게임플레이
게임은 정교하게 설계된 챔피언 캐릭터를 중심으로 진행됩니다. 각 챔피언은 고유한 속성, 토템 능력, 그리고 맞춤형 무기를 보유하고 있습니다. 챔피언은 자신의 플레이 스타일에 맞게 조정할 수 있으며, 민첩성, 공격력, 지원 능력 중 원하는 방향으로 성장시킬 수 있습니다. 벽을 타고 넘고, 활공하며, 강력한 점프를 활용해 정글에서 적을 압도하세요. 기술과 전략이 이 거친 세계에서 생존하고 승리하는 핵심이 될 것입니다.
게임 모드

title: Tearscape
description:
게임 정보
Discover a Gothic world in this 2D top-down action-adventure, blending fast-paced combat, exploration, and pixel art inspired by Game Boy Color classics. Fight monstrous foes, unlock new abilities, and explore a non-linear map filled with hidden secrets and dangerous challenges.
Features
Master precise combat, where every strike and dodge matters. Strategically manage your stamina by carefully considering each move as you face off against grotesque enemies. You have a limited number of healing flasks—use them wisely and plan your moments to recover carefully. Upgrade your character's stats to remain effective and competitive in combat.

title: MÖRK BORG Heresy Supreme
description:
게임 정보
The world's loudest tabletop RPG brings ruin to video gaming.
Take control of the vilest scum ever to crawl upon the earth, and wander the dying lands of the original game through a graphic style inspired by the book.
Evade deadly flails aimed to crack your skull open in a combat system both dynamic and unforgiving that’ll require a strategic, ruthless approach.
Face horrific quests testing your skills to the brink of the Apocalypse.

Literally.

A Desperate Quest at the End of All Things
You wake up in Galgenbeck, a revolting cluster of shanties and ruins-to-be scattered around the greatest cathedral of the dying lands, dedicated to the doomsday following of the two-headed Basilisks. From the Cathedral’s blackened spires slithers a voice and a truth: the world is ending. The two-headed Basilisks demand an offering. This will delay the inevitable end of all things.

There is another voice. From the shit-reeking alleys where the rabble and gutterscums fester, a rumor: whoever appeases this demand will receive Arch-Priestess Josilfa Migol’s blessing. She will cleanse heretic souls and grant them passage to the Shimmering Fields when the true time comes.

The ones desperate enough to embark on this quest are dubbed cursed walkers, and you are one of them. You know that your foul soul is rotting, and every night, you are tormented by visions of eternal damnation. You need a way out. One way or another.

This miserable world is dying, and everyone is looking for salvation, wealth, or vengeance; you can try to cross your destiny with other walkers and form a party, but they will all join you for a reason. Keep everyone’s agenda in mind during the exploration, and you might just get along. Wrong a companion, and they’ll turn their back on you. Or put a dagger in yours. “Friendly” is such an alien world in the brutal, dying world of MÖRK BORG. Remember that when someone offers their help!
s is divided into regions, each one worse than the other. Locations and adventures are dynamically generated based on your progress and the quests you’ll stumble into. Quests, adventures, bosses, and special items reset on every playthrough. Explore the dying world but don't get lost in it. You won't get out alive.

Instead, you level up by performing certain actions during your adventures. When you level up, some of your characters’ abilities will get better, but some will get WORSE. The more you level up, the higher the chances you may lose something in the process. Can’t teach an old goblin new tricks! They’ll kill you.

The more you play and the deeper you crawl into the filth, the more Miseries you get. They can trigger when you end an adventure and the closer you get to the Apocalypse the more likely this is.Rumors say that these Miseries can be delayed. The foolish claim that they can be prevented but nobody these are all unconfirmed heresies. And whatever the price is for such an unholy miracle, it's unpayable.

So remember, you can rely on the fickle fates of alternate worlds tangled with the eyes of eldritch watchers if you want… just don’t tell the Inquisition.
