Every scroll has a chance to trigger an arcane catastrophe, and nobody can foresee what kind of disaster it could bring. You may get dizzy and start puking… or explode. However, some arcane catastrophes might even be better than the intended effect. Use at your own risk.

get your ugly sack of bones and blood to the Valley of the Unfortunate Undead and face the terrifying presence of Verhu, the truth speaker and the most worshiped of the Basilisk heads, and Gorgh, and his envious brother. Will you be able to appease them in time and cleanse your rotting soul by delaying the apocalypse? Will this torment ever end? Or will your repeated sufferings open your soul to the Heresy Supreme?

is a groundbreaking grimdark fantasy tabletop RPG by and of . Unleashed upon the world in 2020, it won three gold ENNIES for Product of the Year, Best Writing, and Best Layout as well as silver for Best Game. MÖRK BORG’s dark, dying world is mid-apocalypse, and its wretched denizens cower in the shadow of the godlike two-headed Basilisks. Life is short, cheap, and full of terrors, but despite this, MÖRK BORG is currently enjoyed by thousands of players scattered around the globe, and the creative community surrounding it thrives.

title: Cosmi: Forbidden Forests
description:
게임 정보
A celebration of pioneering 1980s games, this new-and-old collection of classic C64™ games originally published by Cosmi includes a medieval styled remake of Forbidden Forest with all new graphics and audio, new comic book stories and remade box art, plus a trove of archival bonus material!
Cosmi: Forbidden Forests includes everything from pick-up-and-play shooters and platformers to adventure and simulation games with surprising depth. The games included are Forbidden Forest, Beyond the Forbidden Forest, Aztec Challenge, Caverns of Khafka, Seal, Delta Man, Chomp!, Chernobyl: Nuclear Power Plant Simulation, Spite & Malice, and Navcom 6: The Persian Gulf Defense.
Features
10 legendary games from the C64 era, including hits by master game designer Paul Norman.
A bardcore-inspired Remake of Forbidden Forest with the ability to switch between the remade and original version in real time as you play.
Digital Comics by Andy Lanning and Ant Williams bringing the world of the games to life.
Save States and Rewind features powered by the Arsenal Engine.
Digital gallery of development artifacts and advertisements from the original release of the games.

title: Pumpkin Restaurant
description:
게임 정보
호박 레스토랑은 화면 하단에 나타나며, 다른 일을 하면서 레스토랑을 운영할 수 있습니다.
직원 고용:
레스토랑 직원으로 호박 사람이나 고양이를 고용하세요. 레스토랑에는 웨이터, 요리사, 출납원이 필요합니다.
직원에게는 임의의 속성 값이 있습니다. 더 나은 속성을 가진 직원을 선택하고 적절한 직책을 할당하십시오.
게임이 진행됨에 따라 특별한 직원이 등장합니다.
레시피 모음:
주방에는 다양한 레시피가 갖춰져야 합니다. 레시피가 풍부할수록 주방 효과는 더욱 강해집니다.
레시피는 업그레이드를 통해 속성을 향상시킬 수 있습니다.
게임이 진행되면서 특별한 레시피가 등장합니다.

title: Case Files: Internal Affairs
description:
게임 정보
Two police officers have taken their own lives within hours of each other. Is foul play involved? Can you crack the case in this 3rd installment of the Case Files series?
FEATURES
Observe suspects.
Sort through evidence to discern truth from lies.
Find contradictions in suspect interviews.
Solve mini puzzles.
Guide your partner in the interview room.
Make key decisions that will alter the outcome of the case.
Replay to unlock multiple endings and alternate interview clips.

title: Islets Defense
description:
게임 정보
Islets Defense is a turn-based tower defense game focused on resource management, where you build a small and efficient village to support your towers and secure victory.
A turn consists of executing one of the four available actions, each with its own unique functionality. The order of the cards plays a key role, with the rightmost card offering a stronger effect. After completing your turn, the chosen card moves to the leftmost position, pushing the others one step forward. Consistent and efficient use of all four cards is key to building a solid defense.

title: The Soul
description:
게임 정보
A 3rd person action adventure game set in a parallel universe.
Side by side with us, invisibly live dark creatures. Vampires, zombies, demons and other creatures are very dangerous and always hungry. They have learnt to hide from the Guardians, who have been finding and exterminating bloodthirsty creatures for hundreds of years.
Max Soul is a cold-blooded Guardian, capable of destroying any monster in his path. His whole life is an endless hunt, and his next assignment is to identify the monster and eliminate it.
But is everything so unambiguous? Is there really only good and evil?
The player will have to get into the role of Max, dive headfirst into the hunt and understand the soul of the protagonist.
Conducting an investigation and determining the type of monsters to choose how to destroy them.
Dramatic plot with a complicated, grey morality.
Voice control mechanics using a microphone.

title: Mech Havoc
description:
게임 정보
An Evil AI called HIVE has gained sentience and conquered Planet-X! Now it's up to you to FIGHT BACK using a large range of vehicles. From a small and quick Weaponized Delivery Truck all the way to building sized Heavy Mechs.
Unlock new Vehicles and Weapons by completing missions and fighting against the ever-increasing threat of hostile machines. Equip Your Vehicle with newer and Stronger Weapons. And make use of Artillery Strikes, for when your weapons alone just aren't enough to stop a Horde of Killer Robots.

title: BEAST : Bio Exo Arena Suit Team
description: 게임 정보
autokwd: BEAST : Bio Exo Arena Suit Team

title: No Way Home: BLAMMO!
description:
게임 정보
No Way Home: BLAMMO! is a tactical arcade roguelite that's all about fast-paced twin stick space combat.
Every run is a new adventure. Tinker with your ship, experiment with unique weapons, and discover interesting new builds as you blast your way through waves of enemies and bosses.
The gameplay is simple!
Choose a Loadout
Start BLAMMING!
Salvage, Tinker, Upgrade
BLAM HARDER!
Die | Win
Unlock new co-pilots, their perks, and other long-form progression
GO AGAIN!

title: Spire
description:
게임 정보
In a far-future seascape cursed by the ancients, will you make mankind's last home a haven or a fortress?
Surge, Spire, and Sea is a 333,333-word interactive post-apocalyptic science fantasy novel by Nebula nominated game writer Stewart C Baker. It's entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
Back rebels or royals, or pursue your own rise to power. Speak for the spirits or fight for your own kind, or try to reconcile both by uncovering ancient injustices. Heal the creatures afflicted by a magical rot or defeat them in the name of defending the ones you love. Shape humanity's destiny with magic, alchemy, or high-tech masonry. 
But be warned: the gods, the spirits, and your king are watching your every move.
Master the art of spirit magic, the high-tech craft of masonry, or meld science and the supernatural with alchemical potions.
Play as male, female, or non-binary; cis- or trans-gender; gay, straight, bi, asexual, or poly.
Cast your lot with the king and his Spireguard or the anarchist rebels of the Surge.
Explore the Spires and Shallows, two distinct regions of Gigantea, humanity's last tower-home.
Seek out platonic, romantic, sexual, and polyromantic relationships with a diverse and memorable cast of NPCs.
Sail the rot-cursed Worldsea in search of life—or fortify your home with a powerful military fleet.
Experience a festival and night market with delicious food and entertaining mini-games, as well as gifts for your loved ones.
Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic setting where people of all body shapes, sizes, disabilities, skin tones, and identities are treated equally.
Strive to become the new ruler of your home or turn away from it all for a chance to explore the world.
Communicate in speech and sign language.
* Navigate a world propped up by centuries of truth, lies, and mythology.
* Climb ruined towers or seek refuge in a subterranean space of your own making.

title: Birdigo
description:
게임 정보
Make Words
Longer words score higher, but specific combos can turn short words into powerhouses. Not happy with your hand? Discard any number of letters, up to four times each round.

Build your Deck
Add enhanced letter cards to supercharge your score. Delete difficult letters to improve your odds of drawing the ones you want.
Deploy Feathers to Change the Game
Feathers aren’t just bonuses. They transform how words are scored, making some patterns incredibly potent.
Try Wild Strategies
With more than six million possible combinations of feathers, along with enhanced letters and transformative songs, there’s no limit to the strategies you can try. How about two-letter words with enhanced letters left in your hand? It could work!
Lead your Flock to Safety
Birdigo consists of migrations with dozens of stopovers — each one a chance to replenish and re-strategize. To reach the next one, you’ll need to fly further each round.

Achievements unlock new feathers, songs, decks, and migration routes. Huge bonuses and multipliers mean big numbers, which you’ll need to win these treacherous routes.
Should you play that easy word, or discard some letters in the hopes of drawing something better? Which feather should you pick? Which song? Your choices are the difference between a successful migration and failure.

title: Plush Party
description:
게임 정보
Easy to enter, fun to master controls!
Add style to every game! Customize everything from appearance to accessories, and create your favorite plushie.

title: Chessplus
description:
게임 정보
Combine. Split. Promote.
Use regular chess moves to merge two pieces onto the same square, creating a powerful hybrid. Move the combined piece using either piece’s abilities, or split them apart later to individual pieces for strategic positioning when the time is right.
But beware, if the combined piece is captured, you'll lose both!
Features
Explore exponentially more strategies by combine pieces into powerful hybrids or split them later for strategic positioning. Need more queens? Create your own with a "Biook" (Bishop + Rook) or rocket a pawn across the board with the "Rawn" (Rook + Pawn) for a quick promotion. 
Balanced Chess at its core, only regular legal moves apply. But be careful if your combined piece is captured - you'll lose them both!
Show off your ELO ranking in PC / Mobile in cross-platform multiplayer and make every move matter in a Roguelike adventure.
How to Play
Use traditional Chess moves to combine your pieces.

title: RogueMath
description:
게임 정보
Play your formulas to reach objectives
Use your available formulas strategically to achieve various objectives.
Build your deck

title: The King Of Beasts
description:
게임 정보
Kill enemies to evolve into enemy form. Players will control mutated creatures with this ability, constantly fighting against other mutated creatures to evolve into more powerful creatures. They will survive in terrifying alien experiments and become the king of beasts.
Game features:
Evolutionary freedom, as long as you kill enemies, you can evolve into enemy form.
Perilous dangers lurk in the alien experimental field, and players need to remain vigilant at all times.
Immersive experience, a grand and unique alien experimental field.
Diverse characteristics, mutated organisms all possess unique abilities.
Fighting wits and courage, directly challenging powerful mutant creatures is not the best way. It requires the reasonable use of experimental field mechanisms and other mutant creatures.
Time limited survival, as time goes by, more and more powerful experimental subjects will join the battle and survive until the end to become the king of beasts.

title: Snow Resort Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Step into the world of Snow Resort Simulator. Tackle daily responsibilities: upgrade facilities, maintain a cozy resort, satisfy guests with freshly cooked meals and drinks, and keep your inventory fully stocked. Be prepared for the challenges that come with winter.
Ensure you prepare tickets according to customer requests. Sell tickets to customers who want to ski. Use the income to improve your resort and restock supplies.

title: The Vast White
description:
게임 정보
Explore The Vast White at your own pace
Embark on a solitary snowboarding journey down a vast, untamed mountain where every run is unique. The Vast White blends exploration, storytelling, and the thrill of the descent into a seamless open-world adventure. With only your board and your instincts, carve through pristine alpine wilderness, uncover hidden trails, and unravel the secrets buried beneath the snow.
🏔️ An Open Mountain to Conquer
Ride at your own pace through sprawling peaks, frozen forests, and secluded valleys—every path you choose reveals new wonders and challenges.
❄️ Uncover the Mountain’s Mysteries
Explore every corner of the mountain to find hidden routes, and stunning landscapes that reveal the mountain's past.

title: Sleep Well Cemetery
description:
게임 정보
You play the role of a gravedigger who takes care of peace and order at the cemetery every day. Your daytime duties seem simple, but they require attention and commitment

However, when darkness falls, the cemetery comes to life in a completely different way. The night brings unexpected challenges – things you don't expect. Every night can surprise you, and you have to be ready to face whatever has decided to go out for an evening walk.


Driving a Melex around the cemetery is not just ordinary transport - time is running out and there are plenty of responsibilities. Sometimes you have to be in a hurry, which means that slightly damaging a tombstone is just... part of the workday.



Assembling coffins is the basis of every day - each one must be carefully prepared, because we never know what we will use it for in the end.



Sometimes the situation at the cemetery requires more than just a shovel and a melex. When things start to get out of control, you need to reinforce yourself.



When the dead decide to leave their graves, your task is clear: gently but firmly guide them back to their resting place. Peace must be restored!



Remember that as a gravedigger you have to be ready for anything.

title: Class of Heroes 3 Remaster
description:
게임 정보
Class is back in session! After a 15 year wait Class of Heroes 3, the revered school-themed dungeon RPG series, is finally here!
Enrol in one of three distinct schools and join your fellow students on an epic dungeon crawling adventure. Enjoy school life on campus and meet brand new friends for a huge range of characters and classes.
Choose your party to suit your play style and then take to the sprawling 3D dungeons to take down enemies and acquire loot to see your party get ever stronger. With hundreds of combinations of Race, Classes, armours, weapons and Items, you can create a wild array of party compositions to take on the challenges ahead!
Remastered for an all new generation, Class of Heroes 3 is the pinnacle of this much loved series!
Key features:
Enter the dungeon!: Class of Heroes 3 takes 3D dungeon-crawling RPGs to a new level - with more characters and bigger dungeons than ever before!
Back to School: Choose from one of three distinct schools - each will change your uniform, difficulty and story!
Make new friends! The new relationship system will allow you to forge (or break!) bonds with the fellow students in your party. The stronger the bond, the greater the benefit!
Let’s party!: Team up with fellow students from a huge range of races and classes to build the best possible party of heroes to explore dungeons with.
Plunder the dungeons!: Take your party into colossal, labyrinthine dungeons - fight off enemies and plunder the loot to make yourself stronger on each run!
Build it your way: With hundreds of weapons, armour and items - along with  even more combinations of races and classes. Customise your team to suit your playing style!
New and improved: As the third iteration in the series, every aspect of the original games has been enhanced and improved to make this the most enjoyable in the series yet!

title: Kitty Powers' Matchmaker Makeover
description:
게임 정보
It's time to make love happen, again!
In Kitty Powers’ Matchmaker: Makeover, players step back into the role of a matchmaking agency manager, helping quirky clients find their true love under the expert guidance of the fabulous Kitty Powers.
This remastered version comes bursting with vibrant new artwork, expanded customization options, and a host of gameplay improvements to make matchmaking even more fun and inclusive.
Features
Enhanced Artwork: Feast your eyes on Matchmaker’s enhanced assets and sumptuously high definition artwork. Now with 4K and ultra-widescreen modes!
Expanded Customization: Players have new options to dress and style their characters, with updated personalities and fashion that ensures anything goes!
New Gameplay Elements: Flex your matchmaking muscles with new dating dilemmas, improved mechanics, and refined controls that make it easier to create perfect matches.

title: VoidWalker: Call of Insomnia
description:
게임 정보
VoidWalker is an exciting psychological game in which you will explore the boundaries of conscious dreams and reality. You are Kyle, a researcher in an underground laboratory, participating in a unique experiment that allows you to extract objects from the dream world into reality. But it's not all that simple: as you immerse yourself in dreams, you'll encounter eerie nightmares and strange phenomena that challenge your perception.
The key objective is to explore dreams, solve puzzles and collect artifacts that will help your team become millionaires. But soon Kyle encounters a mystical creature - Morpheus, the lord of dreams, who is not happy to have his peace disturbed. You will go through nightmares, frightening events and unexpected encounters, where your decisions will influence the outcome of the plot.
As you dive deeper and deeper into dream worlds, you will solve complex problems and seek answers to questions, but be careful: conscious dreams can become a trap, and reality may not be what it seems. Courage and wit are your main allies in this battle of reason and illusion.
Main features:
A gripping plot that combines elements of thriller and psychological horror.
Realized dreams as game mechanics: interact with the world around you and manipulate dreams to achieve goals.
Unique puzzles that alter the perception of reality.
Frightening enemies and characters, such as Morpheus, that challenge your fears.
Influence decisions on the further development of the plot and the final game.
Immerse yourself in the world of VoidWalker and find out where the dream ends and reality begins.

title: Kernel
description:
게임 정보
Innovative fusion of automatic combat and Trading Card Games! Become the adventurer Kamus and travel through several unknown star worlds. Summon monsters from other worlds to assist you on your conquest journey through highly liberalized decks!
Game features:
·Extremely high degree of freedom deck construction: Before embarking on an adventure, you can choose and edit unique decks, and continuously acquire new cards during the adventure, dynamically adjusting decks to adapt to complex and ever-changing combat environments.
·Instant automatic combat: During the time freeze period, all units on the field are unable to move, and multiple effects can be achieved using cards. You need to choose the right time to freeze your time in order to maximize your advantage.
·Rich and diverse items: During the adventure, you can obtain various items, all of which play a very important role. Choose appropriate item combinations and combine them with decks to achieve maximum profits.

title: Pinbleton Park
description:
게임 정보
Save your village with the power of pinball in Pinbleton Park.
In this cosy pinball adventure game the whole world turns into one giant pinball table with the help of the spirits who live in the village shrine.
Help out the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!
