description: Adult Game

title: Roguebound Pirates
description:
게임 정보
강렬한 해상 전투
바다에는 보물도 가득하지만... 위험 요소도 가득합니다! 교묘한 계획을 세워 적보다 앞서가지 못하면 심해에 빠지게 됩니다.
 함선 커스텀
함선에 다양한 무기, 장비, 신화 속 유물을 탑재하세요. 플레이어는 선장으로서 자유롭게 함선 구조를 디자인할 수 있습니다. 여러 가지 장비 옵션을 발견할 수 있고, 대부분 다른 장비로 추가 개조가 가능하기 때문에 진정으로 강력하고 독창적인 시너지를 만들어낼 수 있습니다.

title: Kingdom Ascension
description:
게임 정보
「Kingdom Ascension」은 중세 시대를 테마로 한 전략 전쟁 게임입니다. 플레이어는 영주의 역할을 맡아 제로부터 자신의 왕국을 건설합니다. 자원을 모으고, 건물을 짓고, 부대를 모집하며, 탐험과 모험을 통해 끊임없이 영토를 확장하고 고향을 방어합니다.
영토를 구축하세요
황량한 땅에서 시작하여, 부대 훈련, 건물 업그레이드 및 기술 연구에 필요한 음식과 자재 같은 필수 자원을 수집하세요. 제한된 자원의 효율적인 배분이 성공의 열쇠입니다.
군대를 편성하세요
적의 침략을 방어하기 위해 군대를 편성하세요. 다양한 유형의 병사를 모집하고 전술적 필요에 따라 부대를 구성합니다. 부대 편성, 병종 및 전술적 배치는 전장에서의 승패를 결정합니다.
기술과 전쟁 기계
경제 성장의 규모와 효율성을 높이기 위해 기술을 개발하세요. 전쟁 기계는 전투에서 중요한 역할을 하며, 전세를 뒤바꿀 수 있는 능력을 가지고 있습니다. 연구를 통해 그 기능과 전술적 적용을 지속적으로 업그레이드해야 합니다.

title: Deepspace Emporium
description:
게임 정보
Deepspace Emporium is an immersive shopkeeping simulator set in the gritty, atmospheric depths of a massive space station, where survival and success are anything but guaranteed. You play as a former scavenger who, with a little luck and a sizable loan, has managed to open a shop on the Lower Levels of this colossal outpost. Life here is tough, with a sharp divide between the wealthy elite in the Upper Levels and the struggling masses below. To keep your shop running, you'll need to buy, sell, and barter a wide variety of goods—from counterfeit cigarettes and handmade firearms to life-saving drugs—all while keeping an eye on the ever-increasing rent demanded by your ruthless landlord.
In this world of gray morality, every transaction is a choice, every choice has consequences, and no one’s hands are truly clean. Command, corporate interests, and local factions all pull at the strings of station life, each with their own agenda. Do you try to stay out of trouble, or do you play both sides to get ahead? How far will you go to survive, and what will you sacrifice to make a name for yourself on the station?
This is the demo version of the game and does not include Save and Loading.
Features:
Run Your Own Shop: Manage inventory, haggle with customers, and make tough decisions on what to stock. Each sale impacts your reputation and the type of customers you attract.
Navigate Gray Morality: Deal with customers from all walks of life, including desperate scavengers, wealthy upper-level clients, and dangerous underworld figures. Not every sale is strictly legal, and not every buyer can be trusted.
Face Rising Rent and Expenses: Your relentless landlord demands an ever-increasing rent, pushing you to make more money, even if it means taking riskier deals or questionable jobs.
Handle Contraband: Trade in goods of varying legality. Avoid detection by authorities while keeping valuable connections in the black market.

title: Tabletop Tavern
description:
게임 정보
테이블탑 태번: 지휘하고, 정복하고, 반복하라

테이블탑 태번에 빠져보세요. 실시간 전략과 로그라이크가 결합된 게임으로, 모든 전투는 주사위 던지기이며 모든 승리는 직접 쟁취해야 합니다. 혼돈의 탁상 전장에서 용병들을 이끌고, 다양한 전사들을 모집해 무자비한 고블린 무리에 맞서 전설을 만들어 보세요. 무한한 조합, 가혹한 선택, 끝없는 재플레이 가능성을 갖춘 이 게임은 로그라이크 팬을 위한 완벽한 RTS 혼돈입니다.
주요 특징:
실시간 전투: 탁상에서 펼쳐지는 역동적인 전투에서 부대를 지휘하며, 모든 움직임이 중요합니다.
팀 모집: 독특한 기술, 개성, 이야기를 가진 다양한 용병들을 모아 팀을 구성하세요.
로그라이크 요소: 매 플레이가 독특합니다. 강력한 장비를 찾아 독창적인 빌드를 만들고, 예측 불가능한 환경에서 살아남기 위해 적응하세요.
무리와 대결: 당신을 파괴하려는 결심을 한 사나운 고블린 군대를 속이고 싸우세요.

title: Junkyard Builder
description:
게임 정보
폐차장 건설자, 당신은 한때 잊혀졌지만 이제는 무한한 잠재력으로 넘치는 폐차장의 자랑스러운 소유자입니다. 복원, 재활용, 그리고 쓰레기를 보물로 바꾸고 정크 제국의 통치자가 되어 즐거운 세계로 뛰어드세요!
🗺️🚗💎보물 찾기: 새로운 장소로 운전하고 희귀한 발견물을 찾아 세상을 탐험하세요.
💰📈🔧돈 벌기 및 업그레이드: 찾은 아이템을 최대한 활용하고 돈을 벌어 스킬 레벨업, 기계 구매, 운영을 간소화하는 더 나은 도구 잠금 해제를 하세요.
♻️🗑️✨쓰레기 처리: 쓰레기를 처리하여 가치를 높입니다. 모든 비트가 중요합니다!
🔍📦💰희귀 아이템 찾기: 돈이나 금괴와 같은 귀중한 아이템을 쓰레기에서 수색하세요.

title: Nyric
description:
게임 정보
Explore. Survive. Shape the Unknown.
Nyric is an open-ended survival game where your imagination shapes the universe. Use prompt-based world generation to bring surreal realms to life, then venture into the unknown to gather resources, uncover secrets, build settlements and leave your mark.
Chart Your Path
Type a phrase—"A city of glowing fungi," "A world trapped in eternal twilight," "A storm-haunted wasteland"—and Nyric generates an uncharted realm for you to explore. Whether you're wandering through a dream or surviving a nightmare with friends, no two journeys are ever the same.
Collectable AI Companions
You're not alone. Strange, ever-curious Faebots accompany you, offering guidance, mischief, and unexpected insight. Some are eager to assist, others follow their own whims—but all will leave their mark on your journey.

title: Games of the Monarch's Eye
description:
게임 정보
Steel, strategy, sabotage - or forbidden magic? How far will you go to defeat your greatest rival and win glory in the grandest tournament in the entire realm? Will you win back your honor or spark a revolution?
Games of the Monarch’s Eye is a Silk Road inspired interactive fantasy novel by Saffron Kuo. It’s entirely text-based, includes hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
After a decade in disgrace, you have returned to your home city of Varze to compete for the title of Monarch’s Eye. In this grand tournament, the bravest Varzians compete in games of Intellect, Heart, and Might. The winner becomes the Monarch’s most trusted guard and advisor, gaining wealth, fame, and honor – everything that you have lost. The only catch? The current Eye - and therefore your main competition - is Casiola, once your childhood friend and now your bitterest rival.
But while you were gone, the city has grown volatile. Powerful factions vie for dominance and the guilds’ professional differences now spill over into political rivalries. On one side, the idealist Artisans, rumored to still dabble in the ancient magic of Celestia as they seek perfection in their crafts. On the other, the ambitious and pragmatic Merchants, constantly chasing fame and profit. Caught between them is the Monarch, striving for a peaceful revitalization for Varze - if only it can happen before the city tears itself apart with an all-out revolution. And the Games might make the perfect opportunity for the factions to make their first moves.
As you prepare for the Games, you must also navigate this factional strife. How will you forge your path to victory? Will you hone your blades, charm the public with your silver tongue, try to get ahead of your opponents with your careful observation of their strengths and weaknesses, or just cheat your way to the top? Will you dive into politics, currying favor with one faction or the other; or will you try to float aloof above them? Do you dare to seek wisdom in the stars, or from forgotten ancient tomes? Whatever path you take, your old rival is right on your heels - and if you’re not careful, you’ll fall behind and lose your honor once more.
Play as male, female, or nonbinary; gay, straight, bi, pan, or aromantic.
Push Varze’s culture towards commerce or craft, peace or war, tradition or modernity.
Compete in high-stakes tournaments to test your wits, strength, and eloquence!
Regain your lost honor through a performance of stellar integrity - or deceive, and sabotage every single one of your opponents! And what will you do if you find yourself fighting in the ring against your true love?
Uncover lost tomes of once-forbidden magic, and reveal the secrets of the stars!

title: Little Chef 2
description:
게임 정보
Little Chef 2 invites you back into the kitchen for a delightful cooking adventure filled with cozy vibes and whimsical fun! Whether you're a seasoned chef or just here for the laughs, this adorable sequel brings joy to every dish you create!
PHYSICS BASED
Enjoy physics-based interactions as you unleash your creativity across a variety of kitchens and charming settings. Grab ingredients and objects from the scene and toss them around at your will.
OVER 150 UNIQUE DISHES
No matter what you end up cooking, a huge variety of possible dishes make every ingredient count and allow you to throw anything into the pot!
CUTE & HIDDEN INTERACTIONS
company: Julien Truebiger, Hello Erika, Danny van Duist

title: Aooni The Horror of Blueberry Onsen
description:
게임 정보
Challenge yourself while being chased by fear! A horror puzzle action adventure!
■A completely new version of the legendary horror game "Ao Oni"!
[What is the new "blue tragedy" unfolding at the abandoned hot spring?]
The once-popular hot spring inn known for its "beauty-enhancing hot spring" is now a ruin.
There was a rumor that it was haunted.
Hiroshi, Takeshi, Mika, and Takuro visit the abandoned hot spring inn to record “Mika Channel” and encounter a “suspicious man” and “Ai” there...
What is the Blueberry Hot Spring found in the abandoned inn, and what awaits them in its deepest depths...?
Can Hiroshi and the others escape safely?
■Many new systems have been added!
There are many new elements such as conversations with characters, cooperative play with friends, and a chat function.
In addition, many new species of blue demons appear! There is even a monster in the form of a humanoid dog...?
■The fastest game ever! 16x speed mode” has been added!
In “High Speed Mode” you can freely choose between 2x and 16x speed!
Can you escape from the "Ao Oni" chasing you at high speed?
■Online ranking function added!
Participate in online ranking by your score when you clear the game!
Play quickly and without mistakes, and aim for a high score!
autokwd: Aooni The Horror of Blueberry Onsen,青鬼 ブルーベリー温泉の怪異

title: Mashina
description:
게임 정보
Mashina is a digging adventure by the developers behind Judero. You play as Mashina, a friendly mining robot tasked with finding minerals to help mend, build and nurture her quirky robot community.
Gameplay 
The Gameplay in Mashina is divided into two distinct sections; a deep, mysterious underground full of trinkets and minerals and a vibrant, fully explorable 3D Overground.
company: Talha and Jack Co, J King-Spooner,

title: The Last of them
description:
게임 정보
Exploring the Map
Explore mysterious locations, and navigate their way to freedom. Every corner holds the potential for discovery and adventure.
Intense Combat with Guns
Experience the thrill of action-packed gunfights. Engage enemies with precision and strategy, using a variety of weapons to overcome formidable challenges.
Every encounter tests your skills and decision-making under pressure.

title: Chamrosh
description:
게임 정보
Chamrosh is hack-n-slash Action game that came from Persian mythology.where players assume the role of FEREYDOUN in his quest to hunt down and dispose of demons in his way to find Chamrosh.
ENTER THE WORLD OF CHAMROSH

almost thousand years ago , A Covenant was made Chamrosh Legendary Champion have been choose to protect Persia Nation to eternity, the other Legends called gods and Kaveh the blacksmith made an spell on him to make him immortal but this curse will turn him to stone and only kaveh’s blood and anahita’s feather will turn him back to life again.
After a long time persia needs chamrosh again to fight against Greece’s army in this 600 YO war and finish this, but even gods without chamrosh couldn’t go into the world of chamrosh and only kaveh’s bloodline can go, so keyumars the last generation of kaveh have been sent to the world of chamrosh to turn him back to life again but he have been ambushed on the way and couldn’t make it.
But there was another person with kaveh’s bloodline, a kid, named fereydoun son of keyumars , the child grown up with gods, in many years they taught fereydoun how to fight and slay, now is the time to send him to the world of chamrosh…

PLAY AS A HIGHLY TRAINED DEMON SLAYER

Start your destiny with Fereydoun son of Kiamars, the latest generation of Kaveh the blacksmith, who is the last person that can turn Chamrosh alive.he is traveling to Chamrosh's world for the first time and will fight with orcs and demons .he is looking for who killed his father and his vengeance for Loss of his father makes him angry and wants to revenge.


for the first time we brings Persian elder gods and their powers in this game,you can see who they are and their abilities.they will help you in this journey and will give you their powers.listen to them,they will guide you,and you can meet Persian legendary warriors and kings of history.

this trailer is just a preview and will change in final release,we will try our best to fix all the bugs and improve animations and performance until final release and make you feel amazing.

title: Lost In The Open
description:
게임 정보


'Lost In The Open'를 위시리스트에 추가하세요!



전투가 당신을 중심으로 전개되는 가혹한 로그라이크 전술 RPG!

당신은 Ruedome의 지배자 Nrvesk입니다. 당신의 지배는 피비린내 나고, 억압적이며 불공평했습니다. 이웃 나라 Stratha와의 눈에 띄지 않는 전략 회의 중에 암살 시도가 있었습니다. 당신은 중상을 입었지만, 엘리트 경호원들에 의해 기적적으로 성을 빠져나갔습니다.

당신의 왕은 가장 강력한 자산이자 가장 큰 부담입니다. 왕을 어떻게 조종하느냐에 따라 당신이 생존할지 멸망할지 결정됩니다.

만약 당신의 왕이 죽으면 게임이 종료됩니다. 즉, 당신이 죽으면 게임 오버입니다!

자신을 보호하거나, 결과를 감수하십시오!



'Lost in the Open'은 도전적인 경험을 제공하기 위해 설계되었습니다. 적들은 당신을 위치에서 끌어내고, 함정에 빠뜨리며, 팀으로 협력하여 포위할 것입니다. 유닛을 배치하여 철벽의 전선을 구축하십시오. 하지만 측면과 무엇보다 왕을 보호하는 것을 잊지 마세요!





각 노드는 내러티브 선택을 제공합니다. 위험한 전투에 참여할 것인가, 작은 뇌물을 받을 것인가? 무작위 보상을 받을 기회를 얻기 위해 낯선 사람을 도울 것인가, 아니면 속임수에 걸릴 위험을 감수할 것인가?

또한 Strathaian 왕실 경비대가 끊임없이 추격해옵니다. 추격자들의 손에 빠지지 않도록 전략적으로 세계를 탐험해야 합니다.





적을 물리치고, 낯선 사람을 돕고, 상인과 거래하여 새로운 특성과 능력을 해제하고 장비를 업그레이드할 수 있습니다. 적을 측면에서 강력한 일격으로 공격하고, 여러 적을 한 번에 베거나, 전장의 아군에게 강력한 버프를 제공하십시오. 생존하기 위해 만나는 모집자를 단단하고 충성스러운 경호원으로 만들어야 합니다.

title: Tall Poppy 2
description:
게임 정보
About the game

In Tall Poppy 2, the tense exploration, action and puzzle-solving gameplay will keep players on their toes! Players join John and Emma Goldberg, a married couple who are forced to face the mischievous Tall Poppy and his new lackeys together!

With the sinister spirit unleashed, the island city of Boots Bay's population is slowly being possessed! Players will navigate through the city carefully so that they can avoid capture or possession all while trying to escape Tall Poppy's terror!

Both John and Emma have their own separate playable campaigns, allowing players to see the story from both characters’ perspectives. The fate of these two characters is in the players' hands as they work together to survive and get to the bottom of what is behind the terrifying attack on the city. Will they make it out alive?

Exciting gameplay – Engage in frantic combat with enemies, explore frightening corridors, solve puzzles to access areas and collect and use items discovered around the environment in a terrifying comedic fight for survival
Shooting - If players find the taser gun, they can shoot taser rounds and the Boots Bay citizens! With enough rounds, they can zap the possession out of them! Be careful though, rounds are hard to come by!
Climbing - Players can climb hard-to-reach areas!
Talking to characters - The world has some interesting characters to converse with!
Collecting objects - There are different objects in the world that will need to be collected and used for various reasons!
Inspecting - Players can inspect items for secret details, codes and lore!
Push/Pull - Moving objects out of the way or to help climb up a hard-to-reach place!










Welcome to the island of Boots Bay! The island is located in the middle of the pristine freshwater of Lake Huron. It was founded and built by French settlers in the year 1666 after a military conflict. It was a military outpost that later converted into a successful trading outpost. The indigenous population and French had trading relations that were very historic and highly regarded! Speaking of history, historians claim the island is named after the arc angel Bootelbub. However, some speculate it was named after the trading post's popular bever pelt boots!

Legend has it that there's a deeply hidden secret about the island's past. Some say they feel like they're being pulled...or...drawn to the island. City marketers jumped on this conspiracy theory and made the Boots Bay city motto "The island that you won't want to leave!"

The city is widely known for its European look and it's one of the city's main tourist attractions! You can visit some of the local attractions, such as, but not limited to...




















, husband to Emma and nephew to Lawrence Goldberg. John is a successful video game critic on a video-sharing website. He's known for his harsh criticisms, especially for horror games (ironically).


, wife to John. She's a live streamer who plays games and has a social media following. She's known for taking peace sign selfies mixed with the "duck face" expression in various locations.


, who's abnormally tall. His real name is Poppy Ericson. Due to his height, he often got picked on for being tall. His nickname was given to him by his old high school bully... John Goldberg. He was a grave digger for the city church until he got fired for "pranking distraught widowers as they grieved". He's known for being very curious and likes to explore places he shouldn't be exploring...

title: Uncounted Isles
description:
게임 정보
⚔️ From Greenhorn to legend in the Uncounted Isles! 🛡️
Step into the boots of a novice adventurer in the charming Uncounted Isles. You're not here to save the world... at least not yet. Your journey begins with humble tasks that seasoned legendes ignore, but don't be fooled these 'small' quests are the building blocks of your legend.

Progress from chasing mischievous rats to outsmarting crafty bandits and facing spine-chilling undead. Each quest, no matter how small, shapes your story and hones your skills. The beauty lies in the details: every village saved, every item recovered and every mystery solved brings you one step closer to uncovering a plot all other adventurers have overlooked.

Tailor your adventure to your style. Trade with quirky local villagers, discover unique loot and craft the perfect loadout for your evolving tactics. Will you become the go-to problem solver with a mastery of magic or the reliable sword-arm that villagers trust?

Thanks to the Adventurers' Guild's mystical death crystal, your journey never truly ends. Each setback is a chance to learn, adapt and come back stronger. Your safehouse awaits, ready for you to plan your next move. But beware: always store some fallback equipment to recover what's lost.

Uncounted Isles is a passion project, lovingly crafted by a solo developer using a custom-built game engine. This voxel-based, first-person fantasy roguelite RPG celebrates the small victories that lead to bigger adventures. Your support can help shape this indie game's future. Wishlist now on Steam or follow the adventure on Social Media to join our growing community of up-and-coming legendes!

Craft Your Legend, One Quest at a Time:
Flexible Roleplaying: Shape your character's destiny with our custom-built progression system
Living, Breathing World: Explore handcrafted islands enriched with procedural elements for variety
Immersive Perspective: Experience intense, up-close action with our first-person combat system
Roguelite Elements: Face consequences for failures, but retain progress and learn from each attempt
Economy: Engage in a rich item ecosystem through strategic looting and trading

title: Delilah
description:
게임 정보
Delilah is an old-school FPS set in a world divided between Humanity and Hell. Its main goal is to capture the magical formula of the great classics.



Two characters with unique loadouts
Varied encounters, from tight horror experiences to slaughter maps
Seven episodes (planned), each with a distinct theme and story
Authentic 2.5D graphics in 256 colors, multi-directional monster sprites
MIDI tunes emulating sounds straight from the 90's
Custom game engine that supports 3d and dynamic level geometry



A century ago a great hero has saved our species by closing the gates of Hell, but the billions of demons already on Earth didn't just magically disappear. Instead, while Humanity was slowly reconquering the planet, several Arch Devils have adapted to the rules of our dimension. They formed their own twisted governments (known as Circles), to use their populations as human shields.

Our two protagonists were born into this century-long cold war: one is an enforcer of the Transylvanian Daemocratic Circle, the other is an Anointed defender of Humanity.
Borington is a one-person game development team from Transylvania. My previous games include 'BlackChain' and 'Rum & Gun', both available on Steam.

title: System Purge: Hollow Point
description:
게임 정보
Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a challenging, atmospheric, and action-packed 2D platformer.

HOLLOW POINT
Cloned flesh is no substitute; you’ve saved no one real. Hollow Point continues the story of the first System Purge, adding six new surreal sectors to explore. Survive a litany of new obstacles and monstrous threats as you delve into the System’s very foundations…and beyond.

BEARTRAP MODE
After you've finished Hollow Point, tackle the game’s hardest challenge in Beartrap Mode. Play through an alternate story which remixes and redesigns every level from the original game, adding new obstacles, new secrets, and 4 brutally difficult boss encounters.

SPEEDRUN MODE
Put your skills to the test in 2 new speedrun categories. Jumps, deaths, and uncovered secrets are now tracked during each run.

title: Divine Doubt
description:
게임 정보
“I can give you that which you desire most. Your humanity.” This was all that was promised to Callum Röttwell in the mysterious email he received out of the blue one day. It was enough though for him to uproot his life and travel to the city of Starhaven to start anew. As an angel from a small town, he has to adapt quickly and learn how to interact with those he's never encountered before- demons. Especially since he must share a bedroom with one in a cramped apartment. Throughout this journey, Callum will meet many characters, explore the city of Starhaven, and dive deeper into what that strange email entails for him. But he must be wary, for his goddess is watching closely.


Features:

-Dialogue and exploration based RPG gameplay
-Engaging and original story
-Pixel artstyle
-Original soundtrack
-Many characters to meet and talk to
-Two different endings to get
-Many puzzles and minigames to do

Baked with love by Team Meatpie

title: Street Soccer Online
description:
게임 정보
a. General Introduction:
Street Soccer Online is a fast-paced multiplayer street soccer game that captures the energy and fun of the sport. With no rules to hold you back, this game delivers a pure, exhilarating soccer experience. Play as both a player and a goalkeeper, and immerse yourself in the spirit of street soccer!
b. Key Features:
No Rules Soccer: Feel the freedom and dynamism of street soccer.
Play as Both Player and Goalkeeper: Show your skills in every position on the field.
Fast and Fun: Simple controls make it easy to play, but hard to master.
Single Map: Compete and enjoy the game on one map for now. (New maps will be added)
Realistic Physics: Create strategies with realistic football movements and collisions

title: Laws of Nadragia
description:
게임 정보
중세 나라 나드라지아에서 혁명이 일어났습니다! 이제 나라는 왕이 아닌 그의 꼭두각시들이 다스립니다. 새로운 국가 권력 기관인 최고 대학회가 통치합니다. 옛 법들은 불타버렸고, 매일 새로운 법들이 만들어지고 있습니다. 새로운 폭정의 시대가 시작되었습니다.
검사로서 법과 사실을 이용하세요.
법과 재판 기록의 허점을 찾아 피고인에게 어떤 수단을 써서라도 유죄 판결을 얻으세요. 법은 매일 바뀌고, 재판도 그렇습니다. 사람들의 생명이 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
전체주의 국가에서 생존하세요.
나드라지아 당국은 유죄 판결 할당량 준수를 요구하며 당신의 모든 움직임을 감시하고 있습니다. 각 재판은 피고인뿐만 아니라 당신에게도 마지막이 될 수 있습니다.

title: Solnox - Grimoire of Seasons
description:
게임 정보
사계절과 지형 변화 효과를 활용하여 끊임없이 변화하는 전장을 마스터하세요. 나만의 덱을 구성하여 완벽한 시너지 효과를 내고 세 명의 수호자를 이끌고 부정한 생명체를 상대로 승리하는 방법을 배워보세요.




전장은 이제 당신의 것입니다. 다양한 계절 카드를 사용하여 계절의 힘을 불러일으켜 자신과 적의 밑에 놓인 타일을 바꾸세요. 플레이하는 모든 카드가 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 것입니다. 적들이 비슷한 힘을 발휘하여 당신의 죽음을 굳히기 때문에 예측할 수 없는 대학살에 대응하세요.



봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울. 사계절에 내재된 고유한 특성을 발휘하여 강력한 시너지 콤보를 만들어 무자비한 적을 물리치세요. 부패의 확산을 막으려는 헛된 시도로 죽어가는 세상을 되찾으세요.



수호자들은 힘을 합쳐야만 다가오는 타락으로부터 스스로를 지킬 수 있습니다. 매번 신중하게 덱을 구성하거나 실험적인 조합을 시도하여 세 명의 강력한 캐릭터 간의 시너지를 더욱 향상시키세요. 실패할 때마다 더 강해지고, 새로운 카드 슬롯을 잠금 해제하고, 더 강력하고 복잡한 카드를 수집하세요.

title: Tapes of Fear: Smile
description:
게임 정보


Tapes of Fear: Smile는 당신에게 극한의 공포를 안겨주기 위해 만들어졌습니다. 이 1인칭 심리 공포 게임은 플레이할 때마다 독특하고 무서운 경험을 보장합니다.



Tapes of Fear의 중심에는 Infinity Green Game Studio가 개발한 혁신적인 Infinity Fear System™이 있습니다. 공포를 유발하는 방법에 대한 학술 연구를 기반으로 개발된 이 고급 시스템은 실시간으로 사용자의 결정과 반응을 모니터링하고, 게임 이벤트를 동적으로 조정하여 공포를 극대화합니다. 이 시스템은 공포 경험이 지나치거나 부족하지 않도록 보장하여 완벽한 공포의 흐름을 유지합니다. 각 결정과 반응은 사건의 진행을 변화시켜 매번 새로운 무서운 경험을 제공합니다.

SMILE

title: Carbox
description:
게임 정보
Drive. Build. Share. 

Carbox is a Sandbox Driving game
With its easy-to-use and powerful editor, you can let your imagination run wild and create customized maps and races to play and share with other players.
Build your dream city, share it with the community, earn coins and rewards to get more vehicles and content. Drive and compete in an ever-expanding world of custom maps and races.
 
Features

Cars with hand-made designed physics and many different driving styles
World editor to create cities and circuits
Sharing platform to share your maps, and explore other player's cities
Asynchronous multiplayer and leaderboards
Tons of assets to unlock. Make your city unique!
Day-Night cycle
Custom Traffic System
Unlock cars and cities by racing and building

title: Almost My Floor: Duality
description:
게임 정보




Almost My Floor: Duality is a horror game with decision-making mechanics similar to "Dark Pictures" but in 2D. Endless subway mazes, cramped courtyards of high-rise buildings, and dark floors await a new victim. The game features multiple main characters, each capable of experiencing the story differently, or even not surviving at all.



The heroes will face both internal and external threats simultaneously. Their inner demons grow stronger, engulfing their minds in depression and pain. Meanwhile, the city sinks deeper into chaos, with people vanishing without a trace, and the police seem powerless. Rumors circulate about a growing anomaly. But who believes in such things?

Personal experiences of battling depression are woven into the game through images, stories, and thoughts. The characters, each with their own destiny and sorrow, fight differently for the right to live without the perpetual internal struggle with themselves. You must uncover the mysteries in the city, save loved ones, and not lose to your own demons.



In a world on the edge of imagination and reality, you will have to unravel all the mysteries of a provincial town before horror consumes your mind and body. More and more inexplicable disappearances flicker in the news reports, leaving the town's residents frightened by the unknown.












Main characters:



Chloe Freudgel - the daughter of a brilliant psychiatrist and scientist, who is remarkably intelligent for her age. To clear her father's name, she embarks on her own investigation.

Masha - a simple girl from an even more provincial town. To save her beloved, she will have to unravel the city's secrets.

Adam Trust - a private detective famous throughout the city thanks to the Freudgel case. He thought he had solved all the mysteries of House No. 9, with the criminal behind bars. But, as it turns out, not everything is so simple. The most important case in the detective's career is still unsolved.

title: Northanda Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
The Void threatens to devour the ancient realm of Northanda
Lead a party of legendary heroes in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Only your chosen champions have the power to stop the fabric of the cosmos from coming undone.
Recruit three heroes from countless possible combinations to form an unbreakable team. Heroes fill the roles Support, Slayer, and Defender, each bringing their own unique card library to a single, shared deck. Every combination opens new strategic possibilities:
Supports sustain the group with powerful buffs
Slayers exploit enemy weaknesses with devastating attacks
Defenders draw enemy focus and shield their allies from harm

title: PARAVOX
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of PARAVOX!

Navigate your way through the maps at lightning speed: In PARAVOX, players are able to use 'Double Jump', 'Blink', and 'High Jump' to soar through the battlefield, dodge enemy attacks, and launch surprise attacks with ease!

Secure the points: PARAVOX's gameplay revolves around capturing and holding 'Strike Points'. The first team to reach 100 points wins the round. Strike Points are contested areas that switch locations periodically. With each round change, the 'Respawn Time' increases. The dynamic nature of the points, coupled with the variety of maps and team compositions, demands a high level of strategic thinking and adaptability.

Ace the game using unique Brands: Weapons are tagged as “Brands” in the PARAVOXverse. From classic skill-based ARs and SRs to close-combat-oriented swords and Beam Magnums, the diverse weaponry offers a wide range of playstyles and team compositions. Each Brand boasts two skills which can significantly impact the battle's outcome. Lead your team to victory with mechanical prowess and top-notch strategies.



PARAVOX will continue to receive new content in the future. Don't miss out on PARAVOX, the pinnacle of esports shooters!


WASD keys: Movement
Shift: Blink
Space: Jump
Left click: Main fire
Right click: Sub-fire/zoom/scope
R: Reload
F: Primary skill
Q: Secondary skill

title: Chyss
description:
게임 정보
Chyss is a turnbased, tactical 1vs1 game based on chess.
You can move, attack, and consume your mana to spells and use items when it's your turn.
Your goal is to destroy your opponent's Leader!

The year is 12022.
Number of civilisations evolved from primitive life to being able to travel the universe.
In this universe, a game has evolved to become essential: The Chyss.

The Chyss has its roots in chess, but many have added to the rules in order to create its successor. A timeless, universal, and balanced game, allowing interplanetary competition, where fair play, game intelligence and risk-taking are the traits of legendary players.
Young children want to become great Chyss players, the vast majority of adults play, whether to have fun, relax, explore the possibilities, or to pursue their childhood dreams.

In this universe, a phenomenon affects about a third of the people...
About a third of people become incarnates overnight. Falling asleep as themselves, they wake up controlled by different, higher forces.
These forces do not want their loss, but simply direct their steps, their actions.

You are this higher force which is going to take control of an inhabitant of this universe.
You, and all the other players of this video game...
You will embody an incarnate.

This incarnate is now you.
Your goal will be determined by you. You can become the best Chyss player in the universe, but there are many pitfalls along the way.
There are many extremely strong, clever players in this universe.
The best Chyss player in the universe is anonymous. She is only known as "The Galaxy Queen".
Good luck! And battle with pride.

title: Lamia's Bambina
description:
게임 정보
Train the best, most powerful Lamias!
WORLD
In an impoverished demon world ravaged by the war between man and beast, the Lamia tribe are on the verge of extinction.

Ivy, reincarnated into the demon world as the Lamia tribe's savior, along with princess Hedera aim for the revival of their tribe. Play as Ivy as you multiply and raise Lamias and battle the Harpy tribe to reclaim the Lamia Palace.
DUNGEONS
Battles take place in demon world dungeons with familiar 2D maps. Explore the dungeons again and again and defeat the bosses waiting in their depths.
Classic command-style turn-based battles. The key to good battle strategy is to form your party to take advantage of each Lamia's characteristics, choosing from Lamias skilled at physical attacks to those specializing in magic attacks. Lead your Lamias to victory.
Not only will you find Lamias, but you'll also see Harpies, Fairies, and other familiar monsters complete with up-tempo*** conversations and stories in an enjoyable pixel art demon world.

The Lamia training system is scheduled to be released in Summer 2024, when Japan is scorching hot.

Don't miss the latest Lamia's Bambina ("LamiBam") information!

title: 万词破 - 单词女友 WCP Word Girlfriend
description:
게임 정보
An "accident" has caused you, who are about to graduate from university, to lose some important memories, including important events, important people, and a significant portion of your vocabulary. In urgent need of improving your vocabulary to meet the requirements of your future job, you joined an experimental project called the "Ten Thousand Words Club." There, you encountered three women whose destinies are intertwined with yours.
Gameplay Overview:
You need to choose a vocabulary book and set your own study plan, including learning methods, the number of new words and reviews per day, and more. After completing these learning tasks, you can earn virtual currency rewards, increase the teaching assistants' affection levels, and unlock new storylines.
* After completing the daily study plan, you can choose to continue working or battling in the virtual world to earn virtual currency and experience points, or you can improve your attributes by working with a fitness trainer. Whether it's "working," "battling," or "working out," all are vocabulary mini-games with a review function. While playing the game, you also enhance your mastery of previously learned words.
* The development of the storyline will change based on the affection levels of the teaching assistants and your choices. To pursue the teaching assistant you like, you need to select her as your current teaching assistant, complete learning tasks according to your set plan, and earn virtual currency to buy her gifts.
* The main antagonist in the game also has his eyes on these three beautiful teaching assistants, considering you as his rival. He will occasionally challenge you with word challenges. Defeat him, and you'll receive substantial rewards!
Game Features:
* Multiple motivational factors: The presence of virtual teaching assistants, cultivating word girlfriends, exploring multiple endings, facing challenges from the antagonist, rewards from vocabulary mini-games, a rich achievement system, and more. Each aspect of the game is designed to provide you with continuous motivation to learn vocabulary.
* More scientific, user-friendly, and personalized learning methods: We understand the drawbacks of traditional vocabulary learning methods. We have made vocabulary learning more dynamic and moderately intense to reduce user frustration and drowsiness. We prioritize the user learning experience and do not mindlessly recommend vocabulary words that exceed the user's learning capacity. We offer multiple learning methods, allowing users to customize their learning based on their actual situations and make adjustments at any time.
autokwd: 万词破 - 单词女友 WCP Word Girlfriend

title: A Piano Tale
description:
게임 정보
피아노고 스튜디오(Pianogo Studio)의 프랑스 팀은 빠르게 움직이는 이 세상에서 음악과 그림을 사랑하는 분들을 위해 느리고 고요하고 사색적이며 몰입적인 게임을 제안합니다.

피아노 테일(Piano Tale)은 음악적 지략의 요소와 더불어 이야기가 있는 게임입니다. 게임은 가상의 음악가 알렉산드라 아로노비치의 이야기를 따라 그녀의 삶의 여러 단계를 거칩니다. 노년에 들어서 그녀는 알츠하이머 병을 앓고 있는 할머니가 됩니다. 알렉산드라는 소련 스탈린주의 시대의 작곡가였던 아버지 보리스 아로노비치가 체제 전복적인 비밀스런 협주곡을 작곡했다는 사실을 알게 됩니다. 당시 예술가들은 원하는 것을 원하는 대로 만들 수 없던 시대였죠. 그의 협주곡은 딸 알렉산드라를 위한 곡이었고, 이 협주곡을 찾는 일은 대부분의 나레이션에서 중요한 동기가 됩니다. Point&Click 단계와 키보드를 통한 음악적 지략의 게임에서 플레이어의 성공에 따라 세 가지의 결말이 있을 수 있습니다. 알렉산드라가 자신의 병에도 불구하고 기억을 되찾을 수 있었는지, 그리고 아버지로 인해 힘들고 엄격했던 자신의 어린 시절에도 아버지를 용서하게 되는지 볼 수 있습니다.

title: Abyss Fantasia
description:
게임 정보


In the mystical world of “Abyss Fantasia”, players will take on the role of the “missing” girl, Eugaly, as she embarks on an expedition into the Abyss. Here, you'll encounter a diverse cast of characters and unexpected adventures. The treasures you find in your exploration and the choices you make can be collected in the “The Bok of Fate” and transformed into cards. Utilize these cards to unravel complex mysteries, alter the destiny of the characters you meet, and confront the perilous monsters dwelling in the Abyss.



The Abyss, a massive chasm on the continent, is deep and mysterious, with no end in sight. Those who venture into it are affected by the Abyss, with the weak-willed losing their sanity and humanity, twisted into unrecognizable forms. Yet, the precious treasures hidden within lure explorers to journey into its depths.

title: Radical Striker
description:
게임 정보
We are creating a 2D fighting action game by adding stage action elements to the 2D fighting game.
Production is an indie team with one person.
In the game, we are developing 2D fighting battles in one-to-many and multi-to-many so that you can play them on low-spec PCs.

Multiple heroes can be selected, and other fighting styles will be added as the characters level and stats rise.
You can continuously attack like a 2D fighting game.
Since it is basically assumed to be one-to-many, you can avoid it by warping when you are attacked as a evasion in case of being attacked by pinching.



----- World view / Story -----
Not yet published.

title: Another Day with You
description:
게임 정보

You have a date to make! But, it looks like you got there too early... Explore a quiet corner of the bustling city by interacting with locals, playing games at the arcade, fishing, and much more. Leave your date waiting, or fail to impress them with your natural charisma, and you'll be left on "read".



However, walk the walk and talk the talk, and you may have just secured yourself a second date!

There are many minigames to find around the city. These include fishing, playing arcade games, hide and seek, and more! The activities you choose to partake in will affect the available topics of conversations with your date. Pay close attention, as your date may have some questions for you regarding these activities.


Whether you are spending the day in the arcade or picking out flowers for your potential lover, . Spend your time wisely to get the most out of your day. If you miss out on something, there's always , and another chance for love.

title: Space gold rush TD
description:
게임 정보
Space Gold Rush is a unique hybrid of tower-defense and real-time-strategy. Set in the not distant future where space travel has become viable to everyone. In the frontiers of space where there is the unexplored, also means there is untapped resources. No time to waste mining and extracting, and no regulators to setup health and safety laws and procedures, risk it all and join the many other prospectors in a new hazardous industry blowing up asteroids anyway they can in order to strike it rich.

7 Different Towers each with their own upgrade options to specialize their stats (damage, fire rate, and range).

Mobile Turrets able to set up any where and reposition to fit different roles or when plan A does not go well.

title: Unheeded Influences
description:
게임 정보
Plot
You awake in the dark as an elemental soul. You have no memories or strength. Chaos, an indistinct guide, teaches you about intuition and what are energies and how to shape them at will.
You learn about the 12 Natures and the 3 realms where spirits, divines, and living coexist. You start your journey accompanied by an odd and useless Egyptian fennec.
You incarnate, travel through worlds, and influence human life. Soon enough you discover the mark of the biggest realms' threat ever. And it seems you were its first victim, interrupting your old plans...
Stay immersed with our website
As an Elemental soul, you live among our mythologies that coexist
You are a soul and you are imbued with 12 different Natures, such as fire, water, time...
You evolve in the spiritual realms and travel to mystical places.
As a spirit, you'll love taking on the appearance of the living and inspiring dreamwalkers.

title: Dark Age Dinos
description:
게임 정보
Travel alone or with friends through the land of Cretacia - a land of war, banditry and dinosaurs. Each mission is a short, self-contained journey with its own enemies, ability combinations, loot and objectives. Your friend can't make it tonight? They can join you on the next mission tomorrow without getting left behind. Or you can strike out on your own. We get it, not everybody wants to share the power and glory.
Every mission is different and not every journey ends in victory. You'll recruit new characters with each outing, so even defeat has its upside. What are you waiting for? Cretacia isn't going to save itself!

title: Hit and Boom
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT THIS GAME

Hit and Boom is a free-to-play game developed by combining MOBA & Battle Royale game mechanics, where you look down on the battlefield and overwhelm your opponents with every skill shot you hit.

Choose one of the characters equipped with unique weapons and different gameplay styles; step onto the battlefield alone or with your friends, be ready for a fierce battle and use all your skills to survive as the circle closes down!

MOBA and Battle Royale Together!
In Hit and Boom, you will find features familiar from both MOBA and Battle Royale genres. We bring the best features of both game types into a single game, doubling the fun, adrenaline, and action.



Massive Battlefield
Imagine a standard MOBA map for 10 people. Now multiply that map by 4. That equals Hit and Boom Battlefield! You will have the opportunity to strategize endlessly on this massive map. You don't have to struggle with the same opponent in a single corridor for minutes. Different regions, different tactics and different routes in every match. You may feel like a tourist in the Hit and Boom map in your first matches, but as you explore the map, you will become the guide of your team. Don't lose your group!


Instead of trying to get along with hundreds of characters, mastering the skill/weapon sets of your favorite character will be enough. Hit and Boom characters have multiple unique weapons. What does your team need? A close range brawler? A long range sniper? Maybe more mobility? All you need to do is choose the most suitable weapon for your favourite character before entering the match and strategize accordingly,




We have removed MANA and other skill usage resource systems, which we often encounter in MOBA and RPG games and make us feel "do I have enough money in my pocket?" throughout the game. You don't have to worry about your money... Sorry, your MANA. Use your combos most effectively during the battle without worrying about the skill resource.


It gets boring to live the same scenario in all matches due to limited and repetitive strategies in each match. Thanks to the map design, different characters, varied weapons, and mechanics that Hit and Boom has, every battle becomes unique. You can apply different strategies in each match and increase your gaming pleasure exponentially.




Poor minions... They were tortured, destroyed, robbed, and mocked in every game. Of course, there are heroic stories about them as well. They turned matches around, they scored important points... But they are tired now. Players are tired too. There are no minions in the Hit and Boom battlefield. We retired the minions in Hit and Boom without working a single day. We will pay their retirement pensions. You enter a fierce battle on the battlefield without worrying about minion farming. Minions are with us.


There's no need to fight with your teammates for jungle camps. Because in Hit and Boom, the camps are everywhere! Hunt the creatures in the camps for the gold and power-ups and become a force to be reckoned with! But don't forget that this is a team game! So all the loot and power-ups acquired from camps will be distributed between your teammates. So don't argue with your friends over 2 gold coins. If you don't like camping, then go hunting for opponents instead. But remember! The power-ups that the creatures in the camps will provide you, can change the course of battle in your favor.

title: Upfall
description:
게임 정보
Upfall is a game about bouncing, dodging, and dying. Escape the depths by bouncing on bubbles and avoid the hazards which slowly present themselves. Glowing red = danger... at least to start with! Each new depth you reach causes the colours to change and the hazards to increase, with enough random generation so each upfall is never the same. It's not easy, but with fast restarts and quick rounds you'll find yourself coming back over and over.
Can you find your way back to the surface?
Totally, utterly free – The world isn't great right now for a lot of people so we wanted to give back. Upfall is completely free - no ads, no monetisation, no catch
Quick rounds – Each fall takes between 2 and 10 minutes so you can play between other games or on your lunch break
Unlocks and customisation – Unlock new colour palettes, audio styles, ambiences, and characters to customise how the game looks and sounds
Keyboard or controller – Play keyboard only, feel the controller vibrate, or watch the DualShock 4/DualSense controller light change colour to reflect the game state
Chill but eerie – Simple rules with a creepy, no-jump scares, atmosphere to keep you engaged and coming back
A game by Amicable Animal with art from eggysworld and piano samples from Luci Holland.
(Just so you know: this game is provided as is, and we can't offer support as it's free. It is built in Unity so if you can play Unity games it should run fine!)

title: NecroTactics
description:
게임 정보


Build and battle against an army of the undead as you attempt to kill Death itself. Grow your undead army overtime and develop your graveyard with traps and towers to survive as long as possible.
💀 Create Your Own Synergies!

📜 Features
Develop a Huge Army of 100 Total Units!
Place Structures to Bolster Your Army
Cast Fireballs, Lightning Strikes and Poison Bombs
Fight a Giant Boss and Their Army
Earn Achievements

I want your help to make NecroTactics better so if you want to be a part of the testing and give me feedback you can reach me (Jerome) on Discord. Thank you to everyone who has supported the development of my past games as you have made this game possible!

title: Trials of Cascadia
description:
게임 정보


As the son of a farmer, Isaac had always dreamt of one day becoming a Paladin like the Chosen Hero, Zvarus. A man whose bravery was legendary and who stood down in the face of no foe. After a year of training with Orman's father Orlan, a retired Paladin general, Isaac sets off with his sword and holy book alongside his friend to vanquish the forces of Darkness that beset the world.

But not all is as it seems on the surface. Those who presume to speak in the name of justice may abuse their power, while those who commit heinous acts may do so out of perceived necessity. Sometimes, even certain facets of history are conveniently omitted. But the truth is out there waiting to be found, as the friends soon find out. Will they do the right thing, or play it safe? Only time will tell.





-A story-focused RPG. Explore Cascadia in an unfolding narrative to discover the world's true story, that spans multiple continents, and possibly multiple dimensions

-Custom artwork to bring the game alive with a vivid watercolor aesthetic

-Custom sound and meditative, emotional music reminiscent of 90's JRPGs

-A plethora of items and equipment to discover

-Special Artifacts that can empower your entire party

-Optional side quests strewn throughout the world map that may increase your reputation

-Playable with controller, keyboard or mouse





-A charming cast of unique characters, each with their own stories, roles, abilities and skill augments. Mix and match for your favorite group

-Build TP with normal attacks, and then spend them on flashy spells and specials. Gain Pwr with damage or healing to boost your morale

-Delay enemy actions and cancel spells altogether with instant cast skills

-Use elemental debuffs from offensive magic spells to stack weaknesses on your enemy

-Unleash devastating 5 TP ultimate attacks

-Over 50 different enemies for you to encounter, including rare enemies (and even some friendly encounters)











A new recruit to the Paladin order, Isaac is eager to prove himself to his superiors and make his parents proud. What he lacks in experience, he makes up for in talent.
Isaac is able to heal the party and cure various debuffs, but he can also dish out massive damage using his Light-based abilities such as Lumina Blade. He has a higher critical chance than others.




Isaac's best friend from a young age. Although somewhat boisterous and headstrong, Orman has the heart of a hero. He doesn't always like to follow the rules.
Orman is able to protect the party by drawing the enemy's attention and blocking physical attacks with his shield. He excels at interrupting spells and has several defensive utilities up his sleeve.




A mysterious and proud elven girl with pink hair, she is able to wield the power of the elements. Although her motives are unclear, she seems to have peaceful intentions.
Aiya can't take as much abuse as the Paladins, but she has the highest damage potential. When using her magic spells, she can also gain enchantments for her dagger, which can be stacked for exponential damage amounts.




An eccentric man who claims to be an oracle, and hundreds of years old. He claims to guide the party towards their destiny, but his past remains obscured.
Mondrus is a hybrid between a healer and a caster. He can cast nature spells which make the enemy more vulnerable or restore the party and apply shields. While his spells are cheaper to cast, they take a short time to recharge.

title: Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog
description:
게임 정보


Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog is a top-down 2D story-driven adventure game inspired by true events in Bangkok, Thailand 2017. The game lets you experience the harsh life of a homeless man who tries to cope with his mental struggle of the cruelty of the world. The story is framed by an interview he gives to a famous blogger, about how a chance encounter with a stray dog made him regain his sense of self once more.



What could make a man homeless? Is it one's family's financial situation? Is it the government? Is it because of our friends? Or... is it because of oneself?

Explore a journey from his childhood to the present. Unravel what made a man lose everything.

title: Respark
description:
게임 정보
The Ultimate Fireworks Roguelite!
Handheld sparklers, poppers, firecrackers, bottle rockets, and even skyrockets! In Respark, engage in thrilling and intense combat, using all kinds of hanabi (fireworks) to outsmart and overcome your enemies!




Each course is automatically and randomly generated. Not only will the terrain and enemies change, but the important items you find will also differ with each playthrough. Your choices shape your adventure!
Set in the whimsical world of Animalia, where animals have formed a civilized society, Respark offers a dazzling experience. The charming visuals combined with AAAA's catchy and wonderful background music create a joyous gaming journey for both newcomers and seasoned players.
To give you a taste of Respark's magic, we've prepared a special demo! Out of the 8 worlds in the full game, you can explore World 1, 4, and 7! While the demo doesn’t include the storyline or the save/load feature, you’ll still get to experience the thrill of reaching the final phase. Can you conquer the boss of World 7?

Note: The demo version supports keyboard and mouse operation only.

title: V's Rage
description:
게임 정보
“Rise from your bed…”
Those are the words V, an overworked wife and mother, hears as she wakes up in her worst nightmare: she has been cursed and trapped in a videogame by a mysterious entity. Now she must beat any foe unlucky enough to cross her path, and free herself from a crazy low-poly world inhabited by odd creatures. She got a pan, she got rage, and she will beat them all.

title: TRAINS: Electrostorm
description:
게임 정보
Humanity found itself in a quagmire. Electric storms covered most of the planet, world wars, revolutions and endless greed led to the collapse of civilizations. The really dark ages have come, illuminated by electric flashes and lightning.
The middle of the XX century, an alternative story, we play as a girl Anya, an electrician in a small neighborhood.. Trains do not run, they are chained at stations with huge chains. Their task now is to extract energy from electric shutters. People have already forgotten that the railway was created to move between cities.

Anya learns that Trains are not just power plants, if they are released and put on rails, they will help clear the world of electric storms and pull humanity out of the Dark Ages. But would they believe her? Do the survivors want change?

Find the answers and make your decision in the busy world of electropunk.
Gameplay
You play as Anna and have to free Trains at stations. You will meet a variety of enemies and new friends will help you.

Use the Gauss-pistol and modify it. Shoot further and more accurately or hit enemy soldiers with a volley of needles.

You can use the power of the magnetic field to throw heavy objects at enemies, create a protective shield and even levitate!

Drive Trains to move between stations. Solve electrical puzzles and quests.

title: Survivter
description:
게임 정보

Different builds

A large number of bosses

Several modes

title: Raindrop Umbrella
description:
게임 정보
Defeat your enemies with umbrella action!

Raindrop Umbrella is an exploration 2D action game (Metroidvania). In a world where it has been raining for a long time and everything has collapsed and been transformed, you will use mechanical umbrellas created using lost technology to advance your adventure.


You can learn new skills by defeating bosses and exploring. They will surely help you in your adventures.


You can punch enemies, step on umbrellas and jump up high......



The protagonist Shizuku sets out for the altar in the sky to check on the whereabouts of his friend Ame, who has gone missing after a certain ritual. Will Shizuku be able to find Ame again and return home?

title: The Bunker Notes - Horror/Drama Visual Novel
description:
게임 정보

《벙커일기》 이 작품은 영화감독 김성찬의 동명 단편 소설을 원작으로 한 심리 드라마이며, 이를 비주얼 노벨로 각색한 작품이다. 이야기는 전례 없는 속도로 인간을 파괴하는 바이러스가 퍼지는 팬데믹 속에서 시작된다. 주인공은 그 위협에 대비한 몇 안 되는 사람 중 한 명이었다. 그는 세상과 단절된 채 자율 벙커에 숨어드는 데 성공했다. 그러나 때때로 고독은 구원이 될 수도, 절망이 될 수도 있다. 결국, 철문 너머에서 들리는 작은 소리는 감염자의 신호일 수 있고, 그림자는 언제든 나를 없애려는 적이 될지도 모른다.
흑백 톤의 음울한 이야기, 포스트 아포칼립스 유럽을 배경으로 함🖊

오리지널 프로페셔널 연극적 사운드 디자인과 다크 앰비언트 사운드🖊
인간의 두려움과 편집증의 심연에 빠져들어라🖊
autokwd: The Bunker Notes - Horror/Drama Visual Novel,The Bunker Notes 벙커일기

title: Farmistic
description:
게임 정보
Farmistic is a top-down farming simulation game in early development by an independent developer.
Manage your farm
In Farmistic you'll be in charge of managing your farm. The fields need to be plowed, cultivated, drilled and harvested. The grain and corn has to be stored or sold, and the cycle repeats. Start small and get your hands dirty driving the tractors yourself. With your first profits, you can buy more and bigger machinery, and start automating the tasks.

Maybe you want to keep your farm small and comfy for a relaxing experience?
Or will you buy up all the land, let others do the work, and become the ultimate agricultural tycoon?
Farming
Fields need plowing, cultivating, drilling, fertilization, harvesting... a never ending duty! The dealership provides a range of small, medium and large tractors and different sizes of machinery for different fields. You'll need:
Tractors
Plows
Cultivators
Seed drills
Combine harvesters
Trailers
Mowers
Rakes
Balers
Animals
Your animals are going to be hungry! Cows will need hay and straw, chickens require grain. Don't forget the water and logistics to get it to your animals! If they are well taken care of, they reward you with milk and eggs, which can be sold for a nice profit.
Immersive mode
Get your hands dirty and drive/operate the machinery yourself in immersive mode. No need for others to do the work if you want the fun all for yourself!

title: Dicey Birdball
description:
게임 정보
Dicey Birdball is a roguelike strategy sports game where you manage a team of birds playing football. Roll dice and assign them to your birds to maneuver, score goals, and win the championship. Enact leaguewide rule changes to evolve the sport of Birdball, from increasing the size of the field to summoning iceberg obstacles to touchdown teleportation.

Each run you'll take control of a different team with their own unique story and objective. Win enough matches to make it to the championship and fulfill the team's objective. Between matches you'll make decisions to improve the team such as gaining new abilities, drafting new dice, and enacting new rules.

Feature List:
Compete in turn-based, grid-based football matches using a team of up to 3 birds from 5 different classes.
Manage a team of different bird classes, each with their own unique set of abilities.
Spend seeds on new dice to increase the number of moves you can make each turn.
Guide the evolution of the sport by choosing which rules change over time, such as expanding the field and allowing alternate scoring mechanism.
Unlock new teams with different bird combinations to play with.
Unlock the ability to create your own team with custom colors and team composition.

title: Star Shift Freelancers
description:
게임 정보
There are no levels in Star Shift Freelancers; skills and stat increases are managed by Knowledge Points acquired from battle.
In addition to the standard turn-based combat, there is a tactical battle system for fleet and army combat.

title: World's Worst Handyman
description:
게임 정보
세계 최악의 일꾼은 당신을 코미디와 잠입의 세계로 안내합니다. 손재주는 형편없지만 마음은 착한 일꾼, 더그가 되어 플레이하세요. 사랑하는 동물 보호소를 파산 위기에서 구하는 따뜻한 미션을 시작하세요.
엉망진창인 작업 현장을 탐색할 때, 어떤 일이든 완전히 꼬여버릴 수 있으니 마음의 준비를 해야 합니다!
더그는 놀랍도록 값싼 인건비 덕에 찾는 사람이 많습니다! 으스스한 농장부터 우주 정거장까지, 특이하기 짝이 없는 환경에서 수리 작업을 하세요.
너무 작거나, 너무 이상하거나, 너무 위험한 일은 없습니다.

title: Nocturne
description:
게임 정보
Rhythm Combat
Master an entirely skill based rhythm combat with fierce battles and unexpected challenges. With multiple difficulty options, Nocturne is a game suitable for beginners and veterans of the rhythm genre.


 
Find equipment to unlock powerful combat buffs or abilities. Defeat enemies to unlock them in Arcade mode, where you can challenge them again for highscores.  
Rich Narrative
The digital afterlife survived humanity's extinction.
Nocturne is a story-driven RPG set within a digital afterlife. Millennia have passed since humanity's extinction; but somehow you've only just arrived.



Your consciousness was uploaded to a world where a sentient AI has taken control, twisted creatures roam the land, and a vast corruption spreads.
Make friends, battle enemies, and traverse a beautiful world as it falls apart around you. The perfect balance of heart-pumping musical combat, magnificent worldbuilding and deep story.
 
Nocturne was inspired by decades of traditional RPG's that immerse you in fantasy worlds.

title: Shadows of Soldiers
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding action of "Shadows of Soldiers," an adrenaline-fuelled 8v8 third-person cover-based tactical multiplayer shooter! Prepare to embark on an epic battlefield adventure, where strategic choices and teamwork determine victory.
                                         Select your role from three distinct classes:
Juggernaut - Unleash raw power on the battlefield as the mighty Juggernaut. Armed with devastating weaponry and fortified armor, you're a force to be reckoned with. Crush
your enemies and lead your team to glory.
                                                  Shadow - Become the master of stealth and precision. As a Shadow, you can slip into the darkness, surprising foes with deadly efficiency. Employ your cunning and agility to
outmaneuver enemies and strike from unexpected angles.

title: Blood Accord
description:
게임 정보
야나는 두 명의 가장 친한 친구와 함께 공중 화장실에 갇힌 채 깨어납니다. 한 명은 불 같은 성격에 날카로운 말솜씨를 가진 용감한 영혼, 비카입니다. 다른 한 명은 부드럽고 따뜻한 마음을 가진 조화로운 영혼, 랼랴입니다.
처음에는 야나는 안도감을 느낍니다. 혼자가 아니니까요. 그녀가 세상 누구보다 사랑하는 소녀들과 함께 있다는 사실에 마치 하늘이 내려준 축복처럼 느껴집니다.
하지만 시간이 지날수록 좁은 공간은 더 이상 안식처처럼 느껴지지 않고 감옥처럼 느껴집니다.
말 못할 긴장감이 감돌고, 오래전 묻어두었던 비밀들이 수면 위로 떠오르기 시작합니다.
녹슨 수도꼭지에서 떨어지는 핏방울 하나하나가 과거는 잊혀져서는 안 된다는 것을 상기시켜 줍니다.

title: Penelope Pendrick and the Art of Deceit
description:
게임 정보


A phone call from a small, out of state police force was the last thing writer Penelope Pendrick was expecting that morning. But, it wasn't long after that she was boarding a flight to the quaint old town of Carlisle, Connecticut. When debriefed, Penelope learns her job is to join the search for three missing people; an older man who owns a local bookstore, a mysterious woman who keeps to herself, and a troublemaking teenage boy – the only common link between them being that they disappeared from the same town, within the same week. The Sergeant is stumped.

Once she begins to unravel the case, Penelope realizes that there’s something deeper – stranger – going on here. Unusual ties form between four deceptive suspects, each with something to gain and each with something to lose. Motives and suspicions weave in and out as Penelope uses her wits and penchant for rule-breaking to search for answers; some of which died with an eccentric and mysterious local artist fifty years ago. As the danger escalates, a timer begins to tick down on the lives of the missing. All that Penelope knows for sure is that there’s more to the town of Carlisle than it would appear, and that one wrong move could make this first case her last.

Game Features

Explore the town of Carlisle
Interrogate four unique suspects
Steer the conversation with non-linear dialogue
Your choices matter - speak wisely!
Solve unique puzzles inspired by a famous artist
Don't get caught when you snoop!
autokwd: Penelope Pendrick and the Art of Deceit

title: Wild Haven
description:
게임 정보
Wild Haven is a 4x nature builder about a small spirit rebuilding a polluted world. Explore the world around you, clean up the pollution left behind, bring back plants and animals, and grow your woodland forest. Unlock your full potential by helping ancient spirits and selecting upgrades to build a vibrant ecosystem.
Build complex ecosystems
Build your forest and discover unique and varied wildlife.  Strategically place wildlife on the map to act as resources for other kinds of plants and animals.  As you build more, you’ll be able to add more resource intensive plants and animals. Upgrade your own abilities to discover new and interesting wildlife and see what kind of forest you can build.
Explore and clean

description:

Let me be surreal with you

I really like xxxxxno galaxias, I freaking love that game, the person reading it, the ability to run around geometry, and the ability to just listen to cool music while doing it. Maybe, it lost some exploration in the translation to space, but at the same time, who the mictlan cares? Every game is now open world, and in some alternative universe, they'll charge you for every step that you make, so yeah, I wanted to make a game like that, but no, it's not the game that you're thinking about... But I was too dumb to make it, but now, I'm just as dumb, but way more resilient... So every 3D object that you put in the game can now be a planet, isn't that cool?



I also wanted to do some surreal stuff, like, yeah, here, jump the obstacles. Now that you're trapped here, you may continue with your life, but she'll continue to be here forever, and there is nothing you can do. Why? Because I wanted to, and as always it's the will of the writer against the player, there is no houp, but you can play forever regardless; she'll trust you, and she almost always looks at you; that's how you know someone trusts you, or it's freaking scared of you, but regardless.

I want to continue my prolific game creator history of making another game, to duplicate my output from one to two, and to continue the legacy of the universe that I have created and of what I wanted to do before I die. So yeah, I mean, you don't really need to play the first game, you'll be just as confused, which is what I want, if I just keep you confused, then you'll not know how to feel.

So here is the deal, my new protagonist, ALMA, is freaking trapped, in a world of dreams, inspired by 60 years of life and 30 years of being trapped there. She's like a half-mermaid and a half-bald person. I also wanted to have a prophet, someone who will spew propaganda and contrapaganda for a new god, someone who works hard, and she is super smart, just look at her go:

We will be remembering war, we will be remembering sadness, the first contra revolution, the use of brutalism in our travels while running away from the authorities, the first contra revolution, and the use of brutalism in architecture, which you may think is ugly, but it's uglier to live on the streets:



Walk.
Run.
Bite yourself.
Grab stuff.
Dance.
And die as your body doesn't know what happens, this is the time to wake up.

Wake up, Alma, and if the forest doesn't treat you right, maybe the ashes will.

title: The Backwars
description:
게임 정보
The Backwars is a survival horror game that keeps you on edge at all times. Whether you’re playing alone or with friends, your only goal is to survive. Scavenge for food and water, build what you need to stay alive, and hide from the unspeakable horrors hunting you. Each level is packed with threats that force you to think fast and act faster.
Step into an unforgiving world where everything feels disturbingly real. The heavy atmosphere, eerie sounds, and gritty visuals pull you into a nightmare that won’t let go. Every item, object, or system in the game connects in ways that can surprise or terrify you. Nothing feels safe, and nowhere is truly secure.
The entities stalking you aren’t the only danger—other players can be just as deadly. Trust can get you killed, and alliances rarely last long. Whether you’re hiding in the dark, crafting tools, or fighting for your life, every moment is a gamble.
