title: Ghost Frequency
description:
게임 정보
Ghost Frequency는 당신을 PIT - 초자연적 조사 팀의 베테랑 유령 사냥꾼 마크로 만들어주는 1인칭 공포 게임입니다.
동료 에밀리와 함께 마크는 음산한 존재가 있는 버려진 장소에서 두 팀원이 신비롭게 사라진 사건을 조사합니다.
당신의 임무? 밤을 견디고 그림자 속에 잠복한 오싹한 미스터리를 밝혀내는 것입니다.

title: UltraBoxing – VR Boxing
description:
게임 정보
UltraBoxing VR is a boxing + fitness game featuring ultra-realistic AI.
Punch, dodge, move, and strategize as you take on dynamic AI opponents with fluid movements, strong defense, and advanced dodging mechanics, delivering a true boxing challenge. Fight and train in fully immersive or mixed reality modes.

title: Beneath the Frost
description:
게임 정보
You are the sole survivor of a devastating spaceship crash, stranded on a frozen, desolate planet. Now, you must scavenge whatever scraps remain in a desperate attempt to call for help.
Remote-Controlled Exploration
Trapped within the hollow shell of your ship, deploy a scrap recovery bot to venture into the outside world. Search for what scarce resources this planet offers and uncover the mystery behind your crash.
An Unfolding Landscape

title: Bytebond
description:
게임 정보
친구와 함께 컴퓨터의 내부로 들어가 힘을 합치세요. Bytebond는 즐거운 비대칭 협동 모험 게임으로 팀워크가 궁극의 무기가 됩니다. 다양한 바이옴을 탐험하세요. 각각의 바이옴에는 새로운 적과 뇌를 흔드는 퍼즐로 가득합니다. 독특한 에너지 관리 능력을 사용하고, 온라인이나 클래식한 화면 분할로 친구와 협동하세요.
함께 퍼즐을 해결하세요!
다이내믹 협동 게임플레이: 플레이어들은 협력하여 공통 목표를 달성하고 함께 도전을 극복합니다. 힘을 합쳐 에너지를 충전하고 변환하며, 기계를 작동시키고 퍼즐을 풀어 레벨을 진행하세요. 함께할 사람이 없으신가요? 걱정하지 마세요. 싱글 플레이 모드도 제공됩니다!
컴퓨터 속의 여정을 경험하세요!
다양한 바이옴 - 마더보드의 네온 발광 회로부터 CPU의 복잡한 길까지 여러 컴퓨터 부품을

title: To Pixelia
description:
게임 정보
Pixelia로 데려다준 버스에서 내리면 이야기가 시작됩니다. 그 이후로는 오직 당신의 상상력만이 일이 어떻게 진행될 것인지 결정할 수 있습니다. 나만의 방식으로 Pixelian의 스토리를 만들어 보세요. 캐릭터의 외모를 맞춤화하고, 부동산을 구입하거나 임대하고, 정상까지 올라가세요. 당신이 될 수 있는 것에는 제한이 없습니다. 음악가, 정치인, 제빵사, 정육점, 관리인, 모델, 농구 선수, 해커, 심지어 대통령이 될 수도 있습니다.
자신만의 노래를 작곡하고, 좋아하는 음식을 요리하고, 라이벌과 싸우고, 원하는 모든 유형의 차량을 운전해 보세요. 그동안 병에 걸리지 않도록 필요한 사항과 건강을 잘 관리하십시오. 원하는 방식으로 게임을 플레이하고 꿈에 그리던 삶을 살아보세요!
Features
헤어스타일, 얼굴 털, 의상, 액세서리, 문신에 대한 수십 가지 옵션을 사용하여 캐릭터의 독특한 모습을 만들고 개인적인 패션 감각을 표현할 수 있습니다.

title: SUFFOCATE
description:
게임 정보
게임 소개
《질애(窒愛)SUFFOCATE》는 3D 리얼리즘 스타일의 1인칭 생존 공포 게임으로, 현대를 배경으로 가족 관계를 둘러싼 정체불명의 종교, 인간의 탐욕 등을 아우르는 스토리를 다룬다. 이 게임에는 선혈, 폭력, 신앙, 에로 등 다양한 주제를 대담하게 다루고 있으며, 전례 없는 대만식 생존 공포를 선사한다. 플레이어는 스토리가 진행됨에 따라 가족에게서 일어난 변화를 밝혀나감과 동시에 잠행 파쿠르, 퍼즐, 공포 극복 등의 시련과 맞닥뜨리게 된다.
 플레이어는 게임 플레이 중 낯이 익는 원령에게 쫓기게 되며, 서로 다른 입장에서 발생하는 갈등과 충돌을 체험하게 된다. 탐험, 퍼즐, 은신 등을 통해 스토리를 진행해감으로써 주인공과 함께 가족을 둘러싼 섬뜩한 이야기를 경험할 수 있다
게임 플레이
게임 플레이 중, 플레이어는 탐험, 퍼즐, 숨기 등을 통해 이야기를 진행해가면서 저택을 둘러싼 비밀을 밝혀가게 됩니다. 공포 게임 매니아라면 절대 놓쳐서는 안 될 게임!

title: Vivaland
description:
게임 정보
팍팍한 삶을 벗어나 플레이어와 함께 성장해 나가는 매력 넘치는 소도시, 비바랜드에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 비바랜드는 혼자 플레이할 수도 있고, 최대 8명의 플레이어와 함께 협동하여 플레이할 수 있습니다!
각각의 개성을 지닌 캐릭터 (비바라고 부릅니다)들을 생성한 뒤, 그들의 삶의 이야기를 써 내려가세요. 집 1층에 제로 웨이스트 카페를 운영하거나, 옥상에서 텃밭을 가꾸거나 혹은 음악적 재능을 통해 삶을 꾸려 나가는 것 등으로, 플레이어는 마을의 핵심인 녹색 경제 시스템에 기여하고, 마을에 활기를 불어넣을 수 있습니다!


협동 플레이
플레이어의 마을에 친구의 비바를 이웃 또는 동거인으로 초대해 가족이 될 수도 있습니다. 혹시 혼자서 플레이하는 것을 더 선호하신다면, 걱정 마세요. 혼자서도 즐길 거리는 무궁무진하니까요!
비바의 커리어를 쌓아가세요
비바의 능력과 커리어를 쌓으면 마을 전체를 위한 새로운 가능성이 열립니다!
주택 1층에서 제로 웨이스트 카페를 열고 뒷마당에서 비건 케이크 가게를 운영하거나, 또는 고급진 레스토랑을 운영하면서 요리 커리어를 시작해보세요. 어떠한 셰프가 될지는 플레이어에게 달렸습니다!

옥상의 텃밭에서 농사를 시작해보거나 또는 주방에서 고기를 만들어 보세요! 수확물을 사용해 맛있는 요리를 만들거나 혹은 마을 주민 및 트렌디한 지역 브런치 가게에 판매하세요.
마을이 제대로 돌아가려면 기술자도 필요합니다! 마을 주민들의 자동차와 기계를 수리해주고, 공동체를 위한 유용한 장비를 만들어보세요. 아니면 그냥 미치광이 과학자가 되어보는 것도 재밌겠네요.
음악은 우리 모두를 이어주는 수단입니다. 플레이어는 음악가가 되어 다른 비바 친구들과 같이 밴드를 구성해 카페에서 공연을 할 수도 있고, 혹은 대중의 눈을 피해 나만의 정원에서 공연을 할 수도 있죠.
연애
서로 사랑에 빠지거나 나 홀로 짝사랑을 할 수 있습니다. 비바들의 짝사랑의 감정에서 현실과 똑같은 경험을 할 수 있습니다. 이웃과 친구가 될지 앙숙이 될지는 플레이어의 선택에 달렸습니다.


서로 다른 커리어, 직업, 기술을 가진 비바들이 마을에 모여 감에 따라, 마을은 성장하고 또 변해갑니다. 마을의 성장에 영향을 주고 싶다면, 지금 바로 시작하세요.



더욱 세분화된 커스터마이징 옵션을 통해 나만의 드림하우스를 건설하세요. 건축가 혹은 인테리어 디자이너가 되어, 나만의 창조적인 상상을 현실에 옮겨올 수 있습니다.

title: Timeless Heart VR
description:
게임 정보
"Timeless Heart VR is a narrative-focused VR roguelite action game. In it, you'll encounter the fates of various realms sealed within the cage of time and space, while discovering the essence and meaning of this space. As the second entry in the Timeless Stories series, this game further simplifies and enriches the unique sword technique system of the series. It introduces a distinctive VR gameplay mode that merges first-person and third-person perspectives for cooperative play. You will control both yourself and your companion Lycanea, exploring and advancing through four stylistically distinct realms. Choose your weapons and your companion's armor wisely, and together break through the blockades set by fate!"
Game system introduction:

Sword Skill System:
Players will get "Chain Claw Prosthetic Arm" to assist in melee / range attack action.
At the same time in the game players will randomly obtain a variety of special style weapons to further strengthen their own ability.


Chain Claw System:
Players can use the chain claw to rapidly evade attacks from enemies and grab special objects in the scene to throw/use to break the enemy's weaknesses.


Lycaena, the heroine of this game, will accompany the player in battle, and she will also gain new skills and armor as the game progresses.


This game introduces four major elemental attributes: wind, ice, flame, and thunder. Each of them will correspond to different special effects, and different elements will react with each other to produce additional cumulative effects. Building your own and your teammates' elemental attributes properly can help you defeat your enemies more efficiently.

title: Digimon Story Time Stranger
description:
게임 정보
■”시공”과 ”세계”를 넘어, 인간과 디지몬의 유대를 그려가는 이야기
이야기의 무대는 일본 도쿄.
비밀 조직의 에이전트인 주인공은, 미지의 생물 「디지몬」 을 만나 수수께끼의 폭발에 말려든다.
그리고 정신을 차려보니 8년 전의 세계에 와있었는데…
본 작품은 「과거와 미래」「인간 세계와 이세계」, 그리고 「인간과 디지몬」이라는 상반된 두 요소가 복잡하게 얽히며 그려지는 유대와 갈등을 다룬 장대한 이야기를 체험할 수 있습니다.


■인간 세계와 오리지널리티가 넘치는 디지털 월드에서 펼쳐지는 모험
인간 세계와, 디지몬이 사는 이세계 「디지털 월드 일리아스」라는 두 세계. 플레이어는 이야기 속에서 이 세계들을 오가며 해당 세계들의 특성을 살린 기믹이나 퀘스트를 체험할 수 있습니다. 디지털 월드는 지금까지의 디지몬 게임에는 없었던 섬세한 표현이 묘사되어 있으며, 다양한 개성의 필드가 여럿 등장합니다.


■450체 이상의 디지몬을 수집, 육성하고 전략적으로 편성하여 진행하는 턴제 배틀
디지몬은 플레이어와 대등한 동료입니다. 고난에 맞서는 과정에서 당신과 디지몬의 유대가 시험 받게 됩니다.
모험을 통해 디지몬을 동료로 만들고, 진화, 퇴화, 커스터마이즈를 거치며 자신만의 디지몬을 키워 나갑시다. 시리즈에 친숙한 디지몬부터 게임에 처음 등장하는 디지몬까지, 다양한 디지몬과의 만남을 즐겨주세요.
autokwd: Digimon Story Time Stranger,디지몬 스토리 타임 스트레인저

title: Countryballs: The Heist
description:
게임 정보
Countryballs: The Heist는 인기 유튜브 시리즈에 기반한 PWA의 유머러스한 컨트리볼 잠입 어드벤처입니다. 독특한 변장으로 컨트리볼을 커스터마이징하고 전 세계로 잠입하여 한층 더 미친 고객들을 위해 미친 물건들을 훔쳐보세요. 계획하고, 방해하고, 몰래 잠입하여 도둑의 명성을 얻거나 내장된 Heist Editor를 사용하여 커뮤니티를 위한 천재적인 습격을 직접 제작해 보세요.


나만의 컨트리볼 전문가 도둑 만들기

250개 이상의 잠금 해제 가능한 깃발과 스킨으로 구성된 방대한 컬렉션에서 나만의 변장을 만들어 보세요. 얼음으로 뒤덮인 북극, 모래사막, 호화로운 수영장 파티, 비밀 우주 정거장 등 다양한 배경을 만들어 보세요: 위장하거나... 들키면 줄행랑을 치세요!

PWA 컨트리볼 유니버스의 주인공이 되어 보세요

수백만 명이 보고 사랑한 도둑 컨트리볼에 관한 PWA의 이야기를 당신이 주인공이 되어 경험하세요.
(어쩌다 보니) 수상한 스파이 기관에 가입한 컨트리볼 신인이 되어 전 세계를 돌아다니며 미친 여정을 통해 친숙한 컨트리볼 캐릭터들을 만나보세요... 그들의 별난 모습들까지도요.



친구( 혹은 적)의 습격을 다운로드하여 새로운 모험을 시작하거나, 직접 습격 제작자가 되어 통합된 Heist Editor를 사용하여 전 세계 플레이어를 위한 까다로운 습격을 디자인하세요. 이 만능 에디터를 사용하면 모국어로 자신만의 스토리를 담은 완벽한 습격을 만들어 커뮤니티와 공유할 수 있습니다.

title: XEARZ
description:
게임 정보
Overview
XEARZ is a side-scrolling action game.
It contains platforming and light Metroidvania-like elements.
The player progresses through stages using melee attacks, subweapons, a variety of guns, and skill.
The main feature of XEARZ is that although it is a side-scrolling game, the map has depth, and you can enjoy attacking, defending, and exploring with the depth of the map by jumping across multiple planes with a single button press.
Story
Humanity has made tremendous progress in the fields of AI and robotics, the results of which have led to the production of highly intelligent androids.
In this new era, ideological conflicts about the relationship between humans and androids have intensified.
Some saw androids as a type of human, recognizing their consciousness and ability to make emotional and ethical decisions,
They were pursuing the possibility of coexistence. The partisans who advocated this view actively embraced technological advances and advocated a cooperative symbiosis between androids and humans.

In contrast, however, there was a faction that viewed androids as mechanical beings and treated them differently from humans.
They pointed out the potential danger that androids equipped with advanced AI posed to humans and argued for the need to limit them in human society.
This faction took a cautious position on the development and use of androids, emphasizing clear boundaries between humans and androids.

The ideological conflict gradually increased tensions and caused political friction.
Threats from enemy nations also added to this complicated situation, and there were reports of various androids infiltrating the country as spies.
The evolution of androids and the accompanying changes in human society were presenting a new dimension in national security.

The government was busy trying to resolve ideological conflicts within the country while promoting stricter control and monitoring of androids.
At the same time, scientists and ethicists were working to establish new frameworks and norms for the coexistence of humans and androids.
The future was moving toward uncharted territory, and many unanswered questions hung in the air about how the fusion of humans and androids would change society.

title: Astortion
description:
게임 정보
Astortion is a minimalistic, atmospheric puzzle-platformer that revolves around gravity.
Explore the ruins of the most pivotal research facility on earth, unlock new abilities that mess with spacetime itself, and get to the bottom of what is going on.
Features
Gravity-Based Puzzles: Attract or repel objects, stick to walls or change the gravity of an entire room in order to progress further.
Immersive World: Delve into the depths of an abandoned research facility, full of mysterious, interconnected chambers. Piece together the story of this place and find out what is your role to play.
Unlockable Abilities: So-called drivers provide you with new ways to interact with the environment - allowing you to solve more complex puzzles or shine a new light on places you have previously visited.
Unusual Platforming Gameplay: Use your control over gravity to swiftly traverse the world of the game while staying out of harm's way.

title: Tails of Fate
description:
게임 정보


오래 전, 많은 털복숭이 생물이 조화를 이루며 살던 파우나의 외곽에서, 기괴한 사건들이 어둠 속에서 펼쳐지면서 갈등의 울림이 메아리쳤습니다. 이야기는 절망적인 운명에서 파우나를 구하기 위해 여행을 떠나는 레이너드, 바르켄, 코알을 중심으로 전개됩니다. 새로운 친구를 만들고, 에픽한 적들과 싸우고, 영웅적인 전사들과 함께 진실을 찾으며 길을 가로막는 장애물을 극복하세요.



다른 모험가들과 함께 우르시다에 선술집에 모여 가십을 교환하고, 새로운 퀘스트를 찾거나, 단지 승리를 축하하세요. 이 아름답고 광대한 세계, 신비한 폐허, 어두운 던전, 장엄한 성, 그리고 음산한 고대 숲이 가득한 이 세계에서 모험의 중심지로 사용하세요.

게임 특징:
10개 이상의 다양한 생물 군계를 가진 아름답고 상호 연결된, 손으로 제작된 세계를 탐험하면서 숨겨진 영역과 비밀을 발견하세요.
3명의 다른 캐릭터로 플레이하고, 다른 플레이 스타일과 움직임 세트를 매끄럽게 전환하세요. 강력한 검을 휘두르며 전투에 뛰어들거나, 그림자 속에서 숨어들어 석궁으로 적을 사냥하세요.

title: Game Cafe
description:
게임 정보
Game Cafe is a casual game where you can play games like Spades, Okey, Backgammon and more with your friends or other cross platform players.
We bring the traditional Game Cafe culture to online platform. Take a seat, order a tea and enjoy playing games with your friends while sipping it. If you don't want to waste your tokens then play well, win and make others pay the bill.

title: Glaciered
description:
게임 정보


Glaciered takes place on Earth 65 million years in the future, where the "Everwinter" has transformed the planet's surface into a gigantic sheet of ice and life continues to survive under the glacier-covered seas.

Aquatic plants grow from glacier skies and colorful, bioluminescent fish light the seafloor. A new species prospers in this new golden age of life. They are the Tuai, descended from birds and successors of the dinosaurs. The superior intellect and unique metabolism they evolved over millions of years secured their prosperity in this icy environment. The great Ice Age that nurtures this bountiful ecosystem will survive for as long as the Everwinter persists.

Play as a Tuai fighting against that which has come to threaten the Everwinter.



Glaciered features real-time, dynamic combat that combines melee and ranged attacks with special abilities. Unleash the power within the Tuai avian and dinosaur bloodlines and harness their ability to control heat and cold.



Build your character by combining various abilities and passive skills like high-speed swimming that creates tunnels of supercritical water, temporal crystal blades, and more.



Discover unique ecosystems spread across an ocean Earth 65 million years in the future. Visit grasslands growing from icy skies, swim past schools of thermophilic fish coating the seafloor, and fend off members of the Crocodilia family that have been freed from gravity's grip and grown to enormous size.

Glaciered supports NVIDIA RTX features. Experience the far-future Earth in 4K, enhanced by ray-tracing and DLSS, with 8K textures used for the main characters.

title: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon
description:
게임 정보
Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon is a spiritual successor to the classic Ogre Battle series, combining real-time, squad-based tactics gameplay with turn-based RPG combat. Move units across the map in real time to capture towns and castles; when enemy units come in contact, a turn-based battle ensues, with the defeated side forced to give up ground.



Organize soldiers with unique appearance, stats and classes into units. Choose from dozens of classes, and customize your unit's formation to maximize each soldier's effectiveness, taking advantage of position-specific abilities, damage types and resistances, and support abilities which can be used to help nearby units when they enter combat.



Explore dozens of unique regions depicted in lush, hand-painted graphics. Destroy your opponents and capture their territories to win. Choose where to stand your ground - fighting from the right terrain can give you the advantage you need, and traversing difficult terrain can build up fatigue that will reduce your units' effectiveness.




When your unit comes in contact with the enemy, a turn-based battle ensues. Battles play out ; characters act in initiative order, and their actions are determined by their class, formation, and enemy positioning. Archers will rain down destruction on enemies from the rear, but if they lose their cover, they're defenseless. Swordsmen will attack from the front row and must hit the enemy's front row first; from the rear, they'll do nothing. Bleddyn the bard will bravely wield his rapier from the front, or play a song to buff the entire squad from the back.

The side that deals the most morale damage - by hitting hard, taking down units, or weakening the enemy commander - is the winner, with the other side losing ground on the map.


Years ago, the scattered kingdoms of the Britons were nearly united by one of history's greatest princes, Llewelyn the Great, in fulfillment of an ancient prophecy. Llewelyn was the greatest ruler the land had seen since King Arthur. But when he reached the apex of his power, he died, leaving behind a messy succession crisis. And in the chaos, England invaded, leading to a loss of nearly all Llewelyn had won.

Llewelyn II was named after his famous grandfather. He too is destined for greatness and will someday be known to history. But his path to greatness is uncertain: his father and brothers are imprisoned in London, England occupies half of the territory of Gwynedd, raiders harry the coast, and the ruling prince, Llewelyn's uncle, is viewed by many as a usurper. Will he be known as the prophesied Son of Destiny who ruled over a united Kingdom of the Britons, or as the prince who lost everything when England invaded?
autokwd: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon

title: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
description:
게임 정보
The Story
One day, a fox girl and her frog friend find themselves on a mysterious island shrouded by darkness but for a few floating lights.
Torii gates, food stall lanterns, and neon signs give light and color to the island. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

The Game
"Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino" is a 3D action/adventure game focused on the exploration of a mysterious island inspired by Japanese folklore. Kitsune, the titular fox girl, will have to go through exploration sequences and escape sequences where she is being chased by enemies.

In the exploration sequences, you will travel through the island, conversing with its inhabitants and kindling lights within shrines to reach new areas.

During the escape sequences, you will need to outrun the oni demons chasing after you. Kitsune can use light to temporarily blind these monsters, giving her enough time to find safe routes and hiding places. However, the number of times she can use this light is limited, and she has to recharge it at shrines.

Her light also allows her to banish darkness, find hidden paths, and run into more people to talk with.



Looming in the distance is the Tower of Muyo, shining bewitchingly with the lure of myriad stolen lights.
This is the tale of a long summer night, the night of the Jugoya harvest festival...
tag: 탐험,분위기 있는,3D 플랫폼,숨은 그림 및 물체,3D

title: Cloudheim
description:
게임 정보
동료들을 모아 파멸의 그림자가 드리운 세계에서 콤보 중심의 전투를 펼치세요. 물리 공격을 사용해 적을 파괴하면 더 많은 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다. 강력한 능력을 활용하고 강화할 수 있는 무기를 제작하여 새로운 스킬과 치명적인 콤보를 잠금 해제하세요. 비행 거북 기지인 오딘 쉘에서 다양한 섬과 신비로운 던전을 탐험하세요. 
솔로로 플레이하거나 여정을 안내해 줄 캐릭터와 생명체들로 구성된 팀과 함께 최대 4인 온라인 협동 모드를 즐기세요. 클라우드하임은 빠른 속도감의 액션과 역동적인 크래프팅을 결합한 게임으로, 플레이어는 크게 변화할 다채로운 판타지 세계로 빠져들게 됩니다.
혼돈을 정복하라모든 것이 파괴될 수 있는 세계에서 대혼란을 일으키세요. 강력한 능력을 연계하고 위력적인 팀 콤보를 조율하여 적을 물리치세요. 주변의 몬스터들을 향해 기둥을 무너뜨리고, 적들을 회오리에 휘말리게 하며, 대포로 그리블을 발사하고, 폭발하는 통을 싸움터 한가운데로 걷어차세요. 
함께 일어서라온라인 협동 모드에서 최대 세 명의 친구와 힘을 합치세요. 함께 성장하며 잠금 해제한 모든 무기와 능력을 공유하고 새로운 플레이 가능한 캐릭터를 발견하세요.
무한한 가능성을 창조하라시각적 크래프팅 기능이 있어 메뉴에서 친구를 기다릴 필요가 없습니다. 전투에서 사용할 수 있는 무기, 장비, 그리고 강력한 능력을 대량으로 제작하세요. 필요 없다면 판매할 수도 있습니다. 언젠가는 한 세상을 만들 수 있을지도 모릅니다...

title: Summer Road 10-Minute Roguelike
description:
게임 정보


10분 로그라이크 RPG - 바쁜 어른들을 위한
자동전투" x "아이템 수집"x"로그라이크"

화면의 절반을 차지하는 거대한 인벤토리를 활용해 장비를 합성하고 적을 물리쳐라!
전투는 자동이지만, 장비 조합에 따라 캐릭터의 행동이 달라진다.
전략적인 아이템 선택이 승리의 열쇠! 한 번 플레이하는 데 약 10분 정도 소요되어 부담 없이 즐길 수 있다.
선택하는 길과 이벤트에 따라 모험이 달라져, 반복 플레이의 재미가 가득!

추천 대상
아이템 수집가와 빌드 마스터
빠른 플레이 애호가
로그라이크 RPG 매니아



하나의 목표, 무한한 모험

동쪽의 신비로운 빛을 향해 여정을 떠나세요! 매 플레이마다 다른 스토리를 선사하는 10분짜리 RPG입니다. 랜덤 이벤트, 우연한 만남, 그리고 당신의 선택이 길을 결정합니다. 계속해서 플레이하며 새로운 가능성을 발견해 진정한 엔딩을 찾아보세요!



호기심 많은 세 아이가 신비로운 빛의 수수께끼를 풀기 위한 여름 모험을 시작합니다.
그들을 기다리는 시련과 보물은 무엇일까요?


모그모, 여행을 함께하는 신비로운 생명체는 세 개의 아이템을 먹어 새로운 아이템을 만들어냅니다.
상상도 못한 특별한 아이템을 만들기 위해 아이템 조합을 생각해 봅시다!

모그모의 힘을 활용해 모험을 정복하세요!

title: They Speak From The Abyss
description:
게임 정보
THEY SPEAK FROM THE ABYSS is a twisted homage to classic dungeon crawling RPGs. Explore beautifully gruesome environments, solve sinister puzzles, and confront the woeful souls and frightening demons lurking throughout the Abyss.



Step into the shoes of Vanessa Rivera, a young woman who feels lost in her life. After moving to a new city to be closer to her partner, a feeling of dread overwhelms her. Is this a fresh beginning, or the start of something more terrible beyond imagination?



Delve into the Abyss and confront terrifying demons, twisted manifestations, and malevolent devils. Choose your words carefully, as some inhabitants can be reasoned with. But when talking isn’t an option, be ready to engage in heart pounding active-time battles. Practice haste, as blood thirsty beings tend to grow impatient and attack before you’ve made a decision. After all, your flesh is precious…



is about overcoming fears and trauma, and trying to become a stronger person. Players must explore and confront many personal, mature, and often dark themes; themes of body horror and psychological struggle emerged through an expression of hate and anger. The journey of the player is designed to reflect real-world trials and tribulations.

title: The Bugs Manor 🦋
description:
게임 정보

The Bugs Manor is a free top-down 2D pixel art horror game. Explore a cursed mansion, hide from scary monsters, and solve puzzles with an inventory-free gameplay focused on direct interactions with the environment.



The haunted house is full of dangerous creatures, you will need to use the stealth and your wits to escape, but be careful, because if you fail, a bloody death waits for you.



Can you overcome the enigmatic challenges of the manor? Solve multiple puzzles through inventory-free gameplay. This allows you to interact directly with the environment and items without the interruption of annoying menus.



Uncover the dark secrets of the evil Bugs home and its numerous rooms. Follow the story of Danny, a kid who has just moved into the house and is spending his first night there alone. But maybe he's not as alone as he believes...

title: Etheria: Restart
description:
게임 정보
는 도시 이능 전략 턴제 RPG입니다.
전 세계를 뒤엎은 얼음 폭풍... 그로 인해 인류 문명은 붕괴 직전까지 이르게 되었다. 문명의 불씨를 이어가기 위해, 인류는 자아 의식을 가상 세계 '에테리아'로 옮기게 되었다.
'에테리아'에서는 인간뿐만 아니라 아르케 능력을 사용하는 존재인 애니머스들이 함께 살아가고 있다. 두 종족은 '에테리아' 내에서 평화롭게 공존해 왔지만, 어느 날 갑작스레 나타난 '소스 바이러스'라는 재앙이 애니머스들을 감염시키기 시작했다. 바이러스에 감염된 애니머스들이 폭주하며 인간이 위협받게 되었다. 소스 바이러스를 제거하기 위해 슈퍼 링커 협회가 설립되었다.
그리고 이제, 당신은 슈퍼 링커로서 에테리아에서 활동을 시작하게 된다.
[실시간 3D 렌더링, 압도적인 시청각의 향연]
는 언리얼 엔진을 기반으로 현실감 넘치는 조명과 섬세한 디테일, 실시간으로 렌더링된 스토리를 제공하여 마치 영화를 보는 듯한 몰입감을 선사합니다. 전투 중, 각 캐릭터는 전용 전투 애니메이션을 보유하고 있으며, 다채로운 스킬 카메라 연출과 화려한 전투 특수 효과가 절묘하게 어우러집니다. 불필요한 라이트 폴루션 없이 짜릿하고 통쾌한 전투의 극치를 경험해 보세요!

title: Stick It to the Stickman
description:
게임 정보
반갑습니다, [이름]! 당신은 저희가 여태껏 고용한 사람 중 가장 능숙하고 유능한 지원자입니다. 이곳의 편의시설이 마음에 드셨길 바랍니다. 여러분의 재능을 마음껏 뽐내세요!

Stick it to the Stickman은 가능한 한 가장 빠른 방법으로 기업의 사다리를 오르고자 하는 모든 사람을 위한 실용적인 가이드입니다. 이 로그라이크 게임에서 강력한 물리기반 전투, 엄청난 양의 커피, 무기화된 방귀로 사타구니를 차고, 총과 톱을 휘둘러보세요!

동료, 중간 관리자, 상사를 돌파하여 미국 최악의 회사에서 CEO가 되는 길에 더 강력한 "비즈니스 기술"을 배우십시오.

싸우지 않으면 해고당한다
공격은 비즈니스에서 가장 좋은 방어 수단입니다. 죽거나 죽이거나 둘 중 하나지요. 강력한 업그레이드와 본사가 승인한 무기를 선택하여 당신의 스틱맨이 단순한 예스맨 이상인지를 확인하십시오.


노오력하세요
당신의 경력 궤도는 수직이 아닙니다! 새로운 자회사를 통합하여 경쟁에서 우위를 확보하세요. 인수할 때마다 새로운 게임 플레이, 새로운 적, 새로운 보스, 새로운 무기 등이 제공됩니다! 시장을 지배하고 사람들의 마음을 지배하는 대기업을 건설하십시오!


로컬 및 온라인 협동을 통해 당신의 동료는 팀워크의 힘을 사용하여 적대적인 인수를 수행할 수 있습니다.

title: Schrödinger's Call
description:
게임 정보

In a world devoid of human life, you awaken as Mary, the last ear to listen, the last voice to speak.

Forsaken souls seek your help over numerous calls, in a desperate attempt to regain the feelings they've lost.

You are Mary, the last voice they hear, unraveling lost souls with just a telephone.

Souls bound with strong regrets suffer somewhere between the lands of the living and the dead, desperately waiting for someone willing to listen. Will you be that ear and voice?

How to play the game:
Choose the words you want to speak to the souls who cannot die and the actions you want to take to save them and advance the story.
Calling various souls and gathering information is the key to moving forward.

title: Reclaim The Sea
description:
게임 정보
Reclaim the Sea is a roguelike strategy and adventure game, set in a naval pirate fantasy world. Your goal is to lead your pirate crew through dangerous seas, keep your ship in one piece and save the World. Face tough decisions, manage resources, spend gold in equipment, upgrades and new crew. You will encounter different ships from many factions each time and face tough decisions. Will you be a good pirate or reckless buccaneer? Will you defend this civilian ship attacked by thugs? Or will you take advantage of its weakened position? If you engage in a fight, you will have many options: taking down the enemy crew, burning or sinking their ship, staying at long range and playing defensively or engaging at close range… Each run is unique thanks to randomly generated ships and maps.
Command your crew
Order your crew to move in the ship to accomplish all the required tasks : charge weapon, pilot the ship, board the enemy ship, repair the ship and many more!
Set weapon targets
Choose your ship weapons and set their targets. Will you reduce enemy fire power or manoeuvrability? Will you try to kill the enemy crew, destroy their ship or overwhelm it under fire?

title: Hexxen: Hunters
description:
게임 정보
남부 독일의 검은 숲 깊숙한 곳에 지옥문이 열린 지도 어언 수백 년이 지났습니다. 그 후로 세상은 짐승이며 마귀가 다 같이 우글거리는 곳이 되었지만, 더 끔찍한 위협이 가까워진다는 조짐이 나타났습니다. 피할 수 없는 파멸 앞에서 인류를 지킬 마지막 보루로 남은 건 마녀 사냥꾼들뿐입니다.

실시간 탐험과 턴제 전략 전투가 어우러진 RPG, Hexxen: Hunters에서 여러분은 세상의 운명을 짊어진 채 또 다른 어둠의 역사를 살아 나가야 합니다. 외딴 마을을 사악한 이교 집단의 손아귀에서 해방하고 발전시켜 나가는 동시에, 사냥꾼들을 무기와 연금술 혼합물부터 비전 연구와 마법 장비까지 다양한 방법으로 무장시킬 수 있습니다. 극복할 수 없을 것만 같은 역경을 이겨내도록 사냥꾼들을 훈련하면서, 인류를 지키고자 영혼까지 바칠 각오를 하시기 바랍니다.



샛별이 뜨고 죽음의 냄새가 대기 중에 감돕니다. 몇 주 동안 지역 내 주민들이 무언가 때문에 공포에 사로잡혀 있는 가운데, 여러분은 그 위협을 제거하겠다는 청부를 맡습니다. 숲을 누비다 끔찍한 광경을 맞닥뜨리는데, 오늘 사냥해야 할 것은 평범한 구울이나 흡혈귀가 아닙니다...

선택할 수 있는 8명의 독특한 사냥꾼들과 더불어, 해결해야 할 임무에 따라 무수히 많은 선택의 기로에 놓입니다. 흡혈귀, 야행 동물, 악마들은 각기 다른 어려움을 안겨주며, 오랫동안 사이가 좋지 않은 어둠의 인간 이교 집단은 다양한 방식으로 전투를 펼치기에 또 다른 위협이 됩니다.
각 사냥꾼은 나름의 장비는 물론 전문화 기술 계도와 메커니즘이 있어 서로 뚜렷이 구별됩니다. 앞을 막는 자들을 물리치는 데 기묘한 비술을 쓰시겠습니까, 아니면 뛰어난 무술 기량을 펼치시겠습니까? 괴츠 나팔총은 먼 거리에서 강력한 위력을 발휘하지만, 근접전에서는 프란치스카의 정의로운 분노가 가장 강력한 적을 쓰러뜨리는 열쇠입니다. 영혼 정수의 힘으로 펼치는 페이의 비전술을 활용하거나 백마녀 이리나의 휘몰아치는 마법에 의지하여 맹렬한 습격에 맞서 보시기 바랍니다.
엄청난 규모의 무리나 강력하고 무시무시한 존재들과 대결하면서, 공격 패턴을 비롯하여 강점과 약점을 파악하여 그에 맞는 계획을 생각해 내야 합니다. 하지만 방심은 금물입니다. 서사적 임무를 위해 단계적으로 생성되는 지도, 보조 퀘스트, 동료 퀘스트로 여러 번 끝까지 플레이해도 똑같은 경험을 하는 일은 없을 테니까요.



다시 새로운 하루의 태양이 떠오르면, 사냥꾼들은 기진맥진한 채로 돌아옵니다. 먼저 숲속 깊숙한 곳에서 기이한 생물체와 변이된 짐승들을 대적했지만, 수적으로 열세였습니다. 힘든 싸움을 하고 모두 살아남았어도, 그다음 상황을 맞이할 여력은 조금도 남아 있지 않은 상태였습니다. 이전에 본 적 없는 흉물의 습격을 받았는데, 사냥꾼들은 아무런 사전 지식도 없었지만, 결국 승리는 오로지 순수한 믿음의 힘에 의해서만 거둘 수 있음을 깨달았습니다. 여기저기 다치고 부러진 몸을 이끌고 절뚝이며 집으로 돌아오는 그들에게는 휴식이 절실히 필요합니다. 오직 시간이 관건입니다...






어둠이 다시 한번 찾아 들자, 샛별이 밤하늘에서 불길하게 빛나는 가운데 예상치 못한 손님이 마을 외곽에 도착했습니다. 악의 세력은 체계적으로 나타나는 법이 없습니다. 그리고 이교 집단 하나가 자신들의 야망을 더 펼치고자 동맹을 찾고 있습니다. 더 큰 뜻을 위해 마음대로 휘두를 힘을 주겠다고 솔깃해지는 제안을 했지만, 엄청난 대가를 치러야 할지도 모릅니다...

title: Cronos: The New Dawn
description:
게임 정보


동유럽의 브루탈리즘과 복고풍의 미래 기술이 혼합된 어두운 세상을 배경으로 하는 Cronos: The New Dawn은 과거와 미래를 넘나드는 몰입감 넘치는 이야기 속으로 빠져들게 합니다.
과거에서는 인류를 영원히 바꾼 대재앙인 더 체인지의 고통에 빠진 세상을 발견하게 됩니다. 한편, 파괴된 미래의 황무지에서는 매 순간 위험한 괴물들이 생존을 위협하며 당신의 반사 신경과 전술적 사고를 시험합니다.
당신은 여행자이자 의문의 집단인 컬렉티브의 요원으로 활동하며, 미래의 황무지를 샅샅이 뒤져 1980년대 폴란드로 이동할 수 있는 시간의 틈을 찾아야 합니다.
영혼 수확기
여러분의 임무는 다가올 대재앙으로 목숨을 잃을 과거의 핵심 인물들을 찾는 것입니다. 전능한 수확기를 이용하여 정수를 추출하고 미래로 함께 갈 수 있습니다.

title: Salvus: Aries
description:
게임 정보
A story that begins with the heroine meeting her bad end at the chopping block. It can only go uphill from here, right?

Waking up after a long stay in purgatory (that she remembers nothing about), she learns that the rest of her sentence is to serve as a Reaper until the powers above have decided she's paid back her sins.

Through her journey after death as a Reaper, she'll seek out the empty gaps in her memory and reconcile her past with her present. Everyone has something to hide, and unfortunately for them, she's the type to seek out answers. But the biggest challenge for the crew will be to save her from herself.

Or they might all just get a one way ticket to Hell. At best.

Features:



Full Game:
450k+ Words
A story set not only in a modern fantasy world, but will include also beautiful historical settings too.
Beautiful artwork, displayed in the sprites, CGs, and backgrounds.
A lovely OST.
Epilogues to experience sweet stories after achieving happy endings with your desired target.

Choose your fate:
5 Romance Routes to choose from, with the possibility of more in the future through DLC.
Experience both good and bad endings, depending on choices made throughout the game.
A meter to track progress towards a certain type of ending per route.

Fun flavor additions:
Calls and text chats.

title: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3
description:
게임 정보
Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 is "committing to the bit" so hard that it hurts. It's a sequel to a game series that doesn't exist, complete with lore and a fictional development team. It's a game where match-3 is used not just for combat, but for lockpicking doors, debating robots, and swallowing a bunch of diamonds in front of a notorious gem thief so that he can't steal them first. It is, all genre elements considered, a match-3 survival horror comedy RPG metroidvania, and it's rad as hell.
20 years ago, Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion emerged as a smash-hit genre fusion, casting fan-favorite protagonist Jack Briar in a fast-paced puzzle adventure.
8 years ago, Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 was announced on the biggest stage in gaming.
This is what happened next.
What is this?
A match-3 metroidvania--or matchroidvania --exploring the development of a sequel to a game series that doesn't exist.
Another wild genre fusion from the developers behind Clickolding, I Am Your Beast, and Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.
A story about sequels, game development, and the horrible, beautiful things that happen when the foundation of your reality falls apart.
Part match-3 metroidvania, part choice-based narrative, part survival horror parody, part joyful wheel-spinning nightmare.
A game that could only work with a polka soundtrack, provided by award-winning composer David Mason (Dredge, Life Eater).
Committing to the bit.

title: Dead Faces
description:
게임 정보
스토리
몇 년 동안 아파트에 고립된 채 하루하루를 보내다 보면 문 밖의 세상을 서서히 잊게 됩니다. 점점 더 심해지는 환각을 통해 아는 사람들의 환영이 당신을 괴롭히기 시작합니다. 아파트에서 하루하루를 탐험하며 과거와 마주하세요. 죽은 얼굴은 환각과 과거를 마주하는 심리 공포 게임입니다.
잭의 불안한 마음과 과거의 얼굴들, 그리고 그의 행동 뒤에 숨겨진 진실을 풀어보세요. Dead Faces에서 기억하는 행위는 구원의 열쇠가 될 수도 있고 광기로 향하는 마지막 단계가 될 수도 있습니다.

title: Orkendale: The Scarred Land
description:
게임 정보
Orkendale: The Scarred Land is an open-world role-playing game in which the fate of an entire continent is in your hands. Whether the orcs will be able to take over the continent or humanity will defeat them will depend only on your decisions. And if the humans retain power, which faction will rule? Only you are free to decide who to support in this war...

In Orkendale: The Scarred Land you will find a large open world filled with exciting quests, various enemies and dangers. Explore the surroundings and travel through the locations to see how different factions of people live.

There are 3 different factions of people waiting for you in the game:
Free City - its residents prefer not to take an active part in the general unrest, but this time even they won't be able to stay on the sidelines;
Imperial City - people in it believe that only by uniting the mainland into one kingdom you can get power and global weight in the world. And for the sake of this they are ready to seize all the territories to engage in their subsequent development;
Miner's Town - was formerly part of the Imperial City, but it has defended its independence for 100 years, and it looks like it will soon have to do it again.

There are many mysteries hidden on the island of Orkendale. You can solve them or leave them untouched.
In addition, Orkendale is inhabited by various creatures, but it is dominated by two main species: humans and orcs. The Orcs were defeated many years ago, so since then they are no longer considered an equal race and a threat to humans. They have a small territory where the ruins of an ancient tower still remain. A tower that could become their weapon in the struggle for power over the mainland.
Explore World with Full Freedom

You can explore everything you see, in whatever order you want.




At the center of the story is an experienced traveler Jack, who is equally well-trained in both close combat and long-range warfare. He has been tasked with ferrying the magic stones needed to recover a magical artifact. During the voyage, however, the ship was attacked by a sorcerer, resulting in the ship being sunk and the stones stolen. Jack was miraculously saved - he was thrown ashore alive. Now he has to return the stones, and at the same time take part in deciding the fate of the continent on which he found himself...

title: DIE LAST
description:
게임 정보



Plant Trees
Trees are a giver of life — plant them to earn Karma and revive the ground that turned vile after the old order poisoned it. Karma runs everything. Every move you make, every action you take, costs Karma. The larger your Forest, the more Karma you will receive
Find Lost Objects
As you wander, you will find Lost Objects from the old order. Use them to craft cryptic messages. The messages you send and receive can give special powers, offer unexpected opportunities, or devastate you or another player with their cruelty
Create DeBots
DeBots are your trusted companions. Design them yourself with different properties, and they will give you the power to build, defend yourself, or attack and steal another player’s Karma. But make sure your DeBots get enough sleep, or else they will become weak
Build Pipes
Build Pipes to transport Karma. Connect Pipes to a Forest or a Factory, and give yourself the power to go off to wander to where no man has gone before. Wherever you go, your pipes will also transport your DeBots
Any player can attack any pipe they see and steal the Karma with the help of a DeBot. But you also have to use pipes to transport stolen Karma. And because any player can stand in a Forest and send Karma to any Pipe connected to it, there’s a lot of it going around
Every decision you make has to be strategic — defend yourself from other players' attacks by watching out for pipes going in your direction. And prepare yourself for Acki Nacki, dangerous creatures with sharp teeth. They will attack random players at random times, and fight them for Karma
Join a Guild to earn a steady supply of Karma. They are alliances of players that run abandoned Factories producing blocks of Karma. Be warned, other Guilds might attack you. But you can also earn Karma in addition to the supply of a Guild by planting your own forests, or you can go rogue.
Rogue players are not a part of any Guild. They wander with their best friend — their Dog — and battle and steal other players' Karma, and survive any which way they can, growing stronger with each successful fight.
Play in Die Last Tournaments — periodically organized bouts between Guilds where the aim is to stay alive. Tournaments happen in different Zones that are always far away and randomly selected. And they are lucrative, with the winners earning massive quantities of Karma from the Prize Pool.
Any player can buy a Spy DeBot for 1 mission. It will give you analytics about other players and Guilds, and if you have enough, you get real time notifications about the game, and the ability to kill another Spy DeBot. The catch? Other players know you’re spying on them.
You can write a letter to any other player or Guild. If you step into the same square, or wander into a Forest or a Building, a chat will open up allowing you to instantly talk with another player. We cannot survive in, and revive, this world alone.


― Hayao Miyazaki

title: Jitter
description:
게임 정보
Jitter is an immersive sci-fi exploration and survival game set on a mining colony and its outskirts in the Main Asteroid Belt. You assume the role of an experimental AI that maintains ship functions and engages with the crew on board. As you explore the mining colony, you will take on new missions, expand ships and bases using various modules, add survivors to your crew, engage in space fights, and repair the damage left by enemy fire and onboard accidents.
TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE ENVIRONMENT

Asteroids, ships and outposts are susceptible to realistic damage and destruction, opening up strategic opportunities through emergent gameplay. Vaporize an asteroid blocking access to an enemy outpost, and the debris will damage its hulls. Or you.
BUILD (AND REBUILD) YOUR SHIP

Modify your spacecraft to fit your playstyle. Want more firepower? Attach a cannon module. Need to make a quick getaway? Jettison the modules that slow you down – crew members and all, if your conscience is up to it. The mission is too important to jeopardize it.
FIGHT IN SPACE OR ABOARD

Seamlessly switch between strategic ship-on-ship battles and tactical action on deck. Exchange cannon fire in zero gravity – or board an enemy vessel to take it down from the inside.

Each key character brings a unique backstory, personality, and gameplay abilities, significantly affecting the way you play. Just remember to take care of them – losing a main character means game over.
Geek out with complex simulation systems on your ship. Generate and distribute oxygen, calibrate and reroute power, and dismantle modules for scrap to achieve the best performance of your ship.
Navigate a bustling mining colony on a colossal asteroid. Delve into mines, traverse cave systems, investigate outposts and nearby space bodies. Be prepared to face pirates – or discover unknown life forms. Unravel the mystery behind the accident that sent you on your mission.

title: SSR Wives: The Murder Of My Winter Crush
description:
게임 정보


SSR Wives: The Murder Of My Winter Crush Is an upcoming Retro Survival Horror experience that takes inspiration from iconic staples of the survival horror genre with the romantic and interpersonal intrigue of a Visual Novel. The game aims to create a tense, atmospheric, and immersive experience by combining a Haunting Mystery Narrative, Exploration, challenging puzzles, and terrifying enemy encounters.
CLASSIC SURVIVAL HORROR MECHANICS AND MORE...

-Dynamic Fixed camera system
-Classic Tank Controls
-Challenging Puzzles
-High-stakes Combat & Varied Enemy encounters
-Grid Inventory management
-Classic Door Scene Transitions
-Haunting Mystery Narrative & World
-Collectibles/Documents/Pickables
-Inspect the environment and make choices
-Retro Low-Poly Inspired Visual direction
-Romantic Interpersonal VN Intrigue
-Multi-ending Visual Novel experience
-Original Soundtrack Production:KORAII



inhabits a variety of residents. Inflicted with disorder and scattered around the town. Their respective areas a part of their identity, Dungeons hiding dark secrets, Sins in need of light.


The player will encounter various characters with whom they can interact and build relationships. Players must make dialogue choices that impact their relationships and navigate through personal quests that reveal more about each character's backstory. As relationships deepen, The player can potentially find love, but the player must also balance their emotional connections with the need to survive...

Players will encounter a range of grotesque and horrifying enemies, each with unique strengths and weaknesses. Some easier to engage then others the player will have to decide whether to prioritize escape and evasion or directly confront the threats lurking in the dark...

Classic Tank controls create restraint in combat... You do not want to miss your shots,for resources are scarce and consumable items are to be treasured. The Grid based inventory management system will reward organized players with plenty of room and stock to preserve the resources needed to survive until the next safe room.

The game starts out with a small modest arsenal of firearms & melee weapons to collect. But as the game progresses and the combat encounters become more difficult and varied the new arsenal should follow. Earning and seeking out these legendary weapons is optional in many cases. But ultimately rewarding to those who wish to venture into darker places they shouldn't stick around in...
A wide variety of locales,dungeons and environments await In Snowy forests, A Veterinary Clinic, An Abandoned Missile Silo, Liminal Labyrinths, An Antiquated Bakery And a Clown Carnival to name just a few... Aside from dangerous enemy encounters in these areas you will also find Classic Survival Horror puzzles in need of solutions. Interact with the environment, find keys to open locked rooms, collect documents to learn more about the world and its inhabitants.

As you explore the environment you might also find situations where choices will be prompted. So be sure to interact with the entirety of an environment to find clues, discover secret items or engage in miscellaneous actions to affect the world like pushing objects, breaking containers or dialoguing with NPCs.

title: UKNON Jones & Guynelk 2
description:
게임 정보
“UKNON Jones & Guynelk – Awesome!”의 속편
존스의 친구들이 구출된 후, 그는 자신의 할아버지가 미스터리하게 사라진 것을 발견합니다. 그는 "크리스탈 시리얼"이라는 신화 속의 보물을 찾고 있었습니다. Jones, Guynelk, Elsa LOVELUST 및 Saphir 공주는 Jones의 할아버지를 찾기 위해 Crystal Cereal을 찾기로 결정합니다.
주요 특징:
-훌륭한 그래픽이 담긴 오픈 월드를 혼자 또는 분할 화면에서 친구와 함께 탐험해보세요.
- 시간의 힘을 이용해 과거나 미래로 여행을 떠나 환경을 바꿔보세요.
- 점점 더 어려워지는 보스들을 상대하고 그들의 약점을 찾아보세요.
- 1인이 만든 게임으로 다양한 미니게임에 참여하거나 친구들과 경쟁해보세요.
- 이벤트가 가득한 모험에서 당신을 도와줄 동료를 QR 코드로 소환하세요.
- 게임 속 특정 캐릭터에게 장미를 선물해 로맨틱한 데이트를 즐겨보세요.
- 각각 특정 스킬을 보유한 존스, 가이넬크, 엘사, 사피르의 4가지 캐릭터로 모험을 경험할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어 Jones는 폭탄이나 드론을 사용하여 적을 기절시키고 주변을 모니터링할 수 있습니다. Guynelk는 불, 얼음, 전기와 같은 원소의 힘을 마스터합니다. 엘사는 날아서 멀리서 공격할 수 있고, 사피르는 검술에 뛰어납니다.

title: Ghost Villa
description:
게임 정보
In Ghost Villa is an fps with tower defense elements, you farm and build up your defenses during the day, by night you fight hordes of ghosts that want to haunt and take possession of your home.
Farming
Take care of a wide variety of crops, and sell the produce to buy better equipment and defense mechanisms.

title: ELEMASTA -エレマスタ
description:
게임 정보
美麗なドット絵のオープンワールドRPGです。
様々な文化の街や気候、遺跡などがすべてシームレスにつながっています。
仲間に出来るキャラクタは350人以上！3000種もの武器や防具を集め仲間とともに強大な敵を倒し世界を救おう！

An open world RPG with beautiful pixel art.
Cities of various cultures, climates, and ruins are all seamlessly connected.
There are over 350 characters that can be your friends! Collect 3000 types of weapons and armor, defeat powerful enemies with your friends, and save the world!

title: Instants
description:
게임 정보
‘Instants’에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 퍼즐 풀기, 꾸미기 및 따스한 스토리텔링이 어우러진 근사한 여정이 펼쳐집니다. 향수를 자극하는 이 내러티브 퍼즐 게임에서 가족 사진 앨범을 하나씩 완성해 컬렉션을 구성하며 지난날 차곡차곡 쌓인 가족의 이야기를 알아보세요.
제공된 가족 사진을 각 앨범 내에 시간 순서대로 정렬하세요. 가족 이야기가 자연스럽게 전개되는 모습이 반영된 사진들을 타임라인의 단서로 활용할 수 있답니다.
퍼즐을 풀어 가는 동안 감동적인 이야기가 조금씩 나타납니다. 내 속도에 맞춰 탐구하고, 여러 세대에 걸친 한 가족의 이야기를 완성해 보세요.

title: Echo of Prypiat
description:
게임 정보
"프리피야티의 메아리" - 체르노빌 배제 구역의 분위기에 플레이어를 몰입시키는 매혹적인 워킹 시뮬레이터로, 이 잊혀진 땅에 버려진 사람들의 모든 공포와 두려움을 전달합니다. 이 게임은 플레이어가 이 신비로운 장소의 분위기를 느낄 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

체르노빌의 금지 구역을 탐험하며 위험과 수수께끼에 맞서세요. 당신의 인내와 결단력을 시험하는 시련을 겪으세요. 구역의 어두운 구석에 숨어있는 미지의 존재와 마주할 준비를 하세요.

음향 효과와 시각적 효과를 통해 체르노빌의 몰입감 있는 분위기를 제공합니다. 첨단 그래픽을 사용하여 배제 구역을 현실감 있게 재현합니다.

title: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
description:
게임 정보
Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a top-down 8-bit retro action/adventure game inspired by Zelda with a Vice City theme.
Step into the shoes of Dutch, one of Magic City’s most feared enforcers, on a thrilling and dangerous quest to rescue your one true love, Sophie. Navigate through the chaos of wild nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts in this raunchy, high-stakes adventure.
In Vice: Magic City Mayhem, we blend the best of both worlds—drawing inspiration from the immersive exploration, intense combat, and mind-bending puzzles of Zelda, alongside the outrageous storylines, vibrant world-building, and dark humor of Vice City.
Roam the gritty streets of Magic City, facing off against a colorful, eccentric cast of enemies and bosses, all while chasing down your elusive "Princess" in a city where danger is around every corner. It’s an unforgettable ride filled with heart-pounding action, clever puzzles, and plenty of ridiculous humor - perfect for anyone looking to save the day with style!
Game Features

title: Vortica
description:
게임 정보
인류는 무자비한 외계 침략자들에 의해 지구에서 추방되었습니다. 우리는 이제 태양계 전역에 흩어져 있는 폐허가 된 우주 정거장과 전초기지에서 생존을 유지하고 있습니다. 인류의 마지막 희망으로서, 당신은 문명의 잔해를 탐험하고, 잃어버린 기술을 발견하며, 인류의 미래를 위해 싸워야 합니다.
Vortica는 태양계 전역에서 다양한 미션을 수행하는 트윈 스틱 슈터 로그라이트입니다. 인류의 마지막 생존자로서, 당신은 적대적인 영토를 탐험하고, 고립된 민간인을 구출하며, 치명적인 외계 위협을 추적하는 한편, 생존을 위해 필요한 자원을 찾기 위해 싸웁니다.
외계 군단과의 전투
거대한 외계 군단과의 심장을 쥐어짜는 전투에서 수백 명의 적을 처치하며 싸워보세요. 혼란 속에서 자동 포탑을 전략적으로 배치하여 방어를 강화하고 전투의 흐름을 유리하게 만드세요. 각 전투는 끊임없이 변화하는 전장에서 기술과 전략을 테스트하는 기회가 됩니다.
역동적인 세계 탐험
고급 절차적 생성 기법을 사용하여, 각 레벨은 독특하고 일관된 레이아웃을 제공하며, 두 미션은 절대 동일하지 않습니다. 어두운 미로를 탐험하거나 금성의 험난한 표면을 횡단할 때, 각 환경은 자신만의 도전과 기회를 제공합니다.
장비 커스터마이즈

title: Hypogea
description:
게임 정보
Hypogea is a short, atmospheric 3D platformer where you take the role of a staff-wielding automaton trying to escape from an abandoned underground megastructure.




Travel through the mysterious structure using your hooked staff to pole-vault, swing, climb, catch yourself and more.




Restore the puzzling mechanisms of the facility and help its automaton inhabitants.




Explore the cavernous halls and dark corridors of a mysterious suberranean complex through visuals inspired by games from the early 2000s.




Piece together the eclectic narrative via the game's environmental clues and wordless storytelling.

title: Depth Diver
description:
게임 정보
Whether you are thalassophobic, Achluophobic, claustrophobic, batophobic, or even teratophobic, you will be in an underwater nightmare.
Immerse yourself in the depths of Gornak and try to repair old underwater facilities to help the union and serve your sentence.
You will undoubtedly encounter the local fauna... more or less dangerous, but if you pray to Stiska you might find your redemption.. And even more in our magnificent submarine at the cutting edge of gornak technology !

title: The New Rome
description:
게임 정보
The New Rome is a turn-based city-building strategy game that invites you to shape an alternate history as an architect. Merge ancient grandeur with innovation as you construct monumental buildings, collect resources, manage your labor force, and outwit rivals to become The New Rome’s most renowned architect.
Inspired by the rich history of Roman architecture, The New Rome combines city-building, resource management with chill competitive gameplay. Step into an alternate world where an early industrial revolution transforms the era, presenting you with new challenges and opportunities.
Build Your Own New Rome:
Rise to fame as an architect as you build a wide variety of buildings, from simple dwellings to grand bathhouse complexes.
Make impactful design choices and decide on the look of your monuments.
Unlock new building options through technological innovation.
Strategic Resource Management:
Expertly manage resources and worker placement to out-build your rivals.
Gather essential resources like wood, limestone, clay and marble to advance your building projects.

title: Operatives: Revolve
description:
게임 정보
Operative Revolve is a cinematic roguelike deckbuilder with a unique gameplay mechanic. Play as Operatives, secret agents who oversee a world governed by machine ideology. Use your Machine cards to physically attack or block damage while battling enemies who oppose your directive and uncover the hidden truths within the machinated world.

title: LOVE ETERNAL
description:
게임 정보
Run, jump, and reverse the flow of gravity itself to escape the mind of a selfish god in this challenging precision platformer. Play as Maya, a child stolen from her family on the whim of a lonely, forsaken deity, and make your way through over 100 screens filled with spikes, lasers, switches, and traps as you unravel the horrifying secret of your new prison.



Gorgeous hand-drawn pixel art graphics bring the god’s realm to life alongside meticulously handcrafted animations boasting many thousands of frames
A lush, atmospheric score, equal parts unsettling and beautiful
Responsive, snappy controls provide challenges with a sense of mastery and acrobatic accomplishment
A psychological horror narrative contorts and unfolds to reveal choices beyond comprehension



Will you find your way home, or wander these halls carved of memory forever?

title: Primordialis
description:
게임 정보
Primordialis is a physics-based roguelike fish builder. Unleash your creativity to defeat creatures using venomous tentacles, electrical shocks, or exploding children. The possibilities are endless. Explore the primordial depths to reveal its secrets and discover what lies beyond.
================================== Grow ==================================
Use the simple but flexible creature creation system to become anything you want.
Draw your creature using a wide variety of cell types which each have a unique function.
Combine different cells to construct your own weapons, defenses, and mobility.
Decorate your creature with custom coloring.
================================= Survive =================================
Overcome enemies and environmental hazards to grow larger and advance.

title: Fading Faith
description:
게임 정보
예루살렘 아래
1187년, 예루살렘. 살라딘의 군대가 다가오는 동안 탐욕에 이끌린 너는 금을 위해 저주받은 터널로 들어간다—하지만 어둠은 위험을 숨기고 있다.
예루살렘의 탐욕스러운 피신처

title: Bug Alliance
description:
게임 정보
Bug Alliance is a pixel style top-down action RPG, where you play as bug warriors, each with unique abilities and weapons. Choose your Bug, select a game mode and dive into battles against worm tyranny. Fight, upgrade, farm resources, evolve and become a legend. Alliance is calling you!
-------------*******-------------*******-------------*******-------------*******-------------
THE STORY
After the Earth faces the catastrophic meteor strike, everything changes once and for all. With the extinction of humanity, it leaves its place to a new mutated life. This "New World" is mainly ruled by two forms of living, Bugs, and Worms. Worms try to devour the nature to feed their greedy King - Glutton.
Bugs, on the other hand, under the command of their Queens, pledged to protect the nature and the whole living from hoggish worms at any cost. After losing the great battle, bugs and their queens are captured, tortured, and enslaved. Many years later, bugs create a secret alliance, called “Requiem Society”, with the mission to unite all of the brave and mighty Bug warriors across the continent and fight back for the Volucris and the Queens!
-------------*******-------------*******-------------*******-------------*******-------------

title: Fatal Dopamine/ 致命多巴胺
description:
게임 정보
About This Game

"Fatal Dopamine" is a strategy-filled and challenging roguelike card game that also tests your luck. In this game, you will play as an anonymous gambler who arrives at a peculiar casino. Using a variety of unique cards, you'll employ strategy and luck in a blackjack-based game to achieve victory and become a "big shot" on the leaderboard. The gambling here isn't just about playing blackjack; it integrates multiple complex rules and strategies. Each game is a psychological battle where you need to gauge your opponent's thoughts and predict their next move. Simultaneously, you must manage your chips and cards to ensure you can surprise your opponents at critical moments. Through continuous gambling, you can gather clues to uncover the well-hidden truths of this place. Is there a conspiracy behind the games? Deception among gamblers? Evil dealings by merchants? What is the truth behind the dopamine? More stories await your discovery.

Story Background

In this world, there exists a place where only those driven by extreme desires can enter. Here, they come with their lucky cards, wagering their blood as the stakes to raise the ante for their enemies. Those who come here are all in pursuit of becoming the prominent figures on the leaderboard, which promises them the long-coveted "dopamine" they've heard so much about.

However, behind the facade of playful revelry, a darker undercurrent flows. This secretive place attracts a variety of individuals: powerful counts, scholars in search of truth, and swordsmen who will stop at nothing to gain power. Each gathers here for their own reasons, creating an atmosphere thick with tension and excitement. In the brightly lit hall, every table is adorned with exquisite gambling tools. The gamblers' eyes are like those of hungry wolves, fixated on every card and chip on the table.


-Lucky Cards: Customize your own cards that will soon meet you in the game, providing crucial assistance at critical moments.
-Deck Building: Defeat merchant bosses to unlock powerful effect cards and build your unique deck to form a distinct combat style.
-Free Choice of Challenge Order: Challenge the big names on the leaderboard in any order you prefer, which will influence the sequence of merchant card -unlocks and your deck building strategy.



-Randomly Generated Levels: Each adventure is a new experience. Randomly generated enemies, events, and rewards ensure every game is full of surprises.
-Random Events: Encounter random events that will give you extra number and effect cards. Keep an eye out for them when they appear.
-Strategic Combat: Plan every move carefully, using card combinations and tactical strategies to defeat powerful enemies and bosses.
-Permadeath: Death is final. Every failure means starting over, but you can learn and grow stronger from each experience.
-Story Unlocks: Continuously collecting cards will unlock new character stories, giving you a deeper understanding of the diverse characters in the casino.


Diverse Card Collection: Over 100 unique cards providing countless combinations and strategies.
Deep Strategy: Every decision is crucial. Choose the best cards and strategies for the current situation to progress further.
Unique Visual Style: Beautiful hand-drawn art brings you into a fantastical world that is both beautiful and dangerous.
Engaging Music: Completely original soundtrack that creates a tense and exciting adventure atmosphere.

title: Exorcist Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Exorcist Simulator is an immersive multiplayer horror game that will captivate players and immerse them in a world of supernatural events and dangers. Step into the shoes of a professional exorcist and confront powerful demons and malevolent forces. Your task is to vanquish them and save the world from evil.

In Exorcist Simulator, players will experience thrilling first-person shooter gameplay where every move counts. Explore mystical locations, venture into abandoned buildings and monastery complexes where darkness prevails.

With its realistically rendered environment, players will feel the true atmosphere of fear and tension, where every step could be their last. Be prepared for unpredictable acts of violence from demons who will try to eliminate you from the game. Utilize high-precision weaponry and powerful magical spells to overcome hordes of enemies and survive.

Exorcist Simulator also offers an engaging multiplayer mode where you can test your skills in battles against other players. Gather a team of friends and employ strategic tactics to defeat menacing demons and rival exorcists.

Solve puzzles, uncover hidden objects, and collect valuable relics that can grant you additional power in the fight against evil. Your choices and actions will impact the course of events and the ultimate outcome.

Prepare yourself for an unforgettable adventure in the world of multiplayer horror. Quell merciless demons, unravel mysteries, survive brutal encounters, and save the world from impending doom in Exorcist Simulator!

Features:
Intuitive gameplay: The game offers simple controls and easy mechanics that allow you to quickly learn and enjoy the game without unnecessary difficulties.
A variety of weapons: The game offers a wide variety of weapons and magic spells, allowing players to choose the strategy that best suits their playstyle.
Fascinating places: Players will explore a variety of locations, such as abandoned buildings, dark dungeons, and mysterious forests, which creates an immersive atmosphere and sparks the imagination.
Exciting multiplayer: The game offers the opportunity to play with friends online, where you can test your skills and compete with each other in exciting battles

title: Long Trip
description:
게임 정보
게임의 이야기는 장거리 종교 전쟁 중에서 시작됩니다. 플레이어는 초보 기사로서 고대의 신이 탐구를 위해 자신을 부르게 되었습니다.
여행가로서 각 지역을 탐색하고, 오래된 민족의 추적을 찾아내고, 듯한 문제를 해결하려고 합니다. 길을 나아갈수록 위험한 생물들과 만날 것입니다. 그리고 미션을 완성할 때까지 주민들과 팀업합니다. 당신은 자신의 모험 파티에 다양한 동료를 영입할 수 있으며, 그들은 전투에서 유용한 도움을 제공하고 장애물을 무너트리는데 도움이 됩니다.
그러나 승리를 위해 강력한 상인들과 전투에 직면하라. 당신의 여정을 도와주기 위해 능력을 강화하기 위해 소중한 재료를 모아 음식, 요약 및 무기를 제조하십시오. 최고급 무기를 제작하고 강력한 반대자와 힘든 전투에 참여할 수 있습니다.
Long Trip은 매우 인상적인 아트스타일과 광범위한 몰입형 세계를 포함하여 독특한 게임 경험을 제공합니다. 그것은 도전적이지만 공평한 게임 플레이를 통해 플레이어를 마법의 세계를 탐색하고 점령하도록 초청합니다. 이 환상적인 여행을 시작하겠다고 준비했다면?

title: Grand Emprise 2: Portals Apart
description:

A once-in-a-lifetime high-paced high-variety survival crafting adventure through magical portals and into fantasy worlds.
The sequel to Grand Emprise: Time Travel Survival
Features
FANTASY WORLDS: enter into exciting new worlds with seamless portals!
GATHERING & CRAFTING: gather resources and craft your own tools and weapons!
BASE BUILDING & POWER: build crafting stations and power generation structures!
COMBAT: many challenging bosses await (difficulty setting available)!
TRAVERSAL: upgrade and traverse the worlds in the coolest and fastest ways!
Adventure
High-paced, high-variety!

Collect magical ingredients and build your cozy witch home while exploring the wonderful sights and secrets of these mysterious lands. Beware though, danger might be lurking deep in these woods...
Custom outfits for your witch
Craft tools to gather magical resources
Manage your health, happiness, hunger and thirst
Adopt a companion cat
Furnish your secluded witch cabin

title: Goblin Cleanup
description:
게임 정보



Have you ever wondered what happens after completing a dungeon, how it is restarted or, better yet, who is in charge of doing it? In Goblin Cleanup, you assume the role of a professional cleaner hired by the dungeon manager to clean and prepare the dungeon for the next adventure. You can perform this task alone or with up to three companions, cooperatively or maybe not so cooperatively!






Be careful because the dungeons are dark and full of terrors, although as a professional cleaner this is not a problem, just don't step on a trap, and keep the monsters fed, you don't want them to eat you, or any of your friends.



You can clean the dungeons with three more employees, just watch what they do, because if they die you will have to clean their pieces and blood, the heroes already leave everything very dirty to make things worse.
Clean the dungeons in cooperative games for 4 players online.

Art restorer Kaelin Rykhard is invited by the reclusive painter Felix Mortimer to review his famous collection. When Rykhard arrives at the mansion, Mortimer is missing, the place is damaged, and strange artworks hint at something terrifying.
AN EVER-CHANGING NIGHTMARE
Screams, ghouls, ghosts — make your way through an oscillating chateau ripe with paranormal phenomena never repeating and always spine-chilling.

title: Imperialism: Concert of Europe
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to an era defined by steam power, revolution, and imperial expansion in the 19th century. Can you steer your nation towards prosperity, renown, and dominance?

Overview:
Immerse yourself in turn-based grand strategy gameplay set amidst the dynamic landscape of the 19th century.

Gameplay Features:
Develop your nation's industry by constructing factories and expanding railroads.
Transform raw resources into refined goods to drive economic growth.
Utilize goods to bolster your population across various societal strata, including workers, soldiers, and engineers.
Forge alliances with minor powers to extend your Sphere of Influence.
Engage in global trade within a market shaped by the forces of supply and demand.
Negotiate colonial territories with rival great powers to expand your dominion.
Seize diplomatic advantage by purchasing other nations' debts and accruing interest.

Historical Depth:
Experience pivotal historical events that shaped the course of the 19th century.

Visual and Auditory Experience:
Enjoy a board game-inspired aesthetic that captures the essence of the era.
Navigate through a Victorian-style user interface for an immersive gameplay experience.
Immerse yourself in the era with a classical music soundtrack that sets the mood for strategic conquest.

title: The Tragedy at Deer Creek
description:
게임 정보
In the winter of 1997, photographer Charlotte Gray ventures into the remote woods of Alaska, to the derelict logging camp at Deer Creek, in order to complete her project 'Abandoned Alaska.'
Having photographed ghost towns throughout the Midwest, Charlotte expects to find the worn remains of a piece of American labor history, but what she finds is a place that seems to be eerily frozen in time, harboring numerous secrets sleeping deep beneath the Alaskan snow.
Bit by bit, she finds fragments from the lives of the people who once lived here. Piecing together the fragments, Charlotte slowly starts to unravel the tragedy that befell Deer Creek and its people.
'The Tragedy at Deer Creek' is a narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game that tells a mournful tale of family, loss, and loyalty, exploring the lengths we are willing to go to protect the ones we love.

Take your animals on walks anywhere you go to explore and enjoy the countryside together!
Animals come in various colours, patterns, and personalities. Baby animals will inherit genetic traits from both parents, so you'll need to consider these factors as you breed your animals. Can you discover all 50+ special breeds?
Give gifts to your animals, pet, interact with them and play fetch together!
Find and befriend wild animals in various unique areas such as a procedurally-generated maze-like forest!










Llama Town boasts a diverse population for you to meet! From the aspiring designer to the chill gamer, resilient immigrant, and determined engineer, encounter individuals with unique personalities and intriguing stories. Clown Meat is a Precision Platformer with an emphasis on speedrunning and replayability. Tumble through a butchered world where humanity is barely a memory on your naïve journey to cheer up the monolithic clown that came from the Depths of Jupiter.

Rally your friends or team up with other players in a seamless cooperative multiplayer experience.
Build your own band of warriors, each with unique skills and abilities.
Plan and execute strategies together in massive battles that test your teamwork and leadership.

Immerse yourself in a sprawling, realistic medieval world filled with kingdoms, castles, and villages.
Choose your path: serve a lord, establish your own kingdom, or become a feared warlord.
Engage in epic sieges, skirmishes, and large-scale battles that will leave your mark on the realm.

title: Memento Dawn
description:

Memento Dawn is a colorful puzzle game in which we can control the light and shadow to help the girl find a way to get back her memories.
A PUZZLE GAME FOR WHOLESOME EXPERIENCE.
Follow the girl's journey through a beautiful land where her memories are kept and help her answer the hidden mysteries.
UNIQUE BUT SIMPLE MECHANIC FOR EVERYONE.
Manipulate light and shadow to create a path for the girl to go through the darkness. Collect memories to unfold a lovely story.

title: Swordai
description:
게임 정보
Swordai is a multiplayer sword fighting game where players compete to climb a tower full of monsters, traps, and treasure. Swordai combines a fast paced directional combat system that includes ripostes, feints, parries, kicks and combos with massive multiplayer dungeons, loot, abilities and a skill tree. Enter the tower alone or with friends, battle your way through monsters, bosses and other players, and escape with your loot alive.

As you progress through the various trials and challenges that Swordai has to offer you will unlock skills and abilities that allow you to customize your combat style as you strive to gain power and reach the top of the tower. Each floor of the tower is a unique hand-crafted dungeon crawl with a variety of different enemies, trials and monsters as well as the ever present threat of other players.



Fight with or against up to 50 other players as you compete to traverse enormous dungeons filled with monsters, bosses, traps, and treasures.





Swordai uses an "easy to learn, difficult to master" directional combat system that provides a fluid yet brutal combat experience that will keep you coming back day after to day to hone your skills.





Slay bosses, find chests, or kill other players within the tower, then find an exit portal to escape with your loot.





Unlock new powerful abilities and upgrades as you progress.

title: Pirate Island
description:
게임 정보
항해를 시작하고 신비한 해적 섬에서 스릴 넘치는 모험에 참여하세요. 모든 구석에 위험과 경이로움이 기다리는 오픈 월드 서바이벌 크래프트 게임에 깊게 빠져보세요.
위험한 물길을 탐험하고, 숨겨진 만을 발견하며, 섬의 비밀을 밝혀내세요. 해적의 섬의 모든 부분은 발견을 기다리는 이야기로 가득 차 있습니다.
생존 및 제작
난파선에서 재료를 구하고, 자원을 모으며, 필수 도구와 무기를 제작하세요. 자신만의 해적 피난처를 건설하는 것은 요소와 더 많은 것에 대한 생존에 중요합니다.
주변의 바다는 이국적인 해양 생물로 가득 차 있습니다. 생계를 위해 낚시를 하거나, 파도 아래로 다이빙하여 심해의 신비를 만나보세요.

title: Frog Island
description:
게임 정보
Trapped on a deserted island, you are greeted by a mysterious woman who asks you to take care of her frogs while she is away. However, she vanishes the next day, leaving only a hand-written note behind:

"I'm terribly sorry, but some extremely urgent matters have sprung up that I must attend to. It will be a while until I return. Without a caretaker, these froggies will have no one to play with, and no one to take care of them. I've seen the kind of person you are. Kind, caring, and always willing to help. As such, I am entrusting the role of caretaker to you while I am gone. I hope you will accept this."

With nowhere to go, you have but two simple tasks:

1. Escape Frog Island
2. Accept the role of caretaker of Frog Island

Explore the island, grow crops, forage in the wild, fish, and befriend magical and divine frogs as you try to find a way to escape the island, and figure out why you're even here in the first place. Unravel the island's history, and discover the key to your escape, all while forming lifelong bonds with the island's magical and divine frogs. The true answers lie hidden within the island, waiting for you to uncover them.

title: Family Land - Farmer Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Many people dream of running away from the city to the countryside. When you get a chance to buy a farm in Tennessee, you don't hesitate for a moment.
Located in a picturesque spot, surrounded by forested hills, it is truly awe-inspiring.
But there’s a lot of work ahead of you. The buildings are falling apart, so is the equipment. The animals wander around as they please, and the fields are slowly turning into a forest. Even Old Bill who sold us the farm is still living in the shed, the thought of moving out never even crossing his mind.

Time to roll up your sleeves and get to work. The farm needs a serious renovation to become an ecological agricultural enterprise. A humorous story about the struggles of a townie who decided to become a farmer. This simulator will provide you with hours and hours of unconstrained entertainment.

Renovate!
All the buildings need to be renovated. The old boards and tiles have to be removed. Some elements have to be torn down. You need to clean the stables, get rid of rats and mice. You can choose whatever you need from the range of available tools and options to rebuild the farm just the way you like it. You are free to decide what you want to do first.
Build!
If your aim is to have an ecological farm, you need to plan its development. You can construct new buildings or expand the existing ones. Change the interiors and room layouts. Your budget is the only limit.
Cultivate the land and breed animals!
The fields have been lying fallow for a long time. You will need to grub up the trees, remove the weeds and sow corn. Ecological farm has its own rules. There is a lot of manual work to do. Grow tomatoes, green beans, cotton, soya, corn, wheat and sorghum.
As you renew the stable and the barn, you can build new corrals for the animals. You can breed horses, cows, sheep, goats, chickens, rabbits and bees.
Open a store and sell goods from your farm. Invite people from the city to your fields and your orchard, and let them harvest your crops for a fee. Organize family events. Sell your goods in bulk to supermarkets.


As the farm grows, you’ll no longer be able to do everything by yourself. Hire people. Choose the actions they can perform using the UI. Monitor their work, fire them and hire new employees if there is a need.
Old Bill, who lives in the shed by the forest, won’t be very favorable towards your proceedings. Try to win him over. Maybe what he does in the shed can be included in your offer of goods. It's Tennessee, after all!
Set a weather station to protect yourself from dangerous weather events.
Foxes, martens and bears will be a pain in the neck. Build live-capture traps and protect your farm.
The neighborhood has its history. Taking a long walk might pay off. If you look around carefully enough, you may find some interesting objects, or even gold and silver! All of that can be sold, which will surely help you develop your farm.

title: The Lacerator
