title: Cubetory
description:
게임 정보
Cubetory is a factory-building game with a deep focus on automation. You'll place mining drills, conveyor belts, launchers, stampers, power stations, and tons of other machines as you build your factory. Unlock new technologies and fully leverage them to work through the 16 levels of progression. With no enemies or time limits, you’ll have all the time you need to perfect your design.
Paint-based manufacturing with the P.I.T.
Your goal is to produce specific types of cubes by mining, painting, and assembling them, then delivering those cubes to the PIT.  You'll never have to remove old supply lines — only upgrade them — as your factory will need to produce every type of Supply Cube to progress.
Supply lines and Rate of Production
Each new tier of technology is unlocked by reaching a target rate of production, perfect for people who love tweaking their factory to run just right. New tiers introduce advanced technologies, more room to build, and new types of cubes you'll need to deliver to the PIT.

title: Katanaut
description:
게임 정보
Katanaut은 우주적 혼돈 속으로 빨려 들어가는 거대한 우주정거장에서 펼쳐지는 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다. 우주정거장은 점차 통제 불능 상태가 되어 가고, 한때 인간이었던 거주민들은 공포의 존재로 변해 버렸습니다. 그리고 당신은 필사의 전투가 펼쳐지는 격렬한 복도에서 살아남을 수 있을 거라 확신하며 그곳에서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는지를 밝히는 임무를 맡습니다.
넛이 되어 예전의 활기를 잃어버린 우주정거장의 복도를 탐험하세요. 깊숙이 들어갈수록 환경은 더욱 끔찍해지고, 적들은 인간의 모습에서 멀어집니다.
당신은 첨단 시간 조작 기술을 통해 심장박동이 감지되지 않을 때마다 다시 살아납니다. 필요에 따라 새로운 능력을 다운로드할 수 있는 미래의 우주정거장에는 죽은 자들의 기억 파편이 흩어져 있습니다. 각 파편을 열면 잃어버린 기술 또는 재능을 획득할 수 있습니다.

title: To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Wildlands of Faenora!

Embark on an epic journey through the enchanting Wildlands of Faenora, where legends are born and heroes are forged. Inspired by classic tactical RPGs, Wildlands of Faenora combines strategic squad-based combat with rogue-lite elements, set in a mesmerizing world of magic and mystery.

Key Features:

Tactical Squad Battles: Lead your squad of unique units in thrilling turn-based combat. Position your heroes wisely on a 3x3 grid and outsmart your enemies with your tactical brilliance.


Unit Customization: Equip your units with powerful weapons, armor and accessories. Promote them to advanced classes to unlock new abilities and dominate the battlefield.










In the heart of Faenora, a realm where magic and might intertwine, your hero rises to forge their name as a Faenoran legend. Drawn by tales of a fearsome Gryphon, you, the hero, embark on a quest for glory and adventure. Armed with an enchanted Phoenix Amulet that protects you from the lasting embrace of death, you set out with a band of loyal companions and venture into the untamed Wildlands to hunt the Gryphon. What other secrets might you uncover along the way?

The fate of Faenora lies in your hands.


Get a head start on your epic journey by pre-registering for early access and adding Wildlands to your wishlist! Be among the first to explore the Wildlands, provide feedback, and help shape the game.
autokwd: To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora

title: LAUNDRY / ランドリー
description:
게임 정보
Note: This game is still in development, and content may change.
LAUNDRY is a Heisei retro-style 3D horror adventure.
Story
In the 1990s, there was a laundromat in a certain town in Japan. This laundromat had been temporarily closed due to the disappearance of its previous owner, but it is now reopening. The protagonist, Hitomi, visits this laundromat and gradually gets involved in eerie events.

Game System
Fixed Camera + Tank Controls
Players control Hitomi from a third-person perspective using a fixed camera with various angles.





Players guide Hitomi as she enters the laundromat and does her laundry. Through this routine, the background of the laundromat and Hitomi gradually becomes clear, transitioning the game from ordinary to extraordinary.





By playing the cassette tapes obtained, players can transition into flashback scenes to learn about past events.
Each cassette contains unique music and audio, each with its own distinctive emotion.

title: Automaton Heart
description:
게임 정보
Automaton Heart is an adventure game set in an esoteric world. Uncover the history of the place you find yourself trapped in during an expedition to find your creator, learn about your origins, and stabilize the planet's chaotic ecosystem.
Wander through ancient ruins, natural environments, and colossal structures built by the 'constructs', a group of synthetic beings that live forever.

title: BUDD
description:
게임 정보
B.U.D.D. is a sci-fi action platform game with light Metroidvania elements, inspired by games and anime from the late 80's and early 90's.
Bounty Hunter for Hire: Eris Altair
Step into the boots of Eris, an ARCANA bounty hunter-in-training who crash lands on the mysterious alien planet of Verdeo. To make her way back to the space colony, she'll find one of many B.U.D.D. units, versatile helper drones that aid in combat and traversal. After escaping Verdeo, Eris will uncover the secrets of not only her crash, but the organization that hired her, and the entire Lumina System.
A Helping Hand in Battle
Eris can use her B.U.D.D. units to solve puzzles, attack the enemy, extend a combo, or open up opportunities for extra damage. With each level earned, Eris and her BUDD units will learn new skills to overcome the Lumina System's many challenges.
Space Faring Adventure
After repairing your ship, you'll take on missions for colony MARI-XIII and embark on a journey across four planets, each with its own unique challenges, secrets, and boss battles. In addition to the main planets, you can test your skills in multiple timed satellite missions, where precision and speed are rewarded generously.
Features
4 full regions to explore across the Lumina System.
5 Satellite missions to test your skills.
Plenty of abilities to learn thanks to your BUDD Units.
An introspective story. Just who is Eris? Why did she join ARCANA? And why is the desk clerk so interested in her?
Extra challenge modes unlocked after the main campaign.
Galleries that fill out as you progress through the game.
Plenty of other secrets to find!

title: Ink Reverie
description:
게임 정보
Ink Reverie is a casual city-building game set in a fictional historical era with art inspired by the Tang and Song dynasties.

As you gradually unfold these scrolls, you traverse through the shifting sands of time and the rise and fall of history, returning to a secluded town from a thousand years ago. As a diligent manager, you'll guide hardworking villagers to transform a remote village into a prosperous home through exploration, construction, production, and trade.
Game Features

Five distinct regions and human environments, each with unique gameplay mechanics: Jiangnan Mountain Village, Dunhuang and the Western Regions, Citong Sea Area, the Four Seasons of Jincheng, and the ancient capital of Chang'an.
Traditional Chinese style hand-drawn art: Utilizing detailed literature research and field investigations, combined with fictional elements, to recreate the styles of the Tang and Song dynasties in a unique way.
Unique match-3 synthesis gameplay: By clicking and dragging, you can freely adjust the building layouts. Adjacent low-level buildings will merge into high-level buildings, unlocking more gameplay and content.
Goal of increasing prosperity: Through exploration, construction, production, and trade, gradually build your ideal home.
Chapters in the Game

🌸Chapter I: Jiangnan Mountain Village🌸
"In the south of the Yangtze River, I meet you again in the beautiful scenery as flowers fall."

A small village nestled in the picturesque Jiangnan area, perched on a mountain, maintains simple trade relations with the town at the foot of the mountain. The tea and peach blossom brew produced here are considered real treasures. Starting from a small piece of wasteland, you will establish basic production facilities and expand the village through trade with the town, aiming to create an ideal and prosperous home. Tea and peach blossom brew are the village's specialties, and you need to use these resources wisely to acquire more types of buildings and increase the village's prosperity.


🐫Chapter II: Dunhuang and the Western Regions🐫
"Beneath the moon of Dunhuang lies a sea of sand; the ancient road witnesses poplars through the years."

Dunhuang, a vital trade hub on the Silk Road linking East and West, serves as the starting point for you embarking on your trade journey. You can construct relay stations and organize caravans, choosing to trade eastward or westward to acquire diverse resources. Besides regular resource production, you must build relay stations and organize camel caravans to establish trade routes with cities in both directions. Through these extensive journeys, you can obtain precious materials and resources, facilitating the development and expansion of your town.

⛵Chapter III: Citong Sea Area⛵
"The waves are calm, and great whales rest; the sails shine as treasure ships arrive."

Citong ancient port (now Quanzhou) is the starting point of the ancient Maritime Silk Road. You will begin a new chapter of maritime trade here. The sea area is filled with unknowns and challenges, and you need to plan resources wisely to increase the success rate of merchant voyages. Besides regular resource production, you need to build merchant ships and form fleets for maritime trade with other regions.

🌾Chapter IV: The Four Seasons of Jincheng🌾
"In spring, returning to thickly shaded tall trees; in autumn, arriving at late blooming fragrant yellow flowers."

Jincheng, located at the foot of North Heng Mount in Shanxi, experiences four distinct seasons and notable climatic characteristics. You need to strategize resource management according to seasonal changes, ensuring successful crop harvesting and material storage. Each season brings unique production priorities and resource demands, necessitating careful planning of crop planting and storage techniques. Focus on large-scale production activities in autumn, and ensure adequate material reserves to endure the winter cold.

🐲Chapter V: The Prosperity of Chang'an🐲
"Looking back at Chang'an city, the embroidered piles of mountains open in succession."

Chang'an, the capital of thirteen dynasties, was the center of ancient China's politics, culture, and economy. In this chapter, you will develop various markets, experiencing the grandeur of the Tang dynasty. Buildings are classified into 4 types: scholars, farmers, artisans, and merchants. As these buildings upgrade, their attributes will improve. By strategically combining different buildings within various market areas, you can unlock unique benefits.

title: Valheron
description:
게임 정보
Presentation
First game developed by Maël Boucault, 19, a student in video game design.
After nearly a thousand hours of work, I'm proud to present the first version of this project, with updates planned to enrich the experience and add new features.
For a long time, I've found the world around me boring, and playing video games was an escape, but today my aim is to create worlds that entertain and amuse me. With this in mind, I founded AtomicPunch Studio to make this dream a reality and launch my very first game.
Quick Description
Guided and created by the gods, you are the hero the people need.
Your mission: eradicate the demons that threaten this world and help the villagers rebuild their communities. You'll need to explore the lands of Valheron, recruit allies and form a fighting team to confront the forces of darkness.
In the kingdom of Valheron, a fearsome swordsman named Kwang arrives in a village on the brink of destruction. A demonic rift has opened, releasing an ancient demon named Sevarog, who threatens to engulf the entire world in a wave of darkness. On his journey, Kwang befriends two unlikely allies: Gideon, a powerful sorcerer, and Crunch, a robot with mysterious origins. Together, they must join forces to save Valheron.

title: Traveler Of Light
description:
게임 정보
게임 배경
아달루 대륙은 시종 평화와 안녕을 유지하고 있으며 사악한 세력은 오랫동안 봉쇄되어 왔다.그러나 악의 힘이 다시 깨어나면서 용감한 전사로서 어둠의 세력과 절망적인 전투를 벌이도록 다시 소환됩니다.

게임 기능
이 게임은 여성을 주인공으로 한 3인칭 RPG 캐릭터 게임이다.암살, 윗몸일으키기, 점프, 반격, 추격, 조합, 능동 기술 등 다양한 기술 설계가 있다.새로운 스킬을 잠금 해제하고 다양한 액티브 및 패시브 스킬을 사용함으로써 당신은 더욱 강해질 것입니다


게임은 산간, 숲, 성, 지하감옥, 동굴, 눈밭 등 풍부한 장면을 가지고 있다.게임은 만화 장르에 속하며,"허황 엔진"을 선택하여 제작하고, 젤다 스타일 장면!


게임에는 많은 적들이 있다: 근접 유형, 원거리 공격 유형, 마법 유형과 거대 생물, 서로 다른 몬스터는 서로 다른 공격 특징을 가지고 있다. 적의 공격 특징을 파악하는 것이 당신이 적을 성공적으로 격파하는 관건이다.

title: Metro Station Designer
description:
게임 정보
이 매혹적인 엔지니어링 시뮬레이션 샌드박스 게임에서 “지하철역 디자이너”가 되어 현대 지하철역에 대한 당신의 비전을 현실로 만들어 보세요. 개인적으로 수천 명의 통근자 경험을 향상시키는 효율적인 교통 허브를 설계하세요.
건설, 시뮬레이션, 반복
직관적인 도구를 활용하여 복잡한 다층 지하철역을 손쉽게 디자인하십시오. 계단, 에스컬레이터, 엘리베이터 및 개찰구와 같은 필수 시설로 그들을 갖추세요. 그리드가 없는 환경에서 독창적인 통로와 광장 레이아웃을 만들어 보십시오. 다양한 도구를 활용하여 승객 흐름을 효과적으로 관리하고 만족도와 원활한 여행을 보장하세요. 수천 명의 통근자가 움직이는 실시간 시뮬레이션을 통해 역의 유기적 운영을 경험하십시오.
도전과 창의성의 완벽한 조화
구조적인 과제를 좋아하든 제약 없는 창작 공간을 선호하든, “지하철역 디자이너”는 당신의 취향에 맞춥니다. 캠페인 모드에서는 각기 다른 도전과 즐거움을 제공하는 50개 이상의 정교한 레벨에 도전하세요. 지하철역에 대한 더 나은 생각이 있나요? 샌드박스 모드에서 창의력을 발휘하여 꿈의 역을 제한 없이 설계할 수 있습니다.
광범위한 모드 지원
게임은 포괄적인 모드 지원을 제공합니다. 새로운 지도를 만들고 커뮤니티 회원을 초대하여 그들의 실력을 시험해보십시오; 디자인을 공유하여 다른 사람이 더 향상시킬 수 있는지 확인하십시오; 다양한 모드를 가져와 현실 세계의 기차와 시설을 귀하의 지도에 도입하십시오.
도시 교통을 재정의할 준비가 되셨나요? “지하철역 디자이너”에서 자신에게 도전하여 효율적이며 승객 만족도를 향상시키는 혁신적인 솔루션을 만들어 보십시오. 도시 교통의 미래는 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다.

title: Butterfly Dream
description:
게임 정보
Add to wish-list to support us!
Contact Email:
hddy2000@qq.com
The realm of Fargodia, a time long from now.
The ancient ritual of Butterfly Summoning has awakened the once-dormant providence.
King Verlenbair, now fully transformed into a spectral figure, stands poised at the crossroads of fate.
Behind him a silent battle brews, with an archenemy arriving from the depths of dreams.
The laments and hopes of past worlds signal both redemption and judgment, with each butterfly flutter heralding either a new dawn or the shadow of apocalypses.
Will this be the start of a new saga, or the revelation of something deeper?
As destinies intertwine, the story shall be unfolded.
Based on traditional box-garden level exploration and combat experience, Butterfly Dream integrates Chinese philosophy and aesthetic thinking. It is a small-scale souls-like game of retro style.
[Retro-style box level]
"All phases are illusory"
Go into strange dreams, explore dark medieval castles, and immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of Gothic.
Step into a dangerous world and crack the intricate map of the courtyards.
Find a variety of weapons and props to overcome the powerful monsters that hinder you.
[classic fragmented narrative]
"There was once a man who dreamed that he had become a butterfly"
Take the dialogue of characters and the collection of props as clues to piece together the truth of dreams in confusion.
Experience the amplification and distortion of desire, and feel the struggle of people to become monsters.
[High-degree-of-freedom combat]
"Wash us with your precious blood and forgive us all our sins"

title: The Diner at the End of the Galaxy
description:
게임 정보
사막 행성의 버려진 교역소를 은하계의 상인, 음흉한 귀족, 밀수꾼, 무역상, 모험가 등 온갖 손님이 모이는 곳으로 탈바꿈시키세요. 고바드 몇 푼을 쓸 의향만 있다면 누구든 환영입니다.
식당 관리
웅장한 식사 공간, 부산한 주방, 이색 작물이 무성한 실외 정원을 조성하세요. 외계인 손님들의 가지각색 입맛에 맞춰 메뉴를 개발하세요. 인테리어 디자인을 최적화해 배고픈 손님이 몰려오는 시간을 잘 넘기세요. 문을 열고 들어오는 아무나 고용해 누사 항성계 최고의 요리사, 정원사, 웨이터, 기능공을 식당에 영입하세요.
음식을 통한 외교
사람들끼리(아니면 외계인들끼리) 친해지는 데 흡족한 식사만 한 게 없죠. 식당 관리가 어렵게 느껴지신다고요? 전쟁으로 멸망 직전까지 치달았다가 회복 중인 은하계의 복잡한 정치판에 휘말릴 때까지 기다려 보세요. 패권을 두고 다투는 강력한 진영들 간 동맹 관계와 적대 관계를 좌우할 열쇠가 당신의 요리에 있습니다.
야심 찬 지도자의 원대한 비전에 딸려 갈 수도 있고, 기름때 낀 주방의 막후에서 조종할 수도 있습니다.

title: Tavern Keeper 🍻
description:
게임 정보


나만의 선술집을 짓고 꾸미고, 직원을 고용하고, 식료품 저장고를 채우고, 주민들을 만나고, 사장이 되어 시설을 운영하세요! Tavern Keeper 🍻는 디테일한 비즈니스 관리 시뮬레이션, 창의적인 장식 샌드박스, 한입 크기의 인터랙티브 스토리북이 하나로 합쳐진 게임입니다.

이 게임은 Game Dev Tycoon을 개발한 인디 개발사 Greenheart Games 💚의 두 번째 게임으로, 거의 10년에 걸쳐 제작되었습니다!




당신의 역할, 수락해야 하는 이유

당신은 왕국 변두리에 있는 선술집에서 시작하여 방을 짓고, 아이템을 배치하고, 식료품 저장고를 채우고, 직원을 고용하여 문을 열고 들어오는 괴상한 지역 주민들의 요구를 채워줘야 합니다. 잘 운영하여 더 큰 규모의 선술집으로 성장하고 새로운 식사, 음료, 방, 서비스를 추가하여 사업을 확장하세요.







Tavern Keeper는 예상치 못한 방식으로 섞여 나올 수 있는 시뮬레이션 디테일로 가득합니다. 온도 시뮬레이션, 다양한 성격 특성 및 수십 가지의 다른 시스템 덕에 재미가 끊이지 않습니다. 하지만 걱정하지 마세요. 어떤 상황에도 대처할 수 있는 도구들이 있으니까요.





기발한 캐릭터로 가득한 판타지 세계에서 싱글 플레이어 캠페인을 진행하세요. 사기꾼 증후군을 앓고 있는 변신술사부터 사후세계에서 정체성 혼란을 겪는 해골에 이르기까지, 길모퉁이에는 항상 여러분과 같은 선술집 주인의 안내가 필요한 깜짝 손님이 있습니다.




건설, 장식, 제작을 좋아하신다면 Tavern Keeper의 디자인 모드가 마음에 드실 겁니다!


테이블 위에 양초 하나를 올려놓거나 의자를 나만의 화려한 베개 요새로 바꾸고 싶으신가요? 클릭 몇 번으로 전부 해낼 수 있습니다. 게다가 다른 사람과 창작물을 공유할 수도 있습니다!

💚

title: Project Haven
description:
게임 정보
You command the Steel Dragons, a mercenary outfit fighting for survival in the harsh, urban near-future that is Haven City. Select and control squads of mercs as they battle gangsters, rival mercs and corrupt government forces in a bid to make ends meet, and make a difference where you can. Manage your crew’s stats and gear, wrangle a diverse range of merc personalities, and conquer the deep tactical elements that make Project Haven a standalone turn-based combat experience.

You will have at your disposal a variety of mission types and challenges and once a contract is accepted, it’s up to you to select, equip and control your squad of mercs in order to achieve the mission goals. You will have the option to explore different fighting styles using a combination of equipment, attributes, specializations and skills against handcrafted enemies and environments that cater to multiple tactics.


Aim freely at your enemies with simulated projectiles. All this from a 3rd person view. With the modular damage feature, you can wing your enemy to reduce their accuracy, shoot them in the legs to slow their movement or go for sweet extra damage with a headshot.


Hunker down or lean into cover. Use stealth to avoid detection and takedown unaware enemies. Throw grenades or heal your mercs. Hack locks or demolish walls to get to your enemies. And all the while the mercs have free movement, navigating without restrictive square or hex grids.


As events unfold, learn the harsh realities of a seething megacity full of desperation and dark secrets. Witness the gritty lives of mercs and NPCs, and experience a story-driven campaign with fully voiced and motion-captured characters and cinematics.


Command a group of mercenaries, each with their own unique personality and attitude towards each other. Improve their attributes and unlock new skills as they gain experience and level up. Shape your squad to match your tactical approach, from sneaky scouts that go unnoticed to hardy tanks that can shrug off enemy fire. Enjoy a highly personalized experience in leading your mercenary team.


Magazine management, chambered bullets, and different types of ammo for different situations. Calibers and ammunition types affect how far and how well projectiles penetrate and damage the target. Modify your weapons to increase their effectiveness in your preferred playstyle. Suppressors for stealthy kills, long range scopes for improved accuracy and many others.


Play solo or in co-op up to 4 players through the turn-based online co-op campaign mode, or skirmish in procedurally generated maps, fighting against friends or AI.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2
description:
게임 정보
엘더 뱀파이어가 되어 전쟁의 긴장감이 감도는 현대 시애틀을 누비세요. 막강한 영향력을 지닌 인물들을 만나고, 동맹을 맺고, 지배자와 도시의 새로운 모습을 내 손으로 정하세요.

BAFTA 수상에 빛나는 스튜디오 The Chinese Room이 선사하는 세계로 빠져드세요. 뱀파이어 궁정의 권력 공백과 머릿속에 울리는 목소리와 함께 깨어난 엘더의 등장으로 벌어지는 삼파전이 시애틀을 배경으로 펼쳐집니다.
괴물은 다름 아닌 나
당신은 피로 연명하고 피로 디시플린을 사용하는 뱀파이어입니다. 밤에는 도시 사람들에게 접근해 피를 빨아먹죠. 초자연적인 힘을 사용하거나 거친 설득을 통해 희생양들을 깊고 어두운 골목으로 유인하고 굶주림을 해소하세요. 하지만 마스커레이드를 깨뜨리지 않도록 조심해야 합니다. 정체를 드러내는 자에게는 보복이 기다리니까요. 처음에는 법의 처벌이겠지만 그다음은... 밤에 활동하는 강력한 존재는 당신만이 아니라는 걸 기억하세요.

어느 뱀파이어 클랜을 선택하느냐에 따라 플레이 스타일과 접근 방식이 완전히 달라지는 몰입감 넘치는 생생한 전투를 경험하세요. 초자연적인 무력을 사용할지, 멀리서 뛰어난 언변을 자랑할지, 아니면 먹이사슬의 최정상에 있는 포식자답게 약자들을 도태시킬지 싸움의 방식을 고르세요. 클랜 선택은 다양한 플레이스타일과 더 많은 것들을 결정합니다.
어둠의 세계
World of Darkness의 세계로 들어와 뱀파이어 사회에서의 지위를 높이거나 모든 걸 거부하고 사회에 반발하세요. 패권 경쟁으로 자신도 모르는 사이에 위태로운 처지에 놓인 인간들은 물론, 위험하면서도 매혹적인 인물과 세력이 가득한 도시 시애틀을 탐험하세요. 이 컬트 클래식의 속편에서는 권력의 균형, 도시와 그 안에 살아가는 사람들의 운명이 당신의 선택, 음모, 계략에 달렸습니다.

title: Darkwater
description:
게임 정보
Darkwater는 1-4인용 협동 탈출 호러 게임입니다. 직접 만든 잠수함을 타고 외계 행성의 얼어붙을 듯한 깊은 바다에서 살아남으세요.
혼자 또는 잠수함 선원들을 모아 플레이하세요. 최대 4인까지 팀을 이루고 심해의 위협에 대항하세요. 적 잠수함과 결투를 펼치고, 오래 전 버려진 기지에 잠수함을 정박하여 자원을 모으세요.
치명적인 질병이 외계 행성에 퍼졌습니다. 정부에서는 이에 대응하기 위해 바다 표면을 얼려버렸고, 당신과 당신의 선원들은 얼음 속에 갇히고 말았습니다.

title: Slime Alchemy
description:
게임 정보
Rotate the hexagons to fit the pieces together
Go through challenges. Create slimes.


Slime Alchemy is a relaxing puzzle game.
Featuring:
Move pieces on a hexagonal grid, fitting them into patterns to solve the puzzles.
There are 50 challenging levels to complete.
Engaging and relaxing soundtrack.
Fully replayable (pieces are shuffled randomly with each new playthrough).

Are you ready to solve the and create ?

title: Mythos: Build & Survive
description:
게임 정보
Before the missionaries came to the Slavic lands to start writing down the known history, there was the Age of Mythos:

Forests, valleys and fields are full of creatures from Slavic beliefs. Even though they may look like monsters, you don't have to fight them all. Make proper offerings to them and you will gain powerful allies.


Give your workers a roof over their heads and a good supper and they will build a thriving settlement for you. Do not disappoint your subjects, because dissatisfied people may leave you.

title: Agent 64: Spies Never Die
description:
게임 정보


Immerse yourself in a thrilling retro first-person shooter experience that pays homage to the beloved console shooters of the 90s. Step into an adrenaline-fueled world where you'll embark on daring missions, traverse captivating landscapes, and engage in pulse-pounding battles against cutting-edge enemy AI straight out of the futuristic realm of 1997.

A heart-pumping journey through a realm of espionage and non-stop action that will keep you on the edge of your seat!



John Walter, ex-agent codename 64, is called back into action to save the world once more. Protect the future against the phantoms of the past.

Each story mission is a self contained environment where you have to accomplish varied objectives, such as hacking terminals, steal secret plans, free civilian hostages and much more. All the while fighting armed guards in epic shootouts.

Be the most elite operative the world has ever seen!

title: Wander Stars
description:
게임 정보
Unleash custom attacks by combining words in a Super! Anime! Turn-Based! RPG!
Join Ringo, a young martial artist looking for her brother, and Wolfe, a mysterious scoundrel running from his past, as they join forces in an unlikely partnership to collect the pieces of the fabled Wanderstar Map. Across 10 “episodes” of anime-inspired adventure, Ringo and Wolfe will have to work together to find answers, make up for past mistakes, and travel across the universe in search of their goal. And who knows, maybe they’ll learn how to get along at some point!
Trained in the ways of Kiai, a magical form of martial art and also the universe’s most exciting form of televised entertainment, Ringo can combine words to create customized attacks in intense turn-based battles. During her race across the universe you’ll expand Ringo’s vocabulary, equip Pep Up bonuses earned through honorable victories and level up her spirit power. Defeat or befriend a cast of fearsome space pirates, mysterious scoundrels, cute witches, high school delinquents, talking crows, and skilled martial artists on your way to becoming a Kiai master.

title: Cairn
description:
게임 정보
현실적인 등반 시뮬레이션
Cairn의 실제에 가까운 시뮬레이션으로 실감 나는 클라이밍을 경험할 수 있습니다. 최적의 홀드를 찾아 간단한 조작으로 손과 발을 위치시켜 보세요. 자세를 수정하고 힘을 들이며 균형을 잡아야 합니다. 방심하는 그 순간, 추락하고 말 테니까요!
일생일대의 등정
전문 등반가 아바가 되어 그 누구도 오르지 못한 카미산을 올라야 합니다. 모험 도중, 생각지도 못한 동료를 만나고, 땅에 남은 자들의 이야기에 귀를 기울여 보세요. 카미산의 숨겨진 이야기부터 꿈을 위해 아바가 감내하게 될 희생까지. 모든 것은 당신의 손과 발 끝에 달려있습니다.
나만의 길을 개척하기
어디든 자유롭게 오를 수 있습니다. 산을 탐험하며 바위의 표면을 확인하고 루트를 잘 확인하여 정상에 오르세요. 바위 위의 난제를 해결하며 어려운 구간을 돌파해 보세요. 어디든 오를 수 있으니, 경로를 신중하게 선택해야 할 겁니다!
등반은 자신과의 싸움
등반은 어렵습니다. 모든 벽이 최상 난이도로 느껴지죠. 도전을 넘치는 이들에게는 긴장감 넘치는 모험이지만, 난이도를 조절해 더 쉽게 플레이할 수도 있습니다.

title: Beneath
description:
게임 정보
러브크래프트 스타일 1인칭 서바이벌 호러 액션 에드벤처 게임인 Beneath에서 심연 속에 빠져들어 나의 가장 깊은 두려움을 마주하세요.
노련한 다이버 노아 퀸의 일상적인 탐험이 혼돈에 빠져 고대 악마가 도사리고 있는 심해에 갇히고 맙니다. 보급품은 줄어들고 악몽 같은 괴물들이 가까이 다가오고 있는 상황 속에서 노아는 소름끼치는 돌연변이들, 서서히 다가오는 광기, 인류 자체를 위협하는 불길한 음모와 정면으로 맞서야 합니다. 딸의 목숨이 어떻게 될지 모르는 상황에서 노아는 시간과의 사투를 벌이며 자신을 한계까지 몰아붙입니다.
노아가 진실을 파헤치고 고대의 공포가 들어나는 것을 막을 수 있을까요? 아니면 심연이 모든 인류를 잡아먹게 될까요?
러브크래프트 스타일 호러
기괴하고 혐오스러운 존재로 가득한 분위기의 세계관이 여러분이 걸려들기만을 기다리는 으스스한 러브크래프트 스타일의 악몽에 빠져들어 보세요. 긴장을 늦출 수 없는 미스터리, 서스펜스, 충격적인 반전으로 가득한 흥미진진한 서사를 풀어 보세요.
자원 관리
보급품이 부족하고 탄약이 줄어드는 가운데 심연 속으로 내려가는 여정을 헤쳐 나가세요. 온전한 정신은 가장 중요한 자산이며, 심연의 공포가 우리의 몸과 마음을 위협하면서 위태로운 상황에 놓이게 됩니다.

title: Silly Polly Beast
description:
게임 정보
Embrace your inner demon or be consumed by it.
17-year-old Polly escapes a nightmarish shelter, only to find herself trapped in the underworld.
The city was shrouded in fog. Deadly fog. If you see such a sign, be careful. Your fog bracelet will illuminate the deadly fog red when it's very close.
You'll encounter denizens of the otherworldly realm, not all against you, but none on your side. No matter how events unfold, never forget the terms of the pact that plunged you into this abyss.
Prepare for a unique gameplay experience, blending world exploration with battles from side and top-down perspectives. Ancient forbidden knowledge will bolster your strength. With each new spell mastered, Polly's power grows deadlier.

title: Survival Machine
description:
게임 정보
Survival Machine은 협동 모드가 가능한 3인칭 서바이벌 어드벤처 게임으로, 다채롭고 다양한 풍경 속에서 펼쳐집니다. 요새이자 집이며 이동 수단인 거대한 기계 위에서 끊임없이 변화하는 세상을 탐험하세요. 혼자 또는 친구들과 함께 게임을 즐기며, 자원을 모으고 새로운 업그레이드를 제작하고, 생존에 도움이 될 구조물을 건설하세요.
모험적인 여정에 나서세요
매력적인 도전과 다양한 비밀이 가득한 다채로운 땅을 따라 길을 찾아보세요. 귀중한 보상이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다. 더 많이 탐색할수록 플랫폼 도전, 전투 아레나, 숨겨진 비밀 등을 마주하게 될 것입니다.
주변을 살펴보고 계획을 세워 장애물 코스를 통과하세요. 글라이더나 집라인과 같은 개인 이동 수단을 사용하여 가장 험난한 지형과 접근하기 어려운 장소까지 탐험해보세요. 혼자 달리거나 친구들과 팀을 이루어 함께 여행하며 모든 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

title: The Alters
description:
게임 정보
The Alters는 독특한 반전을 품은 야심 찬 SF 서바이벌 게임입니다. 여러분은 얀 돌스키가 되어 외계 행성의 혹독한 환경에서 살아남아야 합니다. 이를 위해서는 거대한 이동식 기지에서 래피듐이라는 물질을 사용해 새로운 대원을 만드는 것이 필수적입니다. 인생의 결정적인 순간에 다른 선택을 내려 지금의 얀과는 판이한 삶을 살아온 여러 다른 버전의 얀, 즉 얼터를 만들어내는 것입니다.
 생존을 위한 투쟁, 숱한 도덕적 딜레마를 직면하며 매력적인 인물관계와 까다로운 선택으로 가득한 분기형 스토리를 헤쳐나가세요.
또한, 이 게임은 인생에서 가장 근본적인 질문 중 하나인 운명과 자유의지에 대한 성찰로 여러분을 초대하여 몰입감 높은 외계 행성에서의 생존 투쟁으로 이끕니다.
기지에 탑재된 양자 컴퓨터를 활용해 과거에 다른 결정을 내렸다면 펼쳐졌을지도 모를 삶을 시뮬레이션하고, 얀의 또 다른 인생 경로를 발견하세요. 래피듐의 놀라운 성질을 말미암아 탄생한 얼터들은 저마다 고유한 능력과 서사를 가지고 있습니다. 이는 얀이 자신의 상처와 존재의의를 직면하고, 대원 간 인간관계를 관리할 기회와 그들 간의 위기를 동시에 제공하는 요소입니다.

title: Moros Protocol
description:
게임 정보
You wake up aboard The Orpheus, a derelict warship lost in deep space and crawling with horrors. No memory. No allies. Only the instinct to fight and a voice urging you forward. The ship shifts around you, the enemies never stop, and survival means battling through blood-soaked corridors to uncover what lies ahead.
Set in a haunting, low-poly world with crunchy pixel textures, Moros Protocol blends fast-paced combat of classic '90s and early 2000s FPS games, the unpredictability of genre-defining roguelites, and the challenge of Souls-like boss fights. Battle relentless enemies and towering nightmares in a brutal test of skill and willpower. With procedurally generated levels, evolving threats, and intense action, survival is never guaranteed.
The ship is a war zone. The enemy is endless. The odds are against you.
You may be outnumbered, but you are not outmatched.
🔺TACTICAL FPS COMBAT
Moros Protocol combines relentless action with adaptability and customization. Shape your loadout and let the augments and weapons you find dictate your fighting style. And yes, you can kick your enemies.

title: Ronin Trail
description:
게임 정보
The samurai were proud warriors who were devoted to their jobs: to cut down their foes. As the Tokugawa Era began, Japan returned to a state of peace and the samurai found themselves jobless. They became drifters who travelled from place to place, tossed around like a wave. These men were called rōnin.

Play as a wandering rōnin travelling across the Japanese countryside in search of a purpose. Reclaim your lost glory and become a legend.

Features
Explore lively environments filled with wildlife and lush vegetation. Catch fish and bugs, hunt animals, and forage for mushrooms. Record unique species in your critter book.

Customize your character with hats, clothing, and katanas as you explore the world and defeat foes. Style your outfits to your liking with dyes and different clothing combinations.

Survive off the land by building campfires and cooking fish. Equip thicker clothing to survive in cold as you travel north towards snowy environments. Maintain your katana's steel by cleaning blood and sharpening with whetstones.

Cut down your foes with your trusty katana. Learn techniques and hone your mastery with the skill-based combat system. Challenge dojos, accept duels, and hunt down bounties on your journey to become the greatest swordsman.

title: Paper Sky
description:
게임 정보

작은 종이공이 날아다니는 꿈을 꾸는 숨막히는 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
이 "오픈 월드" 모험에서 플레이어는 독특한 스타일의 풍경 속에서 종이 비행기를 조종하는 방법을 배웁니다. 자신의 스타일에 맞는 방식으로 동작 기술을 탐색하고, 상호 작용하고, 배워 모든 여행을 개인적인 경험으로 만들어 보세요.



게임의 중요한 메커니즘 중 하나는 종이 비행기와 종이 공 사이를 전환하는 능력입니다. 속도를 높이고, 장애물을 통과하고, 점프하고 활공하여 숨겨진 영역을 발견하고 새로운 이동 능력을 잠금 해제하세요. 모든 사람이 자신의 속도에 맞춰 게임을 즐길 수 있도록 보장하면서 헌신적인 플레이어에게 보상을 제공합니다.



게임의 비행 역학은 활공에 중점을 둡니다. 컨트롤을 마스터하여 공중에 머물고 활공하는 방법을 배우세요.

title: SWAT Commander
description:
게임 정보
첨단 특수 무기와 전술 팀의 지휘를 맡습니다. SWAT Commander는 현실성에 큰 중점을 두면서, 택티컬 게임의 풍부한 역사뿐만 아니라 해당 부대가 배치되어야 할 필요성이 있는 실제 상황을 다룹니다. 스쿼드 성원들은 당신의 지휘를 따르며, 다양한 상황에 적극적으로 대응하여 적과 효과적으로 싸우고 경찰 규약을 따릅니다. 올바른 명령을 내리면서도, 자신이 작전의 중심에 있고 많은 임무를 혼자서 수행해야 한다는 점을 잊지 마세요!
고도로 훈련된 정보원이자 핵심 전술 부대의 구성원인 당신과 팀원들은 매우 위험한 여러 미션을 수행하게 됩니다. 인질극, 강도, 갱 전쟁, 기타 여러 범죄 활동의 증인이 되세요. 최대 5명의 플레이어가 참여하는 코옵 모드에서 AI 정보원이나 친구들과 함께 미션을 완수하세요!

title: No Way Home: BLAMMO!
description:
게임 정보
No Way Home: BLAMMO! is a tactical arcade roguelite that's all about fast-paced twin stick space combat.
Every run is a new adventure. Tinker with your ship, experiment with unique weapons, and discover interesting new builds as you blast your way through waves of enemies and bosses.
The gameplay is simple!
Choose a Loadout
Start BLAMMING!
Salvage, Tinker, Upgrade
BLAM HARDER!
Die | Win
Unlock new co-pilots, their perks, and other long-form progression
GO AGAIN!

title: Spire
description:
게임 정보
In a far-future seascape cursed by the ancients, will you make mankind's last home a haven or a fortress?
Surge, Spire, and Sea is a 333,333-word interactive post-apocalyptic science fantasy novel by Nebula nominated game writer Stewart C Baker. It's entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
Back rebels or royals, or pursue your own rise to power. Speak for the spirits or fight for your own kind, or try to reconcile both by uncovering ancient injustices. Heal the creatures afflicted by a magical rot or defeat them in the name of defending the ones you love. Shape humanity's destiny with magic, alchemy, or high-tech masonry. 
But be warned: the gods, the spirits, and your king are watching your every move.
Master the art of spirit magic, the high-tech craft of masonry, or meld science and the supernatural with alchemical potions.
Play as male, female, or non-binary; cis- or trans-gender; gay, straight, bi, asexual, or poly.
Cast your lot with the king and his Spireguard or the anarchist rebels of the Surge.
Explore the Spires and Shallows, two distinct regions of Gigantea, humanity's last tower-home.
Seek out platonic, romantic, sexual, and polyromantic relationships with a diverse and memorable cast of NPCs.
Sail the rot-cursed Worldsea in search of life—or fortify your home with a powerful military fleet.
Experience a festival and night market with delicious food and entertaining mini-games, as well as gifts for your loved ones.
Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic setting where people of all body shapes, sizes, disabilities, skin tones, and identities are treated equally.
Strive to become the new ruler of your home or turn away from it all for a chance to explore the world.
Communicate in speech and sign language.
* Navigate a world propped up by centuries of truth, lies, and mythology.
* Climb ruined towers or seek refuge in a subterranean space of your own making.

title: Birdigo
description:
게임 정보
Make Words
Longer words score higher, but specific combos can turn short words into powerhouses. Not happy with your hand? Discard any number of letters, up to four times each round.

Build your Deck
Add enhanced letter cards to supercharge your score. Delete difficult letters to improve your odds of drawing the ones you want.
Deploy Feathers to Change the Game
Feathers aren’t just bonuses. They transform how words are scored, making some patterns incredibly potent.
Try Wild Strategies
With more than six million possible combinations of feathers, along with enhanced letters and transformative songs, there’s no limit to the strategies you can try. How about two-letter words with enhanced letters left in your hand? It could work!
Lead your Flock to Safety
Birdigo consists of migrations with dozens of stopovers — each one a chance to replenish and re-strategize. To reach the next one, you’ll need to fly further each round.

Achievements unlock new feathers, songs, decks, and migration routes. Huge bonuses and multipliers mean big numbers, which you’ll need to win these treacherous routes.
Should you play that easy word, or discard some letters in the hopes of drawing something better? Which feather should you pick? Which song? Your choices are the difference between a successful migration and failure.

title: Plush Party
description:
게임 정보
Easy to enter, fun to master controls!
Add style to every game! Customize everything from appearance to accessories, and create your favorite plushie.

title: Chessplus
description:
게임 정보
Combine. Split. Promote.
Use regular chess moves to merge two pieces onto the same square, creating a powerful hybrid. Move the combined piece using either piece’s abilities, or split them apart later to individual pieces for strategic positioning when the time is right.
But beware, if the combined piece is captured, you'll lose both!
Features
Explore exponentially more strategies by combine pieces into powerful hybrids or split them later for strategic positioning. Need more queens? Create your own with a "Biook" (Bishop + Rook) or rocket a pawn across the board with the "Rawn" (Rook + Pawn) for a quick promotion. 
Balanced Chess at its core, only regular legal moves apply. But be careful if your combined piece is captured - you'll lose them both!
Show off your ELO ranking in PC / Mobile in cross-platform multiplayer and make every move matter in a Roguelike adventure.
How to Play
Use traditional Chess moves to combine your pieces.

title: RogueMath
description:
게임 정보
Play your formulas to reach objectives
Use your available formulas strategically to achieve various objectives.
Build your deck

title: The King Of Beasts
description:
게임 정보
Kill enemies to evolve into enemy form. Players will control mutated creatures with this ability, constantly fighting against other mutated creatures to evolve into more powerful creatures. They will survive in terrifying alien experiments and become the king of beasts.
Game features:
Evolutionary freedom, as long as you kill enemies, you can evolve into enemy form.
Perilous dangers lurk in the alien experimental field, and players need to remain vigilant at all times.
Immersive experience, a grand and unique alien experimental field.
Diverse characteristics, mutated organisms all possess unique abilities.
Fighting wits and courage, directly challenging powerful mutant creatures is not the best way. It requires the reasonable use of experimental field mechanisms and other mutant creatures.
Time limited survival, as time goes by, more and more powerful experimental subjects will join the battle and survive until the end to become the king of beasts.
autokwd: The King Of Beasts,异兽之王 The King Of Beasts

title: B-Type: Space Builder
description: 게임 정보

title: Snow Resort Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Step into the world of Snow Resort Simulator. Tackle daily responsibilities: upgrade facilities, maintain a cozy resort, satisfy guests with freshly cooked meals and drinks, and keep your inventory fully stocked. Be prepared for the challenges that come with winter.
Ensure you prepare tickets according to customer requests. Sell tickets to customers who want to ski. Use the income to improve your resort and restock supplies.

title: The Vast White
description:
게임 정보
Explore The Vast White at your own pace
Embark on a solitary snowboarding journey down a vast, untamed mountain where every run is unique. The Vast White blends exploration, storytelling, and the thrill of the descent into a seamless open-world adventure. With only your board and your instincts, carve through pristine alpine wilderness, uncover hidden trails, and unravel the secrets buried beneath the snow.
🏔️ An Open Mountain to Conquer
Ride at your own pace through sprawling peaks, frozen forests, and secluded valleys—every path you choose reveals new wonders and challenges.
❄️ Uncover the Mountain’s Mysteries
Explore every corner of the mountain to find hidden routes, and stunning landscapes that reveal the mountain's past.

title: Sleep Well Cemetery
description:
게임 정보
You play the role of a gravedigger who takes care of peace and order at the cemetery every day. Your daytime duties seem simple, but they require attention and commitment

However, when darkness falls, the cemetery comes to life in a completely different way. The night brings unexpected challenges – things you don't expect. Every night can surprise you, and you have to be ready to face whatever has decided to go out for an evening walk.


Driving a Melex around the cemetery is not just ordinary transport - time is running out and there are plenty of responsibilities. Sometimes you have to be in a hurry, which means that slightly damaging a tombstone is just... part of the workday.



Assembling coffins is the basis of every day - each one must be carefully prepared, because we never know what we will use it for in the end.



Sometimes the situation at the cemetery requires more than just a shovel and a melex. When things start to get out of control, you need to reinforce yourself.



When the dead decide to leave their graves, your task is clear: gently but firmly guide them back to their resting place. Peace must be restored!



Remember that as a gravedigger you have to be ready for anything.

title: Class of Heroes 3 Remaster
description:
게임 정보
Class is back in session! After a 15 year wait Class of Heroes 3, the revered school-themed dungeon RPG series, is finally here!
Enrol in one of three distinct schools and join your fellow students on an epic dungeon crawling adventure. Enjoy school life on campus and meet brand new friends for a huge range of characters and classes.
Choose your party to suit your play style and then take to the sprawling 3D dungeons to take down enemies and acquire loot to see your party get ever stronger. With hundreds of combinations of Race, Classes, armours, weapons and Items, you can create a wild array of party compositions to take on the challenges ahead!
Remastered for an all new generation, Class of Heroes 3 is the pinnacle of this much loved series!
Key features:
Enter the dungeon!: Class of Heroes 3 takes 3D dungeon-crawling RPGs to a new level - with more characters and bigger dungeons than ever before!
Back to School: Choose from one of three distinct schools - each will change your uniform, difficulty and story!
Make new friends! The new relationship system will allow you to forge (or break!) bonds with the fellow students in your party. The stronger the bond, the greater the benefit!
Let’s party!: Team up with fellow students from a huge range of races and classes to build the best possible party of heroes to explore dungeons with.
Plunder the dungeons!: Take your party into colossal, labyrinthine dungeons - fight off enemies and plunder the loot to make yourself stronger on each run!
Build it your way: With hundreds of weapons, armour and items - along with  even more combinations of races and classes. Customise your team to suit your playing style!
New and improved: As the third iteration in the series, every aspect of the original games has been enhanced and improved to make this the most enjoyable in the series yet!

title: Kitty Powers' Matchmaker Makeover
description:
게임 정보
It's time to make love happen, again!
In Kitty Powers’ Matchmaker: Makeover, players step back into the role of a matchmaking agency manager, helping quirky clients find their true love under the expert guidance of the fabulous Kitty Powers.
This remastered version comes bursting with vibrant new artwork, expanded customization options, and a host of gameplay improvements to make matchmaking even more fun and inclusive.
Features
Enhanced Artwork: Feast your eyes on Matchmaker’s enhanced assets and sumptuously high definition artwork. Now with 4K and ultra-widescreen modes!
Expanded Customization: Players have new options to dress and style their characters, with updated personalities and fashion that ensures anything goes!
New Gameplay Elements: Flex your matchmaking muscles with new dating dilemmas, improved mechanics, and refined controls that make it easier to create perfect matches.

title: VoidWalker: Call of Insomnia
description:
게임 정보
VoidWalker is an exciting psychological game in which you will explore the boundaries of conscious dreams and reality. You are Kyle, a researcher in an underground laboratory, participating in a unique experiment that allows you to extract objects from the dream world into reality. But it's not all that simple: as you immerse yourself in dreams, you'll encounter eerie nightmares and strange phenomena that challenge your perception.
The key objective is to explore dreams, solve puzzles and collect artifacts that will help your team become millionaires. But soon Kyle encounters a mystical creature - Morpheus, the lord of dreams, who is not happy to have his peace disturbed. You will go through nightmares, frightening events and unexpected encounters, where your decisions will influence the outcome of the plot.
As you dive deeper and deeper into dream worlds, you will solve complex problems and seek answers to questions, but be careful: conscious dreams can become a trap, and reality may not be what it seems. Courage and wit are your main allies in this battle of reason and illusion.
Main features:
A gripping plot that combines elements of thriller and psychological horror.
Realized dreams as game mechanics: interact with the world around you and manipulate dreams to achieve goals.
Unique puzzles that alter the perception of reality.
Frightening enemies and characters, such as Morpheus, that challenge your fears.
Influence decisions on the further development of the plot and the final game.
Immerse yourself in the world of VoidWalker and find out where the dream ends and reality begins.

title: Kernel
description:
게임 정보
Innovative fusion of automatic combat and Trading Card Games! Become the adventurer Kamus and travel through several unknown star worlds. Summon monsters from other worlds to assist you on your conquest journey through highly liberalized decks!
Game features:
·Extremely high degree of freedom deck construction: Before embarking on an adventure, you can choose and edit unique decks, and continuously acquire new cards during the adventure, dynamically adjusting decks to adapt to complex and ever-changing combat environments.
·Instant automatic combat: During the time freeze period, all units on the field are unable to move, and multiple effects can be achieved using cards. You need to choose the right time to freeze your time in order to maximize your advantage.
·Rich and diverse items: During the adventure, you can obtain various items, all of which play a very important role. Choose appropriate item combinations and combine them with decks to achieve maximum profits.

title: Pinbleton Park
description:
게임 정보
Save your village with the power of pinball in Pinbleton Park.
In this cosy pinball adventure game the whole world turns into one giant pinball table with the help of the spirits who live in the village shrine.
Help out the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

title: Adult Game
description: Adult Game

title: Roguebound Pirates
description:
게임 정보
강렬한 해상 전투
바다에는 보물도 가득하지만... 위험 요소도 가득합니다! 교묘한 계획을 세워 적보다 앞서가지 못하면 심해에 빠지게 됩니다.
 함선 커스텀
함선에 다양한 무기, 장비, 신화 속 유물을 탑재하세요. 플레이어는 선장으로서 자유롭게 함선 구조를 디자인할 수 있습니다. 여러 가지 장비 옵션을 발견할 수 있고, 대부분 다른 장비로 추가 개조가 가능하기 때문에 진정으로 강력하고 독창적인 시너지를 만들어낼 수 있습니다.

title: Kingdom Ascension
description:
게임 정보
「Kingdom Ascension」은 중세 시대를 테마로 한 전략 전쟁 게임입니다. 플레이어는 영주의 역할을 맡아 제로부터 자신의 왕국을 건설합니다. 자원을 모으고, 건물을 짓고, 부대를 모집하며, 탐험과 모험을 통해 끊임없이 영토를 확장하고 고향을 방어합니다.
영토를 구축하세요
황량한 땅에서 시작하여, 부대 훈련, 건물 업그레이드 및 기술 연구에 필요한 음식과 자재 같은 필수 자원을 수집하세요. 제한된 자원의 효율적인 배분이 성공의 열쇠입니다.
군대를 편성하세요
적의 침략을 방어하기 위해 군대를 편성하세요. 다양한 유형의 병사를 모집하고 전술적 필요에 따라 부대를 구성합니다. 부대 편성, 병종 및 전술적 배치는 전장에서의 승패를 결정합니다.
기술과 전쟁 기계
경제 성장의 규모와 효율성을 높이기 위해 기술을 개발하세요. 전쟁 기계는 전투에서 중요한 역할을 하며, 전세를 뒤바꿀 수 있는 능력을 가지고 있습니다. 연구를 통해 그 기능과 전술적 적용을 지속적으로 업그레이드해야 합니다.

title: Deepspace Emporium
description:
게임 정보
Deepspace Emporium is an immersive shopkeeping simulator set in the gritty, atmospheric depths of a massive space station, where survival and success are anything but guaranteed. You play as a former scavenger who, with a little luck and a sizable loan, has managed to open a shop on the Lower Levels of this colossal outpost. Life here is tough, with a sharp divide between the wealthy elite in the Upper Levels and the struggling masses below. To keep your shop running, you'll need to buy, sell, and barter a wide variety of goods—from counterfeit cigarettes and handmade firearms to life-saving drugs—all while keeping an eye on the ever-increasing rent demanded by your ruthless landlord.
In this world of gray morality, every transaction is a choice, every choice has consequences, and no one’s hands are truly clean. Command, corporate interests, and local factions all pull at the strings of station life, each with their own agenda. Do you try to stay out of trouble, or do you play both sides to get ahead? How far will you go to survive, and what will you sacrifice to make a name for yourself on the station?
This is the demo version of the game and does not include Save and Loading.
Features:
Run Your Own Shop: Manage inventory, haggle with customers, and make tough decisions on what to stock. Each sale impacts your reputation and the type of customers you attract.
Navigate Gray Morality: Deal with customers from all walks of life, including desperate scavengers, wealthy upper-level clients, and dangerous underworld figures. Not every sale is strictly legal, and not every buyer can be trusted.
Face Rising Rent and Expenses: Your relentless landlord demands an ever-increasing rent, pushing you to make more money, even if it means taking riskier deals or questionable jobs.
Handle Contraband: Trade in goods of varying legality. Avoid detection by authorities while keeping valuable connections in the black market.

title: Tabletop Tavern
description:
게임 정보
테이블탑 태번: 지휘하고, 정복하고, 반복하라

테이블탑 태번에 빠져보세요. 실시간 전략과 로그라이크가 결합된 게임으로, 모든 전투는 주사위 던지기이며 모든 승리는 직접 쟁취해야 합니다. 혼돈의 탁상 전장에서 용병들을 이끌고, 다양한 전사들을 모집해 무자비한 고블린 무리에 맞서 전설을 만들어 보세요. 무한한 조합, 가혹한 선택, 끝없는 재플레이 가능성을 갖춘 이 게임은 로그라이크 팬을 위한 완벽한 RTS 혼돈입니다.
주요 특징:
실시간 전투: 탁상에서 펼쳐지는 역동적인 전투에서 부대를 지휘하며, 모든 움직임이 중요합니다.
팀 모집: 독특한 기술, 개성, 이야기를 가진 다양한 용병들을 모아 팀을 구성하세요.
로그라이크 요소: 매 플레이가 독특합니다. 강력한 장비를 찾아 독창적인 빌드를 만들고, 예측 불가능한 환경에서 살아남기 위해 적응하세요.
무리와 대결: 당신을 파괴하려는 결심을 한 사나운 고블린 군대를 속이고 싸우세요.

title: Junkyard Builder
description:
게임 정보
폐차장 건설자, 당신은 한때 잊혀졌지만 이제는 무한한 잠재력으로 넘치는 폐차장의 자랑스러운 소유자입니다. 복원, 재활용, 그리고 쓰레기를 보물로 바꾸고 정크 제국의 통치자가 되어 즐거운 세계로 뛰어드세요!
🗺️🚗💎보물 찾기: 새로운 장소로 운전하고 희귀한 발견물을 찾아 세상을 탐험하세요.
💰📈🔧돈 벌기 및 업그레이드: 찾은 아이템을 최대한 활용하고 돈을 벌어 스킬 레벨업, 기계 구매, 운영을 간소화하는 더 나은 도구 잠금 해제를 하세요.
♻️🗑️✨쓰레기 처리: 쓰레기를 처리하여 가치를 높입니다. 모든 비트가 중요합니다!
🔍📦💰희귀 아이템 찾기: 돈이나 금괴와 같은 귀중한 아이템을 쓰레기에서 수색하세요.

title: Nyric
description:
게임 정보
Explore. Survive. Shape the Unknown.
Nyric is an open-ended survival game where your imagination shapes the universe. Use prompt-based world generation to bring surreal realms to life, then venture into the unknown to gather resources, uncover secrets, build settlements and leave your mark.
Chart Your Path
Type a phrase—"A city of glowing fungi," "A world trapped in eternal twilight," "A storm-haunted wasteland"—and Nyric generates an uncharted realm for you to explore. Whether you're wandering through a dream or surviving a nightmare with friends, no two journeys are ever the same.
Collectable AI Companions
You're not alone. Strange, ever-curious Faebots accompany you, offering guidance, mischief, and unexpected insight. Some are eager to assist, others follow their own whims—but all will leave their mark on your journey.

title: Games of the Monarch's Eye
description:
게임 정보
Steel, strategy, sabotage - or forbidden magic? How far will you go to defeat your greatest rival and win glory in the grandest tournament in the entire realm? Will you win back your honor or spark a revolution?
Games of the Monarch’s Eye is a Silk Road inspired interactive fantasy novel by Saffron Kuo. It’s entirely text-based, includes hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
After a decade in disgrace, you have returned to your home city of Varze to compete for the title of Monarch’s Eye. In this grand tournament, the bravest Varzians compete in games of Intellect, Heart, and Might. The winner becomes the Monarch’s most trusted guard and advisor, gaining wealth, fame, and honor – everything that you have lost. The only catch? The current Eye - and therefore your main competition - is Casiola, once your childhood friend and now your bitterest rival.
But while you were gone, the city has grown volatile. Powerful factions vie for dominance and the guilds’ professional differences now spill over into political rivalries. On one side, the idealist Artisans, rumored to still dabble in the ancient magic of Celestia as they seek perfection in their crafts. On the other, the ambitious and pragmatic Merchants, constantly chasing fame and profit. Caught between them is the Monarch, striving for a peaceful revitalization for Varze - if only it can happen before the city tears itself apart with an all-out revolution. And the Games might make the perfect opportunity for the factions to make their first moves.
As you prepare for the Games, you must also navigate this factional strife. How will you forge your path to victory? Will you hone your blades, charm the public with your silver tongue, try to get ahead of your opponents with your careful observation of their strengths and weaknesses, or just cheat your way to the top? Will you dive into politics, currying favor with one faction or the other; or will you try to float aloof above them? Do you dare to seek wisdom in the stars, or from forgotten ancient tomes? Whatever path you take, your old rival is right on your heels - and if you’re not careful, you’ll fall behind and lose your honor once more.
Play as male, female, or nonbinary; gay, straight, bi, pan, or aromantic.
Push Varze’s culture towards commerce or craft, peace or war, tradition or modernity.
Compete in high-stakes tournaments to test your wits, strength, and eloquence!
Regain your lost honor through a performance of stellar integrity - or deceive, and sabotage every single one of your opponents! And what will you do if you find yourself fighting in the ring against your true love?
Uncover lost tomes of once-forbidden magic, and reveal the secrets of the stars!

title: Little Chef 2
description:
게임 정보
Little Chef 2 invites you back into the kitchen for a delightful cooking adventure filled with cozy vibes and whimsical fun! Whether you're a seasoned chef or just here for the laughs, this adorable sequel brings joy to every dish you create!
PHYSICS BASED
Enjoy physics-based interactions as you unleash your creativity across a variety of kitchens and charming settings. Grab ingredients and objects from the scene and toss them around at your will.
OVER 150 UNIQUE DISHES
No matter what you end up cooking, a huge variety of possible dishes make every ingredient count and allow you to throw anything into the pot!
CUTE & HIDDEN INTERACTIONS
company: Julien Truebiger, Hello Erika, Danny van Duist

title: Aooni The Horror of Blueberry Onsen
description:
게임 정보
Challenge yourself while being chased by fear! A horror puzzle action adventure!
■A completely new version of the legendary horror game "Ao Oni"!
[What is the new "blue tragedy" unfolding at the abandoned hot spring?]
The once-popular hot spring inn known for its "beauty-enhancing hot spring" is now a ruin.
There was a rumor that it was haunted.
Hiroshi, Takeshi, Mika, and Takuro visit the abandoned hot spring inn to record “Mika Channel” and encounter a “suspicious man” and “Ai” there...
What is the Blueberry Hot Spring found in the abandoned inn, and what awaits them in its deepest depths...?
Can Hiroshi and the others escape safely?
■Many new systems have been added!
There are many new elements such as conversations with characters, cooperative play with friends, and a chat function.
In addition, many new species of blue demons appear! There is even a monster in the form of a humanoid dog...?
■The fastest game ever! 16x speed mode” has been added!
In “High Speed Mode” you can freely choose between 2x and 16x speed!
Can you escape from the "Ao Oni" chasing you at high speed?
■Online ranking function added!
Participate in online ranking by your score when you clear the game!
Play quickly and without mistakes, and aim for a high score!
autokwd: Aooni The Horror of Blueberry Onsen,青鬼 ブルーベリー温泉の怪異

title: 吞食天地HD2D - Three Kingdoms: Zhuge Liang
description:
게임 정보
독특한 HD2D 픽셀 스타일:
게임은 언리얼 엔진 5를 사용하여 전통적인 픽셀 스타일과 현대 엔진의 빛과 그림자를 결합하여 시각적인 향연을 선사합니다.

스토리 내용이 풍부하며, 다음과 같은 장이 포함되어 있습니다:
《황건의 난》, 《서주 침몰》, 《관도 전투》, 《와룡 각성》, 《적벽 전투》
《남정 사군》, 《서정 파촉》, 《북벌 중원》, 《동멸 손오》, 《천하 귀심》

전술이 풍부함:
전투에서는 계략을 사용할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 다양한 스킬을 조합할 수 있습니다. 유명한 무장들은 각각 독특한 재능을 가지고 있습니다.
autokwd: 吞食天地HD2D - Three Kingdoms: Zhuge Liang

title: Sakagura Life
description:
게임 정보
Sakagura Life is an immersive life simulation RPG set in the tranquil beauty of modern rural Japan!
You've inherited your family's old sake brewery (Sakagura) in Mizutani, a peaceful town nestled among rice paddies and forests. Armed with traditional brewing tools and a passion for crafting, it's time to dive into the art of sake-making and restore the brewery from the ground up. Can you master the delicate process of producing Japan’s finest sake while building lasting relationships with the townsfolk and mystical Yokai? With hard work and dedication, you just might bring the community together and revitalize the sake tradition!
Features
Craft premium sake using traditional methods! From cultivating rice in your own paddies to refining and fermenting it into exquisite sake, you'll experience the full brewing process firsthand. Experiment with ingredients and techniques to create unique varieties with distinct flavors.
Build relationships with the locals and Yokai! Share meals and sake at local restaurants and bars to form bonds with the townspeople. Befriend spirits like the enigmatic Yokai, who will help you in combat and exploration. The deeper your friendships, the more opportunities and rewards await!
Explore a world steeped in Japanese culture and folklore! Uncover the mysteries of your rural town and its surrounding areas, where modern life meets ancient traditions. Engage with fascinating characters and discover hidden stories.
Befriend Yokai to unlock their powers! These mystical spirits can become your allies, offering assistance in combat and exploration. Master their abilities and use them to solve environmental challenges or battle the forces that threaten your brewery and town.
Engage in strategic combat with hostile Yokai! Not all spirits are friendly—some Yokai will challenge you in combat. Face off against these dangerous foes, using strategy and skill to overcome them. The Yokai you befriend, however, can join your side, offering powerful abilities to assist you in battle.
Solve puzzles and uncover mysteries! Dive into environmental puzzles and point-and-click adventure-style challenges to unlock hidden areas, gather rare ingredients, and reveal the secrets of the town. Whether it's solving a puzzle with the help of a Yokai or discovering clues, you'll always have something new to explore.
Customize your brewery and sake recipes! Upgrade your Sakagura with new equipment and technology, improving your brewing output. Combine traditional craftsmanship with modern methods to innovate your recipes and create unique, high-quality sake that will leave an impact on the town.

title: Venusville
description:
게임 정보
Venusville은 금성 구름 속에 도시를 건설하려는 우주 정착민들을 이끄는 도시 건설 게임입니다.
게임에서 당신은 기지 건축가이자 관리자 역할을 맡아 식민지 주민들에게 떠다니는 도시를 확장하고 생존에 필요한 구조물을 건설하는 방법을 지시합니다. 온도와 압력을 관리하여 생존하는 동시에 산소, 식량 및 물을 지속적으로 공급해야 합니다.
정착민들은 혹독한 환경에서 에너지를 수집하고, 물을 추출하고, 구름을 채굴하고, 식량을 재배하고, 로봇을 제작하며 완전히 자급자족할 수 있는 기지를 건설해야 합니다. 언제든 완전히 실패할 수 있는 위험이 도사리고 있습니다.
부력과 균형
당신은 금성 하늘에서 도시의 안정성을 관리하는 중요한 역할을 맡게 됩니다.
도시의 다양한 구조물은 각기 다른 무게와 부력 수준을 가지고 있어, 세심한 관리가 필요합니다. 불균형이 발생하면 도시가 뒤집히거나 구조적으로 붕괴되는 치명적인 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다. 배터리 및 엔진과 같은 무거운 요소는 균형을 유지하기 위해 전략적으로 배치해야 합니다.
부력 유지는 단순히 균형의 문제가 아니라 생존 전략이기도 합니다. 금성 대기의 깊은 곳에 존재하는 위험한 온도와 압력으로부터 도시를 보호하기 때문입니다. 이러한 섬세한 균형 유지는 도시를 확장하고 식민지 주민들의 안전을 보장하는 핵심입니다.

title: Dollhouse of Dead
description:
게임 정보
Dollhouse Corp.는 AI를 탑재한 세계 최고의 장난감 제조업체입니다. 회사의 사업은 번창하고 있지만 한 가지 문제가 있습니다. 때로는 스마트 토이가 통제를 벗어나 회사 공장을 점령하기도 합니다. 하지만 인형하우스 주식회사는 알뜰한 회사이기도 합니다! 그들은 점령된 공장으로 가서 회사에 필요한 재료를 수집하는 청소부 분대를 고용합니다. Dollhouse Corp. 청소부가 되어 10달러에 목숨을 걸 준비가 되셨나요? 축하합니다. 채용되셨습니다!
게임플레이

당신의 팀은 버려진 Dollhouse Corp. 공장 중 하나에 도착합니다. 그것은 똑똑한 장난감에 의해 포착되며, 그들 중 일부는 당신에 대해 중립적이지만 다른 일부는 당신의 죽음을 미치게 열망합니다. 당신의 임무는 다양한 쓰레기를 찾고, 거기에서 재료를 추출하고, 점차적으로 해당 위치의 새로운 영역을 여는 것입니다.
제작

수집된 재료를 사용하여 팀은 다양한 유용한 도구와 개선 사항을 만들 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 버려진 공장에서 살아남을 수도 있습니다. 특정 위치에서 잠긴 문을 열 수 있는 장치를 만들 수 있습니다.
장난감

토끼는 대부분 무해합니다. 그들과 쓰레기를 교환할 수도 있습니다. 그러나 당신이 그들에게 대가로 주는 것보다 더 많은 것을 빼앗는다면, 그들은 당신의 머리를 물어뜯을 것입니다! 그리고 이것이 오늘의 마지막 좋은 소식입니다. 나머지 장난감들: Thumper, Spider, Teddy Bear, Doll 및 기타 많은 장난감들이 당신을 보자마자 당신을 죽일 것이기 때문입니다.
숨바꼭질

모두가 당신을 죽이고 싶어합니까? 걱정하지 마세요, 청소부 여러분. 화장실과 옷장에 있는 피에 굶주린 장난감으로부터 숨을 수 있습니다. 하지만 모든 사람이 숨고 찾을 수 있는 장소가 충분하지 않다는 점을 기억하세요! 그러니 동료들 앞에서 숨을 곳을 선택하고 돈을 가지고 살아남으세요.
돈

잉여 자재를 판매하고 장비 개선을 위해 비용을 절약하세요. 어쩌면 언젠가는 은퇴할 만큼 충분한 돈을 갖게 될 수도 있습니다! 그럴 것 같지는 않지만

title: Middle Ages: Peasants & Knights
description:
게임 정보

Welcome to a medieval story of your own making. Live your life as you choose. Farm and sell your crops or pick up a sword and venture into the dark woods. Middle Ages: Peasants & Knights is a game about survival and adventures that you experience alone or with your friends. Every sunrise brings new challenges. And it is your decisions that hold the power to shape how the day ends when the sun sets.



We want everything in our game to be meaningful. That’s why we made a true inventory system that lets you carry only what you could carry in real life. Feel both the burden and the satisfaction of a realistic weight and inventory system. Find effective ways to move resources around and make your life easier.



Crafting should be fun. Immerse yourself in detailed crafting based on real historical methods. Gather raw materials from the world around you, then transform them using the techniques of the time – grind grain into flour with a quern-stone, knap flint into an axe head, or smelt and forge an iron sword blade.



Survival in the harsh medieval world requires foresight and preparation. You can't simply take nature's bounty for granted – the ability to plan ahead and stockpile crucial resources will make the difference between life and death. Ensure you have everything you need before hard times come.



The choice is yours whether to remain a nomadic survivor constantly seeking temporary havens, or to become a settler who bends the land to your long-term vision. Will you carve out a humble homestead or command the construction of an unassailable castle?



Raise livestock and grow a wide variety of vegetables, fruits and grains. If you’re successful, you'll produce surplus yields beyond just meeting your own needs for survival. This surplus can be traded or bartered with others for goods, services, or simply stocking extra provisions.



Middle Ages: Peasants & Knights isn't just about survival and fight with nature or enemy. People can also relax and enjoy the beautiful medieval world. Tend to your farm during the day, and sit around a campfire with your friends in the evening.

title: Orbo's Exodus
description:
게임 정보


After a whirlwind odyssey with his friend, our accountant-turned-hero Orbo decides to make his way home by way of Peeb's signature biplane. While flying over the coast of a mysterious vacation resort, Peeb's attempt to demonstrate a cool loop-de-loop turns into a spectacular nosedive that is only one-upped by the resulting explosion.

Following the crash, Orbo is left stranded, with Peeb nowhere in sight. Left to his own devices, Orbo begins an all-new quest to buy a ferry back to the mainland, but in the process he may discover there's more to the island than meets the eye...

Armed with some new moves and a set of snazzy hats, Orbo sets out on his final adventure: an exodus of epic proportions.



While on the island, Orbo can discover new hats to enhance his lightning-fast moveset. Burrow beneath the earth, take to the skies, and shatter people's jaws like a cannon ball with the new drill, propeller and bowler caps respectively.

Even beyond their remarkable movement capabilities, these hats are an essential tool for solving problems around the island. Use the drill hat to disassemble the world and forage for gourmet ingredients to create a delightful stew. Use the propeller hat to and kill pesky opponents with a controllable laser turret. Use the bowler cap to and perform amateur surgery on your friends. ...

Learn the extents of your hats' capabilities, and you can handle anything.



Orbo's classic moveset is back, ! Not only are the controls tighter, but Orbo is now armed with his new that allows him to quickly cover ground in style. Combine this with your new hats, and Orbo can quickly launch into spectacular aerial maneuvers, high-speed homing attacks, and more.

provide you with a nice breath of fresh air from the main campaign and a chance to go on silly side stories that will test how you move your body. Help a , explore the , and weather ...

Jump, flip, airspin, launch yourself like a .50 caliber bullet, .



The island might seem like paradise on the surface, but underneath it ... Uncover the truth behind this mysterious land's construction, the individuals inhabiting it, and why Orbo ended up here of all places...

description:

Customize your character:
Choose your character's background, choose your talent, assign attribute points, build your character's advantage, is a hundred steps through the sharpshooter, or the mighty strongman, or the swift raider, everything is up to you.
Arm your character:

title: Eldorion: Guardians of the Crystals
description:
게임 정보
Eldorion: Guardians of The Crystals
A pixel art exploration game where you must face various challenges and collect crystals to save Earth from its impending doom. An RPG with multiple continents that have emerged, bringing forth a new era of mysticism.
Story
A global cataclysm reshaped Earth. New continents emerged, bringing forth a new era of mysticism.
Elena's peaceful life is disrupted when her father, a renowned archaeologist, discovers one of the Crystals of Hope. Upon touching this Crystal, Elena experiences memories of her past lives, revealing her true mission—to gather all six Crystals of Hope to prevent an unprecedented catastrophe.
The planet Eldorion, on a collision course with Earth, threatens all life. On this journey, Elena is accompanied by her father and her friends, known as the Guardians of the Crystals. Together, they will do everything in their power to help Elena fulfill her mission and, through the power of the Crystals of Hope, alter Eldorion’s trajectory, saving all life on Earth. However, the "Cult of the End of Times," a sect that has lost faith in humanity, will stop at nothing to prevent Elena from completing her journey.

title: Tides of The Endless
description:
게임 정보
천 년 전, 정체불명의 대재앙이 세계의 평화를 산산조각 냈습니다. 수많은 이들이 예고 없이 거품처럼 사라져, ‘홍계’라 불리는 이세계로 강제로 이동당했습니다.
홍계는 다중 우주를 융합한 신비로운 용광로와도 같은 세계로, 최소 100종 이상의 서로 다른 종족들이 모여 있습니다. 일부 종족은 자신들의 고향 일부 지역까지 통째로 홍계로 전이되었습니다. 각 종족은 독특한 능력과 기술을 지니고 있으며, 한정된 자원을 놓고 치열한 전투를 벌이고 있습니다.
홍계의 공포는 여기서 그치지 않습니다. 이곳에 발을 들인 모든 존재는 강렬한 광기에 사로잡혀 서로를 적대하며 끊임없이 싸워야만 합니다. 심지어 누군가 죽을 때마다 홍계는 점점 풍요로워지는 듯한 모습을 보입니다.
우리 종족은 오직 10만 명의 인구만 유지할 수 있는 극단적인 생존 조건 아래 놓여 있습니다. 한 명이라도 사망하면 즉시 새로운 대체자를 보내야 하며, 그렇지 않을 경우 우리의 모성은 무작위로 한 명을 강제로 홍계로 전송하게 됩니다.
다행히 우리 종족은 독특한 능력을 지니고 있습니다. 영혼 형태로 차원을 넘어 홍계에 진입할 수 있으며, 첨단 기술 덕분에 다른 종족의 신체를 복제해 ‘기체’를 만들어냅니다.
우리의 영혼은 이 기체에 자유롭게 접속할 수 있으며, 기체가 치명적인 손상을 입더라도 영혼은 즉시 새로운 기체로 전이할 수 있어 사실상 '재생'이 가능해집니다. 하지만 기체가 손상되면 복구는 불가능하며, 새로운 기체를 신속히 찾아야 합니다. 제한 시간 안에 적합한 기체를 찾지 못하면 영혼은 소멸하게 됩니다.
홍계에 투입되기 전, 예비 전사들은 ‘임계’라는 가상 공간에서 훈련을 받습니다. 임계는 홍계와 매우 유사하게 설계되었으며, 여기서 모든 예비 전사는 다양한 시험을 통과해야만 홍계에 발을 디딜 자격을 얻게 됩니다.
게임 특징

title: Creature Park
description:
게임 정보
크리쳐 파크에 오신걸 환영합니다!
지루한 일상 생활에 지친 여러분, 현실과 동 떨어진 크리쳐들이 넘쳐나는 크리쳐 파크에 어서오십시오! 크리쳐 파크와 함께 일하게 된 여러분들은 동물원의 밝은 곳이 아닌, 어두운 곳에서 일하게 되실 겁니다. 하지만 걱정마세요! 여러분들을 위한 적절한 메뉴얼과 돈만 있으면 큰 도움을 주는 첨단 기술들이 있으니까요! 그래도 문제가 생긴다면... 다음 사람이 올 테니 저희는 괜찮습니다!
크리쳐를 잡아오세요!

여러분은 위험 지역에 파견을 나가, 크리쳐를 직접 잡아와야 합니다. 크리쳐들은 각기 다른 특징을 가지고 있습니다. 이들을 잘 관찰하여 빈틈을 노리세요!
동물원을 관리하세요!

여러분이 잡아온 크리쳐들은 동물원에서 살게 됩니다. 크리쳐들이 동물원에서 날뛰는 모습을 보기 싫다면, 그들이 원하는 것을 들어주세요. 여러분들의 작은 선택이 동물원 운영에서 어떤 결과를 가져올지는... 직접 확인하세요!
다양한 위협

위험 지역에는 다양한 종류의 크리쳐들이 존재합니다. 여러분은 포식자가 아닌 피식자라는 것을 잊지 마십시오.
협력 플레이

당사는 여러분이 팀을 꾸려 함께 행동하기를 장려합니다! 혼자서는 힘들 수도 있지만, 여럿이라면 가능한 일도 많으니까요!
