title: Cubetory
description:
게임 정보
Cubetory is a factory-building game with a deep focus on automation. You'll place mining drills, conveyor belts, launchers, stampers, power stations, and tons of other machines as you build your factory. Unlock new technologies and fully leverage them to work through the 16 levels of progression. With no enemies or time limits, you’ll have all the time you need to perfect your design.
Paint-based manufacturing with the P.I.T.
Your goal is to produce specific types of cubes by mining, painting, and assembling them, then delivering those cubes to the PIT.  You'll never have to remove old supply lines — only upgrade them — as your factory will need to produce every type of Supply Cube to progress.
Supply lines and Rate of Production
Each new tier of technology is unlocked by reaching a target rate of production, perfect for people who love tweaking their factory to run just right. New tiers introduce advanced technologies, more room to build, and new types of cubes you'll need to deliver to the PIT.

title: Katanaut
description:
게임 정보
Katanaut은 우주적 혼돈 속으로 빨려 들어가는 거대한 우주정거장에서 펼쳐지는 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다. 우주정거장은 점차 통제 불능 상태가 되어 가고, 한때 인간이었던 거주민들은 공포의 존재로 변해 버렸습니다. 그리고 당신은 필사의 전투가 펼쳐지는 격렬한 복도에서 살아남을 수 있을 거라 확신하며 그곳에서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는지를 밝히는 임무를 맡습니다.
넛이 되어 예전의 활기를 잃어버린 우주정거장의 복도를 탐험하세요. 깊숙이 들어갈수록 환경은 더욱 끔찍해지고, 적들은 인간의 모습에서 멀어집니다.
당신은 첨단 시간 조작 기술을 통해 심장박동이 감지되지 않을 때마다 다시 살아납니다. 필요에 따라 새로운 능력을 다운로드할 수 있는 미래의 우주정거장에는 죽은 자들의 기억 파편이 흩어져 있습니다. 각 파편을 열면 잃어버린 기술 또는 재능을 획득할 수 있습니다.

title: To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Wildlands of Faenora!

Embark on an epic journey through the enchanting Wildlands of Faenora, where legends are born and heroes are forged. Inspired by classic tactical RPGs, Wildlands of Faenora combines strategic squad-based combat with rogue-lite elements, set in a mesmerizing world of magic and mystery.

Key Features:

Tactical Squad Battles: Lead your squad of unique units in thrilling turn-based combat. Position your heroes wisely on a 3x3 grid and outsmart your enemies with your tactical brilliance.


Unit Customization: Equip your units with powerful weapons, armor and accessories. Promote them to advanced classes to unlock new abilities and dominate the battlefield.










In the heart of Faenora, a realm where magic and might intertwine, your hero rises to forge their name as a Faenoran legend. Drawn by tales of a fearsome Gryphon, you, the hero, embark on a quest for glory and adventure. Armed with an enchanted Phoenix Amulet that protects you from the lasting embrace of death, you set out with a band of loyal companions and venture into the untamed Wildlands to hunt the Gryphon. What other secrets might you uncover along the way?

The fate of Faenora lies in your hands.


Get a head start on your epic journey by pre-registering for early access and adding Wildlands to your wishlist! Be among the first to explore the Wildlands, provide feedback, and help shape the game.
autokwd: To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora

title: LAUNDRY / ランドリー
description:
게임 정보
Note: This game is still in development, and content may change.
LAUNDRY is a Heisei retro-style 3D horror adventure.
Story
In the 1990s, there was a laundromat in a certain town in Japan. This laundromat had been temporarily closed due to the disappearance of its previous owner, but it is now reopening. The protagonist, Hitomi, visits this laundromat and gradually gets involved in eerie events.

Game System
Fixed Camera + Tank Controls
Players control Hitomi from a third-person perspective using a fixed camera with various angles.





Players guide Hitomi as she enters the laundromat and does her laundry. Through this routine, the background of the laundromat and Hitomi gradually becomes clear, transitioning the game from ordinary to extraordinary.





By playing the cassette tapes obtained, players can transition into flashback scenes to learn about past events.
Each cassette contains unique music and audio, each with its own distinctive emotion.

title: Automaton Heart
description:
게임 정보
Automaton Heart is an adventure game set in an esoteric world. Uncover the history of the place you find yourself trapped in during an expedition to find your creator, learn about your origins, and stabilize the planet's chaotic ecosystem.
Wander through ancient ruins, natural environments, and colossal structures built by the 'constructs', a group of synthetic beings that live forever.

title: BUDD
description:
게임 정보
B.U.D.D. is a sci-fi action platform game with light Metroidvania elements, inspired by games and anime from the late 80's and early 90's.
Bounty Hunter for Hire: Eris Altair
Step into the boots of Eris, an ARCANA bounty hunter-in-training who crash lands on the mysterious alien planet of Verdeo. To make her way back to the space colony, she'll find one of many B.U.D.D. units, versatile helper drones that aid in combat and traversal. After escaping Verdeo, Eris will uncover the secrets of not only her crash, but the organization that hired her, and the entire Lumina System.
A Helping Hand in Battle
Eris can use her B.U.D.D. units to solve puzzles, attack the enemy, extend a combo, or open up opportunities for extra damage. With each level earned, Eris and her BUDD units will learn new skills to overcome the Lumina System's many challenges.
Space Faring Adventure
After repairing your ship, you'll take on missions for colony MARI-XIII and embark on a journey across four planets, each with its own unique challenges, secrets, and boss battles. In addition to the main planets, you can test your skills in multiple timed satellite missions, where precision and speed are rewarded generously.
Features
4 full regions to explore across the Lumina System.
5 Satellite missions to test your skills.
Plenty of abilities to learn thanks to your BUDD Units.
An introspective story. Just who is Eris? Why did she join ARCANA? And why is the desk clerk so interested in her?
Extra challenge modes unlocked after the main campaign.
Galleries that fill out as you progress through the game.
Plenty of other secrets to find!

title: Ink Reverie
description:
게임 정보
Ink Reverie is a casual city-building game set in a fictional historical era with art inspired by the Tang and Song dynasties.

As you gradually unfold these scrolls, you traverse through the shifting sands of time and the rise and fall of history, returning to a secluded town from a thousand years ago. As a diligent manager, you'll guide hardworking villagers to transform a remote village into a prosperous home through exploration, construction, production, and trade.
Game Features

Five distinct regions and human environments, each with unique gameplay mechanics: Jiangnan Mountain Village, Dunhuang and the Western Regions, Citong Sea Area, the Four Seasons of Jincheng, and the ancient capital of Chang'an.
Traditional Chinese style hand-drawn art: Utilizing detailed literature research and field investigations, combined with fictional elements, to recreate the styles of the Tang and Song dynasties in a unique way.
Unique match-3 synthesis gameplay: By clicking and dragging, you can freely adjust the building layouts. Adjacent low-level buildings will merge into high-level buildings, unlocking more gameplay and content.
Goal of increasing prosperity: Through exploration, construction, production, and trade, gradually build your ideal home.
Chapters in the Game

🌸Chapter I: Jiangnan Mountain Village🌸
"In the south of the Yangtze River, I meet you again in the beautiful scenery as flowers fall."

A small village nestled in the picturesque Jiangnan area, perched on a mountain, maintains simple trade relations with the town at the foot of the mountain. The tea and peach blossom brew produced here are considered real treasures. Starting from a small piece of wasteland, you will establish basic production facilities and expand the village through trade with the town, aiming to create an ideal and prosperous home. Tea and peach blossom brew are the village's specialties, and you need to use these resources wisely to acquire more types of buildings and increase the village's prosperity.


🐫Chapter II: Dunhuang and the Western Regions🐫
"Beneath the moon of Dunhuang lies a sea of sand; the ancient road witnesses poplars through the years."

Dunhuang, a vital trade hub on the Silk Road linking East and West, serves as the starting point for you embarking on your trade journey. You can construct relay stations and organize caravans, choosing to trade eastward or westward to acquire diverse resources. Besides regular resource production, you must build relay stations and organize camel caravans to establish trade routes with cities in both directions. Through these extensive journeys, you can obtain precious materials and resources, facilitating the development and expansion of your town.

⛵Chapter III: Citong Sea Area⛵
"The waves are calm, and great whales rest; the sails shine as treasure ships arrive."

Citong ancient port (now Quanzhou) is the starting point of the ancient Maritime Silk Road. You will begin a new chapter of maritime trade here. The sea area is filled with unknowns and challenges, and you need to plan resources wisely to increase the success rate of merchant voyages. Besides regular resource production, you need to build merchant ships and form fleets for maritime trade with other regions.

🌾Chapter IV: The Four Seasons of Jincheng🌾
"In spring, returning to thickly shaded tall trees; in autumn, arriving at late blooming fragrant yellow flowers."

Jincheng, located at the foot of North Heng Mount in Shanxi, experiences four distinct seasons and notable climatic characteristics. You need to strategize resource management according to seasonal changes, ensuring successful crop harvesting and material storage. Each season brings unique production priorities and resource demands, necessitating careful planning of crop planting and storage techniques. Focus on large-scale production activities in autumn, and ensure adequate material reserves to endure the winter cold.

🐲Chapter V: The Prosperity of Chang'an🐲
"Looking back at Chang'an city, the embroidered piles of mountains open in succession."

Chang'an, the capital of thirteen dynasties, was the center of ancient China's politics, culture, and economy. In this chapter, you will develop various markets, experiencing the grandeur of the Tang dynasty. Buildings are classified into 4 types: scholars, farmers, artisans, and merchants. As these buildings upgrade, their attributes will improve. By strategically combining different buildings within various market areas, you can unlock unique benefits.

title: Valheron
description:
게임 정보
Presentation
First game developed by Maël Boucault, 19, a student in video game design.
After nearly a thousand hours of work, I'm proud to present the first version of this project, with updates planned to enrich the experience and add new features.
For a long time, I've found the world around me boring, and playing video games was an escape, but today my aim is to create worlds that entertain and amuse me. With this in mind, I founded AtomicPunch Studio to make this dream a reality and launch my very first game.
Quick Description
Guided and created by the gods, you are the hero the people need.
Your mission: eradicate the demons that threaten this world and help the villagers rebuild their communities. You'll need to explore the lands of Valheron, recruit allies and form a fighting team to confront the forces of darkness.
In the kingdom of Valheron, a fearsome swordsman named Kwang arrives in a village on the brink of destruction. A demonic rift has opened, releasing an ancient demon named Sevarog, who threatens to engulf the entire world in a wave of darkness. On his journey, Kwang befriends two unlikely allies: Gideon, a powerful sorcerer, and Crunch, a robot with mysterious origins. Together, they must join forces to save Valheron.

title: Traveler Of Light
description:
게임 정보
게임 배경
아달루 대륙은 시종 평화와 안녕을 유지하고 있으며 사악한 세력은 오랫동안 봉쇄되어 왔다.그러나 악의 힘이 다시 깨어나면서 용감한 전사로서 어둠의 세력과 절망적인 전투를 벌이도록 다시 소환됩니다.

게임 기능
이 게임은 여성을 주인공으로 한 3인칭 RPG 캐릭터 게임이다.암살, 윗몸일으키기, 점프, 반격, 추격, 조합, 능동 기술 등 다양한 기술 설계가 있다.새로운 스킬을 잠금 해제하고 다양한 액티브 및 패시브 스킬을 사용함으로써 당신은 더욱 강해질 것입니다


게임은 산간, 숲, 성, 지하감옥, 동굴, 눈밭 등 풍부한 장면을 가지고 있다.게임은 만화 장르에 속하며,"허황 엔진"을 선택하여 제작하고, 젤다 스타일 장면!


게임에는 많은 적들이 있다: 근접 유형, 원거리 공격 유형, 마법 유형과 거대 생물, 서로 다른 몬스터는 서로 다른 공격 특징을 가지고 있다. 적의 공격 특징을 파악하는 것이 당신이 적을 성공적으로 격파하는 관건이다.

title: Metro Station Designer
description:
게임 정보
이 매혹적인 엔지니어링 시뮬레이션 샌드박스 게임에서 “지하철역 디자이너”가 되어 현대 지하철역에 대한 당신의 비전을 현실로 만들어 보세요. 개인적으로 수천 명의 통근자 경험을 향상시키는 효율적인 교통 허브를 설계하세요.
건설, 시뮬레이션, 반복
직관적인 도구를 활용하여 복잡한 다층 지하철역을 손쉽게 디자인하십시오. 계단, 에스컬레이터, 엘리베이터 및 개찰구와 같은 필수 시설로 그들을 갖추세요. 그리드가 없는 환경에서 독창적인 통로와 광장 레이아웃을 만들어 보십시오. 다양한 도구를 활용하여 승객 흐름을 효과적으로 관리하고 만족도와 원활한 여행을 보장하세요. 수천 명의 통근자가 움직이는 실시간 시뮬레이션을 통해 역의 유기적 운영을 경험하십시오.
도전과 창의성의 완벽한 조화
구조적인 과제를 좋아하든 제약 없는 창작 공간을 선호하든, “지하철역 디자이너”는 당신의 취향에 맞춥니다. 캠페인 모드에서는 각기 다른 도전과 즐거움을 제공하는 50개 이상의 정교한 레벨에 도전하세요. 지하철역에 대한 더 나은 생각이 있나요? 샌드박스 모드에서 창의력을 발휘하여 꿈의 역을 제한 없이 설계할 수 있습니다.
광범위한 모드 지원
게임은 포괄적인 모드 지원을 제공합니다. 새로운 지도를 만들고 커뮤니티 회원을 초대하여 그들의 실력을 시험해보십시오; 디자인을 공유하여 다른 사람이 더 향상시킬 수 있는지 확인하십시오; 다양한 모드를 가져와 현실 세계의 기차와 시설을 귀하의 지도에 도입하십시오.
도시 교통을 재정의할 준비가 되셨나요? “지하철역 디자이너”에서 자신에게 도전하여 효율적이며 승객 만족도를 향상시키는 혁신적인 솔루션을 만들어 보십시오. 도시 교통의 미래는 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다.

title: Butterfly Dream
description:
게임 정보
Add to wish-list to support us!
Contact Email:
hddy2000@qq.com
The realm of Fargodia, a time long from now.
The ancient ritual of Butterfly Summoning has awakened the once-dormant providence.
King Verlenbair, now fully transformed into a spectral figure, stands poised at the crossroads of fate.
Behind him a silent battle brews, with an archenemy arriving from the depths of dreams.
The laments and hopes of past worlds signal both redemption and judgment, with each butterfly flutter heralding either a new dawn or the shadow of apocalypses.
Will this be the start of a new saga, or the revelation of something deeper?
As destinies intertwine, the story shall be unfolded.
Based on traditional box-garden level exploration and combat experience, Butterfly Dream integrates Chinese philosophy and aesthetic thinking. It is a small-scale souls-like game of retro style.
[Retro-style box level]
"All phases are illusory"
Go into strange dreams, explore dark medieval castles, and immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of Gothic.
Step into a dangerous world and crack the intricate map of the courtyards.
Find a variety of weapons and props to overcome the powerful monsters that hinder you.
[classic fragmented narrative]
"There was once a man who dreamed that he had become a butterfly"
Take the dialogue of characters and the collection of props as clues to piece together the truth of dreams in confusion.
Experience the amplification and distortion of desire, and feel the struggle of people to become monsters.
[High-degree-of-freedom combat]
"Wash us with your precious blood and forgive us all our sins"

title: Penelope Pendrick and the Art of Deceit
description:
게임 정보


A phone call from a small, out of state police force was the last thing writer Penelope Pendrick was expecting that morning. But, it wasn't long after that she was boarding a flight to the quaint old town of Carlisle, Connecticut. When debriefed, Penelope learns her job is to join the search for three missing people; an older man who owns a local bookstore, a mysterious woman who keeps to herself, and a troublemaking teenage boy – the only common link between them being that they disappeared from the same town, within the same week. The Sergeant is stumped.

Once she begins to unravel the case, Penelope realizes that there’s something deeper – stranger – going on here. Unusual ties form between four deceptive suspects, each with something to gain and each with something to lose. Motives and suspicions weave in and out as Penelope uses her wits and penchant for rule-breaking to search for answers; some of which died with an eccentric and mysterious local artist fifty years ago. As the danger escalates, a timer begins to tick down on the lives of the missing. All that Penelope knows for sure is that there’s more to the town of Carlisle than it would appear, and that one wrong move could make this first case her last.

Game Features

Explore the town of Carlisle
Interrogate four unique suspects
Steer the conversation with non-linear dialogue
Your choices matter - speak wisely!
Solve unique puzzles inspired by a famous artist
Don't get caught when you snoop!
autokwd: Penelope Pendrick and the Art of Deceit

title: Anti-Sane
description:
게임 정보
What is this forgotten world?
You are lost in a strange and unsettling universe. Try to stay sane as you navigate eerie creatures and mysterious places.
Solve puzzles using your ability to possess objects
Uncover the secrets of the protagonist’s past as the story unfolds
Enjoy adorable pixel art with a dark twist
Don't be afraid of being alone. Be afraid of what’s lurking around you.

title: England in London
description:

Help the ungrateful, feel the indifference and play minigames.
Take control of Mark England, a celebrity with a few screws loose, and go on a search for his missing firewire cables. Guide him through London, Ontario as you meet the residents, collect items and take on challenges.

Side-Scrolling 2d with unique visuals
Featuring weird looking art, hand drawn animation and an ambient score for when you truly want to be left alone.

Carefully handmade

title: Rhythm Storm
description:
게임 정보
게임 개요
Rhythm Storm은 리듬감 넘치는 요소로 가득한 로그라이크 호드 서바이벌 슈터(또는 불렛 헤븐) 게임입니다 플레이어는 움직임 제어 및 두 가지의 특별 기능을 사용하여 비행물체를 자동으로 조준하고 사격합니다 비행물체를 선택하고, 최초 구성과 기능을 설정한 후 게임을 시작하면 됩니다 게임을 진행하면 적들이 업그레이드 파워업 아이템을 떨어뜨리며, 이 아이템을 획득할 시 두 가지 방식으로 비행물체의 능력이 강화됩니다 플레이어를 제외한 게임 세계의 모든 요소는 리듬에 맞춰 움직이며, 곡이 끝날 때까지 살아남아야 합니다



텍스처 없는 벡터 그래픽
Rhythm Storm은 무텍스처 라인과 폴리곤만을 렌더링합니다 비주얼 효과 구현에는 텍스처 없이 후처리 효과만 사용되었으며, 이는 화면 캡처만 텍스처로 사용됨을 의미합니다 이를 통해 한눈에 봐도 그래픽이 선명하고 경계가 자연스러우며다른 게임과 비교할 수 없는 높은 해상도를 자랑합니다 더 나은 게임 경험을 위해 새로 고침 속도가 120hz 이상인 1440p 이상의 모니터로 플레이할 것––을 강력 권장합니다. [1080p/60hz로 게임을 플레이하는 것도 좋지만 이상적인 수준에는 미치지 못하죠

리듬감 있는 플레이
Rhythm Storm은 음악을 조합한 게임이지만 기존의 리듬 게임과는 다릅니다 비행물체의 움직임을 제외한 게임 내 다른 모든 요소가 배경 음악의 리듬과 정확히 일치합니다 보통 배경 음악의 8마디마다 파동이 바뀌고, 파워업과 게임 세계는 그러한 파동에 맞추어 움직이며 동적인 선, 원, 스테퍼 장애물을 생성합니다. UI는 박자에 맞추어 움직이며, 무엇보다도 모든 적 또한 박자에 맞추어 움직이며 장애물을 발사합니다 격파 역시 박자에 맞추어 이루어집니다 박자에 따라 파워와 기능을 활성화할 수 있기 때문에 플레이어는 성취감을 느끼게 됩니다. 하지만 이기기 위해 기능을 꼭 활성화할 필요는 없으며, 또한 반드시 음악적 재능이 있어야 하거나, 박자와 싱크를 맞추어야 하는 것은 아닙니다

불렛 헤븐/몰려드는 적으로부터 살아남기
구조적으로 본다면 Rhythm Storm은 다른 불렛 헤븐이나 쇄도하는 적/호드로부터 생존해야 하는 다른 게임과 비슷하게 느껴질 수 있습니다 게임의 장르 이름을 꼭 규정할 필요는 없지만 Rhythm Storm의 경우 불렛 헤븐이라는 장르가 가장 적절하다고 생각합니다 Rhythm Storm은 비교적 최근에 도입된 이 장르의 일부 규칙을 따르기는 하지만, 게임에 더 적절한 기능과 행동을 구현하기 위해 그 일부를 변형하기도 합니다 예를 들어, 적을 파괴할 시 XP가 자동으로 획득되지만, 대신 드론을 생성하거나 파워를 사용하는 데 에너지가 소모되어 에너지 수치가 감소합니다 업그레이드는 자동이 아니기 때문에 업그레이드 파워업을 획득해야 합니다 이에 따라 음악이 끊기더라도 당황스럽지 않고 만족스러운 느낌을 줍니다

게임플레이 트레일러 마지막에 잠깐 나온 것처럼 음악 중단의 가장 중요한 역할은 녹화 및 앙코르 업데이트를 하는 것입니다 데모를 끝냈거나 비행물체가 파괴되었거나에 상관없이 게임이 종료되고 나면, 해당 판에서 선택하여 업그레이드한 목록 전체가 저장되어 다음 판에서도 자동으로 사용할 수 있게 됩니다 앙코르 시 업그레이드 화면이 보이지는 않지만, 자동으로 업그레이드가 진행됩니다. 어떤 업그레이드가 추가되었는지는 추후 확인할 수 있습니다 이후 나타날 앙코르 업그레이드는 또한 일시 중지 메뉴에 표시되기도 합니다 해당 메뉴에서 언제든 다시 앙코르를 종료할 수도 있습니다 이후 (또는 앙코르 선택 항목을 모두 사용한 경우) 수동 업그레이드로 전환됩니다 게임을 즐기기 위해 꼭 이 기능을 사용해야 하는 것은 아니지만 앙코르 업그레이드를 사용하면 게임의 성능을 어느 정도 강화할 수 있습니다


Rhythm Storm의 알파 데모는 게이머들의 관심을 끌고 확인하기 위한 게임의 사전(그러나 업그레이드된) 빌드 버전입니다 데모 버전에도 다양한 콘텐츠가 포함되어 있으나, 정식 버전에는 훨씬 더 많은 요소가 추가됩니다 데모 버전에는 한 종류의 세계에 네 종류의 비행물체가 등장하지만, 정식 게임에서는 세 종류 이상의 세계(비행물체 유지/진행 중 업그레이드를 위해 순서대로 플레이)와 열 가지 이상의 비행물체를 선택할 수 있습니다 정식 릴리즈에서는 기능, 파워, 무기, 적 유형, 업그레이드 등의 요소가 데모와는 비교할 수 없을 정도로 다양해집니다 또한 각 세계 최종판에서는 특별 보스도 만날 수 있습니다. 정식 게임에서는 파워/난이도의 균형도 조금 달라집니다

title: Trials of Cascadia
description:
게임 정보


As the son of a farmer, Isaac had always dreamt of one day becoming a Paladin like the Chosen Hero, Zvarus. A man whose bravery was legendary and who stood down in the face of no foe. After a year of training with Orman's father Orlan, a retired Paladin general, Isaac sets off with his sword and holy book alongside his friend to vanquish the forces of Darkness that beset the world.

But not all is as it seems on the surface. Those who presume to speak in the name of justice may abuse their power, while those who commit heinous acts may do so out of perceived necessity. Sometimes, even certain facets of history are conveniently omitted. But the truth is out there waiting to be found, as the friends soon find out. Will they do the right thing, or play it safe? Only time will tell.





-A story-focused RPG. Explore Cascadia in an unfolding narrative to discover the world's true story, that spans multiple continents, and possibly multiple dimensions

-Custom artwork to bring the game alive with a vivid watercolor aesthetic

-Custom sound and meditative, emotional music reminiscent of 90's JRPGs

-A plethora of items and equipment to discover

-Special Artifacts that can empower your entire party

-Optional side quests strewn throughout the world map that may increase your reputation

-Playable with controller, keyboard or mouse





-A charming cast of unique characters, each with their own stories, roles, abilities and skill augments. Mix and match for your favorite group

-Build TP with normal attacks, and then spend them on flashy spells and specials. Gain Pwr with damage or healing to boost your morale

-Delay enemy actions and cancel spells altogether with instant cast skills

-Use elemental debuffs from offensive magic spells to stack weaknesses on your enemy

-Unleash devastating 5 TP ultimate attacks

-Over 50 different enemies for you to encounter, including rare enemies (and even some friendly encounters)











A new recruit to the Paladin order, Isaac is eager to prove himself to his superiors and make his parents proud. What he lacks in experience, he makes up for in talent.
Isaac is able to heal the party and cure various debuffs, but he can also dish out massive damage using his Light-based abilities such as Lumina Blade. He has a higher critical chance than others.




Isaac's best friend from a young age. Although somewhat boisterous and headstrong, Orman has the heart of a hero. He doesn't always like to follow the rules.
Orman is able to protect the party by drawing the enemy's attention and blocking physical attacks with his shield. He excels at interrupting spells and has several defensive utilities up his sleeve.




A mysterious and proud elven girl with pink hair, she is able to wield the power of the elements. Although her motives are unclear, she seems to have peaceful intentions.
Aiya can't take as much abuse as the Paladins, but she has the highest damage potential. When using her magic spells, she can also gain enchantments for her dagger, which can be stacked for exponential damage amounts.




An eccentric man who claims to be an oracle, and hundreds of years old. He claims to guide the party towards their destiny, but his past remains obscured.
Mondrus is a hybrid between a healer and a caster. He can cast nature spells which make the enemy more vulnerable or restore the party and apply shields. While his spells are cheaper to cast, they take a short time to recharge.

title: Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog
description:
게임 정보


Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog is a top-down 2D story-driven adventure game inspired by true events in Bangkok, Thailand 2017. The game lets you experience the harsh life of a homeless man who tries to cope with his mental struggle of the cruelty of the world. The story is framed by an interview he gives to a famous blogger, about how a chance encounter with a stray dog made him regain his sense of self once more.



What could make a man homeless? Is it one's family's financial situation? Is it the government? Is it because of our friends? Or... is it because of oneself?

Explore a journey from his childhood to the present. Unravel what made a man lose everything.

title: Respark
description:
게임 정보
The Ultimate Fireworks Roguelite!
Handheld sparklers, poppers, firecrackers, bottle rockets, and even skyrockets! In Respark, engage in thrilling and intense combat, using all kinds of hanabi (fireworks) to outsmart and overcome your enemies!




Each course is automatically and randomly generated. Not only will the terrain and enemies change, but the important items you find will also differ with each playthrough. Your choices shape your adventure!
Set in the whimsical world of Animalia, where animals have formed a civilized society, Respark offers a dazzling experience. The charming visuals combined with AAAA's catchy and wonderful background music create a joyous gaming journey for both newcomers and seasoned players.
To give you a taste of Respark's magic, we've prepared a special demo! Out of the 8 worlds in the full game, you can explore World 1, 4, and 7! While the demo doesn’t include the storyline or the save/load feature, you’ll still get to experience the thrill of reaching the final phase. Can you conquer the boss of World 7?

Note: The demo version supports keyboard and mouse operation only.

title: Adult Game
description: Adult Game

title: Call of the Golden Valley
description:
게임 정보
An unexpected turn of events has landed you, an American woman, in the mysterious Australian High Country searching for your missing friend.
Follow clues, solve puzzles, and delve into conspiracy theories to investigate not only her disappearance, but the strange and inexplicable mystery surrounding many missing hikers drawn to the mountains.
In the sleepy small town of Phillipston, your investigation must uncover clues using both good old-fashioned detective tricks combined with the modern-art of internet stalking. Follow the crumbs and get lost in the theories surrounding this mystery.
We respect your detective skills, so it’s all up to you to make the final logical leaps. Set the poetry in motion by linking your observations on your deduction board to ultimately reveal exactly what has transpired. A series of unrelated misadventures? Or something more sinister…
What would drive someone to venture alone into the harsh landscape of a country known for its deadly wilderness? Delve into the psychology of the characters to understand what they’ve done and why.

title: NecroTactics
description:
게임 정보


Build and battle against an army of the undead as you attempt to kill Death itself. Grow your undead army overtime and develop your graveyard with traps and towers to survive as long as possible.
💀 Create Your Own Synergies!

📜 Features
Develop a Huge Army of 100 Total Units!
Place Structures to Bolster Your Army
Cast Fireballs, Lightning Strikes and Poison Bombs
Fight a Giant Boss and Their Army
Earn Achievements

I want your help to make NecroTactics better so if you want to be a part of the testing and give me feedback you can reach me (Jerome) on Discord. Thank you to everyone who has supported the development of my past games as you have made this game possible!

title: Hyper Drill
description:
게임 정보
Hyper Drill은 초고속으로 날아가는 스피드런 러닝 게임입니다. 장애물을 드릴로 뚫고, 타이밍을 잘 맞추고, 레벨 배치에 대해 알아가고, 서로 다른 은하계를 뛰어넘으세요.

title: Breath of Space
description:
게임 정보
STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/GameplayGif_03.gif[/img]

Breath of Space는 3인칭 슈팅 게임, 로그라이트, 로그라이크 장르의 요소를 결합한 액션으로 가득 찬 비디오 게임입니다. 이 게임은 광활한 Aegea Space Mining Facility를 배경으로 하며, 여기에서 다양한 위협에 맞서 싸우고 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하여 더 진행해야 합니다. 그러나 로봇 동료가 저장 파일을 운반하고 죽으면 모든 진행 상황이 손실됩니다. 따라서 경계를 늦추지 말고 동료를 살려두어 진행 상황을 그대로 유지해야 합니다.
로그라이크 또는 로그라이트
게임 내 플레이 스타일은 로봇 동료인 네페스가 죽었을 때 행동하는 방식에 영향을 미칩니다. 네페스를 위한 세 가지 자세 중에서 선택할 수 있으며, 더 위험한 자세를 선택할수록 네페스가 더 강해집니다. 그러나 플레이 스타일이 공격적일수록 모든 진행 상황을 잃을 확률이 높아집니다. 네페스가 죽으면 죽을 때 진행 상황이 초기화되니 조심하세요!

에게 우주 채굴 시설
모든 방이 독특한 시련과 기회를 선사하는 광활한 우주 채굴 시설로 여행을 떠나세요. 다양한 업그레이드, 리소스 및 수정 사항을 사용하여 게임을 탐색하고 당신을 기다리고 있는 진화하는 도전에 적응하십시오. 시설에 더 깊이 파고들수록 판돈이 증가하여 더 큰 보상과 함께 더 큰 위험을 제공합니다.

브레스 오브 스페이스에서 우주 요원이 되어 위험한 임무를 수행하세요. 연방의 번영을 위한 희망의 등대인 에게해 우주 채굴 시설이 미지의 존재에 의해 침략당합니다. 그러나 시설이 공격받고 핵심 인물인 Uzay의 아버지가 사라지자 시설을 되찾기 위한 위험한 임무에 투입됩니다. 다른 요원들과 마찬가지로 어려운 도전에 직면하고 임무 성공에 실패하게 됩니다.

미지의 지역을 탐험하고, 강력한 적과 싸우고, 연방의 운명을 결정하세요. 시설을 구하고 아버지가 남긴 비밀을 밝혀낼 수 있을까요? 이 스릴 넘치는 모험에서 이야기는 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다.
패배는 시작에 불과한 혁신적인 재탄생 시스템을 경험하세요. 동료 드로이드 네페스의 힘을 활용하여 다시 일어서고 한계를 뛰어넘어 새로운 능력과 전략을 잠금 해제하세요.
패시브, 지원, 공격의 세 가지 모드에서 네페스를 지휘하세요. 네페스의 다재다능한 기술을 활용하여 자신만의 스타일로 도전에 대처하며 즉석에서 적응하세요.
"Qouise" 자원 시스템으로 위험과 보상 사이의 미세한 경계를 탐색하세요. 현재 달리기를 위해 임시 업그레이드에 투자할지 아니면 영구적인 발전을 위해 자원을 축적할지 결정하여 장기 전략을 수립하세요.
다양한 슈트 업그레이드, 무기 강화, 네페스 개조로 우자이의 여정을 커스터마이징하세요. 이러한 요소들을 전략적으로 조합하여 독특한 플레이 스타일을 만들고 앞에 놓인 도전을 극복하세요.
에게 연합 연합에서 영감을 받아 세심하게 제작된 세계에 빠져보세요. 문화, 요리, 건축물이 조화롭게 어우러진 세계를 탐험하며 분열되어 있지만 서로 연결된 우주의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

title: Upfall
description:
게임 정보
Upfall is a game about bouncing, dodging, and dying. Escape the depths by bouncing on bubbles and avoid the hazards which slowly present themselves. Glowing red = danger... at least to start with! Each new depth you reach causes the colours to change and the hazards to increase, with enough random generation so each upfall is never the same. It's not easy, but with fast restarts and quick rounds you'll find yourself coming back over and over.
Can you find your way back to the surface?
Totally, utterly free – The world isn't great right now for a lot of people so we wanted to give back. Upfall is completely free - no ads, no monetisation, no catch
Quick rounds – Each fall takes between 2 and 10 minutes so you can play between other games or on your lunch break
Unlocks and customisation – Unlock new colour palettes, audio styles, ambiences, and characters to customise how the game looks and sounds
Keyboard or controller – Play keyboard only, feel the controller vibrate, or watch the DualShock 4/DualSense controller light change colour to reflect the game state
Chill but eerie – Simple rules with a creepy, no-jump scares, atmosphere to keep you engaged and coming back
A game by Amicable Animal with art from eggysworld and piano samples from Luci Holland.
(Just so you know: this game is provided as is, and we can't offer support as it's free. It is built in Unity so if you can play Unity games it should run fine!)

title: V's Rage
description:
게임 정보
“Rise from your bed…”
Those are the words V, an overworked wife and mother, hears as she wakes up in her worst nightmare: she has been cursed and trapped in a videogame by a mysterious entity. Now she must beat any foe unlucky enough to cross her path, and free herself from a crazy low-poly world inhabited by odd creatures. She got a pan, she got rage, and she will beat them all.

title: Farmistic
description:
게임 정보
Farmistic is a top-down farming simulation game in early development by an independent developer.
Manage your farm
In Farmistic you'll be in charge of managing your farm. The fields need to be plowed, cultivated, drilled and harvested. The grain and corn has to be stored or sold, and the cycle repeats. Start small and get your hands dirty driving the tractors yourself. With your first profits, you can buy more and bigger machinery, and start automating the tasks.

Maybe you want to keep your farm small and comfy for a relaxing experience?
Or will you buy up all the land, let others do the work, and become the ultimate agricultural tycoon?
Farming
Fields need plowing, cultivating, drilling, fertilization, harvesting... a never ending duty! The dealership provides a range of small, medium and large tractors and different sizes of machinery for different fields. You'll need:
Tractors
Plows
Cultivators
Seed drills
Combine harvesters
Trailers
Mowers
Rakes
Balers
Animals
Your animals are going to be hungry! Cows will need hay and straw, chickens require grain. Don't forget the water and logistics to get it to your animals! If they are well taken care of, they reward you with milk and eggs, which can be sold for a nice profit.
Immersive mode
Get your hands dirty and drive/operate the machinery yourself in immersive mode. No need for others to do the work if you want the fun all for yourself!

title: Dicey Birdball
description:
게임 정보
Dicey Birdball is a roguelike strategy sports game where you manage a team of birds playing football. Roll dice and assign them to your birds to maneuver, score goals, and win the championship. Enact leaguewide rule changes to evolve the sport of Birdball, from increasing the size of the field to summoning iceberg obstacles to touchdown teleportation.

Each run you'll take control of a different team with their own unique story and objective. Win enough matches to make it to the championship and fulfill the team's objective. Between matches you'll make decisions to improve the team such as gaining new abilities, drafting new dice, and enacting new rules.

Feature List:
Compete in turn-based, grid-based football matches using a team of up to 3 birds from 5 different classes.
Manage a team of different bird classes, each with their own unique set of abilities.
Spend seeds on new dice to increase the number of moves you can make each turn.
Guide the evolution of the sport by choosing which rules change over time, such as expanding the field and allowing alternate scoring mechanism.
Unlock new teams with different bird combinations to play with.
Unlock the ability to create your own team with custom colors and team composition.

title: Blood Accord
description:
게임 정보
야나는 두 명의 가장 친한 친구와 함께 공중 화장실에 갇힌 채 깨어납니다. 한 명은 불 같은 성격에 날카로운 말솜씨를 가진 용감한 영혼, 비카입니다. 다른 한 명은 부드럽고 따뜻한 마음을 가진 조화로운 영혼, 랼랴입니다.
처음에는 야나는 안도감을 느낍니다. 혼자가 아니니까요. 그녀가 세상 누구보다 사랑하는 소녀들과 함께 있다는 사실에 마치 하늘이 내려준 축복처럼 느껴집니다.
하지만 시간이 지날수록 좁은 공간은 더 이상 안식처처럼 느껴지지 않고 감옥처럼 느껴집니다.
말 못할 긴장감이 감돌고, 오래전 묻어두었던 비밀들이 수면 위로 떠오르기 시작합니다.
녹슨 수도꼭지에서 떨어지는 핏방울 하나하나가 과거는 잊혀져서는 안 된다는 것을 상기시켜 줍니다.

title: Total World Liberation
description:
게임 정보
They have taken over everything, it's up to you to LIBERATE the entire world!



* Find other Survivors and bring them with you.
* Build your base with a Workshop, Generator, Houses and plenty of Defenses and Traps!


* Split up into multiple teams and explore different areas, don't forget to bring enough ammo when you leave your base!
* Set up outposts to gather resources in far away lands and Transport them back to your base through Automated machines, ensure the Zombies don't destroy your logistics!


* Craft items, armor, weapons and lots of ammo, build Drones to help you Gather, Craft and Patrol


* Explore a large , with no loading or mission instances, everything happens in the world.
* Turn-Based so you can take your time to think and come up with the


* Zombies and take them all out without suffering casualties
* Be careful when exploring at , and be even more careful so you don't attract a

Start just with Survivor and

title: JUNK!
description:
게임 정보
A Game About Robots!
Do you have what it takes to be a Scrapper, or are you just another piece of JUNK?
Battle with your friends, random opponents, or an AI trainer to unlock new robots, abilities, and customizations. JUNK! is a fast paced, arena 1v1 PVP brawler.
EARLY ACCESS
JUNK! is being built by a very small team of designers and developers with a roadmap that will extend over the next few years. The current plan is to provide monthly balance updates, quarterly content updates (Robots, Arenas, Abilities, Cosmetics), and patches/bug fixes as necessary.
CHOOSE YOUR ROBOT
Each robot has unique aspects like speed, armor, and attack power.

title: Driving Life
description:
게임 정보
Driving Life
Welcome to Driving Life, a hardcore driving and survival experience set in the heart of rural America. Stranded on a remote island with barely any money, you’ll have to scrape by, taking on driving jobs, managing expenses, and surviving on whatever cheap food and drinks you can afford.
With a realistic driving model, manual transmissions, and a variety of vehicles to operate, Driving Life is a true test of skill and endurance. From small personal cars to minivans and even heavy-duty trucks, every vehicle demands mastery as you navigate the island’s winding roads, dirt trails, and ferry routes.
Features:
🚗 Realistic Driving Mechanics – Manual transmission, clutch control, and varied vehicle handling.
🚐 Diverse Vehicles – Drive everything from compact cars to massive trucks.
💰 Hardcore Economy – Earn just enough to survive… if you play it smart.
🏨 Island Life – Stay in a rundown motel, pay rent weekly, and work odd jobs.
🛠 Resource Management – Keep your car fueled, your stomach full, and your debts paid.
🚢 Ferry Routes – Transport tourists and goods between terminals to earn cash.
🥫 Survival on a Budget – Eat cheap meals, drink what you can afford, and don’t blow your last dollar on a flashy car.
Your adventure begins in a modest motel, where the owner might call you for work—driving a van to pick up tourists from the ferry. You’ll start with a clunky manual car, but if you manage your money wisely, you might just afford an upgrade. Be warned: every decision matters. Miss a rent payment? Run out of gas? Go broke? You’re in trouble.
Think you have what it takes to survive behind the wheel?

title: Sacred Constellars: Ruin Raiders
description:
게임 정보
Ruin Raiders, a daring few who risk everything to explore ancient second-era tombs. With the promise of great rewards, they unearth relics of immense power, remnants of a bygone era. The Church of Eion strives to secure these artifacts, sealing them away in heavily guarded vaults. Yet, some relics slip through, disrupting the status quo. This is one such story....
Charming 2D Pixel Art Style.
Master tactics to overcome many battles.
Unique boss fights that are more than just HP sponges or enemies that simply hit harder.
Interact with a fleshed out and unique world that melds fantasy and elements of science fiction.
Create bonds with your fellow party members. Up to twelve interesting characters.
20+ hour story rich role playing campaign.

title: Portal Foxes TD
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Defend portals from hordes of slimes with elemental foxes from a tabletop VR perspective. Recruit a colorful set of characters to help in your quest to reconnect a fragmented world over a 25 level single-player story adventure.
No fixed paths.
Slimes can climb anything, but they (usually) don't like to. You must know your enemy to build your defenses effectively.
No Upgrades. No Numbers.

title: Obliterator-X
description:
게임 정보
Survive in this bloody top-down shooter/tower defense hybrid. Scavenge resources, set traps, and defend against relentless mutant hordes. Upgrade your skills and expand your base into a bustling town, unlock powerful turrets and deploy drones to hold the line. Each step into the Outback is a new challenge!

title: Night Plane
description:
게임 정보
Night Plane is a thrilling airborne hospitality simulator that costs way less than a plane ticket! Board passengers, assist with their trivial struggles, and resolve emergency situations all by yourself in this hyper-realistic representation of a commercial flight in 1999 New Zealand. Enjoy the world-class airport, babies crying at 30,000 feet, and very reliable aircraft systems. Also, please don't let the psychopomp fly the aircraft.
Board passengers, keep them comfortable, and strive to provide a survivable flight for all paying customers.
Decide who boards the plane! Customer satisfaction is what it's all about, but some passengers just aren't worth the hassle. If someone looks like a troublemaker, feel free to reject them at boarding and luxuriate in their absence during the flight.
Countless (99+) interactable objects, both in the airport and on the plane!
Hyper-realist representation of 1999 New Zealand.
Unravel the occult mysteries of the airplane bathroom...
And pet the cat!

title: Lurking Danger
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview:
Step into the unsettling world of Lurking Danger, a survival horror game that will push you to the edge of sanity. You play as Elena, a young waitress at a seemingly ordinary diner. But when Emily, a regular customer, mysteriously disappears, her routine life takes a terrifying turn.
Determined to find out what happened, Elena, alongside her coworker Regina, soon finds herself trapped in a nightmare where reality distorts, familiar places become twisted, and something unspeakable lurks in the shadows. As they search for answers, they are forced to confront horrifying creatures and unsettling visions, all while uncovering a sinister truth that should have remained buried.
With limited resources and no safe place to hide, survival is the only option. Will you unravel the mystery behind “Lurking Danger” and escape the horrors that now hunt you?
Key Features:
Immersive, Psychological Storytelling: Dive into a narrative that blends mystery and psychological horror. Every interaction and decision can reveal clues or escalate the tension.
Split-Screen Co-op: Play through the story solo or team up with a friend in local co-op mode. Work together to solve puzzles and survive the lurking dangers.
Interactive Environment: Use your surroundings to solve puzzles and uncover dark secrets in this eerie and disturbing world. The smallest, most unsettling details may hold the key to your escape.
Enviromental Puzzles: Navigate strange corridors and twisted rooms, solving puzzles in a world where the walls seem alive, and grotesque creatures emerge from the shadows.
Intense Survival Horror: Face your worst fears as you run from unknown horrors. Manage your resources wisely and stay calm in high-pressure situations to stay alive.
Meaningful Choices: How you interact with secondary characters and face the dangers around you will shape your experience. Every conversation and action can influence the story's progression.
Note: Co-op mode can only be played with joysticks, not mouse and keyboard, so you'll need two controllers to play properly.

title: NO EXIT
description:
게임 정보
No Exit is small chapter based indie horror game. You'll have to face challenging enemies, and perhaps make some allies, to escape this crooked dimension that you're trapped in. 
Jump from place to place. Escape or fight. Even though some of them thought your fate is sealed, you can prove them wrong... 

Find the Exit.
Designed for casual horror fans, it offers a spooky atmosphere with plenty of casual scares. Players can expect intense boss encounters with dynamic visuals and cool music, along with a story that unfolds gradually. With each chapter, the game will challenge you with grander events and much more difficult challenges. Can you survive long enough, to learn the truth?
You and your friend have always been the best urban explorers in town, seeking out abandoned places and uncovering their secrets. Your latest target was an old, forsaken warehouse rumored to be haunted. However, while you were away on vacation, your friend’s curiosity got the better of him. Unable to wait, he ventured in alone, and now he’s missing. Determined to find him, you enter the decaying warehouse, only to realize that it’s not just an empty building. Now, you find yourself in a twisted pocket dimension, with strange creatures constantly trying to find and kill you. Can you escape?

title: Psychic Kung Fu Master
description:
게임 정보
 Official QQ Group：2153025067
C-RPG gameplay, turn-based combat, collect martial arts to become the leader of the martial world, recruit disciples, cultivate martial skills, and compete for supremacy in the world.
"At the start, you receive the script of Xuzhu and gain a century's worth of inner power."
"Meet Elder Tong and take over the Lingjiu Palace."
autokwd: Psychic Kung Fu Master,今古群侠传

title: Experimental gnawer No.44: Observation Record
description:
게임 정보
It was a lab mouse, created from birth to be used in experiments, a product of combining human genes with its own. Due to a moment of negligence by the researchers, it escaped from the fate designed for it and fled to safety.
With a mouse’s instinct to hide and survive in human dwellings, it found refuge in the attic of a certain house after escaping.
Due to work requirements, you’ve been assigned by your superiors to live in a remote house, where you continue your monotonous life. However, each night at midnight, you start to hear strange noises coming from the attic… What kind of beginning awaits you?
❗This is a feeding simulation game designed for female players with slight horror, bloody violence, and a touch of the bizarre. Suitable for ages 17+ in the visual novel genre.❗
The game revolves around raising a half-human, half-mouse creature. You can feed it different foods, teach it various skills, and make different choices that lead the little lab mouse to evolve in various forms—and to different endings between you two.
❗ Warning ❗
The game contains graphic depictions, including dissection, internal organs, abuse, and killing, as well as flashing imagery that may be unsettling and/or trigger seizures in players with photosensitive epilepsy.
This game may not be suitable for all audiences.

title: CloverPit
description:
게임 정보
You wake up in a rusty, narrow cell, standing over a dangerously unstable grate.
Someone has kidnapped you, demanding payment, and your only way out is to play the Slot Machine and pay off your debt.
Don’t let yourself fall —literally— into ruin!

title: Neon Hearts City
description:
게임 정보
A private investigator, tracking a missing person, uncovers a conspiracy between humans and androids and a secret that could change everything. Neon Hearts City is a retro point-and-click adventure that thrusts you into a grungy cyberpunk city of the future.
While searching for Audrey, a missing young girl, Elijah Crow's investigation takes a violent turn when one of his leads is silenced.
Somewhere along the shore, androids longing to become human are offered as sacrifices.
Far out at sea, a mysterious tower harbors secrets that could unravel the fabric of civilization.
Suspended in the sky, Roark Prison looms—a colossal airship where thought criminals face imprisonment.
Somehow, these threads are inextricably intertwined.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon
description:
게임 정보
The prophesied end of the Zemurian continent draws near, and so does the launch of humanity's first foray into space. A sudden invitation from Marduk to cooperate in a high-tech training exercise sets Van Arkride, Ashen Chevalier Rean Schwarzer, and Father Kevin Graham on a collision course with the secrets that lay at the very core of Zemuria.
Their paths may diverge, but the ultimate question remains the same: Just what lies beyond the edge of the horizon?
Gameplay Mechanics
Explore detailed locations across the Calvard Republic, strengthen your connections with your allies, and uncover what lies beyond the horizon of Zemuria across three intertwining story paths. Plus, Trails beyond the Horizon introduces new gameplay mechanics to the beloved battle system introduced in Trails through Daybreak, giving you an unprecedented amount of options in both Field and Command Battles. Battle it out in the action-packed Field Battle mode, then swap to the turn-based Command Battle mode to strategically plan out your attacks!
autokwd: The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon

title: Crimson Desert
description:
게임 정보
오픈월드 액션 어드벤처
전례 없는 힘을 둘러싼 전쟁에 휘말린 파이웰 대륙
거친 눈보라가 몰아치는 백색의 산간 지역 크웨이덴부터 끝없는 녹음이 펼쳐진 대지 아카펜, 그리고 사방이 바위산으로 둘러싸인 붉은 사막까지 거대한 자연이 살아 숨 쉬는 파이웰 대륙에 전례 없는 힘을 둘러싼 어두운 전쟁의 그림자가 드리워지고 있습니다.
경이와 신비로 가득 찬 이 방대한 오픈 월드 속에서 베일에 싸인 미지의 세계를 탐험하며, 당신을 막아서는 적들과 치열한 전투를 펼쳐보세요. 
클리프와 회색갈기단
"이것이 우리의 사명이다."
파이웰 대륙을 구하기 위해 분투하는 회색갈기단은 사명을 이루겠다는 집념 하나로 험난한 여정을 이어 나갑니다.
사명으로 향하는 길. 그 위험한 여정에서 목숨을 내주어도 아깝지 않을 동료를 만나기도 하고, 사사건건 방해하는 수많은 적과 마주치기도 합니다.
역경으로 가득 찬 절망 속에 숨겨진 대재앙의 실체를 밝혀내고, 파이웰의 평화를 되찾으세요.

title: Catfall
description:
게임 정보
A lonely astronaut cat survives a spaceship crash and now embarks on a journey.
Customize your cat's appearance and set off on this short third-person adventure to find the crew: your feline friends and your dearest human.
In this alien world, you'll explore a mysterious extraterrestrial city and attempt to unravel its secrets.
The cat will face puzzles, meet new friends, and encounter dangerous foes. Each step will bring him closer to the truth and unveil new horizons of this cosmic journey.

title: Animas
description:
게임 정보
베네수엘라 산악 지대의 기묘한 저택을 탐험하라. 모든 방마다 수십 년의 비극이 메아리친다. 당신은 블랑코 가문의 어두운 역사 뒤에 숨진 진실을 찾아 왔지만… 이 저택은 다른 계획을 품고 있다. 여기서 과거와 현재가 충돌하며, 사이비 의식과 세대를 저주한 선택이 드러난다.
과거를 파헤쳐라
시간의 메아리: 시간으로 갈라진 저택을 탐험하라. 1970년대의 평화로움에서 쇠퇴한 현재까지, 각 단계가 과거의 공포를 드러낸다.
독특한 공포, 현지의 영혼: 『Animas: 원령』 은 베네수엘라 민속과 심리적 공포를 엮는다. 고대 신앙부터 현대 도시전설까지, 비디오게임에서 보기 드문 공포의 면모를 경험하라.
압도적인 분위기: 생생한 3D 오디오와 불안한 분위기로 현실과 악몽의 경계가 무너진다. 이건 당신의 생각인가… 아니면 저택인가?
진정한 목소리, 글로벌 접근
전문 라틴 아메리카 스페인어 더빙으로 『Animas: 원령』 의 독특한 문화적 배경에 완전히 몰입하세요. 이 악몽의 세부 사항을 놓치지 않도록, 모든 대화와 텍스트는 한국어 자막이 제공되며, 영어, 포르투갈어, 중국어, 일본어, 러시아어로도 지원됩니다.

title: 咏唱魔女 witch's Aria
description:
게임 정보
"Witch's Area" is an RPG game with a core gameplay mechanic centered around combining cards to create spells, featuring light strategic roguelike elements.
Combine different cards to craft your unique spells and uncover the truth behind the little witch's cyclical dreams!

title: Beak Island Visitor Center
description:
게임 정보
작은 섬 비크 아일랜드가 50년의 침묵을 깨고 방문객을 맞이합니다! 그런데 이 섬엔 준비된 것이 하나도 없군요. 당신이 필요해요. 섬의 관광안내소를 맡아줘요. 해야 할 일은 방문객을 위한 식사를 준비하고, 섬의 관광 자원을 개발하는 거예요. 간단하죠? 지원은.. 없어요. 섬의 주민들에게 도움을 요청해봐요. 그럼, 잘 부탁해요!
Features
섬을 자유롭게 탐험하세요. 공원 사무소는 당신에게 100% 자율권을 부여했습니다. 정말이에요.
주민들과 이야기를 나눠봐요. 그들의 사연에 귀 기울이면, 분명 서로에게 도움이 될 거예요.
섬에 있는 다양한 재료를 연구해서 새로운 레시피를 찾아봐요. 피자에 파인애플을 올리겠다고요? 음.. 그거 합법인가요?
오래된 시설물을 수리해서 섬을 꾸며봐요. 저는 전망대에 망원경이 있는 걸 좋아해요.
방문객에게 음식을 판매하면 수익은 전부 당신 거예요. 뭘 사고 싶나요? 멋진 보트?
섬을 찾는 방문객을 만족시키면 더 많은 방문객이 섬을 찾아올 거예요. 이 섬에 눌러앉겠다는 친구들도 생기겠지요.

title: Ithya: Magic Studies
description:
게임 정보
Immerse Yourself in a Fantasy World
Unlock beautifully crafted scenes, from serene forests to mystical ancient cities, each providing a calming background for study and creative pursuits. Discover a world created by artist ‘Blue Turtle’ featuring unique, hand-drawn illustrations.
Set the Perfect Ambience
Set the tone for each session by adjusting the environment to match your mood. Choose between day, night, or rainy settings, and enjoy ambient sounds alongside relaxing fantasy and lofi playlists. 
Personalize Your Room
Make the space your own with customization options. Decorate your room and collect Elementals to add personality to your virtual study space.

title: Mushroom Island
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Mushroom Island, a place to relax and unwind.

title: Cat and Isle of Stars
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Isle of Stars, a tranquil paradise where cats roam freely and island life feels untouched by time. In "Cat and Isle of Stars," you’ll manage a unique cat café, build bonds with local residents, and discover the joy of daily life, from farming and fishing to crafting cozy spaces for your cats.
As you settle into this charming world, you may sense the presence of something more—a legend that whispers through the island. By night, the cats may lead you into parts of the island’s history long forgotten, and cryptic hints from residents suggest the island hides a greater purpose. Is your arrival a twist of fate, or does this land hold something special for you?
Game Features:
Cat Café Haven: Decorate and nurture your café to create a warm haven for island cats and visitors alike.
Island Legends: Follow the cats’ quiet guidance as you explore the island’s hidden lore under moonlit skies.
Resident Connections: Each resident has a unique story tied to the island’s past; helping them reveals more about the world and its secrets.
Serene Island Life: Tend crops, craft, and fish along the shores to build your own vibrant corner on the island.
Protect the Isle: As whispers of outsiders’ plans circulate, the cats’ behaviors grow strange, hinting that they may be leading you to an ancient strength, perhaps the island’s last hope for peace.

title: Dino Topia
description:
게임 정보
"Dino Topia" is a sandbox roguelike game set in a prehistoric world.
Tame and collect a variety of dinosaur companions to help you build, farm, and work together in creating your ultimate home. Take on thrilling battles and face monsters of increasing difficulty with your loyal dinosaur allies by your side.
Sandbox Construction
Gather resources, unlock new technologies, and freely design and expand your home base into a thriving settlement.
Farming and Production
Work hand-in-hand with your dinosaur companions to plant, water, fertilize, and harvest crops. Together, build a fully functional and flourishing farm.

title: OFF
description:
게임 정보
Allow me to confess that I find you quite tangible for a phantasmagorical being.
I must say, this is really quite strange. You are the first living being I have ever met in this place. Nevertheless, I will introduce myself. I am the Judge.
The Batter has a sacred mission to fulfill.
He seeks to purify the world. You, then, the controller, the soul that he harbors, must aid him in this laudable task. Alongside my sportive companion you will find it necessary to solve puzzles, rain blows upon certain hostile individuals of our wild zones, and oversee the headways and logistics of a network of swan boats and interurban locomotives.
I, too, travel widely among the zones of this world.
Open your wings and fly toward the zones ahead without hesitation! All of them are filled with strange and enchanting beings as well as every modern convenience. All of them appear, it must be said, to require the beneficient application of our friend the Batter’s muscular wrist. Do not worry, my dear phantasm—I, the Judge, will be with you (in spirit and body) at all the most crucial moments of your quest.

title: Bank Simulator
description:
게임 정보
🏦 Bank Simulator Start with a small bank 🏦 featuring Tellers, Marketing, and Investments, and expand with ATMs and more. Build your team 👥, upgrade facilities for happier customers 😊, invest smartly 📈, balance risks ⚖️, and grow wealth 💰. Reinvest profits to upgrade, expand, and create your financial empire 💼✨!

💰Handle essential banking services and ensure customer satisfaction as your branch grows.


🎨Customize your bank's layout with stylish furniture and eye-catching decor to impress customers.


⚙️Oversee crucial operations, including ATM maintenance, marketing strategies, and investment activities.

title: Cozy
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Cozy Town, a delightful slice-of-life farming adventure where you can create your dream homestead, form meaningful connections, and enjoy the peaceful rhythms of small-town living. Whether you're an experienced farmer or a newcomer to the countryside, there's always something exciting waiting for you in this enchanting world.
Step into a quaint, picturesque village surrounded by lush forests, sparkling rivers, and fields of opportunity. Cozy Town is alive with vibrant characters, seasonal festivals, and endless possibilities for relaxation and discovery. Whether you're growing crops, fishing by the lake, or helping your neighbors, every moment is a chance to find joy in the little things.

title: Fischer's Fishing Journey
description:
게임 정보
Fischer's Fishing Journey takes you to a planet where humanity has long since vanished. Join Fischer, the adventurous little cat, as you travel to stunning locations across the planet and enjoy tranquil fishing moments! Sell your catches or display them in your fish tank to earn Fish Coins, which can be used to buy bait, upgrade fishing rods, expand your tank, and unlock new locations and fascinating fish species! Along the journey, chat with friends, fulfill their wishes, and uncover the history of this unique world.
Dynamic Landscapes: Explore multiple scenic locations with dynamic weather and time-of-day changes, immersing you in varied and serene environments.
Idle Fishing Fun: Let Fischer handle the fishing for you! Just check in occasionally to adjust bait and collect your catches—perfect for a relaxing gameplay experience.

title: Shard Squad
description:
게임 정보
Join the cutest and most fearsome squad ever!
In Shard Squad, help a team of elemental creatures save their lands in a thrilling and chaotic adventure filled with monsters and projectiles leaping off your screen!
But don’t worry—great challenges come with great allies! The squad is ready to assist you, providing valuable items or even cooking up nutrients to power you up to defeat the toughest bosses.
Speaking of bosses, brace yourself for a wave of unique creatures constantly testing your skills. And if you manage to overcome them, an even greater calamity awaits at the end of each stage!

title: Scenes from the Heart - Part 1
description:
게임 정보
Scenes from the Heart is a Visual Novel about a mature but lonely boy (you) who struggles to connect with others due to his superiority complex. His life changes when he befriends Chisaki Namichi, who faces bullying for her unique eye color at elementary school. Together, they later discover Konaka Motomi, a new transferred classmate with her own quirks.
As they bond, Konaka introduces improvisation theater to Chisaki and you. Inspired, Chisaki initiates her long dream of a visual novel development project, involving the player and Konaka. Despite initial conflicts during the process, they succeed and win an award for their demo, as a menacing shadow is watching over them, hinting at challenges ahead...
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The story will be split into two parts:
Part 1 is more like a prologue to introduce the starting point and the main cast.
Part 2 will be diving deeper into everyday life and branching the story at a certain point.
[ Scenes from the Heart is also my first game and Visual Novel ever, so naturally there will be some flaws included most likely, but those I aim to fix on Part 2, which I planned to be developed later if (and when) its Kickstarter-campaign succeeds. ]
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

title: Nexus FPV
description:
게임 정보
In Nexus, you are a force of nature. Weave through gunfire, master aerial combat, and rain destruction from above in this high-stakes FPV drone roguelike shooter. Pilot advanced combat drones through intense missions where split-second decisions matter. Death sends you back to base - but your tech, skills, and power grow with every run.
Master the Skies
High-speed combat that rewards skill and daring. Start as a rookie, become an ace. Dive through obstacles, chain perfect attack runs, and strike from impossible angles. Go loud with guns blazing or strike with surgical precision. The skies are yours to dominate.

title: Lover Interface
description:
게임 정보
A 29-year-old ordinary guy, Ethan Syu works as an on-site computer engineer by day and runs a struggling personal video channel by night. On his way to a filming location, he gets into an accident. When he wakes up the next day, he discovers a mysterious user interface occasionally popping up in his vision, seemingly showing him the affection levels of certain people around him...
In this visual novel, players will:
Explore multiple story branches and make choices that shape the narrative.
Build relationships with 3 unique characters, each with their own story.
Increase affection levels through dialogue choices.
Uncover the truth behind the mysterious interface and reveal deeper plot elements.
Experience rich narrative content and unlock multiple endings.
Every choice you make affects how the story unfolds. As the affection levels change, Ethan's ordinary life will transform completely—

title: Dream Garden
description:
게임 정보
잠시 휴식을 취하며 아늑한 정원을 만드는 데 몰두하고 싶으신가요? 드림 가든에서는 고전적인 일본식 젠 가든이든 연못, 물고기, 백합이 있는 정원이든 원하는 모든 종류의 정원을 만들 수 있습니다.

드림 가든은 작고 귀여운 정원 디오라마를 만드는 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 다양한 도구, 식물, 장식, 커스터마이징이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다. 모든 것을 시도해보고 꿈의 정원을 만들어 보세요.



정원에 사용할 나무, 덤불, 돌, 잔디, 꽃 등이 가득합니다. 원하는 대로 장식을 배치하고, 언제든지 회전하고, 크기를 조정하고, 속성을 변경할 수 있는 완벽한 자유도. 아이템을 한 번에 하나씩 배치하거나 브러시를 사용하여 정원 전체에 간단히 페인트를 칠할 수 있습니다. 원하는 것은 무엇이든 자유롭게 만들 수 있습니다.



풍경을 바꾸고, 강이나 호수를 추가하고, 언덕을 만들고, 정원을 모래, 잔디 또는 자갈로 채우세요. 사전 설정이 없어 나만의 독특한 정원을 만들 수 있습니다. 모든 도구를 조합하여 최고의 디오라마를 만들어 보세요.



정원을 진정한 일본 선 정원처럼 꾸며보세요. 모래 패턴을 만들고, 조합하여 나만의 패턴을 만들거나 마우스를 움직여 패턴이 저절로 만들어지도록 하세요. 직접 해보면 갈퀴를 들고 모래를 긁어모으는 듯한 기분이 들 것입니다.



다양한 조명, 시간, 심지어 계절에 따라 정원을 살펴보세요. 매우 상세한 날씨 사용자 지정 기능을 제공합니다. 비를 켜거나 끌 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 강수량을 사용자 지정할 수 있고, 사계절 중 하나를 선택할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 늦가을이나 초봄과 같은 중간 계절을 선택할 수 있어 잔디가 이미 피기 시작했지만 아직 눈이 조금 남아 있을 때 결과를 얻을 수 있습니다. 기분에 맞게 정원을 꾸미세요.



정원을 만드는 명상적인 과정에 긴장을 풀고 몰입하세요. 컴퓨터 앞에 앉아서 정원을 만드는 것이 아니라 직접 이 정원 앞에 앉아 손으로 장식을 배치하며 분위기를 느끼고 상상할 수 있도록 모든 것을 준비했으며, 이 모든 것이 수작업으로 만들어진 차가운 음악과 함께 분위기를 더해주는 멋진 음악과 함께합니다.

title: Backrooms
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Backrooms—where reality ends, and terror begins.
In this survival-horror experience, you’re trapped in the unsettling liminal spaces of the Backrooms, armed with only your bodycam and your wits. Explore a procedurally shifting maze of endless halls, decaying rooms, and dark corridors, each more unsettling than the last. But beware—something is always watching.
Survival Is Key:
Manage your resources carefully. Batteries, food, and sanity are finite, and the creatures lurking in the shadows are anything but forgiving. Every step brings you closer to escape—or an untimely end.
Solve, Gather, Craft:
The Backrooms aren’t just about survival. Solve intricate puzzles to unlock new areas, gather mysterious artifacts, and craft tools to fend off danger or open hidden pathways. Your ability to adapt is your only chance.
Dynamic Horror:
Experience a world that shifts and twists around you, where nothing stays the same for long. Walls move, rooms disappear, and every sound could mean the arrival of an unspeakable entity.

title: Age Of Warbots
description:
게임 정보
운동
제한된 예산에서 올바른 유닛을 선택하고 전략적 위치에 배치하여 적 워봇을 물리치세요!
각 워봇에는 강점과 약점이 있으므로 올바른 워봇을 선택하는 것이 승리의 열쇠입니다.
전투가 시작되면 워봇이 작업을 수행하도록 하거나 RTS 스타일로 직접 명령을 내릴 수 있습니다. 3인칭 모드에서 개별 워봇을 제어할 수도 있습니다!
모래 상자
샌드박스 모드에서는 상상력을 마음껏 발휘할 수 있습니다. 자신만의 지도를 만들고 원하는 워봇과 관련된 전투를 시뮬레이션해 보세요!

title: 100 Cats Greece
description:
게임 정보
100 CATS 그리스 - 최고의 숨겨진 고양이 게임에 오신 것을 환영합니다!

이곳에는 그리스에 숨어있는 100마리의 고양이가 있습니다! 찾아가세요!
특징
🎮 1 레벨

😸 진짜 고양이 소리

title: Another Door
description:
게임 정보
Another Door is a party game combining turn-based roguelike and gambling for an adventure between betrayal and forced friendship. Hide your intentions, bluff your opponents and bet on your luck with the sole purpose of saving your soul…
On your journey, you'll have to face enemies beyond your imagination, but also the decisions of your "allies". Cooperation is one strategy, betrayal is another - it's up to you to make the right choices.
Think carefully before you walk through another door...
Hidden choices, well-guarded intentions: play with up to 4 players online or on the same screen while keeping your choices secret, and only reveal your darkest plans at the very last moment.
Open another door: face the number of cards indicated, collect the reward and end your adventure here, safe in the knowledge that you'll get out alive, or continue, taking all the risks in the hope of obtaining more gems.
A gambling game based on risk management and luck: no need to be the fastest, have the best reflexes, or know how to aim. Only your audacity, your eloquence, and a good dose of luck will serve you here.
