title: Nitpick: I must hunt
description:
게임 정보
Nitpick is an atmospheric open-ended cooperative multiplayer game, where you hunt animals with up to 8 friends. There is no goal except making money, buying more equipement, and making even more money!
Features
Large world: Hunt in a 6km x 6km large map, filled with secrets and varied areas
Weapons: Multiple weapon classes from hunting rifles to bows
Animals: Varied animals with unique behavior and loot
Loot: Use, sell or share your loot as you see fit
Vehicles: Buy vehicles using your earned money from hunting
Multiplayer: Play alone or cooperatively with up to 8 people

title: Frontier Paladin
description:
게임 정보
임팩트 있는 다채로운 전투
도전적이면서도 공정한 전투 시스템으로 어둠의 세력에 맞서 싸우세요. 신을 선택하고 퀘스트를 성공적으로 완수하여 신의 특별한 축복을 받으세요. 다양한 신성 유물을 수집하고 그 힘을 활용하세요. 신성한 파괴자가 되어 악을 산산조각 내고 싶으신가요? 아니면 불굴의 강자가 되어 악의 피로 자랑스러운 갑옷을 씻어내시겠습니까? 선택은 당신의 몫입니다.

교단의 요새를 방어하라
퀘스트를 성공하면 지역 군벌의 분노를 불러일으킵니다. 도전 과제가 주어졌으니, 군벌들은 기꺼이 이에 응합니다. 성기사단의 요새를 향해 몰려드는 군대에 맞서 굳건히 버텨야 합니다. 하지만 빠른 검을 휘두르는 것만으로는 승리할 수 없습니다. 영리한 성기사단원들이 고안한 함정, 포탑, 바리케이드를 활용하세요. 더 강한 성기사단원들은 전장에서 당신의 명령을 따를 것입니다.
티투스와 그의 교단이 크레이터 깊숙이 들어가면서 신생 교단에 귀중한 기술을 추가할 기회가 생겼습니다. 악에 대항할 수 있는 기술을 가진 사람들을 교단에 모집하거나, 구출하거나, 설득하세요.
티투스는 스승과 신생 교단을 따라 옛 제국의 심장부에 흉측한 상처를 낸 크레이터로 내려갑니다. 견습 성기사인 티투스는 여전히 검술을 배우고 있으며, 어느 신에게 자신의 삶과 목적을 바칠지 고민하고 있습니다. 크레이터가 예상보다 훨씬 더 위험한 것으로 드러나자, 새로운 교단은 생존을 위해 힘을 합쳐야 합니다.

title: POLY IMPULSE
description:
게임 정보
POLY IMPULSE is a minimalist fast-paced movement FPS where you will have to shoot colorful polyhedrons to impulse yourself through the level. Accuracy is also very important so you will put your aim to a test with this game!
Features:
• Shoot neon green icosahedron to impulse yourself and gain speed.
• Speedrun the levels and compete with yourself and the global leaderboard to prove that you are the number one.

title: MetalMercs
description:
게임 정보


파괴. 구조. 수리. 업그레이드. 이익! 당신은 용병 회사를 승리로 이끌어야 합니다!

협상하고 확장된 캠페인에 참여하세요. 각 미션은 새로운 도전과 만남을 제공합니다. 전투 중 정밀 사격을 사용하여 적 메크를 전략적으로 마비시키세요. 하지만 승리만으로는 충분하지 않습니다. 미션 사이에서 구조, 해체 및 수리를 통해 유닛을 운영 상태로 유지해야 합니다. 성공하면 자격 있는 보상을 얻을 수 있습니다. 실패하면 아무것도 남지 않습니다.

계약 사이의 짧은 휴식 시간 동안 유닛을 회복하고 업그레이드하세요. 수백 개의 메크를 발견하세요. 각 메크 로드아웃을 사용자 정의하고 수정하여 빌드를 최적화하세요. 특수 장비 및 업그레이드로 강화 및 수정할 수 있는 수십 개의 무기. 독특한 파일럿 기술과 특전과 결합하면 상호 작용은 무궁무진합니다!

당신은 용병 유닛을 명예와 부로 이끌 것인가, 아니면 파산으로 무너질 것인가?








전술적 지휘, 정치적 음모 및 끊임없는 전쟁의 서사시적인 여정을 준비하세요. 가장 강력한 용병 지휘관으로 거듭날 것인가, 아니면 권력을 위한 끝없는 싸움에서 쓰러질 것인가? MetalMerc가 될 자질이 있습니까?

title: Beyond The Earth
description:
게임 정보
What if you were the sole survivor after a crash landing on Mars? In Beyond The Earth, you will not only fight for survival on the unforgiving red planet but also dive into a gripping narrative that runs parallel to your survival journey. With fully voiced characters and immersive dialogues, the story comes to life, making every decision you make feel important.
Realistic Survival on Mars
Mars is not just a barren wasteland; it’s a planet that challenges your every move. The game offers a hyper-realistic environment: low gravity, harsh weather conditions, dynamic dust storms, and whirlwinds. You must constantly monitor your suit’s pressure, oxygen levels, and the planet's ever-changing conditions in real-time. Your main objective is survival, but it won’t be easy.
A Captivating Storyline
Beyond The Earth is one of the few survival games where the narrative takes center stage. You are not just building bases and collecting resources—you are unraveling the mysteries of past expeditions and the fate of those who arrived on Mars before you. Fully voiced characters add depth to the game, enhancing the atmosphere of loneliness and despair. Every dialogue, every voice echoing across the Martian landscape, will accompany you in this perilous mission.
Freedom and Colony Development
While the story unfolds, you have the freedom to explore Mars at your own pace. Build your colony, upgrade it through a unique crafting system, and develop infrastructure to terraform the planet. Every action brings you closer to transforming Mars into a habitable world.
Battling Against Mars

title: Trickster Trove
description:
게임 정보
In a world where greed surpasses fear, only the cleverest will endure. Design your own dungeon—a lethal snare for anyone who dares to be tempted by your riches. Clever traps, merciless creatures, and complex mazes — all crafted to thwart intruders. Alternatively, take a chance by exploring other players' dungeons, evading deadly traps and claiming their treasures. But remember — death in this world is not final, it's merely another lost opportunity.

Use modules to create intricate labyrinths filled with traps and monsters. Each module has a unique shape, structure, and atmosphere, featuring parkour zones and hidden rooms. Build a dungeon where every step is a risk, every turn is a trap, and anyone who dares to enter becomes a part of your game. But remember – the best dungeon doesn’t just stop intruders. It instills fear in them before they even take their first step.

title: Dragon Spot: Cozy Puzzle Builder
description:
게임 정보
타이머나 스트레스 없이 드래곤 섬을 만들고 발전시키는 명상 전략 게임에 빠져보세요. 숨막히는 풍경을 만들고 주민들이 이빨을 가진 애완동물을 돌보는 모습을 지켜보세요. 휴식과 창의력 모두를 위한 완벽한 게임입니다.
간단한 섬 디자인 및 커스터마이징

몇 가지 간단한 도구로 아름다운 섬을 쉽게 만들어 보세요. 나만의 취향에 맞게 환경을 커스터마이징하세요. 나만의 완벽한 드래곤 파라다이스를 만들어 보세요. 번거로움은 필요 없습니다!
드래곤을 위한 성장하는 커뮤니티를 만드세요

성장하는 정착지를 건설하고 마법의 세계에 빠져보세요. 주민들이 이빨 달린 애완동물을 사랑스럽게 키우며 섬을 활기차고 번성하는 커뮤니티로 변화시키는 모습을 지켜보세요. 새로운 집을 짓고 드래곤을 돌보는 모든 행동으로 섬은 따뜻함과 매력으로 살아납니다.
이웃 주택을 건설하고 개인화하기

드래곤을 키우는 데 도움을 줄 사람들과 함께 살게 됩니다. 그들을 위한 아늑한 보금자리를 건설하세요.

title: Elflock
description:
게임 정보
Elflock is a single-player third-person adventure. You are a princess returning to your home on the brink of war and it's up to you to navigate the machinations of the nobles surrounding the king. Engage in intricate dialogues and uncover mysteries in this branching fantasy tale!
THE FATE OF AN ENTIRE KINGDOM IN YOUR HANDS
When a hostile empire delivers an ultimatum, help your father, the king, make the decision that could save your homeland - or cause its destruction if the circumstances are misjudged.
UNRAVEL A TANGLED WEB OF ULTERIOR MOTIVES
You must explore every nook and cranny of the castle and delve into the personal relationships of its residents to gather crucial information about complex characters needed to win the nobles' support for your goals.

title: You see me?
description:
게임 정보
The main character is on the brink of despair after losing someone dear to them. In an attempt to cope with the loss and find meaning in life, they encounter a mysterious stranger named Crowley. This enigmatic figure offers an unusual path to healing—a journey into the depths of their own consciousness.
Delving into their mind, the protagonist discovers that familiar places from the past have transformed into distorted realms filled with nightmares.
Crowley warns that all pleasant memories will be twisted, and fears will take terrifying forms. Here, reality intertwines with illusions, and time loses its meaning.

title: The Barkeeper
description:
게임 정보
게임의 주인공은 우연히 바텐더가 된 전문 바리스타입니다.
그가 이 기술에서 성공할 수 있도록 도와주세요! 다양한 시설을 방문하여 새로운 레시피를 배우고, 업계 사람들을 만나고, 그들의 기술을 채택하세요.
여러분의 기술만이 다양한 칵테일을 제 시간에 정확하게 만들고 제공하는 데 얼마나 성공할 수 있는지를 결정합니다. 빠른 속도로 업무에 대처할 수 있나요?
게임의 혼란스러운 특성을 통해 자신만의 전술을 구축하세요. 팁을 사용하거나 자신만의 전략을 고안하여 최소한의 움직임과 상호작용으로 빠르게 주문을 전달하세요.
빠르면 빠를수록 좋지만 품질도 놓치지 마세요. 결국 잘못된 재료는 쓰레기만 만들 뿐입니다. 고객의 만족도가 높을수록 더 좋은 피드백과 더 많은 별을 받을 수 있습니다.

title: Pocket Legend : Inventory Roguelike Deckbuilding
description:
게임 정보
포켓 레전드는 영혼이 깃든 전설의 무기들이 있는 다른 세계로 차원이동한 주인공의 이야기입니다. 각기 다른 능력을 가진 전설의 아이템들을 인벤토리에 적절하게 배치하여, 플레이어를 괴롭히는 다양한 패턴을 가진 적들을 물리치며 이야기를 진행해 나가는 '인벤토리' 로그라이크 덱빌딩 게임입니다.
게임플레이 소개 
'인벤토리' 로그라이크 덱 빌딩 게임이라는 특성상,  각 카드들은 인벤토리 안에서의 위치와 주변상황, 유물에 따라 다른 능력을 발휘하게 됩니다. 
인접한 칸에 빈칸이 많을 수록 적을 강하게 공격한다거나
인벤토리에 방해 블록이 많을 수록 더 강하게 공격한다거나
인벤토리 정리를 많이 할 수록 강해진다거나 합니다. 
매 턴 카드 드로우를 하기 때문에 한번 인벤토리를 셋업하면 그 이후로는 지켜보기만 해야 하는 게임과는 다른 재미가 있습니다.
인벤토리를 계속 정리해 가며 최적의 구성을 턴마다 찾아야 합니다.

title: Rolling Thunder: Vietnam
description:
게임 정보
Rolling Thunder: Vietnam is a squad-based first-person shooter set during the Vietnam War, offering deep tactical gameplay and intense, large scale battles. Work closely with your squad to navigate the chaos of war, utilizing combined arms combat with infantry, armored vehicles, helicopters, boats, and jets in 64 player battles where tactics and teamwork are the keys to victory.
Immersive class based combat
While navigating the lush jungles, treacherous rivers, and war-torn villages of Vietnam, Your squad will be the most important capability you have. You must master the art of coordination with your squad and utilize your class abilities to complement their combat efficiency in the field. 
Player will have access to multiple classes to chose from, such as:
Squad Leader
Assault
Medic
Support
Engineer
Recon
Community and Teamwork
In Rolling Thunder: Vietnam, teamwork and communication are essential to survival on the battlefield, and it's one of the core pillars of its development.
The game will feature in-depth social systems, such as built-in local and squad wide VOIP, party options, and clan support, ensuring you can fight alongside existing friends as well as forge new friendships with the soldier in the foxhole next to you.
Combined arms and logistics 
The game will feature complete combined arms, including but not limited to:
Jeeps
Tanks
Armored personnel carriers 
Patrol boats

title: YOU ARE SUPER MEGA LEGEND PHOENIX
description:
게임 정보
불사조는 진짜 유명한 피닉스임.




당신은 2천년 전 엄청 유명한 대학살의 주인공인 전설의 피닉스이다. 당신은 전투의 상처를 치료하기 위해 2천년간 잠적했고, 지상의 마물들은 당신을 처치하기 위해 찾아왔다.



명예로운 환상수인 당신은 그들의 도전을 받아들여야 하지만, 아직 상처 치료가 덜 되어 전성기 시절의 힘을 딱 11초만 낼 수 있다.

차례로 몰려오는 적들을 모두 무찌르고 2천년 전 '불사조는 진짜 유명한 피닉스임.'의 전설을 재현해 주도록 하자.












게임이 시작되면 오른쪽 UI에 당신이 입력 가능한 키보드 키가 표시됩니다. 그 키를 눌러 마물을 공격하세요.

COMBO에 주의하십시오. 올바른 키 입력에 성공하면 1 COMBO가 쌓이고, 공격력이 상승합니다. (COMBO당 +1)
COMBO는 잘못된 키를 입력하면 0으로 초기화됩니다.



당신은 단 11초만 싸울 수 있습니다. 11초 안에 모든 적(LEVEL 10)을 처치하지 못하면 패배합니다.
autokwd: YOU ARE SUPER MEGA LEGEND PHOENIX

title: Shore of Jord
description:
게임 정보
Live through the last winter on the Europe.
Shore of Jord is a story-driven open world cRPG set in an alternative world where sagas and Norse paganism blend with the realism of Scandinavian noir. Players navigate a post-apocalyptic landscape influenced by Scandinavian and Eastern European cultures, 1451 years after the Ragnarok.
You are Orm Junger, a retired military officer haunted by your alter-ego, Shadow. Together, you’ll unravel webs of political upheaval, dark crimes, and veiled conspiracies as you strive to piece yourself back together after a mysterious night call.
FEATURES of the Shore.
Comprehensive Character System: The game features an intricate character system with 22 distinct traits, each possessing its own nuances, contradictions, and complexities. These traits play a central role in shaping the player's journey and interactions within the game world.
Immersive and Distinctive Setting: Set in a meticulously crafted world, the game offers a unique blend of historical realism, mythical elements, and fantastical storytelling. Players will explore a richly detailed environment filled with lore, secrets, and unexpected discoveries.
Narrative-Driven Role-Playing: Experience a story-rich adventure that harkens back to the golden age of CRPGs. With a focus on deep storytelling, branching paths, and meaningful choices, players will navigate a richly layered narrative that unfolds based on their decisions and actions.
Dynamic Time Management: The game features a dynamic time management system that adds depth and consequence to player choices. As time progresses, events unfold, and the world evolves, creating a sense of urgency and agency. The world continues to live and breathe, adapting to the player’s decisions while maintaining its own independent rhythm.
Why Shore?
Choices matter: more than ever. You can get so screwed over that you'll never reach the ending you hoped for. You can ignore the "main quest" entirely and still reach real endings (not just Easter eggs), lose all your companions, or even find yourself unable to finish the game at all. The Shore of Jord is not just about successful or failed checks; it’s a game of social interactions that sometimes can’t be fixed.
The world is hard to figure out—blending the in-game Europa with real historical figures, events, technology, and everything else, shaken and rearranged to the point where players question what's really happening.

title: The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows
description:
게임 정보
As the family dog, it's your job to protect your loved ones from danger - especially from the kind they can't see. In The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows, play as a dog defending its family from an onslaught of paranormal entities.


The Good Dog offers a variety of game modes. In Protect, you must survive the night as waves of entities enter your home and attempt to harm your sleeping family. Distract the entities by squeaking your toys or barking, or attack them if they get too close - whatever it takes to keep them away from your family. In Fetch, you must explore a range of dilapidated locations to retrieve something for your owner while avoiding the entities roaming the level.

In the Story Mode, explore the game's detailed environments to discover why the paranormal creatures have targeted you. Each environment can be explored freely, with some areas of the map opening up as time passes and as you make discoveries about the world. Solving each puzzle will bring you one step closer to saving your family. Be cautious, however; the paranormal will be tracking you throughout your journey. Using your unique abilities, you’ll need to avoid these threats at all costs - or take a chance at slowing them down with tooth and claw.


Use your keen sense of smell to search the area for tools. Roll around in the dirt to cover your scent and hide from threats. Dig up hidden items to solve puzzles and fight back against the paranormal. Bark at certain immaterial entities to disperse them, or at physical entities to draw their attention away from your family.


With over a dozen unique breeds to choose from, each with a different set of stats and abilities, you'll be able to play the game the way you want. Will you choose a small breed to fit into tighter spaces and evade danger, or a larger breed with more health and attacking power? Will you prioritize your stamina, tracking capabilities, stealth, or something else entirely? No matter how you want to play, there will be a breed for you.

title: Solar Wave
description:
게임 정보
Solar Wave is a large-scale space strategy with indirect control. The 21st millennium, the Solar Empire conquers the entire Milky Way and rushes to the nearest galaxy. It turns out that these worlds are already inhabited. But when has this stopped humanity? Become the governor of the empire and ensure the success of the invasion.

Game Features:
4x space strategy - explore the stars, colonize new worlds, capture territories.
Indirect control of fleets - is not the business of the governor to give orders to every soldier of the empire. Each fleet has its own tasks, and they diligently try to fulfill it.

Advanced economic model – create production chains, provide logistics and watch your worlds and fleets grow and gain strength.
Epic battles in which thousands of ships converge and burn down.

title: Brownie's Adventure: The Final Resolution
description:
게임 정보
A thoroughly original point and click adventure set between a vibrant fantasy world and the South Yorkshire/Derbyshire apocalypse.
Venture through working men's club parties, 24-hour all-night shrubberies, A post apocalyptic Peak District and fire-regulation-busting, volcano-adjacent coffee shops in this final comedy point and click extravaganza!
Crammed to breaking point with clever puzzles, hilarious events and a thoroughly 1990s adventure style.

title: Captain Wayne - Vacation Desperation
description:
게임 정보
Witness an elaborately hand-drawn, action-packed epic inspired by the FPS greats!
Make use of the many devastating weapons in Wayne’s arsenal and achieve maximum destruction!
Explore dangerous locales through 8 humongous areas all across Orca Isle!
HALF GAME, HALF CARTOON! Delight in the Captain’s depth-defying tale in CAMPAIGN MODE as you view tons of animated cutscenes exploring his adventure. 
Experience a high-octane soundtrack that emphasizes AGGRESSION and CHAOS!
Go for the gold in our ENDLESS MODE–how long can you survive the onslaught?

title: Magia Story
description:
게임 정보
Features ✅
❤️ Build a bond with your Amimon and collect powerful creatures!
🌎 🏃 Venture out on a new open world adventure!
👚 Customize your character’s appearance and outfit
🎮 🎮 Multiplayer! Play with your friends
👨‍🌾🏡Start your own farm in different cities and environments! Build  your own  welcoming home for your Amimon!
🪄  Battle alongside your Amimon and use the elements to your advantage in team based combat! 🔥🌩️ 🌊⛰️❄️🌪️
⛹️‍♂️🐻 Minigames, including Dodgeball with Amimon!
and more to come!

title: DRIFT ISLAND
description:
게임 정보
Rise as a Drift Master and Missile Car Mechanic in DRIFT ISLAND!
Welcome to DRIFT ISLAND, the ultimate open-world drifting playground where you don’t just drive—you shred every corner in style. Build your own missile car, fine-tune its guts, and let loose on the legendary Drift Island. Whether you’re a veteran sideways slider or fresh to the scene, DRIFT ISLAND offers an immersive, high-octane experience that puts you in control of every detail of your drift machine.
Key Features:
Early Access Drifting Action
We’re launching in Early Access so you can join us on this journey to perfect the drift experience. Expect regular updates packed with new parts, legendary drift cars, track expansions, and engine upgrades—designed with the feedback of dedicated drifters like you.
Build & Customize Your Missile Cars
From iconic JDM legends to the most popular engines around, tune every aspect of your ride. Swap in high-performance parts, adjust suspension geometry, fiddle with the turbo, and push your car to its limit. But be warned: a poorly tuned engine can blow—literally! Master the art of tuning to avoid costly explosions and keep your drift missile in prime condition.
Legendary Drift Island
Explore an open-world environment built for sliding. Take on serpentine mountain roads, industrial zones, and hidden spots that’ll test your skills behind the wheel. Rack up drift points, impress other gearheads, and uncover new challenges as you leave smoking rubber in your wake.

title: Embervale
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to Embervale, the ultimate idle fantasy RPG on Twitch and Steam! Dive into a magical world, strive to be the strongest player, and uncover unique treasures. Thrive in Adventures, where your strategic decisions with streamers and viewers determine your success and lead to victory!

Embark on thrilling adventures alongside your favorite streamers and experience the thrill of victory and the agony of defeat! Whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to the world of role play games, Embervale is the perfect way to dive into the action and join a community of passionate players who share your love for gaming. So why wait? Join the adventure and start your journey to become the ultimate player in Embervale today!
Why Choose the Steam Version of Embervale?
The Steam version of Embervale offers the most reliable and optimized gaming experience. With all graphical assets included directly in the game, you can enjoy significantly reduced loading times. This ensures that even players with slower internet connections can dive into the adventure seamlessly.

Streamers will particularly benefit from using the Steam version when playing Adventure mode with their viewers, as it provides the best and smoothest experience possible.

Rest assured, the Steam version contains the same rich content and exciting features as the Twitch extension and web versions. Plus, you can showcase your Embervale achievements on your Steam profile, adding an extra layer of bragging rights to your gaming accomplishments.
Can I Play Without a Twitch Account?
When you start Embervale, you'll have the option to create an account through Steam or link your existing Twitch account to your Steam profile. This flexibility ensures you can jump into the game whether you’re using Twitch or not.

However, for Twitch streamers, there's an exclusive Adventure Mode. To access this feature, you'll need to either log in with your Twitch account or link your Steam account to Twitch. This mode is designed to enhance the interactive experience for streamers and their communities!
Once you link your account to Steam, all your achievements will be synchronized across platforms. No matter where you play, any unlocked achievements will automatically appear on your Steam profile. This seamless integration ensures your accomplishments are always up-to-date and ready to show off!

title: Montaro 2
description:
게임 정보

Montaro 2 is a stealth game where you are a clever doggo, navigating through various locations such as shopping streets, residential areas, schools, stations, and public swimming pools to complete sneaky missions and steal interesting items.
Sneak into different scenes, use the environment and props to hide from store clerks, and accomplish mission objectives.
Featuring:
Cute Shiba Inu
Busy humans
Underwear
Woof!

title: Cozy Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
코지 던전은 던전을 탐험하며 적을 물리치고 개조하여 수익을 얻는 어드벤처/인테리어 디자인 게임입니다! 사업에 새로운 변화를 더하기로 한 몬스터 퇴치 길드의 리더가 되어 보세요. 던전을 민박집으로 바꿀 수 있는데 던전 정복에만 집중할 필요는 없잖아요?
위험천만한 던전 탐험
교묘한 퍼즐과 사악한 적, 치명적인 함정으로 가득한 던전을 통과하세요. 탐험과 전투에 도움이 되는 다양한 도구를 사용하고 기지를 발휘하면 생존에 필요한 우위를 점할 수 있습니다.

내면의 장인정신을 발휘하세요
여러분이 방문하는 모든 던전은 고객의 소유이며, 고객들은 새로운 모습을 보고 싶어 합니다! 새 가구를 만들고 쓰레기를 치우며, 벽과 바닥을 바꾸고 고장 난 가구를 판매하는 등 다양한 작업을 할 수 있습니다! 모든 준비가 끝나면 이제 돈이 굴러들어 오길 기다리면 됩니다!

길드 커스터마이징
열심히 번 골드를 사용하여 길드를 꾸미고 확장하며 캐릭터를 향상시키고, 새로운 설계도를 사고, 새로운 친구를 만나는 등 원하는 방식대로 길드를 꾸미고 확장할 수 있습니다!

title: Endless Anime Golf
description:
게임 정보
프로시저럴 제너레이션
프로시저럴 제너레이션은 비디오 게임 내에서 역동적이고 독특한 경험을 만드는 데 사용됩니다. 이를 사용하면 코스가 항상 달라져 플레이어가 플레이할 때마다 새로운 경험을 할 수 있습니다. 이를 통해 정적인 콘텐츠로는 달성하기 어려운 수준의 흥미와 재플레이 가능성을 게임에 추가할 수 있습니다.
최대 파 8
파는 플레이어가 한 홀을 완료하는 데 필요한 스트로크 수에 대한 표준을 설정합니다. 최대 8개의 파를 선택할 수 있기 때문에 플레이어는 성공하기 위해 자신의 기술을 연마하고 기술을 완성해야 합니다.
즐겨 찾기 저장하기
즐겨 찾는 홀을 저장하면 나중에 쉽게 액세스할 수 있습니다. 특정 코스나 홀을 다시 플레이하여 스코어를 올리거나 경치를 즐기고 싶을 때 특히 유용합니다. 즐겨 찾는 홀을 기억 속에서 사라지게 하지 말고 저장 시스템을 사용해 나중에 다시 즐길 수 있도록 가까이에 두세요.

title: Soulers
description:
게임 정보
"소울러즈"는 시간을 느리게 가게 만들고, 다양한 동료로 팀을 조합하여 싸울 수 있는 슈팅 게임입니다. 연합의 함장 "마키나"가 되어 강력한 보스들을 무찔러서 동료로 영입하고, 위기를 헤쳐 나가며 세상에 숨겨진 진실을 파헤치세요!
시간을 느리게 가게 하는 능력
"마키나"는 시간을 느리게 하는 특별한 능력을 사용합니다. 적의 공격을 피하고, 날아오는 미사일을 되돌려 반격하며 전황을 뒤집으세요.

title: Space Crafter
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a unique adventure on the trail of the Etherians, a vanished civilization whose technologies seem to attract many people with dubious intentions... Get your hands on these technologies before they use them to wreak havoc across the galaxy.

In this first-person exploration and survival game, many challenges await you!
Explore planets

Your quest will take you to many different planets and environments to unlock the secrets of Etherian technology. Explore ancient caves, enter a working industrial complex and experience unique adventures!

Collect resources

Collect resources on your expeditions and automate their processing with various machines that you unlock as you progress. But be careful: make sure your base has enough energy to run them all!


Build your own base to make yourself at home, and develop new technologies to improve your equipment for further exploration.


During your expeditions, you're likely to encounter unexpected and hostile encounters: toxic gases, wild creatures, bounty hunters and security services; you'll have to build your own weapons to defeat them and advance your quest.

title: SCHROTT
description:
게임 정보
🦝SCHROTT - the roguelite driving game!🦝
SCHROTT is all about absurd vehicles, insane stunts, and endless opportunities to customize and upgrade your ride. And let's not forget speed - SCHROTT is all about fast-paced, heart-pumping action.
⚙️Features🔩
Fast-paced and arcade-like driving controls that are easy to pick up and play
Roguelite gameplay with a focus on driving absurd vehicles
Customize and upgrade your vehicle to make it even more absurd and powerful
Get loot... a lot of loot
Procedural generated tracks with JunkPunk elements

title: Windswept
description:
게임 정보
Marbles 🦆 and Checkers 🐢 were swept away by a storm and they need your help finding their way home!
In this 90s platforming adventure there's a ton of stuff to do and even more to collect.


Windswept Features:
Linear platforming adventure containing a bunch of secrets and collectibles to uncover
Huge world spanning 5 regions with over 40 hand-crafted stages and a few friends to meet along the way
An additional out-of-this-world challenge for the bravest adventurers wanting to push themselves to their limit
Simple controls with lots of movement variety
Play as a tag-team Duck & Turtle duo by yourself or grab a friend for real-time local co-op / Steam Remote Play
Get ready to be swept away!

title: My Cozy Home
description:
게임 정보
꿈에 그리던 집을 짓는 꿈을 꾸어본 적이 있나요? 이 게임은 금전적 투자나 현실의 번거로움 없이 꿈의 집을 짓는 데 필요한 모든 도구를 제공하므로 더 이상 고민하지 마세요.

편안한 사운드트랙을 들으며 수백 가지의 오브제를 사용해 집 안을 원하는 대로 배치해 보세요. 디자인이 마음에 들면 커뮤니티와 자유롭게 공유하세요.
이 게임의 일부 기능은 다음과 같습니다 :-
자유로운 디자인 - 나만의 레이아웃을 디자인하세요. 객실 레이아웃을 자유롭게 선택할 수 있습니다.
가구 배치 - 라이브러리에 있는 가구와 다양한 물건을 배치하여 방을 꾸밀 수 있습니다.
페인팅 - 원하는 대로 벽에 페인트를 칠하거나 가구에 색을 칠하세요.
공유 - 레이아웃이 마음에 들면 커뮤니티, 친구, 가족과 방을 공유할 수 있습니다.
커스터마이징 - 게임에서 날씨, 주변 색상 등을 커스터마이징할 수 있습니다.

title: Remnants of R'lyeh
description:
게임 정보
“How can one be alive but dead at the same time? It is a mound of flesh, decaying and putrid yet crawling with worms and arthropods. It is a sanctuary for fish in a ship sunken lower than the abyssal depths. It is an abandoned castle, overfilled with dancing shadows. There is no true release in death. All of the living will have to pay for their gift once their time is over. And those who never lived will be awakened from their eternal slumber...”

title: Trailer Park Life
description:
게임 정보

Trailer Park Life is a city-building, simulation and management game about building and growing a trailer park with a thriving community.

Your trailer park will be a place for people to come and camp, come to party and come to live. With camping areas with tents, RV trailers on lots to double-wide retirement villas you will have all types of people staying at your trailer park. Your park needs resources like power and water, businesses to keep your citizens entertained and have places to eat and staff to keep it all up and running. Your citizens and your park will challenge you with wants and needs, not to mention a variety of natural disasters including tornados, fires and more!

The success of your trailer park will depend on your attention to your citizens and management of the employees and park resources.



Layout your park as a quiet place to relax or turn it into a freakish party zone, not intended for early risers. Trailer Park Life is all about choices. With many buildings to plop down that cater to services, food & dining and entertainment. Building locations really matter. Be sure they are close enough to access yet not so close to annoy the neighbors.




Park services will be needed in keeping the park up and running. Each of the services require people to run them and funds to pay them so your management will be vital to the success of your park.

You will need staff to help you keep things in order. Life will be easier by hiring and upgrading your cleaning staff, maintenance staff, security guards and more. All these employees don't come free, so you will need manage the park expenses and income so you can turn a profit.


The success of your thriving park will depend on how you treat your citizens. Listening to their wants and needs they will become a happier community and be willing to pay their lot fees. But if you ignore them they will turn on you and take revenge on your hard work and getting them to pay their fees will be difficult.
It will be a fine balance between giving them everything they want and what your park budget can afford.

title: Eastern Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Eastern Tactics is a strategy RPG game set in the fictional backdrop of the Tang Dynasty. In the game, players control descendants of famous Tang Dynasty generals embarking on an adventurous journey. Utilizing diverse incarnate abilities and employing varied combat strategies, players aim to emerge victorious in battle challenges.

Game Features

Embark on an adventure: Experience a mysterious and grand adventure in a magical world where the fate of the world's peace lies in your hands.
Only incarnates can defeat other incarnates: Summon various incarnates with unique abilities to assist you in battles.
Win battles and grow stronger: Every battle poses a strong strategic challenge, and winning battles allows your characters to grow. Equip them with different attribute gear, learn more powerful skills, and prepare for the next challenge.
Challenge peculiar and powerful bosses: Your team will face a variety of formidable and bizarre enemies, and each boss battle requires a targeted strategy to overcome.


In every era, there are always those struggling for survival, while others seek a path to transcendence.

In the sixth year of Zhenguan (632 AD), Emperor Taizong of Tang, upon the advice of the celestial being Yuan Tiangang and others, held a grand ceremony on Mount Tai known as the Fengshan ceremony.

Two years later, certain extraordinary beings with incarnates outside their bodies started to become active. It is said that these beings were demonic entities attached to human desires and transformed into incarnates, granting the possessors of these incarnates various extraordinary abilities. "Only an incarnate messenger can defeat another incarnate messenger."

In the eleventh year of Zhenguan (637 AD), in the distant west, the Sassanid Empire was reaching its final moments. Zoroastrian incarnates in the far west were no match for the four great Muslim caliphs, and the king and nobles decided to flee. Unwilling to accept the fate of the Zoroastrian religion being annihilated by the emerging Abbasid Caliphate, the Zoroastrian high priest, the Mobed, dispatched two messengers to travel across the ancient Silk Road to the emerging Eastern Empire in the far east, in search of awakening the slumbering gods...

As they journeyed thousands of miles through the desert to the east, Emperor Taizong suddenly launched a war to conquer the Western Regions.

And this is just the beginning of the story.

title: Mind Diver
description:
게임 정보
Explore the Mind Ocean to solve a twisted case
You are a Mind Diver.
Using experimental technology, you explore Lina's Mind Ocean, fixing her memories to solve an unprecedented missing persons case. Lina's subconscious hides many secrets, critical to unraveling the dark case.
Restore broken memories and uncover the past

title: Scarecrow
description:
게임 정보

GAMEPLAY
Robert is a hitman. His task is clear and simple: to kill those who ask too many questions without asking any questions himself. The game is a hellish cocktail of multiple genres, with adventure and top-down shooter being the main ones. During the day, roam the city, drink cheap booze at the bar, philosophize with hobos in abandoned buildings, and much more. At night, head out to do your "job"—ruthlessly eliminating everything that stands or lies where it shouldn’t to. Beat up gangsters, find secret items that reveal the game’s lore, and hang out with friends as you gradually dive deeper into the game’s dark atmosphere. Have fun!
The game is developed without external funding by a small independent team of four.
A unique blend of radically different genres that will give you a fresh gaming experience.
Dynamic Combat: each fight requires its own approach.
Awesome Soundtrack: from energetic dubstep to acoustic guitar melodies.
Get wasted with friends, battle with toy guns to heavy electronic beats, and much more!
CHAPTERS
Scarecrow consists of three chapters. The first chapter introduces you to the game world and its core mechanics. In the following two chapters, the story unfolds further. All chapters are included in the game’s price and will be automatically added as they are released.

title: Legends of Astravia
description:
게임 정보
Legends of Astravia is a charming retro RPG set in a world of magic. You play as Oliver, a mystician on a quest to meet new companions and unravel his complicated past... and the truth behind a mysterious trio's plan to reawaken the Cataclysm and bring forth another age of ruin. Influenced by 90s and early 2000s-era JRPGs, the game features hybrid time-based battles and an explorable world filled with twisting dungeons and countless secrets.
Feel the excitement of outracing your opponents with powerful magic and abilities in this fluid system where you fight using the flow of time. A hybrid between turn-based and active systems, Legends of Astravia's unique combat encourages quick—but strategic—decision making.
Vast, explorable overworld designed with care. Intricate dungeons filled with puzzles and traps are contrasted with lively towns and their welcoming NPCs and side-quests. And while the main story's obstacles are balanced and fair, there are plenty of optional areas with difficult and rewarding challenges to discover.
A distinctive cast where each character's unique personality and traits shine through. In this character-driven story, dialogue and scenes are written to make you feel like you're in the company of your companions as they react to the changing world around them.

title: Dark Fracture
description:
게임 정보
Dark Fracture is a psychological horror experience in which you explore an ever-changing world where reality and nightmares collide. Walk on the edge of madness in the shoes of a tormented soul as you descend into the darkest depths of the human psyche, and question everything you see.
Set in the late 90s in a forested area of the Northeastern USA, Dark Fracture brings you into the eerie environment of a body farm – a decomposition research facility. You enter the world as Edward, a lonely individual tormented by a tragic past, whose only solace is in the medicine that helps him to get through the day. Edward is barely able to cope with his issues, which are only intensified by the solitude of his workplace. He puts on a brave front and dutifully wakes up for work every day. His routine serves as his only anchor, but deep inside, trouble is simmering...
One night, while working the dreaded midnight shift, a chain of disturbing events draws Edward ever closer to losing his sanity, as the very fabric of reality seems to unravel and twist around him. The comfort of his self-inflicted apathy is being pulled from under his feet, and the cruel hand of fate is once more nudging him towards disaster – one that threatens to engulf Edward's entire world in the shadows.
Is it merely Edward’s mind playing tricks on him? Or perhaps there truly is something darker clawing at his heels, threatening to drag him into the depths? You need to figure it out and the choices you make will shape the results of his terrifying tale.

title: BLOCKLORDS
description:
게임 정보
What is BLOCKLORDS?
BLOCKLORDS is a player-driven MMO medieval grand strategy game where your decisions and skills shape the world and narrative.
Choose from several playstyles, including farming, fighting, resource management, and ruling, and forge your own destiny as your Hero.
Experience the pinnacle of strategy gaming with BLOCKLORDS and let your legacy be written in the annals of its world. Join us, as this medieval saga beckons you to make your mark.

Heroes at Your Command:
From Farmers, Hunters, Warriors, Rulers and everything in between, every Hero possesses unique stats & traits essential for battles, management, and resource gathering. All new players start as a Farmer character!

The Art of Agriculture:
Farm resources and settle farms across an expansive world map, customizing them to your vision. In this ever-changing world, start a family and watch as your stats and traits evolve with each strategic decision, shaping the future of your lineage. As you navigate the challenges of pioneering life, embark on grand adventures, meeting personalities, confronting fearsome creatures, and unraveling enigmatic adventures. Deploy specialized squads for tasks such as resource gathering and enemy confrontations, furthering your legacy as a strategic leader.

The Thrill of Combat:
Defend your territories or embark on a journey of conquest. As you traverse this challenging landscape, rise steadily from the simple life of a farmer to the power and prestige of a Ruler. Along your path, face treacherous beasts hidden within the forests and stave off aggressive raiders. At every crossroad, decide whether to stand as a loyal knight, upholding honor, or embrace the unpredictability of a wild raider.

The Responsibility of Ruling:
Oversee vast regions, implementing decisions on levies and spearheading the development of flourishing cities. Claim regions, harvest taxes, and shape your city's fate. Hire knights to defend your territories and remain vigilant over factors like population, order, and prosperity which will dictate the gameplay experience, all while becoming an influential leader.

The Quest for Conquest:
Dictate the destinies of entire kingdoms with a blend of power and strategy at your helm. As you claim the crown, take steps to cement a legacy that stands the test of time, with the command of mighty armies at your fingertips, venture forth to expand your dominions.

title: Carbox
description:
게임 정보
Drive. Build. Share. 

Carbox is a Sandbox Driving game
With its easy-to-use and powerful editor, you can let your imagination run wild and create customized maps and races to play and share with other players.
Build your dream city, share it with the community, earn coins and rewards to get more vehicles and content. Drive and compete in an ever-expanding world of custom maps and races.
 
Features

Cars with hand-made designed physics and many different driving styles
World editor to create cities and circuits
Sharing platform to share your maps, and explore other player's cities
Asynchronous multiplayer and leaderboards
Tons of assets to unlock. Make your city unique!
Day-Night cycle
Custom Traffic System
Unlock cars and cities by racing and building

title: Almost My Floor: Duality
description:
게임 정보




Almost My Floor: Duality is a horror game with decision-making mechanics similar to "Dark Pictures" but in 2D. Endless subway mazes, cramped courtyards of high-rise buildings, and dark floors await a new victim. The game features multiple main characters, each capable of experiencing the story differently, or even not surviving at all.



The heroes will face both internal and external threats simultaneously. Their inner demons grow stronger, engulfing their minds in depression and pain. Meanwhile, the city sinks deeper into chaos, with people vanishing without a trace, and the police seem powerless. Rumors circulate about a growing anomaly. But who believes in such things?

Personal experiences of battling depression are woven into the game through images, stories, and thoughts. The characters, each with their own destiny and sorrow, fight differently for the right to live without the perpetual internal struggle with themselves. You must uncover the mysteries in the city, save loved ones, and not lose to your own demons.



In a world on the edge of imagination and reality, you will have to unravel all the mysteries of a provincial town before horror consumes your mind and body. More and more inexplicable disappearances flicker in the news reports, leaving the town's residents frightened by the unknown.












Main characters:



Chloe Freudgel - the daughter of a brilliant psychiatrist and scientist, who is remarkably intelligent for her age. To clear her father's name, she embarks on her own investigation.

Masha - a simple girl from an even more provincial town. To save her beloved, she will have to unravel the city's secrets.

Adam Trust - a private detective famous throughout the city thanks to the Freudgel case. He thought he had solved all the mysteries of House No. 9, with the criminal behind bars. But, as it turns out, not everything is so simple. The most important case in the detective's career is still unsolved.

title: Northanda Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
The Void threatens to devour the ancient realm of Northanda
Lead a party of legendary heroes in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Only your chosen champions have the power to stop the fabric of the cosmos from coming undone.
Recruit three heroes from countless possible combinations to form an unbreakable team. Heroes fill the roles Support, Slayer, and Defender, each bringing their own unique card library to a single, shared deck. Every combination opens new strategic possibilities:
Supports sustain the group with powerful buffs
Slayers exploit enemy weaknesses with devastating attacks
Defenders draw enemy focus and shield their allies from harm

title: PARAVOX
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of PARAVOX!

Navigate your way through the maps at lightning speed: In PARAVOX, players are able to use 'Double Jump', 'Blink', and 'High Jump' to soar through the battlefield, dodge enemy attacks, and launch surprise attacks with ease!

Secure the points: PARAVOX's gameplay revolves around capturing and holding 'Strike Points'. The first team to reach 100 points wins the round. Strike Points are contested areas that switch locations periodically. With each round change, the 'Respawn Time' increases. The dynamic nature of the points, coupled with the variety of maps and team compositions, demands a high level of strategic thinking and adaptability.

Ace the game using unique Brands: Weapons are tagged as “Brands” in the PARAVOXverse. From classic skill-based ARs and SRs to close-combat-oriented swords and Beam Magnums, the diverse weaponry offers a wide range of playstyles and team compositions. Each Brand boasts two skills which can significantly impact the battle's outcome. Lead your team to victory with mechanical prowess and top-notch strategies.



PARAVOX will continue to receive new content in the future. Don't miss out on PARAVOX, the pinnacle of esports shooters!


WASD keys: Movement
Shift: Blink
Space: Jump
Left click: Main fire
Right click: Sub-fire/zoom/scope
R: Reload
F: Primary skill
Q: Secondary skill

title: Chyss
description:
게임 정보
Chyss is a turnbased, tactical 1vs1 game based on chess.
You can move, attack, and consume your mana to spells and use items when it's your turn.
Your goal is to destroy your opponent's Leader!

The year is 12022.
Number of civilisations evolved from primitive life to being able to travel the universe.
In this universe, a game has evolved to become essential: The Chyss.

The Chyss has its roots in chess, but many have added to the rules in order to create its successor. A timeless, universal, and balanced game, allowing interplanetary competition, where fair play, game intelligence and risk-taking are the traits of legendary players.
Young children want to become great Chyss players, the vast majority of adults play, whether to have fun, relax, explore the possibilities, or to pursue their childhood dreams.

In this universe, a phenomenon affects about a third of the people...
About a third of people become incarnates overnight. Falling asleep as themselves, they wake up controlled by different, higher forces.
These forces do not want their loss, but simply direct their steps, their actions.

You are this higher force which is going to take control of an inhabitant of this universe.
You, and all the other players of this video game...
You will embody an incarnate.

This incarnate is now you.
Your goal will be determined by you. You can become the best Chyss player in the universe, but there are many pitfalls along the way.
There are many extremely strong, clever players in this universe.
The best Chyss player in the universe is anonymous. She is only known as "The Galaxy Queen".
Good luck! And battle with pride.

title: Lamia's Bambina
description:
게임 정보
Train the best, most powerful Lamias!
WORLD
In an impoverished demon world ravaged by the war between man and beast, the Lamia tribe are on the verge of extinction.

Ivy, reincarnated into the demon world as the Lamia tribe's savior, along with princess Hedera aim for the revival of their tribe. Play as Ivy as you multiply and raise Lamias and battle the Harpy tribe to reclaim the Lamia Palace.
DUNGEONS
Battles take place in demon world dungeons with familiar 2D maps. Explore the dungeons again and again and defeat the bosses waiting in their depths.
Classic command-style turn-based battles. The key to good battle strategy is to form your party to take advantage of each Lamia's characteristics, choosing from Lamias skilled at physical attacks to those specializing in magic attacks. Lead your Lamias to victory.
Not only will you find Lamias, but you'll also see Harpies, Fairies, and other familiar monsters complete with up-tempo*** conversations and stories in an enjoyable pixel art demon world.

The Lamia training system is scheduled to be released in Summer 2024, when Japan is scorching hot.

Don't miss the latest Lamia's Bambina ("LamiBam") information!

title: Respark
description:
게임 정보
The Ultimate Fireworks Roguelite!
Handheld sparklers, poppers, firecrackers, bottle rockets, and even skyrockets! In Respark, engage in thrilling and intense combat, using all kinds of hanabi (fireworks) to outsmart and overcome your enemies!




Each course is automatically and randomly generated. Not only will the terrain and enemies change, but the important items you find will also differ with each playthrough. Your choices shape your adventure!
Set in the whimsical world of Animalia, where animals have formed a civilized society, Respark offers a dazzling experience. The charming visuals combined with AAAA's catchy and wonderful background music create a joyous gaming journey for both newcomers and seasoned players.
To give you a taste of Respark's magic, we've prepared a special demo! Out of the 8 worlds in the full game, you can explore World 1, 4, and 7! While the demo doesn’t include the storyline or the save/load feature, you’ll still get to experience the thrill of reaching the final phase. Can you conquer the boss of World 7?

Note: The demo version supports keyboard and mouse operation only.

title: Trials of Cascadia
description:
게임 정보


As the son of a farmer, Isaac had always dreamt of one day becoming a Paladin like the Chosen Hero, Zvarus. A man whose bravery was legendary and who stood down in the face of no foe. After a year of training with Orman's father Orlan, a retired Paladin general, Isaac sets off with his sword and holy book alongside his friend to vanquish the forces of Darkness that beset the world.

But not all is as it seems on the surface. Those who presume to speak in the name of justice may abuse their power, while those who commit heinous acts may do so out of perceived necessity. Sometimes, even certain facets of history are conveniently omitted. But the truth is out there waiting to be found, as the friends soon find out. Will they do the right thing, or play it safe? Only time will tell.





-A story-focused RPG. Explore Cascadia in an unfolding narrative to discover the world's true story, that spans multiple continents, and possibly multiple dimensions

-Custom artwork to bring the game alive with a vivid watercolor aesthetic

-Custom sound and meditative, emotional music reminiscent of 90's JRPGs

-A plethora of items and equipment to discover

-Special Artifacts that can empower your entire party

-Optional side quests strewn throughout the world map that may increase your reputation

-Playable with controller, keyboard or mouse





-A charming cast of unique characters, each with their own stories, roles, abilities and skill augments. Mix and match for your favorite group

-Build TP with normal attacks, and then spend them on flashy spells and specials. Gain Pwr with damage or healing to boost your morale

-Delay enemy actions and cancel spells altogether with instant cast skills

-Use elemental debuffs from offensive magic spells to stack weaknesses on your enemy

-Unleash devastating 5 TP ultimate attacks

-Over 50 different enemies for you to encounter, including rare enemies (and even some friendly encounters)











A new recruit to the Paladin order, Isaac is eager to prove himself to his superiors and make his parents proud. What he lacks in experience, he makes up for in talent.
Isaac is able to heal the party and cure various debuffs, but he can also dish out massive damage using his Light-based abilities such as Lumina Blade. He has a higher critical chance than others.




Isaac's best friend from a young age. Although somewhat boisterous and headstrong, Orman has the heart of a hero. He doesn't always like to follow the rules.
Orman is able to protect the party by drawing the enemy's attention and blocking physical attacks with his shield. He excels at interrupting spells and has several defensive utilities up his sleeve.




A mysterious and proud elven girl with pink hair, she is able to wield the power of the elements. Although her motives are unclear, she seems to have peaceful intentions.
Aiya can't take as much abuse as the Paladins, but she has the highest damage potential. When using her magic spells, she can also gain enchantments for her dagger, which can be stacked for exponential damage amounts.




An eccentric man who claims to be an oracle, and hundreds of years old. He claims to guide the party towards their destiny, but his past remains obscured.
Mondrus is a hybrid between a healer and a caster. He can cast nature spells which make the enemy more vulnerable or restore the party and apply shields. While his spells are cheaper to cast, they take a short time to recharge.

title: Drop Point
description:
게임 정보
Drop Point, is an open-world survival PvPvE game that caters to a variety of play styles.
Whether you're a farmer, a fearless bandit, or a resourceful survivor, the game's sandbox environment gives you the freedom to forge your own path.
It's a blend of open-world exploration, survival, RPG, military-sim, action, looters, shooters, and farming elements. The story is in your hands.
Build Bases
Strategically design and build fortified bases to defend your territory against rival players and hostile creatures.
Farm Resources
Gather resources from the environment to craft tools, weapons, buildings and fortifications. In this ever-evolving battleground, your creativity and survival skills will be your greatest allies.

title: Ravenous Horde
description:
게임 정보
총 64명의 플레이어와 팀을 이루어 이 아포칼립스의 FPS 세상에서 좀비 무리에 맞서 싸우거나 또는 반대로 좀비 무리에 들어가 살아 있는 생존자들을 공격하세요! 팀원들을 기습 공격하여 팀원들을 분열시킬 수도 있습니다. 레벨을 올리고 새로운 무기, 특전 시스템, 의상 옵션 등을 언락하여 사용해 보세요! 마음에 드는 무장을 장착하고 전투에 참여하세요!
특전
원하는 방식으로 플레이해 보세요! 특전을 사용하면 원하는 대로 게임을 플레이할 수 있습니다. 50개 이상의 특전을 사용하여 공격 또는 방어로 플레이하거나 동료 헌터들을 도울 수 있습니다. 좀비 캐릭터에 대한 특전도 선택하여, 더 많은 신체 부위를 던질 수도 있으며 피해를 줄일 수도 있고 헌터들의 속도를 늦춰 좀비 친구들도 물릴 수 있도록 할 수 있습니다!

title: Driving Life
description:
게임 정보
Driving Life
Welcome to Driving Life, a hardcore driving and survival experience set in the heart of rural America. Stranded on a remote island with barely any money, you’ll have to scrape by, taking on driving jobs, managing expenses, and surviving on whatever cheap food and drinks you can afford.
With a realistic driving model, manual transmissions, and a variety of vehicles to operate, Driving Life is a true test of skill and endurance. From small personal cars to minivans and even heavy-duty trucks, every vehicle demands mastery as you navigate the island’s winding roads, dirt trails, and ferry routes.
Features:
🚗 Realistic Driving Mechanics – Manual transmission, clutch control, and varied vehicle handling.
🚐 Diverse Vehicles – Drive everything from compact cars to massive trucks.
💰 Hardcore Economy – Earn just enough to survive… if you play it smart.
🏨 Island Life – Stay in a rundown motel, pay rent weekly, and work odd jobs.
🛠 Resource Management – Keep your car fueled, your stomach full, and your debts paid.
🚢 Ferry Routes – Transport tourists and goods between terminals to earn cash.
🥫 Survival on a Budget – Eat cheap meals, drink what you can afford, and don’t blow your last dollar on a flashy car.
Your adventure begins in a modest motel, where the owner might call you for work—driving a van to pick up tourists from the ferry. You’ll start with a clunky manual car, but if you manage your money wisely, you might just afford an upgrade. Be warned: every decision matters. Miss a rent payment? Run out of gas? Go broke? You’re in trouble.
Think you have what it takes to survive behind the wheel?

title: Sacred Constellars: Ruin Raiders
description:
게임 정보
Ruin Raiders, a daring few who risk everything to explore ancient second-era tombs. With the promise of great rewards, they unearth relics of immense power, remnants of a bygone era. The Church of Eion strives to secure these artifacts, sealing them away in heavily guarded vaults. Yet, some relics slip through, disrupting the status quo. This is one such story....
Charming 2D Pixel Art Style.
Master tactics to overcome many battles.
Unique boss fights that are more than just HP sponges or enemies that simply hit harder.
Interact with a fleshed out and unique world that melds fantasy and elements of science fiction.
Create bonds with your fellow party members. Up to twelve interesting characters.
20+ hour story rich role playing campaign.

title: Hyper Drill
description:
게임 정보
Hyper Drill은 초고속으로 날아가는 스피드런 러닝 게임입니다. 장애물을 드릴로 뚫고, 타이밍을 잘 맞추고, 레벨 배치에 대해 알아가고, 서로 다른 은하계를 뛰어넘으세요.

title: Breath of Space
description:
게임 정보
STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/GameplayGif_03.gif[/img]

Breath of Space는 3인칭 슈팅 게임, 로그라이트, 로그라이크 장르의 요소를 결합한 액션으로 가득 찬 비디오 게임입니다. 이 게임은 광활한 Aegea Space Mining Facility를 배경으로 하며, 여기에서 다양한 위협에 맞서 싸우고 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하여 더 진행해야 합니다. 그러나 로봇 동료가 저장 파일을 운반하고 죽으면 모든 진행 상황이 손실됩니다. 따라서 경계를 늦추지 말고 동료를 살려두어 진행 상황을 그대로 유지해야 합니다.
로그라이크 또는 로그라이트
게임 내 플레이 스타일은 로봇 동료인 네페스가 죽었을 때 행동하는 방식에 영향을 미칩니다. 네페스를 위한 세 가지 자세 중에서 선택할 수 있으며, 더 위험한 자세를 선택할수록 네페스가 더 강해집니다. 그러나 플레이 스타일이 공격적일수록 모든 진행 상황을 잃을 확률이 높아집니다. 네페스가 죽으면 죽을 때 진행 상황이 초기화되니 조심하세요!

에게 우주 채굴 시설
모든 방이 독특한 시련과 기회를 선사하는 광활한 우주 채굴 시설로 여행을 떠나세요. 다양한 업그레이드, 리소스 및 수정 사항을 사용하여 게임을 탐색하고 당신을 기다리고 있는 진화하는 도전에 적응하십시오. 시설에 더 깊이 파고들수록 판돈이 증가하여 더 큰 보상과 함께 더 큰 위험을 제공합니다.

브레스 오브 스페이스에서 우주 요원이 되어 위험한 임무를 수행하세요. 연방의 번영을 위한 희망의 등대인 에게해 우주 채굴 시설이 미지의 존재에 의해 침략당합니다. 그러나 시설이 공격받고 핵심 인물인 Uzay의 아버지가 사라지자 시설을 되찾기 위한 위험한 임무에 투입됩니다. 다른 요원들과 마찬가지로 어려운 도전에 직면하고 임무 성공에 실패하게 됩니다.

미지의 지역을 탐험하고, 강력한 적과 싸우고, 연방의 운명을 결정하세요. 시설을 구하고 아버지가 남긴 비밀을 밝혀낼 수 있을까요? 이 스릴 넘치는 모험에서 이야기는 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다.
패배는 시작에 불과한 혁신적인 재탄생 시스템을 경험하세요. 동료 드로이드 네페스의 힘을 활용하여 다시 일어서고 한계를 뛰어넘어 새로운 능력과 전략을 잠금 해제하세요.
패시브, 지원, 공격의 세 가지 모드에서 네페스를 지휘하세요. 네페스의 다재다능한 기술을 활용하여 자신만의 스타일로 도전에 대처하며 즉석에서 적응하세요.
"Qouise" 자원 시스템으로 위험과 보상 사이의 미세한 경계를 탐색하세요. 현재 달리기를 위해 임시 업그레이드에 투자할지 아니면 영구적인 발전을 위해 자원을 축적할지 결정하여 장기 전략을 수립하세요.
다양한 슈트 업그레이드, 무기 강화, 네페스 개조로 우자이의 여정을 커스터마이징하세요. 이러한 요소들을 전략적으로 조합하여 독특한 플레이 스타일을 만들고 앞에 놓인 도전을 극복하세요.
에게 연합 연합에서 영감을 받아 세심하게 제작된 세계에 빠져보세요. 문화, 요리, 건축물이 조화롭게 어우러진 세계를 탐험하며 분열되어 있지만 서로 연결된 우주의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

title: Constance
description:
게임 정보

페인트로 변화하기
페인트 기반 메커니즘을 활용하여 지속적인 흐름 상태를 경험하세요 - 땅과 벽에 다이빙하고 공중과 적을 가르며 이동하세요!
붓 휘두르기
붓을 이용하여 새로운 기술을 해제하여 적을 물리치고 위협적인 상황을 극복하며 플랫폼 도전 과제를 해결하고 진행하세요.


스스로를 발견하기
콘스탄스의 비선형 연결된 내부 세계에서 여섯 개 이상의 독특한 생태구, 무수한 비밀, 다양한 경로, 캐릭터, 부가 퀘스트 및 수집품을 탐험하세요!
균형을 추구하다
붓 기술을 사용하면 페인트가 오염됩니다. 만약 완전히 오염되면 부정적인 효과가 기다리니 주의하세요!
여행 중 발견한 영감을 일기에 스케치하세요. 스케치는 콘스탄스의 능력을 향상시키고 맞춤화합니다. 소재를 모아 스케치를 더 강력한 아트워크로 업그레이드할 수 있습니다.
죽은 후에 여정을 어떻게 계속할지 선택하세요. 도전을 계속하기 원하면 가격이 붙습니다. 아니면 안전 지점으로 돌아가서 다른 미정평을 탐험하세요?
내부 세계는 콘스탄스의 정신적인 건강 여정과 강하게 연결되어 있으며, 각 생태구와 그 독특한 적 및 캐릭터는 그녀의 심리와 개인적인 역사의 다른 측면을 나타냅니다.
개인적인 투쟁, 창의성, 업무-생활 균형, 내적 목적에 관한 할 수 있는 플래시백을 경험하세요. 콘스탄스의 신발을 신어 그녀의 과거를 알아내세요!

title: pan gaia
description:
게임 정보
pan·gaia is a relaxed sandbox game about the whole Earth, featuring abstract, nostalgic graphics, and a rich, open-ended model of the planetary dynamics that shape our world.
Sculpt the Winds and Steer the Currents
Suspended in space, driven by the vast energy of the Sun, your planet swirls with winds and currents of immense power. They are yours to guide, and shape your planet's climate - if you dare.

Can you bring the monsoon to the deserts? Or... will you end up melting the ice caps?
A Whole-Earth Garden
It's a trilobite-eat-trilobite world. From the simplest cyanobacteria to the tiger at your throat, everyone's out to win the game of Natural Selection. Strike a balance between plant and animal, predator and prey, and build your planet's ecology. But whatever you do... be good to the fungi.

There are dozens of predefined species at your disposal to fill, exploit, and dominate every ecological niche. And if there is no pleasing you, then evolve one of your own.
Step Into the Unknown
Your planet has its own, relaxed logic, measured in centuries and millennia. But life can't stay in the cradle forever. Will you take the leap and set one of your species on the path to sapience?

Are you prepared to guide them through the long, perilous journey from animal to Antiquity? And is your planet prepared for the power they will wield, and the dreams they'll have?
The Science
Inspired by Maxis' 1990 SimEarth, and its legendary capture of deep ecological theory in a "software toy", pan·gaia draws on methods and algorithms from established research circulation models, like UVic EMBM, MOM5, and DieCAST. It simulates the Earth system (or other planets, if you want) as a set of interconnected spheres:
The atmosphere, the envelope of air and moisture that stretches from the ground to space, that circulates from the Tropics to the Poles in jetstreams and hurricanes, that nourishes forests and scours away at mountains.
The hydrosphere, your planet's water - from the smallest stream to the vast ocean deep - turning over in cycles from days to millennia, and mediating all life on earth.



Everything - the sea, the sky, the rock, the living things - pulls and pushes on everything else. Your world is not just a silent rock or a pale blue dot - it's alive!

title: Alpine Lake
description:
게임 정보
If you're a fan of Stardew Valley, The Sims, or Animal Crossing, Alpine Lake is the perfect cozy getaway for you.



Shape your inn from the ground up by designing and constructing buildings entirely from scratch. Your imagination sets the limits – create any layout you can envision!



Every guest arrives with their own personality and narrative. Extend a warm welcome, provide them a cozy haven, and unravel the stories they carry within.



Embark on a journey through an expansive alpine region, uncovering hidden treasures and valuable resources. Bring along your faithful canine companion for a hike and see what buried goodies you might unearth along the way!



Engage with a lively community of townspeople, each with their own unique stories. Support your neighbors by sending your guests to local businesses, adding to the collective growth of the town.



Cultivate your own farm to harvest top-notch ingredients, ensuring delightful meals for your guests. Enhance your culinary expertise by upgrading your kitchen and mastering an expanding assortment of recipes acquired on your journey! You may even build, decorate, and open your restaurant on your property for the best eating experience you can provide for your guests!



Lose yourself in one of the many relaxing activities, such as fishing, photography, and crafting.

title: ELDRIMAR
description:
게임 정보
ELDRIMAR is a blend of genres, Action/RPG/Adventure and Survival horror. The game tells a grim story in a dark fantasy setting.In the Kingdom of Eldrimar, a schism occurred, as necromancers rose up against the mages and took over the great city of Tier, destroying all living things and turning people into undead. The situation was seized upon by Lord Azator, the leader of the Alir race, who were once banished to lower worlds by humans long ago. The game's main character is Saron, a warrior of Azator, who has been trained since childhood for invasion. His task is to open the great portal and bring his people back to their homeland of Eldrimar. But it won't be easy as he is alone, and enemies are everywhere.

Dark and grim fantasy atmosphere
Melee combat
Crossbows
Magic
Leveling up
A well-thought-out system of enemy armor and damage
Puzzles
Diverse enemies

ELDRIMAR is the backstory of the Eternal Evil universe:

You can start with any game. ELDRIMAR - past times in a fantasy theme. Eternal Evil - our days.

title: Primal Planet
description:
게임 정보
프라이멀 플래닛은 단독 개발자에 의해 만들어진 게임으로, 생존 및 제작 요소를 픽셀 완벽한 미학과 액션 넘치는 스토리와 결합하며, 이 모든 것이 공룡으로 가득 찬 울창한 행성에서 펼쳐집니다.
이야기를 발견하십시오.
가족을 보호하기 위해 싸우는 동굴 거주민의 매혹적인 이야기를 따라가는 스릴 넘치는 여정에 올라타세요. 잔인한 티렉스 공격을 생존하고, 야생의 세계와 과학 소설적 요소가 어우러진 흥미로운 이야기를 발견하세요. 외계인 존재의 미스터리를 풀어가며 예상치 못한 동맹을 형성하세요.

적응하고 살아남으세요.
야생에서의 생존은 영리함을 요구합니다. 천연 자원을 이용해 필수 도구, 무기, 치유 및 보호용 혼합물을 제작하세요. 경험을 쌓고 기술을 업그레이드하여 원시 행성의 무수한 위험을 극복하세요.

고유 한 도전과 비밀이 있는 다양한 생태계를 발견하십시오. 밀림, 펼쳐진 평원, 교활한 산맥 및 위험이 기다리는 신비한 바다 심층 지역을 가로 지르세요. 매혹적인 아파토사우루스에서 무서운 카르노타우루스까지 다양한 공룡을 만나보세요.

전투와 전략을 결합한 게임 플레이를 경험하십시오. 고대 생물과 외계인에 대처하기 위해 적응하세요. 전술을 맞추고 제작 된 무기, 미끼, 함정 및 은밀함을 사용하여 일반적인 보스 적들과의 만남을 마스터하세요. 모든 대면은 당신의 기술과 교활함을 시험합니다.

친구와 함께 로컬 협동 모드에서 팀을 이뤄 플레이하세요. 두 번째 플레이어는 언제든지 민첩한 시노사우로프테릭스, 충실한 동반자인 시노로 참여할 수 있습니다. 함께 장애물을 극복하고, 퍼즐을 해결하며, 적들과의 싸움에서 유대감을 강화하고 기술을 향상시키며 시노가 강력하고 충성스러운 친구로 성장하게 하세요.



프라이멀 플래닛에서, 동굴 거주민에서 행성의 마지막 희망으로의 여정은 위험과 경이와 가족의 불가분의 유대로 가득합니다. 도전에 대비하셨습니까?

title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
description:
게임 정보
안타깝게도 본 게임은 현재로서는 한국어 지원이 되지 않습니다. 하지만 한국 게이머들의 소망에 따라 수시 조정할 예정이오니 너무 걱정 안하셔도 됩니다. 불편 끼친점 진심으로 사과드리며 여러분의 성원과 사랑에 감사드립니다!
새로운 시작을 서사하는 로그라이크 액션RPG에 흠뻑 빠져보세요. 여러분을 포함한 주민들은 외딴 마을 트레스나에 빈털터리 신세로 조난되었습니다. 이제 엉덩이에 묻은 먼지를 털고 일어나 여러분의 누추한 가게를 마을 경제 활동의 심장으로 탈바꿈할 시간입니다. 위험천만한 던전을 탐험하며 유물을 수집하고 판매하세요. 여기서 벌어들인 돈을 친구들이 운영하는 시설에 재투자하고, 새로운 무기, 갑옷, 상점 장식을 잠금 해제하세요. 고생 끝에 낙이 온다는 옛말의 중요성을 몸소 확인해 보세요.
배낭은 단단히 메고 무기는 날카롭게 벼리세요. 새로운 부를 찾아 미지의 세계로 모험을 떠날 시간입니다. 힘든 모험일수록 더 큰 보물이 기다리고 있습니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 욕심이 커지면 모든 것을 잃을 위험도 커지는 법이니까요.

title: Anseion - Fantasy MMORPG
description:
게임 정보
ANSEION
Welcome to the extraordinary world of Anseion, where you decide which side you will stand on - good or evil. Choose your nation and start a great adventure! Fight against players of the opposing faction and monsters. Explore Anseion in search of new challenges and treasures.
CRAFTING
Collect valuable items, obtain raw materials and make new tools. Upgrade your equipment to strengthen your character and gain an advantage over your enemies.
PVP FIGHTS
PvP battles play a big role in Anseion. Fight against players from your own or the opposing nation. Advance in the rankings, becoming one of the most powerful players. Participate in cyclic battles between cities, where your skill and strategy will determine victory.

title: Rogue Jungle
description:
게임 정보
An Action-Roguelike set in a procedurally generated jungle!
The game world is procedurally generated and offers an unlimited experience! Fight and explore your way through this jungle and improve your skill with each run!



Upgrade your weapons and unlock new abilities!
After every fight, you can upgrade your wepon or unlock a new ability to build a unique moveset in each run!



Epic boss fights at the end of each run!
Face a big boss enemy after every run to escape the jungle!

title: Lost Hellden
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Era, where every life comes with a price
Every Eran is bound to one of the Seven Deadly Sins before their first birthday
All their lives, people fight against their urges
A place in the Sacred Land of Hellden is promised to their immortal souls if they succeed
But if they fail and succumb to their Sin
A fate worse than death awaits them…

Lost Hellden is a unique hand painted JRPG from Artisan Studios.

Take control of 8 unique highly customizable characters through an epic mature story where the 7 Deadly Sins guide your fate.

Witness a new Deep 2D technology allowing you to play in 3D in hand painted artworks with dynamic lighting and weather.

Introducing a battle system mixing action and strategy to allow you to play the way you like.

title: Dr. Emmerson's Nocturnes
description:
게임 정보
""(...) 그리고 무서운 이야기들은 수세기 동안 인간과 함께 동행해왔습니다. 이야기에는 다양한 얼굴과 형태가 존재하죠. 그러나 이 이야기들이 존재하는 목적은 무엇일까요? 어째서 인간은 공포에 몸서리를 치는 와중에도 이런 무서운 이야기들을 즐기는 것일까요? 치료 세션 중에, 저는 (...)""
(Dr. Emmerson의 클리닉 전단에서 인용)
문학을 대화형 매체에 도입한 독창적인 접근 방식을 만나보십시오
기묘한 소설과 장대한 공포 명작의 세계로 뛰어드십시오. 그들의 저자들을 전적으로 존중하여 창조된 완전한 무삭제판에서 이 세계를 경험하십시오.
Dr. Emmerson의 야상곡은 실시간 3D로 된 100% 더빙 소설형 게임 컬렉션입니다. 만약 이 컨셉에 관심이 있다면, 저희는 여러분이 유명한 Cthulhu Mythos와 연결된 Dagon - H. P. Lovecraft의 첫 번째 이야기의 완전 무료 각색 버전을 확인해보시기를 권장합니다:

title: METRO PENGUIN EUTOPIA
description:
게임 정보


About This Game:
METRO PENGUIN EUTOPIA is a game depicting the exploits of ""Penguin Head"" Balm as she is unavoidably pulled into a spiral of violence surrounding penguins and the city of Sapporopolis. What fate awaits her? Only the player can decide. Behold, foolish penguins! The light of truth shall be shed on your eutopia of lies!

Hokkaido has been transformed into a barren wasteland all due to the Penguin Comet that plunged the land into an eternal blizzard. The city of Sapporopolis formed underground as a means of escaping danger. Rarely ever does the city come in contact with the outside world, causing it to grow a culture all of its own.

The vast underground space of Sapporopolis is split into the Upper Layer, where its citizens reside, and the Lower Layer, abandoned mid-construction. At some point, blood-thirsty penguins appeared in the Lower Layer, assaulting citizens and building their nests.

Our heroine Balm becomes an accidental hero when she dons a headdress in the form of a penguin: the Penguin Head. Alongside her accomplice Renade, she fights the murderous penguins day and night for the safety of the city’s people.

Game Features:
・Penguin hunting that begins in the idyllic city of Sapporopolis
Due to the destruction of a mysterious train responsible for birthing the penguins that dwell in Sapporopolis' Lower Layer, you are now able to travel between the city's two layers. In the Upper Layer reside the citizens of Sapporopolis, with diverse views and ways of thinking, along with three alliances operating out of their own objectives. Each of these alliances will surely lend Balm and her comrade a helping hand...out of certain motives, of course.

・Tendency parameters that decide the heroine's fate
The story's heroine Balm has three measures that reflect her tendencies: Order, Exploration, and Violence. These measures are called "tendency parameters" and increase based on the player's actions. The parameters come with level and skill points and can be used to acquire new skills, with the maximum value of each parameter referenced in Balm's actions. The player's actions decide Balm's fate.

・Turn-based battles and skills
Battles with the murderous penguins are turn-based. The lone Balm faces off against multiple penguins at once, so her attacks must be as accurate and powerful as possible. With the tendency parameters you obtain through your actions, you can help Balm gain new powers and unlock her skill tree. What skills and powers Balm builds is up to you.

・Multiple endings
Rumors of blood-thirsty penguins running rampant in Sapporopolis' Lower Layer begin to spread among the citizens. The relationship between Balm and the Three Alliances—a pivotal presence to both the city and penguins—may very well influence the outcome of the story. Solve the mystery surrounding these strange, ferocious penguins and the city regarded as a paradise by outsiders, Sapporopolis.

title: ISLANDERS: New Shores
description:
게임 정보


사랑받는 미니멀리스트 도시 건설 프랜차이즈의 다음 장이 도착했습니다. 아일랜더스: 새로운 해안이 확장된 게임플레이, 아름다운 비주얼, 원작의 매력을 기반으로 한 다양한 새 기능으로 재해석된 평화로운 창의성의 세계로 여러분을 초대합니다.

오랜 팬은 물론 새로운 팬 여러분 모두 전에 없던 새로운 방식으로 탐험하고 건설하고 전략을 세울 준비를 해주세요.
50개의 독특한 레벨에서 꿈에 그리던 도시를 건설하세요
6가지의 다양한 생물 군계에서 44개 이상의 건물 유형을 만나보세요. 각 건물 유형에는 4가지의 화사한 색상을 적용할 수 있어 원하는 대로 전략을 세우고 진정으로 유일무이한 도시를 만들어 낼 수 있습니다.

플레이 모드를 선택하세요. 고득점 모드를 선택하여 경쟁적인 반전을 이끌어 내거나, 샌드박스 모드를 선택하여 창의성의 날개를 펼쳐보세요.

새로운 기능을 갖춘 세계를 경험하세요
사진 모드 - 마음대로 적용할 수 있는 필터와 턴테이블 카메라를 사용하여 직접 건설한 아름다운 섬의 사진을 찍고 공유하세요.

- 건설 모험에 완벽한 분위기를 더하는 75분 분량의 오리지널 음악을 감상하세요.

- 시야, 거리 보너스, 섬 간 전략과 같은 혁신적인 득점 방식을 마스터하여 게임플레이 경험을 향상시키세요.

- 게임을 진행하며 독특한 전략적 이점을 제공하는 일회용 파워업을 잠금 해제하세요.

- 이제 스트리머 여러분은 게임에 내장된 상호작용형 기능을 통해 시청자와 직접 소통할 수 있습니다.

아일랜더스: 새로운 해안은 미니멀리스트의 미학을 완전히 재해석하여 심오하고 전략적인 게임플레이를 보완하는 시각적 향연을 선보입니다. 휴식을 취하든, 건설 실력을 시험하든, 새로운 해안은 모두 창의성을 펼칠 수 있는 새하얀 캔버스가 됩니다.
- 두 가지 모드: 고득점 및 샌드박스(별도 저장)
- 44개의 독특한 건물 유형, 7개의 섬 속성
- 무한한 다양성을 제공하는 50개의 동적 섬 생성기
- 필터 및 턴테이블 카메라를 갖춘 사진 모드
- 75분 분량의 몰입감 넘치는 오리지널 음악
- 부스터: 새로운 일회용 파워업으로 전략적인 게임플레이
- 영리한 전술을 보상하는 고급 득점 시스템
- Twitch 통합으로 상호작용형 스트리밍 경험

아일랜더스: 새로운 해안에서는 모든 섬이 새로운 모험이며, 모든 도전이 특별한 창조물을 만드는 기회가 됩니다.

title: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
description:
게임 정보
Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game set in the stunning city of Eriksholm. When Hanna’s brother, Herman, disappears and the police begin to pursue him, her search sets off a chain of catastrophic events that will not only alter their lives but also the destiny of the entire city. Join your allies, outsmart relentless enemies, and use your cunning to uncover the truth behind Herman’s disappearance — where greater powers are at play than you ever imagined.
Follow Hanna’s adventure through the vibrant streets of Eriksholm, a sprawling Nordic city inspired by the elegance and grit of early 1900s Scandinavia. In this world, every shadow offers a hiding place, and every corner hides a new challenge. Allies and quick reflexes are your greatest tools as you unravel the city's secrets and outsmart your pursuers.
Join Hanna's adventure through Eriksholm on her quest to find her brother and uncover the mystery behind his disappearance. Venture into stunning landscapes in a gripping story where every second counts as Hanna strives to reunite her family.

title: Blackthorn Winter
description:
게임 정보
Hear me, warriors of winter's chill!
Blackthorn Winter calls you to a saga of shattered ice and twisted magic, where the heart of Slavic myths beats strong. Morena's curse has turned our world to frost and shadow; hearths grow cold, flames dance with death's green light, and trees crumble under the ice's cruel embrace.



Take your hammer, your wit, and your courage. Alone or with your brothers and sisters in arms, fight through the frozen wastelands and dark dungeons. Awaken Vesna's spirit, shatter Morena's chains, and let the seasons turn once more. This is our quest, our battle, our story. Will you answer the call?



Stand valiant, alone or amidst comrades in arms, in local or networked battles where unity triumphs over rivalry. Overcome a land where each attempt by brave heroes is met with unexpected twists and elements of surprise. Venture through a realm where every new adventure reshapes the land, drawing ever nearer to the cryptic Baba Yaga. It is she, cloaked in enigma, who may bestow the key to Morena’s sanctum for the ultimate showdown.



Plunge into the depths of dungeons, where a tabletop perspective lets you strategically choose your battles and challenges in a classic setting. Tread thoughtfully, deciding whether to engage fearsome beasts, uncover arcane spells within the dusty pages of forgotten tomes, or face the enigmatic Monolith—a test of your mettle that reflects the core virtues of the game: Praise, Salvation, and Honor.



In this shadowed land, every step is a dance with danger as the insidious Lurker creeps ever nearer, urging haste in your dungeon delve. Yet, caution beckons, for only the well-prepared dare to descend into the abyss. Each choice, each encounter weaves the fabric of a tale thick with tension, cloaking your quest in an aura of otherworldly enigma.


Forge a strong partnership as you progress, making crucial decisions together to build complementary skillsets. Work in unison to maximize your strengths and overcome the challenges that lie ahead in your quest to defeat Morena.



Elementals are versatile and resourceful spellcasters who command the raw power of the elements, shaping them into devastating spells and transformative abilities.
The core of an Elemental's power lies in their passive effects that do not require resources at the start. As they grow stronger, these passive abilities evolve into fearsome active spells that can turn the tide of battle.
Whether focusing on frosty spells to slow and debilitate enemies, or fiery AoE abilities that engulf the battlefield in flames, Elementalists are adaptable and creative, making them a formidable force in any situation.





The Huntress is characterized by her deadly precision and ability to deal massive damage, often at great personal risk. She excels at using her weapons to even out the playing field.
The combination of ranged attacks, critical hits, and agility make her a versatile and exciting choice.
She is a lone wolf, preferring to work alone rather than as part of a team. She is fiercely independent and self-reliant, and her abilities reflect this.





Summoners are enigmatic and powerful warlocks who harness the dark arts and ancient rituals to bend the forces of nature and the spirit world to their will.
With unique abilities centered around sacrificing resources to gain the upper hand on the battlefield, they overwhelm their enemies with numerous summoned minions and disable foes through the use of dark magic.
Drawing from the traditions of seers and necromancers, Summoners are often seen as mysterious figures. They are masters of manipulation, using their knowledge of the spirit realm to control powerful familiars and command the forces of darkness.





Wardens are highly skilled and dedicated individuals who have sworn to protect and defend their allies and the innocent, often at great personal risk.
Wardens excel at defense and support. They are able to use their specialized skills and abilities to protect their allies, heal their wounds, and enhance their combat abilities.
Wardens are stoic, disciplined, and selfless. They are willing to put themselves in harm's way to protect others, and are often seen as the embodiment of honor and duty.





As you delve into this treacherous journey, remember that only the bravest and most disciplined adventurers can hope to conquer the ever-changing challenges brought forth by the procedural generation of content. Each run presents a new and unique experience, testing your wits and resolve in this unyielding battle against the forces of darkness. May fortune favor you, valiant warrior, as you strive to restore balance and vanquish the icy grip of Morena's curse.
company: Dercetech SRL, Jérémie Mercier, Sasa Jovanovic

title: Neo Junk City
description:
게임 정보
네오 정크 시티에 오신 것을 환영합니다
네온 불빛이 결코 꺼지지 않고, 도시의 어두운 이면이 살아 숨 쉬는 곳. 디스토피아적 세계관인 ‘가라앉은 도시(Drowned City)’를 배경으로 펼쳐지는 이 몰입형 사이버펑크 어드벤처는 기존 포인트 앤드 클릭 장르에 신선함을 더합니다. 반쯤 물에 잠긴 메가시티를 누비며 살인 사건을 수사하고, 위험천만한 거리에서 질주하며, 로봇과 정신이상자, 사이보그 괴물 무리를 총격전으로 돌파하게 됩니다.
주요 특징
몰입감 넘치는 스토리
Buster 09가 되어 가라앉은 도시를 누비며 살인 사건의 진상을 밝히세요. 단, 문제는 범인이 이미 ‘나’라는 사실을 알고 있지만, 왜 그런 짓을 저질렀는지 기억나지 않는다는 것입니다.
동적 상호작용 시스템
탐험 범위와 캐릭터 간 관계에 따라 변화하는 ‘상호작용 블록’을 활용해, 전통적인 포인트 앤드 클릭 방식을 한 단계 발전시킨 새로운 게임플레이를 경험하세요.

title: Frenemies
description:
게임 정보
Frenemies는 최대 10명의 플레이어가 무인도에 갇히게 되어 궁극적인 생존과 배신의 시험을 치르는 귀여운 멀티플레이어 게임입니다. 인기 TV 쇼 서바이버(Survivor)에서 영감을 받은 사회적 속임수 게임에서 기지를 건설하고, 동맹을 맺고, 전투를 벌여 최후의 플레이어가 되어보세요.
섬을 탐험하고 농사, 공예, 요리, 낚시 등을 배우는 방법을 알아보세요. 기지를 건설하고 퀘스트를 완료하여 새로운 섬에 보금자리를 마련하는 데 도움을 주세요.
닭 포획, 해적 총격전, 눈덩이 대혼란, 빨간불 초록불, 소품 사냥 등을 포함한 다양한 섬과 게임 모드에서 면역을 위한 전투를 벌이세요.

title: As One We Survive
description:
게임 정보


As One We Survive is a top-down survival game set in a post-apocalyptic America. Step into the shoes of a father as he tries to find help for his sick daughter during a grid down post-pandemic event. Fight, scavenge, craft, and gather resources for your family's survival.

Using a unique blend of survival and colony management mechanics, you will have to form a community both to survive and find help for your daughter. Build and manage your community, protect your people from danger, and make tough decisions that will determine the fate of your group in a harsh and unforgiving world.



Challenging Survival: Scavenge, craft, and outsmart the harsh wilderness in a dangerous world with scarce resources.
Unforgiving Combat: No health packs; use bandages to stop bleeding, sleep to heal injuries, and maintain weapons for reliability.
Community Management: Join a survivor community, upgrade your base with facilities, and create renewable resources to support your people.
NPC Companions: Form bonds with fellow survivors while scavenging for vital supplies and getting to know your community.
Skill Progression: Hone survival skills in the wilderness, improve with every challenge, and master the art of survival.

title: Angeline Era
description:
게임 정보
안녕하세요, 개발자인 멜로스와 마리나입니다. 잊지 못할 야생 충돌 베기 액션 어드벤쳐를 만든 장본인이죠! 오늘 저희 캐릭터들이 본 게임을 소개해드리려고 합니다.
충돌베기는 쉽지만... 만용은 안 됩니다!
인간 모험가 테츠: 내 이름은 테츠 키노시타! 충돌베기술 연마에만 오랜 세월을 바쳤지. 적과 부딪치기만 하면 자동으로 공격할 수 있다는 말씀! (이스 시리즈의 팬들은 명심하라고!) 아주 빠른 템포니까 금세 배울 수 있을 거야!
페이족 공주 니암: 하하하하!! 우리 테츠... 사람들에게 헛된 희망을 불어넣으면 어떡해? 페이의 정령인 "멜로스"가 우리의 고대 비밀을 지키기 위해 사악하고도 우스꽝스런 계략을 잔뜩 준비했거든! 뭐, 그래도 너에게 감사 인사는 해야겠지! 아무것도 모르는 플레이어들이 당할 고초를 생각하기만 해도 가슴이 부풀어오르니까 말이야!
company: Melos Han-Tani, Marina Kittaka, Analgesic Productions

title: Half Sword
description:
게임 정보
Half Sword에 오신 것을 환영합니다
Half Sword는 몰입감 넘치는 물리 기반 중세 전투 시뮬레이션 게임으로, 평민이었던 기사가 되어 15세기 유럽의 잔혹한 토너먼트에서 전투해야 하는 독특한 경험을 선사합니다. 혁신적인 게임플레이 메커니즘 덕분에 마우스를 사용해 무기를 정확하게 휘두르면서 정상에 올라서기 위한 치열한 격전을 치르고, 강력한 적에 맞서 싸우는 스릴을 맛볼 수 있습니다.
정확한 역사적 고증을 바탕으로 섬세하게 제작한 무기와 갑옷 컬렉션과 함께, 풍성한 이야기가 펼쳐지는 역사 속으로 푹 빠져들어 보세요. 역사 속에서 등장하는 다양하고도 강렬한 방어구를 통해 플레이어는 과거를 직접 경험하는 듯한 기분을 느낄 수 있습니다.
용맹을 증명하세요
다양한 난투와 토너먼트에서 상대를 이기고 아레나의 챔피언이 되어보세요. 모든 동작이 큰 영향을 미치는, 비할 데 없는 전투 경험에 대비하세요. 모든 동작과 조종은 최대한 현실감을 살리는 데에 기반을 두고 세심하게 설계되었습니다.
HEMA(유럽 역사 무술) 전문가와 검술사의 전문 지식과 피드백을 바탕으로 제작된 전투 시스템 덕분에 플레이어는 게임 내에서 무기를 실제적으로 제어할 수 있습니다. 이 역동적인 시스템을 통해 플레이어는 정교한 검술에 푹 빠져들어, 게임 속 전투 메커니즘의 기술을 배우게 됩니다.
유혈이 낭자한 전투에서 살아남아 명성과 부를 얻고, 새로운 장비를 구매하거나 본인의 전투 스타일에 딱 맞는 방어구와 무기를 제련해 보세요. 자신감이 느껴지신다고요? 자신의 승리에 베팅해 잠재적인 수익을 늘리고 더 멀리 전진하세요.

title: Corsairs - Battle of the Caribbean
description:
게임 정보

사략선을 조종하여 조국을 위해 부와 명성을 획득하세요. 거친 바다를 항해하고 강력한 함대를 형성하여, 영화를 방불케 하는 해전을 펼치세요.
앤틸리스 제도의 이국적인 섬을 탐험하며 보물을 찾고 카리브해의 패권을 장악하세요. 프랑스, 덴마크, 스페인, 영국, 그리고 네덜란드까지, 강력한 해군력을 자랑하는 국가를 선택하세요.

조국을 위해 해적선을 지휘하세요!

전략적인 전투와 관리 지향적 게임플레이로 함대를 지능적으로 관리하고 거래 장소를 보호하세요. 신규 병사와 확장된 캠페인 모드로 몰입도 높은 경험을 선사합니다.


특징

12대의 함선과 각각 고유한 능력이 있는 세 종류의 탄환으로 치열한 해상 전투를 펼치세요.
개선된 거래 메커니즘을 이용하고 함대와 도시를 지능적으로 관리하여 거래 장소를 보호하고 해상 장악력을 높이세요.
퀘스트 완료, 적 격파, 새로운 영토 탐험을 통해 자원을 획득하여, 함선을 업그레이드하고 승무원을 강화하세요.
autokwd: Corsairs - Battle of the Caribbean,커세어: 배틀 오브 캐리비언 Corsairs - Battle of the Caribbean

title: World of Anterra
description:
게임 정보


World of Anterra is an epic non-linear, open-world role playing adventure. The game features a handcrafted open world, deep progression systems, fast paced combat, and rich lore, all wrapped in a satisfying and tactile interface. It’s the type of game only an independent studio could make!
