The protagonist Shizuku sets out for the altar in the sky to check on the whereabouts of his friend Ame, who has gone missing after a certain ritual. Will Shizuku be able to find Ame again and return home?

title: Hours After Midnight
description:
게임 정보
Hours After Midnight is a game where you take control of one of the heroes who swore their revenge on Rettam'diov - the Consumer of Worlds for their fallen homelands. Survive everything your enemy throws at you in this roguelike survival adventure! Collect gold, find new allies, craft and upgrade your powers, and destroy all the evil that haunts your new home!

title: DESPA
description:
게임 정보
KILL. DIE. REBOOT.
It’s time for bravery, carnage, and adrenaline-fueled action. Welcome to DESPA — a no-nonsense, full-throttle first-person arena shooter where violence is the only language that matters.
It’s a post-cyberpunk Colosseum where androids battle for dominance in brutal, intensive showdowns. No fluff. No filler. Just you, your weapons, and the fight.
KEY FEATURES
METAL, SPARKS AND MAYHEM
No-holds-barred combat in wrestling-style battles where every hit feels personal.
Post-cyberpunk fields are built for destruction. Fight. Dominate. Survive.
Arenas are designed for skill, not luck; master the battleground or be crushed.
POST-CYBERPUNK SHOOTER—PURE AND RAW
No distractions. No hand-holding. Just war.
Brutal gunplay & visceral melee combat: you feel every blow, every kill.
Pure adrenaline. Harsh action. The arena shooter you crave.
UNLEASH THE ULTIMATE ULTRAVIOLENCE
No guilt. No rules. Just destruction.
No morality. No consequences. Just pure mechanical carnage.
Drench the world in machine oil because androids don’t bleed.

title: Amerta
description:
게임 정보
Amerta is a dark, narrative-driven side scrolling games . The game it's all about time. What happened in the past will affect the future. You will be trapped in a recurring time to solve challenging puzzles. Avoid dangerous creatures to avoid death.
Synopsis
When the world is covered by a mist, it creates chaos throughout the world. Besides making living things mutate, the mist affects space and time, making things worse. In the midst of the chaos, you are trapped in time and trying to break free from it.
Meet with Eon
Eon is a tough, brave girl trapped in an apocalyptic situation caused by a mysterious mist that blankets the world. The mist has mutated living creatures and disrupted the fabric of time, creating chaos and danger at every turn. Eon finds herself stuck in a recurring time loop, trying to solve the mysteries of this warped reality and escape from the endless cycle. Though she's caught in this unpredictable world, Eon refuses to be defeated
Features
Challenging Puzzle Related to Time
Sprint, Grab, Jump

title: Hardcube 2
description:
게임 정보
Sequel to the original 2016 game. A simple meditative platformer with nice graphics and a pleasant soundtrack. New levels and new biomes.
Go through levels filled with unique traps for each biome. Collect as many points and Collection items as possible. The game is made in the best traditions of the much-loved  original.
Unique and manually created levels, where there are several paths to the finish, and only you can decide which path to choose: dangerous, but with a good reward, or safe, but with a lesser reward. Unique traps for each biome.

title: Light In Blood
description:
게임 정보
Light In Blood is a thrilling asymmetric action-horror game that immerses you in a dark world where fears and sins battle for dominance. In tense 1v4 matches, you’ll choose to play as a horrifying nightmare or a survivor with unique abilities, creating a dynamic and strategic gameplay experience.

Backstory:

In Light In Blood, survivors are people in comas who lived lives filled with good deeds but also committed grave sins. They are given a final chance to either return to life by winning the competition or remain forever in the shadows. Each nightmare embodies the fears and sins of the survivors' pasts.
Key Features:

Unique Characters: Each character has distinct abilities that influence their play style. Characters are balanced to ensure fair and competitive gameplay.
Interactive Maps: Maps have a base layout with randomly spawned windows, blocked walls, electrical panels, and generators. These elements create new tactical opportunities and affect strategy in each match.
Voice Chat and Pings: Coordinate with your team using voice chat and pings for effective communication. Use commands like “come here,” “I’m going there,” “rescue him,” “help,” “I see the nightmare,” “found a generator,” and “found a panel.”
Competitive and Casual Modes: Light In Blood offers both a competitive mode with a ranking and title system and a casual mode for a more relaxed gameplay experience.
Gameplay:
Immerse yourself in Light In Blood, where you can play as a nightmare aiming to hunt down survivors or as a survivor striving to complete objectives and find a way to escape. Each match requires strategic thinking and quick reactions to either win or survive in challenging conditions.
For Whom:
Light In Blood is perfect for fans of action and horror games looking for new tactical challenges and an immersive atmosphere. If you enjoy intense games with survival and strategy elements, Light In Blood offers countless thrilling moments.

title: Wonderland Quest
description:
게임 정보


Wonderland Quest is a casual point & click adventure game. Travel across Wonderland teeming with colorful challenges, surprises and creatures, brought to life with beautiful artwork.
Join our protagonist Adam the magician on his journey through Wonderland! Let's get back to Medieval Ages, everything is possible here!



Help Adam solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, save ladies from the goblin, majestic evil eagle, dukes and rats! Be eaten by a two-headed giant frog and escape alive! Explore the castle, dungeons of hell, and heights of the heaven, walk through magical forests filled with strange creatures, take a hot air balloon and fly up to the mountains…
… and be rewarded! Guide Adam till the end, save the gorgeous princess from the evil eagle and become a prince of Wonderland!
Logic puzzles, animated intros and cut scenes – everything is combined into one story. Everything is carefully 100% hand drawn.

What are you waiting for? Adventures await you!

title: Axom: Conquest
description:
게임 정보
Axom: Conquest is a base building resource managing tower defense game set on the dangerous planet named Axom.
Gather resources to build defenses, unlock research between games to get stronger and ultimately unlock the secrets of the mysterious planet.
Features
Infinitely repayable procedurally generated levels - Each mission is different
Build your base - Construct towers, walls and hazards to defend your all important Nexus Drill from the hoards of Centurax trying to destroy it!
Wave based combat - Prepare and build in advance, then start the Nexus Drill, alerting all enemies in the area. Each wave the challenge grows stronger until you are ultimately defeated.
Gather resources - Gather from the ground, build refineries on resource nodes scattered around the map, but defend them well to keep your income stream safe!
Upgrade and research - Every building can be upgraded to vastly improve it's performance. Complete upgrades at research buildings to keep up with the ever growing threat of the Centurax
Every game you get stronger - Collect research while in game to complete research aboard your ship which provide permanent advantages for each subsequent game

title: Her Name
description:
게임 정보
A platform and puzzle game, "Her Name" will offer you to solve its puzzles by making your character progress at the same time as a mysterious bead on its tracks.

Days follow each other and look alike in this bleak world where routine afflicts the player in a tasteless and endless vicious circle. Until one day, a warmer aura appears in the dreary life of our character.
But before being able to approach this young woman, the player will have to overcome his fears, his anxieties and his apprehensions through his nightmares. Will a love story manage to hatch between these two souls?

Alternate between dreams and reality. Discover the anxieties and apprehensions of your character through his nightmares. Jump from platform to platform, activate levers and other buttons, push mysterious glowing cubes and trigger the hidden mechanisms of your subconscious. The riddles of your mind are just waiting to be solved...

title: Anti-Sane
description:
게임 정보
What is this forgotten world?
You are lost in a strange and unsettling universe. Try to stay sane as you navigate eerie creatures and mysterious places.
Solve puzzles using your ability to possess objects
Uncover the secrets of the protagonist’s past as the story unfolds
Enjoy adorable pixel art with a dark twist
Don't be afraid of being alone. Be afraid of what’s lurking around you.

title: England in London
description:
게임 정보

Help the ungrateful, feel the indifference and play minigames.
Take control of Mark England, a celebrity with a few screws loose, and go on a search for his missing firewire cables. Guide him through London, Ontario as you meet the residents, collect items and take on challenges.
FEATURES
Side-Scrolling 2d with unique visuals
Featuring weird looking art, hand drawn animation and an ambient score for when you truly want to be left alone.

Minimalistic User Interface
Simple and accessible controls help keep you focused and immersed in the surrealist city of London, Ontario.

Carefully handmade
No NFTs, AI-generated bullshit or asset flip guarantee! I'd buy that for a dollar!

title: Rhythm Storm
description:
게임 정보
게임 개요
Rhythm Storm은 리듬감 넘치는 요소로 가득한 로그라이크 호드 서바이벌 슈터(또는 불렛 헤븐) 게임입니다 플레이어는 움직임 제어 및 두 가지의 특별 기능을 사용하여 비행물체를 자동으로 조준하고 사격합니다 비행물체를 선택하고, 최초 구성과 기능을 설정한 후 게임을 시작하면 됩니다 게임을 진행하면 적들이 업그레이드 파워업 아이템을 떨어뜨리며, 이 아이템을 획득할 시 두 가지 방식으로 비행물체의 능력이 강화됩니다 플레이어를 제외한 게임 세계의 모든 요소는 리듬에 맞춰 움직이며, 곡이 끝날 때까지 살아남아야 합니다



텍스처 없는 벡터 그래픽
Rhythm Storm은 무텍스처 라인과 폴리곤만을 렌더링합니다 비주얼 효과 구현에는 텍스처 없이 후처리 효과만 사용되었으며, 이는 화면 캡처만 텍스처로 사용됨을 의미합니다 이를 통해 한눈에 봐도 그래픽이 선명하고 경계가 자연스러우며다른 게임과 비교할 수 없는 높은 해상도를 자랑합니다 더 나은 게임 경험을 위해 새로 고침 속도가 120hz 이상인 1440p 이상의 모니터로 플레이할 것––을 강력 권장합니다. [1080p/60hz로 게임을 플레이하는 것도 좋지만 이상적인 수준에는 미치지 못하죠

리듬감 있는 플레이
Rhythm Storm은 음악을 조합한 게임이지만 기존의 리듬 게임과는 다릅니다 비행물체의 움직임을 제외한 게임 내 다른 모든 요소가 배경 음악의 리듬과 정확히 일치합니다 보통 배경 음악의 8마디마다 파동이 바뀌고, 파워업과 게임 세계는 그러한 파동에 맞추어 움직이며 동적인 선, 원, 스테퍼 장애물을 생성합니다. UI는 박자에 맞추어 움직이며, 무엇보다도 모든 적 또한 박자에 맞추어 움직이며 장애물을 발사합니다 격파 역시 박자에 맞추어 이루어집니다 박자에 따라 파워와 기능을 활성화할 수 있기 때문에 플레이어는 성취감을 느끼게 됩니다. 하지만 이기기 위해 기능을 꼭 활성화할 필요는 없으며, 또한 반드시 음악적 재능이 있어야 하거나, 박자와 싱크를 맞추어야 하는 것은 아닙니다

불렛 헤븐/몰려드는 적으로부터 살아남기
구조적으로 본다면 Rhythm Storm은 다른 불렛 헤븐이나 쇄도하는 적/호드로부터 생존해야 하는 다른 게임과 비슷하게 느껴질 수 있습니다 게임의 장르 이름을 꼭 규정할 필요는 없지만 Rhythm Storm의 경우 불렛 헤븐이라는 장르가 가장 적절하다고 생각합니다 Rhythm Storm은 비교적 최근에 도입된 이 장르의 일부 규칙을 따르기는 하지만, 게임에 더 적절한 기능과 행동을 구현하기 위해 그 일부를 변형하기도 합니다 예를 들어, 적을 파괴할 시 XP가 자동으로 획득되지만, 대신 드론을 생성하거나 파워를 사용하는 데 에너지가 소모되어 에너지 수치가 감소합니다 업그레이드는 자동이 아니기 때문에 업그레이드 파워업을 획득해야 합니다 이에 따라 음악이 끊기더라도 당황스럽지 않고 만족스러운 느낌을 줍니다

게임플레이 트레일러 마지막에 잠깐 나온 것처럼 음악 중단의 가장 중요한 역할은 녹화 및 앙코르 업데이트를 하는 것입니다 데모를 끝냈거나 비행물체가 파괴되었거나에 상관없이 게임이 종료되고 나면, 해당 판에서 선택하여 업그레이드한 목록 전체가 저장되어 다음 판에서도 자동으로 사용할 수 있게 됩니다 앙코르 시 업그레이드 화면이 보이지는 않지만, 자동으로 업그레이드가 진행됩니다. 어떤 업그레이드가 추가되었는지는 추후 확인할 수 있습니다 이후 나타날 앙코르 업그레이드는 또한 일시 중지 메뉴에 표시되기도 합니다 해당 메뉴에서 언제든 다시 앙코르를 종료할 수도 있습니다 이후 (또는 앙코르 선택 항목을 모두 사용한 경우) 수동 업그레이드로 전환됩니다 게임을 즐기기 위해 꼭 이 기능을 사용해야 하는 것은 아니지만 앙코르 업그레이드를 사용하면 게임의 성능을 어느 정도 강화할 수 있습니다


Rhythm Storm의 알파 데모는 게이머들의 관심을 끌고 확인하기 위한 게임의 사전(그러나 업그레이드된) 빌드 버전입니다 데모 버전에도 다양한 콘텐츠가 포함되어 있으나, 정식 버전에는 훨씬 더 많은 요소가 추가됩니다 데모 버전에는 한 종류의 세계에 네 종류의 비행물체가 등장하지만, 정식 게임에서는 세 종류 이상의 세계(비행물체 유지/진행 중 업그레이드를 위해 순서대로 플레이)와 열 가지 이상의 비행물체를 선택할 수 있습니다 정식 릴리즈에서는 기능, 파워, 무기, 적 유형, 업그레이드 등의 요소가 데모와는 비교할 수 없을 정도로 다양해집니다 또한 각 세계 최종판에서는 특별 보스도 만날 수 있습니다. 정식 게임에서는 파워/난이도의 균형도 조금 달라집니다

title: Call of the Golden Valley
description:
게임 정보
An unexpected turn of events has landed you, an American woman, in the mysterious Australian High Country searching for your missing friend.
Follow clues, solve puzzles, and delve into conspiracy theories to investigate not only her disappearance, but the strange and inexplicable mystery surrounding many missing hikers drawn to the mountains.
In the sleepy small town of Phillipston, your investigation must uncover clues using both good old-fashioned detective tricks combined with the modern-art of internet stalking. Follow the crumbs and get lost in the theories surrounding this mystery.
We respect your detective skills, so it’s all up to you to make the final logical leaps. Set the poetry in motion by linking your observations on your deduction board to ultimately reveal exactly what has transpired. A series of unrelated misadventures? Or something more sinister…
What would drive someone to venture alone into the harsh landscape of a country known for its deadly wilderness? Delve into the psychology of the characters to understand what they’ve done and why.

title: Eternal Mist
description:
게임 정보
"I know not with what weapons World War III will be fought, but World War IV will be fought with sticks and stones" - Albert Einstein.



Several generations have passed since the end of the Great War, and even deep old men cannot remember who first used forbidden spells. But once begun, there was no stopping them, and the land was swallowed by the Mist.

On the wreckage of the old world, a new world gradually emerged - divided into isolated islands and states. And only a few brave men dare to travel through the deadly expanse of mist. You are at the beginning of this journey, and where and how it will end depends only on you!



Eternal Mist is a game that involves real-time tactics where you will be in charge of commanding different types of squads including paladins, hunters, and mages. Each squad possesses unique skills that can be improved as you progress in the game.

Elements such as bonfires, cauldrons, and other objects on the battlefield have an impact on the abilities of your warriors. Placing your units near these objects can provide a significant tactical advantage.

The Mist is a source from which hordes of creatures emerge. These formidable beings represent a relentless force that poses a significant threat to all who cross their path. Their agility and speed allow them to swiftly traverse the terrain, making them a daunting challenge to overcome. Only a skilled commander can give confident and well-thought-out orders to inspire their soldiers and guide them towards victory.

title: Kritter
description:
게임 정보

Kritter은 탑다운 형식의 로그라이트 게임으로, 해킹 앤 슬래시 및 기지 건설 요소를 결합하고 있습니다. 혼자 플레이하거나 최대 4명의 온라인 플레이어와 함께 플레이할 수 있으며, 우주선을 적들로부터 방어하고 수리에 필요한 자원을 수집하는 것이 목표입니다.
당신의 크리터, 당신의 영웅
당신은 M.Ark, 당신의 우주선이 만든 전투 로봇인 크리터를 연기합니다. 당신은 당신의 크리터를 완전히 제어할 수 있습니다: 주무기, 중형 무기, 그리고 건물을 번갈아가며 M.Ark를 보호하고 이 적대적인 행성을 떠나려고 할 것입니다.
당신의 플레이 스타일을 선택하세요!

당신의 크리터는 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞게 적응합니다! 게임 플레이를 급격하게 변화시킬 수 있는 다양한 클래스 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다. 현재 게임에는 3가지 클래스가 있습니다:



게임 중에 몬스터들은 "파도"로 당신의 우주선을 향해 몰려옵니다. 각 파도를 버틸 때마다, 당신은 크리터를 발전시키는 보상을 받습니다. 공격 중 하나를 강화할 것인가요? 치료를 받을 것인가요? 더 많은 자원을 선택할 것인가요? 각 게임은 독특하며, 당신의 선택은 중요합니다.
몬스터 파도 사이에는 잠깐의 휴식 시간이 주어집니다. 이는 주변 환경을 탐험하여 방어 구조물을 건설하거나 크리터의 통계를 향상시키는 데 필요한 귀중한 자원을 수집할 수 있는 기회입니다. 그러나 주의하세요! 이 휴식은 짧을 것입니다! 항상 타이머를 주시하십시오. 타이머가 0이 되면... 다음 파도가 닥칠 것입니다. M.Ark를 무방비로 내버려 두지 마세요.
탐험과 방어가 끝나면 자원이 준비됩니다. 이제 이를 어떻게 사용할지 결정할 수 있습니다. 치명적인 함정을 만들 것인가요? 업그레이드 모듈을 건설할 것인가요? 다음 파도를 막기 위해 우주선 주변에 파괴적인 포탑을 설치할 것인가요?

당신의 노력에도 불구하고, 언젠가는 패배할 가능성이 매우 높습니다. 그럴 때에 M.Ark는 시간을 되돌리고, 당신을 다시 그의 조종석으로 데려가며 모든 것을 다시 해야 할 것입니다... 음, 거의 모든 것이요! 당신은 영혼의 결정을 사용하여 게임 간에 당신의 크리터 또는 M.Ark를 업그레이드할 수 있습니다! 이러한 주요 업그레이드는 당신의 삶을 쉽게 만들어줄 것입니다: M.Ark 주변에 방패를 추가하거나, 적이 어디서 오는지 알 수 있는 레이더를 설치하거나, 힘을 강화하거나, 자원을 증가시키거나, 생명력을 향상시키는 등... 선택의 폭이 매우 다양합니다!
Kritter는 시간의 이야기입니다. 패배하면 시간을 되돌리고, 플레이하면 시간과 맞서 싸웁니다... 이야기 자체가 이 시간적 혼돈 속에서 전개됩니다. M.Ark는 이야기의 서술자입니다... 그러나 M.Ark는 기억상실증에 시달립니다! 매 패배마다, 매 조종석 복귀마다 이야기가 진전됩니다. M.Ark가 여기에 있을 이유를 점차 기억하면서 진전됩니다.

Kritter는 여러 번의 죽음에 맞서야 하는 도전적인 게임입니다... 그렇다면 함께 이겨내는 것이 더 좋지 않을까요? 친구들을 초대하고 최대 4명의 플레이어로 팀을 구성하여 협동 플레이로 Kritter의 흥미진진한 이야기를 발견해 보세요!

title: Hypermarket Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Hypermarket Simulator is a cozy and immersive retail simulation game where you build, manage, and grow a massive shopping paradise that goes way beyond groceries.
Build the Ultimate One-Stop Shop
From electronics to sportswear, frozen food to home décor—design your dream hypermarket filled with everything under one roof. Customize the layout, choose your departments, and create a shopping experience your customers will love.
Master Inventory and Realism
Stock thousands of different products—but be smart! Frozen goods need to be stored properly or they'll go rancid and become unsellable. Organize your backroom storage, build custom stock areas, and manage your supply like a pro.
Embrace Automation
As your hypermarket grows, so does the chaos. Streamline your operations with self-checkout kiosks to handle crowds and keep customers happy. Invest wisely to balance speed and service quality.
Stock, Sell, and Strategize
Hand-pick what you sell, set prices, and track what’s flying off the shelves. Will you specialize in high-end electronics or become the go-to spot for home essentials? Your pricing strategy, shelf organization, and restocking speed will make or break your business.
Expand and Evolve
Start small, dream big. Use your profits to expand your floor space and unlock new product categories to keep your operation running smoothly. Turn your hypermarket into a retail empire with smart upgrades and customer-focused planning.

title: High School Dirty Secrets
description:
게임 정보
Trapped in a haunted high school, Kasuga must uncover buried secrets to escape the terror-filled halls.
                                       Kasuga, a popular student, wakes up to find herself inexplicably trapped inside her school after dark. The eerie silence and shadowy corridors are far removed from the bustling, lively atmosphere she knows. Worse yet, her memory of how she ended up there is a blank slate.
Desperate to escape, Kasuga begins exploring the seemingly abandoned building, only to encounter chilling phenomena. Cryptic text messages flood her smartphone. Strange entities begin to manifest.
Piece by piece, Kasuga must uncover the truth about her school, her peers, and even herself. But beware: nothing is as it seems, and some secrets are better left buried.
                          A Spine-Chilling Horror Adventure: Explore a haunted high school filled with eerie sights, cryptic clues, and unsettling twists that will keep you on edge.
Interactive Smartphone Gameplay: Use Kasuga's smartphone to log clues, capture photos, and receive unsettling messages as you unravel the mysteries surrounding her imprisonment.
Dynamic Perspective Switching: Experience the tension from every angle—switch seamlessly between 3rd and 1st person views to fully immerse yourself in the environment.
Anime-Style 3D Graphics: Dive into a world that combines stunning visuals with a deeply atmospheric setting, creating a perfect blend of beauty and dread.
Will you help Kasuga escape the nightmare... or will you succumb to it?

title: The Celestial Seeker
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic intergalactic adventure in this space faring Metroidvania! Irata, a skilled bounty hunter and unlikely hero, is tasked with saving the solar system from a menacing federation of hostile species. With your blaster and a thirst for adventure, explore three diverse planets filled with bounties, upgrades, civilizations, hidden secrets, and dangers.
Eons ago, the Eternium core, an advanced chipset with the power to link all intelligent systems, was created in a last-ditch attempt to ward off the first coup of power organized by the Federation. Moments before defeat, the planetary alliance activated the Divine Architect, a sentient artificial intelligence that was designed to control the Eternium core.
The war was won but, in its wake, left a thirst for power. It was no longer just the federation that wanted control. Insiders within the planetary alliance from all corners of the solar system tried their hands at gaining control.
It was then, that the leaders of the 3 planets agreed to give the Eternium core its last instructions, to separate in 6 and have its pieces be spread equally across the planets.
Peace was restored. The legend of the Eternium Core faded to myth. And the Divine Architect laid dormant. Until now.

title: Brink of War
description:
게임 정보
Brink of War is a fast-paced and realistic first person shooter (FPS) game. Its realistic graphics, intense and fast combat experience can make everyone feel the excitement of confrontation. In this game, you can team up with friends to fight against enemies and compete for victory.

Realistic visuals: Brink of War utilizes advanced graphics engine technology to present players with a realistic battlefield environment. The terrain, weather, and lighting effects in the game can all provide players with an immersive experience.

Diversified weapons and equipment: The game offers a wide selection of weapons and equipment, including pistols, rifles, sniper rifles, submachine guns, and more. Players can choose suitable weapons and equipment according to their preferences and combat styles, modify firearms to improve various parameters, and dominate the battlefield

Game mode: The game features multiple competitive game modes, such as team death fighting, random weapons, and percentage points, and sets maps with different rhythms. Players can team up with friends to participate in competitions and showcase teamwork and tactical strategies.

Faster paced battles: The game emphasizes a fast-paced and realistic combat experience, where players need to make quick decisions on the battlefield, flexibly use various skills and tactics, and defeat enemies.

https://bfw.framer.ai/

Ranking and Achievement System: The game has a leaderboard where players can compete with other players for honors. Providing players with rich achievements and stimulating their competitive desire.

Regular updates and activities: The development team (i.e. me) will regularly update the game content, introduce new maps, weapons, and modes to keep players fresh at all times. At the same time, various activities will be held within the game to bring more benefits and challenges to players.

In short, Brink of War is an FPS game full of competitive passion and realism, suitable for players who enjoy fast-paced battles and teamwork. In this game, you will experience the fun of fighting alongside friends, challenging yourself, and achieving glory!

title: GOMAN -stuck in the avici hell
description:
게임 정보
GOMAN은 이름 없는 지옥을 배경으로 한 횡스크롤 액션 게임입니다.

어떤 이유로 지옥에 던져진 주인공 가몬이 지옥에서 탈출해 역으로 탈출을 시도합니다.

그는 지옥의 여러 층을 지배하며 탈출을 막으려는 '누시와 그 하인들'과 맞서 싸워야 합니다.

강한 개성을 가진 누시들이 만든 세계에서 탈출을 시도하는 사람은 죽임을 당하고 입구로 되돌아가 끝없는 형벌을 받습니다.

가몬이 가진 유일한 무기는 그가 죽기 전에 얻은 특성인 '무한한 저항 = 깨지지 않는 마음'입니다.

가몬은 수만 번 죽임을 당하고 돌아와도 포기하지 않고 걸음을 멈추지 않으며 누시에게 계속 도전합니다.

적의 강한 일격에 반격하여 격퇴하고, 때로는 죽었다가 돌아오기도 하지만 죽었을 때의 기억을 이용해 적의 공격을 읽고 반격합니다.

title: Idle Space War
description:
게임 정보
About the Game:
Idle Space War is an idle simulation game set in the vast reaches of space. Players upgrade their spaceships, explore uncharted planets, and gather valuable resources along the way. Progress continues even when the game is closed, making it perfect for busy players who want to enjoy the game at their own pace. While combat elements are present, the game focuses on customization and growth, offering a relaxing yet deeply engaging experience with plenty of content to explore.
Details:
• Spaceship Upgrades: Add new modules and equipment to build your own unique spaceship. Enhance its performance to explore distant planets and unlock new adventures.
• Idle Resource Collection: Resources are automatically gathered even when you’re not playing. Simply log in periodically to collect rewards and watch your spaceship evolve.
• Planet Exploration: Visit a variety of planets and develop strategies to adapt to their unique environments. Each planet holds rare resources and hidden treasures to discover.
• Easy Controls: Simple, intuitive interface that allows even beginners to jump in and start playing right away.
Key Features:
• Immersive space experience with captivating visuals
• Extensive upgrade options to tailor gameplay to your style
• A perfect blend of idle gameplay simplicity and in-depth progression
• In-game goals and achievement systems to keep you motivated
Take your spaceship and embark on an epic journey through the vast universe, discovering uncharted planets and hidden treasures along the way!

title: Hold Your Breath
description:
게임 정보
Survive in a post-apocalyptic world
Breathe if you can...






⚔️ Fight against bandits, cultists, military, psychos, and animals.
🗺️ Explore the open world and uncover its mysteries.
🔍 Find a home that will become your shelter and arrange it.
🏕️ Survive by gathering resources and provisions.
🛠️ Craft weapons, resources, medicines, and supplies.
🎯 Hunt diverse wildlife.

A vast world awaits you, ripe for exploration not just for air, but also for other vital resources: food, water, weapons, and armor. Players can follow different narrative paths, from mere survival to interacting with bandits and uncovering the secrets of this devastated world.



Survival is the cornerstone of the gameplay. Players need to adapt to harsh conditions, securing food, water, and shelter while crafting weapons and armor to protect against wild animals, bandits, and other unknown threats.

Danger lurks at every corner in this world. Lack of air, radioactive zones, aggressive creatures, and hostile groups can all lead to your demise. Beyond physical threats, players encounter moral dilemmas that can alter the course of the story and the outcome of their survival.



In "HOLD YOUR BREATH," players are continually faced with the choice between risk and potential reward. Is it worth venturing into danger for valuable resources? Should you trust strangers? Each decision you make could have long-term implications.



Dive into the world of "HOLD YOUR BREATH" if you're ready to confront a reality where every breath could be your last. The choice is yours: fight for every liter of air or succumb and become yet another victim of this ruthless world.

title: Astoaria
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey alone or with friends in this fractured world of floating islands. Thrive by strategically exploiting diverse ecosystems and climates, while surviving, exploring and uncovering the mysteries of this world.
Exploration
Explore a vast world of floating islands, delving into caves to unearth rare minerals unique to each ecosystem. Discover ancient desert ruins, scavenge remnants of airships, and forgotten machinery and structures as you unravel the secrets of a once-thriving civilization.
Exploit Ecosystems and Climates
Strategically optimize farming, resource gathering, and energy production by analyzing islands and considering island-specific factors like wind and solar intensity, minerality index, terrain fertility, temperature, and humidity.

title: You Can't Scare Me
description:
게임 정보
넌 날 겁줄 수 없음 (You Can’t Scare Me)은 소셜 유령 하우스 파티 게임으로, 친구들을 만나 겁을 주려고 하면 그들이 소리를 지르면 점수를 얻게 됩니다! 점프 공포증이든 웃음이든 어느 쪽이든 즐거운 시간입니다!
두 팀이 있습니다: 한터들은 공포 덫과 의상을 사용하여 헌티드를 겁주려고 합니다. 그들은 모두를 보고 들을 수 있습니다. 헌티드는 열쇠를 수집하고 비명을 지르지 않으려고 노력합니다. 헌터는 들을 수 있지만 몬스터로 보이지 않으면 볼 수 없습니다!
50개의 공포 트랩에는 다양한 몬스터, 소리, 특수 효과가 있으며, 공통적으로 많은 두려움이 있습니다!
저택, 묘지, 병원, 박람회 등 8개 층을 방문하세요. 빠른 공포를 위해 작은 맵을 플레이하거나 메가 매치를 위해 큰 맵을 플레이하세요. 각각 멀티플레이어를 위한 잠금 해제 가능한 코스튬이 있습니다!
멀티플레이어는 메타 친구를 소환하여 플레이하는 가장 흥미로운 게임입니다. 인간과 대결할 때, 다음에 어떤 일이 일어날지 알 수 없습니다! 싱글 플레이어를 사용하면 무작위 트랩 레이아웃을 플레이할 수 있습니다. 이를 사용하여 맵을 공부하면 트랩을 배치하기에 가장 좋은 장소를 알 수 있습니다. 파티 모드를 사용하면 트랩을 설치한 다음 헤드셋을 친구에게 전달하여 플레이할 수 있습니다.

title: Star Head
description:

Overview
Master the art of split limbs in this chaotic action-adventure where your head and body become instruments of mayhem. Harness magnetic powers to amplify your control while creating devastating attacks or clever diversions. Whether you're a precision head-shot specialist or a tactical mastermind, every challenge is an opportunity to express your style.
This Isn't Your Normal Platformer
Two points of control. Infinite possibilities. Star Head turns platforming into a symphony of coordinated chaos. Launch your head to clear paths while your body handles platforming challenges. Execute perfect teleports to reunite your split form at crucial moments. Chain magnetic powers between your two points to amplify your effectiveness. Create your own solutions - from aggressive dual-point attacks to cunning tactical separations.
A Journey Beyond Logic
Guide QT, a head-launching android with a rebellious streak, through a world where reality bends in unexpected ways. From abandoned military bases to mysterious cities, you'll face corrupted machines, mutated creatures, and bizarre adversaries who'll push your abilities to their limits. Each environment challenges you to master your unique powers as you search for answers about QT's creator. The Star Head rocket holds secrets - if you can overcome the chaos that stands in your way.

title: Sanguinite
description:
게임 정보
Sanguinite is a lunar-lander-meets-twin-stick-shooter action game with elements of resource management and exploration. Visit the surface of alien planets using remotely operated drones, searching for resources and artifacts to bring back to your ship. Encounter hostile forces with your initially under-equipped hardware. Research advanced alien technology and integrate it into your own while you investigate the nature and origin of the aliens you encounter.

Faced with global annihilation, humanity was able to unite long enough to execute the Exodus projects. Colony ships filled with passengers in stasis undertook centuries long journeys to escape. Specially designed Envoy vessels were sent far ahead of the colonists to scout and secure potential new homes, each operated by a single pilot. This is your task. Equipped with a fleet of standard issue Beryl drones and a universal fabricator to maintain them, you will conduct exploratory surface missions to acquire resources and investigate your target system. In the unlikely event of a hostile encounter, you will need to improvise. Your Envoy is primarily a scientific and industrial vessel, after all.

title: Quadphos
description:
게임 정보
Quadphos is a grid-based rule deduction logic puzzle game.
Each puzzle consists of a grid and several numerical clues. Your goal is to light up the cells to satisfy all the numerical clues.
The symbols next to the numbers represent the specific rules that these clues follow. For example, a number might indicate the number of lit cells within its range.
The game doesn't directly tell you these rules. You'll need to deduce and verify their meanings through a series of levels. As you solve puzzles, you'll continually refine your guesses, or even discard them entirely, until you discover a more exciting perspective.
Once you grasp the new rules, you can tackle more complex puzzles and enjoy the challenge of combining multiple rules for a greater difficulty.
Features
20+ unique and engaging rules
600+ handcrafted puzzles
Each puzzle has a single solution

title: Sashimi Hearts
description:
게임 정보
Sashimi Hearts is a 3D dating sim Inspired by food service visual novels, sunken 2000s sci-fi, and 90's dating sims, Work at a rooftop restaurant and find love amidst a long-submerged city.
Features
A handcrafted low res 3D visual style built to evoke the most vibrant, colorful PSX and DS games.
A whopping 3 fish (girls) that you can smooch! No more being escorted out of the aquarium by security!
Alter the story with the food you make. Talk is cheap, so serve dishes your customers are truly looking for to bond with them.
Work at a restaurant in flooded future to learn about the myriad ways people have survived the rising seas.
Story
As a quiet, heartbroken culinary graduate, What was going to a celebration in paradise has turned into a disaster!
You've ended up shipwrecked in the sunken cities of the Mahina Sea. In order to pay off your boat ticket home, you'll work a quiet little restaurant on the roof of a submerged building.
There, three local girls will befriend you. Serve them the right food, and they'll tell you more of themselves.
Perhaps, if you listen well, the gentle tides will wash away your broken heart before the summer ends...

title: Apocalypse Survivors
description:
게임 정보
이 글로벌 바이러스 대유행 시대에 당신은 인류의 미래 희망인 “알파” 계획의 다음 세대 인간입니다. 당신은 좀비 물결의 최전선에 배치되어 인류의 생존 희망을 다시금 불태우기 위해 나섭니다.
긴 스토리 라인도, 반복되는 인트로 애니메이션도 없습니다. 이 모험 가득한 포스트-아포칼립틱 세계로 들어서세요. 당신이 가장 좋아하는 캐릭터를 선택하고, 선호하는 무기를 들고 나서세요! 이 게임은 누구나 즐길 수 있는 게임입니다.perienced player든 초보자든 상관없이 이동, 선택, 결정만으로 생존의 지속적인 즐거움을 체험할 수 있습니다.
당신은 다양한 스킬과 서포트 스킬을 갖춘 외로운 영웅입니다. 당신이 가장 좋아하는 캐릭터에 집중할 수 있으며, 그들의 장비를 교체하고 최종 능력을.Unlock할 수 있습니다. 장비를 어떻게 조합하고 당신만의 선호하는 플레이스타일을 찾느냐가 이 포스트-아포칼립틱 세계에서 각个人에게 제시하는 도전입니다.
그는 침착한 전사입니다. 그는 칼, 권총, 돌격소총을 사용하는 데 뛰어나며, 시공의 틈을 통해 획득한 어둠의 힘으로 칼로 독특한 기술을 시전할 수 있습니다.

title: Moon Drop Miners
description:
게임 정보
Moon Drop Miners is a high stakes roguelite puzzle resource manager all about building and balancing your mining rig in the gritty frontier of space.


Build and Balance
Slam down structures and watch your resource numbers rise or plummet. Every structure you drop can boost intake or push your rig to the brink of collapse. It’s all about fine tuning Energy and Stability to keep your rig operational and your moon in one piece.
Strategic Placement: Each structure has unique benefits and risks, gaining bonuses or penalties for their place in your rig.
Chain Reactions: Clever layouts can trigger powerful synergies or disastrous meltdowns.
Energy Stability Tug of War: Power your structures without letting Stability drop below critical levels, or risk catastrophic failure.
Survive and Optimize
Race against the clock to meet your quotas. Balance short term survival with long term growth, maximizing your gains without risking total shutdown.
Rising Quotas: Collect enough Celestium or lose your contract for good.
Risk vs. Reward: Push your rig to the limit but know when to pull back.
Adaptive Strategy: Reevaluate your approach as quotas rise and cosmic storms throw a wrench in your plans.
Upgrade and Expand
Earn cash and discover new ways to power up your rig. From game altering unlocks to specialized satellites, every improvement helps you delve deeper, gather more, and meet your next quota.
Satellite Support: Equip specialized orbiters that grant unique bonuses and triggers that dramatically alter how you build your rig.
Unleash Your Potential: Combine upgrades to create unstoppable mining synergies.
Unlock More Options: Between runs unlock more structures to build and moons to mine.
Key Features
Endless Replayability: Each contract offers fresh challenges, ensuring no two mining shifts are ever the same.

title: Zima
description:
게임 정보
                                                                                Zima is a cozy RPG that plunges you into a relentless unnatural winter. As you delve into ancient temples to combat a growing corruption, you’ll unravel the mysterious legacy of who you are and what your purpose is. Prepare to uncover secrets buried deep within the Sacred Temples and uncover your true identity.

In Zima you play as a fierce and stubborn young woman determined to protect her home, and the secrets that lie beneath... Within the Sacred Temples you will fight your way through corrupted enemies and forgotten temple guardians using action combat and skill based dodging all while avoiding traps meant to keep intruders out! 
Your arsenal will include unique melee and ranged weapons that can be upgraded using currency gathered within the temples.
Each temple contains hidden rooms with materials essential for upgrading items in your home, so be sure to explore thoroughly!
Upgrade choices provide unique buffs, allowing customization of your survival strategy.
Most importantly, The Sacred Flame is your lifeline — you'll need to gather Living Coal found within the temples to maintain it and should you fail... winter will consume your home, wreaking havoc.

title: Carthage: Bellum Punicum
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by the renowned YouTube channel HistoryMarche, Carthage: Bellum Punicum brings historical battles to life with a focus on strategic depth and authenticity.
Featuring a distinct visual style that combines military symbols with historical battlemaps, the game delivers an immersive experience where every detail of ancient warfare comes to life. Morale, stamina, terrain, and supply lines all play a crucial role—just like they did on the battlefields of history.
HISTORICAL BATTLES
Relive iconic clashes like Cannae, Trasimene, and Trebia, fought on meticulously crafted battlemaps based on detailed historical sources, bringing the intensity and precision of ancient warfare to life.

title: CorAstral
description:
게임 정보
Face countless perils in this fast paced runner where timing and reflexes are everything. Dodge obstacles or slash them with your sword. Perform aerial acrobatics to overcome more challenging sections.
Control Polaris, a powerful and agile warrior that must reach the Core of his world as soon as possible, where he will face a terrible menace.

title: Specters of the Deep
description:
게임 정보
In life, you were a legendary hero. Now, you'll rise from the grave as a ghost to defend your country in its hour of greatest need! Defy dragons, duel the dead, and face the nightmare at the bottom of the sea!
Specters of the Deep is an interactive epic fantasy novel by Abigail C. Trevor, author of Heroes of Myth and Stars Arisen. It's entirely text-based, 1 million words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects, fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
Centuries ago, you were the finest warrior that the island nation of Galdrin had ever known. The realm was strong and prosperous, upheld by the might of the Eye of the Serpent, a magical artifact bonded to the monarch—and by your might, too. You protected the people and defended the crown; when the dragons emerged from their seclusion, you won the honor of being the king’s emissary to them and forged a powerful alliance.  
Then, you fell in battle at the hands of your greatest rival, dead before your time. 
But now you awake, called forth from your tomb to save the realm from even greater peril. With your new spectral form come new powers: the ability to pass through solid walls and float high above the earth, command over other ghosts, and the potential to strike fear into the hearts of the living. You will need every bit of that power in this new age of crisis. The royal family is shattered and divided, with the young king clinging to scraps of his former power while his connection to the Eye of the Serpent hangs in the balance. Anti-monarchist rebels shout in the streets and political rivals seek to extend their power across the sea. Galdrin’s neighboring nation lies beneath the waves, sunk by cataclysmic earthquakes. Worst of all, the mighty dragons are withdrawing from the alliance you built centuries ago, and you may be the only one who can win them back. 
What’s more, you aren't the only specter on Galdrin's shores. There's an army of ghosts crawling out of the water, tearing at the foundations of the castle. Sometimes, you can hear the voice that commands them. Something is waiting at the bottom of the ocean—and it wants you back.
If Galdrin is to survive, you must rise as its hero once more, and join an epic battle for the Eye of the Serpent, power over the ocean, and the realm itself.
Play as male, female, or non-binary; gay, straight, bisexual, monogamous, polyamorous, asexual, and/or aromantic
Battle enemies old and new as a ghost, commanding spectral armies and passing invisibly through walls, and inspiring dread in the hearts of your foes.

title: VMX
description:
게임 정보
Novel Controls:
VMX utilizes advanced VR controls and a custom physics system to deliver precise, true-to-life bike handling. Tricks are performed entirely through your physical gestures, creating an authentic and immersive riding experience that mirrors real life.
Multiplayer :
VMX features a multiplayer mode where you can ride with friends, explore maps together, and participate in competitive challenges. Whether you're practicing tricks in freeride sessions or competing for the best scores, multiplayer adds a new dimension to the experience.
(More about game modes coming soon).
Customization :
VMX features a highly realistic spray painting system for vehicle customization. Simply grab a spray can in your preferred color and spray away. Beyond its true-to-life handling, the system enables smooth gradients, color blending, and custom pattern creation.
Additionally, the game features a fictional in-game store where you can spend earned points to unlock a wide range of clothing items. Choose from helmets, goggles, full-face helmets, snapbacks, beanies, and more—with even more gear coming soon!

title: Friendly Cat
description:
게임 정보
세계를 탐험하고 동물들이 다시 행복해지도록 도와주세요. 금화를 모으고, 숨겨진 보물을 찾고, 다이아몬드 광산을 찾으세요. 채소와 과일을 재배하세요. 동물원 동물과 공룡을 돌보세요. 누군가가 가져간 동물이 좋아하는 물건과 장난감을 찾으세요. 누가 이 일을 저질렀을까요? 곧 알게 될 겁니다.
시각적 언어를 사용하여 동물과 소통하여 어떤 물건이나 장난감이 필요한지 알아낼 수 있습니다. 동물에게 가까이 다가가면 동물이 무엇이 필요한지 보여줍니다.
일부 동물은 거래할 물건이나 장난감이 있지만, 필요한 물건을 주면 얻을 수 있습니다. 때로는 물건을 얻는 방법에 대해 조금 생각해야 하고, 때로는 그냥 찾을 수 있습니다.
그래서 전 세계를 여행하며 동물이 좋아하는 물건과 장난감을 찾아야 합니다. 말을 위한 말굽? 문제 없습니다. 찾을 수 있을 겁니다. 돼지를 위한 샴푸? 찾을 수 있을 겁니다. 하지만 때로는 더 어려울 수 있습니다. 호수 한가운데로 가서 물개를 위한 해변 공을 구하는 방법은? 생각해야 할 겁니다.
금화를 모으고, 보물과 다이아몬드를 찾는 것도 잊지 마세요. 작은 개들이 운영하는 가게에서 다양한 품목이나 장난감을 사는 데 유용할 것입니다.
하지만 걱정하지 마세요. 친절한 고양이를 만나면 더 쉬워질 것입니다.
그러니 세상을 탐험하고 발견하고, 동물을 위한 품목과 장난감을 찾고, 반려동물 가게에서 쇼핑하고, 동물을 다시 행복하게 만들고, 다채로운 동물 세계의 비밀을 배우세요.
매머드, 공룡, 상어, 그리고 수많은 다른 동물을 만나보세요. 그리고 친절한 고양이의 도움으로 누가 동물을 속이고 좋아하는 품목과 장난감을 가져갔는지 알아낼 수 있다는 것을 기억하세요.
동물의 세계에 오신 것을 환영하고 행운을 빕니다!
Explore the world and help animals be happy again in this retro RPG game. Search for gold coins and find hidden treasures. Grow vegetables and fruits. Take care of zoo animals and dinosaurs. Find the animals' favorite items and toys that someone took. Who is behind it? You will find out.

title: MUDBIRD
description:
게임 정보
MUDBIRD is an adventure survival game about exploring a mysterious archipelago. Use the few sticks and leaves you have at your disposal to make it through the cold days and escape! A cozy and atmospheric spring experience. 
a few features:
survive on a desolate island in early spring!
interact with a whole cast of NPCs and ghosts!
repair grandpa's old canoe to explore a set of islands
save up your hard-earned cash to escape the archipelago and head home!
go spearfishing, take care of your tulip garden, tend to the fire
use your binoculars to discover the birds of the islands
explore a mysterious underground cave
send a message in a bottle to other players on their own islands!
2d top-down hand-drawn pixelart graphics
relax and watch the snow fall

title: Dreadline: Net Quota
description:
게임 정보
Dreadline is a co-op horror fishing game where you embark on dangerous waters to try and catch enough fish to pay off your debts to a shady merchant. 
Different fish require different tools. You’ll use rods, nets, and harpoons to catch increasingly strange creatures lurking beneath the fog-covered waters. The further you venture, the more specialized equipment you'll need to tackle the different fish. 
In order to make it back to shore in time before nightfall, you'll need to upgrade your boat if you want to make it out to the farthest reaches. Speed, hull reinforcement and fuel capacity are essential. You may also want to tack on some more... offensive upgrades, for the more dangerous waters. 
Who knows what swims in the depths below? These waters are dangerous, and there have been unusual creatures sighted around here. Make sure to keep an eye out, and try to keep a low profile. Some monsters are attracted to the light, some sneak up on you—stay alert!

title: Hidden Cats - Easter
description:

title: Tomodakill
description:
게임 정보
Tomodakill is a free multiplayer shooter based on one of the largest Twitch Italy communities. You can play as your favorite streamer and jump into action!

Two teams of 6 players will face off in a fast-paced Deathmatch. The battles will take place on 3 different maps, small and chaotic, full of nooks and secrets. Weapons and healing items will be found on the ground, and the action will be even more intense thanks to the many Jumpads! The first team to reach 30 kills wins. What are you waiting for? Dive in!

title: Venusville
description:
게임 정보
Venusville은 금성 구름 속에 도시를 건설하려는 우주 정착민들을 이끄는 도시 건설 게임입니다.
게임에서 당신은 기지 건축가이자 관리자 역할을 맡아 식민지 주민들에게 떠다니는 도시를 확장하고 생존에 필요한 구조물을 건설하는 방법을 지시합니다. 온도와 압력을 관리하여 생존하는 동시에 산소, 식량 및 물을 지속적으로 공급해야 합니다.
정착민들은 혹독한 환경에서 에너지를 수집하고, 물을 추출하고, 구름을 채굴하고, 식량을 재배하고, 로봇을 제작하며 완전히 자급자족할 수 있는 기지를 건설해야 합니다. 언제든 완전히 실패할 수 있는 위험이 도사리고 있습니다.
부력과 균형
당신은 금성 하늘에서 도시의 안정성을 관리하는 중요한 역할을 맡게 됩니다.
도시의 다양한 구조물은 각기 다른 무게와 부력 수준을 가지고 있어, 세심한 관리가 필요합니다. 불균형이 발생하면 도시가 뒤집히거나 구조적으로 붕괴되는 치명적인 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다. 배터리 및 엔진과 같은 무거운 요소는 균형을 유지하기 위해 전략적으로 배치해야 합니다.
부력 유지는 단순히 균형의 문제가 아니라 생존 전략이기도 합니다. 금성 대기의 깊은 곳에 존재하는 위험한 온도와 압력으로부터 도시를 보호하기 때문입니다. 이러한 섬세한 균형 유지는 도시를 확장하고 식민지 주민들의 안전을 보장하는 핵심입니다.

title: Dollhouse of Dead
description:
게임 정보
Dollhouse Corp.는 AI를 탑재한 세계 최고의 장난감 제조업체입니다. 회사의 사업은 번창하고 있지만 한 가지 문제가 있습니다. 때로는 스마트 토이가 통제를 벗어나 회사 공장을 점령하기도 합니다. 하지만 인형하우스 주식회사는 알뜰한 회사이기도 합니다! 그들은 점령된 공장으로 가서 회사에 필요한 재료를 수집하는 청소부 분대를 고용합니다. Dollhouse Corp. 청소부가 되어 10달러에 목숨을 걸 준비가 되셨나요? 축하합니다. 채용되셨습니다!
게임플레이

당신의 팀은 버려진 Dollhouse Corp. 공장 중 하나에 도착합니다. 그것은 똑똑한 장난감에 의해 포착되며, 그들 중 일부는 당신에 대해 중립적이지만 다른 일부는 당신의 죽음을 미치게 열망합니다. 당신의 임무는 다양한 쓰레기를 찾고, 거기에서 재료를 추출하고, 점차적으로 해당 위치의 새로운 영역을 여는 것입니다.
제작

수집된 재료를 사용하여 팀은 다양한 유용한 도구와 개선 사항을 만들 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 버려진 공장에서 살아남을 수도 있습니다. 특정 위치에서 잠긴 문을 열 수 있는 장치를 만들 수 있습니다.
장난감

토끼는 대부분 무해합니다. 그들과 쓰레기를 교환할 수도 있습니다. 그러나 당신이 그들에게 대가로 주는 것보다 더 많은 것을 빼앗는다면, 그들은 당신의 머리를 물어뜯을 것입니다! 그리고 이것이 오늘의 마지막 좋은 소식입니다. 나머지 장난감들: Thumper, Spider, Teddy Bear, Doll 및 기타 많은 장난감들이 당신을 보자마자 당신을 죽일 것이기 때문입니다.
숨바꼭질

모두가 당신을 죽이고 싶어합니까? 걱정하지 마세요, 청소부 여러분. 화장실과 옷장에 있는 피에 굶주린 장난감으로부터 숨을 수 있습니다. 하지만 모든 사람이 숨고 찾을 수 있는 장소가 충분하지 않다는 점을 기억하세요! 그러니 동료들 앞에서 숨을 곳을 선택하고 돈을 가지고 살아남으세요.
돈

잉여 자재를 판매하고 장비 개선을 위해 비용을 절약하세요. 어쩌면 언젠가는 은퇴할 만큼 충분한 돈을 갖게 될 수도 있습니다! 그럴 것 같지는 않지만

title: Middle Ages: Peasants & Knights
description:
게임 정보

Welcome to a medieval story of your own making. Live your life as you choose. Farm and sell your crops or pick up a sword and venture into the dark woods. Middle Ages: Peasants & Knights is a game about survival and adventures that you experience alone or with your friends. Every sunrise brings new challenges. And it is your decisions that hold the power to shape how the day ends when the sun sets.



We want everything in our game to be meaningful. That’s why we made a true inventory system that lets you carry only what you could carry in real life. Feel both the burden and the satisfaction of a realistic weight and inventory system. Find effective ways to move resources around and make your life easier.



Crafting should be fun. Immerse yourself in detailed crafting based on real historical methods. Gather raw materials from the world around you, then transform them using the techniques of the time – grind grain into flour with a quern-stone, knap flint into an axe head, or smelt and forge an iron sword blade.



Survival in the harsh medieval world requires foresight and preparation. You can't simply take nature's bounty for granted – the ability to plan ahead and stockpile crucial resources will make the difference between life and death. Ensure you have everything you need before hard times come.



The choice is yours whether to remain a nomadic survivor constantly seeking temporary havens, or to become a settler who bends the land to your long-term vision. Will you carve out a humble homestead or command the construction of an unassailable castle?



Raise livestock and grow a wide variety of vegetables, fruits and grains. If you’re successful, you'll produce surplus yields beyond just meeting your own needs for survival. This surplus can be traded or bartered with others for goods, services, or simply stocking extra provisions.



Middle Ages: Peasants & Knights isn't just about survival and fight with nature or enemy. People can also relax and enjoy the beautiful medieval world. Tend to your farm during the day, and sit around a campfire with your friends in the evening.

title: Orbo's Exodus
description:
게임 정보


After a whirlwind odyssey with his friend, our accountant-turned-hero Orbo decides to make his way home by way of Peeb's signature biplane. While flying over the coast of a mysterious vacation resort, Peeb's attempt to demonstrate a cool loop-de-loop turns into a spectacular nosedive that is only one-upped by the resulting explosion.

Following the crash, Orbo is left stranded, with Peeb nowhere in sight. Left to his own devices, Orbo begins an all-new quest to buy a ferry back to the mainland, but in the process he may discover there's more to the island than meets the eye...

Armed with some new moves and a set of snazzy hats, Orbo sets out on his final adventure: an exodus of epic proportions.



While on the island, Orbo can discover new hats to enhance his lightning-fast moveset. Burrow beneath the earth, take to the skies, and shatter people's jaws like a cannon ball with the new drill, propeller and bowler caps respectively.

Even beyond their remarkable movement capabilities, these hats are an essential tool for solving problems around the island. Use the drill hat to disassemble the world and forage for gourmet ingredients to create a delightful stew. Use the propeller hat to and kill pesky opponents with a controllable laser turret. Use the bowler cap to and perform amateur surgery on your friends. ...

Learn the extents of your hats' capabilities, and you can handle anything.



Orbo's classic moveset is back, ! Not only are the controls tighter, but Orbo is now armed with his new that allows him to quickly cover ground in style. Combine this with your new hats, and Orbo can quickly launch into spectacular aerial maneuvers, high-speed homing attacks, and more.

provide you with a nice breath of fresh air from the main campaign and a chance to go on silly side stories that will test how you move your body. Help a , explore the , and weather ...

Jump, flip, airspin, launch yourself like a .50 caliber bullet, .



The island might seem like paradise on the surface, but underneath it ... Uncover the truth behind this mysterious land's construction, the individuals inhabiting it, and why Orbo ended up here of all places...

title: Eldorion: Guardians of the Crystals
description:
게임 정보
Eldorion: Guardians of The Crystals
A pixel art exploration game where you must face various challenges and collect crystals to save Earth from its impending doom. An RPG with multiple continents that have emerged, bringing forth a new era of mysticism.
Story
A global cataclysm reshaped Earth. New continents emerged, bringing forth a new era of mysticism.
Elena's peaceful life is disrupted when her father, a renowned archaeologist, discovers one of the Crystals of Hope. Upon touching this Crystal, Elena experiences memories of her past lives, revealing her true mission—to gather all six Crystals of Hope to prevent an unprecedented catastrophe.
The planet Eldorion, on a collision course with Earth, threatens all life. On this journey, Elena is accompanied by her father and her friends, known as the Guardians of the Crystals. Together, they will do everything in their power to help Elena fulfill her mission and, through the power of the Crystals of Hope, alter Eldorion’s trajectory, saving all life on Earth. However, the "Cult of the End of Times," a sect that has lost faith in humanity, will stop at nothing to prevent Elena from completing her journey.

title: Tides of The Endless
description:
게임 정보
천 년 전, 정체불명의 대재앙이 세계의 평화를 산산조각 냈습니다. 수많은 이들이 예고 없이 거품처럼 사라져, ‘홍계’라 불리는 이세계로 강제로 이동당했습니다.
홍계는 다중 우주를 융합한 신비로운 용광로와도 같은 세계로, 최소 100종 이상의 서로 다른 종족들이 모여 있습니다. 일부 종족은 자신들의 고향 일부 지역까지 통째로 홍계로 전이되었습니다. 각 종족은 독특한 능력과 기술을 지니고 있으며, 한정된 자원을 놓고 치열한 전투를 벌이고 있습니다.
홍계의 공포는 여기서 그치지 않습니다. 이곳에 발을 들인 모든 존재는 강렬한 광기에 사로잡혀 서로를 적대하며 끊임없이 싸워야만 합니다. 심지어 누군가 죽을 때마다 홍계는 점점 풍요로워지는 듯한 모습을 보입니다.
우리 종족은 오직 10만 명의 인구만 유지할 수 있는 극단적인 생존 조건 아래 놓여 있습니다. 한 명이라도 사망하면 즉시 새로운 대체자를 보내야 하며, 그렇지 않을 경우 우리의 모성은 무작위로 한 명을 강제로 홍계로 전송하게 됩니다.
다행히 우리 종족은 독특한 능력을 지니고 있습니다. 영혼 형태로 차원을 넘어 홍계에 진입할 수 있으며, 첨단 기술 덕분에 다른 종족의 신체를 복제해 ‘기체’를 만들어냅니다.
우리의 영혼은 이 기체에 자유롭게 접속할 수 있으며, 기체가 치명적인 손상을 입더라도 영혼은 즉시 새로운 기체로 전이할 수 있어 사실상 '재생'이 가능해집니다. 하지만 기체가 손상되면 복구는 불가능하며, 새로운 기체를 신속히 찾아야 합니다. 제한 시간 안에 적합한 기체를 찾지 못하면 영혼은 소멸하게 됩니다.
홍계에 투입되기 전, 예비 전사들은 ‘임계’라는 가상 공간에서 훈련을 받습니다. 임계는 홍계와 매우 유사하게 설계되었으며, 여기서 모든 예비 전사는 다양한 시험을 통과해야만 홍계에 발을 디딜 자격을 얻게 됩니다.

title: Creature Park
description:
게임 정보
크리쳐 파크에 오신걸 환영합니다!
지루한 일상 생활에 지친 여러분, 현실과 동 떨어진 크리쳐들이 넘쳐나는 크리쳐 파크에 어서오십시오! 크리쳐 파크와 함께 일하게 된 여러분들은 동물원의 밝은 곳이 아닌, 어두운 곳에서 일하게 되실 겁니다. 하지만 걱정마세요! 여러분들을 위한 적절한 메뉴얼과 돈만 있으면 큰 도움을 주는 첨단 기술들이 있으니까요! 그래도 문제가 생긴다면... 다음 사람이 올 테니 저희는 괜찮습니다!
크리쳐를 잡아오세요!

여러분은 위험 지역에 파견을 나가, 크리쳐를 직접 잡아와야 합니다. 크리쳐들은 각기 다른 특징을 가지고 있습니다. 이들을 잘 관찰하여 빈틈을 노리세요!
동물원을 관리하세요!

여러분이 잡아온 크리쳐들은 동물원에서 살게 됩니다. 크리쳐들이 동물원에서 날뛰는 모습을 보기 싫다면, 그들이 원하는 것을 들어주세요. 여러분들의 작은 선택이 동물원 운영에서 어떤 결과를 가져올지는... 직접 확인하세요!
다양한 위협

위험 지역에는 다양한 종류의 크리쳐들이 존재합니다. 여러분은 포식자가 아닌 피식자라는 것을 잊지 마십시오.
협력 플레이

당사는 여러분이 팀을 꾸려 함께 행동하기를 장려합니다! 혼자서는 힘들 수도 있지만, 여럿이라면 가능한 일도 많으니까요!
