title: Weeny Wise
description:
게임 정보
협력 플레이를 사랑하는 이들을 위한 판타지 퍼즐 플랫포머!
신비로운 Weeny Wise의 세계로 뛰어들어 보세요!
이곳에서는 협력과 탐험이 생존의 필수 요소입니다.
용감한 두 명의 모험가 Anneli와 Hugo가 되어,
광활한 마법 세계를 탐험하며 숨겨진 비밀, 독창적인 세계관, 다양한 퍼즐과 플랫폼 도전을 경험하세요!
스토리
오랜 시간이 지난 후, Ragna는 강력한 부적을 손에 쥐고 다시 돌아왔습니다.
그는 Weeny Wise를 결집시켜 전쟁을 일으키려 하며, 이는 인간과 Weeny Wise 모두의 생존을 위협할 수 있습니다.
하지만 아직 희망은 남아 있습니다!
마법 학교의 어린 학생들인 Anneli와 Hugo는 Ragna의 첫 번째 공격에서 살아남았습니다.
그들은 **봉인된 마법의 네 개의 인장(Four Seals of Imprisoned Magic)**을 찾기 위한 여정을 떠납니다.
이것이 Ragna의 계획을 저지하고, 인간과 Weeny Wise를 전쟁에서 구할 수 있는 마지막 희망일지도 모릅니다!

title: A Gentlemen's Dispute
description:
게임 정보
Engage in fisticuffs with your friends online or on the couch. Up to 8 players can dispute online!
A gentleman comes prepared! Grab insane items from around the map to wield against your friends. Battle with bombs and baseball bats, lay down explosive mines and snapping bear traps, and prepare for battle.


SHATTER AND SMASH
A gentleman throws down wherever dispute strikes– gardens, banquet halls, even private islands. Each environment is entirely destructible– after all, what worth are luxuries if you can’t call yourself a winner?
Absurd hazards are included in each scene– artillery cannons, a luxurious railway, and even a pet shark, Rufus.

title: He is Coming
description:
게임 정보
오랫동안 잊혀 있던 적이 다시 나타나 파멸의 징조를 나타냅니다. 마왕이 곧 도래할 것이며, 그를 무찌를 용사가 없다면 세상은 분명 그의 손아귀에 넘어갈 것입니다. 이 로그라이크 롤플레잉 게임에서 낮에는 강력한 무기와 유물을 찾고, 밤에는 마왕의 부하와 맞서 싸우며, 오랜 세월을 건너온 강력한 존재와 싸울 준비를 하십시오.
3일마다 30명 이상의 보스 후보 중에서 뽑힌 무시무시한 마왕의 새로운 부하가 사냥을 시작합니다. 각 몬스터의 강점과 고유의 능력을 알아보고, 그에 따라 빌드를 조정하세요. 이 강력한 포식자를 물리치는 데 가장 적합한 무기와 장비를 찾아 왕국을 탐험하되, 밤에는 이 세계를 배회하는 다른 타락한 괴물도 경계해야 합니다. 제한된 시간 안에 숨겨진 고대 대장간에서 칼날을 갈거나 탐욕스러운 상인에게서 희귀한 장신구를 비싼 가격에 사거나, 강력한 방어구와 마법의 방패를 찾으시겠어요? 다음에 일어날 일에 대한 준비를 게을리하지 않으며, 오늘 여러분을 사냥하는 강력한 적에 맞설 가장 효과적인 도구를 선택해 보세요. 마왕이 직접 여러분 앞에 설 때까지 각 왕국의 수호자를 무찔러야 합니다.
350개가 넘는 아이템으로 다양한 전략과 시너지를 추구하여 각 괴물 보스의 독특한 챌린지에 맞서보세요. 모든 방어구를 무시하는 맹렬한 공격으로 돌진하는 레이저클로 그리즐리에게 사냥당한다면, 최대 체력, 속도 또는 피해를 우선으로 고려하는 장비에 얼마나 많은 방어구를 희생해야 할까요? 왕국을 맴도는 하급 몬스터는 방어구가 없는 영웅을 상대로 소모전을 벌일 것이고, 레이저클로 그리즐리를 처치한다면, 다음에 여러분을 쫓는 강력한 적을 상대하는 데 필요한 방어구를 준비하는 데 3일로는 모자를 수 있습니다. 방어구 대신 속도와 공격을 강화하는 아이템을 여러 개 찾아 먼저 강하게 공격하여 적을 빠르게 제압할 수도 있습니다. 때로는 적이 공격을 시작하기도 전에 말이죠. 운 좋게 사프란 깃털을 발견했다면 전투 중에 빠른 속도를 이용해 상처를 회복하는 데 도움을 받을 수 있습니다. 하지만 상대의 공격력을 자신의 공격력으로 흡수하는 흑기사에게 쫓기는 경우라면, 순수한 공격력보다는 높은 방어력이 우선시됩니다. 면도날 비늘 방어구의 도움으로 적에게 피해를 반사하고, 마법이 걸린 루비 귀걸이로 매 턴에서 피해를 주면, 흑기사는 스스로 흡수할 순수한 공격력 없이 지속적으로 피해를 입게 됩니다. 하지만 우연히 강력한 마법 무기를 발견했다면, 그것이 앞으로의 전투에서 흑기사를 강하게 만들 것이라는 걸 알면서도, 살아남았을 때 도움이 될 거란 기대를 품고 집어들 용기가 있을까요?
autokwd: He is Coming,He is Coming 히 이즈 커밍

title: Block Factory
description:
게임 정보
Creativity meets production in Block Factory, an automation game with a clear purpose: building sets of captivating 3D figurines. Design and optimize your factory to efficiently produce and assemble toy blocks into finished figurines. Analyze blueprints and meticulously plan your assembly lines, orchestrating the production of blocks.
Build specialized machines that streamline the gathering and transformation process, shaping blocks into charming figurines. Create intricate assembly lines to stack, glue, and assemble hundreds of blocks, bringing your models to life! Optimize and enhance every step of the journey to ensure your enchanting figurines.

title: Fatal Claw
description:
게임 정보
현대인들의 기술로 다시 눈뜬 멸망한 고대 왕국
웅장한 지하세계, 난폭한 감염체, 봉인되어버린 출구, 생명을 기록하는 돌, 고대인과 현대인들이 뒤섞여 사는 FatalClaw의 세상은 미스터리 그 자체입니다.
모든 것을 포기한듯한 이 지하 세상 한편에서 선조들의 도움으로 부활한 의문의 고양이 "키샤"와 함께 생존자들을 구출하고 서로 유기적으로 연결된 방대한 고대 유적, 위험천만한 지형을 탐험하며 오염체들로 부터 흡수한 능력을 활용해 지하 세상의 미스터리를 풀고 사건의 진실을 밝히세요.
"키샤"와 당신의 여정 끝에 지상의 빛이 함께 하기를 염원합니다.

진정한 모험
서로 유기적으로 연결된 독특하고 개성 넘치는 각각의 지역은 여러분을 진정한 탐험의 세계로 인도합니다.
비선형으로 디자인된 맵을 통해 정해진 길이 아닌 다양한 방식으로 탐색하며 자신만의 서사를 써내려가 보세요.
수많은 장애물과 함정 때로는 강력한 오염체들을 만나게 될지도 모르지만 당신이 어디로 향하든 그 길 끝에서 의미를 발견하게 될 것입니다.
이 모험의 결말은 플레이어의 선택에 달렸습니다. 자신이 추구하는 가치를 따르고 이루어내세요.
스타일리시한 액션과 중독적인 전투
돌진하고 뛰어넘고 할퀴고 내려찍고 "키샤"의 변이 능력을 개방시키고 활용해 강력한 오염체들을 처치하세요.

title: Pirates Outlaws 2: Heritage
description:
게임 정보
A MUCH-ANTICIPATED SEAQUEL
In this seaquel to Pirates Outlaws, a new era begins at New Elysia. Enter your mansion, pick a character, class ability and starting-deck, and embark on a daring expedition!
ALL HANDS ON DECK - CHARACTERS & COMPANIONS
Every character has several classes, and each one comes with a pre-made starter deck and one unique ability card. At the Alchemy shop, drinking elixirs alters each hero's abilities, pre-made deck, and appearance.
Recruit a companion and add their unique cards to your starter deck. It's your job to discover the many possible strategies created by this combination!
Reinforce your crew throughout your journey by encountering new characters and companions.

title: Esports Team Manager
description:
게임 정보
The world's most realistic esports management game.
Hire your staff, trade for star players, and even set the price of hot dogs—you're in complete control!
Take charge of the worst team in the league and guide them to glory, or defend the title with reigning champions. Play through an entire season packed with preseason, splits, playoffs, international competitions, and a fully immersive offseason complete with free agency, retirements, and more.
How you build your team is entirely up to you. Do you have what it takes to win it all?
Game Features
In-depth Players: Scout and sign players with diverse stats and attributes, crafting the perfect roster to match your playstyle and team synergy.
Day-to-Day Decisions: Balance player rest and training intensity, analyze gameplay footage, or encourage team bonding—every decision affects performance.
Long-term Strategy: Face tough choices like going into debt to keep your stars, or rebuilding from the ground up after a disappointing season.
Full GM/Owner Control: Set ticket and merchandise prices, hire or fire your entire staff—from coaches and analysts to cooks—and trade players to assemble the ultimate dream team.
Infinite Replayability: Choose from 16 unique teams and play through unlimited seasons, navigating random events, unexpected injuries, and even social media scandals.
Are you ready to become the GOAT of esports management? Prove it in Esports Team Manager!

title: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
description:
게임 정보
데들리 데이즈: 로드트립 은 역 탄막 슈팅 게임플레이와 전략적 인벤토리 관리를 조합한 흥미진진한 액션 로그라이트입니다.
좀비 아포칼립스 세계에서 자동차 여행을 떠나세요. 싸우며 길을 헤쳐 나가고, 경험치를 획득하고, 아이템을 수집해 멋진 인벤토리를 채우세요.
점점 더 거세지는 좀비의 파상 공격을 견뎌낼 수 있도록 더욱 효과적인 무기를 제작하고, 어떤 아이템을 조합해야 하는지 알아보세요.


제대로 정리된 인벤토리가 당신의 생명줄입니다.
시너지를 극대화할 수 있는 방식으로 무기와 아이템을 정리하세요.
작업대를 사용해 새로운 장비를 만들거나 아이템의 희귀도를 높이세요.
전투에서 레벨 업할 때마다 받아볼 수 있는 공중 투하에서 특별히 흥미로운 아이템을 찾아보세요.


여정마다 다른 경험을 할 수 있습니다.
이는 목적지 선택과 절차적으로 생성되는 맵 덕분입니다. 메타 진행은 가장 어려운 경로도 마스터할 수 있게 도움을 주죠. 미래는 불확실합니다. 그 과정을 바꾸고, 위험에서 벗어나고, 생존할 방법을 찾을 수 있을까요? 이제 모두 당신에게 달린 문제입니다.
한 명의 영웅에게는 하나의 여정만이 있습니다. 진행할 때마다 고유한 능력과 무기를 갖춘 10명 이상의 잠금 해제 가능한 캐릭터 중 선택할 수 있습니다. 홀로 걷는 길은 심오한 지혜를 가져다 주지만, 새로 사귀거나 오래 알아 온 친구와 유대감을 쌓는 것도 그에 못지않게 신성한 일입니다. 이들의 뛰어난 재능과 시작 무기가 필요할 테니까요. 동료를 구조하고 나면 다음 스테이지에서 이들을 선택할 수 있습니다.

title: Divinastros
description:
게임 정보
Divinastros is a roguelike deck builder focused on making massive scores with your cards!
Pick your cards and make combinations with Tarot Cards and the Zodiac to achieve the best build possible! Fight Greek beasts and Gods, meet different characters, uncover new Tarot Decks and make your way to Mount Olimpus.

title: Daimyo Reign
description:
게임 정보
Unify Medieval Japan in this real-time tactical grand strategy game. Build your domain, recruit armies, plan your attack, and fracture your enemies with rebellions to win!
Build
-Building improvements allow you to increase your wealth, recruit new units, defend your territory, and reduce unrest.

title: Niraya of ■■
description:
게임 정보
"Niraya of ■■"
"Niraya of ■■" is a Japanese horror game inspired by the Buddhist beliefs of the Kamakura period. The game focuses on a unique system where players "avoid" the attacks of various monsters, rather than defeating or hiding from them. This, combined with the fear of exploring eerie environments and solving puzzles, is a major draw of the game.
A Unique Gameplay Experience of Dodging
"Niraya of ■■" emphasizes "dodging" instead of the typical actions of "repelling," "hiding," or "fighting" found in major horror games. Players control a young child, managing limited stamina and using their surroundings to evade monster attacks. While being pursued by supernatural creatures, players will experience the thrill of finding ways to survive through trial and error.
The Fear of Exploring an Unknown World
In this game, the protagonist is cast into a mysterious realm unknown to the modern world and must attempt to escape. Players will guide the protagonist through unknown areas, solving hidden puzzles to progress. However, as mentioned, the exploration is filled with terrifying experiences, including strange phenomena and sudden monster attacks.

title: Backrooms Liminality
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to an immersive horror experience where the familiar becomes unsettling, and the mundane turns into a waking nightmare. Explore an abandoned liminal space trapped in the eerie twilight of darkness, where reality blurs and the past refuses to let go.

Game Overview:

In Backrooms you take on the role of a lone explorer drawn to a forgotten neighborhood by cryptic messages and haunting visions. As you delve deeper into the desolate streets, you’ll uncover the dark secrets that led to its abandonment. Every corner and hallway holds pieces of the puzzle, but be warned: you are not alone. Shadows move in the periphery of your vision, and echoes of the past resonate through the empty halls.

Key Features:

Eerie Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted environment where the ordinary becomes sinister. The game's ambient soundscape and chilling visuals create a palpable sense of dread.
Exploration-Based Horror: Navigate through an open-world liminal space. Each corner hides its own story, revealed through environmental storytelling and hidden clues.
Unravel the Mystery: Piece together the history of the suburb through journals, photographs, and artifacts. Uncover the truth behind the mass disappearance of its residents and the malevolent force that lingers.
Dynamic Encounters: Encounter unpredictable, supernatural entities that stalk the shadows. Use your wits to evade them, as direct confrontation is rarely an option.
Psychological Horror Elements: Experience a narrative that plays with your mind, challenging your perception of reality and making you question what is real and what is imagined.

Survive the Shadows!

Your journey will test your courage and resolve. Will you uncover the truth behind the abandoned suburb, or will you become another lost soul wandering its streets? Backrooms invites you to face your fears and explore the thin line between reality and the supernatural.

Dare to enter the shadows?

title: Devil's Drizzle
description:
게임 정보
Beyond the boundaries of your neighborhood, an unknown world awaits you and your trusty buddy. With boots on your feet, an umbrella in your hand, and an innate thirst for exploration, that’s all you need to embark on this adventure!
With a cute-but-creepy aesthetic, Devil’s Drizzle is a 2D platforming adventure narrated through the eyes of an innocent child. Face your nightmares, conquer the darkness, fight furballs, and confront ancient Sumerian demons in these uncharted lands.

title: FFS 2024: Football Freekick Simulator
description:
게임 정보
FFS 2024는 입력 기반 프리킥 축구 게임입니다. 무작위성도 없고, 스크립팅도 없고, 순수한 기술일 뿐입니다.
AI 골키퍼와 수비수가 당신을 막기 위해 최선을 다하는 동안 가능한 한 많은 프리킥을 득점하시오.
입력 기반 볼 궤적

득점하기에 충분한 힘(및 필요한 경우 곡선)으로 정확한 위치와 방향에서 공을 치십시오. 공의 궤적은 오직 당신의 입력에 의해서만 완전히 정의됩니다.

지능형 AI 골키퍼 및 수비수

당신의 상대는 당신이 득점하는 것을 막기 위해 최선을 다할 것입니다. 당신이 슛을 하실 때, 그들은 어디에서, 언제, 어떻게 가로챌 것인지를 결정하시기 위해 궤적을 주장할 것입니다.
예를 들어, 여기서 골키퍼는 골을 멈추기 위해 때맞춰 공에 손을 뻗기 전에 좋은 위치로 이동합니다:



네트는 공에 현실적으로 반응합니다.

title: Herdling
description:
게임 정보
Herdling is a brand new adventure from Okomotive, creators of the atmospheric and acclaimed FAR games, and Panic, publishers of Firewatch.

Head out on a grand alpine expedition with a herd of loveable beasts, as you ascend a mountain path, encounter eerie dangers and surprising obstacles, and forge your way to the mystery at the summit.
Features:
Guide, protect, and fall in love with a motley herd of Calicorns
Traverse stunning mountainscapes, fog-wreathed forests, snowy plateaus, and forgotten valleys
Hone your herding skills as you navigate a wide range of challenges, threats, and light environmental puzzles
Feel the rush of the mountain air alongside your herd in exhilarating stampede sequences
An emotional, wordless tale of trust, survival, and companionship during a great crossing through a fallen world

title: Video Battle Arena
description:
게임 정보
각 라운드에서는 두 개의 무작위 YouTube 동영상이 서로 맞붙습니다. 여러분의 과제는 어느 동영상이 더 많은 조회수나 댓글을 가졌는지 추측하는 것입니다.

미리 정의된 주제 목록을 사용하여 동영상의 주제를 선택하거나 자신의 관심사에 따라 직접 주제를 만들 수 있습니다.

Steam의 Remote Play Together 기능 덕분에 혼자서 게임을 즐기거나 최대 3명의 친구와 함께 온라인으로 플레이할 수 있습니다(총 4명의 플레이어). 모든 플레이어가 비밀리에 추측을 제출하고 모두가 답변을 마치면 정답과 승자가 공개됩니다.

특히 흥미로운 동영상이 있다면 클릭하여 브라우저에서 열 수 있습니다.

현재 게임에는 15개의 업적이 잠금 해제를 기다리고 있습니다.

title: Here Comes The Swarm
description:
게임 정보
형제자매들 사이에서 속삭임이 들린다. 격렬한 침입! 걷는 기계들이 돌아왔다! 그들은 집단적으로 느낀다, 적의 배가 땅으로 돌아오는 것을. 이 기계들은 역병이다. 그들이 쓰러뜨린 나무들, 그들이 쌓아올린 돌들은 그들을 막으려는 값싼 시도일 뿐이다.

벌집은 분노에 차 있다. 그들은 이 행성을 차지했다. 오늘, 오늘, 오늘, 그들은 형제들에게, 자매들에게 속삭인다. 무리는 기대로 몸을 떤다. 그들은 딱딱거리고, 재잘거리며, 폭발한다. 오늘, 오늘, 오늘. 그들은 강처럼, 꾸준한 흐름처럼, 걷는 기계들의 진영을 향해 움직인다. 그들은 한목소리로 외친다: 우리는 죽인다, 우리는 죽인다, 우리는 죽인다.

"히어 컴즈 더 스웜"에서 정착지를 관리하는 것은 매우 중요합니다. 업그레이드와 확장을 위해 충분한 자원을 모으고, 주민들에게 식량을 공급하고 행복하게 유지하세요. 벌떼가 몰려올 때 방어 준비를 확실히 해야 합니다.

원하는 군대를 구성하고 부대를 훈련시켜 다음 전쟁에 대비하세요. 하이브의 . 의 힘은 숫자로 나타나며, 그들의 맹공격은 것입니다. 당신의 벽을 뚫으려는 의 악마를 찾을 준비를 하세요.

title: Frost Survival VR
description:
게임 정보
After a series of unfortunate events, you find yourself surrounded by an ice-covered wilderness. Isolated from the rest of the world, you must rely on your own wists and limited resources to survive these harsh conditions in this Multiplayer Sandbox Survival in VR.

Your main goal is to stay alive, but how?
Build your Base: Construct a shelter to escape the frost, warm up, protect from wild animals, wait out a snowstorm, store resources, and craft needed equipment.
Tools & Weapons: You will require a variety of tools to fully exploit your surroundings. Each tool and weapon has its purpose and durability.
Hunt, Craft & Gather: Hunt animals to gain food and resources. Collect items to craft tools, weapons, or clothing necessary for survival. Pay attention to your backpack's limited space.

title: Live Lens Bodycam
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Live Lens
Experience the intensity of frontline combat like never before. Live Lens is a hyper-realistic bodycam-style shooter that plunges you into the heart of the action, capturing the raw, unfiltered essence of tactical warfare. Inspired by the latest in immersive simulation technology, Live Lens offers a gripping, authentic experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Live Lens unleashes the power that lies under Unreal Engine 5.
Hyper-Realistic Visuals:
Harnessing the advanced capabilities of Unreal Engine 5, Live Lens delivers stunningly detailed environments and lifelike character animations. Every bullet, every explosion, every motion is rendered with meticulous precision, making you feel like you're truly there.

title: HARK THE GHOUL
description:
게임 정보
HARK THE GHOUL is a dungeon crawler where behind every corner lies a discovery.
A deep, handcrafted world that feels tangible and immersive.
Face terrifying monsters, challenge awe-inspiring foes and meet curious characters along the way!
TIGHT AND TWISTING LEVEL DESIGN
Get lost in a myriad of seamlessly interconnected zones as you descend down the bowels of the earth and uncover its secrets.
TONS OF UNIQUE GEAR TO FIND
Use swords, whips, pistols, cannons, artifacts, employ magic to tear your way through your enemies. Every piece of gear has its unique utility.
CRISP RETRO-MODERN GRAPHICS
HARK THE GHOUL's compelling world is lovingly rendered in a retro-modern low-poly style (with customizable effects!).

title: Stranded
description:
게임 정보
Enter a world where your ingenuity by day is as crucial as your survival instincts by night. Build an ever-expanding factory to gather essential resources and craft powerful tools that will help you fend off relentless nighttime assaults.
Each night brings waves of enemies eager to overrun your base, so prepare your defenses wisely - deploy magic, guns, position automated turrets, and equip potent abilities to stay one step ahead. With deep meta progression that carries over between runs, you’ll continually unlock new ways to strengthen your arsenal and push back the darkness.
Key Features
Daytime Factory Building – Gather materials, research upgrades, and expand your industrial complex to fuel your nighttime defenses.
Nighttime Horde Battles – Stand your ground against swarms of enemies with an array of magical weapons and deployable turrets.
Rogue-Like Progression – Persist beyond each run by earning permanent upgrades that carry over, ensuring you grow more powerful over time.
Adaptive Tactics – Experiment with different playstyles, from aggressive spellcasting to methodical turret placement.
Evolving Challenges – Uncover new enemy types, refine your loadout, and stay ready for the intensified assaults lurking in the dark.
Build, fight, and survive as you master both the calm of daylight strategy and the frenzy of nocturnal combat.

title: Inkwellers
description:
게임 정보
Beware! The game requires both players to have microphones and a stable internet connection. Also this game works in co-op mode only. Both players must communicate effectively to navigate the challenges and uncover the truth.
One day, a mysterious client enters your shop and hands you an old, dusty journal, pleading for you to uncover the story hidden within its pages. You're the Inkwellers, skilled adventurers who dive into journals to reveal their true meanings. Intrigued by the challenge, you and your partner decide to take on the task and dive into the journal's world.

title: Strategos
description:
게임 정보
Simulate Historical Battles
Simulate large scale warfare with the armies of antiquity in Strategos. With thousands of men on screen, you can recreate real or speculative historical battles between the major and minor powers of the ancient Mediterranean.
Manage Complex Mechanics
Strategos is an ancients wargame with large scale formation movements and disorder, unordered charges, pursuing, evading, routing and morale shocks, fog of war, terrain effects, flanking and command and control simulations that bring a hardcore tabletop feel to digital, real-time wargaming.

title: Galaxy Princess Zorana
description:
게임 정보
Rule the galaxy or die trying!
You were never meant to be the heir. You were the second child, the pampered princess, busy with your friends and your pet and your collection of beautiful shoes. But then your mother died, your brother the Prince turned traitor, and your father the Emperor disappeared under mysterious circumstances. Now it's up to you to win the Imperial Election and claim the throne.
Set in the universe of previous title Long Live The Queen, Galaxy Princess Zorana carries on the tradition of strategic life-simulation in a deadly game of court intrigue.
Choose Your Strengths
Every turn, you can choose different skills for Zorana to study, transforming her from an unprepared princess into a master of etiquette or swordfighting or lock-picking or spaceflight.
The skills you prioritise each playthrough will open up different possibilities for responding to story events. Danger is always brewing in the Celestial Empire, and every turn some situation will arise that requires Zorana to make decisions: 
Attempting a lockdown without sufficient Military skill might backfire and make the Imperial Fleet rebel against you!
Keep Your Friends Close (And Your Enemies Closer)

title: Utawarerumono: ZAN
description:
게임 정보
Turn up the music, grab your warfan, and get ready to mow down some mooks in this action-packed take on the Utawarerumono series!

HACK AND SLASH
Land big damage, juggle foes, and build up a combo counter into the hundreds! Carve your mark onto the battlefield while grooving out to over 80 tracks, including upbeat remixes of Utawarerumono's legendary soundtrack!
FOUR'S A PARTY
Build a team of four characters and switch anytime! Every fighter in your squad brings unique stats and abilities. Equip and improve gear to customize your loadout, choose powerful formations that complement your strengths, and power up your party after every battle!

Dodge attacks and land hits to charge up Zeal, then spend it on unique and deadly Chain Attacks—or save up, enter Overzeal, and unleash a devastating Final Strike!
follows the story of , featuring slimmed-down exposition interspersed with button-pounding battles. When a man named Haku wakes up in an unfamiliar world, he quickly finds himself surrounded by a beautiful but strict caretaker and a motley crew of warriors, scholars, princesses, and heroic bandits. Under the direction of the dashing rogue Ukon, they'll rescue damsels, stamp out conspiracies, stymie invasions, and build bonds as they fight to defend the land of Yamato from every threat... even the ones that wear masks.

title: Vesper
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a collection of fantastical and imaginative worlds, packed to the brim with memorable characters, rich stories, and unforgettable encounters. Be prepared to venture through more adventures than you could shake a sword at - and this is just the beginning.
Handcrafted Fantasy
From a cosy frog mystery to an epic fantasy filled with knights and magic, there is a story for everyone in Vesper. Explore vibrant 3D worlds jam-packed with hidden secrets, charming creatures, and… is that a talking sword?! Crafted from the ground up by a diverse range of creators and storytellers, each story will feature so many mysteries to uncover.
Worlds Built by Creators
Experience exclusive stories brought to life in Vesper. Each adventure has been tailor-made by comedians, Dungeon Masters, authors and all-round creative masters you might know from Dungeons & Dragons, Dropout, Comedy Central and beyond. They include creators like Amy Vorpahl, Ross Bryant, Ify Nwadiwe, Aliza Pearl, Johnny Stanton IV and more...

title: UNDERGROUNDED
description:
게임 정보
Synopsis
Meet Scott, a heartbroken young man whose sweetheart rejected him when he proposed to her.

He goes chasing after the ring that he dropped in a street-side gutter, but what he finds is a mysterious dungeon in which people’s dropped possessions and American history have accumulated like strata of the Earth…
Game Summary
“Undergrounded” is a Puzzle-solving Adventure in which the player plumbs the depths of a dungeon formed by American history folding in on itself like layers of the Earth.


■Explore a Dungeon formed by History
An 80s movie theater and arcade, a space station racing to the moon landing, a roaring twenties speakeasy. On the backdrop of an isometric dungeon reminiscent of the games of yesteryear, find key items emblematic of each era and solve puzzles to advance to the next level!


■Scott’s Personal Growth and a Cast of Characters
As Scott, meet a cast of people searching for lost possessions in the Dungeon. With his buddy Canary by his side, Scott will learn to face his own problems through hearing their stories and helping them overcome their losses.


■Formidable Bosses and Retro Games
Scott must face several powerful bosses in the dungeon that block his way forward. Play various “games within a game” that pay homage to retro games of the 80s to stand up to these mighty bosses!

title: Five Laps at Freddy's
description:
게임 정보
Demo Coming August 7th, 2024!

Welcome to Five Laps at Freddy's, The premier animatronic kart racing circuit featuring your favorite and lovable Fazbear friends! Sponsored by Fazbear Entertainment

Select one of 12 of your favorite animatronic #FNaF characters and race on sixteen tracks set across 4 cups! Each track is based on your favorite locations from Five Nights at Freddy's lore, including Fazbear Hills, Midnight Motorist and more!



Starting out on The Dayshift, a relatively safe place, you'll compete to take first place but make sure to manage your kart's battery power... use too much boost or take too many hits and you may end up on The Nightshift where not only do you have to worry about winning, you'll also have to avoid an angry endoskeleton who's on the hunt for you!

While navigating the tracks, find birthday presents which contain items that can help you reach number one, everything from The Fazblaster to the Cupcake Boost! Each item even has a powerup mode, should you dare to risk some of that precious battery power... You'll also find glitched powerups which can increase your battery size and your maximum speed, so long you don't get hit and lose some of them again!



PLEASE NOTE: Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for road rash, broken bones, death and/or dismemberment. Please drive responsibly!

title: Chromatic Conundrum
description:
게임 정보

Chromatic Conundrum is a first person puzzle game where you manipulate light. Combine different colors and form shadows to illuminate your way through an enigmatic world.

title: Dead Soul TowerDefense:Shadow Labyrinth
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 픽셀 스타일의 클래식 타워 디펜스 게임으로 로그라이크 요소를 결합하고 있습니다. 적의 공격을 막기 위해 영혼을 소환해야 하며, 각 영혼 유형은 고유한 스킬 트리를 가지고 있으며 업그레이드 시 스킬이 무작위로 선택됩니다. 게임에는 끝없는 모드가 있어 가능한 한 높은 점수를 얻어 더 많은 스킬 트리를 잠금 해제해야 합니다.
자신만의 독특한 미로를 만들 수 있습니다.
8개의 독특한 방어탑, 각기 다른 직업 스킬을 보유: 도둑질, 감속, 기절, 치명타, 다중 화살, 피의 갈증, 독화살, 방어력 감소...
autokwd: Dead Soul TowerDefense:Shadow Labyrinth,영혼 수비: 그림자 미로

title: Nitro Express
description:
게임 정보
Mysterious T.O.K.Y.O.
Welcome to Nitro City, Tokyo Special Administrative Region! The metropolis of Tokyo is a bit different from what we know, but the streets are just as nostalgic, or, depending on where you're from, they're just as good as the place you've always wanted to visit.
Companions / Atypical Vehicles
Autonomous drones, affectionately called "Companions", have been integrated into daily life, but in cop terms, they're referred to as "Atypical Vehicles".
When they pose a significant threat to society, it's time for the Atypical Vehicle Disposal Squad (AVDS)—a special unit of the Nitro City police force—to commence their mission to destroy all rogue vehicles!

title: Aether Singularity
description:
게임 정보
A demonic anomaly has been detected in an important research facility. DATA agents... deploy!

In 1969, mankind established its first link to the Aethernet. Humanity soon entered a golden age of technological wonder and prosperity.
But, kept secret from the eyes of the public, a second discovery was made shortly after... demons weren't just the subject of myths and religion.
To combat them, the Demonic Anomalies Termination Agency was born. An FBI offshoot where agents are partnered with daemons through a pact, their mission: send the demons back where they belong.
GAMEPLAY
In this fixed camera action game you and your squad will have to explore a top secret facility. Balance the powers of both magic and lead to defeat the demons who are rampaging throughout it!
Battles take place in real-time, requiring you to dodge enemy attacks and find the perfect time to retaliate against them. As you shoot enemies you'll gain mana which you can use to cast spells to gain an advantage. On the verge of death will you choose to use what little mana you have to heal yourself, or will you try to blast away one of your foes so the battle becomes easier? Make strategic use of your resources and complete your mission!
A RACE AGAINST THE CLOCK
As you explore the facility you'll be able to find information, and maybe even spells, to help you with your mission. However, you'll be faced with a constant timer that ticks down even when in battles. Failing to get to the bottom of things before time runs out won't spell the end for you, but...
BONUS CHALLENGES
In addition to the main mission there are over 15 bonus challenges that can be tackled! Defeat the enemies, protect the target, and more as you aim for the best score possible! Can you get a gold rank in all of them?
THE CAST




SILVIA
An experienced agent, she has been working at DATA for a decade. Felt like nobody ever had her back until she got assigned to Alfonso's squad, thus adopted a bit of a rebellious attitude. Competent at her job, she enjoys being sent on assignments despite her snarky remarks.
Silvia's daemon, bound by pact. Quite reliable, has learned to adapt to Silvia's attitude and does his best to cheer her up.
While she might not show it, Silvia is glad to have been partnered with him. Their mutual trust has resulted in Ranru evolving and being able to cast a variety of magicks.
The leader of the squad, his expertise has gained him notoriety within DATA veterans. After a mission gone wrong and a falling off with his previous team, he was reassigned to direct a smaller, fast-response squad, which he's now fond of.

The latest addition to the squad, recruited due to her excellent track record as a police officer. Has great social skills and is used to dealing with civilians, but is still trying to fit in in DATA. Greatly respects Alfonso and Silvia.

title: Youtubers Life 3 - Stream Together!
description:
게임 정보
Become the best Youtuber in the world while you climb in real time in the online ranking.
You have to be the best! Compete with other players from all over the world online and in real time to reach the top of the global ranking. Fight for your rivals' followers in the online card game, create the most epic VOD content to increase your channel subscriptions and post the best photos on Instalife to get more likes than anyone else.

title: dirtbag MAHJONG
description:
게임 정보
Lie, cheat, and steal your way to victory in Dirtbag Mahjong!
Choose your character and join five other dirtbags for a night of riichi mahjong and misdemeanor assault. Nobody here plays fair, and they've all got some dirty tricks up their sleeves.
Dirtbag Mahjong is a complete and beginner-friendly mahjong experience that also offers some party game surprises to keep experienced players guessing.
Features:
A full riichi mahjong text guide and interactive tutorial, to help ease beginners into the game or the higher difficulties
Six playable characters with unique abilities, each with their own story mode
Free play mode with both "standard" or "dirtbag" rules, for a complete single-player mahjong experience
CPU difficulty options ranging from beginner-friendly to unfairly hard
Skins for tiles and characters
Hand drawn pixel art
Full gamepad support
Demo features:
The full riichi mahjong text guide, and the first two chapters of the interactive tutorial to get beginners started
A preview of Vren's first playable story chapter
Dirtbag mode free play with a random character
Normal mode free play with full choice of character
The demo is not limited-time, but there is a restriction in how many full East games you can play before it ends, since the free play mode covers a significant amount of the game.

title: Loop//Error
description:
게임 정보
Something is watching you. Something is waiting.
Alone in the dead of night, you find yourself sent on a simple errand—to check on a quiet gas station on the outskirts of town. But nothing here feels right.
The air is heavy with something unspoken, the radio crackles with words that don't belong, and the station itself... shifts.
Every step forward drags you deeper into a nightmare of fractured reality and unseen terrors. Strange voices whisper in your ear, shadows stretch and writhe, and the choices you make will carve your fate.
Will you listen? Will you obey? Or will you resist, knowing that every decision carries a price?
Features:
Psychological Horror – Experience a slow-burning descent into paranoia, dread, and disturbing imagery.
Decision-Based Gameplay – Every choice you make alters the experience, shaping the horrors that unfold.

title: Song of Maka
description:
게임 정보
Song of Maka is a unique 2D adventure puzzle game in which you play as a king of the Kingdom of Birds who has just been reincarnated into his youthful form and must save the Kingdom from its Pandemonium through your graceful voice.
Kingdom of Birds
The main stage for the story of the Song of Maka is the Kingdom of Birds. Long ago, the birds on land were still beasts without sanity. In order to gain the rumoured Wisdom, the birds went to the sky island in the sky and stole the "Sanity" to their land. The light of "Sanity" gave all the birds the capability to speak, and the Kingdom of Birds was established.
Singing and Flying
As a bird, players will interact with many elements of the game world through singing. Different sound waves resonate with various creatures and obstacles, altering them in unique ways to assist players on their adventure.

title: Cute
description:
게임 정보
⏹︎ Game Description ⏹︎
This is a fun dungeon exploration RPG game!
The protagonist, "Memelis," heads to the dungeon in search of treasure to pay off her debts.
Along the way, she will encounter fearsome monsters and heartwarming companions!
Will she be able to find the treasure and clear her debts?
⏹︎ Game Features ⏹︎
A classic Japanese-style RPG adventure
Rich dungeon maps
RPG battle system
A fun and absurd storyline
You can earn money not just by treasure hunting, but through various other ways.
⏹︎ Characters ⏹︎

title: Legion Was Here
description:
게임 정보
You are Legion, a secret agent who can modify his appearance at will.
Agencies from all around the world call on your chameleon skills to carry out dangerous missions.
To approach your targets, you must succeed in passing yourself off as one of their loved ones: become a husband, a brother, a son…
The possibilities are endless.
But be careful: the slightest misstep can mean… Death.
● Investigate
A file detailing your new identity will be provided to you for each mission. By cross-referencing its documents, you will have to find the appropriate appearance.
Be thorough, as each document is important… Yes, even this chocolate bar wrapper.
● Change your look
Use the operating room to customize Legion's appearance.

title: A Killer Chat! Christmas
description:
게임 정보
Note: this is a standalone game. You do not need to download Killer Chat! to play, but we do recommend playing through Killer Chat! first (it's free!)
WELCOME BACK TO HELL, LOSERS!
Over a year has passed since asking too many murder-related questions online (for your book) got you invited to a serial killer chatroom. Of course, you did what any insane person would do and called the police pretended to be a serial killer. For, uh… hot singles in your server research purposes. 
Somehow, you got your bad happy ending. You’re now a bestselling writer, desperately in love, and have come to think of the server as family - it's like a dream come true. Sure, most of them still think you are a serial killer, your boss needs you to write another hit ASAP and your one true love is definitely technically a murderer, but look on the bright side - it’s Christmas!

title: Ship
description:
게임 정보
Ever wanted to step into the shoes of a packaging expert? In Ship, Inc., you take on the role of a packaging employee at a fast-paced cargo shipment company. Your job? Sort, package, and ship parcels to their correct destinations while keeping up with the growing demands of the business.

How It Works

At Ship, Inc., every package counts! Follow shipment orders carefully, choose the right box sizes, and ensure each package reaches its destination safely. Misplacing or damaging shipments could cost you, so be precise and efficient!


✔ – Select the correct box size, arrange items properly, and seal them securely before shipping.
✔ – Keep an eye on incoming orders and ship parcels correctly to maximize efficiency.
✔ – Earn money to improve your workspace, increase storage, and unlock better shipping tools.
✔ – Stay on top of customer demands as you balance speed and accuracy in your shipments.
✔ – Packages must be handled properly! Fragile items require extra attention to avoid damage during transit.
✔ – As you progress, new challenges and complex orders will test your multitasking skills.


Every second counts in the shipping industry! Improve your workflow, make the right decisions, and prove yourself as the best packaging expert in . Are you up for the challenge?

title: GLOOPALAXY
description:
게임 정보
[The game is still in early development, and most of the visuals are subject to change.]
Run your own space aquarium in this tiny, light management and creature collection game.
Collect strange aquatic creatures from outer space called gloops, and create ecosystems for them to thrive in. Take care of your visitors, coming in from every corner of the universe to admire your aquarium!
🚀 Explore the galaxy and uncover its secrets
Discover and explore new worlds, each revealing unique creatures. Bring back rare objects and materials to customize your aquarium, and capture new gloops with your remote fishing device. You may even get lucky and bring back shiny ones ✨
🐠 Study and take care of your gloops
Each creature has unique preferences. Place them in various tanks, experiment with their environment, and fill your encyclopedia with all there is to know about them!
🪸 Customize your aquarium
While looking for creatures, you may find new decorations and materials to customize your aquarium. Build new rooms, change the colors and place items to make it look just right!
👽 Welcome intergalactic visitors
Visitors from the whole galaxy will come to admire your creatures, so make sure that they get what they're paying for! Adjust the ticket price, and open your aquarium for the day!
✨ Meet your objectives
Each mission brings new creatures, new planets and more! Fill your encyclopedia, make money and drive visitor satisfaction up to unlock them all.

title: Letters of longing
description:
게임 정보
You are a soldier in Spain in 1938. You must infiltrate the enemy's territory to retrieve sensitive information. It's an infiltration mission that awakens memories in you of an old relationship that you think has disappeared.
In this "Walking Simulator" game you will find puzzles in which the solution lies in knowing how to find your way through a town hall destroyed by war. Through keys and maps scatered arround the building you will advance and discover the story that is told to the player through the messages written on a typewriter.
These messages are the letters sent to each other by Juan and Antón, the protagonists of the story. In these you can see how the war has affected them, what their true relationship truly is. The letters show the things they did not share and only the two of them experienced.

title: Wildgate
description:
게임 정보
매번 다른 경험을 선사하는 매치에서 손에 땀을 쥐게 하는 우주선 전투와 긴장감 넘치는 1인칭 총격전을 즐겨보세요. 궁극의 보상인 신비롭고 귀중한 아티팩트를 손에 넣으려면 라이벌 크루를 추격해 장비를 훔치거나, 손상된 함선을 수리하거나, 값비싼 자원을 수색하는 등 즉흥적으로 움직여야 합니다.
함선은 여러분과 탐사자 크루의 본거지이자 생명선입니다. 얼음, 연료, 탄약을 가득 채우고 타이폰 리치에서 누구를 만나든, 무엇을 만나든 모든 상황에 대비하세요.


                       적을 최첨단 대포와 도구로 날려버리거나, 치명적인 함정으로 유인하거나, 적의 함선을 난장판으로 만들 수 있습니다... 적에게 먼저 당하지만 않는다면 말이죠. 완벽한 계획이 틀어졌을 땐 별다른 방법이 없습니다... 즉흥적으로 대응하세요!

title: Jackie Hart: Headhunter
description:
게임 정보
Step into the shoes of Jackie Hart, a paranormal investigator,  as she navigates a chilling mystery set in the shadowy streets and rooftops of modern Taiwan. A gruesome discovery on a hotel roof leads to a tangled web of ritualistic sacrifices, ancient folklore, and unearthly entities each with their own motivations and plans for Jackie.
In this 2D point & click adventure, you'll:
Investigate Disturbing Crime Scenes: Examine eerie environments, piece together clues, and reconstruct events to unravel the truth.
Engage in Deep, Choice-Driven Dialogue: Interact with a cast of richly developed characters, from skeptical police officers to enigmatic shamans, where your decisions shape the narrative and relationships.
Explore Taiwan's Mystical Lore: Delve into indigenous rituals, encounter spirits, and face the terrifying yaoguai, as you uncover secrets rooted in cultural mythology.
Strengthen Your Abilities: Meet powerful allies in the world of mysticism and magic who can unlock your latent powers.

title: Ice Cream Simulator
description:
게임 정보
다양한 문화에서 고유한 아이스크림 제조 기법, 테마 및 고객을 발견하세요.
전통적인 마트카 쿨피, 태국식 롤 아이스크림, 일본식 모치, 또는 클래식 컵과 콘을 만드는 기술을 마스터하세요.
 
가게의 을 개인의 비전과 스타일에 맞게 맞춰보세요.
고객 만족과 환영하는 분위기를 위해 깔끔한 가게를 유지하세요.
자신만의 전략적인 선택을 통해 번창하고 수익성 있는 아이스크림 제국을 구축하세요!

title: Quadrofriend
Blind Touch
description:
게임 정보
You Can't See!
Step into the world of a blind traveler, where every tap of your guide cane reveals the unseen. You navigate environments that are familiar or distant— home, subway, a bustling street—illuminating objects through touch and memory.
Control Your Cane:
With each touch, your cane brings the world to life. Uncover objects that hold meaning, from a humming boombox to the scent of a flowering plant. Each discovery is a small triumph, adding to the rich tapestry of your journey.
Collect Memory:
Collect significant objects, solve tactile-based navigation puzzles, and immerse yourself in an experience designed to replicate the challenge and beauty of moving through the world without sight.

title: The Last Job 2
description:
게임 정보
You’ve done this a hundred times before—show up, lay tiles, get paid. The job is simple, the process familiar. The homeowner barely speaks, keeping to himself as you work. Nothing seems out of the ordinary. The day moves along like any other. But as the hours pass, something begins to feel… off. It’s not the job itself—that part is routine. It’s something else. A nagging sense that you’re missing something important, that there’s more to this house than what’s in front of you.
A slow descent into mystery and tension, this psychological horror experience pulls you in with its realism—until the cracks start to show. Will you finish the job, or will you uncover something you were never meant to find?
Game Mechanics
Lay tiles, just like any other job. Spread mortar, pick up a tile, and place it. Simple, repetitive, almost relaxing—until it isn’t.
Pick up tiles, spread mortar, place tiles – A straightforward job… at first.
Stay focused – Keep working and ignore distractions.
Immerse yourself in the task – Just a normal day’s work. Nothing more.
Features
A Creepy, Unfolding Story – What begins as an ordinary job takes a disturbing turn.
A Mysterious House – The more you observe, the more unsettling the details become.
Realistic Graphics – Every detail, from the environment to the smallest objects, draws you deeper into the experience.
You’re here to lay tiles. That’s the job. That’s all there is to it.
…Right?

title: Wall Street Raider
description:
게임 정보
What is Wall $treet Raider? Wall Street Raider offers one of the deepest stock market simulations in gaming history, giving you control over publicly traded corporations, futures markets, options, and even Bitcoin and Ethereum trading. Whether you want to make billions in equities, short-sell overvalued stocks, or hedge risk using derivatives, the market is yours to conquer
Buy and sell physical Bitcoin and Ethereum—hold crypto like a real investor
Trade Bitcoin and Ethereum futures—go long or short based on market movements
Buy, sell, and short stocks—take advantage of price swings and corporate shifts
Short selling & covering positions—profit from crashing stocks
Trade options—buy and sell calls and puts for strategic advantage
Leverage advanced options trading strategies—master derivatives markets
Buy & sell corporate bonds—invest in debt markets for stable returns
Buy & sell government bonds—secure safe investments during market turmoil
Use interest rate swaps—hedge against changing interest rates ---
Banking, Real Estate, & Debt Markets – Control the Financial Sector Expand your empire into banking, lending, and real estate finance. Whether you want to run a major bank, take over the mortgage industry, or control the loan market, the opportunities are endless.

title: Shut the windows and don't look outside
description:
게임 정보
Gameplay
Survive:
You are alone, trapped in your own home, waiting for "help" to arrive. To make it through the night, you must keep your fear in check and ensure no unwelcome presence lingers for too long. Every second in the dark brings you closer to the unknown.
Manage:
Your home is your only refuge, but the power supply is limited. You must carefully ration your energy, deciding which rooms to keep lit and which to let fall into darkness. Every flicker of light could mean the difference between safety and exposure. Run out of fuel, and you may not get another chance.
Sanity:
Windows keep opening… but did you forget to close them, or is something else inside with you? Keep them shut at all costs. If you let them stay open too long, you might see something you were never meant to. And whatever happens—do not look outside.
Fear:
Fear is more than a feeling—it’s an invitation. If you let the terror take hold, It will take notice. Things that shouldn’t be there begin to manifest. If you see them, make them disappear quickly. Do not stare. Do not hesitate. If you let them stay, you may not be able to tell what’s real anymore.
Story

A critical notice from the Bureau of Liberty and Individual Safety (B.L.I.S.)
Recent disturbances and abnormal phenomena have been detected in your area. For your safety and well-being, all individuals must remain inside their homes. Under no circumstances should you look outside. Keep all doors locked and windows shut.
DO NOT LOOK OUTSIDE. DO NOT GO OUTSIDE.
Some citizens have reported symptoms due to extended isolation, including:
Dry mouth
autokwd: Shut the windows and don't look outside

title: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine
description:
게임 정보
독특한 협력 플레이 경험을 제공한 How 2 Escape가 더욱 향상된 게임플레이와 새로운 도전적인 퍼즐로 돌아왔습니다!
최신 시리즈 **"How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine"**에서 당신과 파트너는 실종된 잠수함을 찾아 세계 대전을 막아야 합니다.
세계를 구하라
아군 군사 기지가 적군에게 점령되었고, 정부는 이를 되찾기 위해 어뢰를 발사하라는 명령을 내렸습니다. 하지만 이는 수많은 아군 희생을 초래할 수도 있는 위험한 결정이었습니다.
추후 내부 논의와 적군과의 협상 끝에 정부는 공격 취소를 결정했지만, 문제가 발생했습니다.
어뢰를 실은 **잠수함 "The Triumphant"**은 통신 범위를 벗어나 있어 취소 명령이 제대로 전달되었는지 확인할 방법이 없습니다.
전쟁을 막기 위해, 정부는 최고의 전문가 두 명, **장교 "오리"와 "르로이"**에게 "The Triumphant"을 찾아내라는 임무를 맡깁니다. 그러나 이들이 마주한 현실은 예상과 달랐습니다. 최근 결정으로 인해 잠수함 내부에서는 도덕적 갈등이 점점 커지고 있었던 것입니다.

title: Treeplanter
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Treeplanter, an interactive woodland that grows and changes with the seasons. Piece together a small grove of trees branch by branch and watch as their roots blossom under the soil!
As time goes by, an ecosystem of animals, plants and birds will move in, turning your creation into a living world. Changing seasons and weather will affect the miniature universe of your grove.
Build your grove in a variety of landscapes, from sunny meadows to ancient ruins. Combining meditation and education, Treeplanter aims to teach players about the interconnected wonders of the natural world both above ground and below.

title: You Shouldn't Be Here
description:
게임 정보
You Shouldn't Be Here is a short psychedelic visual novel that takes place in a strange world filled with harrowing creatures. You’ll meet Dimitriv who is willing to keep you safe as long as you help him with something. 
The story touches on topics such as mental health, exclusion, and various other existential questions.
The gritty pixel-art, together with the somewhat erratic and despairing soundtrack, intends to create a dreamlike, bordering on nightmarish, atmosphere.
In the shape of the infinite, I am one.
Swallowed by an ocean of bliss.
No choices to be made,
no stories to unfold,
no riddles to solve.

title: Pirate's Gambit
description:
게임 정보
해적의 도박에서 당신은 키드 선장이 남긴 기묘한 내기에 발을 들입니다. 살아남기 위해서는 덱을 신중하게 구성하고, 주사위와 도구를 능숙하게 활용하며, 모든 선택을 치밀하게 계산해야 합니다.
새로운 항로가 열릴수록, 당신은 미지의 땅을 탐험하게 됩니다. 타오르는 화산에서 얼어붙은 황무지까지, 그리고 그 너머의 신비로운 영역으로 나아가며, 배에 감춰진 오랜 비밀을 하나씩 밝혀내야 합니다.

title: Leaia
description:
게임 정보
Farm, fight, brew magical alcotions, and uncover the mysteries of the Tree of Life!
 Farming & Harvesting – Sow, water, fertilize, and reap a variety of crops. Sell your produce for profit and expand your farm!
 Adorable & Useful Animals – Raise chickens, goats, pigs, and cows. Ride your very own horse! Train and bond with your loyal dog, who can fetch resources, fight alongside you, and learn special skills.
 Dynamic Combat System – Engage in real-time battles with dodges, parries, staggers, and powerful skills like the whirlwind sword attack or wielding primitive black powder firearms!

title: Glaciered
description:
게임 정보


Glaciered takes place on Earth 65 million years in the future, where the "Everwinter" has transformed the planet's surface into a gigantic sheet of ice and life continues to survive under the glacier-covered seas.

Aquatic plants grow from glacier skies and colorful, bioluminescent fish light the seafloor. A new species prospers in this new golden age of life. They are the Tuai, descended from birds and successors of the dinosaurs. The superior intellect and unique metabolism they evolved over millions of years secured their prosperity in this icy environment. The great Ice Age that nurtures this bountiful ecosystem will survive for as long as the Everwinter persists.

Play as a Tuai fighting against that which has come to threaten the Everwinter.



Glaciered features real-time, dynamic combat that combines melee and ranged attacks with special abilities. Unleash the power within the Tuai avian and dinosaur bloodlines and harness their ability to control heat and cold.



Build your character by combining various abilities and passive skills like high-speed swimming that creates tunnels of supercritical water, temporal crystal blades, and more.



Discover unique ecosystems spread across an ocean Earth 65 million years in the future. Visit grasslands growing from icy skies, swim past schools of thermophilic fish coating the seafloor, and fend off members of the Crocodilia family that have been freed from gravity's grip and grown to enormous size.

Glaciered supports NVIDIA RTX features. Experience the far-future Earth in 4K, enhanced by ray-tracing and DLSS, with 8K textures used for the main characters.

title: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon
description:
게임 정보
Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon is a spiritual successor to the classic Ogre Battle series, combining real-time, squad-based tactics gameplay with turn-based RPG combat. Move units across the map in real time to capture towns and castles; when enemy units come in contact, a turn-based battle ensues, with the defeated side forced to give up ground.



Organize soldiers with unique appearance, stats and classes into units. Choose from dozens of classes, and customize your unit's formation to maximize each soldier's effectiveness, taking advantage of position-specific abilities, damage types and resistances, and support abilities which can be used to help nearby units when they enter combat.



Explore dozens of unique regions depicted in lush, hand-painted graphics. Destroy your opponents and capture their territories to win. Choose where to stand your ground - fighting from the right terrain can give you the advantage you need, and traversing difficult terrain can build up fatigue that will reduce your units' effectiveness.




When your unit comes in contact with the enemy, a turn-based battle ensues. Battles play out ; characters act in initiative order, and their actions are determined by their class, formation, and enemy positioning. Archers will rain down destruction on enemies from the rear, but if they lose their cover, they're defenseless. Swordsmen will attack from the front row and must hit the enemy's front row first; from the rear, they'll do nothing. Bleddyn the bard will bravely wield his rapier from the front, or play a song to buff the entire squad from the back.

The side that deals the most morale damage - by hitting hard, taking down units, or weakening the enemy commander - is the winner, with the other side losing ground on the map.


Years ago, the scattered kingdoms of the Britons were nearly united by one of history's greatest princes, Llewelyn the Great, in fulfillment of an ancient prophecy. Llewelyn was the greatest ruler the land had seen since King Arthur. But when he reached the apex of his power, he died, leaving behind a messy succession crisis. And in the chaos, England invaded, leading to a loss of nearly all Llewelyn had won.

Llewelyn II was named after his famous grandfather. He too is destined for greatness and will someday be known to history. But his path to greatness is uncertain: his father and brothers are imprisoned in London, England occupies half of the territory of Gwynedd, raiders harry the coast, and the ruling prince, Llewelyn's uncle, is viewed by many as a usurper. Will he be known as the prophesied Son of Destiny who ruled over a united Kingdom of the Britons, or as the prince who lost everything when England invaded?
autokwd: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon

title: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
description:
게임 정보
The Story
One day, a fox girl and her frog friend find themselves on a mysterious island shrouded by darkness but for a few floating lights.
Torii gates, food stall lanterns, and neon signs give light and color to the island. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

The Game
"Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino" is a 3D action/adventure game focused on the exploration of a mysterious island inspired by Japanese folklore. Kitsune, the titular fox girl, will have to go through exploration sequences and escape sequences where she is being chased by enemies.

In the exploration sequences, you will travel through the island, conversing with its inhabitants and kindling lights within shrines to reach new areas.

During the escape sequences, you will need to outrun the oni demons chasing after you. Kitsune can use light to temporarily blind these monsters, giving her enough time to find safe routes and hiding places. However, the number of times she can use this light is limited, and she has to recharge it at shrines.

Her light also allows her to banish darkness, find hidden paths, and run into more people to talk with.



Looming in the distance is the Tower of Muyo, shining bewitchingly with the lure of myriad stolen lights.
This is the tale of a long summer night, the night of the Jugoya harvest festival...
tag: 탐험,분위기 있는,3D 플랫폼,숨은 그림 및 물체,3D

title: Cloudheim
description:
게임 정보
동료들을 모아 파멸의 그림자가 드리운 세계에서 콤보 중심의 전투를 펼치세요. 물리 공격을 사용해 적을 파괴하면 더 많은 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다. 강력한 능력을 활용하고 강화할 수 있는 무기를 제작하여 새로운 스킬과 치명적인 콤보를 잠금 해제하세요. 비행 거북 기지인 오딘 쉘에서 다양한 섬과 신비로운 던전을 탐험하세요. 
솔로로 플레이하거나 여정을 안내해 줄 캐릭터와 생명체들로 구성된 팀과 함께 최대 4인 온라인 협동 모드를 즐기세요. 클라우드하임은 빠른 속도감의 액션과 역동적인 크래프팅을 결합한 게임으로, 플레이어는 크게 변화할 다채로운 판타지 세계로 빠져들게 됩니다.
혼돈을 정복하라모든 것이 파괴될 수 있는 세계에서 대혼란을 일으키세요. 강력한 능력을 연계하고 위력적인 팀 콤보를 조율하여 적을 물리치세요. 주변의 몬스터들을 향해 기둥을 무너뜨리고, 적들을 회오리에 휘말리게 하며, 대포로 그리블을 발사하고, 폭발하는 통을 싸움터 한가운데로 걷어차세요. 
함께 일어서라온라인 협동 모드에서 최대 세 명의 친구와 힘을 합치세요. 함께 성장하며 잠금 해제한 모든 무기와 능력을 공유하고 새로운 플레이 가능한 캐릭터를 발견하세요.
무한한 가능성을 창조하라시각적 크래프팅 기능이 있어 메뉴에서 친구를 기다릴 필요가 없습니다. 전투에서 사용할 수 있는 무기, 장비, 그리고 강력한 능력을 대량으로 제작하세요. 필요 없다면 판매할 수도 있습니다. 언젠가는 한 세상을 만들 수 있을지도 모릅니다...

title: Summer Road 10-Minute Roguelike
description:
게임 정보


10분 로그라이크 RPG - 바쁜 어른들을 위한
자동전투" x "아이템 수집"x"로그라이크"

화면의 절반을 차지하는 거대한 인벤토리를 활용해 장비를 합성하고 적을 물리쳐라!
전투는 자동이지만, 장비 조합에 따라 캐릭터의 행동이 달라진다.
전략적인 아이템 선택이 승리의 열쇠! 한 번 플레이하는 데 약 10분 정도 소요되어 부담 없이 즐길 수 있다.
선택하는 길과 이벤트에 따라 모험이 달라져, 반복 플레이의 재미가 가득!

추천 대상
아이템 수집가와 빌드 마스터
빠른 플레이 애호가
로그라이크 RPG 매니아



하나의 목표, 무한한 모험

동쪽의 신비로운 빛을 향해 여정을 떠나세요! 매 플레이마다 다른 스토리를 선사하는 10분짜리 RPG입니다. 랜덤 이벤트, 우연한 만남, 그리고 당신의 선택이 길을 결정합니다. 계속해서 플레이하며 새로운 가능성을 발견해 진정한 엔딩을 찾아보세요!



호기심 많은 세 아이가 신비로운 빛의 수수께끼를 풀기 위한 여름 모험을 시작합니다.
그들을 기다리는 시련과 보물은 무엇일까요?


모그모, 여행을 함께하는 신비로운 생명체는 세 개의 아이템을 먹어 새로운 아이템을 만들어냅니다.
상상도 못한 특별한 아이템을 만들기 위해 아이템 조합을 생각해 봅시다!

모그모의 힘을 활용해 모험을 정복하세요!

title: They Speak From The Abyss
description:
게임 정보
THEY SPEAK FROM THE ABYSS is a twisted homage to classic dungeon crawling RPGs. Explore beautifully gruesome environments, solve sinister puzzles, and confront the woeful souls and frightening demons lurking throughout the Abyss.



Step into the shoes of Vanessa Rivera, a young woman who feels lost in her life. After moving to a new city to be closer to her partner, a feeling of dread overwhelms her. Is this a fresh beginning, or the start of something more terrible beyond imagination?



Delve into the Abyss and confront terrifying demons, twisted manifestations, and malevolent devils. Choose your words carefully, as some inhabitants can be reasoned with. But when talking isn’t an option, be ready to engage in heart pounding active-time battles. Practice haste, as blood thirsty beings tend to grow impatient and attack before you’ve made a decision. After all, your flesh is precious…



is about overcoming fears and trauma, and trying to become a stronger person. Players must explore and confront many personal, mature, and often dark themes; themes of body horror and psychological struggle emerged through an expression of hate and anger. The journey of the player is designed to reflect real-world trials and tribulations.

title: The Bugs Manor 🦋
description:
게임 정보

The Bugs Manor is a free top-down 2D pixel art horror game. Explore a cursed mansion, hide from scary monsters, and solve puzzles with an inventory-free gameplay focused on direct interactions with the environment.



The haunted house is full of dangerous creatures, you will need to use the stealth and your wits to escape, but be careful, because if you fail, a bloody death waits for you.



Can you overcome the enigmatic challenges of the manor? Solve multiple puzzles through inventory-free gameplay. This allows you to interact directly with the environment and items without the interruption of annoying menus.



Uncover the dark secrets of the evil Bugs home and its numerous rooms. Follow the story of Danny, a kid who has just moved into the house and is spending his first night there alone. But maybe he's not as alone as he believes...

title: Etheria: Restart
description:
게임 정보
는 도시 이능 전략 턴제 RPG입니다.
전 세계를 뒤엎은 얼음 폭풍... 그로 인해 인류 문명은 붕괴 직전까지 이르게 되었다. 문명의 불씨를 이어가기 위해, 인류는 자아 의식을 가상 세계 '에테리아'로 옮기게 되었다.
'에테리아'에서는 인간뿐만 아니라 아르케 능력을 사용하는 존재인 애니머스들이 함께 살아가고 있다. 두 종족은 '에테리아' 내에서 평화롭게 공존해 왔지만, 어느 날 갑작스레 나타난 '소스 바이러스'라는 재앙이 애니머스들을 감염시키기 시작했다. 바이러스에 감염된 애니머스들이 폭주하며 인간이 위협받게 되었다. 소스 바이러스를 제거하기 위해 슈퍼 링커 협회가 설립되었다.
그리고 이제, 당신은 슈퍼 링커로서 에테리아에서 활동을 시작하게 된다.
[실시간 3D 렌더링, 압도적인 시청각의 향연]
는 언리얼 엔진을 기반으로 현실감 넘치는 조명과 섬세한 디테일, 실시간으로 렌더링된 스토리를 제공하여 마치 영화를 보는 듯한 몰입감을 선사합니다. 전투 중, 각 캐릭터는 전용 전투 애니메이션을 보유하고 있으며, 다채로운 스킬 카메라 연출과 화려한 전투 특수 효과가 절묘하게 어우러집니다. 불필요한 라이트 폴루션 없이 짜릿하고 통쾌한 전투의 극치를 경험해 보세요!

title: Stick It to the Stickman
description:
게임 정보
반갑습니다, [이름]! 당신은 저희가 여태껏 고용한 사람 중 가장 능숙하고 유능한 지원자입니다. 이곳의 편의시설이 마음에 드셨길 바랍니다. 여러분의 재능을 마음껏 뽐내세요!

Stick it to the Stickman은 가능한 한 가장 빠른 방법으로 기업의 사다리를 오르고자 하는 모든 사람을 위한 실용적인 가이드입니다. 이 로그라이크 게임에서 강력한 물리기반 전투, 엄청난 양의 커피, 무기화된 방귀로 사타구니를 차고, 총과 톱을 휘둘러보세요!

동료, 중간 관리자, 상사를 돌파하여 미국 최악의 회사에서 CEO가 되는 길에 더 강력한 "비즈니스 기술"을 배우십시오.

싸우지 않으면 해고당한다
공격은 비즈니스에서 가장 좋은 방어 수단입니다. 죽거나 죽이거나 둘 중 하나지요. 강력한 업그레이드와 본사가 승인한 무기를 선택하여 당신의 스틱맨이 단순한 예스맨 이상인지를 확인하십시오.


노오력하세요
당신의 경력 궤도는 수직이 아닙니다! 새로운 자회사를 통합하여 경쟁에서 우위를 확보하세요. 인수할 때마다 새로운 게임 플레이, 새로운 적, 새로운 보스, 새로운 무기 등이 제공됩니다! 시장을 지배하고 사람들의 마음을 지배하는 대기업을 건설하십시오!


로컬 및 온라인 협동을 통해 당신의 동료는 팀워크의 힘을 사용하여 적대적인 인수를 수행할 수 있습니다.

title: Schrödinger's Call
description:
게임 정보

In a world devoid of human life, you awaken as Mary, the last ear to listen, the last voice to speak.

Forsaken souls seek your help over numerous calls, in a desperate attempt to regain the feelings they've lost.

You are Mary, the last voice they hear, unraveling lost souls with just a telephone.

Souls bound with strong regrets suffer somewhere between the lands of the living and the dead, desperately waiting for someone willing to listen. Will you be that ear and voice?

How to play the game:
Choose the words you want to speak to the souls who cannot die and the actions you want to take to save them and advance the story.
Calling various souls and gathering information is the key to moving forward.

title: Reclaim The Sea
description:
게임 정보
Reclaim the Sea is a roguelike strategy and adventure game, set in a naval pirate fantasy world. Your goal is to lead your pirate crew through dangerous seas, keep your ship in one piece and save the World. Face tough decisions, manage resources, spend gold in equipment, upgrades and new crew. You will encounter different ships from many factions each time and face tough decisions. Will you be a good pirate or reckless buccaneer? Will you defend this civilian ship attacked by thugs? Or will you take advantage of its weakened position? If you engage in a fight, you will have many options: taking down the enemy crew, burning or sinking their ship, staying at long range and playing defensively or engaging at close range… Each run is unique thanks to randomly generated ships and maps.
Command your crew
Order your crew to move in the ship to accomplish all the required tasks : charge weapon, pilot the ship, board the enemy ship, repair the ship and many more!
Set weapon targets
Choose your ship weapons and set their targets. Will you reduce enemy fire power or manoeuvrability? Will you try to kill the enemy crew, destroy their ship or overwhelm it under fire?

title: Hexxen: Hunters
description:
게임 정보
남부 독일의 검은 숲 깊숙한 곳에 지옥문이 열린 지도 어언 수백 년이 지났습니다. 그 후로 세상은 짐승이며 마귀가 다 같이 우글거리는 곳이 되었지만, 더 끔찍한 위협이 가까워진다는 조짐이 나타났습니다. 피할 수 없는 파멸 앞에서 인류를 지킬 마지막 보루로 남은 건 마녀 사냥꾼들뿐입니다.

실시간 탐험과 턴제 전략 전투가 어우러진 RPG, Hexxen: Hunters에서 여러분은 세상의 운명을 짊어진 채 또 다른 어둠의 역사를 살아 나가야 합니다. 외딴 마을을 사악한 이교 집단의 손아귀에서 해방하고 발전시켜 나가는 동시에, 사냥꾼들을 무기와 연금술 혼합물부터 비전 연구와 마법 장비까지 다양한 방법으로 무장시킬 수 있습니다. 극복할 수 없을 것만 같은 역경을 이겨내도록 사냥꾼들을 훈련하면서, 인류를 지키고자 영혼까지 바칠 각오를 하시기 바랍니다.



샛별이 뜨고 죽음의 냄새가 대기 중에 감돕니다. 몇 주 동안 지역 내 주민들이 무언가 때문에 공포에 사로잡혀 있는 가운데, 여러분은 그 위협을 제거하겠다는 청부를 맡습니다. 숲을 누비다 끔찍한 광경을 맞닥뜨리는데, 오늘 사냥해야 할 것은 평범한 구울이나 흡혈귀가 아닙니다...

선택할 수 있는 8명의 독특한 사냥꾼들과 더불어, 해결해야 할 임무에 따라 무수히 많은 선택의 기로에 놓입니다. 흡혈귀, 야행 동물, 악마들은 각기 다른 어려움을 안겨주며, 오랫동안 사이가 좋지 않은 어둠의 인간 이교 집단은 다양한 방식으로 전투를 펼치기에 또 다른 위협이 됩니다.
각 사냥꾼은 나름의 장비는 물론 전문화 기술 계도와 메커니즘이 있어 서로 뚜렷이 구별됩니다. 앞을 막는 자들을 물리치는 데 기묘한 비술을 쓰시겠습니까, 아니면 뛰어난 무술 기량을 펼치시겠습니까? 괴츠 나팔총은 먼 거리에서 강력한 위력을 발휘하지만, 근접전에서는 프란치스카의 정의로운 분노가 가장 강력한 적을 쓰러뜨리는 열쇠입니다. 영혼 정수의 힘으로 펼치는 페이의 비전술을 활용하거나 백마녀 이리나의 휘몰아치는 마법에 의지하여 맹렬한 습격에 맞서 보시기 바랍니다.
엄청난 규모의 무리나 강력하고 무시무시한 존재들과 대결하면서, 공격 패턴을 비롯하여 강점과 약점을 파악하여 그에 맞는 계획을 생각해 내야 합니다. 하지만 방심은 금물입니다. 서사적 임무를 위해 단계적으로 생성되는 지도, 보조 퀘스트, 동료 퀘스트로 여러 번 끝까지 플레이해도 똑같은 경험을 하는 일은 없을 테니까요.



다시 새로운 하루의 태양이 떠오르면, 사냥꾼들은 기진맥진한 채로 돌아옵니다. 먼저 숲속 깊숙한 곳에서 기이한 생물체와 변이된 짐승들을 대적했지만, 수적으로 열세였습니다. 힘든 싸움을 하고 모두 살아남았어도, 그다음 상황을 맞이할 여력은 조금도 남아 있지 않은 상태였습니다. 이전에 본 적 없는 흉물의 습격을 받았는데, 사냥꾼들은 아무런 사전 지식도 없었지만, 결국 승리는 오로지 순수한 믿음의 힘에 의해서만 거둘 수 있음을 깨달았습니다. 여기저기 다치고 부러진 몸을 이끌고 절뚝이며 집으로 돌아오는 그들에게는 휴식이 절실히 필요합니다. 오직 시간이 관건입니다...






어둠이 다시 한번 찾아 들자, 샛별이 밤하늘에서 불길하게 빛나는 가운데 예상치 못한 손님이 마을 외곽에 도착했습니다. 악의 세력은 체계적으로 나타나는 법이 없습니다. 그리고 이교 집단 하나가 자신들의 야망을 더 펼치고자 동맹을 찾고 있습니다. 더 큰 뜻을 위해 마음대로 휘두를 힘을 주겠다고 솔깃해지는 제안을 했지만, 엄청난 대가를 치러야 할지도 모릅니다...

title: Cronos: The New Dawn
description:
게임 정보


동유럽의 브루탈리즘과 복고풍의 미래 기술이 혼합된 어두운 세상을 배경으로 하는 Cronos: The New Dawn은 과거와 미래를 넘나드는 몰입감 넘치는 이야기 속으로 빠져들게 합니다.
과거에서는 인류를 영원히 바꾼 대재앙인 더 체인지의 고통에 빠진 세상을 발견하게 됩니다. 한편, 파괴된 미래의 황무지에서는 매 순간 위험한 괴물들이 생존을 위협하며 당신의 반사 신경과 전술적 사고를 시험합니다.
당신은 여행자이자 의문의 집단인 컬렉티브의 요원으로 활동하며, 미래의 황무지를 샅샅이 뒤져 1980년대 폴란드로 이동할 수 있는 시간의 틈을 찾아야 합니다.
영혼 수확기
여러분의 임무는 다가올 대재앙으로 목숨을 잃을 과거의 핵심 인물들을 찾는 것입니다. 전능한 수확기를 이용하여 정수를 추출하고 미래로 함께 갈 수 있습니다.

title: Salvus: Aries
description:
게임 정보
A story that begins with the heroine meeting her bad end at the chopping block. It can only go uphill from here, right?

Waking up after a long stay in purgatory (that she remembers nothing about), she learns that the rest of her sentence is to serve as a Reaper until the powers above have decided she's paid back her sins.

Through her journey after death as a Reaper, she'll seek out the empty gaps in her memory and reconcile her past with her present. Everyone has something to hide, and unfortunately for them, she's the type to seek out answers. But the biggest challenge for the crew will be to save her from herself.

Or they might all just get a one way ticket to Hell. At best.

Features:



Full Game:
450k+ Words
A story set not only in a modern fantasy world, but will include also beautiful historical settings too.
Beautiful artwork, displayed in the sprites, CGs, and backgrounds.
A lovely OST.
Epilogues to experience sweet stories after achieving happy endings with your desired target.

Choose your fate:
5 Romance Routes to choose from, with the possibility of more in the future through DLC.
Experience both good and bad endings, depending on choices made throughout the game.
A meter to track progress towards a certain type of ending per route.

Fun flavor additions:
Calls and text chats.

title: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3
description:
게임 정보
Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 is "committing to the bit" so hard that it hurts. It's a sequel to a game series that doesn't exist, complete with lore and a fictional development team. It's a game where match-3 is used not just for combat, but for lockpicking doors, debating robots, and swallowing a bunch of diamonds in front of a notorious gem thief so that he can't steal them first. It is, all genre elements considered, a match-3 survival horror comedy RPG metroidvania, and it's rad as hell.
20 years ago, Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion emerged as a smash-hit genre fusion, casting fan-favorite protagonist Jack Briar in a fast-paced puzzle adventure.
8 years ago, Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 was announced on the biggest stage in gaming.
This is what happened next.
What is this?
A match-3 metroidvania--or matchroidvania --exploring the development of a sequel to a game series that doesn't exist.
Another wild genre fusion from the developers behind Clickolding, I Am Your Beast, and Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.
A story about sequels, game development, and the horrible, beautiful things that happen when the foundation of your reality falls apart.
Part match-3 metroidvania, part choice-based narrative, part survival horror parody, part joyful wheel-spinning nightmare.
A game that could only work with a polka soundtrack, provided by award-winning composer David Mason (Dredge, Life Eater).
Committing to the bit.

title: Tiny Bookshop
description:
게임 정보


편안한 분위기로 이어지는 이야기 중심의 경영 게임에서 모든 것을 뒤로한 채 바닷가에 자그마한 서점을 열어 보세요.

작은 책방에 다양한 책과 물건을 들여놓고, 경치 좋은 장소에 책방을 차리며, 아늑한 헌책방을 운영하면서 지역 주민들과 가까워져 보세요.



수집한 물건으로 작은 책방을 장식해 보세요. 식물로 완전히 도배해 버리는 건 어떤가요? 아니면 으스스하게 양초를 켜놓는 분위기가 더 취향에 맞을까요? 각각의 물건으로 손님들에게 영향을 주고, 새로운 메커니즘이 도입됩니다.




















작은 책방의 세계를 여러분께 선사하고자 열심히 작업하고 있습니다. ^_^ Steam에서 저희를 팔로우하고 찜 목록에 추가해 주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.



개발과 관련하여 더 많은 소식을 듣고 싶거나 책을 사랑하는 분들과 대화를 나누고 싶다면, Discord에서 함께해 주세요!

title: BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW
description:
게임 정보


BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW - 가장자리까지 몰아붙이는 초현실적 공포



공포의 악몽 속에 갇힌 따돌림 피해자인 앤으로 플레이하세요. 무시무시한 괴물들로부터 탈출하고 어둠의 수수께끼를 파헤치며 숨막히는 공포를 경험할 수 있습니다.



앤은 과거의 가장 고통스러운 선택들을 직시해야 합니다. 하지만 그녀는 혼자가 아닙니다. 섬뜩한 괴물들이 every step 주변을 서성이며 앤을 괴롭힙니다...앤은 무사히 탈출할 수 있을까요?



는 소셜 미디어가 몰고 오는 끔찍한 영향을 조명하며, 사회문제에 대한 깊은 고찰을 불러일으킵니다.



정신건강, 신체왜곡, 괴롭힘의 공포와 같은 심오한 주제를 다룹니다.



더 스피어 헌터, 애키디어리스트, 엘시 러브락, 샬라 인 재팬, 나이트, 킨 라이언 등 유명 유튜버들이 출연합니다!



➤ 플레이어의 다양한 선택 결과에 따라 여러 개의 결말
➤ 앤이 겪은 트라우마를 상징하는 독특하고 으스스한 괴물들
➤ 다양한 기능의 앤의 스마트폰에 주목하세요.

title: WorldShards
description:
게임 정보

WorldShards is a sandbox MMORPG set in a fantasy world that consists of flying islands. This once prosperous planet, populated with furry meowkles, was shattered into pieces in a terrible cat-a-strophe and was then subjected to an invasion by brutal usurpers – the wargs. Players will have to explore fragments of an ancient world, fight back against the wargs and their treacherous king, and find a way to restore the world of meowkles to its former glory.
Explore the world

Remnants of the ancient world hold many secrets and mysteries. Use the customizable teleportation system to generate islands best suited to your current goals and play style. Solve various puzzles and complete quests to earn valuable rewards.
Gather resources

Extract and process resources, unlock new crafting recipes, create unique items, and trade with other players at the auction! The player driven economy will provide a dynamic and self-regulating marketplace where everyone has a chance to advance themselves without "pay to win" mechanics.

An entire flying island at your disposal where you can build your home, process your resources and set-up crafting stations to make better equipment and weapons. But you are not alone! Find and recruit adorable meowkles as you travel the world.


These NPCs will ensure your operations run smoothly back home. Not only are they a great source of entertainment that will delight you with their presence but they also provide you with various enhancements and additional possibilities.

A levelless character progression system – your skills and play style will depend purely on the weapons and equipment you choose to craft and use. Defeat monsters in dynamic and challenging battles. Use stealth, gadgets and various consumables. Develop unique equipment and create your own tactics.

It is entirely possible to accomplish everything in the game solo but the experience becomes even better with friends! Explore islands, gather resources and fight monsters together, form a clan of like-minded players and show your superiority!

title: Star Rift Saga
description:
게임 정보
On a distant planet, rifts in space are opening, threatening to release planet-devouring monsters into the galaxy. Close the rifts and save the galaxy in this exploration-based action-platformer with light RPG elements.




Explore a vast and connected planet with secrets around every corner including alternate routes, vitality sparks, power sparks, rocket upgrades, rifts, and more. Unlock new areas as your abilities increase, allowing you to traverse new routes.



Fight a variety of enemies and bosses across multiple biomes by using every weapon and skill at your disposal. You'll have to master platforming, dashes, flight, a grapple hook, and more advanced techniques if you want to succeed. Quickly switching between your customizable weapons is essential to keeping your offense going.



Find items and tools to use in the middle of the action to be ready for any situation. Wield the power of over 130 unique skill chips to customize your loadout with new abilities, buffs for every situation, and tweaking your arsenal to match your playstyle.



Upgrade every part of your arsenal! Equip skill chips and find new permanent upgrades throughout the world.
Your character isn't the only thing that grows over the course of your adventure either! to gain new benefits and services at the outpost with each one doing something different. Some will give you new gear or upgrade what you have, some will teach you new moves, while others will offer new goods and services or advice. Sell at the shop to upgrade their inventory and rebuild the outpost.

title: Streets of Rogue 2
description:
게임 정보
Streets of Rogue 2는 모든 것이 가능한 예측불허의 살아있는 오픈월드로 여러분을 초대합니다. 혼자서, 혹은 친구와 팀으로 타락한 대통령을 쓰러뜨리는 정신나간 모험을 떠나보세요. 원하는 방법으로요! Rimworld, Valheim, Stardew Valley, Kenshi, Terraria, Dwarf Fortress 같이 자유를 중점으로 한 스토리 생성 샌드박스 게임을 좋아한다면 Street of Rogue 2는 여러분에게 딱 맞는 게임입니다. 매력적이고, 타협 없는 시스템 주도식 경험으로 플레이어들은 수없이 많은 재밌는 방식으로 세상과 상호작용 가능합니다.

title: Echoes of the Living
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of the Living is a Survival Horror with fixed cameras inspired by the 90's greatest hits but with updated visuals and fully 3D environments with current gen graphics.
STORY
In 1996, on a quiet small town located in Europe, a mysterious fog suddenly rises upon the town in a clear night, their inhabitants have no clue of the horrors and chaos that were about to unleash.
Not longer after, the locals get sick and panic runs all over the place, nobody knows how or why the dead walks on the streets, a few hours later all left in the town are the echoes of the living…

title: First Blood : Persian Legends
description:
게임 정보
JOIN OUR DISCORD


First Blood : Persian Legends is a story-driven real-time-tactic strategy game based on ancient Persia, Sassanid Empire, year 488 CE. Our story is heavily inspired by true events.
Drive different characters from your team to the best of their capabilities and propel the story forward with seemingly impossible stealth missions. Choose different approaches infiltrating a prison, a city or a convoy, set up convenient plans and horrors on the path of your enemies.

The group is composed of different personalities. Over the course of the whole game, the characters in our story cross paths and go through a journey of trust, friendship, loyalty and betrayal.



The story starts with Vahid, The Assassin, working under the spell of Sukhra, a powerful nobleman. Vahid has great stealth mechanics capable of killing a fleet of enemies without any noise. As the rightful heir of the throne, Kavadh, needs rescuing, Vahid goes on a journey to alter the course of history for him and the whole Sassanid empire.

Later we meet Nizar, The General, of the late king. He is a strong character capable of killing multiple foes at once but giving away subtlety of stealth.

Liana, The Concubine, comes along on the second mission where she becomes the driving force of the story. Camouflaging is her main source of power.


Play as three completely different characters with their rich and unique skill sets
Find dozens of ways to infiltrate enemy lines
Execute your objectives with pure stealth mechanics




These three characters, The Assassin, The General and The Concubine are your playable characters to find and survive impossible missions to unlock the history. Can you help saving the Sassanid Empire from within?

title: Sunkissed City
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to your new life in Apollo City, a sun-kissed seaside metropolis that's pumping with funky vibes and quirky characters.

As a fresh hire for the monolithic Pico corporation's new "Peco Pioneer" pilot program, you've been tasked with fostering a relationship with Apollo's vibrant community and putting in a good word for Pico's new eco-focused initiatives.

But all is not well in these bustling streets. The local wildlife has begun to behave more aggressively, the waters are devoid of life, monsters are pouring out from the sewers, and that's not to mention the constant migraines everyone's been having lately.
Features
Enjoy a fresh start in Apollo City!
The city is a big place packed with a myriad of opportunities to occupy the days and nights of your new city life!

Tend to DIY gardens set up by a local band of "plant-punks", spend a quiet afternoon in the park soaking up a good book, or schmooze it up with the locals over coffee at the Weird Dog Cafe. Snap photos of the wildlife around the city and its surrounds. Try your hand at fishing up "the big one" at Marin Shores. Forage for delicious edibles on a hike at Pinnacle Peak. Or perhaps a daring dive into the city's monster infested sewers is more your speed? You could always take up a gig sorting out shipments at the Pico warehouse for some extra cash.

Reinvent yourself!
With endless, deep customization options, you can be whoever you want to be. Pop into Threads to scope out the next piece of your new favorite fit, or get a complete makeover at Salon Flamingo. Make your clothing items your own with hundreds of different colors, patterns and material combinations.

Give your living spaces your personal touch with a variety of fun, functional furniture pieces, or liven up your walls and floors with dozens of wallpaper and flooring types.

Socialize with the cityfolk!
Apollo City is home to a host of kooky characters to get to know (and love!). Build up your relationships with the locals and they'll open up to you with their daily successes and hardships.

Brighten their day by gifting them hand-crafted presents (or maybe even some things you found in the trash...), and help them navigate their sometimes-messy lives in Apollo. You never know when they'll repay the favor.

And if you're on the market to find that special someone, perhaps you'll find others in the city looking for the same!


Work with the Keby, mysterious, prank-loving forest creatures, to tackle the various maladies afflicting the city and take back Apollo from the forces draining it of its color!


features both online and split-screen multiplayer cooperative modes for you to enjoy your new city life alongside friends and family. Customize your experience with per-player difficulty and accessibility options to tailor the experience to groups of any gaming ability!

title: Hotel Galactic
description:
게임 정보
Hotel Galactic은 낡아빠진 은하계 호텔을 번성하는 관광지로 변모시키는 아늑한 경영 게임입니다. 스튜디오 지브리의 매력적인 세계에서 영감을 받은 Hotel Galactic은 따뜻한 향수와 현대 동화의 마법을 결합하여, Ancient Forge가 만든 새로운 시대의 시뮬레이션 게임으로 여러분을 초대합니다.



창의적인 비전을 표현하며 호텔의 모든 면을 디자인하고 커스터마이즈하세요. 모듈형 건축 메커니즘을 사용하여 독특하고 꿈같은 구조물을 만드세요. 객실을 개조하고, 가구를 손님의 취향에 맞추며, 은하계에서 가장 아름다운 휴양지를 만드세요. 객실 배치부터 작은 장식 선택까지 모든 요소를 관리하세요.



최적의 동선으로 호텔 레이아웃을 구성하여 손님과 직원 모두가 효율적으로 목적지에 도달할 수 있도록 하세요. 숙련된 플레이어는 끊임없이 변화하는 방문객들의 요구를 전략적으로 충족시키기 위해 적절한 아이템과 장식을 선택할 수 있으며, 트렌드와 선호도를 앞서나가도록 호텔을 지속적으로 업데이트할 수 있습니다. 행동 우선순위를 설정하고, 새로운 작업을 생성하며, 직원들을 필요한 곳으로 이동시켜 쇼를 즐기세요!



할아버지 구스타프가 설계한 호텔은 우주의 광활한 공간을 떠도는 마법의 떠다니는 섬에 자리잡고 있습니다. 녹지대에 흩어져 있는 다양한 자원을 수확하고, 목초지로 가는 경로를 복구하며, 새로운 외계 식물과 귀여운 동물들로 섬을 채우세요. 다양한 재료와 생산물을 수집하고, 독특한 요리 시스템을 사용하여 맛있는 요리로 변환하세요. 모든 것이 여러분의 디자인에 달려 있습니다!



할아버지 구스타프라는 유령 가이드가 이끄는 개성 넘치는 사랑스러운 캐릭터들을 만나보세요. 각각 고유한 능력과 특성을 지닌 다양한 외계 동료들을 고용하고 관리하세요. 세대를 거쳐 노동자들이 지식과 기술을 새로운 직원들에게 전달하며 단합감을 키우는 모습을 지켜보세요. 손님들과 친구가 되어 그들의 이야기를 배우고, 호텔을 진정한 집처럼 느끼게 만드세요.



가장 똑똑한 직원을 활용하여 호텔 개발을 위한 새로운 도구, 장비 및 기술을 제작하고 연구하세요. 공급 라인을 개선하고 새로운 자원을 발견하여 제작 요구를 항상 충족시키도록 하세요. 다양한 손님 유형에 맞춰 호텔을 조정하고, 각 손님이 다른 연구 분야를 해제할 수 있게 합니다. 나중에는 으스스한 지하 복합 단지로 뛰어들어 새로운 재료와 생물을 발견하고 건설 공간을 확장하세요.


마법 같은 여정을 시작하여 Hotel Galactic을 복원하고, 전 세계 여행자들에게 사랑받는 목적지로 만드세요. 창의적인 과정을 포용하고, 새로운 아이디어를 실험하며, 여러분의 돌봄 아래 호텔이 번창하는 모습을 지켜보세요. 우리와 함께 시뮬레이션 게임의 새로운 시대를 함께 만들어갑시다.

title: Gilded Destiny
description:
게임 정보
Gilded Destiny is a grand strategy game depicting the transformative era of the Industrial Revolution. You will take the helm of the country of your choice and transform it from a backward agrarian society to an industrial powerhouse. The game is a deep simulation of societal transformation, industrialization, the economy, warfare, and diplomacy.
