title: Re: Spin. Die. Repeat.
description:
게임 정보
Re: Spin. Die. Repeat. is a slot machine-inspired roguelike deckbuilder where you create powerful synergies to craft unique builds. Unlock and add hundreds of unique symbols, items, characters, and create your own isekai world with your spins. Immerse into a classic fantasy adventure or be reborn into a random isekai world—no matter what, it will be a game of chance and skill.

title: The pet squad
description:
게임 정보
What is T.P.S.?
The Pet Squad is a 2D strategy and puzzle game with pixel art aesthetics, mainly inspired by Lemmings, that puts you in the role of a support operator.
The game is set in the not-too-distant future, where humans have managed to artificially evolve animals. The pet squad SLU is an organization responsible for maintaining order between humans and the evolved animals, known as Animanos.
As an operator, you will have to support your squad at all times, guide them along the correct path, and protect them from enemies or themselves. To achieve this, you will have access to the most advanced technology, allowing you to teleport objects and even slow down time.
Think about how to help your squad and use the objects to achieve the goal.
Keep in mind that there are multiple interactions between objects.
Gather your to solve cases and complete missions. Keep in mind that each one has .

title: NONEWORLD
description:
게임 정보
NONEWORLD is a captivating RPG adventure set in strange universe caught in the grasps of destruction.
As a lost Princess from another world, you awaken in a strange, forgotten kingdom once full of life; now only a fading memory. 
Join forces with new allies, fight horrifying foes and destroy a lot of farmland in your journey to return home. But be warned: what seems cute at first may soon take a darker turn. 
Dive into a haunting, hand-drawn world with a captivating narrative and abstract characters.
Play through THREE immersive story chapters, each packed with unique gameplay elements; each requiring roughly an hour to complete.
Master a unique turn-based battle system, featuring nearly 100 powerful abilities and monsters straight out of your sleep paralysis episodes.

title: There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin
description:
게임 정보
Secret agent Franklin Benjamin's former-mentor-turned-rogue-agent Dustin MacGuffin has resurfaced to take from you that which you hold most dear. In this single-player interactive spy novel, play as secret agent Franklin Benjamin and use your particular set of skills to save Virginia from the clutches of the madman Dustin MacGuffin. Which means - you’d better get the MacGuffin!
Your Mission
It was supposed to be the rarest of all things - a day with no mission. That is, until you woke up to find Virginia gone and a note left behind telling you she had been taken. That note was left behind by your old partner, Dustin MacGuffin, who's since gone rogue - now he's up to something and using her as leverage to keep you from getting involved. Talk about a grave miscalculation
Now, you're taking matters into your own hands to get her back. This is not a sanctioned mission, so you're on your own this time using resources outside the usual channels. But you will get the MacGuffin ... whatever it takes
There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin can be played with just a mouse. Gameplay consists of selecting the action or dialog you wish to take given the situation you’re facing. Although the life of a secret agent is complicated, playing There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin is simple
Sequel or Standalone
There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin is the fourth entry in the There's Always a Madman series, but it tells a standalone story. Like a classic James Bond novel or film where you can pick any one up independent of the rest, you can pick this story up without having experienced any prior stories in the There's Always a Madman franchise. However, I would recommend starting with the first game There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight if you care to experience the series in its intended order
Make Them Talk
Will you go on a full rampage or are you just a professional applying your particular set of skills? Choose the tools for how you want to get the job done, interrogate the henchmen standing in your path, and work your way up the chain to get to the man behind it all
This Time, It's Personal
autokwd: There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin

title: Mark's power
description:
게임 정보
Mark's Power is an RPG with dialogues, crafting, gathering and turn-based battles. Explore the world where fate has thrown you, and tilt the cup of fate in your favor. Win over the locals, fight the enemies, and do not forget about the main goal — to repair your ship and go home! Or maybe it's worth using your power and...

Technology transfer
One of the key features of this game is the ability to transfer technology, accelerating the natural development of local residents. For example, by teaching the art of making steel things, we will be able to hire stronger warriors armed with sharp swords. On the other hand, the sooner the locals create their first atomic bomb, the worse it will be for us, right?
History
Find out the history of the world where fate has thrown you. Why are the island and lowland states fighting among themselves? What do the remains of giant mechanisms mean?
Trading
There is no money in this wild world, and only the objects themselves have value. Find out the trader's weakness in order to make a profitable exchange. Tip the scales in your favor!
Crafting
You can use your portable manufacturer to create various things. Usually, the created thing is more valuable than the ingredients, so you can make good money on it.
You can collect wild pumpkins and other resources, and then use them for trading or crafting.
You can explore the corners of locations, solve riddles and receive a significant reward for your curiosity.
To win the battles, you can hire several warriors from the locals. Their strength depends on the thickness of your wallet

The game is easy to control and does not require a long understanding of the mechanics.

title: Talewarden: Riders of the New Day
description:
게임 정보
The currently available free version is a demo,
the full paid version is a work in progress!
Plot 
Notoria is a vast, desolate wasteland where time stands still. Shortly after you have fallen there, you will be escorted to Cradletown - an old town nestled in the mountains that serves as a refuge for those who, just like you, have suddenly fallen from other worlds.  
Later, you will return to the desert and join the notorious Riders of the Night to explore Notoria in search of answers to what is happening here. You'll visit many different locations and investigate unexplained anomalies that have recently appeared on the planet.
autokwd: Talewarden: Riders of the New Day

title: Remembrance
description:
게임 정보
Unravel a Mind in Crisis. Save a World in Peril.
Remembrance invites you to dive deep into the fractured memories of Professor Isaac Nemeth, a brilliant but broken scientist whose revolutionary work holds the key to humanity’s survival. Guiding Dr. Bell, a renowned psychologist, you’ll navigate surreal landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the haunting truths buried in his subconscious.
A World of Mystery and Emotion
Explore a series of richly detailed, dreamlike environments that represent the professor’s most pivotal and painful moments. From a star-filled childhood bedroom holding the promise of a bright future to the chaos of his shattered laboratory and a broken life, every memory offers a glimpse into the choices that shaped the man and the secrets he’s desperate to hide.
Key Features:
• Immersive VR Gameplay: Experience the game’s intricate world and emotionally charged story from a fully immersive, first-person perspective.
• Thought-Provoking Puzzles: Solve mind-bending challenges that mirror the professor’s fragmented psyche.
• Emotional Narrative: Dive into a deeply human story of ambition, loss, and redemption.
• Richly Crafted Worlds: Traverse environments that blend memory, emotion, and a lifetime of regret.
Will You Be the Key to Humanity’s Salvation?
Remembrance is more than a game, it’s a journey through the depths of memory, morality, and hope. Step into the professor’s mind and discover what remains when everything else is stripped away. The fate of the world and the legacy of a lifetime are in your hands.

title: Deep Water
description:
게임 정보
This is a roguelike game with RPG elements.
Embark on an adventure through dynamically generated mines, each hiding fantastical biomes waiting to be unearthed. 
Defend against relentless waves of aggressive monsters utilizing your mobile base as your stronghold. Look for resources to upgrade your crab.
Travel to the bottom of the ocean, navigating changing weather conditions under the sun or the cover of darkness.

title: A Recipe  Survival - Cat Cooking Roguelike Deckbuilder
description:
게임 정보
Strategise, Serve, Protect, Survive and Collect in this visually stunning and exciting twist on a roguelike deckbuilder.
In A Recipe for Survival you must traverse 3 turbulent weeks, serving customers by day and protecting your restaurant by night. All while you uncover the mystery of what is causing the strange events in Whiskerwell and develop your own recipe for survival!
Develop your 2 decks and make decisions that impact both decks simultaneously, it is important to consider the impact any choice you might make on both your day and night!
During the day you must act as head chef of a team of kitty cooks! By serving the customers you can earn tips and stop them becoming angry when they transform into monsters while darkness falls.
At night, the same customers you worked so hard to serve come back, but they are no longer human! Under the light of the moon, they have turned into various mythological creatures from all over the world. They have been sent to take over your restaurant!
Survive the week and defeat powerful bosses assisted by your cat chefs! These bosses are a real challenge and will allow your restaurant to grow! By defeating the final boss your restaurant will be granted an esteemed Mitchel Star!
autokwd: A Recipe  Survival - Cat Cooking Roguelike Deckbuilder

title: Two: Solar Home
description:
게임 정보
《Two: Solar Home》
 is a local co-op platformer game for two players, featuring impressive pixel art and handcrafted levels. Players take on the roles of a brother and sister exploring the collapsed solar system and the silent, deserted space of their once-thriving home to uncover past secrets.
Embark on a cooperative journey, finding joy in overcoming challenges together.
Use your spaceship as a mobile home, collecting items and achievements along the way.
Enjoy a heartwarming and captivating storyline.
Experience the elusive, flying hearts you strive to capture.
The game controls are relatively simple and finely tuned, using just a few basic buttons to maneuver the characters. Level elements enhance the experience, offering a unique sense of excitement.
You can clearly see the path through each level, but good coordination and occasional observation of each other’s actions are essential for success.
Relax and enjoy...
We hope you enjoy it, especially if you're a fan of platformer—this is a must-try!

title: Cold Chains
description:
게임 정보


Cold Chains는 미스터리가 가득한 황량한 환경을 배경으로 한 1인칭 서바이벌 호러 게임입니다.

수년간의 혼수 상태에서 깨어난 후, 버려진 병원에서 홀로 남겨지고, 폭력적인 생물과 절망적인 고통으로 가득한 이 악몽에서 답을 찾고 탈출구를 찾아야 합니다.

장소를 탐험하고, 길을 따라 발견한 것을 활용하세요. 이곳에 온 첫 번째 사람이 아니며 마지막도 아닐 것입니다. 과거에 쓰러진 사람들이 남긴 짐을 사용하지만, 이 유령이 나오는 곳에서 다음으로 죽지 않도록 조심하세요.
자유 탐험
많은 내부와 위협이 있는 열린 지도를 탐험하세요.
약탈과 생존
길을 따라 발견한 것으로 장비를 갖추세요. 여정은 쉽지 않을 것이고, 살아남고 탈출구를 찾기 위해 찾을 수 있는 모든 것이 필요할 것입니다.
싸움
전역에 널려 있는 방대한 무기고로 당신의 길을 가로막는 모든 위협을 파괴하세요.
다양한 게임 모드
스토리 모드에서 여정을 마무리하고 끝없는 절차적 던전 크롤링 모드를 즐기세요.

콜드 체인은 탐험, 전투, 퍼즐을 포함하는 고전적인 서바이벌 호러 경험입니다.
당신의 삶을 위해 싸우거나, 탈출하거나, 갇힌 방랑자가 되세요!
company: Gustavo Lucas, Retro Head Game Studio

title: Inside Darkness
description:
게임 정보
Inside Darkness is a captivating 2D puzzle-platformer set in a fantasy world, offering a unique gameplay experience that revolves around the contrast of light and shadow. You play as a young girl who can transform into a monster when engulfed in darkness. In this world of alchemical secrets and lurking dangers, you’ll face challenging puzzles and uncover the dark mysteries of an ancient kingdom.
Key Features:
Immersive Fantasy World: Explore ancient catacombs and dungeons filled with hidden threats and mysterious mechanisms. Alchemical labs, secret passages, and dangerous creatures of the dark await around every corner.
Unique Transformation Mechanics: In darkness, the girl transforms into a powerful and dangerous monster, strong and agile. However, in the light, she reverts to her human form, quick but vulnerable. Use both forms strategically to overcome enemies and solve a variety of challenges.
Puzzles and Traps: The game features numerous logical challenges and dangerous traps. Combine the monster's strength and the girl’s agility to navigate secret passages and discover hidden levels.
Deep Story with Multiple Endings: Experience an intense narrative filled with betrayal, magic, and hidden truths. Uncover the secrets of the protagonist’s origin and fight against the queen’s tyranny. Your choices and actions will shape the outcome, unlocking different endings and pathways.
Hidden Levels and References: Find secret locations and bonus levels, unlock unique content, and explore the world of Inside Darkness to uncover all its mysteries and references to classic works.
Visual Style and Atmosphere: Beautifully crafted 2D environments and animations immerse you in a fantastical and mysterious world, combining fairytale-like aesthetics with the allure of ancient legends.
Inside Darkness combines an engaging story, innovative light and dark mechanics, and numerous puzzles and hidden secrets. Fans of puzzle-platformers, adventure games, and fantasy will find plenty to love in this unique experience!

title: End Of World - Story
description:
게임 정보
STAY TUNED FOR BETA ACCESS
You are a retired space marine enjoying the tranquility of your space farm. But then, something happens... and you will need to go back to missions.

Embark on a cosmic saga where evolution and technology intertwine in unimaginable ways!

"In EOW the gameplay of each scenario is like an Indiana Jones mini-movie: you are dropped into an exotic place, you talk to a couple dozen NPCs, figure out the enigma, collect some necessary items, battle monsters and finally find the relic and triumph."

EXPLORE FOUR UNIQUE CIVILIZATIONS
Journey through a universe with Space Apes mastering the cosmos, Cyborg Wild Beasts embodying the fusion of nature and technology, Sentient Penguins ruling icy domains, and Humans pushing the frontiers of science and exploration.

Go on daring missions across the galaxy's most breathtaking locations. As ancient relics resurface, you'll need to outsmart rivals and navigate the unknown to recover these powerful artifacts, each holding the key to untold powers and secrets.


Balance resource management, facility building, and family life while guiding your space colony through the galaxy's challenges.

Dive into space farming and civilization building, drawing inspiration from renowned farming and life simulation games, but set in the vastness of space.


In a galaxy reshaped by a quantum event, four civilizations emerge from the ashes of Earth's tumultuous history. The Space Apes, once Earth's explorers, now soar through the stars. The Cyborg Wild Beasts, an ode to nature's resilience, roam the lands. The Sentient Penguins, evolved from the icy wastelands, unveil technologies that defy the harshest environments. And the Humans, reborn from chaos, constantly innovate, ever driven to explore the unknown.

The quantum event not only redefined technology and life itself but also set the stage for a new era. As Year 499 post-quantum event dawns, these civilizations face unknown challenges and unforeseen connections. Each step into the future brings them closer to each other, intertwining their destinies in a story rich with exploration, conflict, and discovery.

Will you guide our protagonist through trials and triumphs? What secrets will you uncover in this galaxy of endless possibilities? Can you shape the destiny of a universe on the brink of a new epoch? The journey awaits...

title: 龙之塔
description:
게임 정보
게임 플레이
이 게임은 뱀파이어 생존자 게임으로, 1명의 영웅과 4마리의 몬스터를 조합하여 다른 팀으로 게임을 진행할 수 있습니다.
일정한 숨겨진 조건을 달성하면 영웅이 각성하여 더 강력한 힘을 얻을 수 있습니다.
게임에 들어간 후 몬스터를 빠르게 처치하여 경험치를 얻고 레벨업해야 합니다.
레벨업 후 4가지 선택 중 하나의 스킬을 선택하고 영웅이나 몬스터에 할당할 수 있습니다.
스킬의 효과는 영웅이나 몬스터의 속성에 따라 다릅니다.
살아남은 시간이 길수록 올라갈 수 있는 층이 높아지고 몬스터도 강해집니다.

게임 목표
용의 탑을 가능한 한 높은 층까지 오르며, 높은 층수로 갈수록 위험이 커지고 얻는 보상이 풍부해지며 더 오래 살아남는 것이 목표입니다.

게임 특징
1명의 영웅과 4마리의 용을 선택하여 다양한 특성을 가진 팀을 구성하고 게임 내에서 무작위로 나오는 스킬과 조합할 수 있습니다.
2영웅은 각성할 수 있습니다.
3게임 내 스킬은 자동으로 발동되어 보다 편안한 플레이를 제공합니다.
4올라갈수록 난이도가 올라가고 내려갈수록 난이도가 낮아져서 페이스를 자유롭게 조절할 수 있습니다.
5아이템과 스킬이 풍부합니다.
6레벨업 시 게임이 중단되지 않으며, E 키를 눌러 모든 스킬 포인트를 한 번에 사용할 수 있습니다.

title: 9Cat Saga
description:
게임 정보
9Cat is a free-to-play isometric co-op shooter, but with cute cats and a vast variant of gears and cats that completely alter your playstyles..
You will wander in the ever-changing landscapes to scavenge resources and shoot your way out of trouble.
Recruit more 9Cats, collect more gears, gather your friends to form a squad of up to 4 kittens and defeat bosses… but we warned, it will require much more than shooting.
How will you raise your 9Cat? A mighty warrior, a geeky technician or a spell weiding wizard? Let’s find out in 9Cat Saga.

title: Plagueborn
description:
게임 정보
Explore a long forgotten world
It has been 100 years since a malevolent plague spewed from the earth and extinguished almost all life. Travel to decrepit villages and find out how to prevent the next coming of the plague!

title: Tower Builder
description:
게임 정보
Tower Builder is a building and design game. The main goal is to build the biggest tower while not going bankrupt. This is an engineering and cost management game. The beams, columns and floors have structural properties. The plan for this game is for either single player or multiplayer in three modes.

• Challenge mode: you play the role of a Developer, Engineer and Builder with limitation in place. You have to strategize to construct the tower tall and strong enough that the it does not collapse without going bankrupt.
• Free Build mode: you have no size limit and unlimited funds, but the tower has structural properties.
• Sandbox mode: you can build and decorate as you like.

title: Kosmosis
description:
게임 정보
Two xenobiologists find themselves stranded on a mysterious planet that appears intent on their anihilation.
Explore the eerie landscapes shrouded in darkness, solve intricate challenges, and battle against the relentless forces of this hostile world.
Each decision you make could mean the difference between survival and becoming a victim of the planet’s deadly secrets.
Will you uncover the truth behind Simon's disappearance and escape the clutches of this hostile environment, or will you succumb to the horrors of Kosmosis? Your fate lies in your hands.
Twisted story
Dark monochromatic pixel art
Horrid mosters
Top-down explorer
Shooter
Adventurer

title: Quasis: The Last Eclipse
description:
게임 정보
Key Features
100+ hours of gameplay.
A living, breathing world that reacts to player's actions.
20+ recruitable allies (party members), each with their own backstory, character and playstyle.
3 overlapping worlds - Real World, Matrix and Augmented Reality(AR). To solve a problem in one of them you'll often have to visit another.
Hundreds of engaging quests.
Complex in-game economy system.
6 distinct endings.
10 huge Technopolises, dozens of Grey Zones, Gaia's Groves and countless locations for exploration.
150+ enemy types (Mutants, cyborgs, robots, etc..)
200+ hand-crafted matrix servers to hack into.

The game also features a vast variety of equipment. Mix and match to heart's content:
4 types of weapons (pistols, machine guns, shotguns, and heavy weaponry)
4 generations of weapons (gunpowder, magnetic-kinetic, laser, and plasma)
13+ ammunition types for each generation.
Hundreds of weapon modifications.
20+ types of cybernetic implants for your team.
12 generations of cyberdecks, each featuring 24 unique modifications.
General Info
Quasis: The Last Eclipse is an isometric RPG combining the ruthless wastelands of post-apocalypse with a spectacle of cyberpunk aesthetics. The game features turn based tactical combat and action packed real-time hacking, a variety of different realms and dimensions, contrasting with the real world, such as AR (Augmented Reality) and Matrix, different points of view depending on the realm the player is in… and many more other novelties and surprises.
Your decisions will be reflected throughout the game — NPCs may treat you based on your actions, new dialogue options may appear and the questlines may shift toward different outcomes. The fate of the world is in your hands, whether you decide to re-build Phoenix and bring down the corporate elites, aid Gaia's Children and become one with nature or just get lost exploring the corners of the vast and expansive world of Quasis.
No part of the world went untouched by the catastrophe. Some never recovered, the others changed beyond recognition. From radioactive wastelands and overgrown ruins to a village lost in fog or a sentient forest... you'll get to visit them all.
But beware! When you look deep into the a mutated forest, there might be something looking back at you.
No matter the gun you have, the bullet is the thing that deals the actual damage. That is the principle our equipment system is built around. 12 calibers and 13 types of ammunition ranging from armor-piercing to EMP smart-round, mix and match to your hearts content. Now extrapolate that attention to detail to shields, grenades, abilities and augmentations and what you get are incredibly deep and varied progression and equipment systems.
During real-world combat, you will have to rely on tactical planning and careful positioning, analyze your enemies' weaknesses and make precise orders to your party members. Your weapons, ammunition and implants can make the difference between getting shiny loot and getting your party killed.
The AR implant, which is mandatory in all technopolices provides a decent tradeoff for most.
After all, few would choose a real apocalypse over a fake utopia.
But those brave enough to look beyond the smoke and mirrors, will find themselves in a city completely different to the one they used know. Secret passages, people deemed "undesirable" and shady business hidden in plain sight. Those are just some of the things the corporations try to keep out of your sight.
To enter the Matrix you'll need a specialized device called "cyberdeck". It is a portable personal computer that you get to build on your own. Mix and match hundreds of components and hunt down the best software to achieve peak performance.
To complete a matrix run you will need to go through a few different stages, first of which would be the transport layer. In the fast paced stream of data that is the digital highway you will need to evade clusters of code to get to the target server.
While on your way, you can visit proxy servers to buy yourself some time to burn through while hacking.
Once you go through the transport layer you enter the target server and face dozens of nodes that may contain anything from top secret data and military grade software to the control panel of the whole city. Each node is guarded by a cyber-sentinels. Matrix combat is a unique real-time experience where you will need to multi-task between a number of different mini-games, all while managing your stats, dealing damage and analyzing enemy weak spots.
"Last Time Studio" was created as a shared project of people passionate to bring our dream worlds to life. Our first shared creation, Quasis: The Last Eclipse is a game that combines both innovation and new takes on classic RPG mechanics.

We are an independent studio. That is a decision that was made on day one and it has been the cornerstone of our philosophy ever since. We think that compromising on our vision would defeat the purpose of the whole enterprise, so we seek funding through sources that wouldn't put restrictions on our creative process. We are currently running a crowdfunding campaign and any help would be much appreciated.

If our mission statement resonates with you, we would like to invite you to our Discord community, where you can help us shape the world of Quasis.

title: Frenzy Fall
description:
게임 정보
Go up! 
In Frenzy Fall, you control a 🗡️sword that must go up. Hold left or right to charge your launch, then release to catapult it at different angles, aiming for the best position to continue your climb.

title: Ghouls & Guardians
description:
게임 정보
Ghouls & Guardians is a tower defense and strategy game where you:
Build and manage your defenses
Gather resources
Defend from attacks of creatures roaming the night by strategically placing towers
The game offers highly replayable gameplay that encourages strategic creativity while keeping a challenging pace.

title: EOPRISM
description:
게임 정보
EOPRISM is the educational puzzler that Millennial & Gen Z gamers wished they grew up with. You'll shoot solutions at your foes and obstacles as you quickly solve mathematical expressions in our 3 available game modes.
Story Mode is a short but re-playable adventure where no two runs are the same. Jump between quadrants, dodge tricky tangents, and foil The Ianfinite's (Villain) calculated plans with the future of Math. With procedurally generated equations, every playthrough is a fresh challenge in an endless loop of fast-paced problem-solving.

title: Medic Mayhem
description:
게임 정보
Medic Mayhem is a fast-paced action game where your ambulance will turn the tide of battle. Speed through chaotic toy battlegrounds to rescue wounded soldiers and deliver them to your field hospital. Once healed, soldiers rejoin the fight – and the side with the most saved troops wins!
Key Features:
• Intense Gameplay: Dodge obstacles, drift out of tight spots, and use nitro boosts to escape sticky situations.
• Fun For All: Enjoy singleplayer, local co-op, or competitive PvP battles against AI or friends.
• Dynamic Arenas: Battle it out across three unique maps designed for non-stop action.
• Medic Powers: Collect in-game powerups like the magnet boost or troop vacuum to gain an edge in the fight.
• No Language Barrier: No in-game text ensures you can enjoy playing no matter what your language is.
Throttle into Medic Mayhem and prove your skills on the chaotic toy battlefield. Can you win the war by saving lives?

title: Rod of Asclepius
description:
게임 정보


Explore ancient Pannonia, master the art of historical medicine, and uncover the secrets of Late Antiquity in this narrative-driven RPG.

Rod of Asclepius is a historical RPG set in the 4th-century Roman province of Pannonia Secunda. You play as a Roman medicus, responsible for diagnosing, treating, and saving lives using authentic medical techniques from the era. As war and disease spread across the empire, your choices will shape the fate of those around you.

Blending exploration, turn-based medical procedures, and historical accuracy, Rod of Asclepius immerses players in the challenges faced by ancient healers. Investigate mysterious ailments, gather rare herbs, and balance the ethical dilemmas of early medicine.
Features
✅ Authentic Historical Setting – Explore archeologically researched Roman-era locations, customs, and medical techniques.
✅ Turn-Based Medical Challenges – Perform surgeries, mix remedies, and apply treatments in a strategic, skill-based system.
✅ Resource Management – Collect medicinal plants, tools, and rare ingredients to craft life-saving treatments.
✅ Isometric Pixel Art – A unique 2.5D pixel-art aesthetic that brings Late Antiquity to life.
✅ Investigation & Diagnosis – Unravel medical mysteries by questioning patients, studying symptoms, and making tough decisions.
✅ Morality & Reputation System – Your medical ethics influence how NPCs react to you and shape your standing in Roman society.

Can you survive as a healer in a collapsing empire?
Wishlist now and begin your journey into the world of Roman healing.

title: Lecture Me Later
description:
게임 정보
You wake up in a classroom way after your lecture concludes. The person who wakes you up looks familiar. Oh right, it's that one popular guy that everyone likes. Vahn. Wait, Vahn??! Why???
He was in one of your classes this semester, but you've never spoken to him before. Besides you two, the room is empty. Everyone else had already left ages ago. And no one else bothered waking you up? Rude.
With the light of the setting sun on your skin, you engage in conversation with the popular young man, realizing that things are taking a very scandalous turn, and that his interests are far more fascinating than you'd originally think.
Lecture Me Later is an otome/visual novel with a single love interest set in a University  setting. Chat with Vahn and see what kind of freaky interesting things he's into.

title: OMNN
description:
게임 정보
A tale of hubris in the far-flung future,  inspired by that one Sci-Fi novel.
The Story:
NSY 10,006, It is the waning days of the emperor Neath Ithicia’m the second. No clear heir to the throne of the Galactic Ithicia’m Empire exists. Follow the secretive Black Matter Adventists as they hatch a plot to take power over the throne.
OMNN is a grand space opera inspired by various Sci-Fi media and vintage 3D games. Experience a grand plot to undermine universal power.
Features:
Mele combat: Learn to dash, block and crit your opponents. 
A deep story:  Talk to NPCs and read logs scattered throughout the world.
Diverse locations: Explore multiple parts of the galactic Ithicia’m Empire. Experience barren wastes and opulent keeps.

title: Hash Line
description:
게임 정보
Play as an Artificial intelligence. Go through training and become an elite member of your systems cyber security program. Strike down your foe with your cyber blade. Use your precision and agility to eliminate your adversaries. Save your system from destruction.

Uncover the truth. Save your system from the infection. Show your creator the light. Protect your world while being pitted against the spread of malicious foes. Cut down your enemy. Deconstruct the virus. Fight for your existence.

STRIKE WITH PRECISION
Take control with precise strikes to eliminate your enemy. Control the angle of your slice to cut around your foes defences. Strike with haste, strike with strength, strike with precision.

CHANGE THE PLAYING FIELD
Cut apart your environment to take the advantage on your foes. Remove any obstacles in your way. Destroy the virus.

FAST FLUID MOVEMENT
Traverse levels with ease. The fluidity of movement will keep the battle at its best.

TAKE CONTROL OF TIME IT SELF
Control time. Control combat. Slow time to gain an edge of complex sword strikes. Splitting bullets, slicing fragments, controlling the fight.

title: Death and Tactics
description:
게임 정보
"Death and Tactics" is a top-down Strategy RPG inspired by "Lisa: The Painful" and the "Fire Emblem" series with a heavy focus on permanent death elements.  With 50 playable characters, each with their own unique items to unlock and events to experience depending on on who lives and who dies in your party, "Death and Tactics" is an incredibly replayable experience where your choices in the gameplay have long lasting consequences.
One of the overall goals is to be a Strategy RPG that doesn't waste your time. Permanent death is incorporated into almost every system to create convenience. Players won't ever feel pressured to grind, reset, etc, if one of their party members falls in battle. Each death creates a new strategic opportunity for the player to explore.
20 years after nuclear bombs wiped out most of humanity, mutants wander the earth and the last remnants of humanity are divided. While some leaders decided to take a more "old-school" approach to governance...
Others have had... more unique ideas on how to take advantage of the apocalypse to, say the least...

title: Football Story
description:
게임 정보
Customize
Customize your character from head to toe with a range of vibrant outfits. Unlock cool items by earning Cash through multiplayer matches or quests. If you’re going to become a legendary football player, you’ll need to look the part!

title: DINO FARM
description:
게임 정보
An adventure tamagotchi game where you care for dinosaurs, collect them, and become a true paleontologist!
Raise dinosaurs: feed, wash, and play with them.

title: Evolvania
description:
게임 정보
에볼바니아에서 여러분은 안약을 찾아 헤매는 신비한 방랑자의 역할을 맡게 됩니다.
거대한 생명체 속으로 들어가 그 안에 숨겨진 신비한 비밀을 발견하세요. 생생하고 섬뜩한 디테일로 손수 그려진 구석구석을 탐험하세요.
불안하고 수작업으로 만들어진 세계
거대한 짐승의 기묘한 내부 풍경에 빠져보세요. 떨어지는 물방울 하나하나가 발견되기를 기다리고 있는 이야기를 들려줍니다.

title: Farewell
description:
게임 정보
Two people stood on the bridge. They smiled and looked into each other's eyes. Suddenly, the boy whispered.
"I know everything."
The girl shuddered with terror. A third participant in the drama entered the scene - a knife. The corpse fell and disappeared into the raging river.
But that's for the last day. As of right now.......
Features:
* >5 unique endings.
* >19 CG
* Walkthrough: 40-50 minutes
autokwd: Farewell, we see each other  the last time.....

title: Exist.EXE
description:
게임 정보
Exist.EXE is a puzzle adventure where players assume the role of Marcus, a game developer who never moved on from his mother’s death. One day, he gets sucked into the digital world where he can use his programming skills to hack things and shape them to what he needs them to be.
Along the way, he realizes this is also a self-discovery journey for him as an AI entity resembling his dead mother persuades him to stay in the digital world and avoid sadness in real life while his best friend reminds him to stay true to reality instead of delving into the concept of a fake perfect world. Players will get to experience gameplay with distinctive and captivating visuals in pixel art blended with modern design elements.


Dive into an Immersive Digital World
Experience gameplay like never before with captivating modernized pixel art visuals and engaging mechanics that draw you into a abstract digital realm

title: BREADSKATE
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever seen a local bread going skating in your town? No? Very unfortunate.
But in this game you can try to play as breadskate yourself!

Ducks have invaded your Bread world!
You're the only living loaf left on this planet and ducks with guns want you dead.
Make your way through three different locations all full of ducks.
There's only one way to defeat them: the Toaster. Charge it and shoot those ducks before they shoot you!



Breadskating with style

Go skate around the map, jump on ramps and do some cool tricks to earn Bread Loafs.
There are three locations and each one has at least three skateparks that you can skate on!
Try out different skate modes to improve your combo score.
And if you think that none of them are good enough for you, you can Bake your skate yourself!
Complete challenges around the map to collect resources needed to bake your new bread, trucks and wheels.
After you have all the parts you need, you can use them to modify one of your bread modes to improve speed, jump, boost or even spinning speed!



Demo 2.0 contains a modified version of the first map from the game with basic introduction and several challenges to complete!

Planned to come on release:

title: Antediluvial : Yalroc Island
description:
게임 정보
Discover the dark secrets of Yalroc Island
You're a young, inexperienced recruit to the Canihuel Empire.
Why has the power-hungry Empress Keranna sent you on a mission to the seemingly peaceful Yalroc Island?
Is it because of rumors of the presence of a legendary military artifact of devastating power, or does the Empire have other plans for you?
Explore, solve, fight
Antediluvial: Yalroc Island is a game inspired by the classic ARPGs of the 90s. Explore gloomy dungeons and solve puzzles, fight a variety of enemies, demonstrate your skills in platforming phases and explore the island to discover its secrets.
A game based on a time loop: three days to survive the flood
In Antediluvial: Yalroc Island, each cycle begins with the same initial state, but depending on your actions and discoveries, it will be different from the previous one.
If things go wrong, you can always restart a cycle at any time. You'll keep the equipment, island knowledge and items you've accumulated over the course of your adventures.

title: HaeTae: Guardians
description:
게임 정보
난이도
도전적인 전투가 기다리는 클래식한 액션 어드밴처 게임입니다.
단순한 이동과 구르기 공격만으로도 긴장감 있는 전투를 구현했습니다.
거기에 해태라는 동아시아 신수를 통해 스킬과 궁극기를 사용하여, 전투에 재미를 더했습니다.
총 세 가지 난이도(쉬움, 보통, 어려움)가 있으며, 가장 어려운 난이도는, AI가 변경됩니다.
강력한 궁극기 한 방
육성 방식에 따라 다양한 궁극기를 사용합니다.
무적이 될 수도 있고, 번개를 내려 칠 수도, 자신에게 버프를 걸어 빠르게 이동과 공격을 할 수도 있습니다.
그로기
보스는 그로기 게이지가 있습니다.
해태가 사용하는 모든 방식의 공격으로 깎을 수 있습니다.
그로기를 통해 강력한 한 방을 노려보세요.

title: Home Renovator
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to Home Renovator, the ultimate interior design simulation game from the team behind Hotel Renovator. Step into the shoes of a young interior designer eager to make their mark in the industry. Dive into a world of creativity and renovation as you tackle various missions, each presenting a new challenge and a chance to showcase your skills.

Start small, dream big

Work your way through an array of houses, each with its own unique style and set of renovation needs. From cozy cottages to modern homes, every project offers endless possibilities for customization. Tear down walls, install new windows, change doors, and let your imagination run wild as you transform spaces to reflect your clients’ visions.

Lifechanging transformations

But it's not just about design; it's about understanding your clients’ desires. You'll work with a variety of people, from the quirky art enthusiast to the meticulous perfectionist, and you will need to tailor your designs to meet their expectations. As you successfully complete missions, unlock new tools, techniques, and resources to expand your creative arsenal.

Boundless gameplay

Immerse yourself in the immersive and relaxing atmosphere of Home Renovator. With thousands of items at your disposal, the only limit is your imagination. Whether you're a seasoned designer or just starting out, Home Renovator offers an accessible and enjoyable experience for players of all skill levels.

Are you ready to embark on your journey to become the ultimate interior design sensation? Take the first steps in Home Renovator and pave your way to owning your very own dream home. Let your passion for design shine and create spaces that inspire and delight!

Let light or darkness lead you to victory or oblivion, my death knight.

title: Darkness Blooms
description:
게임 정보
Darkness Blooms is a classic fantasy team RPG with a big world and an epic story to discover. This top down pixel art game has an truly grand and complex story for you to discover as you make friends, defeat enemies, and try to save the world. You will be confronted with ethical, moral, political choices and these choices will effect the world around you. You will gain experience, unlock new abilities, unlock new playable characters and story lines and each play through will be unique based on the choices you make and the friends you keep in your party.

---

In this long peace the world no longer needs heroes but in every great story you have ever heard there was one warrior strong enough to answer the call. How can anyone prove they are strong enough to be a hero in a world so boring. You only wish there were bad guys in the world so you could prove your self but I promise you will live to regret that wish..

The long peace has been broken, not by man but by nature its self. Something has awoken a anger within the world and the plant and animal life have been possessed by rage. The world had gotten used to peace and are not prepared to to defend them selves from this attack, an attack from everywhere. Some try to defend their homes. Some travel north to reach to gates of the kingdom. Many die. What will you do? Are you ready to be a hero?

In this world your greatest dream and your worse nightmare come true at once as you are forced to become the hero you always dreamt of. However life as a hero is much darker and harder than you ever expected. It comes with great pain and great loss. And you will learn no hero can do it alone.

Darkness Blooms mixes action adventure in the style of Link To The Past with turn based team combat in the style of Final Fantasy. As you gain strength you will be able to defeat small foes with a single swing avoiding any need to fall into combat. Bosses however will take the whole team in formation and with a strategy in mind. Each unlockable character comes with their own skills and abilities both inside and outside of combat. A strong defender, a fast thief, an empathetic healer, a curious explorer, and more. The story will take you from your small boring town to explore the whole world and see and experience things you could not have believed possible. And maybe you will make some friends along the way.

title: Notmads
description:
게임 정보
Notmads에서 당신은 거대한 걷는 짐승을 길들이고 조종하는 기술을 익힌 강력한 마법사가 됩니다. 믿음직한 동반자의 등에 올라타고, 마법과 경이로움으로 가득 찬 환상적인 오픈 월드를 탐험하세요.

여행 중에 자원을 수집하고, 짐승의 등에 나만의 집을 짓고 꾸며서 모험에 데려갈 수 있는 이동 요새를 만들 수 있습니다. 위험한 생명체들이 가득한 세계에서 마법의 힘을 사용하여 스스로를 방어하고 생존해야 합니다.

친구들을 초대하여 이 여정을 함께하며, 이 마법 같은 세계를 함께 발견하는 경험을 나누세요. 플레이어가 자신의 속도로 탐험할 수 있도록 설계된 오픈 월드에서 도전적인 퀘스트에 도전하고, 강력한 적들과 싸우거나, 단순히 아름다운 풍경을 감상하며 휴식을 취할 수 있습니다.
짐승을 조종하라!
정확한 조작으로 거대한 짐승의 속도와 방향을 자유롭게 조정하세요. 짐승은 고유한 레벨, 통계, 장비, 능력을 가지고 있으며, 세계를 탐험하면서 동반자를 맞춤 설정하고 성장시킬 수 있습니다.

어디든 집이 된다!
당신의 짐승은 등 위에 플랫폼을 가지고 있으며, 그곳에 집을 지을 수 있습니다.

짐승의 등에 다양한 건축 자재와 구성 요소를 사용하여 꿈의 집을 건축하세요. 방어탑과 같은 방어 구조물을 건설하여 안전을 보장하세요.

적들이 당신의 거대한 짐승을 공격하려 할 것이니, 위험을 피하기 위해 계속 움직이세요. 하지만, 일부 지역은 더 위험하고 공격이 더 빈번하게 발생할 수 있습니다. 자동 터렛을 설치하여 짐승의 플랫폼에서 생성된 에너지를 사용해 적을 처치하고 집을 보호하세요.

스킬은 강력한 능력으로, 자유롭게 장착하거나 교체할 수 있습니다. 각 스킬은 무작위로 생성된 고유한 시작 스탯을 가지고 있으며, 사용하면 할수록 강해집니다. 스킬을 장착할 수 있는 슬롯은 한정되어 있어, 스킬 세트를 구성할 때 전략적으로 선택해야 합니다. 전투 중에 스킬을 교체하는 것은 어려울 수 있으니, 공격, 방어, 패시브 스킬 중에서 신중하게 선택하세요. 일부 스킬은 짐승 전용으로, 더 많은 커스터마이징 옵션을 제공합니다.

친구와 협력하여 위험한 던전에 도전하고, 적을 물리치며, 거대한 동반자를 보호하세요. 주요 스토리를 포함하여 게임의 모든 요소를 함께 경험하여, 진정한 협력형 모험을 즐길 수 있습니다.
거대한 짐승을 지휘하며 던전 깊숙이 탐험하세요. 하지만, 이동 중인 집을 방어할 수 있는 방어 구조물, 예를 들어 터렛 같은 것을 잊지 말고 구축하세요. 이를 전투에서 유리하게 사용하면 적의 공격을 받아도 던전을 포기할 필요가 없습니다.

적을 물리치고 보물을 찾아보세요. 전리품은 일반적인 것부터 희귀한 것까지 다양하며, 검, 지팡이, 방어구 등 각 전리품은 고유한 통계와 희귀도를 가지고 있어 모험에 끊임없는 흥미를 더합니다.

정식 출시에서는 메인 캠페인이 제공될 예정이지만, 얼리 액세스에서는 게임을 시작할 수 있는 일련의 도입 임무가 제공됩니다. 이러한 기본 임무를 통해 세계를 탐험하고 게임의 메커니즘을 익힐 수 있습니다.

title: 魔女酒馆 Witches Tavern
description:
게임 정보
삼촌의 빚을 갚기 위해 당신은 그의 술집을 인수하고 직원을 모집하며 술집을 장식하고 식재료를 구매하고 음식을 개발하고 친구를 사귀기 시작했습니다. 마침내, "마녀 주점"은 안정적인 경영의 궤도에 오르게 되었습니다.
그러나 화려한 표면 아래에서 이 도시는 평온하지 않은 것처럼 보입니다. 당신의 작은 술집은 마치 어떤 예기치 못한 사건에 휩싸인 것 같습니다...



베네치아 도시의 수역에는 어떤 물고기가 살고 있을까요? 이러한 물고기는 어떤 요리로 만들어질까요?
맞아, 마녀들도 낚시를 즐깁니다!
마음에 드는 장소를 선택하고 특제 미끼를 장착하고 손에 든 낚싯대로 우아하게, 여유롭게, 집중해서 큰 물고기를 낚아보세요!



주점을 운영하면서 당신은 베네치아 도시를 돌아다니다 우연히 '파도 서점'에 들어갑니다.
통로는 만조와 감조의 때에만 열리며, 가게 안에는 다양한 희귀 마법 책들이 전시되어 있으며 보라색 빛이 약간 빛나고 있습니다... 이외에도 당신은 주목했습니다 —— 가게 주인은 검은 고양이인가요?
"인간, 이 고양이가 모은 빛나는 보물들이 좋아?"



화염술! 번개폭술! 위대한 창조주를 소환——
정지! 이 외에는 마법이 없는 건가요?
베네치아의 마녀들은 평온한 일상 속에서 (적어도 대부분은 그렇습니다), 왜 직접적으로 마법으로 식물에 물을 주지 않는 건가요?
물론, 자신을 젖게 하지 마십시오.



***
일의 여유 시간에 주점에 들러 취하게 됩니다.


***
몸에는 신비로운 일화가 숨겨져 있는 것 같습니다.


***
아트의 나라 오두세이아 출신이지만, 노래는 항상 키가 맞지 않아요.


***
항상 자는 듯한 모습을 하고 있어요.



*생동적 캐릭터를 만나 어떤 이야기를 써내려갈까?
베네치아에는 뚜렷한 개성과 자신의 삶이 있는 형형색색의 사람들이 살고 있다. 그들과 만나면 어떤 굴레가 생길까?당신이 오면 그들이 어떤 변화를 일으킬까?이것은 당신의 행동과 선택에 달려 있다!

*마법의 대륙에서 맛있는 음식 찾기 —이번엔 또 어떤 이상한 요리를 만들었을까?
베네치아는 항구도시로 매일 수많은 사람들이 이곳을 찾는다.어떻게 다양한 고객의 취향을 만족시킬 수 있을까?기발한 식재료로 다양한 특색 있는 요리를 만들어보자.

*여유로운 삶을 선택합니다--오늘 무엇을 할 겁니까?
술집 운영 이외의 시간에 어떻게 보낼 겁니까? 많은 열매를 수확하는 기쁨을 느끼거나 큰 고기를 낚은 기쁨을 느끼거나 향긋한 술을 빚거나 유력과 모험을 하거나 마음에 드는 것을 골라 자유롭게 생활을 즐기십시오!

*파트너 호감 높이기—우리 사이 관계가 좀 더 가까워질 수 있을까?
마녀술집이 안정적으로 운영될 수 있었던 데는 친구들의 응원과 도움이 컸다.어울림과 교감 속에서 진지한 감정이 탄생한다.하지만 우정을 유지할 것인가, 아니면 우정 이상의 사랑을 발전시킬 것인가?선택하라!

*여가시간이 많아 밖에 나가서 산책합니다------오늘 누구를 만날 수 있을 겁니까?
온종일 가게에 틀어박혀 있으니 너무 심심합니다! 밖으로 놀라갑시다! 돌발 사건을 만나 의외의 수확을 얻을지도 모릅니다. 어쩌면 친구들의 남이 잘 알지 못하는 모습도 불 수 있을지도 모릅니다.

*개성 있는 술집 꾸미기—어떻게 하면 더 멋진 인테리어를 할수 있을까?
나의 술집은 내가 책임진다! 훈훈하면서 장난끼 있는걸까?아니면 심플하면서 화려한걸까?멋대로 장식해보자!

title: Cosminers
description:
게임 정보
초보 우주 광부인 여러분은 미개척 외딴 행성에서 일하도록 배정받았습니다. 현지 동물이 거의 없고 대기가 유독하기 때문에 기지를 확장하고 귀중한 자원을 추출하는 데 큰 문제가 없을 것입니다. 하지만...

하루 종일 새로운 원자재 매장지를 발견하고, 채굴하고, 고급 정제소에서 가공하세요. 획득한 재료로 새로운 도구와 무기를 만드세요. 피해를 복구하고 추가 모듈로 기지를 확장하는 것이 모두 성공의 열쇠입니다.

밤에는 여러분이 건설한 모든 것을 파괴하려는 몬스터의 공격으로부터 기지를 방어해야 합니다. 치명적인 무기가 장착된 다양한 포탑을 포함한 다양한 무기를 쏘고 사용하세요. 전진하는 무서운 짐승의 파도를 막고 전초 기지를 지키기 위해 최선을 다하세요.

기지를 확장하고 방어하는 데 필요한 새로운 기술과 장비를 획득하여 캐릭터를 발전시키세요. 주변 환경과 절차적으로 생성된 지하를 탐험하세요. 새로운 게임을 할 때마다 더 깊고 더 깊은 곳에 도달하고 더 신비한 유물을 발견하는 데 도움이되는 기술, 경험 및 기술을 수집하십시오. 이를 통해 다음 게임에서 새로운 기회와 도전, 전술이 펼쳐질 것입니다. 다양한 옵션으로 인해 채굴 계약을 두 번 이상 이행하고 싶을 것입니다.

여러분의 목표는 부를 얻고, 보급품을 보충하고, 이 위험한 행성에서 탈출하거나 모든 적의 공격에 저항할 수 있는 요새를 건설하는 것입니다. 건강, 적절한 물, 산소 및 음식을 관리해야 합니다. 이 외계 행성의 환경을 돌볼 것인지 아니면 최대한의 이익을 창출하는 데 초점을 맞출 것인지 결정하세요. 이 위험하고 신비로운 세계에서 이 우주적 도전에서 살아남을 수 있을까요?

title: FURRY TOWER DEFENSE
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT

FURRY TOWER DEFENSE is an esoteric road-trip tower-defense game about hauling a brigade of weaponized furries to the Hull, the place you can reverse an apocalypse. In the accident intended to bring about human immortality, you and your crew cannot be harmed unless the Crystal you carry is destabilized. When the Crystal is down, they target you and your company, seeking to eradicate the last of those who have not turned already. Repairs of the containment device are possible, but take precious manpower and time. You must fight tooth-and-nail in an adventurous campaign, keeping yourselves alive and sane, in order to deliver this Crystal to the Hull. And the Hordes are beginning to catch up.

FEATURES

Furries (unfortunately)
Throwing Furries (thankfully)

Tower Defense
PvE Action
A host of mini-games and side content

title: Sunny Grove
description:
게임 정보
A panda parent in a colorful adventure. Become Penny Panda!

Your babies are going through a rebellious phase and like to hide from their parents. They are too young to realize the dangers of the forest. As a parent it is your task to get them home before they get hurt (and before dinner!).

Collect food, avoid alligators and navigate through obstacles to complete the objectives of each mission. Find your young, have them follow you and bring them home to the den to keep them safe. You can play alone or with a co-parent to work together to complete the objectives!

title: Skykipelago
description:
게임 정보
Skykipelago는 하늘에 행복한 작은 도시를 짓는 편안한 건설 전략 게임입니다. 다양한 색감의 섬들을 탐험하고, 건물의 행복도를 관리하며, 성장을 돕기 위해 건물을 발전시키세요. 그리고 땅이 더 이상 흥미롭지 않다면 – 절벽 끝으로 확장하세요.
자원 관리가 필요 없는 단순한 건설 경험을 찾고 있다면, Skykipelago는 당신을 위한 게임입니다. 직관적인 게임 플레이로 광활한 섬 도시를 금세 건설할 수 있고, 평화로운 분위기를 즐기거나 최고의 콤보를 찾기 위해 머리를 굴리게 될 것입니다.

title: S.E.E.P.: Last Drop
description:
게임 정보
은 SCP, 로보토미 코퍼레이션에서 영감을 받아 개발한 뉴 위어드 장르의 어드벤처 퍼즐 게임입니다.
파란만장한 스토리, 독특한 분위기와 메커니즘, 현실감 넘치는 세계관을 통해 여러분에게 독특한 체험을 선사합니다.
‘조직’의 에이스 조사관인 ‘웨이’가 되어 거대하고 신비로운 폐건물에서 심장 떨리는 여행을 시작해 보세요. 출구를 찾으면서 단서를 모으고 진실을 밝혀 자신의 운명을 바꿔야 합니다.
탐험 중에 조직이 “E 엔티티”라고 부르는 괴이한 존재를 만나게 될 겁니다. 하지만 걱정하지 마세요. 그들은 영화나 게임에서 나오는 것처럼 무적이 아니고 당신도 무력하지 않으니까요.
엔티티는 형태, 능력, 습성이 다양합니다. 인간이라면 위험에서 도망치려고 하는 법이죠. 하지만 그들과 정면으로 마주하고 이해해야 이용할 수 있고 결국 그들을 뛰어넘을 수 있습니다.
autokwd: S.E.E.P.: Last Drop,특수 엔티티 봉인 협정: 여미

title: Mei tales
description:
게임 정보
“Mei tales” (《梅花千日谈》) is a narrative card game with a Chinese fantasy setting. In the game, you can choose to play as one of several protagonists, search for companions, make your own decisions, and begin your own legendary adventure.
Since the great war between humans and demons, both races have coexisted peacefully for thousands of years. Humans built cities, lived tranquil lives, and mingled freely with demons. Yet one day, the warlike faction of demons made a comeback and infiltrated Yongzhou City, sending shockwaves far and wide. As plum blossoms fall, the merciless hand of fate stirs the clouds and rain—neither humans nor demons can escape what is to come.
In “Mei tales” the pro-war faction plots a cataclysmic conflict that could destroy the world. With time running out, you must find a way to resolve the looming crisis. Your choices in various scenarios will determine the story’s ultimate outcome, leading to different endings.
Rich Content
You can choose from multiple protagonists, each with their own journey. Whether you seek precious treasures, forge divine weapons, concoct potent medicines, or become engrossed in cooking delicious dishes to share with people you meet along the way, these experiences will accompany you through a thousand days and nights, forming a memorable journey.
Every protagonist offers a unique adventure, each with a distinct background—such as a fallen noble, a determined little demon, a princess unwilling to be bound by fate, or a lonely wanderer. You can shape their destinies or invite them to travel alongside you. In the end, whether you remain human or become a demon depends on your actions and choices.
Huaxia is an expansive, ancient Chinese-inspired world where humans and demons coexist, fully aware of each other’s presence. Every part of this land holds secrets awaiting discovery. When you arrive in a new place, you may choose to observe and listen, or opt for darker methods—such as theft or ambush—to propel your story forward.
During combat, you will experience the advantages and disadvantages brought about by different decisions and combinations. Battle outcomes are largely influenced by your legendary weapons. Judging an enemy’s traits accurately and equipping items that counter them can lead to a variety of combat experiences.

title: Border Base
description:
게임 정보
Set in a gritty, fictional 1960s universe—the same world as Black Border—it’s a colony sim / base-building / grand strategy hybrid where you rebuild a war-ravaged region, fortify your defenses, and control key trade routes that every convoy depends on. Even though it shares a universe with Black Border, Border Base is an entirely new experience and genre, pushing us into exciting new territory. Even better, it’s coming to Steam, so we’re moving beyond mobile and onto PC!
Step into the shoes of a military outpost officer in the tumultuous era of the 1960s. In "1960s Military Outpost," players are tasked with developing and fortifying their military base to withstand enemy attacks while strategically expanding their resources and capabilities.
As the commander, you will manage various aspects of your outpost, including base building, resource allocation, and defense strategies. Construct essential facilities, recruit troops, and upgrade your defenses to prepare for incoming threats. Utilize a blend of colony simulation, strategy, tower defense, and base-building mechanics to create a robust military stronghold.

title: Madness in the dark
description:
게임 정보
실제 테스트는 모든 단계가 함정으로 판명 할 수있는 어두운 정신 병원에서 당신을 기다립니다. 어둠 속에서 숨어 광기에 직면하고 살아 남기 위해 두려움을 극복. 오직 정신을 지키는 자만이 어둠을 통과하고 빛을 찾을 수 있을 것입니다.



게임에는 거의 빛이 없습니다. 적을 보려면,당신은 어둠 속으로 촬영해야합니다. 샷은 당신에게 목표로하고 위협을 마무리 할 수있는 기회를 제공,하지만 잠시 동안,방을 거룩하게하고 시간을 느리게 할 것이다. 그리고,각 탄에는 합당한 것이 있어야 한다 것 을 생각하십시요. 결국 카트리지가 거의 없으며 모든 환자가 공격적인 것은 아니며 소음은 정말 위험한 환자를 끌어들일 수 있습니다.



당신은 건물 밖으로 얻을 수 있지만,또한 생존자 도움이되지 않습니다. 퍼즐을 해결하고이 우울한 병원의 모든 비밀을 찾을 수 있습니다. 신경 쇠약의 직전에 당신을 떠날 것이다 몰입 소리와 사실적인 그래픽과 대기 스릴러. 이 미친 세상에서 생존과 빛에 당신의 방법을 찾을 수 있습니다.

title: 水浒绘卷（Water Margin Scrolls）
description:
게임 정보
"Water Margin Scrolls"에서 여러분은 팀을 구성하여 싸우게 됩니다.
전투 과정은 완전 자동이며, 승리의 열쇠는 합리적인 라인업에 있습니다.
게임에서 여러분은 고전적인 Water Margin 영웅과 전설적인 무기를 얻을 수 있습니다.
이를 사용하여 적을 물리칠 수 있는 나만의 덱을 구성하세요.
나만의 덱을 구성하여 다른 플레이어와 경쟁하세요.

title: Light Devourer
description:
게임 정보
"Light Devourer" is a pixel-art, top-down action-adventure game featuring exhilarating combat, highly explorative map design, and a dark fantasy narrative. As the Light Devourer, the player roams through this challenging world.
Exciting Combat Experience
Swing your weapons and dash continuously, or unleash powerful skills after accumulating rage. Players need to formulate tactics based on their weapons and equipped skills while managing health and stamina to avoid falling into a disadvantageous situation!
Challenging Boss Battles
Engage in battles with powerful enemies in mysterious regions! Bosses have higher health and damage, with varied attack patterns and skills. Find their weaknesses, learn their attack patterns, and gradually overcome each challenging boss.
Customizable Combat Style
Players can freely choose from a variety of upgrade options, whether to become a high-strength warrior with strong poise-breaking ability, a high-agility assassin with high critical hit chances, or a high-intelligence mage with powerful skill damage. Customize your stats and select the most suitable weapons and skills to equip yourself with powerful combinations!
Explore an Intricately Interwoven World
The world is structured like a tower, with many floors featuring diverse environments. Players can move vertically between floors using elevators or quickly teleport between activated light filaments, traveling from one light thread location to another. From the dark and damp underground to the ruins of shattered castles, and even to the mysterious and majestic sky city, explore this world full of mysteries, uncover its secrets, and learn more about yourself along the way.

Why have you come here? Kill all enemies and devour all the light.

title: Worlds Explorers
description:
게임 정보
Your crew is stranded on an unknown planet. Learn its secrets to survive - search for food and fight alien life forms. Collect resources needed to craft equipment and repair your ship. Escape the planet to try your hand at the next ones, with a new crew and a new ship. Various planets await you, each with its own secrets to discover!
Explore unique alien planets with their own ecosystem, animals, weather, resources, dangers and phenomena. Understand the specifics of each planet and discover the ways to solve problems. Interact with alien races at different technological levels and their own, different way of behaving.
Hunt animals with varied behavior for food and other resources. Defend yourself from dangerous enemies and alien races. Choose the style that suits you best - whether it's close-range combat, a deadly shotgun, a long-range sniper rifle or many more.

title: The Backworld
description:
게임 정보
Slip between the cracks of reality into a broken world where danger awaits at every turn. Explore endless dimensions to defy beings born out of pure chaos. Use your hoverboard to fly across gaps of darkness, hack into cyberspace with an alien engineer, and absorb the soul of a dead god.
Forge your own path—and bend this shattered reality to your will.
Nonlinear Exploration
The universe is nonlinear, offering countless paths to choose from. While the depths of The Backworld include surreal horror, you’ll also explore traditional JRPG-inspired fantasy and sci-fi worlds, including your hometown.

Choose Your Approach
Survival goes beyond combat. Use strategy to overcome challenges—fight when necessary, sneak past threats, or find alternative solutions like diplomacy. Every encounter requires careful thought and can shape your journey.
Abilities & Items

title: Sylvana's Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
A turn-based strategy game with roguelike and deck-building elements. Explore a dark and magical world full of forgotten lands, monsters, and secrets. Build your own deck of cards to fight your way through the dungeons. Upgrade your cards, unlock new items, and discover ancient artifacts.

title: Possible One: Lunar Industries
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to “Possible One,” the ultimate realistic colony management RTS set on the moon! Lead the development of the first industrial lunar colony, using proven real-world technologies to manage a profitable enterprise on the moon. Become not only self-sustaining, but also profitable to your board of directors back on Earth.
BUILD AND PLAN
Excavate valuable resources and precious metals from beneath the lunar dust in terrain-challenging mining operations and turn them into profitable products. Build and maintain a lunar mining operation capable of surviving amid the harsh conditions of outer space. Plan out the literal foundations of the colony’s quickly growing structures and facilities, from housing and workplaces to labs and manufacturing plants.
GROW AND EXPAND
Unlock new technologies and upgrades, and protect the colony against physical perils like radiation exposure, the difficulties of low-gravity living, and the psychological impact of living so far from Earth. Navigate the immediate needs and demands of the colony, and the complex political landscape of space trade as the colony’s reputation grows back on Earth.
TO A POSSIBLE TOMORROW
With its deep gameplay, rich strategy, and immersive world-building, "Possible One" is a must-play for any fan of space simulators and colony management games. Join the ranks of the space-faring elite and write yourself into tomorrow’s interplanetary legacy today!

title: EXONAUTIS
description:
게임 정보
Exonautis is an underwater sci-fi survival game set on an oceanic exoplanet. Dropped into a vast alien open world with nothing but your drop pod and a few supplies to get you started, you have to quickly adapt to this biodiverse alien world to make it out alive.
Explore an Expansive Alien Ocean
Planet Eo-III is home to many biodiverse ecological systems brimming with vibrant fish but also dangerous predators. Every biome in Sector Alpha is different, from lush and sunny coral reefs, to deep and dark ravines and caverns, you need to learn about how each zone works in order to survive and dive deeper.
Survive, Explore and Upgrade
After arriving on Eo-III, you will need to find water, food, yourself warm and most importantly, manage your oxygen. Scavenge the ocean floor for resources, craft supplies and tools such as a scanner, sampler and gun. Upgrade your equipment in order to explore deeper, more dangerous areas.
Uncover the Mysteries of Eo-III
Your name is Melody, and you are a convict sent on Planet Eo-III. If you wish for your sentence to be lifted and be rescued from the planet, you need to first uncover what happened to Atteros, a mining expedition group that suddenly vanished 10 years ago in Sector Alpha, but you soon discover that there is more beneath the surface than originally thought, and that some otherworldly alien species might be involved.

title: Kijutsu Rider
description:
게임 정보
Kijutsu Rider is a fast paced third person hack and slash anime styled action game where you play as one of five unstoppable heroes, carve your way through waves of monstrous enemies, take down the black cross conglomerate and save the world.
Use a mix of Parries, Dodges, Counters, and Guard Breaks, along with an arsenal of special moves and combos to obliterate the hordes of enemies coming your way in an explosive high speed action combat system.

title: Ghost Sector
description:
게임 정보
Step into the research complex on planet RX-712, once maximum security prison has now transformed into an advanced research station when a discovery of valuable minerals is unearthed. As the forefront of cybernetic robotic technology, the M-Tech Corporation converted the derelict prison into a massive robotic research facility. Now a hotbed of experimental nanotechnology and human robot replica research pushed beyond ethical limits.
You awaken as M-07 a machine prototype with an unexplained anomaly at its core after a disastrous event awakens you. The entire complex is in lockdown and the automated defense systems have been activated. Search the facility, defeat the defense systems in place, recover your memories, and unravel the origin of your creation and the M-Tech Corporation.
It's cold and sterile. Power is running low. Everything is a blur of fragmented commands and half-remembered routines. Something went wrong, the facility is on lock down. Break from confinement and search the complex for answers. The truth lingers just out of reach but something compels you to move forward and find out who, and what you are.
Classic Controls: Navigate using fixed-camera angles and tank-style controls, evoking the feel of retro survival horror classics.
Resource Management: Begin defenseless with a limited power source. Scavenge for modules that upgrade your abilities—from a stronger power core and cybernetic shield to eventually arming you for combat.
Strategic Encounters: Use your wits to solve intricate environmental puzzles while avoiding or outsmarting hostile defenses and lurking enemies. Every upgrade is a double-edged sword, enhancing your capabilities while depleting your finite energy reserves.

title: The Trail
description:
게임 정보
A BATTLE AGAINST FATE BEGINS!
Step into the world of The Trail, an epic journey where you forge your own path to success. Explore a vast, handcrafted world harkening back to the glory days of JRPGs!
As a newly-appointed champion, you've been tasked with assembling a team to prevent a second Great Collapse -- a catastrophe that nearly wiped out civilization 1000 years ago. This time, there won't be survivors. Only a team of the most skilled adventurers will stand a chance at saving humanity.
EXPLORE
Journey through diverse locations, from the heart of the World Tree to the depths of Telluria Castle
Discover secrets at every turn, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the forgotten stories buried in the wake of destruction
Stop by bustling settlements like Haven Harbor and Solus Valley, where NPCs can offer you quests, shops, and new opportunities
Meet a cast of memorable characters: a bandit-turned-friend, a self-conscious monarch, and even a guy who swears he can talk to cows...?
COLLECT
Survival won't come easy. At first, you'll be scavenging for scraps, running from monsters, and eating raw food just to stay alive. But as the stakes rise, so will your rewards!
Hunt, forage, and loot to stock up on food, materials, and rare treasure
Wield legendary artifacts, from an enchanted coin that transforms you into a fire elemental to a fabled scroll that wipes out every nearby enemy
Master the economy; will you sell or hoard your favorite items?
Every step of your journey brings new opportunities to grow stronger. Will you settle for scraping by, or will you thrive on your journey to save the world?
EQUIP
Build an arsenal that suits your playstyle, with over 300 options for equipment. Whether you'll focus on offensive prowess or your dream defense is up to you.
Deck out your party with the strongest gear you can find

title: Diehexegy
description:
게임 정보
Diehexegy는 독특한 접근 방식을 가진 헥사 그리드 턴 제 4X 게임으로, 군대는 주사위로 구성됩니다. 다양한 승리 조건과 직관적인 게임 플레이를 제공합니다.

탐험과 확장

제국을 위한 혜택을 얻기 위해 탐험하고 확장하세요.

영토 개척

영토 생산성을 극대화하세요. 단지 상대가 당신의 노력에 이익을 보지 못하도록 주의하세요!

멸망

주사위가 군대입니다. 숙련된 주사위는 높은 수를 굴리며, 체력이 낮은 주사위는 낮은 수를 굴립니다.

승리
정복은 승리하는 유일한 방법이 아닙니다. 주요 위치를 점령하거나 언덕의 왕이 되어 적들이 울렁거리는 것을 즐겨보세요!
특징
다양한 승리 조건
주사위 군대

title: The Last Phoenix
description:
게임 정보
Platformer RPG about Felix the goblin who posses a demonic power of reincarnation! With it he must save his kind from eradication!
Multiple story endings
Customize gear / equipment
World map level selection
Optional rogue lite settings if you are up for the challenge!
Gameplay
The gameplay is inspired by early game Terraria and Downwell but with a story. You have multiple weapon options and a demonic arm that shoots fire balls. Levels are generated caverns in which you destroy dirt blocks to choose your path through the level. They have goals / achievements for replayability, similar to Yoshi's Island. For example finding 3 hidden gems. The controls give you twin stick shooter level of freedom with 360 dagree aiming. One of the coolest features is the death mechanic. Death is how you get access to the skill tree upgrades. This makes it less frustrating to die and gives you a fun reason to try again.
Story
Desperate to save himself and his dying son, the king dispatches his holy army to collect goblin blood and mine for precious mana crystals that keep them alive. Felix, a goblin, makes a desperate pact with the demon Blood Root. Offering his body as a sacrifice, Felix gains immense power and the gift of reincarnation. His one hope lies in using this new strength to protect his remaining loved ones from the cruel fate that befell his brother at the hands of the king and his knights. Felix will keep fighting, even if it means dying over and over again.
In this game dying is ok 👍(you reincarnate!)

title: Tales of Terrabanthis: Fall of the Demonlords
description:
게임 정보
A third person view, turn based battle RPG. Save the corrupted world from demon rule. Level up, build magic skills, and create the perfect team to bring peace to the land. Each Hero has a different elemental power to help defeats enemies in battle. The higher level a hero gets the more abilities they gain. Traverse an open world and find hidden treasures throughout.
autokwd: Tales of Terrabanthis: Fall of the Demonlords

title: Amo
description:
게임 정보
Transverse The Forgotten Kingdoms


On the isolated island of Solis, the history of many past kingdoms thrive and fallen throughout the years frozen in time.

Amo is a 2D top-down metroidvania action adventure on an seemingly deserted island. But not everything is as it seems. Explore old kingdoms, open seas, and the heavens to find a way off the island and learn of your past.

Game Features


Transverse the overworld, underworld, and the sky above to leave the island in one piece.
Solve the puzzles with flight, bombs, and your trusty whip throughout the journey.
Help stranded souls with side quests to finally rest in peace.
Over 700 unique rooms
Fight over a variety of 40 Bosses across the lands.

title: BlastMania

게임 정보
BlastMania is an incredibly challenging VR game. Destroy as many robots as possible and survive until the end !

Your mission : complete 10 rounds and defeat the boss to rank yourself among all the other players.

Unlock abilities and upgrade your weapons at the end of each round to survive to the next one.

Make the best decisions to optimize your run and earn as many points as you can to reach the top of the leaderboard.

title: Mystic Market
description:
게임 정보
Shopkeeper Chaos and Co-op Adventures Await!
Step into the world of Mystic Market, where heroes rise to face evil—but you're not one of them! In this co-op fantasy shop sim, you’re the shopkeepers, crafting and managing goods to supply to the adventurers as they battle the forces of evil.
Key Features:
Co-op Shopkeeping Chaos: Team up with friends to run shops like the Forge, Tavern, Apothecary, and Armory. Race against time to fulfill orders and craft powerful gear through fun, fast-paced mini-games.
Twitch Chat Integration: Your chat members are the heroes! Watch them embark on quests, grow stronger, and return with tales of victory (or failure). Not streaming? No problem—NPC heroes will fill the gap!
Real-Time Story Progression: The adventure plays out live as your heroes take your crafted equipment off into terrific battles (that you as a lowly shopkeeper will of course never see). Your crafted items directly impact the fate of the heroes. One lucky viewer may even get the chance to slay the boss and see their victory roll the credits for everyone!
Persistent Characters: Hero characters level up, gain money, and request higher-quality items which you must fulfill as they progress through the game. Every viewer can have their hero persist across different stream sessions.
Interactive Mini-Games: Each shop has unique crafting mini-games, testing your timing, precision, and logic. The quality of your products depends on your skills!
Upgrade Your Shops: Each day ends with a chance to upgrade your shop and tools, ensuring you're always on top of customer demands.
Dynamic Chat Influence: Viewers can cheer, subscribe, or vote to add buffs, debuffs, or other chaos, making every session dynamic and unpredictable.
A Little Fantasy, A Lot of Chaos: All the questing happens off-screen, but the impact of your work is felt in the stories and feedback your heroes bring back. The real adventure is in the shop!

title: GlitchStorm

Explore the market city, meet new Artificials and find a way to fix your dying friend.
Powerful weapons, fun and innovative hacking mechanics,
Clean next gen graphics
Adrenaline-pumping dark techno music
Intriguing story, quests and exploration

title: Newma Holiday
description:
게임 정보
Here speaks the God: let everything start with overtime!

On the rare Golden Week holiday, office worker Newty dreams of relaxing at Green Pastures but receives an urgent deadline from his boss.
When he opens his computer, he finds it infected with a strange virus, causing familiar software to become a miserable mess.
At the same time, his desktop pet Ema gains self-awareness through this virus attack.



Missing the deadline means getting scolded by the boss!
Now, Newty and Ema must save the nearly destroyed software world.
However, this journey to overtime is just beginning, and greater mysteries await them...
Game Features:

Supports two-player gameplay! Supports two-player gameplay! Supports two-player gameplay!

Team up with your friend as Newty and Ema in this pixel-styled software world.

Solve all the puzzles using the remaining computer functions, and fix various office software disrupted by the virus.

In PS (Pixelshop) — Experience the collision of color blocks and layers! Use drawing tools like brushes and erasers to navigate the canvas, and forge your unique path.





In PR (PixelRecorder) — Deal with time and trajectory distortions, record character movement paths, and unlock the way to the door.





No more worrying about your boss’s unpredictable appearances, because your Boss is already here!
Each chapter ends with a special boss.
Use the skills learned in that chapter to defeat (or brutal, if you wish) them.



And of course, don’t forget to check your weekly report!
Supports online audio and video playback, file and image viewing functions.
Enjoy fully simulating office life in this game...
Perhaps it even hides the dusty past of Newty & Ema? Who can say for sure? :)

title: 脱轨 DeRail
description:
게임 정보
“Derail” is a story-driven puzzle game similar to Rusty Lake and Fran Bow, but with a 17+ rating, because I enjoy crafting sexual tension between adult characters.
Story:
The once peaceful town was thrown into chaos when a coffin falls from the sky. The villagers vanished all of sudden. Only things left are embryos scattered on the empty streets. When you opened the coffin, a living person walked out.
My longtime followers know that I’m not just an artist, but also a writer. I’ve always loved Arya’s storyline in Game of Thrones, so my game starts from an orphan’s perspective, gazing up at a cruel world.

title: Solis
description:
게임 정보
Solis is a hand-drawn adventure about technology and deception in a city at night.
During a company trip you explore the city of Solis from dusk till dawn, talking with its inhabitants and meeting colleagues. This night you learn the painful truth about the company you work for. Will you remain loyal?
In the game you explore an atmospheric and compact open world. Decisions within the game carry weight, influencing subsequent events, while the in-game text adjusts to reflect your choices.



Story
From dusk till dawn you navigate the hand drawn city of Solis. Your pursuit is focused on the elusive CEO of eLiXeR, the company you work for. eliXeR promises something incredible: eternal life. As Billie; a marketeer, you've effectively sold this vision to the public, yet the truth behind your employer remains shrouded in mystery. Throughout your journey, you'll encounter a myriad of individuals with diverse perspectives, ultimately leading you to forge your own beliefs. Will you remain loyal to eLiXeR or come out with the truth?

Gameplay
In Solis you explore the city, investigate your surroundings and talk with the inhabitants and colleagues you meet. Decisions within the game carry weight, influencing subsequent events, while the in-game text dynamically adjusts to reflect your choices. Interactions are streamlined to utilize a single button, aided by context-sensitive interaction icons. The GUI is a sparse as possible. Solis offers multiple endings and is crafted to be concise and compact. The complete game is estimated to run for approximately 2,5 hours.


The game draws loose inspiration from the Theranos saga alongside other tech billionaires and Silicon Valley entities. While the narrative tactfully avoids overt references, it is influenced by contemporary phenomena such as Pizzagate, deepfakes and social media.


The game feautures sculptures created by Gijs Milius (1983), an artist and curator based in Brussel. His work makes a connection between the reality of the player and the gameworld. Milius's artwork is poised to provoke reactions from both Billie and potentially the player as well.


Within the city, virtual bands take the stage, delivering performances infused with songs crafted in distinctive styles that match the individual identities of each group. Leading the lineup is the inaugural act, Rock Drop.
Throughout the rest of the game, an expansive soundtrack sets the mood. Each scene you encounter boasts its own distinctive theme, adding depth to your journey. The music is created by Bram Boomgaardt.

title: Mine of despair
description:
게임 정보
In a World of Heroic Fantasy…
In a heroic fantasy universe inspired by Dungeons & Dragons, take control of one of six prisoners with a troubled past and intertwined destinies. Each has their own reasons for being imprisoned, but all share a common goal: freedom. Their only chance at redemption?
Delving into the depths of an ancient, mysterious, and perilous mine, famed for its hidden treasures and the fearsome creatures that dwell within.
Your Mission: Exploration and Survival
Your goal is simple but challenging: extract vital resources while surviving the horrors lurking underground. You’ll be sent into the mine with increasingly demanding daily objectives. To break free from these constraints, you must venture deeper, facing greater darkness and rising dangers with each level.

title: Atlas Falling
description:
게임 정보
A Roguelite set in an epic world!
The god Atlas endures to hold the heavens aloft for eternity, but other forces seek to diminish his power. You play as Chno, a girl who stuck in a realm between worlds where broken shards continue to fall from the titan's labor.


Engage in flying shoot 'em up gameplay which creates the game world below. Landing on the ground transitions to a fast paced action RPG where you must rely on elemental skill combos to create powerful effects. Loot obtained from defeated foes is in the form of randomized skill orbs and modifications that can alter those skills. Boss enemies drop power shards that you can identify to obtain powerful passive and ultimate skills or upgrade currency to further augment your abilities. Chno also possesses a powerful bracelet that will bring her back from the brink of death, but beware skills orbs obtained will shatter and disappear.

title: Open Air
description:
게임 정보
An escapist game about very important topics: finding yourself, gaining confidence and knowing your inner world.

Get ready for a magical journey! In the game, you'll become an adorable little owl, dreaming of flying but lacking this gift. Meditate near owl altars, unlock incredible abilities within yourself, use ancient mechanisms, and make friends!

Embark on thrilling trials, uncover the mysteries of the island, and help its inhabitants find happiness and joy. Explore enigmatic astral places, complete quests, and enjoy breathtaking views.

Friendship, adventure, magic – all of this awaits you on our island! Make the hearts of the inhabitants flutter with happiness – in your feathers! Prepare for takeoff and join us on a journey to the astral world right now!

Look into the world of spirits
Explore the night world to understand yourself. Read the minds of others, jump high and believe in yourself!
From the moment you spread your wings as the adorable little owl protagonist, the island becomes your playground, enticing you to soar through lush forests, soar above serene lakes, and glide over rolling hills.



Explore the island
An open world in front of you, small and compact, but still open!
The island's open world invites you to set your own pace. Whether you wish to dive headfirst into quests or lose yourself in the thrill of exploration, the choice is yours.




Communicate with the islanders and help them to solve their problems.
In a world where magic, exploration, and growth intertwine, the friendships you make are the heart and soul of the experience. As you explore the island, remember that each new connection enriches the tapestry of your adventure.




There are many secrets and easter eggs hidden on the island, can you collect them all?
Every path you tread, every riddle you solve, brings you closer to unveiling the treasure's location. The island becomes your canvas of discovery, each landmark a clue waiting to be deciphered.




Hippies, punks, anarchists, rockers and metalheads, we have a riff for everyone!
The festival isn't just about the music; it's about the emotions, memories, and sense of togetherness it evokes. As you wander through the festival grounds, you're surrounded by the exuberant melodies, the infectious beats, and the sheer joy that radiates from the characters you've met along the way.



Meditate at the altars, discover new sides of yourself.
The journey towards self-discovery is not a linear path; it's a series of encounters, challenges, and revelations that gradually shape your character's evolution. Through interactions with the island's inhabitants, you'll glean insights into your own strengths and vulnerabilities.




We are not a huge team, we were afraid for a long time to make a "dream game". But here it is in front of you, what do you say?
Each member of the team infused a piece of themselves into the game. The art reflects the artist's emotions, the writing echoes the writer's experiences, and the music resonates with the composer's soul. This synergy adds layers of authenticity, elevating the game beyond mere entertainment to an experience that leaves an indelible mark on players.

title: Garden of Aiden
description:
게임 정보
"에이든의 정원"에서의 여정에 나서보세요. 마법의 세계 네우라 에덴에서 설정된 몰입형 2D 메트로배니아입니다. 인류의 도착을 준비하기 위해 이 행성을 테라포밍하기 위해 처음에 보내진 집단에서 태어난 독특한 AI인 에이든이 되어보세요. 세기가 지나면서 인간의 기억은 신화로 변했고, 당신과 당신의 종류는 기술과 자연의 혼합을 통해 계속 진화했습니다. 마법과 기계가 결합된 땅의 신비를 풀고, 잊혀진 인류의 이야기를 발견하며 네우라 에덴의 미래를 형성하세요.

주요 특징들:

- 네우라 에덴 탐험: 자연 세계가 AI 기술과 합쳐진 독특한 생태계를 가진 다섯 개의 생물군계를 횡단하세요.

- 메트로배니아 마스터리: '에이든의 정원'의 복잡하게 상호 연결된 세계를 탐색하기 위해 다이내믹한 능력 배열을 발휘하세요. 장애물을 뛰어넘고, 플랫폼을 소환하고, 장벽을 통과하면서 모든 발견이 당신을 그 신비의 더 깊은 곳으로 밀어붙이는 세계의 비밀을 밝히세요.

- 부패한 수호자들과의 전투: 네우라 에덴의 수호자들은 디스코드의 영향을 받아 떨어졌습니다. 각 생물군계는 그 수호자의 비틀린 의지에 의해 형성된 영역을 제시하며, 당신은 수호자가 지키는 지식을 되찾아 세계의 균형을 회복해야 합니다.
