title: Casting Shadows
description:
게임 정보
Eris has had a rough life, and to her it feels like she's just living day to day, trying to make things work. She has always had a hard time connecting with others as the men and women in her life didn't stick around long enough to build meaningful relationships, and sometimes it feels like the whole world is against her. Therapy has helped Eris cope with her anxiety and depression, but it's expensive and hasn't always worked in the way she needs. However, there is one place she knows she can go to feel and be herself, an abandoned graveyard just off the path of a tree-lined country road. It calls to her, beckons her to keep coming back, and to keep visiting the Ghosts that inhabit it. They give her the encouragement she desires to keep moving forward, but things aren't always what they seem. Eris will learn to put her trust into an unlikely source and will discover her destined path is hiding in the shadows.

------

Casting Shadows is a story-driven psychological horror RPG that encourages the player to put trust into an unlikely source, overcome obstacles that may be blocking their destined path, and help others in need.

Turn-based combat is incorporated for the sake of the story, but leveling is not the focus of the game. Players will be encouraged to help those in need, rather than outright end them.

Beautiful pixel style graphics and hand drawn character/creature portraits with a dark gothic aesthetic paint the scene for an emotional dive into the unknown.

title: Trope Tales
description:
게임 정보
Harken back to the days of your youth when you sat slack-jawed and starry-eyed in front of a CRT display for hours with an NES controller in hand. Recall the vainglorious days of yore when you triumphed over the first boss in epic fashion then never actually finished the game. Learn a lot of fun words along the way, too!

When I set out to make a game with RPG Maker, I was quick to realize that it was optimized for making a particular type of game: a classic 2-dimensional JRPG, the likes of Golden Sun, Breath of Fire, Final Fantasy, and Chrono Trigger. So I thought -- why not lean in? Let's make the most JRPG game EVER.

To help develop the story and characters, I turned to "TVTropes" - a repository of "tropes". A trope is defined by the Oxford English dictionary as "a significant or recurrent theme; a motif". Common examples include:

* Contrived Coincidence: an unlikely event happens but, despite the low changes, it's not acknowledged as it was necessary to move the plot
* Nobody Poops: Going to the bathroom simply doesn't happen in fiction
* Fantasy Gun Control: No matter how advanced society becomes, guns don't exist

From a hand-picked collection of hundreds of tropes and the general outline for the Hero's Journey (Campbell's version, circa 1949) this game was born:

Take on the role of Hero, a Silent Protagonist who is Conveniently an Orphan. One day Hero is summoned by the Quest Giver to find the Orbs of Ineffable Power. You must leave your home of Arcadia and travel via Global Airship on a World Tour. Acquire Villain-Beating Artifacts and put together a crack-shot team with party members such as: The Chick, The Smart Guy, and The Childhood Friend. Acquire Plot Armor along the way and learn to use Applied Phlebotinum.

Enjoy a somewhat comical take on classic JRPGs in this blast-from-the-past adventure.

title: Triad
description:
게임 정보
Assemble your triad and embark on an adventure across the realm of Lyria. Choose from 15 unique classes, each with their own epic questline to complete.
Build your Triad
Create a highly customized party of three classes drawn from a pool of 15. Each class is a combination of 2 base classes - will you battle with a righteous Paladin or an animalistic Warden? Each class scales uniquely from six stats, allowing you to build your characters in a multitude of ways!
Explore Lyria
Discover a world filled with distinct environments and unique enemies. Explore a massive open world teeming with towns, dungeons, cities, and intrigue, each with its own secrets to uncover.
A Nod to RPGs of an Older Time
Triad pays homage to classic RPGs, featuring highly customizable characters and parties that adhere to the traditional holy trinity. Prepare for an experience of brutal proportions, as Triad offers little hand-holding while you explore the vast expanses of Lyria.
KEY FEATURES
- 15 highly unique and distinct playable classes
- Tab based real-time combat with 3 controlled characters
- Rewarding loot loop with highly meaningful stats.
- All entities respawn - Factions can be ruined and built based on the types of enemies that you decide to kill
- Dozens of custom spells and effects created for each class.

title: Coding Day
description:
게임 정보
Experience classic survival horror, now in 2D.


SYNOPSIS:

December 2019.

Get ready for a last night of work you'll never forget in "Coding Day: A true story"! After two and a half years of dedication, the release of your project is about to become a reality. But when dark secrets and sinister forces stand in your way, will you be able to survive the final delivery?

Explore a dark and mysterious office building as you fight to escape the entity that threatens to destroy everything you've worked so hard for. With loyal friends who will help you along the way, unexpected enemies, and terrifying creatures whose origins no one knows, you'll never know what awaits you around every corner.

Use your skills to solve challenging puzzles, hack security systems, and find valuable resources to stay alive. But be careful: every move you make could take you closer to darkness and madness. You only have one chance to make it out alive.

"Coding Day: A true story" will take you on a journey to the darkest depths of the world of video game development. Are you ready to face your fears and survive the most terrifying night of your life? Discover the truth behind the dark unknown and save your project before it's too late!

FEATURES:

Interact with a wide variety of characters who will help you progress in your challenge to complete the development of Fear the Dark Unknown.
Pick up all sorts of crazy objects to use in ways never seen before. The puzzles in this game can only be compared to the classics of the genre.
In Coding Day, anything can become a danger. Stress is the main problem for the protagonist, and you never know when you’ll get a call from your bank, when a crazy guy will scare you in the dark hallways, or when your freelance fees will go up.
Don't let stress get the best of you and ruin years of development. Eat everything you find to relieve your stress, but remember: Fast food has consequences.

title: Take That Mainstage!
description:
게임 정보
Live the life of wannabe rockstar!
Take That Mainstage! combines several gameplay styles, including life management, song crafting, conversation battling and rhythm game competition into a unique and innovative life management sim.
Tune into the radio to find the hottest events. Plan your day, manage your skills, gear, and relationships. Influence people, recruit band mates, and sometimes maybe even sleep. Head out and busk for cash, catch a movie, whatever inspires you. The world is open and only you can create your unique path to stardom. Every play through generates a new cast of characters that go about their lives you’ll need to engage with to gain the inspiration you, the artist, needs.
Relationships are key
The people of the world generate thousands of thoughts they think constantly in their diary, all based off their unique personalities. Conversation battle to gain as much of them as you can!
You'll use the things you learn about the world, other people, reactions, and moods from your notebook to talk to, influence, and build (or ruin) relationships. The secrets you can get them to share become the lyrics for your hit songs!
Practice makes perfect
Do you want to be the top drawing live act? Focus on your guitar skills, on-stage charisma, and stage decorations. Or a world class songwriter/recording artist? Level up your song crafting skills and spend resources in the recording studio & on marketing.

title: Elodya
description:
게임 정보
Explore the New Continent of Elodya!
Arriving in a boat from the western continent, you and your crew have been tasked with exploring and learning about the habitants, wildlife, materials and secrets of the undiscovered continent of Elodya!
Gather Materials and Craft Gear!

Gather materials to craft gear and complete quests! Upgrade your camp to unlock more crafting recipes, equip more things and much more!
Fight Diverse Creatures and Bosses!

Fight tough souls-like enemies by using diverse weapons! Craft and equip armors and accessories to defeat bosses and progress through the game!
Meet Interesting Characters!

Build relationships with the inhabitants of Elodya! Upgrade your village with new houses to attract more villagers!

title: Terradune
description:
게임 정보
In Terradune, you’ll explore a vast and vibrant landscape where every corner teems with hidden dungeons, ancient ruins, and wandering monsters. Unravel the world’s lore through engaging quests, unique characters, and gripping narrative arcs—all rendered in a beautiful 2D art style that harkens back to classic action RPGs.
Fast-Paced Combat: Master a fluid battle system that rewards timing and strategy. Wield a variety of melee weapons, ranged attacks, and powerful magic to crush your foes in exhilarating, real-time combat.
Character Progression: Level up, learn new skills, and customize your hero to match your playstyle. Experiment with different builds—from quick and agile rogues to mighty elemental mages—and forge your path to power.
Rich Exploration: Traverse diverse regions, from scorching deserts to hidden grottos, teeming with secret paths and hidden loot. Delve into labyrinthine dungeons filled with menacing bosses and cunning traps.
Immersive Storytelling: Interact with a lively cast of characters, each with their own stories and ambitions. Your choices shape your journey, influencing alliances and potentially altering Terradune’s fate.
Gorgeous Hand-Drawn World: Experience an eye-catching art style that blends vibrant colors with detailed environments, capturing both the whimsical and the perilous aspects of Terradune.
Seek glory, unravel the past, and carve out your legend in this captivating 2D action RPG. Will you become the hero Terradune needs—or the force that reshapes it forever?

title: Hallow Maze
description:
게임 정보
Hallow Maze는 빠르고 유연한 전투 스타일을 갖춘 2.5D 메트로배니아입니다. 시각적 스타일은 손으로 그린 것이며 예술적 스타일은 어두운 고딕 판타지입니다. 당신은 생물로 변신하여 도구의 힘을 사용해 적을 처치하고, 퍼즐을 풀고, 땅 속 깊은 곳에 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀내야 합니다.
게임 아트 스타일은 2-5D 세계에서 세심하게 디자인되어 손으로 그려졌습니다. 문제 해결과 전투 모두에 중요하다고 생각한 메트로배니아 장르의 최고의 메커니즘을 사용합니다.

title: One More Round
description:
게임 정보
In One More Round you step into the boots of an alcoholic engineer aboard a space station orbiting a black hole. Tasked with investigating the mysteries of the blackhole, your choices set you on a time-looping adventure. Each loop reveals subtle changes in the station, your surroundings and yourself, as the black hole’s effects warp reality and time.
Features
A Time-Looping Narrative: Experience the consequences of your decisions as each loop subtly alters the station, the mission and the story.
Immersive Sci-Fi Mystery: Uncover the truth about your mission, the black hole and your past in a setting inspired by hard sci-fi concepts.
Evolving Environment: From subtle colour shifts to critical environmental changes, the space station evolves as you progress.
Gameplay
One More Round is a narrative-driven time loop game set aboard a failing space station. Players take on the role of an alcoholic astronaut grappling with personal failure as they attempt to uncover what lead to the time loop. The game combines immersive storytelling with puzzle-solving and exploration, challenging players to uncover the mysteries of the station and their character's past in each loop. Each loop offers subtle changes—such as altered asset colors or item placements—that grow more dramatic over time, reflecting the character’s increasing despair and the environment's degradation. Players must make strategic decisions, repair systems, and piece together clues to break the loop. With a focus on atmospheric tension and player-driven discovery, One More Round delivers a unique blend and narrative and mechanics in a lo-fi sci-fi setting.
With an lo-fi soundtrack consisting of over 30 original songs, and an emotional narrative, One More Round is a thought-provoking experience that explores redemption, sacrifice and the relentless pull of the unknown.
Will you break the cycle? One More Round could make all the difference.
Mature content warning
This game contains scenes of alcohol abuse and alcohol addiction.

title: Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor
description:
게임 정보
A JRPG about a princess knight's psychological downfall. An honorable princess knight must fight the Bloody Emperor, a ruthless usurper. But through a forced marriage to a vassal and the looming threat of a female dark lord, her ideals gradually begin to crumble...
Features
A journey of disillusionment and loss
To restore her empire, the princess knight's ideals are put to the test. Witness her gradual psychological shift as the many ordeals take their toll on the noble knight.
company: Sounding Stone / 老奉毊, MaouCat Studio / 魔王貓工作室,

title: A.L.A.R.M. - Autistic Lovely Assassins Rise of the Matriarchy
description:
게임 정보
지구는 사라졌다. 탐욕과 부패로 인해 파괴되었고, 이제 남은 것은 오직 스타 루인스(Star Ruins) – 망각 속으로 빠져드는 문명의 부서진 잔재뿐이다.
두 개의 세력이 권력을 놓고 맞서 싸운다:
신디 반군(Syndi Rebellion) – 새로운 세계를 건설하려는 암살자와 혁명가들.
캐노피 코프(Canopy Corp) – 죽어가는 지배력을 유지하려는 폭군, 전쟁 군주, 그리고 사이버네틱 괴물들.
당신은 닉스 드레이븐(Nyx Draven), 아르카눔(Arquanum)의 힘을 부여받은 최정예 암살자 – 금지된 양자과학과 신비주의의 융합체. 전쟁이 절정에 달했으며, 당신의 선택이 스타 루인스의 운명을 결정한다.
적을 아군으로 바꿔 세상을 재건할 것인가, 아니면 억압자들을 몰살하고 피와 반란으로 미래를 조각할 것인가?
A.L.A.R.M. 은 고속 액션 RPG 전투, 영화 같은 Dansassination 결투, 그리고 사이버펑크 디스토피아, 오컬트 호러, 혁명의 초현실적인 세계를 결합한 게임이다.
주요 특징
역동적인 액션 전투를 마스터하라
베고, 춤추고, 암살하라 – 닌자식 아크로바틱 기술과 Dansassination의 리듬 처형을 조합해 적을 치명적인 춤으로 유인하라.
애피니티(성향) 기반 전투 – 스타일이 힘을 결정한다.
의상은 용맹, 우울, 눈부심 같은 애피니티를 부여하며, 능력과 저항력을 변화시킨다.
특수 전투 스타일 – 검의 정밀한 공격부터 아르카눔을 활용한 파괴적인 기술까지 다양한 스킬 트리를 익혀라.
사악한 존재들과 맞서라 – 미스트 메이든(Mist Maidens), 사이버네틱 괴물, 그리고 빅터(Victor)의 장군들과 맞붙어라.
DANSASSINATION – 리듬 속 암살
autokwd: A.L.A.R.M. - Autistic Lovely Assassins Rise of the Matriarchy

title: GoopUp
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an unforgettable adventure in GoopUp!
Explore a vibrant world filled with mysterious hats, each granting unique powers that unlock hidden pathways and help you overcome the world’s obstacles.
Team up with a friend to strategize and solve mind-bending puzzles woven into the fabric of GoopUp's world.
Gameplay Features:
Hats with Powers – Discover and equip different hats to alter gameplay and reveal secrets.

title: Time Breaking: Dino Breach
description:
게임 정보
Time Breaking: Dino Breach는 Dino Crisis에서 영감을 받은 등각 생존 호러 게임입니다.
고전 Dino Crisis의 긴박한 생존 역학과 긴장감을 반영한 게임플레이를 통해, Time Breaking: Dino Breach는 액션, 퍼즐 해결, 그리고 치명적인 공룡들로 가득한 선사시대 정글과 밀폐된 연구 시설을 탐험하며 경험하는 순수한 서스펜스의 순간들을 제공합니다.
주요 게임 특징:
감동적이고 몰입감 넘치는 스토리를 경험하세요: R.O.P.E. 병사인 Kate Jeong이 되어, 그녀가 깊이 사랑하는 사람 Alan의 비극적인 운명을 바꾸기 위해 과거로 시간 여행을 떠납니다. 그러나 그녀의 선택은 어떤 결과를 초래할까요?
위험한 환경을 탐험하세요: 적대적인 선사시대 정글과 밀폐된 연구 시설을 탐험하며, 생존과 죽음을 가를 수 있는 자원, 무기 및 중요한 아이템을 찾아보세요.
치명적인 공룡에 맞서세요: Dino Crisis에서 영감을 받은 공룡들의 행동을 바탕으로, 위험한 공룡들과 긴장감 넘치고 공포스러운 전투를 벌이세요. 지혜를 발휘하고 제한된 탄약을 신중하게 관리하여 그들을 물리치거나 도망치세요.
퍼즐과 수수께끼를 해결하세요: 진행을 위해 퍼즐과 환경 수수께끼를 해결하고, 무기 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하며, 포악한 공룡으로부터 생존에 필요한 유용한 도구를 찾아보세요.

title: Your Crown Is Mine
description:
게임 정보
Take the throne and fix the corrupt kingdom— or worsen it! A villainess life simulator and visual novel where you balance your stats and romance rival nations' leaders for foreign policy purposes. Make choices to affect your stats and the entire nation's story. Includes hundreds of manhwa-style artworks hand-drawn by me. How will you rule?
🌟Princess-raising simulator x Country Management x Otome isekai villainess manhwa!
The land of Iriyn is riddled with issues like a stagnant economy, shaky foreign relations, and a dissatisfied public. You can try to fix these, or make it worse for the sake of chasing personal wealth and power. Your choices will determine what happens to the world, and what people say about you. Beware of the 'scandal sheet' newspapers that try to slander you!
🗺️ Setting: A fantasy pseudo-European world inspired by the 19th century, governed by aristocracy. Similar to the world of most Otome Isekai stories!

title: FFA CARDS
description:
게임 정보
GENRE
A strategy card game in the FFA format.
FOR WHOM
Our game is designed specially for those who appreciate the ability to think strategically, who look for intellectual challenges and want to play something special.
GAMEPLAY
Six players confront each other for leadership through efficient resource allocation and tactical use of the abilities of Heroes and Disciples.
FEATURES AND PRINCIPLES:
WE CARE FOR THE COMMUNITY
Suggest ideas, discuss changes and influence the development of the game.
Taking care of the players is our top priority.
NEXT GENERATION GAMEPLAY
Deep strategies, multiple opportunities and the unique character of each game.
You can find all this in a next generation game which turns the concept of the card entertainment upside down.

title: Hurling Herman
description:
게임 정보
당신의 능력을 테스트해보세요
Hurling Herman에서 신비한 지하 세계의 깊숙한 곳으로 내려가보세요. 이 독특한 플랫폼 게임은 발사체 물리학의 기술을 마스터하는 데 도전합니다.
당신의 길을 구축하세요
당신의 무기는요? 간단한 약병. 당신의 힘? 그것을 던지고 임시 플랫폼을 생성하는 능력, 파악하기 어려운 단계 차단. 이 블록을 사용하여 위험한 지형을 탐색하고, 치명적인 생물을 능가하고, 아찔한 높이에 도달하세요.
심연을 통한 대기 여행
Hurling Herman은 4개의 서로 다른 지하 영역에 걸쳐 40개의 레벨로 매혹적인 여행을 제공합니다. 지하 환경을 완벽하게 보완하는 피아노와 신스 멜로디가 혼합된 게임의 분위기 있는 사운드트랙에 푹 빠져보세요.

title: Redemption of the Damned
description:
게임 정보

You are a field doctor's assistant who was heading to a distant village to help local peasants. Someone attacked your stagecoach and you wake up in a mass grave, being the only survivor. Curb your fear because you are waiting for facing incredible beasts and monsters, and you are just a human.

The brutal and dangerous world of Redemption of the Damned will not give the chance to slack off, the slightest mistake may be the last.
SURVIVE

In the first turn the enemy is dangerous not by the number. Even among people there are those who themselves want to see how the world is ablaze. Do not let evil spirits prevail over you, help the locals, but do not forget about yourself - you also need water, food and sleep. But the most important thing is not to go crazy. To do this, keep your mental health normal with the help of potions and altars.


EXPLORE
The RoD universe is much bigger than it seems. How many secrets lie in forgotten but not abandoned ruins? How many answers can you find in the dark corners of the world around you?




Find everything you need for battle and survival. Explore multi-level dungeons in search of relic items.

Go to the open world after the battles in dungeons network to replenish your resources in special hunting zones consisting of forests, swamps, fields etc. Having gained strength, return to the kingdom of darkness, because in the fight against evil it is you who are the main and only hope of the locals for survival.


Mortal danger is everywhere. Dangerous monsters, supernatural monsters with its own behavior and specific mechanics... There is no single way to deal with each of them.




Carefully study your enemy, prepare thoroughly and choose the appropriate way to kill. Melee combat, traditional and unique firearms, and, of course, specific ways of killing (cross, holy water, aspen stakes, witch's candles etc) are available to you.
And remember the most important rule - "always finish the fallen creature, without giving a chance for revenge".

title: Dreaming Worlds
description:
게임 정보
In Dreaming Worlds you play as the red panda Rin and rescue the other Dream Wardens from a mysterious nightmare that has thrown the dream worlds out of balance and turned their inhabitants to stone...or worse!


In order to do this, you must enter and explore the dream worlds of the other Guardians. There you will be faced with tricky puzzles, you have to overcome gorges and cross deserts.




But you are not completely on your own. Although the other Dream Wardens have been mysteriously trapped, you can use some of their special abilities yourself to overcome the obstacles in your journey.




Kitsune the Fox Spirit, Leyfin the Elephant Oracle, and Garv the Panther King await your rescue! The three dream guardians await you in their unique worlds with different challenges and captivating stories.


♦ A third-person game with puzzle & platformer elements
♦ beautiful and stylized worlds
♦ backed with an atmospheric soundtrack
♦ various magical stories
company: Dominik Wolff, Games by Dominik Wolff

title: Bobo Bay
description:
게임 정보


Bobo Bay is a pet simulation game where you collect, mash(breed), accessorize, and train little creatures to compete in races and other competitions.
Lots of bobos
There are thousands of combinations of Bobos you can make. Body color, eye color, body part shapes, patterns, sheens, stats, personality traits, etc will all change with each Bobo you find or mash! Distinct Bobo traits and moods will completely change how you interact and care for your Bobos. Don't forget to dress them up in a fancy little top hat as well.



Bobos start their life as . Then they grow into a which is basically their young adult form. As the Bobo ages and changes based on their stats, they will reach a final form. Finally, at some point, the Bobo will and offer you the chance to let it evolve!
are the main event in this Bobo world. Different companies and organizations from around the globe sponsor different competition series and award unique prizes! Bring your Bobos along to the to enter them into a competition. Maybe you just want to put your Bobo into the which consists of 5 beginner races on 5 different maps that focus on Bobo generalists who have decent skills in running, swimming, and climbing. OR maybe you want to train your Bobo to compete in the which puts Bobos high in the sky jumping across skyscraper rooftops for 3 difficult races.

Once you get more Bobos, sign them all up for a team relay race! Also, you never know maybe your Bobos will compete in other sports too... hmmmm.. hMM!!!!

Don't miss the chance to take down the legendary . If your Bobo beats one of these blockheads then you'll be rewarded with a brand new sapling that is the same species as the Bobo Star. These new species open up loads more Bobo customization possibilities since they offer new colors, patterns, and shapes to mash with your other Bobos.



This next sentence is a teaser -> One of the species is a . Scary!
Walk through a cute little town to buy accessories for your Bobos to wear, register a new Bobo and see competition history at the Town Hall, purchase snacks for your Bobo to eat, or even adopt a Bobo from the shelter. Remember to go back at night time to see some different shops and options.



The time and date are very important! All competitions have scheduled dates they will be held. Check the competition calendar on the Sports Complex to sign up for any competitions that seem tempting! Some competitions will take place every day and night, while others might only happen once a week. Plan ahead and make sure your Bobos are ready to eradicate the competition when the time comes.

It will always be worth checking out each area every day and night. You wouldn't want to miss how rowdy the town gets when celebrating Flag Day!

title: Ventreville: A Cure  Sorrow
description:
게임 정보
Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow is a fantasy visual novel game with a colorful cast of playable characters, each with their own unique mechanics, and all of whom are necessary in solving this mystery. But be careful, as your choices will determine whether their stories end in ruin or victory.

Start as Orven Zanry, an up-and-coming glassblower working for the esteemed Ret Avidine. Work to uncover the secrets of “Remedium,” the cure to the plague destroying the city of Ventreville. And as you learn more about the remedy, your hero, and your coworkers, realize that things are not as they seem…

Key Features
Choices with Consequences: Choose how you play Orven, and see the characters shift based on your choices
Butterfly Effect: Determine the fate of Ventreville and its inhabitants with branching routes, some silly and some dire
Replay to find all the unique endings
More than 75k words for 2.5 hours of gameplay per playthrough
Enjoy the stylish character designs
Live in Ventreville through the expressive backgrounds
Hear the city through an original soundtrack
First chapter of a six-chapter game

title: Jasper's Dream
description:
게임 정보
Jasper's Dream is a first person puzzle game set in a techno mystic Egyptian world. Help Jasper, a robot programmed to create games, by solving his mind-bending puzzles. You will also explore an abandonned futuristic pyramid and unravel its many mysteries.



Follow the guide !
Follow Jasper, a flying robot with a strong personnality, he will be your guide inside the pyramid of Zerzura, renowned for its cult of games and the worship of Ptah, god of creation and creators. Unravel the mystery of the pyramid's abandonment and help its last resident, Jasper, to create a game.




Use Jasper's sand gun to carry and spread magic sand on your environment and take advantage of their many properties to solve complex and fascinating puzzles.
Use Jasper's magic sands to bring electricity from generators to mechanisms like doors, moving platforms, lasers and more. The links you'll create range from simple lines to complex entanglement of multiple colors.




Jasper will also test your platforming skills, be ready to run fast and jump high ! Some challenges will have you run against the clock.




Jasper knows you are not from his world, he will adress YOU, the player, not the avatar you control. This will make for some akward interactions and funny easter eggs. Most of all, Jasper needs a player to test the result of his work and he will surely ask for your honest opinion.




Jasper doesn't really understand the concept of a menu for a game, he linked all the settings of the game to special gauges that the player can fill more or less to adjust the settings. You may have to use these gauges in some unconventional ways.

title: PROJECT MIX
description:
게임 정보
We will be hosting a crowdfunding campaign. Pre-Release page out, find us on Kickstarter!
Project Mix is a VR anime narrative game.
Set in the red light district of Mong Kok, you play as Rone, a young former thug starting a new beginning to try leave behind his life of crime. He unexpectedly becomes a bartender after a chance meeting with Valencia, the eccentric bar owner of Eleventh Heaven.
At first, you live by the paycheck working at Eleventh Heaven, but as you find yourself hearing a bit too much for your own good, you find yourself thrown into a deep conspiracy.

title: Piñata Puppy World
description:
게임 정보
Piñata Puppy World is a nostalgia-driven explorative campaign game inspired by the 2000s, featuring an emotional and surreal storyline where players explore their past through the lens of a grainy VHS camera, disguised within the genre of “Mascot Horror”.

title: HexLands
description:
게임 정보


영향력을 넓히고 영향력을 키우면 곧 왕이 당신의 야망을 두려워하게 될 것입니다.
사용 가능한 자원, 카드와 보너스를 효율적으로 사용하고, 덱을 맞춤화한 후, 환경에 적응하며, 절차적 퀘스트를 완료해야 합니다... 그렇지 않으면 다음 섬으로 항해를 시작할 수 있는 충분히 강한 식민지를 세울 수 없습니다!
항해를 시작하고, 현명하게 선택하세요! 어느 섬의 보너스와 생물군계가 당신의 플레이 스타일과 전략에 가장 잘 맞나요?
북쪽의 혹독한 추위, 건조한 사막 섬, 그리고 다른 역겨운 기후들을 견딜 수 있을까요?
당신의 제국은 얼마나 멀리 도달할까요?



당신의 첫 건물은 항상 시청이며, 그것이 주변의 몇몇 타일에 대한 소유권을 주장합니다.
인구를 늘리고 당신의 영토가 확장되는 것을 지켜보세요!
당신의 섬이 충분히 인구가 밀집되어 있다면, 다음 섬으로 떠날 수 있습니다!
그러나 왜 그 가치 있는 자원을 낭비하겠습니까? 인구가 많을수록 더 큰 보상을 받게 됩니다!







게임에 대한 피드백, 질문, 문제가 있으면 저에게 연락 주시기를 망설이지 마세요. 최선을 다할게요! 오, 게임이 즐거웠다면 알려주세요. 그건 정말 제 하루를 만들어줍니다! 🙂

title: Horse Evolutions
description:
게임 정보
You are a Horse. You play as a wild horse with a freeform camera. It is you versus the world avoiding being captured. Natural disasters involving the elements, man, and gravity are your enemy. Preserve and increase your herd through your offspring, extending your lineage.


You have no weapons, no rider, and a limited to no onscreen user interface.

title: Existence = !Existence;

게임 정보 "존재 =! 존재"
- 장면 모드 : 2066 년. 지난 세기 동안 기술은 큰 발전을 이루었습니다. 세계 생산량은 90 %가 로봇 식이고, 행성은 실업, 빈곤 및 위기의 물결에 휩쓸 렸고, 인류는 인간의 삶의 지속 기간에 한계를 드러내 기 위해 더 가까워지고 있지만 지구상의 상황은 인구 중 층화를 일으켰습니다. 부자들은 자신들이 신이라고 생각하며 모든면에서 인구의 가난한 부분을 얕보고 있습니다. 당신은 인구의 낮은 계층의 권리를 방어하는 해커 그룹의 일원입니다.
- 끝이없는 모드 : 얼마나 오랫동안 적의 끝없는 맹공격을 이길 수 있습니까?

- 음악 반주 : 소리 부분 존재 =! 존재; 이들은 Alef와 Wice와 같은 복고풍 네온 방향의 가장 젊은 재능입니다.

title: Project F.A.L.S.E.
description:
게임 정보

Project F.A.L.S.E. is a game about an alternative world after the tragedy at a powerful energy complex as part of the experiment "Fast Atomic Leading Super Energy" in 2042. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of complete chaos and destruction of the new world, which is faced with great global problems, the solution of which depends on the fate of all mankind. Among these problems: the decline of large areas, a blow to the environment, a high mortality rate. The world's most powerful nations have joined forces and created special military units to address the very dangerous challenges on which the salvation of the world depends.
What awaits you:
You will have to play as a military agent of a secret special unit, performing tasks from the Central Headquarters. But not everything is so simple. The secret services are constantly hindered by various obstacles: robbers and terrorists, mutants and zombies, enemy troops and agents, harsh weather conditions and air pollution. At each level you have to be careful, because danger lurks everywhere.
In the game you will find many different levels with interesting tasks, including:

Key Features:

Interactive Performance Opportunities: Sing or voice the protagonist—perfect for sharing your personality with friends or your streaming audience. Whether you're singing for fun or turning it into a live performance, Love in Space is a stellar way to connect with your viewers.

title: Saikin
description:

Unleash Your Inner Hero: Dive into the Epic Adventure of Saikin

Calling all adventurers! Saikin by Shiryu Studios is an immersive MMORPG that will ignite your thirst for exploration and epic battles. Embark on a journey where breathtaking landscapes meet a captivating storyline, leaving you yearning for more.

Unravel the Mysteries: A world brimming with secrets awaits. Embark on quests that unveil hidden truths, forgotten lore, and forgotten treasures. Forge your path as you uncover the mysteries that shape Saikin's destiny.

A World Crafted for Immersion:

Breathtaking Vistas: Explore sprawling landscapes teeming with life and detail. Traverse majestic mountains, delve into mystical forests, and lose yourself in the beauty of a world brought to life with stunning visuals.
A Feast for the Senses: Saikin's immersive soundscapes and captivating soundtrack will transport you into the heart of the action. Through a carefully crafted audio experience, you will feel the intensity of battle, the tranquility of peaceful moments, and the magic of discovery.

title: Unknown Operations : The Habitus
description:
게임 정보
Unknown Operations: The Habitus
is a story-driven, single-player, first-person tactical shooter set during World War II. In the game, you take on the role of Eduard Pěnkava, a soldier and later an agent of the secret organization Habitus, fighting not only against the Nazis but also for the safety of his loved ones and higher ideals. The story combines fictional and historical characters and events to create an intense and captivating experience.
The game is developed on Unreal Engine 5, delivering high visual quality and a seamless gameplay experience. With planned updates, the game will adapt to the latest versions of this advanced engine, ensuring players have access to the best possible technological advancements.
Key Features:
Historical Inspiration: Missions are inspired by real events, such as the Battle of Czajankova Barracks or the Operation of the Three Kings. The game features accurate models of weapons and certain vehicles from World War II.
Vehicle and Static Weapon Control: Take the wheel of tanks, trucks, or cars, or operate heavy machine guns and cannons to turn the tide of battle.
Compelling Story: A narrative filled with espionage, sabotage, and moral dilemmas, told retrospectively from an interrogation room of the secret police.
Intense Gameplay: Destroy enemy bases, adapt to changing environments, and strategize on the battlefield with realistic ballistics and destructible environments.
NPC Interaction: Engage with characters through a dialogue system and uncover key information that influences the story's progression.
Advanced AI: NPCs dynamically respond to situations using the Utility AI system, adding realism to the gameplay.
Dynamic Environment: Experience changing weather, day-night cycles, and interactive environmental elements that immerse you in the war atmosphere.
Historical Authenticity:
The game emphasizes the accuracy of weapons and certain vehicles, but due to the constraints faced by a solo developer, not all building models and clothing are fully historically accurate. Nevertheless, the game strives to convey an authentic sense of the wartime conflict and its atmosphere.

title: Project OutFox
description:
게임 정보
Project OutFox is a fully extensible, cross-platform rhythm game sim engine based on StepMania, featuring 21 different modes simulating different dance, instrument, and key-based rhythm games.
Its goal is to become a cross-platform “sandbox” and “working museum” for the genre, supporting nearly 25 years worth of content. It is developed by a team of community volunteers creating a game for the fans by the fans. The aim is to be community focussed and to celebrate what rhythm games have done to the world, providing an archive for future generations of players.
It has extensive chart format support across different simulated game modes;
Dance Pad Based Modes
dance (3k, 3k double, 4k, 4k double, 6k, 6k double) .dwi, .sm, .ssc, .bms - The default game type. This game type uses four lanes in the cardinal directions (left, down, up, right). It also contains a 6-lane style, adding up-left and up-right directions, and a 3-lane style using only up-left, down, and up-right.

groove (4k, 4k double) .ssc, - The default game type with mods and gimmick support. This game type uses four lanes in the cardinal directions (left, down, up, right). It features support for extended modifiers, shaders and special effects to create whacky and exciting files to test your friends!
pump (5k, 5k double, 6k (halfdouble) .ksf, .sma, .sm, .ssc - A five-lane dance game, which uses four diagonal directions and the center rather than cardinal directions.
techno (4k, 4k double, 5k, 5k double, 8k, 8k double, 9k, 9k double) .sm, .ssc - A dance game type designed for pads with nine panels, including 4-lane (similar to dance), 5-lane (similar to pump), 8-lane (using all but the center panel), and 9-lane styles in single and double versions.
smx (3k, 3k double, 5k, 5k double) .ssc - A dance game type designed by StepRevolution using a new unique pad which uses the cardinal directions plus middle (left, down, up, right and centre).
ds3ddx (4k + 4 sensor, 5k + 5 sensor) .ssc - A dance game whose format is common among Chinese arcade dance games, which uses four diagonal foot panels, and four hand sensors around the pad in the cardinal directions. The game also supports the 5k variant that allows full interoperability with the different revisions of arcade versions.

title: Blood Reckoning: The Eternal War
description:
게임 정보
A Dark Fantasy MMORPG for the Brave and Bold
Embark on a journey in Blood Reckoning: The Eternal War, a dark fantasy MMORPG that merges the nostalgia of classic role-playing games with groundbreaking mechanics. Set in a world torn apart by the mysterious and powerful Blood-Stones, this game challenges players to forge their own paths in an unforgiving realm where every decision matters.
Key Features:
🗡 Revolutionary Item-Based Skill System: Customize your character like never before with an inventory-based skill system. Discover powerful grimoires, magical artifacts, and rare items that define your playstyle and create endless combinations of abilities.
🏰 Dynamic Castle Sieges: Engage in massive multiplayer battles, claim fortresses, and shape the balance of power in a fractured world.
🛡 Intense PvP Combat: Test your strategy and skills in high-stakes player-versus-player battles, or team up with allies to dominate the battlefield.
🐉 Flyable Dragon Mounts: Soar through the skies on majestic dragons, exploring breathtaking landscapes and uncovering hidden secrets.
🛠 Immersive Crafting and Economy: Forge powerful gear, craft potions, and trade in a thriving player-driven economy.
📜 Intricate Storylines: Delve into a rich narrative filled with moral choices, epic quests, and a world forever changed by the Bloodstones’ magic.
🕵️ Challenging Puzzles and Secrets: Unearth mysteries and solve world-spanning enigmas that reward your curiosity and wit.
🔮 Pre-Alpha Testing and Community-Driven Development: Join our vibrant community, participate in exclusive tests, and help shape the future of Bloodstone.

The Blood-Stones have reshaped existence, merging the mortal realm with the Shadow Realm. Let the Bloodstones decide your fate.

title: WAIFU WARS ONLINE

게임 정보
Game about a troubled mind succumbing to the calls of the void.

Seek the way down.

title: Industrix
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Industrix, the ultimate factory building game in a stunning low poly 3D environment. In this game, you'll embark on a journey to build the biggest and most efficient production lines ever seen, all while exploring different islands and unlocking new resources and technologies.

At the start of the game, you'll be dropped off on a deserted island with nothing but your wits and a few basic resources. From there, you'll need to gather materials, refine them, and craft them into usable components for your factories. The more you produce, the more resources you'll unlock, allowing you to expand your production capabilities and create even more advanced products.

But it's not just about making things; you'll also need to manage your resources wisely, optimizing your factories for maximum efficiency and productivity. You'll need to balance your production rates with your energy consumption, ensuring that you're not wasting valuable resources on unnecessary processes. As you progress through the game, you'll encounter challenges and obstacles that will test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.

But it's not all work and no play in Industrix. Along the way, you'll encounter other companies that are also vying for dominance in the market. You need to compete with them head-on, using your superior production skills to outmaneuver and outproduce them.

As you grow your production capabilities, you'll unlock new islands to explore, each with its own unique resources and challenges. You'll need to adapt your production strategies to each new environment, experimenting with new technologies and production methods to stay ahead of the competition.

Industrix is the ultimate factory building game, offering endless possibilities for creativity, strategy, and exploration. With stunning low poly graphics, challenging gameplay, and a vast world to explore, this game is sure to keep you engaged for hours on end. So what are you waiting for? Start building your empire today!

title: The Bucketlist Tourist
description:
게임 정보
The Bucketlist Tourist is a thrilling multiplayer party game that takes photographic challenges to a new level.

In this exciting game, players compete for the best ratings on their photos. Each participant has their own remote shutter and a limited number of shots to showcase their best work.

Inspired by Europe's famous tourist attractions, the Bucketlist challenges lead players to vibrant, colorful locations. Together, they explore these places and take on various tasks.

At the end of each round, the photos are evaluated based on specific criteria, with the player who has the most creative and compelling snapshots emerging as the winner!

title: Echoes of the Forgotten
description:
게임 정보


Recognized for his unparalleled skills in investigating the paranormal, Alex answered Karlheinz Asylum's distress call, sensing it would be a challenging case. The lone path out was imprisoned beneath the terrifying depths of the darkness, buried there. Alex searched the deserted tunnels for all keys to escape. The urge to unravel the asylum's mysteries grew with each step deeper into its enigmatic shadows. The detective followed his gut and moved through physical tension to reveal the secrets that lay beneath.

With the startling realization that the only way to find the elusive keys to liberty was to delve deeper into the darkness, Alex's struggle to escape the asylum's control became more and more passionate as the dreadful reality set in.


Explore the haunting corridors and derelict chambers of the forsaken asylum, each room holding secrets and horrors that will send shivers down your spine.
Beware of the otherworldly entities that lurk in the shadows, ready to plunge you into madness. Can you outwit and evade these malevolent forces?
Dive into a visually stunning environment, heightened by a bone-chilling soundtrack that intensifies the sense of dread and suspense with every step.
Your sanity is your lifeline. As you search for the keys to escape, remember that the darkness can consume you, leading to a grisly demise.

title: Black Otaku 2: Taekwondo is in my Blood
description:
게임 정보
거의 치명적인 교통사고 후, 사하라 B. 샤바즈는 긴급하게 수혈이 필요했습니다!

title: Port of Jumanah
description:
게임 정보
Sail Away, Sail Away
Explore a multitude of oceans, each with a different environment and unique species. Find treasures, discover every secret, defeat whatever is lurking beneath the surface, and be on your merry way!
Rise from zero to…?
Complete missions to upgrade your kit to complete even more missions. That’s called a gameplay loop, baby! Unlock new abilities and gear to help you out during your descents into the unknown.
You don’t have friends, you have...people who are with you
Is it wise to go on long voyages by yourself? Maybe. But a crew behind your back makes you look a little cooler. Recruit new members to your vessel, and they will help you on your journeys. There is also a cat! What do they bring to the table? The only way to find out is to recruit them, but no way you're getting a CV out of any of them.

title: Inside Utopia
description:
게임 정보
Texts available in 12 languages, check it out!
This is a Visual Novel about exploration, coming of age and moral dilemmas.

You play as Didi, a brave young girl who must quickly overcome her innocence and question her principles in order to infiltrate Utopia and snatch the legendary Gold Stone back into her home land, or else the incompetent Queen will execute her mother, and the Kingdom will fall into collapse due to her negligence.

Didi must explore and befriend the kind people in Utopia in order to gain their trust, become one of them, and explore the island until discovering the location of the elusive Gold Stone and facing the ultimate dilemma: snatch it and save her mother and Kingdom, but let Utopia fall into disgrace? Or sacrifice her mother for the greater good of a seemingly perfect and kind society? Or...?

This is a non-violent and relaxing game, and while you progress in the main storyline, it will also invite you to self-reflect about in which type of society you would like to live into, as you learn the very peculiar ways in which the utopians have built their own.

title: A Forest Tale: Porasy
description:
게임 정보
Porasy is an indie platformer that combines the thrill of classic 2D action with the rich, untold stories of the Tupi-Guarani mythology. Inspired by childhood favorites like Sonic and MegaMan, Porasy brings a fresh challenge to the platforming genre, immersing players in a dangerous, atmospheric world of Brazilian folklore.
You’ll step into the shoes of Porasy, a courageous young woman on a mission to uncover the dark secrets of a wild and untamed forest. Accompanied by her faithful companion, Lelo, a clever bird with his own mysterious past, Porasy must navigate treacherous landscapes, battle fierce enemies, and confront powerful bosses that test both your reflexes and your resolve.
Porasy is a game for those who love a challenge, a great story, and a world that feels alive. Are you ready to step into the untold myths of the Brazilian forest and face what lurks in its shadows? The forest awaits — but be warned: it’s a place where only the strongest survive.
Currently under heavy development

title: Marsbound
description:
게임 정보

MARSBOUND is a survival game which combines elements of economic strategy and psychological thriller. The player assumes the role of an AI manager, leading the international mission "Mars – The New Home." In their hands are the lives of Earth's brightest specialists.
When unforeseen events push the first Martian colony to the brink of disaster, carefully laid plans will crumble, and survival will become the main priority. To accomplish the mission despite all challenges, the player must develop technologies, explore unknown territories, and build life-supporting infrastructure, while Mars grudgingly offers resources but generously throws up obstacles. Every decision brings the colonists closer to either prosperity or catastrophe, with consequences often delayed in time.
The dangers aren’t only outside the base. Isolation, stress, and conflicts threaten to tear the team apart from within. We must not only meet the colonists' needs but also monitor their mental health, preventing hostility toward ourselves and outbreaks of madness.
MARSBOUND is about managing resources and people while balancing on the edge of disaster every day. Strategic thinking, composure, and courage are the player's steadfast allies on the path to victory.

title: Red Recon: 1944
description:
게임 정보
Red Recon is an isometric real-time tactical game with stealth elements, placing you in command of a squad of Soviet scouts deployed into East Prussia in the autumn of 1944. Your mission: gather intelligence and carry out precision strikes against enemy forces on the eve of the Red Army’s strategic offensive.
You will face a variety of tasks and circumstances, demanding everything from discreet infiltration of enemy installations to skillful squad management in open battle. Not only must you accomplish your objectives, but you must also survive deep behind enemy lines, working with limited resources, evading constant enemy pursuit, and maintaining contact with your “Center.”
Such a mission can only be entrusted to hardened fighters. Under your command will be a partisan from the Pskov forests, a Baltic Fleet marine, an experienced underground operative from a Smolensk, a taiga hunter-sniper, and many other soldiers. Each of them possesses unique wartime-honed skills and their own motivation for being part of the squad.

title: Spawn World
description:
게임 정보
We aim to create a world without limits. A game that doesn't put you in any box, it allows you to define yourself. Strive for your own ambitions, achieve them in any way you deem fit. Go out and embark on an adventure, set out to build an empire, settle and hone your craft - it's up to you. Your new life is a legend waiting to be written...Spawn in a new world.
Create your own class, shape your character around your play-style
Classes are not set in stone. Your 'class' is derived from the choices you make as a player to shape your character - this includes the variety of skills you choose for your arsenal, the type of equipment you use, the stats you allocate, etc. However you strategise your combat tactics will influence your decisions in this regard.
Adrenaline-fuelled skill-based combat

title: Anima Shin Gun
description:
게임 정보
총알을 맞아야 살아남는 Bullet Hell Rail Shooter.
적과 싸우고 올바른 색상 주파수로 전환하여 총알을 "생명 초"로 흡수하세요. 시간 루프를 깨고 카운트다운이 0이 되기 전에 전체 모험을 완료하기 위해 충분히 오래 살아남으세요!

아멜리아로 플레이, 인류에 의문을 품기 시작한 동물 영웅

title: Sanguis: Veil of the Forgotten
description:

One night, your normal life is shattered when a friend leads you into the fog-covered woods, revealing a long-buried darkness. Drawn into a world of occult practices, ancient creatures, and supernatural forces, you must navigate a terrifying dungeon and uncover the truth behind the dark ritual. The deeper you go, the more you realize you're not just a bystander - you’re the main prey on tonight’s menu. Make choices that determine your fate and uncover the truth behind the ancient rite before it’s too late. Will you escape the blood-stained curse, or become its next victim?
Experience a dynamic and visually rich narrative. Each moment and shift in the story is uniquely illustrated, immersing you in a world that responds to every action and change in emotion. Complementing this is a diverse musical score, reflecting every twist in the journey.
Make friends, confront enemies, and question the true intentions of those around you. Can you decipher their true motives and make the right choices to ensure your survival?

title: Mion and the Cursed Killer Hamster
description:
게임 정보
If you are a fan of Eva Morozova, Eugène Ionesco, or Daniil Kharms, this game will surely delight you, outrage you, outeat you, and outshi... Ahem. Let's not talk about that yet.

Mion is a most ordinary warrior queen from the magical realm of Wharevarland. She studies at an ordinary vocational magical school, tries to win the love of an ordinary count, and also has a little secret...

The beautiful warrioress is able to magically emit wind with her hair! She also accidentally bought a cursed killer hamster, and now she has to battle a dangerous verse-making kraken!

Absurd. Ridiculousness. Idiocy.
What awaits you on this adventure?

🟠 Spooky Prophecy - 1 piece.
🟠 Sexy Count De Loboda - 1 piece.
🟠 Dwarf kraken and his Mistress - 1+1 piece.
🟠 Sea Captain Sinbavicus - 1 piece.
🟠 Secrets, intrigue, investigations - lots of pieces.
🟠 A bunch of minigames aimed at destroying the evil hamsters who intend to prevent Mion from achieving her goals.

You will find about 100-150 pages of text and a great deal of minigames, in which you must demonstrate exceptional reaction speed.
Take control of the plot by clicking buttons in the dialogue. Use your mouse to destroy the evil hamsters.
Outwit the hamsters in card games. Take a serious flash quiz, the outcome of which will determine the fate of all of Wharevarland.
How do you play this?

Read the text, choose plot developments with your mouse, disintegrate hamsters. Warning: A good ending will be revealed only if you "defuse" all the opponents in the minigames! If you don't succeed, the beautiful warrior queen will die! Yes, yes, I warned you. And don't write in reviews and on the forum that a good ending is difficult to achieve. If you find this game difficult, try practicing on 'Dork Sells' or 'Shakiro: Shadows Fall Twice' first.

🟠 Spiral Shooting Range.
🟠 Regular Shooting Range.

You are a young resistance leader whose parents were killed by covetous technocrats. Recruit and lead ordinary people, in whom true heroes lie dormant. Explore shady corners of a huge city of Solar-30 and fight androids, the mafia, and creepy mutants in a synchronous combat system.
GAME FEATURES
Fight in synchronized battles where you and your enemies move at the same time
Predict your opponent's actions, combine the skills of heroes and use surroundings to win!
Build your secret headquarters!
Build new sections like the training ground, hi-tech workshop, or the library.
Recruit a variety of heroes to join the resistance!
There are 10 available classes to build any type of team.
Improve your heroes and modify their equipment and weapons!
Develop the physical and mental abilities of your fighters. Help the heroes with their psychological problems that affect the gameplay!
Explore a dark future world that combines cyberpunk and post-apocalypse vibes
Talk with colorful characters and find stashes with useful items.

title: Mion and the Cursed Killer Hamster
description:
게임 정보
If you are a fan of Eva Morozova, Eugène Ionesco, or Daniil Kharms, this game will surely delight you, outrage you, outeat you, and outshi... Ahem. Let's not talk about that yet.

Mion is a most ordinary warrior queen from the magical realm of Wharevarland. She studies at an ordinary vocational magical school, tries to win the love of an ordinary count, and also has a little secret...

The beautiful warrioress is able to magically emit wind with her hair! She also accidentally bought a cursed killer hamster, and now she has to battle a dangerous verse-making kraken!

Absurd. Ridiculousness. Idiocy.
What awaits you on this adventure?

🟠 Spooky Prophecy - 1 piece.
🟠 Sexy Count De Loboda - 1 piece.
🟠 Dwarf kraken and his Mistress - 1+1 piece.
🟠 Sea Captain Sinbavicus - 1 piece.
🟠 Secrets, intrigue, investigations - lots of pieces.
🟠 A bunch of minigames aimed at destroying the evil hamsters who intend to prevent Mion from achieving her goals.

You will find about 100-150 pages of text and a great deal of minigames, in which you must demonstrate exceptional reaction speed.
Take control of the plot by clicking buttons in the dialogue. Use your mouse to destroy the evil hamsters.
Outwit the hamsters in card games. Take a serious flash quiz, the outcome of which will determine the fate of all of Wharevarland.
How do you play this?

Read the text, choose plot developments with your mouse, disintegrate hamsters. Warning: A good ending will be revealed only if you "defuse" all the opponents in the minigames! If you don't succeed, the beautiful warrior queen will die! Yes, yes, I warned you. And don't write in reviews and on the forum that a good ending is difficult to achieve. If you find this game difficult, try practicing on 'Dork Sells' or 'Shakiro: Shadows Fall Twice' first.

title: Dark Island: Faded Memories
description:

Join the world of Vanathis, a forsaken archipelago where war and time have buried the past. The Grand Cathedral stands as the last monument to the Three Goddesses, surrounded by ruins, silence, and something unseen stirring beneath. Lost kingdoms, forgotten truths—only despair remains.

title: Oil Rig Simulator
description:
게임 정보
자원 추출, 장비 유지 관리부터 승무원의 안전을 보장하는 것까지 리그의 모든 기능을 관리하세요. 당신의 결정은 실제로 영향을 미칩니다 – 고장을 스스로 처리할 것인가, 아니면 도움을 요청할 것인가요?
매일 새로운 도전이 찾아옵니다: 변화하는 날씨, 장비 고장, 예상치 못한 위기 등. 1인칭 시점으로 리그 생활의 모든 측면을 직접 경험하게 될 것입니다.
플랫폼을 확장하고 장비를 업그레이드하며, 승무원을 돌보아 거친 바다 조건에서 원활한 작업을 보장하세요. 낮과 밤의 주기와 현실적으로 시뮬레이션된 날씨 조건은 모든 결정이 중요하다는 것을 의미합니다.
문제를 해결하기 위해 광범위한 도구와 기술을 선택하세요 – 간단한 수리부터 복잡한 구조 작업까지.

title: Rated Mutant
description:
게임 정보
Tori’s life is turned upside when her father is kidnapped. Rappelling deeper into what she once believed was an abandoned laboratory she begins to find herself fighting against hordes of monstrous creatures, fighting not only for her own life but her father’s as well. Discover the secrets of the lab and uncover the truth beyond the mysterious “V”.
Features


Side-Scrolling Platformer Action - Rated Mutant is a high energy action-platformer, navigate around environmental hazards, run, dash and dodge enemy attacks. Return fire with a barrage of short and long range weapons. Hot swap your weapons and switch your techniques to gain an advantage over your foes, as enemies will adjust and adapt.

Uncover Secrets - Travel down the road less traveled and reveal secret passageways and mutants, always something new to find.

Epic Boss Battles - Experience battles as unorthodox as the creatures themselves, with tough but satisfying combat.

Rogues Gallery - Discover over 30 unique monsters, defeat them to unlock new information and lore.

Master Weapons - Unlock new weapons, and new ways to use them as you continue your descent.

Custom Soundtrack - Rated Mutant features a modern soundtrack, designed to fit its action packed game play and chilling atmosphere.

title: Grimmlins Tale
description:
게임 정보
Grimmlins Tale is an action adventure monster taming game where you fight and explore with fairy tale inspired monsters.
Fairy Tale Monsters!

In Grimmlins Tale, all monsters are inspired by a fairy tale and characters within them.

Here we have Froggold, a water type based on The Frog Prince.



Howlhuff, a wind type based on Little Red Riding Hood and The Big Bad Wolf



Gremlidge, a life and earth type based on the bridge troll in Billy Goat's Gruff



These creatures are going to help you along your journey. In grimmlins, your partners can be out and interact with you and the world totally fluidly. In Never Everland, the setting of the game, the world plays out almost like a predetermined play. All grimmlins live in a magical loop of fate where certain events will ALWAYS happen to them regardless of what they do. This is all done by an entity known as "The Director" who makes their lives play out in a way that echoes the stories they emulate from our world. In this way, grimmlins have no free choice, unless you save them from this fate.



Grimmlins is a lot of things, and one of those things is an rpg with lots of room for growth and player expression in their grimmlin and team building





Grimmlins Tale offers a deep strategic control system over your monsters while allowing you to use multiple monsters at once






Grimmlins Tale is all about depth. Not only do you command multiple grimmlins at once, but you also directly control your player character while you battle.




There is lots of exploring to be done with your grimmlin friends! Throughout the game you will be collecting golden books mysteriously checked out under your name like a modern day collectathon!







The player can climb and explore freely, but that's nothing compared to what your grimmlins can do for you!
In Grimmlins Tale, riding and unique platforming abilities are taken to the extreme!
Each grimmlin can help you get around and platform, and the large ones let you control them directly when riding! Double jump, build platforms, dash, roll, glide, and more with the help of your fairy tale friends!

title: Project Corruption
description:
게임 정보
OVERVIEW
PROJECT CORRUPTION is a tense and atmospheric survival-horror game set in the industrial depths of the failing I.B.I.S. space station where you play as Tanner looking for your wife who is a lead scientist aboard the station.
STORY TELLING
Unravel a deep narrative: Discover the dark history of I.B.I.S. and the twisted experiments that led to the station's downfall.
Subtle dialogue and clues: Pay close attention to conversations environmental storytelling to uncover hidden truths.
Tragedy: Experience a gripping emotional journey as you search for Kaela, whose story intertwines with the station's haunting secrets.
ATMOSPHERIC SCI-FI HORROR
Claustrophobic environments: Navigate the industrial halls of the I.B.I.S. space station, designed for function over aesthetics.
Hostile lifeforms: Encounter monstrous adaptations born from alien life forms and failed experimentations.
EXPLORATION AND SURVIVAL
Diverse station areas: Explore the stations living quarters, labs, comms, water treatment facilities, testing facilities, medical bay and more, each with unique challenges.
Navigate the station: As the halls of the I.B.I.S. space station become more and more hazardous you must make use of the stations vent system.
Resource management: Scavenge supplies and equipment to survive the station's many dangers.
HOSTILE AI
Guard encounters: Avoid or attempt to fight the patrol guards who hunt down anything that moves.
Hostile creatures: Face off against adaptive alien entities with behaviors that keep you on edge.

title: Site 17
description:
게임 정보
Site 17 is an indie scifi-horror game developed by Fallen Crown Games.

The Gameplay
Site 17's gameplay is relatively simple. You are trapped alone in a room. You cannot run, and you cannot fight. You can view the cameras, electrify the corridors, and close the doors. You must survive from 12:00am to 6:00am for the entirety of your mandatory minimum employment period, while avoiding the robotic worker drones trying to reach your office.

The Story
In the year 2047, 90% of the workforce across the entirety of the I.R.C is automated. Robotic drones roam the corridors of ships and stations across the cosmos, performing their tasks without complaint, guided by an interconnected network of drones linked by the central computer (The Meshnet). Under I.R.C law, 10% of the workforce must consist of organic workers. With such little importance placed on the safety of disposable drones, the facility is poorly maintained. Unfortunately for you, this means that getting drafted into employment as the Facility Operations Manager is the worst thing that can possibly happen to you.

On your first day, the facility's central computer goes offline. The bots take over regulation of the Meshnet using their internal systems, but as fate (or the accountants) would have it, their data drives do not contain any copies of the Security Database. Your employee ID badge is flagged as invalid, and you are marked for experimentation as a trespasser on I.R.C. property.

With the bots trying to kill you and the facility in lockdown mode, you must survive until the end of your shift, when the central computer resets.

title: Forgotten Red Fog
description:
게임 정보
On a rainy and stormy night the main character Cyrus wakes up in a cave. He doesn't remember anything. At least a cross tells him his name. He is taken in by a nearby village of the Mali tribe. Time passes as one day a malicious red fog covers the whole village, forcing Cyrus and his friend Vera to flee. Thus is the start of a long journey through a medieval world where Cyrus and his comrades nowhere can feel save nor at home. The cleavage between humans and creatures can be felt in every village the group is about to visit. Safe zones are few and far between. Cyrus and his friends want to figure out the meaning of the malicious red fog. The closer they come to the conclusion the more Cyrus has dreams about his past, revealing a dramatic story.

Dive into a handdrawn cruel medieval world of a classical JRPG. The story is rather gloomy but has individually scattered funny moments. Discover a turn based battle system where the time stops for action selection. However the player can also decide to let it continue. For certain skills the timing is crucial and can result in extra damage or other special effects. Discover further an equipment skill learning system where different items can bear different skills. By practicing against monsters you can learn those skills permanently. Additionally passive skills give you freedom for customization.

title: Slime Slayer Prologue

게임 정보

Slime Slayer is an action-packed roguelite where you exterminate EVERY LAST SLIME! Craft unique character builds in every run with compounding modifier runes.
Features
Pick Your Element: Every spell can be evolved with every element, and every element is mechanically distinct! Learn the strengths and weaknesses of each element and how to best combo them to craft a slime-killing machine!

title: Penalty
description:
게임 정보
The game named Penalty is a 2D adventure RPG, with unique gameplay mechanics, FBF animations, and beautiful sound and visual effects. The story of the game revolves around the world having rejected goodness to such an extent and lacked respect for both the gods and each other, that the gods have subjected the entire world to a massive punishment. They cursed both the existing and future generations, making them unable to rest in peace. Death has been completely abolished, meaning even if the body "dies," it immediately rises again, as the underworld serves as a gathering place from which one can emerge at any time. However, the underworld is terribly cold, and those who dwell there suffer greatly. Moreover, if one manages to return to the surface, it is populated by monsters, curses, and dreadfully contagious diseases. Your only chance is to reach the monolith. Your task is simple: to touch the monolith, and then you can ascend to heaven. But don't think it will be easy. In the past 400 years, no one has been able to even approach the island, as it is teeming with spirits, demons, and colossal Leviathans, many times larger than the great cargo ships.

title: KNOCKOFF
description:
게임 정보
KNOCKOFF is a first of its kind IsoFighter/RPG that takes heavy influence from traditional 2D & 3D Fighting Games. Featuring fast paced dynamic combat, the PvP Demo will rock your world!!!
While the PVP demo is available NOW, KNOCKOFF will eventually be released, featuring 15-30 hours of gameplay set in THE MALL Our protagonist Amy will embark on a quest to thwart the villainous Camilla Carmilla and her Goth Baddies, and along the way release a few lost souls in the process. title: MR.E
description:
게임 정보
You are in a room full of boxes. After calibrating your optics, you see a door in front of you. There are some markers on the walls that seem familiar.

These are your first thoughts when you have enough wits. In MR.E, you’ll try to make sense of your surroundings, your identity, and what happened to the spaceship you are on by beating many obstacles. Kopernik, mainly a research ship, is on a supply run to bring medical resources and rations to the colonists on Titan.



Somewhere on the journey, the ship’s AI had gone rogue. It seems this AI knows a great deal about you, and what makes matters worse is that it knows there is someone dear to you among the surviving crew members. You’re clearly at a disadvantage but have nowhere else to go but keep pressing.
Are you up to the following challenges?

Monitor your power supply and make efficient moves to beat obstacles.
Watch out for the environment, and even better; use it to your advantage.
Help the surviving crew members because the ship is working against them.
Discover your true identity and how you’ve got to this point.

title: Deaded
description:
게임 정보
DEADED Is a Third Person Survival game where you scavenge, build, survive and thrive through the zombie infested post apocalyptic world. With heavy emphasis on physics and ragdoll - block, push and move objects to manipulate zombies to gain an advantage against them.

Physics and Ragdoll
DEADED aims to create an environment in which realistic zombies interact with. Block door ways with couches, barricade doors with wood and have the ability to push zombies over. These zombies will attack you head on, ignoring objects in their way so use it to your advantage.



Save Survivors
Save survivros you find throughout the city and assign them jobs at your base to produce valuable resources. Make them cut wood, scavenge scrap piles or set them as a security gaurd to help defend against the undead.




Scavenge the city for valuable loots and rummage through housese to find materials to help you and your community survive.




Shoot, slice and stomp your way through the infected with a variety of weapons such as the machete and pistol, damage any zombies limb enough and it will pop off!




With the ever changing fog city, discover a way to navigate through it without getting lost. As with each entry something always changes, and its up to you to find out why and how to solve a route of safety through the city.

title: Enfilade

Enfilade is a fast paced low poly multiplayer fps game with 30 levels and 18 weapons.
If there are not enough players there is bot support.
Level up and unlock new weapons.
