There are 9 weapon skins and 6 attachments.

title: 5 Star Fishy
description:
게임 정보
One angry fishy. One cruel world. One nuclear missile.

Welcome to the Zakaria Trench!
Beneath a small bay between two islands lies a deep trench with sunken cities, military bases, submerged nuclear silos, deep wilds, and many other fun tourist spots for the family. There are 9 areas total, so I hope you have a map, because you are going to need it.


Make Them All Pay
Armed with only your teeth, a hunger for vengeance, and whatever you find along the way, you must swim to the bottom of the trench to reach the sunken nuclear missile. You are not alone, however, so you might as well stir up as much mayhem as possible along the way.



No matter how big or fierce you foes are, they will bleed out for the crimes commited against you. You will be heard. And they will be dead.



Find arcade minigames, pets, abilities, secrets, characters, and more!

title: Sol Uknight
description:
게임 정보
The game is a 3D-RPG, Puzzle, Adventure. The story is centered around two main protagonist, from opposite sides of their universe connected through time. The game takes us on an adventure through action based questing and storytelling to save themselves and each other in the ultimate struggle to acquire the Crown of Knight to bring balance back to the realm.
I will want to edit this description in the future, with some imagery and map icons of the over story narrative as to to allude to story narrative side of the game, which has a greater game Lore concept, and world building narratives like LOTR or other fantasy novels.

title: Telluria: Forebodings
description:
게임 정보
Long, long ago on a distant plane of existence, Adhar the Supreme God, sat alone in the primordial void.
Being able to shape matter and energy as he pleased, tired of floating alone in the depths of time, he decided to create the Eternal Flame which, thrown into the vortex of chaos, created a new world, Telluria, and a Divine Being, Teine, for its sustenance.
In subsequent eras Teine, considered Supreme God and venerated as such, led a rebellion against Adhar for dominion over Telluria.
Adhar's anger was terrible. He hurled his power over the world, sending fire from the sky, cataclysms, earthquakes.
All life was extinguished, cities and settlements razed. Earth and grass covered everything.
After a long time, life began to spring anew, but time and space were now torn apart.
Teine herself was punished. Adhar divided her into two halves, Vehra demigoddess of order and Celtia demigoddess of chaos, imprisoning them as soon as they were created on a celestial island adrift in the astral plane.

title: Code5erpent
description:
게임 정보
Step foot on Earth: 3026

Zephir and his two friends, Martha and Orox, are newly recruited soldiers of the Human World State. Born in a world of flames and chaos, the three friends try to make a life for themselves as their destiny is inevitably shaped by the greater conflict that is the war against the serpents, gigantic space-faring entities born in the depths of the cosmos, and hell-bent on devouring the Earth.

Game features

Choose your type of experience: Multiple difficulty modes are available at the start of the game, allowing for gameplay experiences tailored to the player. Play on the Greatest Difficulty mode in order to unlock additional content, such as a new area, new characters and new bosses!
Battle like never before: As the serpents attacked the Earth, Humanity had to adapt: Their scales were impenetrable, nothing could pierce their skin! Nothing... but oxygen. Highly concentrated oxygen. Fortunately for you, Earth is teeming with it, and the Human World State found a way to garner its energy in order to take down its space-faring enemies. Introducing: the Oxygun. Start using it, and see the molecules as numbers! Mix and match them in varied and interesting ways in order to come up with terrifying combos to annihilate your foes!
Customise your playstyle: Code5erpent's unique focus on numbers and their mathematical properties during combat allows for every player to tackle each challenge however they see fit. The game is packed with a host of varied equipment pieces, such as weapons, armors and magic scrolls, spread around the world for you to equip and create the party that suits your playstyle.
Explore a war-torn overworld: Earth has changed a lot since when the serpents started their attack. Investigate a burning world, and meet what's left of Humanity, barely surviving, trying to find a way to fight back against these space invaders under the command of the Human World State.
Enter mysterious dungeons: Just like any RPG worthy of its title, Code5erpent features multiple fully-fledged dungeons for you to enter. Crawl through great, maze-like structures, teeming with loot, enemies, lore, and mathematical puzzles for adventurers to sink their teeth into.
Experience a complex character-driven story: Travel the ruined world of Earth in the year 3026 alongside a colorful cast of six primary characters: Zephyr the pessimistic loner, Martha the fervent soldier, Orox the noble knight and their three instructors: Tomeo the special forces elite, CageHead, the mysterious robot, and Alaska, the passionate orphan girl that is (just a bit) psychopathic. Uncover the secrets of the serpents that attacked the Earth long ago and are still ravaging it, all while completing missions for the enigmatic Human World State. Friendship, love and hatred, brotherhood, betrayal and reconciliation; you will experience it all!

title: Deathly Reprieve
description:
게임 정보
Deathly Reprieve is a unique first-person shooter real-time tactics. Strategize, adapt, and shoot your way through enemy lines. Lead a mercenary organization through a blood-soaked world, as you uncover a global conspiracy. Do you have what it takes?
Game Modes:
Single player PVE (Player Versus Environment)
Features:
Gun Shooting
Real-time tactics
Riddles
Strategy
Blood
Friendly Fire
Humor
Spoken Languages:
English
Subtitles:
English

Story:
You play as "The Valencian", a high-ranking officer in a mercenary organization. In a near-futuristic world, scarred by countless apocalyptic events, you thrive on the three things that keep you alive: luxury, violence, and control.

Your organization operates on the fringes of morality, using expendable convicts—broken souls made obedient through torture and brainwashing—to bolster its ranks. You lead these disposable soldiers on brutal missions, carrying out the will of their shadowy employer without question.
But once you stumble upon a secret you were never meant to find, everything changes. Your organization turns against you and your once-privileged life becomes a fight for survival.
Now, with your wits, skills and dwindling resources, you must uncover the truth behind a global that threatens to destroy what’s left of the world. Only then you can .

title: Club House on Haunted Hill
description:
게임 정보



Club House on Haunted Hill is a story-driven, adventure golf game that blends golf and narrative in the style of a 1960s horror movie. As you play the story you navigate through the haunted lands of the Island of Gallows Neck, each course telling a piece of the overall story.

In addition to the campaign you will be able to play against friends locally or online on various haunted golf courses. Each hole offers an adventure filled with supernatural elements and horrifying hazards enhancing the challenge.





Distribute points in Muscle, Cunning, Control, Mercy, and Sanity to create the perfect golfer tailored to your play style. You can max out muscle to have the longest drive, or put points in sanity to withstand the psychological terror of golf.







Cunning enhances your ability to judge distances and predict ball landings. With a sharp cunning of the game you'll be able to anticipate the ball's trajectory and make strategic decisions to outmaneuver your opponents.


Mercy increases good hit chances, even with off-target hits. Giving you a better chance of landing successful shots, even when your timing isn't perfect.


Sanity improves ball spin and loft control. By mastering this attribute, you can execute complex shots with precision, allowing you to navigate obstacles and fine-tune the ball’s spin.


Muscle determines how hard you will hit the ball and how far it will travel. This attribute gives you an edge on long fairways and challenging your competitors with powerful shots.

title: Fruit Of Choice
description:
게임 정보
Enemies keep coming. You have to use your mouse to move and dash to survive as long as you can.

Make good use of dash boosts, shields, bombs, etc. to help you survive longer.

Use your items carefully, lure and kill enemies to still have room to survive.



If you play well, you'll enter the powerful Hyper Mode!




When touched by an enemy or enemy attack, hyper mode is canceled and life is reduced.




If you find an opening and move while dashing at the appropriate angle and timing, your chances of survival will increase.

Survive as long as you can and score high!




( Currently, the free demo only has an arcade mode.
But the game will feature .
Please look forward to seeing develop in the future :D )

title: Divemensions
description:
게임 정보
What happens when you are a 2D creature that has been given the ability to move between the layers that make up your universe? Well... you start solving puzzles of course!

Get ready to think in 3D to solve interesting puzzles where the main focus is interacting with the different layers of the level, or prove your puzzle-design capabilities by creating your own levels with the Level Editor!
Gameplay Features

Move Between Layers!

By moving forwards or backwards you can travel between different layers of the level to interact with the elements that are found there. In this game the background isn't just for show, it is a physical part of the level!



Sometimes life can get pretty lonely... but luckily you have some boxes to keep you company! These boxes can be pushed around, and not only in 2D! You can move them between different layers or push even them out of the map!



What kind of puzzle would it be if we didn't have some buttons and platforms? Use your body or a friendly box to press buttons that activate platforms that move into a specific position, and it's completely wireless!


More features and elements will be added until the release of the game, so stay tuned for when they're ready to show!
The game features a full-fledged Level Editor that can be used by anyone to expand the limits of what's possible in this universe, are you up to the challenge?

title: GRØWTH
description:
게임 정보
GRØWTH is a first-person psychological horror title that digs its roots deep into the player's psyche. Explore the town of Omlest, as you seek out the answers to the nightmare unfolding in front of you. But beware, you might not like what you uncover...



Exploration is Key

To learn about life in the town of Omlest, you must seek out the answers for yourselves. With a mixture of open-world exploration and a horror atmosphere, you'll navigate this ghastly town using your own intuitions. There are no waypoints.

Risk vs Reward

Never knowing what's around the corner, means exploring Omlest is always a gamble. There's also an emphasis on combat, and you'll have to weigh out whether you stick to your fight or flight response. Sometimes while exploring, you may find a ton of health and ammo, other times you might get ambushed. Whatever you do, keep your wits about you and keep going. Don't let the dread consume you.

Storytelling Through Interactivity

With a focus on telling the narrative through meaningful interactions, players are encouraged to engage with Omlest in creative ways. The town is full of puzzles, enemy variants, special items, unique art and lore. And every single building in the town is explorable!

title: Project DOSA
description:
게임 정보
From Outerloop Games comes Project Dosa, a game about life, love and loss. Join sisters Samara and Amani as they eat the world and taste everything life has to offer. Reunite with the people you love, defeat the forces of capitalism (metaphorically) and eat one last meal before saying goodbye.


BATTLE AND BOND
Journey across a vibrant world to reconnect with estranged friends and family. Battle them in fantastical turn-based narrative combat to reconcile past hurts and open up the possibilities of friendship and love. Grow your bonds with them over time.

Food is more than fuel - it's community, culture, history, shared memories. Discover new recipes through exploration and conversation, and cook for friends, family and local communities to heal rifts and reconcile relationships.
Discover and shape your spirit-mech's mechanical and fantastical abilities as you traverse the world, cook and battle together.

title: Pirate Pillage and Plunder
description:
게임 정보
PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package.
Traverse unique worlds
Choose your path through an INFINITE amount of procedurally generated environments
Battle strange creatures
Overcome ever-insurmountable obstacles
Plunder this world, then the next (and the next, and the next, and the…)
 Build your army
Pick the right allies to turn your army into an unstoppable force
Choose tools which play to your armies strengths, or to cover their weaknesses
Remove the dead-weight to keep your army at full strength
Upgrade your units or spells to bring out their full potential
 Command them in battle

title: Earl the Tomb Robber
description:
게임 정보
Earl the Tomb Robber is a story-driven adventure set on a mysterious "Island of the Dead", full of rewarding exploration, challenging puzzles and cozy combat. After an ancient curse binds Earl to the ghost of a long deceased King, Earl must the break into the tombs and graves of the sacred island to recover the scattered mummified body parts of the cursed King.
This game is as much about exploring exotic locations and mysterious tombs as it is about exploring your own personality and discovering how to identify your true authentic self. As Earl learns to face his own insecurities, can you do the same?
CHALLENGE!
Raid mysterious tombs and solve challenging puzzles to break an ancient curse and come away with untold riches!
ENGAGE!
Navigate your away around the spirited inhabitants of The Island of the Dead, or attack them head on!
EXPLORE!
Explore exotic locations while discovering the secrets of the island natives, and discovering yourself in the process.

title: GAMING RAIDING
description:
게임 정보

A third-person shooter adventure game set in Japan in the near future.
※There are some combat elements too

STORY

Synopsis
In the year 20XX, a world where professional gamers have become a hugely popular profession by controlling androids and keeping the peace.

The protagonist is an ordinary young man with poor dynamic vision, who is a dropout at gaming school and always plays noob in matches.

He barely makes ends meet to pay his monthly internet bills and works as a game tester while aiming to become a professional gamer.

However, in his childhood, the protagonist had a dream of becoming a professional gamer with his best friend, who is already a professional gamer.

One day during these poor days, an incident occurs to the protagonist and the story begins.

Combat system and objectives
With a third-person shooter feel, the protagonist can launch slashing attacks that send enemies flying, or approach distant enemies in one fell swoop and deliver heavy blows that smash them to pieces. He will face off against giant enemies one after another, improving his playing skills as a pro gamer, and ultimately becoming champion in e-sports - this is the protagonist's goal and a promise he made to his best friend.

title: Roman Legacy: Speed Trials
description:
게임 정보
Explore a reimagined ancient Rome thriving in the era of industrial revolution in this fast-paced precision platformer. Master abilities like jetpacks and dashing, interact with the environment for example, through wall running, as you navigate interesting and varied levels filled with challenges and multiple pathways. Compete for the fastest times on leaderboards inside the world of a mechanized empire in ‘Roman Legacy: Speed Trials'.
Features
Traverse: Move, Jump, Climb, Swing, Boost, Wall run in first person using abilities and the level. Mastering execution will take dedication and skill
Explore: Interesting, detailed and varied environments in a unique ‘Romepunk’ style
Compete In Online Leaderboards: Find the fastest route using your knowledge of the abilities and levels
Planned Features To Come
Create: Create content for others to play! Share your creations on the Steam Workshop
Important Note:
This game is currently in early development. The features, graphics, and gameplay are subject to change(improved) as we continue to work on the game. Your feedback is invaluable to us during this process, and we appreciate your understanding and support.

title: Eternal Skies TCG
description:
게임 정보
Remember when handhelds used to have single player card games, where you play through an RPG-like story collecting cards and having battles along the way? This long-dormant genre has always been one of my favorites, so I created Eternal Skies because I wanted a new one. Eternal Skies is a TCG RPG, where you advance through the story by having card battles. The card game and mechanics themselves were created completely from scratch, and are inspired by Slavic mythology and the old Dreamcast game Skies of Arcadia. Don't like the way the card game plays? Change it! There is a built-in card editor, and almost everything else relevant to the game is stored in easily editable plaintext.
Here are some bullet points about the game before I go into more detail:
A completely new TCG with a lot of depth!
Lots of cards and ability to add your own!
Customize basically anything!
Hardcore mode and grind reducing options!
Runs on a potato!
A story!
Arcade modes!
Beep-y music!
Difficult to pronounce words for English speakers!
Really horrible card art until I can afford better art!
Made almost completely by one guy!
Chock full of references and memes!
Sweet sweet 90s vibes!
Plot and Modes
In the story mode, conflicts in this world are settled by card battle. The only issue? The richest nobles control all the most powerful cards. You play helping a young girl named Zyna, and you don't even particularly like card games. However, you end up getting roped into a conflict that pulls you all around the country and then some. Travel around, fix problems, and collect cards and build better decks along the way. You'll need them.

title: Elementalist
description:
게임 정보
Elementalist is a challenging movement puzzle platformer, where you collect elemental orbs that give you powers, such as double jump, horizontal dash, ground slam, and teleporting shot. After you collect a power, it will be the next one you use, so be careful about the order of your actions. Some puzzles will require you to think outside the box.

Collect movement abilities, and use them with just one button


Salvage the Sun Fragments


Interact with the enviroment

title: Endless Onslaught
description:
게임 정보
The world has been corrupted by an evil race of zombies, and you must defeat them! You find yourself in a camp, the stronghold for the very last humans, where you can train, upgrade and discover new weapons.
You must take to the battleground, exploring flaming volcanoes, desert islands, expansive plains and more. You must fight unique zombie types, with different powers and abilities to gain new, exciting weapons!
Once you have enough gear, you must choose your favourite weapons and upgrades to go and fight the King of All Zombies!

title: Predatory Islands
description:
게임 정보
4X real-time strategy. The game takes place on a planet that turned out to be a forced landing site for space settlers. The spaceship crush prevented them from reaching their designated star system. Their home-to-be was almost completely covered with an ocean, so the colonists had no other choice but to settle down on the small islands. The catastrophe destroyed practically everything that the colonists were carrying with them. They found and divided the warp-engine that crashed onto the planet among groups of colonists. They used the parts of the space engine to assemble devices that allow the island to go into hyperspace. Since then each group of colonists owned their own island and the ability to instantly travel. You have to become the leader of such group and guide them to prosperity and victory.

Key Features:

Tournament sessions
Support for gaming sessions on a dedicated server which allows you to participate in various gaming tournaments, with a duration of several hours to several months and a total number of participants from 2 to hundreds or even thousands.

Social sphere and characters skills
Define a profession for the character. It can be a worker or a soldier. Gradually they will gain experience and raise their level. Organize the troops training according to your combat tactics. Build houses for the characters and plan their life. Determine how long they have to work and rest.

Changeable landscape
Fully terraformable landscape. Use terrain modification to defend the island. Apply landscape destruction from explosions when attacking the enemy.

Change of day and night
The game world exists in the same time zone. Day will change into night, and night into day. Determine which of your characters will stay awake during the day and which at night. Plan your attacks during daylight or darkness.

Manage the diet
Develop agriculture, cattle raising or fishing. Determine dietary diversity of the characters so that they are happy with your leadership. Surplus can be sold in some game scenarios.

Industry development
Create production plants and produce what is necessary to survive. Start with a workshop. The study of the lost knowledge will allow you to create more modern productions.

title: CBS: The Beginning
description:
게임 정보
Today, we're attempting to make a come back with another new, unique title, trying to grasp your attention and earn your praise with a fresh cbs game.
Plot
This time it is a turn based rpg, where you will be in charge of your own character in pursuit of freedom and survival through out the game world, helping Gemme, Waett and the Babysitter in their quest to redeem the city and perhaps figure out what has happened to the world and even find out a way to fix it.
Features
Create, customize your characters, choose from 3 primary enhancement classes
Level up, with generated equipments gather inventory and equip them to fight in melee
Fight your way through the story of disasters and heroism
Engage in dialogue with characters in visit mode stages, gain rewards and expand your group
Fight in endless melee maps waves ranging from 7 to 70

title: Full BET - Fighting Casino
description:
게임 정보
카지노에서 펼쳐지는 1대1 턴제 격투 배틀
각양각색의 캐릭터들이 돈과 명예를 걸고 링에 올라, 하이 스테이크 전투 쇼에 참가한다.
게임 시스템
매 턴 6장의 카드가 공개되며, 각 카드에는 공격, 방어 등의 행동이 지정되어 있다.
플레이어는 번갈아 가며 카드를 선택하고, 선택한 순서대로 캐릭터가 행동한다.
공격을 정교하게 명중시키고 상대의 HP를 0으로 만들면 승리한다!
카드에 카지노 칩을 BET하면, 공격력을 강화하거나 상대를 반격할 수도 있다.
BET한 칩이 많을수록 효과는 더욱 강력해진다!
상대와 심리전을 펼치며, 이 하이 스테이크 배틀에서 승리를 쟁취하라!

title: 1 AM MOSCOW TIME
description:
게임 정보


Did you know that Moscow attracts mysterious magical creatures at night?
Going towards the northern lights, they interfere with the city lights and are attracted to the depths of the modern metropolis.

During the day you are a designer: work, communicate with friends, and at night go to the rooftops of Moscow and accompany magical creatures.
Who are these creatures?

Kompots are large magical creatures, and while migrating towards the northern lights, they are distracted by the lights of Moscow. Once lost in Moscow, the creatures can no longer return to their path. Secret design bureaus track their movements and help the creatures get out of the cities.

But is it only the employees of the design bureau who know about the secret of these creatures?
Features:

✦ Recognizable views of Moscow
Familiar locations, many architectural landmarks.



✦ Ordinary life of a designer
Pasha goes to work, drinks coffee, tries to sleep.



✦ Draw posters, tickets, playbills and more, because even wizards need to eat something. Explore the streets of Moscow in search of your "masterpiece" designs.



✦ Magical adventures at night
At night you will go to the roofs of Moscow and undergo stealth missions to save creatures. Beware of prying eyes.
A cozy stealth game in which the game does not punish mistakes, but the most careful ones will be rewarded.



And remember, the main thing is not to forget to pet Shishiga!

title: Critical Upload
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a fast-paced action journey through space, discovering new weapons and abilities through acquisition and research to better each run. Invite friends to experience it with you!
Be careful how you order your items
Each time you are hit, and item will drop from your ship. When you have no items left, you are only one hit away from critical hull breach!

Beam into derelict ships to use unique abilities to combat unique enemies!
Take the ship back to base to research the new technology for later runs
Check out the mothership bar between missions, in first person view!
Fully interactable level between missions to talk to characters about research, combat and story events
Death in co-op does not leave you out of the fun!
When you die in multiplayer coop, you will be attached to a player who is still alive, but you will be missing your items.
When the player you are in picks them up, you can shoot from the alive player's ship!

title: StellarFighter: Galactica
description:
게임 정보
Story
The year is 2092, after the failure of the 2030 Agenda and worsening environmental catastrophes, major corporations began colonizing space.
Space colonies, in orbit and on planets like Mars, were occupied by the wealthy, while the poor on Earth suffer the consequences.
As a Bounty Hunter, you travel through the solar system in search of contracts to ensure the survival of your family and those left behind.
Old School
Hand painted 16-bit pixel art and animations mixed with an amazing synthesized soundtrack.
Features
Story mode with 4 characters to unlock;
15 Levels to master;
5 "Most Wanted" Boss Fights;
Weapons that level up as you defeat enemies.

title: Hexmental
description:
게임 정보
Experience a new take on the MOBA genre!
Dive into fast-paced 10-minute matches of non-stop skirmish filled with impactful decision-making. Playing is easy—just move, cast spells and capture treasures to secure victory! However, mastering the game will take more than luck.
Tip the battle in your favour with elemental mayhem!
Hex grid-based maps and spell arsenal consisting of 6 different elements allow you to control the battlefield with towering flames, slippery ice, soaking water, and sturdy rocks. Each element has unique spells and effects that you can combine to discover even more ways to express yourself during every single match!
Choose your loadout and play it your way!
Go solo or team up with friends in quick matches, ranked games, or custom lobbies. With a variety of elements, items and spell combinations at your disposal it's easy to come up with new ways to play!

title: DevoSlime Lab
description:
게임 정보
[i]DevoSlime Lab[/i] is an platform jumping game. The platform can suck and spray.The core skills are throughout the whole process, but the slime blocks, enemies, are diverse. The game can also record the clearance time, the number of slime blocks used, and the number of collectibles.

title: Ser Chub's Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Join Ser Chubs as they adventure through an exciting world full of slimes, skeletons, and... robots? The world of Ser Chubs is not as it seems on first glance. Fight enemies, solve puzzles, and most importantly have fun! A top down, action-adventure game with puzzle elements. Set in a world blurring the line between fantasy and sci-fi. Do you rush headlong to fight enemies, do you solve puzzles to make fights easier, or do you learn about the world to potentially avoid fights all together? Talk to NPCs, read discarded notes, or ignore everything in favor of action. The choices are yours, but so are the consequences!

Features include:
Top Down Melee Action!
Multiple Unique Enemies and Boss Encounters!
Secret Areas To Uncover!
Upgradeable Weapons and Health!
Dialogue Systems!
Reading! (If You're Into That)
Multiple (Mostly Optional) Puzzle Mechanics!

title: Goblin's Journey
description:
게임 정보
Goblin's Journey is a humorous point & click adventure game with a stupid plot and even more idiotic characters.
You play as a greedy bastard goblin named Alastar. You are about to save you king's life - in exchange for gold of course!
An adventure full of gold, mischief and innapropriate content.

Explore the vast country of Goblin Lands in this semi-open world adventure, visit also Human Lands (ew!) and if you are lucky enough you get to see the beauties of hell as well!

Make money by doing all kinds of (il)legal stuff, and then use the money to buy some cool items for you including collectible cards and other keepsakes! If you are lucky enough you can even buy your own apartment.

Make sure all your kids are asleep before you start playing!

title: Gambetto
description:
게임 정보
Gambetto combines roguelike deckbuilding and the rules of chess to create a challenging, turn-based strategy card game.
Big-Brain Combat!
Confront adversaries on a 5x5 chess board, and leverage your wit with careful placements, timed movements, and varied card synergies. Claim your foe’s king to win the round and dramatically improve your deck with hundreds of randomized rewards!
Improve Your Deck!
Encounter hidden shops and unlock rewards to add powerful cards to your deck. Each king has a unique, character-based card pool, further enhanced with other card effects and synergies. Craft the strongest deck with your imagination and creativity. Endless possibilities await!
... And much much more!!!
Gambetto is still under development, and upcoming features include:
