title: Shadowborn
description:
게임 정보
An ultimate challenge for the daring souls. The fight for your humanity will be relentless. Darkness lies dormant within each of us... One wrong decision, and your light will flicker into the shadows.
Join Kaelara on her quest for revenge against a tyrannical king.
In her desperation, she summons the ancient spirit of darkness, the Nemorsis, to overthrow the evil ruler and his minions.
Step into the shadows in this rogue-like stealth game.
Wield shadow-based powers to navigate your way to the king. Engage in intense combat with a diverse array of enemies and formidable bosses while remaining unseen. Traverse a labyrinth of rooms, each offering unique encounters and puzzles, as you inch closer to your ultimate goal.
Key Features:
Roster of 20 Unique Shadow-Based Skills: Obtain these skills randomly, forcing you to adapt your play style with each run. Each skill can be upgraded up to level 5, with every second level introducing additional shadow-based mechanics.
A Vast Array of Puzzles and Traps: Navigate through intricate puzzles and avoid deadly traps.
In-Depth Stealth System: Utilize the field of view, ambient shadow levels, and character distances. Your actions directly influence your stealthiness.
Expansive Single-Player Campaign: Journey through diverse environments including a dungeon, village, castle, temple, and a hellish landscape.
Challenging AI System: Face enemies with unique behaviors and a keen field of view, making each encounter unpredictable.
Dynamic Fog of War: Experience an animated fog of war that changes based on your character’s field of view.
Randomized Reward System: Each run offers unique rewards, requiring strategic choices between different options.
Permanent Progression System: as you die and you progress you earn permanent skills and point to improve you character.
Embrace the darkness. Fulfill your vengeance and overthrow the king.

title: Rami on Watalands
description:
게임 정보
Rami on Watalands is a "classic" open-world action-adventure game in which you are the Martian Rami, who has come on Earth in search of the perfect souvenir for his beloved. But instead of a simple journey, you find yourself caught in the conflict between Monkeys and Pandas, uncovering ancient mysteries and facing numerous challenges.
Features
Classic top-down action-adventure in a retro 2D world torn by the monkey-panda conflict.
Open world filled with enemies and mysteries.
Resurrect the villagers who have turned into pearls.
Enjoy various mini-games.
Multiple endings shaped by your choices.

title: You Are Dead
description:
게임 정보
Consciousness... Where? Unknown. Who are all these dudes in robes? Only one way forward: through the door.


Overview:
This is a game about finding your path, surviving the mysterious afterlife, and solving the riddle of your purpose in this curious world.

This game will continue to grow with more features and content. Keep an eye out for updates on the official website!



Features:
Randomly generated roguelike runs
Universal controller support (or mouse and keyboard)
Metagame unlockables
Charming creatures, and one total asshole
Acquire powerful weapons
3 obnoxiously colorful environments
Memorable encounters and challenges
Cheese-friendly combat

title: 魔法拾荒者
description:
게임 정보
 > is a light rogue-like spell-building looter extraction game. Players must scavenge valuable items on the map while constructing their own spells to fend off waves of enemies, ultimately escaping with their hard-earned loot.
 In each session, players need to carefully manage their inventory, aiming to collect as many valuable items as possible and compete to see who can extract with the highest total value.
 Players can customize their spell effects based on different spells—what exciting interactions might arise between them?

title: Evolution From the little light
description:
게임 정보
Experience a 2D side-scrolling narrative adventure infused with puzzles and a dash of action, unfurling the compelling story of evolution in the merciless oceans.

Witness the fierce competition among species as they adapt to the harsh environment, mirroring the relentless struggle for survival. As a player, you will navigate this intricate web of existence, making crucial decisions, confronting perils, and unraveling the concealed secrets of evolution.



Visual Style



A captivating play of light and darkness takes center stage, evoking a constant duality.
Vivid splashes of color punctuate a predominantly grayscale world.
The ocean's depths, shrouded in mystery, blend realism with a touch of fantasy.
A seamless, interface-free integration ensures an organic gameplay experience.


Mechanics

title: Crusader's Legacy
description:
게임 정보
This Game is in Early Development

Genre: Bullet Hell, Fantasy, Action-RPG
Story:
Knightguard has been taken over by Skeletron. An undead king that was bested many centres ago, by a small group of heroes. Unfortunately, the Revenants resurrected Skeletron so he could bring back chaos and destruction. Three new heroes who aren’t aware of what’s to come, must band together to fight against Skeletron and his horde of evil minions. To bring peace and tranquillity back to the kingdom of Knightguard. Or that’s what they thought…
Progression:
Unlock gear from exploration, side guests and combat. Each level has unique gear to be obtained. Gold is used for purchasing gear, skills and upgrading equipment. Enjoy a particle weapon or build, upgrade your gear so you can continue to use it until you unlock a better version.
Difficulty:
Beat normal mode to unlock heroic mode and then nightmare mode. Each difficulty has new areas throughout each level, more secrets, new loot, new NPC's, improved/different enemies, new mini games, extra boss phases, new side quests and visual differences.
Endgame:
On nightmare mode you will encounter exotic gear quests, secret raid bosses, unique rarity gear, secret alterative ending. There's optional content with collecting cards or progression, etc with certain mini games, that transfers between each difficulty and level.
Classes:
There's three playable characters. Each class has 2 mobility options, 1 main ability and 3 sub abilities. Only one sub class ability, can be equipped while using your main ability.

Magnus | Void Caster: Magnus use to be a healer at a chapel in Knightguard, where he would heal wounded soldiers, but he wanted more out of life and devoted his time on mastering the art of dark magic instead. Now Magnus lives on the outskirts of town, working on perfecting his magic.
Race: Human, White Skin, Male



Evelyn is one of the towns best hunters. Her parents died when she was just a child, so she became independent at a very young age. She used to pick pockets to make ends meat, but a man named Melvin took her under his wing and trained her to hunt animals.




Lucas is the king’s personal guard. He use to fight on the front lines, but the king personally choose Lucas to work for him. Lucas accepted the job, because his wages where more than quadrupled. He now has a wife and child. He has settled for this quite life, but he keeps thinking back to the good old days.

title: Sliced
description:
게임 정보
Fast-Paced PvP Combat:

Dive into intense player-versus-player battles. Quick reflexes and strategic thinking are your keys to victory in the high-speed arena.

Dynamic Arenas:

Battle across a variety of arenas, each with its own unique layout and hazards. Adapt your strategy to the changing environment to gain the upper hand.


Equip yourself with an arsenal of weapons, from axes to spears, each offering distinct gameplay mechanics. Mastering each weapon’s strengths and weaknesses is essential.



Experience the thrill of combat with a visceral dismemberment system. Strategically target your opponents' limbs to weaken them or go for a dramatic finish.


- Free-For-All (FFA)
- Team Deathmatch
- Teams King of the Hill
- FFA King of the Hill
- Capture the Flag
- Infection




Personalize your fighter with a selection of cosmetic items. Stand out in the arena with unique combinations of armor, weapons skins, and victory poses.


Have the freedom to set up your own game lobbies, making it easy to play with friends or open the doors to challengers worldwide. Perfect for organizing friendly matches or competitive clashes, with full control over your play experience. Additionally, you can create private lobbies filled with bots for practice sessions or enjoy a mix of friends and bots for varied gameplay dynamics.


Enjoy new content and game modes introduced in regular updates.


Become part of a game that listens to its community. Share your feedback, and help shape the future of "Sliced" with new features and content inspired by players.

title: Mearcair/System Pulse
description:
게임 정보
짜릿한 액션으로 가득한 총알 천국, 포지셔닝과 기술 구축에 도전하는 시스템 펄스에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 무자비한 로봇 드론 군단을 거느린 호스트 펄스가 운영하는 게임 쇼에 참가해 실력을 겨뤄보세요. 음악의 비트에 따라 플레이어를 전멸시키려는 로봇 무리의 움직임과 공격이 결정되는 박동하는 경기장을 누비며 혼돈의 교향곡에 빠져보세요.
💥 리듬에 맞춘 대혼란

시스템 펄스에서 음악은 단순한 반주가 아니라 게임의 생명선입니다. 비트에 맞춰 로봇이 움직이고 공격하는 아드레날린이 솟구치는 경험을 준비하세요. 리듬에 맞춰 동작을 조정하지 않으면 어떤 파멸에 직면하게 됩니다. 긴장을 늦추지 말고 음악에 귀를 기울이며 모든 움직임을 음악에 맡기세요.
💥 강렬한 총알 천국

다양하고 역동적인 경기장에서 로봇 적 무리에 맞서 심장을 두근거리게 하는 전투를 벌이세요. 강력한 무기로 무장하고 반사 신경과 정확성을 최대한 발휘해 보세요. 적을 피하고, 파괴적인 화력을 발휘하고, 전략적으로 적을 제압하여 박진감 넘치는 전투에서 살아남으세요.
💥 위험한 파워업

여정 중에 다양한 강력한 능력과 무기를 발견하고 잠금 해제하세요. 생존력을 높이고, 약화 상태 효과를 발동하고, 무기를 업그레이드하여 점점 더 강력해지는 적을 물리치세요. 올바른 조합으로 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있으므로 업그레이드를 현명하게 선택하세요.
박동감 넘치는 음악의 비트가 끊임없는 액션과 동기화되는 매혹적인 오디오 환경에 빠져보세요. 음악의 비트를 활용하여 완벽한 샷을 정렬하고 위험을 피하세요.

title: The Neath
description:
게임 정보
Explore this extensive underground world in this fantasy action adventure game.

Having fled to a isolated island sitting atop a complex network of cavern, tunnels and underground waterways you seek to explore your surroundings and collect whatever useful things you can find.

Search through areas natural and manmade for weapons and tools to help you fight, crawl, climb, swim and think your way past monsters and natural obstacles.

title: The Hydra Experiment
description:
게임 정보
The hive-minded mad scientist, Dr. Esereth, has granted you consciousness! At least, temporarily...
To retain the gift of life, you must prove your worth to the collective by conquering four themed testing areas in any order: the nanite factory, the observatory, the chemistry branch, and the greenhouse.
Find prototypes scattered throughout the facilities to help you solve puzzles and navigate combat. Assign them to one of nine buttons (by default mapped to the numpad).

title: You Are Dead
description:
게임 정보
Consciousness... Where? Unknown. Who are all these dudes in robes? Only one way forward: through the door.


Overview:
This is a game about finding your path, surviving the mysterious afterlife, and solving the riddle of your purpose in this curious world.

This game will continue to grow with more features and content. Keep an eye out for updates on the official website!



Features:
Randomly generated roguelike runs
Universal controller support (or mouse and keyboard)
Metagame unlockables
Charming creatures, and one total asshole
Acquire powerful weapons
3 obnoxiously colorful environments
Memorable encounters and challenges
Cheese-friendly combat

title: Ripley [Remembered]
description:
게임 정보
Sage wakes up every morning to the same routine—serving coffee in a train café. But at 6PM, the train she works on crashes, and the day resets. Time is limited, and every action pushes the clock forward. To escape the loop, Sage must uncover the hidden connections between passengers, solve puzzles in the right order, and survive surreal bullet-hell boss fights. But the deeper she digs, the more she realizes that not everyone on the train is who they seem to be.
As Sage gathers clues, she gets closer to the horrifying truth about her surreal reality.
Features:
Time-Based Puzzle Gameplay – Every interaction moves the clock forward, forcing players to plan their actions wisely.
Bullet Hell Boss Fights – Intense, rhythmic battles reward players with new inventory items.
Psychological Narrative – A haunting mystery about memory, loss, and identity unfolds with each loop.
Persistent Items & Progression – Certain items carry over between loops, unlocking new paths and possibilities.
Immersive Train Setting – A modern, dreamlike train environment filled with unique NPCs hiding secrets.
Genres:
Narrative-Driven Puzzle Adventure
Psychological Mystery
Bullet Hell
Time Loop

title: Mearcair/System Pulse - Prologue
description:
게임 정보
짜릿한 액션으로 가득한 총알 천국, 포지셔닝과 기술 구축에 도전하는 시스템 펄스에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 무자비한 로봇 드론 군단을 거느린 호스트 펄스가 운영하는 게임 쇼에 참가해 실력을 겨뤄보세요. 음악의 비트에 따라 플레이어를 전멸시키려는 로봇 무리의 움직임과 공격이 결정되는 박동하는 경기장을 누비며 혼돈의 교향곡에 빠져보세요.
프롤로그 버전은 정식 게임의 콘텐츠가 제한된 무료 버전입니다.
Steam 클라우드 동기화는 프롤로그의 저장 데이터를 정식 게임으로 옮깁니다. 정식 출시를 기대해 주세요.
💥 리듬에 맞춘 대혼란

시스템 펄스에서 음악은 단순한 반주가 아니라 게임의 생명선입니다. 비트에 맞춰 로봇이 움직이고 공격하는 아드레날린이 솟구치는 경험을 준비하세요. 리듬에 맞춰 동작을 조정하지 않으면 어떤 파멸에 직면하게 됩니다. 긴장을 늦추지 말고 음악에 귀를 기울이며 모든 움직임을 음악에 맡기세요.
💥 강렬한 총알 천국

다양하고 역동적인 경기장에서 로봇 적 무리에 맞서 심장을 두근거리게 하는 전투를 벌이세요. 강력한 무기로 무장하고 반사 신경과 정확성을 최대한 발휘해 보세요. 적을 피하고, 파괴적인 화력을 발휘하고, 전략적으로 적을 제압하여 박진감 넘치는 전투에서 살아남으세요.
💥 위험한 파워업

여정 중에 다양한 강력한 능력과 무기를 발견하고 잠금 해제하세요. 생존력을 높이고, 약화 상태 효과를 발동하고, 무기를 업그레이드하여 점점 더 강력해지는 적을 물리치세요. 올바른 조합으로 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있으므로 업그레이드를 현명하게 선택하세요.
박동감 넘치는 음악의 비트가 끊임없는 액션과 동기화되는 매혹적인 오디오 환경에 빠져보세요. 음악의 비트를 활용하여 완벽한 샷을 정렬하고 위험을 피하세요.

title: Faereld: Old Blood
description:
게임 정보
Description:
Step into the brutal and immersive world of Faereld, where survival is earned through grit, cunning, and skill. Set in the depths of an illegal underground fighting pit within a dark fantasy realm reminiscent of the late 1600s, this action-packed RPG challenges you to navigate a society teetering on the edge of collapse.
Forge your path as a fighter—slave or mercenary—and rise through the ranks of a system designed to crush the weak. Hone your combat skills, master deadly weapons, and outwit your opponents in visceral battles against humans and captured magical creatures. In this gritty, unforgiving world, every choice matters. Ally with rival gangs, barter in the shadowy underbelly, and uncover the secrets that could shift the balance of power forever.
Key Features:
Brutal Combat: Master deep, skill-based melee mechanics with realistic weapon handling and strategic encounters.
Rich Storytelling: Experience a gripping narrative exploring themes of survival, morality, and rebellion in a decaying world.
Dynamic NPC Interactions: Interact with lifelike characters powered by advanced AI, each with their own motivations and consequences for your actions.
Deep Customization: Shape your playstyle with a wide range of skills, gear, and upgrades tailored to your preferences.
Dark Fantasy Setting: Explore a richly detailed, small but intricate world, brought to life with stunning visuals and environmental storytelling.
High-Stakes Choices: Make impactful decisions that shape the course of your journey and the fate of those around you.
Prepare to enter the pits and fight for your life—or your freedom. Will you rise as a legend, or be forgotten in the shadows of the arena?

Read More & Support

title: Dangerous Connections
description:
게임 정보
Dangerous Connections is a Cold War FPS set in 1987.
You slip into the skin of American spy Dan Morris, nicknamed "The Moscow Mule", who specializes in operations behind the Iron Curtain.
Secret Agent Dan Morris aka "The Moscow Mule"
Lots to discover
The game will feature 15 levels, taking you to various fictional locations in the Soviet Union.

title: Closing Time
description:
게임 정보
A massive box store stands at the edge of town. Sat in a car in the pouring rain, you're about to make the biggest decision, and the biggest mistake of your life. This burglary isn't something you had planned for, but so many things in and outside of your control pushed you to this. Inside, the goods and cash prove to be plentiful, but something else is here. Something else, outside of the realms logic and reason is stalking your every move and now you must evade it to avoid becoming prey. Solve puzzles to move throughout the store, gain access to its different sections, and uncover its secrets, and perhaps uncover answers to the mystery of the monster that roams this store and what ties it to this place.
Explore the store after hours where things are not what they seem
Something stalks these halls, and will hunt you, but not before playing with you

title: Project Athenia
description:
게임 정보
Project Athenia is a multiplayer first-person shooter in which you can play against your friends in several game modes on many different maps.
Features
Multiplayer Servers
3 Game Modes
3 Maps
A beautiful & user-friendly UI
AI
Credits
Programming: paasmoo

title: MEANWHILE IN SECTOR 80
description:
게임 정보
As an engineer stranded in an alien star system, scavenge parts and build equipment to fight your way back home. Work with (or against) the laws of physics in MEANWHILE IN SECTOR 80 to turn trash into survival.


Everything you find in SECTOR 80 is battered and abandoned. You must work with what you have: there are no fabricators, nano-scale 3D printers, or factories here. You'll need both skill and creativity to make functioning equipment from space junk.

In MEANWHILE IN SECTOR 80, everything is a physical object with mass, heat, and stored energy. Every part you find might be key to your next invention. A damaged battery might be a critical power source in a pinch, or perhaps an effective explosive in the right hands!


SECTOR 80 is an uncharted system that no human has ever returned from. Scour worlds with familiar and alien biomes to uncover what it is that makes this system so dangerous.


Long-term survival in the hostile system of SECTOR 80 is impossible. With no prospect of rescue, work towards repairing and activating an incomplete sling gate at the center of the solar system to make it home alive.

title: Untrusted: hackers at large
description:
게임 정보
Step again into the dangerous world of "Untrusted" with "hackers at large", in this gripping single-player command line adventure that thrusts you into the roles of mysterious hackers. Immerse yourself in a digital underworld where every decision you make, has profound consequences.

Infiltrate high-stakes targets, seize control, and exploit their vulnerabilities for personal gain. But it's not just about you – manage your crew of skilled hackers, each with their own specialized talents that will open up multiple strategies: the choices are yours to make, and they reverberate throughout the world of Untrusted.

Use vulnerabilities and your deduction skills to hack into computers
Manage your crew around the world. Hide. Escape. Don't die.
Management/RPG elements woven in the hacking gameplay in a unique blend
Set in an alternate timeline in the late 70s/early 80s
Realistic hacking mechanic, albeit with optional friendly interrface commands for those who don't want to meddle with a command line interface (some typing still required :) )

"Untrusted: hackers at large" is a single player prequel to "Untrusted" also available on Steam: join our Discord to learn more!

title: Iridescent
description:
게임 정보
Premise



In "Iridescent" you step into the shoes of Kruk, a long time member of the Astel family, renowned healers entrusted with perilous missions. Tasked with curing a devastating plague that transforms people into beasts or madmen, Kruk soon discovers that this affliction is merely a symptom of a world teetering on the brink of destruction. Beeing seemingly the only one who is willing to try, he embarks on a odyssey through the whole world to acquire the cure.
Gameplay



Venture forth into a sprawling world brimming with diverse characters and hidden secrets waiting to be unearthed. Traverse through intricate dungeons, each presenting its own set of unique challenges and items that unlock new areas and mysteries to explore. But beware, for formidable adversaries lurk around every corner, testing your mettle and resolve. Death comes easy to those who dare danger without caution.



Combat in "Iridescent" is a test of skill and precision. Embrace the art of parrying to deflect enemy attacks while sneaking your own attacks in between, gradually chipping away at their stagger bar until its filled and you can unleash a powerful grapple attack that inflicts massive damage. Boss battles are dynamic and intense, with adversaries evolving and adapting their tactics as the fight unfolds, keeping you on your toes until the very end.



Get a taste of the world of 'Iridescent' with my demo! Dive into the first two levels of the game to experience the intense combat, intricate dungeon exploration, and epic boss battles. Then, after completing the demo, test your skills further by facing off against two optional foes, offering a little glimpse of the challanges in the full game. Don't miss this chance to preview the excitement of 'Iridescent' and prepare for the full adventure!

title: Teddy Knight
description:
게임 정보
Long forgotten in the depths of the toy chest, Teddy—a loyal and courageous knight—is called to action. As chaos spreads across the toy world, driven by the vengeful Baba Yaga plushie and her sinister army, it’s up to Teddy to rise, face the darkness, and fight through haunted toys to restore peace to the realm of playthings!

title: Epic Musical Chairs
description:
게임 정보
Battle friends and family in an epic, high-stakes game of musical chairs !
Throw yourself into the fight with your strength or outwit your opponents by sneaking in at just the right moment to claim victory and become the ultimate International Musical Chairs Champion! Perfect for party nights!
Blast away your opponents with a powerful shout or hurl objects across the arena to knock them off course! Send them splashing into the water to keep them from victory!

title: Don't Die
description:
게임 정보
Don’t Die, Dummy! (DDD) is an over-the-top action game where you control a crash-test dummy who’s sick of getting thrown around—so now it’s time to throw down! Armed with breakdance moves that double as deadly combat techniques, you’ll take on hordes of corporate robots in the ultimate battle for dummy dignity.
Why Play DDD?
Dance Like Nobody’s Watching: Unless you count the army of robots you’re spinning into scrap metal.
Physics Gone Wild: Every punch, spin, and kick takes on a life of its own with chaotic ragdoll physics.
Eye-Popping Style: Bright visuals, goofy animations, and enemies that are as absurd as they are challenging.
Laugh Out Loud Combat: Because why shouldn’t a windmill spin-kick be your deadliest move?
It’s silly, stylish, and packed with enough chaos to keep you grooving and smashing your way through a robot apocalypse.

title: Hero Academy Legacy
description:
게임 정보
A fresh RPG combining school management and hero training!!
Embark on an epic quest to challenge the mighty Demon Lord and restore peace to the world alongside the heroes you've nurtured at your academy. In Hero Academy Legacy, strategy, training, and adventure seamlessly blend together. Forge your own legend in this unique RPG!
■Story
A world devastated by the defeat of the Demon Lord. People are suffering from a curse that renders them powerless. In such a time, by the grace of the goddess, growth becomes possible for only three years. With hope in their hearts, the Hero Academy is established. As a former hero who was defeated by the Demon Lord, you are chosen to be the principal of the academy. Develop the school, train talented students, and take on the mission to defeat the Demon Lord. An epic adventure unfolds to save the world. What surprising fate awaits you……!?
■System
Engage in strategic and intense turn-based command battles! Students can use not only weapon attacks but also various skills and magic with different effects based on their jobs and training. Use the experience points and gold acquired from defeated monsters to strengthen your students and develop your school.
Attributes
Students, enemies, and skills/magic have attributes. Choose advantageous attributes to gain the upper hand in battle!
Death
If a student is defeated at the end of battle, there is a high probability that they will die. When their life is in danger, retreat!
Choose cards to decide your class curriculum. The experience points and amounts obtained will vary depending on the curriculum! Events can also occur based on the squares you land on, so pay attention to the number of days you progress. Acquire cards and find your own efficient training methods!

title: In Another World
description:
게임 정보
Explore Ruins. Fight Monsters. Travel to new worlds. Discover spells. Make/Take on Quests. Idle Farming. Destroy the Demon King. Return back home?
Izekai (異世界), which translates to "another world" or "different world" in Japanese, is a subgenre of fiction, particularly popular in manga, anime, and light novels, where a character is transported or reincarnated into a fantasy or other unfamiliar world.
This happens at the start with the player dying multiple different ways, and meeting a goddess which lets them pick blessings depending on those deaths (therefore choosing there difficulty depending on which one they choose). Then Letting them choose which kind of start they want from a set of one time portals they can go through. Therefore starting the game.
Explore Ruins.
In the game there will be hand made dungeons that the player can take on. Complete with traps, and boss monsters (Like what is found in Izekai Animes). With unique Items to be found in each dungeon. Sometimes the guild may issue to take on a dungeon and clear it for a bonus reward.
Fight Monsters.
Each monster will be set to a race and are only in one area. They Multiply and diminish there numbers with each passing day. If the player desires or by accident kills all of a race they will be lost and possibly throw off the ecology of the area leading to to much of another animal. There will be a way to fix this using a lab to regrow the species.
Travel to new worlds.
In each area you go to there will be a portal (although some will need to be fixed before you can use them) that allows you to travel to other places using a 4 digit 4 number combo. Some combos lead to good things and some lead to just death. While the player themselves can try every combo they want, in text there will be hints to combos or outright combos themselves to make it easier.
Discover Spells.
Using the portal players can access the trails for spells granting them the spell after completion or similarly they can be purchased from a merchant. Some can be found multiple ways while some can only be found one way. 
Each spell will have a "intensity" level added to it making it so you can choose to use all of your stamina on one attack if you want leading to high risk plays.

title: High Mountain Abbey
description:
게임 정보
A mad god has invaded the abbey. Now you must solve puzzles and activate mysterious machines to defeat it. 
High Mountain Abbey is a first-person point-and-click adventure game. I made it by building physical dioramas and photographing their insides.  This may well be the first game with needle-felted stop-motion animation.
You navigate by clicking to turn, move, and activate buttons, knobs, and wheels.  Explore the unique spaces of the abbey.  Figure out interesting machines.  Solve the mysteries of High Mountain Abbey, and banish the mad god!

title: Potion in Motion
description:
게임 정보
Step into the world of potion-making, where every brew is a mix of magic, mystery, and just a little bit of chaos. Learn from your father’s cryptic notes, experiment with mystical ingredients, and cast spells to refine your craft, all while keeping up with the endless demands of your quirky customers.

title: Cross the C
description:
게임 정보
It is a 2D puzzle x 3D first person riddle solving game.
Puzzle
.Aim for the island by controlling a ship that cannot stop until it hits a rock. Use the “pieces” that can be placed on the board to rebuild the stage and solve the puzzle.
Riddle solving
.Solve the riddles scattered around the room.

title: Machine of the Wasteland
description:
게임 정보
Machine of the Wasteland
Step into the chaos, seize your destiny, and become the King of the Wasteland!
Machine of the Wasteland is a high-octane vehicular combat action game set in a brutal, post-apocalyptic world where survival hinges on your ability to outmaneuver and outgun your enemies. MOW offers a taste of the fast-paced, twin-stick shooter action, as you battle through open arenas with customizable combat vehicles.

title: Mortal Quest
description:
게임 정보
MORTAL QUEST
Follow John, a mortal who has been transferred to an island infested by monsters and demons. You must guide him through dangerous challenges in order to prove himself worthy to fulfill an ancient prophecy. Meet uncomprehensible foes and even some unexpected allies on this unforgettable journey. 
SURVIVAL
The main theme of Mortal Quest is survival. There are dangerous monsters to face on the island, and if you die, you have to restart from where you last saved. There are many ways to fend off the monsters, including building a base, crafting new weapons, managing your health and hunger, and learning and adapting to each enemy's unique threats. 
ADVENTURE
Another big theme of Mortal Quest is adventure. The island is big and vast, but that isn't the only place to explore in this alternate realm. There is also a cave system, a still-running ancient civilization, a relic of an older time, and MUCH more! Each area has new resources, new foes, and even possibly new friends? It's up to you to explore and find out!
COOL MECHANICS
Mortal Quest has a bunch of mechanics that keep the game engaging and fun. There is a crafting system that unlocks new recipes the more you progress. This means that not everything is available to the player right off the bat, and they have to progress to unlock new tools and resources. There is also cooking, fishing, long-ranged weaponry, and more!
PLAY THE DEMO
Don't buy a game you might not enjoy. Try the demo first! It's free and will give you an idea of what this game is and what it's all about. If you don't enjoy it, don't buy the full game. Simple as that!

title: HikiDama
description:
게임 정보
Hikidama is a platform where you control a ball, using an anchor that pulls it in the direction you want it to go. Collect gems and resources while you get used to this peculiar mechanic, and with these resources, upgrade your ball to make it easier to control, or perhaps more visually appealing with a generous list of skins and cosmetics. Above all, revive this sport that has been dead for 50 years, while discovering the reasons that led to its cancellation.

title: Mr. White's Agency
description:
게임 정보
So, the paper curtain falls, and the show begins.
One day, a white rabbit detective named Mr. White receives an unusual case: to find the missing mathematics professor, a eublepharis named Mr. Sturt. However, the investigation becomes significantly more complicated when Mr. White finds... the professor’s body parts. These parts are in excellent health, in a great mood, and in no hurry to return to their original place...
Mr. White’s Agency is a cozy and humorous detective story. It’s so cozy that there isn’t a single murder in the entire game! Instead, you’ll solve mysteries, meet peculiar witnesses, and immerse yourself in a charming paper-theater world where you’re not just a player—you’re the director of a detective play.
A Theater That Knows It’s a Theater
In your theater, the actors are well aware that they are actors. But they don’t mind. In fact, some of them will even try to help you. You might not always appreciate their assistance, but rest assured, their intentions are always good.

title: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】
description:
게임 정보
Craft. Sabotage. Survive.
In a world where the Dark Overlord rules with an iron fist, one alchemist's quest for redemption becomes a divine mission of resistance.
「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】is a story-driven stealth action game that puts players in the role of Auronika Cortez, a skilled alchemist turned freedom fighter in a dark medieval-industrial world.
As Auronika, you’ll help bring down the tyrants using your forbidden alchemy skills, crafting potions for the resistance and manufacturing magical bombs to directly attack your oppressors.
Outsmart the regime and turn the tides of secret war—one concoction or explosion at a time.
Key Features
Revolutionary Crafting System: Master the art of medieval chemistry through an innovative alchemy system. Combine reagents to create powerful concoctions and tools for the resistance.
Strategic Sabotage: Design and craft custom explosives. Every component affects the final result - from the blast radius to elemental effects.
Dynamic Stealth Gameplay: Navigate a vertically-stratified city where every shadow could mean survival. Dodge patrols, exploit vantage points, and escape through the underground networks of a society divided by power and privilege.
Morally Complex Narrative: Experience a story of resistance, redemption, and the price of freedom as Auronika must navigate between her heavenly mandate and the brutal realities of uprising.

title: Toward The Ice
description:
게임 정보
It was just another day for the princess, hunting for food alone in the wilderness. What she didn't know is that her younger brother the prince had secretly followed her. She only realized this when she heard his screams as he was being carried off by a band of trolls.

They were too strong for her, and she had to watch helplessly from a distance as he was taken to their cave in the mountains via a winding route through the Dwarven lands. She was able to track them, but she needs your help to defeat the beasts and bring him back safely. It's only a matter of time before they eat him, so time is of the essence. Can you be the heroes that she needs?

Toward The Ice is a classic first-person party-based dungeon crawler RPG with grid-based movement and turn-based combat. It can be described as a gridder, blobber, and a DRPG where you navigate mazes fighting monsters, avoiding or disarming traps, and solving puzzles to reach the next area. Build your party of six from any combination of ten character classes and explore more than a dozen maps, gathering items and equipment along the way.

Toward The Ice is a standalone sequel to Into The Inferno, Navigating The Labyrinth, and Crossing The Sands and you do not need to play the previous games to enjoy this one completely.

title: Steampunk Shinobi
description:
게임 정보
스팀펑크 시노비는 역동적이고 진화하는 세계를 통해 끊임없는 복수의 여정을 떠나는 로그라이트 액션 게임입니다.
스팀펑크의 독창성과 명예를 중시하는 중세 일본의 전통이 만나는 세계로 들어가 보세요. 시노비의 혈통으로서, 죽음을 맞이할 때마다 다음 세대의 클랜에 횃불을 넘겨주는 임무를 수행해야 합니다.
계보 중심 게임플레이
각 시노비는 절차적 세대를 통해 형성되며, 모든 후계자와 함께 탐험할 수 있는 고유한 능력과 속성을 제공합니다.
당신의 유산을 위조하세요
일반 장비부터 전설 가보에 이르기까지 시간이 지남에 따라 더 강해지는 소중한 아이템을 본부로 보내세요. 고유한 능력과 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하는 새로운 시설로 기지를 확장하여 각 세대가 이전 세대보다 더 강력한 힘을 발휘할 수 있도록 하세요.

title: Memoirium
description:
게임 정보
In Memoirium, everything is but sand and stars.
Unique Locations
The realm of dreams does not abide by any rules or genre. In one moment, you will find yourself in a simple 21st-century school, and in the next, your eyes will fall upon a castle held together by wax.
Masks and more
Most, if not all, of the equipment will alter yourself and the entities you encounter. One piece of armor can affect how long negative statuses last, while a specific mask will change how enemies approach you in combat.

title: Deliria VR
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Diliria VR is a psychological horror experience that immerses you in a fog-filled, abandoned town where unsettling secrets lurk beneath the surface. After surviving a car crash, you awaken disoriented in an eerie, desolate town—yet something feels deeply wrong. The crash didn't happen here, and the fog conceals more than just decaying streets and crumbling buildings. As you explore the claustrophobic alleys and unsettling environments, your sense of reality starts to unravel.
With only a cryptic radio signal and scattered clues to guide you, you must navigate the labyrinthine streets, encounter terrifying creatures, and unlock the dark truth behind your past. Each step brings you closer to confronting the painful memories you've buried—especially the truth about your sister's mysterious death.
Key Features:
Immersive VR Horror: Feel the tension and dread as you explore the foggy, decaying town in full virtual reality. Experience every unsettling sound, shadow, and moment of isolation like never before.
Engaging Storyline: A deeply personal narrative that unfolds through cryptic radio broadcasts, eerie flashbacks, and spine-chilling encounters. Face the truth of your past and the consequences of your actions.
Atmospheric World: The town is a character in itself—every street, building, and object reflects the protagonist's fractured psyche. From claustrophobic alleyways to decaying hospitals, every location immerses you deeper into the mystery.
Psychological Horror: Diliria VR focuses on slow-burn tension, guilt, and psychological torment, rather than jump scares. The creatures you encounter represent your inner fears and the darkness you try to hide from.
Challenging Exploration: Solve puzzles, gather items, and find new paths as you navigate blocked roads and crumbling buildings. The town's layout changes subtly as your journey continues, adding to the feeling of unease and disorientation.
The Truth is Buried in the Fog
Diliria VR is a game about guilt, loss, and facing the consequences of our actions. Will you uncover the truth, or will you remain lost in the fog forever? Venture deep into the mystery, but be prepared for what you may find. The truth is waiting… but it’s not what you expect.

title: Sever's Zone
description:
게임 정보
"Sever's Zone" is a First Person Shooter in an alternative universe based on dozens of books and games on the theme of "Stalker". At the same time, "Sever's Zone" only resembles the game "Stalker" - it has no stalkers, no Chernobyl station, no other elements exclusive to "Stalker", but has much in common for the entire universe - the Anomalous Zone, artifacts and anomalies, researchers and inhabitants of the Zone.
The main feature of "Sever's Zone" is the original story written by the author of the game based on his science fiction book, published earlier.
The game will take the player through a story in which several characters will help him learn to survive in the Zone. From the very beginning the player will have a strong dose of ether radiation - a strange radiation that permeates the entire Zone as a result of episodic Breakdowns. The protagonist, having miraculously survived the deadly Breakdown, must reach the scientists' base, where, according to rumors, there are specialists who can help him reduce the ether overdose. However, due to the recent Breakdown, all the anomalies in the Zone are shuffled, all the passages between locations are closed, and the protagonist must find a way through all these obstacles and reach the scientists' base.

title: No Need  Flowers
description:
게임 정보
No Need for Flowers is an arcade-style scrolling shooter bullet hell game about magic dragon girls!
Play as a dragon priestess on a quest to stop a mysterious necromancer from destroying the world.
Skillfully dodge colorful bullet patterns as you shoot down hordes of enemies!

title: AstroMart Adventures
description:
게임 정보
Build a convenience store on an asteroid.

This game is currently not in dev.
Please follow my current game here: ]Playable Alpha[/url]

I am a solo dev who got caught into the magic world of VR.
This won't be the next AAA title, but maybe it will be a fun game you can enjoy for a while.

title: They Fear The Mist
description:
게임 정보
Fight thousands of enemies

Engage in epic battles as you lead your forces against overwhelming hordes of enemies. Strategize, deploy your troops and harness powerful abilities to overcome the relentless onslaught. Every decision counts in this intense real-time strategy experience, where the survival of your people depends on your tactical prowess.
Build your Settlement

Become the architect of your people by constructing and expanding your settlement. Gather resources, plan the layout, and fortify your defenses to withstand the enemy's relentless attacks. As the commander, you hold the fate of your people in your hands – make strategic choices to ensure the growth and security of your evolving community. And always remember to keep the hope of your people up, otherwise your downfall will be guaranteed.

Venture into the mysterious Mist, uncover hidden treasures, face unknown threats, and unlock the mysteries that lie within it. Your exploration decisions will impact your overall strategy and may reveal vital resources or unforeseen challenges. Navigate the Mist wisely, for it holds both the key to survival and the potential for unforeseen peril.

As the commander, your ability to lead and manage your troops is crucial. Recruit and upgrade diverse units with unique strengths. Develop new strategies to outsmart your enemies. Adapt to changing situations and upgrade your forces as they are your most valuable asset. The fate of your people rests on your leadership – can you command with precision and lead them to victory against the advancing threat?

title: M.E.M.O
description:
게임 정보
M.E.M.O demo (α)
Welcome to M.E.M.O demo (α) where you can get a sneak peek into the world of "M.E.M.O"!
While some features are yet to be implemented in this version, you can already experience the captivating world setting and core cryptography gameplay that makes "M.E.M.O" special.
※Please have paper and pen ready when playing.
※The demo(β) is scheduled for release in July 2025.
※This demo may differ from the final product.

※The screenshots shown are all from the development stage.
"In the dark, swaying train, you awaken to the sound of a red telephone, having lost your memory..."
In 2176, Shin Japan is plagued by various social issues.
Amidst this, a terrorist organization called "OUKAMI" threatens the government with the release of a deadly virus nationwide.
As a chosen agent, you must dive into the memories of the deceased to prevent this terror.
Retro landscapes of the mind, cryptic codes guarding old secrets, the truth of a world collapse 100 years ago...
Wandering through the maze of memories, can you find the key to save the future?

title: Evie: The Echo Condition
description:
게임 정보
Battle for your companion's survival as you explore a mysterious, vibrant, and crumbling world full of dangers and secrets to discover. Evie is an action-adventure game with an HD-2D visual style that plays out like a modernized version of SNES and Genesis classics.

UNBREAKABLE BOND

With Evie's help, her friend battles their way back from serious illness as the two bond throughout an epic adventure.

FIND YOUR OWN PATH

Exploration is rewarded and certain magical abilities will make specific encounters easier, while other abilities may be the key to unlocking a secret area.

FACE YOUR FEAR

A fluid combat system allows players to use magic, dash behind enemies, drop traps, block, parry, and deflect projectiles. Play your way and focus on skills and abilities that match your play style.

HD-2D visuals merge hand drawn sprites into a 3D world in a real time action-adventure game.
Lots of secret areas to discover, making way for helpful items on your journey.
Uncover a diverse set of new magical abilities.
Overcome a formidable boss at each distinctive biome to earn new abilities.

title: Handsome and Brave
description:
게임 정보
Handsome and Brave is a story about a World in turmoil and a Knight that can't save it. But he's not alone, he has you. As a Watcher you can pickup, move, and most importantly throw the ragdoll Knight. Together you'll embark on an epic adventure to vanquish the evil Wizard and restore Law to the World.
Solving Puzzles
The Knight's uniquely resistant body and can-do attitude make him the perfect tool for any occasion. Some of his uses are:
Breaking Rocks
Opening Locks
Baking Bread
Turning Cranks
Switching Switches
Farming Produce
Vanquishing villains
Producing lasting pieces of art
And much more!
It's up to you to utilize his ragdoll body to explore this beautiful broken World at your own pace and solve the clever puzzles left by the dastardly people that broke it.
Helping People

title: Master Thief
description:
게임 정보
Slip into the shadows and outsmart security in this thrilling multiplayer heist game!

Master Thief challenges you to become the ultimate burglar in a world where cunning and stealth are your greatest assets.

🕵️‍♂️ Features:
Cunning Heists: Overcome clever obstacles and solve intricate puzzles to secure your loot.
Cooperative Gameplay: Team up with friends in multiplayer mode to pull off daring robberies.
Skill Progression: Embark on a variety of missions to hone your thieving abilities and grow your ill-gotten fortune.
Humorous Twists: Experience a lighthearted take on the world of high-stakes burglary.

Do you have what it takes to become the Master Thief? Gather your crew, plan your heist, and prepare for the ultimate test of stealth and strategy!

title: Frenzy Force
description:
게임 정보
Frenzy Force is a casual top-down shooter set in a diverse collection of biomes known only as The Menagerie.
Existing outside of space and time, The Menagerie is home to formless, bloodthirsty shadow creatures with only one goal: to hunt down and eliminate anyone who enters.
Our brave heroes come from all walks of life, drawn together by the allure of The Menagerie's secrets. Although they have no connection to each other and their pasts are long forgotten, this daring expedition has given them a new identity: The Frenzy Force.
Enter The Menagerie at your own peril, and explore 16 unique biomes with over 30 weapons to aid you in your survival. Last as long as you can against relentless waves of enemies, either solo or with friends!

title: Exoplanet Outpost
description:
게임 정보
In Exoplanet Outpost, you will establish and manage a thriving colony on a distant exoplanet, balancing economic growth, tourism, and defense against relentless alien threats. Begin with a team of intrepid pioneers and transform your base into a bustling hub of commerce and culture.
Resource Management: Mine resources, research technologies, and build infrastructure to support your colony's growth.
Tourist Attractions: Create stunning attractions to draw interstellar tourists, from casinos to mystical temples.
Alien Combat: Defend your outpost from diverse alien species with advanced technology and strategic defenses.
Dynamic Economy: Engage in interstellar trade and manage a complex economy, balancing production, consumption, and resource allocation.
Advanced Technologies: Research and develop cutting-edge technologies to enhance your colony's capabilities and defenses.
Campaign Missions: Embark on focussed scenario missions that challenge your strategic thinking and decision-making skills.
Environmental Challenges: Adapt to harsh planetary conditions, unexpected events, and alien ecosystems that test your colony's resilience.
Experience the ultimate blend of economic strategy, tourism management, and thrilling combat in Exoplanet Outpost.
STORY
In the not-so-distant future, humanity's quest for survival and expansion has reached the stars. Faced with dwindling resources on Earth and the discovery of habitable exoplanets, the Galactic Federation has launched a series of ambitious colonization missions. Among these is "Exoplanet Outpost", a critical initiative aimed at establishing a sustainable human presence on a distant, resource-rich world.
As the commander of this outpost, you are tasked with transforming a wild alien landscape into a thriving hub of economic activity, interstellar tourism, and robust defenses against unforeseen alien threats.
The planet holds untold riches and ancient mysteries, but it also harbors unknown dangers. Alien species and rebel bandits roam the planet, posing both opportunities and threats to your fledgling colony. You must navigate these challenges and harness its resources to build a prosperous and self-sustaining settlement.

title: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
description:
게임 정보
Join brave adventuring duo Cappy and Tappy as they embark on a quest through the trials of many fascinating temples and worlds!
Hand your mouse or keyboard to a friend to tackle challenges as a team, or carve your path forward by controlling both Cappy and Tappy solo.
Don't like mouse and keyboard controls? Play with one or two controllers instead!
Utilize both building and platforming to escape with your life!
Climb and leap away from the ever-encroaching, piranha-infested water beneath your feet!
Jam out to our original soundtrack, hosting a wide variety of handheld game-inspired tunes.
Take in the dazzling and varied atmospheres of each unique world that your adventure brings you to!
Champion each world by collecting all of the idols found within!
Much more waits in store...
Hazards and Helpers

title: Runes of Madness
description:
게임 정보
Runes of Madness is a dark fantasy action RPG that plunges you into a world shrouded in shadow. Delve into perilous dungeons, unravel the secrets of the Runes, and battle hordes of monstrous creatures.
Inspired by the greatest classics of the genre, Runes of Madness offers intense combat, deep character customization, and a challenging rogue-lite experience.
Key Features:
Explore a Dark Fantasy World: A once-peaceful village has been gripped by a mysterious madness, and it's up to you to unravel the sinister truth. Journey through four distinct chapters, each filled with a unique theme, quests, dungeons, and challenges.
Deep Character Customization: Choose from three unique classes - the mighty Warrior, the cunning Rogue, or the powerful Sorcerer.
Customize your character with a variety of skills unique to each class, attributes, and equipment. Enhance your gear with powerful gems, runes, and jewels.
Level up, unlock new abilities, and become a formidable force.
Intense, Strategic Combat: Engage in fast-paced, skill-based combat where precise timing and strategic choices are key. Use the battlefield to your advantage, exploiting traps, environmental hazards, and terrain to defeat your foes.
Mortal Challenge: Every death is permanent. All characters start as mortals; however, by interacting with a certain statue in the world, you can lift this challenge, allowing for a less punishing experience.
Endless Replayability: Explore randomly generated dungeons, filled with loot and encounters.
Team up or go solo: Experience the game alone or with friends in cooperative multiplayer. Explore dungeons, trade items, and fight other players in thrilling PvP encounters in specific zones of the world.
Will you dare to face the darkness and forge your own legend?

title: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
description:
게임 정보
Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world. In the single-player interactive novel villain team-up game There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R., you play as his greatest adversaries. Can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. (short for a "Very Important Collective of Terrorists, Operatives, and Rogues") defeat the only man standing between them and world domination? To the V.I.C.T.O.R. go the spoils!
Your Mission
Having been foiled by secret agent Franklin Benjamin time and time again, a group of madmen decide to team up to take Franklin Benjamin out once and for all. Brandy and The Silver Fox collect a group of six madmen from across the previous four games who theoretically should be enough to take out the only man who is an obstacle to total victory
But what tricks does the unparalleled secret agent Franklin Benjamin have up his sleeve? What lengths will he go to in order to save the world - and himself!
There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. can be played with just a mouse. Gameplay consists of selecting the action or dialog you wish to take given the situation you’re facing. Although the life of a madman is complicated, playing There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. is simple
Sequel or Standalone
There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. is the fifth entry in the There's Always a Madman series, but it tells a standalone story. Like a classic James Bond novel or film where you can pick any one up independent of the rest, you can pick this story up without having experienced any prior stories in the There's Always a Madman franchise. However, I would recommend starting with the first game There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight if you care to meet each madman in their own one-off stories before they all come together in this fifth game
The Underworld is Not Enough
Fed up with being confined to operating in the shadows, do you and your squad have what it takes to eliminate the only man standing between you and world domination? The world is yours for the taking
Teamwork Makes the Dream Work
Madmen from the four previous games join forces with a common goal. But will your cobbled-together crew coalesce around a singular vision and best Franklin Benjamin once and for all or will you succumb to infighting? Put your best foot forward and make nice with a group of madmen

title: Synthroute 82
description:
게임 정보


Take control of VINDICATOR, top of the line simulation vehicle. In this solo arcade infinite destruction racing game your goal is to obliterate evil M.I.N.D. LTD cars and enjoy the never ending ride. Have a moment and need to de-stress? There's nothing better than road mayhem!

Rules are easy - score as many points as you can before you die. Don't worry tho, you can take few hits before that happens.
Features
Infinite racing and destruction
Tailored for busy people - 5 to 10 minutes play session
Ever increasing difficulty - start slow, die hard
Original synthwave soundtrack @2fd5 bandcamp and soon on all streaming platforms
Easy to pick up gameplay
Local leaderboards
Infinite procedurally assembled environments
Vaporwave aesthetics
Keyboard only controls
How to play
AD / Left Right arrow for steering

title: Carry On
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT CARRY ON
Carry On is an upcoming narrative game about the experiences of newcomers who arrive in an unfamiliar place for the first time.
FEATURES
TBD

title: Recital of the Heart
description:
게임 정보
Gregory Bellatoni arrives at a mansion party, intent on meeting his love, Eliza.
Before he can reach her, Gregory finds himself thwarted and trapped inside a mirror world called the 'Weave' within the mansion. Inside, he encounters characters from works of art across all of time. He even meets some of the artists who made them. Gregory quickly finds out, however, that some are friendlier than others...
Gregory, with the help of Kand, a strange denizen of the mirror world, must overcome obstacles, tame beasts, and make peace with his inner desires to escape this world and reach Eliza.
Gameplay
Recital of the Heart is an action adventure game with a focus on exploration, narrative, and challenges. The combat system encourages experimentation with modifications on uniqu melee, ranged, and mobility actions to reward the player with emergent gameplay.
Explore a World of Living Art - The mirror world is a vast and varied world abound with secrets around every corner. Meet a cast of characters, some recognizable and some new,  from works of art, literature, and music.
 Overcome Puzzles and Challenges - Utilize the unique skills you collect while playing to traverse traps, solve puzzles, and outsmart foes.
Create your own Symphony - Mix and match dozens of unique Brushes, Instruments, and Tempos to bestow Gregory with powerful melee, ranged, and mobility abilities. Additional flourishes modify your abilities for even more combinations.
The story is simple and familiar. Save the princess atop the tower distant. But the 'dragons' you will face along the way may surprise you. Some may terrify, some may humble, some may pull on thy heartstrings. But each will bestow upon you a lesson. The story may be simple, and it may seem familiar, but what a tale truly means...

...is all in the way it is told...
"And you realized, didn't you? That when it mattered, there wasn't a moment of hesitation. You marched right through Hell before you realized you were there."

title: Unyverse
description:
게임 정보
Unyverse is a sci-fi, action role-playing game (ARPG) with fighting game combat created by Afrime Studios. Unyverse will deliver an immersive, story-driven gameplay experience enriched by a deep Afro-Futuristic aesthetic.
RPG meets Fighting Game Mechanics.
Unyverse expands on the action-RPG genre by adding fighting game style melee combat. Players will be faced with morally complex decisions that the story in ways that will surprise even the most adept RPG player. Explore an Afrofuturistic world filled with creatures and vast landscapes to discover. In addition to the main story arc of the game, players will be able to uncover unexplored parts of the planet as side quests. At any time during the campaign, a player has the freedom to freely roam a large playable area to uncover resources, trade, hunt, and expand their reputation and influence.
A Fresh New World for RPG Gamers to Explore
Unyverse is an afrofuturistic RPG inspired by the diaspora of African cultures and projected into the future in a galaxy far far away. Never before have we seen an afrocentric world in games but players will be able to create any type of character they want to explore this vast world. We aspire to create the Mass Effect of Afrofuturism with the feel and kinetic action of a fighting game. Your choices will matter and affect your reputation with different factions in the game world. The overarching plot will drive the player forward as a new Mwindaji (Bounty Hunter) as they complete the main quest line where their choices could save their home planet. 
Fighting Game 1v1 Multiplayer That Affects Reputation.
PVP mode will be a combat arena (think ThunderDome) battle allowing players to bring their Characters from single player mode and compete against others online.  Because Unyverse features a unique blend of RPG and fighting game mechanics we can offer players a fun mode that only affects their reputation in the village/city arenas that they have opened up and won PVP matches in - thus giving PVP a single player benefit without upsetting the balance for single player gameplay.

title: Fraudulent Idols
description:
게임 정보
Fraudulent idols is a fixed camera detective action horror where the player guides their way through STRATA Pharmaceutical Plant to investigate missing Alien Technology. The entire game operates on a turn based fixed-camera system. Inspired by the likes of Silent Hill and Final fantasy. Fraudulent Idols is a game where choice is your difficulty setting. Explore STRATA to unveil the mystery behind the Cloud Burst out break and the missing technology.

The character faces challenges in the form of hostile parasites, breathtaking bosses, desperate humans, and decadent designed puzzles in the quests to descend deeper into the mysterious research facility. Multiple scientific based weapons and skills can be acquired and used to help aid this devilish task.

The player will have multiple choices to make throughout the game that will hold groundbreaking weight on other situations in the game including current and future missions, DLC, and even the sequel!

title: WILDERLOCKE
description:
게임 정보
WILDERLOCKE takes the high stakes tactical battles of monster-taming JRPG challenges like the Nuzlocke and adds the unpredictability and replayability of the roguelike formula.
100+ monsters to discover and evolve.
250+ varied moves, 80+ versatile passives (and more to come).
A customisable set of 4 moves and 2 passives for each monster.
Half of your monster’s stats depend on its species, the others are set by you - build the same monster as a supporting tank or fast damage dealer, depending on what your party needs.

title: Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel
description:
게임 정보
There is something very wrong. Or did you just misremember things?
-Take a journey through a strange land with some point-and-click elements, meeting a variety of odd, object-headed citizens as you investigate.
-Let a bizarre mystery unfold as you help Marion find a way to keep her entire world from slipping between her hands.
autokwd: Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel

title: Overrun Protocol
description:
게임 정보
OVERRUN PROTOCOL takes place in 2056, in a world where artificial intelligence has spiraled out of control. After your spaceship crashes on a mysterious island, you quickly discover that this place hides a dark secret.
Facing killer drones, armored units, and autonomous defense systems, you must explore the island, gather resources, and upgrade your equipment to survive. Use hacking to disable or hijack certain machines, access secure areas, and uncover the events that led to this catastrophe.
Key Features
🔹 Intense survival gameplay – resource management, crafting, and open-world exploration.
🔹 Strategic combat against deadly machines – use improvised weapons, traps, and hacking tools to counter the hostile AI.
🔹 An immersive environment – explore a ruined tropical island.
🔹 A deep narrative – uncover the hidden story behind the machine uprising and the true purpose of OVERRUN PROTOCOL.

title: PHi: The Broken Strings
description:
게임 정보
PHi is a 3D puzzle platformer that takes you on an emotional journey through 4 levels, each representing a key life experience. Solve puzzles, explore, and immerse yourself in stunning visuals and a powerful story.
The game offers over 25 creatively designed puzzles, each tested to evoke a unique emotion tied to the story.
Explore the depths of a richly crafted world in this side-scrolling puzzle platformer. With four distinct levels, each evoking a unique emotion, each level offers new challenges and hidden content. 
You are Lost! Find way on your own!

title: Insectile
description:
게임 정보
Find bugs, catch bugs, and piece bugs together! Explore a huge, whimsical world as a little mushroom in this clever, turn-based RPG about puzzlingly-shaped insects!
Find Bugs
These creatures we call “Insectiles” hide under every rock and within every crevice! Finding them is not so easy when you are small. Explore giant gardens, uncover secret pathways, and hop across lily pads in search of each and every Insectile!
Catch Bugs
Every Insectile is a potential teammate! Collecting them all will require careful observation of their behavior: Bring tasty snacks, chase energetic crickets, morph new species, and even dodge wasp stingers to grapple these unique creatures!

title: Step into the Dark
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to HopeTown — a grim underground world where remnants of human civilization fight for survival among the ruins of an ancient prison.

You will:
Explore the Ruins of the Old Prison: Delve into dark corridors and abandoned cells where every corner hides its own secrets and dangers. Discover places where dramatic events once unfolded.
Fight Dangerous Enemies: Overcome confrontations with various threats that remain in the prison after the rebellion. Use your skills and available weapons to survive in this perilous place.
Solve Mysteries and Find Hidden Elements: Collect useful items, explore deserted corners, and uncover secrets that will aid you in your journey.
Key Features:
Immersive Combat System: Experience thrilling battles using a variety of weapons and unique mechanisms created by the Order of Mechanics.

title: Jeff and Crackhead
description:
게임 정보
오버월드- 오버월드를 탐험하는 동안 Jeff와 crackhead의 고유한 능력을 사용하여 하향식 플랫폼 도전을 정복하고 퍼즐을 풀게 됩니다. 스토리를 진행하기 위한 비밀이나 함정을 품고 있는 경로의 많은 갈라짐이 있지만 각 영역의 출구를 찾아야 합니다. 길을 따라 많은 무의미한 몬스터를 만나게 될 것입니다. 하나와 마주치면 전투가 시작됩니다. 전투- 전투는 시간 기반입니다. 공격할 수 있는 속도는 각 캐릭터의 속도 스탯에 따라 다릅니다. 공격할 기회를 기다리는 동안 방어 모드로 전환하고 전용 지역에서 자유롭게 달릴 수 있습니다. 이 모드에서는 노란색 구슬이 생성되어 수집할 수 있으며, 이것들을 수집하면 타이머가 빨라져 더 빨리 들어갈 수 있습니다. 자유로운 움직임을 이용해 다가오는 공격을 피하거나 쳐내기 공격을 충전하세요. 타이밍이 가장 중요합니다. 타이머가 가득 차고 스트라이크를 칠 기회가 보이면 말이죠. 캐릭터 전용 버튼으로 액션 모드로 전환하세요. 여기에서 아이템, 빠른 공격 또는 캐릭터의 특수 능력 중 하나를 사용하도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 하지만 상대방이 공격할 때 놓치거나 반격을 받을 수 있으므로 상대방의 타이머를 주시하십시오. 크랙헤드를 찾으면 공격을 빠르게 연속으로 선택하여 강력한 콤보를 뽑을 수 있습니다. 콤보 히트에서 가장 강력한 움직임이 가장 높은 피해를 입기 위해 지속되도록 하십시오. 이야기 실수로 다른 세계로 가는 포털을 만든 후. Jeff, Crackhead 및 잠재적으로 나머지 국가가 빨려 들어갔습니다. 이 낯선 새로운 장소 주변에서 무작위 장소뿐만 아니라 무작위 시간에도 총에 맞습니다. 게임은 제프가 숲이 우거진 지역에 나타나면서 시작됩니다. 그는 제리라는 이상한 캐릭터에 의해 무례하게 깨어났고, 그녀는 그에게 무슨 일이 일어났는지 모호하게 설명합니다. 올바른 방향을 찾고 이상한 괴물을 몇 번 만난 Jeff는 친구를 찾고 일생일대의 모험을 시작하기 위해 북쪽으로 향합니다.

title: SUPER ADVENTURE
description:
게임 정보
SUPER ADVENTURE is a Shmup turned 2D-Platformer with great emphasis on bullet dodging, expressive boss fights and a wacky story.
ADVENTURE START
Your sleep was interrupted by aliens that destroyed your house, so you head out to find them. On your way you are given an irreplaceable item that holds great importance on your journey!
THE SHIELD:
Always active on your backside
Turn around to block
Protects you from all attacks coming your way
Additionally SUPER ADVENTURE can be mainly played in two different styles.
THE SWORD:
The sword focuses on close quarter combat and features a juggle and combo system.

title: The Town That Died In The Night
description:
게임 정보
Everyone's infected, and the only option is the nuclear one. Can you escape the town, before it comes to that? Or will you succumb to the virus? Explore the town of Little River, while trying to find a way out. You might not figure out the mystery of the outbreak, but you might just escape with your life. Every bite feeds the infection, every second the virus spreads. A message is broadcast on every channel to take shelter immediately. But that only means one thing. You must escape.
A classic-style survival horror game, with online functionality. Try to escape with up to three friends. Fixed cameras, zombies, and plenty to explore.
autokwd: The Town That Died In The Night

title: Felampire
description:
게임 정보

Felampire beckons you into the shadows of its 2D Metroidvania realm. Embrace the essence of a mysterious cat, brought to life within the sacred confines of an ancient crypt. Awaken without memories, alone, yet filled with unfathomable powers just waiting to be unleashed. Your odyssey unfolds in the labyrinthine passages beneath and stretches into the world above, where your kind is feared and scorned.

Embark on a metroidvania platformer adventure unlike any other, where you play as a cat exploring the depth of crypts, acquiring mystical abilities, and navigating through long-forgotten ruins. Unravel puzzles, unlock ancient secrets, and discover the true essence of the felampire, all while piecing together your own mysterious origins.

Face formidable bosses and conquer them to assimilate their extraordinary powers, transforming the way you combat foes and traverse the enigmatic world of the crypts. Felampire invites you into a captivating tale of discovery, power, and identity, where your actions dictate the unfolding of a story far greater than yourself.

Make tough decisions as you discover your heritage and what that means. You decide who you will side with. Navigate the shadows of uncertainty as you face moral dilemmas that shape the destiny of Aethermere. Choose forgiveness or vengeance, alliance or isolation, as you grapple with the consequences of your actions. The path you walk will define not only your journey, but the fate of the kingdom itself.

title: Forum Mortuorum
description:
게임 정보
Sports management with a twist: your athletes can die! Recruit a team. Train and equip them. Pick challenging but winnable matches to maximize your profit and team development. And choose when to sideline your best for a big upcoming match!
‘Hands-off’ arena matches: watch from the stands as your team battles it out through a diverse variety of Mediterranean arenas
Classless character development: mix and match training, perks, and equipment drive your gladiators’ style and specialties
Much more on the way: Until this is the best gladiator management game out there, I will be adding features, content, and polish. Forum Mortuorum accepts no equal! Wishlist today to follow the journey

title: Mechs and Muskets
description:
게임 정보
Step into an alternate history of the Napoleonic Wars, where towering mechs change the course of battle.
Mechs and Muskets is a 2D isometric tactical RPG that blends the grandeur of Napoleonic warfare with the power of mechanized combat. As a French soldier caught in the midst of a fierce continental war, you'll command a team of customizable mechs, each equipped with unique parts and powerful abilities. With a turn-based combat system, strategic depth, and a story driven by choices, you’ll need to outmaneuver, outsmart, and outfight your enemies on the battlefield.
In this alternate timeline, both men and machines clash in an epic struggle for domination. Will you lead your squad to victory in the Emperor's name, or will you be crushed under the weight of steel and gunpowder?
- Tactical, Turn-Based Combat: Plan each move carefully as you lead your team of customizable mechs in intense, strategic battles. Positioning, timing, and teamwork are key to success.
- Deep Customization: Build and upgrade your squad with unique mech parts. Equip them with different weapons, armor, and abilities to adapt to your playstyle or counter your enemies’ strategies.

title: Warrior Chef
description:
게임 정보
WARRIOR CHEF
Play as Mako, a Warrior Chef in a fantasy world of sentient food, chopping up foes for ingredients to cook new abilities in a 3D Metroidvania about eating your way through four Food Kingdoms in a race to stop the spreading Rot.
COMBAT
Deep sword combat has you master Mako's two-handed chef knife, a family heirloom sharp enough to split food in two. Modify it's moveset with special Whetstones providing utility, manoeuvrability or raw power.

COOKING
With a self-heating pot attached at the hip, Mako can cook on the go. The more he eats the stronger his abilities grow, with a variety of ingredient synergies and augmenting Spices to be found. Be warned- with such power comes one hell of a food coma.

title: Skyhell
description:
게임 정보
Featurelist:

Stunning narative adventure.
Survive, invade and rule! In this world you don't only have fanatical war for resources, but also you will conquere states, you're going to be in bloody naval battles and you will explode some skyscrapers. The fate of your own state and of its residents totally depends totally on you.

Weapon modifications.
Customize your gun! Dozens of weapon modification for pistols/rifles/shotguns are available for you. As if this wasn't enough, you can make for your weapons dozens of various modifiers to make your weapon more powerful or paint it in different styles.

Everything is destructible.
Physics of destruction will allow you to break everything into little pieces - doors, walls, ships or anything else. And yes, you can destroy skyscrapers, if you want to;

Made with Unreal Engine 5.
Power Unreal Engine 5 allows to accurately convey the story about the world that keeps getting destroyed by numerous wars for resources.

title: Cereal Reaper
description:
게임 정보
What this?
Cereal Reaper is a game where a cereal addicted freak runs out of cereal and does whatever it takes to get more. Find goofy characters on your journey and beat people up on your way to find the greatest breakfast ever.
Collect items and fight! (if you feel like it)
On the way, find tons of items that make you more powerful to slay more powerful bosses! If you don't want to do that, just do it less. Sometimes violence is the right solution though. There are no random enemy encounters so feel free to explore all corners of the map without any trouble!
Talk to people to find out more things about the world!
There are hundreds of characters around the world to talk to! Some more useful than others, but reading is very good! You should do it more.
GO FAST!!!
The game has many features designed for speedrunning. This makes replaying the game for the purpose of beating it quickly more fun! The game has an ingame timer built in so don't bother with any external tools!

title: Reviving An Angel
description:
게임 정보
How do you revive an angel?
Reviving An Angel promises to offer a different experience derived from the older classics with a unique turn-based system, interesting storylines and engaging characters.
Utilizing Critical Effects provides a new strategy for players during combat. And along with Harold’s unique Next Effects and Counter Effects to customize, Reviving An Angel competes with its one-of-a-kind and intriguing combat system.

title: You Died!
description:
게임 정보
How will you cope with the loss of yourself?
Each episode of You Died! will allow you to experience a stage of grief for yourself. Make choices, deal with the consequences, and interact with your environment to express the emotions of the main character.

You Died! is a choice-based 3D visual novel with elements of psychological horror. It aims to help players struggling with growing up and feelings of wasted childhood. Using death as a metaphor for permanently leaving childhood behind, the story takes the player through 5 stages of grief from the Elisabeth Kubler-Ross model. In each stage, you will notice some changes to the environments and mechanics from shader changes to completely new abilities in each episode!
Episode 1 Denial
Face your death and try to find out why you have chosen to kill yourself. This episode gives you an option to "possess" your body while you walk around the house and uncover the reasons behind your death.
Episode 2 Anger
Dying young could make one pretty angry. That is why in this episode you will have the option to throw as many things as you want and scream your lungs out. Yell and blame everyone (including yourself).
Episode 3 Bargaining
Face death (this time literally) and try to convince them to let you come back to life. How far would you go to turn back time?

Episode 4 Depression & Episode 4 Acceptance (in development)
key Features
story-driven Interactive Fiction
player Choices Altering Gameplay
hand-painted Monochrome Visuals
Each episode reflects emotions felt in the corresponding stage of grief through shaders and game mechanics
Original soundtrack

title: The Midnight Barber
description:
게임 정보
A narrative ASMR adventure in a supernatural barbershop.
“The Midnight Barber” blends rhythm mechanics and introspective storytelling.
Clara's mysterious barbershop doesn't open until midnight. She serves a clientele of vampires, sirens, werewolves and all the other creatures who have nowhere else to go for their grooming needs.
But as the country undergoes a shift from authoritarian dictatorship to democracy, Clara stumbles upon a secret that threatens to unravel a disturbing conspiracy. A secret that puts her in the crosshairs of the most influential individuals in Barcelona - supernatural or otherwise.
Trim to the Beat: Match your barber tools to your clients' inner rhythm in a soothing, relaxing experience.
A city in transition: Immerse yourself in late 70s Barcelona, a time of social change and political turmoil brimming with supernatural intrigue.
Absorbing atmosphere: The city comes alive through stunning hand-drawn art and a reactive, atmospheric soundtrack that evolves with your every move.
Stories that cut deep: Forge connections with a diverse cast of enchanted, discover their backstories, and influence their paths.
Drive the Conversation: Choose icebreakers and unlock new conversation topics and key information to solve your lines of inquiry.
Inside the Mirror: Progress in a client’s story to discover their inner demon—with a unique musical mini-game for every client.

title: Word To Angel
description:
게임 정보
Experience a musical pacifist adventure much more focused on emotions and characters rather than fighting and action. (Beware of the "friendly-looking angels", nonetheless!)
Get to listen to a rich soundtrack and play exciting music-themed mini games, turn-based bosses and more! (Some of them are really challenging.)
Travel the world and get to save it through an original story and deep lore with glimpses of humor! (I've heard the dads and moms' stories are neat...)
No one gets hurt. You'll have to use something other than violence in order to solve conflicts. (Maybe use your brain? Or your heart?)
Choices matter! Whenever a decision is presented to you, choose carefully! It may impact the story and how other characters feel about you. (It may also impact how you feel about yourself, huh.)
Promote nature and animal protection everywhere. Even if you gotta fight for it! (*ahem* Fighting as defending it. Never forget about the fourth feature. NEVER.)
You can feed pigeons.

title: Don't Get Caught!
description:
게임 정보
Don’t Get Caught - Big Brother is Watching!
Your mission: infiltrate an ultra-secure laboratory and steal top-secret documents. Sounds simple? Think again. From dimly lit warehouses to underground sewers and high-tech experimental chambers, each level brings unique mechanics and challenges.
This isn't your typical infiltration platformer. Here, you don’t just control the hero - you also control the surveillance cameras. Navigate the environment, plan your route, and manipulate your field of view as both the infiltrator and the security system.
To escape, you must use the cameras strategically to piece together the level’s layout. But be warned - not all cameras work in your favor! Some are out to catch you, equipped with motion detection, infrared vision, and even sound-tracking technology.
As if dodging an army of mechanical eyes wasn’t enough, you’ll also need to master switches, access keycards, and moving platforms to find your way to freedom.
Can you outsmart the system and pull off the heist? Or will you be just another intruder caught on tape?

title: Conjunctivitalizer
description:
게임 정보
Conjunctivitalizer takes a mallet and smashes all expectations of what traditional 2D shooters should be like. Take the role of the Conjunctivitalizer ("Liza" for short) and set out to remind humanity of the true meaning of creativity.
In addition to a standard and wide shot, the player is equipped with a sword, but this sword isn't used to defeat enemies melee style. Instead, it has different effects on enemy bullets depending on their color. Blue bullets can be reflected back for added damage, yellow bullets can be absorbed into your conjunctivitality meter, and red bullets - run like hell. 
In a bizarre twist, there are no weapon or powerup items. Your weapon will increase in power at certain score milestones, and enemies will only leave behind point items if you kill them with reflected bullets or the conjunctivitality beam (which can be used once your meter is full). This allows players to choose their own play style; you can play it safe and just shoot everything down, or you can master the sword and go for the high score while powering up your weapon as quickly as possible. 
Not only does Conjunctivitalizer offer a completely fresh method of gameplay and scoring, but it's also filled with bizarre and zany enemies. Fruit bowl spaceships, dango mochi birds, flying cacti and gazelles riding tractors are just a fraction of the characters you'll encounter. Still not enough? Conjunctivitalizer features an OST by game music legend Yamanaka Toshiya, whose previous works include Star Cruiser, Bakuretsu Muteki Bangaioh, and Sin & Punishment.
