With multiple difficulty levels and endings, secret characters, and near infinite scoring strategies, this is a shooter that finally breaks the bullet hell mold and truly attempts something new.

title: Lethal Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
"Lethal Dungeon" is a Lethal Puzzle Card Game.
In every battle, you must make a one-turn kill with only the first hand you are dealt.
You will get more rewards if you defeat enemies with the fewest number of cards as possible,
If you cannot defeat the enemy, you can use money to duplicate cards.
Use the money you earn to strengthen your deck!
Fight stronger enemies and earn money!
Repeat this process to conquer the dungeon.

title: Foul
description:
게임 정보
Foul is a survival game set in a post-apocalyptic environment.
It takes you into a world where every action matters and essential supplies are hard to come by. Explore the vast world filled with infected species that need to be dealt with.
Fight off the infected with a range of different weapons.
Engage in fierce combat with enemies found everywhere in the world. Use all kinds of melee and ranged weapons in your defence. Do you stand a chance against the infected?
Drive like there is no tomorrow.
Cars are rare but valuable, allowing for quick map traversal and offering the potential to inflict significant damage.

title: Incoherence
description:
게임 정보
Alex’s quiet life in a small, unassuming town begins to unravel as strange and impossible events take hold. Neighbors disappear, buildings shift overnight, and creatures that shouldn’t exist begin to roam the streets. Something sinister is at work, and Alex must uncover the truth before the town—and himself—are consumed by the madness.
Inspired by classics like Silent Hill and System Shock, Incoherence is a survival exploration game set in a sprawling, open-world town. Scavenge for resources, craft tools, and uncover clues to navigate a reality that seems to bend and break with each passing moment. As Alex pieces together the fragments of this eerie mystery, he must confront the terrifying connection between himself and the forces at play.
In a world where reality itself is the enemy, the answers may come at a cost Alex isn’t prepared to pay.
Key Features
Immerse yourself in a first-person adventure, rich in detail and atmosphere.
Equip a variety of classic weapons, each with unique strengths and abilities.
Interact with complex NPCs, adding depth to the unfolding story.
Encounter diverse monsters, testing your combat skills and strategies.
Evolve your character through RPG elements, with leveling and skill trees.
Tailor your arsenal with weapon upgrades to suit your playstyle.
Unearth blueprints and use found materials to craft vital resources.
Explore computer systems and find notes that piece together the game's narrative and open new pathways.
Overcome challenges by repairing and hacking robots and security systems.
Collect in-game currency scattered throughout the world for use at various vendors.

title: Banned Together
description:
게임 정보
"What do books mean to us? And what happens when the stories we depend on go missing?"
A Library Investigation
Play as Ruby (they/them), a journalism major on a surreal, after-hours adventure to investigate the disappearance of books from their college library. Their quest for library justice leads to dark political revelations and a magnetic connection with a mysterious trans librarian. Can Ruby live out their own queer story, even as queer history is being erased?
Narrative Puzzling
Thought bubbles provide insight into Ruby's (sometimes scattered) mind, as you make your way through the mysterious MacLeod library. Use an interactive journal to focus these thoughts and reveal new insights. The more you learn about Ruby's past, and the queer history of MacLeod itself, the more of the library's secrets you'll unlock!

title: Particles of Reality: Remembrance
description:
게임 정보
(Game development in progress, screenshots will be updated when finalized.)
This game is a dark, corrupted, and twisted otome visual novel full of bad, brutal, and merciless ends. Can you finally find a happy ending? Pfft... good luck.
Remembrance is the standalone-sequel to Particles of Reality: Obsession. A summary of significant relevant events is included in this game, so if Obsession was too dark & depressing for you, no worries!
But be warned, it's still a dark, rough ride, although (for plot purposes!!!) it's not as bad as its predecessor.
Series Information
You are the main character of multiple versions (aka Routes) of multiple clusters of reality (aka Worlds). The characters around you will always be the same people, but the worlds will vary wildly.
But... what does any of this have to do with you destroying reality?!
This game is the second World called "Remembrance". The first was "Obsession." Each world is its own universe and unique story. Obsession & Remembrance plot lines are not related in any way. Only the Particles mystery & Ethereal beings connect them.
Game Features:
Choose-your-own-adventure style dark, dramatic, violent otome visual novel.
MC customizable full name (self-insertion is not recommended)
The MC is now a mostly confident and intelligent woman. No more cowering, phobias, and (usually?) painful naivety. 
Light / Partial / Limited voiced dialog for all love interests (in Obsession - Abridged too!)
Minimum of 7 CGs per love interest character (plus others!)
6 love interests (breakdown at the end)
8 wildly different endings per character
Bonus Content: Side, mini, and what if stories for each love interest! 
Achievements and in-game Achievement screen
[TBD] wordcount. [TBD] hours of content (at 200wpm average reading speed) [Anticipated to be similar to Obsession in length, so 50+ hours. Exact count to come.]

title: Shadow Of The Union
description:
게임 정보
Create various items and weapons from a wide range of unique materials that can be gathered or found in different corners of the locations. Don’t forget to upgrade your workbench — it will allow you to craft cooler items with unique characteristics! However, not all items can be crafted right away; some require research or the creation of blueprints.
Your base is your only safe place, offering great opportunities for survival. Build and upgrade it to withstand the next attack from dangerous monsters without losing any ground. Strive to automate base defense and other processes as efficiently as possible, using electricity, as well as various devices and mechanisms. But remember, all of this requires constant monitoring and maintenance!

title: Owl Force
description:
게임 정보




Owl Force와 함께 서사적인 여정에 나서십시오. 여기서 당신은 영웅적인 부엉이들의 정예 팀을 이끌고 사악한 Darktail Order와 싸웁니다. 생명이 넘치는 우주를 탐험하고, 활기찬 행성에서 강력한 적에 이르기까지 다양한 경험을 하게 됩니다. 여정을 따라 고대 빛의 조각들의 비밀을 풀어 당신의 우주선과 능력을 향상시키십시오. 각 대결은 당신의 전투 기술뿐만 아니라 당신의 힘과 은하계의 미묘한 균형의 신비에 대해 더 깊이 이해할 수 있는 기회를 제공합니다.

특징

무한한 오픈 월드: 새로운 별계, 숨겨진 비밀, 그리고 숨막히는 우주 현상이 가득한 광활한 우주를 횡단하면서 우주선을 조종하십시오.
동적 전투 시스템: 적들이 당신의 움직임에 맞서 진화함에 따라 전술을 적응시키며 격렬한 공중전을 벌입니다.
독특한 모험과 도전을 약속하는 동적 이벤트를 통해 은하계의 운명을 좌우하십시오.
모든 선택이 중대한 결과를 초래하는 시스템에서 우주선과 능력을 신중하게 업그레이드하십시오.
당신의 여정에 영향을 주고 이야기를 더 깊게 만들어 줄 다양한 캐릭터들과 상호작용하십시오.
밀도 높은 소행성 벨트에서 에테리얼한 성운의 아름다움에 이르기까지 놀라운 환경을 탐험하십시오.
음모, 배신, 그리고 구원을 추구하는 이야기에 빠져 은하계 붕괴를 막기 위해 노력하십시오.








추가 정보, 홍보 자료, 업데이트를 원하시면 저희 공식 웹사이트를 방문하거나 언론팀에 직접 연락하십시오.

title: Flooded Burials
description:
게임 정보
Flooded Burials is a top-down action adventure game about exploring a tower buried in the sea. The game consists of an overworld where you can explore and get to know NPCs, and individual stages where you you'll have to face combat and platforming challenges. The game contains:
A beautiful world for you to explore and uncover
A deep combat system with unique parrying mechanics.
Unique npc's you can talk to and get to know.
Multiple stages that can be replayed for higher ranks
Will be able to lower the sea and uncover this words mysteries?

title: The Lonely Tree
description:
게임 정보
Diary of Your Life and Others
Create a personal collection of important life events, writing them as diary entries that shape your journey.
As you add each entry, it becomes a node on your tree, growing and branching as your tree expands and connect with the stories of others.
Connect with Strangers with Similar Experiences
As you build your tree of life, you'll discover that your entries resonate with others.
When your entry aligns with someone else's, their story intertwines with yours, creating new connections and shared experiences.
You’ll grow alongside anonymous players, bound together by similar milestones and emotions.
Build and Customize your Tree
Your tree reflects your life, shaped by the entries you add.
As you grow, watch your tree flourish—an expanding symbol of your personal journey. But with growth comes the need to prune branches, allowing new ones to emerge.
With the changing seasons, your tree transforms, adapting to its environment and to your journey.
Grow your environment 
Start as a tiny sapling on a hill beside a tranquil lake. As you continue to add entries and grow, your environment evolves in tandem with you.
In time, your tree will stand tall in a vast meadow, hosting a vibrant community of plants and animals.
Though still the same solitary tree on a quiet island, it now thrives, intertwined with the stories of others and becoming a home to all who may find solace in your branches.

title: Death Kitchen
description:
게임 정보
Death Kitchen is a fast-paced co-op cooking horror game. You must coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers. Mistakes are fatal. Meet the quota and move on to the next day or suffer the consequences. 
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Gather your friends then connect using built-in direct messaging. Play solo or with up to 4 friends and start your intergalactic food chain empire! TIME TO BE RICH!
TEAM FORMATION
One manager and 4 other morphing creatures. Manager is in charge of morphing decisions. CHANGE IS KEY. ADAPTABILITY IS SUCCESS. 
MORPHING CREATURES
You can turn into most things in the kitchen! Need to cut a lot? Morph into a knife! Is the restaurant too dark? Morph into a lightbulb! NO LIMITATION FOR CREATIVITY.
COOKING FEATURES
Some stations in your kitchen have mini-games! Others are realistic cooking. LET THEM COOK.
AGGRESSIVE ALIEN CUSTOMERS
All customers are unique and have a lot to learn about! Make sure you serve them before they run out of patience and not mess up their order. OTHERWISE DEATH.
PROXIMITY CHAT

title: Bully Ball Brigade
description:
게임 정보
Bully Ball Brigade is about making or breaking friendships (as any good party game). Compete in simple games, and beat your friends. Be the Best Bully there ever was. 
Make the game as easy or complex as you want, with roguelike spice mechanics, and full customisability. Each round's winner decides the game's pace, by choosing the next spice. 
Challenge yourselves by handpicking the available spices. Skip the spice, if the game is already overwhelming.

title: Hidden Tactics
description:
게임 정보

Gods love playing, and Hidden Tactics is their favorite board game. Play as a god of Humans, Elves, Orcs or Dwarves and defeat your opponent on a classic 7-round Hidden Tactics game. Master your strategy, and relax while watching a spectacle of fight & glory.
Strategic Placement
Place units and buildings on your side of the battlefield during the Preparation phase. You win a game of Hidden Tactics by destroying the opponent's villages, located at the end of each lane. Carefully manage your gold income and anticipate your enemy's next move by strategically placing your troops or using game-changing spells.

Watch your units fight during the Battle phase! Don't worry about the fallen - they will rise again, fully healed, at the end of each round.

Each faction has its specific units and buildings. Choose between 60+ cards to create the deck that best fits your playstyle !

As you can only bring a limited selection of units with you in battle, every deck will have its strengths and weaknesses. Some situations might require recruiting more powerful units : Mercenaries ! Each game features a random selection of mercenaries, with 20 mercenaries at launch. Be careful, as your opponent has access to the exact same pool of mercenaries !

title: CHI Project
description:
게임 정보
Every 7 years, the prestigious King's Invitational is held in the nation of Lyssidia. Sponsors seek out only the most promising gladiator candidates to rise to the occasion. The prize? An audience with the king himself, as well as one wish that he MUST oblige, no matter what...
...or so the announcements claim. 

In reality, very few newcomers make it to that stage, with event after event rigged to fall into the hands of those backed by an aristocracy with no intentions of allowing any threats to the status quo to pass...
...but what happens when someone is killed outside of the arena?

title: LAPSE
description:
게임 정보
레트로 서바이벌 호러, 현대적인 게임플레이
90~2000년대 공포 명작에서 영감을 받은 LAPSE 는, 장르의 역사를 만들어온 억압적인 분위기와 긴장감을 되살리는 게임입니다.
현대적인 컨트롤과 어깨 너머 3인칭 시점으로 클래식한 경험에 현대적 요소를 가미하면서도, 진정한 서바이벌 호러의 본질을 잃지 않았습니다.
 퍼즐을 풀고 길을 개척하라
열쇠, 코드, 논리적 사고를 활용해 지능적인 퍼즐을 해결하라.
메트로이드바니아 스타일의 정교하게 설계된 맵을 탐험하며, 문과 복도가 빼곡한 폐쇄적인 미로를 신중히 탐색하라.

title: Boiiing Boiiing
description:
게임 정보
Boiiing Boiiing is a physics-based party game up to 4 players in local. In this game of tag, you bounce with a pogo stick that you angle in order to catch or to escape your opponent. The plot twist? You can play as differents animals with their own unique powers!
Bounce around with your pogo stick in a bunch of differents maps. Catch your friends as the chaser, or escape them until the timer runs out. Exactly like a game of tag, the most exciting game of your childhood.
Play with your friends and family in three differents games modes: 1v1, 2v2, FFA. No friends? No problem! Play with bots and practice in the training campus.
Wanna play with your grandma? No problem! Boiiing Boiiing is accessible with just 3 buttons, and a different control mode for begginers! Two players can even play on the same keyboard!

title: Gig Crawler
description:
게임 정보
Support us on Kickstarter and our socials! Links on right ; )
Get ready to dive into GigCrawler, a multiplayer roguelike where corporate freelancers blast through bullet hell dungeons, chasing paychecks and dodging deadlines! Gear up, test your wildest builds, and uncover the secrets lurking in this chaotic universe.

Enter Dearth, a demonic land reshaped by human capitalism. Play as a freelance hunter hired by Ward Corp, a major corporation specializing in the security of Dearth's diverse population.
Your mission? Battle against the conservative demons and beasts of the old Era, for the sake of civilization... and your paycheck.

Gig Crawler seeks to be a demonic parody of the contemporary labor market and gig economy. Everyday issues and archetypes will appear in Dearth, but with a demonic, fantasy twist!

title: Fabled Frontier
description:
게임 정보
Fabled Frontier is an open world crafting and action rpg set in a procedurally generated world inspired by fairy tales. Build your hero as well as a home!

Build your hero
Build your hero to be a raging warrior, trap setting ranger, beast summoner, or something else!

Explore the lands and beyond
Explore the procedurally generated world and discover what creatures and lands lie in it. Then find what lies beyond the massive rings on the water.

Construct a home
Create a place to rest up and get ready for new adventures

Key Features
Craft a custom character build from practically countless combinations of items, enchantments, abilities, and passive skills
Gather materials by engaging a wide variety of enemies
Visit different planes where each has various biomes to explore, creatures to fight, and resources to craft
Build a base

title: Inherited Shadows
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by the classics of the genre, Inherited Shadows weaves a gripping tale about Amanda, a young adult struggling to lead a normal life while haunted by the trauma of her mother’s absence, but on an ordinary morning in 1999, everything will change for her forever.
A TRUE HORROR ADVENTURE
Explore a world where tension never goes away. Every step is a life or death decision. Hide, solve puzzles and discover the dark secrets of a cult you were never meant to find. With an oppressive atmosphere, relentless enemies and a disturbing story, this is a true horror adventure.
THERE ARE QUESTIONS WHICH ARE BETTER LEFT UNANSTERED

title: Playable Alpha
description:
게임 정보
As researcher with great ambitions, and lack of talent, you are sent to a newly discovered planet far away from civilization.
In this VR first person survival, you will need to build an outpost and survive the hostile environment. While exploring the planet, unveiling its secrets.

title: FLASHLOOP
description:
게임 정보

2X25년. 기술의 비약과 프로세서의 진화를 거쳐 AI는 인류를 속이고 핵무기를 장악할 수 있게 됐다. 그 이후로 사람들은 AI에 복종할 수밖에 없었습니다. 배를 격추시킨 사람은 누구인가? 사이브리드는 누구입니까? 행성이 생명이 없는 행성으로 분류된 이유는 무엇입니까? 지역주민들은 왜 그렇게 공격적인가? 주인공이 정확히 왜 여기에 있었나요? 이 모든 사건은 우연이 아니다

Flashloop는 상호 연결된 거대한 세계에서 3D 그래픽을 사용하는 2D 모험입니다. 당신은 Cybrid로 플레이하며 충돌 후 주변에 흩어져 있는 배의 일부를 찾으려고 노력합니다. 갑자기 행성은 언뜻 보이는 것보다 훨씬 더 무서운 것으로 밝혀졌습니다. 정글, 황무지, 늪, 설원, 불타버린 땅 - 모든 장소를 방문하여 선장이 아직 준비하지 못한 답을 찾으세요...

게임 기능
- 이것은 러그라이크(Rouglike)가 아닌 클래식 메트로배니아(Metroidvania)입니다.
- 여기에는 절차적 생성이 없으며, 전 세계가 수동으로 조립됩니다. 게임 경험과 감각에 대해 모든 것이 신중하게 테스트되었습니다.
-사려 깊은 레벨 디자인. 최소 역추적.

- 관성 없이 매우 반응성이 뛰어난 360° 제어
-지상과 공중에서 완전한 캐릭터 제어
-앞으로 달리고 뒤로 쏠 수 있습니다.

-무기를 업그레이드하고, 능력과 장비를 얻고, 퍼즐을 풀고, 비밀을 찾고, 몬스터와 보스와 싸우세요. 이 모든 것이 새로운 지역을 발견하고 스토리를 진행하는 데 도움이 될 것입니다.

- "배우기 어렵다 - 마스터하기 쉽다". 얼핏 보면 적들이 매우 어려워 보일 수도 있지만, 적들의 행동을 이해하면 피해를 입지 않고 제압할 수 있습니다.
- 게임의 성공은 게임의 무작위성이 아니라 플레이어의 실력에 달려있습니다.
- 눈길을 끄는 시각적 스타일. 무서운 행성의 자연 SF 설정
-모든 스크린샷과 게임 플레이 장면은 색상 보정이나 필터 없이 게임에서 직접 캡처됩니다.

-외로운 분위기. 의인화된 생물은 없습니다.
-독점 음악. 정말 분위기에 푹 빠져들게 만드네요
- 본 게임은 드라마 감독이 단독으로 개발하고 있습니다.
- 사려 깊은 게임 플레이. 게임은 플레이어의 흥미를 유지하면서 단계적으로 드라마틱하게 구축되었습니다.

- 게임에는 레일건이 있습니다. 이 무기는 정말 재미있습니다. 특히 목표를 달성했을 때

title: Sligga Trigger
description:
게임 정보
Sligga Trigger is an arcade twin-stick shooter with a one-of-a-kind style and unique over-the-shoulder perspective. Every millisecond counts in this white-knuckle, red-hot, balls-to-the-walls action game.
Demo Features
18 screens across 2 stages
5 bosses
16+ enemy types
Hi Score Support
Long-Term Features
Every stage has a branching path
Co-op gameplay
Story Mode
Boss Rush Mode
RNG / Roguelike Mode

title: Jet Birds
description:
게임 정보
안전벨트를 매고, 날개를 펼치고, 제트팩을 점화하라!—Jet Birds는 초고속, 고난이도의 레이싱 게임으로, 정밀한 비행이 승리의 열쇠다. 제트 엔진을 장착한 새를 조종하여 숨 막히는 자연 경관을 가로지르며 속도와 컨트롤 사이에서 균형을 잡아라.
하늘을 지배하라
피치, 요, 롤을 자유롭게 조종하고, 비행 중에 날개 길이를 조정할 수 있는 완벽한 컨트롤 시스템. 모든 회전과 급강하는 당신의 손에 달려 있다. 회피 및 대시 기술을 사용하여 장애물을 피하고 좁은 틈을 통과하며, 비행을 정밀하게 조율하여 소중한 몇 밀리초를 단축하라.
시간과의 레이스
타임 어택 레이스에 도전하여 속도와 정확성의 한계를 극복하고 글로벌 리더보드를 정복하라. 루트를 최적화하고, 공기 역학을 개선하며, 제트 추진 비행 기술을 연마하는 것이 승패를 가를 것이다.
새를 선택하고, 세계를 선택하라
거대한 산봉우리부터 울창한 정글 계곡까지, 20개 이상의 독창적인 환경을 누비며 비행하라. 각 환경은 고유한 도전 과제를 제공한다. 개성 넘치는 제트팩 장착 새들 중에서 선택하고, 각기 다른 비행 특성을 활용하여 최고의 레이서가 되어라.
특징:
✅ 정밀한 비행 메커니즘 – 3D 공간에서 자유로운 고급 조종 시스템을 통한 진정한 실력 테스트.
✅ 사실적인 물리 엔진 – 현실적인 공기 역학으로 미세한 조작까지 비행에 영향을 미친다.
✅ – 자신의 기록을 경신하고 전 세계 플레이어들과 경쟁.
✅ – 20개 이상의 아름답게 제작된 자연 경관을 고속 비행.
✅ – 각기 다른 디자인과 비행 특성을 가진 다양한 새들 중에서 선택.

title: Tamer Town
description:
게임 정보
🏗️ Build a Unique Wildling-Friendly City
Construct specialized homes, training centers, and elemental relaxation spas for your Wildlings.
Design your city’s layout with cultural, nature, and entertainment decorations to maximize your Wildlings’ happiness.
Expand your town by claiming new territories, unlocking rare Wildlings and unique resources.
🛠️ Train & Evolve Your Wildling Helpers
Wildlings gain experience slowly through work but train efficiently in specialized facilities.
Unlock evolutionary paths by meeting happiness, experience, and resource requirements.
Discover unique abilities that impact your city and competitions, from energy-efficient Wildlings to rare, high-value species.
🏆 Compete in Thrilling Leagues & Stadiums
Build and upgrade stadiums to host various sports-like Wildling competitions.
Train your Wildlings for different battle formats, from casual 1v1 duels to high-stakes 5v5 league matches.
Manage your city's reputation through victories, attracting stronger tamers and elite Wildlings.
🤝 Catch, Recruit & Bond with Tamers
Attract Wildlings to your city by fulfilling their needs and offering valuable resources.
Assign tamers to Wildlings, forming bonds that enhance their battle and work performance.
Maintain your city's reputation to bring in skilled tamers with powerful perks.
🌍 A Dynamic & Evolving World
Each territory features different environmental influences, affecting which Wildlings can thrive.
Special Cthulhu-inspired events introduce unexpected challenges and rewards.
No traditional tech tree—unlock new buildings based on the Wildlings you’ve recruited!

title: Et le grain mourut
description:
게임 정보
192X. As summer draws near, Parisian students are revising their end-of-year exams. Olivier is one of them. For years, he has been walking to school every morning with his dearest childhood friend, and has unwound with his artistic peers after class. In a week, this routine will come to a close. And recent revelations already threaten Olivier’s comfortable life.
This game is currently in development. Current graphics do not reflect the final result. The game will release simultaneously in both English and French.
Features
3 routes and a half, with various choices that may or may not have consequences
70k word count (around 25k/30k words per route)
25 items and 21 character portraits to collect, and achievements to unlock!
Historical urban fantasy of the angel variety...?

title: The Mystery of Doomsday Valley
description:
게임 정보
Doomsday Valley is a mystery point-and-click adventure game designed to appeal to both experienced players and newcomers alike.
You are Maya Harper: a quirky journalist working for Bizarre Bulletin, specialising in the unexplainable. Videos about haunted buildings, faith healing and urban legends has made you and your platform an internet sensation. Always on the prowl for exciting new rumours, you decide to make Doomsday Valley your next big scoop. There is always something to find if you dig deep enough.

title: Saltwater Bodies
description:
게임 정보
Saltwater Bodies is a cave-diving body horror game.
Explore underwater cave systems beneath a salt flat, and nurture an unnatural vessel away from prying eyes.
Features a physics-based caving system where you have to be mindful of positioning your body parts, and balance that against holding your breath underwater - Is it worth breathing out precious air to squeeze through a smaller gap?
Outside of underwater caves you can socialize with co-workers and perform arcane experiments to construct yourself a new vessel. A branching narrative that depends on how you balance your day job and your more supernatural contracts...
The game uses a retro style with vertex wobble and a lowered resolution. These can be adjusted in the settings if it's not your jam!

title: Fox in the 20th Century
description:
게임 정보
Assume the role of Fox, the laser-blading alien from the HPP (Human Protection Program), and travel back in time, battling the Y2Krew across the ten decades of the 20th century, to save the human race and ultimately battle the Y2K Bug on New Year's Eve, 1999!


- Fast paced action platforming.
- Linear and obstacle-focused level design.
- Over 30 unique levels with their own themes, graphics, enemies and play features!
- New crazy gimmicks and tricks introduced constantly.

- Run, jump, wall-run, and rail grind your way through the years!
- Master Fox's signature attack moves - the Air Sweep, a weak, yet fast and more evasive approach, or the Fox Trot, a powerful combo attack that serves as the slower yet higher damage option.

- Over 100 different characters, enemies, and bosses all with wacky personalities brought to life through hand animation.
- Hundreds of references and homages to fashion, pop culture, leisurely activities, and trends from all the decades of the 1900s, including parody enemies, voice clips, background items, and more! It's a celebration of fun!
- Fully hand drawn graphics and animation for everything in the game!

- Get fun (and sometimes helpful) commentary from Fox's buddies, Sloth and Raven, throughout your adventure. It's like you're always playing with friends! And if the abundance of voices aren't for you, you can just switch it off.
- All characters and enemies brought to life by talented voice actors!
- No gameplay is interrupted or broken up by dialogue scenes. All speaking is short, sweet, and happening while you play!
- A varied soundtrack representing loads of popular music styles from over the course of 100 years!

title: MOKI - The Escape
description:
게임 정보
Moki wakes up in a strange environment. The only memory: their own name. A peaceful world... or is it?! Join Moki in a challenging 2.5D jump & run platformer with many puzzles. Meet lovable and sometimes oddball characters and experience a unique and emotional story.
"Streak"
Moki has a very special ability: "streaking" (short-range teleportation). Even through organic matter like wood or plants, Moki can "streak" and thus solve puzzles and enter places that other beings are hardly able to reach.
Explore
Explore a diverse game world and find out what this seemingly peaceful environment is really all about. Is there perhaps more behind the visible facade? Why are you here in the first place? Why do you only remember your own name "Moki" and who the hell are all these other strange creatures you meet on your journey? Explore and find out!
Collect
Find treasures, items and boosters in the game world. Some of them will help you progress, others will give you special abilities, and still others will just make you happy when you find them.
Push through
Moki doesn't have strong muscles and doesn't like to hurt anyone. But sometimes you'll get into difficult situations. Help Moki overcome it. There are often puzzles to solve but also one or another adversary that might stand in Moki's way.
Info about the development
MOKI - The Escape is the first game development of studio VAMPIRE - Digital Media (Software House Markus Hermann). Only two people are involved in the project. An indispensable part of the atmosphere of MOKI - The Escape is the fantastic music produced by Jakob Wiersch, the artist who exclusively composes and creates the soundtrack for the game.

title: Killbot General
description:
게임 정보
A concentrate of tactical decisions. No need to spend 30 minutes setting up in the beginning, or an hour at the end cleaning up the map. Get your strategy fix with satisfying 5-minute battles that focus on tactical decisions, not micromanagement or actions per minute.
Your personality and choices matter! Discover the unique, irreverent universe of the Killbots as you choose your own path in the dynamic branching storylines, where your choices as well as your successes affect the outcome.
Even bring one or two friends and forge the unique story of your alliance together!
Like pieces on a chess board, gameplay is accessible (and controller-friendly!) yet deep, involving light resource management, multiple unit types, strategic strikes and terrain evaluation. Speaking of which...
In Killbot General, the high ground (and other terrain features) matters. This means every procedural map presents a unique challenge for you to ponder and adapt to.
Fight for (and against!) any faction you wish to create! Create everything starting from the name, leader, what it's fighting for and its motto; even import your own PNG image and put what you want on the flag.

title: Shroomwood
description:
게임 정보
Play as Shroomie, a curious little mushroom navigating the ever-changing wilderness of Shroomwood. This top-down 2D roguelike adventure blends fast-paced combat with dynamic dungeon exploration. Each run through the Shroomwood forest offers new challenges, randomized rooms, and a host of peculiar creatures from classical slimes to zombie-infested mushrooms. Discover powerful weapons, stack unique modifiers, and uncover the secrets hidden within vibrant and unique biomes.
Enter the Shroomwood
In Shroomwood, no two journeys are the same. The forest rearranges itself with every playthrough, offering fresh combinations of handcrafted rooms connected by a procedurally-generated dungeon layout. Equip diverse weapons, enhance them with random modifications, and face off against magical foes in your quest to survive the wild,  remaining alert of the dangers lurking around every corner.
High-Paced Action
We blended the shooting mechanics of traditional roguelikes such as Enter the Gungeon and Binding of Isaac with a brand new melee system to create a roguelike that put a creative spin on the classic tried-and-true formula! There are more bullets, more enemies, more death, and more fun.
Upgrade your Arsenal

title: Night Mafia
description:
게임 정보
Night Mafia: Immerse Yourself in the World of a Thrilling TV Show
Game Description:
"Night Mafia" is a unique multiplayer game that will make you lie to your friends and doubt their words. Even your closest ally may turn out to be the mafia, and only your deduction skills can reveal the traitor hiding among you.
Lore:
On the brink of poverty, you couldn’t pay off your debts, leaving you with no choice but to participate in the terrifying "Night Mafia" show, which might be your only way out. But everything comes at a price.




Gameplay:
Every day you survive is simply luck that you haven’t been betrayed by friends or killed by the mafia. Your victory depends solely on you, but without others' trust, it will be hard to succeed alone.
In Night Mafia, each day, each action, and each choice impacts the game’s final outcome. The game consists of three sessions, each serving as a key to your survival or demise.
Day Session
The game begins during the day. Your goal is to locate vending machines on the map, obtain items from them, and participate in mini-games scattered around the area. The mini-games are diverse: some require teamwork, while others can be completed alone. The more challenging the mini-game and the better you perform, the more valuable the reward. Time management is crucial for success during the day. If you don’t obtain the necessary items before the session ends, it could lead to fatal consequences, as surviving the night without protection will be tough. Your responsibilities also vary depending on the role assigned to you, but the main goal for each resident remains the same: prepare for the night.

title: Citizen Life
description:
게임 정보
Citizen Life is an upcoming Open World City Life Simulator driven by engaging NPCs and complex game mechanics. Begin your adventure in a new town full of opportunities.

Get a job: Become a carrot farmer, patrol the streets as a police officer, save lives as a doctor or sell a cars at a dealership. There are more than 30 pre-defined jobs available.
Unique Artificial Intelligence: NPCs are persistent, procedurally generated and follow daily routines, work jobs, engage socially with others and perform leisure activities. Everything they do, and the way you interact with them, has an actual impact on the town.
Build a business: Whether it‘s a small book store or a major manufacturing corporation, if you have enough investment you can do it. Hire employees and set their task schedules, buy, manufacture and sell goods & services, create production lines, market your products and build business relationships.
Develop skills and knowledge: There are different fields of expertise you can expand on to unlock new abilities, crafting recipees or improve the quality & efficiency of your work. You can increase your skills and knowledge by practicing tasks, reading books or getting taught by someone more knowleadgable.
Break the law: Become a criminal by robbing others, burglarizing houses and selling or manufacturing illegal goods like drugs or weapons. But make sure to hide from law enforcement by concealing your identity, getting rid of evidence and eliminating witnesses.
Interact socially with NPCs: Use the social interaction menu to talk with NPCs. Make a good impression and build trust by being friendly, keeping good hygiene and wearing proper clothing.
Enter politics: Start your political career by running for council or mayor. Represent certain interest groups on different issues in your election campaign in order to garner votes and donations. As a poltician you will have influence on the town‘s laws, tax rates, spending and appointment of the heads of powerful institutional positions.
Be ready for combat: You can prepare yourself for an altercation with another NPC by buying firearms, ammunition, explosives, melee weapons, body armor and by increasing your melee combat, range combat and agility skill level.
Gather resources: Apply for a job as a miner to mine different ores and rock types. Start your own cattle or crop farm and sell your produce to wholesale companies. Work as a lumberjack by cutting trees and turning the logs into different types of planks at a sawmill. Catch fish with a fishing rod or a fishing boat. Hunt wild animals for fur and meat or forage for berries and mushrooms.

title: Elder Magic Squad
description:
게임 정보
Elder Magic Squad is an adventure game with FPS, Roguelite, and magical content. Players control an old wizard who learns a variety of magic and can experience different growth and gameplay, as well as adventures using randomly dropped magic.
The game can be played single-player or in co-op with up to four other players.
Each fresh start creates a completely new experience. Choose from a variety of heroes' abilities, magic, and skills to enjoy battles.
Translated with (free version)

title: Never Stop Gaming - An EPIC Video Game Store Simulation
description:
게임 정보
You and your friends open and manage a video game store in a mall during the mid 90s. Sell games, expand your store, host midnight sales and VIP visits and grow your store to become the geeky superstore of your dreams!
Never Stop Gaming is a love letter to the video game stores we grew up in, and the wild characters that made these stores so special. At its core, Never Stop Gaming is a cozy 4 player co-op business simulation: Order games and consoles, place them on shelves and sell them to customers. As your store becomes more successful, expand it to include additional sections for merchandise, tabletop games, card games and a LAN Party section.
While operating the store, you will perform hilarious missions, host VIP visits and get involved in the life of customers who love video games more than you. Just kidding, we know that’s not possible.
This game is in early development. More information coming soon :)
autokwd: Never Stop Gaming - An EPIC Video Game Store Simulation

title: Take off mask
description:
게임 정보

'가면을 벗다'는 여러 캐릭터들로 구성된 대규모 파티를 운용하며 신비의 세계 '다리안'의 곳곳을 탐험하는 게임입니다. 새로운 동료와 만나고, 불의의 적들과 싸우고, 숨겨진 보물을 찾으며 '북쪽의 악마'를 향해 진군해 나가야 합니다.

플레이어가 조작할 기본 캐릭터는 가면을 쓰고 있으며 이 세계의 불청객입니다. 말이 통하지 않는 이 세계의 주민들과의 소통을 도와줄 '가면'만이 유일하게 의지할만한 점입니다. '가면'은 그 힘으로 주변인들의 감정을 정확히 캐치해 정보를 주게 됩니다. 여러분은 이를 보고 상황을 나름대로 파악하여 여러분만의 선택을 통해 이야기를 이끌어 나가게 됩니다.

수많은 캐릭터들이 각자의 소속, 종족, 가치관에 따라 싸우고, 연계하고, 맺어집니다. 여러분의 선택을 기다리는 동료들은 많이 있지만 한 번에 모든 이들을 동료로 맞이하는 것은 불가능에 가깝죠. 때로는 특징없는 자코 캐릭터들로 남은 빈 자리를 채워야 할지도 모릅니다. 하지만 그 조차도 고유한 선택의 한 갈래로서 재미를 느끼게 해줄 것입니다.

'가면을 벗다'는 몰입감 높은 플레이 경험을 위해 로딩이나 컷신 등에 의해 조작이 중단되는 상황을 최대한 없애는 다소 실험적인 시스템을 추구합니다. 16x16 타일 사이즈의 맵은 백그라운드로 로딩되고, 각 지역의 이야기는 멈춤 없이 벌어지는 이벤트를 통해 접하게 됩니다.

언뜻 복잡해 보이는 화면이지만, 한 번에 하나의 캐릭터만을 조작하며 카메라가 조작중인 캐릭터를 쫒아다니기 때문에, 막상 실제 조작을 해보면 생각보다 쉬운 플레이 감각을 느낄 수 있습니다. 또한 RTS나 시뮬레이션 게임이 아니기 때문에 키보드와 게임 패드를 이용해서도 원활한 플레이가 가능하기 때문에 어렵지 않게 플레이해 나갈 수 있습니다.

title: Lady Death Demonicron
description:
게임 정보
Lady Death: Demonicron is an all new side-scrolling, sword-slicing, magic-wielding, 15 level, multiplayer beat-em-up that takes the best aspects of the 90's arcade classics. A little bit of Streets of Rage, a pinch of Golden Axe and a dash of Mortal Kombat - all mixed together with a killer 90's industrial-metal soundtrack.

All Lady Death wants is to mourn a fallen friend in peace. Then in infernal portal rips open and a throng of demon scum storms the cemetary gates. Little does Lady Death know, the most brutal battle of her undead life has just begun.

Malevolent forces tear Lady Death from one realm to another... From the stinking pits of Hell, to an undead heavy metal festival, to a demonic dinosaur catastrophe, to a cannibalistic, industrial nightmare. Through it all, one true ally stands at her side: Ravenheart, a haunted warrior armed with a savage sword and the touch of death, but will even his strength be enough?

title: Disc Creatures WORLD
description:
게임 정보
"Disc creatures WORLD" is a monster taming RPG featuring over 300 unique creatures! Build your party from the creatures you befriend to battle against those who stand in your way! Discover stories featuring creatures and humans alike!
Welcome to a world where humans and creatures coexist, for better and for worse. Sometimes they work together in harmony, but other times they clash from their differences.
Amid this coexistence, humans developed a groundbreaking technology called "Discs". These discs record a creature’s data, allowing new creatures with identical abilities to be created. Those who master the use of Discs, known as Disc Rangers—"DiscRs" for short—work alongside creatures to solve a wide variety of challenges.
Now it’s your turn to enter the world of a DiscR. Exciting adventures, challenging encounters, and strange creatures await you!
Over 300 unique creatures to befriend!
Adventure with your party by your side! Enjoy the companion system that lets your favorite creatures follow you.
Engage in strategic 3-on-3 battles! Use shared Energy Points to unleash moves!

title: The Forgotten Rooms
description:
게임 정보
현실이 사라지면 무엇이 남을까?
눈을 뜨자, 당신은 이상하고 버려진 구조물 안에 있다는 것을 깨닫습니다. 고요함은 으스스하고, 빛은 깜빡거리고, 벽은 허무한 느낌을 풍긴다. 당신은 여기서 나가야 합니다... 하지만 누군가 당신을 지켜보고 있습니다.
Forgotten Rooms는 심리적 공포와 생존 요소를 결합한 게임으로, 플레이어를 미지의 세계로 끌어들입니다. 현실과 환각의 경계가 점점 얇아지면서 당신은 어둠과 외로움, 그리고 당신을 쫓는 존재들에 맞서 싸워야 하며, 출구를 찾으려고 노력하면서 정신 건강을 유지해야 합니다.
주요 기능:
* 어둠과의 싸움: 손전등은 당신의 유일한 친구이지만, 배터리가 죽기 전에 현명하게 사용해야 합니다.
* 퍼즐과 탈출: 지혜를 사용하여 문을 열고 비밀 통로를 발견하여 출구에 도달하세요.
* 심리적 공포 요소: 실제인가 상상인가? 당신은 보는 것을 얼마나 신뢰할 수 있나요?
* 현실을 왜곡하는 호텔: 게임이 진행되면서, 익숙해 보이지만 똑같이 불안한 호텔에서 길을 잃습니다.
여기서 나갈 방법이 있나요? 아니면 떠나고 싶지 않은 무언가를 발견하게 될까요?

title: Spellsided
description:
게임 정보
Spellsided is a turn-based single-player RPG that comes with a new, puzzling twist on deck-builders - it’s a dice-builder!
Join our Discord community and follow us on YouTube via the links in the sidebar to stay up to date with development!
DISCOVER SPELLS
Play as a fully-customisable magical die named Hex, who has been discarded by the Gods of the Tabletop. Cast your spells with every step as you navigate a fantasy world of toppling dominoes, warring chess pieces, and conniving cards.

title: ProtoZED
description:
게임 정보


프로젝트 좀보이드(Project Zomboid), 림월드(RimWorld), 제로 시버트(Zero Sievert) 및 타르코프에서 영감을 받은 이 탑다운 추출 슈팅 게임에서는 프로시저 생성된 동네를 탐험하고 은밀하게 움직여서 약탈을 할 수 있습니다.
실시간으로 수백 마리의 좀비!
그리드 기반 인벤토리 시스템


DEV STREAMS를 보러 저의 트위치를 팔로우하거나 업데이트를 위해 YT를 구독해주세요!

프로젝트 좀보이드, 타르코프에서의 탈출, 제로 시버트와 같은 게임에서 수천 시간을 투자하며, 이들 게임에서 가장 흥미로운 요소를 가져온 타이틀을 몇 년 동안 개발하고 영감을 받아왔습니다. 이 프로젝트는 2021년 초부터 진행 중입니다.

title: Saltwater Bodies
description:
게임 정보
Saltwater Bodies is a cave-diving body horror game.
Explore underwater cave systems beneath a salt flat, and nurture an unnatural vessel away from prying eyes.
Features a physics-based caving system where you have to be mindful of positioning your body parts, and balance that against holding your breath underwater - Is it worth breathing out precious air to squeeze through a smaller gap?
Outside of underwater caves you can socialize with co-workers and perform arcane experiments to construct yourself a new vessel. A branching narrative that depends on how you balance your day job and your more supernatural contracts...
The game uses a retro style with vertex wobble and a lowered resolution. These can be adjusted in the settings if it's not your jam!

title: Final Absolution
description:
게임 정보
Story
This was supposed to be a simple union-busting job: Get in. Rough up some slackers. Take out a few commies. Get out. Get paid. Easy money. But something’s gone terribly wrong.
PATHOS has gone rogue. It won’t let me leave this godforsaken rock. All systems are down. The colonists are missing. Something horrific has happened here...
The Game
Final Absolution is a survival-horror first-person shooter from the creators of Beyond Sunset. It offers a more tightly focused, slower-paced experience with a strong emphasis on atmosphere and tension.
Features
Retro Nintendo 64-inspired graphics, powered by GZDoom
Methodically paced survival-horror gameplay
Arsenal of 10 unique weapons with alternate fire modes
18 distinct maps
Original ambient soundtrack by Karl Vincent

title: Cozy Beach
description:
게임 정보
고양이 친구들과 함께 아늑한 열대 섬을 탐험할 수 있는 아늑한 해변에 오신 것을 환영합니다!
😸 사랑스러운 아바타를 커스터마이징하고 다양한 스타일 옵션으로 꾸밀 수 있습니다.
🎣 낚시하러 가서 모든 물고기를 모아보세요 - 몇몇은 몇 명의 플레이어가 필요할 수도 있습니다!
🔎 보물 지도를 발견하고 보물을 찾으세요 - 어떤 멋진 것들을 찾을 수 있을까요?
🍍 친절한 카피바라 바키프에서 과일을 모아 재미있고 우스꽝스러운 열대 음료를 만들어보세요 - 재료가 희귀할수록 음료는 더욱 이국적입니다!
⭕ 아름다운 열대 섬 주변의 게으른 강에서 물놀이를 즐기세요.
🎶 라디오에서 감미로운 멜로디를 즐겨보세요!
물론 친구들과 어울리고 대화를 나누지 않으면 해변에서의 하루가 완성되는 날은 없습니다. 👯
아늑한 해변은 현지에서 협동 플레이를 하거나 친구들과 온라인으로 플레이할 수 있습니다.
다른 플레이어와 함께 100% 완료를 달성하세요!

title: Sunblade
description:
게임 정보
Sunblade is an adaptation the tabletop game The 9th Age: Fantasy Battle.
Build armies from a variety of races, units, monsters and heroes; and let them loose on the battlefield ! Overcome your foes with an in-depth turn-based combat system. Make use of the complex cover and line of sight system, various terrains to encircle, ambush or outflank the enemy in order to setup devastating charges, or crushing salvoes and size the advantage by using your strengths and covering your weaknesses. Unleash devastating barrages of damage spells, protect or enhance your allies, or curse your enemies engaging in a duel of minds for magical supremacy ! Manage the discipline of your soldiers, or wage a terror war with your enemy to instill fear and disarray in its battleline !

title: Within
description:
게임 정보
Within is a first-person game where you have to solve puzzles in grim locations. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of mystery and danger as you unravel a crime and fight against a villain. But the further you progress, the more you realize that you yourself are becoming the victim...

YOU JUST NEED TO KEEP GOING

Don't give up. The only one you can rely on is yourself. In a world where every step brings you closer to the truth, but also to danger.

THE COST OF A MISTAKE IS TOO HIGH
In a game where every step is a struggle for survival, any mistake can be fatal. As you solve puzzles and fight for your life, you realize that the cost of a mistake is not just defeat, but life itself.

STAY ON THE PATH

You are the only one who can complete this journey. Don't give up, keep moving forward, because only you can reach the truth and escape the dangers that lurk around every corner.

title: Brush Burial 2
description:
게임 정보
Caught in the mulching churn of a frontier world, Fennel, a devil flung far from home, cuts out a living from the cities and towns at the edge of the earth.
Master a suite of unique combat and movement techniques through use of your forked tail. Lose your way in the slithering guts of the colonial undercarriage. Make wealth out of misery.

Brush Burial 2 is an immersive sim with sanguine and spirited systemic gameplay. Your goal, be it a corpse to make or a coffer to clear, is yours to accomplish as you see fit.
Features:
Sprawling, interconnected levels with countless paths to the objective, full of hostile or friendly NPCs who react to crimes like stealing, trespassing, and murder.
Fast paced, instantaneous combat that is simple but robust, encouraging the use of improvised weapons, environmental objects, and a unique hand-to-hand takedown system.
Dozens of unique cosmetics to be unlocked through gameplay challenges, as well as progression through the game's main story.
A suite of rogues and rough riders to befriend and betray along your way.

title: The Boo Croo
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to The Boo Croo! Pick your Boo and participate in a variety of zany 4-player minigames!

--Coopetitive--
Play each minigame how you want! Team up with your friends or turn on them. Each minigame can be won by all players... but each can be lost by all players too!

--Customization--
Unlock new outfits and accessories through gameplay to customize your Boo's appearance. Why not be a doctor with a cowboy hat?

--Local & Online Play--
Play with your friends either locally offline or online! You can even mix local players with online players.

title: Chemist Wanted
description:
게임 정보
“Chemist Wanted” 에서 제작은 단순히 몇 가지 재료를 모으고 “제작”을 클릭하는 것이 아닙니다. 화합물을 만들려면 다양한 재료와 공정을 결합하여 원하는 결과를 얻어야 합니다. 여기에는 반응, 용해, 침전, 추출, 증발, 여과 또는 심지어 이 모든 과정이 포함될 수 있습니다. 최상의 조합을 찾으려면 많은 실험을 수행하고 지식을 쌓아야 합니다. 당신이 충분히 기술을 갖고 있다면, 당신만의 한적한 열대 섬에서 조기 퇴직을 위한 충분한 돈을 벌 수 있을 것입니다!

특징:
고부가가치 물질 합성을 위한 현실적인 화학 기반 시스템입니다
다양한 출발 물질 및 합성 단계로 인해 올바른 경로를 밝히기 위해서는 세심한 연구가 필요합니다
화학과 다양한 프로세스 사용 방법을 가르쳐 주는 비디오 라이브러리에 연결된 새로운 기술을 점진적으로 잠금 해제하세요
누구 밑에서 일하기로 선택했는지에 따라 흥미로운 스토리라인이 펼쳐집니다
빠른 속도로 발전하는 기술 스타트업, 거대 기업, 수상한 마약상, 아니면 그냥 자신을 위한 회사입니다! 모든 장비, 화학 물질 재고, 제품 재고, 카탈로그된 반응, 측정된 특성 등을 관리할 수 있는 사용하기 쉽고 직관적인 UI입니다
화학 기술을 마스터하려는 사람들에게는 점점 더 어려워지는 과제입니다

화학물질을 자유롭게 실험해 보세요
반응기를 설정하고 두 개의 출발 물질을 추가한 후 무슨 일이 일어나는지 확인하세요! 액체와 고체를 결합하여 용액을 만들고, 용매와 이온 교환을 사용하여 특정 성분을 분리하고, 혼합물을 증발시켜 침전을 유도하는 등 가능성은 사실상 무한합니다.

자신만의 방식으로 플레이하세요
당신의 선택에 따라 게임 경험이 달라집니다. 기업에 근무하면 배송 목표를 엄격하게 정하고 배송 지연에 따른 처벌을 가하지만 급여는 괜찮은 편이다. 범죄 조직과 협력하면 절도나 그보다 더 나쁜 표적이 될 수 있지만 급여는 엄청날 수 있습니다. 또는 실험하고 자신만의 길을 찾으세요.

실제 화학적 변형을 배우세요
연구를 통해 다양한 프로세스를 사용할 수 있는 능력을 확보하세요. 원자 수준의 고유한 시각적 요소로 각 개념을 명확하게 설명하는 상세한 라이브러리를 살펴보세요. 이러한 기술을 이해하면 원하는 결과를 효과적으로 달성하기 위해 언제 적용해야 하는지 알 수 있습니다.

복잡성 증가
최고 가치의 제품을 생산하려면 다양한 기술을 사용하여 여러 가지 출발 물질을 결합해야 합니다. 가능한 조합의 수를 수천 개로 늘리면 게임이 점점 더 어려워집니다! 속성과 상호 작용은 재생 가능성을 최대화하기 위해 절차적으로 생성됩니다.

현재로서는 게임을 한국어로 번역할 계획이 없습니다.

title: Dominova
description:
게임 정보
전략적인 도미노 배치
도미노 네트워크를 확장하여 가능한 최고의 점수를 달성하세요. 우주적 평면을 펼치고 경로를 최적화하여 최대한 많은 자원을 모으세요.
우주적 평면 관리
도미노 네트워크가 커질수록 더 취약해집니다. 각 턴마다 평면이 바뀌므로, 승리를 위해 즉흥적으로 대처해야 합니다.
자원 관리
현금을 모으고 덱을 업그레이드하며, Nova 카드를 구매해 독특한 시너지와 전략적 다양성을 창출하세요.

title: Heretic Red
description:
게임 정보
Unravel the Darkness that Haunts Sermont
You are Pasha, a devoted monk raised in the faith of the great Seraph, guardian of these lands. Now, at the threshold of completing your sacred training, you are sent to the remote, near-ruined village of Sermont, nestled high in the unforgiving mountains.
What begins as a simple mission to soothe the villagers' religious fears soon turns to horror. Brutal, merciless murders stain the snow with blood. Those you befriend will be lost, and with each passing night, fear and suspicion will begin to storm around you. Will you uncover the truth before Sermont is beyond saving?
A Story-Rich Journey of Deception and Doubt
Each act of the game blends narrative-driven storytelling with intricate murder investigations. Between uncovering dark secrets, you will have time to build bonds with the villagers, choose how to spend your days, and progress through the unfolding fate of Sermont.
Unravel the Truth with Evidence Cards
At each crime scene, you will gather evidence cards, chronicling your findings. By combining clues, you will piece together smaller mysteries, leading you ever closer to the true killer. When the time comes, you must name the murderer and cast them into exile. But will your judgment be just? The fate of the innocent lies in your hands.

title: Glutton
description:
게임 정보
Glutton - a game that tells us about a creature brought to earth on a meteorite. The game begins with the level of atoms and ends with the scale of the planet, our creature as it grows acquires new skills for more effective absorption of biomass, and protection from the dangers that wait for it at every step.
Game Features

Ability to upgrade the main character for genome points, which gives him not only new skills or improves existing ones, but also changes his appearance!
5 unique abilities that open up as you progress through the game, which can be upgrade!
As you progress through the main character will evolve, which will also be display on his appearance!
40 eventful levels in 8 different biomes (you will visit the level of atoms, unicellular organisms, microorganisms, marine animals, insects, people and cities, and so on until you reach the scale of the planet).
Levels both on land and in liquids! Depending on this, the control of the character changes!
System of small missions to diversify the gameplay with different missions on the levels!
At the end of the block of levels, you will find a boss ready to challenge you!
A variety enemies!
System of passing levels by the number of stars, the better you pass them – the easier it will be to go further, because for they open up improvements for skills!

title: see you: a brief exile
description:
게임 정보
a teenager lived a normal life, was send to a strange lonely world by mystery power. is it possible to get back to where he came from?
search and discover:
speak with distinguished characters, gradually find out how this world work and how to get out of this place.
step by step mission:
catch up with one character, get more complicated mission.
recover mystery:
think and make decision, is what you must do for the sake of getting back.
qte:
various and lively interaction? once you manipulate well, no problem.
map design:
feel free to get to wherever you want, up to mountain, into forest or go underground, etc. if stuck, try to figure out right time or find corresponding key.
hidden factor:
collect scattered information fractions, which you can put together and get one touching story.

title: Nether Spirits: Beyond the Gate
description:
게임 정보
Death is not the end. But the Nether may be yours.
You have died. Your soul, battered, bruised and shattered into pieces, awakes in the Nether, a vast land consumed and transformed by sin and inhabited by spirits and monsters alike. Your only solace: the beam of blue light right in the center of the Nether, said to make whoever reaches it whole again. To make it, you’ll have to build a powerful deck, fight, explore, outwit and barter - and piece yourself together bit by bit.
New strategic depths
Plan ahead with the timeline, a unique concept in the deckbuilding genre. Queue your cards to create new combinations, unleash a rapid onslaught of attacks all at once, or modify cards you’ve already placed in the timeline.
Change your active sin as you please, feed the different aspects of your soul and experiment with distinct play styles. Do you keep yourself in balance or will you let one sin dwarf all others? Reign with Pride, outwit with Envy, conquer with Wrath, devour with Gluttony - the possibilities are endless.
Team up with a friend or stranger to support each other and increase your chance of victory, or challenge other players to a duel, testing the full potential of your deck. Play in PvE, co-op, 1v1 or 2v2 PvP mode - anytime, anywhere.
Travel the vast expanse of the Nether and discover its dark history. Explore age-old ruins in search of lore and treasure, meet compelling characters and help them on their way, or venture into hostile forests thick with fog and mystery - there is no wrong path, only your own.

title: No Vacation  an Executioner
description:
게임 정보
About
It's a story about a frustrated executioner in late 17th century. He felt sick at his job and ran away from the gallows. It aroused a riot of monsters, he had to clean up this cruel mess, and find out the truth about the "Gloomy Oil" of this crazy world.
It's a Retro PS2 style Survival Horror Action-RPG, you will use various skill to survive, beat your enemy and explore forward.
Inspired by the Book : The Hangman of Paris by Claude Cueni, and the Paintings of Zdzisław Beksiński. (But it's a story nothing about any Sanson family)
About the Control
Recommended to use gamepad such as Xbox controler or PS DualShock. Keyboard players can also use Arrow Keys to control the camera. If using mouse, please trigger the "Use mouse" option at "Config" menu.
(It's a retro PS2 style, slow action battle system for the survival mechanic and for crafting a better atmosphere, not a "quick-action game". Please notice before purchasing.)

title: Keepers of the Keep
description:
게임 정보
STORY
You play as Monet or Vincent, thieves who have found themselves in a sour predicament.
You work at the Hutch & Go shop within The Keep, a new town you have found yourself living in, working off your debts while earning some coin on the side. While this is not the life you envisioned for yourself, your own actions have landed you here.
The Keep is bustling with unique citizens, including six Keepers (short of "shopkeepers"): Elgin, a quiet giantkin and local butcher. Hylda, a flirtatious pixie and owner of Little Grove Construction. Valentine, a rocker harpy and lead vocalist for The Harpy Ladies. Daiba, a friendly oni and café owner. Mango, an upbeat pyka who runs the Keep's recycling center. And Vanitas, a grouchy elf and brilliant ritualist.
Meet and mingle with these six keepers, among many, many others as you work your day job, shop around this new town, and go questing with the help of these new strangers. Make a new life for yourself in the Keep, all while slowly uncovering the tensions brewing deep within the town's surface.

title: Chemical-Burn
description:
게임 정보
WELCOME, WELCOME TO HAZARD CITY
Chemical-Burn is a first person shooter action-adventure set in Hazard City—one of the last few cities on Earth, where the remaining human populations have been placed.  Engage in thrilling first person combat using a variety of weapons and your dog Buddy. 
KEY FEATURES
Satisfying First Person Combat - get ready to engage in fast paced and responsive first person combat with a variety of weapons and against many unique enemies
Powerful Arsenal of Weapons - Cindy will have her hands full with a variety of weapons from a Halligan Bar when at close range to a silenced MP7, she is ready to blow away anyone in her way

title: Hardshell
description:
게임 정보
Take control of a powerful mech, scavenge for different weapons and upgrades, and complete missions to help the last humans recover from the AI apocalypse in this top-down real-time tactical action-roguelite.

title: Frontier Control : Invasion
description:
게임 정보
Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy defense game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.
Each unit can be a hero
Every unit gains experience and levels up while in combat, unlocking access to passive and active abilities according to their current weapon and armor suit.
Flexible playstyle
There are only 2 units you can train in the game, Agents and Specialists.
However each unit can be equiped with a unique weapon and armor suit, each of those influencing the unit stats and abilities. There are 8 different weapons and 8 different armor suits, making for a total of 64 possible different combinations.
Tower Defense x RTS
While the game is played as a classic Real-Time Strategy game, there are 8 different turrets you can build in your base, each of one that can be leveled up twice. Weather you prefer focusing on efficient simcity and static defenses or training your entire colony into an army and not using any turrets, both can work.
Fully destructible map
Every single object on the map can be destroyed or used as a cover for your units like cars or appartments. As the game progresses, the city will get more and more damaged by enemy drops and new routes will be taken by enemy herds to attack your base.

title: Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail
description:
게임 정보
In Jordi & Oslo and the Lost Tail, Oslo the Dragon has gone missing. You impersonate two characters, Jordi and Sígrid, as they try to piece together who is behind their friend’s mysterious disappearance. In this humorous point-and-click adventure, you solve smart puzzles, crack punch lines, and explore beautiful watercolour-painted locations inspired by the Spanish countryside.

Get priority-mailed out of your home, beat an indefense wooden log, and discover off-limit underground facilities. Then, find your way out to a charming rural village full of quirky characters, lovely animals, and obsolete technology. Cozy banter, hot chocolate, and fussball challenges await you!
Jordi and Oslo and the lost tail is a 5x game:

Exchange items between Jordi and Sígrid’s inventories, explore lovely homely locations, explode untidy rooms, examine clues until the characters say something funny,  and expose a shady plan to gain magical powers.
A comic blend:

The video game is based on the ‘Jordi and Oslo’ comic strips that feature in the Spanish local newspaper, Segre, and it is entirely hand-drawn and hand-animated by their author, JoveGuille. The videogame mixes the whimsical 1990s point-and-click adventures style with the playful art and the dialogue style of the comic strips.

title: Just A Shadow Game
description:
게임 정보
네가 감히 내 영역에 들어오겠다고? 그렇다면, 게임 마스터인 나, 섀도우의 감시 아래 궁극의 의식 마스터로서 올라설 준비를 하라! 약한 자들이 너의 비전한 힘 앞에서 굴복하는 모습을 지켜보라. 너는 상상할 수 없는 공포의 주문을 짜고, 무(無)에서 죽은 자들을 소환하며, 자연의 법칙을 무시하는 방어를 구축하게 될 것이다!

너의 통치의 핵심 요소:
• 의식 덱 빌딩: 부패한 건물과 금지된 주문을 마치 용이 금을 모으듯이 쌓아라. 너의 타락의 깊이를 반영하는 덱을 만들어, 너에게 감히 반대하는 어리석은 자들에게 혼돈을 퍼부어라.
• 악몽의 의식 결투: 네 희생물을 둘러싼 탑을 세워라. 가장 용감한 영웅조차도 눈물을 흘리게 만들고, 신성하지 않은 성역 사이의 결투에서 너를 돕기 위해 모독적인 의식을 통해 흉물들을 소환하라. 악마와 같은 정밀도로 그들을 배치하여, 고통에 허덕이는 이단자들의 파도를 부수며, 그들의 희생물을 네 신성하지 않은 공격으로 폭격하라.
• 죽음은 단지 스승일 뿐: 넘어져도 다시 일어나라, 더욱 강해져라! 각 패배는 네 뒤틀린 진화를 촉진한다. 신성 모독적인 지식을 모으고, 점점 더 강력한 카드를 해제하며, 사악한 건물을 건설하고, 너의 어두운 선물을 강화하라.
• 어둠에 잠긴 세계: 빛이 발을 들이기를 두려워하는 영역에 몰입하라. 이 저주받은 땅의 비밀을 파헤쳐라. 지식이야말로 궁극의 지배로 가는 열쇠이다. 너의 힘의 상승은 나, 섀도우의 비꼬는 서사를 통해 전개되며, 기괴하고도 매혹적인 일러스트레이션과 함께 네 나약한 마음에 새겨질 것이다.

자, 떨고 있는 인간이여, 이 힘을 잡을 용기가 있는가? 네가 이전의 많은 자들처럼 무너질 것인가, 아니면 유일하고 진정한 섀도의 지배자로서 일어설 것인가? 네 공포의 통치는 네가 이 악마적인 도전을 받아들이는 순간부터 시작된다. 선택은 네 것이다... 그 선택을 할 용기가 있다면!

title: Solar Voltage
description:
게임 정보
It's the early years of space exploration and a team has set out to find a lost Goldilocks planet, in hopes of being the first to find life outside of their own. However, plans were changed as the ship was hit by a solar flare, now crashing the ship, scattering the crew, and leaving them light-years from home. Luckily, they have Volt. She's the determined space engineer ready to put her athletic vixen grace to the test to get all the power and materials she needs to fix her ship and go home.
Inspired by many games of old, Solar Voltage brings the isometric platformer back, while giving much needed polish to the gameplay to make sure the player feels in control at all times. Roll, spin, and hover your way around many different levels, puzzles, and environments to collect ancient batteries, rescue lost crew members, and learn more about the mysterious alien ruins that trap you.
A good game for a wide range of experience in gaming
Smooth isometric platforming
Customizable controls to give a flawless experience.
Speedrunner friendly.
A colorful cast of characters with new interactions after every level.
Hand crafted pixel art
The motivating power of two girls kissing.

title: Blood Peace
description:
게임 정보
🏃‍♂️ Love Action? 🏃‍♀️
You're in for a treat! Blood Peace offers intense battles where your special abilities and reflexes will be your best weapons ⚡. Each level is a true battlefield where your survival depends on your agility and ability to improvise.
🔁 Rogue-lite with Infinite Replayability
In Blood Peace, every defeat is a new opportunity to come back stronger. Thanks to procedural generation, no run is ever the same! Explore dungeons full of secrets, face unique bosses, and collect increasingly powerful loot 🎁.
👹 Diverse and Dynamic Bestiary
Face off against formidable creatures! Each enemy has its own attacks and behaviors, forcing you to constantly adapt your strategies. From gigantic monsters to cunning foes, every fight is a new challenge for your brain and reflexes 🧠.
🔫 Weapons and Loot Galore
The world of Blood Peace is packed with incredible loot! Access a multitude of weapons, each with random attributes that can radically change your playstyle. Combine them to become an unstoppable force 🚀.
🕹️ Key Features:
Ultra-fast FPS Action 🎮: Shoot, dodge, and survive in epic battles.
Unique Gameplay ⭐: Enjoy a blend of numerous movements and hack'n slash elements.
Rogue-lite Exploration: Every defeat is a lesson. Come back stronger after every run.
7 Unique Biomes 🌍: Explore varied environments, each with its own atmosphere and dangers.
Procedural Loot and Weapons 💣: Thousands of equipment combinations to build your class and adapt to any playstyle.
References and Easter Eggs 🐣: Discover jokes and pop culture nods hidden throughout the game.
🔥 Ready for Maximum Action?
Wishlist Blood Peace now and get ready for explosive action! 🔥

title: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars
description:
게임 정보
HARUKA: Beyond the Stars is a juvenile sci-fi RPG about the intergalactic adventures of the protagonist, Yuuki, and a mysterious girl named Miiya.
Set out on a spaceship and explore unique planets. Enjoy a thrilling adventure in the latest 3D anime art style.


Humankind faces its twilight in the far future.
Having explored every corner of the universe, people have stopped progressing—their lifestyle now dependent on Energy Capsules, a legacy of their past.

Yuuki is a boy living in Spica Village, a base for receiving Energy Capsules from the lunar ruins.
One night, he meets Miiya, a mysterious girl who crash-landed due to a spaceship malfunction.

Their meeting sparks the beginning of an intergalactic journey in search of Yuuki's father, who left for space to unravel the mystery behind humankind's decline.！




Explore the planets' vast fields. Fun and excitement await!
Scour every corner and solve mysteries!



Fight your way through exciting battles while switching between the protagonist, Yuuki, and the heroine, Miiya.
Face off against unique bosses at the end of each episode!
Battle your foes while countering their different gimmicks!



Part of the story is presented in a manga-style format.
Enjoy the story in manga + anime style!



Enjoy ten episodes presented in a TV anime series format!
Each episode ends with a preview of the next one.



Collect all cat pictures scattered throughout the world and win wonderful prizes!




A boy waiting at home for his father who left for the far reaches of the universe. He dreams of venturing into space someday. He likes tinkering with machines and maintains communications facilities daily. The device on his back is for recovering energy capsules.



She meets Yuuki when her spaceship crash-lands on his planet on an out-of-season snowy day. Her bright and carefree personality cheers her friends on. She is a mysterious girl full of secrets.



Yuuki's mysterious alien companion. She has a precocious personality and is proud of her beautiful figure. Her pet phrase is, "I'mma protect Yuuki!" She has psychic powers and is always ready to help in a pinch.



A butler robot who faithfully carries out his duties of taking care of Miiya. He always puts his mistress, Miiya, first. He can't say no to Miiya, no matter how unreasonable her requests are. He looks prim and proper but actually has a chivalric and masculine personality, as his speech patterns show.

title: Time Loop Nibiru
description:
게임 정보
A third-person shooter set in an alternate universe in a fantasy setting.
The main character falls into a time loop on the planet Nibiru. Your task is to break the time loop by solving the mystery of the conspiracy, going through all possible endings.
The plot of the game takes place in an alternate universe. Humanity has gone far in development and is capable of interstellar travel and has thus colonized many planets in the galaxy. There are three main factions in the galaxy.
The empire is very religious, archaic, has a strict hierarchy, aggressive, the goal is the revival of its former power and religious influence, which previously united all human planets, but later lost its former power, losing 80% of its influence in the galaxy.
Federation - that arose within the empire in opposition to the old structure of the state, along the path of freedom of the economic, technological, social structure of life. Having won the civil war, it became a separate state with a little more power than the new Empire.
The third faction is remote planets and sectors, or associations that have taken neutrality during the revolution and civil war. He called himself the Confederation of Free Colonies, whose goal was to uphold the colonies on their own definition of the structure of life, regardless of the Empire, the Federation and also from themselves. Each colony defines its own laws, beliefs and way of life. And the entire military and economic potential is aimed at preserving this.
The plot of the game begins with the fact that you, as part of the Federation expedition, go to the disputed planet Nibiru to the Federation laboratory, but the planet’s spaceship crashes and you are still captured in a time loop, where every certain time there is an explosion in the laboratory that kills everything around, while the laboratory is under siege by local colonial forces and an imperial cruiser has also been spotted in orbit.
The game is created by one person and published in-house. Anyone who wants to help and support the game, write to mail.

title: Galago
description:
게임 정보
Galago is a 2D exploration-platformer, blending puzzle-solving, survival, and mystery.
Find the 6 golden fireflies per level. Some are hidden, others are in plain-sight, yet seemingly out of reach...
While you explore, your endeavour will be hindered by hunger, hazards and predators. To survive, you must forage for tree sap and insects.
This is not the galago's natural habitat — you are in the city's wealthiest suburb. As you skitter along walls, peering through warmly lit windows, what stories might you witness?

title: Midnight Souls
description:
게임 정보
You are a hero setting out to date a girl, whom you met online, traveling to the distant, unknown small town of Camomile Peaks. But not everything is as it seems, and soon enough, you'll find yourself in the middle of dark secrets and uncovered mysteries.
FEATURES
During your stay in Camomile Peaks you're most likely to experience:
Unraveling murder mysteries
Solving puzzles
QTEs and various minigames
Fighting enemies and facing your fears
Buying useful (and questionable) items
Lots of dialogues
True love (probably)
A full three-act story: Setup, Confrontation, and Resolution
Making friends along the way
A cat!

title: Conquest of Eldinar
description:
게임 정보
Conquest of Eldinar is an upcoming 3D Real Time Strategy and Action game being developed for Steam PC, where you choose from one of 16 different epic fantasy Factions to play as while you build your base, train an army, and engage in thrilling large scale battles. The game supports both dynamic single-player campaigns and competitive online multi-player matches.
The world of Eldinar is a chaotic one, where many different races are constantly in conflict, battling for supremacy. Humans, Elves, Dwarves, Orcs, Dragonkin—the list goes on, each with their own unique cultures, aesthetics, lore, and, of course, arsenals of deadly weapons and spells. Some of these factions are heavily inspired by real-world cultures, while others serve as homages to beloved tropes within the fantasy genre. In Conquest of Eldinar, there is no shortage of exhilarating faction choices, each with its own distinct strengths and weaknesses.

title: Cryptica
description:
게임 정보
Cryptica is a narrative-based psychological horror game where the apocalypse is only the beginning. Explore the enigmatic lands of Antarctica and its surrounding areas while the world ends.
Play as Ari Harper, as he desperately attempts to find his missing sister, who has disappeared with a film crew while making a documentary in Antarctica. Uncover unfathomable horrors, discover ancestral secrets, and find your sister at all costs.
Player Freedom
Players can explore in 1st or 3rd-person modes in massive rustic and surreal environments. Go forth and explore freely.

title: Stealer
description:
게임 정보
Stealer is a platformer with Metroidvania elements. You start the game as a thief who, just like you, understands nothing. As you explore the locations, you are immersed in darkness, but you have a precious lantern. Look for clues and interact with the environment to achieve your goals.
Game Difficulty
This is a challenging platformer. Don’t think you’ll be able to simply run past all the obstacles! Sometimes you can make things easier by tackling challenges wisely or even avoiding them altogether. However, this depends on your attentiveness and ability to analyze the situation. Stay alert and use your skills to successfully complete the game!

title: Death Ring
description:
게임 정보
Death Ring is a casual action roguelike in which you will have to force your way through hordes of undead in search of the human world’s main artefact.
Numerous scenarios of each character’s development based on random dropping items will make your runs unique.
Casual mechanics
You control only the movement of the character and the choice of weapons.
The fire is carried out automatically.
Collect coins and crystals dropped from opponents.
Roguelike mechanics
With each character level up, you need to choose one of three randomly dropped items.
There are over a hundred unique items in the game.
Luck and your choice will allow you to create unique builds.
History of the game development
The Death Ring was meant to be the third game in a series of experimental shoot 'em up games, after Bloody Walls and DED. The game prototype was developed back in 2017. In the course of testing various elements of the game mechanics I failed to create a game that would be interesting and captivating, which led to the project suspension.
After the popular Vampire Survivors game was released, I finally realized in what way Death Ring should be modified, so roguelike elements were introduced and the fire control option was eliminated.
Five years have passed since then, and the game is finally going to enter its early access phase.

title: Warplane Quest
description:
게임 정보
Warplane Quest is a side-scrolling dogfighting game set in World War 1.

Join the Royal Flying Corps and become a legendary flying ace

Experience the story of a young RFC pilot and complete intense missions
Fight against the most dangerous aces of the World War 1
Unlock and upgrade authentic warplanes to gain an edge in the air



Engage a variety of air and ground enemies

Fight bosses in epic battles
Equip your machine with the optimal weapons for the given situation
Perform maneuvers to outsmart enemies

title: Closer Than You Know
description:
게임 정보

Closer Than You Know (CTYK) is a cozy, fresh take on the familiar point-and-click adventure games. Packed with story and puzzles, CTYK is a great introduction to point-and-clicks while also being fun for fans of nostalgic point-and-click adventure games.

Young Sam has a spark of creativity burning inside her, but Granican law has deemed any such talents “dangerous” and “a threat to the Granican way of life.” While imprisoned for the crime of “invention” Sam breaks free and discovers the seed of an ancient magic that starts her on a quest to Earth where--with the help of a friendly Praying Mantis--she collects fragments of Hope to restore life to her home planet.




A young girl with the spark of hope! Headstrong, clever, and a little too curious for her own good, Sam is the hero of our story!

Behind every great hero is a great sidekick. Thoughtful, constructive, and kind, Mantis is a whole lot of wisdom in a bug-size package!

The mysterious former King of Granica, who after vanishing without a trace, has seemingly left his magic all over the world...


See the wants and needs of those around you. Fulfill their wishes and gather Hope to take back home!



From the lush tropical rainforest to the frigid arctic to an actual ant farm, your adventures will take you places you never dreamed!



Strangers are just friends you haven't met, and in CTYK you will make friends of everything from a bravely insecure capybara to an eccentric old scientist with an unusual power.

title: The Sintonia Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Discover the Fantastic World of Sintonia!
Embark on a magical adventure as Maria, an unlikely heroine in search of her missing puppies. Explore a vibrant world filled with unique biomes and cunning enemies, where every step uncovers new challenges and secrets. Sintonia is a place where creativity and strategy come together in an unforgettable experience.
Introduction
A Journey of Unexpected Friendships and Epic Challenges
In The Sintonia Chronicles, you don’t just explore a vast world—you forge connections with the Guardian Oracles, powerful beings with unique personalities and a peculiar sense of humor. Every biome is a new discovery, and every boss is a puzzle waiting to be solved.
Core Mechanics:
Open-World Exploration
Explore the universe of Sintonia, inspired by classic 3D platformers, with interconnected areas and hidden secrets in every corner. Scale mountains, traverse dense forests, and dive into the depths of oceans while uncovering new biomes that will test your skills.
Advanced Physics for Dynamic Interactions

title: Mech Log Zero
description:
게임 정보
Mech Log Zero is a shooter akin to games from the old-school PS1 and N64 eras.
Swap between a first-person Pilot view and a third-person view when controlling the Mech.
Use the synergy between the Pilot and the Mech to explore and prevail in Mordaro´s many interconnected Megastructures.
GAMEPLAY-
Use the Mech to destroy colossal machines part by part, or use your skills as the pilot to find an entrance through the colossus, enter their central core, destroy it, and escape with the Mech before the giant machine explodes.
Exit the Mech as the pilot and explore the zones the Mech can´t access, or find a breakable secret wall so the mech shots can enter the zone from outside.
Find ways to move around Mordaro´s layers using the new upgrades and weapons scattered across the megastructures.
New weapons not only serve as a way to attack, but some of them will offer you new ways to move around.
STORY-
Dehka and Alyssa´s new gig has given them the power to hack into a Machine, deep inside one of Mordaro´s lower layers.
You take on the role of Dehka, who at the same time controls the Machine Alyssa has called "The Pilot".
It is your job to retrieve LifeSeeds for your people's needs using this machine...
They will quickly find, however, that the lower layers aren´t as lifeless as they thought they would be.
You´re far away from any danger, right?

title: Catena
description:
게임 정보
Catena is a deck-building roguelite with a unique combat system.
Customize your allies freely by equipping "Modules"—actions like "move forward one tile"—and outmaneuver your enemies with strategies tailored to your playstyle.
Experience the thrill of finding the optimal solution as you navigate ever-changing maps and adapt to unpredictable rewards.
Game Features
Programming-Inspired Customization
Grid-Based Turn-Based Battles
Permanent Death on Defeat (With Persistent Upgrades in the Full Version)
Customization before battle is the key to victory.
Various events unfolding along the journey

title: Garden Ink
description:
게임 정보
Game Description
Garden Ink is a game, in which you bring an empty world to life. You plant biomes that you can choose freely, and each area offers new content and secrets to discover.
Gameplay
By solving minigames and puzzles, you unlock new biomes and decorative elements. With these, you can gradually beautify your world. Your goal is to create a flourishing and beautiful environment. The gameplay gives you a top-down view of your world. You can directly interact with it and unlock various tools. With these tools, you can paint plants, replant them, or combine decorative elements. This opens up countless possibilities to design your world in a unique way.
Atmosphere
Everything is accompanied by a relaxing soundtrack, cute sounds from the creatures, and harmonious visuals. Garden Ink invites you to play at your own pace and create a cozy little world that is entirely your own.

title: SoulSide
description:
게임 정보
SoulSide is a JRPG that blends traditional mechanics with modern elements,
presented in detailed pixel art graphics. The game offers a mix of familiar gameplay and fresh ideas to keep things interesting.
Features
JUMPING and ELEVATION mechanics to add depth to exploration
TURN-BASED combat with MINIGAMES for both attacking and dodging
on-screen enemy encounters (NO RANDOM battles)
a large cast of quirky characters and funny dialogue
hidden puzzles and SECRETS for players who like to explore
diverse gameplay mechanics, including many minigames and unique features to keep things fresh
SoulSide focuses on combining different elements to create a JRPG experience that feels both familiar and new.

title: Timberquest
description:
게임 정보
In this game, we define Survival as the state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in difficult circumstances. Survival can be threatened by various factors such as environmental factors, starvation, dehydration, monsters/animals, psychological distress, diseases, or lack of sleep. Adventure, on the other hand, involves taking risks, covering distances, encountering animals/monsters, and experiencing a story that includes loss, gain, and new visual things.

As you embark on this journey, you will meet Luna, Ray, Davo, Solara, Ember, and Orion, who all met in a tavern and decided to embark on an adventure together. They boarded a ship and set sail towards a new continent, but their journey was cut short when their ship exploded due to a fire caused by the wares they were carrying. They ended up shipwrecked on the shores of the new, wild continent. Despite the setback, they were excited to explore the new land and discover what it had to offer.

Our game is an RPG with a heavy focus on cooperative play, but it can also be enjoyed as a single-player experience. Unlike other "survival" games, our game is more equipment-driven, giving players greater control over their survival strategies. The combat system is inspired by MOBAs, making for a more engaging and challenging experience. However, instead of PvP elements, our game's combat system is designed entirely for PvE. Our game features stat-driven abilities, adding a layer of complexity to the gameplay and allowing players to customize their characters to suit their preferred playstyle.

Are you ready to embark on this adventure and survive the untamed wilderness? Get ready to join Luna, Ray, Davo, Solara, Ember, and Orion and explore the new continent in our exciting RPG game!

title: Kanun 1919
description:
게임 정보
메신저는 외딴 마을 투로우에서 출발해 중요한 문서 꾸러미를 배달해요. 그런데 목적지에 도착하면 자신의 외모가 사람들에게 환영받지 못한다는 사실을 알게 돼요.
이 우울한 장소의 비밀을 밝히고 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알아내 주세요.
20세기 초의 작은 마을에 흠뻑 빠져보세요. 마을 사람들과 대화하고, 적과 싸우고, 마을과 주변을 탐험하세요.
특징:
디젤펑크 대체 역사
스타일라이즈드 그래픽
외딴 마을의 우울한 분위기

title: Nightborn
