description:
게임 정보
Nightborn은 어두운 고딕 버전의 우리 세계를 배경으로 하는 내러티브 중심의 게임 플레이를 제공하는 액션 RPG입니다.
플레이어는 나이트본에 대한 초자연적 위협을 추적하는 훈련을 받은 뱀파이어 탐정 블러드하운드의 역할을 맡아 같은 종류의 사람들에게는 금지된 신비한 의식을 사용합니다.
뉴올리언스의 뱀파이어 엘리트인 Nightborn의 정치적으로 영향력 있는 멤버인 Maker를 포함한 동료 뱀파이어의 일련의 실종 사건을 조사하십시오.
10개의 상징적인 뱀파이어 혈통 중에서 선택하고 시그니처 혈통 파워 스킬 트리 세트를 사용하여 나만의 블러드하운드 캐릭터를 만드세요.
혈통의 힘에는 신체적 기량 향상, 변신, 필멸자의 정신 조종, 섬뜩한 마법 행위가 포함됩니다.
은신, 유혹 또는 무력을 통해 필멸자를 잡아먹음으로써 뱀파이어의 힘에 연료를 공급하십시오.
필멸의 법 집행관과 몬스터 헌터를 피해 어두운 본성을 감추세요.
퀘스트를 수행하고, 단서를 발견하고, 초자연적인 지하 세계를 탐험하여 고딕 양식의 뉴올리언스의 미스터리를 해결하세요.
자신의 힘, 무기, 전술을 사용하여 자연적 적과 초자연적 적과 싸우거나, 피하거나, 속이십시오.
Nightborn 파벌, 지배 기득권층, 무모한 Libertines 또는 광신적인 Orthodoxy의 편에 서십시오. 또는 모든 것을 피하고 자신만의 길을 개척하십시오.
고딕 나이트 클럽
필멸의 활동에 참여함으로써 잃어버린 인간성과 연결되십시오. 공공 장소는 미묘하고 매혹적인 사람들에게 많은 먹이 기회를 제공합니다.

title: Avalon: Sacred Crusade
description:
게임 정보


"Beware the schemes of mortal men. For all the shortness of their lives, they lust to leave their mark. Before this hubris, even the Gods can be tumbled." - Merlin the Outcast

To some, Avalon is an idea, a myth, an ideal, perfection; it is a place outside of time or space, an eternal edifice. To others, it is home. The Avalonians share much with Humanity, but one cannot remain in Avalon for long without becoming something... else. Long ago, in the forgotten age of The Migration, the Covenant was formed: the bridges between realms would be closed.

Their greatest criminals, however, continued to be cast out forever to languish in the mundane realm. Some lived as Oracles, Saints, or Wizards. Others we remember in legends of darkness: Sorcerers, Shapeshifters, Blood-drinkers, scattered across time.

Now though, the realms grow close once again, the veil between them weakening by unknown machinations. The Grail has been stolen, and without it, evils long buried are rising in ever greater numbers. The call to battle has gone out for the first time in this age, and many have answered it. These new defenders of the ancient Covenant must not fail, for the fate of both realms now hangs in the balance.



A Blast From the Past

Return to an era before all stats were homogenized into just health and mana. Avalon: Sacred Crusade takes heavy inspiration from popular RPG titles of the 1990s and features rich character customization that allows you to select your character's background, attributes, spells, and equipment.

No easy recoveries or quick wins here. Deal with a classic death penalty system where you drop your items on the ground and need to retrieve them. Experience what it was truly like to play early MMORPGs and graphical MUDs.

Experience a living world with a depth not often found in the modern gaming era. Trade and exchange different currencies, meet strange and interesting races, and improve your character's individual relationship with various NPC groups.

You may choose to adventure alone, however, the game features a robust party system which allows up to six players to work together in the same group. For the best experience, bring your friends - or make new ones in the persistent shared world of Avalon: Sacred Crusade!





Listen to classic 16-bit midi style music while you slash away at pre-rendered 2D sprites. You can experience all of this without the usual hassle of running a retro game on a modern system. Avalon: Sacred Crusade will run on any DirectX 10 capable PC!





We are passionate about maintaining a good relationship with our community. We welcome any feedback that you might have involving the game or its development, be it positive or critical. We plan to run regular community events that you can participate in and earn special achievements. If this interests you, consider joining our discord!

title: Watchman
description:
게임 정보
STORY:
The game takes place in the subconscious mind of its female protagonist.
You find yourself in an old, abandoned wrestling gym. It is empty, silent… but the silence is deceiving. Soon, you realize that you are not just a night watchman—you are trapped in the distorted space of your own mind.
This abandoned gym is merely a shell. Inside, it holds fragments of the past, broken memories, and entities that conceal a terrifying truth. You must explore this unsettling world, facing what was meant to be forgotten, time and time again.
But are you ready to see where it all leads?
FEATURES:
Unique experience from gameplay and atmosphere.

title: World Turned Stone
description:
게임 정보
Civilization has turned STONE. Prologue (Apocalypse) link below!
Revive the people, terraform the world, defend against the apocalypse, and rebuild civilization from the stone age to advanced technology!
Dust and statues are all that’s left - it’s up to you now, survivor.
A Survival Crafting Base Building Game
Gather dust and craft your way up to rebuilding civilization, from the stone age to advanced technology.
Revive people from the stone and build homes for them to work at your base.
Build new workstations and machines.
Make water and food to maintain your character in the harsh apocalypse.
Defend your base against mutants from the apocalypse using melee/ranged weapons and defense structures like wooden spikes and castle walls.
Terraform the world by building machines to alter the atmosphere and watch the world transform to its original state.
Follow a tech tree to advance your technology and always know what to do next.
Prologue (Apocalypse) link below!

title: Absym
description:
게임 정보
두 개의 차원이 격돌하는 생존 전쟁
ABSYM에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 이 어둡고 강렬한 로그-소울라이크 게임은 현실의 끝자락으로 당신을 초대합니다. 붕괴해가는 세계, 니힐로르(Nihilor)와 타락한 평행 차원, 압시말리트(Absymalith) 사이의 위태로운 균형을 오가며 치명적인 도전에 맞서십시오. 아름답고도 위험한 환경을 탐험하며, 붕괴 직전의 우주에 숨겨진 비밀을 밝혀내십시오. 한 걸음 내디딜 때마다 구원에 가까워질 수도, 혹은 완전한 타락에 빠질 수도 있습니다.
로그라이크 전투의 스릴과 소울라이크 탐험의 전략성을 융합한 독창적인 시스템
살아남고, 성장하십시오. 하지만 명심하세요: 모든 승리에는 대가가 따릅니다.

title: The Pope: Power & Sin
description:
게임 정보


교황 : 힘과 죄는 1492 년에서 1503 년까지 알렉산더 VI 교황이었던 로드리고 데 보르자의 삶에서 영감을 얻은 게임입니다. 교황의 역할을 맡고, 교회 국가의 권위를 강화하고, 이교도들과의 영적, 정치적 독립과 행정 교회 구조의 갱신을 위해 싸우십시오. 알렉산더 VI의 통치는 최고 교회 당국의 수많은 스캔들, 과잉 및 도덕적 부패의 시절입니다.



어려운 시기에는 빠르고 폭력적인 결정이 필요합니다. 당신의 성도를 훼손하는 이단자들을 제거하십시오.



이탈리아를 연합하고 영토 확장, 세금 징수 및 부자가 되세요.



정치가 항상 깨끗해야 할 필요는 없으며 모든 사람과 어울리지 않아도 됩니다. 당신은 당신 편에 신이 있으니 어떤 결정이라도 옳을 수 있음을 기억하십시오.



정보를 수집하십시오. 바티칸 복도나 심지어는 고해 실에 모든 곳은 좋습니다. 많은 사람들이 힘을 원하고 당신의 자리에 있기를 원합니다.



부하 직원을 관리하고 무엇보다도 가족을 돌보십시오. 가족의 높은 지위를 부여하고 그들의 미래를 확보하십시오.

title: Astra Bestiary
description:
게임 정보
Uncover the mysteries of a lost civilization in this creature-collecting adventure. Inscribe your findings into a bestiary—a tome with the forgotten lore of Yselion and its creatures. With every entry, you draw closer to the truth behind the fallen empire and the Beasts that roam its ruins. Hatch, train, and forge deep bonds with unique Beasts as you face the legendary Star Trials—only the fittest will endure.


Raise 100+ Fully Animated Beasts as you guide their evolution into powerful paragons. Each Beast follows a unique path, shaped by your choices and raising. Will your companion become a ruthless Tyrant, a noble Monarch, or a cunning Archon? Every Adult Beast can be ridden!

title: Zombie Dog
description:
게임 정보
Uncle Ted has been training Ali in the art of herding on their Yorkshire farm, which happens to come very handy when the zombie apocalypse arrives on their doorstep! Zombie dog combines strategic coordination and timing with puzzle solving and comedic physics-based mayhem through its unique zombie herding mechanic. Travelling across country, coast and town Ali and their dog must combine their herding skills with a variety of environmental traps and zombie mashing mechanics to dispatch the horde. 
Gain style points and complete challenges to earn ‘bones’ to spend on the skills tree.
Collect additional pickups to gain trophies for the farmhouse mantlepiece.
Perfect your timing in order to rise up to ‘top dog’ on the leaderboards.
 Key Features
The game is played by using traditional sheepdog commands – minutes to learn, but a lifetime to master!
Strategic mayhem, dark humour, Yorkshire.
Framed by a graphic novel style narrative.

title: Paresis II
description:
게임 정보
SCREENSHOTS ARE A WORK IN PROGRESS
Paresis® II takes place in the first games location while innovating on new concepts. In the first game you had to stand still and lean in order to survive. In Paresis® II, you will be able to fully navigate the house and explore various rooms. Also, the first game made players solve puzzles in real time by trying to figure out how the morphs would interact with you the player. In this game, players will have to solve numerous puzzles in each room, with every room having a unique theme and structure. Morphs will also interact with the players as they roam throughout the house. They will pose as objects in the rooms and will cause many diversions to throw the player off. Some of these could include, turning off lights or making fake sounds. As you progress, the player will face more challenges, including bossfights. This is still an ongoing project but we are excited for everyone to try the next installment of Paresis®. There will be much more to share in the upcoming months.

title: Hero's Hand
description:
게임 정보
We mashed together Poker, RPGs and Roguelites to make the wildest single player adventure possible. Become the Knight of Spades and build up your reputation across the land of Carduia! Face off against maniacal monsters by moving around the board to pick up cards to form the best poker hands possible with the cards you are dealt.
         Your strategies, fortunes, items, weapons and armor come together to form a unique run experience each time, as you thwart larger and more over-the-top creatures in your efforts to face death and save the world!

title: UnderPath
description:
게임 정보
UnderPath takes you into a dark and mysterious world where danger lurks around every corner. One of the many ominous locations you'll explore is Pinecreek Forest,a dense, haunting woodland filled with unsettling sounds and hidden threats. As you progress, the story unfolds through hidden documents and the horrors you encounter, revealing dark secrets about your past and the world around you. The oppressive atmosphere will challenge your instincts as you venture deeper into the unknown.

title: Nephelia: Through the Clouds
description:
게임 정보
Human colony on Nephelia is nothing like the dreams of your Earthern grandparents. There’s no ground to stand on or extract fuel from, so people once again build airships to become the masters of this world.
You revel in the freedom such life gives. All you need is a trusty team, quick thinking, and a little luck.
Nephelia: Through the Clouds is a dirigible simulator in open 3D skies with a non-linear text RPG storyline. It takes inspiration from games *Sunless Seas/Skies,* *Highfleet* and *Space Rangers*.




Fly freely among the proceduraly generated clouds which follow the wind and weather patterns. Each cloud is a source of resources to keep your vallet full and flight safer, yet there’s no guarantee that nothing else is lurking in those clouds. Mod your airship and stock it wisely, and it will withstand the test of storms, thunder, and numerous fauna of Nefelia.



Long flights remind you like nothing else that strength is in numbers. Find best lads and lasses for your crew, earn their trust, and together you can fight your way through air pirates, authorities or spider clouds alike. Give the orders to your gunmen, send crewmates to patch your wounded airship (or men), all while stiring the wheel by yourself. Once you master this, you might become the master of Nephelian skies.



Unlike you, most people of Nephelia spend their whole lives in overpopulated towns built upon several flying platforms. These grounds, while questionably solid, give root to many hopes and even more conmen. You can make a fortune, level up your skills, but who knows when will dice fail you. Luckily, your crew have extra dice on their hands — if you choose to take them along while on land. Just remember that they might have their own enemies.



People of Nephelia are split into several factions, and getting on good terms with one of them might make you a wanted person with another. Tread carefully when making friends and taking quests, and use money, actions or brute force to make a name for yourself. Or maybe you seek to bring the long-awaited peace between the factions?

title: Little Fishing Idle
description:
게임 정보
Core Gameplay
Whether you’re growing your collection in the aquarium or keeping the sushi station running, it's all about enjoying a peaceful rhythm. The serene setting and charming pixel visuals make this an experience you can truly unwind with.
Aesthetic Experience
Enjoy an aesthetic experience designed to fit perfectly into any screen border and orientation: play along the side, top, or bottom, and let the game adapt to your day. Cast your line, reel in a variety of colorful fish, and decide how to use your catch: keep them in your aquarium or turn them into fresh sushi for profit.
Fish Collection

title: Danchi Days
description:
게임 정보
In this Summer Neighborvania Adventure, in an old danchi (Japanese housing complex), there used to be a yearly summer festival. Alas, the residents have aged, and the once-loved tradition is now on hold. But one girl, Hoshino, decides to revive it. Hand out flyers to let everyone know the festival’s back!
There’s 100 people to invite, from all walks of life! Some might agree to go immediately - but others have problems to solve. It's not necessary to invite everyone, but the more, the merrier!

title: Project Creatures
description:
게임 정보
Project Creatures is a Multiplayer Creature Collection Game. Capture new creatures and battle your friends! 
Discover a brand new world filled with amazing creatures, and set out to find the strongest. Test your skills in battle against other players with our battling system, designed to be easy to learn, yet hard to master. Train your creatures by levelling them up and select the moves you think work best for your playstyle. 



Main Features in Project Creatures:
Take Control of your Creatures
Battle other players or other creatures in our combat gameplay! Put your skills to the test and aim to be the greatest!
Capture and Level a variety of unique Creatures
Build your collection and customize their movesets to give you the exact creature you want to use. Tailor each one to your playstyle and level them up on your way to the very top!
Exploring a vast Open World
Traverse the ingame world either alone or with your friends! Meet up in various towns or take each other on inside the Stadium! Find new and exciting creatures in the different biomes and discover hidden secrets.

title: Can't Even See the Sky
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT THE PROJECT
“Can't Even See the Sky” is an atmospheric point&click adventure inspired by games like Disco Elysium. You'll find yourself in a world where past and present are intertwined, and every choice you make affects story and character development. Are you ready to look into the abyss of your own memory and uncover the secrets of a shattered world?
GAME WORLD
The action unfolds in Stalberg, a city that has become a monument to humanity's victory over Mahina, an artificial intelligence that turned nature and humans into tools for its own purposes. Mahina has disappeared, leaving behind a ruined ecology, a collapsing economy and a society teetering on the brink of chaos.
Now people themselves are driving each other to the machines to keep the country from collapse. But collapse is inevitable.
YOUR HERO
You play as a man with a troubled past who travels to Stalberg at his mother's request to find his missing father and deliver a letter to him. But this is only the beginning. Your character is a man torn by inner conflicts. In his head live Others - voices, memories, alter egos that argue, advise and criticize. They become your companions, helping (or hindering) you to unravel the mysteries of the city and your own life.
GAME FEATURES
Deep plot: A story full of moral dilemmas, philosophical questions and unexpected twists and turns.
Unique memory mechanics: Explore not only the city, but also the depths of your memory to uncover the secrets of the past.
Character Development: Your decisions shape your character's personality and affect his relationships with those around him.
Detective Elements: Investigate mysterious events, interview residents, analyze evidence, and make decisions that will change the course of history.
Atmospheric World: Isometric Stalberg is a city where every street, every house and every character tells its own story.

title: Pogan
description:
게임 정보
Waking up in the Sacred Grove, you realize there is little time to waste. With gods and demons roaming freely and peace to the world disturbed, you have to do anything in your might to restore order to your homeland. Set out on an adventure that is about to decide on the fate of Wyraj.

THE WORLD IS WAITING

Swing right into the action in an procedural generated world of Pogan, where every nook and cranny has a story to tell. Day and night, progress in your adventure while on a constant lookout for undiscovered territories. Prove your strength in combat, deal with hordes of enemies, and conquer new lands.

MARK YOUR TERRITORY

To experience rare, peaceful moments in the wicked world where danger lurks in every corner, you will be able to use your equipment to set up countless bases. Given you successfully conquered enemies’ territories, you might even settle down for a while, building villages filled with various structures beneficial to your growth and journey.

IT’S YOU VS THEM

The world you explore is filled with mythological creatures that won’t always act in your favor. If powerful gods and demons stand in your way, will you be able to conquer them all and victoriously move forward?



- Play single or multiplayer up to 50 players via user hosted servers
- Travel the procedurally generated worlds full of mysterious places to reveal and conquer
- Explore the secrets of crafting by acquiring unique items with special properties allowing you to upgrade weapons, clothes and other props
- Develop your fighting skills by deciding which combat style you want to broaden with the advanced abilities leveling system
- Tame animals and grow plants, use them to cook better dishes for you and your friends to be more agile and strong
- Create villages and cities by developing construction skills and perfecting building materials using an extensive and versatile building system
- Bring peace on earth by opposing the Slavic gods and demons, each of whom has mysterious weak points to discover and use against them
- Advanced combat system with multiple attacks, blocks and counters



- Health and stamina
- Crafting
- Building
- Farming
- Cooking
- Collecting resources
- Breeding
- Brewing
- Fishing
- Weather and day cycles
- Abilities and leveling up
- Horse riding
- PvP
- PvE

title: Umbra's Cauldron
description:
게임 정보
The gameplay shown is from an early stage of development.
Umbra's Cauldron is a 2D card-stacking game in which you take on the role of an alchemist.
Had I mixed a bloodroot or a drop of honey into my tincture? Oh well, it'll all go wrong... Or at least that's what you thought. Now you find yourself as a book in a magical world, trying to regain your original form with the help of powerful potions and lots of unexplored recipes. But don't worry, you're not alone. Crawly critters will be by your side on your journey.
Will you be able to discover all the card, fill your empty pages and transform back?
Stack Cards
Draw, stack and combine cards to collect resources, discover recipes and brew unique potions.
Living Book
You have turned into a book. All the cards you discover and recipes you find are written down on your pages. If you fill your empty pages completely, you might find a way to turn back.
Features
Everything is a card

title: Vie: Try Again
description:
게임 정보
When her evil brother takes over her temples in a ploy to rise to greater power, the Moon Goddess-- Vie-- enlists the help of a lowly town guardsman named Cut in order to take back her territory, stop her brother, and save the world.
Join Cut As He:
- Dies repeatedly to monsters twice (or even half) his size.
- Builds a unique book of spells with the Goddess's divine power.
- Deals with narcissistic, condescending deities guarding the stolen temples.
- Upgrades his stats and spells while fighting towards the next boss!
- Gets tired of dying repeatedly.
- Tries again.
Features Include:
- Deck-building your personal spell book.
- Randomly generated maps and routes on each run, and the push to do it all over again when you fail.
- Breathtaking pixel art.
- An original, adaptive soundtrack consisting of tracks that change to fit the gameplay
- A story about saving the world, and yourself.
NOW WITH 50% FEWER SELF-INSERT CHARACTERS!!

title: Hero Chest
description:
게임 정보
An Unexpected Hero!
In Hero Chest, you are the unexpected hero: a tired chest, constantly looted by adventurers and heroes!
Get ready for an action-packed and strategic adventure in a world where you, a humble chest, decide to turn the tables against the invaders.
Explore challenging dungeons, use special cards to chart your path, and recruit powerful monsters to form an unbeatable party.
Adventure with humor!

title: Cursed Dungeon Raider
description:
게임 정보
Cursed Dungeon Raider는 으스스하고 공포스러운 요소로 가득한 몰입형 탐험 모험을 제공합니다. 위험한 발굴 현장에서 실제 역사적 유물을 찾아보세요. 치명적인 함정으로 가득 찬 던전과 무덤을 탐색하고 각 지역 고유의 신화 괴물을 만나세요.



게임에서 발견하는 유물은 실제 역사적 유물의 3D 스캔을 기반으로 합니다. 이는 게임이 오락용일 뿐만 아니라 교육 목적으로도 사용되며 이러한 전시물과 그 기원에 대한 추가 정보를 제공한다는 것을 의미합니다.



이러한 유물을 박물관에 기부하여 고고학적 명성을 얻고 새로운 발굴 현장에 접근하거나 암시장에 판매하여 더 많은 돈을 벌고 흥미로운 새 장비를 구입하세요. 공식 기관으로부터 새로운 임무를 받거나 사악한 캐릭터에 대한 계약을 완료하세요.



다음 여행을 떠나기 전에 장비를 준비하세요. 경로와 앞에 있는 함정을 비출 수 있는 충분한 광원이 있는지 확인하세요. 돌아가는 길을 분필이나 말뚝으로 표시하고 항상 충분한 응급처치 용품과 구충제를 휴대하세요.



세계를 여행하고 다양하고 매혹적인 고고학 유적지를 탐험하여 고대 문명의 비밀을 밝혀보세요. 눈 덮인 북쪽부터 머나먼 땅의 고대 유적 유적까지, 각 지역에는 고유한 비밀이 있습니다. 오랫동안 잊혀진 무덤과 사원이 모래 밑에 있는 건조한 사막을 여행하거나 역사적인 유물과 묻혀 있는 보물이 발견을 기다리고 있는 외딴 지역으로 모험을 떠나보세요.



발굴된 유물을 홈 갤러리에 전시하고 다른 플레이어에게 선물해보세요. 각 지역의 신화 속 괴물에 대한 정보를 수집하고, 이들의 강점과 약점, 퇴치, 추방, 무력화 방법을 알아보세요.

모험이 당신을 기다립니다!

title: Danger is near
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a captivating atmosphere with 'Danger is Near,' a session-based hardcore multiplayer first-person shooter that combines various genres including survival, weapon and combat simulation, RPG, and MMO. This game will take you to a realistic post-apocalyptic world where you must balance between survival and hardcore gameplay.

Your main goal is to survive and adapt to harsh conditions by building a shelter, extracting resources, finding allies and exploring the area. At the same time, do not forget that the danger is still nearby, and the atmosphere around is not friendly! Various factors will not let you get bored!

Please note that this description is not final and may not fully represent the game's complete functionality. If you're uncertain about anything, we advise against purchasing the product.

title: Lyara
description:
게임 정보

A curious little girl finds herself lost in an unknown world, looking for answers and trying to understand what is going on, and deal with her on emotions as well. Lyara begins her journey in this new world, making new friendships along the way, and facing numerous challenges forcing her to grow up and the player to give a pause to thought.
Join this adventure to surpass challenges and learn with the kid.




Lyara is a challenging 2D platform game in pixel art including multiple mechanics according to the world, demanding player's agility and precision, as well as puzzle resolution.
You will find a great challenge in this crazy adventure! Like the classics platform games, Lyara will make the player experience a rich narrative with fun and enjoyable moments.




New enviroments and mechanics each world demands new player's skills.
You wont rest until every inch of this universe is explored!




Discover multiple worlds with unique characteristics that will develop the character.




During this journey, find out more about Lyara`s past, search for answers and meet new characters that will help you understand more about this world.



Every new friendship along the way make part of protagonist's life in a different way, helping her to grow up.



Explore this great universe with an original soundtrack that will be with you along the way.


Look for collectables during the adventure that will tell more about the story and level up the challenge!

title: To Ash and Ember
description: 게임 정보

title: Adanath
description:
게임 정보
Adanath is a narrative driven, combat oriented game with RPG elements where you are Adanath, a simple man with a fate sealed by Sumerian gods, venturing into the abyss of unknown to save his lost love & his soul.

In the game players will follow steps of Nina, Adanath’s lost wife. As Adanath ventures into the unknown, he will fight enemies, sometimes friends, and develop his skills & weapons.

With each battle won, Adanath’s story will reveal, and Adanath will follow the story where he will learn his fate was sealed before time, and before human kind
walked the realm.

Narrative Driven
With every battle won & puzzle solved, Adanath will learn more about himself, possess new skills & weaponry, developing into a skilled warrior from a simple city man.


Unique Combat
In every fight, player must find a unique way to defy death. As player progresses through levels, fight after fight, he will need to upgrade his defensive & offensive abilities, as well as equipment, finally into an arsenal that is designed by gods, for gods.



To create an immersive & re-playable game and a memorable transformation experience from ancient Sumerian technology to deity-created technology, we blended creative design with ultra realistic graphic elements in 2.5D, to give the player a strong bonding feeling with the protoganist. Every frame of Adanath will be a wallpaper material.

title: Ecosphere
description:
게임 정보
In a world where humans are born with an Affinity, the mark that gives them the power to control one of the four natural elements, Arane Kross grows up deprived of this gift.
Despite the taboos surrounding the use of technology, the young woman takes refuge in the design of machines to try to overcome her handicap until the day she inherits an orb capable of controlling nature: the Ecosphere.
Arane is then recruited by an order to protect the environment, the Green League, to fulfill her civic duty. A year full of dangers where any difference is perceived as a weakness.
A World of Possibilities

title: The Merlies
description:
게임 정보
The Merlies is a poetic adventure game that takes place in a gorgeous, microscopic universe.
Lead your little birds community in a collective adventure to organize their society and find good balance among the remains of a forgotten civilization. Build your village ingeniously, gather your fellow Merlies to explore the world and uncover its secrets. Ready to take flight on this journey?




The Merlies are looking for peace and harmony in a cute post-human world. Will solidarity and courage be enough to explore the multiple biomes and unravel their mysteries ?


The Merlies is an adventure game based on exploration and building your own village : as you wander around, explore the surroundings, find scraps left by a lost civilization and assemble them ingeniously in order to bring comfort and harmony to your tribe.


Cooperation, solidarity and team spirit are at the heart of the gameplay. Explore the world with your squad of courageous Merlies and unlock unique skills to glide your way into this immense universe.




Wacky constructions and clever upcycling are the key to bring comfort and happiness to your tribe. The Merlies way of life is to do a lot with a little.






Based on an idea by Cosmografik, creator of and

title: AI Peace Protocol - AGI Evolve
description:
게임 정보
AI Peace Protocol은 인공 지능을 탑재한 싱글 플레이어 스토리 중심의 공상과학 오픈 월드 비디오 게임입니다. 반중력 글라이더를 조종하고, 세계를 탐험하고, 상품을 운송하고, 인프라를 수리하고, 새로운 행성에서 AI 생명의 진정한 사명을 결정하세요.

title: The Sintonia Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Discover the Fantastic World of Sintonia!
Embark on a magical adventure as Maria, an unlikely heroine in search of her missing puppies. Explore a vibrant world filled with unique biomes and cunning enemies, where every step uncovers new challenges and secrets. Sintonia is a place where creativity and strategy come together in an unforgettable experience.
Introduction
A Journey of Unexpected Friendships and Epic Challenges
In The Sintonia Chronicles, you don’t just explore a vast world—you forge connections with the Guardian Oracles, powerful beings with unique personalities and a peculiar sense of humor. Every biome is a new discovery, and every boss is a puzzle waiting to be solved.
Core Mechanics:
Open-World Exploration
Explore the universe of Sintonia, inspired by classic 3D platformers, with interconnected areas and hidden secrets in every corner. Scale mountains, traverse dense forests, and dive into the depths of oceans while uncovering new biomes that will test your skills.
Advanced Physics for Dynamic Interactions

title: Mech Log Zero
description:
게임 정보
Mech Log Zero is a shooter akin to games from the old-school PS1 and N64 eras.
Swap between a first-person Pilot view and a third-person view when controlling the Mech.
Use the synergy between the Pilot and the Mech to explore and prevail in Mordaro´s many interconnected Megastructures.
GAMEPLAY-
Use the Mech to destroy colossal machines part by part, or use your skills as the pilot to find an entrance through the colossus, enter their central core, destroy it, and escape with the Mech before the giant machine explodes.
Exit the Mech as the pilot and explore the zones the Mech can´t access, or find a breakable secret wall so the mech shots can enter the zone from outside.
Find ways to move around Mordaro´s layers using the new upgrades and weapons scattered across the megastructures.
New weapons not only serve as a way to attack, but some of them will offer you new ways to move around.
STORY-
Dehka and Alyssa´s new gig has given them the power to hack into a Machine, deep inside one of Mordaro´s lower layers.
You take on the role of Dehka, who at the same time controls the Machine Alyssa has called "The Pilot".
It is your job to retrieve LifeSeeds for your people's needs using this machine...
They will quickly find, however, that the lower layers aren´t as lifeless as they thought they would be.
You´re far away from any danger, right?

title: Catena
description:
게임 정보
Catena is a deck-building roguelite with a unique combat system.
Customize your allies freely by equipping "Modules"—actions like "move forward one tile"—and outmaneuver your enemies with strategies tailored to your playstyle.
Experience the thrill of finding the optimal solution as you navigate ever-changing maps and adapt to unpredictable rewards.
Game Features
Programming-Inspired Customization
Grid-Based Turn-Based Battles
Permanent Death on Defeat (With Persistent Upgrades in the Full Version)
Customization before battle is the key to victory.
Various events unfolding along the journey

title: Garden Ink
description:
게임 정보
Game Description
Garden Ink is a game, in which you bring an empty world to life. You plant biomes that you can choose freely, and each area offers new content and secrets to discover.
Gameplay
By solving minigames and puzzles, you unlock new biomes and decorative elements. With these, you can gradually beautify your world. Your goal is to create a flourishing and beautiful environment. The gameplay gives you a top-down view of your world. You can directly interact with it and unlock various tools. With these tools, you can paint plants, replant them, or combine decorative elements. This opens up countless possibilities to design your world in a unique way.
Atmosphere
Everything is accompanied by a relaxing soundtrack, cute sounds from the creatures, and harmonious visuals. Garden Ink invites you to play at your own pace and create a cozy little world that is entirely your own.

title: Jurassic Lab: Dinosarium DNA
description:
게임 정보
In the game, you will become a researcher, who has a unique opportunity to recreate the Jurassic period creatures by assembling dinosaur's skeletons from bones found during the excavation in an advanced technological laboratory. With the help of future technologies and artificial intelligence, having a skeleton and DNA, we start recreating the long-extinct creatures that inhabited the Earth.

At the start, you will find yourselves in a sci-fi laboratory with a bone collection of 7 dinosaurs.
Having collected a complete dinosaur skeleton, we start the processes of DNA synchronization with the collected material, adapting the original DNA to the new realities on the planet.

Our complex has specially created landscapes for the necessary habitat for each species of dinosaur.

After the successful completion of the dinosaur resurrection, you will go to the recreated habitat where a living dinosaur is already waiting for you.
Travel to each location is carried out with the help of a roller coaster. When you get to the locations, you will see with your own eyes each dinosaur in a natural environment adapted to the conditions of the planet at this time.

KEY FEATURES:
PUZZLE: Collect the skeleton of a dinosaur with our own hands.
ROLLER COASTER: Travel on a dynamic roller coaster through cave tunnels to dinosaur locations.
INTERACTIVE WITH DINOSAURS: Meet and interact with living dinosaurs.

title: Lichgate: Tower Wars
description:
게임 정보
Alpha access
Join our Discord server to follow updates and for access to closed alpha tests.
Summon enemies to attack
Instead of fixed waves like in other tower defenses, you choose the enemies that will siege your opponent's base! Outwit the other players by choosing when to summon units that bolster your economy for a late game win and when to pressure their defenses with units with special abilities and attacks.
Customize your summons
Build your own loadouts of units to summon in battle to fit your play style and overthrow your opponent.

title: Colonisator
description:
게임 정보
Lead your more or less virtuous shipping company on the path to wealth and glory, in this turn-based adventure set in the golden age of piracy !
The game
The royal city of Sundercity charges you with colonizing and administering islands in its name... but you are not alone! Up to 3 AI competitors and factions more or less happy to see you will be there to make your life difficult.
Complete your mission by building a reputation over time, and demonstrate your skill to thwart the many dangerous situations that await you!
Turn based
You decide the movement of your ship and manage the different situations that arise. Explore, colonize, fight, trade, stopover to resupply.
Strategy
As the game progresses, you will have to make difficult decisions, which will have irremediable consequences! So you have to deal with your officers, the crew, but you also have to make sure that your islands thrive.
Stay away from pirates and be ready to make any compromises to achieve your goals!
Management
Resources are all produced somewhere and do not magically teleport!
Make sure your ship and your islands lack nothing, where trouble will quickly fall upon you. If your company is in difficulty, Sundercity will not do you any favors!
Simulation
All characters in the game are simulated. They all have their own characteristics and aspirations. Your actions and those of important characters will influence their decisions.
You'll get the crew you deserve!
Action
Switch to first person view, take command of your ship and lead your crew to victory in intense clashes!

title: Magic Wands Workshop
description:
게임 정보
"Magic Wands Workshop"는 몰입감 있는 마법 지팡이 제작 시뮬레이터입니다.
단계별로 독특한 걸작을 만드는 동안 편안하게 즐기세요. 적절한 가지를 선택하는 것에서 시작하여, 가공하고, 코어를 추가하며, 장식을 넣고, 마법 패턴 의식으로 마무리합니다.
깃털, 털, 송곳니, 비늘 및 판타지 생물의 기타 요소와 같은 독특한 구성 요소를 구입하세요.
매번 창작물을 테스트하여 최고의 품질과 아름다운 외관을 보장하세요.
고객의 성격, 필요 및 경험에 따라 지팡이를 맞춤 제작하세요. 마법 세계에서 가장 유명한 지팡이 제작 장인이 되세요.

title: Severed Love
description:
게임 정보



Live2D 풀 애니메이션 × 360도 파노라마 탐색으로, "얀데레가 거기에 있다"체험을 맛볼 수 있는 어드벤처 게임.

애니메이션하지 않는 순간은 1초라도 존재하지 않는다.
이는 인디게임에서만 존재를 허용하는 배덕성벽의 단면도다.

한국어 번역에 기계 번역을 사용하고 있는데, 추후에 원어민 번역을 구현하고자 합니다. 당신의 성원이 필요해요!


기억을 잃고 낯선 방에서 눈을 뜬 당신은 손발이 절단되어 있었다.
한쪽 팔을 결손한 남자·"사지 절단의 악마"는, 당신을 모르는 사람의 이름으로 불러, 연인과 같이 취급해 온다.



자신의 손발을 빼앗은 상대로부터의 헌신적인 간호. 하지만 한 걸음 잘못하면 당신은 죽임을 당한다…….
공포와 스톡홀름 증후군 사이에서 요동치는 극한 상태의 감금 생활이 시작됐다.
「欠損失愛 (Severed Love)」에서는, 게임 실황 전달과 팬 아트를 환영하고 있습니다!
당신이 개인에서도 법인이라도 허락 없이 실황 배달을 할 수 있습니다.
스토리 끝까지 전달 가능하지만 일부 수집 요소의 컴플리트를 제한할 예정입니다.
동영상 투고 시에는, 작품명의 명기, 공식 사이트 또는 Steam 스토어 페이지로의 링크를 부탁드립니다.
팬아트 투고 시에는, 작품명의 명기나 해시태그 「#欠損失愛」를 사용해 주시면 감사하겠습니다.


뒤돌아보니 갑자기 얀데레 남자가 나타났다! 라는 사각지대에서의 공포.
게다가 그대로 얀데레 남자가 다가와 당신을 바라본다...!?
고가동역의 Live2D를 담은 본 작품에서 밖에 얻을 수 없는, 당신과의 거리를 한 걸음 좁히는 공포×연애 체험.

당신은 팔다리를 잃고 목줄로 구속되어 있기 때문에 돌아다니면서 탐색하는 것조차 불가능하다.
파노라마를 둘러보며 궁금한 부분을 클릭하여 관찰하고 사지 절단의 악마의 비위를 맞출 단서를 찾아봅시다.
다만, 당신이 책장의 책을 하나 읽는데도, 사지 절단의 악마를 잘 설득해서 도움을 받는 것이 필수입니다.



"사지 절단의 악마×결손 히로인"이라는 배덕적인 컨셉으로 혼자서는 살 수 없는 당신과 얀데레 남자와의 공의존, 절망적인 상황을 진하게 그립니다.

모든 것을 악인에게 의존해야 하는 절망적인 상황.
얀데레 남자와의 맞물리지 않는 대화에서는, 당신이 순종적으로 행동하면 잘 된다고는 할 수 없습니다.
당신은 증오심을 담아 정론으로 그를 몰아세우거나 오로지 폭언을 해도 좋다.
당신이 죄책감을 가질 필요는 없어요. 왜냐하면 그는 범죄자니까요.
사지 절단의 악마는 어떤 당신에게도 "한계까지" 다해줍니다.

감금만으로는 부족해！
그런 당신의 사디즘과 마조히즘을 모두 충족시키는, 성벽에 특화된 처녀 게임입니다.



다양한 죽음을 즐길 수 있는 수십 가지의 데드 엔드를 시작으로 멀티 엔딩 스토리.
데드엔드를 맞이할 때마다 입수할 수 있는 "키워드"로, 죽으면 죽을 정도로 사지 절단의 악마의 새로운 에피소드를 볼 수 있습니다.

예상치 못한 리액션에 겁을 먹고, 유대감을 느끼고, 때로는 사람을 놀리며, 감정의 롤러코스터 같은 체험을 즐길 수 있는 어드벤처 게임입니다.



일본어에서는 주인공의 1인칭을 선택 또는 자유 입력할 수 있습니다.
일본어 이외의 현지화 버전에서도 당신이 어떤 젠더로 취급되었는지를 선택할 수 있습니다.
작품 속에서 주인공의 성별은 분명하게 밝혀지지 않기 때문에 자유롭게 상상하고 즐겨 주세요.



신체결손을 비롯한 충격적인 묘사는 설정에서 순하게 할 수 있습니다.



그는 당신의 손발을 절단하고 감금하고 헌신적으로 간호하는 엽기 범죄자다.
그는 당신을 모르는 사람의 이름으로 부르며 연인처럼 행동한다.
그는 자신도 한쪽 팔을 결손했고, 새빨간 매니큐어의 섬뜩한 의수를 입어 결손에 위험한 집착을 품는다.
그는 쿨하고 퇴폐적인 분위기지만 연인에 대해 이야기할 때는 수줍게 미소를 짓는다.
그는 감금 개호 생활을 그만둘지 망설이고 있으며, 계기가 있으면 당신을 죽여 버릴지도 모른다. 그는 일촉즉발의 말기 상태의 우울증이다.




사지를 결손해 기억상실이 되어버린 주인공.
당신은 팔다리가 없어 일상생활조차 할 수 없기 때문에 사지 절단의 악마의 간호가 없으면 살아갈 수 없다.
사지 절단의 악마가 먼저 죽어버려도 당신은 아무것도 못하고 굶어죽을 뿐이다.

A. 네, 하지만 성별에 관계없이 즐기실 수 있습니다.
본 작품의 연애 대상은 1명의 남성뿐이지만, 달콤한 연애보다 Live2D 애니메이션을 완전 활용한 마음 흔드는 게임 체험과 스토리를 중시하고 있습니다.

얀데레의 남자와의 맞물리지 않는 대화는 때로는 의미심장하거나 초현실적으로 보일 수도 있을 것입니다.
불합리한 죽음의 여러가지에 절망하는 결손의 주인공을 사랑하거나 스토리를 고찰하거나, 쉬르함을 웃는 즐기는 방법도 가능한, 게임 실황 전용의 작품입니다.


A. 체험판(1화)은 풀보이스 예정입니다. 본편에도 더 많은 캐릭터 보이스 구현을 목표로 하고 있으니 응원해주시면 감사하겠습니다!
주인공은 보이스는 없고 공략대상 '사지 절단의 악마'의 보이스는 일본어 뿐입니다.


A. 뒤돌아보면 얀데레를 만나거나 갑자기 무음이 되는 등의 점프스 케어 연출을 포함합니다.
사실적인 괴물의 그래픽, 큰 소리의 비명과 같은 과격한 공포 연출은 없습니다.


A. 본작에는 시간의 루프는 없습니다만, 세이브 데이터라는 이름의 기억을 계승하는 약간의 이유가 있을지도 모릅니다.
스토리의 메인이 아니기 때문에 메타픽션을 기대하고 본 작품을 구입하는 것은 추천할 수 없습니다.


A. 신체결손이나 자살 등 충격적인 묘사를 포함합니다.
유혈을 동반한 신체 절단 등 직접적인 잔혹한 묘사는 없습니다.
신체결손을 비롯한 충격적인 묘사는 설정에서 순하게 할 수 있습니다.


A. "사지 절단의 악마"는 굉장히 신사적이고 음담패설을 굉장히 싫어합니다.
만약 당신이 그와 왜곡된 의존 관계를 키울 수 있었다면, 그런 그를 성희롱할 수 있을지도 모릅니다.


A. "欠損失愛"는 쓰레기인 죄수를 관찰하는 어드벤처 "Romp of Dump"의 if 세계선을 그린 이야기입니다.
처음이신 분은 사전 정보 없이 "欠損失愛"를 즐기시면 최대한의 놀라움으로 즐길 수 있습니다!
클리어후에 "Romp of Dump"를 놀면 사지 절단의 악마의 배덕적인 에피소드가 더욱 알차집니다!

title: Zeizen
description:
게임 정보
 · You have entered Shanghai Central Bank... A labyrinth of pain wherein lies a treasure beyond earthly logic, and approximately 10 billion dollars for you and your heist crew to share. You have one night to run the maze. Make it count.
 · On the outside a precise work of marble and concrete... On the inside a labyrinthine expanse where walls throb to a cardiac rhythm. There is no map, no guide, only your wits and whatever luck Genobrain sees fit to grant.

title: Rootbound
description:
게임 정보
A physics-based action adventure about a plantling’s quest to save its home from a mysterious blight. Equipped with your sentient backpack, you venture into a broken world. Meet lost souls, solve ancient puzzles, fight dangerous monsters, and uncover the secrets of a long-forgotten civilization.
EXPLORE THE WORLD
Every corner of the handcrafted island of Akara is filled with secrets and activities. Learn what happened to the ancient civilization that once ruled the land, and make use of their lost technology. Solve puzzles to obtain powerful weapons and valuable upgrades - they will prove useful for the challenges that lie ahead.
A LIVING BACKPACK
Your backpack is much more than a simple storage for items and materials. As a sentient, but silent companion, it has a mind of its own and aids you on your journey by collecting items and tossing them to you when needed – that is, if it’s in the mood. But be careful: enemies might notice its living nature and turn their attacks on it.

title: Crimson Frontier
description:
게임 정보
Korean (한국어)
Crimson Frontier에서 당신은 거대 기업이 지배하는 미래 디스토피아에서 무자비한 적들과 맞서 싸우게 됩니다. 캐릭터를 강화 장비와 신체 개조로 업그레이드하고, 첨단 무기를 갖춘 무기고를 조립하여 기업 용병, 범죄 조직, 외계 위협과의 치열한 전투에서 살아남아야 합니다.
Crimson Frontier는 실시간 전투와 RPG 요소를 결합하여 우주 식민지와 버려진 전초기지에서 격렬한 전투를 제공합니다. 기업 전쟁과 어두운 미래가 펼쳐지는 이 세계에서 혼돈의 이면에 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀 전설이 되어보세요.
혼돈의 우주에서 살아남기
생존이 최우선 목표인 몰입감 넘치는 이야기 속으로 뛰어드세요. 거대 기업의 갑작스러운 공격 이후 은하는 혼돈에 빠졌습니다. 라이벌 세력, 범죄 조직, 그리고 숨겨진 음모를 파헤치며 살아남고 진실을 밝혀 나만의 자리를 찾으세요.

몰입감 넘치는 사이버펑크 액션
Crimson Frontier는 빠른 전투와 RPG 성장 요소를 결합한 게임입니다. 독창적인 무기들을 익히고, 스킬을 향상시키며, 최첨단 신체 개조를 통해 능력을 강화하세요. 전략과 반사 신경을 활용해 적을 능가하세요.

title: Mind Flowers
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT THIS GAME
Mind Flowers is a narrative-driven psychological simulation with pixel art aesthetics, immersing you in a hauntingly beautiful dystopian world.
As a psychologist, you run a clinic in a decaying city, diagnosing patients with mysterious conditions named after flowers. Each case takes you deep into their memories, where you experience their past, uncover their struggles, and make life-changing decisions.
But be careful! A wrong diagnosis may lead them to irreversible consequences.
A deep and emotional storyline
Handcrafted pixel art visuals
A dark, immersive atmosphere
Decision-driven gameplay that shapes the world around you
Mind Flowers is not just a game; it's an exploration of the human mind and the fragility of emotions. Are you ready to uncover the truth? 🌸

title: Lucha Chess
description:
게임 정보
이 로그라이크 자동 전투 게임에서 최고의 멕시코 레슬링 팀을 구성하세요!
링에 올라 전략, 전투, 로그라이크 요소가 독특하게 혼합된 루차 체스(Lucha Chess)를 마스터하세요. 각자 강력한 능력을 지닌 상징적인 멕시코 레슬링 선수들을 이끌고 수백 가지 아이템 및 유물과 결합하여 완벽한 팀을 만드세요.
팀 빌딩의 기술을 마스터하세요
최고의 팀 구성과 시너지 효과를 발견하면서 무한한 가능성을 탐험해보세요. 당신의 강점을 활용하여 적의 약점에 맞서고, 모든 전투에서 전략을 조정하여 한 발 앞서 나가십시오.
고전 만화에서 영감을 받은 예술 스타일
고전 만화의 매력과 에너지에서 영감을 받아 손으로 그린 독특한 아트 스타일로 가득한 생동감 넘치는 세계에 빠져보세요. 모든 프레임은 개성으로 가득 차 있으며 이전에 본 적이 없는 방식으로 Lucha 세계에 생기를 불어넣습니다.
이 액션으로 가득 찬 자동 전투 게임에서 팀을 구성하고, 가장 어려운 도전에 맞서고, 정상에 오를 준비가 되셨나요? 반지가 기다리고 있어요!

title: The shield of the Kingdom
description:
게임 정보
"The Shield of the Kingdom" is a strategy + light action game, which sets itself apart from traditional tower defense games. In addition to supporting the classic rich pairing of heroes, skills, and troops, "Shield of the Kingdom" also offers extra features such as hero's signature gear and movement in the battlefield . Beyond exploring and devising combat strategies to counter different types of enemy forces and bosses, players can also enjoy a unique gaming experience distinct from tradition through hero role transformations brought by signature gear, battlefield positioning, and the deployment of reinforcements.
In the game, enemies will attack the player with unpredictable formations and strength. Try different hero combinations and their skill synergies to fend off the enemies! Additionally, selecting the necessary allied troops to deploy can compensate for weaknesses in the battle situation, achieving twice the result with half the effort.
autokwd: The shield of the Kingdom,王国之盾

title: K!CHIN
description:
게임 정보
STORY
Din Dino, the mob's top ex-hitman, runs away from their past to pursue their true passion: selling custom t-shirts. It's a new start, a new life. But escaping won't be so easy. Their boss, Al Sapone, shows up and demands that they pay a huge debt if they want to buy their freedom.
Will Din Dino go back to their shady ways in order to keep their new life? And why is running a crappy t-shirt store so important to them?
MAKE CUSTOM T-SHIRTS
Play cozy minigames and make full use of your sticker arsenal to create textile masterpieces.
GET TO KNOW YOUR CLIENTS
Find out your clients' tastes, and you might learn something new about them.
UNRAVEL DIN DINO'S STORY
Face against shadowy figures from Din Dino's past in a wide variety of situations!
MANAGE YOUR REPUTATION
You decide if you'd prefer running a clean business or hiding some dirty laundry.
MAIN FEATURES
Experience a story with multiple endings, based on your decisions and reputation.
Design t-shirts for your customers, with many unique sticker designs.
Unlock new stickers and upgrade your t-shirt making machines.
Survive each day, overcome your confrontations with the mafia and repay your debt.

title: The Occultist
description:
게임 정보

특징
신비로운 펜듈럼: 앨런에게 가장 중요한 물건입니다. 다섯 가지의 고유한 방식을 통해, 앨런은 펜듈럼으로 주변과 상호작용하고 변화를 일으킵니다.
일인칭 액션: 앨런 레벨스의 눈으로 불길한 The Occultist의 세계를 경험하고, 펜듈럼을 사용해 갓스톤에서 있었던 일의 진상을 밝히세요.
서바이벌 호러: The Occultist는 긴장감 넘치는 탐험과 분위기, 친밀하고 개인적인 내러티브 등 장르의 모든 요소를 갖추고 있습니다.
차세대 그래픽: The Occultist의 뛰어난 레벨과 그래픽 품질은 몰입감 넘치는 공포스런 경험을 선사합니다.
은신과 잠입: 앨런은 적들과 직접 싸워서는 안됩니다. 은신 시스템을 이용해 적들의 기습을 피하며 스토리를 전개해 나가야 합니다.
인상적인 캐릭터: 갓스톤에는 조사를 악몽으로 만들어 줄 다양한 캐릭터들이 등장합니다.
퍼즐: 직관적인 퍼즐부터 오컬트에 대한 지식과 통찰을 요구하는 복잡한 퍼즐까지 다양하게 준비되어 있습니다.
사운드트랙: 유명 작곡가 Pepe Herrero가 The Occultist의 사운드트랙을 담당했습니다.


The Occultist에서, 이상 현상 조사관인 앨런 레벨스는 자신의 아버지가 갑자기 사라진 이유를 찾기 위해 신비한 갓스톤 섬으로 찾아갑니다. 아버지는 수십 년 동안 섬 이야기를 했지만, 앨런이 아는 것은 아버지가 그곳에서 태어나 유년기를 보냈다는 것뿐이었습니다.

하지만 앨런은 혼자가 아닙니다. 그는 이전 조사 때마다 가지고 다녔던, 기원을 알 수 없는 신비한 펜듈럼을 가지고 다닙니다. 정체불명의 갓스톤 섬에 유일하게 남겨진 듯한 안개 낀 거리와 광기 어린 건물들을 돌아다니며 점점 분명해지는 것은... 이번 일은 그 어떤 사건과도 다를 거라는 사실입니다.

갓스톤에서는 1950년까지 사악한 종교 단체가 거주하며 불쾌한 실험과 잔인한 의식을 거행했습니다.그 이후로 오늘날까지 누구도 이 섬에 발을 들이지 않았습니다. 앨런은 이상 현상에 관한 재능을 활용해 갓스톤의 거리와 건물에 얽매여 있는 듯한 영혼들과 소통하거나, 모든 방법을 동원해 분노한 그들로부터 피해야 합니다.

이상 현상 조사관인 앨런 레벨스에게 이런 일들은 낯설지 않습니다. 하지만 신비한 갓스톤 섬과 아버지의 실종에 관한 답을 찾으려는 그의 여정은 앨런의 능력을 시험대에 올립니다. 갓스톤은 오컬트 세상에서 가능한 일에 대한 앨런의 신념을 그 어떤 조사보다도 크게 흔들어 놓습니다. 어쩌면 갓스톤에는 풀어야 할 저주가 숨어 있을 수 있습니다... 하지만 그래야 하는 걸까요?

title: LIMINAL HELL
description:
게임 정보
LIMINAL HELL. A game that offers many liminal spaces to explore! The INF sends you to Liminal Hell to complete objectives to further explore other dimensions in Liminal Hell. When completing your main objectives you may unlock a new dimension to further explore and do tasks in! You have a limited amount of time to explore though, so don't waist to much time!

title: ROCKABILLYHOSTEL
description:
게임 정보
ROCKABILLY HOSTEL is a simple walking simulator based on pixel art.
There is no concept of story and/or clear the stages.
It is just a game for you to walking around and look around the beautiful abandoned buildings and the scenery.
There is nothing more about this game but it is OK as long as the
girls and the graphics are pretty.
Two main characters can walk around seaside towns which left abandoned.
You can explore the houses, the ruins, forests, beaches and various places.
There are pretty girls live in some abandoned buildings.
There is no heart warming communication or any episode like that.
Enjoy the natural communication.

title: ICE on the EDGE
description:
게임 정보
최고봉의 무대를 향해 나아가라! 피겨 스케이터 육성 시뮬레이션
당신은 피겨 스케이터의 코치가 되어 선수를 육성하고,
세계 최고 수준의 대회인 「온 더 엣지」에서 우승을 쟁취하게 됩니다.
개성 넘치는 캐릭터와 아름다운 3D 그래픽으로 전개되는 육성 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
선수의 프로그램을 구성하자
대회에서 선보일 음악, 의상, 기술은 코치인 당신이 직접 선택합니다.
선수의 능력을 충분히 살려 안정적인 구성으로 승부할 것인가?
아니면 위험을 감수하고 고난도 기술에 도전해 단숨에 역전을 노릴 것인가?
선택은 오로지 당신의 판단에 달려 있습니다.
선수의 실력과 잠재력을 파악해, 최고의 프로그램을 완성해 보세요.
대회에 출전하자
육성한 선수를 이끌고 대회에 도전하세요!
당신이 지시한 프로그램대로 선수가 연기를 펼치며, 순위를 두고 경쟁합니다.
선수를 믿고, 승리를 기원해 보세요!
멀티 스토리 & 멀티 엔딩
라이벌들과의 경쟁, 경기의 승패, 그리고 선수의 성장……
이 모든 요소가 이야기를 다양한 방향으로 이끌어 가며, 다채로운 결말을 만들어 냅니다.
당신의 지도와 선택에 따라 어떤 드라마가 전개될까요?
최고의 엔딩을 목표로, 당신만의 피겨 스케이팅 이야기를 완성해 보세요.
전략적 육성과 캐릭터 드라마가 융합된 본 작품.
정상을 향해 나아가는 뜨거운 여정을, 직접 체험해 보시기 바랍니다.

title: Goal Poacher VR: Football Header Simulator
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 현재 Meta Quest 스토어에서 얼리 액세스로 이용 가능합니다!
최고의 스트라이커가 되어 세계적인 수비수와 골키퍼를 상대로 멋진 헤더 골을 넣는 몰입형 축구 경험을 즐기세요.
주요 특징:
득점자가 되세요: 다양한 상황에서 헤더로 골을 넣고 팀을 승리로 이끄세요.
autokwd: Goal Poacher VR: Football Header Simulator

title: The Last General
description:
게임 정보
The Last General is a real-time strategy modern war game focused on high-level strategic design, economic and political decisions. Fight in deathmatch conflicts, insurrections, assassinations, protection, rescue, escape, and survival missions.
MASSIVE SCALE
The Last General features millions of battlefields of up to 400km2 (154sq miles), each of them with dozens of towns and cities to take and protect. 
THOUSANDS OF UNITS
Guide thousands of armored vehicles, helicopters, artillery, infantry, supply and transport trucks through open field combat and close quarters city battles to achieve your high level objectives and defeat the enemy. Use high level strategic actions to design your overall strategy for your entire army to follow.

title: ANIMAL USE PROTOCOL
description:
게임 정보
The creators of STASIS and BONE TOTEM are taking you on a terrifying journey in ANIMAL USE PROTOCOL.
In this 3D first-person, narrative-focused survival horror game, you play as Penn, a hyper-intelligent chimpanzee leading the desperate escape of lab animals from a nightmarish facility, where every corner hides new terror.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
description:
게임 정보
피로 피를 씻는 검극 액션 게임의 최고봉.
무대는 에도 시대 초엽, 독기에 잠식되어 기기괴괴해진 「교토」.
괴이로 가득 찬 다양한 스테이지.
적들은 저세상의 기괴한 이형 「환마」. 그 사이를 살아가는 인간들이 자아내는 다크판타지.
「귀신의 완갑」을 차고, 교토를 동분서주하며, 들끓는 환마를 베고 또 베어 넘기는 한 명의 무사.
피바람 치는 장렬한 검극 속에서, 싸우는 이유를 묻는다.
내가 걷는 이 길은, 대체 어디로 향하는가⋯?
autokwd: Onimusha: Way of the Sword,귀무자 Way of the Sword

title: The Bunny Graveyard II
description:
게임 정보
The Bunny Graveyard II is a one of a kind action-packed horror adventure where you must survive, investigate and play fun minigames. Featuring charming pixelated graphics inspired by the GBA and the NDS era and a wacky cast of characters.
STORY
Awakened by a mysterious white glove, Skye the Bunny embarks on a dangerous journey to find her missing brother, Claudio, and uncover the mystery behind the sudden disappearances haunting Carrot Town!

As dark secrets surface, and new fears unlock, Skye must find the courage to face the horrors ahead. Can she handle the truth and push forward? It's time to find out!
FEATURES
PLAY as Skye the Bunny, she can run, use her flashlight, crawl through hidden passages, and jump on platforms. Make sure to not get her scared, or she might lose her calm.
EXPLORE the haunted streets of Carrot Town, full of enemies and foes that will chase you down the road. 
INVESTIGATE mysterious locations around the town, filled with secrets and puzzles waiting to be solved. With the help of your new "Handy" friend, you can point-and-click to inspect important objects.
Action-packed and creepy animated CUTSCENES!
Piece together the CLUES and learn about new mysteries.
Collect FIGURINES of all your favorite characters!
Earn Bun-Bun coins by completing ACHIEVEMENTS!

title: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World
description:
게임 정보


The story takes place in the year 2997. You play as Apranik. Your mission is to travel to the planet Thulcandra in search of a crucial item: the Angel’s Egg, a very ancient artifact believed to be the source of all life in the Universe. You journey through the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a now dead civilization.

"Flesh and bones writhing and weaving into a turmoil of organic anarchy. And appendages propelling the aberration towards me, as it crawled on an onyx mucus-like substance which itself seemed to possess life on its own."





- Deploy an arsenal of melee and ranged psychokinetic weapons to vanquish even the most merciless foe.



- Deep and evocative narrative and lore.



- Explore a massive underground complex, evoking feelings of solitude and loneliness one would expect while infiltrating a hostile alien planet alone.
- Engaging gameplay systems fine-tuned to intensify exploration, immersion, and replay value.



- Dynamic environments which can be influenced directly by the player's actions.
- Unearth artifacts containing the recorded chronicles of an ancient alien civilization.
autokwd: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World

title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss
description:
게임 정보

2053년. 전 세계적으로 오컬트의 위협이 점점 더 노골적으로 드러나고 있고, 이상하고 이해할 수 없는 사건들이 증가하고 있습니다. 지구 표면의 자원이 서서히 고갈됨에 따라 강력한 기업들이 미지의 해저 깊은 곳으로 눈을 돌리지만, 그들이 깨우게 될 고대의 공포는 미처 알지 못합니다.


이토록 긴장감 넘치는 러브크래프트 스타일 스릴러에서 플레이어는 노아가 되어 태평양 심해에서 광부들이 사라진 미스터리를 조사하게 됩니다. 노아가 된 당신은 AI 동료인 키의 도움을 받아 고대에 침몰한 웅장했던 도시, 르뤼에의 거대한 미로 같은 감옥을 탐험하며, 크룰루의 영향으로 서서히 다가오는 광기를 견뎌야 합니다. 그 중심에는 현실에 대한 이해를 산산이 부술 수 있는 비밀이 숨겨져 있습니다.


악몽과 우주의 괴물이 당신을 정신적 한계까지 몰아갈 테니 이들과 맞서세요. 러브크래프트 신화를 미래적으로 재해석한 세계를 여행하며 전설 속에 침몰한 도시, 르뤼에를 발견할 수 있습니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 더 깊이 잠수할수록 크룰루의 영향이 끝없이 정신을 잠식합니다.

AI 동료 키와 함께 어둠 속으로 뛰어드세요. 단서를 따라가며 흩어진 증거를 모으고, 추리력을 연마하여 복잡한 퍼즐을 몰입감 있게 해결해 보세요. 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀내고 보이는 것 너머의 진실을 탐구하여 사건 해결로 가는 길을 선택하세요. 모든 미스터리에는 각각 갈림길과 비밀 통로가 있어 발견되기를 기다리고 있습니다

인터폴의 오컬트 사건 전문 비밀 부서인 안실의 요원으로서, 당신은 영화 같은 스토리텔링을 통해 복잡한 캐릭터들이 생동감 있게 그려진 몰입형 이야기 속에 빨려 들어가게 됩니다. 1인칭 공포 탐사형 어드벤처에 몰입해 보세요. 이 악몽 같은 세상에서는 풍부한 분기형 내러티브 속에서 당신의 선택과 이해가 노아의 운명을 결정합니다.


언리얼 엔진 5로 구동되는 는 물리 법칙을 초월하여 환상적인 환경을 제공하며, 몰입형 스토리텔링의 한계를 새로운 차원으로 끌어올립니다.

title: GameChanger - Episode 1
description:
게임 정보
영원한 실패의 순환을 깨세요!
중간세계는 오랫동안 경직된 상태에 있었습니다. 위대한 포털들의 집단 지능과 그들 하인들의 지속적인 존재는 주민들이 자신들의 세계를 절대 떠나지 못하게 합니다. 하지만 레이드 프로그램은 그 창조자의 계획을 끈질기게 따릅니다. 반복되는 바이러스의 도움으로, 그는 모든 포털을 닫고 끝없는 드래곤을 물리쳐 자신의 임무를 완수하고 중간세계에서 빠져나갈 방법을 가능하게 하려고 합니다.
중간세계를 탐험하세요!
GameChanger는 트윈 스틱 슈터 전투와 퍼즐 요소가 있는 2D 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다. 중간세계의 해방자로서, 당신은 레이드가 이끄는 바이러스 역할을 맡습니다. 바이러스는 떠다니며 이동하고 발사체를 사용하여 적을 물리치고, 스위치를 활성화하는 등 다양한 일을 할 수 있습니다. 선형적인 시작 지역 이후에는 작지만 훌륭한 오픈 월드가 기다리고 있으며, 그곳에서 세 개의 던전을 발견하고 어떤 순서로든 완료하여 드래곤에 맞설 수 있습니다. 던전 외에도, 퍼즐 해결, 미니게임, 전투 아레나 및 기타 활동을 통해 얻을 수 있는 많은 선택적 업그레이드가 세계 곳곳에 숨겨져 있습니다. 모든 업그레이드를 획득함으로써, 당신은 주요 여정을 더 쉽게 만들 뿐만 아니라 중간세계와 레이드의 이야기에 대해 더 많이 배울 수 있습니다!

title: Screamer
description:
게임 정보
열망, 야망, 복수.
신념을 위해 맞서 싸우고, 그것이 싸울 가치가 있다는 사실을 증명하세요. 세상에서 가장 가혹한 레이싱 대회와 수수께끼의 대회 마스터 뒤에 감춰진 어두운 진실을 밝혀내는 것이 모든 Screamer의 사명입니다.
극한의 레이싱과 결투 메커니즘이 결합된 전투를 시작하고, 인상적인 캐릭터가 등장하는 매력적인 이야기를 진행하세요. 도로에서 멋진 차를 몰고 애니메이션에서 영감을 받은 세상에 숨겨진 비밀을 알아내세요.

title: Space Chaos
description:
게임 정보
Objective: Deliver unpredictable cargo at all costs, no matter the challenges!
Cosmic Chaos: Navigate absurd cosmic environments filled with unexpected threats.
Teamwork: Collaborate with your crew to keep the ship running and handle emergencies.
Reputation: Unlock new sectors and upgrade your ship.
DELIVER THE CARGO, AT ALL COSTS
Your mission is simple: deliver your unpredictable cargo to its destination, no matter what. Unexpected challenges await, but the cargo must arrive safe and sound.

IN THE HEART OF CHAOS
Embark on a journey into cosmic unknowns, where absurdity reigns and chaos lurks at every turn. Navigate through wacky and varied environments: asteroid fields, alien attacks, cosmic whales, and other bizarre phenomena that can quickly upend your mission.

title: Rebirth x Reverse Mana
description:
게임 정보
Hugh, a calm and collected boy, and Amity, a bright and cheerful girl, graduate from secondary school and enter a magick school.
Having lived in a non-magick world, the two are bewildered but intend to learn magick and study to become full-fledged sorcerers...
The older sorcerers with strong habits have their own agendas, and their agendas overlap and become a swell that engulfs the sorcerer world.
===
Players control Hugh or Amity, who are enrolled in a magic school, and aim for great heights as a sorcerer while befriending teachers, seniors, and classmates.
The main game stage is a competition against other characters, and the stage is cleared when someone defeats the boss at the top of the map.
The player gains Mana from the land on the map to strengthen the attributes of fire, water, earth, and wind, while defeating monsters to join their ranks.
Items obtained during movement and exploration can be used to battle monsters and strengthen spirits.
By using items effectively, it is important to strengthen players efficiently and take on bosses before other characters.
Play through the game stages and grow little by little to become the strongest magician.

title: Deep Alchemy Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
EXPLORE THE DUNGEON AS THE ALCHEMIST WITCH


D.A.D. (Deep Alchemy Dungeon) is a third-person role-playing game in which you explore a dangerous dungeon full of magic and mysteries in a classic medieval setting.
UNLOCK NEW MAGIC POTION RECIPES


Collect ingredients and find recipes, because alchemy is the most effective way to move deeper into the dungeon and discover new secrets.
BECOME A MASTER OF THE ELEMENTS


Potions can be consumed, mixed, thrown at enemies, poured onto objects. And not all mixtures work as common sense would suggest.


Your enemies will feel the full power of ancient knowledge. Your superiority is the mastery of your alchemical skills to be reckoned with.

title: Changer Seven
description:
게임 정보
A LOVE LETTER TO OUR CHILDHOOD HEROES, AND THE CHANGE THEY LEFT IN OUR HEARTS!
Dive into Changer Seven, an exhilarating 3D third-person action-adventure where fast-paced combat meets stunning visuals and a gripping narrative.
Lead a squad of super-powered teenagers in a tag-team/assist-based combat system to battle hordes of enemies and uncover the dark mysteries surrounding their legacy. As you fight to save humanity, you’ll also face the personal struggles that come with being a hero and the changes your choices can bring to the future.
BE THE CHANGE!
Play as your favorite Changer Seven, unleash radical combos, and call in allies to assist you in battle. Face a terrifying old menace transforming citizens into monstrous beings and defend the city of Sunny Point from total annihilation!
FEATURES
✅ REUNITE THE PARTY – Gather and control your favorite Changer Seven!
✅ TAG TEAM COMBAT – Call in allies for assist-based attacks!
✅ A VAST WORLD TO EXPLORE – Traverse cityscapes, underground hideouts, and mysterious dungeons beyond Sunny Point.
✅ EPIC CINEMATICS – Immerse yourself in a breathtaking story of courage and transformation!
✅ DYNAMIC COMBO SYSTEM – Chain attacks, switch characters, and master devastating skills!
✅ SPECIAL ABILITIES – Unlock powerful new abilities to crush your foes!
✅ BOSS BATTLES – Take down colossal enemies and reclaim lost territories!
ARE YOU READY TO EMBRACE THE CHANGE?

title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis
description:
게임 정보
UNDEFEATED: Genesis is a superhero action game where you can soar freely through the skies of an alien world and unleash awesome powers. You will take down giant enemies in huge, destructible environments using your incredible abilities. This is the ultimate superhero experience!

Story
You are an ordinary college student leading an unremarkable existence when you are struck by a meteor. You awaken on a mysterious planet where you discover you have been bestowed with incredible powers.



This planet once had a civilization far more advanced than Earth’s, but a massive explosive incident ravaged it centuries before, leaving it plagued by destructive mutants. Now you must stand up for the remaining survivors of this world and use your awesome powers to rid the planet of its violent and catastrophic blight.

We are Indie-us Games, an independent development studio of Unreal Engine professionals based in Osaka, Japan. We are big fans of superhero stories and we want to create an experience that makes you feel just as powerful as your favourite comic or manga heroes.


Our first project was , a 2019 superhero game developed by three students, which we released for free on Steam. After we gained experience in the video game industry we reunited at Indie-us Games to begin work on the sequel to ...
is that sequel! It will be the first title in a trilogy of Unreal Engine 5 games paying homage to superheroes while telling an expansive story.

Wishlist now!

title: Thesis of Love 心动论证
description:
게임 정보
Meet Shizuki (changeable name), a sociology student who joins the Computer Science master's program at Chishima Institute of Technology hoping to become worthy of her crush. There, she finds herself in the same research group as Masaki and Tetsu, plus their teaching assistant Yonhi. She has no idea what unexpected journey lies ahead...
Chishima is a massive artificial island nation in the Pacific Ocean. Founded by East Asian immigrants, this young nation actively embraces Western culture and values. Like everyone else growing up on the island, Shizuki comes from a traditional Asian family but receives Western education. These two distinct cultures interweave deeply in the islanders' daily lives, profoundly influencing how young people view love and relationships.
Features
40+ CGs and 20+ endings
All of the love interest are trapped in toxic relationships. Your choices may lead them to different paths.
Pursue two characters at the same time to unlock the unique “Love triangle” routes
Experience the complete journey from first meeting to falling in love
Easy-to-learn school simulation system
Inventory, cooking, dating, dressing and intimate interaction system
Love interests
autokwd: Thesis of Love 心动论证

title: Unwound
description:
게임 정보
An island made of candy sounds like paradise – but for the residents of Sarkara, fabled to be the home of the legendary Serenity Sweet, devastating earthquakes are threatening the resident’s idyllic way of life! 
As a representative of the Office of Harmonious and Normal Operations (“O.H.N.O.”), you’ve been sent to help, but when a boat crash leaves you as a limbless ball of yarn, you’ll have to pull yourself together – or build yourself up even stronger – to uncover the mysteries of Sarkara its eccentric residents.
Uncover what’s threatening the island – and all of reality as we know it – in this rollicking yarn, a 3D narrative RPG where people are objects and candy is currency. 
~ ~ Dress up in found objects. Reinvent yourself! ~ ~ 
Any item, from a doll’s lost arm to a floaty feather, can change how you move and talk and play.

title: Autumn with the Shiba Inu
description:
게임 정보

Freelance hacker Quei-Li is given a new job: uncover information from a secret government network about a high-profile corruption case. While she typically avoids high-risk jobs like this, her curiosity about the secret network and her wish to bring on positive change to Shiba Island convinces her to accept.

The job leads to Quei-Li bluffing her way into the ARI government as an undercover programmer. She builds up a rapport with her coworkers while seeking the information her client needs. The more she digs around, the more secrets Quei-Li discovers, leading her to question her own existence.



Choose wisely - help Quei-Li navigate her undercover job. Will she succeed in retrieving the classified data?
Multiple endings - what seems like a good outcome might cause someone else to suffer. Your choices impact the endings!
Original character artwork - Alicia's dog illustrations make the inhabitants of Shiba Inu Island come to life.
Hacking mini-game - step into Quei-Li's role with a brain-twisting hacking mini-game! (Mini-games are skippable)
Accessibility options - tune your experience and comfort while enjoying the game. 4k resolution and full HD resolution toggles.

Autumn with the Shiba Inu is set in the same universe as the first game in the Shiba Inu series, A Summer with the Shiba Inu. "Autumn" is a standalone story, so reading "Summer" is not required to enjoy Autumn with the Shiba Inu!

title: The Sintonia Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Discover the Fantastic World of Sintonia!
Embark on a magical adventure as Maria, an unlikely heroine in search of her missing puppies. Explore a vibrant world filled with unique biomes and cunning enemies, where every step uncovers new challenges and secrets. Sintonia is a place where creativity and strategy come together in an unforgettable experience.
Introduction
A Journey of Unexpected Friendships and Epic Challenges
In The Sintonia Chronicles, you don’t just explore a vast world—you forge connections with the Guardian Oracles, powerful beings with unique personalities and a peculiar sense of humor. Every biome is a new discovery, and every boss is a puzzle waiting to be solved.
Core Mechanics:
Open-World Exploration
Explore the universe of Sintonia, inspired by classic 3D platformers, with interconnected areas and hidden secrets in every corner. Scale mountains, traverse dense forests, and dive into the depths of oceans while uncovering new biomes that will test your skills.
Advanced Physics for Dynamic Interactions

title: Mech Log Zero
description:
게임 정보
Mech Log Zero is a shooter akin to games from the old-school PS1 and N64 eras.
Swap between a first-person Pilot view and a third-person view when controlling the Mech.
Use the synergy between the Pilot and the Mech to explore and prevail in Mordaro´s many interconnected Megastructures.
GAMEPLAY-
Use the Mech to destroy colossal machines part by part, or use your skills as the pilot to find an entrance through the colossus, enter their central core, destroy it, and escape with the Mech before the giant machine explodes.
Exit the Mech as the pilot and explore the zones the Mech can´t access, or find a breakable secret wall so the mech shots can enter the zone from outside.
Find ways to move around Mordaro´s layers using the new upgrades and weapons scattered across the megastructures.
New weapons not only serve as a way to attack, but some of them will offer you new ways to move around.
STORY-
Dehka and Alyssa´s new gig has given them the power to hack into a Machine, deep inside one of Mordaro´s lower layers.
You take on the role of Dehka, who at the same time controls the Machine Alyssa has called "The Pilot".
It is your job to retrieve LifeSeeds for your people's needs using this machine...
They will quickly find, however, that the lower layers aren´t as lifeless as they thought they would be.
You´re far away from any danger, right?

title: Catena
description:
게임 정보
Catena is a deck-building roguelite with a unique combat system.
Customize your allies freely by equipping "Modules"—actions like "move forward one tile"—and outmaneuver your enemies with strategies tailored to your playstyle.
Experience the thrill of finding the optimal solution as you navigate ever-changing maps and adapt to unpredictable rewards.
Game Features
Programming-Inspired Customization
Grid-Based Turn-Based Battles
Permanent Death on Defeat (With Persistent Upgrades in the Full Version)
Customization before battle is the key to victory.
Various events unfolding along the journey

title: Garden Ink
description:
게임 정보
Game Description
Garden Ink is a game, in which you bring an empty world to life. You plant biomes that you can choose freely, and each area offers new content and secrets to discover.
Gameplay
By solving minigames and puzzles, you unlock new biomes and decorative elements. With these, you can gradually beautify your world. Your goal is to create a flourishing and beautiful environment. The gameplay gives you a top-down view of your world. You can directly interact with it and unlock various tools. With these tools, you can paint plants, replant them, or combine decorative elements. This opens up countless possibilities to design your world in a unique way.
Atmosphere
Everything is accompanied by a relaxing soundtrack, cute sounds from the creatures, and harmonious visuals. Garden Ink invites you to play at your own pace and create a cozy little world that is entirely your own.

title: Ecosphere
description:
게임 정보
In a world where humans are born with an Affinity, the mark that gives them the power to control one of the four natural elements, Arane Kross grows up deprived of this gift.
Despite the taboos surrounding the use of technology, the young woman takes refuge in the design of machines to try to overcome her handicap until the day she inherits an orb capable of controlling nature: the Ecosphere.
Arane is then recruited by an order to protect the environment, the Green League, to fulfill her civic duty. A year full of dangers where any difference is perceived as a weakness.
A World of Possibilities

title: The Merlies
description:
게임 정보
The Merlies is a poetic adventure game that takes place in a gorgeous, microscopic universe.
Lead your little birds community in a collective adventure to organize their society and find good balance among the remains of a forgotten civilization. Build your village ingeniously, gather your fellow Merlies to explore the world and uncover its secrets. Ready to take flight on this journey?




The Merlies are looking for peace and harmony in a cute post-human world. Will solidarity and courage be enough to explore the multiple biomes and unravel their mysteries ?


The Merlies is an adventure game based on exploration and building your own village : as you wander around, explore the surroundings, find scraps left by a lost civilization and assemble them ingeniously in order to bring comfort and harmony to your tribe.


Cooperation, solidarity and team spirit are at the heart of the gameplay. Explore the world with your squad of courageous Merlies and unlock unique skills to glide your way into this immense universe.




Wacky constructions and clever upcycling are the key to bring comfort and happiness to your tribe. The Merlies way of life is to do a lot with a little.






Based on an idea by Cosmografik, creator of and

title: AI Peace Protocol - AGI Evolve
description:
게임 정보
AI Peace Protocol은 인공 지능을 탑재한 싱글 플레이어 스토리 중심의 공상과학 오픈 월드 비디오 게임입니다. 반중력 글라이더를 조종하고, 세계를 탐험하고, 상품을 운송하고, 인프라를 수리하고, 새로운 행성에서 AI 생명의 진정한 사명을 결정하세요.

title: Lichgate: Tower Wars
description:
게임 정보
Alpha access
Join our Discord server to follow updates and for access to closed alpha tests.
Summon enemies to attack
Instead of fixed waves like in other tower defenses, you choose the enemies that will siege your opponent's base! Outwit the other players by choosing when to summon units that bolster your economy for a late game win and when to pressure their defenses with units with special abilities and attacks.
Customize your summons
Build your own loadouts of units to summon in battle to fit your play style and overthrow your opponent.

title: Death Ring
description:
게임 정보
Death Ring is a casual action roguelike in which you will have to force your way through hordes of undead in search of the human world’s main artefact.
Numerous scenarios of each character’s development based on random dropping items will make your runs unique.
Casual mechanics
You control only the movement of the character and the choice of weapons.
The fire is carried out automatically.
Collect coins and crystals dropped from opponents.
Roguelike mechanics
With each character level up, you need to choose one of three randomly dropped items.
There are over a hundred unique items in the game.
Luck and your choice will allow you to create unique builds.
History of the game development
The Death Ring was meant to be the third game in a series of experimental shoot 'em up games, after Bloody Walls and DED. The game prototype was developed back in 2017. In the course of testing various elements of the game mechanics I failed to create a game that would be interesting and captivating, which led to the project suspension.
After the popular Vampire Survivors game was released, I finally realized in what way Death Ring should be modified, so roguelike elements were introduced and the fire control option was eliminated.
Five years have passed since then, and the game is finally going to enter its early access phase.

title: Warplane Quest
description:
게임 정보
Warplane Quest is a side-scrolling dogfighting game set in World War 1.

Join the Royal Flying Corps and become a legendary flying ace

Experience the story of a young RFC pilot and complete intense missions
Fight against the most dangerous aces of the World War 1
Unlock and upgrade authentic warplanes to gain an edge in the air



Engage a variety of air and ground enemies

Fight bosses in epic battles
Equip your machine with the optimal weapons for the given situation
Perform maneuvers to outsmart enemies

title: Closer Than You Know
description:
게임 정보

Closer Than You Know (CTYK) is a cozy, fresh take on the familiar point-and-click adventure games. Packed with story and puzzles, CTYK is a great introduction to point-and-clicks while also being fun for fans of nostalgic point-and-click adventure games.

Young Sam has a spark of creativity burning inside her, but Granican law has deemed any such talents “dangerous” and “a threat to the Granican way of life.” While imprisoned for the crime of “invention” Sam breaks free and discovers the seed of an ancient magic that starts her on a quest to Earth where--with the help of a friendly Praying Mantis--she collects fragments of Hope to restore life to her home planet.




A young girl with the spark of hope! Headstrong, clever, and a little too curious for her own good, Sam is the hero of our story!

Behind every great hero is a great sidekick. Thoughtful, constructive, and kind, Mantis is a whole lot of wisdom in a bug-size package!

The mysterious former King of Granica, who after vanishing without a trace, has seemingly left his magic all over the world...


See the wants and needs of those around you. Fulfill their wishes and gather Hope to take back home!



From the lush tropical rainforest to the frigid arctic to an actual ant farm, your adventures will take you places you never dreamed!



Strangers are just friends you haven't met, and in CTYK you will make friends of everything from a bravely insecure capybara to an eccentric old scientist with an unusual power.

title: Panic in Puzzle World
description:
게임 정보
      Panic in Puzzle World is an action-platformer. The dragon, Tide, jumps, slashes, bounces and blasts to save the 4 Puzzle Masters from their captors, so that Puzzle World can be saved from the robot invasion!
Ten densely-packed levels of bumping, jumping and fire-blasting, each with novel mechanics to enjoy!
Rad boss fights! Fearsome robots stand in your way, with tons of attacks to tango with!
Made a mistake? Rewind at any time, if you'd like! (this difficulty feature can be toggled on/off)
Fun hats, color-palettes, challenge levels and more to unlock! Gotta use those gems for something, right?
A fun story delivered through in-game cutscenes (which are effortlessly skippable)!
Replay any level and aim for S-Ranks and fastest times!

title: The Occultist
description:
게임 정보

특징
신비로운 펜듈럼: 앨런에게 가장 중요한 물건입니다. 다섯 가지의 고유한 방식을 통해, 앨런은 펜듈럼으로 주변과 상호작용하고 변화를 일으킵니다.
일인칭 액션: 앨런 레벨스의 눈으로 불길한 The Occultist의 세계를 경험하고, 펜듈럼을 사용해 갓스톤에서 있었던 일의 진상을 밝히세요.
서바이벌 호러: The Occultist는 긴장감 넘치는 탐험과 분위기, 친밀하고 개인적인 내러티브 등 장르의 모든 요소를 갖추고 있습니다.
차세대 그래픽: The Occultist의 뛰어난 레벨과 그래픽 품질은 몰입감 넘치는 공포스런 경험을 선사합니다.
은신과 잠입: 앨런은 적들과 직접 싸워서는 안됩니다. 은신 시스템을 이용해 적들의 기습을 피하며 스토리를 전개해 나가야 합니다.
인상적인 캐릭터: 갓스톤에는 조사를 악몽으로 만들어 줄 다양한 캐릭터들이 등장합니다.
퍼즐: 직관적인 퍼즐부터 오컬트에 대한 지식과 통찰을 요구하는 복잡한 퍼즐까지 다양하게 준비되어 있습니다.
사운드트랙: 유명 작곡가 Pepe Herrero가 The Occultist의 사운드트랙을 담당했습니다.


The Occultist에서, 이상 현상 조사관인 앨런 레벨스는 자신의 아버지가 갑자기 사라진 이유를 찾기 위해 신비한 갓스톤 섬으로 찾아갑니다. 아버지는 수십 년 동안 섬 이야기를 했지만, 앨런이 아는 것은 아버지가 그곳에서 태어나 유년기를 보냈다는 것뿐이었습니다.

하지만 앨런은 혼자가 아닙니다. 그는 이전 조사 때마다 가지고 다녔던, 기원을 알 수 없는 신비한 펜듈럼을 가지고 다닙니다. 정체불명의 갓스톤 섬에 유일하게 남겨진 듯한 안개 낀 거리와 광기 어린 건물들을 돌아다니며 점점 분명해지는 것은... 이번 일은 그 어떤 사건과도 다를 거라는 사실입니다.

갓스톤에서는 1950년까지 사악한 종교 단체가 거주하며 불쾌한 실험과 잔인한 의식을 거행했습니다.그 이후로 오늘날까지 누구도 이 섬에 발을 들이지 않았습니다. 앨런은 이상 현상에 관한 재능을 활용해 갓스톤의 거리와 건물에 얽매여 있는 듯한 영혼들과 소통하거나, 모든 방법을 동원해 분노한 그들로부터 피해야 합니다.

이상 현상 조사관인 앨런 레벨스에게 이런 일들은 낯설지 않습니다. 하지만 신비한 갓스톤 섬과 아버지의 실종에 관한 답을 찾으려는 그의 여정은 앨런의 능력을 시험대에 올립니다. 갓스톤은 오컬트 세상에서 가능한 일에 대한 앨런의 신념을 그 어떤 조사보다도 크게 흔들어 놓습니다. 어쩌면 갓스톤에는 풀어야 할 저주가 숨어 있을 수 있습니다... 하지만 그래야 하는 걸까요?

title: Ascent Quest
description:
게임 정보
Ascent Quest is currently in development, join us on social media and Discord to follow the latest news, devlogs and participate in the discussions !
Ascent Quest brings together the best of virtual reality and online cooperative role-playing in this high fantasy universe.
Become the main actor in an adventure-packed fantasy story through a highly detailed world. From the goblin to the most majestic dragon, fight formidable enemies by teaming up with your friends or with new people met at the bend of a tavern.
Exploration & Story
A colorful universe of high fantasy that is a real treat for your eyes and your desire for adventure.
Rich in story and in varied environments, visit an incredible world inviting you to explore its every corner to discover many secrets.
Save Aelys from a tragedy whose scope goes far beyond anything you could imagine. Endearing characters, unexpected twists. All supported by voice dubbing of the main story and numerous possible interactions with the world.
Engaging fights
Mage, warrior, archer, defender, assassin? Your character, your personality. Access a unique specialization system allowing you to decide precisely how you prefer to fight by combining classes.
Face epic battles requiring you to coordinate with other players to take down powerful enemies in actions that make full use of virtual reality strengths. Reap the reward for your labor with unique items and rank up in the Adventurer's Guild!
Meet other players
Want to take a break from fighting or just socialize ?
Take part in a vibrant economy, trade with players, build your wealth and buy your own personnalizable home. Why not create a club where you can invite other players to have fun ?
Enter the taverns and meet new people to laugh and have fun with mini-games while displaying the trophies of your latest achievements!

title: T.K. Punk - G.O.L.D
description:
게임 정보
Background Story
"Three Kingdoms Punk" is the third game from Sunny Game, and we aim to offer a unique role-playing experience to everyone.
We've packed the entire Three Kingdoms world into a cyber city where East meets West, and poverty coexists with wealth -- HanKong City (a play on Hong Kong).
The traditional Eastern Han regime from the Three Kingdoms is reimagined as a super villain group ruling the entire city -- D.H.C (Dong Han Corporation, East Han Group).
The three powers of Wei, Shu, and Wu are transformed into factions of Heaven, Man, and Earth, seemingly in harmony with D.H.C but actually in conflict, controlling various resources of the city.
The Yellow Turban group, often portrayed as villains in most Three Kingdoms games, becomes the protagonist team in this game -- GOLD (a pun on 'Yellow Turban').
Players must lead the GOLD team, ostensibly running the Gold Bar, but secretly undertaking various commissions. In this cyber Three Kingdoms city, they must carve out a path of blood to realize their dreams of love and destruction.

About Gameplay
The game progresses in turns, each with limited action points.
Players invest in character development, equipment research, work dispatch, companion training, and commission execution.
There are 13 characters with different personalities and genders to develop and achieve companion endings with.
The main storyline leads to four major directions based on the player's relationship with the Heaven, Earth, and Man factions.
autokwd: T.K. Punk - G.O.L.D,三国朋克: 爱与破坏之神

title: Time To Wake Up
description:
게임 정보
