Time To Wake Up is an atmospheric psychological thriller where one night you find yourself stuck in a dream. No worries, though. You are not alone. You hear a voice, in need of your eyes and willing to help you out.
Blinking is thinking



Your sight is your light at the end of the tunnel. Blink and rearrange your surroundings, reset all motion, flood whole rooms, or turn them around.



Even with your sight, even if you're not alone, do watch your step. Your dream can be foggy. You never know what exactly is around the corner during your trip down memory lane.



Didn't we already warn you to watch your step? Do watch it before it falls off the stairs or other dark places your mind might take you to!



Time To Wake Up takes you through various school environments. Imagine lively libraries, perplexing playgrounds, tense toilets, and more...All connected by absurd hallways and strange classrooms.

title: Skyclimbers
description:
게임 정보
도시 건물
하향식 컨트롤과 3인칭 역학을 독특하게 조합하여 청사진을 배치하거나 무료 빌드를 사용하여 왕국을 건설하십시오. 자원을 수확하고, 주민 역할을 할당하고, 확장하세요!

RPG 클래스
선택한 원소 왕조에 따라 고유한 장비와 스킬 트리가 있는 5가지 클래스 중 하나를 선택합니다. 캐릭터 생성을 통해 각 클래스 및 다이너스티와 스타일을 믹스 앤 매치할 수 있습니다. [/비]

몬스터 길들이기
Sentius Gauntlet을 사용하여 오픈 월드에서 몬스터를 길들이십시오. 각 Sentius는 레벨을 올리고 각각 고유한 원소 기술을 가진 새로운 형태로 진화할 수 있습니다.

생존
당신의 영토를 확장하고 포위할 적대적인 토착 부족으로부터 자신을 방어하십시오.
tag: 앞서 해보기,도시 건설,오픈 월드 생존 제작,액션 RPG

title: Oasis the Great
description:
게임 정보
Oasis the Great is an online multi-player physics based sandbox game that have infinite possibilities.

(≖ᴗ≖)✧ Yes! we combine the popular and great mechanics into this tremendous oasis.
huge world for you to explore!
the oasis is full off various place in different art style. lowpoly ,fantasy or realistic.From ancient culture temple to futuristic city

title: Dread Pilots
description:
게임 정보
From Klei Entertainment, creators of Don't Starve, Invisible Inc, and Griftlands comes Dread Pilots, a new space survival exploration sandbox game.
You are a Dread Pilot, an unfortunate soul trapped in a dangerous and uncaring purgatory with only your wits to aid you in your quest to escape.
WELCOME TO THE DREAD
The Dread is a pocket dimension somewhere between deep space and a nightmare. You face mutated, carnivorous plant life, mind-bending anomalies, living computers, fanatical cults, space vampires and more as you traverse its many regions in a desperate search for resources and allies. Explore dark infected caverns, soar past glistening technological landscapes, and navigate chaotic mineral fields, all animated in Klei Entertainment's signature hand-drawn 2D style.
SURVIVAL AT ALL COSTS
The life of a Dread pilot is short and cheap. Combat can pay off if you have the advantage, but it’s perilous if you don't. Explore carefully, judge the risks well, and always keep an eye on your tenuous connection to reality or you may just find yourself blown to pieces - or worse. Sometimes information gathering, trade, and diplomacy is the more prudent option.

title: Mayhem Brawler II: Best of Both Worlds
description:
게임 정보
90년대 아케이드 분위기와 현대적인 로그라이트/RPG 메커니즘이 환상적인 조화를 이루는 시간 전이 테마의 벨트스크롤 액션 게임입니다. 혼자서 또는 친구들과 온라인으로 플레이하고, 원하는 대로 선택을 내려 스토리를 구성해 보세요. 만화에서 영감을 받은 수작업 아트와 프레임 단위의 애니메이션 캐릭터들, 그리고 강렬한 사운드트랙을 즐겨보세요.

한 번에 만날 수 있는 두 세계
20년이나 떨어진 두 시대에서 동시에 전개되는 사건들을 확인해 보세요! 한쪽에는 전설적인 스트롱홀드 요원 스텔라, 다른 한쪽에는 시장 선거에 출마한 사나운 쉬울프가 등장합니다. 메이헴 시티의 어두운 비밀을 파헤치기 위한 둘의 여정이 시작됩니다.
시대를 초월하는 경험
두 시간대의 캐릭터를 오가면서 과거와 현재의 적들을 동시에 맞서 보세요.
로그라이트와 RPG 요소가 클래식한 벨트스크롤 액션 메커니즘과 완벽한 조화를 이뤄, 매 회차마다 풍부한 엔드 게임 콘텐츠와 다양한 게임플레이 경험을 즐길 수 있습니다.

게임 특징
90년대 아케이드 분위기와 현대적인 메커니즘의 환상적인 조화
autokwd: Mayhem Brawler II: Best of Both Worlds

title: Beautiful Light
description:
게임 정보
인디 개발사인 Deep Worlds가 개발한 격렬한 PvPvP 익스트랙션 슈팅 게임 Beautiful Light의 거친 세계로 들어서세요. 기동타격대의 대원으로 성장하거나, 다른 플레이어의 레이드를 무시무시한 이상현상으로 방해해 보세요. 눈길을 사로잡는 그래픽이 돋보이는 Beautiful Light는 몰입감, 호러, 전술 게임플레이에 집중한 게임입니다. 이 게임은 가파른 학습곡선을 적용해 플레이어를 극한으로 밀어붙여 스릴 넘치는 환경에서 자신의 능력을 시험해 볼 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

진입하고, 확보하고, 탈출하세요.
// 진입

진입 지역에 맞설 준비를 단단히 하고, 신비로운 아티팩트를 찾거나 퀘스트를 완료하세요. 다양한 무기, 방어구, 보조화기로 무장하고 두 명의 대원과 팀을 이루세요. 전승, 방해물, 위험으로 가득 찬 적대적인 환경에 진입해 탐험하세요. 적 대원과 기괴한 이상현상이 여러분을 쓰러뜨리기 위해서라면 뭐든지 할 것입니다. 각 레이드는 고유한 속성을 지니니, 미지의 세계에 맞설 준비를 하세요.
// 확보

아티팩트는 이용할 수 있는 다양한 속성을 지닙니다. 이토록 황폐한 세계에서 자원 이용은 곧 도시의 생존과 직결되죠. 아티팩트는 매우 귀중하니 누구보다 먼저 확보해야 합니다. 여러분의 앞길을 가로막는 모든 적을 제거해야만 하죠. 누군가 이 아티팩트를 손에 넣었나요? 아티팩트를 확보하는 이가 여러분이 되도록 하세요.

죽게 되면 임무는 실패하고, 손에 넣은 모든 것을 잃게 됩니다. 일단 조명탄을 쏘고 구출 헬기를 부르고, 무언가가 여러분을 처치하기 전에 탈출하세요. 아티팩트가 있든 없든 말이죠. 어찌되었든 때론 당신의 목숨은 이상한 돌이나 친구보다 더 소중합니다. 구출 헬기가 도착할 때까지 살아남고 숨어 있는 다른 위협에 주의하세요.

게임을 진행하려면 퀘스트를 완료하고, 아티팩트를 확보하고 살아서 탈출하세요. 상인들이 임무를 완료하기를 기다리고 있습니다. 그들을 실망시키지 마세요. 두둑한 보상을 챙겨줄 테니까요. RPG 게임 같은 테크트리에서 보상을 현명하게 사용하여 캐릭터 레벨을 올리고 기술을 향상시키거나, 상인에게서 다음 레이드를 위한 무기와 희귀한 장비를 구매하세요.

이형체로서의 목표는 플레이어를 사냥하고, 죽이고, 먹어 치워 그들이 유물을 가지고 탈출하는 것을 막는 것입니다. 이형체를 해방하고 가능한 많은 플레이어를 먹어 경험치를 획득하세요. 기술을 향상시키고 더 많은 능력을 얻으며 새로운 괴물 같은 이형체들을 잠금 해제하세요.

title: Jurassic Lab: Dinosarium DNA
description:
게임 정보
In the game, you will become a researcher, who has a unique opportunity to recreate the Jurassic period creatures by assembling dinosaur's skeletons from bones found during the excavation in an advanced technological laboratory. With the help of future technologies and artificial intelligence, having a skeleton and DNA, we start recreating the long-extinct creatures that inhabited the Earth.

At the start, you will find yourselves in a sci-fi laboratory with a bone collection of 7 dinosaurs.
Having collected a complete dinosaur skeleton, we start the processes of DNA synchronization with the collected material, adapting the original DNA to the new realities on the planet.

Our complex has specially created landscapes for the necessary habitat for each species of dinosaur.

After the successful completion of the dinosaur resurrection, you will go to the recreated habitat where a living dinosaur is already waiting for you.
Travel to each location is carried out with the help of a roller coaster. When you get to the locations, you will see with your own eyes each dinosaur in a natural environment adapted to the conditions of the planet at this time.

KEY FEATURES:
PUZZLE: Collect the skeleton of a dinosaur with our own hands.
ROLLER COASTER: Travel on a dynamic roller coaster through cave tunnels to dinosaur locations.
INTERACTIVE WITH DINOSAURS: Meet and interact with living dinosaurs.

title: Colonisator
description:
게임 정보
Lead your more or less virtuous shipping company on the path to wealth and glory, in this turn-based adventure set in the golden age of piracy !
The game
The royal city of Sundercity charges you with colonizing and administering islands in its name... but you are not alone! Up to 3 AI competitors and factions more or less happy to see you will be there to make your life difficult.
Complete your mission by building a reputation over time, and demonstrate your skill to thwart the many dangerous situations that await you!
Turn based
You decide the movement of your ship and manage the different situations that arise. Explore, colonize, fight, trade, stopover to resupply.
Strategy
As the game progresses, you will have to make difficult decisions, which will have irremediable consequences! So you have to deal with your officers, the crew, but you also have to make sure that your islands thrive.
Stay away from pirates and be ready to make any compromises to achieve your goals!
Management
Resources are all produced somewhere and do not magically teleport!
Make sure your ship and your islands lack nothing, where trouble will quickly fall upon you. If your company is in difficulty, Sundercity will not do you any favors!
Simulation
All characters in the game are simulated. They all have their own characteristics and aspirations. Your actions and those of important characters will influence their decisions.
You'll get the crew you deserve!
Action
Switch to first person view, take command of your ship and lead your crew to victory in intense clashes!

title: SCP: Distorted Spacetime
description:
게임 정보
SCP: Distorted Spacetime is a thrilling horror game based on the SCP Wiki. In this game, you work in the dangerous world of Site-DE2 and can choose from various jobs such as Class D Personnel, Mobile Task Force Alpha 1, Omega 7, Epsilon 11, as well as O5 and Scientists. Each job has its own unique storyline and challenges to overcome.
Features

Choose Your Job: Players can choose from a variety of jobs each with their own unique skills and abilities.

Engaging Storylines: Each job comes with its own gripping storyline that will keep players on the edge of their seat.

Breach Mode: In this mode, players must try to escape or terminate the SCPs while playing as any of the available jobs.

Dynamic Gameplay: The gameplay is constantly changing, requiring players to adapt and think on their feet in order to survive.

Immersive World: The world of Site-DE2 is richly detailed, with atmospheric environments that will draw players into the game.

In SCP: Distorted Spacetime, players must navigate the dangerous world of Site-DE2, facing off against various SCPs and other hazards. Each job offers a unique perspective on the game, with different strengths and weaknesses that players must leverage to succeed. With its engaging storylines and dynamic gameplay, SCP: Distorted Spacetime is sure to keep players on the edge of their seat as they try to survive and uncover the secrets of Site-DE2.

So if you're a fan of horror games and looking for a thrilling new experience, be sure to check out SCP: Distorted Spacetime.

title: ALYSSA
description:
게임 정보
Here's a new game from the creator of Don't Be Afraid and Mandela Invasion!



ALYSSA is a adventure game with horror elements, in which you play a 9-year-old girl from a broken family who hears disturbing voices in her head. They promise her that they know where she will find her longed-for happy life, but to find it, she will have to murder everyone who stands in her way.

Alyssa will murder discreetly, and the environment is perfect for it. From poisoning tea to initiating explosions, you'll find plenty of opportunities in the levels. Will you be able to find them all? However, remember not to get caught, because if someone catches you in suspicious activity - it means your end.

Due to the fact that Alyssa is not an ordinary child, she will be able to use the help of ghosts and demons. With them, you will easily scare someone to force them to go to another place or cause interesting phenomena. Of course, these beings will want something in return, so before they are available, you will need to convince them with something.

Sometimes you will also meet people and creatures that will try to harm you. In this case, you will avoid detection and look for opportunities to get out of a place. Not everyone is defenseless!

The player's task is to murder targets while remaining undetected, using only elements of the environment. Which way will you choose? Which creatures will you use in your journey? Will you discover all the secrets? And above all - will you help Alyssa find happiness?

title: Magic Wands Workshop
description:
게임 정보
"Magic Wands Workshop"는 몰입감 있는 마법 지팡이 제작 시뮬레이터입니다.
단계별로 독특한 걸작을 만드는 동안 편안하게 즐기세요. 적절한 가지를 선택하는 것에서 시작하여, 가공하고, 코어를 추가하며, 장식을 넣고, 마법 패턴 의식으로 마무리합니다.
깃털, 털, 송곳니, 비늘 및 판타지 생물의 기타 요소와 같은 독특한 구성 요소를 구입하세요.
매번 창작물을 테스트하여 최고의 품질과 아름다운 외관을 보장하세요.
고객의 성격, 필요 및 경험에 따라 지팡이를 맞춤 제작하세요. 마법 세계에서 가장 유명한 지팡이 제작 장인이 되세요.

title: Severed Love
description:
게임 정보



Live2D 풀 애니메이션 × 360도 파노라마 탐색으로, "얀데레가 거기에 있다"체험을 맛볼 수 있는 어드벤처 게임.

애니메이션하지 않는 순간은 1초라도 존재하지 않는다.
이는 인디게임에서만 존재를 허용하는 배덕성벽의 단면도다.

한국어 번역에 기계 번역을 사용하고 있는데, 추후에 원어민 번역을 구현하고자 합니다. 당신의 성원이 필요해요!


기억을 잃고 낯선 방에서 눈을 뜬 당신은 손발이 절단되어 있었다.
한쪽 팔을 결손한 남자·"사지 절단의 악마"는, 당신을 모르는 사람의 이름으로 불러, 연인과 같이 취급해 온다.



자신의 손발을 빼앗은 상대로부터의 헌신적인 간호. 하지만 한 걸음 잘못하면 당신은 죽임을 당한다…….
공포와 스톡홀름 증후군 사이에서 요동치는 극한 상태의 감금 생활이 시작됐다.
「欠損失愛 (Severed Love)」에서는, 게임 실황 전달과 팬 아트를 환영하고 있습니다!
당신이 개인에서도 법인이라도 허락 없이 실황 배달을 할 수 있습니다.
스토리 끝까지 전달 가능하지만 일부 수집 요소의 컴플리트를 제한할 예정입니다.
동영상 투고 시에는, 작품명의 명기, 공식 사이트 또는 Steam 스토어 페이지로의 링크를 부탁드립니다.
팬아트 투고 시에는, 작품명의 명기나 해시태그 「#欠損失愛」를 사용해 주시면 감사하겠습니다.


뒤돌아보니 갑자기 얀데레 남자가 나타났다! 라는 사각지대에서의 공포.
게다가 그대로 얀데레 남자가 다가와 당신을 바라본다...!?
고가동역의 Live2D를 담은 본 작품에서 밖에 얻을 수 없는, 당신과의 거리를 한 걸음 좁히는 공포×연애 체험.

당신은 팔다리를 잃고 목줄로 구속되어 있기 때문에 돌아다니면서 탐색하는 것조차 불가능하다.
파노라마를 둘러보며 궁금한 부분을 클릭하여 관찰하고 사지 절단의 악마의 비위를 맞출 단서를 찾아봅시다.
다만, 당신이 책장의 책을 하나 읽는데도, 사지 절단의 악마를 잘 설득해서 도움을 받는 것이 필수입니다.



"사지 절단의 악마×결손 히로인"이라는 배덕적인 컨셉으로 혼자서는 살 수 없는 당신과 얀데레 남자와의 공의존, 절망적인 상황을 진하게 그립니다.

모든 것을 악인에게 의존해야 하는 절망적인 상황.
얀데레 남자와의 맞물리지 않는 대화에서는, 당신이 순종적으로 행동하면 잘 된다고는 할 수 없습니다.
당신은 증오심을 담아 정론으로 그를 몰아세우거나 오로지 폭언을 해도 좋다.
당신이 죄책감을 가질 필요는 없어요. 왜냐하면 그는 범죄자니까요.
사지 절단의 악마는 어떤 당신에게도 "한계까지" 다해줍니다.

감금만으로는 부족해！
그런 당신의 사디즘과 마조히즘을 모두 충족시키는, 성벽에 특화된 처녀 게임입니다.



다양한 죽음을 즐길 수 있는 수십 가지의 데드 엔드를 시작으로 멀티 엔딩 스토리.
데드엔드를 맞이할 때마다 입수할 수 있는 "키워드"로, 죽으면 죽을 정도로 사지 절단의 악마의 새로운 에피소드를 볼 수 있습니다.

예상치 못한 리액션에 겁을 먹고, 유대감을 느끼고, 때로는 사람을 놀리며, 감정의 롤러코스터 같은 체험을 즐길 수 있는 어드벤처 게임입니다.



일본어에서는 주인공의 1인칭을 선택 또는 자유 입력할 수 있습니다.
일본어 이외의 현지화 버전에서도 당신이 어떤 젠더로 취급되었는지를 선택할 수 있습니다.
작품 속에서 주인공의 성별은 분명하게 밝혀지지 않기 때문에 자유롭게 상상하고 즐겨 주세요.



신체결손을 비롯한 충격적인 묘사는 설정에서 순하게 할 수 있습니다.



그는 당신의 손발을 절단하고 감금하고 헌신적으로 간호하는 엽기 범죄자다.
그는 당신을 모르는 사람의 이름으로 부르며 연인처럼 행동한다.
그는 자신도 한쪽 팔을 결손했고, 새빨간 매니큐어의 섬뜩한 의수를 입어 결손에 위험한 집착을 품는다.
그는 쿨하고 퇴폐적인 분위기지만 연인에 대해 이야기할 때는 수줍게 미소를 짓는다.
그는 감금 개호 생활을 그만둘지 망설이고 있으며, 계기가 있으면 당신을 죽여 버릴지도 모른다. 그는 일촉즉발의 말기 상태의 우울증이다.




사지를 결손해 기억상실이 되어버린 주인공.
당신은 팔다리가 없어 일상생활조차 할 수 없기 때문에 사지 절단의 악마의 간호가 없으면 살아갈 수 없다.
사지 절단의 악마가 먼저 죽어버려도 당신은 아무것도 못하고 굶어죽을 뿐이다.

A. 네, 하지만 성별에 관계없이 즐기실 수 있습니다.
본 작품의 연애 대상은 1명의 남성뿐이지만, 달콤한 연애보다 Live2D 애니메이션을 완전 활용한 마음 흔드는 게임 체험과 스토리를 중시하고 있습니다.

얀데레의 남자와의 맞물리지 않는 대화는 때로는 의미심장하거나 초현실적으로 보일 수도 있을 것입니다.
불합리한 죽음의 여러가지에 절망하는 결손의 주인공을 사랑하거나 스토리를 고찰하거나, 쉬르함을 웃는 즐기는 방법도 가능한, 게임 실황 전용의 작품입니다.


A. 체험판(1화)은 풀보이스 예정입니다. 본편에도 더 많은 캐릭터 보이스 구현을 목표로 하고 있으니 응원해주시면 감사하겠습니다!
주인공은 보이스는 없고 공략대상 '사지 절단의 악마'의 보이스는 일본어 뿐입니다.


A. 뒤돌아보면 얀데레를 만나거나 갑자기 무음이 되는 등의 점프스 케어 연출을 포함합니다.
사실적인 괴물의 그래픽, 큰 소리의 비명과 같은 과격한 공포 연출은 없습니다.


A. 본작에는 시간의 루프는 없습니다만, 세이브 데이터라는 이름의 기억을 계승하는 약간의 이유가 있을지도 모릅니다.
스토리의 메인이 아니기 때문에 메타픽션을 기대하고 본 작품을 구입하는 것은 추천할 수 없습니다.


A. 신체결손이나 자살 등 충격적인 묘사를 포함합니다.
유혈을 동반한 신체 절단 등 직접적인 잔혹한 묘사는 없습니다.
신체결손을 비롯한 충격적인 묘사는 설정에서 순하게 할 수 있습니다.


A. "사지 절단의 악마"는 굉장히 신사적이고 음담패설을 굉장히 싫어합니다.
만약 당신이 그와 왜곡된 의존 관계를 키울 수 있었다면, 그런 그를 성희롱할 수 있을지도 모릅니다.


A. "欠損失愛"는 쓰레기인 죄수를 관찰하는 어드벤처 "Romp of Dump"의 if 세계선을 그린 이야기입니다.
처음이신 분은 사전 정보 없이 "欠損失愛"를 즐기시면 최대한의 놀라움으로 즐길 수 있습니다!
클리어후에 "Romp of Dump"를 놀면 사지 절단의 악마의 배덕적인 에피소드가 더욱 알차집니다!

title: Zeizen
description:
게임 정보
 · You have entered Shanghai Central Bank... A labyrinth of pain wherein lies a treasure beyond earthly logic, and approximately 10 billion dollars for you and your heist crew to share. You have one night to run the maze. Make it count.
 · On the outside a precise work of marble and concrete... On the inside a labyrinthine expanse where walls throb to a cardiac rhythm. There is no map, no guide, only your wits and whatever luck Genobrain sees fit to grant.

title: Rootbound
description:
게임 정보
A physics-based action adventure about a plantling’s quest to save its home from a mysterious blight. Equipped with your sentient backpack, you venture into a broken world. Meet lost souls, solve ancient puzzles, fight dangerous monsters, and uncover the secrets of a long-forgotten civilization.
EXPLORE THE WORLD
Every corner of the handcrafted island of Akara is filled with secrets and activities. Learn what happened to the ancient civilization that once ruled the land, and make use of their lost technology. Solve puzzles to obtain powerful weapons and valuable upgrades - they will prove useful for the challenges that lie ahead.
A LIVING BACKPACK
Your backpack is much more than a simple storage for items and materials. As a sentient, but silent companion, it has a mind of its own and aids you on your journey by collecting items and tossing them to you when needed – that is, if it’s in the mood. But be careful: enemies might notice its living nature and turn their attacks on it.

title: Crimson Frontier
description:
게임 정보
Korean (한국어)
Crimson Frontier에서 당신은 거대 기업이 지배하는 미래 디스토피아에서 무자비한 적들과 맞서 싸우게 됩니다. 캐릭터를 강화 장비와 신체 개조로 업그레이드하고, 첨단 무기를 갖춘 무기고를 조립하여 기업 용병, 범죄 조직, 외계 위협과의 치열한 전투에서 살아남아야 합니다.
Crimson Frontier는 실시간 전투와 RPG 요소를 결합하여 우주 식민지와 버려진 전초기지에서 격렬한 전투를 제공합니다. 기업 전쟁과 어두운 미래가 펼쳐지는 이 세계에서 혼돈의 이면에 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀 전설이 되어보세요.
혼돈의 우주에서 살아남기
생존이 최우선 목표인 몰입감 넘치는 이야기 속으로 뛰어드세요. 거대 기업의 갑작스러운 공격 이후 은하는 혼돈에 빠졌습니다. 라이벌 세력, 범죄 조직, 그리고 숨겨진 음모를 파헤치며 살아남고 진실을 밝혀 나만의 자리를 찾으세요.

몰입감 넘치는 사이버펑크 액션
Crimson Frontier는 빠른 전투와 RPG 성장 요소를 결합한 게임입니다. 독창적인 무기들을 익히고, 스킬을 향상시키며, 최첨단 신체 개조를 통해 능력을 강화하세요. 전략과 반사 신경을 활용해 적을 능가하세요.

title: Mind Flowers
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT THIS GAME
Mind Flowers is a narrative-driven psychological simulation with pixel art aesthetics, immersing you in a hauntingly beautiful dystopian world.
As a psychologist, you run a clinic in a decaying city, diagnosing patients with mysterious conditions named after flowers. Each case takes you deep into their memories, where you experience their past, uncover their struggles, and make life-changing decisions.
But be careful! A wrong diagnosis may lead them to irreversible consequences.
A deep and emotional storyline
Handcrafted pixel art visuals
A dark, immersive atmosphere
Decision-driven gameplay that shapes the world around you
Mind Flowers is not just a game; it's an exploration of the human mind and the fragility of emotions. Are you ready to uncover the truth? 🌸

title: Lucha Chess
description:
게임 정보
이 로그라이크 자동 전투 게임에서 최고의 멕시코 레슬링 팀을 구성하세요!
링에 올라 전략, 전투, 로그라이크 요소가 독특하게 혼합된 루차 체스(Lucha Chess)를 마스터하세요. 각자 강력한 능력을 지닌 상징적인 멕시코 레슬링 선수들을 이끌고 수백 가지 아이템 및 유물과 결합하여 완벽한 팀을 만드세요.
팀 빌딩의 기술을 마스터하세요
최고의 팀 구성과 시너지 효과를 발견하면서 무한한 가능성을 탐험해보세요. 당신의 강점을 활용하여 적의 약점에 맞서고, 모든 전투에서 전략을 조정하여 한 발 앞서 나가십시오.
고전 만화에서 영감을 받은 예술 스타일
고전 만화의 매력과 에너지에서 영감을 받아 손으로 그린 독특한 아트 스타일로 가득한 생동감 넘치는 세계에 빠져보세요. 모든 프레임은 개성으로 가득 차 있으며 이전에 본 적이 없는 방식으로 Lucha 세계에 생기를 불어넣습니다.
이 액션으로 가득 찬 자동 전투 게임에서 팀을 구성하고, 가장 어려운 도전에 맞서고, 정상에 오를 준비가 되셨나요? 반지가 기다리고 있어요!

title: BLOODLETTER
description:
게임 정보
블러드레터는 타로 카드, 중세 필사본, 당시의 치유 방법과 이를 둘러싼 미신에서 영감을 받은 전략 경영 덱 빌더입니다. 마을을 집어삼키는 부패와 마을의 생존 사이에 놓인 것은 목욕탕이라는 성역뿐입니다.
이발사가 되어 카드 덱을 사용해 어젯밤의 공격을 받은 마을 사람들의 마음을 치유하고 다가올 다음 날 밤을 준비하세요.
저녁에는 고통을 덜어주는 대가로 새로운 치유 방법과 독특한 덱 구성 능력을 제공합니다. 그들을 대하는 태도에 유의하세요. 그들이 당신을 신뢰하지 않는다면 그들은 당신을 돕지 않을 것입니다.

title: The Symbiant II
description:
게임 정보
잡범에 불과한 로디아스는 어느 날, 설명할 수 없는 충동에 이끌려 범죄 생활을 뒤로 하고 무작정 외진 산속으로 향합니다.
외계 내륙지를 헤매던 로디아스는 잘생긴 여행객을 만나게 되고, 그 여행자는 로디아스가 갖고 있는 많은 질문에 대한 해답을 쥐고 있다는 소생의 사원으로 그를 초대합니다.
신성한 사원에서 머무르는 동안, 로디아스는 원초적인 굶주림을 비롯해 자기 자신도 알지 못하던 자신의 비밀을 알게 됩니다. 더욱 이상하게도, 그의 마음속에선 만나는 남자들과 은밀한 관계를 맺고 싶다는, 인정하고 싶지 않은 새로운 욕망이 들끓기 시작합니다.
수수께끼와 촉수, 아름다운 남자들로 가득한 이 새로운 성인용 이야기에 흠뻑 빠져보세요!
구성 요소
20시간이 넘는 플레이 시간
50종의 CG (바리에이션 제외)
영어 전체 녹음
3명의 연애 상대 (다자연애 루트 포함)
오리지널 배경 음악
조사 미니 게임

title: Fading Light
description:
게임 정보
잊혀진 세계의 암흑 속을 여정한다
생존이 여러분의 지혜와 예기치 못한 동반자 스파크에 달려 있는 신비롭고 위험한 세계를 배경으로 한 메트로바니아 어드벤처 ' Fading Light (페이딩 라이트) '를 느껴보세요. 이 세계에서 생존은 당신의 지혜와 불꽃 동반자 스파크(Spark)에 달려 있습니다. 모든 그림자 속에 위협이 숨겨져 있고, 나아가는 한 걸음마다 새로운 비밀이 밝혀지는 황혼의 세계를 탐험하세요.
어둡고 험난한 이 세계에서 당신은 숨겨진 부족 출신의 생존자 노테오(Noteo)가 되어 호기심 많은 불덩이 동반자 스파크와 함께 모험을 시작하게 됩니다. 고대 유적을 탐험하고, 공포를 일으키는 생명체들과 맞서 싸우며, 암흑 속에 감춰진 고대의 신비를 밝혀내야 합니다.
게임 특징
메트로이드바니아 스타일 탐험: 서로 얽혀 있는 거대한 세계를 탐험하며, 각기 다른 독특한 환경과 생물, 도전 과제를 지닌 위험한 생물군계로 여정을 떠나세요. 이 세계는 발견을 위해 설계되어 있어, 당신은 자신만의 속도로 탐험하고, 싸우며, 비밀을 밝혀낼 수 있습니다.

title: Bless You Again
description:
게임 정보
“Bless You Again“
Rogue-like 3D action shooting game
Lily, a homunculus girl who is a magician, dives into a dungeon called “Tomb of Blessings” for a certain purpose.
There, she will “risk her life” to challenge the ordeal that awaits her.
Contents
3D models and animations faithfully reproduced from cell animation
Simple 3D actions such as melee attacks, mid-range magic, and aiming magic
Special move magic can be used when conditions are met!
Aim for deeper levels by conquering dungeons!
There are enemies, traps, and treasure chests in the dungeon. Explore and strengthen yourself!
Defeat enemies, gain experience, and obtain blessings to strengthen your status!
Powerful blessings may be hidden in bosses and rare treasure chests!
When your health reaches 0, you have to start over from the first level, but you can bring back only one blessing!

title: Sweets & Dragons
description:
게임 정보
We have opened an otherworldly maid cafe!
Sweets & Dragons is a management simulation game in which you manage a maid cafe with a beautiful maid android as your partner.
You can instruct your beautiful maid androids to renovate the shop to attract customers and serve them food to earn money.
You can then use the money you earn to improve the Maid Cafes facilities and develop a variety of menu items to earn even more money.
Training beautiful maid android.
With the money you earn, you can manage your shop and train a beautiful maid android named Tsubasa.
By training Tsubasa, you will be able to improve her performance and run your shop faster and with more variety.
The story will progress as the shop is renovated, expanded, and the performance of the Tsubasa is improved.
The Story
It has been several years since the "Dragon", a great disaster, appeared in the Empire. Many soldiers and adventurers were active in the realm to defeat the dragon.
One day, a small incident occurred in a remote port city in the empire. A powerful dragon had somehow destroyed an old cafe and left.
The owner of the cafe barely escaped, but what he saw were the ruins of the cruelly destroyed cafe and a battered android.
The owner rescued the android, repaired it, and rebuilt the destroyed cafe.

title: Car Cleaner Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Have you already met Little Sam, from whom you can take over the used car dealership in Car Dealer Simulator? His wife, Clever Emma, runs a small car wash right next door. Wouldn't it be nice to expand it and become the biggest and best car wash in Wingston Springs?
Start with a simple manual car wash for passenger cars and a vacuum for interior upholstery…



… and then expand your services with more car washing and cleaning options.
Your task will be to provide the best possible service for incoming vehicles, focusing on both speed and quality of service.

The game combines elements of management, work organization, and simulation. You won’t just be washing cars - you’ll also take care of the entire infrastructure, from keeping the car wash clean and regularly servicing the machines to investing in new technologies that will attract more customers.

Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your services from passenger cars to delivery vehicles or even larger machines that require a specialized approach.

Car Cleaner Simulator is fun not only for fans of business-themed simulators but also for those seeking a relaxing and satisfying experience. The game allows you to create your ideal car wash, where the quality of services, efficiency, and the wealth of your business depend entirely on your skills and strategy.

title: Rune Dice
description:
게임 정보
Rune Dice는 덱 빌딩 게임의 전략적 깊이와 주사위 던지기의 짜릿한 메카닉을 결합했습니다. 고대 룬의 마법을 사용하여 적의 무리와 싸우세요!
나만의 룬 덱 구축하기
각각 고유한 힘을 가진 고대 룬을 찾아 사용하세요. 적의 공격을 막는 방어적인 쉴드 룬부터 상대를 움직이지 못하게 하는 프로스트 룬까지 - 당신만의 컬렉션을 만들고 강력한 시너지를 발견하세요.
더 멀리 갈수록 더 흥미로워집니다. 룬의 능력을 극적으로 변화시키는 룬 진화 의식을 수행하세요. 독 룬을 변형시켜 적이 죽을 때 독소를 퍼뜨리게 하거나, 쉴드 룬을 강화하여 공격자에게 데미지를 반사하게 만드세요.
주사위 아레나
조준하고 주사위를 던지세요. 매번의 던지기는 강력한 조합을 만들고 룬을 활성화할 기회입니다.

title: Liquid Lungs
description:
게임 정보
Liquid Lungs is an adrenaline-fueled first-person shooter that merges fluid parkour with high-intensity combat. Inspired by the free-running thrills of Mirror’s Edge and the fast-paced firefights of Titanfall, this dystopian adventure delivers a seamless blend of movement and marksmanship that keeps you always on the edge.
Parkour-Fueled Combat
Race across rooftops, leap between walls, and slide under obstacles while engaging in relentless gunfights. Every level is designed for swift traversal, challenging you to combine acrobatics with precise shooting.
Bullet Time and Dodge Mechanics
Channel your inner Max Payne by triggering slow-motion events and executing dodge moves. Slip past incoming attacks with pinpoint timing before retaliating with deadly precision.
Dystopian Cityscapes
Explore a near-future world dominated by towering structures and neon-lit corridors. Each location encourages creative use of your parkour skills, rewarding those who master every inch of verticality.
Arsenal and Secrets
Experiment with a broad range of weapons to match your personal style. Unlock new gear as you progress, and keep an eye out for hidden secrets that add depth and replayability to every run.

title: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of Nytland, your new home, my Liege!

Design intricate cityscapes across diverse biomes, tackle logistical challenges, and make choices that will define the fate of your people.
There are plenty of elements to build with, from towering castles to quaint hamlets. Go beyond the walls of your first settlement, across multiple regions, building many villages and growing them all into bustling cities, to create a vast trade network that spans the continent. Conquer the surrounding land to expand your area of influence. Your vision will shape an empire that stands the test of time.
RAEV pushes the boundaries of city-building—it’s a Kingdom builder, allowing you to build not just one city but many as you construct your kingdom. Every decision matters, from resource management to diplomacy, trade, and citizen welfare. Will you create a utopian paradise, a bustling economic powerhouse, or a militaristic stronghold? The fate of your kingdom is in your hands.
autokwd: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores

title: Elemental Shifter
description:
게임 정보
Choose Your Warrior Path
After clearing rooms and defeating bosses, gain the option to choose from 25+ different Path's with over 10 unique game changing abilities and find that Path that gives you the perfect stats to show the true potential of your build.
Explore And Loot To Find New Weapons
Defeat enemies and explore your randomly generated rooms to find chests with loot including 20+ different weapons ranging from Greatswords to Spears, all having 2 random activatable abilities with over 15 more to discover.

title: Zombie Epoch:Deck Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Zombie Epoch: Deck Apocalypse는 던전 탐험과 카드 전략이 결합된 포스트 아포칼립스 서바이벌 게임입니다. 생존자로서 위험한 폐허 속을 탐험하고, 희귀 자원을 모으며, 강력한 덱을 구축하고, 자신을 강화하여 끝없이 밀려오는 좀비 무리와 싸워야 합니다.
매번 탐험은 생사의 싸움입니다—경로를 신중히 선택하고, 자원을 적절히 관리하며, 무작위로 얻은 아이템과 카드로 자신만의 플레이 스타일을 구축하고 점점 강력해지는 적들과 싸워야 합니다!
강해질수록 더 어려운 지역, 희귀 아이템 및 강력한 카드를 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다.
최종 목표는 단순한 생존이 아니라 인류의 복원을 위한 노력—문명의 불꽃을 되살리는 것입니다!
각 맵은 무작위로 생성되며, 매번 아이템, 카드, 좀비가 달라집니다. 이동 경로를 신중하게 계획하고, 던전을 탐험하며 중요한 자원을 모아야 합니다.
autokwd: Zombie Epoch:Deck Apocalypse,좀비 시대: 덱 아포칼립스

title: Fellowship of the Oak
description:
게임 정보
The lands of Ascrabeth are under threat and an alliance of the willing is gathering. You are responsible for providing your followers with everything they need to succeed! From crafting weapons to farming crops, you will do whatever is necessary to equip them with the finest gear, the tastiest provisions, and the most comfortable accommodations.
Craft, Farm and Build
Improve your skills in gathering resources and crafting a wide range of hero-equipment. Cultivate a variety of crops to create delicious provisions and build up comfortable houses to furnish them cozily.
Lead your Heroes to Success

title: Moonlight Peaks
description:
게임 정보
Experience life as a vampire in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks! In this heartwarming life-sim, you set out to prove to your skeptical father, Count Dracula, that a life of compassion is possible - even for the undead.
Make friends with the local werewolves, witches and mermaids, and find your eternal love in the supernatural dating scene. Unlock ancient powers, brew potions and cast spells as you embrace the immortal life of a vampire.
Unravel the mysteries of the seven families and step out of the shadow of your father, as you create your own legacy!
In Moonlight Peaks, vampire dating is full of options. From werewolves to unsuspecting humans, find your perfect match among a diverse crowd. Embrace the supernatural dating scene and find your true love!

title: Car Rental Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Do you remember Little Sam from Car Dealer Simulator? His son, Lazy Luke, received some unsold cars from his father and a few bucks to start a new business. Unfortunately, the owner lacks the skills to run it. This is your chance to prove your abilities.
Tailor your rental offer to the needs of Wingston Springs residents and visitors. Take care of punctuality, vehicle cleanliness, and positive reviews that will attract new customers.
Be careful, as some orders will require you to modify cars for special occasions.
Also, remember that not all customers return vehicles clean and in good condition, so be prepared for cleaning and minor repairs.
Over time, increase the number and types of cars and other vehicles, invest in promotions, as well as employees and new buildings. A rich offer and a well-maintained company will attract more customers.
Car Rental Simulator is an engaging business simulation with a realistic economic model. It allows you to grow a company, manage a fleet, and interact with customers.
Start your journey in the car rental world and turn Lazy Luke's business into the most magnificent rental service in Wingston Springs.

title: The Last General
description:
게임 정보
The Last General is a real-time strategy modern war game focused on high-level strategic design, economic and political decisions. Fight in deathmatch conflicts, insurrections, assassinations, protection, rescue, escape, and survival missions.
MASSIVE SCALE
The Last General features millions of battlefields of up to 400km2 (154sq miles), each of them with dozens of towns and cities to take and protect. 
THOUSANDS OF UNITS
Guide thousands of armored vehicles, helicopters, artillery, infantry, supply and transport trucks through open field combat and close quarters city battles to achieve your high level objectives and defeat the enemy. Use high level strategic actions to design your overall strategy for your entire army to follow.

title: ANIMAL USE PROTOCOL
description:
게임 정보
The creators of STASIS and BONE TOTEM are taking you on a terrifying journey in ANIMAL USE PROTOCOL.
In this 3D first-person, narrative-focused survival horror game, you play as Penn, a hyper-intelligent chimpanzee leading the desperate escape of lab animals from a nightmarish facility, where every corner hides new terror.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
description:
게임 정보
피로 피를 씻는 검극 액션 게임의 최고봉.
무대는 에도 시대 초엽, 독기에 잠식되어 기기괴괴해진 「교토」.
괴이로 가득 찬 다양한 스테이지.
적들은 저세상의 기괴한 이형 「환마」. 그 사이를 살아가는 인간들이 자아내는 다크판타지.
「귀신의 완갑」을 차고, 교토를 동분서주하며, 들끓는 환마를 베고 또 베어 넘기는 한 명의 무사.
피바람 치는 장렬한 검극 속에서, 싸우는 이유를 묻는다.
내가 걷는 이 길은, 대체 어디로 향하는가⋯?
autokwd: Onimusha: Way of the Sword,귀무자 Way of the Sword

title: The Bunny Graveyard II
description:
게임 정보
The Bunny Graveyard II is a one of a kind action-packed horror adventure where you must survive, investigate and play fun minigames. Featuring charming pixelated graphics inspired by the GBA and the NDS era and a wacky cast of characters.
STORY
Awakened by a mysterious white glove, Skye the Bunny embarks on a dangerous journey to find her missing brother, Claudio, and uncover the mystery behind the sudden disappearances haunting Carrot Town!

As dark secrets surface, and new fears unlock, Skye must find the courage to face the horrors ahead. Can she handle the truth and push forward? It's time to find out!
FEATURES
PLAY as Skye the Bunny, she can run, use her flashlight, crawl through hidden passages, and jump on platforms. Make sure to not get her scared, or she might lose her calm.
EXPLORE the haunted streets of Carrot Town, full of enemies and foes that will chase you down the road. 
INVESTIGATE mysterious locations around the town, filled with secrets and puzzles waiting to be solved. With the help of your new "Handy" friend, you can point-and-click to inspect important objects.
Action-packed and creepy animated CUTSCENES!
Piece together the CLUES and learn about new mysteries.
Collect FIGURINES of all your favorite characters!
Earn Bun-Bun coins by completing ACHIEVEMENTS!

title: Skyclimbers
description:
게임 정보
도시 건물
하향식 컨트롤과 3인칭 역학을 독특하게 조합하여 청사진을 배치하거나 무료 빌드를 사용하여 왕국을 건설하십시오. 자원을 수확하고, 주민 역할을 할당하고, 확장하세요!

RPG 클래스
선택한 원소 왕조에 따라 고유한 장비와 스킬 트리가 있는 5가지 클래스 중 하나를 선택합니다. 캐릭터 생성을 통해 각 클래스 및 다이너스티와 스타일을 믹스 앤 매치할 수 있습니다. [/비]

몬스터 길들이기
Sentius Gauntlet을 사용하여 오픈 월드에서 몬스터를 길들이십시오. 각 Sentius는 레벨을 올리고 각각 고유한 원소 기술을 가진 새로운 형태로 진화할 수 있습니다.

생존
당신의 영토를 확장하고 포위할 적대적인 토착 부족으로부터 자신을 방어하십시오.
tag: 앞서 해보기,도시 건설,오픈 월드 생존 제작,액션 RPG

title: Oasis the Great
description:
게임 정보
Oasis the Great is an online multi-player physics based sandbox game that have infinite possibilities.

(≖ᴗ≖)✧ Yes! we combine the popular and great mechanics into this tremendous oasis.
huge world for you to explore!
the oasis is full off various place in different art style. lowpoly ,fantasy or realistic.From ancient culture temple to futuristic city
Physics based mechanics!
what could be more interesting and more possibilities for you to trigger when you have a physics based character? not to mention it in online co-op .your little human can climb, trot, grab , hold a weapon with one hand,punch ,fly kick,head knock. and there will be First Person View mode for you to interact with stuff more accurately (finally dont have to grab things only in Third Person View mode(✪ω✪))
autokwd: Oasis the Great,Oasis the Great / 超世界绿洲

title: Deep Alchemy Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
EXPLORE THE DUNGEON AS THE ALCHEMIST WITCH


D.A.D. (Deep Alchemy Dungeon) is a third-person role-playing game in which you explore a dangerous dungeon full of magic and mysteries in a classic medieval setting.
UNLOCK NEW MAGIC POTION RECIPES


Collect ingredients and find recipes, because alchemy is the most effective way to move deeper into the dungeon and discover new secrets.
BECOME A MASTER OF THE ELEMENTS


Potions can be consumed, mixed, thrown at enemies, poured onto objects. And not all mixtures work as common sense would suggest.


Your enemies will feel the full power of ancient knowledge. Your superiority is the mastery of your alchemical skills to be reckoned with.

title: Knights Province
description:
게임 정보
Knights Province is intended to be an old-school RTS game. Unlike many modern RTS games, which are fast-paced and often are more about tactics, KP planned to emphasize on “strategy” component. Slower-paced gameplay, base-building, resources collection and processing, in-depth strategic choices, variety of resources and units, attention to details.

title: Beautiful Light
description:
게임 정보
인디 개발사인 Deep Worlds가 개발한 격렬한 PvPvP 익스트랙션 슈팅 게임 Beautiful Light의 거친 세계로 들어서세요. 기동타격대의 대원으로 성장하거나, 다른 플레이어의 레이드를 무시무시한 이상현상으로 방해해 보세요. 눈길을 사로잡는 그래픽이 돋보이는 Beautiful Light는 몰입감, 호러, 전술 게임플레이에 집중한 게임입니다. 이 게임은 가파른 학습곡선을 적용해 플레이어를 극한으로 밀어붙여 스릴 넘치는 환경에서 자신의 능력을 시험해 볼 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

진입하고, 확보하고, 탈출하세요.
// 진입

진입 지역에 맞설 준비를 단단히 하고, 신비로운 아티팩트를 찾거나 퀘스트를 완료하세요. 다양한 무기, 방어구, 보조화기로 무장하고 두 명의 대원과 팀을 이루세요. 전승, 방해물, 위험으로 가득 찬 적대적인 환경에 진입해 탐험하세요. 적 대원과 기괴한 이상현상이 여러분을 쓰러뜨리기 위해서라면 뭐든지 할 것입니다. 각 레이드는 고유한 속성을 지니니, 미지의 세계에 맞설 준비를 하세요.
// 확보

아티팩트는 이용할 수 있는 다양한 속성을 지닙니다. 이토록 황폐한 세계에서 자원 이용은 곧 도시의 생존과 직결되죠. 아티팩트는 매우 귀중하니 누구보다 먼저 확보해야 합니다. 여러분의 앞길을 가로막는 모든 적을 제거해야만 하죠. 누군가 이 아티팩트를 손에 넣었나요? 아티팩트를 확보하는 이가 여러분이 되도록 하세요.

죽게 되면 임무는 실패하고, 손에 넣은 모든 것을 잃게 됩니다. 일단 조명탄을 쏘고 구출 헬기를 부르고, 무언가가 여러분을 처치하기 전에 탈출하세요. 아티팩트가 있든 없든 말이죠. 어찌되었든 때론 당신의 목숨은 이상한 돌이나 친구보다 더 소중합니다. 구출 헬기가 도착할 때까지 살아남고 숨어 있는 다른 위협에 주의하세요.

게임을 진행하려면 퀘스트를 완료하고, 아티팩트를 확보하고 살아서 탈출하세요. 상인들이 임무를 완료하기를 기다리고 있습니다. 그들을 실망시키지 마세요. 두둑한 보상을 챙겨줄 테니까요. RPG 게임 같은 테크트리에서 보상을 현명하게 사용하여 캐릭터 레벨을 올리고 기술을 향상시키거나, 상인에게서 다음 레이드를 위한 무기와 희귀한 장비를 구매하세요.

이형체로서의 목표는 플레이어를 사냥하고, 죽이고, 먹어 치워 그들이 유물을 가지고 탈출하는 것을 막는 것입니다. 이형체를 해방하고 가능한 많은 플레이어를 먹어 경험치를 획득하세요. 기술을 향상시키고 더 많은 능력을 얻으며 새로운 괴물 같은 이형체들을 잠금 해제하세요.

title: Dread Pilots
description:
게임 정보
From Klei Entertainment, creators of Don't Starve, Invisible Inc, and Griftlands comes Dread Pilots, a new space survival exploration sandbox game.
You are a Dread Pilot, an unfortunate soul trapped in a dangerous and uncaring purgatory with only your wits to aid you in your quest to escape.
WELCOME TO THE DREAD
The Dread is a pocket dimension somewhere between deep space and a nightmare. You face mutated, carnivorous plant life, mind-bending anomalies, living computers, fanatical cults, space vampires and more as you traverse its many regions in a desperate search for resources and allies. Explore dark infected caverns, soar past glistening technological landscapes, and navigate chaotic mineral fields, all animated in Klei Entertainment's signature hand-drawn 2D style.
SURVIVAL AT ALL COSTS
The life of a Dread pilot is short and cheap. Combat can pay off if you have the advantage, but it’s perilous if you don't. Explore carefully, judge the risks well, and always keep an eye on your tenuous connection to reality or you may just find yourself blown to pieces - or worse. Sometimes information gathering, trade, and diplomacy is the more prudent option.

title: Mayhem Brawler II: Best of Both Worlds
description:
게임 정보
90년대 아케이드 분위기와 현대적인 로그라이트/RPG 메커니즘이 환상적인 조화를 이루는 시간 전이 테마의 벨트스크롤 액션 게임입니다. 혼자서 또는 친구들과 온라인으로 플레이하고, 원하는 대로 선택을 내려 스토리를 구성해 보세요. 만화에서 영감을 받은 수작업 아트와 프레임 단위의 애니메이션 캐릭터들, 그리고 강렬한 사운드트랙을 즐겨보세요.

한 번에 만날 수 있는 두 세계
20년이나 떨어진 두 시대에서 동시에 전개되는 사건들을 확인해 보세요! 한쪽에는 전설적인 스트롱홀드 요원 스텔라, 다른 한쪽에는 시장 선거에 출마한 사나운 쉬울프가 등장합니다. 메이헴 시티의 어두운 비밀을 파헤치기 위한 둘의 여정이 시작됩니다.
시대를 초월하는 경험
두 시간대의 캐릭터를 오가면서 과거와 현재의 적들을 동시에 맞서 보세요.
로그라이트와 RPG 요소가 클래식한 벨트스크롤 액션 메커니즘과 완벽한 조화를 이뤄, 매 회차마다 풍부한 엔드 게임 콘텐츠와 다양한 게임플레이 경험을 즐길 수 있습니다.

게임 특징
90년대 아케이드 분위기와 현대적인 메커니즘의 환상적인 조화
autokwd: Mayhem Brawler II: Best of Both Worlds

title: Ascent Quest
description:
게임 정보
Ascent Quest is currently in development, join us on social media and Discord to follow the latest news, devlogs and participate in the discussions !
Ascent Quest brings together the best of virtual reality and online cooperative role-playing in this high fantasy universe.
Become the main actor in an adventure-packed fantasy story through a highly detailed world. From the goblin to the most majestic dragon, fight formidable enemies by teaming up with your friends or with new people met at the bend of a tavern.
Exploration & Story
A colorful universe of high fantasy that is a real treat for your eyes and your desire for adventure.
Rich in story and in varied environments, visit an incredible world inviting you to explore its every corner to discover many secrets.
Save Aelys from a tragedy whose scope goes far beyond anything you could imagine. Endearing characters, unexpected twists. All supported by voice dubbing of the main story and numerous possible interactions with the world.
Engaging fights
Mage, warrior, archer, defender, assassin? Your character, your personality. Access a unique specialization system allowing you to decide precisely how you prefer to fight by combining classes.
Face epic battles requiring you to coordinate with other players to take down powerful enemies in actions that make full use of virtual reality strengths. Reap the reward for your labor with unique items and rank up in the Adventurer's Guild!
Meet other players
Want to take a break from fighting or just socialize ?
Take part in a vibrant economy, trade with players, build your wealth and buy your own personnalizable home. Why not create a club where you can invite other players to have fun ?
Enter the taverns and meet new people to laugh and have fun with mini-games while displaying the trophies of your latest achievements!

title: T.K. Punk - G.O.L.D
description:
게임 정보
Background Story
"Three Kingdoms Punk" is the third game from Sunny Game, and we aim to offer a unique role-playing experience to everyone.
We've packed the entire Three Kingdoms world into a cyber city where East meets West, and poverty coexists with wealth -- HanKong City (a play on Hong Kong).
The traditional Eastern Han regime from the Three Kingdoms is reimagined as a super villain group ruling the entire city -- D.H.C (Dong Han Corporation, East Han Group).
The three powers of Wei, Shu, and Wu are transformed into factions of Heaven, Man, and Earth, seemingly in harmony with D.H.C but actually in conflict, controlling various resources of the city.
The Yellow Turban group, often portrayed as villains in most Three Kingdoms games, becomes the protagonist team in this game -- GOLD (a pun on 'Yellow Turban').
Players must lead the GOLD team, ostensibly running the Gold Bar, but secretly undertaking various commissions. In this cyber Three Kingdoms city, they must carve out a path of blood to realize their dreams of love and destruction.

About Gameplay
The game progresses in turns, each with limited action points.
Players invest in character development, equipment research, work dispatch, companion training, and commission execution.
There are 13 characters with different personalities and genders to develop and achieve companion endings with.
The main storyline leads to four major directions based on the player's relationship with the Heaven, Earth, and Man factions.
autokwd: T.K. Punk - G.O.L.D,三国朋克: 爱与破坏之神

title: Time To Wake Up
description:
게임 정보


Time To Wake Up is an atmospheric psychological thriller where one night you find yourself stuck in a dream. No worries, though. You are not alone. You hear a voice, in need of your eyes and willing to help you out.
Blinking is thinking



Your sight is your light at the end of the tunnel. Blink and rearrange your surroundings, reset all motion, flood whole rooms, or turn them around.



Even with your sight, even if you're not alone, do watch your step. Your dream can be foggy. You never know what exactly is around the corner during your trip down memory lane.



Didn't we already warn you to watch your step? Do watch it before it falls off the stairs or other dark places your mind might take you to!



Time To Wake Up takes you through various school environments. Imagine lively libraries, perplexing playgrounds, tense toilets, and more...All connected by absurd hallways and strange classrooms.

title: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World
description:
게임 정보


The story takes place in the year 2997. You play as Apranik. Your mission is to travel to the planet Thulcandra in search of a crucial item: the Angel’s Egg, a very ancient artifact believed to be the source of all life in the Universe. You journey through the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a now dead civilization.

"Flesh and bones writhing and weaving into a turmoil of organic anarchy. And appendages propelling the aberration towards me, as it crawled on an onyx mucus-like substance which itself seemed to possess life on its own."





- Deploy an arsenal of melee and ranged psychokinetic weapons to vanquish even the most merciless foe.



- Deep and evocative narrative and lore.



- Explore a massive underground complex, evoking feelings of solitude and loneliness one would expect while infiltrating a hostile alien planet alone.
- Engaging gameplay systems fine-tuned to intensify exploration, immersion, and replay value.



- Dynamic environments which can be influenced directly by the player's actions.
- Unearth artifacts containing the recorded chronicles of an ancient alien civilization.
autokwd: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World

title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss
description:
게임 정보

2053년. 전 세계적으로 오컬트의 위협이 점점 더 노골적으로 드러나고 있고, 이상하고 이해할 수 없는 사건들이 증가하고 있습니다. 지구 표면의 자원이 서서히 고갈됨에 따라 강력한 기업들이 미지의 해저 깊은 곳으로 눈을 돌리지만, 그들이 깨우게 될 고대의 공포는 미처 알지 못합니다.


이토록 긴장감 넘치는 러브크래프트 스타일 스릴러에서 플레이어는 노아가 되어 태평양 심해에서 광부들이 사라진 미스터리를 조사하게 됩니다. 노아가 된 당신은 AI 동료인 키의 도움을 받아 고대에 침몰한 웅장했던 도시, 르뤼에의 거대한 미로 같은 감옥을 탐험하며, 크룰루의 영향으로 서서히 다가오는 광기를 견뎌야 합니다. 그 중심에는 현실에 대한 이해를 산산이 부술 수 있는 비밀이 숨겨져 있습니다.


악몽과 우주의 괴물이 당신을 정신적 한계까지 몰아갈 테니 이들과 맞서세요. 러브크래프트 신화를 미래적으로 재해석한 세계를 여행하며 전설 속에 침몰한 도시, 르뤼에를 발견할 수 있습니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 더 깊이 잠수할수록 크룰루의 영향이 끝없이 정신을 잠식합니다.

AI 동료 키와 함께 어둠 속으로 뛰어드세요. 단서를 따라가며 흩어진 증거를 모으고, 추리력을 연마하여 복잡한 퍼즐을 몰입감 있게 해결해 보세요. 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀내고 보이는 것 너머의 진실을 탐구하여 사건 해결로 가는 길을 선택하세요. 모든 미스터리에는 각각 갈림길과 비밀 통로가 있어 발견되기를 기다리고 있습니다

인터폴의 오컬트 사건 전문 비밀 부서인 안실의 요원으로서, 당신은 영화 같은 스토리텔링을 통해 복잡한 캐릭터들이 생동감 있게 그려진 몰입형 이야기 속에 빨려 들어가게 됩니다. 1인칭 공포 탐사형 어드벤처에 몰입해 보세요. 이 악몽 같은 세상에서는 풍부한 분기형 내러티브 속에서 당신의 선택과 이해가 노아의 운명을 결정합니다.


언리얼 엔진 5로 구동되는 는 물리 법칙을 초월하여 환상적인 환경을 제공하며, 몰입형 스토리텔링의 한계를 새로운 차원으로 끌어올립니다.

title: GameChanger - Episode 1
description:
게임 정보
영원한 실패의 순환을 깨세요!
중간세계는 오랫동안 경직된 상태에 있었습니다. 위대한 포털들의 집단 지능과 그들 하인들의 지속적인 존재는 주민들이 자신들의 세계를 절대 떠나지 못하게 합니다. 하지만 레이드 프로그램은 그 창조자의 계획을 끈질기게 따릅니다. 반복되는 바이러스의 도움으로, 그는 모든 포털을 닫고 끝없는 드래곤을 물리쳐 자신의 임무를 완수하고 중간세계에서 빠져나갈 방법을 가능하게 하려고 합니다.
중간세계를 탐험하세요!
GameChanger는 트윈 스틱 슈터 전투와 퍼즐 요소가 있는 2D 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다. 중간세계의 해방자로서, 당신은 레이드가 이끄는 바이러스 역할을 맡습니다. 바이러스는 떠다니며 이동하고 발사체를 사용하여 적을 물리치고, 스위치를 활성화하는 등 다양한 일을 할 수 있습니다. 선형적인 시작 지역 이후에는 작지만 훌륭한 오픈 월드가 기다리고 있으며, 그곳에서 세 개의 던전을 발견하고 어떤 순서로든 완료하여 드래곤에 맞설 수 있습니다. 던전 외에도, 퍼즐 해결, 미니게임, 전투 아레나 및 기타 활동을 통해 얻을 수 있는 많은 선택적 업그레이드가 세계 곳곳에 숨겨져 있습니다. 모든 업그레이드를 획득함으로써, 당신은 주요 여정을 더 쉽게 만들 뿐만 아니라 중간세계와 레이드의 이야기에 대해 더 많이 배울 수 있습니다!

title: Screamer
description:
게임 정보
열망, 야망, 복수.
신념을 위해 맞서 싸우고, 그것이 싸울 가치가 있다는 사실을 증명하세요. 세상에서 가장 가혹한 레이싱 대회와 수수께끼의 대회 마스터 뒤에 감춰진 어두운 진실을 밝혀내는 것이 모든 Screamer의 사명입니다.
극한의 레이싱과 결투 메커니즘이 결합된 전투를 시작하고, 인상적인 캐릭터가 등장하는 매력적인 이야기를 진행하세요. 도로에서 멋진 차를 몰고 애니메이션에서 영감을 받은 세상에 숨겨진 비밀을 알아내세요.

title: Space Chaos
description:
게임 정보
Objective: Deliver unpredictable cargo at all costs, no matter the challenges!
Cosmic Chaos: Navigate absurd cosmic environments filled with unexpected threats.
Teamwork: Collaborate with your crew to keep the ship running and handle emergencies.
Reputation: Unlock new sectors and upgrade your ship.
DELIVER THE CARGO, AT ALL COSTS
Your mission is simple: deliver your unpredictable cargo to its destination, no matter what. Unexpected challenges await, but the cargo must arrive safe and sound.

IN THE HEART OF CHAOS
Embark on a journey into cosmic unknowns, where absurdity reigns and chaos lurks at every turn. Navigate through wacky and varied environments: asteroid fields, alien attacks, cosmic whales, and other bizarre phenomena that can quickly upend your mission.

title: Rebirth x Reverse Mana
description:
게임 정보
Hugh, a calm and collected boy, and Amity, a bright and cheerful girl, graduate from secondary school and enter a magick school.
Having lived in a non-magick world, the two are bewildered but intend to learn magick and study to become full-fledged sorcerers...
The older sorcerers with strong habits have their own agendas, and their agendas overlap and become a swell that engulfs the sorcerer world.
===
Players control Hugh or Amity, who are enrolled in a magic school, and aim for great heights as a sorcerer while befriending teachers, seniors, and classmates.
The main game stage is a competition against other characters, and the stage is cleared when someone defeats the boss at the top of the map.
The player gains Mana from the land on the map to strengthen the attributes of fire, water, earth, and wind, while defeating monsters to join their ranks.
Items obtained during movement and exploration can be used to battle monsters and strengthen spirits.
By using items effectively, it is important to strengthen players efficiently and take on bosses before other characters.
Play through the game stages and grow little by little to become the strongest magician.

title: Tetris Cat and Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
한때, 던전에 살고 있는 사악한 생물들은 고양이 부족의 고향을 끊임없이 침략하여 보물과 자원을 빼앗았습니다. 자신의 영토를 방어하고 잃어버린 부를 되찾기 위해 용감한 고양이 전사들은 던전에 들어가 이 적들을 물리치고 영광을 되찾기로 결심했습니다.

테트리스 고양이와 던전은 슬레이 더 스파이어와 고전적인 테트리스 메커니즘을 결합한 게임입니다. 여기서 당신은 테트리스 블록을 제거하여 적에게 피해를 입히고 다양한 효과를 발동시킬 수 있습니다. 방의 모든 적을 물리친 후에는 세 가지 새로운 블록 중 하나를 선택하여 컬렉션에 추가하여 전투력을 점진적으로 증가시킬 수 있습니다.
특징
강력한 블록을 수집하고 업그레이드：몬스터와 보스를 물리쳐 블록을 획득하고 강력한 조합을 만들어보세요。독특한 전투 메커니즘：테트리스 블록을 제거하여 적에게 피해를 입히고 특수 효과를 발동시킵니다。무작위로 생성된 던전：매번 새로운 맵, 적, 놀라운 일들이 당신을 기다리고 있습니다。풍부한 이벤트와 상점：모험 중 다양한 이벤트와 상점을 만나 새로운 블록과 자원을 획득하세요。
전략적 빌딩：블록을 현명하게 조합하고 배치하여 강력한 전략을 만들어 적을 물리치고 게임을 클리어하세요。

이 모험에 참여하여 강력한 블록 조합을 구성하고 던전의 모든 적을 물리쳐 고양이 부족의 영광과 부를 되찾으세요！
autokwd: Tetris Cat and Dungeon,테트리스 고양이와 던전

title: World Turned Stone: Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
This is the prologue for the full game and it includes the first stage of terraforming the world from the beginning of the apocalypse.
Prologue owners will get a special discount on the full game.
Civilization has turned STONE.
Revive the people, terraform the world, defend against the apocalypse, and rebuild civilization from the stone age to advanced technology!
Dust and statues are all that’s left - it’s up to you now, survivor.
A Survival Crafting Base Building Game
Gather dust and craft your way up to rebuilding civilization, from the stone age to advanced technology.
Revive people from the stone and build homes for them to work at your base.
Build new workstations and machines.
Make water and food to maintain your character in the harsh apocalypse.
Defend your base against mutants from the apocalypse using melee/ranged weapons and defense structures like wooden spikes and castle walls.
Terraform the world by building machines to alter the atmosphere and watch the world transform to its original state.

title: Aegis Force: The Scorian War
description:
게임 정보
Tactical victory or agonizing defeat… The choice is yours —
Battle your way through the continent of Ianua with your force of heroes in tactical combat encounters that take place on a grid, reminiscent of games such as Fire Emblem, Final Fantasy Tactics and Shining Force. 
As Callon, use the powers of a Tactimagus to make every move count. Utilize a myriad of spells, attacks, and abilities across your ever-expanding team to forge your victory across dozens of increasingly complex strategic battles.
Battler together with other members of your force to build up your bond, then unlock and employ devastating tach attacks together!

title: Dragons Brew
description:
게임 정보
Dragons Brew is a captivating boardgame cafe simulation game where you can create and manage your very own cozy cafe. Drawing inspiration from beloved games like Stardew Valley and Traveller’s Rest, Dragons Brew combines charming pixel art with engaging simulation mechanics.

In Dragons Brew, you’ll experience the thrill of running a cafe with a unique twist: offering takeaway services, door deliveries, and an innovative boardgame system that impacts both the cafe operations and the overall gameplay!
Variety of Recipes: Serve Delicious Meals and Drinks

In Dragons Brew, you’ll have access to a wide range of recipes to create delightful meals and beverages for your customers. From classic coffee and tea to exotic pastries and gourmet dishes, each recipe will have unique ingredients and preparation methods. Master the art of cooking and brewing to keep your customers happy and coming back for more.
Expand Your Boardgame Collection: Unlock New Boardgames with Unique Effects

As you progress in Dragons Brew, you’ll unlock an extensive collection of boardgames, each offering unique gameplay mechanics and effects on your cafe. Whether it’s increasing customer satisfaction, boosting your cafe’s popularity, or providing special bonuses, every boardgame will add a new layer of strategy and fun to your cafe management experience.
Quest System: Engage with the Community Through Diverse Quests

Engage with the lively community in Dragons Brew by completing a variety of quests. From helping locals with their requests to organizing special events in your cafe, these quests will offer rewards and unlock new content. Build relationships with the townsfolk, gain their trust, and enhance your cafe’s reputation through meaningful interactions and quests.
Day-Night Cycle and Seasons: Dynamic Changes Affecting Gameplay and Strategy

Experience the passage of time with a realistic day-night cycle and changing seasons in Dragons Brew. Each time of day and season will bring different challenges and opportunities, affecting customer preferences, ingredient availability, and event possibilities. Adapt your strategies to thrive in every situation and make the most of each moment.

Immerse yourself in the stunning pixel art world of Dragons Brew. Every detail, from the quaint seaside village to the cozy interiors of your cafe, is meticulously crafted to create a visually enchanting experience. Explore the charming town, interact with its quirky inhabitants, and uncover hidden secrets as you expand your cafe empire.

Express your unique style in Dragons Brew by customizing your avatar. Choose from a variety of hairstyles, outfits, and accessories to create a character that reflects your personality. As you progress, unlock more customization options to keep your avatar fresh and fashionable.

Transform your cafe into the ultimate boardgame hub with extensive customization and expansion options in Dragons Brew. Decorate your cafe with a wide range of furniture, decor, and thematic elements. Expand your space through the local estate agent to accommodate more customers, add new features, and enhance the overall ambiance to attract a diverse clientele.

In Dragons Brew, you can grow your own ingredients to use in your recipes. Cultivate a variety of crops, from herbs and vegetables to rare and magical plants. Harvest your produce and ensure a steady supply of fresh ingredients.

Expand your horizons in Dragons Brew by discovering new areas beyond your cafe. Explore neighbouring towns, enchanting forests, retail parks, coffee roasteries and boardgame conventions. Each new location will offer unique challenges, ingredients, and opportunities for your cafe. Uncover the secrets of these areas and integrate their unique elements into your cafe’s offerings.

The world of Dragons Brew is ever-growing, with new boardgames and recipes continuously being added. Stay updated with regular content updates that introduce new boardgames with exciting mechanics and fresh recipes to keep your menu dynamic. Your cafe will always have something new to offer, ensuring endless fun and engagement for you and your customers.

title: ICE on the EDGE
description:
게임 정보
최고봉의 무대를 향해 나아가라! 피겨 스케이터 육성 시뮬레이션
당신은 피겨 스케이터의 코치가 되어 선수를 육성하고,
세계 최고 수준의 대회인 「온 더 엣지」에서 우승을 쟁취하게 됩니다.
개성 넘치는 캐릭터와 아름다운 3D 그래픽으로 전개되는 육성 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
선수의 프로그램을 구성하자
대회에서 선보일 음악, 의상, 기술은 코치인 당신이 직접 선택합니다.
선수의 능력을 충분히 살려 안정적인 구성으로 승부할 것인가?
아니면 위험을 감수하고 고난도 기술에 도전해 단숨에 역전을 노릴 것인가?
선택은 오로지 당신의 판단에 달려 있습니다.
선수의 실력과 잠재력을 파악해, 최고의 프로그램을 완성해 보세요.
대회에 출전하자
육성한 선수를 이끌고 대회에 도전하세요!
당신이 지시한 프로그램대로 선수가 연기를 펼치며, 순위를 두고 경쟁합니다.
선수를 믿고, 승리를 기원해 보세요!
멀티 스토리 & 멀티 엔딩
라이벌들과의 경쟁, 경기의 승패, 그리고 선수의 성장……
이 모든 요소가 이야기를 다양한 방향으로 이끌어 가며, 다채로운 결말을 만들어 냅니다.
당신의 지도와 선택에 따라 어떤 드라마가 전개될까요?
최고의 엔딩을 목표로, 당신만의 피겨 스케이팅 이야기를 완성해 보세요.
전략적 육성과 캐릭터 드라마가 융합된 본 작품.
정상을 향해 나아가는 뜨거운 여정을, 직접 체험해 보시기 바랍니다.

title: Goal Poacher VR: Football Header Simulator
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 현재 Meta Quest 스토어에서 얼리 액세스로 이용 가능합니다!
최고의 스트라이커가 되어 세계적인 수비수와 골키퍼를 상대로 멋진 헤더 골을 넣는 몰입형 축구 경험을 즐기세요.
주요 특징:
득점자가 되세요: 다양한 상황에서 헤더로 골을 넣고 팀을 승리로 이끄세요.
autokwd: Goal Poacher VR: Football Header Simulator

title: Squadron
description:
게임 정보
Squadron immerses you in a dark and mysterious universe where a multitude of questions can hide. It's up to you to find the answers to the puzzles that will arise, but be careful you will have to travel beyond the limits of the software, which knows a Redit post, or even a steam account can hide answers. Arm yourself with a web browser and a good coffee, it's a safe bet that you will experience a more than eventful journey through this private military network.

You will be the hero of a story that unfolds around you in YOUR world who may know that this game is in fact very real.

title: Limitless
description:
게임 정보
Step into the breathtaking world of Limitless ("Formerly known as Apeiron"), an open-world, third-person, story-driven action RPG set in the mystical Realm of Eternity. Experience a richly crafted high-fantasy universe filled with danger, discovery, and dynamic gameplay.
Build Your Dream Team of Heroes
Lead a squad of four remarkable companions, each with their own strengths, skills, and customizable gear. Strategically swap between characters in real-time to overcome challenges, solve mysteries, and turn the tide of battle in your favor.

title: Astrostrike
description:
게임 정보
This is a realistic simulation physics universe shooting game, where all enemies are realistically shattered according to mechanics. The game features ray tracing and deeply optimized performance.
Battery layout: You need to purchase various types of batteries and place them in the spacecraft. Reasonably utilize the strengths of combat spacecraft.
Special tower layout: You need to arrange various functional towers purchased or obtained on the spacecraft, such as special units for generating protective covers, space radars for detecting distant enemies, etc.
Special Weapon Use: Right clicking with the mouse will activate the special weapon. There are dozens of special weapons obtained from maps and hoarded, or produced by planetary bases. For example, nuclear warheads and cluster bombs.
Accessories and Enhancements: The game offers hundreds of devices and parts that can strengthen turrets, spaceships, and special weapons. The game requires constant selection and can only be temporarily strengthened. Outside of the game, it will be permanently strengthened.
Planet building: You will conquer countless planets and build military bases, research laboratories, mining bases, oil exploration wells, farmland, and more on mineral rich planets. Games have certain elements of management and cultivation.
Continuously explore various scenes, encounter powerful bosses, aliens, and peculiar enemies, and fight against them. Collect various rare minerals and plants. Spaceships often shuttle through various narrow scenes, as well as in super large scenes such as planetary accretion disks, with a wide variety of types and endless possibilities.
The game emphasizes advanced gaming skills and strategies. There are countless types of spacecraft, fighter jets, turrets, special towers, parts, components, and special weapons in the game, each with its own significance.
The game supports all languages, and most languages such as English and Chinese have very good and appropriate translations

title: Buratino
description:
게임 정보
Buratino is a 2D arcade game with light adventure elements for the ZX Spectrum 8-bit computer. It is loosely based on the characters and storyline from the book by same title by Alexei Tolstoi, a well-known Russian author, renowned mostly for his early science fiction and historical prose.

title: Valkyrie: Rosetta
description:
게임 정보
This 2D action role-playing game blends platforming exploration with a turn-based strategic button timed battle system, offering an immersive combat experience that demands both strategy and reflexes. With a deep narrative, diverse character abilities, and a tactical battle system, players will uncover the mysteries of the past while shaping the destiny of their fallen warriors.
STORY
After dying in a war, Rosetta awakens to find herself reborn with the divine power of a Valkyrie. With no memory of how or why she was granted this fate, she embarks on a journey alongside her Einherjars (warriors bound to her service) to uncover the secrets behind her resurrection. As she battles formidable foes, navigates political schemes, and unravels ancient mysteries, she must reconcile her existence as both a human and a goddess, walking the fine line between mortality and divinity.
GAMEPLAY
This 2D RPG platformer offers fast-paced exploration and dynamic turn-based combat infused with button-mashing mechanics. Players will:
Control a party of unique characters, each with their own abilities, stats, and combat roles.
Engage in high-intensity battles, where well-timed inputs determine attack success, skill execution, and defensive maneuvers.

title: Horn of Balance
description:
게임 정보
Oh no!!
Your sweet and caring grandmama has been kidnapped by the villain "Heimgartner" and his group of thugs! It falls upon your shoulders, as the young golem "Linden", to go in pursuit and brave a plethora of labyrinthine dungeons to set things right again!
- How can a golem have a grandmother?
- Who are these villains and why are they doing such terrible things?
- And what is the story with that quirky floating skull following you, called "Murray"?
All will be revealed in the full game.
Features
Classic Zelda-like gameplay with fresh surprises
A big assortment of large and varied dungeons
Non-linear level and world design, ripe for sequence breaking
A gripping story with twists and turns
Secrets hidden everywhere!
Modern conveniences like auto-saves and button remapping
Murray!! (You'll all love him instantly, or so he keeps confidently proclaiming)
WISHLIST NOW to discover a brand new world of secrets and adventure!
-------------------------------------
UPDATE  16 March 2025:
Check out the latest monthly Kickstarter update.
Haven't missed a single one since the campaign. There's constant progress being made.

title: Planetbase 2
description:
게임 정보
Planetbase 2 is not just the sequel to the original Planetbase, but also the spiritual successor to Dawn of Man. The game is currently work in progress and we expect to launch in early 2027. You can follow our devlog on X or Bluesky (see links on the right hand side).
Please note all images and video are work in progress and not representative of the final quality of the product.
Colonize The Solar System
Colonize Mars, The Moon and other worlds of the Solar System. Each world posing a different and increasingly difficult challenge.
Mine and Manufacture
Make use of in-situ resources in order to build a self sustaining colony. Harvest regolith, mine metals, establish manufacturing industries and do whatever it takes for your colony to survive and thrive.
Harness the power of Nature
Collect energy from whatever sources are available in each world. Develop the systems required to harvest and store energy from The Sun, Wind, Nuclear and more.
Research Technologies
Unlock both local and Earth-based technologies in order to build larger and more efficient colonies.
Construct Vehicles and Robots
Manufacture or import vehicles and robots that will aid with the hardest tasks in the settlement and will increase your chances of survival.

title: Primitive Environment Survival
description:
게임 정보
This is a 2d card survival game
Come to the primitive environment wilderness to survive alone, and survive here by collecting and crafting items.
Has a rich weather system sunny, cloudy, cloudy, light rain, moderate rain, heavy rain, heavy rain, heavy rain, typhoon, light snow, moderate snow, heavy snow, blizzard
The protagonist has attributes such as moisture, fullness, state of mind, energy, cold, heat, vomiting, diarrhea, poisoning, fever, protein, weight, etc.
Have a 24-hour time system, walk fast during the day, and walk slowly at night, making it easier to encounter wild animals.
Has a rich crafting system Axe, fire, shelter, spear, knife, house, kiln
Gridded map, gradually open the surrounding environment.

title: ShotFightDisaster
description:
게임 정보
















ShotFightDisaster (SFD) convinces with its tactical, team-based and action-packed gameplay.

We offer different game modes(deathmatch, equal opportunity...).

You can expect a turn-based gameplay experience, in which there are many ways to be victorious:

- Win a round by robbing gold, gems, cash or silver and getting your loot safely to the rescue zone.
- Win a round by successfully carrying out a hit.
- Win a round by eliminating all enemies.

Compete offline against bots or online in multiplayer mode (deathmatch, equal opportunity...) against the world's elite.

This is the biggest conflict the world has ever seen, for this we need the greatest warriors.

title: Coraland: the worst rescuer
description:
게임 정보
Help Joris save Pon-Pon Island in an adventure filled with puzzles, mini-games and secrets.

Contains:

■ +40 Puzzles and Mini-games!
■ Charming Characters!
■ 4 different areas with their own boss and secrets!
■ An exciting story about heroism and growth!



The controls are simple and the puzzles have been designed to be accessible for all ages, without outside knowledge to solve them.

title: RAGINGSTRIKE
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Master the three weapons that change according to the humanoid robot form and fighter form, destroy the scattered enemy attack targets, and finally defeat the boss standing in your way!
Story
The planet EARTHENTIA, a star system in a faraway galaxy, has prospered by building numerous colonial space colonies and expanding its living sphere into outer space.
Conflict with the colony government over the resource satellite "EN-175" discovered during planetary exploration, and the unmanned weapons group that became a negative legacy in the war evolved and suddenly turned against humanity and became an enemy of humanity. came to be called "Thanatos" (Death), and stood up to destroy it with two state-of-the-art weapons VFA and all military strength.
points
・Gamepad support
・ Omni-directional free scroll stg
that can scroll in any direction of the player
・Combine the power and performance of 3D with the simple operability of 2D
・Exhilarating game balance with high-speed development
・7 stages in total
・Two unique types of operable aircraft

title: Vampire vs Devil
description:
게임 정보
적들의 시체를 무기로 사용하세요. 문을 열기 위한 열쇠를 찾으세요. 더 빨리 진행하기 위해 속임수를 사용하세요. 한 번의 실수로 죽을 수 있지만, 지옥의 666단계를 통과하기 위해 필요한 만큼의 목숨이 있습니다. 최종 보스, 악마가 당신을 기다리고 있습니다. 그와 싸울 용기가 있습니까?

Vampire vs Devil은 구형 게임 콘솔과 유사한 픽셀 아트 레트로 그래픽을 특징으로 하는 무서운 2D 플랫폼 게임입니다. 목표는 적을 물리치고 666단계의 각 단계를 완료하는 것입니다. 계속 진행하려면 보스와 싸워서 그들을 물리쳐야 합니다. 보스 전투에서는 단 한 명만 살아남을 수 있습니다. 이길 만큼 똑똑하신가요?
특징:
666단계
12개의 세계
미스터리한 이야기
세밀한 레트로 그래픽
매우 반응이 좋은 게임 플레이
비밀
속임수
보스

컨트롤러, 키보드 또는 마우스로 플레이하세요

Vampire vs Devil - 단 한 명만 생존할 수 있습니다. 이 싸움에서 누가 이길까요?

Use their unique skills to traverse the world, gather equipment, build your shelter, build your skills and meet magical creatures. Live through the dynamically changing weather and adapt your strategies with your friends to thrive. Conquer the forces of dark magic and explore the extent of your platforming skills and more.

title: Battle Scars Eternal Stars

This is a simulation game where you play as a robot to explore a planet. You are free to drive vehicles, attack with weapons, and more advanced weapons; Such as controllable missiles....... In the official version you can also fish freely build, using the backpack system. Use the workbench to synthesize items, trade with merchants, and play remotely with other players (these features will only be available in the official version and may not be available in the beta). We tried to be as detailed as possible in what we implemented. For example, the player needs to manually open the door and use the move button to enter the interior of the car and interact with the control screen before driving the vehicle. Or a hedge engine that can be turned on manually. And streetlight fences that can be easily crushed and destroyed by vehicles and then extinguished after they shatter. But individual developers have limited energy, so don't expect too much

title: Self Simulated
description:
게임 정보
Self Simulated is an all-new action platformer for the Game Boy Color that thrusts you into the shoes of a robot version of yourself, awakening with no memory of your past. Guided by a mysterious voice in your head, you discover that you recently had a severe accident and your mind was transferred into a robot body. Your mission is to synchronize your new body with your mind by navigating through a high-tech facility filled with other robots and tricky obstacles and something that the voice in your head describes as the “glitch”.
Experience fluid and fast-paced gameplay with mechanics such as double jumping, wall jumps, dodge rolls, and dash attacks. Each level is a test of skill, where touching other robots or glitches results in an instant reboot, allowing for quick retries and maintaining a steady, engaging pace. The game features well over 100 meticulously designed levels, each auto-saving upon completion, making it perfect for quick gaming sessions.
Adjustable assist settings allow players of all skill levels to enjoy the game at their own pace, offering features like triple jumps, immunity to glitches, and auto-stomping enemies. Once you've completed the game, unlock the speedrun mode to challenge yourself with an in-game timer and minimal interruptions.
Uncover the truth behind your existence, experience the strange glitches and blackouts, and piece together the story of your past in this captivating journey. Will reaching 100% synchronization reveal everything? Dive into Self Simulated to find out.

title: Pitch Black
description:
게임 정보
Traverse a cave, factory, and other strange places within Pitch Black. Meet many horrific, monstrous, or simply strange creatures, some of which may help you along the way. Discover odd puzzles and mysteries yet to be solved. Can you find a way out and maybe help some new friends along the way?
Story Introduction
In a large, dark, damp cave, a child plays with his own echo, previously playing with his friends left behind outside. But, without any light to guide him, he trips on a small rock and falls to his side into a deep, dark pit. If he could see below himself, he would have noticed rocks below that would surely impale him–but they don’t. Instead, it stops and he ends up in a room with jagged stone walls wreaking a metallic smell. After a moment he finds a nearby chamberstick, a matchbox, and two locked cells nearby… what must he do now?
Run from the watchful eye, stay clear of the crawling corpse, and keep a lookout for any other creature you may run into in the first area. There is certainly something wrong with this place, and you must be the one to figure it out…

title: Argol II - Curse of Nemesis
description:
게임 정보
Argol II - Curse of Nemesis is an action, platform and adventure game. The action takes place in mythological times, after the battle against Kronoss (Argol - Kronoss' Castle).
Story
Nemesis, goddess of vengeance, offered Princess Harmony, guardian of the balance of the world, a mysterious bewitched necklace that plunged her into an eternal sleep. No one can wake her up and since that day, dark creatures have been spreading throughout the country to sow death and chaos. Argol, the young and valiant warrior, must take up his sword again to face this new threat and deliver Harmony from this curse.
Gameplay
In this episode, Argol will not be alone, Evandra the Amazon and Hyperion the demigod will be at his side. Three playable and interchangeable characters at any time. In addition to their common skills (jump, attack, climb, dash, etc.), each has their own abilities. Argol has powerful attacks (diving kick, energy ball, etc.), Evandra can use her whip as a grappling hook to cross dangerous areas, while Hyperion can activate an energy shield that makes him temporarily invincible.
A map will allow you to visualize your progress and choose the order in which you want to explore the different areas, and return to them if necessary.
To achieve your goals, you will therefore need to:
Explore 14 levels with their own enemies and their own atmospheres: dark forest, haunted cemetery, putrid swamps, abandoned temple, labyrinth, mysterious islands and a vast castle in which Nemesis hides.
Face 18 Bosses inspired by mythology.
Ride the legendary Pegasus during 6 Shoot 'em up phases.
Visit the city of Argos to get information from its inhabitants, buy equipment (main and secondary weapons, armor, potions, etc.) and improve your characters' skills.
Discover many magical objects essential to progress in your adventure.
Options and practical information
The game has an automatic save system.
Possibility to create several game parts.
4 languages (English, French, Spanish, Italian).

title: Chronos Phantasia
description:
게임 정보
In my dreams, a voice keeps calling me forward. I see fragments - a young man's face aging in an instant, the sun whispering secrets I can't quite hear. These visions feel like memories, but whose memories are they?

From the towering peak of Zion to the endless Sea of Tears, from the glittering spires of Arcadia to the vast desert beyond - a truth lies scattered across this vast realm. And somewhere out there, Res waits. A being whose existence seems to echo through time itself, bound to me by forces I don't yet understand.
Combat System
You can pick up and use anything around you as a weapon. If enemies hit you, they knock your weapon away. You can fight with your fists if you have no weapon. You can sneak past enemies or fight them.

In the sun, Zein becomes stronger. You can activate a burst mode that maximizes damage, and you can hear whispers from Verir.
Weapons have their own stories. When you hold a weapon, you can hear echoes of its past, with the intensity depending on the momentum bar. As players master timing and build spiritual connections with their weapons, ethereal souls manifest as combat companions.

Emotional States. Based on the story progression, party members will experience different emotional states, indicated by an icon. These emotions affect combat - for example, party members who are upset with you won’t perform combo finishers and might fight alone.
Momentum Bar. The longer you wield a weapon, the more the momentum and connection with the weapon increases. If the bar reaches its limit, you risk breaking the weapon. You can cool down the weapon by shaking it, but this will reduce the momentum to near zero, causing you to lose access to enhanced combos.

World and Story
Long ago, a being named Res led a rebellion against the immortal Eden race. His actions changed the world forever. Now you play as Zein, searching for your missing mother and uncovering your connection to these ancient events. The world is split into three realms: Arcadia, a grand city built around Mount Zion; the Sea of Tears, an endless shallow ocean filled with mysteries; and the Desert Wastes, where strange people with horns live among the burning sands. Each realm holds pieces of the truth about Res, the Eden, and your own past.
